text: Ahyɛse no Nyankopɔn bɔɔ sor nye asaase.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna asaase da hɔ pan a onnyi bɔbea biara; na isum agye bun no enyi: na Nyankopɔn no sunsum butuw nsu no enyi
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Ekan mbra: na ekan bae.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn hun kan no dɛ oye: na Nyankopɔn tseew kan no fii sum no ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Ɔfrɛɛ ekan no Adzekyee, na isum no Adzesaa. Na adze sae na adze kyee, da a odzi kan nye no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Wɔmma wimu mbra nsu no finimfin, na wɔmma ɔntsew nsu no mu ebien: na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn yɛɛ wimu no, na ɔtseew nsu a ɔwɔ wimu no n’ase no fii nsu a ɔwɔ wimu no no sor no ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn frɛɛ wimu no ɔsor. Na adze sae na adze kyee, da a otsia ebien nye no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Wɔmma nsu a ɔwɔ sor n’ase no mpra nkɔboa fakor na wɔmma wewewdo nyi noho: na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn frɛɛ wewewdo no Asaase; na nsu no no mboano no ɔfrɛɛ no Epo: na Nyankopɔn hun dɛ oye.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Asaase mfifir efuw, nhaban a wɔsow aba, na ndua a wɔsow nduaba dɛ mbrɛ hɔn su tse, wɔ asaase do: na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.
title: GENESIS

text: Na asaase fifiir efuw, haban a ɔsow aba dɛ mbrɛ no su tse: na Nyankopɔn hun dɛ oye.
title: GENESIS

text: Na adze sae na adze kyee, da a otsia ebiasa nye no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Nkandzea mbra wimu mbeyi adzekyee mfi adzesaa ho: na ɔnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye mbernkyekyɛmu, nye nda nye mfe:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔnyɛ nkandzea wɔ wimu nhyerɛn asaase do: na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn yɛɛ nkandzea akɛse ebien; kandzea kɛse no dɛ ɔnhwɛ adzekyee do, na kakraba no dɛ ɔnhwɛ adzesaa do: na ɔyɛɛ nworaba so.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn dze sisii wimu dɛ wɔnhyerɛn asaase do,
title: GENESIS

text: na wɔnhwɛ adzekyee nye adzesaa do, na wonyi kan mfi sum ho: na Nyankopɔn hun dɛ oye.
title: GENESIS

text: Na adze sae na adze kyee, da a otsia anan nye no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Nsu no mu mbra mbowa ahorow pii na ntumbowa so nkyin asaase do wɔ sor.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn bɔɔ esumbowa akɛse no, nkakramba na ahorow pii, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn su tsetsee, na ntumbowa nyinara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn su tsetsee: na Nyankopɔn hun dɛ oye.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn hyiraa hɔn see dɛ, Hom nwo, na hom ndɔr, na hom nhyɛ po mu nsu mu ma, na ntumbowa ndɔr wɔ asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na adze sae na adze kyee, da a otsia enum nye no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Asaase ndɔr mbowa a nkwa wɔ hɔn mu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn su tsetsee, fiembowa, nye nketsebowa, nye asaase mbowadoma dɛ mbrɛ hɔn su tsetsee: na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn yɛɛ asaase do mbowadoma dɛ mbrɛ hɔn su tsetsee, na Nyankopɔn hun dɛ oye.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Wɔmma yɛnyɛ nyimpa wɔ hɛn su do, wɔ hɛn saso do: na wonya tum wɔ po mu nam, nye wimu ntumbowa, nye fiembowa, nye mbowa a wɔwea asaase do nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn bɔɔ nyimpa wɔ nankasa no su do, Nyew, Nyankopɔn no su do na ɔbɔɔ nyimpa; ɔbɔɔ hɔn ɔbanyin nye ɔbaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn hyiraa hɔn: na Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nwo, na hom ndɔr, na hom nhyɛ asaase ma, na hom ndzi do tum. Hom nya tum wɔ po mu nam do, nye wimu ntumbowa do, nye asaase do mbowa nyinara do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Hwɛ, mama hom nduadzewa na nduaba a ɔwɔ asaase nyinara enyi, dɛ ɔnyɛ edziban mma hom:
title: GENESIS

text: na asaase do mbowadoma nyinara nye wimu ntumbowa nyinara dze, mama hɔn sar na nhaban nhaban dɛ wondzi: na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn hun adze a ɔayɛ nyinara, na hwɛ, odzi mu papaapa. Na adze sae na adzekyee, da a otsia esia nye no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wowiee sor nye asaase nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara yɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na da a otsia esuon no nna Nyankopɔn ewie n’edwuma a ɔyɛɛ no nyinara; na ɔhomee fii no ndwuma no ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn hyiraa da a otsia esuon no do na ɔtseew ho: osiandɛ ɔno mu na ɔhomee fii no ndwuma a ɔayɛ nyinara ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Iyi nye sor nye asaase ho nsɛm. Ber a EWURADZE Nyankopɔn yɛɛ asaase nye sor no,
title: GENESIS

text: nna hamu dua biara nnyae mmbaa asaase do, na hamu ahaban biara nnyae mmfirii: osiandɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn nntɔɔ nsu nnguu asaase do, na nyimpa so nnyi hɔ a ɔbɔdɔw.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nsu fi asaase do bɔfɔɔw asaase enyi nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn dze asaase do huntuma bɔɔ nyimpa, na oguu nkwahwea guu n’ahwentokura mu; na nyimpa bɛyɛɛ ɔkra tseasefo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn yɛɛ ture wɔ Eden, wɔ boka afamu; na hɔ na ɔdze nyimpa a ɔayɛ no no toe.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn maa ndua a ɔyɛ fɛw, na oye dɛ wodzi nyinara fifirii. Ture no ne finimfin na nkwadua no wɔ, na papa nye bɔn ho nyimdzee dua no so si.
title: GENESIS

text: Na esutsen bi fi Eden kɔree kɔfɔɔw ture no; na ofi hɔ na no mu paapaae, na ɔbɛyɛɛ nsutsir anan.
title: GENESIS

text: Dza odzi kan no ne dzin dze Pison: ɔno na otwa Havila asaase a sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ do no nyinara ho hyia.
title: GENESIS

text: Na asaase no do sika ye, na bedola eduhuam nye epopobibir abo so wɔ hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na esutsen a otsia ebien no ne dzin dze Gihon: ɔno na otwa Kus asaase nyinara ho hyia no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na esutsen a otsia ebiasa no ne dzin dze Tigris: ɔno na otwa mu wɔ Asiria boka no. Esutsen a otsia anan no nye Eufrates.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn faa nyimpa no, na ɔdze no kɔtoo Eden ture no mu dɛ onsiesie hɔ, na ɔnhwɛ hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Ɔhyɛɛ mbra maa nyimpa no dɛ, Ture yi mu ndua nyinara dzi bi:
title: GENESIS

text: na papa nye bɔn ho nyimdzee dua no dze, mma nndzi bi: na da ara a ibedzi bi no, ampaara dɛ ibowu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Onnye dɛ nyimpa no nko tsena hɔ; mebɛyɛ boafo a ɔfata no ama no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn dze dɛtse yɛɛ hamu mbowadoma nyinara, nye wimu ntumbowa nyinara; na ɔdze hɔn brɛɛ nyimpa no dɛ ɔnhwɛ mbrɛ ɔbɛfrɛ hɔn: na dzin biara a nyimpa no dze frɛɛ abɔdze biara a nkwa wɔ no mu no, ɔnoara nye ne dzin.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nyimpa no totoo ofiembowa nyinara, nye wimu ntumbowa, nye hamu mbowadoma nyinara edzin; na nyimpa dze woennhu boafo a ɔfata no amma no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn maa nda heii tɔɔ nyimpa no do, na ɔdae; na oyii ne mparba mu kor, na ɔdze nam hyɛɛ n’ananmu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn dze aparba a oyii no nyimpa no mu no yɛɛ ɔbaa, na ɔdze no brɛɛ nyimpa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nyimpa no see dɛ, Nyew! Me mbiew mu biew, na mo honam mu nam ankasa nye yi. Oyi dze, wɔbɛfrɛ no Ɔbaa, osiandɛ woyii no wɔ Banyin mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi na banyin begya ne na nye n’egya wɔ hɔ, na ɔdze noho akɛbata ne yer ho: na wɔayɛ honankor.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna hɔn beenu no nyinara dzi adagyaw, banyin no nye ne yer no, naaso wɔammfɛr.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna abowatsena no yɛ onyitsewfo kyɛn hamu abowa biara a EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ayɛ. Na obisaa ɔbaa no dɛ, Aso ampaara dɛ Nyankopɔn ase hom dɛ, Mma hom nndzi ture yi mu ndua nyinara bi?
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa no see abowatsena no dɛ, Ture yi mu ndua n’eduaba no yɛwɔ ho kwan dɛ yedzi bi;
title: GENESIS

text: mbom dua a osi ture yi ne finimfin no n’eduaba no na Nyankopɔn ase dɛ, Mma yenndzi, nkyii so mma yɛmmfa hɛn nsa nnka, amma yeennwuwu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na abowatsena no buaa ɔbaa no dɛ, Hom nnkowu bi:
title: GENESIS

text: osiandɛ Nyankopɔn nyim dɛ da a hom bedzi bi no, hom enyi bobue, na hom ayɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn na hom ehu papa nye bɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa no hun dɛ dua no ye dɛ wodzi, na ɔyɛ enyiwa do fɛw, yɛ akɔndɔ, na otum so dɛ obue enyi no, ɔtseew n’aba no bi dzii; na ɔmaa no kun a ɔka no ho no so bi, na odzii.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hɔn beenu no nyinara hɔn enyiwa buebuei, na wohun dɛ wodzi adagyaw; na wɔpempaam adɔmbadua n’ahataw, na wɔyɛɛ nsamenyim maa hɔnho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ewimbir no, wɔtsee EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ne nka dɛ ɔnam ture no mu, na Adam nye ne yer no sumae fii EWURADZE Nyankopɔn n’enyim wɔ ture no mu ndua no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn frɛɛ banyin no na obisaa no dɛ, Ewɔ hen?
title: GENESIS

text: Na banyin no buaa dɛ, Metsee wo ndze wɔ ture no mu, na musuroi, osiandɛ midzi adagyaw; na musumaa moho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na obisaa no dɛ, Woana kaa kyerɛɛ wo dɛ idzi adagyaw? Ana edzi dua a mehyɛɛ wo ho mbra dɛ mma nndzi bi no bi?
title: GENESIS

text: Na banyin no see dɛ, ɔbaa no a edze no bɛkaa mo ho no, ɔno na ɔmaa me dua no bi, na midzii.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn bisaa ɔbaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ayɛ yi? Na ɔbaa no see dɛ, Abowatsena no na ɔdaadaa me ma midzii.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn see abowatsena no dɛ, Osiandɛ ayɛ iyi ntsi, wɔadom wo wɔ fiembowa nyinara mu, na hamu mbowadoma nyinara mu; wo yafun do na ebɛnantsew, na huntuma na ibedzi wo nkwa nda nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Medze ɔtan mobɔto ɔwo nye ɔbaa no ntamu, na w’asefo nye n’asefo ntamu: ɔbɔbɔ wo tsir, na wo so asɔw n’anantsir.
title: GENESIS

text: Ɔsee ɔbaa no dɛ, Mebɛma w’awoko mu amandzehu adɔɔ so kɛse; ɔfona mu na ebɔwo mba; na ebɛdan wo kun, na ɔbɔhwɛ wo do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee Adam dɛ, Osiandɛ etsie wo yer ne ndze, na edzi dua a mehyɛɛ wo ho mbra dɛ, Mma nndzi bi no bi ntsi, wɔadom asaase wɔ ɔwo ntsi; ɔfona mu na ibedzidzi do wo nkwa nda nyinara;
title: GENESIS

text: nhwirom nye nsoɛ so na obefifir ama wo; na ibedzi hamu ahaban;
title: GENESIS

text: w’enyim mfifir mu na ibedzidzi kɛpem dɛ ebɛsan akɔ daadze; osiandɛ ɔno mu na woyii wo fii: na huntuma nye wo, na huntuma mu na ebɛsan akɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na banyin no too ne yer no dzin Eve; osiandɛ ɔno na ɔyɛ atseasefo nyinara hɔn na.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn yɛɛ nwoma ntar maa Adam nye ne yer, na ɔdze hyɛɛ hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Hwɛ, nyimpa no abɛyɛ dɛ hɛn mu kor, ohu papa nye bɔn; na afei bɛyɛ na ɔatsen ne nsa, na ɔatsew nkwadua no so bi edzi, na ɔatsena ase daa;
title: GENESIS

text: dɛm ntsi EWURADZE Nyankopɔn tuu nyimpa fii Eden ture no mu dɛ ɔnkɔdɔw daadze a woyii no fii mu no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na oyii nyimpa no edzi; na ɔdze Kerubim, nye gya nkrantsee a onyinanyinam, sii Eden ture no enyim boka, dɛ wɔnweɔn nkwadua no ho kwan no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na banyin no nye ne yer Eve dae na onyinsenii; na ɔwoo Kain, na ɔsee dɛ, Medze EWURADZE no mboa enya banyin.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔwoo babanyin bio na ɔfrɛɛ no Abel. Nna Abel yɛɛ oguanhwɛfo, na Kain dze okuafo a.
title: GENESIS

text: Nda guu mu no, ɔbaa dɛ Kain dze ekuadze bɔbɔɔ EWURADZE afɔr,
title: GENESIS

text: na Abel so dze no nguan mu mbakan na dza wɔadodɔ seradze no mu bi bae. Na EWURADZE n’enyi sɔɔ Abel nye n’afɔrbɔ:
title: GENESIS

text: na Kain nye n’afɔrbɔ dze n’enyi annsɔ. Na Kain no bo fuuw kɛsenara, na omunae.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE bisaa Kain dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo bo efuw yi? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na emuna yi?
title: GENESIS

text: Sɛ eyɛɛ papa a nkyɛ w’enyim nnkɛba nyam? Na dɛ annyɛ papa ntsi, bɔn kotow w’abowano rohwehwɛ w’ekyir kwan naaso ɔwɔ dɛ ehyɛ wo ho do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Kain kaa kyerɛɛ no nua Abel dɛ ɔmma wɔnkɔ haban mu. Na ɔbaa dɛ wɔwɔ hamu no, Kain soɛɛr no nua Abel do, na okum no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE bisaa Kain dɛ, Wo nua Abel wɔ hen? Na Kain buaa dɛ, Minnyim: ana emi nye mo nua no hwɛdofo?
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ayɛ yi? Wo nua no bɔgyaa ne ndze fi famu keka mu frɛ me.
title: GENESIS

text: Na afei wofi asaase a ɔahan n’anomu regye wo nua no bɔgyaa wɔ wo nsamu no do wɔadom wo:
title: GENESIS

text: Ofi ndɛ kɔ yi, sɛ edɔw asaase a, onnkeyi no ndɔbaa ama wo; na afei so ɔkobɔfo nye okyimakyimafo na ebɛyɛ wɔ asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Kain see EWURADZE dɛ, Mo bɔn ho akatua so kyɛn dɛ mubotum asoa.
title: GENESIS

text: Hwɛ, ndɛ eyi me edzi wɔ asaase yi do; na mubosuma efi w’enyim; na mebɛyɛ kobɔfo nye kyimakyimafo wɔ asaase do; na ɔbɛba dɛ, obiara a obohu me no oboku me.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE see no dɛ wonnkoku wo, osiandɛ obiara a oboku Kain no wobedzi no wer mpɛn esuon. Na EWURADZE yɛɛ asɛnkyerɛdze bi maa Kain, amma obi hu no a, oeennku no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Kain fii EWURADZE n’enyim kɔree, na ɔkɛtsenaa Nod asaase do wɔ Eden no boka.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Kain nye ne yer dae: na onyinsenii, na ɔwoo Enok: na ɔkyekyeer kurow, na ɔfrɛɛ kurow no ne dzin Enok, dɛ mbrɛ ne ba no ne dzin tse.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Enok woo Irad; na Irad woo Mehujael: na Mehujael woo Metusael: na Metusael woo Lamek.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Lamek waar yernom beenu: baako ne dzin dze Ada, na baako so ne dzin dze Zila.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Ada woo Jabal: ɔno nye hɔn a wɔtsena asese mu na wɔwɔ fiembowa no, hɔn egya.
title: GENESIS

text: Na no nua no dzin dze Jubal: ɔno nye asankubɔfo nye mbɛnhɛmfo nyinara hɔn egya.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Zila, so woo Tubal-kain a ɔton kɔɔber nye dadze ndzɛmba a wɔdze twa adze nyinara no; na Tubal-kain n’akyerɛbaa nye Naama.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Lamek see ne yernom dɛ: Hom ntsie me ndze, Ada nye Zila; Hom nyɛ aso mma me kasaa, Lamek yernom: Na meku ɔbarimba dɛ opiraa me, Na meku aberantsɛ dɛ ɔboor me,
title: GENESIS

text: Sɛ wobedzi Kain ho wer mpɛn esuon a, Ampa, Lamek dze, mpɛn eduosuon esuon.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Adam nye ne yer daa bio; na ɔwoo babanyin, na ɔtoo no dzin Set: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn dze ba fofor ahyɛ me Abel n’ananmu; osiandɛ Kain kum no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Set so, wɔwoo babanyin maa no; na ɔtoo no dzin Enos: nna afei adasa hyɛɛ ase bɔɔ EWURADZE ne dzin sɔɔr no.
title: GENESIS

text: Adam n’ebusuasantsen nwoma nye yi. Da a Nyankopɔn bɔɔ nyimpa no, Nyankopɔn ne saso do na ɔyɛɛ no;
title: GENESIS

text: ɔbanyin nye ɔbaa na ɔbɔɔ hɔn; na ohyiraa hɔn, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn nyimpa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Adam dzii mfe ɔha eduasa no ɔwoo ne saso babanyin, na ɔtoo no dzin Set:
title: GENESIS

text: na Adam woo Set no n’ekyir ne nda yɛɛ mfe ahaawɔtwe: na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nda a Adam dzii nyinara ɔyɛ mfe ahaakron eduasa.
title: GENESIS

text: Set dzii mfe ɔha nye enum no, ɔwoo Enos:
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔwoo Enos no n’ekyir odzii mfe ahaawɔtwe nye esuon, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa:
title: GENESIS

text: na Set ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaakron nye duebien.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Enos dzii mfe eduokron no, ɔwoo Kenan:
title: GENESIS

text: na Enos woo Kenan no n’ekyir odzii mfe ahaawɔtwe duenum, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa:
title: GENESIS

text: na Enos ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaakron nye enum.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Kenan dzii mfe eduosuon, na ɔwoo Mahalalel:
title: GENESIS

text: na Kenan woo Mahalalel no n’ekyir no odzii mfe ahaawɔtwe eduanan, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa:
title: GENESIS

text: na Kenan ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaakron nye du: na owui.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Mahalalel dzii mfe eduosia enum, na ɔwoo Jared:
title: GENESIS

text: na Mahalalel woo Jared no n’ekyir odzii mfe ahaawɔtwe eduasa, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Mahalalel ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaawɔtwe eduokron enum.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jared dzii mfe ɔha eduosia ebien, na ɔwoo Enok:
title: GENESIS

text: na Jared woo Enok no n’ekyir odzii mfe ahaawɔtwe, na ɔsanee woo mbabanyin nye mbabaa:
title: GENESIS

text: na Jared ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaakron eduosia ebien na owui.
title: GENESIS

text: Enok dzii mfe eduosia enum no, ɔwoo Metusela:
title: GENESIS

text: na Enok woo Metusela no n’ekyir ɔnye Nyankopɔn nantseew mfe ahaasa, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa binom so.
title: GENESIS

text: Enok ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaasa eduosia enum:
title: GENESIS

text: na Enok nye Nyankopɔn nantsewee: na woennhu no bio, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn faa no kɔree.
title: GENESIS

text: Metusela dzii mfe ɔha eduowɔtwe esuon no, ɔwoo Lamek:
title: GENESIS

text: na Metusela woo Lamek no ekyir no, odzii mfe ahaesuon eduowɔtwe ebien, na no mu na ɔsanee woo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Metusela ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaakron eduosia akron: na owui.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Lamek dzii mfe ɔha eduowɔtwe ebien, na ɔwoo babanyin:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔtoo no dzin Noa, dɛ, Oyiara na ɔbɛkyekye hɛn werɛ wɔ hɛn edwuma nye hɛn nsaano berɛ mu, osian asaase a EWURADZE apaa no no ntsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Lamek woo Noa no ekyir odzii mfe ahaenum eduokron enum, ɔno mu na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa binom so:
title: GENESIS

text: na Lamek ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaesuon eduosuon esuon.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Noa dzii mfe ahaenum no, ɔwoo Sem, Ham, nye Jafet.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nyimpa hyɛɛ ase dɔree wɔ asaase enyi, na wɔwoo mbabaa maa hɔn no,
title: GENESIS

text: Nyankopɔn ne mba hun nyimpa mbabaa no dɛ hɔn ho yɛ fɛw; na wɔwarwaar hɔn mu dza wɔpɛ nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Mo sunsum nnkɛnye nyimpa edzi aper daa, osiandɛ ɔyɛ honam ara. Ofi dɛm ber yi ne nda bɛyɛ mfe ɔha eduonu.
title: GENESIS

text: Nda no mu no nna eso n’ekyir no, nna abran akɛse wɔ asaase do, osiandɛ ber a Nyankopɔn ne mba nye nyimpa mbabaa hyiae no, wɔwoo mba maa hɔn, woyinom nye tsetse etumfo no, nkorɔfo a wɔgyee dzin no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE hun dɛ nyimpa n’emumuyɛ ayɛ kɛse wɔ asaase do, na dɛ n’akoma mu nsusui nyinara yɛ bɔn ara nko daa no,
title: GENESIS

text: EWURADZE nuu noho dɛ ɔyɛɛ nyimpa wɔ asaase do, na ɔyɛɛ no yaw wɔ n’akoma mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Mebɛsɛɛ nyimpa a mabɔ no no efi asaase enyi: nyew, nyimpa, nye mbowa nyinara; osiandɛ menu moho dɛ mayɛ hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Naaso Noa dze, onyaa enyimpa wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Iyinom nye Noa no ho asɛm. Nna Noa yɛ nyimpa tseneneenyi na odzi mu wɔ n’ebusuasantsen mu: Noa nye Nyankopɔn nantsewee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Noa woo mbanyin baasa, Sem, Ham, nye Jafet.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna asaase asɛɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim, na ewurkadze ahyɛ asaase ma.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn hwɛɛ asaase, na, hwɛ, asɛɛ; osiandɛ nyimpa asɛɛ no kwan wɔ asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see Noa dɛ, Abɔdze nyinara n’ewiei edu m’enyim; osiandɛ ɔnam hɔn do na ewurkadze ahyɛ asaase do ma; na hwɛ, mebɛsɛɛ hɔn nyinara nye asaase so.
title: GENESIS

text: Fa dua pa pam hɛn ma woho; yɛ adan wɔ hɛn no mu, na fa ihua tar no mu nye n’ekyir.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mbrɛ ibesi ayɛ no nye yi: ehɛn no ne tsentsen basafa ɔha eduonum, ne tɛtɛr basafa eduonu enum, na no krɔn basafa duenum.
title: GENESIS

text: Yɛ ntokura wɔ hɛn no ho, na wie no anamɔn kor na fa wɔ sor; na hɛn no n’abow no fa si ne nkyɛnmu; yɛ no nsamdo, dza odzi ase, dza otsia ebien, nye dza otsia ebiasa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hwɛ, emi, medze nsuyirii reba asaase do abɛsɛɛ abɔdze a nkwahom wɔ mu nyinara efi sor ase: adze a ɔwɔ asaase do nyinara bowu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na menye wo bedzi ahyɛmu: na aba hɛn no mu, ɔwo, nye wo mba, nye wo yer, nye wo mba hɔn yernom ka wo ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na fa honam nyinara mu adze a nkwa wɔ mu n’ahorow nyinara mu ebien ebien bra hɛn no mu, ma wonnya nkwa nka wo ho; fa hɔn onyin nye ɔber.
title: GENESIS

text: Ntumbowa ahorow, fiembowa ahorow nye mbowa ahorow nyinara hɔn mu ebien ebien bra wo nkyɛn; ama woeenya nkwa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na fa edziban nyinara bi ma woho, na boa ano kɔ wo nkyɛn; ama ɔaayɛ edziban ama ɔwo nye hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Noa yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no nyinara pɛpɛɛpɛr.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE see Noa dɛ, ɔwo nye wo fie nyinara nkɔ hɛn no mu; osiandɛ ɔwo na mehu wo dɛ etsen wɔ m’enyim wɔ ber yi mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Mbowa a hɔn ho tsew nyinara fa hɔn mu esuon esuon, onyin nye ne ber; na mbowa a hɔn ho nntsew no mu ebien ebien, onyin na ne ber;
title: GENESIS

text: wimu ntumbowa mu so, esuon esuon, enyin nye aber; ama hɔn ase eenya nkwa wɔ asaase nyinara enyi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aka nda esuon ma maama nsu atɔ egu asaase do adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa; na mebɛsɛɛ adze a nkwa wɔ mu a mayɛ nyinara no efi asaase enyi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Noa yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ no no nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Aber a nsuyirii baa asaase do no nna Noa edzi mfe ahaesia.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Noa, nye ne mba, nye ne yer nye ne mba hɔn yernom, kɔr hɛn no mu, osian nsuyirii no ntsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Mbowa a hɔn ho tsew, nye mbowa a hɔn ho nntsew, nye ntumbowa, nye mbowa a wɔwea wɔ daadze nyinara mu,
title: GENESIS

text: ebien ebien kɔr Noa nkyɛn wɔ hɛn no mu, enyin nye aber, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ Noa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda esuon ekyir no, nsuyirii no baa asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Noa no nkwa mu afe a otsia ahaesia no mu, bosoom a otsia ebien no ne da a otsia duesuon no ara na bun kɛse no no nsunyiwa nyinara paapaae; na ɔsor ntokura buebuei.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nsu tɔree guu asaase do adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Da no ara na Noa nye ne yer na ne mba Sem, Ham, nye Jafet, hɔn yernom baasa no ka hɔn ho, kɔr hɛn no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Hɔn, nye mbowa ahorow, fiembowa na hambowa, nye ntumbowa ahorow nyinara kɔr hɛn no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔkɔr Noa nkyɛn wɔ hɛn no mu, honam a nkwahom wɔ mu nyinara mu ebien ebien,
title: GENESIS

text: enyin nye aber na wɔkɔr mu, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ Noa no: na EWURADZE toow no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nsuyirii no baa asaase do adaduanan; na nsu no yirii, na ɔsoaa hɛn no, na ɔmaa do fii asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nsu no yirii boor do kɛsenara wɔ asaase do; ma hɛn no tsɛɛw nsu no enyi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nsu no boor do pii wɔ asaase do; na nkokwaa atsentsen nyinara do katae.
title: GENESIS

text: Nsu no boor do kɔr sor basafa esuon na fa; na nkokwaa do katae.
title: GENESIS

text: Na biribiara a nkwa wɔ mu wɔ asaase do nyinara wui, ntumbowa, nye fiembowa, nye mbowadoma, nye nketsebowa a wɔwea asaase do nyinara, nye nyimpa nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Dza ɔwɔ asaase kɛsɛɛ do nyinara a nkwahom wɔ hɔn mu wuwui.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE sɛɛ adze a nkwa wɔ mu a ɔwɔ asaase do no nyinara, nyimpa, fiembowa, nye nketsebowa, nye sor ntumbowa: na ɔkaa Noa, nye hɔn a wɔnye no wɔ hɛn no mu no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nsu no yirii wɔ asaase do nda ɔha eduonum.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn kaa Noa, na adze a nkwa wɔ mu a wɔnye no wɔ hɛn no mu no nyinara: na Nyankopɔn maa mframa bɔe faa asaase do, na nsu no huamee;
title: GENESIS

text: bun no no nsunyiwa so nye ɔsor ntokura ano sisiwii, na nsu a ofi sor gyaa tɔ;
title: GENESIS

text: na nsu no kɔr do ara twee fii asaase do: na nda ɔha eduonum n’ekyir na nsu no huamee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ehɛn no kesii Ararat nkokwaa do wɔ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu, bosoom no ne da a otsia duesuon no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nsu no kɔr do twee araa dze kodur bosoom a otsia du no mu no, bosoom no ne da a odzi kan no mu, na nkokwaa etsifi dedaa hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ adaduanan ekyir no, Noa buee hɛn no no tokura a ɔyɛe no:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔsomaa akonkoran, na ofiir edzi kekyinii araa ma ɔdze kɛpeem dɛ nsu wewewee fii asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsomaa ebubur fii ne nkyɛn, dɛ ɔnkɔhwɛ kyerɛ nsu no ehuam efi asaase enyi;
title: GENESIS

text: na ebubur no ennya ne nan sibew, na ɔsanee baa no hɔ wɔ hɛn no mu, osiandɛ nsu no wɔ asaase nyinara enyi: na ɔtseen ne nsa suoo no mu, na ɔdze no baa ne nkyɛn wɔ hɛn no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔtweɔɔn nda esuon so bio; na ɔsomaa ebubur no fii hɛn no mu bio;
title: GENESIS

text: na ebubur no sanee baa no hɔ ewimbir no; na, hwɛ, olive ahataw momon a ɔatsew tua n’ano: nna Noa hun dɛ nsu no atwe efi asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔtweɔɔn nda esuon so bio; na ɔsomaa ebubur no; na ɔannsan ammba no hɔ bio.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Noa ne mfe a otsia ahaesia nye kor no mu, bosoom a odzi kan no ne da a odzi kan no, nsu no wewewee fii asaase do; na Noa yii hɛn no ne nkatado no, na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, asaase enyi awow.
title: GENESIS

text: Na bosoom a otsia ebien no mu, bosoom no ne da a otsia eduonu esuon no, nna asaase do wewee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ Noa dɛ,
title: GENESIS

text: Fi hɛn no mu pue, ɔwo nye wo yer, nye wo mba, nye wo mba hɔn yernom no ka wo ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Fa adze a nkwa wɔ hɔn mu a wɔnye wo wɔ hɔ nyinara a ɔwɔ honam nyinara mu ka wo ho pue, ntumbowa, nye fiembowa, nye nketsebowa a wɔwea asaase do nyinara; ama wɔaawo, na wɔaadɔr wɔ asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Noa nye ne yer na ne mba, nye ne mba hɔn yernom ka no ho fiir edzi:
title: GENESIS

text: mbowadoma nketsebowa nyinara, nye ntumbowa nyinara, na adze biara a nkwa wɔ mu wɔ asaase do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mbowa ban tsetsee, fii hɛn no mu puei.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Noa sii afɔrmbukyia maa EWURADZE; na ɔfaa mbowa a hɔn ho tsew nyinara mu bi, na ɔdze hɔn bɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE tsee afɔr no no huam; na EWURADZE kaa wɔ n’akoma mu dɛ, Monnkɔdom asaase bio ara da wɔ nyimpa ntsi, osiandɛ minyim dɛ nyimpa n’akoma mu nsusui muo dze fitsi no mbofra mu; nkyii so mennkɛsɛɛ adze a nkwa wɔ mu biara bio ara da, dɛ mbrɛ mayɛ yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Mber tsentsen ara a asaase wɔ hɔ yi, duaber nye buber, awɔwber nye ɔhyewber, ɔpɛ nye esusow, adzekyee nye adzesaa nnkegyaa da.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn hyiraa Noa nye ne mba, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nwo, na hom ndɔr, na wɔnyɛ asaase do ma.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hom ho suro nye hom ho hu mbra asaase do mbowadoma nyinara nye wimu ntumbowa nyinara do; dza wɔwea daadze nyinara, na po mu nam nyinara, wɔdze ahyɛ hom nsa.
title: GENESIS

text: Adze a nkwa wɔ mu nyinara ɔnyɛ edziban mma hom; dɛ mbrɛ medze nhaban nhaban so ama hom no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nam a no bɔgyaa da ho wɔ no mu dze, mma hom nndzi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nyimpa biara a ɔbɛka nyimpa no bɔgyaa egu no, dɛm nyimpa no ne nsamu na mobɔhwehwɛ bɔgya no, na sɛ abowa mpo ka nyimpa no bɔgyaa gu a, mibebisa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Obiara a ɔka nyimpa no bɔgyaa gu no, nyimpa na ɔbɛka no bɔgyaa egu: osiandɛ Nyankopɔn no su do na ɔyɛɛ nyimpa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hom dze, hom nwo menyamenya na hom ndɔr wɔ asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ Noa, nye ne mba a wɔka no ho no dɛ,
title: GENESIS

text: Na hwɛ emi, merema m’ahyɛmu etsim ama hom, nye hom asefo a wodzi hom ekyir;
title: GENESIS

text: na mbowa a nkwa wɔ hɔn mu nyinara a wɔka hom ho no, ntumbowa, fiembowa, nye asaase mbowadoma a wɔka hom ho fi hɛn no mu puei nyinara, mekyerɛ asaase do mbowadoma nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mebɛma menye hom hɛn ahyɛmu etsim; nkyii so nsuyirii nnkotwa honam nyinara efi hɔ bio; nkyii so nsuyirii nnkɛba bio abɛsɛɛ asaase.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Iyi nye ahyɛmu a merema ɔada emi nye hom nye abɔdze a nkwa wɔ hɔn mu a wɔka hom ho nyinara ntamu, dze ama ebusuasantsen a ɔmmbɔ adze no ho asɛnkyerɛdze;
title: GENESIS

text: medze me nyankontɔn abew mununkum mu, na ɔbɛyɛ emi na asaase ntamu ahyɛmu ho asɛnkyerɛdze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ medze mununkum meba asaase do a, wobohu nyankontɔn no wɔ mununkum no mu,
title: GENESIS

text: na mebɛkaa m’ahyɛmu a ɔda emi nye hom nye honam nyinara mu abɔdze a nkwa wɔ mu nyinara ntamu; na nsu no nnkɛyɛ nsuyirii bio asɛɛ honam nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nyankontɔn no bɛbew mununkum no mu; na mobɔhwɛ, ama maakaa daa ahyɛmu a ɔda Nyankopɔn nye honam nyinara mu abɔdze a nkwa wɔ mu a ɔwɔ asaase do nyinara ntamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see Noa dɛ, Iyi nye ahyɛmu a medze ritsim hɔ wɔ emi nye honam a ɔwɔ asaase do nyinara ntamu no ho asɛnkyerɛdze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Noa ne mba a wofii hɛn mu puei nye Sem, nye Ham, nye Jafet: na Ham nye Keenan n’egya.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom baasa yi nye Noa ne mba no: na woyinom mu na nyimpa fi petsee asaase nyinara do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Noa hyɛɛ ase yɛɛ kua, na ɔyɛɛ wenyin ture:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔnoom wenyin no bi, na ɔbowee; na no ho daa hɔ wɔ n’asesee mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Keenan n’egya Ham hun n’egya n’adagyaw, na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ no nuanom beenu no wɔ abowano.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sem nye Jafet faa tam, dze guu hɔn batsir, na wɔnatsewee dze no hɔn ekyir hɔn ekyir dze kɛkataa hɔn egya n’adagyaw do; nna hɔn enyim wɔ ekyir, na woennhu hɔn egya n’adagyaw.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Noa no wenyin no fii n’enyi do, na ɔtsee dza ne ba kuma no dze ayɛ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna ɔsee dɛ, Ndom nka Keenan; Nkowaa mu akowaa na ɔbɛyɛ ama no nuanom.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee bio dɛ, Nhyira nka EWURADZE, Sem ne Nyankopɔn; Na wɔmma Keenan nyɛ n’akowaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Nyankopɔn nyɛ Jafet kɛse, Na wɔmma ɔntsena Sem n’asesee mu; Na wɔmma Keenan nyɛ n’akowaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Nsuyirii no n’ekyir no Noa dzii mfe ahaasa eduonum
title: GENESIS

text: na Noa ne nda nyinara yɛɛ mfe ahaakron eduonum: na owui.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei iyinom nye Noa ne mba, Sem, Ham nye Jafet hɔn ebusuasantsen a nsuyirii no n’ekyir no wɔwoo hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Jafet ne mba nye Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Mesek, nye Tiras.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Gomer ne mba nye Askenaz, Rifat, nye Togarma.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Javan ne mba nye Elisa, Tarsis, Kittim, nye Dodanim.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom hɔn mu na nsuano amanaman fi petsee hɔn asaase do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nyinara hɔn kasaa tse; dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, wɔ hɔn amanaman mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Ham ne mba nye Kus, Egypt, Put, nye Keenan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Kus ne mba nye Seba, Havila, Sabta, Raama, nye Sabteka: na Raama ne mba nye Seba, Dedan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Kus woo Nimrod: ɔno na ɔhyɛɛ ase yɛɛ ɔkatakyi wɔ asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Ɔyɛɛ ɔbɔfo kɛse wɔ EWURADZE n’enyim: ma dɛm ntsi wɔse dɛ, ɔbɔfo a ɔyɛ kɛse wɔ EWURADZE n’enyim a ɔtse dɛ Nimrod.
title: GENESIS

text: Na n’ahendzi n’ahyɛse nye Babel, Erek, Akad, nye Kalne, wɔ Sinar asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Asaase no do na ofi kɔr Asiria, na ɔkɛkyekyeer Ninive, Rehoboth-Ir, nye Kala,
title: GENESIS

text: na Resen kuropɔn a ɔda Ninive nye Kala ntamu no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Egypt woo Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naftuhim,
title: GENESIS

text: Patrusim, Kasluhim (a Filistiafo fiir hɔn mu no), nye Kaftorim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Keenan woo n’abakan Zidon, Het;
title: GENESIS

text: na Jebusfo, Amorifo, Girgasfo;
title: GENESIS

text: Hivifo, Arkifo, Sinfo;
title: GENESIS

text: Arvadfo, Zemarfo, nye Hamatfo: na n’ekyir no na Keenan ebusua ebusua petsee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Keenanfo hɔn he fi Zidon, dze nam Gerar, dze kodu Gaza; dze nam Sodom nye Gomora nye Adma nye Zeboim, dze kodu Lasa.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom nye Ham ne mba, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kasaa tsetsee, wɔ hɔn asaase do, wɔ hɔn amanaman mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sem, Jafet no nua panyin no, no mu na Eber mba nyinara fir.
title: GENESIS

text: Sem ne mba nye Elam, Assur, nye Arpaksad, Lud, nye Aram.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Aram ne mba nye Uz, Hul, Geter, nye Mas.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Arpaksad woo Sela; na Sela woo Eber.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Eber woo mba beenu: baako ne dzin dze Peleg; osiandɛ ɔno ne nda mu na mpaapaamu baa asaase do; na no nua ne dzin dze Joktan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Joktan woo Almodad, Selef, Hazarmavet, Jera;
title: GENESIS

text: Hadoram, Uzal, Dikla;
title: GENESIS

text: Obal, Abimael, Seba;
title: GENESIS

text: Ofir, Havila, nye Jobab. Woyinom nyinara Joktan mba a.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hɔn tsenabew fi Mesa, rokɔ Sefar, boka kokwaa no ho no.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom nye Sem ne mba dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kasaa tsetsee, wɔ hɔn asaase do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn amanaman tsetsee.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom nye Noa ne mba hɔn ebusuasantsen; na woyinom hɔn mu na nsuyirii no n’ekyir no amanaman fi petsee asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna asaase nyinara hɔn kasaa kor.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, wotuu kwan rokɔ boka no, wohun asaase tɛtɛr bi wɔ Sinar asaase do; na wɔtsenaa hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Wɔmbra, wɔmma yengu ntayaa, na yɛnto ma ɔmben. Na ntayaa no yɛɛ hɔn mbobaa, na hua yɛɛ hɔn dɛtse.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Wɔmbra, wɔmma yɛnkyekyer kurow, na yɛntow abantsentsen a n’etsifi bodu sor, na wɔmma yɛmfa ngye dzin; amma yaammpetse asaase nyinara enyi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE sianee bɔhwɛɛ kurow no nye abantsentsen no a adasamba rotow no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman kor, na hɔn nyinara hɔn kasaa kor; na dza wɔahyɛ ase reyɛ nye yi: na afei biribiara a wobosusu dɛ wɔbɛyɛ no, bibiribiara nnkotum esiw hɔn kwan.
title: GENESIS

text: Wɔmbra, wɔmma yensian, na yɛnkɔtoto hɔn kasaa wɔ hɔ, amma obi aanntse ne nyɛnko ne nsɛm ase.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ofi hɔ nna EWURADZE bɔɔ hɔn petsee asaase nyinara enyi: na wogyaa kurow no kyekyer.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Babel; osiandɛ hɔ na EWURADZE totoo asaase nyinara hɔn kasaa: na hɔ na EWURADZE fi bɔɔ hɔn petsee asaase nyinara enyi.
title: GENESIS

text: Iyinom nye Sem n’ebusuasantsen: nsuyirii no ekyir mfe ebien no, nna Sem edzi mfe ɔha, na ɔwoo Arpaksad.
title: GENESIS

text: Sem woo Arpaksad n’ekyir no odzii mfe ahaenu, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Arpaksad dzii mfe eduasa enum no, na ɔwoo Sela:
title: GENESIS

text: na Arpaksad woo Sela no n’ekyir odzii mfe ahaanan ebiasa na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Sela dzii mfe eduasa, na ɔwoo Eber:
title: GENESIS

text: na Sela woo Eber n’ekyir odzii mfe ahaanan ebiasa, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Eber dzii mfe eduasa anan, na ɔwoo Peleg:
title: GENESIS

text: na Eber woo Peleg no n’ekyir odzii mfe ahaanan eduasa, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Peleg dzii mfe eduasa no ɔwoo Reu:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔwoo Reu n’ekyir no odzii mfe ahaenu nye akron, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Reu dzii mfe eduasa ebien, na ɔwoo Serug:
title: GENESIS

text: na Serug n’ekyir no odzii mfe ahaenu nye esuon, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Serug dzii mfe eduasa, na ɔwoo Nahor:
title: GENESIS

text: na Nahor n’ekyir no odzii mfe ahaenu, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Nahor dzii mfe eduonu akron, na ɔwoo Tera:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔwoo Tera no n’ekyir odzii mfe ɔha duakron, na ɔwoo mbabanyin nye mbabaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Tera dzii mfe eduosuon, na ɔwoo Abram, Nahor, nye Haran.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei iyinom nye Tera n’asefo. Tera woo Abram, Nahor, nye Haran; na Haran woo Lot.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Haran wui wɔ n’egya Tera enyim wɔ asaase a wɔwoo no do no do, wɔ Kaldeafo Ur.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram nye Nahor warwaree: Abram ne yer ne dzin dze Sarai; na Nahor ne yer ne dzin dze Milka. Haran a ɔyɛ Milka n’egya, nye Iska n’egya no ne babaa a.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Sarai yɛ ɔbɔnyin; onnyi ba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Tera faa ne ba Abram, ne nana Lot a ɔyɛ Haran ne ba no nye Abram ne yer Sarai na ɔnye hɔn sii mu fi Kaldeafo Ur, dɛ wɔrokɔ Keenan asaase do; na wɔbaa Haran bɛtsenaa hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Tera ne nda yɛɛ mfe ahaenu nye enum: na owui wɔ Haran.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei EWURADZE see Abram dɛ, Fi wo man mu, na fi w’ebusua mu, na fi w’egya fie, kɔ asaase a mebɛkyerɛ wo no do:
title: GENESIS

text: na mebɛyɛ wo ɔman kɛse, na mibehyira wo, na mama wo dzin ayɛ kɛse: na ayɛ nhyira:
title: GENESIS

text: na mibehyira hɔn a wohyira wo, na nyia ɔdom wo no mobɔdom no: na wo mu na wobehyira asaase ebusua ebusua nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Abram kɔr dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ no no: na Lot nye no kɔree: na Abram fii Haran no nna oedzi mfe eduosuon enum.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram faa ne yer Sarai, nye no nua ba Lot, na hɔn ahodze a wonyaa nyinara, na nyimpa a wonyaa no wɔ Haran no nyinara; na wosii mu dɛ wɔrokɔ Keenan asaase do; na Keenan asaase do na wɔbae.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram twaa mu wɔ asaase no do kɔr beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Sekem, kɔr More esudur no ho. Na aber no nna Keenanfo wɔ asaase no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE yii noho kyerɛɛ Abram, na ɔsee dɛ, W’asefo na medze asaase yi bɛma hɔn: na hɔ na Abram sii afɔrmbukyia maa EWURADZE a oyii noho kyerɛɛ no no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ofii hɔ kɔr bepɔw a ɔwɔ Bɛtɛl no boka no do, na hɔ na ɔbɔɔ n’asesee, a Bɛtɛl dzi n’anee, na Ai dzi no boka: na osii afɔrmbukyia maa EWURADZE wɔ hɔ na ɔsɔɔr EWURADZE dzin.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram tuu kwan, dɛ ɔda ho ara rokɔ Pomu afamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkɔm baa asaase no do: na Abram kɔr Egypt kɛtsenaa hɔ ahɔhotsena; osiandɛ ɔkɔm no yɛɛ dzen wɔ asaase no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aka kakra ma ɔahɛn Egypt no, ɔsee ne yer Sarai dɛ, Minyim dɛ eyɛ ɔbaa a wo ho yɛ fɛw:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ Egyptfo no hu wo a, wɔbɛse dɛ, Ne yer nye yi: na woboku emi, na wɔagye ɔwo nkwa.
title: GENESIS

text: Meserɛ wo, se dɛ, m’akyerɛbaa nye wo: ama osian ɔwo ntsi eesi yie ama me, na osian ɔwo ntsi me kra aatsena ase.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Abram baa Egypt no, Egyptfo no hun ɔbaa no dɛ no ho yɛ fɛw papa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao ne mbapɔmba no hun no, na wɔbɛkamfoo no kyerɛɛ Farao: na wɔbɛfaa ɔbaa no kɔr Farao fie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ Abram yie wɔ ne ntsi: na onyaa nguan, nye anantwi, nye nsoasopɔnkɔnyin, nye nkowaa, nye mfonabaa, nye nsoasopɔnkɔber, nye efumpɔnkɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na osian Abram yer Sarai ntsi EWURADZE dze ɔyardɔm akɛse haaw Farao nye ne fi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao frɛɛ Abram, na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na edze ayɛ me yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na annka annkyerɛ me dɛ wo yer a?
title: GENESIS

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na esee dɛ, M’akyerɛbaa a ma dɛm ntsi mefaa no nkyɛ morowar no yi? Dɛm ntsi afei, hwɛ, wo yer nye no, fa no, na kɔ wo kwan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao hyɛɛ nkorɔfo ma wokegyaa ɔno, nye ne yer, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara wɔ ɔkwan do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram fii Egypt, ɔno, nye ne yer, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara, nye Lot ka no ho, kɔr Pomu afamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram nyaa no ho kɛsenara wɔ fiembowa, nye dwetɛ, nye sika mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na otuu no kwan fi Pomu afamu araa kodur Bɛtɛl, beebi mbrɛ ahyɛse no n’asesee wɔ mu no, wɔ Bɛtɛl nye Ai ntamu:
title: GENESIS

text: beebi mbrɛ afɔrmbukyia a asɔpɔn no ɔyɛɛ no wɔ hɔ no wɔ no: na hɔ na Abram sɔɔr EWURADZE.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Lot a ɔnye Abram nam no so wɔ nguan, nye anantwi, nye asese.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna asaase no nnso hɔn dɛ wɔbɛtsena fakor: osiandɛ hɔn ahodze dɔɔ so, ma dɛm ntsi wɔbɔ mu tsena a ɔnnyɛ yie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aperper baa Abram no mbowahwɛfo nye Lot no mbowahwɛfo ntamu. Ber no nna Keenanfo nye Perizfo tsetse asaase no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram see Lot dɛ, Meserɛ wo, mma emma aperper mmba emi nye ɔwo ntamu, na mo mbowahwɛfo nye wo mbowahwɛfo ntamu; osiandɛ yɛyɛ enuanom.
title: GENESIS

text: Ana nnyɛ asaase no nyinara na ɔda w’enyim yi bi? Meserɛ wo, tsew woho fi mo ho: sɛ bankum na ebɛfa a, ɔno mo so mobɔkɔ nyimfa; anaa sɛ nyimfa na ebɛfa a, ɔno mo so mobɔkɔ bankum.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Lot maa n’enyi do, na ɔhwɛɛ Jordan Tɛtɛrmu nyinara dze rokɔ Zoar, na ohun dɛ no do beebiara wɔ nsu papaapa. Iyi ekyir ansaana EWURADZE resɛɛ Sodom nye Gomora, tse dɛ EWURADZE no ture, nna ɔtse dɛ Egypt asaase.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Lot faa Jordan Tɛtɛrmu nyinara; na Lot tui faa boka afamu: na ɔbaako paa noho fii ne nyɛnko ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Abram tsenaa Keenan asaase do, na Lot tsenaa Tɛtɛrmu kurow no mu, na ɔdze n’asesee tutui araa dze kodur Sodom.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei Sodomfo yɛ ehuhufo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo kɛsenara tsia EWURADZE.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Lot paa noho wɔ Abram ho n’ekyir no, EWURADZE see Abram dɛ, Afei ma w’enyi do, na fi beebi mbrɛ ewɔ no hwɛ kwaamu afamu nye pomu afamu nye boka afamu nye anee afamu:
title: GENESIS

text: na asaase a ihu no nyinara, medze bɛma ɔwo, nye w’asefo daa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mebɛma w’asefo ayɛ dɛ asaase do huntuma: na sɛ obi tum kan asaase do huntuma a, ɔnodze nna wobotum akan w’asefo no.
title: GENESIS

text: Soɛr, fa asaase no do wɔ ne tsentsen nye tɛtɛr mu; na ɔwo na medze bɛma wo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram tutuu n’asesee, na ɔbae bɛtsenaa Mamre nsudur a ɔwɔ Hebron no ne nkyɛn, na osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ maa EWURADZE.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Sinarhen Amrafel, Elasarhen Ariok, Elamhen Kedorlaomer, nye Goiimhen Tidal aber do no,
title: GENESIS

text: wɔnye Sodomhen Bora, nye Gomorahen Birsa, Admahhen Sinab, nye Zeboimfo hen Semeber, nye Belahen (ɔnoara nye Zoar) yɛɛ ɔsa.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom nyinara bɔɔ mu wɔ Siddim bɔnsa mu (ɔnoara nye Nkyen Po no).
title: GENESIS

text: Mfe duebien na wɔsoom Kedorlaomer, na afe a otsia duebiasa no mu no wɔtseew etua.
title: GENESIS

text: Na afe a otsia duanan no mu na Kedorlaomer na ahemfo a wɔka no ho no bae, na wobokum Refafo wɔ Asterot-karnaim, nye Zuzfo wɔ Ham, nye Emfo wɔ Savɛ-kiriataim,
title: GENESIS

text: na Horfo wɔ hɔn bepɔw Seir do, dze kodu El-paran a ɔwɔ sar no ho no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsanee, na wɔbaa En-mispat (ɔnoara nye Kades), na wɔbobɔɔ Amalekfo man nyinara, nye Amorifo so a wɔtse Hazazon-tamar no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sodom, Gomora, Adma, nye Zeboim, nye Bela (ɔnoara nye Zoar) ahemfo fiir edzi; na wɔnye hɔn kɔbɔɔ enyim wɔ Siddim bɔnsa mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Elamhen Kedorlaomer, Goiimfo hen Tidal, Sinarhen Amrafel, nye Elasarhen Ariok; dɛm ahemfo baanan no soɛree tsiaa beenum no.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna hua amona wɔ Siddim bɔnsa mu ma ara tɔ; na ber Sodom nye Gomora ahemfo no ruguan no, binom koguu mu na hɔn a wɔkae no guanee kɔr bepɔw no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔfaa Sodom nye Gomora ndzɛmba nyinara, na hɔn edzidzidze nyinara, na wɔkɔr hɔn kwan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔfaa Lot, Abram no nua ba a ɔtse Sodom no, nye ne ndzɛmba, na wosii mu kɔree.
title: GENESIS

text: Na obi a ofii nsa bae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ Hebriwnyi Abram a aber yi nna ɔtse Amorinyi Mamre, Eskol nye Aner hɔn nua no no nsudur ho no; nna woyinom ɔnye Abram akyekyer.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a Abram tsee dɛ wɔafa no nua ne ba ndɔmmum no, ɔdze no nkorɔfo a wɔatsetse hɔn a wɔwoo hɔn wɔ ne fie, ahaasa duawɔtwe tui, na wotsiiw hɔn araa kodur Dan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔno nye no nkowaa kyɛɛ hɔnho mu kɔr hɔn do anafua, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn gui, na wotsiiw hɔn kodur Hoba a ɔwɔ Damaskɔs n’abankum no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔdze ndzɛmba no nyinara sanee bae, ɔdze no nua ne ba Lot, nye ne ndzɛmba, nye mbaa no so, nye nkorɔfo no, sanee bae.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsanee fi Kedorlaomer nye ahemfo a wɔka no ho no hɔn do nkonyimdzi no reba no, Sodomhen puei kehyiaa no kwan wɔ Savɛ bɔnsa mu (ɔnoara nye ɔhen no Bɔnsa mu).
title: GENESIS

text: Na Salemhen Melkizedek dze paanoo nye wenyin bae: nna ɔyɛ Abɔso Nyankopɔn no sɔfoe.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ohyiaa no, na ɔsee dɛ, Nhyira mfi Abɔso Nyankopɔn a ɔsor nye asaase yɛ nedze no hɔ nka Abram;
title: GENESIS

text: na nhyira nka Abɔso Nyankopɔn a ɔdze w’atamfo ahyɛ wo nsa. Na Abram maa no ndzɛmba no nyinara mu ebupɛn du du.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sodomhen see Abram dɛ, Fa nyimpa no ma me, na woara fa ndzɛmba no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram see Sodomhen no dɛ, Mama me nsa do makyerɛ EWURADZE, Abɔso Nyankopɔn a ɔsor nye asaase yɛ nedze no,
title: GENESIS

text: dɛ mennkɛfa ahoma anaa mpaboaahoma anaa biribiara a ɔyɛ wodze, amma aannka dɛ, Mayɛ Abram birɛmpɔn:
title: GENESIS

text: gyedɛ dza mberantsɛ no edzi no nko, na Aner, Eskol nye Mamre a wɔnye me kɔree no hɔn kyɛpɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Iyinom ekyir no EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Abram hɔ wɔ enyido adzehu mu dɛ, Mma nnsuro, Abram: Emi nye wo kokyɛm, na mebɛma wo akatua a ɔbor do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram see dɛ, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, ebɛnadze na edze bɛma me, hwɛ dɛ minnyi ba na menam, na nyia obedzi m’adze nye Eliezer a ofi Damaskɔs anaa?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram see dɛ, Hwɛ, emi dze, emmaa me asefo: na, hwɛ, nyia wɔawo no wɔ me fie na obedzi m’adze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na, hwɛ, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa no hɔ dɛ, Nnyɛ oyi bi na ɔbɛyɛ wo dziadzenyi; na dza ofi woara wo nson mu bɛba no, ɔno na obedzi w’adze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔdze no puei, na ɔsee dɛ, Afei hwɛ sor, na kan nworaba no, kyerɛ dɛ ibotum akan a: na ɔsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ w’asefo bɛyɛ nye no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔgyee EWURADZE dzii; na EWURADZE buu ne gyedzi ndzeyɛtsenenee maa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Emi nye EWURADZE a medze wo fi Kaldeafo Ur wɔ Kaldea bae, dɛ medze asaase yi rebɛma wo, ma edze aayɛ egyapadze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, medze ebɛnadze na medze bohu dɛ ɔbɛyɛ m’egyapadze?
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Fa nantwiba a oedzi mfe ebiasa, nye apɔnkyeber a oedzi mfe ebiasa, nye oguannyin a oedzi mfe ebiasa, nye atamram, nye aborɔnomaba brɛ me.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔdze iyinom nyinara bae, na ɔpaapaa hɔn mu ebien ebien, na ɔdze afa afa no totoo hɔn afa afa ne pɛn do: na nnoma no dze ɔammpaapaa hɔn mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nnoma a wodzi nam bɛgyegyee mbowa fun no do, na Abram kaa hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a wi rokɔtɔ no, nda heii tɔɔ Abram do; na, hwɛ, sum kɛsenara na hu tɔɔ no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Ewuradze see Abram dɛ, Hu no ampaara dɛ w’asefo bɛyɛ ahɔho wɔ asaase a ɔnnyɛ hɔndze do, na wɔbɛyɛ nkowaa na wɔasom hɔn; na wɔbɛtseetsee hɔn mfe ahaanan,
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔman a wɔbɔsom hɔn no, hɔn so mubobua hɔn atsɛn: na n’ekyir no wɔdze ahodze kɛse befi hɔ akɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔwo dze, ebɔkɔ w’egyanom nkyɛn asomdwee mu; wobesie wo wɔ nkɔdaaber pa mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mbasantsen a otsia anan no mu na wɔbɛba ha bio: osiandɛ Amorifo emumuyɛ nnyae nnyɛɛ ma.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a iwi kɔtɔree, na ɔyɛɛ sum no, hwɛ, fononoo a orupun wusiw, nye ɔtsɛn a ɔredzɛw botwaa mu wɔ afa afa no ntamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Da no ara mu na EWURADZE nye Abram dzii ahyɛmu see dɛ, W’asefo na medze asaase yi ama hɔn, ofi Egypt esutsen no ho kodu esutsen kɛse no, Eufrates esutsen no ho:
title: GENESIS

text: Kenfo, Kenizfo, Kadmonfo,
title: GENESIS

text: Hetfo, Perizfo, Refafo,
title: GENESIS

text: Amorifo, Keenanfo, Girgasfo, nye Jebusfo asaase no.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei Abram ne yer Sarai ɔnnwo mma no: mbom nna ɔwɔ afonabaa Egyptnyi bi a ne dzin dze Hagar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sarai see Abram dɛ, Afei hwɛ, EWURADZE esiw me awoo kwan; meserɛ wo, kɔ m’afonabaa nkyɛn; annyɛ a mibenya no ho mba. Na Abram tsiee Sarai ne ndze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram tsenaa Keenan asaase do mfe du n’ekyir no, Abram ne yer Sarai faa n’afonabaa Hagar, Egyptnyi no, na ɔdze no maa no kun Abram awar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkɔr Hagar nkyɛn, na onyinsenii: na aber a ohun dɛ onyinsen no, obuu no wuraba enyimtsia.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sarai see Abram dɛ, Mo mfom da wo do; medze m’afonabaa too wo bo mu, na ohun dɛ onyinsen ntsi, obu me enyimtsia: EWURADZE mbua emi nye ɔwo ntamu atsɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram see Sarai dɛ, Hwɛ, w’afonabaa wɔ wo nsamu, yɛ no dɛ mbrɛ woara ehwɛ a oye no ara. Na Sarai nye no dzii no dzendzenndzen, ma ofii n’enyim guanee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe hun no wɔ nsunyiwa bi ho wɔ sar do, Sur kwan mu nsunyiwa no ho a.
title: GENESIS

text: Na obisaa no dɛ, Sarai n’afonabaa Hagar, ifi henfa bae na erokɔ henfa? Na obuaa dɛ, Mifi mo wuraba Sarai n’enyim na muruguan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see no dɛ, San kɔ wo wuraba hɔ, na kɛbrɛ woho adze wɔ n’ase.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see no dɛ, Mebɛma w’asefo adɔr menyamenya, ma hɔn dodow ntsi wɔkan hɔn a ɔnnkɛyɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see no dɛ, Hwɛ, enyinsen, na ebɔwo babanyin; na ebɛfrɛ ne dzin Ismael, osiandɛ EWURADZE atse w’amandzehu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛ asoaso bɔyafo wɔ adasa mu; ne nsa betsia nyimpa nyinara, na nyimpa nyinara nsa etsia no; na ɔbɔsoɛr etsia no nuanom nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ EWURADZE a ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no no ne dzin dɛ, ɔwo yɛ Nyankopɔn a ihu adze: na ɔkaa dɛ, Aso ha ara mpo mehu nyia ohu me yi?
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bura no Beer-lahai-roi; na, ɔwɔ Kades nye Bered ntamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Hagar woo babanyin maa Abram: na Abram frɛɛ ne babanyin a Hagar woo no no ne dzin Ismael.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a Hagar woo Ismael no, nna Abram edzi mfe eduowɔtwe esia.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a Abram dzii mfe eduokron akron no, EWURADZE yii noho kyerɛɛ Abram na ɔsee no dɛ, Emi nye Nyankopɔn Tumfo; nantsew m’enyim na dzi mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mebɛma m’ahyɛmu ada emi nye ɔwo ntamu, na mebɛma adɔr mbordo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abram dze n’enyim boom famu: na Nyankopɔn nye no kasae see dɛ,
title: GENESIS

text: Emi dze, hwɛ, m’ahyɛmu wɔ hɔ ma wo, na ebɛyɛ amanaman pii hɔn egya.
title: GENESIS

text: Nkyii so wɔnnkɛfrɛ wo dzin Abram bio, na wɔbɛfrɛ wo dzin Abraham; osiandɛ amanaman pii hɔn egya na mayɛ wo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mebɛma awo mbordo, na mayɛ wo amanaman, na ahemfo efi wo mu epue.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mebɛma m’ahyɛmu etsim wɔ emi nye ɔwo nye w’asefo a wodzi w’ekyir no ntamu wɔ hɔn mbasantsen mu, na ɔayɛ daa ahyɛmu, dɛ mebɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ama ɔwo nye w’asefo a wodzi w’ekyir no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na medze asaase a etsenatsena do, yɛ do hɔho yi, Keenan asaase nyinara, mebɛma ɔwo nye w’asefo a wodzi w’ekyir, dɛ daa enyadze; na mebɛyɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see Abraham dɛ, ɔwo dze, sie m’ahyɛmu, ɔwo nye w’asefo a wodzi w’ekyir, wɔ hɔn mbasantsen mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Iyi nye emi nye hom nye w’asefo a wodzi w’ekyir no ntamu ahyɛmu a hom nsie; hom mu mbabanyin nyinara wontwitwa hɔn twatsia.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wontwitwa hom ho twatsia; na ɔbɛyɛ ahyɛmu a ɔda emi nye hom ntamu asɛnkyerɛdze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbabanyin a oedzi nda awɔtwe no, wontwa no twatsia wɔ hom mu, mbanyin nyinara wɔ hom mbasantsen mu, nyia wɔawo no wɔ fie, anaa wɔdze sika atɔ no wɔ hɔho biara hɔ a ɔmmfora w’asefo no.
title: GENESIS

text: Nyia wɔawo no wɔ fie no, nye nyia wɔdze wo sika atɔ no, wontwitwa hɔn twatsia: na m’ahyɛmu bɛtsena hɔn honam mu dɛ daa ahyɛmu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbanyin a wonntwaa no twatsia no, dɛm nyimpa no wontwa no mfi no nkorɔfo mu; ɔato m’ahyɛmu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see Abraham dɛ, Wo yer Sarai dze, mma mmfrɛ ne dzin Sarai, na Sara nyɛ ne dzin.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mibehyira no, ekyir yi so mebɛma enye no awo babanyin: nyew, mibehyira no, na ɔbɛyɛ amanaman hɔn na; aman ahemfo befi no mu epue.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Abraham dze n’enyim boom famu, na ɔserewee, na ɔsee n’akoma mu dɛ, Aso wɔbɔwo ba ama nyia oedzi mfe ɔha na aso Sara a oedzi mfe eduokron yi bɔwo?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham see Nyankopɔn dɛ, kɛtseankyɛ Ismael eenya adom:
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Ampaara ampa, wo yer Sara bɔwo babanyin ama wo; na ebɛfrɛ ne dzin Isaak: na menye no bedzi ahyɛmu ma aayɛ daa ahyɛmu dze ama n’asefo a wodzi n’ekyir.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Ismael ho dze metsie wo; hwɛ, mehyira no, na mebɛma ɔawo, na ɔadɔr mbordo; ɔbɔwo etsitsir duebien, na mebɛyɛ no ɔman kɛse.
title: GENESIS

text: Na m’ahyɛmu dze mebɛma oetsim wɔ emi nye Isaak a Sara bɔwo no ama wo afedan sisei ntamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔnye no gyaa kasa no, Nyankopɔn fii Abraham nkyɛn kɔr sor.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham faa ne ba Ismael, nye hɔn a wɔwoo hɔn wɔ ne fie, nye hɔn a ɔdze ne sika tɔɔ hɔn nyinara, Abraham ne fifo mu mbanyin nyinara, na otwitwaa hɔn twatsia da no ara, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn kaa kyerɛɛ no no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a wotwaa Abraham twatsia no, nna oedzi mfe eduokron akron.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a ne ba Ismael wotwaa no twatsia no nna oedzi mfe du ebiasa.
title: GENESIS

text: Da kor no ara na wotwitwaa Abraham nye ne ba Ismael twatsia.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ne fie mbanyin nyinara, hɔn a wɔwoo hɔn wɔ fie, nye hɔn a wɔdze sika totɔɔ hɔn ahɔho hɔ, wɔka no ho ma wotwitwaa hɔn twatsia.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE yii noho kyerɛɛ Abram wɔ Mamre nsudur nkyɛn, ewia ketee a ɔtse n’asesee abowano no;
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔmaa n’enyi do, na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, mbarimba baasa gyina ne tsentsendo. Na aber a ohun hɔn no, otutuu mbirika fii n’asesee abowano kehyiaa hɔn kwan, na ɔkotoow famu,
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Mo wura, sɛ afei menya w’enyim enyimnyam a, meserɛ wo, mma mmpa w’akowaa ho nnkɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei wɔmma wɔnkɛfa nsu kakra mbra, na hom nhohor hom anan ho, na hom ngye hom ahom wɔ dua yi ase:
title: GENESIS

text: na monkɔ nkɛfa edziban trɔma bi mbra ma hom mfa nhyɛ hom akoma dzen; na n’ekyir no hom akɔ: susuampa dɛ hom aba hom akowaa nkyɛn yi. Na wɔsee dɛ, Yɛ dɛ mbrɛ aka no ara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham kaa noho kɔr asese no mu Sara hɔ, na ɔsee dɛ, Yɛ isiam pa etwadze ebiasa krado ntsɛntsɛm, fetsew, na to tatar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham tutuu enguan kɔr no mbowakuw mu, na ɔkɛfaa nantwiba a ɔyɛ mberɛw na oye, na ɔdze maa ɔsomfo; na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm kɛyɛɛ edziban.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham faa bata, nye merekye, nye nantwiba a ɔdze ayɛ edziban no, na ɔdze besii hɔn enyim: na ogyinaa hɔn nkyɛn wɔ dua no ase, na wodzidzii.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wobisaa no dɛ, Wo yer Sara wɔ hen? Na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔwɔ asese no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hɔn mu kor kaa dɛ, Ampaara dɛ mebɛsan aba wo nkyɛn afedan sisei; na, hwɛ, wo yer Sara benya babanyin. Nna Sara ritsie wɔ asese abow a ɔwɔ n’ekyir no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei nna Abraham nye Sara enyinyin, na woedzi mfe ara yie; na adze a ɔyɛ mbaa no, etwa wɔ Sara ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sara sereew noara no mu see dɛ, Aso mayɛ aberwa yi n’ekyir na mibenya enyigye, mo wura so ayɛ akɔdaa yi a?
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE bisaa Abraham dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Sara serewee see dɛ, Aso ampaara dɛ mayɛ aberwa yi mobɔwo ba?
title: GENESIS

text: Ana biribi yɛ dzen ma EWURADZE a? Aber a mahyɛ no mebɛsan maba wo nkyɛn afedan sisei, na Sara benya babanyin.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sara sanee see dɛ, Mannserew bi; osiandɛ osuroi. Na ɔsee dɛ, Dabida, na eserewee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mbarimba no soɛree fii hɔ, na wɔdaan hɔn enyi kɔr Sodom do: na Abraham kegyaa hɔn kwan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Ana medze dza merebɛyɛ no bosuma Abraham?
title: GENESIS

text: Hwɛ, ampaara Abraham bɛyɛ ɔman a ɔso na ɔwɔ tum, na no mu na wobehyira asaase amanaman nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na masan mu eyi no, ama ɔaahyɛ ne mba nye ne fifo a wodzi n’ekyir, ma woeesie EWURADZE no kwan, wɔayɛ pɛrpɛr nye atsɛmbu; ama EWURADZE dze dza ɔaka no wɔ Abraham ho no aaba mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, ɔnam dɛ Sodom nye Gomora ho nkekamu ayɛ kɛse; na hɔn bɔn ayɛ dur dodow ntsi;
title: GENESIS

text: afei mibesian akɔhwɛ kyerɛ dɛ ɔayɛ dɛ mbrɛ nkekamu a edu me nkyɛn no tse no ewie; na sɛ ɔnntse dɛm so a, mubohu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mbarimba beenu no daan hɔnho fii hɔ dɛ wɔrokɔ Sodom: na Abraham dze, ɔdaa ho ara gyinaa EWURADZE n’enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham twee pinii, na obisaa dɛ, Ana edze atseneneefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo nyinara bɔbɔ mu ahyew hɔn?
title: GENESIS

text: Egyangyanbiara atseneneefo eduonum wɔ kurow no mu ɛ: onnkesian atseneneefo eduonum a wɔwɔ mu no ntsi ma edze efir kurow no, na ebɛhyew no?
title: GENESIS

text: Iyi mpar wo dɛ ebɛyɛ no dɛm, dɛ edze atseneneefo bɛka ndzebɔnyɛfo ho eku hɔn, ma atseneneefo ayɛ dɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo; iyi mpar wo: ana asaase nyinara ɔtsɛmbuafo nnkɛyɛ dza ɔtsen bi a?
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Sɛ muhu atseneneefo eduonum wɔ Sodom kurow no mu a, ɔno osian hɔn ntsi medze bɛkyɛ bea no nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham buae na ɔsee dɛ, Afei hwɛ, emi a meyɛ dɛtse nye nso, na mesi mo bo dɛ mebɛkasa akyerɛ EWURADZE yi:
title: GENESIS

text: egyangyanbiara atseneneefo eduonum no hɔn mu enum fi mu ɛ: ana osian enum a efi mu no ntsi ebɛsɛɛ kurow no nyinara? Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ muhu eduanan enum wɔ hɔ a, mennkɛsɛɛ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔdaa ho ara kasaa kyerɛɛ no bio, na ɔsee dɛ, Egyangyanbiara eduanan na wobohu hɔn wɔ hɔ ɛ. Na ɔsee dɛ, Osian eduanan no ntsi mennkɛyɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Mma mma EWURADZE no bo mmfuw, na menkasa: egyangyanbiara eduasa na wobohu hɔn wɔ hɔ ɛ. Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ muhu eduasa wɔ hɔ a, mennkɛyɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Afei hwɛ, mesi mo bo dɛ mebɛkasa akyerɛ EWURADZE: egyangyanbiara eduonu na wobohu hɔn wɔ hɔ ɛ: Na ɔsee dɛ, Osian eduonu no ntsi mennkɛsɛɛ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ao mma mma EWURADZE no bo mmfuw, na menkasa prɛko pɛ yi ara: egyangyanbiara du na wobohu hɔn wɔ hɔ ɛ; Na ɔsee dɛ, Osian du no ntsi mennkɛsɛɛ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE wiee dɛ ɔnye Abraham kasa ara na ɔkɔr no kwan: na Abraham sanee baa ne tsenabea.
title: GENESIS

text: Na sor abɔfo beenu no baa Sodom ewimbir; nna Lot tse Sodom abotsen ano: na Lot hun hɔn, na ɔsoɛree kehyiaa hɔn kwan; na ɔkotowee dze n’enyim boom famu;
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Afei hwɛ, mo wuranom, meserɛ hom, wɔmman hom akowaa fie, na wɔnkɔsoɛ hɔ anafua yi nyinara, na hom nhohor hom anan ho, na hom asoɛr anapaatu akɔ hom kwan. Na wɔsee dɛ, Dabida; na yɛbɛtsena gua do anafua yi nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔserɛɛ hɔn ɔdzendo ara, na wɔmaan ne nkyɛn, na wɔkɔr ne fie; na ɔtoo hɔn pon, na ɔtoo epitsi ma wodzii.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wonnyae nnkɛdae no, nna kurow no mu mba, mekyerɛ Sodomfo no, botwaa dan no ho hyiae, mbofra nye mpanyin, apaa nyinara mu nkorɔfo nyinara;
title: GENESIS

text: na wɔfrɛɛ Lot na wɔsee no dɛ, Mbarimba a wɔbaa wo nkyɛn anafua yi no wɔ hen? Yi hɔn brɛ hɛn, ma yɛnye hɔn nda.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Lot puei kɔr hɔn nkyɛn wɔ abow no ano, na ɔtoow abow no mu wɔ n’ekyir.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Mo nuanom, meserɛ hom, mma wɔnnyɛ emumuyɛ a ɔtse dɛm.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei hwɛ, mowɔ mbabaa beenu a wonnhun banyin: meserɛ hom, wɔmma minyi hɔn mbrɛ hom, na dza homara hwɛ a oye no ara hom nyɛ hɔn: mbarimba yi dze mma wɔnnyɛ hɔn biribiara; susuampa dɛ wɔaba me hatsɛw no nwin ase yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Gyina nkyɛn. Na wɔsee dɛ, Akowaa kor yi ɔbaa hɛn amanyɛ, na ɔrohwehwɛ ɔayɛ ɔsɛndzifo: afei yɛnye wo bedzi no bɔn akyɛn hɔn. Na wɔhyɛɛ Lot no do dzendzenndzen, na wɔtwee pinii dɛ worubobubu abow no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mbarimba no tseen hɔn nsa, na wɔtwee Lot baa hɔn nkyɛn wɔ dan mu na wɔtoow abow no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔdze enyifura baa nkorɔfo a wogyinagyina ofi no n’abow n’ano no hɔn do, nkakraba nye akɛse nyina: ma wɔfonaa dɛ wobohu abow no n’ano kwan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mbarimba no bisaa Lot dɛ, Ana ewɔ obiara so wɔ ha? Asew, na wo mbabanyin, na wo mbabaa, na obiara a ewɔ no wɔ kurow yi mu; yi hɔn fi ha:
title: GENESIS

text: na yɛrebɛsɛɛ ha, osiandɛ hɔn nkekamu ayɛ kɛse wɔ EWURADZE n’enyim; na EWURADZE asoma hɛn dɛ yɛmbɛsɛɛ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Lot puei, na ɔkɛkasaa kyerɛɛ ne nsewnom a wɔawarwar ne mbabaa no, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nsoɛr mfi ha; na EWURADZE rebɛsɛɛ kurow yi. Na ɔyɛɛ ne nsewnom no enyiwa do dɛ obi a oridzi fɛw.
title: GENESIS

text: Na adze kyee no, sor abɔfo no guu Lot do, dɛ, Soɛr, fa wo yer nye wo mbabaa beenu a wɔwɔ ha yi kɔ; amma aannhyew wɔ kurow yi n’emumuyɛ mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na okyinkyimii; na EWURADZE hun no mbɔbɔr ntsi, nkorɔfo no suoo ɔno nye ne yer nye ne mbabaa beenu no hɔn nsa mu na wɔdze hɔn puei, na wɔdze hɔn kesii kurow no n’ekyir.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔdze hɔn puei no, wɔsee dɛ, Hom nguan wɔ hom nkwa ntsi; mma hom mmbu hom kɔn ekyir, mma hom nngyina Tɛtɛr yi mu beebiara so; hom guan nkɔ bepɔw no do, ɔno bɛyɛ na hom ahyew.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Lot see hɔn dɛ, Ao! Mma ɔmmba no dɛm, mo wura.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei hwɛ, w’akowaa enya w’enyim enyimpa, na ama w’ehumbɔbɔr a edze ehu me adɔɔ so, wɔ dɛ agye me nkwa; mbom munnkotum meguan akɔ mbepɔw no do, ɔno bɛyɛ na mbusu no ato me ma meewu.
title: GENESIS

text: Hwɛ, kurow yi bɛn dɛ mubotum eguan akɔ mu, na osuar. Innhu dɛ osuar? Ao, ma munguan nkɔ hɔ, na me kra benya nkwa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, metsie wo wɔ adze kor yi so mu, dɛ monnkɔbɔ kurow a aka ho asɛm no.
title: GENESIS

text: Ka woho ɛ, guan kɔ hɔ; na murunntum biribiara yɛ, gyedɛ edu hɔ ana. Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ kurow no ne dzin Zoar ase nye dɛ kakraba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a Lot dur Zoar no, nna ewia epue asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna EWURADZE tɔɔ brestɔn nye ogya fi EWURADZE hɔ wɔ sor guu Sodom nye Gomora do;
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔbɔɔ nkurow no, nye Tɛtɛr no nyinara, nye hɔn a wɔtse nkurow no mu nyinara, nye dza ofifir asaase no do no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Lot ne yer buu no kɔn ekyir, na ɔdaan nkyensiw.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham soɛɛr anapaatu kɔr mbrɛ ogyinae wɔ EWURADZE n’enyim no:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔdaan n’enyi kɔr Sodom nye Gomora, nye Tɛtɛr no mu asaase no nyinara do, na, hwɛ, asaase no do wusiw foow sor dɛ fononoo wusiw.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Nyankopɔn sɛɛ Tɛtɛr no mu nkurow no, Nyankopɔn kaa Abraham, na aber a ɔbɔɔ nkurow a Lot tse mu no, oyii Lot wɔ ɔsɛɛ no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Lot fii Zoar fowee, na ɔkɛtsenaa bepɔw no do, na ne mbabaa beenu no ka no ho; osiandɛ osuroo dɛ ɔbɛtsena Zoar: na wɔtsenaa ɔbo tu mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na abakan no see ekumaba no dɛ, Hɛn egya ayɛ akɔdaa, na ɔbanyin biara nnyi asaase do a ɔbɛba hɛn nkyɛn dɛ mbrɛ asaase nyinara yɛ no:
title: GENESIS

text: Bra, ma yɛmma hɛn egya nnom nsa, na yɛnye no nkɛda, ama yeenya hɛn egya no ho mba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔmaa hɔn egya noom nsa anafua no: na abakan no kɔr mu, na ɔnye n’egya kɛdae; na oennhu ne ndaa mu, eso no nsoɛree mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ n’adzekyeenyim no, abakan no see ekumaba no dɛ, Hwɛ, menye m’egya daa anafua yi: ma yɛmma ɔnnom nsa anafua yi so; na kɔ mu, na enye no nkɛda, ama yeenya hɛn egya no ho mba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔmaa hɔn egya noom nsa anafua no so; na ekumaba no soɛree, na ɔnye no kɛdae; na oennhu ne ndaa mu, eso no nsoɛree mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm na Lot ne mbabaa beenu no nyina wɔnye hɔn egya nyinsenii.
title: GENESIS

text: Na abakan no woo babanyin, na ɔtoo no dzin Moab: ɔnoara nye Moabfo hɔn egya ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ekumaba no so woo babanyin, na ɔtoo no dzin Benammi: ɔnoara nye Ammonfo hɔn egya ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham tuu kwan fi hɔ kɔr Pomu Afamu Asaase do; na ɔkɛtsenaa Kades nye Sur ntamu; na ɔkɛyɛɛ hɔho wɔ Gerar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hɔ Abraham kaa no wɔ ne yer Sara ho dɛ, M’akyerɛbaa a: na Gerarhen Abimelek somae ma wɔkɛfaa Sara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn baa Abimelek hɔ wɔ anafua adaaso mu, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔbaa a akɛfa no ntsi ayɛ owufo ara nye no; na banyin no ne yer a.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei Abimelek nnyae mmfaa no ho nnkaa no: na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, aso iboku ɔman tsenenee so?
title: GENESIS

text: Ana ɔno noara annse me dɛ, M’akyerɛbaa a? Na noara, mekyerɛ ɔnoara ɔbaa no so see dɛ, Mo nua a: m’akoma mu tsewee, nye me nsa ho no krɔnkrɔnyɛ mu, na mayɛ yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see no adaaso mu, dɛ, ɛhɛɛ, minyim dɛ w’akoma mu tsewee mu na ayɛ yi, na mo so musuoo wo mu amma aannyɛ bɔn enntsia me: dɛm ntsi na mamma annka no.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm na yɛ afei, fa banyin no ne yer san kɛma no; na ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi, na ɔbɔsɔr ama wo, ma eenya nkwa: na sɛ ammfa no annsan amma no a, hu no ampaara dɛ ibowu, ɔwo, nye dza ɔyɛ wodze nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abimelek soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔfrɛɛ no nkowaa nyinara, na ɔkaa nsɛm yi nyinara wɔ hɔn aso mu: na nkorɔfo no hɔn akoma tuu kɛsenara.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Abimelek frɛɛ Abraham, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ayɛ hɛn yi? Na ebɛnadze mu na mayɛ bɔn etsia wo ma edze bɔn kokroko aba emi nye m’ahenman do yi? Adze a ɔnnsɛ dɛ wɔyɛ na edze ayɛ me yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abimelek bisaa Abraham dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ihunii, ma ayɛ dɛm adze yi?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham see dɛ, Osiandɛ modween dɛ, Ampaara Nyankopɔn no ho suro nnyi ha; na me yer ntsi woboku me.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔyɛ m’akyerɛbaa so ampa, m’egya ba a, na nnyɛ me na ba bi a; na ɔbɛyɛɛ me yer.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Nyankopɔn maa mifii m’egya fie mikekyinii no, nna mesee ɔbaa no dɛ, Ayamuyie a fa yɛ me nye yi; beebiara mbrɛ yebodu no, ka no wɔ mo ho dɛ, Mo nua a.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abimelek faa nguan, nye anantwi, nye nkowaa, nye mfonabaa, na ɔdze maa Abraham, na ɔdze ne yer Sara sanee maa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abimelek see dɛ, Hwɛ, m’asaase na ɔwɔ w’enyim yi: tsena beebiara mbrɛ woara epɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sara dze, ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, mama wo nua ndwetɛbona apem: hwɛ, ɔyɛ nkataenyim dze ma wo wɔ hɔn a wɔka wo ho nyinara hɔn mu; na enya dza ɔtsen wɔ nyimpa nyinara hɔn enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham sɔree maa Nyankopɔn: na Nyankopɔn yɛɛ Abimelek nye ne yer, nye no mfonabaa edur; na wɔwowoo mba.
title: GENESIS

text: Osiandɛ nna EWURADZE esiw Abimelek ne fie yafun nyinara mu kwan petsee wɔ Abraham ne yer Sara ntsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE bɛseraa Sara dɛ mbrɛ ɔsee no, na Ɔyɛɛ Sara dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ no anohoba no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sara nyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin maa Abraham wɔ no nkɔdaaber mu, wɔ aber a EWURADZE kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham too ne babanyin a Sara woo no maa no no, dzin Isaak.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham ne ba Isaak dzii nda awɔtwe no, otwaa no twatsia, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a wɔwoo ne ba Isaak maa no no, nna Abraham edzi mfe ɔha.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sara see dɛ, Nyankopɔn ama maserew; hɔn a wɔbɛtse nyinara nye me bɛserew.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Woana na nkyɛ akyerɛ Abraham dɛ, Sara bɛma mba enumfo? Naaso mawo babanyin ama no wɔ no nkɔdaaber mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na abofra no nyinii, na wotwaa no enumfo: na da a wotwaa Isaak enumfo no, Abraham too pon kɛsenara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sara hun Egyptnyi Hagar ne ba a ɔwoo no maa Abraham no, dɛ orisi atwetwe.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔsee Abraham dɛ, Yi afonabaa yi nye ne ba no edzi: na afonabaa yi ne ba nnkɛnye me ba Isaak edzi adze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na asɛm no yɛɛ Abraham yaw papaara, osian ne ba no ntsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see Abraham dɛ, Mma mma ɔnnyɛ wo yaw, osian abofra no ntsi, na osian w’afonabaa no ntsi; dza Sara ka kyerɛ wo no nyinara mu, tsie ne ndze; na Isaak mu na wɔbɛfrɛ w’asefo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na afonabaa no ne ba no so mebɛyɛ no ɔman, osiandɛ ɔyɛ w’asenyi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔfaa edziban nye nsu bɔdambɔ, na ɔdze maa Hagar, ɔdze sii no kɔn ho, na ogyaa ɔno nye abofra no kwan. Na Hagar sii mu, na okekyiin Beer-seba sar do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nsu a ɔwɔ bɔdambɔ no mu no no sae, na ɔdze abofra no too ndua no bi ase.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkɔree, na ɔkɛtsenaa ne tsentsendo wɔ ekyir kakra, bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔtow egyen a obodu: na ɔsee dɛ, Mma mma monnhwɛ abofra yi no wu. Na ɔtsenaa ne tsentsendo, na ɔmaa ne ndze do, na osui.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn tsee abofra no ne ndze; na Nyankopɔn no bɔfoe fi sor frɛɛ Hagar, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ebɛnadze yɛ wo, Hagar? Mma nnsuro; na Nyankopɔn atse abofra no ne ndze wɔ mbrɛ ɔwɔ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Soɛr, kɛma abofra no do, na fa wo nsa suo no mu; na mebɛyɛ no ɔman kɛse.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn buee n’enyiwa, na ohun nsubura bi; na ɔkɔree, na ɔkɛhyɛɛ bɔdambɔ no nsu ma, na ɔmaa abofra no nsu ma ɔnomee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn dzii abofra no ekyir, na onyinii; na ɔtsenaa sar do, na ɔyɛɛ egyentonyi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔtsenaa Paran sar do; na ne na kɔwaar yer wɔ Egypt asaase do brɛɛ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber no no mu na Abimelek nye ne safohen tsitsir Fikol kasaa kyerɛɛ Abraham dɛ, Nyankopɔn dzi w’ekyir wɔ dza eyɛ nyinara mu:
title: GENESIS

text: dɛm ntsi afei, fa Nyankopɔn dzi nsew kyerɛ me wɔ ha dɛ ennkɛdaadaa emi, nye me ba, nye me mbanana: na dɛ mbrɛ ayamuyie a medze ayɛ wo no tse no ara, ebɛyɛ ama emi, nye asaase a aba do ahɔhoyɛ yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham see dɛ, Mibedzi nsew.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham twuuw Abimelek n’enyim, wɔ nsubura a Abimelek no nkowaa dze enyimpi gyee no ntsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abimelek see dɛ, Minnyim nyia ɔyɛɛ iyi: na wo so annka annkyerɛ me, na nkyii so menntsee pɛn dɛ ndɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham faa nguan, nye anantwi, na ɔdze maa Abimelek; na hɔn beenu no dzii ahyɛmu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham yii nguankuw mu nguambaa aber esuon dze hɔn sii nkyɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abimelek bisaa Abraham dɛ, Na nguambaa aber esuon a eyi hɔn esi nkyɛn yi ase nye dɛn?
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nguambaa aber esuon yi na ebɛgye no wɔ me nsamu ama ɔaayɛ dase ama me, dɛ mara na mutuu bura yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Beer-seba; osiandɛ hɔ na hɔn beenu nyina wodzii nsew.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wodzii ahyɛmu wɔ Beer-seba wiei no, Abimelek soɛree, nye ne safohen tsitsir Fikol, na wɔsanee ba Filistiafo asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham tsɛɛw ɔsɛntsɛw dua wɔ Beer-seba, na ɔsɔɔr EWURADZE, ɔdomankoma Nyankopɔn no wɔ hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham yɛɛ hɔho wɔ Filistiafo asaase do nda pii.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom n’ekyir no Nyankopɔn sɔɔ Abraham hwɛe, na ɔsee dɛ, Abraham; na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na, ɔsee dɛ, Afei fa wo ba, wo ba kortonoo a edɔ no, mekyerɛ Isaak no, na kɔ Moria asaase do; na fa no kɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr wɔ hɔ, wɔ mbepɔw no mu kor a mebɛkyerɛ wo no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham soɛɛr anapaatu hyehyɛɛ n’asoasopɔnkɔ, na ɔfaa ne mberantsɛ no mu beenu kaa no ho, nye ne ba Isaak; na ɔpaa ɔhyew afɔr ne nyena no, na ɔsoɛree kɔr mbrɛ Nyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ne ndaansa no Abraham maa n’enyiwa do, na ohun bea no wɔ ekyir noho ara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham see ne mberantsɛ no dɛ, Hom nye asoasopɔnkɔ yi ntsena ha, na emi na abofra yi yɛbɔkɔ noho, na yɛakɔsɔr, na yɛasan aba hom nkyɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham faa ɔhyew afɔr no ne nyena no, na ɔdze soaa ne ba Isaak; na ɔfaa gya no nye sekan no kitsae; na hɔn beenu nyina bɔɔ mu kɔree.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak kasaa kyerɛɛ n’egya Abraham, na ɔsee dɛ, M’egya: na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye yi, me ba. Na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, ogya nye enyena nye yi: na eguambaa a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr no wɔ hen?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham see dɛ, Me ba, Nyankopɔn noara bɛkyerɛ eguambaa a wɔdze no bɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr: na hɔn beenu nyina bɔɔ mu kɔree.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wodur mbrɛ Nyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no no; na Abraham sii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ, na osiesiee nyena no yie, na ɔkyekyeer ne ba Isaak dze no too afɔrmbukyia no do wɔ nyena no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham tseen ne nsa, na ɔfaa sekan no dɛ ɔdze ruboku ne ba no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe fi sor frɛɛ no, na ɔsee dɛ, Abraham, Abraham: na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Mma mmfa wo nsa nnka abofra no, nkyii so mma nnyɛ no biribiara: na afei na mehu dɛ isuro Nyankopɔn, susuampa dɛ ɔwo annkam me wo ba, wo ba kortonoo ntsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham maa n’enyiwa do, na ɔhwɛe, na hwɛ, oguannyin a n’ambɛn ekosuo mbirikisi mu wɔ n’ekyir: na Abraham kɔree kɛfaa oguannyin no, na ɔdze no hyɛɛ ne ba n’ananmu bɔɔ hyew afɔr.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham frɛɛ bea no ne dzin Jehovah-jireh: dɛ mbrɛ ebodu ndɛ wɔda ho ara frɛ no no, dɛ, EWURADZE ne bepɔw do na wɔbɛkyerɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe fi sor frɛɛ Abraham bio dɛ,
title: GENESIS

text: mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye iyi, osiandɛ ayɛ dɛm adze yi, dɛ ammfa wo ba, wo ba kortsee no, annkam me ntsi, maka moho ntam:
title: GENESIS

text: dɛ nhyira mu a, mibehyira wo, na ɔdɔr mu a, mebɛma w’asefo adɔr dɛ ɔsor nworaba, na dɛ mpoano anhwea; na w’asefo bɛfa hɔn atamfo hɔn abotsen;
title: GENESIS

text: na w’asefo mu na wobehyira asaase amanaman nyinara; osiandɛ etsie me ndze.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Abraham sanee baa ne mberantsɛ no nkyɛn, na wɔsoɛree, na wɔbɔɔ mu kɔr Beer-seba; na Abraham tsenaa Beer-seba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no, wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Abraham dɛ, Hwɛ, Milka so awo ama wo nua Nahor;
title: GENESIS

text: n’abakan Uz, nye no nua Buz, nye Kemuel a ɔyɛ Aram n’egya;
title: GENESIS

text: nye Kesed, Hazo, Pildas, Jidlaf, nye Betuel.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Betuel woo Rebeka: baawɔtwe yi na Milka woe maa Abraham no nua Nahor.
title: GENESIS

text: Na no nwewe a ne dzin dze Reuma no, ɔno so ɔwoo Teba, Gaham, nye Tahas, nye Maaka.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sara dzii mfe ɔha eduonu esuon.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sara wui wɔ Kiriat-arba ɔnoara nye Hebron, wɔ Keenan asaase do; na Abraham bae begyaam Sara, na obosuu no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham soɛree fii no fun no enyim, na ɔkɛkasaa kyerɛɛ Hetmba no, dɛ,
title: GENESIS

text: Meyɛ ɔhɔho nye ɔmamforanyi wɔ hom nkyɛn: hom mma me efunsiebea bi wɔ hom nkyɛn, ma minsie mo fun mfi m’enyi do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Hetmba no buaa Abraham see no dɛ,
title: GENESIS

text: Mo wura, tsie hɛn: eyɛ okunyin katakyi wɔ hɛn mu: hɛn asamandan mu dza woara epɛ no, sie wo fun wɔ mu; hɛn mu biara nnkam wo n’asamandan, na sie wo fun.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham soɛree, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze maa asaase no do nkorɔfo no, mekyerɛ Hetmba no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔnye hɔn kasae see dɛ, Sɛ hom adwen nye dɛ misie mo fun fi m’enyi do a, wontsie me, na wɔnserɛ Zohar ne ba Efron mma me,
title: GENESIS

text: ma ɔmfa Makepela ɔbo tu a ɔwɔ no a ɔwɔ ne haban ano no mma me; ɔngye bo a ɔfata na ɔmfa mma me ma minnya efunsiebea wɔ hom finimfin.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei Efron tse Hetmba no hɔn finimfin: na Hetnyi Efron buaa Abraham wɔ Hetmba no asomu, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔhɛn no kurow n’abotsen mu no nyinara asomu dɛ,
title: GENESIS

text: Dabida, mo wura, tsie me: haban no medze ma wo, na ɔbo tu a ɔwɔ mu no medze ma wo; wɔ me man mba hɔn enyim medze ma wo: sie wo fun.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham bɔɔ no mu adze wɔ asaase no do nkorɔfo no hɔn enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ Efron wɔ asaase no do nkorɔfo no hɔn asomu dɛ, Mbom sɛ ibetsie a, ɔno, meserɛ wo, tsie me: mebɛma haban no ne tsibo; gye no wɔ mo hɔ, ma minsie mo fun wɔ hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Efron buaa Abraham see no dɛ,
title: GENESIS

text: Mo wura, tsie me: dwetɛ dwetɛbona ahaanan asaase nye dɛn wɔ emi na ɔwo ntamu? Dɛm ntsi sie wo fun.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham tsiee Efron; na Abraham keer dwɛɛtɛɛ a Efron bɔɔ dzin wɔ Hetmba no asomu no maa no, dwetɛ dwetɛbona ahaanan a ɔyɛ eguadzifo sika a wodzi no.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Efron ne haban a ɔwɔ Makepela a ɔwɔ Mamre enyim no, haban no, nye ɔbo tu a ɔwɔ mu no, nye ndua a ɔwɔ haban no mu no nyinara a ɔwɔ ne hanoa nyinara bɔ aprɔw no, wosii no pi
title: GENESIS

text: maa Abraham dɛ enyadze wɔ Hetmba no hɔn enyim, wɔ hɔn a wɔhɛn no kurow n’abotsen mu nyinara enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na iyi n’ekyir no, Abraham siee ne yer Sara wɔ Makepela haban no mu ɔbo tu mu wɔ Mamre enyim (ɔnoara nye Hebron), wɔ Keenan asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na haban no, nye ɔbotu a ɔwɔ mu no, Hetmba no sii no pi dɛ enyadze maa Abraham dɛ efunsiebea.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham ayɛ akɔdaa, na oedzi mfe ara yie: na EWURADZE hyiraa Abraham wɔ adze nyinara mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham see, ne fie somfo panyin a ɔhwɛ adze a ɔwɔ nyinara do no, dɛ, Meserɛ wo, fa wo nsa to m’aserɛ ase:
title: GENESIS

text: na mebɛma edze EWURADZE, sor Nyankopɔn nye asaase Nyankopɔn no, edzi nsew, dɛ ennkɛgye Keenanfo a metse hɔn mu yi, hɔn mbabaa mu bi yer ama me ba:
title: GENESIS

text: na ebɔkɔ mo kurow mu, na akɛgye yer wɔ m’ebusua mu abrɛ me ba Isaak.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsomfo no see dɛ, Bi a ɔbaa no nnkɛpɛ dɛ ɔbɛka mo do aba asaase yi do: ɔnodze memfa wo ba nsan nkɔ asaase a ifi do bae no do bio a?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham see no dɛ, Hwɛ woho yie mma aammfa me ba annkɔ hɔ bio.
title: GENESIS

text: EWURADZE, ɔsor Nyankopɔn no a ɔfaa me fii m’egya fie, nye asaase a wɔwoo me do no, na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ me, na odzii nsew kyerɛɛ me, dɛ, W’asefo na medze asaase yi mebɛma hɔn no; ɔbɔsoma no bɔfoe ma oeedzi w’enyim, na akɛgye yer wɔ hɔ abrɛ me ba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na sɛ ɔbaa no ammpɛ dɛ ɔbɛka wo do a, ɔno na wo ho efi me ntam yi mu: me ba no ara na mma mmfa no nnkɔ hɔ bio.
title: GENESIS

text: Na akowaa no dze ne nsa too no wura Abraham ne serɛ ase, na odzii nsew kyerɛɛ no wɔ asɛm yi ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na akowaa no faa no wura n’efumpɔnkɔ mu du, na no wura ne ndzɛmba papa nyinara awɔ ne nsamu: no bi na osii mu kɔr Mesopotemia, Nahor kurow mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔmaa efumpɔnkɔ no butubutuuw kurotsia nsubura no ho ewimbibaamu, aber a mbaa pue kɛsaw nsu no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbɔɔ mpaa dɛ, EWURADZE, mo wura Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, meserɛ wo, ma minhyia yie ndɛ, na yɛ mo wura Abraham ayamuyie.
title: GENESIS

text: Hwɛ, migyina nsubura yi ho; na kurow no mu mba mbabaa rupue abɛsaw nsu:
title: GENESIS

text: na ma ɔmbra dɛ, akataasia a mebɛse no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, soɛ w’ehina, ma monnom bi; na ɔbɛse dɛ, Nom bi, na mebɛma w’efumpɔnkɔ no nsu ma wɔaanom no: ɔnoara na ma ɔnyɛ nyia eyi no ama w’akowaa Isaak; na ɔnam dɛm no do na mubohu dɛ ayɛ mo wura ayamuyie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ onnyae nnwiee kasa no, hwɛ, Rebeka a wɔwoo no maa Betuel a ɔyɛ Abraham no nua Nahor ne yer Milka ne ba no, puei, na n’ehina si no kɔn ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na akataasia no no ho yɛ fɛw dodow, na ɔyɛ ɔbaabun, osiandɛ ɔbanyin biara nnhun no pɛn: na osianee kɔr bura no mu, na ɔkɛhyɛɛ n’ehina ma, na ɔbaa sor.
title: GENESIS

text: Na akowaa no tutuu mbirika kehyiaa no kwan, na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma monnom w’ehina mu nsu kakra.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nom bi, mo wura: na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm soɛɛ ehina no taa ne nsamu, na ɔmaa no nsu ma ɔnomee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a owiee no nsu ma ma ɔnomee no, ɔsee dɛ, Mebɛsesaw bi abrɛ w’efumpɔnkɔ no so, dze ekodu dɛ wobowie nom.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm, na ohuee n’ehina mu nsu guu ɔdaasee mu, na otutuu mbirika kɔr bura no mu bio kɛsawee, na ɔsawee maa n’efumpɔnkɔ no nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na banyin no hwɛɛ no haa dɛ obohu kyerɛ EWURADZE ama n’akwantu no ayɛ prɔmprɔm anaa ɔnnyɛe.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, efumpɔnkɔ no wiee nsu nom no, nna banyin no faa sika mpɛtsea a n’ano tow dwetɛbona fa, nye ne nsakɔnadze ebien a n’ano tow sika dwetɛbona du dze hyɛɛ ne nsa;
title: GENESIS

text: na obisaa no dɛ, Woana babaa nye wo? Meserɛ wo, ka kyerɛ me. Ana ɔkwan wɔ w’egya fie ma hɛn dɛ yɛbɔsoɛ hɔ?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Rebeka see no dɛ, Betuel a ɔyɛ Milka ne babanyin a ɔwoo no maa Nahor no, ne babaa nye me.
title: GENESIS

text: Nkyii so ɔsee no dɛ, Yɛwɔ efuw nye mbowa edziban pii, nye dan a wɔsoɛ mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na banyin no bɔɔ ne tsir adze, na ɔsɔɔr EWURADZE.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nhyira nka EWURADZE, mo wura Abraham ne Nyankopɔn a ɔammpow n’ehumbɔbɔr nye no nokwar no wɔ mo wura ho: emi dze, EWURADZE egya me kwan aba mo wura no nuanom fie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na akataasia no tuu mbirika kɔree, na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ ne na ne fifo dɛ mbrɛ nsɛm yi tse ara.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Rebeka wɔ nuabanyin bi a ne dzin dze Laban.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ohun mpɛtsea nye nsakɔnadze wɔ n’akyerɛbaa Rebeka ne nsa, na ɔtsee n’akyerɛbaa ne nsɛm no, dɛ, Mbrɛ banyin no kaa kyerɛɛ no no, otutuu mbirika baa banyin no nkyɛn; na, hwɛ, ogyina efumpɔnkɔ no nkyɛn wɔ bura no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban see no dɛ, Bra fie, ɔwo a EWURADZE ehyira wo; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na igyina kurotsia yi? Mesiesie dan no, nye kwan ama efumpɔnkɔ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na banyin no baa fie no mu, na Laban yiyii efumpɔnkɔ no hɔn do ndzɛmba; na ɔmaa hɔn edziban, na ɔmaa nsu dɛ banyin no nye hɔn a wɔka no ho no dze ahohor hɔn anan ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔdze edziban besii n’enyim dɛ ondzi: na ɔsee dɛ, Minnkedzi, gyedɛ mabɔ m’amandzɛɛ ana. Na ɔsee dɛ, Bɔ ɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Meyɛ Abraham no somfo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE ehyira mo wura kɛsenara; na ɔayɛ kɛse: na ɔama no nguan nye anantwi, na dwetɛ nye sika, na nkowaa nye mfonabaa, na efumpɔnkɔ nye nsoasopɔnkɔ.
title: GENESIS
