text: Na aber a mo wura ne yer yɛɛ aberwa no, nna ɔwoo babanyin maa mo wura: na ɔno na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara ama no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mo wura maa midzii nsew dɛ, Mma nngye yer wɔ Kanaanfo a metse hɔn asaase do yi hɔn mbabaa mu mma me ba.
title: GENESIS

text: Kɔ m’egya fie, nye m’ebusua mu, na kɛgye yer ma me ba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mesee mo wura dɛ, Bi a ɔbaa no nnkɛka mo do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, EWURADZE a menam n’enyim no, ɔbɔsoma no bɔfoe ma ɔaabɛka wo ho, na ɔama wo kwan do ayɛ dwudwoodwo; na ebɛgye yer wɔ m’ebusua mu, nye m’egya fie ama me ba.
title: GENESIS

text: Sɛ ekɔ m’ebusua mu na sɛ wɔammfa no amma wo a, ɔnodze na wo ho efi me ntam mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mebaa bura no do ndɛ, na mesee dɛ, EWURADZE, mo wura Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, sɛ afei erema mo kwan a morokɔ yi ayɛ dwudwoodwo a:
title: GENESIS

text: hwɛ migyina nsubura yi ho; na ma ɔmbra dɛ akataasia a obopue abɛsaw bi a mebɛse no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma me w’ehina mu nsu kakra ma monnom;
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔbɛse me dɛ, ɔwoara nom bi, na mebɛsaw bi ama w’efumpɔnkɔ so no: ɔnoara na ma ɔnyɛ ɔbaa a EWURADZE eyi no ama mo wura ne ba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ansaana murubowie kasa wɔ m’akoma mu no, hwɛ, Rebeka puei na n’ehina si no kɔn ho; na osianee kɔr bura no mu, na ɔkɛsawee: na mesee no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma monnom bi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm soɛɛ n’ehina fii no kɔn ho, na ɔsee dɛ, Nom bi, na mebɛma w’efumpɔnkɔ so bi ma wɔaanom: nna monomee, na ɔmaa efumpɔnkɔ no so bi ma wɔnomee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mibisaa no dɛ, Woana babaa nye wo? Na ɔsee dɛ, Nahor ba Betuel a Milka woo no maa no no, ne babaa nye me: na medze mpɛtsea no hyɛɛ no hwen, na medze nsakɔnadze no hyehyɛɛ ne nsa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mobɔɔ me tsir adze, na mosɔɔr EWURADZE, na mihyiraa EWURADZE, mo wura Abraham ne Nyankopɔn no a ogyaa me wɔ ɔkwan pa mu dɛ membɛfa mo wura no nua ne babaa nkɛma ne ba no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na afei sɛ hom bɛnye mo wura edzi no ayamuyie mu nye nokwar mu a, ɔno wɔnka nkyerɛ me: oho so a, wɔnka nkyerɛ me; ama maadan mafa enyimfa anaa abankum.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Laban nye Betuel buae na wɔsee dɛ, Asɛm no fi EWURADZE hɔ: yennkotum aka bɔn anaa papa akyerɛ wo.
title: GENESIS

text: Hwɛ, Rebeka na ɔwɔ w’enyim yi, fa no kɔ, ma ɔnkɛyɛ wo wura ne ba ne yer, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE aka no ara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Abraham no somfo no tsee hɔn nsɛm no, ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ famu maa EWURADZE.
title: GENESIS

text: Na oyii dwetɛ egudze, nye sika egudze, nye atar, na ɔdze maa Rebeka: ɔmaa no nua nye ne na so ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wodzidzii na wɔnomee, ɔno nye mbanyin a wɔka no ho no, na wotsintsiim hɔ anafua no nyinara. Na wɔsoɛɛr anapa no, ɔsee dɛ, Hom ngya me kwan ma monkɔ mo wura hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Rebeka no nua nye ne na see dɛ, Ma akataasia no nye hɛn ntsena nda kakra, bɛyɛ dɛ dadu; na n’ekyir no ɔaakɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma wonnsiw me kwan, osiandɛ EWURADZE ama mo kwan ayɛ prɔmprɔm; hom ngya me kwan ma monkɔ mo wura hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Yɛbɛfrɛ akataasia no, na yeebisa n’anomu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔfrɛɛ Rebeka, na wɔsee no dɛ, Ana enye ɔbarimba yi bɔkɔ? Na ɔsee dɛ, Mobɔkɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wogyaa hɔn akyerɛbaa Rebeka, nye no somfo, nye Abraham somfo no, nye no nkorɔfo no kwan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wohyiraa Rebeka, na wɔsee no dɛ, Hɛn akyerɛbaa, yɛ na ma ɔpedu horow mpempem, na w’asefo nnya hɔn a wokyir hɔn hɔn mbobow mfa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Rebeka nye ne mbabaawa soɛree, na wɔtsenatsenaa efumpɔnkɔ no do, na wɔkaa banyin no do: na wosii mu kɔr hɔn kwan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak fi Beer-lahai-roi kwan do aba; osiandɛ nna ɔtse Pomu Afamu Asaase no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Isaak puee ewimbir kɔr haban mu kɔdwendwenee: na ɔmaa n’enyiwa do, na ɔhwɛe, na hwɛ, efumpɔnkɔ reba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Rebeka maa n’enyiwa do, na aber a ohun Isaak no, ofii efumpɔnkɔ no do dwirii.
title: GENESIS

text: Na obisaa Abraham no somfo no dɛ, Ebɛn banyin na ɔnam haban mu ribehyia hɛn yi? Na akowaa no see dɛ, Mo wura a: na basia no faa ne nkataenyim dze kataa noho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsomfo no kaa adze a ɔyɛe nyinara kyerɛɛ Isaak.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak dze Rebeka baa asese a nna ne na Sara tse mu no; na ɔfaa Rebeka yɛɛ no ne yer; na ɔdɔɔ no: na Isaak no werɛ kyekyeree wɔ ne na no wu no ekyir.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham waar yer kor so, ne dzin dze Ketura.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔwoo Zimran, Joksan, Medan, Midian, Isbak, nye Sua maa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Joksan woo Seba, nye Dedan. Na Dedan ne mba nye Assurim, Letusim, nye Leumim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Midian ne mba nye Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida, nye Eldaa. Woyinom nyinara yɛ Ketura ne mba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham dze dza ɔwɔ nyinara maa Isaak.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mbasiafo nkaa no mba a Abraham wɔ no dze, Abraham kyɛɛ hɔn adze; na ogyaa hɔn kwan, boka afamu, fii ne ba Isaak ho, ber a ɔda ho tse ase no, ma wɔkɔr boka asaase no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham no nkwaber mu mfe yɛ mfe ɔha eduosuon enum.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abraham gyaa no sunsum mu, na owuu nkɔdaaber pa mu, akɔdaa a, nna oedzi mfe pii; na wɔdze no kɛkaa no nkorɔfo ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ne mba Isaak nye Ismael siee no wɔ Makepela ɔbo tu mu, wɔ Hetnyi Zohar ne ba Efron ne haban no mu, wɔ Mamre n’enyim;
title: GENESIS

text: haban no a Abraham tɔɔ no wɔ Hetmba nsamu no mu: hɔ na wosiee Abraham nye ne yer Sara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Abraham no wu ekyir no, Nyankopɔn hyiraa ne ba Isaak; na Isaak tsenaa Beer-lahai-roi ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei iyinom nye Abraham ne ba Ismael a Egyptnyi Hagar, Sara n’afonabaa no, woo no maa Abraham no n’ebusuasantsen:
title: GENESIS

text: Ismael ne mba hɔn edzin a wɔdze frɛɛ hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn awoo ndzidzido tsetsee. Nebaiot nye Ismael n’abakan; na nkaa no nye Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
title: GENESIS

text: Misma, Duma, nye Massa
title: GENESIS

text: Binom so nye Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Nafis, nye Kedema:
title: GENESIS

text: iyinom nye Ismael ne mba, na iyinom nye hɔn edzin, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkuroba, nye hɔn nseraban no tsetsee; etsitsir duebien dɛ mbrɛ hɔn aman tsetsee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Ismael no nkwaber mu mfe a dzii nye yi, mfe ɔha eduasa esuon: na ogyaa no sunsum mu na owui; na wɔdze no kɛkaa no nkorɔfo ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔtsenaa fi Havila kodur Sur a ɔwɔ Egypt enyim no, edze rokɔ Asiria afamu no: na ɔnye no nuanom no anntsena wɔ abodwee mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na iyinom nye Abraham ne ba Isaak n’ebusuasantsen: Abraham woo Isaak;
title: GENESIS

text: na Isaak dzii mfe eduanan no, nna ɔwaar Rebeka, Sirianyi Betuel ne babaa a ofi Paddan-aram, Sirianyi Laban n’akyerɛbaa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak serɛɛ EWURADZE maa ne yer, osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔbɔnyin: na EWURADZE tsiee no nkotoserɛ no, na ne yer Rebeka nyinsenii.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mbofra no dzii aper wɔ no mu; na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ ɔtse dɛm a, ebɛnadze ntsi na metse ase? Na ɔkɔree kebisaa EWURADZE.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Aman ebien na wɔwɔ wo yamu, Na nkorɔfo ahorow ebien na wɔbɛpaa hɔnho mu efi wo yafun mu; Na ɔman no mu kor bɛyɛ dzen asen kor; Na ɔpanyin no bɔsom ekumaba no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a ne nda dur dɛ ɔbɔwo no, nna hwɛ, nta wɔ ne yamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nyia odzi kan no ɔbae, no ho memennmen, no ho nyinara wɔ nhwi futuww dɛ nhwi atar; na wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Esau.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔno n’ekyir no no nua bae, na ne nsa dze Esau ne nantsir; na wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Jakob na aber a wɔwoo hɔn no, nna Isaak edzi mfe eduosia.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mbofra no nyinii: na Esau yɛɛ ɔbɔfo a onyim ahayɛ papaapa, ɔhamunyi a; na Jakob dze ɔyɛɛ nyimpa a ɔyɛ ɔdwe na ɔtsetse asese mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei Isaak dɔɔ Esau, osiandɛ odzii ne hanam no bi: na Rebeka dɔɔ Jakob.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob yɛɛ edziban bi: na Esau fi hamu bae no, nna ɔatɔ bitsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau see Jakob dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma me edziban yi bi na mindzi; na matɔ bitsi: dɛm ntsi wɔdze too no dzin Edom.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob see dɛ, Tɔn wo mpanyinyɛ ma me ndɛ da yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau see dɛ, Hwɛ, migyina wuso: na ebɛn mfaso na panyin yi bɛyɛ ama me?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob see dɛ, Dzi nsew kyerɛ me ndɛ da yi; na odzii nsew kyerɛɛ no: na ɔtɔɔn ne mpanyinyɛ maa Jakob.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob maa Esau boodoo nye eduwa noae, na odzii na ɔnomee, na ɔsoɛree ɔkɔr no kwan: na Esau emmbu ne mpanyinyɛ no hwee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkɔm sii asaase no do, ɔsor nkan no ɔkɔm a Abraham n’aber do no osii no. Na Isaak kɔr Filistiafo hɔn hen Abimelek nkyɛn wɔ Gerar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE yii noho kyerɛɛ no, na ɔsee dɛ, Mma nnkɔ Egypt; tsena asaase a mebɛkyerɛ wo no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Tsena asaase yi do dɛ ɔhɔho, na menye wo bɛtsena, na mehyira wo; na ɔwo, nye w’asefo, na medze asaase yi nyinara mebɛma hom, na mebɛma ntam a mekaa kyerɛɛ w’egya Abraham no etsim;
title: GENESIS

text: na mebɛma w’asefo adɔr dɛ ɔsor nworaba, na medze asaase yi nyinara ama w’asefo; na w’asefo mu na wobehyira asaase do aman nyinara,
title: GENESIS

text: osiandɛ Abraham tsiee me ndze, na odzii me nkyerɛkyerɛ, me mbrasɛm, m’ahyɛdze, nye me mbra do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak tsenaa Gerar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hɔ mba no bisaa no wɔ ne yer ho; na ɔsee dɛ, M’akyerɛbaa a: osiandɛ osuroo dɛ ɔbɛse dɛ, Me yer a; na ɔsee dɛ, bɛyɛ na osian Rebeka ntsi hɔ mba no eku me: osiandɛ no ho yɛ fɛw.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔkyɛɛr hɔ no, Filistiafo hen Abimelek hwɛɛ tokura mu, na ohun dɛ Isaak nye ne yer Rebeka rowewe.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abimelek frɛɛ Isaak, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, ampaara wo yer a: na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ekaa dɛ, ɔyɛ m’akyerɛbaa yi? Na Isaak see no dɛ, Osiandɛ mesee dɛ, Bɛyɛ na mewu wɔ ne ntsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abimelek see dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ayɛ hɛn yi? Nkyɛ erebɛyɛ ma nkorɔfo yi mu bi nye wo yer ada, ma edze afɔdzi aba hɛn do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abimelek hyɛɛ nkorɔfo no nyinara, dɛ, Nyia ɔbɛtsen ne nsa aka banyin yi anaa ne yer no ampaara dɛ woboku no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak duaa aba wɔ asaase no do, no onyaa ɔha mbɔho wɔ afe no ara mu: osiandɛ EWURADZE hyiraa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na banyin no nyaa no ho, na onyaa no ho araa kodur dɛ ɔyɛɛ kɛsenara:
title: GENESIS

text: Onyaa nguankuw, anantwikuw, fifo kɛsenara: na Filistiafo hɔn enyi beer no.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei mbura a n’egya Abraham n’aber do no n’egya no nkowaa tutui no nyinara Filistiafo no sisiiw no, na wɔdze dɛtse hyehyɛɛ mu amaama.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abimelek see Isaak dɛ, Fi hɛn nkyɛn kɔ; na ɔwo ewɔ tum dodow sen hɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak fii hɔ kɔree, na ɔkɔbɔɔ asese wɔ Gerar bɔnsa mu, na ɔtsenaa hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak tutuu mbura a n’egya aber do no wotutui no fofor; osiandɛ Abraham wui n’ekyir no Filistiafo no sisiiw no: na ɔfrɛfrɛɛ hɔn edzin dɛ mbrɛ n’egya dze frɛfrɛɛ hɔn no ara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak no nkowaa tuu bɔnsa no mu, na wɔkɔtoo mbasu bura wɔ hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Gerar mbowahwɛfo wɔnye Isaak no mbowahwɛfo perperee, dɛ, Nsu no hɛndze a: na ɔfrɛɛ bura no ne dzin Esek; osiandɛ wɔnye no perperee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wotuu bura fofor, na wɔperpeer ɔno so ho; na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Sitna.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ofii hɔ, na okotuu bura fofor; na ɔnodze wɔammperper ho: na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Rehobot, na ɔsee dɛ, na afei EWURADZE ama hɛn bea, na yɛbɔwowo wɔ asaase yi do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ofii hɔ kɔr Beer-seba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE yii noho kyerɛɛ no anafua no ara, na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye w’egya Abraham ne Nyankopɔn: mma nnsuro, na menye wo nam, na mibehyira wo, na osian m’akowaa Abraham ntsi mebɛma w’asefo adɔr.
title: GENESIS

text: Na osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔsɔɔr EWURADZE, na ɔbɔɔ n’asesee wɔ hɔ: na hɔ na Isaak no nkowaa tuu bura.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Abimelek nye ne nyɛnko Ahuz-zat, nye ne safohen tsitsir Fikol, fi Gerar kɔr ne nkyɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak bisaa hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom aba mo hɔ yi, hwɛ dɛ hom tan me, na hom eyi me edzi wɔ hom nkyɛn?
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Yeehu no kotoo dɛ, EWURADZE nye wo nam: na yɛsee dɛ, Ma ntam nda hɛn ntamu, mekyerɛ hɛn nye ɔwo ntamu a, na ma yɛnye wo ndzi ahyɛmu;
title: GENESIS

text: dɛ ennkɛyɛ hɛn bɔn bi, osiandɛ yɛanntsen hɛn nsa annka wo, na yɛnnyɛ wo hwee dɛ papa nko, na yeegya wo kwan wɔ asomdwee mu: osiandɛ ɔwo nye nyia EWURADZE ehyira no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔtoo hɔn pon, ma wodzidzii na wɔnomee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsoɛɛr anapahema, na wodzii nsew kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔnho: na Isaak gyaa hɔn kwan, na wɔdze asomdwee fii ne nkyɛn kɔree.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ da no ara, na Isaak no nkowaa bae, na wɔbɛkaa no bura a wotui no ho asɛm, na wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛato nsu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ no Siba: dɛm ntsi kurow no ne dzin dze Beer-seba ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a Esau dzii mfe eduanan no, ɔwaar Hetnyi Beeri ne babaa Judit, nye Hetnyi Elon ne babaa Basemat:
title: GENESIS

text: na wɔyɛɛ ma Isaak nye Rebeka dzi awerɛhow.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Isaak yɛɛ akɔdaa, na n’enyi do yɛɛ no kusukusu, na onnhu adze yie no, ɔsomaa frɛɛ ne ba panyin Esau, na ɔsee no dɛ, Me ba: na ɔgyee no do dɛ, Egya Emi nye yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Afei hwɛ, mayɛ akɔdaa, minnyim mo wu da.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, fa w’ahayɛdze, w’egyen kotoku nye w’egyen, na kɔ hamu kɛfa hanam brɛ me;
title: GENESIS

text: na yɛ me edziban a ɔyɛ huam, dɛ mbrɛ mepɛ, na fa brɛ me, ma mindzi; na me kra nhyira wo ana mewu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a Isaak rekasa kyerɛ ne ba Esau no, Rebeka tsee. Na Esau kɔr hamu dɛ orukoku abowa, na ɔdze aba no.
title: GENESIS

text: Rebeka kaa kyerɛɛ ne ba Jakob dɛ, Hwɛ, metsee dɛ w’egya reka kyerɛ wo nua Esau dɛ,
title: GENESIS

text: Kɛfa hanam brɛ me, na yɛ me edziban a ɔyɛ huam, ma mindzi, na minhyira wo wɔ EWURADZE enyim ansaana mewu.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, me ba, tsie me ndze dɛ mbrɛ merehyɛ wo yi ara.
title: GENESIS

text: Kɔ mpɔnkyebuw no mu, na kɛkyer mpɔnkyemba a woye ebien wɔ hɔ brɛ me: na medze bɛyɛ edziban a ɔyɛ huam ama w’egya, dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ:
title: GENESIS

text: na edze akɛma no, ama oedzi, na oeehyira wo ansaana oewu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob see ne na Rebeka dɛ, Hwɛ, mo nua Esau no ho wɔ nhwi, na emi mo ho yɛ monomonom.
title: GENESIS

text: Bi a m’egya bɛkeka mo ho ahwɛ, na mebɛyɛ n’enyi do dɛ ɔdaadaafo; na medze mpaa mebɛba mo do, na nnyɛ nhyira a.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ne na see no dɛ, Wo mpaama mbra mo do, me ba: ɔwo tsie me ndze ara, na kɔ kɛfa hɔn brɛ me.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkɔree kɛfae, na ɔdze brɛɛ ne na: na ne na ɔdze yɛɛ edziban a ɔyɛ huam, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya pɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Rebeka faa ne ba panyin Esau ne ntar fɛɛfɛw a ɔwɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ fie no bi na ɔdze hyɛɛ ne ba kuma Jakob:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔdze mpɔnkyemba no hɔn nwoma duraduraa ne nsa ho nye no kɔn monomonom no ho:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔdze edziban a ɔyɛ huam no nye boodoo a woesiesie no dze hyɛɛ ne ba Jakob nsa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa n’egya hɔ, na ɔfrɛɛ no dɛ, M’egya: na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye yi. Woana nye wo, me ba?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob see n’egya dɛ, Emi nye w’abakan Esau; mayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ekyerɛɛ me no: soɛr meserɛ wo, tsena hɔ na dzi me hanam yi bi, ama wo kra eehyira me.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak bisaa ne ba no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ma wo nsa kaa no ntsɛm dɛm, me ba? Na obuaa dɛ, Osiandɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn maa mihyiaa yie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak see Jakob dɛ, Pin ha, meserɛ wo, ma menkeka wo monhwɛ, me ba, kyerɛ dɛ me ba Esau noara nye wo anaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob piin n’egya Isaak nkyɛn; na ɔkekaa no ho hwɛe, na ɔsee dɛ, Ndze no yɛ Jakob ne ndze, na nsa no na ɔyɛ Esau ne nsa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na oennhu no, osiandɛ ne nsa ho wɔ nhwi, dɛ mbrɛ no nua Esau ne nsa ho tse: nna ohyiraa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na obisaa dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye me ba Esau ara? Na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Fa pin me nkyɛn, ma mindzi me ba ne hanam yi bi, ma me kra nhyira wo. Na ɔdze piin ne nkyɛn, ma odzii: na ɔdze nsa brɛɛ no, ma ɔnomee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na n’egya Isaak see no dɛ, Afei pin ha, na bɛfew m’ano, me ba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔtwee pinii feew n’ano: na Isaak ohuaa n’atar no huam, na ohyiraa no, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, me ba ho hua Tse dɛ haban a EWURADZE ehyira do no mu hua:
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn mma wo sor bɔsu bi, Nye asaase ne seradze bi, Nye eburow nye nsa pii:
title: GENESIS

text: Aman nsom wo, Na amanaman nkotow wo: Yɛ wo nuanom do wura, Na wo na mba nkotow wo: Ndom nka hɔn a wɔdom wo nyinara, Na nhyira nka hɔn a wohyira wo nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, Isaak wiee Jakob nhyira no, na Jakob fii n’egya nkyɛn firii ara pɛ nna no nua Esau fi n’ahayɛ baa fie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔno so yɛɛ edziban a ɔyɛ huam, na ɔdze brɛɛ n’egya; na ɔsee n’egya dɛ, Wɔmma m’egya nsoɛr, na ondzi ne ba ne hanam yi bi, ma ne kra nhyira me
title: GENESIS

text: Na n’egya Isaak bisaa no dɛ, Woana nye wo? Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mara wo ba, w’abakan Esau a.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak no ho popoo kɛsenara, na ɔsee dɛ, Woana mbɔ na ɔakɛfa hanam, na ɔdze abrɛ me, ma medzi ne nyinara bi ansaana ereba, na mehyira no yi? Ampa, mehyiraa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Aber a Esau tsee n’egya ne nsɛm no, osuu su kɛse a ɔyɛ wen, na ɔsee n’egya dɛ, Hyira mo so, mo so bi, ao m’egya.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Wo nua dze ndaadaa aba abɛgye wo nhyira kɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau see dɛ, Ana ɔno wɔmmfrɛ no Jakob bi? Iyi ka ho a oedzi me emim mpɛn ebien: ɔagye me panyin; na, hwɛ, afei ɔagye me nhyira. Na obisaa dɛ, Ana enngyaa me nhyira biara?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak buae na ɔsee Esau dɛ. Hwɛ mayɛ no wo wura, na medze no nuanom nyinara mayɛ no nkowaa; na eburow nye nsa nna medze awowaw no: na ɔwo dze, ebɛnadze na menyɛ mma wo, me ba?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau bisaa n’egya dɛ, Aso nhyira kor pɛ na ewɔ, m’egya? Hyira mo so, mo so bi, ao m’egya. Na Esau maa ne ndze do na osui.
title: GENESIS

text: Na n’egya Isaak buae na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, mbrɛ asaase a seradze nnyi no na ɔbɛyɛ wo tsenabea, Na mbrɛ ɔsor ɔbɔsu yɛ hɔ na;
title: GENESIS

text: Na edze w’afona bɛtsena ase, na ebɔsom wo nua; Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ egye woho a, ɔno ibeyi no kɔndua wɔ wo kɔn ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau taan Jakob wɔ nhyira a n’egya dze hyiraa no ntsi: na Esau see n’akoma mu dɛ, Nda a wɔdze bosu m’egya no abɛn; afei muruboku mo nua Jakob.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ne ba panyin Esua ne nsɛm no wɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ Rebeka; na ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ ne ba kuma Jakob, na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, wo nua Esau kyekye no werɛ wɔ wo ho dɛ oruboku wo.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, me ba, tsie me ndze; na soɛr, guan kɔ mo nua Laban nkyɛn wɔ Haran;
title: GENESIS

text: na kɛtsena ne nkyɛn nda kakra, kɛpem dɛ wo nua n’ebufuw befi no mu;
title: GENESIS

text: na no werɛ befir dza edze ayɛ no no; na mobɔsoma ma wɔaabɛfa wo wɔ hɔ aba: bɛyɛ dɛn ntsi na mobɔhwer hom beenu nyina da kor?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Rebeka see Isaak dɛ, Mo nkwa afon me, osian Het mbabaa ntsi: sɛ Jakob war yer wɔ Het mbabaa mu, dɛ woyinom a, wɔ asaase yi do mbabaa yi mu a, nna membrɛe ngui bi? Nna metse ase reyɛ dɛn?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak frɛɛ Jakob, na ohyiraa no, na ɔhyɛɛ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Mma nnwar yer wɔ Keenan mbabaa mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Soɛr, kɔ Paddan-aram, wo na n’egya Betuel fie; na kɔwar yer wɔ wo na no nua Laban ne mbabaa no hɔn mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn Otumfo nhyira wo, na ɔmma wo, na dɔr, ama aayɛ aman asafo;
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔmfa Abraham nhyira mma ɔwo nye w’asefo a wɔka wo ho; ama eenya asaase a eyɛ do hɔho a Nyankopɔn dze maa Abraham yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak gyaa Jakob kwan: na ɔkɔr Sirianyi Betuel ne ba Laban a ɔyɛ Jakob nye Esau hɔn na Rebeka no nuabanyin no nkyɛn wɔ Paddan-aram.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei Esau hun dɛ Isaak ehyira Jakob, na oegya no kwan dɛ ɔnkɔ Paddan-Aram nkɔwar yer wɔ hɔ; na orihyira no no ɔhyɛɛ no dɛ, Mma nnwar yer wɔ Keenan mbabaa hɔn mu;
title: GENESIS

text: ma Jakob etsie n’egya nye ne na, na ɔkɔ Paddan-aram.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau hun dɛ Keenan mbabaa no nnyɛ n’egya Isaak enyisɔ no;
title: GENESIS

text: osii mu kɔr Ismael nkyɛn, na ɔkɔwaar Abraham ne ba Ismael ne babaa Mahalat a ɔyɛ Nebaiot n’akyerɛbaa, kaa no yernom no ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob fii Beer-seba, na osii mu kɔr Haran afamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsoɛɛ bea bi do, na ɔtsenaa hɔ anafua no nyinara, osiandɛ iwi akɔtɔ, na ɔfaa hɔ abo no kor na ɔdze ne tsir sunii, na ɔdaa hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsoo daa, na hwɛ atwer si asaase do, na n’etsifi pem sor; Nyankopɔn n’abɔfoe ridzi do mfowsian.
title: GENESIS

text: Na, hwɛ, EWURADZE gyina n’etsifi, na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye EWURADZE, w’egya Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, na Isaak ne Nyankopɔn: asaase a eda do no, medze mebɛma ɔwo, nye w’asefo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na w’asefo bɛyɛ dɛ asaase do huntuma, na ebɛtserɛw akɔ anee, boka, nye kwaamu, nye pomu: na ɔwo nye w’asefo mu na wobehyira asaase do ebusua ebusua nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na, hwɛ, menye wo nam, na mobɔhwɛ wo do wɔ beebiara a ebɔkɔ, na medze wo maba asaase yi do bio; na minnkegya wo hɔ, ekodu dɛ mebɛma dza maka makyerɛ wo yi ayɛ hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob fii ne nda mu nyanee, na ɔsee dɛ, Ampaara, EWURADZE wɔ ha; naaso nna minnyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na n’akoma tui, na ɔsee dɛ, ha yi yɛ hu ampa ae! Ha nnyɛ beebiara dɛ Nyankopɔn ne fie a, na ha nye hɛben abotsen no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔfaa ɔbo no a osunii no, na ɔdze yɛɛ idum sii hɔ, na ohuee ngo guu do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Bɛtɛl: na asɔpɔn no nkyɛ kurow no ne dzin dze Luz.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob bɔɔ anohoba see dɛ, Sɛ Nyankopɔn dzi m’ekyir, na ɔhwɛ mo do wɔ ɔkwan yi a murutu yi mu, na ɔma me edziban ma midzi, nye atar ma mehyɛ,
title: GENESIS

text: ma meba m’egya fie bio wɔ asomdwee mu a, ɔno EWURADZE bɛyɛ me Nyankopɔn,
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔbo yi a medze mayɛ idum esi hɔ yi, bɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ne fi: na dza ebɛma me nyinara mebɛma wo mu ebupɛn du du.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob sii no kwan do, na ɔbaa bokamba hɔn asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔhwɛe no, nna ohun dɛ, bura bi wɔ haban no mu, na, hwɛ, nguankuw ebiasa gugu ho wɔ hɔ; osiandɛ bura no no mu nsu na wɔsaw ma nguankuw no ma wɔnom: na ɔbo a ɔda bura no n’ano no so.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hɔ na nguankuw no nyinara wohyia: na sɛ wohyia a wopirew ɔbo no fi bura no n’ano, na wɔma nguan no nsu ma wɔnom, na wopirew ɔbo no hin bura no n’ano bio.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob bisaa hɔn dɛ, Mo nuanom, hom fi hen? Na wobuaa dɛ, Yefi Haran.
title: GENESIS

text: Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nyim Nahor ne ba Laban a? Na wɔsee dɛ, Yenyim no,
title: GENESIS

text: Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, No ho ye? Na wɔsee dɛ, No ho ye: na, hwɛ, ne babaa Rahel na ɔnye nguan reba yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hwɛ, adze nnyae nnsae, nkyii so aber a wɔka mbowa nnyae nndurii: hom mma nguan no nsu ma wɔnnom, na hom nkɔ nkɛma hɔn edziban.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Yennkotum, gyedɛ wɔaboaboa nguankuw no nyinara ano, na woepirew ɔbo efi bura no n’ano; ansaana yɛama nguan no nsu ma wɔaanom.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob nye hɔn da ho rekasa no, nna Rahel nye n’egya no nguan no bae: nna ɔno na ɔhwɛ hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jakob hun ne na no nua Laban ne babaa Rahel, na ne na no nua Laban no nguan no, ɔtwee pinii, na okepireew ɔbo no fii bura no n’ano, na ɔmaa ne na no nua Laban no nguan no nsu ma wɔnomee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob feew Rahel n’ano, na ɔmaa ne ndze do, na osui.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob kaa kyerɛɛ Rahel dɛ, n’egya n’awɔfase nye no, na ɔyɛ Rebeka ne ba: na Rahel tuu enguan na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ n’egya.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Laban tsee n’akyerɛbaa ne ba Jakob ne nka no, otutuu enguan kehyiaa no kwan, na ɔyɛɛ no etuu, na ɔfeew n’ano, na ɔdze no baa ne fie. Na ɔbɔɔ n’amandzɛɛ yi nyinara kyerɛɛ Laban.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban see dɛ, Ampaara, eyɛ me biew nye mo honam. Na ɔtsenaa ne nkyɛn bosoom.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban see Jakob dɛ, Ana osiandɛ mo nua nye wo ntsi, ebɔsom me kwa? Ka kyerɛ me, ebɛnadze na ɔnyɛ w’akatua?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban wɔ mbabaa beenu: panyin dze no ne dzin dze Leah, na ekumaba no ne dzin dze Rahel.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Leah n’enyiwa yɛ meamea; na Rahel dze no ho yɛ fɛw na n’enyim wɔ nyam.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob dɔɔ Rahel; na ɔsee dɛ, Wo ba kuma Rahel ntsi mobɔsom wo mfe esuon.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban see dɛ, Oye dɛ medze no mebɛma wo sen dɛ medze no mebɛma ɔbarimba bi: enye me ntsena.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Rahel ntsi Jakob soom mfe esuon; na ɔdɔ a ɔdɔ no ntsi, ɔyɛɛ n’enyi do dɛ nda kumaabi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob see Laban dɛ, Fa me yer ma me, na me nda aso, ma monkɔ ne nkyɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban hyiahyiaa ekuromfo nyinara, na ɔtoo pon.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ anafua no ɔfaa ne babaa Leah, na ɔdze no brɛɛ no; na ɔnye no dae
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban dze n’abaawa Zilpa maa ne babaa Leah abaawa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyee no, nna Jakob nkɔhwɛ a saana Leah a: na obisaa Laban dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ayɛ me yi? Nnyɛ Rahel ntsi na mosoom wo bi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na adaadaa me yi?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban see dɛ, Hɛn ha wɔnnyɛ no dɛm; wɔmmfa ekumaba no mma awar ana wɔdze abakan no ama.
title: GENESIS

text: Ma oyi ne dapɛn nso, na yɛdze ɔno so bɛma wo wɔ ɔsom a ebɔsom me mfe esuon fofor bio ntsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob yɛɛ dɛm, na ɔmaa ne dapɛn kor soe: na ɔdze ne babaa Rahel so maa no awar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban dze n’abaawa Bilha maa ne babaa Rahel dɛ abaawa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob kɔr Rahel so nkyɛn nye no dae, na ɔdɔɔ Rahel seen Leah, na ɔsoom Laban mfe esuon fofor bio.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE hun dɛ wɔtan Leah no, obuee n’awoo kwan: na Rahel dze nna ɔbɔnyin a.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Leah nyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Reuben a asekyerɛ nye; Monhwɛ ɔbabanyin: na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE ahwɛ m’amandzehu; na afei dze mo kun bɔdɔ me.
title: GENESIS

text: Na onyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin; na ɔsee dɛ, Osiandɛ EWURADZE atse dɛ wɔtan me ntsi, na ɔdze ɔba yi so ama me: na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Simeon a asekyerɛ nye; Otsie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na onyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin; na ɔsee dɛ, Afei na mo kun nye me bɛka, osiandɛ mawo mbabanyin baasa ama no: dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Levi asekyerɛ nye; Ahofam.
title: GENESIS

text: Na onyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin: na ɔsee dɛ, Afei mibeyi EWURADZE ayɛw: dɛm ntsi ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Juda; a asekyerɛ nye; Ayɛyi na ogyaa awoo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Rahel hun dɛ ɔnnwo ba mma Jakob no, Rahel n’enyi beer no nua no; na ɔsee Jakob dɛ, Ma me mba, ɔno mubowu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob no bo fuuw Rahel: na ɔsee dɛ, Ana midzi Nyankopɔn a ɔakam wo yamu mba no ananmu?
title: GENESIS

text: Rahel see dɛ, Hwɛ, m’abaawa Bilha nye yi, nye no nda; ama ɔaawo egu me serɛ do, na mo so menam no do meenya mba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔdze n’abaawa Bilha maa no awar: na Jakob kɔr ne nkyɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Bilha nyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin maa Jakob.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Rahel see dɛ, Nyankopɔn edzi m’asɛm ama me, na eso oetsie me ndze, na ɔama me babanyin: dɛm ntsi ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Dan a asekyerɛ nye: ɔsɛndzifo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Rahel n’abaawa Bilha nyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin a otsia ebien maa Jakob.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Rahel see dɛ, Menye m’akyerɛbaa edzi aper a no mu yɛ dzen, na medzi nyim: na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Naftali a asekyerɛ nye, M’akodzi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a Leah hun dɛ n’awoo mu atwe oegyaa awoo no, ɔfaa n’abaawa Zilpa, na ɔdze no maa Jakob awar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Leah n’abaawa Zilpa woo babanyin maa Jakob.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Leah see dɛ, Siar aba, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Gad a asekyerɛ nye, Yiedzi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Leah n’abaawa Zilpa woo babanyin a otsia ebien maa Jakob.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Leah see dɛ, Ahomkanyi nye me, na mbabaa bɛfrɛ me ɔhomkanyi: na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Aser a asekyerɛ nye Nhyira.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ewifua twaber mu no, Reuben kɔr hamu kohun mandreke, na ɔdze brɛɛ ne na Leah. Nna Rahel see Leah dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma me wo ba ne mandreke yi bi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ana ɔyɛ asɛm ba dɛ egye mo kun, na me ba ne mandreke yi so erebɛgye? Na Rahel see dɛ, Nna ma ɔnye wo nda anafua yi osian wo ba ne mandreke no ntsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob fi hamu ewimbir reba no, Leah puei kehyiaa no kwan, na ɔsee dɛ, Bra me nkyɛn, na ampaara medze me ba ne mandreke abɔ wo paa. Na ɔnye no daa anafua no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn tsiee Leah, na onyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin a otsia enum maa Jakob.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Leah see dɛ, Nyankopɔn dze m’apaabɔdze ama me, osiandɛ medze m’abaawa memaa mo kun awar: na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Isakar; ase nye, Akatua nye yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Leah nyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin a otsia esia maa Jakob.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Leah see dɛ, Nyankopɔn ama me akyɛdze a oye; afei na mo kun nye me bɛtsena, osiandɛ mawo mbabanyin beesia ama no; na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Zebulun; ase nye, Atseyie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na n’ekyir no ɔwoo babaa, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Dina.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn kaa Rahel, na otsiee no, na obuee n’awoo kwan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na onyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin: na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn eyi m’ahorohoraa:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Josef, see dɛ, EWURADZE mma me ɔba kor so nka ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Rahel woo Josef no, nna Jakob see Laban dɛ, Gya me kwan ma monkɔ mbrɛ mifi na me man mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Fa me yernom nye me mba a hɔn ntsi masom wo no ma me, na ma monkɔ: na ɔwoara nyim mo som a medze masom wo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban see no dɛ, Sɛ afei menya w’enyim enyimnyam a, tsintsim: na mehu dɛ ɔwo ntsi na EWURADZE ehyira me.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Kyerɛ me w’akatua, na medze bɛma.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, ɔwoara nyim beebi mbrɛ mesi na masom wo, na mbrɛ wo mbowakuw esi na wɔayɛ wɔ me nsamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mebae no, nna kumaabi na ewɔ, nna ɔadɔr ɔayɛ pii yi; na EWURADZE ehyira wo wɔ beebiara a mefae: na afei aber bɛn na mobɔhwɛ mara me fie so?
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na memfa memma wo? Na Jakob see dɛ, Mma mma me hwee: sɛ ebɛyɛ iyi ama me a, ɔno mebɛnyɛn wo nguan bio, na mahwɛ hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Ndɛ mebɛfa wo nguan nyinara mu, na meyiyi nguan a hɔn ho yɛ woranworan nye ntokowa ntokowa nyinara, na nguan etuntum a wɔwɔ nguantsen no mu nyinara, nye mpɔnkye no dza hɔn ho yɛ ntokowa ntokowa nye woranworan no efi mu: na hɔn a wɔtse dɛm no na ɔnyɛ m’apaabɔdze.
title: GENESIS

text: Ama daakye eba m’apaabɔdze a ɔda w’enyim yi do a, me ndzeyɛtsenenee eebua ama me; mpɔnkye no mu dza hɔn ho nnyɛ woranworan nye ntokowa ntokowa no, na nguantsen no hɔn mu dza wɔnnyɛ etuntum no nyinara, ɔno na sɛ wohu wɔ mo hɔ a, wombu no adzewiadze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban see dɛ, Hwɛ, ka mo nko a nkyɛ dza aka no ara ɔbɛyɛ dɛmara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na da no ara Jakob yiyii mpɔnkyenyin a hɔn ho yɛ nsensanee nsensanee nye ntokowa ntokowa no; nye mpɔnkyeber a hɔn ho yɛ woranworan nye ntokowa ntokowa no nyinara, dza fufuw wɔ hɔn ho no nyinara, nye nguantsen no hɔn mu etuntum no nyinara, na ɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ ne mbabanyin nsa;
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔmaa ndaansa kwan daa ɔnoara nye Jakob ntamu: na Jakob nyɛɛn Laban no nguan nkaa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob faa sɛsɛ dua nye almɔnd dua nye odwon dua mbaa momon; na oyiyii ho nsema efufuw, na ɔmaa mbaa no ho efufuw no puepuei.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔdze mbaa no a oyiyii ho no guu nguan no hɔn tsentsen do wɔ nsuka a ɔwɔ mu mbrɛ nguan no ba hɔ bɔnom nsu no mu; na wɔba bɔnom nsu a nna wɔfow hɔnho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nguan no nyinsenyinsenii wɔ mbaa no enyim, na nguan no wowoo nsensanee nsensanee, woranworan, nye ntokowa ntokowa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob paa nguambaa no na ɔmaa nguan no hɔn enyim kɔr Laban nguan no mu nsensanee nsensanee nye etuntum no nyinara hɔn do; na ɔyɛɛ narankasa no nguankuw wɔ nkyɛn, na ɔammfa ammfora Laban no nguan no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber biara sɛ nguan a hɔn ho yɛ dzen no wonyinsenyinsen a, nna Jakob dze mbaa no ekogu nguan no hɔn enyim wɔ nsuka no mu, ama woeenyinsenyinsen mbaa no do;
title: GENESIS

text: na sɛ nguan no yɛ mberɛw dze a, ɔno ɔmmfa nngu mu: dɛm ntsi hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw no nye Laban dze, na hɔn a hɔn ho yɛ dzen no nye Jakob dze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob yɛɛ kɛsenara, na onyaa nguan pii, nye mfonabaa nye nkowaa, nye efumpɔnkɔ nye nsoasopɔnkɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔtsee Laban ne mbabanyin nsɛm a wɔkae, dɛ, Jakob afa dza ɔyɛ hɛn egya dze nyinara; na dza ɔyɛ hɛn egya dze na ɔdze enya egyapadze yi nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob hwɛɛ Laban no ntɔn mu, na hwɛ, ɔnntse dɛ mbrɛ nkyɛ nkan no ɔtse wɔ no do no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE see Jakob dɛ, San kɔ w’egyanom asaase do, na w’ebusua mu; na mibedzi w’ekyir.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob somae na wɔkɛfrɛɛ Rahel nye Leah ma wɔbaa hamu wɔ no nguan no nkyɛn,
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Muhu hom egya no ntɔn dɛ ɔnntse me dɛ nkan no; na m’egya ne Nyankopɔn na oedzi m’ekyir.
title: GENESIS

text: Na homara nyim dɛ m’ahoɔdzen nyinara na medze asom hom egya.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hom egya adaadaa me, na ɔasakyer m’akatua mpɛn du; na Nyankopɔn na ɔamma no kwan ma ɔannyɛ me bɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Sɛ ɔse dɛ, Hɔn a hɔn ho yɛ woranworan no na ɔnyɛ w’akatua a, ɔno nguan no nyinara wowo woranworan: na sɛ ɔse dɛ, Hɔn a hɔn ho yɛ nsensanee nsensanee na ɔnyɛ w’akatua a, ɔno nguan no nyinara wowo nsensanee nsensanee.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm na Nyankopɔn agye hom egya no mbowa, na ɔdze hɔn ama me.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a nguan no nyinsenyinsenii no, nna memaa m’enyiwa do, na muhun no wɔ adaaso mu, na, hwɛ, mpɔnkyenyin a wɔfow nguan no nyinara hɔn ho yɛ nsensanee nsensanee, woranworan, nye ntokowa ntokowa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn no bɔfoe see me wɔ adaaso mu dɛ, Jakob: na mesee dɛ, Emi nye yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Afei ma w’enyiwa do, na hwɛ, mpɔnkyenyin a wɔfow mpɔnkyeber no nyinara hɔn ho yɛ nsensanee nsensanee, woranworan, nye ntokowa ntokowa: na mehu dza Laban reyɛ wo nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Emi nye Bɛtɛl Nyankopɔn, beebi mbrɛ eseraa idum ho no a, beebi mbrɛ ebɔɔ me anohoba no a; afei soɛr, fi asaase yi do, na san kɔ w’awobea asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Rahel nye Leah buae na wɔsee no dɛ, Ana kyɛpɛn anaa egyapadze biara da ho wɔ hɔ ma hɛn wɔ hɛn egya fie a?
title: GENESIS

text: Ana ommbuu hɛn ahɔho bi a? Osiandɛ ɔatɔn hɛn, na eso oedzi hɛn tsisika ewie.
title: GENESIS

text: Osiandɛ ahonyadze a Nyankopɔn agye no hɛn egya hɔ nyinara hɛn nye hɛn mba dze a: na afei, dza Nyankopɔn aka akyerɛ wo no nyinara, yɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Jakob soɛree, na ɔfaa ne mba nye ne yernom tsenatsenaa efumpɔnkɔ do;
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔfaa no mbowa nyinara, nye n’ahodze a onyae wɔ Paddan-aram no nyinara na, osii mu dɛ ɔrokɔ n’egya Isaak nkyɛn wɔ Keenan asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Laban kɔ rukotwitwa no nguan ho nhwi: na Rahel wiaa n’egya no suman.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob wiaa noho guanee; osiandɛ ɔannka annkyerɛ Laban, Sirianyi no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara guanee; na ɔsoɛree, na otwaa Esutsen no, na ɔmaa n’enyi kɔr Gilead bepɔw do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ne ndaansa no wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Laban dɛ Jakob eguan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔfaa no nkorɔfo kaa noho, na otsiiw no nda esuon kwan; na ɔbɔtoo no Gilead bepɔw do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn baa Laban, Sirianyi no hɔ wɔ anafua adaaso mu, na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ woho yie amma aannkasa papa anaa bɔn annkyerɛ Jakob.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban too Jakob. Nna Jakob abɔ n’asesee wɔ bepɔw no do: na Laban ɔnye no nkorɔfo so bobɔɔ hɔndze wɔ Gilead bepɔw do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban bisaa Jakob dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ayɛ yi, na ewia woho eguan me, na asoa me mbabaa dze hɔn rokɔ dɛ hɔn a wɔdze mfowa afa hɔn ndɔmmum yi?
title: GENESIS

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na isumae guanee, na iwiaa woho fii me nkyɛn; na annka annkyerɛ me, ma maammfa enyigye na ndwom, mpintsin na ɔnye nsanku menngya wo kwan;
title: GENESIS

text: na amma maammfew me mbabanyin nye me mbabaa hɔn ano? Afei dze ayɛ nkwaseadze.
title: GENESIS

text: Mowɔ tum dɛ nkyɛ menye wo dzi no bɔn: na ndeda anafua w’egya ne Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ me dɛ, Hwɛ woho yie, mma aannkasa papa anaa bɔn annkyerɛ Jakob.
title: GENESIS

text: Na afei kaansa afe w’egya fie dodoodow ma ehia dɛ ekɔ mpo a, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ewia mo suman yi?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob buae na ɔsee Laban dɛ, Osiandɛ musuroi: na mesee dɛ, ɔbɛyɛ na eregye wo mbabaa wɔ me nsamu enyimpi do.
title: GENESIS

text: Nyimpa biara a ibohu wo suman wɔ no hɔ no, onyii no ɔnnkɛtsena ase: hɛn nuanom hɔn enyim ha yi ara hwehwɛ dza ɔyɛ wodze wɔ me nkyɛn, na fa w’adze. Nna Jakob nnyim dɛ Rahel na oewia.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban kɔr Jakob n’asesee mu, nye Leah n’asesee mu, nye mbaawa beenu no hɔn asesee mu; na oennhu. Na ofii Leah n’asesee mu, na ɔkɛhɛɛn Rahel n’asesee mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei Rahel afa suman no, na ɔdze ahyehyɛ efupɔnkɔ n’adze a wɔdze hyehyɛ no mu, na ɔatsena do. Na Laban kekaa asese no no ho nyinara, na oennhu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee n’egya dɛ, Mma mma ɔnnyɛ mo wura ebufuw dɛ munntum monnsoɛr wɔ w’enyim; na mayɛ mbaadze. Na ɔhwehwɛe, na oennhu suman no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob no bo fuwii, na ɔnye Laban hamee: na Jakob buae see Laban dɛ, Mo mfom nye mmuana? Mo bɔn nye mmuana, ma etsiw me ɔhyew do dɛm yi?
title: GENESIS

text: Ehwehwɛɛ me ndzɛmba nyinara yi, wo fie ndzɛmba nyinara mu ebɛnadze na ehu no wɔ mu? Fa si mo nuanom nye wo nuanom hɔn enyim ha, ma wombu hɛn beenu ntamu atsɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Matsena wo nkyɛn mfe eduonu nye yi; wo nguamber nye wo mpɔnkyeber ammpon mba da, na wo nguan mu nguannyin so, menndzi bi.
title: GENESIS

text: Hɔn a mbowa kum hɔn no, mammfa ammbrɛ wo; ɔyɛɛ mara me kaw. Dza wowiaa no ewia o, dza wowiaa no anafua o, egyee no mo hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Mbrɛ meyɛe nye yi; adzekyee a nna ewia rehyew me, adzesaa a nna awɔw resar me; na m’enyi so kokwae.
title: GENESIS

text: Mfe eduonu nye yi na matsena wo fie; wo mbabaa beenu ntsi mosoom wo mfe duanan, na wo mbowakuw so ntsi mfe esia: na asakyer m’akatua mpɛn du.
title: GENESIS

text: Sɛ m’egya ne Nyankopɔn, Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, nye Isaak no Suro, enndzi m’ekyir a, nkyɛ ndɛ egya me kwan nsapan. Nyankopɔn ehu m’amandzehu nye me nsaano edwumayɛ, na anadwe yi ɔaka w’enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban buae na ɔsee Jakob dɛ, Mbabaa yi me mbabaa a, na mba yi me mba a, na nguan yi mo nguan a, na dza ihu yi nyinara medze a: na ebɛnadze na mubotum mayɛ me mbabaa yi, anaa hɔn mba a wɔawo hɔn yi ndɛ?
title: GENESIS

text: Na afei bra, ma yendzi ahyɛmu, emi nye ɔwo; na ma ɔnyɛ dase wɔ emi nye ɔwo ntamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob faa ɔbo, na ɔdze yɛɛ idum sii hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob see no nkorɔfo dɛ, Hom mboaboa abo ano; na wɔtasee abo, na wɔhɔɔr no isiw: na wodzidzii siw no ho hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban frɛɛ no Jegar-sahaduta: na Jakob dze ɔfrɛɛ no Galeed.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban see dɛ, Isiw yi nyɛ emi nye ɔwo ntamu dase ndɛ. Dɛm ntsi ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Galeed:
title: GENESIS

text: na Mizpa osiandɛ ɔsee dɛ, sɛ Yɛpaapaa mu a, EWURADZE nhwɛ emi nye ɔwo ntamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Sɛ ebɛtseetsee me mbabaa, na sɛ ebɔwar yernom aka me mbabaa ho a, obi nnka hɛn ho; hwɛ, Nyankopɔn nye emi nye ɔwo ntamu dasefo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban see Jakob dɛ, Hwɛ abo siw yi, na hwɛ idum a mama do mesi emi nye ɔwo ntamu yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Isiw yi yɛ dase, na idum yi yɛ dase, dɛ mennkɛtra siw yi maba wo nkyɛn, na wo so ennkɛtra siw yi nye idum yi aba me nkyɛn, abɛyɛ bɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, nye Nahor Nyankopɔn, hɔn egya ne Nyankopɔn, ombu hɛn ntamu atsɛn. Na Jakob dze n’egya Isaak no Suro no dzii nsew.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob bɔɔ afɔr wɔ bepɔw no do, na ɔfrɛɛ no nuanom dɛ wombedzidzi: na wodzidzii, na wotsintsimii wɔ bepɔw no do anafua no nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Laban soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔfeew ne mbabanyin nye ne mbabaa no hɔn ano, na ohyiraa hɔn: na Laban sanee kɔr no kurow mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob sii no kwan do, na Nyankopɔn n’abɔfoe behyiaa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob hun hɔn no ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn no dɔm nye yi: na ɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Mahanaim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob tuu abɔfo ma wodzii n’enyim kan kɔr no nua Esau hɔ wɔ Seir asaase do, Edom haban mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɛse mo wura Esau dɛm; dɛ, Mbrɛ w’akowaa Jakob se nye yi, Menye Laban akɛtsena, na makyɛr hɔ ara ma ebodu ndɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Menya anantwi, nsoasopɔnkɔ, nguan, mpɔnkye na nkowaa nye mfonabaa: na masoma dɛ wɔmbɛka nkyerɛ mo wura, ama meenya w’enyim adom.
title: GENESIS

text: Na abɔfo no sanee baa Jakob hɔ, dɛ, Yɛkɔr wo nua Esau hɔ na mbom ɔnoara so reba ebehyia wo kwan, na mbarimba ahaanan ka no ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Jakob n’akoma tuu kɛsenara, na no ho hiahiaa no. Na obuee nkorɔfo a wɔnye no nam no, nye mpɔnkye, nguan, anantwi nye efumpɔnkɔ no hɔn mu ekuw ebien;
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ Esau ba kuw kor do, na oboku hɔn a, ɔno ikuw a ɔaka no eefi nsa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob see dɛ, Ao, m’egya Abraham ne Nyankopɔn, na m’egya Isaak ne Nyankopɔn, ao, EWURADZE a esee me dɛ, San kɔ wo man mu, nye w’ebusua mu, na mebɛyɛ wo yie:
title: GENESIS

text: ehumbɔbɔr nye nokwar a eyi akyerɛ w’akowaa no mennsɛ no mu biara; osiandɛ mo poma ara na medze twaa Jordan yi; na afei mayɛ ekuw ebien.
title: GENESIS

text: Meserɛ wo, gye me fi mo nua Esau nsamu: na musuro no, bɛyɛ na ɔaba eboku emi, nye enanom nye hɔn mba yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na esee me dɛ, Ampaara mebɛyɛ wo yie, na mama w’asefo ayɛ dɛ mpoano anhwea a no dodow ntsi wɔkan a ɔnnyɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsoɛɛ hɔ anafua no; na oyii dza ɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no mu bi dɛ ɔdze rekɛkyɛ no nua Esau;
title: GENESIS

text: mpɔnkyeber ahaenu nye mpɔnkyenyin eduonu, nguamber ahaenu nye nguannyin eduonu,
title: GENESIS

text: efumpɔnkɔ a wɔma enumfo eduasa nye hɔn mba, anantwiber eduanan nye anantwinyin du, nsoasopɔnkɔber eduonu nye nsoasopɔnkɔmba du.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔdze no ekuwekuw hyɛɛ no nkowaa no nsa; na ɔsee no nkowaa no dɛ, Hom ntwa mu ndzi m’enyim, na hom mma ikuw nye ikuw ntamu mbra kwan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ dza odzi kan no dɛ, Sɛ mo nua Esau nye wo hyia, na obisa wo dɛ, Woana n’abofra nye wo, erokɔ henfa, na dza wodzi w’enyim yi woana dze a?
title: GENESIS

text: Ɔno se dɛ, W’akowaa Jakob dze a; ɔyɛ akyɛdze a wɔdze rekɛma mo wura Esau: na, hwɛ, ɔnoara so dzi hɛn ekyir.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ dza otsia ebien no so, nye dza otsia ebiasa no, nye hɔn a wɔka mbowakuw no do no nyinara dɛ, Sɛ hom hu Esau a, wɔnka dɛm asɛm yi ara nkyerɛ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hom nse dɛ, Nkyii so, hwɛ w’akowaa Jakob so dzi hɛn ekyir. Afei ɔkaa ɔsee dɛ, Medze akyɛdze a odzi m’enyim yi bɔkɔ akɔdwedwe no, na n’ekyir no meehu n’enyim; bi a no bo bɔdwe.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna akyɛdze no twaa mu dzii n’enyim: na ɔnoara dze, ɔtsenaa dɔm no mu anafua no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsoɛɛr anafua no, na ɔfaa ne yernom beenu no, nye ne mbaawa beenu no, nye ne mba dubiako no, na okotwaa Jabbok esutwaree.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔmaa wotwaa esutsen no, na ɔmaa dza ɔwɔ nyinara twae.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkaa Jakob no nko; na banyin bi nye no dzii aper wɔ hɔ ara ma okodur adzekyee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nyimpa no hun dɛ onndzi Jakob do konyim no, nna ɔkaa n’aserɛ tokur mu; na Jakob no ndwonku huanee wɔ aperper a ɔnye no dzii no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na banyin no see dɛ, Ma monkɔ, na adze rekye. Na ɔsee dɛ, Mennkɛma akɔ, gyedɛ ehyira me ana.
title: GENESIS

text: Na banyin no bisaa no dɛ, Wo dzin dze dɛn? Na obuaa dɛ, Jakob.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔnnkɛfrɛ wo dzin Jakob bio, na mbom, Israel: osiandɛ ɔwo enye Nyankopɔn na ɔnye nyimpa ako, na edzi konyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob bisaa no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, bɔ wo dzin kyerɛ me. Na ɔsee dɛ, Na iribisa me dzin ayɛ dɛn? Na banyin no hyiraa no wɔ hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob frɛɛ bea no ne dzin Peniel; osiandɛ, ɔsee dɛ, Mehu Nyankopɔn mpu na mpu, naaso me kra enya nkwa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na orutwa mu wɔ Peniel no nna ewia epue, na no ndwonku a ehuan no ntsi nna ohuan n’aserɛ mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi ara Israelmba nndzi ntsin a ɔwɔ ndwonku mu no: osiandɛ ɔkaa Jakob no ndwonku wɔ mbrɛ ntsin no wɔ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob maa n’enyiwa do, na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, nna Esau reba, na mbarimba ahaanan ka no ho. Na ɔkyɛɛ mbofra no mu maa Leah, nye Rahel, nye mbaawa beenu no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔdze mbaawa no nye hɔn mba no dzii kan, na ɔdze Leah nye ne mba no dzii hɔ, na ɔdze Rahel nye Josef dzii ekyir.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔnoara paa ho kedzii hɔn enyim, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze mpɛn esuon, dze kodur dɛ ɔbɛɛn no nua no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau tutuu enguan hyiaa no kwan, na ɔyɛɛ no etuu; na ɔdze ne nsa too no kɔn mu, na ɔfeew n’ano: na wosui.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau maa n’enyiwa do, na ohun mbaa no nye mbofra no; na obisaa dɛ, Woananom na wɔka wo ho yi? Na Jakob buaa dɛ, Mbofra a Nyankopɔn dze adom w’akowaa a.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna mbaawa no nye hɔn mba twee pinii, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Leah nye ne mba so twee pinii, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze: na n’ekyir no nna Josef nye Rahel twee pinii, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau bisaa dɛ, Na ekuw a menye hɔn hyiae yi nyinara n’ase nye dɛn? Na ɔsee dɛ, Medze robɔhwehwɛ mo wura n’enyim enyimnyam.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau see dɛ, Dza mowɔ no ara dɔɔ so; mo nua, ma w’adze nko hɔ mma wo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob see dɛ, Dabida, meserɛ wo, sɛ afei menya w’enyim enyimnyam a, nna gye me nsamu akyɛdze: susuampa dɛ mehu w’enyim ara dɛ mbrɛ obiara bohu Nyankopɔn enyim, na masɔ w’enyi yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Meserɛ wo, gye m’akyɛdze a wɔdze abrɛ wo yi; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn adom me, na eso dza mowɔ no dɔɔ so. Na ɔhyɛɛ no ma ɔgyee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau see dɛ, Ma yensi mu, na yɛnkɔ, na mibedzi w’enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mo wura nyim dɛ mbofra yi yɛ mberɛw, na eso nguan nye anantwi a wɔnye me nam yi wɔma enumfo: na sɛ wɔka hɔn dodow da kor a, nguan no nyinara bowuwu.
title: GENESIS

text: Meserɛ wo, wɔmma mo wura mpa ho nkedzi n’akowaa enyim: na emi mobɔdwe m’enyi ara manantsew dɛ mbrɛ mbowa a wodzi m’enyim yi botum, na dɛ mbrɛ mbofra no botum, ekodu dɛ mubodu mo wura nkyɛn wɔ Seir.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau see dɛ, Nna ma memfa nyimpa a wɔka mo ho yi bi mingya wo. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ma ɔnyɛ dɛn? Wɔmma minnya mo wura n’enyim enyimnyam.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Esau saan da no ara faa no kwan do kɔr Seir.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob sii mu kɔr Sukɔt, na okesii dan maa noho, na osisii mpata maa no mbowa: dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Sukɔt.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob baa Sekem kurow a ɔwɔ Keenan asaase do no mu asomdwee mu, wɔ ber a ofii Paddan-aram bae no; na ɔbɔbɔɔ asese wɔ kurow no n’enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔtɔɔ asaase kakraba a ɔbɔɔ n’asesee wɔ do no, wɔ Sekem n’egya Hamor ne mba no hɔ, maa dwetɛ ɔha.
title: GENESIS

text: Na osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔfrɛɛ no El-elohe-Israel a asekyerɛ nye Israel Nyankopɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Dina, Leah na Jakob hɔn babaa no, puei dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ asaase no do mbabaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Hamor, Hivinyi no, asaase no do hen no ne ba Sekem hun no; na ɔkyeer no nye no dae, na ɔbrɛɛ no adze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na no werɛ kitsaa Dina Jakob ne babaa no, na ɔdɔɔ akataasia no na ɔkasaa ayamuyie mu kyerɛɛ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sekem kaa kyerɛɛ n’egya Hamor dɛ, Kɛgye akataasia yi yer ma me.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei Jakob tsee dɛ oegu ne babaa Dina ho fi. Nna ne mbabanyin no wɔ no mbowa nkyɛn wɔ hamu ntsi ɔyɛɛ komm ma wɔbae ana.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sekem n’egya puei kɔr Jakob nkyɛn dɛ ɔrekɛnye no atwetwe nkɔmbɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob ne mbabanyin no tsee no, wofii hamu baa fie: na ɔyɛɛ hɔn no yaw, na hɔn bo fuuw kɛsenara, osiandɛ Sekem ayɛ nkwaseadze wɔ Israel dɛ ɔnye Jakob ne babaa ada; adze a wɔnnyɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Hamor nye hɔn twetwee nkɔmbɔ see dɛ, Me ba Sekem no werɛ ekitsa hom babaa: meserɛ hom, wɔmfa no mma no awar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hom nye hɛn ndzi awarwar; hom mfa hom mbabaa mma hɛn, na hom so mfa hɛn mbabaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hom nye hɛn ntsena: na asaase a ɔda hom enyim yi hom ntsena do, na hom ndzi gua wɔ do, na hom nnya adze wɔ do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sekem see n’egya nye no nuanom no dɛ, Wɔmma minnya hom enyim enyimnyam, na dza hom bɛse me no mebɛma.
title: GENESIS

text: Hom mbisa me tsiadze nye akyɛdze kɛse biara, na dza hom bɛse me no ara mebɛma: na hom mfa akataasia no mma me awar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob ne mbabanyin no buaa Sekem nye n’egya Hamor ndaadaa mu, na ɔnam dɛ oegu hɔn akyerɛbaa Dina ho fi ntsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsee hɔn dɛ, Yɛyɛ dɛm adze yi a ɔnnkɛyɛ, dɛ yɛdze hɛn akyerɛbaa bɛma obi a wonntwaa no twatsia; na dɛm no yɛ enyimguase ma hɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Dza ogyina do a yɛbɛgye hom pen ara nye yi: dɛ sɛ hom bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ yɛtse, na woetwa hom mu mbanyin nyinara twatsia a;
title: GENESIS

text: yɛdze hɛn mbabaa bɛma hom, na hɛn so yɛafa hom mbabaa, na yɛnye hom atsena, na yɛayɛ ɔman kor.
title: GENESIS

text: Na sɛ hom nnketsie hɛn, na hom etwitwa twatsia a; ɔno yɛbɛfa hɛn babaa, na yɛakɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hɔn nsɛm no yɛɛ Hamor nye Hamor ne ba Sekem hɔn pɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aberantsɛ no ennkyinkyim dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛm adze no, osiandɛ ɔpɛ Jakob ne babaa no. Nna wodzi Sekem nyi sen n’egya ne fifo nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Hamor nye ne ba Sekem baa hɔn kurow n’abotsenano, na wɔnye hɔn kurow mu mbanyin no twetwee nkɔmbɔ, dɛ,
title: GENESIS

text: Mbarimba yi wɔnye hɛn tse no asomdwee mu; dɛm ntsi hom mma wɔntsena asaase yi do, na wondzi mu gua; na, hwɛ asaase yi dɔɔ so ara yie ma hɔn; hom mma yɛmfa hɔn mbabaa nwar hɔn, na wɔmma hɛn so yɛmfa hɛn mbabaa mma hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na adze ara a ogyina do a mbanyin no bɛgye hɛn pen na wɔnye hɛn atsena, ma yaayɛ ɔman kor nye dɛ, hɛn mu mbanyin nyinara botwitwa twatsia, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn woetwitwa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Ana nkyɛ hɔn anyɛmbowa nye hɔn ahodze nye hɔn mbowa nyinara nnkɛyɛ hɛndze bi a? Hom mma yɛngye hɔn pen ara, na wɔnye hɛn bɛtsena.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hɔn a wɔnam Hamor no kurow n’abotsenano pue nyinara, wotsiee ɔno na ne ba Sekem; na mbanyin a wɔnam no kurow n’abotsenano pue nyinara wotwitwaa hɔn twatsia.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ne ndaansa no a ne yaw kitsaa hɔn no, nna Jakob ne mbabanyin beenu, Simeon nye Levi, Dina no nuanom no, wɔfefaa hɔn mfowa, na wokefiir kurow no awora, na wokunkum mbanyin no nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔdze afona anomu kum Hamor nye ne ba Sekem, na wɔfaa Dina fii Sekem ne fie, na wɔdze no kɔree.
title: GENESIS

text: Jakob ne mbabanyin no baa atɔfo no do na wɔbɔfoom kurow no mu ndzɛmba, osiandɛ woegu hɔn akyerɛbaa no ho fi.
title: GENESIS

text: Wɔfaa hɔn nguan nye hɔn anantwi, nye hɔn nsoasopɔnkɔ nye dza ɔwɔ kurow no mu, na dza ɔwɔ haban mu;
title: GENESIS

text: na hɔn ahodze nyinara. Wɔfaa hɔn mbofraba nyinara nye hɔn yernom ndɔmmum, na wɔfoom hɔn, mekyerɛ dza ɔwɔ fie nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob see Simeon nye Levi dɛ, Hom afona me, dɛ hom ama mo ho abɔn wɔ hɔn a wɔtse asaase yi do hɔn mu, wɔ Keenanfo nye Perizfo hɔn mu: na mo ho suar ntsi, wɔbɔboaboa hɔn ano aba mo do, na woeboku me; na wɔbɛsɛɛ me, emi nye me fi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Na nkyɛ ɔnyɛ hɛn akyerɛbaa dɛ edwaman a?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see Jakob dɛ, Soɛr, kɔ Bɛtɛl, na kɛtsena hɔ: na yɛ afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ ma Nyankopɔn a oyii noho kyerɛɛ wo wɔ aber a ifii wo nua Esau n’enyim guanee no.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Jakob see ne fifo nye hɔn a wɔnye no wɔ hɔ nyinara dɛ, Hom ntow enyame ananaben a ɔwɔ hom mu no ngu, na hom ntsew homho, na hom nsesa hom ntar:
title: GENESIS

text: na hom mma yɛnsoɛr, na yɛnkɔ Bɛtɛl; na mebɛyɛ afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ ama Nyankopɔn a m’ahohia da no ɔgyee me do, na odzii m’ekyir wɔ kwan a mutui no mu no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔdze hɔn enyame ananaben a ɔwɔ hɔn nsamu nyinara, nye nkaba a ɔhyehyɛ hɔn asomu no maa Jakob; na Jakob dze hyɛɛ esudur no a ɔwɔ Sekem ho no ase.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔkɔree: na ihu kɛsenara tɔɔ nkurow a wɔabɔ hɔn ho aprɔw no do, ma woenntsiw Jakob ne mbabanyin no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob baa Luz a ɔwɔ Keenan asaase do no, (ɔnoara nye Bɛtɛl), ɔno nye nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔfrɛɛ bea no El-Bɛtɛl: osiandɛ hɔ na Nyankopɔn yii noho kyerɛɛ no wɔ aber a ofii no nua enyim guanee no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Debora, Rebeka no hwɛfo no wui, na wosiee no Bɛtɛl anaafo, wɔ esudur no ase: na wɔtoo ne dzin Allon-bakut a asekyerɛ nye Nyinsuwakyi bea.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a Jakob fi Paddan-aram bae no, Nyankopɔn yii noho kyerɛɛ no bio, na ohyiraa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see no dɛ, Wo dzin dze Jakob: wɔnnkɛfrɛ wo dzin Jakob bio, na Israel bɛyɛ wo dzin: na ɔtoo ne dzin Israel.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see no dɛ, Emi nye Nyankopɔn Otumfo: wo mba na dɔr; ɔman nye amanaman asafo befi wo mu aba, na ahemfo befi w’asen mu epue.
title: GENESIS

text: Asaase a medze memaa Abraham nye Isaak no, ɔwo na medze mebɛma wo, na w’asefo a wodzi w’ekyir no na medze asaase no bɛma hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn fii ne nkyɛn wɔ mbrɛ ɔnye no kasae no kɔr sor.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob sii idum wɔ mbrɛ ɔnye no kasae no; ɔbo dum a: na ohuee ɔnom afɔr guu do, na ohuee ngo guu do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob frɛɛ bea no a Nyankopɔn nye no kasae wɔ hɔ no ne dzin Bɛtɛl.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wofii Bɛtɛl sii mu; na aka ɔkwan kakra bi ma woedu Efrat no: awoo kaa Rahel, na n’awoo no mu yɛɛ dzen.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a n’awoo no mu yɛɛ dzen no, nna awogyefo no see no dɛ, Mma nnsuro; ibenya babanyin kor so afei.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, ne kra rifi no mu no (osiandɛ owui), ɔtoo no dzin Ben-oni; na n’egya dze ɔfrɛɛ no Benjamin.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Rahel wui, na wosiee no wɔ Efrat kwan mu, a ɔnoara nye Bɛtlɛhɛm.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob sii ne nda do idum: ɔnoara nye Rahel ne nda do idum dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel tui, na ɔkɔbɔɔ n’asesee wɔ Eder abantsentsen ekyir noho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, Israel tse asaase no do no, nna Reuben kɔree na ɔnye n’egya n’abaawayer Bilha kɛdae: na Israel tsee. Afei Jakob ne mbabanyin yɛ duebien:
title: GENESIS

text: Leah ne mba; Jakob n’abakan Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Juda Isakar, nye Zebulun:
title: GENESIS

text: Rahel ne mba; Josef nye Benjamin:
title: GENESIS

text: na Rahel n’abaawa Bilha ne mba; Dan nye Naftali:
title: GENESIS

text: na Leah n’abaawa Zilpa ne mba; Gad nye Aser. Woyinom nye Jakob ne mbabanyin a wɔwoo hɔn maa no wɔ Paddan-aram.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob baa n’egya Isaak nkyɛn wɔ Mamre, wɔ Kiriat-arba (ɔnoara nye Hebron), mbrɛ Abraham nye Isaak bɛtsenae no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak ne nda yɛɛ mfe ɔha eduowɔtwe.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isaak gyaa no sunsum mu, na owui, na otsiiw ne nananom wɔ samanadze, a nna ɔayɛ akɔdaa a oedzi mfe pii: na ne mba Esau nye Jakob siee no.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei iyinom nye Esau (ɔnoara nye Edom) n’ebusuasantsen.
title: GENESIS

text: Esau waar ne yernom wɔ Keenan mbabaa mu; Hetnyi Elon ne babaa Ada, nye Hivinyi Zibeon ne babaa Ana ne babaa Oholibama;
title: GENESIS

text: na Ismael ne babaa Basemat, Nebaiot n’akyerɛbaa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Ada woo Elifaz maa Esau; na Basemat woo Reuel;
title: GENESIS

text: na Oholibama woo Jeus, Jalam, nye Kora: woyinom nye Esau ne mba a wɔwoo hɔn wɔ Keenan asaase do no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau faa ne yernom, ne mbabanyin, ne mbabaa, ne fie nyimpa nyinara, nye fiembowa, nye no mbowa nyinara, nye n’enyadze a onyaa no wɔ Keenan asaase do nyinara; na ɔtwee noho wɔ no nua Jakob ho kɔr asaase bi do.
title: GENESIS

text: Osiandɛ hɔn ahodze so dodow ma hɔn dɛ wɔbɛtsena fakor. Na asaase a wɔtse do no wɔnnsen do wɔ hɔn mbowa no ntsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau a noara so nye Edom no tsenaa Seir bepɔw do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na iyinom nye Esau, Edomfo a wɔtse Seir bepɔw do hɔn egya no, n’ebusuasantsen:
title: GENESIS

text: Esau ne mbabanyin hɔn edzin nye yi; Elifaz, Esau ne yer Ada ne ba no, Reuel, Esau ne yer Basemat ne ba no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Elifaz ne mba nye Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gatam, nye Kenaz.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau ne ba Elifaz no nwewe nye Timna; na ɔwoo Amalek maa Elifaz. Woyinom nye Esau ne yer Ada n’asefo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Reuel ne mba nye woyinom; Nahat, Zera, Samma, nye Miza. Woyinom nye Esau ne yer Basemat ne mba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na woyinom nye Esau ne yer Oholibama, Zibeon ne babaa Ana ne babaa no ne mba; na ɔwoo Jeus, Jalam, nye Kora maa Esau.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom nye Esau ne mba mu ekunyin: Esau n’abakan Elifaz ne mba; ekunyin Teman, Omar, Zefo, Kenaz,
title: GENESIS

text: Kora, Gatam, na Amalek. Woyinom nye ekunyin a wofi Elifaz no mu puei wɔ Edom asaase do; na woyinom nye Ada n’asefo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Esau ne ba Reuel ne mba nye woyinom; ekunyin Nahat, Zera, Samma, nye Miza: woyinom nye ekunyin a wofi Reuel mu puei wɔ Edom asaase do; woyinom nye Esau ne yer Basemat ne mba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na woyinom nye Esau ne yer Oholibama ne mba; ekunyin Jeus, Jalam, na okunyin Kora. Woyinom nye ekunyin a wofi Esau ne yer Oholibama, Ana ne babaa no no mu puei.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom nye Esau a ɔnoara nye Edom no n’asefo, na woyinom nye hɔn ekunyin.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom nye Hornyi Seir ne mba a nna wɔyɛ asaase no do mba no. Lotan, Sobal, Zibeon, Ana,
title: GENESIS

text: Dison, Ezer nye Disan. Woyinom nye ekunyin a wofi Horfo, Seir ne mba no hɔn mu puei, wɔ Edom asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Lotan ne mba nye Hori na Heman. Nna Lotan n’akyerɛbaa nye Timna.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Sobal ne mba nye woyinom; Alvan, Manahat, Ebal, Sefo nye Onam.
title: GENESIS

text: Na woyinom nye Zibeon ne mba; Aia nye Ana: oyi nye Ana a, mber a ɔhwɛ n’egya Zibeon no nsoasopɔnkɔ no okohun nsuhyew mpumpunadze wɔ sar do no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na woyinom nye Ana ne mba; Dison na Oholibama, Ana ne babaa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na woyinom nye Dison ne mba; Hemdan, Esban, Itran nye Keran.
title: GENESIS

text: Ezer ne mba nye woyinom; Bilhan, Zaavan nye Akan.
title: GENESIS

text: Dison ne mba nye woyinom: Uz nye Aran.
title: GENESIS

text: Ekunyin a wofi Horfo mu puei nye woyinom; ekunyin Lotan, Sobal, Zibeon, na Ana,
title: GENESIS

text: Dison, Ezer, na Disan. Ekunyin a wofi Horfo mu puei nye woyinom dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ekunyinyɛ tsetsee wɔ Seir asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ahemfo a wodzi hen wɔ Edom asaase do, ansaana obiara ridzi Israelmba do hen no nye woyinom.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Beor ne ba Bela dzii hen wɔ Edom; na no kurow dzin dze Din-haba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Bela wui, na Zera a ofi Bozra ne ba Jobab bedzii n’adze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jobab wui, na Husam a ofi Temanfo hɔn asaase do bedzii n’adze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Husam wui no Hadad, Bedad a okum Midian wɔ Moab haban mu no, ne ba no bedzii n’adze: na no kurow ne dzin dze Avit.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Hadad wui, na Samla a ofi Masreka bedzii n’adze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Samla wui no Saul a ofi Rehobot a ɔwɔ Esutsen no ho no bedzii n’adze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Saul wui, na Akbor ba Baal-hanan bedzii n’adze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Akbor ne ba Baal-hanan wui no, Hadar bedzii n’adze: na no kurow ne dzin dze Pau; na ne yer ne dzin dze Mehetabel, Me-zahab ne babaa Matred ne babaa a.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ekunyin a wofi Esau mu puei hɔn edzin nye yi; dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, hɔn tsenabew, nye hɔn edzin tsetsee, ekunyin Timna, Alva, Jetet;
title: GENESIS

text: Oholibama, Ela na okunyin Pinon;
title: GENESIS

text: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar;
title: GENESIS

text: Magdiel, Iram. Woyinom nye Edom ekunyin, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn tsenabew tsetsee wɔ asaase a ɔyɛ hɔn enyadze no do. Oyi nye Esau, Edomfo hɔn egya no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob tsenaa asaase a n’egya tsenaa do no do, Keenan asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Iyi nye Jakob n’ebusua ho abakɔsɛm. Josef dzii mfe duesuon no, nna ɔnye no nuanom rohwɛ nguan no; na ɔyɛ abofra a ɔnye n’egya ne yernom Bilha nye Zilpa hɔn mba na wɔwɔ hɔ: na Josef kɛkaa hɔn ho asɛmbɔn kyerɛɛ hɔn egya.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei nna Israel dɔ Josef sen ne mba nyinara, osiandɛ ɔno nye no nkɔdaaber mu ba: na ɔyɛɛ asaasaaba atar fɛfɛɛfɛw bi maa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na no nuanom no hun dɛ hɔn egya dɔ no sen hɔn nyinara no wɔtaan no, na woenntum annkasa abodwee do annkyerɛ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef soo daa, na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no nuanom no na nkyii wɔtaan no kɛse.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Meserɛ hom, hom ntsie daa a maso yi:
title: GENESIS

text: na hwɛ, nna yɛrekyekyer ewifua ekuwekuw wɔ haban mu, na, hwɛ, mo kuw no soɛree, na ogyinaa tsentsen; na, hwɛ, hom ekuw no botwaa me dze no ho hyiae, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze maa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na no nuanom bisaa no dɛ, Nna tserɛ ampaara dɛ ibedzi hɛn do hen nye no? Ana tserɛ ampaara dɛ ibenya hɛn do tum nye no? Na nkyii wɔtaan no kɛse wɔ n’adaaso no nye ne nsɛm no ntsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsoo daa kor so, na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no nuanom, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, maso daa bio; na, hwɛ, ewia nye bosoom nye nworaba dubiako robɔ hɔn mu adze ma me.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ n’egya nye no nuanom; na n’egya twuuw n’enyim, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ebɛn daa na aso yi? Nna tserɛ ampaara dɛ emi nye wo na nye wo nuanom bɛba abɔbɔ hɛn mu adze wɔ famu ama wo nye no?
title: GENESIS

text: Na no nuanom enyi beer no do; na n’egya dze ɔdze asɛm no too ne tsirmu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na no nuanom kɔree kɔhwɛɛ hɔn egya no nguan wɔ Sekem.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel see Josef dɛ, Ana wo nuanom nnyɛn mbowa wɔ Sekem bi a? Bra ma monsoma wo hɔn hɔ. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Emi nye yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel see no dɛ, Afei kɔ, kɔhwɛ dɛ wo nuanom, nye nguan no hɔn ho ye; na san bɛka kyerɛ me. Nna ofi Hebron bɔnsa mu somaa no ma ɔbaa Sekem.
title: GENESIS

text: Na banyin bi hun no dɛ, orikyin haban no mu: na banyin no bisaa no dɛ, Erohwehwɛ ebɛnadze?
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Morohwehwɛ mo nuanom: meserɛ wo ara, kyerɛ me mbrɛ wɔwɔ rohwɛ nguan no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na banyin no see dɛ, Woefi ha kɔ: na metsee dɛ wɔreka dɛ, Wɔmma yɛnkɔ Dotan. Na Josef tsiiw no nuanom, na okohun hɔn wɔ Dotan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na no nuanom no hun no ekyirkyiikyir, na ansaana ɔrebɛn hɔn no, wɔkɔr ne tsir do apam dɛ woboku no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Wɔnhwɛ, ɔdaasofo no na ɔreba no.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei wɔmbra, wɔmma yenku no, na yɛntow no nkyen mona yi bi mu, na yɛnkɛse dɛ, Abowa bɔn bi na ɔatsetsew no mu: na nkyii yɛnhwɛ mbrɛ n’adaaso no bowie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Reuben tsee, na ɔgyee no wɔ hɔn nsamu; na ɔsee dɛ, Mma wɔmma yennku no;
title: GENESIS

text: Mma hom nnka bɔgya: wɔmfa no nto sar do ha mona yi mu, na mma wɔmmfa nsa nnka no: ɔreyɛ ama nkyɛ ɔaagye no wɔ hɔn nsamu dze no asan akɛma n’egya.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, Josef dur no nuanom no nkyɛn no, wɔpɔɔr, asaasaaba atar fɛɛfɛw a ɔhyɛ no no
title: GENESIS

text: na wɔdze no kɔtoo mona mu: nna mona no mu awew a, nsu nnyi mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔtsenaa famu dɛ woridzidzi no wɔmaa hɔn enyiwa do na wohun Ismaelfo akwantufo kuw bi dɛ wofi Gilead reba, wɔnye hɔn efumpɔnkɔ a wɔsoso eduhuam nye ngo nye mɛɛr dze rokɔ Egypt.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda see no nuanom no dɛ, Sɛ yeku hɛn nua na yesiw no bɔgyaa do a, ebɛn mfaso na ɔwɔ mu?
title: GENESIS

text: Hom mbra ma yɛntɔn no mma Ismaelfo yi, na mma wɔmma yɛmmfa hɛn nsa nnka no; osiandɛ hɛn nua a, hɛn bɔgyaa a. Na no nuanom no tsiee no.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Midianfo eguadzifo bi rutwa mu; na woyii Josef fii mona no mu, na wɔtɔɔn no maa Ismaelfo no gyee ndwetɛbona eduonu. Na wɔdze Josef kɔr Egypt.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ber a Reuben sanee baa mona no do no; hwɛ, nna Josef nnyi mona no mu; na osunsuaan ne ntar mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsanee kɔr no nuanom no nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Abofra no nnyi hɔ; na iyi mara merefa hen?
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔfaa Josef n’atar no, na wokum apɔnkyenyin, na wɔdze atar no bɔɔ bɔgya no mu;
title: GENESIS

text: na wɔdze asaasaaba atar fɛfɛɛfɛw no somae ma wɔdze kɛmaa hɔn egya, kɛsee no dɛ, Adze a yeehu nye yi: hwɛ kyerɛ dɛ wo ba n’atar a.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔhwɛe, na ɔsee dɛ, Me ba n’atar a; abowa bɔn bi na ɔakyer no; tsetsew na wɔatsetsew Josef no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob sunsuaan n’atar mu, na ɔdze kɔben tam bɔɔ n’asen, na osuu ne ba nda pii.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ne mbabanyin nye ne mbabaa nyinara bae dɛ wɔrebɛkyekye no werɛ; naaso oenntsie ma wɔannkyekye no werɛ; na ɔsee dɛ, Mibedzi yaw ara dze akɔ me ba nkyɛn wɔ samanadze. Na n’egya suu no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Midianfo no kɔtɔɔn no wɔ Egypt maa Potifar, Farao no somfo bi a ɔno nye abrafohen no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber no ara mu na Juda fii no nuanom nkyɛn kɔree, na ɔkɛtsenaa Adullamnyi bi a ne dzin dze Hira ne nkyɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda hun Keenannyi bi a ne dzin dze Sua ne babaa bi wɔ hɔ; na ɔwaar no, na ɔnye no dae.
title: GENESIS

text: Na onyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin; na ɔfrɛɛ no Er.
title: GENESIS

text: Na onyinseen bio, na ɔwoo babanyin; na ɔfrɛɛ no Onan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔwoo babanyin bio, na ɔfrɛɛ no Sela: na aber a ɔwoo no no nna ɔwɔ Kezib.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda gyee yer maa n’abakan Er, na ne dzin dze Tamar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda n’abakan Er yɛɛ bɔn wɔ EWURADZE enyim; na EWURADZE kum no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda see Onan dɛ, Kɔ wo nua ne yer nkyɛn, na fa no kunabaa, na wo mba ma wo nua.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Onan nyim dɛ mba no nnkɛyɛ nedze; na ɔbaa dɛ, aber biara a ɔkɔr no nua ne yer nkyɛn no, ɔmaa no ho nsu no guu famu, amma ɔaamma no nua mba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na dza ɔyɛe no yɛ bɔn wɔ EWURADZE enyim: na okum no so.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Juda see n’asew Tamar dɛ, Tsena ekunayɛ mu wɔ w’egya fie kɛpem dɛ me ba Sela benyin: osuro dɛ, bɛyɛ na no so oewu dɛ no nuanom no. Na Tamar kɔree na ɔkɛtsenaa n’egya fie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔwɔ hɔ wɔ hɔ nna Juda ne yer a ɔyɛ Sua ne babaa no, owui. Na Juda no werɛ kyekyeree no, ɔkɔr no nguansusuafo nkyɛn wɔ Timna, ɔno nye ne nyɛnko Adullamnyi Hira.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Tamar dɛ, Hwɛ, w’asew rokɔ Timna ekosusua no nguan ho nhwi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na oyii no kuna ntar wɔ no ho, na ɔdze ne nkataenyim kataa n’enyim, na ɔkataa noho kɛtsenaa Enaim abotsenano, wɔ Timna kwan nkyɛn; osiandɛ ohun dɛ Sela enyin, naaso Juda ammfa no amma no awar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda hun no no, obuu no dɛ edwaman a, osiandɛ ɔakata n’enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔmanee kɔr ne nkyɛn wɔ kwan no ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Bra, meserɛ wo, ma membra wo nkyɛn: nna onnyim dɛ n’asew no a. Na Tamar bisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na edze bɛma me, na enye me ada?
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Mebɛma wɔdze apɔnkyeba fi mbowa no mu abrɛ wo. Na obisaa no dɛ, Ebɛma me ahobadze bi ma ɔdze ekodu dɛ ebɛma wɔdze aba?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda bisaa no dɛ, Ebɛn ahobadze na memfa mma wo? Na ɔsee dɛ, Wo nsɔwanokaba nye w’ahoma, nye wo poma a okitsa wo nsamu no. Na Juda dze maa no, na ɔnye no dae, na ɔnye no nyinsenii.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Tamar soɛree kɔree, na oyii ne nkataenyim no wɔ no ho, na ɔfaa no kuna ntar hyɛe.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda dze apɔnkyeba no maa ne nyɛnko Adullamnyi no, dɛ ɔmfa nkɛgye ahobadze no wɔ ɔbaa no nsa mu: naaso oennhu no.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna obisaa no kuromfo no dɛ, edwaman a ɔtse Enaim kwan nkyɛn no wɔ hen? Na wɔsee dɛ, Edwaman biara mmbaa ha.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsanee baa Juda hɔ, na ɔbɛsee dɛ, Mennhu no; na eso ekuromfo no see dɛ, Edwaman biara mmbaa ha.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda see dɛ, Ma ɔmfa, ɔno bohu na hɛn enyim egu ase: hwɛ, memaa wɔdze apɔnkyeba yi kɔree, na ennhu no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ odzii bɛyɛ abosoom ebiasa n’ekyir no, wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Juda dɛ, W’asew Tamar abɔ edwaman, na hwɛ, ɔnam n’edwaman mu enyinsen so. Na Juda see dɛ, Hom nkɛfa no mbra ma wɔnhyew no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔkɛfaa no bae no, nna Tamar somae ma wɔkɛsee n’asew no dɛ, banyin a ndzɛmba yi yɛ nedze no, ɔno na menye no nyinsen: ntsi, Meserɛ wo, hwehwɛ nyia ndzɛmba yi yɛ nedze, nsɔwanokaba, nye ahoma, nye poma yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda hun dɛ noara nedze a, na ɔsee dɛ, ɔtsen sen me; susuampa dɛ mammfa no amma me ba Sela ntsi. Na ɔnye no annda bio.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa no n’awoo durii no, na, hwɛ, nta na wɔwɔ ne yamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ɔrowo no, nna kor dze ne nsa puei; na awogyefo no faa ahoma memen dze kyekyeer ne nsa dɛ, Oyi na odzii kan puei.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔtwee ne nsa kɔdɔɔ mu, na, hwɛ, no nua puei; na ɔwogyefo no see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na atsew mu aba yi? Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Perez.
title: GENESIS

text: Na n’ekyir no na nyia ahoma memen kyekyer ne nsa no bae: na wɔfrɛɛ no Zera.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔdze Josef kɔr Egypt, na Potifar, Farao no somfo a ɔyɛ n’abrafohen no, tɔɔ no wɔ Ismaelfo a wɔdze no kɔr hɔ no hɔn nsamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE dzii Josef n’ekyir na ɔyɛɛ siar wɔ no wura Egyptnyi no ne fie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na no wura hun dɛ EWURADZE nye no nam, na EWURADZE maa dza ɔyɛɛ no nyinara yɛɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ ne nsamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef nyaa n’enyim enyimnyam, na ɔsoom no: na ɔyɛɛ no panyin wɔ ne fie, na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara hyɛɛ ne nsa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ofitsi aber a ɔyɛɛ no panyin wɔ ne fie, na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara hyɛɛ ne nsa no, Josef ntsi EWURADZE hyiraa Egyptnyi no ne fie; na EWURADZE ne nhyira baa dza ɔwɔ nyinara do, dza ɔwɔ fie nye dza ɔwɔ haban mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara hyɛɛ Josef ne nsa; nna noara nnyim dza ɔwɔ no hɔ gyedɛ edziban a ɔnoara dzi. Nna Josef no ho yɛ fɛw, na n’enyim wɔ nyam.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no, no wura ne yer no dze n’enyi sii Josef do; na ɔsee dɛ, Enye me nda.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔpowee, na ɔsee no wura ne yer no dɛ, Hwɛ, mo wura nnyim dza ɔwɔ mo hɔ wɔ fie ha, na ɔdze dza ɔwɔ nyinara ahyɛ me nsa;
title: GENESIS

text: obiara nnyɛ kɛse nnkyɛn me wɔ fie ha; nkyii so ɔnnkam me biribiara ka wo ho, osiandɛ eyɛ ne yer: na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na mebɛyɛ emumuyɛ kɛse yi, na mayɛ bɔn etsia Nyankopɔn?
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, daa daa nyinara ɔkaa kyerɛɛ Josef, naaso ɔanngye no pen, dɛ ɔnye no bɛda, anaa ɔnye no bɛyɛ biribi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber yi mu no ɔkɔr fie hɔ dɛ ɔrekɛyɛ n’edwuma; nna fie no mu nyimpa no mu biara nnyi hɔ
title: GENESIS

text: na basia no suoo n’atar mu, dɛ, Enye me nda: na Josef gyaa n’atar no wɔ ne nsamu, na oguanee puei.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, ohun dɛ oegya n’atar no wɔ ne nsamu, na oeguan epue no,
title: GENESIS

text: ɔfrɛfrɛɛ no nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ ne fie no, na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Wɔnhwɛ, ɔakɛfa Hebriwnyi aba ma oribesi hɛn atwetwe; ɔbaa me nkyɛn dɛ ɔnye me rebɛda, na medze ndze kɛse kekaa mu:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ɔtsee dɛ memaa me ndze do na mekekaa mu no, nna ɔdaan n’atar gyaa me nkyɛn, na oguanee puei.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔdze n’atar no guu ne nkyɛn ara ma okodur dɛ no wura baa fie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkaa no dɛmara kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Akowaa Hebriwnyi a edze no brɛɛ hɛn no, ɔbaa me nkyɛn dɛ orubogu mo ho fi
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔbaa dɛ, memaa me ndze do, na mekekaa mu no, nna ɔdaan n’atar gyaa me nkyɛn, na oguanee puei.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a no wura tsee ne yer ne nsɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Mbrɛ w’akowaa ayɛ me nye yi no; no bo fuuw kɛsenara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef no wura faa no dze no kɔtoo efiadze, beebi mbrɛ ɔhen n’adaduafo gu no: na ɔdaa efiadze hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na EWURADZE dzii Josef n’ekyir, na ɔdoom no, na ɔmaa onyaa efiadzehwɛfo no n’enyim enyimnyam.
title: GENESIS

text: Na efiadzehwɛfo no dze adaduafo a wɔwɔ efiadze hɔ no nyinara hyɛɛ Josef ne nsa; na biribiara a wɔyɛɛ no wɔ hɔ no, ɔnoara na ɔhwɛe.
title: GENESIS

text: Efiadzehwɛfo no annhaw no ho wɔ dza ɔdze hyɛɛ ne nsa mu no mu biara ho, osiandɛ EWURADZE nye no nam; na biribiara a ɔyɛe no, EWURADZE maa ɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no, Egypthen ne nsahyɛfo nye ne paanootofo no foom hɔn wura Egypthen no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao no bo fuuw n’asomfo beenu no, nsahyɛfo panyin no, nye paanootofo panyin no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔdze hɔn koguu efiadze wɔ abrafohen no ne fie, wɔ efiadze beebi mbrɛ Josef da no no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na abrafohen no dze hɔn hyɛɛ Josef ne nsa, na ɔsoom hɔn: na wɔkyɛɛr efiadze hɔ mber kakra.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hɔn beenu nyina sosoo daa, anafua da kor a ɔsor obiara ne daa, nye ne nkyerɛasee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef baa hɔn nkyɛn anapa no, obohun hɔn dɛ wɔabombɔm.
title: GENESIS

text: Na obisaa Farao n’asomfo a wɔnye no gu efiadze hɔ no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na ndɛ hom abombɔm dɛm yi?
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛasoso daa, naaso yennya obi ma ɔnnkyerɛ hɛn ase. Na Josef see hɔn dɛ, Ana nnyɛ Nyankopɔn na ɔma nkyerɛase bi a? Meserɛ hom, hom nka nkyerɛ me.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nsahyɛfo panyin no kaa n’adaaso kyerɛɛ Josef, na ɔsee no dɛ, M’adaaso mu, hwɛ, wenyindua si m’enyim;
title: GENESIS

text: na nkorbata ebiasa wɔ wenyindua no ho: na ɔyɛ dɛ ɔafefɛw, na ɔabɔ nhyiren; na no do nsiansiaw asow wenyinamba a ɔaber:
title: GENESIS

text: na Farao no kɔɔpow kitsa me nsamu, na metsetseew wenyinamba no, na mikyii guu Farao no kɔɔpow mu, na medze kɔɔpow no hyɛɛ Farao ne nsa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef see no dɛ, Ne nkyerɛase nye yi; nkorbata ebiasa no ɔyɛ ndaansa.
title: GENESIS

text: Aka ndaansa ma Farao eyi wo efi ha na ɔama ekedzi wo dzibew bio: na edze Farao no kɔɔpow bɛhyɛ ne nsa, dɛ nkyɛ kan no a eyɛ ne nsahyɛfo no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na sɛ inya beebi si a, ɔno kaa me, na yɛ me ayamuyie, meserɛ wo, na bɔ me dzin kyerɛ Farao, na beyi me fi dan yi mu:
title: GENESIS

text: na owia na wowiaa me wɔ Hebriwfo asaase do: na ha so mennyɛɛ biribiara a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔdze me to efiadze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a paanootofo panyin no hun dɛ nkyerɛase no ye no, ɔsee Josef dɛ, Mo so m’adaaso mu no, muhun dɛ paanoo fufuw nkɛntsɛn ebiasa sisi m’etsifi:
title: GENESIS

text: na kɛntsɛn a odzi sor no adɔkɔdɔkɔdze a wɔto ma Farao nyinara bi wɔ mu; na nnoma ridzi no kɛntsɛn no mu wɔ m’etsifi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef buae na ɔsee dɛ, Ne nkyerɛase nye yi: nkɛntsɛn ebiasa no yɛ ndaansa:
title: GENESIS

text: na aka ndaansa ma Farao eyi wo tsir wɔ wo do, na wɔasɛn wo wɔ dua do ma nnoma edzi wo nam efi wo ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ne ndaansa no a ɔyɛ Farao n’awoda no, ɔtoo pon maa no nkowaa nyinara: na oyii nsahyɛfo panyin no nye paanootofo panyin no fii efiadze dze hɔn baa no nkowaa no enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔmaa nsahyɛfo panyin no sanee yɛɛ ne nsahyɛdwuma no bio; na ɔdze kɔɔpow no hyɛɛ Farao ne nsa:
title: GENESIS

text: na paanootofo panyin no dze, ɔsɛɛn no: dɛ mbrɛ Josef kyerɛɛ hɔn ase no ara.
title: GENESIS

text: Naaso nsahyɛfo panyin no annkaa Josef, na no werɛ fiir no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe ebien ekyir no, Farao soo daa: na ohun dɛ nna ogyina esutsen Nael no ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ohun dɛ anantwiber esuon a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw na wɔadɔ seradze, fi esutsen no mu puei; na wobedzidzii wɔ sar no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hwɛ, anantwiber esuon afofor so fi esutsen no mu dzi hɔn ekyir puei a hɔn ho yɛ tantan na wɔafomfɔn; na wobegyinaa anantwiber esuon no nkyɛn wɔ esutsen no no kɔn do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na anantwiber esuon a hɔn ho yɛ tantan na wɔafomfɔn no, memeen anantwiber esuon a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw na wɔadodɔ seradze no. Nna Farao nyanee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔdae na ɔsoo daa bio: na ohun dɛ, eburow mbɛtsem esuon efifir eburonan kor do, amaama na oye.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hwɛ, mbɛtsem esuon a ɔyɛ nkɔkɔr na boka mframa enyinyam no fifirii dzii hɔn ekyir.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mbɛtsem nkɔkɔr no memeen mbɛtsem esuon a eburow wɔ mu na ɔyɛ amaama no. Na Farao nyanee, na, hwɛ, adaaso a.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ anapa no, n’ahom annka noho; na ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛfrɛɛ Egypt nkongyaayifo nyinara, nye enyansafo a wɔwɔ hɔ nyinara ma wɔbae: na Farao kaa n’adaaso no kyerɛɛ hɔn; naaso obiara enntum annkyerɛ ase annkyerɛ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna nsahyɛfo panyin no kaa kyerɛɛ Farao dɛ, Mekaa mo mfom ndɛ:
title: GENESIS

text: Farao no bo fuuw no nkowaa, emi nye paanootofo panyin no: na ɔdze hɛn koguu efiadze wɔ abrafohen no ne fie,
title: GENESIS

text: na yɛsosoo daa anafua da kor, emi nye paanotonyi no; a ɔsor obiara ne daa nye mbrɛ ne nkyerɛase tse.
title: GENESIS

text: Na yɛkaa kyerɛɛ Hebriwnyi aberantsɛ bi, abrafohen no n’akowaa a nna ɔnye hɛn wɔ hɔ no, na ɔkyerɛɛ hɛn daa no ase; dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaako ne daa tse no ara na ɔkyerɛɛ no ase.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔyɛɛ hɔ dɛ mbrɛ ɔkyerɛɛ hɛn ase no ara; emi emaa mikedzii me dzibew, na ɔno esɛɛn no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao somae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ Josef, na wɔyɛɛ ntsɛm dze no fii efiadze no mu hɔ puei: na osusuae, na ɔsesaa n’atar, na ɔbaa Farao hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao see Josef dɛ, Maso daa, na obiara nnyi hɔ a otum kyerɛ ase: na ɔwo na matse wo nka dɛ, etse daa a, ekyerɛ ase.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef buaa Farao dɛ, Onnyi mo mu: Nyankopɔn na ɔbɛma Farao asomdwee mbuae.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao kaa kyerɛɛ Josef dɛ, M’adaaso mu no, hwɛ, nna migyina esutsen Nael no kɔn do:
title: GENESIS

text: na muhun dɛ anantwiber esuon a wɔadɔ seradze na hɔn ho yɛ fɛw fi nsu no mu bae; na wobedzidzii sar no do:
title: GENESIS

text: na hwɛ, anantwiber esuon afofor so dzi hɔn ekyir bae a wɔyɛ mbɔbɔr na hɔn ho tantanntan nkamfenkamfe, a munnhun hɔn ho ne tantan ne saso wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do da:
title: GENESIS

text: na anantwiber a wɔyɛ nkamfenkamfe na hɔn ho tantan no memeen anantwiber esuon a wɔadɔ seradze a wodzii kan no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a wowiee hɔn memen no, obi ennhu dɛ woewie hɔn men: osiandɛ nna hɔn ho da ho ara yɛ tantan dɛ nkan no ara so bio. Nna minyanee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na muhun wɔ m’adaaso mu bio, na hwɛ, mbɛtsem esuon efifir eburonan kor do, amaama na oye:
title: GENESIS

text: na muhun dɛ mbɛtsem esuon a enyinyam, na ɔyɛ nkɔkɔr, na boka mframa ama woetwintwam fifirii, dzii hɔn ekyir:
title: GENESIS

text: na mbɛtsem esuon nkɔkɔr no memeen mbɛtsem esuon a oye no. Mekaa kyerɛɛ nkongyaayifo no; naaso obiara nnyi hɔ a otumii kyerɛɛ me ase.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef see Farao dɛ, Farao n’adaaso ebien no yɛ kor: dza Nyankopɔn rebɛyɛ na oeyi akyerɛ Farao no.
title: GENESIS

text: Anantwiber pa esuon no yɛ mfe esuon; na mbɛtsem pa esuon no yɛ mfe esuon: daa no yɛ kor.
title: GENESIS

text: Na anantwiber esuon a wɔafomfɔn na hɔn ho yɛ tantan no a wodzii hɔn ekyir bae no, yɛ ɔkɔm mfe esuon, mbɛtsem esuon nkɔkɔr a boka mframa ama enyinyam no so dɛmara; ɔbɛyɛ ɔkɔm mfe esuon.
title: GENESIS

text: Ɔno nye asɛm a mekaa mekyerɛɛ Farao no; dɛ dza Nyankopɔn rebɛyɛ nna oeyi akyerɛ Farao no.
title: GENESIS

text: Hwɛ, mfe esuon reba a edziban piinara bɛba Egypt asaase nyinara do:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔno n’ekyir no nna ɔkɔm mfe esuon bɔsoɛr; na werɛ befir edziban pii no nyinara wɔ Egypt asaase do; na ɔkɔm no bɛhyew asaase no;
title: GENESIS

text: na osian ɔkɔm a odzi ekyir no ntsi wɔnnkɛkaa edziban pii no wɔ asaase no do; osiandɛ no mu bɛyɛ dzen dodow.
title: GENESIS

text: Na sɛ adaaso no yɛɛ mbɔho ebien maa Farao a, nna ne siantsir nye dɛ, Nyankopɔn esi no pi, na Nyankopɔn bɛma ayɛ hɔ ntsɛntsɛm.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei wɔmma Farao nhwehwɛ nyimpa a ɔyɛ ɔbadwembanyi nye onyansafo, na ɔnyɛ no panyin wɔ Egypt asaase do.
title: GENESIS
