text: Wɔmma Farao nyɛ iyi, na ɔnhyehyɛ ahwɛdofo wɔ asaase no do, na wɔngyegye Egypt asaase do edziban no mbumu enum enum wɔ mfe esuon a edziban pii wɔ mu no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔmma wɔmboaboa mfe pa a ɔreba yi no mu edziban nyinara ano, na wɔmfa eburow nhyehyɛ asan do wɔ Farao ne nsa ase, ma ɔnyɛ edziban wɔ nkurow no mu, na wɔmfa nsie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na edziban no bɛyɛ dza wɔakora ama asaase no dze esie ɔkɔm mfe esuon a ɔbɛba Egypt asaase do no; amma asaase no aannsɛɛ wɔ ɔkɔm no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na asɛm no yɛɛ Farao nye no nkowaa nyinara dɛw.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao see no nkowaa dɛ, Ana yebenya nyimpa a ɔtse dɛ oyi, nyimpa a Nyankopɔn no sunsum wɔ no mu yi?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao see Josef dɛ, Susuampa dɛ Nyankopɔn dze iyi nyinara akyerɛ wo yi, obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛ ɔbadwembanyi nye onyansafo dɛ ɔwo:
title: GENESIS

text: ɔwo na ebɔhwɛ me fi yi do, na dza ebɛka no, dza me man nyinara bedzi do nye no; gyedɛ ahengua no nkotsee na medze mebɛsen wo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao see Josef dɛ, Hwɛ, mayɛ wo Egypt asaase nyinara do panyin.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao worɔɔw no nsɔwanonkaba wɔ ne nsa, na ɔdze hyɛɛ Josef ne nsa, na ɔhyɛɛ no ndwera pa ntar, na ɔdze sika ntweaban too no kɔn mu;
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔmaa ɔtsenaa ne tseaseanam a otsia ebien no mu; na wɔpaa mu wɔ n’enyim dɛ, Obiara mbu nkotodwe; na ɔyɛɛ no Egypt asaase nyinara do panyin.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao see Josef dɛ, Emi nye Farao, na obiara nnkokwetsir wo ayɛ biribiara wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao frɛɛ Josef ne dzin Zafenat-panea; na ɔdze ɔsɔfo Potifera ne babaa Asenat maa no awar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a Josef kopuee Egypthen Farao n’enyim no, nna oedzi mfe eduasa. Na Josef fii Farao n’enyim, na okekyimaa Egypt asaase nyinara do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na bafuu mfe esuon no mu no, edziban baa asaase no do ma obuu do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔboaboaa mfe esuon edziban a ɔbaa Egypt asaase do no nyinara ano, na ɔdze siesiee nkurow no mu: nhaban a wɔabɔ nkurow no nyinara ho aprɔw no mu edziban na ɔdze siesiee nkurow no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef boaboaa eburow ano dɛ mpoano anhwea; ɔdɔɔ so dodow, ma nkyii ogyaa kan mpo; osiandɛ wobu ano a ɔnnyɛ yie.
title: GENESIS

text: Wɔwoo mba beenu maa Josef ansaana ɔkɔm afe no rudu, hɔn a On ɔsɔfo Potifera ne babaa Asenat woo hɔn maa no no a.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef frɛɛ abakan no ne dzin Manaasɛ: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn ama mo werɛ efir me berɛ nyinara, nye m’egya fie nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nyia otsia ebien no ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Efraim: osiandɛ ɔsee dɛ Nyankopɔn ama mawo wɔ amandzehu asaase no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ndɔbaa pii a ɔbaa Egypt asaase do mfe esuon no bɔɔ adze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkɔm mfe esuon hyɛɛ ase dɛ ɔreba, dɛ mbrɛ Josef see no ara; na ɔkɔm baa asaase nyinara do: nna Egypt asaase nyinara do dze, edziban wɔ hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkɔm kaa Egypt asaase nyinara no, ɔman no sui tɔɔ Farao do gyee edziban: na Farao see Egyptfo no nyinara dɛ, Hom nkɔ Josef hɔ; dza ɔbɛse hom no, hom nyɛ.

text: Na ɔkɔm no baa asaase nyinara do, na Josef buebuee mbrɛ edziban wɔ no nyinara, na ɔtɔnee maa Egyptfo no; na ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ Egypt asaase do.

text: Na aman nyinara baa Josef hɔ wɔ Egypt bɔtɔɔ eburow; osiandɛ ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ asaase nyinara do.

title: GENESIS

text: na hwɛ, anantwiber esuon afofor so dzi hɔn ekyir bae a wɔyɛ mbɔbɔr na hɔn ho tantanntan nkamfenkamfe, a munnhun hɔn ho ne tantan ne saso wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do da:
title: GENESIS

text: na anantwiber a wɔyɛ nkamfenkamfe na hɔn ho tantan no memeen anantwiber esuon a wɔadɔ seradze a wodzii kan no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a wowiee hɔn memen no, obi ennhu dɛ woewie hɔn men: osiandɛ nna hɔn ho da ho ara yɛ tantan dɛ nkan no ara so bio. Nna minyanee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na muhun wɔ m’adaaso mu bio, na hwɛ, mbɛtsem esuon efifir eburonan kor do, amaama na oye:
title: GENESIS

text: na muhun dɛ mbɛtsem esuon a enyinyam, na ɔyɛ nkɔkɔr, na boka mframa ama woetwintwam fifirii, dzii hɔn ekyir:
title: GENESIS

text: na mbɛtsem esuon nkɔkɔr no memeen mbɛtsem esuon a oye no. Mekaa kyerɛɛ nkongyaayifo no; naaso obiara nnyi hɔ a otumii kyerɛɛ me ase.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef see Farao dɛ, Farao n’adaaso ebien no yɛ kor: dza Nyankopɔn rebɛyɛ na oeyi akyerɛ Farao no.
title: GENESIS

text: Anantwiber pa esuon no yɛ mfe esuon; na mbɛtsem pa esuon no yɛ mfe esuon: daa no yɛ kor.
title: GENESIS

text: Na anantwiber esuon a wɔafomfɔn na hɔn ho yɛ tantan no a wodzii hɔn ekyir bae no, yɛ ɔkɔm mfe esuon, mbɛtsem esuon nkɔkɔr a boka mframa ama enyinyam no so dɛmara; ɔbɛyɛ ɔkɔm mfe esuon.
title: GENESIS

text: Ɔno nye asɛm a mekaa mekyerɛɛ Farao no; dɛ dza Nyankopɔn rebɛyɛ nna oeyi akyerɛ Farao no.
title: GENESIS

text: Hwɛ, mfe esuon reba a edziban piinara bɛba Egypt asaase nyinara do:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔno n’ekyir no nna ɔkɔm mfe esuon bɔsoɛr; na werɛ befir edziban pii no nyinara wɔ Egypt asaase do; na ɔkɔm no bɛhyew asaase no;
title: GENESIS

text: na osian ɔkɔm a odzi ekyir no ntsi wɔnnkɛkaa edziban pii no wɔ asaase no do; osiandɛ no mu bɛyɛ dzen dodow.
title: GENESIS

text: Na sɛ adaaso no yɛɛ mbɔho ebien maa Farao a, nna ne siantsir nye dɛ, Nyankopɔn esi no pi, na Nyankopɔn bɛma ayɛ hɔ ntsɛntsɛm.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei wɔmma Farao nhwehwɛ nyimpa a ɔyɛ ɔbadwembanyi nye onyansafo, na ɔnyɛ no panyin wɔ Egypt asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Wɔmma Farao nyɛ iyi, na ɔnhyehyɛ ahwɛdofo wɔ asaase no do, na wɔngyegye Egypt asaase do edziban no mbumu enum enum wɔ mfe esuon a edziban pii wɔ mu no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔmma wɔmboaboa mfe pa a ɔreba yi no mu edziban nyinara ano, na wɔmfa eburow nhyehyɛ asan do wɔ Farao ne nsa ase, ma ɔnyɛ edziban wɔ nkurow no mu, na wɔmfa nsie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na edziban no bɛyɛ dza wɔakora ama asaase no dze esie ɔkɔm mfe esuon a ɔbɛba Egypt asaase do no; amma asaase no aannsɛɛ wɔ ɔkɔm no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na asɛm no yɛɛ Farao nye no nkowaa nyinara dɛw.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao see no nkowaa dɛ, Ana yebenya nyimpa a ɔtse dɛ oyi, nyimpa a Nyankopɔn no sunsum wɔ no mu yi?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao see Josef dɛ, Susuampa dɛ Nyankopɔn dze iyi nyinara akyerɛ wo yi, obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛ ɔbadwembanyi nye onyansafo dɛ ɔwo:
title: GENESIS

text: ɔwo na ebɔhwɛ me fi yi do, na dza ebɛka no, dza me man nyinara bedzi do nye no; gyedɛ ahengua no nkotsee na medze mebɛsen wo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao see Josef dɛ, Hwɛ, mayɛ wo Egypt asaase nyinara do panyin.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao worɔɔw no nsɔwanonkaba wɔ ne nsa, na ɔdze hyɛɛ Josef ne nsa, na ɔhyɛɛ no ndwera pa ntar, na ɔdze sika ntweaban too no kɔn mu;
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔmaa ɔtsenaa ne tseaseanam a otsia ebien no mu; na wɔpaa mu wɔ n’enyim dɛ, Obiara mbu nkotodwe; na ɔyɛɛ no Egypt asaase nyinara do panyin.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao see Josef dɛ, Emi nye Farao, na obiara nnkokwetsir wo ayɛ biribiara wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao frɛɛ Josef ne dzin Zafenat-panea; na ɔdze On ɔsɔfo Potifera ne babaa Asenat maa no awar.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a Josef kopuee Egypthen Farao n’enyim no, nna oedzi mfe eduasa. Na Josef fii Farao n’enyim, na okekyimaa Egypt asaase nyinara do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na bafuu mfe esuon no mu no, edziban baa asaase no do ma obuu do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔboaboaa mfe esuon edziban a ɔbaa Egypt asaase do no nyinara ano, na ɔdze siesiee nkurow no mu: nhaban a wɔabɔ nkurow no nyinara ho aprɔw no mu edziban na ɔdze siesiee nkurow no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef boaboaa eburow ano dɛ mpoano anhwea; ɔdɔɔ so dodow, ma nkyii ogyaa kan mpo; osiandɛ wobu ano a ɔnnyɛ yie.
title: GENESIS

text: Wɔwoo mba beenu maa Josef ansaana ɔkɔm afe no rudu, hɔn a On ɔsɔfo Potifera ne babaa Asenat woo hɔn maa no no a.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef frɛɛ abakan no ne dzin Manaasɛ: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn ama mo werɛ efir me berɛ nyinara, nye m’egya fie nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nyia otsia ebien no ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Efraim: osiandɛ ɔsee dɛ Nyankopɔn ama mawo wɔ amandzehu asaase no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ndɔbaa pii a ɔbaa Egypt asaase do mfe esuon no bɔɔ adze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkɔm mfe esuon hyɛɛ ase dɛ ɔreba, dɛ mbrɛ Josef see no ara; na ɔkɔm baa asaase nyinara do: nna Egypt asaase nyinara do dze, edziban wɔ hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkɔm kaa Egypt asaase nyinara no, ɔman no sui tɔɔ Farao do gyee edziban: na Farao see Egyptfo no nyinara dɛ, Hom nkɔ Josef hɔ; dza ɔbɛse hom no, hom nyɛ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkɔm no baa asaase nyinara do, na Josef buebuee mbrɛ edziban wɔ no nyinara, na ɔtɔnee maa Egyptfo no; na ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ Egypt asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aman nyinara baa Josef hɔ wɔ Egypt bɔtɔɔ eburow; osiandɛ ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ asaase nyinara do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ asaase no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wowiee eburow a wɔdze fi Egypt bae no dzi no, hɔn egya see hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ bio, hom nkɔtɔ edziban kakra mbrɛ hɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, banyin no paa mu ara kaa kyerɛɛ hɛn dɛ, Hom runnhu m’enyim, gyedɛ hom nua no ka hom ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Sɛ ebɛma hɛn nua no nye hɛn akɔ a, nna yɛbɔkɔ na yɛakɔtɔ edziban abrɛ wo:
title: GENESIS

text: na sɛ ennkɛma ɔaka hɛn ho dze a, ɔno yɛronnkɔ: osiandɛ banyin no see hɛn dɛ, Mma hom nnsi m’enyim, gyedɛ hom nua no ka hom ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel see dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom nye me dzi no bɔn dɛm, dɛ hom kaa kyerɛɛ banyin no dɛ hom wɔ nua bi so?
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, ɔbarimba no bisaa hɛn ntsɛmara wɔ hɛnara hɛnho, nye hɛn ebusuafo ho, dɛ, Ana hom egya da ho tse ase? Hom wɔ nua bi so a? Na mbrɛ nsɛm yi tse no ara na hɛn so yeyii no ano. Ana hɛn so yenyim dɛ ɔreyɛ na ɔase dɛ, Wɔnkɛfa hom nua no mbra?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda see n’egya Israel dɛ, Ma abofra no nye me nkɔ, na yɛbɔsoɛr na yɛakɔ; ama yeenya nkwa, na yeennwu, hɛn nye ɔwo nyina, nye hɛn mbofraba so.
title: GENESIS

text: Mibedzi no ho egyinamu; hwehwɛ no me nsamu: sɛ mammfa no ammbrɛ wo, na mammfa no emmbegyina w’enyim a, ɔno wɔmma asodzi no nka mo kɔn mu daa:
title: GENESIS

text: sɛ yennkyinkyim a nkyɛ ebodu sisei, ɔyɛ dɛn ara a yɛakɔ aba mpɛn ebien.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hɔn egya Israel see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ mbrɛ ɔtse nye yi a, ɔno hom nyɛ yi; hom mfa asaase yi do ndzepa a oye no bi ngu hom ndzɛmba mu, dɛ akyɛdze nkɛma banyin no, akyenkyendur kakra, ewo kakra, eduhuam mɛɛr, nkatse, nye eduadzewa almɔnd,
title: GENESIS

text: na hom mfa sika fofor nkitsa; na sika a wɔdze sanee maa hom a wɔdze hyehyɛɛ hom nkotoku ano no, ɔno so hom mfa nkitsa bio; bi a enyi na oduaa do.
title: GENESIS

text: Hom mfa hom nua no so, na wɔnsoɛr nkɔ banyin no hɔ bio:
title: GENESIS

text: na Otumfo Nyankopɔn mma banyin no nhu hom mbɔbɔr, ama oeegyaa hom nua kor no nye Benjamin ama hom. Na emi dze, sɛ me mba fi me nsa a, nna woefi me nsa.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna nkorɔfo no faa akyɛdze no, na wɔfaa sika fofor siaan ho, nye Benjamin so; na wɔsoɛree kɔr Egypt, na wokegyinaa Josef n’enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a Josef hun dɛ Benjamin ka hɔn ho no, ɔsee ne fie somfopanyin no dɛ, Fa mbanyin yi kɔ fie, na koku mbowa, na yɛ edziban; na mbanyin yi nye me bedzidzi ewiaber yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na panyin no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Josef see no ara; na ɔdze nkorɔfo no kɔr Josef fie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nkorɔfo no hɔn akoma tui, osiandɛ wɔdze hɔn akɔ Josef ne fie ntsi; na wɔsee dɛ, Sika a wɔsanee dze hyehyɛɛ hɛn nkotoku mu asɔpɔn no ntsi na wɔdze hɛn aba fie yi; ama ɔaahwehwɛ biribi egyina do, na oeesuo hɛn mu, na ɔaafa hɛn ayɛ nkowaa, nye hɛn nsoasopɔnkɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wopiin Josef ne fie somfopanyin no nkyɛn wɔ fi no n’abowano,
title: GENESIS

text: na wɔsee dɛ, Ao mo wura, yɛbaa ha bɔtɔɔ edziban asɔpɔn no ampa:
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a yedur asoɛe, na yɛsansaan hɛn nkotoku ano no, nna, hwɛ, hɛn nyinara hɛn sika hyehyɛ hɛn nkotoku ano, hɛn sika mbrɛ ɔtow ara pɛ: na yɛdze asan aba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na yɛdze sika fofor so aba a yɛdze robɔtɔ edziban: yennyim nyia ɔdze hɛn sika no hyehyɛɛ hɛn nkotoku mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Asomdwee nka hom, mma hom nnsuro: hom Nyankopɔn, nye hom egya ne Nyankopɔn, na ɔama hom ehutudze wɔ hom nkotoku mu: me nsa kaa hom sika no. Na okeyii Simeon brɛɛ hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na banyin no dze nkorɔfo no kɔr Josef fie, na ɔmaa hɔn nsu, na wɔhohoor hɔn anan ho; na ɔmaa hɔn nsoasopɔnkɔ no edziban.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔyɛɛ akyɛdze no krado dze tweɔɔn Josef ne mbae a ɔbaa ewiaber no: osiandɛ wɔtsee dɛ woribedzidzi wɔ hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef baa fie no, wɔdze akyɛdze a okitsa hɔn nsamu no kɔr dan mu kɛmaa no, na wɔkɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze wɔ famu maa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na obisaa hɔn honam mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ana hom egya akɔdaa a hom kaa no ho asɛm no, no ho ye? Ana ɔda ho tse ase?
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, W’akowaa hɛn egya no ho ye, ɔda ho tse ase. Na wɔbɔɔ hɔn tsir adze, na wɔkotoow no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔmaa n’enyiwa do, na ohun no nua Benjamin, ne na ba no, na obisaa dɛ, Ana hom nua kuma a hom kaa no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ me no, ɔno nye yi a? Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn nhyira wo, me ba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef no ho hiahiaa no; osiandɛ ne yamu hyehyee no wɔ no nua no ho; na ɔhwehwɛɛ beebi a obosuma esu; na ɔkɔr ne pia mu, na okosui wɔ hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔhohoor n’enyim, na opuei; na ɔhyɛɛ noho do, na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔmfa edziban mbesisi hɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔdze ɔnoara nedze sii fa, na wɔdze hɔndze sisii fa, na wɔdze Egyptfo a wɔnye no dzidzi no hɔndze sisii fa; osiandɛ Egyptfo nnye Hebriwfo nndzidzi; na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma Egyptfo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔtsenatsenaa n’enyim, abakan no dɛ mbrɛ ne panyin tse, nye ekumaba no dɛ mbrɛ n’ekumaba tse: na ɔyɛɛ nkorɔfo no nwanwa wɔ hɔn mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na oyiyii edziban ma wɔdze fii n’enyim maa hɔn: na Benjamin dze n’edziban no boor hɔn nyinara hɔndze do mpɛn enum. Na wɔnomee, na hɔn nyinara hɔn enyi gyee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef hyɛɛ ne fie somfo no dɛ, Fa edziban dodowara a nkorɔfo no botum asoa hyehyɛ hɔn nkotoku mu, na fa nyimpa biara ne sika hyɛ no kotoku ano.
title: GENESIS

text: Na fa mo kɔɔpow no, mekyerɛ me dwetɛ kɔɔpow no, hyɛ hɔn mu kakraba no no kotoku mu, nye n’eburow sika no. Na ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Josef kae no ara.
title: GENESIS

text: Enyim tsetsewee ara na wogyaa nkorɔfo no kwan, hɔn nye hɔn nsoasopɔnkɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wofii kurow no mu kɔree, na wonnyae nndur ekyirekyir no, Josef see ne somfo no dɛ, Soɛr, tsiw nkorɔfo no; na sɛ eto hɔn a, se hɔn dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom dze bɔn etua papa kaw yi?
title: GENESIS

text: Ana nnyɛ iyi na mo wura nom ano, na ɔdze hyɛ nkɔm ma ɔba mu no bi? Hom ayɛ bɔn dɛ hom ayɛ dɛm adze yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔtoo hɔn, na ɔkaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mo wura ka nsɛm a ɔtse dɛm yi? Nyankopɔn mpa ngu dɛ wo nkowaa bɛyɛ dɛm adze yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Hwɛ, sika a yehun no hɛn nkotoku mu no, yɛdze sanee fii Keenan asaase do brɛɛ wo bio: ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na yebowia dwetɛ anaa sika wɔ wo wura ne fie?
title: GENESIS

text: Wo nkowaa hɛn mu biara a ibohu no wɔ no hɔ no, ma onwu, na hɛn so yɛbɛyɛ mo wura nkowaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nna afei wɔmma ɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ hom aka yi ara: nyia wobohu no no hɔ no ɔbɛyɛ m’akowaa; na hom dze, hom nndzi so.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna wɔyɛɛ no ntsɛm, na nyimpa biara soɛɛ no kotoku too famu, na nyimpa biara saan no kotoku ano.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔhwehwɛe, ofitsi panyin no do, na ɔdze kɛpeem kakraba no do: na wohun kɔɔpow no wɔ Benjamin no kotoku no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna wosunsuaan hɔn ntar mu, na obiara dze n’adze soaa n’asoasopɔnkɔ, na wɔsanee kɔr kurow no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda nye no nuanom no baa Josef fie; nna ɔda ho wɔ hɔ: na wɔhwehwee famu wɔ n’enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef see hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom ayɛ yi? Ana hom nnyim dɛ nyimpa a ɔtse dɛ emi yi mubotum dɛ mehyɛ nkɔm ma ɔba mu bi a?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda see dɛ, Yɛnse mo wura dɛn? Yɛnka dɛn anaadɛ yerudua dɛn asan hɛnho? Nyankopɔn eyi wo nkowaa hɛn emumuyɛ edzi: hwɛ, yɛyɛ mo wura no nkowaa, hɛn nye nyia wohun kɔɔpow no wɔ ne nsamu nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef see dɛ, Nyankopɔn mpa ngu dɛ mebɛyɛ dɛm: nyia woehu kɔɔpow no wɔ ne nsamu no, ɔnoara na ɔbɛyɛ m’akowaa; na hom dze, hom nkɔ hom egya nkyɛn wɔ asomdwee mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Juda piin Josef nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Ao mo wura, meserɛ wo, ma w’akowaa nka asɛm kor wɔ mo wura n’asomu, na mma wo bo mmfuw w’akowaa: osiandɛ tserɛ woara nye Farao.
title: GENESIS

text: Mo wura bisaa no nkowaa dɛ, Ana hom wɔ egya, anaa nua bi?
title: GENESIS

text: Na yebuaa mo wura dɛ, Yɛwɔ egya, akɔdaa bi, na no nkɔdaa ba kakraba bi; na no nua ewu na ne ba a aka ara nye no nko, na n’egya dɔ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na esee wo nkowaa dɛ, Wɔnkɛfa no mbrɛ me, ma monhwɛ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na yɛsee mo wura dɛ, Abofra no fi n’egya nkyɛn a ɔnnkɛyɛ: na sɛ ofi n’egya nkyɛn a, n’egya bowu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na esee wo nkowaa dɛ, Gyedɛ hom nua kakraba no nye hom ba, ɔno hom nnkohu m’enyim bio.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ yɛkɔr w’akowaa, m’egya nkyɛn no, yɛkaa mo wura ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hɛn egya see dɛ, Hom nkɔ bio nkɔtɔ edziban kakra mbrɛ hɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na yɛsee dɛ, Yɛkɔ a ɔnnkɛyɛ: gyedɛ hɛn nua kakraba no ka hɛn ho, ɔno yɛbɔkɔ: osiandɛ sɛ hɛn nua kakraba no nnka hɛn ho a, ɔno yennkohu banyin no n’enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na w’akowaa, m’egya no see hɛn dɛ, Homara hom nyim dɛ me yer woo mba beenu maa me:
title: GENESIS

text: na baako fii me nkyɛn kɔree, na mesee dɛ, Ampaara wɔatsetsew no mu, na munnhun no ara na ɔdze ebodu ndɛ yi:
title: GENESIS

text: na sɛ hom yi oyi so wɔ me nkyɛn, na mbusu bi ba no do a, ɔno hom dze mo gon nam awerɛhow mu bɔkɔ nda mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei sɛ mokɔ w’akowaa, m’egya ne nkyɛn, na sɛ abofra no nnka hɛn ho a, ɔnam dɛ n’akoma da abofra no ho dodow ntsi,
title: GENESIS

text: sɛ ohu dɛ abofra no nnka hɛn ho a, ɔno obowu: nna wo nkowaa dze w’akowaa, hɛn egya no, no gon nam awerɛhow mu akɔ nda mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na w’akowaa midzii abofra no ho egyinamu maa m’egya dɛ, Sɛ mammfa no mammbrɛ wo a, ɔno mibedzi so wɔ m’egya n’enyim daa.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, ma w’akowaa mindzi abofra no ananmu menyɛ mo wura ɔsomfo; na ma abofra no nye no nuanom nkɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mibesi no dɛn na makɔ m’egya nkyɛn, ber a abofra no nnka mo ho? Bɛyɛ na mehu mbusu a ɔbɛba m’egya no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna afei Josef hyɛ noho do a ɔnnyɛ yie, wɔ hɔn a wogyinagyina ne nkyɛn no nyinara hɔn enyim; na ɔkaa mu dɛ, Wɔmma nkorɔfo nyinara mfi me nkyɛn mfi. Na aber a Josef riyi noho edzi akyerɛ no nuanom no, nna obiara nngyina ne nkyɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔmaa ne ndze do sui: na Egyptfo no tsee, na Farao fiefo tsee.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef see no nuanom no dɛ, Emi nye Josef; ana m’egya da ho tse ase? Na no nuanom no enntum emmbua no; osiandɛ hɔn ho popoe wɔ n’enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef see no nuanom no dɛ, Meserɛ hom, wompin me nkyɛn. Na wopinii. Na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye hom nua Josef a hom tɔɔn no baa Egypt no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na afei mma ɔnnyɛ hom yaw, na mma hom bo mmfufuw hom ho so, dɛ hom tɔɔn me baa ha: osiandɛ Nyankopɔn na ɔsomaa me ma midzii hom enyim kan, ama maabɛgye nkwa.
title: GENESIS

text: Osiandɛ ɔkɔm esi asaase yi do mfe ebien nye yi: na mfe enum so aka a adɔw nye buber so nnyi mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn somaa me ma midzii hom enyim kan ama maabɔkora edzinkaa bi ama hom wɔ asaase do, na medze ɔgye kɛsenara agye hom nkwa.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, nnyɛ hom bi na wɔsomaa me wɔ ha, na Nyankopɔn a: na ɔayɛ me Farao n’egya, na ne fi nyinara wura na Egypt asaase nyinara do panyin.
title: GENESIS

text: Hom nka hom ho nkɔ m’egya hɔ, na wɔnkɛse no dɛ, Mbrɛ wo ba Josef se nye yi, Nyankopɔn ayɛ me Egypt nyinara wura: bra me nkyɛn, mma nnkyinkyim:
title: GENESIS

text: Na bɛtsena Gosen asaase do, na bɛn me, ɔwo, nye wo mba, nye wo mbanananom, nye wo nguan, nye w’anantwi, nye dza ewɔ nyinara:
title: GENESIS

text: na mobɔhwɛ wo wɔ hɔ; na aka ɔkɔm mfe enum so; bɛyɛ na ehia, ɔwo, nye wo fidua, nye dza ewɔ nyinara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hwɛ, hom enyiwa tua, na mo nua Benjamin so n’enyiwa tua, dɛ m’ano na ɔrekasa kyerɛ hom yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hom nkɛka m’enyimnyam a mowɔ no wɔ Egypt nyinara no ho asɛm nkyerɛ m’egya, na dza hom ehu no nyinara; na hom nyɛ ntsɛm nkɛfa m’egya mbra ha.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaar no nua Benjamin no kɔn, na osui; na Benjamin so sui wɔ no kɔn ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔfefeew no nuanom nyinara hɔn ano, na ɔdzedze hɔn mu sui: na n’ekyir no no nuanom no nye no kasae.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔtsee nka wɔ Farao fie dɛ, Josef no nuanom aba: na Farao nye no nkowaa enyi gyee papa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao see Josef dɛ, Se wo nuanom no dɛ, Iyi na hom nyɛ: hom mfa ndzɛmba nsoasoa hom mbowa no, na hom nkɔ, hom nsan nkɔ Keenan asaase do;
title: GENESIS

text: na hom nkɛfa hom egya nye hom fifo, na hom mbra me nkyɛn: na mebɛma hom Egypt asaase no mu dza oye, na hom bedzi asaase no do ndzepa.
title: GENESIS

text: Afei se hɔn dɛ, iyi na hom nyɛ; hom mfa ntseaseanam wɔ Egypt asaase do nkɛfa hom mbofraba, nye hom yernom na hom egya ma wɔmbra.
title: GENESIS

text: Eso mma hom mma hom ndzɛmba ho nnhia hom; na dza oye wɔ Egypt asaase do nyinara yɛ homdze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel ne mba no yɛɛ dɛm: na Josef maa hɔn ntseaseanam, dɛ mbrɛ Farao hyɛe no ara, na ɔmaa hɔn kwan mu edziban.
title: GENESIS

text: Ɔmaa hɔn nyinara ntar nsakyerho nkorkor; na Benjamin dze, ɔmaa no ndwetɛbona ahaasa, nye ntar nsakyerho enum.
title: GENESIS

text: Na dza ɔdze kɛmaa n’egya nye yi; nsoasopɔnkɔ du a wɔsoso Egypt ndzɛmba pa, nye nsoasopɔnkɔber du a wɔsoso eburow, nye boodoo, nye edzidzidze a n’egya bedzi no wɔ kwan mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna ogyaa no nuanom no kwan, na wosii mu na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ mma hom aannka yaw wɔ kwan mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wofii Egypt kɔree, na wɔbaa hɔn egya Jakob nkyɛn wɔ Keenan asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Josef da ho tse ase, na ɔno nye Egypt asaase nyinara do panyin. Na bobor boor no, osiandɛ ɔanngye hɔn enndzi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔkaa Josef ne nsɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no nyinara kyerɛɛ no: na aber a ohun ntseaseanam a Josef maa wɔdze kɔree dɛ wɔmfa nkɛfa no no, nna hɔn egya Jakob n’akoma tɔɔ ne yamu:
title: GENESIS

text: na Israel see dɛ, ɔdɔɔ so ma me; me ba Josef da ho tse ase: mobɔkɔ mekohu no ana mewu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel faa dza ɔwɔ nyinara sii mu, na ɔbaa Beer-seba, na ɔbɔɔ afɔr maa n’egya Isaak ne Nyankopɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ Israel wɔ anafua nyikyerɛ mu, na ɔfrɛɛ no, Jakob, Jakob, na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye yi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye Nyankopɔn, w’egya ne Nyankopɔn: mma nnsuro dɛ ebɔkɔ Egypt; na mebɛyɛ wo ɔman kɛse wɔ hɔ:
title: GENESIS

text: menye wo bɔkɔ Egypt; na medze wo efi hɔ aba bio so ampaara: na Josef dze n’abaw mu na ibowu ada.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob soɛree fii Beer-seba: na Israel ne mba no twuuw hɔn egya Jakob, nye hɔn mbofraba, nye hɔn yernom, wɔ ntseaseanam a Farao maa wɔdze baa dɛ wɔmfa mbɛfa no no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔfaa hɔn mbowa, nye hɔn ahodze a wonyaa no wɔ Keenan asaase do no, na wɔbaa Egypt, Jakob nye n’asefo nyinara a wɔka no ho:
title: GENESIS

text: ne mbabanyin, nye ne mbabanyin hɔn mbabanyin ka no ho, ne mbabaa nye ne mbabanyin hɔn mbabaa, nye n’asefo nyinara na wɔka no ho na ɔnye hɔn baa Egypt.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel ne mba a wɔbaa Egypt no hɔn edzin nye yi, Jakob nye ne mbabanyin: Jakob n’abakan Reuben.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Reuben ne mbabanyin; Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, nye Karmi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Simeon ne mbabanyin; Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar, nye Saul, Keenannyi ɔbaa bi ne ba no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Levi ne mbabanyin; Gerson, Kohat, nye Merari.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Juda ne mbabanyin; Er, Onan, Sela, Perez, nye Zera: mbom Er nye Onan dze, wowuu Keenan asaase do. Na Perez ne mbabanyin nye Hezron na Hamul.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Isakar ne mbabanyin; Tola, Puva, Iob, nye Simron.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Zebulun ne mbabanyin; Sered, Elon, nye Jaleel.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom nye Leah ne mbabanyin a ɔwoo hɔn maa Jakob wɔ Paddan-aram nye ne babaa Dina: ne mbabanyin nye ne mbabaa nyinara yɛ akra eduasa ebiasa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Gad ne mbabanyin; Zifion, Hagi, Suni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, nye Areli.
title: GENESIS

text: Aser ne mbabanyin; Imna, Isva, Isvi, Beria, nye hɔn akyerɛbaa Sera: na Beria ne mbabanyin; Heber, nye Malkiel.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom nye Zilpa a Laban dze no maa ne babaa Leah no ne mbabanyin, na woyinom na ɔwoo hɔn maa Jakob; wɔyɛ akra duesia.
title: GENESIS

text: Jakob ne yer Rahel ne mbabanyin; Josef nye Benjamin.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔwoo Manaasɛ nye Efraim wɔ Egypt asaase do maa Josef, On ɔsɔfo Potifera ne babaa Asenat woo hɔn maa no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Benjamin ne mbabanyin; Bela, Beker, Asbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Ros, Muppim, Huppim, nye Ard.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom nye Rahel ne mbabanyin a wɔwoo hɔn maa Jakob: hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ akra duanan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Dan ne babanyin nye Husim.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Naftali ne mbabanyin nye Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, nye Sillem.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom nye Bilha a Laban dze no maa ne babaa Rahel no ne mbabanyin na woyinom na ɔwoo hɔn maa Jakob: hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ akra esuon.
title: GENESIS

text: Akra a wɔnye Jakob kɔr Egypt a wofi n’asen mu nyinara, sɛ Jakob ne mbabanyin hɔn yernom nnka ho a, akra no nyinara yɛ eduosia esia.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef ne mbabanyin a wɔwoo hɔn maa no wɔ Egypt no wɔyɛ akra beenu: Jakob ne fie akra a wɔbaa Egypt no nyinara, wɔyɛ eduosuon.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔsomaa Juda ma odzii n’enyim kan kɔr Josef hɔ, ama oeebedzi n’enyim akyerɛ no Gosen kwan; na wɔbaa Gosen asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef yɛɛ ne tseaseanam krado, na ɔkɔree kehyiaa n’egya Israel kwan wɔ Gosen; na ɔdze noho kyerɛɛ no, na ɔbaar no kɔn, na osui wɔ no kɔn ho ara ma ɔkyɛɛr kakra.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel see Josef dɛ, Menya mehu dɛ eda ho ara etse ase yi dze, afei mutum kɔ me nsamankyir.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef see no nuanom, nye n’egya ne fifo dɛ, Morokɔ na makɛka akyerɛ Farao, na mase no dɛ, Mo nuanom, nye m’egya ne fifo a wɔwɔ Keenan asaase do no aba me nkyɛn:
title: GENESIS

text: na nkorɔfo no yɛ nguanhwɛfo, na mbowa na wɔnyɛn; na wɔdze hɔn nguan, nye hɔn anantwi, nye dza wɔwɔ nyinara aba.
title: GENESIS

text: Na sɛ Farao frɛ hom, na obisa dɛ, Wɔyɛ ebɛn edwuma a?
title: GENESIS

text: Ɔno hom nse dɛ, Ofitsi hɛn mbofra mu dze bɛpem ndɛ ara wo nkowaa mbowa ara na yɛnyɛn, hɛn, nye hɛn egyanom nyinara: ama hom aatsena Gosen asaase do; osiandɛ oguanhwɛfo biara yɛ ekyiwadze ma Egyptfo; wɔnye nguanhwɛfo nndzi afora.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef sii mu kɔr fie na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ Farao, na ɔsee dɛ, M’egya nye mo nuanom, hɔn nguan, hɔn anantwi, nye dza wɔwɔ nyinara, fi Keenan asaase do aba; na, wɔwɔ Gosen asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔfaa no nuanom no hɔn mu beenum, na ɔdze hɔn kɛkyerɛɛ Farao.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao bisaa no nuanom no dɛ, Wɔyɛ ebɛn edwuma? Na wɔsee Farao dɛ, Wo nkowaa yɛyɛ nguanhwɛfo, hɛn nye hɛn egyanom nyina.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsee Farao dɛ, Yɛaba dɛ yɛrebɛtsena asaase yi do; na wo nkowaa hɔn nguan nnya edzidzibea; osiandɛ ɔkɔm no mu ayɛ dzen wɔ Keenan asaase do: dɛm ntsi afei, yɛserɛ wo, ma wo nkowaa ntsena Gosen asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao kaa kyerɛɛ Josef dɛ, W’egya nye wo nuanom aba wo nkyɛn:
title: GENESIS

text: Egypt asaase da w’enyim; asaase no mu mbrɛ oye no na ma w’egya nye wo nuanom ntsena; ma wɔntsena Gosen asaase do: na sɛ inyim hɔn mu bi a wɔyɛ mbɔdzembɔfo a, ɔno yɛ hɔn mo mbowa do ahwɛfo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef dze n’egya Jakob bae begyinaa Farao n’enyim: na Jakob hyiraa Farao.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao bisaa Jakob dɛ, Wo nkwa nda mu mfe yɛ ahen?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob see Farao dɛ, M’akwantu ne mfe nda yɛ mfe ɔha eduasa: mo nkwa ne mfe nda kumaabi na mbusu nko, na ɔnntoo m’egyanom hɔn nkwa ne mfe nda wɔ hɔn akwantu ber no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob hyiraa Farao, na ofii Farao n’enyim kɔree.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef maa n’egya nye no nuanom no tsenabew, na ɔmaa hɔn beebi wɔ Egypt asaase do, wɔ asaase no do mbrɛ oye, wɔ Rameses asaase do, dɛ mbrɛ Farao hyɛe no ara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef bɔɔ n’egya, nye no nuanom, nye n’egya ne fifo nyinara akɔhoma, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna edziban nnyi asaase no do beebiara; na ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen dodoodow, ma Egypt asaase nye Keenan asaase tɔɔ bitsi wɔ ɔkɔm no ntsi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef boaboaa sika a wonyaa no Egypt asaase do, nye Keenan asaase do no, eburow a wɔtɔe no ne sika no nyinara ano: na Josef dze sika no baa Farao fie.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a nkorɔfo ho sika nyinara sae wɔ Egypt nye Keenan asaase do no, Egyptfo no nyinara baa Josef hɔ, na wɔbɛsee dɛ, Ma hɛn edziban: na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn ntsi na yebowuwu wɔ w’enyim? Hɛn ho sika asa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef see dɛ, sɛ hom ho sika asa a, hom mfa hom mbowa mma; na mebɛgye hom mbowa na mama hom bi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔdze hɔn mbowa brɛɛ Josef: na Josef maa hɔn edziban dze gyee mpɔnkɔ, nye nguan, nye anantwi, nye nsoasopɔnkɔ: na ɔmaa hɔn edziban dze gyee hɔn mbowa nyinara wɔ afe no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na afe no bɛsenee no, wɔbaa no hɔ afe a otsia ebien no, na wɔbɛsee no dɛ, Yɛnnkɛfa esuma mo wura dɛ, hɛn sika nyinara asa; na hɛn mbowa nyinara yɛ mo wura dze; biribiara nnyi hɔ a ɔaka wɔ mo wura n’enyim, ka hɛn honam nye hɛn asaase ho;
title: GENESIS

text: ebɛnadze ntsi na yebowu w’enyim, hɛn nye hɛn asaase nyina? Fa edziban tɔ hɛn nye hɛn asaase, na hɛn nye hɛn asaase bɛyɛ asomfo ama Farao: na ma hɛn eduaba, ama yaatsena ase, na yeennwuwu, na amma asaase yi aannda pan.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Josef tɔɔ Egypt asaase nyinara maa Farao; na Egyptfo nyinara tontɔɔn hɔn haban, osiandɛ ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ hɔn do: na asaase no bɛyɛɛ Farao dze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nkorɔfo no dze, ɔdaan hɔn nkowaa otuu hɔn hɔ ma wɔkɛtsenatsenaa nkurow a ofi Egypt ɔhe no kurotsia kɛpem ne kurotsia no mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Asɔfo no hɔn asaase nko na ɔanntɔ: osiandɛ Farao maa asɔfo no kyɛfa bi, na wodzii hɔn kyɛfa a Farao dze maa hɔn no; dɛm ntsi wɔanntɔn hɔn asaase.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna Josef see nkorɔfo no dɛ, Hwɛ matɔ hom nye hom asaase ndɛ ama Farao: hwɛ, hom eduaba nye yi, na hom nkoduadua no wɔ asaase no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na dza ɔbɛyɛ nye dɛ, hom dze ekuadze yi mu mbumu enum enum bɛma Farao, na anan no ayɛ homankasa homdze, ma wɔdze bi edua haban mu, na ɔayɛ hom, nye hom fifo nye hom mbofraba edziban.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Agye hɛn nkwa: ma yennya mo wura n’enyim enyimnyam, na yɛbɛyɛ Farao n’asomfo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef dze yɛɛ mbra too hɔ wɔ Egypt asaase do ɔdze bɛpem ndɛ ara, dɛ wɔmfa mbumu enum enum mma Farao; gyedɛ asɔfo no hɔn asaase nkotsee na annyɛ Farao dze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel tsenaa Egypt wɔ Gosen asaase do; na wonyaa egyapadze wɔ hɔ, na wɔwowoe, na wɔdɔɔr pii.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob tsenaa Egypt asaase do mfe duesuon: na Jakob ne nda, no nkwa ne mfe, yɛɛ mfe ɔha eduanan esuon.
title: GENESIS

text: Na mber a Israel dze bowu no bɛnee no: ɔfrɛɛ ne ba Josef, na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ afei menya w’enyim enyimnyam a, meserɛ wo, fa wo nsa to m’aserɛ ase, na enye me ndzi no ayamuyie mu nye nokwar mu; meserɛ wo, mma nnsie me wɔ Egypt:
title: GENESIS

text: na sɛ mokɔ me nsamankyir a, ɔno soa me fi Egypt, na kesie me wɔ m’egyanom hɔn esiei. Na ɔsee dɛ, Mebɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ aka no ara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob see dɛ, Dzi nsew kyerɛ me: nna Josef dzii nsew kyerɛɛ no. Na Israel bɔɔ no mu adze wɔ mpa no n’etsifi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no, wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Josef dɛ, Hwɛ, w’egya yar: na ɔfaa ne mbabanyin beenu no, Manaasɛ nye Efraim kaa no ho.
title: GENESIS

text: Na obi kaa kyerɛɛ Jakob dɛ, Hwɛ, wo ba Josef reba wo nkyɛn: na Israel miaa n’enyi, na ɔtsenaa mpa do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob see Josef dɛ, Otumfo Nyankopɔn yii noho kyerɛɛ me wɔ Luz wɔ Keenan asaase do, na ohyiraa me,
title: GENESIS

text: na ɔsee me dɛ, Hwɛ, mebɛma awo, na adɔr, na mebɛyɛ wo aman asafo; na medze asaase yi ama w’asefo a wobedzi w’ekyir ma wɔdze ayɛ daa egyapadze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na afei wo mba beenu a ewoo hɔn wɔ Egypt asaase do ansaana mereba wo nkyɛn wɔ Egypt no, wɔyɛ medze; Efraim nye Manaasɛ, bɛyɛ medze, dɛ Reuben nye Simeon ara so.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wo mba a hɔn ekyir ebɔwo hɔn no, na wɔbɛyɛ wodze; wɔdze hɔn nuanom dzin bɛfrɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn egyapadze mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na emi dze, mifi Paddan mebae no, Rahel wuu m’enyim wɔ kwan mu wɔ Keenan asaase do, aber a aka ɔkwan kakraabi ma edu Efrat no: na misiee no Efrat kwan mu hɔ (ɔnoara nye Bɛtlɛhɛm).
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel hun Josef ne mba no, na ɔsee dɛ, Woananom nye yi?
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef see n’egya dɛ, me mba a Nyankopɔn dze hɔn ama me wɔ ha a. Na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ wo, fa hɔn brɛ me, ma minhyira hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Nna onyin dodow ntsi Israel n’enyiwa do ayɛ no nkusunkusu, ma onntum nnhu adze. Na Josef dze hɔn piin ne nkyɛn; na Israel feew hɔn ano, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn etuu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel see Josef dɛ, Manndwen dɛ nkyɛ mubohu w’enyim: na hwɛ, Nyankopɔn ama mehu wo mba so.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef yii hɔn wɔ n’anan ntamu bae; na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze dze n’enyim boom famu.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef faa hɔn beenu nyina, ne nsa enyimfa dze Efraim mu wɔ Israel n’abankum, na ne nsa abankum dze Manaasɛ mu wɔ Israel n’enyimfa, na ɔdze hɔn piin ne nkyɛn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel tseen ne nsa enyimfa, na ɔdze too Efraim a ɔyɛ kakraba no n’etsifi, na ɔdze ne nsa abankum too Manaasɛ n’etsifi, ɔboapa ara yɛɛ ne nsa dɛm; osiandɛ Manaasɛ nye abakan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ohyiraa Josef, na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn no a m’egyanom Abraham nye Isaak wɔnantseew n’enyim no, Nyankopɔn no a ɔahwɛ me mo nkwaber nyinara mu ma ɔdze abɛpem ndɛ no,
title: GENESIS

text: sor abɔfo no a oeyi me efi mbusu nyinara mu no, onhyira mbofra yi: na wɔmma wɔmfa me dzin nye m’egyanom Abraham nye Isaak hɔn dzin mfrɛ hɔn; na wɔmma wonnyin wɔnyɛ ɔdodow wɔ asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na aber a Josef hun dɛ n’egya dze ne nsa enyimfa ato Efraim n’etsifi no, ɔannyɛ no abodwe: na osuoo n’egya ne nsa mu dɛ oriyi wɔ Efraim n’etsifi ato Manaasɛ n’etsifi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef see n’egya dɛ, ɔnntse dɛm, m’egya: na abakan no nye yi; fa wo nsa enyimfa to n’etsifi.
title: GENESIS

text: Na n’egya ammpen, na ɔsee dɛ, Minyim, me ba, minyim: ɔno so bɛyɛ ɔman, na ɔno so bɛyɛ kɛse: naaso no nua kuma bɛyɛ kɛse asen no, na n’asefo bɛyɛ amanaman pii.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ohyiraa hɔn da no see dɛ, ɔwo na Israel dze wo behyira dɛ, Nyankopɔn mma yɛ dɛ Efraim nye dɛ Manaasɛ: na ɔdze Efraim dzii Manaasɛ ne kan.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel see Josef dɛ, Hwɛ, muruwu: na Nyankopɔn bedzi hom ekyir, na ɔdze hom akɔ hom egyanom hɔn asaase do bio.
title: GENESIS

text: Nkyii so medze kyɛpɛn kor a ɔbor wo nuanom do a medze m’afona nye m’egyen megyee no wɔ Amorifo nsamu no ama wo.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob frɛɛ ne mbabanyin, na ɔsee dɛ: Hom mboa hom ano, na menka dza ndaamba ɔbɛba hom do nkyerɛ hom.
title: GENESIS

text: Hom nhyia, na wontsie, hom Jakob mba; Na wontsie hom egya Israel.
title: GENESIS

text: Reuben, ɔwo nye m’abakan, mo tum, nye m’ahoɔdzen ahyɛse; Nyia ɔkyɛn wɔ enyidzi mu na nyia ɔkyɛn wɔ tum mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Ihihim dɛ nsu, ennkɛkyɛn; Osiandɛ efoow w’egya ne mpa: Nna iguu ho fi: efoow m’adae.
title: GENESIS

text: Simeon nye Levi wɔyɛ enuanom; Hɔn mfona yɛ enyiber akodze.
title: GENESIS

text: Ao me kra, mma mmba hɔn apam mu; M’enyimnyam, mma mmfora hɔn mboano mu; Osiandɛ hɔn ebufuw mu na wokum nyimpa, Na hɔn ahopɔw mu na wotwitwaa nantwi anantsir.
title: GENESIS

text: Ndom nka hɔn ebufuw, osiandɛ ɔyɛ hyew; Na hɔn enyiber, osiandɛ no mu yɛ dzen: Mebɛpaapaa hɔn mu wɔ Jakob mu, Na mabɔ hɔn apetse wɔ Israel mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Juda, ɔwo na wo nuanom beyi wo ayɛw: Wo nsa bɛhyɛ w’atamfo hɔn kɔn do; W’egya mba bɔbɔ hɔn mu adze wɔ w’enyim.
title: GENESIS

text: Juda yɛ ogyata ba; Abɔgyanam ara na edze enyin, me ba: ɔkotowee, obutuuw hɔ dɛ ogyata, Na dɛ ogyataber; woana na obekenyan no?
title: GENESIS

text: Ahempoma nnkefi Juda nsa, Nna mbrahyɛfo poma nnkefi n’anan ntamu, Kɛpem dɛ Siloh bɛba; Na ɔno na aman bɛyɛ setsie ama no.
title: GENESIS

text: Ɔdze n’asoasopɔnkɔba amontan wenyindua, Na n’asoasopɔnkɔber ba wɔ wenyindua pa ho; ɔahor ne ntar wɔ wenyin mu, Na n’akataho wɔ wenyinamba bɔgya mu:
title: GENESIS

text: N’enyiwa yɛ dɛnn sen nsa memen, Na numfonsu ama ne se ho ahoa fitaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Zebulun bɛtsena po berekyir: Na ɔbɛyɛ mbrɛ ahɛn gyinagyina; Na ɔnye Zidon bɔbɔ ɔhe.
title: GENESIS

text: Isakar yɛ asoaso a no ho yɛ dzen, Obutuuw nguamban ntamu:
title: GENESIS

text: Na ohun ahomgye bea dɛ oye, Na asaase no dɛ ɔyɛ fɛw; Na ɔbrɛɛ n’abatsir adze dze soae, Na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔsomfo wɔ edwumadzen mu.
title: GENESIS

text: Dan bobua no nkorɔfo atsɛn, Dɛ Israel mbusuakuw mu kor.
title: GENESIS

text: Dan bɛyɛ ɔwɔ a ɔbew kwan mu, Ehurutsia a ɔda akwantsen, ɔsɔw ɔpɔnkɔ nantsir, na no do atsefo no obu dua n’ekyir.
title: GENESIS

text: EWURADZE, matweɔn wo nkwahosan.
title: GENESIS

text: Gad, dɔm bɛhyɛ no do: Na ɔno so bɛhyɛ hɔn etsia hɔn anantsir.
title: GENESIS

text: Aser n’edziban fi no mu bɔtɔ angoa, Na ɔbɛma ahemfo adɔkɔdɔkɔdze.
title: GENESIS

text: Naftali yɛ ɔtrɔmber a woegyaa no: ɔka ahomkasɛm.
title: GENESIS

text: Josef yɛ dua a ɔsow, Abaw a ɔsow wɔ nsunyiwa ho; No nkorbata tratra ban.
title: GENESIS

text: Egyentofo no eyi no awerɛhow kɛsenara, Na wɔatotow no, na wɔayɛ no enyienyi:
title: GENESIS

text: Na n’egyen dze ɔwɔ hɔ pintsinn, Na ne nsa n’abasa no mu yɛ dzen, ɔnam Jakob no Tumfo Kor no ne nsa do, Hɔ na oguanhwɛfo no, Israel no bo no ofi.
title: GENESIS

text: Mekyerɛ w’egya ne Nyankopɔn a ɔbɔboa wo no, Na Otumfo a ɔdze ɔsor nhyira, Bun a ɔda daadzetsirmu ne nhyira, Enumfo mu, nye yafun mu nhyira, Behyira wo no,
title: GENESIS

text: W’egya ne nhyira Akyɛn daa mbepɔw ne nhyira ɔdze kodu tsetse mbepɔw no n’ano no ho ara: ɔbɛtsena Josef n’etsifi, Nyia wɔtseew no fii no nuanom ho no n’etsifi pampamu.
title: GENESIS

text: Benjamin yɛ pataku a ɔtsetsew mbowa mu: Obedzi abɔgyanam anapa, Na ewimbir no ɔakyɛ asadze.
title: GENESIS

text: Woyinom nyinara nye Israel mbusuakuw duebien no: na iyi na hɔn egya kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn na ɔdze hyiraa hɔn no; hɔn nyinara mbrɛ hɔn nhyira tsetsee nkorkor, na ohyiraa hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob hyɛɛ hɔn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, ɔwɔ dɛ wɔdze me kɛka mo nkorɔfo ho: wonsie me m’egyanom nkyɛn wɔ ɔbo tu a ɔwɔ Efron Hetnyi no, ne haban mu no mu,
title: GENESIS

text: wɔ ɔbo tu a ɔwɔ Makepela haban mu no a, ɔwɔ Mamre enyim, wɔ Keenan asaase do no a Abraham dze kaa haban no ho tɔɔ no wɔ Hetnyi Efron hɔ, dze yɛɛ efunsiebea no no mu:
title: GENESIS

text: hɔ na wosiee Abraham nye ne yer Sara; hɔ na wosiee Isaak nye ne yer Rebeka; na hɔ na misiee Leah:
title: GENESIS

text: haban no nye ɔbo tu a ɔwɔ mu no a wɔtɔɔ no wɔ Hetmba hɔ no a.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Jakob wiee ne nsamansew a ɔhyɛɛ ne mba no ara, nna ɔkaa n’anan boaa ano dze guu mpa no do, na ogyaa no sunsum mu, na otsiiw n’egyanom wɔ samanadze.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef twae hwee n’egya n’enyim, na osui guu no do, na ɔfeew n’ano.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef hyɛɛ no nkowaa a wɔhyɛ fun edur no dɛ wɔnhyɛ n’egya akyenkyendur: na wɔhyɛɛ Israel akyenkyendur.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔdze adaduanan dzii ho dwuma: nna mber a wɔdze wie akyenkyendur hyɛ nye no: na Egyptfo no suu no nda eduosuon.
title: GENESIS

text: Na nda a wɔdze suu no no twaa mu no, Josef kaa kyerɛɛ Farao ne fifo, dɛ, Sɛ afei menya hom enyim enyimnyam a, meserɛ hom, wɔnka no wɔ Farao n’asomu, dɛ,
title: GENESIS

text: M’egya maa midzii nsew dɛ, Hwɛ, muruwu: na nda a mabɔ ama moho wɔ Keenan asaase do no mu hɔ na kesie me. Dɛm ntsi, afei meserɛ wo, ma monkɔ, na minkesie m’egya, na membra bio.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Farao see dɛ, Kɔ, na kesie w’egya, dɛ mbrɛ ɔmaa idzii nsew no ara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef kɔree dɛ orikesie n’egya: na Farao no nkowaa nyinara, ne fie mpanyimfo, nye Egypt asaase do mpanyimfo nyinara,
title: GENESIS

text: nye Josef ne fifo nyinara, nye no nuanom, nye n’egya ne fifo, nyinara nye no kɔree. Hɔn mbofraba, nye hɔn nguan, nye hɔn anantwi, nko na wɔdaan hɔn gyaa Gosen asaase do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ntseaseanam nye mpɔnkɔdofo nyina nye no kɔree: na ɔyɛɛ kuw kɛsenara.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔbaa Atad ewuporoweebea a ɔwɔ Jordan egya no, na hɔ na wotwaa kwadwom kɛse a no mu yɛ dzen papanara: na Josef suu n’egya nda esuon.
title: GENESIS

text: Na hɔn a wɔtse asaase no do no, Keenanfo no, hun osu a wosuu no wɔ Atad ewuporoweebea no, wɔsee dɛ, Iyi yɛ eyi kɛse ma Egyptfo: dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Abel-mizraim a ɔwɔ Jordan egya.
title: GENESIS

text: Na ne mba yɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyɛɛ hɔn no ara:
title: GENESIS

text: na ne mba soaa no kɔr Keenan asaase do, na wokesiee no wɔ Makepela haban mu ɔbo tu no mu, dza Abraham dze kaa haban no ho tɔɔ no wɔ Hetnyi Efron hɔ, dze yɛɛ efunsiebea wɔ Mamre enyim no a.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef siee n’egya wiei ekyir no, ɔnoara nye no nuanom no, nye hɔn a wɔnye no kɔree kesiee n’egya no nyinara sanee kɔr Egypt.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef no nuanom no hun dɛ hɔn egya ewu no, wɔsee dɛ, Bɛyɛ na Josef atan hɛn, na bɔn a yɛdze yɛɛ no no nyinara oesusu mbrɛ ɔtse no ara atɔ hɛn do wer.
title: GENESIS

text: Na wɔsomae ma wɔkɛsee Josef dɛ, Ansaana w’egya ruwu no ɔhyɛɛ dɛ,
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm na hom nka nkyerɛ Josef, Afei meserɛ wo, fa wo nuanom hɔn mbrato, nye hɔn bɔn kyɛ hɔn, dɛ wɔyɛɛ wo bɔn: na afei yɛserɛ wo, fa w’egya ne Nyankopɔn no nkowaa hɔn bɔn kyɛ hɔn. Na Josef sui wɔ aber a wɔkaa dɛm kyerɛɛ no no.
title: GENESIS

text: Na no nuanom no so kɔree, na wokotwitwae hwehwee n’enyim; na wɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, yɛyɛ wo nkowaa.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef see hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro: ana migyina Nyankopɔn ananmu a?
title: GENESIS

text: Hom dze, hom dween dɛ wɔreyɛ me bɔn; na Nyankopɔn dze ɔdween dɛ oye, ma ɔaayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ndɛ ɔayɛ yi, ma wɔaagye nkorɔfo piinara nkwa.
title: GENESIS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, mma hom nnsuro: mobɔhwɛ hom, nye hom mbofraba. Na ɔkaa hɔn akoma too hɔn yamu, na ɔkasaa ayamuyie mu kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef tsenaa Egypt, ɔnoara nye n’egya ne fifo: na Josef dzii mfe ɔha nye du.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef hun Efraim ne mbanana a otsia ebiasa: Manaasɛ ne babanyin Makir ne mba so wɔwoo hɔn guu Josef n’aserɛ do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef see no nuanom no dɛ, Morobɔkɔ me nsamankyir: na ampaara Nyankopɔn bɛba abɛsera hom, na oebeyi hom efi asaase yi do akɔ asaase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ Abraham, Isaak nye Jakob no no do.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef maa Israelmba dzii nsew dɛ, Ampaara, Nyankopɔn bɛba abɛsera hom, na hom nsoa me mbiew mfi ha nkɔ.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Josef wui, nna oedzi mfe ɔha nye du: na wɔhyɛɛ no akyenkyendur, na wɔtoo no adaka mu wɔ Egypt.
title: GENESIS

text: Na Israel mbabanyin a wɔbaa Egypt no hɔn edzin nye yi; ɔbanyin biara nye ne fifo kaa Jakob ho bae.
title: EXODUS

text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, nye Juda;
title: EXODUS

text: Isakar, Zebulun, nye Benjamin;
title: EXODUS

text: Dan nye Naftali, Gad nye Aser.
title: EXODUS

text: Na akra a wofi Jakob n’asen mu nyinara yɛ eduosuon: nna Josef wɔ Egypt dada.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Josef, nye no nuanom nyinara, nye ebusuasantsen no nyinara, wuwui.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba no wowoe, na wɔdɔɔr menyamenya, na hɔn dodow dɔɔ so, na hɔn ho yɛɛ dzen papaara; na wɔhyɛɛ asaase no do ma.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔhen fofor bi soɛree wɔ Egypt a nna onnyim Josef.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ ne man dɛ, Hwɛ, Israelmba no dɔɔ so, na hɔn ho yɛ dzen sen hɛn:
title: EXODUS

text: hom mbra ma yɛnye hɔn ndzi no nyansa mu, amma wɔaanndɔɔ so, na aammba dɛ sɛ ɔsa bi ba a, wɔaannkɛka hɛn atamfo ho nye hɛn ammbɔko, na woeenntu emmfi asaase yi do annkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔhyehyɛɛ abɔmbaafo wɔ hɔn do dɛ wɔmma hɔn ndzesoadze nhyɛ hɔn do. Na wɔkyekyeer adzekora nkurow, Pitom nye Raamses, maa Farao.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mber dodow a wɔtseetsee hɔn kɛse no mbom na wɔdɔɔr kɛse na wɔtrɛe. Na Israelmba ho nketsenketse kyeer hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Egyptfo yɛɛ Israelmba ma wodzii suhia:
title: EXODUS

text: na wɔmaa hɔn asetsena foon hɔn wɔ ndwumadzen mu, wɔ dɛtse nye ntayaa, nye hamudwuma ahorow nyinara mu. Na wɔmaa wodzii suhia wɔ hɔn som nyinara mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Egypthen no kasaa kyerɛɛ Hebriwfo awogyefo a hɔn mu kor ne dzin dze Sifra, na ɔbaako so ne dzin dze Pua no:
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ hom regye Hebriwfo mbaa no awoo, na hom hu wɔ awoo egua no do dɛ ɔyɛ ɔbanyin a, ɔno hom nku no; na sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbabaa a, ɔno ɔntsena ase.
title: EXODUS

text: Na awogyefo no suroo Nyankopɔn, na wɔannyɛ dɛ mbrɛ Egypthen no hyɛɛ hɔn no, na mbom wɔgyee mbanyimba no nkwa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Egypthen no frɛɛ awogyefo no, na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ayɛ dɛm adze yi, na hom agye mba mbanyimba no nkwa yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Na awogyefo no see Farao dɛ, Osiandɛ Hebriwfo mbaa no wɔnntse dɛ Egyptfo mbaa; na hɔn dze, wɔyɛ pirim pirim, na awogyefo nnyae nndur hɔn nkyɛn mpo nna wɔawo dada.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Nyankopɔn nye awogyefo no dzii no yie: na nkorɔfo no hɔn dodow dɔɔ so, na hɔn ho yɛɛ dzen pii.
title: EXODUS

text: Na osiandɛ, awogyefo no suroo Nyankopɔn ntsi, ɔkyekyeer efi maa hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao hyɛɛ no nkorɔfo nyinara dɛ, Ɔbabanyin biara a wɔbɔwo no no, hom nkɔtow no nkyen esutsen no mu, na ɔbabaa biara dze, hom mma ɔntsena ase.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbanyin bi fi Levi fie kɔwaar Levi babaa bi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa no nyinsenii, na ɔwoo ɔbabanyin: na ohun dɛ ɔyɛ abofra a no ho yɛ fɛw no, ɔdze no sumaa abosoom ebiasa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze no suma bio a ɔnnyɛ yie no, ɔfaa mbɛw adakaba, na ɔdze hua na aman seraam ho: na ɔdze abofra no too mu, na ɔdze kesii atsen no mu wɔ esutsen no no nkɔkɔnoa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na n’akyerɛbaa gyinaa ekyirekyir, dɛ ɔrohwɛ dza ɔbɛyɛ no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao ne babaa sianee baa esutsen no ho dɛ oruboguar; na ne mbaawa pasaar esutsen no nkyɛn. Ber a ohun adaka no wɔ atsen no mu no, ɔsomaa n’abaawa dɛ ɔnkɛfa mbra.
title: EXODUS

text: Na obuee do, na ohun abofra no: na, hwɛ, akɔkowaba no sui. Na ohun no mbɔbɔr, na ɔsee dɛ, Hebriwfo mba no kor nye yi.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna abofra no n’akyerɛbaa no bisaa Farao babaa no dɛ, Ana monkɔ nkɛfrɛ Hebriwfo mbaa no mu onufomafo mbrɛ wo, ma ɔmma abofra no enumfo mma wo anaa?
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao ne babaa no see no dɛ, Kɔ. Na akataasia no kɔree kɛfrɛɛ abofra no ne na.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao ne babaa no see no dɛ, Fa abofra yi kɔ, na kɛma no enumfo ma me, na medze w’akatua bɛma wo. Na ɔbaa no faa abofra no, na ɔkɛmaa no enumfo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na abofra no nyinii, na ɔdze no brɛɛ Farao ne babaa no, na ɔbɛyɛɛ ne babanyin. Na ɔtoo no dzin Moses, na ɔsee dɛ, Osiandɛ mefaa no nsu mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu no, aber a Moses nyinii no, ofiir edzi kɔr no nuanom nkyɛn, na ɔkɔhwɛɛ hɔn ndzesoadze. Ohun dɛ Egyptnyi bi robor Hebriwnyi bi, no nuanom mu baako.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔhwɛɛ ha hwɛɛ ha, na ohun dɛ nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ no, ɔbɔɔ Egyptnyi no kum no, na ɔdze no hyɛɛ anhwea mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na n’adzekyee no ofiir edzi, na, hwɛ, Hebriwfo beenu roko: na obisaa nyia odzi fɔ no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ebɔ wo nyɛnko yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Na obuaa no dɛ, Woana yɛɛ wo ɔpanyin nye ɔsɛndzifo wɔ hɛn do? Edwen dɛ iruboku me dɛ mbrɛ ikum Egyptnyi no anaa? Na Moses suroi, na ɔsee dɛ, Ampaara asɛm no epue.
title: EXODUS

text: Ber a Farao tsee asɛm yi no, ɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ oboku Moses. Na Moses guanee fii Farao enyim, na ɔkɛtsenaa Midian asaase do: na ɔkɔkoo nsubura bi ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna Midian ɔsɔfo no wɔ mbabaa beesuon; na wɔbae bɔtoow nsu, na wɔdze hyehyɛɛ ndaasee no amaama dɛ wɔrema hɔn egya no nguan anom.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nguanhwɛfo bi bae beyii hɔn edzi: na Moses soɛree boaa hɔn, na ɔmaa hɔn nguan no nomee.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔbaa hɔn egya Reuel nkyɛn no, obisaa hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na ndɛ hom aba ntsɛm dɛm yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Egyptnyi bi na oyii hɛn fii nguanhwɛfo no nsamu, na ɔtoow nsu mpo maa hɛn, na ɔmaa nguan no nomee.
title: EXODUS

text: Na obisaa ne mbabaa no dɛ, Na ɔwɔ hen? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom adan ɔbanyin no egya yi? Wɔnkɛfrɛ no ma ombedzidzi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses peen dɛ ɔnye ɔbanyin no bɛtsena: na ɔpanyin no dze ne babaa Zipora maa Moses awar.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔwoo ɔbabanyin, na ɔtoo no dzin Gersom: na ɔsee dɛ, Osiandɛ mayɛ ɔmamforanyi wɔ ananaben asaase do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda pii guu mu no, Egypthen no wui: na nkowaasom no ntsi Israelmba pempenee, na wosui, na hɔn su fowee kɔr Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Nyankopɔn tsee hɔn nkrumsi, na Nyankopɔn kaa n’ahyɛmu a ɔnye Abraham, Isaak, na Jakob dzii no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Nyankopɔn hwɛɛ Israelmba no, na ohun hɔn haw.
title: EXODUS

text: Dabi a nna Moses rohwɛ n’asew Jetro, Midian ɔsɔfo no, no nguan no, ɔkaa hɔn kɔr sar no ekyir noho, na odur Nyankopɔn bepɔw Horeb ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE bɔfoe beyii noho edzi kyerɛɛ no wɔ haban bi finimfin gyaframee mu: na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, haban no redzɛw ogya, naaso haban no nnhyew.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Iyi dze, mebɛman akɔhwɛ adzehu kɛse yi, siantsir a haban no nnhyew.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE hun dɛ ɔaman rohwɛ no, Nyankopɔn fii haban no mu frɛɛ no, na ɔsee dɛ, Moses, Moses. Na ɔgyee do dɛ, Emi nye yi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Mma nntwe mmpin ha: yiyi w’ananadze mpaboa no, na bea a igyina do no yɛ asaase krɔnkrɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Nkyii so ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye w’egyanom, Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob Nyankopɔn no. Na Moses dze n’enyim sumae; osiandɛ osuroo dɛ ɔbɔhwɛ Nyankopɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Ampaara mehu me man a wɔwɔ Egypt hɔn amandzehu, na matse hɔn su a hɔn abɔmbaafo no ntsi wosu no; na minyim hɔn awerɛhow ntsi;
title: EXODUS

text: na mesian dɛ miribeyi hɔn wɔ Egyptfo nsamu, na metutu hɔn mefi asaase no do makɔ asaase pa a ɔso do, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do; Keenanfo, Hitifo, Amorifo, Perizfo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo hɔn tsenabew no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na afei, hwɛ, Israel hɔn su edu m’enyim: nkyii so mehu ɔhaw a Egyptfo dze haw hɔn no.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei bra, na morosoma wo Farao hɔ, ma eekeyi me man Israelmba no efi Egypt efir.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see Nyankopɔn dɛ, Woana nye emi, na maakɔ Farao nkyɛn ekeyi Israelmba efi Egypt efir?
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ampaara mibedzi w’ekyir; na iyi bɛyɛ wo asɛnkyerɛdze dɛ mara na masoma wo. Na sɛ inya yi ɔman no fi Egypt ba a, hom bɔsom Nyankopɔn wɔ bepɔw yi do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see Nyankopɔn dɛ, Hwɛ, sɛ mudu Israelmba nkyɛn, na mese hɔn dɛ, Hom egyanom Nyankopɔn na ɔasoma me hom hɔ; na wobisa me dɛ, Ne dzin dze dɛn a, menka dɛn menkyerɛ hɔn?
title: EXODUS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see Moses dɛ, MARA NYE MARA NO: na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛm na ka kyerɛ Israelmba, MARA no na ɔasoma me hom hɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nkyii so Nyankopɔn see Moses dɛ, Dɛm na ka kyerɛ Israelmba, EWURADZE, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn no, Abraham Nyankopɔn, Isaak Nyankopɔn, nye Jakob Nyankopɔn no, na ɔasoma me hom hɔ: iyi nye me dzin daa, na iyi nye me nkaadze kɔ ebusuasantsen nyinara mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Kɔ, na kɔboa Israel mpanyimfo ano, na ka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, EWURADZE, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn no, Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob Nyankopɔn no, eyi noho akyerɛ me, dɛ, Ɔsera na mabɛsera hom, na mehu dza wɔdze reyɛ hom wɔ Egypt no:
title: EXODUS

text: na mase dɛ, Mibeyi hom efi Egypt amandzehu no mu akɔ Keenanfo, Hitifo, Amorifo, Perizfo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo asaase do, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wobetsie wo ndze: na ɔwo, nye Israel mpanyimfo nkɔ Egypthen no nkyɛn, na hom nse no dɛ, EWURADZE, Hebriwfo Nyankopɔn no, nye hɛn ehyia mu: na afei yɛserɛ wo, ma yɛnkɔ sar do ndaansa kwan nkɔbɔ afɔr mma EWURADZE, hɛn Nyankopɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na minyim dɛ Egypthen remma hom kwan ma wɔnnkɔ, mpo, nnyɛ nsa a ɔyɛ dzen do a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mebɛtsen me nsa, na medze anwanwadze a mebɛyɛ wɔ no mu hɔ no mabɔ Egypt: na ɔno n’ekyir na ɔbɛma hom akɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mebɛma ɔman yi enyim aba nyam wɔ Egyptfo enyim: na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ hom rokɔ a, hom nnkɔkɔ no nsapan:
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔbaa biara bebisa ne fisamenanyi, na ne fie ɔmamforanyi dwetɛ edwindze, nye sika edwindze, nye atam: na hom dze ahyehyɛ hom mbabanyin nye hom mbabaa; na hom bɛfa Egyptfo no afo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses buae see dɛ, hwɛ, wɔnnkɛgye me edzi, eso wonketsie me ndze: na wɔbɛka dɛ, EWURADZE nnyii noho nnkyerɛɛ wo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE bisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔdze wo nsamu no? Na ɔsee dɛ, Poma a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Tow kyen famu. Na ɔtowee kyeen famu, na ɔdaan abowatsena; na Moses fii n’enyim guanee.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Tsen wo nsa, na suo no dua mu: (na ɔtseen ne nsa suoo mu, na ɔdaan poma wɔ ne nsamu:)
title: EXODUS

text: ama wɔaagye edzi dɛ EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no, Abraham, Isaak nye Jakob Nyankopɔn no, eyi noho akyerɛ wo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nkyii so EWURADZE see no dɛ, Afei fa wo nsa hyɛ wo bo mu. Na ɔdze ne nsa hyɛɛ no bo mu: na oyii puei no, hwɛ, nna ne nsa ho egu kwata fitaa dɛ esukwankyɛba.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Fa wo nsa hyɛ wo bo mu bio. (Na ɔdze ne nsa hyɛɛ no bo mu bio; na oyii fii no bo mu no, hwɛ, nna adan dɛ no honam ara bio.)
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔanngye wo enndzi, nkyii so woenntsie asɛnkyerɛdze a odzi kan no ne ndze a, wɔbɛgye asɛnkyerɛdze a otsia ebien no ne ndze edzi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔanngye nsɛnkyerɛdze ebien yi mpo enndzi, nkyii so woenntsie wo ndze a, ɔno kɛsaw esutsen no mu nsu bi, na hue gu asaase kɛsɛɛ do: na nsu a ebɛsaw no wɔ esutsen no mu no ɔbɛdan bɔgya wɔ asaase kɛsɛɛ no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see EWURADZE dɛ, Ao, EWURADZE, m’ano nntsew, nkan no o, ofitsi aber a ɔwo enye w’akowaa kasae yi o: osiandɛ m’ano yɛ dur, na me tɛkyerɛma yɛ pembɔɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Woana na ɔyɛɛ nyimpa ano? Anaa woana na ɔyɛ nyimpa mmum, anaa otsitsifo, anaa ɔdzehufo, anaa onyifurafo? Ana nnyɛ emi EWURADZE bi a?
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei kɔ, na mibedzi w’ano ekyir, na makyerɛ wo dza ebɛka.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ao EWURADZE, mepa wo kyɛw, dua nyia woara epɛ dɛ esoma no, ne nsa do soma.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛɛw wɔ Moses do, na ɔsee dɛ, Ana wo nua Aaron Levinyi no nnyi hɔ bi a? Minyim dɛ obotum akasa yie. Na eso, hwɛ, orifi edzi nye wo ebehyia: na sɛ ohu wo a, n’akoma bɔtɔ ne yamu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na kasa kyerɛ no, na fa nsɛm no hyɛ n’ano: na mibedzi w’ano, na ɔnye n’ano ekyir, na makyerɛ hom dza hom nyɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ wo kyeame ama ɔman no: na ɔbɛba dɛ, ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ ano ama wo, na ɔwo aayɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn ama no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa poma yi a edze bɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze no kitsa wo nsamu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses sanee kɔr n’asew Jetro nkyɛn, na ɔkɛsee no dɛ, Mepa wo kyɛw, ma monkɔ, na mensan nkɔ mo nuanom a wɔwɔ Egypt no nkyɛn, na monkɔhwɛ kyerɛ wɔda ho tse ase anaa. Na Jetro see Moses dɛ, Kɔ no asomdwee mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses wɔ Midian dɛ, Kɔ, san kɔ Egypt: na nyimpa a wɔhwehwɛ wo nkwa no nyinara ewuwu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses faa ne yer nye ne mbabanyin no, na ɔdze hɔn tsenatsenaa asoaso do, na ɔsanee dɛ ɔrokɔ Egypt asaase do: na Moses faa Nyankopɔn no poma no kitsaa ne nsamu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Sɛ esan kɔ Egypt a, hwɛ na anwanwadze a medze mahyɛ wo nsa no nyinara yɛ no wɔ Farao enyim: na mibepirim n’akoma, na ɔnnkɛma ɔman no akɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na se Farao dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Israel yɛ me babanyin, m’abakan a:
title: EXODUS

text: na mase wo dɛ, Ma me ba nkɔ nkɔsom me; na ɔwo ammpen ma ɔannkɔ: hwɛ, muboku wo babanyin, w’abakan no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔkwan do asoɛe no, EWURADZE hyiaa no, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ oboku no.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna Zipora faa ɔtwerɛbo, na ɔdze twaa ne babanyin no twatsia, na ɔtowee kyeen Moses n’ananadze; na ɔsee dɛ, Ampaara ɔwo yɛ bɔgya ho kun fofor dze ma me.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Ewuradze gyaa Moses. Na osian twatsiatwa no ntsi Zipora see dɛ, Bɔgya ho kun fofor nye wo no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Aaron dɛ, Kɔ sar no do kehyia Moses. Na ɔkɔree, kehyiaa no wɔ Nyankopɔn ne bepɔw no ho, na ɔfeew n’ano.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses kaa nsɛm a EWURADZE dze somaa no no nyinara, nye nsɛnkyerɛdze a ɔdze hyɛɛ no no nyinara kyerɛɛ Aaron.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron kɔree na wɔkɔboaboaa Israelmba mpanyimfo nyinara ano.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Aaron kaa nsɛm a EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Moses no nyinara, na ɔyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze no wɔ ɔman no enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔman no gyee dzii: na aber a wɔtsee dɛ EWURADZE abɛsera Israelmba, na ɔahwɛ hɔn amandzehu no wɔbobɔɔ hɔn tsir adze na wɔsɔree.
title: EXODUS

text: Na n’ekyir no Moses nye Aaron bae, na wɔbɛsee Farao dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, Ma me man nkɔ, na wɔnkɛhyɛ fa mma me wɔ sar no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao see dɛ, Woana nye EWURADZE a mibetsie ne ndze na mama Israel akɔ? Minnyim EWURADZE, na nkyii so meremma Israel nnkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Hebriwfo Nyankopɔn nye hɛn ehyia: yɛpa wo kyɛw, ma yɛnkɔ sar no do ndaansa kwan, na yɛnkɔbɔ afɔr mma EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn; mma ɔaammfa ɔyardɔm, anaa afona emmbotua hɛn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Egypthen no see hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Moses nye Aaron, hom robɔ ɔman no ko wɔ hɔn ndwuma ho yi? Hom nkɔ hom ndzesoadze ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao see dɛ, Hwɛ, afei asaase no do nkorɔfo no adɔɔ so, na hom ma wɔhom fi hɔn ndzesoadze ho yi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na da no ara Farao hyɛɛ ɔman no hɔn abɔmbaafo, nye hɔn ahwɛdofo no dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Mma hom mma ɔman no sar a wɔdze bɛyɛ ntayaa no bio dɛ nkan no: wɔmma hɔnara wɔnkɔ na wɔnkɔboaboa sar ano mma hɔnho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ntayaa dodow a wɔyɛ no dada no, hom ngye hɔn; mma hom nnyi do bi: na wɔyɛ enyihaw; dɛm ntsi na wosu dɛ, Wɔmma yɛnkɔ nkɔbɔ afɔr mma hɛn Nyankopɔn no.
title: EXODUS

text: Hom mma edwuma durdur nda nkorɔfo no do, ama wɔaayɛ mu edwuma aberɛ; na mma wonntsie nsɛnhun.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔman no hɔn abɔmbaafo, nye hɔn ahwɛdofo no fiir edzi, na wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, Mbrɛ Farao se nye yi, Meremma hom sar bio.
title: EXODUS

text: Homara nkɔ nkɛfa sar wɔ mbrɛ hom benya bi: na worinnyi hom edwuma do biribiara.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna ɔman no petsee Egypt asaase nyina do kɔboaboaa mburonan ano dze yɛɛ sar.
title: EXODUS

text: Na abɔmbaafo no piapiaa hɔn dɛ, Hom nwie hom da kor edwuma wɔ ne da mu, dɛ aber a sar wɔ hɔ no ara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔhwee Israelmba ahwɛdofo no a Farao n’abɔmbaafo no dze hɔn esisi hɔn do no, na wobisaa dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ennwie ntayaa a wɔahyɛ hom no yɛ ndeda nye ndɛ dɛ nkan no yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Nna Israelmba ahwɛdofo no bae bosui tɔɔ Farao do dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na enye wo nkowaa dzi no dɛm yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Wɔmmaa wo nkowaa sar, na wɔse hɛn dɛ, Hom nyɛ ntayaa: na, hwɛ, wɔahwe wo nkowaa dze; na wankasa wo man na wɔayɛ bɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Enyiahafo nye hom, enyiahafo nye hom: dɛm ntsi na hom se dɛ, Ma yɛnkɔ nkɔbɔ afɔr mma EWURADZE a.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei hom nkɔ nkɛyɛ edwuma; na sar dze wɔremma hom, naaso ntayaa no dodow dze hom mma.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba ahwɛdofo no hun dɛ wɔwɔ amandzenya mu wɔ aber a wɔkaa dɛ, Mma hom nnyi hom da kor edwuma mu ntayaa no do dabiarada no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wofi Farao nkyɛn reba no, wɔbɔtoo Moses nye Aaron dɛ wogyina ɔkwan no mu hɔ:
title: EXODUS

text: na wɔsee hɔn dɛ, EWURADZE nhwɛ hom, na ombua; dɛ hom ama hɛn ho abɔn wɔ Farao, nye no nkowaa enyim, na hom dze afona ahyɛ hɔn nsa dɛ wɔmfa nku hɛn ntsi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses sanee kɔr EWURADZE nkyɛn kɛsee dɛ, EWURADZE, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na enye ɔman yi edzi no bɔn dɛm yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na esomaa me yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Na ofitsi aber ara a mebaa Farao nkyɛn dɛ medze wo dzin nye no kasae no, ɔayɛ ɔman yi bɔn; nkyii so enngyee wo man koraa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Afei na irubohu dza medze merebɛyɛ Farao: na nsa a ɔyɛ dzen do na ɔbɛma wɔakɔ, na nsa a ɔyɛ dzen do na ɔbɛpam hɔn efi n’asaase do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses, na ɔsee no dɛ, Emi nye EWURADZE:
title: EXODUS

text: na miyii moho mekyerɛɛ Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob, dɛ Nyankopɔn Otumfo, na me dzin YHWH (EWURADZE) no dze mamma wɔammfa ennhu me.
title: EXODUS

text: Na eso mama m’ahyɛmu a menye hɔn dzii no etsim, dɛ medze Keenan asaase a ɔyɛ hɔn ahɔhobea asaase no a wɔyɛ do ahɔho no mebɛma hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nkyii so matse Israelmba a Egyptfo dzii hɔn nya no, hɔn apempen; na makaa m’ahyɛmu no.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi se Israelmba dɛ, Emi nye Jehova, na mibeyi hom mefi Egyptfo ndzesoadze no ase, na meyi hom efi hɔn nkowaasom no mu, na medze abasa a wɔatsɛw mu, nye ntsɛmbu akɛse agye hom:
title: EXODUS

text: na mafa hom ayɛ me man, na mayɛ hom Nyankopɔn: na hom ehu dɛ emi nye Jehova hom Nyankopɔn a oyii hom fii Egyptfo ndzesoadze ase no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na medze hom bɔkɔ asaase a memaa me nsa do wɔ ho dɛ medze mebɛma Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob no do, na medze bɛma hom dɛ egyapadze: emi nye Jehova.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses kaa dɛm kyerɛɛ Israelmba no: na ahomtsew nye nkowaasom dzendzen ntsi woenntsie Moses.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Kɔ, kɛka kyerɛ Egypthen Farao, dɛ ɔmma Israelmba mfi asaase no do nkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses kasae wɔ EWURADZE enyim see dɛ, Hwɛ, Israelmba enntsie me; na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na Farao betsie emi a wonntwaa m’anofamfa twatsia yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, na ɔdze hyɛɛ hɔn nsa dɛ wɔnkɔ Israelmba, nye Egypthen Farao nkyɛn, nkeyi Israelmba no mfi Egypt asaase do.
title: EXODUS

text: Iyinom nye hɔn egyanom efi mu etsitsir: Israel n’abakan Reuben ne mbabanyin; Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, nye Karmi: iyinom nye Reuben n’ebusuafo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Simeon ne mbabanyin; Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar, nye Saul, Keenannyi ɔbaa bi ne babanyin no: iyinom nye Simeon n’ebusuafo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na iyinom nye Levi ne mbabanyin no hɔn edzin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mbusuasantsen tsetsee; Gerson, Kohat, nye Merari: na Levi no nkwaber mu mfe yɛ mfe ɔha eduasa esuon.
title: EXODUS

text: Gerson ne mbabanyin nye Libni na Simei, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuafo tsetsee.
title: EXODUS

text: Kohat ne mbabanyin; Amram, nye Izhar, Hebron, Uziel: na Kohat no nkwamber mu mfe yɛ mfe ɔha eduasa ebiasa.
title: EXODUS

text: Merari ne mbabanyin nye Mahili nye Musi. Iyinom nye Levifo ebusuafo dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuasantsen tsetsee.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Amram faa n’egya akyerɛbaa Jokebed waar no; na ɔnye no woo Aaron nye Moses: na Amram no nkwaber mu mfe yɛ mfe ɔha eduasa esuon.
title: EXODUS

text: Izhar ne mbabanyin nye Kora, Nefeg, nye Zikri.
title: EXODUS

text: Uziel ne mbabanyin nye Misael, Elzafan, nye Sitri.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Aaron faa Eliseba, Aminadab ne babaa no, Nahson n’akyerɛbaa no waar no; na ɔnye no woo Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar nye Itamar.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Kora ne mbabanyin nye Assir, Elkana, na Abiasaf; iyinom nye Korafo ebusuafo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar faa Putiel ne mbabaa mu baako waar no; na ɔnye no woo Finehas. Iyinom nye Levifo egyanom efi mu etsitsir dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuafo tsetsee.
title: EXODUS

text: Iyinom nye Aaron nye Moses no a EWURADZE see hɔn dɛ, wonnyi Israelmba mfi Egypt asaase do dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm tsetsee no.
title: EXODUS

text: Moses na Aaron nye hɔn a wɔkasaa kyerɛɛ Egypthen Farao dɛ wobeyi Israelmba efi Egypt akɔ no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ da no a EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ Egypt asaase do no,
title: EXODUS

text: EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, Emi nye EWURADZE: ka dza meka kyerɛ wo nyinara kyerɛ Egypthen Farao.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses kae wɔ EWURADZE enyim dɛ, Hwɛ, emi wonntwaa m’anofamfa twatsia, na Farao bɛyɛ dɛn etsie me?
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Hwɛ, mebɛma ayɛ dɛ Nyame wɔ Farao enyim; na wo nua Aaron bɛyɛ wo nkɔnhyɛnyi.
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔwo bɛka dza mehyɛ wo nyinara: na wo nua Aaron bɛka akyerɛ Farao ma ɔaama Israelmba efi n’asaase do akɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mibepirim Farao n’akoma, na mama me nsɛnkyerɛdze nye m’anwanwadze adɔɔ so wɔ Egypt asaase do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao rinntsie hom, na medze me nsa bɔto Egypt do, na meyi mo dɔm, me man Israelmba no, mefi Egypt asaase do wɔ atsɛmbu akɛse mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ metsen me nsa wɔ Egypt do na miyi Israelmba fi hɔn mu fir a, nna Egyptfo bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ hɔn no ara.
title: EXODUS

text: Aber a wɔkasaa kyerɛɛ Farao no, nna Moses edzi mfe eduowɔtwe, na Aaron mfe eduowɔtwe ebiasa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ Farao ka kyerɛ hom dɛ, Hom nyi hom anwanwadze bi nkyerɛ a, ɔnodze ka kyerɛ Aaron dɛ, Yi wo poma no, na tow kyen famu wɔ Farao enyim, ma ɔndan abowatsena.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron kɔr Farao nkyɛn, na wɔyɛɛ dɛm, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛe no: na Aaron toow no poma kyeen famu wɔ Farao enyim nye no nkowaa enyim, na ɔdaan abowatsena.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna Farao so frɛfrɛɛ enyansafo no, na abayifo no: na hɔn so, Egypt akɔmfo no, dze hɔn nkaber yɛɛ dɛmara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na hɔn nyinara totoow hɔn mpoma guu famu, na ɔdandaan mbowatsena: na Aaron no poma no memeen hɔn mpoma no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao n’akoma pirimii, na oenntsie hɔn; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kae no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Farao n’akoma epirim, ɔmmpen dɛ ɔman no kɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Kɔ Farao nkyɛn ampa: hwɛ, orupue akɔ nsu mu: na ɔwo kegyina esutsen no no nkɔnkɔnoa hɔ hyia no; na poma no a ɔdaan abowatsena no fa kitsa wo nsamu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na se no dɛ, EWURADZE, Hebriwfo Nyankopɔn no, na ɔasoma me wo hɔ dɛ, Ma me man nkɔ nkɔsom me wɔ sar no do: na, hwɛ, enntsie ara dze ebodu sesei.
title: EXODUS

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Iyi mu na ibohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE: Hwɛ, medze poma a ɔdze me nsamu yi mobɔbɔ esutsen yi mu nsu, na ɔbɛdan bɔgya.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nam a wɔwɔ esutsen no mu bowuwu, na esutsen no bɔbɔn; na Egyptfo bekyir dɛ wɔbɔnom esutsen no mu nsu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Se Aaron dɛ, Fa wo poma, na tsen wo nsa wɔ Egypt esuesu do, hɔn esutsen do, hɔn nsubansuba do, nye hɔn mbakansu nyina do, ma ɔndandan bɔgya; na bɔgya bɛba Egypt asaase nyinara do, ndua esupi nye abo esupi nyina mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron yɛɛ dɛm, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛe no; na ɔmaa poma no do, na ɔdze bɔɔ nsu a ɔwɔ esutsen no mu no wɔ Farao enyim, nye no nkowaa enyim; na nsu a ɔwɔ esutsen no mu nyinara daan bɔgya.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nam a wɔwɔ esutsen no mu wuwui, na esutsen no bɔnee, na Egyptfo enntum annom esutsen no mu nsu; na bɔgya no baa Egypt asaase nyinara do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Egypt akɔmfo no dze hɔn nkaber no yɛɛ dɛmara: na Farao n’akoma pirimii, na oenntsie hɔn; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kae no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao daan noho na ɔkɔr ne fie, na ɔammfa iyi so mpo annto n’akoma mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Egyptfo nyina tutuu amona wɔ esutsen no ho dɛ wobenya nsu anom; osiandɛ wonntum nnom esutsen no mu nsu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE bɔɔ esutsen no ekyir no, nda esuon botwaa mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, Kɔ Farao nkyɛn, na se no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ma me man nkɔ, na wɔnkɔsom me.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ ammpen ma wɔaannkɔ a, hwɛ, medze ntwɛr bofura wo ntoaado nyinara:
title: EXODUS

text: na esutsen no bɔdɔ ntwɛr menyamenya, na wɔbɔfofow aba wo fie, nye w’adankyir, nye wo mpa do, nye wo nkowaa fie, nye wo man do, nye wo mfononoo mu, nye wo mbɔrnkutu mu:
title: EXODUS

text: na ntwɛr no bɔfow aba ɔwo, nye wo mamfo, nye wo nkowaa nyinara do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Se Aaron dɛ, Fa wo poma tsen wo nsa wɔ esutsen, nye nsubansuba, nye nsutaae do, na ma ntwɛr mbra Egypt asaase do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Aaron tseen ne nsa wɔ Egypt nsu do; na ntwɛr no fowee bae, na wobofuraa Egypt asaase do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na akɔmfo no dze hɔn nkaber no yɛɛ dɛmara, na wɔmaa ntwɛr fowee baa Egypt asaase do.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna Farao frɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mpa EWURADZE kyɛw ma onyi ntwɛr no mfi emi, nye me man do; na mebɛma ɔman no akɔ, ma wɔaakɔbɔ afɔr ama EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see Farao dɛ, W’adaworom: ebɛn aber na mempa kyɛw memma ɔwo, nye wo nkowaa, nye wo man, ma wɔnsɛɛ ntwɛr no mfi ɔwo nye w’efi do, na wɔnka esutsen no nko mu?
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔkyena a. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔnyɛ dɛ dza aka no ara: ama eehu dɛ obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ntwɛr no befi ɔwo, nye w’efi, nye wo nkowaa, nye wo man do; esutsen no mu nko na wɔbɛka.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron fii Farao nkyɛn kɔree: na Moses sui frɛɛ EWURADZE wɔ ntwɛr no a ɔdze baa Farao do no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Moses kae no: na ntwɛr no wuwui wɔ efi mu, nye abangua do, nye haban mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔboaboaa hɔn ano ekuwekuw: na asaase no do bɔnee.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao hun dɛ ahotɔ aba mu no, opiriim n’akoma, na oenntsie hɔn: dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kae no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Se Aaron dɛ, Tsen wo poma no, na fa bɔ asaase do huntuma, ma ɔndan dwuw wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm; na Aaron dze no poma no tseen ne nsa, na ɔdze bɔɔ asaase do huntuma, ma dwuw fɔɔr nyimpa nye mbowa: asaase no do huntuma nyinara daan dwuw wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na akɔmfo no dze hɔn nkaber yɛɛ dɛmara dɛ wɔrema dwuw aba na woenntum: na dwuw no wɔ nyimpa nye mbowa ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna akɔmfo no see Farao dɛ, Nyankopɔn nsatseaba nye yi: na Farao n’akoma pirimii, na oenntsie hɔn; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kae no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Soɛr anapaatu, na kegyina Farao enyim; hwɛ, ɔreba nsu no ho; na se no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ma me man nkɔ, ma wɔnkɔsom me.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ ennkɛma me man akɔ a, hwɛ, mebɛma atsɛn menyamenya aba ɔwo, nye wo nkowaa, nye wo man, nye w’efi do: na Egyptfo efiefi mu, na asaase a wɔtse do no so atsɛn menyamenya bɛyɛ no amaama.
title: EXODUS

text: Na da no mubotwa Gosen asaase a me man tse do no egya, ma atsɛn menyamenya aannkɔ hɔ, ama eehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE wɔ asaase finimfin.
title: EXODUS

text: Na medze ɔhe mobɔto me man nye wo man ntamu: ɔkyena na asɛnkyerɛdze yi bɛba.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE yɛɛ dɛm; na atsɛn menyamenya a hɔn ano yɛ yaw baa Farao fi mu, nye no nkowaa efi mu: na osian atsɛn menyamenya no ntsi Egypt asaase no nyinara do sɛɛe.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao frɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɔbɔ afɔr mma hom Nyankopɔn wɔ asaase no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses dɛ, Ɔnnsɛ dɛ wɔyɛ no dɛm; osiandɛ Egyptfo ekyiwadze na yɛdze bɔbɔ afɔr ama EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn no: hwɛ, ana yɛmfa Egyptfo ekyiwadze mbɔ afɔr wɔ hɔn enyiwa mu, na wonnkesiw hɛn abo bi a?
title: EXODUS

text: Yebotu ndaansa kwan akɔ sar no do, na yɛakɔbɔ afɔr ama EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɛhyɛ hɛn no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao see dɛ, mebɛma hom akɔ, ama hom aakɔbɔ afɔr ama EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn no wɔ sar no do; na ekyir nko na hom nnkɔ: hom mpa kyɛw mma me.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Hwɛ, mirifi wo nkyɛn akɔ, na makɛpa EWURADZE kyɛw ma atsɛn menyamenya no eefi Farao, nye no nkowaa, nye ne man do ɔkyena: na abrasɛm nko na mma Farao nndzi bio, dɛ ɔnnkɛma ɔman no akɔ akɔbɔ afɔr ama EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses fii Farao nkyɛn kɔree, na ɔkɛpaa EWURADZE kyɛw.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Moses kae no; na oyii atsɛn menyamenya no fii Farao, nye no nkowaa, nye ne man do; kor mpo annka.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao piriim n’akoma aber yi so, na ɔamma ɔman no annkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Kɔ Farao nkyɛn, na ka kyerɛ no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Hebriwfo Nyankopɔn se nye yi, Ma me man nkɔ, ma wɔnkɔsom me.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ ammpen ma wɔaannkɔ, na eda ho ara tsintsim hɔn do a,
title: EXODUS

text: hwɛ, EWURADZE nsa wɔ wo mbowa a wɔwɔ haban mu do, na ɔdze mbowawu yayaayaw bɛba mpɔnkɔ, nsoasopɔnkɔ, efumpɔnkɔ, anantwikuw, nye nguankuw do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE dze sorbi bɔto Israel mbowa nye Egypt mbowa ntamu na dza ɔyɛ Israelmba dze no nyinara mu biara nnkowu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE hyɛɛ aber, dɛ, Ɔkyena na EWURADZE bɛyɛ adze yi wɔ asaase no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na adze kyee no EWURADZE yɛɛ adze no, na Egypt mbowa nyinara wuwui: na Israelmba mbowa dze no mu kor mpo ennwu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao somae, na hwɛ, nna Israelfo mbowa mu kor mpo nnwui. Na Farao n’akoma sorowee, na ɔamma ɔman no annkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses nye Aaron dɛ, Hom mfa fononoo mu nso nsama nsama, na Moses ntow mpetse wimu wɔ Farao enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbɛdan tutuw wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do, na ɔayɛ mpɔmpɔ a ɔpaapaa tutu ekur wɔ nyimpa nye mbowa ho, wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔfaa fononoo mu nso, na wokegyinaa Farao enyim; na Moses towee petsee wimu; na ɔdaan pɔmpɔ a ɔpaapaa tutu ekur wɔ nyimpa nye mbowa ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na osian mpɔmpɔ no ntsi akɔmfo no enntum enngyina Moses enyim; osiandɛ nna mpɔmpɔ no abobɔ akɔmfo no nye Egyptfo nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE piriim Farao n’akoma, na oenntsie hɔn; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Soɛr anapaatu, na kegyina Farao enyim, na se no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Hebriwfo Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, Ma me man nkɔ, ma wɔnkɔsom me.
title: EXODUS

text: Na afei dze merema me yardɔm nyinara aba w’akoma do, nye wo nkowaa do, nye wo man do; ama eehu dɛ obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ emi wɔ asaase nyinara do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na afei sɛ matsen me nsa, na medze owuyar abɔ ɔwo nye wo man a, nkyɛ woetwa wo efi asaase do:
title: EXODUS

text: na ampaara iyi ntsi na mama egyina hɔ, dɛ mebɛkyerɛ wo mo tum, na wɔaabɔ me dzin akyerɛ wɔ asaase nyinara do.
title: EXODUS

text: Eda ho ara rema woho do wɔ me man do, dɛ eremma wɔnnkɔ anaa?
title: EXODUS

text: Hwɛ, ɔkyena siseber yi mebɛma ɔsorbo a n’ano yɛ dur dodoodow a ne saso mmbaa Egypt pɛn ofi da a wɔkyekyeree dze bodu ndɛ yi atɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei soma na wɔnkɛfa wo mbowa nye biribiara a ewɔ wɔ haban mu nyina mbra ntsɛm; na nyimpa biara nye abowa biara a wobohu hɔn wɔ haban mu, na wɔammfa hɔn ammba fie no, ɔsorbo no bɔhwe hɔn, na wobowuwu.
title: EXODUS

text: Farao nkowaa mu nyia osuroo EWURADZE n’asɛm no maa no nkowaa nye ne fiembowa guanee baa fie.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nyia oemmbu EWURADZE n’asɛm bi no gyaa no nkowaa nye ne fiembowa wɔ haban mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Tsen wo nsa wɔ sor, ma ɔsorbo mbra Egypt asaase nyinara do, nyimpa, nye abowa, nye haban mu efuw biara do, wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses tseen no poma no wɔ sor: na EWURADZE maa senaman nye ɔsorbo bae, na ogya porowee guu asaase do; na EWURADZE tɔɔ ɔsorbo guu Egypt asaase do.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna ɔsorbo no bae, na ogya a ɔdzɛw brambram toatoa mu a ɔfora ɔsorbo no mu a n’ano yɛ dzen dodoodow a ne saso mmbaa Egypt asaase nyinara do pɛn ofi da a ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔman no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsorbo no hwee Egypt asaase nyinara do dza ɔwɔ haban mu nyinara, nyimpa nye abowa nyina; na ɔsorbo no hwee haban mu efuw nyinara, na obubuu haban mu ndua nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Gosen asaase do mbrɛ Israelmba wɔ no nko na ɔsorbo no bi ammba.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao somae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Afei dze mayɛ bɔn: EWURADZE dzi bem, na emi nye me man yɛyɛ afɔdzifo.
title: EXODUS

text: Hom mpa EWURADZE kyɛw; na asenaman dzendzen yi nye ɔsorbo no adɔɔ so; na mebɛma hom akɔ, na hom renntsena ha bio.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see no dɛ, Mefi kurow mu akɔ ara a, nkyɛ matserɛw me nsamu akyerɛ EWURADZE; asenaman no begyaa, nkyii so ɔsorbo biara nnkɛba bio; ama eehu dɛ asaase yɛ EWURADZE dze.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔwo nye wo nkowaa dze, minyim dɛ hom nnyae nnsuroo EWURADZE Nyankopɔn bi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔhwee asaaba nye atoko: osiandɛ atoko no ayɛ mbɛtsem, na asaaba no so abɔ nkukuduuduw.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ewifua nye ewu dze wɔannhwe hɔn: osiandɛ nna wonntuu mpon biara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses fi Farao nkyɛn fii kurow no mu, na ɔkɛtserɛɛw ne nsamu kyerɛɛ EWURADZE, na nsenaman nye ɔsorbo no gyaae, na nyankom no woennhue enngu asaase no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao hun dɛ nyankom, nye ɔsorbo, nye asenaman no egyae no, ɔyɛɛ bɔn bio, na opiriim n’akoma, ɔno nye no nkowaa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao n’akoma pirimii, na ɔamma Israelmba annkɔ; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE nam Moses do kae no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Kɔ Farao nkyɛn: na mepirim n’akoma, nye no nkowaa akoma, ama meeyi me nsɛnkyerɛdze yi akyerɛ no wɔ hɔn mu:
title: EXODUS

text: na aaka no wɔ wo ba, nye wo ba ne ba asomu, ndzɛmba a mayɛ no wɔ Egypt do, na me nsɛnkyerɛdze a mayɛ no wɔ hɔn mu; ama hom eehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron kɔr Farao nkyɛn, na wɔkɛsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Hebriwfo Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, Eropow dɛ ebrɛ woho adze wɔ m’enyim ma ekodu dabɛn? Ma me man nkɔ, na wɔnkɔsom me.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ ammpen ma me man aannkɔ a, hwɛ, ɔkyena medze mbɛbɛw bɛba wo ntoaado:
title: EXODUS

text: na wɔbɛkata asaase enyi, dɛ obi nnkotum ehu asaase: na wobedzi edzinkaa a ɔsorbo no gyaae ma ɔkae maa hom no, na wobedzi dua biara a ɔrefefɛw wɔ haban mu ama hom no:
title: EXODUS

text: na wɔbɛhyehyɛ w’efi mu, nye wo nkowaa nyinara efi mu, nye Egyptfo nyinara efi mu amaama; dɛ mbrɛ w’egyanom, nye w’egyanom hɔn egyanom nnhun bi pɛn ofi da a wɔdze baa asaase do dze bodu ndɛ da yi. Na ɔdaan noho, na ofii Farao nkyɛn puei.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao no nkowaa see no dɛ, Nyimpa yi bɛtseetsee hɛn araa ma ekodu dabɛn? Ma nkorɔfo no nkɔ, ma wɔnkɔsom EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn no. Ana Egypt asɛɛ yi innhu bi a?
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔdze Moses nye Aaron baa Farao nkyɛn bio: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɔsom EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn: na woananom ara na wɔbɔkɔ?
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Yɛnye hɛn mbofra nye hɛn mpanyin bɔkɔ, yɛnye hɛn mbabanyin na ɔnye hɛn mbabaa, yɛnye hɛn nguan na ɔnye hɛn anantwi bɔkɔ; osiandɛ otwar dɛ yɛhyɛ fa ma EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hm, EWURADZE ndzi hom ekyir ɛ, ber a merema hom, nye hom mbofraba no akɔ yi: mutum hu dɛ bɔn na ɔwɔ hom adwen mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Dabida: hom a hom yɛ mbanyin no ara nkɔ, na wɔnkɔsom EWURADZE; na ɔnoara nye dza hom rohwehwɛ. Na woyii hɔn edzi fii Farao enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Tsen wo nsa wɔ Egypt asaase do, wɔ mbɛbɛw no ntsi, ma wɔmbra Egypt asaase do, na wɔmbɔwe asaase no do efuw nyinara, mekyerɛ dza ɔsorbo no egyaa no nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses tseen no poma no wɔ Egypt asaase do, na EWURADZE dze boka mframa bɔɔ asaase no do da no nyinara, na anadwe no nyinara; na anapa no, boka mframa dze mbɛbɛw no bae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mbɛbɛw no kɔr Egypt asaase nyinara do, na wɔkɛgyegyee Egypt ntoaado nyinara; wɔdɔɔ so dodow; mbɛbɛw biara a ɔtse dɛm mbaa pɛn, na hɔn ekyir so bi nnkɛba dɛm da.
title: EXODUS
