text: Na wɔkataa asaase no nyinara enyi, ma isum gyee asaase no do; na wɔwee asaase no do efuw nyinara, nye ndua a ɔsorbo no gyaae no do aba nyinara: na adze momon biara annka a ɔyɛ dua anaa haban mu efuw, wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna Farao maa wɔkɛfrɛɛ Moses nye Aaron ntsɛmara; na ɔsee dɛ, Mayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, nye hom.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, mepa wo kyɛw, fa mo bɔn fir me prɛko yi ara, na hom mpa EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn kyɛw, ma onyi owu yi ara mfi mo do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ofii Farao nkyɛn kɔree, na ɔkɛpaa EWURADZE kyɛw.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE dze daan anee mframa dzendzen mbordo a ɔbɛfaa mbɛbɛw no, na ɔdze hɔn koguu Mbɛw Po no mu; abɛbɛw kor mpo annka wɔ Egypt ntoaado nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE piriim Farao n’akoma, na ɔamma Israelmba no annkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Tsen wo nsa wɔ sor, ma sum mbra Egypt asaase do, mekyerɛ sum a wosuo mu a ɔbɛyɛ a yie.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses tseen ne nsa wɔ sor; na sum kebii hyɛɛ Egypt asaase nyinara dze, do nda ebiasa;
title: EXODUS

text: obiara ennhu ne nyɛnko, nkyii so obiara annsoɛr emmfi ne tsenabew nda ebiasa: na Israelmba nyinara wonyaa kan wɔ hɔn efiefi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao frɛɛ Moses, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɔsom EWURADZE; hom nguan nye hom anantwi nko na wɔmma wɔnka: wɔmma hom mbofraba no so nye hom nkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Ohia dɛ edze okum afɔrbɔdze nye ɔhyew afɔrbɔdze so hyɛ hɛn nsa ama yaabɔ afɔr ama EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Hɛn mbowa so nye hɛn bɔkɔ; ɔnnkɛka abowaanamɔn mpo wɔ ekyir; na ɔno mu bi na otwar dɛ yɛkɛfa som EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn; na yennyim dza yɛdze bɔsom EWURADZE, gyedɛ yedu hɔ ana.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE piriim Farao n’akoma, na ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔma wɔkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao see no dɛ, Fi mo do kɔ, hwɛ woho yie, mma nnhu m’enyim bio; na da a ibohu m’enyim no ibowu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Aka no yie; munnkohu w’enyim bio.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Mebɛma ɔyardɔm kor so aba Farao, nye Egypt do bio; na n’ekyir no ɔbɛma hom efi ha akɔ: aber a ɔbɛma hom akɔ no, ampaara, ɔbɛpam hom efi ha koraa.
title: EXODUS

text: Afei kasa wɔ ɔman no asomu, na ma ɔbanyin biara mbisa wɔ ne nyɛnko hɔ, na ɔbaa mbisa wɔ ne nyɛnko hɔ, dwetɛ ndwindze, nye sika ndwindze.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE maa ɔman no enyimpa wɔ Egyptfo enyim. Nkyii so nna ɔyɛɛ Moses otsitsir paara wɔ Egypt asaase do, wɔ Farao nkowaa enyim, nye ɔman no enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Bɛyɛ esuom na mibefir edzi mafa Egypt mu:
title: EXODUS

text: na Egypt asaase do mbakan nyinara bowuwu, ofi Farao n’abakan a ɔtsena n’ahengua do do, dze kodu afonabaa mpo a ɔwɔ ewuyambo ekyir n’abakan do; nye ofiembowa mbakan nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na su kɛse bɛba Egypt asaase nyinara do a ne saso bi mbaa da, eso ne saso bi nnkɛba bio.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba nyinara dze, ɔkraman mpo nnkɔtwe ne tɛkyerɛma ahye hɔn, ɔnnkɛhye nyimpa anaa abowa: ama hom eehu mbrɛ EWURADZE si dze ɔhe to Egyptfo nye Israel ntamu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wo nkowaa yi nyinara besian aba mo hɔ, na wɔabɔbɔ hɔn mu adze ama me dɛ, Fir edzi kɔ, ɔwo nye ɔman a wɔka wo do nyinara: na ɔno ekyir no na mibefir edzi makɔ. Na ɔdze ebufuhyew fii Farao nkyɛn kɔree.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Farao nnketsie hom; ama m’anwanwadze aadɔɔ so wɔ Egypt asaase do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron yɛɛ anwanwadze yi nyinara wɔ Farao enyim; na EWURADZE piriim Farao n’akoma, na ɔamma Israelmba emmfi n’asaase do annkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron wɔ Egypt asaase do dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Bosoom yi bɛyɛ abosoom ahyɛse ama hom: ɔbɛyɛ afrenhyia mu bosoom a odzi kan ama hom.
title: EXODUS

text: Hom nkasa nkyerɛ Israel mboanofo no nyinara dɛ, Bosoom yi ne da a otsia du no mu, wɔmfefa nguambaa nkorkor, dɛ mbrɛ hom egyanom efiefi tsetsee, fie kor eguambaa kor:
title: EXODUS

text: na sɛ ofidua no suar dodow dze ma eguambaa kor a, ɔno wɔmma ɔnye ne nyɛnko a ɔbɛn ne fi mfa kor dɛ mbrɛ akra no hɔn dodow tse; dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa biara n’edzidzi tse no, na hom mfa mbu eguambaa no ano.
title: EXODUS

text: Hom eguambaa nyɛ dza onndzi dzɛm, onyin a oedzi afrenhyia a: hom nyi no wɔ nkɔsɔw anaa mpɔnkye mu:
title: EXODUS

text: na hom mfa no nsie ma onkodu bosoom kor no ara ne da a otsia duanan no: na Israel mboanofo kuw no nyina nkuku hɔn ewimbir.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔmfa bɔgya no bi, na wɔmfa nsera efi a wobedzi no wɔ mu no n’apondua ebien no nye mpondua etsifi no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wondzi nam no anadwe no ara, wɔmfa gya ntoto, na wɔmfa epitsi boodoo, nye fan wenwen ndzi.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma wonndzi no amon, nkyii so mma wɔmmfa nsu nnoa, mbom wɔmfa gya ntoto; ne tsir nye no ntwɛr na ɔnye n’ayamudze no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mma hom mma no ho biribiara nnka ma adze nnkye do; na dza ɔbɛka ma adze akye do no hom mfa gya nhyew.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mbrɛ hom ndzi no nye yi; hom mbobɔ hom asen do, hom mpaboa nhyehyɛ hom anan, na hom mpoma nkitsakitsa hom nsamu: na hom ndzi no ɔhar do: ɔyɛ EWURADZE apaho.
title: EXODUS

text: Osiandɛ mubotwa mu wɔ Egypt asaase do anadwe no, na muboku Egypt asaase do mbakan nyinara, nyimpa nye mbowa nyina; na mubobu Egypt enyame nyinara ntsɛn: emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na bɔgya no bɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze ama hom wɔ efi a hom wɔ mu no ho: na sɛ muhu mbɔgya no a, mebɛpa hom ho, na ɔyardɔm bi nnkɛba hom do abɛsɛɛ hom, sɛ morobɔbɔ Egypt asaase no a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na da yi nyɛ nkaa mma hom, na hom nhyɛ no fa mma EWURADZE: hom mfa mbra do nyɛ no afahyɛ wɔ hom ebusuasantsen mu daa.
title: EXODUS

text: Nda esuon na hom ndzi epitsi boodoo; da a odzi kan no ara na hom nyi mbɔrkaw mfi hom efiefi: na obiara a obedzi mbɔrkaw boodoo ofitsi da a odzi kan no do dze kodu da a otsia esuon no do no, ɔkra no wobotwa no efi Israel.
title: EXODUS

text: Na da a odzi kan no hom nyɛ no nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn, na da a otsia esuon no so nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; mma wɔnnyɛ edwuma biara wɔ mu, gyedɛ dza nyimpa biara bedzi nko na hom nyɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na hom ndwen epitsi afahyɛ no do; na dɛm da yi ara so na miyii hom dɔm no mifii Egypt asaase do: dɛm ntsi hom ndwen da yi do wɔ hom ebusuasantsen mu nyɛ no mbra daa.
title: EXODUS

text: Bosoom a odzi kan no mu, bosoom no mu da a otsia duanan ewimbir no, na hom ndzi epitsi ma onkodu bosoom no mu da a otsia eduonu biako ewimbir.
title: EXODUS

text: Nda esuon na mma mma wonnhu mbɔrkaw wɔ hom efi mu: na obiara a obedzi dza ɔaka no, ɔkra no wobotwa no efi Israel mboanofo mu, sɛ ɔyɛ ɔmamforanyi o, obi a wɔwoo no wɔ asaase no do o.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma hom nndzi biribiara a akaw; hom ndzi epitsi wɔ hom tsenabew nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna Moses frɛɛ Israel mpanyimfo nyinara, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkeyiyi nguambaa dɛ mbrɛ hom ebusua tsetsee, na hom nku apaho no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na hom mfa odwonhataw (hisɔp) siaw, na hom mfa mbɔ bɔgya a ɔwɔ bɛɛsen no mu no mu, na hom mfa bɔgya a ɔwɔ bɛɛsen no mu no bi mpetse mpondua etsifi nye apondua ebien no ho; na mma hom mu obiara mmfir edzi mmfi ne fie abowano ma onkodu anapa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE botwa mu abɔbɔ Egyptfo; na sɛ ohu bɔgya no wɔ mpondua etsifi, nye apondua ebien no ho a, EWURADZE bɛpa ɔpon no ho, na ɔnnkɛma ɔsɛɛfo no kwan ma ɔaaba hom efi mu abɔbobɔ hom.
title: EXODUS

text: Na hom ndwen iyi do ma ɔnyɛ mbra mma ɔwo nye wo mba daa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ hom du asaase a EWURADZE dze bɛma hom no do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔabɔ anohoba no a, ɔno hom ndzi ɔsom yi do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ hom mba bisa hom dɛ, Hom som yi ase nye dɛn?
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔno hom nse dɛ, Ɔyɛ EWURADZE n’apaho afɔrbɔdze, nyia ɔpaa Israelmba hɔn efi ho wɔ Egypt, wɔ aber a ɔbɔɔ Egyptfo, na oyii hɛn efi fii mu no. Na ɔman no bɔɔ hɔn tsir adze na wɔsɔree.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses nye Aaron no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ esuom no, EWURADZE bɔbɔɔ Egypt asaase do mbakan nyinara, ofi Farao n’abakan a ɔtsena n’ahengua do no do dze kodu adaduadan mu ndɔmmum n’abakan do; nye ofiembowa mbakan nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao soɛɛr anadwe no ara, ɔno, nye no nkowaa nyinara, nye Egyptfo nyinara: na su kɛse baa Egypt; osiandɛ fie biara nnyi hɔ a obi ennwu wɔ mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ Moses nye Aaron anadwe, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nsoɛr, hom mfi me man mu mfir, hom nye Israelmba no nyina; na hom nkɔ nkɔsom EWURADZE, dɛ mbrɛ hom aka no.
title: EXODUS

text: Hom mfa hom nguan nye hom anantwi so, dɛ mbrɛ hom aka no, na hom nkɔ; na hom nhyira mo so.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Egyptfo no piapiaa ɔman no dɛ wɔrepam hɔn ntsɛm efi asaase no do; na wɔsee dɛ, Hɛn nyinara ayɛ ewufo ara nye no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔman no fefaa hɔn mbɔr ansaana ɔrekaw, hɔn mbɔrakorow no wɔakyekyer no wɔ hɔn atam mu sisi hɔn kɔn ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Moses kae no; na wobisabisaa dwetɛ ndwindze, nye sika ndwindze, nye atam wɔ Egyptfo hɔ:
title: EXODUS

text: na EWURADZE maa ɔman no enyimpa wɔ Egyptfo no enyim, ma wɔmaa hɔn nsa kaa dza wobisae no. Na wɔfoom Egyptfo egyapadze kɔree.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba no sii mu fii Rameses kɔr Sukɔt, mbanyin ara a wɔnam famu bɛyɛ mpem ahaesia, a mbofraba nnka ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aforafora dɔm so nye hɔn kɔree; na nguan, na anantwi, mekyerɛ ofiembowa piigyan.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔdze mbɔr a wɔdze fi Egypt bae no totoo epitsi tatar, nna ɔnnkawee; osiandɛ wɔpaam hɔn fii Egypt ntsi, na woenntum enntsinntsim, nkyii so woennsiesie edzidzidze biara amma hɔnho.
title: EXODUS

text: Afei tsena a Israelmba dze tsenaa Egypt no yɛ mfe ahaanan eduasa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe ahaanan eduasa no n’ewiei no, mekyerɛ da kor no ara, EWURADZE no dɔm nyinara tui fii Egypt asaase do.
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔyɛ anadwe a ɔwɔ dɛ wɔhyɛ no nsew ma EWURADZE dɛ oyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do: iyi nye EWURADZE n’anadwe no a wɔhyɛ no nsew wɔ Israelmba nyinara mu wɔ hɔn ebusuasantsen nyina mu no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses nye Aaron dɛ, Iyi nye apaho no ho mbra no: ɔnanaben biara nndzi bi:
title: EXODUS

text: na nyimpa biara n’akowaa a ɔdze sika atɔ no no dze, sɛ etwa no twatsia a, ɔno ondzi bi.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma ɔmamforanyi nye akowaa ɔpaanyi nndzi bi.
title: EXODUS

text: Ofi kor mu na wondzi; mma mmfa nam no bi mmfi fie no mu mmpue; nkyii so mma hom mmbu ne biew bi.
title: EXODUS

text: Israel mboanofo nyinara ndzi do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ ɔhɔho bi bɛnye wo tsena, na ɔpɛ dɛ odzi apaho no ma EWURADZE a, ma wontwa ne mbarimba nyinara twatsia, na nkyii ɔntwe mbɛn na ombedzi; na ɔnyɛ dɛ nyia wɔawo no asaase no do: monomonomnyi biara dze mma onndzi bi.
title: EXODUS

text: Mbra kor na ɔnda hɔ mma nyia ɔyɛ okuromnyi, nye ɔhɔho a ɔtsena hom mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba nyinara yɛɛ dɛm; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses nye Aaron no, dɛmara so na wɔyɛe.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ da kor no ara, EWURADZE yii Israelmba no fii Egypt asaase do dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm tsetsee.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Tu mbakan nyinara si nkyɛn ma me, adze biara a obue yafun mu, wɔ Israelmba mu, wɔ onyimpa nye abowa mu nyinara; yɛ medze.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see ɔman no dɛ, Hom nkaa da yi a hom dze fii Egypt firii, fii nkowaasom fi mu no; na nsa a ɔyɛ dzen na EWURADZE dze yii hom fii bea no do: mma wonndzi mbɔrkaw boodoo.
title: EXODUS

text: Ndɛ da yi na hom rifir edzi wɔ bosoom Abib mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ EWURADZE nya dze wo du Keenanfo, Hitifo, Amorifo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo asaase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w’egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma wo no, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no do a, ɔno som ɔsom yi wɔ bosoom yi mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Nda esuon na dzi epitsi boodoo, na da a otsia esuon no bɛyɛ afahyɛ ama EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Wondzi epitsi boodoo nda esuon no mu nyina; na mma wonnhu mbɔrkaw boodoo wɔ wo nkyɛn, nkyii so mma wonnhu mbɔrkaw wɔ wo nkyɛn, wɔ wo ntoaado nyinara mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na da no kyerɛ mu kyerɛ wo ba dɛ, Osian dza EWURADZE yɛe maa me wɔ ber a mirifi Egypt aba no ntsi a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ wo wo nsa do asɛnkyerɛdze, na w’enyiwa ntamu nkaadze, ama EWURADZE mbra no aako w’anomu: na nsa a ɔyɛ dzen na EWURADZE dze eyi wo efi Egypt.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi dzi mbra yi do wɔ ne ber mu afrenhyia daa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ EWURADZE dze wo du Keenanfo asaase do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ ɔwo nye w’egyanom no, na ɔdze ma wo a,
title: EXODUS

text: ɔno yi dza obue yafun mu nyinara si nkyɛn ma EWURADZE, na abakan biara a ewɔ a ofi abowa mu: enyin no nyɛ EWURADZE dze.
title: EXODUS

text: Na asoasopɔnkɔ abakan biara fa eguambaa sesa; na sɛ annsesa a, ɔno bu no kɔn mu; na nyimpa mbakan a wɔwɔ wo mbabanyin mu nyinara dze sesa gye hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ ndaamba bi wo ba bisa wo dɛ, Ebɛnadze nye yi a, ase no dɛ, Nsa a ɔyɛ dzen na EWURADZE dze yii hɛn fii Egypt, fii nkowaasom fi no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a nna Farao mmpen dɛ ɔbɛma yɛakɔ no, EWURADZE kunkum Egypt asaase do mbakan nyinara, nyimpa abakan, nye mbowa abakan nyina: dɛm ntsi na mo so medze enyin nyinara a wobue yafun mu no mobɔ EWURADZE afɔr; na me mbabanyin mu mbakan nyinara dze medze mbowa sesa gye hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ wo nsa do asɛnkyerɛdze, nye w’enyiwa ntamu nkaadze: na nsa a ɔyɛ dzen na EWURADZE dze yii hɛn fii Egypt.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, Farao maa ɔman no kwan no, Nyankopɔn ammfa hɔn annkɛfa Filistiafo asaase do kwan do, kaansa ɔno ɔbɛn mpo a; na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Bi a bɛyɛ na ɔman no ekehyia ɔsa, na woenu hɔnho, na wɔasan akɔ Egypt:
title: EXODUS

text: mbom Nyankopɔn dze ɔman no danee faa Mbɛw Po no ho sar do ɔkwan do; na Israelmba no miae fii Egypt asaase do kɔree.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses faa Josef mbiew no kaa no ho: osiandɛ ɔaka Israelmba ntam dɛ, Ampaara Nyankopɔn bɛba abɛsera hom; na hom mfa me mbiew nka hom ho mfi ha nkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wotuu hɔn kwan fii Sukɔt, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Etam, wɔ sar no ano.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE dzii hɔn enyim ewimbir wɔ mununkum dum mu, dɛ ɔrekyerɛ hɔn kwan; na anadwe wɔ gya dum mu, dɛ ɔrema hɔn kan; ama wɔaanantsew ewiaber nye anadwe:
title: EXODUS

text: ewiaber mununkum dum no, nye anadwe gya dum no, wɔanntwe hɔnho emmfi ɔman no enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Ka kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ wɔnsan hɔn ekyir na wɔnkɛkyer nsera wɔ Pi-hahirot a wɔ Migidɔl nye Mbɛw po no ntamu na ɔbɛn Baal-zefon no enyim: ne tsentsendo na hom nkyer nsera no wɔ po no ne nkyɛn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao bɛse wɔ Israelmba ho dɛ, Wɔatoto wɔ asaase no do, sar no atow hɔn mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mibepirim Farao n’akoma, na obetsiw hom; na mebɛhyɛ m’enyim nyam wɔ Farao nye no dɔm nyinara do; na Egyptfo bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE. Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Egypthen no dɛ ɔman no eguan kɔ: na Farao nye no nkowaa no hɔn akoma sakyeree wɔ ɔman no ho, na wɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na yɛayɛ yi, dɛ yɛama Israel egyaa hɛn som kɔ yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔhyehyɛɛ ne tseaseanam, na ɔfaa ne man kaa no ho:
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔfaa ntseaseanam a wɔasan mu eyi ahaesia, na Egypt ntseaseanam nyinara, na hɔn nyinara hɔn do asafohemfo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE piriim Egypthen Farao n’akoma, na otsiiw Israelmba no: na Israelmba no dze ahosɛpɛw kɛse fiir edzi kɔree.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Egyptfo tsiiw hɔn, Farao no mpɔnkɔ nye ne ntseaseanam nyinara, nye no mpɔnkɔdofo, nye no dɔm no, na wɔbɔtoo hɔn dɛ wɔakyer nsera wɔ po no ano, Pi-hahirot nkyɛn, wɔ Baal-zefon enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a Farao bɛnee no, Israel memaa hɔn enyi do, na, hwɛ, Egyptfo etu dzi hɔn ekyir reba; na wosuroo dodow; na Israelmba no sui frɛɛ EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔsee Moses dɛ, Osiandɛ ndakamona nnyi Egypt ntsi, na eyi hɛn hɔ ma yerubowuwu wɔ sar do yi? Ebɛnadze ntsi na enye hɛn edzi no dɛm yi, dɛ iyii hɛn fii Egypt bae yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Ana nnyɛ yi nye asɛm a yɛkaa kyerɛɛ wo wɔ Egypt no, dɛ, Gyaa hɛn ma yɛnsom Egyptfo no? Osiandɛ nkyɛ obeye ama hɛn dɛ yɛbɔsom Egyptfo mbom sen dɛ yebowuwu wɔ sar do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see ɔman no dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro, hom ngyina dzinn, na hom nhwɛ EWURADZE no nkwagye a ɔrebɛyɛ akyerɛ hom ndɛ da yi: na Egyptfo a hom ehu hɔn ndɛ da yi, hom nnkohu hɔn bio dabiarada.
title: EXODUS

text: EWURADZE bɔko ama hom, na hom nka hom ano nto mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE bisaa Moses dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na isu frɛ me yi? Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, ma wɔnkɔ kan.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ma wo poma no do, na tsen wo nsa wɔ po no do, na paa mu: na Israelmba nnantsew mfa po no ne finimfin wɔ daadze kɛsɛɛ do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na emi, hwɛ, mibepirim Egyptfo akoma, na wobedzi hom ekyir: na mebɛhyɛ m’enyim nyam wɔ Farao do, nye no mpɔnkɔdofo do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Egyptfo no bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, aber a mahyɛ m’enyim nyam wɔ Farao do, ne ntseaseanam do, nye no mpɔnkɔdofo do no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Nyankopɔn no bɔfoe a odzi Israel nseraban enyim no, ɔtwee noho na okedzii hɔn ekyir; na mununkum dum no twee fii hɔn enyim, na okegyinaa hɔn ekyir:
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔbaa Egypt nseraban no nye Israel nseraban no ntamu; na ɔyɛɛ mununkum nye sum, naaso ɔmaa kan anadwe: na kor ammba kor nkyɛn anadwe ne nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses tseen ne nsa wɔ po no do; na EWURADZE dze boka mframa dzendzen maa po no kɔr ekyir anadwe no nyinara, na ɔyɛɛ po no asaase kɛsɛɛ, na nsu no mu paae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba no nantsewee faa po no ne finimfin wɔ daadze kɛsɛɛ no do: na nsu no yɛɛ hɔn fadum wɔ hɔn nsa enyimfa, nye hɔn abankum.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Egyptfo no tsiiw hɔn, na wodzii hɔn ekyir kɔr po no ne finimfin, Farao no mpɔnkɔ, ne ntseaseanam, nye no mpɔnkɔdofo nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ anapa dasu mu no, EWURADZE nam ogya nye mununkum dum no mu hwɛɛ Egyptfo dɔm no, na ɔkaa Egyptfo dɔm no gui.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ohuhuaan hɔn ntseaseanam n’anan hwiir ma no ntwee mu yɛɛ dzen: ma dɛm ntsi Egyptfo no see dɛ, Hom mma yemfi Israel enyim nguan; osiandɛ EWURADZE roko tsia Egyptfo dze ma hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Tsen wo nsa wɔ po no do, ma nsu no mbra bio wɔ Egyptfo do, hɔn ntseaseanam do, nye hɔn mpɔnkɔdofo do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses tseen ne nsa wɔ po no do, na adze kyee anapa no po no saan n’ekyir peem dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse no ara, na Egyptfo guanee behyiaa no; na EWURADZE toow Egyptfo guu po no ne finimfin.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nsu no saan ekyir, na ɔbɛkataa ntseaseanam, nye mpɔnkɔdofo no, mekyerɛ Farao no dɔm a wodzii hɔn ekyir kɔr po no ne finimfin no nyinara do; hɔn mu kor mpo annka.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba no dze, wɔnantseew asaase kɛsɛɛ do wɔ po no ne finimfin; na nsu no yɛɛ fadum maa hɔn wɔ hɔn nsa enyimfa, nye hɔn abankum.
title: EXODUS

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE sii gyee Israel nkwa da no fii Egyptfo nsamu nye no: na Israel hun Egyptfo no dɛ woewuwu gu po no ano.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israel hun dwuma kɛse a EWURADZE dzii no wɔ Egyptfo do, na ɔman no suroo EWURADZE: na wɔgyee EWURADZE, nye n’akowaa Moses dzii.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses nye Israelmba no toow ndwom yi maa EWURADZE, na wɔkaa dɛ, Mobɔtow ndwom ama EWURADZE, osiandɛ ɔama noho do enyimnyam mu: Ɔpɔnkɔ nye no do tsefo no ɔatow hɔn egu po mu.
title: EXODUS

text: EWURADZE nye m’ahoɔdzen nye mo ndwom, Na ɔabɛyɛ mo nkwagye: Oyi nye me Nyankopɔn, na mibeyi no ayɛw; M’egya ne Nyankopɔn a, na mubohuhor no.
title: EXODUS

text: EWURADZE yɛ ɔsabarimba: EWURADZE nye ne dzin.
title: EXODUS

text: Farao ne ntseaseanam nye no dɔm no ɔatow hɔn egu po mu: Na n’asafohemfo a wɔasan mu eyi no wɔamemem Mbɛw Po no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Ebun akata hɔn do: Wɔamemem kɔ ase too dɛ ɔbo.
title: EXODUS

text: EWURADZE, wo nsa enyimfa yɛ tum mu onyimnyamfo, EWURADZE, wo nsa enyimfa dwerew ɔtamfo no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na w’abɔso akɛseyɛ no mu ara na edze butuw hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia wo no: Ɔwo soma w’ebufuhyew ba, ɔhyew hɔn dɛ eburonan.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wo hwen mu ehuw mu na nsu no ano boae, Nsuyirii no gyinaa bantsenn dɛ kuw: Ebun no kyekyeer wɔ po akoma mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔtamfo no see dɛ, Mibetsiw hɔn, mobɔto hɔn, mebɛkyɛ asadze no mu: Wɔbɛmee me kra; Mobɔtwe m’afona, me nsa bɛsɛɛ hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔwo dze wo mframa huwii, epo no kataa hɔn do: Wɔmeem dɛ sumbui wɔ nsu kɛse no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: EWURADZE, woana na ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, wɔ enyame mu? Woana na ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, krɔnkrɔnyɛ mu onyimnyamfo, Ayɛyi mu ɔhoyifo, anwanwadzeyɛfo?
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔwo tseen wo nsa enyimfa, Asaase meen hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔwo wo mbɔbɔrhu mu na egya ɔman a apon hɔn no kwan: Ɔwo w’ahoɔdzen mu na egya hɔn akɔ wo tsenabew krɔnkrɔn no.
title: EXODUS

text: Aman atsetse, hɔn ho rihim: Ahopopo aka hɔn a wɔtse Filistia.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna Edom asafohen mpanyimfo bɔɔ hu; Moab akatakyi no, ahohim aka hɔn: Hɔn a wɔtse Keenan nyinara anan anan.
title: EXODUS

text: Nketsenketse nye suro ekitsa hɔn; W’abasa ne kɛseyɛ ntsi wɔayeyɛ dzindzinn dɛ ɔbo; Kodu dɛ wo man botwa mu, EWURADZE, Kodu dɛ wo man a enya hɔn no botwa mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔwo dze hɔn bɛba, na abɛtsɛw hɔn wɔ w’egyapadze bepɔw no do, Bea a, EWURADZE, edze ayɛ wo tsenabew no a, Krɔnkrɔnbea a, EWURADZE, edze wo nsa dze etsim hɔ no a.
title: EXODUS

text: EWURADZE bedzi hen daa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Farao no mpɔnkɔ nye ne ntseaseanam na ɔnye no mpɔnkɔdofo na wɔkɔr po no mu, na EWURADZE maa po no mu nsu no sanee bɛkataa hɔn do; na Israelmba no dze wɔnantseew asaase kɛsɛɛ do wɔ po ne finimfin.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Miriam, Aaron n’akyerɛbaa no, faa mfuaba kitsae: na mbaa no nyinara dze mfuaba na ɔnye asaw puei dzii n’ekyir.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Miriam gyee hɔn do dɛ, Hom ntow ndwom mma EWURADZE, na oedzi konyim wɔ enyimnyam mu; Ɔpɔnkɔ nye no do tsefo no ɔatow hɔn egu po mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses gyaa Israel fii Mbɛw Po no ho kɔr kan, na wɔkɔr Sur sar do, na wɔnantseew sar no do ndaansa, na woennhu nsu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔbaa Mara no, woenntum annom Mara nsu no bi, osiandɛ ɔyɛ wen: dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Mara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔman no hwinhwiin Moses ho dɛ, Ebɛnadze na yɛnnom?
title: EXODUS

text: Na osui frɛɛ EWURADZE; na EWURADZE kyerɛɛ no dua bi, na ɔtowee kyeen nsu no mu, na nsu no yɛɛ dɛw. Hɔ na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn ahyɛdze nye mbra, na hɔ so na ɔsɔɔ hɔn hwɛe;
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ ibetsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze yie, na ayɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ n’enyiwa do, na ayɛ aso wɔ ne mbransɛm do, na edzi n’ahyɛdze nyinara do a, ɔnodze mennkɛfa yarba biara a medze megu Egyptfo do no bi megu wo do: na emi nye EWURADZE a ɔsa wo yarba no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔbaa Elim, mbrɛ nsunyiwa duebien, nye mbɛdua eduosuon wɔ: na wɔkyeer nsera wɔ hɔ wɔ nsu no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wotui fii Elim, na Israel mboanofo no nyinara baa Sin sar a ɔda Elim nye Sinai ntamu no do, nna wofii Egypt asaase do no, no bosoom a otsia ebien no mu da a otsia duenum nye no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba mboanofo man mu nyinara hwinhwiin Moses nye Aaron ho wɔ sar no do:
title: EXODUS

text: na Israelmba no see hɔn dɛ, Mbom nkyɛ EWURADZE mma yenwuwu ne nsaano wɔ Egypt asaase do, aber a yɛtsetse nam nkutu ho no, aber a yedzi edziban mee no; osiandɛ hom dze hɛn efir edzi aba sar yi do, dɛ hom dze akɔmfun rubokuku mboanofo man mu yi nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Hwɛ, mebɛma edziban efi sor atɔ ama hom; na ɔman no befir edzi akɛtase dza ɔbɔso hɔn ano da kor wɔ ne da mu, ma maasɔ hɔn mahwɛ kyerɛ dɛ wobedzi me mbra do anaa wonnkedzi do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ da a otsia esia no, wobesiesie dza wɔdze ba no, na ɔbɛyɛ dza wɔtase no daa no no mbɔho ebien.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron see Israelmba no nyinara dɛ, Ewimbir nna hom bohu dɛ EWURADZE eyi hom efi Egypt asaase do:
title: EXODUS

text: na anapa nna hom bohu EWURADZE n’enyimnyam; osiandɛ ɔtse hom ehwinhwin a hom hwinhwin EWURADZE ho no: na hɛn dze, ebɛnadze nye hɛn, na hom hwinhwin hɛn ho?
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Iyi bɛba, EWURADZE bɛma hom nam ewimbir ma woeedzi, na edziban anapa ma wɔaamee, osiandɛ EWURADZE tse hom ehwinhwin a hom dze hwinhwin no ho: na ebɛnadze nye hɛn? Nnyɛ hɛn ho na hom hwinhwin, mbom EWURADZE ho a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see Aaron dɛ, Se Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara dɛ, Hom ntwe mpin EWURADZE enyim: na ɔatse hom ehwinhwin no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Aaron rekasa kyerɛ Israelmba mboanofo nyinara no, wɔdandaan hɔn enyi kɔr sar no do, na hwɛ, EWURADZE enyimnyam puei wɔ mununkum no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Matse Israelmba ehwinhwin no: ka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Ewimbir hom bedzi nam, na anapa hom edzi edziban amee; na hom ehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ewimbir no Nkokɔhwerɛw bae, na wɔbɛkataa nseraban no do: na anapa no ɔbɔw tɔr nseraban no ho hyiae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbɔw a ɔtɔree no kɔr sor no, hwɛ, adze bi nkorkorba nketsenketse deda sar no enyi, nketsenketse dɛ famu ɔbɔsu kyenkyenee.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a Israelmba hunii no, wɔsesee hɔnho nkorkor dɛ, Ebɛnadze nye yi? Osiandɛ wonnyim adze kor no. Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, Iyi nye edziban a EWURADZE dze ama hom dɛ hom ndzi.
title: EXODUS

text: Iyi nye adze a EWURADZE ahyɛ, Hom ntase bi dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa biara n’edzidzi tse; olonka nkorkor, dɛ mbrɛ hom nyimpa dodow tse, nna hom mfefa, nyimpa biara mfa mma hɔn a wɔwɔ n’asesee mu no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dɛm, na wɔtasee, binom dze so, binom dze suar.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔdze olonka susui no, nyia ɔtasee pii no oennya bi ammbor do, na nyia ɔtasee kumaabi no annka no bi: wɔtasee dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa biara n’edzidzi tse.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, Mma obi nngya bi ma adze nnkye do.
title: EXODUS

text: Naaso woenntsie Moses; mbom hɔn mu binom gyaa bi ma adze kyee do, na ɔdɔɔ mbowaba, na ɔbɔnee; na Moses no bo fuuw hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔtasee no anapa anapa, nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ n’edzidzi tse: na ewia ano yɛɛ dzen no, ɔnanee.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, da a otsia esia no wɔtasee edziban no mbɔho, ɔbaako dze yɛ olonka ebien: na mboanofo no mu mpanyimfo nyinara baa bɛkaa kyerɛɛ Moses.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Iyi nye dza EWURADZE aka no, Ɔkyena yɛ awɔse ahomgye, ahomgyeda krɔnkrɔn ma EWURADZE: hom nto dza hom bɔto, na hom nnoa dza hom bɔnoa; na dza ɔka no nyinara hom mfa nsie ma adze nkye do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔdze siee ma okodur anapa, dɛ mbrɛ Moses hyɛe no: na ɔammbɔn, nkyii so abowaba bi nnyi mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Hom ndzi ɔno ndɛ; na ndɛ ɔyɛ ahomgyeda ma EWURADZE: ndɛ hom nnkohu bi wɔ haban mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Nda esia na hom ntase; na da a otsia esuon no dze ɔyɛ ahomgyeda, ɔno mu bi nnkɛba hɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia esuon no, ɔman no mu bi fiir edzi dɛ wɔrekɛtase, na woennhu bi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Hom ropow dɛ wodzi me mbransɛm nye me mbra do ma ekodu dabɛn?
title: EXODUS

text: Hom nhwɛ, osiandɛ EWURADZE ama hom ahomgyeda ntsi, na da a otsia esia no ɔma hom nda ebien edziban: hom mu nyimpa biara ntsena ne tsenabew, mma obiara mmfir edzi mmfi ne tsenabew wɔ da a otsia esuon no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna ɔman no hoom da a otsia esuon no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israel fi frɛɛ ne dzin Manna: nna ɔtse dɛ wusa aba, fitaa, na ne dɛw tse dɛ tatar ntrɛtraba a wɔdze ewo ayɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Iyi nye adze a EWURADZE ahyɛ, Wɔmfa bi nhyɛ esusudze olonka ma mfa nsie hom ebusuasantsen; ama woeehu edziban a medze menyɛɛn hom wɔ sar no do, aber a miyii hom fii Egypt asaase do no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see Aaron dɛ, Fa kutu bi, na fa manna esusudze olonka kor gu mu, na fa si EWURADZE enyim, ma wɔmfa nsie hom ebusuasantsen.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no, dɛmara so na Aaron dze sii Adasehyɛdze no enyim, ma wɔdze eesie.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba dzii manna no mfe eduanan, dze kodur dɛ wɔbaa asaase a nyimpa tse do do; wodzii manna no, dze kodur dɛ wɔbaa Keenan asaase no ntoaado.
title: EXODUS

text: Afei esusudze olonka yɛ efa mu ebupɛn du mu kor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara tui fii Sin sar no do, wɔ hɔn akwantu mu, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE mbrasɛm tse, na wɔkɛkyekyeer nsera wɔ Refidim: na nsu nnyi hɔ mma ɔman no dɛ wɔbɔnom.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔman no nye Moses hamee, na wɔsee dɛ, Ma hɛn nsu ma yɛnnom. Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom nye me reham? Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rosɔ EWURADZE ahwɛ yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Na nsukɔm dzee ɔman no wɔ hɔ; na ɔman no hwinhwiin Moses ho, na wɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na iyii hɛn fii Egypt bae, dɛ edze nsukɔm ruboku hɛn nye hɛn mba nye hɛn mbowa yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses sui frɛɛ EWURADZE see dɛ, Ebɛnadze na menyɛ memma ɔman yi? Aka kakra ma woeesiw me abo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Pa ho kedzi ɔman no enyim, na fa Israel mpanyin no bi ka woho; na wo poma a edze bɔɔ esutsen no, fa kitsa wo nsamu, na kɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Hwɛ, mibegyina w’enyim wɔ hɔ wɔ Horeb ɔbotan no do; na bɔ ɔbotan no, na nsu befi mu aba, ma ɔman no aanom. Na Moses yɛɛ dɛm wɔ Israel mpanyin no enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Massa, nye Meriba, osian Israelmba hɔn ham no ntsi, na EWURADZE a wɔsɔɔ no hwɛe see dɛ, Ana EWURADZE wɔ hɛn mu, anaa onnyi mu ntsi a?
title: EXODUS

text: Nna Amalek bae, na ɔnye Israel bɔkoe wɔ Refidim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see Josua dɛ, San mu yiyi mbanyin ma hɛn, na fir edzi kɔ, nye Amalek nkɔko: ɔkyena medze Nyankopɔn poma no bekitsa me nsamu mekegyina koko no etsifi.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna Josua yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Moses see no no, na ɔnye Amalek kɔkoe: na Moses, Aaron, nye Hur fowee kɔr koko no etsifi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ Moses ma ne nsa do a, nna Israel edzi nyim: na sɛ ɔto ne nsa famu a, nna Amalek edzi nyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses ne nsa gyenee; na wɔfaa ɔbo, na wɔdze too n’ase, na ɔtsenaa do; na Aaron nye Hur susuoo ne nsamu gyinae, ɔbaako dze afa, na ɔbaako so dze afa so; na ne nsa gyinaa dzinn kodur witɔree.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Josua dwereew Amalek nye ne man afona ano.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Kyerɛw iyi wɔ nwoma mu fa yɛ nkaa, na ka hyɛ Josua n’asomu: dɛ pepa ara na mebɛpepa Amalek ho nkaa mefi ɔsor ase.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses sii afɔrmbukyia, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Yahweh-nissi, (a ase nye, EWURADZE nye me frankaa),
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE esua: EWURADZE nye Amalek bedzi ako fi ebusuasantsen do ekodu ebusuasantsen do.
title: EXODUS

text: Afei Jetro, Midian ɔsɔfo no, Moses n’asew no, tsee dza Nyankopɔn ayɛ ama Moses, nye ne man Israel no nyinara, mbrɛ EWURADZE esi eyi Israel efi Egypt.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Jetro, Moses n’asew no, faa Zipora, Moses yer a ɔama ɔasan kɔ no,
title: EXODUS

text: nye ne mbabanyin beenu a ɔbaako ne dzin dze Gersom; osiandɛ ɔkaa dɛ, Mayɛ amanandze hɔho:
title: EXODUS

text: na kor no so ne dzin dze Eliezer, osiandɛ ɔsee dɛ, M’egya ne Nyankopɔn yɛɛ mo mboa, na oyii me fii Farao n’afona anomu:
title: EXODUS

text: na Jetro, Moses n’asew no, dze ne mbabanyin no nye ne yer no baa Moses nkyɛn wɔ sar no do mbrɛ ɔkɛkyeer nsera no, wɔ Nyankopɔn bepɔw no ho:
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔsee Moses dɛ, Emi w’asew Jetro, nye wo yer, nye wo mbabanyin beenu no ka no ho, aba wo nkyɛn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses fiir edzi kehyiaa n’asew, na ɔkotowee, na ɔfeew n’ano; na wobisabisaa hɔn apɔwmu; na wɔbaa asese mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses kaa dza osian Israel ntsi EWURADZE dze ayɛ Farao nye Egyptfo nyinara kyerɛɛ n’asew, awoko a ɔbaa hɔn do wɔ ɔkwan no mu nyinara, na mbrɛ EWURADZE sii yii hɔn no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Jetro dzii dɛw wɔ papa a EWURADZE ayɛ ama Israel, wɔ dɛ oyii hɔn fii Egyptfo nsamu no nyinara ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Jetro see dɛ, Nhyira nka EWURADZE a oeyi hom efi Egyptfo nsamu, na woefi Farao nsamu; ɔno a oeyi ɔman no efi Egyptfo nsaadze.
title: EXODUS

text: Afei na mehu dɛ EWURADZE yɛ kɛse kyɛn enyame nyinara: nyew, adze a wɔdze dzi hɔn do nkontompɔsɛm no ara mu a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Jetro, Moses n’asew no, faa ɔhyew afɔr nye okum afɔr kɛmaa Nyankopɔn: na Aaron nye Israel mpanyin nyinara baa dɛ wɔnye Moses n’asew no ribedzidzi wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyee no, Moses tsenaa famu dɛ orubu ɔman no atsɛn: na ɔman no gyinaa Moses do tsentsen fi anapa kodur ewimbir.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a Moses n’asew hun dza ɔyɛe maa ɔman no nyinara no, ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ereyɛ ma ɔman yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na woara nko etse hɔ, na ɔman no nyinara gyinagyina wo do tsentsen fi anapa ebodu ewimbir yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see n’asew no dɛ, Osiandɛ ɔman no ba me nkyɛn Nyankopɔn hɔ ebisa:
title: EXODUS

text: sɛ wonya asɛm bi a, wɔba me nkyɛn; na mubu nyimpa nye ne nyɛnko ntamu atsɛn, na mema wohu Nyankopɔn n’ahyɛdze, nye ne mbra.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses n’asew no see no dɛ, Adze a eyɛ yi onnye.
title: EXODUS

text: Ampa ebɛberɛ, ɔwo nye ɔman a wɔka wo ho yi nyina, osiandɛ adze no yɛ dur dodow ma wo; ɔwo woara nko irunntum nnyɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Afei tsie me ndze, mebɛma wo apam, na Nyankopɔn ndzi w’ekyir; ɔwo gyina Nyankopɔn afamu ma ɔman no, na fa nsɛm no brɛ Nyankopɔn:
title: EXODUS

text: na kyerɛkyerɛ hɔn ahyɛdze no nye mbra no, na ma wonhu ɔkwan kor a ɔwɔ dɛ wɔnantsew mu, na edwuma a ɔwɔ dɛ wɔyɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Afei so yiyi ɔman no nyinara mu mbanyin a wotum a wosuro Nyankopɔn a wɔyɛ anokwafo a wokyir enyikaber, na fa hɔn sisi hɔn do, ma wɔnyɛ apem apem do mpanyin, ɔha ɔha do mpanyin, eduonum eduonum do mpanyin, nye du du do mpanyin;
title: EXODUS

text: na ma wombu ɔman no ntsɛn aber nyinara mu: na ɔmbra dɛ asɛnkɛse biara dze wɔmfa mbrɛ wo, na nsɛnketseaba nyinara dze, hɔnara wondzi: ama aayɛ wo do har, na wɔnye wo aasoa adzesoa no.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ eyɛ dɛm adze yi, na Nyankopɔn hyɛ wo dɛm a, ɔno na ibotum asɔw, na ɔman yi nyinara so bɔkɔ hɔn tsenabew dwudwoodwo.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna Moses tsiee n’asew ne ndze, na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔsee no nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses yiyii Israel nyinara mu nyimpa a wotum, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn etsitsir wɔ ɔman no do, apem apem do mpanyin, ɔha ɔha do mpanyin, eduonum eduonum do mpanyin, nye du du do mpanyin.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wobuu ɔman no ntsɛn aber nyinara mu: nsɛm a ɔyɛ dzen no wɔdze brɛɛ Moses, na nsɛnketseaba dze hɔnara wodzii.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses gyaa n’asew no kwan; na ɔfaa no kwan kɔr nankasa n’asaase do.
title: EXODUS

text: Bosoom a otsia ebiasa a Israelmba sii mu fii Egypt asaase do no, da no ara na wɔbaa Sinai sar do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a wotui fii Refidim, na wɔbaa Sinai sar do no, wɔkyeer nsera wɔ sar no do; na hɔ na Israel kyeer nsera wɔ bepɔw no enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses fowee kɔr Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na EWURADZE fii bepɔw no do frɛɛ no see dɛ, Dɛm na se Jakob fi, na ka kyerɛ Israelmba;
title: EXODUS

text: Hom ehu dza medze mayɛ Egyptfo, na mbrɛ mosoaa hom nkɔr ntsaban do, na medze hom baa mara me nkyɛn.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, sɛ hom betsie me ndze ara ampa, na woedzi m’ahyɛmu do a, ɔnodze, hom bɛyɛ egyapadze a ɔsom bo efi aman nyinara mu ama me: osiandɛ asaase nyinara yɛ medze:
title: EXODUS

text: na hom bɛyɛ asɔfo ahendzi, nye ɔman krɔnkrɔn ama me. Iyinom nye nsɛm a fa ka kyerɛ Israelmba no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses bae na ɔbɛfrɛɛ ɔman mpanyimfo no, na ɔdze nsɛm yi a EWURADZE dze hyɛɛ no nyinara too hɔn enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔman no nyinara bɔɔ mu buae, na wɔsee dɛ, Dza EWURADZE aka nyinara, yɛbɛyɛ. Na Moses kɛkaa ɔman no hɔn nsɛm no kyerɛɛ EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Hwɛ, mereba wo nkyɛn wɔ mununkum kebii mu, ama sɛ menye wo kasa a ɔman no aatse, na eso wɔaagye wo edzi daa. Na Moses kaa ɔman no hɔn nsɛm no kyerɛɛ EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Kɔ ɔman no nkyɛn, na tsew hɔn ho ndɛ nye ɔkyena, na ma wɔnhohor hɔn ntar,
title: EXODUS

text: na wonsiesie hɔnho nsie da a otsia ebiasa no: na da a otsia ebiasa no EWURADZE besian wɔ ɔman no nyinara enyim aba bepɔw Sinai do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na bɔ ɔman no ho ɔheban hyia, se dɛ, Hom nhwɛ homho yie, ma hom aammfow bepɔw no, anaa hom annkɛka ne he: obiara a ɔbɛka bepɔw no oku na woboku no:
title: EXODUS

text: nsa biara nnka no, mbom abo na wonsiw no, anaa tow na wɔntow no ma onhwira mu; sɛ abowa o, nyimpa o, orinnya nkwa: sɛ abɛn no hɛn kyɛr a, wɔmfow bepɔw no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses sianee fi bepɔw no do kɔr ɔman no nkyɛn, na ɔtseew ɔman no ho; na wɔhohoor hɔn ntar.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee ɔman no dɛ, Hom nsiesie homho nsie da a otsia ebiasa no: mma wɔnnkɔ ɔbaa biara ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia ebiasa no, anapa no, asenaman nye enyinam, nye mununkum kebii baa bepɔw no do, na abɛn ndze dzendzen mbordo; na ɔman a wɔwɔ nseraban no mu nyinara ho popoe.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses dze ɔman no fir edzi fii nseraban no mu dɛ worikehyia Nyankopɔn; na wokegyinagyinaa bepɔw no ase afamu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na bepɔw Sinai no nyinara rupun wusiw, osiandɛ EWURADZE nam gya mu sianee baa do: na no wusiw no tui kɔr sor dɛ fononoo mu wusiw, na bepɔw no nyinara wosoow kɛsenara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na abɛn no ne ndze yɛɛ dzendzenndzen dodow no, Moses kasae, na Nyankopɔn dze ndze gyee no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE sianee baa bepɔw Sinai do, wɔ bepɔw no etsifi: na EWURADZE frɛɛ Moses dɛ ɔnkɔ bepɔw no etsifi: na Moses fowee kɔree.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Sian famu behyia ɔman no, amma wɔaanntsetsew mu ammba EWURADZE nkyɛn ammbɔhwɛ, ma hom mu pii aanntotɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ma asɔfo no so a wɔba EWURADZE nkyɛn no ntsew hɔnho, amma EWURADZE eenntu annhyɛ hɔn do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see EWURADZE dɛ, Ɔman no runntum mmfow mmba bepɔw Sinai do: osiandɛ woara hyɛɛ hɛn dɛ, Bɔ bepɔw no ho ɔheban hyia, na tsew ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Kɔ, sian famu; na fow bra, ɔwo, nye Aaron ka wo ho: na mma asɔfo no nye ɔman no nntsetsew mu mmfow mmba EWURADZE nkyɛn, amma oeenntu annhyɛ hɔn do.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna Moses sianee kɔr ɔman no nkyɛn, na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Nyankopɔn kaa nsɛm yi nyinara, see dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Emi nye EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn a miyii wo wɔ Egypt asaase do, wɔ nkowaasom fi mu no.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma nnya enyame fofor nnka mo ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma nnyɛ ohonyi bi, anaa adze a ɔwɔ wimu wɔ sor, anaa dza ɔwɔ asaase do wɔ famu, anaa dza ɔwɔ nsu mu wɔ asaase ase, ne saso mma woho:
title: EXODUS

text: mma mmbɔ wo mu adze mma hɔn, na nnsom hɔn: na emi EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn meyɛ Nyame nyinkufo a medze egyanom hɔn emumuyɛ bɔhwɛ mba, ekodu ebusuasantsen ebiasa nye anan a wɔtan me do;
title: EXODUS

text: na muhu mpempem a wɔdɔ me na wodzi me mbransɛm do mbɔbɔr.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma mmbɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dzin gyangyan, na EWURADZE nnkɛma nyia no a ɔbɔ ne dzin gyangyan afa noho tɔtrɔtɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Kaa ahomgyeda no na sie no krɔnkrɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Nda esia na yɛ edwuma, na dzi wo dwuma nyinara:
title: EXODUS

text: na da a otsia esuon no yɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ahomgyeda: mma nnyɛ edwuma biara wɔ mu, ɔwo o, wo babanyin o, wo babaa o, w’akowaa o, w’afonabaa o, wo mbowa o, wo hɔho a ɔwɔ wo kuropon mu o:
title: EXODUS

text: na nda esia na EWURADZE bɔɔ sor nye asaase, po, nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, na ɔhoom da a otsia esuon no: dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE hyiraa ahomgyeda no, na ɔyɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Dzi w’egya nye wo na nyi: ama wo nda aawar wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma nndzi ewu.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma nnto awar.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma nnwia adze.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma nngye wo nyɛnko ho dasewia.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma w’enyi mmber wo nyɛnko fi, mma w’enyi mmber ne yer, anaa n’akowaa, anaa n’afonabaa, anaa ne nantwi, anaa n’asoaso, anaa biribiara a ɔyɛ wo nyɛnko dze.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a ɔman no nyinara hun asenaman no, nye enyinam no, nye bepɔw a orupun wusiw no, na wɔtsee abɛn ndze no, hɔn ho popoe, na wokegyinaa ekyirekyir.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔsee Moses dɛ, Woara nye hɛn nkasa, na yebetsie: na mma Nyankopɔn nnye hɛn nnkasa, ɔno yebowuwu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see ɔman no dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro: na Nyankopɔn aba dɛ ɔrobɔsɔ hom ahwɛ, ama no ho suro aaba hom enyi do, ma hom aannyɛ bɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔman no gyinaa ekyirekyir, na Moses twee bɛɛn sum kadoo no mbrɛ Nyankopɔn wɔ no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Mbrɛ se Israelmba nye yi, Homara hom ehu dɛ mifi ɔsor na menye hom akasa.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma hom nnyɛ me saso enyame bi mma hom ho; dwetɛ enyame, anaa sika enyame o, mma hom nnyɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛtse afɔrmbukyia na yɛ ma me, na dze wo hyew afɔr, nye w’asomdwee afɔr, wo nguan, nye w’anantwi no bɔ do afɔr: beebiara a mebɛma wɔakaa me dzin no, mebɛba wo nkyɛn na mebehyira wo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ ereyɛ abo afɔrmbukyia ama me: mma mmfa abo a woetwa nnsia osiandɛ sɛ ema w’edwindadze do bɔ do a, egu ho fi.
title: EXODUS

text: Nkyii so mma mmfow atwer nnkɔ afɔrmbukyia do, amma w’adagyaw aannda edzi wɔ do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na iyinom nye ntsɛmbusɛm a fa to hɔn enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ etɔ akowaa a ɔyɛ Hebriwnyi a, mfe esia na ɔnsom: na dza otsia esuon no mu ɔmfa no ho ndzi nkɔ kwa.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ noara nko na ɔbae a, noara nko nkɔ: sɛ ɔawar a, ɔno ne yer nye no nkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ no wura ma no yer, na ɔwo mbabanyin anaa mbabaa ma no a, yer no nye ne mba nyɛ ɔbaa no no wura dze, na noara nko nkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ akowaa no ka no petee dɛ, Modɔ mo wura, me yer, nye me mba; mennkɛfa moho edzi akɔ a:
title: EXODUS

text: ɔno no wura no mfa no mbra Nyankopɔn enyim, na ɔmfa no mbra ɔpon ho, anaa ɔpon dua ho; na no wura no mfa fitsii mfitsi n’asomu; na ɔnsom no daa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ ɔbanyin bi tɔn ne babaa ma ɔkɛyɛ afonabaa a, ɔnodze mma ɔmmfa noho nndzi nnkɔ dɛ mbrɛ akowaa no yɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ ɔnnsɔ no wura a noara ɔagye no ayewar no enyi a, ɔnodze wɔmma wɔmbɔpon no: onnyi tum dɛ ɔtɔn no ma ɔnanaben bi, osiandɛ ɔadaadaa no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ ɔgye no ayewar ma ne babanyin a, ɔnyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ wɔdze yɛ mbabaa.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ ɔgye yer fofor ma no a; mma onnkuw n’edziban, n’akataho, nye n’awar edwuma do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ ɔannyɛ iyinom ebiasa yi amma no a, ɔnodze ɔmfa noho ndzi nkɔ kwa, sika bi nnyi mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Nyia ɔbɔ nyimpa ma owu no, oku na wonku no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa annkɔ atsɛwee, na Nyankopɔn na ɔama ne nsa apa dze a; ɔno mibeyi beebi mama wo na oeeguan akɔ hɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi ba ne nyɛnko do enyidaho mu dze ndaadaa ku no a; yi no fi m’afɔrmbukyia ho, ma onwu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nyia ɔbɔ n’egya, anaa ne na no, oku na wonku no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nyia owia nyimpa, na ɔtɔn no no, anaa sɛ wohu no wɔ ne nsamu a, oku na wonku no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nyia ɔdom n’egya, anaa ne na no, oku na wonku no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi woridzi aper, na kor bɔ kor no ɔbo, anaa kutuku, na oennwu, na ɔka no to ne mpa do a:
title: EXODUS

text: sɛ ɔsoɛr bio, na osuo no poma mu nantsew fir edzi a, ɔnodze nyia ɔbɔɔ no no no ho nyɛ no tɔtrɔtɔ: ne mber a asɛɛ no nko na ontua kaw, na ɔmma wɔnsa no yarba koraa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bobɔ n’akowaa, anaa n’afonabaa abaa, ma owu ne nsaano a; ɔno wondzi no wer.
title: EXODUS

text: Naaso sɛ ɔtsena hɔ da kor anaa nda ebien a, mma wonndzi no wer: osiandɛ ɔyɛ ne sika.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ mbanyin roko, na wopira onyinsemfo, ma ɔpon ɔba, na mbusu bi ammba ekyir dze a: brabo na wɔngye no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaa no no kun dze bɔto no do no; na ontua no dɛ mbrɛ ntsɛmbuafo no bɛkyerɛ no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ mbusu bi ba ekyir a, ɔnodze fa nkwa hyɛ nkwa ananmu,
title: EXODUS

text: enyiwa hyɛ enyiwa ananmu, se hyɛ se ananmu, nsa hyɛ nsa ananmu, anan hyɛ anan ananmu,
title: EXODUS

text: hyehyew hyɛ hyehyew ananmu, ɔkam hyɛ ɔkam ananmu, mfemfem hyɛ mfemfem ananmu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ obi bɔ n’akowaa enyiwa, anaa n’afonabaa enyiwa na ɔsɛɛ no a, n’enyiwa no ntsi ɔmma ɔmfa noho ndzi nkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ ɔbɔ n’akowaa ne se tu no, anaa n’afonabaa ne se a; ne se no ntsi ɔmma ɔmfa noho ndzi nkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ ɔnantwi sɛ ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa, ma owu a, ɔno ɔnantwi no wonsiw no abo, na mma wonndzi ne nam; na ɔnantwi no wura dze wongyaa no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ ɔnantwi no ɔtɔ sesɛ dada na wɔama no wura atse, na oennsie no fie, na oekoku ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa dze a; ɔnantwi no wonsiw no abo, na no wura no so wonku no.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ wɔbɛgye no mpata a, ɔno ɔmma adze biara a wɔbɛgye no no mfa ntɔ no nkwa.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ ɔbabanyin na ɔasɛ no o, ɔbabaa na ɔasɛ no o, atsɛmbu yi ara na wɔmfa mbu no.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ ɔnantwi no sɛ akowaa anaa afonabaa a; ɔno ɔmma hɔn wura dwetɛ dwetɛbona eduasa, na wonsiw ɔnantwi no abo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi kobue amona do, anaa sɛ nyimpa bi kotu amona na ɔannkata do, na ɔnantwi anaa asoaso kɔhwe mu a,
title: EXODUS

text: ma no wura no nhyɛ ananmu; ɔmfa sika mma hɔn wura no, na mbowafun no nyɛ nedze.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa kor bi ne nantwi pira kor nedze ma owu a; ɔno wɔntɔn nantwi nyikan no, na wɔnkyɛ ne tsiadze no; na fun no so wɔnkyɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Mbom sɛ wonyim dɛ ɔnantwi no ɔtɔ sesɛ dada, na no wura no ammfa no ennsie fie a; ɔno ɔmfa ɔnantwi nhyɛ ɔnantwi ananmu, na abowafun no nyɛ noara nedze.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ nyimpa bi kowia nantwi, anaa guan, na oku no, anaa ɔtɔn no a; ɔmfa anantwi enum nhyɛ nantwi kor ananmu, na nguan anan nhyɛ guan kor ananmu ntua kaw.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ wohu owifo no dɛ oebubu mu reba, na wɔbɔ no adze ma owu a, bɔgya asodzi nnyi hɔ mma no.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ ewia pue no do a, bɔgya asodzi wɔ hɔ ma no: ahyɛnanmu na ɔnyɛ; sɛ onnyi hwee a, ɔno n’adzewia ntsi wɔntɔn no.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ wohu adzewiadze no wɔ ne nsamu enyikan a, sɛ ɔyɛ ɔnantwi o, asoaso o, oguan o, ontua kaw mbɔho.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ nyimpa bi ma wodzi haban anaa wenyin ture mu adze, na ogyaa n’abowa ma okedzi nyimpa kor so ne haban mu adze a, ɔmfa nankasa ne haban mu ndzepa, nye nankasa no wenyin ture mu ndzepa bi nhyɛ ananmu.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ ogya pue, na ɔkɔsɔ nsoɛ mu ma eburow ekuwekuw, anaa eburow a ogyinagyina hɔ, anaa haban no hyew a; ɔhyɛ na nyia ɔsɔɔ gya no nhyɛ ananmu.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ nyimpa bi dze sika anaa efidze ma ne nyɛnko esie, na wowia no wɔ nyimpa no ne fie a; sɛ wohu owifo no a, ontua kaw mbɔho.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ woennhu owifo no a, ɔno fiwura no ntwe mbɛn Nyankopɔn nhwɛ kyerɛ dɛ ɔnntsen ne nsa nnka ne nyɛnko n’adze no a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mbrato ho asɛm biara, sɛ ɔyɛ ɔnantwi dze o, asoaso dze o, oguan dze o, anaa adze a ayew biara a obi bɛse wɔ ho dɛ, Ɔno nye yi o, wɔmfa hɔn beenu nyina hɔn asɛm mbra Nyankopɔn enyim; nyia Nyankopɔn bobu no fɔ no, ontua kaw mbɔho mma ne nyɛnko no.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ nyimpa bi dze asoaso, anaa nantwi, anaa guan, anaa abowa biara ma ne nyɛnko esie; na owu anaa opira, anaa wɔka no to hamu, na nyimpa bi ennhu a:
title: EXODUS

text: EWURADZE ntam mbra hɔn beenu no ntamu, kyerɛ dɛ ɔnntsen ne nsa nnka ne nyɛnko no n’adze no a: na adze no wura no ɔmpen do, na mma ɔnnhyɛ ananmu.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ wowia no wɔ ne nkyɛn dze a, ɔnhyɛ adze no wura ananmu.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ wɔatsetsew no esinesin a, ɔmfa mbra mbedzi dase; dza wɔatsetsew no no mma ɔnnhyɛ ananmu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi kɛfɛm biribi wɔ ne nyɛnko hɔ, na ɔsɛɛ, anaa owu, dɛ adze no wura no no ho nnyi mu a, ɔhyɛ na ɔnhyɛ ananmu.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ adze no wura no no ho wɔ mu a, mma ɔnnhyɛ ananmu: sɛ ɔyɛ apaabɔ adze a, na ogyina n’apaabɔdze do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi kɛdaadaa ɔbaabun a wɔnngyee no yer, na ɔnye no da a, ɔno ɔmma ne tsiadze ma ɔnyɛ ne yer.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ n’egya pow koraa dɛ ɔdze no ma no a, onker sika mma, dɛ mbrɛ mbaabun tsiadze tse.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma mma ɔbaa anyɛn kwan ma ɔntsena ase.
title: EXODUS

text: Obiara a ɔnye abowa bɛda no, oku na wonku no.
title: EXODUS

text: Nyia ɔbɔbɔ afɔr ama onyame biara, na nnyɛ EWURADZE nko no, wɔnsɛɛ no koraa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔhɔho dze mma nnyɛ no bɔn, nkyii so mma nnhaw no: osiandɛ hom yɛɛ ahɔho wɔ Egypt asaase do.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma hom nntseetsee ɔbaa kunafo biara, anaa egyankaba.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ etseetsee hɔn ɔkwan biara mu, na wosu frɛ me dze a, otsie ara na mibetsie hɔn sufrɛ no;
title: EXODUS

text: na m’ebufuw ano bɛyɛ dzen, na medze afona boku hom; na hom yernom bɛyɛ ekunafo na hom mba ayɛ ngyanka.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ efɛm me man mu ohianyi biara a ɔnye wo wɔ hɔ sika a, mma nnyɛ dɛ ɔpempensinyi; nkyii so mma hom nngye no nsiho.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ egye wo nyɛnko tam ahoba a, wi rotɔ no fa san ma no:
title: EXODUS

text: osiandɛ ɔnoara nko nye n’akataho, no honam ho tam a: ebɛnadze na ɔmfa nda? Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ osu frɛ me a, mibetsie: osiandɛ mbɔbɔrhufo nye me.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma nnyeyaw Nyankopɔn, anaa nndom wo man mu ɔpanyin.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma nnkyinkyim dɛ edze wo ndɔbaa anaa wo nsa mu bi bɔbɔ afɔr. Wo mbabanyin mu abakan no fa ma me.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛmara na yɛ w’anantwi, na ɔnye wo nguan: nda esuon na ɔnye ne na ntsena; da a otsia awɔtwe no fa no brɛ me.
title: EXODUS

text: Na hom bɛyɛ nyimpa krɔnkrɔn ama me: dɛm ntsi mma hom nndzi bɔnam bi a abowa atsetsew mu wɔ haban mu; hom ntow nkyen mbɔdɔm.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma nntsie atorsɛm: mma nnye omumuyɛfo nndzi nsawosow dɛ ebɛyɛ ɔdasefo ɔkontompɔnyi.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma nndzi ɔdodow ekyir nnkɛyɛ bɔn; nkyii so mma nnkasa asɛm bi mu nnkedzi ɔdodow ekyir nndan atsɛmbu enyi:
title: EXODUS

text: nkyii so mma nndzi nnkɔ ohianyi afa wɔ n’asɛm mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ ekɔto wo tamfo ne nantwi anaa n’asoaso dɛ ɔatɔ gon a, fa no san ekyir brɛ no bio.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ ihu nyia okyir wo n’asoaso dɛ ɔhyɛ n’adzesoa ase, na nkyɛ ennkɛpɛ dɛ eboa no a, boa na nye no mboa no.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma nndan wo hianyi n’atsɛmbu enyi wɔ n’asɛm mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Twe woho fi atorsɛm ho kɔ ekyirekyir; na mma nnku nyia odzi bem na ɔtsen: osiandɛ murummbu omumuyɛfo bem.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mma nngye akyɛdze: osiandɛ akyɛdze ma hɔn a wɔwɔ enyiwa fura, na ɔkyeakyea atseneneefo nsɛm.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mma nnhaw ɔhɔho: osiandɛ hom nyim ɔhɔho n’akoma, ɔnam dɛ hom yɛɛ ahɔho wɔ Egypt asaase do ntsi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mfe esia na pe w’asaase do aba, na boaboa no ndɔbaa ano sie:
title: EXODUS

text: na afe a otsia esuon no dze ma ɔngye n’ahom na ɔnda hɔ kwa; ma wo man mu ehiafo ndzi: na dza wobegya no, hamu abowa ebedzi. Dɛmara na yɛ wo wenyin ture, nye wo ngodua ture.
title: EXODUS

text: Nda esia na fa yɛ w’edwuma, na da a otsia esuon no fa hom: na wo nantwi nye w’asoasopɔnkɔ eenya ahomgye: na w’afonabaa ba, nye ɔhɔho no so eenya ahomgye.
title: EXODUS

text: Na hom nhwɛ yie wɔ ndzɛmba a maka akyerɛ hom nyinara ho: na mma hom mmbobɔ enyame afofor bi dzin, nkyii so mma mma wɔnntse no wɔ w’anomu.
title: EXODUS

text: Mpɛn ebiasa na hyɛ fa ma me wɔ afrenhyia mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Sie epitsi afahyɛ no: nda esuon na dzi epitsi boodoo, dɛ mbrɛ mehyɛɛ wo no, wɔ mber a wɔahyɛ no wɔ bosoom Abib mu no (osiandɛ no mu na ifii Egypt bae); na mma obiara mmfa nsapan mmbefir m’enyim:
title: EXODUS

text: na otwaber afahyɛ no, w’edwumadze a eyɛ no wɔ haban mu no mu nduadzewakan no: na anoboaboa afahyɛ no wɔ afe no ewiei, aber a eboaboa wo ndwumadze ano fi haban mu no.
title: EXODUS

text: Wo mbanyin nyinara mbefir EWURADZE Nyankopɔn enyim mpɛn ebiasa wɔ afrenhyia mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma mmfa mbɔrkaw nnka m’afɔrbɔ bɔgya no ho mmbɔ afɔr; nkyii so mma m’afahyɛ mu seradze no ɔnnko hɔ anadwe nyinara ma onnkodu adzekyee.
title: EXODUS

text: Wo daadze mu nduadzewakan mu kan dze no fa bra EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn fie. Mma nnoa apɔnkyeba wɔ ne na no numfonsu mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Hwɛ, morosoma ɔbɔfo ma oeedzi w’enyim akɔhwɛ wo wɔ ɔkwan no mu, na ɔdze wo ekodu bea a mesiesie no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ no ho, na wontsie ne ndze; mma wonnyi no ebufuw: na ɔnnkɛfa hom mbrato akyɛ hom; osiandɛ me dzin wɔ no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ itsie ne ndze ara ampa, na eyɛ dza meka nyinara a; ɔnodze, mebɛyɛ ɔtamfo ama w’atamfo, nye ɔhohiahianyi mama w’ahohiahiafo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mo bɔfoe no bedzi w’enyim akɔ, na ɔdze wo ekodu Amorifo, Hitifo, Perizfo, Keenanfo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo nkyɛn: na mubotwa hɔn egu.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma mmbɔ wo mu adze mma hɔn enyame, na nnsom hɔn, na nnyɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ so: na butuw na butuw hɔn, na bubu hɔn edum mu esinesin.
title: EXODUS

text: Na hom nsom EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, na obehyira w’edziban, nye wo nsu do; na mibeyi yarba mefi wo mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Obiara nnkɔpon ɔba, na ɔnnkɛyɛ ɔbɔnyin so, wɔ w’asaase do: mebɛma wo nda no dodow ano edu.
title: EXODUS

text: Mebɛma mo ho hu edzi w’enyim, na mebɛka aman a ebɛba hɔn do nyinara megu, na mama w’atamfo nyinara adan hɔn ekyir ama wo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mobɔsoma nkotokrodo ma woeedzi w’enyim, apam Hivifo, Keenanfo, nye Hitifo no wɔ w’enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Mennkɛpam hɔn wɔ w’enyim wɔ afe kor mu; ɔno bɛyɛ na asaase no adan amamfo, na hamu mbowa adɔɔ so wɔ wo do.
title: EXODUS

text: Nkakrankakra na mebɛpam hɔn wɔ w’enyim, ekodu dɛ ebɔdɔr, na enya asaase no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mubotwa wo he efi Mbɛw Po no ho araa ekodu Filistiafo po no ho, na medze mefi sar no ano ekodu Esutsen no ho: na mibeyi asaase no do mba mahyɛ wo nsa; na ebɛpam hɔn wɔ w’enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma nnye hɔn nye hɔn enyame so nndzi ahyɛmu.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma wɔnntsena w’asaase do, ɔno bɛyɛ na wɔama ayɛ bɔn etsia me: na sɛ esom hɔn enyame a, ampaara ɔbɛyɛ efir ama wo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee Moses dɛ, Fow bra EWURADZE nkyɛn, ɔwo, nye Aaron, Nadab, nye Abihu, nye Israel mpanyimfo mu eduosuon; na hom nkɔsɔr wɔ ekyirekyir:
title: EXODUS

text: na Moses nko ntwe mbɛn EWURADZE; na hɔn dze, mma wɔnntwe mmbɛn; nkyii so mma ɔman no nnye no mmfow nnkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses bae bɛkaa EWURADZE ne nsɛm no nyinara kyerɛɛ ɔman no, na atsɛmbu no nyinara: na ɔman no nyinara dze ndze kor buae, na wɔsee dɛ, Nsɛm a EWURADZE aka no nyinara yɛbɛyɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses kyerɛɛw EWURADZE ne nsɛm no nyinara, na ɔsoɛɛr anapaatu, na osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ bepɔw no ase, nye edum duebien, dɛ mbrɛ Israel ebusuakuw duebien no ano tse.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsomaa Israelmba no mu mberantsɛ a wɔdze anantwi kɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr, nye asomdwee afɔr maa EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses faa bɔgya no ne fa guguu mbɛɛsen mu, na ɔdze bɔgya fa no petsee afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔfaa ahyɛmu nwoma no, na ɔkenkaan no wɔ ɔman no asomu: na wɔsee dɛ, Dza EWURADZE aka no nyinara yɛbɛyɛ, na yɛayɛ setsie.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses faa bɔgya no, na ɔdze petsee ɔman no do, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ ahyɛmu a EWURADZE nye hom edzi wɔ nsɛm yi nyinara ho no no bɔgyaa nye yi.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna Moses, nye Aaron, Nadab, nye Abihu, nye Israel mpanyimfo mu eduosuon no fowee kɔree:
title: EXODUS

text: na wohun Israel Nyankopɔn no; n’anan ase tse dɛ wɔdze hoabo ataa hɔ, na n’enyi tsew dɛ ɔsor noara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔammfa ne nsa annto Israelmba mu ekunyin no do: na wɔhwɛɛ Nyankopɔn, na wodzidzii na wɔnomee.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Fow bra me nkyɛn wɔ bepɔw no do, na tsena hɔ: na medze abopon, nye mbrasɛm a makyerɛw no mebɛma wo, ma aakyerɛkyerɛ hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses soɛree, ɔnye no somfo Josua: na Moses fowee kɔr Nyankopɔn ne bepɔw no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee mpanyimfo no dɛ, Hom ntsintsim ha ntweɔn hɛn ma onkodu dɛ yɛbɛba hom nkyɛn bio: na hwɛ, Aaron nye Hur nye hom wɔ ha: obiara a ɔwɔ asɛm bi no, wɔmma ɔntwe mbɛn hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses fowee kɔr bepɔw no do, na mununkum no bɛkataa bepɔw no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE n’enyimnyam bɛtsenaa bepɔw Sinai do, na mununkum no kataa do nda esia: na da a otsia esuon no, ofi mununkum no mu frɛɛ Moses.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE n’enyimnyam no hwɛbea ɔtse dɛ gya a ɔhyew adze wɔ bepɔw no etsifi wɔ Israelmba no enyiwa mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses kɛhɛɛn mununkum no ne finimfin, na ɔfowee kɔr bepɔw no do: na Moses dzii bepɔw no do adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Ka kyerɛ Israelmba ma wɔmfa ayɛyɛdze mbrɛ me: nyimpa biara a n’akoma pɛ no no hɔ na hom ngye m’ayɛyɛdze.
title: EXODUS

text: Na iyi nye ayɛyɛdze a hom ngye no wɔ hɔn hɔ; sika, nye dwetɛ, nye boran;
title: EXODUS

text: nye bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw, nye mpɔnkyenhwi;
title: EXODUS

text: nye nguannyin nwoma a wɔahyɛ no memen, nye nsukraman nwoma; nye akeesia dua;
title: EXODUS

text: kandzea ho ngo, ɔserango ho nduhuam, nye nduhuam a wɔhyew ho edur;
title: EXODUS

text: abo a no su tse dɛ epopobibir, nye abo a wɔdze besisi egugudo no, nye akatabo no mu no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ma wɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔnbea mma me; ma maatsena hɔn mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ merekyerɛ wo no nyinara, ntamadan no saso, nye no mu ndzɛmba nyinara ne saso, dɛmara pɛ na hom nyɛ no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔnyɛ akeesia dua adaka: ne tsentsen nyɛ bɛyɛ basafa kor na fa, na ne tɛtɛr bɛyɛ anamɔn ebien na fa, na no krɔn so bɛyɛ anamɔn ebien na fa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa sika mapa dura ho, no mu nye n’ekyir na fa dura, na yɛ ho sika hankra twa ho hyia.
title: EXODUS

text: Na gu no ho sika nkaba anan, na fa tuatua n’anan anan no ho; na nkaba ebien ndzi n’afa fakor, na nkaba ebien ndzi n’afa no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa dua sian mpoma, na fa sika dura ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa mpoma no hyehyɛ nkaba no mu wɔ adaka no ne nkyɛn mu, ma wɔmfa nsoa adaka no.
title: EXODUS

text: Mpoma no nhyehyɛ adaka no ne nkaba no mu: mma wonnyiyi mmfi mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa dase a medze mebɛma wo no to adaka no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa sika mapa yɛ mbɔbɔrhu egua: ne tsentsen nyɛ bɛyɛ basafa kor nye fa, na ne tɛtɛr bɛyɛ anamɔn ebien nye fa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ sika kerubim ebien; ɔbor edwuma na fa yɛ, wɔ mbɔbɔrhu egua ne tsir ebien no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ kerubim kor wɔ ne tsir kor, nye kerubim kor wɔ ne tsir kor so: mbɔbɔrhu egua no mu na hom mma kerubim ebien no mfi wɔ ne tsir ebien no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na kerubim no ntserɛtserɛw hɔn ntsaban mu wɔ ɔsor, mfa hɔn ntsaban no nkata mbɔbɔrhu egua no do, hɔn enyim ndzi abɔenyim; mbɔbɔrhu egua no do na kerubim no hɔn enyim mbedzi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa mbɔbɔrhu egua no si adaka no do sor; na adaka no mu na fa dase a medze mebɛma wo no to.
title: EXODUS

text: Na hɔ na menye wo behyia, na mefi mbɔbɔrhu egua no do wɔ kerubim ebien a wɔwɔ dasedaka no do no ntamu maka wo ndzɛmba a mebɛhyɛ wo dɛ fa kyerɛ Israelmba no nyinara ho nsɛm.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa akeesia dua pon: ne tsentsen nyɛ basafa kor, ne tɛtɛr anamɔn kor nye fa, na no krɔn bɛyɛ anamɔn ebien nye fa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa sika mapa dura ho, na yɛ ho sika hankra hyia.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ ho ntotoano a ɔbɛyɛ nsatseama hyia, na yɛ ntotoano no ho sika hankra hyia.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ ho sika nkaba anan, na fa nkaba no sisi nkutuw anan a ɔwowɔ n’anan anan no ho no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Ntotoano no nkyɛn papaapa na nkaba no ndzi, ma ɔnyɛ beebi mbrɛ wɔdze mpoma no bɛhyehyɛ dze asoa ɔpon no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa akeesia dua sinsian mpoma no, na fa sika duradura ho, ama wɔdze aasoa pon no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ do mboyaa, nye ntser, nye nkɔɔpow, nye nkorbaa a wɔdze bohue: sika mapa na fa yɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa kyerɛpaanoo si pon no do wɔ m’enyim daa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa sika mapa yɛ kandzeadua: ɔbor edwuma na fa yɛ kandzeadua no, n’anan, nye no dua; no ho mpokuwa, no nkukuduuduw, nye ne nhyiren, mfi sin kor no ara mu:
title: EXODUS

text: na abaw esia mfifi ne nkyɛn mu; kandzeadua n’abaw ebiasa mfi n’afa fakor, na kandzeadua no n’abaw ebiasa so mfi n’afa kor so:
title: EXODUS

text: mpokuwa ebiasa a wɔayɛ no dɛ almɔnd nhyiren wɔ abaw kor ho, kukuduuduw nye nhyiren; na mpokuwa ebiasa a wɔayɛ no dɛ almɔnd nhyiren wɔ abaw kor no so ho, kukuduuduw nye nhyiren: dɛm na yɛ wɔ abaw esia a efifir wɔ kandzeadua no ho no ho:
title: EXODUS

text: na kandzeadua no ho mpokuwa anan a wɔayɛ no dɛ almɔnd nhyiren, no kukuduuduw nye ne nhyiren:
title: EXODUS

text: na kukuduuduw nhyɛ abaw ebien a otuatua ho no ase, na kukuduuduw nhyɛ abaw ebien a otuatua ho no ase, na kukuduuduw nhyɛ abaw ebien a otuatua ho no ase wɔ abaw esia a efifir kandzeadua no mu no ase.
title: EXODUS

text: No ho nkukuduuduw nye no ho abaw no mfi mu ara, ne nyinara sika mapa na wɔmfa nyɛ no ɔbor edwuma kor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ ne nkandzea no esuon: na wɔnsosɔ ne nkandzea no, ma ɔngyegye wɔ n’enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na no ho adabaa, nye no ho nsompokuwa nyɛ sika mapa.
title: EXODUS

text: Sika mapa kyɛpɛn kor na wɔmfa nyɛ, ɔnye no ho ndzɛmba yi nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na hwɛ na yɛ no dɛ mbrɛ no nsusudo a wɔdze akyerɛ wo wɔ bepɔw no do no tse.
title: EXODUS

text: Nkyii so fa nsensɛnho atam du yɛ ntamadan no; ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira, nye bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa na fa yɛ me kerubim a ɔyɛ odwimfo pa edwinsa.
title: EXODUS

text: Nsensɛnho tam kor ne tsentsen nyɛ basafa duanan, na nsensɛnho tam kor ne tɛtɛr nyɛ basafa ebien: nsensɛnho atam no nyinara no nsusui ngyina kor.
title: EXODUS

text: Wɔmfa nsensɛnho atam enum ntoatoa do kor ntoa kor so do; na nsensɛnho atam enum no so ntoatoa do kor ntoa kor so do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa bibir bobɔ nsensɛnho tam kor mbuano do etokur wɔ ano wɔ ntoae no do; na dɛmara na yɛ wɔ nsensɛnho tam a odzi ekyir no no mbuano do wɔ ntoae a otsia ebien no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Etokur eduonum na bobɔ wɔ nsensɛnho tam kor mu, na etokur eduonum so na bobɔ wɔ nsensɛnho tam a ɔwɔ ntoae a otsia ebien no so ano; etokur no ndzi abɔenyim nkorkor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ sika nkɔtɔkorba eduonum, na fa nkɔtɔkorba no yɛ ma nsensɛnho atam no kor ntoae kor so do: na ntamadan no nyɛ kor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa mpɔnkyenhwi yɛ nsensɛnho atam fa si buw wɔ ntamadan no do: yɛ no nsensɛnho atam dubiako.
title: EXODUS

text: Nsensɛnho tam kor ne tsentsen nyɛ basafa duenum, na nsensɛnho tam kor ne tɛtɛr nyɛ basafa ebien: nsensɛnho atam dubiako no no nsusui ngyina kor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa nsensɛnho atam enum toatoa yɛ no kor, na yɛ nsensɛnho atam esia so kor, na boka nsensɛnho tam a otsia esia no ma ɔnkata buw no do wɔ n’enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ etokur eduonum wɔ nsensɛnho tam kor a odzi ekyir no mbuano do wɔ ntoae no do, nye etokur eduonum so wɔ ntoae a otsia ebien no ne nsensɛnho tam no mbuano do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ mboran nkɔtɔkorba eduonum, na fa nkɔtɔkorba no susuo etokur no mu, na yɛ ma buw no ntoae mu, ma ɔnyɛ kor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na buw no ne nsensɛnho atam a aka sensɛn hɔ no, nsensɛnho tam fa no a aka no, nsensɛn ntamadan no ekyir.
title: EXODUS

text: Na buw no ne nsensɛnho atam no ne tsentsen mu anamɔn kor nye fa a abor do wɔ afa ha, nye anamɔn kor nye fa a abor do wɔ afa hɔ no nsensɛn ntamadan no ne nkyɛn nkyɛn wɔ afa ha nye afa ha nkata do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa nguannyin nwoma a wɔahyɛ no memen yɛ buw no ne nkatado; na fa nsukraman nwoma yɛ no sor akatado.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa akeesia dua yɛ ntamadan no ne ntaabow a osisi hɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Basafa enum nyɛ taabow ne tsentsen, na bɛyɛ anamɔn ebien nye fa nyɛ taabow kor ne tɛtɛr.
title: EXODUS

text: Anan ebien ntuatua taabow kor mu, nsusuo kor mu mfam kor so ho: dɛm na yɛ ma ntamadan no ne ntaabow nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ ntamadan no ne ntaabow no, ntaabow eduonu ndzi pomu afamu nkyerɛ pomu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ ntaabow eduonu no n’ase dwetɛ ngyinado eduanan; ngyinado ebien nhyehyɛ taabow kor ase mma anan ebien no, na ngyinado ebien nhyehyɛ taabow kor so ase mma n’anan ebien no:
title: EXODUS

text: na ntamadan no n’afa a otsia ebien no, odzi kwaamu afamu no, ntaabow eduonu:
title: EXODUS

text: na no dwetɛ ngyinado eduanan no; ngyinado ebien nhyehyɛ taabow ase, na ngyinado ebien nhyehyɛ taabow kor so ase.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ntamadan no n’ekyir a odzi anee afamu no yɛ hɔ ntaabow esia.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ ntaabow ebien ma ntamadan no no kutuw do wɔ n’ekyir afamu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔmpam ho wɔ ase, na ɔnyɛ mu dɛmara nkodu no sor nkaba kor ho: dɛm na n’ebien nyina nyɛ; wondzi kutuw ebien no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔnyɛ ntaabow awɔtwe, nye no dwetɛ ngyinado, ngyinado duesia; ngyinado ebien nhyehyɛ taabow kor ase, na ngyinado ebien nhyehyɛ taabow kor so ase.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa akeesia dua yɛ mbeabeamu; enum nyɛ ntamadan no ne nkyɛn kor ntaabow no dze,
title: EXODUS

text: na mbeabeamu enum so nyɛ ntamadan no ne nkyɛn kor no ne ntaabow no dze, na mbeabeamu enum so nyɛ ntamadan no ne nkyɛn ekyir wɔ anee afamu ntaabow no dze.
title: EXODUS

text: Na finimfin mbeamu a ɔwɔ ntaabow no ne finimfin no ntwa mu mfi tsir nkodu tsir.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa sika duradura ntaabow no ho, na fa sika yɛ no ho nkaba no ma ɔnyɛ mbeabeamu no hyehyɛbea: na fa sika duradura mbeabeamu no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na si ntamadan no dɛ mbrɛ ne nyɛbea a woeyi akyerɛ wo wɔ bepɔw no do no tse.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira yɛ ntwamutam: yɛ me kerubim a ɔyɛ odwimfo pa edwinsa:
title: EXODUS

text: na fa sensɛn akeesia edum anan a woeduradura ho sika do, no nkwaba nyɛ sika, nsisi dwetɛ ngyinado anan do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa ntwamutam no sensɛn nkɔtɔkorba no ase, na fa dasedaka no bra ntwamutam no mu: na ntwamutam no ntwa bea krɔnkrɔn no nye krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔn no mu mma wo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa mbɔbɔrhu egua no si dasedaka no do wɔ krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔnbea no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa ɔpon no si ntwamutam no ekyir, na kandzeadua no ndzi ɔpon no tsentsendo wɔ ntamadan no nkyɛn mu wɔ pomu afamu: na fa ɔpon no si kwaamu afamu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira, wen nkyermu fa yɛ ntamadan no n’abowano nkataano.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ akeesia edum enum fa ma nkataano no, na fa sika duradura ho; no nkwaba nyɛ sika: na gu boran ngyinado enum wɔ ase.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa akeesia dua yɛ afɔrmbukyia no, ne tsentsen basafa ebien nye fa, na ne tɛtɛr basafa ebien nye fa; afɔrmbukyia no nyɛ etwaanan: na no krɔn nyɛ basafa kor nye fa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ no ho mbɛn sisi no kutuw anan no do: ne mbɛn no nye no mfi sin kor no ara mu: na fa boran dura ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ n’asɛn a wɔdze no nso bogu mu, nye no nsofi, nye no nkɔɔpow, nye n’edzinam, nye ne gyansenama kukuwa: no ho ndzɛmba nyinara boran na fa yɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa boran wen no ho serɛnkye dɛ erowen atena; na yɛ atena no do boran nkaba anan wɔ no kutuw anan no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa si afɔrmbukyia no ne bamba no ho wɔ ase, ma atena no ndu afɔrmbukyia no ne finimfin.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sinsian afɔrmbukyia no ho mpoma, akeesia dua mpoma, na duradura ho boran.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔmfa no mpoma no nwurawura nkaba no mu, na mpoma no nhyehyɛ afɔrmbukyia no ne nkyɛn nkyɛn ebien no, na wɔdze aasoa.
title: EXODUS

text: Fa ntaabow yɛ, na no mu nda kwan: dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛ wo wɔ bepɔw no do no, dɛmara na wɔnyɛ no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ ntamadan no ne dampan: pomu afamu a ɔkyerɛ pomu na dampan nsensɛnho a wɔdze ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira awen a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonum ndzi wɔ afa fakor:
title: EXODUS

text: na n’edum nyɛ eduonu, na ne ngyinado eduonu a wɔdze boran ayɛ: edum no no nkwaba nye no mbɔtsir nyɛ dwetɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na dɛmara so na kwaamu afamu ne tsentsen mu na nsensɛnho a ne tsentsen basafa eduonum ndzi hɔ, na n’edum eduonu, nye ne ngyinado eduonu a wɔdze boran ayɛ; edum no no nkwaba nye no mbɔtsir nyɛ dwetɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na dampan no ne tɛtɛr a odzi anee afamu no nnya nsensɛnho basafa eduonu enum: n’edum du, nye ne ngyinado du.
title: EXODUS

text: Na dampan no ne tɛtɛr a odzi boka afamu a ɔkyerɛ boka no nyɛ basafa eduonu enum.
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔponkɛse no afa fakor nsensɛnho no nyɛ basafa esuon nye fa: n’edum ebiasa, nye ne ngyinado ebiasa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nkyɛn fakor so nsensɛnho no nyɛ basafa esuon nye fa: n’edum ebiasa, nye ne ngyinado ebiasa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na dampan no ano ponkɛse no nyɛ basafa du, wɔmfa bibir, ɔberdum, serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira ayɛ nkyermu, nyɛ ne nkataano: n’edum anan, nye ne ngyinado anan.
title: EXODUS

text: Edum a otwa dampan no ho hyia nyinara wɔmfa dwetɛ mbobɔ no mbɔtsir; no nkwaba nyɛ dwetɛ, na ne ngyinado nyɛ boran.
title: EXODUS

text: Dampan no ne tsentsen nyɛ basafa eduonum, na ne tɛtɛr mu beebiara eduonu enum, na no krɔn basafa ebien nye fa, ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira, na no boran ngyinado.
title: EXODUS

text: Ntamadan no ho som nyinara mu ndzɛmba nyinara, nye no mbɔfondua nyinara, nye dampan no ho mbɔfondua nyinara nyɛ boran.
title: EXODUS

text: Na hyɛ Israelmba no ma wɔmbrɛ wo olive ngo gyenengyenen a woesiw a wɔdze sɔ gya, ma ɔmma kandzea nsi do daa.
title: EXODUS

text: Ehyiadzibuw no mu, ntwamutam a ɔwɔ dase no enyim no n’ekyir, na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no nsiesie mfi ewimbir nkodu anapa wɔ EWURADZE enyim: ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ Israelmba afamu wɔ hɔn ebusuasantsen nyina mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ma wo nua Aaron, nye ne mbabanyin no nka no ho, mfi Israelmba no mu mbra wo nkyɛn, ama wɔaabɛyɛ m’asɔfoe, mekyerɛ Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar nye Itamar, Aaron ne mbabanyin no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na pam ntar krɔnkrɔn ma wo nua Aaron, wɔ enyimnyam nye ahoɔfɛw ntsi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na kasa kyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ abadwembafo a medze nyansa sunsum mahyɛ hɔn ma nyinara, ma wɔmpam Aaron ntar no mfa ntsew no ho, ma ondzi mo sɔfoe.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ntar a wɔmpam nye yi; akatabo, nye egugudo, nye bataker, nye sortar a wɔawen no dam dam, asɔfokyɛw, nye abɔdo: na wɔmpam ntar krɔnkrɔn mma wo nua Aaron, nye ne mbabanyin, ma woeedzi mo sɔfoe.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔmfa sika no, nye bibir no, nye ɔberdum no, nye serdaa no, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw no nyɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔnyɛ egugudo no sika, bibir, nye ɔberdum, serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira, odwimfo pa edwinsa.
title: EXODUS

text: Onnya abatsir ahoma ebien a otuatua n’ano ebien no; ma wɔdze aabɔ mu atoa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nkyermu abɔdo a wɔawen a ɔwɔ no do, ma wɔdze aabɔ ne nyinara do no, nyɛ dɛ n’edwinsa a ofi ahoma kor no ara mu; sika, bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa abo a no su tse dɛ epopobibir ebien, na kyerɛw Israelmba hɔn edzin wɔ do:
title: EXODUS

text: hɔn edzin esia ndzi ɔbo kor do, na esia a wɔaka no hɔn edzin ndzi ɔbo kor no so do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn awoe mu tse.
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔbosiamfo edwinsa, ɔtse dɛ nsɔwanokaba nkyerɛwee, na fa kyerɛw abo ebien no do, dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba hɔn edzin tsetsee: yɛ no ma sika mbraho ntwa ho nhyia.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa abo ebien no bobɔ egugudo no n’abatsir ahoma no do, ma ɔnyɛ nkaa abo mma Israelmba no: na Aaron nsoa hɔn edzin wɔ n’abatsir ebien no do wɔ EWURADZE enyim mfa nyɛ nkaa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ sika mbraho:
title: EXODUS

text: nye sika mapa ntweaban ebien; yɛ no dɛ ahoma, mbɛsawɔw edwuma: na fa ntweaban a wɔawɔw no mbɛsa no hyehyɛ mbraho no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ atsɛmbu akatabo, odwimfo pa edwinsa; dɛ mbrɛ egugudo edwuma no tse na yɛ no; sika, bibir, ɔberdum, serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira na fa yɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔnyɛ etwaanan mbɔho; ne tsentsen nyɛ nsatseama, na ne tɛtɛr nyɛ nsatseama.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa nsisimu abo sisi mu, abo akyerɛpɛn anan: kyerɛpɛn a odzi kan no nyɛ bɔgyanambo, kratsebo, nye ahatawmomonbo kyerɛpɛn;
title: EXODUS

text: na kyerɛpɛn a otsia ebien no nyɛ nserɛmɛmbo, hoabo, nye dɛnkyɛmbo;
title: EXODUS

text: na kyerɛpɛn a otsia ebiasa no nyɛ ekutuhonbo, mfrafrabo nye ɔberdumbo;
title: EXODUS

text: na kyerɛpɛn a otsia anan no nyɛ sikabereebo, epopobibirbo nye ahwehwɛbo: na ne nsisimu no, sika ntwa ho nhyia.
title: EXODUS

text: Na abo no nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba hɔn edzin tsetsee, duebien, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edzin tsetsee; dɛ nsɔwanokaba nkyerɛwee, dɛ mbrɛ baako biara ne dzin tse, wɔmfa mma ebusuakuw duebien no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa sika mapa yɛ akatabo no do ntweaban dɛ ahoma, mbɛsawɔw edwuma.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ akatabo no do sika nkaba ebien, na fa nkaba ebien no hyehyɛ akatabo no n’ano ebien no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa sika ntweaban a wɔawɔw no mbɛsa ebien no hyehyɛ akatabo no n’ano nkaba ebien no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ntweaban a wɔawɔw no mbɛsa ebien no n’ano ebien a aka no fa toatoa mbraho ebien no mu, na fa hyehyɛ egugudo no n’abatsir ahoma no do wɔ n’enyim afamu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ sika nkaba ebien, na fa hyehyɛ akatabo no n’ano ebien no do, wɔ ne nkyɛnmu afamu a ɔba egugudo no ho no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ sika nkaba ebien, na fa hyehyɛ egugudo no n’abatsir ahoma ebien no do wɔ ase, wɔ n’enyim afamu, no ntoatoa no ne nkyɛn, wɔ egugudo no ne nkyermu abɔdo a wɔawen no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔmfa bibir ahoma nkyekyer akatabo no ne nkaba no nsusuo egugudo no ne nkaba no mu, ma ɔmfam egugudo no ne nkyermu abɔdo a wɔawen no do, amma akatabo no aannsan emmfi egugudo no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ Aaron rokɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no do a, ɔnsoa Israelmba no hɔn edzin wɔ atsɛmbu akatabo no mu wɔ n’akoma do, mfa nyɛ nkaa wɔ EWURADZE enyim daa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa Urim nye Tummim no hyɛ atsɛmbu akatabo no mu: na sɛ Aaron rokɔ EWURADZE enyim a, aada n’akoma do: na Aaron nsoa Israelmba hɔn atsɛmbu wɔ n’akoma do wɔ EWURADZE enyim daa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa bibir ara nko yɛ egugudo no ne bataker no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na onnya tokur wɔ ne finimfin mfa mma tsir: na wɔmfa ɔtamban a wɔawen mban tokur no n’ano nhyia, ɔtse dɛ dadze atar no tokur, amma oeennsuan.
title: EXODUS

text: Na no mbuano do no fa bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa yɛ pɔmegranate fa twa no mbuano no ho hyia; na sika ndɔndɔmba nsensɛn ne ntamu ne ntamu hyia:
title: EXODUS

text: sika adɔmba nye pɔmegranate sika adɔmba nye pɔmegranate ntwa bataker no no mbuano no ho nhyia.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Aaron mfa nhyɛ nsom: ama wɔaatse ne ndze wɔ aber a ɔrehɛn bea krɔnkrɔn no mu wɔ EWURADZE enyim, na aber a orifir edzi, amma oeennwu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa sika mapa yɛ tɛrba, na kyerɛw do, dɛ nsɔwanokaba nkyerɛwee, dɛ KRƆNKRƆN MA EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa fam bibir ahoma do, na ɔnko asɔfokyɛw no ho; asɔfokyɛw no n’enyim na ɔmfam.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔmfam Aaron no momapɔw do, na Aaron nsoa mbusu biara a aba krɔnkrɔndze a Israelmba tsew ho yɛ no krɔnkrɔn wɔ hɔn ayɛyɛdze nyinara mu no; na ɔnda no momapɔw do daa, ama EWURADZE n’enyi asɔ hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa ndwera fɛɛfɛw wen sortar no dam dam, na fa ndwera fɛɛfɛw yɛ asɔfokyɛw no, na yɛ abɔdo, nkyermuwemfo edwinsa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ sortar ma Aaron ne mbabanyin, na yɛ abɔdo ma hɔn, na yɛ mbɔtsir bi ma hɔn, wɔ enyimnyam nye ahoɔfɛw ntsi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa hyehyɛ wo nua Aaron ne mbabanyin no ka no ho; na sera hɔn ngo, na tu hɔn si nkyɛn, na tsew hɔn ho, ma wondzi m’asɔfoe.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ ndwera ntwontwo ma hɔn, ma ɔnkata hɔn adagyaw do, mfi asen nkodu nserɛekyir:
title: EXODUS

text: na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no, sɛ wɔrokɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, anaa sɛ wɔreba afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn abɔsom wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no mu a, wɔnhyehyɛ, ma woeenndzi mbusu, na woeennwu: ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze mma ɔno nye n’asefo a wobedzi n’ekyir no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na iyi nye adze a fa yɛ hɔn fa tsew hɔn ho, na wondzi m’asɔfoe: fa nantwisaa eburwa kor nye nguannyin ebien a wonndzi dzɛm,
title: EXODUS

text: nye epitsi boodoo, nye epitsi tatar a wɔdze ngo aforɔw, na epitsi tatar ntrɛtraba a wɔasera ho ngo: ewifua pa isiam na fa yɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa gu kɛntsɛn kor mu, na ongu kɛntsɛn no mu ma fa bra, ɔnye nantwisaa no nye nguannyin ebien no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no bra ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano, na fa nsu hohor hɔn ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa ntar no, na fa sortar no, nye egugudo ne bataker no, nye egugudo no, nye akatabo no hyɛ Aaron, na fa egugudo abɔdo a wɔawen no nkyermu no bɔ no mu:
title: EXODUS

text: na fa asɔfokyɛw no soa no, na fa kyɛw krɔnkrɔn no si asɔfokyɛw no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nkyii fa ɔserango no, na hue gu ne tsir do, na fa sera no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa ne mbabanyin no bra, na hyehyɛ hɔn ntar.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa abɔdo bobɔ hɔn mu, Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no, na bobɔ hɔn mbɔtsir: na wonnya asɔfodzi no nyɛ hɔndze dɛ daa ahyɛdze; na tu Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no si nkyɛn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa ɔnantwisaa no bra ehyiadzibuw no enyim: na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no mfa hɔn nsa ngu nantwisaa no etsifi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ku nantwisaa no wɔ EWURADZE enyim, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa nantwisaa no no bɔgyaa bi, na fa wo nsatseaba bɔ mu sera afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn ho; na hue bɔgya no nyinara gu afɔrmbukyia no ase.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yi seradze a ɔkata ayamudze no ho nyinara, nye dza ɔsensɛn berɛbo no ho no, nye nsɛbea ebien no, nye seradze a ɔwɔ do no, na hyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔnantwisaa no ne nam, nye no nwoma, nye n’egyanan dze, fa gya hyew no wɔ nseraban no ekyir: ɔyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
title: EXODUS

text: Eso fa oguannyin kor; na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no mfa hɔn nsa ngu n’etsifi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ku oguannyin no, na fa no bɔgyaa, na fa petse afɔrmbukyia no ho hyia.
title: EXODUS

text: Na twitwa oguannyin no esinesin, na hohor n’ayamudze, nye no ntwɛr ho, na fa ka n’esinesin, na ɔnye ne tsir no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na hyew oguannyin no no nyinara wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: ɔyɛ ɔhyew afɔr ma EWURADZE: ɔyɛ adze huanhuam, afɔr a wɔdze gya bɔ ma EWURADZE a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa oguannyin kor no so; na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no mfa hɔn nsa ngu oguannyin no etsifi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nkyii ku oguannyin no, na fa no mbɔgyaa bi, na fa ka Aaron n’aso nyimfa ano, nye ne mbabanyin no hɔn aso nyimfa ano, nye hɔn nsa nyimfa kokrobetsir ano, nye hɔn anan nyimfa kokrobetsir ano, na fa bɔgya no petse afɔrmbukyia no ho hyia.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa afɔrmbukyia no do bɔgya no bi, nye ɔserango no bi, na fa petse Aaron do, nye ne ntar do, nye ne mbabanyin no do, nye ne mbabanyin no hɔn ntar do ka no ho, ma ɔntsew ɔno nye ne ntar, nye ne mbabanyin no, nye ne mbabanyin no hɔn ntar ho nka no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Nkyii so fa oguannyin no ne seradze, nye ne seradze dua no, nye seradze a ɔkata n’ayamudze ho no, nye adze a ɔsensɛn ne mberɛbo ho no, nye nsɛbea ebien no, nye no do seradze no, nye aserɛ nyimfa dze no; osiandɛ ɔyɛ etuhoakyɛ oguannyin:
title: EXODUS

text: na boodoo ntɔwmu kor, nye boodoo tatar a woegu mu ngo kor, nye tatar trɛtraba kor, fa fi epitsi kɛntsɛn no a osi EWURADZE enyim no mu:
title: EXODUS

text: na fa ne nyina gu Aaron nsamu, nye ne mbabanyin no nsamu; na hihim no yɛ EWURADZE enyim ohim afɔr.
title: EXODUS

text: Na gyegye no wɔ hɔn nsamu, na hyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do wɔ ɔhyew afɔr no do, ma ɔnyɛ EWURADZE enyim adze huanhuam: ɔyɛ afɔr a wɔdze gya bɔ ma EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa Aaron n’etuhoakyɛ oguannyin no ne nyan, na hihim yɛ EWURADZE enyim ohim afɔr: na ɔnyɛ wo kyɛpɛn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ohim afɔr nyan no, na ɔmado afɔr aserɛ no a wɔdze fi Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no hɔn etuhoakyɛ oguannyin no a woehihim no, na wɔama do no mu no tsew ho:
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔnyɛ dɛ daa ndzinoa mfi Israelmba nsamu mma Aaron nye ne mbabanyin: na ɔyɛ ɔmado afɔr: na ɔnyɛ ɔmado afɔr mfa mfi Israelmba hɔn asomdwee afɔr n’afɔrbɔdze mu, mekyerɛ hɔn ɔmado afɔr a wɔbɔ ma EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Aaron ne ntar krɔnkrɔn no nyɛ ne mba a wodzi n’ekyir dze, ma wɔnsera hɔn ngo wɔ mu, na wontu hɔn nsi nkyɛn wɔ mu.
title: EXODUS
