text: Nda esuon na ɔbabanyin a odzi ɔsɔfo wɔ n’ananmu no nhyɛ, aber a ɔreba ehyiadzibuw no mu abɔsom wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa etuhoakyɛ oguannyin no, na noa ne nam no wɔ bea a ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no ndzi oguannyin no ne nam, nye boodoo a ɔwɔ kɛntsɛn no mu no, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wondzi ndzɛmba no a wɔdze yɛɛ mpata, ma wɔdze eetu hɔn esi nkyɛn, na wɔatsew hɔnho no: mbom mma nyimpa biara nndzi bi, osiandɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ etuhoakyɛ nam no, anaa boodoo no bi ka ma adze kye do a, ɔno fa gya hyew dza aka no: mma wonndzi, osiandɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na dɛm na fa yɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ wo no nyinara: nda esuon na tu hɔn si nkyɛn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na daa nyina fa nantwisaa bɔ bɔn ho afɔr no ma ɔnyɛ mpatadze: na tsew afɔrmbukyia no ho, aber a erepata wɔ ne tsir no; na sera ho ngo, fa tsew ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Nda esuon na pata wɔ afɔrmbukyia no ne tsir, na tsew ho: na afɔrmbukyia no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔn; biribiara a ɔka afɔrmbukyia no ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Afei iyi nye dza fa bɔ afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do; daa daa nyina nguambaa ebien a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia.
title: EXODUS

text: Eguambaa kor na fa bɔ afɔr anapa; na eguambaa kor so fa bɔ afɔr ewimbir:
title: EXODUS

text: na fa isiam pa efa ebupɛn du mu kor a wɔdze ngo siwii bɔdambɔ kor na fa ebupɛn anan mu kor aforɔw; na wenyin bɔdambɔ kor na fa ebupɛn anan mu kor a ɔyɛ nom afɔr, ka eguambaa kor ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na eguambaa kor no so fa bɔ afɔr ewimbir, na yɛ no dɛ mbrɛ anapa edzidzi afɔr no, na mbrɛ no nom afɔr no tse, ma ɔnyɛ adze huanhuam, afɔr a wɔdze gya bɔ ma EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔnyɛ daa ɔhyew afɔr wɔ w’ebusuasantsen mu wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano wɔ EWURADZE enyim: mbrɛ menye hom behyia, makasa wɔ hɔ makyerɛ wo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na hɔ na menye Israelmba behyia; na m’enyimnyam atsew Buw no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mebɛtsew ehyiadzibuw no, nye afɔrmbukyia no ho: Aaron so nye ne mbabanyin no mebɛtsew hɔn ho, ma woeedzi m’asɔfoe.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mebɛtsena Israelmba no mu, na mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do bae, dɛ mebɛtsena hɔn mu no: emi nye EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ afɔrmbukyia a wɔhyew do eduhuam: akeesia dua na fa yɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Ne tsentsen nyɛ anamɔn kor nye fa, na ne tɛtɛr nyɛ anamɔn kor nye fa; ɔnyɛ etwaanan: na no krɔn nyɛ basafa kor: ne mmbɛn mfi sin kor no ara mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa sika mapa dura ho, n’etsifi, nye ne nkyɛn nkyɛnmu hyia, nye ne mmbɛn no; na yɛ ho sika hankra fa hyia.
title: EXODUS

text: Na yɛ ho sika nkaba ebien wɔ ne hankra no ase, wɔ ne mparba ebien do, ne nkyɛnmu ebien no na yɛ no wɔ do; na ɔnyɛ mpoma anan mu na wɔdze aasoa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa akeesia dua sinsian mpoma no, na duradura ho sika.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa si ntwamutam a ɔwɔ dase adaka no ho no enyim, wɔ mbɔbɔrhu egua no a ɔwɔ dase no do no enyim, mbrɛ menye wo behyia no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Aaron nhyew do eduhuam: anapa nyinara, sɛ orisiesie nkandzea no ho a, ɔnhyew.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sɛ Aaron sosɔ nkandzea no ewimbir a, ɔnhyew, ɔnyɛ daa eduhuam wɔ EWURADZE enyim nkɔ hom mbasantsen nyina mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma hom nnhyew do eduhuam fofor bi, anaa ɔhyew afɔr, anaa edzidzi afɔr; na mma hom nnhue nom afɔr nngu do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Aaron mpata wɔ ne mmbɛn do afrenhyia mu prɛko: bɔn ho afɔr mpata bɔgyaa no na ɔmfa mpata ne tsir afrenhyia mu prɛko wɔ hom mbasantsen nyina mu: ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔn ma EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ erohwehwɛ Israelmba hɔn dodow ano ebu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu hɔn a wɔkan hɔn no tse a, ɔno nyimpa biara mma ne kra tsir apondze mma EWURADZE, sɛ erekan hɔn a; ama sɛ erekan hɔn a, ɔyardɔm bi eennsi hɔn mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Iyi na wɔmma, obiara a otwa mu kɔ hɔn a wɔkan hɔn no mu no, dwetɛbona fa dɛ krɔnkrɔnbea dwetɛbona: (dwetɛbona yɛ gera eduonu:) dwetɛbona fa nyɛ EWURADZE afɔrbɔdze.
title: EXODUS

text: Obiara a otwa mu kɔ hɔn a wɔkan hɔn no mu no na oedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir no, ɔmma EWURADZE afɔrbɔdze no.
title: EXODUS

text: Sɛ wɔrema EWURADZE afɔrbɔdze no dze aayɛ hom akra tsir mpatadze a, mma obirɛmpɔn mma kɛse, na ohianyi so mma kakraba, nnkyɛn dwetɛbona fa no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na gyegye mpata sika no wɔ Israelmba no hɔ, na fa ma ehyiadzibuw no mu som no; ma ɔaayɛ nkaa ama Israelmba no wɔ EWURADZE enyim, dze aayɛ hɔn akra tsir mpatadze.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Fa boran yɛ eguarsɛn so, na n’ase nyɛ boran, ma wɔdze eeguar; na fa si ehyiadzibuw no nye afɔrmbukyia no ntamu, na fa nsu gu mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no mfa nhohor hɔn nsa ho nye hɔn anan ho wɔ hɔ:
title: EXODUS

text: sɛ wɔrekɛhɛn ehyiadzibuw no mu a, wɔmfa nsu nhohor hɔnho, mma woeennwuwu; anaa sɛ wɔrebɛn afɔrmbukyia no ho abɔsom, ma wɔaahyew afɔrbɔdze a wɔdze gya hyew ma EWURADZE a:
title: EXODUS

text: dɛm na wɔnhohor hɔn nsa ho nye hɔn anan ho, mma woeennwuwu: na ɔnyɛ ahyɛdze mma hɔn daapem, mekyerɛ ɔno nye n’asefo wɔ hɔn mbasantsen nyina mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Nkyii so EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Wo so fa nduhuam mu etsitsir ma woho, eduhuam mɛɛr a ɔsosɔw dwetɛbona ahaenum, nye sinamɔn huanhuam dɛmara ne fa, mekyerɛ ahaenu eduonum, nye kalamus huanhuam ahaenu eduonum,
title: EXODUS

text: nye keesia ahaenum, dɛ krɔnkrɔnbea dwetɛbona no, nye olive ngo kor na fa:
title: EXODUS

text: na fa yɛ ɔserango krɔnkrɔn, eduhuam a wɔafora no oduhuamforafo nyansa mu: na ɔnyɛ ɔserango krɔnkrɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa sera ehyiadzibuw no, nye dasedaka no,
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔpon no nye no ho ndzɛmba no nyinara, nye kandzeadua no nye no ho ndzɛmba no, nye eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia no,
title: EXODUS

text: nye ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no nye no ho ndzɛmba no nyinara, nye eguarsɛn no nye ne ntaease.
title: EXODUS

text: Na tsew ho ma ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔn: biribiara a ɔka no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sera Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no ngo, na tsew hɔn ho, ma wondzi m’asɔfoe.
title: EXODUS

text: Na kasa kyerɛ Israelmba no dɛ, Iyi nyɛ ɔserango krɔnkrɔn mma me wɔ hom mbasantsen nyina mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Nyimpa honam do na mma wonnhue nngu, nkyii so mma hom nnyɛ bi a ɔtse dɛm, dɛ mbrɛ no mforafora mu tse: ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn, na ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma hom.
title: EXODUS

text: Obiara a ɔbɔforafora bi dɛm no, anaa obiara a ɔdze bi bɛka ɔhɔho ho no, wobotwa no efi no nkorɔfo mu akyen.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Fa nduhuanhuam ma woho, stakete, nye onika, nye galbanum; nduhuanhuam a krɔbɔw gyenengyenen ka ho: ne nyina no durdur nyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛr;
title: EXODUS

text: na fa yɛ eduhuam hyewee, eduhuam a wɔafora no oduhuamforafo nyansaa mu a wɔaposa a ɔyɛ gyenengyenen nye krɔnkrɔn:
title: EXODUS

text: na siw no fekɔfekɔ, na fa bi gu dase no enyim wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, mbrɛ menye wo behyia no; ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mu adzekrɔnkrɔn mma hom.
title: EXODUS

text: Na eduhuam hyewee a erebɛyɛ no, mma hom nnsusu no mforaforae do nnyɛ bi mma homankasa homho: ɔnyɛ wo krɔnkrɔn mma EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Obiara a ɔbɛyɛ bi a ɔtse dɛm, ehua ahwɛ no, wobotwa no efi no nkorɔfo mu akyen.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Hwɛ, mabɔ Bezalel, Uri ba no, Hur ba no a ofi Juda ebusuakuw mu no ne dzin mafrɛ no:
title: EXODUS

text: na medze Nyankopɔn sunsum ahyɛ no ma, wɔ nyansa, nye ntseasee, nye nyimdzee, nye edwindzi ahorow nyinara mu,
title: EXODUS

text: dɛ ɔmfa ndwen ne tsir mu ndzi sika, nye dwetɛ, nye boran,
title: EXODUS

text: nye nsisimu abo ntwitwae, nye ndua sian mu edwin, ma oeedzi edwin horow nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na, hwɛ, mara mafa Oholiab, Ahisamak ba a ofi Dan ebusuakuw mu, aka no ho; na hɔn a wɔwɔ nyansa akoma nyinara medze nyansa ahyɛ hɔn akoma mu ma wɔaayɛ dza mahyɛ wo nyinara:
title: EXODUS

text: ehyiadzibuw no, nye dasedaka no, nye mbɔbɔrhu egua a ɔwɔ do no, nye Buw no no ho ndzɛmba nyinara;
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔpon no nye no ho ndzɛmba, nye kandzeadua mapa no ɔnye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia no;
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no ɔnye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye eguarsɛn no nye ne ntaease no;
title: EXODUS

text: na ntar fɛɛfɛw a wɔapempam no, nye ɔsɔfo Aaron ne ntar krɔnkrɔn no, nye ne mbabanyin no hɔn ntar no a wɔdze bedzi m’asɔfoe no;
title: EXODUS

text: nye ɔserango no, nye bea krɔnkrɔn nduhuanhuam a wɔahyew no: wɔnyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ wo no nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Eso kasa kyerɛ Israelmba no dɛ, Ampaara, m’ahomgyenda no na hom nsie: osiandɛ ɔyɛ emi nye hom ntamu asɛnkyerɛdze wɔ hom mbasantsen nyina mu; ma hom eehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE a metsew hom ho no.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nsie ahomgyeda no; osiandɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma hom: obiara a ohura ho no, oku na wonku no: na obiara a ɔyɛ edwuma wɔ mu no, wobotwa dɛm ɔkra no efi no nkorɔfo mu akyen.
title: EXODUS

text: Nda esia na wɔmfa nyɛ edwuma; na da a otsia esuon no ɔyɛ ahomgye mu ahomgyeda a ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma EWURADZE: obiara a ɔyɛ edwuma biara wɔ ahomgyeda no mu no, oku na wonku no.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi Israelmba no nsie ahomgyeda no, dɛ wɔrodwen ahomgyeda no do wɔ hɔn mbasantsen nyina mu, dɛ daa ahyɛmu.
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔyɛ emi nye Israelmba ntamu daa daa asɛnkyerɛdze: na nda esia na EWURADZE dze yɛɛ ɔsor nye asaase, na da a otsia esuon no ɔhomee na ɔdwedwee noho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a ɔnye Moses wiee nkɔmbɔ twetwe wɔ bepɔw Sinai do no, ɔdze dasepon ebien no maa no, abopon a, wɔdze Nyankopɔn nsatseaba akyerɛw do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a ɔman no hun dɛ Moses ekyinkyim dɛ obesian efi bepɔw no do aba no, ɔman no boaa hɔn ano wɔ Aaron nkyɛn, na wɔsee no dɛ, Soɛr, yɛ enyame ma hɛn, ma wondzi hɛn enyim; na Moses yi, nyimpa a ɔdze hɛn fi Egypt asaase do bae no dze, yennyim dza ayɛ no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Aaron see hɔn dɛ, Hom nyiyi sika nkaba a ɔhyehyɛ hom yernom, hom mbabanyin, nye hom mbabaa asowa mu no, na wɔmfa mbrɛ me.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔman no nyinara yiyii sika nkaba a ɔhyehyɛ hɔn asowa mu no, na wɔdze brɛɛ Aaron.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔgyee no wɔ hɔn nsamu, na ɔdze edwindadze huorii, na ɔyɛɛ no nantwiba a woegu: na wɔsee dɛ, Israel, iyinom nye w’enyame a woyii wo fii Egypt asaase do bae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a Aaron hun hɔn enyigye wɔ ho no, osii afɔrmbukyia wɔ n’enyim; na Aaron bɔɔ dawur, na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔkyena nye EWURADZE afahyɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔsoɛɛr ahanamakye, na wɔbobɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr, na wɔdzedze asomdwee afɔr bae; na ɔman no tsenaa famu dzidzii, na wɔnomee, na wɔsoɛree goree.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, Sian famu, kɔ; na wo man a edze hɔn fi Egypt asaase do bae no, asɛɛ hɔnho:
title: EXODUS

text: wɔadan efi kwan a mekyerɛɛ hɔn no do ntsɛmara afa nkyɛn: wɔayɛ nantwiba a woegu ama hɔn ho, na wɔasɔr no, na wɔabɔ afɔr ama no, na wɔase dɛ, Israel, iyinom nye w’enyame a woyii wo wɔ Egypt asaase do bae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Mehu ɔman yi, na, hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman akɔnkyefo.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei gyaa me, ma m’ebufuw nhur nhye hɔn, na menhyew hɔn: na menyɛ wo ɔman kɛse.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses paa EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn kyɛw see dɛ, EWURADZE, ebɛnadze ntsi na w’ebufuw nhur nhye wo man a edze ahoɔdzen kɛse nye tum nsa yii hɔn wɔ Egypt asaase do bae no yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Ebɛnadze ntsi na Egyptfo nka dɛ, Bɔn ntsi na okeyii hɔn fiir edzi, ma oeekoku hɔn wɔ mbepɔw no mu, na ɔahyew hɔn efi asaase enyi yi? Dan fi w’ebufuhyew no mu, na ma bɔn yi a edze rebɛyɛ wo man yi nyɛ wo yaw.
title: EXODUS

text: Kaa Abraham, nye Isaak, nye Israel, nye w’akowaa a ekaa hɔn wankasa wo ho ntam, na esee hɔn dɛ, Mebɛma hom asefo adɔr dɛ ɔsor nworaba, na asaase a maka ho asɛm yi nyinara medze bɛma hom asefo, na wobenya edzi daapem.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE nuu no ho wɔ bɔn a ɔkaa dɛ ɔdze rekɛyɛ ne man no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses daan noho, na ɔdze dase apon ebien no kitsaa ne nsamu, fii bepɔw no do sianee; apon a wɔakyerɛw no afanu a; wɔakyerɛw do ha na ha.
title: EXODUS

text: Na apon no yɛ Nyankopɔn edwinsa, na nkyerɛwee no yɛ Nyankopɔn nkyerɛwee a wɔakyerɛw no apon no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a Josua tsee ɔman no hɔn dede dɛ wɔrobɔ ose no, ɔsee Moses dɛ, Ɔko ne dede esi nsera no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nnyɛ hɔn a woedzi konyim esebɔ ndze, nkyii so nnyɛ hɔn a wɔako egu ntseatseamu ndze: mbom hɔn a wɔrotow ndwom ne dede na metse.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔbɛɛn nsera no ara pɛ, nna ohun nantwiba nye asaw no: na Moses no bo fuwii, na ɔtoow ne nsamu apon no gui, na ɔbobɔɔ no wɔ bepɔw no enyiadze.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔfaa nantwiba no a wɔyɛe no, na ɔdze gya hyeew no, na ɔyaam no mokomoko, na ɔdze petsee nsu enyi, na ɔmaa Israelmba no nomee.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see Aaron dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔman yi yɛɛ wo, na edze bɔn aba hɔn do yi?
title: EXODUS

text: Na Aaron see dɛ, Mma mo wura no bo mmfuw: woara nyim ɔman yi dɛ bɔn ara na osi hɔn enyi do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔsee me dɛ, Yɛ hɛn enyame a wobedzi hɛn enyim: na Moses yi, nyimpa a ɔdze hɛn fi Egypt asaase do bae no dze, yennyim dza ayɛ no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mesee hɔn dɛ, Obiara a ɔwɔ sika biara no, wɔmma wonyi; nna wɔdze maa me: na motowee guu gya mu, na ɔnantwiba yi fii mu bae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a Moses hun dɛ ɔman no ayɛ bisibisibasaa no; osiandɛ Aaron ama wɔayɛ bisibisibasaa abɔ adapaa wɔ hɔn atamfo mu:
title: EXODUS

text: nna Moses gyinaa nseraban no ano, na ɔsee dɛ, Obiara a ɔwɔ EWURADZE afa ɔmbra me nkyɛn. Na Levi mbabanyin nyinara boaboaa hɔnho ano baa ne nkyɛn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi, Hom mu nyimpa biara mfa n’afona mbɔ n’asen, na ondzi akɔnaaba, mfi nseraban no ano nkɔ n’ano, na nyimpa biara nku no nua, nye nyimpa biara ne nyɛnko, nye nyimpa biara ne fisamenanyi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Levi mbabanyin no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Moses n’asɛm no tse no ara: na ɔman no mu nyimpa bɛyɛ mpem ebiasa totɔr da no ara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Hom ntu homho nsi nkyɛn mma EWURADZE ndɛ, nyew, nyimpa biara ntsia ne ba, na ontsia no nua; ma ɔdze nhyira aama hom ndɛ da yi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyee no, Moses see ɔman no dɛ, Hom afom mfom kɛse: na afei mobɔfow akɔ EWURADZE nkyɛn; gyangyanbiara mubotum mapata wɔ hom bɔn no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses sanee kɔr EWURADZE nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Ao, mfom kɛse na ɔman yi afom, na wɔayɛ sika enyame ama hɔnho.
title: EXODUS

text: Naaso afei, sɛ edze hɔn bɔn no bɛkyɛ a; na sɛ annyɛ dɛm a, mepa wo kyɛw, pepa mo so fi wo nwoma a akyerɛw no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Obiara a ɔayɛ bɔn etsia me no, ɔno na mebɛpepa no efi mo nwoma no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na afei kɔ, kegya ɔman no kɔ beebi mbrɛ maka akyerɛ wo no: hwɛ, mo bɔfoe bedzi w’enyim akɔ: naaso da a mebɛba abɛsera no, mebɛsera hɔn bɔn wɔ hɔn do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE haaw ɔman no, osian nantwiba a Aaron yɛe no ntsi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, Si mu, fi ha kɔ, ɔwo nye ɔman a edze hɔn fi Egypt asaase do bae no, kɔ asaase a mekaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob, dɛ W’asefo na medze mebɛma hɔn no do:
title: EXODUS

text: na morosoma ɔbɔfo ma oeedzi w’enyim; na metu Keenannyi, Amorinyi, nye Hitinyi, nye Periznyi, nye Hivinyi, nye Jebusnyi no:
title: EXODUS

text: kɔ asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no do: na mirinndzi wo mu nnkɔ; osiandɛ ɔman akɔnkyefo nye wo: bɛyɛ na mahyew wo wɔ ɔkwan no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a ɔman no tsee nsɛm bɔn yi no, wogyamee: na obiara annhyɛ n’ahyehyɛdze.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Se Israelmba no dɛ, Ɔman akɔnkyefo nye hom: sɛ miridzi wo mu mber kakraabi menye wo akɔ a, nkyɛ mebɛhyew wo: dɛm ntsi afei yiyi w’ahyehyɛdze no wɔ wo ho, ma munhu dza medze bɛyɛ wo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba no yiyii hɔn ho ahyehyɛdze no fi bepɔw Horeb ho araa dze kɔ no.
title: EXODUS

text: Afei Moses ɔtɔ dɛ ɔfa buw no na ɔdze kesi nseraban no ekyir, ekyirekyir fi nseraban no ho; na ɔfrɛɛ no Ehyiadzibuw. Na ɔbaa dɛ obiara a ɔrohwehwɛ EWURADZE no fir edzi kɔ ehyiadzibuw no a ɔwɔ nseraban no ekyir no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Moses fiir edzi rokɔ Buw no ho no, ɔman no nyinara soɛrsoɛree, na wogyinagyinae, nyimpa biara wɔ no buw abowano, na wɔhwɛɛ Moses n’etsikɔ araa kodur dɛ ɔkɛhɛɛn Buw no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Moses kɛhɛɛn Buw no mu no, mununkum dum no sianee, na obegyinaa Buw no n’abowano: na EWURADZE nye Moses kasae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔman no nyinara hun mununkum dum no dɛ ogyina Buw no n’abowano: na ɔman no nyinara soɛrsoɛree na wɔkotokotowee, nyimpa biara wɔ no buw abowano.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses enyim nye enyim, dɛ nyimpa rekasa kyerɛ ne nyɛnko. Na ɔsanee baa nseraban no mu: mbom no somfo Josua, Nun ne babanyin, aberantsɛ no, emmfi Buw no mu emmfi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see EWURADZE dɛ, Hwɛ, ese me dɛ, Fa ɔman yi kɔ: na emmaa munnhun nyia ebɔsoma no ma ɔnye me aakɔ. Naaso aka dɛ, Medze wo dzin minyim wo, na enya m’enyim enyimnyam so.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, mepa wo kyɛw, sɛ menya w’enyim enyimnyam a, afei kyerɛ me w’akwan, ama meehu wo, ma meenya w’enyim enyimnyam: na hwɛ ɔman yi dɛ ɔyɛ wo man.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Mara ankasa bedzi w’enyim nye wo akɔ, na mama wo ahomgye.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ warankasa nnye hɛn annkɔ dze a, ɔno mma mmfa hɛn mfi ha nnkɔ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ebɛnadze mu na wɔdze bohu dɛ menya w’enyim enyimnyam, emi nye wo man? Ana nnyɛ kɔ a enye hɛn bɔkɔ no mu bi a, ma yɛaatse hɛnho, emi nye wo man, wɔ amanaman a wɔwɔ asaase enyi nyinara mu bi a?
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Dza aka yi so mebɛyɛ: osiandɛ enya m’enyim enyimnyam, na medze wo dzin minyim wo.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mepa wo kyɛw, kyerɛ me w’enyimnyam.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Mebɛma me yie nyinara etwa mu wɔ w’enyim, na mapaa EWURADZE ne dzin wɔ w’enyim, na madom nyia mobɔdom no, na mehu nyia mubohu no mbɔbɔr, mbɔbɔr.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Innkotum ahwɛ m’enyim: osiandɛ nyimpa nnkɔhwɛ me na ɔatsena ase.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔkwan wɔ me nkyɛn ha, na gyina ɔbotan no do:
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ m’enyimnyam no rutwa mu a, medze wo bɛhyɛ ɔbotan no ne mpaae bi mu, na medze me nsa akata wo do ma meetwa mu ansaana:
title: EXODUS

text: na meeyi me nsa, ma ehu m’ekyir: naaso m’enyim dze, irunnhu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Sen abopon ebien a ɔtse dɛ kan no dze no: na menkyerɛw kan no apon no a ebobɔɔ no no do nsɛm no, wɔ do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na siesie woho sie anapa, na fow bra bepɔw Sinai do anapa no, na yi woho wɔ hɔ kyerɛ me wɔ bepɔw no etsifi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mma nyimpa biara nnka wo ho mmfow mmba, nkyii so mma wonnhu nyimpa biara wɔ bepɔw no do beebiara; na mma nguan anaa anantwi so nndzidzi wɔ bepɔw no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔseen abopon ebien a ɔtse dɛ kan no dze no; na Moses soɛɛr ahanamakye, na ɔfowee kɔr bepɔw Sinai do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ no no na ɔfaa abopon ebien no kitsaa ne nsamu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE nam mununkum mu sianee, na ɔnye no begyinaa hɔ, na ɔpaa EWURADZE ne dzin.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE twaa mu wɔ n’enyim, na ɔpaa dɛ, EWURADZE, EWURADZE, Nyankopɔn a ayamuhyehye nye adom ahyɛ no ma, ɔfa ebufuw nyaa, na no mbɔbɔrhu nye no nokwar dɔɔ so;
title: EXODUS

text: osie mbɔbɔrhu ma mpempem, na ɔdze emumuyɛ nye mbrato nye bɔn kyɛ: na ɔmma afɔdzifo nndzi bem; ɔdze egyanom hɔn emumuyɛ hwɛ mba nye mbanananom, kesi mbasantsen ebiasa nye anan do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses yɛɛ ntsɛm, na ɔbɔɔ ne tsir adze wɔ famu, na ɔsɔree.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ afei menya w’enyim enyimnyam a, EWURADZE, mepa wo kyɛw, ma EWURADZE ndzi hɛn mu nkɔ; osiandɛ wɔyɛ ɔman akɔnkyefo; na fa hɛn emumuyɛ nye hɛn bɔn kyɛ hɛn, na fa hɛn yɛ w’egyapadze.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, miridzi ahyɛmu: wo man nyinara enyim na mebɛyɛ anwanwadze, dza wɔnnyɛɛ bi da wɔ asaase nyinara do, anaaso ɔman biara mu: na nkorɔfo a ewɔ hɔn mu nyinara ehu EWURADZE edwuma, osiandɛ adze a medze wo rebɛyɛ no yɛ hu.
title: EXODUS

text: Dwen dza merehyɛ wo ndɛ yi do: hwɛ, murutu Amorinyi, Keenannyi, Hitinyi, Periznyi, Hivinyi, nye Jebusnyi no wɔ w’enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Hwɛ woho yie, amma ennye asaase a erokɔ do no do atsefo no eenndzi ahyɛmu:
title: EXODUS

text: mbom hom mbubu hɔn afɔrmbukyia, wondwuruw hɔn edum, na wontwitwa hɔn Aserim no ngu:
title: EXODUS

text: na mma nnsɔr onyame fofor bi: osiandɛ EWURADZE, nyia ne dzin nye Onyinkufo No, ɔyɛ Nyame nyinkufo:
title: EXODUS

text: ɔno bɛyɛ na enye asaase no do atsefo no edzi ahyɛmu, na woekedzi hɔn enyame ekyir abɔ ndwamambra, na wɔabɔ afɔr ama hɔn enyame, na obi afrɛ wo na wo so ekedzi n’afɔrbɔdze no bi;
title: EXODUS

text: na afa hɔn mbabaa ama wo mbabanyin awar, na hɔn mbabaa no edzi hɔn enyame no ekyir abɔ ndwamambra, na wɔama wo mbabanyin no ekedzi hɔn enyame no ekyir abɔ ndwamambra.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma nnyɛ enyame a woegu mma woho.
title: EXODUS

text: Sie epitsi afahyɛ no. Nda esuon na dzi epitsi, dɛ mbrɛ mehyɛɛ wo no, bosoom Abib mu wɔ mber a wɔahyɛ no mu: osiandɛ bosoom Abib mu na ifii Egypt bae.
title: EXODUS

text: Dza obue yafun mu nyinara medze a; nye wo fiembowa nyinara mu mbakan a wɔyɛ enyin no, ɔnantwi o, oguan o.
title: EXODUS

text: Na asoasopɔnkɔ abakan dze fa eguambaa pon: na sɛ ammpon no a, ɔno bu no kɔn mu. Wo mbabanyin mu mbakan nyinara dze sesa pon hɔn. Na mma obiara mmfa nsapan mmbefir m’enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Nda esia na yɛ edwuma, na da a otsia esuon no dze, gye w’ahom: funtumber mu nye twaber mu na hom.
title: EXODUS

text: Na dwen adapɛn afahyɛ no do, ewifua twaber mu nduadzewakan no, nye anoboaboa afahyɛ no wɔ afe n’ewiei no.
title: EXODUS

text: Afrenhyia mu mpɛn ebiasa na wo mbabanyin nyinara mbefir wɔ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn no enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mubotutu amanaman wɔ w’enyim, na matsɛw w’ahe mu: nkyii so sɛ erofow akɔ ekefir wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim afrenhyia mu mpɛn ebiasa a, nyimpa biara n’enyi nnkɛber w’asaase.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma mmfa mbɔrkaw nnka m’afɔr bɔgyaa ho; nkyii so mma adze nnkye apaho afahyɛ afɔr no do.
title: EXODUS

text: W’asaase mu nduadzewakan a odzi kan no fa bra EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn fie. Mma nnoa apɔnkyeba wɔ ne na no numfonsu mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Kyerɛw asɛm yi: na nsɛm yi do na megyina menye wo na ɔnye Israel edzi ahyɛmu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔnye EWURADZE dzii hɔ adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa; nkyii so oenndzi edziban, ɔannom nsu so. Na ɔkyerɛɛw ahyɛmu nsɛm no, mbransɛm du no wɔ apon no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Moses fi bepɔw Sinai do sianee no, nna dasepon ebien no dze ne nsamu, na aber a Moses fi bepɔw no do sianee no, nna onnyim dɛ osiandɛ ɔnye EWURADZE kasae ntsi n’enyim wer ahyerɛn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a Aaron nye Israelmba no nyinara hun Moses no, hwɛ, nna n’enyim wer hyerɛn: na wosuroo dɛ wɔbɛbɛn no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses frɛɛ hɔn; na Aaron nye mboanofo no mu mpanyimfo no nyinara sanee baa ne nkyɛn: na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na n’ekyir no Israelmba no nyinara twee bɛnee: na ɔdze dza EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ no wɔ bepɔw Sinai do no nyinara hyɛɛ hɔn mbra.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a Moses nye hɔn wiee kasa no, ɔdze nkataenyim kataa n’enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a Moses rokɔ EWURADZE enyim nye no akɛkasa no, oyii nkataenyim no, dze kodur dɛ ofii ne nkyɛn; na ofii ne nkyɛn na ɔbɛkaa dza wɔdze hyɛɛ no no kyerɛɛ Israelmba no;
title: EXODUS

text: na Israelmba no hun Moses n’enyim dɛ Moses n’enyim wer no hyerɛn: na Moses dze nkataenyim kataa n’enyim bio, kodur dɛ ɔkɔr mu nye EWURADZE kɛkasae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses poon Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara hyiae, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nsɛm a EWURADZE ahyɛ dɛ hom nyɛ nye yi.
title: EXODUS

text: Nda esia na wɔmfa nyɛ edwuma, na da a otsia esuon no nyɛ da krɔnkrɔn mma hom, ahomgyeda pa mma EWURADZE: obiara a ɔbɛyɛ edwuma biara wɔ mu no woboku no.
title: EXODUS

text: Mma hom nnsɔ gya wɔ hom tsenabea nyinara ahomgyeda no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara dɛ, Iyi nye dza EWURADZE hyɛe no, dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Hom nyiyi ayɛyɛdze wɔ hom mu mma EWURADZE: obiara a n’akoma pɛ no, ɔmfa EWURADZE n’ayɛyɛdze mbra; sika, nye dwetɛ, nye boran;
title: EXODUS

text: nye bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw, nye mpɔnkyenhwi;
title: EXODUS

text: nye nguannyin nwoma a wɔahyɛ no memen, nye nsukraman nwoma, nye akeesia dua;
title: EXODUS

text: nye kandzea no ho ngo, nye ɔserango no nye ɔhyeweduhuam no ho nduhuam;
title: EXODUS

text: nye epopobibirbo, nye nsisimu abo a wɔdze besisi asɔfontar egugudo no nye akatabo no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔmma hom mu onyansafo biara mbra, na ɔmbɛhyɛ dza EWURADZE ahyɛ nyinara;
title: EXODUS

text: ntamadan no no buw, nye ne nkatado, nye nkɔtɔkorba, nye ne ntaabow, ne mbeabeamu, n’edum, nye ne ngyinangyinado;
title: EXODUS

text: adaka no, nye no ho mpoma no, mbɔbɔrhu egua no, nye nsensɛnho ntwamutam no;
title: EXODUS

text: ɔpon no, nye no mpoma no, nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye ɔkyerɛ edziban no:
title: EXODUS

text: eso kandzea no ne kandzeadua no, nye no ho ndzɛmba, nye ne nkandzea, nye kandzea no ho ngo;
title: EXODUS

text: nye eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia no, nye no mpoma, nye ɔserango no, nye ɔhyeweduhuam no nye ntamadan abow no, n’abowano nsensɛnho no;
title: EXODUS

text: ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no, nye boran serɛnkye no, no mpoma, nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, eguarsɛn no nye ne ntaease;
title: EXODUS

text: dampan no ne nsensɛnho no, n’edum no, nye ne ngyinangyinado no, nye dampan no n’abotsen ano nkataano no:
title: EXODUS

text: ntamadan no ho mbɔfondua, nye dampan no ho mbɔfondua, nye ne ntampehoma;
title: EXODUS

text: ntar fɛɛfɛw a wɔapempam, wɔdze som wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no, ɔsɔfo Aaron ne ntar krɔnkrɔn no, nye ne mbabanyin hɔn ntar a wɔdze bedzi asɔfo no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara fii Moses enyim kɔree.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔbae, obiara a n’akoma maa no do, nye obiara a no sunsum kaa no no, na wɔdze EWURADZE ayɛyɛdze no baa dɛ wɔmfa nyɛ ehyiadzibuw no, nye no ho som ndzɛmba nyinara, nye ntar krɔnkrɔn no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔbae, mbanyin nye mbaa nyina, dodow a hɔn akoma pɛ nyinara, na wɔdze nkapo, nye asowamuadze, nye nsɔwanonkaba, nye nkrakyer, sika edwindzi ahorow nyinara bae; mekyerɛ nyimpa biara a ɔpɛɛ dɛ ɔdze sika ayɛyɛdze bɔ afɔr ma EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nyimpa biara a ne nsamu wɔ bibir nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw, nye mpɔnkyenhwi, nye nguannyin nwoma a wɔahyɛ no memen, nye nsukraman nwoma, ɔdze bae.
title: EXODUS

text: Obiara a ɔbɔɔ dwetɛ nye boran ayɛyɛdze afɔr no ɔdze EWURADZE ayɛyɛdze no bae: na nyimpa biara a ne nsamu wɔ akeesia dua a wɔdze bɛyɛ som edwuma no biara no, ɔdze bae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mbaa a wɔwɔ nyansa akoma nyinara wɔdze hɔn nsa toow asaaba, na wɔdze dza wɔtowee no bae, bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera pa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mbaa a hɔn akoma kenyaan hɔn wɔ nyansa mu nyinara toow mpɔnkyenhwi no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mpanyimfo no dze epopobibirbo, nye nsisimu abo a wɔdze besisi egugudo no, nye akatabo no bae;
title: EXODUS

text: nye eduhuam, nye ngo; kandzea ho dze, nye ɔserango ho dze, nye ɔhyew eduhuam ho dze.
title: EXODUS

text: Israelmba no dze ayamuyi ayɛyɛdze brɛɛ EWURADZE; ɔbanyin nye ɔbaa biara a hɔn akoma maa hɔn do dɛ wɔmfa edwuma nyinara a EWURADZE nam Moses ne nsa do hyɛɛ dɛ wɔnyɛ no no ho biribi mbra no a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses see Israelmba no dɛ, Hom nhwɛ, EWURADZE abɔ Bezalel, Uri ba no, Hur ba no a ofi Juda ebusuakuw mu no ne dzin afrɛ no:
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔdze Nyankopɔn sunsum ahyɛ no ma, wɔ nyansa, nye ntseasee, nye nyimdzee, nye edwindzi ahorow nyinara mu;
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔdze aadwen ne tsir mu edzi sika, nye dwetɛ, nye boran,
title: EXODUS

text: nye nsisimu abo ntwitwae, nye nduasian mu edwin, ma oeedzi edwin horow nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze ahyɛ n’akoma mu dɛ ɔmfa nkyerɛkyerɛ, ɔno, nye Oholiab, Ahisamak ne babanyin no a ofi Dan ebusuakuw mu no, beenu.
title: EXODUS

text: Hɔn na ɔdze akoma mu nyansa ahyɛ hɔn ma, dɛ wondzi edwin horow nyinara, ɔbosiamfo, nye duadwimfo, nye ɔwemfo a odzi bibir, nye ɔberdum, serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw mu edwin, nye ɔtanwemfo dze no, mekyerɛ hɔn a wodzi edwin biara, nye hɔn a wɔdwen hɔn tsir mu dzi edwin horow.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Bezalel nye Oholiab nye akoma mu onyansafo biara a EWURADZE dze nyansa nye ntseasee ahyɛ no mu dɛ onhu mbrɛ wosi yɛ krɔnkrɔnbea som no ho edwuma nyinara, nyɛ edwuma, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE ahyɛ nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses frɛɛ Bezalel nye Oholiab, nye akoma mu onyansafo biara a EWURADZE dze nyansa ahyɛ n’akoma mu no, mekyerɛ obiara a n’akoma kenyaan no dɛ ɔmbra edwuma no ho mbɛyɛ bi no nyinara:
title: EXODUS

text: na wɔgyee Moses hɔ ayɛyɛdze no a Israelmba no dze baa dɛ wɔmfa nyɛ krɔnkrɔnbea no som ho edwuma no nyinara, dɛ wɔdze bɛyɛ. Na wɔwɔɔw do ara dze ayamuyi ayɛyɛdze brɛɛ no anapa daa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na enyansafo no nyinara a wɔyɛ krɔnkrɔnbea no ho edwuma no nyinara fifii hɔn edwuma a wɔreyɛ no ho bae;
title: EXODUS

text: na wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, Ɔman no dza wɔdze ba dɔɔ so sen dza ɔbɔso edwuma a EWURADZE hyɛɛ dɛ wɔnyɛ no yɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses hyɛɛ mbra, na wɔmaa wɔbɔɔ no dawur wɔ nseraban no mu nyinara dɛ, Ɔbanyin o, ɔbaa o, mma obiara mmfa biribiara nnyɛ krɔnkrɔnbea no ho ayɛyɛdze bio. Nna ɔman no dze gyaa ba.
title: EXODUS

text: Osiandɛ dza wonyae no ara dɔɔ so ma edwuma no nyinara dɛ wɔdze bɛyɛ ma bi aka.
title: EXODUS

text: Na hɔn a wɔyɛɛ edwuma no mu akoma mu onyansafo biara dze nsensɛnho tam du yɛɛ ntamadan no; ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira, nye bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, ayɛ mu kerubim a ɔyɛ odwimfo pa edwinsa na wɔdze yɛe.
title: EXODUS

text: Nsensɛnhotam no kor ne tsentsen yɛ basafa duanan, na nsensɛnhotam no kor ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebien: nsensɛnhoatam no nyinara no nsusui gyinaa kor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze nsensɛnho tam enum toatoaa do ma kor toaa kor so do: na nsensɛnho tam enum no so ɔdze toatoaa do ma kor toaa kor so do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze bibir bobɔɔ nsensɛnho tam kor mbuano do etokur wɔ ano wɔ ntoae no do: dɛmara na ɔyɛe wɔ nsensɛnhotam a odzi ekyir no no mbuano do wɔ ntoae a otsia ebien no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Etokur eduonum na ɔbobɔe wɔ nsensɛnho tam a ɔwɔ ntoae a otsia ebien no so n’ano: etokur no dzi abɔenyim nkorkor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ sika nkɔtɔkorba eduonum, na ɔdze nkɔtɔkorba no yɛe ma nsensɛnho tam no kor toaa kor so do: ma ntamadan no yɛɛ kor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze mpɔnkyenhwi yɛɛ nsensɛnho tam dze sii buw wɔ ntamadan no do: ɔyɛɛ no nsensɛnho tam dubiako.
title: EXODUS

text: Nsensɛnho tam kor ne tsentsen yɛ basafa duenum, na nsensɛnho tam kor ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebien: nsensɛnho tam dubiako no no nsusui gyinaa kor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze nsensɛnho tam enum toatoae yɛɛ no kor, na ɔyɛɛ nsensɛnho tam esia so kor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ etokur eduonum wɔ nsensɛnho tam kor a odzi ekyir no mbuano do wɔ ntoae no do, na ɔyɛɛ etokur eduonum so wɔ ntoae a otsia ebien no ne nsensɛnho tam no mbuano do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ boran nkɔtɔkorba eduonum dze eesusuo buw no mu atoa mu, ma aayɛ kor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze nguannyin nwoma a wɔahyɛ no memen yɛɛ buw no ne nkatado, na ɔdze nsukraman nwoma yɛɛ no sor akatado.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze akeesia dua yɛɛ ntamadan no ne ntaabow a osisi hɔ no.
title: EXODUS

text: Basafa enum yɛ taabow kor ne tsentsen, na bɛyɛ anamɔn ebien nye fa yɛ taabow kor ne tɛtɛr.
title: EXODUS

text: Anan ebien tuatua taabow kor mu, susuoo kor mu faam kor so ho: dɛm na ɔyɛe maa ntamadan no ne ntaabow no nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ntamadan no ne ntaabow no; ntaabow eduonu dzi pomu afamu kyerɛ pomu:
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔyɛɛ ntaabow eduonu no n’ase dwetɛ ngyinado eduanan; ngyinado ebien hyehyɛ taabow kor ase ma n’anan ebien no, na ngyinado ebien hyehyɛ taabow kor so ase ma n’anan ebien no:
title: EXODUS

text: Na ntamadan no n’afa a otsia ebien no a odzi kwaamu afamu no, ɔyɛɛ ntaabow eduonu,
title: EXODUS

text: nye no dwetɛ ngyinado eduanan; ngyinado ebien hyehyɛ taabow kor ase, na ngyinado ebien hyehyɛ taabow kor so ase.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ntamadan no n’ekyir a odzi anee afamu no ɔyɛɛ ntaabow esia.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ntaabow ebien maa ntamadan no no kutuw do wɔ n’ekyir afamu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔpaam ho wɔ ase, na ɔyɛɛ mu dɛmara kodur no sor nkaba kor ho: dɛm na ɔdze yɛɛ n’ebien nyina wɔ kutuw ebien no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ntaabow awɔtwe, nye no dwetɛ ngyinado, ngyinado duesia; ngyinado ebien hyehyɛ taabow biara n’ase.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze akeesia dua yɛɛ mbeabeamu; enum yɛ ntamadan no ne nkyɛn kor ntaabow no nedze,
title: EXODUS

text: na mbeabeamu enum so yɛ ntamadan no ne nkyɛn kor no ne ntaabow no dze, na mbeabeamu enum so yɛ ntamadan no ne nkyɛn ekyir wɔ anee afamu ntaabow no dze.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ finimfin mbeamu a ɔwɔ ntaabow no ne finimfin no ma otwaa mu fi tsir kodur tsir.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze sika duraduraa ntaabow no ho, ɔdze sika yɛɛ no ho nkaba no ma ɔyɛɛ mbeabeamu no hyehyɛbea, na ɔdze sika duraduraa mbeabeamu no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira yɛɛ ntwamutam no: ɔyɛɛ mu kerubim a ɔyɛ odwimfo pa edwinsa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ho akeesia edum anan, na ɔdze sika duraduraa ho: no nkwaba yɛ sika; na oguu ase dwetɛ ngyinado anan.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira ween nkyermu dze yɛɛ ntamadan no n’abowano nkataano;
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔyɛɛ n’edum enum no nye no nkwaba: na oduraduraa n’etsir nye no mbɔtsir ho sika: na ne ngyinado enum no yɛ boran.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Bezalel dze akeesia dua yɛɛ adaka no: ne tsentsen yɛ bɛyɛ basafa kor nye fa, ne tɛtɛr bɛyɛ anamɔn ebien nye fa, no krɔn bɛyɛ anamɔn ebien nye fa:
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔdze sika mapa duraa no mu nye n’ekyir, na ɔyɛɛ sika hankra twaa ho hyiae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na oguu no ho sika nkaba anan, dze sisii n’anan anan no ho; nkaba ebien wɔ n’afa kor, na nkaba ebien wɔ n’afa kor so.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze akeesia dua senseen mpoma, na oduraduraa ho sika.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze mpoma no hyehyɛɛ nkaba no mu wɔ adaka no ne nkyɛn mu, ma wɔdze aasoa adaka no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze sika mapa yɛɛ mbɔbɔrhu egua: ne tsentsen yɛ bɛyɛ basafa kor nye fa, na ne tɛtɛr bɛyɛ anamɔn ebien nye fa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ sika kerubim ebien; ɔbor edwuma na wɔdze yɛe, wɔ mbɔbɔrhu egua ne tsir ebien no;
title: EXODUS

text: kerubim kor wɔ ne tsir kor, na kerubim kor wɔ ne tsir kor so: mbɔbɔrhu egua no ne sin kor no ara mu na ɔmaa kerubim no firii wɔ ne tsir ebien no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na kerubim no tserɛtserɛɛw hɔn ntsaban mu wɔ sor, dze hɔn ntsaban no kataa mbɔbɔrhu egua no do, hɔn enyim dzi abɔenyim; mbɔbɔrhu egua no do na kerubfo no hɔn enyim bedzii.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze akeesia dua yɛɛ ɔpon no: ne tsentsen yɛ basafa kor, na ne tɛtɛr anamɔn kor na fa, na no krɔn bɛyɛ anamɔn ebien nye fa:
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔdze sika mapa duraa ho, na ɔyɛɛ ho sika hankra hyiae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ho ntotoano a ɔbɛyɛ nsatseama hyiae, na ɔyɛɛ no ntotoano no ho sika hankra hyiae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na oguu no ho sika nkaba anan, na ɔdze nkaba no sisii kutuw anan a ɔwowɔ n’anan anan no ho no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Ntoatoano no nkyɛn papaapa na nkaba no dzii, beebi mbrɛ wɔdze mpoma no bɛhyehyɛ dze asoa ɔpon no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze akeesia dua sinsiaan mpoma no, na oduraduraa ho sika, ma wɔdze aasoa ɔpon no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze sika mapa yɛɛ ɔpon no no do ndzɛmba no, nkwansɛn, nye ne ntser, nye no nkorbaa, nye no nkɔɔpow a wɔdze bohue.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze sika mapa yɛɛ kandzeadua no: ɔbor edwuma na ɔdze yɛɛ kandzeadua no, n’anan, nye no dua; no ho mpokuwa, nye nkukuduuduw, nye ne nhyiren, fi sin kor no ara mu:
title: EXODUS

text: na abaw esia fifi ne nkyɛn mu; na kandzeadua no abaw ebiasa fi n’afa kor, na ebiasa fi n’afa kor so.
title: EXODUS

text: Mpokuwa ebiasa a wɔayɛ no dɛ almɔnd nhyiren wɔ abaw kor ho, kukuduuduw nye nhyiren; na mpokuwa ebiasa a wɔayɛ no dɛ almɔnd nhyiren wɔ abaw kor no so ho, kukuduuduw nye nhyiren: dɛmara na ɔtse wɔ abaw esia a efifir kandzeadua no ho no ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na kandzeadua no ho wɔ mpokuwa anan a wɔayɛ no dɛ almɔnd nhyiren, no nkukuduuduw, nye ne nhyiren:
title: EXODUS

text: na kukuduuduw hyɛ abaw ebien a otuatua ho no mu biara ase, wɔ abaw esia a efifir mu no ase.
title: EXODUS

text: No nkukuduuduw nye n’abaw no fi sin kor mu ara: ne nyinara sika mapa na wɔdze yɛɛ no ɔbor edwuma kor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze sika mapa yɛɛ no ho nkandzea no esuon, nye no ho adabaa no, nye no ho nsompokuwa no.
title: EXODUS

text: Sika mapa kyɛpɛn kor na ɔdze yɛe, nye no ho ndzɛmba no nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze akeesia dua yɛɛ eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia: ne tsentsen yɛ bɛyɛ anamɔn kor nye fa, na ne tɛtɛr bɛyɛ anamɔn kor nye fa, etwaanan a; na no krɔn yɛ basafa kor; ne mmbɛn so fi sin kor no ara mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze sika mapa duraa ho fi n’etsifi, nye ne nkyɛn nkyɛn hyiae, nye ne mmbɛn no: na ɔyɛɛ ho sika hankra dze hyiae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ no ho sika nkaba ebien wɔ ne hankra no ase, wɔ ne mparba ebien no do, wɔ ne nkyɛnmu ebien no do, beebi mbrɛ wɔdze mpoma no bɛhyehyɛ dze asoa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze akeesia dua senseen mpoma no, na oduraduraa ho sika.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ɔserango krɔnkrɔn no, nye nduhuanhuam hyewee gyenengyenen no, dɛ mbrɛ oduhuamforafo n’edwuma tse.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze akeesia dua yɛɛ ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no: ne tsentsen yɛ basafa ebien nye fa, na ne tɛtɛr basafa ebien nye fa, etwaanan a: na no krɔn basafa kor nye fa.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ no ho mmbɛn sisii no kutuw anan no do; ne mmbɛn so fi sin kor no ara mu: na ɔdze boran duraa ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ afɔrmbukyia no no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, n’asɛn, nye no nsofi, nye no nkɔɔpow, n’edzinam, nye ne gyansenama kukuwa: no ho ndzɛmba nyinara boran na ɔdze yɛe.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔween afɔrmbukyia no ho boran serɛnkye a wɔawen no atena, wɔ ne bamba no ho wɔ ase fi famu kodu finimfin.
title: EXODUS

text: Na oguu nkaba anan tuatuaa boran serɛnkye no no kutuw anan no do, dɛ ɔnyɛ mpoma no ne hyɛbew.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze akeesia dua senseen mpoma no, na ɔdze boran duraduraa ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze poma no hyehyɛɛ nkaba no mu wɔ afɔrmbukyia no ne nkyɛn nkyɛn, ma wɔdze aasoa; ɔdze ntaabow yɛe, no mu da kwan.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze boran yɛɛ eguarsɛn no, na ne ntaease no so boran a ofi mbaa asomfo a wɔsom wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano no hɔn nhwehwɛ no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dampan no; pomu afamu a ɔkyerɛ pomu no nye dampan nsensɛnho a wɔdze ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira awen a ne tsentsen basafa eduonu enum dzi:
title: EXODUS

text: n’edum yɛ du, nye ne ngyinado du, boran a; edum no no nkwaba nye no mbɔtsir no dwetɛ a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na kwaamu afamu no basafa eduonum, n’edum du, nye ne ngyinado du, boran a; edum no no nkwaba nye no mbɔtsir no dwetɛ a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na anee afamu no ɔyɛɛ nsensɛnho basafa eduonu enum, n’edum du, nye ne ngyinado du; edum no no nkwaba nye no mbɔtsir no dwetɛ a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na boka afamu a ɔkyerɛ boka no basafa eduonu enum.
title: EXODUS

text: Abotsen no n’afa kor nsensɛnho yɛ basafa esuon na fa; n’edum kor na fa, nye ne ngyinado kor na fa;
title: EXODUS

text: na dɛmara wɔ afa kor no so: dampan no ano abotsen no n’afa ha nye n’afa ha nsensɛnho no ɔyɛ basafa esuon na fa; n’edum kor na fa nye ne ngyinado kor na fa.
title: EXODUS

text: Dampan no ne nsensɛnho a etwa ho ehyia nyinara ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira na wɔdze yɛe.
title: EXODUS

text: Na edum no ne ngyinado no boran a; edum no no nkwaba nye no mbɔtsir no dwetɛ a; na dampan no n’edum nyinara wɔdze dwetɛ abobɔ no abɔtsir.
title: EXODUS

text: Na dampan no n’abotsen no ano nkataano no, wɔdze bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira ayɛ no nkyermu yɛe: na ne tsentsen yɛ basafa du, na no krɔn wɔ ne tɛtɛr mu no ɔyɛ basafa ebien na fa, ɔtse dɛ dampan no ho nsensɛnho no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na edum no yɛ anan, nye ne ngyinado anan, boran a; no nkwaba dwetɛ a, na n’etsir nduraho nye no mbɔtsir dwetɛ a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ntamadan no, nye dampan no ho mbɔfondua a etwa ho ehyia no nyinara boran a.
title: EXODUS

text: Iyi nye ntamadan no ho ndzɛmba, no dodow, mekyerɛ dase ntamadan no, dɛ mbrɛ wɔnam Moses mbrasɛm do, dze maa Levifo no hɔn som, wɔnam ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Itamar ne nsa do buu ano no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Bezalel, Uri ne ba no, Hur ne ba no a ofi Juda ebusuakuw mu no, yɛɛ dza EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nyia ɔka no ho nye Oholiab, Ahisamak ne ba no a ofi Dan ebusuakuw mu no, ɔbosiamfo, nye nduadwimfo, nye ɔwemfo a odzi bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw mu edwin.
title: EXODUS

text: Sika nyinara a wɔdze yɛɛ edwuma wɔ krɔnkrɔnbea no ho edwuma nyinara mu no, mekyerɛ oyima sika no, ɔyɛ talent eduonu akron, nye dwetɛbona ahaesuon eduasa, dɛ mbrɛ krɔnkrɔnbea dwetɛbona no tse.
title: EXODUS

text: Na mboanofo no mu hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn no hɔn dwetɛ yɛ kyɛpɛn ɔha, nye dwetɛbona apem ahaesuon eduosuon enum, dɛ mbrɛ krɔnkrɔnbea dwetɛbona no tse:
title: EXODUS

text: itsir kor, biika kor, ɔnye dɛ, dwetɛbona fa, dɛ mbrɛ krɔnkrɔnbea dwetɛbona no tse, obiara a otwaa mu kɔr hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn no mu no, oedzi mfe fi eduonu nye n’ekyir no a wɔyɛ nyimpa mpem ahaesia mpensa ahaenum eduonum no dze nye no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na dwetɛ kyɛpɛn ɔha no wɔdze guu krɔnkrɔnbea ne ngyinado, nye ntwamutam ne ngyinado no; ngyinado ɔha yɛ dwetɛ kyɛpɛn ɔha, dwetɛ kyɛpɛn kor ngyinado kor.
title: EXODUS

text: Na dwetɛbona apem ahaesuon eduosuon enum no, ɔdze yɛɛ edum no no nkwaba no, na ɔdze duraduraa n’etsir ho, na ɔdze yɛɛ no ho mbɔtsir.
title: EXODUS

text: Na oyima boran no ɔyɛ dwetɛ kyɛpɛn eduosuon, nye dwetɛbona mpemebien ahaanan.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔno na ɔdze yɛɛ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano ngyinado no, nye boran afɔrmbukyia no, nye no ho boran serɛnkye no, nye afɔrmbukyia no ho ndzɛmba nyinara,
title: EXODUS

text: nye dampan no ne ngyinado a etwa ho ehyia, nye dampan no n’abotsen ano ngyinado, nye ntamadan no ho mbɔfondua nyinara, nye dampan no no mbɔfondua a etwa ho ehyia nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔdze bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, yɛɛ ntar fɛɛfɛw a wɔdze bɔsom wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn hɔ no, na wɔyɛɛ Aaron ntar krɔnkrɔn no dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze sika, nye bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira ween egugudo no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔboor sika no tɛtraba, na wotwitwaa no ntseatseaba, dɛ wɔdze robɔfora bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw no mu edzi no edwin.
title: EXODUS

text: Wɔyɛɛ ho abatsir ahoma a wɔdze atoa ano ebien no na wɔkaa bɔɔ mu toae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na nkyermu abɔdo a wɔawen a ɔwɔ no do, ma wɔdze abɔ ne nyina do no, ofi ahoma kor no ara mu na ɔtse dɛ n’edwinsa no ara; sika, bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wosiaan epopobibirbo, sisii sika mbraho mu a, wɔdze nsɔwanokaba nkyerɛwee kyerɛwee, dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba no hɔn edzin tsetsee.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze bobɔɔ egugudo no n’abatsir ahoma no do ma wɔaayɛ nkaa abo ama Israelmba no; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ akatabo no, odwimfo pa edwinsa, dɛ mbrɛ egugudo edwuma no tse; sika, bibir, ɔberdum, serdaa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira.
title: EXODUS

text: Ɔyɛ etwaanan; wɔyɛɛ akatabo no mbɔho: ne tsentsen yɛ nsatseama, na ne tɛtɛr nsatseama, ɔyɛ mbɔho ntsi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔdze abo akyerɛpɛn anan sisii mu: kyerɛpɛn a odzi kan no yɛ bɔgyanambo, kratsebo nye ahatawmomonbo kyerɛpɛn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na kyerɛpɛn a otsia ebien no, nserɛmɛmbo, hoabo, nye ɔdɛnkyɛmbo a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na kyerɛpɛn a otsia ebiasa no, ekutuhonbo, aforaforabo nye ɔberdumbo a.
title: EXODUS

text: Na kyerɛpɛn a otsia anan no, sikabereebo, epopobibirbo, nye ahwehwɛbo a: ne nsisimu no wɔyɛɛ ho sika mbraho hyiae.
title: EXODUS

text: Na abo no wɔyɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba no hɔn edzin tsetsee, duebien, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edzin tsetsee; dɛ nsɔwanonkaba nkyerɛwee, baako biara mbrɛ ne dzin tse, dze ma ebusuakuw duebien no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔdze sika mapa yɛɛ akatabo no do ntweaban dɛ ahoma, mbɛsawɔw edwuma.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔyɛɛ sika mbraho ebien, nye sika nkaba ebien; na wɔdze nkaba ebien no hyehyɛɛ akatabo no n’ano ebien no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔdze sika ntweaban a wɔawɔw no mbɛsa ebien no hyehyɛɛ akatabo no n’ano nkaba ebien no mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ntweaban a wɔawɔw no mbɛsa ebien no n’ano ebien a aka no, wɔdze toatoaa mbraho ebien no mu, na wɔdze hyehyɛɛ egugudo no n’abatsir ahoma no do wɔ n’enyim afamu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔyɛɛ sika nkaba ebien, na wɔdze hyehyɛɛ akatabo no n’ano ebien do, wɔ ne mfɛn, no mu afamu a ɔba egugudo no ho no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔyɛɛ sika nkaba ebien, na wɔdze hyehyɛɛ egugudo no n’abatsir ahoma ebien no do wɔ ase, wɔ n’enyim afamu, no ntoatoado no nkyɛn, wɔ egugudo no ne nkyermu abɔdo a wɔawen no do.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔdze bibir ahoma kyekyeer akatabo no ne nkaba no susuoo egugudo no ne nkaba no mu, dɛ ɔmfam egugudo no ne nkyermu abɔdo a wɔawen no do, amma akatabo no aannsan emmfi egugudo no ho; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ egugudo no ne bataker no tanwemfo edwinsa, ne nyinara bibir ara nko;
title: EXODUS

text: na bataker no ne finimfin otokur no, ɔtse dɛ dadze atar no tokur, wɔdze ɔtamban a wɔawen aban otokur no n’ano ehyia, amma woeennsuan.
title: EXODUS

text: Na bataker no no mbuano no do no wɔyɛɛ bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa, nye ndwera a woefira pɔmegranate eduaba.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔdze sika mapa yɛɛ ndɔndɔmba, na wɔdze ndɔndɔmba no sensɛɛn pɔmegranate eduaba no ne ntamu ne ntamu wɔ bataker no no mbuano no do dze twaa ho hyiae, wɔ pɔmegranate eduaba no ne ntamu ne ntamu;
title: EXODUS

text: adɔmba nye pɔmegranate, adɔmba nye pɔmegranate, wɔ bataker no no mbuano no do ara hyiae, ma wɔdze aasom; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔyɛɛ ndwera fɛɛfɛw ntar a wɔawen no nkyermu maa Aaron, nye ne mbabanyin no,
title: EXODUS

text: nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw asɔfokyɛw, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw mbɔtsir a ɔyɛ fɛw, nye ndwera ntwontwo a wɔdze ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira ayɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: na abɔdo no a wɔdze ndwera fɛɛfɛw a woefira, nye bibir, nye ɔberdum, nye serdaa yɛe, nkyermuwemfo edwinsa a; dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔdze sika mapa yɛɛ abɔtsir krɔnkrɔn no ne tɛrba no, na wɔkyerɛɛw do nkyerɛwee dɛ nsɔwanokaba do nkyerɛwee dɛ, KRƆNKRƆN MA EWURADZE.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔdze bibir ahoma kyekyeree dze faam asɔfokyɛw no ho sor; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Ehyiadzibuw no ntamadan no ho edwuma nyinara mbrɛ wosii wiei nye yi: na Israelmba no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na wɔdze ntamadan no brɛɛ Moses, Buw no, nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, no nkɔtɔkorba, ne ntaabow, ne mbeabeamu, nye n’edum, nye ne ngyinangyinado;
title: EXODUS

text: na nguannyin nwoma a wɔahyɛ no memen nkatado, nye nsukraman nwoma nkatado, nye ntwamutam nsensɛnho no;
title: EXODUS

text: dasedaka no, nye no mpoma no, nye mbɔbɔrhu egua no;
title: EXODUS

text: pon no, no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye kyerɛ edziban no;
title: EXODUS

text: kandzeadua krɔnkrɔn no, ne nkandzea, mekyerɛ nkandzea a wobesiesie esisi do, nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye kandzea no ngo;
title: EXODUS

text: na sika afɔrmbukyia no, nye ɔserango no, nye eduhuam hyewee huanhuam no, nye Buw no n’abowano nsensɛnho no;
title: EXODUS

text: boran afɔrmbukyia no, nye no boran serɛnkye, no mpoma, nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, eguarsɛn no nye ne ntaease;
title: EXODUS

text: dampan no ne nsensɛnho no, n’edum, nye ne ngyinangyinado, nye dampan no n’abotsenano nsensɛnho, n’ahoma, nye no mbɔfondua, nye ntamadan no no som ho ndzɛmba nyinara, dze aama ehyiadzibuw no;
title: EXODUS

text: ntar fɛɛfɛw a wɔdze som wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn hɔ no, ɔsɔfo Aaron ne ntar krɔnkrɔn no, nye ne mbabanyin ntar a wɔdze bedzi asɔfo no.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses nyinara no, dɛmara na Israelmba no yɛɛ edwuma no nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses hwɛɛ edwuma no nyinara, na, hwɛ, wɔayɛ; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛe no, dɛmara so pɛ na wɔyɛe: na Moses hyiraa hɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: EXODUS

text: Bosoom a odzi kan no ne da a odzi kan no si ehyiadzibuw no ne ntamadan no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa ahyɛmudaka no si mu, na fa ntwamutam no kata adaka no enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa ɔpon no kɔ mu, na siesie ndzɛmba a wɔdze sisi do no; na fa kandzeadua no kɔ mu, na sosɔ ne nkandzea no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa sika eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia no kesi ahyɛmudaka no enyim, na fa ntamadan no n’abowano nsensɛnho no sɛn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no si ehyiadzibuw no ne ntamadan no n’abow enyim.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa eguarsɛn no si ehyiadzibuw no nye afɔrmbukyia no ntamu, na fa nsu gu mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sisi dampan no hyia, na fa dampan no n’abotsenano nsensɛnho no sɛn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa ɔserango no, na fa sera ntamadan no, nye no mu adze nyinara, na yɛ no krɔnkrɔn, ɔnye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara; na ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sera ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no, nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara ngo, na yɛ afɔrmbukyia no krɔnkrɔn: na afɔrmbukyia no nyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na sera eguarsɛn no nye ne ntaease no ngo, na yɛ no krɔnkrɔn.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no bra ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano, na fa nsu hohor hɔn ho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa ntar krɔnkrɔn hyɛ Aaron; na sera no ngo, na yɛ no krɔnkrɔn ma ondzi mo sɔfoe.
title: EXODUS

text: Na fa ne mbabanyin no bra, na hyehyɛ hɔn sorntar:
title: EXODUS

text: na sera hɔn ngo dɛ mbrɛ eseraa hɔn egya ngo no, ma wondzi m’asɔfoe: na hɔn sera no nyɛ hɔn daadaa asɔfodzi nkɔ hɔn ebusuasantsen nyina mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Dɛm na Moses yɛe: dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ no no nyinara.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia ebien no mu bosoom a odzi kan no mu, da a odzi bosoom no ne kan no, na wosii ntamadan no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses sii ntamadan no, na ɔhyehyɛɛ ne ngyinangyinado no, na osisii ne ntaabow no, na ɔdze ne mbeabeamu no beabeaa mu, na ogyinagyinaa n’edum no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔtserɛɛw buw no mu kataa ntamadan no do, na ɔdze ɔsor buw no ne nkatado no kataa do; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔfaa dase no dze hyɛɛ adaka no, na ɔdze mpoma no hyehyɛɛ adaka no ho, na ɔdze mbɔbɔrhu egua no sii adaka no do ɔsor;
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔdze adaka no kɔr ntamadan no mu, na ɔdze nsensɛnho ntwamutam no sensɛnee, na ɔdze kataa ahyɛmudaka no enyim; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze ɔpon no sii ehyiadzibuw no mu, wɔ ntamadan no nkyɛn mu kwaamu afamu, wɔ ntwamutam no ekyir.
title: EXODUS

text: Na osiesiee edziban no wɔ do wɔ EWURADZE enyim; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze kandzeadua no sii ehyiadzibuw no mu, wɔ ɔpon no tsentsendo, wɔ ntamadan no nkyɛn mu pomu afamu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔsosɔɔ nkandzea no wɔ EWURADZE enyim; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze sika afɔrmbukyia no sii ehyiadzibuw no mu wɔ ntwamutam no enyim:
title: EXODUS

text: na ɔhyeew nduhuam wɔ do; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze nsensɛnho no sɛɛn ntamadan no n’abow no ano.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no sii ehyiadzibuw ntamadan no n’abow no ano, na ɔbɔɔ do ɔhyew afɔr nye edziban afɔr; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na ɔdze eguarsɛn no sii ehyiadzibuw no nye afɔrmbukyia no ntamu, na ɔdze nsu guu mu dɛ wɔmfa nhohor hɔnho.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no hohoor hɔn nsa ho nye hɔn anan ho wɔ hɔ;
title: EXODUS

text: aber a wɔrokɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, na aber a wɔrebɛbɛn afɔrmbukyia no, wɔhohoor hɔnho: dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: EXODUS

text: Na osii dampan no dze twaa ntamadan no nye afɔrmbukyia no ho hyiae, na ɔdze dampan no n’abotsenano nsensɛnho no sɛnee. Nna Moses wiee edwuma no yɛ.
title: EXODUS

text: Nna mununkum no bɛkataa ehyiadzibuw no do, na EWURADZE enyimnyam bɛhyɛɛ ntamadan no ma.
title: EXODUS

text: Na Moses enntum annhɛn ehyiadzibuw no mu, osian mununkum no a ɔtse do, na EWURADZE enyimnyam a ahyɛ ntamadan no ma ntsi.
title: EXODUS

text: Na aber a wɔama mununkum no do wɔ ntamadan no do no, nna Israelmba etu kɔ kan, wɔ hɔn akwantutu no nyina mu;
title: EXODUS

text: na sɛ mununkum no wɔamma do a, ɔnodze wonntu kwan araa kodur da a wɔama do no.
title: EXODUS

text: Osiandɛ EWURADZE no mununkum no wɔ ntamadan no do adzekyee, na ogya wɔ mu adzesaa, wɔ Israel fi no nyinara enyim, wɔ hɔn akwantutu no nyina mu.
title: EXODUS

text: Na EWURADZE frɛɛ Moses, na ofii ehyiadzibuw no mu kasaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom mu nyimpa biara dze ayɛyɛdze rebrɛ EWURADZE a, hom mfa hom fiembowa, a wɔyɛ anantwi nye nguan mu bi, nyɛ hom ayɛyɛdze mbra.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ n’ayɛyɛdze yɛ ɔhyew afɔr a ofi anantwi mu a, ɔmfa onyin a onndzii dzɛm mbra ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano, ama aayɛ enyisɔ wɔ EWURADZE enyim ama no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto ɔhyew afɔr no n’etsifi; na ɔbɔsɔ enyi dɛ mpata ama no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na onku nantwisaa no wɔ EWURADZE enyim: na Aaron mbabanyin, asɔfo no, mfa bɔgya no mbɛkyerɛ, na wɔmfa bɔgya no mpetse afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano no do nhyia.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔnyer abowa no, na ontwitwa no esinesin.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo Aaron ne mbabanyin no mfa nyena ngu afɔrmbukyia no do, na wɔnsɔ gya wɔ do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Aaron mbabanyin asɔfo no, mfa esinesin no, tsir no, nye seradze no, ngu yie wɔ nyena a ɔsɛw gya no afɔrmbukyia no do no do;
title: LEVITICUS

text: n’ayamudze nye ne ntwɛr dze ɔmfa nsu nhohor ho ana: na ɔsɔfo no nhyew ne nyinara wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, ma ɔnyɛ ɔhyew afɔr, mekyerɛ ogya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdze fi nguankuw, nkɔsɔw anaa mpɔnkye mu a, ɔmfa onyin a onndzii dzɛm mbra.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na onku no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no ne nkyɛn mu kwaamu afamu wɔ EWURADZE enyim: na Aaron mbabanyin, asɔfo no, mfa no bɔgyaa mpetse afɔrmbukyia no do nhyia.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ontwitwa no esinesin, nka ne tsir nye ne seradze ho; na ɔsɔfo no nsiesie no yie ngu nyena no a ɔwɔ gya no a ɔwɔ afɔrmbukyia no do no do:
title: LEVITICUS

text: ayamudze nye ntwɛr no dze ɔmfa nsu nhohor ho ana: na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nyinara mbra, na ɔmbɛhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: ɔyɛ ɔhyew afɔr, mekyerɛ ogya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdze fi nnoma mu na ɔdze robɔbɔ EWURADZE ɔhyew afɔr a, ɔno ɔmfa ntamram, anaa mborɔnomamba bi nyɛ n’ayɛyɛdze mbra.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa mbra afɔrmbukyia no ho, na ɔntsew ne tsir, na ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do; na no bɔgyaa no nkyi ngu afɔrmbukyia no ho:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na onyi no totuaa nka no mu ifi no ho, na ɔntow nkyen afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn wɔ boka afamu, wɔ mbrɛ nso no gu no:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na onsuan mu wɔ n’atsaban ho, na mbom mma ɔnntsew mu: na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, wɔ nyena no a ɔwɔ gya no do no do: ɔyɛ ɔhyew afɔr, mekyerɛ ogya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ obiara dze edziban afɔr ayɛyɛdze rebrɛ EWURADZE a, n’ayɛyɛdze no nyɛ isiam pa; na onhue ngo ngu do, na ɔmfa krɔbɔw nto do:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmfa mbrɛ Aaron mbabanyin asɔfo no: na ɔmfa isiam pa, nye no ngo no ne nsapuw, ɔnye no krɔbɔw no nyinara: na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no dɛ nkaadze wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, ogya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma EWURADZE:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na edziban afɔr no mu dza ɔbɛka no nyɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin dze: ɔyɛ EWURADZE ogya afɔr mu krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ edze edziban afɔr ayɛyɛdze a wɔto no wɔ fononoo mu bi rebɛba a, fa isiam pa epitsi tatar a wɔafrɔw no ngo, anaa epitsi tatar ntrɛtraba a wɔasera ho ngo.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ w’ayɛyɛdze no yɛ ɔtosɛn mu edziban afɔr a, ma ɔnyɛ isiam pa epitsi a wɔafɔw no ngo.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Bubu mu esinesin, na hue ngo gu do: ɔyɛ edziban afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ w’ayɛyɛdze no yɛ ɔkyesɛn mu edziban afɔr a, fa isiam pa nye ngo yɛ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na fa edziban afɔr a wɔdze ndzɛmba yinom ayɛ no brɛ EWURADZE: wɔmfa mma ɔsɔfo no, ma ɔmfa mbra afɔrmbukyia no ho.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no nyi edziban afɔr no do nkaadze no, na ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: ɔyɛ ogya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: na edziban afɔr no mu dza ɔbɛka no nyɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin dze: ɔyɛ EWURADZE ogya afɔr mu krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Edziban afɔr biara a hom dze bɛbrɛ EWURADZE no, mma wɔmmfa mbɔrkaw nnyɛ: na mma hom nnhyew mbɔrkaw, anaa ewo biara, dɛ ogya afɔr mma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Hom mfa iyinom mbrɛ EWURADZE, dɛ nduadzewakan ayɛyɛdze: na afɔrmbukyia no do dze, na mma bi mmba mmbeyi nka huanhuam.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na w’edziban afɔr ayɛyɛdze biara fa nkyen to mu; nkyii so mma wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛmu nkyen no mmpa w’edziban afɔr mu: w’ayɛyɛdze nyinara mu fa nkyen ka ho bra.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ edze nduadzewakan ayɛyɛdze rebrɛ EWURADZE a, fa eburow mbɛtsem a wɔatoto no ogya mu, eburow mbɛtsem nomanoma a wɔapose, yɛ wo nduadzewakan mu ayɛyɛdze bra.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na fa ngo gu do, na fa krɔbɔw to do: ɔyɛ edziban afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew ne nkaadze no, n’eburow mposee no bi, nye no ngo no bi, nye no krɔbɔw no nyinara; ɔyɛ ogya afɔr ma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdze yɛ asomdwee afɔr afɔrbɔdze; sɛ ofi anantwi mu, dɛ onyin o, ɔber o, na ɔdze reba a, dza onndzii dzɛm na ɔmfa no mbra EWURADZE enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n’ayɛyɛdze no etsifi, na onku no wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano: na Aaron mbabanyin asɔfo no mfa bɔgya no mpetse afɔrmbukyia no do nhyia.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na onyi asomdwee afɔr no mu bi mbra mbɛyɛ ogya afɔr mma EWURADZE. Onyi seradze a ɔkata ayamudze do no, nye seradze a ɔwɔ do no,
title: LEVITICUS

text: nye nsɛbɛ ebien no, na seradze a ɔwɔ ho no, dza ɔwɔ sisiw mu, nye berɛbo do ntentan no mfi hɔ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Aaron mbabanyin no nhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do ɔhyew afɔr no a ɔwɔ nyena no a ɔwɔ ogya no do no do: ɔyɛ ogya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdze a ɔdze rebɛyɛ asomdwee afɔr afɔrbɔdze ama EWURADZE no fi nguan mu a; onyin o, ɔber o, dza onndzii dzɛm na ɔmfa no mbra.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ ɔdze eguambaa rebɛyɛ n’ayɛyɛdze a, ɔno ɔmfa no mbra EWURADZE enyim:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n’ayɛyɛdze no etsifi, na onku no wɔ ehyiadzibuw no enyim: na Aaron mbabanyin no mfa no bɔgyaa mpetse afɔrmbukyia no do nhyia.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na onyi asomdwee afɔr no bi mbra mbɛyɛ EWURADZE ogya afɔr; ne seradze no, nye seradze dua mu no nyinara, ɔntwe no wɔ n’ekyir kratse no ho. Na onyi seradze a ɔkata ayamudze no ho no, nye seradze a ɔwɔ ayamudze no do no nyinara,
title: LEVITICUS

text: nye nsɛbɛ ebien no, nye no do seradze no a ɔwɔ sisiw mu no, nye berɛbo do ntentan no mfi hɔ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: ɔyɛ ogya afɔr edziban ma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdze yɛ apɔnkye a, ɔno ɔmfa no mbra EWURADZE enyim:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n’etsifi, na onku no wɔ ehyiadzibuw no enyim; na Aaron ne mbabanyin no mfa no bɔgyaa mpetse afɔrmbukyia no do nhyia.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na onyi mu bi mbra mbɛyɛ n’ayɛyɛdze, mekyerɛ ogya afɔr mma EWURADZE; seradze a ɔkata ayamudze no ho no, nye seradze a ɔwɔ ayamudze no do no nyinara,
title: LEVITICUS

text: nye nsɛbɛ ebien no, nye no do seradze no a ɔwɔ sisiw mu no, nye berɛbo do ntentan no dze, onyi mfi hɔ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: ɔyɛ ogya afɔr edziban a oyi nka huanhuam: seradze no nyinara yɛ EWURADZE dze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hom ebusuasantsen mu wɔ hom tsenabea nyinara mu, dɛ hom nndzi seradze anaa bɔgya biara.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, dɛ, Sɛ nyimpa biara yɛ bɔn a ɔnndze enyidaho wɔ ndzɛmba biara a EWURADZE ahyɛ ho mbra dɛ mma wɔnnyɛ no mu, na ɔkɛyɛ no mu kor biara a, dza wɔnyɛ nye iyi:
title: LEVITICUS

text: sɛ ɔsɔfo a wɔasera no no kɛyɛ bɔn ma ɔdze asodzi ba ɔman no do a: ɔno no bɔn a ɔayɛ no ntsi, ma ɔmfa ɔnantwisaa eburwa a onndzii dzɛm mbrɛ EWURADZE mfa nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa nantwisaa no mbra ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano wɔ EWURADZE enyim; na ɔmfa ne nsa nto nantwisaa no n’etsifi, na onku no wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo a wɔasera no no mfa nantwisaa no no bɔgyaa no bi, na ɔmfa mbra ehyiadzibuw no mu:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatseaba mbɔ bɔgya no mu, na ɔmfa bɔgya no bi mpetse mpɛn esuon wɔ EWURADZE enyim, wɔ krɔnkrɔnbea no no ntwamutam no enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa bɔgya no bi nkeka eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ EWURADZE enyim no a ɔwɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no ne mbɛn no ho; na onhue nantwisaa no no bɔgyaa nyinara ngu ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano no ase.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na onyi bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no ne seradze no nyinara mfi no ho; seradze a ɔkata ayamudze no ho no, nye ayamudze no ho seradze no nyinara,
title: LEVITICUS

text: nye nsɛbɛ ebien no, nye no do seradze no a ɔwɔ sisiw mu no, nye berɛbo do ntentan no, onyi mfi hɔ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: dɛ mbrɛ woyi fi asomdwee afɔr ayɛyɛdze nantwinyin ho: na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nantwisaa no no nwoma, nye ne nam nyinara, nye ne tsir, no ntwɛr, n’ayamudze, nye n’egyanan,
title: LEVITICUS

text: mekyerɛ ɔnantwisaa mu no nyinara na ɔnsoa nkɔ nseraban no ekyir beebi a hɔ tsew, mbrɛ wohue nso gu no, na ɔmfa ogya nhyew no nyena do. Beebi a wohue nso gu no ara na wɔnhyew no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ Israel mboanofo nyinara fom, a wɔammfa enyidaho annyɛ, na wɔyɛ ndzɛmba a EWURADZE ahyɛ ho mbra dɛ mma wɔnnyɛ no mu bi, na wodzi so;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ekyir yi wohu bɔn a wɔafom wɔ mu no a, ɔno bagua no mfa nantwisaa eburwa mbra mbɛyɛ bɔn ho afɔr, na wɔmfa no mbra ehyiadzibuw no enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mboanofo no mu mpanyimfo no mfa hɔn nsa ngu nantwisaa no n’etsifi na wonku nantwisaa no wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo a wɔasera no no mfa nantwisaa no no bɔgyaa no bi mbra ehyiadzibuw no mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatseaba mbɔ bɔgya no mu, na ɔmfa mpetse mpɛn esuon wɔ EWURADZE enyim wɔ ntwamutam no enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa bɔgya no bi nkeka afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ EWURADZE enyim no a ɔwɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no ne mbɛn ho, na onhue bɔgya no nyinara ngu ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano ho ase.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na onyi ne seradze no nyinara mfi ho, na ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no, dɛmara so na ɔnyɛ iyi na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma hɔn, na wɔdze bɛkyɛ hɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa nantwisaa no mfir edzi nkɔ nseraban no ekyir, na ɔnhyew no dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyeew asɔpɔn nantwisaa no. Iyi yɛ bagua no hɔn bɔn ho afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ otsitsir bi ammfa enyidaho na ɔyɛ bɔn, na ɔyɛ EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn ndzɛmba nyinara a wɔahyɛ dɛ mma wɔnnyɛ no mu kor bi ma odzi so;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na sɛ wɔma ohu no bɔn a ɔafom wɔ mu no a, ɔmfa n’ayɛyɛdze a ɔyɛ apɔnkye mbra, onyin a onndzii dzɛm;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmfa ne nsa nto apɔnkye no n’etsifi, na onku no wɔ beebi mbrɛ woku ɔhyew afɔr no wɔ EWURADZE enyim no. Iyi yɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatseaba mfa bɔn ho afɔr bɔgyaa no bi, na ɔmfa nkeka ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn ho, na onhue no bɔgyaa no ngu ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no ase.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔnhyew ne seradze no nyinara wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, dɛ asomdwee afɔr ayɛyɛdze seradze no: na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ no bɔn no ho, na wɔdze bɛkyɛ no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔman mba no bi ammfa enyidaho na ɔyɛ bɔn wɔ ndzɛmba nyinara a EWURADZE ahyɛ ho mbra dɛ mma wɔnnyɛ no mu biara a, odzi so.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ wɔma ohu no bɔn a ɔafom no a ɔno ɔmfa n’ayɛyɛdze, apɔnkyeber a onndzii dzɛm, mbra mbɛma, wɔ no bɔn a ɔayɛ no ntsi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto bɔn ho afɔr no n’etsifi, na onku bɔn ho afɔr no wɔ ɔhyew afɔr bea no do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatseaba mfa bɔgya no bi, na ɔmfa nkeka ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn ho, na onhue no bɔgyaa no nyinara ngu afɔrmbukyia no ase.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na onyi ne seradze no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ woyi asomdwee afɔr seradze no fi ho no; na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do ma onyi nka huanhuam mma EWURADZE; na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no, na wɔdze bɛkyɛ no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔdze eguambaa ba dɛ n’ayɛyɛdze wɔ bɔn ho afɔr ntsi a, ɔmfa ɔber a onndzii dzɛm mbra.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto bɔn no afɔr abowa no n’etsifi, na onku no bɔn ho afɔr wɔ beebi mbrɛ woku ɔhyew afɔr no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatseaba mfa bɔn ho afɔr bɔgyaa no bi, na ɔmfa nkeka ɔhyew afɔr afɔrmbukyia no ne mbɛn ho, na onhue no bɔgyaa no nyinara ngu afɔrmbukyia no ase:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na onyi ne seradze no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ woyi asomdwee afɔr eguambaa seradze no fi ho no; na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, wɔ EWURADZE ogya afɔr no do: na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ no bɔn a ɔayɛ no ho, na wɔdze bɛkyɛ no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ obi tse ntanka bi na ɔyɛ ho dasefo, sɛ ohunii o, ɔtsee o, na sɛ ɔannka a, ɔno ɔnsoa no mbusu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Anaa sɛ obi ka adze fi biara, dɛ abowa bi a no ho nntsew no fun o, fiebowa bi a no ho nntsew no fun o, anaa aweaweabowa bi a no ho nntsew no fun o, na sɛ oennhu mpo na no ho gu fi a, ɔno odzi so:
title: LEVITICUS

text: anaa sɛ ɔka nyimpa bi ne fi, wɔ adze fi biara a nyimpa dze gu no ho fi no mu, ber a onnyim mpo na sɛ ekyir yi ohu a, ɔno odzi so:
title: LEVITICUS

text: anaa sɛ obi ka ntanhun dɛ ɔbɛyɛ bɔn, anaa ɔbɛyɛ papa, wɔ asɛnhun biara mu, na n’adwen annkɔ do na sɛ ekyir yi n’enyi ba noho do a, ɔno odzi ndzɛmba iyinom mu biara ho so:
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔba dɛ, odzi ndzɛmba iyinom mu biara ho so a, ɔnka dza ɔayɛ mu bɔn no:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na no bɔn a ɔayɛ no ntsi ɔmfa n’asodzii ho afɔr mbrɛ EWURADZE, nguan mu ɔber, eguambaa anaa apɔnkye, mfa nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr; na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ no bɔn ho.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ne nsa annso eguambaa do a, ɔno ɔmfa ntamram ebien, anaa mborɔnomamba ebien, mbrɛ EWURADZE mbɛyɛ dza ɔayɛ mu bɔn ho n’asodzii ho afɔr; kor nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr, na kor so nyɛ ɔhyew afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no, ma ondzi kan mfa dza ɔyɛ bɔn ho afɔr no, na ɔntsew ne tsir wɔ no kɔn do, na mbom mma ɔmmpaa mu koraa:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmfa bɔn ho afɔr bɔgyaa no bi mpetse afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn; na bɔgya no ne nkaa no ɔnsɔn ngu afɔrmbukyia no ase: ɔyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa dza otsia ebien no nyɛ ɔhyew afɔr, dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse: na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ no bɔn a ɔayɛ no ho, na wɔdze bɛkyɛ no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ne nsa annso ntamram ebien, anaa mborɔnomamba ebien do a, ɔno ɔmfa isiam pa efa ebupɛn du mu kor nyɛ no bɔn a ɔayɛ no ho ayɛyɛdze mbra mbɛyɛ bɔn ho afɔr; mma ɔmmfa ngo nngu do, nkyii so mma ɔmmfa krɔbɔw bi nnto do: na ɔyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no, na ɔsɔfo no mfa mu ne nsapuw dɛ ne nkaadze, na ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, wɔ EWURADZE ogya afɔr no do; ɔyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ no bɔn a ɔayɛ no wɔ ndzɛmba iyinom mu biara mu no ho, na wɔdze bɛkyɛ no: na nkaa no nyɛ ɔsɔfo no dze, dɛ edziban afɔr no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ obiara to mbra, dɛ ɔannyɛ dza ɔfata, wɔ EWURADZE ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn no mu wɔ ber a ɔnndze enyidaho a; ɔno ɔmfa n’asodzii ho afɔr mbrɛ EWURADZE, nguan mu oguannyin a onndzii dzɛm, dɛ mbrɛ ebo a etwa wɔ dwetɛbona mu wɔ dwɛɛtɛɛ mu tse, dɛ krɔnkrɔnbea dwetɛbona nyɛ asodzi ho afɔr:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔnyɛ ahyɛnanmu mma dza ɔayɛ no bɔn wɔ krɔnkrɔndze mu no, na ɔmfa ebupɛn a otsia enum no nka ho, na ɔmfa mma ɔsɔfo no; na ɔsɔfo no mfa asodzi ho afɔr oguannyin no mpata mma no, na wɔdze bɛkyɛ no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ obiara yɛ bɔn, na ɔyɛ ndzɛmba a EWURADZE ahyɛ ho mbra dɛ mma wɔnnyɛ no mu biara a; kaansa oennhu mpo a, odzi so, na ɔbɔsoa no mbusu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa nguan mu oguannyin a onndzii dzɛm dɛ mbrɛ ebo a etwa tse, nyɛ asodzi ho afɔr mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no: na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ adze a ɔafom wɔ mu na oennhu no no ho, na wɔdze bɛkyɛ no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ɔyɛ asodzi ho afɔr: osiandɛ ampaara odzi EWURADZE enyim so.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ obiara yɛ bɔn, dɛ odzi EWURADZE afomfonsɛm, na odzi akɔhwi wɔ ne nyɛnko adzesiedze ho asɛm mu, anaa ahobadze, anaa afoadze, anaa odzi ne nyɛnko emim;
title: LEVITICUS

text: anaa oehu dza ɔyewee na odzi akɔhwi wɔ mu, na ɔka ntanhun a, ɔayɛ bɔn wɔ iyinom mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ ɔba dɛ ɔayɛ bɔn, na odzi so a, ɔmfa adze a ɔfaa no afoadze mu, anaa adze a onyaa no emim mu, anaa adzesiedze a wɔdze hyɛɛ ne nsa, anaa adze a ɔyewee a ohunii,
title: LEVITICUS

text: anaa adze biara a ɔaka ho ntanhun no no nsan mbra; na ɔmbɛhyɛ ananmu ara pɛ, na ɔmfa ebupɛn enum mu kor so nto do mfa mma nyia adze no yɛ nedze no, wɔ da a woehu no dɛ odzi so no ara mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa n’asodzii ho afɔr mbrɛ EWURADZE, nguan mu oguannyin a onndzii dzɛm, dɛ mbrɛ ebo a etwa tse, mfa mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no nyɛ asodzi ho afɔr:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ EWURADZE enyim, na wɔdze adze biara a ɔayɛ a odzi ho so no bɛkyɛ no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Hyɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dɛ, Iyi nye ɔhyew afɔr ho mbra: ɔhyew afɔr no nko mbukyia no do wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do anadwe araa nkodu anapa; na afɔrmbukyia no do ogya no nsuo mu ndzɛw.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ no ndwera atar, na ɔnhyɛ no ndwera ntwontwo nkata noho; na ɔnsesaw nso no a ogya a ɔhyeew ɔhyew afɔr no gyae wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do no, na ɔmfa ngu afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na onyi ne ntar no, na ɔnhyɛ ntar fofor, na ɔmfa nso no mfir edzi nkɔ nseraban no ekyir nkogu beebi mbrɛ ɔtsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na afɔrmbukyia no do ogya no nda ho ndzɛw wɔ do, mma onndum ara da; na ɔsɔfo no nhyew do nyena anapa daa: na onsiesie ɔhyew afɔr no yie wɔ do, na ɔnhyew asomdwee afɔr no seradze no wɔ do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ogya nkɔ do ndzɛw afɔrmbukyia no do daa; mma onndum ara da.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na iyi nye edziban afɔr ho mbra: Aaron ne mbabanyin no mfa mbra EWURADZE enyim, wɔ afɔrmbukyia no enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa mu ne nsapuw, edziban afɔr isiam pa no bi, nye no ngo no bi, nye edziban afɔr no do krɔbɔw no nyinara, na ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, nyi nka huanhuam, dɛ ne nkaadze, mma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ne nkaa no, Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no ndzi: wondzi no epitsi wɔ mbrɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn; ehyiadzibuw no ne pampamu mu na wondzi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mma wɔmmfa mbɔrkaw nnka ho nnto. Hɔn kyɛfa a medze ama wɔ me gya afɔr mu nye no; ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn, dɛ bɔn ho afɔr, na asodzi ho afɔr no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Aaron ne mba mu banyin biara ndzi bi, dɛ EWURADZE ogya afɔr ho daa ahyɛdze, nkodu hom ebusuasantsen do: obiara a ɔka no no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyi nye Aaron nye ne mbabanyin ayɛyɛdze a wɔmfa mbrɛ EWURADZE wɔ da a wɔasera no ngo no mu; isiam pa efa ebupɛn du mu kor nyɛ daa edziban afɔr, anapa dze, fa, na ewimbir dze, fa.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Wɔmfa ngo nka ho nyɛ no wɔ ɔtosɛn mu; sɛ ɔhon a, fa bra: yɛ no dɛ edziban afɔr a wɔato ebubu mu esinesin bra, ma onyi nka huanhuam mma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no a wɔasera no ngo no a ɔbɛhyɛ n’ananmu wɔ ne mbabanyin mu no mfa mbra: wɔnhyew no mu nyɛ EWURADZE daa mmom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no n’edziban afɔr biara wɔnhyew no mu: mma wonndzi bi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dɛ, Iyi nye bɔn ho afɔr abowa ho mbra: beebi mbrɛ woku ɔhyew abowa afɔr no hɔ ara na wonku bɔn ho afɔr no wɔ EWURADZE enyim: Ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ɔsɔfo a ɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr no ndzi: wondzi no wɔ mbrɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn wɔ ehyiadzibuw no ne pampamu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Biribiara a ɔka ne nam no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn: na sɛ no bɔgyaa petse atar biara do a, hor dza apetse do no wɔ mbrɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom dɛtsesɛn a wɔanoa no wɔ mu no wɔmbɔ no: na sɛ wɔnoa no boransɛn mu a, wontwuw mu, na wɔmfa nsu nhohor mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Banyin biara a ofi asɔfo ebusuakuw mu no ndzi bi: ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na bɔn ho afɔr biara a wɔdze no bɔgyaa bi ba ehyiadzibuw no mu bɛpata wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no, mma wonndzi: wɔmfa ogya nhyew no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na iyi nye asodzi ho afɔr ho mbra: ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Beebi mbrɛ woku ɔhyew afɔr abowa no, hɔ ara so na wonku asodzi ho afɔr abowa no; na ɔmfa no bɔgyaa mpetse afɔrmbukyia no ho nhyia.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na onyi ne seradze nyinara mbra, seradze dua no, nye seradze a ɔkata ayamudze no ho no,
title: LEVITICUS

text: nye nsɛbɛ ebien no, nye seradze a ɔwɔ ho wɔ sisiw mu no, nye berɛbo do ntentan no, nye nsɛbɛ no, onyi mfi hɔ:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no nhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia do nyɛ ogya afɔr mma EWURADZE: ɔyɛ asodzi ho afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Asɔfo ebusuakuw no mu ɔbanyin biara ndzi bi: wondzi no wɔ mbrɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn: ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ bɔn ho afɔr tse no, dɛmara na asodzi ho afɔr tse: mbra kor na ɔda ho: ɔsɔfo no a ɔdze pata no, na ɔnyɛ nedze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo a ɔbɔ nyimpa biara ne hyew afɔr no, ɔhyew afɔr a ɔabɔ no no nwoma no nyɛ ɔsɔfo no dze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na edziban afɔr biara a wɔto wɔ fononoo mu, nye dza wɔyɛ no wɔ kyesɛn mu, nye ɔtosɛn mu nyina, nyɛ ɔsɔfo a ɔdze ba no dze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na edziban afɔr biara a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, anaa wesee no, nyɛ Aaron ne mbabanyin nyinara dze, baako nya dɛ mbrɛ baako so nya.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na iyi nye asomdwee afɔr a obi bɔ ma EWURADZE no ho mbra.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ ɔyɛ no aseda afɔr dze ba a, ɔno, aseda afɔr a ɔdze ba no nyɛ epitsi tatar a wɔdze ngo afrɔw.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbɔrkaw boodoo tatar na ɔmfa nka n’ayɛyɛdze nye n’asomdwee afɔr ho mbra mbɛyɛ aseda.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa ayɛyɛdze biara mu kor mbrɛ mbɛyɛ ɔmado afɔr mma EWURADZE; ɔsɔfo a ɔdze asomdwee afɔr bɔgyaa petse no na ɔnyɛ nedze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na n’aseda asomdwee afɔr no nam no wondzi no wɔ n’ayɛyɛdze da no ara; mma onngya mu bi ma onnkodu adzekyee.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ n’ayɛyɛdze yɛ anohoba, anaa ayamuyi afɔr a, wondzi no da no ara a ɔbɔ n’afɔr no: na no mu dza ɔka ma adze kye do no wondzi:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na mbom afɔr no ne nam a ɔbɛka ekodu da a otsia ebiasa no, wɔmfa gya nhyew no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ wodzi n’asomdwee afɔr no ne nam biara da a otsia ebiasa no a, wɔremmpen do, nkyii so worummbu mma nyia ɔdze ba no: ɔyɛ ekyiwadze, na ɔkra a obedzi bi no bɔsoa no mbusu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nam a aka biribiara a no ho nntsew no, mma wonndzi; wɔmfa ogya nhyew no. Na nam no dze, obiara a no ho tsew ndzi bi:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔkra a odzi asomdwee afɔr a ɔyɛ EWURADZE dze no ne nam bi, na n’efifidze wɔ no ho no, ɔkra no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa biara ka biribiara a no ho nntsew nyimpa n’efifidze, anaa abowa a no ho nntsew, anaa ekyiwadze biara a no ho nntsew, na odzi asomdwee afɔr a ɔyɛ EWURADZE dze no ne nam bi no, ɔkra no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Ɔnantwi, anaa ɔkɔsɔw, anaa apɔnkye seradze no, mma hom nndzi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na dza noara ewu ne seradze, nye dza abowa atsetsew no ne seradze no, wɔmfa nyɛ edwuma biara: mbom dzi na mma hom nndzi bi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na obiara a odzi abowa a adasa dze bi bɔ ogya afɔr ma EWURADZE no ne seradze bi no, mekyerɛ ɔkra a odzi no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mma hom nndzi bɔgya biara, anoma anaa aketsebowa dze, wɔ hom tsenabew biara,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Obiara a odzi bɔgya biara no, no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Nyia ɔbɔ n’asomdwee afɔr ma EWURADZE no ɔmfa n’asomdwee afɔr no mu ayɛyɛdze mbrɛ EWURADZE:
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔmfa noara ne nsa mfa EWURADZE gya afɔr no mbra: seradze no nye nyan no na ɔmfa mbra, ama nyan no wɔaatow no ayɛ ɔtow afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no nhyew seradze no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: na nyan no nyɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin dze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na aserɛ nyimfa no hom mfa nyɛ hom asomdwee afɔr mu ɔmado afɔr mma ɔsɔfo no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Aaron ne mbabanyin mu nyia ɔdze asomdwee afɔr no bɔgyaa, nye seradze ba no, nye aserɛ nyimfa no nyɛ ne kyɛfa.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔtow nyan no nye ɔmado serɛ no mafa wɔ Israelmba hɔn asomdwee afɔr no mu, na medze mama ɔsɔfo Aaron nye ne mbabanyin dɛ daa ahyɛdze a ofi Israelmba hɔ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyi nye Aaron no ngosera kyɛfa, nye ne mbabanyin hɔn ngosera kyɛfa a ofi EWURADZE ogya afɔr mu, wɔ da a ɔdze hɔn bae dɛ wombedzi EWURADZE asɔfoe no a.
title: LEVITICUS

text: EWURADZE hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma hɔn wɔ da a ɔseraa hɔn ngo fii Israelmba mu no. Ɔyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hɔn ebusuasantsen mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyi nye mbra a ɔda hɔ ma ɔhyew afɔr, edziban afɔr, nye bɔn ho afɔr, nye asodzi ho afɔr, nye etuhoakyɛ afɔr, nye asomdwee afɔr a
title: LEVITICUS

text: EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses wɔ bepɔw Sinai do, wɔ da a ɔhyɛɛ Israelmba dɛ wɔmfa hɔn ayɛyɛdze mbrɛ EWURADZE, wɔ Sinai sar do no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Fa Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no ka no ho, na ntar no, nye ɔserango no, nye bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no, nye nguannyin ebien no, nye epitsi boodoo kɛntsɛn no,
title: LEVITICUS

text: na mboanofo no nyinara mbɔ ngua wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ no no; na mboanofo bɔɔ ngua wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses see mboanofo no dɛ, Iyi nye adze a EWURADZE ahyɛ dɛ wɔnyɛ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses dze Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no bae, na ɔdze nsu hohoor hɔn ho.
title: LEVITICUS
