text: Na ɔdze sortar no hyɛɛ no, na ɔdze abɔyamu no bɔɔ no do, na ɔdze bataker no hyɛɛ no, na ɔdze egugudo no guu no, na ɔdze egugudo ne nkyermu nkyekyermu no bɔɔ no do, na ɔdze kyekyeer no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔdze akatabo no hyɛɛ no: na ɔdze Urim nye Tummim (Kan na Emudzi) no hyɛɛ akatabo no mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔdze asɔfokyɛw no hyɛɛ ne tsir: na ɔdze sika abɔtsir, abɔenyim krɔnkrɔn no, bɔɔ asɔfokyɛw no ho, wɔ n’enyim afamu; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses faa ɔserango, na ɔdze seraa ntamadan no nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, na ɔyɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔdze bi petsee afɔrmbukyia no do mpɛn esuon, na ɔseraa afɔrmbukyia no nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye eguarsɛn no nye ne ntaease no ngo dze yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ohuee ɔserango no bi guu Aaron n’etsifi, na ɔseraa no ngo dze yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses dze Aaron mbabanyin no bae, na ɔdze sorntar hyehyɛɛ hɔn, na ɔdze abɔyamu bobɔɔ hɔn do, na ɔdze abɔtsir bobɔɔ hɔn; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔdze bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no bae: na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dze hɔn nsa guu bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no n’etsifi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses kum no; na ɔdze ne nsatseaba faa mbɔgya no bi, na ɔdze kekaa afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn ho hyiae, na ɔtseew afɔrmbukyia no ho, na ohuee bɔgya no guu afɔrmbukyia no ase, na ɔyɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn, dze yɛɛ mpatadze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔfaa seradze a ɔwɔ ayamudze no ho no nyinara, nye berɛbo do ntentan no, nye nsɛbɛ ebien no, nye no ho seradze no, na Moses hyeew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔnantwisaa no, nye no nwoma, nye ne nam, nye n’egyanan, ɔdze ogya hyeew no wɔ nseraban no ekyir; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔdze ɔhyew afɔr oguannyin no bae: na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin dze hɔn nsa guu oguannyin no etsifi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses kum no: na ɔdze bɔgya no petsee afɔrmbukyia no do hyiae.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na otwitwaa oguannyin no mu esinesin; na ɔhyeew tsir no, nye esinesin no, nye seradze no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔdze nsu hohoor ayamudze nye ntwɛr no ho; na afei ɔhyeew oguannyin mu no nyinara wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: ɔyɛ ɔhyew afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam: ɔyɛ EWURADZE ogya afɔr; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔdze oguannyin kor no so, etuhoakyɛ afɔr oguannyin no, bae: na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dze hɔn nsa guu oguannyin no etsifi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses kum no; na ɔfaa no bɔgyaa no bi, na ɔdze kaa Aaron n’aso nyimfa ano, na ne nsa nyimfa kokrobetsir, nye ne nan nyimfa kokonyin no ano.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔdze Aaron mbabanyin no bae, na Moses dze bɔgya no bi kekaa hɔn aso nyimfa ano, nye hɔn nsa nyimfa kokrobetsir, nye hɔn anan nyimfa kokonyin no ano: na Moses dze bɔgya no petsee afɔrmbukyia no do hyiae.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔfaa seradze no, nye seradze dua no, nye nsɛbɛ ebien no, nye no ho seradze no, nye aserɛ nyimfa no:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔfaa epitsi boodoo kɛntsɛn a osi EWURADZE enyim no mu epitsi tatar kor, nye ngo boodoo tatar kor, nye tatar trɛtraba kor, na ɔdze guu seradze no nye aserɛ nyimfa no do:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔdze ne nyinara hyɛɛ Aaron na ne mbabanyin no nsa, na ɔtowee yɛɛ ɔtow afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses gyee no wɔ hɔn nsamu, na ɔhyeew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do wɔ ɔhyew afɔr no do: dze yɛɛ etuhoakyɛ afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam: ɔyɛ ogya afɔr ma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses faa nyan no, na ɔtowee yɛɛ ɔtow afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim: ɔyɛ Moses ne kyɛfa wɔ etuhoakyɛ afɔr oguannyin no mu; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no ara.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses faa ɔserango no bi, nye afɔrmbukyia no do bɔgya no bi, na ɔdze petsee Aaron, nye ne ntar, nye ne mbabanyin, nye ne mbabanyin ntar do; dze yɛɛ Aaron nye ne ntar, nye ne mbabanyin, nye ne mbabanyin ntar no, krɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses see Aaron, nye ne mbabanyin no dɛ, Hom nnoa nam no wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano: na hom ndzi no wɔ hɔ ara ɔnye etuhoakyɛ afɔr kɛntsɛn no mu boodoo no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nam no nye boodoo no mu dza ɔbɛka no hom mfa gya nhyew no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mma hom mmfi ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano nda esuon, kyerɛ hom etuhoakyɛ afɔr nda no aso ana: na nda esuon na ɔdze rutu hom akyɛ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ wɔayɛ no ndɛ da yi no, dɛmara na EWURADZE ahyɛ dɛ wɔnyɛ mfa mpata mma hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom ntsena ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano adzekyee nye adzesaa nda esuon, na hom nhwɛ EWURADZE ahwɛdze no, amma hom eennwuwu: na dɛm na wɔdze ahyɛ me mbra.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no yɛɛ ndzɛmba a EWURADZE nam Moses nsa do hyɛe no nyinara.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia awɔtwe no, Moses frɛɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no, na Israel mpanyimfo no;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsee Aaron dɛ, Fa nantwiba onyin a wɔdze bɛyɛ bɔn ho afɔr, nye oguannyin a wɔdze bɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔr a wonndzii dzɛm, na fa bra EWURADZE enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na kasa kyerɛ Israelmba no dɛ, Hom mfa apɔnkyenyin mbɛyɛ bɔn ho afɔr; na nantwiba nye eguambaa a hɔn beenu nyina woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm, mbɛyɛ ɔhyew afɔr;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔnantwinyin nye oguannyin mbɛyɛ asomdwee afɔr, mfa mbɔ afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim; na edziban afɔr a wɔdze ngo afrɔw: na ndɛ na EWURADZE yi noho kyerɛ hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na wɔdze dza Moses hyɛe no baa ehyiadzibuw no enyim: na mboanofo no nyinara twee bɛnee begyinaa EWURADZE enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Iyi nye adze a EWURADZE hyɛɛ dɛ hom nyɛ: na EWURADZE enyimnyam nyi noho nkyerɛ hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses see Aaron dɛ, Twe bɛn afɔrmbukyia no ho, na bɔ wo bɔn ho afɔr, nye wo hyew afɔr, na pata ma woho, nye ɔman no: na fa ɔman no hɔn ayɛyɛdze bra, na pata ma hɔn; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛe no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Nna Aaron twee bɛɛn afɔrmbukyia no ho, na okum bɔn ho afɔr nantwiba no a ɔyɛ nankasa nedze no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Aaron ne mbabanyin no dze bɔgya no kɛmaa no; na ɔdze ne nsatseaba bɔɔ bɔgya no mu, na ɔdze kekaa afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn no, na ohuee bɔgya no guu afɔrmbukyia no ase:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na bɔn ho afɔr no mu seradze no, nye nsɛbɛ no, nye berɛbo do ntentan no, ɔhyeew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nam no nye nwoma no dze, ɔdze gya hyeew no wɔ nseraban no ekyir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na okum ɔhyew afɔr no; na Aaron ne mbabanyin no dze bɔgya no kɛmaa no, na ɔdze petsee afɔrmbukyia no do hyiae.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na wɔdze ɔhyew afɔr no esinesin, nye tsir no, kɛmaa no: na ɔhyeew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔhohoor ayamudze nye ntwɛr no ho, na ɔhyeew no wɔ ɔhyew afɔr no do wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔdze ɔman no hɔn ayɛyɛdze kɛmae, na ɔfaa bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkye a ɔyɛ ɔman no dze no, na okum no, na ɔyɛɛ no bɔn ho afɔr, dɛ asɔpɔn dze no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔdze edziban afɔr no kɛmae, na ɔyɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse no ara.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔdze edziban afɔr no kɛmae, na ɔfaa mu ne nsapuw, na ɔhyeew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, dze kaa anapa ɔhyew afɔr no ho.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na eso okum nantwinyin nye oguannyin no asomdwee afɔr a ɔyɛ ɔman no dze no: na Aaron mbabanyin no dze bɔgya no kɛmaa no, na ɔdze petsee afɔrmbukyia no do hyiae,
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔnantwinyin nye oguannyin no seradze no; seradze dua no, nye dza ɔkata ayamudze no ho, nye nsɛbɛ no, nye berɛbo do ntentan no:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na wɔdze seradze no guu nyan no do, na ɔhyeew seradze no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na nyan no nye aserɛ nyimfa no Aaron towee dze yɛɛ ɔtow afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim; dɛ mbrɛ Moses hyɛe no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Aaron memaa ne nsa do wɔ ɔman no do, na ohyiraa hɔn; na ɔbɔɔ bɔn ho afɔr nye ɔhyew afɔr, nye asomdwee afɔr wiee no, osianee.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron kɛhɛɛn ehyiadzibuw no mu, na wopuei, na wohyiraa ɔman no; na EWURADZE enyimnyam yii noho kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinara.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ogya fi EWURADZE enyim bae, na ɔbɛhyeew afɔrmbukyia no do hyew afɔr nye seradze no: na ɔman no nyinara hunii no, wɔbɔɔ ose, na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Aaron ne mbabanyin no, Nadab nye Abihu, fefaa hɔn nduhuamsɛn, na wɔdze ogya guu mu, na wɔdze eduhuam guguu do, na wɔdze ananagya a ɔnnhyɛɛ hɔn ho mbra, baa EWURADZE enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ogya fi EWURADZE enyim bae, na ɔbɛmeen hɔn, na wowuwui wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Nna Moses see Aaron dɛ, Iyi nye dza EWURADZE kae no, dɛ hɔn a wɔtwe bɛn me no mu na mebɛyɛ moho krɔnkrɔn, na ɔman no nyinara enyim na mebɛhyɛ moho enyimnyam. Na Aaron muaa n’ano.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses frɛɛ Misael nye Elzafan, Aaron n’egya no nua banyin Uziel ne mbabanyin no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ntwe mbɛn, hom nsoasoa hom nuanom mfi krɔnkrɔnbea no enyim nkɔ nseraban no ekyir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Nna wɔtwee bɛnee, na wɔsoasoaa hɔn wɔ hɔn sorntar mu kɔr nseraban no ekyir; dɛ mbrɛ Moses kae no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses kaa kyerɛɛ Aaron, nye ne mbabanyin Eleazar nye Itamar, dɛ, Mma hom mmbɔ hom tsinhwi mpɛsɛw, nkyii so mma hom nnsunsuan hom ntar mu; amma hom eennwuwu, amma EWURADZE n’ebufuw ammba mboanofo no nyinara do; mbom hom mma hom nuanom, Israel fi nyinara, ngyam ɔhyew a EWURADZE dze gya ahyew hɔn yi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mma hom mmfi ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano, amma hom eennwuwu: na EWURADZE ɔserango no wɔ hom do. Na wɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Moses kae no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Aaron dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mma nnom wenyin anaa nsa dzendzen, ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin nyinara, aber a hom rokɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no, amma hom eennwuwu: ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyinara mu:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na hom dze he aato adzekrɔnkrɔn nye adze a ɔnnyɛ krɔnkrɔn ntamu, nye adze a no ho nntsew nye dza no ho tsew ntamu;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na hom aakyerɛkyerɛ Israelmba ahyɛdze a EWURADZE nam Moses nsa do aka akyerɛ hɔn no nyinara.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Aaron, na Eleazar nye Itamar, ne mbabanyin a wɔkae no dɛ, Hom mfa edziban afɔr a ɔka a ofi EWURADZE ogya afɔr do no, na hom nkwetsi mbɔrkaw ndzi no wɔ afɔrmbukyia ho: osiandɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na hom ndzi no wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn do, osiandɛ ɔyɛ w’ahyɛdze, nye wo mbabanyin ahyɛdze, wɔ EWURADZE ogya afɔr do: na dɛm na wɔahyɛ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔtow nyan no nye ɔmado aserɛ no hom ndzi no wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔtsew; ɔwo, nye wo mbabanyin, nye wo mbabaa a wɔka wo ho: na wɔdze ama dɛ ɔyɛ w’ahyɛdze, na wo mbabanyin ahyɛdze a ofi Israelmba hɔn asomdwee afɔr mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ɔmado aserɛ no nye ɔtow nyan no wɔmfa nka ogya afɔr seradze no ho mbra, mbɔtow no ɔtow afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim; na ɔnyɛ wodze, nye wo mbabanyin a wɔka wo ho no dze, dɛ daa ahyɛdze; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE ahyɛ no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses hwehwɛɛ bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkye no enyiberdo, na hwɛ, wɔahyew no: na no bo fuuw Eleazar na ɔnye Itamar, Aaron ne mbabanyin a wɔkae no, dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ebɛn ntsi na hom enndzi bɔn ho afɔr no wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔyɛ bea krɔnkrɔn no, osiandɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn, na ɔdze ama hom dɛ, hom nsoa mboanofo no hɔn mbusu, nyɛ mpata mma hɔn wɔ EWURADZE enyim?
title: LEVITICUS

text: Hwɛ, wɔammfa no bɔgyaa no ammba krɔnkrɔnbea no no mu: ampaara ɔsee dɛ nkyɛ hom ndzi no wɔ krɔnkrɔn bea no do hɔ, dɛ mbrɛ mehyɛe no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Aaron kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, Hwɛ, ndɛ da yi na wɔdze hɔn bɔn ho afɔr nye hɔn ɔhyew afɔr aba EWURADZE enyim; na ndzɛmba a ɔtsetse dɛm yi aba mo do yi: na sɛ midzi bɔn ho afɔr ndɛ a, ana nkyɛ ɔbɛyɛ enyisɔ wɔ EWURADZE enyim?
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses tsee no, ɔyɛɛ no abodwe.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, see hɔn dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: hom nkasa nkyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Iyinom nye mbowa a hom ndzi wɔ asaase do mbowa nyinara mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Anansambowa mu biara a wɔapaa n’anansa mu, na ɔyɛ anansapaae koraa, na ɔkosa adzepuwii no, ɔno na hom ndzi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Naaso iyinom na mma hom nndzi wɔ hɔn a wɔkosa adzepuwii, anaa hɔn a hɔn anansa mu apaa mu: efupɔnkɔ, osiandɛ ɔkosa adzepuwii dze, naaso n’anansa mu mmpaae, ntsi no ho nntsew mma hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na etwabowa, osiandɛ ɔkosa adzepuwii dze, naaso n’anansa mu mmpaae, no ho nntsew mma hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na asoaso, osiandɛ ɔkosa adzepuwii dze, naaso n’anansa mu mmpaae, no ho nntsew mma hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na preko, osiandɛ n’anansa mu apaa, na ɔyɛ anansapaae koraa dze, naaso ɔnnkosa adzepuwii ntsi no ho nntsew mma hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mma hom nndzi hɔn nam bi, na hɔn efun so mma hom nnka; hɔn ho nntsew mma hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyinom nye dza hom ndzi wɔ dza ɔwɔ nsu mu nyinara mu: biara a ɔwɔ tɛterɛ nye abon wɔ nsu mu, pomu, nye esutsen mu no, iyinom na hom ndzi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na dza wonnyi tɛterɛ nye abon a wɔwɔ pomu, nye esutsen mu nyinara, nye dza wɔwɔ nsu mu nyinara a nkwa wɔ hɔn mu no yɛ ekyiwadze ma hom,
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔnyɛ hom ekyiwadze; mma hom nndzi hɔn nam, na hɔn efun mpo, hom nkyir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Adze biara a onnyi tɛterɛ anaa abon wɔ nsu mu no, ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na iyinom na hom nkyir no wɔ ntumbowa mu; mma wonndzi, wɔyɛ ekyiwadze: ɔkɔr, nye ɔkɔrbia, nye nsukɔr;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsansaa, nye ɔkom n’ahorow;
title: LEVITICUS

text: akonkoran biara n’ahorow;
title: LEVITICUS

text: nye sohor, nye anadwe akrɔma, nye po akokɔ, nye akrɔma n’ahorow;
title: LEVITICUS

text: nye patubia, nye po akonkoran, nye patu kɛse;
title: LEVITICUS

text: nye ambɛnpatu, nye nantwinoma, nye ɔpɛtɛ:
title: LEVITICUS

text: nye esukɔnkɔn, bakanoma n’ahorow, nye esuakokɔ, nye apan.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ntumbowa ahorow a wɔnantsew anan anan anan do nyinara yɛ ekyiwadze ma hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Naaso iyinom na hom ndzi no wɔ ntumbowa menyamenya a wɔnantsew anan anan anan do nyinara mu, hɔn a wɔwɔ aperɛ wɔ hɔn anan do a wɔdze huruw wɔ asaase do no,
title: LEVITICUS

text: mekyerɛ hɔn mu iyinom na hom ndzi; mbɛbɛw n’ahorow, akyekyemawe n’ahorow, kukura n’ahorow, ɔhwedɔm n’ahorow.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ntumbowa menyamenya nyinara a wɔwɔ anan anan anan no, yɛ ekyiwadze ma hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na iyinom na hom dze gu homho fi: obiara a ɔka hɔn fun no, no ho nntsew ara kodu ewimbir:
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na obiara a ɔsoa hɔn fun no ɔnhor ne ntar, osiandɛ no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Anansabowa biara a wɔapaa n’anansa mu, na ɔnnyɛ anansapaae koraa, na ɔnnkosa adzepuwii no, no ho nntsew mma hom; obiara a ɔka hɔn no, no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na abowa biara a ɔnantsew no werɛw ano no wɔ mbowa a wɔnantsew anan anan do nyinara mu no, hɔn ho nntsew mma hom: obiara a ɔka hɔn fun no, no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nyia ɔsoa hɔn fun no ɔnhor ne ntar, na no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir: hɔn ho nntsew mma hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na iyinom nye hɔn a hɔn ho nntsew mma hom wɔ aweaweambowa a wɔwea wɔ asaase do no mu; obirebi, nye okura, nye ɔketsew n’ahorow,
title: LEVITICUS

text: nye ban yer abamba, nye ɔmampam, nye ɔsamanapa, nye anhweaketsew, nye abosomanketsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyinom nye hɔn a hɔn ho nntsew mma hom wɔ dza wɔwea nyinara mu: sɛ wowu a, obiara a ɔka hɔn no, no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na adze biara a hɔn mu dza oewu atɔ do no, no ho nntsew; dua adze o, atar o, nwoma o, bɔtɔ o, adze biara a wɔdze yɛ edwuma biara, wɔmfa nhyɛ nsu mu, na no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir; ansaana no ho atsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na dɛtsesɛn biara a hɔn mu bi bɔtɔ mu no, adze biara a ɔwɔ mu no no ho nntsew, na sɛn no hom mbɔ no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: No mu edziban a wodzi biara a nsu bogu mu no, no ho nntsew: na anondze nyinara a wɔnom wɔ dɛm adze biara mu no, no ho nntsew:
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na adze biara a hɔn fun no bi bɔtɔ do no no ho nntsew; fononoo o, mbukyia o, wombubu no esinesin: hɔn ho nntsew, na hɔn ho nntsew mma hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Naaso nsubura anaa amona a nsu egyina mu no dze, no ho tsew: mbom dza ɔka hɔn fun no, no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ hɔn fun bi tɔ ekuadze a woedua biara do a, no ho tsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ wɔdze nsu gu ekuadze no do a, na hɔn fun bi tɔ do a, ekuadze no ho nntsew mma hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ abowa biara a hom dzi wu a, nyia ɔka no fun no, no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nyia odzi no fun bi no, ɔnhor ne ntar, na no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir: onyia so a ɔsoa no fun no, nhor ne ntar, na no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na aweaweabowa biara a ɔwea wɔ asaase do no, yɛ ekyiwadze; mma wonndzi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Adze biara a ɔnam ɔyafun do, nye adze biara a ɔnam anan anan do, anaa adze biara a ɔwɔ anan pii, mekyerɛ aweaweambowa a wɔwea wɔ asaase do nyinara, mma hom nndzi; na wɔyɛ ekyiwadze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mma hom nnyɛ homho ekyiwadze wɔ aweaweabowa biara a ɔwea ho, nkyii so mma hom nnyɛ homho fi a ɔmma hom ho nntsew wɔ hɔn ho.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn: dɛm ntsi hom ntsew homho, na hom nyɛ krɔnkrɔn; osiandɛ meyɛ krɔnkrɔn. Nkyii so mma hom nngu homho fi wɔ aweaweabowa biara a otwuw noho adze wɔ asaase do no ho.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na emi nye EWURADZE a miyii hom fii Egypt asaase do bae, dɛ meyɛ hom Nyankopɔn no; dɛm ntsi hom nyɛ krɔnkrɔn, na meyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyi nye anansabowa, nye etubowa, nye abowa biara a ɔwɔ nsu mu na abowa biara a ɔwea wɔ asaase do no ho mbra:
title: LEVITICUS

text: ma wɔdze apa adze a no ho nntsew nye dza no ho tsew mu, na adze a nkwa wɔ mu a wodzi nye dza nkwa wɔ mu a wonndzi mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Sɛ ɔbaa bi nyinsen na ɔwo banyimba a, ɔno no ho nntsew araa nda esuon; dɛ mbrɛ no ho nntsew wɔ n’asabu nda no mu no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na da a otsia awɔtwe no wontwa ne banyinwer no twatsia.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔnko ntandan mu adaduasa nda ebiasa wɔ n’ahoguar bɔgya mu; mma ɔnnka adzekrɔnkrɔn biara, nkyii so ɔmmba krɔnkrɔn bea, kyerɛ n’ahoguar nda ewie du ana.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ ɔwo basiaba a, ɔno no ho nntsew araa adapɛn ebien, dɛ n’asabu mu: na ɔnko ntandan mu adaduosia nda esia wɔ n’ahoguar bɔgya mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ n’ahoguar nda no wie du, ma ɔbanyin, anaa ɔbabaa a, ɔmfa eguambaa a oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze bɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr, nye aborɔnoma ba, anaa atamram a wɔdze bɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr, mbra ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano mbɛma ɔsɔfo no:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmfa mbɔ afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim, na ɔmpata mma no; na no ho ntsew wɔ no bɔgyaagu no ho. Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma nyia ɔwo ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ne nsa annso eguambaa do a, ɔno ɔmfa ntamram ebien; kor nyɛ ɔhyew afɔr, na kor so nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr: na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no, na no ho ntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ nyimpa bi nya no honam wer mu biribi soaa, anaa ntwintwamee, anaa ntokowa ntokowa, anaa odzidzi no honam wer mu yɛ kwata ntsetsewee a, ɔno wɔmfa no mbra ɔsɔfo Aaron, anaa ne mbabanyin asɔfo no mu kor:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ honam wer no mu: na sɛ nhwi a ɔwɔ ntsetsewee no mu adan fitaa na ntsetsewee no enyi atotɔ mu asen no honam wer no a, ɔyɛ kwata ntsetsewee; na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no, na ɔnka dɛ no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ntokowa ntokowa no yɛ fitaa wɔ no honam wer no mu, na n’enyi nntotɔɔ mu nnsen wer no, na no nhwi no nndaan fitaa a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no ntow ɔyarfo no mu nda esuon:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na da a otsia esuon no ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no: na ɔhwɛ na sɛ ntsetsewee no esianka wɔ n’enyi do, na ntsetsewee no nntserɛwee wɔ wer no mu a, ɔno asɔfo no ntow no mu nda esuon bio:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na da a otsia esuon no ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no bio: na, hwɛ, sɛ ntsetsewee no enyi edum, na ntsetsewee no nntserɛwee wɔ wer no mu a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ no ho tsew: ɔyɛ ntwintwamee: na ɔnhor ne ntar, na no ho ntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom ɔdze noho akɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no wɔ n’ahotsewee ho ekyir no, na sɛ ntwintwamee no tserɛw wɔ wer no mu a, ɔmfa no ho nkɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no bio:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ na sɛ ntwintwamee no atserɛw wɔ wer no mu a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ no ho nntsew: ɔyɛ kwata.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ kwata ntsetsewee wɔ nyimpa bi ho a, ɔno wɔmfa no mbra ɔsɔfo no;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ, na, hwɛ, sɛ biribi fitaa soaa bi wɔ wer no mu, na ɔadan nhwi no fitaa, na honam momon rupuw wɔ soaa no mu a,
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔyɛ kwata dadaw a ɔwɔ no honam wer no mu, na ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ no ho nntsew: mma ɔnntow no mu: na no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ kwata no epue efi wer no mu, na kwata no akata owuyarfo no no wer nyinara ho fi n’etsifi keka n’ananadze dɛ mbrɛ ɔda edzi ma ɔsɔfo no ara a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ: na, hwɛ, sɛ kwata no akata no honam nyinara do a, ɔnka dɛ owuyarfo no no ho tsew: ne nyinara adan fitaa: no ho tsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom aber biara a honam momon ada edzi wɔ no ho no, no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ honam momon no, na ɔnka dɛ no ho nntsew: honam momon no ho nntsew: ɔyɛ kwata.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Anaa sɛ honam momon no dan fitaa bio a, ɔno ɔmbra ɔsɔfo no hɔ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no: na, hwɛ, sɛ ntsetsewee no dan fitaa a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ ɔyarfo no no ho tsew: na no ho atsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ pɔmpɔ bi bɔ wɔ honam no wer no mu, na ɔsa,
title: LEVITICUS

text: na soaa fitaa bi bɔsoa anaa ntokowa ntokowa fitaa, ɔberhoamu, ba pɔmpɔ no ananmu a, ɔno wɔmfa nkɛkyerɛ asɔfo no;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ, na, hwɛ, sɛ n’enyi atotɔ mu asen wer no; na no nhwi no adan fitaa a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ no ho nntsew: ɔyɛ kwata ntsetsewee, oepue wɔ pɔmpɔ no mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na sɛ, nhwi fitaa bi nnyi mu, na ɔnntotɔ mu nnsen wer no, na n’enyi dum a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no ntow no mu nda esuon:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na sɛ ɔtserɛw wɔ wer no mu a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ no ho nntsew: ɔyɛ ntsetsewee.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ ntokowa ntokowa no sianka n’ananmu, na ɔanntserɛw a, ɔyɛ pɔmpɔ no itua; na ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ no ho tsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Anaa sɛ gya hyew ano tua bi ba honam no wer no mu, na ɔhyew ano tua no do rupuw yɛ ntokowa ntokowa, ɔberhoamu, anaa fitaa a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ: na, hwɛ, sɛ nhwi a ɔwɔ ntokowa ntokowa no do adan fitaa, na n’enyi atotɔ mu asen wer no a; ɔyɛ kwata, oepue wɔ ɔhyew ano tua no mu: na ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ no ho nntsew: ɔyɛ kwata ntsetsewee.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na sɛ nhwi fitaa bi nnyi ntokowa ntokowa no mu, na ɔnntotɔɔ mu nnseen wer no, na n’enyi dum a: ɔno ɔsɔfo no ntow no mu nda esuon:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na da a otsia esuon no ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no: sɛ ɔtserɛw wɔ wer no mu a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ no ho nntsew: ɔyɛ kwata ntsetsewee.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ntokowa ntokowa no sianka wɔ n’ananmu, na ɔanntserɛw wɔ wer no mu, na n’enyi dum a; ɔyɛ ɔhyew ano tua soaa, na ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ no ho tsew: na ɔyɛ ɔhyew ano tua no itua.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa bi nya ntsetsewee wɔ n’etsifi anaa n’abɔdwesa mu a,
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ ntsetsewee no: na, hwɛ, sɛ n’enyi atotɔ mu asen wer no, na nhwi memen tseatseaba bi wɔ mu a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ no ho nntsew: ɔyɛ ntutui, ɔyɛ tsir anaa abɔdwesa mu kwata.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ ntutui ne ntsetsewee no, na, hwɛ, n’enyi nntotɔ mu nnsen wer no, na nhwi tuntum bi nnyi mu a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no ntow ntutui ɔyarfo no mu nda esuon:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na da a otsia esuon no ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ ntsetsewee no; na, hwɛ, sɛ ntutui no nntserɛwee, na nhwi memen bi nnyi mu, na ntutui no n’enyim nntotɔ mu nnsen wer no a,
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno wɔntwerɛw nhwi no, mbom ntutui no na mma wɔnntwerɛw; na ɔsɔfo no ntow nyia ɔyar ntutui no mu nda esuon bio:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na da a otsia esuon no mu ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ ntutui no: na, hwɛ, sɛ ntutui no nntserɛw wer no do, na n’enyi nntotɔ mu nnsen wer no a; ɔno ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ no ho tsew: na ɔnhor ne ntar, na no ho ntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom n’ahotsewee ekyir no sɛ ntutui no tserɛw wɔ wer no mu a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no; na, hwɛ, sɛ ntutui no atserɛw wɔ wer no mu a, mma ɔsɔfo no nnhwehwɛ nhwi memen no; no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ ntutui no yɛ n’enyiwa do dɛ oesianka, na nhwi tuntum efuw wɔ mu a; ntutui no asa, no ho atsew: na ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ no ho atsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa nya ntokowa ntokowa fitaa wɔ no honam wer mu a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ: na, hwɛ, sɛ ntokowa ntokowa a n’enyi dum fitaa na ɔwɔ hɔn honam wer mu a; ɔyɛ ayam na oepue wɔ wer no mu; no ho tsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔbanyin bi no nhwi pepa wɔ n’etsifi a, ɔyɛ otsipaa; naaso no ho tsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ no nhwi pepa wɔ n’etsifi enyim afamu a, ɔyɛ pampamu tsipaa; na no ho tsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ ntsetsewee ɔberhoamu bi tow ne tsipaa no mu, anaa ne pampamu paa no mu a; ɔyɛ kwata a orupue ne tsipaa, anaa ne pampamu paa no mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Nkyii ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ no: na sɛ ntsetsewee no soaa no yɛ ɔberhoamu wɔ ne tsipaa no mu, anaa ne pampamu paa no mu, dɛ mbrɛ kwata firii tse wɔ honam wer no mu a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔyɛ ɔkwatanyi, no ho nntsew: ka ara na ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ no ho nntsew; ne ntsetsewee wɔ n’etsifi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔkwatanyi a ɔyar no wɔ no ho no, nsuansuan ne ntar mu, na ɔmbɔ ne tsinhwi mpɛsɛw, na ɔnkata n’anofamfa sor no, na ɔntsea mu dɛ, Ɔho nntsew o, ɔho nntsew o.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Nda dodow a yar no wɔ no ho no nyinara no ho renntsew; no ho nntsew: noara nkotoo ntsena; nseraban no ekyir na ɔnyɛ ne tsenabew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Atar so a kwata ntsetsewee wɔ mu no, sɛ ɔyɛ kuntu atar o, ndwera atar o;
title: LEVITICUS

text: sɛ ndwera, anaa kuntu, ne nsa anaa ne mfa mu o; sɛ nwoma, anaa adze biara a wɔdze nwoma ayɛ mu o;
title: LEVITICUS

text: sɛ ntsetsewee no yɛ ebunebun anaa ɔberber wɔ atar no mu, anaa nwoma no mu, anaa nsa no mu, anaa mfa no mu, anaa nwoma adze biara mu a; ɔyɛ kwata ntsetsewee, na wɔmfa nkɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ ntsetsewee no, na ɔntow ntsetsewee adze no mu nda esuon:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na da a otsia esuon no ɔnhwɛ ntsetsewee no: sɛ ntsetsewee no atserɛw wɔ atar no mu, anaa nsa no mu, anaa mfa no mu, anaa nwoma no mu, anaa biribiara a wɔdze nwoma ayɛ no mu a; ntsetsewee no yɛ kwata a ɔwewe; no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔnhyew atar no, sɛ nsa no o, mfa no o, wɔ kuntu mu, anaa ndwera mu, anaa nwoma adze biara a ntsetsewee no wɔ mu no: na ɔyɛ kwata a ɔwewe; wɔnhyew no wɔ gya mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na, hwɛ, ntsetsewee no nntserɛw wɔ atar no mu, wɔ nsa no mu, anaa mfa no mu, anaa nwoma adze biara mu a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ ma wɔnhor adze no a ntsetsewee no wɔ mu no, na ɔntow no mu nda esuon bio:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔahor ntsetsewee no ekyir no, ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ: na sɛ ntsetsewee no nnsakyeer n’enyi, na ntsetsewee no nntserɛwee a, no ho nntsew; dza atow mu no wɔ mu o, ekyir o hyew no wɔ ogya mu: osiandɛ ɔyɛ nwewee.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo no hwɛ, na, hwɛ, ntsetsewee no no hor ekyir no n’enyi edum a, ɔno ɔntsew mfi atar no ho, anaa nwoma no ho, anaa nsa no ho, anaa mfa no ho:
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔda ho pue wɔ atar no mu, anaa nsa no mu, anaa mfa no mu, anaa nwoma adze biara no mu a, na orupue: fa gya hyew dza ntsetsewee no wɔ mu no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na atar no, anaa nsa no, anaa mfa no, anaa nwoma adze biara a ebɔhor no, sɛ ntsetsewee no fi mu a, ɔno wɔnhor bio, na no ho atsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma kwata ntsetsewee wɔ kuntu anaa ndwera atar ho, wɔ nsa anaa mfa, anaa nwoma adze biara mu, ma wɔdze aaka dɛ no ho tsew, anaa wɔdze aaka dɛ no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma ɔkwatanyi wɔ n’ahotsewee da no mu: wɔmfa no mbra ɔsɔfo no:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfir edzi nkɔ nseraban no ekyir: na ɔsɔfo no nhwɛ, na, hwɛ, sɛ kwata ntsetsewee no asa wɔ ɔkwatanyi no mu a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ ma wɔmfa nnoma enyikan a hɔn ho tsew ebien, nye kyindur dua, nye serdaa, nye odwonhataw mma nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no mbra:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ mma wonku nnoma no mu kor wɔ dɛtsesɛn bi mu wɔ mbasu do:
title: LEVITICUS

text: anoma nyikan no dze, ɔmfa ɔno, nye kyindur dua no, nye serdaa no, nye odwonhataw no, na ɔmfa ne nyinara nye anoma nyikan no mbɔ anoma a wokum no wɔ mbasu do no no bɔgyaa mu:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmfa mpetse nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho efi kwata ho no do mpɛn esuon, na ɔnka dɛ no ho atsew, na ongyaa anoma nyikan no ma ɔnkɔ haban mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no, nhor ne ntar, na onyi no nhwi nyinara, na onguar nsu mu, na no ho aatsew: na n’ekyir no ɔmbra nseraban no mu dze, na ɔntsena no buw ekyir nda esuon.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ da a otsia esuon no, na onyi no nhwi nyinara wɔ n’etsifi nye n’abɔdwesa nye no ntɔn, mekyerɛ no nhwi nyinara na onyi: na ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar no honam wɔ nsu mu, na no ho aatsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na da a otsia awɔtwe no ɔmfa nguambaanyin ebien a wonndzii dzɛm, nye nguambaaber kor a oedzi afrenhyia a onndzii dzɛm, na edziban afɔr isiam pa efa ebupɛn du mu ebiasa a wɔdze ngo aforɔw, na ngo toa kor, mbra.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no a ɔtsew no ho no mfa ɔbanyin a wɔrebɛtsew no ho no, nye ndzɛmba no, mbegyina EWURADZE enyim, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfa nguambaanyin no mu kor, na ɔmfa no mbra dɛ asodzi ho afɔr, nye ngo toa no, na ɔntow no ɔtow afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na onku eguambaanyin no wɔ beebi mbrɛ woku bɔn ho afɔr nye ɔhyew afɔr abowa no, wɔ ahotseweebea no do hɔ: na dɛ mbrɛ bɔn ho afɔr no yɛ ɔsɔfo no dze no, dɛmara na asodzi ho afɔr no so: ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfa asodzi ho afɔr bɔgyaa no bi, na ɔsɔfo no mfa nkeka nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no n’aso nyimfa ano, nye ne nsa nyimfa kokrobetsir, nye ne nan nyimfa kokonyin ano:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfa ngo toa no, na onhue bi ngu nankasa ne nsa bankum mu:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatseaba nyimfa mbɔ ngo no a ɔwɔ ne nsa bankum mu no mu, na ɔmfa ne nsatseaba mpetse ngo no bi mpɛn esuon wɔ EWURADZE enyim:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ngo no nkaa no a ɔwɔ ne nsamu no ɔsɔfo no mfa bi nkeka nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no n’aso nyimfa ano, nye ne nsa nyimfa kokrobetsir, nye ne nan nyimfa kokonyin ano, wɔ asodzi ho afɔr bɔgyaa no do:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ngo nkaa no a ɔwɔ ɔsɔfo ne nsamu no ɔmfa ngu nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no etsifi: na ɔsɔfo mpata mma no wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mbɔ bɔn ho afɔr no, na ɔmpata mma nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho wɔ n’ahoɔfi ntsi; na n’ekyir no onku hyew afɔr abowa no:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mbɔ hyew afɔr no nye edziban afɔr no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do: na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no, na no ho ntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ odzi hia, na onnkotum enya no dodow dɛm a, ɔno ɔmfa eguambaanyin kor mbɛyɛ asodzi ho afɔr mma wɔntow mfa mpata mma no, na edziban afɔr isiam pa efa ebupɛn du mu kor a wɔdze ngo aforɔw, na ngo toa;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ntamram ebien, anaa mborɔnoma mba ebien, dɛ mbrɛ ne nsa bɔso do ara; na kor nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr, na kor so, nyɛ ɔhyew afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na da a otsia awɔtwe no ɔmfa mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano, wɔ EWURADZE enyim, wɔ n’ahoguar ntsi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa asodzi ho afɔr eguambaa no, nye ngo toa no, na ɔsɔfo no ntow no nyɛ ɔtow afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na onku asodzi ho afɔr eguambaa no, na ɔsɔfo no mfa asodzi no afɔr bɔgyaa no bi, na ɔmfa nkeka nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no n’aso nyimfa ano, nye ne nsa nyimfa kokrobetsir, nye ne nan nyimfa kokonyin ano:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no nhue ngo no bi ngu nankasa ne nsa bankum mu:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfa ne nsatseaba nyimfa mfa ngo no a ɔwɔ ne nsa bankum mu no bi mpetse mpɛn esuon wɔ EWURADZE enyim:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfa ngo no a ɔwɔ ne nsamu no bi nkeka nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no n’aso nyimfa ano, nye ne nsa nyimfa kokrobetsir, nye ne nan nyimfa kokonyin ano wɔ mbrɛ asodzi ho afɔr bɔgyaa no wɔ no:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ngo no ne nkaa no a ɔwɔ ɔsɔfo no nsamu no ɔmfa ngu nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no etsifi, mfa nyɛ mpata mma no wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa ntamram anaa mborɔnomamba no mu kor, dɛ mbrɛ ne nsa bɔso do no ara mbra;
title: LEVITICUS

text: mekyerɛ dɛ mbrɛ ne nsa bɔso do no ara, kor nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr, na kor so nyɛ ɔhyew afɔr nka edziban afɔr no ho: na ɔsɔfo no mpata nyia wɔrebɛtsew no ho no wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma nyia kwata ntsetsewee aka no a ne nsa nnso n’ahoguar adze do no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ hom du Keenan asaase a medze rema hom dɛ enyadze no do, na sɛ medze kwata ntsetsewee mobɔto hom enyadze asaase do fie bi mu a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno fie no wura no mbra, na ɔmbɛka nkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no dɛ, Ɔyɛ me dɛ biribi tse dɛ ntsetsewee bi esi fie no mu hɔ:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ ma wonyi fie no mu ndzɛmba nyinara, ansaana ɔsɔfo no akɔ mu akɔhwɛ ntsetsewee no, amma dza ɔwɔ fie no mu nyinara ho eenngu fi: na n’ekyir no ɔsɔfo no nkɔ mu nkɔhwɛ fie no:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔnhwɛ ntsetsewee no, na, hwɛ, sɛ ntsetsewee no wɔ fie no ne fadum ho ntokurntokur mu nkekaa ebunebun anaa mberberee, na n’enyi atotɔ mu asen ɔfadum no a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno ɔsɔfo no mfi fie no mu mpue fie no n’abowano, na ɔntow fie no mu nda esuon:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na da a otsia esuon no ɔsɔfo no mbra bio, na ɔmbɔhwɛ: na, hwɛ, sɛ ntsetsewee no atserɛw wɔ fie no ne fadum ho a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno ɔsɔfo no nhyɛ ma wonyiyi abo a ntsetsewee no wɔ ho no, na wɔnkɔtow ngu kurow no n’ekyir mbrɛ hɔ nntsew:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmma wɔntwerɛw fie no mu nhyia, na wɔmfa dɛtse a wɔatwerɛw no nkogu kurow no ekyir mbrɛ hɔ nntsew:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na wɔmfa abo fofor na wɔmfa nhyehyɛ abo no n’ananmu; na ɔmfa dɛtse fofor, na ɔmfa ntetar fie no ho.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na oetutu abo no ekyir, na ɔatwerɛw fie no mu ekyir, na ɔatetar ekyir no, na sɛ ntsetsewee no ba bio, na opue wɔ fie no mu a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno ɔsɔfo no mbra mbɔhwɛ, na hwɛ, sɛ ntsetsewee no atserɛw wɔ fie no mu a, ɔyɛ kwata nwewee wɔ fie no mu: no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ondwuruw fie no ngu famu, n’abo, nye no mpuna, nye fie no ne dɛtse nyinara; na ɔnsoa mfi kurow no mu mpue nkogu mbrɛ hɔ nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Afei so nyia ɔbɔkɔ fie no mu wɔ aber a wɔatow mu no nyinara mu no, no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nyia ɔda wɔ fie no mu no nhor ne ntar.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ wɔatetar fie no n’ekyir no, ɔsɔfo no ba, na ɔbɔhwɛ, na, hwɛ, ntsetsewee no nntserɛw wɔ fie no mu a; ɔno ɔsɔfo no nka dɛ fie no ho tsew, osiandɛ ntsetsewee no asa.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa nnoma ebien, nye kyindur dua, nye serdaa, nye odwonhataw ntsew fie no ho:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na onku nnoma no mu kor wɔ dɛtsesɛn mu wɔ mbasu do:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmfa kyindur dua no, nye odwonhataw no, nye serdaa no, nye anoma nyikan no, na ɔmfa anoma a woeku no no no bɔgyaa mu, nye mbasu no mu, na ɔmfa mpetse fie no do mpɛn esuon:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmfa anoma no no bɔgyaa, nye mbasu no, nye anoma nyikan no, nye kyindur dua no, nye odwonhataw no, nye serdaa no, ntsew fie no ho:
title: LEVITICUS

text: mbom ongyaa anoma nyikan no ma omfi kurow no mu nkɔ haban hantann no mu: ma ɔmpata mma fie no: na no ho ntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma kwata ntsetsewee ahorow nyinara, nye ntutui;
title: LEVITICUS

text: nye ntar nye fie ho kwata;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na soaa, nye ntwintwamee, nye ntokowa ntokowa:
title: LEVITICUS

text: ma wɔdze akyerɛkyerɛ aber a adze ho nntsew, nye aber a adze ho tsew: iyi nye kwata ho mbra.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Hom nkasa nkyerɛ Israelmba, na wɔnse hɔn dɛ, Sɔ ɔbanyin biara nya ahosen ma fie no honam mu gu a, n’ahosen no ntsi no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na iyi nye n’ahoɔfi wɔ n’ahosen no mu: sɛ n’ahosen no fi no honam, anaa n’ahosen ma no honam n’ano siw a, ɔyɛ n’ahoɔfi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mpa biara a nyia ɔwɔ ahosen no da do no, no ho nntsew: na adze biara a ɔko do no no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na obiara a ɔka ne mpa no, nhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, osiandɛ no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nyia ɔko adze biara a nyia ɔwɔ ahosen no atsena do no, nhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, osiandɛ no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nyia ɔka nyia ɔwɔ ahosen no no honam no, nhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, na no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ nyia ɔwɔ ahosen to ntafi gu nyia no ho tsew do a; ɔno ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, osiandɛ no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na apɔnkɔgua biara a nyia ɔwɔ ahosen no bɛtsena do no, no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na obiara a ɔka adze biara a ɔhyɛ n’ase no, no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir: na nyia ɔsoa dɛm ndzɛmba no nhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, na no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Obiara a nyia ɔwɔ ahosen annhohor ne nsa ho wɔ nsu mu na ɔdze bɛka no no, ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, osiandɛ no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na dɛtsesɛn a nyia ɔwɔ ahosen no bɛka no, wɔmbɔ no: na dua adze biara dze wɔnhor no wɔ nsu mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ nyia ɔwɔ ahosen no wɔtsew no ho fi n’ahosen no mu a, ɔno ɔnkan nda esuon wɔ n’ahofir ntsi, na ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar no honam wɔ mbasu mu, ama no ho aatsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na da a otsia awɔtwe no ɔno noara mfa ntamram ebien, nye mborɔnomamba ebien, na ɔmfa mbra EWURADZE enyim wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano, na ɔmfa mma ɔsɔfo;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfa mbɔ afɔr, kor nyɛ bɔn ho afɔr, na kor so nyɛ ɔhyew afɔr; na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ EWURADZE enyim wɔ n’ahosen no ntsi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔbanyin bi n’ahoba fi no mu fir a, ɔno onguar no honam nyinara wɔ nsu mu, osiandɛ no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na atar biara, nye nwoma biara a ahoba bogu mu no, wɔmfa nsu nhor, osiandɛ no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ɔbaa so a ɔbanyin dze ahoba nye no da no, hɔn beenu nyinara nguar hɔnho wɔ nsu mu, osiandɛ hɔn ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔbaa nya ahosen, na ahosen yɛ bɔgya fi no honam mu gu a, ɔntsena n’asabu mu nda esuon: na obiara a ɔka no no, no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na adze biara a ɔda do wɔ n’asabu mu no, no ho nntsew, na adze biara so a ɔtsena do no, no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na obiara a ɔka ne mpa no, nhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, osiandɛ no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na obiara a ɔka adze biara a ɔtsena do no, nhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, osiandɛ no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔwɔ mpa no do, anaa adze biara a ɔtsena do no do, na sɛ ɔka a, no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔbanyin bi nye no da, na n’asabu adze no bi ka no ho a, no ho nntsew araa nda esuon; na mpa biara a ɔda do no so ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔbaa nya bɔgya ahosen nda pii a ɔnnyɛ n’asabu aber mu, anaa onya ahosen ma ɔtra n’asabu aber a; n’ahoɔfi ahosen nda no nyinara ɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ n’asabu nda no mu tse: no ho nntsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mpa biara a ɔda do wɔ n’ahosen nda nyinara mu no; ɔnyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ n’asabu mpa tse; na adze biara a ɔtsena do no no ho nntsew, dɛ mbrɛ n’asabu mu ahoɔfi tse.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na obiara a ɔka ndzɛmba no no ho nntsew, na ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar noho wɔ nsu mu, osiandɛ no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ no ho tsew wɔ n’ahosen ho a, ɔno ɔnkan nda esuon, na n’ekyir no no ho aatsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na da a otsia awɔtwe no ɔmfa ntamram ebien, anaa mborɔnomamba ebien, mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa kor mbɔ bɔn ho afɔr, na kor so mbɔ ɔhyew afɔr; na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma no wɔ EWURADZE enyim wɔ n’ahoɔfi ahosen no ntsi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Dɛm na hom mfa nyi Israel mfi hɔn ahoɔfi mu; amma woeennwuwu wɔ hɔn ahoɔfi mu, aber a worukogu me ntamadan a ɔwɔ hɔn mu no ho fi no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma nyia ɔwɔ ahosen, nye nyia ɔwɔ ahoba a fie no mu gu, ma ɔdze gu noho fi;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na nyia ɔyar wɔ n’asabu mu, na ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa biara a ɔnye obi a no ho nntsew da no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Aaron ne mbabanyin beenu no hɔn wu a wɔtwee bɛɛn EWURADZE enyim, na wowuwui no ekyir no, EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Kasa kyerɛ wo nua Aaron dɛ, Mma ɔnnhɛn bea krɔnkrɔn no mu nnkɔ ntwamutam no mu, wɔ mbɔbɔrhu egua no a ɔwɔ adaka no do no enyim aber nyinara; amma woeennwuwu: na mununkum no mu na mibeyi moho akyerɛ wɔ mbɔbɔrhu egua no do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyi na Aaron mfa mbɛhɛn bea krɔnkrɔn no: ɔnantwisaa eburwa a wɔdze bɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr, nye oguannyin a wɔdze bɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ɔnhyɛ ndwera sortar krɔnkrɔn no, na ndwera ntwontwo no nkata no ho, na ndwera abɔyamu no mbɔ do, na ɔnhyɛ ndwera asɔfokyɛw no: ntar krɔnkrɔn no nye no; onguar no honam wɔ nsu mu, na ɔnhyɛ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔngye Israelmba mboanofo no hɔ mpɔnkyenyin ebien mfa mbɔ bɔn ho afɔr, na oguannyin kor mfa mbɔ ɔhyew afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Aaron mfa bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no a ɔyɛ nankasa nedze no, mbra, na ɔmfa mpata mma nankasa noho nye ne fie.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa mpɔnkye ebien no mbegyina EWURADZE enyim wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Aaron ntwe mpɔnkye ebien no ho tonto; tonto kor nyɛ EWURADZE dze, na tonto kor so nyɛ Azazel dze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Aaron mfa apɔnkye a EWURADZE tonto bɔɔ no no mbra, na ɔmfa mbɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Apɔnkye a Azazel tonto bɔɔ no no dze, ɔmfa no enyikan mbegyina EWURADZE enyim, mfa mpata mma no, dɛ wokegyaa no ma Azazel ma ɔkɔ sar no do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Aaron mfa bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no a ɔyɛ nankasa nedze no mbra, ma ɔmfa mpata mma nankasa noho, nye ne fi, na onku bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no a ɔyɛ nankasa nedze no:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmfa eduhuamsɛn gyabiriw mfi afɔrmbukyia no do wɔ EWURADZE enyim, na eduhuam a woesiw no mokomoko ne nsa ma, na ɔmfa mbra ntwamutam no mu:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmfa eduhuam no ngu gya no do wɔ EWURADZE enyim, ama eduhuam no no wusiw aakata mbɔbɔrhu egua no a ɔwɔ dase no do no ho, ma oeennwu:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmfa nantwisaa no ho bɔgyaa bi, na ɔmfa ne nsatseaba nka mpetse mbɔbɔrhu egua no do wɔ boka afamu; na ɔmfa ne nsatseaba nka bɔgya no bi mpetse mbɔbɔrhu egua no enyim mpɛn esuon.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Nkyii onku bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkye no a ɔyɛ ɔman no dze no, na ɔmfa no bɔgyaa no mbra ntwamutam no mu, na ɔmfa no bɔgyaa no nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze nantwisaa no no bɔgyaa yɛe no, na ɔmfa mpetse mbɔbɔrhu egua no do, na mbɔbɔrhu egua no enyim:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔmfa mpata mma bea krɔnkrɔn no, wɔ Israelmba hɔn efifidze, nye hɔn mbrato ntsi, mekyerɛ hɔn bɔn nyinara ho; na dɛm na ɔnyɛ mma ehyiadzibuw no a osi hɔn mu no ɔnam hɔn efifidze no ntsi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mma nyimpa biara nntsena ehyiadzibuw no mu aber a ɔrokɔ mu akɛpata wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no araa nkodu dɛ obefir edzi, na ɔapata ama nankasa noho, nye ne fifo, nye Israel bagua no nyinara.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na omfir edzi nkɔ afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ EWURADZE enyim no ho, na ɔmpata mma no; na ɔmfa nantwisaa no no bɔgyaa no bi, nye apɔnkye no no bɔgyaa no bi na ɔmfa nkeka afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn ho nhyia.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔmfa ne nsatseaba nka bɔgya no bi mpetse do mpɛn esuon, na ɔntsew ho, na ɔnyɛ no krɔnkrɔn mfi Israelmba hɔn efifidze no mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ owie mpata ma bea krɔnkrɔn no, nye ehyiadzibuw no, nye afɔrmbukyia no a, ɔmfa apɔnkye nyikan no mbra:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na Aaron mfa ne nsa ebien nyinara ngu apɔnkye nyikan no etsifi, na ɔnka Israelmba hɔn emumuyɛ nyinara, nye hɔn mbrato nyinara, mekyerɛ hɔn bɔn nyinara, ngu apɔnkye no etsifi, na ɔmfa no nhyɛ ɔbanyin a woeyi no esi hɔ no nsa ma onkegyaa no ma ɔnkɔ sar no do:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na apɔnkye no nsoa hɔn emumuyɛ nyinara mfa nkɔ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Aaron mbra ehyiadzibuw no mu, na onyi ndwera ntar no a ɔhyɛe kɔr bea krɔnkrɔn no, na ongyaa no wɔ hɔ:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na onguar wɔ nsu mu wɔ beebi a ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn, na ɔnhyɛ ne ntar, na omfir edzi, na ɔnkɔbɔ ne hyew afɔr nye ɔman no hɔn hyew afɔr no, na ɔmpata mma nankasa noho, nye ɔman no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na bɔn ho afɔr seradze no ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nyia okegyaa apɔnkye no ma Azazel no ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar no honam wɔ nsu mu, na n’ekyir no ɔmbra nseraban no mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na bɔn ho afɔr nantwisaa no, nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkye a wɔdze hɔn bɔgyaa baa bɛpataa wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no, wɔmfa nkɔ nseraban no ekyir; na wɔnhyew hɔn nwoma, nye hɔn nam, nye hɔn egyanan wɔ gya mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nyia ɔhyew no no nhor ne ntar, na onguar wɔ nsu mu, na n’ekyir no ɔmbra nseraban no mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔyɛ daa ahyɛdze ma hom: bosoom a otsia esuon no mu no, bosoom no ne da a otsia du no, hom mbrɛ homho adze, na mma wɔnnyɛ edwuma biara, okuromnyi o, ɔhɔho a ɔbɔsoɛ hom mu o,

title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mma nnyi wo na n’akyerɛbaa anaa w’egya n’akyerɛbaa n’adagyaw do: ɔno so oeyi no bɔgyaa a ɔbɛn n’adagyaw do: wɔnsoa hɔn mbusu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔbanyin bi nye no wɔfa ne yer da a, oeyi no wɔfa n’adagyaw do: wɔnsoa hɔn bɔn; wɔronnwo ba na woewu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔbanyin bi fa no nua ne yer a, ɔyɛ adze fi: oeyi no nua n’adagyaw do; worinnya ba.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ndzi m’ahyɛdze nyinara, nye me ntsɛmbu nyinara do, na wɔnyɛ: amma asaase no a medze hom rokɔ hɔ akɛtsena do no aammfe hom enngu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mma hom mmfa ɔman a murubotu hɔn wɔ hom enyim no hɔn amambra do: na wɔyɛɛ ndzɛmba iyinom nyinara, na dɛm ntsi hɔn ho yɛɛ me mfon.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mese hom dɛ, Hom na wonnya hɔn asaase no ndzi, na medze mema hom dɛ hom enyadze, asaase a numfonsu nye wo pem wɔ do: emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn a mapaa hom efi amanaman mu no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mpaa mbowa a hɔn ho tsew nye dza hɔn ho nntsew mu, nye nnoma a hɔn ho nntsew nye dza hɔn ho tsew mu: na mma hom mmfa abowa, anaa anoma, anaa adze biara a ɔwea famu a mapaa no wɔ hom ho dɛ no ho nntsew no nngu hom akra ho fi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom nyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma me: na emi EWURADZE meyɛ krɔnkrɔn, na mapaa hom efi amanaman mu dɛ hom mbɛyɛ medze.

text: Ɔbanyin bi so anaa ɔbaa bi a ɔyɛ adzebisafo, anaa ɔyɛ esumamfo no, oku na wonku no: wɔmfa abo nsiw hɔn: hɔn bɔgyaa ngu hɔn etsifi.

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Kasa kyerɛ Aaron ne mbabanyin asɔfo no, na se hɔn dɛ, Mma hɔn mu biara nngu noho fi wɔ fun ho wɔ ne man mu;

text: gyedɛ no bɔgyaa a ɔbɛn no, ne na, nye n’egya, nye ne babanyin, nye ne babaa, nye no nua;

text: nye n’akyerɛbaa a ɔyɛ ɔbaabun a ɔbɛn no a onnyae nnyaa okun no, ɔno ho na ɔmma noho nngu fi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mma onngu noho fi wɔ ne nyimpa tsitsir a ɔyɛ wɔ no nkorɔfo mu ntsi, dɛ obohura noho.

text: Mma wɔnnyɛ hɔn etsifi etsipaa, nkyii so mma wonnyi hɔn abɔdwesa ano, na wɔmmbobɔ hɔn honam mu akam so.

text: Wɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma hɔn Nyankopɔn, na mma wonnhura hɔn Nyankopɔn ne dzin ho: na EWURADZE gya afɔr no, hɔn Nyankopɔn edziban no, hɔn na wɔdze ba: dɛm ntsi wɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn.

text: Mma wɔmmfa ɔbaa a ɔyɛ ohuhunyi, anaa no ho egu fi nnwar no; nkyii so mma wɔmmfa ɔbaa a no kun ako no no nnwar no: na ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma ne Nyankopɔn.

text: Dɛm ntsi tsew no ho; na ɔno na ɔdze wo Nyankopɔn edziban ba: ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma wo: na emi EWURADZE a metsew hom ho no, meyɛ krɔnkrɔn.

text: Na nyia ɔyɛ no nuanom mu ɔsɔfopanyin a woehue ɔserango egu n’etsifi, na woetu no esi nkyɛn dɛ ɔnhyɛ ntar no, mma ɔmmbɔ ne tsinhwi mpɛsɛw, na onnsunsuan ne ntar mu;

title: LEVITICUS

text: Ɔbanyin biara a ofi Aaron n’asefo mu a ɔyɛ kwatanyi, anaa ɔwɔ ahosen no; mma onndzi ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn no bi nnkodu dɛ no ho bɛtsew. Na obi a ɔka adze biara a fun egu ho fi, anaa banyin a no ho nsu sen fi no mu;

text: anaa obiara a ɔka adze biara a ɔwea, dze bogu noho fi, anaa banyin bi a n’ahoɔfi biara a ɔwɔ no bɛma ɔafa no ho ahoɔfi no;

text: Na sɛ iwi kɔtɔ a, no ho bɛtsew; na n’ekyir no ondzi ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn no bi, osiandɛ ɔyɛ n’edziban.

text: Dza noara ewu, anaa mbowa atsetsew no no, mma onndzi mmfa nngu noho fi: emi nye EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Dɛm ntsi wondzi m’ahyɛdze do, amma woeenngu ho fi na wɔaannsoa bɔn wɔ ho, na woeennwuwu wɔ mu; emi nye EWURADZE a metsew hɔn ho no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mma ɔhɔho biara nndzi adzekrɔnkrɔn no bi: ɔsɔfo ne mamforanyi, anaa ɔpaanyi, nndzi adzekrɔnkrɔn no bi:

text: Mbom sɛ ɔsɔfo bi tɔ ɔkra bi a, ne sika enyadze no, ɔno na ondzi bi; na hɔn so a wɔwo hɔn wɔ ne fie no, hɔn na wondzi n’edziban no bi.

text: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo ne babaa bi wohyia no ma hɔho bi a, mma onndzi ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn ohim afɔr no bi.

text: Mbom sɛ ɔsɔfo no ne babaa bi yɛ kunafo, anaa wɔko no, na onnyi ba, na ɔsan kɔ n’egya fie, dɛ ne mbofraber mu a ondzi n’egya edziban no bi: ɔhɔho biara dze, mma onndzi bi.

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi dzi adzekrɔnkrɔn no bi ber a onnyim a, ɔno ɔmfa n’ebupɛn enum mu kor nto do, na ɔmfa adzekrɔnkrɔn no mma ɔsɔfo no.

text: Na mma wonngu Israelmba hɔn ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn a wɔdze brɛ EWURADZE no ho fi;

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,

text: nyɛ onyin a onndzii dzɛm; anantwi mu o, nkɔsɔw mu o, anaa mpɔnkye mu o ama aasɔ enyi ama hom.

text: Mbom adze biara a odzi dzɛm no, mma hom mmfa mmba: na ɔrennyɛ enyisɔdze mma hom.

text: Na obiara a ɔdze asomdwee afɔr bɛbrɛ EWURADZE dɛ ɔdze rehyɛ anohoba ma, anaa ɔdze reyɛ ayamuyi afɔr no, ofi anantwikuw anaa nguankuw mu no, ɔmma ondzi mu na aasɔ enyi; dzɛm biara nnyi no ho.

text: Dza n’enyi efura, anaa oebubu, anaa oepira, anaa ɔahohon, anaa ntwem anaa ase egu no ho no, mma hom mmfa iyinom mmbrɛ EWURADZE, na mma mmfa hɔn mu bi mmbɔ ogya afɔr so wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do mma EWURADZE.

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,

title: LEVITICUS
