text: Nda esuon na hom mbɔ ogya afɔr mma EWURADZE: da a otsia awɔtwe no nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn mma hom; na hom mbɔ ogya afɔr mma EWURADZE: ɔyɛ nguabɔ ewiei; mma hom nnyɛ edwumadzen biara.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyinom nye EWURADZE n’afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ a hom mpaa mu dɛ ɔyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn no, ma wɔmfa ogya afɔr mbrɛ EWURADZE, ɔhyew afɔr, nye edziban afɔr, okum afɔr, nye ɔnom afɔr, kor wɔ nankasa ne da mu:
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔsor EWURADZE n’ahomgyeda no, na ɔsor hom ayɛyɛdze, na ɔsor hom anohoba, na ɔsor hom ayamuyi afɔr nyinara a hom dze ma EWURADZE no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Naaso bosoom a otsia esuon no ne da a otsia duenum no mu, sɛ hom roboaboa asaase no do nduadzewa ano a, hom nhyɛ EWURADZE fa no nda esuon: da a odzi kan no nyɛ ahomgye pa, na da a otsia awɔtwe no nyɛ ahomgye pa.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na da a odzi kan no hom mfa ndua fɛɛfɛw do nduadzewa, nye menankɔnson, nye ndua wusuww n’abaw, nye esukɔn do ndua; na hom enyi ngye wɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn enyim nda esuon.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom nhyɛ no fa mma EWURADZE nda esuon wɔ afrenhyia mu: ɔyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hom ebusuasantsen mu: bosoom a otsia esuon no mu na hom nhyɛ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Hom ntsenatsena asese mu nda esuon; hɔn a wɔyɛ amamba wɔ Israel nyinara ntsenatsena asese mu:
title: LEVITICUS

text: ama hom ebusuasantsen eehu dɛ emi na memaa Israelmba tsenatsenaa asese mu wɔ aber a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do no: emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses kaa EWURADZE n’afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ no kyerɛɛ Israelmba.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Hyɛ Israelmba ma wɔmbrɛ wo olive ngo krɔnkrɔn a woesiw a wɔdze sɔ gya, ma wɔmfa nsɔ kandzea nsi do daa.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Dase ntwamutam no ekyir, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, na Aaron nsiesie mfi ewimbir nkodu anapa wɔ EWURADZE enyim daa: ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ ebusuasantsen mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Onsiesie nkandzea no wɔ sika mapa kandzeadua a no ho tsew no do wɔ EWURADZE enyim daa.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na fa isiam pa, na fa bi to tatar duebien; efa ebupɛn du mu ebien nyɛ tatar kor.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hyehyɛ no akyerɛpɛn ebien, esia nyɛ kyerɛpɛn kor, wɔ sika mapa pon a no ho tsew no do wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na fa krɔbɔw gyirengyirenn to kyerɛpɛn kor do, ma ɔnyɛ nkaadze wɔ boodoo no do, mekyerɛ ogya afɔr mma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ahomgyeda biara ɔnhyehyɛ no yie wɔ EWURADZE enyim daa: ɔyɛ Israelmba afamu daa ahyɛmu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔnyɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin dze; na wondzi no wɔ mbrɛ ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn: na ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn a ofi EWURADZE ogya afɔr do ma no wɔ daa ahyɛdze do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Israelnyi ɔbaa bi ne babanyin a n’egya yɛ Egyptnyi, fiir edzi wɔ Israelmba no mu: na Israelnyi ɔbaa no ne babanyin no ɔnye Israelnyi ɔbanyin bi dzii aperper wɔ nseraban no mu;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na Israelnyi ɔbaa no ne babanyin no kaa Dzin no ho ebususɛm, na ɔdomee: na wɔdze no brɛɛ Moses. Na ne na ne dzin dze Selomit, Dibri ne babaa a ofi Dan ebusuakuw mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na wɔdze no siei, ama woeenya EWURADZE n’anomu asɛm ma wɔaaka akyerɛ hɔn ana.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Fa nyia wɔadom no fir edzi kɔ nseraban no ekyir; na ma hɔn a wɔtsee no nyinara mfa hɔn nsa ngu n’etsifi, na ma mboanofo no nyinara nsiw no abo.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Obiara a ɔdom ne Nyankopɔn no ɔbɔsoa no bɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nyia ɔka EWURADZE ne dzin ho ebususɛm no, oku na wonku no; osiw na mboanofo no nyinara nsiw no abo: ɔhɔho o, okuromnyi o, sɛ ɔka EWURADZE ne dzin ho ebususɛm a, wonku no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nyia ɔbɔ nyimpa biara adze ma ɔtɔr no, oku na wonku no;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na nyia ɔbɔ abowa adze ma owu no ɔnhyɛ ananmu: nkwa nhyɛ nkwa ananmu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa ma ne nyɛnko dzi dzɛm a; dɛ mbrɛ ɔno ɔayɛ no, dɛmara na wɔmfa nyɛ no;
title: LEVITICUS

text: Obu nhyɛ obu ananmu, enyiwa nhyɛ enyiwa ananmu, ese nhyɛ ese ananmu: dɛ mbrɛ ɔama nyimpa bi edzi dzɛm no, dɛmara na wɔnyɛ mma no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nyia oku abowa no ɔnhyɛ ananmu: na nyia oku nyimpa no wonku no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbra kor ara nda hɔ mma hom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ma ɔhɔho no, ɔnyɛ dɛmara mma okuromnyi no: na emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba, na wɔdze nyia ɔdomee no fiir edzi kɔr nseraban no ekyir, na wosiiw no abo. Na Israelmba yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ kokwaa Sinai do dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom du asaase a medze rema hom no do a, ɔno asaase no ndzi ahomgye afe mma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mfe esia na dua wo haban mu adze, na mfe esia na pempan wo wenyin ture mu ndua ho, na boaboa no mu nduadzewa ano;
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom afe a otsia esuon no nyɛ ahomgye pa mu ahomgye afe mfa mma asaase no, nyɛ ahomgye afe mma EWURADZE: mma nndua wo haban mu adze, na mmpempan wo wenyin ture mu ndua ho so.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Wo ndɔbaa mu dza nankasa efifir no mma nntwa, na wo wenyindua a ennsiesie ho no mma nntsetsew no do esikyireamba: ɔnyɛ ahomgye pa afe mfa mma asaase no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na asaase no n’ahomgye afe no nyɛ edziban mma hom; ɔwo, nye w’akowaa nye w’afonabaa, nye wo paanyi nye wo hɔhoe a ɔabɔsoɛ wo;
title: LEVITICUS

text: nye wo fiembowa, nye mbowa a wɔwɔ w’asaase no do, na no do ndɔbaa no nyinara nyɛ hɔn edziban.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na kan ahomgye afe mfe esuon ma woho, mfe esuon esuon ahorow esuon; na ɔnyɛ ahomgye afe mfe esuon mu nda mma wo, mekyerɛ mfe eduanan akron.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nkyii bosoom a otsia esuon no ne da a otsia du no ma totorobɛnto ndze kɛse nkɔ aman do; mpata da no mu na hom mma totorobɛnto no nkɔ aman do ntwa mu wɔ hom asaase nyinara do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom ntsew afe a otsia eduonum no ho, na wɔmpaa fahodzi wɔ asaase no do mma no do atsefo nyinara: ɔnyɛ ahosɛpɛw afe mma hom; na hom nsan, nyimpa biara nkɔ n’ebusua mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ahosɛpɛw afe na afe a otsia eduonum no nyɛ mma hom: mma hom nndua, nkyii so wonntwitwa dza nankasa efifir wɔ mu no, na wɔnntsetsew no mu wenyinndua a woennsiesie ho no do esikyireamba so.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔyɛ ahosɛpɛw afe; ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma hom: hom mfi haban no do ndzi do ndzɛmba a ɔba no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ahosɛpɛw afe yi mu no hom nsan, nyimpa biara nkɔ n’egyapadze ho.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ etɔn biribi ma wo nyɛnko, anaa etɔ wɔ wo nyɛnko nsamu a, mma hom mu kor nndzi kor no emim:
title: LEVITICUS

text: dɛ mbrɛ ahosɛpɛw afe no ekyir mfe dodow tse no na tɔ wɔ wo nyɛnko hɔ, dɛ mbrɛ ndɔbaa mfe dodow tse no na ɔntɔn mma wo.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ mfe no dɔɔ so pa no na to no bo mu, na dɛ mbrɛ mfe no suar pa no na yi no bo do, wɔ ndɔbaa dodow a ɔtɔn ma wo no ho.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mma hom mu kor nndzi kor emim; mbom suro wo Nyankopɔn: na emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nyɛ m’ahyɛdze, na hom ndzi me mbrasɛm do, na wɔnyɛ; na hom ntsena asaase no do dwudwoodwo.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na asaase no bɛma no nsowee, na hom edzi amee, na wɔatsena do dwudwoodwo.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ hom se dɛ, Ebɛnadze na afe a otsia esuon no yebedzi? Hwɛ, yerunndua, na yɛrommboaboa hɛn ndɔbaa ano a:
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno mebɛhyɛ me nhyira wɔ hom do wɔ afe a otsia awɔtwe no mu, na wondzi nduadzewa no bi, akoradze dadaw no;
title: LEVITICUS

text: nkodu afe a otsia akron no, hom ndzi akoradze dadaw araa nkodu dɛ no nduadzewa bɛba.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na asaase no mma wɔnntɔn no korakora; osiandɛ asaase no yɛ medze: na hom yɛ ahɔho nye amamforafo wɔ me nkyɛn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom enyadze asaase no nyinara do na hom mma asaase no no mponee ho kwan.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ ohia wo nua, na ɔtɔn n’egyapadze mu bi a, ɔno no busuanyi a ɔbɛn no no mbra, na ɔmbɔpon dza no nua atɔn no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi nnyi obi a ɔpon, na ne nsamu ba adze na onya dza ɔso pon a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno wɔmma ombu no ntɔnee mu mfe dodow ano, na ɔnhyɛ dza ɔbor do no ananmu mma nyimpa no a ɔtɔnee maa no no; na ɔnsan nkɔ n’egyapadze ho.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ orunntum nngye bio mma noho a, ɔno dza wɔatɔn no nko nyia ɔatɔ no nsamu nkodu ahosɛpɛw afe no: na ahosɛpɛw afe no mu na omfi hɔ, na ɔnsan nkɔ n’enyadze ho.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi tɔn ofi a wɔtsena mu wɔ kurow a afadum wɔ ho mu a, ɔno ɔmpon no wɔ no ntɔnee ekyir afrenhyia no mu; na afrenhyia mu na ɔwɔ mponee ho kwan.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ wɔammpon no wɔ afrenhyia mu ntamu a, ɔno fie a ɔwɔ kurow a afadum wɔ ho mu no, ɔnko hɔ daa mma nyia ɔtɔe no korakora, wɔ n’ebusuasantsen mu: ommfi hɔ wɔ ahosɛpɛw afe no mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na efiefi a ɔwowɔ nkuroba a onnyi fadum a ehyia ho mu dze, wombu nka ɔman no mu haban ho: wɔropon a wɔmpon, na ahosɛpɛw afe no mu omfi hɔ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Naaso Levifo nkurow no, hɔn enyadze nkurow mu efi no dze, Levifo no mpon no aber biara.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ Levifo mu kor pon a, ɔno fie no a wɔtɔnee, nye n’enyadze kurow no mfi hɔ wɔ ahosɛpɛw afe no mu: na Levifo nkurow mu efiefi no nye hɔn enyadze wɔ Israelmba mu.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na nkurow no no kurotsia haban dze, mma wɔnntɔn, na ɔyɛ hɔn daa enyadze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ohia wo nua, na ɔpa abaw wɔ wo nkyɛn a; ɔno suo no mu; na ɔntsena wo nkyɛn dɛ ɔhɔho nye ɔmamforanyi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mma nngye nsiho anaa ndɔree wɔ no hɔ; mbom suro wo Nyankopɔn: ma wo nua nye wo ntsena.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mma mmfa wo sika anaa w’edziban mma no nsiho do, wɔ no ndɔree ntsi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn a, miyii hom fii Egypt asaase do, dɛ medze Keenan asaase rema hom, na maayɛ hom Nyankopɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ohia wo nua wɔ wo nkyɛn, na ɔtɔn noho ma wo a; mma mma ɔnnsom wo dɛ ɔdɔnkɔnyi:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔnyɛ wo nkyɛn dɛ mbrɛ ɔpaanyi nye ɔmamforanyi tse; ɔnsom wɔ wo nkyɛn araa ma onkodu ahosɛpɛw afe no mu:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na nkyii omfi wo nkyɛn nkɔ, ɔno nye ne mba a wɔwɔ wo nkyɛn, na ɔnsan nkɔ nankasa n’ebusua mu, na n’egyanom enyadze ho na ɔnsan nkɔ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na wɔyɛ mo nkowaa a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do: mma wɔnntɔn hɔn dɛ adɔnkɔfo.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mma mmfa egyapadze nnhyɛ no do; mbom suro wo Nyankopɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na wo nkowaa nye wo mfonabaa a ibenya no; amanaman a woehyia hom ho no, hɔn mu na hom ntotɔ nkowaa nye mfonabaa.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Nkyii so ahɔho a wɔabɔsoɛ hom mu hɔn mba no, hɔn hɔ na hom ntɔ, nye hɔn ebusuafo a wɔwɔ hom nkyɛn a wɔawo hɔn wɔ hom asaase do no hɔ: na wɔnyɛ hom egyapadze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom nyɛ hɔn egyapadze mma hom mba wɔ hom ekyir, ma woeesuo mu ayɛ egyapadze; na hɔn mu na hom mfa hom adɔnkɔfo daa: hom nuanom Israelmba dze mma hom nnhyɛ hɔn do, mma obiara mmfa egyapadze do nnhyɛ no nua do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔhɔho anaa ɔmamforanyi bi a ɔwɔ hom nkyɛn nya adze, na ohia wo nua a ɔnye no wɔ hɔ no, na ɔtɔn noho ma ɔhɔho no anaa ɔmamforanyi no a ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn no, anaa ɔhɔho no n’ebusua mu nyimpa bi a:
title: LEVITICUS

text: no ntɔnee ekyir no wɔmpon no; na no nuanom mu baako mpon no:
title: LEVITICUS

text: anaa no wɔfa, anaa no wɔfa ne babanyin mpon no, anaa n’ebusua mu bɔgya biara a ɔbɛn mpon no; anaa sɛ oenya adze a, ɔmpon noho.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na ɔnye nyia ɔtɔ no no mbubu mfitsi afe a ɔtɔɔn noho maa no no do nkodu ahosɛpɛw afe no do: na no ntɔnee bo no nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ mfe no no dodow tse.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ mfe no da ho dɔɔ so a, ne tsisika mu mponee bo no a ɔbɛdan ama no so ndɔɔ so dɛmara.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ aka mfe kumaabi ma edu ahosɛpɛw afe no do a, ɔno ɔnye no mbubu; dɛ mbrɛ ne mfe no tse no na ɔmfa no mponee sika no ndan mma.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ɔnye no ntsena dɛ akowaa a wɔbɔ no paa afrenhyia afrenhyia: mma ɔmmfa egyapadze do nnhyɛ no do wɔ w’enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ woenndua iyinom do ammpon no a, ɔno omfir edzi nkɔ wɔ ahosɛpɛw afe no mu, ɔno nye ne mba nka no ho.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Osiandɛ Israelmba yɛ nkowaa ma me; wɔyɛ mo nkowaa a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do: emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mma hom nnyɛ abosom, nkyii so wɔnnsen ohonyi, anaa dum bi mma homho, nkyii so mma hom mmfa ɔbo a woedzi no akye nnsi hom asaase mu, mmbɔ hom mu adze mma no: na emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Hom ndzi m’ahomgye afe no, na wondzi m’ahotseweebea no nyi: emi nye EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ hom nantsew m’ahyɛdze mu, na hom sie me mbra, na hom yɛ a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno mebɛma hom nyankom atotɔ wɔ n’aber mu, na asaase no ama no ndɔbaa, na haban mu ndua asow n’aba.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom ewuporow bokodu wenyinaba tsetsew mu, na wenyinaba tsetsew no bokodu odua ber mu: na hom bedzi hom edziban amee, na wɔatsena hom asaase do dwudwoodwo.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mebɛma asomdwee aba asaase no do, na hom ada, na obiara rinnyi hom hu: na mebɛma mbowa bɔn tun do etwa wɔ asaase no do, nkyii so nkrantsee remmfa hom asaase do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom betsiw hom atamfo, na wɔbɔtotɔr hom enyim wɔ nkrantsee ano.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom mu beenu betsiw ɔha, na hom mu ɔha betsiw mpem du: na hom atamfo bɔtotɔr hom enyim wɔ nkrantsee ano.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mebɛdan m’enyim ama hom, na mama hom awowo, na hom adɔr, na mama menye hom ahyɛmu no etsim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom bedzi akoradze dadaw a wɔdze esie ma akyɛr no, na hom beyi dadaw no aba wɔ fofor no ntsi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mibesi me ntamadan wɔ hom mu: na me kra rinnkyir hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mebɛnantsew hom mu, na mayɛ hom Nyankopɔn, na hom ayɛ me man.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn a miyii hom fii Egypt asaase do dɛ mma hom nnyɛ hɔn nkowaa; na mebubu hom kɔndua, na memaa hom sii nkyiremben nantsewee no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ hom enntsie me, na wɔannyɛ me mbrasɛm nyinara a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: na sɛ hom pow m’ahyɛdze, na hom kra kyir me mbrasɛm, na hom annyɛ me mbransɛm nyinara, na mbom hom sɛɛ m’ahyɛmu a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: mo so mebɛyɛ hom iyi; mebɛma nketsenketse akyer hom, mekyerɛ sasawaw nye etsiridii a ɔbɛsɛɛ enyiwa, na ɔbɛma ɔkra atsetsew: na hom bodua hom nduaba kwa, na hom atamfo bedzi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mebɛma m’enyi asa hom, na hom edzi hom atamfo enyim nkogu: hɔn a wokyir hom bɛhyɛ hom do; na hom boguan aber a obi nntsiw hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ hom enntsie me wɔ iyinom mpo ntsi a, ɔno mebɛtsea hom mpɛn esuon bio wɔ hom bɔn ntsi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mubobubu hom tum ahokyerɛ no; na mayɛ hom sor dɛ dadze, nye hom asaase dɛ boran:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na hom ahoɔdzen bɛsa kwa: na asaase remma ndɔbaa, nkyii so asaase no do ndua ronnsow n’aba.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ hom nantsew tsia me, na woenntsie me a; medze ɔhaw mpɛn esuon so mebɛba hom do dɛ mbrɛ hom bɔn tse no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mobɔsoma haban mu mbowa wɔ hom mu a wɔbɛgye hom nsamu mba, na wɔasɛɛ hom fiembowa, na wɔama hom dodow esuar; na hom akwan ayɛ akwamfo.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ hom amma iyinom annsakyer hom amma me, na mbom wɔnantsew tsia me a:
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno mo so mebɛnantsew etsia hom; na emi mara mabɔ hom mpɛn esuon wɔ hom bɔn ntsi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na medze awerdzi nkrantsee a obedzi ahyɛmu no ho wer mebɛba hom do; na hom aboaboa hom ano wɔ hom nkurow mu: na mobɔsoma ɔyardɔm wɔ hom mu; na woeyi hom ahyɛ ɔtamfo no nsa.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ mububu hom edziban dua a, mbaa du bɔto hɔn boodoo wɔ fononoo kor mu, na woeyi hom boodoo ama hom bio wɔ nsɛn do: na hom bedzi, na wɔremmee.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ iyi nyinara mu so hom enntsie me, na wɔnantsew tsia me a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno mebɛnantsew etsia hom ebufuw mu; na mo so matsea hom mpɛn esuon wɔ hom bɔn ntsi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom bedzi hom mbabanyin nam, na hom mbabaa nam so hom edzi.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mebɛsɛɛ hom sorɔnsorɔmbea, na metwitwa hom iwihonyi no egu, na matotow hom efun egu hom abosom efun no do; na me kra bekyir hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mebɛyɛ hom nkurow amamfo, na medze hom ahotseweebea akɔ ɔsɛɛ mu, na merenngye hom nduhuam ne nka.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na medze asaase no bɔkɔ ɔsɛɛ mu: na hom atamfo a wɔtse do no ayɛ hɔn nwanwa.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom dze mobɔbɔ hom apetse amanaman mu, na matwe nkrantsee no edzi hom ekyir: na hom asaase ayɛ ɔsɛɛ, na hom nkurow ayɛ amamfo.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ɔno na asaase no benya n’ahomgye mber ho enyigye, mber tsentsen a ɔda hɔ kɔnn no nyinara, na hom wɔ hom atamfo asaase do no; mekyerɛ ɔno na asaase no bɔhom, na woenya n’ahomgye mber ho enyigye.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mber tsentsen a ɔda hɔ kɔnn no nyinara obenya ahomgye; mekyerɛ ahomgye a woennya no wɔ hom ahomgyenda no mu, aber a hom tsenaa do no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom mu hɔn a wɔaka no dze, medze abawpa bɛhɛn hɔn akoma mu wɔ hɔn atamfo asaase do; na ahataw a atsew ne ndze etsiw hɔn; na woeguan dɛ obi ruguan nkrantsee ano; na wɔahwehwe ase aber a obi rinntsiw hɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na wobefintsiw hɔnho nkorkor, dɛ nkrantsee enyim, aber a obi rinntsiw hɔn: na hom rinnya tum nngyina hom atamfo enyim.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom bɛsɛɛ wɔ amanaman mu, na hom atamfo asaase bɛmemen hom.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na hom mu hɔn a wɔaka no bɛtsetsew wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ mu wɔ hom atamfo asaase do; na eso hɔn egyanom emumuyɛ mu na wɔnye hɔn bɛtsetsew.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na wɔbɛka hɔn emumuyɛ, nye hɔn egyanom emumuyɛ, wɔ hɔn mfom a wɔfom mu no mu, na eso dɛ wɔanantsew etsia me ntsi,
title: LEVITICUS

text: mo so menantsewee tsiaa hɔn, na medze hɔn baa hɔn atamfo asaase do: sɛ nkyii hɔn akoma monomonomyɛ no brɛ adze, na nkyii wɔpen hɔn emumuyɛ ho ntsea do a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno na mebɛkaa menye Jakob ahyɛmu no; na menye Isaak ahyɛmu no so, na menye Abraham ahyɛmu no so mebɛkaa; na mebɛkaa asaase no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na asaase no so wobegya no hɔ, na woenya n’ahomgye mber mu enyigye, aber a woekwetsi hɔn ada hɔ kɔnn no; na wɔbɛpen hɔn emumuyɛ ho ntsea do: osiandɛ wɔpoow me mbrasɛm, na hɔn kra kyiir m’ahyɛdze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na iyi nyinara so mpo ekyir, sɛ wɔwɔ hɔn atamfo asaase do a morommpow hɔn, nkyii so mirinnkyir hɔn, dɛ meresɛɛ hɔn korakora, na matsetsew menye hɔn ntamu ahyɛmu no mu; na emi nye EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn:
title: LEVITICUS

text: mbom hɔn ntsi mebɛkaa hɔn nananom ahyɛmu no, hɔn a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do wɔ amanaman enyim, dɛ mebɛyɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn no: emi nye EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyinom nye ahyɛdze nye ntsɛmbu nye mbra a EWURADZE dze nam Moses ne nsa do hyɛe too ɔno nye Israelmba ntamu wɔ kokwaa Sinai do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: LEVITICUS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ nyimpa bi hyɛ anohoba ma a, nkorɔfo no nyɛ EWURADZE dze dɛ mbrɛ w’abotwa tse.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na w’abotwa wɔ banyin a oedzi mfe eduonu do dze kodu nyia oedzi mfe eduosia do no ho nyɛ dwɛɛtɛɛ dwetɛbona eduonum, dɛ mbrɛ krɔnkrɔnbea dwetɛbona tse.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbaa a, ɔno w’abotwa nyɛ dwetɛbona eduasa.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ofi nyia oedzi mfe enum do dze kodu nyia oedzi mfe eduonu do a, ɔno w’abotwa wɔ ɔbanyin ho nyɛ dwetɛbona eduonu, na ɔbaa ho so dwetɛbona du.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ofi nyia oedzi bosoom do dze kodu nyia oedzi mfe enum do a, ɔno w’abotwa wɔ ɔbanyin ho nyɛ dwɛɛtɛɛ dwetɛbona enum, na ɔbaa ho so w’abotwa nyɛ dwɛɛtɛɛ dwetɛbona ebiasa.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ofi nyia oedzi mfe eduosia nye ekyir do a; sɛ ɔbanyin a, ɔno w’abotwa nyɛ dwetɛbona duenum, na ɔbaa ho so dwetɛbona du.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ ɔyɛ ohianyi dodow kyɛn w’abotwa no a, ɔno wɔmfa no mbegyina ɔsɔfo no enyim, na ɔsɔfo no ntwa no bo; dɛ mbrɛ nyia ɔbɔɔ anohoba no ne nsa bɔso do no ara na ɔsɔfo no ntwa no bo.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔyɛ abowa a adasa dze bi yɛ ayɛyɛdze brɛ EWURADZE a, dza nyimpa biara dze mu bi ma EWURADZE no nyinara nyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mma ɔnndan no, nkyii so ɔnnsakyer no, ɔmmfa papa nnsesa bɔn, anaa ɔmmfa bɔn nnsesa papa: na sɛ koraa ɔdze abowa bɛsesa abowa a, ɔno emu ebien nyina ɔno nye dza wɔdze sesaa no no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔyɛ abowa biara a no ho nntsew a wɔmmfa bi nnyɛ ayɛyɛdze mmbrɛ EWURADZE a, ɔno ɔmfa abowa no mbegyina ɔsɔfo no enyim:
title: LEVITICUS

text: na ɔsɔfo no ntwa no bo, sɛ oye o, omuo o: dɛ mbrɛ woara ɔsɔfo no botwa no bo no, dɛmara na ɔnyɛ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ pon ara na ɔbɔpon no a, ɔno ɔmfa no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor nto wo bo a itwae no do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi tsew ne fi ho dɛ ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma EWURADZE a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no ntwa no bo, sɛ oye o, omuo o: dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no botwa no bo no, dɛmara na ongyina.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ nyia ɔtsew ho no bɔpon ne fi a, ɔno ɔmfa wo bo a itwae no ne sika no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor nto do, na ɔnyɛ nedze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi tsew n’asaase mu haban mu bi ho ma EWURADZE a, ɔno w’abotwa nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ no nduae tse: atoko a woedua no homer kor no bo yɛ dwɛɛtɛɛ dwetɛbona eduonum.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Sɛ ahosɛpɛw afe no do na ɔtsew ne haban ho a, ontua dɛ mbrɛ bo a woetwa no tse no ara.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbom sɛ ahosɛpɛw afe no ekyir na ɔtsew ne haban ho a, ɔno ɔsɔfo no mbubu sika no ano mma no dɛ mbrɛ mfe a aka ma akɔso ahosɛpɛw afe no tse no, na wɔntsew bo a itwae no do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ pon ara na nyia ɔtsew haban no ho no bɔpon a, ɔno ɔmfa wo bo a itwae no ne sika no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor nto do, na wonsi no pi mma no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔammpon haban no, anaa sɛ ɔatɔn haban no ama nyimpa bi so a, mma wɔmmpon bio;
title: LEVITICUS

text: mbom haban no, sɛ ofir edzi ahosɛpɛw afe no mu kɔ a, ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma EWURADZE, dɛ haban a woehyira do ama; ɔnyɛ ɔsɔfo no n’enyadze.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔtsew haban a ɔatɔ a ɔnnyɛ n’enyadze haban no bi ho ma EWURADZE a;
title: LEVITICUS

text: ɔno ɔsɔfo no mbubu w’abotwa a ɔdze kodu ahosɛpɛw afe no do no, no bo a ɔsom no mma no: na ɔmma wo bo a itwae no da no ara, dɛ adzekrɔnkrɔn mma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Ahosɛpɛw afe no mu haban no nsan nkɔ nyia wɔtɔɔ no no hɔ, mekyerɛ nyia ɔyɛ n’enyadze asaase no no hɔ.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na w’abotwitwa nyinara nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ krɔnkrɔnbea dwetɛbona no tse: gera eduonu yɛ dwetɛbona kor.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mbowa mu abakan a wɔayɛ no abakan ama EWURADZE no, noara nkotoo na nyimpa bi nntsew ho; sɛ ɔnantwinyin o, ɔkɔsɔw o, EWURADZE dze a.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ ɔyɛ abowa a no ho nntsew bi a, ɔno ɔmma n’apondze dɛ mbrɛ w’abotwa tse no, na ɔmfa no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor nto do: anaa sɛ wɔammpon no no a, ɔno wɔntɔn no dɛ mbrɛ w’abotwa tse no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Naaso ehyiradze biara a nyimpa bi behyira do ama EWURADZE wɔ adze a ɔwɔ nyinara mu no, sɛ nyimpa o, abowa o, n’enyadze mu haban o, mma wɔnntɔn anaa wɔmmpon: ehyiradze biara yɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn ma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na mpo, nyimpa biara a woebu no kumfɔ no, mma wɔmmpon no; oku na wonku no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na asaase no do ebupɛn du du nyinara, sɛ ofi asaase no do o, nduadzewa mu o, dua n’aba mu o, ɔyɛ EWURADZE dze; ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi bɔpon n’ebupɛn du du no mu bi a, ɔmfa no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor nto do.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na anantwi anaa nguan mu ebupɛn du du nyinara, adze a ɔfa poma ase nyinara mu dza otsia du du no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma EWURADZE.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Mma ɔnnhwehwɛ mu dɛ ɔyɛ papa anaa bɔn, nkyii so mma ɔnnsesa bi: na sɛ koraa ɔbɛsesa bi a, ɔno emu ebien nyina, ɔno nye dza wɔdze sesa no no nyɛ krɔnkrɔn; mma wɔmmpon no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Iyinom nye mbransɛm a EWURADZE dze hyɛɛ Moses wɔ bepɔw Sinai do ma ɔdze maa Israelmba no.
title: LEVITICUS

text: Na Israelfo fii Egypt asaase do firii no n’ekyir afe a otsia ebien no mu bosoom a otsia ebien no ne da a odzi kan no, EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ Sinai sar do wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Ɔwo na Aaron mbu Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara ano, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, na mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, na dɛ mbrɛ hɔn banyin biara ne dzin tse nkorkor.
title: NUMBERS

text: Israel mu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara no hom nkan hɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ebusuakuw biara mu banyin bi nka hom ho; kor biara a ɔyɛ n’egyanom fi mu otsitsir.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mbanyin a womfo a ebusuakuw no mu mboa hom no hɔn edzin nye yi: Reuben dze; Sedeur ne babanyin Elizur.
title: NUMBERS

text: Simeon dze; Zurisadai ne babanyin Selumiel.
title: NUMBERS

text: Juda dze; Amminadab ne babanyin Nahson.
title: NUMBERS

text: Isakar dze; Zuar ne babanyin Netanel.
title: NUMBERS

text: Zebulun dze; Helon ne babanyin Eliab.
title: NUMBERS

text: Josef ne mba no dze; Efraim dze; Ammihud ne babanyin Elisama: Manaasɛ dze; Pedazur ne babanyin Gamaliel.
title: NUMBERS

text: Benjamin dze; Gideoni ne babanyin Abidan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dan dze; Ammisaddai ne babanyin Ahiezer.
title: NUMBERS

text: Aser dze; Okran ne babanyin Pagiel.
title: NUMBERS

text: Gad dze; Deutel ne babanyin Eliasaf.
title: NUMBERS

text: Naftali dze; Enan ne babanyin Ahira.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔfrɛɛ hɔn wɔ mboanofo no mu, hɔn egyanom ebusuakuw mu mbapɔmba no; wɔyɛ Israel mpem mpem mu etsitsir.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron faa mbanyin a wɔabobɔ hɔn edzin yi:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wohyiaa mboanofo no nyinara boaa ano wɔ bosoom a otsia ebien no ne da a odzi kan no mu, na wɔkyerɛɛ hɔn asefo dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, dɛ mbrɛ wɔtse nkorkor.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no, dɛmara na ɔkaan hɔn wɔ Sinai sar no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israel n’abakan Reuben, ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse no, ɔbanyin biara a oedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, na hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa
title: NUMBERS

text: a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Reuben ebusuakuw mu, nyinara yɛ mpemeduanan esia na ahaenum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Simeon ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse no, ɔbanyin biara a oedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, na hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara;
title: NUMBERS

text: a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Simeon ebusuakuw mu no, nyinara mpemeduonum akron na ahaasa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Gad ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir a wotum kɔ ɔsa
title: NUMBERS

text: a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Gad ebusuakuw mu, nyinara yɛ mpemeduanan enum ahaesia na eduonum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Juda ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir na hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara
title: NUMBERS

text: a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Juda ebusuakuw mu no nyinara mpemeduosuon anan na ahaesia.
title: NUMBERS

text: Isakar ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse no hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir, hɔn a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara
title: NUMBERS

text: a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Isakar ebusuakuw mu no yɛ mpemeduonum anan na ahaanan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Zebulun ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse no, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir a wotum kɔ ɔsa
title: NUMBERS

text: a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Zebulun ebusuakuw mu nyinara, wɔyɛ mpemeduonum esuon na ahaanan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Josef n’asefo a wɔyɛ, Efraim ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse no hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir a wotum kɔ ɔsa
title: NUMBERS

text: a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Efraim ebusuakuw mu no yɛ mpemeduanan na ahaenum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Manaasɛ ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse no, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir a wotum kɔ ɔsa
title: NUMBERS

text: a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Manaasɛ ebusuakuw mu nyinara, yɛ mpemeduasa ebien na ahaenu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Benjamin ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara;
title: NUMBERS

text: hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Benjamin ebusuakuw mu no, yɛ mpemeduasa enum na ahaanan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dan ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse no, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir a wotum kɔ ɔsa
title: NUMBERS

text: a wɔkaan hɔn, wɔ Dan ebusuakuw mu no nyinara yɛ mpemeduosia ebien na ahaesuon.
title: NUMBERS

text: Aser ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse no hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir a wotum kɔ ɔsa
title: NUMBERS

text: wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Aser ebusuakuw mu no nyinara, wɔyɛ mpemeduanan biako na ahaenum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Naftali ne mba, hɔn ebusuasantsen, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir a wotum kɔ ɔsa nyinara
title: NUMBERS

text: a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Naftali ebusuakuw mu no nyinara, wɔyɛ mpemeduonum ebiasa na ahaanan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye hɔn a Moses na Aaron nye Israel mbapɔmba no a wɔyɛ mbanyin duebien no kanee no: wogyinagyinaa hɔn egyanom efi ananmu nkorkor.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm ntsi hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Israelmba mu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee nyinara, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir a wotum kɔ ɔsa wɔ Israel mu
title: NUMBERS

text: a wɔkaan hɔn nyinara no yɛ mpemahaesia na ebiasa na ahaenum eduonum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Levifo no dze, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom ebusuakuw tse no, wɔannkan hɔn ammfora hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Levi ebusuakuw nkotsee na mma nnkan, nkyii so mma mmbu hɔn dodow ano mmfora Israelmba:
title: NUMBERS

text: mbom woara fa Levifo no si dase ntamadan no na no ho ndzɛmba nyinara na dza odzi wɔ no nyinara do: hɔn na wɔnsoa ntamadan no, na no ho ndzɛmba nyinara; na wɔnyɛ ho edwuma, na wɔmbɔ nseraban nhyia ntamadan no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ worutu ntamadan no akɔ kan a, Levifo no na wontutu: na sɛ wɔrekyer ntamadan no nsera a, Levifo no na wonsi: na sɛ ɔhɔho ba ho a wonku no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba no mbɔ hɔn asesee, nyimpa biara wɔ nankasa ne nseraban do, na nyimpa biara wɔ nankasa ne frankaa ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Levifo no dze wɔnkyer nsera wɔ dase ntamadan no ho nhyia, amma ebufuw bi aammba Israelmba mboanofo no do: na Levifo no nhwɛ dase ntamadan ahwɛdze no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba no yɛe; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no nyinara, dɛmara na wɔyɛe.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses na Aaron dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Israelmba no nkyer nsera wɔ nyimpa biara nankasa ne frankaa ho, wɔ hɔn egyanom efi nsɛnkyerɛdze do: ehyiadzibuw no ne tsentsendo na wɔnkyer hɔn nsera no nhyia.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔn a wɔnkyer nsera wɔ boka afamu a odzi kɔ wipuei no nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Juda nseraban do frankaa ho no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse: na Amminadab ne babanyin Nason na ɔnyɛ Judamba no hɔn safohen panyin.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduosuon anan na ahaesia.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔn a wɔnkyer nsera ntoa no do nye Isakar ebusuakuw. Zuar ne babanyin Netanel na ɔnyɛ Isakarmba no hɔn safohen panyin:
title: NUMBERS

text: na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduonum anan na ahaanan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Zebulun ebusuakuw ntoa do: na Helon ne babanyin Eliab na ɔnyɛ Zebulunmba no hɔn safohen panyin:
title: NUMBERS

text: na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduonum esuon na ahaanan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Juda nseraban do nyinara yɛ mpem ɔha eduowɔtwe esia na ahaanan, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse. Hɔn na wondzi kan ntu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Pomu afamu na Reuben nseraban do frankaa ndzi dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse: na Sedeur ne babanyin Elizur na ɔnyɛ Reubenmba ɔsafohen panyin.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no yɛ mpemeduanan esia na ahaenum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɔn a wɔnkyer nsera ntoa no do nye Simeon ebusuakuw: na Zurisadai ne babanyin Selumiel na ɔnyɛ Simeonmba no hɔn safohen panyin:
title: NUMBERS

text: na no dɔm a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduonum akron na ahaasa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Gad ebusuakuw no ntoa hɔn do: na Reuel ne babanyin Eliasaf na ɔnyɛ Gadmba no hɔn safohen panyin:
title: NUMBERS

text: na no dɔm a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no yɛ mpemeduanan enum na ahaesia eduonum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Reuben nseraban do nyinara wɔyɛ mpem ɔha eduonum biako na ahaanan eduonum, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse. Na hɔn na wɔntɔ do ebien ntu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nkyii so ehyiadzibuw no, nye Levifo nseraban no ntu ndzi nseraban nseraban no ne finimfin: dɛ mbrɛ wɔbɔ nseraban no, dɛmara na wontu, nyimpa biara wɔ ne dzibew, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mfrankaa no tse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Efraim ne nseraban do frankaa ndzi anee afamu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse: na Ammihud ne babanyin Elisama na ɔnyɛ Efraimmba no hɔn safohen panyin.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduanan na ahaenum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Manaasɛ ebusuakuw ntoa no do: na Pedazur ne babanyin Gamaliel na ɔnyɛ Manaasɛmba no hɔn safohen panyin.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no yɛ mpemeduasa ebien na ahaenu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Benjamin ebusuakuw no, Gideoni ne babanyin Abidan na ɔnyɛ hɔn safohen panyin:
title: NUMBERS

text: na no dɔm, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no yɛ mpemeduasa enum na ahaanan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Efraim nseraban do nyinara yɛ mpem ɔha nye awɔtwe na ɔha, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse. Na hɔn na wɔntɔ do ebiasa ntu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dan ne nseraban do frankaa ndzi kwaamu afamu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse: na Ammisaddai ne babanyin Ahiezer na ɔnyɛ Danmba no hɔn safohen panyin.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na no dɔm a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no yɛ mpemeduosia ebien na ahaesuon.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔn a wɔnkyer nsera ntoa no do nye Aser ebusuakuw: na Okran ne babanyin Pagiel na ɔnyɛ Asermba no hɔn safohen panyin.
title: NUMBERS

text: No dɔm na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduanan biako na ahaenum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Naftali ebusuakuw no, Enan ne babanyin Ahira na ɔnyɛ Naftalimba no hɔn safohen panyin:
title: NUMBERS

text: na no dɔm a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, yɛ mpemeduonum ebiasa na ahaanan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Dan ne nseraban do nyinara yɛ mpem ɔha na eduonum esuon na ahaesia. Hɔn na wondzi ekyir ntu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mfrankaa no tse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Israelmba mu hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee: hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ nseraban nseraban do dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tse nyinara yɛ mpemahaesia nye ebiasa na ahaenum eduonum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Levifo no dze, wɔannkan hɔn ammfora Israelmba no; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no nyinara, na wɔkyeer nsera dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mfrankaa no tse, na dɛmara so na wotui, obiara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua na hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee.
title: NUMBERS

text: Afei iyinom nye Aaron nye Moses hɔn ebusuasantsen wɔ da a EWURADZE nye Moses kasae, wɔ kokwaa Sinai do no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na iyinom nye Aaron ne mbabanyin no hɔn edzin; Nadab a ɔyɛ abakan no, nye Abihu, Eleazar, nye Itamar.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Aaron ne mbabanyin, asɔfo a wɔseraa hɔn ngo a wotuu hɔn sii nkyɛn dɛ wondzi asɔfo no, hɔn edzin.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Nadab nye Abihu wuwui wɔ EWURADZE enyim, aber a wɔdze ananagya baa EWURADZE enyim, wɔ Sinai sar do no, na woennya mba ntsi Eleazar nye Itamar nko na wodzii asɔfo wɔ hɔn egya Aaron enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Fa Levi ebusuakuw no bɛn, na fa hɔn begyina ɔsɔfo Aaron enyim ma wɔnsom me.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔnhwɛ n’ahwɛdze do, nye mboanofo no nyinara ahwɛdze no do wɔ ehyiadzibuw no enyim, mfa nyɛ ntamadan no ho edwuma no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔnhwɛ ehyiadzibuw no ne ndzɛmba no nyinara, nye Israelmba ahwɛdze no do, mfa nyɛ ntamadan no ho edwuma no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na fa Levifo no ma Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no: wɔdze hɔn ama no koraa wɔ Israelmba no afamu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na yi Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no si hɔ, na wɔnhwɛ hɔn asɔfodzi no do: na sɛ ɔhɔho ba ho a wonku no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Hwɛ, emi, mafa Levifo no efi Israelmba mu ahyɛ Israelmba mu mbakan a wobue yafun mu no nyinara no ananmu; na Levifo no nyɛ medze:
title: NUMBERS

text: no mbakan nyinara yɛ medze. Da a mobobɔɔ Egypt asaase do mbakan nyinara no na metseew Israel mu mbakan nyinara ho maa moho, nyimpa nye abowa nyina: wɔyɛ medze; emi nye EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ Sinai sar do dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kan Levimba no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi, nye hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: banyin biara a oedzi bosoom nye ekyir no kan no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses kaan hɔn dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔhyɛɛ no no tse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na iyinom nye Levi mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edzin no tse; Gerson, Kohat, nye Merari.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na iyinom nye Gerson ne mbabanyin edzin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee; Libni nye Simei.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Kohat mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, nye Uziel.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Merari mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee; Mahili nye Musi. Iyinom nye Levifo ebusua ebusua no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi no tsetsee.
title: NUMBERS

text: Gerson dze nye Libnifo, nye Simeifo ebusua: iyinom nye Gersonfo ebusua ebusua no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, dɛ mbrɛ mbanyin no nyinara a woedzi bosoom nye ekyir no hɔn dodow tse no, wɔyɛ mpemesuon nye ahaenum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Gersonfo ebusua ebusua no nkyer nsera wɔ ntamadan no ekyir anee afamu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Lael ne babanyin Eliasaf na ɔnyɛ Gersonfo egyanom efi mu safohen panyin.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Gerson ne mbabanyin no hɔn ahwɛdze wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu nye ntamadan no, nye Buw no, n’akatado, nye ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano nkataano,
title: NUMBERS

text: nye dampan no ne nsensɛnho, nye dampan no n’abowano nkataano no, dza ɔwɔ ntamadan no ho, na otwa afɔrmbukyia no ho hyia no, nye ne ntampehoma wɔ no ho edwuma nyinara ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Kohat dze nye Amramfo ebusua, Izharfo ebusua, Hebronfo ebusua, nye Uzielfo ebusua: iyinom nye Kohatfo ebusua ebusua no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ mbanyin nyinara a woedzi bosoom nye ekyir no hɔn dodow tse no, wɔyɛ mpemawɔtwe nye ahaesia a wɔhwɛ ahotseweebea ahwɛdodze no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Kohat ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua no nkyer nsera wɔ ntamadan no nkyɛn wɔ pomu afamu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Uziel ne mbabanyin Elizafan na ɔnyɛ ɔsafohen panyin wɔ Kohatfo ebusua ebusua no hɔn egyanom fie mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ahwɛdze nye adaka no, nye pon no, nye kandzeadua no, nye afɔrmbukyia no, nye ahotseweebea ndzɛmba no a wɔdze som no, nye nkataano no, nye no ho edwuma nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar na nyɛ ɔsafohen panyin wɔ Levifo asafohemfo mu, na ɔnhwɛ hɔn a wɔhwɛ ahotseweebea no do ahwɛdodze do no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Merari dze nye Mahilifo ebusua, nye Musfo ebusua: iyinom nye Merari ebusua ebusua no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no, dɛ mbrɛ mbanyin no nyinara a woedzi bosoom nye ekyir no hɔn dodow tse no, wɔyɛ mpemesia nye ahaenu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Abihail ne babanyin Zuriel nye Merari ebusua ebusua no mu egyanom fi mu safohen panyin: hɔn na wɔnkyer nsera wɔ ntamadan no nkyɛn wɔ kwaamu afamu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ahwɛdodze a wɔahyɛ ama Merari ne mbabanyin no nye ntamadan no ne ntaabow, nye ne ndaban, nye n’edum, nye ne ntaataase, nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye no ho edwuma nyinara;
title: NUMBERS

text: na dampan no n’edum a ehyia ho no, nye ne ntaease no, nye no mbɔfondua, nye ne ntampehoma.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔn a wɔnkyer nsera wɔ ntamadan no enyim wɔ boka afamu, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no enyim a odzi kɔ wipuei no, nye Moses, nye Aaron nye ne mbabanyin a wɔhwɛ ahotseweebea ahwɛdodze no ma Israelmba no; na ɔhɔho biara a ɔbɛba ho no wonku no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɔn a wofi Levifo mu a Moses nye Aaron nam EWURADZE ne mbrasɛm do kaan hɔn nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua no tse no, mbanyin a woedzi bosoom nye ekyir no nyinara, wɔyɛ mpemeduonu ebien.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Kan Israelmba mu mbakan mbanyin a woedzi bosoom nye ekyir no nyinara, na bu hɔn edzin no dodow ano.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na fa Levifo no ma me (emi nye EWURADZE) fa hyɛ Israelmba mu mbakan no nyinara ananmu; nye Levifo fiembowa no hyɛ Israelmba fiembowa mu mbakan no nyinara ananmu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses kaan Israelmba mu mbakan no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ no no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mbakan mbanyin a woedzidzi bosoom nye ekyir, dɛ mbrɛ edzin dodow no tse wɔ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu no mu no, wɔyɛ mpemeduonu ebien ahaenu eduosuon ebiasa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛ, Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Fa Levifo no hyɛ Israelmba mu mbakan no nyinara ananmu, na fa Levifo fiembowa no hyɛ hɔn fiembowa no ananmu: na Levifo no nyɛ medze; emi nye EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba mbakan ahaenu eduosuon ebiasa a wɔbor Levifo no hɔn dodow do no hɔn apondze no dze,
title: NUMBERS

text: gyegye hɔn tsir sika dwetɛbona enum enum dɛ mbrɛ wɔtse nkorkor; mbrɛ ahotseweebea nhyehyɛɛ tse no na gye hɔn (dwetɛbona yɛ gera enum):
title: NUMBERS

text: na fa sika no a wɔdze poon hɔn a wɔbor hɔn do no ma Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses gyegyee apondze sika no wɔ hɔn a wɔbor hɔn a Levifo poon hɔn no hɔ:
title: NUMBERS

text: Israelmba mbakan hɔ na ɔgyegyee sika no; dwetɛbona apem ahaasa eduosia enum, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea dwetɛbona tse:
title: NUMBERS

text: na Moses dze apondze sika no maa Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔhyɛɛ Moses no tse no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Bu Kohat ne mbabanyin no ano fa fi Levi mbabanyin no mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee,
title: NUMBERS

text: ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir do kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do, hɔn a wɔhɛn ɔsom no mu kɛyɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyi nye Kohat ne mbabanyin no hɔn edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, wɔ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn ho:
title: NUMBERS

text: sɛ nseraban no rubotu a, Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no na wɔnkɔ mu, na wonkeyi ntwamutam nkataano no, na wɔmfa nkata dasedaka no do:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔmfa esukraman nwoma akatado nto do, na wɔmfa tam a ne nyinara yɛ bibir nkata do, na wɔmfa no mpoma no nhyehyɛ mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔmfa tam bibir nkata ɔkyerɛpaanoo pon no do, na wɔmfa nkwansɛn no, nye ntser no, nye nkora, nye nkɔɔpow a wɔdze hue no nsisi do: na daa daa paanoo no nsi do:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔmfa tam memen nkata do, na wɔmfa esukraman nwoma akatado nkata ho, na wɔmfa no mpoma no nhyehyɛ mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔmfa tam bibir, nkata kandzea no ne kandzeadua nye ne nkandzea, nye n’adabaa, nye no nsompokuwa no, nye no ngo ntoaba nyinara a wɔdze som no ho:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔmfa ɔno nye no ho adze nyinara nhyɛ esukraman nwoma akatado mu, na wɔmfa nto pata no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Wɔmfa tam bibir nkata sika afɔrmbukyia no do, na wɔmfa esukraman nwoma akatado nkata do, na wɔmfa no mpoma no nhyehyɛ mu:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔmfa ɔsom ho ndzɛmba nyinara a wɔdze som wɔ ahotseweebea no nhyɛ tam bibir mu, na wɔmfa esukraman nwoma akatado nkata ho, na wɔmfa nto pata no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔnsesaw nso no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, na wɔmfa tam ɔberdum nkata do:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔmfa no ho ndzɛmba nyinara a wɔdze som wɔ ho no ngu do, ogyasɛn, edzinam, nye nsofi, nye mbɛɛsen, afɔrmbukyia no ho ndzɛmba no nyinara; na wɔmfa esukraman nwoma akatado nkata do, na wɔmfa no mpoma no nhyehyɛ mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ nseraban no rubotu, na Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no wie ahotseweebea no, nye ahotseweebea no ho ndzɛmba no nyinara do kata a; nna nkyii Kohat ne mbabanyin no mbra mbɔsoa: ahotseweebea no dze mma wɔnnka, amma woeennwuwu. Ndzɛmba yi nye Kohat ne mbabanyin no hɔn adzesoa wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar n’ahwɛdodze nye kandzea no ho ngo no, nduhuanhuam no, daa daa edziban afɔr no, ɔserango no, ntamadan no nye dza ɔayɛ no krɔnkrɔn a ɔwɔ mu no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom nhwɛ ma wontwa Kohatfo ebusua ebusua mu ebusuakuw no mmfi Levifo no mu:
title: NUMBERS

text: na dza hom nyɛ mma hɔn ama woeenya nkwa na woeennwuwu, sɛ wɔbɛn krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn no a: Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no nhɛn mu, na wɔmfa hɔn nsisi obiara n’edwuma nye n’adzesoa ho:
title: NUMBERS

text: na hɔn dze, mma wɔnnhɛn mu nnkɔhwɛ ahotseweebea no dɛ enyi robɔ do mpo, amma woeennwuwu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Bu Gerson mbabanyin no so ano, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi, nye hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee;
title: NUMBERS

text: ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir do kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do na kan hɔn; hɔn a wɔhɛn mu kɔsom dɛ wɔkɛyɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyi nye Gersonfo ebusua ebusua hɔn som wɔ ɔsom nye ndzesoa soa mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɔn na wɔnsoa ntamadan no ne nsensɛnho atam no, nye ehyiadzibuw no, ne nkatado, nye esukraman nwoma akatado no a ɔwɔ do wɔ sor no, nye ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano nkataano;
title: NUMBERS

text: nye pampan no ne nsensɛnho no, nye pampan no n’abotsen abowano nkataano, dza etwa ntamadan no nye afɔrmbukyia no ho ehyia no, nye ne ntampehoma, nye no ho edwuma ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye biribiara a wɔdze bɛyɛ no, no mu na wɔnsom.
title: NUMBERS

text: Aaron nye ne mbabanyin mbrasɛm do na Gersonfo mbabanyin no nyɛ hɔn edwuma nyinara, wɔ hɔn adzesoa nyinara, nye hɔn edwuma nyinara mu: na hom mfa hɔn adzesoa nyinara nhyɛ hɔn nsa ma wɔnhwɛ do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyi nye Gersonfo mbabanyin ebusua ebusua no hɔn edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu: na hɔn ahwɛdodze wɔ ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Itamar nsamu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Merari ne mbabanyin no dze, kan hɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee;
title: NUMBERS

text: ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir do kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do no mu, obiara a ɔhɛn ɔsom no mu, dɛ ɔkɛyɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na iyi nye hɔn adzesoa ahwɛdodze, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edwuma nyinara tse wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu; ntamadan no ne ntaabow, nye n’adaban, nye n’edum, nye ne ngyinado na kan hɔn;
title: NUMBERS

text: na pampan no n’edum a etwa ho ehyia no, nye ne ngyinado, nye no mbɔfondua, nye ne ntampehoma, ɔnye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, na ɔnye n’edwuma nyinara: na hom mfa hɔn adzesoa ahwɛdodze ndzɛmba no mbɔ dzin nhyɛ hɔn nsa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyi nye Merari mbabanyin ebusua ebusua edwuma, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edwuma nyinara tse, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, wɔ ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Itamar nsamu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron nye mboanofo no mu mbapɔmba no kaan Kohatfo mbabanyin no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee,
title: NUMBERS

text: ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir do kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do, dɛ ɔkɛyɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no:
title: NUMBERS

text: na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee no wɔyɛ mpemebien ahaesuon eduonum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Kohatfo ebusua ebusua mu, hɔn a wɔsoom wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu nyinara a Moses nye Aaron nam EWURADZE mbrasɛm a ɔwɔ Moses nsamu no do kanee no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Gerson mbabanyin mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee,
title: NUMBERS

text: ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir do kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do, obiara a ɔhɛn ɔsom no mu, dɛ ɔkɛyɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no,
title: NUMBERS

text: dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua, nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee no, wɔyɛ mpemebien nye ahaesia eduasa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Gerson ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua mu, hɔn a wɔsomee wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu nyinara a Moses nye Aaron nam EWURADZE mbrasɛm do kanee no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Merari mbabanyin ebusua ebusua mu, dɛ mbrɛ ebusua ebusua nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee,
title: NUMBERS

text: ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do, obiara a ɔhɛn ɔsom no mu, dɛ ɔkɛyɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu no,
title: NUMBERS

text: dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tse a wɔkaan hɔn no, wɔyɛ mpemebiasa nye ahaenu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Merari ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua a Moses nye Aaron nam EWURADZE mbrasɛm a ɔwɔ Moses nsamu no do kanee no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Levifo mu nyinara a Moses nye Aaron nye Israel mbapɔmba no kanee, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua, nye hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee,
title: NUMBERS

text: ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa nye ekyir do kodu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do, obiara a ɔhɛn mu dɛ ɔkɛyɛ ɔsom edwuma, nye ndzesoa soa mu edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu
title: NUMBERS

text: a wɔkaan hɔn no, wɔyɛ mpemawɔtwe ahaenum eduawɔtwe.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE mbrasɛm tse na wɔnam Moses nsa do kaan hɔn, obiara dɛ mbrɛ no som tse, nye mbrɛ n’adzesoa tse no ara: dɛm na kaan hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ no no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Hyɛ Israelmba ma wontu ɔkwatanyi biara, nye obiara a ɔwɔ ahosen, nye onyia biara a ɔdze fun egu noho fi, mfi nseraban no mu:
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔbanyin o ɔbaa o hom ntu no. Nseraban no ekyir na hom ntu hɔn nkogu amma woeenngu hɔn nseraban a metse ne finimfin no ho fi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dɛmara, na wotuu hɔn koguu nseraban ekyir: na dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses no, dɛmara na Israelmba no yɛe.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Sɛ ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa yɛ bɔn tsia nyimpa bi, dze fom EWURADZE, na ɔkra no dzi so a;
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔno ɔmpaa mu nka hɔn bɔn a wɔayɛ no: na ontua n’asodzidze no imu, na ɔmfa no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor nto do, na ɔmfa mma nyia ɔafom no edzi so no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Mbom sɛ nyimpa no ewu na onnyi bɔgya bi a ɔbɛn no a wɔdze asodzidze bɛma no wɔ asodzi no ntsi a, asodzi no ho asodzidze no yɛ EWURADZE dze na ɔnyɛ ɔsɔfo no dze; nka mpata oguannyin no a wɔdze rebɛpata ama no no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔtow afɔr biara a ɔwɔ Israelmba adzekrɔnkrɔn nyinara mu a wɔdze brɛ ɔsɔfo no, nyɛ nedze.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nyimpa biara n’adzekrɔnkrɔn a ɔdze ba no yɛ ɔsɔfo no dze: biribiara a nyimpa biara dze ma ɔsɔfo no, nedze ara na ɔnyɛ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ ɔbanyin bi ne yer fi ne nkyɛn, na ɔkɔfom no,
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔbanyin bi nye no da dze no ho nsu ma no, na wɔdze suma no kun, na wosiw do, na ogu noho fi, na no ho ɔdasefo bi nnyi hɔ, nkyii so wɔannkyer no wɔ do;
title: NUMBERS

text: na nyinkun sunsum ba no do, na ɔtwe ne yer no ho nyinkun, na sɛ basia no egu noho fi ampa: anaa sɛ nyinkun sunsum ba no do, na ɔtwe ne yer no ho nyinkun, na sɛ basia no nguu noho fi a:
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔno ɔbanyin no mfa ne yer no mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no, na ɔmfa no ho ayɛyɛdze mbra, atoko isiam efa ebupɛn du mu kor; mma ɔmmfa ngo nngu do, na ɔmmfa krɔbɔw so nnto do; osiandɛ ɔyɛ nyinkun ho edziban afɔr na nkaa ho edziban afɔr, a wɔdze kaa emumuyɛ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa no mbɛn, na ɔmfa no mbegyina EWURADZE enyim:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfa nsu krɔnkrɔn ngu dɛtse kɔɔpow bi mu; na ɔsɔfo no mfa ntamadan no ne daadze huntuma no bi, ngu nsu no mu:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfa ɔbaa no ngyina EWURADZE enyim, na ontutu ɔbaa no ne tsinhwi ngu do, na ɔmfa nkaa edziban afɔr no a ɔyɛ nyinkun edziban afɔr no nhyɛ ne nsamu: na ɔsɔfo no nkitsa nsu wenwen a ɔdze ndom ba no wɔ ne nsamu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mma ondzi nsew, na ɔnse ɔbaa no dɛ, Sɛ banyin bi nnye wo nndae, na sɛ immfii wo kun nkyɛn nnkoguu woho fi a, wo ho nyɛ tɔtrɔtɔ wɔ nsu wenwen a ɔdze ndom ba yi ho:
title: NUMBERS

text: mbom sɛ efi wo kun nkyɛn, ber a ewar wo kun yi na sɛ ekogu woho fi, na banyin bi nye wo ada ka wo kun ho a:
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔno ɔsɔfo no mma ɔbaa no mfa ndom ntam ndzi nsew, na ɔsɔfo no nse ɔbaa no dɛ, EWURADZE nyɛ wo dzin ndom nye ntam wɔ wo man mu, aber a EWURADZE bɛma w’aserɛ atotɔ mu, na wo yafun ahon.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nsu a ɔdze ndom ba yi akɛhɛn wo nson mu, na ɔama wo yafun ahon, na w’aserɛ atotɔ mu: na ɔbaa no nse dɛ, Amen, Amen.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no nkyerɛw ndom yi wɔ nwoma mu, na ɔmpepa ngu nsu wenwen no mu:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔmma ɔbaa no nnom nsu wenwen a ɔdze ndom ba no: na nsu a ɔdze ndom ba no nkɔ no mu nkɛyɛ wenwen.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no ngye nyinkun ho edziban afɔr no wɔ ɔbaa no nsamu, na ɔntow edziban afɔr no wɔ EWURADZE enyim, na ɔmfa mbra afɔrmbukyia no ho;
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfa edziban afɔr no mu nsapuw, dɛ ne nkaadze, na ɔnhyew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, na n’ekyir no ɔmma ɔbaa no nnom nsu no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ aber a ɔama ɔanom nsu no, sɛ oegu noho fi na ɔayɛ bɔn etsia no kun a, nsu no a ɔdze ndom ba no bɛhɛn no mu akɛyɛ wenwen, na ne yafun ahon, na n’aserɛ atotɔ mu: na ɔbaa no ayɛ ndom wɔ ne man mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ ɔbaa no ho enngu fi, na no ho tsew dze a; ɔno no ho bɛyɛ tɔtrɔtɔ, na oenyinsen ɔba.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyi nye nyinkun ho mbra, sɛ ɔyer bi fi no kun nkyɛn na okogu noho fi;
title: NUMBERS

text: anaa sɛ nyinkun sunsum ba banyin bi do, na ɔtwe ne yer ho nyinkun a; ɔno ɔmfa ɔbaa no mbegyina EWURADZE enyim, na ɔsɔfo no nyɛ no mbra yi mu adze nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbanyin no ho bɛyɛ tɔtrɔtɔ wɔ emumuyɛ ho, na ɔbaa no asoa n’emumuyɛ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa bi bɔ anohoba soronko, Nazirinyi anohoba, dɛ orutu noho dze ama EWURADZE a:
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔnkam noho wɔ wenyin nye nsa dzendzen ho: mma ɔnnom wenyin kawee, anaa nsa dzendzen kawee, nkyii so mma ɔnnom esikyireamba nsa biara, na onndzi esikyireamba momon anaa guanee so.
title: NUMBERS

text: Noho nkamee nda nyinara mu mma onndzi biribiara a wɔdze wenyindua ho biribi ayɛ, no nsowee mu aba o, no ho ahon o.
title: NUMBERS

text: Noho nkamee anohoba nda nyinara mu no mma oyindam bi nnka ne tsir: ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn nkodu dɛ nda a ɔkaam noho maa EWURADZE wɔ mu no bɔso, onsie etsimum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nda a ɔakam noho ama EWURADZE no nyinara mma ɔnnkɔ nyimpa bi fun ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Sɛ n’egya, anaa ne na, no nua anaa n’akyerɛbaa mpo wuwu a, mma onnkogu noho fi: osiandɛ noho nkamee a ɔdze ma Nyankopɔn no wɔ n’etsifi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Noho nkamee nda nyinara ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi wu awerɛfir mu wɔ ne nkyɛn, na ogu noho nkamee tsir ho fi a; ɔno da a otsia esuon no onyi ne tsir wɔ n’ahoguar da no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na da a otsia awɔtwe no ɔmfa ntamram ebien, anaa mborɔnomamba ebien, mbrɛ ɔsɔfo no, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfa kor mbɔ bɔn ho afɔr, na kor no so ɔmfa nyɛ ɔhyew afɔr, na ɔmpata mma no, dɛ ɔafom wɔ fun no ho, na ɔntsew ne tsir ho da no ara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔnsan nkam noho mma EWURADZE, na ɔmfa eguambaanyin a oedzi afrenhyia mbra mbɔbɔ asodzi ho afɔr: mbom nkan no nda no ayɛ kwa, osiandɛ noho nkamee no ho egu fi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na iyi nye Nazirinyi ho mbra, aber a noho nkamee nda ewie du no: wɔmfa no mbra ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔmfa ayɛyɛdze mbrɛ EWURADZE, eguambaanyin a oedzi afrenhyia a onndzii dzɛm kor mbɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr, na eguambaaber a oedzi afrenhyia a onndzii dzɛm kor mbɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr, nye oguannyin a onndzii dzɛm kor mbɔbɔ asomdwee afɔr,
title: NUMBERS

text: nye epitsi boodoo kɛntsɛn no, nye isiam pa tatar a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, nye epitsi tatar ntrɛtraba a wɔdze ngo egu do, nye n’edziban afɔr, nye no nom afɔr.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mfa mbra EWURADZE enyim, na ɔmbɔ no bɔn ho afɔr, nye ne hyew afɔr:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔmfa oguannyin no mbɔ asomdwee afɔr mma EWURADZE, nka epitsi boodoo kɛntsɛn no ho: ɔsɔfo no mbɔ n’edziban afɔr, nye no nom afɔr no so.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Nazirinyi no nyi ne tsir no wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano, na ɔmfa ne tsinhwi no ngu ogya no a ɔwɔ asomdwee afɔr ase no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na oeyi ne tsir no ekyir no, ɔsɔfo no mfa oguannyin abasa a wɔanoa, nye kɛntsɛn no mu epitsi tatar kor, na epitsi tatar ntrɛtraba kor ngu Nazirinyi no nsamu,
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔsɔfo no ntow no ɔtow afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim; iyi yɛ krɔnkrɔn ma ɔsɔfo no dze ka ɔtow nyan nye ohim aserɛ no ho: na ɔno ekyir no Nazirinyi no nnom wenyin.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyi nye mbra a ɔwɔ hɔ ma Nazirinyi na mbom sɛ ɔbɔ anohoba bi ka dza Nazirinyi yɛ no ho a, otwar dɛ ɔpon dɛm anohoba no ka dza noho nkamee nhyehyɛɛ no kyerɛ no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dɛ, Mbrɛ hom nsi nhyira Israelmba no nye yi; hom nse hɔn dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: EWURADZE nhyira wo, na ɔnhwɛ wo do:
title: NUMBERS

text: EWURADZE ntsew n’enyim nkyerɛ wo, na ɔndom wo:
title: NUMBERS

text: EWURADZE mma n’enyi do nhwɛ wo, na ɔmma wo asomdwee.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔmfa me dzin nto Israelmba do dɛm; na mibehyira hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ da a Moses wiee ntamadan no si, na ɔseraa ho ngo na ɔtseew ɔno, nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, nye afɔrmbukyia no no ho ndzɛmba nyinara ho, na ɔseraa ho ngo na ɔtseew ho no;
title: NUMBERS

text: nna Israel mbapɔmba, hɔn egyanom efi mu etsitsir no, bɔɔ afɔr; iyinom nye ebusuakuw ebusuakuw do asafohen mpanyin, iyinom nye hɔn a wɔhwɛɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn no do no:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔdze hɔn ayɛyɛdze baa EWURADZE enyim, ntseaseanam a wɔakata do esia, nye anantwi duebien; mbapɔmba beenu dze tseaseanam kor, na ɔbaako ɔnantwi kor: na wɔdze baa ntamadan no enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Gye no wɔ hɔn nsamu, ma wɔmfa nyɛ ehyiadzibuw no ho edwuma; na fa ma Levifo no, dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa biara n’edwuma tse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses gyee ntseaseanam no nye anantwi no na ɔdze maa Levifo no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Ntseaseanam ebien nye anantwi anan na ɔdze maa Gerson mbabanyin no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edwuma tse:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔdze ntseaseanam anan nye anantwi awɔtwe maa Merari mbabanyin no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edwuma tse, wɔ ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Itamar nsamu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Kohat mbabanyin no dze ɔamma hɔn bi: osiandɛ ahotseweebea edwuma no yɛ hɔndze; hɔn na wɔsoa no wɔ hɔn mbatsir do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mbapɔmba no dze afɔrmbukyia oyimadze bae wɔ da a wɔseraa ho ngo no mu, mekyerɛ mbapɔmba no dze hɔn ayɛyɛdze baa afɔrmbukyia no enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Wɔmfa hɔn ayɛyɛdze mbra, ɔbapɔmba kor biara wɔ ne da mu, mfa mbɛyɛ afɔrmbukyia oyimadze.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nyia ɔdze n’ayɛyɛdze baa da a odzi kan no nye Aminadab a ofi Juda ebusuakuw mu no ne babanyin Nahson:
title: NUMBERS

text: na n’ayɛyɛdze nye dwetɛboyaa kor, n’ano tow dwetɛbona ɔha eduasa, dwetɛkora kor a ɔyɛ dwetɛbona eduosuon, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea dwetɛbona tse: na ebien nyina isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw dze rekɛyɛ edziban afɔr ayeyɛ no amaama;
title: NUMBERS

text: sika atser kor a ɔyɛ dwetɛbona du a eduhuam ayɛ no ma;
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, oguannyin kor, eguambaanyin kor a oedzi afrenhyia a wɔdze rokɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr;
title: NUMBERS

text: mpɔnkye mu onyin kor a wɔdze rokɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr;

title: NUMBERS

title: NUMBERS

text: Na asomdwee afɔr anantwi no nyinara yɛ anantwisaa eduonu anan, nguannyin no eduosia, mpɔnkyenyin no eduosia na nguambaanyin a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia no eduosia. Iyi nye afɔrmbukyia no no ngosera ekyir oyimadze.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na aber a Moses hɛɛn ehyiadzibuw no mu dɛ ɔnye no rekɛkasa no, nna ɔtsee ndze a ɔrekasa kyerɛ no fi mbɔbɔrhu egua a ɔwɔ dasedaka no do no do, wɔ kerobim ebien no ntamu: na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron na se no dɛ, Sɛ esosɔ nkandzea no a, nkandzea esuon no ngyegye kandzeadua no enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Aaron yɛɛ dɛm; ɔsosɔɔ ne nkandzea ma ɔgyegyee kandzeadua no enyim, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na iyi nye kandzeadua no ne yɛbea, sika a ɔabor ara nko; fi n’ase dze kodu ne nhyiren do nyinara yɛ ɔbor edwuma: dɛ mbrɛ nsusudo a EWURADZE dze kyerɛɛ Moses no tse no, dɛmara na ɔyɛɛ kandzeadua no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Yi Levifo no wɔ Israelmba mu, na tsew hɔn ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm na yɛ hɔn fa tsew hɔn ho: fa bɔnyi ho nsu petse hɔn do, na ma wɔmfa oyindam nyiyi hɔnho nyinara, na ma wɔnhor hɔn ntar mfa ntsew hɔnho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nna ma wɔmfa ɔnantwisaa eburwa, nye n’edziban afɔr, isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, na fa ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor so bɔ bɔn ho afɔr.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na fa Levifo no bra ehyiadzibuw no enyim: na ma Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara mbɔbɔ ngua:
title: NUMBERS

text: na fa Levifo no bra EWURADZE enyim: na Israelmba mfa hɔn nsa ngu Levifo no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Afei Aaron ntu Levifo no nsi hɔ dɛ ɔtow afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim, mfa ngyina Israelmba no ananmu, ma wɔntsena hɔ nyɛ EWURADZE n’edwuma.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Levifo no mfa hɔn nsa ngu anantwisaa no etsifi: na fa kor bɔ bɔn ho afɔr, na fa kor so bɔ ɔhyew afɔr ma EWURADZE, ma ɔnyɛ mpata mma Levifo no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na fa Levifo no gyina Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no enyim, na tu hɔn si hɔ dɛ ɔtow afɔr ma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm na tsew Levifo no fi Israelmba mu: na Levifo no mbɛyɛ medze.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na n’ekyir no Levifo no nkɔ nkɛyɛ ehyiadzibuw no ho edwuma: na tsew hɔn ho, na tu hɔn si hɔ dɛ ɔtow afɔr.
title: NUMBERS

text: Osiandɛ wɔdze hɔn ama me koraa efi Israelmba no mu; medze hɔn ahyɛ dza obue yafun nyinara, mekyerɛ Israelmba mu mbakan nyinara ananmu mafa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba mu mbakan nyinara yɛ medze, nyimpa nye mbowa nyina da a mobobɔɔ Egypt asaase do mbakan nyinara no na metseew hɔn ho maa moho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mafa Levifo no ahyɛ Israelmba mu mbakan nyinara ananmu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na medze Levifo no ama Aaron nye ne mbabanyin no dɛ akyɛdze a ofi Israelmba mu dɛ wɔnyɛ edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, na wɔmpata mma Israelmba ama sɛ Israelmba no rotwe bɛn ahotseweebea no a, ɔyardɔm bi aammba Israelmba no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm na Moses, nye Aaron, nye Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara, yɛɛ Levifo no. Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses wɔ Levifo no ho nyinara no, dɛmara na Israelmba no yɛɛ hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Levifo no tseew hɔnho fii bɔn ho, na wɔhoor hɔn ntar; na Aaron tuu hɔn sii hɔ yɛɛ ɔtow afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim; na Aaron patae maa hɔn dze tseew hɔn ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na n’ekyir no Levifo no kɔree kɛyɛɛ hɔn edwuma wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu wɔ Aaron, nye ne mbabanyin no enyim: na dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses wɔ Levifo no ho no, dɛmara na wɔyɛɛ hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Dza ɔyɛ Levifo dze no nye yi: hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu enum nye ekyir no nkɔ nkɔsom wɔ ehyiadzibuw no edwuma no mu:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonum do no ngyaa edwuma yɛ, na mma wɔnnkɔsom bio;
title: NUMBERS

text: mbom wɔnye hɔn nuanom nsom wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, nhwɛ ahwɛdodze no, na ɔsom edwuma no na mma wɔnnyɛ. Dɛm na yɛ ma Levifo no wɔ hɔn ahwɛdodze ho afamu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ Sinai sar do, wofii Egypt asaase do firii no n’ekyir afe a otsia ebien no no bosoom a odzi kan no mu dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Nkyii so ma Israelmba ndzi apaho no wɔ n’aber a wɔahyɛ mu,
title: NUMBERS

text: bosoom yi ne da a otsia duanan no mu ewimbir, na hom ndzi: dɛ mbrɛ n’ahyɛdze nyinara tse, na mbrɛ no ho mmom nyinara tse no, na hom ndzi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba no dɛ wondzi apaho no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wodzii apaho no wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no ne da a otsia duanan no mu, ewimbir, wɔ Sinai sar do: dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no nyinara, dɛmara na Israelmba no yɛe.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mbanyin bi wɔ hɔ a hɔn ho egu fi wɔ nyimpa bi no fun ho, ma dɛm ntsi woenntum enndzi apaho no da no ara:
title: NUMBERS

text: na mbanyin no see no dɛ, Hɛn ho egu fi wɔ nyimpa bi no fun ho: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔakam hɛn, dɛ mma yɛmmfa EWURADZE ayɛyɛdze mmba wɔ n’aber a wɔahyɛ mu wɔ Israelmba no mu?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, Hom ngyina hɔ; ma minketsie dza EWURADZE bɛhyɛ wɔ hom ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Sɛ nyimpa bi no ho gu fi wɔ fun bi ho, anaa ɔwɔ ekyirekyir akwantu mu, wɔ hom mu, anaa hom ebusuasantsen mu a, ondzi apaho no mma EWURADZE ara:
title: NUMBERS

text: bosoom a otsia ebien no mu da a otsia duanan no ewimbir na wondzi; epitsi boodoo nye fan wenwen na wɔmfa ndzi:
title: NUMBERS

text: mma wonngya mu bi mma onnkodu anapa, na mma wommbu ne biew bi mu so: na dɛ mbrɛ apaho no no ho ahyɛdze no nyinara tse na wondzi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Mbom nyimpa no a no ho tsew, na orunntu kwan, na ogyaa dɛ odzi apaho no dze, ɔkra no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen osiandɛ ɔammfa EWURADZE ayɛyɛdze no ammba wɔ n’aber a wɔahyɛ mu, dɛm nyimpa no nsoa no bɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ ɔhɔho bi bɔsoɛ hom mu na oridzi apaho no ama EWURADZE a ɔno dɛ mbrɛ apaho ahyɛdze no tse, na mbrɛ no ho mbra no tse no, na ɔnyɛ: hom nya ahyɛdze kor mfa mma ɔhɔho nye nyia wɔawo no wɔ asaase no do nyina.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na da a wɔmaa ntamadan no do sii hɔ no mununkum no bɛkataa ntamadan no do, mekyerɛ dasebuw no: na ewimbir no na ɔwɔ ntamadan no do epue tse dɛ ogya dze kodu anapa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm na ɔtse daa: mununkum no kataa do, na ogya no puee anadwe.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na aber biara a wɔma mununkum no do ma ɔma noho do fi Buw no do no, ɔno n’ekyir no Israelmba tu kwan, na beebi mbrɛ mununkum no gyinae no, hɔ na Israelmba kyeer nsera.
title: NUMBERS

text: EWURADZE mbrasɛm do na Israelmba nam tuu kwan, na EWURADZE mbrasɛm do na wɔnam kyeer nsera: aber tsentsen biara a mununkum no tsena ntamadan no do no nyinara wɔtsena nserakyer mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ mununkum no kyinkyim ntamadan no do nda pii a, ɔno Israelmba hwɛ EWURADZE ahwɛdodze no do, na wonntu kwan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔtɔfabi a mununkum no dzi nda kakrabaa bi wɔ ntamadan no do; nna dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE mbrasɛm tse no wɔatsena nsera no mu, na dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE mbrasɛm tse no, nna wɔnam do etu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔtɔfabi so a mununkum no wɔ hɔ araa fi ewimbir kodu anapa; na sɛ mununkum no ma noho do anapa a, na woetu: anaa sɛ ɔwɔw do adzekyee nye adzesaa, na sɛ mununkum no ma no ho do a, na woetu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Sɛ nda ebien o, bosoom o, afrenhyia o, nna mununkum no kyinkyim wɔ ntamadan no do tsena do a, Israelmba no tsena nsera no mu, na wonntu: na sɛ ɔma no ho do a, nna woetu.
title: NUMBERS

text: EWURADZE ne mbrasɛm na wɔnam do kyeer nsera, na EWURADZE ne mbrasɛm na wɔnam do tui: wɔhwɛɛ EWURADZE n’ahwɛdodze do, wɔ EWURADZE ne mbrasɛm a ɔnam Moses ne nsa do hyɛɛ no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Yɛ dwetɛ ntotorobɛnto ebien fa ma woho: ɔbor edwuma na fa yɛ: na dze aafrɛ mboanofo no aba, na dze ama woeetutu nseraban no akɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ wɔhɛn n’ebien nyina a, mboanofo no nyinara hɔn ano nhyia wo nkyɛn wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ wɔhɛn kor a, ɔno mbapɔmba no, Israel mpempem mu etsitsir no, hɔn ano nhyia wo nkyɛn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ hom hɛn ewubɔ a, nseraban a ɔdeda boka afamu no ntutu nkɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ hom hɛn ewubɔ toa do ebien a, nseraban a ɔdeda pomu afamu no ntutu nkɔ: worubotu no, wɔnhɛn ewubɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Mbom sɛ bagua no ribehyia a, hom nhɛn, na mma hom nnhɛn ewubɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Aaron ne mbabanyin asɔfo no, na wɔmfa ntotorobɛnto no nhɛn; na ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze mma hom wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyinara mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ hom rokɔ ɔsa wɔ hom asaase do nye ɔtamfo a ohiahia hom ho akɔko a, ɔno hom mfa ntotorobɛnto no nhɛn ewubɔ; na wɔnkaa hom wɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn enyim, na wɔngye hom nkwa wɔ hom atamfo nsamu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hom enyigye nda mu, nye hom afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ mu, na hom abosoom ahyɛse mu so, hom mfa ntotorobɛnto no nhɛn no wɔ hom ɔhyew afɔr nye hom asomdwee afɔr no do; na ɔnyɛ nkaa mma hom wɔ hom Nyankopɔn enyim: emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia ebien no, bosoom a otsia ebien no, wɔ bosoom no ne da a otsia eduonu no mu no, mununkum no maa noho do fii dase ntamadan no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba no sii mu fii Sinai sar do dɛ mbrɛ hɔn akwantu no tse: na mununkum no kegyinaa Paran sar do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wodzii kan tuu hɔn akwantu no dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE mbrasɛm a ɔwɔ Moses nsamu no tse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Judamba nseraban do frankaa na odzii kan tui dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tsetsee: na Aminadab ne babanyin Nahson na ɔhwɛɛ no dɔm no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Zuar ne babanyin Netanel na ɔhwɛɛ Isakarmba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Helon ne babanyin Eliab na ɔhwɛɛ Zebulunmba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔpaa ntamadan no; na Gerson ne mbabanyin nye Merari ne mbabanyin a wɔsoasoaa ntamadan no tui.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Reuben nseraban do frankaa tui dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tsetsee: na Sedeur ne babanyin Elizur na ɔhwɛɛ no dɔm no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Zurisadai ne babanyin Selumiel na ɔhwɛɛ Simeonmba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Deutel ne babanyin Eliasaf na ɔhwɛɛ Gadmba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Kohatfo no soasoaa ahotseweebea no dze tui: na binom so sii ntamadan no dze kodur dɛ wɔbae.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Efraimmba nseraban do frankaa tui dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tsetsee: na Ammihud ne babanyin Elisama na ɔhwɛɛ no dɔm no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Pedazur ne babanyin Gamaliel na ɔhwɛɛ Manaasɛmba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Gideoni ne babanyin Abidan na ɔhwɛɛ Benjaminmba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Danmba nseraban do frankaa a ɔyɛ nseraban nseraban nyinara ne nkyidɔm no, tui dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tsetsee: na Ammisaddai ne babanyin Ahiezer na ɔhwɛɛ no dɔm no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Okran ne babanyin Pagiel na ɔhwɛɛ Asermba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Enan ne babanyin Ahira na ɔhwɛɛ Naftalimba ebusuakuw dɔm no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Israelmba akwantu a wotui dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm no tsetsee no nye yi; na wotui.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see Hobab, a ɔyɛ n’asew Midiannyi Reuel ne babanyin no, dɛ, Yerutu akɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE kasaa ho dɛ, Medze mebɛma hom no: bra ma yɛnkɔ, na yɛbɛyɛ wo yie: na EWURADZE aka Israel ho asɛm pa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Moronnkɔ; mbom mobɔkɔ mankasa m’asaase do, nye m’ebusua mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Mepa wo kyɛw, mma nngya hɛn; susuampa dɛ ɔwo inyim mbrɛ yebesi akyer nsera wɔ sar no do ntsi, ɔwo yɛ enyiwa fa ma hɛn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ ɔwo nye hɛn kɔ a, ampa, ɔbɛba dɛ papa kor a EWURADZE dze bɛyɛ hɛn no, ɔnoara na yɛdze bɛyɛ wo.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotutui fii EWURADZE bepɔw no ho tuu ndaansa kwan; na EWURADZE ahyɛmudaka no tui dzii hɔn enyim kɔr ndaansa kwan, dɛ ɔrokɔhwehwɛ ahomgyebea ama hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ wotu fi nseraban no mu a, nna EWURADZE mununkum no wɔ hɔn do adzekyee.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ adaka no rutu a, Moses ka dɛ, EWURADZE, soɛr ɛ, na ma w’atamfo mbɔ mpetse; na ma hɔn a wokyir wo nguan w’enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ ɔsoɛ a, ɔka dɛ, EWURADZE, san bra Israel mpempem no nkyɛn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔman no tse dɛ ehwinhwimfo a wɔkasa bɔn wɔ EWURADZE asomu: na EWURADZE tsee no, n’ebufuw dzɛwee; na EWURADZE ogya hyewee wɔ hɔn mu, na ɔmeen nseraban no ano noho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔman no sui tɔɔ Moses do; na Moses paa EWURADZE kyɛw, na ogya no dumii.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔfrɛɛ bea no dzin dɛ Tabera: osiandɛ EWURADZE ogya hyewee wɔ hɔn mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na aforafora nyimpa dodow a wɔwɔ hɔn mu no hɔn kɔn dɔɔ adze: Na Israelmba no so suu bio, na wɔsee dɛ, Woana na ɔbɛma hɛn nam ma yeedzi?
title: NUMBERS

text: Yɛkaakaa esunam a yedzii no wɔ Egypt no kwa; efer, nye anamuna, nye fan, nye anwew, nye galik no:
title: NUMBERS

text: afei dze hɛn kra etwintwam; biribi biribiara nnyi hɔ: yennyi hwee gyedɛ manna yi ara na yɛahwɛ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na manna no tse dɛ korianda aba, na no ho tse dɛ bedula hyɛ ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Ɔman no kekyinii, na wɔtasetasee, na wɔnyaam no wɔ nwuyambo do, anaa wosiiw no nwɔdur mu, na wɔnoaa no wɔ asɛn mu, na wɔyɛɛ no tatar: na ne dɛw tse dɛ ngo momon ne dɛw.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ ɔbɔsu tɔ gu nseraban no do anadwe a, manna no so tɔ gu do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses tsee dɛ ɔman no worususu wɔ hɔn ebusua ebusua mu: nyimpa biara ɔwɔ no buw abowano: na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛɛw kɛsenara; na ɔyɛɛ Moses ahomtsew.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see EWURADZE dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔwo nye w’akowaa edzi no bɔn? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mennya w’enyim enyimnyam, dɛ edze ɔman yi nyinara adzesoa ato mo do yi?
title: NUMBERS

text: Ana emi na minyinseen ɔman yi nyinara? Emi na mowoo hɔn, na esee me dɛ Tur hɔn wɔ wo koko do, dɛ mbrɛ egya bagyegyefo tur enumfoanoba, fa kɔ asaase a ekaa ho ntam maa hɔn egyanom no do?
title: NUMBERS

text: Henfa na minya nam mema ɔman yi nyinara? Osiandɛ wosu gu mo do, dɛ, Ma hɛn nam, ma yendzi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Mo nko murunntum nnkora ɔman yi nyinara, osiandɛ ɔyɛ dur dodow ma me.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ dɛm na enye me bedzi no a, mepa wo kyɛw, sɛ menya w’enyim enyimnyam a, ɔnodze oku mbom na ku me; na mma munnhu m’awerɛhow.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Boa Israel mpanyimfo mu eduosuon ano ma me hɔn a inyim dɛ wɔyɛ ɔman no mpanyimfo, nye hɔn do asafohemfo; na fa hɔn bra ehyiadzibuw no ho, ma wɔnye wo ngyina hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mibesian na menye wo abɛkasa wɔ hɔ: na mebɛfa sunsum a ɔwɔ wo do no bi, na medze egu hɔn do; na wɔnye wo aasoa ɔman no adzesoa no, amma woara nko aannsoa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na se ɔman no dɛ, Hom ntsew homho nsie ɔkyena, na hom bedzi nam: osiandɛ hom ekosu egu EWURADZE asomu dɛ, Woana na ɔbɛma hɛn nam ma yeedzi? Oye ma hɛn wɔ Egypt mbom: dɛm ntsi EWURADZE bɛma hom nam, na hom eedzi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nnyɛ da kor na hom bedzi, anaa nda ebien anaa nda enum, nnyɛ dadu, anaa adaduonu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Mbom bosoom ara mu, ekodu dɛ obefifir hom ahwentokura mu, na ayɛ hom mfon: osiandɛ hom apow EWURADZE a ɔwɔ hom mu no, na hom esu wɔ n’enyim aka dɛ, Ebɛn ntsi na yefii Egypt bae?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Ɔman a mowɔ hɔn mu yi yɛ anamɔnmufo mpemahaesia; na ɔwo ese dɛ, Mebɛma hɔn nam ma woeedzi no bosoom ara mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Aso wobokuku nguan nye anantwi ama hɔn ma aaso hɔn? Anaa wɔbɔboaboa po mu nam nyinara ano ama hɔn, ma aaso hɔn?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Ana woetwa EWURADZE nsa do a? Afei na ibohu kyerɛ dɛ m’asɛm bɛba mu ama wo, anaa ɔnnkɛba mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses fiir edzi, na ɔkɛkaa EWURADZE n’asɛm no kyerɛɛ ɔman no: na ɔboaa ɔman mpanyimfo no mu mbanyin eduosuon ano, na ɔdze hɔn begyinaa Buw no ho hyiae.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE sianee wɔ mununkum no mu, na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no, na ɔfaa sunsum a ɔwɔ no do no bi, na ɔdze guu mpanyimfo eduosuon no do: na ɔbaa dɛ, sunsum no baa hɔn do no, wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm, naaso wɔannyɛ dɛm bio.
title: NUMBERS

text: Mbom ɔkaa mbanyin beenu wɔ nseraban no mu, ɔbaako ne dzin nye Eldad, na kor no so ne dzin dze Medad: na sunsum no baa hɔn do; na wɔfora hɔn a wɔkyerɛɛw hɔn no mu dze, na wonnyae nnkɔr Buw no ho: na wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm wɔ nseraban no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na aberantsɛ bi tutuu mbirika kɛkaa kyerɛɛ Moses, na ɔsee dɛ, Eldad nye Medad rehyɛ nkɔm wɔ nseraban no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Nun ne babanyin Josua, Moses no somfo no, ɔyɛ ne mbanyin mpamufo mu kor no, buae see dɛ, Mo wura Moses, bra hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see no dɛ, Ana emi ntsi erotwe nyinkun a? Ɔka mo nko a nkyɛ Nyankopɔn aama EWURADZE ne man nyinara ayɛ nkɔnhyɛfo, ma EWURADZE dze no sunsum eegu hɔn do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses sanee baa nseraban no mu, ɔno nye Israel mpanyimfo no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mframa fi EWURADZE nkyɛn bɔe, na ɔdze Nkokɔhwerew fi po no ho boguu nseraban no ho, bɛyɛ da kor akwantu wɔ afa ha, nye da kor akwantu wɔ afa ha so, dze hyiaa nseraban no ho, na hɔn krɔn bɛyɛ basafa kor wɔ asaase enyi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔman no soɛɛr adzekyee no nyinara, nye anadwe no nyinara, na wɔkɔboaboaa Nkokɔhwerew no ano: nyia ɔboaa kumaabi ano mpo, onyaa homer du: na wɔhatahatae araa dze twaa nseraban no ho hyiae maa hɔnho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Aber a nam no da ho wowɔ hɔn se mu a wonnyae nnkosae no, EWURADZE ebufuw fraam ɔman no do, na EWURADZE dze ɔyardɔm kɛsenara bobɔɔ ɔman no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔfrɛɛ bea no dzin dɛ Kibrot-hataava, osiandɛ hɔ na wosiee ɔman a hɔn kɔn dɔɔ adze no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔman no tui fii Kibrot-hataava kɔr Hazerot; na wɔtsenaa Hazerot.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Miriam nye Aaron kasaa tsiaa Moses wɔ Kusnyi ɔbaa bi a ɔawar no no ntsi: osiandɛ nna ɔawar Kusnyi ɔbaa bi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Ana ampaara dɛ Moses nko na EWURADZE nye no akasa? Ana ɔnnye hɛn so nnkasae? Na EWURADZE tsee.
title: NUMBERS

text: Afei ɔbarimba Moses dze nna ɔdwe dodoodow, ɔbor nyimpa a wɔwɔ asaase do nyinara do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa awerɛfir mu kyerɛɛ Moses, nye Aaron, nye Miriam dɛ, Hom baasa hom mfir edzi mbra ehyiadzibuw no ho. Na hɔn baasa no fiir edzi bae.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE sianee wɔ mununkum dum mu, na obegyinaa Buw no n’abowano, na ɔfrɛɛ Aaron nye Miriam: na hɔn beenu no fiir edzi bae.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Afei hom ntsie me nsɛm: sɛ nkɔnhyɛfo bi wɔ hom mu a, emi EWURADZE mibeyi moho akyerɛ no wɔ enyido adzehu mu, adaaso mu na menye no bɛkasa.
title: NUMBERS

text: M’akowaa Moses nntse dɛm; ɔno na medze me fie nyinara ahyɛ ne nsa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Ano nye ano na menye no rekasa, mekyerɛ petee mu a, na nnyɛ abɛbu mu a; na ɔbɔhwɛ EWURADZE no su: na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ennsuro dɛ hom bɛkasa etsia m’akowaa Moses?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE ebufuw fraam hɔn do; na ofii hɔ kɔree.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mununkum no twee fii Buw no do; na, hwɛ, Miriam ayar kwata, ɔhoa dɛ esukwankyɛba: na Aaron hwɛɛ Miriam no, hwɛ, nna ɔayar kwata.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Aaron see Moses dɛ, Ao mo wura, mepa wo kyɛw, mma mmfa bɔn nnto hɛn do, na yɛayɛ nkwaseadze, na ɔno ho yɛayɛ bɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Me kyɛw ara nye yi, mma ɔnnyɛ dɛ obi a oewu fi ne na yamu aba a woedzi no honam fa dada.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses sui frɛɛ EWURADZE dɛ, Ao Nyankopɔn, meserɛ wo, sa no yarba.
title: NUMBERS
