text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Sɛ n’egya hina n’enyi do ntafi a, ana nkyɛ n’enyi nnwu nda esuon bi a? Ma wɔntow no mu nda esuon wɔ nseraban no ekyir, na n’ekyir no na wɔmfa no mbra mu bio.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔtoow Miriam mu wɔ nseraban no ekyir nda esuon: na ɔman no enntu araa kodur dɛ wɔfaa Miriam baa mu bio.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na n’ekyir no na ɔman no tui fii Hazerot, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Paran sar do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Soma mbanyin ma wɔnkɛsera Keenan asaase a medze rema Israelmba no: hɔn egyanom ebusuakuw biara mu no hom nsoma mu banyin kor, na hɔn nyina nyɛ hɔn mu mbapɔmba no bi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses somaa hɔn fi Paran sar do dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE mbrasɛm tse: hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ mbanyin a wɔyɛ Israelmba mu etsitsir.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔn edzin nye yi: Reuben ebusuakuw dze, Zakur ne babanyin Sammua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Simeon ebusuakuw dze, Hori ne babanyin Safat.
title: NUMBERS

text: Juda ebusuakuw dze, Jefune ne babanyin Kaleb.
title: NUMBERS

text: Isakar ebusuakuw dze, Josef ne babanyin Igal.
title: NUMBERS

text: Efraim ebusuakuw dze, Nun ne babanyin Hosea.
title: NUMBERS

text: Benjamin ebusuakuw dze, Rafu ne babanyin Palti.
title: NUMBERS

text: Zebulun ebusuakuw dze, Sodi ne babanyin Gaddiel.
title: NUMBERS

text: Josef ebusuakuw dze, mekyerɛ Manaasɛ ebusuakuw dze, Susi ne babanyin Gaddi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dan ebusuakuw dze, Gemali ne babanyin Ammiel.
title: NUMBERS

text: Aser ebusuakuw dze, Maekɛl ne babanyin Setur.
title: NUMBERS

text: Naftali ebusuakuw dze, Vofsi ne babanyin Nahibi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Gad ebusuakuw dze, Maki ne babanyin Geuel.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye mbanyin a Moses somaa hɔn dɛ wɔnkɛsera asaase no hɔn edzin. Na Moses frɛɛ Nun ne babanyin Hosea no dɛ Josua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses somaa hɔn dɛ wɔnkɛsera Keenan asaase no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa pomu afamu ɔkwan yi do, na hom nkɔfow mbepɔw no:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔnhwɛ asaase no, mbrɛ ɔtse; nye ɔman a wɔtse do no, kyerɛ dɛ wɔyɛ dzen anaa wɔyɛ mberɛw, dɛ wosuar anaa wɔdɔɔ so;
title: NUMBERS

text: nye mbrɛ asaase a wɔtse do no tse, dɛ oye anaa omuo; na mbrɛ nkurow a wɔtsetse mu no tsetsee, dɛ wɔtsetse nseraban mu, anaa akoban mu;
title: NUMBERS

text: na mbrɛ asaase no tse, dɛ ɔyɛ sɔɔsɔɔ anaa etwee, dɛ ndua wɔ do anaa ɔnntse dɛm. Na hom nnya akokodur, na wɔmfa asaase no do aba bi mbra. Nna aber no yɛ esikyireamba ababer a odzi kan n’aber.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nna wosii mu kɔree, na wɔkɛseraa asaase no fi Zin sar do kodur Rehob, wɔ mbrɛ wɔnam kɔ Hamat no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔfowee faa Pomu afamu, na wodur Hebron; na hɔ na Anakmba no, Ahiman, Sesai, nye Talmai, wɔwɔ. (Na Hebron yi wɔkyekyeer no mfe esuon ansaana wɔrekyekyer Zoan a ɔwɔ Egypt.)
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wodur Eskol ɔbɔn no mu, na wotwaa abaw a esikyireamba siaw kor wɔ do wɔ hɔ, na beenu wuraa no dua soae; na wɔdze pɔmegranate eduaba, nye adɔmba so bi bae.
title: NUMBERS

text: Wɔfrɛɛ bea no Eskol ɔbɔn no mu, osian siaw no a Israelmba twaa no wɔ hɔ no ntsi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na adaduanan soe no, wɔsanee fii asaase no ne nserae mu bae.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wosii mu na wɔbaa Moses, nye Aaron, nye Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara nkyɛn, wɔ Paran sar do, wɔ Kades; na wɔbɔɔ hɔn amandzɛɛ kyerɛɛ hɔn, nye mboanofo no nyinara, na wɔdze asaase no do aba no kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no, na wɔsee dɛ, Yɛkɔr asaase a esomaa hɛn do no do, na numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do ampa; na no do aba nye yi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Naaso ɔman a wɔtse asaase no do no na wɔyɛ dzen, na nkurow no wɔabɔ ho ban, ɔsoso dodow: na nkyii so yehun Anakmba wɔ hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Amalek tse Pomu afamu asaase no do: na Hitifo, nye Jebusfo, nye Amorifo, tsetse mbepɔw no do: na Keenanfo tse po no ho, nye Jordan nkyɛn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Kaleb dwedwee ɔman no wɔ Moses enyim, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mma yɛnkɔfow nkɔ prɛko, na yɛnkɛfa, na yebotum edzi hɔn do nyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mbanyin a wɔnye no kɔree no dze see dɛ, Yerunntum nnkɔfow nnkɔ nnkɛhyɛ ɔman no do; osiandɛ wɔyɛ dzen sen hɛn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔdze asaase a wɔkɛserae no ho atsenka bɔn brɛɛ Israelmba no dɛ, Asaase a yɛakɛfa mu akɛsera no, ɔyɛ asaase a odzi no do atsefo no; na nkorɔfo a yehun hɔn wɔ do no nyinara wɔyɛ nyimpa a wɔyɛ akraban.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔ na yehun abran akɛse no, Anak ne mbabanyin no a wofi Nefilfo mu no: na yɛyɛɛ dɛ mbɛbɛw wɔ hɛnankasa hɛn enyi do, na dɛmara na yɛyɛe wɔ hɔn enyi do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mboanofo no nyinara memaa hɔn ndze do, na wɔkekaa mu; na ɔman no suu anadwe no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba no nyinara hwinhwiin Moses nye Aaron ho: na mboanofo no nyinara see hɔn dɛ, Ka hɛn nko a nkyɛ Nyankopɔn maa yewuwui wɔ Egypt asaase do! Anaa sar yi do ha ara mpo, ka hɛn nko a nkyɛ Nyankopɔn maa yewuwui!
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ebɛn ntsi na EWURADZE dze hɛn reba asaase yi do, dɛ yɛmbɔtotɔr nkrantsee ano? Hɛn yernom nye hɛn mbofraba bɛyɛ afonam: ana onnye mma hɛn dɛ yɛbɛsan akɔ Egypt bi a?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Wɔmma yɛnhyɛ ɔpanyin, na yɛnsan nkɔ Egypt.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nna Moses nye Aaron dze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu wɔ Israelmba mboanofo bagua no nyinara enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Nun ne babanyin Josua nye Jefune ne babanyin Kaleb a wofi hɔn a wɔkɛseraa asaase no mu no, sunsuaan hɔn ntar mu:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔkasaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara dɛ, Asaase a yetwaa mu kɔree kɛserae no, ɔyɛ asaase pa mbordo.
title: NUMBERS

text: Sɛ yɛsɔ EWURADZE enyi a, ɔno ɔdze hɛn bodu asaase no do, na ɔdze ama hɛn; asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem do.
title: NUMBERS

text: EWURADZE do etua ara nko na mma hom nntsew, nkyii so mma hom nnsuro asaase no do nkorɔfo no; na wɔyɛ edziban ma hɛn: hɔn akataman efi hɔn do, na hɛn dze EWURADZE nye hɛn wɔ hɔ: mma wonnsuro hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mboanofo no nyinara kaa dɛ wonsiw Josua na Kaleb abo. Na EWURADZE enyimnyam puee ehyiadzibuw no mu kyerɛɛ Israelmba no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Ɔman yi rubu me enyimtsia ekodu dabɛn? Na dabɛn na wɔrenngye me nndzi, wɔ nsɛnkyerɛdze a mayɛ wɔ hɔn mu nyinara mu no ekodu?
title: NUMBERS

text: Medze owuyarba mobɔbɔ hɔn, na masɛɛ hɔn, na medze wo mayɛ ɔman kɛse a ɔwɔ dzin sen hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Ɔno Egyptfo bɛtse; na ɔwo dze wo tum na edze eyi ɔman yi efi hɔn mu;
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔbɛka akyerɛ asaase yi do atsefo: wɔatse dɛ ɔwo EWURADZE ewɔ ɔman yi mu; na ɔwo EWURADZE wohu wo enyim nye enyim, na wo mununkum gyina hɔn do, na ɔwo na idzi hɔn enyim, wɔ mununkum dum mu adzekyee, nye ogya dum mu adzesaa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Afei sɛ iku ɔman yi dɛ nyimpa kor a, ɔno amanaman a wɔatse wo nka no bɛka dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Osiandɛ EWURADZE enntum dɛ ɔdze ɔman yi kɔ asaase a ɔkaa hɔn ho ntam no do no, ntsi na oeku hɔn wɔ sar no do no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na afei, mepa wo kyɛw, ma EWURADZE no tum nyɛ kɛse, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo aka dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: EWURADZE fa ebufuw nyaa, na n’adɔyɛ so, ɔdze emumuyɛ nye mbrato kyɛ, na bem bi na onnkobu ɔfɔdzinyi no; ɔdze egyanom hɔn emumuyɛ hwɛ mba, kodu ebusuasantsen ebiasa nye anan do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Mepa wo kyɛw, fa ɔman yi hɔn emumuyɛ fir hɔn dɛ mbrɛ w’adɔyɛ ne kɛse tse, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo dze efir ɔman yi, efi Egypt araa ebodu sesei.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Medze akyɛ dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse no:
title: NUMBERS

text: mbom nokwar ara, dɛ metse ase, na dɛ EWURADZE enyimnyam bɛhyɛ asaase nyinara ma yi;
title: NUMBERS

text: osiandɛ nyimpa nyina a woehu m’enyimnyam, nye me nsɛnkyerɛdze a meyɛe wɔ Egypt nye sar no do no, naaso wɔasɔ me ahwɛ mpɛn du nye yi, na woenntsie me ndze no;
title: NUMBERS

text: ampaara wonnkohu asaase a mekaa ho ntam mekyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom no, nkyii so hɔn mu biara a obu me enyimtsia no runnhu:
title: NUMBERS

text: na m’akowaa Kaleb dze, osiandɛ ɔwɔ sunsum bi so wɔ no mu, na oedzi m’ekyir koraa no ntsi, medze no mubodu asaase a ɔkɔr do no do; na n’asefo afa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Afei Amalekfo nye Keenanfo tse ɔbɔn no mu: ɔkyena hom ndan, na hom ntu nkɔ sar no do wɔ Mbɛw Po kwan do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Dabɛn na memma mboanofo bɔn yi a wohwinhwin tsia me yi kwan ma onkodu? Israelmba hɔn ehwinhwin a wohwinhwin tsia me no matse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Se hɔn dɛ, Metse ase yi, EWURADZE na ɔse, ampaara dɛ mbrɛ hom akasa wɔ m’asomu no, dɛmara so na mebɛyɛ hom:
title: NUMBERS

text: sar yi do ara na hom efun bɛdeda; nye hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ hom mu no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ hom dodow nyina tse, ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu nye ekyir do no a woehwinhwin etsia me no,
title: NUMBERS

text: ampaara hom runndu asaase a memaa me nsa do mekyerɛɛ dɛ mebɛma hom atsena do no do, gyedɛ Jefune ne babanyin Kaleb, nye Nun ne babanyin Josua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Mbom hom mbofraba a hom see dɛ wɔbɛyɛ afonam no, hɔn na medze hɔn bɔkɔ do, na wobohu asaase a hom apow no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hom dze, sar yi do ara na hom efun bɛdeda.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hom mba ayɛ aworamafo wɔ sar no do mfe eduanan, na wɔasoa hom ndwamanyɛ, ekodu dɛ hom efun bɛsa wɔ sar no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nda a hom dze kɛseraa asaase no, no dodow mbrɛ ɔtse no, mekyerɛ adaduanan na da kor nye afe kor, nna hom nsoa hom emumuyɛ, mekyerɛ mfe eduanan, na hom ehu mbrɛ me pa tse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Emi EWURADZE na maka, ampaara iyi na medze bɛyɛ mboanofo bɔn yi nyinara a woedzi ehyia etsia me yi: sar yi do ara na wɔbɛsa, na hɔ na wobowuwu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mbanyin no a Moses somaa hɔn ma wɔkɛseraa asaase no a wɔsanee bae, na wɔmaa mboanofo no nyinara hwinhwinii tsiaa me no, dɛ wɔdze asaase no ho atsenka bɔn bae no,
title: NUMBERS

text: mekyerɛ mbanyin no a wɔdze asaase no ho atsenka bɔn bae no, wowuu owuyar wu wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Mbom Nun ne babanyin Josua, nye Jefune ne babanyin Kaleb, na wonyaa nkwa wɔ mbanyin a wɔkɔree kɛseraa asaase no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses kaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Israelmba no nyinara: na ɔman no gyaam kɛsenara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔsoɛɛr ahanamakye, na wɔfowee kɔr bepɔw no etsifi, dɛ, Hwɛ hɛn nye yi, yɛbɔfow akɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE abɔ ho anohoba no: na yɛayɛ bɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na afei hom to EWURADZE mbrasɛm yi, na iyi dze ɔrennyɛ yie?
title: NUMBERS

text: Mma hom mmfow nnkɔ, na EWURADZE nnyi hom mu; mma hom aanntotɔr wɔ hom atamfo enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Amalekfo nye Keenanfo wɔ hom enyim hɔ, na hom bɔtotɔr wɔ nkrantsee ano: osiandɛ hom asan efi EWURADZE ekyir ntsi EWURADZE so rinndzi hom ekyir.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotsitsii hɔn enyiwa ho ara dɛ wɔrofow akɔ bepɔw no etsifi: naaso EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka na Moses dze, woemmfi nseraban no mu emmfi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nna Amalekfo, nye Keenanfo a wɔtse bepɔw no do no sianee bae bokunkum hɔn na wɔbɔɔ hɔn petsee araa kodur Horma.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom du hom tsenabew asaase a medze rema hom no do,
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔrobɔ ogya afɔr ama EWURADZE, ɔhyew afɔr, anaa okum afɔr, dze ahyɛ anohoba bi ma, anaa dɛ ayamuyi afɔr, anaa hom afahyɛ a wɔahyɛ no mu, dze eyi nka huanhuam ama EWURADZE a ofi anantwi, anaa nguan mu a:
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔno nyia ɔdze n’ayɛyɛdze ba no, ɔmfa edziban afɔr isiam pa efa ebupɛn du mu kor nka ngo hin ebupɛn anan mu kor ho mbrɛ EWURADZE:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔnom afɔr wenyin, hin ebupɛn anan mu kor, na fa ka ɔhyew afɔr, anaa okum afɔr eguambaa kor ho siesie.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na oguannyin dze, fa isiam pa efa ebupɛn du mu ebien a wɔdze ngo hin ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor afrɔw, siesie yɛ edziban afɔr:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔnom afɔr no fa wenyin hin ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor bra, ma onyi nka huanhuam mma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ ɔnantwisaa na irisiesie abɔ ɔhyew afɔr, anaa okum afɔr, dze ahyɛ anohoba bi ma, anaa edze robɔbɔ asomdwee afɔr ama EWURADZE a:
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔno edziban afɔr a ɔmfa nka ɔnantwisaa no ho nye isiam pa efa ebupɛn du mu ebiasa a wɔdze ngo hin ɔfa afrɔw.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na fa wenyin hin ɔfa yɛ ɔnom afɔr no bra bɔbɔ ogya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm na wɔnyɛ ɔnantwisaa kor, anaa oguannyin kor, anaa nguambaanyin no, anaa mpɔnkyemba no nkorkor.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ dodow a hom besiesie no tse no, dɛmara na hom nyɛ no nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Ekuromfo nyinara nyɛ ndzɛmba yi dɛm mfa mbɔ ogya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ ɔhɔho bi soɛ hom mu, anaa obiara a ɔwɔ hom mu wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyina mu no, na ɔbɔbɔ ogya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ama EWURADZE no; dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ no, dɛmara so na ɔnyɛ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Bagua no, ahyɛdze kor na ɔnda hɔ mma hom na ɔhɔho a ɔbɔsoɛ hom mu no, ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyina mu: dɛ mbrɛ hom tse no, dɛmara so na ɔhɔho no nyɛ wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Mbra kor nye ɔmom kor na ɔnda hɔ mma hom, nye ɔhɔho a ɔabɔsoɛ hom mu nyina.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom du asaase a medze hom rokɔ do no do a,
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔno ɔba dɛ, sɛ hom ridzi asaase no do edziban no bi a, hom mbɔ ohim afɔr mma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom mbɔrkan no bi ne tatar na hom mfa nyɛ ohim afɔr: dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ ewuporoweebea ohim afɔr no, dɛmara so na hom nhim no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom mbɔrkan no bi na hom mfa mma EWURADZE dɛ ohim afɔr wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyina mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ hom fom, na hom annhyɛ mbransɛm yi a EWURADZE aka akyerɛ Moses no nyinara nsew,
title: NUMBERS

text: mekyerɛ dza EWURADZE nam Moses nsa do ahyɛ hom nyinara, ofi da a EWURADZE hyɛɛ mbra no, na ɔdze ba yi wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyina mu no a;
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔno ɔba dɛ, sɛ wɔyɛ no ntɔgon mu, dɛ mboanofo no nnyim a, mboanofo no nyinara mfa ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor mbɔ ɔhyew afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma EWURADZE, nka n’edziban afɔr, nye no nom afɔr no ho dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse, nye apɔnkyenyin kor na ɔnyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma Israelmba mboanofo no nyina, na wɔdze bɛkyɛ hɔn; na ɔyɛ mfom, na hɔn mfom no ntsi, wɔdze hɔn ayɛyɛdze aba dɛ EWURADZE ogya afɔr, nye hɔn bɔn ho afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔdze befir Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara, nye ɔhɔho a ɔabɔsoɛ hɔn mu no; na ɔman no nyinara afamu na wɔyɛɛ no ntɔgon mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa kor bi annhyɛ da na ɔyɛ bɔn a, ɔno ɔmfa apɔnkyeber a oedzi afrenhyia mbra mbɔbɔ bɔn ho afɔr.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no mpata mma ɔkra a ɔfom no, sɛ ɔyɛ bɔn no ber a ɔnndze enyidaho wɔ EWURADZE enyim a, ɔmpata mma no; na wɔdze bɛkyɛ no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom nnya mbra kor nto hɔ mma nyia ɔyɛ biribi a ɔnndze enyidaho dɛ ɔyɛ okuromnyi wɔ Israelmba mu, anaa ɔhɔho a ɔbɔsoɛ hom mu no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Ɔkra a ɔhyɛ da ara yɛ bɔn no dze, sɛ ɔyɛ okuromnyi bi o, ɔhɔho bi o, oedzi etsia EWURADZE; na dɛm ɔkra no wobotwa no efi ne man mu akyen.
title: NUMBERS

text: Osiandɛ oebu EWURADZE n’asɛm enyimtsia, na ɔato ne mbra no; otwa ara na wobotwa ɔkra no akyen, n’emumuyɛ nda no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na aber a Israelmba wɔwɔ sar no do no, wohun ɔbanyin bi a ɔrepɛ nyena ahomgyeda.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔn a wohun no dɛ ɔrepɛ nyena no wɔdze no brɛɛ Moses nye Aaron, nye mboanofo no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔbɔɔ no dua mu, osiandɛ wonnyae nnkyerɛɛ dza wɔmfa nyɛ no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Oku na wonku banyin no: mboanofo no nyinara nsiw no abo wɔ nseraban no ekyir.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mboanofo no nyinara dze no baa nseraban no ekyir na wosiiw no abo ma owui; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na hyɛ hɔn ma wɔnyɛ hɔn ntar ano ndwow wɔ hɔn ebusuasantsen nyina mu, na wɔmfa bibir ahoma nsusuo n’ano n’ano ndwow no mu:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔnyɛ ndwow mma hom, ma hom aahwɛ, na wɔaakaa EWURADZE mbrasɛm nyinara, na wɔaayɛ; na hom eennkekyin enndzi hom akoma nye hom enyiwa ekyir, dza hom tɔ dɛ wodzi ekyir ndwamanyɛ mu no:
title: NUMBERS

text: ama hom aakaa na wɔayɛ me mbransɛm nyinara, na hom ayɛ krɔnkrɔn ama hom Nyankopɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn a miyii hom fii Egypt asaase do dɛ mebɛyɛ hom Nyankopɔn no: emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Afei Kora a n’egya nye Izhar a ɔyɛ Kohat a n’egya nye Levi ne babanyin no na Eliab ne mbabanyin Datan na Abiram na Pelet ne babanyin no (Eliab na Pelet yɛ Reuben ne mbabanyin)
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔsoɛree tsiaa Moses. Wɔnye Israelmba no mu bi, mboanofo no mu mbapɔmba ahaenu eduonum a wɔfrɛ hɔn bagua mu, nyimpa a wɔwɔ dzin:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔpoon hɔnho hyiae bɔɔ Moses nye Aaron do ngua, na wɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom yɛ dodow, na mboanofo nyinara yɛ krɔnkrɔn, hɔn mu obiara, na EWURADZE wɔ hɔn mu: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na hom mema hom ho do wɔ EWURADZE ne baguaa do?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses tsee no, ɔdze n’enyim butuuw famu:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ Kora nye no kuw no nyinara dɛ, Anapa EWURADZE bɛkyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ nedze, nye nyia ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn, na ɔbɛma ɔaba ne nkyɛn: mekyerɛ nyia ɔbɛsan mu eyi no no nna ɔbɛma ɔaba ne nkyɛn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyi na hom nyɛ; hom mfa nduhuam asɛn, Kora nye no kuw nyinara;
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔmfa ogya ngu mu, na wɔmfa eduhuam ngu do wɔ EWURADZE enyim ɔkyena: na ɔbɛba dɛ nyimpa a EWURADZE bɛfa no no, ɔbɛyɛ krɔnkrɔn: hom yɛ dodow, hom Levi mbabanyin.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see Kora dɛ, Afei hom ntsie, hom Levi mbabanyin:
title: NUMBERS

text: ana ɔyɛ hom adze ketseaba, dɛ Israel Nyankopɔn no atsew hom efi Israel mboanofo mu dɛ ɔdze hom rebɛn noho; ma hom aayɛ EWURADZE ntamadan no ho edwuma, na hom egyina mboanofo no enyim asom hɔn;
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔdze nuanom, Levi ne mbabanyin no nyinara ho abɛn, na hom rohwehwɛ asɔfodzi so yi?
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm ntsi na ɔwo nye wo kuw nyinara ehyia wɔ EWURADZE do: na Aaron dze, woana nye no na hom hwinhwin tsia no?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses somae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ Datan nye Abiram, Eliab ne mbabanyin no: na wɔsee dɛ, Yɛremmba:
title: NUMBERS

text: ana ɔyɛ adze ketseaba dɛ eyi hɛn efi asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do do, ruboku hɛn wɔ sar do, na kyenkyennkyen iridzi hɛn do ahenmbasɛm so yi?
title: NUMBERS

text: Nkyii so emmfaa hɛn mmbaa asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no do, na emmfaa haban nye wenyin nture enyadze no so mmaa hɛn; ana mbanyin yi enyiwa na irubotutu? Yɛremmba.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses no bo fuuw kɛsenara, na ɔsee EWURADZE dɛ, Mma w’enyi nnsɔ hɔn afɔrbɔ: menngyee hɔn nsamu asoaso kor, nkyii so mennyɛɛ hɔn mu kor biara bɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see Kora dɛ, Ɔwo nye wo mboanofo no nyinara mbra EWURADZE enyim, ɔwo, nye hɔn, nye Aaron, mbra ɔkyena:
title: NUMBERS

text: na hom mu nyimpa biara mfa n’eduhuamsɛn, na hom mfa eduhuam ngugu mu, na hom mu nyimpa biara mfa n’eduhuamsɛn mbra EWURADZE enyim, nduhuamsɛn ahaenu eduonum; ɔwo so, nye Aaron, obiara mfa n’eduhuamsɛn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔfefae, nyimpa biara nye n’eduhuamsɛn, na wɔdze ogya guguu mu, na wɔnye Moses nye Aaron kegyinagyinaa ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Kora poon mboanofo no nyinara hyiae bɔɔ hɔn do ngua wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano: na EWURADZE enyimnyam yii noho edzi kyerɛɛ mboanofo no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom ntsew homho mfi mboanofo yi mu, ma menhyew hɔn amon mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu, na wɔsee dɛ, Ao Nyankopɔn, honam nyinara hɔn esunsum Nyankopɔn, ana nyimpa kor bɛyɛ bɔn, na wo bo efuw mboanofo no nyinara?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ mboanofo no dɛ, Hom ntwe hom ho do mfi Kora, Datan, nye Abiram ntamadan ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses soɛree na ɔkɔr Datan nye Abiram nkyɛn; na Israel mpanyimfo no dzii n’ekyir kɔree.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, Mepa hom kyɛw, hom ntwe hom ho mfi nyimpa bɔn yi hɔn asesee ho, na mma hom nnka hɔn biribiara, bɛyɛ na hom ahyew wɔ hɔn bɔn nyinara mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nna wɔtwee hɔnho fii Kora, Datan, nye Abiram ntamadan ho wɔ afa nyina: na Datan nye Abiram fiir edzi, na wobegyinagyinaa hɔn asesee abowano, hɔn yernom, nye hɔn mbabanyin, nye hɔn mbɔtoaba so.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see dɛ, Iyi na hom dze bohu dɛ EWURADZE na ɔasoma me dɛ mindzi dwuma yi nyinara; na mommbɔɔ mankasa me tsir mu yɛ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Sɛ nyimpa nyinara wu ara na iyinom bowuwu, anaa sɛ dza ɔto nyimpa nyinara na ɔbɔtɔ hɔn a, ɔnodze na nnyɛ EWURADZE na ɔasoma me.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ adze fofor bi dze na EWURADZE bɛyɛ, na asaase bobue n’ano, na ɔamen hɔn, nye dza odzi wɔ hɔn nyinara, na wɔnam enyikan akɔ samanadze a; ɔnodze hom ntse ase dɛ mbanyin yi ebu EWURADZE enyimtsia.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ owiee nsɛm yi nyinara ka no, asaase a ɔwɔ hɔn ase no paae:
title: NUMBERS

text: na asaase buee n’ano, na ɔmeen hɔn, nye hɔn efifo, nye nyimpa a wodzi wɔ Kora nyinara, nye hɔn adze nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nna hɔn, nye dza odzi wɔ hɔn nyinara, nam enyikan sianee kɔr samanadze: na asaase no seraam hɔn do, na wɔherae wɔ bagua no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelfo a woetwa hɔnho ehyia no nyinara guanee wɔ hɔn nkekamu no ntsi: na wɔsee dɛ, Bɛyɛ na asaase amen hɛn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ogya fii EWURADZE hɔ bae, na ɔbɛhyeew mbanyin ahaenu eduonum a wɔdze eduhuam bae no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar dɛ, ɔntase nduhuam asɛn no mfi ogyahyewee no mu, na fa ogya no petsepetse enyim noho; na ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn:
title: NUMBERS

text: mekyerɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo yi a wɔayɛ hɔnankasa hɔn nkwa ho bɔn nduhuam asɛn no, na ma wɔnyɛ no ɔborntɛrba mfa nyɛ afɔrmbukyia no ho nkataho: osiandɛ wɔdze baa EWURADZE enyim, dɛm ntsi ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn: na ɔnyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze mma Israelmba.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsɔfo Eleazar faa boran nduhuam asɛn no a hɔn a wɔhyewee no dze bae no; na wɔboree dze yɛɛ afɔrmbukyia no ho nkataho:
title: NUMBERS

text: dɛ ɔnyɛ nkaadze mma Israelmba, amma ɔhɔho bi a ommfi Aaron n’asefo mu aammba ho ammbɛhyew eduhuam wɔ EWURADZE enyim; mma ɔaannyɛ dɛ Kora, nye no kuw no: dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE nam Moses do kaa kyerɛɛ no no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na n’adzekyee no Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara hwinhwinii tsiaa Moses nye Aaron dɛ, Hom na hom eku EWURADZE ne man.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a mboanofo no boaboaa hɔn ano tsiaa Moses nye Aaron no, wɔdandaan hɔn enyi wɔ ehyiadzibuw no do: na, hwɛ, mununkum no akata do, na EWURADZE enyimnyam no yii noho edzi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron baa ehyiadzibuw no enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom mma hom ho do mfi mboanofo yi mu, ma menhyew hɔn amon mu. Na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see Aaron dɛ, Fa w’eduhuamsɛn, na sɔ afɔrmbukyia no do ogya gu mu, na fa eduhuam to do, na suo mu nantsew ntsɛmara kɔ mboanofo no nkyɛn, na kɛpata ma hɔn: na ebufuhyew efi EWURADZE hɔ efir; ɔyardɔm no ahyɛ ase.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Aaron fae dɛ mbrɛ Moses kae no, na otuu mbirika kɔr bagua no finimfin; na, hwɛ, ɔyardɔm no ahyɛ ase wɔ ɔman no mu: na ɔdze eduhuam no gui, na ɔpatae maa ɔman no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ogyinaa ewufo nye enyikamfo no ntamu; na wosiankaa ɔyardɔm no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Afei hɔn a wowuwui wɔ ɔyardɔm no mu wɔyɛ mpemduanan nye ahaesuon, ɔsor hɔn a Kora asɛm no ntsi wowuwui no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔyardɔm no siankaa no, Aaron sanee baa Moses nkyɛn wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na gyegye hɔn hɔ mpoma, egyanom ofi kor mu kor, wɔ hɔn mbapɔmba no nyinara hɔ dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, mpoma duebien: kyerɛw nyimpa biara ne dzin wɔ no poma do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na kyerɛw Aaron ne dzin wɔ Levi poma do: na poma kor nyɛ hɔn egyanom efi do tsitsir kor dze.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na gyaa mu gu ehyiadzibuw no mu wɔ Dase no enyim, mbrɛ menye hom hyia no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ banyin a mibeyi no no, no poma bɛfefɛw: na mebɛma mo ho ehwinhwin a Israelmba hwinhwin tsia hom no egyaa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba, na hɔn mbapɔmba no nyinara memaa no mpoma, ɔbapɔmba kor nedze kor, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee no, mekyerɛ mpoma duebien: na Aaron no poma wɔ hɔn mpoma no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses gyaa mpoma no mu guu EWURADZE enyim wɔ Dasebuw no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyee no, Moses kɔr Dasebuw no mu no; na, hwɛ, Aaron no poma no a ɔyɛ Levi ofi dze no afefɛw, ayɛ frɔmfrɔm, na egu nhyiren, na asow almɔnd aba beree.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses dze mpoma no nyinara fi EWURADZE enyim brɛɛ Israelmba no nyinara: na wɔhwɛe, na nyimpa biara faa no poma.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Fa Aaron no poma no san to Dase no enyim, ma wɔmfa nsie nyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze mma mba asoɔdzenfo no; ama eetwa hɔn ehwinhwin a wohwinhwin tsia me no do, amma woeennwuwu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm na Moses yɛe: dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ no no, dɛmara na ɔyɛe.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba no kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, Hwɛ yeruwu, yɛreyera, hɛn nyinara rehera.
title: NUMBERS

text: Obiara a ɔba ho, nyia ɔba EWURADZE ntamadan no ho, owu: ana hɛn nyinara yenwuwu?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Aaron dɛ, Ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin nye w’egyanom fi a wɔka wo ho no nsoa ahotseweebea no ho emumuyɛ: na ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin a wɔka wo ho no nsoa hom asɔfodzi ho emumuyɛ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wo nuanom no so, Levi ebusuakuw no, w’egya n’ebusuakuw no, fa hɔn ka woho bra ho, ma wɔmboa wo wɔ ɔsom no mu: mbom ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin a wɔka wo ho no nsom wɔ dasebuw no enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔnhwɛ w’ahwɛdodze, nye Buw no nyinara ahwɛdodze no: ahotseweebea ndzɛmba ho nye afɔrmbukyia no ho nko ara na mma wɔmmba, amma woeennwuwu, hɔn o, hom o.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔnka wo ho, na wɔnhwɛ ehyiadzibuw no n’ahwɛdodze, dɛ mbrɛ Buw no no ho edwuma nyinara tse: na mma ɔhɔho bi mmba hom nkyɛn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hom nhwɛ ahotseweebea ahwɛdodze no, nye afɔrmbukyia no ahwɛdodze no: amma ebufuhyew bi aammba Israelmba do bio.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mara, hwɛ, mafa wo nuanom Levifo no mefi Israelmba no mu: mama hom dɛ wɔyɛ akyɛdze a wɔdze ama EWURADZE, dɛ wɔnyɛ ehyiadzibuw no ho edwuma.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin a wɔka wo ho no nhwɛ hom asɔfodzi no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no n’adze biara mu, na ntwamutam no mu dze no mu; na hom mfa nsom: medze asɔfodzi no mema hom dɛ akyɛdze dwuma: na ɔhɔho a ɔba ho no wonku no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Aaron dɛ, Hwɛ, emi dze, medze me mado afɔr ahwɛdodze ama wo, mekyerɛ Israelmba adzekrɔnkrɔn nyinara, medze ama ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin no osian ngosera no ntsi, dɛ daa ahyɛdze.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyi na ɔnyɛ wodze wɔ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn a wɔdze esie efi ogya no mu no mu: hɔn ayɛyɛdze biara, mekyerɛ hɔn edziban afɔr biara, nye hɔn bɔn ho afɔr biara, nye hɔn asodzi ho afɔr biara a wɔdze brɛ me no, ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn mma ɔwo nye wo mbabanyin no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dzi no wɔ bea a hɔ yɛ krɔnkrɔn: ɔbanyin biara ndzi bi; ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma wo.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na iyi nyɛ wodze; hɔn ayɛyɛdze mu ɔmado afɔr, mekyerɛ Israelmba hɔn ohim afɔr nyinara; medze ama ɔwo, nye wo mbabanyin, nye wo mbabaa a wɔka wo ho, dɛ daa ahyɛdze: obiara a no ho tsew wɔ wo fi mu no ndzi bi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Ngo mu papa nyinara, nye wenyin nye eburow mu papa nyinara no mu nduadzewakan a wɔdze ma EWURADZE no, ɔwo na medze ama wo.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɔn asaase do nduadzewa nyinara mu edziban beree a wɔdze brɛ EWURADZE no, ɔnyɛ wodze; obiara a no ho tsew wɔ wo fi mu no ndzi bi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Israel mu adze biara a woehyira do ama nyɛ wodze.
title: NUMBERS

text: Adze biara a obue ɔyafun, wɔ honam a wɔdze brɛ EWURADZE no nyinara mu, nyimpa nye abowa nyina, nyɛ wodze: naaso ɔpon na pon nyimpa mbakan, nye abowa a hɔn ho nntsew mbakan so pon hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔn a wɔrobɔpon hɔn a woedzi bosoom no, pon hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ w’abotwa tse, sika dwetɛbona enum, dɛ mbrɛ ahotseweebea dwetɛbona a ɔnoara nye gera eduonu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔnantwi abakan, anaa apɔnkye abakan dze, mma mmpon; wɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn: fa hɔn bɔgyaa no petse afɔrmbukyia no do, na hyew hɔn seradze yɛ ogya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔn nam nyɛ wodze, dɛ mbrɛ ohim nyan nye aserɛ nyimfa no yɛ wodze no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn mu ɔmado afɔr nyinara a Israelmba dze brɛ EWURADZE no, medze mama ɔwo, nye wo mbabanyin, nye wo mbabaa a wɔka wo ho no, dɛ daa ahyɛdze: ɔyɛ EWURADZE enyim daa nkyen ahyɛmu dze ma ɔwo nye w’asefo a wɔka wo ho no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Aaron dɛ, Mma nnya egyapadze wɔ hɔn asaase mu, nkyii so mma nnya kyɛfa bi wɔ hɔn mu: emi nye wo kyɛfa nye w’egyapadze wɔ Israelmba mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Levimba no dze, hwɛ, medze Israel mu ebupɛn du du nyinara ama hɔn dɛ egyapadze, ahyɛ hɔn som a wɔsom no ananmu, mekyerɛ ehyiadzibuw no ho ɔsom no a.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔdzekɔr yi mma Israelmba no mmba ehyiadzibuw no ho, bɛyɛ na wɔasoa bɔn, na woewuwu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Levifo no dze wɔnyɛ ehyiadzibuw no ho ɔsom edwuma, na wɔnsoa no ho mbusu: ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyina mu, na Israelmba mu dze worinnya egyapadze.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba ebupɛn du du a wɔdze ma dɛ ɔmado afɔr ma EWURADZE no, medze ama Levifo no dɛ egyapadze: dɛm ntsi na mase hɔn dɛ, Israelmba mu dze worinnya egyapadze no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Afei so kasa kyerɛ Levifo no, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom regyegye Israelmba no hɔ ebupɛn du du no a medze fi hɔn hɔ ama hom dɛ hom egyapadze no a, ɔno hom mfa no mu ebupɛn du du mu ebupɛn du nyɛ no ɔmado afɔr mma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wombu hom ɔmado afɔr mma hom dɛ ewuporoweebea eburow, nye wenyintwer mayɛ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm na hom so mbɔ ɔmado afɔr mma EWURADZE wɔ hom ebupɛn du du a, hom gyegye no wɔ Israelmba hɔ nyinara mu; na hom mfa no mu EWURADZE ɔmado afɔr no mma ɔsɔfo Aaron.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom akyɛdze nyinara mu na hom mfa mu EWURADZE ɔmado afɔr biara mbra, no mu papa nyinara, mekyerɛ no mu adzekrɔnkrɔn no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm ntsi se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom rema no mu papa no do a, ɔno wombu mma Levifo no dɛ ewuporoweebea ndɔree, nye wenyintwer ndɔree.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hom ndzi no beebiara, hom nye hom efifo: na ɔyɛ hom akatua a ɔhyɛ hom ehyiadzibuw ho ɔsom edwuma ananmu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ hom ma no mu papa no do a, hom ronnsoa bɔn bi wɔ ne ntsi: na mma hom nnhura Israelmba adzekrɔnkrɔn ho, mma hom eennwuwu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyi nye mbra ahyɛdze a EWURADZE ahyɛ, dɛ, Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba no, ma wɔmfa ɔnantwiber memen a nkekaa nnyi ho a onndzi dzɛm a kɔndua nnkɔr no do pɛn:
title: NUMBERS

text: na hom mfa no mma ɔsɔfo Eleazar, na ɔmfa no mpue mbra nseraban no ekyir, na obi nku no wɔ n’enyim:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔsɔfo Eleazar mfa ne nsatseaba mfa no bɔgyaa bi, na ɔmpetse no bɔgyaa no bi ngu ehyiadzibuw no enyim afamu mpɛn esuon:
title: NUMBERS

text: na obi nhyew ɔnantwiber no wɔ n’enyim; no nwoma, nye ne nam, nye no bɔgyaa, nye n’egyanan no:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔsɔfo no mfa kyindur dua, nye odwonhataw, nye serdaa, na ɔntow ngu ɔnantwiber a ɔrehyew no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na afei ɔsɔfo no nhor ne ntar, na onguar wɔ nsu mu, na n’ekyir no na ɔmbra nseraban no mu, na ɔsɔfo no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nyia ɔhyew no no nhor ne ntar wɔ nsu mu, na onguar no honam wɔ nsu mu, na no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbanyin bi a no ho tsew nsesaw ɔnantwiber no nso no, na ɔmfa nkogu nseraban no ekyir beebi a ɔtsew, na wɔmfa nsie nyɛ Israelmba mboanofo ahoguar nsu: ɔyɛ bɔn ho afɔr.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nyia ɔsesaw ɔnantwiber no nso no ɔnhor ne ntar, na no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir: na ɔnyɛ Israelmba no, nye ɔhɔho a ɔsoɛ hɔn mu no, daa ahyɛdze.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nyia ɔka nyimpa biara no fun no no ho nntsew araa nda esuon:
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔnoara na ɔmfa iyi nguar noho da a otsia ebiasa no, na da a otsia esuon no na no ho atsew: na sɛ oennguar noho da a otsia ebiasa no, nye da a otsia esuon no a, no ho renntsew.
title: NUMBERS

text: Obiara a ɔka nyimpa biara a oewu no fun no, na onnguar noho no, ogu EWURADZE ntamadan no ho fi; na ɔkra no wobotwa no efi Israel akyen: osiandɛ wɔammpetse ahoguar nsu no enngu no do ntsi no ho nntsew; n’ahoɔfi da ho wɔ no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Sɛ nyimpa wu asese mu a no ho mbra nye yi: obiara a ɔba asese no mu, na obiara a ɔwɔ asese no mu no, no ho nntsew araa nda esuon.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na kɔɔpow biara a n’ano da hɔ a onnyi ebuado wɔ do no, no ho nntsew.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na obiara a ɔka obi a ɔatɔr nkrantsee ano, anaa fun bi, anaa nyimpa biew bi, anaa nda bi wɔ haban mu no, no ho nntsew araa nda esuon.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nyia no ho nntsew no wɔmfa bɔn ho afɔr nhyewee no no nso no bi, na wɔmfa mbasu ngu do wɔ kɔɔpow mu mma no:
title: NUMBERS

text: na nyimpa a no ho tsew bi mfa odwonhataw, na ɔmfa mbɔ nsu no mu, na ɔmfa mpetse asese no, nye ndzɛmba no nyinara, nye nyimpa a wɔwɔ hɔ no, nye nyia ɔka biew, anaa ɔtɔfo, anaa fun, anaa nda bi no do:
title: NUMBERS

text: na nyimpa a no ho tsew no mfa mpetse nyia no ho nntsew no do da a otsia ebiasa no, nye da a otsia esuon no: na da a otsia esuon no onguar no; na ɔnhor ne ntar, na onguar wɔ nsu mu, na no ho ntsew ewimbir no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nyimpa a no ho nntsew, na oennguar noho no, ɔkra no wobotwa no efi bagua no mu, osiandɛ oegu EWURADZE krɔnkrɔn bea ho fi: wɔmmpetsee ahoguar nsu no wɔ no do; no ho nntsew.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔnyɛ daa ahyɛdze mma hɔn: na nyia ɔpetse ahoguar nsu no nhor ne ntar; na nyia ɔka ahoguar nsu no no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na adze biara a nyimpa a no ho nntsew no ka no, no ho nntsew; na ɔkra a ɔka no no ho nntsew araa kodu ewimbir.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba no, mekyerɛ mboanofo no nyina, baa Zin sar do wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu: na ɔman no tsenaa Kades; na Miriam wui wɔ hɔ, na wosiee no wɔ hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nna nsu nnyi hɔ mma mboanofo no: na wohyiaa hɔnho hyiae tsiaa Moses nye Aaron.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔman no nye Moses hamee, na wɔkaa dɛ, Ka hɛn nko a nkyɛ ber a hɛn nuanom wuwui wɔ EWURADZE enyim no hɛn so yewuwui!
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ebɛn ntsi na hom dze EWURADZE bagua aba sar yi do, dɛ yembowuwu wɔ ha, hɛn nye hɛn mbowa?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ayɛ ma yeefi Egypt efir, dɛ hom dze hɛn reba bea bɔn yi do yi? Ɔnnyɛ abadua, anaa adɔmba, anaa wenyindua, anaa pɔmegranate eduaba bea: nkyii so nsu mpo a wɔnom bi nnyi hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron fii bagua no enyim kɔr ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano, na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw hɔ: na EWURADZE enyimnyam yii noho edzi kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Fa poma no, na boa mboanofo no ano, ɔwo, nye wo nua Aaron, na hom nkasa nkyerɛ ɔbotan no wɔ hɔn enyim, ma ɔmma no nsu; na yi ɔbotan no mu nsu ma hɔn: ma mboanofo no nye hɔn mbowa nnom.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses faa poma no fii EWURADZE enyim, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyɛɛ no no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses nye Aaron boaboaa bagua no ano wɔ ɔbotan no enyim, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Afei hom ntsie, hom asoɔdzenfo; ana yɛntwe ɔbotan yi mu nsu mma hom?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses maa ne nsa do, na ɔdze no poma no bɔɔ ɔbotan no mpɛn ebien: na nsu fiir edzi baa pii, na mboanofo no nye hɔn mbowa nomee.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses nye Aaron dɛ, Osiandɛ hom anngye me enndzi, ammfa anntsew mo ho wɔ Israelmba enyim mu ntsi, hom remmfa bagua yi nndu asaase a medze ama hɔn no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyi nye Meriba nsu no; osiandɛ Israelmba nye EWURADZE hamee, na ɔtseew noho wɔ hɔn mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses somaa abɔfo fii Kades kɔr Edomhen hɔ dɛ, Mbrɛ wo nua Israel se nye yi, Woara inyim ɔhaw a aba hɛn do nyinara:
title: NUMBERS

text: mbrɛ hɛn egyanom dze sianee kɔr Egypt, na yɛdze tsenaa Egypt mber tsentsen; na Egyptfo yɛɛ hɛn, nye hɛn egyanom bɔn:
title: NUMBERS

text: na yesui frɛɛ EWURADZE a, otsiee hɛn ndze, na ɔsomaa ɔbɔfo, na oyii hɛn fii Egypt no: na, hwɛ yɛwɔ Kades, kurow a ɔwɔ wo ntoaado noho no mu:
title: NUMBERS

text: meserɛ wo, ma yentwa mu mfa w’asaase do: yerunntwa mu mmfa haban anaa wenyin ture mu, nkyii so yɛronnom bura mu nsu bi: yɛbɛfa ɔhen ne tsempɔn do ara akɔ, yɛremman enyimfa anaa abankum, ekodu dɛ yeetwa mu wɔ wo ntoaado.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Edom see no dɛ, Mma mmbɛfa mo mu, bɛyɛ na medze nkrantsee efir edzi ebehyia wo.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba no see no dɛ, Yɛrebɛfa ɔtsempɔn do akɔ: na sɛ hɛn nye hɛn mbowa nom wo nsu bi a, ɔno yebotua kaw: ɔnnyɛ biribiara, ma yɛmfa hɛn anamɔn ara mbotwa mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Mma hom nntwa mu. Na Edom dze nkorɔfo pii, nye nsa a ɔyɛ dzen fiir edzi behyiaa hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm na Edom poow dɛ ɔma Israel kwan wɔ no ntoaado: dɛm ntsi Israel danee fii noho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Kades: na Israelmba no, mekyerɛ mboanofo no nyina, baa bepɔw Hor ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye Aaron wɔ bepɔw Hor ho, wɔ Edom asaase ntoaado dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Ɔnnkɛkyɛr na Aaron akɛka no nkorɔfo ho wɔ nsamankyir: na ɔronnkɔ asaase a medze ama Israelmba no do, osiandɛ hom yɛɛ asoɔdzen wɔ m’asɛm do wɔ Meriba nsu ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Fa Aaron nye ne babanyin Eleazar, na fa hɔn fow bepɔw Hor:
title: NUMBERS

text: na pɔr Aaron ne ntar no, na fa hyɛ ne babanyin Eleazar: na onwu wɔ hɔ nkɛka no nkorɔfo ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛe no: na wɔfoow bepɔw Hor wɔ mboanofo no nyinara enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses pɔɔr Aaron ne ntar no, na ɔdze hyɛɛ ne babanyin Eleazar; na Aaron wui wɔ bepɔw no etsifi hɔ: na Moses nye Eleazar fii bepɔw no do sianee.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na aber a mboanofo no nyinara hun dɛ Aaron ewu no, wosuu Aaron adaduasa, mekyerɛ Israel fi no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Aradhen, Keenannyi no a, ɔtse Pomu afamu no, tsee dɛ wɔreka dɛ Israel nam Atarim ɔkwan do aba no; nna ɔnye Israel bɔkoe, na ɔfaa hɔn mu binom ndɔmmum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelfo bɔɔ EWURADZE anohoba see dɛ, Sɛ ɔwo dze ɔman yi rehyɛ hɛn nsa dze a, nkyɛ yɛbɛsɛɛ hɔn nkurow huntuhuntu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE tsiee Israelfo ndze, na oyii Keenanfo no mae; na wɔsɛɛ hɔn nye hɔn nkurow no huntuhuntu: na wɔtoo bea no dzin Horma.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fi bepɔw Hor ho dze faa Mbɛw Po kwan do, dɛ wɔrobɔ Edom asaase ho aprɔw akɔ: na ahomtsew kaa ɔman no hɔn kra pii wɔ ɔkwan no ntsi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔman no kasaa tsiaa Nyankopɔn, nye Moses, dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom eyi hɛn efi Egypt dɛ yembowuwu wɔ sar do yi? Na edziban bi nnyi hɔ; na nsu bi nnyi hɔ; na edzibanhun yi afon hɛn kra.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE somaa mbowatsena a wɔsɔw wɔ ɔman no mu, na wɔkɔsosɔɔw ɔman no; na Israel mu nkorɔfo pii wuwui.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔman no baa Moses nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, Yɛayɛ bɔn, osiandɛ yɛakasa etsia EWURADZE, nye ɔwo; pa EWURADZE kyɛw, ma ombeyi mbowatsena no mfi hɛn do. Na Moses paa kyɛw maa ɔman no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Yɛ boran abowatsena, na fa si dua do: na ɔbɛba dɛ, obiara a abowatsena asɔw no no, sɛ ɔhwɛ a, obenya nkwa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses yɛɛ boran abowatsena, na ɔdze sii dua no do: na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ abowatsena ka nyimpa bi a, ɔhwɛ boran abowatsena no a, onya nkwa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba no tui, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Obot.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Obot, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Iye-abarim, wɔ sar a ɔwɔ Moab enyim, wɔ wipuei afamu no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɔ na wofi tui, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Zered bɔnsa mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɔ na wofi tui, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Arnon a ɔwɔ sar do a ofi Amorifo ntoaado ba no, n’egya: na esutsen Arnon Moab ntoaado a, ɔda Moab nye Amorifo ntamu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔka no EWURADZE Akodzi nwoma no mu dɛ, Vaheb wɔ Sufa, Nye Arnon mbɔnsa no,
title: NUMBERS

text: Nye mbɔnsa no a ɔtserew no a Ɔkom kɔ Ar tsenabew afamu no, Na ɔtwer Moab ntoaado ho no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔ na wofi tui kɔr Beer, nsubura a EWURADZE kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, Boa ɔman no ano, na mebɛma hɔn nsu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Aber no mu na Israel toow ndwom yi dɛ: Nsubura tue ɛ; hom ngye no do:
title: NUMBERS

text: Nsubura a ahenmba tui no, Ɔman no mu ekunyin no fumfunii, Wɔdze ahempoma, ɔnye hɔn mpoma. Na wofi sar no do tui kɔr Mattana:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wofi Mattana kɔr Nahaliel: na wofi Nahaliel kɔr Bamot:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wofi Bamot kɔr bɔnsa a ɔwɔ Moab haban mu wɔ Pisga etsifi a ɔhwɛ sar yiredede no enyi no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israel somaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Amorifo hen Sihon nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Ma muntwa mu mfa w’asaase do: yɛremman haban mu, anaa wenyin ture mu; yɛronnom nsubura mu nsu bi: yɛrefa ɔhen tsempɔn do akɔ, ekodu dɛ yeetwa mu wɔ wo ntoaado.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Sihon amma Israel kwan ma woeenntwa mu wɔ no ntoaado: na mbom ɔboaa ne man nyinara ano, na ofiir edzi kehyiaa Israel wɔ sar no do, na ɔbaa Jahaz: na ɔnye Israel bɔkoe.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israel dze nkrantsee ano kum no, na ɔfaa n’asaase ofi Arnon do dze kɔ Jabbok do, mekyerɛ okodu Ammonmba ho: osiandɛ Ammonmba ntoaado no ɔyɛ dzen.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israel faa nkurow yi nyinara: na Israel tsenaa Amorifo nkurow no nyinara mu, wɔ Hesbon, nye no ho nkuroba nyinara mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Hesbon yɛ Amorifo hen Sihon kurow, ɔno na ɔnye nkan no Moabhen no ako, na ɔagye ne nsamu n’asaase nyinara kodu Arnon ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm ntsi hɔn a wɔkasa wɔ mbɛbu mu no ka dɛ, Hom mbra Hesbon, Ma wɔnkyekyer na wontsintsim Sihon kurow no:
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ogya bi efi Hesbon, Ogyaframee efi Sihon kurow mu: Ɔamen Moab Ar, Arnon mbea sorɔnsorɔm do ekunyin no
title: NUMBERS

text: Ɔwo Moab, due! Kemos ɔman, ɔwo ayera: Oeyi ne mbabanyin ama dɛ eguamfo, Na ne mbabaa akɔ ndɔmmum mu, Wɔ Amorifo hen Sihon hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Yɛatotow hɔn; Hesbon ayera araa ekodu Dibon, Yɛasɛɛ hɔn araa akɔ Nofa a Ɔdze kodu Medeba.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israel tsenaa Amorifo asaase do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses somae ma wɔkɛseraa Jazer, na wɔfaa no nkuroba no, na wotuu Amorifo a wɔwɔ hɔ no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔdanee na wɔkɔ fowee kɔr Basan ɔkwan do: na Basanhen Ɔge fiir edzi kehyiaa hɔn, ɔno nye ne man nyinara, dɛ wɔrokɔ ko wɔ Edrei.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Mma nnsuro no: na meyi ɔno, nye ne man nyinara, nye n’asaase mahyɛ wo nsa; na yɛ no dɛ mbrɛ eyɛɛ Amorifo hen Sihon a ɔtsenaa Hesbon no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nna wokunkum ɔno, nye ne mbabanyin, nye ne man nyinara, kodur dɛ woenngyaa obi amma no: na wɔfaa n’asaase no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba no tui, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu wɔ Jeriko Jordan egya.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Zipor ne babanyin Balak hun dza Israel ayɛ Amorifo no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moab suroo ɔman no dodow, osiandɛ wɔdɔɔ so: na nketsenketse kitsaa hɔn wɔ Israelmba no ntsi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moab see Midian mpanyimfo dɛ, Afei nyimpadodow yi bɛsɛɛ dza etwa ehyia hɛn ho nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ ɔnantwi we haban mu efuw. Na Zipor ne babanyin Balak nna aber no mu ɔyɛ Moabhen.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsomaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Beor ne babanyin Balaam hɔ, wɔ Petor a ɔwɔ Esutsen no ho wɔ ne man mba asaase do dɛ wonkehyia no, dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔman bi efi Egypt aba: hwɛ, wɔkata asaase enyi, na wogu me tsentsendo:
title: NUMBERS

text: dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, bra bɛpaa ɔman yi ma me; na wɔyɛ dzen dodow ma me: dɛ bi a mibedzi nyim, ma meekuku hɔn, na maapam hɔn mefi asaase no do: na minyim dɛ nyia ɔwo ihyira no no woehyira no, na nyia ɔwo edom no no wɔadom no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moab mpanyin nye Midian mpanyin no sii mu dze ebisa no ho akatua no wɔ hɔn nsamu kɔree; na wɔbaa Balaam hɔ, na wɔbɛkaa Balak ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nsoɛ ha anadwe yi, na mebɛbrɛ hom mbuae, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE bɛka akyerɛ me no: na Moab mbapɔmba no nye Balaam tsenae.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Nyankopɔn baa Balaam nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Mbanyin bɛn na wɔnye wo wɔ hɔ yi?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam see Nyankopɔn dɛ, Zipor ne babanyin Balak, Moabhen no, na ɔasoma ma wɔaba mo hɔ dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Hwɛ, ɔman a woefi Egypt aba no, akata asaase enyi: afei, bra bɛpaa hɔn ma me; dɛ bi a mubotum menye hɔn ako, na mapam hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see Balaam dɛ, Mma nnye hɔn nnkɔ, mma mmpaa ɔman no: na woehyira hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam soɛɛr anapa no, na ɔsee Balak mbapɔmba no dɛ, Hom nkɔ hom asaase do: na EWURADZE mmpen dɛ ɔbɛma me kwan ma menye hom akɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moab mbapɔmba no soɛree, na wɔbaa Balak nkyɛn, na wɔsee dɛ, Balaam ammpen dɛ ɔnye hɛn bɛba.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balak somaa mbapɔmba a wɔdɔɔ so, na hɔn enyim wɔ nyam sen hɔn so bio.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔbaa Balaam nkyɛn, na wɔsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ Zipor babanyin Balak se nye yi, Mepa wo kyɛw, mma biribi nnsiw wo me nkyɛn ba ho kwan:
title: NUMBERS

text: na mebɛhyɛ wo enyimnyam kɛsenara, na biribiara a ebɛse me no mebɛyɛ: dɛm ntsi bra, meserɛ wo, bɛpaa ɔman yi ma me.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam buae na ɔsee Balak no nkowaa no dɛ, Sɛ Balak dze dwetɛ nye sika ne fi ma mpo bɛma me a, murunntum mummbu EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn n’asɛm do, mennkɛyɛ biribi, dɛ osuar anaa ɔyɛ kɛse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Afei dɛm ntsi, mɛserɛ hom, hom so ntsintsim ha anadwe yi, ma munhu dza EWURADZE bɛka akyerɛ me bio.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Nyankopɔn baa Balaam nkyɛn anadwe, na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ mbanyin no ba behyia wo a, Soɛr, nye hɔn nkɔ; mbom dza meka mekyerɛ wo no nko na yɛ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam soɛɛr anapa no, na ɔhyehyɛɛ n’asoasopɔnkɔ, na ɔnye Moab mbapɔmba no kɔree.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Nyankopɔn n’ebufuw dzɛwee dɛ ɔkɔree: na EWURADZE bɔfoe begyinaa ɔkwan no do dɛ ɔyɛfo bi a otsia no. Na ɔnodze ɔtse n’asoaso do reba, na no nkowaa beenu ka no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na asoaso no hun EWURADZE no bɔfoe no dɛ ogyina ɔkwan no mu, ɔatwe ne nkrantsee kitsa ne nsamu: na asoaso no danee fii ɔkwan no mu faa nkyɛn, na ɔkɔr haban mu: na Balaam bɔɔ asoaso no dɛ ɔdze redan no aba ɔkwan mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nna EWURADZE no bɔfoe no kegyinaa wenyin nture ntamu ɔkwan tokur bi mu, ban wɔ afa ha, na ban wɔ afa ha.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na asoaso no hun EWURADZE no bɔfoe no, na ɔdze noho miaa ɔfadum no ho, na ɔdze Balaam n’anan miaa ɔfadum no: na ɔbɔɔ no bio.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no kɔr kan, na okegyinaa beebi a ɔmoa, mbrɛ ɔkwan bi nnyi a wɔdan fa enyimfa anaa abankum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na asoaso no hun EWURADZE no bɔfoe no, na obutuuw famu wɔ Balaam n’ase: na Balaam n’ebufuw dzɛwee, na ɔdze n’abaa bɔɔ asoaso no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE buee asoaso no ano, na ɔsee Balaam dɛ, Ebɛnadze na mayɛ wo, na abɔ me mpɛn ebiasa yi?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam see asoaso no dɛ, Osiandɛ esi me atwetwe: kɛtseankyɛ nkrantsee kitsa me nsamu, nkyɛ sisei meku wo.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na asoaso no see Balaam dɛ, Ana nnyɛ w’asoaso nye me a atsena mo do wo nkwa tsentsen nyinara dze ebodu ndɛ da yi? Ana menya wo dɛm nyɛe pɛn? Na ɔsee dɛ, Oho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nna EWURADZE buee Balaam n’enyiwa, na ohun EWURADZE no bɔfoe no dɛ ogyina ɔkwan no mu, wɔatwe ne nkrantsee kitsa ne nsamu: na ɔbɔɔ ne tsir adze, na ɔdze n’enyim butuuw famu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na abɔ w’asoaso mpɛn ebiasa yi? Hwɛ, emi na mefir edzi abɛyɛ wo ɔyɛfo osiandɛ wo kwan no akyea wɔ m’enyim:
title: NUMBERS

text: na asoaso no hun me, na ɔdanee fii m’enyim mpɛn ebiasa yi: sɛ wɔanndan emmfi m’enyim dze a, nkyɛ wo so sisei meku wo, na magye no nkwa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam see EWURADZE no bɔfoe no dɛ, Mayɛ bɔn; na minnyim dɛ ɔwo na igyinaa ɔkwan no mu tsiaa me: dɛm ntsi afei, sɛ emmpɛ a, mebɛsan m’ekyir bio.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see Balaam dɛ, Nye mbanyin no nkɔ: na mbom asɛm a mebɛka makyerɛ wo no nko na ka. Nna Balaam nye Balak mbapɔmba no kɔree.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na aber a Balak tsee dɛ Balaam reba no, ofiir edzi kehyiaa no wɔ Moab Kurow a ɔda Arnon ntoaado a ɔwɔ ntoaado ano no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balak see Balaam dɛ, Ana nnyɛ enyiberdo ara na mosomaa dɛ wombehyia wo ma bra? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ammba me nkyɛn? Egye dzi dɛ murunntum mennhyɛ wo enyimnyam a?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam see Balak dɛ, Hwɛ, maba wo nkyɛn: ana afei mowɔ tum biara a medze meka asɛm bi? Asɛm a Nyankopɔn dze bɛhyɛ m’anomu no, ɔno na mebɛka.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam nye Balak kɔree, na wɔbaa Kiriat-huzoth.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balak dze anantwi nye nguan bɔɔ okum afɔr, na ɔdze kɛmaa Balaam nye mbapɔmba a wɔnye no wɔ hɔ no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ anapa no, Balak faa Balaam, na ɔdze no fowee kɔr Baal ne mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do, na ofi hɔ hun ɔman no ano.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam see Balak dɛ, Sisi afɔrmbukyia esuon ma me wɔ ha, na siesie anantwisaa esuon nye nguannyin esuon ma me wɔ ha.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balak yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Balaam kae no; na Balak nye Balaam dze ɔnantwisaa kor nye oguannyin kor bobɔɔ afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia biara do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam see Balak dɛ, Gyina wo hyew afɔr no ho, na monkɔ, anyanyanbiara EWURADZE bɛba ebehyia me a: na biribiara a ɔdze bɛkyerɛ me no mebɛka makyerɛ wo. Na osii mu kɔr sorɔnsorɔm pataa bi do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Nyankopɔn behyiaa Balaam: na Balaam see no dɛ, Mesiesie afɔrmbukyia esuon no, na medze ɔnantwisaa nye oguannyin nkorkor abobɔ afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia biara do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE dze asɛm hyɛɛ Balaam anomu, see dɛ, San kɔ Balak nkyɛn, na dza ka nye yi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsanee kɔr ne nkyɛn, na, hwɛ, ogyina ne hyew afɔr no ho, ɔno nye Moab mbapɔmba no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔkasaa no abɛbu mu see dɛ, Aram na Balak kɛfaa me bae, Moabhen no faa me fi Boka mbepɔw no mu dɛ: Bra, bɛpaa Jakob ma me, Na bra, bɛhyɛ Israel enyimguase.
title: NUMBERS

text: Meyɛ dɛn na mepaa nyia Nyame mmpaa no? Na meyɛ dɛn na mehyɛ nyia EWURADZE nnhyɛɛ no enyimguase?
title: NUMBERS

text: Abotan etsifi na mifi muhun no, Na akoko do na mifi megyeen no: Hwɛ, ɔman a no nko bɛtsena a, Na worummbu no mmfora amanaman.
title: NUMBERS

text: Woana botum akan Jakob huntuma, Anaa Israel ebupɛn anan mu kor no dodow? Ma munwu ɔtseneneenyi wu, Na ma m’ewiei nyɛ dɛ nedze!
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balak see Balaam dɛ, Ebɛnadze na edze ayɛ me yi? Mekɛfaa wo dɛ bɔdom m’atamfo, na, hwɛ, ehyira hɔn koraa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na obuae see dɛ, Ana onnhia dɛ mohwɛ yie na meka dza EWURADZE dze hyɛɛ m’anomu no bi a?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balak see no dɛ, Mepa wo kyɛw, bra ma yɛnkɔ beebi fofor, mbrɛ ifi bohu hɔn; ibohu hɔn ano nko, na innkohu hɔn nyinara: na paa hɔn ma me wɔ hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔfaa no kɔr Zofim haban mu, wɔ Pisga etsifi, na osisii mbukyia esuon, na ɔdze ɔnantwisaa, nye oguannyin bobɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia biara do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsee Balak dɛ, Gyina wo hyew afɔr ho ha, ber a mirikehyia EWURADZE wɔ enyim noho yi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE behyiaa Balaam, na ɔdze asɛm hyɛɛ n’anomu, see dɛ, San kɔ Balak nkyɛn, na mbrɛ ka nye yi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn, na, hwɛ, ogyina ne hyew afɔr no ho, na Moab mbapɔmba ka no ho. Na Balak see no dɛ, EWURADZE aka dɛn?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔkasaa abɛbu mu see dɛ, Soɛr, Balak, na tsie; Yɛ aso ma me, Zipor babanyin:
title: NUMBERS

text: Nyankopɔn nnyɛ nyimpa, na oeedzi ator; Anaaso nyimpa ba, na oeenu noho: Ana ɔase, na ɔrennyɛ? Ana ɔakasa, na ɔremma onntsim?
title: NUMBERS

text: Hwɛ, nhyira ho mbra na menya: Na oehyira, na murunntum menndan enyi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Onnhun emumuyɛ wɔ Jakob mu, Nkyii so onnhun nkontompɔ wɔ Israel mu: EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn nye no wɔ hɔ, Na ɔhen ho esebɔ wɔ hɔn mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nyame eyi hɔn wɔ Egypt; Ɔwɔ ahoɔdzen dɛ ɔnantwi bɔyafo.
title: NUMBERS

text: Ampaara nkaber bi nnyi Jakob mu, Nkyii so ebisa bi nnyi Israel mu: Afei na wɔbɛka no wɔ Jakob nye Israel ho dɛ, Ebɛnadze na Nyame ayɛ yi!
title: NUMBERS

text: Hwɛ, ɔman no soɛr dɛ ogyataber, Na ɔma noho do dɛ ogyata: Orummbutuw gyedɛ oedzi afonam, Na ɔanom ɔtɔfo bɔgyaa ana.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balak see Balaam dɛ, Mpaa na eremmpaa hɔn a, na nhyira so innhyira hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam buae na ɔsee Balak dɛ, Ana mannka mannkyerɛ wo dɛ, dza EWURADZE bɛka no nyinara, nna mebɛyɛ?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balak see Balaam dɛ, Afei bra, ma memfa wo monkɔ beebi fofor; anyanyanbiara ɔbɔsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi ma efi hɔ adom hɔn ama me.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balak faa Balaam kɔr Peor etsifi a ɔhwɛ sar pradada no enyi no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam see Balak dɛ, Sisi afɔrmbukyia esuon ma me wɔ ha, na siesie anantwisaa esuon nye nguannyin esuon ma me wɔ ha.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balak yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Balaam see no, na ɔdze ɔnantwisaa nye oguannyin bobɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia biara do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na aber a Balaam hun dɛ asɔ EWURADZE enyi dɛ ohyira Israel no, ɔannkɔ ebisa bio, dɛ nkan no, mbom ɔdze n’enyi kedzii sar no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam maa n’enyi do, na ohun Israel dɛ wogu hɔ dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuakuw ebusuakuw tsetsee; na Nyankopɔn sunsum baa no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔkasae see dɛ, Beor babanyin Balaam se dɛ, Ɔbanyin a n’enyi hu adze yie no se dɛ:
title: NUMBERS

text: Nyia otsie Nyame ne nsɛm no, Nyia ohu Twerammpon enyido adze no, Ɔrohwe ase a, wɔtseew n’enyi do no, ɔse dɛ:
title: NUMBERS

text: Ao Jakob, mbrɛ wo tsenabea dua yɛ fɛw a, Wo ntamadan no, Ao Israel!
title: NUMBERS

text: Wɔtserɛw dɛ mbɔnsa, Dɛ esutsen ho nture, Dɛ alɔe ndua a EWURADZE atsetsɛw, Dɛ nsu ho kyindur ndua.
title: NUMBERS

text: No mbokitsi mu nsu bobu do, Na n’asefo bɛtsena nsu pii mu, Na ne hen bɔkrɔn asen Agag, Na wɔbɛma n’ahendzi do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nyame eyi no efi Egypt; Ɔwɔ ahoɔdzen dɛ ɔnantwi bɔyafo: Ɔbɛmen amanaman a wɔyɛ n’atamfo, Na woebubu hɔn mbiew esinesin, Na ɔdze n’egyen menaba ehwirahwira hɔn mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Ɔkotowee, ɔdaa famu dɛ ogyata, Na dɛ ogyataber; woana na obopusuw no? Nhyira nka obiara a ohyira wo, Na mpaa nka obiara a ɔpaa wo.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balak n’ebufuw dzɛɛw Balaam do, na ɔbɔɔ ne nsamu: na Balak see Balaam dɛ, Mibehyiaa wo dɛ bɛpaa m’atamfo, na, hwɛ, ɔwo ehyira hɔn mpɛn ebiasa nye yi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei guan kɔ mbrɛ ifi: modween dɛ nkyɛ mebɛhyɛ wo enyimnyam kɛse; na, hwɛ, EWURADZE esiw w’enyimnyam ho kwan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam see Balak dɛ, Ana mannka annkyerɛ w’abɔfoe a esomaa hɔn me nkyɛn no so dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Sɛ Balak dze dwetɛ nye sika ne fi ma mpo bɛma me a, murunntum mummbu EWURADZE n’asɛm do mommbɔ me tsir mu nnkɛyɛ papa anaa bɔn: dza EWURADZE bɛka no, ɔno na mebɛka?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na afei, hwɛ, morokɔ me man mu: bra, na memma hu dza ɔman yi dze bɛyɛ wo man wɔ nda a odzi ekyir no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na obuu no bɛ see dɛ, Beor babanyin Balaam se dɛ, Ɔbanyin a n’enyi emua no se dɛ:
title: NUMBERS

text: Nyia otsie Nyame ne nsɛm no, Na onyim Abɔso no ho nyimdzee no, Nyia ohu Twerammpon enyido adze no, Ɔrohwe ase a, wɔtseew n’enyi do no ɔse dɛ:
title: NUMBERS

text: Muhu no, nnyɛ sesei dze a: Mohwɛ no, ɔmmbɛn dze: Nworaba bi fi Jakob mu bopue, Na ahempoma befi Israel mu asoɛr, Na wɔabɔ afa Moab nkukuwa mu, Na wɔadwerew ɔko mba gyigyeegye no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Edom bɛyɛ adzenyadze, Seir so a wɔyɛ n’atamfo bɛyɛ n’adzenyadze; Na Israel bɛyɛ mbanyindze ara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na obi fi Jakob mu bedzi tum, Na ɔasɛɛ kurow no mu dza aka no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔhwɛɛ Amalek, na ɔsɔɔw ne kasaa no do see dɛ Amalek nye amanaman mu odzikamfo; Na n’ewiei bowie no ɔsɛɛ mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔhwɛɛ Kennyi, na ɔkasaa bio see dɛ, Wo tsenabew si hɔ pintsinn, Na wɔdze wo berɛbuw ahyɛ ɔbotan mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Naaso Kain bɔhwer, Ekodu dɛ Assur bɛfa wo ndɔmmum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na owiee ne kasaa no obuu no bɛ see dɛ, Ebei, Nyame reyɛ iyi no woana bɛtsena ase?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ahɛn befi Kittim mbew do aba, Na wɔabɛhaw Assur, na wɔahaw Eber, Na ɔnoara so ewie no ɔsɛɛ mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Balaam soɛree, na osii mu sanee kɔr ne tsenabew: na Balak so faa no kwan kɔree.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israel tsenaa Sittim, na ɔman no hyɛɛ ase nye Moab mbabaa no yɛɛ ehuhudze:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wohyiahyiaa ɔman no kɔr hɔn enyame okum afɔr ho; na ɔman no dzidzii, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze maa hɔn enyame no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israel dze noho bɔɔ Baal-peor ho: na EWURADZE ebufuw dzɛɛw Israel do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Fa ɔman no mu etsitsir nyinara, na sensɛn hɔn ma EWURADZE wɔ ewia do, ma EWURADZE ebufuhyew no ndan mfi Israel do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see Israel atsɛmbuafo no dɛ, Hom mu obiara nkuku ne mbanyin a wɔdze hɔnho akɔbɔ Baal-peor ho no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na, hwɛ, Israelmba no mu kor dze Midiannyi ɔbaa bi baa no nuanom no nkyɛn wɔ Moses n’enyim, nye Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara enyim, aber a worususu wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na aber a ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar, ne babanyin Finehas, hunii no, ɔsoɛree fii mboanofo no mu, na ɔfaa nkambaa kitsaa ne nsamu;
title: NUMBERS

text: na odzii Israelnyi no ekyir kɔr pia no mu, na ɔdze wowɔɔ hɔn beenu nyina hwira hwiraa hɔn mu, Israelnyi no, nye ɔbaa no ohwiraa no fur mu. Nna ɔyardɔm no siankae fii Israelmba no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔn a wowuwui wɔ ɔyardɔm no mu no wɔyɛ mpemeduonu anan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar, ne babanyin Finehas, adan m’ebufuw efi Israelmba do, wɔ dɛ ɔatwe me nyinkuntwe no nyinkun wɔ hɔn mu, ma mannhyew Israelmba no wɔ me nyinkuntwe mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm ntsi se dɛ, Hwɛ, medze m’asomdwee ahyɛmu mema no:
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔnyɛ ɔno, nye n’asefo a wobedzi n’ekyir no daa asɔfodzi ahyɛmu; osiandɛ ɔatwe ne Nyankopɔn ho nyinkun, na ɔapata ama Israelmba no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelnyi no a wokum no no, nyia wokum no kaa Midiannyi ɔbaa no ho no, ne dzin dze Zimri, Salu ne babanyin a, ɔyɛ Simeonfo egyanom ofi mu ɔbapɔmba.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Midiannyi ɔbaa no a wokum no no, ne dzin dze Kozbi, Zur a ɔyɛ otsitsir wɔ Midian egyanom ofi bi mu nkorɔfo do no, ne babaa a.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom nhiahia Midianfo no ho, na hom nku hɔn:
title: NUMBERS

text: osiandɛ hɔn so wɔdze hɔn ndaadaa a wɔdze tseetsee hom wɔ Peor ho asɛm no mu, nye hɔn akyerɛbaa Kozbi, Midian ɔsafohen no ne babaa no a wokum no wɔ ɔyardɔm da no mu wɔ Peor ho asɛm no mu no, ehiahia hom ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔhaw no ekyir no, EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses nye ɔsɔfo Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom nkan Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara, ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu do dze rokɔ no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, hɔn a wotum ɔsa kɔ wɔ Israel nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar nye hɔn kasae wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu wɔ Jeriko Jordan nkyɛn dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom nkan ɔman no, ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu do dze rokɔ no; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses nye Israelmba a wofi Egypt asaase do bae no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Reuben, Israel n’abakan no: Reuben ne mbabanyin; Hanok dze, Hanokfo ebusua: Pallu dze, Pallufo ebusua:
title: NUMBERS

text: Hezron dze, Hezronfo ebusua: Karmi dze, Karmifo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Reubenfo ebusua ebusua: na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu wɔyɛ mpemeduanan ebiasa nye ahaesuon eduasa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Pallu ne ba; Eliab.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Eliab ne mbabanyin; Nemuel, nye Datan, nye Abiram. Iyinom nye Datan, nye Abiram no a wɔfrɛɛ hɔn wɔ mboanofo no mu no a wɔhaam Moses nye Aaron ho wɔ Kora no kuw no mu, wɔ aber a wɔhaam EWURADZE ho:
title: NUMBERS

text: na asaase buee n’ano, na ɔmemeen hɔn dze kaa Kora ho, aber a kuw no wuwui no; wɔ aber a ogya memeen nyimpa ahaenu eduonum, dze yɛɛ asɛnkyerɛdze no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Naaso Kora ne mbabanyin no dze, woennwuwu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Simeon ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua tsetsee: Nemuel dze, Nemuelfo ebusua: Jamin dze, Jaminfo ebusua: Jakin dze, Jakinfo ebusua:
title: NUMBERS

text: Zera dze, Zerafo ebusua: Saul dze, Saulfo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Simeonfo ebusua, mpemeduonu ebien nye ahaenu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Gad ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua tsetsee: Zefon dze, Zefonfo ebusua: Hagi dze, Hagifo ebusua: Suni dze, Sunifo ebusua:
title: NUMBERS

text: Ozni dze, Oznifo ebusua: Eri dze, Erifo ebusua:
title: NUMBERS

text: Arod dze, Arodfo ebusua: Areli dze, Arelifo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Gad ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, mpemeduanan nye ahaenum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Juda ne mbabanyin, Er nye Onan: na Er nye Onan wowui wɔ Keenan asaase do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Juda ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua tsetsee nye yi; Sela dze, Selafo ebusua: Perez dze, Perezfo ebusua: Zera dze, Zerafo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Perez ne mbabanyin nye yi; Hezron dze, Hezronfo ebusua: Hamul dze, Hamulfo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Juda ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, mpemeduosuon esia nye ahaenum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Isakar ne mbabanyin: Tola dze, Tolafo ebusua: Puva dze, Punifo ebusua:
title: NUMBERS

text: Jasub dze, Jasubfo ebusua: Simron dze, Simronfo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Isakar ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, mpemeduosia anan nye ahaasa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Zebulun ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Sered dze, Seredfo ebusua: Elon dze, Elonfo ebusua: Jahleel dze, Jahleelfo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Zebulunfo ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, mpemeduosia nye ahaenum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Josef ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Manaasɛ nye Efraim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Manaasɛ ne mbabanyin: Makir dze, Makirfo ebusua: na Makir woo Gilead: Gilead dze, Gileadfo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Gilead ne mbabanyin: Iezer dze, Iezerfo ebusua: Helek dze, Helekfo ebusua:
title: NUMBERS

text: na Asriel dze, Asrielfo ebusua: na Sekem dze, Sekemfo ebusua:
title: NUMBERS

text: na Semida dze, Semidafo ebusua: na Hefer dze, Heferfo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Hefer ne babanyin Zelofehad ennya mbabanyin, na onyaa mbabaa: na Zelofehad ne mbabaa edzin nye Mahala, nye Noa, Hogla, Milka, nye Tirza.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Manaasɛ ebusua: na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu wɔyɛ mpemeduonum ebien nye ahaesuon.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Efraim ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Sutela dze, Sutelafo ebusua: Beker dze, Bekerfo ebusua: Tahan dze, Tahanfo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na iyinom nye Sutela ne mbabanyin: Eran dze, Eranfo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Efraim ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, mpemeduasa ebien nye ahaenum. Iyinom nye Josef ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua tsetsee.
title: NUMBERS

text: Benjamin ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Bela dze, Belafo ebusua: Asbel dze, Asbelfo ebusua: Ahiram dze, Ahiramfo ebusua:
title: NUMBERS

text: Sefufam dze, Sufafo ebusua: Hufam dze, Hufamfo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Bela ne mbabanyin nye Ard nye Naaman: Ard dze, Ardfo ebusua: Naaman dze, Naamanfo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Benjamin ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu wɔyɛ mpemeduanan enum nye ahaesia.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Dan ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Suham dze, Suhamfo ebusua. Iyinom nye Dan ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: NUMBERS

text: Suhamfo ebusua nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, wɔyɛ mpemeduosia anan nye ahaanan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Aser ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Imna dze, Imnafo ebusua: Isvi dze, Isvifo ebusua: Beria dze, Beriafo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Beria ne mbabanyin dze: Heber dze, Heberfo ebusua: Malkiel dze, Malkielfo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Aser ne babaa ne dzin dze Sera.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Aser ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu tse, mpemeduonum ebiasa nye ahaanan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Naftali ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Jahzeel dze, Jahzeelfo ebusua: Guni dze, Gunifo ebusua:
title: NUMBERS

text: Jezer dze, Jezerfo ebusua: Sillem dze, Sillemfo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Naftali ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu wɔyɛ mpemeduanan enum nye ahaanan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Israelmba mu, mpemahaesia nye kor ahaesuon eduasa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom na wɔnkyɛ asaase no mma hɔn dɛ egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ edzin no no dodow tse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nyia ɔso no ma no egyapadze a ɔso, na nyia osuar no ma no egyapadze a osuar: obiara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn no mu tse no na wɔmfa n’egyapadze mma no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Naaso asaase no wɔmfa tonto nkyɛ: dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom ebusuakuw ebusuakuw edzin tsetsee no na wonnya egyapadze no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ tonto no tse no na wɔmfa nkyɛ hɔn egyapadze no mma hɔn a wɔso nye hɔn a wosuar.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na iyinom nye hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ Levifo mu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: Gerson dze, Gersonfo ebusua: Kohat dze, Kohatfo ebusua: Merari dze, Merarifo ebusua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Levi ebusua ebusua: Libnifo ebusua, Hebronfo ebusua, Mahilifo ebusua, Korafo ebusua. Na Kohat woo Amram.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Amram ne yer dzin dze Jokebed, Levi ne babaa a wɔwoo no ma Levi wɔ Egypt no a: na ɔwoo Aaron nye Moses nye hɔn akyerɛbaa Miriam maa Amram.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Aaron so wɔwoo Nadab nye Abihu, Eleazar nye Itamar maa no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Nadab nye Abihu wuwui, wɔ aber a wɔdze ananagya baa EWURADZE enyim no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn wɔ mu wɔyɛ mpemeduonu ebiasa, banyin biara a oedzi bosoom nye ekyir no: na wɔannkan hɔn ammfora Israelmba, osiandɛ wɔamma hɔn egyapadze wɔ Israelmba no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye hɔn a Moses nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar kaan hɔn no; hɔn a wɔkaan Israelmba wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu wɔ Jeriko Jordan ho no a.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na iyinom mu dze ɔbanyin biara nnyi mu a ofi hɔn a Moses nye ɔsɔfo Aaron kaan hɔn wɔ aber a wɔkaan Israelmba wɔ Sinai sar do no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE aka no wɔ hɔn ho dɛ, Owu na wobowuwu wɔ sar no do. Na hɔn mu nyimpa biara annka, gyedɛ Jefune ne babanyin Kaleb, nye Nun ne babanyin Josua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nna Zelofehad, Hefer ne babanyin no, Gilead ne babanyin no Makir ne babanyin no, Manaasɛ ne babanyin no, ne mbabaa a wofi Josef ne babanyin Manaasɛ ebusua mu no, twee bɛnee: na ne babaa no hɔn edzin nye yi; Mahala, Noa, nye Hogla, nye Milka, nye Tirza.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wobegyinaa Moses, nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye mbapɔmba no nye mboanofo no nyinara enyim, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɛn egya wui wɔ sar no do, nna onnyi kuw no a wohyiahyiaa hɔnho dze tsiaa EWURADZE wɔ Kora kuw no mu no mu: mbom owui wɔ nankasa no bɔn mu: na oennya mbabanyin.
title: NUMBERS

text: Ebɛnadze ntsi na hɛn egya ne dzin mpepa mfi n’ebusua mu, dɛ oennya ɔbanyin ntsi? Ma hɛn egyapadze wɔ hɛn egya no nuanom mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses dze hɔn asɛm no baa EWURADZE enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Zelofehad ne mbabaa no aka no tsenn: ɔma na ma hɔn egyapadze wɔ hɔn egya no nuanom mu; na ma hɔn egya n’egyapadze no nkɔ hɔn hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Sɛ ɔbanyin bi wu, na onnyi ɔbabanyin a, ɔno hom mma n’egyapadze nkɔ ne babaa hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ onnyi ɔbabaa a, ɔno hom mfa n’egyapadze mma no nuanom.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ onnyi nuanom a, ɔno hom mfa n’egyapadze mma n’egya no nuanom.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ n’egya nnyi nuanom a, ɔno hom mfa n’egyapadze mma no bɔgyaa a ɔbɛn no wɔ n’ebusua mu, na ɔmfa: na iyi nyɛ atsɛmbu ahyɛdze mma Israelmba, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Fow Abarim bepɔw yi, na kɔhwɛ asaase a medze ama Israelmba no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ inya hu a, wo so akɛka wo nkorɔfo ho, dɛ mbrɛ wo nua Aaron akɛka hɔn ho no:
title: NUMBERS

text: osiandɛ hom yɛɛ asoɔdzen wɔ m’asɛm ho wɔ Zin sar do, wɔ mboanofo ham no mu, dɛ nkyɛ hom tsew mo ho wɔ nsu no ho wɔ hɔn enyim. (Iyi nye Meriba nsu no wɔ Kades wɔ Sin sar do no.)
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ EWURADZE dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Ma EWURADZE, honam nyinara esunsum Nyankopɔn, nhwehwɛ ɔbanyin bi nsi mboanofo no do a
title: NUMBERS

text: obedzi hɔn enyim efir edzi, na obedzi hɔn enyim aba mu a obegya hɔn epue, na ɔdze hɔn bɛba mu; amma EWURADZE no mboanofo aannyɛ dɛ nguan a wonnyi oguanhwɛfo.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Fa Josua, Nun ne babanyin no, ɔbanyin a sunsum no wɔ no mu no, na fa wo nsa gu no do;
title: NUMBERS

text: na fa no gyina ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye mboanofo no nyinara enyim; na hyɛ no mbra wɔ hɔn enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na fa w’enyimnyam no bi ma no, ma Israelmba mboanofo no nyinara ntsie no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na onkegyina ɔsɔfo Eleazar enyim, ɔno na obebisa Urim a ase nye kan no, atsɛmbu ama no wɔ EWURADZE enyim: na n’asɛm do na womfir edzi, na n’asɛm do na wɔmbra mu, ɔno nye Israelmba nyinara a wɔka no ho nyina, mekyerɛ mboanofo no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ no no nyinara: na ɔfaa Josua, na ɔdze no kegyinaa ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye mboanofo no nyinara enyim:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔdze ne nsa guu no do, na ɔhyɛɛ no mbra, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE nam Moses do kae no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Hyɛ Israelmba no, na se hɔn dɛ, M’ayɛyɛdze, me gya afɔr edziban a oyi nka huanhuam ma me no, hom ndwen do mfa mbrɛ me wɔ ne ber mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na se hɔn dɛ, Ogya afɔr a hom mfa mbrɛ EWURADZE nye yi; nguambaanyin a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm, na wɔmfa ebien da kor mbɔ ɔhyew afɔr daa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Eguambaa kor na fa bɔ afɔr anapa na eguambaa kor so fa bɔ afɔr ewimbir;
title: NUMBERS

text: na fa isiam pa efa ebupɛn du mu kor yɛ edziban afɔr a wɔdze ngo a woesiw hin ebupɛn anan mu kor afrɔw.
title: NUMBERS

text: Ɔyɛ daa afɔr a wɔhyehyɛe wɔ bepɔw Sinai do a oyi nka huanhuam a ɔyɛ ogya afɔr ma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na no nom afɔr wɔ eguambaa kor ho nyɛ hin ebupɛn anan mu kor: na bea krɔnkrɔn no do na hue ɔnom afɔr nsadzen no ma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na eguambaa kor no so fa bɔ afɔr ewimbir no: dɛ mbrɛ anapa edziban afɔr no tse, na mbrɛ no nom afɔr no tse no, na fa bɔ ne gya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam ma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ahomgyeda no nguambaanyin ebien a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm, nye edziban afɔr isiam pa efa ebupɛn du mu ebien a wɔdze ngo afrɔw nye no nom afɔr:
title: NUMBERS

text: iyi nye ahomgyeda biara ne hyew afɔr a ɔka daa ɔhyew afɔr, nye no nom afɔr ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hom abosoom ahyɛse no hom mbɔ ɔhyew afɔr mma EWURADZE; anantwisaa mburwa ebien, nye oguannyin kor, nguambaanyin esuon a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm;
title: NUMBERS

text: na edziban afɔr isiam pa efa ebupɛn du mu ebiasa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, nka ɔnantwisaa kor ho; na edziban afɔr isiam pa ebupɛn du mu ebien a wɔdze ngo afrɔw nka oguannyin kor no ho;
title: NUMBERS

text: na edziban afɔr isiam pa ebupɛn du mu nkorkor a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, nka eguambaa biara ho; nyɛ ɔhyew afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam, ogya afɔr mma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na no nom afɔr nyɛ wenyin hin ɔfa nka ɔnantwisaa kor ho, na hin ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor nka oguannyin no ho, na hin ebupɛn anan mu kor nka eguambaa kor ho: iyi nye bosoom biara ne hyew afɔr wɔ afrenhyia abosoom no nyina mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔmfa apɔnkyenyin kor mbɔ bɔn ho afɔr mma EWURADZE; mfa nka daa ɔhyew afɔr no, nye no nom afɔr no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na bosoom a odzi kan no mu, bosoom no ne da a otsia duanan no, ɔyɛ EWURADZE apaho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na bosoom no ara ne da a otsia duenum no, nyɛ afahyɛ da: nda esuon na wondzi epitsi boodoo.
title: NUMBERS

text: Da a odzi kan no nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; mma mma hom nnyɛ edwumadzen biara:
title: NUMBERS

text: mbom hom mbɔ ogya afɔr, ɔhyew afɔr mma EWURADZE; anantwisaa mburwa ebien, nye oguannyin kor, nye nguambaanyin esuon a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia: wɔnyɛ dza wonndzii dzɛm mma hom:
title: NUMBERS

text: nye n’edziban afɔr, isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw: ebupɛn du mu ebiasa na hom mfa nka ɔnantwisaa kor ho, na ebupɛn du mu ebien nka oguannyin no ho mbra;
title: NUMBERS

text: ebupɛn du mu nkorkor na fa ka nguambaa esuon no mu eguambaa biara ho bra;
title: NUMBERS

text: na bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor, ma wɔmfa mpata mma hom.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom nyɛ iyinom nka anapa ɔhyew afɔr a ɔyɛ daa ɔhyew afɔr no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm yi ara na hom nyɛ ogya afɔr edziban a oyi nka huanhuam ma EWURADZE no, daa daa, nda esuon: wɔnyɛ nka daa ɔhyew afɔr no, na no nom afɔr no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na da a otsia esuon no hom nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; mma hom nnyɛ edwumadzen biara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Eso nduadzewakan da no mu, sɛ hom dze edziban fofor afɔr rebrɛ EWURADZE wɔ hom adapɛn afahyɛ mu a, hom nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; mma hom nnyɛ edwumadzen biara:
title: NUMBERS

text: mbom hom mbɔ ɔhyew afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma EWURADZE; anantwisaa mburwa ebien, oguannyin kor, nguambaanyin esuon a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia;
title: NUMBERS

text: na n’edziban afɔr, isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, ebupɛn du mu ebiasa nka ɔnantwisaa kor ho, ebupɛn du mu ebien nka oguannyin kor no ho,
title: NUMBERS

text: ebupɛn du mu nkorkor nka eguambaa esuon no mu eguambaa biara ho;
title: NUMBERS

text: apɔnkyenyin kor, ma wɔmfa mpata mma hom.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom nyɛ mfa nka daa ɔhyew afɔr no, nye n’edziban afɔr no, nye no nom afɔr no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na bosoom a otsia esuon no mu, bosoom no ne da a odzi kan no, hom nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; mma hom nnyɛ edwumadzen edwuma: ɔyɛ totorobɛntohɛn da ma hom.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hom mbɔ ɔhyew afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma EWURADZE; ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, oguannyin kor, nguambaanyin esuon a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm;
title: NUMBERS

text: na n’edziban afɔr, isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, ebupɛn du mu ebiasa nka oguannyin no ho,
title: NUMBERS

text: na ebupɛn du mu nkorkor nka eguambaa esuon no mu eguambaa biara ho:
title: NUMBERS

text: na bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor, ma wɔmfa mpata mma hom:
title: NUMBERS

text: mfa nka bosoom fofor ɔhyew afɔr, nye n’edziban afɔr, nye no nom afɔr ho, dɛ mbrɛ no ho mbra tsetsee, nyɛ ogya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na bosoom a otsia esuon no ara mu da a otsia du no hom nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; na hom mfa akɔnkyen; eso mma hom nnyɛ edwuma biara:
title: NUMBERS

text: na hom mbɔ ɔhyew afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma EWURADZE; ɔnantwisaa eburwa kor, oguannyin kor, nguambaanyin esuon a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia; a wonndzii dzɛm:
title: NUMBERS

text: na n’edziban afɔr, isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, ebupɛn du mu ebiasa nka ɔnantwisaa no ho, ebupɛn du mu ebien nka oguannyin kor no ho,
title: NUMBERS

text: ebupɛn du mu nkorkor nka nguambaa esuon no mu eguambaa biara ho:
title: NUMBERS

text: bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka mpata bɔn ho afɔr, nye daa ɔhyew afɔr, nye n’edziban afɔr, nye no nom afɔr no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na bosoom a otsia esuon no ne da a otsia duenum no hom nyɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn; mma hom nnyɛ edwumadzen biara, na hom nhyɛ fa nda esuon mma EWURADZE.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom mbɔ ɔhyew afɔr, ogya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma EWURADZE; anantwisaa mburwa duebiasa, nguannyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia; a wonndzii dzɛm:
title: NUMBERS

text: na n’edziban afɔr, isiam pa a wɔdze ngo afrɔw, ebupɛn du mu ebiasa ebiasa nkeka anantwisaa du ebiasa no mu ɔnantwisaa biara ho, ebupɛn du mu ebien ebien nkeka nguannyin ebien no mu kor ho,
title: NUMBERS

text: na ebupɛn du mu nkorkor nka nguambaa duanan no mu eguambaa biara ho:
title: NUMBERS

text: na bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew afɔr, n’edziban afɔr, nye no nom afɔr no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na da a otsia ebien no hom mfa anantwisaa mburwa duebien, nguannyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm mbra:
title: NUMBERS

text: na n’edziban afɔr nye no nom afɔr nka anantwisaa, nguannyin nye nguambaa no ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔ mbra kwan:
title: NUMBERS

text: nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew afɔr, nye n’edziban afɔr, nye no nom afɔr no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na da a otsia ebiasa no anantwisaa dubiako, nguannyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm;
title: NUMBERS

text: na n’edziban afɔr nye no nom afɔr nka anantwisaa, nguannyin, nye nguambaa no ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔ mbra kwan:
title: NUMBERS

text: nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew afɔr, nye n’edziban afɔr, nye no nom afɔr no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na da a otsia anan no anantwisaa du, nguannyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm:
title: NUMBERS

text: n’edziban afɔr nye no nom afɔr nka anantwisaa, nguannyin, nye nguambaa no ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔ mbra kwan:
title: NUMBERS

text: nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew afɔr, n’edziban afɔr, nye no nom afɔr no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na da a otsia enum no anantwisaa akron, nguannyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm:
title: NUMBERS

text: na n’edziban afɔr nye no nom afɔr nka anantwisaa, nguannyin, nye nguambaa no ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔmbra kwan:
title: NUMBERS

text: nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew afɔr, n’edziban afɔr, nye no nom afɔr no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na da a otsia esia no anantwisaa awɔtwe, nguannyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm:
title: NUMBERS

text: na n’edziban afɔr nye no nom afɔr nka anantwisaa, nguannyin, nye nguambaa ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔ mbra kwan:
title: NUMBERS

text: nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew afɔr, n’edziban afɔr, nye no nom afɔr no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na da a otsia esuon no anantwisaa esuon, nguannyin ebien, nguambaanyin duanan a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm:
title: NUMBERS

text: na n’edziban afɔr nye no nom afɔr nka anantwisaa, nguannyin, nye nguambaa no ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔ mbrɛ kwan:
title: NUMBERS

text: nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor; mfa nka daa ɔhyew afɔr, n’edziban afɔr, nye no nom afɔr no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Da a otsia awɔtwe no hom mbɔ ngua a no mu yɛ nwin: mma hom nnyɛ edwumadzen biara:
title: NUMBERS

text: mbom hom mbɔ ɔhyew afɔr, ogya afɔr a oyi nka huanhuam mma EWURADZE: ɔnantwisaa kor, oguannyin kor, nguambaanyin esuon a woedzi afrenhyia afrenhyia a wonndzii dzɛm:
title: NUMBERS

text: n’edziban afɔr nye no nom afɔr nka ɔnantwisaa, oguannyin, nye nguambaa no ho, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse, wɔ kwan:
title: NUMBERS

text: nye bɔn ho afɔr apɔnkyenyin kor: mfa nka daa ɔhyew afɔr, nye edziban afɔr, nye no nom afɔr no ho.
title: NUMBERS
