text: Iyinom na hom mfa mbrɛ EWURADZE wɔ hom afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ no mu, mfa nka hom anohobadze nye hom ayamuyi afɔr ho, wɔ hom ɔhyew afɔr, nye hom edziban afɔr, nye hom ɔnom afɔr, nye hom asomdwee afɔr mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses kaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba no dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu etsitsir no dɛ, Iyi nye adze a EWURADZE ahyɛ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Sɛ nyimpa bi bɔ EWURADZE anohoba, anaa ɔka ntam dze nkyehoma kyekyer ne kra a, mma ommbu n’asɛm do; ɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ dza ofi n’anomu nyinara tse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Eso sɛ ɔbaa bi bɔ anohoba ma EWURADZE, na ɔdze nkyehoma kyekyer noho wɔ n’egya fie, ne nkataasiaber mu;
title: NUMBERS

text: na n’egya tse n’anohoba, nye ne nkyehoma a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra, na n’egya ennsiw no kwam a: ɔno n’anohoba nyinara ntsim hɔ, na nkyehoma biara a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra no ntsim hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Sɛ da a n’egya bɛtse no osiw no kwan dze a; ɔno n’anohoba, anaa ne nkyehoma a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra no mu biara rinntsim hɔ: na EWURADZE dze bɛkyɛ no, osiandɛ n’egya siiw no kwan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ ɔwɔ kun, wɔ aber a n’anohoba, anaa n’anosɛm hurutuhurutu a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra no, wɔ no do no;
title: NUMBERS

text: na no kun tse, na da a ɔtsee no oennsiw no kwan a: ɔno n’anohoba no ntsim hɔ na ne nkyehoma a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra no ntsim hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Sɛ no kun siw no kwan da a ɔtsee no dze a; ɔno ɔmma n’anohoba a ɔwɔ no do, nye n’anosɛm hurutuhurutu a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra no nyɛ kwa: na EWURADZE dze bɛkyɛr no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na okunafo, anaa nyia woegyaa no awar no n’anohoba dze, mekyerɛ adze biara a ɔdze kyekyer ne kra no, otsim no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ ɔwɔ no kun fie na ɔbɔɔ anohoba, anaa ɔdze ntam dze nkyehoma kyekyeer ne kra,
title: NUMBERS

text: na no kun tsee, na ɔyɛɛ no komm, na oennsiw no kwan a; ɔno n’anohoba nyinara tsim hɔ, na nkyehoma biara a ɔdze akyekyer ne kra no tsim hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Sɛ no kun no ma ɔyɛ kwa wɔ da a ɔtsee no dze a; ɔno biribiara a ofii n’anomu do wɔ n’anohoba ho, anaa ne kra nkyehoma ho no, rinntsim hɔ: no kun no ama ayɛ kwa; na EWURADZE dze bɛkyɛ no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Anohoba biara, nye ntam biara a wɔdze brɛ ɔkra adze no, no kun na ɔma otsintsim, anaa no kun na ɔma ɔyɛ kwa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ no kun yɛ no komm koraa fi da to da a; ɔno otsintsim n’anohoba nyinara, anaa ne nkyehoma nyinara a ɔwɔ no do no: oetsintsim no, osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ no komm wɔ da a ɔtsee no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Sɛ ɔatse no ɔkyɛr ana ekyir no ɔama ayɛ kwa dze a; ɔno kun no nsoa yer no n’emumuyɛ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye ahyɛdze a EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses dɛ ɔnda banyin nye ne yer ntamu, ɔnda egya nye ne babaa a ɔwɔ ne nkataasiaber mu, wɔ n’egya fie ntamu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Dzi Midianfo wer ma Israelmba ho: na n’ekyir no akɛka wo nkorɔfo ho wɔ nsamankyir.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, Hom mma hom mu mbanyin mmia mma ɔsa no, ama woeetu akɔ Midian do, na wɔmfa EWURADZE n’awerdzi nkɔ Midianfo do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom mma Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu, ebusuakuw biara mu nyimpa apem nkɔ ɔsa no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nna woyiyii Israel mpempem mu mpemduebien a womiae maa ɔsa no, ebusuakuw biara mu apem.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses somaa hɔn, ebusuakuw biara mu apem no, ma wɔkɔr ɔsa no, hɔn nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar ne babanyin Finehas ɔdze ahotseweebea ndzɛmba no na ewubɔ ntotorobɛnto no wɔ ne nsamu na wɔkɔr ɔsa no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔnye Midian kɔkoe dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no; na wokunkum mbanyin no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wokunkum Midian ahemfo no kaa hɔn atɔfo nkaa no ho. Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, nye Reba Midian ahemfo beenum no; na wɔdze nkrantsee kum Beor ne babanyin Balaam so.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba no faa Midian mbaa no nye hɔn mbofraba no ndɔmmum; na wɔfoom hɔn ofiembowa nyinara, nye hɔn nguankuw nyinara, nye hɔn ahodze nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔdze ogya hyehyeew hɔn nkurow nyinara wɔ mbeambea a wɔtsetsee no, nye hɔn nseraban nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔfaa asadze no nyinara, nye afonam no nyinara, nyimpa nye abowa nyina.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔdze ndɔmmum no, nye afonam no, nye asadze no, brɛɛ Moses, nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye Israel mboanofo no; wɔ nseraban no mu wɔ Moab tɛtɛr a ɔda Jeriko Jordan ho no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses, nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye mboanofo no mu mbapɔmba no nyinara fiir edzi kehyiaa hɔn wɔ nseraban no ekyir.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses no bo fuuw dɔm no hɔn asafohemfo no, apem apem do asafohemfo nye ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo a wofi asayɛ bae no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, Ana hom agye mbaa no nyinara nkwa?
title: NUMBERS

text: Hwɛ, iyinom, na ɔnam Balaam apam do, wɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔn tsiaa EWURADZE wɔ Peor asɛm no mu, na ɔmaa ɔyardɔm baa EWURADZE no mboanofo mu no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Afei dɛm ntsi hom nkuku mbofraba no mu mbanyin nyinara, na wonku ɔbaa biara a oehu ɔbanyin dɛ ɔnye no ada.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mbaa mbofraba a wonnhun ɔbanyin dɛ wɔnye no ada no dze, hom ngye hɔn nkwa mma homho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hom nkyer nsera wɔ nseraban no ekyir nda esuon: obiara a oeku nyimpa bi no, nye obiara a ɔaka ɔtɔfo bi no, hom ntsew homho da a otsia ebiasa no, nye da a otsia esuon no, hom nye hom ndɔmmumfo no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na atar biara dze, nye adze a wɔdze nwoma ayɛ nyinara, nye mpɔnkyenhwi edwuma nyinara, nye adze a wɔdze dua ayɛ nyinara, homara hom ntsew ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsɔfo Eleazar see mbanyin akofo a wɔkɔr akono no dɛ, Iyi nye mbra a EWURADZE dze ahyɛ Moses no mu ahyɛdze:
title: NUMBERS

text: naaso sika nye dwetɛ, boran, dadze, seenyaa, nye sumbui no,
title: NUMBERS

text: adze biara a obotum ogya no, hom mma ɔnkɛfa ogya mu, na no ho ntsew; naaso hom mfa ahoguar nsu no ntsew ho: na adze a onnkotum ogya no nyinara, hom mma ɔnkɛfa nsu mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hom nhor hom ntar da a otsia esuon no, na hom ho ntsew, na n’ekyir no na hom mbra nseraban no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ mbu,
title: NUMBERS

text: Ɔwo nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar nye mboanofo no egyanom efi mu etsitsir no, afonam a wɔfae no ano, nyimpa nye mbowa nyina,
title: NUMBERS

text: na kyɛ afonam no mu akyɛkyɛ ebien; ma mbanyin akofo a wɔkɔr akono no, nye mboanofo no nyinara:
title: NUMBERS

text: na gye mbanyin asayɛfo a wɔkɔr akono no hɔ tow ma EWURADZE: nyimpa, nye anantwi, nye nsoasopɔnkɔ, nye nguankuw mu ahaenum mu nkorkor:
title: NUMBERS

text: gye no wɔ hɔn ɔfa no mu, na fa ma ɔsɔfo Eleazar, dɛ EWURADZE ɔmado afɔr.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba ɔfa mu dze, gye nyimpa, anantwi, nsaso, nye nguankuw no, mekyerɛ ofiembowa nyinara mu eduonum eduonum mu nkorkor, na fa ma Levifo no a wɔhwɛ EWURADZE ntamadan ahwɛdodze do no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Afei afonam a ɔbor asadze a mbanyin asayɛfo no fae no do no, ɔyɛ nguan mpemahaesia eduosuon enum,
title: NUMBERS

text: nye anantwi mpemeduosuon ebien,
title: NUMBERS

text: nye nsoasopɔnkɔ mpemeduosia biako,
title: NUMBERS

text: nye nyimpa, mbaa a wonnhun ɔbanyin dɛ wɔnye no ada, nyinara wɔyɛ mpemeduasa ebien.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔfa no a ɔyɛ hɔn a wotui kɔr ɔsa no hɔn kyɛfa no, no dodow yɛ nguan mpemahaebiasa eduasa esuon nye ahaenum:
title: NUMBERS

text: na nguan no mu ɔtow a woyiyii maa EWURADZE no yɛ ahaesia eduosuon enum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na anantwi no yɛ mpemeduasa esia; hɔn mu ɔtow a woyiyii maa EWURADZE yɛ eduosuon ebien.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nsoasopɔnkɔ no yɛ mpemeduasa nye ahaenum; hɔn mu ɔtow a woyiyii maa EWURADZE yɛ eduosia biako.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nyimpa no yɛ mpemduesia; hɔn mu ɔtow a woyiyii maa EWURADZE yɛ nyimpa eduasa ebien.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses dze ɔtow a ɔyɛ EWURADZE ɔmado afɔr no maa ɔsɔfo Eleazar, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba hɔn ɔfa no a Moses gyee no wɔ akofo no hɔ no mu dze,
title: NUMBERS

text: (afei mboanofo no hɔn ɔfa no yɛ nguan mpemahaebiasa eduasa, esuon nye ahaenum,
title: NUMBERS

text: nye anantwi mpemeduasa esia,
title: NUMBERS

text: nye nsoasopɔnkɔ mpemeduasa nye ahaenum,
title: NUMBERS

text: nye nyimpa mpemduesia;)
title: NUMBERS

text: nye Israelmba hɔn ɔfa no mu dze, Moses faa eduonum eduonum mu nkorkor, nyimpa nye mbowa nyina, na ɔdze maa Levifo no a wɔhwɛ EWURADZE ntamadan ahwɛdodze do no; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na asafohemfo a wɔhwɛ dɔm mpempem do no, nye apem apem do asafohemfo, nye ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no, baa Moses nkyɛn:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔbɛsee no dɛ, Wo nkowaa yeebu akofo a wɔwɔ hɛn nsamu no ano, na hɛn mu nyimpa kor mpo annyew.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na yɛdze EWURADZE n’ayɛyɛdze aba, dza nyimpa biara enya no a, sika ndwindze, ananadze ntweaban, nye nsakɔnadze, nsɔwanonkaba, nsowamuadze, nye nkɔnmuadze, dɛ wɔmfa mpata mma hɛn akra wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar gyee hɔn hɔ sika no, mekyerɛ edwindze no nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔmado afɔr sika nyinara a wɔdze brɛ EWURADZE a ofi apem apem do asafohemfo, nye ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo hɔ no, ɔyɛ dwetɛbona mpemduesia ahaesuon eduonum.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na akofo no hɔn afom asadze dze, hɔnankasa na wɔfefae.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar gyee sika no wɔ apem apem nye ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no hɔ, na wɔdze baa ehyiadzibuw no mu, dɛ ɔnyɛ Israelmba no nkaadze wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Afei Reubenmba nye Gadmba no wɔ ofiembowa dodow a wɔdɔɔ so kɛsenara: na aber a wohun Jazer, nye Gilead asaase no, na hwɛ, bea no fata ofiembowa bea no;
title: NUMBERS

text: Wɔbae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ Moses, nye ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye mboanofo no mu mbapɔmba no dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Atarot, nye Dibon, nye Jazer, nye Nimra, nye Hesbon, nye Eleale, nye Sebam, nye Nebo, nye Beon,
title: NUMBERS

text: asaase a EWURADZE bɔɔ no wɔ Israel mboanofo no enyim no, yɛ asaase a oye ma mbowanyɛn, na wo nkowaa so wɔ ofiembowa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Sɛ yeenya w’enyim enyimnyam a, ma wɔmfa asaase yi mma wo nkowaa ma yɛmfa; mma mmfa hɛn nntwa Jordan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see Gadmba nye Reubenmba no dɛ, Aso hom nuanom nkɔ ɔsa, na hom ntsena ha?
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom tu Israelmba akoma dɛ mma wonntwa nnkɔ asaase a EWURADZE dze ama hɔn no do yi?
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm na hom egyanom yɛe, wɔ aber a mosomaa hɔn fii Kades-barnea dɛ wɔnkɔhwɛ asaase no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na aber a wɔfowee kɔr Eskol mbɔnsa mu, na wohun asaase no, wobotuu Israelmba no hɔn akoma dɛ mma wɔnnkɔ asaase a EWURADZE dze ama hɔn no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE ebufuw dzɛɛw da no, na ɔkaa ntam dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Ampaara mbanyin a wofi Egypt bae no a woedzi mfe eduonu nye ekyir no mu biara runnhu asaase a mekaa ho ntam mekyerɛɛ Abraham, nye Isaak, nye Jakob no; osiandɛ woennwie m’ekyir dzi:
title: NUMBERS

text: gyedɛ Keniznyi Jefune ne babanyin Kaleb, nye Nun ne babanyin Josua: osiandɛ hɔn na woedzi EWURADZE ekyir nokwar mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE ebufuw dzɛɛw Israel do, na ɔmaa wokekyiin sar no do mfe eduanan, ma okodur dɛ ebusuasantsen no a wɔyɛɛ bɔn wɔ EWURADZE enyim no nyinara hyewee.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na, hwɛ, hom asoɛr egyina hom egyanom ananmu, ndzebɔnyɛfo asefo, dɛ hom da ho araa dze EWURADZE n’ebufuhyew no reba Israel do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ hom dan fi n’ekyir a, ɔbɛda ho ara adan hɔn egya wɔ sar no do; na hom asɛɛ ɔman yi nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔbaa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, Nguamban na yɛbɛgyegye ama hɛn ofiembowa wɔ ha, na nkurow so yɛbɛkyekyer ama hɛn mbofraba:
title: NUMBERS

text: na hɛnankasa dze hɛn ho bɛyɛ har yeemia edzi Israelmba enyim, ekodu dɛ yɛdze hɔn bɔkɔ ekodu hɔn tsenabew ana: na hɛn mbofraba no ntsenatsena nkurow a wɔagye ho ban mu osian asaase no do atsefo no ntsi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Yɛrennsan mmba hɛn efiefi, gyedɛ Israelmba ɔbanyin biara enya egyapadze edzi ana.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na yɛnnye hɔn remmfa enyadze wɔ Jordan egya, ɔdze kɔ no; osiandɛ hɛn egyapadze ebefir hɛn Jordan nkyɛn ha boka afamu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom bɛyɛ iyi; sɛ hom bemia homho wɔ EWURADZE enyim akɔ ɔsa,
title: NUMBERS

text: na hom mu nyimpa biara a oemia botwa Jordan edzi EWURADZE enyim, ekodu dɛ ɔbɛpam n’atamfo efi n’enyim
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔabrɛ asaase no adze wɔ EWURADZE enyim a: nna n’ekyir no hom bɛsan na hom edzi bem wɔ EWURADZE nye Israelmba ho; na asaase yi nyɛ hom enyadze wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ hom annyɛ dɛm a, hwɛ hom ayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE: na hom nhu dɛ hom bɔn beyi hom ama.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom nkyekyer nkurow mma hom mbofraba, na nguamban mma hom nguan; na hom nyɛ dza efi hom anomu epue no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Gadmba nye Reubenmba no kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ, Wo nkowaa bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ mo wura ahyɛ no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hɛn mbofraba hɛn yernom hɛn nguankuw, nye hɛn ofiembowa nyinara, bɛtsena Gilead nkurow no mu hɔ:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wo nkowaa dze, ɔbanyin biara a oemia rokɔ ɔsa no, botwa mu wɔ EWURADZE enyim akɔko dɛ mbrɛ mo wura aka no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nna Moses dze hɔn ho mbra maa ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye Nun ne babanyin Josua, nye Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu egyanom efi do etsitsir no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ Gadmba nye Reubenmba nye hom twa Jordan, ɔbanyin biara a oemia dzi EWURADZE enyim rokɔko no, na wɔbrɛ asaase no adze wɔ hom enyim a; ɔno hom mfa Gilead asaase mma hɔn ma wɔmfa:
title: NUMBERS

text: na sɛ woemmia nye hom enntwa a, ɔnodze wɔmma wonnya enyadze wɔ hom mu wɔ Keenan asaase do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Gadmba nye Reubenmba no buaa dɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE aka akyerɛ wo nkowaa no, dɛmara na yɛbɛyɛ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Yebemia wɔ EWURADZE enyim etwa mu akɔ Keenan asaase do, na hɛn egyapadze a yeenya no wɔ Jordan egya ha no ako hɛn hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses dze Amorifo hen Sihon n’ahendzi, nye Basanhen Ɔge n’ahendzi, asaase no, dɛ mbrɛ no do nkurow nye no ntoaado tsetsee no, mekyerɛ asaase no do nkurow a ehyia do no, maa hɔn, mekyerɛ Gadmba, nye Reubenmba, nye Josef ne babanyin Manaasɛ n’ebusuakuw ɔfa no a.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Gadmba no kyekyeer Dibon, nye Atarot, nye Aroer;
title: NUMBERS

text: nye Atroth-sofan, nye Jazer, nye Jogbeha;
title: NUMBERS

text: nye Bɛt-nimra, nye Bɛt-haran: nkurow a wɔagyegye ho ban, nye nguamban.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Reubenmba no kyekyeer Hesbon, nye Eleale, nye Kiriataim;
title: NUMBERS

text: nye Nebo, nye Baal-meon, (hɔn edzin no sakyesakyeree), nye Sibma: na wɔdze edzin fofor totoo nkurow a wɔkyekyeree no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Manaasɛ ne babanyin Makir mba no sii mu Gilead, na wɔkɛfae, na wotuu Amorifo a wɔwɔ mu hɔ no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses dze Gilead maa Manaasɛ ne babanyin Makir; na ɔtsenaa mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Manaasɛ ne babanyin Jair sii mu kɛfaa no nkurow no na ɔfrɛɛ no Havot-jair.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Noba sii mu kɛfaa Kenat, nye no nkuroba, na ɔfrɛɛ no Noba, dɛ mbrɛ nankasa ne dzin no tse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye Israelmba akwantu a wɔnam Moses nye Aaron nsa do fi Egypt asaase do tutui dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dɔm tsetsee.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses nam EWURADZE mbrasɛm do kyerɛɛw hɔn edzifir dɛ mbrɛ hɔn akwantu mu asoɛe no tse: na iyinom nye hɔn akwantu mu asoɛe dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edzifir tse.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na bosoom a odzi kan no mu wotui fii Rameses, wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu da a otsia duenum no; apaho no ekyir adzekyee na Israelmba no dze ahosɛpɛw kɛse fiir edzi wɔ Egyptfo nyinara enyim,
title: NUMBERS

text: wɔ aber a Egyptfo risie sie hɔn mbakan nyinara a EWURADZE kunkum hɔn wɔ hɔn mu no: na hɔn enyame no so EWURADZE buu hɔn ntsɛn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba no tui fii Rameses na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Sukɔt.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Sukɔt, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Etam a ɔwɔ sar no ano no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Etam, na wɔdanee baa Pi-hahirot a ɔwɔ Baal-zefon enyim no bio: na wɔkyeer nsera wɔ Migidɔl enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Hahirot enyim, na wokotwaa mu faa po no ne finimfin kɔr sar no do: na wɔnantseew ndaansa kwan wɔ Etam sar no do, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Mara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Mara, na wɔbaa Elim: na Elim hɔ na nsunyiwa duebien, nye nkyiresua ndua eduosuon wɔ; na wɔkyeer hɔ nsera.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Elim, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Mbɛw Po a binom frɛ no Po kɔkɔɔ no ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Mbɛw Po no ho, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Sin sar do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Sin sar do, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Dofka.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Dofka, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Alus.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Alus, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Refidim, mbrɛ ɔman no ennya nsu annom no a.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Refidim, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Sinai sar do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Sinai sar do, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Kibrot-hataava.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Kibrot-hataava, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Hazerot.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Hazerot, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Ritma.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Ritma, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Rimmon-perez.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Rimmon-perez, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Libna.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Libna, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Rissa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Rissa, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Kehelata.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Kehelata, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ bepɔw Sefer do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii bepɔw Sefer do, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Harada.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Harada, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Makhelot.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Makhelot na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Tahat.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Tahat, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Tera.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Tera, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Mitka.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Mitka na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Hasmona.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Hasmona na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Maserot.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Maserot, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Bene-jaakan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Bene-jaakan, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Hor-hagidgad.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Hor-hagidgad, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Jotbata.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Jotbata, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Abrona.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Abrona, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Ezion-geber.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Ezion-geber, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Zin sar do (ɔnoara nye Kades).
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Kades, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ bepɔw Hor do, wɔ Edom asaase ano.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔsɔfo Aaron nam EWURADZE mbrasɛm do fowee kɔr bepɔw Hor do na okowui wɔ hɔ, wɔ afe a Israelmba fi Egypt asaase do firii no ekyir dza otsia eduanan no mu, bosoom a otsia enum no mu da a odzi bosoom no ne kan no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na aber a Aaron wui wɔ bepɔw Hor do no na oedzi mfe ɔha eduonu ebiasa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Keenannyi, Aradhen no a ɔtse Keenan asaase do wɔ Pomu afamu no tsee dɛ Israelmba no reba.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii bepɔw Hor ho, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Zalmona.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Zalmona, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Punon.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Punon, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Obot.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Obot, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Iye-abarim, wɔ Moab ntoaado.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Iyim, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Dibon-gad.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Dibon-gad, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Almon-diblathaim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Almon-diblathaim, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Abarim mbepɔw do, wɔ Nebo enyim.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wotui fii Abarim mbepɔw do, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu, wɔ Jeriko Jordan ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na wɔkyeer Jordan ho nsera, fi Bɛt-jesimot araa kodur Abel-Sittim wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu wɔ Jeriko Jordan ho, dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom twa Jordan kɔ Keenan asaase do a,
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔno hom mpam asaase no do atsefo no nyinara mfi hom enyim, na hom nsɛɛ hɔn abo ehonyi nyinara, na hom nsɛɛ hɔn ehonyi a woegu no nyinara, na hom ndwurudwuruw mbea sorɔnsorɔm nyinara:
title: NUMBERS

text: na hom mfa asaase no mfa, na hom ntsena do: na hom na medze asaase no ama hom dɛ hom mfa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hom ntwe tonto mfa nkyɛ asaase no dɛ mbrɛ hom ebusua ebusua tsetsee; hɔn a wɔso no hom mma hɔn egyapadze a ɔso, na hɔn a wosuar no ma hɔn egyapadze a osuar: beebiara mbrɛ tonto no abɔ nyimpa biara no hɔ na ɔnyɛ nedze; dɛ mbrɛ hom egyanom mbusuakuw tsetsee no na hom nyinya hom egyapadze.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ hom ammpam asaase no do atsefo no wɔ hom enyim a; ɔno hɔn mu hɔn a hom ama wɔaka no bɛyɛ dɛ awowɔdze wɔ hom enyiwa mu, na ayɛ dɛ nsoɛ, wɔ hom mfe mu, na woehiahia hom ho wɔ asaase a hom tse do no do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ modween dɛ mebɛyɛ hɔn no, dɛmara na mebɛyɛ hom.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Hyɛ Israelmba no mbra, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom du Keenan asaase no do a, (iyi nye asaase a ɔda hɔ ma hom dɛ egyapadze, mekyerɛ Keenan asaase no dɛ mbrɛ n’ahe tsetsee,)
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔno hom pomu afamu nkyɛn mfi Zin sar do wɔ Edom nkyɛn mu, na hom pomu ɔhe mfi Nkyen Epo ano wɔ boka afamu:
title: NUMBERS

text: na hom ɔhe no ndan mfa Akrabbim mfowee pomu afamu, na ontwa mu nkɔ Zin: na n’edzifir ndu Kades-barnea pomu afamu; na ɔnkɔ Hazar-adar, na ontwa mu nkɛfa Azmon:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔhe no mpon mfi Azmon nkɔ Egypt ɔwora ho, na n’edzifir ndu po no ano.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na anee afamu ɔhe no dze, hom wɔ po kɛse no dze yɛ ne he: iyi na ɔnyɛ hom anee ɔhe.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na iyi nyɛ hom kwaamu ɔhe: hom mfi po kɛse no ho nsan bepɔw Hor mfa:
title: NUMBERS

text: bepɔw Hor ho na hom mfi nsan mbrɛ wɔfa kɔ Hamat; na ɔhe no n’edzifir ndu Zedad:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔhe no mfir edzi nkɔ Zifron, na n’edzifir ndu Hazar-enan: iyi na ɔnyɛ hom kwaamu ɔhe.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hom nsan boka he mfa mfi Hazar-enan nkɔ Sefam:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔhe no mfi Sefam nsian nkɔ Ribla, wɔ Ain no boka afamu, na ɔhe no nsian araa nkodu Kinneret pomu afamu wɔ boka afamu:
title: NUMBERS

text: na ɔhe no nsian nkodu Jordan do, na n’edzifir ndu Nkyen Po ho: iyi nye hom asaase dɛ mbrɛ no ho ahe tsetsee.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses hyɛɛ Israelmba no mbra dɛ, Iyi nye asaase a hom ntwe ho tonto mfa nkyɛ no a EWURADZE ahyɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma mbusuakuw akron, nye ebusuakuw ɔfa no;
title: NUMBERS

text: nye Reubenmba ebusuakuw, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee nye Gadmba ebusuakuw dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw ɔfa no, woenya hɔn egyapadze:
title: NUMBERS

text: na mbusuakuw ebien no nye ebusuakuw ɔfa no enya hɔn egyapadze wɔ Jeriko Jordan egya wɔ boka afamu ɔdze kɔ wipuei no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye mbanyin a wɔnkyɛ asaase no mu mma hom no hɔn edzin: ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye Nun ne babanyin Josua.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hom nyi ebusuakuw biara mu ɔbapɔmba kor ma wɔnkyɛ asaase no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mbanyin no hɔn edzin nye yi: Juda n’ebusuakuw mu, Jefune ne babanyin Kaleb.
title: NUMBERS

text: Simeon ne mba ebusuakuw mu, Ammihud ne babanyin Semuel.
title: NUMBERS

text: Benjamin n’ebusuakuw mu, Kislon ne babanyin Elidad.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nye Dan ne mba ebusuakuw mu ɔbapɔmba, Jogli ne babanyin Bukki.
title: NUMBERS

text: Josef ne mba mu: Manaasɛ ne mba ebusuakuw mu ɔbapɔmba, Efod ne babanyin Hanniel:
title: NUMBERS

text: nye Efraim ne mba ebusuakuw mu ɔbapɔmba, Siftan ne babanyin Kemuel.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Zebulun ne mba ebusuakuw mu ɔbapɔmba, Parnak ne babanyin Elizafan.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Isakar ne mba ebusuakuw mu ɔbapɔmba, Azzan ne babanyin Paltiel.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Aser ne mba ebusuakuw mu ɔbapɔmba, Selomi ne babanyin Ahihud.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Naftali ne mba ebusuakuw mu ɔbapɔmba, Ammihud ne babanyin Pedahel.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye hɔn a EWURADZE hyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnkyɛ Keenan asaase no mu mma Israelmba no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu wɔ Jeriko Jordan do dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Hyɛ Israelmba no ma wɔmfa hɔn enyadze egyapadze no mu nkurow bi mma Levifo no ma wɔntsena mu; na nkurow no ho mfikyisaase no so hom mfa mma Levifo no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nkurow no na wɔntsena mu: na no ho mfikyisaase no ndeda ho mma hɔn fiembowa, nye hɔn ahodze, nye hɔn mbowa nyinara.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nkurow no ho mfikyisaase a hom dze bɛma Levifo no, mfi kurow no fasu ekyir nkɔ basafa ahaenum ahaenum ntwa ho nhyia.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na hom nsusu kurow no ekyir boka afamu basafa apem, nye pomu afamu basafa apem, nye anee afamu basafa apem, nye kwaamu afamu basafa apem, na kurow no nda ne finimfin. Iyi na ɔnyɛ nkurow no ho mfikyisaase mma hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nkurow no a hom dze bɛma Levifo no nyɛ guansumabew nkurow esia no a, hom dze bɛma dɛ onyimpakumfo nguan nkɔ hɔ no: na hom mfa nkurow eduanan ebien nka ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nkurow a hom dze bɛma Levifo no nyinara nyɛ nkurow eduanan awɔtwe: hom mfa nka ne mfikyisaase no ho mma hɔn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nkurow a hom bɛgye no wɔ Israelmba enyadze mu ama Levifo no ho dze, hɔn a hɔndze dɔɔ so no hɔ na hom ngye dza ɔdɔɔ so: na hɔn a hɔndze suar no hɔ na hom ngye dza osuar: obiara dɛ mbrɛ n’egyapadze a oenya no tse no na ɔmfa no nkurow no mu bi mma Levifo no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses dɛ,
title: NUMBERS

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom twa Jordan kɔ Keenan asaase do a,
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔno hom nyiyi nkurow ma ɔnyɛ guansumabew nkurow mma hom; na onyimpakumfo a oku nyimpa bi wɔ ber a ɔannhyɛ da no oeeguan akɔ hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nkurow no nyɛ hom guansumabew wɔ ɔwerdzinyi no nsamu; amma onyimpakumfo no eennwu, ma eekodu dɛ obegyina mboanofo no enyim ma woeebu no atsɛn ana.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na nkurow a hom beyi ama no nyɛ hom guansumabew nkurow esia.
title: NUMBERS

text: Hom nyi nkurow ebiasa mma wɔ Jordan egya, na nkurow ebiasa so na hom nyi mma wɔ Keenan asaase do; ɔnyɛ guansumabew nkurow.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Israelmba, nye ɔhɔho, nye ɔkwantunyi a ɔwɔ hɔn mu, nye nkurow esia yi nyɛ hɔn guansumabew: na obiara a ne nsa apa no oeeguan akɔ hɔ.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ obi dze dadze bi bɔ obi, ma owu a, ɔyɛ onyimpakumfo; oku na wonku onyimpakumfo no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ obi kitsa ɔbo a obotum eku nyimpa na ɔdze bɔ no, ma owu a, ɔyɛ onyimpakumfo: oku na wonku onyimpakumfo no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Anaa sɛ okitsa dua a obotum eku nyimpa dze bɔ no, ma owu a, ɔyɛ onyimpakumfo: oku na wonku onyimpakumfo no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no noara na onku onyimpakumfo no: sɛ ɔto no a, onku no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ ɔtan do na osun no, anaa ɔboapa tow biribi dze bɔ no ma owu;
title: NUMBERS

text: anaa enyitan do na ɔdze ne nsa dze bɔ no ma owu a: oku na wonku nyia ɔbɔ no no; ɔyɛ onyimpakumfo: bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no nku onyimpakumfo no, sɛ ɔto no a.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ osun no awerɛfir mu na nnyɛ enyitan do, anaa ɔtow adze biara ma ɔbɔ no na ɔannhyɛ da,
title: NUMBERS

text: anaa ɔdze ɔbo biara a obotum eku nyimpa, na oennhu no, na ɔtow bɔ no, ma owu, na nnyɛ ne tamfo nkyii so ɔmmpɛ no bɔn bi a:
title: NUMBERS

text: ɔno mboanofo no mbu nyia ɔbɔe nye no bɔgyaa ho ɔwerdzinyi no ntamu atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ ntsɛmbu yi tsetsee:
title: NUMBERS

text: na mboanofo no nyi onyimpakumfo no mfi bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no nsamu, na mboanofo no mfa no nsan nkɔ no guansumabew kurow no mu, mbrɛ oguanee kɔree no: na ɔnkɛtsena hɔ ma onkodu ɔsɔfopanyin a wɔdze ngo krɔnkrɔn asera no no wu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ onyimpakumfo no fir edzi aber biara tra no guansumabew kurow a oguanee kɔr hɔ no ne he do;
title: NUMBERS

text: na bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no hu no wɔ no guansumabew kurow no ne he ekyir, na bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no koku onyimpakumfo no a; onndzi bɔgya bi ho so:
title: NUMBERS

text: osiandɛ no guansumabew kurow no mu na ɔsɛ no dɛ nkyɛ ɔtsena kodu ɔsɔfopanyin no no wu do: na ɔsɔfopanyin no no wu ekyir no dze onyimpakumfo no nsan mbra n’enyadze asaase do bio.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na iyi nyɛ atsɛmbu ahyɛdze mma hom wɔ hom ebusuasantsen nyina mu wɔ hom tsenabew nyinara mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Obiara a oku nyimpa biara no, adasefo enum na wɔmfa do nku onyimpakumfo no: na ɔdasefo kor dze mma onndzi dase nntsia nyimpa biara mma onnwu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Nkyii so mma hom nngye onyimpakumfo a ɔsɛ owu no nkwa tsir mpata biara: na oku ara na wonku no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mma hom nngye nyia oeguan kɔ no guansumabew kurow mu ne tsir mpata biara dɛ ɔnsan mbɛtsena asaase no do bio, nkodu ɔsɔfo no wu do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Dɛm ntsi mma hom nngu asaase no a hom tse do no ho fi: na bɔgya ara na ogu asaase no ho fi: na wɔrennyɛ mpatadze biara mma asaase no wɔ bɔgya a woehue egu do no ntsi, gyedɛ nyia ɔkaa bɔgya gui no ara no bɔgyaa mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na mma nngu asaase a hom tse do a mo so metse ne finimfin no do fi: na emi EWURADZE na metse Israelmba finimfin.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Gilead, Makir ne babanyin, Manaasɛ ne babanyin, a wofi Josef ne mbabanyin ebusua ebusua mu egyanom efi do etsitsir no bae, na wɔbɛkasae wɔ Moses, nye mbapɔmba no, Israelmba egyanom efi do etsitsir no enyim:
title: NUMBERS

text: na wɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE hyɛɛ mo wura dɛ ɔmfa tontotwe nkyɛ asaase no mu mma Israelmba ma wɔnyɛ no egyapadze: na mo wura na EWURADZE hyɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa hɛn nua Zelofehad n’egyapadze mma ne mbabaa.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ wɔwar hɔn ma Israelmba ebusuakuw bi mu mbabanyin biara a, ɔno wonyi hɔn egyapadze no mfi hɛn egyanom egyapadze mu, na wɔmfa nkɛka ebusuakuw kor a wɔakɛyɛ hɔndze no egyapadze ho: dɛm na wonyi mfi hɛn egyapadze kyɛfa no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na sɛ Israelmba ahosɛpɛw afe no du a, ɔno wɔmfa hɔn egyapadze no nkɛka ebusuakuw kor a wɔakɛyɛ hɔndze no egyapadze ho: ma woeyi hɔn egyapadze efi hɔn egyanom ebusuakuw egyapadze no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na Moses hyɛɛ Israelmba no dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm tse, dɛ, Josef ne mbabanyin ebusuakuw no aka no tsenn.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyi nye adze a EWURADZE hyɛe wɔ Zelofehad mbabaa no ho no, dɛ, Wɔmma wɔnwarwar hɔn a wɔdwen hɔn dɛ woye no: hɔn egya n’ebusuakuw mu ebusua no ara nko na wɔnwarwar wɔ mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Amma Israelmba egyapadze biara eemmfi ebusuakuw kor mu annkɔ ebusuakuw fofor bi mu: na Israelmba no ntakyer hɔn egyanom ebusuakuw egyapadze ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Na ɔbabaa biara a onya egyapadze wɔ Israelmba ebusuakuw biara mu no, ɔnyɛ n’egya ebusuakuw mu ebusua no mu obi ne yer, ama Israelmba no eenyinya nyimpa biara n’egyanom egyapadze edzi.
title: NUMBERS

text: Amma egyapadze biara eemmfi ebusuakuw kor mu annkɔ ebusuakuw kor so mu; na Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no ntakyer hɔnankasa hɔn egyapadze ho.
title: NUMBERS

text: Mekyerɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no, dɛmara na Zelofehad ne mbabaa no yɛe:
title: NUMBERS

text: na Mahala, nye Tirza, nye Hogla, nye Milka, nye Noa, Zelofehad mbabaa no warwaar hɔn egya no nuanom mbabanyin no.
title: NUMBERS

text: Wɔwarwaar hɔn kɔr Josef ne babanyin Manaasɛ mbabanyin ebusua ebusua mu, na hɔn egyapadze no kaa hɔn egya n’ebusua ebusuakuw no mu.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye mbransɛm nye ntsɛmbu a, EWURADZE nam Moses nsa do hyɛɛ Israelmba wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu wɔ Jeriko Jordan do.
title: NUMBERS

text: Iyinom nye nsɛm a Moses kaa kyerɛɛ Israel nyinara wɔ Jordan egya sar no do, wɔ Araba Suf tsentsendo, wɔ Paran, nye Tofel, nye Laban, nye Hazerot, nye Di-zahab ntamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ofi Horeb wɔ bepɔw Seir kwan do kɔ Kades-barnea ɔyɛ nda dubiako kwan.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia eduanan no mu, bosoom a otsia dubiako no ne da a odzi kan no, Moses kasaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba no dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ no dɛ ɔnka nkyerɛ hɔn no nyinara;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: wɔber a oeku Amorifo hen Sihon a ɔtse Hesbon, nye Basanhen Ɔge a ɔtse Astarot, wɔ Edrei no ekyir no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Jordan egya wɔ Moab asaase do, na Moses hyɛɛ ase kyerɛkyerɛɛ mbra yi mu dɛ,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ hɛn wɔ Horeb dɛ, Hom atsena bepɔw yi ho akyɛr dodow:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: hom ndan homho, na hom ntu nkɔ Amorifo nkokodo nkurow mu, nye mbeambea a ɔbɛn ho hɔ nyinara, wɔ Araba, nkokodo nkurow mu, nye tɛtɛr mu, nye Pomu, nye mpoano, Keenanfo asaase do, nye Lebanon do, nkodu esutsen kɛse Eufrates no ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hwɛ, medze asaase no ato hom enyim: hom nkɔ nkɛfa asaase a EWURADZE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hom egyanom, Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob, dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɔn nye hɔn asefo a wodzi hɔn ekyir no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mekasaa kyerɛɛ hom aber no mu dɛ, Mara nkotsee runntum monnkora hom:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ama hom adɔr, na hwɛ, ndɛ da yi hom dodow tse dɛ ɔsor nworaba.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE hom egyanom Nyankopɔn, nyɛ hom dɛ mbrɛ hom tse yi mbɔho apem so nka ho, na onhyira hom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔabɔ hom anohoba no!
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mebɛyɛ dɛn monko metum asoa hom haw, nye hom adzesoa, nye hom aperper?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom nyiyi mbanyin enyansafo, nye enyimdzefo, na wɔda nsew, dɛ mbrɛ hom ebusuakuw no tsetsee, na menyɛ hɔn etsitsir wɔ hom do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom buaa me see dɛ, Dza aka no oye ma hɛn dɛ yɛyɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna mefaa hom ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu etsitsir no, mbanyin enyansafo wɔda nsew, na meyɛɛ hɔn etsitsir wɔ hom do, apem apem do asafohemfo, nye ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo, nye eduonum eduonum do asafohemfo, nye du du do asafohemfo, nye ahwɛdofo, dɛ mbrɛ hom ebusuakuw tsetsee.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mehyɛɛ hom atsɛmbuafo mbra aber no mu dɛ, Hom ntsie hom nuanom ntamu nsɛm, na hom mbu ntsɛn tsenenee wɔ nyimpa nye no nua, nye ɔhɔho a ɔnye no wɔ hɔ ntamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma hom nnhwɛ nyimpa enyim wɔ atsɛmbu mu; hom ntsie aketseaba nye ɔkɛse nyina pɛ; mma hom nnsuro nyimpa enyim; na atsɛmbu yɛ Nyankopɔn dze: na asɛm a ɔyɛ dzen dodow ma hom no na hom mfa mbrɛ me, na mintsie.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mehyɛɛ hom dza hom nyɛ no nyinara ho mbra aber no mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na yetui fii Horeb, na yɛnantsewee faa sar kɛse a ɔyɛ hu a hom hunii no nyinara do wɔ Amorifo nkokodo nkurow kwan do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ hɛn no; na yedur Kades Barnea.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mesee hom dɛ, Hom edu Amorifo nkokodo nkurow a EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn dze rema hɛn no ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze asaase no ato hom enyim: hom mfow kɔ, nkɛfa, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn aka akyerɛ hom no; mma hom nnsuro, nkyii so mma hom akoma nntu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom baa me nkyɛn, hom nyinara; na wɔsee dɛ, Ma yɛnsoma mbanyin ma wondzi hɛn enyim nkɛsera asaase no mma hɛn, na wɔmbɛka ɔkwan kor a yɛbɛfa do, nye nkurow kor a yebodu do ho asɛm nkyerɛ hɛn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na asɛm no yɛɛ me enyisɔ dɛ: na mefaa hom mu nyimpa duebien, ebusuakuw biara mu nyimpa kor:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na wɔdanee kɔfoow bepɔw no, na wokodur Eskol ɔbɔn mu, na wɔserae.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na wɔfaa asaase no do aba bi kitsae, na wɔdze sanee baa hɛn nkyɛn, na wɔbɛkaa hɛn asɛm see dɛ, Asaase a EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn dze rema hɛn no oye.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Naaso hom ammpɛ dɛ hom fow kɔ, na hom tseew EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn mbrasɛm do etua:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na hom hwinhwinii wɔ hom asesee mu see dɛ, Osiandɛ EWURADZE tan hɛn ntsi na oyii hɛn wɔ Egypt asaase do, dɛ ɔdze hɛn rebɛhyɛ Amorifo nsa, ma wɔaasɛɛ hɛn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Henfa na yɛmfa nkɔ? Hɛn enuanom etutu hɛn akoma, dɛ, Ɔman no wɔsoso na wɔwowar sen hɛn; nkurow no yɛ akɛse na wɔatotow ho afasu akɔ sor; na nkyii so yehun Anakfo mbabanyin wɔ hɔ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna mesee hom dɛ, Mma hu nnka hom, nkyii so mma hom nnsuro hɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn a odzi hom enyim rokɔ no, ɔno na ɔbɔko ama hom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛe maa hom wɔ Egypt wɔ hom enyiwa mu no nyinara;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nye sar no do, beebi a hom hun mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn sii tuur hom, dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa tur ne babanyin, wɔ kwan a hom nantsewee no nyinara mu araa dze bodur dɛ hom dur ha yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Naaso iyi mu hom anngye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn enndzi,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno a odzii hom enyim wɔ ɔkwan no mu dɛ ɔrokɔhwehwɛ beebi a ma hom abɔ asesee, wɔ gya mu adzesaa, dɛ ɔkyerɛ hom ɔkwan a hom mfa do, nye mununkum mu adzekyee.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE tsee hom nsɛm, na no bo fuwii, na ɔkaa ntam dɛ,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ampaara ebusuasantsen bɔn yi mu nyimpa yi mu biara runnhu asaase pa a mekaa ho ntam dɛ medze bɛma hom egyanom no,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: gyedɛ Jefune ne babanyin Kaleb, ɔno na obohu; na ɔno na medze asaase a oetsia do no bɛma no, nye ne mba; osiandɛ oedzi EWURADZE ekyir koraa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Eso hom ntsi EWURADZE nyaa no ho ebufuw, dɛ, Wo so ronnkɔ hɔ:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nun ne babanyin Josua a ogyina w’enyim no, ɔno na ɔbɔkɔ hɔ: hyɛ no dzen; na ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ ma Israel enya edzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so hom mbofraba no a hom se dɛ wɔbɛyɛ afonam no, nye hom mba no a ndɛ da yi wonnyi papa anaa bɔn ho nyimdzee no, hɔn na wɔbɔkɔ hɔ, na hɔn na medze mebɛma hɔn, na wɔafa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom dze, hom ndan homho, na hom ntu nkɔ sar no do wɔ Mbɛw Po kwan do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna hom buae na wɔsee me dɛ, Yɛayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE, yɛbɔfow akɔ akɔko, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ hɛn no nyinara. Na hom mu nyimpa biara dze n’akodze miamiae, na wodzii kan dɛ wɔrokɔfow akɔ bepɔw no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Se hɔn dɛ, Mma wɔmmfow, nkyii so mma wɔnnko; na minnyi hom mu; bɛyɛ na hom akɔtotɔr wɔ hom atamfo enyim.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mekasaa mekyerɛɛ hom, na hom enntsie; na hom tseew EWURADZE mbrasɛm do etua, na hom tsitsii hom enyi ho ara fowee kɔr bepɔw no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Amorifo a wɔtse bepɔw no do no fiir edzi behyiaa hom, na wotsiiw hom, dɛ mbrɛ ndowa yɛ, na wokunkum hom wɔ Seir araa kodur Horma.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom sanee na wobosui wɔ EWURADZE enyim; na EWURADZE enntsie hom ndze, na eso ɔannyɛ aso amma hom.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna hom tsenaa Kades dzii nda pii, dɛ mbrɛ nda a hom dze tsenaa hɔ tse no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna yɛdanee, na yetuu hɛn kwan kɔr sar no do wɔ Mbɛw Po kwan do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ me no: na yekyiin Seir bepɔw ho nda pii.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ me dɛ,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom ekyin bepɔw yi ho akyɛr dodow: hom ndan homho wɔ kwaamu afamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hyɛ ɔman no dɛ, Hom rubotwa mu wɔ hom nuanom Esau mba a wɔtse Seir no ntoaado; na wobosuro hom: dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ homho yie papa:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mma wɔnnye hɔn nndzi aper; na meremmfa hɔn asaase no memma hom, oho, nnyɛ mbrɛ ɔnamɔn mpo betsia a: osiandɛ medze Seir bepɔw mama Esau dɛ ɔmfa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom mfa sika ntɔ hɔn hɔ edziban, na hom eedzi; na hom mfa sika ntɔ hɔn hɔ nsu so, na hom aanom.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ehyira wo wɔ wo nsaano edwuma nyinara mu: oehu wo nantsew wɔ sar kɛse yi do: mfe eduanan yi EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn edzi w’ekyir; ennhia wo biribiara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna yetwae fi hɛn nuanom Esaumba a wɔtse Seir no ho, fi Araba kwan do fi Elat nye Ezion-geber. Na yɛdanee, na yekotwaa mu wɔ Moab sar no do kwan do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Mma nnhiahia Moab ho, nkyii so mma nnye hɔn nndzi aper nnko: na meremmfa n’asaase mu bi memma wo mma emmfa; osiandɛ medze Ar ama Lotmba dɛ wɔmfa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Emfo no na wɔtsenaa do nkan no, ɔman kɛse a wɔdɔɔ so, na wɔwowar dɛ Anakfo:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: iyinom so na wobu hɔn Refafo, dɛ Anakfo; na Moabfo dze wɔfrɛ hɔn Emfo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Horfo so na nkyɛ nkan no wɔtsenaa Seir, na Esaumba no hyɛɛ hɔn ananmu; na wɔsɛɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim, na wɔtsenaa hɔn ananmu dɛ mbrɛ Israel yɛɛ n’enyadze asaase a EWURADZE dze maa hɔn no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Afei hom nsoɛr, na hom nkotwa ɔwora Zered. Na yekotwaa ɔwora Zered.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mfe dodow a yɛdze nantsewee fi Kades-barnea bodur dɛ yebotwaa ɔwora Zered no, yɛ mfe eduasa awɔtwe; kodur dɛ akofo ebusuasantsen no nyinara wuwui wɔ nseraban no mu, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kaa ho ntam no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so EWURADZE nsa tsiaa hɔn, dɛ ɔresɛɛ hɔn efi nseraban no mu, ekodu dɛ wɔbɛhyew.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna ɔbaa dɛ, aber a akofo no nyinara hyewee na wowuwui fii ɔman no mu no,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ me dɛ,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ndɛ da yi na irubotwa mu wɔ Ar, Moab ntoaado no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na sɛ ikodu Ammonmba tsentsendo a, mma nnhiahia hɔn ho, na nnye hɔn nndzi aper so: na meremmfa Ammonmba asaase mu bi memma wo mma emmfa: osiandɛ medze mama Lotmba dɛ wɔmfa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔno so wobu no Refafo asaase; Refafo tsenaa do nkan no; na Ammonfo dze wɔfrɛ hɔn Zamzumfo;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔman kɛse a, wɔdɔɔ so, na wɔwowar dɛ Anakfo; na EWURADZE sɛɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim; na wɔhyɛɛ hɔn ananmu:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛe maa Esaumba a wɔtse Seir, aber a ɔsɛɛ Horfo wɔ hɔn enyim; na wɔhyɛɛ hɔn ananmu, na wɔtsenaa hɔn ananmu araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na Avifo a wɔtsenatsenaa nkuroba araa dze kodu Gaza mu no, Kaftorfo a, wofi Kaftor bae no, bɛsɛɛ hɔn, na wɔtsenaa hɔn ananmu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom nsoɛr, wontu hom kwan, na wonkotwa Arnon bɔnsa; hwɛ, medze Amorinyi Sihon, Hesbon hen no, nye n’asaase ahyɛ wo nsa: hyɛ ase fa, na nye no ndzi aper nko.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ndɛ da yi na mebɛhyɛ ase medze wo ho suro nye wo ho hu megu amanaman a wɔwɔ asaase nyina do a wɔbɛtse wo nka do, na hɔn ho apopo, na hɔn ho eguan hɔn wɔ wo ntsi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Kedamot sar do na mifi mosomaa abɔfo ma wɔdze asomdwee nsɛm kɔr Hesbon hen Sihon nkyɛn dɛ,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ma muntwa mu wɔ w’asaase do: ɔtsempɔn do ara na mebɛfa akɔ, merenndan mmfa enyimfa anaa abankum.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Tɔn me edziban gye sika, ma mindzi; na ma me nsu gye sika ma monnom: ma memfa m’anan kwa mumbotwa mu;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: dɛ mbrɛ Esaumba a wɔtse Seir, na Moabfo a wɔtse Ar, yɛɛ me no; ma onkodu dɛ mubotwa Jordan akɔ asaase a EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn dze rema hɛn no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Hesbonhen Sihon amma hɛn kwan dɛ yentwa mu wɔ ne nkyɛn: osiandɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn maa no asoɔdzen sunsum, na opiriim n’akoma, ama ɔdze no aahyɛ wo nsa, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Hwɛ, mahyɛ ase meyi Sihon nye n’asaase mama wɔ w’enyim: hyɛ ase fa, na enya n’asaase no edzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna Sihon fiir edzi behyiaa hɛn, ɔno nye ne man nyinara, dɛ ɔrobɔko wɔ Jahaz.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn yii no mae wɔ hɛn enyim; na yekunkum ɔno, nye ne mbabanyin, nye ne man nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na yɛfaa no nkurow nyinara aber no mu, na yɛsɛɛ kurow biara a nyimpa tse mu no pasapasa, dze kaa mbaa nye mbofraba ho; yeenngyaa biara mma ɔannka:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ofiembowa nko na hɛnara yɛfaa no afonam, dze kaa nkurow a yɛfae no mu asadze ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ofi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon ɔbɔn no ano, na ofi kurow a ɔwɔ Arnon ɔbɔn no mu no do, araa dze kɔ Gilead, kurow biara nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛɛ dzen dodow maa hɛn: EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn yii ne nyinara mae wɔ hɛn enyim:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ammonmba asaase no nko na ɔwo ammbɛn ho; esutsen Jabbok ne nkyɛn nyinara, nye nkurow a ɔwɔ nkokodo nkurow mu no, nye beebiara a EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn amma hɛn ho kwan no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna yɛdanee, na yetuu hɛn kwan kɔr sar no do wɔ Mbɛw Po kwan do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ me no: na yekyiin Seir bepɔw ho nda pii.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ me dɛ,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom ekyin bepɔw yi ho akyɛr dodow: hom ndan homho wɔ kwaamu afamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hyɛ ɔman no dɛ, Hom rubotwa mu wɔ hom nuanom Esau mba a wɔtse Seir no ntoaado; na wobosuro hom: dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ homho yie papa:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mma wɔnnye hɔn nndzi aper; na meremmfa hɔn asaase no memma hom, oho, nnyɛ mbrɛ ɔnamɔn mpo betsia a: osiandɛ medze Seir bepɔw mama Esau dɛ ɔmfa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom mfa sika ntɔ hɔn hɔ edziban, na hom eedzi; na hom mfa sika ntɔ hɔn hɔ nsu so, na hom aanom.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ehyira wo wɔ wo nsaano edwuma nyinara mu: oehu wo nantsew wɔ sar kɛse yi do: mfe eduanan yi EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn edzi w’ekyir; ennhia wo biribiara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna yetwae fi hɛn nuanom Esaumba a wɔtse Seir no ho, fi Araba kwan do fi Elat nye Ezion-geber. Na yɛdanee, na yekotwaa mu wɔ Moab sar no do kwan do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Mma nnhiahia Moab ho, nkyii so mma nnye hɔn nndzi aper nnko: na meremmfa n’asaase mu bi memma wo mma emmfa; osiandɛ medze Ar ama Lotmba dɛ wɔmfa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Emfo no na wɔtsenaa do nkan no, ɔman kɛse a wɔdɔɔ so, na wɔwowar dɛ Anakfo:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: iyinom so na wobu hɔn Refafo, dɛ Anakfo; na Moabfo dze wɔfrɛ hɔn Emfo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Horfo so na nkyɛ nkan no wɔtsenaa Seir, na Esaumba no hyɛɛ hɔn ananmu; na wɔsɛɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim, na wɔtsenaa hɔn ananmu dɛ mbrɛ Israel yɛɛ n’enyadze asaase a EWURADZE dze maa hɔn no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Afei hom nsoɛr, na hom nkotwa ɔwora Zered. Na yekotwaa ɔwora Zered.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mfe dodow a yɛdze nantsewee fi Kades-barnea bodur dɛ yebotwaa ɔwora Zered no, yɛ mfe eduasa awɔtwe; kodur dɛ akofo ebusuasantsen no nyinara wuwui wɔ nseraban no mu, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kaa ho ntam no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so EWURADZE nsa tsiaa hɔn, dɛ ɔresɛɛ hɔn efi nseraban no mu, ekodu dɛ wɔbɛhyew.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna ɔbaa dɛ, aber a akofo no nyinara hyewee na wowuwui fii ɔman no mu no,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ me dɛ,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ndɛ da yi na irubotwa mu wɔ Ar, Moab ntoaado no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na sɛ ikodu Ammonmba tsentsendo a, mma nnhiahia hɔn ho, na nnye hɔn nndzi aper so: na meremmfa Ammonmba asaase mu bi memma wo mma emmfa: osiandɛ medze mama Lotmba dɛ wɔmfa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔno so wobu no Refafo asaase; Refafo tsenaa do nkan no; na Ammonfo dze wɔfrɛ hɔn Zamzumfo;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔman kɛse a, wɔdɔɔ so, na wɔwowar dɛ Anakfo; na EWURADZE sɛɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim; na wɔhyɛɛ hɔn ananmu:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛe maa Esaumba a wɔtse Seir, aber a ɔsɛɛ Horfo wɔ hɔn enyim; na wɔhyɛɛ hɔn ananmu, na wɔtsenaa hɔn ananmu araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na Avifo a wɔtsenatsenaa nkuroba araa dze kodu Gaza mu no, Kaftorfo a, wofi Kaftor bae no, bɛsɛɛ hɔn, na wɔtsenaa hɔn ananmu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom nsoɛr, wontu hom kwan, na wonkotwa Arnon bɔnsa; hwɛ, medze Amorinyi Sihon, Hesbon hen no, nye n’asaase ahyɛ wo nsa: hyɛ ase fa, na nye no ndzi aper nko.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ndɛ da yi na mebɛhyɛ ase medze wo ho suro nye wo ho hu megu amanaman a wɔwɔ asaase nyina do a wɔbɛtse wo nka do, na hɔn ho apopo, na hɔn ho eguan hɔn wɔ wo ntsi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Kedamot sar do na mifi mosomaa abɔfo ma wɔdze asomdwee nsɛm kɔr Hesbon hen Sihon nkyɛn dɛ,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ma muntwa mu wɔ w’asaase do: ɔtsempɔn do ara na mebɛfa akɔ, merenndan mmfa enyimfa anaa abankum.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Tɔn me edziban gye sika, ma mindzi; na ma me nsu gye sika ma monnom: ma memfa m’anan kwa mumbotwa mu;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: dɛ mbrɛ Esaumba a wɔtse Seir, na Moabfo a wɔtse Ar, yɛɛ me no; ma onkodu dɛ mubotwa Jordan akɔ asaase a EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn dze rema hɛn no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Hesbonhen Sihon amma hɛn kwan dɛ yentwa mu wɔ ne nkyɛn: osiandɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn maa no asoɔdzen sunsum, na opiriim n’akoma, ama ɔdze no aahyɛ wo nsa, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Hwɛ, mahyɛ ase meyi Sihon nye n’asaase mama wɔ w’enyim: hyɛ ase fa, na enya n’asaase no edzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna Sihon fiir edzi behyiaa hɛn, ɔno nye ne man nyinara, dɛ ɔrobɔko wɔ Jahaz.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn yii no mae wɔ hɛn enyim; na yekunkum ɔno, nye ne mbabanyin, nye ne man nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na yɛfaa no nkurow nyinara aber no mu, na yɛsɛɛ kurow biara a nyimpa tse mu no pasapasa, dze kaa mbaa nye mbofraba ho; yeenngyaa biara mma ɔannka:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ofiembowa nko na hɛnara yɛfaa no afonam, dze kaa nkurow a yɛfae no mu asadze ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ofi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon ɔbɔn no ano, na ofi kurow a ɔwɔ Arnon ɔbɔn no mu no do, araa dze kɔ Gilead, kurow biara nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛɛ dzen dodow maa hɛn: EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn yii ne nyinara mae wɔ hɛn enyim:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ammonmba asaase no nko na ɔwo ammbɛn ho; esutsen Jabbok ne nkyɛn nyinara, nye nkurow a ɔwɔ nkokodo nkurow mu no, nye beebiara a EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn amma hɛn ho kwan no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na afei, Israel, hom ntsie ahyɛdze nye atsɛmbu a mekyerɛkyerɛ hom dɛ hom nyɛ no; na hom eenya nkwa, na hom akɔ akɛfa asaase a EWURADZE, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn dze rema hom no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma hom mmfa hwee nnka asɛm a merehyɛ hom yi ho, nkyii so mma hom nyi do bi, na hom eedzi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn mbransɛm a merehyɛ hom yi do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom enyiwa ehu dza osian Baal-peor ntsi EWURADZE yɛe; na nyimpa a wodzii Baal-peor ekyir no nyinara, EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn asɛɛ hɔn efi hom mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom a hom takyeer EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ho no dze, hom nyinara tse ase ndɛ da yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hwɛ makyerɛkyerɛ hom ahyɛdze nye ntsɛmbu, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ me no ara, dɛ hom nyɛ dɛm wɔ asaase a hom rokɔ do akɛfa no mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ndzi do na hom nyɛ; na iyi nye hom nyansaa nye hom ntseasee wɔ aman a wɔbɛtse ahyɛdze yi nyinara enyim, na wɔbɛse dɛ, Ampaara ɔman kɛse yi yɛ nyansa nye nyimdzee man.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔman kɛse bɛn na ɔwɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ nyame a ɔbɛn hɔn dɛm, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn tse wɔ aber biara a yɛfrɛ no no?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔman kɛse bɛn na ɔwɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ ahyɛdze nye atsɛmbu tsenenee dɛ mbrɛ mbra yi nyinara a medze risi hom enyim ndɛ da yi tse?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom ho yie ara na nhwɛ, na hom nsie hom kra yie, bɛyɛ na hom werɛ efir ndzɛmba a enyiwa hunii no, na bɛyɛ na efi hom akoma mu hom nkwa nda nyinara mu; mbom ma wo mba nye wo mba hɔn mba nhu;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: da a hom gyinaa EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn enyim wɔ Horeb, aber a EWURADZE see me dɛ, Boaboa ɔman no ano ma me, na memma wontsie me nsɛm, na woeesuasua dɛ wosuro me wɔ nda a wɔdze tse ase wɔ asaase do nyinara, na wɔdze akyerɛkyerɛ hɔn mba no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom twee pinii na hom begyinaa bepɔw no ase; ber a bepɔw no dzɛɛw gya kɔr sor tɔnn, sum, mununkum, nye sum kebii.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE fi gya no mu kasaa kyerɛɛ hom: hom tsee ne nsɛm ndze, na no su dze hom ennhu; ne ndze nko na hom tsee.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔkaa n’ahyɛmu a ɔhyɛɛ hom dɛ hom nyɛ no kyerɛɛ hom, mekyerɛ mbransɛm du no; na ɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ abopon ebien do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE hyɛɛ me aber no mu dɛ menkyerɛkyerɛ hom ahyɛdze nye ntsɛmbu, na hom aayɛ no wɔ asaase a hom rutwa mu akɛfa no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ homho yie papa; osiandɛ hom ennhu su biara da no a EWURADZE fi ogya no mu kasaa kyerɛɛ hom wɔ Horeb no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: bɛyɛ na hom asɛɛ homho, na hom ayɛ ohonyi a wɔasen wɔ adze biara no su mu ama hom ho, ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa saso,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: abowa biara a ɔwɔ asaase do ne saso, etubowa biara a otu wɔ wimu ne saso,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: adze biara a ɔwea famu ne saso, nam biara a ɔwɔ nsu mu wɔ asaase ase ne saso:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na bɛyɛ na hom ama hom enyiwa do wɔ sor, na sɛ hom hu ewia nye bosoom, nye nworaba, mekyerɛ sor dɔm no nyinara a, wɔatwe hom ma hom akɔsɔr hɔn, na asom hɔn, dza EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ahyehyɛ ama aman nyinara wɔ asaase nyina do no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom dze, EWURADZE afa hom, na oeyi hom efi dadze fononoo mu, efi Egypt dɛ hom mbɛyɛ n’egyapadze mma no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so hom ntsi EWURADZE nyaa me ebufuw, na ɔkaa ntam dɛ murunntwa Jordan, na moronnkɔ asaase pa no a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Emi dze muruwu wɔ asaase yi do, murunntwa Jordan: na hom dze wobotwa, na wɔakɛfa asaase pa no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom nhwɛ hom ho yie, bɛyɛ na hom werɛ efir EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ahyɛmu a ɔnye hom dzii no, na hom ayɛ ohonyi a wɔasen wɔ adze bi a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn abra wo no su do ama woho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn yɛ ogya a ɔmen, Nyame nyinkufo a.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ hom wowo mba, na hom mba so wo mba, na hom kyɛr wɔ asaase no do, na hom sɛɛ homho, na wɔyɛ ohonyi a wɔasen wɔ adze biara no su do, na hom yɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn enyiwa do, dze yi no ebufuw a:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mefrɛ sor nye asaase dɛ wondzi hom dase ndɛ da yi, dɛ ɔhera na hom bɛhera ntsɛmara wɔ asaase a hom rutwa Jordan akɛfa no do; hom nda ronnwar wɔ do, mbom ɔsɛɛ na hom bɛsɛɛ pasapasa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE bɔbɔ hom apetse aman mu, na ɔbɛka hom nyimpa kakrabaabi wɔ amanaman mu mbrɛ EWURADZE begya hom akɔ no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hɔ na hom bɔsom enyame, nyimpa nsaano edwuma, ndua nye abo a wonnhu, wɔnntse, wonndzidzi, wonnhua.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ hom fi hɔ hwehwɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn a, hom bohu no, sɛ hom dze hom akoma nyinara nye hom kra nyinara hwehwɛ n’ekyir kwan a.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ hom wɔ ahohia mu, na ndzɛmba yi nyinara ba hom do a, nda a odzi ekyir no mu no nsan mbra EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na hom ntsie ne ndze:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn yɛ mbɔbɔrhufo Nyankopɔn; ɔremmpa hom, nkyii so ɔrennsɛɛ hom, no werɛ rimmfir hom egyanom ahyɛmu a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn no so.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na afei hom nkaa tsetse nda a etwa mu kɔ no, fitsi da a Nyankopɔn bɔɔ nyimpa wɔ asaase do, na ofi ɔsor n’ano kor kodu kor so, kyerɛ dɛ biribi esi a ɔtse dɛ mbrɛ adze kɛse yi tse, anaa wɔatse dza ɔnye no sɛ?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ana ɔman bi atse Nyankopɔn ndze dɛ ofi gya mu rekasa pɛn, dɛ mbrɛ hom atse no, na woenya nkwa?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ana Nyankopɔn asɔ ahwɛ dɛ ɔbɔkɔ akɛfa ɔman bi efi ɔman kor so bi mu afa, wɔ nsɔhwɛ, nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye anwanwadze, nye ɔsa, nye nsa a ɔyɛ dzen, nye abasa a wɔatserɛw mu, nye suro akɛse mu, dɛ mbrɛ dza EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn yɛe maa hom wɔ Egypt wɔ hom enyiwa mu no nyinara tsetsee a?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom na wɔdze kyerɛɛ hom, ma hom eehu dɛ EWURADZE nye Nyankopɔn; obi nnyi hɔ bio ka no ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ofi sor maa hom tsee ne ndze, ma ɔaakyerɛkyerɛ hom: na asaase do na ɔmaa hun ne gya kɛse no; na ofi gya no mu na etsee ne nsɛm.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na osiandɛ ɔdɔɔ hom egyanom ntsi, na ɔpaa hɔn asefo a wodzi hɔn ekyir no na ɔdze n’enyim nye no tum kɛse no, yii hom fii Egypt;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: dɛ orubotutu amanaman a wɔyɛ akɛse na wɔyɛ dzen sen hom efi enyim, dɛ ɔdze hom rokɔ mu, dze hɔn asaase akɛma hom dɛ ewungyadze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nhu ndɛ da yi, na hom mfa nto hom akoma mu, dɛ EWURADZE nye Nyankopɔn wɔ sor nye asaase do: na obi nnyi hɔ bio.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom ndzi dzi n’ahyɛdze, nye ne mbransɛm a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi do, na eesi hom yie, na ɔnye hom mba a wodzi ekyir, na hom nda aawar wɔ asaase a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze rema hom no do daa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna Moses yiyii nkurow ebiasa wɔ Jordan egya a odzi ba wipuei no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: dɛ onyimpakumfo a okum no nyɛnko awerɛfir mu, na ɔnntan no dada bi no, nguan nkɔ hɔ; na sɛ oguan kɔ nkurow yi kor mu a, oeenya nkwa:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno nye yi, oyii Bezer wɔ sar no do, wɔ ɔman tɛtɛr no mu maa Reubenfo; na Ramot wɔ Gilead, maa Gadfo; na Golan wɔ Basan maa Manaasɛfo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na iyi nye mbra a Moses dze too Israelmba enyim:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: iyinom nye dase, nye ahyɛdze, nye ntsɛmbu a Moses kaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba, wɔ aber a wofii Egypt bae no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: wɔ Jordan egya, Bɛt-peor tsentsendo ɔbɔn no mu, wɔ Amorifo hen Sihon a ɔtsenaa Hesbon a Moses nye Israelmba kum no wɔ aber a wofii Egypt bae no, n’asaase do:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na wɔfaa n’asaase no yɛɛ hɔndze, na Basan hen Ɔge asaase no Amorifo ahemfo beenu no a wɔwɔ Jordan egya a odzi ba wipuei no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ofi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon ano no araa dze kodu bepɔw Sion a ɔnoara nye Hermon no ho,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nye Araba nyinara wɔ Jordan egya boka afamu, mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu Araba epo ho, wɔ Pisga ntserɛwee ase.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Moses frɛɛ Israel nyinara, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Israel, hom ntsie ahyɛdze nye atsɛmbu a mereka no hom asomu ndɛ da yi, na hom eesua, na wɔaadwen do ayɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn nye hɛn dzii ahyɛmu wɔ Horeb.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nnyɛ hɛn egyanom na EWURADZE nye hɔn dzii ahyɛmu yi, mbom hɛn a, hɛnara a ndɛ da yi hɛn nyinara tsetse ase ha yi a.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE fii ogya no mu nye hom kasaa enyim nye enyim wɔ bepɔw no ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Emi dze migyinaa EWURADZE nye hom ntamu aber no mu, dɛ merekyerɛ hom EWURADZE asɛm; na osian gya no ntsi hom suroi, na wɔammfow bepɔw no na ɔsee dɛ:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Emi nye EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn a miyii wo fii Egypt asaase do, wɔ nkowaasom ofi mu no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nnya enyame bi so nnka mo ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nnyɛ ohonyi bi, adze a ɔwɔ wimu ɔsor, anaa dza ɔwɔ asaase do famu, anaa dza ɔwɔ nsu mu wɔ asaase ase no su biara ne saso mma woho:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mma mmbɔ wo mu adze mma hɔn, na nnsom hɔn: na emi EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn meyɛ Nyame nyinkufo a medze egyanom hɔn emumuyɛ mohwɛ mba kodu ebusuasantsen ebiasa nye anan a wɔtan me do;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na muhu mpempem a wɔdɔ me na wodzi me mbransɛm do no mbɔbɔr.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma mmbɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dzin gyangyan na EWURADZE nnkɛma nyia ɔbɔ ne dzin gyangyan no afa noho tɔtrɔtɔ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dwen ahomgyeda no do sie no krɔnkrɔn, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ wo no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nda esia na yɛ edwuma na dzi wo dwuma nyinara:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na da a otsia esuon no yɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ahomgyeda: mma nnyɛ edwuma biara wɔ mu, ɔwo o, wo babanyin o, wo babaa o, w’akowaa o, w’afonabaa o, wo nantwi o, w’asoaso o, wo fiembowa mu biara o, wo hɔhoe a ɔwɔ wo kuropon mu o; ama w’akowaa nye w’afonabaa aahom dɛ ɔwo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na kaa dɛ ɔwo yɛɛ akowaa wɔ Egypt asaase do, na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze nsa a ɔyɛ dzen nye abasa a wɔatsɛw mu yii wo fii hɔ: dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ wo dɛ sie ahomgyeda no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dzi w’egya nye wo na nyi, dɛ mbrɛ wo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ wo no: na wo nda aawar, na eesi wo yie, wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nndzi ewu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so nnto awar.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so nnwia adze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so nngye wo nyɛnko ho dasewia.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so mma w’enyi mmber wo nyɛnko yer; nkyii so mma wo kɔn nndɔ wo nyɛnko fi, ne haban, anaa n’akowaa, anaa n’afonabaa, ne nantwi, anaa n’asoaso, anaa adze biara a ɔyɛ wo nyɛnko dze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nsɛm yi na EWURADZE fi ogya, mununkum nye sum kebii no mu, dze ndze kɛse kaa kyerɛɛ hom baguaa no nyinara wɔ bepɔw no do: na wɔammfa bi annka ho. Na ɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ abopon ebien do, na ɔdze maa me.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a hom tsee ndze no wɔ sum no mu, wɔ aber a bepɔw no dzɛɛw gya no, hom twee piin me nkyɛn, mekyerɛ hom ebusuakuw mu etsitsir nyinara, nye hom mpanyimfo;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na hom see dɛ, Hwɛ, EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn eyi n’enyimnyam nye ne kɛseyɛ akyerɛ hɛn, na yɛatse ne ndze wɔ gya no mu: ndɛ da yi na yeehu dɛ Nyankopɔn nye nyimpa kasa, naaso ɔtsena ase.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi afei ebɛnadze ntsi na yenwu? Osiandɛ gya kɛse yi rebɛhyew hɛn: sɛ yɛtse EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ndze bio a, ɔno yebowuwu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na honam nyinara mu woana na ɔatse Nyankopɔn tseasefo ndze dɛ ofi ogya mu rekasa, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn yɛatse yi, na ɔtsena ase?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Woara twe pin, na tsie dza EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn bɛse nyinara: na woara bɛka dza EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn bɛka akyerɛ wo nyinara kyerɛ hɛn; na yebetsie, na yɛayɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE tsee hom nsɛm no ndze, aber a hom kasaa kyerɛɛ me no; na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Matse ɔman yi nsɛm no a wɔaka akyerɛ wo no ndze: dza wɔaka no nyinara, wɔase no yie.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ao kɛtseankyɛ woeenya dɛm akoma wɔ hɔn mu, dɛ wɔdze bosuro me, na woedzi me mbransɛm nyinara do daa daa, na eesi hɔn na ɔnye hɔn mba yie daa!
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Kɔ kɛse hɔn dɛ, Hom nsan nkɔ hom asesee mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔwo dze, gyina me nkyɛn ha, na menka mbrasɛm, nye ahyɛdze, nye atsɛmbu a edze bɛkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn no nyinara menkyerɛ wo, na wɔnyɛ no wɔ asaase a medze rema hɔn dɛ wɔmfa no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ndwen do nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ahyɛ hom no: mma hom nndan mmfa enyimfa anaa abankum.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom nnantsew kwan no a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ahyɛ hom no nyinara mu, na hom aatsena ase, na eesi hom yie, na hom nda aawar wɔ asaase a hom rekɛfa no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Afei iyi nye mbrasɛm, ahyɛdze, nye atsɛmbu a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa nkyerɛkyerɛ hom, na hom nyɛ no wɔ asaase a hom rutwa mu akɛfa no do:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na eesuro EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, eedzi n’ahyɛdze nye ne mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo yi nyinara do, ɔwo, nye wo babanyin, nye wo babanyin ne babanyin, wo nkwa nda nyinara; na wo nda aawar.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi, Israel tsie, na dwen do yɛ; na eesi wo yie, na hom aadɔr pii, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE, w’egyanom Nyankopɔn abɔ wo anohoba no, wɔ asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Israel, tsie: EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ EWURADZE kor:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na fa w’akoma nyinara, na ɔnye wo kra nyinara na ɔnye w’ahoɔdzen nyinara dɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na nsɛm yi a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi, ɔnko w’akoma do;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na fa kyerɛkyerɛ wo mba yie, na twetwe ho nkɔmbɔ aber a etse wo fie, nye aber a enam ɔkwan mu, nye aber a ereda, nye aber a erosoɛr.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na fa yɛ asɛnkyerɛdze bɔ w’abaw do, na ɔnyɛ w’enyiwa ntamu nkaakyekyeree.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na kyerɛw no wɔ wo fie mpondua ho, nye wo mbobotsen ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze wo du asaase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w’egyanom, Abraham, Isaak nye Jakob, dɛ ɔdze rema wo no do; nkurow akɛse fɛɛfɛw a nnyɛ ɔwo na ekyekyeree,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nye adan a ndzepa nyinara ahyɛ no amaama a nnyɛ ɔwo na edze hyɛɛ mu, nye mbura a woetutu a nnyɛ ɔwo na itutui, wenyin nture nye olive ndua a nnyɛ ɔwo na etsetsɛwee, na sɛ idzidzi na emee a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno hwɛ yie bɛyɛ na wo werɛ efir EWURADZE a oyii wo fii Egypt asaase do, wɔ nkowaasom ofi mu no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Suro EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn; na ɔno na som no, na ka ne dzin ho ntam.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma hom nndzi enyame fofor a wofi aman a woetwa hom ho ehyia no enyame mu ekyir;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔwɔ wo mu no yɛ Nyame nyinkufo; bɛyɛ na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ebufuw adzɛw wɔ wo do, na ɔasɛɛ wo efi asaase enyi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma hom nnsɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ, dɛ mbrɛ hom sɔɔ no hwɛe wɔ Massa no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom ndzi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne mbransɛm, nye ne dasesɛm, nye n’ahyɛdze a ɔdze ahyɛ wo no do yie.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na yɛ dza ɔtsen na oye wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do; na eesi wo yie, na aakɔ akɛfa asaase pa a EWURADZE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w’egyanom no,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na eetu w’atamfo nyinara efi w’enyim, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE aka no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ daakye bi wo babanyin bisa wo dɛ, Dasesɛm nye ahyɛdze, nye atsɛmbu a EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn dze hyɛɛ hom yi ase nye dɛn a?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔno se wo ba no dɛ, Nna yɛyɛ Farao no nkowaa wɔ Egypt; na EWURADZE dze nsa a ɔyɛ dzen yii hɛn fii Egypt:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na EWURADZE kyerɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze, akɛse yayaayaw, wɔ Egypt, Farao, nye ne fi nyinara do, wɔ hɛn enyiwa mu:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na oyii hɛn fii hɔ dɛ ɔdze hɛn reba, dze asaase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom abɛma hɛn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE hyɛɛ hɛn dɛ yɛnyɛ ahyɛdze yi nyinara, yensuro EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn, wɔ hɛn yie ntsi, na ɔaagye hɛn nkwa, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ tsenenee ama hɛn, sɛ yɛdwen do dzi mbrasɛm yi nyinara do wɔ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim, dɛ mbrɛ ɔahyɛ hɛn no a.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze hom du asaase a hom rokɔ akɛfa no do, na ɔpam amanaman pii wɔ hom enyim, Hitifo, Gergasfo, Amorifo, Keenanfo, Perizfo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo, amanaman esuon a wɔyɛ akɛse na wɔyɛ dzen sen hom no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na sɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn yi hɔn ma wɔ hom enyim, na hom ku hɔn a; ɔno hom nsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa; mma hom nnye hɔn nndzi ahyɛmu, na mma hom nnhu hɔn mbɔbɔr so:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nkyii so mma hom nnye hɔn nndzi awarwar; mma mmfa hom mbabaa mma hom mbabanyin, mma hom nngye hɔn mbabaa so awar mma hom mbabanyin.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na wɔbɛdan hom mbabanyin enyi ma woeegyaa m’ekyir dzi, na waakɔsom enyame fofor; ma EWURADZE ebufuw adzɛw hom do, na ɔasɛɛ hom ntsɛm.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mbom mbrɛ hom nye hɔn ndzi no nye yi; hom ndwuruw hɔn afɔrmbukyia na wombubu hɔn edum mu esinesin, na wontwitwa hɔn abosompɔw Aserim no ngu, na wɔmfa gya nhyew hɔn ehonyi a wɔasen no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom yɛ ɔman krɔnkrɔn ma EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn: EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi hom dɛ bɛyɛ nankasa no soronko ɔman wɔ aman a wɔwɔ asaase enyi nyinara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nnyɛ dɛ hom dodow so sen ɔman biara ntsi na EWURADZE dze no dɔ sii hom do, na eso ɔsaan mu yii hom: na hom suar dodow wɔ aman nyinara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mbom osiandɛ EWURADZE dɔ hom, na ɔpɛ dɛ odzi ne ntam a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hom egyanom no do ntsi, na EWURADZE dze nsa a ɔyɛ dzen eyi hom, na ɔapon hom efi no mu, wɔ Egypthen Farao nsamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nhu dɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, ɔno nye Nyankopɔn; Nyame nokwafo a osie ahyɛmu nye mbɔbɔrhu ma hɔn a wɔdɔ no na wodzi ne mbransɛm do dze kodu ebusuasantsen apem do;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na otua hɔn a wɔtan no kaw dze bɔ hɔn enyim, dze sɛɛ hɔn: ɔrennyɛ nyaa mma nyia ɔtan no, obotua no kaw dze abɔ enyim.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi dzi mbrasɛm, nye atsɛmbu a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi do, na yɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, osiandɛ hom tsie atsɛmbu yi, na wodzi do, na wɔyɛ no, EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn so bedzi ahyɛmu nye mbɔbɔrhu a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hom egyanom no do ama hom:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ɔbɔdɔ hom, na oehyira hom, na ɔama hom adɔr: na so oehyira hom honam mu aba na hom asaase mu aba, hom eburow nye hom nsa hom wo ngo, hom anantwi mu ngu mu nye hom nguankuw mu mburwa, wɔ asaase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hom egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma hom no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Wobehyira hom asen aman nyinara: ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa anaa hom fiembowa biar rennyɛ ɔbɔnyin wɔ hom mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE beyi yarba nyinara efi hom do; na ɔremmfa Egypt yarba bɔn a hom nyim no bi nnto hom do, na ɔdze bɔto hɔn a wɔtan hom nyinara do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom bɛhyew aman a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn beyi hɔn ama hom no nyinara; mma hom enyi nnhu hɔn mbɔbɔr: nkyii so mma hom nnsom hɔn enyame; na ɔno bɛyɛ efir ama hom.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ hom se wɔ hom akoma mu dɛ, Amanaman yi dɔɔ so sen hɛn; na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yeetum etu hɔn a,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mma nnsuro hɔn: kaa dza EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze yɛɛ Farao, nye Egypt nyinara no yie;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nsɔhwɛ akɛse no a hom enyiwa hunii, nye nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye anwanwadze, nye nsa a ɔyɛ dzen, nye abasa a wɔatserɛw mu a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze yii hom no: dɛmara na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn bɛyɛ aman a hom suro hɔn no nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn bɔsoma nkotokrodo wɔ hɔn mu, ekodu dɛ hɔn a wɔaka, na woesuma hɔnho no, bɛhera wɔ hom enyim.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma hɔn ho nnyɛ hom hu: na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn wɔ hom finimfin, Nyame kɛse a no ho yɛ hu no a.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn bɛpam amanaman no efi hom enyim nkakrankakra: mma hom nnhyew hɔn prɛko, bɛyɛ na haban mu mbowa adɔɔ so hom wo do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn beyi hɔn ama wɔ hom enyim, na ɔdze ɔkogu kɛse bɛka hɔn egu, ekodu dɛ wɔbɛsɛɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na obeyi hɔn ahemfo ahyɛ hom nsa, na hom aama hɔn dzin ayera efi wiadze: nyimpa biara runntum nngyina hom enyim, ekodu dɛ hom asɛɛ hɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom mfa gya nhyew hɔn enyame ehonyi a wɔasen no: mma hom enyi mmber hɔn ho dwetɛ anaa sika, na so mma hom nnyiyi mmfa, bɛyɛ na woesua hom efir wɔ mu: na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na mma hom mmfa ekyiwadze nnkɔ hom fie, na hom aannyɛ ebusudze dɛ ɔno: ma ɔnyɛ hom tantan koraa, na hom nkyir hɔn koraa: na ɔyɛ ebusudze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara hom ndwen do nyɛ, na hom aatsena ase, na wɔaadɔr, na wɔaakɔ akɛfa asaase a EWURADZE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hom egyanom no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom nkaa ɔkwan nyinara a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn egya wo wɔ mu mfe eduanan yi wɔ sar no do no, dɛ ɔrebrɛ hom adze, asɔ hom ahwɛ, ehu dza ɔwɔ hom akoma mu, dɛ hom bedzi ne mbransɛm do, anaa oho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbrɛɛ hom adze, na ɔmaa ɔkɔm dzee hom, na ɔdze manna a hom nnyim, na hom egyanom so nnyim maa hom dzii; na ɔaama hom ehu dɛ nnyɛ edziban nko bi na nyimpa nam do tsena ase, na asɛm biara a ofi EWURADZE anomu so nyimpa nam do tsena ase.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom nkataho ennsuw wɔ hom ho, nkyii so w’anan annhohon mfe eduanan yi mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na dwen wɔ w’akoma mu dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa tsea ne ba no, dɛmara so na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn tsea wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom ndzi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne mbransɛm do, dɛ hom bɛnantsew n’akwan do, na hom esuro no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze hom rokɔ asaase pa do, asaase a no do wɔ nworansu, nsunyiwa nye ebun a ofifi abɔn nye akoko mu pem no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: asaase a ewifua nye atoko, nye wenyinndua nye adɔmbandua nye pɔmegranate ekutu wɔ do; asaase a olive na ewo wɔ do no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: asaase a irinndzi edziban a wɔ do, adze biara so rinnhia wo wɔ do; asaase a n’abo yɛ dadze, na n’akokoe mu na hom botu boran.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ hom bedzidzi mee a, hom nhyira EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn wɔ asaase pa a ɔdze ama hom no ntsi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom nhwɛ yie ɔno bɛyɛ na hom werɛ efir EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dɛ hom rinndzi ne mbransɛm, nye ne ntsɛmbu nye n’ahyɛdze a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi do:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: bɛyɛ so na hom edzidzi amee, na hom esisi adan fɛɛfɛw, atsenatsena mu;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na sɛ hom anantwikuw nye hom nguankuw adɔr, na hom dwetɛ nye hom sika adɔɔ so, na adze a hom wɔ nyinara adɔɔ so a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nkyɛ hom akoma amema no ho do, na hom werɛ efir EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn a oyii hom fii Egypt asaase do, wɔ nkowaasom ofi mu no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nyia ogyaa hom faa sar kɛse huhuhuhu no do, mbrɛ mbowatsena a bɔr wɔ hɔn ano nye nyankoma nketsebowa wɔ, nye asaase kwawee mbrɛ nsu nnyi; nyia oyi nsu fii ɔtwerɛbo botan mu maa hom;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nyia ɔdze manna a hom egyanom nnyim nyɛɛn hom wɔ sar no do; dɛ ɔdze rebrɛ hom adze, na ɔasɔ hom ahwɛ, na ɔayɛ hom yie wɔ hom ewiei ekyir no mu:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na sɛ wɔ hom akoma mu dɛ, Hɛn tum nye hɔn nsa ne dzen na wɔama yenya ahonya yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom nkaa EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, na ɔno na ɔmaa hom tum dɛ hom mfa nya homho; na ɔaama n’ahyɛmu a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hom egyanom no etsim, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ hom werɛ fir EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, na hom kedzi enyame fofor ekyir, na esom hɔn, na hom sɔr hɔn a, midzi hom dase ndɛ da yi, dɛ ɔsɛɛ na hom bɛsɛɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE sɛɛ amanaman fi hom enyim no, dɛmara na hom bɛsɛɛ; osiandɛ hom enntsie EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ndze no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Israel, tsie: rubotwa Jordan ndɛ da yi, akɔ akɛfa amanaman a wɔyɛ akɛse na wɔyɛ dzen sen ɔwoara, nkurow akɛse a wɔatotow ho afasu edu sor,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔman a wɔyɛ akɛse na wɔwowaree, Anakfo mbabanyin a inyim hɔn, na atse dɛ wɔka no hɔn ho dɛ, Woana na obotum egyina Anak mbabanyin no enyim?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi hu ndɛ da yi, dɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn nye nyia odzi w’enyim rukotwa dɛ ogya a ɔmemen; ɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn, na ɔabrɛ hɔn adze wɔ w’enyim ma eetu hɔn, na ama wɔaasɛɛ ntsɛm, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE aka akyerɛ wo no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enya etu hɔn efi w’enyim egu no, mma nnka wɔ w’akoma mu dɛ, Me ndzeyɛtsenenee ntsi na EWURADZE dze me aba dɛ mebɛfa asaase yi: naaso na amanaman yi hɔn ndzebɔnyɛ ntsi na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn rutu hɔn efi w’enyim.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nnyɛ wo ndzeyɛtsenenee, anaa w’akoma ne tsenenee ntsi na erokɔ akɛfa hɔn asaase: mbom amanaman yi hɔn ndzebɔnyɛ ntsi na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn rutu hɔn efi w’enyim, na ɔaama asɛm a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w’egyanom, Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob no etsim.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi hu dɛ nnyɛ wo ndzeyɛtsenenee bi ntsi na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze asaase pa yi rema wo dɛ fa; na ɔman akɔnkyefo nye wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Kaa, mma wo werɛ mmfir, mbrɛ isii yii EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ebufuw wɔ sar no do; ofi da a ifii Egypt asaase do edze bodur dɛ hom baa bea yi do yi, hom atsew etua wɔ EWURADZE do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Horeb so hom yii EWURADZE ebufuw, na EWURADZE no bo fuuw hom dɛ nkyɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ hom.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Aber a mofoow bepɔw no dɛ merekɛgye abopon no, mekyerɛ ahyɛmu a EWURADZE nye hom dzii n’apon no, nna metsenaa bepɔw no do adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa; menndzi edziban mannom nsu so.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE dze abopon ebien a wɔdze Nyankopɔn nsatseaba akyerɛw do no maa me; na no do na wɔakyerɛw nsɛm no nyinara a ofi gya mu wɔ bepɔw no do nye hom kasae wɔ nguabɔ da no mu no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa n’ewiei no, EWURADZE dze abopon ebien no, mekyerɛ ahyɛmu apon no, maa me.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Soɛr, fi ha sian ntsɛm; na wo man a ikeyii hɔn wɔ Egypt no asɛɛ hɔnho; wɔadan efi ɔkwan a mehyɛɛ hɔn no do ntsɛm; wɔayɛ ohonyi a woegu ama hɔnho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ me dɛ, Mehu ɔman yi, na, hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman asoɔdzenfo:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: gyaa me ma mensɛɛ hɔn, na mempepa hɔn dzin mfi ɔsor ase: na menyɛ wo ɔman a ɔyɛ dzen na ɔso sen hɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna medanee na mifii bepɔw no do sianee, na bepɔw no dzɛɛw gya: nna ahyɛmu apon ebien no kitsakitsa me nsamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mohwɛe, na, hwɛ, hom ayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn; hom ayɛ ɔnantwiba a woegu ama hom ho: hom adan efi ɔkwan a EWURADZE hyɛɛ hom no do afa nkyɛn ntsɛm.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na musuoo apon ebien no mu, na motowee fii me nsa ebien no mu gui, na mobobɔɔ no wɔ hom enyim.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mohwee ase wɔ EWURADZE enyim, dɛ ahyɛse no, adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa; menndzi edziban, mannom nsu so; osian hom bɔn nyinara a hom yɛe no ntsi, dɛ wɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dze yii no ebufuw.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na musuroo ebufuw nye ebufuhyew a EWURADZE nyaa no hom ho dɛ ɔdze rebɛsɛɛ hom no. Na EWURADZE tsiee me aber no mu so.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE nyaa Aaron ho ebufuw dodoodow dɛ nkyɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ no; na mepaa kyɛw maa Aaron so aber no ara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mefaa hom bɔn a ɔyɛ ɔnantwiba no a hom yɛe no, ma medze gya hyeew no, na misiwii, nyaam no mokomoko kodur dɛ ɔyɛɛ fekɔfekɔ dɛ huntuma: na motoow no huntuma no guu ɔwora no a ofi bepɔw no do pem no mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Tabera, nye Massa, nye Kibrot-hataava so hom yii EWURADZE ebufuw.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na aber a EWURADZE somaa hom fi Kades-barnea, dɛ, Hom mfow nkɛfa asaase a medze mama hom no, nna hom tseew etua wɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn mbrasɛm do, na hom anngye no enndzi, na woenntsie ne ndze so.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom ayɛ EWURADZE do etuatsewfo ara fi da a muhun hom no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi na mohwee ase wɔ EWURADZE enyim adzekyee nye adzesaa adaduanan; osiandɛ EWURADZE ase dɛ ɔrebɛsɛɛ hom.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mepaa EWURADZE kyɛw, see dɛ, Ao EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, mma nnsɛɛ wo man nye w’egyapadze a enam wo kɛseyɛ do apon hɔn a edze nsa a ɔyɛ dzen eyi hɔn wɔ Egypt no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Kaa wo nkowaa, Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob; mma nnhwɛ ɔman yi hɔn asoɔdzen, nye hɔn ndzeyɛbɔn, nye hɔn bɔn so:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno bɛyɛ na asaase a iyii hɔn fii do no ase dɛ, Osiandɛ EWURADZE enntum ammfa hɔn annkɔ asaase a ɔbɔɔ hɔn ho anohoba no do, na osiandɛ ɔtan hɔn ntsi, na ɔdze hɔn efir edzi dɛ orukokuku hɔn wɔ sar no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Naaso wɔyɛ wo man nye w’egyapadze a enam wo tum kɛse nye w’abasa a wɔatsɛw mu do eyi hɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Aber no mu na EWURADZE see me dɛ, sen abopon ebien a ɔtse dɛ kan dze no ma woho, na fow bra me nkyɛn wɔ bepɔw no do, na yɛ duadaka ma woho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mebɛkyerɛw nsɛm a ɔwɔ nkan no apon a ebobɔɔ no no do no, wɔ apon no do, na fa hyɛ adaka no mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna meyɛɛ akeesia duadaka, na meseen abopon ebien a ɔtse dɛ kan dze no, na mofoow bepɔw no, na apon ebien no kitsa me nsamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE kyerɛɛw apon no do, dɛ mbrɛ kan no nkyerɛwee no tse, mbransɛm du no a ɔnoara fi gya no mu kaa kyerɛɛ hom wɔ bepɔw no do nguabɔ da no: na ɔdze maa me.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na medanee fii bepɔw no do sianee, na medze apon no bɛhyɛɛ adaka a meyɛe no mu; na hɔ na ɔwɔ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ me no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Israelmba tui fii Beerot Bene-jaakan kɔr Mosera: hɔ na Aaron wui, na hɔ na wosiee no; na ne babanyin Eleazar hyɛɛ n’ananmu dzii ɔsɔfo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Wofi hɔ tui kɔr Gudgoda; na wofi Gudgoda kɔr Jotbata, asaase a nworansu wɔ do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Aber no mu na EWURADZE yii Levi ebusuakuw, dɛ wɔnsoa EWURADZE ahyɛmudaka no, wongyina EWURADZE enyim nsom no, na wonhyira wɔ ne dzin mu, a wɔayɛ araa dze ebodu ndɛ da yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi na Levi ennya kyɛfa nye egyapadze wɔ no nuanom mu; EWURADZE nye n’egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn kaa kyerɛɛ no no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na misiankae wɔ bepɔw no do, dɛ asɔpɔn no, adzekyee nye adzesaa adaduanan: na EWURADZE tsiee me aber no mu so; na EWURADZE ammpɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Soɛr, tu wo kwan kedzi ɔman no enyim; ma wɔnkɔ nkɛfa asaase a mekaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom dɛ medze mebɛma hɔn no.
title: DEUTERONOMY
