text: Na afei, Israel, ebɛnadze na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn rohwehwɛ wɔ wo hɔ, kyɛn dɛ ibosuro EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, ebɛnantsew n’akwan nyinara do, na adɔ no, na edze w’akoma nyinara nye wo kra nyinara asom EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na edzi EWURADZE mbransɛm, nye n’ahyɛdze a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi do wɔ wo yieyɛ ntsi?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hwɛ, ɔsor dzi wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, nye ɔsor no sor, asaase, nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: W’egyanom nko na EWURADZE nyaa hɔn ho enyika dɛ ɔbɔdɔ hɔn, na ɔsaan mu yii hɔn asefo a wodzi hɔn ekyir no, mekyerɛ homara, wɔ aman nyinara mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ntwitwa hom akoma twatsia na mma wɔnnyɛ asoɔdzen bio.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, ɔno nye enyame mu Nyame, nye ewuradze mu EWURADZE, Nyame kɛse no, Otumfo a no ho yɛ hu a ɔnnhwɛ nyimpa enyim, na onndzi mboaba.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Odzi egyanka nye okunafo hɔn asɛm, na ɔdɔ ɔhɔho, ɔma no edziban nye akataho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ndɔ ahɔho: osiandɛ ho so hom yɛɛ ahɔho wɔ Egypt asaase do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Suro EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn; ɔno na som no; na ɔno na takyer no ho, na ne dzin ho na ka ntam.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔno nye w’ayɛyi, na ɔno nye wo Nyankopɔn a ɔayɛ ndzɛmba akɛse a ɔyɛ hu a w’enyiwa ehu yi ama wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nyimpa eduosuon na w’egyanom dze sianee kɔr Egypt; na afei EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ wo ɔdodow dɛ ɔsor nworaba.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi dɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, na sie n’ahwɛdodze, nye n’ahyɛdze, nye ne atsɛmbu, nye ne mbransɛm dabaa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom nhu ndɛ da yi: na mennkasa nnkyerɛ hom mba a wonnyim, na wonnhun EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ntsea, ne kɛseyɛ, ne nsa a ɔyɛ dzen, nye n’abasa a wɔatserɛw mu,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nye ne nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye no ndwuma a ɔyɛe no wɔ Egypt tsiaa Egypthen Farao, nye n’asaase nyinara;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nye dza ɔdze yɛɛ Egyptdɔm, nye hɔn mpɔnkɔ, nye hɔn ntseaseanam; mbrɛ ɔmaa Mbɛw Po nsu praam hɔn do aber a woritsiw hom, na mbrɛ EWURADZE asɛɛ hɔn ebodu ndɛ da yi;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nye dza ɔdze yɛɛ hom wɔ sar no do, bodur dɛ hom baa bea yi do;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na dza ɔdze yɛɛ Datan nye Abiram, Reuben ne babanyin Eliab mbabanyin no; mbrɛ asaase buee n’ano, na ɔmeen hɔn, nye hɔn efifo, nye hɔn asesee, nye enyikandze biara a odzii hɔn ekyir, wɔ Israel nyinara finimfin no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na hom enyiwa ehu edwuma kɛse a EWURADZE yɛe no nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ndzi mbrasɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara do, na hom ho aayɛ dzen, na hom aakɛfa asaase a hom rutwa mu akɔ do akɛfa no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na hom nda aawar wɔ asaase a EWURADZE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hom egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɔn na hɔn asefo no do, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na asaase no, mbrɛ irutwa mu akɔ do akɛfa no, ɔnntse dɛ Egypt asaase, mbrɛ hom fi bae no, mbrɛ epe w’aba, na edze w’anan petse do nsu, dɛ fan ture no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na asaase no, mbrɛ hom rutwa mu akɛfa no, yɛ akoko nye abɔn asaase, na ɔnom ɔsor nyankom mu nsu;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn hwɛ do; EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn n’enyiwa wɔ do dabaa, ofi afe n’ahyɛse araa kodu afe n’ewiei.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ hom tsie me mbransɛm a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi yie, dɛ hom dze hom akoma nyinara nye hom kra nyinara bɔdɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, na hom asom no a,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno mebɛma hom asaase do nsɔ atɔ wɔ n’aber mu, esusow nye ɔbɛsɛ, ma aaboaboa w’eburow, nye wo nsa, nye wo ngo ano.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mebɛma wo haban mu aba nkyɛkyɛr ama wo fiembowa, na eedzidzi amee.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom nhwɛ homho yie, ma wɔanndaadaa hom akoma, na hom aanndan ammfa nkyɛn, na hom aannkɔsom enyame fofor, na hom aannsɔr hɔn;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na EWURADZE n’ebufuw aanndzɛw wɔ hom do, na ɔaanntow ɔsor mu, dɛ nsu nntɔ, na asaase mma no ndɔbaa; na hom aannhera ntsɛmara wɔ asaase pa a EWURADZE dze rema hom no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mfa me nsɛm yi nsie hom akoma nye hom kra mu; na hom mfa nyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze mbɔ hom abaw do, na ɔnyɛ nkaakyekyeree wɔ hom enyiwa ntamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom mfa nkyerɛkyerɛ hom mba, twetwe ho nkɔmbɔ aber a etse wo fie, nye aber a enam ɔkwan mu, nye aber a ereda, nye aber a erosoɛr.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na kyerɛw no wɔ wo fi mpondua ho, na wo mbotsen ho:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ama hom nda, nye hom mba nda aadɔɔ so wɔ asaase a EWURADZE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hom egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɔn no do, dɛ ɔsor nda wɔ asaase do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ hom bɔdɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, hom anantsew n’akwan nyinara do, na hom atakyer no ho a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔnodze EWURADZE botutu amanaman yi nyinara efi hom enyim, na hom afa amanaman akɛse a wɔyɛ dzen sen homara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Beebiara a hom anamɔn betsia no bɛyɛ homdze: ofi sar no do, nye Lebanon, ofi esutsen Eufrates ho ara kodu ekyirekyir epo no ho bɛyɛ hom he.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nyimpa biara runntum nngyina hom enyim: EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze hom ho suro nye hom ho hu bogu asaase a hom betsia do nyinara do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔaka akyerɛ hom no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hwɛ, medze nhyira nye ndom mirisi hom enyim ndɛ da yi;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nhyira no, sɛ hom tsie EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn mbransɛm a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ndom no, sɛ hom enntsie EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn mbransɛm, na hom dan fi ɔkwan a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi do fa nkyɛn dɛ worikedzi enyame fofor a hom nnyim hɔn ekyir a.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze wo du asaase a erokɔ akɛfa no do a, ibesi nhyira no wɔ bepɔw Gerizim do, na ndom no wɔ bepɔw Ebal do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ana wonnyi Jordan egya, witɔree kwan no ekyir, wɔ Keenanfo a wɔtse Araba do no asaase do, Gilgal tsentsendo, wɔ More nsudur ho bi a?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom rubotwa Jordan akɔ akɛfa asaase a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze rema hom no, na hom bɛfa, na hom atsena do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom ndwen do nyɛ ahyɛdze nye atsɛmbu a medze mirisi hom enyim ndɛ da yi nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Iyinom nye ahyɛdze nye ntsɛmbu a hom ndwen do nyɛ wɔ asaase a EWURADZE, w’egyanom Nyankopɔn dze ama wo dɛ fa no do, nda a hom dze tse asaase do nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔsɛɛ na hom nsɛɛ mbeambea nyinara a amanaman a hom rekɛfa no som hɔn enyame, mbepɔw atsentsen do, nye akoko do, nye dua momon biara ase;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na hom ndwuruw hɔn afɔrmbukyia, na wombubu hɔn edum mu esinesin, na wɔmfa gya nhyew hɔn Aserim; na hom ntwitwa hɔn enyame ehonyi a woesinsian no mu ngu, na hom nsɛɛ hɔn dzin mfi bea no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma hom nnyɛ dɛm mma EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mbom beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi wɔ hom ebusuakuw nyinara mu dɛ ɔdze ne dzin bɔto hɔ no, mekyerɛ ne tsenabew no na hom nhwehwɛ, na hɔ na hom kɔ;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na hɔ na hom mfa hom ɔhyew afɔr, nye hom okum afɔr, nye hom ebupɛn du du nye hom nsamu ɔmado afɔr, nye hom anohobadze, nye hom ayamuyi afɔr, nye hom anantwikuw nye hom nguankuw mu mbakan nkɔ:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na hɔ na hom ndzidzi wɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn enyim, na hom nye hom efifo, hom enyi ngye wɔ adze nyinara a hom dze hom nsa ka a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ehyira wo wɔ mu no mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma hom nnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ndzɛmba a yɛreyɛ wɔ ha ndɛ da yi mu biara tse yi a nyimpa biara yɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ nankasa n’enyiwa do no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na hom nnyae nndur ahomgye nye egyapadze a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze rema hom no mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mbom sɛ hom nya twa Jordan, na hom kɛtsena asaase a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn rema hom enya edzi no do, na ɔma hom ahomgye fi hom atamfo nyinara a woetwa hom ho ehyia ho, na hom tsena dwudwoodwo a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno ɔbɛba dɛ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi ma ne dzin atsena hɔ no, hɔ na hom mfa dza merehyɛ hom no nyinara nkɔ; hom ɔhyew afɔr, nye hom okum afɔr, hom ebupɛn du du, nye hom nsamu ɔmado afɔr, nye hom soronko anohobadze a hom bɔ ma EWURADZE no nyinara:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na hom mma hom enyi ngye wɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn enyim, hom, nye hom mbabanyin, nye hom mbabaa, nye hom nkowaa, nye hom mfonabaa, nye Levinyi a ɔwɔ hom kuropon mu, susuampa dɛ onnyi kyɛfa anaa egyapadze wɔ hom mu no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom nhwɛ hom ho yie mma hom aammbɔ hom hyew afɔr wɔ beebiara a hom hu;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: gyedɛ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE bɛsan mu eyi wɔ hom ebusuakuw kor mu, hɔ na hom mbɔ hom hyew afɔr, na hɔ na hom nyɛ dza merehyɛ hom nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Naaso ku na dzi nam wɔ wo kuropon nyinara mu, dɛ mbrɛ wo kra no kɔn dɔ nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ nhyira a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze ehyira wo no tse: nyia no ho nntsew nye nyimpa no ho tsew ndzi bi, dɛ adoa, nye dɛ ɔtrɔm.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Bɔgya no nko na mma hom nndzi; hue gu famu dɛ nsu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nndzi w’eburow, anaa wo nsa, anaa wo ngo mu ebupɛn du du wɔ wo kuropon mu, anaa w’anantwikuw anaa wo nguankuw mu mbakan, nye w’anohobadze biara a ebɔ ho anohoba, nye w’ayamuyi afɔr, nye wo nsamu ɔmado afɔr:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mbom dzi no wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim wɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi no, ɔwo, nye wo babanyin, nye wo babaa, nye w’akowaa, nye w’afonabaa, nye Levinyi a ɔwɔ wo kuropon mu: na ma w’enyi ngye wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim wɔ dza wo nsa ka nyinara ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hwɛ woho yie amma aammpow Levinyi aber tsentsen nyina a edze tse w’asaase do nyinara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn trɛw wo he mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔabɔ wo anohoba no, na ese dɛ, mibedzi nam, osiandɛ wo kra no kɔn dɔ dɛ obedzi nam a, dzi nam, dɛ mbrɛ wo kra no kɔn dɔ nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi dze ne dzin ato hɔ no ɔnye wo ntamu twe dodow a, ɔno ku w’anantwikuw nye wo nguankuw a EWURADZE dze ama wo no mu bi, dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ wo no, na dzi wɔ wo kuropon mu, dɛ mbrɛ wo kra no kɔn dɔ nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mekyerɛ dɛ mbrɛ wodzi adoa nye ɔtrɔm no, dɛmara so na dzi bi: nyia no ho nntsew nye nyia no ho tsew nyina ndzi bi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nsew ara na hyɛ mma enndzi bɔgya no: na mma mmfa nam no nnka bɔgya no ho nndzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nndzi; hue gu famu dɛ nsu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nndzi; ma onsi ɔwo, nye wo mba a wodzi w’ekyir yie, aber a ereyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Wo ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn a ewɔ no nko, nye w’anohobadze, na fa kɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE bɛsan mu eyi no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na bɔ wo hyew afɔr, nam nye bɔgya no, wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn afɔrmbukyia no do: na wo kum afɔr bɔgyaa no wonhue ngu EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn afɔrmbukyia no do, na nam no na dzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dwen do tsie nsɛm a merehyɛ wo yi nyinara, ma eesi ɔwo, nye wo mba a wodzi w’ekyir yie daa, aber a ereyɛ dza oye na ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyiwa do no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn twitwa amanaman fi w’enyim, mbrɛ erokɔ akɛfa hɔn no, na efa hɔn, na etsena hɔn asaase do a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: hwɛ woho yie amma wɔasɛɛ hɔn efi w’enyim n’ekyir no, hɔn ekyirdzi aannyɛ wo efir; na eemmbisa hɔn enyame ekyir kwan, dɛ, Amanaman yi dua dɛn som hɔn enyame, na mo so menyɛ dɛmara?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nnyɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dɛm: na EWURADZE n’ekyiwadze a okyir no nyinara na wɔayɛ ama hɔn enyame; na hɔn mbabanyin nye hɔn mbabaa mpo na wɔdze gya hyew hɔn ma hɔn enyame.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Adze biara a merehyɛ hom no, na hom ndwen do nyɛ: mma mmfa bi nnka ho, na mma nnyi do bi so.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi bi, anaa ɔdaasonyi bi soɛr wɔ wo mu, na ɔma wo asɛnkyerɛdze anaa anwanwadze bi,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na asɛnkyerɛdze anaa anwanwadze a ɔkasaa ho kyerɛɛ wo no ba mu, dɛ, Ma yɛnkɔ nkedzi enyame fofor a ɔwo nnyim hɔn no ekyir, na yɛnkɔsom no a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mma nntsie nkɔnhyɛnyi no anaa ɔdaasonyi no nsɛm no: na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn rosɔ hom ahwɛ, dze ehu kyerɛ dɛ hom dze hom akoma nyinara nye hom kra nyinara dɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom nnantsew ndzi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ekyir, na hom nsuro no, na hom ndzi ne mbransɛm do, na hom ntsie ne ndze, na hom nsom no; na hom ntakyer no ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na nkɔnhyɛnyi no, anaa ɔdaasonyi no, wonku no; osiandɛ wɔaka etuatsew ho asɛm etsia EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn a oyii hom fii Egypt asaase do, na ɔpoon wo fii nkowaasom ofi mu no, dɛ ɔdze rotwetwe wo efi ɔkwan a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ wo dɛ nantsew mu no do esi nkyɛn. Ama eetu bɔn no efi wo mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ wo nuabanyin, wo na ne babanyin, anaa wo babanyin, anaa wo babaa, anaa wo yer a ɔda wo bo mu, anaa wo nyɛnko a ɔtse dɛ wankasa wo kra, daadaa wo nsumaa mu, dɛ, Ma yɛnkɔ nkɔsom enyame fofor a ɔwo nye w’egyanom nnyim no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: aman a woetwa hom ho ehyia a wɔbɛn wo, anaa wɔnye wo ntamu twe, ofi asaase ano kor ara kodu asaase ano kor so hɔn enyame mu bi a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mma mmpen no, na nntsie no so; nkyii so mma w’enyiwa nnhu no mbɔbɔr, na nkora no do, na nnhuntsa no do so;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na oku na ku no; wo nsa na ondzi kan ntɔ no do dɛ woboku no, na n’ekyir no na ɔman no nyinara nsa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na siw no abo ma onwu; osiandɛ ɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ ɔtwetwe wo fi EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn a oyii wo fii Egypt asaase do, wɔ nkowaasom ofi mu no ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Israel nyinara ntse, na wonsuro, na wɔannda ho ara annyɛ dɛm ndzebɔn a ɔtse dɛ mbrɛ iyi tse yi wɔ wo mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ etse dɛ wɔreka wɔ wo nkurow a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ tsena mu hɔ no kor bi ho, dɛ,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ebusuyɛfo bi efi wo mu asoɛr, na wɔadaadaa hɔn kurow mu atsefo dɛ, Hom mma yɛnkɔ nkɔsom enyame fofor a hom nnyim hɔn a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno hwehwɛ mu, na bisabisa mu yie; na hwɛ, sɛ ɔyɛ nokwar, na asɛm no yɛ ampa dɛ dɛm ekyiwadze yi wɔayɛ no wɔ wo mu a:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: oku na fa nkrantsee ano ku kurow no mu atsefo no, na fa nkrantsee ano sɛɛ no, nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara nye no mu fiembowa so pasapasa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na boaboa no mu asadze nyinara ano wɔ no brɔn finimfin, na fa gya hyew kurow no, nye no mu asadze no nyinara dɛ ɔhyew afɔr mu, fa ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn: na ɔnyɛ ɔmamfo daa; mma wɔnnkyekyer no bio.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mma ebusudze no mu bi mmfam wo nsa ho: ama EWURADZE aadan efi n’ebufuhyew no ho, na oeehu wo mbɔbɔr, na oennya ayamuhyehye ama wo, na ɔaama adɔr dɛ mbrɛ ɔaka ntam akyerɛ w’egyanom;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: sɛ a itsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ndze, dɛ idzi ne mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara do, na eyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyiwa do a.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom yɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne mba: mma hom mmbobɔ homho akam, na mma hom nnyɛ hom momapɔw do ahyɛnsewdze mma ewufo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔwo yɛ ɔman krɔnkrɔn ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, na EWURADZE asan mu eyi wo dɛ ebɛyɛ noara no soronko ɔman, wɔ aman a wɔwɔ asaase enyi nyinara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nndzi ekyiwadze biara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Iyinom nye mbowa a hom ndzi: ɔnantwi, ɔkɔsɔw, nye apɔnkye,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔtrɔm, nye adoa, nye ɔwansan, nye iwi, nye ɔtwe, nye eko, nye ɔwɛr.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na abowa biara a ɔwɔ anansa a no mu apae, na n’anansa no mu apae ebien koraa, na ɔkosa adzepuwii, wɔ mbowa mu no, ɔno na hom ndzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Naaso iyinom na mma hom nndzi wɔ hɔn a wɔkosa adzepuwii mu, anaa hɔn a hɔn anansa mu apae koraa mu: efupɔnkɔ, nye asokɛtɛ, nye etwabowa, osiandɛ wɔkosa adzepuwii dze na hɔn anansa mu mmpaae, hɔn ho nntsew mma hom:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na preko, osiandɛ n’anansa mu apae dze na ɔnnkosa adzepuwii, no ho nntsew mma hom: hɔn nam no mma hom nndzi bi, na hɔn efun no mma hom nnka.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Iyinom na hom ndzi wɔ dza ɔwɔ nsu mu nyinara mu: dza ɔwɔ tɛterɛ nye abon no hom ndzi:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na biara a onnyi tɛterɛ nye abon no mma hom nndzi; no ho nntsew mma hom.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nnoma a hɔn ho tsew no nyinara hom ndzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na iyinom nye hɔn a mma hom nndzi bi: ɔkɔr, nye ɔkɔrbia, nye nsukɔr;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nye ɔkom pɛtɛ, nye ɔkom, nye ɔsansaa n’ahorow;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nye akonkoran biara n’ahorow;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nye sohor, na anadwe krɔma, nye epo akokɔ, nye akrɔma n’ahorow;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: patu ketseaba, nye patu kɛse, nye ambɛn patu;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na nantwinoma, nye ɔpɛtɛ, nye epo akonkoran;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nye esukɔnkɔn, nye bakanoma n’ahorow, nye esuakwa nye apan.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ntumbowa a wɔwea nyinara hɔn ho nntsew mma hom: mma wonndzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ntumbowa a hɔn ho tsew no nyinara hom ndzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma hom nndzi biribi a noara oewu: fa ma ɔhɔho a ɔwɔ wo kuropon mu ma ondzi; anaa tɔn ma ɔnanaben: na ɔwo yɛ ɔman krɔnkrɔn ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn. Mma nnoa apɔnkyeba wɔ ne na no numfonsu mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: W’aba a idua no ndɔbaa a ofi wo haban mu ba afrenhyia afrenhyia no, yiyi do ebupɛn du du.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na dzi wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim, wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛsan mu eyi dɛ ne dzin ntsena hɔ no, w’eburow, nye wo nsa, nye wo ngo do ebupɛn du du, nye w’anantwikuw, nye wo nguankuw mu mbakan; ama eesua dɛ isuro EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dabaa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn hyira wo na sɛ ɔkwan no war dodow ma wo ma irunntum nnsoa, osiandɛ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi dɛ ɔdze ne dzin bɔto no nye wo ntamu twe dodow,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno dan no sika mu, na kyekyer sika no kitsa, na kɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Fa sika no tɔ adze biara a wo kra no kɔn dɔ, ɔnantwi, anaa oguan, anaa wenyin, anaa nsa dzendzen, anaa adze biara a wo kra pɛ no: na dzi no wɔ hɔ ara wo EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim, na ma w’enyi ngye, ɔwo nye wo fifo:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na Levinyi a ɔwɔ wo kuropon mu no, mma nngya no ekyir; osiandɛ onnyi kyɛfa nye egyapadze ka wo ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mfe ebiasa biara n’ewiei no, yiyi afe no ara mu ndɔbaa do ebupɛn du du no nyinara, na fa gu wo kuropon mu:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na Levinyi, osiandɛ onnyi kyɛfa nye egyapadze biara dɛ mbrɛ ewɔ, na ɔhɔho, nye egyanka, nye okunafo a wɔwɔ wo kuropon mu, mbra, na wombedzidzi mmee; na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn eehyira wo wɔ wo nsaano edwuma a eyɛ nyinara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mfe esuon biara n’ewiei no yɛ akwangya.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mbrɛ wonsi ngya kwan nye yi: ɔdzefɛmfo biara dza ɔdze fɛm ne nyɛnko no ɔmfa nkyɛ no; mma ɔnnhyɛ ne nyɛnko nye no nua no nngye.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔnanaben dze hyɛ no gye: na adze biara a ewɔ wɔ wo nua hɔ dze fa kyɛ no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Naaso mma ohianyi bi mmba wo mu; (na nhyira na EWURADZE behyira wo wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze a kɛfa no do;)
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: sɛ iritsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ndze ara yie, dɛ erodwen do ayɛ ahyɛdze yi a merehyɛ wo da yi nyinara a.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn behyira wo, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ wo anohoba no: na edze afemfɛm amanaman pii, na ɔwo dze erennkɛfɛm: na ɔwo bɔhom amanaman pii do, na hɔn dze, wɔronnhom wo do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ wo nuanom mu obi yɛ ohianyi wɔ wo nkyɛn, wɔ wo kuropon biara mu wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do a, mma mmpirim w’akoma, na mma mmua wo nsa so wɔ wo nua ohianyi no do:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na obue na bue wo nsa ma no, na ɔfɛm na fɛm no dza ɔbɔso ne hia a ehia no no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hwɛ yie ma adwen huhuw ammba w’akoma mu dɛ, Afe a otsia esuon no, akwangya afe no abɛn; na annyɛ bɔn enntsia wo nua ohianyi no, dɛ eremma no hwee; ma ɔaanntsea mu ammfrɛ EWURADZE enntsia wo, na aannyɛ bɔn amma wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔma na ma no, na mma ɔnnyɛ w’akoma mu yaw dɛ ebɛma no: osiandɛ dɛm adze yi ntsi na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn behyira wo wɔ w’edwuma nyinara mu, nye dza edze wo nsa bosuo mu nyinara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ohianyi remmpa wɔ asaase no do: dɛm ntsi na merehyɛ wo dɛ, Bue na bue wo nsa ma wo nua, wo kɔhweaban, nye wo hianyi, wɔ w’asaase do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ wɔtɔn wo nua Hebriwnyi ɔbanyin, anaa ɔbaa, ma wo, na ɔsom wo mfe esia a; ɔno afe a otsia esuon no gya no kwan na omfi wo nkyɛn mfa noho ndzi nkɔ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ irigya no kwan ma oeefi wo nkyɛn afa noho edzi akɔ a, mma ɔmmfa nsapan nnkɔ:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: fa wo nguankuw mu bi, nye w’ewuporoweebea do bi, nye wo wenyintwer mu bi ma no kwa: dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ehyira wo no na ma no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na kaa dɛ eyɛɛ akowaa wɔ Egypt asaase do, na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn poon wo: dɛm ntsi na merehyɛ wo asɛm yi ndɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ɔse wo dɛ, Mirimmfi wo nkyɛn nnkɔ; osiandɛ ɔdɔ wo nye wo fi ntsi, wɔ dɛ ɔtse no yie wɔ wo nkyɛn ntsi a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno fa fitsii, na fa fitsi n’asowa mu suo abow mu, na ɔnyɛ w’akowaa daa. Na w’afonabaa no so yɛ no dɛmara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma ɔnnyɛ dzen mma wo, dɛ ibegya no kwan ma oeefi wo nkyɛn afa noho edzi akɔ; na ɔasom wo mfe esia ayɛ ɔpaanyi akatua mbɔho ebien ho adze: na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn behyira wo wɔ dza eyɛ nyinara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: W’anantwikuw nye wo nguankuw mu mbakan enyin a wɔbɔwo hɔn no tu hɔn si nkyɛn ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn: mma mmfa wo nantwi abakan nnyɛ edwuma, na nnsusua wo nguankuw mu abakan ho nhwi so.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dzi no wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim afrenhyia afrenhyia wɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi no, ɔwo nye wo fifo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ ɔwɔ dzɛm bi wɔ no ho dɛ ɔyɛ apakye anaa n’enyi efura, dzɛm bɔn biara wɔ no ho a, mma mmfa mmbɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn afɔr.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dzi no wɔ wo kuropon mu: nyia no ho nntsew nye nyia no ho tsew nyina ndzi, dɛ mbrɛ wodzi ɔwansan nye ɔforote.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: No bɔgyaa nko na mma nndzi; hue gu famu dɛ nsu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hyɛ bosoom Abib nsew, na dzi apaho no ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn; na bosoom Abib mu na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn yii wo wɔ Egypt anadwe.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na bɔ apaho okum afɔr no ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, nguankuw nye anantwikuw mu, wɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE bɛsan mu eyi dɛ ne dzin ntsena hɔ no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma mmfa mbɔrkaw boodoo nnka ho nndzi; nda esuon na fa epitsi boodoo ka ho dzi, mekyerɛ amandzehu boodoo no; osiandɛ ɔhar mu na ifiir edzi fii Egypt asaase do: ama aakaa da a edze fiir edzi fii Egypt asaase do no wo nkwa nda nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mma wonnhu wo nkyɛn mbɔrkaw wɔ w’ahe nyinara do nda esuon; nkyii so mma nam a iku hɔn da a odzi kan ewimbir no bi nnka anadwe no nyinara mma onnkodu anapa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nnku apaho no wɔ wo kuropon a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no biara mu:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: gyedɛ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi dɛ ne dzin ntsena hɔ no, hɔ na ku apaho no ewimbir, wi rokɔtɔ no, wɔ wo Egypt fi aber no mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na toto na dzi no wɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi no: na anapa no san, na kɔ w’asesee mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nda esia na dzi epitsi boodoo: na da a otsia esuon no nyɛ asomdwee nguabɔ mma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn; mma nnyɛ edwuma wɔ mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Adapɛn esuon na kan ma woho: da a erehyɛ ase dze kantankrankye aka eburow a osisi hɔ no na fi kan adapɛn esuon.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hyɛ adapɛn afahyɛ no ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn fa ka wo nsa mu ayamuyi afɔr ntoboa a edze rema no no ho, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ehyira wo no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ma w’enyi ngye wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim, ɔwo, nye wo babanyin, nye wo babaa, nye w’akowaa, nye w’afonabaa, nye Levinyi a ɔwɔ wo kuropon mu, nye ɔhɔho, nye egyanka, nye okunafo a wɔwɔ wo mu, wɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi dɛ ne dzin ntsena hɔ no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na kaa dɛ eyɛɛ akowaa wɔ Egypt: na dwen do yɛ ahyɛdze yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hyɛ ntamadan afahyɛ nda esuon, aber a aboaboa w’ewuporoweebea do nye wo wenyintwer mu adze ano no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ma w’enyi ngye wɔ w’afahyɛ no mu, ɔwo, nye wo babanyin, nye wo babaa, nye w’akowaa, nye w’afonabaa, nye Levinyi, nye ɔhɔho, nye egyanka, nye okunafo a wɔwɔ wo kuropon mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nda esuon na hyɛ fa ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn wɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE bɛsan mu eyi no: osiandɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn behyira wo wɔ wo ndɔbaa nyinara mu, na wo nsaano edwuma nyinara mu, na w’enyi bɛgye ara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Afrenhyia kor mu mpɛn ebiasa na wo mbanyin nyinara nkefir EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛsan mu eyi no; wɔ epitsi boodoo afahyɛ no mu, nye adapɛn afahyɛ no mu, nye ntamadan afahyɛ no mu: na mma wɔmmfa nsapan mmbefir EWURADZE enyim:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nyimpa biara mma dza obotum, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn nhyira a ɔdze ehyira wo no tse.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hyɛ ntsɛmbuafo nye mpanyimfo wɔ wo nkuropon a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ mbrɛ w’ebusuakuw tsetsee nyinara mu: na wɔmfa ntsɛn tsenenee mbu ɔman no ntsɛn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nndan atsɛmbu enyi; mma mmfɛr nyimpa: nkyii so mma nngye akyɛdze; na akyɛdze fura enyansafo enyi, na ɔdan atseneneefo nsɛm enyi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dza ɔtsen ara na dzi ekyir, ama eenya nkwa, na eenya asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no edzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nntsɛw dua biara mmfa nnyɛ abosompɔw Asera wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn afɔrmbukyia a ebɛyɛ ama woho no nkyɛn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so mma nnsi dum a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn kyir mma woho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma mmfa ɔnantwi, anaa oguan a no ho wɔ dzɛm, anaa adzebɔn biara, mmbɔ okum afɔr mma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ wohu wɔ wo mu, wɔ wo nkuropon a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no biara mu, ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa bi a ɔyɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyi do dɛ ɔto n’ahyɛmu,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ɔkɔ kɔsom enyame fofor bi, ɔsɔr dɛ, ewia, bosoom, anaa ɔsor dɔm no mu biara a mennhyɛɛ ho mbra no,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na wɔka kyerɛ wo, ma etse a, ɔno hwehwɛ mu yie na hwɛ, sɛ ɔyɛ nokwar, na asɛm no wɔ mu ampa, dɛ ɔayɛ dɛm ekyiwadze yi wɔ Israel a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno fa ɔbanyin anaa ɔbaa no a ɔayɛ dɛm adze bɔn yi fir edzi kɔ wo kuropon ho, na wonsiw no abo ma onwu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Adasefo beenu, anaa adasefo baasa anomu do na wɔmfa nku nyia ɔsɛ owu no; mma wɔmmfa ɔdasefo kor anomu do nnku no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Adasefo no nsa na ondzi kan wɔ no do nku no, na n’ekyir no ɔman no nyinara hɔn nsa. Ama eeyi mbusu no efi wo mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ asɛm bi ho atsɛmbu yɛ dzen dodow ma wo, wɔ ewudzi nye nsa a apa ntamu, mansosɛm mu, na opira no, dɛ ɔyɛ akasakasa bi wɔ wo kuropon mu a, ɔno soɛr, na kɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na kɔ asɔfo Levifo, nye nda no mu ɔtsɛmbufo a ɔwɔ do no nkyɛn na kebisa; na wɔnkyerɛ wo asɛm no n’atsɛmbu:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na yɛ dɛ mbrɛ asɛm a wɔbɛkyerɛ wo wɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE bɛsan mu eyi no tse no ara; na dwen do yɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo no nyinara:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: dɛ mbrɛ mbra a wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo, na mbrɛ atsɛmbu a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo no tse no ara, na yɛ: mma nndan mmfi asɛm a wɔbɛkyerɛ wo no ho nnkɔ enyimfa anaa abankum.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na nyimpa a obedzi nkontompɔsɛm, dɛ orinntsie ɔsɔfo a ogyina hɔ som wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim, anaa ɔtsɛmbufo no, dɛm nyimpa no onwu: na yi mbusu no fi Israel.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔman no nyinara ntse, na wonsuro, na wonndzi nkontompɔsɛm bio.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ idu asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do, na efa, na etsena do, na ese dɛ, Mibesi mo do hen, dɛ amanaman a wotwa mo ho hyia nyinara no a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nyia EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi no no noara na fa no si wo do hen: wo nuanom mu bi na fa no si wo do hen: mma mmfa ɔnanaben bi a ɔnnyɛ wo nua nnsi wo do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma ɔhen no mma no mpɔnkɔ nndɔɔ so mma no, nkyii so mma ɔmma ɔman no nnsan nnkɔ Egypt, nnkɛpɛ no mpɔnkɔ dodow: mber dodowara a EWURADZE ase hom dɛ ɔdzekɔr yi mma hom nnsan mmfa ɔkwan no do bio no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so mma ɔmma ne yernom nndɔɔ so.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ɔtse n’ahendzi ahengua do a, onsusu mbra yi a ɔwɔ asɔfo Levifo no enyim no do nkyerɛw bi wɔ nwoma mu mma noho:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ɔnko ne nkyɛn, na ɔnkenkan mu no nkwa nda nyinara: na oeesua dɛ obosuro EWURADZE no Nyankopɔn, na odzi mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara nye ahyɛdze yi do, na ɔyɛ:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na n’akoma aamma noho do annsen no nuanom, na ɔaanndan emmfi mbrasɛm no ho ammfa enyimfa, anaa abankum: ama ne nda aawar wɔ n’ahendzi mu, ɔno nye ne mba wɔ Israel.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Levifo Asɔfo nye Levi ebusuakuw nyinara rinnya kyɛfa nye egyapadze wɔ Israel mu: EWURADZE ogya afɔr nye n’egyapadze na wondzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na worinnya egyapadze wɔ hɔn nuanom mu: EWURADZE nye hɔn egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔaka akyerɛ hɔn no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na iyi nyɛ asɔfo no hɔn ndzinoa mfi ɔman no hɔ, mfi hɔn a wɔbɔ afɔr no hɔ, ɔnantwi o, oguan o, wɔmfa abasa, nye adadaw ebien no, nye efur no mma ɔsɔfo no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: W’eburow, wo nsa, nye wo ngo mu nduadzewakan, nye wo nguan ho nhwi a woesusua no kan no, fa ma no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Osiandɛ ɔno na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi no wɔ w’ebusuakuw nyinara mu, dɛ ongyina nsom wɔ EWURADZE ne dzin mu, ɔno na ne mbabanyin daa nyina.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ Levinyi bi fi wo nkuropon no biara mu, fi Israel mu beebiara mbrɛ ɔakɔsoɛ, na ɔdze ne kra ne pɛ nyinara ba beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE asan mu eyi no a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno ɔnsom wɔ EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn ne dzin mu, dɛ mbrɛ no nuanom Levifo no a wogyina EWURADZE enyim hɔ no nyinara yɛ no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Wonnya kyɛfa dɛ hɔndze no ndzi, mfa nka dza ofi n’egyanom adzetɔn mu ba no ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ inya du asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do a, mma nnsua amanaman no hɔn ndzeyɛɛ a ɔyɛ ekyiwadze no yɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma wonnhu wo mu obi a ɔma ne babanyin anaa ne babaa fa ogya mu, nyia ɔhyɛ mbusunkɔm, nyia ɔyɛ abayidze, anaa adzebisafo, anaa osumantunyi,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: anaa kaberkyernyi, anaa nyia ɔfrɛfrɛ esunsum, anaa anyɛn, anaa ɔsamamfrɛnyi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Osiandɛ obiara a ɔyɛ iyinom no yɛ ekyiwadze ma EWURADZE: na osian ekyiwadze yi ntsi na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn tutuu hɔn fii w’enyim yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Enye EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ntsena no emudzi mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na amanaman yi a erekɛfa yi wotsie hɔn a wɔyɛ abayidze, na mbusunkɔnhyɛfo: na ɔwo dze, EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn mmaa wo kwan dɛ yɛ dɛm.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkɔnhyɛnyi a ofi wo mu, ofi wo nuanom mu a ɔtse dɛ emi, na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma no do ama wo; ɔno na hom ntsie no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: dɛ mbrɛ dza ibisae wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn hɔ wɔ Horeb, wɔ nguabɔ da no tse nyinara, dɛ, Mma menntse EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn ndze bio, nkyii so mma munnhu ogya kɛse yi bio, na meennwu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Dza wɔaka no, wɔaka no yie.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mebɛma nkɔnhyɛnyi do ama hɔn wɔ hɔn nuanom mu tse dɛ ɔwo; na medze me nsɛm bɛhyɛ n’anomu, na ɔaka dza mebɛhyɛ no nyinara akyerɛ hɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ obiara a onnketsie me nsɛm a ɔbɛka wɔ me dzin mu no, mibebisa noara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na nkɔnhyɛnyi a ɔbɛka asɛm bi nkontompɔ mu wɔ me dzin mu a, mennhyɛɛ no dɛ ɔnka no, anaa nyia ɔbɛkasa wɔ enyame fofor bi dzin mu no, nkɔnhyɛnyi kor no bowu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Bi a nna ase wɔ w’akoma mu dɛ, Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn bohu asɛm a EWURADZE nnkae no?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔno nye dɛ, sɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi bi kasa wɔ EWURADZE ne dzin mu, na sɛ asɛm no annyɛ hɔ anaa ammba mu so a, nna asɛm a EWURADZE nnkae no nye no: nkɔnhyɛnyi no aka no ator mu, mma nnsuro no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn twitwa amanaman a ɔdze hɔn asaase rema wo gu, na itu hɔn, na etsena hɔn nkurow, nye hɔn adan mu a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: yiyi nkurow ebiasa si hɔ ma woho wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ fa no mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Siesie ɔkwan no ma woho, na paapaa asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn rema enya edzi no n’ahe mu ebiasa na onyimpakumfo biara eeguan akɔ hɔ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na onyimpakumfo a onguan nkɔ hɔ na onnya nkwa no n’asɛm nye yi: nyia oku ne nyɛnko awerɛfir mu, na ɔnntan no dada bi;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: dɛ nyimpa nye ne nyɛnko kɔ kwaa mu rukotwa dua, na ne nsa ma abɔndua do dze eetwa dua no, na ne tsidadze no hɔn fi no kura mu, na ɔka ne nyɛnko no, ma owu a; onguan nkɔ nkurow yi kor mu na onnya nkwa:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: amma bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no eenntsiw nyimpakumfo no, aber a n’akoma ayɛ hyew no, na osiandɛ ɔkwan no war ntsi ɔaannkɔto no, na ɔaammbɔ no ɔbɔtɔr; naaso na nyimpakumfo no nnsɛ wu, susuampa dɛ ɔnntan no dada bi no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi na merehyɛ wo dɛ yiyi nkurow ebiasa si hɔ ma woho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn tserɛw wo he mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔaka ntam akyerɛ w’egyanom, na ɔdze asaase no a ɔbɔɔ anohoba dɛ ɔdze bɛma w’egyanom no nyinara ma wo:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: sɛ idzi mbrasɛm yi nyinara a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi do eyɛ, dɛ ebɔdɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, na anantsew n’akwan do daa a; ɔno yiyi nkurow ebiasa so ka ebiasa yi ho si hɔ ma woho:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na wɔaannka bɔgya a onndzi so enngu wɔ w’asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no mu, na bɔgya eengu wo do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi tan ne nyɛnko, na ɔkɔ no atsɛwee, na ɔsoɛr no do, na ɔbɔ no ɔbɔtɔr ma owu; na oguan kɔ nkurow yi kor mu a:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno no kurow no mu mpanyimfo nsoma ma wɔnkɛfa no wɔ hɔ na wɔmfa no nhyɛ bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no nsa, ma onwu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma w’enyiwa nnhu no mbɔbɔr, na yi bɔgya a onndzi so fi Israel, na eesi wo yie.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nntwe wo nyɛnko n’asaasehe a tsetsefo no dze esi, wɔ w’egyapadze a ibenya edzi wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ fa no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔdasefo baako nnsoɛr nntsia nyimpa bi wɔ emumuyɛ biara, anaa bɔn biara ho, wɔ bɔn biara a ɔyɛ ho: adasefo beenu anomu, anaa adasefo baasa anomu na wɔmfa do nsi asɛm gyinae.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ ɔdasekrumfo bi soɛr tsia nyimpa bi dzi no mfom ho dase a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno nyimpa beenu nyina a ɔham no da hɔn ntamu no, mbegyina EWURADZE enyim, wɔ asɔfo nye ntsɛmbufo a wɔwɔ hɔ nda no mu no enyim;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ntsɛmbufo no nhwehwɛ mu yie: na, hwɛ, sɛ ɔdasefo no yɛ ɔdasekrumfo, na oedzi no nua dasekrum a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno hom nyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔdween dɛ nkyɛ ɔbɛyɛ no nua no: ama eeyi mbusu no efi wo mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hɔn a wɔaka no ntsi, na wonsuro na ɔdzekɔr yi wɔaammbɔ mbusu biara a ɔtse dɛm wɔ wo mu bio.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mma w’enyiwa nnhu mbɔbɔr; nkwa nhyɛ nkwa ananmu, enyiwa nhyɛ enyiwa ananmu, ese nhyɛ ese ananmu, nsa nhyɛ nsa ananmu, anan nhyɛ anan ananmu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ itu ɔsa nye w’atamfo aakɔko, na ihu mpɔnkɔ, nye ntseaseanam, nye ɔman a wɔdɔɔ so sen wo a, mma nnsuro hɔn: na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔdze wo fi Egypt asaase do bae no ka wo ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ sɛ hom rehɛn akono a, ɔsɔfo no ntwe mpin na ɔmbɛkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ɔnse hɔn dɛ, Israel, hom ntsie, hom rebɛn akono ndɛ da yi nye hom atamfo akɔko: mma hom akoma nntu, mma hom nnsuro, na hom ho mmpopo, nkyii so mma hɔn ho nnyɛ hom hu;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn nye nyia ɔnye hom rokɔ, nye hom atamfo rokɔko ama hom, na ɔaagye hom nkwa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ahwɛdofo no nkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no, dɛ, Nyimpa mmuana na oesi dan fofor, na ommbuei? Wɔmma ɔnsan nkɔ ne fie, ma ɔaanntɔ wɔ ɔko mu, na nyimpa fofor eennkobue.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na nyimpa mmuana na ɔatsew wenyin ture, na onnyae nnyii n’aba bi? Wɔmma ɔnsan nkɔ ne fie, na ɔaanntɔ wɔ ɔko mu, na nyimpa fofor eennkeyi n’aba no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na nyimpa biara a ɔagye basia bi dɛ yer, na onnyae nnhyiaa no no, wɔmma ɔnsan nkɔ ne fie, ma ɔaanntɔ wɔ ɔko mu, na nyimpa fofor bi annkɛfa no dɛ ɔyer.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ahwɛdofo no nwɔw do nkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no, na wɔnse dɛ, Nyimpa mmuana na osuro na n’akoma apa? Wɔmma ɔnsan nkɔ ne fie, amma no nuanom hɔn akoma eenntu dɛ n’akoma.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ahwɛdofo no wie ɔman no kasa kyerɛ a, wɔnhyehyɛ asafohemfo wɔ ɔman no ne tsir.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ ebɛn kurow bi dɛ enye no rokɔko a, ɔno bɔ asomdwee ho dawur kyerɛ no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ɔma wo asomdwee mbuae, na obue wo a, ɔno, ma nkorɔfo a ibohu hɔn wɔ mu no nyinara mbɛyɛ ɔtowyiman mma wo, na wɔnsom wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ ɔnnye wo ennsiesie, na otu wo do sa a, ɔno kɔ no ntoa:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na sɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn yi no hyɛ wo nsa a, ɔno fa nkrantsee ano bobɔ no mu mbanyin nyinara:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na mbaa nye mbofraba, nye ofiembowa, nye dza ɔwɔ kurow no mu nyinara dze, mekyerɛ no mu asadze nyinara, fa no afonam fa ma woho; na dzi w’atamfo asadze a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze ama wo no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm na yɛ nkurow a wɔnye wo ntamu twe dodow nyinara a wɔnnyɛ amanaman yi nkurow bi no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na aman yi nkurow a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no dze, mma nngye biribiara a ogu ahom no nkwa:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mbom sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa; Hetfo, nye Amorifo, Keenanfo, nye Perizfo, nye Hivifo, nye Jebusfo; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ wo no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: amma wɔaannkyerɛ wo mma aannyɛ hɔn ekyiwadze nyinara a wɔyɛ ma hɔn enyame no bi; na hom aannyɛ bɔn enntsia EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ itua kurow bi ma ɔkyɛr, dɛ ereyɛ ho sa afa a, mma mmfa abɔndua nnsɛɛ no ho ndua; na no do aba bi na ibedzi, na mma nntwitwa nngu; ana haban mu dua yɛ nyimpa, na asɛɛ no?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ndua a inyim dɛ ɔnnyɛ ndua a wodzi no nko, na sɛɛ no na twitwa gu; na sisi nduaban wɔ kurow a ɔnye wo dzi ako no ho araa ma onkodu dɛ ɔbɔhwe ase.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ wohu obi a woeku no da haban mu, wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ fa no do, na wonnyim nyia okum no a:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno wo mpanyimfo nye wo atsɛmbufo mfir edzi, na wonkosusu nkodu nkurow a etwa ehyia nyia woeku no no ho no do:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ɔmbra dɛ, kurow a ɔbɛn nyimpa a woeku no no nkyɛn no, mekyerɛ kurow no mu mpanyimfo no mfa anantwikuw mu ɔnantwiber a wɔmmfaa no nnyɛɛ edwuma, na ɔnntwee kɔndua pɛn;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔnantwiber no nsian nkɔ ɔbɔn a nsu pem wɔ do a wɔnndɔwee na wonnduaa mu adze mu, na wombu ɔnantwiber no no kɔn wɔ ɔbɔn no mu:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na Levi mbabanyin asɔfo no mbra ho; na hɔn na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi hɔn dɛ wɔnsom no, na wonhyira wɔ EWURADZE ne dzin mu; na hɔn anomu asɛm do na wɔmfa ndzi ɔham biara nye ɔbɔ biara ho asɛm:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na kurow no mu mpanyimfo a wɔbɛn nyimpa a woku no no, nhohor hɔn nsa ho ngu ɔnantwiber a wobuu no kɔn mu wɔ ɔbɔn no mu no do:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na wombua nse dɛ, Nnyɛ hɛn nsa bi kaa bɔgya gui, nkyii so hɛn enyiwa ennhu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE, fa fir wo man Israel a apon hɔn no, na mma bɔgya a onndzi so nnka wo man Israel mu. Na bɔgya no wɔdze bɛkyɛ hɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ama eeyi bɔgya a onndzi so no efi wo mu, aber a ereyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ itu sa nye w’atamfo kɔko, na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn yi hɔn hyɛ wo nsa, na efa hɔn ndɔmmum,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ihu ndɔmmum no mu ɔbaa fɛɛfɛw bi, na inya no ho akɔndɔ, na epɛ dɛ efa no yɛ wo yer a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno fa no bra fie; na onyi ne tsir na ombubu n’awerɛw;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na onyi no ndɔmmum akataho no mfi noho, na ɔnka wo fie, na ongyam n’egya nye ne na bosoom ara mu: na n’ekyir no akɔ ne nkyɛn, na ayɛ no kun, na ɔayɛ wo yer.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ emmpɛ no a, ɔno ma ɔnkɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔpɛ; na ɔtɔn dze, mma nntɔn no nngye sika, mma nnye no nndzi dɛ afonabaa, osiandɛ abrɛ no adze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ ɔbanyin bi wɔ yernom beenu na, ɔdɔ kor, na ɔtan kor, na hɔn beenu no nyina awowo mba ama no; na sɛ abakan no nye nyia ɔtan no ne babanyin a:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno ɔmbra dɛ, da a ɔkyɛ n’adze a ɔwɔ mu ma ne mbabanyin no mma ɔmmfa nyia ɔdɔ no no ne babanyin nnyɛ abakan nndzi nyia ɔtan no ne babanyin a ɔyɛ abakan no enyim:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mbom ɔngye abakan no nto mu, nyia ɔtan no no ne babanyin no, ɔmma no dza ɔwɔ nyinara mu kyɛfa mbɔho ebien: na ɔno nye n’ahoɔdzen ahyɛse; abakan ndzinoa yɛ nedze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ nyimpa wɔ babanyin ɔsoɔdzennyi nye etuatsewnyi a onntsie n’egya ne ndze, anaa ne na ne ndze, na wɔtsea no so, na onntsie hɔn a:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno n’egya nye ne na nkyer no, na wɔmfa no mfir edzi nkɔ no kurow mu mpanyimfo nkyɛn wɔ no kuropon ano;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na wɔnse no kurow no mu mpanyimfo no dɛ, Hɛn babanyin yi yɛ ɔsoɔdzennyi nye otuatsewnyi, onntsie hɛn ndze. Ɔyɛ ɔkɔhwinyi, nye ɔsabokwanyi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na no kurow no mu mbanyin nyinara nsiw no abo, ma ɔntɔ: ama eeyi mbusu no efi wo mu; na Israel nyinara ntse, na wonsuro.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi yɛ bɔn a ɔsɛ owu, na woku no, na edze no sɛn dua bi do a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mma ne nyimpadua no nnka dua no do anadwe no nyinara, na osie na sie no da no ara; na nyia wɔasɛn no no Nyame apa no; amma eenngu w’asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no ho fi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nnhu wo nua ne nantwi anaa no guan dɛ ɔatɔ gon, na mmfi hɔn ho nnkosuma: fa hɔn san brɛ wo nua.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ wo nua no mmbɛn wo, anaa sɛ innyim no a, ɔno fa no bra wo fie wo, na ɔnko wo nkyɛn nkodu dɛ wo nua no bɔhwehwɛ no, na aadan no ama no bio.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na dɛmara so na fa yɛ n’asoaso; anaa wo nua n’adze biara a ayew no a ehu no: mma nnguan mmfi ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nnhu wo nua n’asoaso anaa ne nantwi dɛ ɔahwe ase wɔ ɔkwan mu, na mmfi ho nnkosuma: boa no ma ɔmma hɔn do bio.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma ɔbaa nnhyɛ adze a ɔyɛ ɔbanyin dze, nkyii so ɔbanyin nnhyɛ ɔbaa n’atar: na obiara a ɔyɛ iyinom no ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ ikopue anoma ne birebuw bi do awerɛfir mu wɔ ɔkwan mu, wɔ dua biara do anaa famu, mba anaa nkyirefuwa wɔ mu, na na no butuw na mba no, anaa nkyirefuwa no do a, mma nnkyer na no nnka mba no ho;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno ma na no nkɔ, na fa mba no; na eesi wo yie, na ama wo nda aawar.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ isi dan fofor a, ɔno gye wo dan etsifi ban, ama sɛ obi fi do hwe ase a, aammfa bɔgya ammba wo dan no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma mmfa aba horow ebien nndua wo wenyin ture mu: amma aannhwer nduadzewa no nyina, aba a edua no, nye wenyin ture no ndɔbaa no nyina.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma mmfa ɔnantwi nye asoaso mmbɔ mu mmfuntum.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma mmfura tam a wɔdze kuntu nye ndwera afora awen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Tu wo tam a edze kata wo do no ntoado anan no do ndwow.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ ɔbanyin bi hyia yer, na ɔkɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔtan no,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ɔdze enyimguasesɛm to no do, na ɔbɔ no dzin bɔn, se dɛ, Mihyiaa ɔbaa yi, na mokɔr ne nkyɛn no, mennhu no ho mbaabunyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze no a:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno akataasia no n’egya nye ne na mfa akataasia no ne mbaabunyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze no na wɔmfa mbra kurow no mu mpanyimfo nkyɛn wɔ kuropon no mu;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na akataasia no n’egya nse mpanyimfo no dɛ, Medze me babaa maa ɔbanyin yi awar, na ɔtan no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na, hwɛ, ɔdze enyimguasesɛm ato no do, dɛ, Mennhu mbaabunyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze wɔ wo babaa yi ho; naaso me babaa ne mbaabunyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye yi. Na wɔntserɛw tam no mu wɔ kurow no mu mpanyimfo no enyim.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na kurow no mu mpanyimfo no mfa ɔbanyin no na wɔntwe n’aso;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na wɔngye no mbratodze dwetɛ ɔha, na wɔmfa mma akataasia no n’egya, osiandɛ ɔabɔ Israel ɔbaabun dzin bɔn: na nwar no; mma ɔnnko no wɔ ne nda nyinara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ asɛm yi yɛ nokwar, dɛ woennhu mbaabunyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze wɔ akataasia no ho dze a:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno wonyi akataasia no mbra n’egya ne fi abowano, na no kurow no mu mbanyin nsiw no abo ma onwu: osiandɛ ɔayɛ nkwaseadze wɔ Israel, dɛ ɔagor ndwamangor wɔ n’egya fie: ama eeyi mbusu no efi wo mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ wohu ɔbanyin bi dɛ ɔnye ɔbaa a ɔwɔ kun da a, ɔno hɔn beenu nyina nwu, ɔbanyin a ɔnye ɔbaa no dae no, nye ɔbaa no: ama eeyi mbusu no efi Israel.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ wɔdze akataasia bi a ɔyɛ ɔbaabun ma banyin bi awar, na banyin bi hu no wɔ kurow mu, na ɔnye no da a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno hom mfa hɔn emu ebien nyina mfir edzi nkɔ kurow no n’abotsen ekyir, na hom nsiw hɔn abo ma wonwuwu; akataasia no, dɛ ɔwɔ kurow mu na ɔannkeka mu ntsi; na ɔbanyin no, dɛ ɔabrɛ ne nyɛnko ne yer adze ntsi: ama eeyi mbusu no efi wo mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ banyin bi hu akataasia ɔwarfo bi yer no wɔ haban mu, na ɔbanyin no kyer no, na ɔnye no da a; ɔno ɔbanyin a ɔnye no dae no nko na onwu:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na akataasia no dze mma nnyɛ no hwee; bɔn a ɔsɛ owu nnyi akataasia no do: na dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa soɛr ne nyɛnko do, na oku no no, dɛmara so na asɛm yi tse:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na haban mu na ohun no; na akataasia a wɔagye no yer no kekaa mu, na nna obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɛgye no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ banyin bi hu akataasia a ɔyɛ ɔbaabun a wɔnngyee no yer, na ɔkyer no, na ɔnye no da, na wohu hɔn a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno banyin a ɔnye no dae no, mfa dwetɛ dwetɛbona eduonum mma akataasia no n’egya, na ɔnyɛ ne yer, osiandɛ ɔabrɛ no adze; mma ɔnnko no ne nda nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔbanyin bi nnwar n’egya ne yer, na onnyi n’egya n’akatado.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nyia no ntɔhwɛbo abɔ, anaa ne banyin etwa no, mma ɔnnhɛn EWURADZE ne baguaa mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nyia wɔawo no wɔ edwaman bi nnhɛn EWURADZE ne baguaa mu; n’ebusuasantsen a otsia du mpo mu biara nnhɛn EWURADZE ne baguaa mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ammonnyi anaa Moabnyi nnhɛn EWURADZE ne baguaa mu; hɔn ebusuasantsen a otsia du mpo mu biara nnhɛn EWURADZE ne baguaa mu ara da:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: osiandɛ wɔammfa edziban na ɔnye nsu emmbehyia hom wɔ ɔkwan no mu, aber a hom fi Egypt reba no; na dɛ wɔkɔbɔɔ Beer ne babanyin Balaam a ofi Petor a ɔwɔ Mesopotemia no paa dɛ ɔmbɔdom wo ntsi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Naaso EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ammpɛ dɛ otsie Balaam; na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn daan ndom no nhyira maa wo, osiandɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dɔɔ wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nnhwehwɛ hɔn asomdwee nye hɔn eyiedzi wo nda nyinara daa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nnkyir Edomnyi; na ɔyɛ wo nua: mma nnkyir Egyptnyi; osiandɛ ekɛyɛɛ n’asaase do ɔhɔho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ebusuasantsen a otsia ebiasa mba a wɔbɔwo hɔn ama hɔn no na wɔnhɛn EWURADZE ne baguaa mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ ifir edzi kɛkyer w’atamfo ho nsera a, ɔno sie woho yie wɔ adze bɔn biara ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ ɔbanyin bi wɔ hom mu a no ho nntsew wɔ no ha a ɔsen anadwe bi ntsi a, ɔno omfi nseraban no mu nkɔ ekyir, mma ɔmmba nseraban no mu;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ɔmbra dɛ orudu ewimbir no, onguar noho wɔ nsu mu: na sɛ wi kɔtɔ a, ɔmbra nseraban no mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nya beebi so wɔ nseraban no ekyir, mbrɛ ibefir edzi akɔ:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na nya ɔsɔsɔw wɔ wo ndadzedze mu; na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ekɔkotow ekyir hɔ a, edze eefun, na aasan ekyir akata dza ofi wo mu ba no do:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn nenam wo nseraban mu, dɛ ɔregye wo, na ɔdze w’atamfo ama wɔ w’enyim; dɛm ntsi wo nseraban nyɛ krɔnkrɔn: amma oeennhu efifidze bi wɔ wo mu, na ɔaanndan emmfi wo nkyɛn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nnyi akowaa a oefi no wura nkyɛn eguan aba wo hɔ mma no wura:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ma ɔnye wo ntsena, wɔ wo mu, wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛsan mu eyi no wɔ wo nkuropon no kor mu, mbrɛ ɔpɛ no dodow no: mma nnhyɛ no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma Israel mbabaa mu biara nnyɛ edwaman, nkyii so mma Israel mbabanyin mu biara nndan edwaman.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma mmfa ɔbaa edwaman apaabɔdze, anaa ɔkraman (banyin edwaman) n’akatua, mmba EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn fie wɔ anohoba biara mu: na ebien yi nyina yɛ ekyiwadze ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma mmbɔ wo nua bosa nngye nsiho:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔnanaben na bɔ no bosa gye nsiho; na wo nua dze, mma mmbɔ no bosa nngye nsiho: na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn eehyira wo adze a edze wo nsa bɛka nyinara mu, wɔ asaase a erokɔ akɛfa no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ ebɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn anohoba a, mma nnyɛ nyaa dɛ ebɔpon: na ampaara EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɔhwehwɛ no wɔ wo hɔ; na ɔbɛdan wo bɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ ema anohoba no ka a, ɔnnyɛ bɔn mma wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dza efi w’anofamfa do epue no dwen do na yɛ; dɛ mbrɛ abɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn anohoba, ayamuyi afɔr a edze w’ano aka no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ idu wo nyɛnko no wenyin ture mu a, ɔno dzi esikyireamba no bi mee; mbom mma mmfa bi nngu w’adze mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ idu wo nyɛnko n’eburow a osisi hɔ mu a, ɔno fa wo nsa pempan mbɛtsem no bi; mbom mma mma dadze do wɔ wo nyɛnko n’eburow a osisi hɔ do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ ɔbanyin bi fa ɔbaa, na ɔwar no a, ɔno ɔba dɛ, sɛ onnya n'enyiwa do enyimnyam, osiandɛ oehu no ho enyitodze bi ntsi a, ɔnkyerɛw ɔkonwoma mma no, na ɔmfa nhyɛ ne nsa, na ongya no kwan ma omfi ne fie nkɔ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ ofi ne fie kɔ a, ɔnkɔ nkɛyɛ ɔbanyin fofor bi ne yer.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ nkyinkyirii kun no so tan no, na ɔkyerɛw ɔkonwoma ma no, na ɔdze hyɛ ne nsa, na ogya no kwan ma ofi ne fie kɔ; anaa sɛ nkyinkyirii kun no a ɔfaa no yɛɛ ne yer no wu a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mma no kun kankan no a ogyaa no kwan no, mmfa no nnyɛ ne yer bio, wɔ no ho fi-gu ekyir no; na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze wɔ Ewuradze enyim: Na mma nnyɛ ma asaase a Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no do nnyɛ bɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ ɔbanyin bi hyia yer fofor a, mma ɔnnkɔ sa, nkyii so mma wɔmmfa edwuma biara nnto no do: Ondzi noho wɔ fie afrenhyia, na ɔmma ne yer a oehyia no no akomatɔmu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nyimpa bi nngye ewuyambo anaa ewuyambobaa a ɔda do no ahoba:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ wohu nyimpa a owia no nuanom Israel mu bi, na ɔyɛ no dɛ onyimfo, anaa ɔtɔn no a; ɔno owifo no nwu; ama eeyi mbusu no efi wo mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hwɛ yie wɔ kwata owuyar ho, na aadwen do yie ayɛ dɛ mbrɛ asɔfo Levifo no bɛkyerɛkyerɛ hom no nyinara: Dɛ mbrɛ mehyɛɛ hɔn no, dɛmara so na hom ndwen do nyɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Kaa dza Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn dze yɛɛ Miriam wɔ ɔkwan no mu aber a hom fi Egypt reba no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ ebɔ wo nyɛnko bosa biara a, mma nnkɔ ne fie nnkɛgye n'ahobadze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Abowenyim na gyina, na nyimpa a ebɔ no bosa no mfa ahobadze no mfir edzi mbrɛ wo wɔ abowenyim.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ ɔyɛ ohianyi a, mma mmfa n'ahobadze no nnda:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ wi kɔtɔ a, fa ahobadze no san kɛma no, na ɔnda wɔ n'atar mu, na onhyira wo: Na ɔnyɛ tsenenee mma wo wɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn enyim
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nnhyɛ ɔpaanyi a ɔyɛ ɔbɔbɔnyi nye ohianyi no do, sɛ ofi wo nuanom mu o, ofi w'ahɔhoe a wɔwɔ w'asaase do wɔ wo nkuropɔn mu o:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ne da mu na ma no n'apaadze, nkyii so mma wi nnkɔtɔ do; osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔbɔbɔnyi, na ɔdze n'akoma esi do: Amma ɔaannka mu ammfrɛ Ewuradze enntsia wo, na aanyɛ bɔn amma wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma wonnku egyanom wɔ mba ntsi, nkyii so mma wonnku mba wɔ egyanom ntsi: Nyimpa biara nankasa no bɔn ntsi na wonku no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nndan ɔhɔho, anaa egyanka n'atsɛmbu enyi na nngye okunafo akataho ahoba:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na kaa dɛ eyɛɛ akowaa wɔ Egypt, na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn poon wo wɔ hɔ: Dɛm ntsi na merehyɛ wo dɛ iyi yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ itwa wo ndɔbaa wɔ wo haban no mu a, mma nnsan nnkɔ nnkɛfa mmba: Ma ɔnyɛ ɔhɔho, egyanka, nye okunafo dze: Na Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn eehyira wo wɔ wo nsaano edwuma nyinara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ eporow wo ngodua a, mma nnkɔ n'abaw no do bio: Ma ɔnyɛ ɔhɔho, egyanka, nye okunafa dze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ etsew wo wenyin ture mu esikyireamba a, mma nnkedzi w'ekyir mpɛpɛw: Ma ɔnyɛ ɔhɔho, egyanka, nye okunafo dze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na kaa dɛ eyɛɛ akowaa wɔ Egypt asaase do: Dɛm ntsi na merehyɛ wo dɛ yɛ iyi yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ ɔham ba mbanyin ntamu, na wɔba asɛndzii, na ntsɛmbuafo rubua hɔn atsɛn a; ɔno wombu ɔtseneneenyi no bem, na wombu ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi no fɔ;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi no sɛ hwe a, ɔtsɛmbuafo no mma ɔnda famu, na wɔnhwe no wɔ n’enyim, dodow dɛ mbrɛ no bɔn no tse.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mbaa eduanan na ɔsɛ no a, mma ɔmmbor: ɔno bɛyɛ na sɛ ɔbor, na ɔhwe no mbaa pii sen iyi a, wo nua no adan w’enyi do ɔhorohoraanyi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nnkata ɔnantwi ano aber a oritsia ewu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ enuanom bɔ mu tsena, na hɔn mu baako wu, na onnyi ɔbabanyin a, mma owufo no ne yer nnkɔ ehuw mu nnkɔwar ɔhɔho: no kun no no nua na ɔnkɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔmfa no nyɛ ne yer, na ɔnyɛ okun no nua asɛdze no mma no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ, abakan a ɔbɔwo no no nhyɛ no nua a oewu no ne dzin ananmu, na ne dzin aammpepa emmfi Israel.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ ɔbanyin no mmpɛ dɛ ɔfa no nua yer no a, ɔno no nua ne yer no nkɔ mpanyimfo nkyɛn wɔ kuropon no ano, na ɔnse dɛ, Mo kun no nua pow dɛ ɔma dzin do ma no nua wɔ Israel, ɔmmpɛ dɛ ɔyɛ kun no nua asɛdze no ma me.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔno no kurow no mu mpanyimfo no mfrɛ no, na wɔnkasa nkyerɛ no: na sɛ ogyina hɔ, na ɔse dɛ, Memmpɛ dɛ mefa no a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno no nua ne yer no mbra ne nkyɛn wɔ mpanyimfo no enyim, onyi banyin no n’ananadze mpaboa na onhima n’enyi do ntafi; na ɔnse dɛ, Dɛm na wɔnyɛ ɔbanyin a ɔnnkyekyer no nua ne fi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na wɔmfrɛ ne dzin wɔ Israel dɛ, Nyia ne mpaboa efi n’ananadze no ne fi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ mbanyin beenu roko, na ɔbaako ne yer twe bɛn dɛ ɔrebɛgye no kun efi nyia ɔrohwe no ne nsamu, na basia no tsen ne nsa suo banyin kor no ne banyin mu a:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno twa ɔbaa no ne nsa, mma w’enyi nnhu no mbɔbɔr.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nnya wo foto mu abrambo ahorow, kɛse nye kakraba.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mma nnya wo fi mu esusudze ahorow, kɛse nye kakraba.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Abrambo kwan mu a ɔtsen na nya; esusudze kwan mu a ɔtsen na nya: na wo nda aawar wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm ndzɛmba nyinara, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ dza ɔmmfa kwan mu nyinara, yɛ ekyiwadze ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Kaa dza Amalek dze yɛɛ wo wɔ ɔkwan no mu aber a hom fi Egypt reba no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mbrɛ osii behyiaa wo wɔ ɔkwan no mu, na ɔbɔɔ w’ekyirfo, hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw wɔ w’ekyir nyinara, aber a atɔ bahaw na aberɛ; na oennsuro Nyankopɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ma wo ahomgye fi w’atamfo a woetwa wo ho ehyia nyinara nsamu wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ fa yɛ egyapadze no do a, pepa Amalek nkaa fi ɔsor ase; mma wo werɛ mmfir.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ idu asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo dɛ egyapadze no do, na efa, na etsena do a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: fa asaase no do nduadzewa a ibenya no wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do no, no nduadzewa a odzi kan no nyinara mu bi; na fa gu kɛntsɛn mu, na fa kɔ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsan mu eyi dɛ ne dzin ntsena hɔ no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na kɔ ɔsɔfo a ɔbɛtsena hɔ nda no mu no nkyɛn, na se no dɛ ndɛ da yi mepaa mu meka kyerɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, dɛ medu asaase a EWURADZE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom dɛ ɔdze rema hɛn no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔsɔfo no ngye kɛntsɛn no wɔ wo nsamu, na ɔmfa nsi EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn n’afɔrmbukyia no enyim.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na bua na ka no wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim dɛ, Sirianyi a ɔreyɛ ahera nye m’egya, na osianee kɔr Egypt, na ɔkɛtsenaa hɔ, ne nyimpa kumaabi; na ɔyɛɛ ɔman kɛse a wɔyɛ dzen, na wɔdɔree wɔ hɔ:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na Egyptfo no yɛɛ hɛn bɔn, na wohiahiaa hɛnho, na wɔdze nkowaasom dzendzen too hɛn do:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na yɛkekaa mu frɛɛ EWURADZE, hɛn egyanom Nyankopɔn, na EWURADZE tsiee hɛn ndze, na ohun hɛn ahohiahia, nye hɛn fona, nye hɛn su:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na EWURADZE dze nsa a ɔyɛ dzen, nye abasa a wɔatserɛw mu, nye suro akɛse, nye nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye anwanwadze yii hɛn fii Egypt firii:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ɔdze hɛn aba bea yi do, na ɔdze asaase yi ama hɛn, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na afei, hwɛ, medze asaase a ɔwo, EWURADZE, dze ama me no do nduadzewa a odzi kan no aba. Na fa si EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim, na sɔr wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na gye w’enyi wɔ adzepa a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze ama ɔwo, nye wo fi nyinara mu, ɔwo, nye Levinyi, nye ɔhɔho a ɔwɔ wo mu no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ iwie wo ndɔbaa mu ebupɛn du du nyinara yiyi wɔ afe a otsia ebiasa no a ɔyɛ ebupɛn du du yiyi afe no mu a, ɔno fa ma Levinyi, nye ɔhɔho, nye egyanka, nye ekunafo, ma wondzi wɔ wo kuropon mu, mmee;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na se wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim dɛ, Meyi ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn no efi me fie, na afei so medze ama Levinyi, nye ɔhɔho, nye egyanka, nye okunafo, dɛ mbrɛ wo mbrasɛm a edze ahyɛ me no nyinara tse monntoo wo mbransɛm mu biara, nkyii so mo werɛ mmfirii.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Minndzii bi wɔ m’eyiyɛ mu, nkyii so minnyii bi nnkyenee dɛ no ho nntsew ntsi, na memmfaa bi memmaa ewufo so: metsie EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn ndze, mayɛ dɛ mbrɛ edze ahyɛ me no nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Fi wo tsenabew krɔnkrɔn no, wɔ ɔsor, hwɛ famu, na hyira wo man Israel, nye asaase a edze ama hɛn no, dɛ mbrɛ ekaa ntam kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom no, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ndɛ da yi EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn rehyɛ wo dɛ yɛ ahyɛdze nye atsɛmbu yi: dɛm ntsi fa w’akoma nyinara nye wo kra nyinara dzi do na yɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ndɛ da yi, aka ato gua dɛ edze EWURADZE bɛyɛ wo Nyankopɔn, na anantsew n’akwan mu, na edze n’ahyɛdze, nye ne mbransɛm, nye ne ntsɛmbu do, na etsie ne ndze:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na EWURADZE aka ato gua ndɛ da yi dɛ ebɛyɛ nankasa no soronko man, dɛ mbrɛ ɔabɔ wo anohoba no, na eedzi ne mbransɛm nyinara do;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ɔaama wo do akyɛn amanaman a ɔayɛ nyinara, wɔ ayɛyi mu, nye dzin mu, nye enyidzi mu; na aayɛ ɔman krɔnkrɔn ama EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, dɛ mbrɛ ɔaka no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Moses nye Israel mpanyimfo no hyɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, Hom ndzi mbrasɛm a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi nyinara do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ, da a hom botwa Jordan akɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do no, fa abo akɛse sisi hɔ, na fa ntarho tetar ho:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na kyerɛw mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara wɔ do, aber a etwa no; na aakɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE, w’egyanom Nyankopɔn, abɔ wo anohoba no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ aber a hom etwa Jordan no, hom mfa abo yi a merehyɛ hom ndɛ da yi, nsisi hɔ wɔ bepɔw Ebal do, na fa ntarho tetar ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hɔ na si afɔrmbukyia ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, abo afɔrmbukyia a: mma emma dadze edwindze do wɔ do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Abo a wonntwae na fa si EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn afɔrmbukyia no: na bɔ ɔhyew afɔr wɔ do ma EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na bɔ asomdwee afɔr, na dzidzi wɔ hɔ; na gye w’enyi wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na kyerɛw mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara petee wɔ abo no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Moses nye Levifo asɔfo no kasaa kyerɛɛ Israel nyinara dɛ, Israel, hom nyɛ dzinn, na hom ntsie; ndɛ da yi abɛyɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne man.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi tsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze, na dzi ne mbransɛm na n’ahyɛdze a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Moses hyɛɛ ɔman no da no ara, dɛ,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Iyinom na wongyina bepɔw Gerizim do nhyira ɔman no, aber a hom etwa Jordan no; Simeon, Levi, Juda, Isakar Josef, nye Benjamin:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na iyinom ngyina bepɔw Ebal do mpaa; Reuben, Gad Aser, Zebulun, Dan, nye Naftali.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Levifo no mfa ndze kɛse ntsea mu, na wɔnse Israelfo no nyinara dɛ:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa nka nyimpa a ɔbɛyɛ ohonyi a wɔasen anaa woegu, EWURADZE ekyiwadze, odwimfo nsaano edwuma, na ɔdze besi kokoa mu. Na ɔman no nyinara mbua nse dɛ, Amen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa nka nyia ɔyaw n’egya anaa ne na. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa nka nyia ɔtwe ne nyɛnko n’asaasehe. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa nka nyia ɔma onyifurafo fi ɔkwan do kyin. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa nka nyia ɔdan ɔhɔho, egyanka, nye okunafo atsɛmbu enyi. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa nka nyia ɔnye n’egya yer da; osiandɛ oeyi n’egya n’akataho. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa nka nyia ɔnye abowa biara da. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa nka nyia ɔnye n’akyerɛbaa da, n’egya ne babaa, anaa ne na ne babaa. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa nka nyia ɔnye n’asew da. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa nka nyia ɔbɔ ne nyɛnko adze nsumaa mu. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa nka nyia ɔgye mboaba dɛ oboku nyimpa a odzi bem. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa nka nyia ɔnnhyɛ mbra yi mu nsɛm dzen dɛ ɔbɛyɛ. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ itsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze yie, dɛ ebɔdwen do ayɛ ne mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara a, EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma wo do akɔ sor asen asaase do amanaman nyinara:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na nhyira yi nyinara bɛba wo do, na wɔabɔto wo, osiandɛ itsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ndze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nhyira bɛka wo wɔ kurow mu, na nhyira aka wo wɔ haban mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nhyira bɛka wo honam mu aba, na w’asaase do aba, na wo fiembowa mu aba, w’anantwi ndɔree, nye wo nguankuw mu mburwa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nhyira bɛka wo kɛntsɛn nye wo mbɔrkorow.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nhyira bɛka wo wɔ wo fie ba mu, na nhyira bɛka wo wɔ w’edzifir mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE bɛma w’atamfo a wɔsoɛr wo do no edzi nkogu wɔ w’enyim: wɔnam ɔkwan kor do bɛba wo do, na wɔnam akwan esuon do eguan wɔ w’enyim.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE bɛhyɛ ma nhyira aba wo do wɔ w’asan do, na dza edze wo nsa bɛka nyinara mu; na obehyira wo wɔ asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze rema wo no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ idzi EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne mbransɛm do, na enantsew n’akwan do a EWURADZE dze wo betsim hɔ ma aayɛ ɔman krɔnkrɔn ama noara, dɛ mbrɛ ɔaka ntam akyerɛ wo no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na asaase do aman nyinara bohu dɛ wɔdze EWURADZE dzin afrɛ wo; na wobosuro wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE bɛma yie ebu wo do, wɔ wo honam mu aba mu, nye wo fiembowa aba mu, nye w’asaase aba mu, wɔ asaase a EWURADZE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w’egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma wo no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE bobue ɔsor n’adzepa korabea no ama wo na ɔaama w’asaase do nyankom atɔ wɔ n’aber mu, na oeehyira wo nsaano edwuma nyinara do: na edze bɛfɛm amanaman pii, na ɔwo remmfɛm.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: sɛ itsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi dɛ ebɔdwen do ayɛ a, EWURADZE bɛma akɔ kan na ennkɛka ekyir; na ɔwo bɔbɔ do ara nko, na eremmba ase.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ne dɛm ntsi mma nndan mmfi nsɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi ho, mmfa enyimfa, anaa abankum, nnkɔ nnkedzi enyame fofor ekyir nnkɔsom hɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ enntsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze dɛ ebɔdwen do edzi ne mbransɛm nye n’ahyɛdze a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara do a; mpaa yi nyinara bɛba wo do, na wɔabɛmen wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa bɛka wo wɔ kurow mu, na mpaa aka wo wɔ haban mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa bɛka wo kɛntsɛn, nye wo mbɔrkorow.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa bɛka wo honam mu aba, nye w’asaase mu aba, nye w’anantwi mu ndɔree, nye wo nguankuw mu mburwa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mpaa bɛka wo wɔ wo fie ba mu, na mpaa bɛka wo wɔ w’edzifir mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE bɛma mpaa, nkogu, nye adapaabɔ aba wo do, wɔ dza edze wo nsa bɛka ayɛ nyinara mu, dze ekodu dɛ ebɛsɛɛ, na ayew ntsɛm; osian wo ndzeyɛɛ a enam do apow me ntsi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE bɛma ɔyardɔm afam wo ho, dze ekodu dɛ ɔahyew wo efi asaase a erokɔ do akɛfa no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE dze asasawaw, nye etsiridii, nye ahohur, nye ahohyehye kɛse, nye nkrantsee, nye ɔhow, nye ɔpo bɔbɔ wo; na wobetsiw wo araa ekodu dɛ ebɛsɛɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔsor bɛyɛ dɛ boran ama wo, na asaase adan dadze ama wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE bɛma etudur na huntuma atɔ dɛ nsu egu wo do araa ekodu dɛ wɔbɛsɛɛ wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE bɛma edzi w’atamfo enyim ɔkogu: enam ɔkwan kor do befir edzi ekehyia hɔn, na enam akwan esuon do eguan wɔ hɔn enyim: na wobedzi wo akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do ahendzi nyinara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na wo fun bɛyɛ wimu ntumbowa nyinara, nye asaase do mbowa edziban, na obiara rennka hɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE dze Egypt pɔmpɔ, tukuruw, satwem, nye ntwem a worunntum wo eduyɛ bɔbobɔ wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE dze abɔdam, nye enyifura, nye akoma mu ahodwuruw bɔbɔ wo;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ebɛkeka ewiaber ketee, dɛ ofurafo rekeka wɔ sum mu, na w’akwan mu rennyɛ wo yie: na ɔhyɛ nko na wɔbɛhyɛ wo na wɔafow wo dabaa, na obiara renngye wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ebɛgye ayewar, na ɔbanyin fofor bi nye no ada: ibesi dan, na erenntsena mu: ebɛtsɛw wenyin ture, na erenntsew n’aba bi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Woboku wo nantwi wɔ w’enyim, na irinndzi bi: wɔbɛfa w’asoaso enyimpi do wɔ w’enyim, na wɔrenndan mma wo: wɔdze wo nguan bɛma w’atamfo na innkenya obi ma ɔaagye wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Wɔdze wo mbabanyin nye wo mbabaa bɛma ɔman fofor bi na w’enyiwa bɔhwɛ, na hɔn ho enyigyinae egura wo daa nyinara: na tum biara nnyi wo nsamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: W’asaase do aba, nye w’edwumadze nyinara, na ɔman a innyim hɔn bedzi; na ɔhyɛ nko na wɔbɛhyɛ wo na wɔadwerew wo dabaa:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: dɛm ntsi w’enyiwa do adze a ibohu no bɔbɔ wo dam.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE dze pɔmpɔ bɔn bɔbɔ wo wɔ anankoroma, nye aserɛ do a worunntum wo eduyɛ, efi w’ananadze ekodu w’etsifipampamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE dze ɔwo, nye wo hen a ibesi no wo do no, bɔkɔ ɔman a ɔwo nye w’egyanom nnyim no mu; na hɔ na ebɔsom enyame fofor, ndua nye abo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ebɛdan ahodwuruwdze, akasabɛbu, nye ifen, wɔ aman a EWURADZE bɛma akɔ no nyinara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ebɔsoa aba pii akɔ haban mu, na kakrabaabi na ebɔboa ano aba fie; na mbɛbɛw bedzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ebɛtsetsɛw wenyin nture na esiesie mu, na ne nsa dze eronnom, na erenntsew esikyireamba no so; na mbowaba bedzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ibenya ngodua wɔ wo ntoado nyinara, na ngo no dze erennsera woho bi; na wo ngodua no bɔporow n’aba.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ebɔwo mbabanyin nye mbabaa, na wɔrennyɛ wodze; na wɔbɔkɔ ndɔmmum mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Wo ndua nyinara nye w’asaase do aba no mbɛbɛw bɛfa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔhɔho a ɔwɔ wo mu bɛkyɛn wo akɔ sorsorsor; na ɔwo dze ibesian aba famufamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔno na ɔdze bɛfɛm wo, na ɔwo dze, irinnya mmfɛm no: ɔno na ɔbɔkɔ kan, na ɔwo aka ekyir.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mpaa yi nyinara bɛba wo do, na woetsiw wo, na wɔamen wo, ekodu dɛ ebɛsɛɛ; osiandɛ enntsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ndze, dɛ ibedzi ne mbransɛm nye n’ahyɛdze a ɔhyɛ wo no do:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ɔbɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze, wɔ ɔwo nye w’asefo do daa:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: osiandɛ ammfa enyigye, nye akoma pa annsom EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, wɔ adze nyinara no dodow mu ntsi:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: dɛm ntsi ebɔsom w’atamfo a EWURADZE bɔsoma hɔn ma wɔaaba wo do no, wɔ ɔkɔm, nsukɔm, adagyaw, nye ndzɛmba nyinara ho hia mu: na ɔdze dadze kɔndua bɔto wo kɔn do, ekodu dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE dze ɔman bi befi ekyirekyir efi asaase ano aba wo do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkɔr tu; ɔman a enntse hɔn kasaa;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔman a hɔn enyim yɛ hu a wɔmmfɛr akɔdaa enyim, na wɔnnkyerɛ enyimtsewee wɔ aberantsɛ do so:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na obedzi wo fiembowa mu aba, na w’asaase do aba, ekodu dɛ wɔbɛsɛɛ wo: eso orinngya wo eburow, nsa, anaa ngo, w’anantwi mu ndɔree, anaa wo nguankuw mu mburwa, ekodu dɛ ɔbɛma asɛe.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɔkɔ wo ntua wɔ wo nkuropon nyinara mu, ekodu dɛ w’afasu atsentsen a ɔyɛ dzen no a edze wo werɛ hyɛ mu no bodwuruw egu famu, wɔ w’asaase nyina do: na ɔbɔkɔ wo ntua wɔ wo nkuropon nyinara a ɔwɔ w’asaase a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze ama wo no nyinara do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ibedzi woara wo honam mu aba, wo mbabanyin nye wo mbabaa a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze ama wo no hɔn nam; wɔ ntua nye ahokyer a w’atamfo bɛma wo ho akyer wo no mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔbanyin a ɔdwe na ɔwɔ tsema wɔ hom mu no n’enyiwa bɛyɛ bɔn wɔ no nua, nye ne yer a ɔda no bo mu, nye ne mba nkaa a wɔama wɔaka no ho:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: dɛ ɔremma hɔn mu biara ne mba nam a oridzi no bi, osiandɛ biribiara annka amma no; wɔ ntua nye ahokyer a wo tamfo bɛma wo ho akyer wo wɔ wo nkuropon nyinara mu no mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom mu ɔbaa so a ɔdwe na ɔsonsɔn no ho na ɔnam mberɛwyɛ ntsi ɔnnsɔe nnhwɛɛ pɛn dɛ ɔdze n’ananadze bɛka famu no, bɛyɛ nyimpa bɔn wɔ no kun a ɔda no bo mu, nye ne babanyin, nye ne babaa ho;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ɔbɔwe ne mba a ɔbɔwo hɔn no nye ekyiradze no wɔ nsumaa mu: wɔ ahohia a ofi ntua nye ahokyer a wo tamfo bɛma aba wo do wɔ wo nkuropon mu no ntsi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ eronndwen do nnyɛ mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu, na ennsuro enyimnyam dzin a no ho yɛ hu yi, EWURADZE WO NYANKOPƆN no a,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno EWURADZE bɛma wo yardɔm, nye w’asefo yardɔm ayɛ nwanwa; mekyerɛ ɔyardɔm akɛse a ɔkyɛr, nye yarba bɔn a ɔkyɛr.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔdze Egypt yarba no a isuro no nyinara bɛba wo do bio; na ɔabɛfemfam wo ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Eso yarba biara, nye ɔyardɔm biara a wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ mbra yi no nwoma mu no, ɔno na EWURADZE dze bɛba wo do, ekodu dɛ wɔbɛsɛɛ wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛka hom nyimpa kakrabaabi, naaso nna nkyɛ hom dodow tse dɛ ɔsor nworaba; osiandɛ hom enntsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne ndze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’enyi gye hom ho dɛ ɔbɛyɛ hom yie, na ɔama hom adɔr no; dɛmara so na EWURADZE n’enyi bɛgye hom ho dɛ ɔbɛma hom ase etu, na ɔasɛɛ hom: na wɔbɛpempan hom efi asaase a hom rokɔ do akɛfa no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE bɔbɔ wo apetse aman nyinara mu, efi asaase ano kor araa ekodu asaase ano kor so; na hɔ na ebɔsom enyame fofor a ɔwo nye w’egyanom nnyim hɔn, mekyerɛ ndua nye abo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na amanaman iyinom mu irinnya ahotɔ, na w’ananadze rinnya ahomgye: na EWURADZE bɛma wo ahopopo akoma, nye enyiwa a ayɛ siamoo, nye ɔkra a etwintwam wɔ hɔ:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na wo nkwa bɛsɛn ehihim wɔ w’enyim; na ibosuro adzesaa nye adzekyee, na irinnya wo nkwa ho gyedzi biara:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: anapa ebɛse dɛ, Kɛtseankyɛ ewimbir a: na ewimbir so ebɛse dɛ, Kɛtseankyɛ anapa a: wɔ w’akoma mu suro a ibosuro, nye w’enyiwa do adze a ibohu no ntsi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE dze ahɛn dze wo bɛsan akɔ Egypt, wɔ ɔkwan a mekaa wo ho asɛm dɛ irunnhu bio no do: na hɔ na hom bɔtontɔn homho ama hom atamfo ayɛ nkowaa nye mfonabaa, na nyimpa biara ronntɔ hom.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Iyi nye ahyɛmu a EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses dɛ ɔnye Israelmba ndzi wɔ Moab asaase do, nka ahyɛmu a ɔnye hɔn dzii wɔ Horeb no ho no, no mu nsɛm.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Moses frɛɛ Israel nyinara, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ehu adze nyinara a EWURADZE dze yɛɛ Farao, nye no nkowaa nyinara, nye n’asaase nyinara, wɔ hom enyiwa mu, wɔ Egypt asaase do;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nsɔhwɛ akɛse a w’enyiwa hunii, nsɛnkyerɛdze, nye anwanwadze akɛse no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: naaso obodu ndɛ da yi, EWURADZE mmaa wo dɛm akoma a onyim dze, enyiwa a wɔdze hwɛ, nye asowa a wɔdze tsie.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na medzi hom enyim ma hom anantsew mfe eduanan wɔ sar no do; hom ntar nnsuwii wɔ hom ho, na wo mpaboa nntsetsewee wɔ w’ananadze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom nndzii paanoo, nkyii so hom nnoom wenyin anaa nsa dzendzen: ama hom eehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na aber a hom dur bea yi do no, Hesbonhen Sihon, nye Basenhen Ɔge, fiir edzi baa hɛn do nye hɛn bɔkoe, na yekum hɔn;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na yɛfaa hɔn asaase, na yɛdze maa Reubenfo, nye Gadfo, nye Manaasɛfo ebusuakuw ɔfa no, dɛ egyapadze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ndzi ahyɛmu yi mu nsɛm do, na hom nyɛ, na hom aayɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ dza hom yɛ nyinara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ndɛ da yi hom nyinara hom ngyina EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn enyim; hom etsitsir, hom ebusuakuw ebusuakuw, hom mpanyimfo, nye hom ahwɛdofo, mekyerɛ Israel mbanyin nyinara,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: hom mbofraba, hom yernom, nye wo hɔhoe a ɔwɔ wo nseraban mu, ofi wo duatwafo do dze kodu wo nsusawfo do:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ama aahɛn EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn n’ahyɛmu, nye ne nsew a Ɔnye wo ridzi ndɛ da yi mu:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ama ɔdze wo eesi hɔ ndɛ da yi dɛ ɔman ama noho, na ɔno so aayɛ Nyankopɔn ama wo, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa kyerɛɛ wo, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ w’egyanom, Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so nnyɛ hom nko na menye hom ridzi ahyɛmu yi nye nsew yi:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mbom menye nyia ɔnye hɛn gyina EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim ha ndɛ da yi, na eso menye nyia ɔnnye hɛn nnyi ha ndɛ da yi:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: (na hom nyim mbrɛ yesii tsenaa Egypt asaase do; na mbrɛ yesii twaa mu wɔ amanaman a hom faa hɔn mu baa no mu;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na hom ehu hɔn ekyiwadze, na hɔn abosom, ndua nye abo, dwetɛ nye sika a ɔwɔ hɔn mu no:)
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hom nhwɛ yie amma hom mu ɔbanyin bi, anaa ɔbaa bi, anaa ebusua bi, anaa ebusuakuw bi n’akoma anndan ndɛ da yi emmfi EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ho, dɛ ɔrokɔ akɔsom amanaman no hɔn enyame no: na ndwow bi aammba hom mu a ɔsow bɔr nye ɔbɔwen;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na aammba dɛ, sɛ ɔtse mpaa yi mu nsɛm a, oeennhyira noho wɔ n’akoma mu, dɛ, mibenya asomdwee, kaansa menam m’akoma no sorow mu mpo a, amma wɔaannsɛɛ dza afɔw annka dza awow ho.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE remmfa nnkyɛ no, na mbom EWURADZE n’ebufuw nye ne nyinkuntwe bopun nyimpa no, na mpaa a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu no nyinara bodwir no do, na EWURADZE bɛpepa ne dzin efi asaase do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE beyi no efi Israel ebusuakuw nyinara mu esi hɔ ama mbusu, dɛ mbrɛ ahyɛmu a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra nwoma yi mu mpaa no tse nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ebusuasantsen a wɔbɛba no, hom mba a wɔbɔsoɛr edzi hom ekyir no, nye ɔnanaben a ofi ekyirekyir asaase do bɛba no, sɛ wohu asaase no do yardɔm, nye nyarbanyarba a EWURADZE dze ama wɔayar no a, wɔbɛse dɛ;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: n’asaase nyinara ayɛ sɔɔfee nye nkyen, nye nkyewee, wonndua do adze, ɔnnsow, nkyɛkyɛr mpo mmfir do, ɔtse dɛ Sodom nye Gomora, Adma nye Zeboim mbutuwii a EWURADZE nam n’ebufuw nye n’ebufuhyew mu butuwii no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mekyerɛ amanaman nyinara bɛse dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na EWURADZE ayɛ asaase yi dɛm yi? Ebufuw kɛse hyeehyew yi ase nye dɛn?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna nkorɔfo bɛse dɛ, Osiandɛ wɔpoow EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn ahyɛmu a oyii hɔn wɔ Egypt asaase do no ɔnye hɔn dzii no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na wɔkɔree kɔsoom enyame fofor, na wɔsɔɔr hɔn, enyame a wonnyim hɔn, na ɔammfa hɔn amma hɔn:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ asaase yi do, ma ɔdze mpaa a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu nyinara aba do;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na EWURADZE tutuu hɔn ase fii hɔn asaase do wɔ ebufuw, nye ebufuhyew, nye ahohyehye kɛse mu, na wɔatow hɔn egu asaase bi so do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ndzɛmba a osuma yɛ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn dze: na ndzɛmba a wɔada no edzi no dze ɔyɛ hɛn nye hɛn mba dze daa, ama yeedzi mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ ndzɛmba iyinom nyinara ba wo do, nhyira nye mpaa a, medze esi w’enyim yi, na ekaakaa no wɔ amanaman nyinara mu mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn apam wo akɔ no,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na sɛ ɔwo, nye wo mba san ba EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na edze w’akoma nyinara, na ɔnye wo kra nyinara tsie ne ndze na eyɛ dza merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: ɔno na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛdan wo ndɔmmumkɔ no, na oenya ayamuhyehye ama wo, na ɔasan aboa w’ano efi aman a ɔnoara EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn abɔ wo apetse mu no nyinara mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ wo nyimpa a wɔapam hɔn no bi wɔ ɔsor ano no ho mpo a, ofitsi hɔ na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɔboa w’ano, na hɔ na ɔbɛfa wo efi:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze wo bɛba asaase a w’egyanom nyaa no do, na aafa; na ɔbɛyɛ wo yie, na ɔama adɔr akyɛn w’egyanom.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma ɔwo nye w’asefo akoma, a ɔdwe, na edze w’akoma nye wo kra nyinara, aadɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, na eenya nkwa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze mpaa yi nyinara bogu w’atamfo, nye hɔn a wokyir wo a wohiahia wo ho no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔwo dze, ebɛsan ebetsie EWURADZE ndze, na edzi ne mbransɛm a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi nyinara do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma yie ebu wo do wɔ wo nsaano edwuma nyinara mu, wɔ wo honam mu aba mu, nye wo fiembowa aba mu, nye w’asaase do aba mu, wɔ wo yieyɛ ntsi: na EWURADZE n’enyi bɛsan agye wo ho wɔ wo yieyɛ ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ n’enyi gyee w’egyanom ho no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: sɛ ibetsie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ndze, dɛ ibedzi ne mbransɛm nye n’ahyɛdze a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra nwoma yi mu no do, dɛ edze w’akoma nyinara, na ɔnye wo kra nyinara bɛsan aba EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn a.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mbrasɛm yi a merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi, ɔnnyɛ dzendzen dodow mma wo, nkyii so onnyi ekyirekyir.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Onnyi sor, na aase dɛ, Woana na ɔbɔfow akɔ sor ama hɛn, na ɔakɛfa abrɛ hɛn, na ɔama yɛatse, na yɛayɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nkyii so onnyi po n’egya, na aase dɛ, Woana na obotwa po ama hɛn, na ɔakɛfa abrɛ hɛn, na ɔama yɛatse, ma yaayɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na asɛm no bɛn wo dodoodow, ɔwɔ w’anomu, na ɔwɔ w’akoma mu, ama aayɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hwɛ, ndɛ da yi medze nkwa nye papa, nye owu nye bɔn, esi w’enyim;
title: DEUTERONOMY
