text: wɔ dɛ merehyɛ wo ndɛ da yi dɛ dɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, nantsew n’akwan do, na dzi ne mbransɛm nye n’ahyɛdze nye ne ntsɛmbu do, na aatsena ase na aadɔr, na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ehyira wo wɔ asaase a erokɔ do akɛfa no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mbom sɛ w’akoma dan, na enntsie, na ema wɔtwe wo kɔ, na ekɔsɔr enyame fofor, na esom hɔn a;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: mepaa mu meka kyerɛ hom ndɛ da yi, dɛ ɔsɛɛ na hom bɛsɛɛ; na hom remma hom nda nnwar wɔ asaase mbrɛ irutwa Jordan akɔ do akɛfa no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mefrɛ ɔsor nye asaase dɛ wondzi hom dase ndɛ da yi, dɛ medze nkwa nye owu, nhyira nye mpaa esi w’enyim: dɛm ntsi fa nkwa, ma ɔwo, nye w’asefo nnya nkwa:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na dɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, tsie ne ndze, na takyer no ho: na ɔno nye wo nkwa, nye wo nda ne tsentsen: ama aatsena asaase a EWURADZE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ w’egyanom, Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɔn no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Moses kɔree kɛkaa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ Israel nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ndɛ yi, medzi mfe ɔha eduonu; emi a munntum nnkɔ, emi so a munntum mmba: na eso EWURADZE ase me dɛ, Irunntwa Jordan yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, ɔno na odzi w’enyim rukotwa; ɔno na ɔbɛsɛɛ amanaman yi efi w’enyim, na afa hɔn: na Josua na oridzi w’enyim ekotwa, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE aka no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE bɛyɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ Amorifo ahemfo, Sihon nye Ɔge a ɔsɛɛ hɔn, nye hɔn asaase no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE beyi hɔn ama wɔ hom enyim, na hom ayɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ mbransɛm a mahyɛ hom nyinara tse.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom nhyɛ dzen na hom nnya akokodur, mma hom nnsuro, mma hɔn ho nnyɛ hom hu so; na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn no, ɔno na ɔnye wo rokɔ, ɔremmpa wo, na ɔrommpow wo so.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Moses frɛɛ Josua, na ɔsee no wɔ Israel nyinara enyim dɛ, Hyɛ dzen na nya akokodur; na ɔwo na edze ɔman yi bɔkɔ asaase a EWURADZE aka ho ntam akyerɛ hɔn egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɔn no do; na ɔwo na ebɛma woenya edzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE, ɔno nye nyia oridzi w’enyim akɔ; obedzi w’ekyir, ɔremmpa wo, nkyii so ɔrommpow wo; mma nnsuro, nkyii so mma w’akoma nntu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Moses kyerɛɛw mbra yi, na ɔdze maa asɔfo Levi mbabanyin no a wɔsoa EWURADZE ahyɛmudaka no, nye Israel mpanyimfo nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Moses hyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Mfe esuon biara n’ewiei, akwangya afe n’aber a wɔahyɛ no mu, ntamadan afahyɛ no mu,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: aber a Israel nyinara rubopue wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn enyim wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛsan mu eyi no, kenkan mbra yi wɔ Israel nyinara enyim ma wɔntse.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Boaboa ɔman no ano, mbanyin nye mbaa nye mbofraba, nye wo hɔhoe a ɔwɔ wo nkuropon mu, ma wontsie, na wonsua, na wonsuro EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, na wɔndwen do ndzi mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara do;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na hɔn mba a wonnyim no ntsie, na wonsua dɛ wonsuro EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, aber tsentsen nyina a hom tse asaase no do mbrɛ hom rukotwa Jordan akɛfa no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Hwɛ, wo nda a ibowu abɛn: frɛ Josua, na wonkeyi homho nkyerɛ wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu, ma menhyɛ no mbra. Na Moses nye Josua kɔree, na wokeyii hɔnho kyerɛe wɔ ehyiadzibuw no mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE nam mununkum dum mu yii noho edzi wɔ Buw no mu: na mununkum dum no begyinaa Buw no n’abowano.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE see Moses dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔwo, iribetsiw wo nananom wɔ samanadze na ɔman yi bɔsoɛr, na woekedzi asaase no do enyame ekyir wɔ ndwamangor mu, wɔ mbrɛ wɔrokɔ akɔforafora hɔn mu no, na wɔbɔpow me na wɔato m’ahyɛmu a menye hɔn edzi no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔno na m’ebufuw bɛdzɛw wɔ hɔn do wɔ da no mu, na mapow hɔn, na medze m’enyim esuma hɔn, na wɔamen hɔn, na mbusu nye ɔfona pii bɛba hɔn do; ama wɔaaka wɔ da no mu dɛ, Ana nnyɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn a onnyi hɛn mu ntsi na mbusu yi aba hɛn do bi a?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na suma ara na medze m’enyim mubosuma wɔ da no mu wɔ mbusu a wɔabɔ no nyinara ntsi, wɔ dɛ wɔadan akɔ enyame fofor nkyɛn ntsi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm ntsi afei hom nkyerɛw ndwom yi mma hom ho, na fa kyerɛkyerɛ Israelmba: fa hyɛ hɔn anomu, ma ndwom yi ndzi me dase ntsia Israelmba.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na sɛ minya dze hɔn du asaase a mekaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom no a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no do a wobedzidzi amee, na wɔayɛ abran. Ɔno nna afei wɔbɛdan akɔ enyame fofor nkyɛn, na wɔakɔsom hɔn, na woebu me enyimtsia, na wɔato m’ahyɛmu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, aber a mbusu nye ɔfona pii aba hɔn do no, ndwom yi bɛyɛ dɛ ɔdasefo edzi dase wɔ hɔn enyim; osiandɛ ɔnnkɛpa hɔn asefo anomu: na minyim hɔn adwendwen a wɔrodwendwen no seseiara mpo, ansaana medze hɔn bodu asaase a mekaa ho ntam no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna Moses kyerɛɛw ndwom yi da no ara, na ɔdze kyerɛkyerɛɛ Israelmba.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ Nun ne babanyin Josua mbra, na ɔsee dɛ, Hyɛ dzen na nya akokodur: na ɔwo na edze Israelmba bɔkɔ asaase a mekaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn no do; na mibedzi w’ekyir.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Moses wiee mbra yi mu nsɛm kyerɛw wɔ nwoma mu no,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Moses hyɛɛ Levifo a wɔsoa EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no, dɛ,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom mfa mbra nwoma yi, na hom mfa nto EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn n’ahyɛmudaka no ho, ma ɔnko hɔ nyɛ dase ntsia hom.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na minyim hom etuatsew, nye hom asoɔdzen: hwɛ, meda ho ara menye hom tse ase ndɛ da yi mpo, na hom ayɛ etuatsewfo wɔ EWURADZE do yi; na afei mo wu ekyir ɛ?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hom mboaboa hom ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu mpanyimfo nyinara, nye hom ahwɛdofo ano mbra me nkyɛn, ma menka nsɛm yi wɔ hɔn aso mu, na memfrɛ ɔsor nye asaase ma wondzi hɔn dase.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na minyim dɛ mo wu ekyir no ɔsɛɛ na hom bɛsɛɛ homho, na hom adan efi ɔkwan a mahyɛ hom no do; na mbusu bɛba hom do nda a odzi ekyir no mu; osiandɛ hom bɛyɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dze nam hom nsaano edwuma do eyi no ebufuw.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Moses kaa ndwom yi mu nsɛm wɔ Israel bagua no nyinara asomu dze kodur dɛ owiei.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔsor, hom nyɛ aso, na merebɛkasa; Na wɔmma asaase ntsie m’anomu nsɛm:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Me nkyerɛkyerɛ bɔsosɔ dɛ nyankom, Me kasaa bogugu dɛ ɔbɔsu; Dɛ nkyɛkyɛr do nsumpetsema, Nye haban do nsutɔree:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mobɔbɔ EWURADZE dzin akyerɛ: Hom mfa kɛseyɛ mma hɛn Nyankopɔn,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔbotan no, n’edwuma dzi mu; Na n’akwan nyinara yɛ atsɛmbu: Nyankopɔn nokwardzifo a, na onnyi emumuyɛ, Ɔyɛ pɛrpɛr na ɔtsen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Woedzi no asɛmbɔn, wɔnnyɛ ne mba, hɔn dzɛmdzi a; Ebusuasantsen kɔntɔnkye a wɔakyea a.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ana EWURADZE na hom nye no dzi no dɛm yi, Ɔman nkwasea a wɔnnyɛ enyansafo? Ana nnyɛ ɔno nye w’egya a ɔawo wo bi a? Ɔno na ɔayɛ wo na oetsintsim wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Kaa tsetsentserdee nda no, Dwen ebusuasantsen pii no hɔn mfe ho: Bisa w’egya, na ɔnkyerɛ wo; Wo mpanyimfo, na wɔnka nkyerɛ wo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Aber a Ɔsorsornyi no memaa amanaman hɔn egyapadze no, Aber a ɔpaapaa nyimpa mba mu no, Osisii aman hɔn ahe Dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba hɔn dodow tse.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE ne kyɛfa nye ne man; Jakob nye n’egyapadze kyɛfa.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ohun no wɔ sar asaase do, Na kwaa tuntum sar predede do nkekabowa mu; Otwaa no ho hyiae, ɔhwɛɛ no do yie, Ɔkoraa no do dɛ n’enyiwa kyesua:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛ mbrɛ ɔkɔr huenyan ne birebuw, Na otu bɔ ne ba do faafaa no, Ɔtserɛɛw ne ntsaban mu faa hɔn no, Ɔsoaa hɔn wɔ ne ntɛkyerɛ do:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE nkotoo na ogyaa no Na onyame fofor bi annka no ho,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔmaa ɔfaa asaase mbea sorɔnsorɔm do tutui kɔree, Na odzii haban mu ndɔbaa; Na ɔmaa ohwieew ewo fii ɔbotan mu, Nye ngo fii ɔtwerɛbo botan mu;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Anantwi numfonsungo, nye nguan numfonsu, Nye nguambaa seradze, Nye Basan nnyɛmbowa mu nguannyin, nye mpɔnkye, Nye ewifua ntan mu seradze; Na enoom esikyireamba mu bɔgya wenyin.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Jesurun yɛɛ ɔbran, na ɔtoow ntsia: Ayɛ bran, ayɛ kɛse, wo mu ayɛ dur: Nna ɔpoow Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛɛ no no, Na obuu no nkwagye botan no tootooba.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Wɔdze enyame nanaben yii no nyinkun, Wɔdze ekyiwadze yii no ebufuw.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Wɔbɔɔ afɔr maa abosom a wɔnnyɛ Nyame, Dze maa enyame a wonnyim hɔn, Dze maa enyame fofor a wɔbaa nkyinkyirii, Dza hom egyanom ennsuro hɔn no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔbotan a ɔwoo wo no anndwen no ho, Na wo werɛ efir Nyame a ɔkyeem wo no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE hunii, na okyiir hɔn, Wɔ ne mbabanyin nye ne mbabaa ho ehi ntsi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Mibeyi m’enyim esuma hɔn, Mobɔhwɛ mbrɛ hɔn ewiei bɛyɛ: Na wɔyɛ ebusuasantsen kɔntɔnkye, Mba a hɔn mu nnyi gyedzi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Wɔdze dza ɔnnyɛ Onyame eyi me nyinkun: Wɔdze hɔn egyangyandze eyi me ebufuw: Na medze hɔn a wɔnnyɛ ɔman biara no mibeyi hɔn nyinkun; Medze ɔman nkwasea bi mibeyi hɔn ebufuw.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ogya adzɛw wɔ m’ebufuw mu, Na ɔrehyew ekodu samanadze ase, Na ɔremen asaase nye no ndɔbaa, Na ɔato mbepɔw mfapem mu ogya.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mobɔboa mbusu ano megu hɔn do; Mobɔhwer m’egyen menaba wɔ hɔn do:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔkɔm bɔfɔn hɔn, na ahohyehye yaayaw Nye ɔsɛɛ wenwen bɛmen hɔn; Na mobɔsoma mbowa se ma wɔaaba hɔn do, Nye huntuma mu nweaweambowa bɔr.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Abɔntsen do na nkrantsee bohwim, Adankyir so nketsenketse a; Ɔbɛsɛɛ aberantsɛ nye ɔbaabun nyina, Enumfoanoba nye nyimpa a oefuw gon nyina.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mesee dɛ nkyɛ mobɔbɔ hɔn apetse ekyirekyir, Nkyɛ mebɛma hɔn nkaa tun do etwa efi nyimpa mu:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ nnyɛ ɔtamfo ehiyi na musuroi a, Bɛyɛ na hɔn ayɛfo anntse m’akwan ase, Bɛyɛ na wɔase dɛ, Hɛn nsa na akrɔn, Na nnyɛ EWURADZE na ɔayɛ iyi nyinara.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na wɔyɛ aman a egyinatu abɔ hɔn, Na ntseasee bi nnyi hɔn mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ao kɛtseankyɛ woeehu nyansa, na wɔaatse iyi ase, Na nkyɛ wɔaadwen hɔn ewiei ekyir no ho!
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔbaako bɛyɛ dɛn etsiw apem, Na beenu aka mpemdu egu, Gyedɛ hɔn Ɔbotan atɔn hɔn ana, Na EWURADZE eyi hɔn ama ana?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hɔn ɔbotan nntse dɛ hɛn Ɔbotan, Na hɛn atamfo ankasa mpo nye atsɛmbuafo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na hɔn wenyindua fi Sodom wenyindua mu, Na ofi Gomora haban mu: Hɔn esikyireamba yɛ bɔr esikyireamba, Hɔn esiaw yɛ wenwen:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hɔn nsa yɛ sasabɔnsam bɔr, Nye nhurutsia owubɔr dzendzen.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ana wɔnnkora iyi do wɔ me nkyɛn, Wɔnnsɔw ano wɔ m’akoradze mu bi a?
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Awerdzi yɛ medze, akatua so, Aber a hɔn anan bɛpatser: Na hɔn mbusu da abɛn, Na ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ dɛ ɔba hɔn do no bɛba ntsɛntsɛm.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE bobu ne man atsɛn, Na oenu noho wɔ no nkowaa ntsi; Aber a obohu dɛ hɔn ahoɔdzen asa, Na ɔdehye anaa akowaa biara nnyi hɔ bio,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔbɛse dɛ, Henfa na hɔn enyame no wɔ, Ɔbotan a wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛɛ mu no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Hɔn a wodzi hɔn okum afɔr seradze, Na wɔnom hɔn ɔnom afɔr nsa no a? Ma wɔnsoɛr mbɔboa hom, Ma wɔnyɛ hom ntwitwagye.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Afei hom nhu dɛ emi, mara nye no, Na onyame bi nnka mo ho: Emi na muku, na mema nkwa; Mipira, na mesa yarba: Na obi nnyi hɔ a obotum agye efi me nsamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mema me nsa do wɔ ɔsor, Na mese dɛ, Dɛ metse ase daa yi,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Sɛ mesew me nkrantsee nyinamnyinam no, Na me nsa suo atsɛmbu mu a; Mibedzi hɔn a wɔnye me dzi esi do wer, Na metua hɔn a wɔtan me kaw.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Mebɛma bɔgya abow m’egyen menaba, Na me nkrantsee edzi nam; Atɔfo nye ndɔmmumfo bɔgyaa, Ofi ɔtamfo Edzikamfo tsir do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Amanaman, hom nye ne man ndzi dɛw: Na obedzi no nkowaa bɔgyaa ho wer, Na ɔdze awerdzi etua n’ayɛfo kaw, Na ɔapata ama n’asaase ama ne man.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Moses baa bɛkaa ndwom yi mu nsɛm nyinara wɔ ɔman no asomu, ɔno, nye Nun ne babanyin Josua.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Moses wiee nsɛm yi nyinara ka kyerɛɛ Israel nyinara:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa hom akoma nsi nsɛm a miridzi hom ho dase ndɛ da yi nyinara do; ɔno na hom mfa nhyɛ hom mba, dɛ wɔndwen do ndzi mbra yi mu nsɛm nyinara do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na mma ɔnnyɛ asɛnhun mma hom; osiandɛ ɔyɛ hom nkwa, na asɛm yi do na hom nam bɛma hom nda awar wɔ asaase a hom rukotwa Jordan akɛfa no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Moses da no ara dɛ,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Kɔfow bepɔw Abarim yi, kɔ bepɔw Nebo a ɔwɔ Moab asaase do, wɔ Jeriko tsentsendo no; na hwɛ Keenan asaase a medze merema Israelmba dɛ enyadze no:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: na wu wɔ bepɔw no a erofow akɔ do no do, na kɛka wo nananom ho wɔ samanadze; dɛ mbrɛ wo nua Aaron wui wɔ bepɔw Horeb do, na ɔkɛkaa ne nananom ho no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: osiandɛ hom foom me wɔ Israelmba mu wɔ Meriba nsu a ɔwɔ Kades, wɔ Zin sar do no ho; osiandɛ hom annyɛ me krɔnkrɔn wɔ Israelmba mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ibohu asaase no wɔ w’enyim; na mbom eronnkɔ asaase a medze rema Israelmba no do hɔ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na iyi nye nhyira a Onyame nyimpa Moses dze hyiraa Israelmba ansaana oruwu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE fi Sinai bae, Na ɔsoɛree fi Seir maa hɔn; Ɔhyerɛɛn fi bepɔw Paran do, Na ofi akrɔnkrɔmfo mpedu mpedu mu bae: Na n’enyimfa wɔ mbra a ɔyɛ ogya ma hɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nyew, ɔdɔ aman; N’ahotseweefo nyinara wɔ wo nsamu: Na wɔtsenatsenaa famu wɔ w’anan ho; Obiara bɛgye wo nsɛm ato mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Moses hyɛɛ hɛn mbra, Jakob bagua egyapadze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen wɔ Jesurun, Aber a ɔman no mu etsitsir hyiae, Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara bɔ mu no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ma Reuben nnya nkwa, na mma onnwu; Na eso mma n’ase nnhyew.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na iyi nye Juda nhyira: na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, tsie Juda ne ndze, Na fa no kɔ fie no nkorɔfo nkyɛn: Ma ne nsa nso no so, Na yɛ ɔboafo fa tsia n’ayɛfo.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Levi ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Wo Tummim nye wo Urim wɔ wo nyamesuronyi no hɔ, Nyia esɔɔ no hwɛe wɔ Massa no, Nye no hamee wɔ Meriba nsu ho no;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nyia ɔsee wɔ n’egya, nye ne na ho dɛ, Munnhun hɔn; Nkyii so ɔammpen no nuanom do no, Na woennhu nankasa ne mba so no: Na wɔadwen w’asɛm do: Na woedzi w’ahyɛmu do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Wɔdze w’atsɛmbu bɛkyerɛ Jakob, Na wo mbra akyerɛ Israel: Wɔdze eduhuam bɔto w’enyim, Na ɔhyew afɔr mu ato w’afɔrmbukyia do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE, hyira n’ahoɔdzen, Na ma ne nsaano edwuma nsɔ w’enyi: Bobɔ hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia no no hɔn ndwonku, Na hɔn a wɔtan no, amma wɔaannsoɛr bio.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Benjamin ho dze ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE no dɔfo bɛtsena ne nkyɛn dwudwoodwo; Ɔkata no do adzekyee tsentsen nyinara, Na ɔtse n’abatsir ntamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Josef ho dze, ɔsee dɛ EWURADZE nhyira n’asaase; Ɔmma ɔsor ndzepa, ɔbɔsu, Nye bun a ɔda daadzetsirmu ne dze,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nye ewia no nduadzewa mu ndzepa, Nye dza abosoom ma ofifir mu ndzepa, Nye tsetse mbepɔw do adze tsitsir,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nye daa daa nkoko do ndzepa,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nye asaase nye ne mayɛ mu ndzepa, Nye nyia ɔtsenaa kwaa mu n’enyisɔ: Ma nhyira no ɔmbra Josef n’etsifi, Nye no nuanom mu nyia woeyi no esi nkyɛn no n’etsifi pampamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ne nantwisaa abakan, tumdzi dzi wɔ no; Na n’ambɛn yɛ eko ambɛn: Ɔno na ɔdze bosunsun aman nyinara, mekyerɛ asaase n’ano n’ano: Na hɔn nye Efraim mpedu mpedu no, Na hɔn nye Manaasɛ mpempem no,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Zebulun, ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Zebulun, ma w’enyi ngye wɔ w’edzifir mu; Na, Isakar, wɔ w’asesee mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Wɔbɛfrɛ aman akɔ bepɔw do; Hɔ na wɔbɔbɔ tsenenee okum afɔr: Na woehwiew epo no mbordo no, Nye anhwea mu akoradze a ohuntsa no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Gad ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Nhyira aka nyia ɔtserɛw Gad mu: Ɔtsena hɔ dɛ ogyataber, Ɔtsetsew abasa, nyew, etsifi pampamu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na osiesiee dza odzi kan no maa noho, Na hɔ na wɔakora mbrahyɛfo ne kyɛfa; Na ɔnye ɔman no mu etsitsir bae, Na ɔyɛɛ EWURADZE ne tseneneedze, Nye ne ntsɛmbu wɔ Israel nkyɛn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Dan ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Dan yɛ ogyata ne ba a Ohuruw fi Basan.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Naftali ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Naftali a enyisɔ amee no, EWURADZE ne nhyira ahyɛ no ma: Fa anee nye pomu afamu asaase no fa,
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Aser ho dze ɔsee dɛ, Wɔmfa mba nhyira Aser; Wɔmma ɔnyɛ nyia ɔsɔ enyi mma no nuanom, Na wɔmma ɔmfa n’anan mbɔ ngo mu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: W’adaban nyɛ dadze nye boran; Na dɛ mbrɛ wo nda tse no, dɛmara so na w’ahoɔdzen nyɛ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Jesurun, obi nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ Onyame a Otutu nam sor dzi boa wo, Na n’akɛseyɛ wɔ wimu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Ɔdomankoma Nyankopɔn nye wo tsenabew: Na n’ase na daa daa abasa wɔ: Na ɔpaam ɔtamfo no wɔ w’enyim, Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛɛ hɔn.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Israel retsena dwudwoodwo, Jakob nsubura no nkotoo, Wɔ eburow nye nsa asaase do; Nyew, no sor so sosɔw ɔbɔsu.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Osiarfo nye wo, Israel: Woana na ɔnye wo sɛ, ɔman a EWURADZE agye no nkwa, Wo mboa akokyɛm, Na ɔno nye wo kɛseyɛ nkrantsee! Na w’atamfo bɛbrɛ hɔnho adze ama wo; Na ibetsiatsia hɔn mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Moses fii Moab tɛtɛr mu fowee kɔr bepɔw Nebo do, wɔ Pisga etsifi a ɔwɔ Jeriko tsentsendo. Na EWURADZE kyerɛɛ no Gilead asaase nyinara, ɔdze kodu Dan:
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nye Naftali nyinara, nye Efraim nye Manaasɛ asaase, nye Juda asaase nyinara, ɔdze kodu ekyirekyir epo no ho;
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: nye Epomu, nye Tɛtɛrmu, nkyiresua kurow Jeriko ɔbɔn no, ɔdze kodu Zoar.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Iyi nye asaase a mekaa ho ntam mekyerɛɛ Abraham, Isaak, nye Jakob dɛ, W’asefo na medze mebɛma hɔn no: mama wo kwan dɛ fa w’enyiwa hwɛ, na hɔ dze eronnkɔ.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Nna EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses wuu hɔ wɔ Moab asaase do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm tse.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na osiee no wɔ ɔbɔn no mu wɔ Moab asaase do wɔ Bɛt-peor tsentsendo na n’adakamona dze nyimpa biara nnyim dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na aber a Moses wui no na oedzi mfe ɔha eduonu: n’enyiwa annyɛ kusukusu, na n’ahoɔdzen so do ennhuan.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na Israelmba sui maa Moses wɔ Moab tɛtɛr mu adaduasa: nna Moab n’eyiyɛ mu osu nda no bɔɔ adze.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na nyansa sunsum hyɛɛ Nun ne babanyin Josua ma: na Israelmba tsiee no, na wɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Na ofitsi aber no nkɔnhyɛnyi biara nnsoɛree wɔ Israel mu bio a ɔtse dɛ Moses a EWURADZE nye no nyaa nkitahodzi a no mu dɔ yie
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Dɛm Moses yi ara so na EWURADZE somaa no wɔ nsa a ɔyɛ dzen do kɔr Egypt ma ɔkɛyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze pii wɔ Farao nye no nkowaa nye n’asaase nyinara do no.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: Afei so, ɔnam Moses do na ndzɛmba akɛse a ɔyɛ hu na tum wɔ mu daa edzi wɔ Israel nyinara enyim.
title: DEUTERONOMY

text: EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses wui n’ekyir no, EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ Nun ne babanyin Josua a nna ɔyɛ Moses no somfo no dɛ,
title: JOSHUA

text: M’akowaa Moses ewu; dɛm ntsi afei soɛr, twa Jordan yi, ɔwo, nye ɔman yi nyinara, kɔ asaase a medze rema hom, mekyerɛ Israelmba no do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Beebiara a hom anamɔn betsia no, medze ama hom, dɛ mbrɛ mekaa kyerɛɛ Moses no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Ofi sar no do, nye Lebanon yi ho araa dze kodu esutsen kɛse Eufrates no ho, Hitifo asaase nyinara, na ɔdze kodu po kɛse no ho wɔ witɔree afamu no, na ɔnyɛ hom he.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nyimpa biara runntum nngyina w’enyim wɔ wo nkwa nda nyinara mu: na dɛ mbrɛ midzii Moses n’ekyir no, dɛmara so na mibedzi w’ekyir: meremmpa wo, na morommpow wo so.
title: JOSHUA

text: Hyɛ dzen na nya akokodur: na ɔwo na ebɛma ɔman yi ekenya asaase a mekaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom dɛ medze mebɛma hɔn no edzi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dzen ara na hyɛ na nya akokodur papaapa, na dwen do dzi mbra a m’akowaa Moses hyɛɛ wo no nyinara do: mma mmfi ho mmfa enyimfa anaa abankum, ama eesi wo yie wɔ beebiara a ebɔkɔ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Mma mbra nwoma yi mmpa w’anomu, na mbom dwen ho adzekyee nye adzesaa, ama aadwen do ayɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ mu no nyinara tse no: na ɔno na ebɛma wo kwan ayɛ dwudwoodwo, na ɔno na ibenya no yie.
title: JOSHUA

text: Ana mennhyɛɛ wo bi a? Hyɛ dzen na nya akokodur; mma mmbɔ hu, nkyii so mma w’abaw mu nntu: na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dzi w’ekyir wɔ beebiara a ebɔkɔ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua hyɛɛ ɔman no hɔn ahwɛdofo no, dɛ,
title: JOSHUA

text: Hom ndɔ nseraban no mu na hom nhyɛ ɔman no dɛ, Hom nsiesie edzidzidze mma homho, na aka ndaansa hom botwa Jordan yi akɔ akɛfa asaase a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze rema hom dɛ wɔnkɛfa no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua kasaa kyerɛɛ Reubenfo, nye Gadfo, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw ɔfa no dɛ,
title: JOSHUA

text: Hom nkaa asɛm a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses hyɛɛ hom no, dɛ, EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn rema hom ahomgye, na ɔdze asaase yi ama hom no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Hom yernom, hom mbofraba, nye hom fiembowa, ntsena asaase a Moses dze maa hom wɔ Jordan egya yi do; na homara dze, hom mmia ndzi hom nuanom enyim ntwa, hom mu mbarimba akatakyi nyinara, na hom nkɔboa hɔn;
title: JOSHUA

text: ma onkodu dɛ EWURADZE bɛma hom nuanom ahomgye, dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze ama hom yi, na hɔn so woeenya asaase a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze rema hom no afa: na n’ekyir no hom asan abɛfa hom enyadze asaase a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze maa hom wɔ Jordan egya ɔdze kɔ wipuei afamu no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wobuaa Josua, dɛ, Dza edze ahyɛ hɛn nyinara yɛbɛyɛ, na beebiara a ebɔsoma hɛn no, yɛbɔkɔ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛ mbrɛ yetsiee Moses wɔ adze nyinara mu no, dɛmara so na yebetsie wo: w’ekyir ara na EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ndzi, dɛ mbrɛ odzii Moses ekyir no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nyimpa biara a ɔbɛtsew etua wɔ wo mbrasɛm do, na onnketsie wo nsɛm wɔ dza edze hyɛ no nyinara mu no, ɔtse dɛ woana ara a wonku no: dzen ara na hyɛ na nya akokodur.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Nun ne babanyin Josua somaa mbanyin beenu nsumaa mu fi Sittim dɛ aserafo dɛ wɔnkɔ nkɔhwɛ asaase no, nye Jeriko. Na wɔkɔree, na wɔkɔr ɔbaa huhunyi bi a ne dzin dze Rahab ne fie, na wɔkɔsoɛɛ hɔ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na binom kaa kyerɛɛ Jerikohen no, dɛ, Hwɛ, mbanyin bi fi Israelmba mu baa ha anadwe yi dɛ wɔrebɛsera asaase yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Jerikohen no somae ma wɔkɔr Rahab hɔ, dɛ, Fa mbanyin no a wɔaba abɛhɛn wo fie no pue: na wɔaba rebɛsera asaase no nyinara.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa no faa mbanyin beenu no, na ɔdze hɔn sumae; na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔyɛ nokwar, mbanyin no baa me nkyɛn, na mbom, minnyim mbrɛ wofi:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔbaa dɛ aber a wɔdze tow kuropon no mu no durii no, nna mbanyin no fii me nkyɛn: na mbrɛ wɔkɔree no dze, minnyim: hom ntsiw hɔn ntsɛm; na hom bɔto hɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna ɔnoara dze hɔn akɔ ɔdan etsifi na ɔdze hɔn ekosuma asaaba a wɔmmpaae bi a ɔaboaboa no yie wɔ ɔdan etsifi no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔhen no n’asomafo no faa Jordan kwan do tsiiw hɔn araa dze kodur esutwaree: na hɔn a wotsiiw hɔn no kɔree no ara, na wɔtoow kuropon no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wonnyae nnkɛdae no, Rahab fowee kɔr hɔn nkyɛn wɔ dan no etsifi hɔ:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔsee mbanyin no dɛ, Minyim dɛ EWURADZE dze asaase yi ama hom, na hom ho hu atɔ hɛn do, na asaase yi do atsefo nyinara hɔn ho mbowa eguan wɔ hom ntsi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na yɛatse mbrɛ EWURADZE sii maa Mbɛw Po (Mbɛw Po) no no nsu wewee wɔ hom enyim, aber a hom fi Egypt firii no; na dza hom dze yɛɛ Amorifo ahemfo beenu, Sihon nye Ɔge a wɔwɔ Jordan egya no, na mbrɛ hom sii sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa no nyinara.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na yɛtsee no ara na hɛn akoma tui, nkyii so ahom biara annka nyimpa biara mu bio, osian hom ntsi: na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn no, ɔno nye Nyankopɔn wɔ sor, nye asaase do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, mepa hom kyɛw, hom mfa EWURADZE ndzi nsew nkyerɛ me dɛ, ɔnam dɛ mayɛ hom yie ntsi, hom so bɛyɛ m’egya fie yie, hom mma me nokwar asɛnkyerɛdze:
title: JOSHUA

text: dɛ hom bɛgye m’egya, nye me na, nye mo nuanom mbanyin nye mbaa, na adze a wɔwɔ nyinara nkwa, na woeyi hɛn efi owu mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na mbanyin no see no dɛ, Hɛn nkwa nhyɛ homdze ananmu, sɛ hom annka hɛn nsɛm yi annkyerɛ a; ɔno ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ EWURADZE dze asaase yi ma hɛn a, yɛnye wo bedzi no yie nye nokwar mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna ɔdze ntampee duaa tokura mu gogoow hɔn sisii famu: osiandɛ ne dan no si kurow no ho fasu no do, na fasu no do na ɔtse.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ bepɔw no do, amma etsiwfo no aannto hom; na hom nsuma homho wɔ hɔ, ndaansa, nkodu dɛ etsiwfo no bɛsan: na n’ekyir no hom bɔkɔ hom kwan a, hom aakɔ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na mbanyin no see no dɛ, Yennkedzi so wɔ wo ntam a ama yɛaka yi ho.
title: JOSHUA

text: Hwɛ, sɛ yɛreba asaase yi do a, fa serdaa ahoma yi kyekyer tokura a edze hɛn duaa mu sisii famu no mu: na boa w’egya, nye wo na, nye wo nuanom, nye w’egya ne fifo nyinara ano wɔ wo nkyɛn wɔ fie no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, obiara a obefi wo fi mbobow ano akɔ abɔntsen do no, no bɔgyaa bogu ɔnoara n’etsifi, na yennkedzi so: na obiara a ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn wɔ fie no, sɛ obi dze ne nsa ka no a, no bɔgyaa ngu hɛn etsifi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na sɛ eka hɛn asɛm yi kyerɛ a, ɔnodze, yennkedzi so wɔ wo ntam a ama yɛaka yi ho.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ hom nsɛm yi tse no ara, wɔmma ɔnyɛ hɔ. Na ogyaa hɔn kwan, na wosii mu kɔree: na ɔdze serdaa ahoma no kyekyeer tokura no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔkɔree kodur bepɔw no do, na wɔtsenaa hɔ ndaansa, kodur dɛ etsiwfo no sanee: na etsiwfo no hwehwɛɛ hɔn wɔ kwan no mu nyina, na woennhu hɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna mbanyin beenu no sanee, na wofii bepɔw no do sianee, na wotwae baa Josua, Nun ne babanyin no, ne nkyɛn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔsee Josua dɛ, Ampaara, EWURADZE dze asaase no nyinara ahyɛ hɛn nsa; na nkyii so asaase no do atsefo no nyinara hɔn akoma etu kɛsenara wɔ hɛn enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua soɛɛr ahanamakye, na wotui fii Sittim, ɔno na Israelmba nyinara; na wɔbaa Jordan do, na wɔkyeer nseraban wɔ hɔ ansaana worutwa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ odzii ndaansa no, ahwɛdofo no tui dɔɔ nseraban no mu;
title: JOSHUA

text: na wɔhyɛɛ ɔman no, dɛ, Sɛ hom hu EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn n’ahyɛmudaka no, na Levifo asɔfo a wɔso no a, ɔno hom ntu mfi hom ananmu na hom ndzi ekyir nkɔ;
title: JOSHUA

text: ama hom eehu kwan kor a ɔwɔ dɛ hom fa do; osiandɛ hom mmfaa kwan yi do da gyedɛ ndɛ. Mbom, hom mma ɔkwan a wosusu a ɔbɛyɛ basafa apem nda hom nye ahyɛmudaka no ntamu: na mma hom mmbɛn no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see ɔman no dɛ, Hom ntsew homho: na ɔkyena EWURADZE bɛyɛ hom mu anwanwadze.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua kaa kyerɛɛ asɔfo no, dɛ, Hom mma ahyɛmudaka no do, na hom ntwa mu nkedzi ɔman no enyim. Na wɔmaa ahyɛmudaka no do, na wokedzii ɔman no enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Ndɛ da yi na mebɛhyɛ ase mama wo do wɔ Israel nyinara enyi do, na woeehu dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ midzii Moses ekyir no, dɛmara so na mibedzi w’ekyir.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hyɛ asɔfo a wɔso ahyɛmudaka no, dɛ, Sɛ hom du Jordan nsu no no nkɔkɔnoa a, hom ngyina dzinn wɔ Jordan no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see Israelmba no dɛ, Hom mbra ha mbetsie EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne nsɛm.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see dɛ, Ɔnam iyi do na hom dze bohu dɛ tseasefo Nyankopɔn no wɔ hom mu, na dɛ ɔpam ara na ɔbɛpam Keenanfo, Hitifo, Hivifo, Perizfo, Girgasfo, Amorifo, nye Jebusfo no nyinara efi hom enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Hwɛ, asaase nyinara Wura ahyɛmudaka no rutwa mu edzi hom enyim akɔ Jordan mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi afei hom nyiyi Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu mbanyin duebien, ebusuakuw biara mu nyimpa baako.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, aber a asɔfo a wɔso EWURADZE, asaase nyinara Wura no, n’adakaa no, hɔn anamɔn besi Jordan no nsu mu no, Jordan no nsu no botwa, mekyerɛ nsu a ɔpem fi etsifi ba no a; na wɔabɔ kuw kor egyina hɔ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔman no tui fii hɔn asesee mu a nna asɔfo no a wɔso ahyɛmudaka no dzi hɔn enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Jordan yir kata no nsukɔn nyinara do buber nyinara naaso, aber a asɔfo a wɔso adaka no dur Jordan do, na hɔn anan sii nsu no nkɔkɔnoa no ara pɛr,
title: JOSHUA

text: nna nsu a ɔpem fi etsifi ba no gyinae, na ɔbɔɔ kuw kor, wɔ ekyirkyiikyir, wɔ Adam, kurow no a ɔwɔ Zaretan ne nkyɛn no noho: na dza ɔpem kɔ Araba po a ɔnoara nye Nkyen Epo no mu no twaa koraa: na ɔman no twae faa Jeriko tsentsendo.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na asɔfo a wɔso EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no gyinaa daadze kɛsɛɛ do pintsinn wɔ Jordan ne finimfin, na Israel nyinara nam daadze kɛsɛɛ do twae araa dze kodur dɛ ɔman no nyinara wiee Jordan twa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔman no nyinara wiee Jordan twa no, EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Josua dɛ,
title: JOSHUA

text: Hom nyiyi ɔman no mu mbanyin duebien, ebusuakuw biara mu nyimpa baako,
title: JOSHUA

text: na hom nhyɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa abo duebien wɔ Jordan mu wɔ mbrɛ asɔfo no hɔn anan gyinaa pintsinn no, na hom nsoa nkɔ, na wɔmfa nkogu asoɛe, mbrɛ hom bɔsoɛ anadwe yi no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua frɛɛ mbanyin duebien no a oesiesie hɔn wɔ Israelmba no mu no, ebusuakuw biara mu nyimpa baako:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ntwa mu nkedzi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no enyim nkɔ Jordan ne finimfin, na hom mu nyimpa baako biara mfa ɔbo kor nto no kɔn ho, dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no dodow tse:
title: JOSHUA

text: ama iyi aayɛ hom mu asɛnkyerɛdze, na sɛ ndaamba bi hom mba bisa hom dɛ, Abo yi hom kyerɛ ase dɛn a,
title: JOSHUA

text: ɔno hom nse hɔn dɛ, Osiandɛ Jordan nsu no twae wɔ EWURADZE ahyɛmudaka no enyim; aber a ahyɛmudaka no twaa Jordan no, hwɛ, Jordan no nsu no, otwaa koraa: na abo yi na ɔyɛ nkaadze ma Israelmba daa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Josua hyɛe no, na wɔfaa abo duebien wɔ Jordan mu, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Josua no, dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no dodow tse; na wɔsoae dze kɔr beebi mbrɛ wɔkɔsoɛe no, na wɔdze guu hɔ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua so dze abo duebien sisii Jordan finimfin, wɔ beebi mbrɛ asɔfo a wɔso ahyɛmudaka no dze hɔn anan sisii no: na ɔwɔ hɔ dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na asɔfo a wɔso adaka no gyinaa Jordan mu araa ma okodur dɛ wowiee adze biara a EWURADZE hyɛɛ Josua dɛ ɔnka nkyerɛ ɔman no yɛ, dɛ mbrɛ Moses dze hyɛɛ Josua no nyinara: na ɔman no yɛɛ ntsɛm twae.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔman no nyinara wiee twa no, na EWURADZE n’adakaa no so twae, na asɔfo no kedzii ɔman no enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Reubenmba, Gadmba, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw ɔfa no, miae twae kedzii Israelmba no enyim, dɛ mbrɛ Moses kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no:
title: JOSHUA

text: mbarimba bɛyɛ mpemeduanan a woemia prɛko dɛ wɔrokɔ sa twae kedzii EWURADZE enyim kɔr akono, wɔ Jeriko tɛtɛr mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Da no ara na EWURADZE maa Josua do wɔ Israel nyinara enyi do; na wosuroo no, dɛ mbrɛ wosuroo Moses no, wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Josua, dɛ,
title: JOSHUA

text: Hyɛ asɔfo a wɔso dasedaka no, ma womfi Jordan mu mbra.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi Josua hyɛɛ asɔfo no, dɛ, Hom mfi Jordan mu mbra.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, asɔfo a wɔso EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no fi Jordan mu fowee, na asɔfo no hɔn anamɔn besii daadze kɛsɛɛ do ara, na Jordan no nsu no sanee kɔr n’anamu, na ɔkɛkataa no nsukɔn nyinara do, dɛ mbrɛ nkan no nna ɔtse no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔman no fii Jordan mu fowee wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu da a otsia du no mu, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Gilgal, wɔ Jeriko no boka afamu ɔhe do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na abo duebien no a woyiyii no wɔ Jordan mu no, Josua dze hyɛɛ siw wɔ Gilgal.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba, dɛ, Sɛ ndaamba bi hom mba bisa hɔn egyanom dɛ, Abo yi ase nye dɛn a,
title: JOSHUA

text: ɔnodze, hom mma hom mba nhu dɛ, Asaase kɛsɛɛ do na Israel nam twaa Jordan yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn weew Jordan mu nsu no wɔ hom enyim, na hom twae ana, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn yɛɛ Mbɛw Po (Mbɛw Po) no a ɔwewee no wɔ hɛn enyim, ma yɛtwae ana no:
title: JOSHUA

text: ama asaase do aman nyinara eehu dɛ EWURADZE n’abasa mu yɛ dzen; ama hom eesuro EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn daa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Amorifo ahemfo a wɔwɔ Jordan egya anee afamu nyinara, nye Keenanfo ahemfo a wɔwɔ po ho no nyinara, tsee mbrɛ EWURADZE sii na ɔweew Jordan no nsu wɔ Israelmba no enyim ma wotwae ana no, hɔn akoma tui, nkyii so nna ahom bi nnyi hɔn mu bio, osian Israelmba no ntsi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Aber no mu na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, ɔwoara yɛ ɔtwerɛbo asekan, na twitwa Israelmba no twatsia bio ne mprɛnu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua noara yɛɛ ɔtwerɛbo asekan, na otwitwaa Israelmba no twatsia wɔ Gibeat Haaralot.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na dza osian ntsi ma Josua twitwaa twatsia no nye yi: ɔman no a wofi Egypt bae no nyinara a wɔyɛ mbanyin no, mekyerɛ mbarimba akofo no nyinara, wuwuu kwan mu wɔ sar no do, ber a wofi Egypt firii n’ekyir no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna ɔman no a wofiir edzi no nyinara woetwitwa hɔn twatsia: na ɔman no a wofi Egypt firii no a wɔwoo hɔn kwan mu wɔ sar no do nyinara dze, wonntwitwaa hɔn twatsia.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israelmba no nantsewee wɔ sar no do mfe eduanan, kodur dɛ ɔman no nyinara, mekyerɛ mbarimba akofo no a wofi Egypt firii no, hɔn ase kumii, osiandɛ woenntsie EWURADZE ne ndze: woyinom na EWURADZE kaa ntam dɛ ɔnnkɛma woehu asaase a ɔno EWURADZE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom dɛ ɔdze bɛma hɛn no, asaase a numfonsu nye ewo pem wɔ do no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hɔn mba no, hɔn a ɔmaa wɔsoɛree hyɛɛ hɔn ananmu no, nna wɔyɛ monomonomfo, osiandɛ woenntwa hɔn twatsia wɔ kwan no mu na hɔn na Josua twitwaa hɔn twatsia no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wowiee ɔman no nyinara twatsia twitwa no, wɔtsenatsenaa hɔn ananmu wɔ nseraban no mu ma wɔtsee apɔw ana.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Ndɛ da yi na meyi Egypt enyimguase no efi hom do. Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Gilgal dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israelmba no kyeer nsera wɔ Gilgal, na wodzii apaho wɔ bosoom no ne da a otsia duanan no n’ewimbir wɔ Jeriko tɛtɛr mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wodzii apaho no n’adzekyee no nna wodzii asaase no do eburow dadaw, epitsi tatar nye eburow kyewee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na da a wodzii asaase no do eburow dadaw no, adzekyee no ara nna manna no siankae; na Israelmba no ennya manna bio; mbom wodzii Keenan asaase no do ndɔbaa wɔ afe no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Josua wɔ Jeriko ho no, ɔmaa n’enyiwa do na ohun banyin bi a ɔatwe n’afona kitsa ne nsamu dɛ ogyina n’enyim tsentsendo: na Josua kɔr ne nkyɛn, na obisaa no dɛ, Ewɔ hɛn afa, anaa ewɔ hɛn atamfo afa?
title: JOSHUA

text: Na obuaa dɛ, Oho, nnyɛ no mu biara, na mbom dɛ EWURADZE no dɔm safohen panyin no, na afei maba. Na Josua dze n’enyim butuuw famu, na ɔsɔɔr no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Na mo wura ese n’akowaa dɛn?
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE no dɔm safohen panyin no see Josua dɛ, Yiyi wo mpaboa wɔ w’anan; na beebi mbrɛ igyinae no yɛ krɔnkrɔn. Na Josua yɛɛ dɛm.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔnam Israelmba no ntsi, wɔtoow Jeriko mu twitwiitwi a obi mmfi mu mmpue, na obi nntum mmba mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Hwɛ, medze Jeriko, nye ne hen, nye ne mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam no nyinara ahyɛ wo nsa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hom nkyin kurow no ho, mbarimba akofo nyinara mbɔ kurow no ho aprɔw prɛko. Yɛ no dɛm nda esia.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na asɔfo beesuon mfa nguannyin mmbɛn mbɛn esuon ndzi adaka no enyim: Na da a otsia esuon no hom nkyin kurow no ho mpɛn esuon, na asɔfo no nhɛn mbɛn no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔhɛn oguannyin abɛn no ma ɔkyɛr a, na sɛ hom tse abɛn no ne ndze a, ɔman no nyinara mfa huro kɛse mbɔ ose; na kurow no ho fasu no bodwuruw egu famu dɛfɛɛ, na ɔman no mu obiara ndua n’enyim tsentsendo mfow nkɔ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua, Nun ne babanyin no, frɛɛ asɔfo no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma ahyɛmudaka no do, na wɔmma asɔfo beesuon mfa nguannyin mmbɛn mbɛn esuon ndzi EWURADZE n’adakaa no enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔsee ɔman no dɛ, Hom ntwa mu nkɔbɔ kurow no ho aprɔw, na wɔmma mbarimba a woemia no ntwa mu nkedzi EWURADZE n’adakaa no enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm, aber a Josua kasaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no, asɔfo beesuon no a wɔdze nguannyin mmbɛn mbɛn esuon dzi EWURADZE enyim no twaa mu, na wɔhɛɛn mbɛn no: na EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no toaa hɔn do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na mbarimba a woemia no dzii asɔfo a wɔhɛn mbɛn no enyim, na nkyidɔm no dzii adaka no ekyir. Wɔnam rokɔ no nna asɔfo no rehɛn mbɛn no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua hyɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, Mma hom mmbɔ ose, mma wɔnntse hom ndze so, mma asɛm bi mmfi hom anomu mmpue, kyerɛ da a mebɛse hom dɛ wɔmbɔ ose no; nna hom mbɔ ose.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna ɔmaa EWURADZE n’adakaa no kekyiin kurow no ho, kɔbɔɔ ho aprɔw prɛko: na wɔbaa nseraban no mu, na wɔbɛdaa nseraban no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua soɛɛr anapaatu, na asɔfo no maa EWURADZE n’adakaa no do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na asɔfo beesuon no a wokitsakitsa nguannyin mmbɛn mbɛn esuon no nantsewee dzii EWURADZE n’adakaa no enyim, na wɔhɛɛn mbɛn no. Nna mbarimba a woemia no dzi hɔn enyim; na nkyidɔm no dzi EWURADZE n’adakaa no ekyir, asɔfo no nam rokɔ no nyina nna wɔrehɛn mbɛn no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na da a otsia ebien no wokyiin kurow no ho prɛko, na wɔsanee kɔr nseraban no mu: wɔyɛɛ dɛm ara nda esia.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia esuon no, wɔsoɛɛr ahanamakye a enyim rebaabaa no, na wokekyiin kurow no ho dɛmara mpɛn esuon: da no nko ara na wɔbɔɔ kurow no ho aprɔw mpɛn esuon.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a asɔfo no hɛɛn mbɛn no, wɔ aprɔwbɔ a otsia mpɛn esuon no, Josua see ɔman no dɛ, Hom mbɔ ose; na EWURADZE dze kurow no ama hom.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na kurow no nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, nyɛ adze a EWURADZE dze ne nsa ato do: mbom, ɔbaa huhunyi Rahab nko na ɔnka, ɔno nye hɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ fie no nyinara, osiandɛ ɔdze abɔfo a yɛsomaa hɔn no sumae.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hom, hom ho ara na hom nhwɛ no yie wɔ adze a woetu esi hɔ ama ɔsɛɛ no ho, ɔno bɛyɛ na hom afa adze a wɔadom no bi; na hom ayɛ ma Israel nseraban ayɛ ebusudze, na hom ahaw no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na dwetɛ, sika, boran nye dadze ndzɛmba nyinara dze, ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn mma EWURADZE: wɔmfa mbra EWURADZE n’adzekorabea.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna ɔman no bɔɔ ose, na asɔfo no hɛɛn mbɛn no: na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔman no tsee abɛn no ndze no, wɔdze huro kɛse bɔɔ ose, na fasu no dwuruwii guu famu dɛfɛɛ, ma ɔman no fowee kɔr kurow no mu, obiara duaa n’enyim tsentsendo, na wɔgyee kurow no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔdze afona kunkum dza ɔwɔ kurow no mu nyinara pasapasa, ɔbanyin nye ɔbaa, abofra na ɔpanyin nyina, nye ɔnantwi, nye oguan, nye asoaso.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see mbanyin beenu a wɔkɛseraa asaase no dɛ, Hom nkɔ ɔbaa huhunyi no ne fie, na wɔnkɛfa ɔbaa no, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara mfi hɔ mbra, dɛ mbrɛ hom kaa ntam kyerɛɛ no no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na mberantsɛ akwanserafo no kɔree, na wɔdze Rahab, nye n’egya, nye ne na, nye no nuanom, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara puei bae; na wokegyaa hɔn wɔ Israel nseraban no ekyir.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔdze ogya hyeew kurow no, nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara: dwetɛ, sika, na boran nye dadze ndzɛmba no ara nko, na wɔdze kɔr EWURADZE ne fie adzekorabea no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa huhunyi Rahab, na n’egya ne fifo, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara dze, Josua gyee hɔn nkwa; na ɔtsenaa Israel mu araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi; osiandɛ ɔdze abɔfo a Josua somaa hɔn dɛ wɔnkɛsera Jeriko no sumae.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua dze ntam braa hɔn aber no mu dɛ, Nyimpa a ɔbɔsoɛr abɛkyekyer Jeriko kurow yi, mpaa nka no wɔ EWURADZE enyim: ɔdze n’abakan bɔtow ne fapem, na ɔdze ne ba kaekyir banyin esisi n’ano mbobotsen.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE dzii Josua n’ekyir; na ne nka tahyee asaase no nyinara do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israelmba too mbra wɔ adze a woetu esi hɔ ama ɔsɛɛ no no ho: osiandɛ Akan a ofi Juda ebusuakuw mu a ɔyɛ Karmi (Karmi) a n’egya nye Zabdi a ɔno so n’egya nye Zera no, ne babanyin no faa adze a wɔadom no no bi: na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛɛw wɔ Israelmba no do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua somaa mbarimba ma wofi Jeriko kɔr Ai a ɔwɔ Bɛt-aven nkyɛn wɔ Bɛtɛl no boka afamu, na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom mfow nkɔ nkɛsera asaase no. Na mbarimba no fowee kɔree kɛseraa Ai.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔsanee baa Josua hɔ bɛsee no dɛ, Mma mma ɔman no nyinara mmfow nnkɔ; mbom ma mbarimba bɛyɛ mpemebien anaa mpemebiasa mfow nkɔ nkɔbɔ Ai; mma mma ɔman no nyinara mmfona hɔnho nnkefir hɔ: osiandɛ hɔn ho suar.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna ɔman no mu mbarimba bɛyɛ mpemebiasa fowee kɔr hɔ: na woguanee wɔ Ai mbarimba no enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Ai mbarimba no kunkum hɔn mu mbarimba bɛyɛ eduasa esia: na wotsiiw hɔn dze fi kuropon no ano araa kodur Sebarim, na wokunkum hɔn wɔ nsianee no mu: na ɔman no hɔn akoma tutui, na abagura kaa hɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua sunsuaan ne ntar mu, na ɔdze n’enyim butuuw famu wɔ EWURADZE n’adakaa no enyim araa ma okodur ewimbir, ɔnoara na Israel mpanyimfo no; na wotuu huntuma guguu hɔn etsifi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see dɛ, Afei, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, ɔyɛ dɛn ara ntsi na edze ɔman yi etwa Jordan, dɛ edze hɛn rebɛhyɛ Amorifo nsa, ma wɔaama yɛahyew yi? Yehunii a nkyɛ yɛnyɛ foo ntsena Jordan egya noho!
title: JOSHUA

text: Ao EWURADZE, na menka dɛn, Israel na wɔadan hɔn ekyir ama hɔn atamfo yi!
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Keenanfo nye asaase no do atsefo no nyinara bɛtse nka, na woetwa hɛn ho ehyia, na woetwa hɛn dzin efi asaase do: na ebɛyɛ dɛn ama wo dzin kɛse no?
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Soɛr: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze w’enyim ebutuw famu dɛm yi?
title: JOSHUA

text: Israel ayɛ bɔn; nyew, wɔato m’ahyɛmu a mehyɛɛ hɔn ho mbra no mpo: nyew, wɔafa adze a wɔadom no no so mpo bi; na woewia adze so, na wɔakata do so, na wɔdze akɛhyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn adze so mpo mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi na Israelmba no nntum nngyina hɔn atamfo enyim no, dan ara na wɔbɛdan hɔn ekyir ama hɔn atamfo, osiandɛ wɔabɛyɛ ebusufo: minnkedzi hom ekyir bio, gyedɛ hom sɛɛ adze a wɔadom no no fi hom mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Soɛr, tsew ɔman no ho, na se dɛ, Hom ntsew homho nsie ɔkyena: na mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi, Adze a wɔadom no no bi wɔ wo mu, Israel: irunntum nngyina w’atamfo enyim, gyedɛ hom eyi adze a wɔadom no no efi hom mu ana.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi anapa hom mfa no hom ebusuakuw mu ebusuakuw mu ntwe mpin: na ɔmbra dɛ, ebusuakuw a EWURADZE beyi no ntwe mpin ebusua mu ebusua mu; na ebusua a EWURADZE beyi no ntwe mpin no efibobow mu efibobow mu; na ofibobow a EWURADZE beyi no ntwe mpin no nyimpa nkorkor mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ, nyia adze a wɔadom no no besi no no wɔdze gya bɛhyew no, ɔnoara nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara: osiandɛ ɔato EWURADZE n’ahyɛmu no, na ɔayɛ ebusudze wɔ Israel.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔdze Israel twee pinii wɔ ebusuakuw mu ebusuakuw mu; na woyii Juda ebusuakuw no:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔdze Juda ebusua no twee pinii; na oyii Zerafo ebusua no: na ɔdze Zerafo ebusua no twee pinii wɔ nyimpa nkorkor mu; na woyii Zabdi:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔdze ne fibobow twee pinii wɔ nyimpa nkorkor mu: na woyii Akan (Akan), Karmi ne babanyin na Zabdi ne nana no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see Akan (Akan) dɛ, Me babanyin, me kyɛw ara nye yi, fa enyimnyam ma EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na yi no ayɛw; na afei ka dza ayɛ kyerɛ me; mma nnsiw me do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Akan buaa Josua see dɛ, Nokwar mayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na dza mayɛ nye yi:
title: JOSHUA

text: aber a muhun asadze no mu Babilɔn egugudo fɛɛfɛw bi, nye dwetɛ dwetɛbona ahaenu, nye sika ndamba a ɔtow dwetɛbona eduonum no, nna m’enyi beree, na mefae; na ampa, ɔhyɛ famu wɔ m’asesee no mu, na dwetɛ no hyɛ ase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua somaa abɔfo, na wɔdze mbirika kɔr asese no mu; na, hwɛ, ɔhyɛ famu wɔ n’asesee mu, na dwetɛ no hyɛ ase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na woyii no wɔ asese no mu, na wɔdze brɛɛ Josua, nye Israelmba no nyinara; na wɔdze boguu EWURADZE enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua nye Israel nyinara faa Akan (Achan), Zera ne babanyin no, nye dwetɛ no, egugudo no, sika ndamba no, ne mbabanyin na ne mbabaa, n’anantwi, no nsoasopɔnkɔ, no nguan, n’asesee, nye dza ɔwɔ nyinara: na wɔdze hɔn baa Akɔr (Akor) ɔbɔn mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na afona hɛn yi? EWURADZE bɔfona wo ndɛ da yi. Na Israel nyinara siiw no abo; na wɔdze abo siiw hɔn na wɔdze ogya hyeew hɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔhɔɔr no do abosiw kɛsenara dze bodu ndɛ da yi: na EWURADZE danee fii n’ebufuw ne hyeehyew no ho. Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin, Akɔr (Akor) ɔbɔn, ase nye ɔhaw ɔbɔn, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Mma nnsuro, nkyii so mma w’abaw mu mmbu: fa akofo no nyinara ka woho, na soɛr, fow kɔ Ai: hwɛ, medze Aihen, nye ne man, nye no kurow, nye n’asaase ahyɛ wo nsa:
title: JOSHUA

text: Yɛ Ai nye ne hen dɛ mbrɛ eyɛɛ Jeriko nye ne hen no: no mu asadze, nye no mu fiembowa nko, na hom mfa no afonam mma homho: hyɛ ma wɔnkɔ kurow no atsɛwee wɔ n’ekyir.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua, nye akofo no nyinara soɛree, dɛ wɔrokɔfow akɔ Ai: na Josua yiyii mbarimba no mpemeduasa, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, na ogyaa hɔn kwan anadwe.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ kurow no atsɛwee, wɔ kurow no n’ekyir: mma hom mmfi kurow no ho nnkɔ ekyirekyir pii, mbom hom nyinara nyɛ krado:
title: JOSHUA

text: na emi, nye hɔn a wɔka mo ho nyinara bɔtwe epin kurow no: na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wopue ba hɛn do dɛ asɔpɔn a, yebefi hɔn enyim eguan;
title: JOSHUA

text: na wobefir edzi etsiw hɛn ekodu dɛ yɛbɔtwe hɔn efi kurow no mu; na wɔbɛse dɛ, Wofi hɛn enyim ruguan, dɛ asɔpɔn no; na sɛ yefi hɔn enyim eguan a,
title: JOSHUA

text: ɔno hom nsoɛr mfi atsɛwee no mu, na hom nkɛfa kurow no: na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze bɛhyɛ hom nsa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ, aber a hom afa kurow no, hom nto kurow no mu gya; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm tse no ara na hom nyɛ: hyɛ, na mahyɛ hom.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua gyaa hɔn kwan: na wɔkɔr atsɛwee no, na wɔtsenaa Bɛtɛl nye Ai ntamu, wɔ Ai n’anee afamu: na Josua dze ɔdaa nseraban no mu anadwe no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua soɛɛr anapaatu, na ɔpoon ɔman no hyiae, na ɔnoara nye Israel mpanyimfo no fowee dzii ɔman no enyim kɔr Ai.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na akofo no a wɔka no ho no fowee, na wɔtwee pinii, na wɔbaa kurow no enyim, na wɔkyeer nsera wɔ Ai kwaamu afamu: nna ɔbɔn bi da ɔno nye Ai ntamu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔfaa mbarimba bɛyɛ mpemenum, na ɔdze hɔn kɔr atsɛwee wɔ Bɛtɛl nye Ai ntamu, wɔ kurow no n’anee afamu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔtotoo ɔman no ho hyiae, mekyerɛ dɔm no a wɔwɔ kurow no no kwaamu afamu, na hɔn atsɛweefo no a wɔwɔ kurow no n’anee afamu no nyinara; na Josua kɔr ɔbɔn no mu anadwe no ara.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Aihen no hunii no, ɔnye ne man nyinara na kurow no mu mbarimba no yɛɛ ntsɛm soɛɛr ahanamakye, fiir edzi dɛ worikehyia Israel nye hɔn ako, wɔ bea a wɔahyɛ no, wɔ Araba no enyim; nna ɔnodze, onnyim dɛ wɔakɔ no atsɛwee wɔ kurow no ekyir.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua nye Israel nyinara yɛɛ dɛ gyama Aimba no etutu hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim, na woguanee faa sar no do kwan no do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔfrɛɛ nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ kurow no mu nyinara bɔɔ mu dɛ wontsiw hɔn: na wotsiiw Josua, na wɔtwee hɔn fii kurow no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbarimba biara annka wɔ Ai anaa Bɛtɛl a oemmpue ennketsiw Israel: na wɔdaan kurow no n’ano gyaa hɔ, na wotsiiw Israel.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Tsen peaa no a ɔdze wo nsamu no wɔ Ai do; na medze mebɛhyɛ wo nsa. Na Josua tseen peaa no a ɔdze ne nsamu no wɔ kurow no do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na atsɛweefo no soɛree fii hɔn ananmu ntsɛm, na ɔtseen ne nsa ara na wotutuu mbirika kɛhɛɛn kurow no mu, na wɔfae; na wɔyɛɛ har too kurow no mu gya.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na aber a Ai mbarimba buu hɔn kɔn ekyir no, wohun dɛ, kurow no mu wusiw afow kɔ sor, na woennya ahoɔdzen a wɔdze guan fa ha anaa ha: na nkorɔfo no a woguanee kɔr sar no do no daan hɔnho wɔ hɔn a woritsiw hɔn no do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na aber a Josua nye Israel nyinara hun dɛ atsɛweefo no agye kurow no, na kurow no no wusiw afow kɔ sor no, nna wɔsaan hɔn ekyir bio bokunkum Ai mbarimba no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na kuw kor no so fiir edzi fii kurow no mu baa hɔn do; ma Aimba no kaa Israel ntamu, binom wɔ afa ha, na binom so wɔ afa ha: na wokunkum hɔn araa ma wɔamma hɔn mu biara annka anaa oemmfi nsa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔkyeer Aihen no enyikan, na wɔdze no brɛɛ Josua.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Israel wiee Aifo a wɔwɔ akoe mu, wɔ sar no do mbrɛ wotsiiw hɔn no kunkum, na hɔn nyinara totɔr wɔ afona anomu araa kodur dɛ hɔn ase kumii no, Israel nyinara sanee kɔr Ai, na wɔdze afona anomu kɔbɔɔ no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hɔn a wɔtotɔr da no nyinara, mbanyin nye mbaa nyina yɛ mpemduebien.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua anntwe ne nsa a ɔdze tseen peaa no annsan ekyir araa kodur dɛ ɔsɛɛ Aifo nyinara pasapasa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Kurow no mu fiembowa nye asadze nko na Israel faa no afonam maa hɔnho, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔdze hyɛɛ Josua no tse.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua hyeew Ai, na ɔyɛɛ no siw a ɔwɔ hɔ daa, mekyerɛ amamfo, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔdze Aihen no sɛɛn dua do araa ma okodur ewimbir: na wi kɔtɔree no Josua hyɛe ma wokeyii no fun no fii dua no do, na wɔkɔtowee kyeen kurow no no kuropon ano na wɔhɔɔr abosiw kɛsenara wɔ do, na ɔwɔ hɔ dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua sii afɔrmbukyia maa EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, wɔ bepɔw Ebal do,
title: JOSHUA

text: dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra nwoma no mu, afɔrmbukyia a wɔdze abo a wonntwae a nyimpa biara mmaa dadze biara do wɔ do pɛn sii: na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr wɔ do maa EWURADZE, na wokum asomdwee afɔr abowa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔkyerɛɛw Moses mbra no no nsusudo wɔ abo no do hɔ, ɔno na ɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israelmba enyim no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israel nyinara, nye hɔn mpanyimfo nye ahwɛdofo, nye hɔn ntsɛmbuafo, gyinaa adaka no n’afa ha, nye n’afa ha, wɔ Levifo asɔfo a wɔso EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no enyim, ɔhɔho nye okuromnyi nyinara: hɔn mu fa wɔ bepɔw Gerizim enyim, na hɔn mu fa so wɔ bepɔw Ebal enyim dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses hyɛɛ dɛ wondzi kan nhyira Israel ɔman no ana no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na n’ekyir no ɔkenkaan mbra no mu nsɛm nyinara, nhyira no nye mpaa no, dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra nwoma no mu nyinara tse.
title: JOSHUA

text: Asɛm biara nnyi dza Moses hyɛe no nyinara mu a Josua annkenkan no wɔ Israel bagua no nyinara, nye mbaa, nye mbofraba, nye ahɔho a wɔnye hɔn nam no enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ahemfo a wɔwɔ Jordan egya, wɔ nkokodo nkurow, nye ɔbɔnmu nkurow, nye po kɛse no no mpoano nyinara wɔ Lebanon tsentsendo no, Hitifo, nye Amorifo, Keenanfo, Perizfo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo no tsee dza esi no;
title: JOSHUA

text: wɔpoon hɔnho hyiae, dɛ wɔreyɛ kor, nye Josua na Israel akɔko.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na aber a Gibeonfo tsee dza Josua dze yɛɛ Jeriko nye Ai no,
title: JOSHUA

text: hɔn dze, wɔyɛɛ no nyansa mu, na wosii mu kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ gyama wɔyɛ abɔfo, na wɔfaa nkotoku dadaw soasoaa hɔn nsoasopɔnkɔ, nye nsanwoma nkotoku a wɔayɛ dadaw na wɔatsetsew na wɔapempam;
title: JOSHUA

text: na mpaboa dadaw pokyipokyi a wɔasesa mu hyehyɛɛ hɔn anan, na ntar gow hyehyɛe; nna hɔn edzidzidze mu edziban nyinara atwentwem na wɔabobɔ etur.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wosii mu kɔr Josua hɔ wɔ nsera mu wɔ Gilgal, na wɔsee ɔno nye Israelmba no dɛ, Yefi ekyirekyir ɔman bi mu na yɛaba, dɛm ntsi afei hom nye hɛn nyɛ apam.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israelmba no see Hivifo no dɛ, Annyɛ a hɛn mu na hom tse; na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn yɛnye hom ayɛ apam?
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔsee Josua dɛ, Yɛyɛ wo nkowaa. Na Josua bisaa hɔn dɛ, Woananom nye hom? Na hom fi hen bae?
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne dzin ntsi na wo nkowaa fi ekyirekyir ɔman bi mu aba: na yɛatse ne nka, na dza ɔyɛe wɔ Egypt nyinara,
title: JOSHUA

text: na dza ɔdze yɛɛ Amorifo ahemfo beenu a wɔwɔ Jordan egya, Hesbonhen Sihon, nye Basanhen Ɔge a ɔwɔ Astarot no nyinara.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hɛn mpanyimfo nye hɛn man mu nkorɔfo nyinara kasaa kyerɛɛ hɛn dɛ, Hom mfa ɔkwan do edzidzidze, na wɔnkɔ nkehyia hɔn, na wɔnse hɔn dɛ, Yɛyɛ hom nkowaa: na afei hom nye hɛn nyɛ apam.
title: JOSHUA

text: Hɛn boodoo yi da a yefiir edzi dɛ yɛreba hom nkyɛn no na yɛfaa no ɔhyew totoo hɛn edzidzidze mu; na afei, hwɛ, atwentwem, na ɔabɔ etur:
title: JOSHUA

text: na nsanwoma nkotoku yi a yɛhyehyɛɛ no amaama yi, wɔyɛ afofor; na, hwɛ, wɔatsetsew; na hɛn ntar nye hɛn mpaboa yi ayɛ adadaw wɔ ɔkwan no no war a ɔwar dodow ntsi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na mbarimba no gyee hɔn edzidzidze no bi, naaso woemmbisa EWURADZE hɔ apam.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua nye hɔn dzii no asomdwee mu, na ɔnye hɔn yɛɛ apam dɛ ɔbɛma wɔatsena ase: na hɔn mu mbapɔmba no dzidzii nsew kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ wɔnye hɔn wiee apam no yɛ no n’ekyir nda ebiasa, nna wɔtsee dɛ wɔyɛ hɔn manmufo, na wɔtse hɔn mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israelmba no tuu kwan, na wokodur hɔn nkurow mu da a otsia ebiasa no. Na hɔn nkurow nye Gibeon, nye Kefira (Kefira), nye Beerot, nye Kiriat-jearim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israelmba ennkuku hɔn, osiandɛ hɔn mu mbapɔmba no dze EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, edzi nsew akyerɛ hɔn. Na dɔm no nyinara hwinhwinii tsiaa mbapɔmba no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na mbapɔmba no nyinara see dɔm no nyinara dɛ, Yɛdze EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, edzi nsew akyerɛ hɔn: dɛm ntsi afei yennyi ho kwan dɛ yɛdze nsa ka hɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyi na yɛbɛyɛ hɔn, na yɛama wɔatsena ase; amma osian ntam a yɛaka akyerɛ hɔn no ntsi, ebufuw aammba hɛn do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na mbapɔmba no see hɔn dɛ, Wɔmma wɔntsena ase: mbom wɔbɛyɛ nduatwafo nye nsusawfo ama hɛn. Dɛm na mbapɔmba no kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua kɛfrɛɛ hɔn, na obisaa hɔn, dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom adaadaa hɛn, dɛ, Yɛnye hom ntamu twe dodoodow; aber a hom tse hɛn mu yi?
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi afei wɔapaa hom, na hom nnkegyaa nkowaa yɛ ara da, hom bɛyɛ nduatwafo nye nsusawfo ama me Nyankopɔn fie.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wobuaa Josua, na wɔsee dɛ, Osiandɛ wɔkaa no kotoo kyerɛɛ wo nkowaa, mbrɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn sii na ɔhyɛɛ n’akowaa Moses dɛ ɔmfa asaase nyinara mma hom, na ɔnsɛɛ asaase no do atsefo no nyinara mfi hom enyim; dɛm ntsi osian hom ntsi yesuroo dodoodow maa hɛn nkwa, iyi ntsi na yɛayɛ dɛm yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na afei, hwɛ, yɛwɔ wo nsamu: dza ehwɛ a oye na ɔtsen ma wo dɛ edze bɛyɛ hɛn no, yɛ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na dɛm na ɔyɛɛ hɔn, na ɔgyee hɔn fii Israelmba nsamu, ma woennkunkum hɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na da no ara Josua yɛɛ hɔn nduatwafo nye nsusawfo dze maa Israelmba no, nye EWURADZE n’afɔrmbukyia no, wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔbɛsan mu eyi biara. Na dɛm na wɔyɛɛ dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Afei ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jerusalɛmhen Adoni-zedek tsee mbrɛ Josua sii gyee Ai, na ɔsɛɛ no pasapasa; dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze yɛɛ Jeriko nye ne hen no, dɛmara so na ɔdze yɛɛ Ai nye ne hen; na mbrɛ Gibeonfo sii nye Israel siesiei, na wɔtsenaa hɔn mu no;
title: JOSHUA

text: wosuroo kɛsenara, osiandɛ Gibeon yɛ kurow kɛse, ɔtse dɛ ahenkurow no bi, na ɔso sen Ai, na no mu mbanyin nyinara yɛ ahoɔdzenfo.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi Jerusalɛmhen Adoni-zedek somae ma wɔkɔr Hebronhen Hoham, Jarmuthen Piram, Lakishen Jafia, nye Eglonhen Debir hɔ, dɛ,
title: JOSHUA

text: Hom mbra me nkyɛn mbɔboa me, ma yenku Gibeon: osiandɛ ɔnye Josua na Israelmba no akɛyɛ asomdwee apam.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi Amorifo ahemfo beenum a hɔn nye, Jerusalɛmhen, Hebronhen, Jarmuthen, Lakishen na Eglonhen no, poon hɔnho hyiae, hɔn nye hɔn dɔm nyinara, na wɔfowee kɔree, na wɔkɛkyeer Gibeon do nsera, na wɔyɛɛ no do sa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Gibeonfo no somae ma wɔkɔr Josua nkyɛn wɔ nsera mu wɔ Gilgal, dɛ, Mma nnyi wo nsa mmfi wo nkowaa do; bra hɛn nkyɛn ntsɛm bɛgye hɛn nkwa, na bɔboa hɛn: na Amorifo ahemfo a wɔtsetse nkokodo nkurow mu nyinara apon hɔnho ehyia abɛhyɛ hɛn do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua fi Gilgal fowee kɔree, ɔnoara, ɔnye akofo a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn nyinara, nye mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam nyinara.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Mma nnsuro hɔn: na meyi hɔn ahyɛ wo nsa; hɔn mu nyimpa biara nnkegyina w’enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi Josua baa hɔn do awerɛfir mu; osiandɛ ɔdze anadwe no nyinara fowee fi Gilgal kɔree.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE kaa hɔn gui wɔ Israel enyim, na ɔdze okum kɛse kunkum hɔn wɔ Gibeon, na wotsiiw hɔn wɔ Bɛt-horon n’afowee ɔkwan no do, na wokunkum hɔn kodur Azeka, nye Makeda.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, woruguan efi Israel enyim, na wɔwɔ Bɛt-horon esianee no, EWURADZE totoow abo akɛse fi sor bobɔɔ hɔn dze kodur Azeka, ma wowuwui: hɔn a wɔdze ɔsorbo no kunkum hɔn no dɔɔ so sen hɔn a Israelmba no dze afona kunkum hɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua kasaa kyerɛɛ EWURADZE wɔ da a EWURADZE yii Amorifo mae wɔ Israelmba enyim no na ɔsee dɛ, Iwi, gyina dzinn wɔ Gibeon do; Na ɔwo, Bosoom, wɔ Aijalon ɔbɔn mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na iwi gyinaa dzinn, na bosoom siankae, Kodur dɛ ɔman no tɔɔ hɔn atamfo do wer. Ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw iyi wɔ Jasar nwoma no mu? Na wi siankae wɔ sor finimfin, na ɔannyɛ ntsɛm annkɔtɔ bɛyɛ adzekyeekwansin mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na da biara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ iyi da, dɛ abɛsen anaa dza ɔbɛba a EWURADZE etsie nyimpa ne ndze dɛm: na EWURADZE koe maa Israel.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua sanee, na Israel nyinara ka no ho, baa nseraban no mu wɔ Gilgal.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Amori ahemfo beenum yi guanee, na wɔdze hɔnho kosumaa Makeda ɔbo tu no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Josua dɛ, Ahemfo beenum no woehu hɔn dɛ wosuma Makeda ɔbo tu no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see dɛ, Hom mpirew abo akɛse nhin ɔbo tu no ano, na wɔmfa nyimpa ngyina ho ma wɔnweɔn hɔn:
title: JOSHUA

text: na hom dze mma wonnsianka; hom ntsiw hom atamfo no, na wonku hɔn mu edziekyifo no, mma hom mma hɔn kwan ma wɔnnkɛhɛn nkurow mu: osiandɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn eyi hɔn ahyɛ hom nsa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Josua nye Israelmba no dze okum kɛse pɔtɔɔ wiee hɔn kunkum araa ma wɔhyewee no, na hɔn mu nkaa a wɔkae no guanguanee kɛhɛnhɛɛn nkurow a wɔagyegye ho ban no mu no,
title: JOSHUA

text: nna ɔman no nyinara sanee baa Josua nkyɛn wɔ nseraban no mu wɔ Makeda dwudwoodwo: na obi anntwe ne gyirama annka Israelmba mu obiara da.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua see dɛ, Hom mbue ɔbo tu no ano, na hom nyi ahemfo beenum no mfi ɔbo tu no mu mbrɛ me.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm, na woyii ahemfo beenum no fii ɔbo tu no mu brɛɛ no, Jerusalɛm, Hebron, Jarmut, Lakis nye Eglon ahemfo no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔdze ahemfo no brɛɛ Josua no, Josua kɛfrɛɛ Israel mbarimba nyinara, na ɔsee mbarimba akofo a wɔnye no kɔree no hɔn asafohemfo no dɛ, Hom ntwe mpin, mfa hom anan mbesisi hɔn kɔn do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro, mma hom abaw mu nntu so; hom nhyɛ dzen na wonnya akokodur: na dɛm na EWURADZE bɛyɛ hom atamfo a hom nye hɔn ko nyinara.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na n’ekyir no Josua bobɔɔ hɔn kunkum hɔn, na ɔdze hɔn sensɛɛn ndua do: na wɔsensɛɛn ndua no do araa kodur ewimbir.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ witɔree ber no, Josua hyɛe ma woyiyii hɔn fii ndua no do, na wɔkɔtoow hɔn guu ɔbo tu no a wɔdze hɔnho kosumaa mu no mu, na wɔdze abo akɛse hiin ɔbo tu no ano, dze bodu ndɛ da yi ara.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua gyee Makeda da no ara, na ɔdze afona bɔɔ kurow no, nye ne hen no; na ɔsɛɛ hɔn nyinara nye akra a wɔwɔ mu no pasapasa, oenngyaa obiara ma ɔaannka: na ɔyɛɛ Makedahen no dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ Jerikohen no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua, nye Israel nyinara twaa mu fi Makeda, kɔr Libna, na wɔnye Libna kɔkoe:
title: JOSHUA

text: na EWURADZE yii ɔno so, nye ne hen no, hyɛɛ Israel nsa; na ɔdze afona anomu bɔɔ no, nye akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara; na oenngyaa obiara ma ɔaannka wɔ mu; na ɔyɛɛ ne hen no so dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ Jerikohen no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua, nye Israel nyinara twaa mu fi Libna, kɔr Lakis, na wɔkɛkyeer no do nsera, na wɔnye no koe:
title: JOSHUA

text: na EWURADZE yii Lakis hyɛɛ Israel nsa, na Josua gyee no da a otsia ebien no, na ɔdze afona bɔɔ no, nye akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔdze yɛɛ Libna no tse nyinara.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Gezerhen Horam fowee bae bɔboaa Lakis; na Josua kum ɔno nye ne man, dze kodur dɛ oenngyaa no biara ma ɔaannka.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua, nye Israel nyinara twaa mu fi Lakis, kɔr Eglon; na wɔkyeer no do nsera, na wɔnye no koe;
title: JOSHUA

text: na wɔgyee no da no ara, na wɔdze afona bɔɔ no, na akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara ɔsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa da no ara, dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔdze yɛɛ Lakis no tse nyinara.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua, nye Israel nyinara fi Eglon fowee kɔr Hebron; na wɔnye no koe:
title: JOSHUA

text: na wɔgyee, na wɔdze afona bɔɔ no, nye ne hen no, nye no nkurow no nyinara, nye akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara; oenngyaa biara ma ɔaannka, dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔdze yɛɛ Eglon no tse nyinara; na ɔsɛɛ Hebron nye akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara pasapasa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua, nye Israel nyinara sanee baa Debir; na wɔnye no koe:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔgyee, nye ne hen no, nye no nkurow no nyinara; na wɔdze afona bobɔɔ hɔn, na wɔsɛɛ akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara pasapasa; oenngyaa obiara ma ɔaannka: dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ Hebron no, dɛmara so na ɔyɛɛ Debir, nye ne hen; dɛ mbrɛ eso ɔyɛɛ Libna, nye ne hen no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua bɔɔ asaase no nyinara, nkokodo nkurow, nye pomu afamu, ɔbɔnmu nkurow, nye nkokonyiadze, nye hɔn ahemfo nyinara; oenngyaa obiara ma ɔaannka: mbom ɔsɛɛ dza ogu ahom nyinara pasapasa, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no hyɛe no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua bobɔɔ hɔn fi Kades-barnea araa kodur Gaza, nye Gosen ɔman no nyinara mu, araa kodur Gibeon.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ahemfo yi nyinara nye hɔn asaase no, Josua gyee no aber kor mu, osiandɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, koe maa Israel.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua, na Israel nyinara ka no ho, sanee baa nseraban no mu wɔ Gilgal.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Hazorhen Jabin tsee no, ɔsomae ma wɔkɔr Madonhen Jobab, Simronhen, nye Aksafhen nkyɛn,
title: JOSHUA

text: nye ahemfo a wɔwɔ kwaamu afamu wɔ nkokodo nkurow no mu, nye Araba Kinnerot no pomu afamu, nye ɔbɔnmu nkurow, nye Dor akoko do wɔ anee afamu,
title: JOSHUA

text: Keenanfo a wɔwɔ boka nye anee, nye Amorifo, Hitifo, Perizfo, nye Jebusfo a wɔwɔ nkokodo nkurow mu, nye Hivifo a wɔwɔ Hermon ase wɔ Mizpa asaase do no nyinara nkyɛn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔnye hɔn dɔm nyinara ka hɔn ho sii mu kɔree, nkurow pii, hɔn dodow tse dɛ mpoano anhwea, nye mpɔnkɔ nye ntseaseanam piigyan.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ahemfo yi nyinara kehyiae; na wɔbaa bɛkyeer nsera fakor wɔ Merom nsu no ho, dɛ wɔnye Israel robɔko.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE see Josua dɛ, Mma onnsian hɔn ntsi ma w’akoma nntu: na ɔkyena siseber yi na mibeyi hɔn nyinara atɔfun ama wɔ Israel enyim: twitwa hɔn mpɔnkɔ anantsir, na fa ogya hyew hɔn ntseaseanam.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua, nye nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no nyinara baa hɔn do awerɛfir mu wɔ Merom nsu no ho, na wotui hyɛɛ hɔn do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE yii hɔn hyɛɛ Israel nsa, na wokunkum hɔn, na wotsiiw hɔn araa dze kodur Zidon kɛse no, nye Misrepot-maim ho, nye Mizpe ɔbɔn mu boka afamu; na wokunkum hɔn kodur dɛ woenngyaa hɔn mu biara ma ɔaannka.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua yɛɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ no no: otwitwaa hɔn mpɔnkɔ anantsir, na ɔdze ogya hyeew hɔn ntseaseanam.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua saan n’ekyir aber no ara mu, na ɔkɛgyee Hazor, na ɔdze afona kum ne hen no: nna nkan no na Hazor na ɔyɛ ahenman no ne tsir.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔdze afona anomu kunkum akra a wɔwɔ mu nyinara, sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa: woenngyaa obiara a ogu ahom wɔ hɔ: na ɔdze gya hyeew Hazor.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ahemfo no hɔn nkurow nyinara, nye no mu ahemfo nyinara Josua gyee, na ɔdze afona kunkum hɔn, na ɔsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses hyɛe no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na nkurow a wɔdeda hɔn apempe do no dze, Israel annhyew no mu biara, gyedɛ Hazor nko; ɔno na Josua hyeew no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na nkurow yi mu asadze nyinara, nye fiembowa no, Israelmba no faa no afonam maa hɔnho, nyimpa biara dze, wɔdze afona kum no, dze kodur dɛ wɔsɛɛ hɔn, na woenngyaa obiara a ogu ahom.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ n’akowaa Moses no, dɛmara so na Moses hyɛɛ Josua: na dɛmara so na Josua yɛe; oenngyaa dza EWURADZE dze hyɛɛ Moses no nyinara mu biara a ɔannyɛ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua gyee asaase no nyinara, nkokodo nkurow no, nye pomu afamu nyinara, nye Gosen asaase nyinara, nye ɔbɔnmu nkurow no, nye Araba no, nye Israel nkokodo nkurow no, nye ɔnoara so no bɔnmu nkurow no;
title: JOSHUA

text: ofi bepɔw Halak a ɔfow kɔ Seir ho, mekyerɛ Baal-gad ho wɔ Lebanon ɔbɔn a ɔwɔ bepɔw Hermon ase no: na ɔfaa hɔn ahemfo nyinara, na ɔbobɔɔ hɔn kunkum hɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Josua nye ahemfo no nyinara dzii ako kyɛree.
title: JOSHUA

text: Kurow bi nnyi hɔ a ɔnye Israelmba yɛɛ nsiesie, gyedɛ Hivifo a wɔtse Gibeon no nko: na wɔkoe gyee ne nyinara.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE piriim hɔn akoma dɛ wonkehyia Israel wɔ ɔko mu, ama ɔaasɛɛ hɔn pasapasa a worunnhu hɔn mbɔbɔr, na mbom ɔaasɛɛ hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua baa aber no mu, na obotwitwaa Anakfo no gui wɔ nkokodo nkurow no mu, wɔ Hebron, Debir, Anab, nye Juda nkokodo nkurow nyinara mu. Josua dze hɔn kaa hɔn nkurow ho sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Woenngyaa Anakfo no mu biara wɔ Israelmba asaase do: Gaza, Gat, nye Ashdod mu nko, na binom kae.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua gyee asaase no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Moses no nyinara; na ɔdze maa Israel dɛ egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nkyekyɛmu tsetsee. Na asaase no so homee fii akodzi mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Woyinom nye asaase no do ahemfo a Israelmba no kunkum hɔn, na wɔfaa hɔn asaase wɔ Jordan egya a ɔdze kɔ wipuei no, ofi Arnon ɔbɔnmu dze kodu bepɔw Hermon ho, nye Araba nyinara boka afamu no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Amorifo hen Sihon a ɔtsenaa Hesbon, na odzii hen fi Aroer a ɔda Arnon ɔbɔn ano, nye kurow a ɔwɔ ɔbɔn no ne finimfin, nye Gilead ɔfa no araa dze kodu esutsen Jabbok ho, Ammonmba he no do;
title: JOSHUA

text: nye Araba dze kodu Kinnerot po no ho, mekyerɛ Nkyen Epo no ho, boka afamu, Bɛt-jesimot kwan do; nye pomu afamu, wɔ Pisga no nkokonyiadze ase no:
title: JOSHUA

text: nye Basanhen Ɔge a ofi Refafo nkaa no mu a ɔtsenaa Astarot nye Edrei no ne he do,
title: JOSHUA

text: na odzii hen wɔ bepɔw Hermon do, nye Saleka, nye Basan nyinara, dze kodu Gersurfo nye Maakatfo he do, nye Gilead ɔfa, wɔ Hesbon hen Sihon he do.
title: JOSHUA

text: EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses nye Israelmba no kaa hɔn gui: na EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze maa Reubenfo, nye Gadfo, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw ɔfa no dɛ enyadze.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na woyinom nye asaase no do ahemfo a Josua nye Israelmba no kunkum hɔn wɔ Jordan egya anee afamu, ofi Baal-gad wɔ Lebanon ɔbɔn no araa dze kodu bepɔw Halak a ɔfow kɔ Seir ho no; na Josua dze maa Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw dɛ enyadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyekyɛmu no tsetsee;
title: JOSHUA

text: wɔ nkokodo nkurow mu, nye ɔbɔnmu nkurow mu, nye Araba, nye nkokonyiadze, nye sar no mu, nye Pomu afamu; Hitifo, Amorifo, nye Keenanfo, Perizfo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo:
title: JOSHUA

text: Woyinom nye Jeriko, Ai a ɔwɔ Bɛtɛl ne nkyɛn no,
title: JOSHUA

text: Jerusalɛm, Hebron,
title: JOSHUA

text: Jarmut, Lakis,
title: JOSHUA

text: Eglon, Gezer,
title: JOSHUA

text: Debir, nye Geder ahemfo.
title: JOSHUA

text: Binom so nye Horma, Arad,
title: JOSHUA

text: Libna, Adullam,
title: JOSHUA

text: Makeda, Bɛtɛl,
title: JOSHUA

text: Tappua, Hefer,
title: JOSHUA

text: Afekhen, Lasaron,
title: JOSHUA

text: Madon nye Hazor ahemfo.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nkaa no nye Simronmeron, Aksaf,
title: JOSHUA

text: Taanak, Megiddo,
title: JOSHUA

text: Kedes, Jokmeam a ɔwɔ Karmel,
title: JOSHUA

text: Dor a ɔwɔ Dor koko do, Goiim a ɔwɔ Gilgal,
title: JOSHUA

text: nye Tirza ahemfo. Ahemfo no nyinara wɔyɛ eduasa biako.
title: JOSHUA

text: Afei nna Josua ayɛ akɔdaa na oedzi mfe ara yie; na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Ayɛ akɔdaa na edzi mfe ara yie, na asaase a aka so dɛ wɔkɛfa no dɔɔ so dodow.
title: JOSHUA

text: Asaase a aka no so nye yi: Filistiafo mbew no nyinara, nye Gersurfo nyinara;
title: JOSHUA

text: ofi Sihor a ɔwɔ Egypt n’enyim araa dze kodu Ekron kwaamu afamu he do a wɔkan ka Keenanfo ho: Filistiafo ahemfo beenum no; Gazafo dze, Ashdodfo dze, Ashkelonfo dze, Gatfo dze, Ekronfo dze; nye Avifo so,
title: JOSHUA

text: wɔ pomu afamu: Keenanfo asaase no nyinara nye Meara a ɔyɛ Zidonfo dze no, dze kodu Afek dze kodu Amorifo he do:
title: JOSHUA

text: nye Gebalfo asaase, nye Lebanon nyinara, dze kɔ wipuei, fi Baal-gad wɔ bepɔw Hermon ase dze rekɛhɛn Hamat:
title: JOSHUA

text: hɔn a wɔtse nkokodo nkurow no mu nyinara, ofi Lebanon ho dze kodu Mesrɛfɔt-maim, mekyerɛ Zidonfo nyinara; mara na mubotu hɔn efi Israelmba enyim: na ɔwo dze, kyɛ ara na twe tonto kyɛ ma ɔnyɛ egyapadze mma Israel, dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ wo yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi afei kyɛ asaase yi ma ɔnyɛ egyapadze mma ebusuakuw akron no, na Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Reubenfo nye Gadfo ka Manaasɛ ɔfa kor no so ho nyaa hɔn egyapadze a Moses dze maa hɔn wɔ Jordan egya boka afamu no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze maa hɔn no ara pɛ;
title: JOSHUA

text: ofi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon ɔbɔn ano, nye kurow no a ɔwɔ ɔbɔn no finimfin, nye Medeba tɛtɛr mu nyinara dze kodu Dibon;
title: JOSHUA

text: na Amorifo hen Sihon a odzi hen wɔ Hesbon no, no nkurow no nyinara, dze kodu Ammonmba he do;
title: JOSHUA

text: nye Gilead, nye Gersurfo nye Maakatfo he do, nye bepɔw Hermon nyinara, nye Basan nyinara dze kodu Saleka;
title: JOSHUA

text: Ɔge a odzii hen wɔ Astarot nye Edrei n’ahenman a ɔwɔ Basan no nyinara (ɔnoara na ɔkae wɔ Refaim nkaa no mu); na woyinom na Moses kum hɔn, gyee hɔn nsaase no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Naaso Israelmba enntu Gersurfo no, nye Maakatfo no so: mbom Gesur nye Maakat tsenaa Israel mu, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Levi ebusuakuw no nko na ɔamma no egyapadze bi; osiandɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, n’afɔrbɔdze a wɔdze ogya bɔ no na ɔyɛ n’egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Moses dze maa Reubenmba ebusuakuw no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hɔn he fi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon ɔbɔn no ano, nye kurow a ɔwɔ ɔbɔn no finimfin no, nye Medeba ho tɛtɛr mu no nyinara;
title: JOSHUA

text: Hesbon, nye no nkurow a ɔwɔ tɛtɛr mu no nyinara; Dibon, nye Bamoth-baal, nye Bɛt-baal-meon;
title: JOSHUA

text: nye Jahaz, nye Kedemot, nye Mefaat;
title: JOSHUA

text: nye Kiriataim, nye Sibma, nye Zeret-sahar wɔ ɔbɔn no mu bepɔw do;
title: JOSHUA

text: nye Bɛt-peor, nye Pisga, nye Bɛt-jesimot;
title: JOSHUA

text: nye tɛtɛrmu nkurow no nyinara, nye Amorifo hen Sihon a odzii hen wɔ Hesbon no n’ahenman nyinara, ɔno na Moses dze no kaa Midian asafohemfo no ho kum hɔn no, Evi, nye Rekem, nye Zur, nye Hur, nye Reba, Sihon ne mbapɔmba a wɔtsenaa asaase no do no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Balaam, Beor ne babanyin, ɔsebramunyi no so, Israelmba dze afona kum no foraa hɔn atɔfun nkaa no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Reubenmba no hɔn he nye Jordan, nye ne he. Iyi nye Reubenmba no hɔn egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow no nye no nkurobaase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Moses dze maa Gad ebusuakuw no, Gadmba no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hɔn he nye Jazer, nye Gilead nkurow no nyinara, na Ammonmba asaase no ne fa, dze kodu Aroer a ɔwɔ Rabaa enyim no;
title: JOSHUA

text: na ofi Hesbon dze kodu Ramat-mizpe nye Bɛtonim; na ofi Mahanaim dze kodu Debir he do;
title: JOSHUA

text: nye ɔbɔn no mu, Bɛt-haram, nye Bɛt-nimra, nye Sukɔt, nye Zafon, Hesbonhen Sihon n’ahenman nkaa no, Jordan nye ne he, dze kodu Kinneret po no n’ano noho Jordan egya boka afamu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyi nye Gadmba no hɔn egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow no nye no nkurobaase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Moses dze egyapadze maa Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no: na ɔyɛɛ Manaasɛmba ebusuakuw fa no dze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hɔn he fi Mahanaim, Basan nyinara, Basanhen Ɔge n’ahenman nyinara, nye Jair no nkurow a ɔwɔ Basan nyinara, nkurow eduosia:
title: JOSHUA

text: na Gilead ne fa, nye Astarot, nye Edrei, Ɔge n’ahenman mu nkurow a ɔwɔ Basan no ɔyɛɛ Manaasɛ ne babanyin Makir ne mba no dze, mekyerɛ Makirmba no hɔn fa no a, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyi nye egyapadze a Moses kyɛɛ no Moab tɛtɛr mu, Jeriko Jordan egya boka afamu no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Levi ebusuakuw dze, Moses amma hɔn egyapadze bi: osiandɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, nye hɔn egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na iyi nye egyapadze a Israelmba nyaa no wɔ Keenan asaase do a ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye Nun ne babanyin Josua, nye egyanom efiefi etsitsir no a wɔyɛ Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no kyekyɛe maa hɔn,
title: JOSHUA

text: nam hɔn egyapadze ho tontotwe do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE nam Moses nsa do hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma ebusuakuw akron, na fa no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Osiandɛ Moses dze ebusuakuw ebien na fa no hɔn egyapadze ama hɔn wɔ Jordan egya: na Levifo no dze ɔamma hɔn egyapadze bi wɔ hɔn mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josefmba yɛ ebusuakuw ebien, Manaasɛ nye Efraim: na Levifo dze, wɔammfa kyɛfa biara amma hɔn wɔ asaase no do, gyedɛ nkurow a wɔtsena mu, nye ne mfikyisaase a wɔdze ma hɔn fiembowa nye hɔn ahodze.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no, dɛmara so na Israelmba no yɛe, na wɔkyekyɛɛ asaase no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Judamba twee piin Josua wɔ Gilgal: na Kaleb, Jefune ne babanyin Keniznyi no see no dɛ, Ɔwoara nyim asɛm a EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Nyame nyimpa Moses wɔ mo ho nye wo ho wɔ Kades-barnea.
title: JOSHUA

text: Aber a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses somaa me fi Kades-barnea dɛ menkɛsera asaase no, nna medzi mfe eduanan; na medze asɛm sanee brɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ m’akoma mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Naaso mo nuanom a wɔnye me fowee kɔree no maa ɔman no hɔn akoma tui: na emi dze, medze m’akoma nyinara dzii EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn no ekyir.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Moses kaa ntam da no ara dɛ, Ampaara asaase a w’anan etsia do no nyɛ wo mba egyapadze daa, osiandɛ edzi EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn ekyir korakorakora.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na afei, hwɛ, EWURADZE ama matsena ase, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkae no mfe eduanan enum yi, ofi aber a EWURADZE kaa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ Moses, aber a Israel nam sar no do no: na afei, hwɛ, medzi mfe eduowɔtwe enum ndɛ da yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Ndɛ da yi ara mo ho da ho yɛ dzen dɛ mbrɛ metse wɔ da a Moses somaa me no: nkan no mbrɛ m’ahoɔdzen tse no, mekyerɛ seseiara so mbrɛ m’ahoɔdzen tse ara nye no, dze ma ɔko, nye nkɔree nye mbae.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi afei fa bepɔw yi a EWURADZE kaa ho asɛm da no mu no ma me; na ɔwoara tsee no wɔ da no mu dɛ Anakfo wɔ hɔ, na nkurow a ɔyɛ akɛse na wɔagyegye ho ban: annyɛ a EWURADZE bedzi m’ekyir ma meetu hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kae no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua hyiraa no; na ɔdze Hebron maa Kaleb, Jefune ne babanyin no dɛ n’egyapadze.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi Hebron bɛyɛɛ Kaleb, Jefune ne babanyin Keniznyi no, n’egyapadze dze bodu ndɛ da yi; osiandɛ ɔdze n’akoma nyinara dzii EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no n’ekyir.
title: JOSHUA

text: Asɔpɔn no nkyɛ Hebron ne dzin nye Kiriat-arba; Arba no nye Anakfo mu nyimpa kɛse koraa. Na asaase no do dwee wɔ ɔko ho.
title: JOSHUA

text: Judamba ebusuakuw kyɛfa, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee no si Edom he do, mekyerɛ Zin sar do pomu afamu, wɔ pomu afamu ekyir noho ara.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hɔn pomu afamu he no hyɛ ase fi Nkyen Po no n’ano a obu fa pomu afamu noho ara:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔdze nam Akrabbim no mfowee mu pomu afamu, na otwa mu kɔ Zin, na ɔfow kɔ Kades-barnea no pomu afamu, na otwa mu wɔ Hezron ho, na ɔfow kɔ Addar, na ɔdan kɔ Karka:
title: JOSHUA

text: na otwa mu kɔ Azmon, na ɔdze pue Egypt ɔwora no do; na ɔhe no n’edzifir wɔ po ho: iyi nyɛ hom pomu afamu he.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na boka afamu he nye Nkyen Po no, mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu Jordan ewiei. Na kwaamu afamu he no ofi po no ho wɔ Jordan ewiei:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔhe no fow kɔ Bɛt-hogla, na otwa mu fa Bɛt-araba no kwaamu afamu; na ɔhe no fow kɔ Reuben ne babanyin Bohan ɔbo no ho:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔhe no fi Akor ɔbɔn mu fow kɔ Debir, na ɔdze no dɛmara kɔ kwaamu afamu, dze hwɛ Gilgal a ɔwɔ Adummim mfowee a ɔwɔ esutsen no no pomu afamu no tsentsendo no: na ɔhe no twa mu kɔ En-semes nsu no ho, na n’edzifir wɔ En-rogel:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔhe no fow fa Hinom ne babanyin no bɔnsa no mu dze kodu Jebusfo nkyɛnmu wɔ pomu afamu a ɔnoara nye Jerusalɛm: na ɔhe no fow kɔ bepɔw a ɔda Hinom ɔbɔn no enyim anee afamu a ɔwɔ Refaim ɔbɔn no n’ano noho ara wɔ kwaamu afamu n’etsifi:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔhe no hima fi bepɔw no etsifi kɔ Nefitoa nsu no no nsunyiwa ho, na ɔfow kɔ Efron bepɔw do nkurow no ho; na ɔhe no hima kɔ Baala a ɔnoara nye Kiriat-jearim:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔhe no dze dan fi Baala anee afamu kɔ bepɔw Seir ho, na otwa mu kɔ bepɔw Jearim ne nkyɛnmu wɔ kwaamu afamu a ɔnoara nye Kesalom, na osian kɔ Bɛt-semes, na otwa mu wɔ Timna ho:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔhe no dze pue kɔ Ekron nkyɛnmu kwaamu afamu: na ɔhe no hima kɔ Sikeron, na otwa mu kɔ bepɔw Baala ho, na ɔdze pue wɔ Jabneel; na ɔhe no n’edzifir wɔ po no ho.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na anee afamu ɔhe no nye po kɛse no, nye ne he. Iyi nye Judamba he a otwa hyia dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔmaa Jefune ba Kaleb kyɛfa wɔ Judamba no mu, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE ne mbrasɛm a ɔdze maa Josua no tse, mekyerɛ Kiriat-arba, Arba no a ɔyɛ Anak n’egya no a ɔnoara nye Hebron.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Kaleb tuu Anak ne mbabanyin baasa no fii hɔ, Sesai, nye Ahiman, nye Talmai, Anakmba no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ofi hɔ fowee kɔr Debir a nkan no na ne dzin nye Kiriat-Sefer no do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Kaleb see dɛ, Nyia ɔbɔbɔ Kiriat-sefer, na ɔagye no, ɔno na medze me babaa Aksa bɛma no ayewar.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Kaleb no nua Kenaz ne babanyin Otiniel, kɛgyee: na ɔdze ne babaa Aksa maa no ayewar.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a basia no baa ne nkyɛn no, Otiniel nunuu no dɛ ombisa n’egya hɔ haban bi; na aber a Aksa fi n’asoaso do dwirii no; Kaleb bisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na erohwehwɛ?
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ma me akyɛdze; sɛ edze me esi Pomu afamu asaase do a, nna ma me mbasu so. Na ɔdze etsifi mbasu nye anaafo mbasu no maa no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyi nye Judamba ebusuakuw no hɔn egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Judamba ebusuakuw no hɔn ano wɔ nkurow a odzi kɔ Edom he do wɔ Pomu afamu no nye Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur;
title: JOSHUA

text: Kina, Dimona, Adada;
title: JOSHUA

text: Kedes, Hazor, nye Itnan;
title: JOSHUA

text: Zif, nye Telem, Bealot;
title: JOSHUA

text: Hazor-hadata, Keriot-hezron a ɔnoara nye Hazor;
title: JOSHUA

text: Amam, Sema, Molada.
title: JOSHUA

text: Bi so nye Hazor-gada, Hesmon, Bɛt-pelet;
title: JOSHUA

text: Hazor-sual, Beer-seba, Biziotia;
title: JOSHUA

text: Baala, Iim, Ezem.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nkurow nkaa no nye Eltolad, Kesil, Horma;
title: JOSHUA

text: Ziklag, Madmanna, Sansanna;
title: JOSHUA

text: Lebaot, Silhim, Ain, nye Rimmon: nkurow no nyinara yɛ eduonu akron, ɔnye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Ɔbɔnmu nkurow no nye Estaol, Zora, Asna;
title: JOSHUA

text: Zanoa, En-gannim, Tappua, Enam;
title: JOSHUA

text: Jarmut, Adullam, Soko, Azeka;
title: JOSHUA

text: Saaraim, Adithaim, Gedera, nye Gederotaim; nkurow duanan ɔnye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na nkurow no bi so nye Zenan, Hadasa, Migdal-gad;
title: JOSHUA

text: Dilan, Mizpe, Jokteel;
title: JOSHUA

text: Lakis, Bozkat, Eglon;
title: JOSHUA

text: Kabbon, Lahman, Kitlis;
title: JOSHUA

text: Gederot, Bɛt-dagon, Naama, nye Makeda; nkurow duesia ɔnye no nkuraase.
