title: JOSHUA

text: Libna, Eter, Asan;
title: JOSHUA

text: Ifta, Asna, Nezib;
title: JOSHUA

text: Keila, Akizib nye Maresa; nkurow akron nye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Ekron, ɔnye no ho nkurow nye no nkuraase:
title: JOSHUA

text: ofi Ekron araa dze kodu po no ho, dza ɔwɔ Ashdod nkyɛnmu nyinara, ɔnye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Ashdod, no ho nkurow nye no nkuraase; Gaza, no ho nkurow nye no nkuraase; dze kodu Egypt ɔwora, nye po kɛse no, nye ne he ho.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nkokodo nkurow no, Samir, Jattir, Soko;
title: JOSHUA

text: Danna, Kiriat-sanna a ɔnoara nye Debir:
title: JOSHUA

text: Anab, Estemo, Anim;
title: JOSHUA

text: Gosen, Holon, Gilo; nkurow dubiako ɔnye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Arab, Duma, Esan;
title: JOSHUA

text: Janom, Bɛt-tappua, Afeka;
title: JOSHUA

text: Humta, nye Kiriat-arba a ɔnoara nye Hebron, nye Zior; nkurow akron ɔnye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Maon, Karmel, Zif, Juta;
title: JOSHUA

text: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoa;
title: JOSHUA

text: Kain, Gibea, nye Timna; nkurow du ɔnye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Halhul, Bɛt-zur, Gedor;
title: JOSHUA

text: Maarat, Bɛt-anot, Eltekon; nkurow esia ɔnye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Kiriat-baal a ɔnoara nye Kiriat-jearim, nye Rabaa; nkurow ebien nye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Sar no do nkurow no nye Bɛt-araba, Middin, Sekaka;
title: JOSHUA

text: Nibsan, Nkyen Kurow no nye Engedi; nkurow esia ɔnye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Jebusfo no dze, nkorɔfo a wɔtse Jerusalɛm no, Judamba enntum enntu hɔn: mbom Jebusfo no wɔnye Judamba no tsenaa Jerusalɛm dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josefmba kyɛfa no ɔdze pue fi Jeriko Jordan, wɔ Jeriko nsu ho wɔ boka afamu, mekyerɛ sar no a ɔdze fi Jeriko fow kodua nkokodo nkurow no mu kɔ Bɛtɛl no;
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔdze pue fi Bɛtɛl kɔ Luz, na otwa mu kɔ Arkifo he do wɔ Atarot;
title: JOSHUA

text: na osian anee afamu kɔ Jaflɛtefo he do, dze kodu anaafo Bɛt-horon he do, mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu Gezer: na n’edzifir wɔ po no ho.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyi nye Josefmba no, Manaasɛ nye Efraim, hɔn egyapadze.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Efraimmba no hɔn he, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee no nye yi: mekyerɛ hɔn egyapadze ne he wɔ boka afamu nye Atarot-addar, dze kodu etsifi Bɛt-horon;
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔhe no dze pue anee afamu wɔ Mikemetat wɔ kwaamu afamu; na ɔhe no dze dan fa boka afamu kɔ Tanaat-siloh, na otwa mu wɔ ho wɔ Janoa no boka afamu;
title: JOSHUA

text: na ofi Janoa sian kɔ Atarot, nye Naara, na okodu Jeriko, na ɔdze pue Jordan ho.
title: JOSHUA

text: Ɔhe no fi Tappua nam anee afamu dze kɔ Kana ɔwora no ho; na n’edzifir wɔ po no ho. Iyi nye Efraimmba ebusuakuw egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee;
title: JOSHUA

text: dze ka nkurow a woyiyii maa Efraimmba no wɔ Manaasɛmba egyapadze mu no ho, nkurow no nyinara nye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Naaso woenntu Keenanfo a wɔtse Gezer no: mbom Keenanfo no tsenaa Efraim finimfin dze bodu ndɛ da yi, na Efraimfo no hyɛɛ hɔn ma wɔyɛɛ ɔsom edwuma.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyi nye Manaasɛ n’ebusuakuw kyɛfa: osiandɛ ɔyɛ Josef n’abakan. Manaasɛ n’abakan Makir, Gilead n’egya no dze, osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔsabarimba no ntsi onyaa Gilead nye Basan.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na kyɛfa no yɛ Manaasɛmba nkaa no dze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee. Iyinom nye Abiezermba, Helekmba, Asrielmba, Sekemmba, Hefermba, nye Semidamba no dze: woyinom nye Josef babanyin Manaasɛ ne mbabanyin dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Zelofehad a n’egya nye Hefer a ɔyɛ Manaasɛ ne babanyin Makir ne babanyin no dze, oennya mbabanyin dɛ mbabaa ara nko: na iyinom nye ne mbabaa no hɔn edzin, Mahala, Noa, Hogla, Milka, nye Tirza.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔbaa ɔsɔfo Eleazar, na Nun babanyin Josua, nye mbapɔmba no enyim, dɛ, EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses dɛ ɔmma hɛn egyapadze wɔ hɛn nuanom mu: dɛm ntsi ɔmaa hɔn egyapadze wɔ hɔn egya no nuanom no mu dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE ne mbrasɛm no tse.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na nkyekyɛmu du kɔr Manaasɛ afamu, ɔsor Gilead nye Basan asaase a ɔwɔ Jordan egya no;
title: JOSHUA

text: osiandɛ Manaasɛ mbabaa no nyaa egyapadze wɔ ne mbabanyin no mu: na Gilead asaase no yɛɛ Manaasɛ mbabanyin nkaa no dze.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Manaasɛ ne he fi Aser kɔ Mikemetat (Mikmethath) a ɔwɔ Sekem enyim no; na ɔhe no dze nam enyimfa araa kodu Entapuafo ehyiae.
title: JOSHUA

text: Tappua asaase no yɛ Manaasɛ dze: na Tappua a ɔwɔ Manaasɛ he do no dze ɔyɛ Efraimmba no dze.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔhe no sian kɔ Kana ɔwora no ho, wɔ ɔwora no no pomu afamu: nkurow yi yɛ Efraim dze wɔ Manaasɛ no nkurow no mu: na Manaasɛ ne he no ɔwɔ ɔwora no no kwaamu afamu, na n’edzifir wɔ po no ho:
title: JOSHUA

text: pomu afamu no Efraim dze a, na kwaamu afamu no Manaasɛ dze a, na po no nye ne he; na okehyia Aser wɔ kwaamu afamu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Manaasɛ nyae wɔ Isakar nye Aser mu Bɛt-sean nye no ho nkurow, Ibleam nye no ho nkurow, nye hɔn a wɔtse Dor nye no ho nkurow, hɔn a wɔtse En-dor nye no ho nkurow, Taanak nye no ho nkurow, na hɔn a wɔtse Megiddo nye no ho nkurow, mekyerɛ akoko ebiasa no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Naaso Manaasɛmba enntum enntu hɔn a wɔtsetse nkurow no mu no; na Keenanfo no pɛɛ dɛ wɔtsena asaase no do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, Israelmba no ho yɛɛ dzen no, wɔhyɛɛ Keenanfo no ma wɔyɛɛ ɔsom edwuma mu, na mbom woenntu hɔn ase korakora.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josefmba no kaa kyerɛɛ Josua dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze egyapadze kyɛfa kor nye nkyekyɛmu kor pɛ ama me, w’enyiwa tua dɛ meyɛ ɔman kɛse, susuampa dɛ EWURADZE ehyira me araa dze ebodu ber yi?
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ ɔman kɛse a, nna fow kɔ kwaa no mu, na kobu hɔ fa ma woho wɔ Perizfo nye Refafo asaase no do; osiandɛ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no suar dodow ma wo.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josefmba no see dɛ, Nkokodo nkurow no nndɔɔ so mma hɛn: na Keenanfo a wɔtsetse ɔbɔn no n’asaase do nyinara wɔwowɔ dadze ntseaseanam, hɔn a wɔwɔ Bɛt-sean nye no ho nkurow nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Jezreel ɔbɔn no mu nyina.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua kasaa kyerɛɛ Josef fie, mekyerɛ Efraim nye Manaasɛ, dɛ, Ɔwo yɛ ɔman kɛse, na ewɔ tum kɛse: nnyɛ kyɛfa kor pɛ bi na ibenya:
title: JOSHUA

text: mbom nkokodo nkurow no nyɛ wodze; osiandɛ ɔyɛ kwaa mpo a, ɔwoara na ibobu, na n’edzifir bɛyɛ wodze: osiandɛ ibotu Keenanfo no, kaansa wɔwowɔ dadze ntseaseanam, na wɔyɛ dzen mpo a.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israelmba no nyinara poon hɔnho kehyiae wɔ Siloh, na wosii ehyiadzibuw no wɔ hɔ: na wɔberɛɛ asaase no adze wɔ hɔn enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔkaa Israelmba mu ebusuakuw esuon a wonnyae nnkyɛɛ hɔn egyapadze.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua bisaa Israelmba no dɛ, Hom rotwetwe homho araa ma ekodu aber bɛn ana hom akɔ akɛfa asaase a EWURADZE, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn, dze ama hom no?
title: JOSHUA

text: Hom ntutu hom mu nyimpa, ebusuakuw nyinara mu baasa baasa: na monsoma hɔn, ma wɔnsoɛr nkekyima asaase no mu, na wɔnkyerɛw no nwoma mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ hɔn egyapadze; na wɔmbra mo hɔ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔnkyɛ mu kyɛpɛn esuon: Juda ntsena ne he do wɔ kwaamu afamu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hom nkyerɛw asaase no kyɛpɛn esuon, na hom mfa nkyerɛwee no mbrɛ me ha: na montwe ho tonto mma hom wɔ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim ha.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Levifo no dze, wonnyi kyɛpɛn wɔ hom mu; osiandɛ EWURADZE asɔfodzi no nye hɔn egyapadze: na Gad nye Reuben nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no enya hɔn egyapadze wɔ Jordan egya boka afamu a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze maa hɔn no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na mbanyin no soɛree, na wɔkɔree: na Josua hyɛɛ hɔn a wɔrokɔ akɛkyerɛw asaase no dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkekyima asaase no mu, na wɔnkyerɛw, na wɔnsan mbra mo hɔ bio, na montwe ho tonto mma hom wɔ EWURADZE enyim ha wɔ Siloh.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na mbanyin no kɔree koduaduaa asaase no mu, na wɔkyerɛɛw no dɛ mbrɛ nkurow no tsetsee kyɛpɛn esuon wɔ nwoma mu, na wɔbaa Josua hɔ wɔ nsera mu wɔ Siloh.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua twee ho tonto maa hɔn wɔ Siloh wɔ EWURADZE enyim: na hɔ na Josua kyɛɛ asaase no maa Israelmba no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyekyɛmu tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Benjaminmba ebusuakuw kyɛfa no baa dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: na hɔn kyɛfa ne he fir edzi wɔ Judamba nye Josefmba ntamu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hɔn he wɔ kwaamu afamu, na ɔfow kodu nkokodo nkurow no mu wɔ anee afamu; na n’edzifir wɔ Bɛt-aven sar do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔhe no twa mu fi hɔ kɔ Luz, wɔ Luz ne nkyɛnmu a ɔnoara nye Bɛtɛl, pomu afamu; na ɔhe no dze sian kɔ Atarot-addar, wɔ bepɔw a ɔda anaafo Bɛt-horon no pomu afamu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔhe no hima na ɔdze dan kɔ anee afamu pomu afamu, dze fi bepɔw a ɔda Bɛt-horon enyim wɔ pomu afamu: na n’edzifir wɔ Kiriat-baal a ɔnoara nye Kiriat-jearim, Judamba kurow no bi a: anee afamu dze nye yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na pomu afamu dze fi Kiriat-jearim n’ano noho ara, na ɔhe no fir edzi wɔ anee afamu, na ɔdze fir kɔ Nefitoa nsu no no nsunyiwa ho:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔhe no sian kɔ bepɔw a ɔda Hinom babanyin ɔbɔn no a ɔwɔ Refafo ɔbɔn no no kwaamu afamu no n’enyim no n’ano noho ara; na osian kɔ Hinom ɔbɔn mu, wɔ Jebusfo nkyɛnmu pomu afamu, na osian kɔ En-rogel;
title: JOSHUA

text: na ohima kɔ kwaamu afamu, na opue wɔ En-semes, na ofir edzi kɔ Gelilot a ɔwɔ Adummim mfowee ne tsentsendo; na osian kɔ Reuben babanyin Bohan ɔbo no no ho;
title: JOSHUA

text: na otwa mu kesi nkyɛnmu wɔ Araba tsentsendo kwaamu afamu; na osian kodu Araba:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔhe no twa mu kɔ Bɛt-hogla nkyɛnmu kwaamu afamu: na ɔhe no n’edzifir wɔ Nkyen Po no no kwaamu afamu ewiei: iyi nye pomu afamu he.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Jordan nye ne he wɔ boka afamu. Iyi nye Benjaminmba egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ n’ahe tsetsee dze hyia, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Afei Benjaminmba ebusuakuw nkurow dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee no nye Jeriko, Bɛt-hogla, Emek-keziz;
title: JOSHUA

text: Bɛt-araba, Zemaraim, Bɛtɛl;
title: JOSHUA

text: Avim, nye Para; Ofra;
title: JOSHUA

text: Kefar-ammoni, Ofini, nye Geba; nkurow duebien ɔnye no nkuraase:
title: JOSHUA

text: Nkaa no nye Gibeon, Rama, Beerot;
title: JOSHUA

text: Mizpe, Kefira, Moza;
title: JOSHUA

text: Rekem, Irpeel, Tarala;
title: JOSHUA

text: Zela, Ha-elef, Jebus a ɔnoara nye Jerusalɛm, Gibeat, nye Kiriat; nkurow duanan ɔnye no nkuraase. Iyi nye Benjaminmba no egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na kyɛfa a otsia ebien no bae maa Simeonmba ebusuakuw no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: nye hɔn egyapadze wɔ Judamba egyapadze no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na dza wonyae yɛɛ hɔn egyapadze nye Beer-seba, anaadɛ Seba, Molada;
title: JOSHUA

text: Hazar-sual, Bala, Ezem;
title: JOSHUA

text: Eltolad, Betul, Horma;
title: JOSHUA

text: Ziklag, Bɛt-makabot, Hazar-susa;
title: JOSHUA

text: Bɛt-lebaot, nye Saruhen; nkurow duebiasa ɔnye no nkuraase:
title: JOSHUA

text: Ain, Rimmon, Eter, nye Asan; nkurow anan ɔnye no nkuraase:
title: JOSHUA

text: nye nkuroba a ɔdeda nkurow yi ho hyia nyinara dze kodu Baalat-beer, Pomu afamu Rama. Iyi nye Simeonmba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Judamba afamu dze no mu na Simeonmba egyapadze fi: osiandɛ Judamba kyɛpɛn no dɔɔ so dodow ma hɔn: dɛm ntsi Simeonmba nyaa egyapadze wɔ hɔn egyapadze no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na kyɛfa a otsia ebiasa no bae maa Zebulunmba dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee: na hɔn egyapadze ne he okodu Sarid:
title: JOSHUA

text: na hɔn he fow kɔ anee afamu, mekyerɛ Marala, na okodu Dabbeset; dze kodu ɔwora no a ɔwɔ Jokmeam enyim no;
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔdze dan fi Sarid boka afamu wɔ wipuei afamu dze kodu Kislɔt-tabor (Kislɔt-tabor) he do: na ofir edzi kɔ Daberat, na ɔfow kɔ Jafia;
title: JOSHUA

text: na hɔ na ofi kotwa mu wɔ boka afamu dze kɔ Gath-hefer dze kɔ Et-kazin; na ofir edzi wɔ Rimmon a ɔtsen dze kɔ Nea;
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔhe no dan fa ho wɔ kwaamu afamu dze kɔ Hannaton: na n’edzifir wɔ Ifta-el ɔbɔn no mu;
title: JOSHUA

text: nye Katat, Nahalal, Simron, Idala, nye Bɛtlɛhɛm: nkurow duebien nye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyi nye Zebulunmba egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow yi nye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Kyɛfa a otsia anan no bae maa Isakarmba no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hɔn he kodu Jezreel, Kesulɔt, Sunem;
title: JOSHUA

text: Hafaraim, Sion, Anaharat;
title: JOSHUA

text: Rabit, Kision, Ebez;
title: JOSHUA

text: Remet, Engannim, En-hadda, nye Bɛt-pazez;
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔhe no dze kodu Tabor, Sahazuma, nye Bɛt-semes; nye hɔn he a n’edzifir wɔ Jordan; nkurow duesia ɔnye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyi nye Isakarmba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow no ɔnye no nkurobaase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na kyɛfa a otsia enum no bae maa Asermba ebusuakuw dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hɔn he nye Helkat, Hali, Beten, Aksaf;
title: JOSHUA

text: Allam-melek, Amad nye Misal; na ɔdze kodu Karmel anee afamu, nye Sihor-libnat;
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔdze dan wipuei afamu kɔ Bɛt-dagon na okodu Zebulun, nye Ifta-el ɔbɔn mu wɔ kwaamu afamu dze kɔ Bɛt-emek nye Neiel; na ofir edzi kɔ Kabul wɔ bankum afamu,
title: JOSHUA

text: nye Ebron, Rehob, Hamon, Kana dze kɔ Zidon kɛse;
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔhe no dan kɔ Rama, na okodu Taere kurow a wɔagye ho ban no; na ɔsan dan kɔ Hosa; na n’edzifir wɔ Akizib mbew ho po no ho:
title: JOSHUA

text: Umma so, nye Afek, nye Rehob: nkurow eduonu ebien ɔnye no nkurobaase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyi nye Asermba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow yi ɔnye no nkurobaase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Kyɛfa a otsia esia no bae maa Naftalimba no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hɔn he fi Zaanannim esudur no ho, nye Adami-nekeb, nye Jabneel dze kɔ Lakum; na n’edzifir wɔ Jordan:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔhe no dan fa anee afamu kɔ Aznoth-tabor, na ɔdze fi hɔ pue Hukok; na okodu Zebulun wɔ pomu afamu, na okodu Aser wɔ anee afamu, na okodu Juda wɔ Jordan wipuei afamu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na nkurow a wɔagye ho ban no nye Zidim, Zer, Hama, Rakat, Kinneret;
title: JOSHUA

text: Adama, Rama, Hazor;
title: JOSHUA

text: Kedes, Edrei, En-hazor;
title: JOSHUA

text: Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Bɛt-anat, nye Bɛt-semes; nkurow duakron ɔnye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyi nye Naftalimba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Kyɛfa a otsia esuon no bae maa Danmba ebusuakuw dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hɔn egyapadze he nye Zora, Estaol, Ir-semes;
title: JOSHUA

text: Saalabbin, Aijalon, Itla;
title: JOSHUA

text: Elon, Timna, Ekron;
title: JOSHUA

text: Elteke, Gibeton, Baalat;
title: JOSHUA

text: Jehud, Bene-berak, Gat-rimmon;
title: JOSHUA

text: Me-jarkon, nye Rakon, na ɔhe no a ɔwɔ Jopa tsentsendo no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Danmba hɔn he no fir edzi tra hɔn: osiandɛ Danmba no fowee kɔree nye Lesem kɔkoe, na wɔgyee, na wɔdze afona bɔɔ no, na wɔfae, na wɔtsenaa mu, na wɔfrɛɛ Lesem dɛ Dan, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egya Dan ne dzin tse.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyi nye Danmba ebusuakuw egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, nkurow yi nye no nkuraase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wowiee asaase no kyɛ dze yɛɛ egyapadze dɛ mbrɛ n’ahe no tsetsee no; na Israelmba no dze egyapadze bi maa Nun ne babanyin Josua wɔ hɔn mu:
title: JOSHUA

text: dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE mbrasɛm tse no na wɔdze kurow a obisae no maa no, mekyerɛ Timnat-sera wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu: na ɔkyekyeer kurow no, na ɔtsenaa mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyi nye egyapadze a ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye Nun ne babanyin Josua, nye Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu egyanom efiefi etsitsir no, nam tontotwe do kyɛe wɔ Siloh wɔ EWURADZE enyim, wɔ ehyiadzibuw no n’abowano. Na wowiee asaase no mu kyɛ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Josua dɛ;
title: JOSHUA

text: Ka kyerɛ Israelmba no dɛ, Hom nyiyi guansumabew nkurow a menam Moses do kaa kyerɛɛ hom no:
title: JOSHUA

text: na obi a ɔnndze enyidaho na oboku nyimpa bi awerɛfir mu no nguan nkɔ hɔ: na ɔnyɛ hom guansumabew mfi bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no nsa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm nyimpa no nguan nkɔ nkurow no kor mu, na onkegyina kurow no n’abotsen ano, na ɔnka n’asɛm wɔ kurow no ne mpanyimfo asomu; na wɔmfa no nkɔ hɔn nkyɛn wɔ kurow no mu, na wɔmma no beebi ma ɔntsena wɔ hɔn mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na sɛ bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no tsiw ba a, ɔno mma wonnyi onyimpakumfo no nnhyɛ ne nsa; osiandɛ okum ne nyɛnko awerɛfir mu, na ɔnntan no dada bi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔntsena kurow no mu, nkodu dɛ obegyina amamfo no enyim agye atsɛmbu, nkodu dɛ ɔsɔfopanyin a ɔwɔ do dɛm mber no mu no bowu: na nkyii onyimpakumfo no nsan mbra nankasa no kurow a ofi mu guanee no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na woyiyii Kades wɔ Galilii wɔ Naftali nkokodo nkurow no mu, nye Sekem wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu, nye Kiriat-arba a ɔnoara nye Hebron wɔ Juda nkokodo nkurow no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Jeriko Jordan egya boka afamu no, woyii Bezer wɔ sar no do wɔ tɛtɛr no mu fii Reuben ebusuakuw mu, nye Ramot wɔ Gilead fi Gad ebusuakuw mu, nye Golan wɔ Basan fii Manaasɛ ebusuakuw mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyinom nye nkurow a woyiyii sisii hɔ maa Israelmba nyinara, nye ɔhɔho a ɔabɔsoɛ hɔn mu no, dɛ obiara a oku nyimpa bi wɔ ber a ɔnndze enyidaho no nguan nkɔ hɔ, na oeennwu wɔ bɔgya ho ɔwerdzinyi no nsamu, nkodu dɛ obegyina amamfo no enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Levifo egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no baa ɔsɔfo Eleazar, nye Nun ne babanyin Josua, nye Israelmba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no hɔ;
title: JOSHUA

text: na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ Siloh wɔ Keenan asaase do, dɛ, EWURADZE nam Moses nsa do hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmma hɛn nkurow ma yɛntsena mu, ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase mma hɛn fiembowa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israelmba no dze hɔn egyapadze no mu nkurow bi nye no ho mfikyisaase maa Levifo no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE mbrasɛm no tse.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na kyɛfa no bae maa Kohatfo ebusua ebusua, na ɔsɔfo Aaronmba no a wofi Levifo mu no, nam tontotwe do nyae fii Juda, Simeon nye Benjamin ebusuakuw mu nkurow duebiasa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Kohatmba nkaa no nam tontotwe do nyae fii Efraim, Dan, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no mu nkurow du.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Gersonmba no nam tontotwe do nyae fii Isakar, Aser, Naftali, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no a ɔwɔ Basan no mu, nkurow duebiasa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Merarimba dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee nyaa Reuben, Gad, nye Zebulun ebusuakuw mu nkurow duebien.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israelmba no nam tontotwe do dze nkurow yi nye no ho mfikyisaase maa Levifo no dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE nam Moses nsa do hyɛe no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔdze Judamba, nye Simeonmba ebusuakuw mu nkurow a wɔabobɔ edzin yi mae:
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔwɔ hɔ ma Aaronmba a wofi Kohat ebusua ebusua mu a wɔwɔ Levimba mu no: na hɔndze nye kyɛfa a odzi kan no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔdze Kiriat-arba maa hɔn, Arba no a ɔyɛ Anak n’egya no, a ɔnoara nye Hebron no, wɔ Juda nkokodo nkurow no mu, ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase a etwa ho ehyia no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na kurow no ho haban, nye no nkuraase no dze, wɔdze maa Jefune babanyin Kaleb dɛ n’enyadze.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔsɔfo Aaronmba no, wɔdze onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Hebron, nye Libna;
title: JOSHUA

text: Jattir, Estemoa;
title: JOSHUA

text: Holon, Debir;
title: JOSHUA

text: Ain, Juta, na Bɛt-semes nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; ebusuakuw ebien no mu nkurow akron.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Benjamin ebusuakuw mu dze nye Gibeon, Geba;
title: JOSHUA

text: Anathot, na Almon nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
title: JOSHUA

text: Aaronmba, asɔfo no, hɔn nkurow nyinara yɛ nkurow duebiasa nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Kohatmba, Levifo no, ebusua ebusua no, mekyerɛ Kohatmba nkaa no, wonyaa hɔn kyɛfa nkurow fi Efraim ebusuakuw mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔdze onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Sekem nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu maa hɔn, nye Gezer;
title: JOSHUA

text: Kibzaim, Bɛt-horon nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Dan ebusuakuw mu dze, Elteke, Gibeton;
title: JOSHUA

text: Aijalon, nye Gat-rimmon nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no mu dze, Taanak nye Gat-rimmon nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow ebien.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nkurow a ɔyɛ Kohatmba nkaa no hɔn ebusua ebusua no dze nyinara yɛ du nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Gersonmba a wofi Levi ebusua ebusua no mu no, wɔmaa hɔn Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no mu onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Golan wɔ Basan; nye Be-estera nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow ebien.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Isakar ebusuakuw mu dze, Kision, Daberat;
title: JOSHUA

text: Jarmut, nye En-gannim nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Aser ebusuakuw mu dze, Misal, Abdon;
title: JOSHUA

text: Helkat nye Rehob nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase, nkurow anan.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Naftali ebusuakuw mu dze, onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Kedes wɔ Galilii, nye ne mfikyisaase, Hamot-dor nye Kartan nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow ebiasa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Gersonfo nkurow nyinara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee yɛ nkurow duebiasa nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Merarimba ebusua ebusua, Levifo nkaa no, wɔmaa hɔn Zebulun ebusuakuw mu, Jokmeam, Karta,
title: JOSHUA

text: Dimna, nye Nahalal nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Reuben ebusuakuw mu dze, Bezer, Jahaz,
title: JOSHUA

text: Kedemot, nye Mefaat nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; nkurow anan.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Gad ebusuakuw mu dze, onyimpakumfo guansumabew kurow Ramot wɔ Gilead ɔnye no ho mfikyisaase, nye Mahanaim;
title: JOSHUA

text: Hesbon, nye Jazer nye hɔn ho mfikyisaase; ne nyinara yɛ nkurow anan.
title: JOSHUA

text: Iyi nyinara nye Merarimba nkurow dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, mekyerɛ Levifo ebusua ebusua nkaa no; na hɔn kyɛfa yɛ nkurow duebien.
title: JOSHUA

text: Levifo nkurow a ɔwɔ Israelmba hɔn enyadze mu nyinara yɛ nkurow eduanan awɔtwe nye no ho mfikyisaase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nkurow yi nyinara wowɔ mfikyisaase a abobɔ ho aprɔw: na nkurow yi nyinara mbrɛ ɔtsetsee ara nye no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna EWURADZE dze asaase a ɔkaa ho ntam dɛ ɔdze bɛma hom egyanom no nyinara maa Israel; na wɔfae, na wɔtsenaa do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE maa hɔn ahomgye hyiae, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom no nyinara: na hɔn atamfo nyinara mu obiara enntum enngyina hɔn enyim; EWURADZE yii hɔn atamfo nyinara hyɛɛ hɔn nsa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Asɛm papa biara a EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Israelfo no mu biribiara anntɔ famu: ne nyinara baa mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua frɛɛ Reubenfo, Gadfo, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no,
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom edzi dza EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze hyɛɛ hom no nyinara do, na hom etsie me ndze wɔ dza mehyɛɛ hom nyinara mu:
title: JOSHUA

text: hom nndaan hom nuanom nngyaa hɔ nda pii yi dze bodu ndɛ da yi, mbom hom edzi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne mbrasɛm no do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na afei EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze ahomgye ama hom nuanom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no: dɛm ntsi afei hom ndzi ndan, na hom nkɔ hom asesee mu wɔ hom kyɛfa asaase a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze maa hom wɔ Jordan egya no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Yie nko ara na hom nhwɛ ndzi mbrasɛm nye mbra no a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses dze hyɛɛ hom, dɛ hom ndɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, na hom nnantsew n’akwan nyinara mu, na hom ndzi ne mbransɛm nyinara do, na hom ntakyer no ho, na hom mfa hom akoma nyinara nye hom kra nyinara nsom no no do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua hyiraa hɔn, na ogyaa hɔn kwan: na wosii mu kɔr hɔn asesee mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Afei Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa kor no nna Moses ama hɔn egyapadze wɔ Basan: na ɔfa kor no so Josua maa hɔn bi wɔ hɔn nuanom mu wɔ Jordan egya anee afamu. Na aber a Josua rigya hɔn kwan ma wɔaakɔ hɔn asesee mu no, ohyiraa hɔn,
title: JOSHUA

text: na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Ahonyadze pii, nye fiembowa piigyan, dwetɛ, sika, boran, dadze, na ntar piigyan na hom mfa nsan nkɔ hom asesee mu; na hom nye hom nuanom nkyɛ hom atamfo asadze no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Reubenmba, Gadmba nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no sanee, na wofii Israelmba no nkyɛn wɔ Siloh a ɔwɔ Keenan asaase do sii mu kɔree, dɛ wɔrokɔ Gilead asaase do, wɔ hɔn enyadze asaase a woekenya no do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE mbrasɛm a ɔnam Moses nsa do no tse no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na aber a wodur Jordan ho mbew a ɔwɔ Keenan asaase do no do no, Reubenmba nye Gadmba nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no sii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ, afɔrmbukyia a wɔhwɛ a ɔso a.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israelmba nkaa no tsee dɛ wɔ dɛ, Hwɛ, Reubenmba, Gadmba nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no esi afɔrmbukyia wɔ Keenan asaase enyim tsentsendo, wɔ Jordan ho mbew no do, wɔ afa a ɔyɛ Israelmba afamu dze no do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na aber a Israelmba no tsee no, hɔn nyinara poon hɔnho hyiae wɔ Siloh, dɛ wontu hɔn do sa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israelmba no somaa ɔsɔfo Eleazar babanyin Finehas ma ɔkɔr Reubenmba, Gadmba, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no hɔ, wɔ Gilead asaase do;
title: JOSHUA

text: na mbapɔmba du ka no ho, Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu egya fie ɔbapɔmba kor; na hɔn nyinara yɛ egyanom efiefi do etsitsir wɔ Israel mpempem no mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wɔbaa Reubenmba, Gadmba, nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no nkyɛn, wɔ Gilead asaase do, na wɔnye hɔn kasaa dɛ,
title: JOSHUA

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE no dɔm nyina se nye yi, Ebɛn mfom na hom dze afom Israel Nyankopɔn yi, dɛ ndɛ da yi hom adan efi EWURADZE ekyir dzi, wɔ dɛ hom esi afɔrmbukyia ama homho, dze retsew EWURADZE do etua yi?
title: JOSHUA

text: Ana Peor emumuyɛ no a ɔdze ɔhaw baa EWURADZE no dɔm do ma mpo ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi ara hɛn ho nntsew wɔ mu no, suar dodoodow ma hɛn,
title: JOSHUA

text: ma ntsi ndɛ da yi hom adan efi EWURADZE ekyir dzi yi? Na ɔbɛba dɛ ɔnam dɛ hom retsew EWURADZE do etua ndɛ da yi ntsi, ɔkyena no bo bofuw Israelmba no nyina.
title: JOSHUA

text: Naaso sɛ hom enyadze asaase no ho nntsew a, ɔno hom ntwa mbra EWURADZE enyadze asaase a EWURADZE ntamadan si do no do, na wɔmbɛfa bi wɔ hɛn mu: na mbom mma hom nntsew etua wɔ hɛn do so, dɛ homara so risi afɔrmbukyia aka EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn n’afɔrmbukyia no ho.
title: JOSHUA

text: Ana nnyɛ Akan, Zera babanyin no, na ɔfomee wɔ adze a wɔadom no no mu, na ebufuw baa Israelmba no nyinara do no bi? Ana Akan no nkotsee na owui wɔ n’emumuyɛ no mu?
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Reubenmba, Gadmba nye Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no buaa Israel mpempem mu etsitsir no dɛ,
title: JOSHUA

text: EWURADZE, Otumfo Nyankopɔn no, EWURADZE, Otumfo Nyankopɔn no, ɔnoara na onyim, na Israel so bohu; sɛ ɔyɛ etuatsew mu o, sɛ mfom a yɛafom EWURADZE mu o, mma ɔwo nngye hɛn nkwa ndɛ da yi,
title: JOSHUA

text: dɛ yeesi afɔrmbukyia ama hɛnho dɛ yɛdze bɛdan efi EWURADZE ekyir dzi; anaadɛ yɛbɔbɔ do ɔhyew afɔr anaa edziban afɔr, anaa yɛbɔbɔ do asomdwee okum afɔr a, EWURADZE noara mbisa hɛn;
title: JOSHUA

text: na sɛ mbom nnyɛ ahwɛyie bi ntsi, na asɛm bi ntsi na yɛayɛ iyi a, dɛ, Daakye bi hom mba bɛka akyerɛ hɛn mba dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom nye EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn wɔ yɛ?
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE dze Jordan ayɛ ɔhe ato hɛn nye hom, Reubenmba nye Gadmba ntamu; hom nnyi kyɛfa wɔ EWURADZE mu: dɛm na hom mba bɛyɛ hɛn mba ma woeegyaa EWURADZE suro.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi na yɛsee dɛ, Wɔmma afei yensiesie hɛnho nsi afɔrmbukyia mma hɛnho, nnyɛ ɔhyew afɔr, na nnyɛ okum afɔr so ntsi a:
title: JOSHUA

text: na mbom dɛ ɔnyɛ dase wɔ hɛn nye hom ntamu, nye hɛn mbasantsen a wobedzi hɛn ekyir no ntamu, na yɛdze hɛn ɔhyew afɔr, na ɔnye hɛn okum afɔr, nye hɛn asomdwee afɔr, ayɛ EWURADZE edwuma no wɔ n’enyim; amma daakye bi hom mba aannse hɛn mba dɛ, Hom nnyi kyɛfa wɔ EWURADZE mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi na yɛsee dɛ, Ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ daakye bi wɔse hɛn anaa hɛn mbasantsen dɛm a, yɛbɛse dɛ, Hom nhwɛ EWURADZE afɔrmbukyia no ne saso a hɛn egyanom yɛe, nnyɛ ɔhyew afɔr ntsi, na nnyɛ okum afɔr so ntsi; mbom ɔyɛ dase wɔ hɛn nye hom ntamu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nyame mpa ngu dɛ yɛbɛtsew etua wɔ EWURADZE do, na yɛadan efi EWURADZE ekyir dzi ndɛ da yi, dɛ yebesi afɔrmbukyia abɔ do ɔhyew afɔr, edziban afɔr, anaa okum afɔr, aka EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn afɔrmbukyia a ɔwɔ ne ntamadan no enyim no ho.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na aber a ɔsɔfo Finehas, nye Israelmba no mu mbapɔmba no, mekyerɛ mpempem mu etsitsir a wɔka no ho no, tsee nsɛm a Reubenmba nye Gadmba nye Manaasɛmba no kae no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn enyisɔ dɛ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔsɔfo Eleazar ne babanyin Finehas see Reubenmba nye Gadmba, nye Manaasɛmba no dɛ, Ndɛ da yi na yeehu dɛ EWURADZE wɔ hom finimfin, osiandɛ hom mmfaa mfom yi mmfoom EWURADZE: afei na hom eyi Israelmba no efi EWURADZE nsamu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔsɔfo Eleazar ne babanyin Finehas, nye mbapɔmba no, sanee fi Reubenmba, nye Gadmba no nkyɛn wɔ Gilead asaase do, baa Keenan asaase do, Israelmba no nkyɛn, na wɔbɔbɔɔ hɔn amandzɛɛ.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na asɛm no yɛɛ Israelmba enyisɔ; na Israelmba hyiraa Nyankopɔn, na wɔannka bio dɛ worutu hɔn do sa, wɔakɛsɛɛ asaase a Reubenmba nye Gadmba tse do no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Reubenmba nye Gadmba frɛɛ afɔrmbukyia no Ed: Na, wɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ hɛn ntamu dase dɛ EWURADZE nye Nyankopɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda pii n’ekyir no, wɔ aber a EWURADZE maa Israel ahomgye wɔ hɔn atamfo a woetwa hɔn ho ehyia nyinara nsamu no, nna Josua ayɛ akɔdaa na oedzi mfe pii.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua kɛfrɛɛ Israel nyinara, hɔn mpanyimfo nye hɔn etsitsir, nye hɔn atsɛmbuafo nye hɔn ahwɛdofo, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mayɛ akɔdaa na medzi mfe pii:
title: JOSHUA

text: na hom ehu dza osian hom ntsi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze ayɛ amanaman yi nyinara; na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn no, ɔnoara na ɔako ama hom.
title: JOSHUA

text: Hom nhwɛ, medze tontotwe akyɛ amanaman a wɔaka yi mu ama hom, dɛ ɔnyɛ egyapadze mma hom ebusuakuw ebusuakuw, ofi Jordan ho, nye amanaman a metwitwa hɔn egu nyinara, mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu po kɛse no ho ɔdze kɔ witɔree no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, no na obosunsun hɔn efi hom enyim, na oetu hɔn efi hom enyi do; na hom afa hɔn asaase dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn kaa kyerɛɛ hom no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nnya akokodur papaara dɛ wɔbɔhwɛ na wɔayɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra nwoma no mu nyinara, dɛ hom nnkɛdan efi ho akɔ enyimfa anaa abankum;
title: JOSHUA

text: dɛ hom nnkɔkɔ amanaman yi a wɔakeka hom mu yi mu. Nkyii so mma hom mmbɔ hɔn enyame dzin, na mma hom mmfa hɔn nndzi nsew so, nkyii so mma hom nnsom hɔn, na hom mmbobɔ hom mu adze mma hɔn so:
title: JOSHUA

text: mbom hom ntakyer EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ho, dɛ mbrɛ hom ayɛ dze ebodu ndɛ da yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na EWURADZE etu amanaman akɛse a wɔyɛ dzen efi hom enyim: na hom dze, nyimpa bi nngyinaa hom enyim dze ebodu ndɛ da yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Hom mu nyimpa baako betsiw apem: na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn no, ɔnoara na ɔko ma hom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hom no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie papaara, dɛ hom bɔdɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Ɔno dze sɛ hom nam ɔkwan biara do san ekyir, na hom dze homho kɛbata amanaman nkaa yi ho, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔakeka hom mu yi ho, na hom nye hɔn dzi awarwar, na hom kɔ hɔn nkyɛn, na hɔn so ba hom nkyɛn a:
title: JOSHUA

text: ɔnodze hom nhu ara ampa dɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn rennda ho nntu amanaman yi mmfi hom enyi do; mbom wɔbɛyɛ efir ama hom, nye mpire wɔ hom mfemu, na nsoɛ wɔ hom enyiwa mu, ekodu dɛ hom bɛsɛɛ efi asaase pa yi a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze ama hom yi do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na, hwɛ, ndɛ da yi morokɔ adasa nyinara kwan no bi: na hom nyim wɔ hom akoma nyinara mu nye hom akra nyinara mu dɛ asɛm kor nntɔɔ famu wɔ nsɛm pa a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn kae wɔ hom ho no nyinara mu; ne nyinara aba mu ama hom, no mu asɛm kor mpo anntɔ famu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ nsɛm papa nyinara a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn kaa kyerɛɛ hom no aba hom do no, dɛmara so na EWURADZE dze nsɛm bɔn nyinara bɛba hom do, ekodu dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ hom efi asaase pa yi a EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn dze ama hom yi do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Sɛ hom to EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ahyɛmu a ɔdze hyɛɛ hom no, na hom kɔ kɔsom enyame fofor na hom bɔ hom mu adze ma hɔn a; ɔno EWURADZE n’ebufuw bɛdzɛw hom do, na ɔasɛɛ hom ntsɛm efi asaase pa no a ɔdze ama hom no do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua poon Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara hyiaa Sekem, na ɔkɛfrɛɛ Israel mpanyimfo, nye hɔn etsitsir, nye hɔn ntsɛmbuafo, nye hɔn ahwɛdofo no; na wokehyiae wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see ɔman no nyinara dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, Esu no n’egya na tsetseberdo no hom egyanom tsenae, mekyerɛ Tera, Abraham nye Nahor hɔn egya no: na wɔsoom enyame bi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na miyii hom egya Abraham fii Esu no n’egya na migyaa no faa Keenan asaase nyinara mu, na memaa n’asefo dɔree, na medze Isaak maa no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na medze Jakob nye Esau maa Isaak: na medze bepɔw Seir maa Esau, dɛ ɔmfa; na Jakob nye ne mba no sianee kɔr Egypt.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na mosomaa Moses nye Aaron, na mehaaw Egypt, dɛ mbrɛ dza meyɛe no wɔ mu no tse no: na n’ekyir no miyii hom puei.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na miyii hom egyanom fii Egypt: na hom baa po no ho: na Egyptfo dze ntseaseanam, na ɔnye mpɔnkɔdofo tsiiw hom egyanom baa Mbɛw Po no ho.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na aber a wɔkekaa mu frɛɛ EWURADZE no, ɔdze sum hyɛɛ hom nye Egyptfo no ntamu, na ɔdze po no baa hɔn do bɛkataa hɔn do; na hom enyiwa hun dza meyɛe no wɔ Egypt: na hom tsenaa sar no do nda pii.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na medze hom baa Amorifo a wɔtse Jordan egya no asaase do; na wɔnye hom koe: na medze hɔn hyɛɛ hom nsa, na hom faa hɔn asaase no fae; na mesɛɛ hɔn wɔ hom enyim.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Zipor babanyin, Moabhen no, soɛree nye Israel koe: na ɔsomae ma wokehyiaa Beor babanyin Balaam dɛ ɔmbɛpaa hom:
title: JOSHUA

text: na mammpɛ dɛ mibetsie Balaam; dɛm ntsi nhyira ara na ohyiraa hom: nna miyii hom fii ne nsamu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na hom twaa Jordan, na wɔbaa Jeriko: na Jeriko mbarimba nye hom koe, Amorifo, Perizfo, Keenanfo, Hitifo, Girgasfo, Hivifo, nye Jebusfo; na miyii hɔn hyɛɛ hom nsa.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na mosomaa nkotokrodo ma wodzii hom enyim, ma wɔpaam hɔn fii hom enyim, mekyerɛ Amorifo ahemfo beenu no; nnyɛ w’afona a, na nnyɛ w’egyen so a.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na memaa hom asaase a hom annyɛ do edwuma, nye nkurow a nnyɛ hom bi kyekyeree, na hom tse mu; wenyin nture nye ngodua nture a ɔnnyɛ hom na hom tsetsɛwee naaso hom dzi yi.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi afei hom nsuro EWURADZE, na hom nsom no turododo nye nokwar mu: na hom ntow enyame a hom egyanom somee wɔ Esu no n’egya, nye Egypt no ngu; na hom nsom EWURADZE.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na sɛ ɔyɛ hom enyi do dɛ omuo dɛ hom bɔsom EWURADZE a, ɔno ndɛ da yi hom nsan mu nyi nyia hom bɔsom no; sɛ enyame a hom egyanom somee a wɔwɔ Esu no n’egya no o, Amorifo a hom tse hɔn asaase do yi enyame o: na emi nye me fi dze, yɛbɔsom EWURADZE.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔman no buae na wɔsee dɛ, Nyame mpa ngu dɛ yɛbɔpow EWURADZE, akɔsom enyame bi;
title: JOSHUA

text: na EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn, ɔnoara nye nyia oyii hɛn nye hɛn egyanom wɔ Egypt asaase do, wɔ nkowaasom fi no mu, na ɔyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze akɛse no wɔ hɛn enyim mu, na ɔbɔɔ hɛn ho ban wɔ ɔkwan a yɛnam mu no nyinara mu, nye aman a yetwaa mu wɔ hɔn mu no nyinara mu:
title: JOSHUA

text: na EWURADZE paam aman no nyinara wɔ hɛn enyim, Amorifo a wɔtse asaase no do no mpo: dɛm ntsi hɛn so yɛbɔsom EWURADZE; na ɔno nye hɛn Nyankopɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see ɔman no dɛ, Oho, Hom runntum nnsom EWURADZE; osiandɛ ɔyɛ Nyame krɔnkrɔn; ɔyɛ Nyame nyinkufo; ɔremmfa hom mbrato nye hom bɔn so nnkyɛ hom.
title: JOSHUA

text: Sɛ hom pow EWURADZE, na wɔsom enyame ananaben a, ɔno ɔayɛ hom papa n’ekyir no, ɔbɛdan ayɛ hom bɔn, na ɔahyew hom.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔman no see Josua dɛ, Dabida; EWURADZE ara na yɛbɔsom no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see ɔman no dɛ, Homara nye hom ho adasefo dɛ hom asan mu afa EWURADZE dɛ hom bɔsom no. Na wɔsee dɛ, Yɛyɛ adasefo.
title: JOSHUA

text: Dɛm ntsi, ɔsee dɛ, afei hom ntow enyame ananaben a wɔwɔ hom mu no ngu, na hom ndan hom akoma mma EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔman no see Josua dɛ, EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn na yɛbɔsom no, na ne ndze na yebetsie.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua nye ɔman no dzii ahyɛmu da no ara na ɔdze ahyɛdze nye mbra hyɛɛ hɔn wɔ Sekem.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua kyerɛɛw nsɛm yi wɔ Nyankopɔn ne mbra nwoma no mu: na ɔfaa ɔbo kɛse, na ɔdze sii hɔ wɔ esudur a osi EWURADZE no krɔnkrɔn bea no ho no ase.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josua see ɔman no nyinara dɛ, Wɔnhwɛ o, ɔbo yi bɛyɛ hɛn ɔdasefo: osiandɛ ɔatse EWURADZE ne nsɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɛn no nyinara: dɛm ntsi ɔnyɛ hom ɔdasefo, amma hom ammpow hom Nyankopɔn.
title: JOSHUA

text: Nna Josua gyaa ɔman no kwan, ma nyimpa biara kɔr n’egyapadze ho.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyinom ekyir no, Josua Nun ne babanyin no, EWURADZE n’akowaa no, wui, nna oedzi mfe ɔha nye du.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na wosiee no wɔ n’asaase he do wɔ Timnat-sera a ɔwɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow mu no wɔ bepɔw Gaas no kwaamu afamu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Israel soom EWURADZE Josua ne nda nyinara, nye mpanyimfo a Josua wui gyaa hɔn, na wohun EWURADZE n’edwuma nyinara a ɔyɛe maa Israel no, hɔn nda nyinara mu.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Josef mbiew a Israelmba dze fi Egypt bae no wosiee no wɔ Sekem, wɔ asaasetɔw a Jakob tɔɔ no wɔ Sekem n’egya Hamor ne mbabanyin no hɔ maa ndwetɛbona ɔha no mu: na ɔbɛyɛɛ Josefmba no egyapadze.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na Aaron ne babanyin Eleazar wui; na wosiee no wɔ ne babanyin Finehas koko a wɔdze maa no wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow mu no do.
title: JOSHUA

text: Na judua no wu ekyir no, Israelmba bisaa EWURADZE dɛ, Woana na ondzi kan ntu nkɔ Keenanfo do nye hɔn nkɔko mma hɛn?
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE buaa dɛ, Juda ntu nkɔ: hwɛ medze asaase no ahyɛ ne nsa.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Juda see no nua Simeon dɛ, Enye me nkɔ me kyɛfa mu, ma yɛnye Keenanfo nkɔko; na mo so menye wo bɔkɔ wo kyɛfa mu. Na Simeon nye no kɔree.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Juda tui kɔree: na EWURADZE dze Keenanfo nye Perizfo no hyɛɛ hɔn nsa: na wokum hɔn mu nyimpa mpem du wɔ Bezek.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wohun Adoni-bezek wɔ Bezek: na wɔnye no koe, na wokum Keenanfo nye Perizfo no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Adoni-bezek guanee; na wotsiiw no, na kɛkyeer no wotwitwaa ne nsa kokrobetsir na n’anansɔba kokonyin.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Adoni-bezek see dɛ Ahemfo eduosuon a hɔn nsa kokrobetsir na hɔn anansɔba kokonyin etwitwa no tasetasee hɔn edziban wɔ mo pon ase: na dza meyɛe no, dɛmara so na Nyankopɔn ama me ho akatua yi. Na wɔdze no baa Jerusalɛm, na hɔ na owui.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Judamba no nye Jerusalɛm koe, na wɔgyee, na wɔdze anomu bɔɔ no, na wɔtoo kurow no mu gya.
title: JUDGES

text: Na n’ekyir no Judamba no kɔree kɛnyee Keenanfo a wɔtse nkokodo nkurow mu, na Pomu afamu, na ɔbɔnmu nkurow mu no koe.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Juda kɔr Keenanfo a wɔtse Hebron no do: nkyɛ nkan no nna Hebron ne dzin nye Kiriat-arba na wɔbɔɔ Sesai, na Ahiman, na Talmai.
title: JUDGES

text: Na hɔ na wofi kɔr Debirfo do. Afei Debir nkyɛ nkan no ne dzin nye Kiriat-sefer.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Kaleb see dɛ, Nyia ɔbɔbɔ Kiriat-sefer, na ɔbɛgye no medze me babaa Aksa bɛma no awar.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Kaleb no nua kuma Kenaz ne babanyin Otiniel kɛgyee; na ɔdze ne babaa Aksa maa no ayewar.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a basia no kɔr ne nkyɛn no, Otiniel dɛfɛdɛfɛɛw no dɛ ombisa n’egya hɔ haban bi; na aber a Aksa fi n’asoaso do dwirii no; Kaleb bisaa no dɛ, Erohwehwɛ ebɛnadze?
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ma me akyɛdze; sɛ edze me esi Pomu afamu asaase do a, nna ma me mbasu so ɛ. Na Kaleb dze etsifi mbasu na anaafo mbasu no maa no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Moses n’asew, Kennyi no ne mba no nye Judamba fi nkyiresua kurow no mu fowee kɔr Juda sar a ɔwɔ Arad pomu afamu no do; na wɔkɔree kɛnyee ɔman no tsenae.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Juda nye no nua Simeon kɔree, na wokokum Keenanfo a wɔtse Zefat no, na wɔsɛɛ no pasapasa. Na wɔfrɛɛ kurow no ne dzin Horma.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Juda kɛgyee Gaza nye ne he, na Ashkelon nye ne he, na Ekron nye ne he.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE dzii Juda n’ekyir; na otuu nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ nkokodo nkurow mu no; na hɔn a wɔwɔ ɔbɔn no mu no dze, oenntum enntu hɔn, osiandɛ nna wɔwɔ dadze ntseaseanam.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔdze Hebron maa Kaleb, dɛ mbrɛ Moses kae no: na otuu Anak mbabanyin baasa no fii hɔ.
title: JUDGES

text: Naaso Benjaminmba no enntu Jebusfo a wɔtse Jerusalɛm no: mbom Jebusfo no nye Benjaminmba no tsenaa Jerusalɛm araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: JUDGES

text: Na judef fi no so fowee kɔr Bɛtɛl do: na EWURADZE dzii hɔn ekyir.
title: JUDGES

text: Na judef fi no somae ma wɔkɛseraa Bɛtɛl. Nkan no nkyɛ kurow no ne dzin nye Luz.
title: JUDGES

text: Na aserafo no hun banyin bi a ofi kurow no mu epue, na wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛserɛ wo, kyerɛ hɛn kurow no mu kwan, na yɛnye wo bedzi no yie.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔkyerɛɛ hɔn kurow no mu kwan, na wɔdze afona bɔɔ kurow no: mbom banyin no na n’ebusuafo nyinara dze, wogyaa hɔn.
title: JUDGES

text: Na banyin no kɔr Hitifo asaase do, na ɔkɛkyekyeer kurow, na ɔtoo no dzin Luz: ɔno nye ne dzin araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Manaasɛ enntu nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ Bɛt-sean na no nkuraase, na Taanak a wɔwɔ Dor na no nkuraase, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Ibleam na no nkuraase, na hɔn a wɔwɔ Megiddo na no nkuraase: na Keenanfo no dze, wɔpɛɛ dɛ wɔtsena asaase no do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Israel hɔn ho yɛɛ dzen no, wɔhyɛɛ Keenanfo no ma wɔyɛɛ ɔsom edwuma, na mbom woenntu hɔn ase korakora.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Efraim enntu Keenanfo a wɔtse Gezer no; na Keenanfo no tsenaa hɔn mu wɔ Gezer.
title: JUDGES

text: Zebulun enntu Kitronfo, na Na-halolfo no so; na Keenanfo no tsenaa hɔn mu na Zebulunfo no hyɛɛ hɔn ma wɔbɛyɛɛ ɔman a wɔyɛ ɔsom edwuma.
title: JUDGES

text: Aser enntu hɔn a wɔtsetse Ako, anaa hɔn a wɔtsetse Zidon, na Ahlab, na Akizib, na Helba, na Afik, na Rehob:
title: JUDGES

text: na Aserfo no tsenaa Keenanfo no mu, asaase no do atsefo no a: osiandɛ woenntu hɔn.
title: JUDGES

text: Naftali enntu hɔn a wɔtsetse Bɛt-semes, anaa hɔn a wɔtsetse Bɛt-anat no; mbom ɔtsenaa Keenanfo no mu, asaase no do atsefo no a: naaso hɔn a wɔtsetse Bɛt-semes na Bɛt-anat no bɛyɛɛ ɔman a wɔyɛ ɔsom edwuma wɔ nhyɛ do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Amorifo no kaa Danmba no kɔr nkokodo nkurow no mu: na wɔammpɛ dɛ wɔma hɔn kwan ma wosian ba ɔbɔn no mu:
title: JUDGES

text: na Amorifo no pɛɛ dɛ wɔtsena bepɔw Heres do wɔ Aijalon, na Saalbim: naaso judef fi no ne nsa daa hɔn do, ma wɔhyɛɛ hɔn ma wɔbɛyɛɛ ɔman a wɔyɛ ɔsom edwuma wɔ nhyɛ do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Amorifo he no fi Akrabbim mfowee, ofi ɔbotan no ho dze kɔ enyim no ho.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe fi Gilgal baa Bokim (Bokim). Na ɔsee dɛ, Mara na memaa hom fi Egypt firii na medze hom aba asaase a mekaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hom egyanom no do, na mesee dɛ, Moronnto menye hom ntamu ahyɛmu no dabiarada:
title: JUDGES

text: na mma hom nnye asaase yi do atsefo no nndzi ahyɛmu: hom mbubu hɔn afɔrmbukyia no: naaso hom enntsie me ndze: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ayɛ iyi?
title: JUDGES

text: Dɛm ntsi na mo so mesee dɛ, murunntu hɔn mmfi hom enyim; mbom wɔbɛyɛ dɛ nsoɛ wɔ hom mfemu, na hɔn enyame ayɛ efir ama hom.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a EWURADZE no bɔfoe no kaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Israelmba no nyinara no, ɔman no maa hɔn ndze do na wosui.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin Bokim ase nye Nyinsuwakyifo: na wɔbɔɔ okum afɔr wɔ hɔ maa EWURADZE.
title: JUDGES

text: Afei aber a judua gyaa ɔman no kwan no, Israelmba mu nyimpa biara kɔr n’egyapadze do dɛ ɔrekɛfa asaase no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔman no soom EWURADZE judua ne nda nyinara, na mpanyimfo a judua wui gyaa hɔn no a wohun ndwuma akɛse nyinara a EWURADZE yɛe maa Israel no hɔn nda nyinara.
title: JUDGES

text: Na judua Nun ne babanyin no, EWURADZE n’akowaa no wui, nna oedzi mfe ɔha nye du.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wokesiee no wɔ n’asaase he do wɔ Timnat-heres, wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow mu, wɔ bepɔw Gaas no kwaamu afamu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ebusuasantsen no nyinara so kɛkaa hɔn egyanom ho wɔ nsamankyir: na afei ebusuasantsen fofor so soɛree dzii hɔn ekyir a nna wonnyim EWURADZE, na dwuma a odzii maa Israel no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, na wɔsoom Baalim:
title: JUDGES

text: na wɔpoow EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no a oyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do no, na wokedzii enyame fofor a wofi aman a wɔabɔ hɔn ho aprɔw no hɔn enyame no mu ekyir, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze maa hɔn, na woyii EWURADZE ebufuw.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔpoow EWURADZE, na wɔsoom Baal na Astarot.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛɛw Israel do, na oyii hɔn hyɛɛ afowfo a wɔfoow hɔn nsa, na ɔtɔɔn hɔn dze hyɛɛ hɔn atamfo a wɔabɔ hɔn ho aprɔw no nsa, ma woenntum enngyina hɔn atamfo enyim bio.
title: JUDGES

text: Beebiara a wopuei kɔree no, EWURADZE ne nsa nye hɔn dzii no bɔn, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kae no, na dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kaa ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn no: na hɔn ho hiahiaa hɔn yie.
title: JUDGES

text: Naaso EWURADZE maa banodzifo do ma wɔgyee hɔn nkwa fii hɔn a wɔfoom hɔn fae no nsamu.
title: JUDGES

text: Iyi nyinara ekyir no, woenntsie hɔn banodzifo no, na wodzii enyame fofor ekyir ndwamanyɛ mu, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze maa hɔn: ntsɛmara na wɔdanee fii ɔkwan a hɔn egyanom nantseew do tsiee EWURADZE mbransɛm no do; hɔn dze, wɔannyɛ dɛm.
title: JUDGES

text: Na sɛ EWURADZE ma banodzifo do ma hɔn a, nna EWURADZE edzi banodzinyi no ekyir, na ɔagye hɔn efi hɔn atamfo no nsamu wɔ banodzinyi no ne nda nyinara mu: na osian hɔn apensi a ɔnam hɔn a wɔhaaw hɔn na woyii hɔn ahomtsew do no ntsi ɔyɛɛ EWURADZE yaw.
title: JUDGES

text: Naaso ɔbaa dɛ sɛ banodzinyi no wu a, wɔdan san ekyir, na wɔsɛɛ sen hɔn egyanom, dɛ wokedzi enyame fofor ekyir som hɔn, na wɔbɔ hɔn mu adze ma hɔn; woenngyaa hɔn ndzeyɛɛ no, na woemmfi hɔn akɔnkye kwan do so.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛɛw wɔ Israel do; na ɔsee dɛ, Osiandɛ ɔman yi ato m’ahyɛmu a mehyɛɛ hɔn egyanom, na woenntsie me ndze ntsi;
title: JUDGES

text: emi so ɔdzekɔr yi murunntu amanaman a judua wui daan hɔn gyae no mu biara bio:
title: JUDGES

text: ma medze hɔn asɔ Israel ahwɛ, kyerɛ dɛ wɔbɔhwɛ EWURADZE no kwan no anantsew do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom hwɛe no, anaa oho.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna EWURADZE gyaa amanaman no, ɔammpɛ ntsɛm enntu hɔn; nkyii so oennyi hɔn annhyɛ judua ne nsa.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Abimelek n’ekyir no, Tola a ɔyɛ Pua a n’egya nye Dodo ne ba no, na ɔsoɛree bɛgyee Israel. Ɔyɛ Isakarnyi, na ɔtsenaa Samir wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na odzii Israel enyim mfe eduonu ebiasa, na owui, na wosiee no wɔ Samir.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔno n’ekyir no Gileadnyi Jair soɛree; na odzii Israel enyim mfe eduonu ebien.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔwɔ mbabanyin eduasa a wɔtsenatsenaa nsoasopɔnkɔmba eduasa do, na wonyaa nkurow eduasa a wɔfrɛ no Havot-jair dze bodu ndɛ da yi a ɔwɔ Gilead asaase do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Jair wui, na wosiee no wɔ Kamon.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Israelmba yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do bio, na wɔsoom Baalim, na Astarot, na Siria enyame, na Zidon enyame, na Moab enyame, na Ammonmba enyame, na Filistiafo enyame; na wɔpoow EWURADZE na wɔannsom no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Israel do, na ɔtɔɔn hɔn hyɛɛ Filistiafo, na Ammonmba nsa.
title: JUDGES

text: Na woyii Israelmba ahomtsew na wɔhaaw hɔn afe noara mu: mfe duawɔtwe na wɔdze haaw Israelmba a wɔwɔ Jordan egya wɔ Amorifo asaase a ɔwɔ Gilead no nyinara do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Ammonmba no botwaa Jordan dɛ wɔnye Juda, na Benjamin, na Efraim fie so rokɔko; na dɛm ntsi Israel no ho hiahiaa no dodoodow.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Israelmba no sui frɛɛ EWURADZE, dɛ, Yɛayɛ bɔn etsia wo, dɛ yɛapow hɛn Nyankopɔn, na yɛasom Baalim.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE see Israelmba no dɛ, Ana manngye hom emmfi Egyptfo, na Amorifo, na Ammonmba, na Filistiafo nsamu?
title: JUDGES

text: Zidonfo, na Amalekfo, na Moabfo so haaw hom; na hom sui frɛɛ me, na megyee hom fii hɔn nsamu.
title: JUDGES

text: Naaso hom apow me, na wɔakɔsom enyame fofor: dɛm ntsi mennkɛgye hom bio.
title: JUDGES

text: Hom nkɔ nkosu mfrɛ enyame a hom asan mu eyiyi hɔn no; wɔmma wɔngye hom wɔ hom ahohiahia aber mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Israelmba no see EWURADZE dɛ, Yɛayɛ bɔn: biribiara a oye wɔ w’enyi do no fa yɛ hɛn: ɔgye nko na yɛserɛ wo dɛ gye hɛn ndɛ da yi.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔtotoow enyame ananaben no fii hɔn mu gui, na wɔsoom EWURADZE: na Israel amandzehu no yɛɛ ne kra awerɛhow.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Ammonmba no boaa ano, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Gilead. Na Israelmba no poon hɔnho hyiae, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Mizpa.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔman no, Gilead etsitsir no, sesee hɔnho nkorkor dɛ, Ɔbarimba mmuana na obedzi kan nye Ammonmba no ako? Ɔno na wɔmma ɔnyɛ otsitsir wɔ Gileadfo nyinara do.
title: JUDGES

text: Afei Gileadnyi Jefta yɛ ɔbarimba katakyi a ɔyɛ ndam, na ɔyɛ ɔbaa huhunyi bi ne ba: na n’egya nye Gilead.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Gilead ne yer woo mbabanyin maa no, na aber a ne yer ne mbabanyin no nyinii no, wɔpaam Jefta, na wɔsee no dɛ, Mma nndzi adze wɔ hɛn egya fie; osiandɛ ɔsor ɔbaa a ɔwoo wo.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Jefta guanee fii no nuanom nkyɛn, na ɔkɛtsenaa Tob asaase do: na akwasampafo bi boaa hɔn ano kɛkaa Jefta ho, na wɔnye no puei.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ n’ekyir mber kakra, nna Ammonmba tuu Israel do sa.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ammonmba tuu Israel do sa no, Gilead mpanyimfo sii mu kɔree kɛfaa Jefta wɔ Tob asaase no do;
title: JUDGES

text: na wɔsee Jefta dɛ, Bra bɛyɛ hɛn sahen, ma yɛnye Ammonmba nkɔko.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Jefta bisaa Gilead mpanyimfo no dɛ, Ana nnyɛ homara na wokyiir me, na wɔpaam me fii m’egya fie no bi a? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na afei a hom wɔ ahohia mu yi dze hom reba me nkyɛn yi?
title: JUDGES

text: Na Gilead mpanyimfo no see Jefta dɛ, Dɛm ntsi na afei yɛadan aba wo nkyɛn bio yi, ama enye hɛn aakɔ, ma yɛnye Ammonmba aakɔko, na ɔwoara yɛ hɛn tsitsir wɔ Gileadmba nyinara do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Jefta see Gilead mpanyimfo no dɛ, Sɛ hom dze me san kɔ fie bio ma menye Ammonmba kɔko, na EWURADZE yi hɔn ma wɔ m’enyim a, emi na mebɛyɛ hom mu tsitsir anaa?
title: JUDGES

text: Na Gilead mpanyimfo no see Jefta dɛ, EWURADZE nyɛ hɛn ntamu ɔdasefo; ampaara dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse no dɛmara so na yɛbɛyɛ.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Jefta nye Gilead mpanyimfo no sii mu kɔree, na ɔman no yɛɛ no hɔn do tsitsir na hɔn sahen: na Jefta kaa ne nsɛm nyinara wɔ EWURADZE enyim wɔ Mizpa.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Jefta tuu abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Ammonmba ɔhen no hɔ, dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ewɔ nye me yɛ, na aba mo do nye m’asaase robɔko yi?
title: JUDGES

text: Na Ammonmba ɔhen no buaa Jefta n’abɔfoe no dɛ, Osiandɛ aber a Israel fi Egypt reba no, ɔfaa m’asaase, ofi Ammon araa dze kodu Jabbok, na Jordan do: dɛm ntsi dan asaase no ma me foo.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Jefta tuu abɔfo bio ma wɔkɔr Ammonmba no hɔ:
title: JUDGES

text: na ɔkɛsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ Jefta se nye yi: Israel ammfa Moab asaase, na Ammonmba asaase so bi:
title: JUDGES

text: mbom aber a wofi Egypt bae no, na Israel nantseew sar no do kodur Mbɛw Po no ho, na wɔbaa Kades no;
title: JUDGES

text: nna Israel tuu abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Edomhen hɔ, dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma muntwa mu wɔ w’asaase do: na Edomhen no enntsie. Na dɛmara so na ɔsomaa ma wɔkɔr Moabhen no so hɔ: na ɔammpen na Israel tsenaa Kades.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna ɔnantseew sar no do, na ɔkɔbɔɔ Edom asaase, na Moab asaase ho aprɔw, na wobopuee Moab asaase no no boka afamu, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Arnon egya no ho; na wɔammba Moab he no mu, osiandɛ Arnon nye Moab he no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Israel somaa abɔfo wɔ Amorifo hen Sihon, Hesbonhen no, hɔ; na Israel see no dɛ, Yɛserɛ wo, ma yentwa mu wɔ w’asaase do nkɔ m’asaase do.
title: JUDGES

text: Naaso Sihon ennya pɛ wɔ Israel ho dɛ ɔbɛma woetwa mu wɔ ne he do: na Sihon poon ne man nyinara hyiae, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Jahaz, na wɔnye Israel koe.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, dze Sihon na ne man nyinara hyɛɛ Israel nsa, na wokunkum hɔn: na Israel faa Amorifo asaase no nyinara, ɔman no mu mba no a.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔfaa Amorifo he nyinara, ofi Arnon do araa kodu Jabbok do, na ofi sar no do araa kodu Jordan do.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna afei a EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, etu Amorifo efi ne man Israel enyim yi, na ɔwo rebɛfa hɔn?
title: JUDGES

text: Ana ennkɛfaa dza wo nyame Kemos (Kemos) dze maa wo dɛ fa no ara bi? Dɛm ntsi hɔn a EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn etu hɔn efi hɛn enyim no hɔn na yɛbɛfa.
title: JUDGES

text: Na afei ana ɔwo iye ara ma ɔsen Zipor babanyin Balak, Moabhen no a? Ana ɔnye Israel dzii aper pɛn, anaa ɔnye hɔn koo pɛn?
title: JUDGES

text: Aber a Israel tsenaa Hesbon na no ho nkurow mu, na Aroer na no ho nkurow mu, na nkurow a ɔwɔ Arnon ho nyinara mu mfe ahaasa no; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom anngye no wɔ aber no mu?
title: JUDGES

text: Dɛm ntsi emi mennyɛɛ wo bɔn bi, mbom ɔwo na ereyɛ me bɔn dɛ irutu mo do sa: EWURADZE, Ɔtsɛmbuafo no ɔnyɛ ɔtsɛmbuafo ndɛ da yi wɔ Israelmba na Ammonmba ntamu.
title: JUDGES

text: Naaso Ammonmba hen no enntsie Jefta ne nsɛm a ɔdze somaa ma wɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ no no.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna EWURADZE no sunsum baa Jefta do, na otwaa mu wɔ Gilead na Manaasɛ, na otwaa mu kɔr Gilead-Mizpe, na ofi Gilead-Mizpe twaa mu kɔr Ammonmba no do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Jefta bɔɔ EWURADZE anohoba, na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ edze Ammonmba no hyɛ me nsa ampa a,
title: JUDGES

text: ɔnodze ɔbɛba dɛ, biribiara a obefi me fi mbobow mu ebehyia me aber a meresan efi Ammonmba ho dwudwoodwo no, ɔbɛyɛ EWURADZE dze, na medze no bɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Jefta twaa mu kɔr Ammonmba no do dɛ ɔnye hɔn rokɔko; na EWURADZE dze hɔn hyɛɛ ne nsa.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔdze okum kɛse paara kunkum hɔn fi Aroer araa dze kodu Minnit, mekyerɛ nkurow eduonu, na edze kodu Abel-keramin. Nna wɔberɛɛ Ammonmba no adze wɔ Israelmba no enyim.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Jefta baa ne fie Mizpa, na, hwɛ, ne babaa dze mfuaba na asaw fiir edzi dɛ oribehyia no: na ɔnoara nye ne ba kortoo; onnyi ɔbabanyin anaa ɔbabaa ka no ho.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ohun no no, osunsuaan ne ntar mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ebei, me babaa! Abrɛ me adze dodoodow, na ɔwo nye hɔn a wɔfona me no mu baako: osiandɛ mebue m’ano mama EWURADZE, na murunntum nnsan m’ekyir.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ne ba no see no dɛ, M’egya, ebue w’ano ama EWURADZE yi dze; yɛ me dɛ mbrɛ efi w’anomu no ara; susuampa dɛ EWURADZE edzi w’atamfo do wer ama wo yi, mekyerɛ Ammonmba no a.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔsee n’egya dɛ, Ma wɔnyɛ iyi mma me: gyaa me abosoom ebien, ma minsi mu minsian monkɔ mbepɔw do, na emi na m’anyɛnkofo nkegyam me mbaabunyɛ ho.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Kɔ. Na ogyaa no kwan abosoom ebien: na osii mu kɔree, ɔno na n’anyɛnkofo, na okegyaam ne mbaabunyɛ ho wɔ mbepɔw do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ abosoom ebien no n’ewiei no, ɔsanee baa n’egya hɔ, ma ɔyɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ n’anohoba a ɔbɔe no tse no ara: na oennhu banyin biara. Na ɔyɛɛ atɔrmuadze wɔ Israel,
title: JUDGES

text: dɛ afrenhyia pempem nyinara Israel mbabaa dze su kɛkaa Gileadnyi Jefta ne babaa no afrenhyia mu nda anan.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Efraim mbanyin bɔboaa ano, na wotwaa mu kɔr kwaamu afamu; na wɔsee Jefta dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na itwae kɔree kɛnyee Ammonmba koe, na ammfrɛ hɛn na yɛnye wo annkɔ? Yɛdze ogya bɛhyew wo fi egu wo do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Jefta see hɔn dɛ, Emi na me man yɛnye Ammonmba nyaa manso kɛse; na aber a mefrɛɛ hom no, hom anngye me emmfi hɔn nsamu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na aber a muhun dɛ hom anngye me no, medze mo nkwa kitsaa me nsamu, na mutwae kɔr Ammonmba do, na EWURADZE dze hɔn hyɛɛ me nsa. Na afei ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi mbɔ na hom afow aba mo do ndɛ da yi, dɛ wɔnye me robɔko yi?
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Jefta poon Gilead mbarimba hyiae, na ɔnye Efraim koe: na Gilead mbarimba no kum Efraim, osiandɛ wɔsee dɛ, Hom Gileadfo, hom yɛ eguamfo wɔ Efraim na Manaasɛ mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Gileadfo twaar Efraimfo kɛgyee Jordan etwaree no: na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ Efraim eguamfo no bi se dɛ, Ma muntwa a, Gilead mbarimba no bisa no dɛ, Ana Efraimnyi nye wo a? Sɛ ɔse dɛ, Oho a;
title: JUDGES

text: nna wɔase no dɛ, Afei se dɛ, Shibolet; na sɛ ɔka Sibolet; osiandɛ onntum nnka no yie a; nna wɔakyer no, na woeku no wɔ Jordan etwaree hɔ: na aber no mu Efraim mu nyimpa mpemeduanan ebien totɔree.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Jefta dzii Israel enyim mfe esia. Nna Gileadnyi Jefta wui, na wosiee no wɔ Gilead nkurow no kor mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Jefta n’ekyir no Ibzan a ofi Bɛtlɛhɛm dzii Israel enyim.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna ɔwɔ mbabanyin eduasa na mbabaa so eduasa, na ogyaa mbabaa eduasa kwan kɔr awar wɔ mbeambea, na ɔdze mbabaa eduasa fi mbeambea brɛɛ ne mbabanyin no. Na odzii Israel enyim mfe esuon.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Ibzan wui, na wosiee no wɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔno n’ekyir no Zebulunnyi Elon dzii Israel enyim; mfe du.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Zebulunnyi Elon wui, na wosiee no wɔ Aijalon wɔ Zebulun asaase do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔno n’ekyir no Piratonnyi Hilel ne babanyin Abdon buu Israel atsɛn.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna ɔwɔ mbabanyin eduanan na mbabanyin hɔn mbabanyin eduasa a wɔtsenaa asoasopɔnkɔ mba eduosuon do: na odzii Israel enyim mfe awɔtwe.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Piratonnyi Hilel ne babanyin Abdon wui, na wosiee no wɔ Piratom wɔ Efraim asaase do, wɔ Amalekfo nkokodo nkurow no mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Israelmba no yɛɛ dza omuo bio wɔ EWURADZE enyi do; na EWURADZE dze hɔn hyɛɛ Filistiafo nsa mfe eduanan.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna banyin bi wɔ hɔ a ofi Zora a ofi Danfo ebusua mu a ne dzin dze Manoa; nna ne yer yɛ ɔbɔnyin.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Afei hwɛ, ɔbɔnyin nye wo, na innyi ba: naaso ibenyinsen, na awo babanyin.
title: JUDGES

text: Dɛm ntsi afei meserɛ wo, hwɛ yie, na mma nnom wenyin anaa nsa dzendzen bi, na mma nndzi efifidze biara so:
title: JUDGES

text: na, hwɛ, ibenyinsen, na awo babanyin; na oyindam bi rennka ne tsir: na abofra no fi yafun mu ara bɛyɛ (Nazirinyi) nyia ɔakam noho ama Nyankopɔn: na ɔno na ɔbɛhyɛ ase agye Israel efi Filistiafo nsamu.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna ɔbaa no bae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ no kun no dɛ, Nyame nyimpa bi baa me nkyɛn, na n’enyim yɛ dɛ Nyame no bɔfoe enyim, ɔyɛ hu dɛ; na memmbisa no mbrɛ ofi, nkyii so ɔammbɔ ne dzin annkyerɛ me:
title: JUDGES

text: na ɔsee me dɛ, Hwɛ, ibenyinsen, na awo babanyin; na afei mma nnom wenyin anaa nsa dzendzen, na mma nndzi efifidzi biara so: na abofra no fi yafun mu araa bɛyɛ nyia ɔakam noho (Nazirinyi) ama Nyankopɔn dze ekodu no wu da.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Manoa totɔe serɛɛ EWURADZE, na ɔsee dɛ, Ao EWURADZE, meserɛ wo ma Nyame nyimpa no a esomaa no no mbra hɛn nkyɛn bio, na ɔmbɛkyerɛ hɛn dza yɛmfa nyɛ abofra a wɔrobɔwo no no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Nyankopɔn tsiee Manoa ne ndze; na Nyame no bɔfoe no baa ɔbaa no nkyɛn bio wɔ aber a ɔtse haban mu no: nna no kun Manoa nnyi ne nkyɛn.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa no yɛɛ ntsɛm tutuu mbirika kɛkaa kyerɛɛ no kun, na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, banyin no a ɔbaa me nkyɛn daano bi no oebeyi noho akyerɛ me.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Manoa soɛree, na odzii ne yer no ekyir, na ɔbaa banyin no nkyɛn, na obisaa no dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye banyin no a ekasaa kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no? Na ɔsee dɛ, Mara a.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Manoa see dɛ, Afei ma wo nsɛm mbra mu: Abofra no ne nyɛbea bɛyɛ dɛn, na n’edwuma nye dɛn?
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see Manoa dɛ, Dza mesee ɔbaa no nyinara na ma ɔnhwɛ yie wɔ ho.
title: JUDGES

text: Adze biara a ofi wenyindua mu ba no mma onndzi bi, nkyii so mma ɔnnom wenyin anaa nsa dzendzen bi, na mma onndzi efifidze biara so: dza mehyɛɛ no nyinara ma ondzi do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Manoa see EWURADZE no bɔfoe no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma yensianka wo, na yensiesie apɔnkyeba bi mma wo.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see Manoa dɛ, Sɛ isianka me mpo a, mirinndzi w’edziban no bi: na sɛ ebɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr a, bɔ ma EWURADZE. Nna Manoa nnyim dɛ ɔyɛ EWURADZE no bɔfoe.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Manoa see EWURADZE no bɔfoe no dɛ, Wo dzin dze dɛn, na sɛ wo nsɛm no ba mu a yɛaahyɛ wo enyimnyam.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na iribisa me dzin a ɔyɛ nwanwa yi?
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Manoa faa apɔnkyeba no kaa edziban afɔr no ho, na ɔdze bɔɔ afɔr wɔ ɔbotan no do maa EWURADZE: nyia ɔyɛ anwanwadze no, na Manoa na ne yer hwɛe.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ogyaframee no fi afɔrmbukyia no do rokɔ sor no, EWURADZE no bɔfoe no fowee nam afɔrmbukyia no do ogyaframee no mu kɔr sor na Manoa na ne yer dze hɔn enyi tsiim no do; na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no ennyi noho bio annkyerɛ Manoa anaa ne yer. Nna Manoa hun dɛ EWURADZE no bɔfoe a.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Manoa see ne yer dɛ, Owu na yerubowuwu, osiandɛ yeehu Nyankopɔn.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ne yer no see no dɛ, Sɛ EWURADZE pɛ dɛ oku hɛn a, nkyɛ ɔanngye hɛn nsamu ɔhyew afɔr, na edziban afɔr, nkyii so nkyɛ oennyi iyinom nyinara annkyerɛ hɛn, na so nkyɛ ɔannka ndzɛmba a ɔtse dɛm yi annkyerɛ hɛn aber yi mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa no woo babanyin, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Samson: na abofra no nyinii, na EWURADZE hyiraa no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE no sunsum hyɛɛ ase kekaa no wɔ Mahane-dan, wɔ Zora na Estaol ntamu.
title: JUDGES

text: Da bi Samson sii mu kɔr Timna, na okohun ɔbaa bi wɔ hɔ a ofi Filistiafo mbabaa no mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ n’egya na ne na, na ɔsee dɛ, Mekohu ɔbaa bi wɔ Timna a ofi Filistiafo mbabaa no mu: dɛm ntsi afei hom nkɛgye no yer mma me.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna n’egya na ne na see no dɛ, Ana ɔbaa biara nnyi wo nuanom mbabaa no mu, anaa mo nkorɔfo nyinara mu, na erokɔ akɔwar wɔ Filistiafo monomonomfo no mu yi? Na Samson see n’egya dɛ, Kɛgye no ma me; na ɔnoara na mepɛ no dodow.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna n’egya na ne na dze wonnyim dɛ ofir EWURADZE; osiandɛ ɔhwehwɛɛ ɔkwan bi wɔ Filistiafo no ho. Afei aber no mu na Filistiafo na wɔhyɛ Israel do.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Samson, na n’egya na ne na, sii mu kɔr Timna, na wodur Timna wenyin nture ho: na, hwɛ, gyata eburwa bi pɔɔw no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE no sunsum baa no do dzendzenndzen, na ɔtsetseew no mu dɛ mbrɛ nkyɛ ɔbɛtsetsew apɔnkyeba mu, nna hwee nndze ne nsamu: na ɔannka dza ɔyɛe no annkyerɛ n’egya anaa ne na.
title: JUDGES

text: Na osii mu kɔree, na ɔnye ɔbaa no kɛkasae; na ɔsɔɔ Samson n’enyi dɛ.
title: JUDGES

text: Na n’ekyir mber kakra no ɔsanee kɔr dɛ orikehyia no, na ɔmanee dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ gyata fun no: na, hwɛ, ndowa menyamenya, na ewo wɔ gyata honandua no mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔfae kitsaa ne nsamu kɔree, na ɔrokɔ no na oridzi, na okodur n’egya na ne na nkyɛn, na ɔmaa hɔn bi, na wodzii: na ɔannka annkyerɛ hɔn dɛ oyii ewo no wɔ gyata honandua mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na n’egya sii mu kɔr ɔbaa no nkyɛn, na Samson too pon wɔ hɔ; dza nna mbrɛ mberantsɛ no tɔ dɛ wɔyɛ nye yi.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wohun no no, wɔdze anyɛnkofo eduasa baa dɛ wɔmbɛka no ho.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Samson see hɔn dɛ, Afei wɔmma memma hom abrɔme bi: sɛ hom tum hu ka kyerɛ me wɔ aponto nda esuon yi mu a, ɔno mebɛma hom ndwera ntar eduasa na nkatado asorɔtow eduasa:
title: JUDGES

text: na sɛ hom ennhu annka annkyerɛ me a, ɔno hom mma me ndwera ntar eduasa na nkatado asorɔtow eduasa. Na wɔsee no dɛ, Fa w’abrɔme no bra, ma yentsie.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Odzidzifo no mu na edziban fi bae, Na ɔhoɔdzenfo no mu na dɔkɔdɔkɔ fi bae. Na ndaansa na wonntum nnkyerɛ abrɔme no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia esuon no, wɔsee Samson ne yer no dɛ, Daadaa wo kun, ma ɔnkyerɛ hɛn abrɔme no, amma yaammfa ogya annhyew ɔwo na w’egya fi: ana hom behyiaa hɛn aabɔ hɛn epoo anaa? Ɔnntse dɛm bi a?
title: JUDGES

text: Na Samson ne yer no sui tɔɔ no do, na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔtan mbom na etan me, na enndɔ me bi: ɔwo edze abrɔme ama me man mba, na ennkaa nnkyerɛɛ me. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, m’egya na me na mpo mennkaa nnkyerɛɛ hɔn, na ɔwo na menka nkyerɛ wo anaa?
title: JUDGES

text: Na osui tɔɔ no do nda esuon no, aber a hɔn aponto no si do no nyina: na ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia esuon no, ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no, osiandɛ ɔhaaw no dodow na ɔbaa no kɛkaa abrɔme no kyerɛɛ ne man mba no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na da a otsia esuon no ansaana iwi rotɔ no kurow no mu mba no see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔyɛ dɔkɔdɔkɔ sen ewo? Na ebɛnadze na no ho yɛ dzen sen gyata: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom ammfa me nantwi emmfuntum a, Nkyɛ hom ennhu m’abrɔme no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na EWURADZE no sunsum baa no do dzendzenndzen, na osii mu kɔr Ashkelon, na okokunkum hɔn mu mbarimba eduasa, na ɔfaa hɔn asadze, na ɔdze nkatado asorɔtow no maa hɔn a wɔkyerɛɛ abrɔme no. Na n’ebufuw dzɛwee, na osii mu kɔr n’egya fie.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Samson ne yer no dze, wɔdze no maa ne nyɛnko a odzii n’ekyir wɔ awar no mu no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na iyi ekyir no a ɔkyɛɛr kakra no, ewifua twaber mu no, Samson dze apɔnkyeba kɔree kɔhwɛɛ ne yer; na ɔsee dɛ, Mobɔkɔ me yer nkyɛn wɔ pia mu. Na ɔbaa no n’egya amma no kwan ma ɔannkɔ.
title: JUDGES

text: Na n’asew no see dɛ, Emi dze modween dɛ ɔtan na etan no; dɛm ntsi medze no ama wo nyɛnko bi: ana no nua kuma no no ho nnyɛ fɛw nnsen ɔno? Ibotum afa no ahyɛ ananmu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Samson see hɔn dɛ, Afei dze wɔ Filistiafo afamu no, sɛ meyɛ hɔn bɔn bi a, minnkedzi ho so.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Samson sii mu kɔree kɛkyeer nsɔ ahaasa, na ɔfaa ngyaabaa, na ɔdaan dua faam dua ho, na ɔdze gyabaa hyɛɛ mu wɔ ndua ebien biara ntamu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na aber a ɔsosɔɔ ngyaabaa no ano gya no, ogyaa hɔn ma wɔkɔr Filistiafo eburow kwa mu, na wɔhyeew eburow ekuwekuw na eburow a osisi hɔ no nyina, na ngodua ture so.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Filistiafo no see dɛ, Woana yɛɛ iyi? Na wɔsee dɛ, Timnanyi no n’asew Samson a, osiandɛ ɔagye ne yer, na ɔdze no ama ne nyɛnko bi. Na Filistiafo fowee bae, na wɔdze gya bɛhyeew ɔbaa no na n’egya.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Samson see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom ayɛ iyi mpo a, gyedɛ medzi hom wer ansaana n’ekyir no megyaa.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbobɔɔ hɔn ndwonku na aserɛ do kunkum hɔn dwɛɛ: na osianee kɔree kɛtsenaa Etam ɔbotan tokur mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Filistiafo no sii mu kɔree, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Juda, na wɔtserɛɛw hɔn mu wɔ Lehi.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Juda mbarimba no bisaa dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom aba hɛn do yi? Na wɔsee dɛ, Yɛbae yaabɛkyekyer Samson, yaayɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze ayɛ hɛn no.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Juda mbarimba mpemebiasa sii mu kɔr Etam ɔbotan tokur no mu, na wɔsee Samson dɛ, Ana ɔwo nnyim dɛ Filistiafo na wodzi hɛn do hen? Ebɛnadze na edze ayɛ hɛn yi? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Dza wɔdze yɛɛ me no, dɛmara so na medze ayɛ hɔn.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛaba dɛ yɛrebɛkyekyer wo, ma yɛdze wo aakɛhyɛ Filistiafo nsa. Na Samson see hɔn dɛ, Hom nka ntam nkyerɛ me dɛ homara runntu nnhyɛ mo do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Dabida na kyekyer ara na yɛbɛkyekyer wo, na yɛdze wo akɛhyɛ hɔn nsa: na oku dze yerunnku wo. Na wɔdze ntampehoma fofor ebien kyekyeer no, na wɔdze no fi ɔbotan no mu bae.
title: JUDGES

text: Aber a odur Lehi no, Filistiafo no hyiaa no, na wohuroo no: na EWURADZE no sunsum baa no do dzendzenndzen, na ntampehoma a ɔwɔ n’abasa ho yɛɛ dɛ asaaba a wɔdze gya aka, na ne nkyehoma no fii ne nsa ho gui.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ohun asoaso n’adadaw fofor bi, na ɔtseen ne nsa fae, na ɔdze kunkum mbarimba apem.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Samson see dɛ, Medze asoaso n’adadaw mehyɛɛ hɔn ekuwekuw, Medze asoaso n’adadaw mekum mbarimba apem.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a owiee kasa no, ɔtoow adadaw no fii ne nsamu kyenee; na bea no wɔfrɛɛ no Ramat-lehi.
title: JUDGES

text: Na nsukɔm dzee no dodow, na ɔfrɛɛ EWURADZE, na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔwo nam w’akowaa nsa do edze nkwagye kɛse ama: na afei nsukɔm nku me, ma monkɔtɔ monomonomfo nsamu?
title: JUDGES

text: Na Nyankopɔn paa otokur korkorba a ɔwɔ Lehi no mu, na nsu fi mu bae; na ɔnomee no, no sunsum sanee bae, na onyaa nkwa: dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no ne dzin En-hakkore a ɔwɔ Lehi dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: JUDGES

text: Na odzii Israel enyim wɔ Filistiafo nda no mu mfe eduonu.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Samson sii mu kɔr Gaza, na okohun ɔbaa huhunyi bi wɔ hɔ, na ɔkɔr ne nkyɛn.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Gazafo no dɛ, Samson aba ha. Na wotwaa no ho hyiae, na wɔtsɛɛw no anadwe no nyinara wɔ kurow no mu kuropon ano, na wɔyɛɛ dzinn anadwe no nyinara, dɛ, Wɔmma ɔnko hɔ na anapa enyim tsetsew a, ɔno yeeku no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Samson dae ma okodur esuom, na osuoo kurow no no kuropon mbobow no, na apondua ebien no mu, na otutui, adaban na dza ɔka ho nyinara, na ɔdze guu no kɔn ho, na ɔsoae dze kɔr bepɔw a ɔwɔ Hebron enyim no etsifi.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ n’ekyir no, ɔdɔɔ ɔbaa bi wɔ Sorek ɔbɔn mu a ne dzin dze Delila.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Filistiafo ekunyin no fowee baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Daadaa no, na hwɛ adze kor a n’ahoɔdzen kɛse no wɔ mu, na ɔkwan kor a yɛnam mu bɛhyɛ no do, ma yaakyekyer no ahyɛ no amen: na ankor ankor nyinara yɛbɛma wo ndwetɛbona ɔhadubiako.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Delila see Samson dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ka adze kor a w’ahoɔdzen kɛse no wɔ mu, na adze kor a wɔdze bɛkyekyer wo ahyɛ wo amen kyerɛ me.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Samson see no dɛ, Sɛ wɔdze mpaahoma momon esuon a ɔnnwoe kyekyer me a, ɔnodze mubogura, na mayɛ dɛ nyimpa biara so.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Filistiafo ekunyin no dze mpaahoma momon a ɔnnwowee esuon brɛɛ ɔbaa no, na ɔdze kyekyeer no.
title: JUDGES

text: Afei nna ɔwɔ atsɛweefo hyɛ adankyir. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Samson, Filistiafo reba wo do oo. Na ɔtsetseew mpaahoma no, dɛ mbrɛ asaabahoma sɛ ɔka gya a ɔtsetsew no. Dɛm ntsi woennhu n’ahoɔdzen no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Delila see Samson dɛ, Hwɛ, esi me atwetwe, na aka akɔhwisɛm akyerɛ me: afei meserɛ wo, ka dza wɔdze kyekyer wo a ɔbɛyɛ yie kyerɛ me.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ wɔdze ntampehoma fofor ara a wɔmmfaa nnyɛɛ edwuma pɛn kyekyer me a, ɔno na mubogura, na mayɛ dɛ nyimpa biara so.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Delila faa ntampehoma fofor, na ɔdze kyekyeer no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Samson, Filistiafo reba wo do oo. Nna atsɛweefo no hyɛ adankyir. Na ɔtsetseew no wɔ n’abasa ho dɛ asaabahoma bi.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Delila see Samson dɛ, Esi me atwetwe ebodu ndɛ da yi, na aka akɔhwisɛm akyerɛ me: ka dza wɔdze kyekyer wo a ɔbɛyɛ yie kyerɛ me. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ edze me tsir mpɛsɛw esuon no fora ɔtanwendze no wen a.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔdze dadzeba no bɔɔ mu, na ɔsee no dɛ, Samson, Filistiafo reba wo do oo. Na ofii ne nda no mu nyanee, na otuu dza wɔawen no mu dadzeba no, na awendze no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ebɛyɛ dɛn ase dɛ modɔ wo, wɔ aber a w’akoma nnyi mo ho yi? Esi me atwetwe mprɛnsa nye yi, na ennkaa adze kor a w’ahoɔdzen kɛse yi wɔ mu no nnkyerɛɛ me.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔbaa no dze ne nsɛm guaan no ho daa daa, na ɔhyɛɛ no no, ɔyɛɛ Samson ne kra ahomtsew dze kɔr owu mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔkaa n’akoma mu asɛm nyinara kyerɛɛ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Oyindam ano nnkaa me tsir da; osiandɛ mifi me na yamu araa na mayɛ (Nazirinyi) nyia ɔakam noho ama Nyankopɔn: sɛ woyi me tsir a, nna m’ahoɔdzen no befi mo ho, na megura, na mayɛ dɛ nyimpa biara so.
title: JUDGES

text: Na aber a Delila hun dɛ ɔaka n’akoma mu asɛm nyinara akyerɛ no no, ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛfrɛɛ Filistiafo ekunyin no, dɛ, Hom mbra prɛko yi ara, na ɔaka n’akoma mu asɛm nyinara akyerɛ me. Nna Filistiafo ekunyin no baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔdzedze sika no wɔ hɔn nsamu bae.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Delila maa ɔdaa n’anankoroma do; na ɔfrɛɛ ɔbanyin bi ma obeyii ne tsir mpɛsɛw esuon no na ɔhyɛɛ ase hyɛɛ no amen, na n’ahoɔdzen no fii no ho kɔree.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Samson, Filistiafo reba wo do oo. Na ofii ne nda no mu nyanee, na ɔsee dɛ, Mubopue dɛ nkan no, na mawosow moho. Naaso nna ɔnodze onnyim dɛ EWURADZE efi ne nkyɛn kɔ.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Filistiafo no kyeer no, na wotutuu n’enyiwa: na wɔdze no baa Gaza, na wɔdze boran mpokyerɛ too no; na ɔyaam ewu wɔ adaduafo fi no mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Mbom woyii ne tsinhwi no, annkyɛr pii na ne tsinhwi no hyɛɛ ase fuuw bio.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Filistiafo ekunyin no poon hɔnho hyiae dɛ wɔrobɔbɔ afɔr kɛse ama hɔn nyame Dagon, na wɔagye hɔn enyi: na wɔsee dɛ, Hɛn nyame dze hɛn tamfo Samson ahyɛ hɛn nsa.
title: JUDGES

text: Na aber a ɔman no hun no no, woyii hɔn nyame ayɛw: na wɔsee dɛ, Hɛn nyame dze hɛn tamfo, na hɛn man ne sɛɛfo a oekuku hɛn mu piigyan no, ahyɛ hɛn nsa.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a hɔn akoma tɔɔ hɔn yamu no, wɔsee dɛ, Wɔnkɛfrɛ Samson ma yɛngor no ho. Na wɔkɛfrɛɛ Samson wɔ adaduafo fi no mu bae; na wɔgoor no ho: na wɔdze no gyinaa edum no ntamu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Samson see abofra no a ɔdze ne nsamu no dɛ, Gyaa me ma munsusuo edum no a ɔdan no si do no mu, ma montwer ho.
title: JUDGES

text: Afei nna dan no mbanyin na mbaa ahyɛ mu ma; na Filistiafo ekunyin no nyinara wɔ hɔ; na nyimpa bɛyɛ mpemebiasa wɔ dan no etsifi a wɔrohwɛ Samson a woridzi no ho fɛw no no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Samson frɛɛ EWURADZE see dɛ, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, meserɛ wo, kaa me, na hyɛ me dzen, meserɛ wo, prɛko yi ara, Nyankopɔn, ma mindzi m’enyiwa ebien yi ho wer prɛko wɔ Filistiafo no do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Samson susuoo finimfin edum ebien no a dan no si do no mu, na ɔtweree, ne nsa enyimfa dze kor mu, na n’abankum dze kor so mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Samson see dɛ, Ma menye Filistiafo no nwu. Na ɔdze n’ahoɔdzen nyinara bɔɔ no mu adze; na dan no bui guu ekunyin na nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ mu no nyinara do. Dɛm ntsi ewufo a okum hɔn wɔ no wu mu no dɔɔ so sen hɔn a okum hɔn wɔ no nkwaber mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna no nuanom na n’egya fie nyinara sii mu kɔree kɛfaa no, na wɔdze no fowee bae besiee no wɔ Zora na Estaol ntamu wɔ n’egya Manoa n’esiei. Na Samson dzii Israel enyim mfe eduonu.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna banyin bi wɔ hɔ a ofi Efraim nkokodo nkurow mu a ne dzin dze Mika.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔsee ne na dɛ, Dwetɛbona ɔhadubiako no a wɔfaa no wɔ wo nkyɛn no a epaae wɔ ho, na ekasaa ho so wɔ m’asomu no, hwɛ, dwetɛ no wɔ mo hɔ; mara na mefae. Na ne na see dɛ, EWURADZE mma nhyira nka me ba.
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔdaan ndwetɛbona ɔhadubiako no dze maa ne na, na ne na see dɛ, Otu na metu dwetɛ no efi me nsa mu esi nkyɛn ama EWURADZE dɛ wɔmfa mma me ba, ma ɔmfa nyɛ ohonyi a oesian na ohonyi a woegu: dɛm ntsi afei mebɛdan ama wo.
title: JUDGES

text: Na aber a ɔdaan sika no dze maa ne na no, ne na faa dwetɛbona ahaenu, na ɔdze maa ogufo na ɔdze yɛɛ osian honyi na ogu honyi: wɔ Mika fie.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Mika no wɔ n’abosomfi, na ɔyɛɛ asɔfontar (efod), na ebusuahonyi (terafim), na ɔtseew ne mbabanyin no mu baako ho a ɔbɛyɛɛ no sɔfoe.
title: JUDGES

text: Nda no mu no nna ɔhen bi nnyi Israel ntsi nyimpa biara yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ nankasa n’enyi do.
title: JUDGES

text: Na aberantsɛ bi wɔ hɔ a ofi Bɛtlɛhɛm-juda, wɔ Juda ebusua mu a ɔyɛ Levinyi, na ɔkɛyɛɛ hɔho wɔ hɔ.
title: JUDGES

text: Na banyin no sii mu fii kurow no mu, ofii Bɛtlɛhɛm-juda, dɛ ɔrokɔ beebi mbrɛ obenya tsenabew: na otuu kwan bodur Mika fie wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Mika bisaa no dɛ, Ifi hen nam? Na ɔsee no dɛ, Meyɛ Levinyi a mifi Bɛtlɛhɛm-juda, na morokɔ makɛtsena beebi mbrɛ mibenya tsenabew.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Mika see no dɛ, Nye me ntsena, na yɛ egya na ɔsɔfo ma me, na mebɛma wo dwetɛbona du afrenhyia, na atar hyɛpɛn kor, na w’edziban. Nna Levinyi no kɔr fie.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Levinyi no peen dɛ ɔnye Mika bɛtsena; na aberantsɛ no yɛɛ no dɛ ne mbabanyin mu baako.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Mika tseew Levinyi no ho, na aberantsɛ no bɛyɛɛ no sɔfoe, na ɔtsenaa Mika fie.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna Mika see dɛ, Afei na mehu dɛ EWURADZE bɛyɛ me yie, dɛ menya Levinyi ma odzi me sɔfo yi.
title: JUDGES

text: Nda no mu no nna ɔhen bi nnyi Israel: na nda no mu no ara so nna Danfo ebusuakuw no rohwehwɛ hɔn egyapadze aatsena do osiandɛ ɔdze bodu da no nna hɔn egyapadze nnyae nnkaa hɔn nsa wɔ Israel ebusuakuw mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Danmba no somaa hɔn ebusua mu mbanyin beenum fi hɔn dodow nyinara mu, mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam, fi Zora, na Estaol, dɛ wɔnkɛsera asaase no, na wɔnhwehwɛ mu; na wɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɔhwehwɛ asaase no mu: na wɔbaa Efraim nkokodo nkurow mu wɔ Mika fie, na wɔsoɛɛ hɔ.
title: JUDGES

text: Aber a wɔwɔ Mika fi nkyɛn no, wɔtsee aberantsɛ Levinyi no ne ndze: na wɔmaan hɔ, na wobisaa no dɛ, Woana dze wo baa ha, ebɛnadze na ereyɛ wɔ ha, na ebɛnadze na ewɔ wɔ ha?
title: JUDGES

text: Na obuaa dɛ, Dɛm na dɛm na Mika nye me edzi, na ɔabɔ me paa, na mabɛyɛ no sɔfoe.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛserɛ wo, bisa Nyankopɔn hɔ apam, ma yenhu kyerɛ dɛ hɛn kwan a yɛrokɔ yi bɛyɛ dwudwoodwo anaa?
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔsɔfo no see hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ no asomdwee mu: EWURADZE enyim na hom kwan a hom nam mu no da.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna mbarimba beenum no sii mu, na wɔbaa Lais, na wohun nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ mu hɔ no, mbrɛ woesi na wɔtsetse hɔ sɔnn, dɛ mbrɛ Zidonfo tse, komm na sɔnn; osiandɛ obiara nnyi asaase no do a ɔwɔ tum a ɔdze bogu hɔn enyim ase wɔ biribiara mu, na wɔnye Zidonfo no ntamu twe, na wɔnnye nyimpa biara nnyi hwee yɛ.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔbaa hɔn nuanom nkyɛn wɔ Zora na Estaol: na hɔn nuanom no see hɔn dɛ, Hom amandzɛɛ ɛ?
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Hom nsoɛr, na wɔmma yɛnkɔ hɔn do: na yeehu asaase no, na, hwɛ, oye dodoodow: na hom ayɛ dzinn yi ɛ? Mma hom nnyɛ akwadwer dɛ wɔbɔkɔ na wɔakɔdɔ mu afa asaase no.
title: JUDGES

text: Sɛ hom kɔ a, hom bɔto ɔman a wɔtse no sɔnn, na asaase no so: na Nyankopɔn dze ahyɛ hom nsa; beebi mbrɛ asaase do adze biara nnyɛ na wɔ hɔ a.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Danfo ebusua no mu mbarimba ahaesia a wɔdze akodze emiamia tui wɔ hɔ, fi Zora na Estaol.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wosii mu kɔree, na wɔkɛkyeer nsera wɔ Kiriat-jearim a ɔwɔ Juda no n’ekyir. Ɔno ntsi wɔfrɛɛ hɔ Mahane-dan a ase nye Dan nseraban, na ɔwɔ dze besi ndɛ.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wotwaa mu wɔ hɔ kɔr Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu, na wɔbaa Mika fie.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna mbarimba beenum no a wɔkɔree kɛseraa Lais man no see hɔn nuanom no dɛ, Ana hom nyim dɛ adan yi mu na asɔfontar na ebusua ehonyi a woesian, na dza woegu wɔ? Dɛm ntsi afei hom ndwen dza hom bɛyɛ ho.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔmaan hɔ, na wɔbaa Levinyi aberantsɛ no ne fie, mekyerɛ Mika fi no a, na wobisaa no honam mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Na mbarimba ahaesia no a woemia hɔn akodze a wofi Danmba no mu no wogyinaa abotsen no ano.
title: JUDGES

text: Na mbarimba beenum no a wɔkɔree kɛseraa asaase no fowee, na wɔbaa hɔ, na wɔkɛfaa ohonyi a woesian, asɔfontar, ebusua honyi na ohonyi a woegu no: nna ɔsɔfo no nye mbarimba ahaesia no a wɔdze akodze emia no gyina abotsen no ano.
title: JUDGES

text: Na aber a woyinom kɛhɛɛn Mika fie, na wɔkɛfaa ohonyi a woesian, asɔfontar, ebusua honyi na ohonyi a woegu no, ɔsɔfo no bisaa hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom reyɛ yi?
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛ komm, fa wo nsa mua w’ano, na nye hɛn nkɔ, na kɛyɛ hɛn egya na ɔsɔfo: ana oye ma wo dɛ ibedzi ɔsɔfo ama nyimpa baako ne fie, anaa dɛ ibedzi ɔsɔfo ama ebusuakuw na ebusua wɔ Israel mu?
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔsɔfo no n’akoma tɔɔ ne yamu, na ɔfaa asɔfontar na ehonyi no, na ɔdze kɔr nkorɔfo no mu.
title: JUDGES

text: Nna wɔdanee na wosii mu kɔree, na wɔdze mbofraba na ofiembowa na ahodze no dzii hɔn enyim.
title: JUDGES

text: Aber a wɔnye Mika fie ntamu twee kakra ara yie no, mbarimba a wɔwɔ efiefi a ɔbɛn Mika fi no mu no boaa ano, na woketsiiw Danmba no.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔtseaa mu frɛɛ Danmba no. Na wɔdaan hɔn enyi, na wɔsee Mika dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔyɛ wo, na edze dɛm asafo yi reba yi?
title: JUDGES

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom afa m’enyame a meyɛe, na ɔsɔfo no, na hom dze rokɔ, na ebɛnadze na mowɔ bio? Na odua dɛn na hom se me dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔyɛ wo yi?
title: JUDGES

text: Na Danmba no see no dɛ, Mma wɔnntse wo ndze wɔ hɛn mu, ɔno bɛyɛ na nkorɔfo a hɔn bo efuw ebotu ahyɛ hom do, ma ahwer wo nkwa, ɔnye wo fifo hɔn nkwa.
title: JUDGES

text: Na Danmba no faa hɔn kwan kɔree: na Mika hun dɛ wɔyɛ dzen dodow ma no no, ɔdaan noho na ɔsanee kɔr ne fie.
title: JUDGES

text: Na wɔfaa dza Mika yɛe no, na ɔsɔfo a onyaa no no, na wɔbaa Lais, bɔtoo ɔman a wɔwɔ hɔ komm na wɔtse hɔ sɔnn no, na wɔdze afona kunkum hɔn; na wɔdze gya hyeew kurow no.
title: JUDGES
