text: Afei so ɔwoara ndeda yi ara na ebae, na ndɛ memma enye hɛn nkɔ nkekyin, hwɛ no dɛ morokɔ beebiara a mibenya makɔ yi? San na fa wo nuanom no san ekyir kɔ; mbɔbɔrhu na nokwar ndzi w’ekyir.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Itai buaa ɔhen no see dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase, na mo wura ɔhen tse ase yi, ampa beebiara mbrɛ mo wura ɔhen bɛtsena no, sɛ owu mu o, nkwa mu o, mekyerɛ hɔ ara so na w’akowaa bɛtsena.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David see Itai dɛ, Kɔ kotwa. Na Itai, Gitinyi no, kotwaa mu, ɔnye ne mbarimba nyinara, na mbofraba a wɔka no ho nyina.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔman no nyinara dze ndze kɛse sui, na nkorɔfo no nyinara twaa mu kɔree: ɔhen no ankasa so twaa ɔwora Kidron no, na nkorɔfo no nyinara twae kɛfaa sar no do kwan no do afamu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na hwɛ, Zadok so, na Levifo a wɔka no ho no nyinara, so Nyankopɔn n’ahyɛmudaka no bae; na wɔsoɛɛ Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no sii famu, na Abiathar fowee ma ɔman no nyinara fii kurow no mu twaa mu wiei ana.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no see Zadok dɛ, Soa Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no san kɔ kurow no mu: sɛ minya EWURADZE enyim enyimnyam a, ɔdze me bɛba bio, na ɔakyerɛ me ɔno, na ne tsenabew nyina:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na sɛ mbom ɔse dɛm dɛ, Minnyi enyigye wɔ wo mu a; hwɛ, emi nye yi, ma ɔnyɛ me dɛ mbrɛ oye wɔ n’enyiwa do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Eso ɔhen no see ɔsɔfo Zadok dɛ, Ana nnyɛ adzehunyi nye wo bi a? San kɔ kurow no mu dwudwoodwo, na hom mbabanyin beenu no nka hom ho, wo babanyin Ahimaaz, na Abiathar ne babanyin Jonatan.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Hwɛ, mibetsintsim wɔ sar no do esutwaree no, ma ekodu dɛ asɛm befi hom hɔ ebesi no pi ama me.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Dɛm ntsi Zadok na Abiathar soaa Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no baa Jerusalɛm: na wɔtsenaa hɔ.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David nam Ngo Koko no afowee kɔree; na mbrɛ ɔrokɔ no na orusu; na ɔakata ne tsir do, na ɔnantseew anamɔnkwaa mu: na nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no nyinara mu nyimpa biara kataa ne tsir do, na wɔfowee kɔree, mbrɛ wɔrofow no nna worusu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na obi kaa kyerɛɛ David, dɛ, Ahithofel wɔ Absalom nkyɛn tsirdo apamfo no mu. Na David see dɛ, EWURADZE, meserɛ wo dan Ahithofel n’apam nkwaseasɛm.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a David dur afowee no etsifi mbrɛ wɔsɔr Nyankopɔn no, hwɛ, Husai, Arkinyi no bae behyiaa no, ɔatsetsew no sortar mu, na dɛtse gu n’etsifi:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na David see no dɛ, Sɛ ɔwo enye me twa kɔ a, ɔno ebɛyɛ adzesoa ama me:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na mbom sɛ esan kɔ kurow no mu, na ekɛse Absalom dɛ, Ɔhen, mebɛyɛ w’akowaa dɛ mbrɛ nkan no meyɛɛ w’egya n’akowaa no, dɛmara so na afei mebɛyɛ w’akowaa a: ɔno na ebɛsɛɛ Ahithofel n’apam no ama me.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ana innyi asɔfo Zadok na Abiathar wɔ wo nkyɛn hɔ bi a? Dɛm ntsi ɔmbra dɛ asɛm biara a ebɛtse no wɔ ɔhen no ne fie no, ka kyerɛ asɔfo Zadok na Abiathar.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Hwɛ, wɔwɔ hɔn mbabanyin beenu no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn hɔ, Zadok ne babanyin Ahimaaz, na Abiathar ne babanyin Jonatan; na asɛm biara a hom bɛtse no, hom nsoma ma wɔmfa ndua hɔn do ndu me nkyɛn.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna David ne nyɛnko Husai sanee baa kurow no mu; na Absalom so baa Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David twaa mu fii afowee no etsifi kakra no, hwɛ, Mefiboset n’akowaa Ziba behyiaa no, ɔdze nsoasopɔnkɔ ebien a wɔahyehyɛ hɔn, na boodoo ntɔwmu ahaenu, na esikyireamba siaw ɔha, na hyewber nduadzewa ɔha, na wenyin bɔdambɔ soso hɔn.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no see Ziba dɛ, Iyinom ekyerɛ asɛ dɛn? Na Ziba see dɛ, Nsoaso no wɔmfa mma ɔhen ne fiefo ma wɔntsena do; na boodoo na hyewber eduadzewa yi wɔmfa mma mberantsɛ no ma wondzi; na wenyin yi wɔmfa mma hɔn a wɔatɔ bitsi wɔ sar no do no ma wɔnnom.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Na wo wura ne ba no wɔ hen? Na Ziba see ɔhen no dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔtse Jerusalɛm: na ɔsee dɛ, Ndɛ na Israel fi bɛdan m’egya n’ahendzi no ama me.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna ɔhen no see Ziba dɛ, Hwɛ, dza ɔyɛ Mefiboset dze no nyinara yɛ wodze. Na Ziba see dɛ, W’adaworom a; ma minya mo wura ɔhen enyim enyimnyam.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na aber a ɔhen David dur Bahurim no, hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi fi hɔ bae a ofi Saul fie ebusua mu a ne dzin dze Simei, Gera ba a: opuei, na mbrɛ ɔreba no nyina nna ɔrodom.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔpraa David, na ɔhen David no nkowaa nyinara abo: nna dɔm no nyinara na mbarimba akatakyi no nyinara dzi ɔhen no n’abanyimfa na n’abankum.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Simei rodom no mbrɛ ɔsee nye yi, Fi hɔ kɔ, fi hɔ kɔ, ɔwo bɔgya nyimpa, na Belial nyimpa:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: EWURADZE adan Saul a ebɛhyɛɛ n’ananmu dzii hen no, ne fie bɔgya nyinara aba wo do; na EWURADZE dze ahendzi no ahyɛ wo ba Absalom nsa: na, hwɛ, wɔakyer wo wɔ wankasa w’emumuyɛ mu, osiandɛ ɔwo yɛ bɔgya nyimpa.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna Abishai, Zeruia ba no see ɔhen no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔkraman fun yi dom mo wura ɔhen yi? Meserɛ wo, ma monkɔ minkeyi ne tsir wɔ do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Ebɛnadze na menye hom wɔ yɛ, hom Zeruia mba? Wɔmma ɔndom ɛ, osiandɛ EWURADZE ase no dɛ, Dom David; na woana na nkyii ɔbɛse dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ayɛ dɛm?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David see Abishai, na no nkowaa no nyinara dɛ, Hwɛ, me ba a ofi mo nson mu bae na ɔrohwehwɛ mo nkwa yi: na afei Benjaminnyi yi na ɔnnkɛyɛ abor do? Wongyaa no ma ɔndom; na EWURADZE na ɔaka akyerɛ no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Annyɛ a EWURADZE bɔhwɛ bɔn a wɔdze ayɛ me, na EWURADZE dze papa ahyɛ me no ndom a ɔrodom me ndɛ da yi ananmu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna David na ne mbarimba no faa ɔkwan no do kɔree: na Simei faa koko noho afamu wɔ ne tsentsendo kɔree; na mbrɛ ɔrokɔ no nna ɔrodom, na ɔpraa no abo, na otuu huntuma petsee.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no, na dɔm a wɔka no ho no nyinara, kodurii a nna wɔaberɛ; na wɔgyee hɔn ahom wɔ hɔ.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Afei Absalom, na Israelmba nyinara, baa Jerusalɛm, nna Ahithofel ka no ho.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a David ne nyɛnko Husai, Arkinyi no, baa Absalom nkyɛn no, ɔsee Absalom dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen nkwa, Nyame ngye ɔhen nkwa.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Absalom see Husai dɛ, Ana w’ayamuyie a edze yɛ wo nyɛnko nye yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na enye wo nyɛnko no annkɔ?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Husai see Absalom dɛ, Dabida; mbom nyia EWURADZE, na ɔman yi, na Israel mbarimba no nyinara asan mu eyi no no, ɔno na mebɛyɛ nedze, na ɔno so na menye no bɛtsena.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Bio so, woana na mobɔsom no? Ana monnkɔsom wɔ ne ba enyim bi a? Dɛ mbrɛ masom wɔ w’egya enyim no, dɛmara so na mebɛyɛ wɔ w’enyim.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna Absalom see Ahithofel dɛ, Hom mfa hom apam mbra wɔ dza yɛnyɛ ho.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Ahithofel see Absalom dɛ, Kɔ w’egya no nwewefo a ɔadan hɔn egya dɛ wɔnhwɛ fie no do no nkyɛn; na ma Israel nyinara ntse dɛ w’egya ekyir wo kɔkɔɔkɔ: na iyi bɛma ɔwo na hɔn a wɔwɔ wo nkyɛn nyinara enya tum kɛse.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna wosii buw maa Absalom wɔ ɔdan no etsifi ntaae no; na Absalom kɔr n’egya no nwewefo no nkyɛn wɔ Israel nyinara enyim.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Ahithofel n’apam a ɔdze pamee wɔ nda no mu no, yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa bi ekebisa Nyankopɔn hɔ asɛm dze: dɛmara na Ahithofel n’apam nyinara yɛe dze maa David na Absalom.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Iyi ekyir no so Ahithofel see Absalom dɛ, Afei ma mensan mu nyi mbarimba mpemduebien, na monsoɛr nketsiw David anadwe yi:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na monkɔ no do aber a ɔaberɛ na ne nsamu agow yi, na minkeyi no hu: na dɔm a wɔka no ho nyinara boguan; na muboku ɔhen no nko:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na memfa dɔm no nyinara nsan mbrɛ wo, dɛ mbrɛ ayefor kɔ no kun nkyɛn no: na nyimpa kor pɛr na erohwehwɛ no eku no: na ɔman no nyinara bɛyɛ komm.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na asɛm no sɔɔ Absalom, na Israel mpanyimfo no nyinara enyi papaara.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna Absalom see dɛ, Afei wɔmfrɛ Husai, Arkinyi no so ma mbra, na wɔmma yentsie dza ɔno so wɔ ka.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na aber a Husai baa Absalom nkyɛn no, Absalom kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Mbrɛ Ahithofel aka nye yi: ana yendzi n’asɛm no do a? Sɛ oho a, wo so kasa.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Husai see Absalom dɛ, Apam a Ahithofel dze ama aber yi dze onnye.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nkyii so Husai see dɛ, Ɔwoara nyim w’egya na ne mbarimba, dɛ wɔyɛ mbarimba akatakyi, na hɔn enyi aber dɛ osisi a woewia ne mba wɔ haban mu: na w’egya so yɛ ɔsabarimba, na ɔnye nkorɔfo no renntsena.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Hwɛ, sisei oekosuma noho wɔ mona bi mu, anaa beebi: na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ hɔn mu binom totɔr asɔpɔn no a, obiara a ɔbɛtse no bɛse dɛ, Ɔkogu esi nkorɔfo a wodzi Absalom ekyir no mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na nyia ɔyɛ ndam a n’akoma tse dɛ gyata akoma no mpo, ɔbɛnan koraa: osiandɛ Israel nyinara nyim dɛ w’egya yɛ ɔbarimba katakyi, na hɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no wɔyɛ mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Mbom mususu dɛ wɔmboaboa Israel nyinara ano wɔ wo nkyɛn, ofi Dan araa dze kodu Beer-seba, dɛ mpoano anhwea wɔ dodow mu; na wankasa kɔ akono.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna yebopue no do wɔ beebiara mbrɛ wobohu no, na yeedwir no do dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔsu tɔ gu famu: yerinngyaa mma ɔno na mbarimba a wɔka no ho mu baako mpo mma nnka.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nkyii so ɔtwe noho kɔ kurow bi mu a, ɔno Israel nyinara dze ntampee bɛba kurow no ho, na yɛatwe no akɔ esutsen mu ma ekodu dɛ worunnhu ɔbo kakraba kor mpo wɔ hɔ.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Absalom na Israel mbarimba no nyinara see dɛ, Husai, Arkinyi no, n’apam no ye sen Ahithofel n’apam no. Na EWURADZE na ɔahyehyɛ dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ Ahithofel n’apam papa no, ama EWURADZE dze mbusu aaba Absalom do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna Husai see asɔfo Zadok na Abiathar dɛ, Dɛm na dɛm na Ahithofel dze apam Absalom na Israel mpanyimfo no: na dɛm na dɛm na mo so mapam.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Dɛm ntsi afei hom nsoma ntsɛm, ma wɔnkɛka nkyerɛ David, dɛ, Mma nntsena sar no do nsutwaree hɔ anadwe yi, na otwa ara na twa kɔ; ɔno bɛyɛ na wɔabɛmen ɔhen, na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no nyinara.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Afei Jonatan na Ahimaaz tsenaa En-rogel ho; na abaawa bi na ɔtɔ dɛ ɔkɛka kyerɛ hɔn; na hɔn so wosi mu kɔ kɛka kyerɛ ɔhen David; osiandɛ nna onnyi dɛ wohu hɔn dɛ wɔaba kurow no mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na abanyimbasiaba bi kohun hɔn, na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ Absalom: ntsi hɔn beenu nyina guaan ntsɛmara kɔree, na wokodur ɔbarimba bi fie wɔ Bahurim, nna ɔwɔ bura bi wɔ ne paado; na wosiaan mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔbaa no a ɔwɔ fie hɔ no faa nkataano no na ɔtserɛɛw mu kataa bura no ano, na ɔdze eburow siwii tserɛtserɛɛw do: na obiara ennhu ho hwee.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Absalom no nkowaa no baa ɔbaa no nkyɛn wɔ fie hɔ; na wɔsee dɛ, Hen na Ahimaaz na Jonatan wɔwɔ? Na ɔbaa no see hɔn dɛ, Woetwa ɔwora no kɔ. Na wɔhwehwɛɛ hɔn na woennhu hɔn no, wɔsanee baa Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔkɔree no ekyir no, wofii bura no mu puei, na wosii mu kɔree kɛkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen David; na wɔsee David dɛ, Hom nsoɛr, na wonkotwa nsu no ntsɛm: na dɛm na Ahithofel apam etsia hom.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna David, na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no nyinara soɛree, na wokotwaa Jordan: na anapa enyimtsetsewee no na hɔn mu baako mpo nnkae a onnyae nnkotwaa Jordan.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Aber a Ahithofel hun dɛ wɔammfa n’apam do no, ɔhyehyɛɛ n’asoaso, na ɔsoɛree kɔr fie wɔ no kurow mu na ɔtotoo ne fie yie, na ɔkɛsɛɛn ne men; na owui, na wosiee no wɔ n’egya n’asamandan mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna David baa Mahanaim. Na Absalom kotwaa Jordan, ɔnoara na Israel mbarimba a wɔka no ho no nyinara.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Absalom dze Amasa hyɛɛ Joab n’ananmu wɔ dɔm no do. Amasa yi yɛ Israelnyi ɔbarimba bi a ne dzin dze Itra ne ba, na ne na nye Nahas ne babaa Abigail, Joab ne na Zeruia no nua no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Israel na Absalom kɛkyeer nsera wɔ Gilead asaase do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a David baa Mahanaim no, Sobi, Nahas ne ba a ofi Ammonmba Rabaa no, na Makir, Ammiel ne ba a ofi Lo-debar, na Barzillai, Gileadnyi a ofi Rogelim no,
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: dze mpa na mbɛɛsen, dɛtse asɛn, ewifua na atoko, isiam na eburow kyewee, eduwa, na asaduwa, na efan kyenkyenee,
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: ewo na buter, na nguan na anantwi kyiise, brɛɛ David, na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no, dɛ wondzi: na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔkɔm dze nkorɔfo no, na wɔaberɛ, na nsukɔm so dze hɔn, wɔ sar no do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David kaan nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no, na ɔdze mpem do asafohemfo na ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo sisii hɔn do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David gyaa nkorɔfo no kwan, ɔdze ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor hyɛɛ Joab nsa, na ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor so hyɛɛ Zeruia ne ba Abishai, Joab no nua no nsa, na ebupɛn ebiasa mu kor so hyɛɛ Itai, Gitinyi no nsa. Na ɔhen no see nkorɔfo no dɛ, Ampa emi mara so menye hom rifir edzi akɔ.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na nkorɔfo no see dɛ, Ɔwo mma mmfir edzi nnkɔ: osiandɛ sɛ yeguan a, wɔronndwen hɛn ho; nkyii so sɛ hɛn mu fa totɔr a, wɔronndwen hɛn ho: naaso ɔwo dze, etse dɛ hɛn mu ɔpedu: dɛm ntsi afei oye dɛ ebɛyɛ krado efi kurow no mu abɔboa hɛn.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no see hɔn dɛ, Dza oye wɔ hom enyi do no, mebɛyɛ. Na ɔhen no gyinaa kuropon nkyɛn, na ɔman no nyinara puei kɔr no ɔha ɔha mu, na mpem mpem mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ Joab na Abishai na Itai, dɛ, Hom nye aberantsɛ no ndzi no berɛww wɔ me ntsi, mekyerɛ Absalom a. Na aber a ɔhen no rehyɛ asafohemfo no nyinara mbra wɔ Absalom ho no, nkorɔfo no nyinara tsee.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔman no fiir edzi kɔr haban mu kehyiaa Israel: na ɔko no wɔkoo no Efraim kwaa mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David no dɔm no bɔɔ Israel ɔman no gui, na okum kɛse sii hɔ da no, na ɔfaa nyimpa mpemeduonu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔko no mu tserɛwee wɔ hɔ kataa asaase no nyinara enyi: na kwaa no sɛɛ nyimpa dodow da no seen hɔn a afona sɛɛ hɔn.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Absalom hyiaa David no nkowaa no awerɛfir mu. Nna Absalom tse n’asoasopɔnkɔ do, na asoasopɔnkɔ no dze kɛfaa esudur kɛse bi n’abaw kusuww ase, na ne tsir kɛhyɛɛ esudur no mu, ma wɔmaa no do ma ɔsensɛɛn ɔsor na asaase ntamu; na asoasopɔnkɔ a ɔwɔ n’ase no nam do kɔree.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔbarimba bi kohunii, na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ Joab see dɛ, Hwɛ, muhun Absalom dɛ ɔsɛn esudur mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Joab see ɔbarimba no a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no no dɛ, Na, hwɛ, ɔwoara ihunii, na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ammbɔ no hɔ annhwe famu? Nkyɛ mebɛma wo dwetɛbona du na abɔdo.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔbarimba no see Joab dɛ, Sɛ mibenya dwetɛbona apem mpo wɔ me nsamu a, nkyɛ mennkɛtsen me nsa maka ɔhen ne ba no: na hɛn asomu na ɔhen hyɛɛ ɔwo na Abishai na Itai mbra, dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie ma obiara annka aberantsɛ Absalom no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Anaaso sɛ mutwa no nkwa ho nkontompɔ a (na asɛm biara nnyi hɔ a osuma ɔhen), ɔnodze nkyɛ ɔwo kor yi ara ebɔtwe woho ekegyina nkyɛn.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna Joab see dɛ, Minnkekyinkyim wo ho dɛm. Na ɔfaa mpeaa ebiasa kitsaa ne nsamu, na ɔtowee hwiraa Absalom n’akoma mu, aber a nkwa da ho wɔ no mu wɔ esudur no mu no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na mberantsɛ du a wɔso Joab n’akodze no twaa ho hyiae na wɔbobɔɔ Absalom kum no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Joab hɛɛn abɛn, na nkorɔfo no gyaa Israel tsiw sanee: osiandɛ Joab twee nkorɔfo no ekyir.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na woyii Absalom kɔtoow no kyeen kwaa no mu mona kɛse bi mu, na wɔhyɛɛ abo isiw kɛsenara wɔ no do: na Israel nyinara guanee obiara kɔr n’asesee mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Absalom tse ase no osii nkaadum bi a ɔwɔ ɔhen no bɔn mu no dze maa noho: na ɔsee dɛ, Minnyi babanyin a wɔdze no bɛkaa me dzin: na ɔdze nankasa ne dzin too dum no: na wɔfrɛɛ no Absalom ne nkaadum, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna Ahimaaz, Zadok ba no see dɛ, Afei ma muntu mbirika monkɔbɔ ɔhen amandzɛɛ, mbrɛ EWURADZE esi na oedzi n’atamfo wer ama no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Joab see no dɛ, Mma ɔwo nnyɛ amandzɛɛbɔfo ndɛ da yi, mbom ebɔbɔ amandzɛɛ da bi: na ndɛ da yi dze mma nnkɔbɔ amandzɛɛ, osiandɛ ɔhen ne ba atɔr.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna Joab see Kusnyi no dɛ, Kɔ kɛka dza ɔwoara ehu kyerɛ ɔhen. Na Kusnyi no bɔɔ no mu adze maa Joab, na otuu mbirika.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna Ahimaaz, Zadok ba no da ho see Joab bio dɛ, Meserɛ wo, dza ɔbɛba biara mbra, ma mo so muntu mbirika memfa Kusnyi no. Na Joab see dɛ, Me ba, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na epɛ dɛ itu mbirika yi, hwɛ no dɛ irinnya akatua bi wɔ amandzɛɛ no ntsi yi?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Dza ɔbɛba biara mbra, mubotu mbirika. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Tu mbirika ɛ. Nna Ahimaaz tuu mbirika dze faa Tɛtɛrmu kwan no do, na ɔkɛpaa Kusnyi no ho.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David tse nkuropon ebien no ntamu: na ɔweɔmfo no fowee kɔr kuropon nkurii no do wɔ fadum no ho, na ɔmaa n’enyiwa do, na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi nankotoo dze mbirika.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔweɔmfo no tseaa mu na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Sɛ nankotoo a nna amandzɛɛ bi wɔ n’anomu. Na ɔdze ba ara, na ɔbɛnee.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔweɔmfo no hun ɔbarimba kor so dɛ ɔdze mbirika reba: na ɔweɔmfo no tseaa mu frɛɛ abowanohwɛfo no, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔbarimba kor so nankotoo dze mbirika reba. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, ɔno so dze amandzɛɛ reba.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔweɔmfo no see dɛ, Emi modwen dɛ odzikamfo no ne mbirikatu tse dɛ Ahimaaz, Zadok ba no ne mbirikatu. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Ɔno ɔyɛ nyimpa pa, na ɔdze amandzɛɛ pa reba.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Ahimaaz frɛe, na ɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, Bɔkɔɔ. Na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ ɔhen no enyim dze n’enyim boom famu, na ɔsee dɛ Nhyira nka EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn a oeyi nyimpa a wɔma hɔn nsa do tsia mo wura ɔhen no ama.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Ana aberantsɛ Absalom no ho ye? Na Ahimaaz buaa dɛ, Aber a Joab rosoma ɔhen n’akowaa no, mekyerɛ mara w’akowaa a, muhun gyigyeegye kɛse bi, na minnyim n’adzeban.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Dan woho, gyina ha. Na ɔdaan noho kegyinaa dzinn.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na, hwɛ, Kusnyi no bae; na Kusnyi no see dɛ, Mo wura ɔhen, amandzɛɛ nye yi. EWURADZE edzi hɔn a wɔsoɛree tsiaa wo nyinara wer ama wo ndɛ da yi.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no see Kusnyi no dɛ, Ana aberantsɛ Absalom no ho ye? Na Kusnyi no buaa dɛ, Wɔmma mo wura ɔhen n’atamfo, na hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia wo dɛ wɔbɛyɛ wo bɔn no nyinara, nyɛ dɛ mbrɛ aberantsɛ no ayɛ.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no ho popoo dodow, na ɔfowee kɔr kuropon no do pia no mu, na osui: na aber a ɔrokɔ no mbrɛ ɔsee nye yi, Me ba Absalom e, me ba e, me ba Absalom e! Ao nkyɛ Nyame mma munwu mma wo, Absalom e, me ba e, me ba e!
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Joab dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔhen rusu na origyam Absalom.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na da no konyimdzi no daan dɔm no nyinara nkɔmbɔdzi: na dɔm no tsee no da no dɛ wɔrese dɛ, Ɔhen ridzi yaw ma ne ba.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na dɔm no wiawiaa hɔnho baa kurow no mu da no, dɛ mbrɛ nkorɔfo a woguan ɔko mu gu hɔn enyim ase no, wiawia hɔnho no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no kataa n’enyim, na ɔhen no dze ndze kɛse kekaa mu dɛ, Me ba Absalom e, Absalom e, me ba e, me ba e!
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Joab baa ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ fie, na ɔsee dɛ, Ndɛ da yi egu wo nkowaa nyinara a ndɛ da yi wɔagye ɔwo na wo mbabanyin, na wo mbabaa, na wo yernom, na wo nwewefo nkwa no enyim ase;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: wɔ dɛ ɔwo edɔ hɔn a wɔtan wo, na etan hɔn a wɔdɔ wo. Osiandɛ ɔwo ada no edzi ndɛ da yi, dɛ asafohemfo na nkowaa nnyɛ hwee mma wo: na ndɛ da yi muhu dɛ, sɛ Absalom tsenaa ase, na hɛn nyinara wuwui a, nkyɛ ɔsɔ w’enyi papaara.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Dɛm ntsi afei soɛr, fir edzi, na kɛkasa awerɛkyekyer mu kyerɛ wo nkowaa: na meka EWURADZE dɛ, sɛ emmpue a, ondu mbrɛ adze nsa no nna w’akofo no mu kor mpo nnkaa wo nkyɛn: na ɔno mbom bɛyɛ ɔhaw kɛse ama wo ma ɔasen mbusu a ofitsi wo mberantsɛber dze ebodu sesei aba wo do nyinara.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna ɔhen no soɛree, na ɔkɛtsenaa kuropon no mu. Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinara dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔhen no tse kuropon no mu: na ɔman no nyinara baa ɔhen no enyim. Afei na Israel eguanguan, nyimpa biara kɔ n’asesee mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔman no nyinara hamee wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu, dɛ, Ɔhen na oyii hɛn fii hɛn atamfo nsamu, na ɔno na ɔgyee hɛn fii Filistiafo nsamu; na afei Absalom ntsi oeguan efi asaase yi do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Absalom a yɛseraa no hyɛɛ no hen wɔ hɛn do no, ɔatɔr wɔ akono. Dɛm ntsi afei ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom nnka asɛm bi a wɔdze bɛkɛfa ɔhen asan aba yi?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen David tsee Israel nyinara hɔn asɛm yi no, ɔsomae ma wɔkɔr asɔfo Zadok na Abiathar nkyɛn, dɛ, Hom nkasa nkyerɛ Juda mpanyimfo, dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom aka ekyir dɛ wɔdze ɔhen bɛsan akɔ ne fie yi?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Hom nye mo nuanom, hom nye me biew na mo honam: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom aka ekyir dɛ wɔdze ɔhen bɛsan akɔ?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na hom nse Amasa dɛ, Ana ɔwo nnyɛ me biew na mo honam bi a? Nyankopɔn nyɛ me dɛm, na bi so nka ho, sɛ ɔwo enndzi dɔm no do ɔsafohen wɔ m’enyim daa nyina annhyɛ Joab n’ananmu a.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔbrɛɛ Juda mbarimba no nyinara hɔn akoma adze, dɛ nyimpa baako n’akoma; ma dɛm ntsi wɔsomae ma wɔkɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn, dɛ, San bra, ɔwo na wo nkowaa nyinara.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna ɔhen no sanee, na ɔbaa Jordan do. Na Juda baa Gilgal, dɛ wɔrokɔ ekehyia ɔhen no, na wɔdze ɔhen no etwa Jordan.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Simei, Gera ba no, Benjaminnyi a ofi Bahurim no, yɛɛ ntsɛm na ɔnye Juda mbarimba no sianee baa dɛ woribehyia ɔhen David.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Benjamin mbarimba apem ka no ho, na Ziba, Saul ne fie akowaa no, na ne mbabanyin duenum na no nkowaa eduonu ka no ho bae; na wotwaa Jordan baa ɔhen no enyim.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na esutwahɛn twae kɔr dɛ wɔdze rekɛfa ɔhen ne fiefo etwa, na wɔayɛ dza ohia biara. Na Simei, Gera ba no, boom ɔhen no n’enyim famu, aber a otwaa Jordan bae no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, Mma mma mo wura mmbu emumuyɛ mma me, nkyii so mma nnkaa dza w’akowaa yɛɛ no nkɔnkɔnsa mu wɔ da a mo wura ɔhen fii Jerusalɛm no, dɛ ɔhen bɛfa ato n’akoma mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Osiandɛ w’akowaa nyim dɛ mayɛ bɔn: dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, emi na medzi Josef fi nyinara ne kan maba ndɛ da yi dɛ mirisian mekehyia mo wura ɔhen.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Abishai, Zeruia ne ba no, buae see dɛ, Ana worunnku Simei wɔ iyi ntsi, osiandɛ ɔadom nyia EWURADZE asera no no?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David see dɛ, Ebɛnadze na mowɔ menye hom yɛ, hom Zeruia mba, dɛ hom bɛyɛ atamfo ama me ndɛ da yi? Ana ndɛ da yi wonku nyimpa wɔ Israel a? Ana minnyim dɛ ndɛ da yi midzi hen wɔ Israel do bi a?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no see Simei dɛ, Innkowu. Na ɔhen no kaa ntam kyerɛɛ no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Mefiboset, Saul ne ba no, sianee baa dɛ oribehyia ɔhen no; ɔnnyɛɛ n’anan ho yie, nkyii so onnsiesiee n’abɔdwesa ho, na ɔannhor ne ntar so ara ofi da no a ɔhen sii mu kɔree no bodur da a ɔbaa fie asomdwee mu no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔbaa Jerusalɛm dɛ oribehyia ɔhen no, ɔhen see no dɛ, Mefiboset, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ennye me annkɔ?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na obuaa dɛ, Ao mo wura ɔhen, m’akowaa na ɔdaadaa me: na w’akowaa see dɛ, Mebɛhyehyɛ asoaso, na nkyɛ matsena do, na menye ɔhen akɔ, osiandɛ w’akowaa yɛ ebubua.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na oebotwir w’akowaa ama mo wura ɔhen; na mo wura ɔhen dze ɔtse dɛ Nyankopɔn no bɔfoe: dɛm ntsi yɛ dza oye wɔ w’enyiwa do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Osiandɛ m’egya fie nyinara yɛ ewufo ara wɔ mo wura ɔhen enyim: naaso ɔwo dze w’akowaa hyɛɛ hɔn a wodzidzi wankasa wo pon do mu. Dɛm ntsi ebɛn kwan na mowɔ bio dɛ medze mebɛkeka mu afrɛ ɔhen bio?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na eda ho kasa wo nsɛm yi ho bio yi? Mese dɛ, Ɔwo na Ziba wɔnkɛkyɛ asaase no mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Mefiboset see ɔhen dɛ, Mpo, ma ɔmfa ne nyinara, susuampa dɛ mo wura ɔhen aba nankasa ne fie asomdwee mu yi.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Barzillai, Gileadnyi no, sianee fi Rogelim bae; na ɔnye ɔhen twaa Jordan, dɛ orikegya no Jordan egya.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna Barzillai yɛ nyimpa a oenyin dodow, oedzi mfe eduowɔtwe: na ɔno na ɔbɔɔ ɔhen akɔhoma mber a ɔda Mahanaim no; osiandɛ ɔyɛ nyimpa kɛse dɛ.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no see Barzillai dɛ, Bra bɛnye me ntwa nkɔ Jerusalɛm, na mobɔhwɛ wo me nkyɛn.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Barzillai see ɔhen no dɛ, Mo nkwa mfe mu nda yɛ ahen, na menye ɔhen mfow nkɔ Jerusalɛm yi?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Mowɔ hɔ yi medzi mfe eduowɔtwe: ana mubotum ehu papa na bɔn mu? Ana w’akowaa botum atse dza midzi anaa dza monom? Ana mubotum atse mbarimba adwontofo na mbaa adwontofo ndze bio a? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’akowaa bɛda ho ara ayɛ adzesoa ama mo wura ɔhen yi?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: W’akowaa nye ɔhen botwa Jordan akɔ kakra: na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔhen dze dɛm akatua botua me kaw?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Meserɛ wo, ma w’akowaa nsan ekyir bio, ma munkowu wɔ mankasa mo kurow mu, wɔ m’egya na me na nda nkyɛn. Mbom hwɛ, w’akowaa Kimham; ma ɔnye mo wura ɔhen ntwa nkɔ; na dza ehwɛ a oye ma wo no fa yɛ no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen buaa dɛ, Kimham nye me botwa akɔ, na mebɛyɛ no dza oye wɔ w’enyi do: na biribiara a ebɔhwehwɛ wɔ mo hɔ no, mebɛyɛ ama wo.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔman no nyinara twaa Jordan, na ɔhen no so twae: na ɔhen no feew Barzillai n’ano, na ohyiraa no; na ɔsanee kɔr nankasa ne tsenabew.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna ɔhen no sii mu kɔr Gilgal, na Kimham nye no sii mu kɔree: na Juda ɔman no nyinara, na Israel ɔman no ne fa, na wɔdze ɔhen no twae bae.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na, hwɛ, Israel mbarimba no nyinara baa ɔhen no nkyɛn, na wɔbɛsee ɔhen no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hɛn nuanom Juda mbarimba ewia wo kɔ, na wɔdze ɔhen, na ne fiefo, na David ne mbarimba a wɔka no ho nyinara etwa Jordan aba yi?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Juda mbarimba no nyinara buaa Israel mbarimba no dɛ, Osiandɛ ɔhen yɛ obusuanyi a ɔbɛn hɛn: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bo bofuw wɔ asɛm yi ntsi yi? Ana yeedzi ɔhen ho biribi? Ana ɔama hɛn akyɛdze bi?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Israel mbarimba no buaa Juda mbarimba no see dɛ, Yɛwɔ kyɛfa du wɔ ɔhen mu, na eso yɛwɔ David mu ɔkwan sen hom: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bu hɛn enyimtsia, dɛ hɛn apam enndzi kan ammba mu dɛ wɔdze hɛn hen bɛsan aba? Na Juda mbarimba no hɔn nsɛm no yɛɛ dzen seen Israel mbarimba no hɔn nsɛm no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nna ɔbarimba kwasampanyi bi wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Seba, a ɔyɛ Benjaminnyi Bikri ne ba: na ɔhɛɛn abɛn see dɛ, Yennyi kyɛpɛn wɔ David mu, nkyii so yennyi egyapadze wɔ Jesse ne ba no mu: Israel e, nyimpa biara nkɔ n’asesee mu oo.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna Israel mbarimba no nyinara fii David n’ekyir na wɔkɔree kedzii Seba, Bikri ne ba no n’ekyir: na Juda mbarimba no dze wɔtakyeer hɔn hen ho, fi Jordan do araa baa Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David baa ne fie wɔ Jerusalɛm; na ɔhen no faa no nwewefo mbaa du no a ogyaa hɔn dɛ wɔnhwɛ fie no, na ɔdze hɔn koguu beebi fofor, na ɔbɔɔ hɔn akɔhoma, na hɔn nkyɛn dze ɔannkɔ. Nna wɔtoow hɔn mu araa ma okodur hɔn wu da, tse dɛ wɔtse ekunayɛ mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna ɔhen no see Amasa dɛ, Kɛfrɛfrɛ Juda mbarimba no ma me ma wonhyia wɔ ndaansa ntamu, na ɔwoara so bra begyina ha.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna Amasa sii mu kɔr dɛ orikehyiahyia Juda mbarimba no ma woeehyia: na ɔkyɛree ma ɔseen aber a wɔdze hyɛɛ no no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David see Abishai dɛ, Afei na Seba, Bikri ne ba no, bɛyɛ hɛn bɔn asen dza Absalom yɛe no: ɔwoara fa wo wura no nkowaa no, na tsiw no, ɔno bɛyɛ na oenya nkurow a wɔagye ho ban mu afa, na oefi nsa eguan efi hɛn enyi do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Joab ne mbarimba no, na Keretfo, na Peletfo, na mbarimba akatakyi no nyinara tui dzii n’ekyir: na wotui fii Jerusalɛm dɛ woritsiw Bikri ne ba Seba.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Aber a wodur ɔbo kɛse no a ɔwɔ Gibeon no ho no, Amasa bae behyiaa hɔn. Nna Joab ɔabɔ n’akontar a ɔhyɛ no do, na ɔno do nna wɔdze abɔdo afona a ɔhyɛ no bɔha mu wɔ do akyekyer n’asen; na orifir edzi no ɔworɔwee tɔɔ famu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Joab see Amasa dɛ, Mo nua, ana wo ho ye? Na Joab dze ne nsa enyimfa suoo Amasa n’abɔdwesa mu dɛ ɔrefew n’ano.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Amasa dze ɔannhwɛ afona no a ɔdze Joab ne nsamu no: dɛm ntsi ɔdze wɔɔ ne yafun mu, na otuu no nson guu famu, na ɔammfee no do; na owui. Na Joab na no nua Abishai tsiiw Bikri ne ba Seba.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Joab ne mberantsɛ no mu baako gyinaa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Nyia ɔpɛ Joab n’asɛm, na ɔwɔ David afa no, wɔmma ondzi Joab n’ekyir.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Amasa yankayankaam no bɔgyaa mu wɔ tsempɔn no mu. Na ɔbarimba no hun dɛ nkorɔfo no nyinara gyinaa hɔ dzinn no, ɔsoaa Amasa fii tsempɔn no mu kɔtoo haban mu, na ohun dɛ obiara a obodu ne nkyɛn no ogyina dzinn ntsi, ɔdze atar kɛkataa no do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Aber a woyii no fii tsempɔn no do no, nkorɔfo no nyinara kɔree kedzii Joab n’ekyir, dɛ woritsiw Bikri ne ba Seba.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔdze faa Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu twaa mu kɔr Aber, na Bɛt-maaka, na Berifo nyina mu: na wɔboaboaa ano, na wɔkɔree so kedzii n’ekyir.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na wɔbae botuaa no wɔ Abel a ɔwɔ Bɛt-maaka, na wɔtotoow kurow no ho pampi, na ogyinaa akoban no ne tsentsendo: na nkorɔfo a wɔka Joab ho nyinara pempeem fasu no, dɛ worudwuruw no egu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna ɔbaa nyansafo bi fii kurow no mu tseaa mu dɛ, Wontsie oo, wontsie oo; meserɛ hom, hom nse Joab dɛ, Twe pin ha ma menye wo nkasa.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔtwee piin ne nkyɛn; na ɔbaa no see dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye Joab a? Na obuaa dɛ, Mara a. Nna ɔsee no dɛ, Tsie w’afonabaa ne nsɛm. Na obuaa dɛ, Miritsie.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna ɔkaa dɛ, Tsetseber no wɔtɔ dɛ wɔka no dɛ, bisa na wombisa apam wɔ Abel: na dɛm no nna woetwa asɛm no do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Modɔm Israel mu hɔn a wɔpɛ asomdwee na nokwar: ɔwo rohwehwɛ asɛɛ Israel mu kurow tsitsir: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na erebɛmen EWURADZE n’egyapadze yi?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Joab buae see dɛ, Ɔmpar me, ɔmpar me dɛ mebɛmen anaa mebɛsɛɛ.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Asɛm no nntse dɛm: mbom ɔbarimba bi a ofi Efraim nkokodo nkurow mu a ne dzin dze Seba, Bikri ne ba no, na ɔama ne nsa do etsia ɔhen, mekyerɛ David a: hom nyi no nkotoo mma, na mibefi kurow no ho makɔ. Na ɔbaa no see Joab dɛ, Hwɛ, wɔbɔtow ne tsir akyen fasu no ekyir.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna ɔbaa no dze ne nyansaa mu kɔr ɔman no nyinara nkyɛn. Na wotwaa Bikri ne ba Seba ne tsir, na wɔtowee kyeen Joab. Na ɔhɛɛn abɛn, na wofii kurow no ho petsee, nyimpa biara kɔr n’asesee mu. Na Joab sanee baa ɔhen nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Afei Joab nna odzi Israel dɔm nyinara do: na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia, na ɔhwɛ Keretfo na Peletfo do:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na Adoram na ɔhwɛ edwumayɛ tow no do: na Ahilud ne ba Jehosafat na ɔyɛ ɔsɛnkaafo:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na Seva nye ɔkyerɛwfo: na Zadok nye Abiathar nye asɔfo:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: nna Ira, Jairnyi no so yɛ David no sɔfoe.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔkɔm bi baa David aber do mfe ebiasa toaa do; na David kɔr EWURADZE hɔ ebisa. Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Saul ntsi a, na no bɔgya fi no ntsi a, osiandɛ okum Gibeonfo no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no frɛɛ Gibeonfo no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ; (na Gibeonfo no wɔnnyɛ Israelmba no mu bi, na mbom Amorifo nkaase no mu bi a; na Israelmba no aka ntam akyerɛ hɔn: na Saul hwehwɛɛ dɛ oku hɔn wɔ no mbɔdzen a ɔbɔ wɔ Israel na Judamba no ho:)
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na David see Gibeonfo no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na menyɛ memma hom, na ebɛnadze na memfa mempata, ama hom eehyira EWURADZE n’egyapadze?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Gibeonfo no see no dɛ, Nnyɛ dwetɛ anaa sikasɛm bi na ɔda hɛn na Saul, anaa ne fi ntamu; nkyii so nnyɛ hɛnara bi na yeruboku Israel mu nyimpa biara. Na David see dɛ, Dza hom bɛse no, ɔnoara na mebɛyɛ ama hom.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na wɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, ɔbarimba no a ɔhyeew hɛn, na ɔpaam hɛn tsir do, dɛ wɔnsɛɛ hɛn ma hɛn ase nhyew mfi Israel ahe do beebiara no,
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: ma wonyi ne mbabanyin mu nyimpa beesuon mma hɛn, na yɛnsensɛn hɔn mma EWURADZE, wɔ Saul a EWURADZE saan mu faa no, ne Gibea no mu. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Mibeyi hɔn ama.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no gyee Saul ne ba Jonatan ne ba Mefiboset nkwa, osian EWURADZE ne ntam a ɔda hɔn ntamu ntsi, dza ɔda David na Saul ne ba Jonatan ntamu no a.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Mbom ɔhen no faa Aia ne babaa Rizpa ne mbabanyin beenu no a ɔwoo hɔn maa Saul no, Armoni na Mefiboset; na Saul ne babaa Mikal ne mbabanyin beenum no a ɔwoo hɔn maa Meholatnyi Adriel, Barzillai ne ba no:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na oyii hɔn hyɛɛ Gibeonfo no nsa, na wɔsɛɛn hɔn bepɔw no do wɔ EWURADZE enyim, na hɔn beesuon no nyinara bɔɔ mu totɔree: na wokum hɔn wɔ twaber nda no mu, nda a odzi kan no mu a, atoko twaber ahyɛse no mu a.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Ahia ne babaa Rizpa faa eyitam, na ɔtsɛɛw mu kataa ɔbotan no do maa noho, fi twaber ahyɛse no ara kodur dɛ nsu fi sor guguu hɔn do ana; na ɔamma kwan ma wimu nnoma ammbɛgyegye hɔn do adzekyee, na hamu mbowa so ammba hɔn do adzesaa.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na wɔkɛkaa dza Aia ne babaa Rizpa, Saul no nwewe no, ayɛ no kyerɛɛ David.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David sii mu kɔree kɛgyee Saul ne mbiew na ne ba Jonatan ne mbiew no wɔ Jabes-gileadfo hɔ, hɔn a wokowiaa hɔn wɔ Bɛt-san abɔntsen do mbrɛ Filistiafo no dze hɔn sensɛnee, wɔ da a Filistiafo kum Saul wɔ Gilboa no:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na ɔdze Saul ne mbiew na ne ba Jonatan ne mbiew no fii hɔ bae; na wɔboaboaa hɔn a wɔsensɛɛn hɔn no hɔn mbiew no ano.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na wosiee Saul na ne ba Jonatan hɔn mbiew no wɔ Benjamin asaase do wɔ Zela, wɔ n’egya Kis n’asamandan mu: na wɔyɛɛ dza ɔhen no hyɛe no nyinara. Na ɔno n’ekyir no Nyankopɔn tsiei maa asaase no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Filistiafo no wɔnye Israel nyaa ko bio; na David na no nkowaa ka no ho sianee kɔree, na wɔnye Filistiafo no kɔkoe: na David tɔɔ bahaw.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Isbi-benob a, ɔyɛ ɔkraban no ne mba no mu bi a ne peaa no dur woker a, ɔtow boran dwetɛbona ahaasa no, na ɔdze afona fofor abɔ ntsi, ɔdween dɛ nkyɛ oboku David.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Zeruia ba Abishai boaa no, na ɔbɔɔ Filistianyi no, na okum no. Nna David ne mbarimba no kaa ntam guu no do, dɛ, Mma nnye hɛn mmfir edzi nnkɔ nkɔko bio, amma eenndum Israel kandzea no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyi n’ekyir no, wɔnye Filistiafo no nya ɔko bio wɔ Gob; nna Husatnyi Sibekai kum Saf a ɔyɛ ɔkraban no ne mba no mu bi no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na wɔnye Filistiafo no nyaa ɔko bio wɔ Gob; na Bɛtlɛhɛmnyi Elhanan, Jaare-oregim ne ba no, okum Gitinyi Goliat a ne peaa no kura tse dɛ ɔtanwemfo n’asadua.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔko baa bio wɔ Gat, mbrɛ ɔbarimba pankor bi a ɔwɔ nsakum do nsatseaba esia esia, na anansa do anansɔba esia esia ma no dodow yɛ eduonu anan; na ɔno so wɔwoo no maa ɔkraban.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na aber a orutwitwa Israel mpoa no, David no nua Simei ne ba Jonatan kum no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Woyinom baa nan yi wɔwowoo hɔn maa akraban no wɔ Gat; na wɔtotɔree wɔ David, na no nkowaa no hɔn nsaano.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David kaa ndwom yi mu nsɛm kyerɛɛ EWURADZE wɔ da a EWURADZE yii no fii n’atamfo nyinara nsamu, na Saul nsamu no:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE nye mo botan, na m’akoban, na me gyefo, mara medze a;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Mo botantsim Nyankopɔn a, no mu na muguan modɔ; M’akokyɛm, na mo nkwagye ambɛn, m’abantsentsen, na mo guansumabew; M’agyenkwa, ɔwo na egye me fi akakabensɛm mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Mubosu afrɛ EWURADZE, ɔno a ɔsɛ dɛ woyi no ayɛw no: Nna wɔbɛgye me efi m’atamfo nsamu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na owu asorɛkye twaa mo ho hyiae, Mbusubɔ nsuyirii maa mo bo tui.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Samanadze ahoma brabraa mo ho: Owu ne mfir baa mo do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: M’ahokyer mu musui frɛɛ EWURADZE, Nyew, me Nyankopɔn na mekaa mu frɛɛ no: Na ofi n’asɔrfi mu tsee me ndze, Na me nkekamu kodur n’asomu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna asaase hihimii na ɔwosowee, Ɔsor fapem tutui Na wohihimii, osiandɛ no bo fuwii ntsi.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Wusiw fi n’ahwentokura mu firii, Na ogya fi n’anomu hyeew adze: Ɔmaa biriw sɔe.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ɔkontoom ɔsor so, na odwirii; Na isum kebikebi dzi n’ananadze.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔtsena kerub do, na otui: Nyew, wohun no wɔ mframa ntsaban do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ɔdze isum yɛɛ asese bɔɔ noho aprɔw, Nsu mboaboano, iwimu mununkum kusuww.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Hyerɛn a odzi n’enyim ntsi Ogyabiriw sɔe.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: EWURADZE bobɔɔ mu wɔ sor, Na Ɔsorsornyi no maa wɔtsee ne ndze.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔtotoow ngyen menaba, na ɔhotsee hɔn; Enyinam, na ɔdze kaa hɔn gui.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna epo mu esuka yiyii hɔnho, Wiadze fapem ho dedaa hɔ, Wɔ EWURADZE ne nkaenyim no ntsi, N’ahwentokura mu ehuhuw huuhuw no ntsi.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ɔsomae fi sor bɛfaa me; Ɔtwee me fii nsu pii mu;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ɔgyee me fii me tamfo ɔhoɔdzenfo no, Na hɔn a wokyiir me no nsa; osiandɛ wɔyɛɛ dzen dodow maa me.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Wɔbɔtoatoaa me wɔ m’amandzehu da no mu: Na EWURADZE nye me kyirtaafo.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔdze me so baa mbrɛ ɔtsɛw: Ɔgyee me, osiandɛ n’enyi gyee mo ho.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: EWURADZE tuaa me kaw dɛ mbrɛ me tsenenee tse: Dɛ mbrɛ me nsa ho tsew pa na ɔahyɛ me ananmu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na mesie EWURADZE n’akwan no, Na mommbɔɔ ehuhubra mimmfii me Nyankopɔn ho.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na n’atsɛmbu nyinara wɔ m’enyi do: Na n’ahyɛdze so mimmfii ho.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Midzii mu so wɔ n’afamu, Na misiee moho fii m’emumuyɛ ho.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE ahyɛ me ananmu dɛ mbrɛ me tsenenee tse; Dɛ mbrɛ m’ahofir wɔ n’enyiwa mu tse.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Mbɔbɔrhufo na enye no bedzi no mbɔbɔr mu, Nyia odzi mu na enye no bedzi no emudzi mu;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nyia no ho tsew, na ebɛtsew woho akyerɛ no; Na nyia ɔyɛ nkɔntɔnkye dze ebɛkyea woho akyerɛ no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔman amandzehufo no, ɔwo ebɛgye hɔn: Na w’enyi sa nkontompɔfo, ma aabrɛ hɔn adze.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔwo EWURADZE, na eyɛ me kandzea: Na EWURADZE bɛhyerɛn mo sum mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔwo na medze wo mutu mbirika tsew edɔm mu: Me Nyankopɔn na medze no huruw tra fasu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nyankopɔn dze, no kwan dzi mu: EWURADZE n’asɛm wɔasɔ ahwɛ; Ɔyɛ akokyɛm ma hɔn a woguan toa no nyinara.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na woana nye Nyankopɔn, gyedɛ EWURADZE nko? Na woana yɛ ɔbotan, gyedɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn nko?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nyankopɔn nye m’akoban dzendzen: Na ɔgye nyia odzi mu no wɔ no kwan mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ɔyɛ ne nan dɛ adoa anan: Na ɔdze me si me mbea sorɔnsorɔm do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ɔkyerɛ me nsa akodzi; Ma m’abasa tum kontom boran egyen.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Eso edze wo nkwagye akokyɛm no ama me: Na w’ahobrɛadze ama mayɛ kɛse.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ɔwo atserɛw m’anamɔn mu wɔ m’ase, Na m’anan mmpatserewee.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Metsiw m’atamfo, na masɛɛ hɔn: Nkyii so mannsan bio dze kodur dɛ wowiee sa.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na mahyew hɔn, na mabɔ hɔn ehwira mu, ma wonnkotum soɛr; Nyew, wɔatotɔr wɔ m’ananadze.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔwo na edze ahoɔdzen abɔ me do ama akodzi: Ɔwo abrɛ hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia me no adze ahyɛ m’ase.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ɔwo na ama m’atamfo so adan hɔn ekyir ama me, Ma metwa hɔn a wɔtan me no egu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Wɔhwɛe, na ɔgyefo bi nnyi hɔ: Wɔhwɛɛ EWURADZE mpo, na oemmbua hɔn.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna moboor hɔn anhweanhwea dɛ famu huntuma, Mitsiatsiaa hɔn do dɛ abɔntsen do dɛtse, na mesaaw hɔn petsee.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Eso ɔwo eyi me efi me man hɔn akokoeko mu; Ɔwo ahwɛ me edze me ayɛ amanaman do tsitsir: Ɔman a minnyim hɔn no wɔbɔsom me.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ananaben bɛbrɛ hɔnho adze ama me: Wɔtse me nka ara a, wobetsie me.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ananaben bɛkyenkyen, Na wɔdze ahohim fi hɔn sumabea aba.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: EWURADZE tse ase; na nhyira nka mo botantsim no; Na abɔso nye mo nkwagye botan Nyankopɔn no:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Mekyerɛ Nyame a odzi wer ma me no, Na ɔbrɛ aman adze hyɛ m’ase no,
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔdze me efi m’atamfo mu aba: Nyew, ɔwo na ema me do bɔ hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia me no do: Ɔwo na iyi me fi nyimpa kakaben no nsamu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Dɛm ntsi, EWURADZE, mebɛda wo ase wɔ amanaman mu, Na matow ayɛyindwom ama wo dzin.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nkwagye kɛse na ɔdze ma ne hen: Na ɔyɛ adɔyɛ ma nyia wɔasera no no, David na n’asefo no daa.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Afei iyinom nye David ne nsɛm a odzi ekyir. Jesse ne ba David, Ɔbarimba a wɔakrɔn no no a, Nyia Jakob ne Nyankopɔn no asera no ngo no a, Israel ɔdwontofo pa no se dɛ:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: EWURADZE no sunsum nam mo do kasae, Na n’asɛm duaa me gyirama do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Israel Nyankopɔn no, Mekyerɛ Israel ɔbotan no, kasaa kyerɛɛ me: Nyia odzi adasa do hen tsenenee mu no, Nyia odzi hen Nyankopɔn no suro mu no a,
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ɔtse dɛ anapa kan, aber a wi rupue, Anapa a mununkum nnyi mu; Ɔtse dɛ dɛ ewia a opue nsutɔree ekyir Na ɔma nkyɛkyɛr nomanoma fifir asaase do no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nyew, dɛm na Nyankopɔn esi ehyira me fie; Ɔnye me edzi daa ahyɛmu, Oesiesie ndzɛmba nyinara mu, na oesi no pi: Na mo nkwagye nyinara, na m’apɛdze nyinara nye no, Nyankopɔn bɛma ne nyinara aba mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na emumuyɛfo dze hɔn nyinara bɛyɛ dɛ nsoɛ a wɔrotow egu, Na wonnkotum dze nsa esuo mu:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na nyimpa a orusuo mu no Ohia dɛ ɔdze dadze anaa peaadua yɛ; Na wɔdze ogya bɛhyew no dwɛɛ wɔ hɔn ananmu hɔ ara.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Iyinom nye mbarimba akatakyi a David nyae no hɔn edzin: Joseb-bassebet, Takemonnyi no, nna odzi asafohemfo no mu tsitsir; ɔnoara so nye Adino, Ezininyi no, na ɔmaa ne peaa do wɔ nyimpa ahaawɔtwe a okum hɔn prɛko do no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔno n’ekyir nye Eleazar, Ahohinyi bi ne ba no, mbarimba akatakyi baasa a wɔka David ho wɔ aber a wotwaa Filistiafo a wɔaboaboa ano dɛ wɔrobɔko no mpowa no. Ber a Israel mbarimba no daan hɔn ekyir maa ɔko no,
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: ɔno na ɔsoɛree gyinae na okunkum Filistiafo no ara ma okodur dɛ ne nsa gyenee, na ne nsa kaa afona no ho: na EWURADZE dzii konyim kɛse da no; na ɔman no sanee kedzii n’ekyir dɛ adze ara nko na wɔrokɔfom.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔno n’ekyir nye Samma, Agee Hararnyi no ne ba. Na Filistiafo no boaboaa ano yɛɛ dɔm, baa Israelfo do wɔ mbrɛ asaase tɔw bi a asaduwa ayɛ do ma wɔ; na ɔman no guanee fii Filistiafo no enyim.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔnodze, ogyinaa asaasetɔw no ne finimfin, na ɔperee, na okum Filistiafo no: na EWURADZE dzii konyim kɛse.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na etsitsir eduasa no mu baasa siaan famu, na wɔbaa David nkyɛn twaber mu wɔ Adullam ɔbo tu no mu; nna Filistiafo dɔm no akyer nsera wɔ Refaim ɔbɔn no mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Aber no nna David wɔ itu no mu, na Filistiafo bansifo no so wowɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm aber no mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David no kɔn dɔe, na ɔsee dɛ, Ao kɛtseankyɛ obi aama me Bɛtlɛhɛm nsubura a ɔwɔ kuropon no ho no mu nsu bi ma maanom!
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na mbarimba akatakyi baasa no bɔe faa Filistiafo dɔm no mu, na wɔkɛsaaw Bɛtlɛhɛm nsubura a ɔwɔ kuropon no ho no mu nsu bi, na wɔfae dze brɛɛ David: na ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔnom, na mbom ohuei gui maa EWURADZE.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔmpar me koraa, EWURADZE, dɛ mebɛyɛ iyi: ana monnom mbarimba a wɔdze hɔn nkwa kitsaa hɔn nsamu sii mu kɔree no hɔn bɔgyaa? Dɛm ntsi ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔnom. Iyinom na mbarimba akatakyi baasa no yɛe.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Zeruia ne ba, Joab no nua Abishai nna ɔyɛ baasa no mu otsitsir. Na ɔmaa ne peaa do wɔ ahaasa do kunkum hɔn, na onyaa dzin wɔ baasa no mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ana ɔnnyɛ onyimnyamfo dodow wɔ baasa no mu bi a? Dɛm ntsi wɔyɛɛ no hɔn safohen: naaso ɔannto asɔpɔn baasa no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Afei Jehoiada ne ba Benaia, ɔbarimba bi a ɔyɛ ndam a ofi Kabzeel ne ba no yɛɛ akatakyidze, ɔno na okum Moab nyimpa gyatasɛfo beenu: na osianee so kokum gyata wɔ mona bi mu wɔ esukwankyɛbaber mu:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na ɔnoara so kokum Egyptnyi bi, ɔbarimba kokroko bi: nna Egyptnyi no kitsa peaa wɔ ne nsamu; naaso ɔnodze ɔdze poma sianee kɔr ne nkyɛn, na okohwiim peaa no wɔ Egyptnyi no nsamu, na ɔdze nankasa ne peaa no kum no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ndzɛmba iyinom na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia yɛe, na onyaa dzin wɔ mbarimba akatakyi baasa no mu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ɔyɛɛ onyimnyamfo dodow seen eduasa no, na mbom ɔannto asɔpɔn baasa no. Na David dze no sii n’annkɔbeafo do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Joab no nua Asahel ɔyɛ eduasa no mu baako; Dodo ne ba Elhanan a ofi Bɛtlɛhɛm;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Harodnyi Samma, Harodnyi Elika;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Paltinyi Helez, Tekoanyi Ikkes ba Ira;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Anathotnyi Abiezer, Husatnyi Mebunnai;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ahohnyi Zalmon, Netofatnyi Maharai;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Baana ne ba Heleb, Netofatnyi, Ribai a ofi Benjaminmba Gibea ne ba Itai;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Benaia, Piratnyi, Hidai a ofi Gaas nwora mu;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Abialbon, Arbatnyi, Azmavet, Barhumnyi;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Eliaba, Saalbonnyi, Jasenmba, Jonatan;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Samma, Hararnyi, Sarar ne ba Ahiam, Ararinyi;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Elifelet, Ahasbai ne ba, Maakatnyi ne ba, Ahithofel ne ba Eliam Gilonyi;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Hezro Karmelnyi, Paa-rai, Arbinyi;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Natan a ofi Zoba ne ba Igal, Bani, Gadnyi;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Zelek, Ammonnyi, Naharai, Beerotnyi, Joab, Zeruia ne ba, n’akodzesoafo;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Ira, Itrinyi, Gareb, Itrinyi;
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Uria, Hitinyi: hɔn nyinara yɛ eduasa esuon.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Israel do bio, na opiapiaa David ma ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Kɔ, kɛkan Israel na Juda.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔhen no see dɔm no do safohen Joab a ɔka no ho no dɛ, Afei kɔ kekyin wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu, fi Dan araa kodu Beer-seba, na hom nkan ɔman no, ma munhu ɔman no hɔn dodow.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Joab see ɔhen no dɛ, Afei EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn nka ɔman no ho dɛ mbrɛ hɔn dodow tse biara mbɔho ɔha, na mo wura ɔhen mfa n’enyiwa nhu: na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mo wura ɔhen repɛ dɛm adze yi?
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Naaso ɔhen no n’asɛm yɛɛ dzen wɔ Joab do, na dɔm no mu asafohemfo no do. Na Joab na dɔm no mu asafohemfo no fii ɔhen no enyim sii mu kɔr dɛ wɔrekɛkan Israel ɔman no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na wokotwaa Jordan, na wɔkɔbɔɔ asese wɔ Aroer, kurow a ɔda Gad ɔbɔn no ne finimfin, na odzi kɔ Jazer no, n’enyimfa:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na nkyii wɔbaa Gilead, na Tatim-hodsi asaase do; na wɔbaa Dan-jaan, na wɔponee sii Zidon,
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: na wɔbaa Taere akoban no, na Hivifo, na Keenanfo nkurow nyinara mu: na wopuei kɔr Juda epomu afamu, wɔ Beer-seba.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Dɛm ntsi aber a wokyiin asaase no nyinara do wie no, nna wɔbaa Jerusalɛm abosoom akron na adaduonu n’ewiei.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Joab dze ɔman no hɔn anobu no dodow no brɛɛ ɔhen no: na Israel mu mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam a wɔtwe afona wɔyɛ mpem ahaawɔtwe; na Juda mbarimba no wɔyɛ mpem ahaenum.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David kaan ɔman no n’ekyir no, n’akoma bɔɔ no paa. Na David see EWURADZE dɛ, Mayɛ bɔn kɛsenara wɔ dza mayɛ yi mu: na afei, EWURADZE, meserɛ wo, yi w’akowaa no bɔn kɔ; na mayɛ nkwaseadze dodow.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David soɛɛr anapa no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa nkɔnhyɛnyi Gad, David n’adzehunyi no, nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Kɔ na kɛka kyerɛ David dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, nsɛm ebiasa na medze risi w’enyim; fa no mu kor, ma menyɛ memma wo.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna Gad baa David nkyɛn, na ɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ana mfe esuon kɔm mbra wo do wɔ w’asaase do a? Anaa iboguan wɔ w’atamfo enyim abosoom ebiasa mber a woritsiw wo? Anaa ɔyardɔm mbra w’asaase do ndaansa? Afei hwɛ na hu mbuae kor a memfa mensan menkɛma nyia ɔsomaa me no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David see Gad dɛ, Mo ho akyer me papaara: afei ma yɛnhwe EWURADZE nsamu; na n’ehumbɔbɔr dɔɔ so: na mma mma monnhwe nyimpa nsamu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Nna EWURADZE maa ɔyardɔm baa Israel do fi anapa araa dze kodur mber a ɔhyɛe no: na ɔman a ofi Dan araa dze kodu n’aponto asefo no, no mu nyimpa mpemeduosuon wuwui.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na ɔbɔfo no tseen ne nsa wɔ Jerusalɛm do dɛ ɔresɛɛ no no, EWURADZE sesaa n’adwen wɔ mbusu no ho, na ɔsee ɔbɔfo no a ɔsɛɛ ɔman no dɛ, Ayɛ yie; afei gyina wo nsa. Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no wɔ Jebusnyi Arauna n’ewuporowee no ho.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David hun ɔbɔfo no a okunkum nkorɔfo no, ɔkaa kyerɛɛ EWURADZE dɛ, Hwɛ, mara na mayɛ bɔn, na mara na metwa nkontompɔ: na nguan yi dze, ebɛnadze na wɔayɛ? Meserɛ wo, ma wo nsa mbra emi na m’egya fi do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Gad baa David nkyɛn da no, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, Fow kɔ, na kesi afɔrmbukyia ma EWURADZE wɔ Jebusnyi Arauna n’ewuporowee hɔ.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David fowee kɔree dɛ mbrɛ Gad n’asɛm no tse, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛe no.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Arauna hwɛe, na ohun ɔhen no na no nkowaa no dɛ wɔreba ne nkyɛn: na Arauna fiir edzi, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ ɔhen no enyim dze n’enyim boom famu.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Arauna see dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na mo wura ɔhen reba n’akowaa nkyɛn yi? Na David see dɛ, Morobɔtɔ wo hɔ ewuporowee no mesi afɔrmbukyia, na mabɔ afɔr ama EWURADZE, ma woeesianka yardɔm no efi ɔman no do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na Arauna see David dɛ, Wɔmma mo wura ɔhen mfa na ɔmbɔ afɔr dɛ mbrɛ oye wɔ n’enyi do: hwɛ, anantwi a wɔdze bɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr, na ewuporowee ndzɛmba na anantwi ahyehyɛdze a wɔdze bɛyɛ nyina nye yi:
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: iyi nyinara, mo wura ɔhen, Arauna dze ma ɔhen. Na Arauna see ɔhen no dɛ, EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ntsie wo.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Naaso ɔhen no see Arauna dɛ, Oho; mbom ɔtɔ ara na mobɔtɔ no wo hɔ dɛ mbrɛ no bo tse ara: nkyii so morommbɔ ɔhyew afɔr mma EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn a ɔnnsom me hwee. Nna David tɔɔ ewuporowee no na anantwi no maa dwetɛ dwetɛbona eduonum.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Na David sii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ maa EWURADZE, na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr na asomdwee afɔr. Nna EWURADZE tsiei maa asaase no, na wosiankaa ɔyardɔm no fii Israel do.
title: 2ND SAMUEL

text: Afei nna ɔhen David ayɛ akɔdaa a oedzi mfe pii; ɔwɔ mu dɛ wɔdze atam kataa no do, naaso no ho annyɛ no hyew.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi no nkowaa see no dɛ, Wɔnhwehwɛ ababaawa ɔbaabun bi mbrɛ mo wura ɔhen: na ɔmbɔsom no, na onyiayia no; na ɔnda no bo mu, ma mo wura ɔhen no ho nyɛ no hyew.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna wɔkɔhwehwɛɛ akataasia fɛɛfɛw bi wɔ Israel asaase nyinara mu, na wokohun Abisag, Sunamnyi no, na wɔdze no brɛɛ ɔhen no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na akataasia no no ho yɛ fɛw dodow; na oyiayiaa ɔhen no, na ɔsoom no; naaso ɔhen no ammfa no ho annka no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Hagit ba Adonija memaa noho do, dɛ, Mara na mibedzi hen; na ɔhyehyɛɛ ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo, na mbarimba eduonum a wɔyɛ n’abrampɔfo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na n’egya annka n’enyim aber biara annse dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ayɛ dɛm yi? Nna ɔno so yɛ nyimpa fɛɛfɛw; nna ɔno nye Absalom n’ekyir ba.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔnye Zeruia ba Joab, na ɔsɔfo Abiathar na wotuu egyina: na wodzii n’ekyir boaa no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsɔfo Zadok, na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan, na Simei, na Rei, na David ne mbarimba akatakyi no dze, wɔannka Adonija ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Adonija kunkum nguan na anantwi na mbowa a wɔadodɔ seradze wɔ Zohelet ɔbo a ɔwɔ En-rogel nkyɛn no ho; na ɔtoo nsa frɛfrɛɛ no nuanom ɔhen ne mba no nyinara, na ɔhen no nkowaa Juda mbarimba no nyinara:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: naaso nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan, na Benaia, na mbarimba akatakyi no, na no nua Solomon dze, ɔammfrɛ hɔn bi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Natan kaa kyerɛɛ Solomon ne na Bat-seba, dɛ, Ana ɔwo enntsee dɛ Hagit ne ba Adonija ridzi hen a hɛn wura David nnyim ho hwee bi a?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, bra, ma memma wo akwankyerɛ, ma edze agye wankasa woho nkwa, na wo ba Solomon nkwa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Kɔ na kɛhɛn ɔhen David nkyɛn, na se no dɛ, Ana nnyɛ woara, mo wura ɔhen, na ekaa ntam kyerɛɛ w’afonabaa dɛ, Ampaara me ba Solomon ara na obedzi hen wɔ m’ekyir, na ɔnoara na ɔbɛtsena m’ahengua do no bi a? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na afei Adonija ridzi hen yi?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Hwɛ, aber a ɔwo nye ɔhen da ho rekasa wɔ hɔ no, mo so mibedzi w’ekyir maba, na mabɛhyɛ wo nsɛm no ma.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Bat-seba kɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ pia mu; na ɔhen no ayɛ akɔdaa dodow; na Abisag, Sunamnyi no soom ɔhen no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Bat-seba bɔɔ no mu adze, na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen no enyidzi. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Erohwehwɛ ebɛnadze?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mo wura, ɔwoara dze EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn kaa ntam kyerɛɛ w’afonabaa dɛ, Ampaara wo ba Solomon ara na obedzi hen wɔ w’ekyir, na ɔnoara na ɔbɛtsena m’ahengua do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na afei, hwɛ, Adonija ridzi hen; na ɔwo, mo wura ɔhen, nnyim yi:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na oekuku anantwi na mbowa a wɔadɔ seradze na nguan piigyan, na ɔato nsa afrɛfrɛ ɔhen ne mbabanyin no nyinara, na ɔsɔfo Abiathar, na dɔm safohen panyin Joab: naaso w’akowaa Solomon dze ɔammfrɛ no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔwo, mo wura ɔhen, na Israel nyinara enyi da wo do dɛ ebɛkyerɛ hɔn nyia ɔbɛtsena w’ahengua do wɔ w’ekyir.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ɔno ɔbɛba dɛ, aber a mo wura ɔhen nye n’egyanom bɔkɔ akɛda no, wobobu emi na me ba Solomon ndzebɔnyɛfo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na, hwɛ, mber a ɔda ho nye ɔhen no rekasa no, nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan bae.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no, dɛ, Hwɛ, nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan aba wo hɔ. Na aber a odur ɔhen n’enyim no, ɔbɔɔ no mu adze dze n’enyim boom famu wɔ ɔhen n’enyim.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Natan bisaa dɛ, Mo wura ɔhen, ana ase dɛ, Adonija na ondzi hen wɔ w’ekyir, na ɔno na ɔntsena w’ahengua do a?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na oesian kɔ ndɛ da yi, na oekuku anantwi na mbowa a wɔadodɔ seradze na nguan piigyan, na ɔato nsa afrɛfrɛ ɔhen ne mbabanyin no, na dɔm asafohemfo mpanyin no, na ɔsɔfo Abiathar; na, hwɛ, woridzidzi na wɔronom wɔ n’enyim, na wɔse dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen Adonija nkwa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na emi, mara w’akowaa mpo, na ɔsɔfo Zadok, na Jehoiada ba Benaia, na w’akowaa Solomon dze, oennhyia hɛn.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ana adze yi mo wura ɔhen na ɔyɛe, na annda no edzi annkyerɛ wo nkowaa nyia ɔbɛtsena mo wura ɔhen n’ahengua do wɔ n’ekyir a?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen David buaa dɛ, Wɔmfrɛ Bat-seba mma me. Na ɔbaa ɔhen no n’enyim, na obegyinaa ɔhen no enyim.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen kaa ntam see dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE a oyii me kra fii ahohiahia nyinara mu tse ase yi,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ampaara dɛ mbrɛ medze EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, mekaa ntam mekyerɛɛ wo, dɛ, Ampa wo ba Solomon ara na obedzi hen wɔ m’ekyir, na ɔnoara na ɔbɛtsena m’ahengua do wɔ m’ananmu no; nyew, dɛmara na mebɛyɛ no ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Bat-seba bɔɔ no mu adze dze n’enyim boom famu, na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen no enyidzi na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔmma mo wura ɔhen David ntsena ase daa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen David see dɛ, Wɔmfrɛ ɔsɔfo Zadok, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan, na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia mma me. Na wɔbaa ɔhen no enyim.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no see hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa hom wura no nkowaa no nka hom ho, na wɔmma me ba Solomon ntsena mankasa m’asoasopɔnkɔ do, na wɔmfa no nkɔ Gihon:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na wɔmma ɔsɔfo Zadok na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan nsera no wɔ hɔ nhyɛ no hen wɔ Israel do: na hom mbɔ abɛn no mu nse dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen Solomon nkwa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nkyii hom ndzi n’ekyir mfow mbra, na ɔmbra mbɛtsena m’ahengua do; na ɔno na ondzi hen wɔ m’ananmu: na mahyɛ no dɛ ɔnyɛ ɔpanyin wɔ Israel na Juda do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia buaa ɔhen no na ɔsee dɛ, Amen: EWURADZE, mo wura ɔhen ne Nyankopɔn no so nse dɛmara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE nye mo wura ɔhen tsenae no, mekyerɛ dɛmara so na ɔnye Solomon ntsena, na ɔmma n’ahengua nyɛ kɛse nsen mo wura ɔhen David n’ahengua.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔsɔfo Zadok, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan, na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia, na Keretfo na Peletfo no, sianee kɔree, na wɔmaa Solomon tsenaa ɔhen David n’asoasopɔnkɔ do, na wɔdze no baa Gihon.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsɔfo Zadok faa ngo ambɛn no wɔ Buw no mu, na ɔdze bɛseraa Solomon. Na wɔhɛɛn abɛn no; na ɔman no nyinara see dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen Solomon nkwa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔman no nyinara dzii n’ekyir fowee bae, na ɔman no hɛɛn ntɛntɛbɛn, na hɔn enyi gyee kɛse, ma hɔn dede no maa asaase wosowee.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Adonija na n’aponto asefo no a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no nyinara tsee wɔ aber a wowiee edzidzi no. Na aber a Joab tsee abɛn no ndze no, obisaa dɛ, Kurow no mu dede yi a ayɛ dɛ abɔ ebutuw yi ase nye dɛn?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Mber a ɔda ho rekasa no, hwɛ, ɔsɔfo Abiathar ne ba Jonatan bae: na Adonija see dɛ, Bra dan mu; na ɔwo yɛ nyimpa a efata, na edze nsɛm pa nam.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Jonatan buae see Adonija dɛ, Nokwar hɛn wura ɔhen David ahyɛ Solomon hen:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ɔhen dze ɔsɔfo Zadok, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan, na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia, na Keretfo na Peletfo no aka noho egya no kwan, na wɔama ɔatsena ɔhen n’asoasopɔnkɔ no do:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ɔsɔfo Zadok na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan asera no ahyɛ no hen wɔ Gihon: na wɔdze enyigye dze fi hɔ afow aba, ma kurow no wosoow bio. Iyi nye dede no a hom atse no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na eso Solomon tse ahendzi ahengua no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nkyii so ɔhen no nkowaa no baa behyiraa hɛn wura ɔhen David, dɛ, Wo Nyankopɔn mma Solomon ne dzin nyɛ yie nsen wo dzin, na ɔmma n’ahengua nyɛ kɛse nsen w’ahengua: na ɔhen bɔɔ no mu adze wɔ mpa no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na eso mbrɛ ɔhen no see nye yi, Nhyira nka EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no a ɔama obi atsena m’ahengua do ndɛ da yi, ma mara m’enyiwa ehu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Adonija n’aponto asefo no nyinara suroi, na wɔsoɛrsoɛree na nyimpa biara faa no kwan kɔree.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Adonija suroi wɔ Solomon ntsi; na ɔsoɛree kosuoo afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Solomon, dɛ, Hwɛ, Adonija suro ɔhen Solomon: na, hwɛ, oekosuo afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn mu, dɛ, Wɔmma ɔhen Solomon ndzi kan nka ntam nkyerɛ me ndɛ da yi dɛ ɔnnkɛfa afona eku n’akowaa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon see dɛ, Sɛ ɔnoara kyerɛ dɛ ɔyɛ nyimpa a ɔfata a, no nhwi bi ronntɔ famu: na sɛ wohu emumuyɛ wɔ no mu dze a, obowu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen Solomon somae ma wɔkɛfaa no fii afɔrmbukyia no ho sianee bae. Na ɔbae na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔhen Solomon enyidzi: na Solomon see no dɛ, Kɔ wo fie.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei David ne nda bɛɛn dɛ obowu; na ɔhyɛɛ ne ba Solomon, dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Morokɔ asaase do nkorɔfo nyinara kwan no: dɛm ntsi hyɛ dzen, na yɛ woho ɔbarimba;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na sie EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn n’ahwɛdodze no, dɛ ebɛnantsew n’akwan mu, dɛ ibesie n’ahyɛdze, na ne mbransɛm, na n’atsɛmbu, na ne dasesɛm, dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra no mu tse no, ama aayɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ dza eyɛ nyinara mu, na beebiara so a edan woho fa:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ama EWURADZE aama n’asɛm a ɔkae no wɔ mo ho no etsim, dɛ, Sɛ wo mba hwɛ hɔn kwan yie, dɛ wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara na hɔn kra nyinara bɛnantsew m’enyim nokwar mu a, ɔnodze (ɔse dɛ) Israel ahengua do nyimpa rommbɔ wo da.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nkyii so ɔwoara nyim dza Zeruia ba Joab so dze yɛɛ me, mekyerɛ dza ɔdze yɛɛ Israel dɔm mu asafohemfo beenu no, Ner ne ba Abner, na Jeter ne ba Amasa a okunkum hɔn na ɔkaa ɔsa mu bɔgya gui wɔ asomdwee ber mu, na ɔdze ɔsa mu bɔgya kekaa n’abɔdo a ɔbɔ n’asen ho, na ne mpaboa a ɔhyɛ n’anan ho no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi yɛ no dɛ mbrɛ wo nyansaa tse, na mma mma ne tsigon nnsian nnkɔ adakamona mu asomdwee mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Mbom Gileadnyi Barzillai ne mba no na kyerɛ ayamuyie wɔ hɔn do, na ma wɔmfora hɔn a wodzidzi wo pon do no mu. Osiandɛ wɔyɛɛ me ayamuyie wɔ aber a mifii wo nua Absalom enyim muguanee no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na afei hwɛ, Benjaminnyi Simei, Gera ne ba no a ofi Bahurim no wɔ wo nkyɛn, ɔno na ɔdze ndom yerɛyerɛw doom me da no a mokɔr Mahanaim no: naaso ekyir no osianee behyiaa me kwan wɔ Jordan do, na medze EWURADZE kaa ntam kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, Emi mara dze meremmfa afona munnku wo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei mma ɔmmfa noho tɔtrɔtɔ, na ɔwoara yɛ onyansafo yi, ibohu dza ɔsɛ dɛ edze yɛ no, na ama ne tsigon dze bɔgya eesian akɔ adakamona mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna afei David kɛkaa n’egyanom ho wɔ nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ David kurow no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nda a David dze dzii Israel do hen yɛ mfe eduanan: odzii hen mfe esuon wɔ Hebron, na odzii hen mfe eduasa ebiasa wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon tsenaa n’egya David n’ahengua do; na n’ahendzi tsiim dzendzenndzen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Hagit ne ba Adonija baa Solomon ne na Bat-seba nkyɛn. Na Bat-seba bisaa no dɛ, Eba no asomdwee mu anaa? Na obuaa dɛ, Asomdwee mu a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Adonija see dɛ, Mowɔ asɛm bi ka kyerɛ wo. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ka ɛ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Adonija see dɛ, Ɔwoara inyim dɛ ahendzi no yɛ medze, na Israel nyinara dze hɔn enyi sii mo do dɛ mara na mibedzi hen: naaso ahendzi no adan, na ɔakɛyɛ mo nua dze: na EWURADZE na ɔama ɔayɛ nedze.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na afei ebisadze kor pɛ na miribisa no wo hɔ, mma nnkam me. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ka ɛ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Adonija see dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ka kyerɛ ɔhen Solomon, (na ɔrennse wo dɛ oho,) ma ɔmfa Sunamnyi Abisag mma me ayewar.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Bat-seba see dɛ, Oye; mebɛka akyerɛ ɔhen ama wo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi Bat-seba sii mu kɔr ɔhen Solomon nkyɛn, dɛ ɔrekɛkasa akyerɛ no ama Adonija. Na ɔhen no soɛree kehyiaa no, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze maa no, na ɔkɛtsenaa n’ahengua do, na ɔmaa wɔdze ahengua besii hɔ maa ne na; na ɔtsenaa do wɔ n’enyimfa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Bat-seba see no dɛ, Ebisadze ketseabaa bi na miribebisa wɔ wo hɔ; mma nnkam me. Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, Me na, bisa ɛ: na merennkam wo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ma wɔmfa Sunamnyi Abisag mma wo nua Adonija ayewar.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Solomon buae na ɔsee ne na dɛ, Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na iribisa Sunamnyi Abisag ama Adonija? Bisa ahendzi no so ma no ɛ; na ɔno nye mo nua panyin; bisa ma ɔno, na ɔsɔfo Abiathar, na Zeruia ba Joab.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen Solomon dze EWURADZE kaa ntam, dɛ, Nyankopɔn nyɛ me dɛm, na bi so nka ho, se Adonija nnkaa asɛm yi nntsiaa nankasa no nkwa a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei dɛ EWURADZE a oetsintsim me, na ɔdze me atsena m’egya David n’ahengua do, na ɔdze ama menye m’asefo dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ anohoba no, tse ase yi, ampa woboku Adonija ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Solomon nam Jehoiada ne ba Benaia ne nsa do somae; na okotui hyɛɛ no do, ma owui.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no see ɔsɔfo Abiathar dɛ, Kɔ wankasa wo haban mu, wɔ Anathot; na efata owu dze naaso murunnku wo, osiandɛ ɔwo na esoaa EWURADZE Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no wɔ m’egya David enyim, na ihun amandze wɔ dza m’egya hun mu amandze no nyinara mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Solomon paam Abiathar dɛ ɔnnyɛ ɔsɔfo mma EWURADZE bio; ama ɔaahyɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔkae no wɔ Eli fi ho wɔ Siloh no ma.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na amandzɛɛ no dur Joab nkyɛn: na kaansa Joab ɔanndan ennkedzi Absalom ekyir mpo a, ɔadan ekedzi Adonija ekyir. Na Joab guanee kɔr EWURADZE no Buw no mu, na okosuoo afɔrmbukyia no ne mmbɛn mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen Solomon dɛ, Joab eguan kɔ EWURADZE no Buw no mu, na hwɛ, ɔwɔ afɔrmbukyia no ho. Nna Solomon somaa Jehoiada ne ba Benaia dɛ, Kɔ, kotu hyɛ no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Benaia kɔr EWURADZE no Buw no mu, na ɔkɛsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, Pue bra. Na ɔsee dɛ, Dabida; mubowu ha ara. Na Benaia dze asɛm brɛɛ ɔhen bio, dɛ, Mbrɛ Joab se nye yi, na mbrɛ oebua me nye yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, Yɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔase no ara, na tu hyɛ no do, na sie no; ama eeyi bɔgya a Joab kae guu gyan no efi emi na m’egya fie do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE mma no bɔgyaa nsan ngu nankasa n’etsifi, osiandɛ otui hyɛɛ mbarimba beenu a wɔtsen na woye sen no no do, na ɔdze afona kunkum hɔn, ber a m’egya David nnyim ho hwee, hɔn nye, Ner ne ba Abner, Israel dɔm mu ɔsafohen, na Jeter ne ba Amasa, Juda dɔm mu ɔsafohen no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na hɔn bɔgyaa bɛsan ebogu Joab n’etsifi, na n’asefo etsifi daa: na David, na n’asefo na ne fie, na n’ahengua dze, wobenya EWURADZE hɔ asomdwee daa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Jehoiada ne ba Benaia sii mu kɔree, na okotui hyɛɛ no do, na okum no, na wokesiee no wɔ nankasa ne fie wɔ sar no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no dze Jehoiada ne ba Benaia hyɛɛ n’ananmu wɔ dɔm no do: na ɔhen no dze ɔsɔfo Zadok hyɛɛ Abiathar n’ananmu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no somaa ma wokehyiaa Simei, na ɔsee no dɛ, Si dan ma woho wɔ Jerusalɛm, na tsena hɔ, na mma mmfi hɔ mmpue nnkɔ beebiara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na da no ara a ibopue, na ekotwa ɔwora Kidron no, ɔno hu no ampaara dɛ, owu ara na ibowu: wo bɔgyaa bogu wankasa w’etsifi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Simei see ɔhen no dɛ, Asɛm no ye: dɛ mbrɛ mo wura ɔhen ase no, dɛmara so na w’akowaa bɛyɛ. Na Simei tsenaa Jerusalɛm nda pii.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe ebiasa ekyir no, Simei no nkowaa mu beenu guanee kɔr Maaka ne ba Akis, Gat hen no nkyɛn. Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Simei, dɛ, Hwɛ, wo nkowaa no wɔ Gat.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Simei soɛree, na ɔhyehyɛɛ n’asoaso, na osii mu kɔr Akis nkyɛn wɔ Gat, dɛ ɔrokɔhwehwɛ no nkowaa no: na ɔkɛfaa hɔn fi Gat bae.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Solomon dɛ, Simei efi Jerusalɛm akɔ Gat, na ɔaba bio.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no somaa ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ Simei, na obisaa no dɛ, Ana mamma ammfa EWURADZE annka ntam, na menndzi wo dase, dɛ, Da no ara a ibopue akɛnantsenantsew beebiara no, ɔno hu no ampaara dɛ, owu ara na ibowu? Na ɔwoara see me dɛ, Asɛm a matse no oye.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na enndzi EWURADZE ne ntam, na mbrasɛm a medze hyɛɛ wo no do?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nkyii so ɔhen no see Simei dɛ, Ɔwoara nyim emumuyɛ nyinara a w’akoma nyim a edze yɛɛ m’egya David no: dɛm ntsi EWURADZE bɛdan w’emumuyɛ no egu wankasa w’etsifi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Solomon dze, nhyira bɛka no, na David n’ahengua no betsim wɔ EWURADZE enyim daa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen no hyɛɛ Jehoiada ne ba Benaia; na ofiir edzi kokum no. Na ahendzi no tsimii wɔ Solomon ne nsamu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon nye Egypthen Farao yɛɛ asew, na ɔfaa Farao ne babaa waar no, na ɔdze no baa David kurow mu, dze kodur dɛ owiee nankasa ne dan, na EWURADZE ne dan, na Jerusalɛm ho fasu no nyina tow ana.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Naaso mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do ara nko na ɔman no bɔɔ afɔr, osiandɛ ɔdze bodur dɛm ber no, nna wonnsii dan mmaa EWURADZE ne dzin.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon dɔɔ EWURADZE, ɔnantseew n’egya David n’ahyɛdze no mu: na mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do ara nko na ɔbɔɔ afɔr na ɔhyeew eduhuam.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no sii mu kɔr Gibeon dɛ ɔrokɔbɔ afɔr wɔ hɔ; osiandɛ ɔno na ɔyɛ bea sorɔnsorɔm kɛse: ɔhyew afɔr apem na Solomon bɔɔ no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Gibeon na EWURADZE daa noho edzi kyerɛɛ Solomon wɔ adaaso mu anadwe: na Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Bisa dza memfa memma wo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon see dɛ, Ɔwo na akyerɛ w’akowaa m’egya David do ayamuyie kɛse, dɛ mbrɛ ɔnantseew w’enyim nokwar mu, na ndzeyɛtsenenee mu na wo ho akoma mu tsenenee mu; na ɔwo edze ayamuyie kɛse yi esie ama no, dɛ ɔwo ama no ɔba dɛ ɔntsena n’ahengua do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na afei, EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn, ɔwo na ahyɛ w’akowaa ɔhen ahyɛ m’egya David n’ananmu: na emi dze, meyɛ abofra kakraba; minnyim mbrɛ wodua fir edzi anaa wɔba mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na w’akowaa wɔ wo man a ɔwoara asan mu eyi hɔn no mu, ɔman kɛse a hɔn dodow ntsi wonntum hɔn kan na wommbu ano so.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi ma w’akowaa ntseasee akoma ma memfa mumbu wo man atsɛn, na munhu papa na bɔn mu; na woana na obotum ebu wo man kɛse yi atsɛn?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na kasa no yɛɛ EWURADZE fɛw, dɛ Solomon ebisa adze a ɔtse dɛm.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Nyankopɔn see no dɛ, Osiandɛ ebisa adze yi, na emmbisa nkwa tsentsen amma woho; nkyii so emmbisa ahonya amma woho, na emmbisa w’atamfo hɔn nkwa so; na mbom ebisa ntseasee a wɔdze hu atsɛmbu mu ama woho ntsi;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: hwɛ, mayɛ no dɛ mbrɛ w’ebisadze tse no ara: hwɛ, mama wo nyansa na ntseasee akoma; ma obiara a odzi w’enyim nntse dɛ ɔwo, nkyii so w’ekyir obiara ronnsoɛr a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na eso medze dza ɔwoara emmbisa so mama wo, ahonya na enyidzi nyina, ma ahemfo mu obiara rennye wo nnsɛ wɔ wo nda nyinara mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na sɛ enantsew m’akwan mu, dɛ idzi m’ahyɛdze na me mbransɛm do, dɛ mbrɛ w’egya David nantsewee no a, ɔno mebɛma wo nda awar.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon nyanee, na hwɛ, adaaso a: na ɔbaa Jerusalɛm, na obegyinaa EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no enyim, na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr, na ɔbɔɔ asomdwee afɔr, na ɔtoo no nkowaa nyinara pon.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Da bi mbaa beenu a wɔyɛ ehuhufo, dze hɔn asɛm baa ɔhen no hɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa baako no see dɛ, Ao mo wura, emi na ɔbaa yi yɛtse fie kor mu; na mowoo ɔba wɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ fie no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, mowoe n’ekyir da a otsia ebiasa no, nna ɔbaa yi so woe; na yɛwɔ fakor; ɔhɔho bi nnka hɛn ho wɔ fie no mu, gyedɛ hɛn beenu ara na yɛwɔ fie no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa yi ne ba wuu anadwe no; osiandɛ ɔdaa no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsoɛɛr esuom, na ɔbɛfaa me ba wɔ me nkyɛn, mber a w’afonabaa ada, na ɔdze no too no bo mu, na ɔdze ne ba a oewu no too mo bo mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aber a mosoɛɛr anapa no dɛ merema me ba enumfo no, hwɛ, nna oewu: na mohwɛɛ no yie anapa no, nna hwɛ, nnyɛ me ba a mowoo no no bi a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa kor no so see dɛ, Dabida; ɔnnyɛ nokwar na emi me ba nye onyikamfo no, na wo ba nye owufo no. Na oyi se dɛ, Oho; na wo ba nye owufo no, na me ba nye onyikamfo no. Na mbrɛ wɔkasae wɔ ɔhen enyim nye yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen no see dɛ, Oyi se dɛ, Me ba na ɔtse ase yi, na wo ba nye owufo no: na oyi so se dɛ, Dabida; mbom wo ba nye owufo no, na me ba nye onyikamfo no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Wɔmbrɛ me afona. Na wɔdze afona baa ɔhen no enyim.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Wɔnkyɛ ɔba onyikamfo no mu ebien, wɔmfa ɔfa mma ɔbaako, na wɔmfa ɔfa mma ɔbaako so.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔbaa a ɔba onyikamfo no yɛ nedze no kasaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no, osiandɛ no nson burbuur no wɔ ne ba no ho, na ɔsee dɛ, Ao, mo wura, wɔmfa ɔba onyikamfo no mma no, na mma wonnku no ara da. Na ɔbaako no dze ɔsee dɛ, Mma ɔnnyɛ medze eso ɔnnyɛ wodze; wɔnkyɛ mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen no buae dɛ, Wɔmfa ɔba nyikamfo no mma nyia ɔse mma wonnku no no, na mma wonnku no ara da: osiandɛ ɔno nye ne na.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israel nyinara tsee atsɛmbu a ɔhen no bui no; na wosuroo ɔhen no; osiandɛ wohun dɛ Nyankopɔn ne nyansaa wɔ no mu, dɛ obobu atsɛn.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Solomon dzii Israel nyinara do hen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na woyinom nye asafohemfo a onyae; Zadok ne ba Azaria nye ɔsɔfo;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Elihoref na Ahija, Sisa ne mba no, nye akyerɛwfo; Jehosafat, Ahilud ne ba no, nye ɔsɛnkaafo;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia na ɔhwɛ dɔm no do; na Zadok na Abiathar nye asɔfo;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na Natan ne ba Azaria na ɔhwɛ ahwɛdofo no do; na Natan ne ba Zabud na ɔyɛ ɔsɔfo, na ɔhen no fotufo;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na Ahishar na ɔhwɛ fidua no do; na Abda ne ba Adoniram na ɔhwɛ ɔtowyi edwuma no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Solomon wɔ ahwɛdofo duebien wɔ Israel nyinara do a wɔdze edziban ma ɔhen na ne fidua: nyimpa baako wɔ dɛ ɔma edziban bosoom kor wɔ afrenhyia mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na hɔn edzin nye yi: Ben-hur wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ben-deker, wɔ Makaz, na Saalbim, na Bɛt-semes, na Elon-beth-hanan:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ben-hesed, wɔ Aru-bot; ɔno na Soko, na Hefer asaase nyinara dzi wɔ no:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ben-abinadab, wɔ Dor akoko do nyinara; onyaa Solomon ne babaa Tafat waar no;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ahilud ne ba Baana, wɔ Taanak na Megiddo, na Bɛt-sean nyinara a ɔwɔ Zaretan ne nkyɛn, wɔ Jezreel ase, ifi Bɛt-sean kodu Abel-mehola, dze kodu Jokmeam egya.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ben-geber, wɔ Ramot-gilead; ɔno na Manaasɛ ne ba Jair no nkurow a ɔwɔ Gilead no, dzi wɔ no: ɔnoara so na Argob asaase a ɔwɔ Bashan, nkurow akɛse eduosia a no ho wɔ afasu na boran adaban no, yɛ nedze:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Iddo ne ba Ahinadab, wɔ Mahanaim:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ahimaaz, wɔ Naftali; ɔno so faa Solomon ne babaa Basemat waar no:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Husai ne ba Baana, wɔ Aser na Bealot:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Parua ne ba Jehosafat, wɔ Isakar:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ela ne ba Simei, wɔ Benjamin:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Uri ne ba Geber, wɔ Gilead asaase do, wɔ Amorifo Sihon na Bashanhen Ɔge ɔman mu; na ɔno nye ɔhwɛdofo kortonoo a ɔwɔ asaase no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Juda na Israel wɔdɔɔ so, hɔn dodow tse dɛ mpoano anhwea, wodzidzi na wɔnom na hɔn enyi gye.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon dzii hen wɔ ahenman a ofi Esutsen no ho nyinara dze kodu Filistiafo asaase do, na Egypt he do: wɔdze ayɛyɛdze bae, na wɔsoom Solomon wɔ no nkwa nda no nyinara mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon ne dakor edzidzi ɔyɛ isiam pa etwadze eduasa na eburow isiam etwadze eduosia;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: anantwi a wɔadɔ seradze du, na edzidzibea do anantwi eduonu, na nguan ɔha, ɔsor ntorɔm, na ndoa na nwansan, na ntumbowa a wɔadɔ seradze.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Osiandɛ ɔno na ɔwɔ tum wɔ Esutsen no n’afa ha asaase no nyinara do, ofi Tifsa araa dze bodu Gaza, wɔ Esutsen n’afa ha ahemfo nyinara do: na onyaa amandwee wɔ nkyɛnkyɛn nyinara a abɔ no ho aprɔw.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Juda na Israel tsenaa no dwudwoodwo, nyimpa biara wɔ no wenyindua ase na n’adɔmbadua ase, ofi Dan araa kodu Beer-seba, wɔ Solomon nda nyinara mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon wɔ ne ntseaseanam ho mpɔnkɔdan mu mpɔnkɔ mpemeduanan, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemduebien.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ahwɛdofo no hwehwɛɛ edziban maa ɔhen Solomon, na hɔn a wɔbaa ɔhen Solomon no pon ho nyinara, nyimpa biara wɔ no bosoom mu: wɔmma hwee nnhia.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔdze atoko so na efuw a wɔdze ma mpɔnkɔ na mbowa a hɔn ho yɛ har baa beebi mbrɛ ahwɛdofo no wɔwɔ, nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ n’ahwɛdodze tse no ara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Nyankopɔn maa Solomon nyansa na ntseasee dodow mbordo, na akoma a ɔtrɛ, dɛ mpoano anhwea.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon ne nyansaa so sen bokamba no nyinara hɔn nyansaa, na Egypt nyansa nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔyɛ nyansafo sen nyimpa nyinara; ɔsen Ezranyi Etan, na Mahol ne mba, Heman, Kalkol, na Darda: na ne nka tahyee amanaman nyinara mu hyiae.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na obubuu mbɛ mpensa: na no ndwom yɛ apem nye enum.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔkaa ndua ho asɛm, ofi nkyindur a ɔwɔ Lebanon do araa dze kodu odwonhataw a ofifir fasu mu do: na ɔkaa mbowadoma, na ntumbowa, na nketsembowa, na esunam so ho asɛm.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aman nyinara mu nyimpa bi baa dɛ woribetsie Solomon ne nyansaa, wofi asaase do ahemfo a wɔtsee ne nyansaa nka no nyinara nkyɛn bae.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Taerehen Hiram yɛ David no dɔfo daa ntsi ɔtsee dɛ Solomon na wɔasera no ahyɛ no hen wɔ n’egya n’ananmu no, ɔsomaa no nkowaa ma wɔbaa ne nkyɛn.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon somaa ma wɔkɔr Hiram nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ɔwoara nyim mbrɛ m’egya David sii na oenntum ennsi dan amma EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn ne dzin, wɔ akokoeko a nna etwa no ho ehyia no ntsi, dze kodur dɛ EWURADZE dze hɔn hyɛɛ n’ananadze.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na afei EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn ama me ahomgye wɔ afa nyinara; ɔtamfo bi nnyi hɔ, na esian bi so nnyi hɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na, hwɛ, mesua dɛ miribesi dan ama EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn ne dzin, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ m’egya David no, dɛ, Wo ba a medze no bɛhyɛ w’ananmu atsena w’ahengua do no, na obesi dan ama me dzin.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei hyɛ ma wontwa nkyindur ndua wɔ Lebanon mma me; na mo nkowaa bɛba abɛka wo nkowaa ho; na mebɛma wo apaabɔdze ma edze aama wo nkowaa dɛ mbrɛ ebɛka nyinara: osiandɛ ɔwoara nyim dɛ obi nnyi hɛn mu a ɔwɔ nduatwa ho nyansa dɛ Zidonfo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Hiram tsee Solomon ne nsɛm no, odzii dɛw kɛsenara, na ɔsee dɛ, Ndɛ da yi, nhyira nka EWURADZE a ɔama David ɔba nyansafo wɔ ɔman kɛse yi do no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Hiram somaa ma wɔkɔr Solomon nkyɛn, dɛ, Matse nkra a esomaa ma wɔdze baa me nkyɛn no: mebɛyɛ w’apɛdze a ɔwɔ nkyindur ndua, na ɔpepeaa ho no nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Mo nkowaa dze befi Lebanon do esian aba po ho: na mebɛkyer no mpanta edua po do akɔ bea a ɔwoara ebɛkyerɛ me no, na mama wɔasansan wɔ hɔ, na abɛgye: na wo so ayɛ m’ahwehwɛdze, dɛ ebɛma me fiefo edziban.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Hiram maa Solomon nkyindur ndua na ɔpepeaa dɛ mbrɛ n’ahwehwɛdze tse nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon so maa Hiram ewifua etwadze mpem eduonu dɛ ne fiefo edziban, na ngo krɔnkrɔn etwadze eduonu: dɛm na Solomon dze maa Hiram afrenhyia afrenhyia.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE maa Solomon nyansa, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ no anohoba no; na asomdwee daa Hiram na Solomon ntamu; na hɔn beenu no bɔɔ mu yɛɛ kor.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Solomon gyee Israel nyinara hɔ ɔtowyi edwuma; na ɔtowyi edwuma ho nyimpa yɛ mpem eduasa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsomaa hɔn wɔ Lebanon do, nyimpa mpemdu bosoom esiado esiado: bosoom na wodzi wɔ Lebanon do, na abosoom ebien na wodzi wɔ fie: na Adoniram na ɔhwɛ ɔtowyi edwuma no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Solomon wɔ ndzesoadzefo mpemeduosuon, na mbepɔw no do nduatwafo mpemeduowɔtwe;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ɔsor Solomon n’ahwɛdofo etsitsir a wɔhwɛ edwuma no do, nyimpa mpemebiasa ahaasa a wɔhwɛ nkorɔfo a wɔyɛ edwuma no do no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ ma wɔpaa abo akɛse, abo a ɔsom bo, dɛ wɔdze abo a wɔasen bɛhyɛ dan no ne fapem.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon n’adansifo na Hiram n’adansifo na Gebalfo no sensenee, na wosiesiee ndua na abo dɛ wɔdze besi dan no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Israelmba fii Egypt bae no n’ekyir afe a otsia ahaanan edwuowɔtwe no mu no, nna Solomon dzii Israel do hen no n’afe a otsia anan nye no, wɔ bosoom Ziv a ɔyɛ bosoom a otsia ebien no mu no, nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ orisi EWURADZE ne dan no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdan a ɔhen Solomon sii maa EWURADZE no, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduasa, na ne tɛtɛr basafa du, na no krɔn basafa duenum.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na abrandaa a ɔwɔ asɔrfi dan no enyim no, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa du, dɛ mbrɛ ɔdan no ne tɛtɛr no tse no; na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa enum wɔ ɔdan no enyim.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ɔdan no ho ntokura a atenadwuma tsintsim mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔtotoow ɔdan no ne fasu ho asansansamdo hyiae, twitwaa ɔdan no n’afasu ho hyiae, asɔrfi no na mpiakyir nyina ho: na ɔyɛɛ mpiakyir mpiakyir hyiae:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ase ɔsansansamdo no ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebien nye fa, na finimfin dze no ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebiasa, na dza otsia ebiasa no ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebiasa nye fa: na ɔyɛɛ ɔdan no ne fasu ekyir mbamba hyiae, ma mpuna no annhyɛ ɔdan no n’afasu no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdan no, aber a worisi no, wɔdze ɔbo a woesiesie no wɔ abopuei na wɔdze sii: mber a worisi no, wɔanntse bɔbo, anaa ekuma, anaa edwindadze biara nka wɔ ɔdan no ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Finimfin mpiakyir no n’abow wɔ ɔdan no n’enyimfa afamu: na wɔfow atwer mpomponee dze kɔ finimfin mpia no mu, na wofi finimfin dze no mu kɔ dza otsia ebiasa no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna osii dan no, na owiei; na ɔdze nkyindur mpuna na ntaabow kataa ɔdan no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na osisii asansansamdo no wɔ ɔdan no no ho nyinara, kor no krɔn basafa ebien nye fa: na wɔdze nkyindur mpuna ma osusuoo dan no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Solomon nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS
