text: Ɔwɔ ɔdan yi a irisi ho, sɛ enantsew m’ahyɛdze mu, na eyɛ m’atsɛmbu, na idzi me mbransɛm nyinara do dɛ ebɛnantsew mu a; ɔnodze mebɛma m’asɛm a mekaa mekyerɛɛ w’egya David no etsim ama wo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na mebɛtsena Israelmba mu, na monnkɔpow me man Israel.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Solomon sii dan no, na owiei.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdze nkyindur ntaabow saam ɔdan no mu afasu no ho; ɔdze ndua kataa no mu afasu, fi dan no ne daadze kodur n’enyi nsamdo mpuna no do: na ɔdze kupresi ntaabow saam dan no ne daadze.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdze nkyindur ntaabow sii ɔdan no n’ekyir afamu basafa du fi famu kɛpeem nsamdo mpuna no: mekyerɛ osii dze no mu yɛɛ mpiakyir, mekyerɛ bea krɔnkrɔn no a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdan no, mekyerɛ asɔrfi no a ɔwɔ mpiakyir no enyim no, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdan no mu wɔ nkyindur a woedzi no nkukuduuduw na nhyiren a wɔahanhan edwin: ne nyinara nkyindur a; wonnhu ɔbo biara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na osiesiee mpiakyir wɔ ɔdan no mu finimfin, dɛ wɔdze EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no besi hɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na mpiakyir no mu wɔ ɔkwan a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa du, na ne tɛtɛr basafa du, na no krɔn basafa du; na ɔdze sika mapa duraa ho: na ɔdze nkyindur kataa afɔrpon no ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Solomon dze sika mapa duraa ɔdan no mu: na ɔdze sika ntweaban dze twaa mpiakyir no enyim; na ɔdze sika duraa ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdan no nyina ɔdze sika duraa mu araa kodur dɛ wowiee ɔdan no nyinara: nkyii so ɔdze sika duraa afɔrpon a ɔwɔ mpiakyir no ho nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdze ngodua yɛɛ kerubim ebien wɔ mpiakyir no mu, kor ne tsentsen yɛ basafa enum.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na kerub no n’atsaban kor yɛ basafa ebien nye fa; na kerub no n’atsaban kor no so basafa ebien nye fa: ofi atsaban tsir kor ano dze kodu atsaban tsir kor so ano ɔyɛ basafa enum.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na kerub kor no so yɛ basafa enum: kerubim ebien nyina wɔ nsusui kor na su kor.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Kerub baako no krɔn basafa enum, na kerub baako no so tse dɛmara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdze kerubim no sisii ekyir dan no mu: na kerubim no tserɛtserɛɛw hɔn ntsaban mu, ma ɔbaako n’atsaban ɔka fasu kor, na kerub baako so n’atsaban ɔka fasu kor no so; na hɔn ntsaban no keka enyim wɔ ɔdan no ne finimfin.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdze sika duraa kerubim no ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na odzii dan no n’afasu no nyinara ho edwin hyiae, dɛ ɔdze kerubim, na mbɛdua, na nhyiren a wɔahanhan no ehonyi yɛɛ ho, no mu na n’ekyir.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdan no ne daadze so ɔdze sika durae, no mu na n’ekyir.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdze ngodua yɛɛ mpiakyir ahɛnee no no mbobow: mpondua no etsifi na ne nkyɛnmu ɔyɛ fasu no mu ebupɛn enum mu kor.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔdze ngodua yɛɛ mbobow ebien; na odzii do edwin a ɔyɛ kerubim na mbɛdua na nhyiren a wɔahanhan, na ɔdze sika duraa ho; na ɔtserɛɛw sika no mu kataa kerubfo na mbɛdua no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛmara so na ɔdze ngodua yɛɛ asɔrfi no n’ahɛnee no mpondua no, wɔ fasu no mu ebupɛn anan mu kor;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na kupresidua mbobow ebien; abow kor wɔ afa ebien a ɔbobɔw, na abow kor no so wɔ afa ebien a ɔbobɔw.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na odzii ho edwin, kerubfo na mbɛdua na nhyiren a wɔahanhan: na ɔdze sika duraa ho dze kekae tsintsiim nkrukyei no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdze abo a wɔasen akyerɛpɛn ebiasa, na nkyindur mpuna akyerɛpɛn kor yɛɛ no mu abangua no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afe a otsia anan no mu bosoom Ziv mu, na wɔtoow EWURADZE ne dan no ne fapem.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na afe a otsia dubiako no mu, bosoom Bul a ɔyɛ bosoom a otsia awɔtwe no mu, na wowiee ɔdan no no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, na mbrɛ ne yɛbea no tse nyinara ho afamu. Mfe esuon nna ɔdze sii.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Solomon dze mfe duebiasa sii nankasa n’ahemfie no wiei.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na osii Lebanon kwaa dan no; ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonum, na ne tɛtɛr basafa eduonu enum, na no krɔn basafa duenum, ɔwɔ nkyindur edum akyerɛpɛn anan do, nye nkyindur mpuna gu edum no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔdze nkyindur saam sor wɔ mpuna eduanan enum a ogu edum no do no do; kyerɛpɛn kor mu duenum.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ntokura akyerɛpɛn ebiasa wɔ hɔ, na tokura hwɛ tokura enyim araa ban ebiasa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na mbobow na mpondua no nyinara yɛ nsamdo mpuna atweanan: na tokura hwɛ tokura enyim araa ban ebiasa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ edum abrandaa; ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu enum, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa duenum; na abrandaa bi wɔ hɔn enyim, na edum na mpuna durdur wɔ enyim.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ahengua abrandaa mbrɛ obobu hɔ atsɛn, mekyerɛ atsɛmbu abrandaa no a: na ɔdze nkyindur kataa do fi famu kodur nsamdo enyi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ne fi mbrɛ ɔtse, dampan kor no a ɔwɔ abrandaa no mu afamu no, ne yɛbea tse dɛmara. Ɔyɛɛ dan so a ɔtse dɛ abrandaa yi maa Farao ne babaa, (nyia Solomon waar no no).
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Iyinom nyinara yɛ abo a ɔsom bo, mekyerɛ abo a woetwa woesusu no dɛ wɔdze nseradaa sianee, no mu na n’ekyir, mekyerɛ ofi fapem do kɛpem etsifi, na dɛmara ɔdze fi ekyir afamu kodu pampan kɛse no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na fapem no yɛ abo a ɔsom bo, mekyerɛ abo akɛse a, basafa enum enum abo, na basafa anan anan abo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsor abo a ɔsom bo, mekyerɛ ɔbo a woesusu etwa na nkyindur dua.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na dampan kɛse a ɔbɔ aprɔw no wɔ abo a wɔasen akyerɛpɛn ebiasa, na nkyindur mpuna kyerɛpɛn kor; tse dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE ne dan no no mu afamu na ɔdan no n’abrandaa no tse.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Solomon somae ma wɔkɛfaa Hiram fi Taere bae.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ɔyɛ Naftali ebusuakuw mu ɔbaa okunafo bi ne ba, na n’egya nye ɔbarimba bi a ofi Taere, boran odwimfo a; na nyansa na ntseasee na nyimdzee ahyɛ no ma, dɛ ɔdze dzi boran dwuma nyinara mu edwin. Na ɔbaa ɔhen Solomon nkyɛn, na ɔbɛyɛɛ n’edwuma nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ boran edum ebien no, kor ne tsentsen yɛ basafa akron; na ahoma basafa esia abɔ no ho aprɔw.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ boran ntaadotsir ebien dɛ wɔdze sisi edum no etsifi: ntaadotsir kor no krɔn yɛ basafa ebien nye fa, na ntaadotsir kor so no krɔn yɛ basafa ebien nye fa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Atena a wɔawen no dam dam, na ntweaban kyinkyimii, wɔ ntaadotsir a ɔwɔ edum no etsifi no ho; esuon wɔ ntaadotsir kor ho, na esuon wɔ ntaadotsir kor so ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔyɛɛ edum no; na ɔyɛɛ pɔmegranate eduaba akyerɛpɛn ebien twaa atenadwuma no kor ho hyiae, dze kataa ntaadotsir no a ɔwɔ edum no etsifi no do: na dɛmara so na ɔyɛe maa ntaadotsir kor no so.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ntaadotsir a ɔwɔ abrandaa no mu edum no etsifi no wɔyɛɛ no nsukookoo dwuma, basafa ebien.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na edum ebien no do so wɔ ntaadotsir, ɔbɛn efur a ɔwɔ atenadwuma no ho no ho: na pɔmegranate eduaba no yɛ ahaenu, akyerɛpɛn akyerɛpɛn bɔ ntaadotsir kor no ho aprɔw.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdze edum no sisii asɔrfi no n’abrandaa no ano: na ɔmaa enyimfa dum no do sii, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Jakin: na ɔmaa abankum dum no do sii hɔ, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Boaz.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na edum no etsifi wɔ nsukookoo dwuma: dɛm na ɔdze wiee edum no edwuma no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ogu po no a ofi ano kɛpem ano yɛ basafa enum no, otwa kɔntɔnkrɔn, na no krɔn yɛ basafa ebien nye fa: na ahoma basafa duenum bɔ ho aprɔw hyia.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nkukuduuduw wowɔ n’ano asease dze bɔ no aprɔw hyia, ne tsentsen basafa enum bɔ po no ho aprɔw hyia: nkukuduuduw no a wogui no woguu no akyerɛpɛn ebien.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ɔtaa anantwi duebien do, ebiasa hwɛ kwaamu afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ anee afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ pomu afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ boka afamu: na po no taa hɔn do wɔ sor, na hɔn ekyir nyinara wɔ no mu afamu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ne peperepee yɛ nsatseama; na n’ano no wɔyɛɛ no dɛ kɔɔpow ano, ɔtse dɛ nsukookoo ne nhyiren a ahan: odzi galɔn mpemdu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ boran eguarsɛn ase ndaka du; adaka kor ne tsentsen yɛ basafa ebien, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebien, na no krɔn yɛ basafa kor nye fa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na mbrɛ eguarsɛn ase ndaka no ne nyɛbea tse nye yi: wɔwowɔ nhyehyɛmu; na nhyehyɛmu no hyehyɛ ngua no ntamu:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ngyata, anantwi, na kerubfo wowɔ ngua no ntamu nhyehyɛmu no do, na ngyinado bi wɔ ngua no do ɔsor: na ngyata na anantwi no ase wɔ ahaban nkyekyeree a ɔsensɛn hɔ edwuma.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na adaka biara wɔ boran ntwahonan anan, na boran nhyehyɛmundua: na ne nan anan no wɔ nsusuomunsa: egurasɛn no ase na nsusuomunsa bi a woegu, ka ahaban nkyekyeree ho wɔ ne nkyɛnkyɛn.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na n’ano wɔ ntaadotsir no no mu na no do afamu yɛ anamɔn kor nye fa: na n’ano yɛ korkorba tse dɛ ngyinado dwuma bi, bɛyɛ anamɔn ebien nye fa: na wodzidzii n’ano so edwin, na ne nhyehyɛmu no yɛ etwaanan, ɔnnyɛ nkorkorba.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ntwahonan anan no wowɔ nhyehyɛmu ntrɛtraba no ase; na ntwahonan no ne nhyɛmu ndua no hyehyɛ adaka no mu: na ntwahonan kor no krɔn yɛ anamɔn ebien nye fa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ntwahonan no ne nyɛbea tse dɛ tseaseanam ntwahonan nyɛbea: ne nhyɛmu ndua, no ho nsusuomudze, na ne hankra ano, na ne mparba, na ne finimfintu nyinara, wogui.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nsusuomunsa anan wowɔ adaka kor no kutuw anan no ho: adaka no ara mu na no nsusuomunsa no wɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na adaka no n’etsifi no wɔyɛɛ no korkorba a no krɔn yɛ bɛyɛ anamɔn kor hyia: na adaka no n’etsifi na ne nsa na ne nhyehyɛmu ntrɛtraba no a ofi kor no ara mu no wɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na odzii ne nsa ne ntɛrba, na ne nhyehyɛmu ntrɛtraba no do edwin, kerubfo ngyata na mbɛdua, dɛ mbrɛ kor ne ntamu tse, nye ahaban nkyekyeree bɔ aprɔw.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ndaka du no mbrɛ ɔyɛe no nye yi: ne nyinara wɔ gubea kor, nsusui kor, na isu kor.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ boran eguarsɛn du: eguarsɛn kor dzi galɔn ahaanan: na eguarsɛn biara yɛ basafa ebien: na eguarsɛn kor wɔ ndaka du no mu kor biara no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdze ndaka no sisii, enum wɔ ɔdan no n’enyimfa afamu, na enum so wɔ ɔdan no n’abankum afamu: na ɔdze po no sii ɔdan no ne nyimfa afamu wɔ boka afamu a ɔhwɛ pomu afamu no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Hiram yɛɛ eguarsɛn, na nsofi, na mbɛɛsen no. Nna Hiram wiee edwuma a ɔyɛe maa ɔhen Solomon wɔ EWURADZE ne fi no ho nyinara yɛ:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: edum ebien no, na edum no n’etsifi ntaadotsir apɔw ebien no; na ntenadwuma ebien no a wɔdze kataa edum no n’etsifi ntaadotsir apɔw ebien no ho no;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ntenadwuma ebien no ho pɔmegranate eduaba ahaanan no; pɔmegranate eduaba akyerɛpɛn ebien yɛ atenadwuma kor nedze, dɛ ɔkata ntaadotsir no n’apɔw ebien no a ɔwɔ edum no no do no ho;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ndaka du no, na ndaka no do eguarsɛn du no;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na po kor no, na po no n’ase anantwi duebien no;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na asɛn, na nsofi, na mbɛɛsen no: mekyerɛ ndzɛmba yi nyinara a Hiram yɛe maa ɔhen Solomon, wɔ EWURADZE ne fi no ho no, yɛ boran a wɔapɔw ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Jordan Tɛtɛr no do na ɔhen no gui, wɔ hyirew daadze mu wɔ Sukɔt na Zaretan ntamu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon gyaa ndzɛmba no nyinara ker, osiandɛ ɔso dodow mbordo: woennhu boran no ne nkerii ano.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon yɛɛ ndzɛmba no a ɔwɔ EWURADZE ne fie no mu no nyinara: sika afɔrmbukyia no, na ɔpon no a kyerɛpaanoo no si do no, sika;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na nkandzeadua no, enum wɔ enyimfa afamu, na enum so wɔ abankum, mpiakyir no enyim, sika mapa: na nhyiren, na nkandzea, na adaban no, sika;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na mpokuwa, na nsompokuwa, na mbɛɛsen, na ntser, na ogyasɛn no, sika mapa; na no mu afamu ɔdan no, bea krɔnkrɔn ho mbobow, na ɔdan no, mekyerɛ asɔrfi no ho mbobow no ho apontsɛr so sika a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wowiee edwuma a ɔhen Solomon yɛe no wɔ EWURADZE ne fie no ho no nyinara yɛ. Na Solomon dze ndzɛmba a n’egya David tui sii hɔ no, mekyerɛ dwetɛ, na sika, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba no bae, na ɔdze besisii EWURADZE fie ndzekoradzebea no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon hyiahyiaa Israel mpanyimfo, na ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu etsitsir nyinara, Israelmba egyanom efiefi mbapɔmba no, ma wɔbaa ne nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalɛm, dɛ wɔrekɛfa EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no efi Zion a ɔyɛ David kurow no mu aba.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israel mbarimba no nyinara hyiahyiaa hɔnho behyiaa ɔhen Solomon ne nkyɛn wɔ afahyɛ no ase, wɔ bosoom Etanim a ɔyɛ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israel mpanyimfo no nyinara bae, na asɔfo no bɔsoaa adaka no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔdze EWURADZE n’adakaa no, na ehyiadzibuw no, na ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn a ɔwɔ Buw no mu no bae; mekyerɛ iyinom na asɔfo na Levifo no dze bae.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen Solomon na Israel mpanyimfo no a woebehyia wɔ ne nkyɛn no nyinara dzi adaka no enyim, rukuku nguan na anantwi a osian hɔn dodow ntsi wonntum nkan eso wommbu ano dze robobɔ afɔr.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na asɔfo no dze EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no besii ne sibew, wɔ ɔdan no ne mpiakyir, bea krɔnkrɔnkrɔn no, mekyerɛ kerubfo no ntsaban ase.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na kerubfo no atserɛtserɛw hɔn ntsaban mu wɔ adaka no ne sibew no do, na kerubfo no akata adaka no na no ho mpoma no do wɔ sor.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na mpoma no wowar dodow ma wohu mpoma no n’etsir wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn mpiakyir no enyim; na wonnhu wɔ abowano: na mbrɛ ɔwɔ ara nye no dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Hweeara nnyi adaka no mu gyedɛ abo apon ebien no a Moses dze guu mu wɔ Horeb no, wɔ aber a wofi Egypt asaase do reba no a EWURADZE nye Israelmba dzii ahyɛmu no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a asɔfo no fii bea krɔnkrɔn no do puei no, mununkum bɛhyɛɛ EWURADZE ne dan no ma,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na mununkum no ntsi asɔfo no enntum enngyina annsom: osiandɛ nna EWURADZE n’enyimnyam ahyɛ EWURADZE ne dan no ma.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Solomon kaa dɛ, EWURADZE ase dɛ ɔbɛtsena sum kebii mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ampa mesi ɔdan ayɛ tsenabew ama wo, beebi a ebɛtsena hɔ daa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no daan n’enyim, na ohyiraa Israel mboanofo no nyinara: na Israel mboanofo no nyinara gyinagyinaa tsentsen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nhyira nka EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn a ɔdze n’ano kasaa kyerɛɛ m’egya David, na ɔdze ne nsa ahyɛ no ma, dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ofitsi da a medze me man Israel fii Egypt bae no, mannsan mu ennyi kurow bi emmfi Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu dɛ wonsi dan, ama me dzin aatsena hɔ; mbom mesaan mu miyii David dɛ ɔnhwɛ me man Israel do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei ɔwɔ m’egya David n’akoma mu dɛ obesi dan ama EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ne dzin.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE see m’egya David dɛ, Susuampa dɛ ɔwɔ w’akoma mu dɛ nkyɛ ibesi dan ama me dzin no, eyɛɛ no yie dɛ ɔwɔ w’akoma mu:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: naaso ɔwoara nnkesi dan no; na mbom wo ba a ofi w’asen mu bɛba no, ɔno na obesi dan no ama me dzin.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE ama n’asɛm a ɔkae no etsim; na masoɛr ahyɛ m’egya David n’ananmu, na metse Israel ahengua do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE bɔɔ anohoba no, na mesi dan no ama EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ne dzin.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na meyi hɔ beebi ama adaka no a EWURADZE ahyɛmu a ɔnye hɛn egyanom dzii, wɔ aber a ɔdze hɔn fi Egypt asaase do reba no wɔ mu no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon gyinaa EWURADZE n’afɔrmbukyia no enyim wɔ Israel mboanofo no nyinara enyim, na ɔtserɛɛw ne nsamu wɔ sor:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, Onyankopɔn bi nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, wɔ wimu, wɔ sor, anaa asaase do, wɔ famu: ɔwo a isie ahyɛmu na mbɔbɔrhu ma wo nkowaa a wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara nantsew w’enyim:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ɔwo a esie dza ebɔɔ anohoba maa w’akowaa m’egya David no ama no: nyew, ɔwo edze w’ano kae, na edze wo nsa ahyɛ no ma, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, sie dza abɔ anohoba ama w’akowaa m’egya David no ma no dɛ, Nyimpa a ɔbɛtsena Israel ahengua do rommbɔ wo wɔ m’enyim; sɛ wo mba hwɛ hɔn kwan yie ara, dɛ wɔbɛnantsew m’enyim dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo nantseew m’enyim no a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, Israel Nyankopɔn e, meserɛ wo, ma w’asɛm a ekaa kyerɛɛ w’akowaa m’egya David no ntsim.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aso ampa dɛ Nyankopɔn bɛtsena asaase do? Hwɛ, ɔsor na ɔsor mu sor mpo nntum nnkora wo; na akantam ɔdan yi a mesi!
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Naaso EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn bu w’akowaa ne mpaabɔ, na no ntotɔserɛ bi, dɛ ibetsie w’akowaa ne nkekamu na ne mpaabɔ, a ɔrobɔ no wɔ w’enyim ndɛ da yi:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: dɛ w’enyi bobue wɔ ɔdan yi do adzesaa na adzekyee, mekyerɛ bea a ɔwoara ase dɛ, Me dzin bɛtsena hɔ no do: dɛ ibetsie mpaabɔ a w’akowaa robɔ akyerɛ bea yi do no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na tsie w’akowaa, na wo man Israel ntotɔserɛ, aber a wɔrobɔ mpaa kyerɛ bea yi do: nyew, tsie no wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea hɔ; na sɛ etse a, fa kyɛ:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Sɛ nyimpa bi yɛ bɔn tsia ne nyɛnko, na ntam bɛda no do dɛ ɔka, na ɔba bɛka ntam wɔ w’afɔrmbukyia enyim wɔ fie yi mu a:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor, na yɛ, na bu wo nkowaa atsɛn, dɛ irubu ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi no fɔ, ma no kwan eebua nankasa n’etsifi: na irubu ɔtseneneenyi no bem, ama no dɛ mbrɛ ne ndzeyɛtsenenee tse.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Sɛ wɔka wo man Israel gu wɔ atamfo enyim, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo ntsi; na sɛ wɔsan ba wo nkyɛn bio, na wɔbɔ wo dzin, na wɔbɔ wo mpaa na wɔtotɔ serɛ wo wɔ fie yi mu a:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor, na fa wo man Israel hɔn bɔn kyɛ hɔn, na fa hɔn bra asaase a ɔwoara dze maa hɔn egyanom no do bio.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Sɛ wɔtow ɔsor mu, na nsu nntɔ, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo ntsi; sɛ wɔbɔ mpaa kyerɛ bea yi do, na wɔbɔ wo dzin, na wɔsan fi hɔn bɔn ho, dɛ ahaw hɔn ntsi a:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor, na fa wo nkowaa, na wo man Israel hɔn bɔn kyɛ hɔn, dɛ erekyerɛ hɔn ɔkwan pa a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔfa do; na ma nsu ntɔ ngu w’asaase a ɔwoara dze ama wo man dɛ egyapadze no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Sɛ ɔkɔm ba asaase no do, sɛ ɔyardɔm ba, sɛ ohuw anaa ɔpo, mbɛbɛw anaa nkonyinko ba; sɛ hɔn atamfo botua hɔn wɔ nkuropon asaase do; owuyar biara, yarba biara ba a;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: mpaabɔ na ntotɔserɛ biara a nyimpa biara, anaa wo man Israel nyinara bɛyɛ a nyimpa biara bohu nankasa n’akoma mu ɔhaw na ɔbɛtrɛ ne nsamu akyerɛ fie yi do no:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea hɔ, na fa kyɛ, na yɛ, na ma nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ n’akwan nyinara tse, nyia ɔwoara nyim n’akoma mu a; (osiandɛ ɔwo, mekyerɛ ɔwoara nkotoo na inyim nyimpa mba nyinara hɔn akoma mu;)
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ama woeesuro wo wɔ nda nyinara a wɔdze bɛtsena asaase a ɔwoara edze maa hɛn egyanom no do no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nkyii so ɔhɔho a ommfi wo man Israel mu ho dze, sɛ osian wo dzin ntsi ma ofi ekyirekyir man bi mu ba;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: (osiandɛ wɔbɛtse wo dzin kɛse no, na wo nsa dzendzen no, na w’abasa a atsen mu no nka;) sɛ ɔba bɔbɔ mpaa kyerɛ ɔdan yi do a:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea, na yɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔhɔho no rusu frɛ wo no nyinara: ama asaase do aman nyinara aatse wo dzin, na woeesuro wo, dɛ mbrɛ wo man Israel yɛ, na woeehu dɛ wo dzin na wɔdze frɛ ɔdan yi a mesi yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Sɛ wo man fir edzi nye hɔn atamfo kedzi ako wɔ ɔkwan biara a ɔwoara bɔsoma hɔn do, na wɔbɔ EWURADZE mpaa kyerɛ kurow a asan mu eyi, na ɔdan a mesi ama wo dzin yi do a:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ɔno ɔwoara tsie hɔn mpaabɔ na hɔn ntotɔserɛ wɔ ɔsor, na dzi hɔn asɛm ma hɔn.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Sɛ wɔyɛ bɔn tsia wo, (osiandɛ nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ a ɔnnyɛ bɔn,) na wo bo fuw hɔn, na iyi hɔn ma atamfo, ma wɔfa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔ atamfo asaase do ekyirekyir o, nkyɛnkyɛn o;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na afei sɛ hɔnara wɔdwen wɔ asaase a wɔafa hɔn ndɔmmum akɔ do no do, na wɔsan bio, na wɔtotɔ serɛ wo wɔ hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree no hɔn asaase do, dɛ, Yɛayɛ bɔn, na yeetwa nkontompɔ, yeedzi emumuyɛsɛm;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: sɛ wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara na hɔn kra nyinara san ba wo nkyɛn wɔ hɔn atamfo a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree no hɔn asaase do, na wɔbɔ mpaa kyerɛ hɔn asaase a ɔwoara dze maa hɔn egyanom, kurow a ɔwoara asan mu eyi, na ɔdan a mesi ama wo dzin yi do a:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ɔno ɔwoara tsie hɔn mpaabɔ na hɔn ntotɔserɛ wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea, na dzi hɔn asɛm ma hɔn;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na fa wo man a wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo, na hɔn mbrato a wɔafom wɔ mu etsia wo nyinara kyɛ hɔn; na ma hɔn mbɔbɔrhu wɔ hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree no enyim, nyew, ma wonhu hɔn mbɔbɔr:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: osiandɛ wɔyɛ wo man, na w’egyapadze a iyii hɔn wɔ Egypt wɔ dadze fononoo no mu bae:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ma w’enyiwa nkɔ w’akowaa no ntotɔserɛ, na wo man Israel ntotɔserɛ do dɛ ibetsie hɔn mber biara a wosu frɛ wo no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Osiandɛ ɔwoara na etseew hɔn fii asaase do aman nyinara mu dɛ wɔyɛ w’egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwoara nam w’akowaa Moses n’abaw do kae no, wɔ aber a edze hɔn egyanom fi Egypt reba no, ao EWURADZE Nyankopɔn.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Solomon wiee mpaa ɔbɔ maa EWURADZE na ntotɔserɛ nyinara no, ɔsoɛree fii EWURADZE afɔrmbukyia no enyim, na ogyaa n’anankoroma enyim kosɔw nye ne nsamu trɛ a ɔtrɛɛ kyerɛɛ ɔsor do no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ogyinae, na ɔdze ndze kɛse hyiraa Israel mboanofo no nyinara, dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE a ɔama ne man Israel ahomgye, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ anohoba no nyinara tse: n’anohoba pa a ɔnam n’akowaa Moses ne nsa do bɔe no nyinara mu asɛm kor mpo annyew.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ndzi hɛn ekyir, dɛ mbrɛ odzii hɛn egyanom ekyir no: ma mma onngyaa hɛn, na eso ɔmmpa hɛn:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ama ɔaadan hɛn akoma akɔ no do, dɛ yɛbɛnantsew n’akwan nyinara mu, na yeedzi ne mbransɛm, na n’ahyɛdze, na n’atsɛmbu a ɔdze hyɛɛ hɛn egyanom no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ma me nsɛm yi a medze edzi ntotɔserɛ wɔ EWURADZE enyim yi mbɛn EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn adzekyee na adzesaa, ma ondzi n’akowaa n’asɛm, na ne man Israel hɔn asɛm mma hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ da biara dze bɛba:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ama asaase do aman nyinara woeehu dɛ EWURADZE nye Nyankopɔn: na obi nnyi hɔ bio.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mma hom akoma ndzi mu wɔ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ho, dɛ wɔbɛnantsew n’ahyɛdze mu, na woedzi ne mbransɛm do dɛ ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no, na Israel nyinara ka no ho bɔɔ afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon dze anantwi mpemeduonu ebien, na nguan mpemɔha eduonu, bɔɔ asomdwee afɔr a ɔbɔe maa EWURADZE no. Dɛm na ɔhen no na Israelmba no nyinara dze buee EWURADZE ne fie no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Da no ara ɔhen no yɛɛ EWURADZE ne dan no enyim dampan no ne finimfin no krɔnkrɔn; na hɔ na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr na edziban afɔr, na asomdwee afɔr ne seradze no: osiandɛ boran afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ EWURADZE enyim no suar dodow dɛ ɔbɛgye ɔhyew afɔr, na asomdwee afɔr ho seradze no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Solomon hyɛɛ fa no aber no mu, na Israel nyinara ka no ho, mboanofo kɛse, wofi Hamat ahɛnee kodu Egypt ɔwora no ho, wɔ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim nda esuon na nda esuon, mekyerɛ dadu ndaanan.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Da a otsia awɔtwe no ogyaa ɔman no kwan, na wohyiraa ɔhen no, na wɔdze papa nyinara a EWURADZE ayɛ ama n’akowaa David, na ne man Israel no ho enyigye na akoma pa sii mu kɔr hɔn asesee mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Solomon wiee EWURADZE ne fie, na ahemfie no si, na Solomon n’apɛdze a ɔsɔ n’enyi dɛ ɔbɛyɛ nyinara yɛ no,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: nna EWURADZE yii noho kyerɛɛ Solomon ne mpɛn ebien, dɛ mbrɛ oyii noho kyerɛɛ no wɔ Gibeon no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Matse wo mpaabɔ na wo ntotɔserɛ a ayɛ no wɔ m’enyim no: mayɛ fie a esi yi krɔnkrɔn, dɛ medze me dzin mobɔto hɔ daa; na m’enyiwa na m’akoma atsena hɔ daa nyina.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔwo dze, sɛ enantsew m’enyim dɛ mbrɛ w’egya David nantsewee no, akomamu tsewee mu, na tsenenee mu, dɛ ebɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ dza medze ahyɛ wo nyinara tse, na edzi m’ahyɛdze na m’atsɛmbu do a;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ɔno mebɛma w’ahendzi ahengua etsim wɔ Israel do daa; dɛ mbrɛ medze bɔɔ w’egya David anohoba no, dɛ, Israel ahengua do nyimpa rommbɔ wo no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Mbom sɛ hom san fi m’ekyir, hom anaa hom mba, na woenndzi me mbransɛm na m’ahyɛdze a medze esi hom enyim yi do, na hom kɔ kɔsom enyame fofor, na hom sɔr hɔn a:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ɔno mubotwa Israel efi asaase a medze ama hɔn no do; na fie a mayɛ no krɔnkrɔn ama me dzin yi mobɔtow efi m’enyim akyen; na Israel bɛdan ɔkasabɛbu na fen wɔ aman nyinara mu:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ɔdan yi krɔn kɔ sor dze, naaso obiara a obotwa mu wɔ ho no, no ho bɔbow no, na ɔabɔ nhwiroma; na wɔase dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na EWURADZE ayɛ asaase yi, na fie yi dɛm yi?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wobobua dɛ, Osiandɛ wɔpoow EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn a ɔdze hɔn egyanom fi Egypt asaase do bae no, na wɔkɛtae suoo enyame fofor mu sɔɔr hɔn, na wɔsoom hɔn: dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE dze mbusu yi nyinara aba hɔn do yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe eduonu no a Solomon dze sisii efie ebien no, mekyerɛ EWURADZE ne fie na ɔhen ne dze no, n’ewiei no,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: (afei nna Taerehen Hiram dze nkyindur ndua na ɔpepeaa, na ɔnye sika, dɛ mbrɛ n’apɛdze tse nyinara ama Solomon,) nna ɔhen Solomon maa Hiram nkurow eduonu wɔ Galilii asaase do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Hiram fiir edzi fii Taere dɛ ɔrobɔhwɛ nkurow a Solomon dze ama no no; na wɔannsɔ n’enyi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Mo nua, ebɛn nkurow nye yi na edze ama me yi? Na ɔfrɛɛ no Kabul asaase (asaasebɔn) dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Hiram somaa ma wɔdze sika dwetsir kɛse ɔha eduonu kɛmaa ɔhen no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na iyi nye siantsir a ɔhen Solomon gyegyee ɔtowyi edwuma; dɛ ɔdze besi EWURADZE ne fie, na nankasa ne fi, na Millo, na Jerusalɛm fasu, na Hazor, na Megiddo, na Gezer no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Egypthen Farao afow akɔ akɛgye Gezer, na ɔdze ogya ahyew no, na oekuku Keenanfo a wɔtse kurow no mu no. Afei ɔdze maa ne babaa a Solomon waar no no, dɛ awar akyɛdze.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon kyekyeer Gezer bio, na Bɛt-horon anaafo no,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na Baalat, na Tamar wɔ sar no do, asaase no do,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na adzekora nkurow a Solomon wɔ no nyinara, na ne ntseaseanam nkurow, na no mpɔnkɔdofo nkurow, na dza Solomon pɛ dɛ osi gye n’enyi wɔ Jerusalɛm, na Lebanon, na n’ahendzi asaase no nyinara mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nkorɔfo a wɔkae wɔ Amorifo, na Hitifo, na Perizfo, Hivifo, na Jebusfo mu a wommfi Israelmba mu no dze;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: hɔn mba a wɔkaa hɔn ekyir wɔ asaase no do no a Israelmba enntum annsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa no, hɔn na Solomon gyegyee hɔn enyadze ɔtowyi edwuma dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Naaso Israelmba no mu dze, Solomon annyɛ hɔn mu biara ɔtowyifo; mbom hɔn na wɔyɛɛ mbarimba akofo, na ne gyasefo na ne mbapɔmba, na n’asafohemfo, na ne ntseaseanam na no mpɔnkɔdofo do mpanyimfo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Woyinom nye Solomon n’edwuma do ahwɛdofo mu mpanyin, ahaenum eduonum a wɔhwɛ nkorɔfo a wɔyɛ edwuma no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Farao babaa no fii David kurow no mu baa ne fi a Solomon sii maa no no mu: nna osii Millo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na afrenhyia mu mpɛn ebiasa na Solomon bobɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr na asomdwee afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia a osii maa EWURADZE no do, ɔhyew eduhuam ka ho, wɔ afɔrmbukyia a osi EWURADZE enyim no do. Dɛm na ɔdze wiee ofi no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Solomon yɛɛ ahɛn wɔ Ezion-geber a ɔwɔ Elot nkyɛn, wɔ Mbɛw Po no no mpoano, wɔ Edom asaase do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Hiram somaa no nkowaa, apofomba a wɔwɔ po ho nyimdzee, ma wɔkɛkaa Solomon no nkowaa ho wɔ ahɛn no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔkɔr Ofir, na wɔkɛfaa hɔ sika, dwetɛsika ahaanan eduonu, na wɔdze brɛɛ ɔhen Solomon.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aber a Seba ɔhembaa no tsee Solomon ne nka wɔ EWURADZE ne dzin ho no, ɔbaa dɛ ɔdze nsɛmbisa dzendzen robɔsɔ no ahwɛ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔnye akadofo kɛsenara baa Jerusalɛm, efumpɔnkɔ a wɔsoso nduhuam, na sika piigyan, na abo a ɔsom bo: na aber a ɔbaa Solomon nkyɛn no, ɔnye no twetwee dza ɔwɔ n’akoma mu nyinara ho nkɔmbɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon kyerɛɛ no ne nsɛm nyinara ano: asɛm biara ennsuma ɔhen no a ɔannka annkyerɛ no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aber a Seba ɔhembaa no hun Solomon ne nyansaa nyinara, na fie a oesi,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na no pon do edziban, na no nkowaa ntsenaa mu, na n’asomfo ngyinaa mu, na hɔn ntar, na ne nsahyɛfo, na n’afowee a ɔnam do fow kɔ EWURADZE fie no; noho boow no kɛse.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, Wo ndwuma na wo nyansaa ho asɛm a metsee no wɔ mankasa m’asaase do no yɛ nokwar.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Naaso manngye nsɛm no enndzi, dze bodur dɛ mebae, na medze m’enyiwa mebohu yi: na hwɛ, wɔannka ne fa mpo annkyerɛ me: wo nyansaa na wo prɔmprɔmyɛ bor wo nka a metsee no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ahomka aka wo nkorɔfo, ahomka aka wo nkowaa yi a wogyinagyina w’enyim daa, na wotsie wo nyansaa no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔpɛ w’asɛm ma ɔdze wo esi Israel ahengua do: osiandɛ EWURADZE dɔ Israel daa, dɛm ntsi na ɔahyɛ wo ɔhen dɛ yɛ atsɛmbudze na pɛrpɛryɛ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔmaa ɔhen no sika dwetsir kɛse ɔha eduonu, na nduhuam burututuitu, na abo a ɔsom bo: nduhuam a ɔdɔɔ so dɛm bi ammba bio a ɔtse dɛ mbrɛ Seba ɔhembaa no dze maa ɔhen Solomon no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Hiram n’ahɛn no so a wɔdze sika fi Ofir bae no, wɔdze almug ndua piigyan na abo a ɔsom bo fi Ofir bae.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no dze almug ndua no yɛɛ EWURADZE fi no na ɔhen ne fi no ho edum, nsankutsen so na bɛnta asanku maa adwontofo no: dɛm almug ndua yi bi ammba bio, nkyii so woennhu bi araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Solomon maa Seba ɔhembaa no n’apɛdze nyinara, biribiara a obisae no, ɔsor dza ofi ɔhen Solomon nsamu a ɔdze maa no no. Nna odzii ndan, na osii mu kɔr nankasa n’asaase do, ɔno na no nkowaa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na afei sika a ɔbaa Solomon hɔ wɔ afe kor mu ne nkerii yɛ sika dwetsir kɛse ahaesia eduosia esia,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: ɔsor dza ofi konkosifo hɔ bae, na eguadzifo eguadzi mu, na dza ofi aforaforadɔm ahemfo nyinara hɔ, na aman no mu ambradofo no hɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Solomon dze sika a wɔabor yɛɛ akyɛm akɛse ahaenu: sika dwetɛbona ahaesia na ɔdze duraa kyɛm kor ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdze sika a wɔabor yɛɛ akyɛm nkakraba ahaasa; sika pɔɔn ebiasa na ɔdze duraa kyɛm kor ho: na ɔhen no dze koguu Lebanon kwaa dan no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nkyii so ɔhen no yɛɛ asombɛn ahengua kɛsenara na ɔdze sika mapa duraa ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ahengua no wɔ ntwerba esia, na ahengua no n’etsifi yɛ korkorba wɔ ekyir: na nsa wowɔ afa na afa wɔ atsenaa no ho, na ngyata ebien gyinagyina nsa no ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ngyata duebien gyinagyina ntwerba esia no do hɔ wɔ afa na afa ha: wɔnnyɛɛ dza ɔtse dɛm bi da wɔ ahenman biara mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Solomon no nkɔɔpow a ɔnom mu nyinara sika dze a, na Lebanon kwaa dan mu nkɔɔpow nyinara sika mapa a: dwetɛ dze biara nnyi mu; wommbu no hwee wɔ Solomon n’aber do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen Solomon wɔ Tarsis ahɛn wɔ po do a ɔka Hiram n’ahɛn ho: mfensa biara mu Tarsis ahɛn no ba prɛko, dze sika, na dwetɛ, asombɛn na ndɔpe, na koohaa ba.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Solomon boor asaase do ahemfo nyinara do wɔ ahonya na nyansa mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na asaase nyinara hwehwɛɛ Solomon n’enyim ehu, dɛ wobetsie ne nyansaa a Nyankopɔn dze ahyɛ n’akoma mu no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na hɔn mu nyimpa biara dze n’ayɛyɛdze bae, dwetɛ ndzɛmba, na sika ndzɛmba, na ntar, na ahodze, na nduhuam, mpɔnkɔ, na nsoasopɔnkɔ, afrenhyiadze afrenhyia afrenhyia.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon boaboaa ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo ano: na onyaa ntseaseanam apem ahaanan, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemduebien a ɔdze hɔn siesiee ntseaseanam nkurow no mu, na ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no maa dwetɛ yɛɛ dɛ abo wɔ Jerusalɛm, na ɔmaa nkyindur ndua yɛɛ dɛ ankye ndua a ɔwowɔ abɔnmu nkurow mu, wɔ ɔdodow mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na mpɔnkɔ a Solomon nyae no wɔdze fi Egypt nye Kue bae: na ɔhen n’eguadzifo no kɛgyegyee hɔn ekuwekuw no, kuw kor wɔ no bo do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔdze tseaseanam fi Egypt bae bɛgyee dwetɛ dwetɛbona ahaesia, na ɔpɔnkɔ so, dwetɛbona ɔha eduonum: na dɛmara so na wokitsaa bi fiir edzi brɛɛ Hitifo ahemfo nyinara, na Siria ahemfo no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei ɔhen Solomon dɔɔ mbaa ananaben piinara kaa Farao ne babaa no ho, mbaa a wofi Moabfo, Ammonfo, Edomfo, Zidonfo, na Hitifo mu;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: wofi amanaman a EWURADZE kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ Israelmba dɛ, Mma hom nnkɔ hɔn mu, nkyii so mma hɔn so mmba hom mu: na ampa wɔbɛdan hom akoma ekedzi hɔn enyame ekyir no a: woyinom na Solomon takyeer hɔn ho wɔ ɔdɔ mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na onyaa yernom ahaesuon, ahembaa a, na nponafo ahaasa: na ne yernom daan n’akoma.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Solomon yɛɛ akɔdaa no, ne yernom daan n’akoma kedzii enyame fofor ekyir: na n’akoma enndzi mu wɔ EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn ho, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya David n’akoma tse.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon kedzii Zidonfo bosom Astoret ekyir, na Ammonfo ekyiwadze Milkɔm ekyir.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, na oenndzi EWURADZE ekyir ennwie, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya David yɛe.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Solomon sii bea sorɔnsorɔm maa Moab ekyiwadze Kemos, wɔ bepɔw a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm enyim no do, na Ammonmba ekyiwadze Molek.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na dɛm na ɔyɛe maa ne yernom ananaben nyinara a wɔhyeew eduhuam na wɔbɔɔ afɔr maa hɔn abosom no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE no bo fuuw Solomon, osiandɛ n’akoma adan efi ɔno EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no a oeyi noho akyerɛ no mpɛn ebien no ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ɔno a ɔahyɛ no asɛm yi ho mbra dɛ mma ɔnnkɔ nnkedzi enyame fofor ekyir no: naaso oenndzi dza EWURADZE hyɛe no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE see Solomon dɛ, Susuampa dɛ ɔwo ayɛ iyi, na enndzi m’ahyɛmu na m’ahyɛdze a mehyɛɛ wo no do ntsi, ampa mebɛtsew ahendzi no efi wo nsamu, na medze ama w’akowaa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Naaso wo nda mu dze merennyɛ, osian w’egya David ntsi: na mbom mebɛtsew efi wo ba nsamu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Naaso merenntsew ahendzi no nyinara; na medze ebusuakuw kor bɛma wo ba, osian m’akowaa David, na Jerusalɛm a masan mu meyi no ntsi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE maa ɔtamfo bi soɛree tsiaa Solomon, Edomnyi Hadad a ofi ɔhen n’asefo mu wɔ Edom no a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a David bɔɔ Edom, na dɔm safohen Joab fowee kɔr dɛ orikesie atɔfo no, na okum Edom mbanyin nyinara;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: (na Joab na Israel nyinara tsenaa hɔ abosoom esia, kodur dɛ okuuw ɔbanyin biara ase wɔ Edom;)
title: 1ST KINGS

text: naaso Hadad guanee, ɔno na Edomfo bi a wofi n’egya nkowaa mu ka no ho, dɛ wɔrokɔ Egypt; nna Hadad yɛ abofra kakrabaa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔsoɛree fii Midian, na wɔbaa Paran: na wɔfaa mbarimba bi wɔ Paran kaa hɔnho, na wɔbaa Egypt, wɔ Egypthen Farao nkyɛn; ɔno na ɔmaa no fie, na ɔhyehyɛɛ edziban maa no, na ɔmaa no asaase.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Hadad nyaa enyimnyam kɛse wɔ Farao enyim, ma ɔdze nankasa ne yer no nua, ɔhembaa Tafenes no nua, maa no ayewar.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Tafenes no nua no woo ne babanyin Genubat maa no, na Tafenes tsetsee no wɔ Farao fie: na Genubat nye Farao ne mba no bɔɔ mu nyinii.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aber a Hadad tsee no wɔ Egypt dɛ David nye n’egyanom akɛda, na dɔm safohen Joab so ewu no, Hadad see Farao dɛ; Gya me kwan ma monkɔ mankasa me man mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Farao see no dɛ, Na ebɛnadze na ehia no wɔ me nkyɛn, ma erohwehwɛ dɛ ekɔ wankasa wo man mu yi? Na obuaa dɛ, Nnyɛ biribiara a: naaso ɔkwan ara na gya me ma monkɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei so Nyankopɔn maa ɔtamfo kor so soɛree tsiaa no, Eliada ba Rezon a oguanee fii no wura Zobahen Hadadezer nkyɛn no a:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ɔboaboaa mbarimba ano maa noho, na ɔbɛyɛɛ dɔm do safohen, wɔ aber a David kum hɔn a wofi Zoba no: na wosii mu kɔr Damaskɔs, na wɔkɛtsenaa hɔ, na odzii hen wɔ Damaskɔs.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ɔtamfo maa Israel wɔ Solomon ne nda nyinara mu, na ɔno so tseetsee hɔn dɛ mbrɛ Hadad yɛe no: na okyiir Israel, na odzii Siria do hen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Nebat ne ba Jeroboam, Efraimnyi bi a ofi Zereda, a ɔyɛ Solomon n’akowaa na ne na ne dzin dze Zerua, ɔbaa okunafo bi no, so maa ne nsa do tsiaa ɔhen no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na asɛm a osian ntsi ma ɔmaa ne nsa do tsiaa ɔhen no nye yi: Solomon sii Millo, na osisiiw n’egya David kurow ho etokur.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na dɛm Jeroboam no ɔyɛ ɔbarimba katakyi a ɔyɛ ndam: na Solomon hun aberantsɛ no dɛ ɔyɛ mbɔdzembɔnyi no, ɔmaa ɔhwɛɛ Josef fie edwuma nyinara do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ mber no mu, aber a Jeroboam fi Jerusalɛm rokɔ no, nkɔnhyɛnyi Silonnyi Ahija hun no wɔ ɔkwan no mu; nna Ahija hyɛ atar fofor; na hɔn beenu nko na wɔwɔ haban no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ahija tae suoo atar fofor a ɔhyɛ no no mu, na ɔtsetseew mu esinesin duebien.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee Jeroboam dɛ, Yi esinesin du woara fa; na mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, Hwɛ, mebɛtsew ahendzi no efi Solomon ne nsamu, na medze mbusuakuw du ama wo:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: (na ɔnodze, obenya ebusuakuw kor, wɔ m’akowaa David ntsi, na Jerusalɛm, kurow a masan mu meyi no wɔ Israel mbusuakuw nyinara mu no ntsi:)
title: 1ST KINGS

text: osiandɛ wɔapow me, na wɔakɔsom Zidonfo hɔn bosom Astoret, Moab nyame Kemos, na Ammonmba nyame Milcom; na wɔannantsew m’akwan mu dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ m’enyiwa do, na woedzi m’ahyɛdze na m’atsɛmbu do, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya David yɛe.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Naaso merenngye ahendzi no nyinara wɔ ne nsamu: na mebɛyɛ no ɔhen wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu wɔ m’akowaa David ntsi, ɔno a mesaan mu miyii no, osiandɛ odzii me mbransɛm na m’ahyɛdze do:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na mbom mebɛgye ahendzi no mefi ne ba nsamu, na medze ama wo, mekyerɛ mbusuakuw du no a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na medze ebusuakuw kor mebɛma ne ba no, ama m’akowaa David oeenya kandzea daa wɔ m’enyim, wɔ Jerusalɛm, kurow a masan mu meyi no dɛ medze me dzin mobɔto hɔ no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na mebɛfa ɔwo, na ibedzi hen dɛ mbrɛ wo kra pɛ nyinara na edzi Israel do hen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ itsie dza mebɛhyɛ wo nyinara, na enantsew m’akwan do, na eyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ m’enyiwa do, dɛ ibedzi m’ahyɛdze na me mbra do, dɛ mbrɛ m’akowaa David yɛe no a; ɔno mibedzi w’ekyir, na m’akyekyer ofi a otsim ama wo, dɛ mbrɛ mekyekyeree memaa David no, na medze Israel mebɛma wo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na iyi ntsi mibehiahia David n’asefo ho, na nnyɛ daa nyina.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi Solomon hwehwɛɛ dɛ oku Jeroboam: na Jeroboam soɛree, na oguanee kɔr Egypt, wɔ Egypthen Sisak nkyɛn, na ɔtsenaa Egypt araa ma okodur Solomon no wu mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Solomon ho nsɛm nkaa, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na ne nyansaa no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Solomon ho nsɛm nwoma no mu bi a?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na mber a Solomon dze dzii hen wɔ Israel nyinara do wɔ Jerusalɛm no ɔyɛ mfe eduanan.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ n’egya David kurow mu: na ne ba Rehoboam dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Rehoboam sii mu kɔr Sekem: osiandɛ Israel nyinara baa Sekem dɛ wɔrebɛhyɛ no ɔhen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Nebat ne ba Jeroboam tsee no, (osiandɛ nna ɔda ho wɔ Egypt, mbrɛ oguanee fii ɔhen Solomon enyim kɔree kɛtsenae no,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na wɔsomae ma wokehyiaa no bae;) nna Jeroboam na Israel dɔm no nyinara bae, na wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ Rehoboam, dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: W’egya yɛɛ hɛn kɔndua durdur: dɛm ntsi afei yɛ w’egya no som dzendzen no, na no kɔndua durdur a ɔdze too hɛn do no, harhar, na yɛnsom wo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma me ndaansa, na nkyii hom nsan mbra me nkyɛn bio. Na ɔman no twee mu kɔree.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Rehoboam nye nkɔdaa a wɔsoom n’egya Solomon dɛ apamfo mber a ɔda ho tse ase no, faa apam, dɛ, Afotu bɛn na hom dze rema me dɛ memfa nsan nkobua ɔman yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Sɛ ndɛ yi ɔwo eyɛ akowaa ma ɔman yi, na esom hɔn, na ibua hɔn, na eka nsɛm pa kyerɛ hɔn a, ɔno wɔbɛyɛ wo nkowaa daa nyina.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Naaso ɔpoow nkɔdaa no hɔn afotu a wɔdze maa no no, na ɔnye mberantsɛ a wɔnye no nyinii a afei wɔabɛyɛ n’apamfo no no dwenee.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Afotu bɛn na hom dze ma, ma yɛdze mbuae aasan akɛma ɔman yi a wɔaka akyerɛ me, dɛ, Yɛ kɔndua a w’egya dze too hɛn do no harhar no?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na mberantsɛ a wɔnye no nyinii no kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Ka kyerɛ ɔman yi a wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ wo dɛ, W’egya yɛɛ hɛn kɔndua durdur, na ɔwo dze, yɛ no harhar ma hɛn no; dɛ: Me nsatseaba kakraba mpo yɛ dur sen m’egya n’asen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na afei sɛ m’egya dze kɔndua durdur soaa hom a, emi so mobɔto hom kɔndua no do: sɛ m’egya dze mpire tseaa hom a, emi dze, medze nyankom nketsebowa mebɛtsea hom.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Jeroboam na ɔman no nyinara baa Rehoboam nkyɛn da a otsia ebiasa no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no kae no, dɛ, Da a otsia ebiasa no, hom nsan mbra me nkyɛn, no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no buaa ɔman no ebufuw mu, na ɔpoow nkɔdaa no hɔn apam a wɔdze maa no no;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ mberantsɛ no hɔn apam no tse, dɛ, M’egya yɛɛ hom kɔndua durdur, na emi dze mobɔto hom kɔndua do; m’egya dze mpire tseaa hom, na emi dze medze nyankoma nketsebowa mebɛtsea hom.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no enntsie ɔman no; osiandɛ nna ɔyɛ adze a EWURADZE ahyehyɛ, ama ɔaama ɔno EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam Silonnyi Ahija nsa do kaa kyerɛɛ Nebat ba Jeroboam no etsim.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aber a Israel nyinara hun dɛ ɔhen no enntsie hɔn no, ɔman no buaa ɔhen no dɛ, Ebɛn kyɛpɛn na yɛwɔ wɔ David mu? Nkyii so yennyi egyapadze wɔ Jesse ne ba no mu: Israel e, hom nkɔ hom asesee mu oo: afei David, hwɛ wankasa wo fie. Nna Israel sii mu kɔr hɔn asesee mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israelmba a wɔtsetse Juda nkurow mu no dze, Rehoboam dzii hɔn do hen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen Rehoboam somaa Adoram a ɔhwɛ ɔtowyi edwuma do no; na Israel nyinara siiw no abo, ma ɔtɔree. Na ɔhen Rehoboam yɛɛ ntsɛm foow ne tseaseanam dɛ oruguan akɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Israel tseew etua wɔ David fi do, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Israel nyinara tsee dɛ Jeroboam fi Egypt asan aba no, nna wɔsomae ma wokehyiaa no ma ɔbaa dɔm no nkyɛn, na wɔhyɛɛ no hen wɔ Israel nyinara do: obiara nnyi hɔ a odzii David fi ekyir, gyedɛ Juda ebusuakuw nko.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aber a Rehoboam baa Jerusalɛm no, ɔboaboaa Juda fi nyinara, na Benjamin ebusuakuw ano, nyimpa a wɔasan mu eyi mpemɔha eduowɔtwe a wɔyɛ akofo ano, dɛ ɔnye Israel fi rokɔko, adan ahendzi no ama Solomon ne ba Rehoboam bio.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Nyankopɔn n’asɛm baa Nyame nyimpa Semaia nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ka kyerɛ Solomon ne ba Rehoboam, Judahen, na Juda na Benjamin fi nyinara, na ɔman nkaa no, dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mma hom mmfow nnkɔ, nkyii so mma wɔnnye hom nuanom Israelmba nnkɔko: nyimpa biara nsan nkɔ ne fie; na asɛm no fir mara. Nna wotsiee EWURADZE n’asɛm no, na wɔsanee kɔr hɔn kwan, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm no tse.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Jeroboam kyekyeer Sekem wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu, na ɔtsenaa mu; na ofii hɔ kɔree kɛkyekyeer Penuel.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Jeroboam see n’akoma mu dɛ, Annhwɛ a ahendzi no bɛsan akɔ David fie:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: wɔ ber a ɔman yi fow kɔ kɔbɔ afɔr wɔ EWURADZE fie wɔ Jerusalɛm no, bɛyɛ nna ɔman yi akoma adan akɔ hɔn wura nkyɛn bio, mekyerɛ Judahen Rehoboam a; na woeku me, na wɔasan akɔ Judahen Rehoboam nkyɛn.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen no faa apam, na ɔyɛɛ sika anantwimba ebien; na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔdɔɔ so dodow ma hom dɛ hom bɔfow akɔ Jerusalɛm; Israel, hwɛ w’enyame a wɔdze wo fi Egypt asaase do bae nye iyinom.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdze kor kesii Bɛtɛl, na ɔdze kor so kesii Dan.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na asɛm yi maa wɔyɛɛ bɔn: osiandɛ ɔman no kɔree kɔsoom hɔn wɔ Bɛtɛl araa dze kɔr Dan.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do adan, na ɔhyɛɛ ɔman no mu binom a wommfi Levimba mu no asɔfo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Jeroboam hyehyɛɛ afahyɛ wɔ bosoom a otsia awɔtwe no mu wɔ bosoom no ne da a otsia duenum no do, ɔtse dɛ afahyɛ a ɔwɔ Juda no, na ɔfowee kɔr afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn; dɛmara na ɔyɛɛ no wɔ Bɛtɛl, ɔbɔɔ afɔr maa anantwimba a ɔyɛe no: na ɔdze mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo a ɔyɛe no guu Bɛtɛl.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔfowee kɔr afɔrmbukyia no a ɔyɛe no wɔ Bɛtɛl wɔ bosoom a otsia awɔtwe no mu da a otsia duenum no, mekyerɛ bosoom a ɔbɔɔ nankasa ne tsirmu hyɛe no mu a: na ɔhyehyɛɛ afahyɛ maa Israelmba no, na ɔfowee kɔr afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn dɛ ɔrekɛhyew eduhuam.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na, hwɛ, Nyame nyimpa bi fi Juda nam EWURADZE n’asɛm do baa Bɛtɛl: nna Jeroboam gyina afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn dɛ ɔrebɛhyew eduhuam.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔnam EWURADZE n’asɛm do tseatseaa mu tsiaa afɔrmbukyia no, na ɔsee dɛ, Afɔrmbukyia e, afɔrmbukyia e, mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi oo: Hwɛ, wɔbɔwo ɔba bi ama David fie, ne dzin dze Josia; na wo do na wɔdze mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo a wɔhyew wo do eduhuam bɔbɔ afɔr, na wɔahyew nyimpa mbiew wɔ wo do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔmaa asɛnkyerɛdze da no ara, dɛ, iyi nye asɛnkyerɛdze a EWURADZE aka no: Hwɛ, afɔrmbukyia no bɛpaa, na nso a ɔwɔ do no ehue egu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen no tsee Nyame nyimpa no n’asɛm a ɔtseatseaa mu tsiaa afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ Bɛtɛl no, Jeroboam fi afɔrmbukyia no do tseen ne nsa dɛ, Hom nsuo no mu. Na ne nsa no a ɔtseen no wɔ no do no sireen, ma oenntum anntwe no ekyir ammba noho bio.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afɔrmbukyia no so paae, na nso no huei fi afɔrmbukyia no do gui dɛ mbrɛ asɛnkyerɛdze a Nyame nyimpa no nam EWURADZE n’asɛm do dze mae no tse no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no see Nyame nyimpa no dɛ, Afei serɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn n’adom, na bɔ mpaa ma me, ma me nsa nsan n’ananmu mma me bio. Na Nyame nyimpa no serɛɛ EWURADZE, na ɔhen no ne nsa saan n’ananmu maa no bio, na ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ nkan no ɔtse no ara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no see Nyame nyimpa no dɛ, Bɛsen nye me nkɔ fie, na kɔdwedwe woho, na mebɛkyɛ wo adze.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Nyame nyimpa no see ɔhen no dɛ, Sɛ ebɛma me wo fi fa mpo a, mennkɛnye wo akɔ, nkyii so mirinndzi edziban na eso moronnom nsu wɔ ha yi:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na dɛm na ɔnam EWURADZE n’asɛm do wɔdze hyɛɛ me, dɛ, Mma nndzi edziban, na so nnom nsu, nkyii so nnsan mmfa ɔkwan a enam do bae no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna osii ɔkwan fofor do kɔree, na ɔannsan ammfa ɔkwan a ɔnam do baa Bɛtɛl no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei nkɔnhyɛnyi akɔdaa bi tse Bɛtɛl; na ne mbabanyin no mu baako bae bɛkaa dwuma a Nyame nyimpa no bedzii no wɔ Bɛtɛl da no nyinara kyerɛɛ no: nsɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no, so ɔkaa kyerɛɛ n’egya.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na hɔn egya bisaa hɔn dɛ, Ɔkwan bɛn do na ɔfae? Afei ne mbabanyin no hun ɔkwan kor a Nyame nyimpa no a ofi Juda bae no dze faa do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee ne mbabanyin no dɛ, Hom nhyehyɛ asoaso no mma me. Nna wɔhyehyɛɛ asoaso no maa no: na ɔtsenaa do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na otsiiw Nyame nyimpa no, na ɔkɔtoo no dɛ ɔtse esudur bi ase: na ɔsee no dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye Nyame nyimpa a ofi Juda bae no? Na ɔsee dɛ, Emi a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔsee no dɛ, Bɛsen nye me nkɔ fie nkedzidzi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Murunntum menye wo nnsan, na eso merennye wo nnkɔ: nkyii so mirinndzi edziban na menye wo ronnom nsu so wɔ ha yi:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: osiandɛ wɔnam EWURADZE n’asɛm do see me dɛ, Mma nndzi edziban na eso nnom nsu wɔ hɔ, na mma nnsan mmfa ɔkwan a enam do bae no do bio.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Emi so nkɔnhyɛnyi nye me dɛ ɔwoara; na ɔbɔfo bi nam EWURADZE n’asɛm do kaa kyerɛɛ me dɛ, Fa no san ma ɔnye wo mbra wo fie, ma ombedzidzi na ɔnnom nsu. Na odzii ator kyerɛɛ no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔnye no sanee kɔree, na okedzii edziban wɔ ne fie, na ɔnoom nsu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔtse pon ho no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa nkɔnhyɛnyi no a ɔdze no sanee bae no nkyɛn:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ɔtseatseaa mu kyerɛɛ Nyame nyimpa no a ofi Juda bae no, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Susuampa dɛ ɔwo ayɛ asoɔdzen wɔ EWURADZE n’anosɛm ho, na enndzi mbrasɛm a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze hyɛɛ wo no do,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na asan aba ebedzi edziban na anom nsu wɔ beebi mbrɛ ɔsee wo dɛ, Mma nndzi edziban, na nnom nsu no ntsi; wo fun ronnkɔ w’egyanom hɔn asamandan mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, odzii edziban, na ɔnomee n’ekyir no, ɔhyehyɛɛ asoaso no maa nkɔnhyɛnyi no a ɔkɛsaan no bae no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aber a ɔkɔree no, gyata hyiaa no ɔkwan no mu, na okum no: na no fun daa kwan no mu, na asoaso no gyinaa ho; nna gyata no so gyina fun no ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na, hwɛ, nyimpa twaa mu, na wohun fun no a ɔda ɔkwan no mu, na gyata a ogyina fun no ho no: na wɔbaa bɛkaa no wɔ kurow no mu mbrɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi akɔdaa no tse no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aber a nkɔnhyɛnyi no a ɔdze no sanee fii ɔkwan no do bae no tsee no, ɔsee dɛ, Nyame nyimpa a ɔyɛɛ asoɔdzen wɔ EWURADZE n’anomu asɛm ho no a: dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE eyi no ama gyata no ma ɔatsetsew no ekum no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no no tse no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ ne mbabanyin no dɛ, Hom nhyehyɛ asoaso no mma me. Na wɔhyehyɛɛ no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na osii mu kɔree na okohun no fun no dɛ ɔda ɔkwan no mu, na asoaso no na gyata no gyinagyina fun no ho; gyata no enndzi fun no, na eso ɔanntsetsew asoaso no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nkɔnhyɛnyi no maa Nyame nyimpa no no fun no do, na ɔdze too asoaso no do, na ɔdze no sanee baa nkɔnhyɛnyi akɔdaa no no kurow no mu, dɛ oribegyam no na oesie no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na akɔdaa no dze fun no too nankasa n’adakamona mu; na ɔnye ne mbabanyin gyaam no dɛ, Ebei, mo nua!
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, osiee no n’ekyir no ɔkaa kyerɛɛ ne mbabanyin no dɛ, Sɛ muwu a, ɔno wonsie me wɔ asamandan a woesie Nyame nyimpa no wɔ mu no mu; wɔmfa me mbiew ngu ne mbiew nkyɛn.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Osiandɛ asɛm a ɔnam EWURADZE n’asɛm do tseatseaa mu tsiaa afɔrmbukyia no wɔ Bɛtɛl na mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm efiefi nyinara a ɔwɔ Samaria nkurow mu no, ɔbɛba mu ampa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Asɛm yi ekyir no Jeroboam annsan emmfi no kwan bɔn do, na oyii ɔman no nyinara mu binom yɛɛ hɔn mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo bio: obiara a ɔpɛ no, na ɔatsew no ho, ma ɔaayɛ mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm no do hɔ asɔfo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na asɛm yi bɛyɛɛ bɔn wɔ Jeroboam fie dɛ wobotwa no akyen, na wɔasɛɛ no efi asaase enyi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Aber no mu no Jeroboam ne ba Abija yaree.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Jeroboam see ne yer dɛ, Meserɛ wo, Soɛr, na sakyer woho amma woeennhu wo dɛ eyɛ Jeroboam ne yer: na kɔ Siloh; hwɛ, hɔ na nkɔnhyɛnyi Ahija a ɔkaa no wɔ mo ho dɛ mibedzi hen wɔ ɔman yi do no wɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na fa boodoo ntɔwmu du, na tatarmba, na ewo pɔr kitsa, na kɔ ne nkyɛn: ɔno na ɔbɛka dza ɔbɛba abofra no do akyerɛ wo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Jeroboam ne yer no yɛɛ dɛm, na ɔsoɛree na osii mu kɔr Siloh, na ɔbaa Ahija ne fie. Afei Ahija no nkɔdaayɛ ntsi n’enyiwa ayɛ kusukusu na onnhu adze.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE see Ahija dɛ, Hwɛ, Jeroboam ne yer reba wo hɔ ebebisa wo hɔ adze wɔ ne ba ho, na ɔyar: dɛm na dɛm na ka kyerɛ no: na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ ɔba a, obepetuw ayɛ noho dɛ ɔbaa fofor bi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahija tsee n’ananadze nka dɛ ɔaba abow no ano no, ɔsee dɛ, Bra, ɔwo Jeroboam ne yer; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na epetuw ayɛ woho dɛ obi yi? Na wɔdze nsɛm durdur asoma me wo hɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Kɔ, kɛka kyerɛ Jeroboam dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Susuampa dɛ memaa wo do wɔ ɔman no mu, na mehyɛɛ wo ɔpanyin wɔ me man Israel do,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na metseew ahendzi no fii David fie, na medze memaa wo: naaso ɔwo annyɛ dɛ m’akowaa David a odzii me mbransɛm do, na ɔdze n’akoma nyinara dzii m’ekyir, dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dza ɔtsen nko wɔ m’enyiwa do no;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ɔwo ayɛ bɔn asen hɔn a wodzii w’enyim nyinara, na akɔ akɛyɛ enyame fofor, na ehonyi a woegu ama wo ho, dɛ edze riyi me ebufuw, na atow me akyen w’ekyir:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, medze mbusu bɛba Jeroboam fi do, na metwa Jeroboam mu abofra banyin biara akyen, Israel mu nyia wɔatow no mu na nyia woegyaa no, na mapra Jeroboam fie sɛsɛɛsɛ, dɛ mbrɛ obi pra efikyir, ma ne nyinara asa koraa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nyia ofi Jeroboam mu a obowu wɔ kurow mu no, nkraman bedzi; na nyia obowu wɔ haban mu no wimu ntumbowa bedzi, na EWURADZE na ɔaka yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi soɛr, kɔ wo fie: na sɛ w’anan si kurow no mu ara a, abofra no bowu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israel nyinara begyam no, na woesie no: na ɔno nko na ofi Jeroboam mu a ɔbɔkɔ adakamona mu: osiandɛ ɔno no mu na woehu adze pa bi wɔ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, afamu, wɔ Jeroboam fie.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nkyii so EWURADZE bɛma ɔhen bi do ama noho wɔ Israel a da no obotwa Jeroboam fi akyen: na ebɛnadze a? Seseiara mpo a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE bɔbɔ Israel, dɛ mbrɛ ndzɛmbir hihim wɔ nsu mu; na oetutu Israel efi asaase pa a ɔdze maa hɔn egyanom yi do, na ɔabɔ hɔn apetse Esutsen no n’egya; osiandɛ wɔayɛ hɔn Aserim dze eyi EWURADZE ebufuw.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na osian Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔayɛ na ɔdze ama Israel so ayɛ bɔn no ntsi, obegyaa Israel mu ama.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Jeroboam ne yer no soɛree sii mu, na ɔbaa Tirza: na obodur ofi no n’apondua ase dze no do ara nna abofra no wui.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israel nyinara siee no, na wogyaam no; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam n’akowaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Ahija ne nsa do kae no tse no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Jeroboam no ho nsɛm nkaa no, mbrɛ osii dzii ako, na mbrɛ osii dzii hen no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nda a Jeroboam dze dzii hen yɛ mfe eduonu ebien: na ɔkɔr ne nsamankyir, na ne babanyin Nadab na ɔhyɛɛ n’ananmu dzii hen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Solomon ne ba Rehoboam dzii hen wɔ Juda. Rehoboam hyɛɛ ase dzii hen no, nna oedzi mfe eduanan biako, na odzii hen mfe duesuon wɔ Jerusalɛm, kurow a EWURADZE saan mu yii no wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu dɛ ɔdze ne dzin bɔto hɔ no mu: na ne na yɛ Ammonnyi a ne dzin dze Naama.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Juda yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do; na wɔdze hɔn bɔn a wɔyɛe no yii EWURADZE nyinkun seen dza hɔn egyanom yɛe no nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Osiandɛ hɔn so wɔyeyɛɛ mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm, na edum, na Aserim, wɔ koko tsentsen biara do, na dua momon biara ase maa hɔnho;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na sodomfo so wɔ asaase no do: wɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ amanaman a EWURADZE tuu hɔn wɔ Israelmba enyim no hɔn ekyiwadze nyinara tse.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔhen Rehoboam n’afe a otsia enum no mu no, Egypthen Sasak fowee baa Jerusalɛm do:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ɔfaa EWURADZE ne fie akoradze, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze no; ɔfaa ne nyinara kwa dze kɔree: na ɔfaa sika akyɛm a Solomon yɛe no nyinara dze kɔree.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Rehoboam yɛɛ boran akyɛm dze sisii hɔn ananmu, na ɔdze hyɛɛ abrampɔfo a wɔhwɛ ɔhen no ne fie abowano no do asafohemfo no nsa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, mber dodow biara a ɔhen no kɔ EWURADZE ne fie no abrampɔfo no susuo mu, na wɔdze san besi abrampɔfo pia mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Rehoboam no ho nsɛm nkaa, na dza ɔyɛe no nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na akodzi daa Rehoboam na Jeroboam ntamu daa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Rehoboam kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ n’egyanom nkyɛn wɔ David kurow no mu: nna ne na ne dzin dze Naama, Ammonnyi a, na ne babanyin Abijam dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Nebat ne ba ɔhen Jeroboam n’afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu nna Abijam hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Juda do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Mfe ebiasa na ɔdze dzii hen wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Maaka, Absalom ne babaa a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔnantsewee wɔ n’egya no bɔn a ɔyɛe no wɔ n’enyim no nyinara mu: na n’akoma enndzi mu wɔ EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn enyim, dɛ n’egya David n’akoma.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Naaso osian David ntsi na EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn maa kandzea wɔ Jerusalɛm, dɛ ɔbɛma ne ba do esi hɔ wɔ n’ekyir, na ɔama Jerusalɛm etsim:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: osiandɛ David yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do, na oemmfi adze biara a ɔhyɛɛ no no ho ɔanndan ammfa nkyɛn wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu, gyedɛ Hitinyi Uria asɛm no nko mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei akodzi daa Rehoboam na Jeroboam ntamu wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Abijam no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe no nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu a? Na akodzi daa Abijam na Jeroboam ntamu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Abijam kɔr ne nsamankyir; na wosiee no wɔ David kurow no mu: na ne babanyin Asa na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israelhen Jeroboam n’afe a otsia eduonu no mu na Asa hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Juda do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na mfe eduanan biako na ɔdze dzii hen wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Maaka, Absalom ne babaa a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Asa yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya David yɛe.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na otutuu sodomfo ndwaman no fii asaase no do, na oyiyii abosom a n’egyanom yɛe no nyinara wɔ hɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ne na Maaka so otuu no do dɛ ɔyɛ ɔhembaa, osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ ekyiwadze honyi bi maa Asera ntsi; na Asa twaa no honyi no, na ɔkɛhyeew no wɔ ɔwora Kidron do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm no dze oennyiyi: naaso Asa n’akoma dzii mu wɔ EWURADZE enyim, ne nda nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdze ndzɛmba a n’egya tui sii hɔ, na ndzɛmba a nankasa tui sii hɔ no baa EWURADZE fie, dwetɛ, na sika, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na akodzi daa Asa na Israelhen Baasha ntamu hɔn nda nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israelhen Baasha fowee kɔr Juda do, na ɔkɛkyekyeer Rama, dɛ ɔremma kwan ma obiara nndzi ndɔfir wɔ Judahen Asa nkyɛn.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Asa faa dwetɛ na sika a wogyaa no wɔ EWURADZE ne fie akoradze mu nyinara, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze no, na ɔdze hyɛɛ n’akowaa nsa: na ɔhen Asa somaa ma wɔdze kɔr Hezion ba Tabrimon ba Ben-hadad, Siriahen a ɔtse Damaskɔs no nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nkyekyeree bi da emi na ɔwo ntamu, wɔ m’egya na w’egya ntamu: hwɛ, mama wɔdze dwetɛ na sika ayɛyɛdze rebrɛ wo; kɔ, kɛtsetsew ɔwo nye Israelhen Baasha nkyekyeree no mu, ma omfi mo do nkɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ben-hadad tsiee ɔhen Asa, na ɔsomaa no dɔm do asafohemfo no wɔ Israel nkurow no do, na ɔbɔɔ Ijon, na Dan, na Abel-beth-maaka, na Kinnerot nyinara, kaa Naftali asaase nyinara ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Baasha tsee no, ogyaa Rama kyekyer, na ɔkɛtsenaa Tirza.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen Asa maa wɔbɔɔ dawur wɔ Juda nyinara a woennyi obiara wɔ mu: na wɔkɔsoaa Rama abo, na no ho ndua no a Baasha dze kyekyeree no; na ɔhen Asa dze kyekyeer Benjamin Geba, na Mizpa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Asa no ho nsɛm nyinara, na ne ndam nyinara, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara na nkurow a ɔkyekyeree no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu a? Na mbom no nkɔdaaber mu no ɔyaar n’anan.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Asa kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ n’egyanom nkyɛn wɔ n’egya David kurow no mu: na ne babanyin Jehosafat na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Jeroboam ne ba Nadab hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia ebien no mu, na odzii hen wɔ Israel do mfe ebien.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, na ɔnantseew n’egya no kwan, na ne ndzeyɛɛ a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ahija ne ba Baasha a ofi Isakar fie no paam ne tsir do; na Baasha bɔɔ no wɔ Gibeton a ɔyɛ Filistiafo dze no do; osiandɛ nna Nadab na Israel nyinara worutua Gibeton.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Mekyerɛ Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia ebiasa no mu na Baasha kum no na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ obedzii hen no ara pɛr, nna ɔtɔr Jeroboam fi nyinara; oenngyaa obiara a ogu ahom amma Jeroboam dze kodur dɛ ɔsɛɛ no pasaa; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam n’akowaa Silohnyi Ahija n’abaw do kae no tse no:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: osian Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔyɛe, na ɔdze maa Israel so yɛɛ bɔn no ntsi; osian yi a oyii EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ebufuw no ntsi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Nadab no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na akodzi daa Asa na Israelhen Baasha ntamu hɔn nda nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia ebiasa no mu na Ahija ne babanyin Baasha hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel nyinara do wɔ Tirza, na odzii hen mfe eduonu anan.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, na ɔnantseew Jeroboam no kwan do, na ne ndzeyɛɛ a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Hanani ba Jehu nkyɛn tsiaa Baasha, dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Susuampa dɛ memaa wo do fii huntuma mu, na mehyɛɛ wo ɔpanyin wɔ me man Israel do; na ɔwo anantsew Jeroboam no kwan mu, na ama me man Israel ayɛ bɔn, na wɔdze hɔn bɔn eyi me ebufuw ntsi;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: hwɛ, mebɛpra Baasha na ne fi korakora; na mebɛyɛ wo fi dɛ Nebat ne ba Jeroboam ne fi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nyia ofi Baasha mu a obowu wɔ kurow mu no nkraman bedzi; na nedze mu nyia obowu wɔ haban mu no, wimu ntumbowa bedzi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Baasha no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe, na ne ndam, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Baasha kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no Tirza; na ne babanyin Ela na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nkyii so EWURADZE n’asɛm nam Hanani ne ba, nkɔnhyɛnyi Jehu n’abaw do bae betsiaa Baasha na ne fi, osian mbusu a ɔbɔɔ no wɔ EWURADZE enyi do nyinara ntsi, dɛ ɔdze ne nsaano edwuma yii no ebufuw yɛɛ dɛ Jeroboam ne fi no, na osiandɛ okum no ntsi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia eduonu esia no mu na Baasha ne babanyin Ela hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Tirza, na odzii hen mfe ebien.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na n’akowaa Zimri a ɔyɛ ne ntseaseanam mu fa do safohen no, paam ne tsir do: na dabi a ɔnodze ɔwɔ Tirza ronom nsa abow wɔ Arza a ɔhwɛ ahemfiefo do wɔ Tirza no ne fie no:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na Zimri kɔr hɔ na ɔkɔwɔɔ no kum no, wɔ Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia eduonu esuon no mu, na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase ridzi hen no, ntsɛmara a ɔtsenaa n’ahengua do no, nna okum Baasha fifo nyinara: oenngyaa no ɔbanyimba kor mpo, n’ebusuafo mu o, ne mfɛfo mu o.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm na Zimri sɛɛ Baasha fi nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam nkɔnhyɛnyi Jehu do kae tsiaa Baasha no tse no,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: wɔ Baasha no bɔn nyinara, na ne ba Ela no bɔn a ɔyɛe, na wɔdze maa Israel so yɛɛ bɔn, dɛ, wɔdze hɔn egyangyandze yii EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn ebufuw no ntsi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Ela no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia eduonu esuon no mu na Zimri dzii hen nda esuon wɔ Tirza. Afei nna Israelman no akyer Gibeton a ɔyɛ Filistiafo dze no ho nsera.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aber a hɔn a wɔakyer nsera no tsee dɛ wɔrese dɛ, Zimri akɔ apam, na eso oeku ɔhen no: dɔm no nyinara dze dɔm do safohen Omri hyɛɛ hen wɔ Israel do da no ara wɔ nsera no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Omri fi Gibeton sii mu kɔree, na Israel akofo nyinara ka no ho, na wokotuaa Tirza.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Zimri hun dɛ kurow no wɔagye no, nna osii mu kɔr ɔhen no ne fi aban no mu, na ɔdze ogya hyeew ɔhen no ne fi no guu no do, na owui,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: osian no bɔn a ɔyɛe dɛ ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dɛ ɔnantseew Jeroboam kwan mu, na no bɔn a ɔyɛe dze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no mu ntsi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Zimri no ho nsɛm nkaa no na no nkontompɔ a otwae no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Israelmba no mu paa ekuw ebien: ɔman no mu fa dzii Ginat ne ba Tibni ekyir, dɛ wɔbɛhyɛ no hen: na ɔfa so dzii Omri ekyir.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔman no a wodzii Omri ekyir no nsa daa ɔman no a wodzii Ginat ne ba Tibni ekyir no do: na Tibni wui, na Omri dzii hen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia eduasa biako no mu na Omri hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do, na odzii hen mfe duebien: mfe esia na ɔdze dzii hen wɔ Tirza.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔkɔtɔɔ Samaria koko wɔ Semer hɔ maa dwetɛ ndwetɛbona ebien; na ɔkyekyeer koko no do kurow, na ɔdze koko no wura Semer ne dzin frɛɛ kurow a ɔkyekyeree no ne dzin dɛ Samaria.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Omri yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, na ɔyɛɛ emumuyɛdze seen hɔn a wodzii n’enyim nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Osiandɛ ɔnantseew Nebat ba Jeroboam no kwan nyinara, na no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel fomee no mu, dɛ wɔdze hɔn egyangyandze yii EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ebufuw.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Omri no ho nsɛm nkaa no, dza ɔyɛe, na ne mbanyinndam a ɔkyerɛe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Omri kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ Samaria: na ne babanyin Ahab dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Judahen Asa n’afe a otsia eduasa awɔtwe no mu Omri ne ba Ahab hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do: na Omri ne ba Ahab dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samaria mfe eduonu ebien.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Omri ne ba Ahab yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyim seen hɔn a wodzii n’enyim nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, dɛ gyama ɔyɛ adze harhar ma no dɛ ɔbɛnantsew Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn mu no ntsi, nna ɔfaa Zidonfo hen Etbaal ne babaa Jezebel ayewar, na osii mu kɔree kɔsoom Baal, na ɔkotoow no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na osii afɔrmbukyia maa Baal wɔ Baal fi a osii no wɔ Samaria no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ahab yɛɛ Asera no; na Ahab kɔr do araa dɛ ɔdze beyi EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ebufuw sen Israel ahemfo a wodzii n’enyim nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ne nda mu na Bɛtɛlnyi Hiel kyekyeer Jeriko: ɔhweer n’abakan Abiram dze toow ne fapem, na ɔhweer ne ba kaekyir banyin Segub sisii n’ano mbobotsen; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam Nun ne ba Josua abaw do kae no tse.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Tisbinyi Elija a ofi Gilead amamforafo mu no, see Ahab dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn a migyina n’enyim tse ase yi, ɔbɔsu anaaso nsu ronntɔ mfe yi mu, gyedɛ ɔnam m’asɛm do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa ne nkyɛn dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Fi ha fir, na kɔ boka afamu, na fa woho kosuma ɔwora Kerit a ɔwɔ Jordan enyim no ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, ebɔnom ɔwora no mu nsu bi: na mahyɛ nkonkoran dɛ wɔnnyɛn wo wɔ hɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna osii mu kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm tse: osiandɛ osii mu kɔree kɛtsenaa ɔwora Kerit a ɔwɔ Jordan enyim no ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nkonkoran no brɛɛ no boodoo na nam anapa, na boodoo na nam ewimbir; na ɔnoom ɔwora no mu nsu bi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔkyɛɛr kakra no, ɔwora no wewee, osiandɛ nna nsu nntɔ asaase no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Elija nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Soɛr, kɔ Zarefat a ɔyɛ Zidon dze no, na kɛtsena hɔ: hwɛ, mahyɛ ɔbaa kunafo bi wɔ hɔ dɛ ɔmbɔ wo akɔhoma.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔsoɛree sii mu kɔr Zarefat; na odur kurow no mu kuropon ano no, hwɛ, ɔbaa kunafo bi wɔ hɔ retaatar mbabaaba: na ɔfrɛɛ no see dɛ, Meserɛ wo, kɛsaw nsu kakra gu kɔɔpow mu brɛ me ma monnom.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔrokɔ akɛsaw no, ɔfrɛɛ no, na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ wo, fa boodoo trɔma bi kitsa wo nsamu brɛ me.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa no see dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn tse ase yi, minnyi tatar biara, gyedɛ isiam nsapuw bi a ɔwɔ barba mu, na ngo kakra a ɔwɔ pɔr mu; na, hwɛ, meretaatar mbabaaba ebien bi, ma maakɔ mekesiesie ama emi na me ba, ma yeedzi na yeewu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Elija see no dɛ, Mma nnsuro; kɔ kɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ase no: mbom dzi kan yɛ bi tatar kakra ma me, na fa brɛ me, na n’ekyir no ayɛ ɔwo na wo ba dze.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi, Isiam barba no ronnhwer, nkyii so ngo pɔr no rennsa, dze ekodu da a EWURADZE bɛma nsu atɔ egu asaase do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa no sii mu kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Elija n’asɛm no tse: na ɔnye Elija, na ɔnoara na ne fie dzii no nda pii.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Isiam barba no annhwer, nkyii so ngo pɔr no annsa, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam Elija do kae no tse no ara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, nsɛm yi ekyir no, ɔbaa ofiwura no ne babanyin yaree; na ne yarba no mu yɛɛ dzen dodoodow, ma ahom biara annka no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee Elija dɛ, Ɔwo Nyame nyimpa, ebɛnadze na menye wo wɔ yɛ? Ɔwo aba me nkyɛn dɛ edze mo bɔn reba nkaa mu, na eku me ba!
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Fa wo ba no ma me. Na oyii no fii no bo mu, na ɔmaa no do kɔr pia mu, mbrɛ ɔtse no, na ɔdze no kɔtoo nankasa ne mpa do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔtseaa mu frɛɛ EWURADZE see dɛ, EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn e, ana edze mbusu aba okunafo yi so a mabɔsoɛ ne nkyɛn yi do, dɛ iruboku ne ba?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔtseen no mu butuuw abofra no do mpɛn ebiasa, na ɔtseaa mu frɛɛ EWURADZE see dɛ, EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn e, meserɛ wo, ma abofra yi ne kra mbra no mu bio.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE tsiee Elija ne ndze: na abofra no ne kra baa no mu bio, na onyaa nkwa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Elija faa abofra no na ɔdze no fi pia no mu sianee baa ɔdan no mu, na ɔdze no maa ne na: na Elija see dɛ, Hwɛ, wo ba enya nkwa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa no see Elija dɛ, Afei na mehu dɛ Nyame nyimpa nye wo, na EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔwɔ w’anomu yɛ nokwar.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda pii n’ekyir no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Elija nkyɛn, wɔ afe a otsia ebiasa no mu, dɛ, Kɔ, keyi woho edzi kyerɛ Ahab; na mebɛma nsu atɔ egu asaase do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Elija sii mu kɔr dɛ orikeyi noho edzi akyerɛ Ahab. Na ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ Samaria.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ahab frɛɛ Obadia a ɔhwɛ fidua no do no. (Nna Obadia suro EWURADZE dɛ:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jezebel rutwitwa EWURADZE no nkɔnhyɛfo no egu no, Obadia faa nkɔnhyɛfo ɔha, na ɔdze hɔn eduonum eduonum kosumasumaa ɔbo tu mu, na ɔdze edziban na nsu hwɛɛ hɔn.)
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ahab see Obadia dɛ, Kɔ, kekyin asaase no mu, nsubura nyinara, na nwora nyinara ho: bi a yebenya nkyɛkyɛr bi dze agye mpɔnkɔ na nsoasopɔnkɔ no nkwa, ma yɛannhwer mbowa no nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna wɔkyɛɛ asaase no mu maa hɔnho dɛ worikekyin do: Ahab nonko faa ɔkwan kor do, na Obadia nonko so faa ɔkwan kor do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Obadia nam ɔkwan no mu no, hwɛ, Elija nye no hyiae: na ohun no, na ɔdze n’enyim butuuw famu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ana ɔwo mo wura Elija nye no a?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na obuaa dɛ, Emi nye no: kɔ, kɛka kyerɛ wo wura dɛ, Hwɛ, Elija wɔ ha.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na mayɛ bɔn, ma ɔwo epɛ dɛ iyi w’akowaa hyɛ Ahab nsa, dɛ onku me yi?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn tse ase yi, ɔman biara, anaa ahenman biara nnyi hɔ a mo wura nnsomae ma wɔnnkɔr hɔ nnkɔhwehwɛɛ wo: na sɛ wɔse dɛ, Onnyi ha a ɔma ahenman no na ɔman no ka ntam dɛ wonnhun wo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na afei ɔwo ese dɛ, Kɔ, kɛka kyerɛ wo wura dɛ, Hwɛ, Elija wɔ ha.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ mefi wo nkyɛn mokɔ ara a, nkyɛ EWURADZE no sunsum no ehwim wo akɔ beebi mbrɛ minnyim; na dɛm ntsi sɛ mokɔ kɛka kyerɛ Ahab, na oennhu wo a, oboku me: na emi, w’akowaa dze, mifi me mberantsɛ mu ara na musuro EWURADZE.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ana wɔnnkaa dza aber a Jezebel rukuku EWURADZE no nkɔnhyɛfo no meyɛe no nnkyerɛɛ mo wura, mbrɛ misii na mefaa EWURADZE no nkɔnhyɛfo no mu mbarimba ɔha, na medze hɔn eduonum eduonum kosumasumaa ɔbo tu mu, na medze edziban na nsu mohwɛɛ hɔn no?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na afei ɔwo ese dɛ, Kɔ, kɛka kyerɛ wo wura dɛ, Hwɛ, Elija wɔ ha: na oboku me.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Elija see dɛ, Dɛ dɔm EWURADZE a migyina n’enyim tse ase yi, ampa mibeyi moho edzi makyerɛ no ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Obadia sii mu kɔree kehyiaa Ahab na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no: na Ahab kɔree kehyiaa Elija.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahab hun Elija no, Ahab see no dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye no, ɔwo Israel no fonafo nye no?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na obuaa dɛ, Emi mommfonaa Israel; mbom ɔwoara, na w’egya fie a, wɔ dɛ hom apow EWURADZE ne mbransɛm, na ɔwo ekedzi Baalim ekyir.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei soma na wɔnkɔboaboa Israel nyinara ano mbrɛ me wɔ bepɔw Karmel do, na Baal nkɔnhyɛfo ahaanan eduonum no, na Asera nkɔnhyɛfo ahaanan a wodzidzi Jezebel no pon do no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Ahab somae ma wɔkɔr Israelmba no nyinara mu, na wɔkɔboaboaa nkɔnhyɛfo no ano kɔr Karmel bepɔw do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Elija baa ɔman no nyinara nkyɛn, na obisaa dɛ, Hom rigyina adwen ebien ntamu ma ekodu dabɛn? Sɛ EWURADZE nye Nyankopɔn a, hom ndzi n’ekyir: sɛ Baal so a, ɔno hom ndzi n’ekyir. Na ɔman no emmbua no asɛm biara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Elija see ɔman no dɛ, Emi, manko ara nye EWURADZE no nkɔnhyɛnyi a ɔaka; na Baal nkɔnhyɛfo dze hom yɛ mbarimba ahaanan eduonum.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi ma wɔmma hɛn anantwi ebien; na ma wɔnsan mu nyi nantwisaa kor mma hɔnho, na wontwitwa no esinesin, na wɔmfa ngu nyena no do, na mma wɔmmfa gya nngu ase: na mo so mibesiesie nantwisaa kor no, na medze egu nyena no do, na meremmfa gya nngu ase.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na hom mfrɛ hom nyame ne dzin, na mo so mebɛfrɛ EWURADZE ne dzin: na onyame a ɔdze gya bɛgye do no, wɔmma ɔno nyɛ Nyankopɔn. Na ɔman no nyinara buae see dɛ, Wɔaka no yie.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Elija see Baal nkɔnhyɛfo no dɛ, Hom nsan mu nyi nantwisaa kor mma homho, na hom ndzi kan nsiesie no; osiandɛ hom dɔɔ so; na hom mfrɛ hom nyame ne dzin, mbom mma wɔmmfa gya nngu ase.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔfaa nantwisaa no a wɔdze maa hɔn no, na wosiesiei, na wɔfrɛɛ Baal ne dzin fi anapa araa kodur wigyinae dɛ, Baal e, tsie hɛn. Naaso nna ndze bi nnyi hɔ, na nyia ɔgye do biara so nnyi hɔ. Na wohuruhuruwii kyiin afɔrmbukyia no a wɔyɛe no ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ wigyinae no, Elija sii hɔn atwetwe see dɛ, Hom mfa ndze kɛse ntsea mu: na ɔyɛ nyame; sisei ɔrodwen, anaa oefir edzi, anaa oetu kwan, anaa bi a ɔada, otwar dɛ wonyan no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔtseaa mu kɛse, na wɔdze asekan na nkambaa twitwaa hɔnho dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ tse no, kodur dɛ bɔgya sɔɔn hɔn ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wigyinae twaa mu no, wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm araa kodur dɛ ɔrokɔ ewimbir afɔr no bɔber; naaso ndze biara nnyi hɔ, na nyia ɔgye do so nnyi hɔ, na obiara so nnyi hɔ a ɔhwɛ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Elija see ɔman no nyinara dɛ, Hom ntwe mpin me; na ɔman no nyinara twee piin no. Na ɔyɛɛ EWURADZE afɔrmbukyia a ebubu no yie.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Elija faa abo duebien, dɛ mbrɛ Jakob ne mba ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no dodow tse, ɔno a EWURADZE n’asɛm baa ne nkyɛn dɛ, Israel nye wo dzin no a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdze abo no sii afɔrmbukyia wɔ EWURADZE ne dzin mu; na otwaa ɔka a obedzi aba a wogu etwadze ebien wɔ afɔrmbukyia no ho hyiae.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na osiesiee nyena no, na otwitwaa nantwisaa no epruw, na wɔdze guu nyena no do. Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mfa nsu nhyehyɛ esuhina anan amaama, na wonhue ngu ɔhyew afɔr, na nyena no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nyɛ no mprɛnu; na wɔyɛɛ no mprɛnu. Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nyɛ no mprɛnsa, na wɔyɛɛ no mprɛnsa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nsu no peem afɔrmbukyia no ho hyiae; na ɔdze nsu hyɛɛ ɔka no so ma.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ewimbir afɔr no bɔber mu no, nkɔnhyɛnyi Elija twee pinii, na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, Abraham, Isaak na Israel Nyankopɔn, ndɛ da yi ma wonhu dɛ ɔwoara nye Nyankopɔn wɔ Israel mu, na meyɛ w’akowaa, na mayɛ ndzɛmba yi nyinara wɔ w’asɛm do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Tsie me, EWURADZE tsie me, ma ɔman yi eehu dɛ ɔwoara, EWURADZE nye Nyankopɔn, na ɔwoara adan hɔn akoma asan aba bio.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna EWURADZE ne gya dwirii, na ɔbɛhyeew ɔhyew afɔr no, na nyena no, na abo na dɛtse no, na ɔtafeer nsu a ɔwɔ ɔka no mu no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aber a ɔman no nyinara hunii no, wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu: na wɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, ɔno nye Nyankopɔn; EWURADZE, ɔno nye Nyankopɔn.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Elija see hɔn dɛ, Hom nkyer Baal no nkɔnhyɛfo no; mma hom mma hɔn mu kor mpo mmfi nsa. Na wɔkyeer hɔn: na Elija dze hɔn sianee baa ɔwora Kishon ho, na okum hɔn wɔ hɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Elija see Ahab dɛ, Fow kɔ, kedzidzi na nom; na matse nsu kɛse nka.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Ahab sii mu kɔr dɛ orikedzidzi na ɔanom. Na Elija sii mu kɔr Karmel n’etsifi; na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ famu, na ɔdze n’enyim hyɛɛ n’anankoroma ntamu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee n’akowaa dɛ, Afei fow kɔ, kɔhwɛ pomu afamu. Na ɔfowee kɔree kɔhwɛe, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwee nnyi hɔ. Na ɔsee dɛ, Kɔ bio mpɛn esuon.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ otsia esuon no, nna ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, mununkum bi fi pomu rosoɛr a osuar dɛ nyimpa ne nsakum. Na ɔsee dɛ, Fow kɔ kɛse Ahab dɛ, Siesie wo tseaseanam, na sian, ma nsu no eennsiw wo kwan.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔkyɛɛr kakraabi no, na mununkum na mframa ebir ɔsor tumm, na nsu kɛse tɔree. Na Ahab tutui kɔr Jezreel.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE ne nsa baa Elija do; na ɔbɔɔ n’asen do, na otuu mbirika dzii Ahab enyim kodur Jezreel ahɛnee.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ahab kaa dza Elija yɛe no nyinara kyerɛɛ Jezebel, na mbrɛ osii dze afona kum nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Jezebel somaa ɔbɔfo ma ɔkɔr Elija nkyɛn dɛ, Dɛm na enyame no nyɛ me, na bi so nka ho, sɛ ɔkyena sisei na memmaa wo nkwa nnyɛɛ dɛ hɔn mu baako no nkwa a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ohunii no, na no nkwa ntsi, ɔsoɛree sii mu kɔree, na okodur Beer-seba a ɔyɛ Juda dze no, na ogyaa n’akowaa no wɔ hɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔno noara dze osii mu kɔr sar no do da kor kwan, na ɔkɔree kɛtsenaa ɔsɛsɛ dua bi ase: na ɔserɛe maa noho dɛ nkyɛ onwu; na ɔsee dɛ, Ayɛ yie; afei EWURADZE, yi mo nkwa; na minnye mennsen m’egyanom.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdaa famu dae wɔ ɔsɛsɛ dua bi ase; na, hwɛ, ɔbɔfo bi kaa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Soɛr dzidzi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, tatar a wɔato no wɔ gyansenama do, na nsu kɔɔpow si n’etsifi. Na odzidzii na ɔnomee, na ɔdaa famu bio.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no baa bio otsia mpɛn ebien no, bɛkaa no see dɛ, Soɛr dzidzi; na akwantu no war dodow ma wo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsoɛree, dzidzii na ɔnomee, na ɔnantsewee wɔ edziban no n’ahoɔdzen mu kɔr Nyankopɔn ne bepɔw Horeb ho adaduanan, adzekyee na adzesaa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa hɔ ɔbo tu bi ho, na ɔsoɛɛ hɔ; na, hwɛ, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, Elija, ereyɛ ebɛnadze wɔ ha?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn ho nyinkun na matwe; osiandɛ Israelmba apow w’ahyɛmu, woedwurudwuruw w’afɔrmbukyia, na wɔdze afona ekuku wo nkɔnhyɛfo: na emi, emi ara nko, na maka; na wɔrohwehwɛ mo so woeeku me.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Pue kɔ, na kegyina bepɔw no do wɔ EWURADZE enyim. Na, hwɛ, EWURADZE botwaa mu, na mframa kɛse dzendzen paapaa mbepɔw mu, na obubuu abotan mu esinesin dzii EWURADZE enyim; naaso nna EWURADZE nnyi mframa no mu: na mframa no ekyir asaasewosow a; na EWURADZE nnyi asaasewosow no mu:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na asaasewosow no ekyir ogya a; na EWURADZE nnyi ogya no mu: na ogya no ekyir ndze bɔkɔɔ bi a.
title: 1ST KINGS
