text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Elija tsee no, ɔdze n’akatakɔnmu no kataa n’enyim, na opuei kegyinaa ɔbo tu no n’ahɛnee. Na hwɛ, ndze bi baa ne nkyɛn, see dɛ, Elija, ereyɛ ebɛnadze wɔ ha?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn ho nyinkun na matwe; na Israelmba apow w’ahyɛmu, woedwurudwuruw w’afɔrmbukyia, na wɔdze afona ekuku wo nkɔnhyɛfo; na emi, emi ara nko na maka; na wɔrohwehwɛ mo so woeeku me.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Kɔ, san fa wo kwan kɔ Damaskɔs sar no do: na sɛ idu a, sera Hazael ngo hyɛ no hen wɔ Siria do:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na sera Nimsi ne babanyin Jehu ngo hyɛ no hen wɔ Israel do: na sera Safat ne babanyin Elisha a ofi Abel-mehola no ngo hyɛ no nkɔnhyɛnyi dzi w’ananmu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, nyia obefi nsa efi Hazael afona anomu no, Jehu boku no: na nyia obefi nsa efi Jehu afona anomu no Elisha boku no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Naaso mibegyaa Israel mu mpemesuon ama moho, anankoroma nyinara a wommbui mmaa Baal, na ano biara a ɔmmfeew n’ano.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna osii mu fii hɔ kɔree, na okohun Safat ne ba Elisha a ɔdze anantwi mpamho duebien dzi n’enyim rufuntum, na ɔnoara ka dza otsia duebien no ho: na Elija twaa mu kɔr ne nkyɛn na ɔtoow n’akatakɔnmu guu no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔdaan anantwi no gyae, na otuu mbirika dzii Elija ekyir, na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma menkɛfew m’egya na me na ano, na nkyii mimbedzi w’ekyir. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Kɔ bra; na ebɛnadze na medze mayɛ wo?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ofii n’ekyir sanee, na ɔkɛfaa anantwi mpamho no, na okum hɔn, na ɔdze anantwi edwumayɛ ndua no noaa nam no, na ɔdze maa nkorɔfo no, na wodzii. Nna ɔsoɛree kedzii Elija ekyir, na ɔsoom no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Siriahen Ben-hadad boaboaa no dɔm nyinara ano: na ahemfo eduasa ebien ka no ho, na mpɔnkɔ na ntseaseanam: na osii mu kɔree kotuaa Samaria, na ɔnye no koe.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsomaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Israelhen Ahab nkyɛn, wɔ kurow no mu, kɛsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ Ben-hadad se nye yi,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Wo dwetɛ na wo sika yɛ medze; wo yernom so na wo mba so a wɔyɛ fɛw no, wɔyɛ me dze.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israelhen no buae see dɛ, Mo wura ɔhen, ɔtse dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm no tse ara; emi na dza mowɔ nyinara, yɛ wodze.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na abɔfo no baa bio, bɛsee dɛ, Mbrɛ Ben-hadad ka nye yi, dɛ, Ampa mosomae ma wɔbaa wo nkyɛn, dɛ, Yi wo dwetɛ na wo sika, na wo yernom, na wo mba ma me;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na ɔkyena siseber yi mobɔsoma mo nkowaa wɔ wo nkyɛn, na wɔbɔhwehwɛɛhwɛ wo fie, na wo nkowaa hɔn efiefi; na ɔbɛba dɛ adze biara a ɔyɛ hɔn enyiwa do fɛw no, wɔbɛfa ekitsa hɔn nsamu, na wɔdze akɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Israelhen no frɛɛ asaase no do mpanyimfo no nyinara, na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ hom, hom nhyɛ no nsew, na wɔnhwɛ mbrɛ nyimpa yi esi rohwehwɛ bɔn: osiandɛ ɔsomae ma wɔbaa me nkyɛn bebisaa me yernom, na me mba, na mo dwetɛ, na me sika ho; na mannkam no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na mpanyimfo no nyinara na ɔman no nyinara see no dɛ, Mma nntsie, nkyii so mma mmpen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔsee Ben-hadad n’abɔfoe no dɛ, Hom nkɛka nkyerɛ mo wura ɔhen dɛ, Dza ibebisaa no wɔ w’akowaa hɔ asɔpɔn no dze mebɛyɛ: na dɛm adze yi dze merennyɛ. Na abɔfo no sii mu kɔree, na wɔdze asɛm kɛmaa no bio.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ben-hadad somae ma wɔbaa ne nkyɛn, bɛsee dɛ, Enyame no nyɛ me dɛm mma bi so nka ho, sɛ mannsɛɛ Samaria anndan no huntuma a ɔbɔso nkorɔfo a wodzi m’ekyir nyinara nsapuw nsapuw a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israelhen no buae see dɛ, Hom nkɛka nkyerɛ no dɛ, Mma nyia ogu do roko no nntuw noho dɛ nyia ɔako ewie.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ben-hadad tsee amandzɛɛ yi, wɔ aber a ɔnoara na ahemfo no ronom nsa, wɔ asese mu no, nna ɔsee no nkowaa dɛ, Hom mbaa mpasuar. Na wɔbaa mpasuar wɔ kurow no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na, hwɛ, nkɔnhyɛnyi bi twee piin Israelhen Ahab nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ana ehu nyimpadodow kɛse yi nyinara? Hwɛ, medze hɔn merehyɛ wo nsa ndɛ da yi; na ehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ahab see dɛ, Ɔnam woana do? Na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ɔnam amansin asafohemfo no hɔn mberantsɛ no do. Nna ɔsee dɛ, Woana na ɔnhyɛ ɔko no ase? Na obuaa dɛ, Ɔwo a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔkaan amansin asafohemfo no hɔn mberantsɛ no, na wɔyɛ ahaenu eduasa ebien: na hɔn ekyir no ɔman no nyinara, mekyerɛ Israelmba a ɔkanee no nyinara, wɔyɛ mpemesuon.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wofir edzi wigyinae. Nna Ben-hadad ronom nsa wɔ asese no mu, ɔno na ahemfo no, ahemfo eduasa ebien a wɔboaboaa no no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na amansin asafohemfo no hɔn mberantsɛ no dzii kan fiir edzi. Na Ben-hadad somaa akwanserafo na wɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Mbarimba epue fi Samaria reba.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ asomdwee ntsi na woefir edzi a, hom mfa hɔn enyikan; na sɛ ɔko so ntsi na woefir edzi a, hom mfa hɔn enyikan.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna amansin asafohemfo no hɔn mberantsɛ no dzii kan, na dɔm nkaa no dzii hɔn ekyir fi kurow no mu fiir edzi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na hɔn nyinara kunkum hɔn nyimpa biara a wɔnye no koe; na Siriafo no guanguanee, na Israel tsiiw hɔn: na Siriahen Ben-hadad tse pɔnkɔ do nye mpɔnkɔdofo no fii nsa guanee.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israelhen no fiir edzi kokunkum mpɔnkɔ na ntseaseanam no, na ɔdze oku kɛse kum Siriafo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nkɔnhyɛnyi no twee piin Israelhen no na ɔsee no dɛ, Kɔ kɛhyɛ woho dzen, na hyɛ no nsew, na hwɛ dza ereyɛ: osiandɛ afedan no Siriahen no bɔfow aba wo do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Siriahen no no nkowaa see no dɛ, Hɔn nyame yɛ akoko do nyame; dɛm ntsi na hɔn ho yɛ dzen kyɛn hɛn no: na ma yɛnye hɔn nkɔko wɔ tɛtɛr mu, ampaara nkyɛ hɛn ho bɛyɛ dzen asen hɔn.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na iyi na yɛ; yiyi ahemfo no fi hɔ, nyimpa biara mfi ne tsenabew, na fa asafohemfo hyehyɛ hɔn ananmu;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na kan dɔm a ɔtse dɛ dɔm a ahwer hɔn no ma woho, ɔpɔnkɔ nhyɛ ɔpɔnkɔ ananmu, na tseaseanam nhyɛ tseaseanam ananmu: na yɛnye hɔn bɔko wɔ tɛtɛr mu na ampaara hɛn ho bɛyɛ dzen asen hɔn. Na otsiee hɔn ndze, na ɔyɛɛ dɛm.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ afedan no mu, Ben-hadad kɛkaan Siriafo no, na osii mu kɔr Afek, dɛ ɔnye Israel rokɔko.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔkaan Israelmba no so, na wosiesiee hɔnho na wosii mu kɔree kehyiaa hɔn: na Israelmba no kyeer nsera wɔ hɔn enyim tse dɛ mpɔnkyemba ekuw nkakraba ebien; na Siriafo no dze wɔhyɛɛ ɔman no ma.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Nyame nyimpa bi twee pinii bɛkaa kyerɛɛ Israelhen no see dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Osiandɛ Siriafo no ase dɛ, EWURADZE yɛ akoko do nyame, na ɔnnyɛ ɔbɔn mu nyame no; dɛm ntsi mibeyi nyimpadodow kɛse yi nyinara mahyɛ wo nsa, na hom ehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔkyekyeer nsera, ɔbaako wɔ ɔbaako so ne tsentsendo nda esuon. Na ɔbaa dɛ, da a otsia esuon no wɔdze ɔko no kɔbɔɔ enyim; na Israelmba no kum Siriafo no mu anamɔnmufo mpemɔha da kor mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nkaa no guanguanee kɔr Afek kurow no mu; na ɔfasu no bui guu nyimpa mpemeduonu esuon a wɔkae no do. Na Ben-hadad guanee, na ɔkɔr kurow no mu, mpiakyir mpia mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na no nkowaa see no dɛ, Hwɛ, afei yɛatse dɛ Israel fie ahemfo no wɔyɛ ahemfo mbɔbɔrhufo: yɛserɛ wo, ma yɛmfa eyitam nkyekyer hɛn asen, na ntampehoma mbobɔ hɛn etsir, na yemfir edzi nkɔ Israelhen nkyɛn: gyangyanbiara ɔbɛgye wo kra nkwa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna wɔdze eyitam kyekyeer hɔn asen, na wɔdze ntampehoma bobɔɔ hɔn etsir, na wɔbaa Israelhen no nkyɛn, bɛsee dɛ, W’akowaa Ben-hadad se dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma mentsena ase. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ana ɔda ho tse ase? Ɔyɛ mo nua.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei mbarimba no hyɛɛ no nsew yie, na wɔyɛɛ ntsɛm dɛ wɔregye no dɛ ɔyɛ n’adwen; na wɔsee dɛ, Wo nua Ben-hadad a. Nna ɔsee dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɛfa no mbra. Nna Ben-hadad fiir edzi baa ne nkyɛn; na ɔmaa ɔfowee baa tseaseanam no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ben-hadad see no dɛ, Nkurow a m’egya gyee no wɔ w’egya nsamu no mebɛdan mama; na tsetsew abrɔn ma woho wɔ Damaskɔs, dɛ mbrɛ m’egya yɛe wɔ Samaria no. Na Ahab see dɛ, Emi so medze ahyɛmu yi mibegyaa wo ma akɔ. Nna ɔnye no dzii ahyɛmu, na ogyaa no ma ɔkɔree.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbarimba bi a ofi nkɔnhyɛfomba no mu nam EWURADZE n’asɛm do see ne nyɛnko dɛ, Meserɛ wo, bɔ me. Na nyimpa no poow dɛ ɔbɔbɔ no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔsee no dɛ, Osiandɛ enntsie EWURADZE ne ndze ntsi, hwɛ, ifi me nkyɛn isi mu rokɔ ara a, gyata boku wo. Na ofii ne nkyɛn sii mu rokɔ ara, nna gyata hun no, na okum no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ohun nyimpa fofor so, na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ wo bɔ me. Na nyimpa no bɔɔ no, ɔbɔɔ no piraa no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi no sii mu kɔree, na ɔkɔtweɔɔn ɔhen no wɔ ɔkwan no mu, na ɔdze n’abɔtsir kyekyeer n’enyim sakyeer noho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aber a ɔhen no rutwa mu no, ɔkaa mu frɛɛ ɔhen no na ɔsee dɛ, W’akowaa fiir edzi kɔr ɔko no ne finimfin; na, hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi danee faa nkyɛn, na ɔdze nyimpa bi brɛɛ me, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ nyimpa yi do: sɛ ɔnam kwan biara do ma ɔyera a, ɔnodze wɔdze wo nkwa bɛhyɛ no nkwa ananmu, anaaso ibotua dwetɛ dwetɛbona kor.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aber a w’akowaa reyɛ adze wɔ ha na n’enyi nnyi no do no, nna nkɔhwɛ a, ɔkɔ. Na Israelhen no see no dɛ, Mbrɛ w’atsɛmbua nyɛ nye no, ɔwoara ebua.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm yii abɔtsir no wɔ n’enyiwa do; na Israelhen no hun no dɛ ofi nkɔnhyɛfo no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Osiandɛ egyaa nyimpa a mehyira no do ama ɔsɛɛ no ma oefi wo nsa kɔr no, dɛm ntsi wo nkwa bɛhyɛ no nkwa ananmu, na wo man ahyɛ ne man ananmu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israelhen no sii mu kɔr ne fie dɛ ɔayɛ kusuu na no bo efuw, na ɔbaa Samaria.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nsɛm yi ekyir no, na Jezreelnyi Nabot wɔ wenyin ture bi wɔ Jezreel, wɔ Samariahen Ahab n’ahemfi ho papaapa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ahab kaa kyerɛɛ Nabot dɛ, Fa wo wenyin ture no ma me, ma memfa menyɛ fan ture, osiandɛ ɔbɛn me fi ho; na mebɛma wo wenyin ture a oye sen no mahyɛ ananmu: anaa, sɛ obeye ama wo a, medze mbrɛ odzi no mebɛma wo wɔ sika mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Nabot see Ahab dɛ, EWURADZE mma ɔmpar me dɛ, medze m’egyanom hɔn egyapadze mebɛma wo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ahab baa ne fie dɛ ɔayɛ kusuu na no bo efuw osian asɛm a Jezreelnyi Nabot ɔaka akyerɛ no no ntsi: na ɔsee no dɛ, Meremmfa m’egyanom egyapadze memma wo. Na ɔdaa ne mpa do, na ɔdaan n’enyim kɔr ban ho, na ɔammpɛ dɛ odzidzi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ne yer Jezebel baa ne nkyɛn, na obisaa no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo sunsum abɔm dɛm, na inndzidzi yi?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Osiandɛ mekasaa kyerɛɛ Jezreelnyi Nabot, na mesee no dɛ, Fa wo wenyin ture no ma me gye sika; anaaso, sɛ epɛ a, mebɛma wo wenyin ture fofor mahyɛ ananmu: na obuaa dɛ, Meremmfa mo wenyin ture memma wo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ne yer Jezebel see no dɛ, Ana nnyɛ ɔwo na ehwɛ Israel ahendzi do a? Soɛr dzidzi, na ma w’akoma ntɔ wo yamu: medze Jezreelnyi Nabot no wenyin ture no mebɛma wo.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔdze Ahab ne dzin kyerɛkyerɛɛw nwoma, na ɔdze no nsɔwano dze sosɔɔw ano, na ɔsomasomae ma wɔdze nwoma no kɛmaa mpanyimfo no na ekunyin a wɔwɔ no kurow mu a wɔnye Nabot tse no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ nwoma no mu dɛ, Hom mbɔ dawur ma wondzi mbuada, na wɔmfa Nabot ndzi tsir wɔ nkorɔfo no mu:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na wɔmfa nyimpa beenu a wɔyɛ asansafo, ngyina n’enyim, na wɔmma wondzi dase ntsia no, dɛ, Ɔwo adom Nyankopɔn na ɔhen. Na nkyii hom mfa no mpue nkesiw no abo ma onwu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na no kurow no mu mbarimba no, mekyerɛ mpanyimfo na ekunyin no a wɔtse no kurow no mu no, yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Jezebel somae ma wɔdze kɛmaa hɔn no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ nwoma a ɔsomae ma wɔdze kɛmaa hɔn no mu no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Wɔbɔɔ dawur dɛ wondzi mbuada, na wɔdze Nabot dzii tsir wɔ nkorɔfo no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nyimpa beenu no, asansafo no, bae bɛtsenaa n’enyim: na asansafo no dzii dase tsiaa no, mekyerɛ wɔdze tsiaa Nabot, wɔ ɔman no enyim, dɛ, Nabot adom Nyankopɔn na ɔhen. Nna wɔfaa no fii kurow no mu puei, na wokesiiw no abo ma owui.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna wɔsomae ma wɔkɔr Jezebel nkyɛn, dɛ, Woesiw Nabot abo, na oewu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jezebel tsee dɛ woesiw Nabot abo ma oewu no, nna Jezebel see Ahab dɛ, Soɛr, kɛfa Jezreelnyi Nabot no wenyin ture no a ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔdze bɛma wo agye sika no yɛ enyadze; na Nabot nntse ase bio, na oewu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahab tsee dɛ Nabot ewu no, nna Ahab soɛree dɛ orisian akɔ Jezreelnyi Nabot no wenyin ture no mu ɔakɛfa ayɛ enyadze.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Tisbinyi Elija nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Soɛr, sian kɔ nye Israelhen Ahab a ɔtse Samaria no nkedzi ehyia: hwɛ, ɔwɔ Nabot no wenyin ture no mu, hɔ na oesian kɔ dɛ ɔrekɛfa ayɛ enyadze.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ka kyerɛ no, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ana eku, na eso afa ayɛ enyadze? Na ka kyerɛ no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Beebi mbrɛ nkraman tafeer Nabot no bɔgyaa no hɔ na nkraman bɛtafer ɔwo so wo bɔgyaa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ahab see Elija dɛ, Me tamfo, ana ehu me? Na obuaa dɛ, Mehu wo: osiandɛ atɔn woho dɛ ereyɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Hwɛ, medze mbusu mebɛba wo do, na mapra wo kwakwaakwa, na metwa Ahab mu abofra banyin biara akyen, na Israel mu nyia wɔatow no mu na nyia woegyaa no:
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na mebɛyɛ wo fi dɛ Nebat ne ba Jeroboam ne fi, na Ahija ne ba Baasa ne fi, wɔ ebufuw a edze eyi me na ama Israel ayɛ bɔn ntsi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔ Jezebel ho so EWURADZE kaa dɛ, Nkraman bedzi Jezebel wɔ Jezreel afasu ho.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nyia ofi Ahab mu a obowu wɔ kurow mu no, nkraman bedzi; na nyia obowu wɔ haban mu no wimu ntumbowa bedzi.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: (Naaso obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ Ahab a ne yer Jezebel hyɛɛ no nkuran ma ɔtɔɔn noho dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ekyiwadze dodow dɛ odzii abosom ekyir, dɛ mbrɛ Amorifo a EWURADZE tuu hɔn wɔ Israelmba enyim yɛe no nyinara.)
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahab tsee nsɛm no, ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔdze eyitam kataa noho na odzii mbuada, na ɔdaa eyitam mu, na otsiaa dɔndɔn kɔree.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Tisbinyi Elija nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Ana ehu mbrɛ Ahab esi na ɔabrɛ noho adze wɔ m’enyim a? Osiandɛ ɔabrɛ noho adze wɔ m’enyim ntsi, meremmfa mbusu no memmba wɔ ne nda mu: na ne ba ne nda mu na medze mbusu no mebɛba ne fi do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Siria na Israel tsenaa hɔ mfe ebiasa a ɔko bi nnyi hɔn ntamu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia ebiasa no mu no, Judahen Jehosafat sianee baa Israelhen do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israelhen no see no nkowaa dɛ, Ana hom nyim dɛ Ramot-gilead yɛ hɛndze, na yɛayɛ komm na yɛnngye mmfi Siriahen no nsamu yi?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee Jehosafat dɛ, Ana enye me bɔkɔ Ramot-gilead akɔko a? Na Jehosafat see Israelhen no dɛ, Metse dɛ woara, me man tse dɛ wo man, mo mpɔnkɔ tse dɛ wo mpɔnkɔ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Jehosafat see Israelhen no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, bisa EWURADZE n’asɛm ndɛ.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Israelhen no boaboaa nkɔnhyɛfo no ano, mbarimba bɛyɛ ahaanan, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana monkɔ Ramot-gilead nkɔko, anaa mingyaa? Na wɔsee dɛ, Fow kɔ; na EWURADZE dze bɛhyɛ ɔhen nsa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Jehosafat see dɛ, Ana EWURADZE no nkɔnhyɛnyi bi so nnyi ha, ma yeebebisa no hɔ adze?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israelhen no see Jehosafat dɛ, Ɔbarimba baako bi da ho wɔ ha a nkyɛ yɛnam no do bebisa EWURADZE hɔ adze, Imla ne ba Mikaia a: na mikyir no; osiandɛ ɔnnhyɛ mo ho nkɔm pa, na bɔn nko. Na Jehosafat see dɛ, Mma mma ɔhen nnse dɛm.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Israelhen no frɛɛ ɔsafohen bi, na ɔsee dɛ, Kɛfa Imla ne ba Mikaia bra ntsɛmara.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Israelhen na Juda hen Jehosafat tsetse hɔn nhengua do nkorkor, hyehyɛ hɔn ahentar, wɔ Samaria kuropon ahɛnee gua do; na nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara rehyɛ nkɔm wɔ hɔn enyim.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Kenaana ne ba Zedekia yɛɛ dadze mmbɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Iyinom na edze bosun Siriafo no ara ma wɔahyew.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara hyɛɛ nkɔm dɛm, dɛ, Fow kɔ Ramot-gilead na kɛyɛ yie: na EWURADZE dze bɛhyɛ ɔhen nsa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbɔfo no a ɔkɔr dɛ ɔrekɛfrɛ Mikaia no kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Afei hwɛ, nkɔnhyɛfo no dze ano kor ka nsɛm pa kyerɛ ɔhen: Meserɛ wo, ma w’asɛm nyɛ dɛ hɔn mu baako n’asɛm, na ka dɛ oye.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Mikaia see dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase yi, dza EWURADZE bɛse me no, ɔno na mebɛka.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na aber a ɔbaa ɔhen no nkyɛn no, ɔhen no see no dɛ, Mikaia, ana yɛnkɔ Ramot-gilead nkɔko, anaa yenngyaa? Na obuaa dɛ, Fow kɔ na kɛyɛ yie; na EWURADZE dze bɛhyɛ ɔhen nsa.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Mpɛn ahen ara na menka ntam ngu wo do ma ka dza ɔyɛ nokwar nko wɔ EWURADZE ne dzin mu kyerɛ me?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Muhun Israel nyinara dɛ wɔapetse mbepɔw do, dɛ nguan a wonnyi oguanhwɛfo: na EWURADZE see dɛ, Iyinom wonnyi wura; ma wɔnsan, nyimpa biara nkɔ ne fie asomdwee mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israelhen no see Jehosafat dɛ, Ana mannka annkyerɛ wo dɛ, Ɔnnkɛhyɛ mo ho nkɔm pa, dɛ bɔn nko?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛm ntsi tsie EWURADZE n’asɛm: Muhun EWURADZE dɛ ɔtse n’ahengua do, na ɔsor dɔm nyinara gyinagyina no ho wɔ n’enyimfa na n’abankum.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Woana na ɔbɛdaadaa Ahab, ma ɔaafow akɔ akɔtɔr wɔ Ramot-gilead? Na obi see dɛm; na obi so see dɛm.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na sunsum bi fiir edzi begyinaa EWURADZE enyim na ɔsee dɛ, Mara mebɛdaadaa no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Edze ebɛnadze? Na ɔsee dɛ, Mibefir edzi, na makɛyɛ sunsum torfo wɔ no nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara anomu. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔwo bɛdaadaa no, na ibedzi nyim so: fir edzi kɔ, na kɛyɛ dɛm.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, hwɛ, EWURADZE dze sunsum torfo ahyɛ wo nkɔnhyɛfo yi nyinara anomu; na EWURADZE akasa wo ho bɔn.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Kenaana ne ba Zedekia twee pinii, na ɔbɔɔ Mikaia sotɔr see dɛ, Ebɛn kwan do na EWURADZE no sunsum fii me nkyɛn bɛkaa iyi kyerɛɛ wo?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Mikaia see dɛ, Hwɛ da no a ebɔkɔ mpiakyir pia mu dɛ irukosuma woho no na ibohu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israelhen no see dɛ, Fa Mikaia, na fa no san kɔ kɛma kurow no mu ambrado Amon, na ɔhen ne ba Joas;
title: 1ST KINGS

text: na se dɛ, Mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, Hom mfa akowaa yi nto efiadze, na hom mfa ahohiahia edziban na ahohiahia nsu mbɔ no akɔhoma, ma onkodu dɛ mebɛba no asomdwee mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Mikaia see dɛ, Sɛ ɔwoara esan ba no asomdwee mu ara dze a, nna nnyɛ EWURADZE na ɔnam mo do akasa. Na ɔsee dɛ, Aman, hom nyinara hom ntsie.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Israelhen na Judahen Jehosafat sii mu kɔr Ramot-gilead.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israelhen no see Jehosafat dɛ, Mebɛsakyer moho na makɔ ɔko no mu; na ɔwo dze hyɛ wo ntar. Na Israelhen no sakyeer noho na ɔkɔr ɔko no mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Siriahen no ahyɛ ne tseaseanam do asafohemfo eduasa ebien no dɛ, Mma hom nnye kakraba anaa kɛse nnko, gyedɛ Israelhen no nkotsee.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no hun Jehosafat no, nna wɔsee dɛ, Ampa, Israelhen no nye no; na wɔdaan hɔnho dɛ wɔnye no rokɔko: na Jehosafat kekaa mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no hun dɛ nnyɛ Israelhen nye no no, nna wogyaa no tsiw saan hɔn ekyir.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔbarimba bi twee n’egyen mu ntɔgon mu ara, na ɔdze bɔɔ Israelhen no wɔ mbɔtoa mu na akatabo no ntamu: dɛm ntsi ɔsee ne tseaseanamkanyi no dɛ, Dan wo nsa, na fa me fi dɔm yi mu; na mepira dzendzen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔko no mu yɛɛ dzen da no: na wosuoo ɔhen no mu gyinaa ne tseaseanam mu wɔ Siriafo enyim, na ɔtɔɔr ewimbir: na bɔgya fi epirakur no mu pemee kɔr tseaseanam no ase.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nkekamu bi faa dɔm no mu witɔree ber no, dɛ, Nyimpa biara nkɔ no kurow mu, na nyimpa biara nkɔ ne man mu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen no wui, na wɔdze no baa Samaria; na wosiee ɔhen no wɔ Samaria.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na wɔkɔhohoor tseaseanam no mu wɔ Samaria nsutaae ho; na nkraman tafeer no bɔgyaa; (afei mbaa ehuhufo hohor hɔnho wɔ hɔ;) dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔkae no tse no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Ahab no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na asombɛn dan a osii, na nkurow a ɔkyekyeree nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ahab kɔr ne nsamankyir; na ne babanyin Ahazia dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Israelhen Ahab n’afe a otsia anan no mu na Asa ne ba Jehosafat hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Juda do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Jehosafat dzii mfe eduasa enum no nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hen; na odzii hen mfe eduonu enum wɔ Jerusalɛm. Na ne na ne dzin dze Azuba, Silhi ne babaa a.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔnantseew n’egya Asa kwan no nyinara do; ɔanndan emmfi ho, dɛ ɔyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do: naaso oennyi mbea sorɔnsorɔm no emmfi hɔ; ɔman no daa ho bɔɔ afɔr na wɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbeambea sorɔnsorɔm no.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na nsiesie baa Jehosafat nye Israelhen no ntamu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Afei Jehosafat no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na ne mbanyinndam a ɔkyerɛe, na mbrɛ osii dzii ako no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na sodomfo nkaa a wɔkae wɔ n’egya Asa nda no mu no, otuu hɔn fii asaase no do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen bi nnyi Edom: na ahyɛnanmu bi na odzi hen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Jehosafat yɛɛ Tarsis ahɛn dɛ wɔnkɔ Ofir nkɛfa sika: na wɔannkɔ, osiandɛ ahɛn no bobɔe wɔ Ezion-geber.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Nna Ahab ne ba Ahazia see Jehosafat dɛ, Ma mo nkowaa nka wo nkowaa ho nkɔ ahɛn no mu. Na Jehosafat ammpen.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Jehosafat kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no kaa n’egyanom ho wɔ n’egya David kurow mu: na ne babanyin Jehoram dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Judahen Jehosafat n’afe a otsia duesuon no mu na Ahab ne ba Ahazia hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel, na odzii hen mfe ebien wɔ Israel do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, na ɔnantseew n’egya no kwan no do, na ne na no kwan do, na Nebat ne ba Jeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no, no kwan do.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na ɔsoom Baal, na ɔsɔɔr no, na oyii EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ebufuw, dɛ mbrɛ dza n’egya yɛe no nyinara tse.
title: 1ST KINGS

text: Na Ahab no wu ekyir no Moab tseew etua wɔ Israel do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Ahazia nam n’abansor pia a ɔwɔ Samaria n’atenatokura mu bɔhwee famu, na ɔyaree: na otuu abɔfo, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ, wonkebisa Ekron nyame Baal-zebub no kyerɛ dɛ mobɔbɔ esu wɔ yarba yi mu a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see Tisbinyi Elija dɛ, Soɛr, fow kɔ kehyia Samariahen n’abɔfoe no, na se hɔn dɛ, Ana osiandɛ Nyankopɔn bi nnyi Israel ntsi, na hom rokɔ ekebisa Ekron nyame Baal-zebub no hɔ adze yi?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mpa no a afow no rimmfi do nnsian, na owu ara na ibowu. Na Elija sii mu kɔree.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na abɔfo no sanee baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom asan yi?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Ɔbarimba bi fowee behyiaa hɛn, na ɔsee hɛn dɛ, Hom nsan nkɔ ɔhen a ɔsomaa hom no nkyɛn bio, na wɔnse no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ana osiandɛ Nyankopɔn bi nnyi Israel ntsi, na asoma dɛ wonkebisa Ekron nyame Baal-zebub no hɔ adze yi? Dɛm ntsi mpa no a afow no irimmfi do nnsian famu, na owu ara na ibowu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔbarimba a ɔfowee bae behyiaa hom na ɔkaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ hom no tse dɛn?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wobuaa no dɛ, ɔyɛ nyimpa a no ho yɛ nhwi nhwi, na nwoma abɔdo bɔ n’asen. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Tisbinyi Elija a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen no somaa eduonum do safohen nye n’eduonum no wɔ no hɔ. Na ɔfowee kɔr ne nkyɛn: na, hwɛ, ɔtse koko no n’etsifi. Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, Nyame nyimpa, ɔhen se dɛ, Sian bra.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elija buae see eduonum do ɔsafohen no dɛ, Sɛ Nyame nyimpa nye me a, ogya mfi sor nsian mbɛhyew ɔwo na w’eduonum no. Na ogya fi sor sianee bɛhyeew ɔno na n’eduonum no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsomaa eduonum do safohen fofor so nye n’eduonum wɔ no hɔ bio. Na obuae see no dɛ, Nyame nyimpa, mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, Yɛ ntsɛm sian bra.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elija buae see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ Nyame nyimpa nye me a, ogya mfi sor nsian mbɛhyew ɔwo na w’eduonum no. Na Nyame gya fi sor sianee bɛhyeew ɔno na n’eduonum no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na bio ɔsomaa eduonum do safohen a otsia ebiasa nye n’eduonum bio. Na eduonum do ɔsafohen a otsia ebiasa no fowee kɔree, na ɔkɔkotoow n’anankoroma enyim wɔ Elija n’enyim, paa no kyɛw, na ɔsee no dɛ, Nyame nyimpa, meserɛ wo, ma mo nkwa, na wo nkowaa eduonum yi hɔn nkwa nsom bo wɔ w’enyi do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Hwɛ, ogya fi sor sianee bɛhyeew nkan no eduonum do asafohemfo beenu no nye hɔn eduonum eduonum no: na afei ma mo nkwa nsom bo wɔ w’enyi do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see Elija dɛ, Enye no nsian nkɔ: mma nnsuro no. Na ɔsoɛree, na ɔnye no sianee kɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Susuampa dɛ ɔwo asoma abɔfo dɛ wonkebisa Ekron nyame Baal-zebub hɔ adze no, nna siantsir nye dɛ Nyankopɔn bi nnyi Israel a wokebisa n’asɛm bi a? Dɛm ntsi mpa no a afow no irimmfi do nnsian, na owu ara na ibowu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna owui dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm no a Elija kae no tse. Na osiandɛ onnyi ba ntsi, Joram hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu wɔ Judahen Jehosafat ne ba Jehoram n’afe a otsia ebien no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Ahazia no ho nsɛm nkaa no, dza ɔyɛe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu a?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a EWURADZE rebɛfa Elija ehum mu akɔ sor no, Elija nye Elisha fi Gilgal sii mu kɔree.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elija see Elisha dɛ, Meserɛ wo, tsintsim ha; na EWURADZE asoma me wɔ Bɛtɛl. Na Elisha see dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase, na wo kra tse ase yi, mirinngya wo hɔ. Na wosii mu kɔr Bɛtɛl.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na nkɔnhyɛfo mba a wɔwɔ Bɛtɛl no fiir edzi baa Elisha nkyɛn bebisaa no dɛ, Ana inyim dɛ ndɛ EWURADZE rebɛfa wo wura efi wo tsir do akɔ a? Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyew, minyim; hom nyɛ komm.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elija see no dɛ, Elisha, Meserɛ wo, tsintsim ha; na EWURADZE asoma me Jeriko. Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase, na wo kra tse ase yi, mirinngya wo hɔ. Nna wɔbaa Jeriko.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na nkɔnhyɛfo mba a wɔwɔ Jeriko no twee piin Elisha nkyɛn bebisaa no dɛ, Ana inyim dɛ ndɛ EWURADZE rebɛfa wo wura efi wo tsir do akɔ a? Na obuaa dɛ, Nyew, minyim; hom nyɛ komm.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elija see no dɛ, Meserɛ wo, tsintsim ha; na EWURADZE asoma me Jordan do. Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase, na wo kra tse ase yi, mirinngya wo hɔ. Na hɔn beenu no sii mu kɔree.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na nkɔnhyɛfo mba no mu nyimpa eduonum sii mu kɔree kegyinagyinaa hɔn tsentsendo wɔ ekyirekyir: nna hɔn beenu no gyina Jordan ho.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elija faa n’egukɔnmu no, na ɔbobɔwee dze bɔɔ nsu no mu, na ɔpaae kɔr ha na ha, na hɔn beenu no nam asaase kɛsɛɛ do twae.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wotwae no, Elija see Elisha dɛ, Bisa dza menyɛ memma wo, ansaana wɔafa me efi wo nkyɛn akɔ. Na Elisha see dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma wo sunsum kyɛfa mbɔho mbra mo do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebisa adze a ɔyɛ dzen: naaso sɛ ihu me aber a wɔrefa me efi wo nkyɛn a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛm ama wo; na sɛ annyɛ dɛm a, ɔnnkɛba dɛm.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔda ho ara nam rokɔ, na wɔrekasa no, hwɛ, ogya tseaseanam, na ogya mpɔnkɔ a ɔbɛpaa hɔn beenu nyina ntamu no puei; na Elija nam ehum mu fowee kɔr sor.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha hunii, na ɔtseatseaa mu dɛ, M’egya e, m’egya e, Israel ntseaseanam na no mpɔnkɔdofo e! Na oennhu no bio: na osuoo nankasa ne ntar mu, na ɔtsetseew mu esinesin ebien.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ɔfaa Elija n’egukɔnmu no a ofi no ho gui no so, na ɔsaan n’ekyir begyinaa Jordan nsukɔn do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔfaa Elija n’egukɔnmu a ofi no ho gui no, dze bɔɔ nsu no mu, see dɛ, Na EWURADZE, Elija Nyankopɔn no wɔ hen? Na aber a ɔno so bɔɔ nsu no mu no, na ɔpaae kɔr ha na ha: na Elisa twae.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a nkɔnhyɛfo mba a wɔwɔ Jeriko wɔ ne tsentsendo hun no no, wɔsee dɛ, Elija no sunsum edwir Elisha do. Na wɔbae behyiaa no, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze butuuw famu wɔ n’enyim.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔsee Elisha dɛ, Afei, hwɛ, mbarimba a wɔyɛ dzen eduonum wɔ wo nkowaa nkyɛn; yɛserɛ wo, ma wɔnkɔ nkɔhwehwɛ wo wura: bɛyɛ na bi a EWURADZE no sunsum no ama no do kɔ dze no akɔto bepɔw bi do, anaa ɔbɔn bi mu. Na ɔsee dɛ, Mma hom nnsoma.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a wɔhyɛɛ no ara ma ɔyɛɛ no ahomtsew no, ɔsee dɛ, Hom nsoma ɛ. Dɛm ntsi wɔsomaa mbarimba eduonum; na wɔkɔhwehwɛe ara ndaansa, naaso woennhu no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔsanee baa ne nkyɛn, mber a otsintsimii wɔ Jeriko no; na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana mannse hom dɛ, Mma hom nnkɔ?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na kurow no mu mbarimba no see Elisha dɛ, Hwɛ, yɛserɛ wo, kurow yi ne dabea yɛ fɛw, dɛ mbrɛ mo wura hu yi: na nsu no dze onnye, na asaase no so pon mba.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mbrɛ me pɔr fofor, na wɔmfa nkyen ngu mu. Na wɔdze brɛɛ no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ofiir edzi kɔr nsu no no nsunyiwa no ho, na ɔtoow nkyen guu mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Masa nsu yi yarba; owu anaa mbapon bi rimmfi mu mmba bio.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna wɔsaa nsu no yarba dze bodu ndɛ da yi, dɛ Elisha n’asɛm a ɔkae no ara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ofii hɔ sii mu kɔr Bɛtɛl: na aber a ɔnam kwan no do rofow akɔ no, mbofra nkakraba fi kurow no mu puei besii no atwetwe see no dɛ, Fow ɛ, otsipaa; fow ɛ, otsipaa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhwɛɛ n’ekyir na ohun hɔn, na ɔdze EWURADZE ne dzin paa hɔn. Na nsisiber beenu fi kwaa no mu bae bɛtsetseew hɔn mu mbofra eduanan ebien.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ofii hɔ kɔr bepɔw Karmel do, na ofii hɔ so sanee kɔr Samaria.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Judahen Jehosafat n’afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu na Ahab ne ba Joram hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samaria, na odzii hen mfe duebien.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do; naaso ɔnntse dɛ n’egya, na ɔnntse dɛ ne na: osiandɛ oyii Baal n’edum no a n’egya yɛe no wɔ hɔ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Mbom ɔdze noho bataa Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no ho; na oemmfi ho emmfi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Moabhen Mesha yɛ nguannyɛmfo; nna ɔma Israelhen no nguambaa mpem ɔha ho nhwi, na nguannyin mpem ɔha ho nhwi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Ahab wui no, na Moabhen no tseew etua wɔ Israelhen no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na no mu no ɔhen Jehoram fiir edzi fii Samaria, na ɔkɛkaan Israel nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔkɔree kɔsomae ma wɔkɔr Judahen Jehosafat nkyɛn, dɛ, Moabhen no atsew mo do etua: ana enye me bɔkɔ enye Moab akɔko a? Na ɔsee dɛ, Mobɔkɔ: metse dɛ ɔwoara, me man tse dɛ wo man, mo mpɔnkɔ tse dɛ wo mpɔnkɔ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔkwan bɛn do na yɛbɛfa akɔ? Na obuaa dɛ, Edom sar no do kwan no do a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Israelhen, na Judahen, na Edomhen no sii mu kɔree: na wokyiin nda esuon kwan: nna nsu bi nnyi hɔ mma dɔm no, na eso mbowa a wodzi hɔn ekyir no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Israelhen no see dɛ, Annyɛ yie! EWURADZE afrɛ ahemfo baasa yi ehyia dɛ oriyi hɛn akɛhyɛ Moab nsa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehosafat see dɛ, Ana EWURADZE nkɔnhyɛnyi bi nnyi ha a yebodua no do ebisa EWURADZE hɔ adze? Na Israelhen no no nkowaa no mu baako buae see dɛ, Safat ne ba Elisha a ohuee nsu guu Elija ne nsa do no, na ɔwɔ ha.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehosafat see dɛ, EWURADZE n’asɛm wɔ ne nkyɛn. Nna Israelhen na Jehosafat na Edomhen no sianee kɔr ne nkyɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha see Israelhen no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na menye wo wɔ yɛ? Kɔ w’egya no nkɔnhyɛfo no, na wo na no nkɔnhyɛfo no nkyɛn. Na Israelhen no see no dɛ, Dabida: osiandɛ EWURADZE afrɛ ahemfo baasa yi ehyia dɛ oriyi hɛn akɛhyɛ Moab nsa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha see dɛ, Dɛ dɔm EWURADZE a migyina n’enyim yi tse ase yi, ampa, sɛ nnyɛ Judahen Jehosafat n’enyim na mohwɛ a, nkyɛ merennkyea m’enyi wɔ wo do, na eso moronnhwɛ wo.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na afei hom mfa ɔsankubɔfo mbrɛ me. Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔsankubɔfo no robɔ no, nna EWURADZE ne nsa baa no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hom nyɛ ɔbɔn yi amona amona.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hom runnhu mframa, nkyii so hom runnhu nyankom, naaso nsu bɛhyɛ ɔbɔn no ma: na hom anom, hom na hom fiembowa na hom adzesoa mbowa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na iyi so yɛ EWURADZE enyi do adze tootooba: obeyi Moabfo no so ahyɛ hom nsa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na hom mbɔ kurow biara a wɔagye ho ban, na kurow biara a ɔyɛ fɛw, na wɔntow dua pa biara, na wonsisiw nsunyiwa nyinara, na hom mfa abo nsɛɛ asaase no tɔw pa biara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ anapa, bɛyɛ afɔrbɔber no, na, hwɛ, nsu fii Edom kwan do bae, na nsu hyɛɛ ɔman no ma.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei aber a Moabfo nyinara tsee dɛ ahemfo no wɔafow aba dɛ wɔnye hɔn robɔko no, wɔpoon hɔnho boaa ano, hɔn a wobotum emia akodze nyinara, na hɔn a wɔbor dɛm, na wobegyinaa ɔhe do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔsoɛɛr anapaatu, na ewia gyegyee nsu no do, na Moabfo no hun nsu no wɔ hɔn enyim tsentsendo dɛ ɔber dɛ bɔgya:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na wɔsee dɛ, Iyi bɔgya a; ampa ahemfo no nye hɔn edzi dɔmpata, na woekuku hɔnho: dɛm ntsi afei, Moab, hom nkɔ asadze no ho ɛ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a wodur Israel nseraban ho no, Israelfo no soɛree kunkum Moabfo no, ma woguanee wɔ hɔn enyim: na wɔhoom do kɔr kan wɔ asaase no mu dɛ worukuku Moabfo no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wodwuruuw nkurow no; na nyimpa biara toow no bo kyeen asaasetɔw pa biara do hyɛɛ no ma; na wosisiiw nsunyiwa biara, na wotwitwaa ndua pa no nyinara: kyerɛ Kir-hareset nko na wogyaa n’abo; naaso tsiabotofo no kotwaa ho hyiae, na wɔbɔɔ no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a Moabhen hun dɛ ɔko no mu ayɛ dzen dodow ama no no, ɔfaa mbarimba ahaesuon a wɔtwe mfona kaa noho, dɛ ɔretsew mu akɔ Edomhen no nkyɛn: na woenntum.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔfaa ne ba panyin a nkyɛ obedzi hen wɔ n’ananmu no, na ɔdze no bɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr wɔ fasu no do. Na hu kɛsenara tɔɔ Israel do: na wofii ne nkyɛn kɔree, na wɔsanee baa hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei nkɔnhyɛfo mba yernom no mu ɔbaa bi kekaa mu frɛɛ Elisha, dɛ, W’akowaa mo kun no oewu: na ɔwoara inyim dɛ nna w’akowaa suro EWURADZE: na afei ɔdzefirfo no aba rebɛfa me mba beenu akɛyɛ no nkowaa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na menyɛ mma wo? Ka kyerɛ me; ebɛnadze na ewɔ no wɔ wo fie? Na ɔsee dɛ, W’afonabaa nnyi adze biara wɔ fie dɛ ngo ehina ara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔsee dɛ, Kɔ, kɛfemfɛm ehina wɔ wo mfɛfo nyinara hɔ, mekyerɛ ehina pan; femfɛm pii.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na kɔ wo dan mu, kɔtow ɔwo na wo mba abow mu, na huehue ngo no gugu ehina no nyinara mu; na fa dza ɔayɛ ma no sisi nkyɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ofii ne nkyɛn kɔree, na ɔkɔtoow ɔno na ne mba no abow mu; wɔdze ehina no brɛɛ no, na ohuehuei.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ehina no yeyɛɛ amaama no, nna ɔsee ne ba dɛ, Fa ehina bi so brɛ me. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ehina biara nnyi hɔ bio. Na ngo no twae.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔbae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ Nyame nyimpa no. Na ɔsee dɛ, Kɔ kɔtɔn ngo no, na tua wo kaw, na ɔwo na wo mba ndzi ne nkaa no ntsena ase.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa da bi dɛ, Elisha twaa mu kɔr Sunem, mbrɛ ɔbaa ɔdzefo bi wɔ; na ɔbaa no serɛɛ no dɛ ondzidzi. Na ɔbaa dɛ, daa orutwa mu a, ɔman hɔ kedzidzi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa no see no kun dɛ, Afei hwɛ, mehu dɛ nyia otwa mu wɔ hɛn nkyɛn daa yi Nyame nyimpa krɔnkrɔn a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Meserɛ wo, ma yɛnyɛ pia kakraba bi wɔ fasu no do; na ma yɛmfa mpa, na pon, na egua, na kandzeadua nsisi mu hɔ mma no; na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ ɔba hɛn nkyɛn a, ɔaman akɔ hɔ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa da bi dɛ ɔbaa hɔ, na ɔmanee kɔr pia no mu kɛdaa hɔ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee n’akowaa Gehazi dɛ, Kɛfrɛ Sunamnyi no ma ɔmbra. Na ɔkɛfrɛɛ no ma ɔbae.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha see Gehazi dɛ, Afei bisa no dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔwo edze ɔhaw yi nyinara ahaw woho ama hɛn; ebɛnadze na wɔnyɛ mma wo? Ebɛpɛ dɛ wɔka wo ho asɛm kyerɛ ɔhen, anaa dɔm safohen no? Na obuaa dɛ, Metse mankasa mo nkorɔfo mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha bisaa dɛ, Ebɛnadze koraa na wɔnyɛ mma no? Na Gehazi buaa dɛ, Ampa onnyi ba, no kun so ayɛ akɔdaa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha see dɛ, Kɛfrɛ no ma ɔmbra. Na ɔkɛfrɛɛ no ma ɔbae no, obegyinaa abow no ano.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Afedan siseber yi mu no, ebɛyɛ ɔba etuu. Na ɔbaa no see dɛ, Dabida, mo wura, Nyame nyimpa, mma nndzi ator nnkyerɛ w’afonabaa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa no nyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin afedan no mu aber no ara mu, dɛ mbrɛ Elisha see no ara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a abofra no nyinii no, da bi ɔbaa dɛ ofiir edzi kɔr n’egya nkyɛn ewitwafo no nkyɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee n’egya dɛ, Me tsir o, me tsir o. Na ɔsee n’akowaa dɛ, Ma no do kɛma ne na.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a ɔmaa no do no, na ɔdze no brɛɛ ne na no, ɔdaa ne na n’aserɛ do kodur wigyinae, na nkyii owui.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa no fowee kɔree dze no kɔtoo Nyame nyimpa no ne mpa no do, na ɔtoow no abow mu, na ofiir edzi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔkɛfrɛɛ no kun no, na ɔsee dɛ, Meserɛ wo, kɛma me nkowaa no mu kor, na nsoasopɔnkɔ mu kor, ma muntutu mbirika monkɔ Nyame nyimpa no nkyɛn, na mensan mbra.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na no kun no bisaa no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na epɛ dɛ ekɔ ne nkyɛn ndɛ da yi? Ɔnnyɛ bosoom fofor na ɔnnyɛ ahomgyeda so. Na ɔsee dɛ, Oye.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔhyehyɛɛ asoaso, na ɔsee n’akowaa dɛ, Ka no kɔ kan; mma nngow mbirikatu no mu mma me, gyedɛ mese wo.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna osii mu kɔree, na obodur Nyame nyimpa no nkyɛn wɔ bepɔw Karmel do. Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Nyame nyimpa no hun no ekyirekyir no, nna ɔsee n’akowaa, Gehazi dɛ, Hwɛ, Sunamnyi no na ɔwɔ noho no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei meserɛ wo, tu mbirika hyia no kwan, na bisa no dɛ, Ana wo ho ye? Ana wo kun ho ye? Ana abofra no so ho ye? Na ɔbaa no buaa dɛ, Oye.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a odur Nyame nyimpa no nkyɛn wɔ koko no do no, nna obosusuoo n’ananmu. Na Gehazi twee piin no dɛ orubosun no; na Nyame nyimpa no see dɛ, Gyaa no: na ne kra werɛ ahow wɔ no mu; na EWURADZE dze esuma me, na ɔannka annkyerɛ me.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔsee dɛ, Ana mibebisaa mo wura hɔ ɔba bi? Ana mannse dɛ, Mma nndaadaa me?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Elisha see Gehazi dɛ, Bɔ w’asen do, na fa mo poma no kitsa wo nsamu, na kɔ: sɛ ihyia nyimpa biara a, mma nnkyia no; na sɛ obiara so kyia wo a, mma nngye no do: na fa mo poma no kɔto abofra no n’enyim.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na abofra no ne na no see dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase, na wo kra tse ase yi, merenndan wo nngya. Na ɔsoɛree dzii n’ekyir.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Gehazi twaa mu dzii hɔn enyim kɔree, na ɔdze poma no kɔtoo abofra no n’enyim; naaso nna ndze bi nnyi hɔ, na ngyedo so nnyi hɔ. Dɛm ntsi ɔsanee kehyiaa no, na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, Abofra no nnyanee.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a Elisha dur ofi no mu no, hwɛ, nna abofra no ewu, na wɔdze no ato ne mpa do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔkɔr dan mu, na ɔtoow hɔn beenu no abow mu, na ɔbɔɔ mpaa maa EWURADZE.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔfowee kɔree kobutuuw abofra no do, na ɔdze n’ano faam n’ano ho, na ɔdze n’enyiwa butuuw n’enyiwa do, na ɔdze ne nsa totoo ne nsamu: na ɔkotoow no do; na abofra no no honam yɛɛ hyew.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔsanee bae bɛnantseew ɔdan no mu dzii akɔnaaba prɛko; na ɔfowee kɔree, na ɔkɔkotowee wɔ no do: na abofra no huntsii mpɛn esuon, na abofra no buee n’enyiwa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ Gehazi na ɔsee dɛ, Kɛfrɛ Sunamnyi no ma ɔmbra. Nna ɔkɛfrɛɛ no. Na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn no, ɔsee dɛ, Ma wo ba do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔkɔree kotwae hwee n’anan ho, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ famu; na ɔmaa ne ba do, na ofiir edzi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha baa Gilgal bio: na ɔkɔm aba asaase no do; na nkɔnhyɛfo mba no tsetse n’enyim: na ɔsee n’akowaa dɛ, Fa ɔsɛn kɛse no si do, na noa edziban ma nkɔnhyɛfo mba no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaako fiir edzi kɔr haban mu dɛ ɔrekɛtsew fan, na okohun hamu haban bi, na ɔtsetseew do hamu efer ne tam ma, na ɔdze bae botwitwaa mu guu ɔsɛn a edziban wɔ mu no mu: osiandɛ wonnyim.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna wohuei maa nyimpa no dɛ wondzi. Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a woridzi edziban no bi no, wɔkekaa mu see dɛ, Nyame nyimpa e, owu wɔ ɔsɛn no mu. Na woenntum enndzi bi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nna wɔmfa isiam mbra ɛ. Na ɔtowee guu ɔsɛn no mu; na ɔsee dɛ, Hue ma nkorɔfo no, ma wondzi. Na biribi bɔn bi nnyi ɔsɛn no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbarimba bi fi Baal-salisa bae, na ɔdze nduadzewakan boodoo, atoko ntɔwmu eduonu, na eburow fofor wɔ no kotoku mu. Na ɔsee dɛ, Fa ma nkorɔfo no, ma wondzi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na n’akowaa no see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze a, aso memfa iyi minsi nyimpa ɔha enyim? Na ɔnodze ɔsee dɛ, Fa ma nkorɔfo no ma wondzi; na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Wobedzi, na woegya bi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔdze sii hɔn enyim, na wodzii, na wogyaa bi, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm no tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Siriahen no dɔm do ɔsafohen Naaman yɛ nyimpa kɛse wɔ no wura enyim, na ɔyɛ onyimnyamfo so, osiandɛ ɔno na EWURADZE nam no do dzii konyim maa Siria. Afei so ɔyɛ nyimpa katakyi a ɔyɛ ndam, na mbom ɔyɛ kwatanyi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Siriafo no hɔn akodzi no mu kor no, wɔakɛfa abaawa kakraba bi ndɔmmum wɔ Israel asaase do aba; na ɔsom Naaman ne yer no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee no wuraba dɛ, Kɛtseankyɛ mo wura wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi a ɔwɔ Samaria no nkyɛn! Ɔno nkyɛ ɔbɛsa no kwata ama no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Naaman kɔree kɛkaa kyerɛɛ no wura, dɛ, Dɛm na dɛm na abaawa a ofi Israel asaase do no se.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Siriahen no see dɛ, Kɔ bra, na mobɔsoma ma wɔdze nwoma akɛma Israelhen no. Ntsi osii mu kɔree, na ɔfaa dwetɛ talent du, na sika dwetɛbona mpem esia, na ntar hyɛpɛn du kitsae.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔdze nwoma no brɛɛ Israelhen dɛ, Sɛ nwoma yi du wo nsamu a, hwɛ, Masoma m’akowaa Naaman wɔ wo hɔ ma aasa no kwata no ama no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Israelhen no kenkaan nwoma no no, ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ana Nyankopɔn nye me, dɛ muboku na mama nkwa, na nyimpa yi rosoma ma ɔaaba mo hɔ dɛ mensa nyimpa no kwata yi? Meserɛ hom, hom ndwen ho, mbrɛ oesi rohwehwɛ manso etsia me.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Nyame nyimpa Elisha tsee dɛ Israelhen atsetsew ne ntar mu no, ɔsomae ma wɔkɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn, dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na atsetsew wo ntar mu yi? Ma ɔmbra me nkyɛn ɛ, na obohu dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi wɔ Israel.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Naaman nye no mpɔnkɔ nye ne ntseaseanam bae, na obegyinaa Elisha ne fi abowano.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha somaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr ne nkyɛn, dɛ, Kɔ na koguar Jordan mu mpɛn esuon, na wo honam bɛsan aba wo ho, na wo ho efir.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Naaman no bo fuwii, na osii mu kɔree, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, modween dɛ, Obopue aba me nkyɛn ampa, na oebegyina hɔ abɔ n’EWURADZE Nyankopɔn no ne dzin, na ɔdze ne nsa aserasera, na ɔasa kwatanyi no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ana Damaskɔs esutsen, Abana na Farpar, nnye nnsen Israel nsu nyinara? Aso nkyɛ munnguar mu ma mo ho mfir? Nna ɔdaan noho na ɔdze ebufuw sii mu kɔree.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na no nkowaa no twee pinii bɛkasaa kyerɛɛ no, see dɛ, M’egya, ana sɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi no kaa kyerɛɛ wo dɛ yɛ adze kɛse bi a, aso nkyɛ annyɛ bi a? Na nkyii, sɛ ɔse wo dɛ, Koguar, na wo ho mfir a?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna osianee kɔree na ɔdze noho kɔbɔɔ Jordan mu mpɛn esuon, dɛ mbrɛ Nyame nyimpa no n’asɛm no tse: na no honam sanee baa dɛ abofra kakraba no honam, na no ho firii.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsanee baa Nyame nyimpa no nkyɛn, ɔno na no kuw nyinara, na ɔbae begyinaa n’enyim: na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ afei mehu dɛ Nyame bi nnyi asaase nyinara do, dɛ Israel nko: dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, gye w’akowaa ne nsamu akyɛdze.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE a migyina n’enyim tse ase yi, merenngye bi. Na ɔhyɛɛ no dɛ ɔngye; na ɔpowee.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Naaman see dɛ, Sɛ erenngye m’akyɛdze a, ɔno meserɛ wo, ma wɔmfa dɛtse asoasompɔnkɔ beenu ndzesoa mma w’akowaa; osiandɛ ofi ndɛ kɔ yi w’akowaa rommbɔ ɔhyew afɔr anaa okum afɔr mma enyame biara, dɛ EWURADZE nko.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Adze kortsee na EWURADZE mfa nkyɛ w’akowaa; sɛ mo wura rokɔ Rimmon fie akɔsɔr wɔ hɔ, na ɔtwer me nsa do, na mobɔ mo mu adze wɔ Rimmon fie a, sɛ mobɔ mo mu adze wɔ Rimmon fie a, EWURADZE mfa nkyɛ w’akowaa wɔ asɛm yi mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Kɔ asomdwee mu. Nna osii mu fii ne nkyɛn kɔr kan kakra.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Nyame nyimpa Elisha n’akowaa Gehazi, see dɛ, Hwɛ, mo wura egyaa Sirianyi Naaman yi, dɛ ɔaangye ne nsamu dza ɔdze bae no: dɛ EWURADZE tse ase yi, mubotu mbirika mafa no, na makɛgye no hɔ biribi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Gehazi tsiiw Naaman. Na aber a Naaman hun dɛ obi dze mbirika refa no no, ofii tseaseanam no mu dwirii behyiaa no, na ɔsee dɛ, Asomdwee mu anaa?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Asomdwee mu a. Mo wura asoma me dɛ, Hwɛ, seseiara nkɔnhyɛfo mba no mu mberantsɛ beenu fi Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu aba me nkyɛn; meserɛ wo, ma hɔn dwetɛ talent kor, na ntar hyɛpɛn ebien.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Naaman see dɛ, Pen na gye talent ebien. Na ɔhyɛɛ no, na ɔkyekyeer dwetɛ talent ebien wɔ nkotoku ebien mu, nye ntar hyɛpɛn ebien ka ho, na ɔdze soaa no nkowaa no mu beenu; na wɔsoso dzi n’enyim.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a odur koko no ho no, ɔgyee wɔ hɔn nsamu, na ɔdze maa esie wɔ fie: na ogyaa mbarimba no kwan, na wosii mu kɔree.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔnodze ɔsanee kɔr no wura nkyɛn. Na Elisha see no dɛ, Gehazi, ifi hen nam? Na ɔsee dɛ, W’akowaa nnkɔr beebiara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ana aber a ɔbarimba no fi ne tseaseanam mu sanee dɛ oribehyia wo no, mo sunsum nye wo annkɔ bi a? Ana aber a wɔgye sika, na wɔgye ntar, na olive nture na wenyin nture, na nguan na anantwi, na nkowaa na mfonabaa nye yi a?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi Naaman no kwata no bɛtakyer ɔwo, na w’asefo daa. Na ofii n’enyim kɔree a kwata eguar no fitaa dɛ esukwankyɛba.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na nkɔnhyɛfo no binom see Elisha dɛ, Afei hwɛ, beebi mbrɛ yɛtse wɔ w’enyim yi ha kyer dodow ma hɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Yɛserɛ wo, ma yɛnkɔ Jordan nkyɛn, na nyimpa biara nkɛfa mpuna wɔ hɔ, na yɛnyɛ beebi wɔ hɔ a yɛbɛtsena mma hɛnho. Na obuaa dɛ, Hom nkɔ ɛ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na obi see dɛ, Meserɛ wo, pen, na enye wo nkowaa nkɔ. Na obuaa dɛ, Mobɔkɔ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔnye hɔn sii mu kɔree. Na aber a wodur Jordan nkyɛn no, wɔtotoow ndua.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a ɔbaako rotow mpuna no, ekumatsir no hɔree kɔtɔɔ nsu no mu: na ɔkekaa mu see dɛ, Ewuo, mo wura! Wɔkɛfɛmee o.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Nyame nyimpa no see dɛ, Ɔtɔɔ hen? Na ɔkyerɛɛ no fakor no. Na otwaa dua bi towee kyeen mu hɔ, na ɔmaa dadze no bɛtsɛɛw nsu no enyi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ma do fa. Nna ɔtseen ne nsa maa do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Siriahen no nye Israel bedzii ako; na ɔnye no nkowaa faa apam, dɛ, Dɛm na dɛm bea no do na mebɛkyer me nseraban.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Nyame nyimpa no somae ma wɔkɔr Israelhen no ne nkyɛn, dɛ, Hwɛ yie ma innkotwa mu wɔ dɛm bea yi do; osiandɛ hɔ na Siriafo no risian aba.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Israelhen no somae ma wɔkɔr beebi mbrɛ Nyame nyimpa no kaa kyerɛɛ no na ɔdaa noho do wɔ hɔ, ɔnnyɛ prɛko na ɔnnyɛ mprɛnu so.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Siriahen no n’akoma tuu dodow wɔ asɛm yi ho; na ɔfrɛɛ no nkowaa no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnkɛkyerɛ me hɛn mu nyia ɔwɔ Israelhen no n’afa?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na no nkowaa no mu baako see dɛ, Dabida, mo wura ɔhen: mbom nkɔnhyɛnyi Elisha a ɔwɔ Israel no na ɔka nsɛm a ɔwo eka no wɔ w’adankyir no no, kyerɛ Israelhen no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Kɔhwehwɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ, ma monsoma ma wɔnkɛfa no mbra. Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔwɔ Dotan.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔsomaa mpɔnkɔ, na ntseaseanam, na dɔm kɛsenara ma wɔkɔr hɔ: na wodur anadwe, na wotwaa kurow no ho hyiae.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a Nyame nyimpa no n’akowaa no soɛɛr ahanamakye na opuei no, hwɛ, dɔm nye mpɔnkɔ na ntseaseanam abɔ kurow no ho aprɔw. Na n’akowaa no see no dɛ, Ao, mo wura, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na obuaa dɛ, Mma nnsuro: osiandɛ hɔn a wɔka hɛn ho wɔdɔɔ so sen hɔn a wɔka hɔn ho no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha bɔɔ mpaa see dɛ, EWURADZE, meserɛ wo, bue n’enyiwa ma onhu. Na EWURADZE buee aberantsɛ no n’enyiwa; na ohunii: na, hwɛ, ogya mpɔnkɔ na ntseaseanam ayɛ mbepɔw no do ma abɔ Elisha ho aprɔw.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a Siriafo no sianee baa ne nkyɛn no, Elisha bɔɔ mpaa maa EWURADZE, see dɛ, Meserɛ wo, fa enyifura bɔ nkorɔfo yi. Na ɔdze enyifura bɔɔ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ Elisha n’asɛm no tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha see hɔn dɛ, Nnyɛ ɔkwan no bi nye yi, nkyii so nnyɛ kurow no bi nye yi: hom ndzi m’ekyir, na memfa hom nkɔ ɔbarimba no a hom rohwehwɛ no no nkyɛn. Na ɔdze hɔn kɔr Samaria.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wodur Samaria no, nna Elisha see dɛ, EWURADZE, bue nyimpa yi hɔn enyiwa, ma wonhu. Na EWURADZE buee hɔn enyiwa na wohunii; na, hwɛ, wɔwɔ Samaria finimfin.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a Israelhen no hun hɔn no, ɔsee Elisha dɛ, M’egya, ana munku hɔn? Ana munku hɔn?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na obuaa dɛ, Mma nnku hɔn: ana epɛ dɛ iku hɔn a edze w’afona na w’egyen afa hɔn ndɔmmum a? Fa edziban na nsu sisi hɔn enyim, ma wondzi na wɔnnom, na wɔnkɔ hɔn wura nkyɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔtoo pon kɛse maa hɔn: na aber a wodzidzii na wɔnomee no, ogyaa hɔn kwan, na wosii mu kɔr hɔn wura nkyɛn. Na Siria ekuwekuw no ammba Israel asaase no do bio.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyi n’ekyir, Siriahen Ben-hadad boaa no dɔm nyinara ano, na osii mu kɔree kotuaa Samaria.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔkɔm kɛse sii Samaria: na, hwɛ, wotuaa no araa ma ɔdze kodur dɛ wɔtɔɔn asoasopɔnkɔ ne tsir gyee ndwetɛbona eduowɔtwe, na aborɔnoma egyanan ebupɛn anan mu kor gyee ndwetɛbona enum.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a Israelhen no rutwa mu wɔ fasu no do no, ɔbaa bi tseaa mu frɛɛ no, dɛ, Mo wura ɔhen e, boa me.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ EWURADZE ammboa wo a, mibefi hen maboa wo? Ewuporowee no mu, anaa nsatwer no mu a?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔyɛ wo? Na obuaa dɛ, Ɔbaa yi see me dɛ, Fa wo ba bra ma yenku no ndzi no ndɛ, na yeedzi mo so me ba ɔkyena.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna yɛnoaa me ba no dzii: na n’adzekyee mesee no dɛ, Fa wo ba bra ma yendzi a: ɔno ɔdze ne ba esuma.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen no tsee ɔbaa no ne nsɛm no, na ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu; (afei nna orutwa mu wɔ fasu no do;) na nkorɔfo no hwɛe, na, hwɛ, ofura eyitam kata no honam enyi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔsee dɛ, Nyame nyɛ me dɛm, na bi so nka ho, sɛ mennyi Safat ne ba Elisha emmfi atseasefo mu ndɛ da yi a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Elisha dze ɔtse ne fie, na mpanyimfo no tsetse ne nkyɛn; na ɔhen no somaa nyimpa bi dzii n’enyim: na ansaana ɔbɔfo no rudu ne nkyɛn no, ɔnoara see mpanyimfo no dɛ, Ana hom ehu dɛ owudzifo ne ba yi asoma dɛ wombotwa me tsir wɔ do? Hom nhwɛ, sɛ ɔbɔfo no ba a, hom ntow abow no mu, na wompia no nkɔ abowano: ana nnyɛ no wura n’ananadze tsim tsim na odzi n’ekyir no a?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a ɔda ho nye hɔn rekasa no, hwɛ, ɔbɔfo no sianee baa ne nkyɛn: na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, mbusu yi fir EWURADZE hɔ; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mobɔtweɔn EWURADZE bio?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha see dɛ, Hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ɔkyena siseber yi wɔbɔtɔn isiam pa etwadze kor agye dwetɛbona kor, na atoko etwadze ebien agye dwetɛbona kor, wɔ Samaria kuropon ano.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔsafohen no a ɔhen no twer ne nsa do no buaa Nyame nyimpa no see dɛ, Hwɛ, sɛ EWURADZE reyɛ ntokura wɔ ɔsor mpo a, ana nkyɛ dɛm asɛm yi bɛba mu a? Na Elisha see no dɛ, Hwɛ, edze w’enyiwa bohu, na mbom innkedzi bi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei akwatafo baanan wɔ kuropon no n’ahɛnee: na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na yɛretsenatsena ha araa dze ewuwu yi?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Sɛ yɛse dɛ, Yɛbɛhɛn kurow no mu a, ɔnodze ɔkɔm no wɔ kurow no mu, na yebowuwu wɔ hɔ: na sɛ yɛda ho tsetse ha a, eso yebowuwu dɛmara. Dɛm ntsi afei hom mbra ma yɛnkɔhwɛ Siria dɔm no mu: sɛ wɔgye hɛn nkwa a, yɛbɛtsena ase; na sɛ woku hɛn so a, nna yeewu ara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔsoɛɛr adansaber no, dɛ wɔrokɔ Siriafo nsera mu: na aber a wodur Siriafo nsera no ne ntsiatsia no, hwɛ, nna nyimpa biara nnyi hɔ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Osiandɛ EWURADZE ayɛ ma Siriafo dɔm no atse ntseaseanam, na mpɔnkɔ, mekyerɛ dɔm kɛse nka: na wɔasese hɔnho dɛ, Hwɛ, Israelhen no akɔbɔ Hitifo ahemfo, na Egyptfo ahemfo ɔkopaa etsia hɛn, dɛ wɔmbra hɛn do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔasoɛr eguan adansaber no, na woegya hɔn asesee, na hɔn mpɔnkɔ, na hɔn nsoasopɔnkɔ, mekyerɛ nsera no dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse no ara, na woeguan wɔ hɔn nkwa ntsi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a akwatafo yi dur nsera no n’ano no, wɔkɔr asese kor mu kedzidzii nomee, na wɔfaa dwetɛ, na sika, na ntar, na wɔkɔree dze kosumae; na wɔsanee bae bɛhɛɛn asese kor so mu, na wɔfaa hɔ so adze na wɔkɔree dze kosumae.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Yɛrennyɛ no yie: ndɛ da yi yɛ nsɛmpa da, na yɛayɛ komm yi: sɛ yɛtweɔn ma okodu anapa enyimtsetsewee a, so bi bɛda hɛn do: dɛm ntsi afei hom mbra ma yɛnkɔ nkɛka nkyerɛ ɔhen ne fifo.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna wɔbae bɛfrɛɛ kurow no n’abowanoahwɛfo no: na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Yɛkɔr Siriafo nsera mu, na, hwɛ, nyimpa biara, na nyimpa ndze biara so nnyi hɔ, gyedɛ mpɔnkɔ a wɔamontamontan hɔn, na nsoasopɔnkɔ a wɔamontamontan hɔn, na asese no dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse no ara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ abowanoahwɛfo no; na wɔkɛkaa no wɔ ɔhen no ne fidua no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no soɛɛr anadwe no, na ɔsee no nkowaa dɛ, Afei mebɛkyerɛ hom dza Siriafo dze ayɛ hɛn yi. Wonyim dɛ ɔkɔm dze hɛn; dɛm ntsi na woefi nsera no mu kɔ, dɛ wɔdze hɔnho rukosuma haban mu, dɛ, Sɛ wofi kurow no mu pue a, yɛbɛkyekyer hɔn enyikan, na yɛakɛhɛn kurow no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na no nkowaa no mu baako buae see dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma binom mfa mpɔnkɔ nkaa a wɔaka wɔ kurow mu ha no mu enum, (hwɛ, wɔtse dɛ Israel nyimpadodow a wɔaka mu no nyinara; hwɛ, wɔtse dɛ Israel nyimpadodow a wɔahyew no nyinara:) na ma yɛnsoma ma yɛnhwɛ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔfaa ntseaseanam ebien kaa mpɔnkɔ ho; na ɔhen no somae ma wodzii Siriafo dɔm no ekyir, dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɔhwɛ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wodzii hɔn ekyir kodur Jordan do: na, hwɛ, ntar na ndzɛmba a Siriafo no atotow egu wɔ hɔn ntsɛmpɛ no mu ayɛ ɔkwan no nyinara do ma. Na abɔfo no sanee bae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na nkorɔfo no fiir edzi, na wɔkɔfoow Siriafo nsera no. Nna wɔtɔɔn isiam pa etwadze kor gyee dwetɛbona kor, na atoko etwadze ebien gyee dwetɛbona kor, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm no tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no yii ɔsafohen no a ɔtwer ne nsa do no dɛ ɔnhwɛ kuropon no ano: na nkorɔfo no tsiatsiaa no do wɔ kuropon no mu, na owui dɛ mbrɛ Nyame nyimpa no see no, nyia ɔkasae wɔ aber a ɔhen no sianee baa ne nkyɛn no a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Osiandɛ aber Nyame nyimpa no kaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no, dɛ, Atoko etwadze ebien bɔsom dwetɛbona, na isiam pa etwadze kor bɔsom dwetɛbona ɔkyena siseber yi wɔ Samaria kuropon ano no;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: ɔsafohen no buaa Nyame nyimpa no see dɛ, Hwɛ, sɛ EWURADZE reyɛ ntokura wɔ ɔsor mpo a, ana nkyɛ dɛm asɛm yi bɛba mu a? Na Nyame nyimpa no see dɛ, Hwɛ, edze w’enyiwa bohu, na mbom irinndzi bi:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na ɔbaa mu so dɛmara maa no; osiandɛ nkorɔfo no tsiatsiaa no do wɔ kuropon no mu, na owui.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei nna Elisha aka akyerɛ ɔbaa no a onyaan ne ba ma ɔbaa nkwa mu no, dɛ, Soɛr, na ɔwo na wo fiemba nkɔ, na kɛyɛ ɔhɔho wɔ beebiara a ibotum ayɛ ɔhɔho no: osiandɛ EWURADZE afrɛ ɔkɔm; na ɔbɛba asaase no do mfe esuon.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa no soɛree, na ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Nyame nyimpa no n’asɛm no tse: na ɔnye ne fiefo sii mu kɔree, na ɔkɛyɛɛ ɔhɔho wɔ Filistiafo asaase do mfe esuon.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe esuon no n’ewiei no, nna ɔbaa no fii Filistiafo asaase do sanee bae: na ɔkɔree kosui tɔɔ ɔhen no do dɛ ɔregye ne fie na n’asaase.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber no nna ɔhen no nye Nyame nyimpa no n’akowaa Gehazi rekasa, dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ka ndzɛmba akɛseakɛse a Elisha ayɛ no nyinara kyerɛ me.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔreka mbrɛ osii nyaan nyia owui ma ɔbaa nkwa mu no rekyerɛ ɔhen no, nna, hwɛ, ɔbaa no a onyaan ne ba ma ɔbaa nkwa mu no, sui tɔɔ ɔhen no do dɛ ɔregye ne fi na n’asaase no. Na Gehazi see dɛ, Mo wura, ɔhen, ɔbaa no nye yi, na ne ba a Elisha nyaan no ma ɔbaa nkwa mu no so nye yi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a ɔhen no bisaa ɔbaa no no, ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no. Nna ɔhen no yii ɔhwɛdofo bi maa no, dɛ, Dan dza ɔyɛ nedze nyinara, na haban mu nduadzewa nyinara a ofi da a ogyaa asaase yi dze bodu sesei no ma no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha baa Damaskɔs; na Siriahen Ben-hadad yar; na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Nyame nyimpa no aba ha.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no see Hazael dɛ, Fa akyɛdze kitsa wo nsamu, na kɔ kehyia Nyame nyimpa no, na kodua no do bisa EWURADZE hɔ adze, dɛ, Ana mobɔbɔ esu wɔ yarba yi mu a?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Hazael sii mu kɔree kehyiaa no, na ɔfaa akyɛdze kitsae, mekyerɛ Damaskɔs adze pa biara mu bi, efumpɔnkɔ eduanan hɔn adzesoa, na ɔbae begyinaa n’enyim see dɛ, Wo ba Siriahen Ben-hadad, na ɔsomaa me wɔ wo nkyɛn, dɛ, Ana mobɔbɔ esu wɔ yarba yi mu a?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha see no dɛ, Kɔ, kɛse no dɛ, Esu dze ebɔbɔ ampa; naaso EWURADZE eyi akyerɛ me dɛ owu ara na obowu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔdze n’enyi tsiim no do hann kodur dɛ ɔyɛɛ no ahomtsew: na Nyame nyimpa no sui.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Hazael see dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mo wura rusu yi? Na obuaa dɛ, Osiandɛ minyim mbusu a edze bɔbɔ Israelmba: ebɔtoto hɔn akoban mu gya, na edze afona bokuku hɔn mberantsɛ, na abobɔ hɔn nkɔkowaba egu famu, na apaapaa hɔn enyinsemfo mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Hazael see dɛ, Na w’akowaa nye woana, ɔkraman yi a, dɛ ɔbɛyɛ adze kɛse yi? Na Elisha buaa dɛ, EWURADZE eyi akyerɛ me dɛ ɔwoara na ebɛyɛ Siria do hen.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ofii Elisha nkyɛn sii mu kɔree na ɔbaa no wura nkyɛn; na obisaa no dɛ, Na Elisha see wo dɛn? Na obuaa dɛ, Ɔkaa kyerɛɛ me dɛ, Esu dze ebɔbɔ ampa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso ɔbaa dɛ n’adzekyee no, Hazael faa mpadotam no bɔɔ nsu mu dze kataa n’enyim, ma owui: na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Israelhen Ahab ne ba Joram n’afe a otsia enum no mu, aber no a Jehosafat dzii Judahen no, Judahen Jehosafat ne ba Jehoram hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hen no nna oedzi mfe eduasa ebien; na odzii hen mfe awɔtwe wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔnantseew Israel ahemfo kwan do, dɛ mbrɛ Ahab fie yɛe no: osiandɛ onyaa Ahab ne babaa yɛɛ ne yer: na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso EWURADZE ammpɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ Juda, osian n’akowaa David ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ no anohoba dɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔno na n’asefo kandzea afebɔɔ no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ne nda mu na Edom tseew etua fii Juda ne nsaadze, na wɔkɛhyɛɛ hɔnara hɔn do hen.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Joram twaa mu kɔr Zair, na ne ntseaseanam nyinara ka no ho: na ɔsoɛɛr anadwe, na okunkum Edomfo a woetwa no ho ehyia, na ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no: na nkorɔfo no guanguanee kɔr hɔn asesee mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Edom tseew etua fii Juda ne nsaadze, dze bodu ndɛ da yi. Nna Libna so tseew etua mber no ara mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Joram ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn mber do nsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Joram kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no kaa n’egyanom ho wɔ David kurow mu: na ne ba Ahazia dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Israelhen Ahab ne ba Joram n’afe a otsia duebien no mu, na Judahen Jehoram ne ba Ahazia hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a Ahazia hyɛɛ ase dzii hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu ebien: na odzii hen afrenhyia wɔ Jerusalɛm. Na ne na ne dzin dze Atalia, Israelhen Omri ne nanaba a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔnantseew Ahab fi kwan do, na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ Ahab fi yɛe no: osiandɛ ɔyɛ asew wɔ Ahab fie.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔnye Ahab ne ba Joram tuu sa wɔ Siriahen Hazael do wɔ Ramot-gilead: na Siriafo no piraa Joram.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Joram sanee baa Jezreel dɛ ɔrebɛyɛ n’epirakur a onyaa no wɔ Rama wɔ aber a ɔnye Siriahen Hazael roko no edur. Na Judahen Jehoram ne ba Ahazia sii mu kɔr dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ Ahab ne ba Joram wɔ Jezreel, osiandɛ ɔyar.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi Elisha frɛɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no mu baako na ɔsee no dɛ, Bɔ w’asen do, na fa ngotoaba yi kitsa wo nsamu, na kɔ Ramot-gilead.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na sɛ idu hɔ a, hwehwɛ Nimsi ba Jehosafat ne ba Jehu wɔ hɔ, na kɔ dan mu, na ma ɔnsoɛr mfi no nuanom mu, na fa no kɔ mpiakyir pia mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na nkyii fa ngotoaba no, na hue gu n’etsifi, na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Masera wo mahyɛ wo Israel do hen. Na afei bue abow no, na guan, na mma nntsintsim koraa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna aberantsɛ no, mekyerɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi aberantsɛ no, sii mu kɔr Ramot-gilead.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a odurii no, nna, hwɛ, dɔm do asafohemfo no tsetse hɔ; na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔsafohen, mowɔ nkra bi dze ma wo. Na Jehu see dɛ, Edze ma hɛn nyinara mu woana? Na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔsafohen, ɔwoara a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsoɛree, na ɔkɔr dan no mu; na ohuee ngo no guu n’etsifi, na ɔsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, se nye yi, Masera wo mahyɛ wo EWURADZE ne man do hen, mekyerɛ Israel do a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔwo bɔbɔ wo wura Ahab ne fie, ma meedzi mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no hɔn bɔgyaa, na EWURADZE no nkowaa no nyinara hɔn bɔgyaa ho wer wɔ Jezebel nsamu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Osiandɛ Ahab fi nyina bɛsɛɛ: na mubotwa Ahab mu abofra ɔbanyin biara akyen, na Israel mu nyia ɔdze no ho mu na nyia ɔnndze no ho.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na mebɛyɛ Ahab fi dɛ Nebat ne ba Jeroboam fi, na dɛ Ahija ne ba Baasha fi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na nkraman bedzi Jezebel ne nam wɔ Jezreel asaase do, na obi nnyi hɔ a obesie no. Na obuee abow no, na oguanee.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Jehu fiir edzi baa no wura no nkowaa no nkyɛn: na obi see no dɛ, Asomdwee mu anaa? Ebɛnadze ntsi na ɔbɔdamfo yi ba wo nkyɛn yi? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Homara hom nyim ɔbarimba no na mbrɛ ne nsɛnkekaa tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Akɔhwi a; ka kyerɛ hɛn ɛ. Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛm na dɛm nna ɔkaa kyerɛɛ me, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Masera wo mahyɛ wo Israel do hen.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna wɔyɛɛ ntsɛm yiyii hɔn ntar dze hyehyɛɛ n’ase wɔ atwer no no ara do, na wɔhɛɛn abɛn, dɛ, Jehu dzi hen.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm na Nimsi ba Jehosafat ne ba Jehu paam Joram ne tsir do. (Afei nna Joram, noara na Israel nyinara, rohwɛ Ramot-gilead do, osian Siriahen Hazael ntsi:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na ɔhen Joram dze, ɔasan aba Jezreel dɛ ɔrebɛyɛ n’epirakur a, aber a ɔnye Siriahen Hazael roko no, opirae no edur.) Na Jehu see dɛ, Sɛ hom adwen nye yi a, ɔno mma hom mma obiara mmfir edzi mmfi nsa nnguan mmfi kurow yi mu nnkɔ nnkɛka no wɔ Jezreel.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Jehu tsenaa tseaseanam mu sii mu kɔr Jezreel; osiandɛ hɔ na Joram da. Na Judahen Ahazia esian aba dɛ ɔrobɔhwɛ Joram.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei ɔweɔmfo gyina Jezreel abantsentsen no do, na ohun Jehu no kuw no dɛ ɔreba, na ɔsee dɛ, Muhu kuw bi. Na Joram see dɛ, Fa ɔpɔnkɔdonyi soma no ma onkehyia hɔn, na ma ɔnnkɛse dɛ, Asomdwee anaa?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna obi tse ɔpɔnkɔ do sii mu kɔree kehyiaa no, na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, Asomdwee anaa? Na Jehu see dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔwo nye asomdwee ewɔ yɛ? Dan woho kedzi m’ekyir. Na ɔweɔmfo no kaa dɛ, Ɔbɔfo no ekodu hɔn nkyɛn, naaso ɔannsan ammba.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔsomaa nyia otsia ebien so a ɔtse ɔpɔnkɔ do a okodur hɔn nkyɛn no, ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, Asomdwee anaa? Na Jehu see dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ɔwo nye asomdwee ewɔ yɛ? Dan woho kedzi m’ekyir.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔweɔmfo no kaa dɛ, Ɔno so ekodu hɔn nkyɛn, naaso ɔannsan ammba; na hɛnka no tse dɛ Nimsi ne ba Jehu ne hɛnka; osiandɛ ɔka no abɔdam mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Joram see dɛ, Hom nyɛ krado. Na wosiesiee ne tseaseanam. Na Israelhen Joram, na Judahen Ahazia fiir edzi, obiara wɔ noara ne tseaseanam mu, na wofiir edzi dɛ worikehyia Jehu, na wokohun no wɔ Jezreelnyi Nabot n’asaase no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Joram hun Jehu no, nna ɔsee dɛ, Jehu, asomdwee anaa? Na obuaa dɛ, Ebɛn asomdwee a, dɛ wo na Jezebel n’ehuhubra na n’abayidze ayɛ pii yi a?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Joram daan ne nsa, na oguanee, na ɔsee Ahazia dɛ, Ahazia e, nkɔnkɔnsa wɔ mu o.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehu dze n’ahoɔdzen nyina twee n’egyen mu towee bɔɔ Joram wɔ n’abasa ntamu, na egyen menaba no hwiraa n’akoma mu puei, na ɔhwee ne tseaseanam mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Jehu see ne safohen Bidkar dɛ, Ma no do, na kɔtow no kyen Jezreelnyi Nabot ne haban mu asaase no do: na kaa aber a emi na ɔwo tse mpɔnkɔ do dzi n’egya Ahab ekyir no, mbrɛ EWURADZE sii na ɔdze atsɛmbusɛm yi too no do, dɛ;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ampa mehu Nabot no bɔgyaa, na ne mba hɔn bɔgyaa ndeda ara, EWURADZE na ɔse; na mebɛhyɛ wo ananmu wɔ asaasetɔw yi do, EWURADZE na ɔse. Dɛm ntsi afei ma no do kɔtow no kyen asaasetɔw no do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm no tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a Judahen Ahazia hun iyi no, ɔfaa Bɛt-hagan kwan do guanee. Na Jehu tsiiw no, na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔmbɔ ɔno so wɔ tseaseanam no mu: na wɔbɔɔ no Gur afowee a ɔwɔ Ibleam ho no. Na oguanee kɔr Megiddo, na okowui wɔ hɔ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na no nkowaa no dze no nam tseaseanam mu kɔr Jerusalɛm, na wokesiee no wɔ n’asamandan mu kaa n’egyanom ho wɔ David kurow mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Ahab ne ba Joram n’afe a otsia dubiako no mu na Ahazia hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Juda do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a Jehu baa Jezreel no, Jezebel tsee; na ɔkekaa n’enyiwa ho edur, na ɔkyekyeer ne tsir, na ɔhwɛɛ tokura mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a Jehu hɛɛn kuropon no mu no, nna ɔsee dɛ, Asomdwee anaa? Ɔwo Zimri, wo wura no kumfo?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔmaa n’enyi do wɔ tokura no mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Woana na ɔwɔ m’afa? Woana a? Na asaa beenu anaa baasa fi hɔ hwɛɛ no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom ntow no nkyen famu. Nna wɔtoow Jezebel kyeen famu: na no bɔgyaa no petsee fasu no, na mpɔnkɔ no ho: na wɔdze anamɔn tsiatsiaa no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehu dur ahemfie no mu no, odzidzii na ɔnomee; na ɔsee dɛ, Afei hom nkɔhwɛ ɔbaa a wɔapaa no no, na wonsie no; osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔhen ne babaa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔkɔr dɛ worikesie no: na woennhu no ho biribiara dɛ ne tsidwerba, na n’anansa, na ne nsakum.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔsanee bae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ no. Na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam n’akowaa Tisbinyi Elija do kae no nye yi, dɛ, Jezreel asaase do na nkraman bedzi Jezebel ne nam:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na Jezebel no fun ayɛ dɛ efikyir wɔ haban enyi wɔ Jezreel asaase no do; amma wɔaannse dɛ, Jezebel nye yi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Ahab wɔ mbabanyin eduosuon wɔ Samaria. Na Jehu kyerɛɛw nwoma, na ɔsomae ma wɔdze kɔr Samaria dze kɛmaa Jezreel asafohemfo, mekyerɛ amampanyin no, na hɔn a wɔnyɛɛn Ahab ne mba no, dɛ,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Sɛ nwoma yi du hom nkyɛn a, ɔnam dɛ hom wura ne mba wɔ hom nkyɛn, na ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔ, kurow a wɔabɔ ho ban so, na akodze wɔ hom nkyɛn no yi;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: hom nhwehwɛ hom wura ne mba no mu nyia oye na ɔfata na wɔmfa no nsi n’egya n’ahengua no do, na hom nko mma hom wura fi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wosuroo mbordo, na wɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, ahemfo beenu no enngyina n’enyim, na hɛn dze, yɛbɛyɛ dɛn egyina?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na nyia ɔhwɛ fidua no do, na nyia ɔhwɛ kurow no do no, amampanyin no so, na hɔn a wɔnyɛɛn mba no, somae ma wɔkɔr Jehu nkyɛn, dɛ, Yɛyɛ wo nkowaa, na dza ebɛhyɛ hɛn no nyinara yɛbɛyɛ; yɛrennhyɛ nyimpa biara ɔhen: ɔwoara yɛ dza oye wɔ w’enyi do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔkyerɛɛw hɔn nwoma a otsia mpɛn ebien, dɛ, Sɛ hom wɔ m’afa, na hom betsie me ndze a, hom mfa mbarimba no, mekyerɛ hom wura ne mba no, hɔn etsir mbrɛ me nkyɛn ɔkyena siseber yi wɔ Jezreel. Nna ɔhen ne mba no a wɔyɛ nyimpa eduosuon no wɔwɔ kurow no mu nyimpa akɛse no a wɔnyɛn hɔn no nkyɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a nwoma no dur hɔn nkyɛn no, nna wɔkyeer ɔhen ne mba no, na wokunkum hɔn, mekyerɛ nyimpa eduosuon no, na wɔdze hɔn etsir guguu nkɛntsɛn mu, na wɔsomae ma wɔdze kɛmaa no wɔ Jezreel.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbɔfo bi bae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, Wɔdze ɔhen ne mba no hɔn etsir no aba. Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom ngu no ekuw ebien wɔ kuropon ahɛnee no ano nkodu anapa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, anapa no, ofiir edzi kegyinae, na ɔsee ɔman no nyinara, dɛ, Hom dzi bem: hwɛ emi na mepaam mo wura ne tsir do, na mukum no: na woana na okunkum woyinom nyinara?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei hom nhu dɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a EWURADZE kae no wɔ Ahab fi ho no mu biara ronntɔ famu: na EWURADZE ayɛ dza ɔnam n’akowaa Elija do kae no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Jehu kum Ahab fie hɔn a wɔkae nyinara wɔ Jezreel, na ne nyimpa akɛse nyinara, na n’anyɛnko brɛbo, na n’asɔfoe, kodur dɛ oenngyaa no obiara ma ɔaannka.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsoɛree fii hɔ sii mu dɛ ɔrokɔ Samaria. Na aber a ɔwɔ nguanhwɛfo dan a wosusua nguan ho wɔ ɔkwan no mu no,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Jehu nye Judahen Ahazia no nuanom no hyiae, na ɔsee dɛ, Woananom nye hom? Na wobuaa dɛ, Ahazia no nuanom nye hɛn: na yerisian akɔ ekekyiakyia ɔhen ne mba, na ɔhembaa ne mba no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nkyer hɔn enyikan. Na wɔkyekyeer hɔn enyikan, na wokunkum hɔn nguansusua dan no ho mona no ho, mekyerɛ nyimpa eduanan ebien; na oenngyaa hɔn mu biara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a ofi hɔ sii mu rokɔ no, ohun Rekab ne ba Jehonadab dɛ ɔreba ebehyia no kwan: na okyiaa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ana w’akoma tsen, dɛ mbrɛ m’akoma tse wɔ w’akoma ho no? Na Jehonadab buaa dɛ, Ɔtse dɛm. Sɛ ɔtse dɛm a, fa wo nsa ma me ɛ. Na ɔdze ne nsa maa no; ma ɔmaa no do kɔr ne nkyɛn wɔ tseaseanam no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Enye me nkɔ, na kɔhwɛ mo mbɔdzembɔ a mobɔ ma EWURADZE. Nna wɔmaa ɔnye no tsenaa ne tseaseanam no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a odur Samaria no, okum hɔn a wɔkae maa Ahab wɔ Samaria no nyinara, kodur dɛ ɔsɛɛ no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ Elija no tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehu poon ɔman no nyinara hyiae, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ahab soom Baal kakra; na Jehu dze, ɔbɔsom no dodow.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei hom mfrɛ Baal nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara, n’asomfo nyinara, na n’asɔfoe nyinara, ma wɔmbra me nkyɛn; mma obiara nnka: osiandɛ mowɔ afɔr kɛse mobɔ mema Baal; obiara a ɔbɛka no ɔrenntsena ase. Na Jehu dze, ɔyɛɛ no bradato mu ama ɔaasɛɛ Baal n’asomfo no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehu see dɛ, Hom ntsew ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn ho mma Baal. Na wɔpaae.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehu somae ma wokekyiin Israel nyinara mu: na Baal n’asomfo no nyinara bae, ma nyimpa biara annka a ɔammba. Na wɔbaa Baal fie; na Baal fie no yɛɛ ma fi tsir kɔ tsir.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee nyia ɔhwɛ ntardan do no dɛ, Fa ntar brɛ Baal n’asomfo no nyinara. Na ɔdze ntar brɛɛ hɔn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehu na Rekab ne ba Jehonadab sii mu kɔr Baal fie; na ɔsee Baal n’asomfo no dɛ, Hom nhwehwɛ mu nhu amma EWURADZE no nkowaa mu obiara aammbɛka hom ho wɔ ha, gyedɛ Baal n’asomfo no nko.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wosii mu kɔr mu dɛ wɔrokɔbɔ hɔn okum afɔr na ɔhyew afɔr. Afei na Jehu ahyɛ mbarimba eduowɔtwe ama noho wɔ dan ekyir, dɛ, Sɛ mbarimba a medze hɔn rehyɛ hom nsa yi mu biara fi nsa guan a, nyia ɔbɛma wɔakɔ no, no nkwa bɛhyɛ no nkwa ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, ntsɛmara a owiee ɔhyew afɔr no bɔ no, nna Jehu see brampafo na asafohemfo no dɛ, Hom nkɔ mu nkokuku hɔn; ma hom mma obiara mmfir edzi. Na wɔdze afona anomu kunkum hɔn; na brampafo na asafohemfo no totoow hɔn gui, na wosii mu kɔr Baal fie kurow no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔdze Baal fie edum no puei bɛhyeew no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wodwuruuw Baal no dum no guu famu, na wodwuruuw Baal ne fie no guu famu, na ɔyɛɛ no egyananbea dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Mbrɛ Jehu sii sɛɛ Baal fii Israel nye no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no dze, Jehu emmfi ekyir emmfi, ɔnye dɛ sika anantwimba a wɔwɔ Bɛtɛl na Dan no dze ɔannsɛɛ hɔn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE see Jehu dɛ, Osiandɛ ayɛ no yie dɛ ayɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ m’enyi do, na ayɛ Ahab fie dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔwɔ m’akoma mu nyinara tse no ntsi, wo mbabanyin a wofi wo mbasantsen a otsia anan no mu bɛtsena Israel ahengua do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso Jehu annhwɛ yie dɛ ɔdze n’akoma nyinara bɛnantsew wɔ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn ne mbra do: oemmfi Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel fomee no ho emmfi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nda no mu na EWURADZE hyɛɛ ase dɛ orukuw Israel do: na Hazael kunkum hɔn wɔ Israel ntoaado nyinara;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: ofi Jordan boka afamu, Gilead asaase no nyinara, Gadfo, na Reubenfo, na Manaasɛfo dze, ofi Aroer a ɔwɔ Arnon bɔnsa nkyɛn, mekyerɛ Gilead na Bashan.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Jehu no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na ne mbanyinndam nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehu kɔr ne nsamankyir: na wosiee no wɔ Samaria. Na ne babanyin Jehoahaz na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na mber a Jehu dze dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samaria no yɛ mfe eduonu awɔtwe.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei aber a Ɔhen Ahazia ne na Atalia hun dɛ ne ba no ewu no, nna ɔsoɛree na ɔsɛɛ adehye asefo no nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso ɔhen Joram ne babaa Jehoseba, Ahazia n’akyerɛbaa no, faa Ahazia ne ba Joas, na owiaa no fii ɔhen ne mba no a wokum hɔn no mu, mekyerɛ ɔno na no hwɛdofo, na ɔdze hɔn kɛhyɛɛ mpiakyir; na wɔdze no sumaa Atalia, ma dɛm ntsi woennku no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔnye no sumaa EWURADZE ne fie mfe esia a Atalia yɛɛ ɔhembaa wɔ asaase no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na afe a otsia esuon no mu no ɔsɔfo Jehoiada somae ma wɔkɛfaa ahemfie aweɔmfo na ahemfo do aweɔmfo mu ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no, na wɔdze hɔn baa ne nkyɛn wɔ EWURADZE fie; na ɔnye hɔn dzii ahyɛmu, na ɔmaa wɔkekaa ntam kyerɛɛ no wɔ EWURADZE fie, na ɔdze ɔhen ne ba no kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn, dɛ, Adze a hom nyɛ nye yi: hom mu nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor a ɔba mu ahomgyeda no, na wɔnyɛ ɔhen ne fi do hwɛ no n’ahwɛfo;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor ntsena Sur kuropon ano; na nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor ntsena brampafo ekyir kuropon no ano: dɛm na hom nhwɛ ofi no do hwɛ no, na wɔnyɛ pampi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na hom mu ekuw ebien no, mekyerɛ hɔn a wofir edzi ahomgyeda no nyinara no, wɔnhwɛ EWURADZE ne fi do hwɛ no wɔ ɔhen no ho.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na hom mbɔ ɔhen no ho aprɔw, nyimpa biara mfa n’akodze nkitsa ne nsamu; na nyia ɔbɛba akyerɛpɛn no mu no, wɔmma wonku no: na hom ndzi ɔhen no nkyɛn aber a orupue, na aber a ɔreba fie.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada hyɛe no nyinara: na wɔfefaa nyimpa biara ne nyimpa, hɔn a wɔwɔ dɛ wɔba mu ahomgyeda no, kaa hɔn a wɔwɔ dɛ wofir edzi ahomgyeda no ho, na wɔbaa ɔsɔfo Jehoiada nkyɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsɔfo no yiyii mpeaa na akyɛm a ɔyɛ ɔhen David dze no a ɔwɔ EWURADZE fie no, memaa ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aweɔmfo no gyinagyinae, nyimpa biara n’akodze kitsa ne nsamu, ofi ɔdan no n’enyimfa afamu kodu ɔdan no n’abankum afamu, wɔ afɔrmbukyia no na dan no ho, bɔɔ ɔhen no ho aprɔw.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔdze ɔhen ne ba no fiir edzi, na ɔdze ahenkyɛw no soaa no, na ɔdze dase no maa no; na wɔhyɛɛ no hen, na wɔseraa no; na wɔbobɔɔ hɔn nsamu see dɛ, Nyame ngye ɔhen nkwa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a Atalia tsee aweɔmfo na ɔman no hɔn gyigyeegye no, nna ɔbaa ɔman no nkyɛn wɔ EWURADZE fie:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na ɔhwɛe, na, hwɛ, ɔhen no gyina dum no ho, dɛ mbrɛ amambu no tse, na asafohen no na mbɛn no wɔ ɔhen no nkyɛn; na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara enyi gyee, na wɔhɛɛn mbɛn. Nna Atalia tsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔkekaa mu dɛ, Etuatsew o, iyi yɛ etuatsew.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsɔfo Jehoiada hyɛɛ ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no a wɔhwɛ dɔm no do no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa no mfa akyerɛpɛn no ntamu; na hom mfa afona nku nyia obedzi n’ekyir no: na ɔsɔfo no see dɛ, Mma mma wonnku no wɔ EWURADZE fie.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna wɔmaa no kwan; na ɔfaa ɔkwan a mpɔnkɔ nam do ba ɔhen no ne fie no do: na hɔ na wokum no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehoiada dze ahyɛmu too EWURADZE na ɔhen no na ɔman no ntamu, dɛ wɔnyɛ EWURADZE ne man; na ɔdze too ɔhen no na ɔman no so ntamu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara sii mu kɔr Baal fie kobubuu no gui; n’afɔrmbukyia na n’ehonyi no, wobubuu no esinesin pasapasa, na wokum Baal no sɔfoe Maatan wɔ afɔrmbukyia no enyim. Na ɔsɔfo no hyehyɛɛ EWURADZE ne fi do ahwɛdofo.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔfaa ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo, na aweɔmfo na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara; na wɔdze ɔhen no fi EWURADZE fie sianee bɛfaa aweɔmfo kuropon ano ɔkwan no do baa ɔhen no ne fie. Na ɔtsenaa ahemfo ahengua no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara enyi gyee, na kurow no mu dwee: na wɔdze afona kum Atalia wɔ ɔhen no ne fie.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a Joas hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe esuon.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Jehu n’afe a otsia esuon no mu na Joas hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen; na odzii hen mfe eduanan wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Zibia a ofi Beer-seba.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Joas yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do, wɔ ne nda a ɔsɔfo Jehoiada kyerɛkyerɛɛ no wɔ mu nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso mbea sorɔnsorɔm no dze woennyi no hɔ: ɔman no daa ho bɔɔ afɔr na wɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Joas see asɔfo no dɛ: Ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn ho sika nyinara a wɔdze ba EWURADZE fie kan mu sika, nkorɔfo a woetwa hɔn mu nyimpa baako ne tsibo hɔn sika, na sika a ɔba nyimpa biara n’akoma mu dɛ ɔdze bɛba EWURADZE fie nyinara no,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: wɔmma asɔfo no hɔnara wɔngyegye, nyimpa biara ne manyimfo hɔ: na wɔmpempam ofi no n’agow no, beebiara a wobohu hɔ gow bi no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔhen Joas n’afe a otsia eduonu ebiasa no mu no nna asɔfo no mmpempaam ofi no n’agow no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen Joas kɛfrɛɛ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada, na asɔfo nkaa no, na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom mmpempaam ofi no n’agow no yi? Dɛm ntsi afei mma hom nngyegye sika wɔ hom amanyimfo hɔ bio, na hom nyi mma ma wɔmfa mpempam ofi no n’agow no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na asɔfo no peen dɛ wɔrenngyegye ɔman no hɔ sika bio, nkyii so wɔremmpempam ofi no n’agow no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsɔfo Jehoiada faa adaka bi, na ofitsii n’ebuado no mu otokur, na ɔdze sii afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn, enyimfa afamu dɛ obi a ɔreba EWURADZE fie no: na asɔfo a wɔhwɛ abow no ano no wɔdze sika a wɔdze ba EWURADZE fie no nyinara egu mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, sɛ wohu dɛ sika pii aba adaka no mu a, nna ɔhen ne kyerɛwnyi no na ɔsɔfopanyin no afow aba, na woebohue egu nkotoku mu na wɔakan sika a wohun no wɔ EWURADZE fie no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔdze sika a woeker no hyɛɛ hɔn a wɔyɛɛ edwuma no a wɔyɛɛ hɔn EWURADZE fi do ahwɛdofo no nsa: na woyii tuatuaa nduadwimfo na adansifo a wɔyɛɛ EWURADZE ne fi no ho edwuma no,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na abantofo na abotwafo no kaw, na dɛ wɔdze bɔtɔ ndua na abo a woetwa dɛ wɔdze bɛpempam EWURADZE fi no n’agow no, na adze a wɔhweer no wɔ ofi no ho dɛ wɔdze pempamee nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS
