text: Na wɔammfa sika a wɔdze baa EWURADZE fie hɔ no mu bi annyɛ EWURADZE fie dwetɛmpokuwa, nsompokuwa mbɛɛsen, mbɛn, sika ndzɛmba biara anaa dwetɛ ndzɛmba:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na wɔdze maa hɔn a wɔyɛɛ edwuma no, na wɔdze pempaam EWURADZE fi no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nkyii so wɔnnye nyimpa a wɔdze sika no hyɛɛ hɔn nsa dɛ wɔmfa mma hɔn a wɔyɛɛ edwuma no emmbu nkontaa: osiandɛ wɔyɛɛ no nokwar mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Asodzi afɔr sika, na bɔn ho afɔr sika no dze, wɔammfa ammba Ewuradzefie: ɔyɛ asɔfo no dze.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Mber no mu no, Siriahen Hazael sii mu kɔree, na ɔnye Gat kɔkoe, na ɔfae: na Hazael dze sii n’enyi do dɛ ɔrokɔfow akɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Judahen Joas faa ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn nyina a n’egyanom Juda ahemfo Jehosafat, na Jehoram, na Ahazia yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn no, na nankasa ne ndzɛmba a otui sii hɔ no krɔnkrɔn, na sika a wohun no wɔ EWURADZE fie, na ɔhen no ne fie ndzekoradze mu nyinara, na ɔsomae ma wɔdze kɛmaa Siriahen Hazael: na ofii Jerusalɛm ho sii mu kɔree.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Joas no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na no nkowaa soɛree, na wɔkɔr ne tsir do apam, na wokum Joas wɔ Millo dan ho, ɔkwan a ɔdze risian kɔ Silla no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na no nkowaa Simeat ne ba Jozakar, na Somer ne ba Jehozabad, bobɔɔ no, na owui; na wokesiee no kaa n’egyanom ho wɔ David kurow mu: na ne babanyin Amazia dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Judahen Ahazia ne ba Joas n’afe a otsia eduonu ebiasa no mu no, na Jehu ne ba Jehoahaz hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samaria, na odzii hen mfe duesuon.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, na odzii Nebat ne ba Jeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no no ne ndzeyɛɛ bɔn ekyir; na oemmfi ho emmfir.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Israel do, na oyii hɔn hyɛɛ Siriahen Hazael nsa, na Hazael ne ba Ben-hadad nsa daa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehoahaz paa EWURADZE kyɛw, na EWURADZE tsiee no: osiandɛ ohun Israel hɔn atseetsee, mbrɛ Siriahen no sii tseetsee hɔn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: (Na EWURADZE maa Israel ɔgyefo bi ma wofii Siriafo nsa ase firii: na Israelmba no tsenatsenaa hɔn asesee mu, dɛ mbrɛ nkan no ɔtse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso woemmfi Jeroboam fi no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no ho, na wɔnantsewee wɔ mu: na wogyaa Asera so wɔ Samaria.)
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Jehoahaz nnyi akofo dɔm biara gyedɛ mpɔnkɔdofo eduonum, na ntseaseanam du, na anamɔnmufo mpemdu; osiandɛ Siriahen no sɛɛ hɔn, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn dɛ ewuporowee do huntuma.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Jehoahaz no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na ne mbanyindze, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehoahaz kɔr ne nsamankyir; na wosiee no wɔ Samaria: na ne babanyin Joas dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Judahen Joas n’afe a otsia eduasa esuon no mu nna Jehoahaz ne ba Jehoas hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samaria na odzii hen mfe duesia.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do; oemmfi Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn nyinara a ɔdze maa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no ho emmfi: na ɔnantsewee wɔ mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Jehoas no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na ne mbanyinndam a nye Judahen Amazia koe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehoas kɔr ne nsamankyir; na Jeroboam tsenaa n’ahengua do: na wokesiee Jehoas wɔ Samaria kaa Israel ahemfo no ho.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei na Elisha yar yarba a ɔdze no robɔkɔ nsamankyir: na Israelhen Jehoas sianee baa ne nkyɛn bosuu no, see dɛ, M’egya e, m’egya e, ɔwo a ayɛ Israel ntseaseanam na no mpɔnkɔdofo e!
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha see no dɛ, Kɛfa egyen na egyen menaba: na ɔkɛfaa egyen na egyen menaba brɛɛ no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee Israelhen no dɛ, Fa wo nsa to egyen no do: na ɔdze ne nsa too do. Na Elisha dze ne nsa guu ɔhen no ne nsa do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Bue boka afamu tokura no: na obuei. Nna Elisha see dɛ, Tow: na ɔtowee. Na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE no konyim egyen menaba, mekyerɛ Siria do konyimdzi egyen menaba: osiandɛ ebɔbobɔ Siriafo wɔ Afek araa ma ahyew hɔn ana.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Tase egyen menaba no: na ɔtasee. Na ɔsee Israelhen no dɛ, Tow bɔ famu: na ɔtowee bɔɔ famu mprɛnsa, na ogyaae.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Nyame nyimpa no no bo fuuw no, na ɔsee dɛ, Nkyɛ ɔsɛ dɛ etow mpɛn enum anaa esia; ɔno na nkyɛ ebɔbɔ Siria araa ma ahyew no: na afei dze mprɛnsa ara pɛr na ibedzi Siria do konyim.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Elisha wui, na wosiee no. Afei afe bae no Moabfo ekuwekuw botuaa asaase no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, nna binom rikesie nyimpa bi, nna, hwɛ, wohun Moabfo kuw bi; na wɔtoow nyimpa no kyeen Elisha ne nda no no mu na woguanee: na ntsɛmara a fun no kɛkaa Elisha ne mbiew no, nna onyanee, na ɔsoɛree gyinaa n’anan do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Siriahen Hazael tseetsee Israel wɔ Jehoahaz ne nda nyinara mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE kyerɛɛ ayamuyie wɔ Israelfo no do na ohun hɔn mbɔbɔr, na ɔtseew n’enyim kyerɛɛ hɔn, osian n’ahyɛmu a ɔnye Abraham, Isaak, na Jakob dzii ntsi, na ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ hɔn, nkyii so ɔanntow hɔn emmfi n’enyim enngu araa nye ndɛ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Siriahen Hazael wui; na ne babanyin Ben-hadad dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehoahaz ne ba Jehoas kɛgyee Hazael ne ba Ben-hadad ne nsamu nkurow no a ɔdze akodzi gyee no wɔ n’egya Jehoahaz ne nsamu no. Mpɛn ebiasa na Joas dzii no do konyim no, na ɔdaan Israel nkurow no bae.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Israelhen Joahaz ne ba Jehoas n’afe a otsia ebien no mu nna Amazia, Judahen Joas ne ba no, hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe eduonu akron wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Jehoadin a ofi Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do, naaso ɔnntse dɛ n’egya David: ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ n’egya Joas yɛe no nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso mbea sorɔnsorɔm no dze, woennyiyi no hɔ: ɔman no kɔr do bɔɔ afɔr na wɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, ntsɛmara a ahendzi no tsintsimii wɔ ne nsamu ara, nna okunkum no nkowaa a wokum n’egya ɔhen no:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na ewudzifo no hɔn mba no dze oennku hɔn: dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses ne mbra nwoma a EWURADZE hyɛe no mu dɛ, Mma wonnku egyanom wɔ mba ntsi, nkyii so mma wonnku mba wɔ egyanom ntsi; na mbom nyimpa biara bowu wɔ nankasa no bɔn ntsi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Amazia kum Edom mu mpemdu wɔ Nkyen Bɔnsa no mu, na ɔnam akodzi do gyee Sela, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Jokteel, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Amazia somaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Jehu ba Jehoahaz ne ba, Jehoas, Israelhen no nkyɛn, dɛ, Bra, ma yendzi ako.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Israelhen Jehoas somae ma wɔkɔr Judahen Amazia nkyɛn, dɛ, Kɔkrɔnsoɛ a ɔwɔ Lebanon do no somae ma wɔkɔr nkyindur a ɔwɔ Lebanon do no nkyɛn, dɛ, Fa wo babaa ma me babanyin ayewar: na abowa bɔyafo bi a ɔwɔ Lebanon do botwaa mu, na otsiatsiaa kɔkrɔnsoɛ no do sɛɛe no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ampa etum eku Edom, ma ntsi ayɛ ahomemado: fa tuw, na tsena fie; na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze woho bɛgyegye ɔhaw mu ama mbusu aba wo do, ma aahwe ase, mekyerɛ ɔwo, na Juda ka wo ho?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso Amazia enntsie. Nna Israelhen Jehoas sii mu kɔree; na ɔno na Judahen Amazia dzii ako wɔ Bɛt-semes a ɔyɛ Juda dze no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Juda dzii nkogu wɔ Israel enyim; na woguanguanee, nyimpa biara kɔr n’asesee mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Israelhen Jehoas kyeer Judahen Amazia, Ahazia ba Joas ne ba no, wɔ Bɛt-semes, na ɔbaa Jerusalɛm bobubuu Jerusalɛm fasu no fi Efraim kuropon ho dze kodur kutuwdo kuropon no ho, basafa ahaanan.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔfaa sika na dwetɛ nyinara, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba a wohun no wɔ EWURADZE ne fie, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze mu no nyinara, ɔnye nyimpa so ndɔmmum, na ɔsanee kɔr Samaria.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Jehoas ho nsɛm nkaa no, dza ɔyɛe, na ne mbanyinndam, na mbrɛ osii na ɔnye Judahen Amazia koe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehoas kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ Samaria kaa Israel ahemfo no ho; na ne babanyin Jeroboam dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Israelhen Jehoas, Jehoahaz ne ba no, no wu ekyir no, Judahen Amazia a ɔyɛ Joas ne ba no, tsenaa ase mfe duenum.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Amazia no ho nsɛm nkaa no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔpaam ne tsir do wɔ Jerusalɛm; na oguanee kɔr Lakis: na wɔsomae ma wotsiiw no kɔr Lakis, na wokokum no wɔ hɔ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔdze no too mpɔnkɔ do bae: na wosiee no wɔ Jerusalɛm kaa n’egyanom ho wɔ David kurow mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Juda ɔman no nyinara faa Azaria a oedzi mfe duesia no, na wɔhyɛɛ no hen wɔ n’egya Amazia n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ɔno na ɔkyekyeer Elat, na ɔdanee maa Juda, ber a nna n’egya ɔhen no kɔ ne nsamankyir no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Judahen Amazia, Joas ba no, n’afe a otsia duenum no mu no nna Joas ne ba Jeroboam Israelhen no hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Samaria, na odzii hen mfe eduanan biako.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do: oemmfi Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel fomee no nyinara ho.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ɔno na ɔkoe gyee Israel nsaase a ofi Hamat ahɛnee dze bodu Araba mpoano a ofii hɔn nsa no sanee bae, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn, n’asɛm a ɔnam n’akowaa, Amittai ba Jona, nkɔnhyɛnyi a ofi Gath-hefer do kae no tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE hun Israel n’ahohiahia, dɛ ɔyɛ wen dodow: osiandɛ obiara nnyi hɔ, dɛ ɔdze ho anaa ɔnndze no a ɔbɔboa Israel.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso EWURADZE annka dɛ ɔbɛpepa Israel ne dzin efi asaase do: ntsi ɔdze nam Joas ne ba Jeroboam n’abaw do gyee hɔn nkwa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Jeroboam no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na ne mbanyinndam, mbrɛ osii yɛɛ sa, na mbrɛ osii kɛgyee Damaskɔs, na Hamat a ɔyɛ Juda dze no sanee maa Israel no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jeroboam kɔr ne nsamankyir kɛkaa n’egyanom Israel, ahemfo no ho; na ne babanyin Zekaria dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Israelhen Jeroboam n’afe a otsia eduonu esuon no mu nna Judahen Amazia ne ba Azaria hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hen no nna oedzi mfe duesia; na odzii hen mfe eduonum ebien wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Jekolia a ofi Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ dza n’egya Amazia yɛe no nyinara tse no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso woennyi mbea sorɔnsorɔm no wɔ hɔ: ɔman no kɔr hɔ bɔɔ afɔr na wɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE bɔɔ ɔhen no, ma ɔyɛɛ ɔkwatanyi dze kodur no wu da, na ɔkɛtsenaa nkyɛn ofi bi mu. Na ɔhen no ne ba Jotam na ɔhwɛɛ fidua no do, na obuu asaase no do nkorɔfo no atsɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Azaria no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Azaria kɔr ne nsamankyir; na wosiee no kaa n’egyanom ho wɔ David kurow mu: na ne babanyin Jotam dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Judahen Azaria n’afe a otsia eduasa awɔtwe no mu, na Jeroboam ne ba Zekaria dzii hen wɔ Israel do wɔ Samaria abosoom esia.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ n’egyanom yɛe: oemmfi Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel fomee no ho.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jabes ne ba Sallum paam ne tsir do, na ɔbɔɔ no wɔ ɔman no enyim kum no, na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Zekaria no ho nsɛm nkaa no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Iyi nye EWURADZE n’asɛm no a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ Jehu no, dɛ, Wo mba dze kodu mbasantsen a otsia anan do bɛtsena Israel ahengua do. Na ɔbaa mu dɛm.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Jabes ne ba Sallum hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Judahen Uzia n’afe a otsia eduasa akron no mu; na odzii hen bosoom kor ara wɔ Samaria.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Gadi ne ba Menahem fi Tirza sii mu baa Samaria, na ɔbɔbɔɔ Jabes ne ba Sallum wɔ Samaria kum no, na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Sallum no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na ne tsirdo apam a ɔpamee no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Menahem fi Tirza kotui hyɛɛ Tifsa na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, na n’ahe do: osiandɛ wɔammpen annkɛhyɛ no tum ase, na mbaa a wɔwɔ mu a wonyinsenyinsen nyinara mpo ɔpaapaa hɔn mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Judahen Azaria n’afe a otsia eduasa akron no mu nna Gadi ne ba Menahem hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Israel do, na odzii hen mfe du wɔ Samaria.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do: na oemmfi Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel fomee no ho ne nda nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Asiriahen Pul soɛree baa asaase no do; na Menahem maa Pul dwetɛ talent apem, ama oeenya no aba n’afa ma ɔaahyɛ ahendzi no dzen wɔ ne nsamu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Menahem gyegyee Israel hɔ sika no tow, mekyerɛ mbarimba akatakyi ahonyafo no nyinara hɔ, ɔbarimba baako hɔ dwetɛ dwetɛbona eduonum, dɛ ɔdze rekɛma Asiriahen no. Na Asiriahen no peem adze, na oenngyina asaase no do hɔ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Menahem no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Menahem kɔr ne nsamankyir; na ne babanyin Pekahia dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Judahen Azaria n’afe a otsia eduonum mu na Menahem ne ba Pekahia hyɛɛ ase dzii Israel do hen wɔ Samaria, na odzii hen mfe ebien.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do: oemmfi Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel fomee no ho.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ne safohen Peka, Remalia ne ba no paam ne tsir do, na ɔbɔɔ no wɔ Samaria, wɔ ɔhen no ne fie aban no mu, nna ɔnye Argob na Arieh; na Gileadfo mu mbarimba eduonum ka no ho: na okum no, na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Pekahia no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Judahen Azaria n’afe a otsia eduonum ebien no mu na Remalia ne ba Peka hyɛɛ ase dzii Israel do hen wɔ Samaria, na odzii hen mfe eduonu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do: na oemmfi Nebat ne ba Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔdze maa Israel fomee no ho.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Israelhen Peka ne nda no mu na Asiriahen Tiglat-pileser bae bɛgyee Ijon, na Abel-beth-maaka, na Janoa, na Kedes, na Hazor, na Gilead, na Galilii, na Naftali asaase no nyinara; na ɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔr Asiria.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Ela ne ba Hosea paam Remalia ne ba Peka ne tsir do, na ɔbɔɔ no kum no, na odzii hen wɔ n’ananmu, wɔ Uzia ne ba Jotam n’afe a otsia eduonu no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Peka no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Israelhen Peka, Remalia ne ba no, n’afe a otsia ebien no mu na Judahen Uzia ne ba Jotam hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hen no na oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe duesia wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Jerusa, Zadok ne babaa a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do: ɔyɛɛ dɛ dza n’egya Uzia yɛe no nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso oennyiyi mbea sorɔnsorɔm no wɔ hɔ: ɔman no daa ho ara bɔɔ afɔr na wɔhyew eduhuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do. Ɔno na osii EWURADZE fi abotsen sor dze no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Jotam no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nda no mu na EWURADZE hyɛɛ ase dɛ ɔrosoma Siriahen Rezin, na Remalia ne ba Peka wɔ Juda do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jotam kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no kaa n’egyanom ho, wɔ n’egya David kurow mu: na ne babanyin Ahaz dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Remalia ne ba Peka n’afe a otsia duesuon no mu na Judahen Jotam ne ba Ahaz hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a Ahaz hyɛɛ ase dzii hen no na oedzi mfe eduonu; na odzii hen mfe duesia wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ɔannyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ n’EWURADZE Nyankopɔn enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya David yɛe.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Mbom ɔnantseew Israel ahemfo kwan do, nyew, na ɔdze ne ba mpo bɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr, dɛ mbrɛ amanamamfo a EWURADZE tuu hɔn fii Israelmba enyim no hɔn atɔrmuadze tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbɔɔ afɔr na ɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do, na akoko do, na dua momon biara ase.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Siriahen Rezin na Israelhen Peka, Remalia ne ba no fowee baa Jerusalɛm dɛ wɔrobɔko: na wɔkɔr Ahaz ntuae, na mbom woenntum enndzi no do nyim.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber no mu na Siriahen Rezin gyee Elat sanee maa Siria, na ɔpaam Jewfo no fii Elat: na Siriafo no baa Elat, na wɔtsenaa hɔ, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Ahaz tuu abɔfo ma wɔkɔr Asiriahen Tiglat-pileser nkyɛn, dɛ, Meyɛ w’akowaa na wo ba: fow bra bɛgye me fi Siriahen, na Israelhen a wɔasoɛr mo do yi nsamu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Ahaz faa dwetɛ na sika a wohun no wɔ EWURADZE ne fie, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze mu, na ɔsomae ma wɔdze kɛmaa Asiriahen no dɛ ayɛyɛdze.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Asiriahen no tsiee no: na Asiriahen no sii mu kɔr Damaskɔs do, na ɔkɛgyee, na ɔfaa no mu nkorɔfo no ndɔmmum kɔr Kir, na okum Rezin.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Ahaz sii mu kɔr Damaskɔs dɛ orikehyia Asiriahen Tiglat-pileser kwan, na ohun afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ Damaskɔs no: na ɔhen Ahaz somae ma wɔdze afɔrmbukyia no su, na no nsusudo dɛ mbrɛ ne yɛbea nyinara tse, kɛmaa ɔsɔfo Uria.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsɔfo Uria sii afɔrmbukyia: dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔhen Ahaz somae ma wɔdze fi Damaskɔs no tse no, dɛmara so na ɔsɔfo Uria yɛe dze tweɔɔn ɔba a ɔhen Ahaz fi Damaskɔs bae no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a ɔhen no fi Damaskɔs bae na obohun afɔrmbukyia no, ɔtwee piin ho, na ɔbɔɔ do afɔr.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhyeew ne hyew afɔr na n’edziban afɔr, na ohuee no nom afɔr, na ɔdze n’asomdwee afɔr bɔgyaa no petsee afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na boran afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ EWURADZE enyim no, oyii fii ɔdan no enyim dze fii n’afɔrmbukyia no na EWURADZE ne dan no ntamu, na ɔdze kesii n’afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn wɔ kwaamu afamu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Ahaz hyɛɛ ɔsɔfo Uria, dɛ, Afɔrmbukyia kɛse no do na hyew anapa hyew afɔr, na ewimbir edziban afɔr, na ɔhen ne hyew afɔr, na n’edziban afɔr, ka asaase yi do ɔman nyinara hɔn ɔhyew afɔr, na hɔn edziban afɔr, na hɔn nom afɔr ho; na fa ɔhyew afɔr bɔgyaa no nyinara petse do: na boran afɔrmbukyia no dze onsi hɔ mma me, ma memfa nhwehwɛ adze.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm na ɔsɔfo Uria yɛe, dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔhen Ahaz hyɛe no tse nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen Ahaz twitwaa ndaka no ne nhyehyɛmu no, na oyiyii eguarsɛn bo fii do; na oyii po no fii boran anantwi no a wɔwɔ n’ase no do, na ɔdze kesii abosɛwee bi do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no nsumaa kwan a wɔyɛɛ no ɔdan no mu no, na ɔhen no n’ahɛnee a ɔwɔ guado no, ɔdanee kɔr EWURADZE ne fi no nkyɛn, osian Asiriahen no ntsi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Ahaz no ho nsɛm nkaa no, dza ɔyɛe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Ahaz kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no kaa n’egyanom ho wɔ David kurow mu: na ne babanyin Hezekia dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Judahen Ahaz n’afe a otsia duebien no mu na Ela ne ba Hosea hyɛɛ ase dzii Israel do hen wɔ Samaria, na odzii hen mfe akron.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, naaso nna ɔnntse dɛ Israel ahemfo a wodzii n’enyim kan no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ɔno na Asiriahen Salmanesar fowee baa no do; na Hosea bɛyɛɛ n’akowaa, na ɔdze ayɛyɛdze brɛɛ no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Asiriahen no hun tsirdo apam wɔ Hosea mu; osiandɛ ɔasoma abɔfo ma wɔakɔ Egypthen So nkyɛn, na ɔammfa ayɛyɛdze annkɛma Asiriahen no, dɛ mbrɛ nkyɛ ɔyɛ no afrenhyia afrenhyia no: dɛm ntsi Asiriahen kyeer no, na ɔkyekyeer no kɔtoo efiadze.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Asiriahen no fowee bae bɛfaa asaase no nyinara do, na osii mu kɔr Samaria, na okotuaa no mfe ebiasa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Hosea n’afe a otsia akron no mu, na Asiriahen no faa Samaria, na ɔdze Israelmba no kɔr Asiria, na ɔdze hɔn koguu Hala, na Habor, Gozan esutsen ho, na Mediafo nkurow mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛm, osiandɛ Israelmba ayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn a oyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do, wɔ Egypthen Farao ne nsaadze bae no, na woekosuro enyame fofor,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na wɔanantsew amanaman a EWURADZE tuu hɔn fii Israelmba enyim no hɔn ahyɛdze do, na Israel ahemfo dza wɔyɛe no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Israelmba no nam no nsumaa mu yɛɛ ndzɛmba a ɔnntsen tsiaa EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn, na wosisii mbea sorɔnsorɔm wɔ hɔn nkurow nyinara mu maa hɔnho, ofi aweɔmfo abantsentsen do kodu kurow a wɔagye ho ban do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wosisii edum na Aserim wɔ koko tsentsen biara do, na dua momon biara ase;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na hɔ na wɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no nyinara do dɛ mbrɛ amanaman a EWURADZE tutuu hɔn fii hɔn enyim no yɛe; na wɔyɛɛ ndzɛmba fun dze yii EWURADZE ebufuw:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na wɔsoom abosom a EWURADZE aka hɔn ho asɛm dɛ, Mma hom nnyɛ dɛm adze yi no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso EWURADZE nam nkɔnhyɛfo nyinara, na adzehufo nyinara abaw do bɔɔ Israel na Juda kɔkɔ, dɛ, Hom nsan mfi hom akwan bɔn ho, na wondzi me mbransɛm na m’ahyɛdze do, dɛ mbra a mehyɛɛ hom egyanom no nyinara a menam mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no abaw do mosomae ma wɔdze brɛɛ hom no tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie, mbom wɔyɛɛ asoɔdzen mbordo, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom a wɔanngye EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn enndzi no yɛe.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔpoow n’ahyɛdze, na n’ahyɛmu a ɔnye hɔn egyanom dzii no, na ne kɔkɔ a ɔbɔɔ hɔn no; na wokedzii egyangyandze ekyir yɛɛ gyan, na wokedzii amanaman a wɔabɔ hɔn ho aprɔw no a EWURADZE ahyɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn ho dɛ mma wɔnnyɛ dɛ hɔn no ekyir.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔpoow EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn ne mbrasɛm nyinara, na wɔyɛɛ ehonyi a woegu, mekyerɛ anantwimba ebien, na wɔyɛɛ Asera, na wɔsɔɔr wimu ndzɛmba nyinara, na wɔsoom Baal.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔhyeew hɔn mbabanyin na hɔn mbabaa bɔɔ afɔr, na wɔdze adzehwehwɛ na nkaberkyer dzii dwuma, na wɔtɔɔn hɔnho dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dze eyi no ebufuw.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE no bo fuuw Israel dodoodow, na oyii hɔn fii n’enyi do: obiara annka gyedɛ Juda ebusuakuw nko.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Juda so mpo enndzi EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn ne mbrasɛm do, na wɔnantseew Israel ahyɛdze a wɔyɛe no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE poow Israel asefo nyinara, na ohiahiaa hɔn ho, na oyii hɔn hyɛɛ asɛɛfo nsa, kodur dɛ ɔtoow hɔn fii n’enyi do gui.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔtseew Israel fii David fi ho; na wɔhyɛɛ Nebat ne ba Jeroboam hen: na Jeroboam twee Israel fii EWURADZE n’ekyir dzi, na ɔmaa wɔyɛɛ bɔn kɛse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Israelmba nantseew Jeroboam no bɔn a ɔyɛe nyinara mu; na woemmfi ho;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: kodur dɛ EWURADZE yii Israel fii n’enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔnam no nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara abaw do kae no. Nna wɔfaa Israel fii hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do kɔr Asiria, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Asiriahen no kɛfaa nyimpa fii Babilɔn, na Kutha, na Ava, na Hamat na Sefarvaim bae, na ɔdze hɔn boguu Samaria nkurow mu hyɛɛ Israelmba no ananmu: na wɔfaa Samaria, na wɔtsenatsenaa no nkurow no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ hɔn hɔ ntsenae n’ahyɛse no mu no, woennsuro EWURADZE: dɛm ntsi EWURADZE somaa ngyata wɔ hɔn mu a wokunkum hɔn mu binom.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Asiriahen no, dɛ, Amanaman a eyiyi na edze hɔn ebogu Samaria nkurow mu yi, wonnyim asaase no do Nyankopɔn n’amambra: dɛm ntsi ɔasoma ngyata wɔ hɔn mu, na, hwɛ, worukuku hɔn, osiandɛ wonnyim asaase no do Nyankopɔn n’amambra.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Asiriahen no hyɛɛ dɛ, Hom mfa asɔfo a hom dze hɔn fi hɔ bae no mu baako nkɔ hɔ; na hom mma wɔnkɔ nkɛtsena hɔ, na ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn asaase no do Nyankopɔn n’amambra.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna asɔfo no a wɔdze hɔn fi Samaria bae no mu baako bae bɛtsenaa Bɛtɛl, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn mbrɛ wonsi na wɔnsɔr EWURADZE.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso ɔman biara yeyɛɛ hɔnankasa hɔn enyame, na wɔdze hɔn sisii mbea sorɔnsorɔm do adan a Samariafo yeyɛe no mu, ɔman biara wɔ hɔn nkurow a wɔtse mu no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Babilɔnfo no yɛɛ Sukɔt-benot, na Kutfo no yɛɛ Nergal, na Hamatfo no yɛɛ Ashima,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na Avafo no yɛɛ Nibhaz na Tartak, na Sefarvaimfo hyehyeew hɔn mba wɔ gya mu dze maa Adrammelek na Anammelek, Sefarvaim enyame no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna wɔsɔɔr EWURADZE, na wɔdze hɔn ara hɔn mu bi hyehyɛɛ mbea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo a wɔbɔɔ afɔr maa hɔn wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do adan no mu maa hɔnho.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Wɔsɔɔr EWURADZE, naaso wɔsoom hɔnankasa hɔn enyame, dɛ mbrɛ amanaman a wɔfaa hɔn fii hɔn mu bae no hɔn amambra tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi ara wɔyɛ nkan no ndzeyɛɛ no: wɔnnsuro EWURADZE, nkyii so wɔnnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ahyɛdze, anaa mbra no anaa mbrasɛm a EWURADZE hyɛɛ Jakob a ɔtoo no dzin Israel no ne mba no tse no;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: hɔn na EWURADZE nye hɔn dzii ahyɛmu, na ɔbraa hɔn, dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro enyame fofor, nkyii so hom mmbɔ hom mu adze mma hɔn, na wɔnnsom hɔn, na wɔmmbɔ afɔr mma hɔn:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: mbom EWURADZE a ɔdze tum kɛse na abasa a wɔatserɛw mu yii hom fii Egypt asaase do bae no, ɔno na hom nsuro no, na ɔno na hom mbɔ hom mu adze mma no, na ɔno na hom mbɔ no afɔr:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na ahyɛdze na mbra na mbrasɛm a ɔkyerɛwee maa hom no, hom ndwen do nyɛ no daapem; na mma hom nnsɔr enyame fofor:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na ahyɛmu a menye hom edzi no mma hom werɛ mmfir; nkyii so mma hom nnsuro enyame fofor:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: mbom hom EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na hom nsuro no; na ɔno na obeyi hom efi hom atamfo nyinara nsamu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso woenntsie, na mbom wɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ nkan no hɔn amambra tse no ara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna amanaman yi sɔɔr EWURADZE, naaso wɔsoom hɔn ehonyi a woesian no; hɔn mba so, na hɔn mba so mba, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom yɛe no, dɛmara so na wɔayɛ dze ebodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei ɔbaa dɛ Israelhen Hosea, Ela ne ba no n’afe a otsia ebiasa no mu no, nna Judahen Ahaz ne ba Hezekia hyɛɛ ase dzii hen.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe eduonu akron wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Abi, Zekaria ne babaa a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ dza n’egya David yɛe no tse nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ɔno na oyiyii mbea sorɔnsorɔm, na obubuu edum no, na otwitwaa Asera no gui: na obubuu boran abowatsena a Moses yɛe no mu esinesin; osiandɛ ɔdze bodu nda no mu no nna Israelmba hyew eduhuam ma no; nna wɔfrɛ no Nehusitan.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ɔdze no werɛ hyɛɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no mu; ma n’ekyir obiara nntse dɛ ɔno wɔ Juda ahemfo nyinara mu, nkyii so wɔ hɔn a wodzii n’enyim no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Osiandɛ ɔdze noho bataa EWURADZE ho, oenngyaa n’ekyir dzi, mbom odzii ne mbrasɛm a ɔnoara EWURADZE hyɛɛ Moses no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE dzii n’ekyir; beebiara a ofiir edzi kɔree no ɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm: na ɔtseew etua wɔ Asiriahen no do, na ɔannsom no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ɔno na okunkum Filistiafo no kodur Gaza na n’ahe do, ofi aweɔmfo abantsentsen ho dze kodu kurow a wɔagye no ban no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔhen Hezekia n’afe a otsia anan no a ɔyɛ Israelhen Hosea, Ela ne ba no n’afe a otsia esuon no mu no, na Asiriahen Salmanesar fowee baa Samaria do, na obotuu hyɛɛ no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na mfe ebiasa n’ewiei no nna wɔgyee: mekyerɛ Hezekia n’afe a otsia esia no a ɔyɛ Israelhen Hosea n’afe a otsia akron no mu no, nna wɔgyee Samaria fae.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Asiriahen no faa Israel kɔr Asiria, na ɔdze hɔn koguu Hala, na Habor, esutsen Gozan ho, na Mediafo nkurow mu:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: osiandɛ woenntsie hɔn EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ne ndze, mbom wɔtoo n’ahyɛmu, mekyerɛ dza EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses hyɛe no nyinara, na wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie, na eso wɔaayɛ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei ɔhen Hezekia n’afe a otsia duanan no mu no na Asiriahen Senakerib fowee baa Juda nkurow a wɔagyegye ho ban no nyinara do, na ɔbɛgyee fae.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Judahen Hezekia somae ma wɔkɔr Asiriahen no hɔ wɔ Lakis, dɛ, Mayɛ bɔn; san fi mo do: dza edze bɔto mo do no mobɔsoa. Na Asiriahen no twae maa Judahen Hezekia dɛ ontua dwetɛ talent ahaasa na sika talent eduasa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Hezekia dze dwetɛ a wohun no wɔ EWURADZE ne fie nyinara maa no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber no mu na Hezekia twitwaa EWURADZE n’asɔrfi no mbobow ho, na edum a Judahen Hezekia duraduraa ho no, no ho sika, na ɔdze maa Asiriahen no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Asiriahen no somaa Tartan na Rab-saris na Rabsake ma wofi Lakis nye dɔm kɛsenara kɔr ɔhen Hezekia nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalɛm. Na wɔfowee baa Jerusalɛm. Na aber a wɔfowee bae no, wobegyinaa etsifi nsutaae a ɔwɔ ɔtanhofo haban no ne tsempɔn do, nsuka ho.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a wokehyiia ɔhen no, nna Hilkia ne ba Eliakim a ɔhwɛ fidua no do no, ɔkyerɛwfo Sebna, na Asaf ne ba ɔsɛnkaafo Joa, fiir edzi baa hɔn nkyɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Rabsake see hɔn dɛ, Afei hom nka nkyerɛ Hezekia dɛ, Mbrɛ ɔhen kɛse, Asiriahen no se nye yi, Awerɛhyɛmu bɛn nye iyi a edze wo werɛ ahyɛ mu yi?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ɔwo eka dze na ɔyɛ nsɛnhun, Dɛ ɔsa ho egyinatu na ahoɔdzen wɔ wo hɔ. Afei woana na etwer no, ma atsew mo do etua yi?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei, hwɛ, ɔwo etwer Egypt a, ɔtse dɛ ndzɛmbir a ebu yi no poma do, ɔno no do na nyimpa bi twer a, ɔwɔ ne nsamu, na ohwira mu: mbrɛ Egypthen Farao tse dze ma hɔn a wɔtwer no nyinara nye no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na sɛ hom se me dɛ, Yɛtwer EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn a: ana nnyɛ ɔno na Hezekia eyiyi ne mbea sorɔnsorɔm na n’afɔrmbukyia, na ɔase Juda na Jerusalɛm dɛ, Afɔrmbukyia yi enyim wɔ Jerusalɛm na hom nsɔr no?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, meserɛ wo, enye mo wura Asiriahen no nkyiakyia, na memma wo mpɔnkɔ mpemebien, kyerɛ dɛ w’afamu ibotum ama nyimpa atsenatsena hɔn do a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ibodua dɛn na etum adan mo wura no nkowaa nketseaba mu ɔsafohen kor n’enyi, na osian ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo ntsi, edze woho akɔtwer Egypt?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ana edween dɛ mekwetsir EWURADZE na maba bea yi do dɛ merebɛsɛɛ no? EWURADZE na ɔsee me dɛ, Fow kɔ asaase yi do, na kɛsɛɛ no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Hilkia ne ba Eliakim, na Sebna, na Joa, see Rabsake dɛ, Meserɛ wo, kasa kyerɛ wo nkowaa wɔ Siria kasa mu; na yɛtse: na mma nnye hɛn nnkasa wɔ Judafo kasaa mu, wɔ nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ fasu do no asomu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Rabsake see hɔn dɛ, Ana mo wura somaa me dɛ membɛka asɛm yi nkyerɛ wo wura, na ɔwo a? Ana nnyɛ mbarimba a wɔtsetse fasu do no nkyɛn na ɔsomaa me bi a, hɔn a hɔn so wobedzi hɔnankasa hɔn egyanan, na wɔanom hɔnankasa hɔn ase nsu dɛ homara no?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Rabsake gyinae, na ɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu wɔ Judafo kasaa mu, na ɔkaa dɛ, Hom ntsie ɔhen kɛse no, Asiriahen no, n’asɛm.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, Mma hom mma Hezekia ndaadaa hom; na orunntum nngye hom mmfi ne nsamu:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: nkyii so mma mma Hezekia mma hom nntwer EWURADZE, dɛ, ɔgye na EWURADZE bɛgye hom, na wɔremmfa kurow yi nnhyɛ Asiriahen nsa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Mma hom nntsie Hezekia: na mbrɛ Asiriahen no se nye yi, Hom nye me ndzi no hom abodweesɛm mu; na hom mfir edzi mbra me nkyɛn; na hom mu obiara ndzi no wenyindua, na n’adɔmbadua do bi, na hom mu obiara nnom nankasa no bura mu nsu;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: nkodu dɛ mebɛba m’abɛfa hom akɔ asaase a ɔtse dɛ homankasa hom asaase yi do, eburow na nsa asaase, edziban na wenyin nture asaase, ngodua na ewo asaase, ma hom aatsena ase, na hom eennwu: na mma hom nntsie Hezekia, aber a ɔredaadaa hom, dɛ, EWURADZE bɛgye hom no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ana amanaman enyame no mu biara agye n’asaase efi Asiriahen nsamu pɛn?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Hamat na Arpad enyame no wɔwɔ henfa? Sefarvaim, Hena, na Iva enyame no wɔwɔ henfa? Ana wɔagye Samaria efi me nsamu a?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Amanaman enyame nyinara mu woananom na wɔagye hɔn man efi me nsamu, ma EWURADZE rebɛgye Jerusalɛm efi me nsamu yi?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔman no kaa hɔn ano too mu, na woemmbua no asɛm biara: osiandɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm nye dɛ, Mma wommbua no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Hilkia ne ba Eliakim a ɔhwɛ fidua no do no, na ɔkyerɛwfo Sebna, na Asaf ne ba ɔsɛnkaafo Joa, dze hɔn ntar a wɔatsetsew mu baa Hezekia nkyɛn, na wɔbɛkaa Rabsake ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen Hezekia tsee no, nna ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔdze eyitam kataa no do, na osii mu kɔr EWURADZE ne fie.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsomaa Eliakim a ɔhwɛ fidua no do no, na ɔkyerɛwfo Sebna, na asɔfo no mu mpanyin no, a nna wɔdze eyitam akatakata hɔn do no, ma wɔkɔr Amoz ne ba nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia nkyɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ Hezekia se nye yi, Ndɛ da yi ɔyɛ ɔfona, na nkaenyim, na ebufuw da: osiandɛ mbaa edu akoe mu, na ahoɔdzen nnyi hɔ a wɔdze bɔwo.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Annyɛ a w’EWURADZE Nyankopɔn bɛtse Rabsake a no wura Asiriahen no asoma no dɛ ɔmbɔsopa tseasefo Nyankopɔn no, ne nsɛm no nyinara, na ɔaka n’enyim wɔ nsɛm a w’EWURADZE Nyankopɔn atse no ntsi: dɛm ntsi ma wo mpaabɔ do ma nkaa a wɔaka no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔhen Hezekia no nkowaa no baa Isaia nkyɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Isaia see hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ hom nka nkyerɛ hom wura nye yi, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mma nnsuro asɛm a atse no a Asiriahen no nkowaa dze abɛyeyaw me no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Hwɛ, medze sunsum bi mebɛhyɛ no mu, na ɔbɛtse atsesɛm bi, na ɔasan akɔ nankasa n’asaase do; na mebɛma ɔatɔ wɔ afona ano wɔ nankasa n’asaase do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Rabsake sanee, na okohun dɛ Asiriahen reyɛ Libna do sa: osiandɛ ɔatse dɛ oetu efi Lakis.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na aber a ɔtsee dɛ wɔreka no wɔ Etiopiahen Tirhaka ho dɛ, Hwɛ, oefir edzi dɛ ɔnye wo robɔko no: ɔsomaa abɔfo bio ma wɔkɔr Hezekia nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Mbrɛ hom nkɛka nkyerɛ Judahen Hezekia nye yi, dɛ, Mma mma wo Nyankopɔn a edze wo werɛ etwer no no nndaadaa wo, dɛ, Wɔremmfa Jerusalɛm nnhyɛ Asiriahen nsa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Hwɛ, ɔwoara atse dza Asiria ahemfo dze ayɛ asaase nyinara, dɛ wɔasɛɛ hɔn pasapasa: na ɔwo na wɔbɛgye wo anaa?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ana amanaman a m’egyanom asɛɛ hɔn, mekyerɛ, Gozan, Haran, Rezef, na Eden mba a wɔwɔ Telasar no, hɔn enyame no gyee hɔn anaa?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Henfa na Hamathen, Arpadhen, na Sefarvaim kurow, na Hena, na Ivahen no wɔ?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Hezekia gyee nwoma no wɔ abɔfo no nsamu, na ɔkenkanee: na Hezekia sii mu kɔr EWURADZE fie, na ɔkɛtsɛɛw mu wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Hezekia bɔɔ mpaa wɔ EWURADZE enyim, see dɛ, EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn a etse do, ɔwo nkotoo ara nye asaase do ahendzi nyinara do Nyankopɔn; ɔwo na ayɛ ɔsor na asaase.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: EWURADZE e, brɛ w’aso adze, na tsie; EWURADZE e, bue w’enyiwa, na hwɛ; na tsie Senakerib ne nsɛm a ɔdze asoma dɛ wɔmfa mbɔsopa tseasefo Nyankopɔn no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nokwar nye yi, Ao, EWURADZE, Asiria ahemfo asɛɛ amanaman na hɔn asaase,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na wɔatotow hɔn enyame egu ogya mu: osiandɛ wɔnnyɛ enyame, na nyimpa nsaano edwuma a, dua na abo; dɛm ntsi na wɔasɛɛ hɔn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, hɛn EWURADZE Nyankopɔn e, mototɔ meserɛ wo, gye hɛn fi ne nsamu, ma asaase do ahenman nyinara nhu dɛ ɔwo nye EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, mekyerɛ ɔwoara nkotoo.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Amoz ne ba Isaia somae ma wɔkɔr Hezekia nkyɛn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi, Susuampa dɛ abɔ me mpaa wɔ Asiriahen Senakerib ho ntsi, metsie wo.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Iyi nye asɛm a EWURADZE aka wɔ no ho: Ɔbaabun Zion babaa no ebu wo enyimtsia esi wo atwetwe; na Jerusalɛm babaa no awosow ne tsir wɔ wo do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Woana na asopa no na ayeyaw no, na woana do na ama wo ndze do na w’enyiwa do wɔ sor etsia no? Ana nnyɛ Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no bi a?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ɔwo nam w’abɔfoe do asopa EWURADZE, na ase dɛ, Medze me ntseaseanam dodow no mobɔfow na maba mbepɔw etsifi, makɔ Lebanon mu nohonoho ara; na mubotwitwa ne nkyindur atsentsen, na no kupresi ndua a wɔapa no megu: na makɛhɛn n’etsiwatsiwa mu asoɛe, ne habanber kwaa no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Emi na metutu mbura na manom amanandze nsu, na medze m’ananadze awew Egypt esutsen nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ana enntsee dɛ mahyehyɛ no dadaada, na mifi tsetseberdo na mehyehyɛe? Afei na mebɛma aba mu dɛ, ɔwo esɛɛ nkurow a wɔagyegye ho ban na ema wɔdandan ekurofo ekuwekuw.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔnam dɛ ekuromfo no hɔn tum suar ntsi, hɔn akoma tui na hɔn enyim guu ase; wɔtse dɛ haban mu efuw, na haban momon, dɛ adantsifi efuw, na eburow a ɔahyew ansaana orutu mpon.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na minyim w’asetsena, wo mfiredzii, na wo mbamu, na wo dam a ebɔ wɔ mo do no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Osian wo dam a ebɔ wɔ mo do, na w’enyimenamsɛm a afow ebodu m’asomu ntsi, medze nkwaba mebɛhyɛ wo hwen mu, na medze menyiamfrɛ mato w’ano, na mebɛsan wo ekyir afa ɔkwan a enam do bae noara do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na iyi bɛyɛ wo asɛnkyerɛdze: afe yi mu hom bedzi dza noara efifir, na afe a otsia ebien no mu dza obefir noara mu epue; na afe a otsia ebiasa no mu no hom ndua, na wombu, na wɔntsetsɛw wenyin nture, na wondzi mu aba.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Juda ofi mu nkaa a woefi nsa no wɔbɛgye ndwow akɔ famu bio, na wɔasow aba akɔ sor.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Osiandɛ Jerusalɛm ne nkaase bi befir edzi efi, na hɔn a wobefi nsa so efi bepɔw Zion do; EWURADZE no mbɔdzembɔ na ɔbɛyɛ iyi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE ka no wɔ Asiriahen ho nye yi, Ɔremmba kurow yi mu, na ɔronntow hɔ egyen menaba so, nkyii so ɔremmfa kyɛm mmba n’enyim, na eso ɔronnhɔr pempe wɔ no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ɔkwan a ɔnam do bae no, ɔnoara so na ɔnam do bɛsan akɔ, na ɔremmba kurow yi mu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na mebɛper kurow yi na magye no nkwa, wɔ mankasa me ntsi, na m’akowaa David ntsi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ anadwe no ara, EWURADZE no bɔfoe fiir edzi kokunkum Asiriafo nseraban do nyimpa mpemɔha eduowɔtwe enum: na aber a nyimpa soɛɛr anapaatu no, nna, hwɛ, hɔn nyinara ayɛ ewufo.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Asiriahen Senakerib fii hɔ, sii mu sanee, na ɔkɛtsenaa Ninive.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔrosɔr wɔ ne nyame Nisrok fie no, nna ne mba Adrammelek na Sarezer dze afona kum no: na wofii nsa guanee kɔr Ararat asaase do. Na ne babanyin Esar-haddon dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nda no mu na Hezekia yaar owuyar. Na Amoz ne ba nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Siesie wo fie yie; na ibowu, na erenntsena ase.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔdaan n’enyim kɔr ban ho, na ɔbɔɔ mpaa kyerɛɛ EWURADZE, dɛ,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ao EWURADZE, mototɔ serɛ wo, afei kaa, mbrɛ mesi na manantsew w’enyim nokwar na akoma a odzi mu mu, na mayɛ dza oye wɔ w’enyi do. Na Hezekia suu pii.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, ansaana Isaia rifir edzi akɔ kurow no ne finimfin afamu no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa ne nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: San bio, na kɛse me man do ɔpanyin Hezekia dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, w’egya David ne Nyankopɔn no, se nye yi, Matse wo mpaabɔ, mehu wo nyinsuwa: hwɛ, mebɛsa wo yarba: da a otsia ebiasa no ebɔsoɛr akɔ EWURADZE ne fie.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na medze mfe duenum mubogu wo nda do; na mebɛgye ɔwo na kurow yi efi Asiriahen no nsamu; na mobɔbɔ kurow yi ho ban wɔ mankasa me ntsi, na m’akowaa David ntsi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Isaia see dɛ, Hom mfa adɔmba tɔw mbra. Na wɔfae dze bɔtoo pɔmpɔ no do, ama ɔaabɔ esu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Hezekia see Isaia dɛ, Ebɛnadze bɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze dɛ EWURADZE bɛsa me yarba, na dɛ mobɔkɔ EWURADZE ne fie da a otsia ebiasa no?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Isaia see dɛ, Iyi nyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze a ofi EWURADZE hɔ mma wo, dɛ EWURADZE bɛyɛ adze a ɔaka no: ana sunsuma nkɔ enyim ntwerba du, anaa ɔnsan ekyir ntwerba du?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Hezekia buaa dɛ, Ɔyɛ har ma sunsuma dɛ ɔpem adze ntwerba du: dabida, mbom ma sunsuma nsan ekyir afamu ntwerba du.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia tseaa mu frɛɛ EWURADZE: na ɔmaa sunsuma no baa ekyir afamu ntwerba du, wɔ Ahaz n’ewiadɔn do ntwerba a oesian dada no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber no mu no, Babilɔnhen Berodak-baladan, Baladan ne ba no, tsee dɛ Hezekia yaree, na ɔsomae ma wɔdze nwoma na ayɛyɛdze kɛmaa Hezekia.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Hezekia tsiee hɔn, na ɔkyerɛɛ hɔn ne ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo da no nyinara, dwetɛ, na sika, na nduhuam na ngo a ɔsom bo, na n’akodze dan, na dza wohun no wɔ n’akoradze nyinara mu: biribi nnyi ne fie, na n’ahenman mu so a Hezekia ammfa annkyerɛ hɔn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia baa ɔhen Hezekia nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, Mbarimba yi se dɛn? Na wofi hen baa wo nkyɛn? Na Hezekia see dɛ, Wofi ekyirekyir ɔman bi mu bae, mekyerɛ Babilɔn a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na woehu wɔ wo fie? Na Hezekia buaa dɛ, Dza ɔwɔ me fie nyinara woehu: biribi nnyi m’akoradze mu a mammfa annkyerɛ hɔn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Isaia see Hezekia dɛ, Tsie EWURADZE n’asɛm.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Hwɛ, nda reba a dza ɔwɔ wo fie nyinara, na dza w’egyanom akora dze ebodu ndɛ da yi, wɔbɔsoa akɔ Babilɔn: biribiara rennka, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na woara wo mba a wofi wo mu no mpo, wɔbɛfa hɔn mu binom so akɔ; na wɔakɛyɛ Babilɔnhen no n’ahemfie asaa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Hezekia see Isaia dɛ, EWURADZE n’asɛm a aka no oye. Osiandɛ ɔkaa no ne tsirmu dɛ, Susuampaara dɛ asomdwee na nokwar bɛba me nda mu a?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Hezekia no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na ne mbanyinndam nyinara, na mbrɛ osii yɛɛ nsutaae, na nsuka, na ɔdze nsu baa kurow no mu no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Hezekia kɔr ne nsamankyir: na ne babanyin Manaasɛ dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a Manaasɛ hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no na oedzi mfe duebien, na odzii hen mfe eduonum enum wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Hefzi-ba.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ wiadzefo a EWURADZE tuu hɔn fii Israelmba enyim no hɔn ndzeyɛɛ no tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Osiandɛ osii mbea sorɔnsorɔm a n’egya Hezekia sɛɛ no no bio; na osisii afɔrmbukyia dze maa Baal, na ɔyɛɛ Asera, dɛ mbrɛ Israelhen Ahab yɛe no, na ɔsɔɔr wimu ndzɛmba nyinara, na ɔsoom hɔn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na osisii afɔrmbukyia wɔ EWURADZE fie a EWURADZE kaa ho asɛm dɛ, Jerusalɛm na medze me dzin mobɔto hɔ no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na osisii afɔrmbukyia dze memaa wimu ndzɛmba no nyinara wɔ EWURADZE fie abangua ebien no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhyeew ne babanyin bɔɔ afɔr, na ɔyɛɛ akɔmfodze, na ɔkyeer nkaber, na ɔnye asamamfrɛfo, na abayifo yɛe: ɔbɔɔ mbusu pii wɔ EWURADZE enyi do dze yii no ebufuw.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔdze Asera ne siaan honyi a ɔyɛe no, sii ofi no mu, ofi no a EWURADZE kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ David na ne ba Solomon dɛ, Ofi yi mu, na Jerusalɛm a masan mu meyi no wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu no mu na medze me dzin mobɔto daa no a:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: nkyii so meremma Israel hɔn anan nntu mmfi asaase a medze memaa hɔn egyanom no do nkekyin bio; sɛ wɔrodwen do ara ayɛ dza medze ahyɛ hɔn no nyinara, na dɛ mbrɛ mbra a m’akowaa Moses dze hyɛɛ hɔn no nyinara tse dze a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso woenntsie: na Manaasɛ daadaa hɔn ma wɔyɛɛ dza omuo seen dza amanaman a EWURADZE sɛɛ hɔn wɔ Israelmba enyim no yɛe.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE nam no nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no do kaa dɛ,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Osiandɛ Judahen Manaasɛ ayɛ ekyiwadze yi, na ɔayɛ bɔn asen dza Amorifo a wodzii n’enyim no yɛe nyinara, na ɔdze n’abosom ama Juda so ayɛ bɔn ntsi:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi, Hwɛ, medze mbusu mereba Jerusalɛm na Juda do a obiara a ɔbɛtse no, n’aso ebien nyina mu bɛyɛ no weɔɔ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na mobɔtwe Samaria esusuhoma mu, na Ahab fie susudua promo mu maba Jerusalɛm do: na mebɛpepa Jerusalɛm mu dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa pepa nkwansɛn mu, ɔpepa na ɔdan no butuw.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na mubopuw m’egyapadze nkaa no, na meyi hɔn ahyɛ hɔn atamfo nsa; na wɔabɛyɛ afonam na asadze ama hɔn atamfo nyinara;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: osiandɛ wɔayɛ dza omuo wɔ m’enyi do, na woeyi me ebufuw araa ofitsi da a hɔn egyanom fi Egypt bae, dze bodu ndɛ da yi mpo.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nkyii so Manaasɛ kaa bɔgya a odzi bem piigyan gui, araa dze kodur dɛ ɔhyɛɛ Jerusalɛm ma fi ano kor kɛpeem kor so; ɔsor no bɔn a ɔdze maa Juda so fomee, dɛ wɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Manaasɛ no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, na no bɔn a ɔyɛe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Manaasɛ kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ nankasa ne fie ture no mu, wɔ Uza no ture no mu: na ne babanyin Amon dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a Amon hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu ebien; na odzii hen mfe ebien wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin Mesullemet, Haruz a ofi Jotba ne babaa a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya Manaasɛ yɛe.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔnantseew ɔkwan a n’egya nantseew mu no nyinara mu, na ɔsoom abosom no a n’egya somee no, na ɔsɔɔr hɔn:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na ɔpoow EWURADZE, n’egyanom Nyankopɔn no, na ɔannantsew EWURADZE no kwan mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Amon no nkowaa paam ne tsir do, na wokum ɔhen no wɔ nankasa ne fie.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na asaase no do nkorɔfo no kunkum hɔn a wɔpaam ɔhen Amon ne tsir do no nyinara; na asaase no do ɔman no hyɛɛ ne babanyin Josia ɔhen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Amon no ho nsɛm nkaa no, dza ɔyɛe no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wosiee no wɔ n’asamandan no mu wɔ Uza no ture no mu: na ne babanyin Josia dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a Josia hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no na oedzi mfe awɔtwe; na odzii hen mfe eduasa biako wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Jedida, Adaia a ofi Bozkat ne babaa a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE n’enyiwa do, na ɔnantseew n’egya David no kwan nyinara mu, na ɔanndan ammfa nkyɛn annkɔ enyimfa anaa abankum.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔhen Josia n’afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu no, nna ɔhen no somaa ɔkyerɛwfo Safan, Mesullam ne ba Azalia ne ba no, ma ɔkɔr EWURADZE ne fie, dɛ,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Fow kɔ ɔsɔfopanyin Hilkia nkyɛn, ma ombu sika a wɔdze ba EWURADZE fie a abowanoahwɛfo no aboa ano efi ɔman no hɔ no ano:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na ma wɔmfa nhyɛ edwumayɛfo a wɔhwɛ EWURADZE fie do no nsa: na ma wɔmfa mma edwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ EWURADZE fie no ma wɔmpempam ofi no n’agow no;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: wɔmfa mma nduadwimfo, na adansifo, na abantofo: na wɔmfa ntotɔ ndua na abo a woetwa mfa mpempam ofi no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso wɔnnye hɔn emmbu sika a wɔdze hyɛɛ hɔn nsa no ho nkontaa; osiandɛ wɔyɛɛ no nokwar mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsɔfopanyin Hilkia see ɔkyerɛwfo Safan dɛ, Mehu mbra nwoma no wɔ EWURADZE fie. Na Hilkia dze nwoma no maa Safan, na ɔkenkanee.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔkyerɛwfo Safan baa ɔhen no nkyɛn, na ɔdze asɛm brɛɛ ɔhen no bio, see dɛ, Wo nkowaa ehue sika no a wohun no ofi no mu no, na woeyi ahyɛ edwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ EWURADZE fi do ahwɛdofo no nsa.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔkyerɛwfo Safan kaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no, dɛ, Ɔsɔfo Hilkia dze nwoma bi ama me. Na Safan kenkaan no wɔ ɔhen no enyim.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen no tsee mbra nwoma no mu nsɛm no, nna ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ ɔsɔfo Hilkia, na Safan ne ba Ahikam, na Mikaia ne ba Akbor, na ɔkyerɛwfo Safan, na ɔhen n’akowaa Asaia, dɛ,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Hom nkɔ nkebisa EWURADZE mma emi, na ɔman no, na Juda nyinara, wɔ nwoma a woehu yi mu nsɛm no ho: na EWURADZE n’ebufuw a ɔadzɛw wɔ hɛn do no ɔso, osiandɛ hɛn egyanom enntsie nwoma yi mu nsɛm no, dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no hɛn ho no nyinara tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔsɔfo Hilkia, na Ahikam, na Akbor, na Safan, na Asaia, sii mu kɔr ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Hulda, ntardohwɛfo Sallum, Tikeva ba no, Harhas ba no, ne yer no nkyɛn; (nna ɔtse Jerusalɛm ne nkyɛmu afa a otsia ebien no mu;) na wɔnye no twetwee nkɔmbɔ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hom nkɛka nkyerɛ ɔbarimba a ɔsomaa hom wɔ me nkyɛn no dɛ,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, medze mbusu mebɛba bea yi, na no do atsefo do, mekyerɛ nwoma a Judahen akenkan no mu nsɛm nyinara:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: osiandɛ wɔapow me, na wɔakɛhyew eduhuam ama enyame fofor, na wɔdze hɔn nsaano edwuma nyinara eyi me ebufuw; dɛm ntsi m’ebufuhyew bɛdzɛw wɔ bea yi do, na wonnkodum no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Judahen no a ɔsomaa hom dɛ wombebisa EWURADZE hɔ adze no dze, mbrɛ hom nse no nye yi, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Ɔfa nsɛm a atse no ho dze,
title: 2ND KINGS

text: osiandɛ w’akoma yɛɛ mberɛw, na ebrɛɛ woho adze wɔ EWURADZE enyim aber a etsee dza mekae mitsiaa bea yi, na no do atsefo, dɛ wɔbɛyɛ amamfo na ndom no, na atsetsew wo ntar mu, na esu wɔ m’enyim ntsi; mo so metsie wo, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, mebɛma akɛka w’egyanom ho wɔ nsamankyir, na wɔbɔkora wo akɔ w’adakamona mu wɔ asomdwee mu, nkyii so w’enyiwa nnkohu mbusu a medze reba bea yi do no nyinara. Na wɔbɛkaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ ɔhen no bio.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no somae ma wokehyiaa Juda na Jerusalɛm amampanyin no nyinara ma wɔbaa ne nkyɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no sii mu kɔr EWURADZE fie, na Juda mbarimba nyinara na Jerusalɛm atsefo nyinara ka no ho, na asɔfo no, na nkɔnhyɛfo no, na ɔman no nyinara, nkakraba na akɛse nyina: na ɔkenkaan ahyɛmu nwoma no a wohun no wɔ EWURADZE fie no no mu nsɛm no nyinara guu hɔn asomu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no kegyinaa dum no ho, na odzii ahyɛmu wɔ EWURADZE enyim, dɛ ɔdze n’akoma nyinara, na ne kra nyinara, bedzi EWURADZE ekyir, na oedzi ne mbransɛm, na ne dasee, na n’ahyɛdze do, dɛ ɔbɛma ahyɛmu yi no mu nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu no etsim: na ɔman no nyinara gyinaa ahyɛmu no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ ɔsɔfopanyin Hilkia, na asɔfo a wodzi do no, na abowanoahwɛfo no, dɛ wonyiyi ndzɛmba nyinara a wɔyɛe maa Baal, na Asera, na wimu ndzɛmba nyinara, mfi EWURADZE n’asɔrfi no mu mpue: na ɔkɛhyeew no Jerusalɛm ekyir wɔ Kidron ho haban mu, na ɔfaa no ho nso no kɔr Bɛtɛl.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na otutuu asɔfo huhuw no a Juda ahemfo hyehyɛe a wɔhyew eduhuam wɔ Juda nkurow mu, mbea sorɔnsorɔm do, na mbeambea a abɔ Jerusalɛm ho aprɔw no fii do; hɔn so a wɔhyew eduhuam ma Baal, na ewia, na bosoom, na nworaba mu ekunyin, na wimu ndzɛmba no nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na oyii Asera no fii EWURADZE ne fie, Jerusalɛm ekyir, kɔr ɔwora Kidron ho, na ɔhyeew no wɔ ɔwora Kidron ho, na osiiw no nketsenketse dɛ huntuma, na ɔkɔtoow no huntuma guu nkorɔfo mba adakamona do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na obubuu ndwamandan a ɔwɔ EWURADZE fie no, beebi mbrɛ mbaa no ween nsensɛnho maa Asera no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔdze asɔfo no nyinara fi Juda nkurow no mu bae, na oguu mbea sorɔnsorɔm mbrɛ asɔfo no hyeew hɔ eduhuam no ho fi, fi Geba kodu Beer-seba; na odwuruuw nkuropon ano mbea sorɔnsorɔm a ɔwɔ kurow no mu ambrado Josua no kuropon ahɛnee mu a ɔwɔ nyimpa n’abankum afamu mber a ɔrehɛn kurow no no kuropon no mu no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso mbea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo no wɔammfow ammba EWURADZE n’afɔrmbukyia no do wɔ Jerusalɛm, mbom wodzii epitsi no bi wɔ hɔn nuanom mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na oguu Tofet a ɔwɔ Hinommba ɔbɔn no mu no ho fi, ama nyimpa bi aannhyew ne babanyin anaa ne babaa ammbɔ afɔr amma Molek bio.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔfaa mpɔnkɔ a Juda ahemfo dze esisi hɔ ama ewia no, wɔ EWURADZE ne fi ahɛnee no, ɔdze kɔ opianyi Natan-melek ne dan a ɔwɔ asɔrdan no nkyɛn no ho; na ɔdze gya hyeew ewia ne ntseaseanam no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na afɔrmbukyia a ɔwɔ Ahaz abansor dan etsifi a Juda ahemfo yɛe, na afɔrmbukyia a Manaasɛ yɛe no wɔ EWURADZE ne fie aban paado ebien no do no, ɔhen no dwuruuw no, na odwuwii fii hɔ, na ɔdze no huntuma no guu ɔwora Kidron mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na mbea sorɔnsorɔm no a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm enyim no a ɔwɔ ɔsɛɛ bepɔw no enyimfa a Israelhen Solomon sii maa Zidonfo ekyiwadze Ashtoret, na Moab ekyiwadze Kemos, na Ammonmba ekyiwadze Milcom no, ɔhen no guu ho fi.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na obubuu edum no mu esinesin, na otwitwaa Aserim no, na ɔdze nyimpa mbiew hyehyɛɛ hɔn ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nkyii so afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ Bɛtɛl, na bea sorɔnsorɔm no a Nebat ne ba Jeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔn no, yɛe no, afɔrmbukyia no na bea sorɔnsorɔm no mpo so odwuruuw no; na ɔhyeew bea sorɔnsorɔm no na ɔyaam no huntuhuntu dɛ huntuma, na ɔhyeew Asera ndua no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Josia daan noho no, nna ohun asamandan a ɔwɔ bepɔw no mu no; na ɔsomae, na wɔkɛfaa mbiew no wɔ asamandan no mu bɛhyeew no wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, na oguu ho fi, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a Nyame nyimpa no a ɔka nsɛm yi no paa mu kae no tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛn nkaabɔdze na muhu yi? Na ekuromfo no kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Nyame nyimpa no a ofi Juda bae, na ɔbɛkaa nsɛm a edze ayɛ Bɛtɛl afɔrmbukyia yi no, n’asamandan a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mma ɔnko hɔ: mma mma nyimpa biara nnka ne mbiew. Nna wɔmaa ne mbiew, na nkɔnhyɛnyi a ofi Samaria bae no ne mbiew koo hɔ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na mbea sorɔnsorɔm adan nyinara so a ɔwɔ Samaria nkurow mu a Israel ahemfo yeyɛɛ dɛ wɔdze riyi EWURADZE ebufuw no, Josia yiyii kɔree, na ɔkɛyɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ndzeyɛɛ a ɔyɛe no Bɛtɛl no nyinara tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na okunkum mbea sorɔnsorɔm do asɔfo no a wɔwɔ hɔ no nyinara wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do, na ɔhyeew nyimpa mbiew wɔ do; na ɔsanee baa Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ ɔman no nyinara, dɛ, Hom ndzi apaho no mma hom EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ ahyɛmu nwoma yi mu no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Woenndzi apaho bi a ɔtse dɛm yi da fitsi atsɛmbuafo a wobuaa Israel atsɛn no nda do, na Israel ahemfo, na Juda ahemfo nda nyinara mu;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: gyedɛ ɔhen Josia n’afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu na wodzii apaho yi maa EWURADZE wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nkyii so hɔn a wɔyɛ asamamfrɛfo, na abayifo, na ekum, na abosom, na ekyiwadze nyinara a wohun no wɔ Juda asaase do na Jerusalɛm no, Josia yiyii no hɔ, ama ɔaama nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma a ɔsɔfo Hilkia kohun no wɔ EWURADZE ne fi no mu no etsim.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔhen biara enndzi n’enyim a ɔtse dɛ ɔno a ɔdze n’akoma nyinara, na ɔnye ne kra nyinara, na ɔnye n’ahoɔdzen nyinara danee baa EWURADZE nkyɛn dɛ mbrɛ Moses mbra no nyinara tse; nkyii so ɔno n’ekyir obiara nnsoɛree a ɔtse dɛ ɔno.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso EWURADZE anndan emmfi n’ebufuhyew kɛse a ɔdzɛwee wɔ Juda do, osian abohur nyinara a Manaasɛ dze huur no bo no nyina ntsi no ho.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Mibeyi Juda so efi m’enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ meyi Israel no, na matow kurow a masan mu eyi yi, mekyerɛ Jerusalɛm, na ofi a mesee dɛ, Me dzin bɛtsena hɔ no, akyen.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Josia no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ne nda no mu na Egypthen Farao-neko sii mu kɔr Asiriahen do, wɔ esutsen Eufrates ho: na ɔhen Josia sii mu kɔr no do; naaso wokum no wɔ Megiddo, aber a ohun no no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na no nkowaa no twee no fun wɔ tseaseanam mu fii Megiddo, na wɔdze no baa Jerusalɛm besiee no wɔ nankasa n’asamandan mu. Na asaase no do ɔman no faa Josia ne ba Jehoahaz seraa no, na wɔhyɛɛ no hen hyɛɛ n’egya n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a Jehoahaz hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no na oedzi mfe eduonu ebiasa; na odzii hen abosoom ebiasa wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Hamutal, Jeremia a ofi Libna ne babaa a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ dza n’egyanom yɛe nyinara tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Farao-neko too no nkyehoma mu wɔ Ribla wɔ Hamat asaase do, amma oeenndzi hen wɔ Jerusalɛm; na ɔdze dwetɛ talent ɔha, na sika talent kor tow too asaase no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Farao-neko hyɛɛ Josia ne ba Eliakim hen hyɛɛ n’egya Josia n’ananmu, na ɔdaan ne dzin Jehoiakim: na Jehoahaz dze, ɔfaa no kɔree; na ɔbaa Egypt, na obowuu hɔ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Jehoiakim dze dwetɛ na sika no maa Farao; na ɔpaa tow maa asaase no dɛ wɔmma sika no dɛ mbrɛ Farao ne mbrasɛm no tse: ɔgyegyee dwetɛ na sika no wɔ asaase no do nkorɔfo no hɔ, obiara dɛ mbrɛ no tow tse, dɛ ɔdze rekɛma Farao-neko.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a Jehoiakim hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe dubiako wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Zebida, Pedaia a ofi Ruma ne babaa a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ dza n’egyanom yɛe no nyinara tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Ne nda no mu na Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar fowee bae, na Jehoiakim bɛyɛɛ n’akowaa mfe ebiasa: nna ɔdanee na ɔtseew no do etua.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na EWURADZE somaa Kaldeafo ekuwekuw, na Siriafo ekuwekuw, na Moabfo ekuwekuw, na Ammonmba ekuwekuw wɔ no do, na ɔsomaa hɔn wɔ Juda do dɛ wɔnkɛsɛɛ no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam no nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no do kae no tse.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nyew, ɔnam EWURADZE ne mbrasɛm do na iyi baa Juda do, dɛ orutu hɔn efi n’enyi do, osian Manaasɛ no bɔn ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ dza ɔyɛe nyinara tse;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na eso osian bɔgya a odzi bem a ɔkae gui ntsi; osiandɛ ɔdze bɔgya a odzi bem hyɛɛ Jerusalɛm ma: na EWURADZE ammpɛ dɛ ɔdze kyɛ.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei Jehoiakim no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na dza ɔyɛe nyinara, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna Jehoiakim kɔr ne nsamankyir: na ne babanyin Jehoiakin dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Egypthen no annda ho ara emmfi n’asaase do ammba bio: osiandɛ Babilɔnhen agye fi Egypt ɔwora ho kodu esutsen Eufrates ho, dza ɔyɛ Egypthen dze nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a Jehoiakin hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe duawɔtwe; na odzii hen abosoom ebiasa wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Nehusita, Elnatan a ofi Jerusalɛm ne babaa a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya yɛe no nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber no mu na Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar no nkowaa tui baa Jerusalɛm, na wobotui hyɛɛ kurow no do.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar baa kurow no do, aber a no nkowaa no worutua no no;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na Judahen Jehoiakin fiir edzi kɔr Babilɔnhen no nkyɛn, ɔnoara, na ne na, na no nkowaa, na n’asafohemfo na ne mpanyimfo: na Babilɔnhen no faa no wɔ n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia awɔtwe no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsoaa EWURADZE ne fie akoradze nyinara, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze fii hɔ kɔree, na otwitwaa sika ndzɛmba a Israelhen Solomon yɛe no wɔ EWURADZE n’asɔrdan no mu no nyinara mu esinesin, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE see no ara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsoaa Jerusalɛm nyinara, na asafohemfo no nyinara, na mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam no nyinara, kɔree, mekyerɛ ndɔmmum mpemdu, na edwimfo na atomfo nyinara; obiara annka gyedɛ asaase no do nkorɔfo ehiafo neminemi no nkotsee.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔfaa Jehoiakin kɔr Babilɔn; na ɔhen no ne na, na ɔhen no ne yernom, na ne mpanyimfo, na asaase no do nyimpa tsitsir no, ɔsoaa hɔn fi Jerusalɛm kɔr Babilɔn ndɔmmum mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na mbarimba akatakyi nyinara, mekyerɛ nyimpa mpemesuon, na edwimfo na atomfo nyimpa apem, hɔn nyinara dɔm mbarimba a wɔfata ɔsa kɔ, mekyerɛ woyinom na Babilɔnhen no faa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔr Babilɔn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Babilɔnhen no hyɛɛ n’egya no nua Mattania ɔhen wɔ n’ananmu, na ɔdaan ne dzin Zedekia.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Aber a Zedekia hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu biako; na odzii hen mfe dubiako wɔ Jerusalɛm na ne na ne dzin dze Hamutal, Jeremia a ofi Libna no ne babaa a.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ Jehoiakim yɛe no nyinara.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔnam EWURADZE n’ebufuw do na ɔbaa dɛm wɔ Jerusalɛm na Juda, dze kodur dɛ ɔtoow hɔn fii n’enyim gui: na Zedekia tseew Babilɔnhen no do etua.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia akron no mu, bosoom a otsia du no ne da a otsia du no mu no, nna Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar, bae, ɔnoara na no dɔm nyinara, baa Jerusalɛm do, bɛkyeer do nsera; na wɔtotoow ho akoban bɔɔ aprɔw.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wɔkyeer kurow no do nsera kodur ɔhen Zedekia n’afe a otsia dubiako no mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Bosoom a otsia anan no mu, da a otsia akron no na ɔkɔm no mu yɛɛ dzen wɔ kurow no mu, nna edziban bi nnyi hɔ mma asaase no do nkorɔfo no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna wotuu tu wɔ kurow no mu na mbarimba akofo no nyinara guaanee duaa mu anadwe faa afasu ebien no a ɔwɔ ɔhen no ture ho no ntamu kuropon mu ɔkwan do kɔree; (afei Kaldeafo etwa kurow no ho ehyia:) na ɔhen no faa Araba ɔkwan do kɔree.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso Kaldeafo dɔm no tsiiw ɔhen no, na wɔkɔtoo no wɔ Jeriko tɛtɛr mu: na wɔbɔɔ no dɔm no nyinara fii no ho petsee.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Nna wɔkyeer ɔhen no, na wɔdze no kɛmaa Babilɔnhen wɔ Ribla; na wobuaa no atsɛn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na wokunkum Zedekia ne mbabanyin wɔ n’enyim, na wotutuu Zedekia n’enyiwa, na wɔtoo no mpokyerɛ mu, na wɔdze no kɔr Babilɔn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei bosoom a otsia enum no mu, wɔ bosoom no ne da a otsia esuon no a, ɔyɛ ɔhen Nebukadenezar, Babilɔnhen no, n’afe a otsia duakron no mu, nna abrafohen Nebuzaradan, Babilɔnhen n’akowaa bi, baa Jerusalɛm:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na ɔbɛhyeew EWURADZE ne fi, na ɔhen ne fi; na Jerusalɛm efi nyinara, mekyerɛ efi akɛse nyinara ɔdze gya hyeew no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Kaldeafo dɔm a wɔka abrafohen no ho no nyinara dwuruuw Jerusalɛm afasu no guu famu hyiae.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na nkorɔfo nkaa a wɔkaa kurow no mu, na hɔn a wɔpaae fii Zedekia ho no kɔr Babilɔnhen nkyɛn no, na nyimpadodow nkaa no, abrafohen Nebuzaradan faa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na abrafohen no gyaa asaase no do ehiafo no bi dɛ wɔnyɛ wenyin tureahwɛfo na ekuafo.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na boran edum a ɔwɔ EWURADZE ne fie no, na eguarsɛn ase ndaka na boran po a ɔwɔ EWURADZE ne fie no, nna Kaldeafo bubuu mu esinesin, na wɔfaa no ho boran no kɔr Babilɔn.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na asɛn, na nsofi, na nsompokuwa, na ntser, na boran ndzɛmba a wɔdze som no nyinara, wɔfae kɔree.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ogyasɛn no, na mbɛɛsen no; dza ɔyɛ sika no, nna sika mapa a, na dza ɔyɛ dwetɛ no, dwetɛ a, abrafohen no faa ne nyinara kɔree.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Edum ebien no, po kor no, na eguarsɛn ase ndaka a Solomon yɛe maa EWURADZE ne fie no; ndzɛmba yi nyinara ho boran no woenntum woennker.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Idum kor ne tsentsen yɛ basafa duawɔtwe, na boran ntaadotsir wɔ no do: na ntaadotsir no ne tsentsen yɛ basafa ebiasa; atenadwuma na pɔmegranate ekutu wɔ ntaadotsir no do bɔ aprɔw, ne nyinara boran a: na idum a otsia ebien no so tse dɛ iyinom, atenadwuma wɔ ho.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na abrafohen no faa ɔsɔfo tsitsir Seraia, na ɔsɔfo a odzi do, Zefania, na abowanoahwɛfo baasa no:
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na kurow no mu so ɔfaa ɔpanyin a wɔdze no sii akofo no do no; na ɔhen no n’apamfo no mu mbarimba beenum a wohun hɔn wɔ kurow no mu, na ɔkyerɛwfo, dɔmhen a ɔpon asaase no do nkorɔfo kɔ ɔsa no; na asaase no do nkorɔfo no mu mbarimba eduosia a wohun hɔn wɔ kurow no mu no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na abrafohen Nebuzaradan faa hɔn, na ɔdze hɔn brɛɛ Babilɔnhen wɔ Ribla.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Babilɔnhen bobɔɔ hɔn na okunkum hɔn wɔ Ribla wɔ Hamat asaase do. Dɛm kwan yi do na wɔfaa Judafo ndɔmmum fii hɔn asaase do kɔree.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na nkorɔfo a wɔkaa Juda asaase do a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar maa wɔkae no dze, mekyerɛ hɔn na ɔdze Safan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedalia dzii hɔn do ambrado.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Afei aber a dɔm no hɔn asafohemfo no nyinara, hɔn na hɔn mbarimba no, tsee dɛ Babilɔnhen dze Gedalia ayɛ ambrado no, wɔbaa Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mizpa. Iyinom nye, Netania ne ba Ismael, Karea ne ba Johanan, Netofanyi Tanhumet ne ba Seraia, na Maakanyi ba Jaazania, hɔn na hɔn mbarimba.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na Gedalia suae kyerɛɛ hɔn na hɔn mbarimba no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro osian Kaldeafo nkowaa no ntsi: hom ntsena asaase yi do, na wɔnsom Babilɔnhen, na obesi hom yie.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Naaso ɔbaa dɛ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu no, nna Elisama ba Netania ne ba Ismael a ofi adehyemba no mu bae, na mbarimba du ka no ho, na ɔbɔbɔɔ Gedalia ma owui, na Judafo na Kaldeafo a wɔka no ho wɔ Mizpa no so.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na nkorɔfo no nyinara, nkakraba na akɛse nyina, na dɔm no hɔn asafohemfo soɛree na wɔbaa Egypt: osiandɛ wosuroo Kaldeafo no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Judahen Jehoiakin no ndɔmmumkɔ afe a otsia eduasa esuon no mu bosoom a otsia duebien no ne da a otsia eduonu esuon no, nna Babilɔnhen Evil-merodak, n’afe a ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ mu no mu no, oyii Judahen Jehoiakin fii efiadze;
title: 2ND KINGS

text: na ɔkasaa ayamuyie mu kyerɛɛ no, na ɔkrɔɔn n’ahengua no ma ɔkyɛɛn ahemfo a wɔka no ho wɔ Babilɔn no hɔn ahengua no.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na ɔsakyeer n’efiadze ntar no, na odzidzii wɔ n’enyim daa wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Na dza wɔdze maa no no, ofi ɔhen no hɔ na wɔdze maa no daa, da biara onyaa ne kyɛpɛn, no nkwa nda nyinara. NHƐNMU Ɔreyɛ ayɛ dɛ Mbermunsɛm Nwoma ahorow ebien no nyina ka nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Samuel na Ahemfo Nwoma no mu wɔ kwan fofor do. Botae ahorow ebien na ɔda edzi wɔ Israel ahendzi ho abakɔsɛm mu wɔ Mbermunsɛm Nwoma no mu. Ɔkyerɛwfo no pɛ dɛ ɔdze iyi kyerɛ dɛ dza ɔtoo Israel na Juda ahenman no nyina ekyir no, Nyankopɔn kɔr do araa dzii n’anohoba a ɔdze bɔɔ ɔman no do. Oduaa nyimpa a nna wɔtse Juda no do na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔsɛ maa ne mamfo no. Dza ɔkyerɛwfo no gyina do ka iyi nye David na Solomon hɔn mbɔdzembɔ, nsakyer edwuma a Jehosafat, Hezekia, na Josia dze bae, na nkorɔfo a wodzii nokwar maa Nyankopɔn no kyerɛ dɛ dɛm anohoba no a Nyankopɔn dze bɔɔ ɔman no bɛba do ampa. Botae a otsia ebien nye dɛ ɔbɛkyerɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛe ma ɔsom a wɔsomee wɔ Jerusalɛm mu no bae, ne tsitsir nye asɔfo na Levifo no som ho nhyehyɛɛ no. Ɔkyerɛ dɛ Solomon na osii Asɔrfi no dze, naaso David nye Asɔrfi no ne farbaa pɔtsee. Ɔnoara na ɔyɛɛ Asɔrfi no ho nhyehyɛɛ nyina.
title: 2ND KINGS

text: Adam woo Set, Set woo Enos, na Enos woo Kenan;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Kenan woo Mahalalel, Mahalalel woo Jared, na Jared woo Enok.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Enok woo Metusela, Metusela woo Lamek, Lamek woo Noa;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Noa woo Sem, Ham, na Jafet.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Jafet ne mba: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Mesek, na Tiras.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Gomer ne mba nye: Ashkenaz, Difat na Togarma.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Javan ne mba: Elisha na Tarsis, Kittim, na Rodanim.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ham ne mba: Kus, Egypt, Put, na Keenan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Kus ne mba: Seba na Havila, Sabta Raama na Sabteka. Na Raama ne mba: Seba na Dedan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Kus woo Nimrod: ɔno na ɔhyɛɛ ase yɛɛ otumfo wɔ asaase do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Egypt woo Ludim, Anamim, na Lehabim, na Naftuhim,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Patrusim, na Kasluhim a Filistiafo fi hɔn mu bae no, na Kaftorim.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Keenan woo n’abakan Zidon, na Het;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Jebusfo, na Amorifo, na Girgasfo;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Hivifo, na Arkifo, na Sinfo;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Arvadfo, Zemarfo, na Hamatfo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Sem ne mba; Elam, Assur, Arpaksad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Geter, na Mesek.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Arpaksad woo Sela, na Sela woo Eber.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Eber woo mba beenu: ɔbaako ne dzin dze Peleg; (osiandɛ ne nda no mu no nna asaase paae), na no nua no dzin dze Joktan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Joktan woo Almodad, Selef, Hazarmavet, na Jera;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hadoram, Uzal, na Dikla;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ebal, Abimael, na Seba;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ofir, Havila, na Jobab. Iyinom nyinara nye Joktan ne mba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ebusuasantsen a ofi Sem do dze kesi Abraham nye iyi: Sem, Arpaksad, Sela;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Eber, Peleg, Reu;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Serug, Nahor, Tera;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Abram a ɔnoara nye Abraham.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Abraham ne mba nye Isaak, na Ismael.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Iyinom nye hɔn mbasantsen: Ismael n’abakan, Nebaiot; na Kedar, na Adbeel, na Mibsam,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Misma, na Duma, Massa; Hadad, na Tema,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Jetur, Nafis, na Kedema. Iyinom nye Ismael ne mba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Abraham no nwewe Ketura ne mba: nye Zimran, Joksan, Medan, na Midian, Isbak, na Sua. Na Joksan ne mba; Seba, na Dedan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Midian ne mba; Efa, na Efer, na Hanok, na Abida, na Eldaa. Iyinom nyinara nye Ketura ne mba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Abraham woo Isaak, na Isaak so woo Esau na Jakob a ɔnoara nye Israel.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Esau ne mba; Elifaz, Reuel, Jeus, Jalam, na Kora.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Elifaz ne mba; Teman, na Omar, Zefi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, na Amalek.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Reuel ne mba; Nahat, Zera, Samma, na Miza.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Seir ne mba; Lotan, Sobal, Zibeon Ana, Dison na Ezer na Disan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Lotan ne mba; Hori na Honam; na Timna yɛ Lotan n’akyerɛbaa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Sobal ne mba; Alian, Manahat na Ebal, Sefi na Onam. Na Zibeon ne mba; Aia na Ana.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ana ne ba nye Dison, na Dison ne mba nye Hamran, Esban, Itran na Keran.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ezer ne mba; Bilhan na Zaavan, Jaakan. Disan ne mba; Uz na Aran.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei ahemfo a wodzii hen wɔ Edom asaase do, ansaana ɔhen biara ridzi Israelmba do hen no nye woyinom: Beor ne ba Bela; na no kurow dzin dze Din-haba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Bela wui, na Zera a ofi Bozra ne ba Jobab bedzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jobab wui, na Husam a ofi Temanfo hɔn asaase do no bedzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Husam wui, na Hadad ne ba Bedad a okum Midian wɔ Moab haban mu no ne ba no, bedzii hen wɔ n’ananmu: na no kurow dzin dze Avit.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Hadad wui, na Samla a ofi Masreka bedzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Samla wui, na Saul a ofi Rehobot a ɔwɔ Esutsen no ho no bedzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Saul wui, na Akbor ne ba Baal-hanan bedzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Baal-hanan wui, na Hadad bedzii hen wɔ n’ananmu; na no kurow dzin dze Pai: na ne yer ne dzin dze Mehetabel, Me-zahab ne babaa, Matred ne babaa a.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Hadad wui. Na Edom ekunyin nye yi; ekunyin Timna, Alia, Jetet;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Oholibama, Ela, Pinon;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Magdiel, na Iram. Woyinom nye Edom ekunyin.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nye Israel ne mba; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, na Juda, Isakar na Zebulun;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Dan, Josef na Benjamin, Naftali, Gad na Aser.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Juda ne mba; Er, Onan, na Sela: baasa yi na Keenannyi Bathshua woo hɔn maa no no. Na Juda n’abakan Er, ɔyɛɛ nyimpa bɔn wɔ EWURADZE enyim; na EWURADZE kum no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na n’asew Tamar woo Perez na Zera maa no. Juda ne mba nyinara wɔyɛ beenum.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Perez ne mba; Hezron na Hamul.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Zera ne mba; Zimri, Etan, Heman, Kalkol, na Dara: hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ beenum.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Karmi ne mba; Akan, Israel hɔn hawfo no a ɔtoo mbra wɔ adze a woehyira do no ho no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Etan ne mba; Azaria.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hezron so ne mba a wɔwoo hɔn maa no nye; Jerameel, Ram, na Kelubai.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Ram woo Amminadab; na Amminadab woo Nahshon, Judamba mu bapɔmba no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Nahshon woo Salma, na Salma woo Boaz;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Boaz woo Obed, na Obed woo Jesse;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Jesse woo n’abakan Eliab, na otsia ebien nye Abinadab, na ebiasa nye Simea;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: otsia anan Netanel, enum Radai;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: esia Ozem, esuon David;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na hɔn nkyerɛbaa nye Zeruia na Abigail. Na Zeruia ne mba yɛ baasa; Abishai, Joab, na Asahel.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Abigail woo Amasa: na Amasa n’egya nye Ismaelnyi Jeter.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Hezron ne ba Kaleb nye ne yernom Azuba, na Jeriot wowoo mba: na ne mba nye yinom; Jeser, Sobab, na Ardon.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Azuba wui, na Kaleb faa Efrat waar no, na ɔwoo Hur maa no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Hur woo Uri, na Uri woo Bezalel.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na n’ekyir no Hezron kɔr Gilead n’egya Makir ne babaa nkyɛn; ɔno na ɔfaa no waar no aber a oedzi mfe eduosia; na ɔwoo Segub maa no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Segub woo Jair a onyaa Gilead asaase do nkurow eduonu ebiasa no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Gesur na Aram gyee Jair nkurow no wɔ hɔn nsamu, nye Kenat, na no nkurobaase, mekyerɛ nkurow eduosia. Woyinom nyinara Gilead n’egya Makir ne mba a.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Hezron wui wɔ Kaleb Efrata no, Abija, Hezron ne yer no woo Ashur, a ɔyɛ Tekoa n’egya no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Hezron n’abakan Jerameel ne mba nye; Ram, Buna, Oren, Ozem, na Ahija.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jerameel wɔ yer kor so a ne dzin dze Atara; ɔno nye Onam ne na.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jerameel n’abakan Ram ne mba nye Maaz, Jamin, na Eker.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Onam ne mba nye Sammai, na Jada: na Sammai ne mba; Nadab na Abishur.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Abishur ne yer ne dzin dze Abihail; na ɔwoo Ahban, na Molid maa no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Nadab ne mba; Seled, na Appaim: na Seled wui a oennya mba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Appaim woo Isi, na Isi woo Sesan, na Sesan so woo Ahlai.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Sammai no nua Jada ne mba; Jeter, Jonatan; na Jeter wui a oennya mba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jonatan ne mba; Pelet na Zaza. Woyinom nye Jerameel n’asefo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei Sesan nnyi mbabanyin, gyedɛ mbabaa. Na Sesan nyaa akowaa, Egyptnyi bi a ne dzin dze Jarha.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Sesan dze ne babaa maa n’akowaa Jarha ayewar; na ɔwoo Attai maa no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Attai woo Natan, na Natan woo Zabad;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Zabad woo Eflal, na Eflal woo Obed;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Obed woo Jehu, na Jehu woo Azaria;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Azaria woo Helez, na Helez woo Eleasa;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Eleasa woo Sismai, na Sismai woo Sallum;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Sallum woo Jekamia na Jekamia woo Elisama.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Jerameel no nua Kaleb ne mba: n’abakan Mesha a ɔyɛ Zif n’egya no; na Hebron n’egya Maresa ne mba no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Hebron ne mba; Kora, Tappua, Rekem, na Sema.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Sema woo Raham, Jorkeam n’egya no; na Rekem woo Sammai.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Sammai ne ba nye Maon; na Maon yɛ Bɛt-zur n’egya.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Kaleb no nwewe Efa woo Haran, na Moza, na Gazez: na Haran woo Gazez.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jadai ne mba; Regem, na Jotam, Gesan, na Pelet, Efa, na Saaf.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Kaleb no nwewe Maaka woo Seber na Tirhana.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Eso ɔwoo Saaf, Madmanna n’egya, na Seva a ɔyɛ Makbena na Gibea hɔn egya; na Kaleb ne babaa nye Aksa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nye Kaleb ne mba; Efrata n’abakan, Hur ne ba no, Kiriat-jearim n’egya Sobal;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Bɛtlɛhɛm n’egya Salma, Bɛt-gader n’egya Haref.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Kiriat-jearim n’egya Sobal nyaa mba; Haroe, a Menuhot ɔfa fi no mu no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Kiriat-jearim n’ebusuafo nye; Itrifo, Putfo, Sumatfo, na Misrafo; hɔn mu na Zoratfo na Estaolfo no fi bae.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Salma ne mba; Bɛtlɛhɛm, Netofatfo, Atroth-beth-Joab, na Manahatfo ɔfa, Zorfo no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na akyerɛwfo a wofi Jabez ebusuafo mu no nye; Tiratfo, Simeatfo, na Sukatfo. Woyinom nye Kenfo a wofi Rekab fie egya, Hamat, mu bae no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nye David ne mba a ɔwoo hɔn wɔ Hebron: abakan, Amnon a ɔnye Jezreelnyi Ahinoam woo no no; otsia ebien, Daniel a ɔnye Karmelnyi Abigail woo no no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: otsia ebiasa, Absalom, Gesurhen Talmai ne babaa Maaka ba no; otsia anan, Adonija, Hagit ba no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: otsia enum, Sefatia a ɔnye Abital woo no; otsia esia, Itream a ɔnye ne yer Egla woo no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Beesia na wɔwoo hɔn maa no wɔ Hebron; na hɔ na odzii hen mfe esuon na abosoom esia: na Jerusalɛm na odzii hen mfe eduasa ebiasa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na woyinom na ɔwoo hɔn wɔ Jerusalɛm: Simea, Sobab, Natan, na Solomon, dɛm baanan yi na ɔnye Ammiel ne babaa Bat-seba woo hɔn.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ne mba no binom so nye; Ibhar, Elisua, Elifelet;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Noga, Nefeg, na Jafia;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Elisama, Eliada, na Elifelet. Wɔyɛ baakron.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nyinara wɔyɛ David ne mba, nna ɔsor nwewefo mba no so. Ɔwoo babaa so a ɔtoo no Tamar.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Iyi nye Solomon n’asefo: Solomon, Rehoboam, Abija, Asa, Jehosafat;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Joram, Ahazia, Joas;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Amazia, Azaria, Jotam;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ahaz, Hezekia, Manaasɛ;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Amon na Josia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Josia ne mba yɛ baanan. N’abakan nye Johanan, otsia ebien no Jehoiakim, ebiasa nye Zedekia, anan nye Sallum.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehoiakim ne mba nye Jekonia, na Zedekia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jekonia ndɔmmumnyi no ne mba nye; Sealtiel,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Malkiram, Pedaia, Senazar, Jekamia, Hosama, na Nedabia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Pedaia ne mba nye Zerubabel, na Simei. Zerubabel ne mba nye Mesullam, na Hanania; na Selomit nye hɔn akyerɛbaa:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Binom so nye Hasuba, Ohel, Berekia, Hasadia, Jusab-hesed, wɔyɛ beenum.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Hanania ne mba nye Pelatia, na Jesaia. Jesaia ne ba nye Refaia, Refia ne nye ba Arnan, ne ba nye Obadia na ɔno so ne ba nye Sekania.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Sekania ne ba nye Semaia: na Semaia ne ba nye Hatus, Igal, Baria, Nearia, na Safat, esia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Nearia ne mba nye; Elioenai, Hizkia, na Azrikam, baasa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Elioenai ne mba; Hodavia, na Eliasib, na Pelaia, na Akkub, Johanan, Delaia, na Anani, beesuon.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Juda ne mba nye; Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur, na Sobal.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES
