text: Na Sobal ne ba Reaia woo Jahat; na Jahat woo Ahumai na Lahad. Woyinom nye Zoratfo ebusuafo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na woyinom nye Etam n’egya ne mba; Jezreel, na Isma, na Idbash: na hɔn akyerɛbaa ne dzin dze Hazelelponi:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Gedor n’egya nye Penuel, na Husa so n’egya nye Ezer. Woyinom nye Bɛtlɛhɛm n’egya Efrata, n’abakan Hur ne mba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Tekoa n’egya Ashur wɔ yernom beenu, Hela na Naara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Naara woo Ahuzzam, Hefer, Temeni, na Haahastari maa no. Woyinom nye Naara ne mba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Hela ne mba nye Zeret, Izhar, na Etnan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Hakoz woo Anub, na Zobeba, na Harum ne ba Aharhel n’ebusuafo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jabez nyaa enyimnyam seen no nuanom: na ne na frɛɛ ne dzin Jabez, see dɛ, Medze yaw na mowoo no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jabez frɛɛ Israel Nyankopɔn, see dɛ, Ao nkyɛ edze nhyira ara eehyira me, na aatrɛ me he mu, na wo nsa eedzi m’ekyir, na nkyɛ eesie me efi mbusu ho, ama ɔaammfa ɔhaw ammbrɛ me! Na Nyankopɔn maa no dza obisae no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Suha no nua Kelub woo Mehir a ɔyɛ Eston n’egya no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Eston woo Bɛt-rafa, na Pasea, na Ir-nahas n’egya Tehinna. Woyinom nye Reeka nkorɔfo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Kenaz ne mba; Otiniel, na Seraia: na Otiniel ne mba nye; Hatat na Meonotai.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Meonotai woo Ofra: na Seraia woo Ge-harasim n’egya Joab; nna wɔyɛ edwimfo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jefune ne ba Kaleb ne mba nye; Iru, Ela, na Naam: na Ela woo Kenaz.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Jehalelel ne mba nye; Zif, na Zifa, Tiria, na Asarel.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Ezra ne mba; Jeter, na Mered, na Efer, na Jalon: na ɔwoo Miriam, na Sammai, na Estemoa n’egya Isba so.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ne yer Judanyi no woo Gedor n’egya Jered, na Soko n’egya Heber, na Zanoa n’egya Jekutiel. Na woyinom nye Farao ne babaa Bitia a Mered faa no waar no no ne mba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Hodia ne yer, Naham n’akyerɛbaa no, ne mba nye Marminyi Keila, na Maakatnyi Estemoa hɔn egya.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Simon ne mba nye; Ammon, na Rinna, Ben-hanan, na Tilon. Na Isi ne mba nye; Zohet, na Ben-zoheth.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Juda ne ba Sela ne mba nye; Leka n’egya Er, na Maresa n’egya Laada, na hɔn a wɔdze ndwera fɛɛfɛw dzi edwin hɔn fie ebusuafo, wofi Ashbea fie;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Jokim, na Kozeba mbarimba, na Joas, na Saraf a ɔwaree wɔ Moab, na wɔasan aba Lehem no. (Dɛm nsɛm yi yɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no tsetse ato hɔ.)
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nye awemfo, Netaim na Gedera ekuromfo: hɔn na wɔnye ɔhen no tsenae wɔ n’edwuma no ntsi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Simeon ne mba; Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zera, na Saul:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Sallum, Mibsam, na Misma.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Misma n’asefo nye Hamuel, Zakur, na Simei.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Simei nyaa mbabanyin duesia na mbabaa esia; na no nuanom no dze woennya mba pii, nkyii so hɔn ebusua nyinara anndɔr, dɛ Judamba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔtsenaa: Beer-seba, Molada, Hazar-sual;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Bilha, Ezem, Tolad;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Betuel, Horma, Ziklag;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Bɛt-makabot, Hazar-susim, Bɛt-biri, na Saaraim. Iyinom nye hɔn nkurow dze bodu David n’ahendzi do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn nkuroba nye Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token, na Ashan, nkuroba enum:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na hɔn nkuroba nyinara wɔabɔ nkurow no ara ho aprɔw dze kodu Baal. Iyinom nye hɔn tsenabew, na wɔwɔ hɔn ebusuasantsen nwoma da hɔ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Mesoba, Jamlek, Amazia ne ba Josa;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Joel, Jehu, Josibia ne ba no, Seraia ne ba no, Asiel ne ba no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Elioenai, Jaakoba, Jesohaia, Asaia, Adiel, Jesimiel, na Benaia;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ziza, Sifi ne ba no, Allon ne ba no, Jedaia ne ba no, Simri ne ba no, Semaia ne ba no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: woyinom a wɔabobɔ hɔn edzin yi wɔyɛ mbapɔmba wɔ hɔn ebusua ebusua mu: na hɔn egyanom efiefi trɛɛ kɛsenara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wosii mu kɔr mbrɛ wɔnam kɔ Gedor ahɛnee, mekyerɛ ɔbɔn no no boka afamu, dɛ wɔrokɔhwehwɛ edzidzibea ama hɔn nguankuw.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wohun edzidzibea frɔmfrɔm a oye, na asaase no mu trɛ, no do dwe komm; na hɔn a nkyɛ nkan no wɔtsetse hɔ no wofi Ham mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na woyinom a wɔabobɔ hɔn edzin akyerɛw no bae wɔ Judahen Hezekia ne nda no mu, na wɔkɛsɛɛ hɔn asesee na Meunim a wohun no hɔ no, na wɔsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa, dze bodu ndɛ da yi, na wɔtsenatsenaa hɔn ananmu: osiandɛ edzidzibea wɔ hɔ ma hɔn nguankuw.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn mu binom, mekyerɛ Simeon n’asefo no mu, mbarimba ahaenum, sii mu kɔr bepɔw Seir do, na hɔn asafohemfo nye Pelatia, Nearia, Refaia, na Uziel, Isi mba no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wokunkum Amalekfo nkaa a wofii nsa guanee no, na wɔtsenaa hɔ dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Israel n’abakan Reuben n’asefo, (nna ɔnoara nye abakan dze, naaso susuampa dɛ oguu n’egya ne mpa ho fi ntsi, wɔdze n’abakan ndzinoa maa Israel ne ba Josef ne mba no; na ebusuasantsen nkanee no so woemmbu ano wɔ abakan ndzinoa no do.)
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ɔwɔ mu dɛ Juda dzii no nuanom do nyim, na ɔbapɔmba no fii no mu bae; naaso abakan ndzinoa no dze ɔyɛɛ Josef dze.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Israel n’abakan Reuben ne mba nye; Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, na Karmi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Joel ne n’asefo nye; Semaia, Gog, Simei;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Mika, Reaia, Baal:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Beera a Asiriahen Tilgat-pilneser faa no ndɔmmum kɔree no: ɔno nye Reubenfo mu bapɔmba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na no nuanom dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, wɔ aber a worubu hɔn ebusuasantsen nkanee ano no nye yi; otsitsir Jeiel, na Zekaria,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Bela Azaz ne ba no, Sema ne ba no, Joel ne ba no a ɔtsenaa Aroer araa dze kodur Nebo na Baal-meon ho:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na boka afamu so ɔtsenae araa dze kodur sar no n’ahɛnee a ofi esutsen Eufrates ho: osiandɛ hɔn mbowakuw dɔree wɔ Gilead asaase do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Saul ne nda no mu no ɔnye Hagrifo dzii ako, ma wɔtotɔr hɔn nsaano: na wɔtsenatsenaa hɔn asesee mu wɔ Gilead boka afamu asaase no do nyinara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Gadmba no tsenaa hɔn tsentsendo, wɔ Bashan asaase do dze kodur Saleka:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Joel dzi kan, na Safam dzi hɔ, na Janai, na Safat wɔ Bashan:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na hɔn nuanom a wofi hɔn egyanom efiefi nye yi; Maekɛl, Mesullam, Seba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia, na Eber, wɔyɛ beesuon.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nye Abihail ne mba. Abihail n’ebusuasantsen nye, Huri, Jaroa, Gilead, Maekɛl, Jesisai, Jahdo, na Buz.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ahi, a ɔyɛ Abdiel a n’egya nye Guni ne ba no, yɛ otsitsir wɔ hɔn egyanom efiefi do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔtsenaa Gilead wɔ Bashan, na no nkuroba mu, na Saron no nkurotsia nyinara araa dze kodur hɔn ahe do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Iyinom nyinara wobuu ano ebusuasantsen nkanee no wɔ Judahen Jotam ne nda no mu, na Israelhen Jeroboam ne nda no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Reuben ne mba, na Gadfo, na Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no, nyimpa ndandamfo mu, mbarimba a wokitsa kyɛm na afona, na wɔtow egyen, na wonyim ɔsa yɛ no, wɔyɛ nyimpa mpem eduanan anan ahaesuon eduosia a wotum dɛ wotu kɔ ɔsa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔnye Hagrifo, Jetur, Nafis, na Nodab dzii ako.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔboaa hɔn ma wɔfaa hɔn do, na wɔdze Hagrifo no, na hɔn a wɔka hɔn ho no nyinara, hyɛɛ hɔn nsa: osiandɛ wɔtseaa mu frɛɛ Nyankopɔn wɔ ɔko no mu, na otsiee hɔn; osiandɛ wɔdze hɔn werɛ tweer no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔfaa hɔn mbowakuw kɔree; hɔn efumpɔnkɔ mu mpemeduonum, na nguan mu mpemahaenu eduonum, na nsoasopɔnkɔ mu mpemebien, na nyimpa mu mpemɔha.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na piigyan hwee ase totɔree, osiandɛ ɔsa no fi Nyankopɔn hɔ. Na wɔfaa hɔn nkurow no tsenatsenaa mu kodur ndɔmmumkɔ no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no mba no tsenaa asaase no do: na wɔdɔree fi Bashan dze kodur Baal-hermon na Senir na bepɔw Hermon ho.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na woyinom nye hɔn egyanom efiefi do etsitsir; mekyerɛ Efer, Isi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremia, Hodavia, na Jahdiel, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, nyimpa a wɔwɔ dzin. Wɔyɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi do etsitsir.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Naaso wɔfoom hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn, na woenndzi nokwar amma no, dɛ wokedzii asaase no do aman a Nyankopɔn sɛɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim no enyame ekyir.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Israel Nyankopɔn no nunuu Asiria ahemfo Pul, na Tilgat-pilneser tsiaa hɔn, na wɔfaa hɔn kɔree, mekyerɛ Reubenfo, Gadfo, na Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no, na wɔdze hɔn baa Hala, na Habor, na Hara, na esutsen Gozan ho, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Levi ne mba; Gerson, Kohat, na Merari.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Kohat ne mba; Amram, Izhar, na Hebron, na Uziel.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Amram ne mba; Aaron, na Moses, na Miriam. Na Aaron ne mba; Nadab na Abihu, Eleazar na Itamar.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Eleazar woo Finehas, Finehas woo Abishua;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Abishua woo Bukki, na Bukki woo Uzi;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Uzi woo Zerahia, na Zerahia woo Meraiot;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Meraiot woo Amaria, na Amaria woo Ahitub;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Ahitub woo Zadok, na Zadok woo Ahimaaz;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Ahimaaz woo Azaria, na Azaria woo Johanan;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Johanan woo Azaria, (ɔno nye nyia odzii sɔfo wɔ dan no a Solomon sii no wɔ Jerusalɛm no mu no:)
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Azaria woo Amaria, na Amaria woo Ahitub;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Ahitub woo Zadok, na Zadok woo Sallum;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Sallum woo Hilkia, na Hilkia woo Azaria;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Azaria woo Seraia, na Seraia woo Jehozadak;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Jehozadak kɔr ndɔmmumyɛ mu wɔ aber a EWURADZE nam Nebukadenezar nsa do faa Juda na Jerusalɛm kɔree no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Levi ne mba; Gerson, Kohat, na Merari.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na iyinom nye Gersonmba no hɔn edzin; Libni na Simei.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Kohat ne mba nye Amram, na Izhar, na Hebron, na Uziel.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Merari ne mba; Mahili na Mushi. Na iyinom nye Levifo ebusua ebusua dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi tsetsee.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Gerson dze; Libni, Jahat, ne ba Zima;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: ne ba Joa ne ba Iddo, ne ba Zera, na Jeaterai.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Kohat ne mba; Aminadab, Kora, Assir;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Elkana, Eliasaf, Assir;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Tahat, Uriel, Uzia, na Saul.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Elkana ne mba; Amasai, na Ahi-moth.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Elkana dze: Elkana n’asefo binom nye Zofai, Nahat;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Eliab, Jeroham, na Elkana.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Samuel ne mba; abakan Joel, na otsia ebien Abija.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Merari ne mba; Mahili, Libni, Simei, Uza;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Simea, Hagia, na Asaia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na woyinom nye hɔn a David dze hɔn sisii EWURADZE fie ndwom edwuma do, ofi ber a adaka no nyaa ahomgye no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze ndwom somee wɔ ehyiadzibuw no ne ntamadan no enyim, dze kodur dɛ Solomon sii EWURADZE ne fi no wɔ Jerusalɛm: na wɔkɔr do soom ndzidzido ndzidzido, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn gyinabew tsetsee.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na woyinom nye hɔn a wogyinae na hɔn mba no. Kohatfo no mba mu: ɔdwontofo Heman a ofi woyinom hɔn ebusuasantsen mu. Joel, Samuel;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Elkana, Jeroham, Eliel, Toa;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Zuf, Elkana, Mahat, Amasai;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Elkana, Joel, Azaria, Zefania;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Tahat, Assir, Ebiasaf, Kora;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Izhar, Kohat, Levi, Israel.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na no nua Asaf a ogyinaa ne nsa enyimfa no, mekyerɛ Asaf, a ofi Berekia, Simea;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Maekɛl, Baaseia, Malkija;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Etni, Zera, Adaia;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Etan, Zima, Simei;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Jahat, Gerson, na Levi ebusua mu no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na abankum afamu hɔn nuanom Merari: Etan a ofi woyinom ebusua mu no: Kishi, Abdi, Malluk;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hasabia, Amazia, Hilkia;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Amzi, Bani, Semer;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Mahili, Mushi, Merari, na Levi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn nuanom Levifo no wɔdze hɔn maa Nyankopɔn ne fie ntamadan ho som nyinara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Aaron na ne mba na wɔbɔɔ afɔr wɔ ɔhyew afɔrmbukyia no do, na eduhuam afɔrmbukyia no do, wɔdze maa bea krɔnkrɔn edwuma no nyinara, na wɔpatae maa Israel, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn n’akowaa Moses hyɛe no nyinara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na woyinom nye Aaron n’asefo; Eleazar, Finehas, Abishua;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Bukki, Uzi, Zerahia;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Meraiot, Amaria, Ahitub;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Zadok, na Ahimaaz.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei iyinom nye hɔn tsenabea horow dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nseraban tsetsee wɔ hɔn ahe do: Aaronmba no a wofi Kohatfo ebusua mu no nyaa hɔn kyɛfa, osiandɛ hɔndze no nye tonto a odzi kan,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: hɔn na wɔmaa hɔn Hebron a ɔwɔ Juda asaase do, na no nkurotsia asaase a ɔabɔ ho aprɔw no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na kurow no ne haban, na no nkurobaase no dze, wɔdze maa Jefune ne ba Kaleb.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze guansumabew nkurow no maa Aaron ne mba no, guansumabew kurow, Hebron; Libna so nye ne mfikyisaase, na Jattir, na Estemoa nye ne mfikyisaase;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Hilen nye ne mfikyisaase, Debir nye ne mfikyisaase;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Ashan nye ne mfikyisaase, na Bɛt-semes nye ne mfikyisaase:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Benjamin ebusuakuw mu so; Geba nye ne mfikyisaase, na Allemet nye ne mfikyisaase, na Anathot nye ne mfikyisaase. Hɔn nkurow a ɔwɔ hɔn ebusua ebusua mu nyinara yɛ nkurow duebiasa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Kohatmba nkaa no wɔnam tonto do fi ebusuakuw no mu ebusua mu, fi ebusuakuw fa no mu, Manaasɛ fa no mu, maa hɔn nkurow du.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Gerson ne mba, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee no, wɔdze Isakar ebusuakuw mu, na Aser ebusuakuw mu, na Naftali ebusuakuw mu, na Manaasɛ ebusuakuw a ɔwɔ Bashan no mu, nkurow duebiasa maa hɔn.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Merarimba no, wɔnam tonto do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, wɔdze Reuben ebusuakuw mu, na Gad ebusuakuw mu, na Zebulun ebusuakuw mu, nkurow duebien maa hɔn.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelmba no dze nkurow no nye ne mfikyisaase no maa Levifo no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔnam tonto do dze Judamba ebusuakuw mu, na Simeonmba ebusuakuw mu, nkurow yi a wɔabobɔ dzin yi mae.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Kohatmba ebusua ebusua no mu binom nyaa hɔn ahe do nkurow wɔ Efraim ebusuakuw mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔmaa hɔn guansumabew nkurow, Sekem nye ne mfikyisaase wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow mu; Gezer so nye ne mfikyisaase;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Jokmeam nye ne mfikyisaase, na Bɛt-horon nye ne mfikyisaase;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Aijalon nye ne mfikyisaase, na Gat-rimmon nye ne mfikyisaase:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no mu: Aner nye ne mfikyisaase, na Bileam nye ne mfikyisaase, wɔdze maa Kohatmba ebusua nkaa no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Gersonmba no wɔmaa hɔn Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no ebusua mu, Golan a ɔwɔ Bashan nye ne mfikyisaase, na Ashtarot nye ne mfikyisaase;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Isakar ebusuakuw mu; Kedes nye ne mfikyisaase, Daberat nye ne mfikyisaase;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Ramot nye ne mfikyisaase, na Anem nye ne mfikyisaase:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Aser ebusuakuw mu; Mashal nye ne mfikyisaase, na Abdon nye ne mfikyisaase;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Hukok nye ne mfikyisaase; na Rehob nye ne mfikyisaase:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Naftali ebusuakuw mu; Kedes a ɔwɔ Galilii nye ne mfikyisaase, na Hamon nye ne mfikyisaase, na Kiriataim nye ne mfikyisaase.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Levifo nkaa no, Merarimba no, wɔmaa hɔn Zebulun ebusuakuw mu, Rimono nye ne mfikyisaase, Tabor nye ne mfikyisaase:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Jeriko-Jordan egya, Jordan no boka afamu so, wɔmaa hɔn Reuben ebusuakuw mu, Bezer a ɔwɔ sar no do nye ne mfikyisaase, na Jahza nye ne mfikyisaase,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Kedemot nye ne mfikyisaase, na Mefaat nye ne mfikyisaase:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Gad ebusuakuw mu; Ramot a ɔwɔ Gilead nye ne mfikyisaase, na Mahanaim nye ne mfikyisaase,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Hesbon nye ne mfikyisaase, na Jazer nye ne mfikyisaase.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Isakar ne mba nye yi; Tola, Pua, Jasub, na Simron. Wɔyɛ baanan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Tola ne mba nye; Uzi, Refaia, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, na Semuel, hɔn egyanom efiefi etsitsir, dɛ, Tola dze; mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam wɔ hɔn mbasantsen mu: hɔn dodow wɔ David ne nda no mu no ɔyɛ mpemeduonu ebien na ahaesia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Uzi ne ba nye Izrahia; na Izrahia ne mba nye; Maekɛl, Obadia, Joel, Ishia, beenum: hɔn nyinara nyimpa etsitsir a.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn a wɔka hɔn ho, nam hɔn mbasantsen do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi tsetsee no, nye akodzi dɔm ekuwekuw, mpemeduasa esia: na wɔwɔ yernom na mba pii.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn nuanom a wɔwɔ Isakar ebusua ebusua nyinara mu, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam no, wobuu hɔn ano dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ananakan tse no, wɔyɛ mpemeduowɔtwe esuon.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Benjamin mba; Bela, Beker, na Jediael, baasa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Bela mba; Ezbon, na Uzi, na Uziel, na Jerimot, na Iri, beenum; egyanom efiefi etsitsir, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam; na wɔkaan hɔn ananakan do mpemeduonu ebien na eduasa anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Beker mba nye; Zemira, Joas, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, na Jeremot, Abija, na Anathot, na Alemet. Woyinom nyinara Beker ne mba a.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔkaan hɔn ananakan do, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mbasantsen tse, hɔn egyanom efiefi do etsitsir, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, mpemeduonu na ahaebien.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Jediael asefo nye; Bilhan, Jeus, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaana, Zetan, Tarsis, na Ahishahar.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nyinara yɛ Jediael n’asefo, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi tsetsee, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, mpemduesuon ahaenu a wotum fir edzi kedzi ako wɔ dɔm mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Supim na Huppim yɛ Ir ne mba, na Husim yɛ Aher ne ba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Naftali ne mba nye; Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, na Sallum, wɔyɛ Bilha asefo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Manaasɛ mba; Asriel a ne yer woo no no: (no nwewe Aramnyi no woo Gilead n’egya Makir:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Makir waar Huppim na Supim akyerɛbaa a ne dzin dze Maaka;) na nyia otsia ebien no ne dzin dze Zelofehad: na Zelofehad nyaa mbabaa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Makir ne yer Maaka woo babanyin, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Peres; na no nuabanyin dzin dze Seres; na ne mba nye Ulam na Rakem.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Ulam ne ba nye Bedan. Woyinom fi Gilead, Makir na Manaasɛ mba mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na n’akyerɛbaa Hamoleket woo Isod, na Aiezer, na Mahala.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Semida mba nye Ahian, Sekem, Likhi, na Aniam.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Efraim asefo nye; Sutela, Bered, Tahat, Eleada, Tahat.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Zabad, Sutela. Sutela, Ezer, na Elead a Gat mbarimba a wɔwoo hɔn wɔ asaase no do no kunkum hɔn, osiandɛ wɔkɔree dɛ worukowia hɔn mbowakuw akɔ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn egya Efraim gyaam hɔn nda pii, na no nuanom baa dɛ wɔrebɛkyekye no werɛ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔkɔr ne yer nkyɛn, na onyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin, na ɔfrɛɛ ne dzin Beria, osiandɛ mbusu na ɔbaa ne fie.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ne babaa nye Seera a ɔkyekyeer Bɛt-horon anaafo na etsifi, na Uzen-seera.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Efraim ne ba kor so nye Refa a n’asefo nye Resef, Tela, Tahan;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ladan, Ammihud, Elisama;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nun, na Josua.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn egyapadze na hɔn tsenabew nye Bɛtɛl na no ho nkuroba, na boka afamu Naaran, na anee afamu Gezer, nye no ho nkuroba; Sekem so na no ho nkuroba, dze kodu Azza na no ho nkuroba;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Manaasɛmba hɔn ahe nkyɛn no, Bɛt-sean na no nkuroba, Taanak na no nkuroba, Megiddo na no nkuroba, Dor na no nkuroba. Iyinom mu na Israel ne ba Josef n’asefo tsenae.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Aser mba; Imna, Isva, Isvi, Beria, na hɔn akyerɛbaa Sera.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Beria mba; Heber, na Malkiel a ɔyɛ Birzait n’egya no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Heber woo Jaflɛt, Somer, na Hotam, na n’akyerɛbaa Sua.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jaflɛt ne mba nye; Pasak, na Bimhal, na Ashvat. Woyinom nye Jaflɛt ne mba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Semer mba nye; Ahi, Rohga, Jehubba, na Aram.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na no nua Helem mba nye; Zofa, Imna, Seles, na Amal.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Zofa n’asefo nye; Sua, Harnefer, Sual, Beri, Imral,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Bezer, Hod, Samma, Silsa, Itran, na Beera.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jeter mba; Jefune, na Pispa, na Ara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Ulla mba nye; Ara, Hanniel, na Rizia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nyinara wofi Aser ebusua mu, egyanom efiefi do etsitsir mu, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn, mbapɔmba mu etsitsir. Na hɔn dodow wobu ano dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ananakan tse a, wotu ɔsa a wɔyɛ mbarimba mpemeduonu esia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Benjamin woo ne mba Bela, Ashbel, Ahara;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Noha, na Rafa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Bela nyaa mba, Addar, Gera, Abihud;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoa;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Gera, Sefufan, na Huram.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na woyinom nye Ehud n’asefo: wɔyɛ Geba atsefo mu egyanom efiefi do etsitsir, na wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔr Manahat:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Naaman, Ahija, na Gera; ɔnoara na ɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree; na ɔwoo Uza na Ahihud.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Saharaim woo mba wɔ Moab haban mu, ber a oegya Husim na Baara a wɔyɛ ne yernom no kwan no n’ekyir no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔnye ne yer Hodes woo Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malkam;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Jeuz, Sakia, na Mirma. Woyinom nye ne mba, egyanom efiefi do etsitsir.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔnye Husim woo Abitub na Elpaal.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Elpaal n’asefo nye; Eber, Misam, na Semed a ɔkyekyeer Ono na Lod, nye no nkuroba:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Beria, na Sema a wɔyɛ Aijalon atsefo mu egyanom efiefi do etsitsir a wɔpaam Gat atsefo no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ahio, Sasak, Jeremot;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Zebadia, Arad, Eder;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Maekɛl, Ispa, na Joha; woyinom yɛ Beria asefo;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Zebadia, Mesullam, Hizki, Heber;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ismerai, Izlia, na Jobab, Elpaal asefo nye no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Jakim, Zikri, Zabdi;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Elienai, Ziletai, Eliel;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Adaia, Beraia, na Simrat yɛ Simei asefo;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Ispan, Eber, Eliel;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Abdon, Zikri, Hanan;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hanania, Elam, Anto-tija;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ifdeia, na Penuel yɛ Sasak asefo;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Samserai, Seharia, Atalia;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Jaaresia, Elija, na Zikri yɛ Jeroham asefo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nye egyanom efiefi do etsitsir hɔn ebusuasantsen nyina mu, nyimpa etsitsir: woyinom tsenaa Jerusalɛm.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Gibeon hɔ na Gibeon n’egya, Jeiel a ne yer dzin dze Maaka tsenae:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na n’abakan banyin nye Abdon, afei Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Gedor, Ahio, na Zeker.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Miklot woo Simea. Na hɔn so wɔnye hɔn nuanom tsenaa Jerusalɛm, wɔ hɔn nuanom no hɔn tsentsendo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Ner woo Kish; na Kish woo Saul; na Saul woo Jonatan, Malkisua, Abinadab na Esbaal.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jonatan ne ba nye Merib-baal; na Merib-baal woo Mika.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Mika mba; nye Piton, Melek, Tarea, na Ahaz.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Ahaz woo Jehoada; na Jehoada woo Alemet, Azmavet, na Zimri; na Zimri woo Moza:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Moza woo Binea; n’asefo nye Rafa, Eleasa, na Azel:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Azel nyaa mbabanyin beesia, hɔn edzin nye yi; Azrikam, Bokeru, Ismael, Searia, Obadia, na Hanan. Woyinom nyinara wɔyɛ Azel n’asefo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na no nua Esek ne nye mba; n’abakan Ulam, otsia ebien Jeus, na otsia ebiasa Elifelet.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Ulam ne mba no wɔyɛ mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, egyentofo a, na wonyaa mba piigyan, na mbabanyin hɔn mba, ɔha eduonum. Woyinom nyinara yɛ Benjamin n’asefo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wobuu Israel nyinara ano dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ananakan tsetsee; na, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel ahemfo nwoma no mu: na wɔfaa Juda ndɔmmum kɔr Babilɔn wɔ hɔn mbrato ntsi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei atsefo a wodzi kan a wɔtsenaa hɔn enyadze mu wɔ hɔn nkurow mu nye Israel, asɔfo no, Levifo no, na asɔrdan mu asomfo no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jerusalɛm dze, Judamba, Benjaminmba, na Efraim na Manaasɛmba no mu binom tsenatsenaa hɔ;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Utai a ofi Ammihud, Omri, Imri, Bani a ofi Juda ne ba Perez ne mba mu no ebusuasantsen mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Silonfo mu; abakan Asaia, na ne mba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Zera ne mba mu; Jeuel, na no nuanom, wɔyɛ ahaesia eduokron.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Benjamin ne mba mu; Sallu, Mesullam ne ba no, Hodavia ne ba no, Hasenua ne ba no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Ibneia, Jeroham ne ba no, na Ela, Uzi ne ba no, Mikri ne ba no, na Mesullam, Sefatia ne ba no, Reuel ne ba no, Ibnija ne ba no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na hɔn nuanom dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusuasantsen tsetsee, ahaakron eduonum esia. Mbarimba yi nyinara wɔyɛ egyanom efiefi do etsitsir dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi tsetsee.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na asɔfo no mu; Jedaia, Jehoiarib, Jakin;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Azaria a ofi Hilkia, Mesullam, Zadok, Meraiot, na Ahitub a nna ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn ne fie ɔpanyin no hɔn ebusuasantsen mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Adaia, Jeroham ne ba no, a ofi Pasur, Malkija, Maasai, Adiel, Jahzera, Mesullam, Meshillemit, na Immer ebusuasantsen mu;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na hɔn nuanom, hɔn egyanom efiefi do etsitsir, apem ahaesuon eduosia; mbarimba ara a wotum Nyankopɔn ne fie ɔsom edwuma yɛ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Levifo mu; Semaia, a ofi Hasub, Azrikam, Hasabia, na Merarimba mu;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Bakbakkar, Heres, Galal, na Mattania, a ofi Mika, Zikri, na Asaf asefo mu no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Obadia a ofi Semaia, Galal, Jedutun, Berekia, Asa, na Elkana, ebusua mu a ɔtse Netofatfo nkuroba mu no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna mbobowano ahwɛfo no nye; Sallum, Akkub, Talmon, na Ahiman, na hɔn nuanom: Sallum nye otsitsir;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: ɔno na ahyɛse no ara ogyinaa ɔhen no kuropon ano boka afamu: hɔn na wɔyɛ Levimba nseraban mbobowano ahwɛfo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Sallum, a ofi Kore, Ebiasaf, na Kora asefo no mu, na no nuanom a wofi n’egya fie. Korafo no nna wɔhwɛ ɔsom edwuma no do, ntamadan no no mbobotsenano ahwɛfo a: na hɔn egyanom, EWURADZE ne nseraban no do ahɛnee no ano ahwɛfo a;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Eleazar ne ba Finehas nna odzii hɔn do ɔpanyin mber a etwa mu no, na EWURADZE dzii n’ekyir.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Zekaria, Meselemia ne ba no, nye ehyiadzibuw no n’abowanohwɛfo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nyinara a wɔsaan mu yii hɔn dɛ wɔmbɛyɛ mbobowano ahwɛfo wɔ mbobotsenano no wɔyɛ ahaenu duebien. Woyinom na wobuu ano hɔn ebusuasantsen do wɔ hɔn nkurobaase, hɔn na David na ɔdzehunyi Samuel dze hɔn sisii hɔn nokwardzi edwuma mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hɔn na hɔn mba hwɛɛ EWURADZE fie mbobotsen no ano, mekyerɛ ntamadan ofi no, apatamu apatamu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Mfɛndzanan do na abowanoahwɛfo no wɔ, boka, anee, kwaamu, na pomu afamu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn nuanom a wɔwɔ hɔn nkurobaase, ɔwɔ dɛ wɔba nda esuon biara mu ofi ber to ber bɛka hɔn ho:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na mbobowano ahwɛfo etsitsir baanan no a wɔyɛ Levifo no, wɔwɔ nokwardzi edwuma mu, na wɔhwɛ Nyankopɔn ne fie mpia na adzekorabea no do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔtsetse Nyankopɔn ne dan no ho bɔ ho aprɔw, osiandɛ hɔn asɛdze nye dɛ wɔweɔn, na no mbuei anapa anapa no yɛ hɔn asodzii.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn mu binom hwɛ ɔsom ndzɛmba no do; osiandɛ wobu ano dze ba mu, na wobu ano fa kɔ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Wɔdze hɔn mu binom so sisii dan mu ndzɛmba no, na krɔnkrɔnbea ndzɛmba no nyinara, na isiam pa, na nsa, na ngo, na krɔbɔw, na nduhuam no do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na asɔfomba no binom dze nduhuam foraforae yɛɛ ɔserango no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Mattitia, Levifo no mu baako, a ɔyɛ Koranyi Sallum n’abakan no, nyaa nokwar edwuma wɔ ndzɛmba a wɔto no wɔ kyesɛn mu no do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn nuanom no a wofi Kohatfo mu no mu binom na wɔhwɛ kyerɛpaanoo no do, dɛ wonsiesie no ahomgyeda biara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na woyinom nye adwontofo no, Levifo mu egyanom efiefi do etsitsir a wɔtsenaa mpia mu na wɔnnyɛ edwuma nkaa no bi: osiandɛ hɔn edwuma da hɔn do adzekyee na adzesaa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nye Levifo mu egyanom efiefi do etsitsir, wɔ hɔn ebusuasantsen nyina mu, nyimpa tsitsir: woyinom na wɔtsenaa Jerusalɛm.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Gibeon hɔ na Gibeon n’egya, Jeiel a ne yer dzin dze Maaka tsenae:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na n’abakan nye Abdon, afei Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Gedor, Ahio, Zekaria, na Miklot.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Miklot woo Simea. Na hɔn so wɔnye hɔn nuanom tsenaa Jerusalɛm, wɔ hɔn nuanom no hɔn tsentsendo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Ner woo Kish; na Kish woo Saul; na Saul woo Jonatan, Malkisua, Abinadab, na Esbaal.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jonatan ne ba nye Merib-baal; na Merib-baal woo Mika.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Mika mba nye; Piton, Melek, Tarea, na Ahaz.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Ahaz woo Jara; na Jara woo Alemet, Azmavet, na Zimri; na Zimri woo Moza:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Moza woo Binea; na Binea woo Refaia, na Refaia woo Eleasa, na Eleasa woo Azel:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Azel nyaa mbabanyin beesia, hɔn edzin nye yi; Azrikam, Bokeru, Ismael, Searia, Obadia, na Hanan: woyinom nye Azel ne mba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei Filistiafo nye Israel koe: na Israel mbarimba no fii Filistiafo no enyim guanee, na wɔtotɔree wɔ bepɔw Gilboa do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Filistiafo no tsiiw Saul na ne mba dzendzenndzen; na Filistiafo no kum Jonatan, na Abinadab, na Malkisua, Saul ne mbabanyin no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔko no kyeer Saul do, na egyentofo no too no; na no ho hiahiaa no wɔ egyentofo no ntsi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna Saul see n’akodzesoafo no dɛ, Twe w’afona, na fa wɔ me; amma monomonomfo yi aammba na woeemmbogu m’enyim ase. Na n’akodzesoafo no annyɛ; osiandɛ osuroo dodoodow. Dɛm ntsi Saul faa n’afona, na otwae hwee do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na n’akodzesoafo no hun dɛ Saul ewu no, ɔno so otwae hwee n’afona do dɛmara, na owui.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm na Saul, na ne mbabanyin baasa no, na ne fi nyinara wɔbɔɔ mu wui.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Israel mbarimba a wɔwɔ bɔnsa no mu no hun dɛ woegu no, na Saul na ne mbabanyin ewuwu no, wɔdandaan hɔn nkurow no gyae, na woguanguanee; na Filistiafo no bae bɛtsenatsenaa mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyee enyim no, Filistiafo a wɔbaa dɛ woribeyiyi atɔfo no ho ndzɛmba no hun Saul na ne mbabanyin no dɛ wɔatotɔ wɔ bepɔw Gilboa do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na woyiyii no ho ndzɛmba, na wotwaa ne tsir, na wɔfaa n’akodze, na wɔsomae ma wɔdze kekyimaa Filistiafo asaase do hyiae, dɛ wɔnkɔbɔ hɔn abosom, na ɔman no amandzɛɛ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze n’akodze no koguu hɔn abosondan mu, na wɔdze ne tsir no kɛfaam Dagon dan mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Jabes-gilead nyinara tsee dza Filistiafo dze ayɛ Saul no nyinara no,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: nna mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam no nyinara soɛree, na wokeyiyii Saul, na ne mba hɔn efun no, na wɔdze baa Jabes, na wobesiee hɔn mbiew no wɔ esudur no ase wɔ Jabes, na wodzii mbuada nda esuon.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna Saul wui wɔ no bɔn a ɔyɛe tsiaa EWURADZE, osian EWURADZE n’asɛm a oenndzi do no ntsi; na eso dɛ okebisaa ɔsamamfrɛnyi hɔ adze hwehwɛɛ n’ekyir kwan,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na ɔannhwehwɛ EWURADZE ekyir kwan: dɛm ntsi na okum no, na ɔdaan ahendzi no maa Jesse ne ba David.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Israel nyinara boaboaa hɔn ano kɔr David nkyɛn wɔ Hebron, dɛ, Hwɛ, yɛyɛ wo biew na wo honam.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Mber a etwa mu asen no, mekyerɛ aber a Saul dzi hen no, ɔwo nye nyia ɔdze Israel kɔr sa na ɔdze hɔn sanee bae: na w’EWURADZE Nyankopɔn see wo dɛ, Ɔwo na ebɛnyɛn me man Israel, na ɔwo na ebɛyɛ bapɔmba wɔ me man Israel do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Israel mpanyimfo no nyinara baa ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ Hebron; na David nye hɔn dzii ahyɛmu wɔ EWURADZE enyim wɔ Hebron; na wɔseraa David ngo hyɛɛ no ɔhen wɔ Israel do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam Samuel do kae no tse.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David na Israel nyinara sii mu kɔr Jerusalɛm (ɔnoara nye Jebus); nna Jebusfo no, asaase no do atsefo no, wɔwɔ hɔ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jebus atsefo no see David dɛ, Ɔwo mma mmba ha. Naaso David gyee Zion akoban no; ɔnoara so nye David kurow no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David see dɛ, Obiara a obedzi kan eku Jebusfo no ɔbɛyɛ otsitsir na safohen. Na Zeruia ne ba Joab dzii kan fowee kɔree, na wɔyɛɛ no otsitsir.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David tsenaa akoban no mu; dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ no David no kurow.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔkyekyeer kurow no bɔɔ aprɔw, ɔdze fi Millo araa bɔɔ aprɔw: na Joab yɛɛ kurow nkaa no yie.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David kɔr do yɛɛ otsitsir ara; osiandɛ dɔm EWURADZE no dzii n’ekyir.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei woyinom nye mbarimba akatakyi a David nyae no mu etsitsir a wɔhyɛɛ hɔnho dzen kaa no ho wɔ n’ahendzi no mu, dɛ wɔnye Israel nyinara bɛhyɛ no hen, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔwɔ Israel ho no tse.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na mbarimba akatakyi a David nyae no hɔn dodow nye yi: Jasobeam Hakmonnyi bi ne ba no, eduasa no mu otsitsir no; ɔno na ɔmaa ne peaa do wɔ ahaasa do kum hɔn prɛko no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔno n’ekyir nye Eleazar, Dodo ba, Ahohnyi a ɔyɛ mbarimba baasa no mu baako no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔno na ɔwɔ David nkyɛn wɔ Pas-dammim no, na hɔ na Filistiafo aboaboa hɔn ano dɛ wɔrobɔko. Nna asaasetɔw a atoko ayɛ do ma wɔ hɔ; na ɔman no fii Filistiafo no enyim guanee.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wokegyinaa ne finimfin, na wɔperee, na wokum Filistiafo no; na EWURADZE nam konyim kɛse do gyee hɔn nkwa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na etsitsir eduasa no mu baasa siaan famu kɔr ɔbotan no do wɔ David nkyɛn, wɔ Adullam ɔbo tu no mu; nna Filistiafo dɔm no akyer nsera wɔ Refaim ɔbɔn no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Aber no nna David wɔ tu no mu, na Filistiafo bansifo no so wɔwɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm aber no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David no kɔn dɔe, na ɔsee dɛ, Ao kɛtseankyɛ obi aama me Bɛtlɛhɛm nsubura a ɔwɔ kuropon no ho no mu nsu bi ma maanom!
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na baasa no bɔe faa Filistiafo dɔm no mu, na wɔkɛsaaw Bɛtlɛhɛm nsubura a ɔwɔ kuropon no ho no mu nsu bi, na wɔfae dze brɛɛ David: naaso ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔnom, na mbom ohuei gui maa EWURADZE,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Me Nyankopɔn, ma ɔmpar me, dɛ mebɛyɛ iyi: ana monnom mbarimba yi a wɔdze hɔn nkwa kitsaa hɔn nsamu yi bɔgyaa? Osiandɛ wɔdze hɔn nkwa kitsaa hɔn nsamu kɛfae bae. Dɛm ntsi ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔnom. Iyi nye dza mbarimba akatakyi baasa no yɛe.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Joab no nua Abishai, na ɔyɛ baasa no mu otsitsir: na ɔmaa ne peaa do wɔ ahaasa do kunkum hɔn, na onyaa dzin wɔ baasa no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Baasa no mu, ɔno na ɔyɛ onyimnyamfo dodow sen beenu no, na wɔyɛɛ no hɔn safohen: naaso ɔannto baasa no a wodzii kan no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Jehoiada ne ba Benaia, ɔbarimba bi a ɔyɛ ndam a ofi Kabzeel ne ba no a ɔyɛɛ akatakyidze no, ɔno na okum Moab nyimpa gyatasɛfo beenu no: na osianee so kokum gyata wɔ mona bi mu wɔ esukwankyɛba ber mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na okokum Egyptnyi bi, ɔbarimba kɛse bi a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa enum; na Egyptnyi no kitsa peaa a ɔtse dɛ ɔtanwemfo nsadua wɔ ne nsamu; na ɔdze poma sianee kɔr ne nkyɛn, na okohwiim peaa no wɔ Egyptnyi no nsamu, na ɔdze nankasa ne peaa no kum no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Iyinom na Jehoiada ne ba Benaia yɛe, na onyaa dzin wɔ mbarimba akatakyi baasa no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hwɛ, ɔyɛ onyimnyamfo dodow sen eduasa no, na mbom ɔannto baasa no a wodzii kan no: na David dze no sii n’annkɔbeafo do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Eso dɔm no mu mbarimba akatakyi no nye yi; Joab no nua Asahel, Dodo ne ba Elhanan a ofi Bɛtlɛhɛm;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Harorinyi Sammot, Pelonnyi Helez;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Tekoanyi Ikkes ne ba Ira, Anathotnyi Abiezer;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Husatnyi Sibekai, Ahohnyi Ilai;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Netofatnyi Maharai, Netofatnyi Baana ne ba Heled;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ribai a ofi Benjaminmba Gibea ne ba Itai, Piratonnyi Benaia;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hurai a ofi Gaas nwora mu, Arbatnyi Abiel;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Baharumnyi Azmavet, Saalbonnyi Eliaba;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Gizonnyi Hasem ne mba, Hararnyi Sage ne ba Jonatan;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hararnyi Sakar ne ba Ahiam, Ur ne ba Elifal;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Mekerathnyi Hefer, Pelonnyi Ahija;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Karmelnyi Hezro, Ezbai ne ba Naarai;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Natan no nua Joel, Hagri ne ba Mibhar;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ammonnyi Zelek, Berotnyi Naharai, Zeruia ne ba Joab n’akodzesoafo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Itrinyi Ira, Itrinyi Gareb;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hitinyi Uria, Ahlai ne ba Zabad;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Reubennyi Siza ne ba Adina, Reubenfo mu otsitsir, na eduasa ka no ho;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Maaka ne ba Hanan, na Mitnyi Josafat;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ashteratnyi Uzia, Aroernyi Hotam ne mba Sama na Jeiel;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Simri ne ba Jediael, na no nua Tizinyi Joha;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Mahavinyi Eliel, na Elnaam ne mba Jeribai, na Josa-via, na Moabnyi Itma;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Eliel, na Obed, na Mezobanyi Jaasiel.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei woyinom nye hɔn a wɔbaa David nkyɛn wɔ Ziklag mber a osian Kish ne ba Saul ntsi osiiw noho do no: nna wɔwɔ mbarimba akatakyi, n’akodzi mu aboafo no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Wɔdze egyen emiamia, na wotum dze nsa enyimfa na abankum nyina tow tsiabo do abo, na egyen do egyen menaba; wɔyɛ Saul no nuanom a wofi Benjamin mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ahiezer nye otsitsir, nna Joas, Gibeatnyi Semaa mba no; na Jeziel, na Pelet, Azmavet mba no; na Beraka, na Jehu Anathotnyi no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Gibeonnyi Ismaia, eduasa no mu ɔbarimba katakyi, na ɔhwɛ eduasa no do; na Jeremia, na Jahaziel, na Johanan, na Gederatnyi Jozabad;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Eluzai, na Jerimot, na Bealia, na Semaria, na Harufnyi Sefatia;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Elkana, na Ishia, na Azarel, na Joezer, na Koranyi Jasobeam;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Joela, na Zebadia, Jeroham a ofi Gedor mba no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Gadfo mu hɔn a wɔtseew hɔnho baa David nkyɛn wɔ sar no do tu no mu no yɛ mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, mbarimba akofo a wotum suo kyɛm na peaa mu a, hɔn enyim tse dɛ ngyata enyim, na hɔn ho yɛ har dɛ mbepɔw do atwe no nye yi:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: otsitsir nye Ezer, otsia ebien Obadia, ebiasa Eliab;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: anan Mismanna, enum Jeremia;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: esia Attai, esuon Eliel;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: awɔtwe Johanan, akron Elzabad;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: du Jeremia, dubiako Makbanai.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Gadmba mu woyinom na wɔyɛ dɔm mu asafohemfo: nyia osuar dodow koraa no botum ɔha, na ɔkɛse no so apem.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nye hɔn a wosii mu kotwaa Jordan wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu, aber a nsu no eyir akata no kɔn nyinara do no; na wɔkaa hɔn a wofi abɔn no mu nyinara gui, boka afamu, na anee afamu nyina.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Benjamin na Judamba mu binom baa David nkyɛn wɔ tu no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David fiir edzi kɔr hɔn enyim, na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom baa me nkyɛn asomdwee mu dɛ hom robɔboa me a, ɔno m’akoma bɛfam hom ho: na sɛ hom baa dɛ woribeyi me ama m’atamfo, wɔ dɛ mfom bi nnyi me nsamu yi a, ɔnodze hɛn egyanom Nyankopɔn nhwɛ na ɔnka enyim.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna sunsum no baa Amasai a ɔyɛ eduasa no mu otsitsir no do, na ɔsee dɛ, Yɛyɛ wodze, David, na yɛwɔ w’afa, ɔwo Jesse ba: Asomdwee, asomdwee nka wo, na asomdwee nka w’aboafo; osiandɛ wo Nyankopɔn roboa wo. Nna David gyee hɔn, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn kuw no do asafohemfo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Manaasɛ mu so binom danee kɔr David nkyɛn, aber a nkyɛ ɔnye Filistiafo no reba nye Saul abɔko no; naaso Filistiafo no enntsie no, osiandɛ hɔn asafohemfo no kɔr egyina gyaa no kwan, dɛ, Hɛn etsir na ɔdze bɛpata akɔ no wura Saul nkyɛn.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na osii mu kɔr Ziklag no, Manaasɛ mu binom danee kɔr ne nkyɛn, Adna, na Jozabad, na Jediael, na Maekɛl, na Jozabad, na Elihu, na Ziletai, na Manaasɛ mu mpem do asafohemfo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn na wɔboaa David ma ɔnye epoobɔfo dzii esi; osiandɛ hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, na wɔyɛ dɔm no mu asafohemfo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na daa nyina wɔdze David nkyɛn ba ara, dɛ wɔbɔboa no, kodur dɛ wɔyɛɛ dɔm kɛse, dɛ Nyankopɔn no dɔm.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na woyinom nye hɔn mu etsitsir a woemia ama akodzi a wɔbaa David nkyɛn wɔ Hebron, dɛ wɔrebɛdan Saul n’ahendzi no ama no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm no tse no, hɔn dodow.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Judamba a wokitsa kyɛm na peaa a woemia ama akodzi wɔyɛ mpemesia ahaawɔtwe.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Simeonmba mu mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam ma akodzi, mpemesuon na ɔha.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Levimba mu mpemanan na ahaesia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehoiada na ɔyɛ Aaron fie ɔbapɔmba, na nyimpa mpem ebiasa ahaesuon ka no ho;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Zadok, aberantsɛ ɔkatakyi a ɔyɛ ndam, na n’egya fi mu asafohemfo eduonu ebien.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Benjaminmba mu, Saul no nuanom, mpem ebiasa na ɔdze bodu mber no nna hɔn mu nyimpadodow ara esie hɔn nokwardzi ama Saul fie.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Efraimmba mu mpemeduonu ahaawɔtwe, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, nyimpa a wɔwɔ dzin wɔ hɔn egyanom efiefi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no mu, mpemduawɔtwe a wɔbɔɔ hɔn dzin dɛ wɔmbra mbɛhyɛ David hen.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Isakarmba mu, nyimpa a wɔwɔ mber mu nhumu, dɛ wɔdze bohu dza ɔsɛ dɛ Israel yɛ no; hɔn mu etsitsir yɛ ahaenu; na hɔn nuanom nyinara hwɛ hɔn ano.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Zebulun mu, hɔn a wotum fir edzi wɔ dɔm no mu a wɔdze akodze horow nyinara mia, dze tum siesie kɔ mpasuar do, mpemeduonum; na wobotum ahyehyɛ mpasuar, na wɔnnyɛ akoma ntanta.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Naftali mu asafohemfo apem, na nyimpa a wokitsa kyɛm na peaa mpemeduasa esuon ka hɔn ho.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Danfo mu hɔn a wobotum mpasuar do kɔ, mpemeduonu awɔtwe na ahaesia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Aser mu hɔn a wotum fir edzi wɔ dɔm no mu a wotum kɔ mpasuar do, mpemeduanan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jordan n’egya no ho, Reubenfo mu, na Gadfo, na Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no mu, nyimpa a wɔdze ɔko mu akodze horow nyinara mpemɔha eduonu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nyinara, wɔyɛ mbarimba akofo a wobotum akɔ mpasuar do no, wɔdze akoma a odzi mu baa Hebron, dɛ wɔbɛhyɛ David hen wɔ Israel nyinara do: na Israel nkaa no nyinara so yɛɛ akoma kor dɛ wɔbɛhyɛ David hen.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔnye David dzii hɔ ndaansa, dzidzii nomee: nna hɔn nuanom esiesie hɔn ekyir.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so hɔn a wɔbɛn hɔn no, mekyerɛ ɔdze kodu Isakar na Zebulun na Naftali, wɔdze edziban wɔ efumpɔnkɔ, na nsoasopɔnkɔ, na anantwi do bae, isiam edziban, adɔmba tatar, na esikyireamba esia, na wenyin, na ngo, na anantwi, na nguan piigyan: nna ampaara, enyigye aba Israel.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David nye apem apem do na ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo, mekyerɛ mbapɔmba no nyinara kɔr egyina.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David see Israel bagua no nyinara dɛ, Sɛ oye ma hom, na sɛ ofir EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn hɔ a, hom mma yentwar mu nsoma ma wɔnkɔ hɛn nuanom a wɔaka wɔ Israel asaase nyinara do beebiara, nye asɔfo na Levifo a wɔka hɔn ho wɔ hɔn edzidzibea nkurow mu no nkyɛn, ma wonhyiahyia hɔnho mbra hɛn nkyɛn:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na yɛnkɛfa hɛn Nyankopɔn N’adakaa no mbra hɛn nkyɛn bio: osiandɛ Saul ne nda mu no yɛannhwehwɛ n’ekyir kwan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na bagua no nyinara see dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dɛm: osiandɛ asɛm no tsen wɔ ɔman no nyinara enyi do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna David poon Israel man mu nyinara hyiae, ofi Egypt ɔwora Sihor ho araa dze kodu Hamat ahɛnee, dɛ wɔrekɛfa Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no efi Kiriat-jearim aba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David na Israel nyinara fowee kɔr Baala, ɔno nye Kiriat-jearim a odzi wɔ Juda no, dɛ wɔrekɛfa Nyankopɔn, EWURADZE a ɔtse kerubfo no do a wɔdze Dzin no frɛ no no, n’adakaa no efi hɔ aba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na woyii Nyankopɔn adakaa no wɔ tseaseanam fofor bi do, na wɔdze fii Abinadab fie firii: na Uza na Ahio piaa tseaseanam no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David na Israel nyinara dze hɔn ahoɔdzen nyinara goree wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim: mekyerɛ wɔdze ndwom, nye nsankutsen, na ɔnye bɛnta asanku, na mpintsin, na ɔnye akasaa, na mbɛn.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a wodur Kidon ewuporoweebea no, Uza tseen ne nsa suoo adaka no mu; osiandɛ anantwi no fintsiwii.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Uza do, na ɔbɔɔ no, osiandɛ ɔtseen ne nsa kaa adaka no ntsi: na hɔ na owui wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David ammpɛ, osiandɛ EWURADZE ebu afa Uza do ntsi: na ɔfrɛɛ bea no Perez-Uza, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David suroo Nyankopɔn da no, dɛ, Mibesi dɛn medze Nyankopɔn adakaa no aba me nkyɛn wɔ fie?
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David ennyi adaka no ammba ne nkyɛn wɔ David kurow no mu, na mbom ɔdze maan nkyɛn kɔr Gitinyi Obed-edom n’ebusua mu wɔ ne fie abosoom ebiasa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Nyankopɔn adakaa no kaa Obed-edom n’ebusua mu wɔ ne fie abosoom ebiasa: na EWURADZE hyiraa Obed-edom fi, na dza ɔwɔ nyinara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Taerehen Hiram somaa abɔfo ma wɔbaa David nkyɛn na wɔdze nkyindur ndua, na abodwimfo na nduadwimfo, dɛ wombesi ofi mma no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David hun dɛ EWURADZE etsintsim ne dzin ahyɛ no Israel do hen, na osian ne man Israel ntsi, wɔama n’ahendzi do wɔ sor.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David warwaar yernom bi so wɔ Jerusalɛm: na David wowoo mbabanyin na mbabaa bi so bio.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na mba a onyae wɔ Jerusalɛm no hɔn edzin nye yi; Sammua, na Sobab, Natan, na Solomon;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ibhar, na Elisua, na Elpelet;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Noga, na Nefeg, na Jafia;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Elisama, na Beeliada, na Elifelet.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Filistiafo tsee dɛ wɔasera David ahyɛ no hen wɔ Israel nyinara do no, Filistiafo no nyinara sii mu kɔr dɛ wɔrokɔhwehwɛ David akyer no: na David tsee, na ofiir edzi kɔr hɔn do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna Filistiafo aba dze abɛyer Refaim bɔnsa no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David bisaa Nyankopɔn, dɛ, Ana momfow monkɔ Filistiafo no do a? Ana ibeyi hɔn ahyɛ me nsa a? Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Fow kɔ; na mibeyi hɔn ahyɛ wo nsa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna wɔfowee baa Baal-perazim, na David kunkum hɔn wɔ hɔ; na David see dɛ, Nyankopɔn nam me nsa do atsew m’atamfo mu, dɛ nsu ntsewee. Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ bea no dzin dɛ Baal-perazim.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdaan hɔn nyame gyaa hɔ; na David hyɛe ma wɔdze gya hyeew no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Filistiafo no sanee bae dze bɛyeer bɔnsa no mu bio.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David bisaa Nyankopɔn bio; na Nyankopɔn see no dɛ, Mma mmfow nnkɔ nnkedzi hɔn ekyir: dan fi hɔn nkyɛn, na bra hɔn do wɔ bakandua no ne tsentsendo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ, sɛ etse nantsew ndze wɔ bakandua no etsifi a, ɔno fir edzi kɔko: osiandɛ Nyankopɔn efir edzi dzi w’enyim dɛ orukoku Filistiafo dɔm no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no: na wokunkum Filistiafo dɔm no fi Gibeon araa dze kodur Gezer.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David ne nka tahyee asaase nyinara do; na EWURADZE maa no ho suro baa amanaman nyinara do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David sisii adan maa noho wɔ David kurow mu; na osiesiee bea bi maa Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no, na ɔbɔɔ asese bi maa no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna David see dɛ, Obiara nnyi ho kwan dɛ ɔsoa Nyankopɔn adakaa no gyedɛ Levifo no ara nko: osiandɛ hɔn na EWURADZE asan mu eyi hɔn dɛ wɔnsoa Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no, na wɔnsom no daa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David poon Israel nyinara behyiaa Jerusalɛm, dɛ wɔrekɛfa EWURADZE n’adakaa no aba ne sibew a oesiesie ama no no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David boaa Aaronmba, na Levifo no ano:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Kohatmba no mu; otsitsir Uriel, na no nuanom ɔha eduonu:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Merarimba mu; otsitsir Asaia, na no nuanom ahaenu eduonu:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Gersonmba mu; otsitsir Joel, na no nuanom ɔha eduasa:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Elizafanmba mu; otsitsir Semaia, na no nuanom ahaenu:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hebronmba mu; otsitsir Eliel, na no nuanom eduowɔtwe:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Uzielmba mu; otsitsir Amminadab, na no nuanom ɔha nye duebien.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David kɛfrɛɛ asɔfo Zadok na Abiathar, na Levifo no, Uriel, Asaia, na Joel, Semaia, Eliel, na Amminadab,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nye Levifo mu egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir: hom ntsew homho, hom na hom nuanom nyina, na hom dze EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, n’adakaa no aba ne sibew a mesiesie ama no no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na osiandɛ nkan no hom annsoa ntsi, EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn bui faa hɛn do, dɛ yɛannhwehwɛ no dɛ mbrɛ n’amambra no tse.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna asɔfo na Levifo no tseew hɔnho dɛ wɔrekɛfa EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, n’adakaa no aba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Levifo mba no soaa Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no wɔ hɔn kɔn ho, wɔdze no ho mpoma no, dɛ mbrɛ Moses nam EWURADZE n’asɛm no do hyɛe no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David kaa kyerɛɛ Levifo safohen no dɛ wonyi hɔn nuanom no adwontofo a wɔdzedze asanku ndzɛmba, bɛnta asanku na nsankutsen na nkasaa a wɔma ɔgyegye kɛse na wɔma ndze do enyigye mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna Levifo no yii Joel ne ba Heman; na no nuanom mu, Berekia ne ba Asaf; na hɔn nuanom Merari ne mba no mu, Kusaia ne ba Etan;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na hɔn nuanom a wodzi hɔn ekyir no ka hɔn ho, Zekaria, na Jaaziel, na Semiramot, na Jehiel, na Unni, Eliab, na Benaia na Maaseia, na Mattitia, na Elifelehu, na Mikneia, na Obed-edom, na Jeiel, mbobowano ahwɛfo no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna woyii adwontofo no, Heman, Asaf, na Etan, dɛ wɔmfa boran nkasaa nwosow ma wɔntse nka;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Zekaria, Aziel, Semiramot, Jehiel, Unni, na Eliab, na Maaseia, na Benaia, dɛ wɔmfa bɛnta asanku mbɔ no wɔ Alamot do;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Mattitia, na Elifelehu, na Mikneia, na Obed-edom, na Jeiel, na Azazia, wɔbɔ nsankutsen wɔ Seminit do, dze kyerɛ kwan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Kenania, Levifo safohen no, ɔhwɛ ndwom no do: ɔno na ɔkyerɛkyerɛe wɔ ndwom no ho, osiandɛ ɔyɛ onyansafo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Berekia na Elkana wɔyɛ adaka no mbobowano ahwɛfo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Sebania, na Josafat, na Netanel, na Amasai, na Zekaria, na Benaia, na Eliezer, asɔfo no, nna wɔhɛn mbɛn wɔ Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no enyim: na Obed-edom na Jehia nna wɔyɛ adaka no mbobowano ahwɛfo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna David, na Israel mpanyimfo, na apem apem do asafohemfo no, dze enyigye sii mu kɔr dɛ wɔrekɛfa EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no efi Obed-edom fie aba:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Nyankopɔn boaa Levifo a wɔso EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no no, wɔdze anantwisaa esuon na nguannyin esuon bɔɔ afɔr.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David hyɛɛ ndwera fɛɛfɛw bataker, na Levifo a wɔso adaka no nyinara, na adwontofo no, na Kenania ndwom kyerɛkyerɛfo a ɔka adwontofo no ho no: nna ndwera asɔfontar gu David no ho.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm na Israel nyinara wɔdze esebɔ, mbɛnhɛn, totorobɛnto, nye nkasaa a ɔgyegye kɛse nye bɛnta asanku na nsankutsen, dze EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no bae.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no dur David kurow mu no, Saul ne babaa Mikal hwɛɛ tokura mu, na ohun ɔhen David dɛ ɔresaw na ɔrogor; na obuu no enyimtsia wɔ n’akoma mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze Nyankopɔn adakaa no bae, na wɔdze besii asese a David abɔ ama no no ne finimfin: na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr na asomdwee afɔr wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a David wiee ɔhyew afɔr na asomdwee afɔr bɔ no, ɔdze EWURADZE ne dzin hyiraa ɔman no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔkyɛɛ Israelnyi biara adze, ɔbarimba na ɔbaa nyina, ɔmaa obiara paanoo ntɔwmu, na nankum, na esikyireamba a wɔabɔ no etɔw.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na oyii Levifo no bi sisii hɔ dɛ wɔnsom wɔ EWURADZE n’adakaa no enyim, na wɔnkamfo EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na wɔnda no ase na wonyi no ayɛw:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Asaf nye otsitsir, na Zekaria dzi no do hɔ, Jeiel, na Semiramot, na Jehiel, na Mattitia, na Eliab, na Benaia, na Obed-edom, na Jeiel, wɔdzedze bɛnta asanku ɔnye nsankutsen; na Asaf dze akasaa a ɔgyegye kɛse:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Benaia na Jahaziel asɔfo no a wɔhɛn ntotorobɛnto daa, wɔ Nyankopɔn n’ahyɛmudaka no enyim.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Da no ara na David dzii kan hyehyɛɛ dɛ wondua Asaf na no nuanom nsa do nda EWURADZE ase.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hom mfa ndaase mma EWURADZE, hom mbɔ ne dzin; Hom mma wonhu ne nyɛe wɔ aman mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hom ntow ndwom mma no, hom ntow ayɛyindwom mma no; Hom nka n’anwanwa dwuma nyinara ho asɛm.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hom nhyehyɛ homho wɔ ne dzin krɔnkrɔn no mu: Wɔmma hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE hɔn akoma ntɔ mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hom nhwehwɛ EWURADZE na n’ahoɔdzen; Hom mbra n’enyim daa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hom nkaa n’anwanwa dwuma a ɔayɛ; N’ahobowdze, na n’ano atsɛmbusɛm;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hom n’akowaa Israel asefo, Hom Jakobmba a wɔasan mu eyi hom.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ɔno nye EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn; N’atsɛmbusɛm wɔ asaase nyinara do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hom nkaa n’ahyɛmu no daa, Asɛm a ɔhyɛe maa mbasantsen apem no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ahyɛmu a ɔnye Abraham dzii no, Na ne ntam a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ Isaak no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na osii no pi maa Jakob dɛ ahyɛdze, Ɔdze maa Israel dɛ daa ahyɛmu no:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Dɛ, Ɔwo na medze Keenan asaase mebɛma wo, Hom tontotwe no do egyapadze nye no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Aber a hom nyimpadodow ano nndɔɔ so; Nyew, wosuar koraa, na wɔyɛ amamforafo wɔ mu no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wokyinkyinii fi ɔman mu kɔr ɔman mu, Na wofii ahenman kor mu kɔr ɔman kor so mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ɔamma nyimpa bi kwan ma ɔannyɛ hɔn bɔn; Nyew, otwuuw ahemfo enyim wɔ hɔn ntsi;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Dɛ, Mma hom nka hɔn a masera hɔn, Na mma hom nnyɛ mo nkɔnhyɛfo bɔn bi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Asaase nyinara, hom ntow ndwom mma EWURADZE; Hom nkyerɛ no nkwagye mfi da nto da.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hom nka n’enyimnyam wɔ amanaman mu, N’anwanwa dwuma wɔ aman nyinara mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE yɛ kɛse, na ɔsɛ dɛ woyi no ayɛw dɛ: Ɔno so na ɔsɛ dɛ wosuro no sen enyame nyinara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aman enyame nyinara yɛ abosom: Na EWURADZE na ɔyɛɛ ɔsor.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Enyidzi na tumdzi wɔ n’enyim: Ahoɔdzen na enyika wɔ ne tsenabew.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Aman mbusuakuw, hom mma EWURADZE, Hom mma EWURADZE enyimnyam na ahoɔdzen.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hom mma EWURADZE enyimnyam a ɔsɛ ne dzin: Hom mfa ayɛyɛdze mbra, na hom mbra n’enyim: Hom nsɔr EWURADZE wɔ krɔnkrɔnyɛ ahoɔfɛw mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Asaase nyinara, hom ho mpopo wɔ n’enyim: Wiadze so woetsim no dɛ wohim no a ɔnnkɛyɛ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Wɔmma ɔsor enyi ngye, na asaase ho nsɛpɛw no: Na wɔnka no wɔ amanaman mu dɛ, EWURADZE dzi hen.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Wɔmma po, na ne mayɛ nwor; Wɔmma haban, na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara ndzi ehurusi;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna kwaa mu ndua nyinara bɔtow ahosɛpɛw ndwom wɔ EWURADZE enyim, Na ɔreba ebobu asaase atsɛn.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hom mfa ndaase mma EWURADZE; na oye: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hom nse dɛ, Gye hɛn nkwa, hɛn nkwagye Nyankopɔn, Na boaboa hɛn ano na yi hɛn fi amanaman mu, Na yɛnda wo dzin krɔnkrɔn no ase, Na yɛntenan wɔ w’ayɛyi mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, Mfi daapem nkesi daapem. Na ɔman no nyinara see dɛ, Amen, na woyii EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna ogyaa Asaf na no nuanom hɔ, wɔ EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no enyim, dɛ wɔnsom wɔ adaka no enyim daa, dɛ mbrɛ da biara no mu edwuma gye:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Obed-edom nye hɔn nuanom, yɛ eduosia awɔtwe: Jedutun ne ba Obed-edom so na Hosa dɛ wɔnyɛ mbobowano ahwɛfo:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na ogyaa ɔsɔfo Zadok, na no nuanom asɔfo no, wɔ EWURADZE ntamadan no enyim wɔ bea sorɔnsorɔm a ɔwɔ Gibeon no mu,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dɛ wɔmbɔ ɔhyew afɔr mma EWURADZE wɔ ɔhyew afɔrmbukyia no do daa anapa na ewimbir, mekyerɛ dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ EWURADZE ne mbra a ɔhyɛɛ Israel no mu nyinara tse;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Heman na Jedutun ka hɔn ho, na nkaa a wɔsaan mu yii hɔn a wɔbobɔɔ hɔn dzin, dɛ wɔmfa ndaase mma EWURADZE, osiandɛ n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Heman na Jedutun ka hɔn ho dze ntotorobɛnto na nkasaa a ɔgyegye kɛse, na ɔnye Nyankopɔn ndwom ho ndzɛmba: na Jedutun mba dɛ wɔnhwɛ kuropon ano.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔman no nyinara sii mu kɔree, nyimpa biara kɔr ne fie: na David sanee kɔr dɛ orikehyira ne fi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a David tsenaa fie no, nna David see nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan dɛ, Hwɛ, emi metse nkyindur dua ofi mu, na EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no dze, osi atam ase.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Natan see David dɛ, Yɛ dza ɔwɔ w’akoma mu nyinara; na Nyankopɔn dzi w’ekyir.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ anadwe no ara nna Nyankopɔn n’asɛm baa Natan hɔ, dɛ,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Kɔ na kɛka kyerɛ m’akowaa David dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mma ɔwo nnsi ofi mma me ma menntsena mu:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: osiandɛ ofitsi da a miyii Israel bae araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi, menntsenaa ofi bi mu da; mbom mifi asese mu kɔ asese mu, na mifi ntamadan kor mu kɔ kor so mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Mbeambea nyinara a menye Israel anantsew no do, ana menye Israel atsɛmbuafo a mehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnyɛn me man no mu bi kaa asɛm bi, dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom nnsi me nkyindur dua ofi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi afei mbrɛ ka kyerɛ m’akowaa David nye yi, dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, Emi na miyii wo fii nguamban mu, fii nguan ekyir dzi, ama aabɛyɛ ɔpanyin wɔ me man Israel do;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na medzi w’ekyir wɔ beebiara mbrɛ ekɔree, na metwitwa w’atamfo nyinara efi w’enyim; na mebɛma enya dzin, dɛ asaase do akɛsefo hɔn dzin.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na mibesiesie beebi ama me man Israel, na matsɛw hɔn, na wɔaatsena hɔnankasa hɔn tsenabew, na woeenntutu hɔn bio, dɛ nkan no,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na dɛ ofi da a mehyɛɛ atsɛmbuafo dɛ wɔnhwɛ me man Israel do no; na mebrɛɛ w’atamfo nyinara adze. Nkyii so EWURADZE ka kyerɛ wo dɛ EWURADZE na ɔbɛkyekyer ofie ama wo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wo nda so dɛ ebɔkɔ w’egyanom nkyɛn a, medze w’asenyi a obedzi w’ekyir no a obefi wo mba mu no, besi hɔ; na mama n’ahendzi etsim.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ɔno na obesi ofi ama me, na mebɛma n’ahendzi etsim hɔ daa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Emi na mebɛyɛ n’egya, na ɔno ɔayɛ me ba: na mirinnyi mo mbɔbɔrhu mmfi no ho, dɛ mbrɛ miyii fii nyia odzi w’enyim no ho no:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na medze no besi me fi na m’ahendzi mu daa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Dɛ mbrɛ nsɛm yi nyinara tse, na mbrɛ enyido adzehu yi nyinara tse no, dɛmara so na Natan kaa kyerɛɛ David.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen David sii mu kɔree, na ɔkɛtsenaa EWURADZE enyim; na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye woana, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, na me fi nye bɛn, na edze me aba ebodu ha yi?
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Nyankopɔn, iyi yɛ w’enyi do adze ketseaba; na ɔwo EWURADZE Nyankopɔn dze aka w’akowaa ne fi ho asɛm dze ama mber tsentsen bi a ɔreba, na ebu me dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa bi a ɔkrɔn ne dzibew tse.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David botum ase wo dɛn bio wɔ enyidzi a wɔdze edzi w’akowaa ho? Osiandɛ ɔwoara inyim w’akowaa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: EWURADZE, osian w’akowaa ntsi, na dɛ mbrɛ wankasa w’akoma tse no, nna ayɛ adze kɛse yi nyinara, dɛ erema woehu ndzɛmba akɛse yi nyinara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: EWURADZE, obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, nkyii so Nyame biara nnyi hɔ ka wo ho, dɛ mbrɛ dza yɛdze hɛn aso atse no nyinara tse no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔman kor bɛn na ɔwɔ asaase do a ɔtse dɛ wo man Israel a Nyankopɔn sii mu kɔree kɔpoon hɔn dze yɛɛ ɔman maa noho dɛ edze ndzɛmba akɛse a ɔyɛ hu agye dzin, dɛ etutu amanaman efi wo man a epoon hɔn fii Egypt no enyim?
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wo man Israel na eyɛɛ hɔn wankasa wo man daa; na ɔwo EWURADZE bɛyɛɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na afei, EWURADZE, ma asɛm a aka wɔ w’akowaa ho, na ne fi ho no, ntsim hɔ daa, na yɛ dɛ mbrɛ aka no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ma wo dzin ntsim na wonhuhor no daa dɛ, Dɔm EWURADZE nye Israel Nyankopɔn, mekyerɛ Israel Nyankopɔn a: na w’akowaa David fi etsim wɔ w’enyim.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔwoara me Nyankopɔn, na ada no edzi akyerɛ w’akowaa dɛ ibesi no ofi: dɛm ntsi na w’akowaa ehu no wɔ n’akoma mu dɛ ɔbɔ w’enyim mpaa yi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na afei, EWURADZE, ɔwoara nye Nyankopɔn, na edze papa yi abɔ w’akowaa anohoba:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na afei ayɛ wo fɛw dɛ ibehyira w’akowaa ne fi, ama ɔaako w’enyim daa: na ɔwo, EWURADZE, ehyira yi dze, na woehyira no daa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na iyi ekyir no ɔbaa dɛ David kaa Filistiafo no gya, na ɔbrɛɛ hɔn adze, na ɔgyee Gat na no nkurobaase wɔ Filistiafo nsamu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ɔkaa Moab so gya, na Moabfo no bɛyɛɛ nkowaa maa David, na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze bae.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David kaa Zobahen Hadadezer gya dze kodur Hamat, aber a osii mu kɔr dɛ oriketsintsim n’ahendzi wɔ esutsen Eufrates ho no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David gyee no hɔ ntseaseanam apem, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemesuon, na anamɔnmufo mpemeduonu: na David twitwaa ntseaseanam mpɔnkɔ nyinara hɔn anantsir ntsin na ogyaa hɔn mu ntseaseanam ɔha ho dze.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Damaskɔs Siriafo no baa dɛ wɔrobɔboa Zobahen Hadadezer no, David kum Siriafo no mu nyimpa mpemeduonu ebien.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David dze bansifo bɛtsenaa Damaskɔs Siria: na Siriafo no bɛyɛɛ nkowaa maa David, na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze bae. Na EWURADZE maa David konyimdzi wɔ beebiara a ɔkɔree.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David gyegyee sika akyɛm a ɔwowɔ Hadadezer no nkowaa ho no, na ɔdze baa Jerusalɛm.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Hadadezer no nkurow Tibhat na Kun mu, na David faa boran piigyan. Iyi na ekyir no Solomon dze yɛɛ boran po, na edum no, na boran ndzɛmba no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Hamathen Tou tsee dɛ David aka Zobahen Hadadezer no dɔm nyinara gya no,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: ɔsomaa ne ba Hadoram ma ɔbaa ɔhen David nkyɛn bekyiaa no, na ɔmaa no mbo dɛ ɔnye Hadadezer ako, na ɔaka no gya ntsi: osiandɛ Hadadezer nye Tou dzii ako. Na ɔdze sika na dwetɛ na boran ndzɛmba n’ahorow nyinara dɛ ayɛyɛdze kɛmaa no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Iyinom so ɔhen David tui sii nkyɛn maa EWURADZE dze kaa dwetɛ na sika a ɔkɔsoae fii amanaman nyinara mu no ho; ofi Edom, na Moab, na Ammonmba, na Filistiafo, na Amalek hɔ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ekyir no so Zeruia ne ba Abishai kum Edomfo mu nyimpa mpemduawɔtwe wɔ Nkyen Bɔnsa no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze bansifo tsenaa Edom, na Edomfo no nyinara bɛyɛɛ nkowaa maa David. Na EWURADZE maa David konyimdzi wɔ beebiara a ɔkɔree.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David dzii hen wɔ Israel nyinara do, na odzii atsɛmbu na tseneneesɛm maa ne man nyinara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Zeruia ba Joab na ɔhwɛ dɔm no do; na Ahilud ba Jehosafat nye ɔsɛnkaafo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Ahitub ba Zadok, na Abiathar ba Abimelek, nye asɔfo; na Savsia nye ɔkyerɛwfo;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Jehoiada ba Benaia na ɔhwɛ Keretfo na Peletfo no do; na David mba no na wɔyɛ etsitsir wɔ ɔhen no nkyɛn.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na iyi ekyir no ɔbaa dɛ Ammonmba hɔn hen Nahas wui, na ne ba bedzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David see dɛ, Mebɛyɛ Nahas ne ba Hanun ayamuyie, osiandɛ n’egya yɛɛ me ayamuyie. Nna David somaa abɔfo dɛ wɔnkɛkyekye no werɛ wɔ n’egya ntsi. Na David no nkowaa baa Hanun nkyɛn wɔ Ammonmba asaase no do, dɛ wɔrebɛkyekye no werɛ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna Ammonmba asafohemfo no see Hanun dɛ, Ana edwen dɛ David dzi w’egya nyi ntsi na ɔasoma awerɛkyekyefo wɔ wo nkyɛn yi? Ana no nkowaa yi ammba wo nkyɛn dɛ wɔrobɔhwehwɛ asaase yi, woebobutuw no, na wɔaserasera ahwɛ bi a?
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna Hanun faa David no nkowaa no, na oyiyii hɔn, na otwitwaa hɔn ntar mu finimfin finimfin araa dze bodur hɔn nserɛekyir, na ogyaa hɔn kwan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna obi sii mu kɔree, na ɔkɛkaa mbrɛ wɔdze yɛɛ mbarimba no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ David. Na ɔsomae ma wokehyiaa hɔn kwan; osiandɛ woegu mbarimba no enyim ase kɛse. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Hom ntsintsim wɔ Jeriko ma onkodu dɛ hom mbɔdwesa bofuw, ana nkyii hom asan aba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Ammonmba no hun dɛ hɔn ho abɔn David no, Hanun na Ammonmba no wɔdze dwetɛ talent apem somae ma wɔdze kɛgyee Mesopotemia, na Aram-maaka, na Zoba ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo dɔm.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna wɔgyee ntseaseanam mpemeduasa ebien, na Maakahen na ne man dɔm; hɔn a wɔbae bɛkyeer nsera wɔ Medeba enyim. Na Ammonmba no fifii hɔn nkurow mu poon hɔnho hyiae, na wɔbaa ɔsa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a David tsee no, nna ɔsomaa Joab, na mbarimba akatakyi dɔm no nyinara ma wɔkɔree.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Ammonmba no puei, na wɔbaabaa mpasuar wɔ kurow no mu kuropon ano: na ahemfo no a wɔbae no hɔnara nko na wɔtsenaa wɔ haban no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei aber a Joab hun dɛ ɔko no wɔ n’enyim na n’ekyir no, nna ɔpaa Israel mu mbarimba a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn nyinara mu bi, na ɔmaa wɔdanee kehyiaa Siriafo no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na nkorɔfo nkaa no ɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ no nua Abishai nsa, na wɔbaa hɔnho mu kɔr Ammonmba no do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ Siriafo no yɛ dzen dodow ma me a, ɔno bɔboa me: na sɛ Ammonmba no yɛ dzen dodow ma wo a, ɔno mo so mobɔboa wo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nya akokodur, na ma yɛnyɛ hɛnho mbarimba mma hɛn man, na hɛn Nyankopɔn no nkurow no: na EWURADZE nyɛ dza oye wɔ n’enyiwa do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna Joab na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no twee piin Siriafo no enyim dze kɔbɔɔ enyim; na Siriafo no guanee wɔ n’enyim.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Ammonmba no hun dɛ Siriafo no eguan no, nna hɔn so woguanee wɔ no nua Abishai enyim, na wɔkɛhɛɛn kurow no mu. Nna Joab baa Jerusalɛm.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Siriafo no hun dɛ woegu wɔ Israel enyim no, nna wɔsomaa abɔfo, ma wɔkɔpoon Siriafo a wɔwɔ Esutsen egya no bae, dɛ Hadadezer no dɔm safohen Sofak na odzi hɔn enyim.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ David; na ɔpoon Israel nyinara hyiae, na okotwaa Jordan, na ɔbaa hɔn do, na ɔbaa hɔn do mpasuar hyiaa hɔn. Dɛm ntsi aber a David baa mpasuar hyiaa Siriafo no, nna wɔnye no koe.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Siriafo no guanee wɔ Israel enyim, na David kunkum Siriafo mu ntseaseanammufo no mu mpemesuon, na anamɔnmufo no mu mpemeduanan, na okum dɔm safohen panyin Sofak.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Hadadezer no nkowaa no hun dɛ woegu wɔ Israel enyim no, wɔnye David siesiei, na wɔsoom no: nkyii so Siriafo no ammpɛ dɛ wɔboa Ammonmba no bio.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a n’afedan no durii no, aber a ahemfo wotu sa mu no, nna Joab dze dɔm no n’ahoɔdzen no kɔree kɛsɛɛ Ammonmba man no, na wokotuaa Rabaa. Na David dze, otsintsimii wɔ Jerusalɛm. Na Joab bɔɔ Rabaa, na obutuuw no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David yii hɔn hen n’ahenkyɛw no wɔ ne tsir, na ohun dɛ ɔtow sika talent, na no mu wɔ aboɔdzen abo; na wɔdze hyɛɛ David ne tsir: na ɔdze kurow no mu asadze piigyan mbordo puei bae.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ mu no puei bae, na ɔdze nseradaa, na dadze dɛtseporoweedze, na nkuma twitwaa hɔn. Na mbrɛ David dze yɛɛ Ammonmba nkurow no nyinara nye no. Na David na ɔman no nyinara sanee baa Jerusalɛm.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na iyi ekyir no ɔbaa dɛ Filistiafo no nyaa ɔko wɔ Gezer: nna Husatnyi Sibekai kum Sippai a ɔyɛ ɔkraban no ne mba no mu bi no: na wɔbrɛɛ hɔn adze.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔnye Filistiafo nyaa ɔko bio; na Jair ne ba Elhanan kum Gitinyi Goliat no nua Lahmi a ne peaa no kura tse dɛ ɔtanwemfo n’asadua.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔko baa bio wɔ Gat, mbrɛ ɔbarimba pankor bi a ne nsatseaba na n’anansɔba yɛ eduonu anan, nsakum kor do esia, na anansa kor do esia; na ɔno so ɔkraban woo no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a orutwitwa Israel mpowa no, David no nua Simea ne ba Jonatan kum no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom na wɔwoo hɔn maa ɔkraban no wɔ Gat; na wɔtotɔree wɔ David, na no nkowaa no hɔn nsaano.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Satan soɛree tsiaa Israel, na onuu David mu dɛ ɔnkɛkan Israel.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David see Joab na ɔman no mu asafohemfo no dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɛkan Israel mfi Beer-seba araa nkodu Dan na hom mbɛka nkyerɛ me, ma munhu hɔn dodow.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Joab see dɛ, EWURADZE nyɛ ne man dɛ mbrɛ wɔtse yi mpɛn ɔha so nka ho: na, mo wura ɔhen, ana hɔn nyinara nnyɛ mo wura no nkowaa bi a? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mo wura rohwehwɛ dɛm adze yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na iyi bɛyɛ asodzi ama Israel yi?
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Naaso nna otwar dɛ Joab yɛ dza ɔhen no ahyɛ no no. Dɛm ntsi Joab fii edzi na osii mu kekyinii faa Israel nyinara mu, na ɔbaa Jerusalɛm.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Joab dze ɔman no hɔn anobu no dodow no brɛɛ David. Na hɔn a wofi Israel mu nyinara wɔyɛ ɔpepe na mbarimba a wɔkɔ akono so mpem ɔha: na Juda yɛ mbarimba mpemahaanan eduosuon a wɔkɔ akono.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Levi na Benjamin dze, ɔannkan hɔn ammfora: osiandɛ nna ɔhen n’asɛm no yɛ Joab tan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Nyankopɔn ammpɛ dza David yɛe no; dɛm ntsi ɔbɔɔ Israel.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David see Nyankopɔn dɛ, Mayɛ bɔn kɛsenara, dɛ mayɛ dɛm adze yi: na afei, meserɛ wo, yi w’akowaa no bɔn kɔ; na mayɛ nkwaseadze dodow.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ Gad, David n’adzehunyi no, dɛ,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Kɔ na kɛka kyerɛ David dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ndzɛmba ebiasa na medze si w’enyim; fa no mu kor, na menyɛ mma wo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Gad baa David nkyɛn, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Fa mu dza epɛ;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dɛ mfe ebiasa ɔkɔm; anaa abosoom ebiasa a wɔbɛsɛɛ wo wɔ w’atamfo enyim aber a w’atamfo afona roto wo; anaaso EWURADZE n’afona, mekyerɛ asaase no do nyimpa ɔyardɔm, ndaansa a EWURADZE no bɔfoe dze bɛsɛɛ nyimpa wɔ Israel mbew nyinara do. Afei hwɛ mbuae kor ma memfa nsan nkɛma nyia ɔsomaa me no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David see Gad dɛ, Mo ho akyer me papaara: afei ma monhwe EWURADZE nsamu; na n’adɔyɛ dɔɔ so dodow: na mma monnhwe ɔdasanyi nsamu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna EWURADZE maa ɔyardɔm baa Israel do: na Israel mu nyimpa mpemeduosuon wuwui.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Nyankopɔn somaa ɔbɔfo ma ɔkɔr Jerusalɛm dɛ ɔnkɛsɛɛ no: na aber a ɔrebɛsɛɛ no, nna EWURADZE hwɛe, na ɔsesaa n’adwen wɔ hɔn ho, na ɔsee ɔbɔfo a ɔresɛɛ no dɛ, Ayɛ yie; afei gyina wo nsa. Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no gyinaa Jebusnyi Ornan n’ewuporowee no ho.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David maa n’enyiwa do, na ohun EWURADZE no bɔfoe no dɛ ogyina asaase na ɔsor ntamu, na afona a wɔatwe kitsa ne nsamu, na ɔatsen no wɔ Jerusalɛm do. Nna David na amampanyin no a wofurafura eyitam no, dze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David see Nyankopɔn dɛ, Ana nnyɛ mara na mehyɛɛ dɛ wɔnkan ɔman no? Mbom mara nye nyia ɔayɛ bɔn na ɔabɔ mbusu yi; na nguan yi dze, ebɛnadze na wɔayɛ? M’EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, meserɛ wo, ma wo nsa mbra emi, na m’egya fi do; na mma ɔmmba wo man do, ma wɔnnhaw.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna EWURADZE no bɔfoe no hyɛɛ Gad dɛ ɔnkɛse David dɛ ɔmfow nkɔ nkesi afɔrmbukyia mma EWURADZE wɔ Jebusnyi Ornan n’ewuporowee ho.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David fowee kɔree dɛ mbrɛ Gad n’asɛm a ɔkae no EWURADZE ne dzin mu no tse.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Ornan daan noho, na ohun ɔbɔfo no; na ne mbabanyin baanan a wɔka no ho no wɔdze hɔnho sumae. Nna Ornan roporow ewifua.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a David dur Ornan nkyɛn no, Ornan hwɛe na ohun David, na ofiir edzi fii ewuporowee ho, na ɔkotoow David na ɔdze n’enyim boom famu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna David see Ornan dɛ, Fa ewuporoweebea yi ma me, ma minsi do afɔrmbukyia memma EWURADZE: no bo a odzi no ara pɛr na fa ma me: ama woeesianka ɔyardɔm no efi ɔman no do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Ornan see David dɛ, Gye fa, na ma mo wura ɔhen nyɛ dza oye wɔ n’enyiwa do: hwɛ, mema wo anantwi a wɔdze bɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr, na ɔporow ndadze a wɔdze bɛpaa nyena, na ewifua a wɔdze bɛyɛ edziban afɔr: medze ne nyina mema.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen David see Ornan dɛ, Oho; na ɔtɔ ara na mebɛma bo a ɔfata dze atɔ: osiandɛ mennkɛfa adze a ɔyɛ wodze ama EWURADZE, afei so mennkɛfa adze a annsom me bo biara abɔ ɔhyew afɔr.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna David maa Ornan sika a woeker dwetɛbona ahaesia dze tɔɔ bea no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David sii afɔrmbukyia wɔ hɔ maa EWURADZE, na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr na asomdwee afɔr, na ɔsɔɔr EWURADZE; na ɔdze gya fi sor gyee no do wɔ ɔhyew afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE hyɛɛ ɔbɔfo no; na ɔdze n’afona no sanee hyɛɛ bɔha no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David hun dɛ EWURADZE agye no do wɔ Jebusnyi Ornan ewuporowee hɔ, nna ɔbɔɔ afɔr wɔ hɔ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna EWURADZE ne ntamadan a Moses yɛe no wɔ sar no do, na ɔhyew afɔr mbukyia no so wɔ sorɔnsorɔmbea a ɔwɔ Gibeon no aber no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Naaso David enntum annkɔ ɔno n’enyim ennkebisa Nyankopɔn: osiandɛ osuroi wɔ EWURADZE no bɔfoe afona no ntsi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna David see dɛ, Iyi nye EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ne fi no, na iyi nye Israel ɔhyew afɔrmbukyia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David hyɛe ma wɔkɔboaboaa ahɔho a wɔwɔ Israel no ano; na osisii abo edwimfo dɛ wɔmpaa abo a wɔasen mfa nsi Nyankopɔn ne fi no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David siesiee dadze piigyan a wɔmfa mbɔ mbobotsenano apon ho mprɛgow, na nkrɔkrɔw no; na boran piigyan a onnyi nkerii;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na nkyindur ndua a onnyi anobu: na Zidonfo na Traefo dze nkyindur ndua piigyan brɛɛ David.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David see dɛ, Me ba Solomon yɛ abofra a ɔyɛ mberɛw, na ofi a wobesi ama EWURADZE no ɔnyɛ kɛse paara, ɔnyɛ dzin na enyimnyam wɔ asaase nyinara do: dɛm ntsi mebɛyɛ ahosiesie ama no. Nna David yɛɛ ahoboa piinara ana oruwu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔfrɛɛ ne ba Solomon, na ɔhyɛɛ no dɛ onsi ofi mma EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David see ne ba Solomon dɛ, Emi dze, ɔwɔ m’akoma mu dɛ nkyɛ mibesi ofi ama EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn ne dzin.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ dɛ, Ɔwo aka bɔgya egu dodow, na edzi ako akɛse: mma ɔwo nnsi ofi mma me dzin, osiandɛ ɔwo aka bɔgya pii egu famu wɔ m’enyim:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: hwɛ, wɔbɔwo ɔbarimba ama wo, ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ ahomgye nyimpa; na mebɛma no ahomgye efi n’atamfo nyinara ho ehyia: na wɔbɛfrɛ ne dzin Solomon, na medze asomdwee na kommyɛ mebɛma Israel wɔ ne nda mu:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: ɔno na obesi ofi ama me dzin; na ɔbɛyɛ me ɔba, na emi so mayɛ no egya; na mebɛma n’ahendzi egua no etsim wɔ Israel do daa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei, me ba, EWURADZE ndzi w’ekyir; na yɛ prɔmprɔm, na si EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne fi no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔaka wɔ wo ho no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Adwenmutsewee na ntseasee ara na EWURADZE mfa mma wo, na ɔnhyɛ wo Israel ho mbra; ma ɔnam dɛm do eedzi EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne mbra do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ɔno na ebɛyɛ prɔmprɔm, sɛ idzi ahyɛdze na mbra a EWURADZE dze hyɛɛ Moses wɔ Israel ho no do a: hyɛ dzen, na nya akokodur; mma nnsuro, eso mma wo w’akoma nntu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei, hwɛ, m’ahohia mu na mesiesie EWURADZE ne fi ho sika talent mpemɔha, na dwetɛ talent ɔpepem; na boran na dadze a wonnyi nkerii; na ɔdɔɔ so piigyan: ndua na abo so mesiesie; na ɔwoara edze bi aaka ho.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so edwimfo piigyan wɔ wo nkyɛn, abopaafo na abo na ndua edwimfo, na nkorɔfo a wɔawea edwuma nyinara ho nyinara;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: sika, dwetɛ, boran, na dadze no, wonnkotum kan; soɛr na yɛ, na EWURADZE ndzi w’ekyir.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: David hyɛɛ Israel asafohen no so dɛ wɔmboa ne ba Solomon, dɛ,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Aso nnyɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn na odzi hom ekyir? Ana ɔmmaa hom ahomgye wɔ hom ho nyinara nnhyiae bi a? Osiandɛ ɔdze asaase no do atsefo no ahyɛ me nsa; na wɔabrɛ asaase no adze wɔ EWURADZE na ne man enyim.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei hom mfa hom akoma na hom adwen mma dɛ hom bɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn no n’ekyir kwan. Hom nsoɛr nkesi EWURADZE Nyankopɔn no krɔnkrɔnbea no, dɛ wɔdze EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no, na Nyankopɔn ne ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn bɛba ofi a wobesi ama EWURADZE ne dzin no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David dzii mfe pii na ɔyɛɛ akɔdaa no; ɔdze ne ba Solomon sii Israel do hen.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔboaa Israel asafohen nyinara, ɔnye asɔfo na Levifo no ano hyiae.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES
