text: Na wɔkaan Levifo no, hɔn a woedzi mfe eduasa na ekyir no: na hɔn dodow dɛ mbrɛ wosi a wɔyɛ mbarimba ara nko yɛ mpem eduasa awɔtwe.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom mu mpemeduonu anan na wɔnhwɛ EWURADZE fie edwuma no do; na mpemesia nyɛ akyerɛwfo na atsɛmbuafo:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na mpemanan nyɛ abowanoahwɛfo; na mpemanan mfa ndzɛmba a, David kaa dɛ ɔyɛe maa ayɛyi no nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David kyekyɛɛ hɔn mu ebupɛn ebupɛn dɛ mbrɛ Levi mba tse; Gerson, Kohat, na Merari.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Gersonfo dze Ladan na Simei.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ladanmba otsitsir Jehiel, Zetam, na Joel, wɔyɛ baasa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Simeimba; Selomot, Haziel, na Haran, wɔyɛ baasa. Woyinom nye Ladan egyanom etsitsir.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Simeimba; Jahat, Zina, na Jeus, na Beria. Baanan yinom nye Simeimba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Jahat nye otsitsir, na Ziza tsia hɔ: na Jeus na Beria ennya mba pii; dɛm ntsi wɔbɛyɛɛ egyanom fi kor wɔ nkanee kor mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Kohat ne mba; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, na Uziel, baanan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Amram ne mba; Aaron na Moses: na woyii Aaron sii nkyɛn, dɛ ɔntsew akrɔnkrɔndze no ho, ɔno na ne mba, nkesi daa, dɛ wɔnhyew eduhuam wɔ EWURADZE enyim, na wɔnsom no, na wonhyira wɔ ne dzin mu, nkesi daa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Moses, Nyame nyimpa no dze, wɔbɔɔ ne mba no edzin foraa Levi ebusuakuw no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Moses ne mba; Gersom na Eliezer.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Gersom ne mba; Sebuel otsitsir.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Eliezer ne mba, Rehabia otsitsir. Na Eliezer ennya mba bi so bio; na Rehabia mba na wɔdɔɔ so dodow.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Izhar ne mba; Selomit otsitsir.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hebron ne mba; Jeria otsitsir, Amaria tsia hɔ, Jahaziel tsia ebiasa, na Jekameam tsia anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Uziel ne mba; Mika otsitsir, na Ishia tsia hɔ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Merari ne mba; Mahili na Mushi. Mahili ne mba; Eleazar na Kish.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Eleazar wui, na oennya mbabanyin, dɛ mbabaa ara nko: na hɔn nuanom Kish mbabanyin no warwaar hɔn.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Mushi ne mba; Mahili, Eder, na Jeremot, baasa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nye Levimba no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tse, mekyerɛ egyanom mu etsitsir mu hɔn a wɔkan hɔn a wɔyɛ EWURADZE fie ɔsom edwuma no a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David see dɛ, EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ama ne man asomdwee; na ɔtse Jerusalɛm afebɔɔ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na eso onnkehia ama Levifo no dɛ wɔsoa ntamadan no na no som ho ndzɛmba no nyina bio.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔnam David ne nsɛm a odzi ekyir no do kaan Levimba no hɔn dodow, ofitsi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn gyinabew wɔ Aaronmba no enyim dɛ wɔyɛ EWURADZE fie ɔsom edwuma no, wɔ abanguado, na mpia mu, na wɔtsew akrɔnkrɔndze nyinara ho, mekyerɛ EWURADZE fie ɔsom edwuma no;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na kyerɛpaanoo no so, na edziban afɔr epitsi ntatar dze, anaa dza wɔakyew no wɔ sɛn mu, anaa dza wɔafɔw, na etwadze na esusudze nyinara;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na wongyina hɔ anapa daa wɔnda EWURADZE ase wonyi no ayɛw, na ewimbir so dɛmara;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na wɔmbɔ ɔhyew afɔr nyina mma EWURADZE, wɔ ahomgyenda mu, na abosoom fofor mu, na afahyɛ mu, no dodow mu dɛ mbrɛ atɔrmuadze tse daa nyina wɔ EWURADZE enyim:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na dɛ wɔnhwɛ ehyiadzi ntamadan ahwɛdze, na krɔnkrɔnbea ahwɛdze, na hɔn nuanom Aaronmba ahwɛdze no mfa nsom EWURADZE ne fi no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Aaronmba no hɔn mu nkyekyɛmu nye yinom. Aaron ne mba; Nadab na Abihu, Eleazar na Itamar.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Nadab na Abihu dzii hɔn egya enyim wuwui, na woennya mba: dɛm ntsi Eleazar na Itamar bedzii asɔfo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David kyekyɛɛ hɔn mu, mekyerɛ Zadok a ofi Eleazarmba mu, na Ahimelek a ofi Itamarmba mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn edwumayɛ dzibew tse wɔ hɔn som no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wohun Eleazarmba mu mbarimba etsitsir pii seen Itamarmba mu, na wɔkyekyɛɛ hɔn mu: Eleazarmba nyaa egyanom efi etsitsir duesia, na Itamarmba, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn efi tsetsee, awɔtwe.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm na wosii dze tonto kyekyɛɛ hɔn mu, yinom nye yinom; na krɔnkrɔnbea asafohen na Nyankopɔn n’asafohen no nyina fi Eleazarmba mu, na Itamarmba mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔkyerɛwfo Netanel a ofi Levifo mu no ne ba Semaia kyerɛɛw hɔn wɔ ɔhen, na asafohen, na ɔsɔfo Zadok, na Abiathar ba Ahimelek, na asɔfo na Levifo egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no enyim: woyii egyanom fi kor maa Eleazar, na woyii kor so maa Itamar.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei kyɛfa a odzi kan no bae maa Jehoiarib, dza otsia ebien no bae maa Jedaia;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia ebiasa no bae maa Harim, dza otsia anan no bae maa Seorim;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia enum no bae maa Malkija, dza otsia esia no bae maa Mijamin;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia esuon no bae maa Hakoz, dza otsia awɔtwe no bae maa Abija;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia akron no bae maa Jesua, dza otsia du no bae maa Sekania;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia dubiako no bae maa Eliasib, dza otsia duebien no bae maa Jakim;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: duebiasa no bae maa Huppa, dza otsia duanan no bae maa Jesebeab;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia duenum no bae maa Bilga, dza otsia duesia no bae maa Immer;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: duesuon no bae maa Hezir, duawɔtwe no bae maa Hap-pizez;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia duakron no bae maa Petahia, eduonu no bae maa Jehezkel;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia eduonu biako no bae maa Jakin, dza otsia eduonu ebien no bae maa Gamul;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia eduonu ebiasa no bae maa Delaia, na dza otsia eduonu anan no bae maa Maazia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Iyi nye hɔn edwumayɛ dzibew wɔ hɔn som no mu, dɛ wɔnhɛn EWURADZE fie dɛ mbrɛ atɔrmuadze a wɔnam hɔn egya Aaron nsa do dze maa hɔn no tse, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, hyɛɛ no no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Levimba nkaa no dze: Amram mba dze, Subael; Subael mba dze, Jehseia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Rehabia dze; Rehabia mba dze, Ishia otsitsir no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Izharfo dze, Selomot; Selomot mba dze, Jahat.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Hebron ne mba; Jeria otsitsir, Amaria tsia hɔ, Jahaziel tsia ebiasa, Jekameam tsia anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Uziel ne mba, Mika; Mika mba dze, Samir.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Mika no nua, Ishia: Ishia mba dze, Zekaria.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Merari ne mba; Mahili na Mushi: Jaazia ne mba; Beno.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Merari ne mba; Jaazia dze, Beno, na Soham, na Zakur, na Ibri.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Mahili dze; Eleazar, ɔno oennya mba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Kish dze; Kish ne mba, Jerameel.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Mushi ne mba; Mahili, Eder, na Jerimot. Woyinom nye Levifo mba dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom so twee tonto dɛ hɔn nuanom Aaronmba no ara wɔ ɔhen David, na Zadok na Ahimelek, na asɔfo no na Levifo egyanom efi mu etsitsir no enyim; otsitsir no n’egyanom efi dɛ no nua kuma no dze no ara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so David na dɔm no asafohen no yiyii Asaf, na Heman, na Jedutun mba no mu hɔn a wɔnsom mfa nsankutsen, na mbɛntasanku, na akasamu nhyɛ nkɔm: na hɔn a wɔyɛɛ edwuma dɛ mbrɛ hɔn som tse no hɔn dodow nye yi:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Asaf mba mu; Zakur, na Josef, na Netania, na Asharela, Asaf ne mba a wɔwɔ Asaf ne nsaano, hɔn a wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm wɔ ɔhen no n’aber do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Jedutun dze: Jedutun ne mba; Gedalia, na Zeri, na Jesaia, Hasabia na Mattitia, beesia; hɔn a wɔwɔ hɔn egya Jedutun ne nsamu, wɔdze nsankutsen hyɛɛ nkɔm wɔdze ndaase na ayɛyi maa EWURADZE.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Heman dze: Heman ne mba; Bukkia, Mattania, Uziel, Sebuel, na Jerimot, Hanania, Hanani, Eliata, Giddalti, na Romamti-ezer, Josbekasa, Malloti, Hotir na Mahaziot:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: woyinom nyinara nye Heman ne mba, ɔno nye ɔhen n’adzehunyi no, dɛ ɔmfa Nyankopɔn ne nsɛm mu mma abɛn do. Na Nyankopɔn maa Heman mbabanyin duanan na mbabaa baasa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nyinara wɔ hɔn egya ne nsamu, wɔ EWURADZE fie adwontow no mu, dzedze nkasaa, mbɛntasanku, na nsankutsen som Nyankopɔn fie; Asaf, Jedutun, na Heman wɔwɔ ɔhen no ne nsamu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔnye hɔn nuanom a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ hɔn EWURADZE fie adwontow no, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ ho enyansafo no nyinara hɔn dodow yɛ ahaenu eduowɔtwe awɔtwe.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔtwee hɔn ɔhwɛdwuma no ho tonto, hɔn nyinara pɛr, ekumaba dɛ ɔkɛse, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo dɛ osuanyi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei kyɛfa a odzi kan a ɔyɛ Asaf dze no bae maa Josef: dza otsia ebien no bae maa Gedalia; ɔno na no nuanom na ne mba wɔyɛ duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia ebiasa no bae maa Zakur, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia anan no bae maa Izri, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia enum no bae maa Netania, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia esia bae maa Bukkia, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia esuon no bae maa Jesarela, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia awɔtwe no bae maa Jesaia, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia akron no bae maa Mattania, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia du no bae maa Simei, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia dubiako no bae maa Azarel, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia duebien no bae maa Hasabia, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia duebiasa no bae maa Subael, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia duanan no bae maa Mattitia, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia duenum no bae maa Jeremot, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia duesia no bae maa Hanania, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia duesuon no bae maa Josbekasa, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia duawɔtwe no bae maa Hanani, ne mba na no nuanom duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia duakron no bae maa Malloti, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia eduonu no bae maa Eliata, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia eduonu biako no bae maa Hotir, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia eduonu ebien no bae maa Giddalti, ne mba na no nuanom duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: dza otsia eduonu ebiasa no bae maa Mahaziot, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na dza otsia eduonu anan no bae maa Romamti-ezer, ne mba na no nuanom, duebien.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Abowanohwɛfo no mu nkyekyɛmu nye yi: Korafo no mu; Kore ba Meselemia a ofi Asaf mba mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Meselemia nyaa mba; Zekaria n’abakan, Jediael tsia hɔ, Zebadia tsia ebiasa, Jatniel tsia anan:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Elam tsia enum, Jehohanan tsia esia, Eliehoenai tsia esuon.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Obed-edom nyaa mbabanyin baawɔtwe. Hɔn awoo ndzidzido ofi abakan do kesi kaaekyir do nye iyi: Semaia, Jehozabad, Joa, Sakar, Netanel,
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ammiel, Isakar, na Peulletai: na Nyankopɔn hyiraa no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ne ba Semaia so wɔwoo mba maa no a wɔhwɛɛ hɔn egya fie do: na wɔyɛ mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Semaia ne mba; Otni, na Rafael, na Obed, Elzabad, no nuanom wɔyɛ mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam, Elihu, na Semakia.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nyinara fi Obed-edom ne mba mu: wɔnye hɔn mba na hɔn nuanom, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔwɔ ɔsom mu ahoɔdzen; eduosia ebien a wɔyɛ Obed-edom dze.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Meselemia nyaa mba na enuanom, mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam duawɔtwe.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hosa a ofi Merarimba mu no so nyaa mba; Simri otsitsir, (ɔnnyɛ abakan dze, naaso n’egya yɛɛ no otsitsir;)
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hilkia tsia hɔ, Tebalia tsia ebiasa, Zekaria tsia anan: Hosa ne mba na no nuanom nyinara wɔyɛ duebiasa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nye abowanoahwɛfo no hɔn nkyekyɛmu, mbrɛ mbarimba etsitsir no tsetsee; wɔwɔ ɔweɔn edwuma dɛ hɔn nuanom no ara so, dɛ wɔnsom wɔ EWURADZE fie.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔtwee tonto, ekumaba tse dɛ ɔkɛse, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee, wɔ kuropon biara ano.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na boka afamu tonto no bɔɔ Selemia. Nna ne ba Zekaria a ɔyɛ nyimdzee mu ɔfotunyi no wɔtwee no ho tonto; na ne kyɛfa kedzii kwaamu afamu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Obed-edom dze wɔ pomu afamu; na ne mba dze nye akoradzedan no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Supim na Hosa dze wɔ anee afamu, Sal-leket kuropon ho, afowee tsempɔn no do, aweɔmfo no wɔ afa na afa hwɛ enyim.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Levifo beesia wɔ boka afamu, baanan wɔ kwaamu afamu da kor, baanan wɔ pomu afamu da kor, na akoradzedan no ho dze, beenu beenu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Parbar dze, wɔ anee afamu, baanan wɔ tsempɔn no ano, na beenu wɔ Parbar ho.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nye abowanoahwɛfo no hɔn nkyekyɛmu; Korafo mba, na Merarimba no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na Levifo no mu bi, Ahija hwɛ Nyankopɔn fie akoradze na akrɔnkrɔndze akoradze no do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ladan, Gerson ne mba no kor; Gersonfo mba wɔyɛ Ladan dze no, egyanom efi mu etsitsir no kor na Gersonnyi Ladan asenyi Jehieli.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Jehieli ne mba; Zetam, na no nua Joel a wɔhwɛ EWURADZE fie akoradze no do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Amramfo, Azharfo, Hebronfo, Uzielfo no mu:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Moses ne ba Gersom ne ba Sebuel na odzi akoradze no do ɔpanyin.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na no nuanom; Eliezer dze mu na ne ba Rehabia, na ne ba Jesaia, na ne ba Joram, na ne ba Zikri, na ne ba Selomot fi bae.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Selomot yi na no nuanom na wodzii akrɔnkrɔndze a ɔhen David, na n’egyanom efi mu etsitsir no, apem apem na ɔha ɔha do asafohen na dɔm do asafohen no yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn no nyinara akoradze do mpanyin.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Akodzi mu asadze mu bi na wɔyɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn dɛ wɔdze repempam EWURADZE ne fi no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ndzɛmba nyinara so a adzehunyi Samuel, na Saul Kish ne ba no, na Abner Ner ba, na Joab Zeruia ba yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn no; obiara n’adze biara a ɔayɛ no krɔnkrɔn no, ɔwɔ Selomot, na no nuanom nsamu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Izharfo mu Kenania na ne mba a wɔhwɛ Israel kwasafo edwuma no do, dɛ wɔyɛ akyerɛwfo na atsɛmbuafo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hebronfo mu, Hasabia na no nuanom, mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam, apem ahaesuon, na wɔhwɛ Israel do wɔ Jordan egya anee afamu; wɔ EWURADZE n’edwuma nyinara, na ɔhen no no som afamu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Hebronfo mu na otsitsir Jerija wɔ, mekyerɛ Hebronfo no mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi mu ebusuasantsen tse. David ahendzi mu afe a otsia eduanan mu na wɔhwehwɛɛ hɔn, na wohun hɔn mu mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam wɔ Jazer a ɔwɔ Gilead.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na no nuanom, mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam no, wɔyɛ mpemebien ahaesuon, egyanom efi etsitsir a David dze hɔn sisii Reubenfo, Gadfo, na Manaasɛfo ebusua fa no do, wɔ asɛm biara a ɔfa Nyankopɔn ho, na ɔhen no no ho nsɛm ho.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei Israelmba a woebu hɔn ano, dɛ, efi mu etsitsir na apem apem na ɔha ɔha do asafohen, na hɔn ahwɛdofo a wɔsoom ɔhen no, wɔ nkyekyɛmu ahorow wɔ nsɛm nyinara mu, hɔn a wɔbaa mu na hɔn a wofiir edzi bosoom bosoom wɔ afrenhyia abosoom nyinara mu, wɔ nkyekyɛmu biara mu no yɛ nyimpa mpemeduonu anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Bosoom a odzi kan no mu nkyekyɛmu a odzi kan no do na Zabdiel ba Jasobeam hwɛ: na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu nyimpa wɔyɛ mpemeduonu anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ofi Perez mba mu, dɔm no do asafohen nyinara mu otsitsir wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na bosoom a otsia ebien ne nkyekyɛmu no do na Ahohnyi Dodai hwɛ, na ne nkyekyɛmu no do ɔpanyin nye Miklot: na nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonu anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Bosoom a otsia ebiasa no dɔm a otsia ebiasa no do safohen nye Benaia, ɔsɔfo Jehoiada ne ba, otsitsir no; na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonu anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Iyi nye Benaia no a ɔyɛ eduasa no mu ɔbarimba katakyi a ɔhwɛ eduasa no do: na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu na ne ba Ammizabad dzi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Safohen a otsia anan wɔ bosoom a otsia anan no mu no nye Asahel, Joab no nua no, na ne ba Zebadia dzii n’ekyir: na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonu anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Safohen a otsia enum wɔ bosoom a otsia enum no mu no nye Izrahnyi Samhut: na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonu anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Safohen a otsia esia wɔ bosoom a otsia esia no mu no nye Tekoanyi Ikkes ne ba Ira: na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonu anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Safohen a otsia esuon wɔ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu no nye Pelonnyi Helez, ofi Efraimmba mu: na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonu anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Safohen a otsia awɔtwe wɔ bosoom a otsia awɔtwe no mu no nye Husahnyi Sibekai, ofi Zerafo mu: na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonu anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Safohen a otsia akron wɔ bosoom a otsia akron no mu no nye Anathotnyi Abiezer, ofi Benjaminfo mu: na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonu anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Safohen a otsia du wɔ bosoom a otsia du no mu no nye Netofatnyi Maharai, ofi Zerafo mu: na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonu anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Safohen a otsia dubiako wɔ bosoom a otsia dubiako no mu no nye Piratonnyi Benaia, ofi Efraimmba mu: na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonu anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Safohen a otsia duebien wɔ bosoom a otsia duebien no mu no nye Netofatnyi Heldai, ofi Otiniel: na ne nkyekyɛmu no mu wɔ nyimpa mpemeduonu anan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so hɔn a wɔhwɛ Israel ebusuakuw duebien no do nye iyi: Reubenfo hwɛdofo nye Zikri ba Eliezer: Simeonfo mu, Maaka ba Sefatia:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Levi mu, Kemuel ba Hasabia: Aaron mu, Zadok.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Juda mu, Elihu, David no nuanom no mu baako: Isakar mu, Maekɛl ba Omri:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Zebulun mu, Obadia ne ba Ismaia: Naftali mu, Azriel ne ba Jeremot:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Efraimmba mu, Azazia ba Hosea: Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no mu, Pedaia ba Joel:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Manaasɛ ebusuakuw fa no a ɔwɔ Gilead no mu, Zekaria ba Iddo: Benjamin mu, Abner ba Jaasiel.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Dan mu, Jeroham ba Azarel. Woyinom nye Israel ebusuakuw do asafohen.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David emmbu hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na hɔn a wonndzii no ano: osiandɛ EWURADZE aka dɛ ɔbɛma Israel adɔr dɛ ɔsor nworaba.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Zeruia ne ba Joab na ɔhyɛɛ ase kanee, na oennwie; na iyi kɔtwetwee ebufuw baa Israel do; nkyii so wɔammfa dodow no annhyɛ ɔhen David ne Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen n’akoradze no do na Adiel ba Azmavet hwɛ: na akoradze a ɔwɔ asaase no do, nkurow mu, na nkurobaase, na abantsentsen mu no, Uzia ba Jonatan na ɔhwɛ:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na hɔn a wɔyɛ hamudwuma dɔw asaase no do no na Kelub ba Ezri hwɛ:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na wenyin nture do na Ramatnyi Simei hwɛ: na wenyin nture ndɔbaa mu akoransa no do na Sefamnyi Zabdi hwɛ:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na ngondua na ankye ndua a ɔwɔ tɛtɛr mu no na Gedernyi Baal-hanan hwɛ: na ngo fiadze no do na Joas hwɛ:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na anantwi a wɔnyɛn hɔn wɔ Saron no do na Saronnyi Sitrai hwɛ: na anantwi a wɔwɔ mbɔnsa no mu no Adlai ba Safat hwɛ:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na efumpɔnkɔ do na Ismaelnyi Obil hwɛ: na nsoasopɔnkɔ do na Meronotnyi Jedeia hwɛ:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na nguan do na Hagrinyi Jaziz hwɛ. Woyinom nyinara wɔyɛ ɔhen David n’ahodze do ahwɛfo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so David no wɔfa Jonatan na ɔyɛ ɔpamfo, nyimpa a ɔwɔ ntseasee, na ɔkyerɛwfo: na Hakmoni ne ba Jehiel na ɔnye ɔhen ne mba no tse:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Ahithofel nye ɔhen ne pamfo, na Arkinyi Husai nye ɔhen ne nyɛnko:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na Ahithofel n’ekyir na Benaia ba Jehoiada na Abiathar dzi: na ɔhen no dɔm do safohen nye Joab.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David hyiahyiaa Israel asafohen nyinara, ebusuakuw do asafohen, na ekuwekuw no do asafohen a wɔsom ɔhen esiado esiado, na apem apem do asafohen, na ɔha ɔha do asafohen, na ɔhen na ne mba ahodze na enyadze nyinara do ahwɛdofo, wɔnye edzibewdzifo, na mbarimba akatakyi, mekyerɛ mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam nyinara baa Jerusalɛm.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔhen David soɛree gyinaa n’anan do, na ɔsee dɛ, Mo nuanom, na me man, hom ntsie me: emi dze, ɔwɔ m’akoma mu dɛ nkyɛ mibesi ahomgye fi ama EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no, na ɔayɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn n’ananadzegua; na mayɛ ahoboa ama ne nsii no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Naaso Nyankopɔn see me dɛ, Mma ɔwo nnsi ofi mma me dzin, osiandɛ ɔwo yɛ akodzi nyimpa, na aka bɔgya egu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, saan mu yii emi wɔ m’egya fi nyinara mu dɛ mindzi Israelhen daa: na ɔasan mu eyi Juda ayɛ no ɔpanyin; na Juda ofi mu so oeyi m’egya fi; na m’egya mba mu so, onyaa mo ho enyisɔ dɛ ɔdze me besi Israel nyinara do hen:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na me mba nyinara mu so, (na EWURADZE ama me mba pii,) ɔasan mu eyi me ba Solomon dɛ ɔntsena EWURADZE n’ahendzi a odzi no wɔ Israel no do egua do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Wo ba Solomon na obesi me fi na m’abangua no: osiandɛ masan mu eyi no ayɛ me ba, na mo so mebeyɛ n’egya.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na mebɛma n’ahendzi etsim hɔ daa, sɛ ɔkɔ do ara dzi me mbransɛm na m’ahyɛdze do, dɛ mbrɛ ogu do reyɛ yi a.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, Israel nyinara a wɔyɛ EWURADZE bagua no enyim, na hɛn Nyankopɔn n’asomu, hom nhyɛ hom Nyankopɔn ne mbransɛm nyinara nsew na hom nhwehwɛ ekyir kwan: ama hom nsa aaka asaase pa yi, na hom aadan egya dɛ ewungyadze ama hom mba a wobedzi hom ekyir no daa.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔwo, me ba Solomon, hu w’egya ne Nyankopɔn no, na fa akoma a odzi mu na ɔpɛ adwen som no: osiandɛ EWURADZE pɛnsapɛnsa akoma nyinara mu, na ohu adwen nyinara mu nsusui: sɛ ehwehwɛ no a, ɔbɛma ehu no; na sɛ epow no dze a, ɔbɔtow wo akyen korakora.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei hwɛ yie; na EWURADZE asan mu eyi wo dɛ si ofi yɛ krɔnkrɔnbea no: hyɛ woho dzen, na yɛ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna David dze asɔrdan n’abrandaa, na no ho adan, na n’adzekorambea, na n’abansor mpia, na ne mpiakyir mpia, na ne mpatabea no nsusudo maa ne ba Solomon:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na dza ɔnam sunsum no do nyae nyinara no nsusudo, EWURADZE fie abangua, na mpia a etwa ho ehyia nyinara, EWURADZE fie adzekorambea, na akrɔnkrɔndze adzekorambea:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na asɔfo na Levifo nkyekyɛmu no so, na EWURADZE fie ɔsom edwuma no nyinara, na EWURADZE fie ɔsom ho ndzɛmba nyinara:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: sika ndzɛmba no wɔ sika ne nkerii do, dɛ wɔmfa nyɛ ɔsom nyinara ho ndzɛmba nyinara dwetɛ ndzɛmba nyinara ne nkerii, dɛ wɔmfa nyɛ ɔsom nyinara ho ndzɛmba nyinara:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na sika kandzea ndua, na no ho sika kandzea ne nkerii, ɔnye kandzeadua biara na no ho nkandzea ne nkerii: dwetɛ kandzea ndua, dwetɛ kandzeadua biara na no ho nkandzea ne nkerii, dɛ mbrɛ kandzeadua biara no ho som tse:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na kyerɛpaanoo apon no, nkorkor, sika a woeker; na dwetɛ apon no no dwetɛ;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na edzinam, na mbɛɛsen, na nkɔɔpow no, sika mapa a: na sika nkorbaa dze, mbrɛ korbaa biara ne nkerii tse; na dwetɛ nkorbaa dze, mbrɛ korbaa biara ne nkerii tse:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na eduhuam afɔrmbukyia no ho sika a woeyiyi mu ne nkerii: na tseaseanam esusudo no ho sika, mekyerɛ kerubfo a wɔtserɛɛw hɔn atsaban mu kataa EWURADZE ahyɛmudaka no do no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: David see dɛ, Iyi nyina kyerɛw a ofi EWURADZE nsamu bae no ama matse ase, mekyerɛ nsusudo ndwuma nyinara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David see ne ba Solomon dɛ, Hyɛ woho dzen na nya akokodur, na yɛ: mma nnsuro, nkyii so mma w’akoma nntu: na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, mekyerɛ me Nyankopɔn no, ɔnye wo nam; ɔremmpa wo, eso orinngya wo hɔ, dze ekodu dɛ wobowie EWURADZE fi ɔsom edwuma no nyinara yɛ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na, hwɛ, asɔfo na Levifo nkyekyɛmu a wɔbɔsom Nyankopɔn fie nye yi: na dwuma no nyina mu, nyimpa biara a ɔpra ne yamu a ɔwɔ ɔsom biara ho nyansa no, ɔbɛba wo nkyɛn: asafohen no na ɔman no nyinara so bedzi w’anosɛm nyinara do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen David see bagua no nyinara dɛ, Me ba Solomon, ɔbaako a Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi no no ɔda ho yɛ abofra na ɔyɛ mberɛw, na edwuma no so: osiandɛ ahemfi no nnyɛ nyimpa dze, na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn dze a.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei medze m’ahoɔdzen nyinara mesiesie me Nyankopɔn fi no ho sika ama sika ndzɛmba, na dwetɛ ama dwetɛ ndzɛmba, na boran ama boran ndzɛmba, na dadze ama dadze ndzɛmba, na ndua ama ndua ndzɛmba; epopobibir abo, na nhyehyɛmu abo, abo senasena, na abo nworanworan, na aboɔdzen abo n’ahorow nyinara, na abo fufuw piigyan.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so, osian mo dɔ a medze esi me Nyankopɔn fi no ho ntsi, sika na dwetɛ a ɔyɛ mankasa m’akoradze no, medze no so mema me Nyankopɔn fi no, dze ka dza mesiesie ama krɔnkrɔnbea no nyinara ho;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: sika talent mpensa, Ofir sika, na dwetɛ a woeyiyi mu talent mpemesuon, dɛ wɔmfa ndura adan no n’afasu no ho:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: wɔmfa sika nyeyɛ sika ndzɛmba, na wɔmfa dwetɛ nyeyɛ dwetɛ ndzɛmba, na wɔmfa nyɛ edwimfo nsaano edwuma no nyinara. Na afei, woana na ɔpra ne yamu tu noho hyɛ EWURADZE nsa ndɛ da yi?
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna egyanom efi mu mbapɔmba, na Israel ebusuakuw mu mbapɔmba, na apem apem na ɔha ɔha do asafohen wɔnye ɔhen n’edwuma do ahwɛdofo no praa hɔn yamu mae;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na wɔmaa Nyankopɔn fie ɔsom no ho sika talent mpemenum na sika darik mpemdu, na dwetɛ talent mpemdu, na boran talent mpemduawɔtwe, na dadze talent mpemɔha.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn a wohun aboɔdzen abo wɔ hɔn hɔ no, wɔdze maa EWURADZE fie akoradze, wɔ Gersonnyi Jehiel ne nsamu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔman no dzii ehurusi, dɛ wɔpraa hɔn yamu yii mae, osiandɛ wɔdze akoma a odzi mu praa hɔn yamu yii maa EWURADZE: na ɔhen David so dze dɛw kɛse dzii ehurusi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi David hyiraa EWURADZE wɔ bagua no nyinara enyim: na David see dɛ, Ao EWURADZE, hɛn egya Israel ne Nyankopɔn, nhyira nka wo mbersantsen mfesantsen.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ɔwo, EWURADZE, na akɛseyɛ, ahoɔdzen, enyimnyam, konyimdzi na tumdzi dzi wɔ wo: na dza ɔwɔ ɔsor na asaase nyinara yɛ wodze; ɔwo, EWURADZE, na ahendzi no yɛ wodze, na ɔwo na ekrɔn wɔ adze nyinara do.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Ahonya na enyimnyam nyinara fi wo hɔ ba, na ɔwo na idzi adze nyinara do; na wo nsamu na ahoɔdzen na tum wɔ; na ɔwo wo nsamu na ɔwɔ dɛ edze akɛseyɛ ma, na edze ahoɔdzen ma nyimpa nyinara.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na afei, hɛn Nyankopɔn, yɛda wo ase, na yeyi w’enyimnyam dzin no ayɛw.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na emi nye woana, na me man nye ebɛn, dɛ yebotum apra hɛn yamu yeeyi ama dɛm yi? Na adze nyina fi wo nsamu, na woara w’adze na yɛdze ama wo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na yɛyɛ ahɔho wɔ wo nkyɛn, na amamforafo, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn egyanom nyinara yɛe: hɛn nda tse dɛ sunsuma wɔ asaase do, na enyidado bi nnyi hɔ.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: EWURADZE, hɛn Nyankopɔn, okuw yi nyinara a yesiesie dɛ yɛdze ribesi ofi ama wo dzin krɔnkrɔn yi wo nsamu na ofi, na ne nyinara yɛ woara wodze.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Me Nyankopɔn, minyim so dɛ ɔwo esɔ akoma hwɛ, na ewɔ enyigye wɔ tsenenee ho. Emi dze, m’akoma ne tsenenee mu na mapra me yamu mama ndzɛmba yinom yi: na afei medze enyigye na mehu wo man a wɔwɔ ha yi, dɛ wɔapra hɔn yamu woeyi ama wo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: EWURADZE, hɛn egyanom Abraham, Isaak, na Israel Nyankopɔn, fa iyi sie wo man akoma mu adwen mu nsusui mu daa daa, na siesie hɔn akoma ma woho:
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na fa akoma a odzi mu ma me ba Solomon, ma onsie wo mbrasɛm, w’adasesɛm, na w’ahyɛdze, na ɔnyɛ yinom nyinara, na onsi ahemfie a mesiesie ho ama no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David see bagua no nyinara dɛ, Afei hom nhyira EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn. Na bagua no nyinara hyiraa EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no, na wɔkotowee sɔɔr EWURADZE, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze maa ɔhen no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔbobɔɔ afɔr maa EWURADZE, na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr maa EWURADZE, da no n’adzekyee no, anantwinyin apem, nguannyin apem, na nguambaa apem, na hɔn ho huensa, na afɔr piigyan maa Israel nyinara;
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: na wɔdze enyigye kɛse dzidzii na wɔnomee wɔ EWURADZE enyim da no. Na wɔhyɛɛ David ne ba Solomon ɔhen ne mpɛn ebien, na wɔseraa no ngo maa EWURADZE dɛ bapɔmba, na wɔseraa Zadok so ngo dɛ ɔsɔfo.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Nna Solomon hyɛɛ n’egya David ananmu tsenaa EWURADZE egua no do dɛ ɔhen, na ɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm; na Israel nyinara yɛɛ setsie maa no.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na asafohen nyinara, na mbarimba akatakyi, na ɔhen David ne mba no nyinara so, wɔbrɛɛ hɔnho adze maa ɔhen Solomon.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE maa Solomon do kɛsenara wɔ Israel nyinara enyim, na ɔmaa no ahendzi mu tumdzi bi a Israelhen biara a odzii n’enyim no ennya no dɛm da.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm na David, Jesse ba no, dzii Israel nyinara do hen.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a ɔdze dzii Israel do hen no yɛ mfe eduanan; odzii hen mfe esuon wɔ Hebron, na mfe eduasa ebiasa na odzii hen wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na owuu ne nkɔdaaber mapa mu a oedzi mfe pii, na ahonya, na enyimnyam so ahyɛ no ma: na ne ba Solomon dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Afei ɔhen David ho nsɛm a odzi kan na dza odzi ekyir no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ adzehunyi Samuel nsɛm na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan nsɛm, na adzehunyi Gad nsɛm no mu.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Iyinom da n’ahendzi na no tum, na dza osii ne ber do a ɔfa noara no ho, Israel ho, na asaase no n’ahendzi nyinara ho no edzi.
title: 1ST CHRONICLES

text: Na David ne ba Solomon maa n’ahendzi no tsimii, na EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn no dzii n’ekyir, na ɔmaa no do kɛsenara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon kasaa kyerɛɛ Israel nyinara, apem apem na ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no, na atsɛmbuafo no, na Israel nyinara mu ɔbapɔmba biara, egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Solomon, na mboanofo a wɔka no ho no nyinara sii mu kɔr bea sorɔnsorɔm no a ɔwɔ Gibeon no do; osiandɛ hɔ na Nyankopɔn n’ehyiadzibuw no a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses yɛɛ no wɔ sar no do no wɔ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Nyankopɔn n’adakaa no dze David akɛfa no wɔ Kiriat-jearim aba bea a David esiesie ama no no do; osiandɛ oesi buw bi ama no wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so boran afɔrmbukyia no a Bezalel, Uri ba no, Hur ba no, yɛe no, ɔwɔ EWURADZE ne ntamadan no enyim hɔ: na Solomon na mboanofo no hwehwɛɛ n’ekyir kwan.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon fowee kɔr boran afɔrmbukyia no a ɔwɔ EWURADZE enyim no a osi ehyiadzibuw no enyim no ho, na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr apem wɔ do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Anadwe no ara nna Nyankopɔn yii noho kyerɛɛ Solomon, na ɔsee no dɛ, Bisa dza memfa mma wo.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon see Nyankopɔn dɛ, Ɔwo na ayɛ m’egya David ayamuyie kɛse, na ahyɛ me ɔhen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, ma w’anohoba ntsim mma m’egya David: osiandɛ ɔwo ahyɛ me ɔhen wɔ ɔman a hɔn dodow tse dɛ asaase do huntuma do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei ma me nyansa na nyimdzee, ma muntum mfa mbu wo man yi: na woana na obotum ebu wo man yi a ɔyɛ kɛse dɛm yi atsɛn?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Nyankopɔn see Solomon dɛ, Osiandɛ iyi wɔ w’akoma mu, na emmbisa ahonya, akoradze, anaa enyidzi, na eso hɔn a wɔtan wo hɔn nkwa, nkyii so emmbisa nkwa tsentsen; na mbom ebisa nyansa na nyimdzee ama woho, ma edze eebu me man a mahyɛ wo hɔn do hen no atsɛn ntsi yi:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: nyansa na nyimdzee medze ama wo; na mebɛma wo ahonya, na akoradze, na enyidzi so a ahemfo a woedzi w’enyim no mu biara ennya no dɛm, eso hɔn a wodzi w’ekyir no mu biara rinnya ne saso.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Solomon fii n’akwantu a otui kɔr bea sorɔnsorɔm no a ɔwɔ Gibeon no, fii ehyiadzibuw no enyim baa Jerusalɛm; na odzii hen wɔ Israel do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon boaboaa ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo ano: na onyaa ntseaseanam apem ahaanan, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemduebien, na ɔdze hɔn sisii ntseaseanam nkurow no mu, na ɔnye ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no maa dwetɛ na sika yɛɛ dɛ abo wɔ Jerusalɛm, ɔmaa nkyindur ndua so yɛɛ dɛ ankye ndua bi a ɔwowɔ abɔn mu nkurow mu, wɔ ɔdodow mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na mpɔnkɔ a Solomon nyae no, wɔdze fi Egypt bae; ɔhen n’eguadzifo no kɛgyegyee hɔn ekuwekuw mu, kuw kor wɔ no bo do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔkɛfaa tseaseanam fi Egypt bae dze bɛgyee dwetɛ dwetɛbona ahaesia, na mpɔnkɔ so, dze bɛgyee ɔha eduonum: na dɛmara so na wɔdze bi fiir edzi bɔtɔnee maa Hitifo ahemfo na Siria ahemfo no nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Solomon sii n’adwen pi dɛ obesi ofi ama EWURADZE ne dzin, na ofi ama n’ahendzi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon kaan ndzesoadzefo mpemeduosuon a wɔsoasoa adze, na mbepɔw do nduatwafo mpemeduowɔtwe, na mpemebiasa ahaesia a wɔhwɛ hɔn do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon somae ma wɔkɔr Taerehen Huram nkyɛn, dɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo nye m’egya David yɛe, na ekɛmaa no nkyindur ndua dɛ ɔmfa nsi ofi ntsena mu no, mekyerɛ dɛmara so na enye me nyɛ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Hwɛ, mirisi dan ama m’EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ne dzin, na wɔaayɛ no krɔnkrɔn ama no, na wɔaahyew eduhuam a ɔyɛ huam wɔ n’enyim, na wɔdze aama daa kyerɛpaanoo no, na ɔhyew afɔr no anapa na ewimbir, ahomgyeda, na abosoom fofor, na hɛn EWURADZE Nyankopɔn n’afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ no. Iyi yɛ mbra ma Israel daa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdan a mirisi no so: osiandɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn no so sen enyame nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na woana ara na obotum esi dan ama no, hwɛ dɛ ɔsor na ɔsor no sorsor mpo nntum nnkora no yi? Woana nye me koraa na mibesi dan ama no, gyedɛ eduhuam a wɔhyew wɔ n’enyim nko?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, brɛ me nyimpa onyansafo bi a obedzi edwin wɔ sika, na dwetɛ, na boran, na dadze, na ɔberdum, na serdaa, na bibir mu, na obotum eyiyi nsema ahorow nyinara, ma ɔmbɛka edwimfo a wɔwɔ me nkyɛn wɔ Juda na Jerusalɛm a m’egya David siesiee hɔn siei no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Eso fa nkyindur ndua, ɔpepeaa ndua, na algum ndua fi Lebanon brɛ me: na minyim dɛ wo nkowaa botum etwa ndua wɔ Lebanon: na, hwɛ, mo nkowaa bɛka wo nkowaa ho,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ma woeesiesie ndua piigyan ama me: osiandɛ dan a miribesi no ɔso na ɔyɛ nwanwa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na, hwɛ, mebɛma wo nkowaa, nduatwafo a wotwa ndua no edziban, ewi etwadze mpemeduonu, na atoko etwadze mpemeduonu, na wenyin galɔn mpemɔha nye du, na ngo galɔn mpemɔha nye du.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Taerehen Huram buaa no wɔ nwoma a ɔdze brɛɛ Solomon no mu dɛ, Osiandɛ EWURADZE dɔ ne man ntsi, nna ɔahyɛ wo hen wɔ hɔn do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so Huram see dɛ, Nhyira nka EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛɛ ɔsor na asaase, dɛ ɔama ɔhen David ɔba nyansafo a wɔama no nyimdzee na ntseasee a obesi dan ama EWURADZE, na ofi ama n’ahendzi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na afei masoma ɔbarimba onyansafo a wɔama no ntseasee, mekyerɛ m’egya Huram,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ɔbaa bi a ofi Dan ne mbabaa mu ne ba, n’egya nye ɔbarimba bi a ofi Taere, onyim sika, na dwetɛ, boran, dadze, abo, na ndua, ɔberdum, bibir, na ndwera fɛɛfɛw, na serdaa mu edwin dzi; eso onyim nsema ahorow nyinara yiyi, na ndwindze biara ho edwin: ma wɔmma no dzibew bi ma ɔnka wo mbarimba enyansafo, na mo wura David w’egya ne mbarimba enyansafo no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi afei ewifua na atoko, ngo na nsa a mo wura kaa ho asɛm no, wɔmma ɔmfa mbrɛ no nkowaa:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na yebotwa ndua efi Lebanon, dodow ara a ibehia no: na yɛdze no mpanta no edua po do abrɛ wo wɔ Jopa; na ɔwo so edze afow akɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon kaan ahɔho a wɔwɔ Israel asaase do no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ nkanee a n’egya David dze kaan hɔn no tse; na wohun hɔn dɛ wɔyɛ mpemɔha eduonum na mpemebiasa ahaesia.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn mu mpemeduosuon dɛ wɔnsoasoa adze, na mpemeduowɔtwe a wɔyɛ mbepɔw do nduatwafo, na mpemebiasa ahaesia a wɔyɛ ahwɛdofo dɛ wɔmma nkorɔfo no nyɛ edwuma.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Solomon hyɛɛ ase dɛ orisi EWURADZE ne fi no wɔ Jerusalɛm bepɔw Moria do, mbrɛ EWURADZE yii noho kyerɛɛ n’egya David no, wɔ bea a David esiesie, wɔ Jebusnyi Ornan n’ewuporowee no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na n’ahendzi no n’afe a otsia anan no mu bosoom a otsia ebien no mu da a otsia ebien no, nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ orisi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei fapem a Solomon hyɛe dze maa Nyankopɔn ne fi ne nsii no nye yi. Ne tsentsen basafa mu dɛ mbrɛ nkan no nsusui tse no, ɔyɛ basafa eduasa, na ne tɛtɛr basafa du.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na abrandaa a ɔwɔ dan no enyim no ne tsentsen, dɛ mbrɛ ɔdan no ne tɛtɛr tse, ɔyɛ basafa du, na no krɔn eduosia: na ɔdze sika mapa duraa no mu afamu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na dan kɛse no ɔdze ɔpepeaa ndua saam do, na ɔdze sika pa duraa ho, na odzidzii do edwin, mbɛdua na ntweaban.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze abo a ɔsom bo kataa ɔdan no ho wɔ ne fɛw ntsi: na sika no yɛ Parvaim sika.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze sika duraa dan no, mpuna no, apondua no, na n’afasu no, na no mbobow no ho; na oyiyii wɔ afasu no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔyɛɛ krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔn dan no; ne tsentsen, dɛ mbrɛ dan no ne tɛtɛr no tse, ɔyɛ basafa du, na ne tɛtɛr basafa du; na ɔdze sika pa a n’ano tow talent ahaesia duraa ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ne mprɛgow ne nkerii no n’ano tow sika dwetɛbona eduonum. Na ɔdze sika duraduraa ɔsor mpia no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔyɛɛ kerubfo ebien osian edwuma wɔ krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔn dan no mu; na wɔdze sika duraa ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na kerubfo no hɔn ntsaban ne tsentsen yɛ basafa du: kerub baako n’atsaban kor basafa ebien na fa, ɔka dan no ne fasu no; na atsaban kor no so yɛ basafa ebien na fa, ɔka kerub baako no so n’atsaban.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na kerub baako no so n’atsaban kor yɛ basafa ebien na fa, ɔka ɔdan no ne fasu no; na n’atsaban kor no so yɛ basafa ebien na fa, ɔka kerub baako no so n’atsaban no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Kerubfo yi hɔn ntsaban mu tsɛw basafa du: na wogyinagyina hɔn anan do, na hɔn enyim dzi dan no no do afamu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze bibir, na ɔberdum, na serdaa, na ndwera pa dze yɛɛ ntwamutam no, na ɔween kerubfo wɔ mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Eso dan no enyim edum ebien a n’atsentsen yɛ basafa duesuon na fa, na ntaadotsir a ɔwɔ no mu kor etsifi ɔyɛ basafa ebien na fa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ntweaban wɔ mpiakyir no mu, na ɔdze sensɛɛn edum no etsifi; na ɔyeyɛɛ pɔmegranate ekutu ɔha, na ɔdze hyehyɛɛ ntweaban no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze edum no sisii asɔrfi no enyim, kor wɔ enyimfa, na kor so wɔ abankum afamu; na ɔfrɛɛ dza ɔwɔ enyimfa no ne dzin Jakin, na dza ɔwɔ abankum no ne dzin Boaz.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so ɔyɛɛ boran afɔrmbukyia, ne tsentsen basafa du, na ne tɛtɛr basafa du, na no krɔn basafa enum.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Eso ɔyɛɛ nsutaae a woguar mu a ofi ano kɛpem ano yɛ basafa enum no, otwa kɔntɔnkrɔn, na no krɔn yɛ basafa ebien na fa; na ahoma basafa duenum bɔ ho aprɔw hyia.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na nkukuduuduw ne saso wowɔ n’ase dze bɔ no aprɔw hyia, du wɔ anamɔn kor na fa mu, ɔbɔ po no ho aprɔw hyia. Nkukuduuduw no a wogui no, woguu no akyerɛpɛn ebien.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ogyinaa anantwi duebien do, ebiasa hwɛ kwaamu afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ anee afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ pomu afamu, na ebiasa hwɛ boka afamu: na po no taa hɔn do wɔ sor, na hɔn ekyir nyinara wɔ no mu afamu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ne peperepe yɛ nsatseama nsusui; na n’ano no wɔyɛɛ no dɛ kɔɔpow ano, ɔtse dɛ nsukookoo ne nhyiren: odzi galɔn mpemduenum.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Eso ɔyɛɛ eguarsɛn du, na ɔdze enum sisii enyimfa afamu, na enum so abankum afamu, dɛ wɔnhohor adze ho wɔ mu; ndzɛmba a ɔyɛ ɔhyew afɔr ho dze no na wɔhohoor ho wɔ mu: na po no dze, ɔwɔ hɔ ma asɔfo no, ma wɔaahohor hɔnho wɔ mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔyɛɛ sika nkandzeadua du no dɛ mbrɛ no ho mbra tse no; na ɔdze sisii asɔrfi no mu, enum wɔ enyimfa, na enum so wɔ abankum.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Eso ɔyɛɛ apon du, na ɔdze sisii asɔrfi no mu, enum wɔ enyimfa afamu, na enum so wɔ abankum afamu. Na ɔyɛɛ sika mbɛɛsen ɔha.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so ɔyɛɛ asɔfo hɔn abangua no, na abangua kɛse no, na abangua no ano mbobow no, na ɔdze boran duraa mbobow no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze po no sii dan no ne nyimfa afamu wɔ boka afamu a ɔhwɛ pomu afamu no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Huram yɛɛ nsenaba, na nsofi, na mbɛɛsen no. Nna Huram wiee edwuma a ɔyɛe maa ɔhen Solomon wɔ Nyankopɔn ne fi no ho yɛ:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: edum ebien no, na edum no n’etsifi ntaadotsir apɔw ebien no; na ntenadwuma ebien no a wɔdze kata edum no n’etsifi ntaadotsir apɔw no ho no;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ntenadwuma ebien no ho pɔmegranate eduaba ahaanan no; pɔmegranate eduaba akyerɛpɛn ebien yɛ atenadwuma kor nedze, dɛ ɔkata ntaadotsir no n’apɔw ebien no a ɔwɔ edum no no do no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ɔyɛɛ ngyina ndaka no so, na ɔyɛɛ ndaka no do eguarsɛn no;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: po kor, na n’ase anantwi duebien no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nsenaba no so, na nsofi no, na edzinam no, na no ho ndzɛmba nyinara, na n’egya Huram yɛe maa ɔhen Solomon dze maa EWURADZE ne fi no, ɔyɛ boran a wɔapɔw ho hyɛnn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Jordan Tɛtɛr mu hɔ na ɔhen no gui, wɔ hyirew daadze mu wɔ Sukɔt na Zereda ntamu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm na Solomon yɛɛ ndzɛmba yi nyinara kɛse piigyan: na woennhu boran no ne nkerii ano.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon yɛɛ ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn ne fi no mu nyinara, sika afɔrmbukyia no so, na apon a kyerɛpaanoo no sisi do no;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na nkandzeadua no nye no ho nkandzea, ma wɔaasɔ no dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse wɔ mpiakyir no enyim no, yɛ sika mapa;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na no ho nhyiren, na nkandzea, na ndabaa no, sika a, ne nyinara sika ara nko;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na edumgya, na mbɛɛsen, na ntser, na ngyasɛn no, sika mapa: na dan no n’ahɛnee no dze, no mu afamu krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔnbea no no mbobow no, na dan no, mekyerɛ asɔrfi no no mbobow no, sika a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wowiee edwuma a Solomon yɛe maa EWURADZE ne fi no nyinara. Na Solomon dze ndzɛmba a n’egya David tui sii hɔ no bae; mekyerɛ dwetɛ, na sika, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba no nyinara, na ɔdze besisii Nyankopɔn fie ndzekoradzebea.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Solomon hyiahyiaa Israel mpanyimfo, na ebusuakuw ebusuakuw mu etsitsir nyinara, Israelmba egyanom efiefi mbapɔmba no, ma wɔbaa Jerusalɛm, dɛ wɔrekɛfa EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no efi Zion a ɔyɛ David kurow no mu aba.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israel mbarimba no nyinara hyiahyiaa hɔnho behyiaa ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ afahyɛ no ase, wɔ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israel mpanyimfo no nyinara bae, na Levifo no bɛmaa adaka no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze adaka no, na ehyiadzibuw no, na ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn a ɔwɔ Buw no mu no bae; iyinom na asɔfo na Levifo no wɔdze bae.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen Solomon na Israel mboanofo no nyinara a woebehyia wɔ ne nkyɛn no, wodzi adaka no enyim, rukuku nguan na anantwi a osian hɔn dodow ntsi wonntum nnkan eso wommbu ano, dze robobɔ afɔr.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na asɔfo no dze EWURADZE n’ahyɛmudaka no bae dze besii ne sibew, wɔ dan no ne mpiakyir, krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔnbea no mu; mekyerɛ kerubfo no hɔn ntsaban ase.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na kerubfo no atserɛtserɛw hɔn ntsaban mu wɔ adaka no ne sibew no do, na kerubfo no akata adaka no na no ho mpoma no do wɔ ɔsor.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na mpoma no wowar dodow ma wohu mpoma no n’etsifi wɔ adaka no ho wɔ mpiakyir no enyim; na wonnhu wɔ abowano: na mbrɛ ɔwɔ ara nye no, bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Hweeara nnyi adaka no mu gyedɛ abopon ebien no a Moses dze guu mu wɔ Horeb no, wɔ mbrɛ EWURADZE nye Israelmba dzii ahyɛmu, wɔ mber a wofi Egypt asaase do reba no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a asɔfo no wofii bea krɔnkrɔn no do puei no, (osiandɛ asɔfo a wɔwɔ hɔ no nyinara wɔatsew hɔnho, na woenndzi hɔn nkyekyɛmu ekyir;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: eso Levifo no a wɔyɛ adwontofo no, hɔn nyinara, mekyerɛ Asaf, Heman, Jedutun, na hɔn mba na hɔn nuanom no, wɔhyehyɛ ndwera fɛɛfɛw, kitsakitsa nkasaa na bɛnta asanku na nsankutsen gyinagyina afɔrmbukyia no no boka afamu na asɔfo ɔha eduonu rehɛn mbɛn ka hɔn ho:)
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: nna ɔbaa dɛ, aber a mbɛnhɛmfo na adwontofo no wɔyɛɛ dɛ ɔbaakofo, na wɔdze ndze kor dɛ wɔdze riyi EWURADZE ayɛw da no ase; na aber a wɔdze mbɛn na nkasaa na asanku ndzɛmba maa hɔn ndze do riyi EWURADZE ayɛw, dɛ, Na oye; na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa no: Nna mununkum bɛhyɛɛ dan no ma, mekyerɛ EWURADZE ne dan no a,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na osian mununkum no ntsi asɔfo no enntum enngyina annsom: osiandɛ EWURADZE n’enyimnyam ahyɛ Nyankopɔn ne dan no ma.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Solomon kaa dɛ, EWURADZE ase dɛ, ɔbɛtsena sum kebii mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na emi dze, mesi dan ayɛ tsenabew ama wo, na beebi a ebɛtsena hɔ daa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no daan n’enyi, na ohyiraa Israel mboanofo nyinara: na Israel mboanofo no nyinara gyinagyinaa tsentsen.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nhyira nka EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn a ɔdze n’ano kyerɛɛ m’egya David, na ɔdze ne nsa ahyɛ no ma, dɛ,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ofitsi da a medze me man mifi Egypt asaase do mebae no, mannsan mu ennyi kurow bi emmfi Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu dɛ wonsi mu dan, ma me dzin ntsena hɔ; nkyii so mannsan mu ennyi nyimpa biara dɛ ondzi panyin wɔ me man Israel do:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: mbom masan mu eyi Jerusalɛm, dɛ me dzin ntsena hɔ; na masan mu eyi David dɛ ɔnhwɛ me man Israel do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei ɔwɔ m’egya David n’akoma mu dɛ nkyɛ obesi dan ama EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ne dzin.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE see m’egya David dɛ, Susuampa dɛ ɔwɔ w’akoma mu dɛ nkyɛ ibesi dan ama me dzin no, ayɛ no yie dɛ ɔwɔ w’akoma mu:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: naaso ɔwoara nnkesi dan no, na mbom wo ba a ofi w’asen mu bɛba no, ɔno na obesi dan no ama me dzin.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE ama n’asɛm a ɔkae no ahyɛ ma; na masoɛr mahyɛ m’egya David n’ananmu, na metse Israel ahengua do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE bɔɔ anohoba no, na mesi dan no ama EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ne dzin.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔ na medze adaka no a EWURADZE n’ahyɛmu a ɔnye Israelmba dzii no wɔ mu no esi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ogyinaa EWURADZE n’afɔrmbukyia no enyim wɔ Israel mboanofo no nyinara enyim, na ɔtrɛɛ ne nsamu:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: (osiandɛ Solomon ayɛ boran sumpii bi a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa ebien na fa, na ne tɛtɛr basafa ebien na fa, na no krɔn basafa kor na fa, na ɔdze esi abangua no ne finimfin; na ɔno do na okegyinae, na ɔkotoow n’anankoroma enyim wɔ Israel mboanofo no nyinara enyim, na ɔtrɛɛ ne nsamu wɔ sor:)
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, Onyankopɔn bi nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo, wɔ sor, anaa asaase do a isie ahyɛmu na mbɔbɔrhu ma wo nkowaa a wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara nantsew w’enyim:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ɔwo a esie dza edze bɔɔ w’akowaa m’egya David anohoba no ama no: nyew, ɔwo edze w’ano kae, na edze wo nsa ahyɛ no ma, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, sie dza edze abɔ anohoba ama w’akowaa m’egya David no ma no, dɛ, Nyimpa a ɔbɛtsena Israel ahengua do rommbɔ wo wɔ m’enyim; sɛ wo mba hwɛ hɔn kwan yie, dɛ wɔbɛnantsew wɔ me mbra mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo anantsew wɔ m’enyim yi ara a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, ma w’asɛm a ekaa kyerɛɛ w’akowaa David no ntsim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ma aso ampa dɛ Nyankopɔn bɛtsena nyimpa nkyɛn wɔ asaase do a? Hwɛ, ɔsor na ɔsor no sorsor mpo nntum nnkora wo; na ankantam ɔdan yi a mesi yi!
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Naaso EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn, bu w’akowaa ne mpaabɔ, na no ntotɔserɛ bi, dɛ ibetsie w’akowaa ne nkekamu na ne mpaabɔ a ɔrobɔ no w’enyim yi:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: dɛ w’enyi bobue wɔ ɔdan yi do adzekyee na adzesaa, mekyerɛ bea a ɔwoara ase dɛ edze wo dzin bɛtsena hɔ no do; dɛ ibetsie mpaabɔ a w’akowaa bɔbɔ akyerɛ bea yi do no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na tsie w’akowaa na wo man Israel ntotɔserɛ, aber a wɔrobɔ mpaa kyerɛ bea yi do; nyew, tsie no wɔ wo tsenabea hɔ, mekyerɛ ɔsor a; na sɛ etse a, fa fir.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Sɛ nyimpa bi yɛ bɔn tsia ne nyɛnko, na ntam bi bɛda no do dɛ ɔka, na ɔba bɛka ntam wɔ w’afɔrmbukyia enyim wɔ ofi yi mu a:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ sor, na yɛ, na bu wo nkowaa atsɛn, dɛ erehyɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi no ananmu, ma no kwan eebua nankasa n’etsifi; na irubu ɔtseneneenyi no bem, ma aama no dɛ mbrɛ ne ndzeyɛtsenenee tse.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na sɛ wɔka wo man Israel gu wɔ atamfo enyim, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo ntsi; na wɔsan ba bio bɔbɔ wo dzin, na wɔbɔ mpaa na wɔtotɔ serɛ wɔ w’enyim wɔ ofi yi mu a:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ sor, na fa wo man Israel hɔn bɔn kyɛ, na fa hɔn bra asaase a ɔwoara dze maa hɔn na hɔn egyanom no do bio.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Sɛ wɔtow sor mu, na nyankom nntɔ, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo ntsi; na sɛ wɔbɔ mpaa kyerɛ bea yi do, na wɔbɔ wo dzin, na wɔsan fi hɔn bɔn ho, dɛ ahaw hɔn ntsi a:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ sor, na fa wo nkowaa na wo man Israel hɔn bɔn kyɛ hɔn, dɛ erekyerɛ hɔn ɔkwan pa a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔfa do; na ma nyankom ntɔ ngu w’asaase a ɔwoara dze ama wo man dɛ egyapadze no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Sɛ ɔkɔm ba asaase no do, sɛ ɔyardɔm ba, sɛ ehuw anaa ɔpo, mbɛbɛw anaa nkonyinko ba; sɛ hɔn atamfo botua hɔn wɔ hɔn nkuropon asaase do; owuyar biara anaa yarba biara ba a;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: mpaabɔ na ntotɔserɛ biara a nyimpa biara, anaa wo man Israel nyinara bɛyɛ a nyimpa biara bohu nankasa no wuyar na nankasa ne yaw, na ɔbɛtrɛ ne nsamu akyerɛ ofi yi do no:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor wo tsenabea hɔ, na fa kyɛ, na ma nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ n’akwan nyinara tse, nyia ɔwoara inyim n’akoma mu a; (osiandɛ ɔwo, mekyerɛ ɔwoara nkotoo, na inyim nyimpa mba hɔn akoma mu;)
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ama woeesuro wo, na wɔaanantsew w’akwan do, mber tsentsen a wɔdze bɛtsena asaase a ɔwoara edze maa hɔn egyanom no do no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so ɔhɔho a ommfi wo man Israel mu ho dze, sɛ wo dzin kɛse, na wo tum nsa, na w’abasa a atsen mu no ntsi, ma ofi ekyirekyir man bi mu ba; na sɛ wɔba bɔbɔ mpaa kyerɛ dan yi do a:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ɔno ɔwoara tsie wɔ ɔsor, mekyerɛ wo tsenabea hɔ, na yɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔhɔho no su frɛ wo no nyinara; ma asaase do aman nyinara eehu wo dzin, na woeesuro wo, dɛ mbrɛ wo man Israel yɛ, na woeehu dɛ wo dzin na wɔdze frɛ ɔdan yi a mesi yi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Sɛ wo man fir edzi nye hɔn atamfo kedzi ako, wɔ ɔkwan biara a ɔwoara bɔsoma hɔn do, na wɔbɔ wo mpaa kyerɛ kurow a asan mu eyi, na dan a mesi ama wo dzin yi do a:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ɔno ɔwoara tsie hɔn mpaabɔ na hɔn ntotɔserɛ wɔ sor, na dzi hɔn asɛm ma hɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Sɛ wɔyɛ bɔn tsia wo, (osiandɛ nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ a onnyi bɔn,) na wo bo fuw hɔn, na iyi hɔn ma atamfo, ma wɔfa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔ asaase bi do ekyirekyir o, ɔbɛn o;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: naaso sɛ hɔnara wɔdwen wɔ asaase a wɔafa hɔn ndɔmmum akɔ do no do, na wɔsan bio, na wɔtotɔ serɛ wo wɔ hɔn ndɔmmum asaase no do, dɛ, Yɛayɛ bɔn, yeetwa nkontompɔ, yeedzi emumuyɛsɛm;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: sɛ wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara na hɔn kra nyinara san ba wo nkyɛn wɔ hɔn ndɔmmum asaase no do, mbrɛ wɔafa hɔn ndɔmmum akɔ no, na woyi mpaa kyerɛ hɔn asaase a ɔwoara edze maa hɔn egyanom, na kurow a ɔwoara asan mu eyi, na wɔkyerɛ ɔdan a mesi ama wo dzin yi do a:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ɔno ɔwoara tsie hɔn mpaabɔ na hɔn ntotɔserɛ wɔ sor, mekyerɛ wo tsenabea hɔ, na dzi hɔn asɛm ma hɔn; na fa kyɛ wo man a wɔayɛ bɔn etsia wo no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei, me Nyankopɔn, meserɛ wo, bue w’enyiwa, na kyɛn w’aso wɔ mpaabɔ a wɔbɔ wɔ ha yi do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, soɛr kɔ w’ahomgyebea no mu, ɔwo, na w’ahoɔdzen adaka no: EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, ma w’asɔfoe nya nkwagye, na ma w’ahotseweefo enyi ngye wɔ papa mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, mma nndan wo nyia asera no no enyi: kaa w’akowaa David adɔyɛ no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Solomon wiee mpaa bɔ no, ogya fi sor dwirii, na ɔbɛhyeew ɔhyew afɔr na okum afɔr no; na EWURADZE n’enyimnyam bɛhyɛɛ dan no ma.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na asɔfo no enntum annhɛn EWURADZE ne dan no mu, osiandɛ EWURADZE n’enyimnyam no ahyɛ EWURADZE ne dan no ma.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a ogya no rudwir, na EWURADZE n’enyimnyam reba ofi no do no, Israelmba no nyinara hwɛe; na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mu adze dze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu wɔ abonsɛwee no do sɔree, na wɔdaa EWURADZE ase, dɛ, Na oye, na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔhen no na ɔman no nyinara bɔɔ okum afɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen Solomon dze anantwi mpemeduonu ebien, na nguan mpemɔha eduonu bɔɔ okum afɔr. Dɛm na ɔhen no na ɔman no nyinara dze tseew Nyankopɔn fi no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na asɔfo no gyinagyina hɔ, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nhwɛdodwuma tsetsee; Levifo no so kitsakitsa EWURADZE no ndwom ho ndzɛmba a ɔhen David yɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa nda EWURADZE ase, dɛ, n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa, aber a David nam hɔn som do yii ayɛw no: na asɔfo no henhɛɛn mbɛn wɔ hɔn enyim; na Israel nyinara gyinagyinaa hɔ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so Solomon yɛɛ abangua a ɔwɔ EWURADZE fi no enyim no ne finimfin no krɔnkrɔn; na hɔ na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr, na asomdwee afɔr ho seradze no: osiandɛ boran afɔrmbukyia a Solomon yɛe no, ɔhyew afɔr, na edziban afɔr, na seradze no nnsen do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Solomon hyɛɛ fa no aber no mu, nda esuon, na Israel nyinara ka no ho, mboanofo kɛsenara, wofi Hamat ahɛnee dze kodu Egypt ɔwora no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na da a otsia awɔtwe no wɔbɔɔ ngua a ɔtaa dzinn: na afɔrmbukyia no ne ntsewho no wodzii no nda esuon, na afahyɛ no so nda esuon.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na bosoom a otsia esuon no ne da a otsia eduonu ebiasa no, nna ogyaa ɔman no kwan ma wɔkɔr hɔn asesee mu, wɔdze enyigye na akoma pa wɔ yie a EWURADZE ayɛ ama David, na Solomon, na ne man Israel no ntsi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Solomon wiee EWURADZE ne fie, na ɔhen ne fie no: na dza ɔbaa Solomon n’akoma mu nyinara dɛ ɔbɛyɛ wɔ EWURADZE ne fie mu, na nankasa ne fie mu nyinara, owiee yɛ dwudwoodwo.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE yii noho kyerɛɛ Solomon anadwe, na ɔsee no dɛ, Matse wo mpaabɔ, na masan mu eyi bea yi ama moho dɛ afɔrbɔ fie.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Sɛ motow ɔsor mu ma nyankom nntɔ, anaa sɛ mehyɛ mbɛbɛw dɛ wɔmbɛmen asaase no, anaa medze ɔyardɔm ba me man mu;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na sɛ me man a wɔdze me dzin frɛ hɔn no brɛ hɔnho adze, na wɔbɔ mpaa, na wɔhwehwɛ m’enyim, na wɔsan fi hɔn kwan bɔn do a; ɔno mibefi sor metsie, na medze hɔn bɔn akyɛ hɔn, na mayɛ hɔn asaase no edur.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei mubobue m’enyiwa, na makyɛn m’aso, wɔ mpaabɔ a wɔbɔ no, wɔ ha yi do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na afei na masan mu eyi fie yi na mayɛ no krɔnkrɔn, dɛ me dzin ntsena hɔ daa: na m’enyiwa na m’akoma bɛtsena hɔ daa nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔwo dze, sɛ ebɛnantsew m’enyim dɛ mbrɛ w’egya David nantsewee, na ayɛ dɛ mbrɛ medze ahyɛ wo no nyinara, na edzi m’ahyɛdze na m’atsɛmbu no do a;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ɔno mebɛma w’ahendzi ahengua etsim hɔ, dɛ mbrɛ menye w’egya David dzii ahyɛmu, dɛ, Wɔremma nyimpa a ɔbɛyɛ Israel do ɔhwɛfo mmbɔ wo no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na sɛ hom san, na wɔpow m’ahyɛdze na me mbransɛm a medze esi hom enyim yi, na hom kɔ kɔsom enyame fofor, na wɔsɔr hɔn a:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ɔno mubotu hɔn efi m’asaase a medze ama hom no do; na ofi a mayɛ no krɔnkrɔn ama me dzin yi, mobɔtow efi m’enyi do akyen, na mayɛ no ɔkasabɛbu na fen wɔ aman nyinara mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ofi yi a ɔkrɔn dɛm yi, obiara a obotwa mu wɔ ho no, no ho bɔbow no, na ɔase dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na EWURADZE ayɛ asaase yi, na ofi yi dɛm yi?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wobobua dɛ, Osiandɛ wɔpoow EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn a ɔdze hɔn fii Egypt asaase do bae no, na wɔkɛtae suoo enyame fofor mu sɔɔr hɔn, na wɔsoom hɔn: dɛm ntsi na ɔdze mbusu yi nyinara aba hɔn do yi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ mfe eduonu a Solomon dze sisii EWURADZE ne fi, na nankasa ne fi, n’ewiei no,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: nna nkurow a Huram dze maa Solomon no, Solomon kyekyeree, na ɔmaa Israelmba kɛtsenatsenaa hɔ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon sii mu kɔr Hamat-zoba, na okedzii do nyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔkyekyeer Tadmor wɔ sar no do, na adzekora nkurow a ɔkyekyeer no wɔ Hamat no nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Eso ɔkyekyeer etsifi Bɛt-horon, na anaafo Bɛt-horon, nkurow a wɔagyegye ho ban a ɔwowɔ afasu, nkuropon, na apon ekyir adaban;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na Baalat, na adzekora nkurow a Solomon wɔ no nyinara, na ne ntseaseanam nkurow nyinara, na no mpɔnkɔdofo nkurow, na dza Solomon pɛɛ dɛ ɔkyekyer dze gye n’enyi wɔ Jerusalɛm nyinara, na Lebanon, na n’ahendzi asaase no nyinara mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na nkorɔfo a wɔkae wɔ Hitifo, na Amorifo, na Perizfo, na Hivifo, na Jebusfo mu nyinara a wommfi Israel mu no dze;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: hɔn mba a wɔkaa hɔn ekyir wɔ asaase no do no a Israelmba enntum annsɛɛ hɔn pasapasa no bi no, hɔn na Solomon gyegyee hɔn enyadze ɔtowdwuma dze bodur ndɛ da yi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelmba no mu dze, Solomon annyɛ mu bi n’edwuma mu nkowaa; na hɔn nye mbarimba akofo, na n’asafohemfo do etsitsir, na ne ntseaseanam na no mpɔnkɔdofo do mpanyimfo.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na woyinom nye ɔhen Solomon n’ahwɛdofo mu etsitsir; mekyerɛ nyimpa ahaenu eduonum a wɔhwɛ nkorɔfo no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon dze Farao babaa no fii David kurow mu baa ofi a oesi ama no no mu: na ɔsee dɛ, Me yer nnkɛtsena Israelhen David fie, osiandɛ beebi mbrɛ EWURADZE n’adakaa no aba hɔ no yɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Solomon bɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr maa EWURADZE wɔ EWURADZE n’afɔrmbukyia a osii no wɔ nkrandaa no enyim no do,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: da biara na no mu dza ɔsɛ no na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr no, dɛ mbrɛ Moses ne mbrasɛm tse, ahomgyenda dze, bosoom fofor dze na afahyɛ dze, afrenhyia mu mpɛn ebiasa, mekyerɛ epitsi afahyɛ no mu, na adapɛn nda afahyɛ no mu, na ntamadan afahyɛ no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya David ne mbra no tse no ɔdze asɔfo no hɔn nkyekyɛmu no sisii hɔn som do, na Levifo no so hɔn nhwɛdodwuma mu, dɛ wonyi ayɛw, na wɔnsom wɔ asɔfo no enyim, dɛ mbrɛ da biara no mu edwuma gye: mbobowano ahwɛfo no so dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyekyɛmu tse wɔ kuropon biara ano: na dɛm na Nyame nyimpa David hyɛe.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na woemmfi ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm a ɔwɔ asɔfo na Levifo no do wɔ asɛm biara, anaa akoradze no ho emmfi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Solomon n’edwuma nyinara wosiesiei maa da a wɔtoow EWURADZE ne dan no ne fapem, na okodur dɛ wowiei. Nna wowiee EWURADZE ne fi no korakora.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Solomon sii mu kɔr Ezion-geber, na Elot, wɔ mpoano wɔ Edom asaase do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Huram nam no nkowaa nsa do dze ahɛn, na nkowaa a wɔwɔ po ho nyimdzee brɛɛ no; na wɔnye Solomon no nkowaa no kɔr Ofir, na wɔkɛfaa hɔ sika kɔkɔɔ talent ahaanan eduonum, na wɔdze brɛɛ ɔhen Solomon.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Seba ɔhembaa no tsee Solomon ne nka no, nna ɔbaa dɛ ɔdze nsɛmbisa dzendzen robɔsɔ Solomon ahwɛ wɔ Jerusalɛm, ɔnye akadofo kɛsenara, na efumpɔnkɔ a wɔsoso nduhuam, na sika piigyan, na abo a ɔsom bo; na aber a ɔbaa Solomon nkyɛn no, ɔnye no twetwee dza ɔwɔ n’akoma mu nyinara ho nkɔmbɔ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon maa no ne nsɛmbisa nyinara ho mbuae: na asɛm biara nnyi hɔ a Solomon enntum amma no mbuae.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Seba ɔhembaa no hun Solomon ne nyansaa, na ofi a oesi,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na no pon do edziban, na no nkowaa hɔn atsenae, na n’asomfo ngyinaamu, na hɔn ntar; ne nsahyɛfo so, na hɔn ntar; na n’afowee a ɔnam do fow kɔ EWURADZE fie no; noho boow no mbordo.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, Wo ndwuma na wo nyansaa ho asɛm a metsee no wɔ mankasa m’asaase do no yɛ nokwar.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Naaso manngye hɔn nsɛm no menndzi, dze bodu dɛ mebae, na medze m’enyiwa mubohu yi: na, hwɛ, saana wɔannka wo nyansaa ne kɛseyɛ ne fa mpo annkyerɛ me: ɔwo ebor nka a metsee no do koraa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ahomka aka wo nkorɔfo, na ahomka aka wo nkowaa yi a wogyinagyina w’enyim daa, na wotsie wo nyansaa no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nhyira nka w’EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔpɛ w’asɛm dɛ ɔdze wo esi n’ahengua do, dɛ dzi hen ma w’EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn: na osiandɛ wo Nyankopɔn dɔ Israel, dɛ ɔdze hɔn betsim hɔ daa ntsi na ɔahyɛ wo hɔn do hen, dɛ ma pɛrpɛryɛ na tsenenee nyɛ edwuma.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔmaa ɔhen no sika talent ɔha eduonu, na nduhuam piigyan, na abo a ɔsom bo: na eduhuam a ɔtse dɛm dɛ mbrɛ Seba ɔhembaa no dze maa ɔhen Solomon no bi ammba bio.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Huram no nkowaa, na Solomon no nkowaa no a wɔdze sika fi Ofir bae no, wɔdze algum ndua na abo a ɔsom bo so bae.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no dze algum ndua no yɛɛ EWURADZE ne fi na ɔhen ne fi no ho edum, na nsankutsen na bɛnta asanku maa adwontofo no: na wonnhun bi dɛm pɛn wɔ Juda asaase do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen Solomon maa Seba ɔhembaa no n’apɛdze nyinara, biribiara a obisae nyina, ɔsor dza ɔdze brɛɛ ɔhen no. Nna odzii ndan, na osii mu kɔr nankasa n’asaase do, ɔno na no nkowaa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei sika a ɔbaa Solomon hɔ wɔ afe kor mu no ne nkerii yɛ sika talent ahaesia eduosia esia;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔsor dza konkosifo na eguadzifo dze bae no: na Arabia ahemfo nyinara na ɔman no mu ambradofo no so wɔdze sika na dwetɛ brɛɛ Solomon.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen Solomon dze sika a wɔabor yɛɛ akyɛm akɛse ahaenu: sika a wɔabor dwetɛbona ahaesia na ɔdze duraa kyɛm kor ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze sika a wɔabor yɛɛ akyɛm nkakraba ahaasa; sika dwetɛbona ahaasa na ɔdze duraa kyɛm kor ho: na ɔhen no dze koguu Lebanon kwaa dan no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so ɔhen no yɛɛ asombɛn ahengua kɛsenara, na ɔdze sika mapa duraa ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ahengua no ho wɔ ntwerba esia, nye sika ananadzegua a wɔabobɔ mu afam ahengua no ho, na nsa wowɔ afa na afa wɔ atsenaa no ho, na ngyata ebien gyinagyina nsa no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ngyata duebien gyinagyina ntwerba esia no do hɔ wɔ afa ha na ha: wɔnnyɛɛ dza ɔtse dɛm bi da wɔ ahenman biara mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen Solomon no kɔɔpow a ɔnom mu nyinara sika dze a, na Lebanon kwaa dan no mu nkɔɔpow nyinara sika mapa a: dwetɛ dze wommbu no hwee wɔ Solomon ne nda no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no wɔ ahɛn a wɔnye Huram no nkowaa no kɔ Tarsis: mfensa biara mu Tarsis ahɛn no ba prɛko, wɔdze sika kɔkɔɔ, na dwetɛ, asombɛn, na ndɔpe, na koohaa ba.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔhen Solomon boor asaase do ahemfo nyinara do wɔ ahonya na nyansa mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na asaase do ahemfo nyinara hwehwɛɛ Solomon n’enyim ehu, dɛ wobetsie ne nyansaa a Nyankopɔn dze ahyɛ n’akoma mu no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn mu nyimpa biara dze n’ayɛyɛdze bae, dwetɛ ndzɛmba, na sika ndzɛmba, na ntar, akodze, na nduhuam, mpɔnkɔ, na nsoasopɔnkɔ, afrenhyiadze afrenhyia afrenhyia.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon nyaa mpɔnkɔ na ntseaseanam ho mpɔnkɔdan mpemanan, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemduebien a ɔdze hɔn siesiee ntseaseanam nkurow no mu, na ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhwɛɛ ahemfo no nyinara do dze fi Esutsen no ho araa dze kodur Filistiafo asaase do, na Egypt ahe do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no maa dwetɛ yɛɛ dɛ abo wɔ Jerusalɛm, na ɔmaa nkyindur so yɛɛ dɛ ankye ndua a ɔwowɔ abɔnmu nkurow mu, wɔ ɔdodow mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze mpɔnkɔ fi Egypt, na asaase nyinara brɛɛ Solomon.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Solomon ho nsɛm nkaa no, kan dze na ekyir dze, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan n’abakɔsɛm, na Silonnyi Ahija no nkɔnhyɛsɛm, na ɔdzehunyi Iddo n’enyido adzehusɛm a Nebat ne ba Jeroboam hunii no mu bi a?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon dzii Israel nyinara do hen wɔ Jerusalɛm mfe eduanan.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Solomon kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ n’egya David kurow mu: na ne ba Rehoboam dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Rehoboam sii mu kɔr Sekem: osiandɛ Israel nyinara aba Sekem dɛ wɔrebɛhyɛ no hen.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Nebat ba Jeroboam tsee no, (osiandɛ ɔda ho wɔ Egypt, mbrɛ oguanee fii ɔhen Solomon enyim kɔree no,) nna Jeroboam sanee fii Egypt bae.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ no; na Jeroboam na Israel nyinara bae, na wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ Rehoboam, dɛ,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: W’egya yɛɛ hɛn kɔndua durdur: dɛm ntsi afei yɛ w’egya no som dzendzen, na no kɔndua durdur a ɔdze too hɛn do no, harhar, na yɛnsom wo.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ondzi ndaansa, na hom mbra me nkyɛn bio. Na ɔman no twee mu kɔree.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen Rehoboam nye nkɔdaa a wɔsoom n’egya Solomon dɛ apamfo mber a nna ɔtse ase no faa apam dɛ, Afotu bɛn na hom dze rema me ma medze mbuae aasan akɛma ɔman yi?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ ayamuyie ma ɔman yi, na esɔ hɔn enyi, na eka nsɛm pa kyerɛ hɔn a, ɔno wɔbɛyɛ wo nkowaa daa nyina.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔpoow nkɔdaa no hɔn apam a wɔdze maa no no, na ɔnye mberantsɛ a wɔnye no nyinii a wɔsom no dɛ apamfo no faa apam.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Afotu bɛn na hom dze ma, ma yɛdze mbuae aasan akɛma ɔman yi a wɔaka akyerɛ me dɛ, Yɛ kɔndua a w’egya dze too hɛn do no harhar no?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na mberantsɛ a wɔnye no nyinii no kaa kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, Dɛm na ka kyerɛ ɔman yi a wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ wo, dɛ, W’egya yɛɛ hɛn kɔndua durdur, na ɔwo dze yɛ no harhar ma hɛn no; dɛm na ka kyerɛ hɔn, Me nsatseaba kakraba ɔyɛ dur sen m’egya n’asen.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na afei susuampa dɛ m’egya dze kɔndua durdur soaa hom no, emi so mobɔto hom kɔndua no do: m’egya dze mpire tseaa hom, na emi dze medze nyankoma nketsebowa mebɛtsea hom.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Jeroboam na ɔman no nyinara baa Rehoboam nkyɛn da a otsia ebiasa no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no kae no, dɛ, Da a otsia ebiasa no hom mbra me nkyɛn bio no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no buaa hɔn ebufuw mu; na ɔhen Rehoboam poow nkɔdaa no hɔn apam no,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ mberantsɛ no hɔn apam no tse, dɛ, M’egya yɛɛ hom kɔndua durdur, na emi dze, mobɔto do: m’egya dze mpire tseaa hom, na emi dze, medze nyankoma nketsebowa mebɛtsea hom.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔhen no enntsie ɔman no; osiandɛ ofi Nyankopɔn hɔ na ɔbaa dɛm, ama EWURADZE eetsim n’asɛm a ɔnam Silonnyi Ahija ne nsa do kaa kyerɛɛ Nebat ba Jeroboam no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Israel nyinara hun dɛ ɔhen no enntsie hɔn no, nna ɔman no buaa ɔhen no, dɛ, Ebɛn kyɛpɛn na yɛwɔ wɔ David mu? Nkyii so yennyi egyapadze wɔ Jesse ne ba no mu: Israel e, hom nkɔ hom asesee mu o: afei David, hwɛ wankasa wo fie. Nna Israel nyinara sii mu kɔr hɔn asesee mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelmba a wɔtsetse Juda nkurow mu no dze Rehoboam dzii hɔn do hen.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔhen Rehoboam somaa Hadoram a ɔhwɛ ɔtowdwuma do no; na Israelmba no siiw no abo, ma ɔtɔree. Na ɔhen Rehoboam yɛɛ ntsɛm foow ne tseaseanam, dɛ oruguan akɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Israel tseew etua wɔ David fi do, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Rehoboam baa Jerusalɛm no, ohyiahyiaa Juda na Benjamin ofi, nyimpa a wɔasan mu eyi mpem ɔha eduowɔtwe a wɔyɛ akofo ano, dɛ ɔnye Israel rokɔko, adan ahendzi no ama Rehoboam bio.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Nyame nyimpa Semaia nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ka kyerɛ Solomon ba Rehoboam, Judahen, na Israel nyinara a wɔwɔ Juda na Benjamin, dɛ,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mma hom mmfow nnkɔ, nkyii so mma wɔnnye hom nuanom nnkɔko: nyimpa biara nsan nkɔ ne fie, na asɛm yi fir mara. Nna wotsiee EWURADZE ne nsɛm no, na wofii Jeroboam do nkɔree no do sanee.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Rehoboam tsenaa Jerusalɛm, na ɔkyekyeer twitwagye nkurow wɔ Juda.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ɔkyekyeer Bɛtlɛhɛm so, na Etam, na Tekoa,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na Bɛt-zur, na Soko, na Adullam,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na Gat, na Maresa, na Zif,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na Adoraim, na Lakis, na Azeka,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na Zora, na Aijalon, na Hebron a wɔwɔ Juda na Benjamin mu, nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhyehyɛɛ akoban no dzen, na ɔdze asafohemfo, na akɔhomabɔdze, na ngo na nsa, akoradze koguu mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze akyɛm na mpeaa kurakuraa nkurow ahorow nyinara mu, na ɔyeyɛɛ hɔn dzendzen mbordo. Na Juda na Benjamin yɛɛ nedze.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na asɔfo na Levifo a wɔwɔ Israel nyinara mu no fi hɔn ahe nyinara do kɔr ne nkyɛn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Levifo no gyaa hɔn mfikyisaase na hɔn enyadze hɔ, na wɔbaa Juda na Jerusalɛm: osiandɛ Jeroboam na ne mba tuu hɔn dɛ mma wonndzi EWURADZE n’asɔfoe:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔhyehyɛɛ n’asɔfoe maa mbea sorɔnsorɔm no, na mpɔnkyenyin, na anantwimba a ɔyɛe no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn ekyir no, hɔn a wɔdze hɔn akoma maa dɛ wobefi Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu ahwehwɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, wɔbaa Jerusalɛm, dɛ wɔrobɔbɔ afɔr ama EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna wɔyɛɛ Juda ahendzi no dzendzen, na wɔhyɛɛ Solomon ba Rehoboam dzen, mfe ebiasa: osiandɛ wɔnantseew David na Solomon kwan do mfe ebiasa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Rehoboam waar David ne ba Jerimot ne babaa Mahalat, na Jesse ba Eliab ne babaa Abihail;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔwoo mba maa no; Jeus, na Semaria, na Zaham.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔno n’ekyir na ɔwaar Absalom ne babaa Maaka; na ɔwoo Abija, na Attai, na Ziza, na Selomit maa no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Rehoboam dɔɔ Absalom ne babaa Maaka seen ne yernom na no nwewefo nyinara: (na ɔwaar yernom duawɔtwe, na nwewefo eduosia, na ɔwoo mbabanyin eduonu awɔtwe na mbabaa eduosia.)
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Rehoboam hyɛɛ Maaka ne ba Abija otsitsir, mekyerɛ no nuanom mu ɔpanyin: osiandɛ ɔdween dɛ ɔbɛyɛ no ɔhen.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔyɛɛ no nyansa mu, na ɔdze ne mbabanyin no nyinara mu binom petsee Juda na Benjamin asaase nyinara do, kurow biara a wɔabɔ ho ban mu: na ɔmaa hɔn akɔhomabɔdze piigyan. Na ɔhwehwɛɛ yernom pii memaa hɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Rehoboam n’ahendzi tsintsimii na ɔyɛɛ dzen no, nna ɔpoow EWURADZE ne mbra, na Israel nyinara ka no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔhen Rehoboam n’afe a otsia enum no mu, nna Egypthen Sasak fowee baa Jerusalɛm do, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ɔdze ntseaseanam apem ahaenu, na mpɔnkɔdofo mpemeduosia: na nkorɔfo a wɔnye no fi Egypt bae no dɔɔ so dodow; Lubifo, Sukifo, na Etiopiafo.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔgyegyee nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban no a ɔyɛ Juda dze no, na obodur Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei nkɔnhyɛnyi Semaia baa Rehoboam, na Juda mbapɔmba no a osian Sasak ntsi ma wɔaboa ano wɔ Jerusalɛm no, nkyɛn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi; Hom apow me, dɛm ntsi mo so megyaa hom ahyɛ Sasak nsa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Israel mbapɔmba na ɔhen no wɔbrɛɛ hɔnho adze; na wɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE dzi bem.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a EWURADZE hun dɛ wɔabrɛ hɔnho adze no, EWURADZE baa Semaia nkyɛn, dɛ, Wɔabrɛ hɔnho adze; mennkɛsɛɛ hɔn: mbom ɔyɛ kakra a mebɛma woefi mu, na m’ebufuw runndua Sasak nsa do nnhue nngu Jerusalɛm do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Naaso wɔbɛyɛ no nkowaa; ama woeehu mo som, na aman no ahendzi som no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Egypthen Sasak fowee baa Jerusalɛm do, na ɔbɛfaa EWURADZE ne fie akoradze, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze no; ɔfaa ne nyinara dze kɔree: ɔfaa sika akyɛm a Solomon yɛe no dze kɔree.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen Rehoboam yɛɛ boran akyɛm dze sisii n’ananmu, na ɔdze hyɛɛ abrampɔfo a wɔhwɛ ɔhen ne fie abowano no do asafohemfo no nsa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, mber dodow biara a ɔhen no kɛhɛn EWURADZE ne fie no, abrampɔfo no ba bosusuo mu, na wɔdze san besi abrampɔfo pia no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbrɛɛ noho adze no, EWURADZE n’ebufuw danee fii no do, dɛ ɔmmpɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ no nwionn nwionn: na nkyii so woehu ndze pa wɔ Juda mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔhen Rehoboam hyɛɛ noho dzen wɔ Jerusalɛm, na odzii hen: na aber a Rehoboam hyɛɛ ase dzii hen no nna oedzi mfe eduanan biako, na odzii hen mfe duesuon wɔ Jerusalɛm, kurow no a EWURADZE saan mu yii no wɔ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw nyinara mu dɛ ɔdze ne dzin bɔto hɔ no a: na ne na ne dzin dze Naama, Ammonnyi a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo, osiandɛ ɔammfa n’akoma ennsi do dɛ ɔbɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Rehoboam no ho nsɛm, kan dze na ekyir dze ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Semaia na adzehunyi Iddo abakɔsɛm no mu, dɛ mbrɛ ebusuasantsen no tsetsee bi a? Na akodzi daa Rehoboam na Jeroboam ntamu daa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Rehoboam kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ David kurow mu: na ne babanyin Abija dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ɔhen Jeroboam n’afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu na Abija hyɛɛ ase dzii hen wɔ Juda do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Mfe ebiasa na odzii hen wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Mikaia, Uriel a ofi Gibea ne babaa a. Na akodzi baa Abija na Jeroboam ntamu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Abija dze dɔm mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam, mekyerɛ mbarimba a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn mpemahaanan, kɔr akono: na Jeroboam dze mbarimba a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn a wɔyɛ mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam, mpem ahaawɔtwe, baa mpasuar kehyiaa no:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na Abija kegyinaa bepɔw Zemaraim a ɔwɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu no do, na ɔsee dɛ, Jerusalɛm na Israel, Hom ntsie me;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ana ɔnnsɛ dza hom hu dɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, dze Israel do ahendzi no maa David daa, mekyerɛ dɛ ɔnam nkyen ahyɛmudzi do dze maa ɔno na ne mba no bi a?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Naaso Nebat ba Jeroboam, David ba Solomon n’akowaa no soɛree tseew no wura do etua.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na nyimpa huhuw, asansafo bi, boaa ano kɔr ne nkyɛn a wɔhyɛɛ hɔnho dzen tsiaa Solomon ba Rehoboam, wɔ aber a Rehoboam yɛ aberantsɛ na n’akoma yɛ mberɛw, na onnkotum esiw hɔn kwan.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na afei hom dwen dɛ hom besiw EWURADZE n’ahendzi no a ɔwɔ David mba nsamu no kwan; osiandɛ hom yɛ nyimpadodow kɛse, na sika anantwimba a Jeroboam yɛe maa hom dɛ hom enyame no wɔ hom nkyɛn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ana hom nnyiyii EWURADZE n’asɔfoe, Aaron mbabanyin no, na Levifo no edzi, na hom nhyehyɛɛ asɔfo mma homho dɛ mbrɛ asaase binom do aman no tsetsee? Dɛm ntsi obiara a ɔdze nantwisaa eburwa na nguannyin esuon ba dɛ wɔmfa no nsi nkyɛn no, ɔnoara na ɔnyɛ ɔsɔfo mma hɔn a wɔnnyɛ enyame no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hɛn dze, EWURADZE nye hɛn Nyankopɔn, na yɛmmpoow no; na yɛwɔ asɔfo a wɔsom EWURADZE, Aaronmba no a, na Levifo no wɔwɔ hɔn edwuma mu:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na anapa biara, na ewimbir biara wɔhyew ɔhyew afɔr na eduhuam pa ma EWURADZE: wosiesie kyerɛpaanoo so yie wɔ pon krɔnkrɔn no do; na sika kandzeadua na ne nkandzea no, ma ɔdzɛw ewimbir biara: na hɛn na yɛhwɛ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn n’ahwɛdodze no do; na hom dze, hom apow no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na, hwɛ, Nyankopɔn ka hɛn ho dzi hɛn kan, na n’asɔfoe dzedze osebɔ mbɛn dɛ wɔdze bɛhɛn osebɔ etsia hom. Israel e, mma hom nnye EWURADZE, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn no nnko; na onnkesi hom yie.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jeroboam hyɛɛ atsɛweefo bɔɔ aprɔw, ma wobopuee hɔn ekyir: na wobedzii Juda enyim, na atsɛweefo no dzii hɔn ekyir.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Juda twaa hɔn enyi ekyir no, hwɛ nna dɔm no wɔ hɔn enyim na hɔn ekyir: na wosui frɛɛ EWURADZE, na asɔfo no hehɛɛn mbɛn no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Juda mbarimba no bɔɔ ose gyee do: na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Juda mbarimba no bɔɔ ose no, nna Nyankopɔn kaa Jeroboam na Israel nyinara gya wɔ Abija na Juda enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelmba no gui wɔ Juda enyim: na Nyankopɔn yii hɔn hyɛɛ hɔn nsa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Abija na ne man kunkum hɔn oku kɛse: ma dɛm ntsi hɔn a wɔhwee ase totɔree wɔ Israel mu wɔyɛ mbarimba a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn mpemahaenum.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Mbrɛ wosii brɛɛ Israelmba no adze aber no no nye yi, na Judamba no dzii nyim, osiandɛ wɔtweer EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Abija tsiiw Jeroboam, na ɔkɛgyegyee ne nsamu nkurow, Bɛtɛl nye no nkurobaase, na Jesana nye no nkurobaase, na Efron nye no nkurobaase.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so Jeroboam ennya ahoɔdzen bio wɔ Abija ne nda no mu: na EWURADZE bɔɔ no ma owui.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Abija dze ɔhyɛɛ dzen, na ɔwarwaar yernom duanan, na ɔwowoo mbabanyin eduonu ebien, na mbabaa duesia.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Abija no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na n’akwan, na ne nsɛm no, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Iddo ne nkyerɛkyerɛase nwoma no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Abija kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ David kurow mu, na ne ba babanyin Asa dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu: ne nda no mu na asaase no do dwee mfe du.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Asa yɛɛ dza oye na ɔtsen wɔ n’EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn enyi do:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na oyiyii anana afɔrmbukyia, na mbea sorɔnsorɔm no, na odwuruuw edum no, na otwitwaa bosom Aserim no gui;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔhyɛɛ Juda dɛ wɔnhwehwɛ EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no, na wondzi ne mbra na ne mbransɛm no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Eso oyiyii Juda nkurow nyinara do mbea sorɔnsorɔm, na ewia ehonyi no: na ahenman no mu dwee wɔ n’enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔkyekyeer nkurow a ɔyɛ dzen wɔ Juda, osiandɛ asaase no do dwee na oenndzi ako bi wɔ mfe no mu; osiandɛ EWURADZE ama no ahomgye.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES
