text: Na ɔsee Juda dɛ, Hom mma yɛnkyekyer nkurow yi, na yɛnyɛ fasu, na aban atsentsen, mbobotsen, na ndaban wɔ ho; asaase no da ho wɔ hɛn enyim, osiandɛ yɛahwehwɛ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn; yɛahwehwɛ no, na ɔama hɛn ahomgye wɔ afa nyinara. Nna wɔkyekyeree na wɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Asa wɔ dɔm a wosuo akokyɛm na mpeaa mu, Juda mu nyimpa mpemahaasa; na Benjamin mu nyimpa a wosuo akyɛm mu, na wɔtow egyen, mpemahaenu eduowɔtwe: woyinom nyinara mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Etiopianyi Zera dze dɔm mpempem, na ntseaseanam ahaasa fiir edzi baa hɔn do; na obodur Maresa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Asa fiir edzi kehyiaa no na wɔbaa mpasuar no wɔ Zefata bɔnsa mu, wɔ Maresa ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Asa sui frɛɛ EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn, na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, obi nnyi hɔ ka wo ho dɛ ɔbɔboa, wɔ ɔkatakyi na nyia onnyi ahoɔdzen no ntamu: EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn e, boa hɛn; na ɔwoara na yɛtwer wo, na wo dzin mu na yɛaba ribehyia nyimpadodow yi. EWURADZE, ɔwo nye ehɛn Nyankopɔn; mma mma ɔdasanyi nndzi wo do nyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna EWURADZE kaa Etiopiafo no gya wɔ Asa, na Juda enyim; na Etiopiafo no gui.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Asa na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no tsiiw hɔn kodur Gerar: na Etiopiafo no mu nyimpa dodowara hwehwee ase a woenntum anngye hɔnho nkwa; na wɔsɛɛ hɔn wɔ EWURADZE, na no dɔm enyim; na wɔfaa asadze piigyan kɔree.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔkaa nkurow a abɔ Gerar ho aprɔw no nyinara gya; na EWURADZE ho suro baa hɔn do: na wɔfoom nkurow no nyinara; osiandɛ asadze pii wowɔ mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Wɔkɛkaa mbowakuw asesee no so gya, na wɔfaa nguan piigyan na efumpɔnkɔ kɔree, na wɔsanee baa Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Nyankopɔn no sunsum baa Oded ba Azaria do;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ofiir edzi kehyiaa Asa, na ɔsee no dɛ, Asa, na Juda na Benjamin nyinara, hom ntsie me: EWURADZE wɔ hom nkyɛn, aber a hom wɔ ne nkyɛn yi; na sɛ hom hwehwɛ no a, hom bohu no; na sɛ hom pow no dze a, ɔno so ɔbɔpow hom.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei mber tsentsenntsen na Israel tsenae a nna wonnyi nokwar Nyankopɔn, na wonnyi ɔsɔfo so a ɔkyerɛkyerɛ, na wonnyi mbra so:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na sɛ ahokyer mu no wɔsan ba EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no nkyɛn, na wɔhwehwɛ no a, ɔma wohu no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na mber no mu no na asomdwee bi nnyi hɔ mma nyia ofir edzi na nyia ɔba mu so, na ɔfona kɛse wɔ asaase no do atsefo no nyinara do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔbobɔɔ hɔnho pɔsɔpɔsɔ, ɔman tsiaa ɔman, na kurow tsiaa kurow osiandɛ Nyankopɔn dze ahohia nyinara fonaa hɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hom dze, hom nhyɛ dzen, na mma mma hom abaw nngow: na hom edwuma benya akatua.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Asa tsee nsɛm yi, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Oded no nkɔnhyɛ no, nna ɔhyɛɛ dzen, na oyiyii ekyiwadze no fii Juda na Benjamin asaase nyinara do, na nkurow a ɔgyegyee no wɔ Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu no mu; na ɔyɛɛ EWURADZE n’afɔrmbukyia a ɔwɔ EWURADZE ne nkrandaa no enyim no fofor.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ohyiahyiaa Juda na Benjamin nyinara, na hɔn a wofi Efraim na Manaasɛ, na Simeon mu baa hɔn nkyɛn ahɔhotsena no boaa ano; osiandɛ Israel mu piigyan danee baa ne nkyɛn, aber a wohun dɛ n’EWURADZE Nyankopɔn dzi n’ekyir no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna wohyiahyiaa hɔnho kehyiaa Jerusalɛm wɔ bosoom a otsia ebiasa no mu, wɔ Asa n’ahendzi no mu afe a otsia duenum no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na da no wɔdze asadze a wɔdze bae no mu, anantwi ahaesuon na nguan mpemesuon bɔɔ EWURADZE okum afɔr.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wodzii ahyɛmu dɛ wɔdze hɔn akoma nyinara na ɔnye hɔn kra nyinara bɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na dɛ obiara a ɔnnkɛpɛ dɛ ɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, kakraba o, ɔkɛse o, ɔbarimba o, ɔbaa o, wonku no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze ndze kɛse, na esebɔ, na ɔnye nkasamu, na ɔnye mbɛn suae kyerɛɛ EWURADZE.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Juda nyinara hɔn enyi gyee wɔ ntam no ho; osiandɛ hɔn akoma nyinara na wɔdze suae, na wɔdze hɔn pɛ nyinara hwehwɛɛ no; na ɔmaa wohun no: na EWURADZE maa hɔn ahomgye wɔ mbea nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen Asa ne na Maaka so, otuu no fii ahembaadzi mu, osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ ekyiwa honyi bi maa Asera ntsi; na Asa twaa no honyi no, na ɔyɛɛ no huntuhuntu, na ɔkɛhyeew no wɔ ɔwora Kidron ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Asa enntum ennyiyi mbea sorɔnsorɔm no nyinara emmfi Israel: naaso n’akoma dze, odzii mu wɔ ne nda nyinara mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze ndzɛmba a n’egya yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn, na dza nankasa yɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn no baa Nyankopɔn ne fie, dwetɛ, na sika, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na akodzi bi ammba araa dze kodur Asa n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia eduasa enum no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Asa n’ahendzi afe a otsia eduasa esia no mu, na Israelhen Baasha fowee kɔr Juda do, na ɔkɛkyekyeer Rama, dɛ ɔremma kwan ma obiara nndzi Judahen Asa nkyɛn akɔnaaba.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Asa faa dwetɛ na sika fi EWURADZE ne fie na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze mu, na ɔsomae ma wɔdze kɔr Siriahen Ben-hadad a ɔtse Damaskɔs no nkyɛn dɛ,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyekyeree bi da emi na ɔwo ntamu, dɛ mbrɛ nkyɛ ɔda m’egya na w’egya ntamu no: hwɛ, mama wɔdze dwetɛ na sika rebrɛ wo; kɔ, kɛtsetsew ɔwo nye Israelhen Baasha nkyekyeree no mu, ma omfi mo do nkɔ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Ben-hadad tsiee ɔhen Asa, na ɔsomaa no dɔm do asafohemfo wɔ Israel nkurow do; na wɔkɔbɔɔ Ijon, na Dan, na Abel-maim, na Naftali adzekora nkurow no nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Baasha tsee no, nna ogyaa Rama kyekyer, na ɔmaa n’edwuma no kae.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔhen Asa faa Juda nyinara; na wɔkɔsoaa Rama abo, na ndua no a Baasha dze kyekyeree no; na ɔdze kyekyeer Geba na Mizpa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber no mu no adzehunyi Hanani baa Judahen Asa nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, Osiandɛ ɔwo atwer Siriahen, na anntwer EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn no ntsi na Siriahen no dɔm no efi wo nsa eguan no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ana Etiopiafo na Lubifo no nnyɛ dɔmtutuw, wɔ ntseaseanam na mpɔnkɔdofo dodow mbordo mu bi a? Naaso, osiandɛ etweer EWURADZE ntsi, ɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ wo nsa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE dze n’enyi kɔ asaase nyina do aprɔw, dɛ ɔdze n’ahoɔdzen bedzi ama hɔn a hɔn akoma dzi mu wɔ no ho no. Iyi mu na ayɛ nkwaseadze; dɛm ntsi ofi ha kɔ yi ibenya akodzi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Asa no bo fuuw adzehunyi no, na ɔdze no kɔtoo adaduadan no mu; na onyaa no ho ebufuw wɔ asɛm yi ntsi. Na Asa tseetsee ɔman no mu binom wɔ mber no ara so mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na, hwɛ, Asa no ho nsɛm, kan dze na ekyir dze no, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Juda na Israel ahemfo nwoma no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Asa n’ahendzi no mu afe a otsia eduasa akron no mu na ɔyaar n’anan; ne yarba no yɛɛ kɛse mbordo: naaso ne yarba no mu no ɔannhwehwɛ EWURADZE, na mbom enunsimfo a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Asa kɔr ne nsamankyir wɔ n’ahendzi no mu afe a otsia eduanan biako no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wosiee no wɔ nankasa n’asamandan a otwae maa noho wɔ David kurow mu no mu, na wɔdze no too mpa a nduhuam na ndur ahorow a wɔaforafora no nduforaforafo nyansaa mu ahyɛ do ma no do: na wɔbɔɔ ogya kɛsenara hyɛɛ no enyimnyam.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ne babanyin Jehosafat dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu, na ɔhyɛɛ noho dzen dze tsiaa Israel.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze dɔm guguu Juda nkurow a wɔabɔ ho ban nyinara mu, na ɔdze bansifo sisii Juda asaase do, na Efraim nkurow a n’egya Asa gyegyee no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE dzii Jehosafat n’ekyir, osiandɛ ɔnantseew n’egya David n’akwan a odzi kan no mu, na ɔannhwehwɛ Baalim n’ekyir kwan;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na mbom ɔhwehwɛɛ n’egya ne Nyankopɔn no, na ɔnantseew ne mbransɛm no mu, na nnyɛ Israel ndzeyɛɛ no ekyir a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE tsintsiim ahendzi no wɔ ne nsamu; na Juda nyinara dze ayɛyɛdze brɛɛ Jehosafat; na onyaa adze na enyidzi piigyan.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na onyaa EWURADZE no som ho enyigye: na nkyii so oyiyii mbea sorɔnsorɔm na Aserim no fii Juda.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Eso n’ahendzi no mu afe a otsia ebiasa no mu no ɔsomaa ne mbapɔmba, mekyerɛ Ben-hail, na Obadia, na Zekaria, na Netanel, na Mikaia, dɛ wɔnkɛkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ Juda nkurow no mu;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na Levifo, mekyerɛ Semaia, na Netania, na Zebadia, na Asahel, na Semiramot, na Jehonatan, na Adonija, na Tobija, na Tob-adonija a wɔyɛ Levifo no ka hɔn ho; na asɔfo no, Elisama na Jehoram so ka hɔn ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔkyerɛkyerɛe wɔ Juda, dɛ wɔwɔ EWURADZE ne mbra nwoma no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn; na wokekyimakyimaa Juda nkurow no nyinara mu; na wɔkɛkyerɛkyerɛe wɔ ɔman no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE ho suro baa asaase a wɔabɔ Juda ho aprɔw no mu ahendzi nyinara do, ma dɛm ntsi wɔnnye Jehosafat enndzi ako.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Filistiafo no mu binom dze ayɛyɛdze, na ɔtowyi dwetɛ brɛɛ Jehosafat; Arabiafo no so dze nguankuw nguankuw brɛɛ no, nguannyin mpemesuon ahaesuon, na mpɔnkyenyin mpemesuon ahaesuon.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehosafat yɛɛ kɛse mbordo; na osisii adan na adzekora nkurow wɔ Juda.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na onyaa ndwuma pii wɔ Juda nkurow no mu; na mbarimba akofo, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn nkanee dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efi tsetsee nye yi: Juda mu, mpem do asafohemfo no; ɔsafohen Adna, na mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam mpemahaasa ka no ho:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔsafohen Jehohanan na odzi no do, na nyimpa mpemahaenu eduowɔtwe ka no ho:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔno so no do na Zikri ne ba Amasia a ɔdze noho maa EWURADZE ɔpɛ do no dzi; na mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam mpemahaenu ka no ho:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na Benjamin mu; Eliada ɔbarimba ɔkatakyi a ɔyɛ ndam bi, na nyimpa a wɔdze egyen na kyɛm emiamia mpemahaenu ka no ho:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na no do na Jehozabad dzi, na nyimpa mpemɔha eduowɔtwe a woesiesie hɔnho ama ɔsa ka no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Woyinom nye hɔn a wɔsom ɔhen no, ɔsor hɔn a ɔhen no dze hɔn guguu Juda nyinara mu nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban no mu no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Jehosafat nyaa adze na enyidzi piigyan; na ɔnye Ahab yɛɛ asew.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na mfe bi n’ekyir no osii mu kɔr Ahab nkyɛn wɔ Samaria. Na Ahab kunkum nguan na anantwi piigyan dze maa ɔno, na nkorɔfo a wɔka no ho no, na ɔdaadaa no dɛ ɔnye no mfow nkɔ Ramot-gilead.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelhen Ahab see Judahen Jehosafat dɛ, Ana enye me bɔkɔ Ramot-gilead a? Na obuaa no dɛ, Metse dɛ woara, na me man tse dɛ wo man; na yɛnye wo bɔkɔ ɔsa no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehosafat see Israelhen no dɛ, Mbom bisa EWURADZE ana.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Israelhen no boaboaa nkɔnhyɛfo no ano, mbarimba ahaanan, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana yɛnkɔ Ramot-gilead nkɔko, anaa mingyaa? Na wɔsee dɛ, Fow kɔ; na Nyankopɔn dze bɛhyɛ ɔhen ne nsa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehosafat see dɛ, Ana EWURADZE no nkɔnhyɛnyi bi so nnyi ha, ma yebebisa no hɔ adze?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelhen no see Jehosafat dɛ, Ɔbarimba baako bi da ho wɔ hɔ a nkyɛ yɛnam no do bebisa EWURADZE adze: na mikyir no; osiandɛ ɔnnhyɛ mo ho nkɔm pa dɛ bɔn ara nko. Ɔno nye Imla ne ba Mikaia. Na Jehosafat see dɛ, Mma mma ɔhen nnse dɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Israelhen no frɛɛ ɔsafohen bi, na ɔsee dɛ, Kɛfa Imla ne ba Mikaia bra ntsɛmara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Israelhen na Judahen Jehosafat tsetse hɔn ahengua do nkorkor, hyehyɛ hɔn ahentar, na wɔtsetse Samaria kuropon ahɛnee gua do; na nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara rehyɛ nkɔm wɔ hɔn enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Kenaana ne ba Zedekia yɛɛ dadze mmbɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Iyinom na edze bosun Siriafo no araa ma wɔaahyew.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara hyehyɛɛ nkɔm dɛm, dɛ, Fow kɔ Ramot-gilead, na onsi wo yie: na EWURADZE dze bɛhyɛ ɔhen ne nsa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbɔfo no a ɔkɔr dɛ ɔrekɛfrɛ Mikaia no kaa kyerɛɛ no, dɛ, Hwɛ, nkɔnhyɛfo nsɛm no dze anokor yi papa kyerɛ ɔhen: dɛm ntsi meserɛ wo, ma w’asɛm nyɛ dɛ hɔndze no kor, na ka asɛm pa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Mikaia see dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase yi, dza me Nyankopɔn bɛse no, ɔno na mebɛka.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a ɔbaa ɔhen no nkyɛn no, ɔhen no see no dɛ, Mikaia, ana yɛnkɔ Ramot-gilead nkɔko, anaa mingyaa? Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mfow nkɔ, na onsi hom yie; na wobeyi hɔn ahyɛ hom nsa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, Mpɛn ahen ara na menka ntam ngu wo do ma ennka hwee dɛ dza ɔyɛ nokwar nko wɔ EWURADZE ne dzin mu kyerɛ me?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Muhun Israel nyinara dɛ wɔapetse mbepɔw do, dɛ nguan a wonnyi oguanhwɛfo: na EWURADZE see dɛ, Iyinom wonnyi wura; ma wɔnsan, nyimpa biara nkɔ ne fie asomdwee mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelhen no see Jehosafat dɛ, Ana mannka annkyerɛ wo dɛ ɔnnkɛhyɛ mo ho nkɔm pa, dɛ bɔn nko?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛm ntsi hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm: Muhun EWURADZE dɛ ɔtse n’ahengua do, na ɔsor dɔm nyinara gyinagyina n’enyimfa na n’abankum.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Woana na ɔbɛdaadaa Israelhen Ahab ma ɔaafow akɔ akɔtɔr wɔ Ramot-gilead? Na obi kasaa see dɛm, na obi so see dɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na sunsum bi fiir edzi begyinaa EWURADZE enyim, na ɔsee dɛ, Mara mebɛdaadaa no. Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Edze ebɛnadze?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Mibefir edzi, na makɛyɛ sunsum torfo wɔ no nkɔnhyɛfo nyinara anomu. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔwo bɛdaadaa no, na eso edzi nyim: fir edzi kɔ, na kɛyɛ dɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, hwɛ, EWURADZE dze sunsum torfo ahyɛ wo nkɔnhyɛfo yi anomu; na EWURADZE akasa wo ho bɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Kenaana ne ba Zedekia twee pinii, na ɔbɔɔ Mikaia sotɔr see dɛ, Ebɛn ɔkwan do na EWURADZE no sunsum nam fi me nkyɛn bɛkaa iyi kyerɛɛ wo?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Mikaia see dɛ, Hwɛ, da no a ebɔkɔ mpiakyir pia mu dɛ irukosuma woho no na ibohu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelhen no see dɛ, Hom mfa Mikaia, na hom mfa no nsan nkɔ kurow no mu ambrado Amon, na ɔhen ne ba Joas nkyɛn;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na hom nse dɛ, Mbrɛ ɔhen se nye yi, Hom mfa akowaa yi nto efiadze, na hom mfa ahohiahia edziban na ahohiahia nsu nyɛn no, na onkodu dɛ mebɛsan aba no asomdwee mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Mikaia see dɛ, Sɛ ɔwoara esan ba no asomdwee mu ara dze a, nna nnyɛ EWURADZE na ɔnam mo do akasa. Na ɔdze sɔɔw do dɛ, Aman, hom nyinara hom ntsie dza maka yi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelhen no na Judahen Jehosafat fowee kɔr Ramot-gilead.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelhen no see Jehosafat dɛ, Mebɛsakyer moho, na makɔ akono: na ɔwo dze hyɛ w’ahentar. Nna Israelhen no sakyeer noho; na wosii mu kɔr akono.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Siriahen no ahyɛ ne ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no, dɛ, Mma hom nnye kakraba anaa kɛse nnko, gyedɛ Israelhen no nkotonoo.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no hun Jehosafat no, nna wɔsee dɛ, Israelhen nye no. Dɛm ntsi wotwae yeer no dɛ wɔnye no rokɔko: na Jehosafat kekaa mu, na EWURADZE boaa no: na Nyankopɔn nuu hɔn mu ma wɔdanee fii no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ntseaseanam do asafohen no hun dɛ nnyɛ Israelhen nye no, nna wogyaa no tsiw saan ekyir.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbarimba bi twee n’egyen mu a ɔannhyɛ da ara towee, na ɔbɔɔ Israelhen no wɔ mbɔtoamu na akatabo no ntamu: dɛm ntsi ɔsee tseaseanam kafo no dɛ, Dan wo nsa, na fa me fi dɔm yi mu; na mepira dzendzen.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔko no mu yɛɛ dzen da no: naaso Israelhen no suoo noho mu gyinaa ne tseaseanam mu wɔ Siriafo no enyim araa dze kodur ewimbir: na bɛyɛ mber a wi rokɔtɔ no na owui.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Judahen Jehosafat sanee kɔr ne fie asomdwee mu wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Hanani ne ba Jehu adzehunyi no fiir edzi kehyiaa no kwan, na ɔsee ɔhen Jehosafat dɛ, Aso ɔsɛ dɛ eboa ndzebɔnyɛfo, na edɔ hɔn a wokyir EWURADZE no anaa? Na iyi ntsi ebufuw fi EWURADZE enyim aba wo do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Naaso woehu wo mu ndzɛmba pa bi, wɔ dɛ ɔwo etwitwa Aserot no efi asaase no do, na esiesie w’akoma dɛ erohwehwɛ Nyankopɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehosafat tsenaa Jerusalɛm: na ofiir edzi kɔr ɔman no mu ɔdze fi Beer-seba kodu Efraim nkokodo nkurow no mu, na ɔdaan hɔn sanee baa EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no nkyɛn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na osisii atsɛmbuafo wɔ asaase no do wɔ Juda nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban nyinara mu, nkurow nkurow,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔsee atsɛmbuafo no dɛ, Hom ndwen dza hom yɛ ho: osiandɛ hom mmbu atsɛn mma nyimpa, na mbom EWURADZE a; na ɔwɔ hom nkyɛn wɔ atsɛmbu no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi afei wɔmma EWURADZE ho suro mbra hom do; hom nhwɛ yie na hom nyɛ: na emumuyɛ, na enyimhwɛ, na mboabadzi, nnyi EWURADZE, hɛn Nyankopɔn afamu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so Jerusalɛm na Jehosafat dze Levifo na asɔfo, na Israel egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no mu binom sisii hɔ maa EWURADZE n’atsɛmbusɛm, na asɛndzi do. Na wɔsanee baa Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn, dɛ, Dɛm na hom nyɛ wɔ EWURADZE no suro mu, nokwar mu, na akoma a odzi mu mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber biara a akasakasa biara bɛba hom enyim a ofi hom nuanom a wɔtsetse hɔn nkurow mu, wɔ bɔgya na bɔgya ntamu asɛm, mbra na mbrasɛm, ahyɛdze na atsɛmbu ntamu asɛm no, hom mbɔ hɔn nkaa, amma woeenndzi so wɔ EWURADZE afamu, na ebufuw aammba hom na hom nuanom do: hom nyɛ yi, na hom nnkedzi so.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na, hwɛ, ɔsɔfopanyin Amaria na ɔhwɛ hom do wɔ EWURADZE afamu nsɛm nyinara ho; na Ismael ne ba Zebadia, Juda fie ɔpanyin no so, wɔ ɔhen afamu nsɛm nyinara ho: Levifo no so nyɛ asafohemfo wɔ hom enyim. Hom nyɛ no akokodur mu, na EWURADZE ndzi apapafo no ekyir.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, iyi ekyir no, nna Moabmba, na Ammonmba, na Ammonfo binom ka hɔn ho, baa Jehosafat do dɛ wɔnye no robɔko.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna obi bae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ Jehosafat dɛ, Dɔmtutuw bi fi po no egya fi Siria reba wo do; na, hwɛ, wɔwɔ Hazazon-tamar (ɔnoara nye En-gedi).
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehosafat suroi, na ɔdze n’enyi sii do dɛ ɔbɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE; na ɔbɔɔ mbuadadzi ho dawur wɔ Juda nyinara mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Juda poon hɔnho hyiae, dɛ wɔrobɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE hɔ mboa: mekyerɛ wofi Juda nkurow nyinara mu na wɔbaa dɛ wɔrobɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehosafat gyinaa Juda na Jerusalɛm bagua no mu, wɔ EWURADZE ne fi no mu, wɔ abangua fofor no enyim;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE, hɛn egyanom Nyankopɔn, ana ɔwo nnyɛ Nyankopɔn wɔ ɔsor? Ana nnyɛ ɔwo nye amanaman ahendzi nyinara do ɔhwɛfo bi a? Wo nsamu na tum na mbanyinndam wɔ, ma dɛm ntsi obi runntum nngyina w’enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ana nnyɛ ɔwo, hɛn Nyankopɔn, na ituu asaase yi do atsefo no fii wo man Israel enyim, na edze maa wo nyɛnko Abraham daa no bi a?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔtsenaa do, na wosii wo do krɔnkrɔnbea maa wo dzin, dɛ,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Sɛ mbusu bi, afona, atsɛmbu, anaa ɔyardɔm, anaa ɔkɔm ba hɛn do a, yɛbɛba ebegyina ofi yi enyim, na w’enyim, (osiandɛ wo dzin wɔ ofi yi mu,) na yeesu afrɛ wo wɔ hɛn amandzehu mu, na ɔwo etsie hɛn na agye hɛn nkwa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na afei, hwɛ, Ammonmba, na Moab na Seir bepɔw mba no a ɔwoara ammpɛ ma Israel annkɔ hɔn ntuae, aber a wofi Egypt asaase do reba no, na mbom wɔdanee fii hɔn ho, na wɔannsɛɛ hɔn no;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: hwɛ, mbrɛ woesi rutua hɛn kaw, dɛ wɔaba rubotu hɛn efi w’enyadze a ɔwoara edze ama hɛn dɛ yendzi no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Hɛn Nyankopɔn e, ana innkobu hɔn atsɛn? Osiandɛ yennyi tum bi a yɛdze rigyina kuw kɛse yi a wɔreba hɛn do yi enyim; nkyii so yennyim dza yɛnnyɛ: na ɔwoara na hɛn enyi da wo do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Juda nyinara, nye hɔn mbofraba, hɔn yernom, na hɔn mba, gyinagyinaa EWURADZE enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna EWURADZE no sunsum baa Jahaziel, Zekaria ba no, Benaia ba no, Jeiel ba no, Mattania ba no, Levinyi a ofi Asaf mba no mu no do wɔ mboanofo no finimfin;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Hom ntsie, Juda nyinara, na hom Jerusalɛm atsefo, na ɔwo ɔhen Jehosafat: mbrɛ EWURADZE se hom nye yi, Mma hom nnsuro, nkyii so mma hom akoma nntu osian nyimpadodow kɛse yi ntsi; osiandɛ ɔko yi nnyɛ homdze bi a, na Nyankopɔn dze a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ɔkyena hom nsian nkɔ hɔn do; hwɛ, wɔnam Ziz afowee rofow aba; na hom bohu hɔn wɔ bɔnsa no n’ewiei, wɔ Jeruel sar no enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Onnkehia hom dɛ hom bɔko wɔ ɔko yi mu: hom nhuruhuruw ngyina, hom ngyina dzen, na wɔnhwɛ EWURADZE a ɔka hom ho no, no nkwagye, Juda na Jerusalɛm e: mma hom nnsuro na hom akoma nntu so: ɔkyena hom mfir edzi nkɔ hɔn do; na EWURADZE bedzi hom ekyir.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehosafat bɔɔ ne tsir adze dze n’enyim kaa famu: na Juda nyinara na Jerusalɛm atsefo no hwehwee famu wɔ EWURADZE enyim sɔɔr EWURADZE.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Levifo a wofi Kohatfo mba, na Korafo mba mu no, soɛree gyinagyinaa dɛ wɔdze ndze kɛse mbordo riyi EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ayɛw.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔsoɛɛr anapaatu, na wofiir edzi kɔr Tekoa sar no do: na worifir edzi akɔ no, Jehosafat gyinae na ɔsee dɛ, Juda, na hom Jerusalɛm atsefo, hom ntsie me; hom ngye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ndzi, na hom betsim; hom ngye no nkɔnhyɛfo no ndzi, na hom bɛyɛ prɔmprɔm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a ɔnye ɔman no faa apam no, nna ɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn a wɔntow ndwom mma EWURADZE, na wonyi no ayɛw wɔ n’ahokeka krɔnkrɔn mu, aber a worifir edzi wɔ dɔm no enyim no, na wɔsee dɛ, Hom nda EWURADZE ase; na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a wɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ wɔrotow ndwom na woriyi ayɛw no nna EWURADZE maa atsɛweefo baa Ammonmba, Moab, na Seir bepɔw do atsefo a wɔbaa Juda do no do; na wɔbɔɔ hɔn gui.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Ammon na Moabmba no soɛree tsiaa Seir bepɔw do atsefo no, dɛ woruku hɔn asɛɛ hɔn pasapasa: na aber a wowiee Seir atsefo no, obiara boae ma wɔsɛɛ obi so.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Juda baa sar no do ahwɛɛtsentsen no nkyɛn no, nna wɔdanee hwɛɛ nyimpadodow no; na, hwɛ, wɔayɛ efun gugu famu, na obiara nnyi hɔ a ofii nsa guanee.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Jehosafat na no nkorɔfo no baa dɛ wɔrebɛfa hɔn asadze no, nna wohunii wɔ hɔn mu ahonyadze na ntar, na ndwindze a ɔsom bo piigyan a hɔnara wɔtasee fae, ɔso ma dɛ wobotum asoa akɔ: na wɔdze asadze no fom araa ndaansa, osiandɛ ɔdɔɔ so dodow.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na da a otsia anan no wɔpoon hɔnho hyiae wɔ Beraka bɔnsa no mu; osiandɛ hɔ na wohyiraa EWURADZE: dɛm ntsi na wɔfrɛɛ no Beraka Bɔnsa, dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna wɔsanee, Juda na Jerusalɛm mbarimba nyinara, na Jehosafat dzi hɔn enyim, dɛ wɔdze enyigye reba Jerusalɛm bio; osiandɛ EWURADZE ama hɔn enyi agye wɔ hɔn atamfo ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze bɛnta asanku na nsankutsen na mbɛn bae bɛhɛɛn EWURADZE fie wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Nyankopɔn ho suro kaa ɔman no mu ahendzi no nyinara, wɔ aber a wɔtsee dɛ EWURADZE nye Israel hɔn atamfo ako no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Jehosafat n’ahenman mu dwee: osiandɛ ne Nyankopɔn maa no ahomgye wɔ mbea nyinara hyiae.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehosafat dzii hen wɔ Juda do: aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduasa enum; na odzii hen mfe eduonu enum wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Azuba, Silhi ne babaa a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔnantseew n’egya Asa kwan do, na ɔanndan emmfi ho emmfi, dɛ ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Mbom mbea sorɔnsorɔm no dze oennyiyi no hɔ; nkyii so nna ɔman no nnyae mmfaa hɔn akoma mmaa hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Jehosafat no ho nsɛm nkaa no, kan dze na ekyir dze no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Hanani ne ba Jehu n’abakɔsɛm a wɔdze hyɛɛ Israel ahemfo nwoma no mu no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na iyi ekyir na Judahen Jehosafat dze noho kɔbɔɔ Israelhen Ahazia ho; ɔnoara na ɔyɛɛ ndzeyɛbɔn dodow no:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔdze noho bɔɔ no ho dɛ wɔbɛyɛ ahɛn akɔ Tarsis: na wɔyɛɛ ahɛn no Ezion-geber.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Dodavahu a ofi Maresa no ne ba Eliezer hyɛɛ Jehosafat ho nkɔm, dɛ, Osiandɛ ɔwo edze woho abɔ Ahazia ho ntsi, EWURADZE asekyɛw wo ndwuma. Na ahɛn no bobɔe, ma woenntum annkɔ Tarsis.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehosafat kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no kaa n’egyanom ho wɔ David kurow mu: na ne babanyin Jehoram dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na onyaa enuanom Jehosafat mbabanyin, Azaria, na Jehiel, na Zekaria, na Azaria, na Maekɛl, na Sefatia: woyinom nyinara Israelhen Jehosafat ne mba a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn egya maa hɔn akyɛdze kɛsenara, dwetɛ, na sika, na ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo, ɔnye Juda mu nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban: na ahendzi no dze, ɔdze maa Jehoram osiandɛ ɔno nye abakan.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei aber a Jehoram n’ahendzi tsimii wɔ ne nsamu no, nna ɔdze afona kunkum no nuanom no nyinara, na Israel mbapɔmba no mu binom so.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a Jehoram hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduasa ebien; na odzii hen mfe awɔtwe wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔnantseew Israel ahemfo kwan do, dɛ mbrɛ Ahab fi yɛe no: osiandɛ onyaa Ahab ne babaa waar no: na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Naaso EWURADZE ammpɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ David fi no, osian ahyɛmu a ɔnye David edzi no ntsi, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ anohoba dɛ ɔbɛma ahendzi no etsim wɔ ɔno na ne mba nsamu dabaa no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ne nda mu na Edom tseew etua fii Juda nsaadze, na wɔkɛhyɛɛ hɔnara hɔn do hen.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Jehoram nye n’asafohemfo, na ne ntseaseanam nyinara ka no ho twaa mu kɔree: na ɔsoɛɛr anadwe, na okunkum Edomfo a woetwa no ho ehyia, na ntseaseanam do asafohemfo no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Edom tseew etua fii Juda ne nsaadze, dze bodu ndɛ da yi: nna Libna so tseew etua mber no ara mu fii ne nsaadze: osiandɛ wɔapow EWURADZE, n’egyanom Nyankopɔn no ntsi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so osisii mbea sorɔnsorɔm wɔ Juda mbepɔw no do, na ɔyɛɛ ma hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalɛm no enndzi nokwar amma Nyankopɔn, na ɔmaa Juda tɔɔ gon.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na krataa bi fi nkɔnhyɛnyi Elija hɔ baa ne nkyɛn, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, w’egya David ne Nyankopɔn se nye yi, Osiandɛ ɔwo annantsew w’egya Jehosafat akwan do, na Judahen Asa akwan do;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na mbom anantsew Israel ahemfo akwan do, na ayɛ Juda na Jerusalɛm atsefo ma wɔafom, dɛ mbrɛ Ahab fi yɛe no; na eso ekuku wo nuanom a wofi w’egya fie a woye sen ɔwoara no ntsi:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: hwɛ, EWURADZE dze owuyar kɛse bɔbɔ wo man, na wo mba, na wo yernom, na w’ahodze nyinara:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔwoara so ibenya yafun mu yarbason, ma ekodu dɛ osian yarba no ntsi w’ayamudze botu egu daa nyina.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE nunuu Filistiafo, na Arabiafo a wɔwɔ Etiopiafo nkyɛn no hɔn sunsum tsiaa Jehoram:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na wɔfowee baa Juda do, na wɔtseew mu, na wɔsosoo ahodze a wohun no wɔ ɔhen no ne fie no nyinara, na ne mbabanyin so, na ne yernom kɔree; ma dɛm ntsi ɔannka ɔbabanyin biara amma no, gyedɛ Jehoahaz, ne mbabanyin mu ekumaba no nko.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na iyi nyinara ekyir no EWURADZE dze yarba a onnyi edur bɔɔ no wɔ n’ayamudze mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, mber guu mu, mfe ebien n’ewiei no, nna osian ne yarba no ntsi n’ayamudze tui gui, na owuu yarba bɔn mu. Na ne man annhyew ɔhyew bi amma no a ɔtse dɛ n’egyanom ɔhyew no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduasa ebien, na odzii hen mfe awɔtwe wɔ Jerusalɛm: na owui a annyɛ obiara mpo asɛm; na wosiee no wɔ David kurow mu, naaso nnyɛ ahemfo no hɔn asamandan no mu bi a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalɛm no yɛɛ ne ba ekumaba Ahazia ɔhen hyɛɛ n’ananmu: osiandɛ nna mbarimba kuw a wɔnye Arabiafo no baa nseraban no mu no ekuku mpanyin no nyinara. Nna Judahen Jehoram ne ba Ahazia dzii hen.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a Ahazia hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduanan ebien; na odzii hen afrenhyia wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Atalia, Omri ne babaa a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ɔno so ɔnantseew Ahab fi akwan do: osiandɛ ne na nye ne pamfo a ɔmaa ɔyɛɛ emumuyɛdze.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do, dɛ mbrɛ Ahab fi yɛe no: osiandɛ n’egya no wu ekyir no hɔn na wɔbɛyɛɛ n’apamfo dze maa ne nsɛɛe.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Hɔn apam so ekyir na ɔnantsewee, na ɔnye Israelhen Ahab ne ba Jehoram tuu sa wɔ Siriahen Hazael do wɔ Ramot-gilead: na Siriafo no piraa Joram.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsanee baa Jezreel dɛ ɔrebɛyɛ n’epirakur a onyae wɔ aber a ɔnye Siriahen Hazael roko ma wopiraa no wɔ Rama no edur. Na Judahen Jehoram ne ba Ahazia sii mu kɔr dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ Ahab ne ba Jehoram wɔ Jezreel, osiandɛ ɔyar.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Ahazia ne nsɛɛe fi Nyankopɔn hɔ, wɔ dɛ osii mu kɔr Joram nkyɛn: osiandɛ aber a odurii no, nna ɔnye Jehoram fiir edzi kɔr Nimsi ne ba Jehu a EWURADZE asera no dɛ ontwa Ahab ne fi do no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jehu rubu Ahab fi atsɛn no, nna okohun Juda asafohemfo, na Ahazia no nuanom mbabanyin no a wɔsom no no, na okunkum hɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhwehwɛɛ Ahazia, na wɔkyeer no, (afei na oesuma noho wɔ Samaria,) na wɔdze no brɛɛ Jehu, na wokum no; na wosiee no, na wɔsee dɛ, Jehosafat a ɔdze n’akoma nyinara hwehwɛɛ EWURADZE no ne ba nye no. Na Ahazia fie ennya tum dɛ ɔdze bosuo ahendzi no mu bio.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei aber a Ahazia ne na Atalia hun dɛ ne ba no ewu no, nna ɔsoɛree na ɔsɛɛ Juda fie adehye asefo no nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no ne babaa Jehosabat faa Ahazia ne ba Joas na owiaa no fii ɔhen ne mba no a wokum hɔn no mu, na ɔdze ɔno na nyia ɔhwɛ no no kɛhyɛɛ mpiakyir. Nna Jehosabat, ɔhen Jehoram ne babaa no, ɔsɔfo Jehoida ne yer no, (ɔyɛ Ahazia n’akyerɛbaa ntsi) ɔdze no sumaa Atalia, ma dɛm ntsi oennku no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔnye hɔn wokosumaa Nyankopɔn ne fie mfe esia: a Atalia yɛɛ ɔhembaa wɔ asaase no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na afe a otsia esuon no mu no Jehoiada hyɛɛ noho dzen, na ɔfaa ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo, Jeroham ne ba Azaria, na Jehohanan ne ba Ismael, na Obed ne ba Azaria, na Adaia ne ba Maaseia, na Zikri ne ba Elisafat, ma wɔnye no dzii ahyɛmu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wokekyiin Juda mu, na wohyiahyiaa Juda nkurow no nyinara mu Levifo no, na Israel egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir no, na wɔbaa Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na mboanofo no nyinara nye ɔhen no dzii ahyɛmu wɔ Nyankopɔn fie. Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔhen ne ba no na obedzi hen, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE aka no wɔ David mba ho no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Adze a hom nyɛ nye yi: hom mu nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor a ɔba mu ahomgyeda no, a wofi asɔfo na Levifo no mu no, na wɔnyɛ mbobowano ahwɛfo;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor so ntsena ɔhen no ne fie; na nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor so ntsena fapem no no nkuropon no ano: na ɔman no nyinara ngyina EWURADZE fie abangua no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na mma mma obiara nnhɛn EWURADZE ne fie no mu, gyedɛ asɔfo no na Levifo no mu hɔn a wɔsom no; hɔn na wɔnhɛn mu, osiandɛ wɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn: na ɔman no nyinara dze, wɔnhwɛ EWURADZE ne fie do ahwɛdze no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Levifo no mbɔ ɔhen no ho aprɔw, nyimpa biara mfa n’akodze nkitsa ne nsamu; na obiara a ɔbɛba ofi no mu no, wɔmma wonku no: na hom ndzi ɔhen no nkyɛn aber a ɔreba fie, na aber a orupue.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Levifo na Juda nyinara yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada hyɛe no nyinara: na wɔfefaa nyimpa biara ne nyimpa, hɔn a wɔwɔ dɛ wɔba mu ahomgyeda no, kaa hɔn a wɔwɔ dɛ wofir edzi ahomgyeda no ho; osiandɛ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada ammpon nkyekyɛmu no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsɔfo Jehoiada yiyii mpeaa na akyɛm akɛse na akyɛm nkakraba a ɔyɛ ɔhen David dze no a ɔwɔ EWURADZE fie no, memaa ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze ɔman no nyinara gyinagyinae, nyimpa biara n’akodze kitsa ne nsamu, ofi dan no n’enyimfa afamu kodu dan no n’abankum afamu, wɔ afɔrmbukyia no na dan no ho, bɔɔ ɔhen no ho aprɔw.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna wɔdze ɔhen ne ba no fiir edzi, na wɔdze ahenkyɛw no soaa no, na wɔdze dase no maa no, na wɔhyɛɛ no hen: na Jehoiada na ne mba seraa no; na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔhen nya nkwa!
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Atalia tsee ɔman no a worututu mbirika na woriyi ɔhen ayɛw no ne gyigyeegye no, nna ɔbaa ɔman no nkyɛn wɔ EWURADZE fie:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔhwɛe, na hwɛ, ɔhen no gyina no dum no ho, wɔ ahɛnee, na asafohemfo no mbɛn no wɔ ɔhen no nkyɛn; na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara enyi gyee, na wɔhɛɛn mbɛn; adwontofo no so goree wɔ nsanku ndzɛmba do, na wɔkyerɛɛ ayɛyi adwontow no. Nna Atalia tsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Tsirdo mpamee o, tsirdo pam a!
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsɔfo Jehoiada dze ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo no a wɔhwɛ dɔm no do no puei, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa no mfa akyerɛpɛn no ntamu; na nyia obedzi n’ekyir no, wɔmma wɔmfa afona nku no: na ɔsɔfo no see dɛ, Mma wonnku no wɔ EWURADZE fie.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna wosuoo no mu faa mpɔnkɔ ahɛnee aponkɛse no ano dze kɔ ahemfie hɔ: na wokum no wɔ hɔ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehoiada dzii ahyɛmu wɔ ɔnoara, na ɔman no nyinara, na ɔhen no ntamu, dɛ wɔnyɛ EWURADZE ne man.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔman no nyinara sii mu kɔr Baal fie kobubuu no gui, na wobubuu n’afɔrmbukyia na n’ehonyi no esinesin, na wokum Baal no sɔfoe Maatan wɔ afɔrmbukyia no enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehoiada hyehyɛɛ EWURADZE ne fi do ahwɛdofo dze hyɛɛ asɔfo no nsa, Levifo no a David kyekyɛɛ hɔn mu sisii EWURADZE ne fi do, dɛ wɔmbɔ EWURADZE ne hyew afɔr no nsa, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra no mu no, wɔdze enyigye na adwontow, dɛ mbrɛ David ne nhyehyɛɛ tse no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze mbobowano ahwɛfo no gyinagyinaa EWURADZE fi mbobotsen no ano, amma obi a no ho egu fi wɔ adze biara mu aannhɛn mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔfaa ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo, na ekunyin no, na ɔman no do ambradofo, na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara na wɔdze ɔhen no fi EWURADZE fie sianee: na wɔnam sor abobotsen no mu baa ɔhen no ne fie, na wɔdze ɔhen no tsenaa ahendzi ahengua no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna asaase no do nkorɔfo nyinara enyi gyee, na kurow no mu dwee: na Atalia dze, wɔdze afona kum no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a Joas hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe esuon; na odzii hen mfe eduanan wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Zibia, ofi Beer-seba.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Joas yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do wɔ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada ne nda nyinara mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehoiada waar yernom beenu maa no; na ɔwowoo mbabanyin na mbabaa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, iyi ekyir no, Joas nyaa adwen dɛ obesiesie EWURADZE ne fi no fofor.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔpoon asɔfo na Levifo no hyiae, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mfir edzi nkɔ Juda nkurow do, na hom nkɔboaboa sika ano wɔ Israel nyinara hɔ dɛ hom dze rebɛyɛ hom Nyankopɔn fi no yie afrenhyia afrenhyia, na hom nhwɛ ma ɔnyɛ ntsɛm. Naaso Levifo no amma annyɛ ntsɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no frɛɛ otsitsir Jehoiada, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na emmbisa Levifo no dɛ wɔngyegye Juda na Jerusalɛm tow a EWURADZE n’akowaa Moses, na Israel mboanofo no hyɛe maa dasebuw no mmba?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Atalia, ɔbaa bɔn no, ne mba ebubu Nyankopɔn fi no mu; na EWURADZE fie ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn nyinara so wɔahwer no ama Baalim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔhen no hyɛe ma wɔpaam adaka bi, na wɔdze sii EWURADZE fi abotsen no ano guado.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔbɔɔ dawur faa Juda na Jerusalɛm, dɛ wɔmfa Nyankopɔn n’akowaa Moses tow a ɔdze too Israel do wɔ sar no do no mbrɛ EWURADZE.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na mbapɔmba no nyinara na ɔman no nyinara enyi gyee, na wɔdze bae boguu adaka no mu araa kodur dɛ wowiei.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber biara a Levifo no bohu dɛ sika no adɔɔ so wɔ adaka no mu no nna wɔdze abrɛ ɔhen ne kyerɛwfo na nyia ɔsɔfopanyin no hyɛɛ no dɛ ɔnhwɛ do no, na wohue no wɔ adaka no mu, na wɔma adaka no do soa kesi ne sibew bio. Dɛm na wɔyɛɛ no daa nyina, na wɔboaboaa sika piigyan ano.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no na Jehoiada dze maa hɔn a wɔyɛ EWURADZE fie som edwuma no; na wɔdze bobɔɔ abopaafo na nduadwimfo paa dɛ wonsiesie EWURADZE ne fi no fofor, na hɔn a wɔyɛ dadze na boran dwuma no so dɛ wommiamia EWURADZE ne fi no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna edwumayɛfo no yɛɛ edwumadzen, na wowiee nsiesie edwuma no nyinara yɛ, na wɔdze Nyankopɔn ne fi no gyinaa ne gyinabew, na wɔmaa ɔyɛɛ dzen.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a wowiei no, nna wɔdze sika no nkaa baa ɔhen no na Jehoiada enyim, ɔno na wɔdze yeyɛɛ ndzɛmbandzɛmba maa EWURADZE ne fi no, mekyerɛ ndzɛmbandzɛmba a wɔdze som, na wɔdze bɔ afɔr, ntser, na sika na dwetɛ ndzɛmba no. Na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyew afɔr wɔ EWURADZE fi no mu daa wɔ Jehoiada ne nda nyinara mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehoiada yɛɛ akɔdaa a nna oedzi nda pii, na owui; aber a owui no na oedzi mfe ɔha eduasa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wokesiee no David kurow mu wɔ ahemfo no mu, osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ papa wɔ Israel mu, na Nyankopɔn na ne fi no ho afamu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Jehoiada no wu ekyir no Juda mbapɔmba no bae, na wɔbɛyɛɛ ɔhen no enyidzi. Nna ɔhen no tsiee hɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔpoow EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no, ne fi no, na wɔkɔsoom Aserim na abosom no: na ebufuw baa Juda na Jerusalɛm do wɔ hɔn asodzi yi ntsi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Naaso ɔsomaa nkɔnhyɛfo ma wɔkɔr hɔn nkyɛn, dɛ wɔnkɛsan hɔn mbra EWURADZE nkyɛn bio; naaso woentsie hɔn: na wɔammpɛ dɛ wɔyɛ aso.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Nyankopɔn no sunsum baa ɔsɔfo Jehoiada ne ba Zekaria do; na okegyinaa ɔman no do, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ Nyankopɔn se nye yi, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom to EWURADZE ne mbrasɛm, ma hom nntum nnyɛ prɔmprɔm yi? Osiandɛ hom apow EWURADZE ntsi, ɔno so ɔapow hom.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔpaam ne tsir do, na wokesiiw no abo dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm tse wɔ EWURADZE fie abangua no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm na ɔhen Joas annkaa adɔyɛ a Zekaria n’egya Jehoiada dze yɛɛ no no, na okum ne ba no. Na aber a oruwu no, ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE nhwɛ na ɔntɔ do wer.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ afe no n’ewiei no, nna Siriafo dɔm baa Joas do: na wɔbɔɔ Juda na Jerusalɛm, na wɔbɛsɛɛ ɔman no hɔn asafohemfo nyinara, na wɔdze hɔn asadze no nyinara kɛmaa Damaskɔs hen no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Siriafo dɔm no dze nyimpa kuw kakraabi bae, na EWURADZE dze dɔmtutuw kɛsenara hyɛɛ hɔn nsa, osiandɛ wɔapow EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no. Dɛm na wobuu Joas atsɛn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a wofii ne nkyɛn kɔree no, nna woegya no epirakur pii, na nankasa no nkowaa paam ne tsir do wɔ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada ne mba hɔn bɔgyaa no ntsi, na wokokum no wɔ ne mpa do, na owui: na wosiee no wɔ David kurow mu, na woennsie no wɔ ahemfo hɔn asamandan no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na woyinom nye hɔn a wɔpaam ne tsir do no, Ammonnyi Simeat ne ba Zabad, na Moabnyi Simrit ne ba Jehozabad.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei dza ɔfa ne mba ho, na nkɔnhyɛsɛm dodow a wɔkaa tsiaa no, na Nyankopɔn ne fi ne nsiesie ho no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ ahemfo nwoma ne nkyerɛkyerɛase no mu. Na ne babanyin Amazia dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a Amazia hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no na oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe eduonu akron wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Jehoadan, ofi Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do, naaso nna ommfi n’akoma mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wotsiim ahendzi no maa no no, nna okunkum no nkowaa a wokum n’egya ɔhen no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn mba dze, woennkuku hɔn, mbom ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no mbra no mu wɔ Moses no nwoma no mu, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛe no, dɛ, Egyanom runnwu wɔ mba ntsi, nkyii so mba runnwu wɔ egyanom ntsi; na mbom nyimpa biara bowu wɔ nankasa no bɔn ntsi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so Amazia poon Juda hyiae, na ɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi tsetsee, wɔ mpem do asafohemfo na ɔha ɔha do asafohemfo ase, mekyerɛ Juda na Benjamin nyinara: na ɔkaan hɔn fi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu na ekyir do, na ohun dɛ wɔyɛ mbarimba a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn mpemahaasa a wotum ɔsa tu a, wobotum esuo peaa na kyɛm mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Eso ɔdze dwetɛ talent ɔha bɔɔ Israel mu mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam mpemɔha paa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Nyame nyimpa bi baa ne nkyɛn, dɛ, Ɔhen, mma mma Israel dɔm no nnye wo nnkɔ; osiandɛ EWURADZE nndzi Israel ekyir, ɔnye dɛ, onndzi Efraimmba no nyinara ekyir.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na mbom sɛ ɔwoara bɔkɔ a, nna yɛ mbanyindze, na hyɛ dzen wɔ ɔko no mu: ɔno Nyankopɔn bɛma ahwe ase wɔ atamfo no enyim; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn wɔ tum a ɔdze bɔboa, na ɔdze bɛma obi ahwe ase.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Amazia see Nyame nyimpa no dɛ, Na talent ɔha a medze mama Israel dɔm no yɛnyɛ no dɛn? Na Nyame nyimpa no buaa dɛ, EWURADZE yɛ otumfo dɛ ɔbɛma wo dza ɔdɔɔ so sen iyi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Amazia yiyii hɔn, ɔnye dɛ, oyii dɔm a wofi Efraim baa ne nkyɛn no, dɛ wɔnsan nkɔ fie: dɛm ntsi hɔn ebufuw dzɛɛw kɛsenara wɔ Juda do, na wɔsanee kɔr fie wɔ ebufuhyew mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Amazia nyaa akokodur, na ɔdze no nkorɔfo no sii mu kɔr Nkyen Bɔnsa no mu, na okokum Seirmba no mu nyimpa mpemdu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Judamba no faa hɔn mu mpemdu so enyikan kɔree, na wɔdze hɔn baa ɔbotan no etsifi, na wɔtotoow hɔn fi ɔbotan no n’etsifi hwehwee famu, ma hɔn nyinara hɔn mu tsetseew esinesin.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na dɔm no mu nyimpa no a Amazia maa wɔsanee, dɛ mma mma wɔnnye no nkɔ ɔsa no, kotui hyɛɛ Juda nkurow do, dze fi Samaria araa kodur Bɛt-horon, na wokunkum hɔn mu nyimpa mpensa na wɔfaa asadze piigyan.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei ɔbaa dɛ, n’ekyir no a Amazia fi Edomfo nkumii no bae no, nna ɔdze Seirmba enyame bae, na ɔdze hɔn besisii hɔ dɛ wɔnyɛ n’enyame, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze wɔ hɔn enyim, na ɔhyeew eduhuam maa hɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Amazia do, na ɔsomaa nkɔnhyɛnyi ma ɔbaa ne nkyɛn a ɔbɛsee no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ahwehwɛ ɔman bi enyame a woenntum ennyi hɔnankasa hɔn man emmfi wo nsamu no ekyir kwan yi?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔnye no rekasa no nna ɔhen no see no dɛ, Ana yɛahyɛ wo ɔhen n’apamfo bi a? Gyaa; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na woboku wo? Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi no gyae, na ɔsee dɛ, Muhu dɛ Nyankopɔn esua dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ wo, osiandɛ ɔwo ayɛ adze a ɔtse dɛm, na enntsie m’apam so.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Judahen Amazia gyee apam, na ɔsomae ma wɔkɔr Israelhen Joas, Jehoahaz ne ba no, Jehu ne ba no nkyɛn dɛ, Bra, ma yendzi enyimhu nkorkor.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelhen Joas somae ma wɔkɔr Judahen Amazia nkyɛn, dɛ, Kɔkrɔnsoɛ a ɔwɔ Lebanon do no somae ma wɔkɔr nkyindur a ɔwɔ Lebanon do no nkyɛn, dɛ, Fa wo babaa ma me babanyin ayewar: na abowa bɔyafo bi a ɔwɔ Lebanon do botwaa mu, na otsiatsiaa kɔkrɔnsoɛ no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ɔwo ese dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔwoara eku Edom; na w’akoma ama wo do dɛ irutwa mpoa: afei tsena fie; ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze woho rebɛgyegye mu ama wo mbusu, ma aahwe ase yi, mekyerɛ ɔwo, na Juda ka wo ho?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Amazia enntsie; osiandɛ ofi Nyankopɔn hɔ, ama oeeyi hɔn ahyɛ hɔn atamfo nsa, osiandɛ, wɔahwehwɛ Edom enyame no n’ekyir kwan.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Israelhen Joas sii mu kɔree; na ɔno na Judahen Amazia wodzii enyimhu wɔ Bɛt-semes a ɔyɛ Juda dze no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔbɔɔ Juda gui wɔ Israel enyim; na woguanguanee, nyimpa biara kɔr n’asesee mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelhen Joas kyeer Judahen Amazia, Jehoahaz ba Joas ba no, wɔ Bɛt-semes, na ɔdze no baa Jerusalɛm, na obobubuu Jerusalɛm fasu no fi Efraim kuropon ho dze kodur kutuwdo kuropon no ho, basafa ahaebien.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔfaa sika na dwetɛ nyinara, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba nyina a wohun no wɔ Nyankopɔn ne fie wɔ Obed-edom nkyɛn no nyinara, na ɔhen no ne fie akoradze no, na no dɔm no so bi, na ɔsanee kɔr Samaria.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Judahen Amazia, Joas ba no dzii mfe duenum wɔ Israelhen Joas, Jehoahaz ne ba no, no wu ekyir.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Amazia no ho nsɛm nkaa no, kan dze na ekyir dze no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Juda na Israel ahemfo nwoma no mu?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei ofitsi mber a Amazia sanee fii EWURADZE ekyir dzi no, nna wɔpaam ne tsir do wɔ Jerusalɛm; na oguanee kɔr Lakis: na wɔsomae ma wotsiiw no kɔr Lakis, na wokokum no wɔ hɔ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze no too mpɔnkɔ do bae, na wosiee no kaa n’egyanom ho wɔ Juda kurow no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Judah ɔman no nyinara faa Uzziah oedzi mfe duesia, na wɔhyɛɛ no hen wɔ n'egya Amaziah n'ananmu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ɔno na ɔkyekyeer Eloth, na ɔdanee maa Judah, n'ekyir no ɔhen no nye n'egyanom kɛdae.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a Uzziah ridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe duesia; na odzii hen mfe eduonum ebien wɔ Jerusalem: Na ne nã ne dzin dze Jechiliah, ofi Jerusalem.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ Ewuradze enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ n'egya Amaziah yɛe no nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze sii n'enyi do dɛ ɔrohwehwɛ Nyankopɔn wɔ Zechariah a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn maa ɔyɛɛ prɔmpɔm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ofiir edzi nye Philistiafo kɔkõe, na obubuu Gath fasu, na Jabueh fasu, na Ashdod fasu no; na ɔkvekyeer nkurow wɔ Ashdod man mu, na Philistiafo no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Nyankopɔn buae tsiaa Philistiafo no, na Arabiafo a wɔtsetse Gur-baal, na Meunifo no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Ammonfo dze akyɛdze brɛɛ Uzziah: Na ne dzin tahyee araa dze kodur Egypt ahɛnee mu mpo; osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ dzen mbordo.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so Uzziah totoow aban atsentsen wɔ Jerusalem wɔ kutuwdo kuropon no ho, na bɔnsa mu nkuropon no ho, na fasu no no mponee no ho, na ɔhyehyɛɛ no dzen.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔtotoow aban atsentsen wɔ sar no do, na otutuu nsubura pii, osiandɛ ɔwɔ mbowakuw pii wɔ ɔbɔn no mu na tɛtɛr no mu: Na ɔwɔ ekuafo na wenyin turehwɛfo wɔ mbepɔw no do, na nhaban-ber no mu; osiandɛ ɔpɛ ekuayɛ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so Uzziah ɔwɔ mbarimba Ekuafo dɔm a, wotu sa ekuw mu ekuw mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkanee a wɔnam ɔkyerɛwfo Jeiel na ɔhwɛdofo Maaseiah do kanee no no dodow tsetsee, wɔ ɔhen no n’asafohemfo no mu baako, Hananiah, ne nsaadze.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Egyanom efiefi mu etsitsir, mekyerɛ mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam nyinara, hɔn dodow yɛ mpemebien ahaesia.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn nsaadze na dɔm a wɔatsetse hɔn, mpemahaasa na mpemesuon ahaenum a wɔdze tum kɛse yɛ sa, dze boaa ɔhen no tsiaa atamfo no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Uzziah siesiee akyɛm, na mpeaa, na ndadzekyɛw, na ndadzentar, na ngyen, na tsiabo abo, maa hɔn, mekyerɛ wɔdze maa dɔm no nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔyɛɛ mfir a ɔyɛ edwimfo pa edwin wɔ Jerusalem, dɛ onsisi aban atsentsen do na akoban do, ma wɔmfa ntotow egyen-menaba na abo akɛse nyina. Na ne dzin tahyee kɔr ekyirkyir; osiandɛ wɔboaa no nwanwa mu araa kodur dɛ oyɛɛ dzen.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a ɔyɛɛ dzen no, nna n’akoma maa do ma ɔbɔɔ ɔbrafun, na ɔyɛɛ bɔn tsiaa Ewuradze ne Nyankopɔn; osiandɛ ɔnoara sii mu kɔr Ewuradze n’asɔrdan no mu dɛ ɔrekɛhyew eduhuam wɔ eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsɔfo Azariah dzii n’ekyir kɛhɛɛn mu, na Ewuradze n’asɔfoe eduowɔtwe, mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam, kã no ho:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wosiiw ɔhen Uzziah kwan, na wɔsee no dɛ, Uzziah, ɔnnyɛ ɔwo wodze, dɛ ebɛhyew eduhuam ama Ewuradze, na mbom Aaronmba asɔfo no a wɔayɛ hɔn krɔnkrɔn dɛ wɔnhyew eduhuam no na hɔndze a: Fi krɔnkrɔn-bea yi do ha fi, na ayɛ bɔn; nkyii so ɔrennyɛ w’enyidzii wɔ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Uzziah no bo fuwii; na eduhuamhyew adze no dze ne nsamu dɛ ɔdze rebɛhyew eduhuam; na aber a no bo fuuw asɔfo no, kwata fifiir no momapɔw do wɔ asɔfo no enyim wɔ Ewuradze ne fie hɔ, wɔ eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsɔfopanyin Azariah, na asɔfo no nyinara, hwɛɛ no, na, hwɛ, ɔayar kwata wɔ no momapɔw do, na wosunsuun no fii hɔ ntsɛmara; nyew, ɔnoara so yɛɛ ntsɛm fiir edzi, osiandɛ Ewuradze abɔ no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen Uzziah yɛɛ ɔkwatanyi dze kodur no wu da, na ɔkɛtsenaa nkyɛn ofi bi mu, ɔyɛ ɔkwatanyi ntsi; osiandɛ woetwa no efi Ewuradze fie: Na ne ba Jotham na ɔhwɛɛ ɔhen ne fidua no do, dɛ obuu asaase no do nkorɔfo no atsɛn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Uzziah no ho nsɛm nkaa no, kan dze na ekyir dze no, Amoz ne ba nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaiah kyerɛwee.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Uzziah nye n’egyanom kɛdae; na wokesiee no n’egyanom nkyɛn wɔ haban mu esiei a ɔyɛ ahemfo dze no mu; na wɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ ɔkwatanyi: Na ne babanyin Jotham dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a Jotam hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no, nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum, na odzii hen mfe duesia wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Jerusa, Zadok ne babaa a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya Uzia yɛe no nyinara tse: naaso ɔannkɛhɛn EWURADZE n’asɔrdan no mu. Na ɔman no kɔr do bɔɔ ɔbrafun.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ɔno na osii EWURADZE fi abotsen sor dze no, na Ofel fasu no do so osii pii.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so ɔkyekyeer nkurow wɔ Juda nkokodo nkurow mu, na ɔtotoow aban dzendzen na aban atsentsen wɔ kwaa mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ɔnoara na ɔnye Ammonmba hen no so koe, na odzii hɔn do nyim. Na afe no ara mu na Ammonmba no maa no dwetɛ talent ɔha, na ewifua esusudze mpemdu, na atoko so mpemdu. Dɛmara na Ammonmba no dze brɛɛ no wɔ afe a otsia ebien na ebiasa no mu so.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Jotam bɛyɛɛ ɔkatakyi, osiandɛ ɔhyehyɛɛ n’akwan wɔ EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Jotam no ho asɛm nkaa no na n’akodzi nyinara, na n’akwan no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel na Juda ahemfo nwoma no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum, na odzii hen mfe duesia wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jotam kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ David kurow mu: na ne babanyin Ahaz dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a Ahaz hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu; na odzii hen mfe duesia wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ɔannyɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE n’enyiwa do, dɛ n’egya David:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: mbom ɔnantseew Israel ahemfo akwan do, no so ɔyɛɛ ehonyi a woegu maa Baalim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so ɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ Hinom ne ba no bɔnsa no mu, na ɔhyeew ne mba wɔ ogya mu bɔɔ afɔr, dɛ mbrɛ amanamamfo a EWURADZE tuu hɔn fii Israel enyim no hɔn ndzeyɛɛ tse.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbɔɔ afɔr na ɔhyeew eduhuam wɔ mbea sorɔnsorɔm no do, na nkokodo, na ndua momon biara ase.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn yii no hyɛɛ Siriahen nsa; na wɔkaa no gya, na wɔfaa ne nyimpa mu piigyan ndɔmmum, na wɔdze hɔn kɔr Damaskɔs. Eso oyii no hyɛɛ Israelhen nsa, ɔno na ɔdze oku kɛse kaa no gya.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Remalia ne ba Peka kunkum Juda mu nyimpa mpemɔha eduonu da kor, hɔn nyinara mbarimba a wɔyɛ ndam a; osiandɛ wɔapow EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no ntsi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Zikri, ɔbarimba katakyi bi a ofi Efraim, kum ɔhen no ne ba Maaseia, na ofi no do ɔhwɛfo Azrikam, na Elkana a ɔyɛ ɔhen no n’ebedziekyir no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelmba no faa hɔn nuanom mu nyimpa mpemahaenu ndɔmmum, mbaa, mbabanyin, na mbabaa, na wɔfaa asadze so piigyan wɔ hɔn ho kɔree, na wɔdze asadze no kɔr Samaria.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE no nkɔnhyɛnyi bi wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Oded: na ɔno na ofiir edzi kehyiaa dɔm a wɔbaa Samaria no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hwɛ, osiandɛ EWURADZE, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn no bo fuuw Juda ntsi, na ɔdze hɔn ahyɛ hom nsa, na hom dze ebufuw a ekodu ɔsor ekuku hɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na afei hom robɔ tsirmpɔw dɛ hom ribedzi Juda na Jerusalɛmmba no nya ayɛ nkowaa na mfonabaa ama hom ho. Ana homara so homankasa hom mbrato nndeda hom do wɔ hom EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn afamu bi a?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi afei hom ntsie me, na hom mma dɔm a hom faa hɔn ndɔmmum wɔ hom nuanom mu no nsan nkɔ: na EWURADZE n’ebufuhyew no wɔ hom do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Efraimmba mu etsitsir no mu binom, Johanan ne ba Azaria, Mesillemot ne ba Berekia, na Sallum ne ba Jehizkia, na Hadlai ne ba Amasa, soɛrsoɛree tsiaa hɔn a wofi ɔsa bae no,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na wɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma hom mmfa ndɔmmumfo no mmba ha: na dza ɔdze asodzi a otsia EWURADZE bɛba hɛn do no ho na hom bɔ tsirmpɔw, ma wɔdze bi aka hɛn bɔn na hɛn asodzii ho: na hɛn asodzii dɔɔ so, osiandɛ ebufuhyew wɔ Israel do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna mbarimba a woemia no gyaa ndɔmmumfo na asadze no wɔ mbapɔmba na mboanofo no nyinara enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na mbarimba a wɔabobɔ hɔn edzin no soɛrsoɛree, na wɔfaa ndɔmmumfo no, na wɔdze asadze no bi furafuraa hɔn a wodzi adagyaw wɔ hɔn mu no, na wɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn ntar, na wɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn mpaboa, na wɔmaa hɔn biribi ma wodzii na wɔnomee, na wɔseraa hɔn, na wɔdze hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw wɔ hɔn mu no nyinara tsenatsenaa nsoasopɔnkɔ mpɔnkɔ do, na wɔdze hɔn baa Jeriko, mbɛ kurow no mu, wɔ hɔn nuanom nkyɛn: na Israelfo no sanee kɔr Samaria.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber no mu na ɔhen Ahaz somae ma wɔkɔr Asiria ahemfo no hɔ dɛ wɔmbɔboa no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Osiandɛ Edomfo no baa bio bɛkaa Juda gya, na wɔfaa ndɔmmumfo kɔree.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Filistiafo no so ebotua ɔbɔnmu nkurow, na Juda Pomu afamu nkurow no, na wɔagye Bɛt-semes, na Aijalon, na Gederot, na Soko nye no nkurobaase na Timna nye no nkurobaase; Gimzo so na no nkurobaase: na wɔtsenaa hɔ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na osian Israelhen Ahaz ntsi EWURADZE brɛɛ Juda adze; osiandɛ ɔayɛ Juda mu akɔhwidze, na ɔafom EWURADZE yayaayaw.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Asiriahen Tilgat-pilneser baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔbɛtseetsee no, na mbom ɔannhyɛ no dzen.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Ahaz faa EWURADZE ne fie, na ɔhen no na ahenmba fie adze na ɔdze maa Asiriahen no: naaso iyi mpo ammboa no papa biara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na n’ahohia mber mu mpo na ɔhen Ahaz yi foom EWURADZE dodoodow.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbɔɔ afɔr maa Damaskɔsfo a wɔkaa no gya no hɔn enyame: na ɔsee dɛ, Osiandɛ Siria ahemfo hɔn enyame no boaa hɔn no ntsi, emi so mobɔbɔ afɔr ama hɔn, ama wɔaaboa me. Mbom wɔyɛɛ ɔno, na Israel nyinara hɔn nsɛɛe.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Ahaz boaboaa Nyankopɔn fie ndzɛmba no ano, na otwitwaa Nyankopɔn fie ndzɛmba no mu esinesin, na ɔtotoow EWURADZE fie mbobow no mu; na osisii afɔrmbukyia wɔ Jerusalɛm kutuw biara do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na oyiyii mbea sorɔnsorɔm wɔ Juda kurow biara mu, dɛ wɔnhyew eduhuam mma enyame fofor, na ɔdze dɛm yii EWURADZE n’egyanom hɔn Nyankopɔn no ebufuw.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na n’akwan nyinara, kan dze na ekyir dze no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Juda na Israel ahemfo nwoma no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Ahaz kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ kurow no mu, mekyerɛ, Jerusalɛm mu; na wɔammfa no ammba Israel ahemfo hɔn asamandan no mu: na ne babanyin Hezekia dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a Hezekia hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe eduonu akron wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na ne dzin dze Abija, Zekaria ne babaa a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ dza n’egya David yɛe no tse nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ɔno na n’ahendzi mu afe a odzi kan no mu, bosoom a odzi kan no mu no, obuebuee EWURADZE fie mbobow no, na osiesiee no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze asɔfo na Levifo no bae, na ɔboaboaa hɔn kehyiaa boka afamu bea tɛtɛr no do,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ntsie me, hom Levifo; afei hom nyɛ homho krɔnkrɔn, na hom nyɛ EWURADZE, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn fi no krɔnkrɔn, na hom nyiyi efifidze no mfi bea krɔnkrɔn no do hɔ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hɛn egyanom fomee, na wɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn enyiwa do, na wɔpoow no, na wɔdaan hɔn enyi fii EWURADZE ne tsenabew no ho, na wɔdaan hɔn ekyir maa no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Eso wɔatotow nkrandaa no no mbobow no mu, na woedundum nkandzea no, na wɔannhyew eduhuam na wɔammbɔ ɔhyew afɔr so wɔ bea krɔnkrɔn no do amma Israel Nyankopɔn no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE n’ebufuw baa Juda na Jerusalɛm do, na oyii hɔn maa dɛ wɔntotow hɔn ndzi akɔnaaba, wɔnyɛ ahobowdze, na nhwiromabɔ, dɛ mbrɛ homara hom dze hom enyiwa hu yi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na, hwɛ, hɛn egyanom atotɔr afona ano, na hɛn mbabanyin na hɛn mbabaa na hɛn yernom no, wɔwɔ ndɔmmum mu, wɔ iyi ntsi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei ɔwɔ m’akoma mu dɛ menye EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, bedzi ahyɛmu, ma n’ebufuhyew no aadan efi hɛn do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Me mba, afei mma hom nnyɛ akwadwer: na EWURADZE asan mu eyi hom dɛ hom ngyina n’enyim nsom no, na hom nyɛ n’asomfo, na wɔnhyew eduhuam.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Levifo no soɛree, Amasai ne ba Mahat, na Azaria ne ba Joel a wofi Kohatfo mba mu no: na Merari ne mba mu, Abdi ne ba Kish, na Jehalelel ne ba Azaria: na Gersonfo mu, Zima ne ba Joa, na Joa ne ba Eden:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na Elizaffo mba mu, Simri na Jeuel: na Asaf ne mba mu, Zekaria na Matania:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na Heman ne mba mu, Jehuel na Simei: na Jedutun ne mba mu, Semaia na Uziel.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔboaboaa hɔn nuanom ano, na wɔsaan hɔnho krɔnkrɔn, na wɔkɔree, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm a ɔnam EWURADZE n’asɛm do tse no, dɛ wɔrebɛpepa EWURADZE ne fi no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na asɔfo no kɛhɛɛn EWURADZE ne fi no mu afamu dɛ wɔrekɛprapra mu, na woyiyii efifidze no nyinara a wohun no wɔ EWURADZE n’asɔrdan no mu no dze baa EWURADZE ne fi no n’abangua no do. Na Levifo no sosoe fii hɔ, dɛ wɔrokɔtow egu ɔwora Kidron mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei bosoom a odzi kan no mu da a odzi kan no na wɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ wɔreyɛ krɔnkrɔn no, na bosoom no ne da a otsia awɔtwe no wɔbaa EWURADZE ne nkrandaa no ho; na wɔyɛɛ EWURADZE ne fi no krɔnkrɔn nda awɔtwe: na bosoom a odzi kan no ne da a otsia duesia no na wowiei.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna wɔhɛɛn mu kɔr ɔhen Hezekia nkyɛn wɔ ahemfi no mu, na wɔsee dɛ, Yɛaprapra EWURADZE ne fie hɔ nyinara, na ɔhyew afɔrmbukyia no, nye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara ho, na kyerɛpaanoo pon no, ɔnye no ho ndzɛmba nyinara ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so ndzɛmba no nyinara a ɔhen Ahaz n’ahendzi no mu no ɔtowee gui wɔ aber a ɔtoo mbra no, yeesiesie na yɛayɛ no krɔnkrɔn; na, hwɛ ɔwowɔ EWURADZE n’afɔrmbukyia no enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔhen Hezekia soɛɛr ahanamakye, na ɔboaboaa kurow no mu asafohemfo no ano, na osii mu kɔr EWURADZE ne fie.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze anantwisaa esuon, na nguannyin esuon, na nguambaa esuon, na mpɔnkyenyin esuon, bae wɔ ahenman no na krɔnkrɔnbea no na Juda ho bɔn ho afɔr ntsi. Na ɔhyɛɛ Aaron ne mba asɔfo no dɛ wɔmfa mbɔ afɔr wɔ EWURADZE n’afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wokunkum anantwisaa no, na asɔfo no sɔɔw bɔgya no, na wɔdze petsee afɔrmbukyia no do: na wokunkum nguannyin no, na wɔdze bɔgya no petsee afɔrmbukyia no do: wokunkum nguambaa no so, na wɔdze bɔgya no petsee afɔrmbukyia no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze bɔn ho afɔr mpɔnkyenyin piin ɔhen no na mboanofo no enyim; na wɔdze hɔn nsa guguu hɔn do:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na asɔfo no kunkum hɔn, na wɔdze hɔn bɔgyaa no yɛɛ bɔn ho afɔr guu afɔrmbukyia no do, dɛ wɔdze repata ama Israel nyinara: osiandɛ ɔhen no hyɛɛ dɛ ɔhyew afɔr na bɔn ho afɔr no wɔmbɔ mma Israel nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze Levifo no gyinagyinaa EWURADZE ne fi no mu, wɔdzedze nkasaa, nye mbɛntasanku, na ɔnye nsankutsen, dɛ mbrɛ David na ɔhen n’adzehunyi Gad, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Natan mbrasɛm no tse: na mbrasɛm no fi EWURADZE hɔ ɔnam no nkɔnhyɛfo do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Levifo no dzedze David n’adwontow ndzɛmba no gyinagyinae, na asɔfo no so dzedze mbɛn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Hezekia hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmbɔ ɔhyew afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do. Na aber a ɔhyew afɔr no hyɛɛ ase no, nna EWURADZE no ndwom no, na ntotorobɛnto ɔnye Israelhen David n’asanku ndzɛmba no so hyɛɛ ase.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na mboanofo no nyinara kotokotowee na adwontofo no toow ndwom, na mbɛnhɛmfo no hɛnee; iyi nyinara do araa dze kodur dɛ wowiee ɔhyew afɔr no bɔ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a wowiee afɔr no bɔ no, nna ɔhen no na hɔn a wohun hɔn wɔ ne nkyɛn no nyinara, bobɔɔ hɔn mu adze sɔree.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so ɔhen Hezekia na asafohemfo no hyɛɛ Levifo no dɛ wɔmfa David, na adzehunyi Asaf nsɛm no nyi EWURADZE ayɛw. Na wɔdze enyigye yii ayɛw, na wɔbobɔɔ hɔn tsir adze sɔree.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Hezekia buae see dɛ, Afei hom etu homho esi nkyɛn ama EWURADZE, hom ntwe mpin, na hom mfa okum afɔr na aseda afɔr mbra EWURADZE fie. Na mboanofo no dze okum afɔr na aseda afɔr bae; na dodow a wɔwɔ ayamuyi akoma no dze ɔhyew afɔr bae.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhyew afɔr a mboanofo no dze bae no n’ano si anantwisaa eduosuon, nguannyin ɔha, na nguambaa ahaenu: iyinom nyinara wɔdze bɔbɔɔ EWURADZE ɔhyew afɔr.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na etuhoakyɛ ndzɛmba no yɛ anantwi ahaesia na nguan mpemebiasa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na asɔfo no dze hɔn ho suar dodow, ma dɛm ntsi woenntum enngua ɔhyew afɔr no nyinara: dɛm ntsi hɔn nuanom Levifo no boaa hɔn araa kodur dɛ wowiee edwuma no, na eso okodur dɛ asɔfo no yɛɛ hɔn ho krɔnkrɔn: osiandɛ Levifo no wɔtsen wɔ akoma mu dodow na wɔyɛɛ hɔnho krɔnkrɔn seen asɔfo no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na eso ɔhyew afɔr no dɔɔ so piigyan, nye asomdwee afɔr ho seradze no, na ɔnye ɔnom afɔr a ɔka ɔhyew afɔr biara ho no no. Nna wɔhyehyɛɛ EWURADZE fie ɔsom no pɛpɛɛpɛr.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Hezekia na ɔman no nyinara, hɔn enyi gyee, osian dza Nyankopɔn esiesie ama ɔman no ntsi: osiandɛ adze no wɔyɛɛ no ntsɛmdo.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Hezekia somae ma wɔkɔr Israel na Juda nyinara do, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛw nwoma so kɛmaa Efraim na Manaasɛ, dɛ wɔmbra EWURADZE fie wɔ Jerusalɛm, mbedzi apaho no mma EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no, na n’asafohemfo na mboanofo a wɔwɔ Jerusalɛm nyinara faa apam, dɛ wobedzi apaho no wɔ bosoom a otsia ebien no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Woenntum enndzi no ne ber no mu, osiandɛ nna asɔfo no nnyae nnyɛɛ hɔnho krɔnkrɔn ma wɔnndɔɔ so, nkyii so ɔman no nnhyiahyiaa hɔnho nnkehyiaa Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na asɛm no sɔɔ ɔhen no na mboanofo no nyinara enyi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna wɔhyɛɛ mbra pintsinn dɛ wɔmbɔ dawur wɔ Israel nyinara mu, mfi Beer-seba araa nkodu Dan, dɛ wɔmbra mbedzi apaho no mma EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no wɔ Jerusalɛm: osiandɛ nna wonndzii no nyimpa dodow kɛse dɛm yi dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔman nwoma asoafo no dze nwoma no a ofi ɔhen no na n’asafohemfo no hɔ no sii mu kɔree kekyiin Israel na Juda nyinara mu, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm no tse, dɛ, Hom Israelmba, hom nsan mbra EWURADZE, Abraham, Isaak, na Israel Nyankopɔn no, nkyɛn, ma ɔno so aasan aba nkaa a wofii nsa guanee wɔ hom mu no a wofii Asiria ahemfo nsamu firii no nkyɛn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na mma hom nnyɛ dɛ hom egyanom, na hom nuanom a wɔfoom EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn, ma ogyaa hɔn mu maa ɔsɛɛ, dɛ mbrɛ hom hu yi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei mma hom nnyɛ asoɔdzenfo dɛ mbrɛ hom egyanom yɛe; mbom hom ngyaa homho mma EWURADZE, na hom nkɛhɛn no krɔnkrɔnbea a ɔayɛ no krɔnkrɔn daa no, na hom nsom EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, ma n’ebufuhyew no mfi hom do mfir.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na sɛ hom san ba EWURADZE nkyɛn a, hom nuanom na hom mba benya mbɔbɔrhu wɔ hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum no enyim, na wɔasan aba asaase yi do bio: na EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn yɛ ɔdomfo na mbɔbɔrhufo, na onnkeyi n’enyi efi hom do, sɛ hom san ba ne nkyɛn a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔman nwoma asoafo no twaa mu fi kurow mu kɔr kurow mu dze faa Efraim na Manaasɛ man mu araa dze kodur Zebulun: na wɔseresereew hɔn, na wosii hɔn atwetwe.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Naaso binom a wofi Aser na Manaasɛ na Zebulun mu brɛɛ hɔnho adze, na wɔbaa Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Juda mu so Nyankopɔn ne nsa baa hɔ dɛ ɔrema hɔn akoma kor, dɛ wondzi ɔhen no na asafohemfo no mbrasɛm a wɔnam EWURADZE n’asɛm do hyɛe no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na nkorɔfo piinara behyiae wɔ Jerusalɛm dɛ wɔrebɛhyɛ epitsi fa no wɔ bosoom a otsia ebien no mu, dɔm kɛsenara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔsoɛree yiyii afɔrmbukyia a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no, na eduhuamhyew afɔrmbukyia no nyinara so woyiyii, na wɔkɔtowee guu ɔwora Kidron mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna wokunkum apaho no wɔ bosoom a otsia ebien no ne da a otsia duanan no: na asɔfo no na Levifo no enyi toe, na wɔyɛɛ hɔnho krɔnkrɔn, na wɔdze ɔhyew afɔr baa EWURADZE ne fie.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wokegyinagyinaa hɔn gyinabew wɔ hɔn kyenan do, dɛ mbrɛ Nyame nyimpa Moses mbra no tse: asɔfo no dze bɔgya no a wɔgyee no wɔ Levifo no nsamu no petsee.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Osiandɛ dodowara wɔ bagua no mu a wɔnnyɛɛ hɔnho krɔnkrɔn: dɛm ntsi Levifo no na ɔdaa hɔn do dɛ wokuku apaho no dze ma obiara a no ho nntsew, ma wɔaayɛ hɔn krɔnkrɔn ama EWURADZE.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔman no mu nyimpa dodow, mekyerɛ nyimpa pii, Efraim na Manaasɛ, Isakar na Zebulun mu ɔdodowara nntseew hɔnho, naaso wokwetsiir dza wɔakyerɛw no dzii apaho no. Na Hezekia bɔɔ mpaa maa hɔn see dɛ, EWURADZE pa no mfa nkyɛ obiara
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: a oesiesie n’akoma dɛ ɔrohwehwɛ Nyankopɔn, EWURADZE no, n’egyanom Nyankopɔn no, kaansa wɔnntseew noho dɛ mbrɛ krɔnkrɔnbea ahoguar no tse mpo a.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE tsiee Hezekia, na ɔbɔɔ ɔman no esu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelmba a wohun hɔn wɔ Jerusalɛm no, dze enyigye kɛse hyɛɛ epitsi fa no nda esuon: na Levifo no na asɔfo dze asanku ndzɛmba dzendzen toow ndwom dze yii EWURADZE ayɛw daa daa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Hezekia kasaa akomatɔyamu mu kyerɛɛ Levifo no nyinara a wonyim EWURADZE no som ho nyansa yie. Nna wodzidzii wɔ afahyɛ no ase nda esuon no, wɔbobɔɔ asomdwee afɔr, na wɔkamfoo EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na bagua no nyina faa apam dɛ wobedzi nda esuon fofor so: na wɔdze enyigye dzii nda esuon so bio.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Judahen Hezekia maa bagua no afɔrbɔdze anantwisaa apem na nguan mpemesuon; na asafohemfo no so maa bagua no anantwisaa apem na nguan mpemdu: na asɔfo dodowara yɛɛ hɔnho krɔnkrɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Juda bagua no nyinara, nye asɔfo na Levifo no, na dɔm no a wofi Israel bae no nyinara, na ahɔho a wofi Israel asaase do bae no, na hɔn a wɔtse Juda no, enyi gyee.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna enyigye kɛse baa Jerusalɛm: osiandɛ ofi Israelhen David ne ba Solomon n’aber do no, ne saso mmbaa pɛn wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna asɔfo na Levifo no soɛree na wohyiraa ɔman no: na wɔtsee hɔn ndze, na hɔn mpaabɔ dur ne tsenabea krɔnkrɔn, mekyerɛ ɔsor.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei aber a wowiee iyi nyinara no, Israel nyinara a wohun hɔn no fiir edzi kɔr Juda nkurow no mu, na wokobubuu edum no mu esinesin, na wotwitwaa Aserim no, na wodwuruuw mbea sorɔnsorɔm, na afɔrmbukyia no wɔ Juda na Benjamin nyinara, wɔ Efraim na Manaasɛ mu so, kodur dɛ wɔsɛɛ ne nyinara. Nna Israelmba no nyinara sanee, nyimpa biara kɔr n’enyadze mu, wɔ hɔnankasa hɔn nkurow mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Hezekia hyehyɛɛ asɔfo na Levifo nkyekyɛmu no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyekyɛmu tsetsee, nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ no som tse, asɔfo no na Levifo no nyina, dze maa ɔhyew afɔr na asomdwee afɔr, dɛ wɔnsom na wɔnda ase, na wonyi ayɛw wɔ EWURADZE ne nseraban aponkɛse no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Eso ɔhyɛɛ ɔhen no ne kyɛpɛn a ofi n’ahodze mu dze maa ɔhyew afɔr no, ɔnye dɛ, anapa na ewimbir ɔhyew afɔr no dze, na ahomgyeda, na abosoom fofor, na afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ, ɔhyew afɔr no dze, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ EWURADZE ne mbra nwoma no mu no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so ɔhyɛɛ nkorɔfo a wɔtse Jerusalɛm no dɛ wɔmfa asɔfo no na Levifo no hɔn kyɛfa no mma, ma wɔdze hɔnho aama EWURADZE ne mbra no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ntsɛmara a mbrasɛm no tahyee ara nna Israelmba no dze eburow, na nsa, na ngo, na ewo, na haban mu ndɔbaa nyinara mu nduadzewakan piigyan bae; na adze nyinara mu ebupɛn du du no so wɔdze baa piigyan.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israel na Judamba a wɔtsetse Juda nkurow mu no, hɔn so wɔdze anantwi na nguan mu ebupɛn du du, na ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn a wɔayɛ no krɔnkrɔn ama hɔn EWURADZE Nyankopɔn no ebupɛn du du no bae, na wɔdze guu hɔ ekuwekuw.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Bosoom a otsia ebiasa no mu na wɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ wɔrotow ekuwekuw no ne fapem, na wowiei wɔ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Hezekia na asafohemfo no bae bohun ekuwekuw no, nna wohyiraa EWURADZE, na ne man Israel.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Hezekia bisaa asɔfo na Levifo no ekuwekuw no ho asɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsɔfopanyin Azaria a ofi Zadok fie no, obuae see dɛ, Ofitsi dɛ ɔman no hyɛɛ ase dɛ wɔdze ayɛyɛdze reba EWURADZE ne fie no, yeedzidzi amee, na yeegyaa pii osiandɛ EWURADZE ehyira ne man; na dza ɔkae no nye fiadze kɛse yi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Hezekia hyɛɛ dɛ wonsiesie mpia wɔ EWURADZE ne fi no mu; na wosiesiei.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze no, na ebupɛn du du no, na ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn bɛhyɛɛ mu wɔ nokwar mu ara: na Levinyi Konania na ɔyɛ ɔpanyin wɔ do, na no nua Simei dzi hɔ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jehiel, Azazia, Nahat, Asahel, Jerimot, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakia, Mahat, na Benaia nye ahwɛdofo wɔ Konania na no nua Simei nsaadze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen Hezekia, na Nyankopɔn ne fie do ɔpanyin Azaria hyehyɛe no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Levinyi Imna ne ba Kore, boka kuropon ano ɔhwɛfo no, na ɔhwɛ Nyankopɔn n’ayamuyi ayɛyɛdze no do, dɛ ɔdze EWURADZE afɔrbɔdze, na krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn no bɛma.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔno n’ase na Eden, na Miniamin, na Jesua, na Semaia, Amaria, na Sekania wɔ, wɔ asɔfo nkurow no mu, wɔ hɔn nokwardzi edwuma mu, dɛ wɔdze bɛma hɔn nuanom dɛ mbrɛ nkyekyɛmu no tsetsee no, ɔkɛse dze tse dɛ ekumaba dze:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ɔsor hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn mbarimba ananakan do a, ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe ebiasa do dze rokɔ no, mekyerɛ obiara a ɔhɛn EWURADZE ne fie, dɛ mbrɛ da biara n’edwuma regye, dɛ wɔbɔsom wɔ hɔn ahwɛdodze mu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyekyɛmu tsetsee no;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na asɔfo no mu hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn ananakan do dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi tsetsee, na Levifo no so ofi hɔn a woedzi mfe eduonu do dze rokɔ no, wɔ hɔn ahwɛdodze mu wɔ hɔn nkyekyɛmu do;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na hɔn mbofraba, hɔn yernom, na hɔn mbabanyin, na hɔn mbabaa nyinara mu hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn ananakan do, wɔ mboanofo no nyinara mu: na hɔn nokwardzi edwuma no mu na wɔtseew hɔnho wɔ krɔnkrɔndze ho:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: eso Aaronmba asɔfo no a wɔwɔ hɔn nkurow no mfikyisaase do nhaban mu no, mbarimba a wɔabobɔ hɔn edzin, wɔwɔ kurow biara mu nkorkor, dɛ wɔmfa kyɛpɛn mma asɔfo no mu mbanyin, na hɔn a wɔkaan hɔn ananakan do wɔ Levifo no mu no nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na dɛm na Hezekia yɛe no wɔ Juda nyinara mu; na ɔyɛɛ dza oye na ɔtsen na ɔyɛ nokwar wɔ n’EWURADZE Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na edwuma biara a ɔhyɛɛ ase wɔ Nyankopɔn ne fie ɔsom no mu, na mbra no mu, na mbransɛm no mu, dɛ ɔrohwehwɛ ne Nyankopɔn no, ɔdze n’akoma nyina yɛe, na osii no yie.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm nokwardzi na dwuma pa a Hezekia na ɔman no dzii yi ekyir no, Asiriahen Senakerib bae na ɔbɛhɛɛn Juda, na ɔkyeer nsera wɔ kurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban no do, na ɔdween dɛ ɔbɛgye ama noho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a Hezekia hun dɛ Senakerib aba, na oesua dɛ ɔnye Jerusalɛm robɔko no,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: nna ɔnye ne mbapɔmba na ne mbarimba akatakyi faa apam dɛ wobesiw nsunyiwa a ɔwowɔ kurow no ekyir no; na wɔboaa no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna nkorɔfo pii behyiae, na wosisiiw nsunyiwa no nyinara, na ɔwora no a ɔpem da asaase no ne finimfin no, dɛ, Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na Asiria ahemfo bɛba ebohu nsu pii?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ dzen, na ɔtoow fasu a ebubu no nyinara, na ɔmaa do kodur aban atsentsen no ho, na fasu fofor so wɔ kurow no ekyir, na ɔhyɛɛ Millo dzen wɔ David kurow mu, na ɔyeyɛɛ akodze na akyɛm piigyan.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze ɔsa mu asafohemfo sisii ɔman no do, na ɔpoon hɔn behyiaa ne nkyɛn wɔ kurow no no kuropon ano gua no do, na ɔkasaa akomatɔmu mu kyerɛɛ hɔn, dɛ,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Hom nhyɛ homho dzen na hom nya akokodur, mma hom nsuro na eso hom abaw mu nntu wɔ Asiriahen no, na eso nyimpadodow a wɔka no ho no ntsi: osiandɛ nyia ɔwɔ hɛn nkyɛn no yɛ ɔkɛse sen nyia ɔka no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ɔno dze honam abasa na ɔnye no wɔ hɔ; na hɛn dze, hɛn EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔnye hɔn wɔ hɔ dɛ ɔbɔboa hɛn, na ɔaako hɛn ko ama hɛn. Nna ɔman no dze hɔnho tweer Judahen Hezekia ne nsɛm no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Iyi ekyir no Asiriahen Senakerib somaa no nkowaa ma wɔbaa Jerusalɛm, (afei nna ɔnoara wɔ Lakis ho, na n’etumfo nyinara so ka no ho,) Judahen Hezekia na Juda nyinara a wɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Mbrɛ Asiriahen Senakerib se nye yi, Ebɛnadze do na hom enyi da, ma hom retsena ntuae yi mu wɔ Jerusalɛm yi?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ana nnyɛ ndaadaa na Hezekia redaadaa hom, ma ɔdze hom ahyɛ owu nsa wɔ ɔkɔm na nsukɔm mu, dɛ, Hɛn EWURADZE Nyankopɔn beyi hɛn efi Asiriahen no nsamu no bi a?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ana nnyɛ ɔnoara Hezekia yi bi na oeyiyi ne mbea sorɔnsorɔm na n’afɔrmbukyia no, na ɔahyɛ Juda na Jerusalɛm, dɛ, Afɔrmbukyia kor enyim na hom nsɔr, na no do na hom nhyew eduhuam no bi a?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ana hom nnyim dza emi na m’egyanom dze ayɛ asaase do aman nyinara no? Ana asaase do amanaman hɔn enyame no nam kwan biara do tumii gyee hɔn asaase no wɔ me nsamu a?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Amanaman no a m’egyanom sɛɛ hɔn pasapasa no mu enyame nyinara mu woana na otumii gyee ne man fii me nsamu, na hom, hom Nyankopɔn no botum agye hom efi me nsamu yi?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi afei mma hom mma Hezekia nnsisi hom, na eso ɔnndaadaa hom dɛm, nkyii so mma hom nngye no nndzi: osiandɛ ɔman anaa ahenman biara mu nyame biara enntum anngye ne man emmfi me nsamu, na m’egyanom nsamu: na ankantam hom Nyankopɔn! Ɔno na ɔrebɛgye hom efi me nsamu anaa?
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na no nkorɔfo no so kasaa pii dze tsiaa EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na wɔdze tsiaa n’akowaa Hezekia.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛw nwoma so dze bɛyeyaaw EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na ɔkasaa tsiaa no, dɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ asaase no amanaman a wɔanngye hɔn man emmfi me nsamu no tse no, mbrɛ eso Hezekia ne Nyankopɔn no renngye ne man mmfi me nsamu ara nye no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu wɔ Jewfo kasaa mu frɛɛ Jerusalɛm nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ fasu no do no, dɛ worupuw hɔn ma wɔabɔ hu; ama wɔaagye kurow no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔkasaa Jerusalɛm Nyankopɔn no ho, tse dɛ, asaase do aman enyame no a wɔyɛ nyimpa nsaano edwuma no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen Hezekia, na Amoz ne ba nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia, bɔɔ mpaa wɔ iyi ntsi, na wosui frɛɛ ɔsor.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE somaa ɔbɔfo bi a okotwitwaa Asiriahen no ne nseraban mu mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, na mbapɔmba no, na asafohemfo no nyinara. Nna Asiriahen no dze enyimguase sanee kɔr nankasa n’asaase do. Na ɔkɔr ne nyame fie no nna hɔn a wofi nankasa ne yafun mu no bi dze afona kum no wɔ hɔ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm na EWURADZE gyee Hezekia na Jerusalɛm atsefo no nkwa fii Asiriahen Senakerib, na nyimpa nkaa no nyinara nsamu, na ɔmaa hɔn ho tɔɔ hɔn wɔ afa beebiara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na dodowara dze akyɛdze brɛɛ EWURADZE wɔ Jerusalɛm, na ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo brɛɛ Judahen Hezekia: ma dɛm ntsi ofitsi ber no na wohuhoor no wɔ amanaman nyinara enyi do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nda no mu Hezekia yaar owuyar: na ɔbɔɔ mpaa maa EWURADZE; na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no, na ɔmaa no asɛnkyerɛdze.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Mbom Hezekia annhyɛ ananmu dɛ mbrɛ yie a wɔyɛe maa no no tse; na n’akoma maa noho do: dɛm ntsi ebufuw baa ɔnoara, na Juda na Jerusalɛm do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Naaso Hezekia brɛɛ noho adze wɔ n’akoma ne ntsɛn no ho, ɔno na Jerusalɛm atsefo nyinara, ma dɛm ntsi EWURADZE n’ebufuw no ammba hɔn do wɔ Hezekia ne nda no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Hezekia nyaa ahonyadze na enyidzi kɛse mbordo: na ɔyɛɛ ndzekoradzebea maa dwetɛ, na sika, na abo a ɔsom bo, na nduhuam, na akyɛm, na ndzɛmbandzɛmba pa nyinara;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: adzekoradze adan so dze maa eburow na nsa na ngo ndɔbaa; na mbowadan dze maa fiembowa ahorow nyinara, na nguamban mu nguankuw.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so ɔkyekyeer nkurow maa noho, na onyaa nguankuw na anantwikuw piigyan: na Nyankopɔn maa no ahodze pii.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔnoara Hezekia yi ara so na osiiw Gihon nsu etsifi nsunyiwa no ano, na ɔdze nsu no nam daadze ase tɔnn baa David kurow no n’anee afamu. Na Hezekia yɛɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ dza ɔyɛe nyinara mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Mbom ber Babilɔn mbapɔmba abɔfoe a wɔsomaa hɔn ma wɔkɔr ne nkyɛn dɛ wonkebisa anwanwadze a wɔyɛɛ no wɔ asaase no do no ho asɛm no bae no, Nyankopɔn gyaa no dɛ ɔdze rosɔ no ahwɛ, ama oeehu dza ɔwɔ n’akoma mu nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Hezekia no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na ne ndzeyɛɛ pa, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Amoz ne ba nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia n’enyido adzehu no mu wɔ Juda na Israel ahemfo nwoma no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Hezekia kɔr ne nsamankyir, na wosiee no wɔ David ne mba asamandan mu afowee: na Juda na Jerusalɛm man no nyinara yɛɛ no enyidzi wɔ no wu mu. Na ne babanyin Manaasɛ dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
