text: Na n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia awɔtwe no a ɔda ho yɛ abofra no, nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ ɔrohwehwɛ n’egya David ne Nyankopɔn no n’ekyir kwan: na afe a otsia duebien no mu no nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ ɔretsew Juda na Jerusalɛm ho efi mbea sorɔnsorɔm, na Aserim, na ehonyi a woesian na ehonyi a woegu no ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wodwuruuw Baalim n’afɔrmbukyia no wɔ n’enyim; na ewia ehonyi no a osisi do wɔ sor no, otwitwae gui; na Aserim na ehonyi a woesian, na ehonyi a woegu no, obubuu no esinesin, na ɔyɛɛ no huntuma, na ɔtowee petsee hɔn a wɔbɔɔ afɔr maa hɔn no hɔn ndakamona no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhyeew asɔfo no hɔn mbiew no wɔ hɔn afɔrmbukyia no do, na ɔtseew Juda na Jerusalɛm ho.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na dɛmara so na ɔyɛɛ no wɔ Manaasɛ na Efraim na Simeon nkurow do, araa dze kodur Naftali, wɔ hɔn amamfo do hyiae.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na odwuruuw afɔrmbukyia no, na osiiw Aserim, na ehonyi a woesian no huntuhuntu, na otwitwaa ewia ehonyi no nyinara gui wɔ Israel asaase no nyinara mu, na ɔsanee baa Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei n’ahendzi no mu afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu, aber a ɔtseew asaase no, na ofi no ho no, ɔsomaa Azalia ne ba Safan, na kurow no mu ambrado Maaseia, na Joahaz ɔsɛnkaafo no ne ba Joa, dɛ wɔnkɔ nkesiesie EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn ne fi no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔbaa ɔsɔfopanyin Hilkia nkyɛn, na woyii sika no a wɔdze baa Nyankopɔn fie a Levifo, abowanoahwɛfo no, wɔagyegye no wɔ Manaasɛ na Efraim, na Israel nkaa no nyinara, na Juda na Benjamin, na Jerusalɛmfo no hɔ no, mae.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze hyɛɛ edwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ EWURADZE ne fi do ahwɛfo no nsa; na edwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ EWURADZE ne fie edwuma no dze maa dɛ wɔnsesa ofi no mu, na wommiamia mu;
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: mekyerɛ nduadwimfo na adansifo no na wɔdze maa hɔn, dɛ wɔmfa ntotɔ abo a woetwa, na nsɛwdo ndua, na wɔmfa nyɛ mpuna mma adan no a Juda ahemfo asɛɛ no no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na mbarimba no yɛɛ edwuma no nokwar mu: na hɔn ahwɛdofo nye Jahat na Obadia, Levifo a wofi Merarimba mu; na Zekaria na Mesullam a wofi Kohatfo mba mu no, dɛ wompiapia no: na Levifo nkaa no, hɔn a wonyim nsanku ndzɛmba mu nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Eso hɔn na wɔhwɛ ndzesoadzefo do, na wopiapia hɔn a wɔyɛ edwuma nyinara wɔ ɔsom ahorow biara mu: na Levifo no mu binom yɛ akyerɛwfo, na mpanyimfo, na mbobowano ahwɛfo.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na aber a woriyi sika a wɔdze aba EWURADZE fie no epue no, nna ɔsɔfo Hilkia hun EWURADZE ne mbra nwoma no a wɔdze nam Moses do mae no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Hilkia buae see ɔkyerɛwfo Safan dɛ, Mehu mbra nwoma no wɔ EWURADZE fie. Na Hilkia dze nwoma no maa Safan.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Safan dze nwoma no kɛmaa ɔhen no, na nkyii so ɔbɔɔ ɔhen no amandzɛɛ dɛ, Dza wɔdze hyɛɛ wo nkowaa nsa no nyinara wɔreyɛ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na woehue sika a wohun no wɔ EWURADZE fie no, na wɔdze ahyɛ ahwɛdofo no na edwumayɛfo no nsa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na afei ɔkyerɛwfo Safan kaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no dɛ, Ɔsɔfo Hilkia dze nwoma bi ama me. Na Safan kenkaan no wɔ ɔhen no enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen no tsee mbra no ne nsɛm no, ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ Hilkia, na Safan ne ba Ahikam, na Mika ne ba Abdon, na ɔkyerɛwfo Safan, na ɔhen n’akowaa Asaia, dɛ,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Hom nkɔ EWURADZE hɔ ebisa mma emi, na hɔn a wɔaka wɔ Israel na Juda mu no, wɔ nwoma no a woehu no no mu nsɛm no ho: na EWURADZE n’ebufuw a woehue egu hɛn do no ɔso, osiandɛ hɛn egyanom enndzi EWURADZE n’asɛm do, annyɛ dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu no tse.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna Hilkia, na hɔn a ɔhen no hyɛɛ hɔn no sii mu kɔr ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Hulda, ntardohwɛfo Sallum, Tokat ba no, Hasra ba no, ne yer no nkyɛn; (nna ɔtse Jerusalɛm afa a otsia ebien no mu;) na wɔkaa no dɛm kyerɛɛ no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Hom nkɛka nkyerɛ ɔbarimba a ɔsomaa hom wɔ me nkyɛn no dɛ,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ medze mbusu mebɛba bea yi, na no do mba do, mekyerɛ ndom a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma a wɔkenkaan no wɔ Judahen no enyim no mu nyinara:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: osiandɛ wɔapow me, na wɔakɛhyew eduhuam ama enyame fofor, ama wɔdze hɔn nsaano ndwuma nyinara eeyi me ebufuw; dɛm ntsi m’ebufuhyew bohue egu bea yi do, na wonnkodum no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Judahen a ɔsomaa hom dɛ wombebisa EWURADZE hɔ adze no dze, mbrɛ hom nse no nye yi, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Ɔfa nsɛm a atse no ho dze,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: osiandɛ w’akoma yɛ mberɛw, na ebrɛɛ woho adze wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim, aber a etsee ne nsɛm a otsia bea yi, na no do mba no ho no, na abrɛ woho adze wɔ m’enyim, na atsetsew wo ntar mu, na esu wɔ m’enyim ntsi; mo so metsie wo, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Hwɛ, mebɛma akɔ w’egyanom nkyɛn na wɔbɔkora wo akɔ w’adakamona mu asomdwee mu, nkyii so w’enyiwa nnkohu mbusu nyinara a medze reba bea yi, na no do mba no do no. Na wɔbɛkaa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ ɔhen no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna ɔhen no somae na wokehyiaa Juda na Jerusalɛm amampanyin no nyinara ma wɔbaa ne nkyɛn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no, na Juda mbarimba no nyinara na Jerusalɛm mba no nyinara na asɔfo no, na Levifo no, na ɔman no nyinara, akɛse na nkakraba nyina sii mu kɔr EWURADZE fie: na ɔkenkaan ahyɛmu nwoma no a wohun no wɔ EWURADZE fie no no mu nsɛm no nyinara guu hɔn asomu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔhen no gyinaa ne gyinabew, na odzii ahyɛmu wɔ EWURADZE enyim, dɛ obedzi EWURADZE n’ekyir, na ɔdze n’akoma nyinara, na ɔnye ne kra nyinara edzi ne mbrasɛm, na n’adasesɛm, na n’ahyɛdze a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nwoma yi mu no do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔmaa hɔn a wohun hɔn wɔ Jerusalɛm na Benjamin mu nyinara peen do. Na Jerusalɛm mba no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no, n’ahyɛmu no tse.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Josia yiyii ekyiwadze no nyinara fii aman a ɔyɛ Israelmba dze no nyinara mu, na ɔmaa hɔn a wohun hɔn wɔ Israel mu no nyinara soom EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn no. Ne nda nyinara mu no woemmfi EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no, n’ekyir dzi no ho emmfir.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Josia dzii apaho wɔ Jerusalɛm maa EWURADZE: na wokunkum apaho no wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu da a otsia duanan no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔdze asɔfo no kesisii hɔn ahwɛdodze mu, na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dzen maa EWURADZE fie ɔsom no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsee Levifo no a wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ Israel nyinara no a wɔyɛ akrɔnkrɔmfo dze ma EWURADZE no dɛ, Hom mfa adaka krɔnkrɔn no mbesi ofi no a David ne ba Israelhen Solomon sii no mu; ɔnnkɛyɛ hom kɔn ho adzesoadze bio: afei hom nsom EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, na ne man Israel.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hom nsiesie hom ho dɛ mbrɛ hom egyanom efiefi tsetsee wɔ hom nkyekyɛmu mu dɛ mbrɛ Israelhen David ne nkyerɛwee, na dɛ mbrɛ ne ba Solomon ne nkyerɛwee no tse.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hom ngyinagyina bea krɔnkrɔn no do dɛ mbrɛ hom nuanom ɔman no mba no egyanom efiefi mpaapaamu no tsetsee, na wɔmma Levifo egyanom ofi kor nnya kyɛfa kor.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hom nkuku apaho no, na hom nyɛ homho krɔnkrɔn, na hom nsiesie mfa mma hom nuanom, na wɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam Moses nsa do no tse.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Josia yii nguankuw mu, nguambaa na mpɔnkyemba, dze maa ɔman mba no, dɛ wɔmfa ne nyinara nyeyɛ apaho ayɛyɛdze mma hɔn a wohun hɔn wɔ hɔ no nyinara, no dodow yɛ mpemeduasa, na anantwisaa so mpemebiasa: iyi nyinara fi ɔhen no n’adze mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ne mbapɔmba no so yiyii maa ɔman no, asɔfo no, na Levifo no, ayamuyie mu. Hilkia na Zekaria na Jehiel, Nyankopɔn fie mbapɔmba no, dze apaho afɔrbɔdze nguan mpemebien ahaesia, na anantwi ahaasa maa asɔfo no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Konania so, na Semaia na Netanel, no nuanom no, na Hasabia na Jeiel na Jozabad, Levifo etsitsir no, dze apaho afɔrbɔdze nguan mpemenum, na anantwi ahaenum maa Levifo no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna wosiesiee ɔsom no, na asɔfo no gyinagyinaa hɔn gyinabew, na Levifo no so wowɔ hɔn nkyekyɛmu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm no tse.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wokunkum apaho no, na asɔfo no dze bɔgya no a wɔsɔɔw no hɔn nsamu no petsee, na Levifo no guguaa hɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na woyii ɔhyew afɔr no ma wɔdze aamema dɛ mbrɛ ɔman no mba egyanom efiefi mpaapaamu no tsetsee, dɛ wɔmfa nkɛma EWURADZE, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses nwoma no mu no. Na wɔyɛɛ anantwi no so dɛmara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔdze ogya totoo apaho no dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse: na afɔrbɔdze krɔnkrɔn no, wɔnoaa no wɔ nsenaba, na nkutu, na asɛn mu, na wɔmemaa do kɛmaa ɔman mba no ntsɛmara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na n’ekyir no wosiesiei maa hɔnho, na asɔfo no; osiandɛ Aaronmba asɔfo no woennya adagyer wɔ ɔhyew afɔr no bɔ na seradze ne hyew ho araa ma okodur adzesaa: dɛm ntsi na Levifo no siesiee bi maa hɔnho, na Aaronmba asɔfo no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na adwontofo Asafmba no so wɔ hɔn gyinabew dɛ mbrɛ David, na Asaf, na Heman, na ɔhen n’adzehunyi Jedutun, mbrasɛm no tse; na mbobowano ahwɛfo no wowɔ kuropon biara ano: wonnyi dɛ wofi hɔn som mu fir, na hɔn nuanom Levifo no siesiei maa hɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna wosiesiee EWURADZE no som no nyinara da no ara, dɛ wobedzi apaho no, na wɔabɔ ɔhyew afɔr wɔ EWURADZE n’afɔrmbukyia no do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen Josia ne mbrasɛm no tse.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Israelmba a wohun hɔn wɔ hɔ no dzii apaho no mber no mu, na epitsi afahyɛ no nda esuon.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na woenndzi apaho bi a ɔtse dɛ iyi, wɔ Israel, ofitsi nkɔnhyɛnyi Samuel ne nda no mu; nkyii so Israel ahemfo mu biara enndzi dɛm apaho a ɔtse dɛ mbrɛ Josia, na asɔfo no, na Levifo no, na Juda nyinara na Israel a wohun hɔn wɔ hɔ no, na Jerusalɛm mba no dzii no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Josia n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu na wodzii apaho yi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Iyi nyinara n’ekyir no, aber a Josia esiesie asɔrfi no, nna Egypthen Neko sii mu kɔr dɛ ɔrokɔko wɔ Karkemis wɔ Eufrates ho: na Josia fiir edzi kehyiaa no.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔsomaa abɔfo wɔ ne nkyɛn, dɛ, Ebɛnadze na menye wo wɔ yɛ, ɔwo Judahen? Mammba wo do ndɛ da yi, na mbom ofi a menye no wɔ akodzi no do a; na Nyankopɔn ahyɛ me dɛ menyɛ no ntsɛm: gyaa dɛ edze woho bɛgyegye mu wɔ Nyankopɔn a ɔka mo ho no ho, mma ɔaannsɛɛ wo.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Naaso Josia ammpɛ dɛ ɔdan n’ekyir fi no ho, na mbom ɔsakyeer noho ama ɔnye no aakɔko, na oenntsie Neko ne nsɛm no a ofi Nyankopɔn anomu no, na ɔbae bɔkoe wɔ Megiddo bɔnsa no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na egyentofo no totowee bobɔɔ ɔhen Josia; na ɔhen no see no nkowaa no dɛ, Hom mfa me mfi ha nkɔ; na mepira dɛ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna no nkowaa no yii no fii tseaseanam no mu, na wɔdze no koo tseaseanam a otsia ebien no a ɔwɔ no mu, na wɔdze no baa Jerusalɛm; na owui, na wosiee no wɔ n’egyanom asamandan no mu. Na Juda na Jerusalɛm nyinara wogyaam Josia.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Jeremia twaa Josia ho kwadwom: na mbarimba adwontofo na mbaa adwontofo nyinara kaa Josia ho asɛm wɔ kwadwom mu dze bodu ndɛ da yi; na wɔdze yɛɛ mbra wɔ Israel mu: na, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no kwadwom no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Josia no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na ne ndzeyɛɛ pa dɛ mbrɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ EWURADZE ne mbra mu tse,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na no ho nsɛm, kan dze na ekyir dze no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel na Juda ahemfo nwoma no mu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nna asaase no do ɔman no faa Josia ne babanyin Jehoahaz, na wɔhyɛɛ no hen wɔ n’egya n’ananmu wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a Jehoahaz hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu ebiasa: na odzii hen abosoom ebiasa wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Egypthen no tuu no adze do wɔ Jerusalɛm, na odzii asaase no ɔsakaw gyee dwetɛ talent ɔha na sika talent.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Egypthen no dze Jehoahaz no nua Eliakim hyɛɛ hen wɔ Juda na Jerusalɛm do, na ɔdaan ne dzin Jehoiakim. Na Neko faa Jehoahaz, na ɔdze no kɔr Egypt.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a Jehoiakim hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu enum; na odzii hen mfe dubiako wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn enyi do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Ɔno na Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar fowee baa no do, na ɔtoo no mpokyerɛ, dɛ ɔdze no rokɔ Babilɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nebukadenezar dze EWURADZE ne fie ndzɛmba no bi so kɔr Babilɔn, na ɔdze kesisii n’asɔrdan mu wɔ Babilɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Jehoiakim no ho nsɛm nkaa no, na n’ekyiwadze a ɔyɛe no, na dza wohun no wɔ mu no, hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Israel na Juda ahemfo nwoma no mu: na ne babanyin Jehoiakin dzii hen wɔ n’ananmu.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a Jehoiakin hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe awɔtwe; na odzii hen abosoom ebiasa na dadu wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyi do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na n’afedan no, ɔhen Nebukadenezar somae ma wɔkɛfaa no kɔr Babilɔn, ka EWURADZE ne fie ndzɛmba fɛɛfɛw no ho, na ɔhyɛɛ no nua Zedekia ɔhen wɔ Juda na Jerusalɛm do.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Aber a Zedekia hyɛɛ ase dɛ oridzi hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu biako; na odzii hen mfe dubiako wɔ Jerusalɛm,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn enyi do; ɔammbrɛ noho adze wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia a ɔkasaa EWURADZE ano no enyim.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na ɔno so ɔtseew etua wɔ ɔhen Nebukadenezar a ɔmaa ɔdze Nyankopɔn kaa ntam no no do: na mbom ɔkyee no kɔn, na opiriim n’akoma, dɛ ɔrennsan mmba EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no nkyɛn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Nkyii so asɔfo no mu etsitsir nyinara, na ɔman no, foom kɛsenara dɛ mbrɛ wiadze ekyiwadze no tsetsee; na woguu EWURADZE ne fi no a ɔayɛ no krɔnkrɔn wɔ Jerusalɛm no ho fi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom Nyankopɔn no, nam n’abɔfoe do somae ma wɔbaa hɔn nkyɛn, ɔsoɛɛr ahanamakye na ɔsomae; osiandɛ ohun ne man, na ne tsenabew mbɔbɔr:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: naaso hɔn dze, wosii Nyankopɔn abɔfoe no atwetwe, na wobuu ne nsɛm no enyimtsia, na wɔsesaar no nkɔnhyɛfo no, kodur dɛ EWURADZE n’ebufuhyew no soɛree wɔ ne man do, kodur dɛ ɔyarsa nnyi hɔ bio.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Dɛm ntsi na ɔdze Kaldeafo hen no baa hɔn do, ɔno na ɔdze afona kunkum hɔn mberantsɛ wɔ hɔn krɔnkrɔnbea ofi no mu, na woennya ayamuhyehye wɔ aberantsɛ anaa akataasia, akɔdaa anaa ɔtsetsenyi ho: ɔdze hɔn nyinara hyɛɛ ne nsa.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na Nyankopɔn fie ndzɛmba no nyinara, akɛse na nkakraba, na EWURADZE fie akoradze no, na ɔhen no, na n’asafohemfo akoradze no; iyinom nyinara ɔdze baa Babilɔn.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na wɔhyeew Nyankopɔn ne fi no, na wodwuruuw Jerusalɛm fasu no, na wɔdze ogya hyeew no mu aban no nyinara, na wɔsɛɛ no mu ndzɛmba fɛɛfɛw no nyinara.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Na hɔn a wofii afona anomu guanee no, ɔsosoo hɔn kɔr Babilɔn; na wɔkɛyɛɛ nkowaa maa ɔno na ne mba araa dze kodur Persia ahendzi ber no:
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: ama wɔdze aama EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam Jeremia anomu no ahyɛ ma, ekodu dɛ asaase no benya n’ahomgyenda no edzi: na mber tsentsen a ɔda hɔ amamfo no nna n’ahomgyeda no dze ewie mfe eduosuon dzi.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Persiahen Sirus n’afe a odzi kan mu no, mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ofi Jeremia n’anomu no bɛba mu ntsi, nna EWURADZE bɔɔ Persiahen Sirus no sunsum nkenyan, ma ɔmaa wɔkɔbɔɔ dawur dze kyiin n’ahenman nyinara mu, na ɔmaa wɔkyerɛwee so, dɛ,
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Mbrɛ Persiahen Sirus se nye yi, Asaase do ahendzi nyinara nna EWURADZE, ɔsor Nyankopɔn no, ɔdze ama me; na ɔnoara na ɔdze ahyɛ me dɛ minsi no ofi wɔ Jerusalɛm a ɔwɔ Juda no. Obiara a ɔwɔ hom mu a ofi ne man nyinara mu no, EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn ndzi n’ekyir, na wɔmma ommfi ha nkɔ.
title: 2ND CHRONICLES

text: Afei Persiahen Sirus n’afe a odzi kan no mu no, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam Jeremia n’anomu no bɛba mu ntsi, nna EWURADZE maa Persiahen no nyaa atsenka soronko bi wɔ no mu ma ɔmaa wɔkɔbɔɔ dawur kyiin n’ahenman nyinara mu, na ɔmaa wɔkyerɛwee so, dɛ,
title: EZRA

text: Mbrɛ Persiahen Sirus se nye yi, Asaase do ahendzi nyinara nna EWURADZE, ɔsor Nyankopɔn no, ɔdze ama me; na ɔnoara na ɔdze n’ahyɛdze ama me dɛ minsi fie wɔ Jerusalɛm a ɔwɔ Juda no mma no.
title: EZRA

text: Obiara a ɔwɔ hom mu a ofi ne man nyinara mu no, ne Nyankopɔn ndzi n’ekyir, na wɔmma ɔmfow nkɔ Jerusalɛm a ɔwɔ Juda no, na onkesi EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, ne fi no, (ɔno nye Nyankopɔn,) a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no.
title: EZRA

text: Na obiara a ɔaka wɔ beebiara a ɔakɔsoɛ hɔ hɔho no, wɔmma ne bea do hɔ nyimpa no mfa dwetɛ, ɔnye sika, ɔnye ahodze, ɔnye mbowa, nka ayamuyi afɔrbɔdze a wɔdze bɛma Nyankopɔn fi no a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no ho, mboa no.
title: EZRA

text: Nna Juda na Benjamin mu egyanom efiefi etsitsir, na asɔfo, na Levifo, mekyerɛ hɔn a Nyankopɔn abɔ hɔn sunsum nkenyan no nyinara, soɛrsoɛree dɛ wɔrofow akɔ ekesi EWURADZE ne fi a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no.
title: EZRA

text: Na hɔn a wɔabɔ hɔnho aprɔw no nyinara wɔdze dwetɛ ndzɛmba, nye sika nye ahodze, nye mbowa, na ɔnye ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo, hyɛɛ hɔn nsa dzen, dze kaa dza wɔdze maa ayamuyi mu no nyinara ho.
title: EZRA

text: Eso ɔhen Sirus yiyii EWURADZE fie ndzɛmbandzɛmba a Nebukadenezar dze fii Jerusalɛm bae besisii n’enyame fie no;
title: EZRA

text: mekyerɛ ɔno na Persiahen Sirus dze nam no fotosamfo Mitredat nsa do bae, na ɔbɛkanee dze hyɛɛ Juda ɔbapɔmba, Sesbazar nsa.
title: EZRA

text: Na no dodow nye yi: sika mboyaa eduasa, dwetɛ mboyaa apem, asekan eduonu akron;
title: EZRA

text: sika mbɛɛsen eduasa, dwetɛ mbɛɛsen a odzi do hɔ ahaanan na du, na ndzɛmba a ɔkeka ho so apem.
title: EZRA

text: Sika na dwetɛ ndzɛmba no nyinara yɛ mpemenum na ahaanan. Iyinom nyinara na Sesbazar dze bae, wɔ aber a wɔdze hɔn a wɔkɔr ndɔmmum mu no fi Babilɔn sanee baa Jerusalɛm no.
title: EZRA

text: Afei woyinom nye ɔmansin no mu mba a wofi ndɔmmumkɔ a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar sosoo hɔn koguu Babilɔn no sanee bae, na wɔsanee baa Jerusalɛm na Juda, na obiara kɔr no kurow mu.
title: EZRA

text: Na woyinom nye hɔn a wofi Tel-mela, Tel-harsa, Kerub, Addan, nye Immer sanee bae no: na woenntum annkyerɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi, nye hɔn ase, kyerɛ dɛ wofi Israel anaa:

title: EZRA

text: Na asɔfomba: Habaimba, Hakozmba, Barzillai a ɔwaar Gileadnyi Barzillai ne mbabaa no mu bi, na wɔdze hɔn dzin too no no, mba.
title: EZRA

text: Woyinom wɔhwehwɛɛ hɔn ebusua nwoma wɔ hɔn a wɔnam do buu hɔn ano no mu, naaso woennhu: dɛm ntsi wobuu hɔn ahoɔfifo na woyii hɔn fii asɔfodzi no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Na Ambrado no see hɔn dɛ, mma wonndzi krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn no bi, ma onkodu dɛ ɔsɔfo bi dze Urim na Tummim begyina hɔ.
title: EZRA

text: Mboanofo no nyinara yɛ mpemeduanan ebien ahaasa eduosia,
title: EZRA

text: ɔsor hɔn nkowaa na hɔn mfonabaa a hɔn so wɔyɛ mpemesuon ahaasa eduasa esuon: na wɔwɔ mbarimba adwontofo na mbaa adwontofo ahaenu.
title: EZRA

text: Hɔn mpɔnkɔ yɛ ahaesuon eduasa esia; hɔn asoasompɔnkɔ, ahaenu eduanan enum;
title: EZRA

text: hɔn efumpɔnkɔ ahaanan eduasa enum; hɔn nsoasopɔnkɔ, mpemesia ahaesuon eduonu.
title: EZRA

text: Na wɔbaa EWURADZE fie a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no ara pɛr, nna egyanom efiefi etsitsir no mu binom fi hɔn pɛ mu kyekyɛɛ Nyankopɔn fie no ho ndzɛmba dɛ wɔmfa mma do nsi ne sibew:
title: EZRA

text: wɔmaa dɛ mbrɛ hɔn tum tse na wɔdze guu edwuma no ho adzekoradze no mu, sika darik mpem eduosiabiako, na dwetɛ abɛndaa mpemenum, na asɔfo ntar ɔha.
title: EZRA

text: Nna asɔfo no, na Levifo no, na ɔman no mu binom, nye adwontofo no, nye mbobowano ahwɛfo no, nye Netinfo no, tsenatsenaa hɔn nkurow mu, na Israel nyinara so tsenatsenaa hɔn nkurow mu.
title: EZRA

text: Na aber a bosoom a otsia esuon no durii, na Israelmba tsetse nkurow no mu no, nna ɔman no poon hɔnho hyiae dɛ nyimpa kor baa Jerusalɛm.
title: EZRA

text: Nna Jozadak ne ba Jesua, na no nuanom asɔfo no, na Sealtiel ne ba Zerubabel, na no nuanom, soɛree, na wokesii Israel Nyankopɔn n’afɔrmbukyia no, dɛ wɔrobɔ hyew afɔr wɔ do, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Nyame nyimpa Moses ne mbra no mu no.
title: EZRA

text: Na wɔdze afɔrmbukyia no sii ne ngyinado no do; na suro baa hɔn do osian amanaman do nkorɔfo no ntsi: na wɔbɔɔ hyew afɔr wɔ do maa EWURADZE, mekyerɛ hyew afɔr anapa na ewimbir.
title: EZRA

text: Na wodzii ntamadan afe no, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no, na wɔbɔɔ daa daa hyew afɔr no, wɔ no dodow mu, dɛ mbrɛ mbra no kyerɛ, na dɛ mbrɛ da biara no ho nhyehyɛɛ tse;
title: EZRA

text: na n’ekyir no wɔbɔɔ daa hyew afɔr, na abosoom fofor dze, na EWURADZE n’afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ ayɛ no krɔnkrɔn no nyinara dze, na obiara a ɔpra ne yamu bɔ ayamuyi afɔr ma EWURADZE no dze so.
title: EZRA

text: Ofitsi bosoom a otsia esuon no ne da a odzi kan no mu na wɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ wɔrobɔ hyew afɔr ama EWURADZE: nna EWURADZE n’asɔrdan no ne fapem no dze, wonnyae nntoe.
title: EZRA

text: Wɔdze sika so maa abotwafo, na nduadwimfo no so; na wɔdze edziban, na nsa, na ngo, maa hɔn a wofi Zidon, na hɔn a wofi Taere, dɛ wɔmfa nkyindur ndua mfi Lebanon nkɔ po ho wɔ Jopa, dɛ mbrɛ kwan a Persiahen Sirus dze maa hɔn no tse.
title: EZRA

text: Afei hɔn mbae a wɔbaa Nyankopɔn fi no ho wɔ Jerusalɛm no n’afe a otsia ebien no mu, bosoom a otsia ebien no mu no, Sealtiel ne ba Zerubabel, na Jozadak ne ba Jesua, na hɔn nuanom asɔfo nkaa no na Levifo no, na hɔn a wofii ndɔmmumkɔ no mu baa Jerusalɛm no nyinara hyɛɛ ase; na wɔdze Levifo a woedzi mfe eduonu dze rokɔ no sisii hɔ dɛ wɔnhwɛ EWURADZE fi no n’edwuma do.
title: EZRA

text: Nna Jesua ɔnye ne mba na no nuanom, Kadmiel na ne mba, Judamba no, gyinae dɛ nyimpa kor, dɛ wɔrohwɛ Nyankopɔn fie edwumayɛfo no do: na Henadadmba, wɔnye hɔn mba na hɔn nuanom Levifo no so.
title: EZRA

text: Na aber a adantofo no hyɛɛ EWURADZE asɔrdan no ne fapem no ase no, wɔdze asɔfo a woewuna hɔn ntar na wɔdzedze mbɛn gyinagyina hɔ na Asaf ne mba Levifo no wɔdzedze nkasaa gyinagyina hɔ, dɛ wonyi EWURADZE ayɛw, dɛ mbrɛ Israelhen David ne nhyehyɛɛ no tse.
title: EZRA

text: Na wɔbɔɔ mu toow ndwom wɔ ayɛyi na ndaase mu memaa EWURADZE, dɛ, Na oye, na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa, wɔ Israel do. Na ɔman no nyinara dze esebɔ kɛse bɔɔ ose, wɔ aber a woriyi EWURADZE ayɛw no, osiandɛ wɔato EWURADZE ne dan no ne fapem ntsi.
title: EZRA

text: Na asɔfo na Levifo na egyanom efiefi etsitsir no, nkɔdaa a wohun fie a odzi kan no ana wɔresɛɛ no no, aber a wɔtoo fie kor yi ne fapem wɔ hɔn enyim no, wɔdze ndze kɛse sui; na dodowara so bɔɔ ose kɛse wɔ enyigye ntsi:
title: EZRA

text: ma dɛm ntsi ɔman no enntum ennhu enyigye osebɔ ne dede no na ɔman no hɔn su no ne dede no mu nsonsonee: osiandɛ ɔman no dze esebɔ kɛse bɔɔ ose, na dede no wɔtsee no wɔ ekyirkyiikyir.
title: EZRA

text: Afei aber a Juda na Benjamin hɔn atamfo no tsee dɛ ndɔmmumkɔ mu mba no risi asɔrdan ama EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no,
title: EZRA

text: nna wɔtwee piin Zerubabel, na egyanom efiefi etsitsir no, na wɔsee hɔn dɛ, Wɔmma yɛnye hom nsi: osiandɛ yɛsɔr hom Nyankopɔn no, dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ yi; na ɔno na yɛbɔ no afɔr ofitsi Asiriahen Esar-haddon a ɔdze hɛn baa ha no ne nda no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Na Zerubabel, na Jesua, na Israel egyanom efiefi etsitsir nkaa no see hɔn dɛ, Hom nnyi hweeara nye hɛn yɛ dɛ hom nye hɛn besi dan ama hɛn Nyankopɔn; na hɛnara nko bɔbɔ mu esi ama EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, dɛ mbrɛ Persiahen Sirus ahyɛ hɛn no.
title: EZRA

text: Nna asaase no do nkorɔfo no, gogoow Juda ɔman no abaw, na wotuu hɔn akoma wɔ adansi no mu,
title: EZRA

text: na wɔbobɔɔ apamfo paa tsiaa hɔn, dɛ wonsiw hɔn tsirmpɔw kwan, wɔ Persiahen Sirus ne nda no nyinara mu araa dze kodu Persiahen Darius n’ahendzi no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Na Ahasuerus n’ahendzi no mu, n’ahendzi ahyɛse no mu, nna wɔkyerɛɛw ntoatoa nwoma dze tsiaa Juda na Jerusalɛm mba no.
title: EZRA

text: Na Artasɛkeses ne nda no mu na Bishlam, Mitredat, Tabeel, na ne nsɛfo nkaa no kyerɛɛw Persiahen Artasɛkeses; na nwoma no wɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ Siria kyerɛwee mu, na wɔkyerɛɛ ase so wɔ Siria kasa mu.
title: EZRA

text: Eguasosɛmpanyin Rehum na ɔkyerɛwfo Simsai kyerɛɛw nwoma no tsiaa Jerusalɛm dze kɛmaa ɔhen Artasɛkeses dɛm dɛ:
title: EZRA

text: nna eguasosɛmpanyin Rehum, na kyerɛwfo Simsai, na hɔn mfɛfo nkaa no; atsɛmbuafo, ambradofo, abirɛmpɔn, Persiafo, Erekfo, Babilɔnfo, Susafo a hɔnara so nye Elamfo,
title: EZRA

text: na amanaman nkaa a Ɔsenapar kɛse a ɔwɔ dzin no dze hɔn bae, na ɔdze hɔn boguu Samaria kurow mu, na aman nkaa a wɔwɔ esuegya noho no mu no, na adze kyerɛwee.
title: EZRA

text: Nwoma a wɔdze somae ma wɔdze kɛmaa ɔhen Artasɛkeses no no nsusudo nye yi; Wo nkowaa mbarimba a wɔwɔ esuegya noho no, na adze.
title: EZRA

text: Wɔmma ɔhen nhu, dɛ Jewfo a wofi wo nkyɛn bae no wɔaba hɛn nkyɛn wɔ Jerusalɛm; wɔrekyekyer etuatsew kurow bɔn no, na woewie ho afasu no, na woemiamia fapem no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Afei wɔmma ɔhen nhu, dɛ sɛ wɔkyekyer kurow yi, na wowie ho afasu no a, ɔno wɔnnkɛma ɔtow, amandze, anaa kwandodze, na no nsunsuando bɛyɛ na ahemfo hɔn adze abɔ hɔn.
title: EZRA

text: Afei osiandɛ ahemfie nkyen na yedzi, na ɔnnsɛ hɛn dɛ yɛtsena ho hwɛ ɔhen n’adapaabɔ no ntsi, na yɛasoma dɛ wɔmbɛda no edzi nkyerɛ ɔhen:
title: EZRA

text: ma wɔnhwehwɛ w’egyanom nkaa nwoma no mu: na ibohu no wɔ nkaa nwoma no mu, na ehu dɛ kurow yi yɛ etuatsew kurow, na obusufo dze ma ahemfo na amansin, na wɔatwe manso wɔ ɔnoara mu fi tsetseberdo: iyi ntsi na wɔbɔɔ kurow no.
title: EZRA

text: Hɛn dze, yɛreda no edzi akyerɛ ɔhen dɛ, sɛ wɔkyekyer kurow yi, na wowie ho afasu no a, ɔno irinnya kyɛfa biara wɔ esuegya noho.
title: EZRA

text: Nna ɔhen no somae ma wɔdze mbuae kɛmaa eguasosɛmpanyin Rehum, na kyerɛwfo Simsai, na hɔn mfɛfo nkaa no a wɔtsetse Samaria, na aman nkaa a wɔwɔ esuegya noho no mu no dɛ, Asomdwee, na adze.
title: EZRA

text: Nwoma no a hom somae ma wɔdze brɛɛ hɛn no wɔakenkan no kofee wɔ m’enyim.
title: EZRA

text: Na emi so mehyɛe, na wɔahwehwɛ mu, na woehu dɛ kurow yi fi tsetseberdo na ɔmaa noho tsiaa ahemfo, na etuatsew na mansotwe sisii mu.
title: EZRA

text: Ahemfo akatakyi so na wɔahwɛ Jerusalɛm do, hɔn na wɔhwɛɛ aman a ɔwɔ esuegya noho nyinara do; na ɔtow, amandze, na kwandodze so wotuae maa hɔn.
title: EZRA

text: Afei hom nhyɛ mbra mma mbarimba no ngyaa, na amma wɔannkyekyer kurow yi ma onkodu dɛ mara mebɛhyɛ ho mbra ana.
title: EZRA

text: Na hom nhwɛ yie ma hom aannyɛ nyaanyaa wɔ mu: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔsɛɛ botu mpon ma ahemfo adze abɔ hɔn?
title: EZRA

text: Afei aber a ɔhen Artasɛkeses no nwoma no no nsusudo no wɔkenkaan no wɔ Rehum, na kyerɛwfo Simsai, na hɔn mfɛfo no enyim ara pɛr, nna wosii mu ntsɛmara baa Jerusalɛm Jewfo no nkyɛn, na wɔdze nhyɛ na tum siiw hɔn kwan.
title: EZRA

text: Nna wogyaa Nyankopɔn ne fi no a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no no ho edwuma no yɛ; na ɔkwan siwii araa dze kodur Persiahen Darius n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia ebien no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Afei nkɔnhyɛfo no, nkɔnhyɛnyi Hagai, na Iddo ne ba Zekaria hyɛɛ Jewfo a wɔwɔ Juda na Jerusalɛm no nkɔm; Israel Nyankopɔn ne dzin mu na wɔhyɛɛ hɔn nkɔm.
title: EZRA

text: Nna Sealtiel ne ba Zerubabel, na Jozadak ne ba Jesua soɛree, na wɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ worisi Nyankopɔn fi no a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no; na Nyankopɔn no nkɔnhyɛfo no ka hɔn ho, susuoo hɔn mu.
title: EZRA

text: Mber no mu ara na Tattenai, ambrado no a ɔwɔ esuegya noho no, na Setar-bozenai, na hɔn mfɛfo baa hɔn do, na wɔsee hɔn dɛ, Woana na ɔhyɛɛ hom mbra dɛ hom nsi dan yi, na wonwie fasu yi?
title: EZRA

text: Nna wɔsanee so bisaa hɔn dɛ, Na hɔn worisi dan yi edzi nye dɛn?
title: EZRA

text: Naaso nna hɔn Nyankopɔn n’enyiwa wɔ Jewfo mpanyimfo no do, ntsi woennsiw hɔn kwan, kɛpem dɛ asɛm no bodu Darius nkyɛn, na nkyii wɔdze no ho mbuae nwoma bɛsan aba.
title: EZRA

text: Nwoma no a esuegya noho ambrado Tattenai, na Setar-bozenai, na ne mfɛfo Afarsakfo a wɔwɔ esuegya noho somae ma wɔdze kɛmaa ɔhen Darius no no nsusudo nye yi:
title: EZRA

text: wɔsomae ma wɔdze nwoma bi kɛmaa no a wɔakyerɛw mu dɛm; Asomdwee ara nko na ɔnka ɔhen Darius.
title: EZRA

text: Wɔmma ɔhen nhu dɛ yesii mu kɔr Juda ɔmansin mu, Nyankopɔn kɛse no ne fie hɔ, na wɔdze abo akɛse risi, na wɔdze ndua egugu fasu no do, na edwuma yi wɔreyɛ no ɔyɛ pa ara, na ɔreyɛ yie wɔ hɔn nsaano.
title: EZRA

text: Nna yebisaa mpanyimfo no na yɛsee hɔn dɛ, Woana na ɔhyɛɛ hom mbra dɛ hom nsi dan yi, na hom nwie fasu yi?
title: EZRA

text: Yebisabisaa hɔn edzin so dɛ yɛrebɛka akyerɛ wo ma yaakyerɛkyerɛw mbarimba a wɔyɛ hɔn mu etsitsir no edzin.
title: EZRA

text: Na mbrɛ wobuaa hɛn nye yi, dɛ, Hɛn dze, yɛyɛ ɔsor na asaase Nyankopɔn no nkowaa, na yerisi fi a wosii no dadaada mfe pii yi a Israelhen kɛse bi sii na owiei no.
title: EZRA

text: Na n’ekyir no hɛn egyanom yii sor Nyankopɔn no ebufuw no, na ɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar, Kaldeanyi no nsa, ɔno na ɔsɛɛ fi yi, na ɔsosoo ɔman no kɔr Babilɔn.
title: EZRA

text: Na mbom Babilɔnhen Sirus n’afe a odzi kan no mu, nna ɔhen Sirus hyɛɛ mbra dɛ wonsi Nyankopɔn ne fi yi.
title: EZRA

text: Na Nyankopɔn ne fie sika na dwetɛ ndzɛmba a Nebukadenezar faa no wɔ asɔrdan a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no mu, na ɔdze baa Babilɔn asɔrdan mu no so, ɔno na ɔhen Sirus yiyii no wɔ Babilɔn asɔrdan no mu, na wɔdze hyɛɛ obi a ne dzin dze Sesbazar a ɔnoara ɔahyɛ no ambrado no ne nsa;
title: EZRA

text: na ɔsee no dɛ, Fa ndzɛmba yi kɔ kesie asɔrfi a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no mu no, na ma wonsi Nyankopɔn dan no wɔ ne sibew.
title: EZRA

text: Sesbazar yi ara na ɔbae bɛhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn fie a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no ase: na ofitsi ber no ara dze bodu sisei yi wɔdze no si ara, na eso wonnwiei yi.
title: EZRA

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, sɛ ɔhen hwɛ dɛ oye a, ɔno ma wɔnhwehwɛ ɔhen n’adzekorafi a ɔwɔ Babilɔn no mu nhwɛ, kyerɛ dɛ ɔtse dɛm, dɛ ɔhen Sirus na ɔhyɛɛ mbra dɛ wonsi Nyankopɔn dan yi wɔ Jerusalɛm anaa, na wɔmma ɔhen nsoma ma wɔmbɛka ne pɛ a ɔwɔ asɛm yi ho nkyerɛ hɛn.
title: EZRA

text: Nna ɔhen Darius hyɛɛ mbra ma wɔkɔhwehwɛɛ nwomakorafi no mu, mbrɛ wɔdze akoradze sie wɔ Babilɔn no.
title: EZRA

text: Na wokohun nwoma mbobɔwee bi wɔ Akmetha ahemfie a ɔwɔ Media ɔmansin mu no, no mu, na wɔakyerɛw asɛm bi wɔ mu dɛ:
title: EZRA

text: Ɔhen Sirus n’afe a odzi kan no mu no, ɔhen Sirus hyɛɛ mbra dɛ; Nyankopɔn ne fi a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no dze, wɔmma wonsi, ma ɔnyɛ beebi mbrɛ wɔbɔ afɔr, na wɔmma ne fapem nyɛ dzendzenndzen; na no krɔn basafa eduasa na ne tɛtɛr basafa eduasa;
title: EZRA

text: nye abo akɛse akyerɛpɛn ebiasa, na ndua kyerɛpɛn kor: na wɔmma womfi ɔhen ne fie mbɔ no ho kaw no:
title: EZRA

text: na eso wɔmma Nyankopɔn ne fie sika na dwetɛ ndzɛmba a Nebukadenezar kɛfaa no wɔ asɔrdan no a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no mu, na ɔdze baa Babilɔn no, nsan mfa mma, na wɔmfa nkɔ asɔrdan no a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no mu bio, biara nkesi ne sibew, na fa sisi Nyankopɔn ne fie hɔ.
title: EZRA

text: Dɛm ntsi afei ɔwo Tattenai, esuegya noho ambrado, na Setar-bozenai, na hom mfɛfo Afarsakfo a wɔwɔ esuegya noho, hom ntwe hom ho mfi hɔ koraa:
title: EZRA

text: hom ngyaa Nyankopɔn fi no ho edwuma no n’ekyir dzi; hom mma Jewfo ambradofo na Jewfo mpanyimfo no nsi Nyankopɔn fi no wɔ ne sibew.
title: EZRA

text: Nkyii so mara na merehyɛ mbra makyerɛ hom dza hom nyɛ mma Jewfo mpanyimfo yi wɔ Nyankopɔn ne fi no ne nsii mu: ɔnye dɛ hom mfa ɔhen n’efidze no, mekyerɛ esuegya noho tow no, no mu bi, ntua ahwerdze ne kaw no ntsɛmara mfa mma mbarimba no amma woeenngyaa.
title: EZRA

text: Na adze a ohia hɔn no, anantwisaa mburwa, na nguannyin, na nguambaa nyina a wɔdze bɔbɔ sor Nyankopɔn hyew afɔr, ewifua, nkyen, nsa, na ngo, dɛ mbrɛ asɔfo a wɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no bɛkyerɛ no ara, na wɔmma wɔmfa mma hɔn dabaa, mma wonngyaa:
title: EZRA

text: ama wɔaabɔ afɔr huanhuam ama sor Nyankopɔn no, na wɔaabɔ ɔhen, na ne mba, nkwa ho mpaa.
title: EZRA

text: Eso m’ahyɛ mbra dɛ obiara a ɔbɛsakyer asɛm yi enyi no, wɔmma wonyi ne dan do mpuna, na wɔnkyekyer no mfam ho nsi hɔ; na wɔmma ne fie nyɛ sumina wɔ iyi ntsi:
title: EZRA

text: Na Nyankopɔn a ɔama ne dzin tse hɔ no, ombutuw ahemfo na aman nyinara a wɔbɛtsen hɔn nsa asakyer enyi dɛ wɔresɛɛ Nyankopɔn ne fi yi a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm yi. Mara Darius na mahyɛ mbra yi: wɔmma wɔmfa mbɔdzembɔ nyinara nyɛ.
title: EZRA

text: Nna Tattenai, esuegya noho ambrado no, na Setar-bozenai, na hɔn mfɛfo no yɛɛ dza ɔhen Darius dze kɔree no dɛm ntsɛmara.
title: EZRA

text: Na Jewfo mpanyimfo no sisii na wɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm, ɔnam nkɔnhyɛnyi Hagai na Iddo ba Zekaria nkɔnhyɛ no do. Na wosii ɔdan no na wowiei, dɛ mbrɛ Israel Nyankopɔn ne mbrasɛm, na dɛ mbrɛ Sirus, na Darius, na Persiahen Artasɛkeses mbra no tse ara.
title: EZRA

text: Na wowiee fi no wɔ bosoom Adar ne da a otsia ebiasa no a ɔyɛ ɔhen Darius n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia esia no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Na Israelmba no, asɔfo na Levifo no, na ndɔmmumkɔfo mba nkaa no, wɔdze ahosɛpɛw dzii Nyankopɔn ne fie no mbueida pa no.
title: EZRA

text: Na wɔbobɔɔ Nyankopɔn ne fi yi no mbueida pa no ho afɔr anantwisaa ɔha, nguannyin ahaenu, nguambaa ahaanan; na mpɔnkyenyin a wɔdze bɔ Israel nyinara hɔn tsir bɔn ho afɔr, duebien, dɛ mbrɛ Israel ebusuakuw ebusuakuw no dodow tse.
title: EZRA

text: Na wɔdze asɔfo no sisii hɔn ekuw mu, na Levifo no wɔ hɔn nkyekyɛmu mu, wɔdze maa Nyankopɔn no som a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no; dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses nwoma no mu no.
title: EZRA

text: Na ndɔmmumkɔfomba no dzii apaho no wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no ne da a otsia duanan no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Na ɔsɔfo no na Levifo no abɔ mu kor atsew hɔnho; hɔn nyinara hɔn ho atsew: na wokunkum apaho no maa ndɔmmummba no nyinara, na hɔn nuanom asɔfo no, na hɔnara hɔnho.
title: EZRA

text: Na Israelmba a wofi ndɔmmumkɔ mu bae no, na hɔn a wɔatsew hɔnho efi asaase no do amanamamfo efifidze ho aba hɔn nkyɛn, dɛ wɔrobɔsɔr EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no so dzii bi,
title: EZRA

text: na wɔhyɛɛ epitsi afahyɛ no enyigye mu araa nda esuon; osiandɛ EWURADZE maa hɔn enyi gyee, na ɔdaan Asiriahen no n’akoma baa hɔn do, ma ɔbɛhyɛɛ hɔn nsa dzen wɔ Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ne fi ho edwuma no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Afei iyinom ekyir no, Persiahen Artasɛkeses n’ahendzi no mu no, Ezra a ɔyɛ Seraia ba, Azaria ba, Hilkia ba no,
title: EZRA

text: Sallum ba no, Zadok ba no, Ahitub ba no,
title: EZRA

text: Amaria ba no, Azaria ba no, Meraiot ba no.
title: EZRA

text: Zerahia ba no, Uzi ba no, Bukki ba no,
title: EZRA

text: Abishua ba no, Finehas ba no, Eleazar ba no, ɔsɔfopanyin Aaron ba no:
title: EZRA

text: Sii mu fi Babilɔn bae; eso nna ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔawea Moses mbra no a EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, dze maa no no mu: na ɔhen no dze dza obisae nyinara maa no, osiandɛ n’EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn ne nsa wɔ no do.
title: EZRA

text: Na Israelmba no mu bi, nye asɔfo no, nye Levifo no, nye adwontofo no nye mbobowano ahwɛfo no, nye asɔrfi asomfo no mu binom baa Jerusalɛm wɔ ɔhen Artasɛkeses n’afe a otsia esuon no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Na ɔbaa Jerusalɛm wɔ bosoom a otsia enum no a, ɔyɛ ɔhen no n’afe a otsia esuon no ara mu.
title: EZRA

text: Na bosoom a odzi kan no ne da a odzi kan no mu nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ orifi Babilɔn afow akɔ, na bosoom a otsia enum no ne da a odzi kan no mu nna ɔbaa Jerusalɛm, dɛ mbrɛ ne Nyankopɔn ne nsa pa a ɔwɔ no do no tse.
title: EZRA

text: Osiandɛ nna Ezra esiesie n’akoma dɛ ɔbɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE ne mbra no, na oedzi do, na ɔaakyerɛkyerɛ ahyɛdze na atsɛmbusɛm wɔ Israel.
title: EZRA

text: Afei nwoma a ɔhen Artasɛkeses dze maa ɔsɔfo Ezra, ɔkyerɛwfo no, no mu nsɛm nye yi.
title: EZRA

text: Artasɛkeses, ahemfo hen no, dze kɛma ɔsɔfo Ezra, ɔsor Nyankopɔn ne mbra ho kyerɛwfo a odzi mu na adze.
title: EZRA

text: Mara na mehyɛ mbra dɛ, m’ahenman mu nyimpa biara a ofi Israel man mu, na hɔn asɔfoe na Levifo no mu a hɔnankasa wɔpra hɔn yamu dɛ wɔbɔkɔ Jerusalɛm no, wɔnye wo nkɔ.
title: EZRA

text: Susuampa dɛ wofi ɔhen na n’apamfo beesuon no enyim asoma wo dɛ kɔhwehwɛ Juda na Jerusalɛm mu dɛ mbrɛ wo Nyankopɔn mbra a ɔwɔ wo nsamu no tse;
title: EZRA

text: na fa dwetɛ na sika a ɔhen na n’apamfo apra hɔn yamu dze ama Israel Nyankopɔn a ne tsenabew wɔ Jerusalɛm no,
title: EZRA

text: na dwetɛ na sika nyinara a ibenya no wɔ Babilɔn ɔmansin nyinara mu no, ɔnye ayamuyi afɔrbɔdze a ɔman no, na asɔfo no, praa hɔn yamu dze maa hɔn Nyankopɔn ne fi a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no;
title: EZRA

text: dɛm ntsi bɔ mbɔdzen ara fa sika no totɔ anantwisaa, nguannyin, nguambaa, ɔnye hɔn ho edziban afɔr na hɔn nom afɔr, na fa kɔbɔ afɔr wɔ afɔrmbukyia a ɔwɔ hom Nyankopɔn ne fi a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no mu no do.
title: EZRA

text: Na adze biara a oye wɔ ɔwoara na wo nuanom no enyi do dɛ wɔdze dwetɛ na sika no ne nkaa no bɛyɛ no, hom nyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ hom Nyankopɔn no pɛ.
title: EZRA

text: Na ndzɛmba a wɔdze ama wo wɔ wo Nyankopɔn fi no som ho no, yi no wɔ Jerusalɛm Nyankopɔn no enyim ma.
title: EZRA

text: Na adze biara so a ohia ma wo Nyankopɔn fi a ohia dɛ edze bɛma no, yi no wɔ ɔhen n’adzekorafi no mu ma.
title: EZRA

text: Na emi, mekyerɛ mara ɔhen Artasɛkeses, mehyɛ mbra ma adzekorafo nyinara a wɔwɔ esuegya noho no dɛ, adze biara a ɔsɔfo Ezra, ɔsor Nyankopɔn ne mbra kyerɛwfo no, bebisa hom no, wɔmfa mma mbɔdzembɔ do ara,
title: EZRA

text: nkodu dwetɛ talent ɔha, na ewifua esusudze ɔha, na wenyin galɔn ahaenum nye eduonum, na ngo galɔn ahaenum nye eduonum, na nkyen a wonnkotum akan.
title: EZRA

text: Adze biara a ɔsor Nyankopɔn ahyɛ no, wɔmma wɔnyɛ no pɛr mma ɔsor Nyankopɔn ne fi no; na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn ntsi na ebufuw bɔsoɛr wɔ ɔhen na ne mba ahenman no do?
title: EZRA

text: Eso yɛrema hom ehu dɛ, asɔfo, na Levifo no, adwontofo, mbobowano ahwɛfo, Netinfo, anaa Nyankopɔn ne fie asomfo no mu biara ɔmmfa kwan mu dɛ wɔgye hɔn tow, amandze, anaa ɔkwandodze.
title: EZRA

text: Na ɔwo, Ezra, dɛ mbrɛ wo Nyankopɔn ne nyansaa a ɔwɔ wo nsamu no tse, na hyehyɛ nsɛndzifo na atsɛmbuafo a wobobu nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ esuegya noho nyinara atsɛn, hɔn a wonyim wo Nyankopɔn ne mbra no nyinara; na hom nkyerɛkyerɛ nyia onnyim no so.
title: EZRA

text: Na obiara a onnkedzi wo Nyankopɔn ne mbra, na ɔhen ne mbra do no, wombu no ho atsɛn mbɔdzembɔ do ara, sɛ ɔgye owu o, otu o, efidze no fom o, efiadze nda o.
title: EZRA

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE, hɛn Nyankopɔn a ɔdze dɛm adze yi ahyɛ ɔhen n’akoma mu, dɛ ɔdze rebɛyɛ EWURADZE ne fi a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no fɛɛfɛw;
title: EZRA

text: na ɔatrɛ mbɔbɔrhu mu aba no do wɔ ɔhen na n’apamfo, na ɔhen ne mbapɔmba akatakyi no nyinara enyim. Na emi, minyaa ahoɔdzen dɛ mbrɛ m’EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn ne nsa a ɔwɔ mo do no tse, na moboaboaa Israel mu nyimpa etsitsir no ano hyiae dɛ wɔnye me mfow nkɔ.
title: EZRA

text: Afei iyinom nye hɔn egyanom efiefi etsitsir, na hɔn a ɔhen Artasɛkeses n’ahendzi no mu no wɔnye me fi Babilɔn sii mu kɔree no, hɔn ebusuasantsen nye yi.
title: EZRA

text: Finehasmba mu, Gersom: Itamarmba mu, Daniel: Davidmba mu, Hatus.
title: EZRA

text: Sekaniamba mu; Parosmba mu, Zekaria: na wɔnam hɔn ebusuasantsen do kaan mbanyin mu ɔha eduonum kaa no ho.
title: EZRA

text: Pahat-moabmba mu, Zerahia ba Eliehoenai; na mbanyin ahaenu ka no ho.
title: EZRA

text: Sekaniamba mu, Jahaziel ba no; na mbanyin ahaasa ka no ho.
title: EZRA

text: Na Adinmba mu, Jonatan ba Ebed; na mbanyin eduonum ka no ho.
title: EZRA

text: Elammba mu, Atalia ba Jesaia; na mbanyin eduosuon ka no ho.
title: EZRA

text: Sefatiamba mu, Maekɛl ba Zebadia, na mbanyin eduowɔtwe ka no ho.
title: EZRA

text: Joabmba mu, Jehiel ba Obadia; na mbanyin ahaenu duawɔtwe ka no ho.
title: EZRA

text: Selomitmba mu, Josifia ba no; na mbanyin ɔha eduosia ka no ho.
title: EZRA

text: Na Bebaimba mu, Bebai ba Zekaria; na mbanyin eduonu awɔtwe ka no ho.
title: EZRA

text: Azgadmba mu, Hakatan ba Johanan; na mbanyin ɔha na du ka no ho.
title: EZRA

text: Adonikammba a wodzi ekyir no mu; hɔn edzin nye yi, Elifelet, Jeuel, na Semaia, na mbanyin eduosia ka no ho.
title: EZRA

text: Na Bigivaimba mu, Utai na Zabud; na mbanyin eduosuon ka no ho.
title: EZRA

text: Na moboaboaa hɔn ano hyiaa esutsen a ɔpem kɔ Ahava no ho, na yɛkyeer hɔ nsera ndaansa; na mohwehwɛɛ ɔman no nye asɔfo no mu, na mennhu Levimba no mu bi wɔ hɔ.
title: EZRA

text: Nna mosomae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ Eliezer Ariel, Semaia, na Elnatan, na Jarib, na Elnatan, na Natan, na Zekaria, na Mesullam, nyimpa etsitsir no; eso Joiarib, na Elnatan a wɔyɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo no.
title: EZRA

text: Na mosomaa hɔn ma wɔkɔr Iddo, otsitsir a ɔwɔ Kasifia kurow mu no nkyɛn; na mekaa dza wɔnkɛka nkyerɛ Iddo na no nuanom Netinfo a wɔwɔ Kasifia kurow mu no kyerɛɛ hɔn, dɛ wɔmfa asomfo a wɔbɔsom wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn fie mbrɛ hɛn.
title: EZRA

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn ne nsa pa a ɔwɔ hɛn do tse no, wɔbrɛɛ hɛn onyimdzefo bi a ofi Mahili, Levi ba no, Israel ba no, ne mba no mu; na Serebia, ne mba na no nuanom duawɔtwe ka no ho;
title: EZRA

text: na Hasabia, na Jesaia a ofi Merarimba mu, no nuanom na hɔn mba eduonu ka no ho;
title: EZRA

text: na Netinfo so a David na mbapɔmba no yii hɔn maa Levifo som no, wɔyɛ Netinfo ahaenu eduonu: hɔn nyinara wɔbobɔɔ hɔn edzin.
title: EZRA

text: Na mobɔɔ mbuadadzi ho dawur wɔ hɔ, wɔ esutsen Ahava do, ama yaabrɛ hɛnho adze wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim, ahwehwɛ no hɔ kwan tsenenee ama hɛnho, na hɛn mbofraba, na hɛn ahodze nyinara.
title: EZRA

text: Na ɔyɛɛ me enyito dɛ mibebisa ɔhen hɔ nsordaafokuw na mpɔnkɔdofo ma wɔaaboa hɛn wɔ atamfo ho wɔ kwan mu: osiandɛ yɛaka akyerɛ ɔhen, dɛ, Hɛn Nyankopɔn ne nsa wɔ hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ no nyinara do dze ma hɔn yie: na no tum na n’ebufuw wɔ hɔn a wɔpow no nyinara do.
title: EZRA

text: Nna yedzii mbuada na yɛserɛɛ iyi wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn hɔ: na otsiee hɛn.
title: EZRA

text: Nna miyii asɔfo no mu etsitsir duebien, mekyerɛ Serebia, Hasabia, na hɔn nuanom no mu du ka hɔn ho,
title: EZRA

text: na mikeer dwetɛ, na sika, na ndzɛmba no, mekyerɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn fi ho afɔrbɔdze a ɔhen na n’apamfo, na ne mbapɔmba, na Israel a wohun wɔ ho no nyinara, dze mae no, na medze hyɛɛ hɔn nsa:
title: EZRA

text: na mikeer dwetɛ talent ahaesia eduonum mpo so hyɛɛ hɔn nsa, na dwetɛ ndzɛmba talent ɔha; sika so talent ɔha;
title: EZRA

text: na sika mbɛɛsen eduonu a ɔsom sika darik apem; na boran fɛɛfɛw ndzɛmba hyɛnhyɛn ebien a no bo yɛ dzen dɛ sika.
title: EZRA

text: Na mesee hɔn dɛ, Hom yɛ krɔnkrɔndze ma EWURADZE, na ndzɛmba yi so yɛ krɔnkrɔn; na dwetɛ na sika no yɛ ayamuyi afɔr dze ma EWURADZE, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn no.
title: EZRA

text: Hom nweɔn, na wɔnhwɛ do ara, nkodu dɛ hom beker no wɔ asɔfo etsitsir no na Levifo no, na Israel mu egyanom efiefi do mbapɔmba no hɔn enyim, wɔ Jerusalɛm, wɔ EWURADZE ne fi no ne mpia no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Nna asɔfo no na Levifo no gyee dwetɛ na sika, na ndzɛmba no a wokerii no dɛ wɔdze reba Jerusalɛm dze abɛma hɛn Nyankopɔn no fi no.
title: EZRA

text: Na bosoom a odzi kan no ne nda a otsia duebien no mu na yefi esutsen Ahava ho sii mu dɛ yɛrokɔ Jerusalɛm: na hɛn Nyankopɔn nsa wɔ hɛn do, na ɔgyee hɛn fii atamfo na ɔkwan do atsɛweefo no nsamu.
title: EZRA

text: Na yebodur Jerusalɛm, na yɛtsenaa hɔ ndaansa.
title: EZRA

text: Na da a otsia anan no, wokeer dwetɛ no na sika no na ndzɛmba no wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn fie, dze hyɛɛ Uria ba sɔfo Meremot nsa; na Finehas ba Eleazar ka no ho; na Jesua ba Jozabad, na Binnui ba Noadia, Levifo no, ka hɔn ho;
title: EZRA

text: na wɔkanee na wokeer ne nyinara, na wɔkyerɛɛw ne nyinara wɔ nwoma mu.
title: EZRA

text: Ndɔmmumkɔmba no a wofi amantu mu bae no, wɔdze ɔhyew afɔr brɛɛ Israel Nyankopɔn no, Israel nyinara tsir dze, anantwisaa duebien, nguannyin eduokron esia, nguambaa eduosuon esuon, bɔn ho afɔr mpɔnkyenyin duebien: iyi nyinara yɛ hyew afɔr dze ma EWURADZE.
title: EZRA

text: Na wɔdze ɔhen no ne mbra no maa ɔhen n’amansin do ahwɛfo na n’ambradofo a wɔwɔ esuegya noho no, na wɔwowaaw ɔman no na Nyankopɔn ne fi no.
title: EZRA

text: Afei aber a wowiee ndzɛmba yi yɛ no, na mbapɔmba no twee piin me nkyɛn, dɛ, Israelman, na asɔfo na Levifo no, wɔnntseew hɔnho mmfii asaase no do aman no ho, wɔreyɛ dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ekyiwadze no tsetsee, mekyerɛ dɛ mbrɛ Keenanfo, Hitifo, Perizfo, Jebusfo, Ammonfo, Moabfo, Egyptfo, na Amorifo yɛ no.
title: EZRA

text: Na wɔafefa hɔn mbabaa mu bi amema hɔnho na hɔn mbabanyin; ma asefo krɔnkrɔn no dze hɔnho akɔfora asaase no do aman no mu: ampa, mbapɔmba na mpanyimfo no nsa na odzi mbrato yi mu tsitsir.
title: EZRA

text: Na aber a metsee asɛm yi no, metsetseew m’atar na m’akatado mu, na mututuu me tsinhwi na m’abɔdwesa, na medze ahobow tsenaa famu.
title: EZRA

text: Nna obiara a no ho popo wɔ Israel Nyankopɔn ne nsɛm ho no osian ndɔmmumkɔfo no hɔn mbrato no ntsi no, boaboaa hɔn ano baa me nkyɛn; na medze ahobow tsenaa hɔ ara ma okodur ewimbir afɔrbɔ no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Na ewimbir afɔrbɔ no mu na mosoɛree fii m’ahobrɛadze no mu, mekyerɛ matsetsew m’atar na m’akatado no mu; na mokotoow mo ntwɛr enyim, na metserɛɛw me nsamu kyerɛɛ EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn;
title: EZRA

text: na mesee dɛ, Ao, me Nyankopɔn, m’enyi ato na ɔyɛ me fɛr so dɛ mebɛma m’enyi do makyerɛ ɔwo, me Nyankopɔn: osiandɛ hɛn emumuyɛ adɔɔ so wɔ hɛn tsir do, na hɛn afɔdzi afow ekodu sor.
title: EZRA

text: Ofitsi hɛn egyanom aber do no afɔdzi kɛse mbordo mu na yɛwɔ ara dze ebodu ndɛ da yi; na osian hɛn emumuyɛ ntsi, woeyi hɛn, hɛn ahemfo, na hɛn asɔfoe, ahyɛ asaase ahemfo nsa, wɔdze ama afona, ndɔmmumkɔ, ɔfomdzi, na enyimguase, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: EZRA

text: Na afei mber kakrabaa bi na woeyi EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn hɔ adom akyerɛ hɛn, ma woeegyaa hɛn nkaa, ma woeefi mu eguan, na wɔaama hɛn bambɔ wɔ ne bea krɔnkrɔn no do, ma hɛn Nyankopɔn aatsew hɛn enyi, na ɔaama dzenhyɛ kakra wɔ hɛn nkowaasom mu.
title: EZRA

text: Na yɛyɛ nkowaa dze; naaso hɛn Nyankopɔn mmpoow hɛn wɔ hɛn nkowaasom mu, na mbom ɔama ehumbɔbɔr ato hɛn wɔ Persia ahemfo enyim, dɛ ɔbɛma hɛn dzenhyɛ, ma yaama hɛn Nyankopɔn fi no do esi hɔ, na yaakyekyer ne n’ekurofo, na ɔaama hɛn fasu bi wɔ Juda na Jerusalɛm.
title: EZRA

text: Na afei, hɛn Nyankopɔn, yɛnse dɛn wɔ iyi ekyir? Osiandɛ yɛapow wo mbransɛm a
title: EZRA

text: edze nam wo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no do hyɛe, dɛ, Asaase a hom rokɔ akɛfa no, ɔyɛ asaase a no ho ekum wɔ asaase no do aman no hɔn efifidze no mu, ɔnam hɔn ekyiwadze a ɔayɛ fi ano kor kɛpem ano kor so, wɔ hɔn efifidze mu no ntsi.
title: EZRA

text: Dɛm ntsi afei mma hom mmfa hom mbabaa mma hɔn mbabanyin, nkyii so mma hom nnkɛgye hɔn mbabaa mbrɛ hom mbabanyin, na eso mma hom nnhwehwɛ hɔn asomdwee anaa hɔn eyiedzi ara da: ama hom aahyɛ dzen, na woeedzi asaase no do yie, na wɔdze aayɛ egyapadze dze egya hom mba daa.
title: EZRA

text: Na dza osian hɛn ndzeyɛbɔn na hɛn afɔdzi kɛse no ntsi ma aba hɛn do no nyinara ekyir yi, wɔ dɛ ɔwo hɛn Nyankopɔn atsea hɛn kakraba asen mbrɛ hɛn emumuyɛ regye, na igyaa hɛn nkaa a ɔtse dɛm yi,
title: EZRA

text: aso yɛnto wo mbrasɛm bio, na yɛmfa hɛnho nkɔbɔ aman a wɔyɛ ekyiwadze yi ho wɔ awarwar mu anaa? Aso nkyɛ wo bo nnkofuw hɛn ara ma ekodu dɛ yɛbɛhyew ma obiara nnkɛka a obefi mu efi bi a?
title: EZRA

text: EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, ɔwo na eyɛ tseneneenyi; osiandɛ yɛaka dɛ nkaa a yeefi mu efi, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ yi: hwɛ, yɛwɔ w’enyim wɔ hɛn afɔdzi mu; na osian iyi ntsi, obiara nnkotum egyina w’enyim.
title: EZRA

text: Afei aber a Ezra robɔ mpaa, na orusu na ɔrobobɔ noho famu reka bɔn wɔ Nyankopɔn ne fi no enyim no, nna Israel mu mboanofo kɛsenara, mbarimba na mbaa, na mbofraba boaboaa hɔn ano baa ne nkyɛn: na ɔman no suu pii.
title: EZRA

text: Na Jehiel ba Sekania, obi a ofi Elammba mu no, buae see Ezra dɛ, Yɛayɛ bɔn etsia hɛn Nyankopɔn, dɛ yɛawarwar mbaa ananaben wɔ asaase do aman mu: naaso afei enyidado bi da ho wɔ hɔ ma Israel.
title: EZRA

text: Dɛm ntsi afei wɔmma yɛnye hɛn Nyankopɔn ndzi ahyɛmu dɛ yebeyi yernom no nyinara edzi, na hɔn a wɔawowo hɔn no, dɛ mbrɛ mo wura, na hɔn a hɔn ho popo hɛn Nyankopɔn mbrasɛm ho hɔn apam no tse; na wɔmma wɔnyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse.
title: EZRA

text: Soɛr; na dwumadzi no da wo do, na yɛtaa w’ekyir: hyɛ dzen, na yɛ.
title: EZRA

text: Nna Ezra soɛree, na ɔmaa asɔfo, na Levifo, na Israel nyinara mu etsitsir no kekaa ntam dɛ wobedzi asɛm yi do. Nna wɔkekaa ntam.
title: EZRA

text: Nna Ezra soɛree fii Nyankopɔn fi no enyim, na ɔkɔr Eliasib ba Jehohanan pia mu: na ɔbaa hɔ no, oenndzi edziban biara, na ɔannom nsu so: na odzii yaw wɔ ndɔmmumkɔfo no hɔn mbrato no ntsi.
title: EZRA

text: Na wɔbɔɔ dawur kyimaa Juda na Jerusalɛm nyina kyerɛɛ ndɔmmumkɔfomba no nyinara dɛ wɔmboaboa hɔn ano nkehyia wɔ Jerusalɛm;
title: EZRA

text: na obiara a ɔannkɔ ndaansa mu no, dɛ mbrɛ mbapɔmba na amampanyin apam tse no, n’ahodze nyinara wobehyira do akyɛ, na ɔnoara so woetu no efi ndɔmmumkɔfo no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Nna Juda na Benjamin mbarimba nyinara boaboaa hɔn ano kehyiaa Jerusalɛm wɔ ndaansa no mu: ɔyɛ bosoom a otsia akron no ne da a otsia eduonu no mu: na ɔman no nyinara tsenatsenaa Nyankopɔn fi no n’enyim bea tɛtɛr no do hɔ ahopopo mu osian asɛm yi, na nyankom kɛse no ntsi.
title: EZRA

text: Na ɔsɔfo Ezra soɛree gyinae, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ato mbra, dɛ hom awarwar mbaa ananaben, dɛ wɔdze rema Israel afɔdzi adɔɔ so.
title: EZRA

text: Dɛm ntsi afei hom nka hom bɔn nkyerɛ EWURADZE, hom egyanom Nyankopɔn no, na wɔnyɛ n’apɛdze; na wɔntsew homho mfi asaase no do amamba no na mbaa ananaben no ho.
title: EZRA

text: Na mboanofo no nyinara dze ndze kɛse gyee do see dɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ ɔwoara aka no wɔ hɛn ho no, dɛmara so na otwar dɛ yɛyɛ.
title: EZRA

text: Na mbom ɔman no dɔɔ so, na ɔyɛ nsutɔber, na yerunntum dɛ yebegyina guado, nkyii so iyi nnyɛ da kor anaa nda ebien bi edwuma: osiandɛ yɛato mbra kɛsenara wɔ asɛm yi mu.
title: EZRA

text: Afei ma wonyi hɛn mbapɔmba nsi hɔ mma amamba no nyinara, na wɔmma hɔn a wɔwowɔ hɛn nkurow mu a wɔawarwar mbaa ananaben no nyinara, wɔnye kurow biara mu mpanyimfo, na n’atsɛmbuafo mbra, mber a wɔahyehyɛ mu araa ma onkodu dɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn n’ebufuhyew a ɔwɔ asɛm yi ho befi hɛn do.
title: EZRA

text: Na Asahel ba Jonatan na Tikeva ba Jahzeia nko soɛree tsiaa asɛm yi: na Mesullam na Levinyi Sabbethai boaa hɔn.
title: EZRA

text: Na ndɔmmumkɔfomba no yɛɛ dɛm. Na wofii ɔsɔfo Ezra, nye egyanom efiefi etsitsir a wɔwɔ hɔn egyanom efiefi no mu bi, nna wɔbobɔɔ hɔn nyinara hɔn edzin yiyii hɔn sisii nkyɛn; na wɔtsenatsenaa famu wɔ bosoom a otsia du no ne da a odzi kan no mu dɛ wɔrohwehwɛ asɛm no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Na wɔnye mbarimba a wɔawarwar mbaa ananaben no nyinara wiei, wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no ne da a odzi kan no mu.
title: EZRA

text: Na wohun asɔfomba mu hɔn a wɔawarwar mbaa ananaben: hɔn nye, Jozadak ba Jesua, na no nuanom mba mu, Maaseia, na Eliezer, na Jarib, na Gedalia.
title: EZRA

text: Na wɔdze hɔn nsa maa dɛ wobegyaa hɔn yernom no: na wodzi fɔ ntsi, wɔdze nguankuw mu oguannyin bɔbɔɔ hɔn afɔdzi ho afɔr.
title: EZRA

text: Na Immermba mu; Hanani na Zebadia.
title: EZRA

text: Na Harimmba mu; Maaseia, na Elija, na Semaia, na Jehiel, na Uzia.
title: EZRA

text: Pasurmba mu; Elioenai, Maaseia, Ismael, Netanel, Jozabad, na Elasa.
title: EZRA

text: Na Levifo mu; Jozabad, na Simei, na Kelaia (ɔnoara nye Kelita), Petahia, Juda, na Eliezer.
title: EZRA

text: Na adwontofo no mu; Eliasib: na mbobowano ahwɛfo no mu; Sallum, na Telem, na Uri.
title: EZRA

text: Na Israel mu: Parosmba mu; Ramia, na Izia, Malkija, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malkija, na Benaia.
title: EZRA

text: Na Elammba mu; Mattania, Zekaria, na Jehiel, na Abdi, Jeremot, na Elija.
title: EZRA

text: Zatumba mu; Elioenai, Eliasib, Mattania, Jeremot, Zabad, na Aziza.
title: EZRA

text: Bebaimba mu; Jehohanan, Hanania, Zabai, na Atlai.
title: EZRA

text: Banimba mu; Mesullam, Malluk, Adaia, Jasub, Seal na Jeremot.
title: EZRA

text: Na Pahat-moabmba mu; Adna, Kelal, Benaia, Maaseia, Mattania, Bezalel, Binnui, na Manaasɛ.
title: EZRA

text: Harimmba mu; Eliezer, Ishija, Malkija, Semaia, Simeon;
title: EZRA

text: Benjamin, Malluk na Semaria.
title: EZRA

text: Hasummba mu; Matenai, Mataata, Zabad, Elifelet, Jeremai, Manaasɛ na Simei.
title: EZRA

text: Banimba mu; Maadai, Amram, na Uel;
title: EZRA

text: Benaia, Bedeia, Keluhi;
title: EZRA

text: Vania, Meremot, Eliasib;
title: EZRA

text: Mattania, Matenai, Jaasu;
title: EZRA

text: Bani, Binnui, Simei;
title: EZRA

text: Selemia, Natan, na Adaia;
title: EZRA

text: Maknadebai, Sasai, Serai;
title: EZRA

text: Azarel, na Selemia, Semaria;
title: EZRA

text: Sallum, Amaria na Josef.
title: EZRA

text: Nebomba mu; Jeiel, Mattitia, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, Joel na Benaia.
title: EZRA

text: Woyinom nyinara wɔawarwar mbaa ananaben: na hɔn mu binom nye hɔn awowo mba, na wɔpaam hɔn nye hɔn mba no nyina ma wɔkɔree.
title: EZRA

text: Iyi nye Hakalia ba Nehemia ne nsɛm. Afei ɔbaa dɛ bosoom Kislev mu, wɔ afe a otsia eduonu a nna mowɔ Susa aban mu no,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hanani, mo nuanom mu baako, bae, ɔno na mbarimba bi a wofi Juda; na mibisaa hɔn Judafo a wofii nsa firii a wɔkae wɔ ndɔmmumkɔfo no mu, na Jerusalɛm ho nsɛm.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na wɔsee me dɛ, Ndɔmmumkɔfo no mu nkaa a wɔaka wɔ ɔmansin no mu hɔ no, wɔwɔ ahohiahia kɛse na enyimguase mu; na Jerusalɛm fasu no ebubu, na no nkuropon so wɔdze gya ahyew no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a metsee nsɛm yi no, nna metsenaa famu musui, na migyaam nda kakra; na midzii mbuada na mobɔɔ mpaa wɔ ɔsor Nyankopɔn no enyim,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na mesee dɛ, Ao, EWURADZE, sor Nyankopɔn, Nyame kɛse a wo ho yɛ hu a isie ahyɛmu na mbɔbɔrhu dze ma hɔn a wɔdɔ wo na wodzi wo mbrasɛm do, mokotow serɛ wo:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: afei ma w’aso mbra mo do, na w’enyiwa mbue, na fa tsie w’akowaa mpaa a morobɔ no wɔ w’enyim aber yi, adzekyee na adzesaa, wɔ wo nkowaa Israelmba ntsi no, wɔ mber a mereka Israelmba hɛn bɔn a yɛayɛ etsia wo no: ɛhɛɛ, emi na m’egya fie so yɛayɛ bɔn.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Yɛabɔ brafun etsia wo, na yenndzi mbrasɛm, na ahyɛdze, na atsɛmbusɛm so a edze hyɛɛ w’akowaa Moses no do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Mokotow serɛ wo, kaa asɛm a edze hyɛɛ w’akowaa Moses no, dɛ, Sɛ hom fom a, mobɔbɔ hom apetse aman mu:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na sɛ hom san ba me nkyɛn, na hom dzi me mbrasɛm do na wɔyɛ a, ɔnodze kaansa sɛ hom adedamfikyirfo wowɔ sor ano no ho mpo a, mobɔpon hɔn efi hɔ, na medze hɔn aba bea a masan mu eyi dɛ mebɛma me dzin atsena hɔ no do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Afei woyinom wɔyɛ wo nkowaa na wo man a ɔwoara edze wo tum kɛse, na wo nsa a ɔyɛ dzen agye hɔn.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ao, EWURADZE, mokotow serɛ wo, afei ma w’aso mbra w’akowaa mpaabɔ, na wo nkowaa a wɔpɛ dɛ wosuro wo dzin no mpaabɔ do: na, meserɛ wo, ma onsi yie mma w’akowaa ndɛ da yi, na ma onya mbɔbɔrhu wɔ ɔbarimba yi enyim. Nna meyɛ ɔhen no nsahyɛfo wɔ ber no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔhen Artasɛkeses n’afe a otsia eduonu no mu, bosoom Nisan mu a nsa si n’enyim no, nna memaa nsa no do, na medze maa ɔhen no. Afei nna mennyɛɛ m’enyim mbɔbɔmbɔbɔr dɛm da.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔhen no bisaa me dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’enyim ayɛ mbɔbɔmbɔbɔr, na ennyar so yi? Iyi nnyɛ hweeara dɛ akoma mu awerɛhow a. Nna m’akoma tuu dodoodow.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mesee ɔhen no dɛ, Wɔmma ɔhen ntsena ase daa: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na m’enyim nnkɛyɛ mbɔbɔmbɔbɔr, wɔ aber a kurow no, m’egyanom asamandan bea no, da hɔ pan, na wɔdze gya ahyew no nkuropon no?
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna ɔhen no bisaa me dɛ, Ebɛnadze na erohwehwɛ yi? Nna mobɔɔ mpaa kyerɛɛ sor Nyankopɔn no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mesee dɛ, Sɛ ɔhen pɛ, na sɛ w’akowaa enya enyimpa wɔ w’enyim a, nkyɛ aasoma me wɔ Juda, m’egyanom asamandan kurow no mu, ma maakɛkyekyer no bio.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔhen no bisaa me dɛ, (nna ɔhembaa no so ko ne nkyɛn,) Na w’akwantu no bɛkyɛr ahen ara? Na aber bɛn na ebɛsan aba? Na ɔhen no pɛɛ dɛ ogya me kwan; na mekyerɛɛ no mber dodow a mibedzi.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nkyii so mesee ɔhen no dɛ, Sɛ ɔhen pɛ a, ɔno wɔmma me nwoma ma memfa nkɛma esuegya noho ambradofo no, ma wɔmma me kwan ma muntwa mu munkodu Juda;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na nwoma so a medze bɛkɛma ɔhen kwaamuhwɛfo Asaf, ama ɔaama me ndua ma medze ayɛ aban a ɔwɔ fi no ho no, no mbobotsen no, no mpuna, na kurow no ne fasu no dze, na ofi a morokɔ mu no, dze. Na ɔhen no yɛe maa me, osiandɛ me Nyankopɔn n’ayamuyie nsa wɔ mo do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna mudur esuegya noho ambradofo no nkyɛn, na medze ɔhen no nwoma no maa hɔn. Afei nna ɔhen asoma dɔm do asafohemfo na mpɔnkɔdofo so aka mo ho.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na aber a Horonnyi Sanballat, na akowaa Tobia, Ammonnyi no, tsee no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn yaw mbordo, dɛ nyimpa bi aba dɛ ɔrobɔhwehwɛ Israelmba hɔn yieyɛ.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna mebaa Jerusalɛm, na midzii hɔ ndaansa.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mosoɛɛr hɔ anadwe, emi na mbarimba kakra bi ka mo ho; nkyii so mannka dza me Nyankopɔn dze hyɛɛ m’akoma mu dɛ menyɛ mma Jerusalɛm no annkyerɛ nyimpa biara: nkyii so nna abowa biara nnyi me nkyɛn, gyedɛ dza metsenaa no do no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na menam Bɔnsa Kuropon no mu fiir edzi anadwe, mekyerɛ ɔdze kɔ Mpataku Nsubura ho, na mokɔr Sumina Kuropon no ano, na mokɔhwɛɛ Jerusalɛm afasu a ebubu, na no kuropon a wɔdze gya ahyew no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna misii mu kɔr Nsunyiwa Kuropon no ano na ɔhen nsutaae ho: nna ɔkwan nnyi hɔ mma m’abowa a ɔwɔ m’ase no dɛ obotwa mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na menam ɔwora no ho foow anadwe no, na mokɔhwɛɛ fasu no; na mesaan m’ekyir, na mekɛfaa Bɔnsa Kuropon no mu, na mesanee bae.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna mpanyimfo no nnyim mbrɛ mokɔree, anaa dza meyɛe; nkyii so nna minnyae nnkaa nnkyerɛɛ Judafo, na asɔfo no, na ekunyin no, na mpanyimfo no, na nkaa a wɔyɛɛ edwuma no so.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna mesee hɔn dɛ, Homara hom hu ahokyer a yɛwɔ mu, mbrɛ Jerusalɛm edua da hɔ pan, na no ho nkuropon so wɔdze gya ahyew no: hom mbra ma yɛntow Jerusalɛm afasu no, ma yaannda ho annyɛ enyimguasefo.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mekaa hɔn me Nyankopɔn ne nsa a oye wɔ mo do no ho nsɛm; na ɔhen ne nsɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ me no so. Na wɔsee dɛ, Wɔmma yɛnsoɛr na yensi. Na wɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn nsa dzen maa edwuma pa no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na aber a Horonnyi Sanballat, na akowaa Tobia, Ammonnyi no, na Arabianyi Gesem, tsee no, wosii hɛn atwetwe, na wobuu hɛn enyimtsia, na wɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom reyɛ yi? Ana hom retsew etua wɔ ɔhen do a?
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mubuaa hɔn, na mesee hɔn dɛ, Sor Nyankopɔn no, ɔno na ɔbɛma esi hɛn yie; dɛm ntsi hɛn no nkowaa dze, yɛbɔsoɛr na yeesi: na hom dze, hom nnyi kyɛfa, na ndzinoa, na nkaa biara so wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na sɔfopanyin Eliasib nye no nuanom asɔfo no soɛree, na wosii abobow a wɔfrɛ no Nguantsen Kuropon no; hɔn na wɔyɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn, na wosisii no mbobow no; mekyerɛ wɔyɛɛ no krɔnkrɔn dze kodur Hamea abantsentsen no ho, dze kodur Hananel abantsentsen no ho.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ne nkyɛnmu na Jeriko mbarimba sii. Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Imri ba Zakur sii.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Enam Abotsen no, Hasenaa mba na wosii; hɔn na wɔdze no mpuna gui, na wosisii no mbobow, na nkrɔkrɔw, na n’adaban.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Meremot, Uria ba no, Hakoz ba no, miamiaa mu. Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Mesullam, Berekia ba no, Mesezabel ba no, miamiaa mu. Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Zadok, Baana ba no, miamiaa mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Tekoafo miamiaa mu; naaso hɔn ekunyin no ammfa hɔn ho ammbɛhyɛ hɔn wura n’edwuma no mu bi.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na abotsen dadaw no, Pasea ba Joiada na Besodeia ba Mesullam na womiamiaa mu, hɔn na wɔdze no mpuna gui, na wosisii no mbobow, na no nkrɔkrɔw, na n’adaban.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na hɔn nkyɛnmu Gibeonnyi Melatia, na Meronotnyi Jadon, Gibeon na Mizpa mbarimba a wodzi wɔ esuegya noho ambrado n’ahengua no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ne nkyɛnmu na Harhaia sikadwimfo no mu bi no ba Uziel miamiaa mu. Na ne nkyɛnmu, na Hanania, nduforaforafo no mu bi no miamiaa mu, na wɔyɛɛ Jerusalɛm dzendzen araa dze kodur fasu tɛtɛɛtɛr no do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Refaia, Hur ba no, Jerusalɛm amantɔw fa do hwɛfo no, miamiaa mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Harumaf ne ba Jedaia, miamiaa mu, mekyerɛ noara ne fie tsentsendo no a. Na ne nkyɛnmu na Hasabineia ba Hatus miamiaa mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Harim ba Malkija, na Pahat-moab ba Hasub, miamiaa sin bi so, na mfononoo abantsentsen no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ne nkyɛnmu na Halohesh ba Sallum, Jerusalɛm amantɔw fa do hwɛfo no, miamiaa mu, ɔno na ne mbabaa.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Bɔnsa Kuropon no, hɔn a wɔtse Hanun, na Zanoa na womiamiaa mu; hɔn na wɔtowee, na wosisii no mbobow, no nkrɔkrɔw, na n’adaban, na wɔtoow fasu no mu basafa ahaenum dze kodur Sumina Kuropon no ho.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na sumina kuropon no, Rekab ba Malkija, Bɛt-hakerem amantɔw do hwɛfo no, na omiamiaa mu; ɔno na ɔtowee, na osisii no mbobow, no nkrɔkrɔw, na n’adaban.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Nsunyiwa Kuropon no, Kol-hoze ba Sallum, Mizpa amantɔw do hwɛfo no, na omiamiaa mu; ɔno na ɔtowee, na ɔkataa do, na osisii no mbobow, no nkrɔkrɔw na n’adaban, na ɔtoow Sela Nsutaae ho fasu so wɔ ɔhen no ture no ho araa dze kodur ntwer a osian fi David kurow mu no ho.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ɔno n’ekyir na Azbuk ba Nehemia, Bɛt-zur ɔmantɔw fa do hwɛfo no, miamiaa mu, dze kodur David asamandan no ne tsentsendo bea no do, na nsutaae a wɔyɛe no ho, na mbarimba akatakyi no hɔn fi no ho.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ɔno n’ekyir na Levifo no, Bani ba Rehum miamiaa mu. Ne nkyɛnmu na Hasabia, Keila ɔmantɔw fa do hwɛfo no miamiaa mu dze maa ne mantɔw.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ɔno n’ekyir na hɔn nuanom, Henadad ba Bavai, Keila ɔmantɔw fa do hwɛfo no, miamiaa mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ne nkyɛnmu na Jesua ba Ezer, Mizpa hwɛfo no, miamiaa sin bi so mu, wɔ fasu no ne mbekyewee no mu akodzedan no mfowee no ne tsentsendo.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ɔno n’ekyir na Zabai ba Baruk miamiaa sin bi so mu enyiberdo, fi fasu no ne mbekyewee no mu, dze kodu sɔfopanyin Eliasib ne fi abow ho.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ɔno n’ekyir na Meremot, Uria ba no, Hakoz ba no, miamiaa sin bi so mu, fi Eliasib ne fi abow ho araa dze kodu Eliasib ne fi tsir.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔno n’ekyir na asɔfo no, Ɔbɔn no mu mbarimba no bɔtoaa do miamiaa mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hɔn ekyir na Benjamin na Hasub miamiaa mu wɔ hɔn fi ne tsentsendo. Hɔn ekyir na Azaria, Maaseia ba no, Anania ba no, miamiaa mu wɔ nankasa ne fi nkyɛn.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ɔno n’ekyir na Henadad ba Binnui miamiaa sin bi so mu, fi Azaria fi ho dze kodu fasu no ne mbekyewee no mu, na kutuw no ho.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Uzai ba Palal na omiamiaa fasu no ne mbekyewee no, na abantsentsen a ɔworɔw fi n’etsifi fi no a ɔwɔ aweɔmfo abangua ho no ne tsentsendo. Ɔno n’ekyir na Paros ba Pedaia miamiaa mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: (Afei Asɔrfi mu asomfo no tsenaa Ofel do, mbrɛ ɔdze kɔ Nsu Kuropon ne tsentsendo wɔ boka, na abantsentsen a ɔworɔw no n’afamu.)
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ɔno n’ekyir na Tekoafo no miamiaa sin bi so mu, wɔ abantsentsen kɛse a ɔworɔw no ne tsentsendo, na ɔdze kodu Ofel ho fasu no ho.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ofi Mpɔnkɔ Kuropon ano na asɔfo no miamiaa mu, obiara wɔ nankasa ne fi no ne tsentsendo.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hɔn ekyir na Immer ba Zadok miamiaa mu wɔ nankasa ne fi no ne tsentsendo. Na ɔno n’ekyir na Sekania ba Semaia, Boka Kuropon anohwɛfo no, miamiaa mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ɔno n’ekyir na Selemia ba Hanania, na Hanun, Zalaf ba no a otsia esia no, miamiaa sin bi so mu. Ɔno n’ekyir na Berekia ba Mesullam, miamiaa mu wɔ ne pia ne tsentsendo.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ɔno n’ekyir na Malkija, sikadwimfo no mu baako no miamiaa mu kodur Netinfo na eguadzifo no fi wɔ Hamifikad kuropon ne tsentsendo, na ɔdze kodu kutuw do afowee no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na kutuw do afowee no na abobow a wɔfrɛ no Nguantsen Kuropon no ntamu na sikadwimfo na eguadzifo no miamiaa mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Sanballat tsee dɛ yɛrotow fasu no, no bo fuwii, na ɔyɛɛ no ehi kɛse, na osii Judafo no atwetwe.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔkasae wɔ no nuanom na Samaria dɔm no enyim, see dɛ, Ebɛnadze na Judafo mberɛmberɛwfo reyɛ yi? Ana wɔbɛyɛ hɔnho dzendzen a? Ana wɔbɔbɔ afɔr a? Ana wobowie no dakor a? Ana wobenyanyan abo no efi wura ekuwekuw a wɔahyehyew yi mu?
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Afei nna Ammonnyi Tobia wɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔno so see dɛ, Dza wɔrotow yi, sɛ odompo mpo fow a, obobubu hɔn abo fasu no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mobɔɔ mpaa dɛ, Hɛn Nyankopɔn e, tsie, na woebu hɛn enyimtsia; na dan hɔn adapaabɔ bua hɔnankasa hɔn etsifi, na gyaa hɔn ma ɔfom wɔ ndɔmmumkɔ asaase do:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na mma nnkata hɔn emumuyɛ do, na mma wɔmmpepa hɔn bɔn so mmfi w’enyim: osiandɛ woeyi wo ebufuw wɔ adantofo no enyim.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna yɛtoow fasu no; na fasu no nyinara wɔtoatoae kodur no krɔn ne fa do: osiandɛ ɔman no nyaa pɛ dɛ wɔbɛyɛ edwuma.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Sanballat, na Tobia, na Arabiafo, na Ammonfo, na Ashdodfo no tsee dɛ Jerusalɛm afasu no ne mmiamiamu no akɔ kan, na etokur no ahyɛ ase risisiw no, hɔn ebufuw no yɛɛ dodoodow;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na hɔn nyinara kɔr apam yɛɛ kor dɛ wɔreba na wɔnye Jerusalɛm abɔko, na wɔayɛ ma no mu ayɛ sakasaka.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na hɛn dze, yɛbɔɔ hɛn mpaa kyerɛɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn, na osian hɔn ntsi, yesisii do aweɔmfo adzekyee na adzesaa.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Juda see dɛ, Ndzesoadzefo no hɔn ahoɔdzen asa, na wura no so dɔɔ so; ma dɛm ntsi yenntum nntow fasu no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na hɛn atamfo no see dɛ, Mma wɔnntse, nkyii so mma wonnhu, nkodu dɛ yebodu hɔn mu, na yeekuku hɔn, na yɛama edwuma no etwa sin.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Judafo a wɔtsetse hɔn nkyɛn no bae no, wɔbɛsee hɛn mpɛn du dɛ, Wofi mbeambea nyinara bɛba hom do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi medze nyimpa sisii ɔkwan a ɔwɔ fasu no n’ekyir asease no do hɔ, wɔ guadoguado, na medze ɔman no sisii hɔ dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ebusua ebusua tsetsee, wɔdzedze hɔn mfona, hɔn mpeaa, na hɔn ngyen.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mohwɛe, na mosoɛree, na mesee ekunyin, na mpanyimfo, na ɔman no nkaa no dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro hɔn: hom nkaa EWURADZE a no ho yɛ hu no, na hom nko mma hom nuanom, hom mba na hom mbabaa, hom yernom na hom efiefi.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a hɛn atamfo no tsee dɛ yɛatse, na Nyankopɔn ama hɔn egyinatu ayɛ gyan no, nna hɛn nyinara sanee kɔr fasu no ho, ma obiara kosuoo n’edwuma mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ofi ber no do dze kɔ no, mo nkowaa mu fa foraa mu yɛɛ edwuma, na hɔn mu fa so dzedze mpeaa, akyɛm, na ngyen, na dadzentar; na mpanyimfo no so gyinaa Juda fi nyinara ekyir.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hɔn a wɔtoow fasu no na hɔn a wɔsoasoaa ndzesoadze no miaa hɔnho, obiara dze ne nsa kor yɛɛ edwuma, na ɔdze kor no so suoo n’akodze mu;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na adantofo no mu obiara bɔɔ n’afona wɔ ne nkyɛnmu, na wɔdze no dɛm dze towee. Nna nyia ɔhɛn abɛn no wɔ me nkyɛn.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mesee ekunyin no, na mpanyimfo no, na ɔman no nkaa no dɛ, Edwuma no so na no mu trɛ, na hɛn so hɛn mu ebuebue wɔ fasu no do ɔbaako na ɔbaako so ntamu twe:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: dɛm ntsi beebiara a hom bɛtse abɛn ndze no, hom ntsia homho ndan mbra hɛn nkyɛn wɔ hɔ; hɛn Nyankopɔn bɔko ama hɛn.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Dɛm na yɛyɛɛ edwuma no: na hɔn mu fa dzedze mpeaa fi adzekyee araa kodur dɛ nworaba puepuei.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Dɛmara so na ber no ara mu no mesee ɔman no dɛ, Wɔmma obiara nye n’akowaa nda wɔ Jerusalɛm, ma wɔnyɛ aweɔmfo mma hɛn anadwe, na wɔnyɛ edwuma ewiaber.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi emi, na mo nuanom, na mo nkowaa, na mbarimba aweɔmfo so a wodzi m’ekyir no, hɛn mu biara yerinnyiyi hɛn ntar, obiara dze n’akodze wɔ ne nsamu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna ɔman no na hɔn yernom mu nkekamu kɛse soɛree tsiaa hɔn nuanom Judafo no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na binom wɔ hɔ a wɔsee dɛ, Hɛn, hɛn mbabanyin na hɛn mbabaa, yɛdɔɔ so: wɔmma yɛnhwehwɛ eburow, na yendzi na yeenya nkwa.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Binom so wɔ hɔ a wɔsee dɛ, Yɛdze hɛn haban, na wenyin nture, na hɛn adan risisi nhoba: wɔmma yɛnhwehwɛ eburow osian ɔkɔm no ntsi.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Binom so wɔ hɔ a wɔsee dɛ, Yɛafemfɛm sika dze eyi ɔhen no tow, wɔ hɛn nhaban na hɛn wenyin nture no do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Naaso afei hɛn honam tse dɛ hɛn nuanom honam, hɛn mba tse dɛ hɔn mba: na, hwɛ, yɛdze hɛn mbabanyin na hɛn mbabaa reba ɔsom mu dɛ wɔnyɛ asomfo, na hɛn mbabaa mu binom wɔ hɔ a wɔahɛn nkowaasom mu dada: nkyii so ahoɔdzen bi nnyi hɛn afamu a yɛdze bɛyɛ hwee: osiandɛ hɛn nhaban na hɛn wenyin nture wowɔ binom nsamu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na aber a metsee hɔn nkekamu na nsɛm yi no, mo bo fuuw dodow.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna mara mutuu me tsir mu egyina, na menye ekunyin na mpanyimfo no hamee, na mesee hɔn dɛ, Hom sii akaperɛ gyegyee nsiho, obiara wɔ no nua hɔ. Na mobɔɔ hɔn do ngua kɛse.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mesee hɔn dɛ, Hɛn dze, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn tum tse no na yɛdze apon hɛn nuanom Judafo a wɔtɔɔn hɔn maa amanamamfo no; na hom so hom pɛ dɛ wɔtontɔn hom nuanom, na wɔntontɔn hɔn ma hɛn anaa? Nna wɔyɛɛ komm, na woennya asɛm biara ammfa emmbua.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Eso mesee dɛ, Adze a hom reyɛ yi onnye: ana ɔnnsɛ dɛ hom nantsew hom Nyankopɔn no suro mu, osian hɛn atamfo amanamamfo enyimtsiabu no ntsi bi a?
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na emi so dɛmara, mo nuanom na mo nkowaa, yɛfemfɛm hɔn sika na eburow gye nsiho, meserɛ hom, wɔmma yengyaa nsiho yi ekyir dzi.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Meserɛ hom, ndɛ da yi ara, hom ndan hɔn nhaban, hɔn wenyin nture, hɔn olive ndua, na hɔn efi mma hɔn, na sika, na eburow, nsa, na ngo mu ɔha mu ebupɛn no a hom si akaperɛ gyegye no wɔ hɔn hɔ no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna wɔsee dɛ, Yɛbɛdan ama, na yɛnnkɔhwehwɛ hɔn hɔ hwee; dɛmara na yɛbɛyɛ, dɛ mbrɛ ereka no ara. Nna mefrɛɛ asɔfo no, na memaa wɔkekaa ntam, dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ anohoba yi tse.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Eso mopopoo m’akoko mu, na mesee dɛ, Dɛmara na Nyankopɔn mpopo nyimpa biara a ɔmma anohoba yi nntsim no mfi ne fi, na n’edwuma mu; mekyerɛ mbrɛ wobesi apopo no, na wɔato no pan nye yi. Na mboanofo no nyinara see dɛ, Amen, na woyii EWURADZE ayɛw. Na ɔman no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ anohoba yi tse.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nkyii so ofi ber a wɔdze me sii hɔn ambrado wɔ Juda asaase do no, ofi ɔhen Artasɛkeses n’afe a otsia eduonu do araa dze kodu afe a otsia eduasa ebien do no, ɔnye dɛ, mfe duebien, emi na mo nuanom yenndzii ambrado edziban.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na kan no ambradofo a wodzii m’enyim no wɔyɛɛ adzesoa dze maa ɔman no, na wɔgyee hɔn hɔ edziban na nsa, ɔsor dwetɛ dwetɛbona eduanan so; nyew, hɔn nkowaa mpo so hoom ɔman no do: naaso emi dze, osian Nyankopɔn no suro ntsi, mannyɛ dɛm.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nyew, fasu yi ho edwuma no so mowɔɔw do ara suoo mu, nkyii so yɛanntɔ asaase biara: na mo nkowaa nyinara ano boae wɔ edwuma no ho hɔ.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nkyii so Judafo na mpanyimfo no mu nyimpa ɔha eduonum ka hɔn a wofifi amanamamfo a wɔabɔ hɛn ho aprɔw no mu ba hɛn nkyɛn no ho, nna wodzidzi mo pon do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Afei dza wosiesiei dze maa da kor nye ɔnantwi kor na nguan a wɔasan mu eyiyi esia; eso ntumbowa na wosiesiei maa me, na dadu biara mu nsa ahorow nyinara pii: naaso iyi nyinara mu memmbisa ambrado edziban, osiandɛ nkowaasom no yɛɛ durdur wɔ ɔman yi do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ao, me Nyankopɔn, mesrɛ wo, kaa dza osian ɔman yi ntsi mayɛ no nyinara fa ma me wɔ me yieyɛ ntsi.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Afei ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔkaa kyerɛɛ Sanballat na Tobia, na Arabianyi Gesem, na hɛn atamfo nkaa no dɛ matow fasu no, na otokur bi nnkae wɔ mu bio no; (naaso aber no mu na minnsisii mbobow no wɔ nkuropon no ano:)
title: NEHEMIAH

text: nna Sanballat na Gesem somae ma wɔbaa me nkyɛn, dɛ, Bra, ma yenhyia mu wɔ nkuroba no mu kor mu wɔ Ono tɛtɛr no mu. Na hɔn dze, wɔdween dɛ wɔbɛyɛ me bɔn.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mosomaa abɔfo ma wɔkɔr hɔn nkyɛn, dɛ, Mereyɛ edwuma kɛse, dɛm ntsi murunntum minnsian mmba: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edwuma no ntwa sin mber a mirigya no hɔ, na mesian aba hom nkyɛn no?
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na wɔsomae ma wɔbaa me nkyɛn dɛmara mpɛn anan; na mubuaa hɔn dɛmara.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna Sanballat somaa n’akowaa ma ɔbaa me nkyɛn dɛmara otsia enum, ɔdze nwoma a n’ano da hɔ kitsa ne nsamu;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: wɔakyerɛw wɔ mu dɛ, Wɔkeka no wɔ amanaman mu, na Gashmu se dɛ, ɔwo na Judafo no wɔrodwen dɛ wɔbɛtsew etua; ɔno ntsi na erotow fasu no yi: na ɔwoara so epɛ dɛ ibedzi hɔn do hen, dɛ mbrɛ nsɛm yi tse.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔwoara so ahyehyɛ nkɔnhyɛfo so dɛ wɔnka wo ho asɛm wɔ Jerusalɛm, dɛ, Ɔhen bi wɔ Juda: na afei wɔbɛka akyerɛ ɔhen dɛ mbrɛ nsɛm yi tse. Dɛm ntsi afei bra, na ma yɛmbɔ mu ntu egyina.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna mosomae ma wɔkɔr ne nkyɛn, dɛ, Wɔnnyɛɛ ndzɛmba biara dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo ereka yi, mbom wankasa na abɔ wo tsirmu irususu iyi.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na hɔn nyinara pɛɛ dɛ wɔyɛ ma hɛn akoma tu, dɛ, Hɛn nsamu bɔgow efi edwuma no ho, ama yeegyaa mu. Na afei, Ao Nyankopɔn, hyɛ me nsa dzen.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na misii mu kɔr Semaia, Delaia ba no, Mehetabel ba no a wɔdze no ato dan mu no ne fie; na ɔsee me dɛ, Ma yenhyia mu wɔ Nyankopɔn fie, wɔ asɔrdan no mu na ma yɛntotow asɔrdan no no mbobow mu: osiandɛ wɔbɛba dɛ woruboku wo: nyew, anadwe na wɔbɛba eboku wo.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Aso ɔbarimba a ɔtse dɛ emi boguan? Na woana na ɔwɔ hɔ a ɔtse dɛ emi a ɔbɛkɛhɛn asɔrdan mu dze agye noho nkwa? Moronnkɔ mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na modween ho yie, na hwɛ, minyaa nhumu dɛ nnyɛ Nyankopɔn bi na ɔsomaa no: na ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm yi dze tsiaa me, na Tobia na Sanballat na wɔabɔ no paa.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na siantsir a wɔbɔɔ no paa nye dɛ, ama meesuro, na maayɛ dɛm, na maayɛ bɔn, ama woeenya kwan abɔ me dzin bɔn na wɔdze aasopa me.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ao me Nyankopɔn, kaa Tobia na Sanballat dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndwuma yi tse, na eso nkɔnhyɛnyibaa Noadia, na nkɔnhyɛfo nkaa no a nkyɛ wɔrepɛ eyi me hu no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna wowiee fasu no wɔ bosoom Elul mu da a otsia eduonu enum no. Adaduonum ebien na wɔdze yɛe.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a hɛn atamfo nyinara tsee no, nna amanamamfo a wɔwowɔ hɛn ho no surosuroi, na wɔbombɔmee wɔ hɔnankasa hɔn enyiwa do dodoodow: na wohun dɛ edwuma yi hɛn Nyankopɔn na ɔyɛe.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nkyii so nda no mu no Juda ekunyin no somae ma wɔdze nwoma pii kɛmaa Tobia, na Tobia so no nwoma baa hɔn nkyɛn.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na dodowara wɔ Juda a woesua akyerɛ no, osiandɛ ɔyɛ Ara ba Sekania n’asew; na ne ba Jehohanan afa Berekia ba Mesullam ne babaa awar no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Eso wɔbɛkaa ne ndzeyɛɛ pa ho asɛm wɔ m’enyim, na wɔkɛkaa me nsɛm so kyerɛɛ no. Na Tobia kɔr do dze nwoma somae dɛ ɔdze ribeyi me hu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Afei ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔtoow fasu no, na misisii mbobow no, na wɔhyehyɛɛ mbobowano ahwɛfo na adwontofo na Levifo no,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: nna mehyɛɛ mo nua Hanani, na Hanania aban no mu ambrado wɔ Jerusalɛm do: na ɔyɛ ɔbarimba nokwafo, na osuro Nyankopɔn sen dodowara.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mesee hɔn dɛ, Mma hom mma wommbuebue Jerusalɛm nkuropon kɛpem dɛ ewia ano bɛyɛ hyew ana; na mber a wogyina apata mu no, wɔmma wɔntotow mbobow no mu, na hom ntotow ekyir: na wonyi Jerusalɛm mba no bi aweɔmfo nsisi hɔ, obiara ngyina n’aweɔmber do, na obiara ngyina ne fi tsentsendo.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Afei kurow no mu tserɛw na ɔso: na ɔman no suar wɔ mu, na adan no so wonnsisii.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na me Nyankopɔn dze hyɛɛ m’akoma mu dɛ mompon ekunyin, na mpanyimfo, na ɔman no nhyia, ma wɔnkan hɔn ebusuasantsen. Na muhun hɔn a wodzii kan bae no hɔn ebusuasantsen nwoma, na muhun dɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ mu dɛ:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Woyinom nye ɔmansin no mu mba a wofi ndɔmmumkɔfo no a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar faa hɔn kɔree no mu fowee bae, na wɔsanee baa Jerusalɛm na Juda, obiara kɔr no kurow mu no a
title: NEHEMIAH

text: wɔnye Zerubabel, Jesua, Nehemia, Azaria, Raamia, Nahamani, Modekai, Bilshan, Misperet, Bigivai, Nehum, Baana bae no. Israel ɔman mu mbarimba dodow nye yi:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Paros mba, mpemebien ɔha eduosuon ebien.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Seohaia mba, ahaasa eduosuon ebien.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ara mba, ahaesia eduonum ebien.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Pahat-moab mba, Jesua na Joab mba dze, mpem ebien, ahaawɔtwe duawɔtwe.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Elam mba, apem ahaenu eduonum anan.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Latu mba, ahaawɔtwe eduanan enum.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Lakai mba, ahaesuon eduosia.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Binnui mba, ahaesia eduanan awɔtwe.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Bebai mba, ahaesia eduonu awɔtwe.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Azgad mba, mpemebien ahaasa eduonu ebien.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Adonikam mba, ahaesia eduosia esuon.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Bigivai mba, mpemebien eduosia esuon.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Adin mba, ahaesia eduonum enum.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ater mba, Hezekia dze, eduokron awɔtwe.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hasum mba, ahaasa eduonu awɔtwe.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Bezai mba, ahaasa eduonu anan.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Harif mba, ɔha duebien.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Gibeon mba, eduokron enum.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Bɛtlɛhɛm na Netofa mba, ɔha eduowɔtwe awɔtwe.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Anathot mbarimba, ɔha eduonu awɔtwe.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Bɛt-azmavet mbarimba, eduanan ebien.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Kiriat-jearim, Kerifira, na Beerot mbarimba, ahaesuon eduanan ebiasa.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Rama na Geba mbarimba, ahaesia eduonu biako.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Mikmas mbarimba, ɔha eduonu ebien.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Bɛtɛl na Ai mbarimba, ɔha eduonu ebiasa.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nebo kor no mu mbarimba, eduonum ebien.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Elam baako no mba, apem ahaenu eduonum anan.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Harim mba, ahaasa eduonu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Jeriko mba, ahaasa eduanan enum.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Lod, Hadid, na Ono mba, ahaesuon eduonu biako.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Senaa mba, mpemebiasa ahaakron eduasa.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Asɔfo no: Jedaia mba, Jesua fie dze, ahaakron eduosuon ebiasa.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Immer mba, apem eduonum ebien.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Pasur mba, apem ahaenu eduanan esuon.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Harim mba, apem eduosuon.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Levifo no: Jesua mba, Kadmiel dze, Hodeva mba dze, eduosuon anan.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Adwontofo no: Asaf mba, ɔha eduanan awɔtwe.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Mbobowano ahwɛfo no: Sallum mba, Ater mba, Talmon mba, Akkub mba, Hatita mba, Sobai mba, ɔha eduasa awɔtwe.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Netinfo no: Ziha mba, Hasufa mba, Tabaot mba;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Keros mba, Sia mba, Padon mba;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Lebana mba, Hagaba mba, Salmai mba;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hanan mba, Gidel mba, Gahar mba;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Reaia mba, Rezin mba, Nekoda mba,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Gazam mba, Uza mba, Pasea mba;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Besai mba, Meunim mba, Nefu-sesim mba;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Bakbuk mba, Hakufa mba, Harhur mba;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Bazlit mba, Mehida mba, Harsa mba;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Barkos mba, Sisera mba, Tema mba;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nezia mba, Hatifa mba.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Solomon no nkowaa mba: Sotai mba, Soferet mba, Perida mba;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Jaala mba, Darkon mba, Gidelmba;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Sefatia mba, Hatil mba, Pokeret-hazebaim mba, Amon mba.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Netinfo nyinara, na Solomon no nkowaa mba no, wɔyɛ ahaasa eduokron ebien.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na woyinom nye hɔn a wofi Tel-mela, Tel-Harsa, Kerub, Addon, na Immer bae no: na woenntum annkyerɛ hɔn egyanom efiefi; na hɔn asɔfo so, dɛ wofi Israel mu:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Delaia mba, Tobia mba, Nekoda mba, ahaesia eduanan ebien.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na asɔfo no: Hobaia mba, Hakoz mba, Barzillai (a ɔwaar Gileadnyi Barzillai ne mbabaa mu bi, na wɔdze hɔn dzin too no no ne mba.)
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Woyinom hwehwɛɛ hɔn ebusua nwoma wɔ hɔn a wɔnam ananakan do buu hɔn ano no mu, naaso woennhu: dɛm ntsi wobuu hɔn ahoɔfifo na wotuu hɔn fii asɔfodze no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ambrado no see hɔn dɛ mma wonndzi krɔnkrɔndze mu adzekrɔnkrɔn no bi, ma onkodu dɛ ɔsɔfo bi dze Urim na Tummim begyina hɔ.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Mboanofo kuw no nyina yɛ mpemeduanan ebien ahaasa eduosia,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: ɔsor hɔn nkowaa na hɔn mfonabaa a hɔn so wɔyɛ mpemesuon ahaasa eduasa esuon: na wɔwɔ mbanyin na mbasiafo adwontofo ahaenu eduanan enum.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hɔn mpɔnkɔ yɛ ahaesuon eduasa esia; hɔn asoasompɔnkɔ, ahaenu eduanan enum;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: hɔn efumpɔnkɔ, ahaanan eduasa enum; hɔn nsoasopɔnkɔ, mpemesia ahaesuon eduonu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na egyanom efiefi etsitsir no mu binom bɛkyekyɛɛ edwuma no ho adze. Ambrado no maa sika darik apem, mbeesin eduonum, asɔfo ntar ahaenum eduasa dɛ wɔmfa ngu adzekoradze no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH
