text: Na egyanom etsitsir no mu binom guguu edwuma no ho adzekoradze no mu sika darik mpemeduonu, na dwetɛ abɛndaa mpemebien ahaenu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na dza ɔman no nkaa no wɔdze mae no nye sika darik mpemeduonu, na dwetɛ abɛndaa mpemebien, na asɔfo ntar eduosia esuon.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna asɔfo no na Levifo no, na mbobowano ahwɛfo no, na adwontofo no, na ɔman no mu binom, na Netinfo no, na Israel nyinara, tsenatsenaa hɔn nkurow mu. Na aber a bosoom a otsia esuon no durii no, nna Israelmba no wowɔ hɔn nkurow mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔman no nyinara poon hɔnho hyiae dɛ nyimpa kor kɔr bea tɛtɛr no a ɔwɔ nsu kuropon no enyim no do; na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ kyerɛwfo Ezra dɛ ɔmfa Moses mbra a EWURADZE dze hyɛɛ Israel no mbra.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔsɔfo Ezra dze mbra no baa mboanofo no enyim, mbarimba na mbaa nyina, na hɔn a wobotum dze ntseasee etsie no nyinara, wɔ bosoom a otsia esuon no ne da a odzi kan no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔkenkaan mu wɔ bea tɛtɛr no a ɔwɔ Nsu Kuropon no enyim no do fi ahanamakye kodur wigyinae, wɔ mbarimba na mbaa, na hɔn a wobotum atse ase no enyim; na ɔman no nyinara kyɛɛn hɔn aso wɔ mbra nwoma no do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔkyerɛwfo Ezra gyinaa dua asɛnkadaka bi a asɛm no ntsi wɔyɛe no do; na Mattitia, na Sema, na Anaia, na Uria, na Hilkia, na Maaseia, gyinagyina ne nkyɛn, wɔ n’enyimfa; na n’abankum so, Pedaia, na Misael, na Malkija, Hasum, Hasbad-dana, Zekaria, na Mesullam.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Ezra buee nwoma no mu wɔ ɔman no nyinara enyim; osiandɛ ɔbor ɔman no nyinara do; na obuee mu no, ɔman no nyinara soɛree gyinagyinae:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na Ezra hyiraa EWURADZE, Nyankopɔn kɛse no. Na ɔman no nyinara dze hɔn nsa ne memado gyee do dɛ, Amen, Amen: na wɔbobɔɔ hɔn tsir adze, na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu sɔɔr EWURADZE.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Eso Jesua, na Bani, na Serebia, Jamin, Akkub, Sabetai, Hodia, Maaseia, Kelita, Azaria, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaia, na Levifo no, maa ɔman no tsee mbra no ase: na ɔman no gyinaa hɔn ananmu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na wɔkenkaan buukuu no mu, wɔ Nyankopɔn ne mbra no mu, kofee; na wɔkyerɛɛ ase, ma wɔtsee akenkan no ase.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Nehemia a ɔyɛ Ambrado no, na ɔsɔfo Ezra, ɔkyerɛwfo no, na Levifo a wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ ɔman no, see ɔman no nyinara dɛ, Ndɛ da yi ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn; mma hom nndzi nkɔmbɔ, na wonnsusu so. Osiandɛ ɔman no nyinara sui wɔ aber a wɔtsee mbra no mu nsɛm no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ hom kwan, nkedzi seradzenam, na wɔnnom adɔkɔdɔkɔdze, na wɔmfa bi nkɛma nyia woennsiesie hwee amma no no: osiandɛ ndɛ da yi yɛ krɔnkrɔn ma hɛn EWURADZE: nkyii so mma hom nnhow hom werɛ; na EWURADZE n’enyigye nye hom ahoɔdzen.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna Levifo no dwedwee ɔman no nyinara, dɛ, Hom nyɛ dzinn, na da yi yɛ krɔnkrɔn; nkyii so mma hom werɛ nnhow.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔman no nyinara sii mu kɔr hɔn kwan kedzidzii, na wɔnomee, na wɔdze bi kɛkyekyɛe, na wonyaa enyigye kɛse, osiandɛ wɔtsee nsɛm a wɔdaa no edzi kyerɛɛ hɔn no ase.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na da a otsia ebien no, ɔman no nyinara mu egyanom efiefi etsitsir, na Levifo no boaboaa hɔn ano kɔr kyerɛwfo Ezra nkyɛn, dɛ ɔmma wɔntse mbra no ase.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na wohun dɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra no mu, mbrɛ EWURADZE sii na ɔnam Moses do hyɛe, dɛ Israelmba no ntsenatsena mpata mu wɔ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu afahyɛ no mu:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na dɛ wɔmma ɔntahye na wɔmbɔ no dawur wɔ hɔn nkurow nyinara mu, na Jerusalɛm, dɛ, Hom mpue nkɔ bepɔw no do, na wɔnkɛfa ngodua ne mban, na sɛsɛw ne mban, na kranku ne mban, na berɛw, na ndua wusuww ne mban, mbra mbɔbobɔ mpata, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna ɔman no fiir edzi, na wɔkɛfae bae, na wɔbobɔɔ mpata maa hɔnho, obiara wɔ ne dan etsifi na hɔn abanguado, na Nyankopɔn ne fi abanguado, na nsu kuropon ho bea tɛtɛr no do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na hɔn a wɔsanee fi ndɔmmumkɔ mu bae no mu mboanofo no nyinara bobɔɔ mpata, na wɔtsenatsenaa mpata no mu: osiandɛ ofitsi Nun ba Jesua ne nda do dze bodu da no Israelmba nnyɛɛ dɛm da. Na enyigye kɛsenara sii hɔ.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Eso ɔkenkaan Nyankopɔn mbra nwoma no mu daa daa, ofi da a odzi kan no do dze bodur da a odzi ekyir no do. Na wɔhyɛɛ fa no nda esuon; na da a otsia awɔtwe no yɛ ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn, dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Afei dɛm bosoom yi ne da a otsia eduonu anan no mu no Israelmba no dze mbuadadzi, na eyitam, na hɔnho dɛtsedɛtse, bɔɔ ngua.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Israelmba no tseew hɔnho fii ahɔho nyinara ho, na wogyinagyinaa hɔ kekaa hɔn bɔn, na hɔn egyanom emumuyɛ no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na wɔsoɛree gyinagyinaa hɔn gyinabew, na wɔkenkaan EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn mbra nwoma no mu, wɔ adzekyee mu nkyɛmu anan mu kor mu; na nkyɛmu anan mu kor so mu wɔdze kaa hɔn bɔn, na wɔdze sɔɔr EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna Jesua, na Bani, Kadmiel, Sebania, Bunni, Serebia, Bani, na Kenani, soɛree gyinagyinaa Levifo sumpii no do, na wɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu frɛɛ EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna Levifo no, Jesua, na Kadmiel, Bani, Hasabineia, Serebia, Hodia, Sebania, na Petahia, see dɛ, Hom nsoɛr nhyira EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn mfi daapem nkesi daapem: na wonhyira w’enyimnyam dzin a wɔama do atra nhyira na ayɛyi nyinara no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ɔwo nye EWURADZE, mekyerɛ wo nkotoo korɛ; ɔwo na eyɛɛ sor, ɔsor mu sor, nye hɔn dɔm nyinara, asaase na ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ do nyinara, po na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, na ɔwoara na ekora hɔn nyinara do; na sor dɔm no, ɔwo na wɔsɔr wo.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ɔwo nye EWURADZE Nyankopɔn no a esaan mu faa Abram, na edze no fiir edzi fii Kaldeafo Ur bae, na emaa no dzin Abraham;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: ihun n’akoma mu dɛ odzi nokwar wɔ w’enyim, na enye no dzii ahyɛmu dɛ edze Keenanfo, Hitifo, Amorifo, na Perizfo, na Jebusfo, na Girgasfo asaase bɛma, mekyerɛ dɛ edze bɛma n’asefo, na ama wo nsɛm no etsim; osiandɛ ɔwo yɛ ɔtseneneenyi.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔwo hun hɛn egyanom ahohiahia wɔ Egypt, na etsee hɔn nkekamu wɔ Mbɛw Po no ho;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na ekyerɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze na anwanwadze wɔ Farao, na no nkowaa nyinara, na n’asaase do ɔman no nyinara do; na ɔwoara hun dɛ woedzi hɔn do nkontompɔsɛm; na edze gyee dzin, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔwo epaa po no mu wɔ hɔn enyim, na wɔfaa po no ne finimfin wɔ asaase kɛsɛɛ do; na hɔn a wotsiiw hɔn no, etoow hɔn guu ebun no mu, dɛ mbrɛ wɔtow ɔbo kyen nsu a ɔyɛ dzen mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nkyii so ɔwo igyaa hɔn wɔ mununkum dum mu ewiaber; na gya dum mu anadwe, dɛ ɔmma hɔn kan wɔ kwan a ɔwɔ dɛ wodua do no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Eso ɔwo isianee baa bepɔw Sinai do, na ifii sor nye hɔn kasae, na emaa hɔn atsɛmbu tsenenee na nokwar mbra, ahyɛdze a oye na mbransɛm:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na emaa wohun w’ahomgyeda krɔnkrɔn no, na enam w’akowaa Moses ne nsa do hyɛɛ hɔn mbransɛm, na ahyɛdze, na mbra:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na emaa hɔn sor edziban dze kum hɔn kɔm, na edze nsu fi botan mu puei maa hɔn dze kum hɔn nsukɔm, na ehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnkɔ nkɛfa asaase a emaa wo nsa do dɛ edze bɛma hɔn no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Naaso hɔn na hɛn egyanom dzii nkontompɔsɛm, na wɔseen hɔn kɔn, na woenntsie wo mbransɛm no,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na wɔpoow dɛ wobetsie, nkyii so wɔannkaa w’anwanwadze a eyɛɛ no wɔ hɔn mu no; mbom wɔseen hɔn kɔn, na hɔn etuatsew no mu wɔhyɛɛ hɔn do safohen dɛ wɔresan akɔ hɔn nkowaasom no mu: na ɔwo yɛ fakyɛfakyɛ Nyankopɔn, ɔdomfo na mbɔbɔrhufo, a efa ebufuw nyaa, na w’adɔyɛ so ntsi ammpow hɔn.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nyew, aber a wɔyɛɛ nantwiba a woegu maa hɔnho, na wɔsee dɛ, Iyi nye wo Nyankopɔn a ɔdze wo fi Egypt bae, na woyii ehi kɛse mpo;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: ɔwo wo mbɔbɔrhu pii no ntsi ammpow hɔn wɔ sar no do: mununkum dum no emmfi hɔn do ewiaber, dɛ obegya hɔn wɔ kwan no mu; nkyii so gya dum no anadwe, dɛ ɔbɛma hɔn kan wɔ kwan a ɔwɔ dɛ wɔfa do mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ɔwo, edze wo sunsum pa no so maa hɔn dɛ ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn, na wo manna so amma ammpa hɔn ano, na emaa hɔn nsu dze kum hɔn nsukɔm.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nyew, ɔwo ehwɛɛ hɔn mfe eduanan wɔ sar no do, na woennhia hwee; hɔn ntar ennsusuw, na hɔn anan annhohon.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nkyii so ɔwo maa hɔn nhenman na aman a ɔwoara ekyɛe no dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kyɛpɛn tse: nna wɔfaa Sihon asaase, mekyerɛ Hesbonhen asaase, na Bashanhen Ɔge asaase no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hɔn mba so, ɔwo maa wɔdɔɔr dɛ sor nworaba, na edze hɔn baa asaase a ɔwoara esee hɔn egyanom dɛ wɔbɔkɔ do akɛfa no do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna mba no kɔree na wɔkɛfaa asaase no, na ɔwo ebrɛɛ hɔn a wɔtse asaase no do no, mekyerɛ Keenanfo no, adze wɔ hɔn enyim, na edze hɔn hyɛɛ hɔn nsa, nye hɔn hen, na asaase no do aman no, ma wɔaayɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ wɔpɛ.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na wɔgyegyee nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban, na asaase a ɔadɔ seradze, na wonyaa efi a ndzɛmba pa nyinara ahyehyɛ mu amaama, nsubura a wotwae, wenyin nture, na ngodua nture, na ndua a wodzi no nsowee, piigyan: nna wodzidzii, na wɔmee, na wɔyeyɛɛ abran, na wɔgyee hɔn enyi wɔ wo papayɛ kɛse no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Naaso wɔyɛɛ asoɔdzen, na wɔtseew etua wɔ wo do, na wɔtoow wo mbra kyeen hɔn ekyir, na wokunkum wo nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzii dase tsiaa hɔn dɛ wɔdze resan hɔn aba wo nkyɛn no, na woyii wo ehi kɛse.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔwo edze hɔn hyɛɛ hɔn atamfo nsa, hɔn na wohiahiaa hɔn ho: na hɔn ahokyer ber mu no a wosui frɛɛ wo no, ɔwo ifi sor tsiee hɔn; na dɛ mbrɛ w’adɔyɛ pii tse no, ɔwo maa hɔn agyefo a wɔgyee hɔn fii hɔn atamfo nsamu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Naaso wonyaa asomdwee ara pɛr na wɔyɛɛ w’enyim bɔn bio: dɛm ntsi ɔwo igyaa hɔn hyɛɛ hɔn atamfo nsa, na wonyaa hɔn do tum: naaso aber a wɔsanee, na wosui frɛɛ wo no, nna ɔwo fi sor tsiei; na mber pii na ɔwo gyee hɔn dɛ mbrɛ wo mbɔbɔrhu no tse;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na ebɔɔ hɔn kɔkɔ dɛ edze hɔn bɛba wo mbra no mu bio: naaso wodzii nkontompɔsɛm, na woenntsie wo mbrasɛm, na wɔyɛɛ bɔn tsiaa w’ahyɛdze a sɛ nyimpa dzi do a obenya mu nkwa no, na wɔmemaa hɔn mbatsir do, na wɔseen hɔn kɔn, na wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Naaso mber pii na ɔwo ekoraa hɔn, na edze wo sunsum nam wo nkɔnhyɛfo do bɔɔ hɔn kɔkɔ: naaso wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie: dɛm ntsi ɔwo iyii hɔn hyɛɛ asaase no do aman no nsa.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Naaso wo mbɔbɔrhu pii no ntsi, ɔwo ennkum hɔn ase, na ammpow hɔn so; osiandɛ ɔwo yɛ ɔdomfo na mbɔbɔrhufo Nyankopɔn.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, hɛn Nyankopɔn, Onyankopɔn kɛse, ɔkatakyi a wo ho yɛ hu na isie ahyɛmu na adɔyɛ, mma mma ɔfona nyinara a aba hɛn, hɛn ahemfo, hɛn mbapɔmba, hɛn asɔfoe na hɛn nkɔnhyɛfo, hɛn egyanom, na wo man nyinara do, ofitsi Asiria ahemfo ber do araa dze bodu ndɛ yi nnyɛ w’enyi do adze kakraba.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Naaso ɔwo etsen wɔ dza aba hɛn do nyinara mu; osiandɛ ɔwo edzi no nokwar mu, na hɛn dze, yɛayɛ no emumuyɛ mu:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: nkyii so hɛn ahemfo, hɛn mbapɔmba, hɛn asɔfoe, na hɛn egyanom so, woenndzi wo mbra do, eso woenntsie wo mbransɛm na w’adasesɛm a edze dzii dase tsiaa hɔn no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Osiandɛ wɔannsom wo wɔ hɔn ahendzi mu, na wo papayɛ kɛse a edze maa hɔn, na asaase tɛtɛr a ɔadɔ seradze a edze mae wɔ hɔn enyim no mu no, nkyii so wɔannsan emmfi hɔn ndzeyɛɛ bɔn no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hwɛ, yɛyɛ nkowaa ndɛ da yi, na asaase a ɔwo edze maa hɛn egyanom, dɛ wondzi no do aba na no do ndzepa bi no, dze, hwɛ, yɛyɛ nkowaa wɔ do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔsow ndɔbaa pii dze ma ahemfo a osian hɛn bɔn ntsi ma edze hɔn esisi hɛn do no: eso wɔwɔ tum wɔ hɛn nyimpadua do, na hɛn mbowa do, dɛ mbrɛ wɔpɛ, na yɛwɔ atseetsee kɛse mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na iyi nyinara so mpo mu no yeridzi nokwar ahyɛmu, na yɛrekyerɛw; na hɛn mbapɔmba, na hɛn Levifo, na hɛn asɔfoe, rosɔw ano.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Afei hɔn a wɔsɔɔw ano nye yi, Nehemia, Tirsata no, Hakalia ba no, na Zedekia;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Seraia, Azaria, Jeremia;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Pasur, Amaria, Malkija;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hatus, Sebania, Malluk;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Harim, Meremot, Obadia;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Daniel, Ginneton, Baruk;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Mesullam, Abija, Mijamin;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Maazia, Bilgai, Semaia: woyinom nye asɔfo no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Levifo no: ɔnye dɛ, Jesua Azania ba no, Binnui a ofi Henadad mba mu, Kadmiel;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na hɔn nuanom, Sebania, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaia, Hanan;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Mika, Rehob, Hasabia;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Zakur, Serebia, Sebania;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hodia, Bani, Beninu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ɔman no mu etsitsir: Paros, Pahat-moab, Elam, Zatu, Bani;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Adonija, Bigivai, Adin;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ater, Hezekia, Azzur;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hodia, Hasum, Bezai;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Harif, Anathot, Nobai;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Magpia, Mesullam, Hezir;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Mesezabel, Zadok, Jadua;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Pelatia, Hanan, Anaia;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hosea, Hanania, Hasub;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Halohesh, Pilha, Sobek;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Rehum, Hasabina, Maaseia;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na Ahia, Hanan, Anan;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Malluk, Harim, Baana.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔman no, nkaa no, Levifo, mbobowano ahwɛfo, adwontofo, Netinfo, na hɔn a wɔtseew hɔnho fii asaase do aman ho baa Nyankopɔn mbra ho no, hɔn yernom, hɔn mbabanyin, na hɔn mbabaa, obiara a ɔwɔ nyimdzee na ntseasee,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: wɔbɛtakyeer hɔn nuanom, hɔn ekunyin no ho, na wɔhɛɛn ndom, na ntanka mu, dɛ wɔbɛnantsew Nyankopɔn mbra a wɔnam Nyankopɔn n’akowaa Moses do hyɛe no do, na wɔaahwɛ na wɔaayɛ hɛn EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ne mbrasɛm, na n’atsɛmbusɛm, na n’ahyɛdze nyinara;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na dɛ yɛremmfa hɛn mbabaa mma asaase no do aman, na eso yɛremmfa hɔn mbabaa mma hɛn mbabanyin;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na sɛ asaase no do aman no dze adzetɔndze anaa edzidzidze biara ba ahomgyeda no mu bɔtɔn a, yɛronntɔ no wɔ hɔn hɔ ahomgyeda no mu, anaa da krɔnkrɔn bi mu; na yebegyaa afe a otsia esuon no, na akaperɛ biara si.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Eso yɛhyehyɛɛ hɛnho mbra, dɛ hɛnara yɛdze dwetɛbona mbumu ebiasa mu kor bɛma afrenhyia afrenhyia ma wɔdze ama hɛn Nyankopɔn fi ho som no;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: ama kyerɛpaanoo, na daa edziban afɔr, na daa ɔhyew afɔr, ahomgyeda dze no, abosoom fofor dze no, ama afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ, na ndzɛmba krɔnkrɔn na bɔn ho afɔr no dɛ wɔmfa mpata mma Israel no, na hɛn Nyankopɔn fi ho edwuma nyinara.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na yɛtwee enyena ayɛyɛdze ho tonto, asɔfo, Levifo, na ɔman no, dɛ wɔmfa mbra hɛn Nyankopɔn fi mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn egyanom efiefi tsetsee, wɔ mber a wɔahyehyɛ mu, afrenhyia afrenhyia, ma wɔaasɔ no wɔ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn n’afɔrmbukyia no do, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra no mu no:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na yɛdze hɛn asaase do nduadzewakan, na ndua ahorow nyinara n’aba nyinara mu nduadzewakan, bɛba EWURADZE fi mu, afrenhyia afrenhyia:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na yɛdze hɛn mbabanyin, na hɛn mbowa mu mbakan so, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mbra no mu so, na hɛn anantwi na hɛn nguan mu mbakan, bɛba hɛn Nyankopɔn fi mu, dze abrɛ asɔfo a wɔsom wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn fi mu no:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na yɛdze hɛn mbɔr, na hɛn mado afɔrbɔdze, na ndua horow nyinara n’aba, nsa na ngo mu nduadzewakan no bɛba, dze abrɛ asɔfo no, ma wɔdze aaba hɛn Nyankopɔn fie mpia no mu; na yɛdze hɛn asaase do ebupɛn du du no bɛma Levifo no; na hɔnara, Levifo no, na wɔgyegye ebupɛn du du no wɔ hɛn ekuayɛ nkurow nyinara mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Aaron ba, ɔsɔfo no, nka Levifo no ho, aber a Levifo no regyegye ebupɛn du du no: na Levifo no mfa ebupɛn du du no mu ebupɛn a otsia du no mbra hɛn Nyankopɔn fi mu mpia no mu, wɔ adzekoradan no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Israelmba na Levifo no mfa eburow, nsa, na ngo mado afɔrbɔdze no mbra mpia no mu, mbrɛ krɔnkrɔnbea ndzɛmba, na asɔfo a wɔsom, na mbobowano ahwɛfo, na adwontofo no wɔ: na yɛronnto hɛn Nyankopɔn fi no pan.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔman no mu mbapɔmba no tsenaa Jerusalɛm: na ɔman no nkaa no dze, wɔtwee tonto dɛ wɔdze nyimpa du mu baako bɛtsena Jerusalɛm, kurow krɔnkrɔn no mu, na baakron no so atsenatsena nkurow nkaa no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔman no hyiraa mbarimba no a woyii hɔn yamu dze hɔnho mae dɛ wɔbɛtsena Jerusalɛm no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Afei woyinom nye amansin mu etsitsir a wɔtsenaa Jerusalɛm no na Juda nkurow no mu dze, obiara tsenaa n’egyapadze do wɔ hɔn nkurow do, ɔnye dɛ, Israel asɔfo, na Levifo, Asɔrdan mu asomfo, na Solomon no nkowaa mba no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Jerusalɛm hɔ na Judamba no mu bi, na Benjaminmba no mu bi tsenae. Judamba no mu: Ataia a ofi Uzia, Zekaria, Amaria, Sefatia, na Mahalalel ebusuasantsen no a wofi Perezmba no mu no;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na Maaseia a ofi Baruk, Kol-hoze, Hazaia, Adaia, Joiarib, na Zekaria a wofi Silonnyi no n’asefo mu no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Perezmba nyinara a wɔtsenaa Jerusalɛm no wɔyɛ mbarimba ahaanan eduosia awɔtwe a wɔyɛ ndam.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Benjamin ebusuasantsen nye yi: Sallu, Mesullam, Joed, Pedaia, Kolaia, Maaseia, Itiel na Jesaia.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔno n’ekyir Gabbai, na Sallai, nyimpa no yɛ ahaakron eduonu awɔtwe.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Joel, Zikri ba no nye hɔn hwɛdofo: na Juda, Hasenua ba no, nye nyia otsia ebien a ɔhwɛ kurow no do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Asɔfo no mu: Jedaia, Joiarib ne ba no, na Jakin.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Seraia, a ofi Hilkia, Mesullam, Zadok, Meraiot, na Ahitub a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn fi mu panyin no n’ebusua mu,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na hɔn nuanom a wɔyɛ ofi no mu edwuma no. Hɔn dodow yɛ ahaawɔtwe eduonu ebien. Na Adaia a ofi Jeroham, Pelalia, Amzi, Zekaria, Pasur, na Malkija ebusua mu,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na no nuanom, egyanom efiefi etsitsir, ahaenu eduanan ebien. Na Amassai, a ofi Azarel, Ahzai, Mesillemot, na Immer ebusua mu no,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na hɔn nuanom, mbarimba akatakyi a wɔyɛ ndam, ɔha eduonu awɔtwe: na hɔn hwɛdofo nye Zabdiel, Hagedolim ba no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Levifo no mu: Semaia, a ofi Hasub, Azrikam, Hasabia na Bunni ebusua mu no;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na Sabbethai na Jozabad a wofi Levifo mu etsitsir no mu, hɔn na wɔhwɛ Nyankopɔn fie edwuma no do,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na Mattania, Mika a ofi Zabdi, na Asaf a ɔyɛ otsitsir a odzi aseda mpaabɔ adwontow no enyim no ebusua mu, na Bakbukia a odzi do wɔ no nuanom mu no; na Abda, Sammua a ofi Galal na Jedutun ebusua mu no ne ba no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Levifo nyinara a wɔwɔ kurow krɔnkrɔn no mu no wɔyɛ ahaenu eduowɔtwe anan.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nkyii so mbobowano ahwɛfo no, Akkub, Talmon, na hɔn nuanom a wɔweɔn nkuropon ano no, wɔyɛ ɔha eduosuon ebien.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Israel nkaa no, asɔfo no, Levifo no, wɔwowɔ Juda nkurow no nyinara mu, obiara tse n’egyapadze do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Asɔrfi mu asomfo no dze wɔtsenaa Ofel: na Ziha na Gispa na wɔhwɛ Asɔrfi mu asomfo no do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Levifo do ɔhwɛfo so a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm nye Uzi a ofi Bani, Hasabia, Mattania, Mika, na Asafmba no mu adwontofo no a wɔhwɛ Nyankopɔn fi mu edwuma no do no ebusua mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔhen hɔ mbrasɛm bi wɔ hɔn ho, na wɔaahyɛ edzidzidze bi ama adwontofo no, dɛ mbrɛ da biara ɔsɛ.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Petahia, Mesezabel ba no a ofi Juda ba Zera mba mu no, na ɔdze ɔhen no nsaano wɔ ɔman no ho nsɛm nyinara mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔwɔ nkurobaase, nye hɔn nhaban ho dze, Judamba no mu bi tsenatsenaa Kiriat-arba na no nkuroba mu, na Dibon na no nkuroba mu, na Jekabzeel na no nkuroba mu;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: binom so tsenaa Jesua, Molada, Bɛt-pelet;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na Hazar-sual, na Beer-seba na no nkuroba mu;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na Ziklag, na Mekona na no nkuroba mu;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: En-rimmon, Zora, Jarmut;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Zanoa, Adullam, na hɔn nkurobaase, Lakis na ne nhaban, Azeka na no nkuroba. Nna wɔtsenatsenae fi Beer-seba kodur Hinom bɔnsa mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Benjaminmba so tsenae fi Geba araa kɔr Mikmas na Aija, na Bɛtɛl na no nkuroba mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Anathot, Nob, Anania;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hazor, Rama, Gitaim;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Lod, na Ono, edwimfo bɔnsa mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Levifo no mu, nkyekyɛmu bi a wɔyɛ Juda dze no bi kɛkaa Benjamin ho.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Woyinom nye asɔfo na Levifo a wɔnye Zerubabel, Sealtiel ba no, na Jesua sii mu kɔree no: Seraia, Jeremia, Ezra;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Amaria, Malluk, Hatus;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Sekania, Rehum, Meremot;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Iddo, Ginnetoi, Abija;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Mijamin, Maadia, Bilga;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Semaia, na Joiarib, Jedaia;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Sallu, Amok, Hilkia, Jedaia. Woyinom nye asɔfo no na hɔn nuanom no mu etsitsir wo Jesua nda mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nkyii so Levifo no: Jesua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Serebia, Juda, na Mattania a ɔhwɛ ndaasema no do, ɔnoara na no nuanom.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Eso Bakbukia na Unno, hɔn nuanom na wodzi hɔn tsentsendo wɔ ɔweɔn no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Jesua woo Joiakim, na Joiakim woo Eliasib, na Eliasib woo Joiada,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na Joiada woo Jonatan, na Jonatan woo Jadua.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Joiakim ne nda mu asɔfo no, egyanom efiefi etsitsir no nye yi: Seraia dze, Meraia; Jeremia dze, Hanania;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ezra dze, Mesullam; Amaria dze, Jehohanan;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Malluki dze, Jonatan; Sebania dze, Josef;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Harim dze, Adna; Meraiot dze, Helkai;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Iddo dze, Zekaria; Ginneton dze, Mesullam;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Abija dze, Zikri; Miniamin dze, Moadia dze, Piltai;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Bilga dze, Sammua; Semaia dze, Jehonatan;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Joiarib dze, Matenai; Jedaia dze, Uzi;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Sallai dze, Kalai; Amok dze, Eber;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Hilkia dze, Hasabia; Jedaia dze, Netanel.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Levifo no, Eliasib, Joiada, Johanan, na Jadua, nda no mu no, na wɔkyerɛɛw egyanom efiefi etsitsir no: na asɔfo no so wɔ Persianyi Darius n’ahendzi no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Levifo mba no, egyanom efiefi etsitsir no, wɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu araa dze bodur Eliasib ba Johanan ne nda no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Levifo mu etsitsir no: Hasabia, Serebia, na Jesua, Kadmiel ba no, ɔnye hɔn nuanom a wodzii hɔn tsentsendo, dɛ woyi ayɛw na wɔda ase, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn ne nyimpa David ne mbrasɛm no tse, aweɔmfo na aweɔmfo.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Mattania, na Bakbukia, Obadia, Mesullam, Talmon, Akkub, na wɔyɛ mbobowano ahwɛfo wɔ nkuropon ano ndzekoradze adan no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Iyinom wɔ Joiakim, Jesua ba no, Jozadak ba no, nda mu, na ambrado Nehemia, na ɔsɔfo Ezra, ɔkyerɛwfo no nda mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Jerusalɛm afasu no no mbueidapa no, wɔhwehwɛɛ Levifo no wɔ hɔn tsenabew nyinara, dɛ wɔdze hɔn reba Jerusalɛm, ma wɔdze ndaasema na ɔnye ndwom, ɔnye nkasaa, mbɛntasanku, na ɔnye nsankutsen, eedzi mbueidapa no enyigye mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na adwontofomba no boaboaa hɔn ano hyiaa fi tɛtɛr a abɔ Jerusalɛm ho aprɔw no mu, na Netofatfo nkurobaase;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: eso wofi Bɛt-gilgal, na Geba nkwaado na Azmavet; osiandɛ adwontofo no akyekyer nkuroba ama hɔnho dze abɔ Jerusalɛm ho aprɔw.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na asɔfo na Levifo no tseew hɔnho: na wɔtseew ɔman no, na nkuropon no, na fasu no ho.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna medze Juda mbapɔmba no fowee baa fasu no do, na miyii ekuw akɛse ebien a wɔda ase na wɔtow santsen nantsew sisii hɔ; no mu kor faa enyimfa wɔ fasu no do ɔdze kɔ sumina kuropon no ano:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na Hosaia, na Juda mbapɔmba no mu fa na wodzi hɔn ekyir,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na Azaria, Ezra, na Mesullam,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Juda, na Benjamin, na Semaia, na Jeremia,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na asɔfomba no mu binom dzedze mbɛn: Zekaria a ofi Jonatan, Semaia, Mattania, Mikaia, Zakur, na Asaf ebusua mu no;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na no nuanom, Semaia, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Netanel, Juda, na Hanani. Hɔn nna wɔdzedze Nyame nyimpa David ne nsanku adwontow ndzɛmba no; na kyerɛwfo Ezra dzi hɔn enyim:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na nsunyiwa kuropon no ano, na hɔn enyim tsentsendo no, wɔfoow David kurow ntwer no, na fasu no n’afowee no, wɔ David fi no n’etsifi, mekyerɛ ɔdze kɔ nsu kuropon no nkyɛn boka afamu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na hɔn a wɔda ase kuw kor no so sii mu kehyiaa hɔn, nna mo so midzii hɔn ekyir, ɔnye ɔman no fa no, wɔ fasu no do, dze kesi mfononoo abantsentsen no do, mekyerɛ ɔdze kɔ fasu tɛtɛr no do;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na Efraim kuropon no do, na kuropon dadaw no do, na enam kuropon no ho, na Hananel abantsentsen na Hamea abantsentsen no do araa dze kodu abobow a wɔfrɛ no Nguantsen Kuropon no ano: na wokegyinaa adaduafo dan kuropon no ano dzinn.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna hɔn a wɔda ase ekuw ebien no kegyinaa Nyankopɔn fi no mu, na emi, na mpanyimfo no fa a wɔka mo ho no:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na asɔfo no, Eliakim, Maaseia, Miniamin, Mikaia, Elioenai, Zekaria, na Hanania, wɔdzedze mbɛn;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na Maaseia, na Semaia, na Eleazar, na Uzi, na Jehohanan, na Malkija, na Elam, na Ezer. Na adwontofo no, wɔnye hɔn hwɛdofo Jezra-hia, memaa hɔn ndze do ma wɔtsee.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na wɔbobɔɔ afɔr akɛse da no, na hɔn enyi gyee; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn dze enyigye kɛse ama hɔn enyi agye; na mbaa na mbofra no so enyi gyee ma wɔtsee Jerusalɛm enyigye no ne nka wɔ ekyir noho ara.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na da no ara na woyiyii mbarimba binom sisii akoradze, mado afɔr, nduadzewakan, na ebupɛn du du mpia no do, dɛ wɔmboaboa kyɛfa a mbra no hyɛe dze maa asɔfo na Levifo no ano ngu mu, osiandɛ Juda nyaa asɔfo na Levifo a wɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn no ho enyigye.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na wɔhwɛɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn ahwɛdodze no, na ahoguar ahwɛdodze no, na dɛmara so na adwontofo no na mbobowano ahwɛfo no so yɛe, dɛ mbrɛ David na ne ba Solomon mbrasɛm no tse.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Osiandɛ tsetsefo David na Asaf nda mu, wɔhyehyɛɛ adwontofo, na Nyankopɔn ayɛyi na ndaasema do etsitsir.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Zerubabel nda mu, na Nehemia nda mu no, Israel nyinara memaa adwontofo na mbobowano ahwɛfo no kyɛfa, dɛ mbrɛ da biara ɔsɛ: na wɔdze sii hɔ maa Levifo no; na Levifo no so wotui sii hɔ maa Aaronmba no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Da no ara mu na wɔkenkaan Moses nwoma no mu wɔ ɔman no asomu; na wohun dɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mu dɛ, mma Ammonnyi na Moabnyi nnhɛn Nyankopɔn ne bagua mu dabiarada;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: osiandɛ wɔammfa edziban na nsu emmbehyia Israelmba kwan, na mbom wɔkɔbɔɔ Balaam paa tsiaa hɔn, dɛ ɔmbɔdom hɔn, naaso hɛn Nyankopɔn daan ndom no nhyira.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔtsee mbra no, nna woyiyii amamforafo no nyinara fii Israel mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Afei iyi nnyae mmbae no, ɔsɔfo Eliasib a wɔdze no sii hɛn Nyankopɔn fie mpia no do no, ɔnye Tobia ayɛ kor ntsi,
title: NEHEMIAH

text: oesiesie pia kɛse bi dze ama no, wɔ mbrɛ nkan no wɔdze edziban ayɛyɛdze, krɔbɔw, na ndzɛmba ndzɛmba, na eburow, nsa, na ngo mu ebupɛn du du a wɔahyɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma Levifo, na adwontofo, na mbobowano ahwɛfo no; na mado afɔr a wɔdze ma asɔfo no, sie no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na aber yi nyinara mu no nna minnyi Jerusalɛm: osiandɛ Babilɔnhen Artasɛkeses n’afe a otsia eduasa ebien mu no mokɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn; na nda bi ekyir no nna mibisaa ɔhen hɔ kwan:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na mesanee baa Jerusalɛm, na mubohun mbusu a Eliasib dze abɔ Tobia, dɛ oesiesie pia ama no wɔ Nyankopɔn fie abanguado no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔyɛɛ me awerɛhow dodow: dɛm ntsi miyiyii Tobia fidua mu ndzɛmba no nyinara fii pia no mu towee gui.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna mehyɛe ma wɔhohoor mpia no mu: na medze Nyankopɔn fie ndzɛmba no sanee baa hɔ bio, ɔnye edziban ayɛyɛdze na krɔbɔw no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na muhun dɛ Levifo kyɛpɛn no wɔammfa amma hɔn; na Levifo na adwontofo no a wɔyɛ edwuma no woeguanguan ma obiara kɔ ne haban mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna mutwuuw mpanyimfo no enyim, na mesee dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔapow Nyankopɔn fie yi? Na mopoon hɔn boaa ano, na medze hɔn sisii hɔn ananmu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna Juda nyinara dze eburow na nsa na ngo ebupɛn du du bae boguu adzekoradze no mu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mehyɛɛ adzekoradzehwɛfo wɔ ndzekoradze no do, ɔsɔfo Selemia, kyerɛwfo Zadok, na Pedaia a ofi Levifo no mu: na hɔn nkyɛnmu na Hanan, Zakur ba no, Mattania ba no wɔ: osiandɛ wobuu hɔn anokwafo, na hɔn edwuma nye dɛ wɔkyekyɛ ma hɔn nuanom.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Me Nyankopɔn, kaa ma me wɔ iyi ho, na mma mmpepa me nyɛe pa a mayɛ ama me Nyankopɔn fi, na ne nsewhyɛ no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nda no mu na muhun Juda mu binom a wotsiatsia nsatwer do ahomgyeda, na wɔdze eburow efiefi so ba, na wɔdze soasoa nsoasopɔnkɔ dɛ nsa so, na esikyireamba, na ndɔmba, na ndzesoadze ahorow nyinara a wɔdze ba Jerusalɛm ahomgyeda: na mobɔɔ hɔn kɔkɔ wɔ da a wɔrotɔn edzidzidze no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na Taere mbarimba so tsenaa hɔ a wɔdze enam, na adzetɔndze horow nyinara bae, na wɔbɔtɔɔn no ahomgyeda no maa Judamba no, wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna mutwuuw Juda ekunyin no enyim, na mesee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛn mbusu na hom robɔ, dze rugu ahomgyeda ho fi yi?
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ana hom egyanom annyɛ dɛm, ana hɛn Nyankopɔn ammfa mbusu yi nyinara ammba hɛn, na kurow yi do bi a? Naaso hom dze ebufuw bi so reba Israel do, dɛ worugu ahomgyeda ho fi.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Jerusalɛm nkuropon no mu rehyɛ ase ayɛ sum ansaana ahomgyeda rudu no, nna mehyɛɛ dɛ mbobow no wɔntotow mu, na mehyɛɛ dɛ mma wommbuebue gyedɛ ahomgyeda no etwa mu ana: na medze mo nkowaa no mu binom sisii nkuropon no ano, amma adzesoa bi aammba mu ahomgyeda no.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna eguadzifo na adzetɔndze horow no nyinara atɔmfo no, soɛsoɛɛ Jerusalɛm nkuropon no ekyir prɛko anaa mprɛnu.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna mobɔɔ hɔn kɔkɔ, na mesee hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom soɛsoɛ deda fasu no ekyir? Sɛ hom yɛ dɛm bio a, medze nsa mobɔto hom do. Ofitsi ber no, wɔammba ahomgyeda bio.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mehyɛɛ Levifo no dɛ wɔntsew hɔnho, na wɔmbra mbɔhwɛ kuropon no ano, ma wɔntsew ahomgyeda no ho. Ao, me Nyankopɔn, iyi so kaa ma me, na kora mo do dɛ mbrɛ w’adɔyɛ ne kɛseyɛ tse.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nda no mu so na muhun Judafo a wɔawarwar Ashdod mu mbaa, Ammon mu mbaa, na Moab mu mbaa:
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na hɔn mba kasa Ashdod kasa fa, na wonntum nnkasa Judafo kasaa, na mbom dɛ mbrɛ ɔman na ɔman kasaa tse.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Na mutwuuw hɔn enyim na modoom hɔn, na mobobɔɔ hɔn mu binom, na mututuu hɔn nhwi na memaa wɔdze Nyankopɔn dzii nsew, dɛ, Hom remmfa hom mbabaa mmema hɔn mbabanyin, na hom remmfa hɔn mbabaa mmema hom mbabanyin, anaa homara hom ho awar.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Ana nnyɛ iyinom na Israelhen Solomon nam do yɛɛ bɔn no bi? Ɔno a nna amanaman dodowara mu ɔhen biara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔno, na nyimpa a ne Nyankopɔn dɔ no, na Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ no hen wɔ Israel nyinara do: naaso ɔno mpo na mbaa ananaben maa ɔyɛɛ bɔn.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Aso yentsie hom dɛ yɛbɛyɛ bɔn kɛse yi nyinara, ma yaafom hɛn Nyankopɔn wɔ mbaa ananaben awarwar mu anaa?
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Nna sɔfopanyin Eliasib ba, Joiadamba no mu baako, yɛ Horonnyi Sanballat n’asew: dɛm ntsi mepaam no fii mo do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Me Nyankopɔn, kaa ma hɔn, osiandɛ woegu asɔfodzi no ho fi, na asɔfodzi ahyɛmu no, na Levifo no ahyɛmu no ho fi.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Dɛm na metseew hɔn ho fii ahɔho nyinara ho, na medze asɔfo na Levifo no mu ahwɛdzehwɛfo sisii hɔ, obiara wɔ n’edwuma mu;
title: NEHEMIAH

text: na mber a wɔahyehyɛ no mu, enyena ayɛyɛdze no dze, na nduadzewakan no dze no. Ao me Nyankopɔn, kaa ma onsi me yie, wɔ iyi do.
title: NEHEMIAH

text: Afei ɔbaa dɛ Ahasuerus ber do, Ahasuerus a odzii hen fitsi India araa dze kodu Etiopia, wɔ amansin ɔha eduonu esuon do no:
title: ESTHER

text: dɛ nda no mu no a ɔhen Ahasuerus tse n’ahendzi ahengua a ɔwɔ Susa ahemfie no do no,
title: ESTHER

text: wɔ n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia ebiasa mu no, ɔtoo pon maa n’asafohemfo nyinara na no nkowaa; Persia na Media etumfo, ekunyin na amansin no mu asafohemfo no, wɔ n’enyim:
title: ESTHER

text: Aber no na oyii n’enyimnyam ahendzi mu adzedodow na n’abɔso tumdzi mu enyidzi kyerɛe wɔ nda pii, mekyerɛ ndafua ɔha eduowɔtwe.
title: ESTHER

text: Na aber a nda yi soe no, nna ɔhen no too pon dze maa nkorɔfo a wohun hɔn wɔ Susa ahemfie no nyinara, akɛse na nkakraba nyina. Aponto no kɔr do nda esuon, wɔ ɔhen n’ahemfie ture no mu abangua no do.
title: ESTHER

text: Hɔ na asaaba ntwamu atam efufuw, na bibir sensɛnee a wɔdze ndwera fɛɛfɛw a ɔberdum ahoma esusuo mu akyekyer dwetɛ nkaba mu, ɔbo fufuw edum ho: sika na dwetɛ adamu egua nsisii na hoabo, abo amemen, na efufuw, na bufua, na etuntum abonsɛwee do.
title: ESTHER

text: Na wɔhyehyɛɛ hɔn nsa wɔ sika ndzɛmba no nkɔɔpow mu, na nkɔɔpow asorɔtow pii, nna ɔhen ne nsa no dɔɔ so dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no n’ayamuyie tse.
title: ESTHER

text: Na nsanom no wɔyɛɛ no dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no ahyehyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛr; wɔannhyɛ obiara: na dɛm na ɔhen no ahyɛ ne fie mpanyimfo no nyinara dɛ wɔnyɛ; wɔmma nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ obotum.
title: ESTHER

text: Ɔhembaa Vasti so too pon dze maa mbaa wɔ ahemfie a ɔyɛ ɔhen Ahasuerus dze no mu.
title: ESTHER

text: Da a otsia esuon no a ɔhen no n’akoma nyaa nsa ho enyigye no, ɔhyɛɛ Mehuman, Bizita, Harbona, Bigita, Abagta, Zetar, na Karkas, epiafo beesuon yi a wɔsom wɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus enyim no,
title: ESTHER

text: dɛ wɔnkɛfa ɔhembaa Vasti mbra ɔhen no enyim wɔ ber a ɔhyɛ ahendzi ho ahenkyɛw no, ma ɔmfa n’ahoɔfɛw mbɛkyerɛ aman na asafohemfo no, osiandɛ no ho yɛ fɛw.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhembaa Vasti poow dɛ ɔbɛba dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen no nam epiafo no do hyɛɛ no no: dɛm ntsi ɔhen no no bo fuuw dodoodow, na n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ no mu.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna ɔhen no bisaa mbarimba mbrahyɛfo a wɔwɔ nyimdzee wɔ mbra na atsɛmbu ho no faa iyi ho, (osiandɛ nna ɔhen no susu n’asɛm a ɔfa mbra ho kyerɛ hɔn a wonyim mbra na atsɛmbusɛm nyinara no.
title: ESTHER

text: Hɔn a nna wɔbɛn no wɔ hɔ nye Karsena, Seetar, Ad-matha, Tarsis, Meres, Marsena, na Memukan, Persia na Media mbapɔmba beesuon no a wɔbɛn ɔhen no na wokitsa dzibew wɔ ahendzi no mu no).
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no bisaa dɛ, Ebɛnadze na yendua mbra do mfa nyɛ ɔhembaa Vasti, osiandɛ oenndzi emi ɔhen Ahasuerus m’asɛm a medze somaa epiafo no kɛmaa no no do?
title: ESTHER

text: Na Memukan buae wɔ ɔhen na mbapɔmba no enyim, dɛ, Nnyɛ ɔhen nko na ɔhembaa Vasti ayɛ no bɔn, na mbom ɔafom mbapɔmba nyinara, na aman nyinara a wɔwɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’amansin nyinara mu no so.
title: ESTHER

text: Osiandɛ ɔhembaa yi ne ndzeyɛe yi bodu mbasiafo nyinara nkyɛn, na wobobu hɔn kunnom enyimtsia osiandɛ wɔbɛka dɛ, Ɔhen Ahasuerus mpo hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa ɔhembaa Vasti mbra n’enyim, naaso ɔammba.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ndɛ da yi Persia na Media mbasiafo a wɔwɔ dzibew a wɔatse ɔhembaa no ne ndzeyɛɛ no nka no bɛsese ɔhen ne mbapɔmba nyinara dɛmara. Nna enyimtsiabu na ebufuhyew dodow bɔsoɛr.
title: ESTHER

text: Sɛ ɔhen bɛpɛ a, ɔno ɔmma ahendzi mu mbrasɛm mfi no hɔ mpue, na wɔmma wɔnkyerɛw no wɔ Persiafo na Mediafo mbra no mu, amma wɔaanndan no, dɛ mma Vasti mmba ɔhen Ahasuerus n’enyim bio: na wɔmma ɔhen mfa n’ahembaa gyinabew no mma obi so a oye sen no.
title: ESTHER

text: Na sɛ ɔhen ne mbra a ɔbɛhyɛ no tahye n’ahendzi kɛse yi nyinara mu a, yernom nyinara bɛma hɔn kunnom enyidzi, akɛse na nkakraba nyina.
title: ESTHER

text: Na asɛm no yɛɛ ɔhen no na ne mbapɔmba no enyisɔ; na ɔhen no yɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Memukan n’asɛm no tse:
title: ESTHER

text: osiandɛ ɔsomae ma wɔdze nwoma kɔr ɔhen n’amansin nyinara mu, wɔdze kɔr ɔmansin biara mu dɛ mbrɛ ne kyerɛwee tse, na wɔdze kɔr ɔman biara mu dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kasaa tse, dɛ ɔbarimba biara ndzi nankasa ne fi do panyin.
title: ESTHER

text: Nsɛm yi ekyir no, aber a ɔhen Ahasuerus n’ebufuhyew ano dwee no, ɔkaa Vasti na dza ɔyɛe no, na mbra a wɔhyɛɛ tsiaa no no.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna ɔhen no nkowaa a wɔsom no no see dɛ, Wɔmma wɔnhwehwɛ mbaabun a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw mma ɔhen:
title: ESTHER

text: na wɔmma ɔhen nhyehyɛ ahwɛdofo wɔ ahendzi mu amansin nyinara mu ma wonhyiahyia mbaabun nkakraba a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw nyinara ma wɔmbra Susa ahemfie, mbaa fi no mu, mfa nhyɛ ɔhen ne pianyi Hegai a ɔhwɛ mbasiafo do no ne nsa: na wɔmma wɔmfa hɔn ahosiesie ndzɛmba mma hɔn:
title: ESTHER

text: na wɔmma ababaawa a ɔhen bɛpɛ no nyɛ ɔhembaa ndzi Vasti n’ananmu. Na ɔhen no enyisɔ sɔɔ asɛm no; na ɔyɛɛ no dɛm.
title: ESTHER

text: Afei Judanyi bi wɔ Susa ahemfie a ne dzin dze Modekai, Benjaminnyi bi a ofi Jair, Simei, na Kish ebusua mu,
title: ESTHER

text: wɔfaa no fi Jerusalɛm kaa ndɔmmumfo a wɔfaa hɔn kaa Judahen Jekonia a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar faa hɔn kɔree no ho.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔtsetsee no wɔfa ne babaa Hadasa, ɔno nye Ester: osiandɛ onnyi egya na ena so, na ababaawa no no bɔbea yɛ fɛw na n’enyim wɔ nyam; na aber a n’egya na ne na wowui no, nna Modekai faa no yɛɛ nankasa ne babaa.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔtsee ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm na n’ahyɛdze no, na wohyiahyiaa mbabaawa pii baa Susa ahemfie, bɛhyɛɛ Hegai nsa no, wɔfaa Ester so baa ɔhen no ne fie, dze no bɛhyɛɛ Hegai, mbaa weɔmfo no nsa.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ababaawa no sɔɔ n’enyi, na onyaa no hɔ ayamuyie; na ɔdze n’ahosiesie ndzɛmba, nye akyɛpɛn maa no ntsɛmara, na ɔdze mbabaawa beesuon a wɔfata dɛ wɔdze ma no, fi ɔhen ne fie maa no: na oyii ɔno na ne mbabaawa no kɔr mbaa fi no mu beebi mbrɛ oye dodow.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna Ester nnkyerɛɛ ne man na n’ebusuafo so: osiandɛ Modekai abra no dɛ mma ɔnnkyerɛ.
title: ESTHER

text: Na da biara Modekai kɛpasapasar mbaa fi no n’abangua no enyim, ama oeehu mbrɛ Ester n’apɔw mu tse, na dza wɔdze no bɛyɛ.
title: ESTHER

text: Afei odur ababaawa biara do dɛ ɔkɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus nkyɛn, dɛ mbrɛ mbaa mbra no tse no, abosoom duebien ekyir no na hɔn ahosiesie nda no soe, na wɔdze krɔbɔw dzi abosoom esia, na wɔdze nduhuam na ɔnye mbaa ahosiesie ndzɛmba so dzi abosoom esia so.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ababaawa no dze no dɛm ba ɔhen nkyɛn, biribiara a ɔhwehwɛ no wɔdze ma no ma ɔdze fi mbaa fi no mu kɔ ɔhen no fie.
title: ESTHER

text: Ewimbir no na ɔkɔ, na anapa no ɔsan kɔ mbaa fi no a otsia ebien no mu, wɔ ɔhen ne pianyi Saasgaz a ɔhwɛ nwewefo do no nsamu: na ɔnnkɔ ɔhen no nkyɛn bio; gyedɛ ɔhen no pɛ n’asɛm na wɔbɔ ne dzin frɛ no.
title: ESTHER

text: Afei aber a odur Ester, Modekai n’egya no nua Abihail ne babaa a ɔafa no ayɛ ne babaa no do dɛ ɔbɔkɔ ɔhen no nkyɛn no, oemmbisa hwee gyedɛ dza ɔhen pianyi Hegai, mbaa weɔmfo no hyɛe no. Na Ester nyaa enyimpa wɔ hɔn a wohun no nyinara enyi do.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna wɔfaa Ester kɔr ɔhen Ahasuerus nkyɛn wɔ n’ahemfie wɔ bosoom a otsia du no a ɔno nye bosoom Tebeth no mu, wɔ n’ahendzi mu afe a otsia esuon no mu.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no dɔɔ Ester seen mbaa no nyinara, na onyaa adom na enyimpa wɔ n’enyim seen mbaabun no nyinara; ma ɔdze ahendzi no abɔtsir no bɔɔ ne tsir, na ɔyɛɛ no ɔhembaa dzii Vasti n’ananmu.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna ɔhen no too pon kɛsenara maa ne mbapɔmba na no nkowaa nyinara, wɔ Ester ntsi; na ɔmaa amansin no ahomgye, na ɔkyekyɛɛ adze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔno ɔhen n’ayamuyie tse.
title: ESTHER

text: Na aber a wohyiahyiaa mbaabun no a otsia ebien no, nna Modekai tse ɔhen no kuropon no mu.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna Ester nnyae nnkyerɛɛ n’ebusuafo na ne man so: dɛ mbrɛ Modekai abra no no: osiandɛ Ester dzii Modekai ne mbrasɛm do, dɛ aber a ɔrenyɛn no no.
title: ESTHER

text: Nda no mu no, mber a Modekai tse ɔhen no kuropon no mu no, ɔhen n’epiafo no mu beenu, Bigtan na Teres a wofi hɔn a wɔhwɛ abowano no mu no, hɔn bo fuwii, na wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wobeyi ɔhen Ahasuerus efi hɔ.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Modekai tsee asɛm no, na ɔno na ɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhembaa Ester; na Ester dze Modekai ne dzin dze kɛkaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no.
title: ESTHER

text: Na aber a wɔhwehwɛɛ asɛm no mu, na wohun dɛ ɔtse dɛm no, wɔsɛɛn hɔn beenu nyinara wɔ dua do na wɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu wɔ ɔhen no enyim.
title: ESTHER

text: Iyinom ekyir no, ɔhen Ahasuerus yɛɛ Agagnyi Haman, Hamedata ba no otsitsir, na ɔmaa no do, na ɔkrɔɔn n’egua seen mbapɔmba a wɔka no ho nyinara.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna ɔhen no nkowaa a wɔtse ɔhen no kuropon no mu nyinara wɔbɔ hɔn mu adze, na wɔyɛ Haman enyidzi: osiandɛ dɛm na ɔhen no ahyɛ wɔ no ho. Na Modekai dze, ɔammbɔ no mu adze na ɔannyɛ no enyidzi so.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna ɔhen no nkowaa a wɔtse ɔhen no kuropon no mu no, see Modekai dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔwo eto ɔhen ne mbrasɛm yi?
title: ESTHER

text: Afei ɔbaa dɛ, aber a wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no daa daa na onntsie hɔn no, wɔkɛkaa kyerɛɛ Haman, dɛ wɔrohwɛ kyerɛ Modekai botum egyina n’asɛm do anaa: osiandɛ nna ɔaka akyerɛ hɔn dɛ ɔyɛ Jewnyi.
title: ESTHER

text: Na aber a Haman hun dɛ Modekai mmbɔ no mu adze, na eso ɔnnyɛ no enyidzi no, ebufuw hyɛɛ no ma.
title: ESTHER

text: Na obuu no adze kakrabaa dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ Modekai nko, osiandɛ ɔakyerɛ no Modekai ne man: dɛm ntsi Haman hwehwɛɛ dɛ ɔsɛɛ Judafo nyinara a wɔwɔ Ahasuerus n’ahenman nyinara mu, mekyerɛ Modekai ne nkorɔfo no.
title: ESTHER

text: Na bosoom a odzi kan a ɔno nye bosoom Nisan wɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’afe a otsia duebien no mu no, wɔtwee Pur, ɔnye dɛ, tonto, wɔ Haman enyim dabiara, dze hwehwɛ da na bosoom pɔtsee no, na bosoom a otsia duebien no a ɔno nye bosoom Adar no ne da a ɔtɔ do duebiasa do na tonto no sii.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Haman see ɔhen Ahasuerus dɛ, Ɔman bi wɔ hɔ a wɔabɔ apetse na wɔatsew hɔnho efi aman mu wɔ w’ahendzi n’amansin nyinara mu; na hɔn mbra yɛ soronko wɔ ɔman biara dze mu; nkyii so wonndzi ɔhen ne mbra do; dɛm ntsi onnye mma ɔhen dɛ ɔbɛma hɔn kwan.
title: ESTHER

text: Sɛ ɔhen bɛpɛ a, ɔmma wɔnkyerɛw ma wɔnsɛɛ hɔn: na mibeker dwetɛ talent mpemdu ahyɛ hɔn a wɔhwɛ ɔhen n’edwuma do no nsa, dɛ wɔmfa mbogu ɔhen n’adzekoradze no mu.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no yii ne mpɛtsea wɔ ne nsa, na ɔdze maa Agagnyi Haman, Hamedata ba no, Jewfo tamfo no.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no see Haman dɛ, Dwetɛ no wɔdze ama wo, ɔman no so, dɛ yɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ oye wɔ w’enyi do no ara.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna wɔfrɛfrɛɛ ɔhen n’akyerɛwfo no wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu, wɔ ne da a otsia duebiasa no mu, na wɔkyerɛɛw no dɛ mbrɛ Haman hyɛe no nyinara dze kɛmaa ɔhen n’amansin do ahwɛfo, na ambradofo a wɔhwɛ ɔmansin biara do, na ɔman biara mu mbapɔmba; ɔmansin biara dɛ mbrɛ ne kyerɛw tse, na ɔman biara, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kasaa tse; ɔhen Ahasuerus dzin mu na wɔdze kyerɛwee, na wɔdze ɔhen no ne mpɛtsea sɔɔw ano.
title: ESTHER

text: Na wɔdze nwoma no somasomae ma embirikatufo dze kɔr ɔhen n’amansin nyinara mu dɛ, wɔnsɛɛ, wonkuku, na wɔntɔr Jewfo nyinara, mberantsɛ na nkɔdaa nyina, mbofra nkakraba na mbaa so da kor mu, mekyerɛ bosoom a otsia duebien no a ɔno nye bosoom Adar no, ne da a otsia duebiasa no, na wɔmfom hɔn agyapadze mfa.
title: ESTHER

text: Kyerɛw no no nsusudo a wɔdze kɛhyɛɛ mbra no wɔ ɔmansin biara mu no, wɔdaa no edzi maa ɔman nyinara, dɛ wonsiesie hɔnho nsie da no.
title: ESTHER

text: Embirikatufo no nam ɔhen ne mbrasɛm do fiir edzi ntsɛmara na wɔhyɛɛ mbra no wɔ Susa ahemfie; na ɔhen no na Haman tsenaa ase dɛ wɔrobɔnom nsa; nna Susa kurow no mu dze ayɛ basabasa.
title: ESTHER

text: Afei aber a Modekai hun dza aba nyinara no, nna ɔtsetseew ne ntar mu, na ɔdze eyitam nye nso kataa noho, na ofiir edzi kɔr kurow no ne finimfin, na ɔdze nkekamu dzendzen a ɔyɛ wen sui:
title: ESTHER

text: na ɔkɔr ɔhen no no kuropon no enyim mpo: osiandɛ obiara nnyi ho kwan dɛ ofura eyitam dze hɛn ɔhen no no kuropon mu.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔmansin biara mu beebiara mbrɛ ɔhen ne mbrasɛm no durii no, nkɔmbɔdzi kɛse baa hɔ wɔ Jewfo no mu, na mbuadadzi, na osu, na osukwadwom, na dodowara dedaa eyitam na nso mu.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Ester ne mbabaawa na ne mpiafo no bae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ no; na ɔhembaa no no werɛ hoow mbordo: na ɔsomaa dɛ wɔmfa atar nkɛhyɛ Modekai, na wonyi eyitam wɔ no ho: naaso ɔanngye.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna Ester kɛfrɛɛ Hatihak, ɔhen n’epiafo no mu baako a woeyi no dɛ ɔnhwɛ no no, na ɔsomaa no dɛ ɔnkɔ Modekai nkyɛn.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna Hatihak fiir edzi kɔr Modekai nkyɛn wɔ kurow no ne bea tɛtɛr no a ɔwɔ ɔhen no kuropon enyim no do.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Modekai kaa dza aba no do nyinara kyerɛɛ no, na sika dodow a Haman abɔ anohoba dɛ osian Jewfo ntsi obeker egu ɔhen n’akoradze mu, ma wɔaasɛɛ hɔn no.
title: ESTHER

text: Eso ɔdze mbra no a wɔhyɛɛ no wɔ Susa dɛ wɔnsɛɛ hɔn no ne kyerɛw saso maa no, dɛ ɔmfa nkyerɛ Ester na ɔnka nkyerɛ no; na ɔnhyɛ no dɛ ɔnkɔ ɔhen nkyɛn, nkɔtotɔ nserɛ no na ombisa adze wɔ n’enyim mma ne man.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Hatihak bae bɛkaa Modekai ne nsɛm no kyerɛɛ Ester.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna Ester kasaa kyerɛɛ Hatihak, na ɔmaa no nkra wɔ Modekai nkyɛn, dɛ;
title: ESTHER

text: Ɔhen no nkowaa nyinara, na ɔhen n’amansin mu nkorɔfo nyinara, nyim dɛ obiara, ɔbarimba o, ɔbaa o, ɔbɛba ɔhen nkyɛn wɔ fie afamu abanguado a wɔammfrɛ no no, mbra kor pɛr na ɔwɔ hɔ ma no, dɛ wonku no, gyedɛ nyia ɔhen bɛtsen sika ahempoma akyerɛ no dɛ ɔntsena ase no: na wɔmmfrɛɛ me dɛ monkɔ ɔhen nkyɛn adaduasa yi.
title: ESTHER

text: Na wɔkɛkaa Ester ne nsɛm no dze kyerɛɛ Modekai.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna Modekai hyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔmfa mbuae nsan nkɛma Ester dɛ, Mma nsusu wo tsirmu dɛ ɔwo befi mu efi wɔ ahemfie, asen Jewfo no nyinara.
title: ESTHER

text: Na sɛ ɔwo imua w’ano koraa wɔ aber yi mu a, ɔnodze mboa na ɔgye bɔsoɛr efi beebi fofor so ama Jewfo, na ɔwo na w’egya fi dze wɔbɛsɛɛ: na woana na onyim dɛ aber a ɔtse dɛm yi ntsi na wo nsa aka ahendzi no?
title: ESTHER

text: Nna Ester kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ wonkobua Modekai dɛ,
title: ESTHER

text: Kɔ, kɔpon Jewfo a wohu hɔn wɔ Susa nyinara hyia, na hom ndzi mbuada wɔ me ntsi, na mma hom nndzidzi na wɔnnom so ndaansa, adzesaa na adzekyee: emi so na me mbabaawa so bedzi mbuada dɛmara; na medze no dɛm akɔ ɔhen nkyɛn a ɔnnam mbra kwan do: na sɛ muwu a, nna mewu.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna Modekai sii mu kɔr no kwan, na ɔkɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Ester hyɛɛ no no nyinara.
title: ESTHER

text: Afei ɔbaa dɛ da a otsia ebiasa no, nna Ester hyɛɛ ahembaa ntar, na okegyinaa ahemfie fie afamu abanguado, wɔ ɔhen ne dan no ne tsentsendo.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a ɔhen no hun ɔhembaa Ester dɛ ogyina abangua no do no, nna onyaa n’enyim enyimnyam: na ɔhen no tseen sika ahempoma a ɔdze ne nsamu no kyerɛɛ Ester. Nna Ester twee pinii, na obosuoo ahempoma no ne tsir.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no bisaa no dɛ, Ɔhembaa Ester, erohwehwɛ ebɛnadze? W’ebisadze nye dɛn? Na sɛ odu ahendzi no ne fa mpo a, wɔdze bɛma wo.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Ester see dɛ, Sɛ oye wɔ ɔhen enyi do a, wɔmma ɔhen na Haman mbra pon a moroto ama no ho ndɛ da yi.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Hom mma Haman mbra ntsɛm, na wɔnyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ Ester aka no. Nna ɔhen no na Haman baa pon a Ester ato no ho.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no see Ester wɔ nsa aponto no ho dɛ, W’adzeserɛ nye dɛn? Na wɔmfa mma wo: na w’ahwehwɛdze nye dɛn? Odu ahendzi no ne fa mpo a, wɔbɛyɛ.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna Ester buae see dɛ, M’adzeserɛ na m’ahwehwɛdze nye dɛ;
title: ESTHER

text: sɛ menya ɔhen enyim enyimpa, na sɛ ɔhen pɛ dɛ ɔbɛma m’adzeserɛ, na ɔayɛ m’ahwehwɛdze a, wɔmma ɔhen na Haman mbra pon a morobɔto hɔn no ho, na ɔkyena mebɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen ase no.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna da no Haman dze enyigye na akoma pa fiir edzi: na aber a Haman hun Modekai wɔ ɔhen no kuropon no mu, dɛ ɔannsoɛr enngyina, na eso oennhima noho amma no no, nna ebufuw hyɛɛ no ma wɔ Modekai ho.
title: ESTHER

text: Naaso Haman konkoom noho do, na osii mu kɔr ne fie, na ɔsomae ma wɔkɛfrɛfrɛɛ ne mfɛfo na ne yer Zeres ma wɔbae.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Haman kaa n’ahonya enyimnyam, na ne mba dodow, na ndzɛmba nyinara a ɔhen no ayɛ no kɛse wɔ mu, na mbrɛ oesi na ɔama no do abɔ mbapɔmba na ɔhen no nkowaa no do no, kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: ESTHER

text: Nkyii so Haman see dɛ, Nyew, ɔhembaa Ester ɔamma nyimpa biara annka ɔhen ho ammba pon a ɔtoe no ho gyedɛ mara; na ɔkyena so oehyia emi na ɔhen wɔ ne nkyɛn.
title: ESTHER

text: Naaso iyi nyinara nndɔɔ so mma me, aber tsentsen ara a muhu Jewnyi Modekai no dɛ ɔtse ɔhen no kuropon mu yi.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna ne yer Zeres na ne mfɛfo no nyinara see no dɛ, Ma yɛnyɛ mbeamudua a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu enum, na ɔkyena anapa ka kyerɛ ɔhen ma wɔnsɛn Modekai wɔ do: na nkyii ɔwo nye ɔhen nkɔ aponto no ho enyigye mu. Na asɛm no yɛɛ Haman enyisɔ; na ɔmaa wɔyɛɛ dua no.
title: ESTHER

text: Anago no ɔhen no ne nda fii no do, na ɔhyeɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mbermunsɛm nkaanwoma no mbra, na wɔkenkaan no wɔ ɔhen no enyim.
title: ESTHER

text: Na wohun dɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ Mordecai na ɔbɛkãa Bigthana na Teresh, ɔhen n’epiafo beenu no a wofi hɔn a wɔhwɛ abowano no mu no a wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔdze nsa to ɔhen Ahasuerus do no, ho asɛm no.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no see dɛ ebɛn enyidzi na kɛseyɛ na wɔdze ayɛ Mordecai wɔ iyi ho? Nna ɔhen no nkowaa a wɔsom no no see dɛ, wɔnnyɛ hwee mma no.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Woana na ɔwɔ abangua no do? Afei na Haman aba ɔhen ne fie no ekyir abangua no do, dɛ ɔrebɛkã akyerɛ ɔhen ma wɔaasɛn Mordecai wɔ asɛndua no a oesi ama no no do.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no nkowaa no see no dɛ, hwɛ, Haman gyina abangua no do. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, wɔmma ɔmbra dan mu.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna Haman baa dan mu. Na ɔhen no see no dɛ, ebɛnadze na wɔmfa nyɛ nyimpa a ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no? Afei Haman see wɔ n’akoma mu dɛ, woana mpo na ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi sen mara?
title: ESTHER

text: Na Haman see ɔhen no dɛ, nyimpa a ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no,
title: ESTHER

text: ma wɔmfa ahentar a ɔhen tɔ dɛ ɔhyɛ no mbra, na ɔpɔnkɔ a ɔhen tɔ dɛ ɔtsena do no a wɔdze ahendzi abɔtsir abɔ ne tsir no,
title: ESTHER

text: na ma wɔmfa a tar na ɔpɔnkɔ no nhyɛ ɔhen ne mbapɔmba ekunyin no mu baako ne nsa, ma wɔmfa nhyɛ nyimpa a ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no, na wɔmma ɔntsena ɔpɔnkɔ no do mfa kurow no n’abɔntsen do, na wɔmpaa ndzi n’enyim dɛ, mbrɛ wɔdze bɛyɛ nyimpa a ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no, nye yi oo.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna ɔhen no see Haman dɛ, ka woho kɛfa atar na ɔpɔnkɔ no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwoara ase no, na yɛ dɛmara ma Jewnyi Mordecai no a ɔtse ɔhen no kuropon mu no: Mma mma nngyaa dza akã no nyinara mu biara.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna Haman faa atar no na ɔpɔnkɔ no, na ɔdze hyehyɛɛ Mordecai, na ɔmaa ɔtsenaa ɔpɔnkɔ do dze faa kurow no n’abɔntsen do, na wɔpaae dzii n’enyim dɛ, mbrɛ wɔdze bɛyɛ nyia ɔhen pɛ dɛ odzi no nyi no nye yi oo.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Mordecai sanee baa ɔhen no kuropon no mu bio. Na Haman dze, ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm dze nkɔmbodzi na ne tsir do a wɔakata, kɔr ne fie.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Haman kãa dza aba no do no nyinara kyerɛɛ ne yer Zeresh na ne mfɛfo no nyinara. Nna n'enyansafo no na ne yer Zeresh see no dɛ, sɛ Mordecai a ɔwo ahyɛ ase rohwe famu wɔ n’enyim yi, ofi Jewfo asefo mu a, ɔno irunntum nndzi no do nyim, mbom ase ara na ebɔhwe wɔ n’enyim.
title: ESTHER

text: Aber a wɔnye no da do rekasa no, nna ɔhen n’epiafo no bae, na wɔpɛɛ ntsɛm dɛ wɔdze Haman bɔkɔ pon no a Esther ato no ho.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no na Haman baa dɛ wɔnye Ɔhembaa Ester robɔto pon.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no see Ester da a otsia ebien no mu so, wɔ nsa aponto no ho dɛ, Ɔhembaa Ester, w’adzeserɛ nye dɛn? Na wɔmfa mma wo: na w’ahwehwɛdze nye dɛn? Odu ahendzi yi ne fa mpo a, wɔbɛyɛ.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna ɔhembaa Ester buae see dɛ, Ɔhen, sɛ menya w’enyim enyimpa, na sɛ ɔhen pɛ a, ma wɔmfa mo nkwa mma me wɔ adzeserɛ yi do, na me man wɔ adzeserɛ yi do:
title: ESTHER

text: na wɔatɔn hɛn, emi na me man, dɛ wɔnsɛɛ hɛn, nkuku hɛn. Na sɛ wɔtontɔɔn hɛn yɛɛ nkowaa na mfonabaa a, nkyɛ mennkɛkasa, naaso ɔtamfo no runntum nnhyɛ ɔhen n’adze a ɔbɛsɛɛ no ananmu.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna ɔhen Ahasuerus buae see ɔhembaa Ester dɛ, Woana nye no, na hen na ɔwɔ, na n’akoma ara ahyɛ no mu ma dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛm no?
title: ESTHER

text: Na Ester see dɛ, Ɔyɛfo na ɔtamfo bi a, mekyerɛ Haman otsiɔdzennyi yi a. Nna Haman n’akoma tui wɔ ɔhen no na ɔhembaa no enyim.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no soɛree wɔ n’ebufuw no mu fii nsa aponto no ho, na osii mu kɔr ahemfi ture no mu; na Haman soɛree gyinaa dɛ ɔrepa no nkwa ho kyɛw wɔ ɔhembaa Ester hɔ, osiandɛ ohun dɛ ɔhen no abɔ no ho pɔw bɔn.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna ɔhen no sanee fii ahemfie ture no mu baa beebi mbrɛ nsa pon no wɔ no; nna Haman ahwe adamu egua a Ester wɔ do no do. Nna ɔhen no see dɛ, Ana mpo orubotu ahyɛ ɔhembaa do so wɔ m’enyim wɔ ofi yi mu? Aber a asɛm no fii ɔhen no n’anomu puei ara, nna wɔkataa Haman n’enyim.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna Harbona, epiafo a wɔwɔ ɔhen no n’enyim no mu baako no, see dɛ, Eso hwɛ, dua a Haman ayɛ ama Modekai a ɔkaa ɔhen no ho asɛmpa no, osi Haman fie, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu enum. Na ɔhen no see dɛ, Hom nkɛsɛn no wɔ do.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna wɔsɛɛn Haman wɔ dua a oesiesie ama Modekai no do. Nna ɔhen no n’ebufuw ano dwee.
title: ESTHER

text: Da no ara na ɔhen Ahasuerus dze Haman, Jewfo tamfo no, ne fie maa ɔhembaa Ester. Na Modekai baa ɔhen no n’enyim; osiandɛ Ester aka mbrɛ ɔnye ne ntamu tse.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no worɔɔw ne mpɛtsea a ɔgyee no Haman nsamu no, na ɔdze maa Modekai. Na Ester dze Haman ne fie no hyɛɛ Modekai nsa.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Ester kasae wɔ ɔhen no n’enyim, na otwae hwee n’ananadze, na ɔdze nyinsuwa totɔe serɛɛ no dɛ onyi Agagnyi Haman no mbusu na ne tsirmpɔw a ɔbɔɔ no wɔ Jewfo no ho no.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna ɔhen no tseen sika ahempoma no kyerɛɛ Ester. Nna Ester soɛree, na ogyinaa ɔhen no enyim.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ ɔhen pɛ, na sɛ menya n’enyim enyimpa, na asɛm no tsen wɔ ɔhen enyim, na mo so miye wɔ n’enyiwa do a, ɔno ma wɔnkyerɛw nkɛsan nwoma no a Agagnyi Haman, Hamedata ba no, bɔɔ no pɔw a ɔkyerɛɛw dɛ ɔdze rekɛsɛɛ Jewfo a wɔwɔ ɔhen n’amansin no nyinara mu no;
title: ESTHER

text: na mebɛyɛ dɛn na metum atsena hɔ mahwɛ mbusu a ɔbɛba me man do? Na mebɛyɛ dɛn na metum atsena hɔ ahwɛ m’ebusuafo hɔn nsɛɛe?
title: ESTHER

text: Nna ɔhen Ahasuerus see ɔhembaa Ester na Jewnyi Modekai no dɛ, Hwɛ medze Haman fi ama Ester na ɔnoara so wɔasɛn no wɔ dua no do, ɔnam dɛ ɔdze ne nsa too Jewfo no do ntsi.
title: ESTHER

text: Hom so nkyerɛw nkɛma Jewfo no, dɛ mbrɛ homara wɔpɛ, wɔ ɔhen no ne dzin mu, na wɔmfa ɔhen no ne mpɛtsea no nsɔw ano: osiandɛ kyerɛw a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ ɔhen ne dzin mu, na wɔdze ɔhen ne mpɛtsea asɔw ano no, nyimpa biara nndan no.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna wɔfrɛfrɛɛ ɔhen n’akyerɛwfo no aber no mu, bosoom a otsia ebiasa no a, ɔno nye bosoom Sivan no, ne da a otsia eduonu ebiasa no mu: na wɔkyerɛɛw no dɛ mbrɛ Modekai hyɛe no nyinara dze kɛmaa Jewfo no, na amansin do ahwɛfo na ambradofo na amansin mu mbapɔmba no a wɔwɔ India dze kodu Etiopia, amansin ɔha eduonu esuon, ɔmansin biara dɛ mbrɛ ne nkyerɛwee tse, na ɔman biara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kasaa tse, na Jewfo no so dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nkyerɛwee na hɔn kasaa tse.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔdze ɔhen Ahasuerus ne dzin na ɔdze kyerɛwee na ɔdze ɔhen no ne mpɛtsea sɔɔw ano, na ɔdze nwoma no somasomaa embirikatufo a wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do, na wɔtsetse nsoasopɔnkɔ a hɔn ho yɛ har a wɔdze hɔn yɛ ɔhen n’edwuma no a wɔanyɛn hɔn mpɔnkɔban mu do:
title: ESTHER

text: no mu na ɔhen no maa Jewfo a wɔwɔ kurow biara mu kwan dɛ wɔmpon hɔnho nhyia, na hɔn nkwa ntsi wongyina hɔ, na wɔnsɛɛ, wonkuku, na wɔmbɔ ɔman na ɔmansin a wobehiahia hɔn ho no, hɔn tum nyinara ngu, hɔn mbofraba na mbaa, wɔmfom hɔn ndzɛmba mfa,
title: ESTHER

text: da kor mu wɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’amansin nyinara mu, ɔnye dɛ, wɔ bosoom a otsia duebien no a ɔno nye bosoom Adar no, ne da a otsia duebiasa no mu.
title: ESTHER

text: Nkyerɛwee no no nsusudo a wɔdze kɛhyɛɛ mbra no wɔ ɔmansin biara mu no, wɔdaa no edzi maa aman nyinara, dɛ Jewfo no nsiesie hɔnho nsie da no ma woeedzi hɔn atamfo wer.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna embirikatufo a wɔtsetse asoaso mpɔnkɔ a hɔn ho yɛ har a wɔdze hɔn yɛ ɔhen n’edwuma no do no, wɔnam ɔhen ne mbrasɛm do sii mu kɔree; na mbra no wɔhyɛɛ no wɔ Susa ahemfie.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Modekai fiir edzi fii ɔhen no enyim dɛ ɔhyɛ ahentar bibir na fufuw, na ɔnye sika ahenkyɛw kɛse, na ɔnye ndwera fɛɛfɛw na ɔberdum bataker: na Susa kurow no dzii ehurusi na hɔn enyi gyee.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Jewfo no nyaa kan na enyigye, na ahosɛpɛw na enyidzi.
title: ESTHER

text: Na kurow biara mu, beebiara mbrɛ ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm na no mbra no durii no, Jewfo no nyaa enyigye na ahosɛpɛw, aponto na da pa dzi. Na asaase no do aman no mu nyimpa dodowara bɛyɛɛ Jewfo; osiandɛ Jewfo no ho suro aka hɔn.
title: ESTHER

text: Afei bosoom a otsia duebien no a ɔno nye bosoom Adar no, ɔnoara mu da a otsia duebiasa no a ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm na n’ahyɛdze no dur dɛ wodzii do no, da no ara na Jewfo hɔn atamfo no enyi daa kwan dɛ wobedzi hɔn do tum; naaso ɔdaan dɛ Jewfo no mbom na wonyaa hɔn a wɔtaan hɔn no do tum.
title: ESTHER

text: Jewfo poon hɔnho hyiaa hɔn nkurow mu, wɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’amansin nyinara mu, dɛ wɔrosoɛr etsia hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ hɔn nsɛɛe no do: na nyimpa biara enntum ennsiw hɔn kwan; osiandɛ hɔn ho suro aka ɔman no nyinara.
title: ESTHER

text: Na amansin no mu mbapɔmba, na amansin do ahwɛfo, na ambradofo, na hɔn a wɔyɛ ɔhen n’edwuma no nyinara, boaa Jewfo no; osiandɛ Modekai ho suro aka hɔn.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Modekai yɛɛ nyimpa tsitsir wɔ ɔhen no ne fie, na ne nka tahyee amansin no nyinara mu: na ɔbarimba Modekai no kɔr do araa krɔnee.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Jewfo no dze afona ano, na oku na ɔsɛɛ dze kaa hɔn atamfo nyinara gya, na wɔyɛɛ hɔn a wɔtan hɔn no dza wɔpɛ.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Susa ahemfie mu no Jewfo no kumii na wɔsɛɛ mbarimba ahaenum.
title: ESTHER

text: Wokunkum Parsandata, Dalfon, Aspatha,
title: ESTHER

text: Porata, Adalia, Aridatha,
title: ESTHER

text: Parmasta, Arisai, Aridai, na Vaizata;
title: ESTHER

text: a wɔyɛ Jewfo tamfo Hamedata ne ba Haman ne mbambanyin du no so, naaso asadze no dze wɔammfa hɔn nsa annka.
title: ESTHER

text: Da no ara hɔn a wokunkum hɔn wɔ Susa ahemfie mu no dodow no wɔdze bɔtoo ɔhen no enyim.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no see ɔhembaa Ester dɛ, Jewfo no woekuku na wɔasɛɛ mbarimba ahaenu wɔ Susa ahemfi no mu, na Haman ne mbabanyin du; na ebɛnadze so na wɔayɛ no wɔ ɔhen no n’amansin nkaa no mu? Afei w’adzeserɛ nye dɛn? Na wɔmfa mma wo.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna Ester see dɛ, Sɛ ɔhen pɛ a, ɔmma wɔmma Jewfo a wɔwɔ Susa no kwan ma ɔkyena so wɔnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ndɛ da yi mbra no tse, na ma wɔnsensɛn Haman mbabanyin du no wɔ dua do.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ dɛ wɔnyɛ no dɛm: na wɔhyɛɛ mbra wɔ Susa; na wɔsensɛn Haman ne mbabanyin du no.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Jewfo a wɔwɔ Susa no poon hɔnho hyiae wɔ bosoom Adar ne da a otsia duanan no mu so, na wokunkum mbarimba ahaasa wɔ Susa: naaso asadze no dze, wɔammfa hɔn nsa annka.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Jewfo nkaa no a wɔwɔ ɔhen no n’amansin mu no so poon hɔnho hyiae, na hɔn nkwa ntsi wogyinae, na wodzii hɔn atamfo do, na wokunkum hɔn a wokyiir hɔn no mu nyimpa mpemeduosuon enum; naaso asadze no dze, wɔammfa hɔn nsa annka.
title: ESTHER

text: Iyi wɔyɛɛ no wɔ bosoom Adar ne da a otsia duebiasa no mu, na ɔnoara ne da a otsia duanan no mu, na wɔgyee hɔn ahom, na wɔyɛɛ no aponto na enyigye da.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Jewfo a wɔwɔ Susa no boaa ano hyiae wɔ ne da a otsia duebiasa no, na ne da a otsia duanan no; na da a otsia duenum no na wɔgyee hɔn ahom, na wɔyɛɛ no aponto na enyigye da.
title: ESTHER

text: Dɛm ntsi na Jewfo a wɔwɔ nkurobaase no a wɔtsetse nkuroba a wɔammbɔ ho ban no mu no, wɔyɛɛ bosoom Adar ne da a otsia duanan no enyigye na aponto da, na da pa, na da a wɔdze adze kyekyɛ hɔnho nkorkor.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Modekai kyerɛɛw nsɛm yi, na ɔsomasomae ma wɔdze nwoma kɛmemaa Jewfo nyinara a wɔwɔ ɔhen Ahasuerus n’amansin nyinara mu no, hɔn a wɔbɛn na hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir nyina,
title: ESTHER

text: dɛ ɔdze rehyɛ hɔn dɛ wondzi bosoom Adar ne da a otsia duanan na ɔnoara ne da a otsia duenum no, afrenhyia afrenhyia,
title: ESTHER

text: dɛ nda a Jewfo nyaa mu ahomgye wɔ hɔn atamfo nsamu, na bosoom a wɔdanee fii awerɛhow mu kɔr enyigye mu, na ofi nkɔmbɔdzi mu kɔr da pa mu maa hɔn no: dɛ wɔmfa nyɛ aponto na enyigye nda, na wɔnkyekyɛ hɔnho adze na wɔnkyɛ ehiafo so adze.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Jewfo no suoo mu dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ Modekai akyerɛw akɛma hɔn no;
title: ESTHER

text: osiandɛ Agagnyi Haman, Hamedata ba no, Jewfo no nyinara tamfo no, bɔɔ Jewfo no ho pɔw dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn, na ɔtwee Pur, ɔnye dɛ, tonto, dɛ ɔbɛhyew hɔn, na ɔasɛɛ hɔn;
title: ESTHER

text: na aber a asɛm no dur ɔhen no enyim no, nna ɔnam nwoma do hyɛɛ dɛ no pɔw bɔn a ɔbɔɔ no wɔ Jewfo no ho no ɔnsan mbobua nankasa n’etsifi; na dɛ wɔnsɛn ɔno na ne mba wɔ dua do no.
title: ESTHER

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔfrɛɛ nda yi Purim dɛ mbrɛ Pur dzin no tse no. Na osian nwoma yi mu nsɛm no nyinara, na dza wohun no wɔ asɛm yi mu, na dza aba hɔn do no ntsi,
title: ESTHER

text: Jewfo no hyehyɛe, na wɔgyee too hɔn do, na hɔn asefo do, na hɔn a wɔdze hɔnho kɔbɔɔ hɔn ho no nyinara do, dɛ orunntwa mu, dɛ wobedzi nda ebien yi dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kyerɛw, na hɔn mber a wɔahyɛ no tse, afrenhyia biara mu;
title: ESTHER

text: na dɛ wɔnkaa nda yi, na wondzi no wɔ mbasantsen biara, ebusua biara, ɔmansin biara, na kurow biara mu, na dɛ Purim nda yi mma ɔmmpa wɔ Jewfo no mu, na ne nkaa so mmbɔ adze wɔ hɔn asefo mu.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna ɔhembaa Ester, Abihail ne babaa no, na Jewnyi Modekai, wɔdze tum nyinara kyerɛwee dɛ wɔdze Purim nwoma a otsia ebien yi etsim.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔsomae ma wɔdze nwoma kɛmemaa Jewfo nyinara, dze kɔr Ahasuerus n’ahendzi amansin ɔha eduonu esuon no mu, wɔdze asomdwee na nokwardzi nsɛm,
title: ESTHER

text: dɛ wɔdze rema Purim nda yi etsim wɔ ne mber a wɔahyehyɛ no mu, dɛ mbrɛ Jewnyi Modekai na ɔhembaa Ester ama etsim hɔn mu no, na dɛ mbrɛ wɔama mbuadadzi na hɔn sufrɛ ho asɛm no mu, ama hɔnho na hɔn asefo no.
title: ESTHER

text: Na Ester ne mbrasɛm no maa Purim nsɛm yi tsimii; na wɔkyerɛɛw no wɔ nwoma no mu.
title: ESTHER

text: Na ɔhen Ahasuerus dze asaasetow too asaase no na po mu nsupɔw no do.
title: ESTHER

text: Na no tum na ne mbanyindze ho asɛm nyinara, na Modekai n’akɛseyɛ a ɔhen no maa ɔyɛe no no ho asɛm no, ana wɔnnkyerɛɛw no wɔ Media na Persia ahemfo hɔn Mbermunsɛm nwoma no mu?
title: ESTHER

text: Osiandɛ Jewnyi Modekai no nye nyia otsia ebien a odzi ɔhen Ahasuerus n’ekyir, na ɔyɛ nyimpa kɛse wɔ Jewfo mu, na no nuanom nyimpadodow no penee no; ɔhwehwɛɛ ne man ne yieyɛ, na ɔkaa asomdwee nsɛm kyerɛɛ n’asefo nyinara.
title: ESTHER

text: Nna banyin bi wɔ Uz asaase do a ne dzin dze Job; nna odzi mu yie na ɔtsen, nyimpa a osuro Nyankopɔn na okyir bɔn a.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔwoo mbabanyin beesuon na mbabaa baasa.
title: JOB

text: N’ahodze so yɛ nguan mpemesuon na efumpɔnkɔ mpemebiasa, na anantwi mpamho ahaenum, na nsoasopɔnkɔber ahaenum, na asomfo piinara; ma dɛm ntsi nna banyin yi yɛ otsitsir wɔ boka mba no nyinara mu.
title: JOB

text: Nna ɔtɔ dɛ ne mbabanyin no kɔ kɔto pon wɔ ɔbaako biara ne fie wɔ ne kra da mu; na wɔsoma ma wɔkɛfrɛfrɛ hɔn nkyerɛbaa baasa no ma wɔba dɛ wɔnye hɔn mbedzidzi na wɔnnom.
title: JOB

text: Na aber biara sɛ hɔn aponto nda no kɔ aprɔw wie a, nna Job asoma ma wɔakɛtsew hɔnho. Ɔsoɛr ahanamakye, na ɔkɔbɔ hyew afɔr dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nyinara hɔn dodow tse: osiandɛ Job see dɛ, Bi annyɛ a me mba no ayɛ bɔn, na wɔapow Nyankopɔn wɔ hɔn akoma mu. Dɛm na Job yɛɛ no daa.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ da bi sor dɔm no bae begyinaa EWURADZE enyim, na Satan so dzi hɔn mu bae.
title: JOB

text: Na EWURADZE bisaa Satan dɛ, Ehen na ifi reba yi? Nna Satan buaa EWURADZE dɛ, Mifi asaase do akɔnaabadzi na no do apasapasar mu na mereba.
title: JOB

text: Na EWURADZE see Satan dɛ, Ana ihun m’akowaa Job a? Obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔno wɔ asaase no do, ɔbanyin a odzi mu na ɔtsen, obi a osuro Nyankopɔn na okyir bɔn a.
title: JOB

text: Nna Satan buaa EWURADZE dɛ, Aso gyan ara na Job suro Nyankopɔn a?
title: JOB

text: Ana nnyɛ ɔwoara na abɔ ɔno, na ne fi, na dza ɔwɔ nyinara ho ban ehyia bi a? Ɔwo ehyira ne nsaano edwuma do, na n’ahodze adɔɔ so wɔ asaase no do.
title: JOB

text: Na afei ɔwo dze, tsen wo nsa ka dza ɔwɔ nyinara ɛ, na hwɛ, sɛ ɔnnkɔdom wo ntsɛmara a.
title: JOB

text: Na EWURADZE see Satan dɛ, Hwɛ, dza ɔwɔ nyinara wɔ wo nsamu; ɔno noara nko no do na mma mmfa wo nsa nnto. Nna Satan fii EWURADZE enyim kɔree.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ da bi aber a ne mbabanyin no na ne mbabaa no woridzidzi na wɔronom nsa wɔ hɔn nua panyin no ne fie no,
title: JOB

text: ɔbɔfo bi baa Job nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, nna Anantwi no rufuntum, na nsoasopɔnkɔ no so ridzidzi wɔ hɔn nkyɛn:
title: JOB

text: na Sabeafo ebotu ahyɛ hɔn do, na wɔafa hɔn kɔ; nyew, wɔdze afona ekuku mberantsɛ no; na emi mara nkotsee korɛ na mefi nsa dɛ merebɛka akyerɛ wo.
title: JOB

text: Aber a n’ano da do rekasa no, nna fofor so bae, na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn ne gya fi sor atɔ, na ɔabɛhyew nguan no, na mberantsɛ no, na ɔamen hɔn; na emi mara nkotsee korɛ na mefi nsa dɛ merebɛka akyerɛ wo.
title: JOB

text: Aber a ɔno so n’ano da do rekasa no, nna fofor so bae, bɛsee dɛ, Kaldeafo abɔ kuw ebiasa, na woebotu ahyɛ efumpɔnkɔ no do, na wɔafa hɔn kɔ, nyew, wɔdze afona ekuku mberantsɛ no; na emi ara nkotsee korɛ na mefi nsa dɛ merebɛka akyerɛ wo.
title: JOB

text: Aber a n’ano da do rekasa no, nna fofor so bae bɛsee dɛ, Nna wo mbabanyin na wo mbabaa no woridzidzi na wɔronom nsa wɔ hɔn nua panyin no ne fie:
title: JOB

text: na, hwɛ, mframa kɛse fi sar no do aba abɔbɔ dan no n’etwaanan no, ma ebu egu hɔn do, ma woewuwu; na emi nkotsee korɛ na mefi nsa, dɛ merebɛka akyerɛ wo.
title: JOB

text: Nna Job soɛree, na ɔtsetseew n’atar mu, oyii ne tsir, na otwae hwee famu, na ɔsɔɔr EWURADZE:
title: JOB

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Adagyaw na medze fi me na yamu bae, na adagyaw na medze bɛsan akɔ: EWURADZE dze mae, na EWURADZE afa kɔ: nhyira nka EWURADZE ne dzin.
title: JOB

text: Na iyi nyinara mu no Job annyɛ bɔn dɛ ɔbɔbɔ Nyankopɔn sombo.
title: JOB

text: Na da bi baa bio a sor dɔm no bae dɛ woribegyina EWURADZE enyim, na Satan so dzi hɔn mu bae dɛ ɔrebɛda noho edzi wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: JOB

text: Na EWURADZE bisaa Satan dɛ, Ehen na ifi reba yi? Na Satan buaa EWURADZE, na ɔsee dɛ, Mifi asaase akɔnaabadzi, na no do apasapasar mu na mereba.
title: JOB

text: Na EWURADZE see Satan dɛ, Ana ihun m’akowaa Job a? Obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔno wɔ asaase no do, nyimpa a odzi mu na ɔtsen, obi a osuro Nyankopɔn, na okyir bɔn a: na ɔda ho ara dze n’emudzi no mu, kaansa ɔwo Satan enunu me etsia no dɛ mensɛɛ no kwa mpo a.
title: JOB

text: Na Satan buaa EWURADZE, na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔdze wer per wer, nyew, dza nyimpa wɔ nyinara ogyaa mu dze per no nkwa.
title: JOB

text: Na afei tsen wo nsa, na ka ne biew na no honam hwɛ ɛ, sɛ ɔnnkɔdom wo ntsɛmara a.
title: JOB

text: Na EWURADZE see Satan dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔwɔ wo nsamu; ne nkwa nko na gyaa no.
title: JOB

text: Nna Satan fii EWURADZE enyim kɔree, na ɔdze mpɔmpɔ yayaayaw kɔbobɔɔ Job fi n’ananadze kodu n’etsifi pampamu.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔfaa tankofɛr bi dɛ ɔdze rotwerɛw noho; nna ɔtse nso mu.
title: JOB

text: Nna ne yer see no dɛ, Ana eda ho dze w’emudzi mu ara? Dom Nyankopɔn, na wu.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ɔwo ekasa dɛ mbrɛ mbaa egyangyantwi no mu bi kasa. Ebɛnadze a? Aso yɛngye Nyankopɔn ne nsamu adze pa, na adze bɔn na mma yɛnngye anaa? Iyi nyinara mu no Job ammfa n’anofamfa annyɛ bɔn.
title: JOB

text: Afei aber a Job n’anyɛnkofo baasa tsee mbusu a aba no do yi nyinara no, nna hɔn mu obiara fi nankasa ne tsenabew bae; Temannyi Elifaz, Suhinyi Bildad na Naamatnyi Zofar; na wobehyiaa dɛ woribegyam no na wɔaakyekye no werɛ.
title: JOB

text: Na aber a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir na wɔmemaa hɔn enyi do na wohun no, woennhu dɛ ɔno a, na wɔmemaa hɔn ndze do sui; na hɔn mu obiara tsetseew n’atar mu, na wɔtotoow huntuma wɔ sor guguu hɔn etsifi.
title: JOB

text: Na wɔnye no tsenaa famu hɔ nda esuon, adzekyee na adzesaa, naaso obiara nye no annkasa: osiandɛ wohun dɛ n’amandzehu no so dodow.
title: JOB

text: Iyi n’ekyir no Job buee n’ano, na ɔdoom ne da.
title: JOB

text: Na Job see dɛ:
title: JOB

text: Wɔmma da a wɔwoo me wɔ mu no nhera, Na anadwe a wɔsee dɛ, Woenyinsen babanyin no.
title: JOB

text: Wɔmma da no nyɛ sum; Mma mma Nyankopɔn mmfi sor mmbisa ekyir kwan, Nkyii so mma kan nnhyerɛn wɔ do.
title: JOB

text: Wɔmma sum na wu no nwinwin ngye nyɛ hɔnankasa hɔndze; Wɔmma mununkum ntsena do; Wɔmma dza ɔhyɛ adzekyee sum nyinara nyi no hu.
title: JOB

text: Na adzesaa no dze, wɔmma sum kebii nkitsa no: Mma mma ɔmmfora afrenhyia nda no mu nndzi ehurusi; Mma mma ɔmmba abosoom no dodow mu.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, wɔmma anadwe no nyɛ kɔnn; Mma mma ehurusi ndze mmba mu.
title: JOB

text: Wɔmma hɔn a wɔdom da wɔndom no, Hɔn a wɔaben dɛ wopusuw dɛnkyɛmnyin no.
title: JOB

text: Wɔmma adansaber nworaba nhyɛ sum: Wɔmma ɔntweɔn kan, na mma onnya bi; Nkyii so mma onnhu adzekyee n’enyisoatsɛw:
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ ɔanntow me na n’awotoa abow no mu, Na ɔammfa awerɛhow ennhuntsa m’enyi so.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mennwu wɔ awotoa mu? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na menngyaa mo sunsum mu aber a mifi yafun mu firii no?
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na anankoroma gyee me? Anaa ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na motoo enumfo na munumii?
title: JOB

text: Na nkyɛ sisei meda hɔ mayɛ komm; Nkyɛ mada; ɔnodze nkyɛ menya ahomgye:
title: JOB

text: Menye ahemfo na asaase do apamfo a Wɔkyekyer amamfo ma hɔnho no;
title: JOB

text: Anaa menye mbapɔmba a wɔwɔ sika a, Wɔdze dwetɛ hyehyɛ hɔn efiefi amaama:
title: JOB

text: Anaa metse dɛ ɔponba a wɔakora no a nkyɛ minnyi hɔ; Dɛ nkɔkowaba a wonnhun kan pɛn?
title: JOB

text: Hɔ na nyimpa bɔn gyaa haw; Na hɔ na hɔn a wɔaberɛ wɔhom.
title: JOB

text: Hɔ na adaduafo nyinara hɔn ho dwe hɔn; Wɔnntse bɔmbaanyi ndze.
title: JOB

text: Hɔ na nkakraba na akɛse wɔ; Na nkowaa dzi hɔnho fi hɔn wura nsamu.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔdze kan ama nyia ɔwɔ awerɛhow mu, Na wɔdze nkwa ama hɔn a hɔn kra mu ayɛ wenwen;
title: JOB

text: Hɔn a hɔn kɔn dɔ wu, na ɔmmba; Na wɔbɔr hwehwɛ no kyɛn egyapadze a ohuntsa;
title: JOB

text: Hɔn a hɔn enyi gye mbordo, Na hɔn ho sɛpɛw hɔn, dɛ wobenya adakamona?
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔdze kan ama nyimpa a wɔdze no nkwa ehuntsa, Na Nyankopɔn abɔ no ho ban?
title: JOB

text: Na m’apensi abɛhyɛ m’edziban ananmu, Na mo sufrɛ hue gu dɛ nsu.
title: JOB

text: Na adze a musuro aba mo do, Na dza n’akoma tu wɔ ho ato me.
title: JOB

text: Minnya ahodwe, nkyii so mennyɛ komm, nkyii so minnya ahomgye; Mbom ahoguan ara na ɔba.
title: JOB

text: Nna Temannyi Elifaz buaa Job dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Sɛ obi pɛ dɛ ɔka asɛm yi ho biribi a, ɔbɛyɛ wo ahomtsew anaa? Naaso meka m’ano to mu a ɔnnyɛ yie.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, ɔwo etu dodowara fo, Na ɔwo ahyɛ nsa a agow dzen.
title: JOB

text: Wo nsɛm ama nyia ɔrohwe ase egyina, Na ɔwo ahyɛ anankoroma a egura no dzen,
title: JOB

text: Na afei ɔtoo wo yi dze, ɔwo atɔ bahaw, Enya aka wo yi, na w’akoma etu yi?
title: JOB

text: Ana nnyɛ wo Nyamesuro nye w’awerɛhyɛmu, Na w’enyidado nye w’akwan a ɔtsen no?
title: JOB

text: Meserɛ wo, kaa, woana na odzi bem na ɔahera pɛn? Anaa ehen na woetwa atseneneefo egu da?
title: JOB

text: Dɛ mbrɛ menya nhunii no, hɔn a wofuntum emumuyɛ, Na wodua mbusu no, ɔnoara so na wobu.
title: JOB

text: Nyankopɔn n’ahomgu ma hɔn ase hyew, Na n’ebufuw mframa ma wɔhyew.
title: JOB

text: Nyew, dɛ mbrɛ gyata no pɔw, na gyata bɔyafo ne ndze, Na ngyata eburwa hɔn se bubu,
title: JOB

text: Na afonam bɔ gyata ma ntsi ɔhera, Na gyataber ne mba bɔ apetse no, Dɛmara so na owie emumuyɛfo.
title: JOB

text: Afei wɔdze asɛm bi baa me nkyɛn nsumaa mu, Na m’aso tsee no ho biribi kakra.
title: JOB

text: Adwendwen a ofi anadwe enyido adzehu mu, Aber a nda heii atɔ nyimpa do no,
title: JOB

text: Suro na ahopopo baa mo do a Ɔmaa me mbiew nyinara wosowee.
title: JOB

text: Nna sunsum twaa mu wɔ m’enyim; Mo ho nhwi soɛree gyinagyinae.
title: JOB

text: Ogyinaa hɔ komm, naaso mennhu no su; Suban bi gyinagyinaa m’enyi do. Hɔ yɛɛ dzinn, na metsee dɛ ndze bɔkɔɔ bi, rese dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Ana dasanyi bɛtsen asen Nyankopɔn? Anaa nyimpa ho bɛtsew asen ne yɛfo?
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, no nkowaa mpo ɔmmfa werɛ nnhyɛ hɔn mu; Na n’abɔfoe no mpo ohu mfomdo wɔ hɔn mu:
title: JOB

text: Na afei akantam hɔn a wɔtse dɛtse adan mu a, Hɔn fapem wɔ huntuma mu a, Wɔfetsew hɔn dɛ abowaba?
title: JOB

text: Wɔwɔ hɔ anapa naaso obodu ewimbir na wɔasɛɛ hɔn: Wɔhera daa na obiara mmbu no hwee.
title: JOB

text: Ana wɔnntsew hɔn asesehoma wɔ hɔn mu? Wowuwu, naaso nnyɛ nyansa mu bi a.
title: JOB

text: Afei frɛ ɛ, Job, frɛ, kyerɛkyerɛ obi wɔ hɔ a obobua wo a? Na ahotseweefo mu woana na edze bɔkɔ akɛdan no?
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ ehisɛm ku kwasea, Na nyinkuntwe ku kotobonyi.
title: JOB

text: Muhun kwasea dɛ ɔregye ndwow: Na amonmu ara na modoom ne tsenabew.
title: JOB

text: Ne mba nye nkwagye ntamu twe, Na wɔpɔtɔw hɔn wɔ kuropon mu, Nkyii so obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔgye hɔn so.
title: JOB

text: Nyia ɔkɔm dze no bedzi no ndɔbaa, Na nsoɛ mu mpo na obeyi efi, Na efir da hɔ petoo dze ma hɔn ahodze.
title: JOB

text: Na ahohia mmfi huntuma mu mmpue, Nkyii so fona mmfi famu mmfifir;
title: JOB

text: Mbom wɔwo nyimpa ma fona, Dɛ mbrɛ gyansenama so tutu fa sor no.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ emi dze a, nkyɛ mobɔhwehwɛ Nyankopɔn n’ekyir kwan, Na medze m’asɛm ahyɛ ne nsa:
title: JOB

text: Ɔno a ɔyɛ ndzɛmba akɛse a onnyi nhwehwɛmu; Anwanwadze a onnyi anobu:
title: JOB

text: Ɔno a ɔma nyankom tɔ gu asaase do, Na ɔma nsu gugu ahaban do:
title: JOB

text: Na ɔdze ahobrɛadzefo sisi mbrɛ ɔkrɔn; Na hɔn a wodzi awerɛhow no, opegya hɔn kɔ eyiedzi mu.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔma enyitseweefo nhyehyɛɛ yɛ kwa, Ma hɔn nsa nntum nnyɛ hɔn esusudze.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔkyer enyansafo wɔ hɔnankasa hɔn enyitsew mu; Na osi ndabrabafo apam tsir adze.
title: JOB

text: Wɔtɔ sum mu ewiaber, Na wɔkeka ewiaketee dɛ anadwe.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔno na ɔgye nkwa fi afona a ofi hɔn anomu no ano, Mekyerɛ kɔhweaban no fi katakyi no nsamu.
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi hianyi no wɔ enyidado, Na emumuyɛ mua n’ano.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, homkanyi nye nyimpa a Nyankopɔn ka n’enyim: Dɛm ntsi mma mmbu Otumfo ne ntsea no enyimtsia.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔtow kam, na ɔkyekyer; Opira, na ne nsa ma ɔsa.
title: JOB

text: Obeyi wo wɔ ahohia esia mu; Nyew, dza otsia esuon no mu mpo mbusu bi rennka wo.
title: JOB

text: Ɔkɔm ber mu ɔbɛgye wo efi wu mu; Na akodzi mu so ɔagye wo efi afona ano;
title: JOB

text: Ɔbɔkora wo efi tɛkyerɛma mpire ano; Nkyii so irunnsuro ɔsɛɛ a ɔreba.
title: JOB

text: Ebɛserew ɔsɛɛ na kɔm; Nkyii so irunnsuro asaase do mbowadoma.
title: JOB

text: Na enye haban mu abo bɛyɛ nkyekyeree; Na haban mu mbowadoma nye wo benya asomdwee.
title: JOB

text: Na ibohu dɛ w’asesee wɔ asomdwee mu; Na ebɛsera wo nguamban, na erennyew hwee.
title: JOB

text: Ibohu so dɛ w’asefo adɔɔ so, Na wo mbanananom bɛyɛ dɛ asaase do nkyɛkyɛr.
title: JOB

text: Edze mfe dodow bɔkɔ w’adakamona mu, Dɛ mbrɛ wɔdze ewi efiefi ba wɔ ne ber mu no.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, iyi na yɛahwehwɛ mu ehu, na mbrɛ ɔtse nye yi; Tsie ɛ, na ɔwo so hu fa ma woho.
title: JOB

text: Nna Job buaa no dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Ao, kɛtseankyɛ woeeker m’awerɛhow, Na wɔdze m’amandzehu eegu nsɛn mu!
title: JOB

text: Na afei nkyɛ ɔbɛyɛ dur asen mpoano anhwea: Dɛm ntsi na me nsɛm ayɛ yerɛyerɛw yi.
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ Otumfo no n’egyen menaba tuatua mo mu, Mo sunsum ronom no mu bɔr: Nyankopɔn ho hu aba mo do mpasuar.
title: JOB

text: Ana hamu asoaso paapaa mu aber a ɔwɔ efunoma? Anaa nantwi bobɔ mu su wɔ n’aforafora edziban do?
title: JOB

text: Anaa edziban tabrabaa wokwetsi nkyen dzi? Anaa dɛw bi wɔ nkyirefuwa mu fufuw mu?
title: JOB

text: Me kra pow dɛ ɔdze nsa bɛka; Ɔtse dɛ edziban a ɔyɛ nkɔw dze ma me.
title: JOB

text: Ao, kɛtseankyɛ meenya m’ebisadze; Na nkyɛ Nyankopɔn dze adze a mo kɔn dɔ no aama me.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ nkyɛ Nyankopɔn bɛpɛ dɛ ɔdwerew me; Na ogyaa ne nsamu, na otwa me kyen mpo a!
title: JOB

text: Ɔno nkyɛ mibenya awerɛkyekyer dɛ; Nyew, nkyɛ mibedzi ehurusi wɔ yaw a ɔso noho: Dɛ mummbuu Krɔnkrɔnnyi kor no ne nsɛm do.
title: JOB

text: Naaso m’ahoɔdzen wɔ hen, dɛ medze mobɔtweɔn? Na m’enyidado nye dɛn, dɛ mebɛyɛ ho abotar?
title: JOB

text: Ana m’ahoɔdzen yɛ abo ahoɔdzen? Anaa mo honam yɛ boran?
title: JOB

text: Ana nnyɛ mboa bi na minnyi no wɔ mo mu, Na woetu nyansa pa efi mo mu koraa?
title: JOB

text: Nyia ɔrotɔ bitsi no, ɔsɛ dɛ onya ne nyɛnko nsamu ayamuyie; Mekyerɛ nyia ɔpow Otumfo no no suro no.
title: JOB

text: Mo nuanom etwa nkontompɔ dɛ ɔwora, Dɛ suka mu nwora a ɔsen twa mu kɔ a
title: JOB

text: Nsudaa ntsi n’enyi ebir, Na esukwankyɛba suma noho wɔ mu:
title: JOB

text: Mber a ɔhyew ka no no, ɔhera: Ahohur ber mu ɔsa wɔ n’ananmu.
title: JOB

text: Akwantsemfo a wodua n’akwan mu dan fa nkyɛn: Wɔkɔ framfram no mu, na wɔhera.
title: JOB

text: Tema akwantsemfo no hwehwɛe. Seba akwantsemfo ekuwekuw no dze enyi too do.
title: JOB

text: Hɔn enyi wui dɛ wɔdze hɔn enyi too do; Wokodur hɔ, na hɔn enyim guu ase.
title: JOB

text: Na dɛmara na hom so hom tse; Hom ehu m’amandzehu yi, naaso hom nnyi tsema biara ma me.
title: JOB

text: Ana mase dɛ, Hom mma me biribi? Anaa, emi ntsi hom mfa hom ahodze mu bi nkyɛ?
title: JOB

text: Anaa, hom ngye me mfi ɔyɛfo nsamu? Na, hom mpon me mfi ahyɛdofo nsamu anaa?
title: JOB

text: Hom nkyerɛkyerɛ me, na mubomua m’ano: Na hom mma munhu dza mafom wɔ mu.
title: JOB

text: Mbrɛ nsɛm tsenenee dua na ɔyɛ dzen a: Na hom atsɛnyiyi yi dze otwuw ebɛnadze enyim?
title: JOB

text: Ana hom susu dɛ wobotwuw nsɛm enyim? Osiandɛ nyia n’enyi aber no ne nsɛm tse dɛ mframa.
title: JOB

text: Nyew, hom twe tonto wɔ egyanka mpo do, Na hom dze hom nyɛnko yɛ eguadze.
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi afei hom mpɛ dɛ wɔbɛgyen enyi ahwɛ me; Na ampaara mirinndzi ator wɔ hom enyim.
title: JOB

text: Meserɛ hom, hom nsan, mma mma ntɛnkyew bi mmba; Nyew, hom nsan bio, m’asɛm tsen.
title: JOB

text: Ana ntɛnkyew bi wɔ me gyirama do? Ana mo nhumu nntum nnhu ebusudze mu?
title: JOB

text: Ana akodzi bi nnyi hɔ mma dasanyi wɔ asaase do? Na ne nda nntse dɛ paanyi nda bi a?
title: JOB

text: Dɛ mbrɛ akowaa hwehwɛ nwinwin enyiberdo, Na dɛ mbrɛ paanyi hwɛ n’apaabɔdze kwan no:
title: JOB

text: Dɛmara so na wɔama menya abosoom gyangyan, Na wɔahyehyɛ berɛ anadwe dze ama me.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mekɛda hɔ a, mese dɛ, Aber bɛn na mobɔsoɛr? Na adzesaa mu atwe; Na adafatwitwa fon me dze kodu enyimtsetsewee.
title: JOB

text: Mo honam fura mbowaba na dɛtse atɔwatɔw; Mo wer twintwam na otuetue fofor.
title: JOB

text: Me nda ho yɛ har sen ɔwemfo n’akrokroba, Na ɔhwer dɛ enyidado bi nnyi ho.
title: JOB

text: Ao, kaa dɛ mo nkwa yɛ mframa: M’enyiwa runnhu papa bio.
title: JOB

text: Nyia ohu me n’enyiwa ronnhwɛ me bio: W’enyiwa bɛba mo do no, nna minnyi hɔ.
title: JOB

text: Dɛ mbrɛ mununkum sa na ɔhera no, Dɛmara so na nyia osian kɔ samanadze rommfow mmba bio.
title: JOB

text: Ɔrennsan mmba ne fie bio, Nkyii so wonnkohu no bio wɔ ne tsenabew.
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi merennka m’ano nnto mu, Mebɛkasa wɔ mo sunsum n’ahoguan mu;
title: JOB

text: Ana meyɛ po, anaa po mu abowapɔn, Ma ɔwo edze aweɔmfo sisi mo do yi?
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mese dɛ, Me mpa bɛkyekye mo werɛ, M’adae bɔdwedwe mo nkɔmbɔdzi no a;
title: JOB

text: Nna ɔwo edze adaaso riyi me hu. Na enam enyido adzehu mu robɔ me piriw:
title: JOB

text: Ma me kra pɛ menebabɔ, Na wu mbom sen me mbiew.
title: JOB

text: Mo nkwa afon me; memmpɛ dɛ metsena ase daa; Gyaa me; na me nda yɛ egyangyandze.
title: JOB

text: Dasanyi nye woana na ɔwo ihuhor no, Na ɔwo edze w’akoma si no do,
title: JOB

text: Na ɔwo esera no anapa nyinara, Na esɔ no hwɛ aber nyinara?
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo rinnyi w’enyi mmfi mo do araa ma ekodu dabɛn, Na eso irinngyaa me araa ma ekodu dɛ mamen me ntafi?
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mayɛ bɔn a, ebɛnadze na mayɛ wo, ɔwo nyimpa weɔmfo? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze me esi hɔ dɛ wo botae, Ma mayɛ adzesoa ama moho yi?
title: JOB

text: Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na emmfa me mbrato nnkyɛ, na innyi m’emumuyɛ nnkɔ? Na afei mebɛda huntuma mu; Na ɔwo bɔhwehwɛ me enyiberdo, naaso nna minnyi hɔ bio.
title: JOB

text: Nna Suhinyi Bildad gyee do dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Aber bɛn na ebɛka iyinom ekodu? Na aber bɛn na w’anomu nsɛm bɛyɛ dɛ mframa dzendzen ekodu?
title: JOB

text: Ana Nyankopɔn kyeakyea atsɛmbu? Anaa Otumfo no bɛkyea pɛrpɛr.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ wo mba ayɛ bɔn etsia no, Na oegyaa hɔn ahyɛ hɔn mbrato nsamu a:
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ɔwoara hwehwɛ Nyankopɔn ekyir kwan enyiberdo, Na edze wo ntotɔserɛ kyerɛ Otumfo no;
title: JOB
