text: Na sɛ wo ho tsew na etsen a; Ampa nkyɛ afei onkekenyan noho ama wo, Na ɔama wo tsenenee tsenabew ayɛ prɔmprɔm anaa?
title: JOB

text: Na kaansa w’ahyɛse yɛ kakraba mpo a, W’ewiei bɛyɛ kɛsenara.
title: JOB

text: Meserɛ wo, bisa tsetse mpanyin, Na ma w’enyi mbra dza hɔn egyanom ahwehwɛ mu ehu no do:
title: JOB

text: (Na hɛn dze, yefi ndeda yi ara, na yennyim hwee, Osiandɛ hɛn nda tse dɛ nwinwin wɔ asaase do:)
title: JOB

text: Ana nnyɛ hɔn na wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo, na wɔaka akyerɛ wo, Na woeyiyi nsɛm efi hɔn akoma mu?
title: JOB

text: Ana ntɔn begyina mbrɛ atɛkyɛ nnyi? Ana atsen begyina mbrɛ nsu nnyi?
title: JOB

text: Mber a ɔda ho wɔ no frɔmfrɔmyɛ mu a wonntwae nnkyenee no mpo, Ɔkyenkyen ansaana efuw biara akyenkyen:
title: JOB

text: Mbrɛ hɔn a hɔn werɛ fir Nyankopɔn nyinara hɔn akwan tse nye no; Na nyaatwomnyi n’enyidado bɛhera:
title: JOB

text: N’enyidado botwitwa, Na n’awerɛhyɛmu tse dɛ ananse ntentan.
title: JOB

text: Ɔbɔtwer ne dan, na orinngyina: Obosuo mu dzen, na ɔronnko hɔ.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ frɔmfrɔm wɔ ewia enyim, Na n’abaw toto kata no ture do.
title: JOB

text: No ndwow mantamanta abo kuw ho, Ɔhɛn abo ntamu mpo.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ wɔsɛɛ no wɔ ne tsenabew a, Ɔno ɔbɛpa no, dɛ, Munnhun wo.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, no kwan ahosɛpɛw nye yi, Na asaase no mu na fofor fi befifir.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, Nyankopɔn ronntow nyimpa a odzi mu nnkyen, Nkyii so orunnsuo ebusuyɛfo no mu nngyina.
title: JOB

text: Ɔdze serew ara bɛhyɛ w’anomu ma, Na ɔdze osebɔ ahyɛ w’anofamfa mu.
title: JOB

text: Hɔn a wokyir wo bofura enyito; Na nyimpa bɔn atsenae ronnko hɔ bio.
title: JOB

text: Nna Job buaa dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Ampaara, minyim dɛ ɔtse dɛm: Na dasanyi bɛyɛ dɛn atsen wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim?
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ɔpɛ dɛ ɔnye no yiyi ano a, Orunntum mmbua no apem mu kor mpo.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ nyansafo wɔ akoma mu, na katakyi wɔ ahoɔdzen mu: Woana na ɔasen no kɔn wɔ no do, na oewie yie?
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na otutu mbepɔw, na wonnyim, Aber a obutuw hɔn wɔ n’ebufuw mu no.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔwosow asaase fi ne sibew, Na n’edum ho popo.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔhyɛ ewia, ma ommpue; Na ɔsosɔw nworaba ano.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno nko na ɔtserɛw ɔsor mu, Na otsiatsia po asorɛkye do.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔyɛɛ nworaba Ɔbɔɔ nda esuon, Etsekwagyan, na Aberwa na mba, Na pomu afamu mpia no.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔyɛ ndzɛmba akɛse a ɔtra nhwehwɛmu; Nyew, ndzɛmba nwanwa a wonntum mmbu ano.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, ɔnam me nkyɛn sen, na munnhu no: Otwa mu kɔ so, na mennhyɛ no nsew.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, okukur afonam no, woana na ɔbɛsan no ekyir? Woana na obotum ase no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ereyɛ yi?
title: JOB

text: Nyankopɔn ronntwe n’ebufuw nnsan; Rahab aboafo brɛ hɔnho adze wɔ n’ase.
title: JOB

text: Na burbur ayɛ dɛ emi na mubobua no, Na mibeyiyi me nsɛm dɛ menye no bɛsensan?
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na sɛ metsen mpo a, nkyɛ murummbua no; Mibedzi ntotɔserɛ akyerɛ me tamfo.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mefrɛ na ɔgye me do mpo a; Nkyɛ merenngye nndzi dɛ ɔayɛ aso ama me ndze.
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ ɔdze ehum pusuw me, Na ɔma m’epirakur dɔɔ so ara yie.
title: JOB

text: Ɔremma me kwan ma munngu ahom, Na ɔdze bɔwema ahyɛ me ma tɔ.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ yɛreka no akatakyi ahoɔdzen do a, hwɛ, ɔwɔ hɔ! Na sɛ atsɛmbu so do a, nkyɛ woana bɛsaman no ama me?
title: JOB

text: Sɛ metsen mpo a, nkyɛ mankasa m’ano bobu me fɔ: Sɛ midzi mu mpo a, ɔbɛma makyea.
title: JOB

text: Midzi mu dze, naaso mummbu moho bi, mo nkwa afon me.
title: JOB

text: Ne nyinara kor; dɛm ntsi na mese dɛ, Ɔsɛɛ nyia odzi mu, na dzebɔnyɛnyi no so.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mpire no ku obi awerɛfirmu a, Osi hɔn a wodzi bem hɔn amandzehu atwetwe.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ asaase kedzi nyimpa bɔn no nsamu a: Ɔno Nyankopɔn na ɔkatakata n’atsɛmbuafo enyi; Sɛ ɔnnyɛ ɔno a, nna woana a?
title: JOB

text: Afei me nda ho yɛ har sen mbirikatufo: Wotu kɔ, wonnhu papa biara.
title: JOB

text: Wotwa mu kɔ dɛ ndzɛmbir ahɛn: Dɛ korpɔn a ɔtow fa afonam do.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mese dɛ mo werɛ befir m’awerɛhow, Mibegyaa m’enyim botooyɛ, na m’enyim atsew a:
title: JOB

text: Me yaw nyinara yɛ me hu, Minyim dɛ irummbu me bem.
title: JOB

text: Na sɛ wobobu me fɔ dze a, Ebɛnadze ntsi na mebɛberɛ gyan yi?
title: JOB

text: Sɛ medze esukwankyɛba nsu hohor moho, Na meyɛ me nsa ho wansawansa dɛn ara mpo a:
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo edze me bɔto adɛtsebir amona no mu, Na mankasa me ntar mpo bekyir me.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔnnyɛ nyimpa dɛ emi, na meebua no, Ma hɛn beenu yeehyia asɛndzii.
title: JOB

text: Hɛn ntamu sɛntwamunyi bi nnyi hɔ a Ɔdze ne nsa bɔto hɛn beenu nyina do.
title: JOB

text: Ma onyi n’abaa mfi mo do, Na mma mma no ho hu nnkitsa me:
title: JOB

text: Nna nkyii nkyɛ mebɛkasa, a murunnsuro no; Naaso munnkotum dɛm yɛ wɔ mankasa m’afamu.
title: JOB

text: Mo nkwa afon me kra; Mebɛma m’apensi kwan; Mebɛkasa wɔ me kra n’awerɛhow mu.
title: JOB

text: Mebɛse Nyankopɔn dɛ, Mma mmbu me fɔ; Kyerɛ me adze kor a osian ntsi ma enye me ridzi esi yi.
title: JOB

text: Ana oye ma wo dɛ ɔwo etseetsee obi, Dɛ ɔwo ibu wo nsaano edwuma enyimtsia, Na ehyerɛn nyimpa bɔn n’apam do?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo ewɔ honam enyiwa, Anaa ɔwo ehwɛ adze dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa hwɛ?
title: JOB

text: Ana wo nda tse dɛ dasanyi nda? Anaa wo mfe tse dɛ dasanyi dze,
title: JOB

text: Ma ɔwo erohwehwɛ m’emumuyɛ ekyir kwan, Na idzi mo bɔn ekyir atwee yi?
title: JOB

text: Naaso ɔwoara inyim dɛ mennyɛ nyimpa bɔn; Na obi nnyi hɔ a obotum agye efi wo nsamu?
title: JOB

text: Wo nsa na ɔyɛɛ me na ɔween me nyimpa mu nyina hyiae; Nna ɔwoara resɛɛ me yi.
title: JOB

text: Meserɛ wo, kaa dɛ ɔwo na eween me dɛ awendɛtse: Na aso edze me bɛba huntuma mu bio?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwoara innhuee me nnguu dɛ numfonsu, Na emma mimmpiw dɛ numfonsudaa?
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo na edze wer na honam edura mo ho, Na edze mbiew na ntsin ewurawura mo mu.
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo na adom me nkwa na enyimpa, Na wo nhwɛdo pa no so akora mo sunsum do.
title: JOB

text: Naaso iyinom na edze siee w’akoma mu; Mehu dɛ iyi na edze etsia me:
title: JOB

text: Sɛ meyɛ bɔn a, ɔno ɔwoara na ebɔ me nyikam, Na ɔwo rummbu me bem wɔ m’emumuyɛ ho.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ meyɛ nyimpa bɔn a, mundue; Na sɛ meyɛ tseneneenyi mpo a, meremma me tsir do; Enyimguase ahyɛ me ma Na ɔwoara hwɛ m’amandzehu.
title: JOB

text: Na sɛ me tsir ma noho do a, ɔwo ibetsiw me dɛ gyata: Na ɔwo asan nye me ebedzi anwanwasɛm.
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo edze w’adasefo afofor ba mo do, Na ema w’ebufuhyew dɔɔ so wɔ mo do; Nsakyer na akodzi esi m’enyim.
title: JOB

text: Ebɛnadze ntsi na iyii me fii awotoa mu bae? Ao, sɛ migyaa mo sunsum mu na enyiwa bi ennhu me ɛ.
title: JOB

text: Kɛtseankyɛ meyɛɛ dɛ mammbabra koraa; Nkyɛ wɔdze me fii yafun mu kɔr adakamona mu.
title: JOB

text: Ana me nda nnyɛ kakrabaabi bi? Dɛm a sianka, Na gyaa me, ma minnya akomatɔmu kakra,
title: JOB

text: Ansaana makɔ beebi mbrɛ merennsan mmba, Mekyerɛ sum na wu no nwinwin asaase no do:
title: JOB

text: Sum kebii asaase a, ɔtse dɛ sum noara; Owu no nwinwin asaase a nhyehyɛɛ biara nnyi hɔ, Na beebi mbrɛ kan no tse dɛ sum kebii no a.
title: JOB

text: Nna Naamatnyi Zofar gyee do dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Ana edwen dɛ obiara rinnyi wo nsɛm dodow yi ano? Na aso wɔbɛma nyimpa anobɛrbɛrnyi yi edzi bem?
title: JOB

text: Ana wo ntuw bɛma nyimpa aka hɔn ano ato mu? Na sɛ ɔwo si atwetwe a, aso nyimpa biara nnkɛhyɛ wo enyito anaa?
title: JOB

text: Na ɔwo ese dɛ, Me nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ pefee na odzi mu, Na mo ho tsew wɔ Nyankopɔn n’enyiwa mu.
title: JOB

text: Ao kɛtseankyɛ Nyankopɔn aakasa, Na oebue n’ano wɔ wo do;
title: JOB

text: Na nkyɛ ɔakyerɛ wo nyansa n’esumasɛm, Dɛ nyansa mapa no mu dɔ yie. Dɛm ntsi hu dɛ Nyankopɔn retsea wo kakraba sen dza ɔfata w’emumuyɛ.
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo ibotum afa nhwehwɛmu do ehu Nyankopɔn? Anaa ɔwo ibotum ehu Otumfo no ewie pɛr?
title: JOB

text: Ɔkrɔn sen sor; ibotum ebɛnadze yɛ? Ɔdɔ sen samanadze; ebɛnadze na inyim?
title: JOB

text: No nsusui war sen asaase, Na ɔtserɛw sen po.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ɔtsew mu ba, na ɔtow mu, Na ɔfrɛ asɛndzii a, ɔno woana na obotum esiw no kwan?
title: JOB

text: Na ɔno na onyim nyimpa huhuw: Ohu emumuyɛ so, kaansa ɔnndwen ho mpo a.
title: JOB

text: Dɛ mbrɛ haban mu asoaso nnkotum adan nyimpa no, Dɛmara so na nyimpa huhuw nnyim nyansa biara.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ɔwo ibesiesie w’akoma yie, Na adan wo nsamu akyerɛ no a;
title: JOB

text: Sɛ emumuyɛ wɔ wo nsamu a, yi kɔ ekyir, Na mma mma ɔbrakyew nntsena w’asesee mu;
title: JOB

text: Ampa, ɔno na ebɛma w’enyi do dɛ nkekaa biara nnyi ho; Nyew, ibetsim hɔ pintsinn, na innkosuro:
title: JOB

text: Na wo werɛ befir w’awerɛhow; Ebɛkaa no dɛ esu a oetwa mu kɔ:
title: JOB

text: Na wo nkwaber bɛhyerɛn dɛ ewiaber; Kaansa sum gye mpo a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛ adzekyee.
title: JOB

text: Na wo ho bɛyɛ sɔkyee, osiandɛ enyidado wɔ hɔ; Nyew, ebɔhwehwɛ woho ehyia, na agye w’ahom dwudwoodwo.
title: JOB

text: Eso ɔwo ebɛda, na obiara rinnyi wo hu; Na dodowara bedzi w’enyim ntotɔserɛ.
title: JOB

text: Na ndzebɔnyɛfo dze, hɔn enyiwa do besiw hɔn, Na wonnkenya kwan biara afa do eguan, Na hɔn enyidado bɛyɛ dɛ ɔkra ne ngyaamu.
title: JOB

text: Nna Job buaa dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Nyew, hom nye ɔman no ne ndze! Na sɛ hom wu a, nna nyansa so ewu.
title: JOB

text: Na mbom mo so mowɔ ntseasee dɛ homara; Monntɔ mu wɔ hom enyim koraa: Nyew, woana na onnyim ndzɛmba a ɔtse dɛm yi?
title: JOB

text: Metse dɛ obi a ɔyɛ sesɛba wɔ hom enyi do, Nyimpa a ɔfrɛ Nyankopɔn, na ɔgye no do, Nyimpa tsenenee a odzi mu no, ema ɔyɛ sesɛba?
title: JOB

text: Nyia no ho adwe no no ommbu nyia oruhu amandze no bi wɔ n’adwen mu; Ɔyɛ no dɛ oesiesie ama hɔn a hɔn anan retserew nko.
title: JOB

text: Edwotwafo asetsena mu yɛ prɔmprɔm; Mpo hɔn a woyi Nyankopɔn ebufuw so tse hɔ komm; Hɔn a hɔn nyame nye hɔn ahoɔdzen no a.
title: JOB

text: Na afei bisa mbowa, na wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo, Na wimu ntumbowa, na wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo:
title: JOB

text: Anaa kasa kyerɛ asaase, na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo; Na po mu nam bɛda no edzi akyerɛ wo.
title: JOB

text: Woana na onnyim wɔ yinom nyinara mu, Dɛ EWURADZE ne nsa na ɔayɛ iyi?
title: JOB

text: Ɔno ne nsamu na atseasefo nyinara hɔn kra wɔ. Na adasa nyinara hɔn ahom wɔ.
title: JOB

text: Ana nnyɛ asowa na ɔsɔ asɛm hwɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ adadaw so sɔ n’edziban hwɛ bi a?
title: JOB

text: Nkɔdaayɛ mu na nyansa wɔ, Na nda tsentsen mu na ntseasee wɔ.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno no mu na nyansa na tum wɔ, Ɔno na ɔwɔ apam na ntseasee.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, ɔno na odwuruw, na wonntum nntow bio; Ɔno na ɔtow nyimpa mu, na wonntum mmbue.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, ɔno na ɔkam nsu ma ɔwew; Eso, ɔno na ogyaa mu na ɔpram asaase do.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno no mu na ahoɔdzen na nyansa wɔ; Nyia wɔdaadaa no na ɔdaadaafo no nyina yɛ nedze.
title: JOB

text: Ɔto apamfo pan dze hɔn kɔ, Na ɔma atsɛmbuafo yɛ nkwasea.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔsansan ahemfo nkyehoma, Na ɔdze abɔdo kyekyer hɔn asen.
title: JOB

text: Ɔto asɔfo pan dze hɔn kɔ, Na obutuw akatakyi.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na oyi nokwafo ano kasa kɔ, Na ɔgye mpanyimfo nyimdzee.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ohue enyimtsiabu gu mbapɔmba do, Na ɔsansan ahoɔdzenfo abɔyamu.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na oyi adze a no mu dɔ edzi fi sum mu, Na ɔdze wu no nwinwin fir edzi ba kan mu.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔma amanaman dɔɔ so, na ɔsɛɛ hɔn: Ɔno na ɔbɔ amanaman mu, na ogya hɔn kɔ.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔgye asaase do ɔman mu etsitsir hɔn akoma, Na ɔma wokyin wɔ sar do mbrɛ ɔkwan bi nnyi hɔ.
title: JOB

text: Wɔkeka wɔ sum a kan nnyi hɔ mu, Na ɔma wokyin dɛ sabokwanyi.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, m’enyiwa ehu iyi nyinara, M’aso atse na ɔatse ase.
title: JOB

text: Dza hom nyim no, ɔnoara na mo so minyim: Monntɔ mu wɔ hom enyim.
title: JOB

text: Ampa mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ menye Otumfo no bɛkasa, Na morohwehwɛ dɛ menye Nyankopɔn beyiyi nsɛm ano.
title: JOB

text: Na hom dze, hom yɛ atorfo mapa, Hom nyinara hom yɛ ayarsafo a wɔnntow bo.
title: JOB

text: Ao, kɛtseankyɛ hom mua hom ano koraa! Na nkyɛ mbom hom nyansaa nye no.
title: JOB

text: Afei hom ntsie m’atsɛnyi, Na hom nyɛ aso mma me nyiano.
title: JOB

text: Ana hom bɛka no dza ɔnntsen mu ama Nyankopɔn, Na hom akasa ndaadaa mu ama no a?
title: JOB

text: Ana hom bɛgye ne tsir? Na hom aham ama Nyankopɔn anaa?
title: JOB

text: Ana oye dɛ nkyɛ ɔbɔhwehwɛ hom mu ehu? Anaa dɛ mbrɛ obi daadaa nyimpa no, hom so bɛdaadaa no?
title: JOB

text: Ɔbɛka hom enyim ampa, Sɛ hom hwɛ nyimpa enyim nsumaa mu a.
title: JOB

text: Ana n’akɛseyɛ nnkɛma hom akoma etu, Na no ho hu nnkɔtɔ hom do?
title: JOB

text: Hom akasabɛbu yɛ nso mbɛbusɛm, Hom akoban yɛ awendɛtse akoban.
title: JOB

text: Hom mmua hom ano, hom ngyaa me, ma menkasa, Na wɔmma dza ɔbɛba mo do mbra.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na mebɛfa mo honam etua me se mu, Na mafa mo nkwa ekitsa me nsamu?
title: JOB

text: Sɛ oruku me mpo a, ɔnoara na mohwɛ: M’akwan ara nko na mebɛper ho wɔ n’enyim.
title: JOB

text: Iyi so na ɔbɛyɛ mo nkwagye, Dɛ nyia onnsuro Nyame no remmba n’enyim.
title: JOB

text: Hom ntsie me kasaa enyiberdo, Na wɔmma m’asɛm a mepaa mu ka nkɔ hom asomu.
title: JOB

text: Afei hwɛ, mahyehyɛ m’asɛm; Minyim dɛ midzi bem.
title: JOB

text: Woana nye nyia ɔnye me bedzi esi? Na afei mubomua m’ano, na megyaa mo sunsum mu.
title: JOB

text: Ao, EWURADZE, adze ebien pɛr na meserɛ wo dɛ mma mmfa nnyɛ me, Ɔno na mubotum aba w’enyim:
title: JOB

text: Twe wo nsa fi mo do kɔ ekyirekyir: Na mma mma wo ho hu nnkitsa me.
title: JOB

text: Na nkyii frɛ, na mebɛgye wo do: Anaa ma menkasa, na ɔwoara bua me.
title: JOB

text: M’emumuyɛ na mo bɔn yɛ ahen ara? Ma munhu me mbrato na mo bɔn.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ihuntsa w’enyim, Na ibu me wo tamfo yi?
title: JOB

text: Ana ebɛtaa ahataw a mframa robɔ no kyin do? Na etsiw eburonan a eguan?
title: JOB

text: Na ɔwo ekyerɛw nsɛm wenwen dze tsia me, Na ema midzi me mbofrabermu emumuyɛ ho adze:
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo na edze m’anan so hyehyɛ apo mu, na ehyɛ m’akwan nyinara nsew; Ɔwo na itwa m’ananadze ho he:
title: JOB

text: Ntsi meresɛɛ dɛ adze prɔwee a ohi, Dɛ atar a mbowaba awewe.
title: JOB

text: Nyimpa a ɔbaa wo no, Ne nda kumaabi, na ɔfona ma.
title: JOB

text: Ɔba sor dɛ nhyiren, na wotwa to famu: Oguan so dɛ nwinwin, na ɔnnko hɔ.
title: JOB

text: Aso obi a ɔtse dɛm yi na ɔwo ibue w’enyiwa wɔ no do, Na edze me kɔ w’enyim atsɛmbu mu yi?
title: JOB

text: Woana na obotum dze adze a no ho tsew efi dza no ho nntsew mu aba? Oho, obiara runntum.
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ ne nda wɔahyɛ ato hɔ, n’abosoom no dodow wɔ wo hɔ, Na ɔwo etwa no he a orunntum nntra;
title: JOB

text: Yi w’enyi fi no do, ma ɔnhom, Nkodu dɛ obowie ne da dɛ paanyi.
title: JOB

text: Na dua mpo enyidado wɔ ho, dɛ sɛ wotwa kyen a, ɔbɛfefɛw bio, Na no nkorbata fɔr no remmpa.
title: JOB

text: Kaansa no ndwow yɛ dadaw wɔ dɛtse mu, Na no dusin wu wɔ famu mpo a:
title: JOB

text: Ɔnam nsu na hua do ɔbɛfefɛw, Na oeyiyi abaw dɛ dua a wɔatsɛw.
title: JOB

text: Na nyimpa dze owu na ɔbea hɔ, Nyew, nyimpa gyaa no sunsum mu, na ɔwɔ hen?
title: JOB

text: Dɛ mbrɛ nsu fi po mu kɔ no, Na esutsen huam, na ɔwew no;
title: JOB

text: Dɛmara so na nyimpa da hɔ na ɔnnsoɛr: Ɔsor nnyae nntwaa mu yi worinnyan, Na eso worummpusuw hɔn mmfi hɔn nda mu.
title: JOB

text: Ao, kɛtseankyɛ ɔwoara edze me eehuntsa ekodu samanadze, Nkyɛ ɔwoara edze me eesuma, ekodu dɛ w’ebufuw botwa mu, Nkyɛ ɔwoara aahyɛ me mber, na aakaa me!
title: JOB

text: Aso nyimpa wu a, ɔbɛtsena ase bio anaa? Dɛm ntsi m’akodzi nda nyinara mobɔtweɔn, Ekodu dɛ me nsakyeree bɛba.
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo ebɛfrɛ, na emi so magye wo do: Ibenya akɔndɔ wɔ wo nsaano edwuma ho.
title: JOB

text: Na afei dze ɔwo bɛkan m’anamɔn: Na erenntsɛw mo bɔn.
title: JOB

text: Wɔasɔw me mbrato ano ahyɛ kotoku mu. Na ɔwo akyekyer m’emumuyɛ ano.
title: JOB

text: Ampa bepɔw a orutu ahwe ase no, ohi, Na botan twe fi n’ananmu;
title: JOB

text: Na nsu hi abo; Na ne nyirii hohor famu huntuma kɔ no, Dɛmara so na ɔwo esɛɛ dasanyi n’enyidado;
title: JOB

text: Idzi no do nyim koraa, na otwa mu kɔ; Ɔwo esakyer n’enyim, na igya no kwan ma ɔkɔ.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ne mba ba nya enyimnyam mpo a, onnyim; Na wɔbrɛ hɔn adze so a, onnhu.
title: JOB

text: Nankasa no honanyaw nko na ɔtse, Na ne kra a ɔwɔ no mu so dzi yaw.
title: JOB

text: Nna Temannyi Elifaz buaa dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Ana nyansafo dze nyimdzee gyan bobua, Na ɔdze boka mframa ahyɛ ne yafun ma?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔdze kasa a mfaso nnyi ho beyi atsɛn, Anaa asɛnka a orunntum mmfa nnyɛ papa biara?
title: JOB

text: Nyew, ɔwo etow Nyamesuro kyen, Na isiw mpaabɔ kwan wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: JOB

text: Na w’ano kyerɛ w’emumuyɛ, Na ɔwo asan mu afa enyitseweefo tɛkyerɛma.
title: JOB

text: Wankasa w’ano na obu wo fɔ, na nnyɛ emi bi a; Nyew, wankasa w’anofamfa na odzi dase tsia wo.
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo nye nyimpa a wodzii kan woo no? Anaa wɔwoo wo ansaana wɔreyɛ akoko?
title: JOB

text: Ana atse Nyankopɔn no nsumaa mu egyinatu? Na isianka nyansa dze ma woho yi?
title: JOB

text: Ebɛnadze na ɔwo inyim a hɛn yennyim? Ebɛnadze na ɔwo etse ase a ohuntsa hɛn?
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ etsigonfo na nkɔdaa posoposo nyina wɔ hɛn mu a Wɔyɛ mpanyin koraa sen w’egya mpo.
title: JOB

text: Aso Nyankopɔn n’awerɛkyekyer na asɛm a wɔnye wo ka no bɔkɔɔ no, suar dodow ma wo anaa?
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’akoma soa wo kɔ? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ema w’enyiwa bubu pɛrpɛr yi?
title: JOB

text: Dɛ ɔwo edze w’ebufuw gu Nyankopɔn do, Na ema dɛm nsɛm yi fi w’anomu ba.
title: JOB

text: Dasanyi nye woana a no ho bɛtsew? Na nyia ɔbaa awo no, dɛ ɔbɛtsen?
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, Nyankopɔn mmfa werɛ nnhyɛ n’akrɔnkrɔmfo mpo mu; Nyew, sorsor mpo ho nntsew wɔ n’enyi do.
title: JOB

text: Na bubur nyia no ho yɛ nkɔw na ɔaprɔw, Nyimpa a ɔanom emumuyɛ dɛ nsu:
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ mebɛkyerɛ wo, na ɔwo tsie me; Na dza mehu no mebɛka akyerɛ:
title: JOB

text: Dza enyansafo aka akyerɛ a Ofi hɔn egyanom hɔ, na wɔammfa ennsuma no a;
title: JOB

text: Hɔn nko na wɔdze asaase no maa hɔn, Na ɔhɔho biara enntwa mu wɔ hɔn mu:
title: JOB

text: Nyimpa bɔn ne nda nyinara tse dɛ basia a ɔdze yaw ko awoo, Na wɔdze mfe a wɔakan esie ama hyɛdofo.
title: JOB

text: Ihu ne nka gyegye n’aso mu; Prɔmprɔmyɛ mu na ɔsɛɛfo no bɛba no do:
title: JOB

text: Ɔnngye nndzi dɛ ɔbɛsan efi sum mu, Na afona da hɔ rotweɔn no:
title: JOB

text: Okyima hwehwɛ edziban, obisa dɛ, Ɔwɔ henfa? Onyim dɛ sum da bɛn ne nkyɛn:
title: JOB

text: Ahohia na ahoguan yi no hu; Wodzi no do nyim, dɛ ɔhen a oesiesie noho ama ɔko a ɔyɛ hu:
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ ɔatsen ne nsa etsia Nyankopɔn, Na odzi nkontompɔsɛm tsia Otumfo no:
title: JOB

text: Ɔdze kɔn a ɔasen tutu kɔ no do, Ɔnye n’akyɛm ho apɔwapɔw a no mu yɛ dur no:
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ ɔdze ne seradze akata n’enyim, Na ɔayɛ seradze nankum wɔ ne nkyɛnmu:
title: JOB

text: Na ɔakɛtsena ekurow a woegu do, Efi a nyimpa biara nntsena mu a Ɔaka no dɛ ɔndan efitu mu.
title: JOB

text: Orinnya noho, nkyii so n’ahodze rinngyina, Nkyii so hɔn nsowee ronnkontom mmba famu.
title: JOB

text: Orimmfi sum mu mmfi. Ogyaframee bɛma no ndubaa eguan, Na n’anomu mframa bɛpra akɔ.
title: JOB

text: Mma mma ɔnntwer egyangyandze, nndaadaa noho: Na egyangyandze ara na ɔbɛyɛ n’akatua.
title: JOB

text: Ɔbɛyɛ hɔ ansaana ne mber aso, Na no dubaa rennyɛ frɔmfrɔm.
title: JOB

text: Ɔbɔporow n’esikyireamba bun dɛ wenyindua, Na ɔapo ne nhyiren dɛ ngodua.
title: JOB

text: Na ndabrabafo fɛkuw bɛyɛ abɔnyin, Na gya bɛhyew mboabagye asesee.
title: JOB

text: Wonyinsen ewurkadze, na wɔwo emumuyɛ, Na hɔn yamu siesie ndaadaa.
title: JOB

text: Nna Job buaa dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Matse nsɛm a ɔtsetse dɛm pii: Hom nyinara hom yɛ nkɔmbɔhundzifo.
title: JOB

text: Aso nsɛm huhuw yi bɔbɔ adze nye yi? Anaa ebɛnadze na ohur wo bo ma ibua?
title: JOB

text: Mo so mubotum akasa dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ; Sɛ hom wɔ me gyinabew yi mu a, Nkyɛ mubotum ahɔr nsɛm egu hom do, Na mawosow me tsir wɔ hom do.
title: JOB

text: Nyew, nkyɛ medze m’ano bɛhyɛ hom dzen, Na menam m’anofamfa awerɛkyekyer do ama hom awerɛhow aabotow.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mekasa a, m’awerɛhow rommbotow: Na sɛ migyaa so mpo a, ebɛnadze na mibenya efi mu?
title: JOB

text: Ao, Nyankopɔn, afei dze ama maberɛ: Ɔwo ama me fɛkuw nyinara egu.
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo edze mpomponee ahyɛ me ma a odzi me dase: Na mo fɔn ayɛ kɛse na, odzi dase wɔ m’enyim.
title: JOB

text: Nyankopɔn atsetsew me wɔ n’ebufuw mu, na ɔyɛ me enyienyi; Ɔatwɛr ne se egu mo do: Na ɔdze enyitanhwɛ hwɛ me.
title: JOB

text: Wɔahanhan hɔn anomu wɔ mo do; Wɔabobɔ m’asomu enyimguase mu: Wɔka hɔnho boa ano tsia me.
title: JOB

text: Nyankopɔn dze me ahyɛ hɔn a wonnyim Nyame nsa, Na ɔatow me akyen ndzebɔnyɛfo nsamu.
title: JOB

text: Nna mo ho dwe me, naaso Nyankopɔn ebubu mo mu, Nyew, oesuo mo kɔn, na ɔabobɔ me posoposo: Ɔdze me esi hɔ so ayɛ no botae.
title: JOB

text: N’egyentofo etwa mo ho ehyia, Ɔpaa me nsɛbɛ mu, na onngyaa; Ohue no bɔwema gu famu.
title: JOB

text: Ɔdwerew me dze dwerew paa dwerew do: Otutu ba mo do dɛ ɔbran katakyi.
title: JOB

text: Mapam eyitam akata mo wer do, Na medze m’ambɛn ato huntuma mu.
title: JOB

text: Osu ntsi m’enyim ayɛ nkɔnkɔw, Na owu nwinwin wɔ m’enyisoatsɛw do;
title: JOB

text: Naaso enyiber bi nnyi me nsamu, Na me mpaabɔ yɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: JOB

text: Asaase e, mma nnkata mo bɔgyaa do, Na mma mma mo sufrɛ nnya ahomgyebea.
title: JOB

text: Seseiara mpo, hwɛ, me dasefo wɔ sor, Na nyia ɔka ma me wɔ mbrɛ ɔkrɔn.
title: JOB

text: Me mfɛfo si me atwetwe: Na Nyankopɔn na m’enyiwa porow nyinsuwa kyerɛ no;
title: JOB

text: Ao, nkyɛ obi atotɔ aserɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim ama me, Dɛ nyimpa ba totɔ serɛ wɔ ne nyɛnko enyim:
title: JOB

text: Na aka mfe kakrabaabi, Mobɔkɔ kwan a merennsan memmba no.
title: JOB

text: Mo sunsum asa, me nda ahwer, Adakamona wɔ hɔ ma me.
title: JOB

text: Ampaara atwetwesifo wɔ me nkyɛn, Na m’enyiwa tua hɔn ehiyi.
title: JOB

text: Afei woara dzi me egyinamu ɛ, ao Nyankopɔn; Na woana na ɔwɔ hɔ a ɔbɛka bi ama me?
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ ɔwo eyi hɔn akoma efi ntseasee ho esuma: Dɛm ntsi eremma wonndzi mo do nyim.
title: JOB

text: Nyia oyi ne mfɛfo ma afonam no, Ne mba enyiwa mpo bofura.
title: JOB

text: Nyankopɔn ayɛ mo so ɔman akasabɛbu; Na madan obi a wohinahina n’enyi do ntafi.
title: JOB

text: Awerɛhow ntsi m’enyiwa so ayɛ kusukusu; Na m’akwaa nyinara ayɛ dɛ nwinwin.
title: JOB

text: Nyimpa a wɔtsen na hɔn ho bɔbow hɔn wɔ yi ho, Na nyia odzi bem no bekenyan noho etsia dabrabanyi.
title: JOB

text: Naaso tseneneenyi bosuo no kwan mu ara, Na nyia ne nsa ho tsew no benya ahoɔdzen aka ho:
title: JOB

text: Na hom nsan, hom nyinara, na afei hom mbra: Na murunnhu nyansafo biara wɔ hom mu.
title: JOB

text: Me nda etwa mu, me tsirmpɔw ebubu, M’akoma mu adwen mpo so.
title: JOB

text: Wɔdan adzesaa adzekyee: Wɔse dɛ, Kan bɛn sum ho.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mobɔhwɛ samanadze kwan dɛ ɔyɛ me fie; Na matow me mpa wɔ sum mu;
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mebɛse mpɔtɔwee dɛ, Ɔwo nye m’egya; Na nsaamaa dɛ, Ɔwo nye me na, anaa m’akyerɛbaa a;
title: JOB

text: Na dɛm a m’enyidado wɔ henfa? Ana obi botum ehu m’enyidado?
title: JOB

text: Oho, obesian nye me akɔ samanadze adaban no mu, Na yɛbɔbɔ mu agye hɛn ahom wɔ huntuma mu.
title: JOB

text: Nna Suhinyi Bildad buaa dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Na hom rusuasua nsɛm mfir araa ma ekodu dabɛn? Hom ndwen ho, na n’ekyir no yɛakasa.
title: JOB

text: Ebɛnadze ntsi na ibu hɛn dɛ mbowa, Na yɛayɛ dɛ akwasampafo wɔ w’enyi do yi?
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo a etsetsew woho gu wɔ w’ebufuw mu, Aso wɔbɔpow asaase wɔ wo ntsi? Anaa wobotutu abotan efi n’ananmu?
title: JOB

text: Nyew, dzebɔnyɛnyi ne kandzea bodum, Na ne gyansenama rennhyerɛn.
title: JOB

text: Kan bɛdan sum wɔ n’asesee mu, Na ne kandzea edum wɔ no do.
title: JOB

text: N’ahoɔdzen anamɔn bomua, Na nankasa n’apam ahwe no ase.
title: JOB

text: Na nankasa n’anan dze no akɔtoto eboa mu, Na ɔanantsew wɔ ngor do.
title: JOB

text: Bɛmba bosuo n’anantsir, Na efir ata esuo no mu.
title: JOB

text: Wɔdze ahoturoho efir ehuntsa no wɔ famu, Na woesua no apafir wɔ kwan mu.
title: JOB

text: Ihu bɛhyɛ n’akoma do wɔ beebiara, Na woetsiw no wɔ n’anantsir.
title: JOB

text: N’ahoɔdzen bɔtɔ bitsi, Na mbusu ayɛ krado ama ne ngyinae.
title: JOB

text: Obedzi ne nyimpadua n’akwaa no, Nyew, owu n’abakan bedzi n’akwaa.
title: JOB

text: Wobotu no efi n’asesee a no werɛ hyɛ mu no mu; Na wɔdze no abrɛ hu hen no.
title: JOB

text: Wɔdze sɔfee bɛtsew ne tsenabew: Na nyia ɔnnyɛ nedze mu bi na ɔbɛtsena n’asesee mu.
title: JOB

text: No ndwow bɛkyenkyen wɔ ase, Na woetwitwa n’abaw wɔ sor.
title: JOB

text: Ne nkaa bɛhyew efi asaase do, Na orinnya dzin wɔ abɔntsen do.
title: JOB

text: Wɔbɛpam no efi kan mu akɔ sum mu, Na wɔatam no efi wiadze.
title: JOB

text: Onnkenya ba na banana so wɔ ne manmu, Nkyii so onnkenya kyirkafo biara wɔ mbrɛ ɔkɛtsenae no.
title: JOB

text: Hɔn a wobefi anee no hɔn ho bɔbow hɔn wɔ ne da no ho, Dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a wofii boka no nketsenketse kyeer hɔn no.
title: JOB

text: Ampaara dɛm na abrakyewfo tsenabew tsetsee, Na yi nye nyia onnyim Nyankopɔn no ne gyinabew.
title: JOB

text: Na Job buaa dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Hom beyi me kra ahomtsew, Na wɔdze nsɛm ebubu me pasaa araa ma ekodu dabɛn?
title: JOB

text: Mpɛn ara du nye yi na hom asopa me: Aso hom enyi nnto dɛ hom nye me dzi no wenwen dɛm?
title: JOB

text: Na sɛ ampaara mpo dɛ mafom a, Mo mfom da mara mo do.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ampa dɛ hom bɛmema homho do etsia me, Na hom eyi me m’enyimguase ho atsɛn a:
title: JOB

text: Ɔno dze hom nhu dɛ Nyankopɔn ebutuw no ama me, Na ɔdze no boa etwa moho ehyia.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, metsea mu dɛ, Akatabansɛm o, naaso wɔnngye me do: Musu mefrɛ mboa, naaso ɔgye bi nnyi hɔ.
title: JOB

text: Nyankopɔn esi mo kwan do ban ma munntum munntwa mu, Na ɔama sum ahyehyɛ m’atsempɔn do.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔapa m’enyimnyam efi mo ho, Na oeyi me tsir abɔtsir.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na oebubu m’afa nyina, na minnyi hɔ: Na oetu m’enyidado dɛ dua.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na eso ɔama n’ebufuw dzɛw wɔ mo do, Na obu me dɛ n’atamfo no mu bi.
title: JOB

text: No dɔm horow bɔɔ mu bae, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn kwan baa mo do, Na wɔkyeer nsera bɔɔ m’asesee ho aprɔw.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na oeyi mo nuanom efi mo ho akɔ ekyirekyir, Na m’amanyimfo adandan me ananaben koraa.
title: JOB

text: M’ebusuafo apow me, Na m’anyɛnko berɛbo werɛ efir me.
title: JOB

text: Hɔn a wɔtsetse me fi mu, na me mbaawa mpo bu me ɔhɔho: Meyɛ nanaben wɔ hɔn enyi do.
title: JOB

text: Mefrɛ m’akowaa, na ɔnngye me do, Kaansa medze m’ano mepa no kyɛw mpo a.
title: JOB

text: M’ahomgu mpo adan atantandze ama me yer, Na moho afon me na yamu mba.
title: JOB

text: Mbofraba nkakraba mpo bu me enyimtsia; Na sɛ mosoɛr a, wɔkasa tsiatsia me.
title: JOB

text: Me mbanyin apamfo nyinara kyir me kɔkɔɔkɔ: Na hɔn a modɔ hɔn adan hɔnho etsia me.
title: JOB

text: Me biew afam mo wer na mo honam ho, Na aka ketseketse ma nkyɛ mahwer mo nkwa.
title: JOB

text: Ao hom me mfɛfo, hom nhu me mbɔbɔr, hom nhu me mbɔbɔr ae; Na Nyankopɔn ne nsa na aka me.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom tsiw me dɛ Nyankopɔn, Na mo honam ara mmee hom yi?
title: JOB

text: Ao kɛtseankyɛ afei wɔaakyerɛw me nsɛm! Ao ankyɛ wɔdze aahyɛ nwoma mu!
title: JOB

text: Dɛ nkyɛ wɔdze dadze kyerɛwdze na sumbui Eekrukye no wɔ botan mu ato hɔ daa:
title: JOB

text: Na emi dze, minyim dɛ mo pomfo tse ase, Na ewiei no, ɔbɛba ebedzi m’asɛm ama me wɔ asaase yi do:
title: JOB

text: Na mo wer asɛɛ dɛm ekyir no, Mpo mifi mo honam mu mubohu Nyankopɔn.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na mobɔhwɛ no ama moho, Na m’enyiwa bohu, na nnyɛ obi fofor a. Ao, mbrɛ me nsɛbɛ si wosow wɔ mo mu a!
title: JOB

text: Sɛ hom se dɛ, Yebesi dɛn etsiw no, Osiandɛ woehu asɛm no no ndwow wɔ mo mu a;
title: JOB

text: Ɔno homara so, hom nsuro afona no: Na ebufuhyew na ɔdze afona ne ntsea ba, Ama hom eehu dɛ atsɛmbu bi wɔ hɔ.
title: JOB

text: Nna Naamatnyi Zofar buaa dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi na m’adwen yɛ me dɛ mumbua wo, Osiandɛ mehaahaa.
title: JOB

text: Matse nkaenyim a ogu m’enyim ase, Na me ntseasee hyɛ me tsipia dɛ mumbua.
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo innyim iyi a ofi tsetseberdo, Ofitsi dɛ wɔdze nyimpa too asaase do no,
title: JOB

text: Dɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo eyiedzi yɛ tsia, Na ndabrabafo ehurusidzi nnkyɛr?
title: JOB

text: Kaansa n’akɛseyɛ fow kɔ sor, Na ne tsir kɛka mununkum mpo a;
title: JOB

text: Ɔbɛsɛɛ korakora dɛ nankasa n’egyanan. Hɔn a woehu no no bebisa dɛ, Ɔwɔ hen?
title: JOB

text: Obotu akɔ dɛ adaaso, na worunnhu no, Nyew, wobetsiw no dɛ anadwe enyido adzehu.
title: JOB

text: Enyiwa a ohun no no runnhu no bio; Nkyii so ne tsenabew runnhu no bio.
title: JOB

text: Ne mba bɔhwehwɛ abɔbɔfo hɔ enyimpa, Na ne nsa eyi n’ahonyadze asan ama.
title: JOB

text: Ne mberantsɛber mu ahoɔdzen hyɛɛ ne mbiew amaama. Na mbom ɔnye no bɛda wɔ huntuma mu.
title: JOB

text: Kaansa ndzebɔnyɛ yɛ fenemfenem wɔ n’anomu, Na ɔdze suma ne tɛkyerɛma ase;
title: JOB

text: Na ɔkora do, na oenngyaa mu ma ɔannkɔ, Na mbom ɔkɔ do ara sie no wɔ n’adadaw mu mpo a;
title: JOB

text: N’edziban bɛsakyer wɔ no nson mu, Na ɔbɛyɛ nhurutsia bɔwema wɔ no mu.
title: JOB

text: Ɔamen ahonya, naaso ɔbɛfe egu: Nyankopɔn beyi efi ne yamu akyen.
title: JOB

text: Obohwiew nhurutsia bɔr: Na ɔpambir tɛkyerɛma boku no.
title: JOB

text: N’enyi nnkɔbɔ esutsen no do, Ewo na buter nsupemee no.
title: JOB

text: Dza ɔaberɛ ho no, ɔbɛdan ama, na ɔnnkɛmen: Na onnkedzi n’eguadzi mu mfaso ho ehurusi.
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ ɔatseetsee ehiafo na ɔapow hɔn; Na ɔdze enyimpi afa fie bi a nnyɛ ɔno na osii.
title: JOB

text: Ɔnam dɛ oennhu n’akɔndɔ mu mee ntsi, Ɔronnkora dza n’enyigye wɔ mu mu biribiara do.
title: JOB

text: Hweeara annka a oenndzi, Dɛm ntsi n’eyiedzi nnketsim.
title: JOB

text: N’adze dodow mayɛ no mu no, no ho behiahia no: Amandzehu yaayaw bodwir no do.
title: JOB

text: Ɔahyɛ ne yafun ma ewie no, Nyankopɔn bohue n’ebufuhyew no egu no do, Na ɔatɔ ekutuku dɛ nsu wɔ no do.
title: JOB

text: Oboguan efi dadze akodze ano, Na boran egyen abɔ no ehwira mu.
title: JOB

text: Ɔtwe, na ofi ne nyimpadua mu pue: Nyew, n’ano dɛhyɛdɛhyɛ no fi no bɔwema mu pue; Ihu ho nketsenketse kyekyer no.
title: JOB

text: Sum nyinara wɔdze esie ama n’akoradze: Gya a nyimpa bi nnhuta na ɔbɛmen no; Ɔbɛhyew dza aka wɔ n’asesee mu.
title: JOB

text: Sor bɛda n’emumuyɛ edzi, Na asaase bɔsoɛr etsia no.
title: JOB

text: Ne fie ndɔbaa befi hɔ akɔ, N’adze bɛpem akɔ wɔ n’ebufuw da no mu.
title: JOB

text: Iyi nye nyimpa dzebɔnyɛnyi ne kyɛfa a ofi Nyankopɔn hɔ, Na egyapadze a Nyankopɔn ahyɛ ama no.
title: JOB

text: Na Job buaa dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Hom ntsie me kasaa yie; Na wɔmma iyi nyɛ hom awerɛkyekyer.
title: JOB

text: Hom mma me kwan, ma mo so menkasa; Na sɛ mekasa wie a, afei hom esi atwetwe.
title: JOB

text: Emi dze, ana nyimpa na midzi mo nkɔmbɔ kyerɛ no? Na bɛyɛ dɛn na m’ahom nnkɛtsew?
title: JOB

text: Hom ngyen hom enyi nhwɛ me, na hom ho mbow hom, Na hom mfa hom nsa ntoto hom ano.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ modwen iyi ho mpo a, m’akoma tu, Na nketsenketse kitsa mo honam.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ndzebɔnyɛfo tsena ase, Wɔkye, nyew, na wɔyɛ akatakyi wɔ tumdzi mu yi?
title: JOB

text: Hɔn mba tsintsim wɔ hɔn enyim ka hɔn ho, Nyew, mekyerɛ hɔn asefo.
title: JOB

text: Hɔn fie mu dwe, suro bi nnyi mu, Na nkyii so Nyankopɔn ne ntsea bi nnyi hɔn do.
title: JOB

text: Hɔn nantwinyin wo, na ɔnnyɛ kago, Hɔn nantwiber yɛ awoyie, na ɔmmpon ba.
title: JOB

text: Wɔdze hɔn mbɔdomaba pue dɛ nguankuw, Na hɔn mbofraba so dzi ehuruhuruw.
title: JOB

text: Wɔma hɔn ndze do wɔ mpintsin na nsankutsen mu, Na hɔn enyi gye wɔ atɛntɛbɛn ndze ho.
title: JOB

text: Wodzi hɔn mber wɔ eyiedzi mu, Na wosian kɔ samanadze wɔ asomdwee mu.
title: JOB

text: Naaso wɔse Nyankopɔn dɛ, Fi hɛn do kɔ; Na yɛronnhwehwɛ w’akwan ho nyimdzee.
title: JOB

text: Otumfo no nye woana na yɛaasom no? Na sɛ yɛbɔ mpaa ma no a, ebɛn mfaso na yebenya?
title: JOB

text: Naaso hwɛ, hɔn ndzepa nnyi hɔnara hɔn nsamu: Ntsi ndzebɔnyɛfo apam mpar me.
title: JOB

text: Mpɛn ahen na ndzebɔnyɛfo kandzea dum, Na mbusu so to hɔn, Na Nyankopɔn kyɛ awerɛhow ma hɔn wɔ n’ebufuw mu?
title: JOB

text: Mpɛn ahen so na ɔma wɔyɛ dɛ eburonan wɔ mframa enyim, Na dɛ ntsɛw a ehum soa kɔ?
title: JOB

text: Wɔka dɛ, Nyankopɔn dze ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi n’asotwee to hɔ ma ne mba, Kɛtseankyɛ, ontua ɔnoara kaw, ma onhu.
title: JOB

text: Ma nankasa n’enyiwa nhu noara ne sɛɛe, Na ma ɔnnom Otumfo no n’ebufuhyew no bi.
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ ebɛn adwen na ɔdwen wɔ ne fiemba ho, Aber a woewie ne nda dzi no?
title: JOB

text: Ana obi bɛkyerɛ Nyankopɔn nyimdzee? Osiandɛ ɔno na obu hɔn a wɔkrɔn atsɛn.
title: JOB

text: Obi wu wɔ n’ahoɔdzen mu mu, Aber a no ho baa no na n’asomu dwe no koraa no:
title: JOB

text: Na enumfonsu ahyɛ n’ehina mu amaama, Na ne mbiew mu ehuon yɛ fɔɔfɔɔ no a.
title: JOB

text: Na obi so wu wɔ ne kra awerɛhow mu, Na ɔnnsɔ ndzepa no bi nnhwɛ da.
title: JOB

text: Naaso, hɔn nyinara deda pɛr wɔ huntuma mu, Na nsaamaa kata hɔn do.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, minyim hom adwen, Na tsirmpɔw a hom susu no bɔn mu tsia me no.
title: JOB

text: Hom bisa hom ho dɛ, Bapɔmba no ne fie wɔ henfa seseiara? Na hen na dzebɔnyɛnyi no ne tsenabew no wɔ?
title: JOB

text: Ana hom mmbisaa hɔn a wɔfa kwan no do no? Ana hom adwendwen hɔn amandzɛɛbɔ ho?
title: JOB

text: Dɛ wɔakora nyimpa bɔn do efi sɛɛ da no mu? Na woeyi no efi ebufuw da no mu da?
title: JOB

text: Woana na ɔka n’enyim wɔ ne ndzeyɛɛ ho? Na dza ɔayɛ no, woana na obotua no ho kaw?
title: JOB

text: Wɔsoa no enyidzi mu kɔ adakamona mu, Na wɔweɔn ne nda no.
title: JOB

text: Nyimpadɔm dzi n’enyim na n’ekyir kɔ efunsiebea, Na dɛtsetɔw mpo ma no asomdwee.
title: JOB

text: Ntsi ebɛn kwan do na hom dze nsɛnhun kyekye mo werɛ? Osiandɛ hom nsɛnkaa nyina yɛ atorsɛm.
title: JOB

text: Nna Temannyi Elifaz buaa dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Aso nyimpa bi botum edzi mu wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim anaa? Hwɛ, onyimdzefo mpo, odzi mu wɔ narankasa n’enyi do.
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔyɛ enyigye bi ma Otumfo no, dɛ ɔwo etsen? Anaadɛ ɔyɛ mfaso ma no, dɛ ɔwo ema w’akwan dzi mu?
title: JOB

text: Ana wo suro a isuro no ntsi na ɔka w’enyim, Na ɔdze wo kɔ atsɛmbu mu yi?
title: JOB

text: Ana wo ndzeyɛbɔn nnyɛ kɛse dodow? Na nkyii so w’emumuyɛ nnyi ewiei?
title: JOB

text: Na ɔwo agye wo nua hɔ ahobadze kwa, Na apepa adagyafo hɔn atam.
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo amma abahatɔfo nsu ma wɔannom, Na ɔwo akam nyia ɔkɔm dze no n’edziban.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ wo dɛ nyimpa a ɔwɔ tum; Na enyimnyam no na obenya asetsena pa.
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo na egya mbaa ekunafo kwan ma wɔdze nsapan kɔ, Na ngyanka so ahyɛ hɔn abagura.
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi na mfir abɔ wo ho aprɔw, Na awerɛfir suro rehaw wo yi.
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo nnhu sum, Na nsu piigyan a ɔkata wo do no?
title: JOB

text: Ana nnyɛ sor no krɔn mu na Nyankopɔn wɔ, Na ofi hɔ hu nworaba a ɔwɔ sorsor no etsifi.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔwo ese dɛ, Ebɛnadze na Nyankopɔn nyim? Ana obotum ehu sum kebii mu asɛm ebu ho atsɛn?
title: JOB

text: Mununkum kusuww no yɛ akataho ma no, na onnhu adze; Na ɔnantsew wɔ sor no kɔntɔnkrɔn mu.
title: JOB

text: Ana ebɛfa tsetse kwan no do Dza nyimpa bɔn anantsew do no?
title: JOB

text: Hɔn a wohwiim hɔn kɔree ansaana hɔn ber rudu Na wohuee hɔn fapem gui dɛ esutsen no:
title: JOB

text: Hɔn a wɔsee Nyankopɔn dɛ, Fi hɛn do kɔ; Na, Ebɛnadze na Otumfo no botum ayɛ ama hɛn no?
title: JOB

text: Naaso ɔdze ndzepa hyehyɛɛ hɔn efiefi amaama: Mbom emi dze, mennkɛnye ndzebɔnyɛfo afa apam koraa.
title: JOB

text: Atseneneefo no hu, na hɔn enyi gye; Na hɔn a wodzi bem no sereserew hɔn.
title: JOB

text: Dɛ, ampaara hɔn a wɔsoɛree tsiaa hɛn no woetwitwa hɔn egu, Na hɔn mu nkaa no gya no ahyew.
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi, afei fa woho bɔ Nyankopɔn ho ɛ, na wo ho ntɔ wo: Ɔnam iyi do na adzepa bɛba ama wo.
title: JOB

text: Meserɛ wo, gye n’anomu mbra no, Na fa ne nsɛm sie w’akoma mu.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ɔwo esan kɔ Otumfo no nkyɛn a, ɔdze wo besi hɔ; Sɛ nkyɛ ibeyi emumuyɛ efi w’asesee mu akɔ ekyirkyiikyir a.
title: JOB

text: Na fa w’egyapadze gu huntuma mu, Na wo sika mapa so gu ɔwora mu mbosaabo mu;
title: JOB

text: Na Otumfo no bɛyɛ w’egyapadze, Na dwetɛ a wɔahoa ho ama wo.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔno na wo ho bɛsɛpɛw wo wɔ Otumfo no ho, Na ama w’enyi do akyerɛ Nyankopɔn.
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo bɔbɔ wo mpaa ama no, na obetsie wo; Na ɔwo etua w’anohobadze.
title: JOB

text: Eso ɔwo ebɔbɔ adze bi ho tsirmpɔw, na ɔbɛyɛ hɔ ama wo; Na ekan bɛhyerɛn w’akwan do.
title: JOB

text: Na sɛ Nyankopɔn brɛ wo adze a, nna ɔno ahomado ntsi a Osiandɛ nyia ɔbrɛ noho adze no, na ɔbɛgye no nkwa.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ nyia onndzi bem no mpo ɔgye no a: Nna ɔno, ɔnam w’ahotsewee do ɔbɛgye wo.
title: JOB

text: Na Job see dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Ndɛ so mo nkɔmbɔdzi yɛ etuatsew: Me nsa yɛ m’apensi do durdur.
title: JOB

text: Ao kɛtseankyɛ minyim beebi mbrɛ mubohu no, Na nkyɛ mekodu ne tsenabew:
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na nkyɛ mubohue m’asɛm egu n’enyim, Na meebisabisa no nsɛm ara yie.
title: JOB

text: Nkyɛ meehu nsɛm a ɔdze bobua me, Na maatse dza ɔbɛka akyerɛ me no ase.
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔnye me bɛham wɔ no tum kɛseyɛ no mu? Dabida; mbom ɔbɛyɛ aso ama me.
title: JOB

text: Hɔ na tseneneenyi nye no beyi atsɛn; Nna mibefi me tsɛmbuafo nsamu korakora.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, mokɔ enyim, na onnyi hɔ; Na ekyir so, na munnhu no:
title: JOB

text: Abankum, mber a ɔreyɛ edwuma, na mohwɛ no a ɔnnyɛ: Osuma noho wɔ enyimfa, na munntum nnhu no.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔno onyim kwan a mefa do: Sɛ ɔasɔ me ahwɛ a, nkyɛ mada edzi dɛ sika kɔkɔɔ mapa a wɔdze afa gya mu.
title: JOB

text: M’anan etsintsim n’anamɔn mu dzendzenndzen: No kwan na mesie, na manndan ammfa nkyɛn.
title: JOB

text: Mennsaan ekyir mimmfii n’anomu mbrasɛm ho; Mesie n’anomunsɛm na ɔsom mo bo yie.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔnodze, ɔayɛ n’adwen, na woana na ɔbɛdan no? Na dza ɔpɛ no, ɔnoara na ɔyɛ.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔno na ɔyɛ dza wɔahyɛ ama no no: Na ndzɛmba a ɔtsetse dɛm pii wɔ ne nkyɛn.
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi morofona wɔ n’enyim; Sɛ modwendwen a, m’akoma tu wɔ no ho.
title: JOB

text: Na Nyankopɔn ama m’akoma etu, Na Otumfo no afona me.
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ woenntwa me annkyen wɔ sum no enyim, Nkyii so ɔannkata sum kebii no do wɔ m’enyim.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Otumfo no nnhyɛ ber nntua emumuyɛfo kaw? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hɔn a wonyim no nnhu dɛm ber no?
title: JOB

text: Binom wɔ hɔ a hɔn dze, wɔtwe asaase he; Wɔfa nguankuw enyimpido, na wɔnyɛn hɔn.
title: JOB

text: Wɔka egyanka n’asoaso ma ɔkɔ, Wɔgye ɔbaa kunafo ne nantwi ahoba.
title: JOB

text: Woyi ɔkɔhweaban edzi wɔ kwan mu: Wɔpam asaase do ehiafo kɔ nsumaa mu.
title: JOB

text: Dɛ mbrɛ sar do hamu nsoasopɔnkɔ pue kɔhwehwɛ edziban no, Dɛmara so na ehiafo no pue kɔhwehwɛ edziban mbɔdzen do ara; Sar no do na wonya edziban ma hɔn mba.
title: JOB

text: Haban mu na wotwa hɔn mbowa edziban; Na wodzi ndzebɔnyɛfo wenyin ture mu mpɛpɛw.
title: JOB

text: Anadwe nyinara wodzi adagyaw da dɛ wonnyi adzefuradze, Na wonnyi akataho wɔ awɔw mu.
title: JOB

text: Mbepɔw do nsutɔree fɔw hɔn, Na wonnyi guansumabew ntsi wɔyɛ ɔbotan etuu.
title: JOB

text: Binom wɔ hɔ a wɔtsew ngyanka fi enumfo ano, Na wɔgye hianyi hɔ ahobadze:
title: JOB

text: Ma wɔnenam no adagyaw mu a wonnyi adzefuradze, Wɔasoasoa ewifua efiefi no, naaso wɔda kɔm;
title: JOB

text: Wɔyɛ ngo wɔ hɔn afasu mu; Wotsiatsia hɔn nsatwer do, naaso wodzi nsukɔm.
title: JOB

text: Hɔn a wɔda wuso no apensi fow fi kurow no mu. Na epirafo no hɔn akra su frɛ mboa; Naaso Nyankopɔn nnhu no dɛ emumuyɛdze a.
title: JOB

text: Woyinom na wɔtsew etua wɔ kan no do; Wonnyim n’akwan, Na eso wɔnntsena n’atsempɔn do.
title: JOB

text: Wudzifo dzi kan soɛr ber a adze asa no, na oku hianyi na kɔhweaban; Na anadwe ɔyɛ dɛ wifo.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyefafo enyiwa so tweɔn adansaber, Ɔse dɛ, Enyiwa bi nnkohu me: Na ɔdze akataho kata n’enyim.
title: JOB

text: Sum mu na wobubu adan mu: Naaso obodu enyim kan no, nna wɔatotow hɔnho mbobow mu, Na wɔnnye kan nnyi hwee yɛ.
title: JOB

text: Na hɔn nyinara anapa yɛ hɔn dɛ wu no nwinwin, Osiandɛ wonyim no mu dza oyi hu.
title: JOB

text: Wɔyɛ ehur wɔ nsu enyi; Wɔdom hɔn kyɛfa wɔ asaase do: Na obiara nnkɔ wenyin nture no mu.
title: JOB

text: Dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyew na nsukɔm nan esukwankyɛba no: Dɛmara so na samanadze dze yɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ bɔn no.
title: JOB

text: Awotoa werɛ befir hɔn; nsunsuma bedzi hɔn nam; Wɔrennkaa hɔn bio: Na emumuyɛfo bobubu dɛ dua.
title: JOB

text: Wɔmemen bɔnyin a onnyi ba no: Na wɔnnyɛ ɔbaa kunafo ayamuyie.
title: JOB

text: Naaso Nyankopɔn dze no tum yi akatakyi fi hɔ: Wotum nya asetsena pa, naaso wonnya nkwa ho enyidado biara.
title: JOB

text: Nyankopɔn ma hɔn asetsena yɛ dwudwoodwo, na wɔdze hɔnho twer iyi; Na n’enyiwa wɔ hɔn akwan do.
title: JOB

text: Woehuhor hɔn; naaso mber kakrabaabi na wonnyi hɔ; Nyew, ɔbrɛ hɔn adze, oyi hɔn fi kwan no mu dɛ nyimpa nyinara, Na wotwitwa hɔn gu dɛ eburow mbɛtsem.
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔnntse dɛm a? Afei woana na ɔbɔbɔ me ɔtor, Na ɔakyerɛ dɛ aba biara nnyi m’asɛm yi mu?
title: JOB

text: Nna Suhinyi Bildad buaa dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Tumdzi na suro yɛ Nyankopɔn dze; Ɔno na ɔyɛ asomdwee wɔ ne mbea sorɔnsorɔm mu.
title: JOB

text: Ana wobotum ebu no dɔm ano? Na woana na ne kan nnsoɛr no do?
title: JOB

text: Dasanyi besi dɛn atsen wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim? Anaa ɔbɛyɛ dɛn ma nyia ɔbaa awo no no no ho bɛtsew?
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, bosoom mpo mmpaa hyerɛɛn wɔ n’enyim, Na nworaba so ho nntsew wɔ n’enyi do:
title: JOB

text: Na akantam dasanyi a ɔyɛ nsaamaa yi! Na nyimpa ba a ɔyɛ abowaba yi!
title: JOB

text: Na Job see dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Mbrɛ ɔwo esi na aboa nyia onnyi tum a! Mbrɛ ɔwo esi na agye abasa a onnyi ahoɔdzen nkwa a!
title: JOB

text: Mbrɛ ɔwo esi na etu nyia onnyim nyansa fo, Na eyi nyimdzee mu a ɔdɔɔ so akyerɛ a!
title: JOB

text: Na woana na ɔwo aka nsɛm akyerɛ no, Na ebɛn sunsum, na ofi wo mu puei yi?
title: JOB

text: Hɔn a woewuwu ho popo Wɔ nsu na no mu atsefo no ase.
title: JOB

text: Samanadze dzi adagyaw wɔ n’enyim, Na ɔsɛɛ nnyi akataho.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔtserɛw kwaa mu kata bea kwawee do, Na ɔdze asaase sɛn mbrɛ hwee nnyi.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔkyekyer nsu hyɛ no mununkum kebii mu; Na mununkum mmpaae wɔ n’ase.
title: JOB

text: Omunum ahengua enyim, Na ɔtserɛw no mununkum mu kata ho.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na oetwa he wɔ nsu enyi Dze ekodu kan na sum ehyiae.
title: JOB

text: Ɔsor edum ho popo Na hɔn ho bow hɔn wɔ ne nkaenyim ano.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔdze no tum nu po mu, Na ɔnam ne ntseasee do sɛɛ po dɛnkyɛmnyin.
title: JOB

text: Ɔnam no sunsum do na sor hyehyɛ; Ne nsa na oehwira abowatsena a no ho yɛ har no mu.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, iyinom nye n’akwan n’anoano: Na mbrɛ huhuhuhu a yɛtse no wɔ no ho dua suar a! Na no tum asenaman no dze, woana na obotum atse ase?
title: JOB

text: Na Job maa n’abɛbusɛm do bio, na ɔsee dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Dɛ Nyankopɔn a oeyi m’eyiedzi kɔ, Na Otumfo no a oeyi me kra awerɛhow no, tse ase yi;
title: JOB

text: Na mber dodow a nkwa da ho wɔ mo mu, Na Nyankopɔn nkwahwea wɔ m’ahwentokura mu yi;
title: JOB

text: Ampaara m’anofamfa rennka nsɛmfun, Nkyii so me tɛkyerɛma nnkɔbɔ ndaadaa dzin.
title: JOB

text: Nyankopɔn mpa ngu dɛ mubobu hom bem: Mirinnyi m’emudzi mmfi moho araa ma ekodu dɛ mubowu.
title: JOB

text: Medze me ndzeyɛtsenenee mu dzendzenndzen, na mirinngyaa mu: M’akoma nnsopa me mber tsentsen a metse ase yi.
title: JOB

text: Wɔmma me tamfo nyɛ dɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi, Wɔmma nyia ɔsoɛr tsia me no nyɛ dɛ brakyewnyi.
title: JOB

text: Na dabrabanyi n’enyidado nye ebɛnadze, aber a Nyankopɔn etwa no do, Aber a oeyi ne kra kɔ no?
title: JOB

text: Ana Nyankopɔn betsie no sufrɛ, Aber a ɔfona bɛba no do no?
title: JOB

text: Ana no ho bɛsɛpɛw no wɔ Otumfo no ho, Na ɔafrɛ Nyankopɔn mber nyinara mu?
title: JOB

text: Mebɛkyerɛkyerɛ hom wɔ Nyankopɔn nsa do; Dza ɔwɔ Otumfo ho no mirinnsiw do.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, hom nyinara hom ehu; Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ayɛ gyan dɛm yi?
title: JOB

text: Iyi nye nyimpa dzebɔnyɛnyi ne kyɛpɛn a onya no wɔ Nyankopɔn hɔ, Na ahyɛdofo egyapadze a wonya no wɔ Otumfo no hɔ.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ne mba dɔr a, wɔdɔr ma afona; Na ne yafumba no, edziban remmee hɔn.
title: JOB

text: Hɔn a wofi mu bɛka no wobesie hɔn wɔ owu mu, Na ne mbaa ekunafo runntwa sukwadwom.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ɔpra dwetɛ hyɛ kuw dɛ huntuma, Na osiesie ntar dɛ dɛtse mpo a;
title: JOB

text: Ɔno dze, obesiesie, na mbom ɔtseneneenyi na ɔdze bɛhyɛ, Na nyia odzi bem no na ɔbɛkyɛ dwetɛ no mu.
title: JOB

text: Osi ne dan dɛ ebubumbaba, Na ɔtse dɛ pata a ɔweɔmfo bɔ.
title: JOB

text: Ɔkɛda hɔ dɛ ɔdzefo, naaso ɔnnkɔsoɛr dɛm bio; Obobue n’enyiwa no, nna onnyi hɔ.
title: JOB

text: Ihu fa no dɛ nsu; Anadwe na ehum wia no kɔ.
title: JOB

text: Boka mframa soa no kɔ, na ofi hɔ kɔ; Na ɔpra no fi ne tsenabew.
title: JOB

text: Na Nyankopɔn bɔtow egu no do, na ɔrenngye no nkwa: Onya pɛ dɛ oguan fi ne nsamu.
title: JOB

text: Nkorɔfo bɔbobɔ hɔn nsamu egu no do, Na wɔabobɔ no do nhwiroma etu no efi ne tsenabew akɔ.
title: JOB

text: Ampaara, mona bi wɔ hɔ a dwetɛ wɔ mu, Na bea bi wɔ hɔ ma sika a wɔhor.
title: JOB

text: Dadze wotu no wɔ famu, Na boran wɔnan fi ɔbo mu.
title: JOB

text: Nyimpa tum ma sum no tun twa: Ɔbɔntse araa kodu ekyirekyir Dze hwehwɛ sum kebii na owu no nwinwin mu abo.
title: JOB

text: Na otu mona kronn kɔ mbrɛ nyimpa biara nntse hɔ; Anamɔn a otwa mu no werɛ fir no; Oefi nyimpa nkyɛn sensɛn ekyirekyir, oridzi adande.
title: JOB

text: Asaase a edziban fi mu ba no: Ɔdan n’ase ba sor dɛ gya.
title: JOB

text: N’abo no mu nye hoabo ne dabew, Na ɔwɔ sikamfutuw so wɔ hɔ.
title: JOB

text: Ɔkwan no anoma edzinam bi nnyi mu, Nkyii so ɔkom enyiwa nnhunii.
title: JOB

text: Ahantan mbowa nntsiatsiaa do, Na eso gyata bɔyafo nntwa mu hɔ.
title: JOB

text: Ɔtsen ne nsa ka ɔtwerɛbo botan; Obutuw mbepɔw wɔ no ndwow mu.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na otwitwa abotan mu aka; Na n’enyiwa hu adze a ɔsom bo biara.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na osisiw esutsen kwan ma ɔnnsosɔw; Na adze a osuma no, ɔno na oyi pue kan mu.
title: JOB

text: Na nyansa dze, hen na wobohu no? Na ntseasee ananmu so wɔ hen?
title: JOB

text: Dasanyi nnyim no bo; Nkyii so wonnhu no wɔ atseasefo asaase do.
title: JOB

text: Bun dɔnkuronn no se dɛ, Onnyi mo mu: Na po so se dɛ, Onnyi me nkyɛn.
title: JOB

text: Wɔmmfa sika mapa nnya, Nkyii so wonnker dwetɛ mma ne tsibo.
title: JOB

text: Wɔmmfa Ofir sika nntwa ne tsibo, Wɔmmfa epopobibirbo a ɔsom bo, anaa hoabo nntɔ.
title: JOB

text: Sika na ahwehwɛ nnye no nnsɛ: Nkyii so wɔmmfa sika mapa n’edwindze nnsesa.
title: JOB

text: Wɔmmbɔ nankyenema anaa ahwehwɛbo dzin: Nyew, nyansa no bo sen mbota dze.
title: JOB

text: Etiopia kratsebo nnye no nnsɛ, Nkyii so wɔmmfa sika mapa nntwa ne tsibo.
title: JOB

text: Nna dɛm a henfa koraa na nyansa fi ba? Na ntseasee ananmu so wɔ henfa?
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ wɔdze esuma atseasefo nyinara enyiwa, Na wɔdze akam sor ntumbowa.
title: JOB

text: Ɔsɛɛ na owu se dɛ, Yɛdze hɛn aso atse ne nka.
title: JOB

text: Nyankopɔn na ɔtse no kwan ase, Na ɔno na onyim ne tsenabew.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔno na ɔhwɛ asaase ewiei, Na ohu sor nyina ase:
title: JOB

text: Aber a ɔhyɛɛ mframa dur too hɔ: Nyew, osusu nsu dɛ mbrɛ no nsusui tse no.
title: JOB

text: Aber a ɔhyɛɛ nyankom mbra, Na ɔyɛɛ kwan maa senaman n’enyinam no:
title: JOB

text: Nna ohunii, na ɔdaa no edzi; Otsintsiim no, nyew, na ɔhwehwɛe puei.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔsee nyimpa dɛ, Hwɛ, dɛ irusuro EWURADZE no, nye nyansa; Na irifi bɔn ho eguan, nye ntseasee.
title: JOB

text: Na Job maa n’abɛbusɛm do bio, na ɔsee dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Ao kɛtseankyɛ metse no dɛ nkan no abosoom no mu, Dɛ nda no a Nyankopɔn hwɛɛ mo do wɔ mu no;
title: JOB

text: Aber a ne kandzea hyerɛnee wɔ m’etsifi, Na medze ne kan nantsewee wɔ sum mu no;
title: JOB

text: Dɛ mbrɛ metse wɔ me nda pa no mu, Aber a Nyankopɔn n’esumadze wɔ m’asesee do no;
title: JOB

text: Aber a Otumfo no da ho wɔ me nkyɛn, Na me mba so bɔ mo ho aprɔw no;
title: JOB

text: Aber a medze seradze fɔw m’anan ho, Na botan hue ngo esutsen dze ma me no!
title: JOB

text: Aber a mupuei kɔr kuropon ano, Na misiesiee m’egua wɔ abɔntsen do a,
title: JOB

text: Mberantsɛ hun me na wɔdze hɔnho sumae, Na nkɔdaa soɛree gyinagyinae;
title: JOB

text: Mbapɔmba gyaa kasa, Na wɔdze hɔn nsa totoo hɔn ano;
title: JOB

text: Mbakomba ndze taa dzinn, Na hɔn tɛkyerɛma femfaam hɔn anomu.
title: JOB

text: Na aber a asowa tsee no, nna ohyiraa me; Na aber a enyiwa hun me no, nna odzii me dase;
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ megyee ohianyi a osu frɛ, Na egyanka no so a onnyi obi a ɔbɔboa no no.
title: JOB

text: Nyia ɔreyɛ ayew no ne nhyira baa mo do: Na memaa ɔbaa kunafo n’akoma toow ehurusi ndwom.
title: JOB

text: Mufuraa ndzeyɛtsenenee, na ɔkataa mo ho, Me pɛrpɛr yɛɛ dɛ ahentar na abɔtsir.
title: JOB

text: Meyɛɛ enyiwa dze maa onyifurafo, Na meyɛɛ anan dze maa apakye.
title: JOB

text: Meyɛɛ egya dze maa hianyi: Na nyia minnyim no no mpo n’asɛm mohwehwɛɛ mu maa no.
title: JOB

text: Na mubuu brakyewnyi no n’adadaw, Na muhwiim afonam no fii ne se mu.
title: JOB

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Mubowu wɔ me berɛbuw mu, Na mebɛma me nda adɔɔ so dɛ anhwea:
title: JOB

text: Mo ndwow atsen kɔ nsu ho, Na bɔsu so tɔ gu m’abaw do anadwe nyinara.
title: JOB

text: M’enyimnyam yɛ fofor wɔ mo mu, Na m’egyen dan fofor wɔ me nsamu.
title: JOB

text: Emi na nkorɔfo yɛɛ aso maa me, na wɔtweɔnee, Na wɔyɛɛ komm tsiee m’apam.
title: JOB

text: Me nsɛm ekyir wɔannkasa bio, Na me kasaa tɔɔ hɔn do.
title: JOB

text: Na wɔtweɔɔn me dɛ wɔrotweɔn nyankom; Na wobuee hɔn anomu tɛtɛɛtɛr dɛ wɔregye ɔbɛsɛ nsu.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ meserew mekyerɛ hɔn a, wɔnngye nndzi; Na m’enyim ne ntsewee no wɔnntow nnkyen famu.
title: JOB

text: Mesaan mu yii hɔn kwan, na metsenaa dɛ tsitsir, Na metsenaa dɛ ɔhen wɔ dɔm mu, Dɛ obi a ɔkyekye awerɛhowfo werɛ.
title: JOB

text: Na afei hɔn a wɔyɛ mbofra sen me sereserew me, Hɔn a hɔn egyanom mpo mopoow dɛ medze hɔn bɛhyɛ mo nguankuw do nkraman mu no a.
title: JOB

text: Nyew, hɔn nsamu tum no, ebɛn mfaso na ɔbɛyɛ me? Nyimpa a hɔn mu ahoɔdzen asa.
title: JOB

text: Hia na kɔm ntsi wɔafomfɔn; Wɔwewe asaase kɛsɛɛ do wɔ ɔsɛɛ na amamfo kusuww mu.
title: JOB

text: Wɔtsetsew nkyenhaban wɔ ndua do: Na sar do mfuwamfuwa ndwow nye hɔn edziban.
title: JOB

text: Woetu hɔn efi nyimpa mu; Wɔpɔw dzi hɔn ekyir dɛ wodzi wifo ekyir.
title: JOB

text: Bɔnsa mu a hɔ yɛ hu na wɔtsetsee, Wɔ asaase na abotan etu mu.
title: JOB

text: Ndua ntamu na wosu dɛ asoaso, Nsason ase na wɔsam.
title: JOB

text: Wɔyɛ dɛ egyangyantwimba, nyew, nyimpa a wonnyi dzin mba a; Wɔpaam hɔn fii asaase no do.
title: JOB

text: Na afei mabɛyɛ hɔn ndwom, Nyew, mabɛyɛ fen ama hɔn.
title: JOB

text: Mo ho yɛ hɔn nkɔw, wɔbɔ me kyɛ kegyina nkyɛn, Na wɔnntwentweɔn ho koraa dɛ wobehima m’enyi do ntafi mpo.
title: JOB

text: Ɔnam dɛ Nyankopɔn asan m’ahoma na oehiahia mo ho ntsi, Hɔn so wɔatow ahohyɛdo akyen wɔ m’enyim.
title: JOB

text: M’enyimfa do na nkusiwa no soɛr Wosun m’anan fa nkyɛn, Na woyi hɔn sɛɛ akwan ba mo do.
title: JOB

text: Wɔsɛɛ mo kwan, Wɔyɛ ma mo mbusu da edzi, Mekyerɛ nyimpa a wonnyi aboafo.
title: JOB

text: Wɔba dɛ wɔnam tokur a ɔtrɛ mu: Wopirew hɔnho ba mo do wɔ efitu no mu.
title: JOB

text: Hu adan aba mo do, Wɔpam m’enyidzii dɛ mframa; Na me yieyɛ etwa mu kɔ dɛ mununkum.
title: JOB

text: Na afei me kra anan wɔ mo mu; Ahohiahia nda esusuo mo mu.
title: JOB

text: Anadwe hodwow me mbiew mu wɔ mo mu, Na yaw no a ɔwewe me no nngyaa.
title: JOB

text: Me yarba ne dzendzen ntsi m’atar asakyer: Ɔkyekyer mo ho dɛ sortar no kɔn.
title: JOB

text: Ɔatotow me akyen adɛtsebir mu, Na madan dɛ dɛtse na nso.
title: JOB

text: Musu mefrɛ wo, na ɔwo nngye me do: Migyina hɔ, na ɔwo ehwɛ me hann.
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo adan ayɛ etsiɔdzen wɔ mo do; Ɔwo edze wo nsa a ɔyɛ dzen nye me dzi esi.
title: JOB

text: Ɔwo na ama me do ama mframa, Ɔwo na ema metsena do tutu kɔ; Na ɔwo na enan me wɔ ehum mu.
title: JOB

text: Na minyim dɛ ɔwo edze me bɛma owu, Na fi a wɔahyɛ ama atseasefo nyinara mu.
title: JOB

text: Ampaara ɔrenntsen ne nsa nnka efitu ahyɛmukuw; Kaansa ɔyɛ ne sɛɛ mpo a, osian iyinom ntsi obi bosu afrɛ.
title: JOB

text: Ana mennsu amma nyia ɔwɔ fona mu? Ana me kra no werɛ annhow wɔ hianyi ntsi?
title: JOB

text: Naaso ber a m’enyi da papa kwan no, nna bɔn aba; Na aber a morotweɔn kan no, nna sum aba.
title: JOB

text: M’ayamudze hur, na ɔnnhom; Ahohiahia nda aba mo do.
title: JOB

text: Mebir tumm nenam, naaso ommfi ewia: Migyina bagua no mu, na metsea mu frɛ mboa.
title: JOB

text: Mayɛ nua ama mpataku, Na nyɛnko ama nsohor.
title: JOB

text: Mo wer ebir, na orifi mo ho, Na ahohur rehyew me mbiew.
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi me nsankutsen adan nkɔmbɔdzi, Na m’atɛntɛbɛn adan hɔn a wosu ndze.
title: JOB

text: Mennye m’enyiwa dzii ahyɛmu dɛ; Monnkɔhwɛ ɔbaabun
title: JOB

text: Na ebɛnadze nye Nyankopɔn ne kyɛfa a ofi sor, Na Otumfo no n’egyapadze a ofi sorsor?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔnnyɛ mbusu mma brakyewnyi, Na amandzehu so mma emumuyɛfo?
title: JOB

text: Ana nnyɛ ɔno na ohu m’akwan, Na ɔkan m’anamɔntutu nyinara?
title: JOB

text: Sɛ medzi egyangyandze ekyir, Na m’anan apɛ ntsɛm wɔ ndaadaa ho a;
title: JOB

text: Wɔmma wonker me wɔ nokwar nsɛn mu, Na Nyankopɔn bohu me tsenenee;
title: JOB

text: Sɛ m’anamɔn adan efi kwan no do, Na m’akoma dzi m’enyi ekyir nantsew, Na sɛ nkekaa bi fam me nsa ho a:
title: JOB

text: Ɔno dze, wɔmma mundua, na bi so ndzi, Nyew, wɔmma wontutu me haban mu ndɔbaa ngu.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ wɔadaadaa m’akoma akɔ ɔbaa bi ho, Na makɛtsɛw me nyɛnko abowano a:
title: JOB

text: Ɔno dze, wɔmma me yer nyam mma obi, Na obi so mbutuw no do.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔno na ɔyɛ ewudzisɛm kɛse; Nyew, ɔno na ɔyɛ emumuyɛ a ntsɛmbuafo tua ho kaw bɔn.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔno na ɔyɛ gya a ɔhyew kɔ Ɔsɛɛ mu, Na nkyɛ obotutu mo ndɔbaa nyinara.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mubuu m’akowaa anaa m’afonabaa asɛm enyimtsia, Aber a wɔnye me kasakasae a:
title: JOB

text: Ɔno ebɛnadze koraa na sɛ Nyankopɔn soɛr a mebɛyɛ? Na sɛ ɔbɛsera a, ebɛn mbuae na medze mubobua no?
title: JOB

text: Ana nnyɛ nyia ɔyɛɛ me wɔ yafun mu no na ɔyɛɛ no? Ana nnyɛ obi na osinsiaan hɛn wɔ yafun mu?
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mesianka ehiafo efi hɔn ahwehwɛdze ho, Anaa mama ɔbaa kunafo enyi ebu;
title: JOB

text: Anaa monkotsee medzi mo trɔma, Na egyanka enndzi mu bi a;
title: JOB

text: Dabida, ofi ne mbofraber mu na menyɛɛn no dɛ egya, Na ofi ne na yamu na mayɛ no kwankyerɛfo;
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mehu obi a tam abɔ no ntsi ma ɔrehera, Anaadɛ ɔkɔhweaban dɛ onnyi akataho a;
title: JOB

text: Na sɛ oennhyira me dɛ, Mo nguan ho nhwi na ɔdze bɔɔ no hyew a,
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mama me nsa do etsia egyanka, Osiandɛ minyim dɛ mowɔ tum wɔ kuropon mu a:
title: JOB

text: Ɔno dze, wɔmma m’abatsir nhuan mfi abatsir biew no mu, Na m’abasa mbubu mfi ne biew do.
title: JOB

text: Na amandzehu a ofi Nyankopɔn hɔ yɛɛ hu dze maa me, Na ne kɛseyɛ ntsi, menntum annyɛ ndzɛmba a ɔtse dɛm.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ sika na medze ayɛ m’enyidado, Na mase sika mapa dɛ, Ɔwo nye m’awerɛhyɛmu;
title: JOB

text: Sɛ m’enyi gyee dɛ m’ahodze yɛɛ kɛse ntsi, Na dɛ me nsa kaa no dodow ntsi;
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mohwɛɛ ewia wɔ ber a ɔhyerɛnee, Anaa bosoom dɛ ɔnam ne hyerɛn mu;
title: JOB

text: Na sɛ wɔadaadaa m’akoma nsumaa mu, Na m’ano afew me nsa ho a:
title: JOB

text: Nna nkyɛ mibedzi ator akyerɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔwɔ sor no, Na iyi so yɛ emumuyɛ bi a atsɛmbuafo tua ho kaw.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ m’enyi gyee nyia okyir me no ne nsɛɛe ho, Anaa memaa m’enyi gyee wɔ aber a mbusu too no a;
title: JOB

text: Dabida, mamma m’ano kwan ma ɔannyɛ bɔn, Dɛ medze ndom mibebisa no nkwa.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ m’asesee mu nyimpa annse dɛ, Woana na obotum ehu obi a ne nam ammee no?
title: JOB

text: Ɔhɔho biara annsoɛ abɔntsen do; Osiandɛ mubuebuee mo mbobow maa kwantsennyi;
title: JOB

text: Sɛ mekataa me mbrato do dɛ Adam, Dɛ medze m’emumuyɛ sumaa mo bo mu;
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ musuroo nyimpadodow kɛse no ntsi, Na ebusua ebusua enyimtsiabu yii me hu, Ma meyɛɛ komm, na memmpue abowano.
title: JOB

text: Ao kɛtseankyɛ meenya obi a obetsie me: Hwɛ, me nsewhyɛdze nye yi, wɔmma Otumfo no mbua me; Na nkyɛ me nsa nka odunwoma no a me tamfo no akyerɛw no!
title: JOB

text: Ampaara nkyɛ medze bɔto me batsir do; Nkyɛ medze bɛkyekyer moho dɛ abɔtsir.
title: JOB

text: Nkyɛ mebɛka m’anamɔn no dodow akyerɛ no; Nkyɛ mobɔtwe epin no dɛ ɔhenba.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ m’asaase tseatsea mu tsia me, Na n’akɔfi ka bɔ mu su a;
title: JOB

text: Sɛ midzii n’aba bi a menntua kaw, Anaa mama no wuranom ahwer hɔn nkwa a:
title: JOB

text: Wɔmma nsoɛ mfifir nhyɛ ewifua ananmu, Na nkyɛkyɛr nhyɛ atoko ananmu. Job ne nsɛm no abɔ adze.
title: JOB

text: Nna mbanyin baasa yi gyaa Job bua, osiandɛ obu noho tseneneenyi wɔ nankasa n’enyi do.
title: JOB

text: Nna Buzinyi Barakel ba Elihu a ofi Ram ebusua mu no, n’ebufuw dzɛwee wɔ Job do, osiandɛ obuu noho tseneneenyi seen Nyankopɔn.
title: JOB

text: Na no bo fuuw ne mfɛfo baasa no so; osiandɛ woennya mbuae biara bio, naaso nna woebu Job fɔ.
title: JOB

text: Afei nna Elihu atweɔn ana ɔrekasa akyerɛ Job, osiandɛ hɔn wɔyɛ mpanyin sen ɔno.
title: JOB

text: Na aber a Elihu hun dɛ mbuae nnyi mbanyin baasa no anomu bio no, nna n’ebufuw dzɛwee.
title: JOB

text: Nna Buzinyi Barakel ba Elihu buae na ɔsee dɛ, Meyɛ abofra, na hom dze wɔyɛ nkɔdaa; Dɛm ntsi na mikyinkyimii, na mammper dɛ mebɛkyerɛ hom m’adwen.
title: JOB

text: Mesee dɛ, Nyinkyɛr nkasa ana, Ɛhɛɛ ma mfe dodow nkyerɛkyerɛ nyansa.
title: JOB

text: Mbom sunsum bi wɔ nyimpa mu, Na Otumfo no no sunsum na ɔma hɔn ntseasee.
title: JOB

text: Nnyɛ akɛsefo na wɔyɛ enyansafo, Nkyii so nnyɛ hɔn a woenyin no na wɔtse atsɛmbusɛm ase.
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi na mese dɛ, Hom ntsie me; Mo so mebɛkyerɛ m’adwen.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, motweɔɔn hom nsɛm, Meyɛɛ aso maa hom ntsɛnyiyi, Mber a hom rohwehwɛ dza wɔbɛse no.
title: JOB

text: Nyew, mekyɛɛn aso maa hom, Na hwɛ, obiara nnyi hɔ a ne nsɛm bɔɔ Job, Na otumii buaa no.
title: JOB

text: Hom nhwɛ yie ma hom annse dɛ, Yeehu nyansa; Nyankopɔn na ɔbɔ no gu, nnyɛ nyimpa a:
title: JOB

text: Na ɔnnhyehyɛɛ ne nsɛm nntsiaa me; Nkyii so meremmfa hom nsɛm mu mbua no.
title: JOB

text: Hom ho abow hom, mmbua bio: Hom nnyi asɛm kor mpo ka.
title: JOB

text: Na montweɔn, osiandɛ hom nnkasa ntsi, Osiandɛ hom gyina hɔ dzinn, na hom mmbua bio ntsi?
title: JOB

text: Emi so mubobua m’afamu dze, Emi so mebɛkyerɛ m’adwen.
title: JOB

text: Na nsɛm ahyɛ me ma; Sunsum a ɔwɔ mo mu no hyɛ me.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, me yafun tse dɛ nsa a wonntuu ano; Ɔtse dɛ nsa nwoma nkotoku afofor a ɔreyɛ apaapaa.
title: JOB

text: Mebɛkasa, ma mo ho atɔ me; Mubobue m’anofamfa na mebua.
title: JOB

text: Ɔmmpar me, mma mma monnhwɛ nyimpa biara enyim; Nkyii so meremmfa abɔdzin ndzɛfɛdzɛfɛw mma nyimpa biara.
title: JOB

text: Na minnyim abɔdzin ndzɛfɛdzɛfɛw ma, Ɔno dze nkyɛ me yɛfo bɛfa me akɔ ntsɛmara.
title: JOB

text: Na afei Job, tsie me kasaa ɛ, Na yɛ aso ma me nsɛm nyinara.
title: JOB

text: Afei hwɛ, mebue m’ano, Me tɛkyerɛma rekasa wɔ m’adadaw mu.
title: JOB

text: Me nsɛm bɛka m’akoma ne tsennyɛ: Na dza m’anofamfa nyim no wɔbɛka no pefee.
title: JOB

text: Nyankopɔn no sunsum na ɔyɛɛ me, Na Otumfo no n’ahom na ɔmaa me nkwa.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ibotum a, bua me; Siesie wo nsɛm yie wɔ m’enyim, soɛr gyina.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, mowɔ Nyankopɔn afamu dɛ woara: Mo so awendɛtse na wɔdze yɛɛ me.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, mo ho hu remma innsuro, Nkyii so mo nhomdo rennyɛ wo do dur.
title: JOB

text: Ampaara ɔwo akasa wɔ m’asomu, Na matse wo nsɛm dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Mo ho tsew, mbrato nnyi mo ho; Midzi bem, nkyii so emumuyɛ bi nnyi mo mu:
title: JOB

text: Naaso hwɛ, Nyankopɔn hwehwɛ mansosɛm bi etsia me, Obu me dɛ ne tamfo;
title: JOB

text: Ɔdze m’anan ahyehyɛ mpokyerɛ mu, Ɔhyɛ m’akwan nyinara nsew.
title: JOB

text: Afei tsie ɛ, Job, hwɛ, murubua wo, iyi mu na enntsen; Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn so sen dasanyi.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔwo nye no perper? Osiandɛ ommbu ne nsɛm biara ho nkontaa.
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn kasa prɛko, Nyew, mprɛnu, sɛ nyimpa nndwen ho mpo a.
title: JOB

text: Adaaso mu, anadwe enyido adzehu mu, Aber a nda heii atɔ adasa do, Mpa do nkomtɔ mu;
title: JOB

text: Nna obue adasa hɔn aso, Na ɔsɔw hɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ ano,
title: JOB

text: Ama ɔaatwe nyimpa aasan efi ne ndzeyɛɛ ho, Na oeeyi nkontompɔ efi nyimpa ho esuma;
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔtwe ne kra ekyir fi mona mu, Na no nkwa so fi afona ano wu mu.
title: JOB

text: Wɔdze yaw so tsia no wɔ ne mpa do, Na ne mbiew mu daa aperper:
title: JOB

text: Na no nkwa kyir edziban, Na ne kra kyir adɔkɔdɔkɔ edziban.
title: JOB

text: No honam wew, ma wonnhu; Na ne mbiew a wonnhu no puepue.
title: JOB

text: Nyew, ne kra twe bɛn mona no, Na no nkwa so bɛn asɛɛfo no.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ bɔfo bi wɔ ne nkyɛn, Ɔkyeame bi, apem mu ɔbaako bi, Dɛ ɔrekyerɛ nyimpa dza ɔtsen ma no a;
title: JOB

text: Nna ohu no mbɔbɔr, na ɔse dɛ, Gye no fi mona no mu nkɔree mu, Na menya apondze a,
title: JOB

text: Ɔno no honam bɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm asen abofra dze; Ɔsan kɔ ne mberantsɛber nda mu:
title: JOB

text: Ɔbɔ Nyankopɔn mpaa, na n’enyi sɔ no: Ma ɔdze ehurusi hu n’enyim: Na ɔdan dasanyi ne tsenenee ma no.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔtow ndwom wɔ nyimpa enyim, na ɔse dɛ, Mayɛ bɔn, na makyeakyea dza ɔtsen, Naaso ɔnnye me enndzi no wenwennwen:
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔagye me kra efi mona no mu nkɔree mu, Na mo nkwa bɔhwɛ kan.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, yinom nyinara na Nyankopɔn yɛ, Mprɛnu, nyew mprɛnsa, wɔ nyimpa ho,
title: JOB

text: Dɛ ɔdze ne kra bɛsan efi mona no ho, Ma wɔdze nkwa kan aadan no kan.
title: JOB

text: Hyɛ no nsew yie, Job, tsie me: Mua w’ano, ma menkasa.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ewɔ asɛm bi ka a, bua me: Kasa, na mepɛ dɛ mubu wo bem.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ɔnntse dɛm a, ɔno tsie mara: Mua w’ano, na menkyerɛ wo nyansa.
title: JOB

text: Elihu sɔɔw ne kasaa do dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Enyansafo, hom ntsie me nsɛm; Na hom a hom wɔ nyimdzee, hom mma me aso.
title: JOB

text: Na asowa na ɔsɔ nsɛm hwɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ adadaw so sɔ edziban hwɛ no.
title: JOB

text: Wɔmma yɛnsan mu nyi dza ɔtsen mma hɛnho: Wɔmma yenhu dza oye wɔ hɛnara hɛn mu.
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ Job ase dɛ, Metsen, Na Nyankopɔn agye me bem kɔ:
title: JOB

text: Naaso me bem mu ara na woebu me torfo; M’epirakur nnyi edur, kaansa mbrato nnyi mo mu mpo a.
title: JOB

text: Nyimpa bɛn na ɔtse dɛ Job a Ɔnom emumuyɛ dɛ nsu?
title: JOB

text: Nyia ɔkɔ emumuyɛ anyɛnkoyɛ mu, Na ɔnye nyimpa bɔn nantsew no a.
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ ɔase dɛ, Ɔnnyɛ mfaso biara mma nyimpa Dɛ ɔnye Nyankopɔn bɛnantsew.
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi hom a hom wɔ ntseasee, hom ntsie me: Ɔmpar Nyankopɔn, dɛ ɔbɛyɛ ndzeyɛbɔn; Na Otumfo no, dɛ ɔbɛyɛ emumuyɛ.
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ nyimpa n’edwuma ho kaw na otua no, Na ɔma nyimpa biara nya no dɛ mbrɛ n’akwan tse.
title: JOB

text: Nyew, ampaara, Nyankopɔn rennyɛ adzebɔn. Nkyii so Otumfo no rennkyea atsɛmbu.
title: JOB

text: Woana na ɔdze asaase hyɛ ne nsa? Anaa woana na oesiesie wiadze nyina?
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ɔnoara yɛ n’adwen dɛ, Ɔbɔtwe sunsum na n’ahom nyinara aba ne nkyɛn a;
title: JOB

text: Nkyɛ honam nyinara bɔbɔ mu asɛɛ; Na nyimpa asan akɔ huntuma mu bio.
title: JOB

text: Afei sɛ ewɔ ntseasee a, tsie iyi: Yɛ aso ma me nsɛm.
title: JOB

text: Aso obi a okyir pɛrpɛr bɔhwɛ aman do? Na ɔwo ibobu nyia ɔtsen na ɔyɛ katakyi no fɔ?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔfata dɛ wɔbɛse ɔhen dɛ, Ohuhunyi nye wo? Anaa ekunyin dɛ, Ndzebɔnyɛfo nye hom.
title: JOB

text: Na burbur nyia ɔmmfɛr mbapɔmba enyim, Na eso ommbu obirɛmpɔn bi nnsen kɔhweaban? Na hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ ne nsaano edwuma.
title: JOB

text: Amonmu ara na wowu, mekyerɛ esuom a; Ɔman no hihim na wɔsen kɔ, Na akatakyi no wɔpra hɔn kɔ, wɔnndze nsa.
title: JOB

text: Na n’enyiwa wɔ nyimpa n’akwan do, Na ohu no nkɔree nyinara.
title: JOB

text: Sum bi nnyi hɔ, na owu nwinwin bi so nnyi hɔ, A emumuyɛfo dze hɔnho bosuma.
title: JOB

text: Na onnhia Nyankopɔn biribiara bio dɛ obohu no nyimpa ho, Ana ɔaama ɔakɔ n’enyim atsɛmbu mu.
title: JOB

text: Obubu akatakyi mu esinesin wɔ akwan a wɔnnhwehwɛ no mu, Na ɔdze binom hyehyɛ hɔn ananmu.
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔhyɛ hɔn ndwuma nsew; Na obutuw hɔn anadwe, ma wɔsɛɛ.
title: JOB

text: Ɔbobɔ hɔn dɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo Wɔ nyimpa enyi do petee;
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ wofii n’ekyir danee faa nkyɛn, Na wɔammpɛ dɛ wobu n’akwan biara bi.
title: JOB

text: Ma wɔama hianyi ne nkekamu edu ne nkyɛn, Na ɔatse amandzehufo nkekamu.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ɔno ma ahodwe a, nna woana koraa na obotum ebu fɔ? Na sɛ ɔdze n’enyim suma a, woana na obotum ahwɛ no? Sɛ wɔreyɛ ama man o, nyimpa baako o, pɛr:
title: JOB

text: ama ennsuronyame nyimpa no eenndzi hen, Ma obi eennsua man no efir.
title: JOB

text: Na aso obi see Nyankopɔn dɛ, Masɔw ntsea, na morommfom bio?
title: JOB

text: Dza munnhu no, woara kyerɛkyerɛ me: Sɛ mayɛ emumuyɛdze a, merennyɛ bio anaa?
title: JOB

text: Aso n’akatua bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ woara epɛ, ma eropow yi? Osiandɛ ɔwo na ewɔ dɛ esan mu yi, na nnyɛ emi a: Dɛm ntsi dza woara inyim no, ka.
title: JOB

text: Nyimpa a wɔwɔ ntseasee no bɛse me dɛ, Nyew, nyimpa nyansafo a otsie me no bɛse me dɛ:
title: JOB

text: Job kwetsir nyimdzee kasa, Na nyansa nnyi ne nsɛm mu.
title: JOB

text: Kɛtseankyɛ wɔaasɔ Job ahwɛ ekodu ewiei, Osian no mbuae a ɔtse dɛ emumuyɛfo dze ntsi.
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ ɔdze etuatsew so ka no bɔn ho, Enyimtsiabu mu na ɔbɔ ne nsamu wɔ hɛn mu, Na ɔma ne nsɛm dɔɔ so tsia Nyankopɔn.
title: JOB

text: Elihu sɔɔw ne kasaa do dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo ihu iyi dɛ odzi mu, Na ese dɛ Nyankopɔn beyi me efi mu yi?
title: JOB

text: Naaso ɔwo ese dɛ, Ebɛn yie na ɔbɛyɛ ama wo? Na, ebɛn mfaso na mibenya, asen dɛ meyɛɛ bɔn?
title: JOB

text: Mubobua wo, Na wo mfɛfo a wɔka wo ho no.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ sor, na hu; Na hwɛ wimu a ɔkrɔn sen wo no.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ayɛ bɔn a, ebɛnadze na eyɛ tsia no? Na sɛ wo mbrato dɔɔ so a, ebɛnadze na edze yɛ no?
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ɔwo etsen a, ebɛnadze na edze ma no? Anaa ebɛnadze na ɔgye no wɔ wo nsamu?
title: JOB

text: Nyimpa a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo na wo ndzeyɛbɔn bɛka no; Na nyimpa ba na wo tsenenee bɛyɛ no mfaso.
title: JOB

text: Ahohiahia dodow ntsi na ɔma wosu frɛ; Akatakyi basa ntsi na ɔma wosu frɛ mboa.
title: JOB

text: Naaso obi nnse dɛ, Ehen na mo Bɔfo Nyankopɔn wɔ, Nyia ɔma ndwom anadwe;
title: JOB

text: Nyia ɔkyerɛkyerɛ hɛn sen asaase do mbowa, Na ɔyɛ hɛn enyansafo sen sor ntumbowa no?
title: JOB

text: Hɔ na wosu frɛ, na obi nngye do, Osian nyimpa bɔn hɔn nkontompɔ ntsi.
title: JOB

text: Ampaara Nyankopɔn rinntsie egyangyansɛm, Nkyii so Otumfo no rummbu no hwee.
title: JOB

text: Na akantam mber a ɔwo erese dɛ ɔwo nnhu no no, Asɛm no da n’enyim, na ɔwo etweɔn noara.
title: JOB

text: Na afei, osiandɛ ɔmmbae wɔ n’ebufuw mu, Nkyii so ommbu ahopɔw hweeara;
title: JOB

text: Ntsi na Job bue n’ano wɔ egyangyansɛm mu; Na okwetsir nyimdzee na ɔma ne nsɛm dɔɔ so no.
title: JOB

text: Elihu wiee ne kasaa no dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Ma me kwan kakra, na menkyerɛ wo; Osiandɛ mowɔ asɛm bi so ka wɔ Nyankopɔn afamu.
title: JOB

text: Mebɛfa me nyimdzee wɔ ekyirekyir, Na mebu mo Bɔfo no bem.
title: JOB

text: Na nokwar, me nsɛm nnyɛ akɔhwi: Obi a odzi mu wɔ nyimdzee mu nye wo wɔ hɔ.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, Nyankopɔn yɛ Ɔkɛse na ommbu obiara enyimtsia; Ɔyɛ katakyi wɔ ntseasee ahoɔdzen mu.
title: JOB

text: Ɔnnkora ndzebɔnyɛfo hɔn nkwa do: Mbom ɔdze ahohiahiafo bem ma hɔn.
title: JOB

text: Onnyi n’enyiwa mmfi atseneneefo do: Mbom ɔma wɔnye ahemfo tsena ahengua do, Na ɔma wɔtsena do daa, na wɔama hɔn do.
title: JOB

text: Na sɛ wogu hɔn wɔ mpokyerɛ mu, Na wɔdze ahohiahia ahoma kyekyer hɔn a;
title: JOB

text: Nna ɔkyerɛ hɔn hɔn edwuma, Na hɔn mbrato, dɛ wɔamema hɔnho do.
title: JOB

text: Obue hɔn aso so dze ma nkyerɛkyerɛ, Na ɔhyɛ dɛ wɔnsan mfi emumuyɛ mu.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ wotsie na wɔsom no a, Wobedzi hɔn nda wɔ prɔmprɔmyɛ mu, Na hɔn mfe so wɔ enyigye mu.
title: JOB

text: Na sɛ woenntsie a, wɔbɔtotɔ wɔ afona ano, Na woekwetsi nyimdzee ewuwu.
title: JOB

text: Na hɔn a wɔyɛ akoma mu ennsuronyamefo boaboa ebufuw ano: Sɛ ɔkyekyer hɔn a, wonnsu mmfrɛ mboa.
title: JOB

text: Wowu wɔ mberantsɛber mu, Na wɔhwer hɔn nkwa wɔ ahoɔfifo mu.
title: JOB

text: Oyi ahohiahiafo fi hɔn ahohia mu, Na obue hɔn aso wɔ atseetsee mu.
title: JOB

text: Nkyɛ ɔpɛ dɛ ɔgye ɔwo so fi ahohia mu Kɔ bea tɛtɛr bi do, mbrɛ ahokyer nnyi hɔ; Na seradze ayɛ wo pon do edziban no ma.
title: JOB

text: Naaso ndzebɔnyɛfo atsɛmbu ahyɛ wo ma: Atsɛmbu na pɛrpɛr esuo wo mu dzendzenndzen.
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ ebufuw wɔ hɔ ntsi, hwɛ yie ɔno bɛyɛ na w’ahonya egya wo kɔ; Nkyii so mma mma mpatadze ne kɛseyɛ nndan wo mmfa nkyɛn.
title: JOB

text: Ana w’ahonya botum agye wo, dɛ ɔwo nnkɔkɔ ahohia mu, Anaa w’ahoɔdzen tum nyinara?
title: JOB

text: Mma mmper anadwe ho, Dɛ ɔmbɛpra aman mfi hɔn ananmu.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ yie, mma nngye emumuyɛ enyi: Na iyi na ɔwo w’enyi gye ho sen ahohiahia.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, Nyankopɔn yɛ no tum mu akɛsedze: Woana na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo tse dɛ ɔno?
title: JOB

text: Woana na ɔdze no kwan ahyɛ no do? Anaa woana botum ase dɛ, Ɔwo ayɛ emumuyɛ?
title: JOB

text: Kaa dɛ ebɛkamfo n’edwuma, Dza nyimpa atow ho ndwom no.
title: JOB

text: Nyimpa nyinara ahwɛ ara; Dasanyi hwɛ no ekyirekyir.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, Nyankopɔn so, na yennyim no; Ne mfe no dodow nnyi nhwehwɛmu.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔno na ɔtwe nsu atɔw atɔw a Ofi n’ehubɔhubɔw mu sosɔw tɔ nyankom:
title: JOB

text: Dza wimu hue gu famu Na ɔsosɔw gu nyimpa do pii no.
title: JOB

text: Nyew, ana obi botum atse mununkum ne ntserɛwmu ase, N’ehuntsae mu asenaman no?
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, ɔtserɛw ne kan mu; Na ɔkata po n’ase do.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔnam yinom do na obu aman atsɛn; Ɔno na ɔdze edziban piigyan ma.
title: JOB

text: Ɔdze enyinam katakata ne nsa ho; Na ɔhyɛ ne mbra ma ɔtow bɔ botae no.
title: JOB

text: No mbobɔmu no ka ne mbae no ho asɛm, Mbowakuw so ka asɛm wɔ ehum a ɔreba ho.
title: JOB

text: M’akoma popo wɔ iyi ho, Na otutu fi n’ananmu.
title: JOB

text: Hom ntsie ne ndze ne dede, Na ndze a ofi n’anomu fir no.
title: JOB

text: Ɔnoara na ogyaa mu wɔ sor nyina ase, Na n’enyinam kodu asaase ewiei.
title: JOB

text: N’ekyir no na ndze bi bobɔ mu; Ɔdze no tumdzi ndze no tow asenaman: Na sɛ wɔtse ne ndze a, onnsianka hɔn.
title: JOB

text: Nyankopɔn dze ne ndze tow asenaman nwanwa mu; Ndzɛmba akɛseakɛse na ɔyɛ a yenntum nntse ase.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔse esukwankyɛba dɛ, Tɔ asaase do; Nyankom so no nsutɔree, Na n’ahoɔdzen nsu akɛse no so dɛmara.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno na ɔsɔɔw nyimpa biara ne nsaano: Ama nyimpa a ɔayɛ hɔn no nyinara eehu.
title: JOB

text: Nna mbowadoma kɔ hɔn sumabew, Na wɔtsenatsena hɔn etu mu.
title: JOB

text: Pomu afamu pia no mu na ehum ba: Na awɔw so fi kwaamu afamu.
title: JOB

text: Ɔnam Nyankopɔn n’ehuhuw do na wɔdze nsubo ma; Na nsu no ne tɛtɛr no ada.
title: JOB

text: Nyew, fɔɔfɔɔ ara na ɔdze soa mununkum kebii no, Ɔtsɛw n’enyinam mununkum no mu tɛtɛr:
title: JOB

text: Na ɔnam no kwankyerɛ do dandan bɔ aprɔw, Wɔ wiadze nyina na asaase enyi Ama wɔaayɛ biribiara a ɔhyɛ hɔn:
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ɔdze ma nkyerɛkyerɛ o, ɔdze ma asaase o, Ɔdze ma adɔyɛ o, ɔyɛ ma ɔba.
title: JOB

text: Job, tsie iyi: Gyina dzinn, na dwen Nyankopɔn n’anwanwa dwuma ho.
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo inyim mbrɛ Nyankopɔn dze ne mbra soa hɔn, Na ɔma no mununkum mu enyinam hyerɛn?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo inyim mununkum nkerii, Nyia odzi mu wɔ nyimdzee mu no n’anwanwa dwuma no?
title: JOB

text: Mbrɛ wo ntar mu si yɛ hyew, Aber a osian pomu afamu mframa ntsi, ma asaase ayɛ dzinn no?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo ibotum enye no atsɛw wimu a Ɔyɛ dzen dɛ ahwehwɛ a woegu?
title: JOB

text: Kyerɛ hɛn dza yɛnka nkyerɛ no; Na osian sum ntsi yerunntum nnhyehyɛ hɛn kasaa.
title: JOB

text: Ana wɔnka nkyerɛ no dɛ merepɛ maakasa? Anaa nyimpa bi pɛ dɛ wɔmen no?
title: JOB

text: Na afei nyimpa nntum nnhwɛ kan aber a ɔayɛ hyɛnn wɔ wimu no: Aber a mframa etwa mu, na ɔama hɔ atsew no.
title: JOB

text: Kwaamu afamu na sika senasena fi ba: Nyankopɔn wɔ tumdzi a ɔyɛ hu wɔ no do.
title: JOB

text: Otumfo no ho dze, yerunntum nnhu no; ɔyɛ abɔso wɔ tum mu: Na ɔrenntseetsee wɔ atsɛmbu na pɛrpɛr dodow mu.
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi nyimpa suro no: Osiandɛ ommbu hɔn a wɔyɛ akoma mu enyansafo bi.
title: JOB

text: Nna EWURADZE fi ehum no mu buaa Job dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Woana nye nyia ɔnam nsɛm a nyimdzee nnyi mu do bir afotu enyi yi?
title: JOB

text: Afei bɔ w’asen do dɛ barimba; Na mibebisa wo, na ɔwo eyi me ano.
title: JOB

text: Aber a motoo asaase ne fapem no na ɔwo ewɔ hen? Sɛ ewɔ ntseasee a, ka ɛ.
title: JOB

text: Woana na ɔdze no nsusui too hɔ, sɛ inyim a? Anaa woana na ɔtseen ahoma mu wɔ do?
title: JOB

text: Ebɛnadze do na wɔdze ne fapem tsintsimii? Anaa woana na ɔdze kutuwdo bo no toe?
title: JOB

text: Aber a adzekyee nworaba bɔɔ mu toow ndwom, Na Sor dɔm nyinara bɔɔ ose wɔ enyigye ntsi no?
title: JOB

text: Anaa woana na ɔtotoow po mbobow mu. Aber a obui faa do, dɛ gyama ofi yafun mu rupue no;
title: JOB

text: Aber a medze mununkum yɛɛ n’akataho Na sum kebii so yɛɛ n’abɔyamu no,
title: JOB

text: Na mehyehyɛɛ me mbra maa no, Na misisii adaban na mbobow,
title: JOB

text: Na mesee dɛ, Eha yi na bra bodu, na mma nntra, Na eha ara na w’asorɛkye ntsɛntsɛn no mbegyina, no?
title: JOB

text: Ana ofitsi dɛ wo nda hyɛɛ ase yi ahyɛ anapa do pɛn, Na ama adzekyee ehu ne dzibew;
title: JOB

text: Ama ɔaata esuo asaase n’atsaban mu, Na wɔaapopo ndzebɔnyɛfo efi do da?
title: JOB

text: Ɔadan dɛ dɛtse a ɔhyɛ nsɔwano ase; Na ndzɛmba nyinara sisi hɔ dɛ ntar:
title: JOB

text: Na hɔn kan no wɔdze akam ndzebɔnyɛfo, Na abasa a wɔama do no woebu mu.
title: JOB

text: Ana akɛhɛn po no nsunyiwa mu? Anaa anantsew bun eduodoo eduodoo mu?
title: JOB

text: Ana woeyi wu no mbobotsen no akyerɛ wo? Anaa ehu wu no nwinwin mbobotsen no?
title: JOB

text: Ana ehu asaase ne tɛtɛr mu? Sɛ inyim ne nyinara a, ka ɛ.
title: JOB

text: Ehen na kwan a wɔdze kɔ kan ne tsenabew wɔ, Na sum so, n’ananmu wɔ hen?
title: JOB

text: Ma ɔwo edze bɔkɔ ne he do, Na ɔwo ahyɛ ne fi ho akwan no nsew?
title: JOB

text: Ɛhɛɛ, ɔwoara inyim, nna wɔawo wo bi a, Nna edzi mfe pii so!
title: JOB

text: Ana akɛhɛn esukwankyɛba no korabea, Anaa ehu sorbo no korabea no,
title: JOB

text: Dza makora do esie fona mber, Ama ko na sa da no?
title: JOB

text: Ebɛn kwan na kan nam do hyerɛn, Dza ɔdze boka mframa bɔ asaase do no?
title: JOB

text: Woana na oeyiyi aka ama nsuyirii, Anaa kwan ama senaman n’enyinam no;
title: JOB

text: Dɛ ɔbɛma nyankom atɔ asaase mbrɛ nyimpa nnyi no do; Sar a nyimpa nnyi mu no do;
title: JOB

text: Dɛ ɔbɛma daadzehun amamfo no amee; Na ɔama mfunoma no afefɛw?
title: JOB

text: Ana nyankom wɔ egya? Anaa woana na ɔwoo bɔsu a ɔsosɔw no?
title: JOB

text: Woana ne yafun mu na nsubo fi ba? Na sor bɔsu kyenkyenee no, woana na ɔwoo no?
title: JOB

text: Nsu da dɛ ɔbo, Na bun no n’enyi apam.
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo ibotum akyekyer Aberwa na mba no n’ahoma, Anaa asan Etsekwagyan n’abɔyamu?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo botum eyi ewia kwan mu nworaba no epue wɔ ne ber mu? Anaa egya Ɔbɔɔ nda esuon nye ne mba?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo inyim sor mbra? Na ibotum ahyehyɛ no tumdzi wɔ asaase do?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo ibotum ama wo ndze do ekodu mununkum mu, Ama nsu pii aabɛkata wo do?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo ibotum asoma enyinam, ma wɔaakɔ, Na wɔaase wo dɛ, Hɛn nye yi?
title: JOB

text: Woana na ɔdze nyansa ahyɛ akoma mu? Anaa woana na ɔdze ntseasee ama adwen?
title: JOB

text: Woana na ɔdze nyansa botum akan mununkum? Anaa woana na ohue sor nsu nkotoku no gu,
title: JOB

text: Aber a huntuma no pem yɛ siw, Na dɛtse atɔw atɔw no abɔ mu afemfam ho no?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo na eyɛ ha nya afonam ma gyataber, Anaa ema ngyatamburwa mee,
title: JOB

text: Aber a wobutubutuw hɔn etu mu, Na wɔtsetse dɔtɔ mu dɛ wɔretsɛw no?
title: JOB

text: Woana na osiesie akonkoran n’edziban ma no, Aber a ne mba su frɛ Nyankopɔn, Na wokyin wɔ edziban a ho ayɛ dzen ntsi no?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo inyim mber a botan do iwi dze wo? Anaa ɔwo ehyɛ aber a ndoa dze ko awoo nsew?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo ekan abosoom dodow a hɔn efur dze nyin? Anaa ɔwo inyim mber a wɔdze wo?
title: JOB

text: Wɔkotow wɔwo hɔn mba, Wɔtow hɔn yaw kyen.
title: JOB

text: Hɔn mba kokwa, wonyin wɔ haban mu; Wofir edzi kɔ, na wɔnnsan mmba bio.
title: JOB

text: Woana na oegyaa hamu asoaso dɛ ɔmfa noho ndzi? Anaa woana na ɔasan hamu asoaso nkyehoma?
title: JOB

text: Nyia medze sar pradada no ayɛ ne fi, Na nkyen asaase no yɛ ne tsenabea.
title: JOB

text: Ɔsereserew kurow ne gyigyeegye, Nkyii so ɔnntse ɔkafo ntseatseamu no.
title: JOB

text: Mbepɔw do nkyinii nye n’edzidzibea, Na odzi adze momon biara ekyir.
title: JOB

text: Aso ɔnantwi bɔyafo bɛpen dɛ ɔsom wo? Anaa ɔbɛtsena wo mbowa edzidzidaka ho?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo edze ahoma bɛsa ɔnantwi bɔyafo wɔ funtumka ho? Anaa obofuntum abɔn no edzi w’ekyir?
title: JOB

text: Ana ebɔtwer no, osiandɛ n’ahoɔdzen so ntsi? Anaa ibegyaa w’edwuma mu ama no?
title: JOB

text: Ana ebɛgye no edzi dɛ ɔno na ɔdze w’aba bɛba fie, Na ɔaboa w’ewuporoweebea eburow no ano?
title: JOB

text: Sohor bɔ n’atsaban mu ehurusidzi mu; Ana ne ntsaban na ne ntɛkyerɛ tse dɛ esukɔnkɔn dze?
title: JOB

text: Ɔtow na ogyaa ne nkyirefuwa wɔ asaase do, Na ɔbɔ no hyew wɔ huntuma mu.
title: JOB

text: Na no werɛ fir dɛ anan botum adwerew no, Anaa abowa bɔyafo betsiatsia do.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ etsiɔdzen wɔ ne mba do, dɛ gyama wɔnnyɛ nedze: Kaansa ne berɛ yɛ gyan mpo a, ɔmmfa no ho;
title: JOB

text: Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn ama nyansa abɔ no, Nkyii so ɔamma no ntseasee.
title: JOB

text: Aber a ɔma noho do wɔ sor no, Ɔsereserew pɔnkɔ na no do tsefo.
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo edze pɔnkɔ n’ahoɔdzen maa no? Anaa ɔwo edze nhwi hugyaa ahyehyɛ no kɔn?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo na ayɛ no ma ohuruhuruw dɛ abɛbɛw yi? Ma no hwenmubɔ ne dzenyɛ tu akoma yi?
title: JOB

text: Ɔtwerɛw bɔnsa mu, na odzi ehurusi wɔ n’ahoɔdzen mu: Opue kehyia akofo a woemia.
title: JOB

text: Osi suro atwetwe, na n’abaw mu mmbu; Nkyii so ɔnnsan ekyir mmfi afona enyim.
title: JOB

text: Egyen kotoku wosow wɔ no do, Peaa na egyen menaba gyaframee so.
title: JOB

text: Ɔdze enyiber gyigyeegye men asaase no; Nkyii so ɔnngye nndzi dɛ ɔyɛ abɛn ndze.
title: JOB

text: Mpɛn dodow a abɛn hɛn no, nna ɔtsea mu dɛ, Yɛɛ! Na ɔtse ko hua wɔ ekyirekyir, Asafohemfo mbobɔmu, na esebɔ no.
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔnam wo nyansaa do na akrɔma tu, Na ɔtserɛw ne ntsaban mu wɔ pomu afamu?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔnam w’anosɛm do na ɔkɔrpɔn ma noho do, Na ɔyɛ no buw wɔ sor?
title: JOB

text: Ɔtse botan do, na ɔwɔ ne dabew wɔ hɔ, Botan ano hwironhwirom, na akoban do.
title: JOB

text: Hɔ na ofi serasera afonam; N’enyiwa hu no ekyirekyir.
title: JOB

text: Ne mba so hwiew bɔgya: Na mbrɛ atɔfo wɔ no, hɔ na ɔwɔ.
title: JOB

text: Nkyii so EWURADZE see Job dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Aso nyia ɔyɛ nyiyiano no ɔnye Otumfo no bɛham? Nyia ɔnye Nyankopɔn gye kyim no, wɔmma ombua ɛ.
title: JOB

text: Nna Job buaa EWURADZE dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, musuar; mumbua wo dɛn? Me nsa na medze to m’ano.
title: JOB

text: Makasa prɛko, na murummbua; Nyew, mprɛnu, na moronnkɔ kan bio.
title: JOB

text: Nna EWURADZE fi ehum no mu buaa Job dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Afei bɔ w’asen do dɛ barimba: Mibebisa wo, na ɔwo aka akyerɛ me.
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo bogura m’atsɛmbu no so? Ibobu me fɔ, ma ɔwo edzi bem.
title: JOB

text: Anaa ewɔ abasa a ɔtse dɛ Nyankopɔn dze? Na edze ndze a ɔtse dɛ nedze bɔbɔ mu?
title: JOB

text: Afei fa akɛseyɛ na tumdzi hyehyɛ woho; Na fa enyimnyam na ahoɔfɛw kata woho.
title: JOB

text: Hue w’ebufuw mbordo no gu: Na hwɛ obiara a ɔyɛ ntsɛn na brɛ no adze.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ obiara a ɔyɛ ntsɛn, na fa no bra famu; Na tsiatsia ndzebɔnyɛfo do wɔ mbrɛ wogyinaa no.
title: JOB

text: Fa hɔn bɔ mu suma huntuma mu, Kyekyer hɔn enyim wɔ nsumaa bea no do.
title: JOB

text: Nna emi so mebɛka no wo ho Dɛ wankasa wo nsa enyimfa na ɔbɛgye wo.
title: JOB

text: Afei hwɛ esuson a meyɛɛ no kaa wo ho no; Odzi efuw dɛ nantwi.
title: JOB

text: Afei hwɛ, n’ahoɔdzen wɔ ne sisiw mu, Na no tum wɔ ne yafun mu ntsin mu.
title: JOB

text: Ohim no dua dɛ nkyindur ndua: Ne nserɛ mu ntsin so pempam ho.
title: JOB

text: Ne mbiew yɛ dɛ boran a woehun mu; N’akwaa tse dɛ adaban.
title: JOB

text: Ɔno nye Nyankopɔn akwan no mu tsitsir: Nyia ɔyɛɛ no no nkotsee na obotum ama n’afona aka no.
title: JOB

text: Ampaara mbepɔw fa edziban ma no; Hɔ na hamu mbowadoma nyinara gor.
title: JOB

text: Nsoɛndua ase na ɔda, Ndzɛmbir na atakyɛ nsumaa mu.
title: JOB
