text: Nsoɛndua dze no nwinwin kata no do, Esukɔn do ndua bɔ no aprɔw.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, sɛ esutsen yir a, no ho mmpopo: Sɛ Jordan yir kodu n’ano mpo a, n’akoma nntu.
title: JOB

text: Aso obi bɛkyer no aber a ɔwɔ atsɛwee no, Anaa wɔdze efir bohwira no hwen mu?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo ibotum edze nkwaba atwe dɛnkyɛmnyin? Anaa edze ahoma bɛkyekyer ne gyirama?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo ibotum edze ntampehoma ahyɛ no hwen mu? Anaa edze kɔtɔkorba bɔbɔ n’afon mu?
title: JOB

text: Ana obedzi wo ntotɔserɛ pii? Anaa ɔbɛkasa kasa mberɛw akyerɛ wo?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔnye wo bedzi ahyɛmu, Dɛ ɔwo ebɛfa no ayɛ akowaa daa?
title: JOB

text: Ana ɔwo enye no bɔgor dɛ mbrɛ enye anoma gor? Anaa ebɛkyer no ama wo mbabaawa?
title: JOB

text: Ana apofo ekuwekuw dze no bedzi bata? Anaa wɔbɛkyɛ no mu wɔ abatafo mu?
title: JOB

text: Ana edze dadze nsoɛ bɛhyɛ no wer ma, Anaa edze nam mpeaa bɔwɔ ne tsir?
title: JOB

text: Fa wo nsa ka no na hwɛ ɛ; Ɔwoara ibohu w’enyiwa mu, nnkɛbɛn no bio.
title: JOB

text: Hwɛ, enyidado biara nnyi hɔ dɛ ibotum: Ana nnyɛ no hwɛ gyan ara mpo na ɔma obi hwe ase?
title: JOB

text: Obiara n’enyi nnyɛ dzen dɛ ɔbɔbɔ no nkenyan; Na sɛ dɛm a, woana koraa nye nyia obotum emi m’enyim gyina?
title: JOB

text: Woana na ɔse ɔama me biribi, ma menhyɛ no ananmu? Adze biara a ɔwɔ asaase do nyina no medze a.
title: JOB

text: Merennyɛ komm wɔ n’akwaa ho, Na n’ahoɔdzen tum, na n’ahoɔfɛw so ho.
title: JOB

text: Woana na ɔbɛpa no ho akataho? Woana na ɔbɛba ne menyiamfrɛ mbɔho no mu?
title: JOB

text: Woana na obobue n’enyim mbobow no? Ne se ho nyina yɛ hu.
title: JOB

text: No ho abon dzendzen no nye n’ahohyehyɛ, Wɔatotow mu dɛ wɔdze nsɔwanodze ayɛ.
title: JOB

text: Kor bɛn kor so dodow, Ma mframa nntum mmfa hɔn ntamu.
title: JOB

text: Wɔfemfam ho nkorkor; Woesuo mu kor, ma wɔtsetsew hɔn mu a ɔnnkɛyɛ.
title: JOB

text: No huntsii pa gya, Na n’enyiwa tse dɛ adzekyee enyisoatsɛw.
title: JOB

text: Atsɛn a ɔdzɛw fi n’anomu pue, Na gyansenama tutu fi mu.
title: JOB

text: Wusiw fi n’ahwentokura mu pue, Dɛ mbrɛ ofi sɛn a oruhur na nkyɛkyɛr a ɔrehyew mu,
title: JOB

text: N’ahomgu sɔ gyabiriw, Na ogyaframee fi n’anomu pue.
title: JOB

text: Ahoɔdzen wɔ no kɔn mu, Na hu huruhuruw wɔ n’enyim.
title: JOB

text: No honam a ɔsensɛn hɔ femfam ho twer: Wotsintsim no do, wɔtwetwe a ɔnnyɛ.
title: JOB

text: N’akoma tsim hɔ dɛ ɔbo; Nyew, otsim hɔ dɛ famu ewuyambo.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ ɔma noho do a, akatakyi akoma tu: Na ahobow ntsi wɔbobɔ adam.
title: JOB

text: Sɛ obi dze afona tow no a, onntum no; Nnyɛ peaa, egyen menaba, na dadze akodze mpo so.
title: JOB

text: Obu dadze dɛ nkyɛkyɛr, Na boran dɛ duawui.
title: JOB

text: Egyen menaba remma onnguan: Tseabo mu abo yɛ no dɛ mburonan.
title: JOB

text: Obu mpɔtsibaa dɛ mburonan: Ɔserew nkambaa no huuyɛ.
title: JOB

text: N’ase tse dɛ ntankofɛr a n’ano yɛ ndam: Ɔtwe no dɛ ewuporow tseaseanam wɔ adɛtsebir do.
title: JOB

text: Ɔyɛ bun ma ohur dɛ ɔsɛn mu: Ɔyɛ epo dɛ ngo.
title: JOB

text: Ɔma ɔkwan hyerɛn dzi n’ekyir; Obi bobu bun no dɛ oehura gon.
title: JOB

text: Ne saso nnyi asaase do a, Na wɔammbɔ suro amma no.
title: JOB

text: Ɔhwɛ adze biara a ɔkrɔn: Ɔyɛ hen wɔ ahokyerɛ mba nyinara do.
title: JOB

text: Nna Job buaa EWURADZE dɛ,
title: JOB

text: Minyim dɛ ɔwo itum adze nyinara yɛ, Na dɛ wo tsirmpɔw biara worunntum nnsiw no kwan.
title: JOB

text: Woana nye nyia onnyi nyimdzee ntsi ɔpow afotu yi? Dɛm ntsi na meka dza menntse ase yi, Ndzɛmba a ɔyɛ nwanwa dodow ma me a minnyim.
title: JOB

text: Meserɛ wo, tsie, na menkasa; Mibebisa wo, na aka akyerɛ me.
title: JOB

text: Ɔnam asowa ne ntsee nko do na metsee wo nka; Na afei dze m’enyiwa tua wo.
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi mopow moho, na munu moho Wɔ dɛtse na nso mu.
title: JOB

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ EWURADZE kaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Job n’ekyir no, EWURADZE see Temannyi Elifaz dɛ, Mo bo efuw ɔwo na w’anyɛnkofo beenu no: osiandɛ hom annka mo ho asɛm a ɔtsen, dɛ mbrɛ m’akowaa Job ayɛ.
title: JOB

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mfa anantwinyin esuon na nguannyin esuon, na hom nkɔ m’akowaa Job nkyɛn, na hom nkɔbɔ hyew afɔr mma homho: na m’akowaa Job mbɔ hom tsir do mpaa; na ɔno na mebɛpen no, ama menye hom eenndzi dɛ mbrɛ hom nkwaseasɛm tse; osiandɛ hom annka mo ho asɛm a ɔtsen, dɛ mbrɛ m’akowaa Job ayɛ.
title: JOB

text: Nna Temannyi Elifaz na Suhinyi Bildad na Naamatnyi Zofar sii mu kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ hɔn no: na EWURADZE tsiee Job.
title: JOB

text: Na aber a Job bɔɔ n’anyɛnkofo no hɔn tsir mpaa no, EWURADZE daan no ndɔmmumyɛ no: na EWURADZE maa Job adze dodow a nkyɛ ɔwɔ no mbɔho ebien.
title: JOB

text: Nna no nuanom nyinara, na ne nkyerɛbaa nyinara, na hɔn a nkyɛ wɔyɛ n’anyɛnkofo no nyinara, baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔnye no bedzidzii wɔ ne fie: na wogyaam no, na wɔkyekyee no werɛ wɔ mbusu a EWURADZE maa ɔbaa no do no nyinara ho: nyimpa biara so maa no sika, na sika nkaba so kor.
title: JOB

text: Nna EWURADZE hyiraa Job n’ewiei ma ɔseen n’ahyɛse: na onyaa nguan mpemduanan, efumpɔnkɔ mpemesia, anantwi mpamho apem, na nsoasopɔnkɔber apem.
title: JOB

text: Onyaa mbabanyin beesuon na mbabaa baasa so.
title: JOB

text: Na ne mbabaa no, ɔfrɛɛ nyia odzi kan no Jemima; nyia otsia ebien no Kezia; na nyia otsia ebiasa no so Keren-hapuk.
title: JOB

text: Na woennhu mbaa a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw dɛ Job ne mbabaa no wɔ asaase no nyinara do: na hɔn egya memaa hɔn egyapadze wɔ hɔn nuanom mu.
title: JOB

text: Na yi ekyir no Job dzii mfe ɔha eduanan, na ohun ne mba, na ne mba so hɔn mba, mekyerɛ mbasantsen anan.
title: JOB

text: Nna Job wui, nna ɔayɛ akɔdaa a oedzi mfe pii.
title: JOB

text: Osiarfo nye nyimpa a ɔnye emumuyɛfo nntu egyina, Na ɔnnantsew ndzebɔnyɛfo kwan do, Eso ɔnntsena atwetwesifo tsenabea.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mbom n’enyi gye EWURADZE ne mbra ho; Na ɔdwen ho adzekyee na adzesaa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛ dua a ɔtsɛw esutsen ho a Ɔsow n’aba wɔ ne ber mu, N’ahataw so mmpo; Na dza ɔyɛ nyinara bowie yie.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ndzebɔnyɛfo dze wɔnntse dɛm, Wɔtse dɛ ntsɛw a mframa bɔ petse.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi emumuyɛfo rinndzi bem wɔ atsɛmbu mu, Eso ndzebɔnyɛfo rummpue atseneneefo bagua mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ EWURADZE nyim atseneneefo kwan: Na emumuyɛfo kwan dze ɔbɛhera.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na amanaman yɛ gyigyeegye, Na nkorɔfo dwendwen adze gyangyan ho yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Asaase do ahemfo soɛr gyina, Na etumfo no bɔ mu tu egyina Tsia EWURADZE, na ne nyia ɔasera no no dɛ,
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mma yembubu hɔn mpokyerɛ mu, Na yɛntow hɔn nkyehoma mfi hɛnho ngu.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso nyia ɔtse sor no bɛserew: Nyew, EWURADZE besi hɔn atwetwe.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔbɛkasa akyerɛ hɔn wɔ n’ebufuw mu, Na oeyi hɔn hu wɔ n’ebufuhyew mu:
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi EWURADZE na mesi me hen Wɔ me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn Zion do.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛka mbra no ho asɛm: EWURADZE see me dɛ, Ɔwo nye me ba; Emi na ndɛ da yi mawo wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Bisa mo hɔ, na medze amanaman bɛma wo dɛ w’egyapadze, Na asaase ano noho dɛ w’enyadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Edze dadzepoma bobubu hɔn; Ibobubu hɔn posoposo dɛ ɔwemfo awendze.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi ahemfo ee, afei hom nhu nyansa: Asaase do atsɛmbuafo, hom ntsie afotu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa suro nsom EWURADZE, Na hom mfa ahopopo ndzi ehurusi.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa enyidzi mapa mma no amma no bo eemmfuw, na hom aannhyew wɔ kwan no mu, Na aka ketseketse na n’ebufuw adzɛw. Esiarfo nye hɔn a wɔtwer no nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, mbrɛ m’ahohiahiafo dua dɔɔ so a! Hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia me no ayɛ pii.
title: PSALMS

text: Dodowara na wɔka no mo ho dɛ, Mboa bi nnyi hɔ ma no wɔ Nyankopɔn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo, EWURADZE, nye mo ho kyɛm; M’enyimnyam, na me tsir madofo.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze me ndze musu frɛ EWURADZE, Na ofi no koko krɔnkrɔn do bua me.
title: PSALMS

text: Mekɛdae na medae; Minyanee; na EWURADZE kitsa mo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Murunnsuro nkorɔfo mpempem a Wɔabobɔ mo ho nsera ehyia yi.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, soɛr ɛ; me Nyankopɔn, gye me nkwa: Ɔwo na ebubu emumuyɛfo se.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ ɔwo EWURADZE na nkwagye dzi wɔ no: Ma wo nhyira mbra wo man do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, me tsenenee Nyankopɔn, sɛ musu frɛ wo a, gye me do; Aber a mowɔ ahohia mu no, nna ɔwo etseew mu maa me: Hu me mbɔbɔr, na tsie me mpaabɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Na hom nyimpa mba, hom bɛdan m’enyimnyam adapaabɔ ekesi dabɛn? Hom bɔdɔ adze gyangyan, na hom edzi ator ekyir ekesi dabɛn?
title: PSALMS

text: Mbom hom nhu dɛ EWURADZE eyi nyamesuronyi esi nkyɛn ama noho: Na EWURADZE betsie me, sɛ musu frɛ no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mbɔ hu, na mma hom nnyɛ bɔn; Hom nye homankasa hom akoma ndzi nkɔmbɔ wɔ hom mpa do, na hom nyɛ komm.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mbɔ tsenenee afɔr, Na hom mfa hom werɛ nhyɛ EWURADZE mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Dodowara na wɔka dɛ, Woana bɛkyerɛ hɛn dza oye? EWURADZE, tsew w’enyim wɔ hɛn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze enyigye ahyɛ m’akoma mu Akyɛn hɔn a wonyaa eburow na nsa pii no mpo.
title: PSALMS

text: Asomdwee mu na mobɔto moho ase na mada: Osiandɛ ɔwo, EWURADZE, nko na ema metsena hɔ dwudwoodwo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, yɛ aso ma me nsɛm, Na dwen mo nkɔmbɔdzi ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Tsie me nkekamu ndze, me Hen, na me Nyankopɔn: Na ɔwo na mobɔ wo mpaa.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, anapa na ebɛtse me ndze; Anapa na mebɛhyehyɛ me mpaabɔ ama wo, na mahwɛ kwan do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo nnyɛ Nyame a epɛ emumuyɛ; Mbusu rennye wo nntsena.
title: PSALMS

text: Nkwasea rinngyina w’enyim: Ɔwo ikyir emumuyɛfo nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo bɛsɛɛ hɔn a wɔka atorsɛm: EWURADZE kyir bɔgyakafo na esisifo.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, menam w’adɔyɛ dodow no do mebɛba wo fie: Wo ho suro mu na mobɔkotow asɔr akyerɛ w’asɔrfi krɔnkrɔn no do.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, gya me kwan wɔ wo tsenenee mu, wɔ m’atamfo ntsi: Ma wo kwan nyɛ tɔɔtsen wɔ m’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Na nokwardzi bi nnyi hɔn anomu; Hɔn yamu wɔ emumuyɛ; Hɔn meneba yɛ asamandan a ebue; Wɔdze hɔn gyirama dzɛfɛdzɛfɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, bu hɔn fɔ, Ma womfi hɔnankasa hɔn egyinatu ho nhwe ase: Sunsun hɔn gu wɔ hɔn mbrato dodow ntsi: Na wɔatsew wo do etua.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ma hɔn a wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛ wo mu nyinara ndzi ehurusi; Ma wɔmbɔ ose daa wɔ enyigye ntsi. Tserɛw wo bambɔ no wɔ hɔn do. Ama hɔn a wɔdɔ wo dzin so enyi agye wɔ wo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo na ibehyira ɔtseneneenyi: EWURADZE, ɔwo na edze enyimnyam dɛ kyɛm botwa no ho ehyia.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, mma nntwuw m’enyim wɔ w’ebufuw mu, Nkyii so mma nntsea me wɔ w’ebufuhyew mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, hu me mbɔbɔr; osiandɛ makyenkyen: Ao EWURADZE, sa me yarba; na me mbiew adwerew.
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra so ho yerɛw no dɛ: Ao, EWURADZE, ɔnkyɛr dɛn ara?
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, san bra, bɛgye me kra: Gye me nkwa wɔ w’adɔyɛ ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wo ho nkaa nnyi owu mu: Woana na obeyi ayɛw wɔ adakamona mu?
title: PSALMS

text: Maberɛ na m’apensi; Anadwe biara mema me mpa taa nsu mu; Medze me nyinsuwa fɔw me dabew.
title: PSALMS

text: M’enyi yɛ monsoom wɔ awerɛhow ntsi; Ɔayɛ kusukusu wɔ m’atamfo nyinara ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom emumuyɛfo nyinara, hom mfi me nkyɛn mfi; Na EWURADZE atse mo sufrɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE atse mo nkotoserɛ; EWURADZE bɛgye me mpaayi.
title: PSALMS

text: M’atamfo nyinara enyi bɔto, na hɔn ho ahyehye hɔn dɛ: Wɔdze enyito bɛsan ekyir awerɛfir mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, M’EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, ɔwo na muguan modɔ wo: Gye me fi hɔn a wotsiw me nyinara nsamu na yi me:
title: PSALMS

text: Bɛyɛ na wɔaatsetsew me kra mu dɛ gyata, Esunsuan no esinesin, ber a obi nnyi hɔ a obeyi me.
title: PSALMS

text: M’EWURADZE, Nyankopɔn, sɛ mafom; Sɛ emumuyɛdze bi wɔ me nsamu;
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ medze bɔn bi ayɛ nyia ɔnye me tse asomdwee mu a: Na medzi nyia ɔhaw me no mpo emim gyan ara a:
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ɔtamfo no ntsiw me kra, na ɔnkyer no; Nyew, ma ontsiatsia mo nkwa do wɔ famu; Na ɔmfa m’enyimnyam nto huntuma mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, soɛr wɔ w’ebufuw mu, Ma woho do tsia m’atamfo hɔn gyigyeegye yɛ: Na keka wo ho ma me; na ɔwo na ibu atsɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ma aman mboanofo ntwa wo ho nhyia: Na fa hɔn do san kɔ sor.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE bobu aman atsɛn: EWURADZE, bu me atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ me tsenenee tse, na mbrɛ bemdzi a ɔwɔ mo mu tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, ma emumuyɛfo hɔn emumuyɛ mbɔ adze, na ma ɔtseneneenyi ntsim: Na ɔwo nye tsenenee Nyankopɔn a ihu akoma na adwen mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Me kyɛm wɔ Nyankopɔn nsamu, Ɔno na ɔgye akoma mu tseneneenyi nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn yɛ ɔtsɛmbuafo tsenenee, Nyew, Nyankopɔn a ɔda n’ebufuw edzi da biara.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ nyimpa bi ennya nnuho a, Nyankopɔn bɛsew n’afona: Ɔakontom n’egyen, na oewie no siesie.
title: PSALMS

text: Oesiesie owu adze so ama dɛm nyimpa no; Ɔyɛ n’egyen menaba ano ma ɔhye.
title: PSALMS

text: Omumuyɛnyi no nyinsen emumuyɛ; Nyew, oenyinsen ewurkadze, na ɔwo atorsɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Otu mona, na ofun mu, Naaso ɔtɔ mona a noara tui no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: N’ewurkadze bɛsan ebua nankasa n’etsifi, Na n’emim edwir nankasa n’apampamu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛda EWURADZE ase dɛ mbrɛ ne tsenenee tse: Na matow ayɛyindwom ama Ɔsorsor EWURADZE ne dzin.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, hɛn EWURADZE, Mbrɛ wo dzin dua krɔn wɔ asaase nyinara do a! Ɔwo a edze w’enyimnyam akata ɔsor.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo a nkɔkowaba na numfoanomba Tow w’enyimnyam a ɔbor ɔsor mpo no ho ndwom, Ɔwo na esiesie akoban, w’atamfo ntsi, Ama eemua ɔtamfo na ɔwerdzifo no ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ mohwɛ wo sor, wo nsatseaba ano edwuma, Bosoom na nworaba a ahyehyɛ a;
title: PSALMS

text: Nna dasanyi nye woana, na ɔwo ekaa no? Na nyimpa ba, na w’enyi wɔ no do yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo ama aka no kumaabi ma ɔnye Nyankopɔn asɛ, Na edze enyimnyam na enyidzi abɔ no abɔtsir.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ama oedzi wo nsaano edwuma do tum; Ɔwo edze adze nyinara egu n’ananadze:
title: PSALMS

text: Nguan na anantwi nyinara, Nyew, na wiramu mbowadoma so;
title: PSALMS

text: Wimu ntumbowa, na po mu nam, Biribiara a ɔnam po mu akwan do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, hɛn EWURADZE, Mbrɛ wo dzin dua krɔn wɔ asaase nyinara do a!
title: PSALMS

text: Medze m’akoma nyina bɛda EWURADZE ase; Mibeyi w’anwanwa dwuma nyinara akyerɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo mu na mebɛgye m’enyi na medzi ehurusi: Mobɔtow ayɛyindwom ama wo dzin, ɔwo Ɔsorsornyi.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ m’atamfo asan ekyir, Woefintsiw na wɔahera wɔ w’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo edzi m’asɛm ebu me bem; Ɔwo atsena ahengua do ebu atsɛntsenenee.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na aka amanaman enyim, ɔwo na asɛɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo, Ɔwo na apepa hɔn edzin korakorakora.
title: PSALMS

text: Atamfo ewiei aba, wɔayɛ amamfo nwionn nwionn; Hɔn ase ahyew koraa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE dze, ɔtse n’ahengua do dɛ ɔhen daa; Ɔdze n’egua esi hɔ rubu atsɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔno na obobu wiadze atsɛn wɔ tsenenee mu, Obobua amanaman atsɛn wɔ dza ɔtsen mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE bɛyɛ abantsentsen ama nyia wɔtseetsee no, Ɔfona ber mu guandɔbea.
title: PSALMS

text: Na hɔn a wonyim wo dzin dze, wɔdze hɔn werɛ bɛhyɛ wo mu; Osiandɛ ɔwo, EWURADZE, enndaan hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo nngyae da.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom ntow ayɛyindwom mma EWURADZE a ɔtse Zion: Hom nka ne ndzeyɛɛ nkyerɛ aman.
title: PSALMS

text: Na nyia oridzi bɔgya ho wer no ɔkaa hɔn: No werɛ mmfir abrɛfo sufrɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, hu me mbɔbɔr; Hwɛ m’ahohia a muruhu a ofir hɔn a wokyir me, Ɔwo ama me do fi owu aponkɛse ano;
title: PSALMS

text: Ama maaka w’ayɛyi nyinara akyerɛ: Wɔ Zion babaa aponkɛse mu, Mibedzi ehurusi wɔ wo nkwagye mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Amanaman amem wɔ mona a wotui no mu: Efir a wosuae sumae no apa hɔnankasa hɔn anan.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE ada noho edzi, oebu atsɛn: Ɔdze ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi nankasa ne nsaano edwuma esua no efir.
title: PSALMS

text: Emumuyɛfo besian akɔ samanadze, Mekyerɛ amanaman a hɔn werɛ fir Nyankopɔn nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Na no werɛ rimmfir ohianyi daa, Eso ɔbɔbɔnyi enyidado rennyɛ gyan daa.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, soɛr; mma mma ɔdasanyi nndzi nyim: Ma wombu amanaman atsɛn wɔ w’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, yi hɔn hu: Ma amanaman nhu hɔnho dɛ wɔyɛ nyimpa ara.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na igyina ekyirekyir yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na isuma woho wɔ ɔfona mber mu yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Omumuyɛfo ahopɔw ntsi otsiw ɔbrɛfo ɔhyew do; Wɔdze hɔnara hɔn adwen a wɔadwendwen no kyer hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Na omumuyɛfo hyehyɛ noho wɔ n’akoma akɔndɔ ho, Na onyiberfo ka ebususɛm, nyew, oyi EWURADZE ehi.
title: PSALMS

text: Omumuyɛfo no ahomemado dodow ntsi, ɔse dɛ, Hwee mmfa no ho, N’adwen nyinara nye dɛ, Nyankopɔn bi nnyi beebi.
title: PSALMS

text: N’akwan tsim hɔ pintsinn mber nyinara, Ommbu w’atsɛmbu bi koraa: N’atamfo nyinara dze, ɔpeepee hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔse n’akoma mu dɛ, Mirinnhim da; Mbasantsen nyinara mu murunnhu amandze dabiarada.
title: PSALMS

text: Ndom na ndaadaa na emimdzi ahyɛ n’anomu ma: Ewurkadze na emumuyɛ wɔ ne tɛkyerɛma ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtsɛw nsumaa mu wɔ nkurobaase, Odzi nyia odzi bem no ewu wɔ nsumaa mu. N’enyi sa onnyibi nsumaa mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtsɛw kokoa mu dɛ gyata a ɔwɔ no tu mu: Ɔtsɛw dɛ ne nsa bɛka ɔbɔbɔfo: Ne nsa ka ɔbɔbɔfo no, na ɔtwe no wɔ no boa mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔkotow, ɔdzɛɛdzɛw, Na ɔbrɛfo kɔtɔ n’abaw mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔse n’akoma mu dɛ, Nyankopɔn no werɛ efir; Oehuntsa n’enyim; orunnhu ara da.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, soɛr ɛ, Nyankopɔn, ma wo nsa do: Mma wo werɛ mmfir ɔbɔbɔnyi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na omumuyɛfo mmbu Nyankopɔn bi, Na ɔse n’akoma mu dɛ, Ɔwo ronntwe n’aso?
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwoara ehu; na ɔwo na ehwɛ ɔhaw na awerɛhow, dɛ ibosuo mu: Wo nsamu na ɔbrɛfo dze noho hyɛ; Ɔwo na ayɛ egyanka no boafo.
title: PSALMS

text: Bubu omumuyɛfo ne basa; Na nyimpa bɔn dze, hwehwɛ ne ndzebɔnyɛ araa kodu dɛ innhu bi bio.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE yɛ Hen daa daapem: Amanaman ahera efi n’asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, ɔwo atse abrɛfo hɔn ahwehwɛdze. Ɔwo ibetsim hɔn akoma, ɔwo ebɛma w’aso atse:
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ ibobua egyanka na nyia wɔtseetsee no asɛm, Ama ɔdasanyi so a asaase yi ara na ofi mu no ho annyɛ hu bio.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE mu na muguan kosuma: Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom se me kra dɛ, Guan dɛ anoma kɔ hom bepɔw do yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Na, hwɛ, emumuyɛfo kontom egyen, Wɔdze hɔn egyen menaba esi ahoma no do, Dɛ wɔbɔtow no sum mu abɔ nyia ɔtsen wɔ akoma mu:
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ wɔsɛɛ fapem no a, Ɔtseneneenyi bɛyɛ dɛn?
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE wɔ n’asɔrfi krɔnkrɔn no mu, EWURADZE n’ahengua wɔ sor; N’enyiwa hu, na n’enyiwamba ker adasamba hwɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE sɔ ɔtseneneenyi hwɛ: Na omumuyɛfo na nyia ɔpɛ emim dze, ne kra kyir no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbɔtow asenaman egu emumuyɛfo do; Ogya na sɔɔfee na mframa a ɔdzɛw na ɔbɛyɛ hɔn kɔɔpow mu kyɛfa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE yɛ tseneneenyi; ɔpɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee: Hɔn a wɔtsen no na wobohu n’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, boa; na nyamesurofo resa, Na nokwafo rugu wɔ adasamba mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔnye hɔn mfɛfo keka nsɛngyangyan: Ano fenemfenem, na akoma nta, na wɔdze kasa.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE botwitwa ano fenemfenem nyinara egu, Gyirama a ɔka nsɛm akɛse no:
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔase dɛ, Hɛn gyirama na yɛdze bedzi nyim; Yɛwɔ anowerba a ɔyɛ dzen: hɛn wura nye woana no a?
title: PSALMS

text: Abɔbɔfo hɔn afofa, na ehiafo hɔn apensi ntsi, Afei mobɔsoɛr, EWURADZE na ɔse; Medze hɔn besi nkwagye a wɔhaahaw ho no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE ne nsɛm yɛ nsɛm krɔnkrɔn; Dɛ dwetɛ a wɔanan no fononoo mu wɔ famu a, Wɔahoa ho mpɛn esuon.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, ɔwo na ebɔbɔ hɛn ho ban, Na akora hɛn efi mbasantsen yi mu daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ ehuhusɛm huhor wɔ adasamba mu a, Ndzebɔnyɛfo nantsenantsew nkyɛnkyɛn nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, onkodu dabɛn? Ana wo werɛ befir me daa? Edze w’enyim bohuntsa me ekodu dabɛn?
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra nndzi yaw ma onkodu dabɛn, Na awerɛhow ntsena m’akoma mu adzekyee nyinara? Me tamfo nhoran mo do nkodu dabɛn?
title: PSALMS

text: Dwen ho na bua me, EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn: Tsew m’enyi, ɔno bɛyɛ na mada owu nda:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno bɛyɛ na me tamfo ase dɛ, Medzi no do nyim; Ɔno bɛyɛ na sɛ mesan ekyir a m’atamfo edzi ehurusi.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, mo werɛ hyɛ wo mbɔbɔrhu mu; M’akoma enyi bɛgye wɔ wo nkwagye mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔtow ndwom ama EWURADZE, Osiandɛ ɔnye me edzi no ayamuyie mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔkwasampanyi na ɔse n’akoma mu dɛ, Nyankopɔn bi nnyi hɔ. Wɔaprɔw, wɔyɛ mbusu ndwuma; Obi nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛ papa.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE fi sor hwɛ adasa, Dɛ obohu dɛ obi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ badwembanyi, Obi a ɔhwehwɛ Nyankopɔn ekyir kwan.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn nyinara aman nkyɛn; hɔn nyina ho ayɛ nkɔnkɔw; Obi nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛ papa, dabida, nnyɛ ɔbaako mpo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ana emumuyɛfo nyinara nnyi nyimdzee? Hɔn a wodzi me nam dɛ mbrɛ wodzi edziban, Na wɔnnsɔr EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɛhɛɛ, hɔ na hɔn ho bɔpopo kɛse: Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn ka atseneneefo mbasantsen ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom ma ɔbɔbɔfo tsirmu apam yɛ gyan, Naaso EWURADZE nye no guandɔbew.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao nkyɛ Israel nkwagye eefi Zion aba! Aber a EWURADZE dze ne man hɔn egyapadze bɛsan aba no, Nna Jakob bedzi ehurusi, na Israel enyi agye.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, woana na ɔbɔsoɛ wo ntamadan mu? Woana na ɔbɛtsena wo bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do?
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ɔnantsew tɔɔtsen, ɔyɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee, Na odzi nokwar wɔ n’akoma mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ɔmmfa ne gyirama mmbɔ nseku, Eso ɔnnyɛ ne nyɛnko bɔn, Eso ɔnnhyɛ ne nyɛnko ahorba.
title: PSALMS

text: Na obu omumuyɛnyi enyimtsia; Na odzi hɔn a wosuro EWURADZE nyi, Nyia ɔka amandzenya ntam a, ɔnnsakyer.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ɔmmfa ne sika mmfɛm nnsi apempem, Eso ɔnngye nyia odzi bem hɔ mboaba. Nyia ɔyɛ iyinom no betsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, kora mo do: na wo mu na muguan bɛhyɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Mese EWURADZE dɛ, Ɔwo nye m’EWURADZE, Minnyi biribi papa bi kyɛn ɔwo.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ahotseweefo a wɔwɔ asaase do no dze, Hɔn nye enyimnyamfo a m’enyigye nyinara wɔ hɔn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔdze EWURADZE sesa nyame fofor no, wɔma hɔn awerɛhow dɔɔ so: Meremmfa hɔn bɔgyaa huensa no nnkrantse, Eso meremmfa m’ano mmbɔ hɔn enyame dzin.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, ɔwo nye m’egyapadze mu kyɛfa, na mo kɔɔpow: Ɔwo na ema me kyɛpɛn ko hɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Esusuhoma no egu me wɔ mbrɛ oye; Nyew, mowɔ egyapadze a ɔyɛ fɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Mibehyira EWURADZE a ɔama me apam no: Nyew, m’akoma tu me fo anadwe ber.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze EWURADZE esi m’enyim daa: Ɔnam dɛ ɔwɔ m’enyimfa ntsi, murunntutu.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi m’akoma enyi gye, na m’enyimnyam dzi ehurusi: Mo honam so bɛtsena hɔ sɔkyee.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo renndan me kra nngya samanadze; Nkyii so eremma kwan ma wo krɔnkrɔnnyi nnhu mprɔwee.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na ebɛkyerɛ me nkwa kwan: Ahotɔ a ɔmee wɔ w’enyim; Enyigye wɔ w’abanyimfa hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, tsie dza ɔtsen, kyɛn aso ma mo sufrɛ; Yɛ aso ma me mpaayi a ommfi ndaadaa anofamfa mu pue.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma me bemdzi mfi w’enyim mbra; Ma w’enyi nhwɛ adze a ɔtsen.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ ɔwo esɔ m’akoma hwɛ; eba bɛsera me anadwe; Sɛ epɛnsapɛnsa mo mu a, innkohu mo mu bɔn bi, Mabɔ me tsirmu pɔw dɛ m’ano rommfom.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyimpa ndzeyɛɛ afamu dze, ɔnam w’anosɛm do Masɔn moho wɔ ɔkakabemfo no akwan ho.
title: PSALMS

text: M’anamɔn tsim wɔ w’akwan do ara, M’anan ammpatser.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, musu frɛ wo, na ɔwo ebɛgye me do: Kyɛn w’aso ma me, na tsie m’asɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Anwanwa kwan do ara, kyerɛ w’adɔyɛ a ɔmmbɔ adze no, Ɔwo egye hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ guandɔbea fi hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia hɔn no nsamu wɔ w’enyimfa do no,
title: PSALMS

text: Kora me dɛ enyi kyiresua. Fa me huntsa wo ntsaban no nwinwin ase,
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔ emumuyɛfo a wɔfa me afo, M’atamfo kɔkɔɔkɔ a wotwa mo ho hyia no ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Tsema biara nnyi hɔn afamu: Wɔdze hɔn ano kasa ntsɛn ntsɛn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wotsiatsia m’anamɔn mu, afei woetwa mo ho ehyia: Wɔdze hɔn enyi si do dɛ wɔdze me bɔhwe famu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔtse dɛ gyata a n’enyi aber repɛ afonam, Na dɛ gyata ba a ɔretsɛw wɔ mbrɛ osuma.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, soɛr ɛ, Nnye hɔn nsi enyim, ma wondzi nkogu: Fa w’afona gye me kra fi omumuyɛfo no nsamu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, fa wo nsa gye me fi nyimpa nsamu, Nyimpa a, hɔn nkwa kyɛpɛn yɛ wiadze dze, Ma dza ahyehyɛ afa hɔn ho no nhyɛ hɔn yafun ma; Ma hɔn mba nya bi ma ɔmmbor do, Ma mpo wongyaa bi mma hɔn mbɔtoaba.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, mobɔhwɛ w’enyim wɔ tsenenee mu: Sɛ minyan a, m’ahom bɛka moho dɛ mehu wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Modɔ wo, ao EWURADZE, m’ahoɔdzen.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE yɛ mo botan, na m’akoban na me gyefo; Me Nyankopɔn, mo botantsim, ɔwo wo mu na muguan kosuma, Me kyɛm, na mo nkwagye ambɛn, m’abantsentsen,
title: PSALMS

text: Musu frɛ EWURADZE, ɔno a ɔsɛ dɛ woyi no ayɛw no: Na ɔgye me fi m’atamfo nsamu.
title: PSALMS

text: Owu ahoma brabraa mo ho, Na ɔsɛɛ praam mo do dɛ nsu n’awor dzendzen.
title: PSALMS

text: Samanadze nkyehoma brabraa mo ho: Owu ne mfir baa mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: M’ahokyer mu mefrɛɛ EWURADZE, Me Nyankopɔn na musui frɛɛ no: Ofi n’asɔrfi mu tsee me ndze, Na mo su wɔ n’enyim kodur n’asomu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna asaase hihimii na ɔwosowee, Mbepɔw fapem so tutui, Na wohihimii, osian n’ebufuw ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Wusiw fi n’ahwentokura mu firii, Na ogya dzɛwee fi n’anomu puei: Ogyansenama a ɔdzɛw a.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔkontoom ɔsor so, na odwirii; Nna sum kebii dzi n’ananadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔtsenaa Kerub do, na otui: Nyew, otuu wɔ mframa ntsaban do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze sum yɛɛ no huntsabea, n’asesee a etwa no ho ehyia, Nsu kebii, wimu mununkum kusuww.
title: PSALMS

text: Hyerɛn a odzi n’enyim no mu, Na ɔsor abo na ogyansenama puei fii no mununkum kebii no mu bae.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE toow asenaman so wɔ sor, Na Ɔsorsornyi no paapaa ne ndze mu: Ɔsor abo na ogyansenama.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔtotoow n’egyen menaba, na ɔbɔɔ hɔn petsee, Nyew, enyinam pii, na ɔtaan hɔn enyi.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna epo mu nsuka dedaa edzi, Na wiadze mfapem ho dedaa hɔ, Wɔ wo nkaenyim ntsi, EWURADZE, Wɔ w’ahwentokura mu ehuhuw huuhuw no ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtseen ne nsa fi sor bɛfaa me; Ɔtwee me fii nsubansuba pii mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔgyee me fii me tamfo ɔhoɔdzenfo no hɔ, Na hɔn a wokyir me no, osiandɛ nna wɔyɛ dzen dodow ma me.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔbɔtoatoaa me wɔ m’amandzehu da no mu: Na EWURADZE yɛɛ me kyirtaafo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze me fiir edzi so baa beebi a ɔtsew; Ɔgyee me, osiandɛ n’enyi gyee mo ho.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE tuaa me kaw dɛ mbrɛ me ndzeyɛtsenenee tse; Dɛ mbrɛ me nsa ho tsew pa no na oetua me ho kaw.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mesie EWURADZE akwan no, Na mimmfii me Nyankopɔn nkyɛn emumuyɛ mu mmfirii.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ne mbrasɛm nyinara wɔ m’enyim, Na mennyi n’ahyɛdze emmfi me nkyɛn annkyen.
title: PSALMS

text: Midzii mu so wɔ n’enyim, Na misiee moho fii emumuyɛ ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE ahyɛ me ananmu dɛ mbrɛ me ndzeyɛtsenenee tse; Dɛ mbrɛ me nsa ho tsew pa wɔ n’enyi do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔnokwafo no na ɔwo enye no bedzi no nokwar mu; Nyia odzi mu na ɔwo enye no bedzi no emudzi mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia no ho tsew na ɔwo ebɛtsew woho akyerɛ no, Na nyia ɔyɛ kɔntɔnkye na ɔwo ebɛkyea woho akyerɛ no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo ebɛgye ɔman ahobrɛadzefo nkwa; Na enyiwa a ɔtra ntɔn dze ɔwo ebɛberɛ no adze.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, ɔwo na ebɔsɔ me kandzea: EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn bɛtsew mo sum mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, ɔwo na medze wo tu mbirika fa asafo dɔm do; Na me Nyankopɔn na medze no huruw tra atamfo fasu.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm Nyankopɔn yi dze, no kwan tsen: Na EWURADZE n’anohoba yɛ nokwar; Ɔyɛ kyɛm dze ma hɔn a woguan kosuma no mu nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Na woana nye Nyankopɔn, gyedɛ hɛn EWURADZE nko? Na woana yɛ ɔbotan, ka hɛn Nyankopɔn ho?
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn a ɔdze ahoɔdzen bɔ mo do, Na ɔma mo kwan dzi mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔyɛ m’anan dɛ ntrɔmaber anan: Na ɔdze me si me mbea sorɔnsorɔm do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔkyerɛkyerɛ me nsa akodzi; Ma m’abasa tum pon kɔɔber egyen.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, ɔwo edze wo nkwagye kyɛm no so ama me: Na wo nsa enyimfa esuo mo mu, Na wo mboa maa meyɛɛ ɔkɛse.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo atserɛw m’anamɔn mu wɔ m’ase, Na m’anan nntserewee.
title: PSALMS

text: Mibetsiw m’atamfo, na mato hɔn: Nkyii so merennsan dze ekodu dɛ woewie sa.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔbobɔ hɔn ehwiramu ma wonnkotum asoɛr: Wɔbɔtotɔ wɔ m’ananadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo na edze ahoɔdzen abɔ me do ama akodzi no: Ɔwo abrɛ hɔn a wɔsoɛree tsiaa me no adze ahyɛ m’ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na ama m’atamfo so adan hɔn ekyir ama me, Ama maasɛɛ hɔn a wokyir me.
title: PSALMS

text: Wosui frɛe, na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔgye hɔn: Wɔfrɛɛ EWURADZE mpo, naaso ɔanngye hɔn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna meyaam hɔn huntuhuntu dɛ mframa enyim tutuw: Motoow hɔn gu dɛ abrɔn mu dɛtse.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo eyi me efi ɔman aperdzi mu; Ɔwo ayɛ me amanaman do etsitsir: Ɔman a minnyim hɔn mpo na wɔsoom me.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔtsee me nka ara na wobetsiee me: Ananaben brɛɛ hɔnho adze maa me.
title: PSALMS

text: Ananaben bɔɔ hu, Na wɔdze ahopopo fi sumabea bae.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE tse ase; na nhyira nka mo botantsim no; Na abɔso nye mo nkwagye Nyankopɔn;
title: PSALMS

text: Mekyerɛ Nyankopɔn a odzi wer ma me, Na ɔbrɛ aman adze hyɛ m’ase no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na oyi me fi m’atamfo mu: Nyew, ɔwo na ema me do bɔ hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia me do: Ɔwo na iyi me fi nyimpa kakaben ne nsamu.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi, EWURADZE, mebɛda wo ase wɔ amanaman mu, Na matow ayɛyindwom ama wo dzin.
title: PSALMS

text: Nkwagye kɛse na ɔdze ma ne hen; Na ɔyɛ adɔyɛ ma ne nyia wɔasera no no, Ɔdze ma David na n’asefo afebɔɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsor da Nyankopɔn n’enyimnyam edzi; Na wimu kyerɛ ne nsaano edwuma.
title: PSALMS

text: Da kor biara hue asɛm kyerɛ, Na anadwe biara so kyerɛ nyimdzee.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔnnyɛ asɛm eso ɔnnyɛ nkasafua; Wɔnntse hɔn ndze.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso hɔn ndze ekodu asaase nyinara do. Na hɔn nsɛm edu wiadze n’ewiei. Hɔn mu na oesi ntamadan ama ewia,
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno a ofir edzi dɛ ayeforkun a ofi ne pia mu, Tse dɛ ɔhoɔdzenfo a otu enguan no, Ɔdze ahosɛpɛw guan fa no kwan do.
title: PSALMS

text: N’edzifir wɔ ɔsor ano no ho, Na n’aprɔwbɔ kodu n’ase: Na hweeara nnyi hɔ a ohuntsa fi ne hyew ano.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE n’akwankyerɛ dzi mu, ɔdwedwe ɔkra: EWURADZE ne nkyerɛkyerɛ tsen, ɔyɛ okotobonyi onyansafo.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE ahyɛdze tsen, ɔma akoma tɔ yamu: EWURADZE ne mbrasɛm ho tsew, ɔma enyibuei.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE ho enyidzi yɛ wansawansa, ɔwɔ hɔ daa: EWURADZE ne n’atsɛmbu yɛ nokwar, na ɔtsen koraa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔyɛ akɔndɔ sen sika, nyew, ɔsen sika mapa pii: Ɔyɛ fenemfenem so sen ewo na wokyɛm nsosɔe.
title: PSALMS

text: Nkyii so wɔnam hɔn do bɔ w’akowaa nkaa: Na hɔn ndzido mu wɔ akatua kɛse.
title: PSALMS

text: Woana na otum hu no mfom mu? Ɔwoara san mo ho fi bɔn a ohuntsa no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Twe w’akoma ekyir so fi enyidaho bɔn ho; Mma mma wonndzi mo do tum: ɔno na mibedzi mu, Na mo ho bɛsan efi emumuyɛ kɛse ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma m’anomu nsɛm na m’akoma mu adwendwen nyɛ enyisɔ wɔ w’enyi do, Ao EWURADZE, mo botan, na mo pomfo.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE ngye wo do wɔ ɔfona da no mu; Ma ɔno a ɔyɛ Jakob ne Nyankopɔn no mfa wo nsi sorsor;
title: PSALMS

text: Na omfi krɔnkrɔnbea no mbɛyɛ wo mboa. Ma omfi Zion Bepɔw do mbɛhyɛ wo dzen;
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔnkaa w’afɔrbɔdze nyinara, Na ɔmpen wo hyew afɔr do mma wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ɔmma wo w’akoma n’apɛdze, Na ɔmma wo tsirmsɛm nyinara mbra mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma yɛmbɔ ose wɔ wo konyimdzi ho, Na hɛn Nyankopɔn dzin mu na yebesi hɛn mfrankaa: EWURADZE mma w’ebisadze nyinara mbra mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Afei na mehu dɛ EWURADZE gye ne nyia wɔasera no no nkwa; Ofi no sor krɔnkrɔn no bɛgye no do Ɔdze ne nsa enyimfa ahoɔdzen no bɛgye no.
title: PSALMS

text: Binom twer ntseaseanam, na binom twer mpɔnkɔ: Na hɛn dze, yɛbɔbɔ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ne dzin.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn na wɔkotokotow na wɔhwehwe ase: Na hɛn dze, yɛsoɛr, na yegyina hɔ bantsenn.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, ma ɔhen konyimdzi: Sɛ yɛfrɛ wo a, gye hɛn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, w’ahoɔdzen no mu na ɔhen n’enyi bɛgye wɔ; Na wo mboa ntsi, mbrɛ no ho bodua asɛpɛw no a!
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ama no n’akoma n’apɛdze, Na annkam n’ano ebisadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo edze ayamuyie nhyira twar n’ano: Ɔwo edze sika mapa ahenkyɛw bɔ ne tsir.
title: PSALMS

text: Obisaa wo nsamu nkwa, na ɔwo edze maa no; Mekyerɛ nda a ɔwar daa daa.
title: PSALMS

text: N’enyimnyam yɛ kɛse wɔ wo nkwagye mu: Enyidzi na tumdzi na ɔwo edze ma no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo eyɛ no nhyira ara nko daa: Nyew, ɔwo edze w’enyim enyigye ma no ho sɛpɛw no.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ ɔhen no twer EWURADZE, Na ɔnam Ɔsorsornyi n’adɔyɛ do ntsi orunntutu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo nsa bɛka w’atamfo nyinara: Wo nsa enyimfa bɛka hɔn a wokyir wo.
title: PSALMS

text: W’ebufuw ber no mu ebɛma wɔayɛ dɛ gya fononoo. EWURADZE bɛmen hɔn wɔ n’ebufuhyew mu, Na gya ahyew hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ebɛsɛɛ hɔn aba efi asaase do, Na hɔn asefo efi adasamba mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ wosusu bɔn tsia wo: Anaa wɔdwendween adwen bi a, wonnkotum yɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo ebɛma wɔadan hɔn ekyir. Ɔwo ibesiesie w’egyenhoma esi hɔn enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, ma woho do, wɔ w’ahoɔdzen mu: Nna yɛbɔtow ndwom na yɛakamfo w’ahoɔdzen.
title: PSALMS

text: Me Nyankopɔn, ao, me Nyankopɔn, ɔyɛ dɛn na apa me yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔwo enye mo mboa na me nkekamu ntamu atwe yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, me Nyankopɔn, mekeka mu ewiaber, naaso ɔwo immbua, Na anadwe ber so, naaso minnya ahomgye.
title: PSALMS

text: Eso ɔwo eyɛ krɔnkrɔn, Ɔwo etse w’ahengua do, Na ɔwo na Israel ayɛyi nyinara dzi wɔ wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɛn egyanom tweer wo: Wɔtweer wo, na ɔwo egyee hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Wosui frɛɛ wo, na wonyaa nkwagye: Wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛɛ wo mu, na hɔn enyim enngu ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso emi dze, binom bu me dɛ nsaamaa, na nnyɛ nyimpa bi; Nyimpa mu ɔsesɛba, na ɔman mu ɔkwasampanyi.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wohu me nyinara si me atwetwe: Wɔseberseber hɔn ano, wosow hɔn tsir, dɛ,
title: PSALMS

text: Oyi, opireew noho too EWURADZE do; ma ɔngye no ɛ: Sɛ ɔpɛ n’asɛm a, wɔmma ɔngye no.
title: PSALMS

text: Eso, ɔwo nye nyia oyii me fii me na yamu: Mutua me na n’enumfoano no, nna emaa minyaa bambɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ofi yafun mu ara na wɔtoow me kyeen wo do: Ɔwo nye me Nyankopɔn dze fi me na yamu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, mma nnye me ntamu nntwe; na ɔfona abɛn; Na ɔboafo biara nnyi hɔ a ɔbɔboa me.
title: PSALMS

text: Anantwinyin pii etwa mo ho ehyia: Basan anantwinyin akataban etwa ayer me.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔhanhan hɔn anomu wɔ mo do, Dɛ gyata odzifodzepɛfo a ɔropɔw.
title: PSALMS

text: Woehue me egu dɛ nsu, Me mbiew nyinara ehuhuan efi n’akwaa do: Na m’akoma ayɛ dɛ nku a anan.
title: PSALMS

text: M’ahoɔdzen asa dɛ ehina a abobɔ; Na me gyirama afam m’adadaw mu; Na ɔwo edze me ato owu huntuma mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ndzebɔnyɛfo etwa mo ho ehyia: Tse dɛ mbɔdɔmkuw no, wɔbɔ mu ba mo do; Wotuetue me nsa na m’anan mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mutum kan me mbiew nyinara; M’atamfo hwɛ me, na hɔn enyi gye:
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔkyɛ m’akataho mu fa, Na m’atar ho na wɔtwe tonto.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ao, ɔwo EWURADZE, mma nnkɔ ekyirekyir: Ao, me dzenhyɛfo, yɛ ntsɛm bɔboa me.
title: PSALMS

text: Yi me kra fi afona ano; Gye mo nkwa fi dɛm mbɔdɔm no tum ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Gye me fi ogyata no n’anomu; Na me kra a ɔrehaahaa no fi nantwibɔyafo no mmbɛn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔbɔ wo dzin makyerɛ mo nkorɔfo: Mbrɛ dɔm hyia som wo no na mebɛkamfo wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom a hom dzi EWURADZE nyi na hom som no, hom nyi no ayɛw, Hom Jakob asefo nyinara, hom nhyɛ no enyimnyam: Na hom Israel asefo nyinara, hom mfa enyidzi kɛse mma no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔmandzehufo n’amandzehu no, oemmbu no adzeba, eso oennkyir; Nkyii so ɔammfa n’enyim ennhuntsa no; Na mbom aber a osui frɛɛ no no, otsiei.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo nye m’ayɛyi ne farbae na no botae wɔ mboanofo kɛse no mu; Mebɛma m’anohobadze wɔ hɔn a wosuro wo no enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Abrɛfo no bedzidzi na wɔaamee; Hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE ekyir kwan no, beyi no ayɛw: Nyankopɔn mma hom ndzepa daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Asaase ano noho nyinara wɔbɛkaa EWURADZE: Wofi wiadze ne nfɛndzeanan nyinara bɛsan aba no hɔ; Na amanaman mbusuakuw nyinara bɔsɔr no.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ ahendzi no yɛ EWURADZE dze: Na ɔno na odzi amanaman do hen.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, ɔno na ahomemadofo nyinara mpo bɔkotow no; Nyimpa dasanyi biara bɔkotow wɔ n’enyim, Ɛhɛɛ, nyia ɔnoara nntum nnkora ne kra do no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Nkyirmba bɔsom no; Wɔbɛka EWURADZE ho asɛm akyerɛ mbasantsen a odzi do no.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔbɛba na wɔabɛka ne ndzeyɛtsenenee akyerɛ ɔman a wɔbɔwo hɔn no, dɛ, ɔno EWURADZE na ɔayɛ iyi.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE nye mo hwɛdofo; na hwee nnkehia me.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔma meda bea a hɔ yɛ frɔmfrɔm: Ogya me kɔ nsutaae ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔma me kra ho dwe no: Ogya me fa akwantsenenee mu wɔ ne dzin ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, kaansa menam owu bɔnsa kebii mu mpo a, Murunnsuro mbusu bi, osiandɛ ɔwoara wɔ me nkyɛn: W’abaa na wo poma, nna wɔkyekye mo werɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo eto mo pon wɔ m’atamfo enyim: Ɔwo edze ngo sera me tsirmu; ema mo kɔɔpow yɛ ma bu do.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, yie na adɔyɛ ara nko na ɔbɛka mo do mo nkwa nda nyinara: Na mebɛtsena EWURADZE fie daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Asaase na dza ɔwɔ do nyinara yɛ EWURADZE dze, Wiadze na hɔn a wɔtse mu nyinara so.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ ɔno na ɔtoo ase wɔ po do, Na ɔdze tsintsiim nsuyirii do.
title: PSALMS

text: Woana na obotum afow EWURADZE no kokwaa no? Na woana na obegyina ne bea krɔnkrɔn no do?
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ne nsa ho nnyi fi, na n’akoma mu tsew; Nyia ɔmma n’enyi nngye adze gyangyan ho, Na ɔnnka ntam akɔhwi mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na obenya EWURADZE hɔ nhyira, Na no nkwagye Nyankopɔn no bobu no bem.
title: PSALMS

text: Iyi nye mbasantsen a wɔhwehwɛ n’ekyir kwan, Hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ w’enyim no, Jakob Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, hom aponkɛse, hom mmema hom tsir do ɛ; Na hom tsetse mbobow, hom mmema homho do: Ma enyimnyam Hen no nhɛn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Woana nye enyimnyam Hen no? EWURADZE ɔhoɔdzenfo na otumfo no a, EWURADZE ɔko mu otumfo no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, hom aponkɛse, hom mmema hom tsir do ɛ; Nyew, hom tsetse mbobow, hom mmema homho do: Ma enyimnyam Hen no nhɛn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Woana nye dɛm enyimnyam Hen yi? Dɔm EWURADZE no a, Ɔno nye enyimnyam Hen no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, ɔwo na mema me kra do mema wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, me Nyankopɔn, wo mu na medze mo werɛ mahyɛ, Mma mma m’enyim nngu ase; Mma mma m’atamfo nnka me nnhyɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, mma mma hɔn a wɔtwer wo no mu biara enyim nngu ase: Mbom hɔn a wɔka atorsɛm gyan no na ma hɔn enyi nto.
title: PSALMS

text: Kyerɛ me w’akwan, Ao, EWURADZE; Kyerɛkyerɛ me w’atsempɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Kyerɛkyerɛ me ma menantsew wɔ wo nokwar no mu; Na ɔwo nye mo nkwagye Nyankopɔn; Ɔwo na motwer wo mber nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, kaa w’ehumbɔbɔr na w’adɔyɛ; A ɔwɔ hɔ fi tsetse no.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nkaa me mbofraber mu bɔn, anaaso me mbrato: Kaa me dɛ mbrɛ w’adɔyɛ tse, Ao, EWURADZE, na dɛ mbrɛ wo yieyɛ so tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔnam dɛ EWURADZE ye na ɔtsen ntsi: Ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo kwan a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔfa do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze ahobrɛadzefo fa ɔkwan tsenenee do: Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn ne pɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE dze adɔyɛ na nokwardzi kyerɛkyerɛ Hɔn a wodzi n’ahyɛmu na ne mbrasɛm do no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, wo dzin ntsi Fa m’emumuyɛ kyɛ me, na ɔdɔɔ so.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyimpa biara a osuro EWURADZE no, Ɔno na EWURADZE bɛkyerɛkyerɛ no kwan a ɔmfa do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ne kra bɛtsena hɔ dwudwoodwo; Na n’asefo benya asaase no edzi.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE da n’etsirmpɔw edzi kyerɛ hɔn a wosuro no; Na ɔkyerɛ hɔn n’ahyɛmu no.
title: PSALMS

text: M’enyiwa tsim EWURADZE do daa, Osiandɛ ɔno na obeyi m’anan efi efir mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, dan w’enyi bra mo do na hu me mbɔbɔr; Na meyɛ ankonam na ɔwerɛhonyi.
title: PSALMS

text: M’akoma mu ɔfona adɔɔ so: Ao yi me fi m’ahokyer mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ m’amandzehu na m’atseetsee; Na fa mo bɔn nyinara kyɛ me.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ m’atamfo hɔn dodow; Na etsiɔdzen kyir a wokyir me.
title: PSALMS

text: Kora me kra do, na gye me: Mma mma m’enyim nngu ase, na ɔwo wo mu na mo werɛ hyɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma nokwardzi na tsenenee nkora mo do, Osiandɛ ɔwo na m’enyi da wo kwan.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Nyankopɔn, gye wo man Israel Fi no fona nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, fa me bemdzi ma me, na emi dze, mo nokwardzi mu na manantsew: Medze mo werɛ so ahyɛ ɔwo EWURADZE mu a minnhihim.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, hwehwɛ mo mu, na sɔ me hwɛ, Sɔ m’akoma na m’adwen hwɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Na w’adɔyɛ wɔ m’enyi do; Na manantsew wo nokwar no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mennye nyimpa gyangyan nntsenae; Nkyii so merennye ndabrabafo mmbɔ mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mikyir nyimpa bɔn nguabɔ, Na merennye ndzebɔnyɛfo nntsena.
title: PSALMS

text: Mohohor me nsa ho wɔ bemdzi mu. Ma mobɔ w’afɔrmbukyia ho aprɔw, ao, EWURADZE:
title: PSALMS

text: Motow aseda ndwom, Na meka w’anwanwa ndwuma nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, modɔ wo tsenabea no, Na beebi mbrɛ w’enyimnyam tse no.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nnyi me kra nnka ndzebɔnyɛfo ho nnkɔ, Anaaso mo nkwa nka bɔgyakafo ho:
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a mbusubɔ wɔ hɔn nsamu, Na mboabadzi ahyɛ hɔn nsa enyimfa ma no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze mebɛnantsew mo nokwardzi mu: Gye me, na hu me mbɔbɔr.
title: PSALMS

text: Fa m’anan si mbrɛ hɔ taa: Mboanofo no mu na mibehyira EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE nye me kan na mo nkwagye; woana na mubosuro no? EWURADZE nye mo nkwa n’ahoɔdzen; woana n’enyim na mo ho bɔpopo?
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a nyimpa bɔn baa mo do dɛ worubosunsuan me, Mekyerɛ m’atamfo na mo dɔmdzifo no, wofintsifintsiwii na wɔhwehwee ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Kaansa dɔm bɛkyer mo ho nsera mpo a, M’akoma runntu: Kaansa wobotu mo do sa mpo a, Moho nnkɔpopo ara da.
title: PSALMS

text: Adze kor na maserɛ EWURADZE, ɔno na mobɔhwehwɛ ekyir kwan, Dɛ mebɛtsena EWURADZE fie mo nkwa nda nyinara, Dɛ mobɔhwɛ EWURADZE n’anwanwadwuma no, na mebisa adze wɔ n’asɔrfi mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ ɔfona da no mu ɔdze me bohuntsa nsumaa mu wɔ n’asesee mu: Ne ntamadan mu ehuntsae na ɔdze me bohuntsa; Ɔbɛma me do esi ɔbotan do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na afei na ɔbɛma me tsir do ma ɔaakrɔn akyɛn m’atamfo a wɔabɔ mo ho aprɔw nyinara dze; Na mabɔ enyigye afɔr wɔ ne ntamadan mu, Mobɔtow ndwom, nyew, mobɔtow ayɛyindwom ama EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, sɛ medze me ndze su frɛ wo a, tsie: Hu me mbɔbɔr so na gye me do.
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a ɔwo esee dɛ, Hom nsom me no, nna m’akoma see wo dɛ, EWURADZE, ɔwo na mobɔsom wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nnyi w’enyim nnhuntsa me; Mma nnyi w’akowaa edzi ebufuw mu: Ɔwo na ayɛ mo boafo; Mma nntow me nnkyen, nkyii so mma nndan me nngya, Ao, mo nkwagye Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ m’egya na me na dan me gya mpo a, EWURADZE bɛfa me.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, kyerɛkyerɛ me wo kwan; Na gya me fa ɔtsempɔn huronn do, Osian m’atamfo ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nnyi me mma m’atamfo hɔn pɛ: Na adasefo atorfo asoɛr etsia me, na wopuw etsiɔdzen gu.
title: PSALMS

text: Megye dzi dɛ mubohu EWURADZE ne yie wɔ atseasefo asaase do, Nkyɛ motɔɔ bitsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Twer EWURADZE: Hyɛ woho dzen, na nnya gyedzi; Nyew, nya gyedzi wɔ EWURADZE mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, mo botan, ɔwo na musu frɛ wo; Mma nnsisiw w’aso wɔ mo do: Na sɛ ɔwo anngye me do a, Mebɛyɛ dɛ hɔn a wosian kɔ adakamona mu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ musu frɛ wo a, tsie mo nkotoserɛ ndze, Aber a mema me nsa do tsen wo krɔnkrɔnbea hɔ no.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nntwe me mmfora ndzebɔnyɛfo, Na emumuyɛfo mu nnkɔ; Hɔn a wɔnye hɔn anyɛnkofo kasa asomdwee mu, Naaso na ewurkadze wɔ hɔn akoma mu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Twe hɔn aso dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndwuma tse, na dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛbɔn tse: Twe hɔn aso dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nsaano edwuma tse; Tua hɔn dza ɔsɛ hɔn no ho kaw.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔnam dɛ wommbu EWURADZE no ndwuma, Anaa ne nsaano edwuma no bi ntsi, Obodwuruw hɔn egu na ɔnnkɛma hɔn do esi hɔ da.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE, Osiandɛ oetsie mo nkotoserɛ ndze.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE nye m’ahoɔdzen na me kyɛm; Medze m’akoma atwer no, na wɔaboa me: Dɛm ntsi m’akoma n’enyi gye kɛse; Na medze mo ndwom beyi no ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE nye no nkorɔfo hɔn ahoɔdzen, Na ɔno nye ne nyia ɔno EWURADZE asera no no no nkwagye akoban.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, gye wo man nkwa, na hyira w’egyapadze: Nyɛn hɔn so, na ma hɔn do daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom Sor dɔm, hom ntonton EWURADZE, Hom mfa EWURADZE n’enyimnyam na ahoɔdzen mma no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, hom mma EWURADZE enyimnyam a ɔfata ne dzin; Hom nsɔr EWURADZE wɔ ahokeka krɔnkrɔn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ Enyimnyam Nyankopɔn no kasa a, Ɔtse dɛ asenaman wɔ ehum mu, Na ne ndze kodu ekyir pii.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ EWURADZE kasa a, ɔkyerɛ no tum; EWURADZE ne ndze da ne kɛseyɛ edzi.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE ne ndze bubu ndupɔn. Nyew, EWURADZE ne ndze bubu Lebanon kwaa mu ndupɔn mu esinesin.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔma Lebanon mbepɔw huruhuruw dɛ ɔnantwiba; Na Bepɔw Sirion so, dɛ ekoba.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE ne ndze paa enyinam.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE ne ndze wosow sar; EWURADZE wosow Kades sar.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE ne ndze ma kwaa mu ndupɔn wosow, Na ɔma kwaa mu ndua ho da hɔ: Na obiara a ɔwɔ n’asɔrfi mu no tsea mu dɛ, Enyimnyam [nka Nyankopɔn].
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE tsenaa hɔ dɛ ɔhen wɔ Nsuyirii no do, Nyew, EWURADZE tse hɔ dɛ ɔhen daa.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE bɛma ne man ahoɔdzen; EWURADZE dze asomdwee behyira ne man.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔtonton wo, Ao EWURADZE; osiandɛ ɔwo na ama me do egyina, Na amma m’atamfo enndzi ehurusi wɔ mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn, Musui frɛɛ wo, na ɔwo asa me yarba.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, ɔwo na egyee me kra fii owu mu: Ɔwo na ama me nkwa, ma mannkɔ mona no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom ntow ayɛyindwom mma EWURADZE, ao, hom n’ahotseweefo. Na hom mfa ndaase mma ne dzin krɔnkrɔn no.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ n’ebufuw wɔ hɔ ber tsiabaa bi; Na n’enyimtsewee dze, otsim hɔ afebɔɔ: Na sɛ osu ba bɔsoɛ anadwe mpo a, enyigye bɛba anapa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, m’eyiedzi mu no mesee dɛ, Murunntutu ara da.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo, EWURADZE, edze w’enyimtsewee ama metsim hɔ dzendzen dɛ bepɔw: Na ɔwo edze w’enyim huntsae no; mofonae.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, ɔwo na musui frɛɛ wo; Na ɔwo EWURADZE na mokotowee serɛɛ wo dɛ:
title: PSALMS

text: Mfaso bɛn na ɔwɔ mo ho, aber a mokɔ adakamona no mu? Aso huntuma beyi wo ayɛw? Aso ɔbɛka wo nokwar akyerɛ?
title: PSALMS

text: Tsie, Ao EWURADZE, na hu me mbɔbɔr: Ao EWURADZE, yɛ mo boafo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ama mo nkɔmbɔdzi adan me asaw; Ɔwo asan m’eyitam, na edze enyigye abɔ me do:
title: PSALMS

text: Ama maatow wo ayɛyindwom na maannyɛ foo. EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn, medze ndaase bɛma wo daa.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, wo mu na medze mo werɛ hyɛ; mma mma m’enyim nngu ase dabiarada: Gye me wɔ wo tsenenee mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Brɛ w’aso adze ma me; gye me ntsɛmara: Yɛ ɔbotantsim ma me, na mo guansumabew dɛ ebɛgye me.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo nye mo botan na m’akoban; Dɛm ntsi, kyerɛ me kwan na kegya me, osian wo dzin ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Yi me fi efir a woesua no nsumaa mu no mu; Na ɔwo nye m’akoban.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo nsamu na medze mo sunsum hyɛ: EWURADZE, ɔwo nokwar Nyankopɔn no, ɔwo na agye me,
title: PSALMS

text: Mikyir hɔn a wodzi ator egyangyandze ekyir: Na emi dze, motwer EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: M’enyi bɛgye na medzi ehurusi wɔ wo mbɔbɔrhu mu, Na ɔwo ahwɛ m’ahohia; Ɔwo ehu me kra wɔ amandzehu mu:
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo annka me annhyɛ ɔtamfo no nsamu: Ɔwo edze m’anan esi mbrɛ hɔ tserɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, hu me mbɔbɔr, na mowɔ ahokyer mu: Awerɛhow ntsi m’enyiwa resɛɛ, nyew, me kra na me nyimpadua so.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mo nkwa rohwer wɔ yaw mu, me mfe so wɔ apensi mu: M’ahoɔdzen apa wɔ m’emumuyɛ ntsi, na me mbiew afomfɔn wɔ m’atamfo ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: M’atamfo nyinara ntsi mayɛ ɔsesɛba, Nyew, mo sɔnmufo so moho afon hɔn, na mo ho ayɛ hu ama m’amanyimfo. Hɔn a wohu me guado no guan me.
title: PSALMS

text: Nkorɔfo werɛ efir me dɛ owufo efi adwen mu: Metse dɛ senaba bobɔe.
title: PSALMS

text: Na matse dodowara hɔn huhuhuhu, Ihu etwa mo ho ehyia: Ber a wɔrokɔ me tsir do apam no, Wɔhyehyɛɛ dɛ wobeyi mo nkwa efi hɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso emi dze, ɔwo EWURADZE, na medze mo werɛ hyɛ wo mu: Mese dɛ, Ɔwo nye me Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Me mber wɔ wo nsamu: Gye me fi m’atamfo nsamu, na hɔn a wohiahia mo ho no.
title: PSALMS

text: Tsew w’enyim kyerɛ w’akowaa: Gye me nkwa wɔ w’adɔyɛ mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, mma mma m’enyim nngu ase, na mesu afrɛ wo: Ma ndzebɔnyɛfo enyi nto, na wɔnyɛ foo wɔ Samanadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma atorfo ano ntɔ mmum; Hɔn a wɔdze ntsɛn na enyiammbɔho keka nsɛm, Nsɛm a ɔyɛ dzen tsia tseneneenyi no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, mbrɛ wo papayɛ a edze esie ama hɔn a wosuro wo no dua dɔɔ so a! Dza ɔwo ayɛ ama hɔn a woguan toa wo wɔ nyimpa mba enyim no a.
title: PSALMS

text: W’enyim ehuntsae mu na edze hɔn bohuntsa efi nyimpa tsirdo apam mu: Ɔwo na edze hɔn huntsa nsumaa mu wɔ w’asesee mu fi gyirama ntokwadzi ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE, Osiandɛ ɔakyerɛ me n’adɔyɛ nwanwa no, wɔ kurow a ahohia wɔ hɔ mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, me ntsɛmpɛ mu, mesee dɛ, Woetwa me efi w’enyi do: Naaso aber a musui mefrɛɛ wo no, ɔwo itsiee mo nkotoserɛ ndze no.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom ndɔ EWURADZE, hom n’ahotseweefo nyinara: EWURADZE kora nokwardzifo no do, Na otua nyia ɔyɛ ntsɛn no kaw berdzedzeedze.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nhyɛ dzen, na hom nya akokodur, Hom a hom enyi da EWURADZE do nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiarfo nye nyia wɔdze ne mbrato akyɛ no, na wɔakata no bɔn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiarfo nye nyimpa a EWURADZE mmbu emumuyɛ nngu no do, Na ndaadaa nnyi no sunsum mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a mekataa mo bɔn do no, me mbiew gurae Ɔnam m’apempen a midzii no adzekyee nyinara no ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ adzekyee na adzesaa wo nsa yɛɛ dur wɔ mo do: Mo fɔɔfɔɔyɛ daan ɔpɛber kwaweeyɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Mekaa mo bɔn kyerɛɛ wo, na m’emumuyɛ no mammfa ennhuntsa: Mesee dɛ, Mebɛka me mbrato makyerɛ EWURADZE; Na ɔwo edze mo bɔn ho emumuyɛ kyɛ me.
title: PSALMS

text: Iyi ntsi wɔmma obiara a ɔyɛ nyamesuronyi nyi mpaa mma wo wɔ ahohiahiaber mu: Na sɛ ɔhaw pram dɛ esu akɛse a eyir a, orunndu ne nkyɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo nye mo sumabea; ɔwo bɔkora me efi ɔfona mu: Ɔwo dze nkwagye ndwom botwa mo ho ehyia.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo EWURADZE aka dɛ: Mebɛma esua na makyerɛkyerɛ wo kwan a ɔsɛ dɛ efa do: M’enyi wɔ wo do dɛ mubotu wo fo.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma hom nnyɛ dɛ pɔnkɔ, anaa asoasopɔnkɔ a wonnyi ntseasee: Wɔdze ndabraka na no ho ahoma to hɔn anomu twe hɔn, Annyɛ dɛm a nkyɛ wɔnnkɔtwe abɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Yaw pii bɛka ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi: Na nyia ɔdze no werɛ hyɛ EWURADZE mu no dze, adom bɔbɔ no aprɔw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom atseneneefo, hom mma hom enyi ngye EWURADZE mu, na hom ndzi ehurusi: Na akomamutseweefo nyina hom mbɔ ose wɔ enyigye ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom ndzi ehurusi wɔ EWURADZE mu, ao hom atseneneefo Ɔfata hɔn a wɔtsen dɛ woyi ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa nsankutsen nda EWURADZE ase: Hom mfa bɛntasanku a no do ahoma du ntow no ayɛyindwom.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom ntow ndwom fofor mma no; Hom mbɔ sanku yie nka dede huu ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm tsen; Na no ndwuma nyinara da no nokwardzi edzi.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE dɔ ndzeyɛtsenenee na atsɛntsenenee: Na n’adɔyɛ ahyɛ asaase ma.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm na ɔdze yɛɛ ɔsor; Na n’anomu ehubɔw na ɔdze yɛɛ no mu dɔm nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔka po nsu boa ano dɛ kuw: Na ɔdze n’ebun sie ekyirekyir.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma asaase nyinara nsuro EWURADZE: Wɔmma hɔn a wɔtse wiadze nyinara mbɔ no ho hu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔno na ɔka a, ɔba mu; Ɔno na ɔhyɛ a, ogyina pintsinn.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE ma amanaman egyinatu yɛ kwa: Ɔno na ɔma aman adwen yɛ gyan.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE n’apam gyina pintsinn daa nyina, N’akoma mu adwen wɔ hɔ ma mbasantsen nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira aka ɔman a EWURADZE yɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn; Nkorɔfo a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn ayɛ nankasa n’egyapadze no.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE fi sor na ɔhwɛ; Ɔhwɛ nyimpa mba nyinara;
title: PSALMS

text: Ofi ne tsenabea na ɔto n’enyi hwɛ Asaase do atsefo nyinara;
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na ɔbɔɔ hɔn nyinara hɔn akoma, Ɔdween hɔn ndwuma nyina ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔhen bi nndua dɔm dodow do nnya nkwa: Ɔkatakyi nndua ahoɔdzen kɛse do nngye noho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔpɔnkɔ yɛ adze gyangyan ma nkwagye: Nkyii so ɔremmfa n’ahoɔdzen kɛse no nngye obiara.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE enyiwa wɔ hɔn a wosuro no do, Ɔwɔ hɔn a hɔn enyi da n’adom kwan no do;
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ ɔbɛgye hɔn kra efi owu mu, Na ɔama woenya nkwa wɔ ɔkɔm mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɛn akra twer EWURADZE: Ɔno na ɔyɛ hɛn boafo na hɛn kyɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Na hɛn akoma bɔtɔ hɛn yamu wɔ no mu, Osiandɛ yɛdze hɛn werɛ ahyɛ ne dzin krɔnkrɔn no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, ma wo mbɔbɔrhu mbra hɛn do, Dɛ mbrɛ yɛdze hɛn enyi ato wo do no.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛda EWURADZE ase mber nyinara: N’ayɛyi nnkefi m’anomu da.
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra hyehyɛ noho wɔ EWURADZE mu: Abrɛfo no bɛtse nka na hɔn enyi agye.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nye me ntonton EWURADZE ne kɛseyɛ, Na hom mma yɛmbɔ mu nhuhor ne dzin.
title: PSALMS

text: Musui frɛɛ EWURADZE, na ɔgyee me do, Na oyii me fii mo suro nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Abrɛfo hwɛ no, na oenya akomatɔmu: Na hɔn enyim runngu ase da.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbɔbɔnyi yi tsea mu, na EWURADZE tsie no, Na ɔgye no fi no fona nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE no bɔfoe no kyer hɔn a wosuro no ho nsera hyia, Na ɔgye hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, hom nsɔ nhwɛ na hom nhu dɛ EWURADZE ye: Osiarfo nye nyimpa a no werɛ hyɛ no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom n’ahotseweefo, hom nsuro EWURADZE: Na biribi rinnhia hɔn a wosuro no no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ngyataburwa mpo dzi hia, na ɔkɔm dze hɔn: Naaso hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE dze, adze pa biara rinnhia hɔn da.
title: PSALMS

text: Mba, hom mbra, hom nyɛ aso mma me; Mebɛkyerɛ hom EWURADZE no suro.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyimpa mmuana na ɔrohwehwɛ nkwa, Na ɔpɛ nda dodow, na oehu papa?
title: PSALMS

text: Nna kora wo tɛkyerɛma wɔ bɔn ho, Na w’anofamfa wɔ ndaadaasɛm ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Yi bɔn akwa, na yɛ papa; Hwehwɛ asomdwee, na tsiw no.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE n’enyiwa wɔ atseneneefo do. Na n’aso wɔ hɔn sufrɛ do.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE enyi sa hɔn a wɔyɛ bɔn, Dɛ obotu hɔn ase korakora efi asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Atseneneefo sui frɛe, na EWURADZE tsiei, Na ɔgyee hɔn fii hɔn fona nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE bɛn hɔn a hɔn akoma abobɔ, Na ɔgye hɔn a hɔn sunsum abotow nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi n’ahohia dɔɔ so: Naaso EWURADZE yi no fi ne nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔkora ne mbiew nyinara: Na hɔn mu kor ara mpo mmbu.
title: PSALMS

text: Bɔn boku ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi: Na hɔn a wɔtan tseneneenyi no wobobu hɔn fɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE pon no nkowaa hɔn akra: Na hɔn a wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛ no mu no mu biara dze worummbu hɔn fɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, ɔwoara enye hɔn a wɔnye me dzi esi no nsi: Ɔwoara enye hɔn a wɔnye me ko no nko.
title: PSALMS

text: Suo kyɛm na nkataenyim mu, Na soɛr gyina bɔboa me.
title: PSALMS

text: Twe peaa no so, na siw hɔn a wɔtaa mo do no kwan: Se me kra dɛ, Emi nye wo nkwagye.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a wɔrohwehwɛ mu wu no hɔn enyim ngu ase, na fɛr nka hɔn: Ma hɔn a wɔpɛ me bɔn no nsan hɔn ekyir na hɔn enyim ngu ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma wɔnyɛ dɛ ntsɛw wɔ mframa enyim, Na ma EWURADZE no bɔfoe no mbɔ hɔn ngu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn kwan mu nyɛ sum na ɔnyɛ tortor, Na ma EWURADZE no bɔfoe no ntsiw hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Na gyan ara na woesua me efir ehuntsa wɔ mona mu; Gyan ara na woetu mona ama me kra.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ɔsɛɛ ndwir hɔn do awora; Na ma n’efir a oesua ehuntsa no mpa hɔnara: Ma wɔnhwe ɔsɛɛ kor noara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna me kra bedzi ehurusi wɔ EWURADZE mu: N’enyi bɛgye no nkwagye no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Me mbiew nyinara bɛse dɛ, Ao EWURADZE, woana na ɔnye wo sɛ? Ɔwo a egye ɔbɔbɔfo fi nyia ɔyɛ dzen dodow ma no no nsamu, Nyew, ɔbɔbɔnyi na hianyi no fi nyia ɔfa no afo no nsamu?
title: PSALMS

text: Adasefo nkontompɔfo soɛr gyina; Wobisa me ndzɛmba a minnyim ho hwee.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔdze bɔn tua me papa kaw, Na wɔma me kra yɛ egyanka.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso emi dze, wɔyaree no, mufuraa eyitam: Medze mbuadadzi haaw me kra; Na medze yaw bɔɔ mpaa dzendzenndzen.
title: PSALMS

text: Meyɛɛ m’adze dɛ gyama ɔyɛ me nyɛnko bi anaa mo nua bi: Mobɔɔ mo mu adze dzii awerɛhow dɛ obi a origyam ne na.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso emi dze mokɔr ahokyer mu no, hɔn enyi gyee, na wɔkaa hɔnho boaa ano: Akwasampafo no kaa hɔn ho boaa ano tsiaa me a nna minnyim; Tsetsew ara na wɔtsetseew me, na woenngyaa:
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔtse dɛ aponto ho daadaa atwetwesifo, Wɔtwɛɛr hɔn se guu mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, ebɔhwɛ ara ma ekodu dabɛn? Gye me kra fi hɔn nsɛɛe no mu, Gye me nkwa fi dɛm ngyata yi nsamu
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛda wo ase wɔ mboanofo kɛse no mu: Mibeyi wo ayɛw wɔ aman dodow mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma mma hɔn a wɔyɛ m’atamfo atorfo no nnsi me atwetwe; Nkyii so mma mma hɔn a wokyir me kwa no mmbubu me enyikyiw.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ wɔnnka asomdwee nsɛm: Na mbom wɔdwen ndaadaasɛm tsia hɔn a wɔdwe wɔ asaase do no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, wɔhanhan hɔn anomu petoo wɔ mo do; Wɔse dɛ, Ɔyɛ nokwar, hɛn enyiwa hun wo.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, ɔwoara ehu, mma nnyɛ komm: EWURADZE, mma mmfi me nkyɛn nnkɔ ekyir.
title: PSALMS

text: Kenyan woho, na soɛr bobua me atsɛn, Mekyerɛ me Nyankopɔn na m’EWURADZE, bedzi m’asɛm ma me.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn, bua me atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ wo tsenenee tse, Na mma mma wonnsi me atwetwe.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma mma wɔnnse wɔ hɔn akoma mu dɛ, Yɛɛ, dza yɛpɛ nye yi: Mma mma wɔnnse dɛ, Yɛamen no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a hɔn enyi gye mo mbusu ho nyina hɔn enyi nto na hɔn enyim ngu ase: Ma enyito na fɛr mfura hɔn a wodzi mo do ekokrokosɛm no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a hɔn enyi sɔ me tsenenee mbɔ ose, na wondzi ehurusi: Nyew, ma wɔnse daa dɛ, Wɔntonton EWURADZE, Ɔno a n’enyi sɔ n’akowaa no prɔmprɔmyɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Na me tɛkyerɛma bɛkasa wɔ wo tsenenee, Na w’ayɛyi ho adzekyee tsentsen nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Omumuyɛnyi ne mbrato kasa wɔ n’akoma mu dɛ, Nyankopɔn ho suro biara nnyi n’enyi do.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ obu noho bi wɔ nankasa n’enyi do, Dɛ worunnhu n’emumuyɛ na woekyir.
title: PSALMS

text: N’anomu nsɛm yɛ emumuyɛsɛm na ndaadaa: Oegyaa dɛ ohu nyansa na ɔyɛ papa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdwendwen emumuyɛ ho wɔ ne mpa do; Ɔdze noho si ɔkwan a onnye mu; Na onnkyir bɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, w’adɔyɛ wɔ sorsor; Wo nokwardzi kodu wimu tɔnn.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo tsenenee tse dɛ Nyankopɔn mbepɔw; Wo ntsɛmbu yɛ bun a no mu dɔ: EWURADZE, ɔwo na ekora nyimpa na abowa do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn, mbrɛ w’adɔyɛ dua som bo a: Na adasamba guan dɔ w’atsaban no nwinwin ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo fie mu ndzepa bɛmee hɔn; Na ɔwo ebɛma wɔanom w’enyigye esutsen no.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ wo nkyɛn na nkwa nsunyiwa wɔ: Wo kan mu na yebohu kan.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma w’adɔyɛ ntoa do mma hɔn a wonyim wo; Na wo tsenenee mma hɔn a wɔtsen wɔ akoma mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma mma ntsɛntsɛnnyi anan mmbetsia me, Na mma mma ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi nsa nntwe me nnkɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔ na emumuyɛfo atotɔ: Woesun hɔn ahwehwe famu, na worunntum nnsoɛr.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nnhaw woho wɔ emumuyɛfo ntsi, Nkyii so mma hɔn a wɔbɔ brakyew ho nnyɛ wo ehi.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔrennkyɛr na woetwa hɔn egu dɛ nkyɛkyɛr,na wɔakyenkyen dɛ haban momon a woetwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo dze, twer EWURADZE, na yɛ papa; Tsena asaase do, na dzi nokwar.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma w’enyi nka EWURADZE so mu, Na ɔbɛma wo w’akoma n’ebisadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Fa wo kwan to EWURADZE do; Twer no so, na ɔno na ɔbɛma wo nhyehyɛɛ aba mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔbɛma wo tsenenee epue dɛ ekan, Na w’atsɛmbu dɛ wigyinae.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛ dzinn wɔ EWURADZE mu, na tweɔn no abotar mu: Mma nnhaw woho wɔ nyia no kwan mu esi no yie ntsi, Wɔ nyimpa a ɔma ne tsirmsɛm bɔn ba mu no ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ebufuw ntɔ, na gyaa akoma bɔn: Mma nnhaw woho, na obowie bɔn nko.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emumuyɛfo no wobotwa hɔn efi hɔ: Naaso hɔn a wɔtweɔn EWURADZE dze, wobenya asaase no afa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na aka kakrabaa, na omumuyɛfo nnyi hɔ bio. Nyew, ebɔhwehwɛ ne tsenabea ara yie, naaso nna onnyi hɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Na abrɛfo dze wobenya asaase no atsena do; Na wɔagye hɔn enyi wɔ asomdwee pii mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Omumuyɛnyi bɔ ɔtseneneenyi ho pɔw, Na ɔtwɛr ne se gu no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso, EWURADZE bɛserew no: Osiandɛ ohu dɛ omumuyɛnyi no ne da reba.
title: PSALMS

text: Emumuyɛfo atwe afona, na wɔakontom hɔn egyen; Dɛ wɔbɛma ɔbɔbɔnyi na ohianyi ahwe ase, Dɛ woboku hɔn a wɔtsen wɔ ɔkwan no mu:
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn afona bɔwɔ hɔnankasa hɔn akoma mu, Na hɔn egyen ebubu.
title: PSALMS

text: Kakra a ɔtseneneenyi wɔ no, Oye sen emumuyɛfo pii hɔn adze dodow.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ omumuyɛnyi basa bobubu; Naaso ɔtseneneenyi dze, EWURADZE wowaaw no.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE nyim hɔn a wodzi mu hɔn nda: Na hɔn egyapadze bɔko hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn enyi ronnto wɔ mbusu ber mu: Na ɔkɔm nda mu so wɔbɛmee.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emumuyɛfo dze wɔbɛhera, Na EWURADZE atamfo bɛyɛ dɛ sar do nhyiren: Wɔbɛhyew asa; wɔbɛhyew asa dɛ wusiw.
title: PSALMS

text: Omumuyɛnyi fɛm, na onntua kaw bio: Naaso ɔtseneneenyi dze ɔyɛ adom, na ɔkyɛ adze.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ hɔn a EWURADZE hyira hɔn no na wobenya asaase no atsena do; Naaso hɔn a ɔpaa hɔn no wobotwa hɔn egu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyimpa n’anamɔn EWURADZE na otsintsim no; Na n’enyi ka no kwan ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Kaansa ɔhwe ase mpo a, ɔrennka famu korakora: Osiandɛ EWURADZE dze ne nsa wowaw no.
title: PSALMS

text: Meyɛɛ abofra, na afei dze mayɛ akɔdaa; Naaso munnhun ɔtseneneenyi a wɔapa no da, Anaadɛ n’asefo a wɔserɛserɛ edziban.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔyɛ adom adzekyee nyina, na ɔdze fɛm; Na n’asefo so yɛ esiarfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Fi bɔn ho, na yɛ papa; Ama aatsena hɔ daapem.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE dɔ atsɛntsenenee, Na ɔmmpa n’ahotseweefo; Ɔkora hɔn do daa: Na omumuyɛnyi n’asefo dze, wobotwa hɔn egu.
title: PSALMS

text: Atseneneefo benya asaase no afa, Na wɔaatsena mu daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi ano ka enyansasɛm, Na ne tɛkyerɛma bu atsɛntsenenee.
title: PSALMS

text: Na Nyankopɔn mbra wɔ n’akoma mu; N’anamɔn biara renntserew.
title: PSALMS

text: Omumuyɛnyi tsɛw ɔtseneneenyi, Na ɔhwehwɛ dɛ oku no.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso EWURADZE renndan no nngya ne nsamu, Eso sɛ worubu no atsɛn a, orummbu no fɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Twer EWURADZE, na fa no kwan do, Na ɔbɛma wo do ma enya asaase no afa. Sɛ otwa emumuyɛfo gu a, ɔwo ibohu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mehu omumuyɛnyi wɔ tum kɛsenara mu, Na ɔatoto abaw dɛ dua prɔmprɔm bi a oenya esiyie.
title: PSALMS

text: Na obi kotwaa mu, na hwɛ, onnyi hɔ: Nyew, mohwehwɛɛ no, naaso mennhu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Bɔ nyia odzi mu no nyikam, na hwɛ nyia ɔtsen no: Na nyimpa no n’ewiei yɛ asomdwee.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mbratofo dze, wɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn nyinara prɛko: Emumuyɛfo dze, hɔn ase bɛhyew.
title: PSALMS

text: Na atseneneefo hɔn nkwagye dze ofi EWURADZE: Ɔno na ɔyɛ hɔn akoban wɔ ɔfona ber mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE boa hɔn, na oyi hɔn: Oyi hɔn fi emumuyɛfo nsa, na ɔgye hɔn nkwa, Osiandɛ woeguan ekosuma no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, mma nntwuw m’enyim wɔ ebufuw mu: Nkyii so mma nntsea me wɔ w’ebufuhyew mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na w’egyen menaba awowɔ me aka mu, Na wo nsa edwir mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Osian w’ebufuhyew ntsi ahoɔdzen bi nnyi mo honam mu; Nkyii so osian mo bɔn ntsi apɔwmudzen bi nnyi me mbiew mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na m’emumuyɛ emunam m’etsifi: Ayɛ mo do dur dɛ adzesoadze durdur.
title: PSALMS

text: Osian mo nkwaseasɛm ntsi, M’epirakur apɔtɔw na ɔbɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Mo mu akom na matɔ famu koraa; Adzekyee nyinara medze awerɛhow nenam.
title: PSALMS

text: Na m’asen mu hyehye me; Na ahoɔdzen bi nnyi mo honam mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Matɔ bahaw na mebubu posoposo: Makeka mu dzendzen wɔ m’akoma n’ahomtsew ntsi:
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, m’ahwehwɛdze nyinara wɔ w’enyim; Na mo nkrumsi nnhuntsa wo.
title: PSALMS

text: M’akoma tow hwim hwim, m’ahoɔdzen apa: M’enyiwa ne kan mpo, no so efi mo ho kɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: M’adɔfo na me m’anyɛnkofo atwe hɔnho efi me haw ho; Na m’ebusuafo so mpo gyina ekyirekyir.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn so a wɔrohwehwɛ mo wu no esua me mfir; Na hɔn a wɔpɛ me bɔn no ka ebususɛm, Na wɔdwendwen ndaadaasɛm ho adzekyee nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze metse dɛ otsitsifo a menntse asɛm; Na metse dɛ mmum a ommbue n’ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, metse dɛ nyimpa a ɔnntse asɛm, Ntsi munntum nnyi ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo, Ao EWURADZE, na m’enyi da wo do: Ao, EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn, ɔwoara bobua.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mese dɛ, Mma mma wonsi me atwetwe: Sɛ m’anan patser a, mma mma wɔnnhyehyɛ hɔnho wɔ mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze mereyɛ mahwe ase, Na me yaw wɔ m’enyim daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mebɛka m’emumuyɛ akyerɛ: Mibedzi mo bɔn ho yaw.
title: PSALMS

text: Na m’atamfo dze, hɔn ho yɛ hyew, na hɔn ho yɛ dzen: Na hɔn a wɔtan me gyan no adɔɔ so.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn so a wɔdze bɔn tua papa kaw no, Wɔyɛ m’atamfo, osiandɛ midzi papa ekyir ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, mma mmpa me: Ao, me Nyankopɔn, mma nnye me ntamu nntwe.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛ ntsɛm bɔboa me, Ao EWURADZE, mo nkwagye.
title: PSALMS

text: Mesee dɛ, mobɔhwɛ m’akwan yie, Amma maammfa me tɛkyerɛma annyɛ bɔn: Medze ewur bɔto m’ano, Ber a omumuyɛfo no wɔ m’enyim yi.
title: PSALMS

text: Motɔɔ mmum komm, mekaa m’ano too mu fii papa mpo ho: Naaso onyanyaan me yaw.
title: PSALMS

text: M’akoma yɛɛ hyerehyerew wɔ mo mu; Ber a morodwendwen no na ɔsɔɔ dɛ ogya: Na afei medze me tɛkyerɛma kasae:
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, ma munhu m’ewiei, Na me nda ne nhyehyɛɛ mbrɛ ɔtse; Ma munhu me nda mbrɛ odua yɛ tsia.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, ɔwo ayɛ me nda nsatseama nsatseama; Na me mfe nnyɛ hwee wɔ w’enyim: Ampaara, kaansa nyimpa biara gyina hɔ petsee dɛnara mpo a, ɔyɛ ehubɔw koraa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ampaara, nyimpa biara nenam dɛ nwinwin kwa: Nyew, wɔhaw hɔn werɛ kwa: Wɔhyɛ ahonyadze kuw, naaso wonnyim nyia ɔbɛtase.
title: PSALMS

text: Na afei, EWURADZE, ebɛnadze na montweɔn? M’enyidado wɔ wo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Gye me fi me mbrato nyinara mu: Mma mennyɛ ɔsesɛba mma nkwasea.
title: PSALMS

text: Motɔɔ mmum, mannhan m’ano; Osiandɛ ɔwo na eyɛe.
title: PSALMS

text: Yi asotwe fi mo do: Na wo nsaano hwe rehyew me.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ ɔwo edze ntwuwenyim tsea nyimpa wɔ emumuyɛ ntsi a, Ema n’ahoɔfɛw hyew dɛ nsaamaa awe: Ampaara, nyimpa biara yɛ ehubɔw.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, tsie me mpaayi, na yɛ aso ma mo sufrɛ; Mma mmua w’ano wɔ me nyinsuwa ho: Na meyɛ ɔhɔho wɔ wo nkyɛn, Ɔmamforanyi, dɛ mbrɛ m’egyanom nyinara yɛe.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma w’enyi mfi mo do, na ma m’enyim ntsew bio, Ansaana mefi ha akɔ, a wonnkohu me bio.
title: PSALMS

text: Abotar mu na motweɔɔn EWURADZE; Na ɔbrɛɛ n’aso adze maa me, na otsiee mo sufrɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Na oyii mo so fii ɔsɛɛ mona no mu, fii adɛtsebir atɛkyɛ no mu; Na ɔdze m’anan sii ɔbotan do, na ɔmaa m’anamɔn tsintsimii.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔdze ndwom fofor bi ahyɛ m’anomu, mekyerɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn ayɛyindwom: Dodowara bohu na woesuro, Na wɔatwer EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiarfo nye nyimpa a ɔdze EWURADZE ayɛ n’awerɛhyɛmu, Na ommbu ahopɔwfo bi, anaa hɔn a wɔman kedzi ator.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn, w’anwanwa ndwuma a ayɛ dɔɔ so, Na w’adwen a ɔwɔ hɛn do: Worunntum nnhyehyɛ no akyerɛpɛn wɔ w’enyim; Sɛ mereka na makasa ho a, Wɔdɔɔ so sen dɛ wobotum kan.
title: PSALMS

text: Afɔrbɔ na ayɛyɛdze ɔwo nnyi enyigye wɔ mu; Hyew afɔr na bɔn ho afɔr ɔwo emmbisa: Ɔwo na akyerɛ me setsie.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Hwɛ maba: Nwoma mbobɔwee no mu na wɔakyerɛw wo mbra no wɔ:
title: PSALMS

text: Me Nyankopɔn, mepɛ dɛ meyɛ wo pɛ, Nyew, wo mbra wɔ m’akoma mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Maka tsenenee ho asɛmpa wɔ mboanofo kɛse no mu; Hwɛ, merennka m’ano nnto mu, EWURADZE, ɔwoara inyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze wo tsenenee siee m’akoma mu; Maka wo nokwardzi na wo nkwagye akyerɛ: Memmfaa w’adɔyɛ na wo nokwar nnsumaa mboanofo kɛse no.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, mma nnkam me w’ayamuhyehye: Ma w’adɔyɛ na wo nokwar nkora mo do daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbusu a wonnyim ano etwa mo ho ehyia, M’emumuyɛ ato me, ma munntum mma m’enyi do; Ɔdɔɔ so sen me tsir do nhwi, na m’akoma apa me.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, ma ɔnyɛ wo fɛw dɛ ebɛgye me: Ao EWURADZE, yɛ ntsɛm bɔboa me.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me kra asɛɛ no no, Hɔn enyi nto na hɔn enyim ngu ase prɛko: Ma hɔn a wɔpɛ me bɔn no Nsan hɔn ekyir na wɔndan adapaafo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a wɔse me dɛ, Yɛɛ, yɛɛ, no Hɔn ho ndwuruw hɔn dɛ hɔn enyito ho akatua.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo nyinara ndzi ehurusi na hɔn enyi ngye wo mu: Ma hɔn a wɔdɔ wo nkwagye nse daa dɛ, Wɔntonton EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze meyɛ ɔbɔbɔfo na ohianyi; Naaso EWURADZE dwen mo ho: Ɔwo nye mo boafo na me gyefo; Ao Me Nyankopɔn, mma nnkyinkyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiarfo nye nyia ɔdwen ɔbɔbɔfo do: EWURADZE bɛgye no mbusu da no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE bɔkora no do, na ɔama no nkwa, na wobehyira no wɔ asaase do; Na ɔwo irinnyi no nnhyɛ n’atamfo hɔn pɛ nsa.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE bɔwowaw no wɔ yar mpa do: Ne mpa nyinara ɔwo na esɛw wɔ ne yarba mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mesee dɛ, EWURADZE, hu me mbɔbɔr: Sa me yarba; na mayɛ bɔn etsia wo.
title: PSALMS

text: M’atamfo ka mo ho nsɛmbɔn, dɛ, Aber bɛn na obowu ma ne dzin ayew?
title: PSALMS

text: Na sɛ obi ba bɔhwɛ me a, ɔka atorsɛm; N’akoma tase emumuyɛ ma nankasa noho: Sɛ opue kɔ gua do a, nna ɔkɔbɔ no dawur.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔtan me no nyinara wɔyɛ huhuhuhu tsia me: Wosusu mo ho bɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔse dɛ, Mbusu yarba bi ekitsa no: Na afei ɔda hɔ yi ɔronnsoɛr bio.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, mankasa me nyɛnko berɛbo mpo a mo werɛ wɔ no mu no a odzi m’edziban bi no, Ɔama n’anantsir do etsia me.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo, EWURADZE, hu me mbɔbɔr, na ma me do, Ma muntua hɔn ho kaw.
title: PSALMS

text: Iyi na medze bohu dɛ ɔwo epɛ m’asɛm, Osiandɛ me tamfo rinndzi mo do konyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, ɔwo na isuo mo mu gyina m’emudzi mu, Na edze me si w’enyim daa nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, Ofi tsetse na ɔdze kesi daa. Amen, na Amen.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ ɔtwe haahaw hwehwɛ nwora nsu no, Mbrɛ me kra haahaw hwehwɛ ɔwo nye no, ao, me Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, nkwa Nyankopɔn no, ho nsukɔm dze me kra: Dabɛn na mebɛba ebopue Nyankopɔn enyim?
title: PSALMS

text: Me nyinsuwa ayɛ m’edziban adzekyee na adzesaa, Mber a wɔsee me daa nyina dɛ, Wo Nyankopɔn wɔ hen no?
title: PSALMS

text: Iyinom na sɛ mekaa a, nna me kra ridzi awerɛhow no, Mbrɛ misii enye nyimpa petsee no nantsewee na midzii hɔn enyim kɔr Nyankopɔn fie; Yɛdze enyigye na ayɛyindwom ndze, dɛ nyimpa dodow a wɔrehyɛ fa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao me kra, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na abotow? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na iridzi mo mu awerɛhow yi? Ma w’enyi nda Nyankopɔn do: na mebɛda ho eyi no ayɛw, Dɛ ɔyɛ m’enyim boafo, na me Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Me Nyankopɔn, me kra abotow wɔ mo mu: Dɛm ntsi na mifi Jordan asaase do, Na Hermon mbepɔw do, na Mizar koko do mekaa wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Bun frɛ bun wɔ w’awor ne gyegye ntsi: W’asorɛkye na w’eminiminim nyinara afa mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso EWURADZE beyi n’adɔyɛ edzi wɔ adzekyeeber, Na anadwe matow no ndwom, Mekyerɛ mpaa a mibeyi ama mo nkwagye Nyankopɔn no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛse Nyankopɔn, mo botan no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo werɛ efir me yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na menam ridzi awerɛhow wɔ ɔtamfo no ne nhyɛdo ntsi yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Atseetsee a m’atamfo dze hyɛ me ntsi, ɔyɛ me dɛ me mbiew rodwerew; Mber a daa wɔse me dɛ, Wo Nyankopɔn wɔ hen?
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na abotow yi? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na iridzi mo mu awerɛhow yi? Ma w’enyi nda Nyankopɔn do: na mebɛda ho meyi no ayɛw, Dɛ ɔyɛ m’enyim boafo, na me Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn, bu me atsɛn na nye ɔman ebusuyɛfo yi ndzi asɛm mma me: Gye me fi nyimpa ɔdaadaafo na osisifo no nsamu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo nye m’ahoɔdzen Nyankopɔn, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na atow me akyen? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na menam ridzi awerɛhow wɔ ɔtamfo nhyɛdo ntsi yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Ma wo kan na wo nokwar mbra; ma wombegya me kwan: Ma wɔmfa me mbra wo bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do, Na wo ntamadan no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na mobɔkɔ Nyankopɔn afɔrmbukyia ho, Wɔ m’ehurusi enyigye Nyankopɔn nkyɛn: Na medze nsankutsen beyi wo ayɛw, Ao Nyankopɔn, me Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na iridzi mo mu awerɛhow yi? Ma w’enyi nda Nyankopɔn do; na mebɛda ho eyi no ayɛw, Dɛ ɔyɛ m’enyim boafo, na me Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛdze hɛn aso atse, Ao Nyankopɔn, hɛn egyanom aka akyerɛ hɛn, Dwuma bi a idzii no hɔn ber do, wɔ tsetseberdo no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze wo nsa paam ananaman na edze wo man tsɛɛw hɔ; Ɔwo ituu aman gui, na hɔn dze etserɛɛw hɔn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na nnyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn afona na wɔdze nyaa asaase no, Nkyii so nnyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn abasa na ɔgyee hɔn nkwa: Na mbom wo nsa enyimfa, na w’abasa, na w’enyim kan a, Osiandɛ wonyaa ɔwo w’enyim enyimpa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, ɔwo nye me Hen: Ɔwo na ehyɛ ma Jakob nya konyimdzi.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo do na yɛnam bosun hɛn atamfo egu famu: Wo dzin do na yɛnam betsiatsia hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia hɛn no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na meremmfa mo werɛ nnhyɛ m’egyen mu, Nkyii so nnyɛ m’afona na ɔbɛgye me nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo na agye hɛn efi hɛn atamfo nsamu, Na ahyɛ hɔn a wɔtan hɛn no enyito.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, wo mu na yɛahyehyɛ hɛnho daa nyina, Na yɛdze ndaase bɛma wo dzin daapem.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso afei ɔwo atow hɛn akyen, na ahyɛ hɛn fɛr, Na ennye hɛn dɔm nnkɔ bio.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ma yɛdan hɛn ekyir ma hɛn atamfo: Na hɔn a wɔtan hɛn fow hɛn fa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze hɛn akyɛ dɛ nguan a wodzi hɔn nam; Na abɔ hɛn apetse amanaman mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo nntɔn wo nkorɔfo nngye hwee, Na hɔn bo mma w’ahonya nndɔɔ so.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ama yɛadan sesɛba ama hɛn sɔnmufo, Na hɔn a wɔbɔ hɛn aprɔw hɔn atwetwesi na ehiyi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo yɛayɛ fen wɔ amanaman mu, Ema aman wosow hɔn tsir wɔ hɛn ho.
title: PSALMS

text: M’enyimguase wɔ m’enyim adzekyee nyinara, Na m’enyito akata mo do,
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔ nyia ɔhyɛ amen na ɔka ebususɛm ndze no ntsi, Wɔ atamfo na werdzifo no ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Iyi nyinara aba hɛn do dze, naaso hɛn werɛ mmfiir wo, Nkyii so yɛnntoo w’ahyɛmu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɛn akoma nnsaan ekyir, Nkyii so hɛn anamɔn nntseer wo kwan ho;
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso ɔwo ebubu hɛn pasaa wɔ mbrɛ mpataku wɔ, Na edze owu nwinwin akata hɛn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ hɛn werɛ efir hɛn Nyankopɔn dzin, Anaa yɛatserɛw hɛn nsamu akyerɛ onyame nanaben bi a;
title: PSALMS

text: Aso nnyɛ ɔwo Nyankopɔn na ebɔhwehwɛ yi? Na ɔwo na inyim akoma mu esumasɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, ɔwo ntsi na woku hɛn daa nyina; Wobu hɛn dɛ nguan a worukoku hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, soɛr ɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ennkasa hɛnho yi? Soɛr, mma nntow hɛn nnkyen daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ehuntsa w’enyim, Na wo werɛ fir hɛn ahohia na hɛn atseetsee yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Na hɛn kra abrɛ adze akɔ huntuma mu: Hɛn yafun tar famu.
title: PSALMS

text: Soɛr bɔboa hɛn, Na pon hɛn wɔ w’adɔyɛ ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: M’akoma ruhur asɛmpa bu do: Medze m’asɛm yi ma ɔhen: Me tɛkyerɛma yɛ dɛ kyerɛwfo a ne nsa ho yɛ har ne kyerɛwdua.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo ho yɛ fɛw sen nyimpa mba, Wɔdze enyimnyam ahyɛ w’ano; Dɛm ntsi Nyankopɔn ehyira wo daa no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao ɔkatakyi, fa w’afona bɔ w’asen, W’enyimnyam na wo tumdzi no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na nam wo tumdzi mu tutu kɔ kan dwudwoodwo, Wɔ nokwar na ahobrɛadze na tsenenee ntsi; Na wo nsa enyimfa nkyerɛkyerɛ wo adze a ɔyɛ hu.
title: PSALMS

text: W’egyen menaba ano yɛ ndam dɛ; Aman hwehwe w’enyim ase; Wɔawowɔ ɔhen atamfo akoma mu.
title: PSALMS

text: W’ahengua yɛ Nyankopɔn ahengua: W’ahendzi ahempoma yɛ tsenenee ahempoma.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo adɔ tsenenee, na ekyir emumuyɛ: Dɛm ntsi na Nyankopɔn, wo Nyankopɔn no, Dze enyigye ngo asera wo asen w’asɛfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo ntar nyinara yi eduhuam mɛɛr, alɔe na keesia hua; Nsankutsen fi asombɛn aban no mu bɛma w’enyi agye.
title: PSALMS

text: Ahemfo mbabaa fora wo mbaa enyimnyamfo mu: Ɔhembaa no gyina w’abanyimfa wɔ Ofir sika mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Tsie, ao ɔbabaa, dwen ho, na yɛ aso; Eso mma wo werɛ mmfir wankasa wo man, na w’egya fie;
title: PSALMS

text: Nna ɔhen kɔn bɔdɔ w’ahoɔfɛw: Na ɔno nye wo wura; na som no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na Taere babaa dze akyɛdze bɛba hɔ; Aman mu ahonyafo mpo bɛserɛ w’enyimtsewee.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔhen ne babaa yɛ onyimnyamfo koraa wɔ ahemfie ɔdan mu: N’efuradze wɔdze sika awen mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔhyɛ awen ntar na wɔdze no bɛbrɛ ɔhen: N’asɛfo mbaabun no a wodzi n’ekyir no Wɔdze hɔn bɛbrɛ wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔdze enyigye na ehurusi dze hɔn bɛba: Wɔbɛhɛn ɔhen ne fie mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo mba bedzi w’egyanom ananmu; Hɔn na edze hɔn bɛyɛ asaase nyinara do asafohemfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛma wɔakaa wo dzin wɔ mbasantsen nyinara mu: Dɛm ntsi aman bɛda wo ase daa daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn yɛ hɛn guandɔbea na ahoɔdzen, Mprɛmprɛ boafo wɔ ɔfona mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi kaansa asaase enyi dan, Na kaansa mbepɔw tutu kogu po bun mu;
title: PSALMS

text: Kaansa no mu nsu wor na ohur, Kaansa n’asorɛkye na mbepɔw wosow mpo a, yerunnsuro.
title: PSALMS

text: Esutsen bi wɔ hɔ, no nworaba ma Nyankopɔn kurow enyi gye, Ɔsorsornyi no ne ntamadan bea krɔnkrɔn no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn wɔ ne finimfin; na orunntutu: Nyankopɔn bɔboa no anapahema.
title: PSALMS

text: Amanaman yɛɛ weɔɔ weɔɔ, ahendzi tutui, Na ɔbɔɔ ne ndze mu no, asaase nanee.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɔm EWURADZE nye hɛn wɔ hɔ, Jakob Nyankopɔn yɛ hɛn abantsentsen.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mbra mbɔhwɛ EWURADZE no ndwuma, Ɔsɛɛ kor a ɔama aba asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔma akodzi bɔ adze kodu asaase ano; Obubu egyen mu, na otwitwa mpeaa mu esinesin; Ɔhyew ntseaseanam wɔ ogya mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyɛ dzinn, na hom nhu dɛ emi nye Nyankopɔn: Wobohuhor me wɔ asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɔm EWURADZE nye hɛn wɔ hɔ; Jakob Nyankopɔn yɛ hɛn abantsentsen.
title: PSALMS
