text: Aman nyinara, hom mbɔ hom nsamu; Hom mfa konyim ndze mbɔ ose mma Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE, Ɔsorsornyi no, no ho yɛ hu; Ɔyɛ Ɔhen kɛse wɔ asaase nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbrɛ aman adze hyɛ hɛn ase, Na ɔdze amanaman hyɛ hɛn ananadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsan mu yi hɛn egyapadze ma hɛn, Hɛn, Jakob asefo a wɔsɔ n’enyi.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn dze esebɔ kɔ sor, EWURADZE dze akasamu gyegye kɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom ntow ayɛyindwom mma Nyankopɔn, hom ntow ayɛyindwom: Hom ntow ayɛyindwom mma hɛn Hen no, hom ntow ayɛyindwom.
title: PSALMS

text: Na Nyankopɔn nye asaase nyinara do Hen: Hom mfa asanku ntow ayɛyindwom mma no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn dzi amanaman do hen: Nyankopɔn tse n’ahengua krɔnkrɔn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Aman ahemfo aboa ano Abɛyɛ Abraham Nyankopɔn ne man: Na asaase do akyɛm dzi wɔ Nyankopɔn; Woehuhor no kɛsenara.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE yɛ kɛse, na ɔsɛ dɛ woyi no ayɛw dɛ, Wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn kurow no mu, wɔ ne mbepɔw krɔnkrɔn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Zion, Nyankopɔn ne bepɔw no, Mbrɛ odua krɔn na ɔyɛ fɛw a, Ɔhen kɛse no kurow no dze enyigye brɛ asaase nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn ama woehu no wɔ n’aban no mu dɛ abantsentsen.
title: PSALMS

text: Na, hwɛ, ahemfo behyiae, Wotwaa mu wii senee.
title: PSALMS

text: Wohunii, nna hɔn ho boow hɔn; Hɔn bo tui, na woguaan tom tom.
title: PSALMS

text: Ahopopo kitsaa hɔn hɔ; Yaw a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo.
title: PSALMS

text: Tse dɛ mbrɛ boka mframa si Bobɔ Tarsis ahɛn no.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbrɛ yɛatse no dɛmara so na yeehu no Wɔ dɔm EWURADZE kurow mu, wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn kurow mu, Nyankopɔn bɛma etsim daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, yɛadwen w’adɔyɛ ho, Wɔ w’asɔrdan mu hɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, mbrɛ wo dzin tse no, Dɛmara so na w’ayɛyi tse kodu asaase ano: Tsenenee ahyɛ wo nsa enyimfa ma.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma bepɔw Zion n’enyi ngye, Ma Juda mbabaa ndzi ehurusi, Osian w’atsɛmbu ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nnantsew Zion ho, na wɔnkɔbɔ ho aprɔw: Hom nkan n’abantsentsen.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mbɔ n’afasu nyikam yie, Hom nkyin nhwɛ n’aban no mu, Ama hom aaka akyerɛ mbasantsen a wodzi ekyir no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na Nyankopɔn yi yɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn daa daa: Ɔbɛyɛ hɛn kwankyerɛfo ara ekodu owu mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Aman nyinara, hom ntsie iyi; Hom a hom tse wiadze nyinara, hom nyɛ aso:
title: PSALMS

text: Enyimdzefo na mbapɔmba, Ahonyafo na ehiafo nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: M’ano bɛka enyansasɛm; Na m’akoma mu adwendwen ayɛ ntseasee.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛbrɛ m’aso adze metsie abɛbusɛm: Mubobue m’asɛm a no mu yɛ sum do wɔ nsankutsen do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ebɛnadze ntsi na munsuro wɔ nda bɔn mu, Aber a m’atweefo emumuyɛ etwa mo ho ehyia?
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛ hɔn ahonyadze mu, Na wɔhyehyɛ hɔnho wɔ hɔn adzedodow mu,
title: PSALMS

text: Ampaara, nyimpa biara runntum mmpon no noho da, Eso onnkotum etua ne tsir do kaw ama Nyankopɔn,
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ nyimpa ne kra no pon som bo kɛse, Na dza obotum etua no nnkotum:
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ ɔbɛma ɔaatsena ase afebɔɔ, A ɔnnkɔkɔ owu mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, obiara hu dɛ enyansafo mpo wuwu, Na nkwasea na egyimfo nyina so dɛmara, Na wɔdan hɔn ahonyadze gya binom.
title: PSALMS

text: Kaansa wonyinyaa nsaase dze hɔn edzin totoo do mpo a, Hɔn ndakamona nye hɔn tsenabea afebɔɔ; Na hɔ na wɔbɛtsena ekodu mbasantsen nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na nyimpa n’eyiedzi nnkɛma ɔatsena ase daa: Obowu tse dɛ mbowa ara pɛr.
title: PSALMS

text: Iyi nye nkwaseafo hɔn ewiei: Hɔn a wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛ hɔn ahonyadze mu no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Woebua hɔn dɛ nguankuw ama samanadze; Owu na ɔbɛyɛ hɔn guanhwɛfo na ɔdze hɔn akɔ: Na tseneneefo no benya hɔn do tum anapa; Na hɔn dze, samanadze bɛsɛɛ hɔn bɔbew, na hɔ bɛyɛ hɔn tsenabea.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso me kra dze, Nyankopɔn bɛgye no owu nsamu: Na ɔbɛgye me.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ obi nya noho a, mma nnsuro, Aber a ne fie enyimnyam rodɔɔ so no:
title: PSALMS

text: Na sɛ owu a, ɔremmfa hweeara nnkɔ; N’enyimnyam rinnsian nndzi n’ekyir,
title: PSALMS

text: Kaansa ɔtse ase no ohyiraa ne kra, Na nyimpa yii no ayɛw, dɛ ɔabɔ noho mbɔdzen mpo a,
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbɔkɔ akɛka n’egyanom ebusuasantsen ho, Bea a worunnhu kan ara bio.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyimpa a ɔwɔ enyidzi mu na onnyi ntseasee no, Ɔtse dɛ mbowa a wowuwu.
title: PSALMS

text: Otumfo Nyankopɔn, mekyerɛ Nyankopɔn, EWURADZE no, akasa, Na ɔafrɛ asaase fi wipuei ekodu n’atɔree.
title: PSALMS

text: Zion, ahoɔfɛw a ewie pɛyɛ no mu, Nna Nyankopɔn efi ahyerɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɛn Nyankopɔn reba, na ɔrennyɛ komm: Ogya bedzi n’enyim ahyew adze, Na ehum etu huu etwa no ho ehyia.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbɛfrɛ ɔsorsor wɔ sor, Na asaase, dɛ orubobu ne man atsɛn:
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mboaboa m’ahotseweefo no ano mma me; Hɔn a wɔnam afɔrbɔ do nye me edzi ahyɛmu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔsorsor ka ne tsenenee kyerɛ; Dɛ Nyankopɔn noara na ɔyɛ tsɛmbuafo.
title: PSALMS

text: Mo nkorɔfo, hom ntsie, na merebɛkasa; Israel e, tsie, na miribedzi wo dase: Emi nye Nyankopɔn, mekyerɛ wo Nyankopɔn no.
title: PSALMS

text: Murunntwuw w’enyim wɔ wo kum afɔr ntsi, Eso wo hyew afɔr a ɔwɔ m’enyim daa no ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Meremmfa wo fie ɔnantwisaa, Eso wo nguamban mu mpɔnkyenyin.
title: PSALMS

text: Na kwaa mu mbowa nyina yɛ medze, Na mbepɔw pem do mbowa so.
title: PSALMS

text: Minyim mbepɔw do ntumbowa nyinara: Na wiramu mbowadoma nyina so medze a.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ ɔkɔm dze me a, merennka nnkyerɛ wo: Osiandɛ wiadze, na ne mayɛ, yɛ medze.
title: PSALMS

text: Aso mibedzi anantwinyin nam, Anaa mobɔnom mpɔnkye bɔgyaa?
title: PSALMS

text: Bɔ ndaase afɔr ma Nyankopɔn; Na tua w’anohobadze ma Ɔsorsornyi no:
title: PSALMS

text: Na frɛ me wɔ hia da no mu; Mebɛgye wo, na ɔwo so ahyɛ me enyimnyam.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi no dze, Nyankopɔn se no dɛ, Ebɛn tum na ewɔ dɛ eka m’ahyɛdze kyerɛ, Nna ɔwo afa m’ahyɛmu ato w’ano yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ dɛ ɔwo kor yi ara ikyir enyimtwuw, Naaso etow me nsɛm gu w’ekyir.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ ihu owifo a, enye no fa nyɛnko, Na wo kyɛfa wɔ awartofo nkyɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze w’anomu ma nsɛmbɔn, Na wo tɛkyerɛma hyehyɛ ndaadaasɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo etsena ase na eka nsɛm dze tsia wo nua; Na idzi wankasa wo na ba ho anokum.
title: PSALMS

text: Iyinom na ɔwo ayɛ, na meyɛɛ komm ntsi; Ɔwo isusuu dɛ meyɛ dɛ obi a ɔtse dɛ ɔwoara: Na mebɛka w’enyim, na mataataa no yie wɔ w’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Afei hom ndwen iyi ho, hom a hom werɛ efir Nyankopɔn, Ma maanntsetsew hom mu esinesin a ɔgyefo bi nnyi hɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ɔbɔ ndaase afɔr no ɔhyɛ me enyimnyam; Na nyia osiesie no kwan yie no Mebɛkyerɛ no Nyankopɔn no nkwagye.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, hu me mbɔbɔr dɛ mbrɛ w’adɔyɛ tse: Dɛ mbrɛ wo mbɔbɔrhu no dodow tse no pepa me mbrato.
title: PSALMS

text: Hohor mo ho koraa fi m’emumuyɛ mu, Na tsew mo ho fi mo bɔn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na muhu me mbrato: Na mo bɔn wɔ m’enyim daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo, woara nkotsee na mayɛ bɔn etsia wo, Na mayɛ dza ɔyɛ mbusu wɔ w’enyi do: Dɛm ntsi sɛ ekasa a, idzi ka, Na ibu atsɛn a, wo ho aatsew.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, wɔwoo me wɔ emumuyɛ mu; Na bɔn mu na me na nyinseen me.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, ɔwo epɛ nokwar a ɔwɔ akoma mu: Na no mu ehuntsae mu na ebɛma mehu nyansa.
title: PSALMS

text: Fa odwonhataw tsew mo ho, na mo ho befir: Guar me, na mo ho bɔhoa asen esukwankyɛba.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma mentse enyigye na ahosɛpɛw nka, Ama mbiew a ɔwo ebubu no no eedzi ehurusi.
title: PSALMS

text: Yi w’enyi fi mo bɔn ho huntsa, Na pepa m’emumuyɛ nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn, bɔ akoma a no mu tsew ma me, Na yɛ akoma a ɔtsen fofor wɔ mo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nntow me mmfi w’enyim nnkyen; Na nnyi wo krɔnkrɔnyɛ sunsum no mmfi mo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Fa wo nkwagye ho enyigye no san ma me bio: Na fa ɔpɛ sunsum suo mo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna mebɛkyerɛkyerɛ mbratofo w’akwan; Na ndzebɔnyɛfo bɛdan aba wo nkyɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn, ɔwo mo nkwagye Nyankopɔn, yi me fi bɔgya ho asodzi mu; Na me tɛkyerɛma atow wo tsenenee ho huro ndwom.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, bue m’anofamfa; Na memfa m’ano nyi w’ayɛyi nkyerɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo ammpɛ afɔrbɔ; nkyɛ mobɔbɔ: Ɔwo innyi akɔndɔ wɔ hyew afɔr mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, afɔr a epɛ nye sunsum bobɔe: Ao, Nyankopɔn, akoma a abobɔ na abotow no, ɔwo erommpow.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛ Zion yie wɔ w’enyisɔ pa no mu; Tow Jerusalɛm afasu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna ebɛpɛ tsenenee afɔr, ɔhyew afɔr na ɔhyew afɔr mu: Nna wɔdze anantwisaa bɔkɔ w’afɔrmbukyia do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔkatakyi, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ituw woho wɔ ewurkadze mu? Nyankopɔn adom wɔ hɔ daa nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo tɛkyerɛma hyehyɛ ndzebɔnyɛ; Dɛ oyindam a n’ano ndam ndam, odzi nkontompɔsɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edɔ bɔn sen papa; Na ator sen dɛ ebɛka dza ɔtsen.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edɔ amambɔesɛm ara nko, Ɔwo nkɔnkɔnsa tɛkyerɛma.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn so bodwuruw wo egu famu koraa, Obeyi wo hɔ, na oetu wo efi w’asesee mu. Na oetutu w’ase efi atseasefo asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Atseneneefo no so bohu, na woesuro, Na wɔaserew no, dɛ,
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, nyimpa a ɔammfa Nyankopɔn annyɛ n’akoban; Na ɔdze no werɛ tweer n’ahonya no dodow, Na ɔhyɛɛ noho dzen wɔ ne ndzebɔnyɛ mu no nye yi.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, metse dɛ ngodua prɔmprɔm wɔ Nyankopɔn fie: Medan Nyankopɔn n’adom daa daa nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛda wo ase daa, osiandɛ ɔwoara na ayɛ: Na matweɔn wo dzin, osiandɛ oye, wɔ w’ahotseweefo no enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔkwasea se wɔ n’akoma mu dɛ, Nyankopɔn nnyi beebi. Wɔaprɔw, na wɔayɛ emumuyɛdze a wokyir; Obi nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛ papa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn fi sor hwɛ nyimpa mba. Dɛ obohu dɛ obi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ badwembanyi, Obi a ɔhwehwɛ Nyankopɔn ekyir kwan a.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn nyina asan ekyir; hɔn nyina ho yɛ nkɔw; Obi nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛ papa, dabida, nnyɛ ɔbaako mpo.
title: PSALMS

text: Aso emumuyɛfo nnyim dze? Hɔn a wodzi me man dɛ mbrɛ wodzi edziban, Na wɔmmfrɛ Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔ na wosuro kɛse, wɔ mbrɛ suro bi nnyi: Na Nyankopɔn dze nyia ɔkyer wo do nsera ne mbiew apetse; Ɔwo ahyɛ hɔn enyiwu, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn apow hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, nkyɛ Israel nkwagye eefi Zion aba! Aber a Nyankopɔn dze ne man egyapadze bɛsan aba no, Nna Jakob bedzi ehurusi, na Israel enyi agye.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn, dua wo dzin do gye me, Na dua wo tum do dzi m’asɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, tsie me mpaayi; Yɛ aso ma m’anomu nsɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔnanaben asoɛr etsia me, Na nyimpa akakaben rohwehwɛ me kra: Wɔammfa Nyankopɔn ennsi hɔn enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, Nyankopɔn nye mo boafo: EWURADZE nye mo twitwagyefo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbɛma m’atamfo hɔn mbusu ebua hɔn etsifi: Ɔwoara sɛɛ hɔn wɔ wo nokwar no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛpra me yamu mabɔ wo afɔr; Medze ndaase bɛma wo dzin, Ao EWURADZE, osiandɛ oye.
title: PSALMS

text: Na eyi me efi ɔfona nyinara mu; Na m’enyiwa ehu m’apɛdze wɔ m’atamfo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Nyankopɔn, yɛ aso ma me mpaayi; Na mma nnhuntsa woho wɔ mo nkotoserɛ ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Kyɛn aso ma me, na gye me do: Mo ho nntɔ me wɔ mo nkɔmbɔdzi mu, na misi nkrum;
title: PSALMS

text: Osian ɔtamfo no ne ndze ntsi; Osian ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi no ne nhyɛdo ntsi; Na wɔtow emumuyɛdze gu mo do, Na ebufuw ntsi wɔtaa mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: M’akoma ridzi yaw wɔ mo mu: Na owu ho hu atɔ mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Osuro na ahopopo aba mo do, Na ahodwuruw akata mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mesee dɛ, Ao, sɛ mowɔ ebubur atsaban ɛ! Nkyɛ mubotu makɔ beebi, na maakɔhom.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, nkyɛ mibekyin makɔ ekyirkyiikyir, Na maakɛtsena sar no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Nkyɛ mebɛyɛ ntsɛm meguan Mefi mframa dzendzen na ehum no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, sɛɛ hɔn, na paapaa hɔn tɛkyerɛma mu, Na mehu akatabansɛm na aperdzi wɔ kurow no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Adzekyee na adzesaa wɔnam n’afasu do twa ho hyia: Emumuyɛ na ewurkadze wɔ no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ndzebɔnyɛ wɔ no mu: Nhyɛdo na ndaadaa mmpa m’abɔntsen do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na nnyɛ ɔtamfo bi na ɔhyɛ me amen; Ɔno dze nkyɛ mobɔsɔw. Nkyii so nnyɛ nyia okyir me no na okunkon noho wɔ mo do; Ɔno dze nkyɛ medze moho bohuntsa no:
title: PSALMS

text: Na mbom ɔwoara a, ɔdasanyi a menye wo sɛ a, Me gyafo na me nyɛnko brɛbo a.
title: PSALMS

text: Yedzi tsirmsɛm dɛɛdɛw, Na yɛnye nyimpakuw nantsewee wɔ Nyankopɔn fie a.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma owu mbra hɔn do, Ma wonsian nkɔ samanadze enyikan: Ma wɔmfa suro nkɔ hɔn ndakamona mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, mubosu afrɛ Nyankopɔn; Na EWURADZE bɛgye me nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ewimbir na anapa na wigyinae na mibedzi nkɔmbɔ na mesi nkrum: Na obetsie me ndze.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔagye me kra wɔ asomdwee mu efi ɔko a osii m’enyim no mu; Na hɔn a wɔperee tsiaa me dɔɔ so.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn betsie na ɔahaw hɔn, Mekyerɛ nyia ɔtse hɔ fi tsetse no. Osiandɛ wɔyɛ nyimpa a wonnyi nsakyer, Na wonnsuro Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Me nyɛnko atsen ne nsa wɔ hɔn a wɔnye no tse nsiesie mu do: Ɔato n’ahyɛmudzi.
title: PSALMS

text: N’ano yɛ dɛfɛɛ dɛ buter, Na n’akoma mu dze ɔko a: Ne nsɛm yɛ bɛtɛɛ sen ngo, Naaso wɔyɛ mfona a wɔatwetwe.
title: PSALMS

text: Tow w’adzesoa kyen EWURADZE do, na obosuo wo mu: Ɔremma kwan ma ɔtseneneenyi mmfi n’ananmu da.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo, Nyankopɔn, edze emumuyɛfo besian ɔsɛɛ mona no mu; Nyimpa bɔgyakafo na adaadaafo rinndzi hɔn nda ne fa mpo; Naaso emi dze, mobɔtwer wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Nyankopɔn, hu me mbɔbɔr; na ɔdasanyi repɛ amen me: Adzekyee nyina ɔdze ɔko hiahia mo ho.
title: PSALMS

text: M’atamfo repɛ amen me adzekyee nyina: Na hɔn a wɔama hɔnho do nye me roko dɔɔ so.
title: PSALMS

text: Ber a musuro no, Medze mo werɛ hyɛ wo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn mu na mibeyi n’asɛm ayɛw: Nyankopɔn mu na medze mo werɛ mahyɛ, murunnsuro; Nyimpa botum ayɛ me dɛn?
title: PSALMS

text: Adzekyee nyina na wosi me nsɛm tsir adze: Bɔn nko ara na wɔdwen tsia me.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔpon hɔnho hyia, wohuntsa hɔnho, Wɔhyɛ m’anamɔn nsew, Dɛ mbrɛ wɔatsɛw me kra.
title: PSALMS

text: Aso wɔnam emumuyɛ do befi nsa? Ao Nyankopɔn, fa aman hwehwe famu wɔ ebufuw mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na ibu mo nkwankwambɔ ano; Fa me nyinsuwa gu wo toa mu. Ana wonnyi wo nwoma mu?
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na m’atamfo bɛsan ekyir wɔ da a musu frɛ wo no: Iyi na minyim, dɛ Nyankopɔn wɔ hɔ ma me.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn mu na mibeyi n’asɛm ayɛw: EWURADZE mu na mibeyi n’asɛm ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn mu na medze mo werɛ mahyɛ, murunnsuro, Nyimpa botum ayɛ me dɛn?
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn, w’anohobadze wɔ mo hɔ: Mobɔbɔ ndaase afɔr ama wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo na agye me kra efi owu mu: Ana ɔwo innyii m’anan mmfii asehwe mu? Ama maanantsew Nyankopɔn enyim Wɔ nkwa kan no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hu me mbɔbɔr, Ao Nyankopɔn, hu me mbɔbɔr; Na wo mu na me kra nya guandɔbew: Nyew, wo ntsaban ase nwinwin mu mibenya mo guandɔbew, Ekodu dɛ mbusu yi botwa mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mubosu afrɛ ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn; Mebɛfrɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔma dza ɔahyehyɛ ama me no wie pɛyɛ no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbɔsoma efi sor abɛgye me nkwa, Aber a nyia ɔrepɛ amen me no rehyɛ ahorba no; Nyankopɔn bɔsoma n’adom na no nokwar,
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra da ngyata mu, Meda hɔn a wɔato hɔn gya mu, Mekyerɛ nyimpa a hɔn se yɛ mpeaa na egyen, Na hɔn tɛkyerɛma yɛ afona ndam ndam no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn, kyerɛ wo kɛseyɛ wɔ sorsor, Na w’enyimnyam mbɔ asaase nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Woesua m’anamɔn efir; Na me kra abrɛ adze: Woetu mona wɔ m’enyim; Naaso hɔnankasa akɔhwehwe mu.
title: PSALMS

text: M’akoma etsim, Ao Nyankopɔn, m’akoma etsim: Mobɔtow ndwom, nyew, mobɔtow ayɛyindwom.
title: PSALMS

text: M’enyimnyam, nyan ɛ; bɛnta na nsankutsen, hom nnyan: Emi mankasa so mibenyan ahema.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, mebɛda wo ase wɔ aman mu: Mobɔtow ayɛyindwom ama wo wɔ amanaman mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ w’ehumbɔbɔr so kodu ɔsorsor, Na wo nokwar kodu wimu noho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn, kyerɛ wo kɛseyɛ wɔ sorsor; Ma w’enyimnyam mbɔ asaase nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom etumfo, aso ampa dɛ hom ka nsɛntsenenee? Nyimpa mba, aso atsɛn tsenenee na hom bu yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Ampaara, hom dzi asɛmbɔn wɔ akoma mu; Hom nsamu akatabansɛm na hom ker dze ma wɔ asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ndzebɔnyɛfo bɔ ko fi yafun mu: Wɔwo hɔn ara a na wɔafom kwan, ridzi ator.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn bɔr tse dɛ abowatsena no bɔr: Wɔtse dɛ ehurutsia tsitsifo a osisiw n’aso;
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔnntse nyia ɔkantse no ndze, Kaansa ɔrekantse nyansa mu dɛn ara mpo a.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, bubu hɔn se wɔ hɔn anomu: EWURADZE, bubu ngyatamburwa se bɔmbɔfo no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma wɔnwew dɛ nsu a oruhuam: Sɛ ɔtaa n’egyen a, ma ɔnyɛ dɛ woetwa ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma wɔnyɛ dɛ ɔwaa a ɔnan sen kɔ: Ɔtse dɛ ɔba a ɔbaa apon a oennhu ewia da.
title: PSALMS

text: Ansaana hom nkutu bɛtse nsoɛ ne hyew no, Ɔdze ekyinmframa bɛpra hɛn akɔ, amon na dza wɔato nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ ɔtseneneenyi hu awerdzi no a, n’enyi bɛgye: Ɔbɔhohor n’anan ho wɔ ndzebɔnyɛfo bɔgyaa mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna nyimpa bɛka dɛ, Ampaara, akatua pa wɔ hɔ ma ɔtseneneenyi: Ampaara, Nyankopɔn bi wɔ hɔ a obu atsɛn wɔ asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, me Nyankopɔn, gye me fi m’atamfo nsamu: Fa me sie sor fi hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia me no nkyɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Gye me fi emumuyɛfo nsamu, Na gye me nkwa fi bɔgyapɛfo nsamu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na hwɛ, wɔtsɛw me kra; Akatakyi boaboa hɔn ano tsia me: Ao, EWURADZE, nnyɛ me mbrato, eso nnyɛ mo bɔn ntsi a.
title: PSALMS

text: Nnyɛ mo mfom ntsi na wotu mbirika siesie hɔnho: Kenyan wo ho bɔboa me, na hwɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Mekyerɛ ɔwo, dɔm EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn, Soɛr bɔtwe amanaman nyinara aso: Mma nnhu emumuyɛfo mbrato biara mbɔbɔr.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔsan ba ewimbir, wopuow dɛ mbɔdɔm, Na wokyinkyin kurow no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, wɔdze hɔn ano wor kasa; Mfona wɔ hɔn anofamfa do: Na hɔn adwen nye dɛ, Woana na ɔtse?
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo, EWURADZE, ebɛserew hɔn; Ɔwo ibesi amanaman nyinara atwetwe.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao m’ahoɔdzen, ɔwo na mobɔhwɛ wo kwan: Na ɔwo Nyankopɔn, eyɛ m’abantsentsen.
title: PSALMS

text: Me Nyankopɔn dze n’adom botwar m’ano: Nyankopɔn bɛma mehu m’apɛdze wɔ m’atsɛweefo ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nnku hɔn, bɛyɛ na me man werɛ efir: Fa wo tum bɔ hɔn petse, na fa hɔn hwe famu, Ao EWURADZE, hɛn kyɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn anomu nsɛm yɛ nsɛmbɔn, Na mpaa na akɔhwisɛm a wɔka ntsi, Ma wɔnkyer hɔn wɔ hɔn ntsɛn mu ara.
title: PSALMS

text: Hyew hɔn wɔ ebufuw mu, hyew hɔn, amma wɔaanntsena ase bio, Na ma wonhu dɛ Nyankopɔn na odzi Jakob do hen, Dze kodu asaase ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Ewimbir biara wɔsan ba, wopuow dɛ mbɔdɔm, Na wokyinkyin kurow no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔbɔ nkwankwan hwehwɛ edziban, Na sɛ wɔammee a, wɔtsena hɔ anafua nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze mobɔtow w’ahoɔdzen ho ndwom; Nyew, mobɔtow wo mbɔbɔrhu ho ehurusi ndwom anapa: Na ɔwo na ayɛ m’abantsentsen, Na guandɔbew wɔ m’ahokyer da no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: M’ahoɔdzen, ɔwo na mobɔtow ayɛyindwom ama wo: Na Nyankopɔn nye m’abantsentsen, mo mbɔbɔrhu Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn, ɔwo atow hɛn akyen, ɔwo egura hɛn egu famu; Wo bo efuw; dan hɛn bra hɛn dzibew bio.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ama asaase no ehim; ɔwo apaa mu: Ka mpaapaae no kuakua enyim, na ohihim.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ama wo man ehyia nkodzen: Ɔwo ama yɛatɔ ntentan dɛ yɛabow nsa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze frankaa ama hɔn a wosuro wo, Ama wɔdze aakyerɛ wɔ nokwar no ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma wɔaagye w’adɔfo ntsi, Fa wo nsa enyimfa gye hɛn nkwa, na boa hɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn akasa wɔ no krɔnkrɔnyɛ mu; mibedzi ehurusi: Mebɛkyɛ Sekem mu, na mesusu Sukɔt bɔnsa.
title: PSALMS

text: Gilead dzi wɔ me, na Manaasɛ dzi wɔ me; Efraim so yɛ me tsir do dadzekyɛw; Juda yɛ m’ahempoma,
title: PSALMS

text: Moab yɛ m’eguarsɛn; Edom do na mobɔtow mo nsokota akyen; Filistia, bɔ ose wɔ emi ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Woana na ɔdze me bɔkɔ kurow dzendzen no mu? Woana na obegya me akɔ Edom?
title: PSALMS

text: Ana nnyɛ ɔwo, na atow hɛn akyen yi, Ao Nyankopɔn? Na ɔwo, Nyankopɔn, ennye hɛn dɔm nntu nnkɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Bɔboa hɛn ɔtamfo no enyim: Na nyimpa mboa dze kwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛnam Nyankopɔn do bɛyɛ mbanyindze: Na ɔno nye nyia obetsiatsia hɛn atamfo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Nyankopɔn, tsie mo sufrɛ; Yɛ aso ma me mpaayi.
title: PSALMS

text: Mifi asaase ewiei noho na mebɛfrɛ wo ber a m’akoma apa: Gya me kɔ ɔbotan a ɔkrɔn sen me no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo na ayɛ guansumabea ama me, Abantsentsen a ɔyɛ dzen wɔ atamfo no enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛtsena wo ntamadan mu daa: Wo ntsaban akatado no ase na muboguan madɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo, Ao, Nyankopɔn, atse m’anohoba: Ɔwo edze hɔn a wosuro wo dzin no hɔn egyapadze no ama me.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ɔhen no nkwa nwar: Na ne mfe nkodu mbasantsen pii.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ɔntsena Nyankopɔn enyim daa: Siesie adɔyɛ na nokwar ma wɔnkora no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na mobɔtow ayɛyindwom ama wo dzin daa, Ma maapon m’anohobadze daa daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn ara na me kra ayɛ komm rohwɛ no: No hɔ na mo nkwagye fi ba.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno nko nye mo botan na mo nkwagye: Ɔno nye m’abantsentsen, mirinnhim ara da.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom botu ahyɛ ɔbaakofo do ekodu dabɛn, Ma hom nyinara eedwuruw no, Dɛ fasu a ehima, dɛ ban a orugura?
title: PSALMS

text: Dza wotu ho egyina ara nye dɛ wobosun no efi n’abɔsobea ahwe famu; Hɔn enyi gye atorsɛm ho: Wɔdze hɔn ano hyira, na hɔn mu dze wɔdom.
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra, yɛ komm hwɛ Nyankopɔn ara: Na m’enyidado fi no hɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: No nko ara nye mo botan na mo nkwagye: Ɔno nye m’abantsentsen: mirinnhihim.
title: PSALMS

text: Mo nkwagye na m’enyimnyam wɔ Nyankopɔn nsamu; M’ahoɔdzen botan na mo guandɔbew wɔ Nyankopɔn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Aman, hom ntwer no mber nyinara, Hom nhue hom akoma ngu n’enyim: Nyankopɔn yɛ guandɔbew ma hɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ampaara, nyimpa enyimfo yɛ ehubɔw, na nyimpa mbapɔmba yɛ atorfo: Wogu nsɛn mu a wohuan kɔ sor: Wɔyɛ har koraa sen ehubɔw.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma hom nntwer emimdzi, Na mma hom nnyɛ ahopɔw wɔ adzewia ho: Sɛ ahonyadze dɔɔ so a, mma hom mmfa hom akoma nnto do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na Nyankopɔn akasa prɛko; Mpɛn ebien na matse iyi; Dɛ tum yɛ Nyankopɔn dze:
title: PSALMS

text: Eso ɔwo, EWURADZE, na mbɔbɔrhu dzi wɔ wo: Na ɔwo na itua nyimpa biara kaw dɛ mbrɛ n’edwuma tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn, ɔwo nye me Nyankopɔn, mobɔhwehwɛ wo ahema: Wo ho nsukɔm dze me kra, na mafe wo, Wɔ asaase kɛsɛɛ a atɔ bitsi a nsu nnyi do do.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛmara na mahwɛ wo wɔ krɔnkrɔnbea hɔ, Dɛ mubohu wo tum na w’enyimnyam.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔnam dɛ w’adɔyɛ ye sen nkwa ntsi: M’anofamfa beyi wo ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi metse ase yi mibehyira wo; Mebɛma me nsa do wɔ wo dzin mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbɛmee me kra dɛ ehuor na seradze; Na m’ano dze ahosɛpɛw anofamfa beyi wo ayɛw;
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ mekaa wo wɔ me mpa do a, Modwendwen wo ho wɔ anadwe dasu mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ ɔwo na ayɛ mo boafo, Na wo ntsaban ase nwinwin mu na mibedzi ehurusi.
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra dzi w’ekyir pɛpɛɛpɛ: Wo nsa enyimfa dze mo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me kra asɛɛ no no, Wobesian akɔ asaase ase tɔnn.
title: PSALMS

text: Wobeyi hɔn ama afona no tum: Wɔbɛyɛ mpataku kyɛpɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔhen dze, n’enyi bɛgye wɔ Nyankopɔn mu: Obiara a ɔka ne ntam bɛhyehyɛ noho; Na wobomua hɔn a wodzi atorsɛm ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Tsie me ndze, Ao Nyankopɔn, wɔ mo nkɔmbɔdzi mu: Kora mo nkwa do fi ɔtamfo no ho suro ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Fa me huntsa fi ndzebɔnyɛfo nsumaa mu egyinatu ho; Fi emumuyɛfo weɔɔ weɔɔ no ho:
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔasew hɔn tɛkyerɛma dɛ afona, Na wɔataataa hɔn awenwen nsɛm dɛ egyen menaba, no:
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ wɔbɔtow abɔ nyia odzi mu no wɔ nsumaa mu: Awerɛfir mu na wɔtow bɔ no, na wonnsuro.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔhyɛ hɔnho dzen wɔ nsɛmbɔn ho, Wɔkeka mbrɛ wohuntsa sua efir; Wɔse dɛ, Woana na obohu hɔn?
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔbɔr hwehwɛ emumuyɛ; wɔse dɛ, Yeewie, yɛabɔ mbɔdzen abɔr: Na obiara no mu adwen, na n’akoma mu dɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Na Nyankopɔn bɔtow abɔ hɔn; Egyen menaba na wɔdze bepira hɔn awerɛfir mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm na wɔbɛma woefintsiw, hɔnankasa hɔn tɛkyerɛma do asɛm betsia hɔn: Hɔn a wohu hɔn nyinara bɔwosow hɔn tsir.
title: PSALMS

text: Na nyimpa nyinara bosuro; Na wɔaka Nyankopɔn n’edwuma akyerɛ, Na wɔadwen ne nyɛe ho nyansa mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi enyi bɛgye wɔ EWURADZE mu, na ɔatwer no; Na akoma mu tseneneefo nyinara bɛhyehyɛ hɔnho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn, ayɛyi yɛ wodze wɔ Zion: Na ɔwo na wɔbɛyɛ anohobadze no ama wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo itsie mpaayi, Wo nkyɛn na honam nyinara bɛba.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ emumuyɛdze dzi mo do nyim a: Ɔwo na ebɛpepa me mbrato.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiarfo nye nyimpa a ɔwo esan mu yi no, na ema ɔbɛn wo nkyɛn, Ma ɔaatsena w’abanguado: Wo fie ndzepa bɛmee hɛn, W’asɔrfi krɔnkrɔnbea no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo nam ndzɛmba a ɔyɛ hu do bobua hɛn wɔ tsenenee mu, Hɛn nkwagye Nyankopɔn; Ɔwo a eyɛ asaase ano nyinara werɛhyɛmu, Na hɔn a wɔwɔ po do ekyirekyir noho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo a edze w’ahoɔdzen dze mbepɔw etsintsim hɔ; Na edze tum emia:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo a ema po no hurututu, n’asorɛkye n’awor, Na aman hɔn weɔɔweɔɔyɛ taa dzinn.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn so a wɔtse ekyirekyir noho no wosuro wo nsɛnkyerɛdze: Ɔwo ma anapa na ewimbir mfirii dzi ehurusi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na esera asaase, na igugu do nsu, Ɔwo ema no do adze dɔɔ so; Nyankopɔn n’esutsen no nsu ma tɔ: Sɛ iwie asaase no siesie dɛm a, ɔwoara ema hɔn eburow.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo igugu n’akɔfi do nsu pii; Ɔwo ema n’apɔwapɔw tar: Edze nsutɔree yɛ no bɛtɛɛ; Na ihyira ne fifirii.
title: PSALMS

text: Edze wo ndzepa abɔ afrenhyia no abɔtsir; Na w’atsempɔn do sosɔw seradze.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔsosɔw sar do edzidzibea do: Na akoko dze enyigye emia.
title: PSALMS

text: Edzidzibea efura mbowakuw; Abɔn no mu so eburow akata do Wodzi ehurusi bɔ ose, wɔtow enyigye ndwom so.
title: PSALMS

text: Asaase nyinara, hom mfa ehurusi mbɔ ose mma Nyankopɔn:
title: PSALMS

text: Hom ntow ndwom mma ne dzin n’enyimnyam: Hom mma ne nkamfoe nyɛ enyimnyam.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nse Nyankopɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ wo ndwuma dua yɛ hu a: Wo tum ne kɛseyɛ ntsi w’atamfo bɛbrɛ hɔnho adze ama wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Asaase nyinara bɔsɔr wo; Na wɔatow ndwom ama wo; Wɔbɔtow ndwom ama wo dzin.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mbra mbɔhwɛ Nyankopɔn no ndwuma; No ho yɛ hu wɔ ne ndzeyɛɛ mu wɔ adasamba ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdaan po asaase kɛsɛɛ: Wɔdze anamɔn twaa esutsen no: Hɔ na hɛn enyi gyee no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze no tum dzi hen daa; N’enyiwa tua amanaman: Mma mma etuatsewfo mmema hɔnho do.
title: PSALMS

text: Aman, hom nhyira Nyankopɔn, Na hom mma wɔntse n’ayɛyi ndze:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na ɔdze hɛn aka atseasefo ho, Na ɔmma kwan mma hɛn anan mmpatser.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo Nyankopɔn asɔ hɛn ahwɛ: Ɔwo anan hɛn ahwɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔnan dwetɛ hwɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze hɛn ato efir mu; Ɔwo edze adzesoa pembɔɔ ato hɛn asen.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ama nyimpa anantsew edua hɛn tsir do; Yɛfaa ogya na nsu mu kɔree. Na ɔwo edze hɛn aba mbrɛ ndzepa ebu do.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze hyew afɔr bɛba wo fie, Mubotua wo m’anohobadze,
title: PSALMS

text: Dza m’anofamfa kasae, Na m’ano kae wɔ m’ahohiaber mu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze mbowa a wɔadɔ seradze bɔbɔ wo hyew afɔr, Ɔnye nguannyin huam; Medze anantwisaa nye mpɔnkye bɔbɔ afɔr.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom a hom suro Nyankopɔn nyinara, hom mbra mbetsie, Na mebɛka dza ɔayɛ ama me akyerɛ hom.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze m’ano sui frɛɛ no, Na medze me tɛkyerɛma tontoon no.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ mubu emumuyɛ bi wɔ m’akoma mu a, Nkyɛ EWURADZE rinntsie me:
title: PSALMS

text: Na ampaara Nyankopɔn etsie me; Ɔakyɛn aso ama me mpaabɔ ndze.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira nka Nyankopɔn a Ɔanndan me mpaabɔ enyi, eso oennyi no mbɔbɔrhu emmfi mo do no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn hu hɛn mbɔbɔr na hyira hɛn, Ma w’enyim ntsew wɔ hɛn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ama woeehu w’akwan wɔ asaase do, Na wo nkwahosan wɔ amanaman nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Nyankopɔn, ma aman nyi wo ayɛw; Ma aman nyinara nyi wo ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma amanaman enyi ngye na wɔntow ehurusi ndwom: Na ɔwo ibobu aman ntsɛntsenenee, Na akyerɛ asaase do amanaman kwan.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma aman nyi wo ayɛw Ao, Nyankopɔn; Ma aman nyinara nyi wo ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Asaase ama no ndɔbaa: Nyankopɔn, mekyerɛ hɛnankasa hɛn Nyankopɔn no, obehyira hɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn behyira hɛn; Ama asaaseanofo nyinara eesuro no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma Nyankopɔn nsoɛr, ma n’atamfo mpetse; Ma hɔn so a wɔtan no no mfi n’enyim nguan.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ mframa bɔ wusiw kɔ no, dɛmara so na bɔ hɔn kɔ: Dɛ mbrɛ ihua nan wɔ gya enyim no, Dɛmara so na ma ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi nsɛɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Na atseneneefo dze, ma hɔn enyi ngye; ma wondzi ehurusi wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim: Nyew, ma wɔmfa ahosɛpɛw ndzi ehurusi.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom ntow ndwom mma Nyankopɔn, hom ntow ayɛyindwom mma ne dzin: Hom mbɔ ɔtsempɔn kwan mma nyia ɔtse adze do nam sar do no; Ne dzin nye EWURADZE; na hom ndzi n’enyim ehurusi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ngyanka hɔn egya, na ekunafo hɔn sɛndzifo, Nye Nyankopɔn wɔ ne tsenabew krɔnkrɔn no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn dze ankonam si ebusua mu: Otu adaduafo dze hɔn ba eyiedzi mu: Na etuatsewfo dze, wɔtsena asaase a woetwee do.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, aber a ɔwo ipuei dzii wo man enyim, Aber a ɔwo ituu ntsen faa sar no do no;
title: PSALMS

text: Asaase wosowee, Ɔsor so sosɔɔw wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim: Sinai noara mpo wosoow wɔ Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn no enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo, Nyankopɔn, maa nyankom tɔɔ berdzedzeedze, Ɔwo na ehyɛɛ w’egyapadze dzen, aber a ɔtɔɔ bahaw no.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo mboanofo tsenaa mu: Ɔwo, Nyankopɔn, na isiesiee abɔbɔfo wɔ w’ayamuyie mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE kaa asɛm no; Mbaa a wɔdze nsɛmpa no tahye no wɔyɛ dɔm kɛse.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɔm ahemfo guanguan, woguanguan: Na nyia ɔtse fie na ɔkyɛ asadze mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a hom deda nguamban ntamu no, Ɔyɛ dɛ ebubur atsaban a wɔdze dwetɛ egu ho, Na ne ntɛkyerɛ a sika gonn hyerɛn wɔ ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a Otumfo no bɔɔ ahemfo petsee asaase no do no, Ɔyɛɛ dɛ aber a ɔrotɔ esukwankyɛba gu wɔ Zalmon no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn bepɔw nye Basan bepɔw no; Bepɔw sorɔnsorɔm Basan.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom mbepɔw sorɔnsorɔm hwɛ Bepɔw a Nyankopɔn apɛ dɛ ɔdze yɛ ne tsenabew no enyikankye yi? Ampa, EWURADZE bɛtsena do daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn ntseaseanam yɛ apeduonu mpempem mpempem mpo: EWURADZE wɔ hɔn mu, dɛ Sinai krɔnkrɔnbea no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo afow sor, afa wo ndɔmmumfo no ndɔmmum; Ɔwo akɛgye ayɛyɛdze wɔ nyimpa mu, Nyew, etuatsewfo so mu, ama EWURADZE Nyankopɔn aatsena hɔn nkyɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE a ɔsoa hɛn adzesoa ma hɛn daa daa, Mekyerɛ Nyankopɔn no a ɔyɛ hɛn nkwagye no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn yɛ nkwagye Nyankopɔn ma hɛn; Na EWURADZE no, na otum gye fi owu nsamu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na Nyankopɔn bɔbɔ n’atamfo tsir ehwira mu, Nyia ɔda ho nam n’afɔdzi mu ne tsir a woesie no tsimum no a.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE see dɛ, Medze fi Basan bɛba bio, Medze hɔn fi po ebun mu bɛba bio:
title: PSALMS

text: Ama edze w’anan aabɔ bɔgya mu, Ama wo mbɔdɔm tɛkyerɛma eenya ne kyɛpɛn wɔ w’atamfo ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, woehu wo edzifirii, Mekyerɛ me Nyankopɔn, me Hen, no mpuei a orubopue akɔ no krɔnkrɔnbea no.
title: PSALMS

text: Adwontofo no dzii enyim, asankubɔfo no dzii ekyir, Wɔ mbabaawa a wɔrowosow nkasaa no hɔn finimfin.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nhyira Nyankopɔn wɔ mboanofo no mu, EWURADZE no a, hom a hom fi Israel nsunyiwa no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Benjamin ketseaba wɔ hɔ, hɔn do hwɛfo nye no, Juda asafohemfo na hɔn apamfo, Zebulun asafohemfo, Naftali asafohemfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn kyerɛ w’ahoɔdzen: Kyerɛ wo tum, Ao Nyankopɔn, dza edze agye hɛn no.
title: PSALMS

text: Osian w’asɔrfi a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm ntsi Ahemfo dze akyɛdze bɛbrɛ wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Twuw ndzɛmbir mu abowa bɔyafo no, Anantwisaa kuw no, ɔnye aman anantwimba no enyim, Wɔdzedze ndwetɛbona robɔsom; Ɔno na ɔabɔ aman a wɔpɛ akodzi no apetse.
title: PSALMS

text: Ekunyin fi Egypt bɛba; Etiopia bɛyɛ ntsɛm atsen ne nsa ama Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Asaase do nhenman, hom ntow ndwom mma Nyankopɔn: Hom ntow ayɛyindwom mma EWURADZE;
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ɔtse ɔsorsor mu ɔsorsor a ofi tsetse no do no; Hwɛ, ɔbɔ ne ndze mu, na tum ndze a.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa ahoɔdzen mma Nyankopɔn: N’enyimnyam kata Israel do, Na n’ahoɔdzen wɔ wimu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, wo ho yɛ hu wɔ wo mbea krɔnkrɔn do: Israel Nyankopɔn, ɔno na ɔdze ahoɔdzen na tum ma ne man. Nhyira nka Nyankopɔn!
title: PSALMS

text: Ao NYANKOPƆN, gye me nkwa; Na esu no edu me kra mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Matɔ atɛkyɛ bun mu, mbrɛ gyinabew nnyi: Medu bun mu, mbrɛ nsuyirii kata mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Mo sufrɛ ama maberɛ, me meneba mu awew: Mahwɛ me Nyankopɔn kwan araa ma m’enyi ebu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔtan me kwa wɔdɔɔ so kyɛn me tsir do nhwi: Hɔn a wɔrepɛ etwa me akyen a wɔyɛ m’atamfo akɔhwifo no, wɔyɛ etumfo: Dza memmfae, nna wɔma mehyɛ ananmu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, ɔwoara nyim mo nkwaseasɛm; Na m’afɔdzi nnhuntsa wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn, mma mma hɔn a wɔtwer wo enyi nnto wɔ emi ntsi: Ao Israel Nyankopɔn, mma mma hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo mmfɛr wɔ emi ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ ɔwo ntsi na masɔw ahorbahyɛ; Enyito akata m’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Madan ɔhɔho ama mo nuanom, Na ɔnanaben mama me na ne mba.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wo fie ho dɔ ahyɛ me mu ma mbordo: Na hɔn a wɔhyɛ wo ahorohoraa hɔn ahorba no hɔn ahorbahyɛ atɔ mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a musui, na medze mbuadadzi tseaa me kra no, Ɔdaan ahorbahyɛ maa me.
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a medze eyitam yɛɛ m’efuradze no, Wodzii mo ho fen.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔtsetse kuropon ano dzi mo ho asɛm; Na asabokwafo dze me tow ndwom.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, ɔwo EWURADZE, na miyi wo mpaa wɔ enyisɔ ber mu: Nyankopɔn, w’adom dodow ntsi Gye me do wɔ wo nkwagye nokwar no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Yi me fi atɛkyɛ no mu, na mma mma memmem: Ma wonyi me mfi hɔn a wɔtan me nsamu, na ebun no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma mma nsuyirii no mmpram mo do, Nkyii so mma mma bun no mmen me; Na mma mma mona no mmua n’ano nnka me nnhyɛ mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, gye me do; na w’adɔyɛ ye: Dan woho ma me dɛ mbrɛ w’ehumbɔbɔr dodow no tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mma nnyi w’enyim nnhuntsa w’akowaa; Osiandɛ mowɔ ahokyer mu, na gye me do ntsɛntsɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Twe pinkyɛn me kra, na bɔpon no: M’atamfo ntsi tɔ mo wer.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo inyim m’ahoguan, na m’enyito, na me fɛr: M’atamfo nyinara wɔ m’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Ahorbahyɛ atsew m’akoma, na meyar ankasa; Na mohwɛ obi a ɔbɛtse ama me kwan na obi nnyi hɔ; Na akyekyewerɛfo, naaso mennhu obi.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔdze bɔwema so yɛ m’edziban; Na mo nsukɔm mu wɔmaa me nsa yerɛyerɛw dɛ monnom.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn pon a osi hɔn enyim ndan apafir; Na aber a wɔwɔ asomdwee mu no, ma ɔndan efir.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn enyi do nyɛ kusukusu, ama woeennhu adze; Na ma hɔn sisiw mpopo daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Hue w’ebufuhyew gu hɔn do, Na ma w’ebufuw enyiber nto hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn tsenabea ndan amamfo; Mma mma obiara nntsena hɔn asesee mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ wɔtaa nyia ɔwoara abɔ no no do: Na wɔka hɔn a ɔwoara epirapira hɔn no hɔn yaw.
title: PSALMS

text: Fa emumuyɛ ka hɔn emumuyɛ ho: Na mma mma wɔmmba wo tsenenee mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma wonyi hɔn mfi atseasefo nwoma no mu, Na mma wɔmmfa hɔn nnka atseneneefo ho nnkyerɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze meyɛ ɔbɔbɔnyi na ɔwerɛhonyi: Ao Nyankopɔn, ma wo nkwagye mfa me nsi sorsor.
title: PSALMS

text: Na medze adwontow ibeyi Nyankopɔn wo dzin ayɛw, Na medze aseda atonton wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔbɔsɔ EWURADZE enyi yie asen anantwinyin, Anaa ɔnantwisaa a ɔwɔ mmbɛn na ntɔtse.
title: PSALMS

text: Aberɛfo ehu, na hɔn enyi agye: Hom a hom hwehwɛ Nyankopɔn ekyir kwan, hom mma hom akoma nnya nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ EWURADZE tsie ehiafo, Na ommbu no nkorɔfo enyimtsia.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma sor na asaase nkamfo no, Po na dza ɔkeka noho wɔ mu nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Na Nyankopɔn bɛgye Zion nkwa, na ɔakyekyer Juda nkurow; Na wɔatsena mu, na wɔafa ayɛ hɔndze.
title: PSALMS

text: No nkowaa asefo so benya edzi; Na hɔn a wɔdɔ ne dzin no atsena mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao NYANKOPƆN, yɛ ntsɛm bɛgye me ae; Yɛ ntsɛm bɔboa me, ao EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ mo wu no Hɔn enyi nto na hɔn enyim ngu ase: Ma hɔn a wɔpɛ me bɔn no Nsan hɔn ekyir na wɔndan adapaafo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a wɔse dɛ, Yɛɛ, yɛɛ, no Nsan hɔn ekyir wɔ hɔn enyito ho akatua ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo nyinara ndzi ehurusi na hɔn enyi ngye wɔ wo mu; Na ma hɔn a wɔdɔ wo nkwagye nka daa dɛ, Ampa Nyankopɔn yɛ kɛse.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, meyɛ bɔbɔnyi na hianyi; Ao, Nyankopɔn, yɛ ntsɛm ma me: Na ɔwo nye mo boafo na me gyefo; EWURADZE, mma nnkyinkyim.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, wo mu na medze mo werɛ hyɛ: Mma mma m’enyim nngu ase dabiarada.
title: PSALMS

text: Yi me wɔ wo tsenenee mu, na gye me: Brɛ w’aso adze ma me, na gye me nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛ dɛ ɔtsenabea botan a modɔ hɔ daa ma me: Ɔwo ahyɛ dɛ wɔngye me nkwa; Na ɔwo nye mo botan na m’akoban.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, me Nyankopɔn, gye me fi ɔdzebɔnyɛfo no nsamu, Gye me fi omumuyɛfo na otsiɔdzenfo nsamu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwoara, Ao EWURADZE, Nyankopɔn nye m’enyidado: Nyia mifi mbofrase dze mo werɛ too no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na mifi yafun mu medze moho tweer wo: Ɔwo nye nyia oyii me fii me na yamu: Ɔwo na mibeyi wo ayɛw daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Mayɛ dɛ anwanwadze ama dodowara; Na ɔwo nye mo guandɔbea dzendzen.
title: PSALMS

text: W’ayɛyi bɛhyɛ m’anomu ma, Na ɔnye w’enyidzii adzekyee nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nntow me nnkyen wɔ nkɔdaaber mu, Sɛ m’ahoɔdzen sa a, mma mmpa me.
title: PSALMS

text: Na m’atamfo ka mo ho asɛm, Na hɔn a wɔtsɛw me kra no bɔ mu tu egyina,
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ, Nyankopɔn apa no ntsi, Hom ntsiw no nkyer no; na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɛgye no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, mma nnye me ntamu nntwe: Me Nyankopɔn, yɛ ntsɛm bɔboa me.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a wɔyɛ m’atamfo no enyi nnto na wɔnnsɛɛ; Ma enyimguase na fɛr nkata hɔn a wɔpɛ me bɔn no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, mibenya enyidado daa, Na mada ho eyi wo ayɛw mbordo mbordo.
title: PSALMS

text: M’ano bɛka wo tsenenee, Na wo nkwagye adzekyee nyinara; Na minnyim no dodow.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze EWURADZE Nyankopɔn n’akatakyidze bɛba: Mobɔbɔ wo tsenenee dzin, mekyerɛ, wo nko wodze no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Nyankopɔn, ɔwo na ifi me mbofrase akyerɛkyerɛ me; Na maka w’anwanwa dwuma akyerɛ dze ebodu sesei.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, mo nkɔdaaber na gon mu mpo, Ao, Nyankopɔn, mma mmpa me; Ma onkodu dɛ maka w’ahoɔdzen ho asɛm akyerɛ nkyirmba, Wo tum akyerɛ hɔn a wɔreba nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, wo tsenenee so wɔ sorsorsor; Ɔwo a ayɛ adze akɛse, Nyankopɔn, woana na ɔtse dɛ ɔwo?
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo a akyerɛ hɛn ɔfona yaayaw pii no, Ebɛma yeenya nkwa bio, Na edze hɛn efi asaase tsirmu aba sor bio.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo bɛma m’akɛseyɛ adɔɔ so, Na ebɛdan woho bio abɛkyekye mo werɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze bɛntasanku so beyi wo ayɛw, Mekyerɛ wo nokwar no a, me Nyankopɔn: Ɔwo na medze nsankutsen bɔtow wo ayɛyindwom, Ao, ɔwo Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ motow ayɛyindwom ma wo a, m’anofamfa ho bɛsɛpɛw no kɛse; Na me kra a ɔwo apon no no.
title: PSALMS

text: Me tɛkyerɛma so bɛka wo tsenenee ho asɛm adzekyee nyinara: Na hɔn a wɔpɛ me bɔn no, hɔn enyi ato, na hɔn enyim egu ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, fa w’atsɛmbu ma ɔhen, Na wo tsenenee ma ɔhen ne ba.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ɔmfa tsenenee nhwɛ wo man do, Na ɔmfa atsɛmbu nhwɛ w’abɔbɔfo do,
title: PSALMS

text: Ma mbepɔw mfa asomdwee mbrɛ ɔman no, Na akoko so mbra wɔ tsenenee mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ombu ɔman mu abɔbɔfo atsɛn, Ma ɔngye ehiafo mba nkwa, Na ombubu ahyɛdofo no posoposo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ewia na bosoom da ho wɔ hɔ yi, Ma wonsuro wo wɔ mbasantsen nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ɔmbra dɛ nyankom a ɔtɔ gu nkyɛkyɛr a woekruw do do: Dɛ nsu kɛse a ɔtɔ fɔw asaase.
title: PSALMS

text: N’aber do na ma atseneneefo nyɛ prɔmprɔm; Na asomdwee pii mbra, nkodu dɛ bosoom nnyi hɔ bio.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma onnya ahendzi so mfi po ho nkesi po ho, Na omfi Esutsen no ho nkesi asaase ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a wɔtse sar no do nkotow n’enyim; Na n’atamfo ntafer huntuma.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma Tarsis na nsupruw mu ahemfo mfa ayɛyɛdze mbra: Na Seba na Seba ahemfo mfa akyɛdze.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, ma ahemfo nyinara ntwa nhwehwe n’enyim: Ma amanaman nyinara nsom no.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ ohianyi su a, ma ɔngye no do; Na bɔbɔnyi a onnyi boafo no so.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma onhu ɔbrɛfo na ohianyi mbɔbɔr, Na ɔngye ehiafo nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ɔngye hɔn mfi nhyɛdo na akatabansɛm mu; Ma hɔn bɔgyaa nsom bo wɔ n’enyi do:
title: PSALMS

text: Ma wɔntsena ase, na ɔno na wɔmfa Seba sika bi mma no: Na nyimpa mbɔ mpaa mma no daa; Wonhyira no adzekyee nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma eburow piigyan mbra mbepɔw etsifi asaase no do; Na wɔmma no do aba nwosow dɛ Lebanon: Na ekuromfo nyɛ prɔmprɔm dɛ asaase do nkyɛkyɛr.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma ne dzin ntsena hɔ daa daa, Na ewia wɔ hɔ yi wɔmma ne dzin nwɔw do; Na nyimpa nyinara nhyira hɔnho wɔ no mu; Amanaman mfrɛ no ɔhomkanyi.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn a No nkotsee na ɔyɛ anwanwadze no:
title: PSALMS

text: Na nhyira nka n’enyimnyam dzin no daa daa; Na wɔmma n’enyimnyam nhyɛ asaase nyina ma. Amen, na Amen.
title: PSALMS

text: Jesse ba David ne mpaabɔ abɔ adze.
title: PSALMS

text: Ampaara, Nyankopɔn ye ma Israel, Mekyerɛ hɔn a hɔn akoma mu tsew.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, nkyɛ m’anan reyɛ aman; M’anamɔn reyɛ apatser.
title: PSALMS

text: Na minyaa ahopɔwfo ho ahoɔyaw, Aber a muhun ndzebɔnyɛfo eyiedzi no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na owungyam bi nnyi hɔn wu mu: Na mbom hɔn ahoɔdzen wɔ hɔ pintsinn.
title: PSALMS

text: Wonnyi fona mu dɛ nyimpa binom; Nkyii so wonnguan hɔn do dɛ nyimpa binom.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi ntsɛn tse dɛ ntweaban brabra hɔn kɔn ho; Akatabansɛm kata hɔn ho dɛ atar.
title: PSALMS

text: Seradze ama hɔn enyiwa apopɔr: Hɔn akoma mu adwendwen bu do.
title: PSALMS

text: Wosi atwetwe, na ndzebɔnyɛ mu wɔka nhyɛdosɛm: Wɔka ekromponsɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔama hɔn ano ato sor, Na hɔn gyirama nenam asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi na no nkorɔfo san ba ha: Na wɔsɔn nsu a ofi kɔɔpow a ayɛ ma mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔse dɛ, Nyankopɔn si dɛn hu? Ana nyimdzee bi wɔ Ɔsorsornyi no mu?
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, woyinom nye nyimpa bɔn no; Na hɔn ho dwe hɔn daa ntsi, wɔdɔr wɔ ahonya mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ampaara matsew m’akoma ho kwa, Na mahohor me nsa ho wɔ abemdzi mu kwa;
title: PSALMS

text: Na woeguan mo ho adzekyee nyinara, Na wɔatsea me anapa nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ mesee dɛ, Mebɛka no dɛm a, Hwɛ, ɔnodze mubotwa wo mbasantsen nkontompɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a modween mbrɛ mebɛyɛ ehu yi no, Ɔyɛɛ m’enyi do edwumadzen;
title: PSALMS

text: Kodur dɛ mokɔr Nyankopɔn n’ahotseweebea no mu hɔ, Na mukohun mbrɛ hɔn ewiei rukowie.
title: PSALMS

text: Ampaara, edze hɔn esisi beebi mbrɛ ɔyɛ tor: Na ɔwo dze hɔn hwe famu ma wɔsɛɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbrɛ woedua adan amamfo awerɛfir mu a! Hu ama wɔasa koraa.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ daa a wɔaso enyan; Dɛmara so na ɔwo, EWURADZE, sɛ inyan a, ibobu hɔn suban tootooba.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ m’akoma awerɛhow, Na me nsɛbɛ mu wowɔɔ me:
title: PSALMS

text: Meyɛɛ dɛ ɔkwasea a minnyim dze; Meyɛɛ dɛ abowa wɔ w’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso mowɔ wo nkyɛn daa: Ɔwo na esuo me nsa enyimfa mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze w’apam bɛkyerɛ me kwan, Na n’ekyir no agye me akɔ enyimnyam mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Woana na mowɔ no wɔ sor ka wo ho? Na obi nnyi asaase do a morohwehwɛ no ka wo ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Mo honam na m’akoma repa: Na Nyankopɔn nye m’akoma n’ahoɔdzen na me kyɛpɛn daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na hwɛ, hɔn a wɔnye wo ntamu twe no wɔbɛsɛɛ: Ɔwo asɛɛ hɔn a wofi wo nkyɛn kɔgor ndwamangor nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, oye ma me dɛ motwe pin Nyankopɔn: Medze EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ayɛ mo guandɔbea, Ama maaka no ndwuma nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na atow hɛn akyen koraa yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’ebufuw rehyew w’edzidzibea do nguan yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Kaa wo dɔm a etɔɔ hɔn tsetseetse no a Apon hɔn dɛ wɔnyɛ w’egyapadze ebusuakuw no; Na bepɔw Zion a ɔwo etsena do no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma w’anan do bra daa amamfo no ho, Ɔtamfo no abɔ mbusu nyinara wɔ krɔnkrɔnbea no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: W’atamfo atseatsea mu wɔ w’ehyiadzifo mu; Woesisi hɔn mfrankaa ayɛ asɛnkyerɛdze.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔyɛɛ dɛ nyimpa a wɔama mbɔndua do sor Robɔtow ndupɔn petsepetse.
title: PSALMS

text: Na afei no ho edwindze nyinara Wɔdze ekuma na nhamɛr ebubu egu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔato wo krɔnkrɔnbea mu gya; Woegu wo dzin ne tsenabea ho fi akɛka famu mpo.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔka no wɔ hɔn akoma mu dɛ, Wɔmma yɛnyɛ hɔn buruburoo prɛko: Wɔahyehyew Nyankopɔn ne nhyiamudan a ɔwɔ asaase no do nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Yennhu hɛn nsɛnkyerɛdze: Nkɔnhyɛnyi bi nnyi hɔ bio; Nkyii so obi nnyi hɛn mu a onyim mbrɛ ɔbɛkyɛr ekesi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Nyankopɔn, ɔtamfo no nhyɛ amen araa nkesi dabɛn? Aso ɔtamfo nkasa wo dzin ho bɔn daa?
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na etwe wo nsa kɔ ekyir, mekyerɛ wo nsa enyimfa no a? Yi fi w’akoko mu na sa hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso Nyankopɔn yɛ Hen fi tsetseetse, Ɔyɛ nkwagye ho edwuma wɔ asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na edze w’ahoɔdzen paa po mu: Ɔwo na ibubu esu mu mbowapɔn etsir.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na ibubu dɛnkyɛmnyin tsir posoposo, Ɔwo na edze no yɛɛ edziban maa sar do atsefo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na epaa nsunyiwa na nsuyirii mu: Ɔwo na eweew esutsen a ɔpem daa no.
title: PSALMS

text: Adzekyee yɛ wodze, adzesaa so wodze a; Ɔwo na esiesie kan na ewia.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na etwitwa asaase ahe nyinara: Ɔwo na ayɛ hyewber na awɔwber.
title: PSALMS

text: Kaa iyi dɛ, ɔtamfo ahyɛ ɔwo EWURADZE ahorba, Na dɛ ɔman nkwasea aka wo dzin ho nsɛmbɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, mma nnyi w’atamram no nkwa nnhyɛ abowa bɔyafo no nsa: Mma wo werɛ mmfir w’ehiafo nkwa da.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma w’enyi mbra ahyɛmu no do: Na akatabansɛm tsenabea ayeyɛ asaase nkukua mu ma.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, mma mma nyia wɔhyɛ no do no mmfa enyito nnsan mmba: Ma ɔbɔbɔnyi na ohianyi nkamfo wo dzin.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, soɛr ɛ, bedzi wankasa w’asɛm: Kaa mbrɛ ɔkwasea no esi rehyɛ wo ahorba adzekyee nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma wo werɛ mmfir w’atamfo ndze: Hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia wo no hɔn weɔɔ weɔɔ a ɔfow sor daa no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, yɛdze ndaase ma wo; Yɛdze ndaase ma wo, na yɛbɔ wo dzin: Adasa ka w’anwanwa dwuma ho asɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo se, Sɛ mber a ɔsɛ ba a, Mubobu atsɛn tsenenee mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Asaase na no do atsefo nyinara huenyan a: Emi na medze no mu edum sisi hɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Mese ahopɔwfo dɛ, Mma hom nnyɛ ahopɔw; Na ndzebɔnyɛfo dɛ, Mma hom mma hom ambɛn do:
title: PSALMS

text: Mma hom mma hom ambɛn do wɔ sor; Mma hom nnkye hom kɔn nnkasa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ommfi boka, eso ommfi anee, Eso ommfi pomu na amado ba.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mbom Nyankopɔn nye ɔtsɛmbuafo: Ɔno na ɔbrɛ ɔbaako adze, na ɔma ɔbaako so do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE ne nsamu wɔ kɔɔpow bi, na no mu wenyin twa ehur; Aforafora nsa ma, na ohue bi: Ampaara n’ase nsaa mpo, asaase do ndzebɔnyɛfo nyinara bohwiew, na wɔanom.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emi dze, mebɛka daa, Mobɔtow ayɛyindwom ama Jakob Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ndzebɔnyɛfo ambɛn nyinara so mubotwitwa egu; Na atseneneefo ambɛn dze wɔbɛma do wɔ sor.
title: PSALMS

text: Juda na wohun Nyankopɔn: Ne dzin so wɔ Israel.
title: PSALMS

text: Salem na ne ntamadan si, Na ne tsenabea wɔ Zion.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔ na obubuu egyen no n’egyen menaba mu; Kyɛm no, afona no, na ɔsa no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo yɛ onyimnyamfo na abɔso sen afonam mbepɔw no mpo.
title: PSALMS

text: Akokodurfo no wɔafow hɔn, wɔada hɔn nda, Na akatakyi no mu biara ennhu hɔn nsa.
title: PSALMS

text: Jakob Nyankopɔn, wo nkaenyim ntsi, Na tseaseanam na ɔpɔnkɔ nyina atotɔ nda heii.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo, mekyerɛ ɔwo, na wo ho yɛ hu: Na sɛ wo bo nya fuw a, woana botum w’enyim gyina?
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ma wɔtse atsɛmbu fi sor; Asaase suroi, na ɔyɛɛ dzinn.
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a Nyankopɔn soɛɛr dɛ orubobu atsɛn, Dɛ ɔbɛgye hɔn a wɔdwe wɔ asaase do nyinara nkwa no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ampaara nyimpa n’ebufuw beyi wo ayɛw: Na ebufuw nkaase no ɔwo besianka.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mbɔ anohoba, na hom ntua mma EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn: Wɔmma hɔn a wɔabɔ no ho aprɔw nyinara mfa akyɛdze mbra nyia no ho yɛ hu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia otwa asafohemfo sunsum kyen: No ho yɛ hu ma asaase do ahemfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Mubosu afrɛ Nyankopɔn dzendzenndzen; Mekyerɛ Nyankopɔn na medze me ndze bɛfrɛ no, na ɔbɛyɛ aso ama me.
title: PSALMS

text: Mo fona da mu mohwehwɛɛ EWURADZE: Me nsamu tseen anafua, na ɔannwodow; Me kra poow dɛ obenya awerɛkyekyer.
title: PSALMS

text: Mekaa Nyankopɔn a, misi apen: Modwendwen a, me kra tɔ bahaw.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na edze m’enyisoatsɛw mu ma osi pe: Mafona ma munntum mennkasa.
title: PSALMS

text: Madwen tsetse nda no ho, Tsetseberdo mfe no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Mekaa m’adzesaa mu adwontow no: Modwendween mankasa m’akoma mu; Na mo sunsum hwehwɛɛ mu pɛsɛɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Aso EWURADZE bɔtow akyen daa? Aso ɔrennyɛ adom bio?
title: PSALMS

text: Aso no mbɔbɔrhu etwa mu kɔ kranana? Aso anohoba asa nwionn nwionn?
title: PSALMS

text: Aso Nyankopɔn no werɛ efir dɛ ɔbɛyɛ adom? Aso ɔdze ebufuw atow n’ayamuhyehye mu?
title: PSALMS

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Iyi yɛ me awerɛhow; Na mbom mebɛkaa Ɔsorsornyi ne nsa nyimfa mfe no asesa.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔbɔ EWURADZE, mebɛkaa wo ndzeyɛɛ akɛse no; Nyew, mebɛkaa wo tsetse anwanwadze no.
title: PSALMS

text: Eso mobɔdwendwen wo ndwuma nyinara ho, Na mesina adwen wɔ wo ndzeyɛɛ ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Nyankopɔn, wo kwan wɔ ahotseweebea no mu: Woana na ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn kɛse dɛ ɔwo Nyankopɔn?
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn a eyɛ anwanwadze: Ɔwo ama woehu w’ahoɔdzen wɔ aman mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze w’abasa agye wo man, Jakob na Josef mba no.
title: PSALMS

text: Esuesu no hun wo, Nyankopɔn; Esuesu no hun wo, na wɔkoo awoo: Ebun so ho popoe.
title: PSALMS

text: Mununkum huee nsu gui; Wimu bobɔɔ mu: W’egyen menaba so fiir edzi.
title: PSALMS

text: W’asenaman ne ndze wɔ ekyinmframa no mu; Enyinam no gyegyee wiadze do: Asaase ho popoe na ɔwosowee.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo kwan daa po mu, Na w’atsempɔn daa nsu akɛse no mu, Na woennhu w’anamɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo enam Moses na Aaron nsa do Gyaa wo man dɛ mbowakuw.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, me man, hom nyɛ aso mma me nkyerɛkyerɛ: Hom nkyɛn hom aso mma m’anomu nsɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Mubobue m’ano wɔ mbɛbu mu; Mebɛka tsetsesɛm a no mu yɛ sum:
title: PSALMS

text: Dza yɛatse na yeehu, Na hɛn egyanom aka akyerɛ hɛn no.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛremmfa nnsuma hɛn mba, Yɛreka EWURADZE ayɛyisɛm kyerɛ nkyirmba, Na n’ahoɔdzen, na n’anwanwa dwuma a ɔayɛ no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔno na ɔdze mbrasɛm etsintsim wɔ Jakob mu, Na ɔahyɛ mbra wɔ Israel mu, Dza ɔdze hyɛɛ hɛn egyanom, Dɛ wɔmma hɔn mba nhu no:
title: PSALMS

text: Ama nkyirmba eehu, mekyerɛ mba a wɔbɔwo hɔn no, Hɔn na wɔbɔsoɛr na wɔaka akyerɛ hɔn mba:
title: PSALMS

text: Ma wɔdze hɔn enyidado ato Nyankopɔn do, Na hɔn werɛ emmfir Nyankopɔn no ndwuma no, Na mbom woedzi ne mbrasɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔannyɛ dɛ hɔn egyanom, Mbasantsen asoɔdzenfo na etuatsewfo; Mbasantsen a wɔmmfa hɔn akoma nnsi dza ɔtsen do, Na hɔn sunsum nntsintsim wɔ Nyankopɔn afamu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Efraim mba a woemia kurakura egyen no, Wɔdaan hɔn ekyir wɔ nkoda no mu;
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ woenndzi Nyankopɔn n’ahyɛmu no do, Na wɔpoow dɛ wɔbɛnantsew ne mbra mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn werɛ fiir ne ndzeyɛɛ, Na n’anwanwa ndwuma a ɔdze kyerɛɛ hɔn no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ahobowdze na ɔyɛɛ no wɔ hɔn egyanom enyim, Wɔ Egypt asaase do, wɔ Zoan mfuwa mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔpaa po mu, na ɔdze hɔn twaa mu; Na ɔmaa esu no gyinaa dɛ kuw.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze mununkum gyaa hɔn kwan adzekyee so, Na adzesaa nyinara ɔdze ogya kandzea.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔpaapaa abotan mu wɔ sar no do, Na ɔmaa wɔnoom nsu mee dɛ ofi ebun mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze nsutsen so fii ɔbotan mu bae, Na ɔmaa nsu peem dɛ esutsen.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso wɔkɔr do araa yɛɛ bɔn tsiaa no, Wɔtseew Ɔsorsornyi no do etua wɔ sar no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔsɔɔ Nyankopɔn hwɛe wɔ hɔn akoma mu Dɛ wobisaa edziban maa hɔn akɔndɔ ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, wɔkasae tsiaa Nyankopɔn; Wɔsee dɛ, Aso Nyankopɔn botum ato pon wɔ sar do?
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, ɔbɔɔ ɔbotan ma nsu tuei, Na nsutsen pemee; Aso obotum ama boodoo so? Aso obenya nam ama ne man?
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE tsee, na onyaa ebufuw: Na gya sɔe wɔ Jakob do, Na ebufuw so soɛree tsiaa Israel:
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ wɔanngye Nyankopɔn enndzi, Na wɔammfa hɔn werɛ anntwer no nkwagye.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso ɔhyɛɛ wimu wɔ sor, Na obuebuee ɔsor mbobow no;
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔtɔr manna guu hɔn do dɛ wondzi, Na ɔdze sor eburow bi maa hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyimpa dzii akatakyi edziban: Ɔmaa hɔn edziban ma wɔmee.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔmaa boka mframa bɔɔ wɔ sor: Na ɔdze no tum gyaa pomu mframa kwan.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtɔr nam so guu hɔn do dɛ huntuma, Na ntɛkyerɛbowa dɛ mpoano anhwea:
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔmaa ɔtɔree wɔ hɔn nsera no mu, Dze twaa hɔn tsenabea ho hyiae.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna wodzidzii mee ara yie; Na ɔmaa hɔn dza hɔn kɔn dɔe.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn akɔndɔ nnyae nngyaae, Na hɔn edziban da ho da hɔn anomu no,
title: PSALMS

text: Nna Nyankopɔn n’ebufuw soɛree tsiaa hɔn, Na okunkum hɔn mu abran no mu bi, Na ɔbobɔɔ Israel mberantsɛ no hwehwee famu.
title: PSALMS

text: Iyi nyinara mu no mpo nna wɔda ho yɛ bɔn, Na wɔanngye n’anwanwa dwuma no enndzi.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔmaa hɔn nda sae wɔ egyangyandze mu, Na hɔn mfe wɔ ehuyidze mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a okunkum hɔn no, nna wɔhwehwɛɛ n’ekyir kwan: Na wɔsanee hwehwɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyiberdo.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔkaa dɛ Nyankopɔn yɛ hɔn botan, Na Ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn no yɛ hɔn pomfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔdze hɔn ano dzɛfɛdzɛfɛɛw no, Na wɔdze hɔn tɛkyerɛma dzii ator kyerɛɛ no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na hɔn akoma enntsim wɔ no ho, Nkyii so woenndzi nokwar wɔ n’ahyɛmu no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso, ɔnodze, ayamuhyehye ahyɛ no ma ntsi, ɔdze hɔn emumuyɛ kyɛe, na ɔannsɛɛ hɔn; Nyew, mber pii na ɔdaan n’ebufuw kɔree, Na oennkenyan n’ebufuhyew nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔkaa dɛ wɔyɛ honam ara; Mframa a ɔbɔ kɔ, na ɔnnsan mmba bio.
title: PSALMS

text: Mpɛn ahen ara na wɔanntsew no do etua wɔ sar no do, Na wɔannhow no werɛ wɔ asaase kwawee no do!
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔsaan bio bɔsɔɔ Nyankopɔn hwɛe, Na woyii Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ehi.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔannkaa no tum, Eso da a ɔgyee hɔn fii hɔn atamfo nsamu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛdze wɔ Egypt, Na n’anwanwadze wɔ Zoan mfuwa mu;
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔdaan hɔn esutsen bɔgya, Na hɔn nsupemee, ma woenntum annom no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsomaa atsɛn pii wɔ hɔn mu, ma wɔbɔwee hɔn; Na ntwɛr, ma wɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze hɔn ndɔbaa so maa nkonyinko, Na hɔn edwumadze maa mbɛbɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze ɔsorbo kum hɔn wenyinndua, Na ɔdze nsukyenkyenee bɔɔ hɔn ankye ndua.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze hɔn anyɛmbowa so maa ɔsorbo no, Na hɔn mbowakuw maa asenamambo hyew.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtoow n’ebufuw ne hyeehyew no guu hɔn do, Ebufuw, na enyiber, na ahohia, Dɛ abɔfo bɔn a wɔsɛɛ adze.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbɔɔ kwan maa n’ebufuw; Ɔammfa hɔn kra annkam owu, Na oyii hɔn maa owuyarba;
title: PSALMS

text: Na okum Egypt mbakan nyinara, Hɔn ahoɔdzen ahyɛse wɔ Ham n’asesee mu:
title: PSALMS

text: Na ogyaa nankasa ne man dɛ nguan, Na ɔkaa hɔn wɔ sar no do dɛ mbowakuw.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ogyaa hɔn dwudwoodwo kɔree, ma woennsuro hwee: Na hɔn atamfo dze, po kataa hɔn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔdze hɔn baa ne he krɔnkrɔn no do, Bepɔw yi a ne nsa enyimfa tɔe no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔpaam amanaman so wɔ hɔn enyim, Na ɔdze ahoma kyɛe maa hɔn dɛ egyapadze, Na ɔmaa Israel mbusuakuw tsenatsenaa hɔn asesee mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso wɔsɔɔ Ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn hwɛe na wɔtseew no do etua, Na woenndzi mbrasɛm do;
title: PSALMS

text: Mbom wɔsaan ekyir, na wotwaa nkontompɔ dɛ hɔn egyanom: Wɔdaan hɔn faa nkyɛn dɛ egyen daadaafo.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔdze hɔn sorɔnsorɔmbea yii no ehi, Na wɔdze hɔn ehonyi a woegu yii no nyinkun.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn tsee iyi no, no bo fuwii, Na Israel he yɛɛ no nkɔw koraa:
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ntsi ɔdaan Siloh ntamadan gyaae, Asese no a osii no wɔ nyimpa mu no;
title: PSALMS

text: Na oyii n’ahoɔdzen hyɛɛ ndɔmmum nsa, Na n’enyimnyam hyɛɛ ɔtamfo no nsa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ogyaa ne man maa afona so; Na no bo fuuw n’egyapadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Ogya hyeew hɔn mberantsɛ; Na hɔn mbabaawa ennya ayeforhyia ndwom.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn asɔfoe totɔr afona ano; Na hɔn ekunafo enntwa sukwadwom.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna EWURADZE nyaan dɛ obi a ofi nda mu, Dɛ ɔkatakyi a nsa ama oruhuro.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔbobɔɔ n’atamfo no korakora nkyirnkyir no: Ɔbɔɔ hɔn sɛɛ hɔn daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Bio so ɔpoow Josef n’asesee, Na ɔannsan mu ennyi Efraim ebusuakuw,
title: PSALMS

text: Mbom ɔsaan mu yii Juda ebusuakuw, Bepɔw Zion a ɔpɛɛ no no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na osii no krɔnkrɔnbea dɛ ɔsor, Dɛ asaase a ɔdze etsim hɔ daa no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsaan mu yii n’akowaa David so, Na oyii no fii nguamban no mu:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze no fii nguamber a wɔma enumfo hɔn ekyirdzi bae, Dɛ ɔmbɛnyɛn ne man Jakob, na n’egyapadze Israel.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna ɔnyɛɛn hɔn dɛ mbrɛ n’akoma mu nokwardzi tse; Na ɔnam ne nsa nyimdzee do gyaa hɔn kwan.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, ananaben abɔfora w’egyapadze mu; Woegu w’asɔrfi krɔnkrɔn no ho fi; Wɔama Jerusalɛm ayɛ amamfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔdze wo nkowaa efun ama ntumbowa edziban, W’ahotseweefo honam ama asaase do mbowadoma.
title: PSALMS

text: Woehue hɔn bɔgyaa egu dɛ nsu dze etwa Jerusalɛm ho ehyia; Na obi nnyi hɔ a osie hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛayɛ asesɛba dze ama hɛn asɔnmufo, Hɔn a woetwa hɛn ho ehyia si hɛn atwetwe, dzi hɛn ho fɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Onkodu dabɛn, Ao, EWURADZE, aso wo bo bofuw daa? Aso wo nyinkun bɛdzɛw dɛ ogya?
title: PSALMS

text: Hue w’ebufuw gu abosonsɔrfo a wonnyim wo no do, Na nhenman a wɔmmbɔ wo dzin no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ wɔamen Jakob, Na wɔato n’edzidzibea pan,
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nnkaa hɛn egyanom emumuyɛ nntsia hɛn; Ma w’ayamuhyehye ntwar hɛn ano ntsɛmara: Na wɔabrɛ hɛn adze koraa dodow.
title: PSALMS

text: Boa hɛn, ao hɛn nkwagye Nyankopɔn, boa hɛn wɔ wo dzin n’enyimnyam ntsi: Gye hɛn, na wo dzin ntsi, hor hɛn bɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn ntsi na ebɛma amanaman ase dɛ, Hɔn Nyankopɔn no wɔ hen? Ma wonhu no wɔ amanaman mu wɔ hɛn enyim dɛ Erotɔ wo nkowaa bɔgyaa a wɔka gu no do wer.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ɔdaduafo nkrumsi ndu w’enyim; Dɛ mbrɛ w’abasa ne kɛseyɛ tse no kora hɔn a ɔtamfo no repɛ hɔn wu no do;
title: PSALMS

text: Na ahorbahyɛ a hɛn asɔnmufo hyɛ wo no, EWURADZE, bɔ ho mpɛn esuon gu hɔn tsir do.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna hɛn, wo man na w’edzidzibea do nguan no Yɛdze ndaase bɛma wo daa; Yɛbɛka w’ayɛyi akyerɛ mbasantsen nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛ aso, Ao Israel Guanhwɛfo, Ɔwo a igya Josef dɛ nguankuw; Ɔwo a etse Kerubfo ntamu, hyerɛn pue.
title: PSALMS

text: Kenyan wo tum, wɔ Efraim na Benjamin na Manaasɛ enyim, Na bra bɛgye hɛn nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, fa hɛn san si yie; Na ma w’enyim nhyerɛn, na yebenya nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Dɔm EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, Onkodu dabɛn na wo bo bofuw etsia wo man hɔn mpaabɔ?
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze nyinsu ayɛ edziban ama woedzi, Na ama hɔn nyinsuwa kɔɔpow kɛse ma ma wɔanom.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze hɛn yɛ aperdzi ma hɛn asɔnmufo: Na hɛn atamfo sereserew wɔ hɔnara hɔn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɔm Nyankopɔn, fa hɛn san si yie; Na ma w’enyim nhyerɛn, na yebenya nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze wo nkorɔfo dɛ wenyindua fi Egypt bae; Ɔwo epampaam amanaman na etsɛɛw wo man.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo siesiee n’enyim kwan, Na ɔgyee ndwow, na ɔyɛɛ asaase no ma.
title: PSALMS

text: Ne nwinwin kataa mbepɔw no do, Na n’abaw tse dɛ Nyankopɔn no dum.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtserɛɛw no ndubaa kodur po ho, Na ne mfefɛwee kodur Esutsen no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Afei ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ebubu no ho ban, Ma hɔn a wotwa mu wɔ ɔkwan mu nyinara tsetsew no yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Yambowa fi kwaa mu sɛɛ no, Na mbowa abɔyafo fi haban mu we.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Dɔm Nyankopɔn, yɛserɛ wo, san w’ekyir: Kom w’enyi adze fi sor, na hwɛ, na bɛsera wo wenyindua yi.
title: PSALMS

text: Wowaw dza wo nsa enyimfa tsɛwee, Na ɔba a afa no ayɛ wodze pintsinn no.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔdze ogya ahyew no, woetwa ato famu: W’enyim nkaenyim ntsi wɔasɛɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma wo nsa nda w’enyimfa nyimpa no do, Ɔnda nyimpa ba a afa no ayɛ wodze pintsinn no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na yennkefi wo nkyɛn akɔ ekyir: Ma yennya nkwa, na yɛbɔbɔ wo dzin.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Dɔm EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, fa hɛn san si yie; Ma w’enyim nhyerɛn, na yebenya nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mbɔ mu ntow ndwom mma Nyankopɔn hɛn ahoɔdzen: Hom mbɔ ehurusi ose mma Jakob Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa ndwom, na hom nka mpintsin, Hom mbɔ nsankutsen dɛɛdɛw no nye bɛntasanku no.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mbɔ akasamu no mu wɔ bosoom fofor no mu, Bosoom mu no mu, wɔ hɛn afahyɛ da no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔyɛ ahyɛdze ma Israel, Ɔyɛ mbra a Jakob Nyankopɔn ahyɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔhyɛɛ no adasedzi wɔ Josef mu, Aber a opuee faa Egypt asaase no do no: Mbrɛ metsee obi a minnyim no ne kasaa.
title: PSALMS

text: Miyii ne batsir fii adzesoa no ase: Ne nsa fii kɛntsɛn no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo efrɛe wɔ fona mu, na miyii wo wɔ mu; Megyee wo do wɔ ɔsenaman huntsabea mu; Mosɔɔ wo hwɛe wɔ Meriba nsu no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Me man, tsie, mo kɔkɔbɔ: Ao, Israel, sɛ nkyɛ ibetsie me a!
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nyame, nanaben bi nntsena wo mu; Nkyii so ma nnsɔr nyame nanaben bi.
title: PSALMS

text: Emi nye EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn a Medze wo fii Egypt asaase do bae no: Bue w’anomu tɛtɛɛtɛr, na mebɛhyɛ no ma.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso me man enntsie me ndze; Na Israel ammpɛ mo ho hwee.
title: PSALMS

text: Ntsi migyaa hɔn ma wodzii hɔn akomadzen ekyir, Ma wɔnantseew hɔnankasa hɔn apam do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, sɛ nkyɛ me man ritsie me a, Dɛ Israel bɛnantsew m’akwan mu a!
title: PSALMS

text: Nkyɛ ɔrennkyɛr na mabrɛ hɔn atamfo adze, Na madan me nsa etsia hɔn atamfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Nkyɛ EWURADZE n’atamfo bɛbrɛ hɔnho adze wɔ n’enyim: Na mobɔtwe hɔn aso daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze ewifua mu ewipa bɛnyɛn wo so: Na medze ɔbotan mu ewo amee wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn tsena ɔsor mboanofo mu; Obu atsɛn wɔ enyame mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Onkodu dabɛn na hom bobu ntɛnkyew, Na hom bedzi aboa nyimpa bɔn no?
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa pɛrpɛryɛ ndzi abɔbɔfo na ngyanka asɛm: Hom ndzi nsɛntsenenee mma ɔmandzehunyi na ɔkɔhweaban.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mper ngye abɔbɔfo na ehiafo: Hom nhwim hɔn mfi nyimpa bɔn no nsamu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wonnyim, nkyii so wɔnntse ase; Wodzi sum mu akɔnaaba; Asaase fapem nyinara rihim.
title: PSALMS

text: Emi dze, mesee dɛ, Hom yɛ enyame, Na hom nyinara yɛ Ɔsorsornyi ne mba.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso hom bowu dɛ nyimpa ara, Na hom atotɔ dɛ mbapɔmba mu biara.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn, soɛr ɛ, bu asaase atsɛn; Na ɔwo na ibedzi adze wɔ amanaman nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, mma nnyɛ komm: Mma nnka w’ano nnto mu, anaa nnyɛ dzinn, Ao Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Na, hwɛ, w’atamfo yɛ weɔɔ weɔɔ: Na hɔn a wokyir wo ama hɔn tsir do.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔfa nyansanyansa pam wɔ wo man tsir do, Na wɔbɔ mu tu egyina wɔ hɔn a ehuntsa hɔn no tsir do.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔse dɛ, Hom mbra ma yenkruw hɔn ase ma wongyaa dɛ wɔbɛyɛ ɔman; Ama wɔnnkɛkaa Israel dzin bio.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔayɛ adwen kor abɔ mu etu egyina; Wɔkɔ wo tsir do apam:
title: PSALMS

text: Edom n’asesee nye Ismaelfo; Moab na Hagarfo;
title: PSALMS

text: Gobal, na Ammon, na Amalek;
title: PSALMS

text: Filistia ɔnye hɔn a wɔtse Taere: Asiria so dze noho abɔ hɔn ho; Wɔaboa Lot mba.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛ hɔn dɛ Midian; Dɛ Sisera, dɛ Jabin, wɔ Kison esutsen ho:
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔherae wɔ En-dor; Wɔyɛɛ efikyir maa asaase.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛ hɔn etsitsir dɛ Oreb na Zeeb; Nyew, hɔn mbapɔmba nyinara dɛ Zeba na Zalmunna:
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔsee dɛ, Hom mma yɛmfa Nyankopɔn ne tsenabea nyɛ hɛndze no.
title: PSALMS

text: Me Nyankopɔn, yɛ hɔn dɛ huntuma a oridzi kyinhyia; Dɛ mframa enyim ntsɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ gya a ɔhyew kwaa, Na dɛ gyaframee a ɔto mbepɔw mu gya no;
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛmara na fa w’ehum tsiw hɔn, Na fa wo mframa dzendzen yi hɔn hu.
title: PSALMS

text: Fa enyimguase hyɛ hɔn atar; Ma wɔnhwehwɛ wo dzin ekyir kwan, Ao, EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn enyi nto na hɔn bo ntu daa; Nyew, ma hɔn enyim ngu ase na wɔnhera:
title: PSALMS

text: Ma woeehu dɛ ɔwo a wo dzin dze EWURADZE no, Ɔwoara nko nye Ɔsorsornyi wɔ asaase nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɔm Ewuradze, mbrɛ wo ntamadan dua yɛ fɛw a!
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra kɔn dɔ, nyew, ɔtɔ bitsi mpo wɔ Ewuradze adapan no ntsi; m'akoma na mo honam dzi ehurusi ma tseasefo Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, ɔsorɔm enya dan, na akyemfowa enya berɛbuw ama noho, mbrɛ ɔbɔtow ne mba egu mu, mekyerɛ w'afɔrmbukyia ou a, dɔm Ewuradze, me hen, na me Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyirafo nye hɔn a wɔtse wo fi mu: Wɔbɛda ho eyi wo ayɛw. (Selah.)
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyiranyi nye nyimpa a n'ahoɔdzen wɔ wo mu: Zion atsempɔn no wɔ n'akoma mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wotwa mu wɔ nyinsu bɔnsa no mu a wɔdan no bae a mbasu wɔ; nyew, adɔwnsu dze nhyira kata do.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔnantsew fi ahoɔdzen mu kɔ ahoɔdzen mu, hɔn nyinara befir Nyame enyim wɔ Zion.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɔm Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, tsie me mpaayi: Jacob Nyankopɔn, yɛ aso. (Selah.)
title: PSALMS

text: Hɛn akokyɛm Nyame, hwɛ, na hwɛ nyia asera no no enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wo fie dakordzi ye sen apem. Mepɛ dɛ migyina me Nyankopɔn fi ano; sen dɛ mebɛtsena ndzebɔnyɛfo asesee mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn yɛ ewia na kyɛm: Ewuradze bɛma adom na enyimnyam: Ɔremmfa adze pa biara nnkam hɔn a wɔnantsew tɔɔtsenn.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɔm Ewuradze, nhyiranyi nye nyimpa a ɔtwer wo.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, ɔwo adom w’asaase: Ɔwo edze Jakob egyapadze asan aba.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze wo man n’emumuyɛ akyɛ, Na akata hɔn bɔn nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo eyi w’ebufuw nyinara kɔ: Na adan woho efi w’ebufuw ne hyeehyew no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Fa hɛn san si yie, ao hɛn nkwagye Nyankopɔn, Na ma w’ebufuhyew no a ɔwɔ hɛn do no mbɔ adze.
title: PSALMS

text: Aso wo bo bofuw hɛn daa? Aso ebɔtwe w’ebufuw no ekodu mbasantsen nyinara do?
title: PSALMS

text: A eremma hɛn nkwa bio: Ma wo man nndzi ehurusi wɔ wo mu?
title: PSALMS

text: Kyerɛ hɛn wo mbɔbɔrhu, Ao, EWURADZE, Na dom hɛn wo nkwagye.
title: PSALMS

text: Na afei mibetsie dza EWURADZE Nyankopɔn bɛka, Ɔbɛka asomdwee nsɛm akyerɛ ne man, na n’ahotseweefo: Wɔnnkɛdan nkɔ nkwaseasɛm ho bio dze a.
title: PSALMS

text: Ampaara no nkwagye bɛn hɔn a wosuro no no; Ama enyimnyam aatsena hɛn asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbɔbɔrhu na nokwar behyia; Tsenenee na asomdwee bedzi hɔnho mfewano.
title: PSALMS

text: Nokwar befi asaase mu efir; Na tsenenee efi sor ahwɛ famu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, EWURADZE dze dza oye bɛma; Na hɛn asaase beyi no ndɔbaa.
title: PSALMS

text: Tsenenee bedzi n’enyim; Na ɔdze hɛn esi n’anamɔn kwan do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, brɛ w’aso adze, na bua me; Na meyɛ ɔbɔbɔnyi na ohianyi.
title: PSALMS

text: Kora me kra do, na midzi nokwar ma wo: Me Nyankopɔn, gye w’akowaa a ɔdze noho twer wo no nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, hu me mbɔbɔr; Na ɔwo na musu frɛ wo adzekyee nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma w’akowaa n’enyi ngye; Osiandɛ ɔwo, EWURADZE, na mema me kra do ma wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo, EWURADZE, iye, na edze kyɛ, Na w’adom dɔɔ so ma hɔn a wɔfrɛ wo nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, yɛ aso ma me mpaayi; Na tsie mo nkotoserɛ ndze.
title: PSALMS

text: Mefrɛ wo wɔ mo fona da mu; Osiandɛ ɔwo na egye me do.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, obi nntse dɛ ɔwo wɔ enyame mu; Nkyii so ndwuma biara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ wo ndwuma.
title: PSALMS

text: Amanaman a ayɛ hɔn bɛba abɔkotow w’enyim, Ao, EWURADZE; Na wɔahyɛ wo dzin enyimnyam.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo eso, na eyɛ anwanwadze: Ɔwoara nkotsee nye Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Kyerɛkyerɛ me wo pɛ; Ao, EWURADZE, ama meetsie wo wɔ nokwar mu: Kyerɛkyerɛ me ma monsom wo nokwar mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn, medze m’akoma nyina beyi wo ayɛw; Na mebɛhyɛ wo dzin enyimnyam daa daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wo mbɔbɔrhu so wɔ mo do; Na ɔwo eyi me kra efi samanadze n’ase noho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Nyankopɔn, ntsɛntsɛmfo asoɛr etsia me, Na nyimpa akakaben mboanofo no rohwehwɛ mo nkwa, Na wɔmmfa wo nnsi hɔn enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo, EWURADZE, eyɛ Nyankopɔn a ayamuhyehye na adom ahyɛ wo ma, Efa ebufuw nyaa, na wo mbɔbɔrhu na wo nokwar dɔɔ so.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, dan w’enyi kyerɛ me, na hu me mbɔbɔr; Fa w’ahoɔdzen ma w’akowaa, Na gye w’afonabaa ba nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Kyerɛ me yieyɛ ho asɛnkyerɛdze bi; Ma hɔn a wokyir me nhu, na hɔn enyi nto, Osiandɛ ɔwo EWURADZE na aboa me, na akyekye mo werɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do na mo kurow fapem si.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE dɔ Zion mbobotsen Sen Jakob ne tsenabea nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔka wo ho enyimnyamnsɛm, Ao, Nyankopɔn kurow.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔbɔ Egyptfo, Babilɔnfo, Filistiafo, Traefo nye Etiopiafo edzin akyerɛ, Wɔ hɔn a wonyim me mpo a: Oyinom, wɔwoo hɔn hɔ ara.
title: PSALMS

text: Na Zion ho dze, wɔbɛka dɛ, Oyi ɔno wɔwoo no wɔ no mu; Na Ɔsorsornyi no ankasa na ɔbɛma oetsim.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ EWURADZE rekyerɛw aman edzin a, Ɔbɛka dɛ oyi dze, wɔwoo no wɔ hɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔtow ndwom na hɔn a wɔsaw nyina bɛse dɛ, Mo nsunyiwa nyinara fi wo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, mo nkwagye Nyankopɔn, Musu frɛ wo adzekyee na adzesaa:
title: PSALMS

text: Ma me mpaabɔ ndu w’enyim, Kyɛn w’aso ma mo sufrɛ:
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔfona ahyɛ me kra ma, Na mo nkwa rotwe bɛn samanadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔakan me afora hɔn a wosian kɔ adakamona mu no; Mayɛ dɛ nyimpa a onnyi boafo:
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔatow me akyen ewufo mu prododo, Dɛ atɔfo a wɔdeda adakamona mu Hɔn a ɔwo nnkaa hɔn bio, Osiandɛ woetwa hɔn efi wo nsamu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze me ato mona no ase noho noho, Wɔ sum mu, wɔ ebun no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: W’ebufuw hyɛ mo do, Dɛ asorɛkye a ɔrepram mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo eyi m’amanyimfo efi me nkyɛn akɔ ekyirekyir; Ɔwo ayɛ me ekyiwadze ama hɔn: Wɔatow me mu, na munntum mmpue.
title: PSALMS

text: Awerɛhow ntsi m’enyiwa ayɛ meamea: Dabiara musu frɛ wo, Ao, EWURADZE, Mema me nsa do kyerɛ wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Aso eyɛ anwanwadze akyerɛ ewufo? Aso hɔn a woewuwu bɔsoɛr eyi wo ayɛw?
title: PSALMS

text: Aso wɔbɛka w’adɔyɛ akyerɛ wɔ adakamona mu? Anaa wo nokwardzi wɔ Ɔsɛɛ mu?
title: PSALMS

text: Aso wobohu w’anwanwadze wɔ sum no mu? Na wo tsenenee wɔ awerɛfir asaase no do?
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso emi dze, ɔwo, EWURADZE, na musu frɛ wo, Na me mpaabɔ bodu w’enyim anapa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na etow me kyen dɛm yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na edze w’enyim ehuntsa me yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Fitsi mo mbofraber mu na mehu amandze na owu abɛn me: Morosɔw wo ho hu na mayɛ hahaaha.
title: PSALMS

text: W’ebufuw hyeehyew no abɔ afa me tsir do; W’ahoɔhu etwa me akyen.
title: PSALMS

text: Wotwa mo ho hyia dɛ nsu adzekyee nyinara; Wɔbɔ mu twa mo ho kɔntɔnkrɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ama adɔfo na anyɛnko nyina apow me, Na m’amanyimfo kɔ sum mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔtow w’ehumbɔbɔr ho ndwom daa, Ao, EWURADZE: M’ano na medze mebɛma woehu wo nokwardzi ekodu mbasantsen nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ w’adɔyɛ kɛse no tsim hɔ daa; Wo nokwardzi tsim hɔ dzendzenndzen dɛ wimu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo aka dɛ; Menye nyia masan mu eyi no no edzi ahyɛmu, Maka ntam akyerɛ m’akowaa David;
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛma w’asefo etsintsim daa, Na mama w’ahengua esi hɔ ekodu mbasantsen nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔsor beyi w’anwanwadze ayɛw daa, EWURADZE, Wo nokwardzi so wɔ wo krɔnkrɔmfo ehyiadzi mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na woana na ɔwɔ wimu a wɔdze no bɔto EWURADZE ho? Woana na ɔtse dɛ EWURADZE wɔ enyame mba mu,
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn a no ho yɛ hu wɔ krɔnkrɔmfo apam mu, Na wosuro no sen hɔn a wɔabɔ no ho aprɔw nyinara?
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Dɔm EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, Woana na ɔyɛ ɔkatakyi tse dɛ ɔwo, EWURADZE? Na wo nokwardzi etwa wo ho ehyia.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na ehyɛ po ne gyigyeegyeyɛ do: Sɛ n’asorɛkye soɛr a, ɔwo na edwedwe ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na ebubu Rahab posoposo dɛ obi a ɔatɔ; Ɔwo na edze w’ahoɔdzen abasa abɔ w’atamfo apetse.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsor yɛ wodze, asaase so yɛ wodze: Wiadze na ne mayɛ, ɔwo na etoo ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Kwaamu afamu na pomu afamu, ɔwoara na ebɔe: Tabor na Hermon dzi ehurusi wɔ wo dzin mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na ewɔ tum abasa: Wo tum yɛ kɛse na ɔbor adze nyina do
title: PSALMS

text: Tsenenee na atsɛmbu yɛ w’ahengua ne fapem: Mbɔbɔrhu na nokwar dzi w’enyim kan.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira nye ɔman a wonyim mbrɛ wosi tow wo ho ayɛyi: Ao, EWURADZE, hɔn a wɔnantsew wɔ w’enyim kan no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo dzin mu na wodzi ehurusi adzekyee nyinara, Na wo tsenenee mu na wɔama hɔn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo na eyɛ hɔn ahoɔdzen n’enyimnyam; Na w’adom mu na wɔbɛma hɛn ambɛn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE na hɛn kyɛm dzi wɔ no; Na hɛn hen yɛ Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no dze.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo, ekasae ber bi kyerɛɛ w’ahotseweefo no wɔ enyido adzehu mu, Na esee dɛ, Medze mboa ato ɔkatakyi bi do; Ɔno na masan mu eyi no wɔ ɔman no mu dɛ ɔhen.
title: PSALMS

text: Mehu m’akowaa David; Mo ngo krɔnkrɔn na medze masera no:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na me nsa betsintsim no; M’abasa no bɛhyɛ no dzen.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtamfo no rinndzi no emim, Eso emumuyɛ ba no rinnhiahia no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mubogura n’atamfo egu famu wɔ n’enyim, Na mabobɔ hɔn a wokyir no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mo nokwardzi na mo mbɔbɔrhu nye no bɛtsena; Na me dzin mu na wɔbɛma n’ambɛn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze ne nsa so besi po do, Na medze ne nsa enyimfa esi esutsen do:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na obosu afrɛ me dɛ, Ɔwo nye m’egya, Me Nyankopɔn, na mo nkwagye botan.
title: PSALMS

text: Emi so mebɛyɛ no m’abakan, Asaase do ahemfo mu abɔso.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛkyerɛ mo mbɔbɔrhu akyerɛ no daa, Na m’ahyɛmu etsim hɔ ama no.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛma n’asefo so etsi hɔ daa, Na n’ahengua ayɛ dɛ ɔsor nda.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ ne mba pow me mbra, Na wɔannantsew me mbrasɛm mu;
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ wɔto m’ahyɛdze, Na woenndzi me nkyerɛkyerɛ do a;
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno dze medze abaa bɛba abɛsera hɔn mbrato, Na medze ɔhwe abɛsera hɔn emumuyɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso, mo mbɔbɔrhu dze mirinnyi mmfi no ho koraa da, Eso merennsesa mo nokwardzi wɔ no ho da.
title: PSALMS

text: Murunngu m’ahyɛmu ho fi, Eso mennkɛdan m’anohoba kor mpo da.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze mo krɔnkrɔnyɛ aka ntam prɛko; Murunntwa apaw nnkyerɛ David;
title: PSALMS

text: N’asefo bɛtsena hɔ daa, Na n’ahengua ayɛ dɛ ewia wɔ m’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Obetsim hɔ daa dɛ bosoom, Na dɛ dasefo nokwafo a ɔwɔ wimu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na afei, ɔwo wo bo efuw nyia woara asera no no, Apow na atow no akyen.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ekyir w’akowaa n’ahyɛmu: Ɔwo egu n’abɔtsir ho fi araa dze ato daadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edwuruw ne ban nyinara egu; Na ama n’akoban ayɛ amamfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wotwa mu wɔ ɔkwan no do nyinara fa no afo, Ɔayɛ enyitodze ama n’asɔnmufo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ama n’atamfo edzi no do konyim; Ama hɔn nyinara edzi ehurusi.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew ɔwo edan n’afona ano, Na ama oenntum enngyina akono.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ama n’enyimnyam apa, Na atow n’ahengua ahwe famu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo etwa ne mberantsɛber nda do: Na edze enyito akata no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Onkodu dabɛn, Ao, EWURADZE, aso ibohuntsa woho daa? Onkodu dabɛn, na w’ebufuw bɛdzɛw dɛ ogya?
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, kaa mbrɛ me mber dua yɛ tsia: Adzegyan bɛn na ɔwo abɔ nyimpa mba nyinara yi!
title: PSALMS

text: Nyimpa bɛn na ɔtse ase na onnkowu da, Na obotum eyi ne kra efi samanadze?
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, w’asɔpɔn mbɔbɔrhu no wɔ hen, Dza ekaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ David wɔ wo nokwardzi mu no a?
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, kaa ahorba a wɔdze hyɛ wo nkowaa, Dza hɔn a wɔnnsom wo no dze hyɛ me no;
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, w’atamfo hyɛ nyia asera no no ahorba na wɔdom no, Anamɔn biara a otu no wosi no atwetwe.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE daa daa. Amen, na Amen.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, ɔwo na ayɛ hɛn tsenabea, Wɔ mbasantsen nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ansaana wɔrobɔwo mbepɔw, Anaa ereyɛ asaase na wiadze, Ofi tsetseetse kesi ɔdomankoma mpo, ɔwo yɛ Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edan ɔdasanyi kɔ ɔsɛɛ mu; Na ese dɛ, Ao, Adasamba, hom nsan hom dɛtse mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mfe apem yɛ w’enyi do Dɛ ndeda a oetwa mu, Na anadwe mu dasu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ema nyimpa pem kɔ dɛ nsuyirii; wɔyɛ dɛ adaaso: Anapa wɔtse dɛ nkyɛkyɛr a ɔfefɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Anapa ɔyɛ prɔmprɔm, na ɔfefɛw; Ewimbir no wotwa kyen, na otwintwam.
title: PSALMS

text: Na yɛresa wɔ w’ebufuw mu, Na yɛrofona wɔ w’ebufuhyew mu,
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze hɛn emumuyɛ esi w’enyim, Edze hɛn nsumaa mu bɔn aba w’enyim kan no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na hɛn nda nyinara etwa mu kɔ wɔ w’ebufuw mu: Hɛn mfe ba ewiei dɛ ahomgu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɛn mfe mu nda yɛ mfe eduosuon, Anaa bi a ahoɔdzen ntsi wodu mfe eduowɔtwe; Naaso hɔn ahopɔw yɛ ɔberɛ na awerɛhow; Na otwa mu ntsɛmara, na yetu kɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Woana ara nyim w’ebufuw ne dzen, Na w’ebufuhyew dɛ mbrɛ wo ho suro tse?
title: PSALMS

text: Ntsi kyerɛkyerɛ hɛn ma yɛnkan hɛn nda, Ama yeenya nyansa akoma.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, san w’ekyir fi w’ebufuw ho: ɔnkyɛr nkodu dabɛn ara? Ao, ma wo nkowaa adze nyɛ wo mbɔbɔr.
title: PSALMS

text: Fa wo mbɔbɔrhu mee hɛn anapahema; Ma yendzi ehurusi na hɛn enyi ngye hɛn nda nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɛn ho nsɛpɛw hɛn dɛ mbrɛ nda a ahaw hɛn wɔ mu no tse, Na dɛ mbrɛ mfe a yeehu mu mbusu no tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma w’edwuma nda edzi mma wo nkowaa, Na w’enyimnyam nda edzi wɔ hɔn mba do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ma EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn n’enyimtsewee no mbra hɛn do: Na ma hɛn nsaano edwuma nyɛ yie mma hɛn; Nyew, ma hɛn nsaano edwuma nyɛ yie.
title: PSALMS
