text: Nyia ɔtse Ɔsorsornyi no no huntsabea no, Mekyerɛ, nyia ɔtse Otumfo no no nwinwin no ase no.
title: PSALMS

text: Bɛse EWURADZE dɛ, Ɔwo nye mo guandɔbea na m’akoban; Me Nyankopɔn a wo mu na medze mo werɛ hyɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ampaara ɔno na obeyi wo efi efirsuafo efir mu, Na ɔsor yarba a ɔsɛɛ no mu,
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze ne ntɛkyerɛ bɛkata wo do, Na ne ntsaban ase na iboguan akɔdɔ: No nokwar yɛ kyɛm na nkataenyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo irunnsuro wɔ anadwe adze a ɔyɛ hu ntsi, Eso wɔ egyen menaba a otu ewiaber ntsi;
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔ ɔsor yarba a ɔnenam sum mu, Anaa ɔsɛɛ a ɔsɛɛ wigyinae ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Apem bɔtotɔ wɔ wo nkyɛnmu, Na ɔpedu atotɔ wɔ w’enyimfa; Naaso orunndu wo nkyɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: W’enyiwa nko na edze bɔhwɛ, Na ehu ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi n’akatua.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ ɔwo, edze EWURADZE ayɛ wo guandɔbew! Nyew edze Ɔsorsornyi no ayɛ wo tsenabew;
title: PSALMS

text: Mbusu biara nnkɔtɔ wo do, Nkyii so ɔyarbɔn bi remmbɛn w’asesee.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ ɔbɛhyɛ n’abɔfoe mbra wɔ wo ho, Dɛ wɔnhwɛ wo do wɔ w’akwan nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔbɔsoa wo wɔ hɔn nsamu, Amma aammfa w’anan ammpem ɔbo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ebɛnantsew gyata na ehurutsia do: Gyataburwa na abowatsena na ɔwo ibetsiatsia hɔn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia no dɔ tsim mo do no, Mebɛgye no: Medze no besi yie, osiandɛ oehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbɛfrɛ me, na mebɛgye no do; Menye no bɛtsena ɔfona mu: Mibeyi no, na medzi no nyi.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze nkwa tsentsen bɛmee no, Na makyerɛ no mo nkwagye.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbrɛ odua ye dɛ wɔda ase, Ao, EWURADZE, Na wɔtow ayɛyindwom ma wo dzin, Ao, Ɔsorsornyi:
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ woyi w’adɔyɛ kyerɛ anapa, Na wo nokwardzi anadwe anadwe.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔ sanku a no do nhoma du, na bɛntasanku do, Wɔ nsankutsen do awɔse ndze mu,
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ ɔwo EWURADZE, nam w’edwuma do ama m’enyi agye: Mobɔtow enyigye ndwom wɔ wo nsaano ndwuma mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, mbrɛ wo ndwuma dua yɛ nwanwa a! W’adwen mu dɔ pii.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ogyangyantwi dze, onnyim; Nkyii so ɔkwasea nntse iyi ase:
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ sɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo fefɛw dɛ nkyɛkyɛr, Na emumuyɛfo nyinara yɛ prɔmprɔm mpo a; Wɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn koraa:
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso ɔwo EWURADZE dze, ekrɔn daa. Na, hwɛ, w’atamfo no, Ao, EWURADZE,
title: PSALMS

text: W’atamfo no dze, wɔbɛhera, Na emumuyɛfo nyinara wɔbɔbɔ apetse.
title: PSALMS

text: Na m’ambɛn dze, ɔwo ama do dɛ eko n’ambɛn: Wɔdze ngo fofor asera me.
title: PSALMS

text: M’enyiwa so ehu m’apɛdze wɔ m’atamfo do, M’asowa atse m’apɛdze wɔ ndzebɔnyɛfo a wɔsoɛr tsia me no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi bɛyɛ prɔmprɔm dɛ abɛdua: Obenyin dɛ Lebanon do nkyindur ndua.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔatsɛw hɔn wɔ EWURADZE ne fie no Wɔbɛyɛ prɔmprɔm wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn n’abanguado.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔbɛda ho asow aba wɔ nkɔdaaber mu; Wɔbɛyɛ sufɔɔ na ebun ebun:
title: PSALMS

text: Dze akyerɛ dɛ EWURADZE tsen; Ɔno nye mo botan, na dza ɔnntsen bi nnyi no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE dzi hen, ɔdze akɛseyɛ ewuna; EWURADZE ewuna, ɔdze ahoɔdzen abɔ noho do: Wiadze so wɔdze etsim hɔ dɛ orinnhihim.
title: PSALMS

text: W’ahengua tsim hɔ fi tsetse: Ɔwo fi ɔdomankoma.
title: PSALMS

text: Nsuyirii no amema hɔn ndze do, Ao, EWURADZE, Nsuyirii no ama hɔn ndze do, Nsuyirii no ama hɔn asorɛkye do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsor EWURADZE no yɛ tumfo Sen esu pii ne ndze, Sen po asorɛkye a ɔwɔ tum mpo.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo mbrasɛm tsim hɔ ara pi: Krɔnkrɔnyɛ fata wo fie, Ao, EWURADZE, mbersantsen nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, ɔwo Nyankopɔn a awerdzi dzi wɔ wo, Ɔwo, awerdzi Nyankopɔn ei, yi woho edzi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo asaase tsɛmbuafo, ma woho do: Fa ahopɔwfo hɔn akatua ma hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, dabɛn na ndzebɔnyɛfo, Dabɛn ara na ndzebɔnyɛfo ndzi ehurusi nkodu?
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔtoa atsɛn, wɔkasa ahopɔw mu: Emumuyɛfo nyinara tuw hɔnho.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔbɔ wo man pasapasa, Ao, EWURADZE, Na wɔhaw w’egyapadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Woku okunafo na ɔhɔho, Na wodzi egyanka ewu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔse dɛ, EWURADZE nnhu hɛn, Nkyii so Jakob Nyankopɔn no ronndwen ho:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔman mu egyangyantwi, hom ndwen ho: Na hom nkwasea, dabɛn na hom bohu dze?
title: PSALMS

text: Aso nyia ɔtsɛɛw asowa no, ɔrenntse asɛm anaa? Na nyia ɔhyehyɛɛ enyiwa no, aso orunnhu adze?
title: PSALMS

text: Aso nyia ɔtsea amanaman no, ɔrennkyerɛ nyansa anaa? Mekyerɛ nyia ɔkyerɛkyerɛ nyimpa nyimdzee no a.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE nyim nyimpa n’adwen, Dɛ ɔtse dɛ ehubɔw bi a otwa mu ntsɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, osiarfo nye nyimpa a ɔwo etsea no, Na ifi wo mbra no mu ekyerɛkyerɛ no;
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ ebɛma no akomatɔmu wɔ abɛbrɛsɛ nda mu, Ma ekodu dɛ wobotu mona ama ndzebɔnyɛfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE nnkɔtow ne man akyen, Nkyii so ɔnnkɔpow n’egyapadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Na atsɛmbu bɛsan akɔ tseneneenyi nkyɛn: Na akoma mu tseneneefo nyinara bedzi ekyir.
title: PSALMS

text: Woana na ɔbɔsoɛr nye ndzebɔnyɛfo edzi esi ama me? Woana na obegyina nye emumuyɛfo edzi esi ama me?
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ EWURADZE annyɛ mo boafo a, Nkyɛ ɔka kakrabaabi ma me kra aakɛtsena foofoo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a mesee dɛ m’anan retserew no; Ao, EWURADZE, wo mbɔbɔrhu na osuoo mo mu gyinae.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ me dadwen dɔɔ so wɔ mo mu a, W’awerɛkyekyer ma me kra enyi gye.
title: PSALMS

text: Aso ndzebɔnyɛfo ahengua nye wo benya anyɛnkoyɛ, Dza ɔnam ahyɛdze do hyehyɛ ewurkadze no?
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔbɔ bagua wɔ tseneneenyi ne kra do, Na wobu bɔgya a odzi bem fɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso EWURADZE ayɛ m’abantsentsen, Na me Nyankopɔn ayɛ mo guandɔbea botan.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔdze hɔnankasa hɔn emumuyɛ aba hɔn do, Na obotwa hɔn egu hɔnankasa hɔn mbusu mu; EWURADZE, hɛn Nyankopɔn botwa hɔn egu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mbra ma yɛntow ndwom mma EWURADZE: Hom mma yɛmbɔ ose mma hɛn nkwagye botan no.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mma yɛmfa ndaase mbra n’enyim, Hom mma yɛmbɔ ose ntow ndwom mma no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE yɛ Nyankopɔn kɛse, Na Ɔhen kɛse bɔ enyame nyina do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ne nsamu na asaase do ebun wɔ; Mbepɔw do sorɔnsorɔmbea so yɛ nedze.
title: PSALMS

text: Po yɛ nedze na ɔno na ɔyɛe; Na ne nsa na ɔhyehyɛɛ asaase kɛsɛɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mbra ma yɛnkotow na yɛmbɔ hɛn mu adze, Hom mma yɛmbu ntwɛr wɔ EWURADZE hɛn Yɛfo enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔno nye hɛn Nyankopɔn, Na hɛn dze yɛyɛ n’edzidzibea do nkorɔfo, na ne nsamu nguan. Ao, sɛ nkyɛ ndɛ hom betsie ne ndze a!
title: PSALMS

text: Mma hom mmpirim hom akoma, dɛ Meriba, Dɛ Massa da no wɔ sar no do:
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a hom egyanom gyigyee me, Sɔɔ me hwɛe, wɔ aber a nna woehu mo ndwuma so.
title: PSALMS

text: Mfe eduanan koraa na mbasantsen no yii me awerɛhow, Na mesee dɛ, Ɔman a wɔfom wɔ hɔn akoma mu nye hɔn, Na woennhu m’akwan.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi mekaa m’ebufuw mu ntam, Dɛ wɔrennhɛn m’ahomgye no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom ntow ndwom fofor mma EWURADZE: Asaase nyinara, hom ntow ndwom mma EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom ntow ndwom mma EWURADZE, hom nhyira ne dzin; Hom nkyerɛ no nkwagye mfi da nto da.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nka n’enyimnyam nkyerɛ wɔ amanaman mu, N’anwanwa dwuma wɔ aman nyina mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE yɛ kɛse, na ɔsɛ dɛ woyi no ayɛw: Ɔno na ɔsɛ dɛ wosuro no sen enyame nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Na aman enyame nyinara yɛ adze huhuw: Na EWURADZE mbom na ɔyɛɛ sor.
title: PSALMS

text: Enyidzi na tumdzi wɔ n’enyim: Ahoɔdzen na ahoɔfɛw wɔ no krɔnkrɔnbea mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Aman mbusuakuw, hom ntonton EWURADZE, Hom ntonton EWURADZE n’enyimnyam na ahoɔdzen.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mma EWURADZE ne dzin enyimnyam a ɔsɛ: Hom mfa ayɛyɛdze mbra, na hom mbra n’abanguado.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nsɔr EWURADZE wɔ ahoɔfɛw krɔnkrɔnyɛ mu: Asaase nyinara, hom ho mpopo wɔ n’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nka wɔ amanaman mu dɛ, EWURADZE dzi hen: Wiadze so woetsim no dɛ worinnhim no. Obobu aman atsɛn tsenenee.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma ɔsor enyi ngye, na wɔmma asaase ho nsɛpɛw no; Wɔmma po, na ne mayɛ nwor;
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma haban, na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara ndzi ehurusi; Nna hamu ndua nyinara bɔtow ahosɛpɛw ndwom;
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔ EWURADZE enyim, na ɔreba; Ɔreba ebobu asaase atsɛn: Obobu wiadze atsɛn wɔ tsenenee mu, Na aman wɔ no nokwardzi mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE dzi hen; wɔmma asaase ndzi ehurusi; Wɔmma nsupruw pii no enyi ngye.
title: PSALMS

text: Mununkum na sum etwa no ho ehyia: Tsenenee na atsɛmbu nye n’ahengua ne fapem.
title: PSALMS

text: Ogya dzi n’enyim, Na ɔhyew n’atamfo hyia.
title: PSALMS

text: N’enyinam hyerɛn wiadze: Asaase hu, na no ho popo.
title: PSALMS

text: Akoko naan dɛ hua wɔ EWURADZE enyim, Wɔ asaase nyinara EWURADZE no enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsor ka ne tsenenee kyerɛ, Na aman nyinara ehu n’enyimnyam.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔsɔr ehonyi nyinara hɔn enyi nto, Mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔdze ehonyi hyehyɛ hɔnho no a: Hom nkotow no, hom enyame nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Zion tse na no ho sɛpɛɛw no, Na Juda mbabaa dzi ehurusi; Osian w’atsɛmbu ntsi, Ao, EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo, EWURADZE, nye ɔsorsornyi wɔ asaase nyinara do: Wɔama wo do koraa abɔ enyame nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom a hom dɔ EWURADZE, hom nkyir bɔn: Ɔno na ɔkora n’ahotseweefo akra do; Ɔno na ɔgye hɔn fi emumuyɛfo nsamu.
title: PSALMS

text: Kan hyerɛn ma atseneneefo, Na enyigye ma akomamutseweefo.
title: PSALMS

text: Atseneneefo, hom enyi ngye wɔ EWURADZE mu; Na hom nda ne dzin krɔnkrɔn no ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom ntow ndwom fofor mma EWURADZE; Na ɔayɛ anwanwadze. Ne nsa enyimfa na n’abasa krɔnkrɔn edzi nyim ama no.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE ama woehu no nkwagye: Oeyi ne tsenenee akyerɛ petee wɔ amanaman enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔakaa no mbɔbɔrhu na no nokwardzi wɔ Israel fi do: Asaase ano nyinara ehu hɛn Nyankopɔn no nkwagye.
title: PSALMS

text: Asaase nyinara, hom mbɔ ose mma EWURADZE: Hom ntsea mu ntow ehurusi ndwom, nyew, hom ntow ayɛyindwom.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa nsankutsen ntow ayɛyindwom mma EWURADZE; Wɔmfa nsankutsen na adwontow ndze.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa akasamu na mbɛn ndze Mbɔ enyigye ose wɔ Ɔhen, EWURADZE no enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma po, na ne mayɛ nwor; Wiadze, na hɔn a wɔtse mu no;
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma nsuyirii mbɔ hɔn nsamu; Wɔmma mbepɔw mbɔ mu ntow ehurusi ndwom,
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔ EWURADZE enyim, na ɔreba ebobu asaase atsɛn: Obobu wiadze atsɛn wɔ tsenenee mu, Na aman wɔ nsɛntsenenee mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE dzi hen; wɔmma aman ho mpopo: Ɔtse kerubim do; wɔmma asaase nhim.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE yɛ kɛse wɔ Zion; Na ɔwɔ sor bɔ aman nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma wonyi ne dzin kɛse a ɔyɛ hu no ayɛw: Ɔno na ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔhen n’ahoɔdzen so pɛ atsɛmbu; Ɔwo na itsim atsɛntsenenee, Ɔwo na ibu atsɛmbu na tsenenee wɔ Jakob mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mma EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn do, Na hom nkotow nsɔr wɔ n’ananadzegua ho; Ɔno na ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Moses na Aaron wɔ n’asɔfoe mu, Na Samuel wɔ hɔn a wɔbɔ ne dzin no mu; Wɔfrɛɛ EWURADZE, na ɔgyee hɔn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn mununkum dum no mu: Wodzii ne mbrasɛm na n’ahyɛdze a ɔdze maa hɔn no do.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, hɛn Nyankopɔn, ɔwo na egyee hɔn do; Ɔwo eyɛɛ Nyankopɔn a edze kyɛɛ hɔn, Kaansa ituaa hɔn nyɛe ho wer mpo a.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mma EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn do, Na hom nkotow nsɔr wɔ no koko krɔnkrɔn do; Na EWURADZE, hɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Asaase nyinara, hom mbɔ ose mma EWURADZE,
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa enyigye nsom EWURADZE: Hom mfa adwontow mbra n’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nhu dɛ EWURADZE nye Nyankopɔn: Ɔno na ɔayɛ hɛn, yɛyɛ nedze, na yɛnndze hɛn ho bi; Yɛyɛ ne man, na n’edzidzibea do nguan.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa ndaase nhɛn n’aponkɛse mu, Na hom mfa ayɛyi mbra n’abanguado: Hom mfa ndaase mma no, na hom nhyira ne dzin.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE ye, na no mbɔbɔrhu wɔ hɔ daa; Na no nokwardzi kodu mbasantsen nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔtow nokwardzi na pɛrpɛryɛ ho ndwom: Ama wo, Ao, EWURADZE, mobɔtow.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔdwen emudzi kwan no do wɔ nyansa mu; Ao, dabɛn na ebɛba me nkyɛn? Mebɛnantsew me fie wɔ m’akoma n’emudzi mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Meremmfa adze huhuw biara nnsi m’enyi do: Mikyir akɔhwidze ne yɛ; Ɔremmfam mo ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Nkontompɔ akoma befi me nkyɛn efi: M’enyi ronnsɔ bɔn biara.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia otwir ne nyɛnko nsumaa mu no, ɔno na mebɛsɛɛ no: Nyia ɔwɔ enyi a ɔyɛ sorsor na ntsɛn akoma no meremmpen no.
title: PSALMS

text: M’enyi bɛba asaase no do anokwafo do, ma wɔnye me aatsena: Nyia ɔnantsew emudzi kwan do no, ɔno na ɔbɔsom me:
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia otwa nkontompɔ renntsena me dan mu: Nyia ɔka atorsɛm rinntsintsim wɔ m’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Anapa biara mebɛsɛɛ asaase no do ndzebɔnyɛfo nyinara; Dɛ mubotwa emumuyɛfo nyinara efi EWURADZE kurow no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, tsie me mpaabɔ, Na ma mo sufrɛ ndu w’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nnyi w’enyim nnhuntsa me wɔ m’ahokyer da mu: Brɛ w’aso adze ma me; Da a musu mefrɛ no, gye me do ntsɛmara.
title: PSALMS

text: Na me nda hi dɛ wusiw, Na me mbiew hyew dɛ nyena.
title: PSALMS

text: M’akoma abɔ dɛ nkyɛkyɛr, na akyenkyen. Na mo werɛ fir dɛ midzi m’edziban.
title: PSALMS

text: M’apensi ndze ntsi Me mbiew afemfam mo honam mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Metse dɛ sar do ɔpɛtɛ: Mayɛ dɛ amamfo do ɔpatu.
title: PSALMS

text: Misi pe, na mayɛ dɛ Ɔsorɔm a no nko wɔ ɔdan etsifi.
title: PSALMS

text: M’atamfo hyɛ me ahorba adzekyee nyinara; Hɔn a woegyim wɔ mo do dze me dom.
title: PSALMS

text: Osian w’ebufuw na w’ebufuhyew ntsi, Medzi nso ayɛ m’edziban.
title: PSALMS

text: Na medze nyinsuwa afora m’anondze: Osiandɛ ɔwo ama me do, na atow me akyen.
title: PSALMS

text: Me nda tse dɛ ewimbir nwinwin; Na mekyenkyen dɛ nkyɛkyɛr.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso ɔwo, EWURADZE dze, ebɛtsena hɔ daa; Na wo nkaa bodu mbasantsen nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ebɔsoɛr ebohu Zion mbɔbɔr: Na mber a ɔsɛ dɛ wohu no mbɔbɔr nye yi, nyew mber no edu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wo nkowaa enyi gye n’abo ho, Na wonya ayamuhyehye wɔ no huntuma ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna amanaman bosuro EWURADZE ne dzin, Na asaase do ahemfo nyinara esuro w’enyimnyam.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE akyekyer Zion, Oeyi noho edzi wɔ n’enyimnyam mu;
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze n’enyi aba onnyibi ne mpaabɔ do, Na oemmbu hɔn mpaabɔ tootooba.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔbɛkyerɛw iyi ama mbasantsen a wɔreba: Na aman a wɔbɔbɔ hɔn no beyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Na oefi no krɔnkrɔnbea sor hɔ ahwɛ famu; Ɔsor na EWURADZE fi ahwɛ asaase;
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ obetsie ɔdaduanyi apensi; Dɛ ɔbɛsan hɔn a wɔrokɔ owu mu;
title: PSALMS

text: Ama adasa aabɔ EWURADZE ne dzin akyerɛ wɔ Zion, Na n’ayɛyi wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a aman na ahendzi ahorow, Aboaboa hɔn ano dɛ wɔbɔsom EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE egura m’ahoɔdzen wɔ kwan no mu; Oetwa me nda do tsia.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, me Nyankopɔn, mese dɛ mma nntwa me nnkyen wɔ me nda finimfin: Ɔwo a wo mfe kyɛr kodu mbasantsen nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Tsetseetse na ɔwo etoow asaase ne fapem; Na ɔsorsor yɛ wo nsaano edwuma.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn wɔbɛsɛɛ, naaso ɔwo dze, ibetsim hɔ daa; Nyew, hɔn nyinara bosuw dɛ atar; Ɔwo ebɛsakyer hɔn dɛ efuradze, na wɔasakyer:
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso ɔwo dze, etse mbrɛ etse ara, Na wo mfe nnyi ewiei.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo nkowaa mba bɛtsena hɔ, Na hɔn asefo etsim wɔ w’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra, hyira EWURADZE, Na dza ɔwɔ mo mu nyinara nhyira ne dzin krɔnkrɔn no.
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra, hyira EWURADZE, Na ne yieyɛ nyinara mma wo werɛ mmfir:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na ɔdze w’emumuyɛ nyinara kyɛ, Ɔno na ɔsa wo yarba nyinara;
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na ɔgye wo nkwa fi mona no mu, Ɔno a ɔdze adɔyɛ na mbɔbɔrhu bɔ wo abɔtsir:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno a ɔdze ndze pa hyɛ w’afon ma; Ma wo mberantsɛber yɛ fofor dɛ ɔkɔr.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE dzi nsɛntsenenee, Na atsɛmbu ma hɔn a wɔhyɛ hɛn do nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔmaa Moses hun n’akwan, Ɔmaa Israelmba hun ne ndzeyɛɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ayamuhyehye na adom ahyɛ EWURADZE ma, Ɔfa ebufuw nyaa, na no mbɔbɔrhu dɔɔ so.
title: PSALMS

text: Orunntwuw enyim daa; Nkyii so orinnsie n’ebufuw dabaa.
title: PSALMS

text: Oenndzi hɛn bɔn ekyir nye hɛn enndzi, Eso oenndzi hɛn emumuyɛ ekyir enntua hɛn kaw.
title: PSALMS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ ɔsor krɔn bɔ asaase do no, Dɛmara so na no mbɔbɔrhu so wɔ hɔn a wosuro no do nye no.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ anee na boka ntamu war no, Dɛmara so na ɔama yɛnye hɛn mbrato ntamu awar.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ egya ne yamu hyehye no wɔ ne mba ho no, Dɛmara so na EWURADZE ne yamu hyehye no wɔ hɔn a wosuro no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Na onyim hɛn bɔbea; Ɔkaa dɛ yɛyɛ huntuma.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdasanyi dze, ne nda tse dɛ nkyɛkyɛr; Ɔyɛ prɔmprɔm dɛ haban mu nhyiren.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mframa bɔ fa no do a, na onnyi hɔ; Na ne sibew irunnhu no bio.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE no mbɔbɔrhu dze ofi daa kesi daa ma hɔn a wosuro no, Na ne tsenenee kodu mba hɔn mba do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a wosie n’ahyɛmu, Na hɔn a wɔkaa n’ahyɛdze dɛ wɔbɛyɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE dze n’ahengua etsim sorsor; Na n’ahendzi hom adze nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nhyira EWURADZE, hom n’abɔfoe: Hom ahoɔdzen mu akatakyi a hom dzi n’asɛm do, Hom a hom tsie n’asɛm ndze no.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nhyira EWURADZE, hom no dɔm nyinara; Hom n’asomfo a hom yɛ dza ɔsɔ n’enyi.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nhyira EWURADZE, hom no ndwuma nyinara, Wɔ mbeambea a no tumdzi wɔ nyinara: Me kra, hyira EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Hyira EWURADZE, ao me kra. Ao, EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn, ɔwo eso kɛsekɛse ae; Ɔwo ahyɛ enyidzi na tumdzi dɛ atar.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo a ifura kan dɛ tam; Ɔwo a etserɛw ɔsorsor mu dɛ ntamadan ho tam:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo a edze wo mpia mpuna sa esu do; Na edze mununkum yɛ wo tseaseanam; Ɔwo a ɔdze mframa atsaban nantsew:
title: PSALMS

text: Na edze mframa yɛ w’abɔfoe; Ogyaframee yɛ w’asomfo:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo a edze asaase fapem etsim hɔ, Dɛ mma onnhim dabiarada.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo edze bun kataa do dɛ edze efuradze; Nsu no gyinagyinaa mbepɔw do.
title: PSALMS

text: W’enyimtwuw ntsi woguanguanee; Wo senaman ndze ntsi wɔyɛɛ ntsɛm kɔree;
title: PSALMS

text: Mbepɔw soɛrsoɛree, mbɔnsa hohomee, Wɔkɔr mbrɛ esiesie ama hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo etwa ɔhe dɛ mma wɔnntra; Na wɔnnsan mmbɛkata asaase do bio.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo itue nsunyiwa wɔ mbɔnsa mu; Wɔpem nenam mbepɔw ntamu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔma hambowa biara nya nsu nom; Hamu nsoasopɔnkɔ dze ku hɔn nsukɔm.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn do na wimu ntumbowa nya hɔn tsenabew, Hɔn ndubaa mu na wofi ma hɔn ndze do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ifi wo mpia mu gugu mbepɔw do nsu: Wo ndwuma aba amee asaase.
title: PSALMS

text: Ema nkyɛkyɛr fifir ma fiembowa, Na efuw ma nyimpa no dwumadzi; Ama ɔaama edziban a efi asaase mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wenyin a ɔma ɔdasanyi n’akoma n’enyi gye, Na ngo a ɔma n’enyim hyerɛn, Na edziban a ɔhyɛ dasanyi n’akoma dzen.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE gugu no ndua do nsu; Lebanon ndua akɛse a ɔtsɛwee no.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbrɛ nnoma yɛ hɔn mberɛbuw: Esukɔnkɔn dze, ne fie nye kupresi ndua do.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbepɔw atsentsen yɛ nwi tsenabew; Abotan yɛ twambowa guandɔbea.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔyɛɛ bosoom dze kyerɛɛ mber: Ewia nyim no tɔber.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na ema sum gye, na adze sa; No mu na kwaa mu mbowa nyinara weawea fir edzi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ngyataburwa pɔw dzi hɔn afonam ekyir, Na wɔhwehwɛ hɔn edziban wɔ Nyankopɔn hɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ewia fir a, wɔtwe hɔnho, Na wɔkɛdeda hɔn etu mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyimpa fir edzi kɔ n’edwuma Na no dwumadzi ho kodu ewimbir.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, mbrɛ wo ndwuma dua dɔɔ so a! Nyansa mu na ayɛ hɔn nyinara: Asaase ahyɛ w’abɔdze ma.
title: PSALMS

text: Po na ɔda noho no, ɔso na ɔtrɛ, No mu na aweaweambowa a wonnyi ano wɔ, Mbowa nkakraba na akɛse nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔ na ahɛn nenamee; Bonso a eyɛɛ no dɛ ɔngor mu so wɔ hɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Iyinom nyinara hwɛ wo kwan, Ma aama hɔn hɔn edziban wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Dza ɔwo edze ma hɔn na wɔtase; Ɔwo ibue wo nsamu a, nna ndzepa amee hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ihuntsa w’enyim a, wɔberɛ; Sɛ iyi hɔn ahom a, wowu, Na wɔsan kɔ hɔn huntuma mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo esoma wo sunsum ba, wɔdze bɔ hɔn, Na ɔwo na ema asaase enyi yɛ fofor.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma EWURADZE n’enyimnyam nko hɔ daa; Wɔmma EWURADZE n’enyi ngye wɔ no ndwuma mu:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno a ɔhwɛ asaase, ma ɔwosow; Ɔka mbepɔw ma wopun wusiw.
title: PSALMS

text: Metse ase yi mobɔtow ndwom ama EWURADZE: Mowɔ hɔ yi mobɔtow ayɛyindwom ama me Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma m’adwendwen nyɛ no dɛw: Mibedzi ehurusi wɔ EWURADZE mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma ndzebɔnyɛfo nsa wɔ asaase do, Na mma mma emumuyɛfo nntsena hɔ bio. Hyira EWURADZE, ao me kra. Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa ndaase mma EWURADZE, hom mbɔ ne dzin; Hom mma wonhu dza ɔyɛ wɔ aman mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom ntow ndwom mma no, hom ntow ayɛyindwom mma no; Hom nka n’anwanwa ndwuma nyina ho asɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nhyehyɛ homho wɔ ne dzin krɔnkrɔn no mu: Wɔmma hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE no hɔn akoma ndzi ehurusi.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nhwehwɛ EWURADZE na n’ahoɔdzen; Hom nhwehwɛ n’enyim daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nkaa n’anwanwa ndwuma a ɔayɛ; N’ahobowdze na n’ano ntsɛmbu;
title: PSALMS

text: Hom n’akowaa Abraham n’asefo, Hom Jakob mba, ne mpamufo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno nye EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn, N’atsɛmbu wɔ asaase nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔakaa n’ahyɛmu no daa, Asɛm a ɔhyɛe maa mbasantsen pem no;
title: PSALMS

text: Ahyɛmu a ɔnye Abraham dzii no, Na ne ntam a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ Isaak no;
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na ɔhyɛɛ no dzen maa Jakob dɛ ahyɛdze, Dze maa Israel dɛ daa ahyɛmu:
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ, Ɔwo na medze Keenan asaase bɛma wo, Dɛ wo susuhoma do egyapadze:
title: PSALMS

text: Ber a hɔn ano yɛ nyimpa kumaabi; Na mpo wɔyɛ ahɔho wɔ Keenan asaase do no.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔnantsenantsewee fi ɔman mu kɔr ɔman mu, Wofi ahenman kor mu kɔr ɔman kor so mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔamma nyimpa biara kwan ma ɔannyɛ hɔn bɔn; Nyew, otwuuw ahemfo enyim wɔ hɔn ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ, mma hom nnka mo nkorɔfo a wɔasera hɔn no, Na mma hom nnyɛ mo nkɔnhyɛfo bɔn bi.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ ɔkɔm baa asaase no do; Obubuu edziban dua no nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsomaa nyimpa bi dzii hɔn enyim; Josef a wɔtɔɔn no kɛyɛɛ akowaa no:
title: PSALMS

text: Womiaa n’anan hyɛɛ mpokyerɛ mu; Wɔdze no montaan dadze nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu:
title: PSALMS

text: Kodur aber a n’asɛm baa mu; EWURADZE n’asɛm saan no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔhen somae ma wɔkɛsaan no; Mekyerɛ aman do ɔhwɛfo no, ma okegyaa no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔyɛɛ no ne fi do ɔpanyin, Na n’ahodze nyinara do ɔhwɛfo:
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ ɔnkyekyer n’asafohemfo dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ, Na ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ n’apamfo nyansa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna Israel so baa Egypt; Na Jakob kɛyɛɛ hɔho wɔ Ham asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE maa ne man dɔɔr kɛse, Na ɔmaa wɔyɛɛ dzen kyɛɛn hɔn atamfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdaan hɔn akoma ma wokyiir ne man, Dɛ wɔnye no nkowaa ndzi no ndaadaa mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Afei EWURADZE somaa n’akowaa Moses, Ɔnye Aaron a ɔsaan mu yii no no.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔyɛɛ Nyankopɔn ne nsɛnkyerɛdze akɛse, Na n’anwanwadze wɔ Ham asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsomaa sum ma ɔhyɛɛ asaase no sum; Naaso wɔtseew etua wɔ ne nsɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdandaan hɔn esuesu bɔgya, Na okunkum no mu nam,
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn asaase dɔɔr ntwɛr menyamenya, Wɔ hɔn ahemfo mpia mu mpo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔkasae ma nwansema na dwuw boboebo bae, Wɔpetsee ɔman no mu nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze ɔsorbo yɛɛ hɔn nsutɔree, Na ogyaframee baa hɔn asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Obubuu hɔn wenyinndua na hɔn adɔmbandua so;
title: PSALMS

text: Na obubuu hɔn ahe do ndua. Ɔkasae, na mbɛbɛw bae, Mbɛbɛw a hɔn dodow nnyi ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wodzii efuw a ɔwɔ hɔn asaase do nyinara, Na wodzii hɔn asaase do ekuadze nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbobɔɔ hɔn asaase do mbakan nyinara so, Hɔn ahoɔdzen nyinara ahyɛse no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na afei ɔdze dwetɛ na sika dze hɔn fiir edzi kɔree: Nna nyimpa a ɔyɛ mberɛw kor mpo nnyi n’ebusuakuw no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wosii mu kɔree no, Egypt enyi gyee; Osiandɛ nna hɔn ho hu atɔ hɔn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtserɛɛw mununkum mu yɛɛ akatado; Na ogya dɛ ɔmma kan anadwe.
title: PSALMS

text: Wobisae, na ɔdze Nkokɔhwerɛw bae, Na ɔdze sor edziban mee hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Obuee ɔbotan mu, na esu tuei; Wɔpemee wɔ wewewdo dɛ esutsen.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔkaa n’asɛm krɔnkrɔn no, Na n’akowaa Abraham.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔdze ehurusi yii ne man fiir edzi, Na hɔn a ɔasan mu eyi hɔn no wɔ adwontow mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔdze amanaman asaase maa hɔn; Na wɔfaa aman hɔn edwumadze yɛɛ hɔndze:
title: PSALMS

text: Ma woeesie n’ahyɛdze, Na woeedzi ne mbra do. Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw. Ao, Hom mfa ndaase mma EWURADZE; na oye; Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Woana botum aka EWURADZE n’akatakyi ndwuma akyerɛ, Anaa ɔada n’ayɛyi nyinara edzi?
title: PSALMS

text: Esiarfo nye hɔn a wɔyɛ pɛrpɛr, Na hɔn wɔyɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee mber nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, kaa me wɔ enyisɔ a ewɔ no wɔ wo man ho no mu; Fa wo nkwagye no bɛsera me.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma meehu hɔn a asan mu eyi hɔn no hɔn eyiedzi, Ma meedzi ehurusi wɔ wo man ahosɛpɛw mu, Ma menye w’egyapadze aahyehyɛ hɛnho.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛnye hɛn egyanom ayɛ bɔn, Yɛayɛ emumuyɛ, yɛabɔ mbusu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɛn egyanom anntse w’anwanwadze ase wɔ Egypt; Wɔannkaa wo mbɔbɔrhu dodow no; Na wɔtseew Ɔsorsornyi no do etua wɔ po no ho, mekyerɛ Mbɛw Po no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso ɔgyee hɔn nkwa wɔ ne dzin ntsi, Ma wɔaama woehu no tum ahoɔdzen.
title: PSALMS

text: Otwuuw Mbɛw Po no so enyim na ɔwewee; Nna ogyaa hɔn faa ebun no mu, dɛ sar do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔgyee hɔn nkwa fii nyia okyir hɔn no nsamu, Na ɔpoon hɔn fii atamfo no nsamu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na esu no kataa hɔn atamfo do: Hɔn mu baako ara mpo annka.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna wɔgyee ne nsɛm dzii; Wɔtoow n’ayɛyindwom.
title: PSALMS

text: Ntsɛmara na hɔn werɛ fiir no ndwuma; Wɔanntweɔn n’akwankyerɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wonyaa akɔndɔ dzendzenndzen wɔ sar no do, Na wɔsɔɔ Nyankopɔn hwɛe wɔ asaase kɛsɛɛ no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔdze hɔn ebisadze maa hɔn; Mbom ɔdze ɔfɔn baa hɔn kra mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ber a hɔn enyi beer Moses so wɔ nseraban no mu, Na Aaron EWURADZE no krɔnkrɔnnyi no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na asaase buei na ɔmeen Datan, Na ɔkataa Abiram no kuw no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔsɔɔ gya wɔ hɔn kuw no mu: Ogyaframee no hyeew emumuyɛfo no.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔyɛɛ nantwiba wɔ Horeb, Na wɔsɔɔr ehonyi a woegu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔsakyeer Nyankopɔn n’enyimnyam Yɛɛ nantwi a odzi efuw saso.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn werɛ fiir hɔn gyefo Nyankopɔn, Ɔno a ɔyɛɛ ndzɛmba akɛse wɔ Egypt no:
title: PSALMS

text: Anwanwa ndwuma wɔ Ham asaase do, Na ndzɛmba a ɔyɛ hu wɔ Mbɛw Po no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔsee dɛ nkyɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn; Sɛ nnyɛ dɛ ne mpamunyi Moses gyinaa ntamu, Dɛ ɔbɛdan n’ebufuw, ma ɔaannsɛɛ hɔn a.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, wobuu asaase fɛɛfɛw no tootooba; Wɔanngye n’asɛm enndzi.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wohwinhwinii wɔ hɔn asesee mu; Na woenntsie EWURADZE ndze.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔmaa ne nsa do tsiaa hɔn, Dɛ ɔbɛma wɔahwehwe ase wɔ sar no do:
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔabɔ hɔn asefo egu amanaman mu; Na ɔabɔ hɔn apetse asaase no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔdze hɔnho so kɔbɔɔ Baal-peor ho, Na wodzii ewufo afɔrbɔdze no.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm na wɔdze hɔn nyɛe eyi no ebufuw; Na ɔyardɔm sii hɔn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna Finehas soɛree, na obuu atsɛn: Na ɔyardɔm no siankae.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wobuu iyi tsenenee maa no, Kodu mbasantsen nyinara daa daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Woyii no ebufuw so wɔ Meriba esu no ho; Ma okowiee bɔn maa Moses wɔ hɔn ntsi:
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ wɔtseew no sunsum do etua, Ma n’ano tɔɔ ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔannsɛɛ aman no, Dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ hɔn no;
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔdze hɔnho foraforaa amanaman no mu, Na wosuasuaa hɔn ndwuma:
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔsoom hɔn ehonyi; Ɔno na ɔbɛyɛɛ efir maa hɔn:
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, wɔdze hɔn mbabanyin na hɔn mbabaa bobɔɔ afɔr maa abosom,
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔkaa bɔgya a onndzi so gui, mekyerɛ hɔn mbabanyin na hɔn mbabaa bɔgyaa a; Hɔn a wɔdze hɔn bobɔɔ afɔr maa Keenan ehonyi no; Ma wɔdze bɔgya huraa asaase no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm na wɔdze hɔn ndwuma guu hɔn ho fi, Na wɔdze hɔn nyɛe daan ndwaman.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE ebufuw dzɛɛw ne man do, Na okyiir n’egyapadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ amanaman nsamu; Na hɔn a wokyir hɔn no dzii hɔn do tum.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn atamfo so haaw hɔn, Na wɔbrɛɛ hɔn adze hyɛɛ hɔn nsa ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Mber pii na ɔgyee hɔn; Naaso wɔtseew etua wɔ hɔn apam mu, Na hɔn emumuyɛ brɛɛ hɔn adze.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso hɔn ahokyer no hiaa no, Ber a ɔtsee hɔn sufrɛ no:
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔkaa n’ahyɛmu maa hɔn, Na mbɔbɔrhu dodow ntsi ogyaa mu ma ɔkae.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔmaa hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum no so Wohun hɔn mbɔbɔr.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn, gye hɛn nkwa, Na tase hɛn fi amanaman no mu, Na yɛmbɛda wo dzin krɔnkrɔn no ase, Na yendzi konyim wɔ w’ayɛyi no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, Mfi daapem nkesi daapem mpo. Na ɔman no nyinara nse dɛ, Amen. Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa ndaase mma EWURADZE; na oye: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma hɔn a EWURADZE apon hɔn no nka dɛm, Mekyerɛ hɔn a ɔapon hɔn efi ɔtamfo no nsamu no;
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔaboaboa hɔn ano efi asaase no do, Efi boka na anee, Efi kwaamu na pomu no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Wokyinkyiin sar no do wɔ asaase kɛsɛɛ mu; Woennhu kurow biara a wɔtsena mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔkɔm na nsukɔm dzee hɔn, Hɔn kra tɔɔ bitsi wɔ hɔn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna wosui frɛɛ EWURADZE wɔ hɔn fona mu, Na oyii hɔn fii hɔn ahokyer mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ogyaa hɔn so faa kwan tsenenee mu, Dɛ wɔnkɔ kurow a wɔtsena mu do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, nkyɛ adasa eeyi EWURADZE ayɛw wɔ ne yieyɛ ntsi, Na n’anwanwa ndwuma a ɔwɔ adasamba do ntsi!
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔmee ɔkra a ɔhaahaa no, Na ɔkra a ɔkɔm dze no no ɔdze ndzepa hyɛ no ma.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔtsenaa sum na owu no nwinwin mu, Wɔakyekyer hɔn egu amandzehu na dadze mu;
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ wɔtseew Nyankopɔn asɛm do etua, Na wobuu Ɔsorsornyi no n’apam tootooba:
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔdze ɔhaw brɛɛ hɔn akoma adze; Wɔhwee ase, nna ɔboafo bi nnyi hɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna wosui frɛɛ EWURADZE wɔ hɔn fona mu, Na ɔgyee hɔn nkwa fii hɔn ahokyer mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Oyii hɔn fii sum na owu nwinwin mu, Na obubuu hɔn mpokyerɛ mu esinesin.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, nkyɛ adasa eeyi EWURADZE ayɛw wɔ ne yieyɛ ntsi, Na n’anwanwa ndwuma a ɔwɔ adasamba do ntsi!
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ oebubu boran aponkɛse no mu, Na oetwitwa dadze adaban no mu esinesin.
title: PSALMS

text: Binom hɔn mbrato ntsi, wɔyɛɛ mberɛw Na hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi, wohun amandze.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn kra kyir edziban horow nyinara; Na wɔtwe pin owu aponkɛse ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna wosu frɛ EWURADZE wɔ hɔn fona mu, Na ɔgye hɔn nkwa fi hɔn ahokyer mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsoma n’asɛm, na ɔkɛsa hɔn yarba, Na ɔgye hɔn fi hɔn sɛɛe mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, nkyɛ adasa eeyi EWURADZE ayɛw wɔ ne yieyɛ ntsi, Na n’anwanwa ndwuma a ɔwɔ adasamba do ntsi!
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔmma wɔmbɔ ndaase afɔr, Na wɔmfa adwontow nka no ndwuma nkyerɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wosian kɔfow po ahɛn mu, Na wokedzi dwuma wɔ esu akɛse mu;
title: PSALMS

text: Woyinom na wohu EWURADZE no ndwuma, Na n’anwanwadze wɔ ebun no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔhyɛ, na otu ehum, Ɔno na ɔmema n’asorɛkye do.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔfow kɔ sor, wosian kɔ ebun no mu bio: Hɔn kra nan wɔ ɔfona ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Wohima dzi akɔnaaba, na wɔto ntentan dɛ ɔsabokwafo, Hɔn nyansaa nyinara mem.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna wosu frɛ EWURADZE wɔ hɔn fona mu, Na oyi hɔn fi hɔn ahokyer mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔma ehum no taa tsinkonn, Na asorɛkye no so yɛ fɛmm.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna hɔn enyi gye dɛ hɔn ano adwe; Nna ɔdze hɔn kɔ ahɛngyinaa a wɔrohwehwɛ no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, nkyɛ adasa eeyi EWURADZE ayɛw wɔ ne yieyɛ ntsi, Na n’anwanwa ndwuma a ɔwɔ adasamba do ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔntonton no so wɔ ɔman no hɔn ehyiadzi mu, Na wonyi no ayɛw wɔ mpanyimfo nguabɔ mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdan esutsen ma ɔyɛ sar do, Na nsunyiwa ma ɔyɛ daadze kwawee;
title: PSALMS

text: Asaaseber ma ɔyɛ nkyen sar, Wɔ hɔn a wɔtse do hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdan sar ma ɔyɛ nsutaae, Na asaase kwawee ma ɔyɛ nsunyiwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na hɔ na ɔma hɔn a ɔkɔm dze hɔn no kɛtsena, Ama wɔaakyekyer kurow a wɔtsena mu;
title: PSALMS

text: Na woeeduadua kwa, na wɔaatsetsɛw wenyin nture, Na woeenya ndɔbaa pii.
title: PSALMS

text: Ohyira hɔn so ma wɔdɔr pii; Na ɔmma hɔn anyɛmbowa do nnkuw.
title: PSALMS

text: Bio so hɔn ho suar na wɔbrɛ adze Wɔ ahohiahia, ɔfona, na awerɛhow ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ohue enyimtsia gu mbapɔmba do, Na ɔma wokyin asaasefo mbrɛ kwan bi nnyi no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso ɔdze ohianyi si sor fir amandzehu mu, Na ɔma no mbusua dɛ nguankuw.
title: PSALMS

text: Atseneneefo bohu na hɔn enyi agye; Na emumuyɛ nyinara bomua n’ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Obiara a ɔyɛ onyansafo no ma ɔnhyɛ yinom nsew, Ma ɔndwendwen EWURADZE no mbɔbɔrhu ho.
title: PSALMS

text: M’akoma etsim, Ao Nyankopɔn, m’akoma etsim; Mobɔtow ndwom, nyew, mibedzi ehurusi. Nyan, me kra!
title: PSALMS

text: Bɛnta na nsankutsen, hom nyan; Mankasa so mibenyan anapahema.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, medze ndaase bɛma wo wɔ aman no mu: Na matow ayɛyindwom mama wo wɔ amanaman mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ wo mbɔbɔrhu so na ɔbɔ ɔsorsor do, Na wo nokwar du wimu too.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Nyankopɔn, ma woho do bɔ sorsor do: Na w’enyimnyam mbɔ asaase nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma wɔaagye w’adɔfo ntsi, Fa wo nsa enyimfa gye nkwa, na bua hɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn akasa wɔ no krɔnkrɔnyɛ mu; mibedzi ehurusi: Mebɛkyɛ Sekem mu, na mesusu Sukɔt mbɔnsa.
title: PSALMS

text: Gilead yɛ medze; Manaasɛ yɛ medze; Efraim so nye me tsir do dadzekyɛw; Juda nye m’ahempoma.
title: PSALMS

text: Moab nye m’eguarsɛn; Edom do na mobɔtow mo nsokota makyen: Filistia do na mobɔbɔ ose.
title: PSALMS

text: Woana na ɔdze me bɔkɔ kurow a wɔgye ho ban no mu? Woana begya me akɔ Edom?
title: PSALMS

text: Ana nnyɛ ɔwo, Ao, Nyankopɔn, na atow hɛn akyen yi? Na ɔwo, Nyankopɔn, ennye hɛn dɔm nntu nnkɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Bɔboa hɛn ɔtamfo no enyim: Na nyimpa mboa dze kwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛnam Nyankopɔn do bɛyɛ mbanyindze: Na ɔno nye nyia obetsiatsia hɛn atamfo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nnyɛ dzinn, ao m’ayɛyi Nyankopɔn, mma mmua w’ano;
title: PSALMS

text: Na emumuyɛfo na ndaadaafo ebue hɔn anomu etsia me: Wɔdze ator gyirama akeka mo ho nsɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔdze ɔtan nsɛm so twa mo ho hyia, Na wɔnye me dzi ako kwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔdze ɔtan hyɛ mo dɔ ananmu: Naaso emi dze, mobɔ mpaa ma hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔdze bɔn hyɛ me papa ananmu, Na okyir hyɛ mo dɔ ananmu.
title: PSALMS

text: Fa omumuyɛnyi si no do panyin: Na ma ɔtamfo mbɔ no sombo.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ wobua no atsɛn a, ma ondzi fɔ; Na ma ne mpaabɔ ndan bɔn mma no,
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ne nda nsuar; Na ma obi mfa no nhwɛdo dwuma no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ne mba nyɛ ngyanka, Na ne yer nyɛ okunafo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ne mba nyɛ akobɔfo, na wɔnserɛserɛ adze; Na ma womfi hɔn amamfo do nkɔhwehwɛ edziban.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ɔpempensinyi nsa nka dza ɔwɔ nyinara; Na ma ananaben mfow n’edwumadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma obiara nntsen mbɔbɔrhu nndu no do; Nkyii so mma obiara nnhu ne ngyanka mbɔbɔr.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma wontwa n’asefo mfi hɔ; Ma wɔmpepa hɔn edzin wɔ mbasantsen a odzi do no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma wɔnkaa n’egyanom emumuyɛ wɔ EWURADZE enyim, Na mma wɔmmpepa ne na no bɔn ara da.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ɔnda EWURADZE enyim daa, Ama oeetwa hɔn nkaa efi asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ ɔannkaa dɛ ɔbɛkyerɛ mbɔbɔrhu, Na ohiahiaa nyimpa ɔbɔbɔnyi na ohianyi ho, Na akoma mu bobɔefo, dɛ oboku hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, ɔdɔɔ ndom, na ɔbaa no do; Na n’enyi anngye nhyira mu, na ɔnye ne ntamu twee.
title: PSALMS

text: Ofuraa ndom so dɛ ne tam, Na ɔbaa ne yafun mu dɛ nsu, Na ne mbiew mu dɛ ngo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ɔnyɛ no dɛ tam a ofura, Ma ɔnnonom nkɔ no honam mu dɛ nsu.
title: PSALMS

text: Iyi nye m’atamfo hɔn akatua a ofi EWURADZE hɔ, Na hɔn a wɔka me kra ho nsɛmbɔn no hɔndze.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo, Ao Nyankopɔn, m’EWURADZE dze, dzi ma me wɔ wo dzin ntsi: Ɔnam dɛ wo mbɔbɔrhu ye ntsi, ɔwoara gye me.
title: PSALMS

text: Na meyɛ ɔbɔbɔnyi na ohianyi, Na m’akoma epira wɔ mo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mokɔ dɛ nwinwin a no mu atwe: Wɔtow me kɔ sor ba ase dɛ abɛbɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbuadadzi ntsi m’anankoroma him biribiriw; Na mo honam mu seradze asa.
title: PSALMS

text: Madan ɔsesɛba so ama hɔn: Hɔn enyi bɔ mo do ara a, wɔwosow hɔn tsir.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, me Nyankopɔn, boa me ɛ, Dua wo mbɔbɔrhu do gye me nkwa:
title: PSALMS

text: Ama woeehu dɛ wo nsa nye yi, Dɛ ɔwo, EWURADZE, na ayɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn dze ma wɔndom, na ɔwo dze hyira: Wɔsoɛr a, ma hɔn enyi nto, na w’akowaa dze, ma ondzi ehurusi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma m’atamfo nhyɛ enyimguase, Na ma womfura hɔnankasa hɔn enyito dɛ tam.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze m’ano bɛda EWURADZE ase kɛse; Nyew, mibeyi no ayɛw wɔ nyimpadodow mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ obegyina ohianyi ne nsa enyimfa, Dɛ ɔregye no nkwa efi hɔn a wobu ne kra atsɛn no nsa.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE se mo wura dɛ, Tsena m’abanyimfa, Kodu dɛ medze w’atamfo bɛyɛ w’ananadzegua.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE befi Zion atsen w’ahoɔdzen poma no: Dzi tum wɔ w’atamfo finimfin.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo man dze hɔnho bɛma ɔpɛdo wɔ wo tumdzi da mu: Krɔnkrɔnyɛ n’ahoɔfɛw mu, Na wo mberantsɛ bɛba ama wo.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE aka ntam, na ɔrenndan no; Ɔwo eyɛ ɔsɔfo daa Wɔ Melkizedek mbrɔn do.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE a ɔwɔ w’abanyimfa no, Ɔbɔbobɔ ehwira ahemfo mu wɔ n’ebufuw da no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Obobubu atsɛn wɔ amanaman mu, Ɔbɛma efun ahyɛ mbea no do ma; Ɔbɔbɔ ehwira tsirmu wɔ asaase pii mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbɔnom kwan do ɔwora no bi: Dɛm ntsi na ɔbɛma ne tsir do.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw, Medze m’akoma nyina bɛda EWURADZE ase, Wɔ atseneneefo bagua mu, na mboanofo no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE no ndwuma soso, Hɔn a wɔwɔ enyigye wɔ mu nyinara hwehwɛ ekyir kwan.
title: PSALMS

text: N’edwuma yɛ enyidzi na enyimnyam: Na ne ndzeyɛtsenenee tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔyɛ n’anwanwa ndwuma ma wɔaakaa: EWURADZE yɛ adom, na mbɔbɔrhu so ahyɛ no ma.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze edziban ama hɔn a wosuro no: Ɔbɛkaa n’ahyɛmu daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Oeyi no ndwuma no tum akyerɛ ne man, Dɛ ɔdze amanaman egyapadze ama hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ne nsaano ndwuma yɛ nokwar na atsɛmbu, N’ahyɛdze nyinara si pi.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔdze etsintsim hɔ daa daa, Wɔayɛ no nokwar na tɔɔtsen mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔasoma ɔpon abrɛ ne man; Ɔahyɛ n’ahyɛmu no daa: Ne dzin yɛ krɔnkrɔn na ɔyɛ hu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE ho suro nye nyansa ahyɛse; Hɔn a wodzi do nyina nya ntseasee pa. N’ayɛyi tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw. Osiarfo nye nyimpa a osuro EWURADZE, Na ɔwɔ enyigye pii wɔ ne mbra mu.
title: PSALMS

text: N’asefo bɛyɛ akatakyi wɔ asaase do: Atseneneefo mbasantsen behyira hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Bafuu na ahonya wɔ ne fie; Na ne ndzeyɛtsenenee tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Kan pue sum mu ma atseneneefo: Ɔyɛ adom, na mbɔbɔrhu ahyɛ no ma, na ɔtsen.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyimpa a ɔyɛ adom na ɔdze fɛm no, osi no yie; Obegyina n’asɛm do wɔ atsɛmbu mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ orinnhim ara da; Ɔtseneneenyi no wɔbɛkaa no daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Orunnsuro nsɛmbɔn; N’akoma esi pi, rotwer EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: N’akoma etsim, orunnsuro, Ekodu dɛ obohu n’apɛdze wɔ n’atamfo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔatow apetse, ɔdze ama ehiafo; Ne tsenenee tsim hɔ daa: Wɔdze enyidzi bɛma n’ambɛn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Omumuyɛnyi bohu, na ayɛ no yaw; Ɔbɔtwɛr ne se, na ɔanan: Omumuyɛnyi n’apɛdze bɛhera.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw. Hom EWURADZE no nkowaa, hom nyi ayɛw, Hom nyi EWURADZE ne dzin ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE ne dzin Ofi ndɛ dze kɔ yi na daapem.
title: PSALMS

text: Ofi wipuei kesi n’atɔree EWURADZE ne dzin sɛ ayɛyi.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE krɔn bɔ amanaman nyinara do, Na n’enyimnyam bɔ sorsor do.
title: PSALMS

text: Woana na ɔtse dɛ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn, Ɔno a ɔayɛ ne tsenabea wɔ sor,
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno a ɔbrɛ noho adze hwɛ Ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ sor na ase?
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔma ɔbɔbɔnyi do fi huntuma mu, Na ɔma ohianyi do fi suminado;
title: PSALMS

text: Ama ɔdze no aatsena etsitsir nkyɛn, Ne man mu etsitsir no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔma ɔbaa bɔnyin nya ofi mu siesie, Na ɔyɛ ɔbaatan a n’enyi gye. Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a Israel fii Egypt firii, Jakob fifo fii ananaben man mu no;
title: PSALMS

text: Juda bɛyɛɛ no krɔnkrɔnbea, Israel bɛyɛɛ n’ahenman.
title: PSALMS

text: Po hunii, na oguanee; Jordan so wɔsaan no ekyir.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbepɔw huruhuruuw dɛ nguannyin, Nkokwaa no dɛ nguambaa.
title: PSALMS

text: Epo ei, ebɛnadze yɛ wo na iruguan yi? Ɔwo Jordan, na eresan w’ekyir yi ɛ?
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mbepɔw, na hom ruhuruhuruw dɛ nguannyin; Na hom nkokwaa, dɛ nguambaa yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo asaase, hihim wɔ EWURADZE enyim, Wɔ Jakob ne Nyankopɔn no enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno a ɔdaan ɔbotan no yɛɛ nsutaae, Ɔtwerɛbo no yɛɛ no nsunyiwa no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nnyɛ hɛn a, Ao, EWURADZE, nnyɛ hɛn a, Na ɔwo wo dzin na enyimnyam nka, Wɔ wo mbɔbɔrhu na wo nokwar ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ebɛnadze ntsi na amanaman bisa dɛ, Hɔn Nyankopɔn no wɔ hen ndɛ yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Hɛn Nyankopɔn wɔ sorsor: Dza ɔpɛ na ɔyɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn ehonyi yɛ dwetɛ na sika, Nyimpa nsaano edwuma a.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔwɔ ano, naaso wɔnnkasa; Wɔwɔ enyiwa, naaso wonnhu adze;
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔwɔ asowa, naaso wɔnntse asɛm; Wɔwɔ hwen, naaso wonnhua adze;
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔwɔ nsa, naaso wonnsuo adze mu; Wɔwɔ anan, naaso wɔnnantsew; Eso wonndua hɔn meneba mu nnkasa.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔyɛ hɔn no tse dɛ hɔnara; Nyew, obiara a ɔtwer hɔn no so.
title: PSALMS

text: Israel ei, ɔwo dze, twer EWURADZE; Ɔnoara nye hom mboa na hom kyɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Aaron ne fifo, hom ntwer EWURADZE: Ɔnoara nye hɔn mboa na hɔn kyɛm,
title: PSALMS

text: Hom a hom suro EWURADZE, hom ntwer EWURADZE: Ɔnoara nye hom mboa na hom kyɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE adwen hɛn do; obehyira hɛn: Obehyira Israel ne fifo; Obehyira Aaron ne fifo.
title: PSALMS

text: Obehyira hɔn a wosuro EWURADZE, Nkakraba na akɛse nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE mma hom ndɔr mbordo ara, Hom na hom mba.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom yɛ EWURADZE n’esiarfo, Ɔno a ɔyɛɛ sor na asaase.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsorsor yɛ EWURADZE no sorsor; Na asaase dze, ɔdze ama adasamba.
title: PSALMS

text: Nnyɛ ewufo na woyi EWURADZE ayɛw, Nkyii so nnyɛ hɔn a wosian kɔ foofoo mu no a;
title: PSALMS

text: Na hɛn dze, yebehyira EWURADZE Ofi ndɛ dze kɔ yi, na daapem. Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Modɔ EWURADZE, osiandɛ oetsie Me ndze na mo nkotoserɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiandɛ ɔabrɛ n’aso adze ama me, Dɛm ntsi metse ase yi mobɔbɔ ne dzin.
title: PSALMS

text: Owu ahoma brabraa me, Na samanadze yaw too me: Muhun ahoguan na awerɛhow.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna mobɔɔ EWURADZE ne dzin; Ao EWURADZE, meserɛ wo, gye me kra.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE yɛ adom na tsenenee; Nyew, hɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ mbɔbɔrhu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE sie botooyɛfo: Wɔbrɛɛ me adze, na ɔgyee me nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao me kra, san kɔ w’ahomgye mu; Na EWURADZE nye wo edzi no yie.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo eyi me kra efi owu mu, M’enyiwa efi nyinsuwa mu, Na m’anan efi asehwe mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi, mebɛnantsew EWURADZE enyim Wɔ atseasefo asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Megyee dzii, mpo ber a mekaa dɛ: Mo ho hiahiaa me kɛse no.
title: PSALMS

text: M’akomatu mu, mekaa dɛ, Nyimpa nyinara yɛ atorfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ebɛnadze na medze mebɛhyɛ EWURADZE ananmu, Wɔ ne yie a ɔyɛ me nyinara ntsi?
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛfa nkwagye kɔɔpow no, Na mabɔ EWURADZE ne dzin.
title: PSALMS

text: Mubotua m’anohobadze ama EWURADZE, Ampaara, wɔ ne man nyinara enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE n’ahotseweefo hɔn wu dze Ɔsom bo wɔ n’enyi do.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, meyɛ w’akowaa turododo: Meyɛ w’akowaa, w’afonabaa ne ba; Ɔwo na asan me nkyehoma.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔbɔ ndaase afɔr ama wo, Na mabɔ EWURADZE ne dzin.
title: PSALMS

text: Mubotua m’anohobadze ama EWURADZE, Ampaara, wɔ ne man nyinara enyim;
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔ EWURADZE fie abanguado, Wɔ ɔwo, Jerusalɛm, wo finimfin. Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Amanaman nyinara, hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw; Amanaman nyinara, hom ntonton no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na no mbɔbɔrhu dɔɔ so wɔ hɛn do; Na EWURADZE no nokwar tsim hɔ daa. Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa ndaase mma EWURADZE; na oye: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Afei wɔmma Israel nka, Dɛ n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma Aaron ne fifo so wɔnka Dɛ n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma hɔn a wosuro EWURADZE nyina wɔnka, Dɛ n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Mifi m’ahokyer mu mefrɛɛ EWURADZE: EWURADZE gyee me do na ɔdze me sii bea a ɔtrɛ do.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE dzi m’afa; murunnsuro: Ebɛnadze na nyimpa botum ayɛ me?
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE dzi m’afa dɛ mo boafo: Dɛm ntsi mubohu m’apɛdze wɔ hɔn a wɔtan me no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Oye dɛ wɔtwer EWURADZE Kyɛn dɛ wɔdze werɛ bɛhyɛ nyimpa mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Oye dɛ wɔtwer EWURADZE Kyɛn dɛ wɔdze werɛ bɛhyɛ ahemfo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Amanaman nyinara twaa mo ho hyiae: EWURADZE ne dzin mu na mutwitwaa hɔn gui.
title: PSALMS

text: Wotwaa mo ho hyiae, ampaara, wotwaa mo ho hyiae: EWURADZE ne dzin mu na mubotwitwa hɔn egu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wotwaa mo ho hyiaa dɛ ndowa; woedum hɔn dɛ nsoɛ mu ogya: EWURADZE ne dzin mu na mubotwitwa hɔn egu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔpeem me ta ma nkyɛ morohwe ase: Na EWURADZE boaa me.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE nye m’ahoɔdzen na mo ndwom; Na ɔabɛyɛ mo nkwagye.
title: PSALMS

text: Ehurusi na nkwagye ndze wɔ atseneneefo asesee mu: EWURADZE n’abanyimfa yɛ mbanyindze.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE n’abanyimfa ama do: EWURADZE n’abanyimfa yɛ mbanyindze.
title: PSALMS

text: Munnkowu, na mebɛtsena ase, Na maka EWURADZE no ndwuma makyerɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE atsea me yaayaw: Naaso onngyaa mo mu nnhyɛɛ owu nsa.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mbuebue ndzeyɛtsenenee aponkɛse no mma me; Mebɛhɛn mu, medze ndaase bɛma EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE no ponkɛse nye yi; Atseneneefo bɛhɛn mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze ndaase bɛma wo, osiandɛ ɔwo na agye me do, Na abɛyɛ mo nkwagye.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbo a adantofo powee no Ɔabɛyɛ kutuwdo bo.
title: PSALMS

text: Iyi EWURADZE ne nyɛe a; Ɔyɛ nwanwa wɔ hɛn enyiwa do.
title: PSALMS

text: Iyi nye da a EWURADZE ayɛ; Yebedzi ehurusi na hɛn enyi agye wɔ mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, yɛserɛ wo, afei gye nkwa; EWURADZE, yɛserɛ wo, afei ma prɔmprɔmyɛ mbra.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiarfo nye nyia ɔnam EWURADZE dzin mu reba no: Yefi EWURADZE fie ehyira wo.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE nye Nyankopɔn, na ɔama hɛn kan: Hom mfa ndubaa nkitsa hom nsamu nhyɛ fa no ase, na hom mbɔ afɔrmbukyia no ho aprɔw.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo enye me Nyankopɔn, na medze ndaase bɛma wo: Ɔwo enye me Nyankopɔn, mubohuhor wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa ndaase mma EWURADZE, na oye, Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: א ALEPH. Esiarfo nye hɔn a wodzi mu wɔ EWURADZE n’asɛm mu, Hɔn a wɔnantsew EWURADZE ne mbra do.
title: PSALMS

text: Esiarfo nye hɔn a wodzi ne mbrasɛm do, Hɔn a wɔdze hɔn akoma nyina hwehwɛ no no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, wɔmmbɔ ɔbrakyew biara; Wɔnantsew n’akwan no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ahyɛ hɛn w’ahyɛdze, Dɛ yendzi do pɛpɛɛpɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, nkyɛ meedzi nokwar wɔ dza ahyɛ no nyinara mu!
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno nna m’enyi nnkɔto, Ber a mubu wo mbra nyinara bi no.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze tsenenee akoma mebɛda wo ase, Ber a musua wo tsenenee atsɛmbu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Mibedzi wo mmom do: Mma mmpow me koraa.
title: PSALMS

text: ב BETH. Ebɛnadze na aberantsɛ bɛyɛ ma n’abrabɔ ho atsew? Ɔnye dɛ ɔbɔhwɛ noho yie dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze m’akoma nyina na maper dɛ mobɔsom wo: Mma mma mummbu wo mbra do.
title: PSALMS

text: W’asɛm na medze ahyɛ m’akoma mu, Amma maannyɛ bɔn enntsia wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ayɛyi nka wo, Ao, EWURADZE; Kyerɛkyerɛ me wo mbra.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze m’anofamfa aka W’anomu atsɛmbu nyinara akyerɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Medzi ehurusi wɔ wo mbrasɛm no mu, Wɔ ahonyadze nyinara so mu dɛmara.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔdwendwen w’ahyɛdze ho, Na mebu w’asɛm bi.
title: PSALMS

text: M’enyi bɛgye wo mbra ho: Mo werɛ nnkefir w’ahyɛdze.
title: PSALMS

text: ג GIMEL. Enye w’akowaa ndzi no yie, ma mentsena ase; Na mibedzi w’asɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: Bue m’enyiwa, ma monhwɛ Anwanwadze a ofi wo mbra mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Meyɛ ɔmamforanyi wɔ asaase do: Mma mmfa wo mbrasɛm nnhuntsa me.
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra si apen wɔ akɔndɔ a Ɔwɔ wɔ w’atsɛmbu ho daa nyina ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo etwuw ahopɔwfo enyim, Wɔadom hɔn a wofi wo mbrasɛm ho kyin no.
title: PSALMS

text: Yi ahorbahyɛ na enyito fi mo do; Osiandɛ mesie wo mbrasɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔman mu etsitsir so mpo fa apam tsia me: Naaso w’akowaa bɔdwendwen wo mbra ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo mbrasɛm so yɛ m’enyigyedze Na m’apamfo.
title: PSALMS

text: ד DALETH. Me kra aka huntuma mu: Ma me nkwa bio dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Muhuee m’asɛm nyina guu w’enyim. Kyerɛkyerɛ me wo mbra.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma mentse w’ahyɛdze kwan ase; Na mobɔdwendwen w’anwanwa ndwuma ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra nan wɔ awerɛhow ntsi: Hyɛ me dzen dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Twe me ekyir fi ndabraba kwan do: Na dua adom do fa wo mbra ma me.
title: PSALMS

text: Masan mu eyi nokwardzi kwan no: Medze w’atsɛmbu esi m’enyi do.
title: PSALMS

text: Medzi wo mbrasɛm do: Ao, EWURADZE, mma m’enyi nnto.
title: PSALMS

text: Mibedzi wo mbransɛm do dzendzenndzen mu, Ber a ebɛma me ntseasee ayɛ kɛse no.
title: PSALMS

text: ה HE. Ao, EWURADZE, kyerɛkyerɛ me wo mbra no, Na mibedzi do akɔ ewiei.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma me ntseasee, na mibesie wo mbra; Nyew, medze m’akoma nyina bedzi do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma memfa wo mbrasɛm kwan do; Na ɔno na m’enyi gye mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Dan m’akoma kɔ wo mbrasɛm ho, Na nnyɛ enyikaber ho bi a.
title: PSALMS

text: Dan m’enyiwa fi egyangyandze no hwɛ ho, Na ma me nkwa bio wɔ w’akwan mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma w’anohoba a edze abɔ w’akowaa no mbra mu, Anohoba a edze abɔ hɔn a wosuro wo no.
title: PSALMS

text: Gye me fi ahorbahyɛ a musuro no mu; Osiandɛ w’atsɛmbu ye.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, mo kɔn dɔ w’ahyɛdze: Wo tsenenee ntsi, ma me abrabɔ fofor.
title: PSALMS

text: ו VAU. Ma wo mbɔbɔrhu so mbra me nkyɛn, Ao, EWURADZE, Wo nkwagye no a, dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Nna mibenya mbuae bi ama hɔn a wɔhyɛ me ahorba no; Osiandɛ motwer w’asɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mma nnyi nokwar asɛm no mmfi m’anomu koraa; Na m’enyi ada w’atsɛmbu do.
title: PSALMS

text: Mibedzi wo mbra do daa ekesi daapem.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mebɛnantsew abodweemu do; Osiandɛ medzi w’ahyɛdze.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛkasa wo mbrasɛm ho so wɔ ahemfo enyim, Na m’enyi ronnto.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mo ho bɛsɛpɛw me wɔ wo mbransɛm a modɔ no ho, Dza madɔ no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze moho bɛma mbrasɛm a modɔ no ho; Na mobɔdwendwen w’ahyɛdze ho.
title: PSALMS

text: ז ZAIN. Kaa asɛm a ekaa kyerɛɛ w’akowaa no, Dza ama medze m’enyi ato do no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Iyi nye m’awerɛkyekyer wɔ m’amandzehu mu; Dɛ w’asɛm na ɔama me nkwa bio.
title: PSALMS

text: Ahopɔwfo esi me atwetwe biara: Naaso menndanee mmfii wo mbra ho.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, makaa w’atsɛmbu a ofir tsetseetse no, Na makyekye mo werɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Hu ekitsa me, Osian emumuyɛfo a wɔpow wo mbra ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo mbra ayɛ mo ndwom Wɔ m’akwantu fi no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, mekaa wo dzin anadwe, Na midzi wo mbra do.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira yi na menya, Dɛ medzi w’ahyɛdze do.
title: PSALMS

text: ח CHETH. Me kyɛpɛn, Ao, EWURADZE: Nye dɛ mibedzi wo nsɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze m’akoma nyina meserɛ enyimtsewee: Hu me mbɔbɔr dɛ mbrɛ w’anohoba tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Modwendween m’abra ho, Na medanee fii ho bedzii w’ahyɛdze do.
title: PSALMS

text: Meyɛɛ ntsɛm, na mannyɛ ekyim, Dɛ mibedzi wo mbrasɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: Kaansa emumuyɛfo nhoma adwer me ehyia mpo a; Mo werɛ mmfir wo mbra.
title: PSALMS

text: Esuom na mosoɛr dze ndaase ma wo Wɔ w’atsɛmbu tsenenee ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wosuro wo nyinara na menye hɔn gor, Na hɔn a wodzi w’ahyɛdze do no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, wo mbɔbɔrhu ahyɛ asaase ma: Kyerɛkyerɛ me wo mbra no.
title: PSALMS

text: ט TETH. Enye w’akowaa edzi no yie, Ao, EWURADZE, dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Kyerɛkyerɛ me atsɛmbu pa na nyimdzee; Na magye wo mbrasɛm edzi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ansaana murubohu amandze no motɔɔ gon; Na afei dze midzi w’asɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo iye, na eyɛ dza oye; Kyerɛkyerɛ me wo mbra no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ahopɔwfo etwa akɔhwi ato mo do: Naaso medze m’akoma nyina bedzi w’ahyɛdze do.
title: PSALMS

text: Wonnyi wo mbra ho ntseasee; Naaso emi dze, m’enyi ka wo mbra mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Oye ma me dɛ mehu amandze; Ama meesua wo mbra.
title: PSALMS

text: W’anomu mbra ye ma me Kyɛn sika na dwetɛ mpempem.
title: PSALMS

text: י JOD. Wo nsa na wɔayɛ me na wɔahyehyɛ me: Ma me ntseasee, ama meesua wo mbrasɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wosuro wo no bohu me na hɔn enyi agye; Osiandɛ medze m’enyi ato w’asɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, minyim dɛ w’atsɛmbu tsen, Na dɛ nokwardzi mu na ehiahia mo ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Meserɛ wo, ma w’adɔyɛ mma me awerɛkyekyer, Dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm a aka akyerɛ w’akowaa no tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma w’ayamuhyehye mbra mo do, na minnya nkwa: Na wo mbra nye m’enyikadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ahopɔwfo enyi nto; osiandɛ woebutuw me akɔhwi mu: Na emi dze, mobɔdwendwen w’ahyɛdze ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a wosuro wo no ndan mbra me nkyɛn, Hɔn a wonyim wo mbrasɛm no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma m’akoma ndzi mu wɔ wo mbra no mu: Amma m’enyi aannto.
title: PSALMS

text: כ CAPH. Me kra tɔ wo nkwagye ho bitsi; Na m’enyi da w’asɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: M’enyiwa ebu wɔ w’anohoba no tweɔn ntsi, Mibisaa dɛ, Dabɛn na ebɛkyekye mo werɛ?
title: PSALMS

text: Na mayɛ dɛ kɛntsɛn a woeyi no egow; Naaso mo werɛ mmfir wo mbra.
title: PSALMS

text: W’akowaa nhaahaa nkodu dabɛn? Dabɛn na ibobu hɔn a wohiahia mo ho no atsɛn?
title: PSALMS

text: Ahopɔwfo etutu amona ama me, Hɔn a wonndzi wo mbra do no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo mbrasɛm nyinara yɛ nokwar: M’atamfo hiahia mo ho akɔhwi mu; ɔwoara boa me.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔka kakraabi ma nkyɛ wɔaahyew me wɔ asaase do; Naaso mammpow w’ahyɛdze.
title: PSALMS

text: W’adɔyɛ ntsi, gye me fi owu mu: Ama meedzi wo mbrasɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: ל LAMED. W’asɛm, Ao, EWURADZE, Tsim hɔ daapem wɔ sor hɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo nokwardzi wɔ hɔ ma mbasantsen nyinara: Ɔwo edze asaase etsim na ɔwɔ hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo mbra ntsi ndzɛmba nyinara wɔ hɔ bodu ndɛ; Na biribiara dzi wo mbra do.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ wo mbra annyɛ m’enyikadze a, Nkyɛ ɔnodze mahera wɔ m’amandzehu mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mo werɛ nnkefir w’ahyɛdze da; Osiandɛ ɔno na edze ama me nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Meyɛ wodze, gye me nkwa; Na mahwehwɛ w’ahyɛdze.
title: PSALMS

text: Emumuyɛfo retsɛw me asɛɛ me; Naaso mobɔdwendwen wo mbrasɛm ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Mehu emudzi nyinara n’ewiei; Na wo mbrasɛm dze, ɔmmbɔ adze da.
title: PSALMS

text: מ MEM. Ao, mbrɛ mudua dɔ wo mbra a! Modwendwen ho adzekyee nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo mbrasɛm nye me wɔ hɔ daa; Na ɔayɛ me onyansafo akyɛn m’atamfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Mowɔ ntseasee kyɛn m’akyerɛkyerɛfo nyinara; Osiandɛ wo mbrasɛm nye m’adwendwen.
title: PSALMS

text: Metse adze ase kyɛn nkɔdaa mpo, Osiandɛ medzi w’ahyɛdze do.
title: PSALMS

text: Matwe m’anan efi emumuyɛ kwan biara do, Ama meedzi w’asɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: Memmanee mmfii w’ahyɛdze ho; Osiandɛ ɔwoara na akyerɛkyerɛ me.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbrɛ wo nsɛm dua yɛ dɛw wɔ me gyirama do a! Nyew, ɔkyɛn ewo mpo, wɔ m’anomu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔnam w’ahyɛdze do na minya ntseasee: Dɛm ntsi na mikyir akɔhwi kwan biara no.
title: PSALMS

text: נ NUN. W’asɛm yɛ kandzea ma m’anan, Na kan ma mo kwan.
title: PSALMS

text: Maka ntam, na mafoa do, Dɛ mibedzi wo tsenenee ahyɛdze do.
title: PSALMS

text: Muruhu amandze dodow, Ao, EWURADZE: Gye me nkwa dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, meserɛ wo, ma w’enyi nsɔ m’anomu ayamuyi afɔr, Na kyerɛkyerɛ me w’ahyɛdze.
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra da me nsamu daa; Naaso mo werɛ mmfir wo mbra.
title: PSALMS

text: Emumuyɛfo esua me efir; Naaso memmfi w’ahyɛdze ho anntɔ gon.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo mbrasɛm na mafa ayɛ egyapadze daa; Na m’akoma n’ehurusi ara nye no.
title: PSALMS

text: Madan m’akoma dɛ mibedzi wo mbra do, Daa, ekodu ewiei mpo.
title: PSALMS

text: ס SAMECH. Mikyir hɔn a hɔn adwen nta nta; Na wo mbra na modɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo nye mo guansumabea na me kyɛm: M’enyi da w’asɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfi me nkyɛn nkɔ hom emumuyɛfo; Ama meedzi me Nyankopɔn ne mbrasɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: Wowaw me dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse, ma minnya nkwa; Na mma m’enyi nnto m’enyidado ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Suo mo mu, na mibenya nkwa, Na mebu wo mbra bi daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ama hɔn a wɔfom wo mbra no nyinara ayɛ kwa; Na hɔn ndaadaa ayɛ gyan.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ema asaase do emumuyɛfo nyinara fi hɔ dɛ sumina: Dɛm ntsi na modɔ wo mbrasɛm no.
title: PSALMS

text: Mo ho popo wɔ wo ho hu ntsi; Na musuro w’atsɛmbu.
title: PSALMS

text: ע AIN. Mayɛ dza ɔtsen na pɛrpɛr: Mma nngyaa me mma m’ahyɛdofo.
title: PSALMS

text: Dzi egyinamu ma w’akowaa ne yieyɛ: Mma ahopɔw nnhyɛ mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: M’enyiwa ada kwan akyɛr wɔ wo nkwagye, Na wo tsenenee asɛm no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Enye w’akowaa ndzi no dɛ mbrɛ wo mbɔbɔrhu tse, Na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo mbra.
title: PSALMS

text: Meyɛ w’akowaa, ma me ntseasee; Ama meehu wo nkyerɛkyerɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, edu aber a Edze yɛ edwuma; Osiandɛ wɔato wo mbra pan.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi na modɔ wo mbrasɛm Kyɛn sika, nyew, kyɛn sika mapa mpo.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi na mubu w’ahyɛdze wɔ adze nyinara ho dɛ ɔtsen; Na mikyir akɔhwi kwan biara no.
title: PSALMS

text: פ PE. Wo nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ nwanwa: Dɛm ntsi na me kra dzi do.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo nsɛm no do mbuei ma kan; Ɔma okotobonyi ntseasee.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebue m’anomu petoo, na mehaahaa; Osiandɛ mo kɔn dɔ wo mbrasɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Kyea woho hwɛ me, na hu me mbɔbɔr, Dɛ mbrɛ etɔ dɛ eyɛ ma hɔn a wɔdɔ wo dzin no.
title: PSALMS

text: Tsintsim m’anamɔn wɔ w’asɛm mu; Na mma emumuyɛ biara nndzi mo do tum.
title: PSALMS

text: Pon me fi ɔdasanyi ne nhyɛdo mu: Ama meedzi w’ahyɛdze do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma w’enyim nhyerɛn w’akowaa do; Na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo mbra.
title: PSALMS

text: Me nyinsuwa pem dɛ esutsen, Osiandɛ nyimpa ndzi wo mbra do.
title: PSALMS

text: צ TZADDI. Ɔtseneneenyi nye ɔwo, EWURADZE, Na w’atsɛmbu yɛ tɔɔtsen.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ahyɛ wo mbrasɛm wɔ tsenenee Na nokwardzi mu ara.
title: PSALMS

text: Mo mbɔdzembɔ redzɛw mo mu dɛ ogya, Osiandɛ m’atamfo werɛ efir wo nsɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: W’asɛm ho tsew krɔnn; Dɛm ntsi na w’akowaa dɔ no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Musuar na wommbu me bi: Naaso mo werɛ mmfir w’ahyɛdze.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo tsenenee yɛ ɔdomankoma tsenenee, Na wo mbra nye nokwar.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔfona na ahoguan ekitsa me, Naaso wo mbrasɛm nye m’enyikadze.
title: PSALMS

text: W’ahyɛdze yɛ tsenenee daa; Ma me ntseasee, na mibenya nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: ק KOPH. Medze m’akoma nyina mesu afrɛ; gye me do, Ao EWURADZE; Na mibedzi wo mbra do.
title: PSALMS

text: Musu frɛ wo; gye me nkwa, Na mibedzi wo mbrasɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: Mutwaar anapahema ano, na mekaa mu: M’enyi daa wo nsɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: M’enyiwa twaar anadwe dasu ano, Ama maadwendwen w’asɛm ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Tsie me ndze dɛ mbrɛ w’adɔyɛ tse: EWURADZE, ma me nkwa bio dɛ mbrɛ w’atsɛmbu tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔka emumuyɛ do no abɛn; Wɔnye wo mbra ntamu atwe.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso, EWURADZE, ɔwo ebɛn, Na wo mbrasɛm nyinara yɛ nokwar.
title: PSALMS

text: Muhunii wɔ wo mbrasɛm ho akyɛr, Dɛ ɔwo na edze etsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: ר RESH. Hwɛ m’amandzehu, na gye me; Osiandɛ mo werɛ mmfir wo mbra.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwoara dzi m’asɛm ma me, na pon me: Gye me nkwa dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Nkwagye nye emumuyɛfo ntamu twe; Osiandɛ wɔnnhwehwɛ wo mmom no.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso w’ayamuhyehye dɔɔ so, Ao EWURADZE: Gye me nkwa dɛ mbrɛ w’atsɛmbu tse.
title: PSALMS

text: M’ahohiahiafo na m’atamfo dɔɔ so: Naaso menndanee mmfii wo mbrasɛm ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ mohwɛ abrɔdɔtwafo a, na mo werɛ howee; Osiandɛ wonndzi w’asɛm do.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ mbrɛ mudua modɔ w’ahyɛdze: Ao, EWURADZE, gye me nkwa dɛ mbrɛ w’adɔyɛ tse.
title: PSALMS

text: W’asɛm ne tamsi nye nokwar; Na w’atsɛmbu tsenenee mu biara tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: ש SCHIN. Aman mpanyin ehiahia mo ho kwa; Na wo nsɛm ho na m’akoma tu.
title: PSALMS

text: M’enyi gye w’asɛm ho, Dɛ obi a oenya asadze pii.
title: PSALMS

text: Metan atorsɛm na mikyir no kɔkɔɔkɔ; Naaso wo mbra dze, modɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Mpɛn esuon da kor na miyi wo ayɛw, Wɔ w’atsɛmbu tsenenee ntsi.
title: PSALMS

text: Asomdwee kɛse na hɔn a wɔdɔ wo mbra no wɔwɔ; Na biribiara mma wommfintsiw.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, m’enyi ada wo nkwagye no kwan, Na medzi wo mbrasɛm no do.
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra edzi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ do; Na modɔ no mbordo ara.
title: PSALMS

text: Midzi w’ahyɛdze na wo mbrasɛm do; Na m’akwan nyinara da w’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: ת TAU. EWURADZE, ma me nkekamu ndu w’enyim: Ma me ntseasee dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma mo nkotoserɛ ndu w’enyim: Gye me dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma m’anofamfa bohue w’ayɛyi; Dɛ ɔwo na ekyerɛkyerɛ me wo mbra.
title: PSALMS

text: Me tɛkyerɛma bɔtow w’asɛm ho ndwom; Osiandɛ wo mbrasɛm nyinara yɛ tsenenee.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma wo nsa nyɛ krado mbɔboa me; Na w’ahyɛdze na masan mu meyi.
title: PSALMS

text: Mo kɔn adɔ wo nkwagye, Ao, EWURADZE; Na wo mbra nye m’enyikadze.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma me kra ntsena ase, na obeyi wo ayɛw; Na ma w’atsɛmbu mboa me.
title: PSALMS

text: Matɔ gon dɛ oguan a ɔayew; hwehwɛ w’akowaa; Osiandɛ mo werɛ mmfir wo mbrasɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: M’ahokyer mu, musui frɛɛ EWURADZE, Na ɔgyee me do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, gye me kra fi ator ano, Na ndaadaa tɛkyerɛma mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ebɛnadze na wɔmfa mma wo, na ebɛnadze na wɔmfa nyɛ wo nka ho, Ɔwo ndaadaa tɛkyerɛma?
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔkatakyi n’egyen hwironhwirom, Na ogyansenama huoo bɛyɛ wo kyɛfa.
title: PSALMS

text: Mundue, dɛ mabɔsoɛ Mesek, Dɛ metsena Kedar asese mu!
title: PSALMS

text: Matsena akyɛr dodow Wɔ nyia okyir asomdwee no nkyɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Emi dze, mepɛ asomdwee: Naaso, sɛ mekasa a, hɔn dze wɔpɛ ɔko.
title: PSALMS

text: Mebɛma m'enyiwa do mahwɛ mbepɔw no: Henfa na mo mboa fi bɛba?
title: PSALMS

text: Mo mboa fi Ewuradze hɔ ba, ɔno a ɔyɛɛ sor na asaase no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔremma kwan ma w'anan mpatser: Nyia ɔkora wo do no ronntɔ nkom.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, nyia ɔkora Israel do no ɔronntɔ nkom eso ɔrennda.
title: PSALMS

text: Ewuradze nye nyia ɔkora wo do: Ewuradze nye wo nwin wɔ w'abanyimfa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ewia rennhye wo adzekyee, nkyii so bosoom rinnsi wo do adzesaa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ewuradze bɔkora wo do efi mbusu nyinara mu; ɔbɔkora wo kra do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ewuradze bɔkora w'edzifir na wo fieba do, ofitsi aber yi dze kesi daapem.
title: PSALMS

text: M’enyi gyee ber a wɔsee me dɛ, Ma yɛnkɔ EWURADZE fie.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɛn anan gyinagyina W’aponkɛse mu, ao, Jerusalɛm;
title: PSALMS

text: Jerusalɛm a wɔakyekyer wo Dɛ kurow a ɔayɛ pepeepe:
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔ na mbusuakuw fow kɔ, mekyerɛ EWURADZE mbusuakuw no a, Ama wɔdze ndaase aama EWURADZE ne dzin, Dɛ mbrɛ n’ahyɛdze a ɔdze ama Israel no tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Na hɔ na wɔdze nhengua esisi ama atsɛmbu, David ne fie nhengua no a.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nserɛ asomdwee mma Jerusalɛm: Hɔn a wɔdɔ wo no bɛyɛ prɔmprɔm.
title: PSALMS

text: Asomdwee ntsena w’afasu mu, Na prɔmprɔmyɛ ntsena w’aban mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mo nuanom na me mfɛfo ntsi, Afei mebɛka dɛ, Asomdwee ntsena wo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ne fi ntsi Mobɔhwehwɛ wo yieyɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo na mema m’enyiwa do mohwɛ wo, Ao, Ɔwo a etse sorsor.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, dɛ mbrɛ nkowaa dan hɔn wura, Na afonabaa hɔn wuraba no; Dɛmara so na yɛdan EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn, Kodu dɛ obohu hɛn mbɔbɔr.
title: PSALMS

text: Hu hɛn mbɔbɔr, Ao, EWURADZE, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr: Na enyimtsiabu ahyɛ hɛn do dodow.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a hɔn ho adwe hɔn hɔn atwetwesi, Na ahopɔwfo hɔn enyimtsiabu Ahyɛ hɛn kra do dodow.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ nnyɛ EWURADZE na odzii hɛn afa a, Wɔmma Israel wɔnka ɛ;
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ nnyɛ EWURADZE na odzii hɛn afa, Ber a adasa soɛɛr hɛn do no a:
title: PSALMS

text: Nkyɛ wɔmeen hɛn enyimon, Ber a hɔn ebufuw dzɛɛw hɛn do no:
title: PSALMS

text: Nkyɛ esu no praam hɛn do, Nkyɛ esutsen no faa hɛn kra do.
title: PSALMS

text: Nkyɛ esu begyabegya no faa hɛn kra do.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE, Ɔno a ɔammfa hɛn annyɛ afonam amma hɔn se.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɛn kra efi nsa dɛ mbrɛ anoma fi efirsuafo efir mu: Efir ebubu, na yeefi nsa.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɛn mboa fi EWURADZE hɔ, Ɔno a ɔyɛɛ sor na asaase no.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔtwer EWURADZE no Wɔtse dɛ mbepɔw Zion a onnhihim, na osi hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ mbepɔw etwa Jerusalɛm ho ehyia no, Dɛmara so na EWURADZE etwa ne man ho ehyia, Ofitsi aber yi dze kesi daapem.
title: PSALMS

text: Na emumuyɛ ahempoma nnkɛtsena atseneneefo kyɛpɛn do; Amma atseneneefo anntsen hɔn nsa annka emumuyɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, ma onsi hɔn a wodzi w’asɛm do no yie, Na hɔn a wɔtsen wɔ hɔn akoma mu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Na hɔn a wɔman fa hɔn akwan kyew do dze, EWURADZE dze hɔn bɛka emumuyɛfo ho akɔ. Asomdwee mbra Israel do.
title: PSALMS

text: Aber a EWURADZE dze Zion fi ndɔmmum sanee bae no, Ɔyɛɛ hɛn dɛ adaaso.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na serew hyɛɛ hɛn afon ma, Na adwontow hyɛɛ hɛn gyirama do ma: Nna wɔkekaa no wɔ amanaman mu dɛ, EWURADZE ayɛ ndzɛmba akɛse ama hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, EWURADZE ayɛ ndzɛmba akɛse ama hɛn; Ntsi na hɛn enyi agye.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, fa hɛn fi ndɔmmum san bra, Dɛ mbrɛ edze nsu san ba ɔwora a awew mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔpe aba no nyinsuwa mu no, wɔdze ehurusi botwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, kaansa worusu wɔ ber a wokura aba esusudze no a, Wɔdze ehurusi bɛsan, ber a wɔdze no efiefi reba no.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ EWURADZE ennsi dan no a, Hɔn a worisi no wɔberɛ kwa: Sɛ EWURADZE annweɔn kurow no a, Ɔweɔmfo no si ho pe kwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Gyan ara na hom soɛr anapahema, na hom nngye hom ahom papa biara, adzesae ber mpo, Na hom berɛ ana hom enya edziban: Naaso, EWURADZE osiesie ma n’adɔfo, mpo wɔ ber a nna wɔadeda.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, mba yɛ akyɛdze a ofi EWURADZE hɔ: Na wɔyɛ nhyira mapa.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa katakyi ne nsamu egyen menaba tse no, Dɛmara na mberantsɛber mu mba tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔhomkanyi nye nyimpa a ɔahyɛ hɔn n’egyen kotoku ma; Na n’enyim nnkogu ase da, Ber a ɔnye atamfo bɛkasa wɔ baguamu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Osiarfo nye obiara a osuro EWURADZE, Na ɔnantsew n’akwan mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ibedzi wo nsaano edwuma: Ebɛyɛ ɔhomkanyi, na obesi wo yie.
title: PSALMS

text: Wo yer bɛyɛ dɛ wenyindua a ɔsow, wɔ wo fie adankyir: Wo mba botwa wo pon ho ehyia dɛ ngodua ntsetsɛwee.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, dɛm na wobesi ehyira Nyia osuro EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE fi Zion behyira wo: Na ibohu Jerusalɛm ne yieyɛ wo nkwa nda nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, ibohu wo mba hɔn mba. Asomdwee mbra Israel do.
title: PSALMS

text: Mber pii na woehiahia mo ho fitsi me mbofrase, Wɔmma Israel afei ɔnka;
title: PSALMS

text: Mber pii na woehiahia mo ho fitsi me mbafose: Naaso woenntum me.
title: PSALMS

text: Funtumfo no funtuum m’ekyir; Wɔyɛɛ hɔn aka atsentsen.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso EWURADZE yɛ tseneneenyi: Oetwitwa emumuyɛfo nhoma mu esinesin.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɔn a wɔtan Zion nyinara, Hɔn enyim ngu ase na wɔnsan hɔn ekyir.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma wɔnyɛ dɛ dan etsifi efuw, Onnwie nyin ana ɔahyew no a;
title: PSALMS

text: Dza otwafo no mmfa nnhyɛ ne nsa ma, Nkyii so efikyekyefo no mmfa mmboa no bo mu,
title: PSALMS

text: Na hɔn a wotwa mu so mpo nnka dɛ, EWURADZE ne nhyira mbra hom do no a. Yehyira hom wɔ EWURADZE ne dzin mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mifi ebun no mu na meka mu frɛ ɔwo, EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, tsie me ndze: Ma w’aso mbra Mo nkotoserɛ ndze do.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ ɔwo, EWURADZE, ritsin emumuyɛ do a, Nkyɛ, woana begyina?
title: PSALMS

text: Mbom ɔwo na fakyɛ wɔ w’afamu, Ama woeesuro wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Motweɔn EWURADZE, nyew, me kra tweɔn, Na n’asɛm do na m’enyi da.
title: PSALMS

text: Me kra tweɔn EWURADZE, Kyɛn aweɔmfo a wɔrotweɔn adzekyee; Nyew, ɔkyɛn aweɔmfo a wɔrotweɔn adzekyee.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Israel, ma w’enyi nda EWURADZE do, Na n’afamu na mbɔbɔrhu wɔ, Ne nkyɛn na nkwagye mbordo wɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔbɔpon Israel Efi n’emumuyɛ nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, m’akoma nnyɛ ahopɔw, eso m’enyiwa nntra no ntɔn; Eso mennantsew apɔmpɔmpɛ mu, Anaa ndzɛmba a wɔyɛ nwanwa dodow kyɛn me no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ampaara madwedwe me kra ma ɔayɛ foo; Dɛ ɔba a woetwa no enumfo a ɔwɔ ne na hɔ, Nyew, me kra tse dɛ ɔba a woetwa no enumfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Israel, ma w’enyi nda EWURADZE do Ofitsi aber yi dze kesi daapem.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, kaa David N’amandzehu nyinara ma no;
title: PSALMS

text: Mbrɛ ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ EWURADZE, Na ɔbɔɔ Jakob no Tumfo Kor no anohoba:
title: PSALMS

text: Ampaara, moronnkɔ me fie ntamadan mu, Eso morommfow nnkɔ me pia mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Meremma m’enyisoatsɛw nntɔ nkom, Eso merennda;
title: PSALMS

text: Ekodu dɛ mibenya beebi ama EWURADZE, Ntamadan ama Jakob no Tumfo Kor no.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, yɛkɛtsee no wɔ Efrata: Yekohun no wɔ kwaa mu haban mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Yɛbɔkɔ ne ntamadan mu; Yɛbɔkotow asɔr wɔ n’ananadzegua ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, soɛr kɔ w’ahomgyebea; Ɔwo, na w’ahoɔdzen adaka no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma w’asɔfoe mfa ndzeyɛtsenenee nhyɛ; Na ma w’ahotseweefo mbɔ ose ndzi ehurusi.
title: PSALMS

text: Osian w’akowaa David ntsi Mma nndan nyia asera no no enyi.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE aka ntam akyerɛ David nokwar mu a; Ɔrenndan mmfi ho: Wo honam mu aba bi na medze mibesi w’ahengua do.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ wo mba bedzi m’ahyɛmu Na me mbrasɛm a mebɛma hɔn no do a, Hɔn mba so bɛtsena w’ahengua do daa daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE asan mu eyi Zion; Ɔapɛ hɔ ayɛ ne tsenabea.
title: PSALMS

text: Iyi nye m’ahomgyebea daa: Ha na mebɛtsena; na mepɛ no dɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Mibehyira n’edzidzidze pii: Medze edziban bɛmee n’abɔbɔfo.
title: PSALMS

text: N’asɔfoe so medze nkwagye bɛhyɛ hɔn: Na n’ahotseweefo bɔbɔ ose kɛse edzi ehurusi.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔ na mebɛma ambɛn bi efir ama David: Mesiesie kandzea ama nyia masera no no.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze enyito bɛhyɛ n’atamfo: Na ɔnoara dze, n’ahenkyɛw bɛhyerɛn wɔ n’etsifi.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, mbrɛ odua ye na ɔyɛ fɛw Ma enuanom dɛ wɔbɔbɔ mu atsena koryɛ mu!
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtse dɛ aboɔdzen ngo a Wohuei guu Aaron n’apampamu, Osianee guu n’abɔdwesa mu; Na ɔsɔnee boguu n’atar no mbuano no do;
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtse dɛ Hermon ɔbɔsu a Osian bogu Zion mbepɔw do: Na hɔ na EWURADZE hyɛɛ nhyira no, Nyew, nkwa daapem no.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwɛ, hom nhyira EWURADZE, hom EWURADZE no nkowaa nyinara a Hom gyina EWURADZE fie anadwe.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mmema hom nsa do wɔ krɔnkrɔnyɛ mu, Na hom nhyira EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE mfi Zion nhyira wo; Ɔno a ɔyɛɛ sor na asaase no.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw, Hom nyi EWURADZE ne dzin ayɛw:
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, hom EWURADZE no nkowaa, Wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn ne fie abangua no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw; na EWURADZE ye: Hom ntow ayɛyindwom mma ne dzin; na oye dɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE asan mu eyi Jakob ama noho, Na ɔdze Israel ayɛ nara n’egyapadze soronko.
title: PSALMS

text: Na minyim dɛ EWURADZE yɛ kɛse, Na dɛ hɛn EWURADZE bɔ enyame nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Biribiara a EWURADZE pɛe no, ɔnoara na ɔayɛ, Wɔ ɔsor na asaase, wɔ po na ebun nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔma ehubɔhubɔw fi asaase ano fow sor; Ɔpaa enyinam ma nyankom tɔ; Ɔbɔ mframa fi n’adzekorabea mu fir.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno a okum Egypt mbakan, Nyimpa na mbowa dze nyina.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsomaa nsɛnkyerɛdze na anwanwadze baa ɔwo, Egypt, wo finimfin, Wɔ Farao na no nkowaa nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na ɔbobɔɔ amanaman akakraka, Na okunkum ahemfo akatakyi;
title: PSALMS

text: Amorifo hɔn hen Sihon. Na Basanhen Ɔge, Na Keenan ahenman nyinara:
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔdze hɔn asaase maa dɛ egyapadze, Dɛ egyapadze maa ne man Israel.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, wo dzin tsim hɔ daa; EWURADZE, wo nkaa du mbasantsen nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE bobu ne man bem, Na oenya ayamuhyehye ama no nkowaa.
title: PSALMS

text: Amanaman ehonyi yɛ dwetɛ na sika, Nyimpa nsaano edwuma a.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔwɔ ano, naaso wɔnnkasa; Wɔwɔ enyiwa, naaso wonnhu adze;
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔwɔ asowa, naaso wɔnntse asɛm; Eso ahom biara nnyi hɔn anomu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wɔyɛ hɔn no bɛyɛ dɛ hɔnara: Ampaara, obiara a ɔtwer hɔn no so.
title: PSALMS

text: Israel ne fifo, hom nhyira EWURADZE: Aaron ne fifo, hom nhyira EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Levi ne fifo, hom nhyira EWURADZE: Ao, Hom a hom suro EWURADZE, hom nhyira EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira mfi Zion nka EWURADZE, Ɔno a ɔtse Jerusalɛm. Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa ndaase mma EWURADZE; na oye: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa ndaase mma enyame mu Nyankopɔn no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa ndaase mma ewuranom EWURADZE no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia no nko yɛ anwanwadze akɛse no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ɔdze ntseasee yɛɛ ɔsorsor no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ɔdze asaase tserɛɛw esu no do no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ɔyɛɛ kan kɛse no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ewia dɛ ondzi adzekyee do: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Bosoom na nworaba dɛ wondzi adzesaa do: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ɔbobɔɔ Egyptfo hɔn mbakan: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na oyii Israel fii hɔn mu no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze nsa a ɔyɛ dzen, na basa a wɔatserɛw mu: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ɔpaa Mbɛw Po no mu ebien no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔmaa Israel twae no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Farao na no dɔm dze, ɔtoow hɔn guu Mbɛw Po no mu: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ɔgyee ne man duaa sar no do no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ɔbobɔɔ ahemfo akɛse no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na okunkum ahemfo a wɔayɛ atsenka no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Amorifo hɔn hen Sihon: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Basanhen Ɔge: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔdze hɔn asaase maa dɛ egyapadze: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Mekyerɛ egyapadze a ɔdze maa n’akowaa Israel: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyia ɔkaa hɛn wɔ hɛn ahobrɛadze asetsena mu no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔagye hɛn efi hɛn atamfo nsamu no: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔma honam nyinara edziban: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa ndaase mma sor Nyankopɔn: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Babilɔn esutsen no ho, Hɔ na yɛtsenae, nyew, yesui, Ber a yɛkaa Zion no.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔ esukɔnndua no do Na yɛdze hɛn nsankutsen sensɛnee.
title: PSALMS

text: Na hɔ na hɔn a wɔfaa hɛn ndɔmmum no bisaa hɛn hɔ ndwom, Na hɔn a wɔmaa yɛfɔnee no bisaa hɛn hɔ enyigye, dɛ, Hom ntow Zion ndwom kor nkyerɛ hɛn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛbɔtow EWURADZE no ndwom Wɔ ananabea?
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Jerusalɛm, sɛ mo werɛ fir wo a, Ma m’abanyimfa nngura wɔ mu ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma me tɛkyerɛma mfam m’anomu, Sɛ mannkaa wo a; Na sɛ mammpɛ Jerusalɛm Annkyɛn m’enyikadze tsitsir a.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, kaa Jerusalɛm da no Fa tsia Edommba no; Hɔn a wɔkaa dɛ, Wondwuruw no, wondwuruw no, Nkodu ne fapem do mpo no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, Babilɔn babaa a wɔrebɛsɛɛ wo; Nhyira nka nyia otua wo kaw Dɛ mbrɛ edze ayɛ hɛn no.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira nka nyia osuo wo nkɔkowaba mu Dze hɔn hwehwe ɔbotan no.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze m’akoma nyina bɛda wo ase, Ao EWURADZE: Abosom enyim mpo, mobɔtow ayɛyindwom ama wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔkotow asɔr wɔ w’asɔrfi krɔnkrɔn no afamu, Na medze ndaase ama wo dzin wɔ w’adɔyɛ na wo nokwardzi no ntsi: Na ɔwo ehuhor w’asɛm abɔ wo dzin nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: Da a musui frɛe no, ɔwo egyee me do, Ɔwo edze ahoɔdzen hyɛɛ me dzen wɔ me kra mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, asaase do ahemfo nyinara dze ndaase bɛma wo, Osiandɛ wɔatse w’anomu nsɛm.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyew, wɔbɔtow EWURADZE n’akwan no ho ndwom; Osiandɛ EWURADZE n’enyimnyam yɛ kɛse.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE yɛ okokroko dze, Naaso obu ahobrɛadzefo bi: Na ahopɔwfo dze onyim hɔn ekyirekyir.
title: PSALMS

text: Kaansa menam ɔfona mu mpo a, ebɛma me nkwa; Ɔwo ebɛtsen wo nsa wɔ m’atamfo hɔn ebufuw do, Na w’abanyimfa bɛgye me nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE bɛma dza ɔfa mo ho no edzi mu: EWURADZE, w’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa; Mma mmpow woara wo nsaano edwuma.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, ɔwo ahwehwɛ mo mu, na ehu me.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo inyim m’asetsena na mo soɛr, Ɔwo etse m’adwen ase kɔ ekyirekyir.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo epɛnsapɛnsa me nantsew na me nda mu, Na inyim m’akwan nyinara mu yie.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ansaana mebɛkasa no mpo, Hwɛ, EWURADZE, ɔwo inyim ne nyinara kwar.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo etwa ayer me wɔ m’ekyir na m’enyim, Na edze wo nsa ato mo do.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm nyimdzee yi ɔyɛ me nwanwa dodow; Ɔkrɔn, munntum menntse ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Henfa na mibefi wo sunsum enyim akɔ? Anaa henfa na mibefi w’enyim meguan akɔ?
title: PSALMS
