text: Sɛ mofow kɔ sor a, ewɔ hɔ: Sɛ mekɛsɛw me kɛtɛ wɔ samanadze a, hwɛ, ewɔ hɔ:
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ mefa anapa n’atsaban, Na mutu kɛtsena po ekyirekyir hɔ a;
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔ mpo wo nsa begya me kwan, Na w’abanyimfa esuo mo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ medɛ, Ampaara sum bɛkata mo do a, Ɔno dze, adzesaa mpo bɛdan kan etwa mo ho ehyia;
title: PSALMS

text: Sum mpo nnhuntsa wo, Na adzesaa yɛ kann dɛ adzekyee: Sum na kan nyina yɛ wo adze kor.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔwo na ebɔɔ mo mu ndzɛmba nyina: Ɔwo na eween me wɔ me na n’awotoa mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze ndaase bɛma wo; osiandɛ awanwakwan a ɔyɛ hu do na ayɛ me: Wo ndwuma yɛ nwanwa; Na me kra nyim ara yie.
title: PSALMS

text: Mo frɔdɔɔ ennhuntsa wo, Ber a wɔyɛɛ me wɔ ehuntsae mu, Na wɔween me nwanwa mu wɔ asaase ase noho noho no.
title: PSALMS

text: W’enyiwa hun me ber a meyɛ bɔgyatɔw nko no, Na me mfafakuwa nyinara wɔakyerɛw no wɔ wo nwoma no mu, Na nda dodow a wɔahyehyɛ ama me no, Naaso na no mu biara nnyae mmbae.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Nyankopɔn, mbrɛ w’adwen dua som me bo so a! Mbrɛ no dodow ano dua dɔɔ so a!
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ merekan a, no dodow ano dɔɔ so sen anhwea: Minyan a, meda ho wɔ wo nkyɛn ara.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, ampaara ɔwo boku emumuyɛfo: Dɛm ntsi hom bɔgyakafo, hom mfi me nkyɛn mfi.
title: PSALMS

text: Na wɔkasa tsia wo emumuyɛ mu, Na w’atamfo bɔ wo dzin gyangyan.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, ana minnkyir hɔn a wokyir wo? Na mo werɛ nnhow hɔn a wɔsoɛr tsia wo no?
title: PSALMS

text: Mikyir hɔn yerɛyerɛyerɛw: Mubu hɔn m’atamfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Nyankopɔn, pɛnsapɛnsa mo mu, na hu m’akoma mu: Sɔ me hwɛ, na hu m’adwendwen:
title: PSALMS

text: Na hwɛ, sɛ emumuyɛ kwan bi wɔ mo mu a, Na gya me fa daa kwan no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, gye me fi nyimpa mumuyɛnyi no ne nsa; Kora mo do fi nyimpa kakaben no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn a wosusu ewurkadze wɔ hɔn akoma mu; Na daa nyina na wɔka ɔko do no.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔasew hɔn tɛkyerɛma dɛ ɔwɔ; Ehurutsia bɔr wɔ hɔn se ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, sie me fi omumuyɛnyi no ne nsamu; Kora mo do fi nyimpa kakaben no ho: Hɔn a woesua dɛ wobosun m’anamɔn akyen.
title: PSALMS

text: Ahopɔwfo dze efir ehuntsa me, ɔnye nhoma; Wɔatserɛw eboa mu wɔ ɔkwan nkyɛn; Woesua me apamfir.
title: PSALMS

text: Mese EWURADZE dɛ, Ɔwo nye me Nyankopɔn: Yɛ aso ma mo nkotoserɛ ndze, EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, mo wura, mo nkwagye n’ahoɔdzen, Ɔwo na akata me tsir do wɔ nkoda mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, mma omumuyɛnyi nnya n’apɛdze; Mma no mbusu tsirmpɔw no nnkɔ do; bɛyɛ na wɔremema hɔnho do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na hɔn a wotwa mo ho hyia hɔn etsifi dze, Ma hɔnankasa hɔn anofamfa mbusu mbua hɔn do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ogyansenama ngu hɔn do: Ma wɔntow hɔn ngu gya mu; Amona dɔnkuronn mu, ma wɔnnkɔsoɛr bio.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔnnkɛma tɛkyerɛma bɛrbɛrnyi no atsena asaase do: Mbusu betsiw nyimpa kakaben no ebutuw no.
title: PSALMS

text: Minyim dɛ EWURADZE bedzi amandzehunyi n’asɛm, Na ɔdze ohianyi ne bemdzi ama no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ampaara atseneneefo dze ndaase bɛma wo dzin: Tɔɔtsenyɛfo bɛtsena w’enyim.
title: PSALMS

text: Musu frɛ wo, Ao EWURADZE; yɛ ntsɛm boa me: Musu frɛ wo a, yɛ aso ma me ndze.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma me mpaayi mbesi w’enyim dɛ eduhuam; Na me nsa a mama do no dɛ ewimbir afɔrbɔdze.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, fa ɔweɔmfo besi m’ano; Na hwɛ m’anofamfa abow no ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma nndan m’akoma nnkɔ ebusudze bi ho, Dɛ menye nyimpa a wɔyɛ emumuyɛ Bɔbɔ emumuyɛ bra: Na mma minndzi hɔn adɔkɔdɔkɔdze bi.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma ɔtseneneenyi mbɔ me, anaa ɔntsea me wɔ ayamuyie mu; Ɔbɛyɛ tsir do ngo a me tsir rommpow; Na emumuyɛfo ngosera dze, mikyir: Osiandɛ mokɔ do ara bɔ mpaa tsia hɔn ndzeyɛbɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ wosun hɔn atsɛmbufo hwe abotan nkyɛn a; Na wobetsie me nsɛm; na woehu ɔyɛ dɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ obi funtum asaase na ɔpaapaa mu no, Dɛmara na wɔdze hɛn mbiew apetse nda ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Naaso ɔwo na m’enyi da wo do, Ao, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn: Wo mu na medze mo werɛ hyɛ; mma nnto me kra prododo.
title: PSALMS

text: Sie me fi efir a woesua me no ho, Na emumuyɛfo apamfir no ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma emumuyɛfo ntɔ hɔnankasa hɔn mboa mu, Aber a emi dze mutwa mu kɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Medze me ndze su frɛ EWURADZE; Me ndze na medze yɛ nkotoserɛ ma EWURADZE.
title: PSALMS

text: Muhue mo nkɔmbɔ gu n’enyim; Meda mo fona edzi kyerɛ no.
title: PSALMS

text: Sɛ mo sunsum tɔ bitsi wɔ mo mu a, ɔwo na ekyerɛ dza menyɛ. Ɔkwan a menam do no na woesua efir ehuntsa me.
title: PSALMS

text: Mohwɛɛ m’enyimfa mohwɛe; na nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ a onyim me: Guandɔbea abɔ me; nyimpa biara nndwen mo ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, ɔwo na musu frɛ wo; Mese dɛ, Ɔwo nye mo guandɔbea, Me kyɛfa wɔ atseasefo asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: Kyɛn aso wɔ mo su do; na wɔabrɛ me adze dodow: Gye me fi m’ahohiahiafo nsa; na hɔn ho yɛ dzen sen me.
title: PSALMS

text: Yi me kra fi efiadze pue, ma medze ndaase ama wo dzin: Atseneneefo botwa mo ho ehyia; Osiandɛ ɔwo enye me bedzi no yie.
title: PSALMS

text: Tsie me mpaabɔ; Ao EWURADZE, yɛ aso ma mo nkotoserɛ: Gye me do wɔ wo nokwardzi na wo tsenenee mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na mma mmfa w’akowaa nnkɔ atsɛmbu mu; Na ɔwo w’enyim ɔtseasefo biara rinndzi bem.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔtamfo no ahaw me kra; Ɔabɔ mo nkwa ahwe famu: Ɔama matsena sum mbeambea do dɛ hɔn a woewu akyɛr.
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛm ntsi mo sunsum atɔ bitsi wɔ mo mu; M’akoma ayɛ ankonam wɔ mo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Mekaa tsetse nda no; Modwendwen wo ndzeyɛe nyinara ho: Mususu wo nsaano edwuma ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Mema me nsa do kyerɛ wo: Wo ho sukɔm dze me kra, dɛ asaase a oetwie.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, yɛ ntsɛm gye me do; m’ahom repa: Mma nnyi w’enyim nnhuntsa me ae; Bɛyɛ na mayɛ dɛ hɔn a wosian kɔ adakamona mu no.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma mentse w’adɔyɛ nka anapa; Na ɔwo na motwer wo: Ma munhu akwan a ɔsɛ dɛ menantsew do; Na ɔwo na mema me kra do ma wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao, EWURADZE, gye me fi m’atamfo nsa: Muguan toa wo dɛ fa me huntsa.
title: PSALMS

text: Kyerɛkyerɛ me ma menyɛ wo pɛ; na ɔwo nye me Nyankopɔn: Ma wo sunsum akwankyerɛ pa no ngya me mfa tsenenee asaase do.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, gye me nkwa wɔ wo dzin ntsi: Yi me kra fi ɔfona mu wɔ wo ndzeyɛtsenenee mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Na twa m’atamfo gu wɔ w’adɔyɛ mu, Na sɛɛ hɔn a wohiahia me kra ho nyinara; Osiandɛ meyɛ w’akowaa.
title: PSALMS

text: Nhyira nka EWURADZE mo botan, Ɔno a ɔkyerɛkyerɛ me nsa na nsatseaba akodzi,
title: PSALMS

text: M’adɔyɛ, na m’akoban, M’abantsentsen na me gyefo; Me kyɛm, na nyia motwer no; Ɔno a ɔbrɛ me man adze hyɛ m’ase.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, ɔdasanyi nye woana, na ɔwo edwen no do yi? Anaa ɔdasanyi ne ba, na ɔwo ibu no bi yi?
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdasanyi tse dɛ ehuhuw: Ne nda tse dɛ nwinwin a ɔresen.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao EWURADZE, kontom wo sorsor, na si famu: Keka mbepɔw, na wobopun wusiw.
title: PSALMS

text: Paapaa asenaman, na pansam hɔn; Totow w’egyen menaba na bɔ hɔn
title: PSALMS

text: To wo nsa fi sor; Hwim me, na gye me fi esu akɛse mu, Fi ananaben nsamu;
title: PSALMS

text: Hɔn na hɔn ano ka nsɛnhun, Na hɔn abanyimfa yɛ ator abanyimfa.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔtow ndwom fofor ama wo, Ao, Nyankopɔn: Medze nsankutsen a no do nhoma du mobɔtow ayɛyindwom ama wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo a edze nkwagye ma ahemfo: Na egye w’akowaa David fi afona ndam ndam no ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Hwim me, na gye me fi ananaben nsamu, Hɔn a hɔn ano ka nsɛnhun, Na hɔn abanyimfa yɛ ator abanyimfa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɛn mbabanyin hɔn mberantsɛber nyɛ dɛ atsɛndua a woenyin yie; Na hɛn mbabaa nyɛ kutuwdo abo a wɔasen no ahemfie dze no saso;
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɛn asan nyeyɛ amaama a ɔma adze horow nyinara; Ma hɛn nguan nwowo mpempem na pedu pedu wɔ hɛn haban mu;
title: PSALMS

text: Ma hɛn anantwi nya apɔwmudzen; Mma wɔmmpon yafun anaa wɔnnyɛ asaa, Ma osu nkekamu biara mmba hɛn abrɔn mu;
title: PSALMS

text: Esiarfo nye ɔman a wɔtse dɛm asetsena yi mu: Ampaara esiarfo nye ɔman a EWURADZE yɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Mobɔtonton wo, me Nyankopɔn, me hen; Na mehyira wo dzin daa daa daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Daa nyina na mibehyira wo; Na meyi wo dzin ayɛw daa daa daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔkɛse nye EWURADZE, na ɔsɛ ayɛyi ntrado; Na n’akɛseyɛ mu yɛ hwehwɛna.
title: PSALMS

text: Mbasantsen kor bɛkamfo wo ndwuma akyerɛ kor so, Na wɔaka w’akatakyi ndzeyɛɛ akyerɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: W’enyidzii n’enyimnyam tum no, Na w’anwanwa ndwuma no, na mobɔdwendwen ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Na adasa keka wo ndzeyɛɛ a ɔyɛ hu no tum no ho asɛm; Na emi dze mebɛka w’akɛseyɛ akyerɛ.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔbɔtoa wo papayɛ kɛse ne nkaa no ho atsɛn, Na wɔatow wo ndzeyɛtsenenee ho ndwom.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE yɛ adom, na mbɔbɔrhu ahyɛ no ma; Ɔfa ebufuw nyaa, na n’adɔyɛ so.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE ye ma nyimpa nyinara, Na n’ayamuhyehye wɔ no ndwuma nyinara do.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE, wo ndwuma nyinara dze ndaase bɛma wo; Na w’ahotseweefo behyira wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔbɛka w’ahendzi n’enyimnyam no ho asɛm, Na wɔabɔ wo tum dzin.
title: PSALMS

text: Ma adasamba eehu w’akatakyi ndzeyɛɛ, Na w’ahendzi no tum n’enyimnyam no.
title: PSALMS

text: W’ahendzi yɛ ɔdomankoma ahendzi, Na w’ahenman wɔ hɔ mbasantsen nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE wowaw hɔn a wɔhwe ase nyinara, Na ɔma hɔn a wɔbrɛ adze do.
title: PSALMS

text: Enyiwaenyiwa nyinara hwɛ wo kwan; Na ɔwo ema hɔn hɔn edziban wɔ n’aber ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔwo ibue wo nsamu, Na ema atseasefo nyinara nya hɔn akɔndɔdze mee.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE tsen wɔ n’akwan nyinara mu, Na ɔyɛ adom wɔ no ndwuma nyinara mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE bɛn hɔn a wɔfrɛ no nyinara, Hɔn a wosu frɛ no nokwar mu nyinara.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔbɛma hɔn a wosuro no no hɔn apɛdze ayɛ hɔ; Obetsie hɔn nkekamu so na ɔagye hɔn nkwa.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE kora hɔn a wɔdɔ no nyinara do, Na emumuyɛfo nyinara dze, ɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: M’ano bɛka EWURADZE n’ayɛyi; Na wɔmma honam nyinara nhyira ne dzin krɔnkrɔn no daa daa daa.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw. Ao me kra, yi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Metse ase yi, mibeyi EWURADZE ayɛw: Mobɔtow ayɛyindwom mama me Nyankopɔn, ber a metse nkwa mu yi.
title: PSALMS

text: Mma hom mmfa hom werɛ nnhyɛ ahemfo mu, Anaa ɔdasanyi ne ba a mboa bi nnyi no mu no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: N’ahom fi mu kɔ, ɔsan kɔ ne dɛtse mu; Da no ara na ne tsirmu nsɛm ayɛ gyan.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔhomkanyi nye nyia ɔwɔ Jakob ne Nyankopɔn dɛ no boafo, Nyia n’enyidado wɔ EWURADZE ne Nyankopɔn mu:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno a ɔyɛɛ ɔsor na asaase, Po na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara; Ɔno a osie nokwar daa:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno a obua atsɛn ma hɔn a wodzi hɔn emim; Ɔno a ɔdze edziban ma hɔn a ɔkɔm dze hɔn: EWURADZE tu adaduafo dua mu.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE bue enyifurafo hɔn enyiwa; EWURADZE ma hɔn a wɔabrɛ adze do; EWURADZE dɔ atseneneefo;
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE kora ananaben do; Ɔwowaw ngyanka na ekunafo; Na emumuyɛfo kwan dze ɔdan no butuw.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE bedzi hen daa, Ao Zion, wo Nyankopɔn bedzi hen ekodu mbasantsen nyinara do. Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw; Na oye dɛ wɔtow ayɛyindwom ma hɛn Nyankopɔn; Na ɔyɛ enyigye, na ayɛyi yɛ fɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE na ɔkyekyer Jerusalɛm; Ɔno na ɔpon Israelfo a wɔapetse boa ano.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsa hɔn a hɔn akoma ebubu yarba, Na ɔkyekyer hɔn ekur.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔkyerɛ nworaba hɔn dodow ano; Ɔtoto hɔn nyinara edzin.
title: PSALMS

text: Hɛn EWURADZE yɛ kɛse, na tum mu ɔkatakyi; Ne ntseasee nnyi mbanano.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE wowaw abrɛfo: Ɔno na ɔdze emumuyɛfo hwe famu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa ndaase ntow ndwom mma EWURADZE; Hom ntow ayɛyindwom wɔ nsankutsen do mma hɛn Nyankopɔn:
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno a ɔdze mununkum kata sor, Ɔno a osiesie nyankom ma asaase, Ɔno a ɔma nkyɛkyɛr fifir mbepɔw do.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔdze abowa n’edziban ma no, Na nkonkoranmba a wosu no.
title: PSALMS

text: N’enyi nngye ɔpɔnkɔ n’ahoɔdzen mu: Onnya enyigye wɔ ɔdasanyi n’akokodur ho.
title: PSALMS

text: EWURADZE n’enyi gye hɔn a wosuro no no mu; Hɔn a hɔn enyi da no mbɔbɔrhu do no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ao Jerusalɛm, yi EWURADZE ayɛw; Ao Zion, yi wo Nyankopɔn ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔahyɛ w’aponkɛse n’adaban no dzen; Oehyira wo mba a wɔwɔ wo mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔma wo ntoaado dwe; Ɔdze ewifua pa mee wo.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsoma ne mbrasɛm ba asaase do; N’asɛm tu mbirika harhar.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔma esukwankyɛba dɛ kuntu fufuw; Ɔpetse ɔbɔsu daa dɛ nso,
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔtow n’esubo gu dɛ ntrɔma: Woana botum n’awɔw enyim gyina?
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔsoma n’asɛm, na ɔnan hɔn: Ɔma ne mframa bɔ, na esu pem.
title: PSALMS

text: Oyi n’asɛm kyerɛ Jakob, Ne mbra na n’atsɛmbu kyerɛ Israel.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔnnye ɔman biara nndzii no dɛm da: Na n’atsɛmbu dze, wonnhunii. Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw. Hom mfi sorsor nyi EWURADZE ayɛw: Hom nyi no ayɛw wɔ wimu noho noho.
title: PSALMS

text: N’abɔfoe nyinara, hom nyi no ayɛw: No dɔm nyinara, hom nyi no ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Ewia na bosoom, hom nyi no ayɛw: Hom kan na nworaba nyinara, hom nyi no ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom sorsor no sorsor, hom nyi no ayɛw, Na hom esuesu a wɔwɔ sorsor n’etsifi.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma wonyi EWURADZE ne dzin ayɛw: Na ɔno na ɔhyɛe, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn.
title: PSALMS

text: Ɔno na ɔdze hɔn etsintsim hɔ so daa daa daa. Ɔahyɛ mbra a orunntwa mu nnkɔ.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfi asaase do nyi EWURADZE ayɛw, Hom mbonso, na ebun nyinara:
title: PSALMS

text: Ogya na sorbo, esukwankyɛba na ehubɔhubɔw; Ehum dzendzen a ɔhyɛ n’asɛm ma:
title: PSALMS

text: Nkokwaa na akoko nyinara; Nduaber na ndupɔn nyinara:
title: PSALMS

text: Hambowa na fiembowa nyinara; Aweaweambowa na tumbowa:
title: PSALMS

text: Asaase do ahemfo na aman nyinara; Ebirɛmpɔn na atsɛmbuafo a wɔwɔ asaase do nyinara:
title: PSALMS

text: Mberantsɛ na mbabaawa; Nkɔdaa na mbofraba:
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma wonyi EWURADZE ne dzin ayɛw; Na ne dzin nkotsee na ɔkrɔn: N’enyimnyam bɔ asaase na sor do.
title: PSALMS

text: Na ɔama ambɛn do ama ne man, N’ahotseweefo nyinara hɔn ayɛyi; Mekyerɛ Israelmba, ɔman a wɔbɛn no no. Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw. Hom ntow ndwom fofor mma EWURADZE, Na n’ayɛyi wɔ n’ahotseweefo ehyiadzi no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma Israel ndzi ehurusi wɔ nyia ɔyɛɛ no no mu: Wɔmma Zionmba hɔn enyi ngye hɔn Hen ho.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma wɔmfa asaw nyi ne dzin ayɛw: Wɔmma wɔmfa mpintsin na nsankutsen ntow n’ayɛyindwom.
title: PSALMS

text: Na EWURADZE n’enyi ka ne man ho: Ɔdze nkwagye bɛhyehyɛ abrɛfo.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma ahotseweefo nhyehyɛ hɔnho wɔ enyimnyam mu: Wɔmma wɔntow enyigye ndwom wɔ hɔn mpa do.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma Nyankopɔn n’ayɛyi a ɔkrɔn ntsena hɔn anomu, Na afona anofanu nkitsa hɔn nsamu;
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ wɔdze bedzi amanaman wer, Na wɔdze atsea aman;
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ wɔdze nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn bɛkyekyer hɔn ahemfo, Na wɔdze dadze mpokyerɛ atoto hɔn etsitsir;
title: PSALMS

text: Dɛ wɔdze atsɛmbu a wɔakyerɛw no bobu hɔn: Enyidzi yi na n’ahotseweefo nyinara wɔ. Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw. Hom nyi Nyankopɔn ayɛw wɔ no krɔnkrɔnbea: Hom nyi no ayɛw wɔ no tum wi no mu.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyi no ayɛw wɔ n’akatakyi ndzeyɛɛ ntsi: Hom nyi no ayɛw dɛ mbrɛ n’akɛseyɛ nwanwa no tse.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa akasamu ndze nyi no ayɛw: Hom mfa bɛnta na nsankutsen nyi no ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom mfa mpintsin na asaw nyi no ayɛw: Hom mfa nhoma nsanku na atɛntɛbɛn nyi no ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Hom nyi no ayɛw wɔ akasaa a ne ndze so do: Hom nyi no ayɛw wɔ akasaa a ɔgyegye dzendzen do.
title: PSALMS

text: Wɔmma adze biara a ogu ahom no nyi EWURADZE ayɛw. Hom nyi EWURADZE ayɛw.
title: PSALMS

text: Israelhen Solomon, David ne ba no, ne mbɛbusɛm:
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ wɔmfa nhu nyansa na nkyerɛkyerɛ; Dɛ wɔmfa nhu ntseasee nsɛm mu;
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ wɔmfa nya nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ enyansadze mu, Wɔ ntseasee na atsɛmbu na nsɛntsenenee mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ wɔmfa nkyerɛ atsetsekwaa enyitsew, Dɛ wɔmfa mma aberantsɛ nyimdzee na adwenmutsewee:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ama onyansafo eetsie, na n’adzesua akɔ sor; Na onyimdzefo dze eenya apam pa:
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ wɔmfa nhu abɛbusɛm na akasabɛbu, Enyansafo nsɛm, na hɔn mbrɔme mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE ho suro nye nyimdzee n’ahyɛse: Na nkwasea dze, wobu nyansa na nkyerɛkyerɛ enyimtsia.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, tsie w’egya ne nkyerɛkyerɛ, Na mma mmpow wo na ne mbra.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na wɔbɛyɛ enyimnyam abɔtsir ama wo tsir, Na wo kɔn mu ntweaban.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, sɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo daadaa wo a, Mma mmpen do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ wɔ dɛ, Bra ma yɛnkɔ, Ma yenkotu nhyɛ anokwafo do, Nyia odzi bem no, ma yɛnkɛtsɛw no kwa;
title: PROVERBS

text: Ma yɛnkɛmemen hɔn enyikan dɛ samanadze, Na emudzifo no, dɛ hɔn a wosian kɔ adakamona mu;
title: PROVERBS

text: Na yebenya adze a ɔsom bo nyina, Yɛdze asadze bɛhyehyɛ hɛn adan amaama;
title: PROVERBS

text: Bra, fa woho bɔbɔ hɛnho; Na hɛn nyinara yebenya foto kor a:
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, mma nnye hɔn ntu kwan; Twe w’anan fi hɔn kwan do:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na hɔn anan tu mbirika kɔ mbusu mu, Na hɔn ho yɛ har ka bɔgya gu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na kwa ara na wosua efir, Wɔ anoma biara enyim:
title: PROVERBS

text: Woyinom ara wohue hɔnankasa hɔn bɔgyaa gu, Wɔtsɛw hɔnankasa hɔn nkwa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛm na obiara a ɔpɛ edzifodze n’akwan tse; Oyi ewuranom hɔn nkwa fi hɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyansa tseatsea mu dzendzen wɔ ɔbrɔn do: Ɔbɔ ne ndze mu wɔ papratamu;
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkeka mu wɔ guado; Nkuropon ano, Kuropɔn no mu, na ɔka ne nsɛm dɛ:
title: PROVERBS

text: Dabɛn ara na hom, ntsetsekwaa, hom bɛpɛ ntsetsekwaadze ekodu? Na atwetwesifo enyi bɛgye atwetwesi mu, Na nkwasea bekyir nyimdzee?
title: PROVERBS

text: Hom ndan homho mma me nkaenyim: Hom nhwɛ, mubohue mo sunsum ama hom, Mebɛda me nsɛm edzi akyerɛ hom.
title: PROVERBS

text: Osiandɛ mafrɛ na hom apow; Matsen me nsamu, na nyimpa biara ammfa annyɛ hwee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na hom ebu m’apam nyina adze gyangyan, Na hom ammfa me nkaenyim biara annyɛ hwee;
title: PROVERBS

text: Emi so mebɛserew wɔ hom mbusu da no mu; Da a hom suro bɛba no, mibesi hom atwetwe;
title: PROVERBS

text: Da a hom suro bɛba dɛ ehum, Na hom mbusu bɛba dɛ ekyinehyia mframa, Da a ahohia na ahokyer bɛba hom do no a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔno na wobosu afrɛ me, na munnkobua; Wɔbɔhwehwɛ me anapahema, na wonnkohu me:
title: PROVERBS

text: Osiandɛ wokyiir nyimdzee, Na wɔannsan mu ennyi Nyankopɔn ho suro ntsi:
title: PROVERBS

text: Wɔammfa n’apam biara annyɛ hwee; Wobuu ne nkaenyim nyina enyimtsia:
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛm ntsi wobedzi hɔnankasa hɔn kwan do aba, Na hɔnankasa hɔn nhyehyɛɛ amee hɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na mbatam hɔn ekyirsan boku hɔn, Na nkwasea hɔn prɔmprɔmyɛ asɛɛ hɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na obiara a obetsie me no dze, ɔbɛtsena hɔ sɔkyee, Na no ho adwe no dɛ onnkosuro mbusu biara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, sɛ ibetsie me nsɛm, Na edze me mbrasɛm sie wo nkyɛn;
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ ebɛkyɛn w’aso ama nyansa, Dɛ edze w’akoma bɛma ntseasee;
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyew, sɛ isu frɛ nhumu, Na ema wo ndze do frɛ ntseasee;
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ ehwehwɛ no dɛ dwetɛ, Na ebɔr hwehwɛ no dɛ akoradze a ohuntsa a;
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔno na ebɛtse Nyankopɔn no ho suro ase, Na ehu Nyankopɔn no ho nyimdzee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Osiandɛ EWURADZE na ɔma nyansa; N’anomu na nyimdzee na ntseasee fi ba:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkora nyansa mapa do ma tɔɔtsenyɛfo, Ɔyɛ kyɛm ma hɔn a wɔnantsew emudzi mu;
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ ɔbɔweɔn atsɛmbu akwan, Na ɔakora n’ahotseweefo kwan do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔno na ebɛtse ndzeyɛtsenenee na atsɛmbu ase. Nsɛntsenenee, nyew, ɔkwan pa nyina so.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na nyansa bɛhɛn w’akoma mu, Na nyimdzee ayɛ wo kra fɛw;
title: PROVERBS

text: Adwenmutsewee bɔweɔn wo, Ntseasee bɔkora wo do:
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ obeyi wo efi mbusu kwan mu, Na nyimpa a wɔka nsɛm akɔntɔnkye ho;
title: PROVERBS

text: Nye hɔn a wɔpow akwan tsenenee, Na mbom wɔnantsew sum akwan mu;
title: PROVERBS

text: Hɔn a wɔbɔ mbusu no dzi ho ehurusi, Na hɔn enyi gye mbusu akɔntɔnkyesɛm ho;
title: PROVERBS

text: Hɔn a wɔkyeakyea wɔ hɔn akwan mu, Na wɔdandan hɔn akwan enyi:
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ obeyi wo efi ɔbaa sansanyi no ne nsamu, Mekyerɛ ɔsansanyi a ɔka adɔkɔdɔkɔsɛm no ne nsamu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔno a ɔpa ne nkataasiaber mu kun, Na no werɛ fir ne Nyankopɔn ahyɛmu:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ne fi kom kɔ owu mu, Na n’akwan kɔ ewufo mu:
title: PROVERBS

text: Obi nnkɔ ne nkyɛn nnsan mmba, Eso wonnkodu nkwa akwan mu:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ama aanantsew nyimpa papa kwan do, Na eesie atseneneefo akwan.
title: PROVERBS

text: Osiandɛ tɔɔtsenyɛfo bɛtsena asaase no do, Na hɔn a wodzi mu bɛka mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na emumuyɛfo dze, wobotwa hɔn efi asaase no do, Na hɔn a wotwa nkontompɔ no, wobotutu hɔn ase koraa efi do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, mma wo werɛ mmfir me mbra; Na ma w’akoma ndzi me mbrasɛm do:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na nda tsentsen, na nkwa mfe, Na asomdwee, na wɔdze bɛka wo ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mma adɔyɛ na nokwardzi mmpar wo: Fa hyɛ wo kɔn; Kyerɛw no wɔ w’akoma pon do:
title: PROVERBS

text: Nna ibenya enyimpa na atsenka pa Wɔ Nyankopɔn na nyimpa enyim.
title: PROVERBS

text: Fa wo werɛ nyina hyɛ EWURADZE mu, Na mma nntwer wankasa wo ntseasee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Fa w’akwan nyinara hyɛ ne nsa, Na ɔno na ɔbɛkyerɛ wo kwan.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnyɛ wankasa w’enyiwa do onyansafo; Suro EWURADZE, na yi mbusu akwa:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbɛyɛ nkwa ama wo funuma, Na ehuon ama wo mbiew.
title: PROVERBS

text: Fa w’ahodze hyɛ EWURADZE enyimnyam, Ɔnye wo ndɔbaa nyinara mu nduadzewakan no;
title: PROVERBS

text: Nna w’asan bɛhyehyɛ amaama, Na wo nsatwer mu nsa fofor bobu do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, mma mmbu EWURADZE ne ntsea enyimtsia; Eso mma ne nkaenyim mmfon wo:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na nyia EWURADZE dɔ no no na ɔka n’enyim; Dɛ mbrɛ egya ka ɔba a ɔdɔ no no n’enyim no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Osiarfo nye nyimpa a ohu nyansa, Na nyimpa a onya ntseasee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na n’eguadze ye kyɛn dwetɛ n’eguadze, Na ne mfaso kyɛn sika mapa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔsom bo kyɛn mbota: Na ndzɛmba a wo kɔn bɔdɔ mu biara wɔmmfa nnto ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nda tsentsen wɔ ne nsa nyimfa mu; Ne nsa bankum mu wɔ ahonya na enyidzi.
title: PROVERBS

text: N’atsempɔn yɛ atsempɔn a ɔyɛ fɛw, Na n’akwan nyinara asomdwee a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔyɛ nkwa dua ma hɔn a wosuo no mu: Na osiarfo nye obiara a ɔkora no.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE dze nyansa hyɛɛ asaase ase; Ɔdze ntseasee dze ɔsorsor tsintsiim hɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ne nyimdzee do na esubun no mu paapaae, Na wimu sosɔw ɔbɔnsu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, fa nyansa mapa na adwenmutsewee sie; Na mma mma wɔnndan mmfi w’enyiwa do;
title: PROVERBS

text: Nna wɔbɛyɛ nkwa ama wo kra, Na enyimnyam ama wo kɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔno na ebɛnantsew wo kwan do sɔkyee, Na w’anamɔn nnkefintsiw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ ekɛda a, innkosuro: Nyew, ebɛda, na wo nda bɛyɛ wo dɛw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnsuro awerɛfir mu ehuyi, Anaaso emumuyɛfo hɔn sɛɛe, wɔ aber a ɔbɛba:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na EWURADZE bɛyɛ w’awerɛhyɛmu, Na obesie w’anan efi ɔkyer mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mmfa yieyɛ nnkam nyia odzi wɔ no, Ber a ewɔ wɔ wo nsamu dɛ ibotum yɛ no,
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnse wo nyɛnko dɛ, Kɔ, ana aba bio, Na ɔkyena na medze bɛma wo; Ber a ewɔ adze no wɔ wo nkyɛn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nndwendwen mbusu nntsia wo nyɛnko, Ber a ɔnye wo tse hɔ dwudwoodwo yi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnye nyimpa biara nndzi aper kwa, Ber a ɔmmbɔɔ wo mbusu biara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma w’enyi mmber nyimpa otsirmɔdzenfo no, Na mma nnsan mu nnyi n’akwan no mu biara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi no yɛ ekyiwadze ma EWURADZE: Na mbom ɔnye atseneneefo dzi etsirmsɛm.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE no ndom wɔ emumuyɛfo fi mu; Na ohyira Ndzeyɛtsenenee tsenabea.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ampaara, osi atwetwesifo atwetwe, Na ɔma ahobrɛadzefo adom.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyansafo benya enyimnyam dɛ egyapadze; Na nkwasea dze, enyimguase bɛyɛ hɔn ntodo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me mba, hom ntsie hom egya ne nkyerɛkyerɛ, Na hom nyɛ aso nhu ntseasee:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na mema hom nkyerɛkyerɛ pa; Ntsi mma hom mmpow me mbra.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na aber a meyɛ abɔdomaba no, Ɔbabanyin na ɔdɔba kor ma me na na m’egya no,
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ me, na ɔsee me dɛ, Ma w’akoma nsuo me nsɛm mu; Dzi me mbrasɛm do, na nya nkwa:
title: PROVERBS

text: Nya nyansa, nya ntseasee; Mma wo werɛ mmfir, eso mma mmfi m’anomu kasa ho:
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mmpow no, na ɔbɔkora wo do; Dɔ no, na ɔdze wo besie.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyansa nye adze tsitsir; dɛm ntsi nya nyansa. Nyew, dza enya nyinara ekyir, nya ntseasee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Huhor no, na ɔbɛma wo do: Sɛ eyɛ no etuu a, ɔbɛhyɛ wo enyimnyam.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdze enyimnyam abɔtsir bɔbɔ wo tsir: Abɔtsir fɛɛfɛw na ɔdze bɛma wo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ao, me ba, tsie, na gye me nsɛm; Na wo nkwa ne mfe adɔɔ so.
title: PROVERBS

text: Makyerɛkyerɛ wo nyansa ɔtsempɔn do, Magye wo afa akwan tsenn do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ enantsew nokwar mu a, w’anamɔn nnkɛkyer wo; Na itu mbirika so a, innkefintsiw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Suo nkyerɛkyerɛ mu dzendzen; mma nngyaa no: Fa no sie; na wo nkwa ara nye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnhɛn emumuyɛfo kwan mu, Na mma nnantsew mbusubɔfo kwan mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Yi no akwa, mma nntwa mu wɔ ho; Fi ho fi, na twa mu kɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na wɔnnda, gyedɛ wɔabɔ mbusu ana; Na wɔagye hɔn nsamu nda, gyedɛ wɔama obi ahwe ase ana.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na wodzi emumuyɛdze edziban, Na wɔnom emimdzi nsa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na atseneneefo kwan dze, ɔtse dɛ kan hyɛnhyɛn a Ɔhyerɛn mbordo araa kodu ewia ketee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emumuyɛfo kwan tse dɛ sum: Wofintsiw, naaso wonnhu dza wofintsiw do no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, tsie me nsɛm; Kyɛn w’aso ma me kasaa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma ommfi w’enyiwa do; Fa sie w’akoma mu tɔnn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ɔyɛ nkwa ma hɔn a wohu, Na apɔwmudzen ma hɔn honam nyinara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Fa mbɔdzen nyinara kora w’akoma do; Na no mu na nkwa pue fi ba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Yi ano kɔntɔnkye fi wo ho, Na ma nkontompɔ ano mfi wo nkyɛn nkɔ ekyir.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ma w’enyiwa nhwɛ w’enyim kan ara, Na ma w’enyisoatsɛw ntsim w’enyim ara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Taataa w’anamɔn pɛpɛɛpɛr, Na ma w’akwan nyinara ntsim.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nndan mmfa enyimfa anaa abankum: Twe w’anan fi mbusu ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, tsie me nyansaa; Yɛ aso ma me ntseasee:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ama aakora adwenmutsewee do, Na w’ano eesie nyimdzee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbaa sansanyi n’ano kyi ewo sosɔw, Na n’anomu yɛ tor sen ngo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na n’ewiei dze ɔyɛ wen dɛ bɔwema, Ɔyɛ ndam dɛ afona anofanu.
title: PROVERBS

text: N’anan sian kɔ owu mu; N’anamɔn tutu kɔ samanadze;
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ɔmmfa nkwa kwan tsenn no do: N’akwan hihim naaso onnyim.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, me mba, hom ntsie me, Na mma hom nndan mmfi m’anomu nsɛm ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Yi wo kwan fi ne nkyɛn koraa, Na mma mmbɛn ne fi abowano:
title: PROVERBS

text: Amma aanndan w’enyidzii amma binom, Na wo nkwa aamma etsiɔdzenfo:
title: PROVERBS

text: Amma ahɔho eenndzi w’ahodze ammee; Na w’edwumadze eennkedzi ɔnanaben fie;
title: PROVERBS

text: Amma eenndzi apempen wɔ w’ewiei ekyirii, Ber a wo honam na wo nyimpadua asa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na aka dɛ, Mbrɛ muduae kyiir nkyerɛkyerɛ, Na m’akoma poow nkaenyim;
title: PROVERBS

text: Eso menntsie m’akyerɛkyerɛfo hɔn ndze, Na mannyɛ aso amma hɔn a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ me a!
title: PROVERBS

text: Aka kuma ma nkyɛ mbusu aato me koraa Wɔ mboanofo na bagua mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nom wankasa wo nsuhina mu nsu, Na nsu a ɔpem fi wankasa wo bura mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Aso wo nsunyiwa bobu do apetse Na ɔayɛ abɔntsen do esutsen a?
title: PROVERBS

text: Ma wɔnyɛ wankotsee wodze, Na nnyɛ ɔwo na ahɔho bi dze a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ma wonhyira wo nsunyiwa; Na ma w’enyi ngye wɔ wo mberantsɛber mu yer ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtse dɛ ɔtweber dɔfo na ɔwansan hoɔfɛfo, Ma no mpokuwa nsɔ w’enyi aber nyinara; Na ma no dɔ ndzi w’aso daa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ɔwo, me ba, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔbaa sansanyi bedzi w’aso, Na aka ɔbaa sansanyi n’akoko efua?
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ɔdasanyi n’akwan da edzi wɔ EWURADZE enyim, Na ɔtaataa n’anamɔn nyinara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Omumuyɛfo noara n’emumuyɛ bosuo no mu, Na no bɔn ho ahoma bɛkyekyer no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔnam dɛ okwetsir nkyerɛkyerɛ ntsi, obowu ara; Na no nkwaseadze dodow ntsi, ɔbɔtɔ dɔnsuar ara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, sɛ idzi wo nyɛnko akagyinamu, Anaadɛ igyina ɔnanaben bi ekyir,
title: PROVERBS

text: Ma wɔdze w’anomu nsɛm esua wo efir, Na wɔnam w’anomu nsɛm do akyer wo a;
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, afei iyi na yɛ fa gye woho, Ɔnam dɛ atɔ wo nyɛnko nsamu ntsi; Kɛbrɛ woho adze, na totɔ serɛ wo nyɛnko no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnkyinkyim ho, Mma nnda do so koraa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Gye woho dɛ adoa a oefi ɔbɔfo nsamu, Na dɛ anoma a oefi efirsuafo nsamu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔwo ɔkwadwefo, kɔ pataakowa nkyɛn; Sua n’akwan yie, na hu nyansa:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔno a onnyi otsitsir, Ɔhwɛdofo, anaa ɔpanyin;
title: PROVERBS

text: Naaso osiesie n’edziban ɔhyewber mu, Na ɔboaboa n’edzidzidze ano otwaber mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwadwefo, ebɛda ara ekodu dabɛn? Aber bɛn ara na ibenyan efi wo nda mu?
title: PROVERBS

text: Nda kakra so bio, nkomtɔ kakra, Eropon nsa kakra ada:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔno na wo hia bɛba dɛ owifo, Na w’ahokyer dɛ ɔbarimba a oemia.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa huhuw, ɔbarimba busuyɛfo; Ɔdze ano kɔntɔnkye nenam;
title: PROVERBS

text: Obubu enyiwa, ɔdze n’anan kasa, Ɔdze ne nsatseaba kyerɛkyerɛ adze;
title: PROVERBS

text: Akɔntɔnkyesɛm wɔ n’akoma mu, ɔpam ne tsirmu apam bɔn daa. Ɔhyɛ tɛkyerɛ mu gya.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛm ntsi awerɛfir mu na no mbusu bɛba; Awerɛfir mu na wobobubu no, na onnkenya edur.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ndzɛmba esia na EWURADZE kyir; Nyew, esuon na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma no:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ahopɔw enyiwa, ator tɛkyerɛma, Nsa a ɔka bɔgya a odzi bem gu;
title: PROVERBS

text: Akoma a ɔdwendwen emumuyɛ adwen, Anan a no ho yɛ har tu mbirika kɔtɔ mbusu mu;
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdasetorfo a odzi ator, Na nyia ɔhyɛ enuanom mu tɛkyerɛ mu gya.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, dzi w’egya ne mbrasɛm do, Na mma mmpow wo na ne mbra:
title: PROVERBS

text: Fa kyekyer w’akoma ho daa, Fa brabra wo kɔn mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ enam a, obegya wo kwan; Sɛ eda hɔ a, ɔbɔweɔn wo; Na sɛ inyan a, ɔnye wo bɛkasa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na mbrasɛm yɛ kandzea; na mbra yɛ kan; Na nkyerɛkyerɛ ho nkaenyim yɛ nkwa no kwan:
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ obesie wo efi ɔbaa bɔn no ho, Efi ɔbaa sansanyi ne tɛkyerɛma dɔkɔdɔkɔ no ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma w’enyi mmber n’ahoɔfɛw wɔ w’akoma mu; Eso mma ɔmmfa n’enyisoatsɛw nnkyer wo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ɔbaa huhunyi tsirbo som paanoo sin bi: Naaso nyia ɔfa ɔbaa warfo dze, ɔhwer ne nkwa a ɔsom bo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Aso nyimpa botum aso gya egu no bo mu, a ne ntar nnkɛhyew?
title: PROVERBS

text: Anaadɛ aso obi botum anantsew gyansenama do, Na n’ananadze nnkɛhyew?
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛm na nyia ɔkɔ ne nyɛnko ne yer nkyɛn no tse; Obiara a ɔdze ne nsa ka no no, ɔnnkɛfa no ho tɔtrɔtɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Adasa wɔnnhyɛ owifo ahorba, sɛ owia adze Dze amee ne kra ber a ɔkɔm adze no a:
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbom sɛ wohu no dze a, ɔno ɔbɔ ho mpɛn esuon hyɛ ananmu; Ɔdze ne fie ndzɛmba nyinara bɛma.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a ɔnye ɔbaa to awar no, onnyim nyansa: Ɔyɛ adze a ɔbɛsɛɛ nankasa ne kra.
title: PROVERBS

text: Epirapira na enyimguase na obenya; Na noho fi ngui no, nnkɛpepa efi hɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyinkun twetwee ɔbarimba n’ebufuhyew; Na onnkegyaa mu wɔ n’awerdzi da mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Onnkobu mpata hwee; Eso sɛ ema akyɛdze pii mpo a, no bo nnkɔdwe da.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, dzi me nsɛm do, Na fa me mbrasɛm sie wo nkyɛn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dzi me mbransɛm do, na nya nkwa; Na yɛ me mbra dɛ w’enyiwa kyiresua.
title: PROVERBS

text: Kyekyer no wɔ wo nsatseaba do; Kyerɛw no wɔ w’akoma pon do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Se nyansa dɛ, Ɔwo nye m’akyerɛbaa; Na frɛ ntseasee dɛ wo nyɛnko berɛbo:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ama woeesie wo efi ɔbaa sansanyi no ho, Efi ɔbaa sansanyi a ɔka adɔkɔdɔkɔsɛm no nsamu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na mifi me dan mu tokura mu, Na muduaa m’atenatokura mu mohwɛe;
title: PROVERBS

text: Na muhun ntsetsekwaa mu, Muhun mbofraba mu, Aberantsekwaa bi a onnyim nyansa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Orutwa mu wɔ abɔntsen mbrɛ ɔbɛn ɔbaa no ne nsaaba mu, Na ɔdze faa ne fie kwan;
title: PROVERBS

text: Ewimbibaamu, adansaber, Adzesaa kebii na sum mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na, hwɛ, ɔbaa bi behyiaa no kwan, Ofura ehuhufotam, na brada ahyɛ n’akoma ma.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbɔ ndze na ɔyɛ ntsintsiman; N’anan nntsena ne fie:
title: PROVERBS

text: Sesei na ɔwɔ abrɔn mu, sesei na ɔwɔ gua do, Na ɔretsɛw nsaaba nyinara mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nna ɔdze ne nsa braa no, na ɔfeew n’ano, Na opiriim n’enyim, na ɔsee no dɛ:
title: PROVERBS

text: Asomdwee ho afɔrbɔ da mo do; Ndɛ da yi metua m’anohobadze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛm ntsi na mepue ebehyia wo kwan, Mabɔhwehwɛ w’enyim yie, na mehu wo yi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Medze kuntu a woedzi mu edwin asɛw me mpa do, Egypt nkyermu atam.
title: PROVERBS

text: Medze nduhuam dɛ: mɛɛr, alɔe na sinamɔn Egugu me kɛtɛ do huanhuam.
title: PROVERBS

text: Bra ma ɔdɔ mmee hɛn araa nkodu anapa; Ma yɛmfa ɔdɔ nkyekye hɛn werɛ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ofiwura nnyi fie, Oetu kwan kɔ ekyirekyir:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔafa sika kotoku ma kɔ; Ɔbosoom yɛ mu a, nna ɔbɛba fie.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdze asɛndɛw pii maa ɔdze noho mae, Ɔdze ano fenemfenem nyaa no ma ɔkɔree. Awerɛfir mu ara na ɔtaa no do
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ ɔnantwi a ɔrokɔ ekumii, Anaadɛ mpokyerɛ a wɔdze twe ɔkwasea n’aso;
title: PROVERBS

text: Kodu dɛ egyen menaba bohwira ne berɛbo mu. Ɔtse dɛ mbrɛ anoma no ho yɛ har kɔtɔ efir mu, Naaso onnyim dɛ woesua ama no nkwa no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, me mba, hom ntsie me, Na hom nyɛ aso mma m’anomu nsɛm.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mma w’akoma nntɔ nnkɔ n’atsempɔn do, Mma nntɔ dɔnsuar nnkefir n’akwan do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Osiandɛ oepirapira piinara ahwehwe famu: Nyew, hɔn a wɔatotɔr wɔ ne nsamu yɛ dɔm kɛsenara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Fa ne fie kwan do na hwɛ, Na ɔdze wo bɔkɔ owu mu, Nyew, samanadze tɔnn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ana nnyɛ nyansa na ɔtsea mu, Na ntseasee ma ne ndze do bi?
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwan do sorɔnsorɔmmbea etsifi, Nkwanta do na ogyinae;
title: PROVERBS

text: Aponkɛse nkyɛn, wɔ kurotsia, Mbobow ano na ɔtseatsea mu:
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa e, hom na mefrɛ hom oo; Na me ndze refrɛ adasamba nyina.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ao hom ntsetsekwaa, hom nhu enyitsew; Na, hom nkwasea, hom nnya ntseasee akoma.
title: PROVERBS

text: Hom ntsie, na merebɛka nsɛm a oye kyɛn; Na m’ano bobue aka nsɛm a ɔfata.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na nokwar befi m’anomu; Na emumuyɛ yɛ m’ano ekyiwadze.
title: PROVERBS

text: M’anomu nsɛm nyinara nam tsenenee mu; Adze nkyeakyeae anaa kɔtɔnkye biara nnyi mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ne nyinara mu da edzi ma ntseaseenyi, Na ɔtsen ma hɔn a wohu nyimdzee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Hom ngye me nkyerɛkyerɛ, na nnyɛ dwetɛ; Na hom ngye nyimdzee nkyɛn sika a wɔahwɛ mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyansa ye sen mbota; Na akɔndɔdze nyinara wɔmmfa nnto ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emi mara, nyansa, na medze enyitsew ayɛ me tsenabew, Na muhu nyimdzee na adwenmutsewee.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE ho suro nye bɔn ne kyir: Na ntsɛn, enyimenam, ɔkwan bɔn, Na kɔntɔnkyesɛm dze, na mikyir.
title: PROVERBS

text: Afotu yɛ medze, na nyimdzee pa so: Ntseasee nye mara; mowɔ tum.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emi na ahemfo wɔdze me dzi hen, Na etsitsir dze me bua atsɛn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emi na mpanyimfo dze me dzi mpanyin, Na ekunyin so, mekyerɛ asaase do atsɛmbuafo nyinara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emi dze, modɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ me; Na hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ me anapahema no wobohu me.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ahonya na enyidzi wɔ mo hɔ; Nyew, ahonya a otsim na ndzeyɛtsenenee wɔ mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: M’aba ye sen sika, nyew, ɔsen sika mapa; No mu ndɔbaa sen dwetɛ a wɔasan mu eyiyi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ndzeyɛtsenenee tsempɔn mu na menam, Atsɛmbu akwan mu so:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ama hɔn a wɔdɔ me no woeenya adze edzi, Na maahyehyɛ hɔn akoradze amaama.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE bɔɔ me dze hyɛɛ no kwan ase, Ne tsetse ndwuma mu ɔkandzifo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Wɔdze me sii hɔ fir tsetse, fir ahyɛse, Ansaana asaase reba no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Aber a ebun nnyi hɔ no, nna wɔwoo me; Aber a nsunyiwa a ɔba nsu pii nnyi hɔ no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ansaana wɔdze mbepɔw ribesisi hɔ, Ansaana akoko reba, nna wɔawo me:
title: PROVERBS

text: Aber a onnyae nnyɛɛ asaase na nhaban, Na ommbuu wiadze huntuma ano no,
title: PROVERBS

text: Aber a orisiesie ɔsorsor no, nna mowɔ hɔ: Aber a orutwa ebun no enyi kɔntɔnkrɔn no:
title: PROVERBS

text: Aber a ɔyɛɛ wimu ɔsor pintsinn no; Aber a ebun no no nsunyiwa yɛɛ dzendzen no:
title: PROVERBS

text: Aber a otwaa epo ne he maa no, Ma esu emmbu ne mbrasɛm do; Aber a ɔsensaan asaase ne fapem no:
title: PROVERBS

text: Nna mowɔ ne nkyɛn, dɛ odwimfopanyin: Na meyɛɛ n’enyigyedze daa nyinara, Midzii ehurusi wɔ n’enyim daa;
title: PROVERBS

text: Midzii ehurusi wɔ n’asaase a wɔtsena do yi mu; Na n’enyigyedze wɔ adasamba mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, me mba, hom ntsie me, Na esiarfo nye hɔn a wosie m’akwan.
title: PROVERBS

text: Hom ntsie nkyerɛkyerɛ, na hom nhu nyansa, Na mma hom mmpow.
title: PROVERBS

text: Osiarfo nye nyimpa a otsie me, Ɔweɔn m’aponkɛse ano daa daa. Ɔweɔn wɔ mo mbobow apondua ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na obiara a ohu me no, ohu nkwa, Na obenya EWURADZE n’enyimpa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na obiara a ɔyɛ bɔn tsia me no, ɔyɛ nankasa ne kra bɔn. Hɔn a wokyir me nyinara wɔdɔ owu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyansa esi ne dan, Ɔasen n’edum esuon:
title: PROVERBS

text: Oekuku no mbowa; ɔafora ne nsa; Ɔato no pon so.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔasoma ne mbaawa, wɔtsea mu Wɔ kurow no nsorɔnsorɔm mbea no do, dɛ,
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a ɔyɛ atsetsekwaa no, ɔmman mbra ha: Obiara a onnyim nyansa no dze, ɔse no dɛ,
title: PROVERBS

text: Hom mbra mbedzi m’edziban bi, Na wɔmbɔnom nsa a mafora no bi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ntsetsekwaa ee, hom ngyaa, na hom nnya nkwa; Na hom nnantsew nyansa kwan mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔtwe ɔtwetwesifo aso no, noara na onya enyimguase: Na nyia ɔka omumuyɛfo enyim no, noara na onya nkekaa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nka ɔtwetwesifo enyim, amma oeennkyir wo: Ka onyansafo enyim, na ɔbɔdɔ wo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ma onyansafo nkyerɛkyerɛ, na obohu nyansa bi so: Kyerɛkyerɛ ɔtseneneenyi, na ne myimdzee bɔdɔɔ so.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyew, EWURADZE ho suro nye nyansa ahyɛse: Na Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ho nyimdzee nye ntseasee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na emi na mebɛma wo nda adɔɔ so, Na wo nkwa mfe no wɔdze bi bɛka ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ eyɛ onyansafo a, eyɛ onyansafo ma woho: Na sɛ isi atwetwe a, wo nko na ebɔsoa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbaa kwasea kasa gyegyeegye, Atsetsekwaa a, onnyim hwee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ɔtsena ne fie abowano, Wɔ kuropon mu nsorɔnsorɔm mbea egua do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ ɔrefrɛfrɛ hɔn a wɔresen, Wɔnam hɔn kwan do tsenn no dɛ,
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a ɔyɛ atsetsekwaa no, ɔmman mbra ha: Na obiara a onnyi ntseasee no dze, ɔse no dɛ,
title: PROVERBS

text: Nsu a woewia yɛ fenemfenem, Na edziban a wodzi no wɔ nsumaa mu no yɛ dɛw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Naaso onyia no onnyim dɛ ewufo wɔ hɔ; Dɛ samanadze ebun no mu na hɔn a woehyia hɔn no wɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Solomon ne Mbɛbusɛm. Ɔba nyansafo ma n’egya n’enyi gye: Na ɔba kwasea dze, ɔhyɛ ne na n’awerɛhow.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emumuyɛ akoradze nnyɛ mfaso biara: Na ndzeyɛtsenenee dze, ɔgye nkwa fi owu mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE nnkɛma ɔkɔm adze ɔtseneneenyi ne kra: Mbom omumuyɛfo apɛdze dze, ɔbɔ petse.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔyɛ adze akwadwer mu no obedzi hia. Na mbɔdzembɔfo nsa dze, ɔma ahonya.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔboaboa ano ɔhyewber mu no ɔyɛ ɔba nyansafo: Na nyia ɔda twaber mu no dze, ɔyɛ ɔba a ɔdze enyimguase ba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nhyira gu ɔtseneneenyi etsifi: Na akakabensɛm kata omumuyɛfo ano.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi ho nkaa yɛ nhyira: Naaso omumuyɛfo ne dzin dze, ɔbɔprɔw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Akoma mu enyansafo bɛgye mbrasɛm: Na ɔkwasea a ɔkrɔw pii no dze, ɔbɔhwe ase.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔnantsew tɔɔtsen no ɔnantsew sɔkyee: Na nyia ɔkyeakyea n’akwan no dze, wobohu no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia obubu n’enyiwa no, oyi awerɛhow: Na ɔkwasea a ɔkrɔw pii no dze, ɔbɔhwe ase.
title: PROVERBS

text: Tseneneenyi ano yɛ nkwa nsunyiwa: Na akakabensɛm kata omumuyɛfo ano.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyitan kenyan mansotwe: Na ɔdɔ dze, ɔkata mbrato nyinara do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔwɔ nhumu n’anomu na wohu nyansa: Na nyia onnyi ntseasee dze, n’ekyir fata abaa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyansafo boaboa nyimdzee ano: Na nkwasea ano dze, ɔdze ɔsɛɛ ba ntsɛm.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obirɛmpɔn n’ahonya nye no kurow a ɔyɛ dzen: Abɔbɔfo dze, hɔn sɛɛe nye hɔn hia.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi ne berɛ ho akatua yɛ nkwa: Na omumuyɛfo no ndɔbaa dze, ɔdze kɔ bɔn pii mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia obu nkyerɛkyerɛ bi no, ɔwɔ nkwa kwan mu: Na nyia ɔpow nkaenyim dze, ɔfom kwan.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔkata enyitan do no odzi ator; Na nyia ɔkasa sɛɛ obi dzin no, ɔyɛ ɔkwasea.
title: PROVERBS

text: Kasa dodow mu mmpa mbrato: Na nyia osianka n’ano dze, ɔyɛ onyansafo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi tɛkyerɛma tse dɛ dwetɛ a wɔasan mu eyi: Naaso emumuyɛfo akoma dze, ɔnnsɛ hwee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi n’ano nyɛn nyimpa pii: Na nkwasea dze, ntseasee a wonnyi ntsi wowu.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE ne nhyira ma ahonya, Na ɔmmfa awerɛhow biara mmbata ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emumuyɛ tse dɛ agodzi ma ɔkwasea. Naaso nyimpa a ɔwɔ ntseasee dze, nyansa yɛ no fɛw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dza omumuyɛfo no suro no ara na ɔbɛba no do: Na ɔtseneneenyi dze, wɔbɛyɛ n’apɛdze ama no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ ekyinehyia mframa bɔ twa mu a, nna omumuyɛfo nnyi hɔ: Naaso ɔtseneneenyi dze, ɔyɛ ɔdomankoma fapem.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ nsa yerɛyerɛw tse ma ese, na wusiw tse ma enyiwa no, Mbrɛ ɔkwadwefo tse ma hɔn a wɔsoma no ara nye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE ho suro ma nda tsentsen: Na emumuyɛfo hɔn mfe dze wobotwa do tsia.
title: PROVERBS

text: Atseneneefo enyidado bɛyɛ ahomka: Naaso emumuyɛfo enyidado dze, ɔbɛhera.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE no kwan yɛ akoban ma tɔɔtsenyɛfo; Na ɔyɛ ɔsɛɛ dze ma emumuyɛfo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi nnkefi n’ananmu dabiarada: Naaso emumuyɛfo dze, wɔnnkɛtsena asaase no do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi n’ano wo nyansa: Na tɛkyerɛma kɔntɔnkye dze, wobotwa akyen.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi n’ano nyim adze a ɔsɔ enyi: Naaso omumuyɛfo ano dze, ɔka nkɔntɔnkyesɛm.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nsisi nsɛn yɛ ekyiwadze ma EWURADZE: Na pɛrpɛr nkerii dze, ɔyɛ n’enyigyedze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ ahomemado ba a, nna enyimguase so ba: Na ahobrɛadzefo dze nyansa nye hɔn tse.
title: PROVERBS

text: Tɔɔtsenyɛfo hɔn emudzi begya hɔn kwan: Na nkontompɔtwafo dze, hɔnara hɔn ndabraba bɛsɛɛ hɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Adzenya dodow nnkotum agye nkwa wɔ ebufuw da mu: Na ndzeyɛtsenenee dze, ɔgye nkwa fi owu mpo mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia odzi mu no ne tsenenee na ɔbɛtsentsen no kwan: Naaso omumuyɛfo dze, ɔbɔhwe ase wɔ nankasa n’emumuyɛ mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Tɔɔtsenyɛfo hɔn ndzeyɛtsenenee bɛgye hɔn nkwa: Na nkontompɔtwafo dze, wɔbɛkyer hɔn wɔ hɔnankasa hɔn mbusubɔ mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Omumuyɛfo no wu sɛɛ n’enyidado nyinara: Nkankaara dza ɔdze hyɛɛ n’ahonya mu no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi, wɔgye no fi ɔfona mu, Na omumuyɛnyi ebesi n’ananmu ehu amandze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi dze n’ano sɛɛ ne nyɛnko: Na atseneneefo dze, wɔdze nyimdzee bɛgye hɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ atseneneefo yɛ yie a, kurow no dzi ehurusi: Mbom sɛ emumuyɛfo hera dze a, wɔbɔ ose.
title: PROVERBS

text: Wɔnam tɔɔtsenyɛfo hɔn nhyira do na wɔma kurow do: Na wɔnam emumuyɛfo ano na wɔbɔ no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia obu ne nyɛnko enyimtsia no, onnyim nyansa: Na nyimpa ɔwɔ ntseasee dze, omua n’ano.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔyɛ afakɔafaba no, ɔda esumasɛm edzi: Na nyia ɔwɔ nokwardzi sunsum no dze, ɔkata asɛm do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ nyansa apam nnyi no, ɔman hwe ase: Na apamfo dodow mu, na amandwee wɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia odzi ɔnanaben egyinamu no, no ho bɛhyehye no: Na nyia okyir egyinamudzi no, no ho dwe no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbaa dɔyɛfo no, ɔwɔ enyimnyam: Na nyimpa enyimpifo dze, wosie ahonyadze gyan.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa mbɔbɔrhufo yɛ nankasa ne kra yie: Na nyia ɔyɛ etsiɔdzen no, ɔhaw noara no honam.
title: PROVERBS

text: Omumuyɛfo nya ndaadaa apaabɔdze: Mbom nyia ɔpɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee no dze, ɔwɔ akatua a osi pi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia otsim wɔ ndzeyɛtsenenee mu no, ɔbɔkɔ nkwa mu: Na nyia ɔka emumuyɛ do no, ɔyɛ dze nya noara no wu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Hɔn a wɔyɛ akoma mu akɔnkyew no, wɔyɛ EWURADZE n’ekyiwadze: Na hɔn a wodzi mu wɔ hɔn mu no, wɔsɔ n’enyi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Kansɛ nsa da nsamu mpo a, nyimpa bɔn nnkɛfa noho edzi: Na ɔtseneneenyi n’asefo dze, wɔbɛgye hɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ sika edwindze tse wɔ preko n’ahwen mu no, Dɛmara so na ɔbaa ɔhoɔfɛfo a onnyi adwenmutsewee no tse.
title: PROVERBS

text: Atseneneefo apɛdze ye ara: Naaso emumuyɛfo enyidado dze, ebufuw a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obi wɔ hɔ a ɔtow petse, mbom ɔdɔr mbordo; Na obi wɔ hɔ a ɔkam adze do kyɛn mbrɛ ɔsɛ, naaso odzi hia ara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkra a ne nsa bue no, ɔbɔdɔ seradze: Na nyia ogugu nsu no, wobogugu no so no do nsu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔkam eburow do no, ɔman no bɛpaa no: Nhyira bɛba nyia ɔtɔn no etsifi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔhwehwɛ papa enyiberdo no, ɔhwehwɛ enyimpa: Na nyia ɔhwehwɛ mbusubɔ dze, ɔbɛba no do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔtwer n’ahonya no, ɔbɔhwe ase: Na ɔtseneneenyi dze, ɔbɛyɛ prɔmprɔm dɛ haban momon.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔhaw noara ne fifo no, onnkenya hwee efi mu: Na ɔkwasea bɛyɛ onyansafo n’akowaa daa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi n’aba yɛ nkwa dua; Naaso nyia onya akra no yɛ onyansanyi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Hwɛ, sɛ wobotua ɔtseneneenyi mpo kaw wɔ asaase do a: Nna burburbur omumuyɛnyi na ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi!
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a ɔdɔ asotwe no, ɔdɔ nyimdzee: Na nyia okyir nkaenyim no, ɔyɛ mbowadze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa papa benya EWURADZE n’enyimpa: Na nyimpa a ɔhyehyɛ emumuyɛ no dze, obobu no fɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa nnkodua emumuyɛ do etsim: Na atseneneefo ndwow nnkotutu ara da.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbaa nokwafo yɛ abɔtsir ma no kun: Na nyia ɔyɛ enyimguasedze no dze, ɔtse dɛ mpɔtɔwee wɔ ne mbiew mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Atseneneefo adwen yɛ pɛrpɛr: Na emumuyɛfo apam dze, ɔyɛ ndaadaa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emumuyɛfo nsɛm yɛ bɔgya ho atsɛw: Na tɔɔtsenyɛfo ano dze, ɔbɛgye hɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Wobutuw emumuyɛfo, a wonngya hɔn asefo biara: Naaso atseneneefo fi dze, wobetsim no daa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa ne nyansaa na wɔdze bɛkamfo no: Na nyia n’akoma kyeakyea no dze, wobobu no enyimtsia.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia wommbu no bi a ɔwɔ ɔsomfo no, oye Sen nyia obu noho bi na edziban abɔ no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa tsenenee bu n’abowa mpo no nkwa bi: Naaso emumuyɛfo hɔn ayamuhyehye dze, ɔyɛ etsirmɔdzen.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔdɔw n’asaase no, obenya edziban pii: Na nyia odzi akwasampafo ekyir no, onnyim nyansa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Omumuyɛfo hwehwɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo hɔn afonam: Na atseneneefo ndwow dze, ɔsow aba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ano mfomdo mu na efir bɔn da ma omumuyɛnyi: Na ɔtseneneenyi dze obefi ɔfona mu efir.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa n’anomu aba na ɔdze bedzi papa amee: Na nyimpa ne nsaano ndzeyɛɛ na wɔbɛdan ama no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwasea no kwan tsen wɔ nankasa n’enyiwa do: Na nyia ɔyɛ onyansafo dze, otsie apam.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwasea n’ebufuw, ntsɛmara na woehu: Na ɔbadwembanyi dze, osiw enyimguase do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔkasa nokwar da ndzeyɛtsenenee edzi, Na ɔdasetorfo dze, ndaadaa a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obi wɔ hɔ a ɔkasa efuraado dɛ nkrantsee no nwowɔe: Naaso onyansafo ne tɛkyerɛma dze, apɔwmudzen a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nokwar ano betsim hɔ daa: Na tɛkyerɛma torfo dze, ɔwɔ hɔ mber kumaabi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ndaadaa wɔ hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ bɔn wɔ hɔn akoma mu: Na asomdwee ho apamfo dze, enyigye yɛ hɔndze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbusu biara nnkɔto ɔtseneneenyi: Na emumuyɛfo dze, mbusu bɛhyɛ hɔn ma.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ator ano yɛ EWURADZE ekyiwadze: Na hɔn a wodzi nokwar dze, wɔsɔ n’enyi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbadwembanyi dze nyimdzee suma: Na nkwasea hɔn akoma dze, ɔbɔ nkwaseadze dawur.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbɔdzembɔfo hɔn nsa bedzi tum: Na enyihaw nsa dze, wɔdze bɛhyɛ nkowaadwuma ase.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa n’akoma mu awerɛhow ma no mu kom: Na asɛmpa dze, ɔma no enyigye.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi yɛ ɔkwankyerɛfo ma ne nyɛnko: Na emumuyɛfo kwan dze, ɔma wɔfom.
title: PROVERBS

text: Onyihanyi nnya hwee wɔ abrabɔ mu: Na adasa ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo dze, odzi wɔ mbɔdzembɔfo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ndzeyɛtsenenee kwan do na nkwa wɔ: Na ɔbrakyew kwan dze, ɔkɔ owu mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔba nyansafo tsie n’egya ne nkyerɛkyerɛ: Naaso ɔtwetwesifo dze, onntsie ntwuwenyim.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa nam n’anomu aba do bedzi ndzepa. Na nkontompɔtwafo akra dze, wobedzi akakabensɛm.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔweɔn n’ano no, osie no nkwa: Na nyia obue n’ano petoo dze, obenya ɔsɛɛ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwadwefo kra kɔn dɔ, naaso onnya hwee: Na mbɔdzembɔnyi ne kra dze, ɔbɔdɔ seradze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi kyir atorsɛm: Na omumuyɛnyi dze, no ho yɛ nkɔw, na ɔba enyimguase mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ndzeyɛtsenenee kora nyia no kwan yɛ tɔɔtsen: Naaso emumuyɛ dze, obutuw ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ noho ɔhonyanyi, naaso onnyi hwee: Obi so wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ noho ohianyi, naaso ɔwɔ adze kɛse.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa ne kra n’apondze nye n’ahonya: Na ohianyi dze, onntsie mpuwbɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Atseneneefo kan dzɛw huoo: Naaso emumuyɛfo kandzea dze, obodum.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nkontompɔ dze aperper nko ba: Na hɔn a wotsie apam pa no dze, wonya nyansa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Hwimhwim adze kɔ sorɔsorɔw, Na nyia ɔdze berɛ boaboa ano no, obenya ngumu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyidado kyɛr a, ɔma akoma yar: Na sɛ ahwehwɛdze ba mu a, ɔyɛ nkwadua.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a obu asɛm no enyimtsia no, ɔsɛɛ noara noho. Na nyia osuro mbrasɛm dze, obenya akatua.
title: PROVERBS

text: Onyansafo ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ nkwa nsunyiwa, Dɛ nyimpa dze befi owu mfir mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ntseasee papa ma enyimpa: Na nkontompɔtwafo kwan dze, ɔyɛ kekakeka.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbadwembanyi biara yɛ edwuma nyimdzee mu: Na ɔkwasea dze, ɔma no nkwaseadze tahye.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔsomafo omumuyɛnyi dze mbusu ba: Na ɔnokwafo dze, ɔdze asomdwee ba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ohia na enyito bɛka nyia ɔpow asotwe: Na nyia obu nkaenyim bi no dze, wobedzi no nyi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Akɔndɔdze a nsa aka no, ɔyɛ ɔkra dɛw: Na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma nkwasea dɛ wobefi mbusu ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enye enyansafo nnantsew, na ibohu nyansa: Na nkwasea anyɛnkofa dze, wo ho bɛhyehye wo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbusu tsiw ndzebɔnyɛfo: Na atseneneefo dze, wɔdze papa botua hɔn kaw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa papa dan ewungyadze gya ne mba hɔn mba; Na ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi n’ahonya dze, wotsia ma ɔtseneneenyi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Edziban pii wɔ ehiafo kwa mu. Na bi wɔ hɔ a, pɛrpɛr nnyi mu ntsi, wɔsɛɛ no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔkam n’abaa no, ɔtan ne ba: Na nyia ɔdɔ no no, ɔhwe no mber a ɔsɛ mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi dzidzi ma ne kra mee: Na omumuyɛfo dze, yafunkɔm bɛka no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbaa onyansafo biara ɔkyekyer ne fie: Na ɔkwasea no dze, ɔdze ne nsa dwuruw ne fie gu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔnantsew no tɔɔtsen mu no, odzi EWURADZE nyi. Na nyia ɔkyeakyea n’akwan no dze, obu no enyimtsia.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwasea anomu na nkontompɔ abaa wɔ: Na onyansafo ano dze, ɔbɔkora hɔn do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ anantwi nnyi no, edziban so nnyi hɔ: Na ndɔbaa pii dze, ofi ɔnantwi n’ahoɔdzen.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdasefo nokwafo rinndzi ator: Na ɔdasefo torfo dze, ɔka atorsɛm.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtwetwesifo hwehwɛ nyansa, naaso onnya: Na nyimdzee dze, ɔyɛ mberɛw ma nyia ɔwɔ ntseasee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Fi ɔkwasea n’enyim kɔ, Osiandɛ innkohu nyimdzee nsɛm biara wɔ no ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbadwembanyi ne nyansaa nye dɛ ɔtse no kwan ase: Na nkwasea hɔn nkwaseadze nye hɔn ndaadaa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nkwasea si afɔdzi ho atwetwe: Na tɔɔtsenyɛfo mu na enyisɔ wɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Akoma nyim noara n’awerɛhow: Na ɔhɔho mmfa noho nngyegye ne dɛw mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emumuyɛfo fie bobutuw: Na atseneneefo asese dze, ɔbɛyɛ prɔmprɔm.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwan bi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ dɛ ɔtsen ma nyimpa, Naaso n’ewiei yɛ owu akwan.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔserew mu mpo, akoma dzi yaw: Na enyigye n’ewiei, awerɛhow a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Akoma mu okyirsannyi noara n’akwan bɛhyɛ noara ma: Na nyimpa papa fi noara no ho bɛmee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ntsetsekwaa gye asɛm biara dzi: Naaso ɔbadwembanyi dze, ɔhwɛ ne nantsew yie.
title: PROVERBS

text: Onyansafo suro, na oyi mbusu akwa: Naaso ɔkwasea dze, ɔyɛ nyiyiano na ɔgye noho dzi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔnnkyɛr ebufuw fa no, odzi nkwaseasɛm: Na nyimpa a ɔhyehyɛ emumuyɛ no dze, wokyir no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nkwaseadze bra ntsetsekwaa: Na abadwembafo dze, wɔdze nyimdzee bɔ hɔn abɔtsir.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbusubɔfo kotow apapafo enyim: Na emumuyɛfo kotow atseneneefo aponkɛse enyim.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ohianyi noara no sɔnmufo mpo kyir no: Naaso obirɛmpɔn dze, ɔwɔ adɔfo pii.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia obu ne sɔnmunyi bi enyimtsia no, ɔyɛ bɔn: Na nyia ohu ohianyi mbɔbɔr no dze, osiarfo a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ana hɔn a wosusu mbusu no, wɔmmfom bi a? Na hɔn a wosusu papa no dze, wobenya ehumbɔbɔr na nokwar.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔberɛ nyinara mu wɔ mfaso: Anosɛm dze, ɔma ohia ara nko.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyansafo hɔn abɔtsir nye hɔn ahonya: Na nkwasea hɔn nkwaseadze nye nkwaseadze ara nko.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdasefo nokwafo gye akra nkwa: Na nyia odzi ator no dze, ɔyɛ ndabrabanyi.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE ho suro mu na awerɛhyɛmu wɔ. Na ne mba benya guandɔbea.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE ho suro yɛ nkwa nsunyiwa Dɛ wɔdze yi owu efir akwa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpadodow mu na ɔhen n’enyimnyam wɔ: Na no nkorɔfo sa a, n’enyimguase yɛ pii.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔfa ebufuw nyaa no, ɔwɔ ntseasee kɛse: Na nyia no bo haw no no ɔma nkwaseadze do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Akoma pa yɛ honam no nkwa: Na enyitan dze, ɔyɛ mbiew mu mpɔtɔwee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔtseetsee ɔbɔbɔfo no, ogu ne Yɛfo n’enyim ase: Na nyia ohu ohianyi mbɔbɔr no dze, ɔhyɛ no enyimnyam.
title: PROVERBS

text: Wosun obusuyɛfo kyen wɔ no mbusubɔ mu: Na ɔtseneneenyi dze, ɔwɔ enyidado wɔ no wu mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyansa tse nyia ɔwɔ ntseasee no n’akoma mu: Na dza ɔwɔ nkwasea hɔn mu dze, ɔda edzi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ndzeyɛtsenenee na ɔma ɔman do: Na bɔn dze, ɔyɛ ɔman biara n’enyimguase.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhen n’enyimpa wɔ akowaa onyimdzefo do: Na n’ebufuw dze, ɔwɔ nyia ɔdze enyimguase ba no do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyiano bɔkɔɔ pa ebufuw: Na ehuatsɛn dze, ohur ebufuw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyansafo tɛkyerɛma kasa nyimdzee pefee: Na nkwasea ano dze, ɔwora nkwaseadze gu.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE enyiwa wɔ mbea nyinara, Rohwɛ emumuyɛfo na apapafo hɔn ndzeyɛɛ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Tɛkyerɛma a odzi mu no, ɔyɛ nkwadua: Na no mu nkyeakyeae no dze, ɔyɛ sunsum a ebubu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwasea bu n’egya nkyerɛkyerɛ enyimtsia: Na nyia obu nkaenyim bi no, onya nyansa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi fie wɔ akoradze pii: Naaso emumuyɛfo ndɔbaa mu wɔ ɔfona.
title: PROVERBS

text: Onyansafo ano petse nyimdzee. Na ɔkwasea akoma dze, onntsim.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emumuyɛfo afɔrbɔ yɛ EWURADZE ekyiwadze: Na tɔɔtsenyɛfo mpaabɔ dze, ɔyɛ enyigyedze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emumuyɛfo kwan yɛ EWURADZE ekyiwadze: Na nyia odzi ndzeyɛtsenenee ekyir no dze, ɔdɔ no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Asotwe yaayaw wɔ hɔ ma nyia ɔpow ɔkwan no: Na nyia okyir nkaenyim no, obowu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Samanadze na owu amona mpo da EWURADZE enyim: Na burburbur adasamba akoma!
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtwetwesifo mmpɛ dɛ wɔka n’enyim: Ɔnnkɛgye afotu wɔ onyansafo nkyɛn da.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyigye akoma ma enyimtsewee: Na akoma mu awerɛhow ntsi na sunsum bubu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔwɔ ntseasee no, n’akoma hwehwɛ nyimdzee. Na nkwasea ano dzi nkwaseasɛm.
title: PROVERBS

text: Amandzehufo nda nyinara yɛ mbusu: Na akomatɔmunyi no dze, ɔtsena edzidzii daa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Adze kakrabaa a EWURADZE ho suro ka ho no, oye Sen akoradze kɛse a ɔhaw bata ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Efan edziban a ɔdɔ wɔ mu no, oye Sen ɔnantwi a ɔadɔ seradze a enyitan wɔ mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ebufuwfafo huenyan mansotwe mu: Na nyia ɔfa ebufuw nyaa no dze, ɔpata ɔko.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwadwefo kwan tse dɛ nkɛtseefuw ban: Na tɔɔtsenyɛfo kwan dze, wɔdze yɛ ɔtsempɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔba nyansafo ma egya n’enyi gye: Na ɔkwasea dze, obu ne na enyimtsia.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nkwaseadze yɛ enyigye ma nyia onnyim nyansa: Na nyia ɔwɔ ntseasee no dze, ɔtsen ne nantsew.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ egyinatu nnyi no, tsirmpɔw yɛ kwa: Na egyinatufo dodow mu na wosi no pi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa n’anomu mbuae ma no enyigye: Na asɛm a wɔka no ne ber mu no ye dodow!
title: PROVERBS

text: Onyansafo fa kwan a wɔdze kɔ nkwa mu, Ama oeeyi owu akwan akwa.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE bodwuruw nkontompɔfo dan: Mbom ɔbɛma okunafo ne he etsim.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbusu nsusui yɛ EWURADZE n’ekyiwadze: Na asɛm a ho tsew dze, ɔyɛ n’enyisɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Odzifodzepɛnyi no sɛɛ nankasa ne fie: Na nyia okyir mboabagye no, ɔbɛtsena ase.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi dwen asɛm ho ana oeebua: Naaso omumuyɛnyi ne nyiano dze, ɔdze ɔhaw ba.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE nye emumuyɛfo ntamu twe: Mbom otsie atseneneefo mpaabɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyiwa ne kan ma akoma n’enyiwa gye: Na nsɛmpa ma mbiew dɔ seradze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Asowa a otsie nkaenyim papa no, ɔbɛtsena enyansafo mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔpow nkyerɛkyerɛ no, obu noara ne kra enyimtsia: Na nyia otsie nkaenyim no, onya ntseasee.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE ho suro yɛ nyansa nkyerɛkyerɛ: Na ahobrɛadze dze enyimnyam ba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Akoma mu nhyehyɛɛ yɛ nyimpa dze: Na tɛkyerɛma no mbuae fir EWURADZE.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdasanyi n’akwan nyinara dzi mu wɔ noara n’enyiwa do: Naaso EWURADZE na oker esunsum.
title: PROVERBS

text: Fa wo ndwuma hyɛ EWURADZE nsa, Na dza eyɛ no bowie yie.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE wɔ botae ma biribiara a ɔayɛ: Nyew, emumuyɛfo mpo ama mbusu da no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a ɔyɛ akoma mu ntsɛn no, ɔyɛ EWURADZE n’ekyiwadze: Na hyɛ no nsew dɛ, ɔnnkɛfa noho edzi da.
title: PROVERBS

text: Adɔyɛ na nokwardzi na wɔdze pepa emumuyɛ: Na wɔdze EWURADZE ho suro kwetsir mbusu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ nyimpa n’akwan sɔ EWURADZE enyi a, Ɔma n’atamfo mpo nye no tsena asomdwee mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Adze kakrabaa a tsenenee ka ho no, oye Sen ndɔbaa pii a pɛrpɛr nnyi mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa n’akoma na ɔhyehyɛ no kwan: Naaso EWURADZE na ɔtaataa n’anamɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nkɔnhyɛ wɔ Ɔhen n’anomu: N’ano so nnkɔfom atsɛmbu mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Abrambo na nsɛn tsenee yɛ EWURADZE dze. Foto mu abo nyinara n’edwuma a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔyɛ mbusu ma ahemfo dɛ wɔbɛyɛ ewurkadze: Osiandɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee na ɔma ahengua tsim.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ahemfo enyigye nye ano tsenenee: Na wɔdɔ nyia ɔkasa nokwar.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhen n’ebufuw tse dɛ owu n’abɔfoe: Naaso onyansafo bɛpata no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhen n’enyimtsewee mu na nkwa wɔ: Na n’enyimpa tse dɛ ɔbɛsɛber nsuwusiw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ odua ye dodow dɛ wobenya nyansa asen sika a! Nyew, oye dɛ wɔsan mu yi ntseasee ne nyae sen dwetɛ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Riyi mbusu akwa nye tɔɔtsenyɛfo tsempɔn: Nyia ɔhwɛ no kwan yie no, ɔkora ne kra do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ahomemado dzi ɔsɛɛ enyim, Na ahopɔw sunsum dze asehwe ba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Oye dɛ enye abɔbɔfo benya ahobrɛadze sunsum, Sen dɛ enye nkontompɔfo bɛkyɛ asadze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔdwen asɛm no do no, obohu papa; Na obiara a ɔdze no werɛ hyɛ EWURADZE mu no, osiarfo a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Akoma mu onyansafo no wɔbɛfrɛ no ɔbadwembanyi: Na anotsewee krɔn adzesua.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ntseasee yɛ nkwa nsubura ma nyia ɔwɔ no: Na nkwasea asotwe nye hɔn nkwaseadze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Onyansafo akoma kyerɛkyerɛ n’ano, Na ɔdze adzesua hyɛ n’ano.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nsɛm a ɔyɛ dɛw tse dɛ wokyɛm, Ɔkra n’adɔkɔdɔkɔdze a, na mbiew n’apɔwmudzen.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwan bi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ dɛ ɔtsen ma nyimpa, Naaso n’ewiei yɛ owu akwan.
title: PROVERBS

text: Odwumayɛfo n’akɔndɔ ma ɔyɛ edwuma yie; Osiandɛ ɔdze hwehwɛ dza obedzi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa huhuw susu mbusu, Na n’ano tse dɛ ogya a ɔhyehye.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa kɔntɔnkyenyi tow mansotwe petse: Na bɔ tom kɛka no tsetsew anyɛnko brɛbo ntamu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkakabenyi no daadaa ne nyɛnko, Na ɔgye no kɔ ɔhaw mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Hwɛ woho yie wɔ nyia ɔyerɛw n’ano na obu n’enyi kyerɛ wo no ho, Osiandɛ ɔayɛ mbusu nhyehyɛɛ bi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Otsigon yɛ enyimnyam abɔtsir, Wonya wɔ ndzeyɛtsenenee kwan mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔfa ebufuw nyaa no, oye sen ɔkatakyi: Na nyia ɔhyɛ no sunsum do no, ɔsen nyia ɔko fa kurow.
title: PROVERBS

text: Aserɛ do na wɔtwe tonto; Naaso atsɛmbu nyinara dze, ofir EWURADZE.
title: PROVERBS

text: Trɔma kwaa a asomdwee wɔ mu no oye Sen ofi a aponto ma na ntokwaa wɔ mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Akowaa a ɔyɛ enyansadze no, obedzi ɔba a ɔhyɛ enyito no do, Na obenya enuanom mu egyapadze no bi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ogya na wɔdze sɔ sika na dwetɛ hwɛ, Na akoma dze, EWURADZE na ɔsɔ hwɛ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obusuyɛnyi tsie emumuyɛ ano: Na ɔtor yɛ aso ma mbusubɔ tɛkyerɛma.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a osi ɔbɔbɔfo atwetwe no, ogu Nyankopɔn a ɔbɔɔ no no n’enyim ase: Na nyia n’enyi gye amandze mu no, ɔnnkɛfa noho edzi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nkɔdaa hɔn abɔtsir nye mba hɔn mba; Na mba hɔn enyimnyam nye hɔn egyanom.
title: PROVERBS

text: Abɔso no mmfata ɔkwasea: Na burburbur atorsɛm afata ɔdehye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mboabagye tse dɛ siar suman wɔ nyia ɔgye no nsamu: Mbrɛ ɔbɛdan biara no onya dza ɔrohwehwɛ no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔkata mbrato do no, ɔhwehwɛ ɔdɔ: Na nyia otsi asɛm mu no dze, ɔtsetsew anyɛnko brɛbo ntamu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nkaenyim tum nyia ɔwɔ ntseasee Sen ɔkwasea a ɔahwe no mbaa ɔha.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obusuyɛfo hwehwɛ etuatsew nko ara; Dɛm ntsi wobotu ɔbɔfo tsiɔdzennyi wɔ no do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ma osisi a woewia ne mba nhyia obi mbom, Nkyɛn ɔkwasea a no nkwaseasɛm aba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a ɔdze bɔn hyɛ papa ananmu no, Mbusu nnkɛpa ne fie ara da.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mansotwe ahyɛse tse dɛ obi rutue nsu ano: Dɛm ntsi ansaana ɔrebɛyɛ ɔham no, gyaa akasakasa no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia obu emumuyɛfo bem, na nyia obu ɔtseneneenyi fɔ no, EWURADZE n’ekyiwadze nye hɔn beenu nyina.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na sika kitsa ɔkwasea nsamu dɛ ɔdze rokɔtɔ nyansa, Ber a onnyi ntseasee?
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔnyɛnko dɔ aber nyinara, Naaso onua dze, wɔwo no ma abɛbrɛsɛber.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa a onnyim nyansa no, na odzi akagyinamu, Na odzi egyinamu ma ɔnanaben.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔpɛ mbrato no, ɔpɛ mansotwe: Nyia ɔma n’abowano kɔ sor ntrado no, hwehwɛ ɔnoara ne pira.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔwɔ akoma kɔntɔnkye no, onnya adze papa biara: Na nyia ɔwɔ tɛkyerɛma nkyeakyeae no, ɔtɔ mbusu mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔwo ɔkwasea no, ɔwo nya awerɛhow: Na enyigye bi nnyi hɔ ma ɔkwasea n’egya.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyigye akoma yɛ edur pa: Na sunsum bobɔe dze, ɔwew mbiew mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Omumuyɛnyi gye nsumaa mu akyɛdze, Dɛ ɔdze bɛdan atsɛmbu akwan enyi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyansa wɔ nyia ɔwɔ ntseasee enyim: Na ɔkwasea enyiwa gu asaase ano.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔba kwasea yɛ n’egya ne yaw, Na ɔbaa a ɔwoo no no bɔwen.
title: PROVERBS

text: Eso onnye dɛ wɔbɛtsea ɔtseneneenyi, Anaadɛ wɔbɔhwe ekunyin wɔ hɔn tɔɔtsenyɛ ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔkam ne nsɛm no, ɔwɔ nyimdzee: Na nyia no sunsum dwe no, ɔyɛ ntseasee nyimpa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwasea mpo, sɛ omua n’ano a, wobu no onyansafo: Nyew, ɔka n’ano to mu a, wobu no ɔbadwembanyi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔpɛ nonkotsee ne yieyɛ no, hwehwɛ nankasa n’apɛdze: Ɔnngye nsusui papa biara nnto mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwasea nnyi enyigye wɔ ntseasee ho, Na mbom dɛ n’akoma bɛda edzi ntsi ara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emumuyɛ nye enyimguase nam, Gu w’enyim ase, na ibenya enyimtsiabu so.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa n’anomu nsɛm tse dɛ esubun: Nyansa no nsunyiwa tse dɛ bura a ɔpem.
title: PROVERBS

text: Onnye dɛ wɔbɔhwɛ omumuyɛnyi enyim, Anaadɛ wɔbɛdan ɔtseneneenyi enyi wɔ atsɛmbu mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwasea n’ano dze aperper ba, Na n’ano frɛfrɛ asotɔr.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwasea n’ano nye ne sɛɛe, Na n’anofamfa nye ne kra n’efirsua.
title: PROVERBS

text: Bɔ tom kɛkanyi no ne nsɛm tse dɛ trɔma dɛɛdɛw, Na osian kɔ yafun ne mpiatun noho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔyɛ n’edwuma ho akwadwer no, No nua nye ɔdzesɛɛfo.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE ne dzin yɛ aban dzendzen: Ɔtseneneenyi guan kɔdɔ mu a, onya bambɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obirɛmpɔn n’ahonya nye kurow a ɔyɛ dzen, Na ɔtse dɛ fasu a ɔkrɔn wɔ nankasa n’adwen mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyidzi biara nnyi hɔ ma nyia ɔmema noho do no, Na ahopɔw dze nyimpa kɔ ɔsɛɛ mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia obua asɛm ana ɔatse no, Ɔyɛ nkwaseasɛm na enyito ma no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa no sunsum na osuo n’ahomberɛw mu: Na sunsum bobɔe dze, woana botum asɔw?
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbadwembanyi n’akoma nya nyimdzee, Na onyansafo n’asowa hwehwɛ nyimdzee ekyir kwan.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa n’akyɛdze bɔ kwan ma no, Na ɔdze no ba ekunyin enyim.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia odzi kan ka n’asɛm no, ɔyɛ dɛ odzi bem, Kɛpem dɛ nyia ɔnye no enya no ba bɛda no edzi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Tontotwe ma aperper bɔ adze, Na ɔpata etumfo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔyɛ dzen dɛ nsa bɛka onua a wɔafom no no, sen kurow dzendzen: Osiandɛ aperperdzi tse dɛ aban adaban.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa ne yafun wɔdze n’anomu aba bɛhyɛ no ma, Wɔdze n’anomu ndɔbaa bɛmee no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Owu na nkwa wɔ tɛkyerɛma no tum mu; Na hɔn a wɔdɔ no no, wobedzi n’aba bi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a onya ɔyer no, oenya adze pa, Na oenya EWURADZE n’enyimpa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbɔbɔfo dze akyɛpa kasa: Na obirɛmpɔn dze, otu ehuatsɛn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔyɛ anyɛnkosɛm pii no, ɔdze sɛɛ nankasa noho: Naaso, ɔnyɛnko bi wɔ hɔ a ɔfam ho kɛse sen onua.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbɔbɔfo a ɔnam nokwardzi mu no, oye Sen nyia ndabraba ahyɛ n’anomu ma na ɔyɛ ɔkwasea.
title: PROVERBS

text: Eso, ɔkra nnyi nyimdzee a, onnye: Na nyia ne nan ho yɛ har no, ɔyɛ bɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa ne nkwaseadze dze no fa ɔsɛɛ kwan do: Na n’akoma sorow EWURADZE do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ahonya dɔr anyɛnkofo pii: Na ohianyi dze, ɔnye ne nyɛnko ntamu tsetsew.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdasetorfo nnkɛfa noho edzi; Na nyia ɔka atorsɛm no onnkefi nsa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dodowara bɛdzɛfɛdzɛfɛw ɔyamuyiefo: Na obiara fa nyia ɔkyekyɛ adze no nyɛnko.
title: PROVERBS

text: Hianyi dze, no nuanom nyinara mpo kyir no: Na akantam dɛ n’anyɛnkofo bɛbɛn no. Ɔka kasa pa dɛn ara mpo a, ne nsa nnka hɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔnya nyansa no, ɔdɔ nankasa ne kra: Nyia ɔdze ntseasee sie no, obenya ndzepa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdasetorfo nnkɛfa noho edzi: Na nyia ɔka atorsɛm no, ɔbɛhera.
title: PROVERBS

text: Asetsena fɔntɔmm mmfata ɔkwasea; Na akantam dɛ akowaa bedzi ahenmba do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa nyansanyi fa ebufuw nyaa: Na ɔyɛ enyimnyam ma no dɛ ɔdze mfom bɛkyɛ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhen n’ebufuw tse dɛ awendadze a ɔropɔw; Na n’enyimpa tse dɛ nkyɛkyɛr do ɔbɔnsu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔba kwasea yɛ n’egya n’amandzehu: Na ɔyer n’enhwinhwin tse dɛ daa nsu nsosɔwee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdan na ahonya yɛ ewungyadze a ofir egyanom: Na ɔyer ɔbadwembanyi dze, ofir EWURADZE.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyiahaw ma nda heii: Na ɔkra kwadwefo bedzi kɔm.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia osie mbrasɛm no, osie ne kra: Na nyia obu n’enyi gu n’akwan do no, obowu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ohu ohianyi mbɔbɔr no, ɔdze fɛm EWURADZE, Na ne yieyɛ no, wobotua ama no bio.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyidado wɔ hɔ yi, tsea wo ba; Mbom mma mmfa w’akoma nnsi ne sɛɛe do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia n’ebufuw so no, ma onya ho ntsea: Osiandɛ sɛ egye no kor a, ebɛsan so agye no bio.
title: PROVERBS

text: Tsie afotu, na gye nkyerɛkyerɛ, Ama aayɛ onyansafo wɔ w’ewiei ekyir no mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nhyehyɛɛ pii wɔ nyimpa n’akoma mu, Naaso EWURADZE nhyehyɛɛ no na obegyina.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa ho akɔndɔ gyina n’ayamuyie dodow do: Na ohianyi ye sen ɔkɔhwinyi.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE ho suro dzi kɔ nkwa mu: Na nyia ɔwɔ no no, ɔbɛtsena hɔ dɛ ɔamee; Wɔnnkɛfa mbusu aba no do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwadwefo dze ne nsa nu nkwansɛn mu, Na ɔnnkɛfa asan akɔ n’anomu mpo bio.
title: PROVERBS

text: Bɔ ɔtwetwesifo, na ɔbatam bosua enyitsew: Na ka nyia ɔwɔ ntseasee enyim, na ɔbɛtse nyimdzee ase.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔbɔ n’egya etsirmɔdzen na ɔpam ne na no, Ɔyɛ ɔba a ɔhyɛ enyito na ɔdze enyimguase ba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, sɛ igyaa nkyerɛkyerɛ tsie a, Ebɔfom efi nyimdzee nsɛm ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdasefo huhuw si atsɛmbu atwetwe: Na emumuyɛfo ano memen mbusu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Woesiesie atsɛmbu ama atwetwesifo, Na mbaahwe ama nkwasea hɔn ekyir.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nsa yɛ ɔtwetwesifo, nsadzen ma nyimpa yɛ gyigyeegye: Na obiara a ɔtɔ mu ntentan no, onnyim nyansa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhen no ho hu tse dɛ awendadze a ɔropɔw: Nyia oyi no ebufuw no, ɔyɛ noara no nkwa bɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔyɛ enyimnyam ma nyimpa dɛ ɔtwe noho fi manso ho: Na ɔkwasea biara dze, ɔpɛ ɔham.
title: PROVERBS

text: Awɔwber ntsi onyihanyi nnkɔdɔw; Dɛm ntsi twaber mu ɔbɛserɛserɛ, naaso onnkenya hwee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa akoma mu pɔwbɔ tse dɛ esubun; Na nyia ɔwɔ ntseasee no na ɔbɔtow.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa pii bɔbɔ hɔnankasa hɔn ayamuyie dawur: Naaso nyimpa nokwafo dze, woana bohu no?
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa tsenenee a ɔnam n’emudzi mu no, Esiarfo nye ne mba a wodzi n’ekyir.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhen a ɔtse asɛndzii egua do no, Ɔdze n’enyiwa bɔ mbusu nyina petse.
title: PROVERBS

text: Woana botum aka dɛ, Matsew m’akoma mu, Mo ho efir efi mo bɔn ho?
title: PROVERBS

text: Nkerii ahorow, na esusudze ahorow, Emu ebien nyinara yɛ EWURADZE n’ekyiwadze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Abofra mpo, wɔdze ne nyɛe hu no, Sɛ n’edwuma ho tsew o, sɛ ɔtsen o.
title: PROVERBS

text: Asowa a ɔtse, na enyiwa a ohu, Emu ebien nyina so mpo EWURADZE yɛe.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mmpɛ nda, amma eenndzi hia: Bue w’enyiwa, na ibenya ndzepa pii edzi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Adzegyangyan a, adzegyangyan a, ɔdzetɔfo na ɔse: Na sɛ otwa noho kɔ pɛ, nna orutuw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sika wɔ hɔ, na mbota pii so: Naaso nyimdzee kasa dze, ɔyɛ edwindze a ɔsom bo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Fa nyia odzi ahɔho egyinamu no n’efuradze; Na fa nyia odzi ahɔho egyinamu si ahoba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Akɔhwi edziban yɛ nyimpa bi dɛw; Na n’ekyir no mbosaabo bɛhyɛ n’anomu ma.
title: PROVERBS

text: Tsirmpɔw biara wɔdze egyinatu si no gyinae: Na fa nyansa apam kyer ɔsa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia okyimakyima dɛ afakɔafaba no, ɔda esumasɛm edzi: Dɛm ntsi mma nnye nyia obue n’ano tɛtɛɛtɛr no ndzi afora.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a ɔdom ne na anaa n’egya no, Wobodum ne kandzea wɔ sum kebii mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbɛhyɛ ase enya egyapadze ntsɛntsɛm dze; Naaso n’ewiei nnkɛyɛ siar.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma ɔwoara nnse dɛ, Mubotua bɔn kaw: Twer EWURADZE, na obedzi ama wo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nkerii ahorow, EWURADZE n’ekyiwadze a: Na nsisi nsɛn nnye.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa n’anamɔntu biara fir EWURADZE; Nyimpa bɛyɛ dɛn koraa atse no kwan ase?
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔyɛ efir ma nyimpa dɛ ɔbɔbɔ anohoba efuraado dɛ, Krɔnkrɔn a, Na anohoba no ekyir no ansaana ɔadwendwen ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhen nyansafo huw emumuyɛfo do, Na wɔdze ewuporow hwiir dua hɔn do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa no sunsum yɛ EWURADZE ne kandzea, Ɔhwehwɛ yafun mu mpiatun nyinara mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbɔbɔrhu na nokwar kora ɔhen do: Na mbɔbɔrhu suo n’ahengua mu gyina.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mberantsɛ enyimnyam nye hɔn ahoɔdzen: Na nkɔdaa hɔn ahoɔfɛw nye hɔn tsigon.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbaa a opirapira no, ɔhohor mbusu: Na ɔhwe bɔ wura nyimpa mu siesie no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhen n’akoma wɔ EWURADZE nsamu dɛ esutsen: Ɔdan no fa mbrɛ ɔpɛ biara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa no kwan tsen wɔ noara n’enyiwa do: Naaso EWURADZE na oker akoma hwɛ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Pɛrpɛryɛ na atsɛmbu Sɔ EWURADZE enyi sen afɔrbɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyi a ɔtra no ntɔn, na ntsɛn akoma, Mekyerɛ emumuyɛfo kwan no dze, ɔyɛ bɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbɔdzembɔ adwen dze adze dodow nko ba: Na obiara a ɔpɛ ntsɛm no, ɔpɛ ntsɛm kedzi hia ara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Akoradze a wɔdze ator tɛkyerɛma nya no, Ɔyɛ ehubɔhubɔw a oridzi akɔnaaba; hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ no wɔhwehwɛ owu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emumuyɛfo hɔn akakabensɛm bɛpra hɔn akɔ; Osiandɛ wɔpow dza ɔtsen.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia wɔdze afɔdzi asoa no no, no kwan kyeakyea koraa: Na ɔhotseweenyi dze, n’edwuma tsen.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdan etsifi duodoo mu ne tsena ye Sen dɛ enye ɔbaa a ohwinhwin bɛtsena ɔdan kɛse mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Omumuyɛfo ne kra pɛ mbusu: Na nyia ɔnye no tse fie no nnya n’enyim enyimpa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ wɔtsea ɔtwetwesinyi a, atsetsekwaa hu nyansa: Na sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ onyansafo a, ne nsa ka nyimdzee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi gyen n’enyi hwɛ emumuyɛfo fie; Mbrɛ wobutuw emumuyɛfo kɔ hɔn sɛɛe mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia osisiw n’aso wɔ abɔbɔfo su ho no, No so bosu ara, naaso wɔnnkɛgye no do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nsumaa mu akyɛdze pata ebufuw, Na akoko mu ayɛyɛdze pata ebufuhyew.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔyɛ ɔtseneneenyi enyigye dɛ obobu atsɛn tsenenee; Naaso ɔyɛ ɔsɛɛ ma emumuyɛfo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa a ɔwonawona fi ntseasee kwan do no, Ɔnye ewufo mboanofo bɛtsena.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔpɛ agofɛw no, ɔbɛyɛ hianyi: Nyia ɔpɛ nsa na ngo no, onnkenya noho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Omumuyɛnyi yɛ asadze ma ɔtseneneenyi; Na nkontompɔtwanyi besi ɔtseneneenyi n’ananmu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Asaase sar do tsena ye, Sen dɛ enye ɔbaa a ohwinhwin na no bo nndwe no ho bɛtsena.
title: PROVERBS

text: Akoradze a ɔsom bo na ngo wɔ onyansafo ne tsenabea; Na ɔkwasea dze ɔmemen.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia odzi ndzeyɛtsenenee na mbɔbɔrhu ekyir no Onya nkwa, ndzeyɛtsenenee, na enyidzi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Onyansafo fow akatakyi hɔn kurow, Na ɔbrɛ no mu awerɛhyɛmu ho ahoɔdzen no adze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia osie n’ano na ne tɛkyerɛma no, Osie ne kra fi ɔfona ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ntsɛntsɛnnyi na ɔhopɔwnyi no, ne dzin dze ɔtwetwesinyi, Ɔyɛ edwuma wɔ ntsɛn ahopɔw mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwadwefo n’akɔndɔ na oku no; Osiandɛ ne nsa pow edwumayɛ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obi wɔ hɔ a n’enyi ber adze yerɛyerɛw adzekyee nyina: Na ɔtseneneenyi dze, ɔdze ma na ɔnnkam do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Omumuyɛfo n’afɔrbɔdze yɛ ekyiwadze: Na akantam dɛ ɔdze adwembɔn na ɔdze reba!
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdasefo torfo bɛhera: Na nyia otsie no dze, ɔbɛkasa dɛ obi runntwar n’ano.
title: PROVERBS

text: Omumuyɛfo pirim n’enyim: Na tɔɔtsenyɛnyi dze, ɔhyehyɛ n’akwan.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyansa anaa ntseasee Anaa apam biara nnyi hɔ tsia EWURADZE.
title: PROVERBS

text: Wosiesie ɔpɔnkɔ ma ɔko da: Naaso konyimdzi dze, ofir EWURADZE hɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dzin pa ye dɛ wɔsan mu yi sen ahonya kɛse, Na enyimpa ye sen dwetɛ na sika.
title: PROVERBS

text: Adze kor bi yɛ dansewa wɔ obirɛmpɔn na ɔkɔhweaban ho: EWURADZE nye hɔn nyina hɔn yɛfo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbadwembanyi hu mbusu, na ɔdze noho suma: Na adwenharnyi dze, ɔnam n’enyim araa kɔtɔ mbusu no mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ahobrɛadze n’akatua na EWURADZE ho suro Nye ahonya, enyidzi, na nkwa tsentsen.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nsoɛ na mfir wɔ kɔntɔnkyenyi no no kwan do: Nyia osie ne kra no dze, ɔnye hɔn ntamu bɔtwe.
title: PROVERBS

text: Tsetse abofra wɔ ɔkwan a ɔsɛ dɛ ɔfa do no do, Na sɛ onyin mpo a, ɔnnkɛdan efi ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obirɛmpɔn dzi ɔkɔhweaban do tum, Na ɔdzefirfo yɛ akowaa ma ɔdzefɛmfo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia odua emumuyɛ no obubu mbusu Na n’ebufuw abaa no behi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔwɔ ayamuyie enyiwa no, wobehyira no; Osiandɛ ɔdze n’edziban bi ma ehiafo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Yi ɔtwetwesinyi no edzi, na aperper befi hɔ akɔ; Nyew, mansotwe na adapaa begyaa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔdɔ akoma mu krɔnkrɔnyɛ no, N’ano kasa yɛ dɛw ntsi, ɔhen bɛfa no nyɛnko.
title: PROVERBS

text: EWURADZE n’enyiwa kora nyia ɔwɔ nyimdzee, Na nkontompɔtwanyi ne nsɛm dze, obutuw no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwadwefo dɛ, Ogyata wɔ abowano: Wobedzi me ewu wɔ abrɔn do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbaa asansafo ano yɛ mona dɔnkuronn: Nyia EWURADZE no werɛ apow no no, ɔkɔhwe mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nkwaseadze wɔ abofra n’akoma mu; Na ntsea abaa na obotu ase koraa efi no mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔhaw ɔbɔbɔfo dze dɔr ne mfaso no, Na nyia ɔdze ma ɔhonyanyi no, obedzi hia ara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Kyɛn w’aso, na tsie enyansafo nsɛm, Na fa w’akoma ma me nyimdzee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ɔyɛ adze a oye dɛ edze besie wo mu, Dɛ wɔdze ne nyina bɔbɔ mu afam w’ano.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma edze wo werɛ bɛhyɛ EWURADZE mu no, Makyerɛ wo ndɛ da yi, nyew, ɔwoara a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ana mennkyerɛɛw wo nsɛm eduasa a odzi mu Wɔ apam na nyimdzee ho;
title: PROVERBS

text: Ama eehu nokwasɛm no nokwar a ɔyɛ, Ama edze nokwasɛm aasan akɛma hɔn a wɔsoma wo?
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnwia ɔbɔbɔfo, osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔbɔbɔfo ntsi, Eso mma nntseetsee amandzehunyi wɔ kuropon mu:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na EWURADZE bedzi hɔn asɛm ama hɔn, Na hɔn a wɔfa hɔn afo no, ɔbɛfa hɔn kra afo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mmfa nyimpa a ɔyɛ ebufuw ebufuw no nyɛnko; Na mma nnye nyimpa a ɔwɔ ebufuhyew no nnkɔ:
title: PROVERBS

text: Amma eennsua n’akwan, Na eennsua efir amma wo kra.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnyɛ hɔn a wodzi egyinamu ma binom no mu bi Anaa hɔn a wodzi akagyinamu mu baako:
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ innyi dza edze botua a, Wo mpa a eda do mpo, wobeyi efi w’ase?
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnyi tsetse ɔhe a W’egyanom dze esi hɔ no mmfi hɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ana ehu obi a ɔyɛ nsi wɔ n’edwuma mu a? Obegyina ahemfo enyim. Na onnkegyina mpapahwekwa enyim da.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ enye obirɛmpɔn kɛtsena edzidzii a, Dwendwen dza osi w’enyim no ho yie;
title: PROVERBS
