text: Na sɛ eyɛ otumfur a, Ɔno edze sekan bɛhyɛ wo meneba mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma wo kɔn nndɔ n’adɔkɔdɔkɔdze no; Osiandɛ ɔyɛ ndaadaa edziban.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mmfona woho dɛ ebɛyɛ ɔhonyanyi; Gyaa woara wo nyansaa ekyir dzi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ana edze w’enyiwa besi dza onnyi hɔ do? Na ampaara dɛ ahonya fuw atsaban Dɛ ɔkɔr a otu fa sor.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nndzi nyia ɔwɔ enyi bɔn no n’edziban, Eso mma wo kɔn nndɔ n’adɔkɔdɔkɔdze no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na mbrɛ ɔdwendwen wɔ no mu no, mbrɛ ɔtse ara nye no: Ɔka kyerɛ wo dɛ, Dzidzi na nom; Naaso ommfi n’akoma mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Trɔma a edzi no, ebɛfe egu, Na ayew wo nsɛm dɛɛdɛw no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnkasa ma ɔkwasea nntse; Na obobu wo nsɛm mu nyansa no enyimtsia.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnyi tsetse ɔhe no mmfi hɔ; Na mma nnkɛfa egyanka no kwa mu ndɔbaa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na hɔn pomfo no yɛ otumfo; Obedzi hɔn asɛm etsia wo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Fa w’akoma ma nkyerɛkyerɛ, Na w’aso ma nyimdzee nsɛm.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mmfa asotwe nnkam abofra: Osiandɛ sɛ edze abaa hwe no a, onnkowu bi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔwo dze, fa abaa hwe no, Na gye ne kra fi samanadze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, sɛ w’akoma hu nyansa a, Emi mara so mpo, m’akoma enyi bɛgye.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyew, me nsɛbɛ ho bɛsɛpɛw no, Sɛ w’ano ka dza ɔfata a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mma w’akoma n’enyiwa mmber ndzebɔnyɛfo: Na ɔwo dze, tsena EWURADZE ho suro mu adzekyee nyina:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ampaara akatua wɔ hɔ, Na w’enyidado nnkotwa tsia.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, tsie na hu nyansa, Na gya w’akoma kɔ kwan no mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mmfa woho mmfora asabokwafo mu; Honam ho edzifodzepɛfo no mu:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ɔsabokwafo na otumfur dze, wobedzi hia: Na nkomtɔ dze ntangow bofura nyimpa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Yɛ aso ma w’egya a ɔwoo wo no, Na sɛ wo na yɛ aberwa mpo a, mma mmbu no enyimtsia.
title: PROVERBS

text: Tɔ nokwar, na mma nntɔn; Nyew, nyansa, na nkyerɛkyerɛ, na ntseasee so.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi n’egya bedzi ehurusi kɛsenara: Na nyia ɔwo ɔba nyansafo no, obedzi no ho dɛw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ma w’egya na wo na hɔn enyi ngye, Na ma ɔbaa a ɔwoo wo no ondzi ehurusi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, fa w’akoma ma me, Na ma w’enyiwa ngye m’akwan mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na odwamamfo yɛ mona dɔnkuronn; Na ɔbaa sansanyi yɛ bura heaheabaa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ampaara, ɔkɔ atsɛwee dɛ odwotwafo, Na ɔma nkontompɔtwafo dɔɔ so wɔ adasa mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Woana na ɔwɔ mbusu? Woana na ɔwɔ awerɛhow? Woana na ɔwɔ aperper? Woana na ɔwɔ nkɔmbɔdzi? Woana na ɔwɔ epirakur a onnyi ase? Woana na ɔwɔ enyiwa a ayɛ kɔɔ?
title: PROVERBS

text: Hɔn a wokyinkyim nsa ho no a; Hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ aforafora nsa no a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnhwɛ nsa aber a ɔayɛ kɔɔ no, Na orutwa no ho wɔ kɔɔpow mu no, Ber a orisian tromm no:
title: PROVERBS

text: Osiandɛ ewiei no ɔsɔw dɛ ɔwɔ, Na ɔbɔ dɛ ehurutsia.
title: PROVERBS

text: W’enyiwa bɔhwɛ ananadze, Na w’akoma bɛka akɔntɔnkyesɛm.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyew, ebɛyɛ dɛ nyia ɔda epo finimfin, Anaadɛ nyia ɔda hɛn mu frankadua etsifi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ebɛka dɛ, Wɔabɔbɔ me, na annka me; Wɔabor me, naaso manntse: Ebɛn aber na mibenyan? Ama maakɔhwehwɛ so bio.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma w’enyiwa mmber emumuyɛfo, Eso mma wo kɔn nndɔ dɛ enye hɔn bɛtsena:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na hɔn akoma susu amenhyɛ, Na hɔn ano ka ebususɛm.
title: PROVERBS

text: Wɔdze nyansa si ɔdan; Na wɔdze ntseasee ma otsim:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na nyimdzee na wɔdze hyehyɛ adanmudze amaama, Ahonya a ɔsom bo na ɔyɛ fɛw a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Onyansafo no ho yɛ dzen; Nyew, onyimdzefo to n’ahoɔdzen mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na edze nyansa apam bɛkyer wo sa: Na apamfo dodow mu na amandwee wɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyansa krɔn bor ɔkwasea do dodow: Ommbue n’ano wɔ kuropon ano.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔdwendwen emumuyɛ ne yɛ ho no, Adasa bɛfrɛ no obusuyɛfo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwasea n’adwembɔn a: Na ɔtwetwesinyi yɛ ekyiwadze ma adasa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ etɔ bahaw wɔ ahohia da mu a, W’ahoɔdzen suar.
title: PROVERBS

text: Gye hɔn a wɔtwe hɔn kɔ owu mu no, Na hɔn a aka hɔn na owu no, hwɛ sianka hɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ edɛ, Hwɛ, yeennhu yi a: Ana nyia oker akoma no so nndwen ho? Na nyia osie wo kra no, ana no so onnyim? Ana onnkotua nyimpa biara n’edwuma ho kaw ama no?
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, dzi ewo, na oye; Na wokyɛm a ɔyɛ w’anomu fenemfenem no:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔno na ibohu nyansa dze ama wo kra: Sɛ inya ihu a, nna ibenya akatua, Na w’enyidado nnkotwa tsia.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ao omumuyɛnyi, mma nnkɔ ɔtseneneenyi ne tsenabea atsɛwee; Mma nnsɛɛ n’ahomgyebea:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ɔtseneneenyi hwe ase mpɛn esuon, naaso ɔsoɛr bio: Na emumuyɛfo dze, mbusu butuw hɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ wo tamfo hwe ase a, mma nndzi ehurusi, Na sɛ wofintsiw a, mma w’akoma enyi nngye.
title: PROVERBS

text: Amma EWURADZE eennhu, na ɔaannyɛ no ebufuw, Na ɔaanndan n’ebufuw emmfi no do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnhaw woho wɔ ndzebɔnyɛfo ntsi; Eso mma w’enyi mmber emumuyɛfo:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na omumuyɛnyi nnkenya akatua biara; Emumuyɛfo kandzea bodum.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, suro EWURADZE na ɔhen: Mma mmfa woho mmfora hɔn a wɔtsew etua no:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na hɔn mbusu bɔsoɛr awerɛfir mu; Na woana nyim afanu nyina hɔn sɛɛe?
title: PROVERBS

text: Iyinom so yɛ enyansafo nsɛm. Nyimpa enyimhwɛ wɔ atsɛmbu mu nnye.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔka kyerɛ omumuyɛnyi dɛ, Eyɛ tseneneenyi no, Aman bɔdom no, amanaman bekyir no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ enyigye ama hɔn a wotwuw n’enyim no, Na nhyira papa bɛba hɔn do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔma mbuae pa no, Ɔfew ano.
title: PROVERBS

text: Siesie w’edwuma wɔ hamu, Na yɛ wo kwa yie; Na ekyir no si wo dan.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nndzi dase nntsia wo nyɛnko kwa; Na mma mmfa w’ano nndaadaa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnse dɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ ɔno ɔdze ayɛ me no, mo so mebɛyɛ no dɛmara; Mbrɛ nyimpa n’edwuma tse no ara na mubotua no kaw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Hwɛ, mukotwaa mu wɔ ɔkwadwefo no kwa ho Na nyimpa a onnyi nyimdzee no wenyin ture ho;
title: PROVERBS

text: Na, hwɛ, no mu nyinara efuw nsoɛ, Na nsason akata n’enyi, Na n’abo fasu no ebubu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔno na mohwɛe, na modwendwen ho yie: Muhunii, na mefaa mu nyansa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nda kakra so bio, nkomtɔ kakra, Pon wo nsa kakra na da hwɛ ɛ:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔno na wo hia bɛba dɛ owifo, Na w’ahokyer dɛ ɔbarimba a oemia.
title: PROVERBS

text: Iyinom so nye Solomon ne mbɛbusɛm a Judahen Hezekia ne mbarimba fae kyerɛwee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn n’enyimnyam dɛ ɔkata adze do: Na ahemfo hɔn enyimnyam nye dɛ wɔmpɛnsapɛnsa asɛm mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ ɔsor no krɔn a ɔkrɔn, na asaase no dɔ a ɔdɔ tse no: Dɛmara na ahemfo akoma nnyi mpɛnsampɛnsamu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Yi dwetɛ mu fi no, Na egudze fi odwimfo hɔ bopue:
title: PROVERBS

text: Yi omumuyɛnyi fi ɔhen enyim, Na n’ahengua betsim ndzeyɛtsenenee mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnhyehyɛ woho wɔ ɔhen enyim, Na mma nnkegyina ekunyin ananmu:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na oye dɛ wɔbɛse wo dɛ, Bra sor ha; Sen dɛ wɔbɛbrɛ wo adze wɔ ɔhen a W’enyiwa tua no no enyim.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mmpɛ ntsɛm mmfir edzi nnkɔko, Ɔno bɛyɛ na irunnhu mbrɛ n’ewiei no ebɛyɛ, Ber a wo nyɛnko egu w’enyim ase no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enye wo nyɛnko noara ndzi w’asɛm a enye no wɔ dzi no, Na mma nnda esumasɛm edzi nkyerɛ obi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Amma nyia ɔbɛtse no aannyeyaw wo, Na wo nsopaa annyɛ kɛse.
title: PROVERBS

text: Asɛm a wɔka no enyiwa do no, Ɔtse dɛ sika eduaba a ɔwɔ dwetɛ kɛntsɛn mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ sika asowamuadze, na sika mapa ntweaban tse no, Dɛmara so na onyimkafo onyansafo tse ma asowa a ɔyɛ setsie.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ otwaber mu nsukwankyɛba n’awɔw tse no, Dɛmara so na ɔbɔfo nokwafo tse ma hɔn a wɔsoma no; Osiandɛ ɔdwedwe no wuranom hɔn kra.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ nsuwusiw na mframa a ɔnntɔ nsu tse no, Dɛmara so na nyia ɔdze akyɛdze hun tuw noho no tse.
title: PROVERBS

text: Abotaryɛ tsentsen na wɔdze dan ɔtsɛmbufo n’adwen, Na tɛkyerɛma bɔkɔɔ bubu mbiew.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ana enya ewo? Dzi dodow a ɔbɔso wo; Amma eennyi wo, na aammfe enngu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mma wo nan nnyɛ wo nyɛnko fie ntsiantsia; Amma wo ho aannyɛ no mfon, na oeennkyir wo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa a odzi ne nyɛnko ho dasewia no, Ɔyɛ dua hamɛr, na nkrantsee, na egyen menaba hwironhwirom.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ndabrabanyi no mu awerɛhyɛmu wɔ ɔfona da mu, Ɔtse dɛ ese a ebu, na anan a ehuan.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ obi a oyi noho efuradze wɔ awɔwber mu, na mbrɛ pirakur do nsayerɛyerɛw tse no, Dɛmara na nyia ɔtow ndwom kyerɛ awerɛhow akoma tse.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ ɔkɔm dze wo tamfo a, ma no edziban ma ondzi; Na sɛ nsukɔm dze no a, ma no nsu ma ɔnnom:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ɔwo ebɔsɔ gyansenama egu n’etsifi, Na EWURADZE bɛhyɛ wo ananmu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Kwaamu ehum dze nyankom ba: Dɛmara so na nsekubɔ tɛkyerɛma dze ebufuhyew ba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dan etsifi duodoo mu ne tsena ye Sen dɛ enye ɔbaa a ohwinhwin bɛtsena dan kɛse mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ nsu nwin tse ma ɔkra a ɔrehaahaw no, Mbrɛ nsɛmpa a ofi ekyirekyir man mu tse ara nye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ nsunyiwa a afon, na mbasu a asɛɛ tse no, Dɛmara so na ɔtseneneenyi a ogyaa mu ma emumuyɛfo tse.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ewo pii ne dzi nnye: Dɛm ntsi enyimnyam a adasa wɔhwehwɛ ma hɔnho no, ɔnnyɛ enyimnyam.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia onntum nnhyɛ noho do no, Ɔtse dɛ kuropɔn a edwuruw na onnyi fasu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ ɔhyewber mu esukwankyɛba tse, na mbrɛ otwaber mu nyankom tse no, Mbrɛ enyidzi so mmfata ɔkwasea ara nye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ ɔsorɔm a orututu fɛm fɛm tse, na mbrɛ akyemfowa a orututu tse no, Mbrɛ duabɔ a onnyi ntseasee so nnkɛyɛ edwuma ara nye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Pɔnkɔbaa fata ɔpɔnkɔ, menyiamfrɛ fata asoasopɔnkɔ, Na abaa fata nkwasea hɔn ekyir.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnsusu ɔkwasea no nkwaseasɛm do mmbua no, Amma wo so annyɛ dɛ ɔnoara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Bua ɔkwasea wɔ no nkwaseasɛm ho, Amma ɔannyɛ noara n’enyiwa do onyansafo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔdze asɛm suma ɔkwasea no, Otwitwa nankasa ne nan, na ɔnom mbusu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ apakye ne nan sensɛn hɔ no: Dɛmara so na abɛbusɛm tse wɔ ɔkwasea n’anomu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ aboɔdzembo kotoku a ɔhyɛ abo ntamu tse no, Mbrɛ nyia ɔma ɔkwasea enyidzi tse so ara nye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ nsoɛ si kohwira sabokwanyi ne nsamu no, Dɛmara so na abɛbusɛm tse wɔ nkwasea anomu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ egyentofo pirapira nyimpa no, Dɛmara na nyia ɔbɔ ɔkwasea paa na nyia ɔbɔ ɔkwantsemfo paa tse ara nye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ bɔdɔm san kɔ ne fe ho no, Dɛmara na ɔkwasea si do yɛ no nkwaseadze ara nye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ana ihu nyimpa a noara obu noho onyansafo? Ɔkwasea ho wɔ enyidado sen no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwadwefo dɛ, Ogyata wɔ ɔkwan mu: Ogyata wɔ abɔntsen do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ abow twa noho apontsɛr do no, Mbrɛ ɔkwadwefo so da ne mpa do ara nye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwadwefo dze ne nsa nu nkwansɛn mu; Naaso haw n’enyi dɛ ɔdze bɛsan n’anomu bio.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwadwefo bu nankasa noho onyansafo Sen nyimpa beesuon a wotum kyerɛkyerɛ asɛm ase.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwantsennyi a ɔhaw noho wɔ aperper a ɔmmfa no ho mu no, Ɔtse dɛ obi a osuo bɔdɔm n’asowa mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ ogyimfo a ɔtotow gyantsia, Egyen menaba, na owu gugu tse no,
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ nyimpa a ɔdaadaa ne nyɛnko, Na ɔka dɛ, Ana nnyɛ agor na miridzi bi a, tse ara nye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyena sa a, ogya dum: Na bɔtomkɛka nnyi hɔ a, mansotwe gyaa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ biriw tse ma ogyansenama, na enyena tse ma ogya no, Mbrɛ ɔmansotwenyi sɔ aperper mu ogya ara nye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Bɔtomkɛkanyi ne nsɛm tse dɛ ntrɔma dɛɛdɛw, Na osian kɔ yafun mpiatun no ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ano hyeehyew na akoma bɔn Tse dɛ dɛtse kuraba a wɔdze dwetɛ dutu edura ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔtan obi no, ɔdze n’ano kata do, Na no mu dze, ɔprapra ndaadaa boa ano:
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ ɔkasa dɛɛdɛw a, mma nngye no nndzi; Na n’akoma mu wɔ ekyiwadze esuon.
title: PROVERBS

text: Kaansa enyitan dze ndaadaa kata noho mpo a, Wɔbɛda n’emumuyɛ no edzi akyerɛ mboanofo no petee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a otu mona no, ɔbɔtɔ mu ara: Na nyia opirepirew ɔbo no, ɔbɛsan aba no do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Tɛkyerɛma torfo kyir hɔn a oepirapira hɔn no, Na ndzɛfɛdzɛfɛw ano dze ɔsɛɛ ba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mmfa ɔkyena nntuw woho; Na innyim dza eda no dze bɛba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ma obi nkamfo wo, na nnyɛ woara w’ano a; Ɔhɔho ei, na nnyɛ woara w’anofamfa bi a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbo yɛ dur, na anhwea yɛ pembɔɔ; Naaso ɔkwasea n’ebufuw yɛ dur sen ebien nyina.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ebufuhyew yɛ etsirmɔdzen, na ebufuw yɛ ewurkadze; Na woana na obotum egyina nyinkun enyim?
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyimka petee ye Sen ɔdɔ a ohuntsa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔnyɛnko pira wo a, ɔyɛ nokwar: Na ɔtamfo ne mfewano dze, ndaadaa a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkra a ɔamee tsiatsia wokyɛm do, Na ɔkra a ɔkɔm dze no dze, adze wenwen biara yɛ no dɛw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ anoma a ofi ne berɛbuw mu kyinkyin tse no, Mbrɛ nyimpa so a ofi ne fie kyinkyin tse ara nye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ngo na eduhuam ma akoma dzi ehurusi: Mbrɛ nyimpa ne nyɛnko ho dɛw a ofi apam a ofi akoma mu so tse ara nye no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mmpa woara wo nyɛnko, na w’egya ne nyɛnko; Na mma nnkɛhɛn wo nua fie wɔ wo mbusu da no mu: Ɔnyɛnko a ɔbɛn no, oye sen onua a ɔwɔ ekyirekyir.
title: PROVERBS

text: Me ba, hu nyansa, ma m’akoma ntɔ me yamu, Ama meenya bi ebua nyia ogu m’enyim ase no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbadwembanyi hu mbusu, na osuma noho: Na adwenharfo dze, wotwa mu, na wohu ho amandze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Fa nyia odzi ɔhɔho egyinamu no n’efuradze; Na fa nyia odzi ɔbaa sansanyi egyinamu no si ahoba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔsoɛr anapahema dze ndze kɛse hyira ne nyɛnko no, Wobobu no ndom ama no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Esusow dzendzen ber mu daa nsosɔwee Na ɔbaa a ohwinhwin, wɔsɛ pɛr:
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔpɛ dɛ osianka no no, osianka mframa, Na ne nsa nyimfa mu ngo sɔnsɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dadze sew dadze ano; Dɛmara so na nyimpa sew ne nyɛnko enyim.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔhwɛ adɔmbadua do no, obedzi n’aba bi; Na nyia ɔsom no wura no, wobedzi no nyi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ enyim kyerɛ enyim wɔ nsu mu no, Dɛmara so na nyimpa akoma kyerɛ nyimpa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Samanadze na owumona wɔmmee ara da; Dɛmara so na nyimpa n’enyiwa mmee ara da.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ogya na wɔdze sɔ sika na dwetɛ hwɛ, Na nyimpa dze, wɔdze n’ayɛyi sɔ no hwɛ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Kaansa edze dwomba bɔwɔw ɔkwasea wɔ wɔdur mu afora ewu mu mpo a, No nkwaseadze nnkefi no ho ara da.
title: PROVERBS

text: Bɔ mbɔdzen hu mbrɛ wo nguan ekuwekuw no tsetsee, Na hwɛ w’anantwi ekuwekuw no yie.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na ahonya nntsena hɔ daa; Na aso ahenkyɛw kyɛr kodu mbasantsen nyinara do?
title: PROVERBS

text: Wotwa nkyɛkyɛr, na nkyɛkyɛr momon so fefɛw, Na wɔboaboa mbepɔw do habanmba ano.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nguambaa wɔ hɔ ma w’efuradze, Na mpɔnkye yɛ haban ne tsibo:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na wobenya mpɔnkye enumfonsu a ɔbɔso w’edziban, na wo fiefo edziban; Na wo mbabaawa akɔhomabɔdze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Emumuyɛfo guan wɔ aber a nyimpa biara nntaa hɔn do: Na atseneneefo dze, wɔyɛ ndam dɛ ogyata.
title: PROVERBS

text: Asaase do mbrato ntsi na no mu ahemfo dɔɔ so: Na ɔnam nyimpa ntseaseefo na nyimdzefo do na n’ahendzi bɛkyɛr.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ohianyi a ɔhaw ɔbɔbɔfo no Ɔtse dɛ nsu a ɔpra adze kɔ na ɔmma edziban mmba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Hɔn a wɔpow mbra no woyi emumuyɛfo ayɛw: Na hɔn a wosie mbra no dze, wɔnye hɔn dzi aperper.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ebusuyɛfo nntse atsɛmbu ase: Na hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE ekyir kwan no dze, wɔtse adze nyina ase.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbɔbɔfo a ɔnam n’emudzi mu no ye Sen nyia ɔkyea wɔ n’akwan mu, kansɛ ɔyɛ obirɛmpɔn mpo a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a odzi mbra do no, ɔyɛ ɔba nyansafo: Na nyia ɔnye etumfur fa nyɛnko no, ogu n’egya n’enyim ase.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔdze nsiho na apempensi dɔr n’ahodze no, Ɔboaboa ano ma nyia ohu ɔbɔbɔfo mbɔbɔr.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔdan n’aso fi mbra ne tsie ho no, Ne mpaabɔ mpo yɛ ekyiwadze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a ɔma tɔɔtsenyɛnyi tɔ kwan bɔn mu dɔnsuar no, Nankasa ɔbɔtɔ noara no mona no mu: Na hɔn a wodzi mu no dze, wobenya papa edzi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhonyanyi bu noara noho onyansafo; Na ɔbɔbɔfo a ɔwɔ ntseasee no, ɔhwehwɛ no mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ atseneneefo dzi nyim a, enyimnyam kɛse ba: Na sɛ emumuyɛfo soɛr dze a, adasa dze hɔnho suma.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔkata ne mbrato do no, ɔnnkɛyɛ prɔmprɔm: Na obiara a ɔka to gua na ɔpow no, obenya ehumbɔbɔr.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ahomkanyi nye nyimpa a osuro noho daa no: Na nyia opirim n’akoma no dze, ɔbɔtɔ mbusu mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ gyata a ɔropɔw, na osisi a origyam tse no, Dɛmara so na abɔbɔfo do ɔhen tsirmɔdzennyi tse.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhen a onnyi ntseasee no, na ɔhyɛ atseetsee kɛse so: Na nyia okyir enyiber no dze, ɔbɛma ne nda awar.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa a wɔdze obi no bɔgyaa asoa no no, Oboguan akɔtɔ mona mu; mma nyimpa biara nnsianka no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a ɔnantsew tɔɔtsen no, wɔbɛgye no nkwa, Na nyia ɔkyeakyea wɔ n’akwan mu no dze, ɔbɔhwe ase prɛko.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔdɔw n’asaase no, obenya edziban pii: Na nyia odzi akwasampafo ekyir no dze, obedzi hia ara yie.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔnokwafo ne nhyira bobu do: Na nyia ɔpɛ ntsɛm yɛ ɔhonyanyi no dze, ɔnnkɛfa noho tɔtrɔtɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa enyimhwɛ nnye: Anaaso dɛ nyimpa bɔfom wɔ edziban sin ntsi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔwɔ enyiwa bɔn no, ɔpɛ ntsɛm hwehwɛ ahonya, Naaso onnyim dɛ ohia bɛba no do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia otwuw nyimpa enyim no, n’ekyir no obenya enyimpa Asen nyia ɔdze ne tɛkyerɛma dzɛfɛdzɛfɛw no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a owiawia n’egya anaa ne na, na ɔdɛ, Ɔnnyɛ mbrato, no; Ɔno kor no ara ɔyɛ ɔsɛɛfo nyɛnko.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔwɔ edzifodzepɛ sunsum no, okenyan mansotwe: Na nyia ɔdze no werɛ hyɛ EWURADZE mu no dze, ɔbɔdɔ seradze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔtwer nankasa n’akoma no, ɔkwasea a: Na obiara a ɔnantsew nyansa mu no dze, wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔma ɔbɔbɔfo no, onnkehia da: Na nyia ohuntsa n’enyiwa no dze, obenya ndom pii.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ emumuyɛfo soɛr a, adasa dze hɔnho suma: Na sɛ wɔhera dze a, nna atseneneefo adɔɔ so.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia wɔka n’enyim pii naaso ɔkye no kɔn no, Wobobubu no awerɛfir mu a onnkenya ano edur.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ atseneneefo dzi tum a, ɔman no dzi ehurusi: Na sɛ omumuyɛnyi dzi tum dze a, ɔman no si nkrum.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a ɔdɔ nyansa no, ɔma n’egya dzi ehurusi: Na nyia ɔnye mbaa ehuhufo fa nyɛnko no, ɔsɛɛ n’ahodze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhen dze atsɛmbu ma asaase gyina: Na nyia odzi mboaba no, obutuw no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔdzɛfɛdzɛfɛw ne nyɛnko no, Osua n’anamɔn efir.
title: PROVERBS

text: Omumuyɛnyi ne mbrato mu wɔ efir: Na ɔtseneneenyi dze, ɔtow ndwom na odzi ehurusi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtseneneenyi hu ɔbɔbɔfo n’asɛm dzi ma no; Omumuyɛnyi nnyi ntseasee a ɔdze bohu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Atwetwesifo sɔ kurow mu ogya: Na enyansafo dze, woyi ebufuw fi hɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ onyansafo nye ɔkwasea nya asɛm, Na sɛ no bo fuw o, ɔserew o, ahomgye biara nnyi hɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Bɔgyakafo kyir nyia odzi mu: Na tɔɔtsenyɛnyi dze, wɔhwehwɛ no nkwa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkwasea da n’ebufuw nyina edzi: Na onyansafo dze, ɔma ɔka ekyir na ɔdwedwe no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ ɔpanyin tsie atorsɛm a, N’asomfo nyinara yɛ emumuyɛfo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Adze kor bi yɛ dansewa wɔ ohianyi na opoobɔnyi ho: EWURADZE na ɔtsew hɔn beenu nyina enyi do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhen a obu ɔbɔbɔfo atsɛn nokwar mu no, N’ahengua betsim hɔ daa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Abaa na nkaenyim ma nyansa: Na abofra a wɔato pansam dze, ɔhyɛ ne na enyito.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ emumuyɛfo dzi tum a, mbrato dɔɔ so: Naaso atseneneefo no bohu emumuyɛfo no hɔn asehwe.
title: PROVERBS

text: Twe wo ba n’aso, na ɔbɛma wo ahomgye; Nyew, ɔbɛma wo kra enyi agye.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ enyido adzehu nnyi no, nkorɔfo yɛ basabasa: Na nyia osie mbra no dze, ahomkanyi a.
title: PROVERBS

text: Wɔnndze anosɛm twe ɔsomfo aso: Na sɛ ɔtse ase mpo a, ɔmmfa nnyɛ hwee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ana ihu nyimpa a n’ano yɛ no har no a? Ɔkwasea mpo ho wɔ enyidado sen no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyia ɔdze nkakrankakra tsetse n’akowaa fitsi mbofraber mu no, Ekyirii obenya no ayɛ dɛ ɔba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ebufuwfafo huenyan mansotwe mu, Na ebufuhyewnyi ne mbrato bu do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa no nkontompɔ bɛbrɛ no adze: Na sunsum mu ahobrɛadzenyi no benya enyidzi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obiara a ɔnye owifo kyɛ adze no, okyir noara ne kra: Ɔtse ntanka, naaso ɔnnka hwee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyimpa ho suro sua efir: Na obiara a ɔdze no werɛ hyɛ EWURADZE mu no dze, ɔbɛyɛ sɔkyee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Dodowara hwehwɛ ɔhen n’enyimpa: Naaso nyimpa n’atsɛmbu dze, ofir EWURADZE hɔ ba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbrakyewnyi yɛ ekyiwadze ma atseneneefo: Na nyia ɔyɛ tɔɔtsen wɔ ɔkwan mu no dze, ɔyɛ ekyiwadze ma emumuyɛfo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Jakɛ ne ba Agur, ne nsɛm; Nkɔnhyɛsɛm no. Ɔbarimba no ka kyerɛ Itiel, ɔka kyerɛ Itiel na Ukal:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ampaara dɛ mayɛ mbowadze asen nyimpa biara, Nna minnyi nyimpa ne ntseasee:
title: PROVERBS

text: Na munnsuaa nyansa, Eso minnyi Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ho nyimdzee.
title: PROVERBS

text: Woana na ɔafow akɔ ɔsor, na ɔasan esian? Woana na ɔaboaboa mframa ano ekitsa? Woana na ɔabɔ nsu boa wɔ n’atar ano? Woana na ɔdze asaase ano nyinara etsintsim hɔ? Ne dzin dze dɛn, na ne ba ne dzin dze dɛn, sɛ inyim a ka ɛ?
title: PROVERBS

text: Nyankopɔn n’asɛm biara wɔasɔ ahwɛ: Ɔyɛ kyɛm ma hɔn a wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛ no mu no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mmfa biribi nnka ne nsɛm ho, Amma ɔaannka w’enyim, na woeennhu wo dɛ ɔtorfo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ndzɛmba ebien na mebisa no wo hɔ; Mma mmfa nnkam me ansaana mewu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Yi egyangyandze na atorsɛm fi me nkyɛn koraa: Mma mma me ohia anaa ahonya; Edziban a mihia ara na fa nyɛn me.
title: PROVERBS

text: Amma maammee, na mammpa wo, na mannse dɛ, EWURADZE so nye woana? Anaa menndzi hia, na mennwiawia adze, Na menngu me Nyankopɔn ne dzin ho fi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma nnsɛɛ akowaa nnkyerɛ no wura, Ɔno ɔbɔdom wo, na woebu wo fɔ.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ebusuasantsen bi wɔ hɔ a wɔdom hɔn egya, Na wonnhyira hɔn na.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ebusuasantsen bi wɔ hɔ a hɔn ho tsew hɔnara hɔn enyiwa do, Naaso nna wɔnnhohor hɔnho mmfii hɔn efifidze ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ebusuasantsen bi wɔ hɔ, ao mbrɛ hɔn enyi dua tra hɔn ntɔn a! Na hɔn enyisoatsɛw amema do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ebusuasantsen bi wɔ hɔ a hɔn se ayeyɛ dɛ nkrantsee na hɔn adadaw mu se ayeyɛ dɛ asekan, Dɛ wɔdze bɔwe abɔbɔfo efi asaase do, na ehiafo efi adasa mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Esukun wɔ mbabaa beenu a wɔkeka mu dɛ, Fa ma me, fa ma me. Ndzɛmba ebiasa na wɔwɔ hɔ a wɔmmee ara da, Nyew, baanan na wɔnnse dɛ, Ayɛ yie:
title: PROVERBS

text: Adakamona; na yafun bɔnyin; Asaase a nsu mmee no; Na ogya a ɔnnse dɛ, Ayɛ yie
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyiwa a osi n’egya atwetwe, Na obu ne na hɔ setsie enyimtsia no, Bɔnsa mu akonkoran botutu, Na ɔkɔrmba bedzi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ndzɛmba ebiasa na wɔwɔ hɔ a wɔyɛ me nwanwa dodow, Nyew, anan na minnyim:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔkɔr no kwan wɔ wimu; Abowatsena no kwan wɔ ɔbotan do; Nsuhɛn no kwan wɔ po mu; Na ɔbarimba no kwan wɔ akataasia ho.
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbrɛ ɔbaa awartofo no kwan tse ara nye no; Odzidzi, na ɔpepa n’ano, Na ɔka dɛ, Mommbɔɔ mbusu biara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ndzɛmba ebiasa ntsi na asaase wosow, Nyew, anan ntsi, na onntum nnsoa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Akowaa a oebedzi hen ntsi; Na ɔkwasea a oedzidzi amee;
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔbaa a onnyi ɔpɛfo na oenya kun; Na abaawa a odzi no wuraba adze.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ndzɛmba anan wɔ hɔ a wosusuar wɔ asaase do, Naaso wɔyɛ enyansafo ara mbordo:
title: PROVERBS

text: Mpataakowa yɛ kuw bi a hɔn ho nnyɛ dzen, Naaso wosiesie hɔn edziban wɔ ɔhyewber mu;
title: PROVERBS

text: Twambowa yɛ mbowa a wɔyɛ mberɛw, Naaso wɔyɛ hɔn adan wɔ abotan mu;
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbɛbɛw nnyi ɔhen, Naaso hɔn nyinara wɔnam ekuwekuw mu kɔ;
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔketsew a wotum dze nsa suo no mu, Naaso ɔwɔ ahemfie.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ndzɛmba ebiasa na wɔwɔ hɔ a wɔkyea wɔ nantsew mu, Ampaara, baanan na hɔn kɔsu yɛ fɛw:
title: PROVERBS

text: Ogyata a ɔyɛ mbowa nyinara mu ɔkatakyi, Na ɔnndan mmfi obiara enyim no;
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔsapɔnkɔ a n’asen emia; apɔnkyenyin so; Na ɔhen a obi nntsew no do etua.
title: PROVERBS

text: Sɛ ayɛ nkwaseadze na ama woho do, Anaa sɛ adwen ebusudze ho a, Ɔno fa wo nsa mua w’ano.
title: PROVERBS

text: Na numfonsu no bɔ na ɔma buter, Na hwen ne minkyimii na ɔma bɔgya: Dɛmara so na ebufuhyɛ ɔma aperper.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhen Lemuel ne nsɛm; nkɔnhyɛsɛm a ne na dze kyerɛɛ no no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Wɔyɛ no dɛn, me ba? Wɔyɛ no dɛn, ao me yafumba? Na wɔyɛ no dɛn, ao m’anohoba ba?
title: PROVERBS

text: Mma mmfa w’ahoɔdzen mma mbaa, Anaa w’akwan mma adze a ɔsɛɛ ahemfo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔmmfata ahemfo, ao Lemuel, ɔmmfata ahemfo dɛ wɔbɔnom nsa; Anaa mbapɔmba, dɛ wɔbɛse dɛ, Nsadzen wɔ hen o?
title: PROVERBS

text: Amma wɔaannom, na hɔn werɛ eemmfir mbra, Na wɔaanndan amandzehunyi biara n’atsɛmbu enyi.
title: PROVERBS

text: Wɔmfa nsadzen mma nyia aka no na owu no, Na nsa mma nyia no werɛ ahow no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Wɔmma ɔnnom, na no werɛ mfir ne hia, Na ɔnnkɛkaa n’amandzehu bio.
title: PROVERBS

text: Kasa ma hɔn a wonntum nnkasa mma hɔnho, Dzi hɔn a wɔadan hɔn egya nyinara asɛm.
title: PROVERBS

text: Bue w’ano, bua atsɛn tsenenee, Na dzi abɔbɔfo na ehiafo asɛm.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔyer nokwafo, woana benya? Na ne tsibo sen mbota koraa.
title: PROVERBS

text: No kun no werɛ hyɛ no mu, Na mfaso biara nnkɔbɔ no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔyɛ no kun yie na nnyɛ bɔn bi, No nkwa nda nyinara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhwehwɛ kuntu na asaaba, Na ɔdze ne nsa yɛ edwuma ɔpɛdo ara.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔtse dɛ eguadzifo nsuhɛn; Ɔdze edziban fi ekyirekyir ba.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔsoɛr so aber a adze nnyae nnkyee, Na ɔma ne fifo edziban, Na ɔdze mbaawa hɔn edwuma ma hɔn.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdwendwen haban ho, na ɔtɔ: Ɔdze ne nsaano aba tsetsɛw wenyin ture mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdze ahoɔdzen bɔ n’asen do, Na ɔhyɛ n’abaw mu dzen.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ohu dɛ n’eguadzi yɛ mfaso: Ne kandzea so nndum anadwe.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔdze ne nsa suo tadua mu, Na ne nsatseaba kosuo kyekyer no mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obue ne nsamu ma abɔbɔfo; Nyew, ɔtsen ne nsa ma ehiafo.
title: PROVERBS

text: Onnsuro esukwankyɛbaber mma ne fifo; Na ne fifo nyinara furafura serdaa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔyɛ nkuntu a woedzi mu edwin ma noho; N’efuradze yɛ ndwera pa na ɔberdum.
title: PROVERBS

text: Wonyim no kun wɔ kuropon ano, Wɔ ber a ɔtse asaase do ekunyin mu no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔpempam ndwera ntar na ɔtontɔn; Na ɔdze abɔyamu ma oguadzinyi no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ahoɔdzen na enyidzi nye n’efuradze; Na onnsuro mber a ɔwɔ n’enyim no.
title: PROVERBS

text: Obue n’ano nyansa mu; Na ayamuyie mbra wɔ ne tɛkyerɛma do.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔhwɛ ne fiemba akwan yie, Na onndzi akwadwer edziban.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ne mba bɔsoɛr, na wɔafrɛ no osiarfo; No kun so, oyi no ayɛw, dɛ,
title: PROVERBS

text: Mbaa pii na wɔayɛ no nokwardzi mu, Na ɔwo dze, esen hɔn nyinara koraa.
title: PROVERBS

text: Enyimpa ndaadaa a, na ahoɔfɛw so adze gyangyan a, Na ɔbaa a osuro EWURADZE no dze, ɔnoara na wobeyi no ayɛw.
title: PROVERBS

text: Wɔmma no ne nsaano aba bi; Na wɔmma no ndwuma nyi no ayɛw wɔ kuropon mu.
title: PROVERBS

text: Ɔsɛnkafo, David ne ba, Jerusalɛmhen no, ne nsɛm nye yi.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Egyangyandze mu egyangyandze, Ɔsɛnkafo no na ɔse; egyangyandze mu egyangyandze, ne nyinara egyangyandze a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mfaso bɛn na ɔdasanyi nya wɔ ne berɛ a ɔberɛ wɔ wi ase yi mu?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ebusuasantsen kor kɔ, na ebusuasantsen fofor so ba; naaso asaase dze otsim hɔ daa.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ewia so pue, na ewia kɔtɔ, na ɔgye ntsɛm kɔ bea a ofi do pue no do.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mfar bɔ kɔ pomu afamu, na ɔdan dze fa kwaamu afamu; odzi adandan daa wɔ ne nkyekyɛmu mu: na mfar san bio kɔ n’aprɔwbɔmu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Esutsen nyinara pem kɔ po mu, naaso po nnyɛ ma ara da; fakor a esutsen pem kɔ no, hɔ ara so na ɔkɔ bio.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Abrabɔ nyinara mu wɔ ɔberɛ ma; ɔdasanyi nnkotum ka: enyiwa mmee adzehwɛ, na asowa so nnhyɛ asɛntsie ma.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dza aba no, ɔnoara na ɔbɛba; na dza wɔayɛ noara na wɔbɛyɛ: na adze fofor biara nnyi wi yi ase.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ana biribi wɔ hɔ a adasa ka wɔ ho dɛ, Hwɛ, iyi dze fofor a? Ɔaba dada ana, wɔ tsetseber a abɛsen kɔ no mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nkaa bi nnyi hɔ ma ndzɛmba a asen kɔ no; na daakye ndzɛmba ɔbɛba a no so, nnkenya nkaa biara efi dza obesi ekyir aba no hɔ.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Emi, mara Ɔsɛnkafo, midzii Israel do hen wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na medze m’akoma nyinara tsiim do dɛ mobɔhwehwɛ na mehu dza wɔyɛ no asaase do nyinara mu: mekyerɛ ɔberɛ edwuma a Nyankopɔn dze ama adasamba dɛ wɔmfa mu no.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mehu dwuma a wodzi no wi ase nyinara; na, hwɛ, ne nyinara yɛ egyangyandze nye ɔberɛ gyan.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dza akyea no, wonnkotum atsen no: na dza efi mu no, wonnkotum dze afora akan.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Modwendween wɔ m’akoma mu dɛ, Hwɛ, menya nyansa kɛse akyɛn hɔn a wodzii m’enyim nyinara wɔ Jerusalɛm: nyew, m’akoma enya nyansa nye nyimdzee nhunii.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na medze m’akoma nyina hwehwɛɛ nyansa na nyimdzee mu, na maahwehwɛ abɔdam nye nkwaseasɛm so mu: na iyi so muhun dɛ ɔyɛ ɔberɛ gyan.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na nyansa mbordo mu wɔ awerɛhow dodow: na nyia ɔdɔr nyimdzee no, ɔdɔr awerɛhow.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mesee wɔ m’akoma mu dɛ, Afei mobɔsɔ enyigye ahwɛ dɛ mibenya ndzepa bi efi mu a; na, hwɛ, iyiara so mpo egyangyandze a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Muhun wɔ serew na enyigyedze ho dɛ ne nyina yɛ adze a ɔnnkye. Ebɛnadze na wɔwɔ dze ma?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mosɔe hwɛɛ wɔ m’akoma dɛ mubotum dze nsa agye mo honam enyi dɛ ɔkwasea, na ber kor no ara mu manantsew nyansa mu a. Nna mepɛ dɛ muhu dɛ oye ma adasamba dɛ wɔbɛyɛ dɛm wɔ wi yi ase hɔn nkwa nda nyinara mu a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Meyɛɛ mo ndwuma akɛse akɛse; misisii adan mefae; metsetsɛɛw wenyin nture fae;
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: meyeyɛɛ nture na enyigyekwaa fae, na metsetsɛɛw mu ndua a ɔsow eduaba horow nyinara;
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: meyeyɛɛ nsutaae fae, dɛ medze no mu nsu bi mubogugu kwaa a wɔnyɛn ndua wɔ mu no do:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: mototɔɔ nkowaa nye mfonabaa, na minyaa mba a wɔwowoe no so; eso minyaa anantwi nye nguan ekuwekuw akɛsenara seen hɔn a wodzii m’enyim kan wɔ Jerusalɛm nyinara:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: moboaboaa dwetɛ nye sika so ano fae, na ahemfo nye amansin akoradze soronko: minyaa mbanyin nye mbaa adwontofo, na adasamba hɔn enyigyedze, nwewefo burigyaa.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nna meyɛɛ ɔkɛse, na meyɛɛ ɔkɛse mbordo seen hɔn a wodzii m’enyim wɔ Jerusalɛm nyinara: eso me nyansaa tsenaa mo mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na dza m’enyiwa hwehwɛe biara, mammfa ennsuma no: mammfa enyigye biara annkam m’akoma, na m’akoma dzii ehurusi wɔ me berɛ nyinara ntsi; osiandɛ iyi nye me berɛ nyinara ho kyɛfa.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔno na mohwɛɛ ndwuma a me nsa yɛe nyinara, na ɔberɛ a meberɛe yɛe no: na, hwɛ, ne nyinara yɛ egyangyandze nye ɔberɛ gyan, na mfaso papa biara nnyi wi yi ase.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na mesanee dwendween nyansa, na abɔdam nye nkwaseasɛm ho: na ebɛnadze na nyimpa a obedzi ɔhen ekyir aba no botum ayɛ? Mekyerɛ adze a woewie yɛ dada no ara a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nna muhun dɛ saa nyansa mu wɔ mfaso sen nkwaseasɛm, dɛ mbrɛ kan mu wɔ mfaso sen sum no.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Onyansafo n’enyiwa wɔ ne tsir mu, naaso ɔkwasea dze, ɔnantsew sum mu. Na muhunii so dɛ esian kor no ara na osian hɔn nyinara.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔno na mekae wɔ m’akoma mu dɛ, Dza ɔba kwasea do no, mbrɛ ɔbɛba mo so mo do ara nye no; na ebɛnadze ntsi na muhun nyansa seen binom? Ɔno na mekae wɔ m’akoma mu, dɛ iyiara so mpo egyangyandze a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na nkaa biara nnyi hɔ daa mma onyansafo, dɛ ɔkwasea ara so; osiandɛ nda a ɔbɛba no mu no nna werɛ efir hɔn dada. Na hwɛ mbrɛ onyansafo dua wu dɛ ɔkwasea ara so!
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dɛm ntsi na mikyiir nkwa; osiandɛ dwuma a wodzi no wɔ wi ase no yɛɛ me awerɛhow: osiandɛ ne nyinara yɛ egyangyandze nye ɔberɛ gyan.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na mikyiir me berɛ nyinara a meberɛe wɔ wi ase: osiandɛ otwar dɛ medan migya nyimpa a obedzi m’ekyir aba no.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na woana nyim, dɛ ɔbɛyɛ onyansafo anaa ɔkwasea o? Naaso obedzi me berɛ nyinara a maberɛ na makyerɛ mu nyansa wɔ wi ase no no do. Iyiara so mpo egyangyandze a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na minyaa abagura wɔ me berɛ a meberɛe wɔ wiadze nyina ho.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a ɔdze nyansa, nye nyimdzee, nye enyigye berɛ; naaso nyimpa a ɔmmberɛ mu bi na ɔbɛdan egya no dɛ ne kyɛfa. Iyiara so egyangyandze nye mbusu kɛse a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na ebɛnadze ara na nyimpa nya no wɔ ne berɛ nyinara, n’akoma n’aperdzi a ɔdze berɛ wɔ wi ase mu?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na ne nda nyinara awerɛhow ara nko, na ne berɛ edwuma yaw a; ampaara, anadwe mpo n’akoma nntɔ ne yamu. Iyiara so egyangyandze a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Biribi papa biara nnyi hɔ ma nyimpa sen dɛ obedzidzi na ɔanom, na ɔama ne kra edzi ndzepa wɔ ne berɛ mu. Iyiara so muhunii, dɛ Nyankopɔn nsamu na ofi.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na woana ara na obenya edzi, na woana ara na n’enyi bɛgye asen emi mara?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na Nyankopɔn dze nyansa, nye nyimdzee, nye dɛw ma nyia ɔsɔ n’enyi no: na ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi dze, ɔma no ɔberɛ edwuma a ɔdze bɔboaboa na ɔahyɛ no kuw, ama ɔdze aama nyia ɔsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi no. Iyiara so egyangyandze na ɔberɛ gyan a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Adze biara wɔ ne hyɛber, na asɛm biara wɔ n’aber, wɔ wi yi ase:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: awoo n’aber, na owu n’aber; aber a wɔtsɛw, na aber a wotu dza wɔatsɛw no;
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: aber a woku, na aber a wɔsa yarba; aber a wobubu gu famu, na aber a wɔma do si;
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: aber a wosu, na aber a wɔserew; aber a wogyam, na aber a wɔsaw;
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: aber a wɔtotow abo gu, na aber a wɔboaboa ano; aber a wɔyɛ etuu, na aber a wogyaa etuuyɛ mu;
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: aber a wɔhwehwɛ adze, na aber a wɔyew adze; aber a wosie adze, na aber a wɔtow adze kyen;
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: aber a wosunsuan mu, na aber a wɔpempam; aber a wɔyɛ komm, na aber a wɔkasa;
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: aber a wɔdɔ, na aber a wɔtan; ɔsa n’aber, na asomdwee n’aber.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mfaso bɛn na nyia ɔyɛ edwuma nya no wɔ dza ɔberɛ ho no mu?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mehu ɔberɛ edwuma a Nyankopɔn dze ama adasamba dɛ wɔmfa mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔayɛ adze nyina fɛɛfɛw wɔ ne ber mu: eso ɔdze mber ahorow ho adwen ahyɛ hɔn akoma mu, naaso nyimpa nntum nnhu edwuma a Nyankopɔn ayɛ mu, ofitsi ahyɛse araa dze kodu ewiei mpo.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Minyim dɛ biribi papa biara nnyi hɔ ma adasamba, sen dɛ wobedzi ehurusi, na wɔayɛ dza oye aber a wɔdze tse ase nyina.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na eso dɛ nyimpa biara bedzidzi na ɔanom, na oenya ne ber nyinara mu ndzepa oedzi no, ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn akyɛdze.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Minyim dɛ biribiara a Nyankopɔn yɛ no, ɔnoara na ɔbɛtsena hɔ daa: wɔnnkɛfa hweeara aka ho, eso wonnkeyi do biribiara, na Nyankopɔn ayɛ no dɛm, ama adasa eesuro wɔ n’enyim.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dza ɔwɔ hɔ yi, ɔwɔ hɔ dadaada ana; na dza ɔbɛba no, oenya aba dadaada ana: na Nyankopɔn hwehwɛ dza etwa mu asen no bio.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na nkyii so muhun wɔ wi ase, wɔ atsɛmbu bea do, dɛ emumuyɛ wɔ hɔ; na ndzeyɛtsenenee bea do, dɛ emumuyɛ wɔ hɔ.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mekae wɔ m’akoma mu dɛ, Nyankopɔn bobu atseneneefo na emumuyɛfo nyina atsɛn, osiandɛ ɔahyɛ da bi ama tsirmpɔw na ndzeyɛɛ biara.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mekae wɔ m’akoma mu faa adasamba ho dɛ, Nyankopɔn rosɔ hɔn ahwɛ, na ama woeehu dɛ hɔnankasa wɔtse dɛ mbowa ara.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na dza ɔba adasamba do no ara na ɔba mbowa do; adze kor pɛr ara na ɔba hɔn do: mbrɛ ɔbaako wu no, mbrɛ ɔbaako so wu ara nye no; nyew, ahom kor na hɔn nyinara wɔwɔ; na nyimpa nnyi biribiara a ɔdze kyɛn mbowa: na ne nyinara so mpo, egyangyandze a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Hɔn nyinara wɔkɔ bea kor do; hɔn nyinara wofi huntuma mu, na hɔn nyinara wɔsan kɔ huntuma mu bio.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Woana nyim ɔdasanyi no sunsum dɛ ɔfow kɔ sor na abowa sunsum dɛ osian kɔ asaase do famu?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dɛm ntsi muhun dɛ adze papa biara nnyi hɔ, sen dɛ dasanyi bedzi n’edwuma mu ehurusi; osiandɛ ne kyɛpɛn ara nye no: na woana dze no bɛsan aba ma oebohu dza obesi wɔ n’ekyir?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nna mesanee hun atseetsee nyina a ɔkɔ do wɔ wi yi ase: na hwɛ, hɔn a wɔtseetsee hɔn no hɔn nyinsuwa, naaso wonnyi ɔwerɛkyekyefo biara; osiandɛ hɔn nhyɛdofo no nsamu wɔ tum, dɛm ntsi wonnyi ɔwerɛkyekyefo.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dɛm ntsi mekaa dɛ ewufo a woewuwu dada no enya no yie sen enyikamfo a wɔda ho tse ase no;
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: nyew, nyia muhun no dɛ oenya no yie seen beenu yi nyina nye nyia wonnyae nnwoo no, na onnyae nnhun ndzeyɛɛbɔn a wɔyɛ no wɔ wi yi ase no.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nna muhun ɔberɛ nye yieyɛ edwuma, dɛ saa iyi ntsi na nyimpa n’enyi ber ne nyɛnko. Iyiara so egyangyandze na ɔberɛ gyan a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔkwasea pompon ne nsa hyehyɛ n’anantamu, na ɔbɔ nankasa no ho abor.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nsapuw ma a asomdwee ka ho no, oye sen nsapuw amaama ebien a edwumadzen nye ɔberɛ gyan ka ho.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nna mesanee hun egyangyandze a ɔwɔ wi yi ase.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Obi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ ankonam, na onnyi obi ka no ho; nyew, onnyi ba anaa nua; naaso ne berɛ nyinara nnyi ewiei, na ahonya so mmee n’enyiwa. Ɔka dɛ, Woana koraa na mereberɛ dze egyapadze yi egya no na mo so menngye m’enyi bi yi? Iyiara so mpo, egyangyandze a; nyew, ɔyɛ ɔberɛ edwuma dzendzen.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Beenu ye sen ɔbaako; osiandɛ wonya hɔn berɛ mu akatua pa.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na sɛ wɔhwe ase a, ɔbaako bɛma ne nyɛnko do: mbom ɔbaakofo a ɔhwe ase a onnyi obi a ɔbɛma no do no, ondue.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Bio so, sɛ wɔnam beenu da a, ɔnodze hɔn ho yɛ hɔn hyew: na ɔbaakofo dze, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn no nko no ho ayɛ no hyew?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na sɛ nyimpa bi dzi ɔbaakofo do nyim a, beenu nye no bedzi esi; na ahoma a ɔpam ho ebiasa no, ɔnntsew ntsɛntsɛm.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔfanyim dɛ aberantsɛ hianyi onyansafo bobu man, sen ɔhen akɔdaa ɔkwasea a onntsie afotu bio.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Kaansa aberantsɛ no fi efiadze ara na obedzii hen; anaa n’ahenman mu hɔara mpo na wɔwoo no hianyi a oye.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Muhun atseasefo nyinara a woridzi hɔn dwuma wɔ wi yi ase, na muhun aberantsɛ bi so a ɔbɛba ebedzi ɔhen no n’adze.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔman no nyinara, mpo hɔn a odzii hɔn do hen no, nye hɔn a wobedzi n’ekyir aba no yɛ dɔm kɛse, naaso oyi so mpo hɔn enyi renngye no ho. Ampaara iyiara so egyangyandze na ɔberɛ gyan a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Sɛ ekɔ Nyankopɔn fie a, hwɛ dza eyɛ no yie. Oye dɛ ebɛbɛn etsie, sen dɛ ebɔbɔ afɔr dɛ nkwasea: na hɔn dze, wonnyim mpo dɛ wɔreyɛ bɔn.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mma mma w’ano nnyɛ tobɛrtobɛr, na mma mma w’akoma mmpɛ ntsɛm nnkasa wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim; na Nyankopɔn wɔ sor, na ɔwo dze ewɔ ase: dɛm ntsi ma wo kasaa nyɛ nyaa na ntsiantsia.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na adaaso dze edwuma dodow ba; na ɔkwasea ne ndze dze nsɛm dodow ba.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Sɛ ebɔ Nyankopɔn anohoba a, mma nnkyinkyim no tua ho: tua dza edze bɔɔ anohoba no.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔfanyim dɛ ennkɔbɔ anohoba, sen dɛ ebɔbɔ anohoba na innkotua.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mma mma kwan ma w’ano mmfa wo nnkɔ bɔn mu; eso mma nnse ɔbɔfo no dɛ dza mekae no mfom a. Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ebɛma Nyankopɔn no bo efuw wo ndze, na ɔasɛɛ wo nsaano edwuma, dɛ enndzi w’anohoba do ntsi?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na dɛm na ɔnam adaaso dodow na egyangyandze na nsɛm pii do ba: Nyankopɔn mbom na ɔwo dze suro no.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Sɛ ihu ɔbɔbɔfo ne haw, na atsɛmbu na pɛrpɛr a ɔadan enyi enyiber mu wɔ ɔmansin biara mu a, mma mma dɛm adze no nnyɛ wo nwanwa: na obi a ɔyɛ abɔso no, rohwɛ no so no do; na abɔso bi wɔ hɔ sen hɔn nyina.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nkyii so asaase do mfaso wɔ hɔ ma nyimpa nyinara: na asaase som ɔhen nankasa.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nyia ɔpɛ dwɛɛtɛɛ no, dwɛɛtɛɛ nnkɛmee no; na nyia ɔpɛ adze dodow no, ndɔbaa nnkɛmee no: iyi so egyangyandze a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Aber a ndzepa adɔɔ so no, hɔn a wodzi no so dɔɔ so: na mfaso bɛn na ɔwɔ hɔ ma ndzɛmba no wura, dɛ ɔdze n’enyiwa bɔhwɛ ara?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Odwumayɛfo ne nda yɛ dɛw, sɛ odzidzi kakra o, kɛse o: naaso obirɛmpɔn ne mee dze, ɔnnkɛma no kwan ma ɔada.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mbusu yaayaw bi wɔ hɔ a mehu no wɔ wi yi ase, ɔno nye yi; ahonya a no wura kora do ma nankasa no mbusu:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: na eguadzi bɔn ma ahonya no sɛɛ; na sɛ ɔawo ɔba a, biribiara nnka ne nsamu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dɛ mbrɛ ofi ne na ne yamu bae no, adagyaw ara so na ɔdze bɛsan akɔ dɛ mbrɛ ɔbae no, na onnkenya ne berɛ mu hweeara, dɛ ɔdze bekitsa akɔ.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na iyi so mbusu yaayaw a, dɛ mbrɛ ɔnam bae no ara pɛr, dɛmara so na ɔbɔkɔ: na mfaso bɛn na ɔyɛ ma no dɛ ɔberɛ ɔberɛhun?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na ne nda nyinara mu so odzidzi wɔ sum mu, na no bo fuw dodow na onya yarba na yamugya.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Hwɛ, dza mehu dɛ oye na ɔyɛ fɛw nye dɛ obi bedzidzi na ɔanom, na oenya edziyie wɔ ne berɛ a ɔaberɛ wɔ wi yi ase nyinara mu, no nkwa nda nyinara a Nyankopɔn dze ama no no: na iyi nye ne kyɛpɛn.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nyimpa biara so a Nyankopɔn ama no ahonya na ahodze, na ɔama no tum a ɔdze dzi bi, na ɔfa ne kyɛfa, na odzi ne berɛ mu ehurusi no; iyi nye Nyankopɔn akyɛdze.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na ɔnnkɛkaa no nkwa nda pii; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn ama no enyigye dodow wɔ n’akoma mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mbusu bi wɔ hɔ a mehu wɔ wi yi ase, na ɔhyɛ adasa do:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: nyimpa a Nyankopɔn ma no ahonya, ahodze, nye enyidzi, na dza ɔyɛ no akɔndɔ mu biara mmbɔ ne kra, naaso Nyankopɔn mma no tum a ɔdze bedzi bi, mbom ɔhɔho na odzi; iyi egyangyandze a, na ɔyɛ yarba bɔn.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Sɛ nyimpa wo ɔha, odzi mfe pii araa ma ne mfe dɔɔ so, na mbom papa ammee ne kra, na nkyii so oennya efunsie pa a; meka, dɛ ɔba a owuu ne na yamu mpo ye sen no:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: na ɔno dze, ɔba no egyangyandze mu, na ɔkɔ no sum mu, na sum kata ne dzin do;
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: nkyii so oennhu ewia na onnyim so; oyi mpo, ɔwɔ ahomgye sen dɛm nyimpa no:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: nyew, kaansa odzi mfe apem mbɔho mpo a, onnya mu yiedzi biara: aso nnyɛ fakor na hɔn nyinara wɔkɔ?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nyimpa ne berɛ nyinara, n’anomu ntsi a, naaso n’akɔndɔ mmee.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na mfaso bɛn na onyansafo wɔ ma ɔkyɛn ɔkwasea, anaadɛ ebɛnadze na hianyi a onyim atseasefo enyim nantsew wɔ?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔfanyim enyiwa n’adzehu sen akɔndɔ a okyin: iyi so egyangyandze na ɔberɛ gyan.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dza ɔaba biara, wɔato no dzin dada ana, na wonnyim no dɛ nyimpa a: eso onnkotum ɔnye nyia no ho yɛ dzen sen no efimfen.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔnam dɛ ndzɛmba pii wɔ hɔ a wɔma egyangyandze dɔr ntsi, nyimpa ne mfaso wɔ hen?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na woana na onyim dza oye ma nyimpa wɔ no nkwa mu, no nkwa huhuw ne nda a ɔhwer no dɛ sunsuma? Na woana botum aka akyerɛ nyimpa dza obesi n’ekyir wɔ wi yi ase?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dzin pa ye sen ngo a ɔsom bo; na owuda sen awoda.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Eyiadze no kɔ ye sen aponto ase kɔ: osiandɛ ɔbra twa owu na ohia dɛ adasa dwendwen ho yie.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Awerɛhow ye sen enyigye: osiandɛ dza ɔdze awerɛhow ba no ma osuahu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Enyansafo akoma wɔ eyiadze; na nkwasea akoma dze ɔwɔ enyigye fi mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Enyansafo enyimka ne tsie ye sen dɛ nyimpa betsie nkwasea hɔn adwontow.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na mbrɛ nsoɛ dɛw turuturu wɔ kutu ase no, dɛmara so na ɔkwasea ne serew tse: dede gyan a; iyi so egyangyandze a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ampaara apempensi ma onyansafo dan kwasea; na mboabagye fura enyiwa.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Adze n’ewiei ye sen n’ahyɛse: na sunsum mu abotarnyi no, oye sen sunsum mu ɔkontompɔnyi.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mma mmpɛ ntsɛm wɔ wo sunsum mu mmfa ebufuw: na ebufuw tse nkwasea hɔn akoko mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mma woara ennka dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na nkan no nda no oye sen iyinom yi? Osiandɛ nyansa biara nnyi dɛm asɛmbisa yi mu?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nyansa ye dɛ egyapadze ara so: nyew, oye dodow ma hɔn a wohu ewia.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na nyansa yɛ akoban, dɛ mbrɛ sika so yɛ akoban: na nyimdzee n’abɔso nye yi, dɛ nyansa kora nyia ɔwɔ no no nkwa.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dwendwen Nyankopɔn n’edwuma ho: na woana botum atsentsen dza ɔakyeakyea no no?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Eyiedzi da mu, ma w’enyi ngye, na ahohiahia da mu, dwendwen: mpo Nyankopɔn ayɛ iyi afam ɔno ho, amma nyimpa biara ennhu n’ekyir biribiara a ɔbɛba.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Iyinom nyinara mehu wɔ m’egyangyandze nda no mu: ɔtseneneenyi wɔ hɔ a ne ndzeyɛtsenenee nyina mu no, wotwa no kyen nna omumuyɛfo bi so wɔ hɔ a n’emumuyɛ nyina ekyir no, ɔkyɛr wiadze.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mma nnyɛ woho tseneneenyi nntra do; eso mma nnyɛ onyansafo nntra do: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ebɛsɛɛ woara woho?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mma nnyɛ omumuyɛfo nntra do, eso mma nnyɛ kwasea. Ɔyɛ dɛn na ibotwar wo mber ano ewu?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Oye dɛ ibosuo iyiara mu; nyew, ɔno so, mma nnyi wo nsa mmfi ho: na nyia osuro Nyankopɔn no, obefi ne nyinara mu efi.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nyansa yɛ ahoɔdzen ma onyansafo sen kuropɔn mu ahemfo du.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ampaara, ɔtseneneenyi nnyi asaase do a ɔyɛ papa na ɔnnyɛ bɔn.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Eso mma mmfa nsɛm a wɔkeka nyinara nnyɛ asɛm; amma anntse dɛ w’akowaa rodom wo:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: na wankasa w’akoma so hu no mpɛn pii dɛ ɔwoara so adom binom dɛmara.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Iyinom nyinara medze nyansa mosɔe hwɛe: mesee dɛ, mubohu nyansa; na ɔno so ɔnye me ntamu waree.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dza ɔwɔ hɔ yi, ɔwɔ ekyirekyir, na ɔyɛ dɔnkuronn: woana botum ehu?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Medaan moho, na musuaa m’akoma mu dɛ mubohu na mapɛnsapɛnsa, na mahwehwɛ nyansa na ndzɛmba ase, na mehu dɛ emumuyɛ yɛ nkwaseadze, na nkwaseasɛm yɛ abɔdam:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: na mehu adze a ɔyɛ wenwen sen owu, mekyerɛ ɔbaa a ɔyɛ mfir, na n’akoma yɛ asawu, na ne nsa tse dɛ mpokyerɛ: nyia ɔsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi no, obefi ne nsa efi; na ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi dze, ɔbɛkyer no.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Hwɛ, dza mehu nye yi, Ɔsɛnkafo no na ɔse, ɔdze adze kor so reka ho, dze ahwehwɛ ne siantsir:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: ɔno na me kra da ho hwehwɛ, naaso munnhunii: ɔbarimba baako na mehu no wɔ apem mu; na ɔbaa dze, munnhunii wɔ hɔn nyinara mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Hwɛ, iyiara nko na mehu dɛ Nyankopɔn bɔɔ dasanyi tɔɔtsenn; na hɔnara na wɔakɔhwehwɛ tsirmu nhyehyɛɛ pii.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Woana na ɔtse dɛ onyansafo no? Na woana na ɔtse ndzɛmba ase? Nyimpa nyansanyi ne nyansaa ma n’enyim hyerɛn, na n’enyim pirim sakyer.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mutu wo fo, dɛ, Dzi ɔhen ne mbrasɛm do, mekyerɛ Nyankopɔn ne ntam no a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mma mmpɛ ntsɛm mmfi n’enyim nkɔ; mma nnsi nketse wɔ ndzebɔn mu: na dza ɔsɔ n’enyi biara na ɔyɛ.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Osiandɛ ɔhen n’asɛm mu wɔ tum, na woana botum ase no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ereyɛ yi?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Obiara a odzi mbrasɛm no do no, onnkohu ebusudze biara; na nyansafo n’akoma hu aber na atsɛmbu mu:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: na aber na atsɛmbu wɔ hɔ ma asɛm biara; osiandɛ nyimpa no mbusu so wɔ no do:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: na onnyim dza ɔbɛba; na woana botum akyerɛ no mbrɛ obesi bɛba?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nyimpa biara nnyi hɔ a ɔwɔ ehum do tum dɛ ɔdze besianka no; eso onnyi tum wɔ owuda do; na ahomgye bi nnyi ɔsa no mu: na emumuyɛ nnkegyaa ne yɛfo.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Iyi nyinara mehu, na medze m’akoma ato edwuma biara a wodzi no wɔ wi ase no do: aber bi wɔ hɔ a nyimpa dzi ne nyɛnko no do tum dze ma noara no mbusu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na dɛmara so na muhun emumuyɛfo a wosiee hɔn, na wɔhɛɛn adakamona mu; na hɔn a wɔayɛ dza ɔfata no so, wofii krɔnkrɔnbea hɔ kɔree, na werɛ fiir hɔn wɔ kurow no mu: iyi so egyangyandze a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔnam dɛ wɔmmpɛ ntsɛm mmbu emumuyɛ ho atsɛn ntsi na adasamba dze esi hɔn akoma mu pɔkyee dɛ wɔbɔbɔ mbusu no.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Kaansa dzebɔnyɛnyi bɔbɔ mbusu mpɛn ɔha, na ɔama ne nda awar mpo a, ɔyɛ dɛn ara a minyim dɛ obesi yie ama hɔn a wosuro Nyankopɔn, mekyerɛ hɔn a wosuro n’enyim no:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: naaso onnkesi yie ama omumuyɛfo, eso ɔnnkɛma ne nda a ɔtse dɛ sunsuma no awar; osiandɛ onnsuro Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Egyangyandze bi wɔ hɔ a wɔyɛ no asaase do; dɛ atseneneefo wɔ hɔ a adze to hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata emumuyɛfo edwuma; bio, emumuyɛfo wɔ hɔ a adze to hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata atseneneefo edwuma: nna mesee dɛ iyi so egyangyandze a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔno na mekamfoo enyigye, osiandɛ nyimpa nnyi adze papa biara wɔ wi ase, dɛ obedzidzi, na ɔanom, na n’enyi agye: na ɔno ɔbɛfam no ho ne berɛ mu wɔ no nkwa nyinara a Nyankopɔn dze ama no wi ase no mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Aber a medze m’akoma memaa dɛ mubohu nyansa, na mehu edwuma a wodzi no wɔ asaase do no: (na eso obi nnyi hɔ a n’enyiwa nnda adzekyee na adzesaa:)
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: nna mohwɛɛ Nyankopɔn no ndwuma nyina, dɛ nyimpa nntum nnhu dwuma a wodzi no wi ase no: osiandɛ sɛ ɔberɛ bɛn na nyimpa bɛberɛ ahwehwɛ a, orunnhu; ampaara so bio dɛ, sɛ nyansafo dwen dɛ obohu a, orunntum nnhu ara da.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na iyi nyinara na medze too m’akoma mu, dɛ nkyɛ mobɔhwehwɛ iyi nyinara mu; dɛ atseneneefo, na enyansafo, na hɔn ndwuma, wɔ Nyankopɔn nsamu: sɛ ɔdɔ o, ɔtan o, nyimpa nnyim; ɔhaw kor no ara na hɔn nyina wodua mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Adze nyina ba nyimpa nyinara do pɛr: esian kor na ɔwɔ hɔ ma atseneneefo na emumuyɛfo; ɔwɔ hɔ ma nyia ɔbɔ afɔr na nyia ɔmmbɔ afɔr: nyia ɔyɛ nyimpa papa, na nyia ɔyɛ nyimpa bɔn so tse ara nye no; na nyia noho tsew na nyia noho nntsew so.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Iyi yɛ ɔhaw kɛse wɔ dza wɔyɛ no wɔ wi ase nyinara mu, dɛ esian kor wɔ hɔ ma hɔn nyinara: ampaara so, adasamba akoma ahyɛ ewurkadze ma, na abɔdam wɔ hɔn akoma mu ber a wɔtse ase, na ɔno n’ekyir no, wɔkɔ ewufo nkyɛn.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na enyidado wɔ hɔ ma atseasefo nyina: osiandɛ bɔdɔm nyikan ye sen awendadze a oewu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na atseasefo nyim dɛ wobowu ara: naaso ewufo dze, wonnyim hwee bio, eso wonnyi akatua bio; na werɛ efir hɔn ho nkaa.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Hɔn dɔ o, hɔn enyitan na hɔn enyiber o, ahera dada; eso wonnyi kyɛfa biara bio ara da wɔ dza wɔyɛ no wɔ wi yi ase no mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Kɔ do ara, fa enyigye dzi w’edziban, na fa enyigye akoma nom wo nsa, na Nyankopɔn enyi asɔ wo ndwuma dada.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ma wo ntar nhoa daa; na mma mma seradze mmpa wo tsirmu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Enye wo yer a edɔ no no ntsena enyigye mu wɔ w’egyangyandze nkwa nda nyinara a Nyankopɔn dze ama wo wi ase no mu, wɔ w’egyangyandze nda nyinara mu: na ɔno nye wo kyɛfa wɔ nkwa mu, na wo berɛ a eberɛ wɔ wi ase mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Biribiara a edze wo nsa bɛka dɛ ereyɛ no, fa w’ahoɔdzen yɛ; osiandɛ edwuma, anaa nhyehyɛɛ, anaa nyimdzee, anaa nyansa biara nnyi adakamona a erokɔ mu no mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Medaan moho, na muhun wɔ wi ase, dɛ empiresi nnyɛ ahoɔharfo dze, na dɛ ɔko nnyɛ ahoɔdzenfo dze, nyew, dɛmara na boodoo nnyɛ enyansafo nko dze, na eso enyimpa nnyɛ edwimfo dze; na mber na esian ba hɔn nyinara do.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Bio, nyimpa nnyim ne mber so: dɛ nam a wɔdze eboa saw hɔn, na dɛ nnoma a wɔpa hɔn efir mu no, dɛmara so na wosua adasamba efir wɔ mber bɔn a ɔba hɔn do awerɛfir mu no mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dɛmara so na mehu nyansa wɔ wi ase, na ɔyɛɛ kɛse wɔ m’enyiwa do:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: kurow kakraba bi wɔ hɔ, na nyimpa kumaabi na wɔwɔ mu; na ɔhen kɛse bi soɛɛr do, na obotui hyɛɛ do, na ɔtotoow ho abantsentsen akɛse:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: afei wohun mu hɔ onyansafo hianyi bi, na ɔnam ne nyansaa do gyee kurow no; naaso nyimpa biara annkaa ohianyi no.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Naaso mese dɛ, Nyansa ye sen ahoɔdzen: kaansa woebu nyimpa hianyi ne nyansaa no enyimtsia, na ne nsɛm so wɔnntse mpo a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Enyansafo nsɛm a wɔka no komm no, wɔtse no yie sen nyia odzi nkwasea do tum ne nkekamu no.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nyansa ye sen akondadze: na dzebɔnyɛnyi kor sɛɛ papa pii.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dɛ mbrɛ nwansema fun ma eduforafo ne seradze yi nka bɔn no: dɛmara so na nkwaseadze kakrabaa bor nyansa na enyidzi do.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nyimpa nyansafo n’akoma dze no kɔ n’abanyimfa; na ɔkwasea n’akoma dze no kɔ n’abankum.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mpo sɛ ɔkwasea nantsew kwan biara do a, ne ntseasee bɔ no, na ɔda no ho edzi dɛ ɔkwasea a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Sɛ otumfo no sunsum soɛr tsia wo a, mma mmfi w’ananmu; na ngyaamu dwedwe mfom pii.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mbusu bi wɔ hɔ a mehu no wɔ wi ase a ɔtse dɛ mfom a ofi otumfo hɔ ba.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Wɔama nkwaseafo dzibew akɛse akɛse, ma ahonyafo mbom tsetse famu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mehu nkowaa a wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do, na ahenmba a wɔnenam dɛ nkowaa wɔ asaase do.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nyia otu mona no, ɔbɔtɔ mu; na obiara a obubu ban mu no, abowatsena bɔsɔw no.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Obiara a opue abo no, wɔdze bepira no; na nyia ɔpaa ndua no, ɔdze bɔ noho mbusu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Sɛ dadze n’ano kum, na obiara annsew ano a, ɔnodze ɔwɔ dɛ wɔma no ahoɔdzen kɛse: naaso hu no dɛ nyansa bɛma esi wo yie.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Sɛ abowatsena sɔw ansaana wɔakyer no nkaber a, nna mfaso biara nnyi nkaberkyerfo no ho.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nyimpa nyansafo n’anomu nsɛm yɛ adom; na ɔkwasea dze, n’anofamfa bɛmen narankasa.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔkwasea ne kasaa ahyɛse yɛ nkwaseasɛm, na n’ewiei no yɛ abɔdam emumuyɛ.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔma n’asɛm so dɔɔ so: naaso nyimpa nnyim dza ɔbɛba; na dza obesi n’ekyir aba no, woana botum aka akyerɛ no?
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔkwasea ne berɛ haw no, ntsi onndu no botae ho.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Asaase e, due! Aber a wo hen yɛ abofra, na w’asafohemfo dzidzi anapa!
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Asaase e, osiarfo nye wo oo! Ber a wo hen yɛ ekunyin ba, na w’asafohemfo dzidzi ber a ɔsɛ dze nya ahoɔdzen na wɔnnyɛ asabokwafo!
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Akwadwer ara ntsi na nkurii pa bɔ mu; na nsamugow na ɔma ɔdan nwin.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Asereserew ntsi na wɔto pon, na nsa ma ɔbra mu enyigye: na sika bua adze nyinara.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Mma nndom ɔhen, mpo wɔ w’adwen mu; na mma nndom obirɛmpɔn wɔ w’adankyir: na wimu anoma dze ndze no bɔkɔ, na dza otuatua ntɛkyerɛ bɔkɔ akɛka asɛm no.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Totow w’edziban gugu nsu enyi: na daakye bi wo nsa bɛka.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Fa bi ma beesuon, nyew, fa ma baawɔtwe mpo; na innyim mbusu kor a ɔbɛba asaase do.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Sɛ nsu hyɛ nsuwusiw ma a, otue gu asaase do; na sɛ dua kɔhwe pomu afamu anaa kwaamu afamu a, beebi a dua no ahwe no, mbrɛ ɔbɛda ara nye no.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nyia ɔhwɛ mframa enyim no, onnkodua; na nyia ɔhwɛ nsuwusiw no, onnkobu da.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo innyim mbrɛ mframa no kwan da, anaaso innyim mbrɛ mbiew si nyin wɔ onyinsemfo ne yamu no; dɛmara so mpo na ɔwo innyim Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ adze nyina no n’edwuma.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dua w’aba anapa, na ewimbir so mma nnyi wo nsa mmfi ho: na ɔwo innyim no mu dza ɔbɛyɛ prɔmprɔm, sɛ iyi o, ɔno o, anaa beenu nyina na wɔbɔbɔ mu ayɛ yie o.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ampaara dɛ kan yɛ dɛw, na ɔyɛ enyiwa fɛw dɛ obohu ewia.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Nyew, sɛ nyimpa dzi mfe pii a, wɔmma n’enyi ngye ne nyinara mu; naaso wɔmma ɔnkaa sum nda no, na wɔbɔdɔɔ so. Dza ɔbɛba nyinara egyangyandze a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Aberantsɛ e, ma w’enyi ngye wo mberantsɛber mu oo; na ma w’akoma ntɔ mu wɔ wo mberantsɛber mu, na fa wankasa w’akoma n’akwan do, na dza woara w’enyiwa tua mu: naaso hu dɛ iyi nyinara ntsi Nyankopɔn dze wo bɔkɔ atsɛmbu mu.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Dɛm ntsi yi adwendwen fi w’akoma mu, na ma emumuyɛ mpar wo honam: na mbofraber na mberantsɛber yɛ egyangyandze.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Eso kaa wo Bɔfo wɔ wo mberantsɛber mu, ansaana mbusu da no aba, na mfe a ebɛse dɛ, Minnyi mu enyigye no, edu;
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: ansaana ewia, na kan, na bosoom, na nworaba ahyehyɛ sum, na nsuwusiw agye nyankom ekyir:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: da a fie aweɔmfo ho bɔpopo, na mbarimba ahoɔdzenfo mu bɔkonkom, na ewunyamfo begyaa osiandɛ hɔnho esuar ntsi, na hɔn a wodua atena ntokura mu hwɛ adze no hɔn enyiwa do bɛyɛ kusuww,
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: na wɔatotow abɔntsen do mbobow no mu; ber a ewuyam ne dede abrɛ adze no. Wɔbɔsoɛr anoma no su ano, na mbaa adwontofo nyinara wɔbɛbrɛ hɔn adze;
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: nyew, wobosuro dza ɔkrɔn biara, na ehuyi bɛba kwan mu; na almɔnd dua bɔbɔ nhyiren, na abɛbɛw ayɛ adzesoa, na akɔndɔ tun etwa: osiandɛ dasanyi rokɔ ne daa fie, na eyiyɛfo rikyin abrɔn do:
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: ansaana dwetɛ ahoma bɛtsew, anaa sika toa bɛpaa, na ehina no abɔ nsubura ho, anaa supi hwiir ebubu;
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: na dɛtse bɛsan akɔ asaase mu dɛ mbrɛ nkyɛ ɔtse, na sunsum bɛsan akɔ Nyankopɔn a ɔdze mae no hɔ.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Egyangyandze mu egyangyandze, Ɔsɛnkafo no na ɔse; ne nyinara egyangyandze a.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na bio so, osiandɛ Ɔsɛnkafo no ɔyɛ onyansafo ntsi, ɔdaa ho ara kyerɛkyerɛɛ ɔman no nyimdzee; nyew, ɔdwendween ho, na ɔpɛnsaa mu, na obubuu mbɛbusɛm pii.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ɔsɛnkafo no hwehwɛɛ dɛ obohu nsɛm a ɔyɛ enyigye, na dza wɔakyerɛw no tɔɔtsenyɛ mu, mekyerɛ, nokwar nsɛm.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Onyansafo ne nsɛm tse dɛ ɔnantwikafo ndadzepoma; na dɛ mbrɛ mprɛgow a wɔdze etsintsim yie tse no, dɛmara so na nsɛm a ɔkandzifo kor na ɔka no tse.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na nkyii so bio, me ba, tsie afotu; nwoma pii ne yɛ nnyi ewiei; na nwomasua dodow pii so mu wɔ ɔhaw.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Asɛm no n’ewiei nye yi, ne nyinara wɔatse: suro Nyankopɔn, na dzi ne mbrasɛm do; na iyiara nye dza wɔrohwehwɛ efi nyimpa hɔ.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Na Nyankopɔn dze dwumadzi biara bɛba asɛndzii, ɔnye esumasɛm biara, sɛ oye o, sɛ omuo o.
title: ECCLESIASTES

text: Ndwom mu ndwom a ɔyɛ Solomon dze.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ao, nkyɛ edze w’ano afew m’ano: Osiandɛ wo dɔ ye sen nsa.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Wo seradze yɛ huam papa; Wo ho nka tse dɛ eduhuam a woehue egu; Dɛm ntsi na mbaabun dɔ wo no.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Twe me; ma yɛnyɛ no ntsɛm nkɔ: Ɔhen dze me aba ne mpia mu: Yebedzi ehurusi na hɛn enyi agye, Mobɔbɔ wo dɔ dzin asen nsa: Ɔnnyɛ hu dɛ mbaabun dɔ wo.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mibir dze, naaso mo ho yɛ fɛw, Jerusalɛm mbabaa e, Tse dɛ Kedar asese, Na dɛ mbrɛ Solomon nkatahotam tse.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mma nnhwɛ me dɛ mibir, osiandɛ ewia ahyew me ntsi. Emi na mbabanyin bo fuuw me, Wɔdze me yɛɛ wenyin nture mu ɔhwɛfo; Na mbom mankasa mo wenyin ture no dze mannhwɛ.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ɔwo a me kra dɔ wo, ka kyerɛ me, Henfa na enyɛn wo nguan, henfa na ema wɔhom ewiaber? Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na menyɛ dɛ nyia wɔakata n’enyim Wɔ w’anyɛnkofo hɔn nguankuw nkyɛn?
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ao, mbaa mu ɔhoɔfɛfo, sɛ ɔwo innyim a, Kɔ, ketsin nguankuw anamɔn no do, Na nyɛn wo nguambaa wɔ nguanhwɛfo ntamadan no nkyɛn.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: M’adamfowa e, medze wo ato Farao ne ntseaseanam ɔpɔnkɔ ho.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: W’afon yɛ fɛw wɔ tsidwow mu, Wo kɔn yɛ fɛw wɔ ntweaban mu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Yɛbɛyɛ sika edwindzi ndwowee ama wo a, dwetɛ sisi mu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Aber a ɔhen tse no pon ho no, Nna me seradzehuam ayɛ huatsee.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mo dɔfo yɛ eduhuam mɛɛr siaw dze ma me, Ɔda m’enumfo ntamu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mo dɔfo tse dɛ nhyiren siaw dze ma me Wɔ Engedi wenyin nture mu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Hwɛ, mo dɔfo, wo ho yɛ fɛw; wo ho yɛ fɛw ae; W’enyiwamba tse dɛ ebubur dze.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Hwɛ, mo dɔfo, wo ho yɛ fɛw, nyew, wo ho yɛ akɔndɔ: Hɛn dabew so yɛ efuw momon.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Hɛn dan no mpuna yɛ nkyindur ndua, Na hɛn mpar so yɛ pepeaa.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Emi dze, meyɛ Saron nhyiren, Mbɔnsa mu esukookoo.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mbrɛ esukookoo tse wɔ nsoɛ mu no, Dɛmara so na mo dɔfo tse wɔ mbabaa mu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Dɛ mbrɛ aperdua tse wɔ haban mu ndua mu no, Dɛmara so na mo dɔfo tse wɔ mbabanyin mu. Medze enyigye kɛse tsenaa no nwinwin ase, Na no nduadzewa yɛɛ m’anomu dɔkɔdɔkɔ.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ɔdze me baa aponto ase, Na ne frankaa a osi mo do yɛ ɔdɔ.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Hom mfa esikyireamba nsianka me, hom mfa aper nkyekye mo werɛ: Osiandɛ ɔdɔ yarba akyer me.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: N’abankum da me tsiadze, Na n’abanyimfa abra me.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Jerusalɛm mbabaa e, hom nka ntam nkyerɛ me Hom mfa nwansan, na ɔtweba a wɔwɔ hamu nka ntam, Dɛ hom nnkopusuw hɛn dɔ, anaa wonnkenyan no, Gyedɛ noara ɔpɛ.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mo dɔfo ne ndze nye no! Hwɛ, ɔreba, Oruhuruhuruw mbepɔw do, ɔrobɔ nkoko do mpentsenkwa.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mo dɔfo tse dɛ ɔwansan anaadɛ ɔtweba: Hwɛ, ogyina hɛn fasu ekyir, Ɔhwɛ ntokura mu, Onyinam noho wɔ atenatokura mu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mo dɔfo kasae na ɔsee me dɛ, Soɛr, mo dɔfo, me yima, na bra ɛ.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Na, hwɛ, awɔwber etwa mu, Esusow atsew na ɔkɔ;
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Nhyiren efifir asaase do; Nnoma adwontober edu, Wɔtse atamram nka wɔ hɛn asaase do;
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Adɔmbadua n’aba ebun ebun reber, Na wenyinndua robɔ nhyiren, Woriyi hɔn huam. M’adamfowa e, me yima e, soɛr na bra ɛ.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ao m’ebubur, ɔwo a ewɔ ɔbotan ne mpaae mu, wɔ bea sorɔnsorɔm no n’ehuntsae mu, Ma munhu w’enyim, ma mentse wo ndze; Na wo ndze yɛ dɛw, na wo ho yɛ fɛw.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Hom nkyekyer nsɔ no mma hɛn, nsɔ nkakraba a wɔsɛɛ wenyin nture no; Na hɛn wenyin nture no abobɔ nhyiren.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mo dɔfo yɛ medze, na meyɛ nedze: Ɔnyɛn no nguan wɔ nsukookoo mu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mo dɔfo, san w’ekyir, na yɛ dɛ ɔwansan anaadɛ ɔtweba a Ɔwɔ Bɛɛta mbepɔw do, Ma onkodu dɛ wi ano bɔdwe, na sunsuma bɛsen akɔ.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Me mpa do anadwe na mohwehwɛɛ nyia me kra dɔɔ no no: Mohwehwɛɛ no, naaso mennhu no.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mesee dɛ, Afei mobɔsoɛr, na mekekyin kurow no ho, Wɔ abrɔn mu na gua do, Mobɔhwehwɛ nyia me kra dɔ no no: Mohwehwɛɛ no, naaso mennhu no.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Aweɔmfo a wokyin kurow no ho no hun me: Hɔn na mibisaa hɔn dɛ, Ana hom ehu nyia me kra dɔ no no?
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mepaa hɔn ho kakra ara pɛr, Nna muhun nyia me kra dɔ no no: Musuoo no mu dɛ minnkegyaa no ma ɔaakɔ, Ekodu dɛ medze no bodu me na fie, Na nyia onyinseen me no ne pia mu ana.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Jerusalɛm mbabaa e, hom nka ntam nkyerɛ me Hom mfa nwansan na ɔtweba a wɔwɔ hamu nka ntam, Dɛ hom nnkopusuw hɛn dɔ, anaa wonnkenyan no, Gyedɛ noara ɔpɛ.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Woana nye oyi a ofi sar do reba dɛ wusiw fadum, A mɛɛr na krɔbɔw, Na oguadzifo nduhuam ayɛ no ho huatsee yi?
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Hwɛ, Solomon n’apakan a; Mbarimba akatakyi eduosia na woetwa ho ehyia, Israel mbarimba akatakyi no mu bi a.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Hɔn nyinara wɔdzedze mfona, na wɔawea asayɛ ho: Nyimpa biara n’afona bɔ n’asen, Wɔ anadwe mu ɔhaw ntsi.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ɔhen Solomon yɛɛ apakan maa noho, Ɔdze Lebanon ndua yɛe.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ɔdze dwetɛ yɛɛ ne fadum no, N’ase no so sika a, n’egua no ɔberdum a; Jerusalɛm mbabaa dze anwendze a ɔyɛ fɛw Edura no mu no.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Zion mbabaa e, hom mpue mbɔhwɛ ɔhen Solomon a Ɔbɔ n’abɔtsir a ne na dze bɔɔ ne tsir wɔ n’ayehyia da, Da a n’akoma nyaa enyigye no.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Hwɛ, wo ho yɛ fɛw, mo dɔfo, wo ho yɛ fɛw ae; W’enyiwamba tse dɛ ebubur dze wɔ w’akataenyim n’ekyir: Wo tsinhwi tse dɛ serekye ahoma.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Wo se tse dɛ nguamber kuw a woetwitwa hɔn ho nhwi fofor a Wofi eguaree aba; Hɔn nyinara wɔawowo nta nta, Na hɔn mu biara nndzi awo mba ewu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: W’anofamfa tse dɛ adaaben ahoma, Na w’ano kasa yɛ dɛw: W’asontɔrmu tse dɛ pɔmegranate eduaba fa Wɔ wo nkataenyim n’ekyir.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Wo kɔndua tse dɛ David abantsentsen a woesi ama akodze a Dadze nkataenyim apem sensɛn ho, Ne nyinara akatakyifo hɔn akyɛm a.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: W’enumfo ebien tsetse dɛ wansanmba ebien a wɔyɛ ntafo a Wodzidzi nsukookoo mu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mobɔkɔ eduhuam mɛɛr bepɔw, Na krɔbɔw koko no do, Ma ekodu dɛ wi ano bɔdwe, na sunsuma bɛsen akɔ.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Wo ho nyinara yɛ fɛw, mo dɔfo; Na dzɛm biara nnyi wo ho.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ma yemfi Lebanon, m’ayefor, Ma yemfi Lebanon nkɔ: Ma yemfi Amana etsifi, Yemfi Senir na Hermon etsifi, Yemfi ngyata buw no do, Yemfi nsebɔ mbepɔw no do nhwɛ famu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: M’akyerɛbaa, m’ayefor, ɔwo atwe m’akoma, Edze w’enyiwa mu kor atwe m’akoma, Edze wo kɔn mu ntweaban kor.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: M’akyerɛbaa, m’ayefor, mbrɛ wo dɔ dua no ho yɛ ahomka a! Mbrɛ wo dɔ dua ye sen nsa a! Na mbrɛ wo seradze ne nka dua yɛ huam sen nduhuam nyinara a!
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ao m’ayefor, w’ano sosɔw dɛ wokyɛm: Ewo na numfonsu wɔ wo tɛkyerɛma ase; Na w’atar no huam tse dɛ Lebanon no huam.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ture a wɔatow mu nye m’akyerɛbaa, m’ayefor; Nsunyiwa a woesiw ano, nsubura a wɔasɔw ano.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Wo mfefɛwee tse dɛ pɔmegranate ekutu ture a no mu aba som bo; Hɛɛna na seradzehuam ndua,
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Seradzehuam na safrɔn, Kalamus na sinamɔn, na krɔbɔw ndua nyinara; Mɛɛr na alɔe, nye nduhuam etsitsir nyinara.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ɔwo eyɛ nture mu nsunyiwa, Ɔwo eyɛ mbasu, Na esutsen a ofi Lebanon pem.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Kwaamu mframa, nyan; na ɔwo pomu afamu, bra; Bɔ fa mo ture do, ma no mu nduhuam ntu mpetse. Ma mo dɔfo mbra no ture mu, Na ombedzi no nduadzewa a ɔsom bo no bi.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: M’akyerɛbaa, m’ayefor, maba wo ture mu oo: Matsetsew eduhuam mɛɛr aka m’eduhuam ho; Medzi mo wokyɛm aka mo wo ho; Manom me nsa aka m’enumfonsu ho. Mfɛfo e, hom ndzidzi oo; Adɔfo e, hom nnom, nyew, hom nnom tosee.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Medae, na m’akoma nyanee: Mo dɔfo a ɔrobɔ mu ne ndze a, dɛ, M’akyerɛbaa, mo dɔfo, m’ebubur, m’adze a idzi mu e, bue me ɛ: Na bɔw atɔ me tsir do ma, Anadwe bɔw ayɛ me mpɛsɛw ma.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mapɔr m’atar; meyɛ dɛn mehyɛ? Mahohor m’anan ho; meyɛ dɛn mugu ho fi?
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mo dɔfo tseen ne nsa duaa abow no tokura no mu, Na me yamu hyehyee me maa no.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mosoɛɛr dɛ murukobue mo dɔfo; Na me nsa ho sosɔɔw eduhuam mɛɛr, Na me nsatseaba sosɔɔw eduhuam mɛɛr a ɔanan, Guguu krɔkrɔw n’esuomu no do.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mubuei maa mo dɔfo; Nna mo dɔfo atwe noho, na ɔkɔ. Ber a ɔkasae no, m’ahom pae: Mohwehwɛɛ no, na mennhu no; Mefrɛfrɛɛ no, naaso ɔanngye me do.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Aweɔmfo a wokyin kurow no ho no hun me, Wɔbobɔɔ me, wopirapiraa me. Afasu no ho ahwɛfo no yii me nkataenyim kɔree.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ao Jerusalɛm mbabaa, meka ntam gu hom do dɛ sɛ hom hu mo dɔfo no a, Ɔno hom nse no dɛ ɔdɔ yarba abɔ me.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Adze bɛn na wo dɔfo dze sen ɔdɔfo bi, Ɔwo mbaa mu ɔhoɔfɛfo kɛse? Adze bɛn na wo dɔfo dze sen ɔdɔfo bi, Na ɔwo ka ntam gu hɛn do dɛm yi?
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mo dɔfo hoa na ɔber mu, Ɔpedu mu dansewa a.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ne tsir tse dɛ sika pa mapa, Ne tsir do nhwi fukuww, dukuduku dɛ akonkoran.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: N’enyiwamba tse dɛ esutsen ho mbubur; Wɔdze numfonsu ahohor, na woesisi yie.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: N’afon tse dɛ nduhuam akɔfi, dɛ nduadzewa dɛɛdɛw a wɔahohɔr isiw. N’anofamfa tse dɛ esukookoo a ɔsosɔw eduhuam mɛɛr nanee.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ne nsa tse dɛ sika mpɛtsea a wɔdze sikabereebo esisi do: Ne nyimpadua tse dɛ asombɛn edwindzi a wɔdze hoabo edura ho.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: No ntwɛr tse dɛ abo fitaa edum a osisi sika pa ngyinado do: No suban tse dɛ Lebanon, fɛfɛɛfɛw dɛ nkyindur ndua.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: N’anomu yɛ huam dodow: nyew, no ho nyinara yɛ akɔndɔ. Mo dɔfo no nye yi, na me nyɛnko no nye yi, Ao Jerusalɛm mbabaa.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Henfa na wo dɔfo kɔ, Ɔwo mbaa mu ɔhoɔfɛfo kɛse? Henfa na wo dɔfo etwa noho afa, Ma yɛnye wo nkɔhwehwɛ no?
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mo dɔfo esian kɔ no ture mu, nduhuam akɔfi no mu, Dɛ orikedzidzi wɔ ture mu, na ɔatsetsɛw nsukookoo.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Emi dze meyɛ mo dɔfo nedze, na mo dɔfo so yɛ medze: Ɔnyɛn no nguankuw wɔ nsukookoo no mu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ao mo dɔfo, wo ho yɛ fɛw dɛ Tirza, Eyɛ oyima dɛ Jerusalɛm, Wo ho yɛ hu dɛ dɔm a wɔdze mfrankaa.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Dan w’enyiwa kɔ nkyɛn kakra, Osiandɛ ɔato me mpokyerɛ. Wo tsinhwi nahanaha tse dɛ serekye ahoma.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Wo se tse dɛ nguamber a Wofi eguaree aba a Hɔn nyinara wɔawowo nta nta, Na hɔn mu biara nndzi awo mba ewu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: W’asontɔrmu tse dɛ pɔmegranate eduaba fa Wɔ wo nkataenyim no mu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ɔhen yernom eduosia, na nwewefo eduowɔtwe, Na mbaabun a wonnyi anobu wɔwɔ hɔ,
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Naaso m’ebubur, m’adze a odzi mu dze, ɔda mu fua; Ne na ne ba kor ara nye no; Nyia ɔwoo no no n’adɔnadze nye no. Mbabaa hun no, na wɔfrɛɛ no osiarfo; Nyew, ɔhen yernom na nwewefo so, na wɔkamfoo no.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Woana nye nyia opue dɛ adzekyee, Ɔyɛ fɛw dɛ bosoom, N’enyim tsew dɛ ewia, No ho yɛ hu dɛ dɔm a wɔdze mfrankaa yi?
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Misianee kɔr nkatse ture no mu, Dɛ morokɔhwɛ bɔnsa no mu ndua ebun ebun, Dɛ morokɔhwɛ dɛ wenyindua no abɔ nkukuduuduw, Na dɛ pɔmegranate ekutu no abɔ nhyiren a.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ansaana mara murubohu no, nna me kra dze me esisi Me man mbapɔmba hɔn ntseaseanam mu.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: San bra, san bra, ao Sulamnyi; San bra, san bra, ma yɛnhwɛ wo. Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bɔhwɛ Sulamnyi no, Dɛ gyama hom rohwɛ Mahanaim asaw yi?
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ao ɔhen ne babaa, mbrɛ wo mpaboa, mu anamɔntutu dua yɛ fɛw a! W’aserɛ no ntoado tse dɛ edwindzi a Odwimfo pa ne nsa ayɛ.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Wo funuma tse dɛ kɔɔpow korkorba a Nsa mforaforae mmpa mu: Wo yafun tse dɛ ewifua kuw a Wɔdze nsukookoo abɔ ho aprɔw.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: W’enumfo ebien tsetse dɛ wansanmba beenu a Wɔyɛ ntafo.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Wo kɔndua tse dɛ asombɛn abantsentsen; W’enyiwamba tse dɛ Hesbon nsutaae a ɔwɔ Bath-rabbim ɔponkɛse ho; Wo hwen tse dɛ Lebanon abantsentsen a Odzi kɔ Damaskɔs afamu no.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Wo tsir a ɔso wo tse dɛ Karmel, Na wo tsir do nhwi tse dɛ adaaben; No do ataku akyer ɔhen no ndɔmmum.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mbrɛ wo ho dua yɛ fɛw na mbrɛ eyɛ enyisɔ, Ao mo dɔfo, wɔ enyigye enyigye mu a!
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Wo pankor yi tse dɛ abɛdua, Na w’enumfo tse dɛ esikyireamba siawsiaw.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Meka dɛ, Mobɔfow abɛdua no, Mebɛtam esuo n’abaw no mu: Ma w’enumfo nyɛ dɛ wenyinamba siawsiaw, Na wo hwen mu hua nyɛ dɛ aper;
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Na w’anomu tse dɛ nsa pa a Osian kɔ mo dɔfo yie, Ɔma hɔn a wɔatotɔ nkom buebue hɔn ano.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Meyɛ mo dɔfo nedze, Na n’akɔndɔ gyina mo do.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mo dɔfo e, bra ma yemfir edzi nkɔ haban mu; Ma yɛnkɛtsena nkurobaadze.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ma yɛnsoɛr ahanamakye nkɔ we nyin nture mu; Ma yɛnkɔhwɛ dɛ wenyindua no abɔ nkukuduuduw, na ne nhyiren epuepue, Na pɔmegranate ekutu no abɔ nhyiren a: Hɔ na mibeyi mo dɔ ama wo.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Eduaba mandreke no riyi huam, Na hɛn mbobowano ahyɛ nduaba horow nyinara a wɔsom bo ma, afofor na adadaw a Medze esie ama wo, ao mo dɔfo.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ao kɛtseankyɛ eyɛ mo nuabanyin a Onuum me na n’enumfo ano! Sɛ muhu wo wɔ ehuw mu beebi a, nkyɛ mebɛfew w’ano; Nyew, na nkyɛ obiara nnkobu me enyimtsia.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Nkyɛ medze wo bɛba me na fie, Na akyerɛkyerɛ me adze; Nkyɛ mebɛma anom nsa a eduhuam wɔ mu, Me pɔmegranate nsa no bi.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: W’abankum bɛda me tsiadze, Na w’abanyimfa abar me.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Jerusalɛm mbabaa e, hom nka ntam nkyerɛ me Dɛ hom nnkopusuw hɛn dɔ, anaa wonnkenyan no, Gyedɛ noara ɔpɛ.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Woana nye nyia ofir sar do reba, Ɔtwer no dɔfo no bo mu yi? Aperdua no ase na minyaan wo: Hɔ na wo na woo wo, Hɔ na nyia ɔwoo wo no ɔkoo awo.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Fa me si w’akoma do dɛ nsɔwano, dɛ w’abaw do nsɔwano: Na ɔdɔ yɛ dzen dɛ owu; Nyinkun ne tsirmu yɛ dzen dɛ adakamona: N’enyinam yɛ ogya enyinam, Na ɔyɛ gyaframee ara ampa.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Nsu pii nntum nndum ɔdɔ, Nkyii so nsuyirii nntum nnkata do: Sɛ nyimpa dze fie adze nyinara bɛma wɔ ɔdɔ ntsi a, Enyimtsia ara na wobobu no.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Yɛwɔ akyerɛbaa kakraba bi, Na ɔmmbɔɔ enumfo: Ebɛnadze na yɛbɛyɛ ama hɛn akyerɛbaa Wɔ da a wɔbɛba ebebisa no ayewar no mu?
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Sɛ nkyɛ ɔyɛ ɔfasu a, Yɛbɔtow no do dwetɛ aban: Na sɛ ɔyɛ abow a, Yɛdze nkyindur ntaabow botwa no ho ehyia.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Emi dze, meyɛ ɔfasu, na m’enumfo tse dɛ no do abantsentsen: Ɔno na meyɛɛ n’enyiwa do dɛ obi a oenya asomdwee.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Solomon nyaa wenyin ture wɔ Baal-hamon; Ɔdze wenyin ture no hyɛɛ ahwɛfo nsa; No mu nduadzewa no ntsi, na ɔwɔ dɛ obiara obiara dze dwetɛbona apem brɛ no.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mo wenyin ture a ɔyɛ medze no ɔwɔ m’enyim: Ɔwo, Solomon, ibenya apem no, Na hɔn a wɔhwɛ no nduadzewa no do no so wobenya ahaebien.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Ɔwo a etse nture mu, M’anyɛnkofo ritsie wo ndze: Ma mo so mintsie ɛ.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Mo dɔfo, yɛ ntsɛm, Keka woho dɛ ɔwansan anaa ɔtweba Wɔ nduhuam mbepɔw no do.
title: SONG OF SOLOMON

text: Iyi nye Amoz ne ba Isaia n’enyido adzehu a ohunii wɔ Juda na Jerusalɛm ho wɔ Juda ahemfo Uzia, Jotam, Ahaz, na Hezekia nda mu no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔsorsor, hom ntsie, asaase, yɛ aso, na EWURADZE akasa: Manyɛn mba na matsetse hɔn, na hɔn dze wɔatsew mo do etua.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔnantwi nyim no wura, na asoasopɔnkɔ nyim no wura n’edzidzidaka: naaso Israel dze wonnyim, na me man nnyi ntseasee.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ao, ɔman ndzebɔnyɛfo, nkorɔfo a wɔdze emumuyɛ asoa hɔn, emumuyɛfo asefo, mba a hɔn abrabɔ aprɔw: wɔapow EWURADZE, woebu Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no enyimtsia, wɔapaa hɔnho na wɔasan ekyir.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔnda ho mbɔ hom nyɛ dɛn, dɛ hom da ho ara retsew etua yi? Tsir mu no nyinara yar, na akoma mu no nyinara apa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ofitsi ananadze kesi etsifi mpo apɔwmudzen biara nnyi mu, mbom epirakur, na nsoasoae na ekur mpɔtɔwee: wɔnnsaae, eso wɔnnkyekyeree, eso wɔmmfaa ngo nndwedwee no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom kurow ayɛ amamfo; wɔdze gya ahyew hom nkurow; ananaben asɛɛ hom asaase wɔ hom enyim, ɔayɛ amamfo, dɛ ananaben ebutuw no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na woegyaa Zion babaa dɛ asese a ɔwɔ wenyin ture mu, dɛ efer ture mu asoɛe, dɛ kurow a woetu do sa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Sɛ dɔm EWURADZE no enngyaa hɛn nkaa kakraabi a, nkyɛ yɛayɛ dɛ Sodom, nkyɛ yɛayɛ dɛ Gomora.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom ntsie EWURADZE asɛm, hom Sodom mpanyimfo! Gomora ɔman e, hom nyɛ aso mma hɛn Nyankopɔn ne nkyerɛkyerɛ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom afɔrbɔdze dodow yɛ dɛn ma me? EWURADZE na ɔse: nguannyin ɔhyew afɔr afon me, na anyɛmbowa seradze adɔ me; minnyi enyigye wɔ anantwi, nguambaa, anaa mpɔnkye bɔgyaa mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Sɛ hom ba befir m’enyim a, woana hwehwɛ iyi wɔ hom nsamu, dɛ wobetsiatsia m’abanguado?
title: ISAIAH

text: Mma hom mmfa ayɛyɛdze hun biara mmba bio; eduhuam nhyewee yɛ me ekyiwadze; bosoom fofor na ahomgyeda, baguabɔ, Munnkotum ahwɛ ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn a emumuyɛ wɔ mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom abosoom fofor na hom afahyɛ no me kra kyir: ɔyɛ me ɔhaw; na maberɛ no soa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na sɛ hom tserɛw hom nsamu a, mibeyi m’enyiwa ehuntsa hom: sɛ hom yi mpaa mpo a, emi dze, mirinntsie: bɔgya ayeyɛ hom nsa amaama.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom nhohor homho, hom ntsew homho; hom nyi hom emumuyɛdze no mfi m’enyiwa do; hom ngyaa bɔn yɛ:
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom nsua papa yɛ; hom nhwehwɛ atsɛmbu, hom ngye nyia wɔhaw no no, hom ndzi mma egyanka, hom ntotɔ nserɛ mma okunafo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Afei hom mbra ma yɛndwen mbɔ mu ɛ, EWURADZE na ɔse: kaansa hom bɔn tse dɛ adaaben mpo a, ɔbɔhoa dɛ esukwankyɛba; kaansa ɔber dɛ bɔgyaben mpo a, ɔbɛyɛ sakoo dɛ guannhwi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Sɛ hom pen do na hom yɛ setsie a, hom bedzi asaase no do ndzepa:
title: ISAIAH

text: na sɛ hom pow na hom tsew etua a, wɔdze afona bɛsɛɛ hom: na emi EWURADZE na maka.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn na kurow nokwafo adan edwaman yi! Ɔno a nkyɛ atsɛntsenenee ahyɛ no ma! Ndzeyɛtsenenee tsenaa no mu, na afei dze ewudzifo a.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wo dwetɛ adan ifi, wo nsa wɔdze nsu afora mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wo man do ahwɛfo yɛ etuatsewfo, na nwuradan anyɛnkofo; hɔn mu biara pɛ mboabagye, na wodzi akatua ekyir: wonndzi mma egyanka, eso okunafo asɛm nndu hɔn enyim.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, dɔm EWURADZE no, Israel Tumfo no a: Aa, mubohue m’ebufuhyew egu m’ahohiahiafo do, na medzi mo wer wɔ m’atamfo do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mebɛdan me nsa aba wo do, na medze semina etu wo fi no, mibeyi wo ho nkekaa nyina.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mebɛdan w’atsɛmbufo ama wo dɛ asɔpɔn no, w’apamfo dɛ ahyɛse no: n’ekyir no wɔbɛfrɛ wo dɛ, Ɔtsenenee kurow, kurow nokwafo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔdze atsɛmbu bɔpon Zion, na wɔdze tsenenee apon ne mba a wɔasakyer.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mbratofo na ndzebɔnyɛfo hɔn sɛɛe bɔbɔ mu aba prɛko, na hɔn a wɔdan EWURADZE gya no wɔbɛhyew hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hɔn enyi bɔto wɔ nsudur a hom hom enyi gyee ho no ho, na hom enyim egu ase wɔ nture a hom asan mu afa no ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hom bɛyɛ dɛ osudur a n’ahaban apo, na ture a nsu nnyi mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔhoɔdzenfo bɛyɛ dɛ otuw, na n’edwuma ayɛ dɛ ogyansenama, na ebien nyina abɔ mu ahyew, na obi runndum no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Asɛm a Amoz ne ba Isaia nyae a ɔfa Juda na Jerusalɛm ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ nda a odzi ekyir no mu no, mbepɔw a EWURADZE fi si do no, bɔbɔ mbepɔw nyina do, na wɔbɛma no do abɔ akoko nyina do, na amanaman bɛpem aba ho.
title: ISAIAH
