text: Na aman pii bɛba abɛse dɛ, Hom mbra ma yɛnkɔ EWURADZE bepɔw no do, yɛnkɔ Jakob Nyankopɔn no ne fie; ama ɔaakyerɛkyerɛ hɛn n’akwan, ma yɛaanantsew n’atsempɔn mu: na Zion na mbra befi aba, na EWURADZE n’asɛm efi Jerusalɛm.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na obobu amanaman ntamu atsɛn, na woesi gyinae ama nkorɔfo pii: na wɔdze hɔn mfona abobɔ nsɔw, na wɔdze hɔn mpeaa abobɔ nsɔsɔw: ɔman bi remma afona do nntsia ɔman fofor, eso worunnsua akodzi bio.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ao Jakob fifo, hom mbra ma yɛnnantsew EWURADZE kan no mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔwo adan wo man egya, Ao Jakob fi, osiandɛ atɔrmuadze a ofi boka ahyɛ hɔn ma, na wɔayɛ ɔsebramufo dɛ Filistiafo, na wɔnye ananamba futuw mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn asaase ayɛ dwetɛ na sika ma; na hɔn akoradze so nnyi ewiei; hɔn asaase ayɛ mpɔnkɔ ma, na hɔn ntseaseanam so nnyi ewiei.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn asaase so ayɛ abosom ma; wɔsɔr hɔnankasa hɔn nsaano edwuma, dza hɔnankasa hɔn nsatseaba ayɛ no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔma dasanyi bɔ famu, na wɔbrɛ nyimpa adze: dɛm ntsi mma mmfa nnkyɛ hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Kɛhɛn ɔbotan mu, na huntsa woho wɔ huntuma mu, fi EWURADZE ho hu no enyim, nye no tumdzi enyimnyam no enyim.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nyimpa enyiwa a ɔtra no ntɔn no bɛbrɛ adze, na nyimpa n’ahopɔw bɛba famu, na EWURADZE nko ara na wobohuhor no wɔ da no mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na dɔm EWURADZE ne da bi wɔ hɔ a ɔbɛba nkontompɔfo na ahopɔwfo nyina do, na ahomemadonyi biara do;
title: ISAIAH

text: na ɔbɛba Lebanon nkyindur a ɔwowaree na ɔyɛ kusuww no, na Bashan nsudur nyinara do;
title: ISAIAH

text: na mbepɔw sorɔnsorɔm nyinara, na akoko a amema do nyinara do;
title: ISAIAH

text: na abantsentsen biara, na ɔfasu a wɔaban ho biara do;
title: ISAIAH

text: na Tarsis ahɛn nyinara, na ahwɛdze a ɔyɛ fɛw nyinara do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔbɛbrɛ nyimpa n’ekromponsɛm adze, na adasa ahopɔwsɛm bɛba famu; na EWURADZE nko ara na wɔbɔkrɔn no da no mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na abosom botwa mu akɔ koraa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔbɛhɛn abotan ntokur mu, na famu etu mu, efi EWURADZE no ho hu ho, na no tumdzi enyimnyam enyim, ber a ɔbɔsoɛr abɔwosow asaase dzendzenndzen no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no mu na nyimpa bɔtow no dwetɛ abosom, na ne sika abosom a wɔyɛe maa no dɛ ɔnsɔr no no akyen, ama nkusi na mpan;
title: ISAIAH

text: ama wɔaakɛhɛn abotan ntokur na abo mpaapaae mu, efi EWURADZE ho hu ho, na no tumdzi enyimnyam enyim, ber a ɔbɔsoɛr abɔwosow asaase dzendzenndzen no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom ngyaa nyimpa a n’ahom wɔ n’ahwentokura mu no ekyir dzi: na ebɛnadze mu ara na wobu no bi?
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hwɛ, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no rututu efi Jerusalɛm na Juda nyina, dua a wɔtwer nye dua a wɔdze waw ekyir edziban dze, na nsu dze nyina:
title: ISAIAH

text: ɔkatakyi, na ɔsabarimba; ɔtsɛmbuafo, na nkɔnhyɛnyi, ɔdzehunyi, na ɔpanyin:
title: ISAIAH

text: eduonum do safohen, na onyimdzefo, ɔpamfo, na nkongyaayinyi mapa, na nyia onyim nkankye yie no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mebɛma mbanyimbasiaba ayɛ hɔn asafohemfo, na mbɔdomaba edzi hɔn do mpanyin.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na nkorɔfo bɛhaw hɔnho, oyi na oyi, na obi na ne nyɛnko: akɔkowaba bɛhyehyɛ noho wɔ akɔdaa do, na atsetsekwaa so wɔ onyimnyamfo do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no mu no, sɛ obi suo no nua a ɔwɔ n’egya fie mu, dɛ, Ɔwo ewɔ atar, ntsi bedzi hɛn do panyin, na soa adzesoa durdur yi a:
title: ISAIAH

text: ɔbɛma ne ndze do, dɛ, Merennyɛ ɔyarsafo; na edziban anaa atar bi nnyi me fie: mma hom nnyɛ me ɔman panyin.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nyew, Jerusalɛm edwuruw! Na Juda ahwe ase: osiandɛ hɔn gyirama na hɔn nyɛe tsia EWURADZE, wɔdze bu n’enyimnyam no enyimtsia.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn nyaatwom dzi dase tsia hɔn; na wɔda hɔn bɔn edzi dɛ Sodomfo, wɔmmfa nnsuma. Wondue! Na wɔdze bɔn abrɛ hɔnho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom nka nkyerɛ atseneneefo no dɛ obesi hɔn yie: na wobedzi hɔn nsaanodze.
title: ISAIAH

text: Omumuyɛnyi ndue! Obowie no mbusu: na ne nsaano akatua na wɔdze bɛma no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Me man dze, mbofraba nye hɔn ahyɛdofo, na mbaa dzi hɔn do mpanyin. Ao me man, w’akandzifo ma efom, na wɔsɛɛ w’atsempɔn kwan.
title: ISAIAH

text: EWURADZE egyina ridzi asɛm, oegyina rubu aman atsɛn.
title: ISAIAH

text: EWURADZE nye me man mu mpanyimfo na no mu asafohemfo bɔkɔ asɛndzii: Homara na hom edzi wenyin ture no; abɔbɔfo asadze wɔ hom efiefi mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ase nye dɛn na hom dwerew me man, na hom hyɛ abɔbɔfo amen yi? EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ISAIAH

text: EWURADZE see bio dɛ, Osiandɛ Zion mbabaa yɛ ahopɔw, na wɔtoto hɔn kɔn na wɔdeda hɔn enyi ekyir nantsew; na wɔkyeakyea nantsew ma hɔn nansa nkaba gyegye ntsi:
title: ISAIAH

text: EWURADZE bɛma satwem egu Zion mbabaa etsifi pampamu, na EWURADZE bɛda hɔn adagyaw edzi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no, EWURADZE beyi hɔn anantuadze fɛɛfɛw no, na dza wɔdze ahyehyɛ hɔn etsir no;
title: ISAIAH

text: asowamuadze, nsakɔnadze, na nkataenyim;
title: ISAIAH

text: abɔtsir, na anadwe ntweaban, na abɔdo, na nduhuam mpakyiwa, na nsɛbɛ;
title: ISAIAH

text: mpɛtsea, na hwenmuadze;
title: ISAIAH

text: afahyɛ ntar, na egugudo, na nkatakɔnmu, na mbɔtɔwa;
title: ISAIAH

text: nhwehwɛmba, na ndwera pa, akyekyertsir na nkataenyim.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na bɔnee bɛhyɛ ohuam ananmu; na ntampehoma ahyɛ abɔdo ananmu; na etsipaa ahyɛ takuwa a woesi no yie ananmu; na eyitam abɔdo bɛhyɛ abɔyamu ananmu: na fɛr ahyɛ ahoɔfɛw ananmu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wo mbarimba bɔtotɔ afona ano, na w’akatakyi atotɔ ɔsa mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na n’aponkɛse botwa ewuo na oegyam; na ɔbɛda hɔ pan na ɔatsena famu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mbaa beesuon bosuo ɔbarimba baako mu wɔ da no mu, dɛ, Yebedzi hɛnara hɛn edziban, yeefura hɛnara hɛn atam: ma wɔmfa wo dzin nto hɛn do ara: na yi hɛn enyimguase wɔ hɛn do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no mu na EWURADZE no dubaa no bɛyɛ fɛɛfɛw na enyimnyam, na asaase no do aba bɛyɛ abɔso na enyisɔ ama Israel mu hɔn a woefi nsa no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ nyia wɔgye no wɔ Zion, na nyia ɔka wɔ Jerusalɛm no, wɔbɛfrɛ hɔn krɔnkrɔn, mekyerɛ obiara a wɔakyerɛw ne dzin afora atseasefo mu wɔ Jerusalɛm:
title: ISAIAH

text: ber a EWURADZE enya ahohor Zion mbabaa ho fi, na ɔdze atsɛmbu sunsum na ɔhyew sunsum ebeyi Jerusalɛm bɔgya efi kurow no mu no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE bɛyɛ nsuwusiw na wusiw adzekyee, na ogyaframee hyerɛn anadwe dze akata Zion bepɔw do tsenabea nyina, na n’ehyiadzi nyina do: na enyimnyam no nyina benya nkatado.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ ntamadan a ɔma nwin ewiaber fi ɔhyew mu, na ɔayɛ guandɔbea na huntsabea wɔ ehum na nsutɔ mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ma montow mo dɔfo pa ndwom, ɔdɔ ndwom a ɔfa no wenyin ture ho. Mo dɔfo pa nyaa wenyin ture bi wɔ koko do asaaseber bi do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Otwaa ho nsuka, na ɔtasee mu abo, na ɔtsetsɛɛw mu wenyindua pa, na ɔtoow abantsentsen wɔ mu, na otuu nsatwer so wɔ mu: na n’enyi daa kwan dɛ ɔbɔsow wenyinaba, naaso ɔsoow kwaa mu wenyinaba.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na afei, hom Jerusalɛmmba, nye Juda mbarimba, meserɛ hom, hom mbu emi na mo wenyin ture ntamu atsɛn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ebɛnadze na aka dɛ nkyɛ meyɛ mema mo wenyin ture bio a mennyɛe? M’enyi daa kwan dɛ nkyɛ ɔbɔsow wenyinaba no, ɔsoow kwaa mu wenyinaba.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na afei, mebɛma hom ehu dza medze bɛyɛ mo wenyin ture no. Mibeyi no ho ban, ma mbowa eedzi; mubobubu no ho ɔfasu ma woeetsiatsia do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mobɔto no pan; wonnkotwitwa ho, eso wɔnnkɔdɔw ho; na obofuw nkɔkrɔw na nsoɛ: na mebɛhyɛ nsuwusiw so dɛ mma ɔnntɔ nyankom nngu do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɔm EWURADZE no wenyin ture nye Israel fie, na Juda mbarimba nye no kwa a n’enyi gye ho: na ɔhwɛɛ pɛrpɛryɛ kwan, naaso hwɛ, emimdzi nye yi; ɔhwɛɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee kwan, naaso hwɛ, nkekamu a.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wondue, hɔn a wɔdze ofi toa ofi do, wɔdze kwa ka kwa ho, kodu dɛ ɔkwan bi nnyi hɔ, na hom nkotsee tsena ase asaase do!
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɔm EWURADZE aka no m’asomu dɛ, Ampaara, adan pii bɛyɛ afo, dza ɔsosoe na ɔyɛ fɛw, nnkenya obi atsena mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wenyin ture susuhoma du bɛma wenyin galɔn enum pɛr, na aba kutu kɛse kor bɛma esusudze kor pɛr.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wondue, hɔn a wɔsoɛr anapahema tu enguan kedzi nsadzen ekyir; na wosi pe anadwe, ma nsa fram hɔn!
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔwɔ nsankutsen na bɛntasanku, akasaa, na atɛntɛbɛn, na wenyin nsa, wɔ hɔn aponto ase; naaso wommbu EWURADZE ne ndzeyɛe bi, ne nsaano edwuma so wɔnndwendwen ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi na me man etu kɔ ndɔmmum, osian nyimdzee a wonnyi ntsi: na ɔkɔm dze hɔn enyimnyamfo, na nsukɔm rehyew hɔn nyimpadodow.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi na samanadze atrɛ n’akɔndɔ mu, na ɔahan n’anomu petoo: ma Jerusalɛm enyimnyam, na ne nyimpadodow, n’apɔmpɔmpɛ, na nyia n’enyi gye mu, nyina risian kɔ mu yi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔdze nyimpa aba famu, na ɔabrɛ mbarimba adze, na ahopɔwfo enyi aka famu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Naaso dɔm EWURADZE dze, wohuhor no wɔ pɛrpɛryɛ mu, na Nyankopɔn Krɔnkrɔnnyi no dze, ɔda noho edzi wɔ ndzeyɛtsenenee mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔno na nguambaa bedzidzi dɛ hɔn edzidzibea do, na akobɔfo bedzi hɔn a wɔatɔ angoa no hɔn asaasefo no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wondue, hɔn a wɔdze egyangyandze hom a twe emumuyɛ, na wɔdze hwiir ntampee twe bɔn:
title: ISAIAH

text: hɔn a wɔka dɛ, Wɔmma ɔnyɛ no ntsɛm ɛ, ɔnyɛ n’edwuma ntsɛm ma yɛnhwɛ, wɔmma Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no n’apam mbɛn na ɔmbra ma yenhu!
title: ISAIAH

text: Wondue, hɔn a wɔfrɛ bɔn dɛ papa, na papa dɛ bɔn; hɔn a wɔdze sum yɛ kan, na wɔdze kan yɛ sum; hɔn a wɔdze wenwen yɛ fenemfenem, na fenemfenem yɛ wenwen!
title: ISAIAH

text: Wondue, hɔn a wɔyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn enyi do enyansafo, na wɔyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn enyi do abadwembafo!
title: ISAIAH

text: Wondue, hɔn a wɔyɛ akatakyi wɔ nsanom mu, na ahoɔdzenfo wɔ nsadzen no fora mu:
title: ISAIAH

text: hɔn a wobu omumuyɛnyi bem gye mboaba, na wɔgye ɔtseneneenyi ne nsamu tsenenee!
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi dɛ mbrɛ ogya tɛkyerɛma dzi mburonan, na gyaframee hyew nkyɛkyɛr guanee no, dɛmara so na hɔn ndwow bɔprɔw, na hɔn nhyiren botu afa sor dɛ huntuma: osiandɛ wɔapow dɔm EWURADZE ne mbra, na woebu Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no n’asɛm enyimtsia.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE n’ebufuw redzɛw ne man do, na ɔatsen ne nsa etsia hɔn, na ɔabɔ hɔn, ma akoko ho ehim, na hɔn efun ayɛ dɛ abɔntsen do wura. Iyi nyinara mu, n’ebufuw nntɔree, na ne nsa da ho ara tsen.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛma frankaa do ama amanaman a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir, na ɔabɔ nhwiroma afrɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ asaase ano noho no: na, hwɛ, wɔdze ahoɔhar bɛba ntsɛmara.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn mu obiara mmberɛ, eso obiara mmfintsiw; obiara nntɔ nkom anaa ɔnnda; hɔn asen mu abɔdo rennsan, eso hɔn mpaboa ho ahoma renntsew.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn egyen menaba ano yɛ hwironhwirom, na hɔn egyen nyinara akonkom; wobobu hɔn mpɔnkɔ ananadze dɛ ɔtwerɛbo, na hɔn nhwiir dɛ ekyinehyia mframa:
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn pɔw bɛyɛ dɛ ogyata dze, wɔbɔpɔw dɛ ngyatafɔr: nyew wɔbɔpɔw, na wɔatɔ afonam, na wɔdze akɔ sɔnn, obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɛgye hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔbɔpɔw ahyɛ hɔn do da no dɛ po rowor: na sɛ obi hwɛ asaase a, hwɛ, sum na ahoguan, na kan ahyɛ sum wɔ wimu hɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Afe a ɔhen Uzia wui no, muhun EWURADZE dɛ ɔtse ahengua bi a ɔkrɔn na wɔama do do, na n’atar ekyir ntoado hyɛɛ asɔrfi no ma.
title: ISAIAH

text: Serafim gyinagyina no do: ɔbaako wɔ ntsaban esia; ɔdze ebien kata n’enyim, na ɔdze ebien kata n’anan ho, na ɔdze ebien tu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbaako tseaa mu kyerɛɛ ɔbaako dɛ, Krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, krɔnkrɔn, Krɔnkrɔn nye dɔm EWURADZE: asaase nyina ahyɛ n’enyimnyam ma.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na apondua no ase wosowee wɔ nyia ɔtseaa mu no ne ndze ntsi, na wusiw hyɛɛ ofi no ma.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Mundue! Na mewu ara nye no; osiandɛ meyɛ nyimpa a m’ano ho nntsew, na metse ɔman a hɔn ano ho nntsew mu: na m’enyiwa ehu Ɔhen, dɔm EWURADZE no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nna Serafim no mu ɔbaako tui baa me nkyɛn, okitsa ogyansenama a ɔdze ɔdabaa kɛfae wɔ afɔrmbukyia no do:
title: ISAIAH

text: na ɔdze kaa m’ano, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, iyi aka w’ano; na woeyi w’emumuyɛ no kɔ, na wɔapo wo ho bɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nna metsee EWURADZE ne ndze dɛ ɔrese dɛ, Woana na mobɔsoma no, na woana na ɔbɔkɔ ama hɛn? Nna mesee dɛ, Emi nye yi; soma me ɛ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Kɔ, kɛse ɔman yi dɛ, Ɔtse ara nna hom ntse, na mma hom nntse ase; na ohu ara nna hom nhu, na mma hom nnhu mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ma ɔman yi n’akoma mpirim, na ma hɔn asowa nyɛ durdur, muamua hɔn enyiwa; amma wɔaammfa hɔn enyiwa ennhu, na wɔaammfa hɔn asowa so anntse, na hɔn akoma anntse ase; na wɔaannsakyer, ma wɔaannsa hɔn yarba.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Ao EWURADZE, onkodu dabɛn? Na obuaa dɛ, Onkodu dɛ nkurow no ayɛ afoafo a obiara nntse mu, efiefi ayeyɛ efitɔw a nyimpa nntsetse mu, na asaase no ayɛ afo koraa,
title: ISAIAH

text: na EWURADZE aka nyimpa akɔ ekyirkyiikyir, na mbea a wɔadan egya no adɔɔ so wɔ asaase no do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na sɛ ebupɛn du mu kor ka wɔ mu mpo a, wɔbɛsan asɛɛ no bio: dɛ odupɔn na osudur a no dusin si hɔ, ber a wɔatow ato famu no, dɛmara so na n’asefo krɔnkrɔn no yɛ no dusin.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Uzia ba Jotam, ne ba Ahaz, Judahen no n’aber do, na Siriahen Rezin, na Remalia ba Peka Israelhen no fowee kɔr Jerusalɛm dɛ wɔnye no rokɔko; naaso woenntum no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ David fie dɛ, Siria abɔbɔ Efraim mu, na ɔno nye ne man akoma tuu kɛsenara, na hɔnho wosowee dɛ mbrɛ kwaa mu ndua wosow wɔ mframa enyim no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE see Isaia dɛ, Afei si mu kɔ kehyia Ahaz, ɔwo, na wo ba Sear-jasub, wɔ etsifi nsutaae no ano a ɔwɔ ɔtanhofo kwa tsempɔn mu no;
title: ISAIAH

text: na se no dɛ, Hwɛ yie, na yɛ komm; mma nnsuro, eso mma w’akoma nntu, wɔ ngyantsia ebien a opun wusiw yi no ndua ebien no ntsi, wɔ Rezin na Siria na Remalia ba no hɔn ebufuhyew no ntsi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Osiandɛ Siria apam wo do mbusu, Efraim so, ɔnye Remalia ba no, dɛ,
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom mma yɛnkɔ Juda do, na yɛnkɛhaw no, na yembubu mu mfa, na yɛnhyɛ Tabeel ba no hen wɔ mu:
title: ISAIAH

text: mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi, Orinngyina, eso ɔremmba mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Osiandɛ Siria tsir nye Damaskɔs, na Damaskɔs tsir nye Rezin: Na obodu mfe eduosia enum no nna woebubu Efraim posoposo a ɔnnkɛyɛ ɔman bi bio,
title: ISAIAH

text: na Efraim tsir nye Samaria, na Samaria tsir nye Remalia ba no. Sɛ hom renngye nndzi a, ampaara hom rinntsintsim.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa bio kyerɛɛ Ahaz, dɛ,
title: ISAIAH

text: Bisa EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn hɔ asɛnkyerɛdze bi; sɛ osian kɔ samanadze bun mu o, ɔkrɔn kɔ sor o.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na Ahaz see dɛ, Mirimmbisa, eso moronnsɔ EWURADZE nnhwɛ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na Isaia see dɛ, David fi, afei hom ntsie, aso osuar ma hom dɛ hom haw nyimpa, na afei hom bɛhaw emi Nyankopɔn so yi?
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE nankasa bɛma hom asɛnkyerɛdze. Hwɛ, akataasia no benyinsen awo ɔbabanyin, na wɔato no dzin Immanuel, a asekyerɛ nye: Nyankopɔn nye hɛn wɔ hɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Numfonsu na ewo na obedzi, ber a ohu dɛ ɔpow bɔn, na ɔsan mu yi papa no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ansaana abofra no bohu dɛ ɔpow bɔn na ɔsan mu yi papa no, wɔbɛpa asaase no a hɔn isuro hɔn ahemfo beenu no egya.
title: ISAIAH

text: EWURADZE dze nda bi bɛba ɔwo, na wo man, na w’egya fi do a ofitsi nda a Efraim tsewee fii Juda ho no ɔmmbaa da; mekyerɛ Asiriahen no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no, EWURADZE bɔbɔ nhwiroma afrɛ wansema a ɔwɔ Egypt nsutsen ano noho no, na adowa a ɔwɔ Asiria asaase do no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔbɛba, na hɔn nyina abɛgyegye bɔnsa a osian kuronn no mu, nye abotan mpaapaae mu, na nsoɛ nyina do, na nhaban nyina do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no na EWURADZE dze oyindam a wɔabɔ no paa wɔ esuegya noho no a ɔno ɔnye Asiriahen no beyi tsir nye anan ho nhwi, na oeyi abɔdwesa so.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no obi bɛnyɛn ɔnantwiburwa na nguan ebien bi;
title: ISAIAH

text: na ɔbɛba dɛ, numfonsu dodow a wɔbɛma no ntsi, obedzi numfonsudaa: na numfonsudaa nye ewo na obiara a ɔaka ɔman no mu no bedzi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na da no mu no ɔbɛba dɛ, beebiara mbrɛ nkyɛ wenyinndua apem a odzi ndwetɛbona apem wɔ, bɛdan nkɔkrɔw nye nsoɛ ara nko.
title: ISAIAH

text: Egyen menaba nye egyen na wɔdze bɛba hɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na akoko a nkyɛ wɔdze asɔw dɔw do nyina no, ennkɔkɔ hɔ bio, wɔ nkɔkrɔw ɔnye nsoɛ ho hu ntsi, na wobegya anantwi akɔ do, na nguan etsiatsia do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Fa kyerɛwpon kɛse, na fa ɔdasanyi ne nsaano kyerɛw do dɛ, Maher-salal-has-baz;
title: ISAIAH

text: na mebɛma adasefo anokwafo edzi me dase, ɔsɔfo Uria, na Jeberekia ba Zekaria.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mokɔr nkɔnhyɛnyibaa no ho na onyinsenii woo ɔbabanyin. Nna EWURADZE see me dɛ, To no dzin Maher-salal-has-baz,
title: ISAIAH

text: osiandɛ ansaana abofra no bohu mbrɛ wosi ka, M’egya, anaa Me na no, Asiriahen bɔsoa Damaskɔs ahonya na Samaria asadze edzi n’enyim akɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE kasaa kyerɛɛ me bio dɛ,
title: ISAIAH

text: Susuampa dɛ ɔman yi apow Siloa nsu a ɔpem nyaa, na hɔn ho asɛpɛw Rezin nye Remalia ba no ho yi;
title: ISAIAH

text: dɛm ntsi, afei, hwɛ, EWURADZE dze esutsen no mu nsu a ɔyɛ dzen na ɔdɔɔ so no reba hɔn do, Asiriahen nye n’enyimnyam nyina, na ɔbɛba abɔfow n’esuka nyina na ɔatra n’esukɔn nyina do;
title: ISAIAH

text: na ɔbɛpram akɔ Juda do, na oeyir etwa mu akɔ; obodu kɔn ho mpo; na n’atsaban mu han bɛhyɛ w’asaase ne tɛtɛr nyina ma, Ao Immanuel.
title: ISAIAH

text: Aman, hom nka homho mbɔ mu, na wɔbɔdwerew hom; ekyirekyir asaasedofo nyina, hom nyɛ aso: hom nsiesie homho mma ɔko, na wɔbɔdwerew hom ara.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom mbɔ mu nkɔ apam, na ɔbɛyɛ kwa; hom nka dza hom pɛ, naaso orinngyina: osiandɛ Onyankopɔn nye hɛn wɔ hɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE dze tum kɛse kasaa dɛm kyerɛɛ me, na ɔbɔɔ me kɔkɔ, dɛ mma mennantsew ɔman yi no kwan do, dɛ,
title: ISAIAH

text: Mma hom mmfrɛ dza ɔman yi frɛ no Tsirdo apam nyina dɛ Tsirdo apam a; eso mma hom nnsuro dza wosuro, eso mma hom akoma nntu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɔm EWURADZE no, ɔno na hom mbu no krɔnkrɔn; na ɔno na ɔnyɛ hom suro, na ɔnyɛ hom akomatu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ krɔnkrɔnbea ama hom, na ɔayɛ fintsiw bo, na patatsir botan ama Israel efiefi ebien nyina, na ɔayɛ apafir na efir ama hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalɛm nyina.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na dodowara befintsiw do, na wɔahwehwe ase, na woebubu, na wɔatotɔ efir mu, ma wɔaakyekyer hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔwoara kyekyer dase no, sɔw nkyerɛkyerɛ no ano wɔ m’esuafo mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na emi dze, mobɔtweɔn EWURADZE a ɔdze n’enyim suma Jakob fi, na mahwɛ no kwan.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, emi ɔnye mba a EWURADZE dze ama me yɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze wɔ Israel mu, ofi dɔm EWURADZE a ɔtse Zion bepɔw do no hɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na sɛ wɔse hom dɛ, Hom mbisa asamamfrɛfo nye esumamfo a wosu twɔtwɔw na wɔyɛ huhuhuhu no a: aso onntwar dɛ ɔman bi wobisa hɔn Nyame hɔ adze? Aso wombisa atseasefo ho asɛm wɔ ewufo hɔ?
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom ndzi mbra no nye adasesɛm no do! Sɛ wɔannkasa dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse yi a, ɔnodze adzekyee bi nnyi hɔ ma hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wobodua mu etwa mu, na adzen hɔn, na ɔkɔm adze hɔn: na ɔbɛba dɛ ɔkɔm nya dze hɔn a, hɔn ahom bɛtsew hɔn, na wɔadom hɔn hen na hɔn Nyankopɔn, na wɔaama hɔn enyi akyerɛ sor.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔbɔhwɛ famu so, na hwɛ, ahokyer nye sum nye ahoguan kusuwwyɛ nye yi; na wobosun hɔn egu sum kebii no mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na kusuwwyɛ no ronnko hɔ mma nyia ɔwɔ ahoguan mu no. Mber a odzi kan no, oemmbu Zebulun asaase na Naftali asaase bi, na ekyirii dze ɔahyɛ no enyimnyam, po kwan do, Jordan egya, amanaman Galilii.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔman a wɔnantseew sum mu no, woehu kan kɛse, hɔn a wɔtsenaa owu sunsuma asaase do no, kan ahyerɛn hɔn do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔwo ama ɔman no adɔr, ɔwo ama hɔn enyigye adɔɔ so: hɔn enyi gye w’enyim dɛ otwaber mu enyigye, dɛ mbrɛ adasa dzi ehurusi ber a wɔrekyɛ asadze.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na n’adzesoa kɔndua no, na ne batsir poma no, ne hyɛdofo abaa no, ɔwo ebubu mu dɛ Media da no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔkofo n’akodze a ɔwɔ gyigyeegye no mu nyina, na ntar a wɔdze efuntamfuntam bɔgya mu, ɔbɛyɛ adze a wɔhyew, ɔnye ogya nyena.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔawo ɔba ama hɛn, wɔama hɛn ɔbabanyin; na ahendzi no bɛda ne batsir do: na wɔbɛfrɛ ne dzin Ɔpamfo Nwanwanyi, Onyankopɔn Katakyi, Ɔdomankoma Egya, Asomdwee Hen.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na n’ahendzi na n’asomdwee ne trɛ nnkodu ewiei, wɔ David ahengua do na n’ahendzi do, dɛ obetsim no, na ɔdze atsɛmbu na tsenenee awowaw no ofitsi ndɛ dze ekesi mbersantsen. Dɔm EWURADZE no mbɔdzembɔ bɛyɛ yi.
title: ISAIAH

text: EWURADZE dze asɛm bi kraa Jakob, na oebodwir Israel do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔman no nyinara bohu, Efraim na Samariafo a wɔka wɔ nkontompɔ na hɔn akokodur mu dɛ,
title: ISAIAH

text: Ntaayaa egu famu, na yɛdze abo a wɔasen besi: wɔatotow ankye ndua, na yɛdze nkyindur bɛhyɛ ananmu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE bɛma Rezin ahohiahiafo do ahyɛ no do, na oekenyan n’atamfo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Siriafo dzi boka, na Filistiafo dzi anee, wɔdze anomu petoo bɛmen Israel. Iyi nyinara mu n’ebufuw nntɔree, na ne nsa da ho ara tsen.
title: ISAIAH

text: Naaso ɔman no nnsanee mmbaa nyia ɔbɔɔ hɔn no nkyɛn, eso wɔnnhwehwɛɛ dɔm EWURADZE n’ekyir kwan.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE botwa efi Israel mu da kor tsir na dua, berɛw na mbɛw.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔpanyin na onyimnyamfo nye tsir no, na nkɔnhyɛnyi kyerɛkyerɛnyi torfo no, nye dua no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn a wodzi ɔman yi enyim no ma wɔfom; na hɔn akwankyerɛ no sɛɛ hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi, EWURADZE rinnya hɔn mberantsɛ ho enyigye, eso onnyi ehumbɔbɔr ma hɔn ngyanka nye hɔn ekunafo: na obiara tsia Nyankopɔn, na ɔyɛ emumuyɛdze na ano biara ka nkwaseasɛm. Iyi nyina mu n’ebufuw nntɔree, na ne nsa da ho ara wɔ sor.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na emumuyɛ hyew dɛ ogya; ɔmen nkɔkrɔw ɔnye nsoɛ: ampaara, ɔsɔ wɔ kwaa mu adɔtɔ mu, na opun wusiw kumbɔɔ fow kɔ sor.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɔm EWURADZE n’ebufuw do na asaase no ahyew tumm no: na ɔman no so ayɛ dɛ ogya nyena; obiara mmfa no nua ho nkyɛ no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wohwim fi enyimfa dzi, naaso ɔkɔm dze hɔn; Wodzidzi wɔ bankum, naaso wɔmmee: na wɔwewe hɔnara hɔn nsa ho nam.
title: ISAIAH

text: Manaasɛ we Efraim, na Efraim we Manaasɛ: na hɔn beenu soɛr hyɛ Juda do. Iyi nyina mu n’ebufuw nntɔree na ne nsa da ho ara wɔ sor.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wondue, hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ mbrakyew, na akyerɛwfo a wɔkyerɛw dza ɔkyea;
title: ISAIAH

text: dɛ wɔredan ohianyi efi pɛrpɛryɛ ho, na woeehwim me man abɔbɔfo hɔn ndzinoa, na ekunafo aayɛ hɔn asadze, na wɔdze ngyanka aayɛ hɔn afonam!
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom bɛyɛ dɛn wɔ ɔsera da no mu, na ɔsɛɛ a ofi ekyirekyir reba no mu? Woana hɔ na hom boguan akɛgye mboa? Na henfa na hom bɛdan hom enyimnyam egya?
title: ISAIAH

text: Adaduafo ase nko ara na wɔbɔbɔ hɔn mu adze, na wɔahwehwe atɔfo ase. Naaso iyi nyina mu n’ebufuw nntɔree, na ne nsa da ho ara wɔ sor.
title: ISAIAH

text: Asiria, due, m’ebufuw abaa, wo nsamu poma nye m’ebufuhyew!
title: ISAIAH

text: Mobɔsoma no ɔman a wonnyim Nyankopɔn mu, m’ebufuw man no ho na mebɛhyɛ no mbra, dɛ ɔnkɔfow asadze, na ɔnkɛfa afonam, na onketsiatsia hɔn do dɛ abrɔn mu dɛtse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Naaso ɔnndwen dɛm, eso n’akoma nnsusu dɛm; dza ɔwɔ n’akoma mu nye dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ, na oetwitwa amanaman a wɔdɔɔ so egu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔka dɛ, Ana m’asafohen nnyɛ ahemfo bi a?
title: ISAIAH

text: Aso Kalno nntse dɛ Karkemis bi a? Na Hamat nntse dɛ Arpad? Aso Samaria nntse dɛ Damaskɔs bi a?
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛ mbrɛ me nsa aka abosom ahendzi no a hɔn ehonyi a woegu kyɛn Jerusalɛm na Samaria dze no;
title: ISAIAH

text: aso nnyɛ dza medze ayɛ Samaria nye n’abosom no, ara so na medze bɛyɛ Jerusalɛm nye n’abosom bi a?
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ EWURADZE wie n’edwuma nyina yɛ wɔ bepɔw Zion nye Jerusalɛm do a, mebɛtsea Asiriahen n’akomadzen no, nye n’ahomemado no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Osiandɛ ɔaka dɛ, Me nsamu ahoɔdzen na medze ayɛ na ɔnye me nyansaa so, osiandɛ meyɛ ɔbadwembafo: na matwe aman no hɔn ahe no, na mafom hɔn akoradze, na mesun hɔn a wɔtsetse nhengua do egu dɛ ɔkakaben:
title: ISAIAH

text: na me nsa aka amanaman ahonya no dɛ berɛbuw; na dɛ mbrɛ wɔtase nkyirefuwa a wɔadan egya no, dɛmara na matase asaase nyina: na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɔɔ atsaban mu, eso ɔhaan anomu, anaaso osuu twɔtwɔw.
title: ISAIAH

text: Aso ekuma bɛhyehyɛ noho wɔ nyia ɔdze twa adze no do? Anaa seradaa bɛhyehyɛ noho wɔ nyia ɔtwetwe no do? Dɛ gyama abaa bi him nyia ɔma do no do, anaadɛ poma bɛma nyia ɔnnyɛ dua no no do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE, bɛma ɔfɔn aba n’abran do; na ɔasɔ n’enyimnyam ase ogya a ɔredzɛw.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na Israel kan no bɛdan ogya, na ne Krɔnkrɔnnyi no adan gyaframee: na ɔbɛhyew na ɔaamen no nsoɛ nye no nkɔkrɔw nyina da kor.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔbɛma no kwaa nye no mfuwa enyimnyam asa, ofitsi ɔkra do kesi nyimpadua do: na ɔayɛ dɛ aber a frankaakitsafo rotɔ bitsi.
title: ISAIAH

text: No kwaa mu ndua nkaa no bosuar, ma abofra mpo eetum akan.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba da no mu dɛ, Israel nkaa no nye Jakob fi mu hɔn a woefi nsa no nnkɔtwer nyia ɔbobɔɔ hɔn no bio: na wɔbɔtwer EWURADZE, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no nokwar mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nkaa no bɛsan aba, Jakob nkaa no bɛba Onyame katakyi no nkyɛn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na kaansa wo man Israel tse dɛ mpoano anhwea mpo, a, nkaa ara na wɔbɛsan aba: wɔahyɛ ɔhyew a ɔbɛpram ndzeyɛtsenenee do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ndzɛmba ewiei a wɔahyɛ na EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE, dze bɛba asaase nyina mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE, se nye yi, Ao me man a etse Zion, mma nnsuro Asiria: kaansa abaa na ɔdze bɔhwe wo, na ɔama no poma do wɔ wo do, dɛ Egypt dze no mpo a.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na aka kakrabaabi na ebufuhyew no abɔ adze, na n’ebufuw adan ayɛ hɔn sɛɛe.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na dɔm EWURADZE behim mpirebi wɔ no do, dɛ Midian ekumii wɔ Oreb botan do no: na n’abaa bɛkyerɛ po no do, ɔama do dɛ Egypt dze no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ n’adzesoa beyi efi wo batsir do, na kɔndua efi wo kɔn ho, na kɔndua no asɛɛ wɔ seradze no ntsi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔaba Aiat, oetwa mu wɔ Migron, ɔdze ne ndzɛmba rugu Mikmas:
title: ISAIAH

text: wɔafa akoko ntamu; wɔakɔsoɛ Geba: Rama ho popo; Saul Gibea eguan.
title: ISAIAH

text: Galim babaa, ma wo ndze do tsea mu! Laisa e, tsie ɛ! Anathot e, ma mbuae!
title: ISAIAH

text: Madmena ayɛ oguamfo; Gebim atsefo aboa hɔn ano ruguan.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ndɛ da yi ara wobesianka Nob: ɔbɔwosow ne nsa atsen Zion babaa ne bepɔw no do, Jerusalɛm koko no a.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE, dze hu bɛpempan ndubaa no: na ndupɔn atsentsen no wɔbɔtotow ato famu, na dza wɔwowaree no abrɛ adze.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔdze dadze etwitwa kwaa mu adɔtɔ, na Lebanon nam ɔkatakyi nsa do ahwe ase.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mfɛwee bi befi Jesse dusin no mu afɛw, na odubaa efi no ndwow mu efir asow aba:
title: ISAIAH

text: na EWURADZE no sunsum bodwir no do, nyansa nye ntseasee sunsum, apam nye ahoɔdzen sunsum, na nyimdzee ɔnye EWURADZE suro sunsum;
title: ISAIAH

text: na EWURADZE ho suro mu na ɔbɛfa n’enyika: Na onnkedzi dza n’enyiwa hu no ekyir ebu atsɛn, eso onnkedzi dza n’asowa tse no ekyir aka enyim:
title: ISAIAH

text: tsenenee mbom na ɔdze bobu ɔbɔbɔfo atsɛn, na ɔdze atsɛntsenenee aka enyim wɔ asaase no do abrɛfo no ntsi: na ɔdze n’anomu abaa abobɔ asaase no, na ɔdze n’anomu ahom eku omumuyɛnyi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ndzeyɛtsenenee bɛyɛ n’asen abɔdo, na nokwardzi ayɛ n’abɔyamu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na pataku nye eguambaa bɛtsena, na ɔsebɔ nye apɔnkyeba ada hɔ; na nantwiba a ɔadɔ seradze nye ogyataba atsena fakor; na abɔdomaba ahwɛ hɔn do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔnantwiber nye osisi bedzidzi, na hɔn mba abɔ mu ada fakor: na ogyata bɔwe efuw dɛ ɔnantwi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na enumfoanoba bɔgor ehurutsia tu ano, na ɔba a oetwa enumfo dze ne nsa ato ɔkyerben no bɔn mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔnnkɛyɛ bɔn eso wɔnnkɛsɛɛ wɔ me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn nyina do: na EWURADZE ho nyimdzee bɛhyɛ asaase ma, dɛ mbrɛ esu kata po do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ Jesse ndwow no besi hɔ dɛ frankaa ama aman no, n’ekyir kwan na amanaman bɔhwehwɛ; na n’ahomgyebea bɛyɛ enyimnyam.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ, EWURADZE dze ne nsa bosuo mu bio ne mprɛnu agye ne man nkaa wɔaka no efi Asiria na Egypt, na Patros, na Kus, na Elam, na Sinar, na Hamat, na po mu nsupruw no mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Obesi frankaa ama amanaman, na ɔapon Israel tokyemfo no aboa ano, na ɔatase Judafo a wɔapetse no efi asaase mfɛndzanan mu aboa ano.
title: ISAIAH

text: Efraim n’enyitan so befi hɔ akɔ, na wobotwa hɔn a wohiahia Juda ho no efi hɔ: Efraim n’enyi nnkɛber Juda, na Juda so nnkehiahia Efraim ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mbom wobotu ekesi Filistiafo kɔn ho wɔ anee; na wɔbɔbɔ mu akɔfom bokamba no. Wɔdze hɔn nsa bɔto Edom nye Moabmba do; na Ammonmba ayɛ setsie ama hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE bɔwew Egypt po mu nsu korakora; na ɔdze ne hyew mframa bɔpopo ne nsa ho egu Esutsen no do, na ɔbɔbɔ no ma ɔadan nsubansuba esuon, ma nkorɔfo dze nsokota eedua mu wesee.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔtsempɔn bi bɛda hɔ efi Asiria ama me man nkaa a wɔaka no; dɛ mbrɛ ɔdaa hɔ maa Israel wɔ da a ofii Egypt asaase do bae no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na da no ebɛse dɛ, ao Ewuradze, medze ndaase mebɛma wo; na kaansa wo bo fuuw me a, w’ebufuw no adan kɔ, na ekyekye mo werɛ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, Nyame nye mo nkwagye; mobɔtwer, na munnkosuro: Na Ewuradze Jehoyah nye m’ahoɔdzen nye mo ndwom: Na ɔno na ɔabɛyɛ mo nkwagye.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi enyigye na hom dze bɔtow nsu efi nkwagye bura no mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na da no hom bɛkã dɛ, hom nda Ewuradze ase, hom mbɔ ne dzin, hom mbɔ ne nyɛe dawur nkyerɛ aman, hom mbɔ dzin dɛ wɔama ne dzin do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom ntow ndwom mma Ewuradze; na ɔayɛ adze kyɛnee: Hom mma wonhu yi wɔ asaase nyina.
title: ISAIAH

text: Keka mu na bɔ ose, ɔwo a etse Zion: Na Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi a ɔtse wo mu no ɔsõ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Babilɔn ho nkɔnhyɛ a Amoz ba Isaia hunii.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom nsi frankaa wɔ bepɔw petee no do, hom mma hom ndze do mma hɔn, hom nyam nsa mma hɔn ama wɔaakɛhɛn ekunyin mbobotsen no mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mahyɛ mo nkorɔfo a woetu hɔn esi nkyɛn no, nyew, mafrɛ me mbarimba akatakyi, mekyerɛ hɔn a wodzi mo tumdzi mu ehurusi no, dɛ wontu hɔn a m’ebufuw aba hɔn do no do sa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Tsie dede wɔ mbepɔw no do dɛ gyama ɔman kɛse bi dze! Tsie ahendzi horow ne gyigyeegye, amanaman a wɔaboa ano hɔn dede a! Dɔm EWURADZE rotwe no dɔm roboa hɔn ano akɔ ɔko.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wofi ekyirekyir asaase do, na wimu n’ewiei noho reba, EWURADZE, na n’ebufuhyew akodze no a, dɛ ɔrebɛsɛɛ asaase no nyina.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom ntwa ewuo; na EWURADZE da no abɛn; ɔbɛba dɛ ɔsɛɛ a ofi Otumfo no hɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi nsa nyina mu bɔgow, na nyimpa akoma biara anan:
title: ISAIAH

text: na hɔn bo botu; nketsenketse nye awerɛhow bekitsa hɔn; ɔyaw bɛba hɔn do dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo: obiara dze hu bɔhwɛ ne nyɛnko enyim; na hɔn enyim bɛyɛ gyaframee enyim.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE ne da no reba, etsirmɔdzen a ebufuw nye ebufuhyew ka ho; dɛ ɔrebɛyɛ asaase no afo, na ɔasɛɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo efi mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔsor nworaba ɔnye hɔn nworaba ekuwekuw nnkɛma hɔn kan: ewia bɛhyɛ sum wɔ ne mfirii mu, na bosoom so nnkɛma ne kan ahyerɛn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mebɛtsea wiadze wɔ hɔn bɔn ntsi, na emumuyɛfo wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi; na mama ntsɛntsɛnnyi ne ntsɛn abɔ adze, na mama ahokyerɛfo hɔn ahokyerɛ abrɛ adze.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mebɛma nyimpa ho ayɛ na asen sika mapa, ɔdasanyi bɛsen Ofir sikakɔkɔɔ mpɔkowa mpo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mebɛma ɔsorsor apopo, na wɔawosow asaase efi ne sibea, wɔ dɔm EWURADZE n’ebufuw no mu, na n’ebufuhyew da no mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na dɛ ɔwansan a woritsiw no, anaa nguan a obi mmboa hɔn ano no, obiara bɛdan no ho akɔ no nkorɔfo nkyɛn, na woeguanguan akokɔ hɔn asaase do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Obiara a wobohu no wobohwira no mu; na obiara a wɔbɛkyer no no, ɔbɔtɔ afona ano.
title: ISAIAH

text: Woboposow hɔn mbɔtowaba so wɔ hɔn enyim; wɔbɔfow hɔn efi na wɔabobɔ hɔn yernom adapaa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, murubohuenyan Mediafo etsia hɔn, hɔn a wonnkobu dwetɛ bi, na sika so wonnkenya mu enyigye.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn ngyen bɛtsetsew mberantsɛ mu esinesin, na worinnya tsimbɔbɔr mma yafun mu aba; na wonkenya ayamuhyehye ama mbofraba.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na Babilɔn, ahendzi horow mu onyimnyamfo, Kaldeafo hɔn ahopɔw n’ahoɔfɛw no, ɔbɛyɛ dɛ Sodom nye Gomora ber a Nyankopɔn butuuw hɔn no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔrenntsena mu ara da, eso ebusuasantsen kesi ebusuasantsen renntsena hɔ: Arabnyi biara nnkɔbɔ asese wɔ hɔ; eso nguanhwɛfo nnkɛma hɔn nguankuw ebutubutuw hɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Sar do mbowa abɔyafo mbom na wɔbɛdeda hɔ, na mpatu ebusufo bɛhyehyɛ hɔn adan amaama; na nsohor bɛtsena hɔ, na haban mu mpɔnkye asaw wɔ hɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mpataku bosu wɔ hɔn aban mu, na sardo nkraman so, wɔ hɔn ahemfi fɛɛfɛw no mu: na ne ber abɛn dɛ ɔbɛba, na ɔnnkɛkyɛr ne ba no koraa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE benya ayamuhyehye wɔ Jakob ho, na ɔasan mu eyi Israel bio, na ɔdze hɔn esi hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do; na ɔnanaben dze noho abɔ hɔn ho, na wɔatakyer Jakob fi ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na aman no bɛfa hɔn, na wɔdze hɔn aba hɔn tsenabea, na Israel fie afa hɔn ayɛ nkowaa na mfonabaa wɔ EWURADZE asaase no do, na wɔafa hɔn ndɔmmumfafo no ndɔmmum; na wɔahom hɔn ahyɛdofo do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ da a EWURADZE bɛma wo ahomgye efi wo yaw, wo fona, na wo nhyɛsom dzendzen a wɔdze wo kɔr mu no mu no,
title: ISAIAH

text: edze bɛ yi bobu Babilɔnhen, na ase dɛ, Mbrɛ ɔhyɛdofo esi egyaa a! Sika kurow no edua abɔ adze a!
title: ISAIAH

text: EWURADZE ebubu omumuyɛnyi n’abaa, na mpanyindzifo ahempoma so;
title: ISAIAH

text: nyia ɔdze ebufuw bobɔɔ aman bobɔ a onngyaa da, na ɔdze ebufuw hoom amanaman do hyɛɛ hɔn amen a obi ennsianka no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Asaase nyina adwe, na ɔayɛ dzinn: wɔtow ehurusi ndwom.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nyew, ɔpepeaa so nya wo ho enyigye, na Lebanon nkyindur ndua ka dɛ, Ofitsi dɛ wɔdze wo too famu yi, ɔtowfo biara mmfowee mmbaa hɛn do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Samanadze efi ase akeka noho dɛ oribehyia wo mbae kwan; okenyan ewufo ma wo; hɔn a nkyɛ wɔyɛ asaase do etsitsir nyinara no a; ɔama amanaman ahemfo nyinara asoɛrsoɛr efifi hɔn nhengua do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn nyinara bɛgye do na wɔaka akyerɛ wo dɛ, Ɔwoara so na egura dɛ hɛn yi? Ayɛ dɛ hɛnara so pɛr yi?
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔabrɛ w’akɛseyɛ adze akɔ samanadze, na wo mbɛntasanku dede no; wɔasɛw nsaamaa mpa dɛ wɔ w’ase, na nsaamaa nye w’akatado.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mbrɛ edua na ifi sor ahwe ase a, Ao Adzekyee Nworaba, Anapa ba! Mbrɛ woedua etwa wo ato famu a, ɔwo a ebrɛɛ amanaman adze no!
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ekae wɔ w’akoma mu dɛ, Mobɔfow makɔ sor, Nyankopɔn no nworaba etsifi, mebɛma m’ahengua do atra; na matsena mboanofo bepɔw no do wɔ kwaamu afamu etsifi ano noho tɔnn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mobɔfow matra nsuwusiw n’etsifi no ho ara; mebɛyɛ moho dɛ Abɔso no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Naaso wɔabrɛ wo adze akɔ samanadze ekodu mona no n’ase noho ara.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn a wohu wo bɔhwɛ wo kann Wɔbɔdwen wo ho dɛ, Aso nyimpa no a ɔmaa asaase wosowee, na ɔmaa ahendzi hihimii no nye yi;
title: ISAIAH

text: nyia ɔmaa wiadze yi yɛɛ dɛ sar, na obutuuw no mu nkurow; na oenngyaa n’adaduafo ma wɔaannkɔ fie nye yi?
title: ISAIAH

text: Amanaman ahemfo nyinara deda enyimnyam mu, obiara deda nankasa n’adakamona mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔwo dze, wɔatow wo efi w’asamandan mu akyen, dɛ odubaa a wɔapow, dɛ atɔfo a afona ehwirahwira hɔn mu na woesian kɔ mona no n’abo ho na wɔakata wo do; dɛ fun a ɔnamɔn etsiatsia do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔnnkɛfa wo aka hɔn ho wɔ efunsie mu, osiandɛ asɛɛ w’asaase, ekuku wo mamba. Emumuyɛfo asefo edzin dze, mma wɔmmbɔ no dabiarada bio.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom nsiesie ekumii mma mba no wɔ hɔn egyanom emumuyɛ ntsi; ama wɔaannsoɛr ammfa asaase no enndzi do, na wɔaammfa nkurow annhyɛ wiadze mu ma.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mobɔsoɛr etsia hɔn, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse. Na metwa dzin na hɔn a wɔaka, mba na asefo nyinara efi Babilɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mebɛyɛ no nkɔtɔkɔ tsenabew, na nsu ntaataae so, na medze ɔsɛɛ mena mapra no, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɔm EWURADZE aka ntam, Ampaara, dɛ mbrɛ madwendwen ho no, dɛmara no ɔbɛba mu, na dɛ mbrɛ mobɔɔ tsirmpɔw no, dɛmara na obegyina:
title: ISAIAH

text: dɛ mubobubu Asirianyi no wɔ m’asaase do, na medze m’anamɔn etsiatsia no do wɔ me mbepɔw do; nna no kɔndua befi hɔn do akɔ, na n’adzesoa efi hɔn abatsir.
title: ISAIAH

text: Iyi nye tsirmpɔw a wɔabɔ ɔfa asaase nyina ho; na iyi nye nsa a wɔatsen no wɔ amanaman nyina do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na dɔm EWURADZE abɔ tsirmpɔw, na woana botum ama ayɛ gyan? Na ɔatsen ne nsa, na woana na ɔbɔpon mu?
title: ISAIAH

text: Afe a ɔhen Ahaz wui no mu, na atsɛmbusɛm yi bae.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mma nndzi ehurusi, ɔwo Filistia nyina, dɛ abaa a ɔhwee wo no ebu ntsi: na ɔwɔ no ndwow mu na ɔkyerben befir aba, na n’aba bɛyɛ dɛ ogya abowatsena a otu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɔbɔfo n’abakan bedzidzi, na ohianyi ada hɔ dwudwoodwo: na medze ɔkɔm boku wo ndwow, na wo nkaasefo so wobokuku hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Abobokɛse e, twa ewuo; kurow e, keka mu; ɔwo Filistia nyina ma w’akoma ntu; na wusiw fi kwaamu afamu reba, na no dɔm mu obiara nnkegyina ekyir.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ebɛn asɛm na wɔdze bobua amanaman asomafo no? Dɛ EWURADZE dze Zion etsim hɔ, na no mu na ne man mu amandzehufo benya guandɔbew.
title: ISAIAH

text: Moab ho atsɛmbusɛm. Ɔnam dɛ anadwe da kor na wɔasɛɛ Ar ntsi, Moab abɔ; na anadwe da kor na wɔasɛɛ Kir ntsi, Moab abɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dibonmba afow kɔ, wɔkɔ nsorɔnsorɔmbea no do rukosu: Moab rutwa ewuo rutwa gu Nebo na Medeba do: hɔn nyinara hɔn etsifi apepa, abɔdwesa biara woetwitwa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wofurafura eyitam wɔ abrɔn mu: hɔn adan etsifi, na hɔn eguabirim, obiara rutwa ewuo, rusu pii.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na Hesbon na Eleale rekeka mu; wɔtse hɔn ndze ara kodu Jahaz mpo: dɛm ntsi na Moab akofo rekeka mu dzendzen; ne kra ho him wɔ no mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: M’akoma keka mu ma Moab; n’ekunyin guan kɔ Zoar, wɔkɔ Eglath-selisiya: na Luhit afowee no, na wɔdze osu fow; na Horonaim kwan mu na wɔma ɔsɛɛ ewuotwa do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na Nimrim esu bɛyɛ kwawee: na sar no eguan, na mfunoma no asa, na ha momon biara nnyi hɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi adze pii a woenya, na dza wɔapɛ esie, na wɔbɔsoa akɔ wɔdze bɔkɔ esukɔnndua no wora no ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na nkeka mu afow kɔ, abɔ Moab he do aprɔw ehyia; na ewuotwa no du Eglaim, na ewuotwa no du Beer-elim.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na Dimon esu ayɛ bɔgya ma: na medze bi so bɛka Dimon ho, ogyata bɔtɔ nyia ofi Moab boguan, ɔnye asaase no do nkaa no do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔdze nguambaa fi Sela nam sar do afamu akɛma, asaase no do hwɛdofo no wɔ Zion babaa bepɔw no do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛ nnoma a worikyin, ɔnye berɛbuw a wɔahotse mu, dɛm na Moab mbabaa bɛyɛ wɔ Arnon esutwae.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ma apam, bua atsɛn; yɛ wo nwinwin dɛ anadwe wɔ ewiaber ketee: fa hɔn a wɔapam hɔn huntsa; mma nnkyerɛ ɔkobɔfo do kwan.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ma Moab atokyemfo no ntsena wo nkyɛn; yɛ huntsabea ma hɔn wɔ ɔsɛɛfo no enyim. Sɛ ɔpempensifo no fi hɔ na ɔsɛɛ bɔ adze, na ahyɛdofo sa wɔ asaase no do a,
title: ISAIAH

text: nna wobetsim ahengua bi wɔ mbɔbɔrhu mu, na obi atsena do wɔ nokwar mu wɔ David ntamadan mu nyia obu atsɛn, na ɔhwehwɛ atsɛmbu, na ɔpɛ ntsɛm yɛ tsenenee.
title: ISAIAH

text: Yɛatse Moab horan a ɔahoran dodow no nka; n’ahopɔw, no nkontompɔ, na n’ebufuw; naaso n’ahohyehyɛ yɛ gyan.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi ma Moab ntwa ewuo, obiara ntwa ewuo mma Moab: Kir-hareset esikyireamba tatar ntsi hom bɛka mmɔn dɛ wɔabobɔ hom pasaa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na Hesbon mfuwa akyenkyen, na Sibma wenyindua no so; amanaman ewuranom no ebubu n’abaw fɛɛfɛw no; ɔtserɛw kodu Jazer mpo, ɔtserɛwee kɔr sar no do, na okotwaa mu wɔ po do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi medze Jazer osu bosu, Sibma wenyindua: medze me nyinsuwa bogugu wo do nsu, Ao Hesbon, na Eleale: wo nduaba nye wo twaber do na ɔko mu nkekamu no abɔhwe.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na woeyi enyigye efi hɔ, na dɛw no efi nhabamber no mu; na adwontow biara nnyi wenyin nture no mu anaa ehurusi dede biara nnkɛba hɔ: na okyifo biara nnkekyi wenyin wɔ nsakyimona mu; mama esikyireambatsew dede abɔ adze.
title: ISAIAH

text: Iyi ntsi me kra si nkrum dɛ sanku ndze wɔ Moab ho, na m’akoma so wɔ Kir-heres ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ Moab yi noho edzi, sɛ ɔberɛ wɔ sorɔnsorɔmbea hɔ, na ɔba no krɔnkrɔnbea hɔ beyi mpaa a, orinndzi nyim.
title: ISAIAH

text: Iyi nye asɛm a EWURADZE kae wɔ Moab ho aber a ɔabɛsen.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na afei dze EWURADZE se dɛ, Mfe ebiasa mu, dɛ ɔpaanyi mfe no, na Moab nye ne nyimpadodow pii no nyinara hɔn enyimnyam bɛyɛ gyan; na hɔn a wɔbɛka no bɛyɛ ketseabaa a wonnyi ahom biara.
title: ISAIAH

text: Aa, ntsaban worakaworaka asaase a ɔwɔ Etiopia nsutsen egya no ho:
title: ISAIAH

text: nyia otu ahembɔfo nam po do, a wɔtsetse ndzɛm ahɛn mu wɔ nsu enyi! Hom nkɔ, abɔfo a hom ho yɛ har, hom nkɔ ɔman a wɔyɛ apankor trontrom no nkyɛn, nkorɔfo a mbɛnee na ekyirekyir suro hɔn no nkyɛn; ɔman bi a wɔwɔ tum na wɔka nkorɔfo hyɛ a nsutsen etwitwa hɔn asaase mu no!
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom wiadzemba nyinara, hom asaase do atsefo, sɛ wosi frankaa wɔ mbepɔw do a, hom nhwɛ; na sɛ wɔbɔ akasamu mu a, hom ntsie.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na dza EWURADZE aka akyerɛ me nye yi, Mebɛyɛ komm, na mahwɛ wɔ me tsenabea; dɛ ewiaber ketee mu ɔhyew, dɛ ɔbɔsu nsuwusiw wɔ otwaber hyew mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na otwaber nnyae nndurii na nkukuduuduw apaa, na nhyiren adan wenyinaba a ɔregyegye no, ɔdze adar botwitwa nsasar no egu, na ndubaa a ɔatsentsen no etwitwa mu egu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wobegya ne nyinara hɔ ama mbepɔw do nnoma edzinam, ɔnye asaase do mbowa, na nnoma edzinam bedzi ɔpɛber wɔ do, na asaase mbowa nyinara edzi do awɔwber.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ber no mu wɔdze akyɛdze bɛbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE; wɔdze fi nkorɔfo apankor trontrom no, nkorɔfo a mbɛnee na ekyirekyir nyinara suro hɔn, ɔman a wɔwɔ tum na wɔka nkorɔfo hyɛ a nsutsen etwitwa hɔn asaase mu no mu no, bɛba dɔm EWURADZE ne dzin tsenabea, bepɔw Zion no do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Egypt ho atsɛmbusɛm nye yi. Hwɛ, EWURADZE tse nsuwusiw a ano yɛ har do nam, na ɔreba Egypt: Egypt abosom botutu wɔ n’enyim, na Egyptfo akoma anan wɔ hɔn mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mibekenyan Egyptfo etsia Egyptfo: wɔnye hɔnho bɔkoko, obiara nye no nua, na obiara nye ne nyɛnko; kurow nye kurow, na ahenman nye ahenman.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na Egypt no sunsum bɔtɔ pan wɔ no mu; na mebɛsɛɛ n’egyinatu; wobɔkɔ ebisa wɔ ebisatsirfo, asamamfrɛfo, na abayifo nkyɛn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mibeyi Egyptfo ahyɛ owura tsiɔdzennyi bi nsa; na ɔhen a no ho yɛ hu edzi hɔn do tum, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no, na ɔse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na po mu nsu bohuam, na esutsen no bɛsa na ɔawew.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na nsutsen no bɔbɔn; na Egypt nwora bɔtwe na wɔawewew; na ndzɛmbir nye atsen no bɛkyenkyen.
title: ISAIAH

text: Kwawee bɛba Nael ho, nye Nael no kɔn do efuw do, dza woedua no wɔ Nael ho nyina boguan, ahotse efi hɔ na wonnkohu bio.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na apofo so bɛka mmɔn na woedzi nkɔmbɔ, nyew, hɔn a wɔtotow Nael mu nyina; na hɔn a wogu nsu no enyi eboa so, wɔbɛyeyɛ samoo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nkyii so asaabaserɛwfo na hɔn a wɔwen ndwera enyi bɔto.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na n’edum nyina bobubu esinesin, na apaadzifo nyina werɛ bɔhow.
title: ISAIAH

text: Zoan banodzifo yɛ nkwasea koraa; Farao n’apamfo mu enyansafo hɔn apam adan mbowasɛm. Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom se Farao dɛ, Meyɛ onyansafo ba, tsetse ahemfo ba?
title: ISAIAH

text: Henfa koraa na afei w’enyansafo wɔ? Afei ma wɔnka nkyerɛ wo ɛ ma wonhu; tsirmpɔw a dɔm EWURADZE abɔ no wɔ Egypt ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Zoan banodzifo adan nkwasea, na Memfis banodzifo adwen efura mu; na hɔn a wɔyɛ no mbusuakuw kutuwdo bo no, wɔama Egypt atɔ dɔnsuar.
title: ISAIAH

text: EWURADZE dze basabasayɛ sunsum afora Egypt mu: na wɔama Egypt atɔ ntentan wɔ n’edwuma biara mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔsabokwafo tɔ ntentan wɔ ne fe mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Eso biribiara remmba mma Egypt a ɔpanyin anaa ekumaba, berɛw anaa mbɛw bɛyɛ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no mu Egypt bɛyɛ dɛ mbaa; na no ho bɔpopo na oesuro wɔ dɔm EWURADZE ne nsahim a obehim no wɔ do ntsi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na Juda asaase bɛyɛ Egypt hu, obiara a wɔbɔ ne dzin kyerɛ no bosuro, wɔ dɔm EWURADZE ne tsirmpɔw a ɔabɔ etsia no ntsi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no mu nkurow enum bɛba Egypt asaase do a wɔkasa Keenan kasa, na wɔka ntam kyerɛ dɔm EWURADZE; wɔbɛfrɛ kor Ewia kurow.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no mu afɔrmbukyia besi Egypt finimfin ama EWURADZE, na nkyindur ndua besi ne he do ama EWURADZE.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze nye dase ama dɔm EWURADZE wɔ Egypt asaase do, na sɛ wosu kyerɛ EWURADZE wɔ ahyɛdofo no ntsi a, ɔdze ɔgyefo nye twitwagyefo bɛbrɛ hɔn, na ɔabɛgye hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE beyi noho akyerɛ Egypt, na Egyptfo bohu EWURADZE wɔ da no mu; nyew, wɔdze afɔr nye ayɛyɛdze bɔsom no, na wɔabɔ EWURADZE anohoba, na wɔayɛ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE bɔbɔ Egypt, ɔbɔbɔ hɔn na ɔayɛ hɔn edur; na wɔbɛsan aba EWURADZE nkyɛn, na obetsie hɔn ntotɔserɛ na ɔayɛ hɔn edur.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no mu ɔtsempɔn kwan bɛda hɔ fi Egypt akɔ Asiria, na Asirianyi aba Egypt, na Egyptnyi akɔ Asiria; na Egyptfo nye Asiriafo abɔ mu asom.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no mu na Israel bɛka Egypt nye Asiria ho, na ebiasa yi ayɛ nhyira wɔ asaase finimfin:
title: ISAIAH

text: osiandɛ dɔm EWURADZE ehyira hɔn, dɛ, Nhyira nka me man Egypt, na me nsaano edwuma Asiria, na m’egyapadze Israel.
title: ISAIAH

title: ISAIAH

text: Afe a Tartan baa Ashdod, ber a Asiriahen Sargon somaa no, na ɔnye Ashdod bɔkoe na ɔfae no;
title: ISAIAH

text: ber no mu nna EWURADZE nam Amoz ba Isaia do kaa dɛ, Kɔ, kɛpa eyitam no fi w’asen mu, na san mpaboa no fi w’anan. Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm dze adagyaw nye anamɔnkwaa nantsewee.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ m’akowaa Isaia nam adagyaw nye anamɔnkwaa mfe ebiasa ma ɔaayɛ asɛnkyerɛdze ɔnye anwanwadze ama Egypt na Etiopia yi;
title: ISAIAH

text: dɛmara na Asiriahen bɛka Egyptfo ndɔmmumfo na Etiopiafo amantufo akɔ, mbofra na mpanyin, adagyaw mu na anamɔnkwaafo a hɔn etun deda hɔ, ama Egypt enyi aato.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hɔn bo botu na hɔn enyi ato, wɔ hɔn enyidado Etiopia ho, na hɔn enyimnyam Egypt ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na nsuano kuromnyi no bɛka wɔ da no mu dɛ, Hwɛ, mbrɛ hɛn enyidado a yeguanee kɔdɔɔ hɔ dɛ wɔnkɛgye hɛn mfi Asiriahen nsamu tse nye yi: na hɛn dze, yɛyɛ dɛn fi nsa?
title: ISAIAH

text: Po ho sar do atsɛmbusɛm. Dɛ ekyinehyia mframa a ofi Negeb robɔ ba no, ofi sar no do ba, ofi asaase a ɔyɛ hu do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Enyido adzehu a ɔyɛ awerɛhow na woeyi akyerɛ me; ɔfomfafo rofom fa, na ɔsɛɛfo no resɛɛ. Elam ee, fow kɔ; Media ee, kɔ no ntuae; apensi a ɔdze abɔbɔ dze nyina mama aba ewiei.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi na m’asen mu guan me yerɛyerɛw; ɔkyem aka me, dɛ ɔbaa awokofo kyem; ɔyɛ me yaw ma menntse asɛm; mabɔ hu ara ma munnhu adze.
title: ISAIAH

text: M’akoma tow pɛmpɛm, suro eyi mo hu: ewimbir kan a mo kɔn dɔe no adan ahopopo ama me.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔto pon, wɔsɛw nkuntu mpa, wodzidzi na wɔnom. Banodzifo ee, hom nsoɛr, hom nsera kyɛm no ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE aka akyerɛ me nye yi, Kɔ, fa ɔweɔmfo kegyina hɔ; ma ɔnka dza ohu nkyerɛ:
title: ISAIAH

text: na sɛ ohu dɔm, mpɔnkɔdofo beenu beenu, nsoasopɔnkɔ dɔm na efumpɔnkɔ dɔm a, ɔnkyɛn n’aso pɛnn ara ntsie.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔweɔmfo no bɔɔ mu dɛ ogyata dɛ; Ao, EWURADZE, migyina aweɔnee aban do daa adzekyee, na misi m’atsɛwee anadwe nyina:
title: ISAIAH

text: na hwɛ, nyimpa dɔm reba, mpɔnkɔdofo beenu beenu. Na obuae see dɛ, Babilɔn ahwe ase, ɔahwe ase; na n’abosom ehonyi a woegu nyina ebubu egu famu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ao ɔwo m’aporowee, na m’aporoweebea do eburow: dza matse wɔ dɔm EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn no anomu no na maka makyerɛ hom yi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Duma ho atsɛmbusɛm. Obi fi Seir refrɛ se me dɛ, Ɔweɔmfo, anadwe ber bɛn nye yi? Ɔweɔmfo, anadwe ber bɛn nye yi?
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔweɔmfo no see dɛ, Orudu anapa, na adzesaa so reba; sɛ hom bebisa a, hom mbisa: hom nsan, hom mbra.
title: ISAIAH

text: Arabia ho atsɛmbusɛm. Kwaa a ɔwɔ Arabia no mu na hom bɔsoɛ, Ao, Dedanfo akwantufo kuw.
title: ISAIAH

text: Obi a osukɔm dze no no, brɛ no nsu; Tema asaase do atsefo ee, hom mfa edziban mbehyia eguamfo no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Osiandɛ mfona ano na wofi guanee, afona a wɔatwe a, egyen a wɔapon, na ɔko dzendzen ano a.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na dza EWURADZE aka akyerɛ me nye yi, Afe kor mu, dɛ ɔpaanyi mfe, na Kedar enyimnyam nyina apa:
title: ISAIAH

text: na egyentofo hɔn dodow nkaa no, Kedarmba akatakyi no, hɔn ho bosuar: na EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na ɔaka.
title: ISAIAH

text: Enyido adzehu bɔnsa no ho atsɛmbusɛm. Ebɛnadze yɛ hom na hom afow yi, hom nyinara kɔ adantsifi koraa yi?
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔwo a esebɔ ahyɛ wo ma, weɔɔweɔɔyɛ kurow, ahosɛpɛw man; w’atɔfoe wɔanntotɔ afona ano, eso woennwuwu wɔ akono.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wo tumdzifo nyina bɔɔ mu guanguanee kɔree, nnyɛ egyentofo kyekyeer hɔn: hɔn a wohun hɔn no nyina wɔkyekyeer hɔn, kaansa woguanee kɔr ekyirekyir mpo a.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi na mesee dɛ, Hom nyi hom enyi mfi mo do, ma munsu wenwennwen; mma hom mmper nnkyekye mo werɛ, wɔ me man ne babaa ne sɛɛe no ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no, ahyɛ da bi; ɔyɛ ɔkogu, na ntsiatsiado, na enyibɔ da wɔ enyido adzehu bɔnsa no do; ɔfasu no ndwuruwii na mbepɔw ho sufrɛ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na Elam kitsaa egyen kotoku, ɔnye ntseaseanammufo na mpɔnkɔdofo; na Kir maa kyɛm no ho daa hɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ntseaseanam yɛɛ wo mbɔnsa fɛfɛɛfɛw mu amaama, na mpɔnkɔdofo totoo nkuropon no ano.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na oeyi Juda akataho no efi hɔ; da no ehwɛɛ akodze a ɔwɔ kwaa mu fi no mu no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hom hun David kurow no ne mpaapaae no, dɛ wɔayɛ pii: na hom boaboaa ase nsutaae no no nsu ano.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hom kaan Jerusalɛm adan, na hom bubuu adan no dɛ hom dze rowowaw afasu no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom yɛɛ korabea so wɔ afasu ebien no ntamu dze maa nsutaae dadaw no no nsu; naaso hom annhwɛ onyia no a ɔyɛɛ adze yi, eso hom emmbu nyia a ɔhyehyɛɛ no dadaada no bi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na da no mu, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no, maa osu, na ewuotwa, etsipra, na eyitamfura bae:
title: ISAIAH

text: naaso hwɛ, hom dze enyigye na ahosɛpɛw, anantwi menetwa na nguankum, namdzi nye nsanom. Hom kaa dɛ, hom mma yendzidzi nnom, na ɔkyena na yeewuwu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na dɔm EWURADZE yii me asotsiw dɛ, Ampaara wɔnnkɛfa emumuyɛ yi akyɛ hom ma ekodu dɛ hom bowuwu, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no, na ɔse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no, se nye yi, Kɔ fotosamfo Sebna yi a odzi ofi no do no nkyɛn kɛse dɛ,
title: ISAIAH

text: Ereyɛ dɛn wɔ ha na woana na ewɔ no wɔ ha, na etwa asamandan wɔ ha yi? Irutwa asamandan wɔ sor, na irututu tsenabea ama wo ho wɔ botan mu yi?
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE bɔtow wo akyen enyiberdo dɛ ɔkatakyi, nyew, ɔbɛkata wo do munum.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ampaara ɔbɛdandan wo atow wo sor dɛ etɔw akyen ekyirekyir asaase do; hɔ na ibowu, na hɔ na w’enyimnyam ntseaseanam bɔkɔ, ɔwo a eyɛ wo wura fie enyimguase.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mubosun wo efi wo dzibew, na wobodwuruw wo efi wo gyinabea.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ mebɛfrɛ m’akowaa Eliakim, Hilkia ba no:
title: ISAIAH

text: na medze w’atar no ahyɛ no, na medze w’abɔdo emia no, na medze w’ahendzi mpanyindzi ahyɛ ne nsa: na ɔayɛ egya ama Jerusalɛmfo, na Juda fi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na medze David fie saafee bɔto ne batsir; na obobue, na obiara nnkɔtow mu; na ɔbɔtow mu, na obiara nnkobue.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mebɛpaa no do dɛ prɛgow a ɔwɔ mbrɛ hɔ yɛ dzen, na ɔbɛyɛ enyimnyam ahengua ama n’egya fie.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔdze n’egya fie enyimnyam nyina bɛsensɛn no do, n’asefo nye hɔn a wofi no mu nyina, kɔɔpow kakraba biara, ofi kukuwa do kesi asahina do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no mu, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, prɛgow a wɔdze bɔɔ mbrɛ hɔ yɛ dzen no bɔhɔr; na woetwa ma ɔatɔ famu, na adzesoa a ɔsensɛn do no atsew atɔ; na EWURADZE na ɔaka.
title: ISAIAH

text: Taere ho atsɛmbusɛm. Tarsis ahɛn ee, hom ntwa ewuo; osiandɛ wɔayɛ Taere afo ma ofi nnyi mu bio, obi nnhɛn mu bio; wofi Kittim asaase do eyi akyerɛ hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom mpoanofo, hom ntaa dzinn; hom Sidon eguadzifo a hom twa po no wɔama hom ahyɛ ma.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom faa esu akɛse do hom ndzinoa nye Sihor aba, na Nael ho ndɔbaa; hom yɛɛ amanaman eguadzifo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ao Sidon, ma w’enyi nto, na po akasa, po mu abankɛse no, akasa dɛ, Monnkoo awoo, na monnwoo mba, eso mennyɛɛn mberantsɛ, na eso menntsetsee mbaabun.
title: ISAIAH

text: Sɛ asɛm no kodu Egypt a, wobedzi yaw wɔ Taere ntsi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom ntwa nkɔ Tarsis; ao hom mpoanofo, hom ntwa ewuo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ana hom enyigye kurow a ofi tsetse bɔbɔɔ adze no, na n’anan dze no dɔɔ mu kɔr ekyirekyir kɛtsenae no nye yi?
title: ISAIAH

text: Woana abɔ tsirmpɔw yi etsia Taere, ahenkyɛwmafo kurow a n’eguadzifo yɛ mbapɔmba, na n’abatafo yɛ asaase do enyimnyamfo no?
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɔm EWURADZE a, ɔabɔ ne tsirmpɔw dɛ obogu enyimnyam ahopɔw nyina ho fi, na ɔdze asaase do enyimnyamfo nyina aba enyimguase mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Bu do fa w’asaase do dɛ esutsen Nael, Ao Tarsis babaa; bambɔ biara nnyi hɔ bio.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔatsen ne nsa wɔ po do, ɔawosow nhenman: EWURADZE ahyɛ Keenan ho mbra, dɛ wɔnsɛɛ n’aban kɛse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔaka dɛ, Innkedzi ehurusi bio, ɔwo Zidon ba ɔbaabun a wɔahyɛ wo do: soɛr, kotwa mu kɔ Kittim; na hɔ so mpo irinnya ahomgye.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, Kaldeafo asaase; ɔman yi wonnyi hɔ bio; Asirianyi no kyekyeree maa sar do mbowa: wosisii hɔn abantsentsen, wodwuruuw n’ahemfi; ɔmaa ɔyɛɛ amamfo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom ntwa ewuo, Ao Tarsis ahɛn, na ɔasɛɛ hom akoban.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da bi bɛba dɛ werɛ befir Taere mfe eduosuon, tse dɛ mbrɛ ɔhen kor ne nda tse: na mfe eduosuon n’ewiei no wɔbɛyɛ Taere tse dɛ dza ɔwɔ edwaman no no ndwom mu no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Fa sanku kyin kurow no mu, edwaman a werɛ efir wo. Bɔ sanku dɛɛdɛw, tow ndwom pii, ama wɔaakaa wo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, mfe eduosuon n’ewiei no, EWURADZE bɛba abɛsera Taere, na ɔasan enya n’apaadze, na ɔnye wiadze ahendzi horow a ɔwɔ asaase enyi nyina agor ndwamangor.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na n’eguadze nye n’apaadze bɛyɛ krɔnkrɔndze ama EWURADZE: wɔnnkɛfa esie korakora, eso worinntsia; na n’eguadze bɛyɛ hɔn a wɔtse EWURADZE enyim no dze, na woedzi amee, na wɔayɛ efuradze a ɔkyɛr.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE bɛyɛ asaase no pan, na ɔama ɔayɛ afo na ɔadan no ebutuw, na ɔabɔ no do atsefo no apetse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ ɔman no tse no, mbrɛ ɔsɔfo tse ara nye no; mbrɛ akowaa tse no, mbrɛ no wura tse ara nye no; mbrɛ afonabaa tse no, mbrɛ no wuraba tse ara nye no; mbrɛ ɔtɔfo tse no, mbrɛ ɔtɔmfo tse ara nye no; mbrɛ ɔdzefɛmfo tse no, mbrɛ ɔdzefirfo tse ara nye no; mbrɛ nsihogyefo tse no, mbrɛ nsihomafo tse ara nye no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔbɔto asaase no no pan koraa na wɔafa no afo koraa: na EWURADZE na ɔakasa yi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Asaase reka mmɔn, na oenyam, wiadze abotow na oenyam, wimu na asaase nyina enyinyam.
title: ISAIAH

text: Asaase so asɛɛ wɔ no do mba ase; osiandɛ woetsiatsia mbra no do, wɔasakyer ahyɛdze no, wɔato daa ahyɛmu no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi na ndom no amen asaase no; na no do atsefo woebu hɔn fɔ: dɛm ntsi na asaase no do atsefo no ahyew, na woegya nyimpa kakrabaabi yi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nsa fofor ridzi mmɔn, wenyindua enyam, akomamu enyigyefo risi nkrum.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mpintsin ehurusidzi egyaa, ahosɛpɛwfo dede abɔ adze, sanku enyigye egyaa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔnnkɛfa adwontow anom nsa; nsa dzendzen bɛyɛ wen ama hɔn a wɔnom.
title: ISAIAH

text: Woedwuruw asakrabutuw kurow no: wɔatow ofi biara mu, amma obiara aannkɔ mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Osu wɔ mbɔntsen do wɔ wenyin ntsi; enyigye nyina ahyɛ sum, asaase no do ehurusidzi etu kɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Kurow no mu dza ɔaka nye amamfoyɛ, wɔdze ɔsɛɛ abɔ kuropon no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na dɛm na ɔbɛba asaase do wɔ aman mu, dɛ mbrɛ wɔwosow ngodua no, dɛ wenyin abatsew ekyir mpɛpɛwdzi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔbɛma hɔn ndze do abɔ ose: EWURADZE akɛseyɛ ntsi wofi atɔe bɛtseatsea mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nhyɛ EWURADZE enyimnyam wɔ boka, mekyerɛ EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn ne dzin no, wɔ po nsupruw mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ofi asaase ano noho na yɛatse ndwom, ɔtseneneenyi n’enyimnyam no. Naaso meka dɛ, Morofɔn, morofɔn, mundue! Nkontompɔtwafo etwa nkontompɔ; nyew, nkontompɔtwafo etwa nkontompɔ paara.
title: ISAIAH

text: Osuro, mona no, na efir no, da wo do, ɔwo asaase do mba.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nyia oboguan osuro no ntsi no, ɔbɔtɔ mona no mu; na nyia obefi mona no mu epue no, efir no bɛpa no. Na woebuebue ɔsor ntokura na asaase fapem rihihim.
title: ISAIAH

text: Asaase edwuruw koraa, asaase anan krɔngyenn, asaase ehim mbordo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Asaase bɔto ntentan dɛ ɔsabofo, na oehimahima dɛ suaba; ne mbrato bɛyɛ no do dur, na ɔahwe ase a, ɔronnsoɛr bio.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔbɛba dɛ, da no mu no, EWURADZE bɛtsea sor dɔm wɔ sor, na asaase ahemfo wɔ famu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔaboaboa hɔn ano, dɛ mbrɛ wɔboaboa mpokyerɛfo ano wɔ mona no mu, na wɔatow hɔn efiadze mu, na nda pii ekyir no wɔakɔ akɛsera hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔno na bosoom enyim bogu ase, na ewia enyi ato; osiandɛ dɔm EWURADZE bedzi hen wɔ Zion bepɔw do, na Jerusalɛm, na ne tsetsefo enyim enyimnyam mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: EWURADZE, ɔwo nye me Nyankopɔn; mubohuhor wo, mibeyi wo dzin ayɛw; na ɔwo na ayɛ anwanwadze, nhyehyɛɛ dadaw, osi pi na ɔyɛ nokwar.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔwo na ayɛ kurow no ndamfo; kurow a wɔbɔ ho ban ayɛ kurofo, ananaben aban nnyɛ kurow bi; wɔronntow dabiarada.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi aman a wɔyɛ dzen bɛhyɛ wo enyimnyam, amanaman a hɔn ho yɛ hu kurow no bosuro wo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Osiandɛ ɔwo ayɛ akoban ama ɔbɔbɔnyi, akoban ama ohianyi wɔ n’ahohia mu, ehum ano guandɔbew, ɔhyew mu nwinwin, osiandɛ etsiɔdzemfo no ehuhuw tse dɛ ehum a ɔhwe fasu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔwo brɛɛ ananaben dedeedeyɛ no adze dɛ ɔhyew wɔ bea kwawee do; wɔbrɛɛ etsiɔdzemfo no adwontow adze dɛ ɔhyew wɔ nsuwusiw nwinwin ase.
title: ISAIAH

text: Bepɔw yi do na dɔm EWURADZE bɔto aman nyina pon: edziban a angoa wɔ mu, wenyin a ɔagyen atɔ mu, angoadze a ehuor ma, wenyin a ɔagyen atɔ mu a wɔasɔn do krɔnn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na bepɔw yi do na ɔbɛsɛɛ akatado a ɔkata aman nyina do no enyim; na akataenyim a wɔatserɛw no amanaman nyina do no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔamen owu daa; na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn bɛpepa enyiwa nyina ho nyinsuwa; na oeyi ne man ahorohoraa efi asaase nyina do akɔ: na EWURADZE na ɔaka.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔbɛka wɔ da no mu dɛ, Hwɛ, hɛn Nyankopɔn nye yi; yɛatweɔn no, ama ɔaagye hɛn nkwa: EWURADZE nye yi; yɛatweɔn no, hɛn enyi bɛgye na yeedzi ehurusi wɔ no nkwagye no mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na bepɔw yi do na EWURADZE nsa bɛda, na wobetsiatsia Moab do wɔ n’afamu, dɛ mbrɛ wotsiatsia nkyɛkyɛr do wɔ suminado.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛtserɛw ne nsamu wɔ hɔn finimfin, dɛ mbrɛ nyia ɔrobor tserɛw ne nsamu bor: na ɔbɛbrɛ no nkontompɔ no adze ɔnye ne nsaano edwin no nyina.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na w’aban dzendzen afasu a ɔkrɔn no ɔbɛbrɛ no adze, edwuruw no, na ɔama aka famu, ma adan huntuma mpo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no na wɔbɔtow ndwom yi wɔ Juda asaase do dɛ: Yɛwɔ kurow a ɔyɛ dzen; obetsintsim nkwagye dɛ afasu na ntuae ban.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom mbuebue aponkɛse no, ama ɔman tsenenee a odzi nokwar no aahɛn mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nyia n’adwen etsim wo do no, ebɔkora no asomdwee a odzi mu mu: osiandɛ ɔdze no werɛ hyɛ wo mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom ntwer EWURADZE daa daa: na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn mu na ɔdomankoma ɔbotantsim wɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔdze hɔn a wɔtsetse sor, kurow a ɔkrɔn no, aba daadze: ɔbrɛ no adze, ɔbrɛ no adze kɛka famu; nyew, ɔma ɔka huntuma mpo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Anan tsiatsia do, ɔbɔbɔfo anan a, ohianyi anamɔn no a.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔtseneneenyi no kwan yɛ tɔɔtsen; ɔwo na eyɛ atseneneefo kwantsempɔn tɔɔtsen.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɛhɛɛ, w’atsɛmbu kwan do, EWURADZE, na yɛahwɛ wo kwan: hɛn kra akɔndɔ gyina wo dzin ne nkaae do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Me kra fe wo anadwe; nyew, mo sunsum a ɔwɔ mo mu hwehwɛ wo enyiberdo: na sɛ w’atsɛmbu ba asaase do a, wiadzemba bosua ndzeyɛtsenenee.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔyɛ omumuyɛnyi yie dɛn ara a, onnsua ndzeyɛtsenenee; tɔɔtsenyɛ asaase do na odzi afomfonsɛm, na onnhu EWURADZE no tumdzi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE, ama wo nsa do, naaso wonnhu. Ma wonhu wo mbɔdzembɔ wɔ wo man ho, na hɔn enyi ato: Nyew, ma ogya nhyew w’atamfo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE, ɔwoara bɛhyehyɛ asomdwee ama hɛn: na ɔwoara na edzi hɛn dwuma nyinara so ama hɛn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE, hɛn Nyankopɔn, ewuranom bi so edzi hɛn do tum aka wo ho; naaso ɔwo nko wo dzin na yɛbɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Woewuwu, wɔnnkɛtsena ase; wɔadan nsamamfo, wɔnnkɔsoɛr: osiandɛ asera hɔn na asɛɛ hɔn, na apepa hɔn ho nkaa nyina koraa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Naaso ama ɔman no adɔr, EWURADZE, ama ɔman no adɔr; wɔahyɛ wo enyimnyam: ɔwo atserɛw asaase no n’ahe nyinara mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE, ahohia mu na wɔhwehwɛɛ wo, wo ntsea baa hɔn do no, na wɔworaa mpaabɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛ mbrɛ ɔpemfo a ɔrebɛn n’awoo dzi yaw na ɔkeka mu wɔ n’awoko mu no; mbrɛ yɛayɛ wɔ w’enyim ara nye no, Ao EWURADZE.
title: ISAIAH

text: Yeenyinsen, yeedzi yaw, ɔyɛ dɛ yɛawo mframa; yɛannyɛ ɔgye bi ho edwuma wɔ asaase do; eso wiadze mu mba nnhwehwee ase.
title: ISAIAH

text: W’ewufo bɛtsena ase; hɔn efun bɔsoɛr. Hom a hom tse huntuma mu e, hom nyan na hom ntow ehurusi ndwom. Na wo bɔsu yɛ kan bɔsu, na asaase do ewufo do na ebɔtɔ egu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Me man, hom mbra, hom mbɛhɛn hom adankyir mu, na hom ntotow homho mbobow mu: hom nhuntsa ber kakra, ma onkodu dɛ ebufuhyew no botwa mu akɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hwɛ, EWURADZE fi ne tsebea rifir edzi abɛtsea asaase do mba wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi: asaase so bɛda no bɔgyaa edzi, na ɔrennkata n’atɔfoe do bio.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no mu na EWURADZE dze n’afona kɛse dzendzen ndam ndam no bɛtsea dɛnkyɛmnyin, dɛm ɔwɔ ɔhoɔharfo no, na dɛm ɔwɔ mpomponee no; na oeku esu mu abowapɔn a ɔwɔ po mu no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no mu: Nsa wenyin ture, hom ntow ho ndwom.
title: ISAIAH

text: Emi mara EWURADZE na mohwɛ do; mugugu do nsu aber nyina: mohwɛ do adzekyee na adzesaa amma biribiara aansɛɛ no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ebufuhyew nnyi mo mu: sɛ nkyɛ nkɔkrɔw na nsoɛ na wɔnye me ridzi esi wɔ akono a, nkyɛ mobɔbɔ afa hɔn do; na mahyew hɔn nyina.
title: ISAIAH

text: Annyɛ dɛm a wɔmma wonsuo me bambɔ mu, na ɔnye me nsiesie; nyew, ɔnye me nsiesie.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nda a ɔreba no mu, Jakob bɛgye ndwow; Israel bɔbɔ nhyiren abɔ nkukuduuduw: na wɔdze aba ahyɛ wiadze enyi ma.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ana ɔabɔ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ hɔn a wɔbɔɔ no no? Anaadɛ aso woeku no dɛ hɔn a okunkum hɔn no hɔn kum no?
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn mbrato ho na ehwɛɛ nye hɔn dzii; ɔdze aahow dzendzen eyi hɔn efi hɔ wɔ boka mframa da no mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi iyi na wɔdze bɔhor Jakob ne mbrato; na no bɔnyi no ho aba nyina nye yi; aber a oenya ayɛ afɔrmbukyia abo no nyina dɛ kaadowbo a wɔabor efurufuruw, ma hɔn abosom Aserim na ewia ehonyi no ronnsoɛr bio no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na kurow a wɔagye ho ban no ada mpan, ayɛ tsenabea a woetu do na wɔadan egya dɛ sar do; hɔ na nantwiba no bedzidzi, na hɔ na wɔbɛpempan n’abaw no pasaa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Sɛ no ndubaa no guan a, wobobu akyen; mbasiafo bɛba abɛfa akɔsɔ gya, osiandɛ wɔyɛ ɔman a wonnyi ntseasee; dɛm ntsi nyia ɔyɛɛ hɔn no ne yamu rennhyehye no mma hɔn, na nyia ɔween hɔn no runnhu hɔn mbɔbɔr.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba da no mu dɛ EWURADZE bɔporow n’aba efi Esutsen no ne yir ho ekesi Egypt ɔwora no ho, na wɔatase hom nkorkor, ao Israelmba.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ wɔbɔbɔ akasamu kɛse bi mu; na hɔn a aka dɛ nkyɛ wɔhera wɔ Asiria asaase do, na hɔn a woeyi hɔn tokyen wɔ Egypt asaase do no aba; na wɔbɔsɔr EWURADZE wɔ bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: ISAIAH

text: Efraim asabokwafo ahopɔw abɔtsir ndue, na n’ahoɔfɛw enyimnyam nhyiren a ɔromonsom no a ɔwɔ hɔn a nsa ato hɔn ntentan wɔ hɔn angoa bɔnsa no etsifi no!
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE wɔ ahoɔdzenfo na ɔkatakyi bi; ɔtse dɛ ɔsorbo a orugu, ehum a ɔsɛɛ adze, na obodwiriw egu famu ahoɔdzen do dɛ nsutɔr dzendzen, dɛ esu a oeyir apram do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Efraim asabokwafo ahopɔw abɔtsir no wobetsiatsia do wɔ ananadze:
title: ISAIAH

text: na n’ahoɔfɛw enyimnyam nhyiren a amonsom a ɔwɔ angoa bɔnsa no etsifi no, ɔbɛyɛ dɛ adɔmba a odzi kan ber ansaana ɔpɛber edur a obiara a ohu no, odzi ne nsa ka ara a, na oewie dzi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Da no mu na dɔm EWURADZE bɛyɛ enyimnyam abɔtsir na ahoɔfɛw ahenkyɛw ama ne man nkaa no:
title: ISAIAH

text: ɔnye atsɛmbu sunsum ama onyia no a ɔatsena rubu atsɛn no, na ahoɔdzen ama hɔn a wopia ɔko fi kuropon ano san no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na woyinom so wɔnam nsa do ato ntentan, wɔnam nsadzen do wɔatɔ dɔnsuar; ɔsɔfo na nkɔnhyɛnyi nam nsadzen do ato ntentan, nsa amen hɔn, nsadzen ama wɔatɔ dɔnsuar, wɔfom wɔ enyido adzehu mu, wofintsiw wɔ atsɛmbu mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na fe nye fi ayeyɛ edzidzipon nyina do ma, ma bea biara do nntsew.
title: ISAIAH

text: Woana na ɔbɛkyerɛ no nyimdzee? Na woana na ɔbɛma ɔatse amandzɛɛ no ase? Hɔn a woetwa hɔn enumfo, na wɔatsew hɔn efi numfo ano no anaa?
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ahyɛdze tsia ahyɛdze, ahyɛdze tsia ahyɛdze; mbra tsia mbra, mbra tsia mbra; ha kakra, hɔ kakra.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dabida, mbom apɔtɔfo kasaa nye ananaben gyirama na EWURADZE dze bɛkasa akyerɛ ɔman yi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn a ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ahomgye nye yi, hom mma nyia ɔaberɛ ahomgye; na ahotɔ nye yi: naaso wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE asɛm bɛyɛ hɔn dɛ; ahyɛdze a otsia ahyɛdze, ahyɛdze tsia ahyɛdze; mbra a otsia mbra, mbra a otsia mbra; ha kakra, hɔ kakra; ma wɔaakɔ na woeekotutu ahwe hɔn ekyir, na woeebubu, na wɔaatotɔ mfir mu, na wɔaakyer hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ntsie EWURADZE asɛm, hom atwetwesifo a hom dzi ɔman yi a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm do mpanyin:
title: ISAIAH

text: osiandɛ hom aka dɛ, Yɛnye owu edzi ahyɛmu, na yɛnye samanadze edzi nhyehyɛɛ; sɛ mbusu a ɔpram do no rutwa mu a, hɛn dze, ɔrennka hɛn; osiandɛ yɛdze atorsɛm ayɛ hɛn guandɔbew, na akɔhwisɛm ase na yehuntsa hɛnho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi, Hwɛ, medze ɔbo bi roto fapem wɔ Zion, ɔbo a wɔasɔ ahwɛ, kutuwdo bo a ɔsom bo a wɔato no fapem pintsinn: Nyia ɔgye dzi no, ɔremmpeper no ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na medze atsɛmbu no bɛyɛ susuhoma, medze tsenenee ayɛ susudua promo; na ɔsorbo no bɛpra ator guandɔbew no nyina akɔ, na esu no apram huntsabea no do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hom nye owu ntamu ahyɛmu no wɔbɛtsetsew mu, na hom nye samanadze nhyehyɛɛ no rinngyina; sɛ mbusu a ɔpram do no rutwa mu a, obetsiatsia hom do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mpɛn dodow a orutwa mu no, ɔbɛfa hom: na anapa anapa na obotwa mu, adzekyee na adzesaa: na no ho amandzɛɛbɔ no asetse bɛyɛ hu ara nko.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mpa no yɛ tsia dɛ obi bɛtsen no ho ato do; na akatado tam no ɔyɛ heahea dɛ obi dze bobua no do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE bɔsoɛr dɛ bepɔw Perazim do dze no, no bo bofuw dɛ Gibeon bɔnsa mu dze no: ama ɔaayɛ n’edwuma, n’anwanwa dwuma no, na ɔaayɛ ne nyɛe no, ne nyɛe nwanwa no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Afei dɛm ntsi mma hom nnyɛ atwetwesifo, ma hom nkyehoma aannyɛ dzen; osiandɛ ɔsɛɛ pasapasa a woesua ato hɔ na matse wɔ EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no hɔ, dɛ ɔreba asaase nyina do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom nyɛ aso na hom ntsie me ndze, hom nkyɛn aso na hom ntsie me kasaa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ana daa nyina na ofuntumfo funtum dɛ orudua? Ana daa nyina na otutu n’asaase enyi, bobɔ no do nkotowa?
title: ISAIAH

text: Sɛ ɔyɛ enyi dɛfɛɛ a, ana ondua nhabamba dɛ eme na akatsewa? Ana onndua ewifua akyerɛpɛn akyerɛpɛn, ɔnye atoko wɔ mbrɛ wɔahyɛ ama no no, na ewi wɔ n’ahe ano?
title: ISAIAH

text: Osiandɛ ɔakyerɛ no n’enyiwado, ne Nyankopɔn na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔmmfa porowdze ndam ndam mmporow eme, eso wɔmmfa tseaseanam anan nntsiatsia fan do; na wɔdze aborbaa bor eme, na wɔdze poma bor
title: ISAIAH

text: Ana wɔsan dwow paanoo bio a? Oho, wɔnnkɔ do ara mmporow no daapem: na kaansa ɔdze ne ntseaseanam anan na no mpɔnkɔ fa do mpo a, ɔnndwow no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Iyi so fi dɔm EWURADZE hɔ ba; ɔyɛ apam mu ɔnwanwanyi, na nyansa mu abɔso no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Due, Ariel, kurow a David kyeer mu nsera no! Hom mfa afe nka afe ho; hom mma afahyɛ mbɔ aprɔw mbra,
title: ISAIAH

text: nna mebɛma Ariel ho akyer no, na nkɔmbɔdzi ɔnye sukwadwom aba hɔ: na ɔayɛ dɛ Ariel ama me.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mebɛkyer nsera etwa wo ho kɔntɔnkrɔn, na medze aban abɔ wo ho dantaban, na mahohɔr pempe esiw wo kwan.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ibefi famu tɔnn akasa, na wo kasaa efi huntuma mu ayɛ huhuhuhu; na wo ndze befi famu aba na ayɛ dɛ ɔsaman ne ndze, na wo kasaa efi huntuma mu awasa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na w’atamfo dodow bɛyɛ dɛ huntuma wekoweko, na etsiɔdzenfo dodow no bɛyɛ dɛ ntsɛw a ɔresen kɔ: ɛhɛɛ, ɔbɛba dɛm amonmu ara wɔ awerɛfir mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɔm EWURADZE dze ɔsenaman, nye asaasewosow, dede kɛse, nye ekyinehyia mframa, ehum, nye ogya a ɔmemen ne gyaframee bɛba abɛsera no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na amanaman nyina mu dɔm a wɔnye Ariel dzii ako, hɔn a wɔnye ɔno na n’akoban ko, na wɔma no ho kyer no nyina, wɔbɛyɛ dɛ adaaso, anadwe enyido adzehu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ mbrɛ nyia ɔkɔm dze no so daa, dɛ oridzidzi; na onyan, na no kɔm no da ho ara wɔ hɔ no: anaadɛ mbrɛ nyia nsukɔm dze no so daa, na ɔronom; naaso onyan, na ɔtɔ bitsi, na no nsukɔm da ho ara wɔ hɔ no: dɛmara so na amanaman nyinara a wɔnye bepɔw Zion dzi ako no, bɛyɛ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom ho mbow hom kɛse, na ɔnyɛ hom nwanwa; hom mfura hom enyi na hom nyɛ enyifurafo! Hom mbow, naaso nnyɛ nsa ntsi a; hom nto ntentan, na nnyɛ nsadzen ntsi a.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE ehuei egu hom do, nda heii sunsum a, oemuamua hom enyi, mekyerɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no; na hom etsir, adzehufo no, ɔakata hɔn do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na enyido adzehu nyina ayɛ hom dɛ nwoma a wɔasɔw ano mu nkyerɛwee a adasa dze ma nyia onyim nwoma dɛ, Meserɛ wo, kenkan yi: na ɔka dɛ, Murunntum, osiandɛ wɔasɔw ano:
title: ISAIAH

text: na wɔdze nwoma no ma nyia onnyim nwoma dɛ, Meserɛ wo, kenkan a, ɔka dɛ, Minnyim nwoma.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Susuampa dɛ ɔman yi twe bɛn me, na wɔdze hɔn ano nye hɔn anofamfa dzi me nyi, na hɔn akoma dze woeyi efi me nkyɛn kɔ ekyirekyir, na hɔn suro a wosuro me yɛ nyimpa ahyɛdze a wɔdze akyerɛkyerɛ hɔn no ntsi:
title: ISAIAH

text: hwɛ, mobɔkɔ do ara mayɛ ahobowdze wɔ ɔman yi mu, ahobowdze nye anwanwadze bi a: na hɔn enyansafo nyansaa no ahera, na hɔn abadwembafo ntseasee ehuntsa hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wondue, hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ dɛ wɔdze hɔn apam huntsa EWURADZE fee, na hɔn ndzeyɛɛ wɔ sum mu na wɔka dɛ, Woana na ohu hɛn? Woana na onyim hɛn?
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom si ndzɛmba tsir adze! Aso wobobu ɔwemfo dɛ awendɛtse; anaa adze a wɔyɛe no bɛse nyia ɔyɛɛ no no dɛ, Nnyɛ ɔno yɛɛ me; anaa dza wɔahyehyɛ bɛse nyia ɔhyehyɛɛ dɛ, Innyim dze?
title: ISAIAH

text: Ana ɔnnkaa kakraabi ma Lebanon adan mfuwa prɔmprɔm, na mfuwa prɔmprɔm no woebu no dɛ kwaa?
title: ISAIAH

text: Na da no mu na etsitsifo bɛtse nwoma mu asɛm no, na efurafo enyi efi kusukusuyɛ na sum no mu ehu adze.
title: ISAIAH

text: Abrɛfo so bɛma hɔn enyigye adɔɔ so wɔ EWURADZE mu, na adasa mu ehiafo asɛpɛw hɔnho wɔ Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na otsiɔdzennyi no ayɛ kwa, na ɔtwetwesifo egyaa, na hɔn a wɔtsɛw emumuyɛ nyina woetwa hɔn akyen:
title: ISAIAH

text: hɔn asɛndzii mu wɔma nyimpa yɛ mbratonyi, na wosua nyia ɔka enyim wɔ kuropon ano efir, na wɔdze nsɛnhuhuw dan ɔtseneneenyi fa nkyɛn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE a ɔpoon Abraham no ka wɔ Jakob fifo ho nye yi: Afei Jakob enyi ronnto, eso n’enyim ronntow fitaa bio.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na sɛ ohu ne mba a wɔyɛ me nsaano edwuma no wɔ ne ntamu a, wɔbɛtsew me dzin ho; nyew, wɔbɛtsew Jakob Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ho, na wɔabɔ hu wɔ Israel Nyankopɔn ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn a wɔfomfom wɔ sunsum mu so benya ntseasee, na hɔn a wohwinhwin bosua nkyerɛkyerɛ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wondue! Mba etuatsewfo, EWURADZE na ɔse: hɔn a wɔgye apam a ommfi mo hɔ, na wɔdze ebuado bua do, na ommfir mo sunsum, ama wɔdze bɔn aaka bɔn ho:
title: ISAIAH

text: hɔn a wotsia anamɔn kɔ Egypt, na wommbisa mo hɔ apam, dɛ wɔdze hɔnho rokɔtwer Farao n’ahoɔdzen, na wɔdze hɔn werɛ kɛhyɛ Egypt nwinwin mu!
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi Farao ahoɔdzen bɛhyɛ hom fɛr, na Egypt nwinwin mu awerɛhyɛmu ayɛ hom enyimguase.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na kaansa ne mbapɔmba wɔ Zoan, na n’ahembɔfo edu Hanes mpo a,
title: ISAIAH

text: hɔn nyinara enyi bɔto, ɔman a worinnya mfaso bi mmfi hɔnho no ho. Wɔrennyɛ hɔn mboa anaa mfaso biara, na mbom enyimguase, nye fɛr ara nko.
title: ISAIAH

text: Pomu afamu mbowa ho atsɛmbusɛm. Wɔnam ɔfona na ahoguan asaase no do, mbrɛ ogyataber na ogyatanyin, ehurutsia na ɔwɔ a otu fir ba no, na wɔdzedze hɔn ahonya gugu nsoasopɔnkɔ abatsir, na wɔdze hɔn akoradze atoto efumpɔnkɔ ekyir efu no do, dze rekɛma ɔman a wɔrennyɛ hɔn mfaso no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Egypt mboa dze, mboa gyan a, onnsi hwee: dɛm ntsi na mafrɛ no Rahab a ɔtse hɔ dzinn no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Afei kɔ, kyerɛw no wɔ pon do wɔ hɔn enyim, na krukye no wɔ nwoma mu, ama ɔaako hɔ ekesi mber a ɔreba afebɔɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔyɛ ɔman etuatsewfo, mba atorfo, mba a wɔmmpɛ dɛ wotsie EWURADZE mbra no:
title: ISAIAH

text: hɔn a wɔse adzehufo dɛ, Mma hom nnhu adze; na wɔse nkɔnhyɛfo dɛ, Mma hom nnhyɛ dza ɔtsen ho nkɔm nkyerɛ hɛn, hom nka hɛn adɛfɛdɛfɛsɛm, hom nhyɛ ndaadaasɛm ho nkɔm:
title: ISAIAH

text: hom mfi ɔtsempɔn no mu, hom nyi ɔkwan no akwa, mma hom nnka Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ho asɛm nnkyerɛ hɛn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no se nye yi, Osiandɛ hom bu asɛm yi enyimtsia, na hom twer ahyɛdo nye akɔnkyew, na hom dze homho wowaw no no ntsi;
title: ISAIAH

text: emumuyɛ yi bɛyɛ hom dɛ mpaapaae a ɔwɔ ɔfasu a ɔkrɔn na ɔreyɛ ahwe ase, na oepuhuw mu ma no bu ba awerɛfir mu na amonmu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na obobubu no dɛ mbrɛ sɛ wɔbobɔ ɔwemfo sɛn a wɔbobɔ no posoposo na bi nnka; amma wonnya n’esinesin mu efɛr a wɔdze suo mbukyia mu ogya, anaa wɔdze saw bura mu nsu mpo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no, see nye yi, Ɔsan ba na ahomgye mu na wɔbɛgye hom nkwa; kommyɛ na awerɛhyɛmu mu na hom ahoɔdzen befir: naaso hom ammpɛ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mbom hom see dɛ, Oho, na yɛbɛtsena mpɔnkɔ do eguan; ntsi eguan ara na hom boguan: na, Yɛbɛtsena mbowa ahoɔharfo do akɔ; dɛm ntsi hɔn a wotsiw hom no ho bɛyɛ har.
title: ISAIAH

text: Apem boguan ɔbaakofo mpuw ano; beenu mpuw ano na hom boguan: ma ekodu dɛ hom bɛka dɛ bepɔw etsifi asɛnkyerɛdze, na frankaa a osi koko do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE rotweɔn, ama ɔaayɛ adom ama hom, dɛm ntsi na ɔbɛma no ho do, dze eehu hom mbɔbɔr: na EWURADZE yɛ atsɛmbu Nyankopɔn; esiarfo nye hɔn a wɔtweɔn no nyinara.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔman no bɛtsena Zion wɔ Jerusalɛm: ɔwo innkosu ara bio; ɔnam wo nkekamu ndze no do ɔbɔdom wo ara ampa; sɛ ɔtse a, ɔbɛgye wo do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE bɛma hom amandzehu edziban na ahohiahia nsu dze, naaso w’akyerɛkyerɛfo remmfa hɔn ho nnhuntsa bio, na w’enyiwa bohu w’akyerɛkyerɛfo:
title: ISAIAH

text: na w’asowa bɛtse w’ekyir asɛm, dɛ, Ɔkwan no nye yi, hom nnantsew mu; sɛ hom dze fa hom nsa nyimfa, na sɛ hom dze fa hom abankum a.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hom bogu hom dwetɛ kyerɛw ehonyi nduraho, ɔnye hom sika ehonyi a woegu nkataho no ho fi: hom bɔtow hɔn egu dɛ adze a no ho nntsew; hom bɛse no dɛ, Fi ha fir.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɔtɔ nsu egu w’aba a edze bodua famu no do; na ɔama asaase ndɔbaa edziban, na ɔayɛ sɔɔsɔɔ bafuu: da no mu na w’anyɛmbowa bedzidzi edzidzibea a ɔtserɛw do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Anantwi no so ɔnye asoasopɔnkɔ mba a wɔyɛ asaase mu edwuma no, wɔbɔwe efuw pa a wɔdze sofi ɔnye apaawa apo do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na bepɔw sorɔnsorɔm biara do, na koko a ɔkrɔn biara do, nna nsutsen na esu a ɔworawora bɛpem, wɔ oku kɛse da no mu a abantsentsen bɔhwehwe ase no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nkyii so bosoom ne kan bɛyɛ dɛ ewia ne kan, na ewia ne kan ayɛ mbɔho esuon, dɛ ndaesuon ne kan, wɔ da a EWURADZE bɛkyekyer ne man ne pira, na ɔasa hɔn mbaa ano kur no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE ne dzin fir ekyirekyir reba, n’ebufuw redzɛw, na orupun wusiw kumbɔɔ: n’anomu ahyɛ n’ebufuhyew ma, na ne tɛkyerɛma tse dɛ ogya a ɔhyew adze:
title: ISAIAH

text: na n’ahom tse dɛ esu a oeyir ka kɔn mpo, dɛ ɔdze egyangyandze sɔnee bɔsɔn amanaman do: na ndabraka a ɔma akwamfom ato aman hɔn adadaw mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom benya ndwom dɛ anadwe a wodzi afahyɛ krɔnkrɔn; na akoma mu enyigye, dɛ obi a ɔnam atɛntɛbɛn ano rokɔ EWURADZE bepɔw do, wɔ Israel Botan no nkyɛn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE bɛma wɔatse n’enyimnyam ndze no, na ɔakyerɛ ne nsa ne sian, nye n’ebufuw ne hyeehyew, na ogya a ɔhyew adze ne gyaframee, ɔnye ehuw, na ehum, na ɔsorbo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔnam EWURADZE ne ndze do na Asirianyi no ho bɔpopo na ɔbɛtse n’abaa ne yaw.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hyɛber poma biara a EWURADZE dze besi no do no, wɔbɛka no mpintsin na asanku: na ɔdze nsa a ɔwosow na ɔnye hɔn bɔko.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wofir tsetseetse na woesiesie ogyahyewbea ato hɔ; nyew, wɔayɛ no krado ama ɔhen no; ɔayɛ no dɔnkuronn tɛtɛɛtɛr: ne ntanaa yɛ ogya na ngyantsia pii; EWURADZE n’ahom ma ɔdzɛw dɛ ogya sɔɔfee a ɔrepem.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wondue, hɔn a wosian kɔ Egypt kɔhwehwɛ mboa, na wɔdze hɔnho dan mpɔnkɔ; na wɔtwer ntseaseanam, osiandɛ wɔdɔɔ so ntsi, na mpɔnkɔdofo, ɔnam hɔn ahoɔdzen dodow ntsi; na mbom wɔnnhwɛ Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no, eso wɔnnhwehwɛ EWURADZE ekyir kwan!
title: ISAIAH

text: Naaso ɔno so yɛ onyansafo, na ɔdze mbusu bɛba, na ɔnnkɛsan ne nsɛm: na ɔbɔsoɛr etsia ndzebɔnyɛfo fi, na hɔn a wɔyɛ emumuyɛfo mboa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na Egyptfo no nyimpa a, na nnyɛ Nyankopɔn bi a; hɔn mpɔnkɔ so enam a, na nnyɛ sunsum bi a: na sɛ EWURADZE nya tsen ne nsa a, ɔboafo no befintsiw, na nyia wɔboa no so ahwe ase, na hɔn nyina abɔ mu ayɛ gyan.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE ase me nye yi, Dɛ mbrɛ ogyata anaa ogyatafɔr pɔw wɔ n’afonam do, na sɛ wɔfrɛ nguanhwɛfo dodow dɛn ara ba no do mpo a, hɔn ndze remma ɔmmbɔ hu, na hɔn dede remma ɔmmbrɛ noho adze no: dɛmara so na dɔm EWURADZE besian abɔko wɔ Zion bepɔw, na no kokwaa do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛ nnoma a worutu wii no, dɛm na dɔm EWURADZE botwitwa agye Jerusalɛm; obotwitwa agye no na oeyi no efi mu, obotwa egya, na ɔakora no do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ao Israelmba, hom nsan mbra nyia hom fi no hɔ atsew etua kɛsekɛse no nkyɛn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na da no mu hɔn mu nyimpa biara bɔtow ne dwetɛ ehonyi, na ne sika ehonyi a homankasa hom nsa ayɛ ama hom bɔn no egu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔno na Asirianyi bɔtɔ afona a ɔnnyɛ nyimpa dze no ano, na afona a ɔnnyɛ adasa dze no edzi ne nam: na obefi afona enyim eguan, na ɔdze ne mberantsɛ etua amantow.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na no botan botwa mu akɔ ɔnam hu ntsi, na n’asafohen bo etutu wɔ frankaa no ntsi, EWURADZE a ne gya wɔ Zion, na no fononoo wɔ Jerusalɛm no na ɔse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, ɔhen bi bedzi hen wɔ tsenenee mu, na mbapɔmba edzi tum wɔ atsɛmbu mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hɔn mu biara bɛyɛ dɛ huntsabea wɔ mframa ano, na guandɔbea wɔ ehum ano; dɛ asaase kwawee do esuesu, dɛ ɔbotan kɛse ase nwinwin wɔ asaase a oetwie do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hɔn a wohu adze enyi nnkɛyɛ kusukusu, na hɔn a wɔtse asɛm aso bɛkyɛn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na horopohoropofo akoma bɛtse nyimdzee ase, na adodopofo gyirama bɛkasa a no mu tsew.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔnnkɛfrɛ ogyangyantwi no onyimnyamfo bio, na otsiɔdzenfo wɔnnkɛse no dɛ ɔyɛ ɔdɔyɛfo.
title: ISAIAH
