text: Ebɛnadze ntsi na yeedzi mbuada, na ɔwo innhu? Yeehiahia hɛn kra ho, na ɔwo mmfa nnyɛ hwee yi? Hwɛ, hom mbuadadzi da no mu, hom nya homankasa hom enyigye, na hom tseetsee hom edwumayɛfo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, mansotwe na etutuwpɛ ntsi na hom dzi mbuada, na hom awowɔ emumuyɛ ekutuku: nnyɛ hom ndɛ mbuadadzi yi na ɔbɛma wɔaatse hom ndze wɔ sor.
title: ISAIAH

text: Aso iyi nye mbuada a masan mu meyi no? Aso da a nyimpa hiahia ne kra ho nye yi? Aso ɔno nye dɛ ɔbɔbɔ ne tsir adze dɛ mbɛw, na ɔdze eyitam na nso asɛw n’ananadze? Aso ebɛfrɛ iyi dɛ mbuadadzi, na da a ɔsɔ EWURADZE enyi?
title: ISAIAH

text: Ana nnyɛ iyi nye mbuadadzi a masan mu meyi? Dɛ hom bɛsansan emumuyɛ apɔw no, wɔapopɔr kɔndua nhoma no, na wɔama hɔn a wɔatseetsee hɔn no wɔaafa hɔnho edzi akɔ, na hom eebubu kɔndua nyina mu?
title: ISAIAH

text: Ana nnyɛ ɔno nye dɛ ibubu w’edziban ma nyia ɔkɔm dze no, na dɛ edze abɔbɔfo a woeyi hɔn tokyen no ba wo fie? Sɛ ihu ɔdagyanyi a, ekata no ho; na dɛ emmfa woho nnhuntsa woara wo busuanyi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔno na wo kan bɛgyegye dɛ adzekyee, na w’ayarsa efifir ntsɛm: na wo tsenenee bedzi w’enyim; EWURADZE n’enyimnyam bɔbɔ wo nkyidɔm.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔno na ebɛfrɛ, na EWURADZE bɛgye do; ebɛtsea mu, na ɔbɛse dɛ, Emi nye yi oo. Sɛ iyi kɔndua no, nsatseaba ne tsen, na ehuhukasa fi wo mu;
title: ISAIAH

text: na sɛ edze dza wo kra no kɔn dɔ ma nyia ɔkɔm dze no, na ma ɔkra a oruhu amandze mee a; nna wo kan bopue wɔ sum mu, na wo kusuww ayɛ dɛ ewiaber ketee:
title: ISAIAH

text: na EWURADZE begya wo kwan daa, na ɔama wo kra amee wɔ mbrɛ hɔ yɛ kwawee, na ɔama wo mbiew ayɛ dzen; na ebɛyɛ dɛ ture a woegugu mu nsu, na dɛ mbasu a no nsu nntwe.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hɔn a wobefi wo mu no bɛkyekyer tsetse ekurofo no: na wɔbɛfrɛ wo Osiw etu, Nyia ɔsesɛw akwan a wɔtsena mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Sɛ iyi w’anan fi ahomgyeda no ho, na annyɛ wo pɛ ho edwuma wɔ me da krɔnkrɔn no mu; na efrɛ ahomgyeda no enyigyedze, na EWURADZE n’akrɔnkrɔndze no dɛ enyimnyamdze; na idzi no nyi, na annyɛ woara wo kwan do adze, na annhwehwɛ woara w’enyigye, na annka woara wo nsɛm a:
title: ISAIAH

text: ɔno na ebɛgye w’enyi wɔ EWURADZE mu; na mama anantsew asaase nsorɔnsorɔmbea do; na mama edzi w’egya Jakob n’egyapadze: na EWURADZE ano na ɔaka.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE ne basa nntwaa tsia, dɛ onntum nkwa gye; eso n’asomu nnyɛ dzen, dɛ ɔnntse asɛm:
title: ISAIAH

text: na mbom hom emumuyɛ na apaa hom nye hom Nyankopɔn ntamu, na hom bɔn na oehuntsa n’enyi efi hom do, ma onnketsie.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na bɔgya egu hom nsa ho fi, na emumuyɛ ehura hom nsatseaba ho; hom anofamfa aka atorsɛm, hom tɛkyerɛma hwinhwin ehuhusɛm.
title: ISAIAH

text: Obiara nnsaman tsenenee mu, na obiara nndzi n’asɛm wɔ nokwar mu: wɔdze hɔn werɛ hyɛ egyangyandze mu, na wɔka atorsɛm; wonyinsen ewurkadze, na wɔwo emumuyɛ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wosuow akyerben nkyirefuwa, na wɔwen ananse ntentan: nyia odzi hɔn nkyirefuwa bi no, owu, na dza wɔbobɔ no, ɔpaa ehurutsia.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn ntentan no renndan atar, eso wɔremmfa hɔn ndwuma nnkata hɔnho: hɔn ndwuma yɛ emumuyɛ ndwuma, na akakabensɛm wɔ hɔn nsamu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn anan tutu mbirika kɔ mbusu mu, na wɔyɛ ntsɛm kɛka nyia onndzi fɔ no bɔgyaa gu: hɔn adwen yɛ emumuyɛ adwen; amamfoyɛ na ɔsɛɛ wɔ akwan mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Asomdwee ɔtsempɔn no dze wonnyim; na atsɛmbu biara nnyi hɔn nkɔree mu: wɔabɔ hɔn akwan akyewakyew; obiara a ɔfa mu no onnyim asomdwee.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi na atsɛmbu nye hɛn ntamu atwe, eso ndzeyɛtsenenee nnto hɛn: yɛhwɛ kan kwan, na hwɛ, sum nye yi; ɔhyerɛn so, na mbom yɛnam sunkamm mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Yɛkeka ban ho dɛ ofurafo, nyew, yɛkeka dɛ hɔn a wonnyi enyiwa: yefintsiw ewiaber ketee dɛ wantawanta ber mu; yɛayɛ dɛ ewufo wɔ hɔn a wɔyɛ atwɛntwɛmfo mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɛn nyinara yɛpopɔw dɛ nsisi, na yɛka mmɔn pii dɛ mbubur: yɛhwɛ atsɛmbu kwan, naaso bi nnyi hɔ; nkwagye so, na ɔnye hɛn ntamu atwe koraa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hɛn mbrato adɔɔ so pii wɔ w’enyim, na hɛn bɔn gye dase tsia hɛn: osiandɛ hɛn mbrato wɔ hɛn nkyɛn, na hɛn emumuyɛ dze, yenyim:
title: ISAIAH

text: wɔ mbrato na EWURADZE do nkontompɔtwa mu, na ɔsan a yɛasan efi hɛn Nyankopɔn n’ekyirdzi mu, nhyɛdo na etuatsew ne ka, atorsɛm a yɛadwendwen ho na yeefi akoma mu aka.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔadan atsɛmbu asan ekyir, na ndzeyɛtsenenee ekegyina ekyirekyir noho: osiandɛ nokwar ahwe ase wɔ abɔntsen do, na tɔɔtsenyɛ nntum nnhɛn mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nyew, nokwar asa; na nyia otwa noho fi mbusu ho no, ɔyɛ noho afonam: na EWURADZE hunii, na ɔannyɛ no abodwe dɛ atsɛmbu bi nnyi hɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ohun dɛ nyimpa biara nnyi hɔ, na ɔyɛɛ no nwanwa dɛ odzimafo bi nnyi hɔ: dɛm ntsi nankasa ne basa na ɔdze nkwagye brɛɛ no; na ne ndzeyɛtsenenee no, osuoo no mu gyinae.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔdze ndzeyɛtsenenee hyɛɛ dɛ akatabo, na nkwagye kyɛw so ne tsir; na ɔhyɛɛ awerdzi ntar dɛ akataho, na ɔhyɛɛ mbɔdzembɔ dɛ atar egugudo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mbrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ tse no, dɛmara na ɔbɛhyɛ hɔn ananmu, ɔdze ebufuhyew ama n’ahohiahiafo, akatua a ɔsɛ ama n’atamfo; nsuano aman no so ɔdze akatua a ɔfata bɛma hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm no bɛma wofi anee esuro EWURADZE ne dzin, na wofi wipuei esuro n’enyimnyam: na ɔbɛba dɛ esutsen a ɔrepem yaayaa a EWURADZE n’ehum ripia no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔpomfo bɛba Zion, na hɔn a wɔsan fi mbrato ho wɔ Jakob mu no nkyɛn, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na emi dze, menye hɔn ntamu ahyɛmu no nye yi, EWURADZE na ɔse: mo sunsum a ɔwɔ wo do, na me nsɛm a medze mahyɛ w’ano no rimmfi w’anomu, anaa w’asefo hɔn asefo so anomu, ofitsi ndɛ dze kesi daa, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Soɛr, hyerɛn; na wo kan aba, na EWURADZE n’enyimnyam asoɛr wo do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na, hwɛ, sum bɛkata asaase do, na sum kebii akata aman do: na EWURADZE befir wo do, na n’enyimnyam woehu no wo do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na amanaman bɛba wo kan ho, na ahemfo aba wo mfirii ne hyerɛn ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ma w’enyi do bɔ aprɔw, na hwɛ; hɔn nyinara wɔboa hɔn ano, wɔba wo nkyɛn: wo mbabanyin fi ekyirekyir bɛba, na wo mbabaa so woetutur hɔn abaw mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔno na ibohu na w’enyim atsew, na w’akoma behihim na ɔayɛ kɛse; osiandɛ po mu ndzepa bɛdan aba wo hɔ, amanaman ahonya bɛba wo hɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Efumpɔnkɔ menyamenya bɛkata wo do, Midian na Efa efumpɔnkɔfɔr; hɔn nyinara wofi Seba bɛba. Wɔdze sika na nduhuam, na wɔbɔbɔ EWURADZE n’ayɛyi dawur.
title: ISAIAH

text: Kedar mbowa ekuwekuw nyina bɔboa ano aba wo nkyɛn, Nebaiot nguannyin bɔsom wo; wɔbɔfow aba m’afɔrmbukyia no do enyisɔ mu, na mahyɛ m’enyimnyam fi no enyimnyam.
title: ISAIAH

text: Woananom nye woyi a wotu dɛ nsuwusiw, na dɛ mbubur a wɔrokɔ hɔn ntokura mu yi?
title: ISAIAH

text: Ampaara nsuano aman bɔtweɔn me, na Tarsis ahɛn dzi kan, dɛ wɔdze wo mbabanyin fi ekyirekyir reba, hɔn dwetɛ na hɔn sika ka hɔn ho, wɔ EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn ne dzin ntsi, na Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ntsi, osiandɛ ɔno na ɔahyɛ wo enyimnyam.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ananaben bɔtow w’afasu, na hɔn ahemfo bɔsom wo: na m’ebufuw mu na mobɔɔ wo, na m’enyimpa mu na mehu wo mbɔbɔr.
title: ISAIAH

text: W’aponkɛse so bɛda hɔ daa; wɔronntotow mu adzekyee na adzesaa; ama adasa wɔdze amanaman ahonya aabrɛ wo, na wɔaaka hɔn ahemfo aka hɔn ho aba.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔman na ahenman biara a ɔnnkɔsom wo no, ɔbɛhera; nyew, amanaman no bɔbɔ huntuhuntu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Lebanon n’enyimnyam bɛba wo hɔ, ɔpepeaa, ɔsɛsɛw, na ɔpapaa dua bɔbɔ mu, dze abɛyɛ mo krɔnkrɔnbea hɔ fɛɛfɛw, na maahyɛ m’anan tsiabea no enyimnyam.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hɔn a wohiahiaa wo ho no hɔn mbabanyin dze akotokotow bɛba wo nkyɛn; na hɔn a wobuu wo enyimtsia nyinara dze hɔn enyim bobom w’ananadze; na wɔbɛfrɛ wo EWURADZE no kuropɔn, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ne Zion.
title: ISAIAH

text: Susuampaara dɛ wɔadan wo egya na woekyir wo, na nyimpa biara ammfa wo mu ntsi, mebɛyɛ wo otsitsir daa, na mayɛ mbasantsen pii hɔn enyigye.
title: ISAIAH

text: Eso ebɔnom amanaman numfonsu, na enum ahemfo hɔn enumfo: na ibohu dɛ emi EWURADZE nye w’agyenkwa, na wo pomfo, Jakob ne Katakyi no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Boran ananmu na medze sika bɛba abɛhyɛ, na dadze ananmu na medze dwetɛ bɛba abɛhyɛ, na dua ananmu na medze boran mebɛhyɛ, na abo ananmu medze dadze bɛhyɛ: eso mebɛma asomdwee ayɛ w’ahwɛdofo, na ndzeyɛtsenenee ayɛ wo bɔmbafo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔnnkɛtse akatabansɛm nka wɔ w’asesee mu bio, amambɔe anaa ɔsɛɛ nka wɔ w’ahe do; na ebɛfrɛ w’afasu Nkwagye, na w’aponkɛse Ayɛyi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ewia nnkɛyɛ wo kan adzekyee bio; eso bosoom nnkɛyɛ ɔhyerɛn ahyerɛn ama wo: na EWURADZE bɛyɛ ɔdomankoma kan ama wo, na wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ w’enyimnyam.
title: ISAIAH

text: W’ewia ronntɔ bio, eso wo bosoom ronntwe noho: na EWURADZE bɛyɛ wo domankoma kan, na wo nkɔmbɔdzi da abɔ adze.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wo man so nyinara bɛyɛ atseneneefo, wobenya asaase no edzi afebɔɔ; me ntsetsɛwee mu dubaa, me nsaano edwuma, ama wɔaahyɛ me enyimnyam.
title: ISAIAH

text: Kakraba no bɛdan apem, na dza osuar no adan ɔman dzendzen: emi EWURADZE na mebɛyɛ no ntsɛm wɔ ne ber mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: EWURADZE no sunsum wɔ mo do; osiandɛ EWURADZE asera me dɛ menka nsɛmpa no menkyerɛ abɔbɔfo; ɔasoma me dɛ membɛkyekyer hɔn a hɔn akoma ebubu, mombɔbɔ fahodzi dawur nkyerɛ ndɔmmumfo, na efiadze no mbuei nkyerɛ hɔn a wɔakyekyer hɔn;
title: ISAIAH

text: mombɔbɔ EWURADZE n’enyisɔ afe no, na hɛn Nyankopɔn n’awerdzi da no dawur; dɛ menkyekye hɔn a wodzi nkɔmbɔ nyinara werɛ;
title: ISAIAH

text: dɛ menhyehyɛ mma hɔn a wodzi nkɔmbɔ wɔ Zion, memma hɔn abɔtsir nhyɛ nso ananmu, enyigye ngo nhyɛ nkɔmbɔdzi ananmu, ayɛyi atar nhyɛ awerɛhow sunsum ananmu; ama wɔaafrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛtsenenee ndua, EWURADZE n’atsɛndua, ma wɔaahyɛ no enyimnyam.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔbɛkyekyer tsetse amamfo no, wɔamema nkan no amamfo no do egyinagyina, na wɔayeyɛ nkurow a egugu, mbasantsen pii amamfo no yie.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ahɔho begyina na wɔanyɛn hom mbowakuw, na amamforafo ayɛ hom ekuafo na hom wenyin ntureahwɛfo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hom dze, wɔbɛfrɛ hom EWURADZE asɔfoe: adasa bɛfrɛ hom hɛn Nyankopɔn n’asomfo: hom bedzi amanaman ahonya, na hɔn enyimnyam mu na hom bɛhyehyɛ homho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom benya mbɔho ahyɛ hom enyito no ananmu; na wobedzi ehurusi wɔ hɔn kyɛfa mu ahyɛ hɔn enyimguase ananmu: dɛm ntsi wobenya mbɔho wɔ hɔn asaase no do: ɔdomankoma dɛw bɛyɛ hɔndze.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na emi EWURADZE modɔ atsɛmbu, mikyir edwotwadze a emumuyɛ ka ho; na medze hɔn akatua mebɛma hɔn nokwar mu, na menye hɔn edzi ɔdomankoma ahyɛmu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wobohu hɔn asefo wɔ amanaman mu, na hɔn mba wɔ aman mu: hɔn a hɔn enyi bɔ hɔn do nyinara bohu dɛ hɔn nye asefo a EWURADZE ehyira hɔn.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mibedzi ehurusi kɛse wɔ EWURADZE mu, me kra enyi bɛgye me Nyankopɔn mu; osiandɛ ɔdze nkwagye ntar ahyɛ me, ɔdze tsenenee bataker ewuna me, dɛ mbrɛ ayeforkun dze abɔtsir bɔ, na dɛ mbrɛ ayefor dze n’edwindze hyehyɛ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ asaase dze no nkukuduuduw pue, na dɛ mbrɛ ture ma dza woedua no wɔ mu no fifir no; dɛmara so na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn bɛma tsenenee na ayɛyi efifir wɔ amanaman nyinara enyim.
title: ISAIAH

text: Zion ntsi mennkɛka m’ano ato mu, na Jerusalɛm ntsi mennkɛgye m’ahom, ekodu dɛ ne tsenenee befir edzi dɛ kan hyɛnhyɛn, na no nkwagye dɛ kandzea a ɔdzɛw.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na amanaman bohu wo tsenenee, na ahemfo nyinara ehu w’enyimnyam: na wɔbɔto wo dzin fofor bi a EWURADZE n’ano bɔbɔ dzin.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ebɛyɛ ahoɔfɛw abɔtsir wɔ EWURADZE nsamu so, na ahenkyɛw wɔ wo Nyankopɔn nsamu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔnnkɛda ho bio afrɛ wo Nyia wɔapow no; eso w’asaase wɔnnkɛfrɛ no Amamfo bio: na mbom wɔbɛfrɛ wo dɛ: M’enyisɔ wɔ wo mu, na w’asaase so dɛ Ɔwarfo: osiandɛ EWURADZE wɔ wo ho enyigye, na wɔbɔwar w’asaase no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ aberantsɛ war ɔbaabun no, dɛmara so na wo mbabanyin bɔwar wo: na mbrɛ ayeforkun no ho sɛpɛw no ayefor ho no, dɛmara so na wo Nyankopɔn no ho bɛsɛpɛw no wo ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Jerusalɛm e, mesisi aweɔmfo wɔ w’afasu do; wɔrennka hɔn ano nnto mu adzekyee anaa adzesaa: hom a hom yɛ akaakaafo ma EWURADZE, mma hom nngye hom ahom,
title: ISAIAH

text: na mma hom mma no ahomgye, ma onkodu dɛ obetsim Jerusalɛm, na ɔama ɔayɛ ayɛyi wɔ asaase do.
title: ISAIAH

text: EWURADZE dze n’abanyimfa na n’ahoɔdzen basa aka ntam dɛ, Ampaara mennkɛfa w’eburow ama w’atamfo dɛ edziban bio: na ahɔho nnkɔnom wo wenyin a aberɛ ho no bio:
title: ISAIAH

text: na hɔn a wɔdze ahyɛ san do no na wobedzi eyi EWURADZE ayɛw; na hɔn a wɔatsew no na wɔbɔnom no wɔ mo krɔnkrɔnbea abangua do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom ndua mu, hom ndua aponkɛse no mu; hom mbɔ ɔman no hɔn kwan no; hom nsiesie, hom nsiesie do nyɛ no ɔtsempɔn; hom ntase mu abo no, hom mma frankaa do mma aman no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE abɔ dawur edu asaase ewiei noho dɛ, Hom nse Zion babaa dɛ, Hwɛ, wo nkwagye reba; hwɛ ɔdze n’akatua nam, na n’ahyɛnanmu dzi n’enyim.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔbɛfrɛ hɔn Ɔman krɔnkrɔn, Hɔn a EWURADZE apon hɔn: na wɔbɛfrɛ wo Nyia wɔahwehwɛ no ehu no, Kurow a wɔmmpow no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Woana nye oyi a ofi Edom reba a ɔhyɛ Bozra bɔgyaben ntar yi? Oyi a ɔyɛ onyimnyamfo wɔ n’afadze mu, na ɔrekyea wɔ n’ahoɔdzen akɛseyɛ mu yi? Emi a mekasa ndzeyɛtsenenee mu a, otumfo a ɔgye nkwa a.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’afadze aber dɛm, na wo ntar ayɛ dɛ nyia otsiatsia wenyintwer mu nedze yi?
title: ISAIAH

text: Mo nko ara na metsiatsia wenyintwer no do; na aman no mu nyimpa biara nnka mo ho: nyew, mitsiatsiaa hɔn do wɔ m’ebufuw mu, na misiiw hɔn wɔ m’ebufuhyew mu; na hɔn mu bɔgya abɔ apetse me ntar mu, na wɔama m’efuradze nyinara mu ayɛ nkekaa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na awerdzi da baa m’akoma mu, na mo nkorɔfo a mapon hɔn no hɔn afe no aba.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mohwɛe, na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔboa; na ɔyɛɛ me nwanwa dɛ obi nnyi hɔ a osuo mu gyina: dɛm ntsi mankasa m’abasa na ɔdze nkwagye brɛɛ me; na m’ebufuhyew na osuoo mo mu gyinae.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mitsiatsiaa aman no do wɔ m’ebufuw mu, na memaa wɔbobowee wɔ m’ebufuhyew mu, na muhuee hɔn mu bɔgya muguu asaase do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mobɔbɔ EWURADZE n’adɔyɛdze, na EWURADZE n’ayɛyi dzin, dɛ mbrɛ dza EWURADZE dze ama hɛn nyinara tse; na yieyɛ kɛse a ɔdze ayɛ Israel fifo a ɔdze ama hɔn dɛ mbrɛ no mbɔbɔrhu tse, na dɛ mbrɛ n’adɔyɛ no dodow tse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔkaa dɛ, Ampaara, wɔyɛ me man, mba a worunntwa ator: ntsi na ɔbɛyɛɛ hɔn agyenkwa no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn ahohia nyinara mu no ho hiaa no bi, na n’enyim ɔbɔfo no gyee hɔn nkwa: no dɔ na ne tsimbɔbɔr mu na ɔpoon hɔn; na otuur hɔn, na ɔsoaa hɔn tsetsenda no nyinara mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Naaso hɔn dze, wɔtseew etua, na wɔhoow no sunsum krɔnkrɔn no werɛ: dɛm ntsi na ɔdanee bɛyɛɛ hɔn tamfo, na noara ɔnye hɔn dzii ako.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nna ɔkaa tsetsenda no, na n’akowaa Moses, Nyia ɔdze no mbowakuw ahwɛfo no fii po mu bae no wɔ hen? Nyia ɔdze no sunsum krɔnkrɔn no hyɛɛ hɔn finimfin no wɔ hen?
title: ISAIAH

text: Nyia ɔmaa n’enyimnyam basa dzii Moses n’abanyimfa kɔree no, na ɔpaa nsu no mu wɔ hɔn enyim dze gyee ɔdomankoma dzin maa noho no?
title: ISAIAH

text: Nyia ɔgyee hɔn duaa ebun no mu, dɛ pɔnkɔ nam sar do, na woemmfintsiw no?
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛ anantwi a wosiansian kɔ bɔnsa mu, na EWURADZE no sunsum maa wɔhomee: dɛmara so na igyaa wo man kwan, dze gyee enyimnyam dzin maa woho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Fi sor hwɛ famu, na fi wo krɔnkrɔnyɛ na w’enyimnyam tsenabea hɔ hwɛ: wo mbɔdzembɔ na w’akatakyidze no wɔ henfa? W’ehumbɔbɔr na w’ayamuhyehye no woesianka no wɔ mo do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔwoara nye hɛn egya, kaansa Abraham nnyim hɛn, na Israel nngye hɛn nnto mu mpo a: EWURADZE, ɔwoara nye hɛn egya; hɛn pomfo nye wo dzin fir tsetseetse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ema yɛfom fi w’akwan do na ipirim hɛn akoma fi wo suro ho? Wo nkowaa, w’egyapadze mbusuakuw no ntsi, san bra.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wo man krɔnkrɔn nyaa no mber ketseabaa bi: hɛn ahohiahiafo etsiatsia wo krɔnkrɔnbea no do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Yɛabɛyɛ dɛ hɔn a inndzii hɔn do tum da; dɛ hɔn a wɔammfa wo dzin ammfrɛ hɔn no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ao, kɛtseankyɛ esunsuan ɔsorsor mu, na esian famu, ma mbepɔw apem asen wɔ w’enyim;
title: ISAIAH

text: dɛ mbrɛ ogya ma mbabaaba dzɛw, na ogya no ma esu hur: ama w’atamfo eehu wo dzin, na amanaman ho aapopo wɔ w’enyim!
title: ISAIAH

text: Ber a eyɛɛ ndzɛmba huhuhuhu a hɛn enyi annda kwan no, ɔwo isianee, mbepɔw wosowee wɔ w’enyim.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ofi tsetse adasa nntsee, aso mmbɔɔ do, enyiwa so nnhun Nyankopɔn bi ka wo ho a odzi dwuma ma nyia ɔtweɔn no no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔwo na ihyia nyia ɔdze enyigye yɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee, hɔn a wɔkaa wo wɔ w’akwan mu: hwɛ, ɔwo wo bo fuwii, na hɛn yɛyɛɛ bɔn: bɔn mu na yɛatsena dadaada yi, na aso wɔbɛgye hɛn nkwa?
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hɛn nyinara ayeyɛ dɛ obi a no ho egu fi, na hɛn tsenenee nyinara tse dɛ atar fi pɔtɔɔ: na hɛn nyinara yɛpa dɛ ahataw; na hɛn emumuyɛ soa hɛn kɔ dɛ mframa.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɔ wo dzin, anaa okenyan noho a obosuo wo mu: na ɔwo eyi w’enyim ehuntsa hɛn, na enam hɛn emumuyɛ do ama yɛahyew.
title: ISAIAH

text: Naaso, ao EWURADZE, ɔwoara nye hɛn egya; awendɛtse no nye hɛn, na ɔwemfo no nye woara; na hɛn nyinara yɛyɛ wo nsaano edwuma.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE, mma wo bo mmfuw pii, eso mma nnkaa emumuyɛ daa: to enyi hwɛ, yɛtotɔ serɛ wo, hɛn nyinara yɛyɛ wo man.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wo nkurow krɔnkrɔn no adan sar, Jerusalɛm adan amamfo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɛn fi krɔnkrɔn fɛɛfɛw mbrɛ hɛn egyanom yii wo ayɛw wɔ mu no, wɔdze ogya ahyew no; na hɛn afɛɛfɛdze nyinara ayɛ amamfo.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE, aso iyinom ntsi ebɛkam woho? Aso ebɛyɛ komm, na ahaw hɛn kɛse pii?
title: ISAIAH

text: Meyɛɛ krado tweɔɔn hɔn a woemmbisa m’ekyir kwan; hɔn a wɔannhwehwɛ me no meyɛɛ krado dɛ nkyɛ wobohu me: mesee hɔn a wɔammfa me dzin ammfrɛ hɔn no dɛ, Emi nye yi, emi nye yi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Matserɛw m’abaw mu adzekyee nyina ama ɔman etuatsewfo hɔn a wɔnantsew ɔkwan bɔn do dzi hɔnankasa hɔn adwen ekyir;
title: ISAIAH

text: ɔman a woyi me ehi wɔ m’enyim daa nyina, wɔbobɔ okum afɔr wɔ nture mu, na wɔhyew nduhuam wɔ ntaayaa do;
title: ISAIAH

text: hɔn a wɔtsenatsena nda mu, wɔdeda asamandan mu; wodzi mprekonam, na ekyiwadze nkwan wɔ hɔn asɛn mu;
title: ISAIAH

text: wɔka dɛ, Tsew woho gyina, mma mmbɛn me nkyɛn, na mo ho tsew sen wo: iyinom yɛ wusiw wɔ m’ahwen mu, ogya a ɔdzɛw adzekyee nyina.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hwɛ, wɔakyerɛw no wɔ m’enyim: murummua m’ano, na mbom mebɛhyɛ ananmu, nyew, mebɛhyɛ ananmu egu hɔn bo mu,
title: ISAIAH

text: homara hom emumuyɛ na hom egyanom hɔn emumuyɛ ka ho, dɛ wɔahyew nduhuam wɔ mbepɔw do, na wɔaka mo ho asɛm bɔn wɔ akoko do, EWURADZE na ɔse: dɛm ntsi mibedzi kan mesusu hɔn kan edwuma ho akatua egu hɔn akoko mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Dɛ mbrɛ wohu nsa fofor wɔ wenyinaba siaw mu, na obi ka dɛ, Mma nnsɛɛ no, na nhyira wɔ mu no: dɛmara so na mebɛyɛ wɔ mo nkowaa ntsi, amma mannsɛɛ hɔn nyinara.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na medze asefo befi Jakob mu aba, na me mbepɔw adzedzinyi efi Juda aba: na me mpamufo benya edzi, na mo nkowaa bɛtsena hɔ.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na Saron bɛyɛ nguamban na Akor bɔnsa ayɛ anantwikuw dabea, ama me man a wɔhwehwɛɛ m’ekyir kwan no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hom a hom dan EWURADZE gya, hom werɛ fir me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn, hom to pon ma Isiar, na hom hyɛ aforafora nsa ma Nkrabea;
title: ISAIAH

text: mebɛhyɛ hom ama afona, na hom nyinara bɔkotow ama oku: osiandɛ mefrɛe no, hom emmbua; mekasae no, hom anntse; na mbom hom yɛɛ dza omuo wɔ m’enyi do, na hom saan mu yii dza minnyi enyigye wɔ mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi, Hwɛ, mo nkowaa bedzidzi, naaso hom dze, ɔkɔm bɛdze hom: mo nkowaa bɔnom, naaso hom dze, nsukɔm bɛdze hom: hwɛ, mo nkowaa bedzi ehurusi, naaso hom dze hom enyi bɔtɔ:
title: ISAIAH

text: hwɛ, mo nkowaa bɔtow ndwom wɔ akoma mu enyigye ntsi, naaso hom dze, hom bɛkeka mu wɔ akoma mu awerɛhow ntsi, na hom aka mmɔn wɔ sunsum n’ahomtsew ntsi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hom begyaa hom dzin ma aayɛ ndom ama me mpamufo, na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn boku wo; na ɔbɔto no nkowaa dzin fofor:
title: ISAIAH

text: ama nyia ohyira noho wɔ asaase do no, oeehyira noho wɔ nokwar Nyankopɔn mu; na nyia ɔka ntam wɔ asaase do no, ɔdze nokwar Nyankopɔn aka ntam; osiandɛ werɛ efir nkan no fona no, na osiandɛ oehuntsa efi m’enyi do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na, hwɛ, morobɔ ɔsorsor fofor na asaase fofor: na nkan no ndzɛmba no wɔrennkaa, eso wɔremmfa mmba adwen mu bio.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mbom hom nnya ahomka na hom ndzi ehurusi daa daa wɔ dza morobɔ no ntsi: na, hwɛ, morobɔ Jerusalɛm ma aayɛ ehurusi, na no mu mba ma aayɛ enyigye.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mibedzi ehurusi wɔ Jerusalɛm ho, na m’enyi agye wɔ me man ho: na wɔnnkɛtse osu ne nka wɔ no mu bio, anaa nkekamu nka.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ofitsi hɔ dze kɔ no, abɔtoaba a ne nda suar, anaa akɔdaa a onnwiee ne nda dzi remmba hɔ bio: na abofra edzi mfe ɔha ana oewu, na ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi a odzi mfe ɔha no bɛyɛ obusunyi.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wobesisi adan, na wɔatsenatsena mu; na wɔatsɛw wenyin nture, na woedzi no mu aba.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wonnkesi, na obi atsena mu; wɔnnkɛtsɛw, na obi edzi: na mbrɛ dua ne nda tse no, mbrɛ me man hɔn nda bɛyɛ ara nye no, na me mpamufo bedzi hɔn nsaano edwuma akyɛr.
title: ISAIAH

text: Wɔnnkɛberɛ kwa, eso wɔronnwo mba mma mbusu; na wɔyɛ EWURADZE n’esiarfo hɔn asefo, na hɔn mba ka hɔn ho.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, ansaana wɔrefrɛ no, nna magye do; na wɔda do rekasa no, nna matse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Ɔpataku na eguambaa bedzidzi fakor, na ogyata awe efuw dɛ ɔnantwi: na huntuma na ɔbɛyɛ abowatsena n’edziban. Wɔnnkɛyɛ obi bɔn, eso wɔrennsɛɛ wɔ me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn nyina do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ɔsor yɛ m’ahengua, na asaase yɛ m’ananadzegua: ɔdan a ɔtse dɛn na hom besi ama me, na henfa na ɔbɛyɛ m’ahomgyebea?
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ndzɛmba iyinom nyinara me nsa na ɔayɛ, na mbrɛ ndzɛmba iyinom nyinara yɛe bae nye no, EWURADZE na ɔse: naaso nyimpa a mobɔhwɛ no nye oyi, mekyerɛ onyia no a ɔyɛ ɔbɔbɔfo na sunsum a ɔabobɔ, na no ho popo wɔ m’asɛm ntsi no.
title: ISAIAH

text: Nyia oku ɔnantwi ɔtse dɛ nyia oku nyimpa ara so; nyia oku eguambaa bɔ afɔr no, ɔtse dɛ nyia obu kraman no kɔn mu; nyia ɔbɔ edziban afɔr no, ɔtse dɛ nyia ɔbɔ preko bɔgyaa afɔr; nyia ɔhyew eduhuam no, ɔtse dɛ nyia ohyira ohonyi: nyew, hɔn nyinara asan mu eyiyi hɔnankasa hɔn akwan, na hɔn kra enyi gye hɔn ekyiwadze mu;
title: ISAIAH

text: emi so mebɛsan mu meyi hɔn ndaadaa, na medze hɔn suro aba hɔn do; osiandɛ mefrɛe a, obi anngye do; mekasae a, wɔanntse: na mbom wɔyɛɛ dza ɔyɛ mbusu wɔ m’enyi do, na wɔsaan mu yii dza minnyi mu enyigye.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm, hom a hom ho popo wɔ n’asɛm ho: Hom nuanom a wɔtan hom, wɔtow hom kyen wɔ me dzin ntsi no, wɔka dɛ, Wɔnhyɛ EWURADZE enyimnyam, ma yenhu hom enyigye; na hɔn dze, hɔn enyi bɔto.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dede weɔɔ fi kurow no mu, dede fi asɔrdan no mu, EWURADZE a otua n’atamfo hɔn ndzeyɛɛ do kaw no ne ndze a.
title: ISAIAH

text: Onnyae nnkyemee no, ɔwoe; awooyaw nnyae nnkaa no no, nna ɔawo ɔbabanyin.
title: ISAIAH

text: Woana atse iyi bi da? Woana ehu iyinom bi pɛn? Aso wɔkyem wo asaase da kor? Aso wɔwo ɔman prɛko? Naaso Zion dze, ɔkyemee ara, nna ɔwoo ne mba.
title: ISAIAH

text: Aso emi, medze bɛba awotoa ano, na meremma wɔnnwo? EWURADZE na ɔse. Aso emi a mema wɔwo no, mibesiw awotoa ano? Wo Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hom nye Jerusalɛm ndzi ehurusi, na hom ho nsɛpɛw hom wɔ no ho, hom a hom dɔ no nyinara: hom nye no ndzi ehurusi wɔ enyigye ntsi, hom a hom dzi no ho nkɔmbɔ nyinara:
title: ISAIAH

text: ama hom eenum n’awerɛkyekye enumfo no amee; ama hom dze enyigye aanom efi n’enyimnyam mbordo no mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, mebɛtsen asomdwee ama no dɛ esutsen, na amanaman enyimnyam no dɛ ɔworaba a oeyir, na hom bɔnom bi; wobotur hom nkyɛmfa mu, na wɔagyegye hom anankoroma do.
title: ISAIAH

text: Dɛ obi a ne na kyekye no werɛ no, dɛmara na mebɛkyekye hom werɛ; na hom werɛ bɛkyekye wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hom bohu, na hom akoma edzi ehurusi, no hom mbiew bowuna dɛ ahaban fɔr: na wobohu EWURADZE ne nsa wɔ no nkowaa afamu, na obenya n’atamfo ho ebufuhyew.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na, hwɛ, EWURADZE dze ogya bɛba, na ne ntseaseanam bɛyɛ dɛ ekyinehyia mframa; dɛ ommbobu n’ebufuw ama wɔ ebufuhyew mu, na ne nkaenyim wɔ ogyaframee mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na EWURADZE dze ogya na afona na ɔnye adasa nyinara bedzi: na EWURADZE n’atɔfoe bɔdɔɔ so.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hɔn a wɔtsew hɔnho na woguar hɔnho dɛ wɔbɔkɔ nture mu a, wodzi ɔbaako a odzi finimfin no n’ekyir, woridzi prekonam, na ekyiwadze, na okura no; wɔbɔbɔ mu aba ewiei, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na minyim hɔn ndwuma na hɔn adwen: mber reba a mobɔboaboa amanaman na kasa horow nyinara ano; na wɔbɛba, na woebohu m’enyimnyam.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na medze asɛnkyerɛdze besi hɔn mu, na masoma hɔn mu hɔn a wobefi nsa no akɔ amanaman no hɔ, Tarsis, Put na Lud a wɔkontom egyen no, Tubal na Javan, nsuano aman a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir a wɔnntsee me nka, eso wonnhun m’enyimnyam no; na wɔbɛka m’enyimnyam akyerɛ wɔ amanaman mu.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wɔdze hom nuanom nyinara befi amanaman nyinara mu aba dɛ ayɛyɛdze ama EWURADZE, wɔ mpɔnkɔ do, na ntseaseanam mu, na nsako mu, na nsoasopɔnkɔ do, na mbowa a hɔn ho yɛ har do, aba me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn Jerusalɛm do, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ mbrɛ Israelmba dze hɔn ayɛyɛdze wɔ kɔɔpow a no ho tsew mu ba EWURADZE fie.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na hɔn mu binom so na mebɛfa ayɛ asɔfo Levifo, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ ɔsorsor afofor na asaase fofor a mebɛyɛ no, bɛka wɔ m’enyim no, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛmara so na hom asefo na hom dzin bɛka.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ ofi bosoom fofor kor do kodu kor so do, na ofi ahomgyeda kor do kodu kor so do no, nyimpa nyinara bɛba abɔsɔr wɔ m’enyim, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ISAIAH

text: Na wobefir edzi akɔ akɔhwɛ nyimpa a wɔato mbra etsia me no hɔn efun: na hɔn abowaba nnkowu, eso hɔn gya nnkodum; na wɔbɛyɛ ekyiwadze ama adasa nyinara.
title: ISAIAH

text: Hilkia ne ba Jeremia a ofi asɔfo a wɔwɔ Anathot wɔ Benjamin asaase do no mu no ne nsɛm nye yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔno na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa no hɔ wɔ Amon ne ba Josia a nna ɔyɛ Judahen no, ne nda no mu, wɔ n’ahendzi afe a otsia duebiasa no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbae so wɔ Josia ne ba Jehoiakim, Judahen no, ne nda mu, dze kesii Josia ne ba Zedekia, Judahen no, n’afe a otsia duebien no n’ewiei; dze kodur ɔsoakɔr a wɔsoaa Jerusalɛm kɔr ndɔmmum wɔ bosoom a otsia enum no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ansaana moween wo yafun mu no, nna minyim wo, na ansaana irifi awotoa mu efir no, nna metseew wo ho; mehyɛɛ wo nkɔnhyɛnyi maa amanaman.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Ao EWURADZE Nyankopɔn! Hwɛ, minnyim kasa: osiandɛ meyɛ abofra.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso EWURADZE see me dɛ, Mma nnse dɛ, Meyɛ abofra: na obiara a mobɔsoma wo no hɔ no, ebɔkɔ, na biribiara a mebɛhyɛ wo no, ebɛka.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mma onnsian hɔn ntsi mma innsuro: na mowɔ wo nkyɛn dɛ mibeyi wo, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE tseen ne nsa dze kaa m’ano; na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Hwɛ, medze me nsɛm ahyɛ w’ano:
title: JEREMIAH

text: hwɛ, ndɛ da yi medze wo esi amanaman do na ahendzi do, dɛ tutu na bubu gu famu, sɛɛ na butuw; si, na tsɛw.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa me nkyɛn dɛ, Jeremia, ihu ebɛnadze? Na mubuaa dɛ, Muhu almɔnd dua bi n’abaw.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE see me dɛ, Ehu no yie: na moroweɔn m’asɛm na mayɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ otsia mpɛn ebien, dɛ, Ihu ebɛnadze? Na mesee dɛ, Muhu dadzesɛn a oruhur na n’enyim fi kwaamu afamu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE see me dɛ, Kwaamu afamu na mbusu befir etue aba asaase no do atsefo nyinara do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na, hwɛ, mebɛfrɛ kwaamu ahendzi ebusua ebusua nyinara, EWURADZE na ɔse; na wɔbɛba na hɔn mu biara dze n’ahengua ebesi Jerusalɛm aponkɛse ano, ɔnye n’afasu nyinara ho ehyia, na Juda nkurow nyina.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mubobua m’atsɛn etsia hɔn wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ nyina ntsi; wɔ dɛ wɔapow emi, na wɔahyew nduhuam ama abosom afofor bi, na wɔasɔr hɔnankasa hɔn nsaano edwuma.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔwo dze bɔ w’asen do, na soɛr na ka dza mahyɛ wo nyinara kyerɛ hɔn: mma wo bo nntu wɔ hɔn enyim, mma maamma wo bo enntu wɔ hɔn enyim.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na, hwɛ, ndɛ da yi mayɛ wo akoban kurow na dadze fadum, na boran afasu etsia asaase no nyina, Juda ahemfo, hɔn mbapɔmba, hɔn asɔfoe, na asaase no do nkorɔfo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔnye wo bedzi ako; naaso wonnkotum wo: osiandɛ menye wo nam, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ mebɛgye wo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Kɔ, kɛpaa mu wɔ Jerusalɛm asomu dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mekaa wo mbofrabermu adɔyɛ nye w’ayeforber mu dɔ no ma wo; mbrɛ idzii m’ekyir wɔ sar no do, asaase a nna wonnduaa do adze no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Israel yɛɛ adze krɔnkrɔn maa EWURADZE, no ndɔbaa mu nduadzewakan no: hɔn a wɔmemen no no nyinara wobuu hɔn fɔ; mbusu baa hɔn do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Jakob fifo, na Israel fie mu mbusua nyinara, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm:
title: JEREMIAH

text: mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ɔbrakyew bɛn na hom egyanom hunii wɔ mo mu, ma wofii me nkyɛn kɔr ekyirekyir, na wokedzii egyangyandze ekyir, ma wɔyɛɛ gyan yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Eso wɔannse dɛ, EWURADZE a ɔdze hɛn fii Egypt asaase do bae no wɔ henfa; ɔno a ɔgyee hɛn duaa sar no do, nsar pradada, na amona asaase do, kwaweeyɛ nye owu sunsuma asaase do, asaase a obi nnduaa mu, na nyimpa biara nntsenaa do no?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na medze hom baa asaaseber do, dɛ hom ndzi no do aba na no do ndzepa; na mbom hom baa mu no, hom guu m’asaase ho fi, na hom yɛɛ m’egyapadze ekyiwadze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɔfo no annse dɛ, EWURADZE wɔ henfa? Na hɔn a mbra no dze hɔn nsamu no ennhu me: na ahwɛdofo no so fomee tsiaa me, na nkɔnhyɛfo no nam Baal do hyɛɛ nkɔm, na wokedzii ndzɛmba a ɔnnyɛ mfaso bi ekyir.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi menye hom bedzi esi, EWURADZE na ɔse, na menye hom mba hɔn mba so medzi esi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hom ntwa mu nkɔ Kittim esupruw do nkɔhwɛ; na hom nsoma nkɔ Kedar nkɔhwehwɛ mu kofekofe; na hom nhwɛ kyerɛ dɛ adze a ɔtse dɛm yi bi aba pɛn ana.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso ɔman bi asesa hɔn abosom a mpo wɔnnyɛ abosom bi no? Naaso me man dze, wɔdze hɔn enyimnyam asesa dza mfaso biara nnyi ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔsorsor e, hom mma yi nyɛ hom nwanwa, na ahodwuruw nkitsa hom, nketsenketse nkyer hom dzendzenndzen, EWURADZE na ɔse,
title: JEREMIAH

text: osiandɛ me man abɔ mbusu ebien: wɔapow me emi a meyɛ nkwa nsu no nsunyiwa no, na woetutu mbura ama hɔnho, mbura mpaapaae a nsu nngyina mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ana Israel yɛ akowaa anaa ɔdɔnkɔnyi ba? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔayɛ afonam yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ngyatafɔr apɔw no, na wɔabobɔ hɔn ndze mu; wɔama n’asaase ayɛ amamfo; na wɔahyehyew no nkurow, dɛ obi nntse mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Memfis nye Tapanhes mba so epuepue wo tsir.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso nnyɛ ɔwoara na akɛfa iyi aba wo do, dɛ apow EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, aber a origya wo kwan no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na afei ebɛnadze na enya wɔ Egypt nkɔree mu, dɛ erokɔnom Nael nsu? Anaadɛ ebɛnadze na enya wɔ Asiria mu, dɛ ebɔnom Eufrates esutsen no n’esu?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Woara w’emumuyɛ bɛtsea wo, na ɔwoara w’ekyirsan botwuw w’enyim; dɛm ntsi hu na hwɛ dɛ ɔyɛ ebusudze nye adze wenwen, dɛ apow EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, na dɛ mo ho suro nnyi wo mu, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ofir tsetse na ibubuu wo kɔndua mu, na etsetseew wo nkyehoma mu; na ɔwo ekaa dɛ, Monnkɔsom. Koko sorɔnsorɔm biara do na dua ebun ebun biara ase na ebɔɔ wo mu adze dɛ edwaman.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso nna matsɛw wo wenyindua soronko, aba pa turododo. Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na adan amanandze wenyindua n’aba ahoma ahoma ama me yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na kaansa edze ehyɛ guar, na efa semina pii mpo a, w’emumuyɛ no dze ne nsensanee da ho wɔ m’enyim, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ebɛyɛ dɛn etum aka dɛ, Mo ho nnguu fi, minnkedzii Baal pii ekyir? Hwɛ wo kwan wɔ bɔnsa no mu, hu dza ayɛ: eyɛ efumpɔnkɔ ɔhoɔharfo a ɔwonawona wɔ n’akwan do;
title: JEREMIAH

text: hamu asoaso a ɔakokwaa sar do a ɔto mfar wɔ n’akɔndɔ hyeehyew mu; n’aber du a, woana besianka no? Hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ no nyinara nnkɛberɛ hɔnho; no bosoom mu na wɔdze bohu no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Siw wo nan kwan ma no ho annda hɔ, na wo meneba so ma nsukɔm anndze wo: naaso ɔwo esee dɛ, Dabida! Apa ho koraa: osiandɛ madɔ ananaben, na hɔn ekyir na mibedzi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛ mbrɛ owifo wɔkyer no a, n’enyi to no, dɛmara so na Israelmba hɔn enyi ato; hɔn, hɔn ahemfo, hɔn mbapɔmba, hɔn asɔfoe, nye hɔn nkɔnhyɛfo a
title: JEREMIAH

text: wɔse dusin dɛ, Ɔwo nye m’egya; na ɔbo dɛ, Ɔwo na awo me no: na hɔn ekyir na wɔadandan ama me, na nnyɛ hɔn enyim a: naaso hɔn fonaber mu dze wɔse dɛ, Soɛr na gye hɛn nkwa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: W’abosom a ayɛ ama woho no wɔ henfa? Ma wɔnsoɛr ɛ, sɛ wobotum agye wo nkwa wɔ wo fonaber mu a: na, Juda e, w’abosom hɔn dodow tse dɛ wo nkurow dodow ano.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom hwinhwin tsia me yi? Hom nyinara afomfom etsia me, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔkwa ara nna mabobɔ hom mba; wɔammfa mu esuadze biara: homankasa hom afona na ɔamemen hom nkɔnhyɛfo dɛ ogyata a ɔsɛɛ adze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbasantsen, hom nhwɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm, Aso madan sar ama Israel? Anaa sumpɔrwa asaase? Ebɛnadze ntsi na me man se dɛ, Yɛatsew ahoma; yɛnnkɛba wo nkyɛn ara bio yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso ɔbɛyɛ dɛ ababaawa no werɛ befir n’ahyehyɛdze, anaa ayefor no werɛ befir n’efuradze? Naaso me man dze, hɔn werɛ efir me nda pii a wɔkan a ɔnnyɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ isiesie wo kwan kɔhwehwɛ ɔdɔ a! Dɛm ntsi mbaa emumuyɛfo mpo akyerɛkyerɛ hɔn wo kwan.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Eso w’atar ano na wohu abɔbɔfo a wodzi bem hɔn akra bɔgyaa; nnyɛ dɛ ihun hɔn dɛ worububu adan mu, naaso yinom nyinara ekyir no,
title: JEREMIAH

text: ese dɛ, Midzi bem; ampaara n’ebufuw adan efi mo do. Hwɛ, medze wo bɛba asɛndzii, osiandɛ ese dɛ, Mennyɛɛ bɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ebɔ awonama pii dɛm dɛ ebɛsesa wo kwan? Egypt bɛma w’enyi ato, dɛ mbrɛ ato Asiria maa w’enyi toe no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hɔ so na ibefir edzi akɔ, dɛ wo nsa bɔ w’etsifi: osiandɛ EWURADZE apow w’awerɛhyɛmu, na innkowie yie wɔ hɔn mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔ dɛ, Sɛ banyin gyaa ne yer, na ɔbaa no fi ne nkyɛn kɔ, na ɔkɛyɛ banyin fofor bi so dze a, aso banyin no bɛsan akɔ ne nkyɛn bio? Aso nkyɛ asaase no ho nnkogu fi pɔtɔɔ? Na ɔwo enye nwewefo pii agor ndwamangor; na ebɛsan aba mo hɔ bio, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ma w’enyi do kɔ mpampaa pataa no do, na hwɛ; henfa na wɔnye wo nndaa wɔ hɔ? Akwan nkyɛn na atsena atweɔn w’adɔfo, dɛ Arabianyi wɔ sar no do; na edze wo ndwamandze nye w’emumuyɛ egu asaase no ho fi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi na wɔatwe esusow nsu asɛn, na ɔbɛsɛ nsu so nntɔree; naaso w’enyim tse dɛ basia edwaman ne dze, na nnyim enyito.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso ntseaa mu mfrɛɛ me dɛ, M’egya, ɔwoara nye me mbofrabermu gyafo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso ɔbɛfa ebufuw daa? Aso ɔdze bɛhyɛ no mu daa? Hwɛ, dɛm na akasa, naaso ayɛ ebusudze biara a epɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nkyii so EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ me wɔ ɔhen Josia ne nda no mu dɛ, Ana ehu dza okyirsamfo Israel ayɛ yi? Ɔakɔ bepɔw sorɔnsorɔm biara do, nye dua ebun ebun biara ase akɔgor ndwamangor.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔyɛɛ iyinom nyinara ekyir no, mesee dɛ, Ɔbɛsan aba me nkyɛn ara: naaso ɔnodze ɔannsan: na n’akyerɛbaa ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi Juda so hunii.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ohun dɛ osian awar a okyirsannyi Israel ato no ntsi, na megyaa no awar na mama no awarko nwoma no, naaso na n’akyerɛbaa ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi Juda ennsuro; na mbom no so kɔree kɔgoor ndwamangor.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ osian no ndwamangor ne nka ntsi, na asaase no ho guu fi, na ɔnye abo nye ndusin too awar.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso na iyinom nyinara n’ekyir yi, n’akyerɛbaa ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi Juda mmfaa n’akoma nyina nnsanee mmbaa mo hɔ, na mbom akɔhwi mu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Ekyirsannyi Israel akyerɛ noho dɛ ɔtsen kyɛn ɔkɔnkɔnsanyi Juda.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Kɔ, kɔbɔ nsɛm yi dawur kyerɛ kwaamufo, se dɛ, Ekyirsannyi Israel e, san bra o, EWURADZE na ɔse; moronnhwɛ wo ebufuw mu: na meyɛ ehumbɔbɔr, EWURADZE na ɔse, mo bo nnkofuw daa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hu w’emumuyɛ nko ara, dɛ ato mbra etsia EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn, na akyeakyea wo kwan ekefir ananaben hɔ wɔ dua ebun ebun biara n’ase, na hom enntsie me ndze, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mba ekyirsamfo e, hom nsan mbra o, EWURADZE na ɔse; osiandɛ meyɛ hom wura: na mebɛfa hom ɔbaako efi kurow bi mu, na beenu efi ebusua bi mu, na medze hom aba Zion.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mebɛma hom nguanhwɛfo dɛ mbrɛ m’akoma pɛ a wɔdze nyimdzee nye ntseasee bɛnyɛn hom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ hom dɔɔ so na hom dɔr asaase no do wɔ nda no mu a, EWURADZE na ɔse, ɔno wɔnnkɛkaa bio dɛ, EWURADZE ahyɛmudzi adaka; eso ɔremmba adwen mu: eso wɔrennkaa; eso wɔronnhwehwɛ no; eso wɔrennyɛ bi bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aber no wɔbɛfrɛ Jerusalɛm dɛ EWURADZE ahengua; na amanaman nyinara bɔboa ano wɔ ne nkyɛn, ama EWURADZE ne dzin wɔ Jerusalɛm; eso worinndzi hɔn akoma bɔn ne ntsintsiman ekyir bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nda no mu no Juda ebusua nye Israel ebusua bɛnantsew, na wɔabɔ mu efi kwaamu afamu asaase no do aba asaase a medze maa hom egyanom dɛ egyapadze no do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mesee dɛ, Minsi dɛn memfa wo mfora mba mu, ma memma wo asaase a ɔyɛ fɛw, amanaman dɔm egyapadze fɛfɛɛfɛw no? Na modween dɛ hom bɛfrɛ me, M’egya, na hom rennsan mmfi m’ekyir dzi mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ampaara dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaa twa nkontompɔ fi no kun nkyɛn no, mbrɛ hom so etwa me nkontompɔ ara nye no, Israel ebusua, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔtse ndze bi wɔ mpampaa pataa no do, Israelmba hɔn osu na ntotɔserɛ; wɔ dɛ wɔakyea hɔn kwan, hɔn werɛ efir EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mba ekyirsamfo e, hom nsan mbra o, na mebɛyɛ hom ekyirsan no edur. Hwɛ, yɛaba wo hɔ; na ɔwo nye EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ampaara akoko do mboa ho enyidado yɛ ɔkwa, mbepɔw do weɔɔweɔɔyɛ no yɛ gyan: ampaara EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn mu na Israel nkwagye wɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na enyitodze amen hɛn egyanom berɛ a ofir hɛn mbofrase no; hɔn nguankuw nye hɔn anantwikuw, hɔn mbabanyin nye hɔn mbabaa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔmma yɛndeda famu wɔ hɛn enyito mu, na wɔmma hɛn enyimguase nkata hɛn do: na yɛayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn, hɛn nye hɛn egyanom, ofitsi hɛn mbofrase dze besi ndɛ da yi mpo: na yenntsie EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ne ndze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Israel ee, sɛ ebɛsan w’ekyir a, EWURADZE na ɔse, me nkyɛn na san bra: na sɛ ibeyi w’ekyiwadze efi m’enyi do a, na sɛ w’adwen nnkehihim a,
title: JEREMIAH

text: sɛ ebɛka ntam, wɔ nokwar, atsɛmbu, nye ndzeyɛtsenenee mu dɛ, EWURADZE tse ase yi; nna amanaman bɛyɛ esiarfo wɔ no mu, na wɔahyehyɛ hɔnho wɔ no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se Judamba nye Jerusalɛmmba nye yi, Hom ndɔw hom epe, na mma hom nndua wɔ nsoɛ mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Judamba nye Jerusalɛmmba, hom ntwitwa hom ho twatsia mma EWURADZE, na hom nyiyi hom akoma ho wer no: amma m’ebufuw eemmfir dɛ ogya ammbɛhyew mbrɛ obi nntum nndum no, osian hom mbusu ndzeyɛɛ no ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mpaa mu nka wɔ Juda, hom mfa ntahye wɔ Jerusalɛm; na hom nse dɛ, Hom mbɔ akasamu no mu wɔ asaase no do: hom ntsea mu dzendzen na hom nse dɛ, Hom mboa hom ano na yɛnkɔ nkurow a wɔabobɔ ho ban no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nsi frankaa nkyerɛ Zion do; hom mbɔ hom ho eguaa, mma hom nngyina: na medze mbusu fi kwaamu afamu reba, ɔnye ɔsɛɛ kɛse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ogyata efi no dɔtɔ mu epue, amanaman ɔsɛɛfo bi oesi no kwan mu, oetu efi ne tsenabea; dɛ ɔrebɛyɛ w’asaase amamfo, na wo nkurow ayɛ ekurofo a obi nntse mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Iyi ntsi hom mfa eyitam mbɔ hom ho do, hom ntwa sukwadwom, na hom ntwa ewuo: na EWURADZE n’ebufuw hyeehyew no nndanee mmfii hɛn do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ ɔhen n’akoma bɛhera, ɔnye mbapɔmba akoma; na asɔfo ho bɔbow hɔn, na nkɔnhyɛfo no ayɛ hɔn nwanwa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Ao EWURADZE Nyankopɔn! Ampaara ɔwo adaadaa ɔman yi nye Jerusalɛm dodow dɛ, Hom benya asomdwee: naaso afona ato ɔkra.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ber no mu wɔbɛse ɔman yi nye Jerusalɛm dɛ, Mframa hyeehyew befi sar do mpampaa do abɛfa me man ne babaa do, nnyɛ dɛ orubohuw anaa ɔrebɛtsew ho;
title: JEREMIAH

text: ehum a ɔyɛ dzen kyɛn dɛm fi hɔ no ara botu ama me: afei na mo so mebɛka atsɛmbu etsia hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, ɔbɔfow aba dɛ nsuwusiw, na ne ntseaseanam ayɛ dɛ ekyinehyia mframa: no mpɔnkɔ ho yɛ har sen nkɔr. Yendue! Na wɔafa hɛn afo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Jerusalɛm ee, hohor w’akoma ho fi emumuyɛ mu, ma wɔaagye wo nkwa. Ehuhudwen bɛtsena wo mu akyɛr ahen ara nko?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ndze bi tsea mu fi Dan, na ɔdze mbusu fi Efraim akoko do tahye.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nka nkyerɛ amanaman dɛ wɔreba; hom mma wɔntse no Jerusalɛm, dɛ wɔrema hɔn ndze do wɔ Juda nkurow do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔakyer no ho etwa ehyia dɛ mfuwa ahwɛdofo; osiandɛ ɔatsew mo do etua, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: W’akwan nye wo nyɛe na wɔatwetwe ndzɛmba iyinom ama wo; w’emumuyɛ nye iyi; ampaara ɔyɛ wen, ampaara odu w’akoma ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Me yamu o, ao me yamu! Meretse yaw! Ao m’akoma yɛ me yaw, m’akoma reper mo mu: munntum mmua m’ano; osiandɛ me kra atse akasamu no ne ndze, ɔko ho gyegyeegye no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔsɛɛ bɔtɔ ɔsɛɛ do; wɔafa asaase no nyina afo: awerɛfir mu ara nna wɔafa me ntamadan afo, nye me nkataho amon mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dabɛn na munhu frankaa no, na mentse akasamu no ne ndze nkodu?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Osiandɛ me man yɛ nkwasea, wonnyim me; wɔyɛ mbatam, na wonnyi ntseasee: wɔyɛ enyansafo wɔ emumuyɛ ho, na papayɛ ho dze, wonnyi nyimdzee biara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mohwɛɛ asaase, na hwɛ, ayɛ afoafo nye pan: na ɔsorsor so, na wonnyi kan bi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mohwɛɛ mbepɔw, na hwɛ, wɔrowosow, na akoko nyinara rihihim dzi akɔnaaba.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mohwɛe, na, hwɛ, nyimpa bi nnyi hɔ, na wimu nnoma nyinara etutu kɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mohwɛe, na, hwɛ, asaaseber adandan sar, na no mu nkurow nyinara edwurudwuruw wɔ EWURADZE enyim nye n’ebufuw enyim.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Asaase no nyinara bɛyɛ amamfo; naaso murunnwie no korakora.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Iyi ntsi na asaase bedzi mbɔɔ, na ɔsor ebir wɔ wimu: osiandɛ emi na maka, emi na mesua, na minngyaa mu, eso mennkɛsan efi ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Kurow no nyinara ruguan wɔ mpɔnkɔdofo nye egyentofo hɔn dede ntsi; wɔhɛnhɛn adɔtɔ mu, na wɔfofow abotan: kurow biara wɔadan egya, na nyimpa biara nntsena mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔwo, ɔwo a wɔafa wo afo a, Ekyerɛ dɛn na ifura ɔdaaben, na edze sika ahodze hyehyɛ woho, na edze dubir hohɔr w’enyiwa yi? Eyɛ woho fɛɛfɛw kwa; w’adɔfo bu wo enyimtsia, wɔhwehwɛ wo nkwa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na matse ndze bi a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo nedze, ahoguan a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔrowo abakan nedze, Zion babaa ne ndze a origyam, ɔtserɛw ne nsamu dɛ, Afei mundue! Me kra rotɔ bitsi wɔ ewudzifo enyim!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom ntutu mbirika ndzi akɔnaaba wɔ Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu, na afei hom nhwɛ, na hom nhu! Hom nhwehwɛ n’abɔntsen do, kyerɛ dɛ hom bohu nyimpa bi, dɛ obi wɔ hɔ a odzi atsɛntsenenee, na ɔhwehwɛ nokwardzi; ama medze aakyɛ Jerusalɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔwɔ mu dɛ wɔka dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase yi; naaso ntanhun ara na wɔka.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE, aso w’enyi nndzi nokwar ekyir bi a? Ɔwo abobɔ hɔn, naaso annyɛ hɔn yaw, ɔwo ahyew hɔn, naaso wɔapow ntsea: wɔayeyɛ hɔn enyim dzendzenndzen sen ɔbotan, wɔapow dɛ wɔbɛsan.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Woyinom yɛ abɔbɔfo ara, wɔyɛ nkwasea; na wonnyim EWURADZE no kwan, anaa hɔn Nyankopɔn ne mbra no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ma monkɔ nyimpa akɛse no nkyɛn, na menkɛkasa nkyerɛ hɔn; osiandɛ wonyim EWURADZE no kwan no, nye hɔn Nyankopɔn ne mbra no. Naaso woyinom nyinara ayɛ kor ebubu kɔndua no, na wɔatsetsew nkyehoma no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi ogyata fi kwaa mu bokuku hɔn, sar do pataku bɛba abɛsɛɛ hɔn. Ɔsebɔ bɛtsɛw hɔn nkurow ho, obiara a ofi mu hɔ fir no, wɔbɛtsetsew no esinesin: osiandɛ hɔn mbrato ayɛ dodow, na hɔn ekyirsan adɔɔ so.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na medze bɛkyɛ wo? Wo mba adan me egya, na wɔakɛka hɔn a wɔnnyɛ abosom hɔn ntam: memaa wodzidzii mee no, wɔtotoo awar, na wɔboaboaa hɔn ano ekuwekuw kɔr ndwaman efiefi mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔtsetse dɛ mpɔnkɔnyin a wɔameemee anapa: obiara robɔ no hwen mu dzi ne nyɛnko ne yer ekyir.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso mennkɛtsea hɔn wɔ ndzɛmba yinom ntsi? EWURADZE na ɔse. Aso me kra nnkedzi wer wɔ ɔman a ɔtse dɛm yi do?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mfow n’afasu na hom nsɛɛ; mbom mma hom nnwie no korakora: hom mpempan n’abaw: osiandɛ wɔnnyɛ EWURADZE dze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Israel nye Juda mba etwa me nkontompɔ yerɛyerɛw, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔapa EWURADZE na wɔase dɛ, Nnyɛ ɔno bi a; eso mbusu bi nnkɛba hɛn do; eso yennkohu afona anaa ɔkɔm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: na nkɔnhyɛfo no nnyɛ hwee dɛ mframa ara, osiandɛ asɛm no nnyi hɔn mu: na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ama hɔn nye no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn no, se nye yi, Osiandɛ hom ka dɛm asɛm yi ntsi, hwɛ, mebɛma me nsɛm ayɛ ogya wɔ w’anomu, na mayɛ ɔman yi nyena, na ɔahyew hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, medze ɔman bi fir ekyirekyir bɛba hom do, Ao Israel fifo, EWURADZE na ɔse: ɔmantsimadze a, tsetse man a, ɔman a hɔn kasaa innyim, na dza wɔka so enntse ase a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hɔn egyen kotoku yɛ asamandan a n’ano da hɔ, hɔn nyinara yɛ mbarimba akatakyi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wobedzi wo ndɔbaa, na w’edziban na wobedzi wo mbabanyin nye wo mbabaa: wobedzi wo nguan nye w’anantwi; wobedzi wo wenyinndua nye w’adɔmbandua: wɔdze afona bɔdwerew wo nkurow a wɔaban ho a edze wo werɛ twer no no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso nda no mu mpo, EWURADZE na ɔse, Murunnwie wo yɛ koraa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ wo nkorɔfo no se dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ayɛ hɛn dɛm ndzɛmba yinom nyina a? Ɔno na wo so se dɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ hom adan me egya, na wɔakɔsom anana abosom wɔ hom asaase do no, dɛmara na hom bɔsom ananafo so wɔ ɔman bi a ɔnnyɛ homdze mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nka iyi nkyerɛ Jakob fie, na hom mfa ntahye wɔ Juda, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom ntsie yi, ɔman kwasea a wonnyi ntseasee; wɔwɔ enyiwa, naaso wonnhu adze: wɔwɔ asowa, naaso wɔnntse asɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso hom nnsuro me? EWURADZE na ɔse; aso hom ho mmpopo wɔ m’enyim? Emi a medze anhwea mabɔ po n’ano ban, dɛ daa ɔhe a onntum nntra; na kaansa n’asorɛkye bu mpo a, onnkotum atra, na sɛ wɔyɛ hurututuutu mpo a, wonntum nntra.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔman yi dze, wɔwɔ etuatsew nye mansotwe akoma; wɔatsew etua na wɔkɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Eso wɔnnka wɔ hɔn akoma mu dɛ, Afei wɔmma yensuro EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ɔno a ɔma nsu, esusow nye ɔbɛsɛ nyina tɔ wɔ ne ber mu; na ɔkora adapɛn a wɔahyɛ ama otwaber no do ma hɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom emumuyɛ na ɔama ndzɛmba yinom adandan, na hom bɔn ama ndzepa abɔ hom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wohu emumuyɛfo wɔ me man mu: wɔweɔn, dɛ mbrɛ efirsuafo tsɛw; wosua efir, wɔpa nyimpa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Tse dɛ nnoma a wɔahyɛ buw mu ma no, mbrɛ nsisi ahyehyɛ hɔn efi ma ara nye no: dɛm ntsi na wɔayeyɛ akɛse na woenyinya hɔnho no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔadodɔ angoa, wɔayɛ senasena: nyew, wɔtra do wɔ emumuyɛ dze mu; wonndzi asɛm wɔ pɛrpɛryɛ mu, wonndzi ngyanka asɛm, ma onnwie yie; na ohianyi ne ndzinoa so wɔmmfa mma no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso munnkotua hɔn iyinom ho kaw? EWURADZE na ɔse: aso me kra nnkedzi wer wɔ ɔman a ɔtse dɛm yi do?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Anwanwadze na adze a ɔyɛ hu aba asaase yi do;
title: JEREMIAH

text: nkɔnhyɛfo no hyɛ nkɔm akɔhwi mu, na asɔfo nam hɔn ahodze do dzi tum; na me man so pɛ no dɛmara: na n’ewiei no hom bɛyɛ dɛn?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Benjaminmba, hom mbɔ homho eguaa mfi Jerusalɛm mu! Hom nhɛn akasamu no wɔ Tekoa, na hom nsi frankaa no wɔ Bɛt-hakerem do: na mbusu fi kwaamu afamu rupue, ɔnye ɔsɛɛ kɛse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Zion babaa, ɔhoɔfɛfo no, mubotwa no akyen.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nguanhwɛfo dze hɔn mbowakuw bɛba ne nkyɛn; na wɔabobɔ hɔn asesee wɔ no ho ehyia; hɔn nyinara wobedzidzi wɔ hɔn ananmu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nkyer no do sa; hom nsoɛr, na yɛmfow nkɔ ewiaber. Yendue! Na adze resa, ewimbir sunsuma mu atwe.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nsoɛr, na yɛmfow nkɔ anadwe, na yɛnkɛsɛɛ n’ahemfie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, Hom ntow no ndua ngu famu, na hom nhɔr Jerusalɛm ho pempe: kurow a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔkɛsera no nye yi; nhyɛdo ara nko na ɔwɔ no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛ mbrɛ bura bi puw no nsu ba no, mbrɛ opuw n’emumuyɛ ba ara nye no: wɔtse akakabensɛm nye afofa nka wɔ no mu; ɔyar nye pirakur wɔ m’enyim daa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Jerusalɛm, ma wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ wo, amma me kra aanntwe emmfi wo ho: amma maannyɛ wo amamfo, asaase a wɔnntsena do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, wobedzi Israel nkaa ho mpɛpɛw kofee dɛ wenyindua ho: dan wo nsa bio kɔ mbirefi no mu dɛ wenyinabatsewnyi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Woananom na menkasa na mombɔ hɔn kɔkɔ, ma wontsie? Hwɛ, hɔn asowa wonntwaa no twatsia, na wonntum nnkyɛn aso nntsie: hwɛ, EWURADZE n’asɛm adan atwetwesidze bi ama hɔn; wonnyi enyigye biara wɔ mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE n’ebufuhyew ahyɛ me ma, mesuo mu aberɛ. Hom nhue ngu mbofra no do wɔ ɔbrɔn mu, na mberantsɛ a wɔaboa ano ehyia no do: na wɔbɛkyer okun nye ne yer so, akɔdaa ɔnye nyia oedzi mfe pii.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hɔn efi bɛdandan binom dze, hɔn nhaban nye hɔn yernom nyinara: na mebɛtsen me nsa aka asaase no do mba no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ofi hɔn mu ekumaba do kesi hɔn mu ɔkɛse mpo do, hɔn nyina dze hɔnho ama enyiber; na ofi nkɔnhyɛnyi do kesi ɔsɔfo mpo do, hɔn nyina twa nkontompɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔayɛ me man ne pira no edur biarabiara, na wɔka dɛ, Asomdwee, asomdwee; ber a asomdwee biara nnyi hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso hɔn enyi too ber a wɔyɛɛ ekyiwadze no? Dabida, hɔn enyi annto koraa, eso wɔammfɛr. Dɛm ntsi na wɔbɔtotɔ wɔ hɔn a wɔtotɔ mu; ber a mobɔtwe hɔn aso no, wobosun hɔn egu famu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hom ngyinagyina atsempɔn mu, na hom nhwɛ, na hom mbisa akwan dadaw no, mbrɛ ɔkwan pa no wɔ, na hom nnantsew mu, na hom benya ahomgye ama hom akra: naaso hɔn dze wɔsee dɛ, Yɛrennantsew mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na misisii hom do aweɔmfo, dɛ, Hom ntsie akasamu no ne ndze no; naaso hɔn dze wɔsee dɛ, Yennketsie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi amanaman e, hom ntsie, na mboanofo, hom nhu dza ɔrebɛyɛ hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asaase e, tsie: hwɛ, medze mbusu bɛba ɔman yi do, mekyerɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ do aba no, osiandɛ wɔannyɛ aso amma me nsɛm, na me mbra dze, wɔapow.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ebɛnadze na eduhuam a ofi Seba nye adɔkɔdɔkɔdze a ofi ekyirekyir asaase do no, yɛ ma me? Hom hyew afɔr nnsɔ m’enyi, na hom kum afɔr nnyɛ me fɛw.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, medze fintsidua mobɔto ɔman yi enyim: ama woeefintsifintsiw do egyanom nye mba nyina; na ɔmanyimfo nye ne nyɛnko nyina bowuwu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, ɔman fi kwaamu afamu asaase do reba: na wobekenyan ɔman kɛse bi efi asaase etsiwa mu no ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wokurakura egyen ɔnye mpeaa; wɔyɛ etsiɔdzenfo, na wonnyi ehumbɔbɔr; hɔn ndze wor dɛ po, wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do; hɔn mu biara abɔ n’asen do dɛ nyimpa a ɔrokɔ akono, dɛ wɔreba wo do, O Zion babaa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Yɛatse ne nka; hɛn abaw agow: ahokyer ekitsa hɛn, na yaw a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo nedze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mma mmfir edzi nnkɔ haban mu, eso mma nnantsew kwan no mu; na ɔtamfo no kitsa afona wɔ hɔ, na hu kɛse etwa ehyia.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Me man ɔbɔbɔfo e, fa eyitam bɔ woho do, na yankayankam nso mu: twa sukwadwom dɛ edze rema ɔba kor; sukwadwom wenwen a, osiandɛ awerɛfir mu ara na ɔsɛɛfo no bɛba hɛn do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mayɛ wo abantsentsen nye akoban wɔ me man mu; ama eehu na aasɔ hɔn kwan ahwɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ etuatsewfo ehiyifo a wɔkasakasa sɛɛ nkorɔfo edzin; boran nye dadze na wɔyɛ: hɔn nyinara wɔyɛ ndzeyɛbɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afa no bɔ hyehyeehyew; sumbui no rehyew wɔ gya mu: gyan ara na wɔda ho nan; osiandɛ wonnyiyii emumuyɛfo no nnkɔree.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Adasa bɛfrɛ hɔn dwetɛ a wɔapow, osiandɛ EWURADZE apow hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a ofi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Gyina EWURADZE fie ɔponkɛse no mu, na bɔ asɛm yi dawur wɔ hɔ, na se dɛ, Hom Judafo nyinara a hom hɛn ɔponkɛse yi mu dɛ wɔrobɔsɔr EWURADZE, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no ɔse nye yi, Hom nsakyer hom akwan nye hom ndzeyɛɛ, na mebɛma hom atsena bea yi do ha.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mma hom nntwer atorsɛm, dɛ, EWURADZE n’asɔrdan, EWURADZE n’asɔrdan, EWURADZE n’asɔrdan nye yinom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ hom sakyer hom akwan nye hom ndzeyɛɛ koraa; sɛ hom bu nyimpa nye ne nyɛnko ntamu atsɛn nokwarmu;
title: JEREMIAH

text: sɛ hom anntseetsee hɔho, egyanka, nye kunafo, na hom annka onndzi fɔ bɔgyaa enngu wɔ bea yi do, eso hom ennkedzi abosom afofor bi ekyir annyɛ homankasa homho bɔn a,
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔno na mebɛma hom atsena bea yi do, asaase a medze maa hom egyanom, ofir tsetse kesi daa no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nhwɛ, hom twer atorsɛm a ɔnnyɛ mfaso bi no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso hom bowia adze, edzi ewu, ato awar, na hom aka ntanhun, na hom ahyew eduhuam ama Baal na hom edzi abosom a hom nnyim hɔn no ekyir,
title: JEREMIAH

text: na hom aba ebegyina m’enyim wɔ ofi yi a wɔdze me dzin ato no yi mu na hom ase dɛ, Wɔagye hɛn nkwa: ama hom aayɛ ekyiwadze yinom nyinara?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso ofi a wɔdze me dzin ato no yi adan edwotwafo tu wɔ hom enyiwa mu? Hwɛ, emi mara mehu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na afei hom nkɔ me bea a ɔwɔ Siloh a memaa wɔkyerɛɛw me dzin wɔ hɔ asɔpɔn no, na hom nkɔhwɛ dza medze yɛɛ no wɔ me man Israel emumuyɛ ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na afei osiandɛ hom ayɛ dɛm ndzeyɛɛ yinom nyina ntsi, EWURADZE na ɔse, na mekasaa kyerɛɛ hom, mosoɛɛr ahema mekasae, naaso hom enntsie; na mefrɛɛ hom, naaso hom anngye do:
title: JEREMIAH

text: dɛm ntsi na mebɛyɛ ofi a wɔdze me dzin ato no a hom dze hom werɛ twer no, ɔnye bea a medze maa hom nye hom egyanom no, dɛ mbrɛ mayɛ Siloh.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mobɔtow hom efi m’enyim akyen, dɛ mbrɛ matow hom nuanom, mekyerɛ Efraim asefo nyinara, akyen no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mma nnsɔr mma ɔman yi, eso mma mmpegya osu anaa mpaabɔ wɔ hɔn ntsi, eso mma nndzi nkotoserɛ nnkyerɛ me: osiandɛ mirinntsie wo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ana innhu dza wɔreyɛ no Juda nkurow nye Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbofra tase nyena, na egyanom kua gya, na mbaa fetsew mbɔr, dɛ wɔreyɛ tatar ama ɔsor hembaa, na woehue ɔnom afɔr ama abosom afofor bi, ama wɔdze eeyi me ebufuw.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso emi na woyi me ebufuw? EWURADZE na ɔse; aso wonnyi hɔnankasa hɔnho ebufuw, dze gu hɔnankasa hɔn enyim ase?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Hwɛ, m’ebufuw na m’ebufuhyew bohue egu bea yi do, nyimpa, abowa, na haban mu ndua, na daadze eduaba do; na ɔbɛdzɛw, na orunndum.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi: Hom mfa hom ɔhyew afɔr nka hom okum afɔr ho, na hom ndzi nam.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mannkasa annkyerɛ hom egyanom, eso mannhyɛ hɔn mbra da no a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase no do no, wɔ ɔhyew afɔr na okum afɔr ho:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na mbra a mehyɛɛ hɔn nye iyi, dɛ, Hom ntsie me ndze, na mebɛyɛ hom Nyankopɔn, na hom so ayɛ me man: na hom nnantsew ɔkwan a mahyɛ hom nyina mu, ama eesi hom yie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso woenntsie, eso wɔammbrɛ hɔn aso adze, na mbom wɔnantseew hɔnankasa hɔn akoma bɔn n’egyinatu na ne ntsintsiman do, na wɔsaan ekyir na wɔannkɔ kan.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ofitsi, da a hom egyanom fiir Egypt asaase do bae dze bodu ndɛ, masoma mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara aba hom nkyɛn, dabiara mosoɛr ahanamakye na mosoma hɔn:
title: JEREMIAH

text: naaso woenntsie me, eso wɔannkyɛn aso, na mbom wɔsorowee mbordo: wɔyɛɛ bɔn seen hɔn egyanom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ntsi ɔwo na ebɛka nsɛm yinom nyinara akyerɛ hɔn; naaso wonnketsie; ebɛfrɛ hɔn so; na wɔnnkɛgye wo do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ebɛka akyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Woyi nye ɔman a woenntsie EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn ne ndze, eso wɔanngye ntsea: nokwar asa, na oetu efi hɔn anomu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Jerusalɛm, pra wo tsinhwi gu, na twa ewuo wɔ mpampaa pataa do; osiandɛ EWURADZE apow mbasantsen a wɔhyɛɛ no ebufuw no na ɔadan hɔn egya.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Judamba ayɛ dza omuo wɔ m’enyim, EWURADZE na ɔse: wɔdze hɔn ekyiwadze esisi ofi a wɔdze me dzin ato do no mu, dze egu ho fi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na woesi Tofet a ɔwɔ Hinom ba no bɔnsa no mu nsorɔnsorɔmbea, dɛ wɔbɛhyew hɔn mbabanyin na hɔn mbabaa wɔ gya mu; dza nnyɛ emi na mehyɛe, eso ɔmmbaa m’adwen mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔremmfrɛ no Tofet bio, anaa Hinom ba no bɔnsa, na mbom Okum bɔnsa: na wobesie efun wɔ Tofet ara ma ekodu dɛ wonnya siebea bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔman yi hɔn efun bɛyɛ edziban ama ɔsor nnoma, nye asaase mbowa: na obiara remmpam hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna mebɛma ahosɛpɛw ndze na enyigye ndze, ayeforkun ndze na ayefor ndze, abɔ adze wɔ Juda nkurow, na Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu: na asaase no bɛdan amamfo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aber no, EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔbɛsaw Juda ahemfo hɔn mbiew, na ne mbapɔmba hɔn mbiew, na asɔfo hɔn mbiew, na nkɔnhyɛfo hɔn mbiew, na hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalɛm hɔn mbiew, efi hɔn ndakamona no mu aba:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na wɔahata hɔn wɔ ewia, na bosoom, na wimu ndzɛmba nyina a wɔdɔ hɔn, na wɔsom hɔn, na wodzi hɔn ekyir, na wɔhwehwɛ hɔn, na wɔsɔr hɔn no, enyim: wɔrennka hɔn mmboa ano, eso worummfua hɔn; wɔbɛyɛ efikyir wɔ asaase enyi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ebusua bɔn yi mu nkaa a wɔbɛka no nyinara bɛsan mu eyi owu asen nkwa; hɔn a wɔbɛka no wɔ mbea a metwuw hɔn adze akɔ mu nyinara, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nkyii so ebɛka akyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Aso obi hwe ase a ɔnnsoɛr bio? Aso obi bɔfom kwan a ɔnnkɛsan n’ekyir?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Jerusalɛm man yi asan ekyir wɔ daa ekyirsan mu yi? Wɔtakyer ndaadaa ho, wɔpow dɛ wɔbɛsan.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mekyɛɛn aso na metsiee, naaso wɔannkasa tsenenee mu: nyimpa biara nnu noho wɔ n’emumuyɛ ho, dɛ, Ebɛnadze na mayɛ yi? Obiara dan noho fa noara no kwan do, dɛ pɔnkɔ a ɔrobɔ twitwi kɔ akono.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nyew, ɔkompɛtɛ a ɔwɔ wimu mpo onyim ne hyɛber; na atamram na akyemfowa na nantwinoma hyɛ hɔn baber nsew; naaso me man dze, wonnyim EWURADZE n’ahyɛdze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom ka dɛ, Yɛyɛ enyansafo, na EWURADZE ne mbra wɔ hɛn hɔ, wɔ ber nokwar nye yi, akyerɛwfo ator akyerɛwdze no wɔama wɔayɛ atorsɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Enyansafo no enyi bɔto, wɔbɔbɔ hu na wɔakyer hɔn: dɛ, wɔapow EWURADZE n’asɛm yi; ebɛn nyansa na ɔwɔ hɔn mu?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi medze hɔn yernom bɛma binom, na medze hɔn nhaban bɛma hɔn a wobenya edzi: osiandɛ hɔn mu biara ofi ekumaba do kesi ɔkɛse do mpo wɔdze hɔnho ama enyiber, ofi nkɔnhyɛnyi do kesi ɔsɔfo do mpo, obiara dzi akɔhwisɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔayɛ me man ne pira no edur biara biara, dɛ, Asomdwee, asomdwee; ber a asomdwee biara nnyi hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔyɛɛ enyitodze, wɔyɛɛ ekyiwadze, Naaso hɔn enyi annto, dabida, hɔn enyi annto koraa, eso wɔammfɛr. Dɛm ntsi na wɔbɔtotɔ hɔn a wɔtotɔ mu: hɔn asotweber no mu wobosun hɔn egu famu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mebɛma wɔasa koraa, EWURADZE na ɔse: aba remmba wenyindua do, eso adɔmba remmba adɔmbadua do, na ahataw no mpo bɔpo; na ndzɛmba a medze ama hɔn no befi hɔn nsa akɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ebɛnadze ntsi na yɛtsetse hɔ dzindzinn yi? Hom mboa hom ano ma yɛnkɔ nkurow a wɔagye ho ban no mu, na yenkowuwu wɔ hɔ: osiandɛ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn eyi hɛn ama owu, na ɔama hɛn ewudur nsu dɛ yɛnnom, osiandɛ yɛayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Yɛhwɛɛ asomdwee kwan, naaso papa biara ammba; na ɔyarsaber kwan, naaso hwɛ ehubɔ ara nko!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔtse no mpɔnkɔ hwen mu huuhuuyɛ fi Dan: n’abran no hɔn su ne dede ntsi, asaase no nyinara ho popo. Wɔba, na wɔbɛmemen asaase no na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara, nkurow no na hɔn a wɔtse mu nyina.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, morosoma nwɔ, akyerben a wonntum hɔn dwedwe, aba hom mu; na wɔbɛkeka hom, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao, m’enyigye efi mo mu, awerɛhow ekitsa me! M’akoma atɔ bitsi wɔ mo mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Tsie, me man ne nkekamu ndze ɔda mu fitsi ekyirekyir asaase do no: Aso EWURADZE nnyi Zion? Ana ne Hen nnyi no mu? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔdze hɔn ehonyi a woesian, na ananadze egyangyandze eyi me ebufuw yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Otwaber etwa mu, ɔhyewber asa, na hɛn dze, wɔnngyee hɛn nkwa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Me man ne pira ntsi emi so mepira: mayɛ kusuww; ahobow ekitsa me.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso edur bi nnyi Gilead? Ana onunsinnyi bi nnyi hɔ? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na me man nnyaa n’apɔwmudzen yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao, sɛ me tsir yɛɛ esuesu, na m’enyiwa yɛɛ nyinsuwa nsunyiwa a, nkyɛ mubosu me man n’atɔfoe no adzekyee na adzesaa!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao, nkyɛ meenya akwantsemfo asoɛe wɔ sar do ɛ; nkyɛ mebɛdan me man egya, na mefi hɔn nkyɛn akɔ! Na hɔn nyinara yɛ awartofo, nkontompɔfo mboanofo a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔkontom hɔn tɛkyerɛma dɛ egyen; Wɔagye ntsin wɔ asaase no do wɔ atorsɛm mu, na nnyɛ nokwar mu bi a; na wofi mbusu mu kɔ mbusu mu, na wonnyim me, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mu biara nhwɛ yie wɔ ne nyɛnko ho, na mma hom nntwer nua biara: na nua biara bedzi emim pasaa, na nyɛnko biara akasakasa asɛɛ nkorɔfo edzin.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hɔn nyinara bɛdaadaa hɔn amanyimfo, na obiara nnka nokwar; wɔakyerɛkyerɛ hɔn tɛkyerɛma atorsɛm dzi; wɔberɛ hɔnho wɔ emumuyɛ ne yɛ ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wo tsenabea wɔ ndaadaa finimfin; ndaadaa ntsi na wɔpow dɛ wobohu me, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, mebɛnan hɔn, na masɔ hɔn ahwɛ; na mebɛyɛ no dɛn koraa wɔ me man ho?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hɔn tɛkyerɛma yɛ ewudzi egyen menaba; ɔkasa ndaadaa: obi dze n’ano kasa asomdwee mu kyerɛ ne nyɛnko, naaso n’akoma mu dze, nna ɔretsɛw no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso monnkɔtwe hɔn aso wɔ ndzɛmba yinom ntsi? EWURADZE na ɔse: aso me kra rinndzi wer wɔ dɛm man yi do?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbepɔw no ntsi mubotue osu na sukwadwom, na sar do dzidzibea ntsi, metwa ewuo, osiandɛ wɔahyew ma obi nndua hɔ; eso adasa nntse anantwi ndze; wimuwimu noho nnoma na mbowa nyinara eguanguan, na wɔkɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛyɛ Jerusalɛm amamfo, nsɔ tsenabea; na mebɛma Juda nkurow ayɛ nkurofo a obiara nntse mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Woana nye onyansafo, ma ɔaatse iyi ase? Woana nye nyia EWURADZE n’ano akasa akyerɛ no, ma ɔaaka akyerɛ? Ebɛnadze ntsi na asaase no asɛɛ na ɔahyew dɛ sar, ma obiara nndua do yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na EWURADZE se dɛ, Osiandɛ wɔadan me mbra a medze sii hom enyim no egya, na woenntsie me ndze, eso wɔannantsew mu;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na mbom woekedzi hɔnankasa hɔn akoma ne ntsintsiman ekyir, na Baalim a hɔn egyanom kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn no ekyir ntsi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, Hwɛ, medze ɔbɔwen mebɛnyɛn hɔn, ɔman yi ara, na mama hɔn ɔbɔwema nsu ma wɔaanom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mobɔbɔ hɔn so apetse amanaman a hɔn anaa hɔn egyanom nnyim hɔn mu: na mebɛma afona aka hɔn do, ekodu dɛ mama wɔasa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, Hom ndwendwen ho, na hom mfrɛ mbaa a wonyim su ma wɔmbra; na hom nsoma ma wɔnkɛfrɛ mbaa enyansafo ma wɔmbra:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na wɔnyɛ ntsɛm ntu sukwadwom mma hɛn, ma hɛn enyiwa nwora nyinsuwa, na hɛn enyisoatsɛw mporow nsu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na yɛatse sukwadwom ndze fi Zion dɛ, Mbrɛ woedua asɛɛ hɛn afa a! Hɛn enyim egu ase koraa, osiandɛ yɛadan asaase no egya, osiandɛ woedwuruw hɛn tsenabew egu famu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mbaa, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm, na hom mma n’anosɛm nkɔ hom asomu, na hom nkyerɛkyerɛ mbabaa sukwadwom, na obiara nkyerɛkyerɛ ne nyɛnko ewuotwa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na owu afow aba hɛn ntokura mu, ɔahɛn hɛn nhemfie; dɛ obotwa mbofra efi abrɔn do, na mberantsɛ efi abɔntsen do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Kasa! Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Adasa efun bogugu dɛ mfuwa pradada do efikyir, na dɛ eburotwafo ekyir ekuwekuw na obiara nnkɔboaboa ano.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mma onyansafo nnhyehyɛ noho wɔ ne nyansaa mu, eso mma ɔhoɔdzenfo nnhyehyɛ noho wɔ n’ahoɔdzen mu, na ɔhonyafo nnhyehyɛ noho wɔ n’ahonya mu:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na mbom nyia ɔhyehyɛ noho no, ɔnhyehyɛ noho wɔ iyi mu, dɛ ɔtse me ase, na onyim me, dɛ emi nye EWURADZE a meyɛ adɔyɛ, atsɛmbu, na tsenenee wɔ asaase do: na ndzɛmba iyinom mu na m’enyigye wɔ, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, nda bi reba, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ mebɛba abɛtsea hɔn a wɔyɛ twatsiafo wɔ hɔn monomonomyɛ mu;
title: JEREMIAH

text: Egypt, na Juda, na Edom, na Ammonmba, na Moab, na hɔn a woetwitwa ntakuwa a wɔtsetse sar do: na amanaman nyinara yɛ monomonomfo, na Israel fifo nyinara yɛ akoma mu monomonomfo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Israelmba, hom ntsie nsɛm a EWURADZE ka kyerɛ hom:
title: JEREMIAH

text: mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mma hom nsuansua amanaman hɔn kwan no, na mma hom bo nntutu, wɔ ɔsor nsɛnkyerɛdze ho; na amanaman na hɔn bo tutu wɔ ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na amanaman no hɔn atɔrmuadze yɛ egyangyandze: na obi twa dua wɔ kwaa mu, odwimfo ne nsaano edwuma a wɔdze ekuma yɛe.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔdze dwetɛ na sika hyehyɛ no; wɔdze mprɛgow na nhamɛr bobɔ mu, amma oeennhihim.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔtse dɛ kakaa bi a wɔayɛ esi efɛr kwa mu, na wonntum nnkasa: otwar dɛ wɔsoa hɔn, osiandɛ wonntum nnantsew. Mma nnsuro hɔn, na wonntum mmbɔ mbusu, eso papayɛ bi nnyi hɔn mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE, obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo; ɔwo na eyɛ ɔkɛse, na wo dzin so so wɔ tum mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Amanaman Hen, woana na onnkosuro wo? Ɔwo na ɔyɛ wodze: susuampaara dɛ amanaman enyansafo nyinara mu na hɔn ahendzi nyinara mu, obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ɔwo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔyɛ mbowadze na nkwaseadze prɛko: na ehonyi ne nkyerɛkyerɛ dze, ɔtse dɛ duasin ara a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dwetɛ a wɔabor no trɛtrɛ fi Tarsis ba, na sika a ofi Ufaz, ɔyɛ odwimfo na sikadwimfo ne nsaano edwuma; bibir na ɔberdum nye hɔn efuradze; ne nyinara edwimfo enyansafo edwuma a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso EWURADZE nye nokwar Nyankopɔn; ɔno nye Nyankopɔn tseasefo na ɔdomankoma hen no. No bo fuw a, asaase wosow, na amanaman nntum n’ebufuhyew enyim gyina.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Iyi na hom nka nkyerɛ hɔn: Abosom a nnyɛ hɔn bi na wɔyɛɛ ɔsor na asaase no, wɔbɛsɛɛ efi asaase do, na ɔsorsor ase.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔno na ɔdze no tum ayɛ asaase, ɔno na ɔdze ne nyansaa etsintsim wiadze, na ɔdze ne ntseasee atserɛw ɔsorsor mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Sɛ ɔbɔ ne ndze mu a, esuesu no weɔɔyɛ ba ɔsorsor, na ɔma ehubɔhubɔw tu fi asaase ano fa sor; ɔno na ɔyɛ enyinam na nyankom, na ɔdze mframa fi n’adzekorabea ba.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nyimpa biara adan kwasea na onnyim dze; sikadwinnyi biara no honyi a woesian hyɛ no enyito: na no honyi a woegu no yɛ ator, na ahom biara nnyi hɔn mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔyɛ egyangyandze, ndaadaa edwuma a: hɔn asotweber mu no wɔbɛsɛɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Jakob ne kyɛfa no dze ɔnntse dɛ iyinom; na ɔno nye adze nyinara ne hyehyɛfo; na Israel nye n’egyapadze ebusuakuw: dɔm EWURADZE nye ne dzin.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔwo a etse kurow a woetua no mu, boaboa w’ahodze ano fi asaase no do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mobɔtow asaase no do nkorɔfo no tsiabo akyerɛkyerɛ dɛm aber yi mu, na meguan hɔn ho, ma wɔaatse no yie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mundue wɔ me pira ntsi! Me pirakur yɛ yaayaw; naaso mesee dɛ, Ampaara iyi nye me yaw, na otwar dɛ mosɔw.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Me ntamadan asɛɛ, na me ntampehoma nyinara atsetsew: me mba efi me nkyɛn kɔ, na wonnyi hɔ: obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔtserɛw me ntamadan mu bio, na ɔasese me ntamadan ho nkataho no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na nguanhwɛfo no adan nkwasea, na wommbisa EWURADZE ekyir kwan: dɛm ntsi na ennsi hɔn yie, na hɔn mbowakuw nyinara apetse yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Tsie dedeedeyɛ bi, hwɛ ɔreba, na asakrabutuw kɛse bi a ofi kwaamu afamu asaase do, dɛ ɔrebɛma Juda nkurow ayɛ nkurofo, mpataku tsenabea.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE, minyim dɛ ɔdasanyi no kwan nnyi nankasa ne nsamu: onnyi ɔdasanyi a ɔnam ne nsamu mbrɛ obodua etutu n’anamɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE, tsea me, na mbom wɔ pɛrpɛryɛ mu a; nnyɛ ebufuw mu a, amma maannsɛɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hue w’ebufuhyew gu aman a wonnyim wo no do, na mbusua a wɔmmbɔ wo dzin no do: osiandɛ wɔamen Jakob, nyew, wɔamen no seranseram, na wɔama ne tsenabea ayɛ amamfo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a ofi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom ntsie ahyɛmu yi ne nsɛm no, na hom nka nkyerɛ Juda mbarimba na Jerusalɛmfo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Mpaa nka nyimpa a onntsie ahyɛmu yi ne nsɛm a
title: JEREMIAH

text: mehyɛɛ hom egyanom wɔ da a miyii hɔn Egypt asaase do, fii dadze fononoo no mu, dɛ, Hom ntsie me ndze, na hom nyɛ, dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ hom nyinara: ɔno na hom bɛyɛ me man, na emi so mayɛ hom Nyankopɔn:
title: JEREMIAH

text: ama maama ntam a mekaa kyerɛɛ hom egyanom no etsim, dɛ mebɛma hɔn asaase bi a numfonsu na ewo pem wɔ do, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi. Nna mubuae see dɛ, Ɔnyɛ hɔ, EWURADZE.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Bɔ nsɛm yi nyinara dawur wɔ Juda nkurow mu, na Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu, dɛ, Hom ntsie ahyɛmu yi ne nsɛm no, na hom nyɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mepaa mu kaa no enyiberdo ara kyerɛɛ hom egyanom wɔ da a miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do, dze besi ndɛ, morosoɛr ahanamakye merepaa mu mereka, dɛ, Hom ntsie me ndze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso woenntsie, eso wɔammbrɛ hɔn asowa adze, na mbom obiara nantseew n’emumuyɛ akoma ne ntsintsiman mu: dɛm ntsi medze ahyɛmu yi ne nsɛm a mehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnyɛ, na wɔannyɛ no, nyinara baa hɔn do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Woehu tsirdo apam bi wɔ Juda mbarimba, na Jerusalɛmfo mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔasan ekyir akɔ hɔn nananom a wɔpoow dɛ wobetsie me nsɛm no hɔn emumuyɛ ho; na woekedzi enyame afofor ekyir rokɔsom hɔn: Israelfo na Judafo ato m’ahyɛmu a menye hɔn egyanom dzii no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, medze mbusu bɛba hɔn do a worunntum mmfi nsa; na wobosu afrɛ me, naaso mirinntsie hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔno na Juda nkurow na Jerusalɛmfo bɔkɔ ekosu afrɛ enyame a wɔhyew nduhuam ma hɔn no: naaso wɔnnkɛgye hɔn nkwa koraa wɔ hɔn fona ber no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Juda, mbrɛ wo nkurow hɔn dodow ano si no, mbrɛ w’enyame dodow ano so si ara nye no; na mbrɛ Jerusalɛm abrɔn hɔn dodow ano si no, na hom esisi afɔrmbukyia ama enyitodze no, afɔrmbukyia a wɔhyew do nduhuam ma Baal no a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mma nnsɔr mma ɔman yi, eso mma mmpegya osu anaa mpaabɔ wɔ hɔn ntsi: osiandɛ mirinntsie hɔn wɔ ber a wobosu afrɛ me wɔ ɔfona ntsi no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ebɛnadze na mo dɔfo wɔ yɛ wɔ me fie, ber a ɔnye dodowara ayɛ ehuhudze yi? Aso mbowa afɔrbɔ botum apa wo mbusu? Ana afei ibotum edzi ehurusi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE too wo dzin dɛ, Ngodua ebun ebun a aba pa ama ɔayɛ fɛɛfɛw; ɔdze weɔɔyɛ kɛse ne dede ekua gya wɔ do, na n’abaw ebubu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na dɔm EWURADZE a ɔtsɛɛw wo no, ɔakasa mbusu etsia wo, osian mbusu a Israelmba na Judamba abobɔ ama hɔnho wɔ dɛ wɔahyehyew nduhuam ama Baal dze eyi me ebufuw no ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE na ɔmaa me ho nyimdzee, na muhunii: nna ekyerɛɛ me hɔn ndzeyɛɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na meyɛɛ dɛ eguambaa brɛfo a wɔdze no rokɔ ekumii. Nna minnyim dɛ saa wɔdze ritsia me wɔadwendwen mo ho adwen, dɛ, Hom mma yɛnsɛɛ dua no na no do aba, na hom mma yentwa no mfi atseasefo asaase do, amma wɔaannkaa ne dzin bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso, Ao dɔm EWURADZE, ɔwo a ibu atsɛn tsenenee, na esɔ adwen na akoma hwɛ, ma munhu w’awerdzi wɔ hɔn do: na ɔwo na medze m’asɛm abrɛ wo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se wɔ Anathot mbarimba a wɔrohwehwɛ wo nkwa na wɔka dɛ, Mma nnhyɛ nkɔm wɔ EWURADZE dzin mu, ɔno ibowu wɔ hɛn nsaano no ho nye dɛ:
title: JEREMIAH

text: mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, mebɛtsea hɔn: mberantsɛ no bowuwu wɔ afona ano; ɔkɔm bokuku hɔn mbabanyin na hɔn mbabaa;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na nkaa bi nnkɛka ama hɔn: na medze mbusu bɛba Anathot mbarimba do, mekyerɛ hɔn asotwe afe no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE, sɛ mobɔ wo sombo a, bem ara na ibedzi: naaso menye wo beyi atsɛn ara. Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na emumuyɛfo kwan yɛ prɔmprɔm? Ɔyɛ dɛn na hɔn a wotwa nkontompɔ nyinara hɔn ho dwe hɔn yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔwoara na atsɛw hɔn, nyew, wɔagye ndwow; wonyin, na wɔsow aba; ɔwo ebɛn hɔn ano, naaso enye hɔn akoma ntamu twe.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso ɔwo, EWURADZE, inyim me; ɔwo ihu me, na esɔ m’akoma hwɛ wɔ wo ho: twetwe hɔn pue dɛ nguan a wɔdze hɔn rokɔ ekumii, na siesie hɔn ma okum da no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Onkodu dabɛn na asaase no ngyam, na asaase nyinara do nhaban nkyenkyen? Hɔn a wɔtse mu no hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi mbowa na nnoma asa; osiandɛ wɔsee dɛ, Onnhu hɛn, wɔ dza yɛyɛ ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Sɛ enye anamɔnmufo etutu mbirika, na wɔama aberɛ a, ebɛyɛ dɛn afei etum enye mpɔnkɔ esi empire? Na kaansa asomdwee asaase do mpo ehwe ase a, ɔnodze ebɛyɛ dɛn wɔ Jordan ne yir mu?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wo nuanom, na w’egya fie mpo hɔnara mpo woetwa wo nkontompɔ; hɔnara mpo wɔatseatsea mu edzi w’ekyir: kaansa wɔkasa dɔkɔdɔkɔ kyerɛ wo mpo a, mma nngye hɔn nndzi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Madan me fie egya, matow m’egyapadze akyen; medze dza me kra no dɔ pa ara ahyɛ n’atamfo nsa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: M’egyapadze adan me dɛ kwaa mu ogyata: ɔabɔ ne ndze mu etsia me; dɛm ntsi matan no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso m’egyapadze adan me anoma edzinam ntokowa ntokowa? Aso nnoma edzinam etwa ayer me? Hom nkɔ nkɔboa hamu mbowadoma nyinara ano, na hom mfa hɔn mbra ma wombedzi ne nam.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nguanhwɛfo pii asɛɛ mo wenyin ture na woetsiatsia me kyɛfa do, wɔama me kyɛfa fɛɛfɛw no ayɛ sar pradada.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔayɛ no amamfo; orusu kyerɛ me, dɛ ɔayɛ afoafo, asaase no nyina ayɛ amamfo, naaso obiara nndween ho da wɔ n’akoma mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Sar pradadaada nyina do, adzesɛɛfo aba; na EWURADZE n’afona no ridzi nam fi asaase no ne tsir pem tsir: ɔdasanyi biara nnya asomdwee.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Woegu ewifua, na woetwa nsoɛ; wɔafona hɔnho, naaso woennya mu hwee. Hom enyiwa bɔto hom ndɔbaa ho, osian EWURADZE n’ebufuhyew ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se wɔ nyimpa emumuyɛfo nyinara a wɔdze hɔn nsa ka egyapadze a medze ama me man Israel dɛ wondzi do no ho nye yi: Hwɛ, mubotutu hɔn efi hɔn asaase no do, na metutu Judamba efi hɔn mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ metu hɔn ewie ekyir no, mebɛsan ebohu hɔn mbɔbɔr; na medze hɔn bɛsan aba obiara n’egyapadze mu, na obiara n’asaase do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔdze mbɔdzen sua me man hɔn akwan, dɛ wɔka me dzin ho ntam, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase yi; dɛ mbrɛ mpo wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ me man ma wɔkaa Baal ntam no a; ɔnodze wɔdze hɔn besisi me man finimfin.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ woenntsie a, ɔnodze mubotutu ɔman no, mubotutu na masɛɛ no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE see me nye yi, Kɔ, na kɔtɔ ndwera pa abɔdo, na fa bɔ w’asen, na mma mmfa nnka nsu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna motɔɔ abɔdo dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm tse, na medze bɔɔ m’asen.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ otsia ebien no dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Fa abɔdo a atɔ abɔ w’asen no, na soɛr, kɔ Eufrates ho, na fa kosuma ɔbotan no no tokur bi mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna mokɔree, na medze kosumaa Eufrates ho, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE hyɛɛ me no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda pii ekyir no, EWURADZE see me dɛ, Soɛr, si mu kɔ Eufrates ho, na keyi abɔdo a mehyɛɛ wo dɛ fa kosuma hɔ no fi hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna mokɔr Eufrates ho, mokɔree, na miyii abɔdo no fii beebi mbrɛ medze sumae no: na, hwɛ, abɔdo no esuw, onnye mma hwee.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Dɛm yi ara na mibesi masɛɛ Juda ne ntsɛn, na Jerusalɛm ne ntsɛn beberebe no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔman bɔn yi a wɔpow dɛ wobetsie me nsɛm, wɔnantsew hɔn akoma ne ntsintsiman mu na woekedzi enyame afofor ekyir, dɛ wɔrokɔsom hɔn, na wɔasɔr hɔn no, wɔbɛyɛ dɛ abɔdo yi ara a onnye mma hwee no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ abɔdo fam nyimpa n’asen no, dɛmara na mama Israelmba nyina na Judamba nyina afam mo ho nye no, EWURADZE na ɔse; ama wɔaayɛ me ɔman, na dzin, na ayɛyi, na enyimnyam: naaso wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi ka asɛm yi kyerɛ hɔn: Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi, Nsatoa biara wɔbɛhyɛ no nsa ma: na wɔbɛse wo dɛ, Ana innyim dɛ nsatoa biara wɔbɛhyɛ no nsa ma?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔno na wo so se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, mebɛma asaase yi do mba nyinara, mekyerɛ ahemfo a wɔtsetse David akɔngua do, na asɔfo, na nkɔnhyɛfo, na Jerusalɛmmba nyinara wɔabobow nsa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na medze hɔn besisi hɔnho nkorkor, egyanom a wonnyi mba mpo, EWURADZE na ɔse: munnkohu mbɔbɔr, eso mennkɛkam do, eso minnkenya ayamuhyehye dɛ mennkɛsɛɛ hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom ntsie, na hom nyɛ aso; mma hom nnyɛ ntsɛntsɛn, na EWURADZE akasa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mfa enyimnyam mma EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn no, ansaana sum agye, ansaana hom anan efintsiw mbepɔw no do ewimbir; na ber a hom rohwehwɛ kan no, ɔdan no owu sunsuma, na ɔyɛ no sum kebikebi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso sɛ hom rinntsie a, me kra bosu nsumaa mu wɔ hom ntsɛn ntsi; na m’enyiwa bosu kɛse, na oekyi nyinsuwa pii, osiandɛ wɔafa EWURADZE no nguankuw no ndɔmmum.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Se ɔhen nye ɔhen ne na dɛ, Hom mbrɛ hom ho adze bɔkɔɔ: na hom enyimnyam abɔtsir no efi hom tsir ho egu famu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔatotow pomu afamu nkurow no mu, na obi nnyi hɔ a obuebue: woetu Juda manmu nyina ndɔmmum kɔ; woetu no kɔ ndɔmmum korakora.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mma hom enyi do, na hom nhwɛ hɔn a wofi kwaamu afamu reba: wo mbowakuw a wɔdze kyɛɛ wo no wɔ hen, mekyerɛ, wo mbowakuw fɛɛfɛw no a?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Sɛ ɔdze hɔn a ɔwoara akyerɛkyerɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnyɛ w’aboafo no dzi wo do panyin a, ebɛn asɛm na ebɛka? Aso yaw nnkekitsa wo dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ ibisa wo ho dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ndzɛmba iyinom aba mo do a? W’emumuyɛ ne kɛse ntsi wɔada w’asetar ho edzi, na w’anantsir ruhu amandze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso Etiopianyi botum asakyer no wer, anaa ɔsebɔ bɛsesa no ho nsisii? Ɔno na hom a mbusubɔ akokwa hom yi hom botum ayɛ papa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi na mobɔbɔ hɔn apetse dɛ ntsɛw a sar do mframa ma otu kɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Iyi nye w’afamudze, wo kyɛfa a mesusu ama wo, EWURADZE na ɔse; osiandɛ wo werɛ efir me, na edze woho atwer atorsɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi emi mara so mibeyi w’asetar ebua w’enyim na w’enyito bɛda edzi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mehu w’ekyiwadze, mekyerɛ w’awarto na wo hwenmubɔ, wo ndwamangor n’atantandze, wɔ haban mu akoko do. Jerusalɛm e due! Onkodu dabɛn na wo ho bɛtsew?
title: JEREMIAH
