text: Nna EWURADZE see me dɛ, Kaansa Moses na Samuel begyina m’enyim mpo a, nkyɛ m’adwen nnkɔtɔ akɔ ɔman yi do; hom nyi hɔn edzi mfi m’enyim, na wɔmma womfi hɔ nkɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔse wo dɛ, Henfa na yemfir edzi ɔno ka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hɔn a wɔfata owu no, wɔnkɔ owu mu; na hɔn a wɔfata afona ano no, wɔnkɔ afona ano; na hɔn a wɔfata ɔkɔm no, wɔnkɔ ɔkɔm mu; na hɔn a wɔfata ndɔmmum no, wɔnkɔ ndɔmmum mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ndzɛmba horow anan na mebɛma wɔaba hɔn do, EWURADZE na ɔse: afona a wɔdze boku hɔn, na nkraman a wɔbɛtsetsew hɔn mu, na wimu nnoma, na asaase mbowa a wɔbɛmemen na wɔasɛɛ hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛma woedzi hɔn akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do ahendzi horow nyina mu, osian dza Judahen Hezekia ne ba Manaasɛ yɛe wɔ Jerusalɛm ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na woana benya tsema ama wo, ao Jerusalɛm, anaa woana bedzi wo nkɔmbɔ? Woana bɛman nkyɛn ekebisa wo yieyɛ?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔwo apow me, EWURADZE na ɔse, na w’ekyir ara na eresan: dɛm ntsi na matsen me nsa wɔ wo do, na masɛɛ wo; maberɛ na mbɔbɔrhu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na medze nhuwdo adze mehuw hɔn do wɔ asaase no n’aponkɛse no mu; magye hɔn nsamu mba, na masɛɛ me man; osiandɛ wɔnnsanee mmfii hɔn akwan do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hɔn ekunafo adɔɔ so ama me asen mpoano anhwea: medze ɔsɛɛfo bi aba mberantsɛ no hɔn na do ewiaber ketee: mama ahoguan na hu atɔ no do awerɛfir mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔbaa a ɔawo esuon no, oegura; oegyaa no sunsum mu; no wi atɔ ber a adzekyee da ho wɔ do no; n’enyi ato na n’enyim egu ase: na hɔn mu nkaase no medze hɔn bɛma afona wɔ hɔn atamfo enyim, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Me na, mundue, dɛ awo me ɔko nyimpa na mansotwe nyimpa dze ama adasa nyinara! Mommbɔɔ bosa minnsii apempem, eso obi mmbɔɔ me bosa nnsii apempem; naaso hɔn mu obiara biara dom me.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE see dɛ, Ampaara mebɛma ɔtamfo no akotow aserɛ wo wɔ mbusu ber na ahohia ber mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso obi tum bu dadze, mekyerɛ dadze a ofir kwaamu afamu, na boran mu?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mebɛma wɔafom w’akoradze na wonnkotua kaw, wɔ wo bɔn nyinara ntsi, wɔ w’ahe nyinara do mpo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛma asom w’atamfo wɔ asaase a innyim no do; osiandɛ ogya bi asɔ wɔ m’ebufuw mu a ɔbɛdzɛw wɔ hom do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE, ɔwoara inyim; kaa me, na bɛsera me, na bɔtɔ m’ahohiahiafo wer ma me; mma mmfa me nnkɔ wɔ wo penkyɛr mu: hu dɛ ɔwo ntsi na masɔw ahorbahyɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wohun wo nsɛm, na midzii; na wo nsɛm yɛɛ me enyigye na m’akoma n’ehurusi: osiandɛ, wo dzin na wɔdze frɛ me, Ao, dɔm EWURADZE Nyankopɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Manntsena hɔn a wɔregye hɔn enyi, anaa wodzii ehurusi hɔn bagua mu: osian wo nsa ntsi mankotsee metsenae; osiandɛ ɔwo edze ebufuhyew ahyɛ me ma.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na me yaw wɔ hɔ daa, na me pirakur ayɛ koannkɔ a ɔpow dɛ wɔyɛ no edur yi? Aso ampaara dɛ ɔwo ebɛyɛ ndaadaa ɔwora, dɛ esu a ɔwew ama me?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Sɛ esan w’ekyir a, ɔno na medze wo bɛba bio, ma aabɔsom me; na sɛ iyi dza ɔsom bo fi dza ɔyɛ huhuw no mu a, ebɛyɛ dɛ m’ano. Hɔn na wɔbɛsan aba wo nkyɛn, na nnyɛ ɔwo na ebɛsan akɔ hɔn nkyɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na medze wo besi hɔ ama ɔman yi; dɛ boran afasu a wɔabɔ ho ban na wɔnye wo bedzi ako, naaso worunntum nnka wo nngu; na mowɔ wo nkyɛn dɛ meregye wo nkwa na meyi wo, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mibeyi wo efi omumuyɛnyi no ne nsamu, na mapon wo efi etsiɔdzemfo no nsamu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE see me dɛ, Kaansa Moses na Samuel begyina m’enyim mpo a, nkyɛ m’adwen nnkɔtɔ akɔ ɔman yi do; hom nyi hɔn edzi mfi m’enyim, na wɔmma womfi hɔ nkɔ.

title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ so, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mma nnwar yer, eso mma nnya mbabanyin na mbabaa wɔ bea yi do ha.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se wɔ mbabanyin na mbabaa a wɔwo hɔn wɔ bea yi do ho, na hɔn nanom a wɔwo hɔn, na hɔn egyanom a wɔwo hɔn wɔ asaase yi do ho no nye yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wobowuwu awerɛhow wu; wonnkosu hɔn, eso wonnkesie hɔn; wɔbɛyɛ dɛ efikyir wɔ daadze enyi; na afona na ɔkɔm bɛhyew hɔn; na hɔn efun bɛyɛ edziban ama ɔsor nnoma, na asaase mbowa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mma hom nnkɔ eyiadze, eso mma hom nnkosu, eso mma hom nnkegyam hɔn: osiandɛ meyi m’asomdwee efi ɔman yi ho kɔ, EWURADZE na ɔse, mpo m’adɔyɛ na m’ayamuhyehye.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Akɛse na nkakraba nyinara bowuwu wɔ asaase yi do: worinnsie hɔn, eso nyimpa runnsu hɔn, eso wɔrommbɔ hɔnho akam, eso wɔremmpa hɔn etsir mma hɔn:
title: JEREMIAH

text: eso wɔrennkyɛ edziban mmema hɔn eyiyɛ mu mmfa nnkyekye hɔn werɛ wɔ ewufo no ntsi, eso wɔremma hɔn awerɛkyekyer kɔɔpow dɛ wɔnnom wɔ hɔn egya na hɔn na ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mma nnye hɔn nnkɔ aponto fi mu nnkɛnye hɔn nntsena ase nndzidzi na nnom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi: Hwɛ, mebɛma ahosɛpɛw ndze, na enyigye ndze, okumfor ndze na ayefor ndze egyaa, wɔ bea yi do ha, wɔ hom enyiwa do na hom ber yi mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ iyi nsɛm yinom nyinara kyerɛ ɔman yi, na wobisa wo dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na EWURADZE aka mbusu kɛse yi nyina egu hɛn do yi, na hɛn emumuyɛ nye dɛn? Hɛn bɔn a yɛayɛ etsia EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn enye dɛn a?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔno dze se hɔn dɛ, Osiandɛ hom egyanom adan me egya, EWURADZE na ɔse, na woekedzi abosom afofor bi ekyir, na wɔasom hɔn, na wɔakotow hɔn, na wɔadan me egya, na woenndzi me mbra do;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na hom so abɔ mbusu asen hom egyanom; na, hwɛ, hom mu obiara dzi nankasa n’akoma bɔn ne ntsintsiman ekyir, ma dɛm ntsi na hom mma me aso:
title: JEREMIAH

text: dɛm ntsi na mobɔtow hom efi asaase yi do ekogu asaase bi a hom na hom egyanom nnyim do; na hɔ na hom bɔsom abosom afofor adzekyee na adzesaa; osiandɛ merennyɛ adom biara mma hom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda bi reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔnnkɛse bio dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE a oyii Israelmba fii Egypt asaase no do tse ase yi;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na mbom, dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE a oyii Israelmba fii kwaamu afamu asaase do, na aman a ɔpaam hɔn kɔr hɔ nyina do, tse ase yi: na medze hɔn bɛba asaase a medze maa hɔn egyanom no do bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, mobɔsoma ekehyia apofo pii, EWURADZE na ɔse, na wobonu hɔn; na n’ekyir no masoma ekehyia abɔmbɔfo pii, ma wɔbɔtwe hɔn efi bepɔw biara na koko biara do, na abotan mu etu mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Osiandɛ m’enyi wɔ hɔn akwan nyinara do: wonnsuma wɔ m’enyi do, eso wommbuabua hɔn emumuyɛ do wɔ m’enyiwa do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mibedzi kan metua hɔn emumuyɛ na hɔn bɔn kaw mbɔho: osiandɛ wɔdze hɔn atantandze n’efun egu m’asaase ho fi, na wɔdze hɔn ekyiwadze ahyɛ m’egyapadze do ma.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE, m’ahoɔdzen, na m’akoban, na mo guandɔbea wɔ ahohia da mu, ɔwo na amanaman fi asaase ano bɛba wo nkyɛn abɛse dɛ, Hɛn egyanom ennya ewungyadze biara dɛ atorsɛm nko, mekyerɛ egyangyandze na ndzɛmba a mfaso bi nnyi mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso dasanyi bɛyɛ enyame bi ama noho? Iyinom nyina nnyɛ enyame bi!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, mebɛma woehu, prɛko yi ara dze mebɛma woehu me nsa na m’ahoɔdzen; na wobohu dɛ me dzin dze EWURADZE.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Juda no bɔn wɔdze dadze kyerɛwdze na dɛnkyɛmbo hwintsi akyerɛw: woekrukye no wɔ hɔn akoma pon, na hɔn afɔrmbukyia mmbɛn do;
title: JEREMIAH

text: ber a hɔn mba ka hɔn afɔrmbukyia na hɔn Aserim a ɔwowɔ ndua ebun ebun ase wɔ akoko sorɔnsorɔm do no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Me bepɔw a ewɔ wiramu, medze w’ahodze na w’akoradze nyina bɛma ma wɔaafom afa, na wo nsorɔnsorɔmbea no, wɔ bɔn ntsi, wɔ w’ahe nyinara do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔwo, ɔwoara wo mu no, ibegyaa egyapadze a medze maa wo no mu ato hɔ; na mebɛma akɔsom w’atamfo wɔ asaase a innyim no do: osiandɛ hom asɔ gya wɔ m’ebufuw mu a ɔbɛdzɛw daa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Ndom nka ɔdasanyi biara a ɔtwer ɔdasanyi, na ɔdze ɔhonam yɛ n’akodadze, na n’akoma twe fi EWURADZE ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛ sar do duaba, na sɛ yie ba a orunnhu. Ɔbɛtsena mbea a ayɛ kɛsɛɛ no do wɔ sar no do, nkyen asaase a obi nntse do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Osiarfo nye nyimpa a ɔdze noho twer EWURADZE, na EWURADZE yɛ n’enyidado.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛ dua a wɔatsɛw no wɔ nsu ho, na ɔtsentsen no ndwow kɔ esutsen no nkyɛn, na sɛ ɔhyew ba a, ɔnnyɛ no hu, na mbom n’ahaban bɛyɛ ebun ebun, na nsuna afe nnkɛyɛ no asɛm, eso orinngyaa aba sow.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Akoma yɛ ɔdaadaafo kyɛn adze nyina, na ɔyɛ otsiɔdzennyi kɛse, woana botum atse no ase?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Emi mara EWURADZE na mosɔ adwen hwɛ na mohwehwɛ akoma mu, ama maama obiara, dɛ mbrɛ n’akwan tse, dɛ mbrɛ ne ndzeyɛe n’aba tse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛ mbrɛ akokɔhwerɛw da nkyirefuwa a nnyɛ ɔno bi towee do tse no, dɛm ara so na nyia ɔammfa tsenenee do nya ahonya no tse; ne nda ne finimfin no wobegya no hɔ, na ewiei no ɔbɛyɛ ɔkwasea.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao enyimnyam ahengua, wɔakrɔn no fir tsetse hɛn krɔnkrɔnbea!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE, Israel enyidado! Hɔn a wɔdan wo gya nyina enyi bɔto; hɔn a wofi wo nkyɛn kɔ no, wɔbɛkyerɛw hɔn edzin aka asaase ase mba ho osiandɛ wɔadan EWURADZE, nkwa nsunyiwa no egya.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE, sa me yarba, na mo ho bɛsan; gye me nkwa, na mibenya nkwa: na ɔwo nye m’ayɛyi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, mbrɛ wobisa me dɛ, EWURADZE n’asɛm no wɔ hen? Ma ɔmbra ɛ!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Emi dze memmpɛɛ ntsɛm minngyaae dɛ meyɛ oguanhwɛfo dzi w’ekyir: eso memmpɛɛ mbusu da no. Ɔwoara inyim dza ofiir m’ano no, ɔdaa w’enyim.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mma nnyɛ ohuyifo mma me; ɔwo nye mo guandɔbea wɔ mbusu da no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ma hɔn a wohiahia mo ho no hɔn enyi nto, na emi dze, mma m’enyi nnto; hɔn dze, ma hɔn akoma ntu, naaso emi dze, ma mma m’akoma nntu: fa mbusu da no bra hɔn do, na fa ɔsɛɛ mbɔho sɛɛ hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE see me nye yi: Kɔ, kegyina ɔman no ne mba hɔn aponkɛse a Juda ahemfo dzi mu akɔnaaba, ɔnye Jerusalɛm aponkɛse no nyinara mu;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na se hɔn dɛ, Hom Juda ahemfo, na Juda nyinara, na hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalɛm nyinara a wodua aponkɛse yi mu kɛhɛn mu, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm;
title: JEREMIAH

text: mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi; Hom nhwɛ hom ho yie, na mma hom nnsoa adzesoa ahomgyeda anaaso wɔmmfa nndua Jerusalɛm aponkɛse mu mmba mu;
title: JEREMIAH

text: eso mma hom nnsoa adzesoa mmfifi hom efiefi mu ahomgyeda, eso mma hom nnyɛ edwuma biara; na mbom hom nyɛ ahomgyeda no krɔnkrɔn, dɛ mbrɛ mehyɛɛ hom egyanom no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: naaso woenntsie, eso wɔammbrɛ hɔn aso adze, na wɔkyee hɔn kɔn, amma wɔaanntse na wɔaanngye nkyerɛkyerɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ hom tsie me enyiberdo, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ hom nnkɛfa adzesoa biara edua kurow yi n’aponkɛse mu ahomgyeda, na mbom hom yɛ ahomgyeda no krɔnkrɔn, dɛ hom nnkedzi dwuma biara wɔ mu a,
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔnodze ahemfo na mbapɔmba a wɔtsetse David akɔngua do no, wobodua kurow yi aponkɛse mu ahɛn mu a wɔtsenatsena ntseaseanam mu na mpɔnkɔ do, hɔnara, na hɔn mbapɔmba, Juda mbarimba ɔnye hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalɛm: na kurow yi besi hɔ daa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wofi Juda nkurow, na mbeambea a abɔ Jerusalɛm ho aprɔw, na Benjamin asaase, na bɔnsa mu, na mbepɔw do, na Pomu afamu bɛba, dze ɔhyew afɔr, na okum afɔr, na edziban afɔr, na nduhuam aba, na wɔdze ndaase afɔrbɔdze aba EWURADZE fie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ hom enntsie me dɛ hom bɛyɛ ahomgyeda no krɔnkrɔn, na hom nnkɔsoa adzesoa akɛhɛn Jerusalɛm aponkɛse no mu ahomgyeda a, ɔnodze mobɔsɔ gya wɔ aponkɛse no mu, na ɔahyew Jerusalɛm ahemfie no na worunndum no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a ofi EWURADZE hɔ baa Jeremia nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Soɛr, na sian kɔ ɔwemfo no ne fie, na hɔ na mebɛma atse me nsɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna misianee kɔr ɔwemfo no ne fie, na, hwɛ, nna ɔreyɛ n’edwuma wɔ nhwiir do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ber a ɔsɛn a ɔdze awendɛtse reyɛ no, sɛɛe wɔ ɔwemfo no nsamu no, ɔyɛɛ no ɔsɛn fofor bio, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwemfo noara hwɛ a oye no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Israelmba, aso murunntum mmfa hom nnyɛ dɛ ɔwemfo yi? EWURADZE na ɔse. Hwɛ, mbrɛ awendɛtse tse wɔ ɔwemfo nsamu no, mbrɛ hom tse wɔ me nsamu ara nye no, Israelmba.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aber biara a mebɛkasa wɔ ɔman bi ho, na ahendzi bi ho, dɛ mubotutu no, na medwuruw no, na masɛɛ no no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: sɛ ɔman no a makasa hɔn ho no wɔsan fi hɔn emumuyɛ ho a, mebɛsesa m’adwen wɔ mbusu a modween dɛ medze bɔbɔ hɔn no ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na aber biara a mebɛkasa ɔman bi ho na ahendzi bi ho, dɛ mibesi na matsɛw no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: sɛ ɔbɔ mbusu wɔ m’enyi do, dɛ onntsie me ndze a, ɔnodze mebɛsesa m’adwen wɔ papa a mekaa dɛ medze bɛyɛ hɔn mfaso nyinara ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na afei kɔ ɛ, kɛka kyerɛ Juda mbarimba, na Jerusalɛmmba, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, merehyehyɛ mbusu bi etsia hom, na merepam apam bi etsia hom: afei hom mu biara nsan mfi no mbusu kwan ho, na hom nyɛ hom akwan na hom ndzeyɛɛ yie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso hɔn dze, wɔse dɛ, Enyidado bi nnyi hɔ: na yebedzi hɛnankasa hɛn tsirmsɛm ekyir, na hɛn mu biara aka n’akoma bɔn ne ntsintsiman do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Afei hom mbisa amanaman mu dɛ woana atse dɛm ndzɛmba yi bi da; Israel ɔbaabun no ayɛ adze a ɔyɛ hu papaapa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso Lebanon esukwankyɛba bɛsa wɔ kwaa mu ɔbotan do? Anaa aso amanandze nsubansuba nwinwin a ɔrepem sian no bɔwew a?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso me man werɛ efir me, wɔhyew nduhuam ma egyangyandze; na wɔama woefintsiw hɔn akwan mu, tsetse atsempɔn no do, na wɔakɛnantsew akwamfo do, akwan a wɔmmbɔe do;
title: JEREMIAH

text: reyɛ hɔn asaase amamfo na daa asesardze. Obiara a ɔfa do no no ho bow no, na ɔwosow ne tsir.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mobɔbɔ hɔn apetse wɔ atamfo enyim dɛ boka mframa; mebɛdan m’ekyir ama hɔn na nnyɛ m’enyim bi a, wɔ hɔn mbusu da no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna wɔkaa dɛ, Hom mbra ma yɛnkɛpam Jeremia ne tsir do; osiandɛ mbra no rennhera mmfi ɔsɔfo hɔ, na afotu efi onyansafo hɔ, anaa asɛm no efi nkɔnhyɛnyi hɔ. Hom mbra ma yɛmfa tɛkyerɛma mbɔ no, na mma yenntsie ne nsɛm biara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE, yɛ aso ma me ɛ, na tsie dza hɔn a wɔnye me ridzi esi no ka.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso wɔdze mbusu botua papa kaw? Naaso hɔn dze, woefun mona ama me kra. Kaa mbrɛ migyinaa w’enyim dɛ mereka papa ama hɔn, dɛ meredan w’ebufuw efi hɔn do no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi yi hɔn mba ma ɔkɔm, na gyaa hɔn mu hyɛ afona no tum nsa; na ma hɔn yernom ndzi mba ho nsaansa, na wɔnyɛ ekunafo. Ma owuyarba nku hɔn mbarimba, na hɔn mberantsɛ nwu afona ano wɔ ɔko mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ma wɔntse osu nka wɔ hɔn efiefi mu, ber a edze dɔm bɛba hɔn do awerɛfir mu no; osiandɛ woefun mona dɛ wɔdze rekyer me, na woesuasua m’anamɔn mfir.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso ɔwo, Ao EWURADZE, inyim hɔn apam a wɔpam mo do dze eboku me nyinara; mma mmfa hɔn emumuyɛ nnkyɛ hɔn, eso mma mmpepa hɔn bɔn mmfi w’enyi do: na mbom ma wombutuw hɔn wɔ w’enyim; enye hɔn ndzi wɔ w’ebufuw ber no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Kɔ kɔtɔ ɔwemfo ne dɛtse kɔɔpow bi, na fa ɔman mu mpanyimfo, na asɔfo no mu mpanyimfo no bi;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na si mu kɔ Hinom ba no bɔnsa a ɔwɔ ɔponkɛse Harsit n’ahɛnee no nkyɛn no, na bɔ nsɛm a mebɛka akyerɛ wo no dawur wɔ hɔ:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na se dɛ, Juda ahemfo na hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalɛm, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm; mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi, Hwɛ, medze mbusu mebɛba bea yi do a obiara a ɔbɛtse no, n’asomu bɛyɛ no gyengyenngyen.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Osiandɛ wɔadan me egya, na wɔayɛ bea yi ananabea, na wɔahyew eduhuam wɔ mu ama abosom afofor bi a wonnyim hɔn, hɔn na hɔn egyanom na Juda ahemfo; na wɔdze hɔn a wodzi bem hɔn bɔgyaa ahyɛ bea yi do ma;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na woesi Baal no nsorɔnsorɔmbea dɛ wɔbɛhyew hɔn mba wɔ gya mu dze abɔ ɔhyew afɔr ama Baal; dza mennhyɛɛ hɔn, eso mennkae, eso ɔmmbaa m’adwen mu:
title: JEREMIAH

text: dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔnnkɛda ho afrɛ bea yi Tofet, anaa Hinom ba no bɔnsa bio, na mbom dɛ, Ekumii Bɔnsa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛma Juda na Jerusalɛm egyinatu ayɛ kwa wɔ bea yi do; na mebɛma wɔatotɔ afona ano wɔ hɔn atamfo enyim, na hɔn a wɔrohwehwɛ hɔn nkwa no nsamu: na medze hɔn efun mebɛma ɔsor nnoma na asaase mbowa ma woeedzi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛma kurow yi ayɛ amamfo, na asesardze; obiara a obotwa mu wɔ hɔ no, no ho bɔbow no na ɔabɔ nhwiroma wɔ ne yardɔm nyinara ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛma woedzi hɔn mbabanyin nam, na hɔn mbabaa nam, na hɔn mu obiara bedzi ne nyɛnko ne nam, wɔ ntuae na ahokyer a hɔn atamfo na hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ hɔn nkwa no dze bɛkyer hɔn ho no ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔno na ebɔbɔ kɔɔpow no wɔ mbarimba a wɔnye wo rokɔ no enyim,
title: JEREMIAH

text: na ase hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Dɛmara so na mobɔbɔ ɔman yi na kurow yi, dɛ mbrɛ obi bɔ ɔwemfo ne sɛn a wonntum mma onndzi mu bio: na wobesie hɔn wɔ Tofet, ma ekodu dɛ siebea bi nnyi hɔ bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ medze bɛyɛ kurow yi na no mu atsefo nye yi, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ mebɛyɛ kurow yi dɛ Tofet:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na Jerusalɛm efiefi na Juda ahemfo efiefi a woegu ho fi no, bɛyɛ dɛ Tofet bea no, mekyerɛ adan nyinara a wɔahyehyew nduhuam wɔ n’etsifi ama ɔsor dɔm nyinara, na woehue ɔnom afɔr ama abosom afofor no so.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Jeremia fii Tofet, mbrɛ EWURADZE somaa no ma ɔkɛhyɛɛ nkɔm wɔ hɔ no, bae; na obegyinaa EWURADZE ne fie abangua no do, na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinara dɛ:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, Hwɛ, medze mbusu a maka egu kuropɔn yi ɔnye no nkurow nyinara do no, bɛba no do; osiandɛ wɔakye hɔn kɔn, dɛ worinntsie m’asɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei ɔsɔfo Immer ba Pashhur a ɔyɛ Ewuradze fie ɔsomfo otsitsir no, ɔtsee dɛ Jeremiah rehyɛ yinom ho nkɔm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Pashhur bɔɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremiah, na ɔdze no too dua mu, wɔ Benjamin ɔponkɛse a odzi sor wɔ Ewuradze fie no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyēe no, Pashhur tuu Jeremiah fii dua mu. Nna Jeremiah see no dɛ, Ewuradze mmfrɛɛ wo dzin Pashhur, na mbom Magor-missabib.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ Ewuradze se nye yi, hwɛ, mebɛma ayɛ ehudze ama wankasa woho na wo nsɛfo nyinara: Na wɔbɔtotɔ hɔn atamfo afõwa ano, na w'enyiwa bohu: Na medze Judah nyina bɛhyɛ Babylonhen nsa, na ɔbɔsoa hɔn akɔ ndɔmmum wɔ Babylon, na ɔdze afõwa ekuku hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Bio so medze kurow yi no mu ahonya nyina na n'enyadze nyina, na ne ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo nyina, mebɛma, nyew, medze Judah ahemfo akoradze nyinara mebɛhyɛ hɔn atamfo nsa, na wɔafa hɔn afo, na wɔafa, na wɔasoa akɔ Babylon.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔwo Pashhur na hɔn a wɔtse wo fie nyinara bɔkɔ ndɔmmum: Na ebɛba Babylon, na hɔ na ibowu, na hɔ na wobesia wo, ɔwo, na wo nsɛfo nyinara a ahyɛ nkɔntor akyerɛ hɔn no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ewuradze, adaadaa me, na mennhu ekyir: Wo ho yɛ dzen sen me, na edzi nyim; mayɛ asereserewdze adzekyee nyina, obiara si me atwetwe.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mekasa ara apem a metsēa mu: Metsēa mu dɛ, akakabensɛm na afofa; osiandɛ wɔama Ewuradze n'asɛm adan me ahorohoraa na atwetwesi adzekyee nyina.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ mekã dɛ, morommbɔ ne dzin, anaa merennkasa wɔ ne dzin mu bio a, nna ɔyɛ m'akoma mu dɛ ogya a ɔredzɛw a wɔatow mu wɔ me mbiew mu, na maberɛ penkyɛr, na munntum nnsɔw.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na matse nyimpa pii hɔn dzinsɛɛ kasa, hu wɔ mbea nyina. Kasa tsiatsia, na yɛbɛkasa etsia no bi; me nsɛfo a menye hɔn bɔ awɛ na wɔse, hɔn a wɔrotweɔn m'esianka bɔn no a; dɛ, egyangyanbiara wɔbɛdaadaa no, na yeedzi no do nyim, na yeedzi hɛn wer wɔ no do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Ewuradze wɔ me nkyɛn dɛ ɔkatakyi a no ho yɛ hu: Dɛm ntsi m'ahohiahiafo befintsiw, na wonnkedzi nyim; hɔn enyi bɔtõ kɛsenara, osiandɛ woenndzi enyansasɛm, mekyerɛ daa enyimguase a werɛ nnkefir ara da no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na dɔm Ewuradze, ɔwo a esɔ ɔtseneneenyi hwɛ, ihu w'awerdzi wɔ hɔn do; na ɔwo na meyi m'asɛm makyerɛ wo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom ntow ndwom mma Ewuradze, hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw; na oeyi ohianyi ne kra efi emumuyɛfo nsamu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ndom nkã da a wɔwoo me wɔ mu no: Mma nhyira nnkã da me nã woo me wɔ mu no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ndom nkã nyimpa a ɔdze amandzɛɛ brɛɛ brɛɛ m'egya, dɛ, wɔawo ɔbabanyin ama wo; ma ɔmaa n'enyi gyee pii no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔmma nyimpa no nyɛ dɛ nkurow a Ewuradze butuuw hɔn, na onnu noho no: Na wɔmma ɔntse osū anapa, na nkekamu ewiaber;
title: JEREMIAH

text: osiandɛ oennku me yafun mu; na nkyɛ me nã aadan m'adakamaa, na ne yafun aayɛ kuntuw daa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn na mifii yafun mu mifirii, dɛ murubohu ɔberɛ na awerɛhow, na me nda asã enyito mu?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a ofi EWURADZE hɔ baa Jeremia nkyɛn, ber a ɔhen Zedekia somaa Malkija ba Pasur, na ɔsɔfo Maaseia ba Zefania wɔ ne nkyɛn dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Meserɛ wo, bisa EWURADZE hɔ ma hɛn; na Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar nye hɛn ridzi ako: egyangyanbiara EWURADZE nye hɛn bedzi no dɛ mbrɛ n’anwanwa ndwuma no nyina tse, ma oeefi hɛn do afow akɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Jeremia see hɔn dɛ, Dɛm na hom nkɛka nkyerɛ Zedekia:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi, Hwɛ, mebɛdan hom nsamu akodze a hom dze nye Babilɔnhen na Kaldeafo a woebotua hom roko, wɔ afasu ekyir no, na mobɔboa hɔn ano aba kurow yi ne finimfin.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na emi mankasa medze nsa a atsen na basa a ɔyɛ dzen, mekyerɛ ebufuw, na ebufuhyew, na enyiber kɛse menye hom bɔko.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mobɔbɔ kurow yi mu atsefo, nyimpa na mbowa nyina: na ɔyardɔm kɛse bɛma woewuwu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na n’ekyir no, EWURADZE na ɔse, mibeyi Judahen Zedekia, na no nkowaa, na ɔman no, na hɔn a wɔaka kurow yi mu a woefi ɔyardɔm, na afona, na ɔkɔm mu no mahyɛ Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar nsa, na hɔn atamfo nsa, na ɔdze afona anomu ekuku hɔn; ɔrennkam hɔn do, eso ɔrenntse mma hɔn, na onnhu hɔn mbɔbɔr.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ka kyerɛ ɔman yi dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, medze nkwa no kwan na owu no kwan misi hom enyim.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nyia ɔbɛtsena kurow yi mu no, obowu afona, na ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm ano: na nyia obefir edzi na ɔakɔtɔ Kaldeafo a woetwa hom ho mu no, ɔbɛtsena ase, na no nkwa bɛyɛ afonam ama no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na medze m’enyim mesi kurow yi do wɔ mbusu ntsi, na nnyɛ papa ntsi bi a, EWURADZE na ɔse: wɔdze bɛhyɛ Babilɔnhen ne nsa, na ɔdze ogya ahyew no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Judahen ne fie ho dze, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm no:
title: JEREMIAH

text: David fifo e, mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hom mbu atsɛn anapa, na hom ngye dza wɔafa no afo no mfi ɔhyɛdofo no ne nsamu amma m’ebufuhyew eemmfir edzi dɛ ogya, na ɔaannhyew mbrɛ obi nntum nndum no, wɔ hom nyɛe no mbusu ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, menye wo enya, ɔwo a etse bɔnsa mu e, na asaase tɛtɛr mu botan do e, EWURADZE na ɔse; hom a hom ka dɛ, Woana botum esian aba hɛn do? Anaa woana na ɔbɛba hɛn tsenabea ha?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mebɛtsea hom dɛ mbrɛ hom ndzeyɛɛ no nsowee tse, EWURADZE na ɔse: na mobɔsɔ gya wɔ no kwaa mu ma ɔahyew dza ɔabɔ no ho aprɔw nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE kae nye yi: Sian kɔ Judahen fie, na kɛka asɛm yi wɔ hɔ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: na se dɛ, Tsie EWURADZE n’asɛm, Judahen a etse Juda akɔngua do, ɔwo, na wo nkowaa, na wo man a wodua aponkɛse yi mu ba mu no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hom nyɛ atsɛmbu na ndzeyɛtsenenee, na hom ngye dza wɔafa no afo no mfi ɔhyɛdofo no nsamu: na mma hom nnyɛ ɔhɔho, egyanka, anaa okunafo no bɔn, anaa wonndzi hɔn do etsiɔdzensɛm, eso mma hom nnka bɔgya a odzi bem nngu bea yi do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ hom yɛ adze yi ara ampa a, ɔno na ahemfo a wɔtsetse David akɔngua do no wobodua ofi yi n’aponkɛse no mu ahɛn mu, wɔtsenatsena ntseaseanam mu na mpɔnkɔ do, ɔno, na no nkowaa, na ne man.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ hom enntsie nsɛm yinom dze a, meka moho ntam, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ ofi yi bɛdan ofitɔw.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE ka wɔ Judahen ne fi ho nye yi: Ɔwo yɛ dɛ Gilead ma me, na Lebanon ne tsir: naaso ampaara dɛ mebɛyɛ wo sar, na nkurow a wɔnntsena do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mibesiesie asɛɛfo etsia wo, obiara dze n’akondadze: na wɔbɔtotow wo nkyindur papa no, na wɔatow egu gya mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na amanaman pii botwa mu wɔ kurow yi ho, dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na EWURADZE ayɛ kurow kɛse yi dɛm yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔno na wobobua dɛ, Osiandɛ wɔdaan EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn n’ahyɛmu no gyae, na wɔkotowee maa abosom afofor, na wɔsoom hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mma hom nnsu mma owufo no, eso mma hom nngyam no: na mbom hom nsu osu wen mma nyia ɔrokɔ no; na ɔrennsan bio, eso orunnhu asaase a wɔwoo no do no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE ka wɔ Judahen Josia ne ba Sallum a odzii hen wɔ n’egya Josia ananmu a ofii bea yi do kɔree no nye yi: Ɔrennsan nnkɔ ara bio;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na bea a wɔafa no ndɔmmum kɔ do no, hɔ ara na obowu, na orunnhu asaase yi bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ndom nka nyia ɔdze ɔbrakyew si ne dan, na ɔdze ntɛnkyew tow ne mpia; nyia ɔma ne nyɛnko yɛ edwuma kwa ma no, na ɔmmfa n’apaafobɔdze mma no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: nyia ɔka dɛ, Mibesi ofi yantamm na mpia atɛtɛr ama moho, na otwitwa no ntokura; na wɔdze nkyindur sɛw enyi, na wɔka mu edur memen.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso eyɛ ɔhen, osiandɛ ereper akyerɛ woho wɔ nkyindur mu ntsi? Ana w’egya oenndzidzi na ɔannom, na ɔannyɛ atsɛmbu na pɛrpɛr adze? Nna osii no yie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Odzii ɔbɔbɔfo na ohianyi asɛm maa no; nna osii yie. Ana nnyɛ mo ho nyimdzee nye yi bi? EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso w’enyiwa na w’akoma nnyi hɔ mma hwee, dɛ ebɛper enya mfaso bɔn, na ebɛka bɔgya a odzi bem egu, na dɛ ebɛyɛ nhyɛdo, na etsiɔdzen nko ara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se wɔ Judahen Josia ne ba Jehoiakim ho nye yi: Wonnkegyam no dɛ, Ao mo nua! Anaadɛ, Ao akyerɛbaa! Wonnkegyam no dɛ, Ao owura! Anaadɛ, Ao onyimnyamfo!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wobesie no asoaso sie, dɛ wobotwuw no adze akɔtow no akyen Jerusalɛm aponkɛse ekyir noho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Fow kɔ Lebanon, kɛtsea mu; na ma wo ndze do wɔ Bashan: na fi Abarim tsea mu; osiandɛ wɔasɛɛ w’adɔfo nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mekasaa mekyerɛɛ wo wɔ w’eyiedzi mu; naaso esee dɛ, Mirinntsie. Wo suban ara nye no ofitsi wo mbofrabermu, dɛ irinntsie me ndze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aahow bɛnyɛn wo nguanhwɛfo nyinara, na w’adɔfo bɔkɔ ndɔmmum: ɔno na w’enyi bɔto na w’enyim egu ase ara ampa wɔ w’emumuyɛ nyinara ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao ɔwo a etse Lebanon, a ayɛ wo berɛbuw wɔ nkyindur do, mbrɛ ibodua ayɛ mbɔbɔr kɛse, ber a ngyam bɛba wo do a, yaw a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo ne dze!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Metse ase yi, EWURADZE na ɔse, sɛ Judahen Jehoiakim ba Konia yɛ nsɔwano pɛtsea hyɛ me nsa nyimfa mpo a, nkyɛ mobɔhɔr wo efi hɔ;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na medze wo ahyɛ hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo nkwa, na hɔn a isuro hɔn no nsa, mekyerɛ Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar nsa, na Kaldeafo nsa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mubotu ɔwo, ɔnye wo na a ɔwoo wo makɔ asaase bi a wɔannwo hom wɔ do; na hɔ na hom bowuwu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na asaase a hɔn kra fe dɛ ɔsan ba do no dze, wɔrennsan mmba hɔ bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso barimba Konia yi yɛ senaba bobɔe a wommbu no bi? Aso ɔyɛ senaba a enyi nnsɔ no? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔatow ɔno na n’asefo akyen, woetu hɔn ekogu asaase a wonnyim hɔ do yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asaase e, asaase, asaase, tsie EWURADZE n’asɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hom nkyerɛw wɔ barimba yi ho dɛ ɔkwawee, ɔbarimba a onnkedzi yie wɔ ne nda mu: na n’asefo mu obiara a ɔbɛtsena David akɔngua do, na oedzi panyin wɔ Juda do no nnkedzi yie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ndom nka nguanhwɛfo a wɔsɛɛ m’edzidzibea do nguan na wɔbɔ hɔn petse no! EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ka dze tsia nguanhwɛfo a wɔnyɛn me man no nye yi: Hom abɔ mo nguankuw apetse, na hom apam hɔn, na hom annsera hɔn; hwɛ, medze hom ndzeyɛɛ no mbusu mebɛba abɛsera hom, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na emi mara mobɔboa mo nguankuw nkaa no ano mefi asaase nyina a mapam hɔn makɔ hɔ no do, na medze hɔn aba hɔn nguamban mu bio; na wɔawowo na wɔadɔr.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mibesisi hɔn do nguanhwɛfo a wɔbɛnyɛn hɔn; na worunnsuro bio, eso wɔrommbɔ hu, eso hɔn mu obiara rennka, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, mebɛma Odubaa tsenenee bi do mama David, na obedzi hen dɛ ɔhen a ɔyɛ enyansadze, na ɔayɛ atsɛmbu na pɛrpɛr wɔ asaase no do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ne nda no mu na wɔbɛgye Juda nkwa, na Israel atsena ase dwudwoodwo na iyi nye dzin a wɔdze bɛfrɛ no; EWURADZE hɛn tsenenee.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔrennse bio dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE a oyii Israelmba fii Egypt asaase do tse ase yi;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na mbom, dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE a okeyii Israel fi asefo fii kwaamu afamu mbew do bae no tse ase yi; na wɔbɛtsena hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na nkɔnhyɛfo no ho dze: M’akoma a ɔda mo mu ebubu, me mbiew nyinara him biribiriw; mayɛ dɛ ɔsabofo, na dɛ nyimpa a nsa etum no; wɔ EWURADZE ntsi, na ne nsɛm krɔnkrɔn ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na awartofo ayɛ asaase no ma; na mpaamba ntsi, asaase no dzi awerɛhow; sar do edzidzibea akyenkyen; na hɔn anamɔnkwan yɛ mbusu, na hɔn mbɔdzen so nntsen.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na nkɔnhyɛnyi na ɔsɔfo nyina ho ekum; nyew, me fie mpo, mehu hɔn emumuyɛ, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi hɔn kwan bɛyɛ hɔn dɛ mbea a ɔyɛ tortor wɔ sum mu: wɔbɔtwe hɔn akɔ ma wɔakɔhwehwe ase wɔ mu: na medze mbusu mebɛba hɔn do, mekyerɛ hɔn asotwe afe no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mehu nkwaseasɛm wɔ Samaria nkɔnhyɛfo no mu; wɔdze Baal hyɛɛ nkɔm na wɔmaa me man Israel fomee.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Jerusalɛm nkɔnhyɛfo no mu so, mehu dza ɔyɛ hu mbordo bi; wɔto awar, na wɔnantsew ator mu, na wɔhyɛ emumuyɛfo nsa dzen, amma obiara emmfi n’emumuyɛ mu annsan: hɔn nyinara ayɛ me dɛ Sodom, na hɔn mu hɔn a wɔtse hɔ no ayɛ dɛ Gomora.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo no ho nye yi: Medze ɔbɔwen bɛnyɛn hɔn, na mama wɔanom ewudur nsu: na ahokum fi Jerusalɛm nkɔnhyɛfo no nkyɛn akɔ asaase no nyina do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, Mma hom nntsie nkɔnhyɛfo no a wɔhyɛ hom nkɔm no hɔn nsɛm no; wɔkyerɛkyerɛ hom adze huhuw: hɔnankasa hɔn akoma enyido adzehu na wɔka, na ommfi EWURADZE anomu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔka daa kyerɛ hɔn a wommbu me bi dɛ, EWURADZE na ɔse, Hom benya asomdwee; na obiara a ɔnantsew noara n’akoma ne ntsintsiman mu no so wɔse no dɛ, Mbusu bi nnkɛba hom do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na woana na oegyina EWURADZE n’egyinamu, ama oeehu na ɔaatse n’asɛm? Woana na woetsie n’asɛm, ama wɔaapaa mu aka?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE n’ehum, mekyerɛ n’ebufuhyew no, efir edzi, nyew, ekyinehyia ehum a ɔbɔbɔ ebesi emumuyɛfo etsifi a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE n’ebufuw rennsan n’ekyir, ma ekodu dɛ obowie na ɔayɛ dza ɔahyehyɛ wɔ n’akoma mu nyina: nda a odzi ekyir no mu na hom bɛtse ase kofee.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nnyɛ emi mosomaa nkɔnhyɛfo no, naaso wotuu mbirika: emi mankasa annkyerɛ hɔn, naaso wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ wogyinaa m’egyinatu mu a, nkyɛ wɔmaa me man tsiee me nsɛm, na wɔsaan hɔn fii hɔn kwan bɔn na hɔn ndzeyɛɛ bɔn no ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso meyɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔbɛn, EWURADZE na ɔse, na nnyɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔwɔ ekyirekyir?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso obi botum ehuntsa noho wɔ huntsabea bi a emi murunnhu no? EWURADZE na ɔse. Ana mennhyɛ ɔsor na asaase ma? EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Matse dza nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛ ator nkɔm wɔ me dzin mu aka, dɛ, Maso daa, maso daa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔnkyɛr nkodu dabɛn ara na iyi bɔko nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛ ator nkɔm no akoma mu; nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn akoma mu ndaadaa nkɔm no a?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔdwen dɛ wɔbɛma me man werɛ efir me dzin wɔ hɔn adaaso a hɔn mu nyimpa biara ka kyerɛ ne nyɛnko no ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn egyanom werɛ fiir me dzin wɔ Baal ntsi no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nkɔnhyɛnyi a ɔwɔ adaaso bi, ma ɔnka n’adaaso; na nyia ɔwɔ m’asɛm, ma ɔnka m’asɛm nokwar mu. Ebɛn na ntsɛw nye ewifua wɔ yɛ? EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ana m’asɛm nntse dɛ ogya? EWURADZE na ɔse; na dɛ hamɛr a opuepue ɔbotan mu esinesin?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi hwɛ, menye nkɔnhyɛfo no enya, EWURADZE na ɔse, hɔn a wowiawia m’asɛm wɔ hɔn nsɛfo nkyɛn no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE na ɔse, menye nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔdze hɔn tɛkyerɛma ka dɛ, Ɔno na ɔse, no enya.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, menye hɔn a wɔhyɛ ator adaa ho nkɔm no enya, EWURADZE na ɔse, na wɔkeka kyerɛ, na wɔdze hɔn atorsɛm na hɔn ntuw hun ma me man wɔfom: naaso mannsoma hɔn, eso mannhyɛ hɔn; eso wɔrennyɛ mfaso bi mma ɔman yi koraa, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ ɔman yi, anaa nkɔnhyɛnyi no, anaa ɔsɔfo bi bisa wo dɛ, EWURADZE adzesoa nye bɛn a? Ɔno se hɔn dɛ, Adzesoa bɛn a? Mobɔtow hom egu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na nkɔnhyɛnyi, na ɔsɔfo, na ɔman a wɔbɛka dɛ, EWURADZE n’adzesoa no, dze, mebɛtsea nyimpa no na ne fi mpo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ hom mu obiara nka nkyerɛ ne nyɛnko, na obiara nka nkyerɛ no nua nye yi, Ebɛnadze na EWURADZE ebua? Na, ebɛn asɛm na EWURADZE aka?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na EWURADZE adzesoa no dze, mma hom mmbɔ dzin bio, na obiara noara n’asɛm bɛdan no adzesoa; osiandɛ hom esi tseasefo Nyankopɔn, dɔm EWURADZE, hɛn Nyankopɔn no ne nsɛm tsir adze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm na hom nse nkɔnhyɛnyi no, Ebɛn na EWURADZE dze ebua wo? Asɛm bɛn na EWURADZE aka?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ hom se dɛ, EWURADZE n’adzesoa a; dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Osiandɛ hom ka asɛm yi, dɛ, EWURADZE n’adzesoa, na emi na masoma wɔ hom nkyɛn, dɛ, Mma hom nnka dɛ, EWURADZE n’adzesoa;
title: JEREMIAH

text: dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, mo werɛ befir hom korakora, na matow hom na kurow a medze maa hom na hom egyanom no efi m’enyim akyen:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na medze daa ahorohoraa, na daa enyito a werɛ nnkefir da, mebɛba hom do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE dze kyerɛɛ me, na, hwɛ, adɔmba nkɛntsɛn sisi EWURADZE n’asɔrdan enyim; ofitsi ber a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar nyaa Judahen Jehoiakim ne ba Jekonia, na Juda mbapɔmba na edwimfo, na atomfo fii Jerusalɛm, na ɔdze hɔn kɔr Babilɔn ndɔmmum ekyir no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Kɛntsɛn kor mu wɔ adɔmba a oye dɛ biribi, dɛ adɔmba a oedzi kan aber: na kɛntsɛn kor no so mu wɔ adɔmba a omuo dɛ biribi a wodzi a ɔnnyɛ yie, omuo dodow.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE see me dɛ, Jeremia, ihu ebɛn? Na mesee dɛ, Adɔmba a; adɔmba papa no, oye dodow; na dza omuo no, omuo dodow ma wodzi a ɔnnyɛ, omuo koraa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa me nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi; Mbrɛ adɔmba papa yi tse no, dɛmara so na mubobu Juda ndɔmmumfo a memaa wofii bea yi do kɔr Kaldeafo asaase no do no bi, mama hɔn yie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na medze m’enyi mibesi hɔn do wɔ yie ntsi, na medze hɔn aba asaase yi do bio: na medze hɔn mibesisi hɔ, na murunndwuruw hɔn; na mebɛtsɛw hɔn, na murunntutu hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛma hɔn akoma ma wɔdze ehu me, dɛ emi nye EWURADZE: na wɔbɛyɛ me man, na mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn: na wɔdze hɔn akoma nyina bɛsan aba me nkyɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ adɔmba a omuo a wodzi a ɔnnyɛ tse no, womuo dodow; ampaara mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Dɛmara na mibeyi Judahen Jedekia, na ne mbapɔmba, na Jerusalɛm nkaa a wɔaka asaase no do, na hɔn a wɔtse Egypt asaase do mama:
title: JEREMIAH

text: mpo mibeyi hɔn mama ma wɔatow hɔn edzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do nhenman nyina mu ayɛ hɔn mbusu; ma wɔayɛ ahorohoraa na kasabɛbu, asesardze na ndom, wɔ mbeambea nyina a mebɛpam hɔn makɔ nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mobɔsoma afona, na ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm wɔ hɔn mu, ma ekesi dɛ wɔbɛsa koraa wɔ asaase a medze maa hɔn na hɔn egyanom no do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a ɔbaa Jeremia hɔ wɔ Juda man nyina ho wɔ Josia ba Jehoiakim n’afe a otsia anan no mu; ɔnoara nye Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar n’afe a odzi kan no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔno na nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia kasaa kyerɛɛ Juda man no nyina na Jerusalɛm atsefo nyinara, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ofi Ammon ba Josia, Judahen no, n’afe a otsia duebiasa no mu, dze bodu ndɛ, mfe eduonu ebiasa nye yi, na EWURADZE n’asɛm aba mo do, na makasa makyerɛ hom, morosoɛr ahema na merekasa; na mbom hom enntsie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na EWURADZE asoma no nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no nyina wɔ hom nkyɛn, ɔsoɛr ahema na ɔsoma hɔn, na hom enntsie, eso hom ammbrɛ hom aso adze,
title: JEREMIAH

text: wɔreka dɛ, Hom nsensan mfifi hom mu obiara no kwan bɔn do, na hom ndzeyɛɛ bɔn no mu, na hom ntsena asaase a EWURADZE dze ama hom na hom egyanom, ofir tsetse kesi daapem no do mpo:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na mma hom nnkedzi abosom afofor ekyir nnkɔsom hɔn, na wɔnnsɔr hɔn, na hom mmfa hom nsaano edwuma nnyi me ebufuw; na mennkɛyɛ hom bɔn bi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso hom enntsie me, EWURADZE na ɔse; ama hom dze hom nsaano edwuma eeyi me ebufuw ayɛ homara homho bɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Osiandɛ hom enntsie me nsɛm ntsi,
title: JEREMIAH

text: hwɛ, mobɔsoma ma wɔakɛfa kwaamu afamu mbusua nyina, EWURADZE na ɔse, na masoma hɔn akɛma Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar, m’akowaa no, na medze hɔn maba asaase yi, na no mu atsefo nyina do, na amanaman a wɔabɔ ho aprɔw nyina do, na masɛɛ hɔn huntuhuntu, na mama wɔadan ahobowdze, na asesardze, na daa amamfo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Bio so mibeyi ehurusi ndze na enyigye ndze, ayeforkun ndze, na ayefor ndze, ewuyambo nka, na kandzea ne kan mefi hɔn mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na asaase yi nyina bɛyɛ amamfo na ahobowdze; na amanaman yi bɔsom Babilɔnhen mfe eduosuon.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ sɛ mfe eduosuon no wie so a, mebɛtsea Babilɔnhen na ɔman no, EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi, na Kaldeafo asaase no; na mebɛyɛ no amamfo afebɔɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛma me nsɛm a maka etsia asaase no nyina aba mu, mekyerɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no buukuu yi mu no nyina a Jeremia ahyɛ ho nkɔm etsia amanaman nyina no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na amanaman pii na ahemfo akɛse dze hɔn bɔsom hɔnho, mekyerɛ hɔnara a: na mebɛhyɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ na hɔn nsaano edwuma tse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se me nye yi: Gye ebufuw yi ne nsa kɔɔpow no wɔ me nsamu, na ma amanaman nyina a morosoma wo hɔn nkyɛn no wɔnnom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔbɔnom, na wɔato ntentan, na woegyingyim, osian afona a mobɔsoma no aba hɔn mu no ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna megyee kɔɔpow no wɔ EWURADZE nsamu, na memaa amanaman a EWURADZE somaa me hɔn nkyɛn no nyina nomee:
title: JEREMIAH

text: mekyerɛ, Jerusalɛm, na Juda nkurow, na n’ahemfo, na ne mbapɔmba, na wɔaayɛ amamfo ahobowdze, asesardze, na ndom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse, ndɛ yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Egypthen Farao, na no nkowaa, na ne mbapɔmba, na ne man nyinara;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na amamforafo nyinara na Uz asaase do ahemfo nyina, na Filistiafo asaase do ahemfo nyina; na Ashkelon, na Gaza, na Ekron, na Ashdod nkaa no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: Edom, na Moab, na Ammonmba no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na Taere ahemfo nyina, na Zidon ahemfo nyina, na nsupruw a ɔwɔ po no egya no do ahemfo;
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dedan, na Tema na Buz, na hɔn a woetwitwa ntakuwa nyina;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na Arabia ahemfo nyina, na aforaforafo a wɔtse sar do no hɔn ahemfo nyina;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na Zimri ahemfo nyina na Elam ahemfo nyina, na Media ahemfo nyina;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na kwaamu afamu ahemfo nyina, hɔn a wɔbɛn na hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir, wɔnye hɔnho nkorkor, na wiadze nhenman horow a wɔwɔ asaase enyi nyina; na Sesakhen bedzi hɔn ekyir anom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hom nnom, na hom mbobow, na hom mpuw ngu, na hom nhwehwe ase, na mma hom nnsoɛr bio, wɔ afona a morosoma aba hom mu no ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ ɔba dɛ wɔpow dɛ wɔgye kɔɔpow no wɔ wo nsamu nom a, ɔnodze ka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Ɔnom ara na hom bɔnom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na, hwɛ, kurow a wɔdze me dzin ato no na mefitsi ase morobɔ no mbusu yi, na aso hom dze hom bɛfa hom ho edzi koraa? Hom remmfa hom ho nndzi: osiandɛ mebɛfrɛ afona maba asaase do atsefo nyina do: dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi hyɛ nsɛm yinom nyina ho nkɔm tsia hɔn, na se hɔn dɛ, EWURADZE befi sor bɔpɔw, na oefi no krɔnkrɔn tsenabea no do abɔ ne ndze mu; ɔbɔpɔw ɔdzendo wɔ no nguamban do; ɔbɛtseatsea mu dɛ wenyinaba wɔwfo wɔ asaase do mba nyina do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dede bi bokodu asaase ano noho mpo; na EWURADZE nye amanaman enya ɔham, ɔnye adasa nyina enya atsɛn; na emumuyɛfo dze, obeyi hɔn ama afona, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ mbusu retserɛw ba obefi ɔman do akɔ ɔman do, na ehum kɛse etu efi asaase etsiwa mu noho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na da no EWURADZE n’atɔfoe bɛdeda hɔ fi asaase ne tsir ekesi asaase ne tsir kor do: worinngyam hɔn, eso wɔrommboaboa hɔn ano, eso worinnsie hɔn; wɔbɛyɛ dɛ efikyir egugu asaase enyi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nguanhwɛfo e, hom mbɔ mbubuw na hom nkekamu ɛ; na hom nguankuw mu etsitsir, hom nyankanyankam nso mu: na hom okum nda no enya edu; na mobɔbobɔ hom posoposo, na hom abobɔ famu dɛ kuraba a ɔyɛ fɛw.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na nguanhwɛfo no nnkenya kwan eguan, eso nguankuw mu etsitsir no nnkefi nsa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Tsie nguanhwɛfo no hɔn su ne ndze bi, na nguankuw mu etsitsir mbubuwbɔ! Osiandɛ EWURADZE asɛɛ hɔn edzidzibea.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na suro ekitsa asomdwee nguamban no ɔnam EWURADZE n’ebufuhyew ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔadan ne dabew egya, dɛ ogyata: na hɔn asaase adan ahobowdze wɔ nhyɛdo afona no ne hyeehyew, na n’ebufuhyew ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Josia ba Jehoiakim, Judahen no, n’ahendzi ahyɛse no, na asɛm yi fii EWURADZE nkyɛn bae, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Kegyina EWURADZE fie abanguado, na Juda nkurow nyinara a wɔba bɔsɔr EWURADZE fie no, ka nsɛm a mehyɛ wo dɛ ka kyerɛ hɔn no nyinara kyerɛ hɔn; mma mmfa asɛm biara nnsuma ekyir.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Annyɛ a wobetsie, na hɔn mu nyimpa biara adan efi n’akwan bɔn no mu; ma meenu moho wɔ mbusu a mesua me tsirmu dɛ medze mobɔbɔ hɔn wɔ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ bɔn ntsi no ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Sɛ hom enntsie me, dɛ hom bedzi me mbra a medze esi m’enyim no do,
title: JEREMIAH

text: dɛ hom betsie mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo a mosoma hɔn hom nkyɛn a, mosoɛr ahema mpo na mosoma hɔn, na hom enntsie me nsɛm a;
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔnodze mebɛyɛ ofi yi dɛ Siloh, na mayɛ kurow yi ndom ama asaase do amanaman nyina.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na asɔfo na nkɔnhyɛfo na ɔman no nyina tsee dɛ Jeremia reka nsɛm yi wɔ EWURADZE fie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Jeremia wiee dza EWURADZE hyɛɛ no dɛ ɔnka nkyerɛ ɔman na asɔfo no, na nkɔnhyɛfo no, na ɔman no nyina suoo no mu, dɛ, Owu ara na obowu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ebɛn ntsi na edze EWURADZE dzin ahyɛ nkɔm, dɛ, Ofi yi bɛyɛ dɛ Siloh na kurow yi ayɛ ekurofo a obi nntsena do? Na ɔman no nyinara behyiaa Jeremia nkyɛn wɔ EWURADZE fie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Juda mbapɔmba tsee ndzɛmba yinom no, wofii ahemfie fowee baa EWURADZE fie ɔponkɛse fofor no ano.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna asɔfo no na nkɔnhyɛfo no kasaa kyerɛɛ mbapɔmba na ɔman no nyina, dɛ, Ɔbarimba yi sɛ owu; osiandɛ ɔahyɛ nkɔm etsia kurow yi, dɛ mbrɛ hom aso atse yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Jeremia kasaa kyerɛɛ mbapɔmba nyinara na ɔman no nyinara, dɛ, EWURADZE na ɔsomaa me dɛ membɛhyɛ asɛm a hom atse yi nyina ho nkɔm ntsia ofi yi na kurow yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi afei hom nyeyɛ hom akwan na hom nyɛe yie, na hom ntsie EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne ndze; na EWURADZE bonu noho wɔ mbusu a ɔaka etsia hom no ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na emi dze, hwɛ, mowɔ hom nsamu; hom nyɛ me dɛ mbrɛ oye na ɔtsen wɔ hom enyi do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ohu ara na hom nhu no ampa dɛ, sɛ hom ku me a, hom dze bɔgya a odzi bem bɛba homankasa, na kurow yi, na no mu atsefo nyina do: na nokwar mu ara, EWURADZE na ɔasoma me hom nkyɛn dɛ membɛka nsɛm yi nyina wɔ hom asomu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna mbapɔmba na ɔman no nyina kaa kyerɛɛ asɔfo na nkɔnhyɛfo no dɛ: Ɔbarimba yi nnsɛ wu; osiandɛ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn dzin mu na ɔakasa akyerɛ hɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na binom fi asaase no do mpanyimfo no mu soɛree na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ ɔman baguafo no, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Moresɛtnyi Mikaia hyɛɛ nkɔm wɔ Judahen Hezekia ne nda mu; na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ Judaman no nyina dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Wobofuntum Zion dɛ mfuwa, na Jerusalɛm adan ekurofo na ofi no ne bepɔw no ayɛ dɛ kwaa mu nsorɔnsorɔmbea.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso Judahen Hezekia na Judafo nyina kum no? Ana nnyɛ EWURADZE na osuroo no, na ɔdze nkotoserɛ bisaa EWURADZE n’enyimpa, na EWURADZE so nuu noho wɔ mbusu a ɔkae tsiaa hɔn no ho. Dɛm na yɛdze bɔbɔ mbusu kɛse etsia hɛnankasa hɛn akra.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbarimba bi so wɔ hɔ a ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm wɔ EWURADZE dzin mu, Semaia a ofi Kiriat-jearim no ne ba Uria; na ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm tsiaa kurow yi na asaase yi, dɛ mbrɛ Jeremia ne nsɛm nyina tse:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na ɔhen Jehoiakim, na ne mbarimba akatakyi nyinara, na mbapɔmba nyinara, wɔtsee ne nsɛm no, ɔhen no hwehwɛɛ dɛ oku no; na Uria tsee no, osuroi, na oguanee, na ɔkɔr Egypt:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na ɔhen Jehoiakim somaa mbarimba bi kɔr Egypt, mekyerɛ Akbor ne ba Elnatan, na mbarimba bi wɔka no ho kɔr Egypt:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na wɔkɛfaa Uria fii Egypt, na wɔdze no brɛɛ ɔhen Jehoiakim; ɔno na ɔdze afona kum no, na ɔtoow no fun kyeen amansuon esiei.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Safan ba Ahikam ne nsa wɔ Jeremia afa, dɛ mma wonnyi no nnhyɛ ɔman no nsa mma wonnku no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Josia ba Jehoiakim, Judahen no, n’ahendzi ahyɛse no, na asɛm yi fi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Yɛ nkyehoma na adaban ma woho, na fa hyɛ wo kɔn;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na fa mona Edomhen, na Moabhen, na Ammonmba hɔn hen, na Taerehen, na Sidonhen, wɔ abɔfo a wɔba Judahen Zedekia hɔ wɔ Jerusalɛm ne nsamu:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na hyɛ hɔn ma wɔnkɛka nkyerɛ hɔn wuranom, dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, se nye yi: Mbrɛ hom nkɛka nkyerɛ hom wuranom nye yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Emi na medze m’ahoɔdzen kɛse na me basa a atsen mayɛ asaase, nyimpa na mbowa a wɔwɔ asaase enyi nyina; na medze ma obiara dɛ mbrɛ ɔtsen wɔ m’enyi do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na afei medze asaase yi nyina mahyɛ m’akowaa Nebukadenezar, Babilɔnhen no, ne nsa; na wiramu mbowa so medze ama no dɛ wɔnsom no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na amanaman nyina bɔsom ɔno na ne ba, na ne ba ne ba, ma ekodu dɛ noara so n’asaaseber bɔso: nna nkyii amanaman pii na ahemfo akɛse dze no bɔsom hɔnho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, ɔman na ahendzi a wɔronnsom ɔno Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar, na wɔremmfa hɔn kɔn nnhyɛ Babilɔnhen no kɔndua ase no, medze afona na ɔkɔm na ɔyardɔm mebɛtsea ɔman no, ma ekodu dɛ menam ne nsa do mama wɔasa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hom dze, mma hom nntsie hom nkɔnhyɛfo, na hom mbusu nkɔnhyɛfo, na hom abayifo a wɔkasa kyerɛ hom, dɛ, Hom ronnsom Babilɔnhen no:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na nkɔntor na wɔhyɛ hom, ama woeeyi hom efi hom asaase do akɔ ekyirekyir, na maapam hom na hom aahera.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔman a wɔdze hɔn kɔn bɛhyɛ Babilɔnhen kɔndua ase, na wɔasom no no, ɔman no na mebɛma wɔaka hɔnankasa asaase do, EWURADZE na ɔse; na wɔadɔw do, na wɔatsena do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mekasaa kyerɛɛ Judahen Zedekia dɛ, Mbrɛ nsɛm yi nyina tse, dɛ, Hom mfa hom kɔn nhyɛ Babilɔnhen no kɔndua no ase, na hom nsom ɔno na ne man, na hom atsena ase.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ebɛn ntsi na hom bowu, ɔwo na wo man, wɔ afona, ɔkɔm na ɔyardɔm ano, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE aka wɔ ɔman a wɔronnsom Babilɔnhen ho no?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mma hom nntsie nsɛm a nkɔnhyɛfo no ka kyerɛ hom, dɛ, Hom ronnsom Babilɔnhen no: na nkɔntor na wɔhyɛ hom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na nnyɛ emi na masoma hɔn, EWURADZE na ɔse, na wɔdze me dzin hyɛ ator nkɔm; ama maapam hom, na hom aahera, hom na nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛ hom nkɔm no nyina.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Eso mekaa mekyerɛɛ asɔfo no, na ɔman yi nyina, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Mma hom nntsie nsɛm a hom nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛ hom nkɔm no ka dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔrennkyɛr na wɔdze EWURADZE fie nkɔɔpow no efi Babilɔn asan aba no: na nkɔntor na wɔhyɛ hom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mma hom nntsie hɔn; hom nsom Babilɔnhen, na hom ntsena ase: ebɛn ntsi na kurow yi ndan amamfo?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ wɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛfo, na EWURADZE asɛm wɔ hɔn nkyɛn a, ma wɔnkotow nserɛ dɔm EWURADZE, dɛ mma nkɔɔpow no a aka EWURADZE fie, na Judahen ne fie, na Jerusalɛm no, aannkɔ Babilɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se wɔ edum no na po no na afɔrmbukyia no na nkɔɔpow nkaa a woegya no kurow yi mu ho nye yi,
title: JEREMIAH

text: dza Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar ammfa annkɔ ber a ɔsoaa Jehoiakim ba Jekonia, Judahen no, na Juda na Jerusalɛm mbapɔmba kɔr Babilɔn no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: nyew, mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se wɔ nkɔɔpow a aka EWURADZE fie, na Judahen fie, na Jerusalɛm ho nye yi;
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔbɔsoa akɔ Babilɔn, na hɔ na ɔbɛtsena ekodu da a mebɛkɛsera no, EWURADZE na ɔse, ɔno na medze no bɛsan aba bea yi do bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa afe no ara mu, Judahen Zedekia n’ahendzi ahyɛse, afe a otsia anan no, bosoom a otsia enum no mu, dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi Azzur ba Hanania a ofi Gibeon no, ɔsee me wɔ EWURADZE fie, wɔ asɔfo no na ɔman no nyina enyim, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn ka nye dɛ, Mebubu Babilɔnhen no kɔndua no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mfe ebien mu ara pɛr na medze EWURADZE fie nkɔɔpow a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar bɛfae fii bea yi do kɔr Babilɔn no nyinara bɛsan aba bea yi do bio:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na medze Jehoiakim ba, Jekonia, Judahen no, na Juda ndɔmmumfo a wɔkɔr Babilɔn no nyina mebɛsan aba bea yi do bio, EWURADZE na ɔse: na mubobubu Babilɔnhen no kɔndua no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia see nkɔnhyɛnyi Hanania wɔ asɔfo no enyim, na ɔman a wogyinagyina EWURADZE fie no nyina enyim,
title: JEREMIAH

text: mekyerɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia see dɛ, Amen: EWURADZE nyɛ sa: EWURADZE mma wo nsɛm a ahyɛ nkɔm aka dɛ wɔdze EWURADZE fie nkɔɔpow, na ndɔmmumfo no nyina befi Babilɔn asan aba bea yi do mbra mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso afei tsie asɛm yi a mereka wɔ w’asomu, na ɔman yi nyina asomu yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzi m’enyim na w’enyim fi tsetse no, wɔhyehyɛɛ asaase pii, na ahendzi akɛse, akodzi, na mbusu, na ɔyardɔm ho nkɔm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nkɔnhyɛnyi a ɔhyɛ asomdwee ho nkɔm no, sɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi no n’asɛm no ba mu a, nna wɔdze hu nkɔnhyɛnyi a EWURADZE asoma no nokwar mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi Hanania yii ɔdaban no fii nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia no kɔn mu, na obubuu mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Hanania kae wɔ ɔman no nyina enyim, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Dɛmara na mubobubu Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar no kɔndua no mefi amanaman nyina hɔn mu mfe ebien ara pɛr mu. Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia kɔr no kwan.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Hanania bubuu ɔdaban no fii nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia kɔn mu no ekyir no, nna EWURADZE asɛm baa Jeremia nkyɛn, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Kɔ, kɛse Hanania, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Ebubu dua adaban no; na ebɛyɛ dadze adaban ahyɛ ananmu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, se nye yi: Medze dadze kɔndua mato amanaman yi nyina kɔn mu, dɛ wɔnsom Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar: na wɔbɔsom no: na medze wiramu mbowa so mama no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia see nkɔnhyɛnyi Hanania dɛ, Hanania, afei tsie; EWURADZE annsoma wo; na ɔwo ema ɔman yi dze hɔnho twer atorsɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, mubotu wo efi asaase enyi: afe yi ibowu, osiandɛ aka etuatsewsɛm etsia EWURADZE.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛmara na nkɔnhyɛnyi Hanania wuu afe no ara mu bosoom a otsia esuon no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na iyinom nye nsɛm a ɔwɔ nwoma a nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia fi Jerusalɛm dze monaa ndɔmmumfo no mu mpanyimfo no nkaa no, na asɔfo no, na nkɔnhyɛfo no, na nkorɔfo nyinara a Nebukadenezar soaa hɔn fii Jerusalɛm kɔr Babilɔn ndɔmmum no:
title: JEREMIAH

text: (ber a ɔhen Jekonia, na ɔhen ne na, na epiafo no, na Juda na Jerusalɛm mbapɔmba no, na edwimfo no, na atomfo no fii Jerusalɛm kɔree no:)
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔdze nam Safan ba Elasa na Hilkia ba Gemaria (a Judahen Zedekia somaa no kɔr Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar hɔ wɔ Babilɔn no,) ne nsa do, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se ndɔmmumfo nyina a mama wɔasoa hɔn akɔ Babilɔn ndɔmmum no nye yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: hom nsisi adan ntsenatsena mu; na hom ntsetsɛw nture, na hom ndzi hɔn mu aba;
title: JEREMIAH

text: hom nwarwar, na hom nwowo mbabanyin na mbabaa; na hom ngyegye yernom mma hom mbabanyin, na hom mfa hom mbabaa mma kunnom na wɔnwowo mbabanyin na mbabaa; na hom ndɔr wɔ hɔ, na hom ho eennsuar.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hom nhwehwɛ kurow a mama wɔasoa hom akɔ hɔ ndɔmmum no n’amandwee, na hom nyi EWURADZE mpaa mma no: na n’amandwee mu na hom benya asomdwee.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Mma hom mma nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔwɔ hom mu no, na adzehufo no ndaadaa hom, eso mma hom nntsie adaaso a hom ma wɔso no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ator mu na wɔdze me dzin hyɛ hom nkɔm: monnsoma hɔn, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Mfe eduosuon nya du ma Babilɔn a mebɛserɛ hom, na mama m’asɛmpa aba mu ama hom, dɛ mebɛma hom asan aba ha bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na minyim adwen a modwen wɔ hom ho, EWURADZE na ɔse, asomdwee adwen a, na nnyɛ mbusu adwen bi a, dɛ mebɛma hom enyidado wɔ hom ewiei.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hom bɛfrɛ me, na hom akɔ na hom eyi mpaa ama me, na metsie hom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hom bɔhwehwɛ me, na hom ehu me, ber a hom dze hom akoma nyina bɔhwehwɛ m’ekyir kwan no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛma hom ehu me, EWURADZE na ɔse, na medze hom ndɔmmum masan maba, na maboa hom ano efi amanaman nyina mu, na mbea nyina a mapam hom makɔ hɔ no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse; na medze hom aba mbea a memaa wɔsoaa hom fir kɔr ndɔmmum no bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hom aka dɛ, EWURADZE ama nkɔnhyɛfo no do ama hɛn wɔ Babilɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE ka wɔ ɔhen a ɔtse David akɔngua do, na ɔman no nyina a wɔtse kurow yi mu, hom nuanom a wɔnnye hom ronnkɔ ndɔmmum ho nye yi;
title: JEREMIAH

text: mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, mebɛma afona, ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm aba hɔn do, na mayɛ hɔn dɛ adɔmba prɔwee a, muo a omuo dodow ntsi, wodzi a ɔnnyɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na medze afona, ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm betsiw hɔn, na meyi hɔn ama ma wɔatow hɔn edzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do nhenman nyina mu, na mayɛ ekyiwadze na ahobowdze, na asesardze, na ahorohoraadze wɔ amanaman nyina a mapam hɔn makɔ hɔ nyina mu:
title: JEREMIAH

text: osiandɛ woenntsie me nsɛm a, EWURADZE na ɔse, medze mosomaa mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no baa hɔn nkyɛn, mosoɛɛr ahema na mosomaa hɔn; na hom enntsie, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ndɔmmumfo a mama hom efi Jerusalɛm akɔ Babilɔn nyinara, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se wɔ Kolaia ba Ahab, na Maaseia ba Zedekia a wɔdze me dzin hyɛɛ nkɔntor ho nye yi: Hwɛ, mibeyi hɔn ahyɛ Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar nsa; na woeku hɔn wɔ hom enyim;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na hɔn na wɔdze hɔn bɛyɛ ndom wɔ Juda ndɔmmumfo a wɔwɔ Babilɔn nyina anomu, dɛ, EWURADZE nyɛ wo dɛ Zedekia na Ahab a Babilɔnhen hoow hɔn wɔ ogya mu no:
title: JEREMIAH

text: osiandɛ woedzi nkwaseasɛm wɔ Israel, na wɔafefa hɔn nsɛfo yernom, na wɔdze me dzin aka atorsɛm a nnyɛ emi na mehyɛɛ hɔn; na emi na minyim, na emi nye ɔdasefo, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ka wɔ Nehelamnyi Semaia ho, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi; dɛ, Osiandɛ amona nwoma wɔ wankasa wo dzin mu akɛma ɔman a wɔwɔ Jerusalɛm nyina, na ɔsɔfo Zefania Maaseia ba no, na asɔfo no nyinara, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE ahyɛ wo ɔsɔfo wɔ ɔsɔfo Jehoiada ananmu, dɛ hom nyɛ asomfo wɔ EWURADZE fie mma nyimpa biara a ɔabɔ dam, na ɔyɛ noho nkɔnhyɛnyi, na edze no ato dua mu na mpokyerɛ mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na afei, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na enntwuw Anathotnyi Jeremia a ɔyɛ noho hom nkɔnhyɛnyi no n’enyim,
title: JEREMIAH

text: susuampa dɛ ɔasoma aba hɛn nkyɛn wɔ Babilɔn dɛ, Ndɔmmum no akyɛr: hom nsisi adan, na hom ntsena mu; na hom ntsetsɛw nture, na hom ndzi mu aba?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔsɔfo Zefania kenkaan nwoma yi wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia asomu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Soma ma wɔnkɔ ndɔmmumfo no nyina hɔ, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se wɔ Nehelamnyi Semaia ho nye yi: Osiandɛ Semaia ahyɛ hom nkɔm, na mannsoma no, na ɔama hom atwer atorsɛm ntsi;
title: JEREMIAH

text: dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, mebɛtsea Nehelamnyi Semaia na n’asefo; orinnya barimba biara ma ɔnntsena ɔman yi mu, eso orunnhu yie a medze mebɛyɛ ɔman yi, EWURADZE na ɔse: osiandɛ ɔaka etuatsewsɛm etsia EWURADZE.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a ofi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi, dɛ, Kyerɛw nsɛm a maka makyerɛ wo nyina wɔ nwoma mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na, hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, medze me man Israel na Juda ndɔmmumfo bɛsan aba, EWURADZE na ɔse: na mama wɔasan asaase a medze memaa hɔn egyanom no do, na woenya edzi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na yinom nye nsɛm a EWURADZE kae wɔ Israel ho na Juda ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Yɛatse ahopopo ndze, na suro nka, na nnyɛ asomdwee dze bi a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei hom mbisa na hom nhu kyerɛ dɛ ɔbarimba botum awo ba anaa: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na muhu ɔbarimba biara dɛ ne nsa dze ne sisiw mu dɛ ɔbaa a awoo aka no yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na enyim nyinara atotow fitaa yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Due! Na da no yɛ hu dodow a biara nntse dɛ ɔno: Jakob no fona ber a; naaso wɔbɛgye no nkwa efi mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no mu no, Dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, mubobubu no kɔndua efi wo kɔn ho, na matsetsew wo nkyehoma no mu; na ananaben nnkedzi no nya bio:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na wɔbɔsom EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn, na hɔn hen David a mebɛma no do ama hɔn no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi m’akowaa Jakob, mma nnsuro, EWURADZE na ɔse; eso, Israel, mma wo bo nntu: na, hwɛ, mebɛgye wo nkwa mefi ekyirekyir na w’asefo mefi hɔn ndɔmmumfafo asaase do; na Jakob bɛsan aba, ebenya asomdwee na ahotɔ, na obiara rinnyi no hu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na menye wo nam, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ mebɛgye wo nkwa: na mebɛma amanaman a mabɔ wo apetse hɔ nyina asa koraa, na ɔwoara dze, meremma ennsa koraa; na mbom medze atsɛmbu mebɛtsea wo, na meremma emmfa woho tɔtrɔtɔ ara da.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Wo pira nnyi edur, na wo pirakur adzen wo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Obi nnyi hɔ a odzi w’asɛm ma wo ayarsadur biara innyi hɔ ma w’epirakur, na ayarsa biara innyi hɔ ma wo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: W’adɔfo nyinara werɛ efir wo; wɔnnhwehwɛ wo: osiandɛ medze ɔtamfo epirakur mepira wo, medze otsiɔdzennyi ntsea matsea wo; wɔ w’emumuyɛ ne kɛse ntsi, osiandɛ wo bɔn adɔɔ so pii.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na erekeka mu wɔ wo pira ntsi? Wo kur nnyi edur: wɔ w’emumuyɛ ne kɛse ntsi, osiandɛ wo bɔn adɔɔ so ntsi na medze ndzɛmba yinom ayɛ wo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi hɔn a wɔmemen wo nyina wɔbɛmen hɔn; na w’atamfo no nyinara mu obiara bɔkɔ ndɔmmum; na hɔn a wɔsoɛr wo no wɔbɔsoɛr hɔn do; na hɔn a wɔfa wo afo nyinara wɔbɛfa hɔn afo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛma wo apɔwmudzen bio, na masa w’epirakur, EWURADZE na ɔse; osiandɛ wɔafrɛ wo nyia woeyi no tokyen, dɛ, Zion a obi nnhwehwɛ n’ekyir kwan a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, medze Jakob ntamadan mu ndɔmmum mebɛsan aba bio, na menya ayamuhyehye wɔ ne tsenabea ho; na wɔbɛkyekyer kurow no wɔ ne ndamfo no ara do, na ahemfi no besi hɔ dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse no ara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ndaase na hɔn a hɔn enyi agye ndze befir edzi wɔ mu: na mebɛma wɔadɔr, na worunnsuar; mebɛhyɛ hɔn enyimnyam so, na wonnkobu hɔn enyimtsia.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hɔn mba so bɛyɛ dɛ asɔpɔn no, na hɔn mboanofo betsim wɔ m’enyim, na mebɛtsea hɔn a wɔhaw hɔn no nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hɔn hen bɛyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn bi, na hɔn hwɛdofo efir hɔn mu; na mebɛma wɔatwe epin me, na wɔbɛbɛn me nkyɛn: na woana nye nyia woesi no bo dɛ ɔbɛbɛn me? EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hom bɛyɛ me man, na emi mayɛ hom Nyankopɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE n’ehum, mekyerɛ n’ebufuhyew no, etu, ekyinehyia ehum a: obotu abɔ emumuyɛfo etsifi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE n’ebufuw hyeehyew no rennsan, gyedɛ oewie yɛ, na ɔama n’akoma mu esusudze aba mu ansaana. Nda a odzi ekyir no mu na hom bɛtse ase.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aber no mu no, EWURADZE na ɔse, mebɛyɛ Israel mbusuakuw no nyina hɔn Nyankopɔn, na hɔn so wɔayɛ me man.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Ɔman a afona daan hɔn gyae no, enya adom wɔ sar no do; mekyerɛ Israel, ber a memaa onyaa ahomgye no a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE yii noho kyerɛɛ me tsetse, dɛ, Ampaara, madɔ wo ɔdomankoma dɔ: dɛm ntsi na medze adɔyɛ atwe wo no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mibesi wo bio, na esi hɔ, Ao Israel ɔbaabun: edze wo mpintsin bɛgyegye w’enyi bio, na epue wɔ agofo asaw mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ebɛtsetsɛw wenyin nture wɔ Samaria mbepɔw do bio: atsetsɛwfo bɛtsetsɛw, na woedzi n’aba bi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na da bi bɛba a aweɔmfo bɛtsea mu wɔ Efraim mbepɔw do, dɛ, Hom nsoɛr ma yɛmfow nkɔ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn wɔ Zion.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hom mfa enyigye ntow ndwom wɔ Jakob ho, na hom mbɔ amanaman etsitsir ho ose: hom mfa ntahye, hom nyi ayɛw, na hom nse dɛ, EWURADZE, gye wo man, Israel nkaa no nkwa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, medze hɔn fi kwaamu afamu asaase do mebɛba, na makɔboa hɔn ano efi asaase ano noho, na enyifurafo na mpakye, ɔpemfo na ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo nyina ka ho bi: okuw kukuankoma na wɔbɛsan aba ha.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔdze osu bɛba, na nkotoserɛ na medze bɛgye hom nkwa: mebɛma wɔanantsew esutsen ho, wɔ ɔkwan tsenee mu a worimmfintsiw: na meyɛ egya ma Israel, na Efraim nye m’abakan.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Amanaman, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm, na hom nka wɔ esupruw a ɔwɔ ekyirekyir no mu; dɛ, Nyia ɔbɔɔ Israel petsee no, ɔbɔboaboa n’ano, na wɔahwɛ no do, dɛ mbrɛ oguanhwɛfo hwɛ no nguankuw do no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na EWURADZE agye Jakob, na ɔapon no efi nyia ɔkyɛn no ahoɔdzen no nsamu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔbɛba abɔtow ndwom wɔ Zion sorɔnsorɔmbea, na wɔapem akɔ EWURADZE ne yieyɛ ho, eburow, na nsa, na ngo, na hɔn nguan na anantwimba ho: na hɔn kra bɛyɛ dɛ ture a woegugu mu nsu; na worinndzi awerɛhow bio koraa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna nkataasia enyi bɛgye asaw mu, na mberantsɛ na nkɔdaa nyinara abɔ mu enyi agye: na mebɛdan hɔn nkɔmbɔdzi ahosɛpɛw, na makyekye hɔn werɛ na mama woefi hɔn awerɛhow mu edzi ehurusi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛma angoanam amee asɔfo hɔn kra, na me yieyɛ amee me man, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Wɔtse ndze bi nka wɔ Rama, osukwadwom, na osu wenwen, Rakel rusu ne mba; na ɔmmpen dɛ wɔbɛkyekye no werɛ wɔ ne mba ntsi; osiandɛ wonnyi hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Sianka wo ndze wɔ osu ho, na w’enyiwa wɔ nyinsuwa ho: na w’edwuma ho akatua wɔ hɔ, EWURADZE na ɔse: na wobefi ɔtamfo no asaase do aba bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na enyidado wɔ hɔ ma w’ewiei, EWURADZE na ɔse; na wo mba bɛsan aba hɔnankasa hɔn aman do bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nyew, matse Efraim no nkɔmbɔdzi dɛ, Ɔwo atsea me na magye ntsea no, meyɛɛ dɛ ɔnantwiba a ɔnnweaa kɔndua ho. Fa me san bra, ma mensan mbra; na ɔwo nye EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ampaara me nsankyir ekyir no, munuu moho; na wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ me no, mutwaa m’aserɛ ho: m’enyi toe, nyew, m’enyim guu ase mpo, osiandɛ mosoaa me mberantsɛber mu enyimguase.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aso Efraim yɛ me dɔba? Aso ɔyɛ ɔba a m’enyi gye no ho? Mpɛn dodow ara a mekasa tsia no no, nkaa ara na meda ho mekaa no: dɛm ntsi mo nson mu burbur me wɔ no ho; mubohu no mbɔbɔr ampaara, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Sisi ɔkwanmu nsewhyɛdze ma woho, sisi ɔkwankyerɛ edum ma woho: fa w’akoma si tsempɔn no no do, ɔkwan a efaa mu no a. San bra, Israel ɔbaabun, san bra wo nkurow yi mu bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔwo ekyirsannyi babaa, ibedzi akɔnaaba ekodu dabɛn ara? Na EWURADZE abɔ adze fofor wɔ asaase do, Ɔbaa botwitwa agye barimba.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, se nye yi: Wɔbɛda ho aka asɛm yi bio wɔ Juda asaase do na no nkurow mu, ber a medze hɔn efi ndɔmmum asan aba no dɛ: Ao Pɛrpɛr tsenabea, krɔnkrɔnyɛ bepɔw, EWURADZE nhyira wo!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Juda na no nkurow nyinara bɔbɔ mu atsena mu; ekuafo, na hɔn a wɔnye mbowakuw kyinkyin.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mama ɔkra a ɔaberɛ amee, na ɔkra werɛhofo biara mahyɛ no ma bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Iyi do na minyanee, na mohwɛe; na me nda tɔɔ me dɛw mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, medze ɔdasanyi n’asefo, na abowa n’asefo mubodua Israel fi na Juda fi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ m’enyi asa hɔn do dɛ mubotutu na mebubu, na mebutuw na masɛɛ, na mehiahia ho no; dɛmara so na m’enyi bɔko hɔn ho dɛ mibesi na matsɛw, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nda no mu no wɔnnkɛka bio dɛ, Egyanom atwɛr ebuntwirede yerɛyerɛw, na mba hɔn se afemfem.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbom obiara bowu wɔ nankasa n’emumuyɛ ntsi: nyimpa biara a obedzi ebuntwirede yerɛyerɛw no, ɔnoara ne se na ɔbɛfem.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, menye Israel fi na Juda fi bedzi ahyɛmu fofor:
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔnntse dɛ ahyɛmu a menye hɔn egyanom dzii wɔ da a musuoo hɔn nsamu no, miyii hɔn Egypt asaase do no; m’ahyɛmu a wɔtoe, naaso na emi dze meda ho meyɛ hɔn kun no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na iyi nye ahyɛmu a menye Israel fi bedzi wɔ nda no ekyir, EWURADZE na ɔse; medze me mbra bɛhyɛ hɔn mu, na hɔn akoma mu na mebɛkyerɛw mu; na emi mebɛyɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn, na hɔn so wɔayɛ me man:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na obiara nnkɛkyerɛ ne nyɛnko, na obiara nnkɛkyerɛ no nua bio dɛ, Hu EWURADZE: na hɔn nyinara wobohu no, ofi hɔn mu aketseaba do kesi hɔn mu kɛse do, EWURADZE na ɔse: na medze hɔn emumuyɛ mebɛkyɛ hɔn, na hɔn bɔn so merennkaa bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE a ɔma ewia hyerɛn adzekyee, na ɔhyehyɛ bosoom na nworaba ma wɔhyerɛn anadwe, onunu po mu ma n’asorɛkye hur, a ne dzin dze dɔm EWURADZE no, ɔse nye yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Sɛ ahyehyɛdze yinom fi m’enyim fir a, EWURADZE na ɔse, ɔnodze na Israel asefo so begyaa dɛ wɔyɛ ɔman wɔ m’enyim daa nyina.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Sɛ wotum susu ɔsor wimu, na wɔbɔr hwehwɛ asaase ne fapem wɔ n’ase noho a, ɔnodze na mo so mobɔtow Israel asefo akyen wɔ dza wɔayɛ nyina ntsi, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔbɛkyekyer kurow no ama EWURADZE, efi Hananel abantsentsen ho ekodu nkyɛnmu ɔponkɛse no ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na susuhoma no befi hɔ ara nam tsentsendo ekodu Gareb koko ho, na oebu adan ekesi Goa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na efun na nso bɔnsa no nyina, na mfuwa nyina a okodu ɔwora Kidron ho, dze kodu pɔnkɔ ɔponkɛse no nkyɛn no wɔ boka afamu, wɔbɛyɛ krɔnkrɔn ama EWURADZE; worunntutu, eso worunndwuruw nngu famu dabiarada.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a ofi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ wɔ Judahen Zedekia n’afe a otsia du no a, ɔyɛ Nebukadenezar n’afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Aber no na nkyii Babilɔnhen no dɔm kotuaa Jerusalɛm: na wɔdze nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia too efiadze wɔ ɔweɔmfo bagua no a ɔwɔ Judahen ne fie no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Judahen Zedekia dze no too efiadze, dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ehyɛ nkɔm, na eka dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, medze kurow yi mebɛhyɛ Babilɔnhen nsa, ma ɔagye;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na Judahen Zedekia rimmfi Kaldeafo nsa, na oyi ara na wobeyi no ahyɛ Babilɔnhen nsa, na ɔnye no akasa ano na ano, na n’enyi ehu n’enyi;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na obegya Zedekia akɔ Babilɔn, na hɔ na ɔbɛtsena ekodu dɛ mebɛsera no, EWURADZE na ɔse: kaansa hom nye Kaldeafo ko mpo a, orunnwie hom yie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Jeremia see dɛ, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, wo wɔfa Sallum ne ba Hanamel bɛba wo nkyɛn, dɛ, Tɔ mo mfuwa a ɔwɔ Anathot no; na ɔwo na no pon ho kwan dzi wɔ wo dɛ ebɔtɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna mo wɔfa ba Hanamel baa me nkyɛn wɔ aweɔmfo abangua no do, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE n’asɛm tse no na ɔsee me dɛ, Meserɛ wo, tɔ mo mfuwa a ɔwɔ Anathot a ɔwɔ Benjamin asaase do no: na ɔwo na adze no ne dzi yɛ wodze, na no pon dzi wɔ wo; tɔ ma woho. Nna muhun dɛ EWURADZE asɛm no nye no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na motɔɔ asaase a ɔwɔ Anathot no wɔ mo wɔfa ba Hanamel hɔ, na mikeer dwɛɛtɛɛ no memaa no, mekyerɛ dwetɛ dwetɛbona duesuon.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mekyerɛɛw no wɔ nwoma mu, na mosɔɔw ano, na mefrɛɛ adasefo, na mikeer dwɛɛtɛɛ no wɔ nsɛn mu memaa no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna mefaa ɔtɔ nwoma no, dza wɔsɔɔw ano, dɛ mbrɛ mbra na atɔrmuadze se no, na dza n’ano da hɔ no nyina:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na medze ɔtɔ nwoma no mehyɛɛ Maseia ba Neria ne ba Baruk nsa, wɔ no wɔfa ba Hanamel n’enyim, na adasefo a wɔdze hɔn nsa hyɛɛ ɔtɔ nwoma no ase wɔ Juda a wɔtsetse ɔweɔmfo abanguado hɔ nyina enyim no enyim.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mehyɛɛ Baruk wɔ hɔn enyim, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Fa nwoma iyinom, ɔtɔ nwoma yi, dza wɔasɔw ano, na nwoma yi a n’ano da hɔ nyinara, na fa hyɛ dɛtsesɛn bi mu; na ɔaakyɛr nda pii.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi: Wɔbɛda ho atotɔ adan, na mfuwa, na wenyin nture wɔ asaase yi do bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei medze ɔtɔ nwoma no maa Neria ba Baruk n’ekyir no, miyii mpaa maa EWURADZE, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao EWURADZE Nyankopɔn! Hwɛ, ɔwo na edze wo tum kɛse na wo basa a atsen yɛɛ ɔsor na asaase; biribiara nnyɛ wo yɛ na:
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔwo a ekyerɛ mbɔbɔrhu ma mpempem, na itua egyanom hɔn emumuyɛ kaw gu hɔn mba a wodzi hɔn ekyir hɔn bo mu: ne dzin dze ɔkɛse, Onyankopɔn katakyi, dɔm EWURADZE:
title: JEREMIAH

text: apam mu ɔkɛse, ndwuma mu ɔkatakyi: ɔwo w’enyiwa bue wɔ adasamba akwan nyina do; dɛ edze bɛma obiara dɛ mbrɛ n’akwan tse, na dɛ mbrɛ ne ndzeyɛɛ aba tse:
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔwo emaa nsɛnkyerɛdze na anwanwadze sii Egypt asaase do, dze bodu ndɛ da yi mpo, wɔ Israel na amanaman nyina mu; na edze gyee dzin maa woho, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na edze nsɛnkyerɛdze na anwanwadze, na nsa a ɔyɛ dzen, na basa a atsen, na ehudze kɛse, yii wo man Israel fii Egypt asaase do;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na emaa hɔn asaase yi a ekaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn egyanom dɛ edze bɛma hɔn no, asaase a ɔpem numfonsu na ewo;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na wɔbae bɛfae dzii, na woenntsie wo ndze, eso wɔannantsew wo mbra do; wɔannyɛ dza ehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnyɛ no nyinara mu biara: dɛm ntsi na ama mbusu yi nyina aba hɔn do yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: hwɛ, mpempe no wɔaba kurow no ho dɛ wɔrebɛgye; na wɔdze kurow no ahyɛ Kaldeafo a wɔnye no roko nsa, na afona, na ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm no ntsi na dza ekae no aba mu; na hwɛ w’enyi tua.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔwo, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, esee me dɛ, Fa dwɛɛtɛɛ tɔ mfuwa no, na frɛ ho adasefo; na eso na kurow no wɔdze ahyɛ Kaldeafo nsa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, emi nye EWURADZE, adasa nyinara Nyankopɔn: aso biribiara wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛ dzen ma me?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, medze kurow yi bɛhyɛ Kaldeafo nsa, na Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar nsa, ma ɔagye:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na Kaldeafo a wɔnye kurow yi roko no, wɔbɛba abɔto kurow yi mu ogya, na wɔahyew no, ɔnye efiefi a wɔahyehyew n’etsifi nduhuam ama Baal, na woehue ɔnom afɔr ama abosom afofor, dɛ wɔdze riyi me ebufuw no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Israelmba na Judamba wɔayɛ dza ɔyɛ mbusu ara wɔ m’enyim ofir hɔn mbofraber mu: na Israelmba wɔdze hɔn nsaano edwuma eyi me ebufuw ara, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na kurow yi eyi me ebufuw na ebufuhyew ara ofi da a wɔkyekyeree dze bodu ndɛ da yi mpo; ma meeyi no efi m’enyi do:
title: JEREMIAH

text: wɔ Israelmba na Judamba hɔn mbusu nyinara a wɔabɔ dze eyi me ebufuw no ntsi hɔn, hɔn ahemfo, hɔn mbapɔmba hɔn asɔfoe, na hɔn nkɔnhyɛfo, na Juda mbarimba, na Jerusalɛm atsefo
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔadandan hɔn ekyir ama me, na nnyɛ hɔn enyim a: na kaansa makyerɛkyerɛ hɔn, mosoɛr ahema na mekyerɛkyerɛ hɔn mpo a, woenntsie dɛ wɔbɛgye nkyerɛkyerɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔdze hɔn ekyiwadze sisii ofi a wɔdze me dzin ato no no mu, dɛ wongu ho fi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wosisii Baal no nsorɔnsorɔmbea a ɔwɔ Hinom bɔnsa no mu, dɛ wɔremma hɔn mbabanyin na hɔn mbabaa edua ogya mu ama Molek a nnyɛ emi na mehyɛɛ hɔn no mu, eso wɔammba m’adwen mu, dɛ wɔyɛ dɛm ekyiwadze yi; ma Juda aayɛ bɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na afei dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, se wɔ kurow yi a hom ka wɔ ho dɛ, Wɔdze ahyɛ Babilɔnhen ne nsa, wɔ afona, na ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm mu no ho nye yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: hwɛ, emi mara mobɔboa hɔn ano mefi asaase nyina a mapam hɔn makɔ do wɔ m’ebufuw, na m’ebufuhyew, na m’enyiber kɛse mu no; na medze hɔn bɛsan aba bea yi do bio, na mama wɔatsena dwudwoodwo:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na wɔbɛyɛ me man, na emi so mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na mebɛma hɔn akoma kor na ɔkwan kor, ama woeesuro me afebɔɔ; wɔ hɔnara na hɔn mba a wobedzi hɔn ekyir hɔn yie ntsi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na mirinngyaa hɔn ekyir dzi, dɛ mebɛyɛ hɔn yie; na medze mo suro bɛhyɛ hɔn akoma mu, mma woeemmfi me nkyɛn annkɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ampaara, m’enyi bɛgye hɔn ho dɛ mebɛyɛ hɔn yie, na medze m’akoma nyina na me kra nyina matsɛw hɔn asaase yi do nokwar mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Dɛ mbrɛ medze mbusu kɛse yi nyinara maba ɔman yi do no, dɛmara so na medze yie a mabɔ hɔn ho anohoba nyina mebɛba hɔn do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔbɔtotɔ mfuwa wɔ asaase yi a hom ka wɔ ho dɛ, Ɔyɛ amamfo, nyimpa anaa abowa nnyi do; wɔdze ahyɛ Kaldeafo nsa no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nkorɔfo dze sika bɔtotɔ mfuwa, na wɔdze hɔn nsa ahyehyɛ nwoma ase na wɔasosɔw ano, na wɔafrɛfrɛ adasefo, wɔ Benjamin asaase do, na mbeambea a etwa Jerusalɛm ho ehyia, na Juda nkurow mu, na koko do nkurow mu, na ɔbɔnmu nkurow mu, na Pomu afamu nkurow mu: na medze hɔn ndɔmmum mebɛsan maba, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Jeremia nkyɛn a otsia ebien, ber a ɔda ho da efiadze wɔ ɔweɔmfo abangua mu hɔ no, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE a ɔyɛ adze yi, EWURADZE a ɔhyehyɛ ma otsim hɔ no; ne dzin dze EWURADZE no, ɔse nye yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Frɛ me, na mebɛgye wo do, na makyerɛ wo ndzɛmba akɛse a ɔyɛ yɛ na a ɔwo innyim.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, ɔse wɔ kurow yi mu adan, na Juda ahemfo adan a mpempe na afona ntsi woedwuruw egu famu no ho nye yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔreba wɔnye Kaldeafo abɔko, na mbom wɔdze nyimpa a mekuku hɔn wɔ m’ebufuw na m’ebufuhyew mu, na osian hɔn emumuyɛ nyinara ntsi ma medze m’enyim ehuntsa efi kurow yi ho no, hɔn efun abɛhyehyɛ no amaama.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, emi mara mebɛbrɛ no apɔwmudzen na edur, na masa hɔn yarba; na meyi asomdwee na nokwar pii makyerɛ hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛma Juda ndɔmmum na Israel asan aba, na medze hɔn mesi hɔ dɛ asɔpɔn no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛtsew hɔn ho efi hɔn emumuyɛ nyina a wɔdze ayɛ bɔn etsia me no ho; na medze hɔn emumuyɛ nyina a wɔdze ayɛ bɔn etsia me no, na wɔdze afom me no mefir hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na kurow yi bɛdan me ahosɛpɛw dzin, ayɛyi na enyimnyam wɔ asaase do amanaman nyina a wɔbɛtse yie a medze reyɛ hɔn no nyina enyim, na woesuro na hɔn ho apopo wɔ yie nyina na asomdwee nyina a mirinya mama hɔn no ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Bea yi a hom ka wɔ ho dɛ, Ɔayɛ amamfo, nyimpa na abowa biara nnyi hɔ, Juda nkurow mu mpo, Jerusalɛm abrɔn a ɔayɛ afo, nyimpa na tsefo na abowa biara nnyi mu no, na wɔbɛda ho atse
title: JEREMIAH

text: ehurusi ndze na ahosɛpɛw ndze, na ayeforkun ndze na ayefor ndze, hɔn a wɔtow ndwom, ber a wɔdze ndaase afɔrbɔ reba EWURADZE fie no ndze dɛ, Hom mfa ndaase mma dɔm EWURADZE, na EWURADZE ye, na n’ehumbɔbɔr tsim hɔ daa, Na mebɛma asaase no asan ayɛ prɔmprɔm dɛ asɔpɔn no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Bea yi a ɔabɔ a nyimpa na abowa biara nnyi, na no nkurow nyinara mu, ɔbɛyɛ tsenabea bio ama nguanhwɛfo a wɔbɛma hɔn nguan ebutubutuw hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Koko do nkurow, bɔnsamu nkurow, na Pomu afamu nkurow, na Benjamin asaase do, na mbeambea a etwa Jerusalɛm ho ehyia, na Juda nkurow mu, na nguankuw bodua nyia ɔkan hɔn no nsa ase etwa mu bio, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, mebɛma asɛmpa no a mekaa no Israel fifo ho na Juda fifo ho no aba mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nda no mu no, na aber no, nna mebɛma ɔtsenenee Odubaa afefɛw ama David; na ɔayɛ atsɛmbu na tsenenee wɔ asaase no do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nda no mu na Jerusalɛm atsena ase dwudwoodwo: na iyi nye dzin a wɔdze bɛfrɛ no, EWURADZE nye hɛn tsenenee.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Ɔbarimba a ɔbɛtsena Israel fie akɔngua do ɔrommbɔ David;
title: JEREMIAH

text: eso ɔbarimba a ɔbɔbɔ ɔhyew afɔr, na ɔahyew edziban afɔr, na ɔabɔ okum afɔr daapem wɔ m’enyim no, ɔrommbɔ asɔfo Levifo no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Sɛ hom botum ato m’adzekyee ahyɛmu na m’adzesaa ahyɛmu, ma adzekyee na adzesaa remmba bio wɔ n’aber mu a;
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔnodze na wɔbɔto menye m’akowaa David ntamu ahyɛmu no, ma onnkenya ɔbabanyin a ɔbɛtsena n’akɔngua do edzi hen; na ɔnye Levifo asɔfo a wɔsom me no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛ mbrɛ wonntum nnkan ɔsor dɔm, eso wonnsusu mpoano anhwea no; dɛmara na mebɛma m’akowaa David asefo, na Levifo a wɔsom me no wɔadɔr.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ana enndwen dza ɔman yi aka no ho, dɛ, Mbusu ebien a EWURADZE saan mu yii hɔn no, wɔatow hɔn akyen? Mbrɛ wobu me man enyimtsia nye yi, dɛ wɔnnyɛ hɔn enyi do dɛ ɔman bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Sɛ m’adzekyee na adzesaa ahyɛmu no enngyina a, sɛ mannhyɛ ɔsor na asaase ahyɛdze no a;
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔnodze na mo so mobɔtow Jakob, na m’akowaa David asefo akyen, dɛ mennkɛfa n’asefo mu bi ma woeedzi Abraham, Isaak, na Jakob asefo do mpanyin: na mebɛma hɔn ndɔmmumfo asan, na mehu hɔn mbɔbɔr.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a ofi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ, aber a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar, na no dɔm nyina, na asaase do ahendzi a wɔwɔ no tumdzi ase nyina, na aman nyina, bɛnye Jerusalɛm, na no nkurow nyinara koe dɛ:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi, Kɔ kɛkasa kyerɛ Judahen Zedekia, na se no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Hwɛ, medze kurow yi bɛhyɛ Babilɔnhen nsa, na ɔdze ogya ahyew no:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na ɔwoara so irimmfi ne nsa, na ɔkyer ara na wɔbɛkyer wo, na woeyi wo ahyɛ ne nsa; na w’enyiwa bohu Babilɔnhen enyi, na ɔnye wo akasa ano na ano, na akɔ Babilɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso Judahen Zedekia, tsie EWURADZE n’asɛm: mbrɛ EWURADZE ka wɔ wo ho nye yi, Innkowu afona ano;
title: JEREMIAH

text: ibowu asomdwee mu; na mbrɛ wɔhyehyeew adze maa w’egyanom, ahemfo nkankan no a wodzii w’enyim no, dɛmara so na wɔbɛhyew ama wo; na wobegyam wo, dɛ, Ao ewura! Na emi na maka asɛm no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia kaa nsɛm yinom nyina kyerɛɛ Judahen Zedekia wɔ Jerusalɛm,
title: JEREMIAH
