text: ber a Babilɔnhen no dɔm wɔnye Jerusalɛm, na Juda nkurow a aka no, Lakis na Azeka, ridzi ako no; na iyinom nye nkurow a wɔagye ho ban a wɔkae wɔ Juda nkurow no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a ofi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ, aber a ɔhen Zedekia nye nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ Jerusalɛm nyinara dzii ahyɛmu no dɛ wɔmbɔ fahodzi dawur mma hɔn no ekyir no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: dɛ nyimpa biara mma n’akowaa, na nyimpa biara mma n’afonabaa a ɔyɛ Hebriwnyi banyin anaa Hebriwnyi basia mmfa noho ndzi; dɛ mma biara nndzi hɔn nya, mekyerɛ, no nua Hebriwnyi no a:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na asafohen no nyinara na ɔman no nyinara a wodzii ahyɛmu no tsiei, dɛ biara mma n’akowaa, na biara mma n’afonabaa mfa noho ndzi, na mma biara nndzi hɔn nya bio; wotsiei na wɔmaa wɔfaa hɔnho dzii;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na n’ekyir no wotwaa hɔnho, na wɔmaa nkowaa na mfonabaa a wɔama wɔafa hɔnho edzi no, sanee bae bɛyɛɛ nkowaa na mfonabaa bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi EWURADZE n’asɛm fi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn se nye yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Menye hom egyanom dzii ahyɛmu wɔ da a medze hɔn mifii Egypt asaase do, fii nkowaasom fi no mu no, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mfe esuon ewiei no, hom mu nyimpa biara mma no nua a ɔyɛ Hebriwnyi a wɔatɔn no ama wo no, na ɔasom wo mfe esia no, ɔnkɔ nkɛfa noho ndzi mfi wo nkyɛn: na hom egyanom enntsie me, eso wɔammbrɛ hɔn aso adze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hom dze, ndaenu yi hom sanee, na hom yɛɛ dza ɔtsen wɔ m’enyi do, dɛ hom mu nyimpa biara bɔɔ fahodzi dawur maa ne nyɛnko; na hom enya edzi ahyɛmu wɔ m’enyim wɔ fi a wɔdze me dzin ato no no mu:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na hom sanee boguu me dzin ho fi, na hom maa nyimpa biara n’akowaa, na nyimpa biara n’afonabaa a hom maa wɔfaa hɔnho dzii dɛ mbrɛ wɔpɛ no, sanee bae; na hom tseetsee hɔn dɛ nkowaa na mfonabaa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hom enntsie me dɛ hom bɔbɔ fahodzi dawur, nyimpa biara dze ama no nua, na nyimpa biara dze ama ne nyɛnko: hwɛ, mo so morobɔ fahodzi dawur, EWURADZE na ɔse, medze hom mama afona, ɔyardɔm, na ɔkɔm; na mebɛma wɔatow hom edzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do ahendzi horow nyina mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na medze mbarimba a wɔato m’ahyɛmu, wɔannyɛ ahyɛmu a wodzii no m’enyim no mu nsɛm no, ber a wɔpaa ɔnantwiba mu ebien no, ha woduaa n’afaafa no ntamu no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: Juda asafohen, na Jerusalɛm asafohen, epiafo no, na asɔfo no, na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara a woduaa ɔnantwiba n’afaafa ntamu no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔhyɛ ara na medze hɔn mebɛhyɛ hɔn atamfo nsa, na hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ hɔn nkwa no nsa: na hɔn efun bɛyɛ edziban ama sor nnoma, na asaase mbowa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Judahen Zedekia na n’asafohen no so medze hɔn mebɛhyɛ hɔn atamfo nsa, na hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ hɔn nkwa nsa na Babilɔnhen no dɔm a woefi hom enyim kɔ no nsa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, mebɛhyɛ, EWURADZE na ɔse, na mama wɔasan aba kurow yi ho; na wɔnye no bɔko, na wɔagye, na wɔdze gya ahyew no: na mebɛyɛ Juda nkurow amamfo a ɔtsefo nnyi mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a ofi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ wɔ Judahen Josia ne ba Jehoiakim ne nda no mu dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Kɔ Rekabfo fie, na kɛkasa kyerɛ hɔn, na fa hɔn bra EWURADZE fie mpia no kor mu, na ma hɔn nsa ma wɔnnom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna mefaa Habazinia ba Jeremia ne ba Jaazania, na no nuanom, na ne mbabanyin nyinara, na Rekabfo fie nyinara;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na medze hɔn mebaa EWURADZE fie, wɔ Nyame nyimpa Igdalia ba Hanan ne mbabanyin hɔn pia no a ɔwɔ abowanohwɛfo Sallum ba Maaseia ne pia etsifi no mu:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na medze kuraba a nsa ahyehyɛ no amaama, na nkɔɔpow sisii hɔn enyim, na mesee hɔn dɛ, Hom nnom nsa ɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔkaa dɛ, Yɛnnkɔnom nsa biara: na hɛn egya Rekab ne ba Jonadab hyɛɛ hɛn, dɛ, Hom o, hom mbabanyin o, mma hom nnom nsa dabiarada:
title: JEREMIAH

text: eso mma hom nnsi dan, na wonndua aba, anaa wɔnntsɛw wenyin ture, anaa wonnya bi: na mbom hom ntsena asese mu hom nda nyina; ama hom aatsena ase nda pii wɔ asaase a hom yɛ do amamforafo no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na yɛayɛ setsie ama hɛn egya Rekab ne ba Jonadab wɔ dza ɔdze hyɛɛ hɛn nyinara ho dɛ, mma yɛnnom nsa hɛn nda nyinara, hɛnara, hɛn yernom, hɛn mbabanyin, na hɛn mbabaa;
title: JEREMIAH

text: anaaso yennsisi adan yɛnntsena mu: eso yennyi wenyin ture, na mfuwa, na aba:
title: JEREMIAH

text: mbom yɛatsenatsena asese mu, na yɛayɛ setsie, na yɛayɛ dɛ mbrɛ hɛn egya Jonadab hyɛɛ hɛn no nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, ber a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar tui baa asaase yi do no, nna yɛsee dɛ, Hom mbra ma yɛnkɔ Jerusalɛm wɔ Kaldeafo dɔm ho hu ntsi, na Siriafo dɔm ho hu ntsi; nna yɛtse Jerusalɛm yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi: Kɔ, na kɛse Juda mbarimba na Jerusalɛm atsefo dɛ, Aso hom nnkɛgye nkyerɛkyerɛ dɛ hom betsie me nsɛm bi a? EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nsɛm a Rekab ba Jonadab dze hyɛɛ ne mbabanyin dɛ mma wɔnnom nsa no, woedzi do, na ɔdze bodu ndɛ da yi wɔnnoom bi, osiandɛ wodzi hɔn egya ne mbrasɛm do: na emi dze, makasa makyerɛ hom, mosoɛr ahema na mekasa; na hom enntsie me.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Masoma mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara aba hom nkyɛn, eso mosoɛr ahema na mosoma hɔn, dɛ, Afei hom mu nyimpa biara nsan mfi no kwan bɔn no do, na ɔnyɛ ne nyɛe yie, na mma onnkedzi abosom afofor bi ekyir nnkɔsom hɔn, na hom atsena asaase a medze mama hom na hom egyanom no do: na mbom hom ammbrɛ hom aso adze, eso hom enntsie me.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Susuampaara dɛ Rekab na Jonadab ne mba woedzi mbrasɛm a hɔn egya dze hyɛɛ hɔn no do no, na ɔman yi dze, woenntsie me yi;
title: JEREMIAH

text: dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn, ɔse nye yi: Hwɛ, medze mbusu nyina a maka etsia Juda na Jerusalɛm atsefo nyinara no mebɛba hɔn do: osiandɛ makasa akyerɛ hɔn, na woenntsie; mafrɛ hɔn so, na wɔanngye do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Jeremia see Rekabfo fi no dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi: Osiandɛ hom etsie hom egya Jonadab ne mbrasɛm, na hom edzi n’ahyɛdze nyinara do, na hom ayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyɛɛ hom nyinara ntsi;
title: JEREMIAH

text: dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn, se nye yi: Ɔbarimba a ogyina m’enyim nnkɔbɔ Rekab ba Jonadab ara da.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Josia ba Jehoiakim, Judahen no, n’afe a otsia anan no mu no nna asɛm yi fi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Fa nwoma mbobɔwee, na kyerɛw nsɛm nyina a maka akyerɛ wo etsia Israel, na Juda, na amanaman nyina wɔ mu, ofi da a mekasaa kyerɛɛ wo fi Josia ber do dze besi ndɛ da yi mpo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Bi a Juda fi bɛtse mbusu nyina a mesua me tsir mu dɛ medze bɛyɛ hɔn; ama hɔn mu nyimpa biara ɔaasan efi no kwan bɔn do; ama medze hɔn emumuyɛ na hɔn bɔn aakyɛ hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Jeremia frɛɛ Neria ba Baruk; na Baruk kyerɛɛw EWURADZE nsɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ Jeremia nyina fir n’anomu hyɛɛ nwoma mbobɔwee no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Jeremia hyɛɛ Baruk, dɛ, Wɔatow me mu; murunntum nnkɔ EWURADZE fie:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔwoara kɔ, na kɛkenkan EWURADZE nsɛm a ekyerɛwee no, wɔ EWURADZE fie, wɔ mbuadadzi da no mu: na kenkan no wɔ Judafo nyina a wofi hɔn nkurow do ba no so asomu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Bi a wɔdze hɔn nkotoserɛ bogu EWURADZE enyim, na hɔn mu biara bɛsan efi no kwan bɔn no do: na ebufuw na ebufuhyew a EWURADZE aka egu ɔman yi do no ɔso.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Neria ba Baruk yɛɛ dɛ dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia hyɛɛ no no nyina, na ɔkenkaan EWURADZE nsɛm no a ɔwɔ nwoma no mu no wɔ EWURADZE fie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei ɔbaa dɛ Josua ba Jehoiakim, Judahen no, n’afe a otsia enum no, wɔ bosoom a otsia akron no, nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ Jerusalɛm nyina, na nkorɔfo a wofi Juda mu baa Jerusalɛm nyina, wɔbɔɔ mbuadadzi ho dawur wɔ EWURADZE enyim.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Baruk kenkaan Jeremia ne nsɛm a ɔwɔ nwoma no mu no wɔ EWURADZE fie, wɔ ɔkyerɛwfo Safan ne ba Gemaria ne pia a ɔwɔ etsifi abangua no mu wɔ EWURADZE fie ɔponkɛse no ano, wɔ ɔman no nyina asomu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Safan ne ba Gemaria ne babanyin Mikaia tsee EWURADZE nsɛm a ɔwɔ nwoma no mu no nyina no,
title: JEREMIAH

text: osianee kɔr ɔhen ne fie. Ɔkɔr ɔkyerɛwfo no ne pia no mu: na, hwɛ, asafohen no nyina tsetse hɔ, mekyerɛ ɔkyerɛwfo Elisama, na Semaia ba Delaia, na Akbor ba Elnatan, na Safan ba Gemaria, na Hanania ba Zedekia, na asafohen no nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Mikaia kaa nsɛm a ɔtsee no ber a Baruk kenkaan nwoma no wɔ ɔman no asomu nyina kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi asafohen no somaa Jehudi a ofi Kusi ebusua mu no wɔ Baruk hɔ, dɛ, Fa nwoma mbobɔwee no a akenkan mu nsɛm wɔ ɔman no asomu no kitsa wo nsamu bra. Nna Neria ba Baruk faa nwoma mbobɔwee no kitsaa ne nsamu na ɔbaa hɔn nkyɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Tsena ase ɛ, na kenkan no hɛn asomu. Nna Baruk kenkaan no hɔn asomu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei ɔbaa dɛ, wonyae tsee nsɛm no nyinara no, wɔdze akomatu danee hwehwɛɛ hɔnho, na wɔsee Baruk dɛ, Otwar dɛ yɛkɛka nsɛm yi nyina kyerɛ ɔhen.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wobisaa Baruk dɛ, Afei ka kyerɛ hɛn, Isii dɛn kyerɛɛw nsɛm yi nyina? Ana ɔkae ma ekyerɛwee a?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Baruk buaa hɔn dɛ, Ɔdze n’ano kaa nsɛm yi nyinara kyerɛɛ me, na mo so medze dubir kyerɛwee guu nwoma mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna asafohen no see Baruk dɛ, Kɔ, kosuma, ɔwo na Jeremia; mma obiara nnhu mbrɛ hom wɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asafohen no dze nwoma mbobɔwee no siee ɔkyerɛwfo Elisama ne pia no mu; na wɔkɔr ɔhen no nkyɛn wɔ abangua no do; na wɔkaa nsɛm no nyina wɔ ɔhen no asomu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna ɔhen no somaa Jehudi dɛ ɔnkɛfa nwoma mbobɔwee no mbra: na okeyii no ɔkyerɛwfo Elisama ne pia no mu. Na Jehudi kenkanee kyerɛɛ ɔhen no na asafohen a wogyinagyina ɔhen no nkyɛn nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna ɔhen tse awɔwber dan no mu, wɔ bosoom a otsia akron no mu: na mbukyia mu ogya a ɔredzɛw taa n’enyim.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a Jehudi wiee nkrataa ebiasa anaa anan kenkan no, ɔhen no dze sekamba twitwae na ɔdze guu gya a ɔwɔ mbukyia mu no mu kesii dɛ nwoma mbobɔwee no nyina hyewee wɔ ogya a ɔwɔ mbukyia mu no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na woennsuro, eso woennsunsuan hɔn ntar mu, ɔhen no, na no nkowaa nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mpo ber a Elnatan na Delaia na Gemaria totɔe serɛɛ ɔhen no dɛ nkyɛ mma ɔnnhyew nwoma mbobɔwee no: oenntsie hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ ɔhenba Jerameel, na Azriel ba Seraia, na Abdeel ba Selemia, dɛ wɔnkɛkyer ɔkyerɛwfo Baruk na nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia: naaso EWURADZE dze hɔn sumae.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei ɔhen no hyeew nwoma mbobɔwee no a nsɛm a Baruk kyerɛwee fii Jeremia anomu wɔ mu no ekyir no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Fa nwoma mbobɔwee fofor so bio, na kyerɛw nkan nsɛm a ɔwɔ nwoma mbobɔwee a odzi kan no a Judahen Jehoiakim ahyew no no, wɔ mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ka wɔ Judahen Jehoiakim ho dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Ɔwo ahyew nwoma mbobɔwee yi, na ase dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na akyerɛw no wɔ mu dɛ, Babilɔnhen bɛba abɛsɛɛ asaase yi ampaara, na ɔama nyimpa na abowa abɔ adze wɔ do?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE ka wɔ Judahen Jehoiakim ho nye yi: Onnkenya obi a ɔbɛtsena David akɔngua do: na no fun so wɔbɔtow akyen ma ɔhyew afa do ewiaber, na awɔw afa do anadwe.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛtsea ɔno na n’asefo na no nkowaa wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi, na medze mbusu nyina a maka etsia hɔn no, na woenntsie no, bɛba hɔn na Jerusalɛm nyina, na Judamba do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Jeremia faa nwoma mbobɔwee fofor so, na ɔdze maa ɔkyerɛwfo Baruk, Neria ba no ɔno na ɔkyerɛɛw nwoma a Judahen Jehoiakim hyeew no wɔ gya mu no no mu nsɛm nyina fii Jeremia anomu hyɛɛ mu: na wɔdze nsɛm a ɔtsetse dɛm pii kekaa ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Josia ba Zedekia dzii hen wɔ Jehoiakim ba Konia a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar hyɛɛ no hen wɔ Juda asaase no do no ananmu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔno o, no nkowaa o, asaase no do nkorɔfo o, woenntsie EWURADZE ne nsɛm a ɔnam nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia do kae no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔhen Zedekia somaa Selemia ba Jehukal, na ɔsɔfo Zefania, Maaseia ne ba no wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia nkyɛn, dɛ, Afei yi mpaa ma EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ma hɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Jeremia dzi ɔman no mu ndɔfir: osiandɛ nna wonnyae mmfaa no nntoo efiadze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ber no nna Farao no dɔm efir edzi fi Egypt reba: na ber a Kaldeafo a wobotuaa Jerusalɛm no tsee hɔn nka no, wotui fii Jerusalɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE nsɛm baa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia hɔ, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi: Mbrɛ hom nkɛse Judahen a ɔsomaa hom me nkyɛn dɛ hom mbebisa mo hɔ adze no, nye yi. Hwɛ, Farao no dɔm a woefir edzi robɔboa hom no, wɔbɛsan akɔ Egypt hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Kaldeafo no bɛba bio, na wɔnye kurow yi abɔko, na wɔbɛgye na wɔdze gya ahyew no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Mma hom nndaadaa homho, dɛ, Ɔkɔ ara na Kaldeafo befi hɛn nkyɛn akɔ: osiandɛ wɔronnkɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na kaansa hom kuku Kaldeafo dɔm a wɔnye hom roko nyina, na ɔka hɔn mu epirafo nko mpo a, nkyɛ hɔn mu nyimpa biara bɔsoɛr efi n’asesee mu, na wɔdze gya ahyew kurow yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Kaldeafo dɔm tui fii Jerusalɛm wɔ Farao no dɔm ho hu ntsi no,
title: JEREMIAH

text: nna Jeremia fii Jerusalɛm dɛ ɔrokɔ Benjamin asaase do akɛgye ne kyɛfa wɔ hɔ wɔ ɔman no ne finimfin.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na odur Benjamin ɔponkɛse no mu no, na aweɔmfo panyin bi wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Irija, Hanania ba Selemia ne ba a; na osuoo nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia mu, see dɛ, Ɔwo adan rokɔ Kaldeafo nkyɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Jeremia see dɛ, Eboa; mennyɛ nyia ɔadan rokɔ Kaldeafo nkyɛn; naaso oenntsie no: nna Irija suoo Jeremia mu, na ɔdze no brɛɛ asafohen no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na asafohen no bo fuuw Jeremia, na wɔhwee no, na wɔdze no kɔtoo efiadze wɔ ɔkyerɛwfo Jonatan fie; nna hɔ na wɔdze ayɛ efiadze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Jeremia kɔr mona efiadze no mu, na etu no mu, na Jeremia dzii hɔ nda pii.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna ɔhen Zedekia somae ma wɔkɛfaa no bae: na ɔhen no bisaa no wɔ ne fie nsumaa mu, dɛ, Ana asɛm bi a ofi EWURADZE nkyɛn wɔ hɔ? Na Jeremia see dɛ, Bi wɔ hɔ. Ɔkae so dɛ, Wobeyi wo ahyɛ Babilɔnhen ne nsa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Bio so Jeremia see ɔhen Zedekia dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na mayɛ bɔn etsia ɔwo, anaa wo nkowaa, anaa wo man, ma hom dze me ato efiadze yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛɛ hom nkɔm dɛ, Babilɔnhen remmba hom do, anaa asaase yi do no, wɔwɔ henfa?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na afei, mo wura ɔhen, meserɛ wo, tsie ɛ: meserɛ wo ma mo nkotoserɛ nsɔ w’enyi; na mma wɔmmfa me nnsan ɔkyerɛwfo Jonatan fie, ɔno bɛyɛ na mewu wɔ hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna ɔhen Zedekia hyɛe ma wɔdze Jeremia kesiee aweɔmfo abangua no mu, ma daa wofi boodootofo brɔn no mu ma no boodoo ntɔwmu kor, dze kodur dɛ kurow no mu boodoo nyina sae. Mbrɛ Jeremia tsenaa aweɔmfo abangua no mu nye no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Maatan ba Sefatia, na Pasur ba Gedalia, na Selemia ba Jukal, na Malkia ba Pasur tsee nsɛm a Jeremia kaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyina, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Nyia ɔbɛtsena kurow yi mu no, obowu afona, ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm ano: na nyia obefir edzi akɔ Kaldeafo nkyɛn no dze, ɔbɛtsena ase, na no nkwa bɛyɛ no dɛ afonam, na ɔbɛtsena ase.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi, Wɔdze kurow yi bɛhyɛ Babilɔnhen no dɔm nsa ara ampa, na wɔagye.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna asafohen no see ɔhen no dɛ, Yɛserɛ wo, Ma wonku ɔbarimba yi: susuampaara dɛ ɔgow akofo a wɔaka wɔ kurow yi mu nsa, na ɔman no nyinara nsa, wɔ dɛ ɔka dɛm nsɛm yi kyerɛ hɔn ntsi: na ɔbarimba yi ɔnnhwehwɛ ɔman yi ne yie, na mbom no mbusu a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔhen Zedekia see dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔwɔ hom nsamu: na nnyɛ ɔhen nye nyia obotum ayɛ biribi etsia hom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna wɔfaa Jeremia, na wɔkotoow no kyeen ɔhenba Malkia mona efiadze a ɔwɔ aweɔmfo abanguado no mu: na wɔdze ntampehoma gyaagyaa Jeremia siaan mu. Na mona efiadze no hɔ nnyi nsu, dɛ adɛtsebir nko: na Jeremia homee kɔr adɛtsebir no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei ber a Etiopianyi Ebed-melek, opianyi a ɔwɔ ahemfie no, tsee dɛ wɔdze Jeremia akɔto mona efiadze no, nna ɔhen no so tse Benjamin ɔponkɛse mu no,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ebed-melek fiir edzi fii ahemfie, kɛkasaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mo wura ɔhen, mbarimba yi abɔ mbusu wɔ dza wɔdze ayɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia no nyina, dɛ wɔakɔtow no akyen mona efiadze no mu; na ɔkɔm ntsi ɔreyɛ oewu wɔ mbrɛ ɔwɔ no: osiandɛ edziban bi nnyi kurow no mu bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna ɔhen no hyɛɛ Etiopianyi Ebed-melek, dɛ, Fa mbarimba eduasa fi ha ka wo ho, na keyi nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia fi mona efiadze no mu, ansaana oewu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Ebed-melek faa mbarimba no kaa no ho, na ɔkɔr ahemfie adzekoradan no ase, na ɔkɛfaa ntangow dadaw a atsetsew na esusuw, na ɔdze ntampehoma kyekyeree gyaagyaa mu siaan mona efiadze no mu maa Jeremia.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Etiopianyi Ebed-melek see Jeremia dɛ, Fa ntangow dadaw a atsetsew na esusuw no hyehyɛ w’ambɔtoadze wɔ ntampehoma no ase. Na Jeremia yɛɛ dɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna wɔdze ntampehoma no twee Jeremia baa sor, na woyii no fii mona efiadze no mu: na Jeremia tsenaa aweɔmfo abangua no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna ɔhen Zedekia somae ma wɔkɛfaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia baa ne nkyɛn wɔ EWURADZE fie abow a otsia ebiasa no ano: na ɔhen no see Jeremia dɛ, Miribebisa wo asɛm bi; na mma nnsiw me biribiara do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Jeremia see Zedekia dɛ, Aso mepaa mu ka kyerɛ wo a, ana nnyɛ oku ara na woboku me bi? Na sɛ mema wo apam a, irinntsie me.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Zedekia kaa ntam nsumaa mu kyerɛɛ Jeremia, dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE a ɔyɛɛ hɛn kra yi tse ase yi, murunnku wo, eso meremmfa wo nhyɛ mbarimba yi a wɔrohwehwɛ wo nkwa yi nsamu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Jeremia see Zedekia dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE dɔm Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse nye yi: Sɛ ibefir edzi akɔ Babilɔnhen n’asafohen no nkyɛn a, nkyɛ ɔnodze wo kra bɛtsena ase, na kurow yi so, wɔnnkɛfa gya ahyew no; na ɔwo na wo fifo bɛtsena ase:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na sɛ irimmfi edzi nnkɔ Babilɔnhen n’asafohemfo no nkyɛn a, ɔnodze wɔdze kurow yi bɛhyɛ Kaldeafo nsa, na wɔdze gya ahyew no, na ɔwoara so irimmfi hɔn nsa mfi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔhen Zedekia see Jeremia dɛ, Musuro Judafo a wɔadan kɔ Kaldeafo no nkyɛn no, bi a wobeyi me ahyɛ hɔn nsa, na woesi me atwetwe.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Jeremia see dɛ, Wonnkeyi wo ama. Meserɛ wo ara, tsie EWURADZE ne ndze wɔ dza mereka kyerɛ wo yi mu: dɛm na obesi wo yie, na wo kra atsena ase.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ epow dɛ ibefir edzi akɔ a, asɛm a EWURADZE dze akyerɛ me nye yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, mbaa a wɔaka wɔ Judahen ne fie nyina wɔdze hɔn befir edzi akɔ Babilɔnhen n’asafohen no nkyɛn, na mbaa no bɛse dɛ, W’anyɛnko brɛbo na wɔadaadaa wo, na woedzi wo do nyim: afei a w’anan atɔ adɛtsebir mu yi, wɔadan wo egya.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔdze wo yernom na wo mba nyinara befir edzi akɔ Kaldeafo nkyɛn: na ɔwoara nnkefi hɔn nsa efi, na mbom Babilɔnhen ne nsa bɛka wo: na ɔwoara na ebɛma wɔdze gya ahyew kurow yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Zedekia see Jeremia dɛ, Mma nyimpa biara nntse asɛm yi, na innkowu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na iyi sɛ asafohen no tse dɛ menye wo akasa a, na wɔba wo nkyɛn, na wɔbɛse wo dɛ, Afei ka dza aka akyerɛ ɔhen no kyerɛ hɛn; mma nnsiw hɛn biribiara do, na yerunnku wo: eso dza ɔhen kaa kyerɛɛ wo no, a:
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔnodze se hɔn dɛ, Mo nkotoserɛ na medze koguu ɔhen no enyim, dɛ mma ɔmma me nnsan nnkɔ Jonatan fie munnkowu wɔ hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna asafohen no nyinara baa Jeremia nkyɛn bebisaa no: na ɔkaa nsɛm yi a ɔhen no hyɛɛ no no nyinara kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛmara. Nna wogyaa dɛ wɔnye no kasa; osiandɛ woennhu asɛm no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Jeremia tsenaa aweɔmfo abangua no mu ara dze kodur dɛ wɔgyee Jerusalɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ wɔgyee Jerusalɛm (wɔ Judahen Zedekia afe a otsia akron no mu, bosoom du no mu no, Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar na no dɔm nyinara wɔbaa Jerusalɛm, na wobotuaa no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: Zedekia afe a otsia dubiako no, bosoom a otsia anan no, na bosoom no mu da a otsia akron no mu, na wokefiir kurow no mu:)
title: JEREMIAH

text: ma Babilɔnhen n’asafohen no nyinara bɛhɛɛn kurow no mu, na wɔtsenatsenaa finimfin abow kɛse no mu, mekyerɛ Nergal-sarezer, Samgar-nebo, Sarsekim, Rab-saris, Nergal-sarezer, Rab-mag, wɔnye Babilɔnhen n’asafohen nkaa no nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a Judahen Zedekia, na mbarimba akofo no nyinara hun hɔn no, nna woguanguanee, na wofii kurow no mu fiir anadwe, duaa ɔhen no ture mu kwan do, dze faa abow kɛse mu wɔ afasu ebien ntamu: na wɔdze faa Araba kwan do kɔree.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Kaldeafo hɔn dɔm no tsiiw hɔn, na wɔkɔtoo Zedekia wɔ Jeriko tɛtɛr mu: na wɔkyeer no no, wɔdze no baa Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar nkyɛn wɔ Ribla wɔ Hamat asaase do, na obuaa no atsɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Babilɔnhen kunkum Zedekia ne mba wɔ Ribla wɔ n’enyim: eso Babilɔnhen kunkum Juda ekunyin no nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei so otutuu Zedekia n’enyiwa, na ɔtoo no mpokyerɛ dɛ wɔmfa no nkɔ Babilɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Kaldeafo dze gya hyeew ahemfi no, na ɔmamfo no efiefi no, na wodwuruuw Jerusalɛm afasu no guu famu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan faa ɔman no nkaa a wɔkaa kurow no mu no; na hɔn a wɔdanee kɔr ne nkyɛn no so, na ɔman no nkaa a wɔkae no nyinara ndɔmmum kɔr Babilɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan gyaa ɔman no mu ehiafo a wonnyi hwee no wɔ Juda asaase do, na ɔdze wenyin nture na mfuwa memaa hɔn da no ara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar hyɛɛ aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan wɔ Jeremia ho dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Fa no, na hwɛ no yie, na mma nnyɛ no bɔn biara; na dza ɔbɛse wo nyina yɛ ma no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan, na Nebusaziban, Rab-saris, na Nergal-sarezer, Rab-mag, na Babilɔnhen n’asafohen etsitsir no nyinara wɔsomae;
title: JEREMIAH

text: wɔsomae ma wɔkɛfaa Jeremia fii aweɔmfo abangua no mu bae, na wɔdze no hyɛɛ Safan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedalia nsa, dɛ ɔmfa no nkɔ fie: nna ɔkɛtsenaa no nkorɔfo no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei Jeremia da ho da efiadze wɔ aweɔmfo abangua no no mu no, nna EWURADZE n’asɛm baa no hɔ dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Kɔ, na kɛse Etiopianyi Ebed-melek, dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ase nye yi: Hwɛ, mebɛma me nsɛm aba mu wɔ kurow yi do ayɛ mbusu, na nnyɛ papa bi a; na ɔbɛba mu wɔ w’enyim da no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na da no mebɛgye wo, EWURADZE na ɔse: na wɔremmfa wo nnhyɛ mbarimba a isuro hɔn no nsa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na nkwa na mebɛgye wo, na eronntɔ afona ano, na wo nkwa bɛyɛ afonam ama wo: osiandɛ ɔwo edze wo werɛ atwer me, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a ofi EWURADZE nkyɛn baa Jeremia hɔ, aber a aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan gyaa no wɔ Rama n’ekyir no, ber a ɔfaa no dɛ ɔda nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu wɔ Jerusalɛm na Juda ndɔmmumfo a wɔdze hɔn rokɔ Babilɔn ndɔmmum no mu no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na aweɔmfo safohen no faa Jeremia, na ɔsee no dɛ, EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn na ɔkaa mbusu yi baa bea yi do:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na EWURADZE na ɔama aba mu, na ɔayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔkae no; osiandɛ hom ayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE, na hom enntsie ne ndze, dɛm ntsi na adze yi aba hom do yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na afei, hwɛ, Masan wo ndɛ da yi efi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a ɔda wo nsa no mu. Sɛ ehwɛ na oye ma wo dɛ enye me bɔkɔ Babilɔn a, bra, na mobɔhwɛ wo yie; na sɛ ehwɛ na omuo ma wo dɛ enye me bɔkɔ Babilɔn a, ma ɔnka: hwɛ, asaase no nyina da w’enyim; beebiara a ehwɛ a oye na ɔyɛ ahomka ma wo dɛ ebɔkɔ no, kɔ hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na onnyae nnsanee no, ɔsee dɛ, San mbɔ na kɔ Safan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedalia a Babilɔnhen ahyɛ no ambrado wɔ Juda nkurow do no, na kɛtsena ne nkyɛn wɔ ɔman no mu: anaa kɔ beebiara a ehwɛ a ibenya ahomka dɛ ebɔkɔ no. Nna aweɔmfo safohen no maa no akwantu mu edziban na ahyɛdze, na ogyaa no kwan.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Jeremia kɔr Ahikam ba Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mizpa, na ɔkɛtsenaa ne nkyɛn wɔ ɔman a wɔaka asaase no do no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei ber a dɔm no hɔn asafohen a wɔwɔ nhaban mu no, mekyerɛ hɔn na hɔn mbarimba no, wɔtsee dɛ Babilɔnhen ahyɛ Ahikam ba Gedalia ambrado wɔ asaase no do, na ɔdze mbarimba, na mbaa, na mbofraba, na asaase no do akɔhweaban a wɔammfa hɔn ndɔmmum annkɔ Babilɔn no mu bi ahyɛ n’ase no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: nna wɔbaa Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mizpa, mekyerɛ Netania ba Ismael, na Karea mba Johanan na Jonatan, na Tanhumet ba Seraia, na Netofanyi Efai ne mba, na Maakanyi ne ba Jezania, hɔn na hɔn mbarimba.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Safan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedalia kaa ntam kyerɛɛ hɔn na hɔn mbarimba no, dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro dɛ hom bɔsom Kaldeafo no: na hom ntsena asaase no do, na hom nsom Babilɔnhen no, na obesi hom yie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Emi dze, hwɛ, Mebɛtsena Mizpa megyina Kaldeafo a wɔbɛba hɛn nkyɛn no enyim: na hom dze, hom mboaboa nsa na ɔpɛber nduadzewa na ngo ano, na hom mfa ngugu hom ndzɛmba mu, na hom ntsenatsena hom nkurow a hom afefa no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛmara so na Judafo a wɔwɔ Moab, na Ammonmba mu, na Edom, na hɔn a wɔwɔ asaase no nyina do nyinara, wɔtsee dɛ Babilɔnhen egya Juda nkaa, na dɛ ɔdze Safan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedalia edzi hɔn do ɔpanyin no;
title: JEREMIAH

text: nna Judafo no nyina sanee fii mbea a wɔpaam hɔn kɔree no do bae, na wɔbaa Juda asaase do, wɔ Gedalia nkyɛn, wɔ Mizpa, na wɔboaboaa nsa na ɔpɛber nduadzewa piigyan ara ano.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nkyii so Karea na Johanan, na dɔm a wɔwɔ haban mu n’asafohen no, wɔbaa Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mizpa,
title: JEREMIAH

text: na wɔsee no dɛ, Ana inyim dɛ Ammonmba hɔn hen Baalis asoma Netania ba Ismael dɛ omboku wo? Na Ahikam ba Gedalia anngye hɔn enndzi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Karea ba Johanan see Gedalia wɔ Mizpa wɔ nsumaa mu, dɛ, Meserɛ wo, ma monkɔ, na munkoku Netania ba Ismael, na nyimpa biara runnhu: ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na oboku wo, ma Judafo a wɔaboa ano aba wo nkyɛn no nyinara mbɔ mpetse, na Juda nkaa no nhera?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Ahikam ba Gedalia see Karea ba Johanan, dɛ, Mma nnyɛ dɛm adze yi: na atorsɛm na eka no Ismael ho yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei ɔbaa dɛ bosoom a otsia esuon no mu, Elisama ba Netania ne ba Ismael, a ofi ɔhen asefo, na ɔhen n’etsitsir no mu no, na mbarimba du a wɔka no ho no, baa Ahikam ba Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mizpa: na Mizpa hɔ na wɔbɔɔ mu dzidzii.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Netania ba Ismael, na mbarimba du a wɔka no ho no soɛree, na wɔdze afona twitwaa Safan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedalia, na wokum nyia Babilɔnhen hyɛɛ no ambrado wɔ asaase no do no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ismael so kunkum Jewfo a wɔnye Gedalia wɔ Mizpa nyina, na Kaldeafo a wohun hɔn wɔ hɔ no, mbarimba akofo no a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ oeku Gedalia ekyir ndaenu no a obiara nntsee no,
title: JEREMIAH

text: mbarimba bi eduowɔtwe fi Sekem, Siloh, na Samaria bae a woeyiyi hɔn abɔdwesa na woesunsuan hɔn ntar mu, na wɔatotow hɔnho akam, na edziban afɔr na nduhuam kitsakitsa hɔn nsamu, dɛ wɔdze reba EWURADZE fie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Netania ba Ismael fiir edzi fii Mizpa kehyiaa hɔn kwan, ɔrokɔ nyina nna orusu: na ɔbaa dɛ, ɔnye hɔn hyiae no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mbra Ahikam ba Gedalia nkyɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔbaa kurow no ne finimfin no, Netania ba Ismael, ɔnoara na mbarimba a wɔka no ho no kunkum hɔn, na wɔtoow hɔn guu mona no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hɔn mu mbarimba du see dɛ, Mma nnku hɛn: na yɛwɔ edzidzidze suma haban mu, ewifua na atoko, na ngo, na ewo. Nna ogyaae, na oennku hɔn ammfora hɔn nuanom no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei mona a Ismael toow hɔn a okunkum hɔn kaa Gedalia ho hɔn efun guu mu no, (ɔnoara nye dza ɔhen Asa tui wɔ Israelhen Baasha ho suro ntsi no) na Netania ba Ismael dze hɔn a wokunkum hɔn no hɔn efun hyɛɛ no ma.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Ismael faa ɔman nkaa a wɔwɔ Mizpa no nyinara kɔr ndɔmmum, mekyerɛ ɔhen ne mbabaa no, na nkorɔfo a wɔkaa Mizpa aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan dze hyɛɛ Ahikam ba Gedalia n’ase no nyina Netania ba Ismael soaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree, na osii mu dɛ orukotwa mu akɔ Ammonmba no nkyɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Karea ba Johanan, na dɔm asafohemfo a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no nyina, wɔtsee mbusu nyina a Netania ba Ismael abɔ no,
title: JEREMIAH

text: nna wɔfaa mbarimba no nyina, na wɔkɔr dɛ wɔnye Netania ba Ismael rokɔko, na wɔkɔtoo no wɔ esu kɛse a ɔwɔ Gibeon no ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nkorɔfo nyina a wɔwɔ Ismael nkyɛn no hun Karea ba Johanan, na dɔm asafohemfo nyina a wɔka no ho no, hɔn enyi gyee.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna nkorɔfo a Ismael soaa hɔn ndɔmmum fii Mizpa kɔree no, wɔdandaan hɔnho, na wɔsensanee, na wɔkɔr Karea ba Johanan nkyɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Netania ba Ismael nye mbarimba baawɔtwe fii Karea nsa kɔr Ammonmba no nkyɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Karea ba Johanan na dɔm no mu asafohemfo no nyina faa ɔman no nkaa no nyina a ɔkɛgyee hɔn fii Netania ba Ismael a okum Ahikam ba Gedalia wɔ Mizpa no nsamu no: mbarimba akofo, na mbaa, na mbofraba, na epiafo a ɔdze hɔn fi Gideon sanee bae no:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na wosii mu kɔree, na wɔkɛtsenaa Gerut Kimham a ɔwɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm no, dɛ wɔnkɛhɛn Egypt,
title: JEREMIAH

text: wɔ Kaldeafo no ntsi: osiandɛ wosuroo hɔn, wɔ dɛ Netania ba Ismael eku Ahikam ba Gedalia a Babilɔnhen hyɛɛ no ambrado wɔ asaase no do ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna dɔm no mu asafohen no nyinara na Karea ba Johanan, na Hosaia ba Jezania, na ɔman no nyinara, ofi ekumaba do kesi ɔkɛse do, twee bɛnee,
title: JEREMIAH

text: bɛsee nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia dɛ, Yɛserɛ wo, ma hɛn nkotoserɛ yi nsɔ w’enyi na yi EWURADZE, wo Nyankopɔn mpaa ma hɛn, nkaa yi nyinara; na hɛn nye kakraabi a yɛaka wɔ pii no mu, dɛ mbrɛ w’enyiwa tua hɛn yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: ama EWURADZE, wo Nyankopɔn aakyerɛ hɛn kwan kor a yɛnnantsew mu, na adze kor a yɛnyɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia see hɔn dɛ, Matse hom asɛm: hwɛ, mibeyi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn mpaa dɛ mbrɛ hom aka yi; na ɔbɛba dɛ asɛm biara a EWURADZE dze bobua hom no, mebɛpaa mu aka akyerɛ hom; mirinnsiw hom biribiara do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna wɔsee Jeremia dɛ, EWURADZE nyɛ nokwar dasefo turododo wɔ hɛn ntamu, sɛ yɛannyɛ dɛ mbrɛ asɛm nyina a EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze bɔsoma wo wɔ hɛn nkyɛn no tse a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Sɛ oye o, sɛ omuo o, yebetsie EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn a yɛasoma wo ne nkyɛn no ndze: ama sɛ yetsie EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ne ndze a oeesi hɛn yie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ dadu soe ekyir no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna ɔfrɛɛ Karea ba Johanan, na dɔm no mu asafohen a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no nyina, na ɔman no nyinara, ofi ekumaba do kesi ɔkɛse do,
title: JEREMIAH

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn a hom somaa me ne nkyɛn dɛ memfa hom nkotoserɛ nkɔto n’enyim no, ɔse nye yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Sɛ hom bɛda ho atsena asaase yi do a, ɔnodze mibesi hom, na murunndwuruw hom nngu famu, na matsɛw hom, na menntutu hom ase: na menu moho wɔ mbusu a mabɔ hom no ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mma hom nnsuro Babilɔnhen a hom suro no no; mma hom nnsuro no, EWURADZE na ɔse: na mowɔ hom nkyɛn dɛ mebɛgye hom nkwa, na meyi hom efi ne nsamu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mibenya mbɔbɔrhu ama hom, na oehu hom mbɔbɔr, na ɔama hom asan akɔ homankasa hom asaase do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na sɛ hom ka dɛ, Yɛrenntsena asaase yi do; ma dɛm no hom enntsie EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne ndze;
title: JEREMIAH

text: dɛ, Oho; na yɛbɔkɔ Egypt asaase do, mbrɛ yennkohu asayɛ, eso yɛnnkɛtse akasamu ne ndze, eso yennkedzi edzibankɔm; na yɛatsena hɔ a;
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔnodze afei, Juda nkaasefo, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm: mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, Sɛ hom dze si hom enyi do pɛpɛɛpɛ dɛ Egypt ara na hom bɔkɔ akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ a:
title: JEREMIAH

text: ɔnodze ɔbɛba dɛ, afona a hom suro no bɔto hom Egypt asaase do hɔ, na ɔkɔm a hom suro no betsiw hom dzendzenndzen wɔ Egypt hɔ; na hɔ na hom bowuwu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm na ɔbɛyɛ hɔn mbarimba nyinara a wɔdze esi hɔn enyi do pɛpɛɛpɛ dɛ Egypt ara na wɔbɔkɔ akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ no nye yi; wobowuwu afona, na ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm ano: na hɔn mu biara rennka anaa oefi mbusu a medze bɛba hɔn do no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Dɛ mbrɛ m’ebufuw na m’ebufuhyew ehue egu Jerusalɛm mba do no, dɛmara so na, sɛ ekɛhɛn Egypt a, m’ebufuhyew bohue egu hom do: na hom bɛyɛ ekyiwadze, na ahobowdze, na ndom, na ahorohoraadze; na hom nnkohu bea yi bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Juda nkaasefo, EWURADZE aka wɔ hom do dɛ, Mma hom nnkɔ Egypt: hom nhu no kotoo dɛ medzi hom dase ndɛ da yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hom adaadaa homankasa hom akra; osiandɛ hom somaa me EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne nkyɛn, dɛ, Yi EWURADZE, hɛn Nyankopɔn mpaa ma hɛn; na dza EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn bɛse nyina, dɛmara na ka kyerɛ hɛn, na yɛbɛyɛ:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na ndɛ da yi mapaa mu aka akyerɛ hom; na hom enntsie EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne ndze, wɔ dza ɔdze somaa me hom nkyɛn no mu biara mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi afei hom nhu no ampaara dɛ hom bowuwu afona, ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm ano, wɔ bea a hom kɔn dɔ dɛ hom bɛyɛ hɔ amamforafo no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Jeremia kaa ɔman no nyina hɔn EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ne nsɛm a hɔn EWURADZE Nyankopɔn dze somaa no hɔn nkyɛn no nyina wiei no, mekyerɛ nsɛm yi nyina no,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hosaia ba Azaria, na Karea ba Johanan, na ahopɔwfo no nyina kasaa kyerɛɛ Jeremia, dɛ, Eka atorsɛm: EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn no ɔnnsomaa wo dɛ bɛse dɛ, Mma hom nnkɔ Egypt nnkɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na Neria ba Baruk na opiapia wo tsia hɛn, ma oeyi hɛn ahyɛ Kaldeafo nsa, ma woeekuku hɛn, na wɔaasoa hɛn ndɔmmum akɔ Babilɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Karea ba Johanan, na dɔm no mu asafohemfo no nyina, na ɔman no nyina, woenntsie EWURADZE ne ndze dɛ wɔbɛtsena Juda asaase do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Karea ba Johanan, na dɔm no mu asafohen no nyina wɔfaa Juda nkaase nyina a wɔasan efi amanaman a wɔpaam hɔn kɔr hɔ nyina mu abɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ Juda;
title: JEREMIAH

text: mbarimba, na mbaa, na mbofraba, na ɔhen ne mbabaa no, na nyimpa biara a aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan daan no gyaa Safan ba Ahikam ne ba Gedalia ne nkyɛn no, na nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia, na Neria ba Baruk;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na wɔbaa Egypt asaase do; na woenntsie EWURADZE ne ndze: na wɔbaa Tapanhes mpo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Jeremia nkyɛn wɔ Tapanhes, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Fa abo akɛse wɔ wo nsamu, na fa hyehyɛ ntaayaa nsɛwee a ɔwɔ Farao fie abowano wɔ Tapanhes no mu, wɔ Juda mbarimba no enyim;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hwɛ, mobɔsoma akɛfa Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar m’akowaa no, na medze n’akɔngua esi abo a medze ahyehyɛ ha yi do; na ɔaheran n’akatamanso do wɔ do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba abɔbɔ Egypt asaase; hɔn a wɔsɛ owu no, wobowu, na hɔn a wɔsɛ ndɔmmum kɔ no, wɔakɔ ndɔmmum, na hɔn a wɔsɛ afona no, afona aka hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mobɔsɔ gya wɔ Egypt abosom efi mu, na ɔbɛhyew hɔn, na ɔasoa hɔn akɔ ndɔmmum: na ɔdze Egypt asaase bofura dɛ mbrɛ oguanhwɛfo dze n’atar hyɛ; na ofi hɔ befir edzi asomdwee mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Obobu Bɛt-semes a ɔwɔ Egypt asaase do no n’edum no; na ɔdze gya ahyew Egypt abosom efi no nyina.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a ɔbaa Jeremia hɔ wɔ Jewfo nyina a wɔtse Egypt asaase do a wɔtsetse Migidɔl, na Tapanhes, na Nof, na Patros asaase do no ho, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hom ehu mbusu a medze maba Jerusalɛm do nyina, na Juda nkurow nyinara do; na, hwɛ, ndɛ da yi wɔayeyɛ amamfo, na nyimpa biara nntse do;
title: JEREMIAH

text: osian hɔn emumuyɛ a wɔayɛ dze eyi me ebufuw ntsi, wɔ dɛ wɔkɔree kɛhyeew nduhuam, na wɔkɔsoom abosom afofor a hom nnyim hɔn ntsi, hɔn o, hom o, hom egyanom o.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso mosomaa mo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara baa hom nkyɛn, mosoɛɛr ahema na mosomaa hɔn, dɛ, Ao, mma hom nnyɛ ekyiwadze a mikyir no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na woenntsie, eso wɔammbrɛ hɔn aso adze dɛ wɔbɛsan efi hɔn emumuyɛ ho, dɛ wɔnnkɛhyew nduhuam ama abosom afofor.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi na m’ebufuhyew na m’ebufuw huei gui, na ɔdzɛwee wɔ Juda nkurow na Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu; ma ayeyɛ ekurofo na amamfo, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi afei mbrɛ EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bɔ mbusu yi tsia homankasa hom akra, dɛ hom botwitwa hom mu ɔbarimba na ɔbaa, abɔdomaba na enumfoanoba efi Juda mu, dɛ mma wonngyaa hom nkaa bi;
title: JEREMIAH

text: wɔ dɛ hom dze hom nsaano edwuma yi me ebufuw, dɛ hom rehyew nduhuam ama abosom afofor wɔ Egypt asaase a hom akɔ do akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ no do; ama woeekuruw hom ase, na hom aayɛ ndom na ahorohoraadze wɔ asaase do amanaman nyinara mu?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ana hom werɛ efir hom egyanom emumuyɛ na Juda ahemfo emumuyɛ, na hɔn yernom emumuyɛ, homankasa hom emumuyɛ, na hom yernom emumuyɛ a wɔyɛɛ no Juda asaase do, na Jerusalɛm abrɔn no mu?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔmmbrɛɛ hɔnho adze ara dze bodu ndɛ da yi mpo, eso wonnsuroi, eso wɔnnantseew me mbra, anaa m’ahyɛdze a medze mesi hom enyim, na hom egyanom enyim.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hwɛ, medze m’enyi bɛsa hom do, ma aayɛ hom mbusu, mekyerɛ dɛ wobokuruw Juda nyinara ase.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛfa Juda nkaase a wɔdze esi hɔn enyim dɛ wɔbɔkɔ Egypt asaase do akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ no, na hɔn nyinara wɔasa: Egypt asaase do na wɔbɔtotɔ; wɔbɛhyew wɔ afona na ɔkɔm ano; wobowuwu, ofi ekumaba do kesi ɔkɛse do, wɔ afona na ɔkɔm ano: na wɔbɛyɛ ekyiwadze, na ahobowdze, na ndom, na ahorohoraa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛtsea hɔn a wɔtse Egypt asaase do no, dɛ mbrɛ medze afona, ɔkɔm, na ɔyardɔm matsea Jerusalɛm no:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na Juda nkaase a wɔkɔ Egypt aakɛyɛ hɔ amamforafo, no mu obi rimmfi nsa anaaso ɔnnka, dɛ wɔbɛsan aba Juda asaase a hom enya akɔndɔ dɛ hom bɛtsena do: na obiara rennsan, gyedɛ hɔn a wobefi nsa no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna mbarimba no a wonyim dɛ hɔn yernom hyeew eduhuam maa abosom afofor bi no, na mbaa a wogyinagyina nkyɛn no nyina, kuw kɛse pa a, mekyerɛ nkorɔfo a wɔtse Egypt asaase do, wɔ Patros no nyina, wobuaa Jeremia, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔfa asɛm a aka akyerɛ hɛn wɔ EWURADZE dzin mu no dze, yerinntsie wo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbom ɔyɛ ara na yɛbɛyɛ asɛm biara a oefi hɛn anomu efir, dɛ yɛbɛhyew eduhuam ama ɔsor ɔhembaa no, na yɛabɔ ɔnom afɔr ama no, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn na hɛn egyanom, hɛn ahemfo na mbapɔmba, yɛayɛ wɔ Juda nkurow mu, na Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu: na ber no na yenyaa edziban bafuu, na yedzii yie, na yeennhu mbusu biara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ofitsi ber a yegyaa dɛ yɛhyew eduhuam ma ɔsor ɔhembaa, na yɛbɔ ɔnom afɔr ma no no, adze nyina abɔ hɛn, na yeewie sa wɔ afona na ɔkɔm ano.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na yɛhyeew eduhuam maa ɔsor ɔhembaa, na yɛbɔɔ ɔnom afɔr maa no no, aso yɛyɛɛ tatar maa no dɛ yɛdze rosɔr no, na yekwetsir hɛn kunnom bɔɔ ɔnom afɔr maa no?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Jeremia see ɔman no nyina, mbarimba, na mbaa, mekyerɛ nkorɔfo a wobuaa no no nyina, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Eduhuam a hom na hom egyanom, hom ahemfo na hom mbapɔmba, na asaase no do nkorɔfo, hom hyewee wɔ Juda nkurow, na Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu no, aso EWURADZE annkaa, na ɔammba n’adwen mu a?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ma dɛm no EWURADZE enntum annsɔw bio, osian hom emumuyɛ, na ekyiwadze a hom ayɛ no ntsi; dɛm ntsi na hom asaase adan amamfo, na ahobowdze, na ndom a obiara nnyi mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Osiandɛ hom ahyew eduhuam, na osiandɛ hom ayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE, na hom enntsie EWURADZE ne ndze, eso wɔannantsew ne mbra, na n’ahyɛdze, na n’adasesɛm do ntsi; dɛm ntsi na mbusu yi ato hom dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Bio so Jeremia see ɔman no nyina, na mbaa no nyina dɛ, Juda a hom wɔ Egypt asaase do nyina, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm:
title: JEREMIAH

text: mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi, dɛ: Hom na hom yernom dze hom ano aka, na hom dze hom nsa ahyɛ no ma, dɛ, Ɔba ara na yɛbɛma hɛn nsuaa a yesuae no aba mu, dɛ yɛbɛhyew eduhuam ama ɔsor ɔhembaa no, na yɛabɔ ɔnom afɔr ama no: hom mma hom nsuaa ntsim, na hom mma hom nsuaa mbra mu ɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi hom Judafo a hom tse Egypt asaase do nyina, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm: Hwɛ, maka me dzin kɛse no ho ntam, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ wɔnnkɔbɔ me dzin bio wɔ Judanyi biara anomu wɔ Egypt asaase nyinara do, dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn tse ase yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, moroweɔn hɔn wɔ mbusu ho, na nnyɛ papa a: na Juda mbarimba a wɔwɔ Egypt asaase do nyinara bɛhyew afona na ɔkɔm ano, dze ekodu dɛ woewie sa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hɔn a wofi afona nsa no, wɔbɛsan efi Egypt asaase do, hɔn dodow kumaabi, na Juda nkaa a wɔkɔ Egypt asaase do akɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ hɔ no nyina, wobohu nyia n’asɛm begyina, sɛ medze o, hɔndze o.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na iyi bɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze ama hom, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ mebɛtsea hom bea yi do ha, ama hom eehu dɛ me nsɛm begyina ara ampa ayɛ mbusu etsia hom:
title: JEREMIAH

text: mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, medze Egypthen Farao Hofra bɛhyɛ n’atamfo nsa; dɛ mbrɛ medze Judahen Zedekia mehyɛɛ ne tamfo, na nyia ɔhwehwɛɛ no nkwa, Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar no, ne nsa no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia kaa kyerɛɛ Neria ba Baruk, ber a ɔkyerɛɛw nsɛm yi fii Jeremia anomu hyɛɛ nwoma mu wɔ Josia ba Jehoiakim n’afe a otsia anan no mu, dɛ,
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ka kyerɛ ɔwo, Baruk, nye yi:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Eka dɛ, Afei mundue! Na EWURADZE dze awerɛhow aka me yaw ho; maberɛ na m’apensi, na minnya ahomgye biara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm na ka kyerɛ no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, dza mesi no, mubodwuruw, na dza matsɛw no, metutu; na iyi besi asaase no nyinara do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na erohwehwɛ ndzɛmba akɛse ama woho anaa? Mma nnhwehwɛ: na, hwɛ, medze mbusu bɛba adasamba nyinara do, EWURADZE na ɔse: na medze mo nkwa bɛma wo ayɛ afonam wɔ mbea a erokɔ do nyinara do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE asɛm a ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia hɔ wɔ amanaman ho:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Egypt dze: wɔ Egypthen Farao Neko no dɔm a wɔwɔ esutsen Eufrates ho wɔ Karkemis a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar bɔɔ no wɔ Josia ba Jehoiakim, Judahen no, n’afe a otsia anan no mu no ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nkra nkataenyim na kyɛm, na hom ntwe mbɛn akono.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nhyehyɛ mpɔnkɔ no, na hom ntsenatsena do! Hom nsoa hom dadzekyɛw ngyinagyina hɔ; hom mpɔw hom mpeaa no ho, hom nhyehyɛ hom dadzentar.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na muhu dɛ hɔn bo etutu yi? Wɔadan hɔn ekyir; wɔabɔ hɔn akatakyi no egu, na woeguan ntsɛntsɛm. Wommbu hɔn kɔn ekyir: hu wɔ mbea nyina, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔhoɔharfo nntum nnguan nnkɔ, eso ɔkatakyi mmfi nsa; kwaamu afamu esutsen Eufrates ho na woefintsiw na wɔahwehwe ase.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Woana na ɔasoɛr noho yi dɛ Nael a n’esu bu asorɛkye begyabegya dɛ nsutsen yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Egypt asoɛr dɛ Nael, dɛ nsutsen a n’esu rubu asorɛkye begyabegya: na ɔse, Mibeyir, mebɛkata asaase no do; mebɛsɛɛ kurow no na no mu mba no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mpɔnkɔ e, hom mbɔ mfa mu; na ntseaseanam e, hom mbɔ kyirdidi! Hom mma akatakyi mfir edzi: Kus na Put a wokurakura kyɛm; na Ludfo a wokurakura egyen, na wɔkontokontom no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na da no yɛ EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE, ne da, awerdzi da a, ama oeedzi n’atamfo wer: na afona bedzidzi amee, na ɔanom hɔn bɔgyaa ɔabow: na EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE, wɔ okum afɔr bi wɔ kwaa mu asaase do wɔ esutsen Eufrates ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Egypt ne babaa ɔbaabun e, fow kɔ Gilead kɛgye edur! Eyɛ edur pii kwa; ɔyarsa biara nnyi hɔ ma wo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Amanaman atse w’enyimguase, na wo nkekamu ahyɛ asaase ma tɔ: na ɔkatakyi asoasoa ɔkatakyi do, hɔn beenu no abɔ mu ahwe ase.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia, mbrɛ Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar bɛba abɔbɔ Egypt asaase no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mpaa mu nka no Egypt, na hom mfa ntahye Migidɔl, hom ntahye no Nof na Tapanhes: hom nka dɛ, Gyina kan, na siesie woho; na afona no bedzidzi etwa wo ho ehyia.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’ahoɔdzenfo wɔapra hɔn kɔ yi? Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na w’anantwi enngyina? Osiandɛ EWURADZE paam hɔn kɔree.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔmaa pii fintsifintsiwii, nyew, wɔhwehwee ase dedaa hɔnho do: na wɔsee dɛ, Hom nsoɛr ma yɛnsan nkɔ hɛn nkorɔfo, na hɛn awobea no do hɔ, mfi afona a ɔrehyɛ hɛn no ano.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔkekaa mu wɔ hɔ dɛ, Egypthen Farao yɛ dede ara kwa; ɔama hyɛber no etwa mu asen.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Metse ase yi, Ɔhen a ne dzin dze dɔm EWURADZE no na ɔse, ampaara mbrɛ Tabor tse wɔ mbepɔw mu, na mbrɛ Karmel tse wɔ po ho no, dɛmara na no so bɛba.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔwo babaa a etse Egypt, siesie woho kɔ ndɔmmum mu: na Nof bɛdan amamfo, na wɔahyew a, obi renntsena do bio.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Egypt yɛ ɔnantwiber a no ho yɛ fɛw; na ɔsɛɛ fi kwaamu afamu aba no do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: N’apaafo so a wɔtse no mu no, wɔtse dɛ nantwibuw mu anantwimba; na hɔn so wɔadandan hɔnho na wɔabɔ mu eguanguan, woenngyina: osiandɛ hɔn mbusu da, hɔn sera ber no, aba hɔn do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ne ndze bɛgyegye dɛ ɔwɔ dze; osiandɛ n’atamfo nam reba, na wɔdze nkuma aba no do, dɛ nduatowfo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wobobu no kwaa, EWURADZE na ɔse, naaso worunntum nnhwehwɛ mu; osiandɛ wɔdɔɔ so sen mbɛbɛw, na wɔkan hɔn dodow a ɔnnyɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔbɛma Egypt babaa n’enyi ato; wobeyi no ahyɛ kwaa mu ɔman no nsa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, ɔse dɛ: Hwɛ mebɛtsea Amon a ɔwɔ No, na Farao, na Egypt ɔnye n’abosom, na n’ahemfo; mekyerɛ Farao na hɔn a wɔtwer no no:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na mibeyi hɔn mahyɛ hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ hɔn nkwa no nsa, na Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar nsa, na n’akowaa nsa: na n’ekyir no wɔbɛtsena do dɛ tsetse nda no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔwo m’akowaa Jakob, mma nnsuro, na Israel so, mma wo bo nntu: na, hwɛ, mebɛgye wo nkwa mefi ekyirekyir, na w’asefo efi ndɔmmum asaase do: na Jakob bɛsan, na ɔbɛtsena ase dwudwoodwo, na obiara remma onnsuro.
title: JEREMIAH

text: M’akowaa Jakob, mma nnsuro, EWURADZE na ɔse; na mowɔ wo nkyɛn: na mebɛma amanaman a mabɔ hɔn apetse do no woewie sa, naaso ɔwo dze, meremma innwie sa; na mbom mebɛtsea wo dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata, na meremma emmfa woho tɔtrɔtɔ ara da.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE asɛm a ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia hɔ wɔ Filistiafo ho ansaana Farao robɔ Gaza.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, esu rema noho do efi kwaamu afamu, na ɔabɛyɛ ɔwora a oeyir, na ɔaseram asaase no na dza ɔwɔ mu nyina do, kurow no na hɔn a wɔtse mu do: na nyimpa bɛkeka mu, na hɔn a wɔtse asaase no do no nyina abɔ mbubuw.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mpɔnkɔ hɔn ntɔtse a osisi famu pipi no ne gyegye, ne ntseaseanam ne nkyirdidi, no nhwiir no kurduduyɛ ntsi, egyanom nndan hɔn enyi nnhwɛ hɔn mba wɔ hɔn nsa a agow ntsi;
title: JEREMIAH

text: osian da a ɔreba no ntsi, ɔreba abɛsɛɛ Filistiafo nyina, ebotwitwa Taere na Sidon ɔboafo a ɔaka biara efi hɔ: osiandɛ EWURADZE resɛɛ Filistiafo, Kaftor nsupruw mu hɔn a wɔaka no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Etsipaa aba Gaza do; Ashkelon ataa dzinn na hɔn bɔnsa mu nkaa no asɛɛ pasaa: ebɔtotow woho akam ekesi dabɛn?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao, EWURADZE n’afona! Onkodu dabɛn ara na ayɛ komm? Fa woho kɛhyɛ wo bɔha mu; gye w’ahom, na taa dzinn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ibesi dɛn ayɛ komm, ber a EWURADZE dze asodzi bi ahyɛ wo nsa yi? Ashkelon, na mpoano hɔ na ɔahyɛ dɛ ɔmbra.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Moab dze, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Nebo ndue, osiandɛ wɔabɔ no! Woegu Kiriataim n’enyim ase, wɔagye: woegu aban dzendzen no n’enyim ase na wɔadwerew no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nkamfo nnyi hɔ bio mma Moab; woetu no ho egyina bɔn wɔ Hesbon dɛ, Hom mbra, ma yentwa no nkyen mma ɔaannyɛ ɔman bio. Madmen, ɔwo so wɔbɛma ayɛ foo; afona betsiw wo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nkekamu ndze fi Horonaim, afofa na ɔsɛɛ kɛse!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔasɛɛ Moab; no nkɔkowaba rekeka mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Luhit afowee na wɔdze osu araa bɔfow akɔ sor; na Horonaim esianee na wɔatse ɔsɛɛ ne nkekamu ho mbubuwbɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nguanguan, hom ngye hom akra nkwa, na hom nyɛ dɛ sar do asoaso.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na osiandɛ ɔwo atwer wo ndwuma na w’akoradze ntsi, wo so wɔbɛfa wo: na Kemos bɔkɔ ndɔmmum, n’asɔfoe na n’asafohen ka ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na afofanyi no bɛba kurow biara do, na kurow biara rimmfi nsa; bɔnsa so bɛhera, na asaase taae asɛɛ; dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE aka no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mma Moab nkaadum, na ɔsɛɛ ara na wɔbɛsɛɛ no: no nkurow bɛyɛ amamfo, na obiara nnkɛtsena mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ndom nka nyia ɔyɛ EWURADZE n’edwuma akwadwer mu, na ndom nka nyia osianka n’afona fi bɔgya mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Moab atsena ase ahodwe mu fi ne mbofraber mu, na ɔagyen ataa n’ase dɛ wenyin, na wonnhuee no mmfii adze kor mu nnkɔr adze kor mu, eso ɔnnkɔr ndɔmmum da: dɛm ntsi na ne dɛw aka no mu, na no huam so nnsakyeree.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, mobɔsoma hɔn a wohue gu ma wɔaaba no do, ma woeehue no egu, na wɔaabobɔ hɔn mbɔdambɔ no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Moab n’enyi bɔto Kemos ho, dɛ mbrɛ Israel fifo hɔn enyi too hɔn awerɛhyɛmu Bɛtɛl ho no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom se dɛ, Yɛyɛ akatakyi na akofo a yebotum ɔko no?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nyia ɔbɔɔ Moab na no nkurow no afow kɔ mu, na ne mberantsɛ a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn no esian kɔ ekumii, ɔhen a ne dzin dze dɔm EWURADZE no na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Moab no mbusu abɛn reba, na n’amandzehu reba ntsɛntsɛm.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom a hom abɔ no ho aprɔw nyina, hom ngyam no, na hom a hom nyim ne dzin nyina; hom nse dɛ, Nhwɛ, mbrɛ poma a ɔyɛ dzen, na enyimnyam abaa no, edua ebu a!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔwo babaa a etse Dibon, fi w’enyimnyam mu sian, na tsena nsukɔm mu, na nyia ɔfa Moab afo no aba wo do, ɔasɛɛ w’aban dzendzen no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom a hom tse Aroer e, kegyina akwan nkyɛn, na tsɛw: bisa nyia oruguan, na nyia oefi nsa no; se dɛ, Wɔyɛ no dɛn?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Woegu Moab n’enyim ase; osiandɛ woedwuruw no egu famu: hom mbɔ mbubuw na hom nkekamu; hom nka wɔ Arnon dɛ, Moab abɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na atsɛmbu aba asaase taae no do; ɔaba Holon, Jahza, Mefaat;
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dibon, Nebo, Bɛt-diblathaim;
title: JEREMIAH

text: Kiriataim, Bɛt-gamul, Bɛt-meon;
title: JEREMIAH

text: Keriot, na Bozra, na Moab asaase do nkorɔfo a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir, na dza wɔbɛn nyina do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Woetwa Moab n’ambɛn, na woebu n’abasa, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mma ɔmbow nsa; osiandɛ okunkoon noho wɔ EWURADZE do: na Moab bɛyankayankam ne fe mu, na ɔno so wɔdze no esi atwetwe.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na aso Israel annyɛ atwetwe amma wo? Aso wohun no ewifo mu? Na ɔwo eka no ho asɛm ara apem a, ewosow wo tsir.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao Moab mba e, hom ndan nkurow no ngya, na hom ntsena abotan do. Hom nyɛ dɛ ebubur a ɔyɛ no buw wɔ itu no ano no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Yɛatse Moab n’ahokyerɛ, dɛ ɔkyerɛ no ho dodow; n’ahomemado, na no nkontompɔ, na n’ahopɔw, na n’akoma ne ntsɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Minyim n’enyiansɔ, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ ne nyinara gyan; n’ahohyehyɛ enntum hwee yɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi nna mobɔ Moab ho mbubuw; nyew, mebɛkeka mu wɔ Moab nyina ho: na Kir-heres mbarimba ntsi wobedzi nkɔmbɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao Sibma wenyindua, medze dza ɔkyɛn Jazer no su na mubosu wo: w’abaw atra po ekodu Jazer po ho mpo: wo hyewber nduadzewa na wo wenyin nduadzewa do na ɔsɛɛfo no ebotu ahyɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na woeyi enyigye na dɛw efi mfuwa prɔmprɔm na Moab asaase no do; na mama wenyin asa wɔ wenyinntwer no mu: obiara mmfa esebɔ ntsiatsia do; esebɔ no rennyɛ enyigye esebɔ bi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ofi Hesbon nkekamu no do dze kesi Eleale mpo, dze kesi Jahaz mpo, na wɔama hɔn ndze do, ofi Zoar dze kesi Horonaim mpo, dze kesi Eglath-selisiya: na Nimrim esuesu bɛdan asaase kɛsɛɛ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Bio so mebɛma nyia ɔbɔ afɔr wɔ no mu sorɔnsorɔmbea, na nyia ɔhyew nduhuam ma n’abosom no abɔ adze wɔ Moab.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi m’akoma gyegye ma Moab dɛ atɛntɛbɛn, na m’akoma gyegye dɛ atɛntɛbɛn ma Kir-heres mbarimba: dɛm ntsi adze pii a woenya no ahera.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ne tsir nyina apepa, na n’abɔdwesa nyina ekukuw: nsa nyina ho ayɛ akam akam, na eyitam sisi asen.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Moab adan nyina etsifi na n’abrɔn do sukwadwom wɔ mbea nyina: na mabɔ Moab dɛ senaba a enyigye nnyi mu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ woesi edwuruw no a! Mbrɛ wodua bɔ mbubuw a! Mbrɛ Moab edua dze enyito adan n’ekyir a! Dɛm na Moab bɛyɛ atwetwesi na akomatu ama hɔn a wɔabɔ no ho aprɔw nyina.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, obotu dɛ ɔkɔr, na ɔatserɛw ne ntsaban mu aba Moab do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Keriot wɔagye, na wɔakɔ n’akoban no ntuae. Da no mu, Moab mbarimba akatakyi hɔn akoma bɛyɛ dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo n’akoma.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔbɛsɛɛ Moab ma ɔrennyɛ ɔman bio, osiandɛ oekunkon noho wɔ EWURADZE do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Moab mba e, suro, na mona, na efir, aba wo do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nyia obefi suro enyim eguan no ɔbɔkɔtɔ mona no mu; na nyia ɔbɔfow efi mona no mu no, efir no bɛpa no: osiandɛ medze asotwe bɛba ɔno noara Moab no do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hɔn a woguanee a wonnyi ahoɔdzen no gyinagyina Hesbon nwinwin ase: na gya fir Hesbon efir edzi, na gyaframee fi Sihon ne finimfin, na ɔahyew Moab no kutuwdo, na weɔɔweɔɔyɛfo no hɔn etsifi pampamu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Moab, due! Kemos man abɔ: na wɔafa wo mbabanyin no ndɔmmum, na wɔdze wo mbabaa kɔ ndɔmmumkɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso medze Moab befi ndɔmmum asan aba wɔ nda a odzi ekyir no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse. Iyi nye Moab do atsɛmbu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dza ɔfa Ammonmba ho. Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Aso Israel nnyi mbabanyin? Aso onnyi owuodzi? Afei ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na Malkam enya Gad, na no nkorɔfo tsenatsena no nkurow mu yi?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, mebɛma wɔatse ɔko na esebɔ ndze etsia Rabaa a ɔyɛ Ammonmba dze no; na ɔbɛdan amamfo isiw, na wɔdze ogya ahyew ne mbabaa; nna Israel bɛpam hɔn a wɔpaam no no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hesbon e, bɔ mbubuw, na Ai asɛɛ! Rabaa mbabaa, hom nkeka mu, hom mfura eyitam: hom ntwa sukwadwom, na hom ndzi akɔnaaba wɔ mban mu; na Milkɔm bɔkɔ ndɔmmum, n’asɔfoe na n’asafohemfo nyina.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔbabaa ekyirsannyi, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ehyehyɛ woho wɔ w’ahoɔdzen mu, w’ahoɔdzen a ɔrokɔ famu no mu? Ɔwo a edze wo werɛ hyɛɛ w’egyapadze mu, dɛ, Woana bɛba mo do?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, medze hu fi hɔn a woetwa wo ho ehyia nyina nkyɛn mebɛba wo do, EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse; na wɔbɔbɔ hom apetse, hom mu nyimpa biara akɔ n’enyim, a obiara nnkɔboaboa eguamfo no ano.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na n’ekyir no medze Ammonmba no befi ndɔmmum asan aba, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Edom dze. Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Aso nyansa nnyi Teman bio? Aso apam ahera abadwembafo? Aso hɔn nyansaa etu ayew?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nguan, hom nsan ekyir, hom ntsena mbrɛ ɔdɔ, Ao Dedanfo! Na medze Esau no mbusu mebɛba no do ber a medze n’asotwe bɛba no do no!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Sɛ wenyin abatsewfo mpo na wɔbaa wo do a, aso nkyɛ wonnkegya wenyinaba mpɛpɛw bi? Sɛ ewifo baa anadwe a, nkyɛ hɔn mpo wɔnnkɛsɛɛ ara ekodu dza ɔbɔso hɔn?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Naaso emi dze, mama Esau no ho ada hɔ, mama no sumabea ada edzi; na orunntum nnsuma noho. N’asefo asɛɛ, na no nuanom, na n’efisamenafo, na onnyi hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dan wo ngyanka mba no gya, mobɔkora hɔn do enyikan; na ma w’ekunafo mfa hɔn werɛ ntwer me.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, sɛ hɔn a wɔmmfata dɛ wɔbɔnom kɔɔpow no mu no mpo wɔbɔnom ara ampa a; nna aso ɔwo na ebɛfa woho edzi sɔnn? Ennkɛfa woho edzi sɔnn, na ɔnom ara na ebɔnom.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na maka moho ntam, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ Bozra bɛdan ahobowdze, atwetwesidze, amamfo, na ndom, na no nkurow nyinara bɛyɛ amamfo daa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Matse amandzɛɛ bi wɔ EWURADZE nkyɛn, na wɔasoma ahembɔfo wɔ amanaman mu, dɛ, Hom mboa hom ano, na hom mbra no do, na hom nsoɛr mbra akono.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na, hwɛ, mebɛyɛ wo amanaman mu aketseaba, na adasa mu nyia woebu no enyimtsia.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na w’etsiɔdzendze, w’akoma ne ntsɛn adaadaa wo, ɔwo a etse ɔbotan ne mpaapaae mu, ɔwo a akoko a ɔkrɔn kitsa wo nsamu: kaansa eyɛ wo buw wɔ ɔsorsor dɛ ɔkɔr mpo a, medze wo befi hɔ esi famu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Edom bɛdan ahobowdze: obiara a otwa mu wɔ ho no no ho bɔbow no, na ɔabɔ no mu ayardɔm nyina ho nhwiroma.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛ mbrɛ Sodom na Gomora na nkurow a wɔdeda ho no hɔn mbutuwii tse no, EWURADZE na ɔse, dasanyi biara renntsena hɔ, eso ɔdasanyi ne ba biara rennyɛ ɔmamforanyi wɔ hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, ɔbɔfow aba dɛ gyata fi Jordan ne ntsɛn no mu aba tsenabea a ɔyɛ dzen no do: na mebɛma oefi ne nkyɛn eguan awerɛfir mu; na obiara a wɔsan mu yi no no, ɔnoara na medze no besi no do: na woana na ɔtse dɛ emi? Woana bɛhyɛ me ber? Woana nye oguanhwɛfo a obotum m’enyim gyina?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ntsie EWURADZE n’apam a ɔrepam wɔ Edom ho; na ne tsirmpɔw a ɔabɔ wɔ Teman atsefo ho: Ampaara, wobotwuw hɔn adze akɔ dɛ nguankuw mu nkakraba mpo; ampaara ɔbɛma hɔn tsenabea ayɛ amamfo aka hɔn ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hɔn asehwe ne dede ntsi, asaase no popo; nkekamu heei wɔ hɔ a wɔtse ne nka wɔ Mbɛw Po no ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, ɔbɔfow aba na oetu dɛ ɔkɔr, na ɔatserɛw ne ntsaban mu wɔ Bozra do: na da no Edom mbarimba akatakyi hɔn akoma bɛyɛ dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo n’akoma.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Damaskɔs dze. Hamat n’enyi ato, na Arpad; osiandɛ wɔatse nsɛmbɔn, suro ekitsa hɔn: po do ayɛ begyabegya; wonntum nntaa dzinn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Damaskɔs ayɛ mberɛw, ɔadan noho ruguan, na ahopopo ekitsa no: ahoguan na awerɛhow ekitsa no, dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ayɛyi kurow no, m’enyigye kurow no, mbrɛ oesi adan no egya?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi ne mberantsɛ bɔtotɔ wɔ n’abrɔn no mu, na woetwitwa n’asambarimba nyinara egu wɔ da no mu, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mobɔsɔ gya wɔ Damaskɔs fasu no mu, na ɔahyew Ben-hadad n’ahemfi no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Kedar, na Hazor n’ahenman a Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar bɔɔ no no ho dze. Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hom nsoɛr, hom nkɔ Kedar, na hom nkɛsɛɛ bokamba no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mfa hɔn asesee na hɔn nguankuw; hom nsoa hɔn ntwamuatam, na hɔn ndzepa, na hɔn efumpɔnkɔ mma hom ho: na hom ntseatsea mu dɛ, Hu etwa hɛnho nyina ehyia.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao Hazormba e, hom nguan, hom nkyin nkɔ ekyirekyir, hom nkosuma mbrɛ hɔ dɔ, EWURADZE na ɔse. Osiandɛ Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar akɔ hom tsir do apam na ɔabɔ hom ho tsirmpɔw bi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nsoɛr, hom nsoɛr nkɔ ɔman a hɔn ho adwe hɔn a wɔtse hɔ dwudwoodwo no do, EWURADZE na ɔse; hɔn a wonnyi mbobotsen na adaban a hɔn nko ara na wɔtse no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na hɔn efumpɔnkɔ bɛyɛ asadze, na hɔn anantwi dodow ayɛ afonam: na mobɔbɔ hɔn a woetwitwa ntakuwa no ma apetse mframa nyina mu; na medze hɔn mbusu befi mbea nyina aba hɔn do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Hazor bɛyɛ mpataku tsenabea, amamfo daa: ɔdasanyi biara renntsena hɔ, eso ɔdasanyi ne ba biara rennyɛ ɔhɔho wɔ mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Iyi nye EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia hɔ wɔ Elam ho wɔ Judahen Zedekia n’ahendzi ahyɛse no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, mubobubu Elam egyen, hɔn tum ne tsitsir mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na medze mframa anan mibefi ɔsor mfɛndzanan maba Elam do, na mabɔ hɔn apetse mframa anan no mu nyinara; na ɔman biara nnyi hɔ a Elam tokyemfo no wonnkodu hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛma Elam hɔn akoma etu hɔn atamfo, na hɔn a wɔrohwehwɛ hɔn nkwa no enyim: na medze mbusu mebɛba hɔn do, mekyerɛ m’ebufuw hyeehyew no a, EWURADZE na ɔse; na mebɛma afona etsiw hɔn ekodu dɛ mewie hɔn sa:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na medze m’ahengua mibesi Elam, na masɛɛ ɔhen na mbapɔmba mefi hɔ, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ nda a odzi ekyir no mu no, medze Elam befi ndɔmmum asan aba, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a EWURADZE nam nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia do kaa tsiaa Babilɔn wɔ Kaldeafo asaase ho no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mpaa mu nka wɔ amanaman mu na hom mfa ntahye, na hom nsi frankaa; hom mfa ntahye, na mma hom nnsiw do: hom nse dɛ, Wɔafa Babilɔn, woegu Bel n’enyim ase, Merodak no bo etu; woegu n’ehonyi enyim ase, n’abosom akoma etutu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔman bi fii kwaamu afamu rutu no do ɔsa a wɔbɛma n’asaase ayɛ amamfo, na obiara renntsena do: woeguanguan, wɔkɔ, nyimpa na mbowa nyina.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nda no mu na aber no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse, Israelmba bɛba, hɔn na Judamba nyina; wɔdze osu botu hɔn kwan wɔakɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔbɛdan hɔn enyim akyerɛ Zion do, woebisa ekyir kwan, dɛ, Hom mbra mfa homho mbɔbɔ EWURADZE ho, wɔ daa ahyɛmudzi a werɛ rimmfir no mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Me man ayɛ nguan a wɔayew: hɔn nguanhwɛfo ama wɔatotɔ gon, na wɔama wɔafomfom kwan wɔ mbepɔw no do: woefi bepɔw do kɔ koko do, hɔn werɛ efir hɔn ahomgyebea.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hɔn a wɔtoo hɔn nyina amemen hɔn: na hɔn atamfo see dɛ, Yɛmmfom, osiandɛ wɔayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE, pɛrpɛr tsenabea, mekyerɛ EWURADZE, hɔn egyanom enyidado no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nguan mfi Babilɔn finimfin, na hom mfir edzi mfi Kaldeafo asaase do nkɔ, na hom nyɛ dɛ mpɔnkyenyin a wodzi nguankuw enyim.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na, hwɛ, mibekenyan amanaman akɛse mboanofo ma wofi kwaamu afamu asaase do aba Babilɔn do; na wobotwa no ho mpasuar; na nkyii wɔbɛfa kurow no: hɔn egyen menaba tse dɛ ɔbarimba katakyi nedze; no mu biara nnsan ekyir kwa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Kaldea bɛyɛ afonam: hɔn a wɔfa no afo nyinara bɛmee, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom a hom foom m’egyapadze fae, kaansa hom enyi agye, na hom ridzi ehurusi, kaansa hom adodɔ seradze dɛ nantwifɔr a ɔroporow eburow, na hom su dɛ mpɔnkɔ abran mpo a;
title: JEREMIAH

text: hom na n’enyi bɔto papaara; nyia ɔwoo hom no n’enyim bogu ase. Hwɛ, ɔbɛyɛ amanaman mu ekyirkafo, sar, asaase kɛsɛɛ, na sar pradada.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Osian EWURADZE n’ebufuw ntsi wɔrenntsena do, na ɔbɛyɛ amamfo koraa: obiara a otwa mu wɔ Babilɔn no no ho bɔbow no, na ɔabɔ nhwiroma wɔ n’amandzehu nyinara ntsi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom a hom kontom egyen nyinara, hom mbaa mpasuar ntwa nhyia Babilɔn ho; hom ntotow mbobɔ no, mma hom nnkam hom egyen menaba do: na ɔayɛ bɔn etsia EWURADZE.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mbɔ ose ngu no do ntwa nhyia; ɔdze noho ama; n’aban ahwehwe ase, n’afasu edwuruw; na EWURADZE n’awerdzi nye no; hom ndzi no wer; dɛ mbrɛ ɔayɛ no, hom so nyɛ no bi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom ntwa duafo no mfi Babilɔn, na nyia osuo kantankrankye no mu wɔ twaber mu no: ahyɛdo afona no ho suro ntsi, hɔn mu biara bɛdan noho akɔ no nkorɔfo hɔ, na hɔn mu obiara eguan akɔ nankasa n’asaase do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Israel yɛ nguantsen a wɔabɔ apetse; ngyata no apam no kɔ; asɔpɔn no Asiriahen bɛtsetseew no mu; na ekyirii Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar yi bobubuu ne mbiew mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Hwɛ, mebɛtsea Babilɔnhen na n’asaase, dɛ mbrɛ matsea Asiriahen yi.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na medze Israel bɛsan aba n’edzidzibea, na oedzidzi wɔ Karmel na Basan, na ne kra amee wɔ Efraim akoko do na Gilead.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nda no mu, na aber no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔbɔhwehwɛ Israel emumuyɛ ekyir kwan, na worinnya bi; na Juda no bɔn so, na wonnkohu: na medze befir hɔn a mebɛdan hɔn megya dɛ nkaasefo no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Tu Merataim asaase no do sa, ɔnoara no do a, na Pekod atsefo no do: kuku na sɛɛ nkaasefo no korakora, EWURADZE na ɔse, na yɛ dɛ mbrɛ mahyɛ wo nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔko ne dede gyegye asaase no do, na ɔsɛɛ kɛse so dze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ woetwitwa na woebubu asaase nyina hamɛr no mu esinesin a! Mbrɛ Babilɔn edua adan amamfo wɔ amanaman mu a!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Babilɔn, mesua wo efir na wɔapa wo so, na ɔwoara ennhu: woehu wo, na wɔakyer wo so, osiandɛ enye EWURADZE edzi aperper.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE ebua n’akoradze dan na woeyi n’ebufuhyew akodze epue: osiandɛ EWURADZE, dɔm EWURADZE no, wɔ dwuma bi dzi wɔ Kaldeafo asaase do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mfir mfɛndzanan mbra no do, hom mbuebue n’eburosan no: hom ntutu no ngu dɛ efiefi, na hom nsɛɛ no huntuhuntu: mma hom mma no mu biribi nnka.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nkuku n’anantwinyin nyina; hom mma wɔnsan nkɔ ekumii. Wondue! Osiandɛ hɔn da edu, hɔn asotweber no a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom ntsie hɔn a woguan na wofi nsa fi Babilɔn asaase do, dɛ wɔrekɛpaa mu aka EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn n’awerdzi, n’asɔrfi ho awerdzi akyerɛ no hɔn ndze.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom mfrɛ egyentofo no nyinara nkɔtoatoa Babilɔn, hɔn a wɔkontom egyen no nyinara; hom mbɔ nseraban ntwa no ho nhyia; mma hom mma no mu obiara mmfi nsa: hom nsusu n’edwuma do nhyɛ no ananmu; dɛ mbrɛ ɔno ɔayɛ nyinara no, hom so nyɛ no bi: osiandɛ ɔayɛ EWURADZE no do nkontompɔ, Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no do a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi na ne mberantsɛ bɔtotɔ n’abrɔn do, na wɔbɛma ne mbarimba akofo nyinara wɔayɛ foo wɔ da no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, ɔwo ɔkontompɔnyi, menye wo enya, EWURADZE, dɔm Ewuradze no na ɔse: osiandɛ wo da no edu, ber a medze bɔtwe w’aso no a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔkontompɔnyi no befintsiw na ɔahwe ase, na obiara remma no do: na mubokua gya wɔ no kurow no mu, na ɔahyew dza abɔ no ho aprɔw nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: wɔatseetsee Israelmba na Juda prɛko: na hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum nyina dzedze hɔn mu dzen; wɔpow dɛ wɔbɛma wɔakɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hɔn pomfo yɛ dzen; ne dzin dze dɔm EWURADZE: obedzi hɔn asɛm kofekofe ama hɔn, na ɔama asaase no ahomgye, na ɔahyɛ Babilɔnfo no ahomtsew.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afona wɔ Kaldeafo do, EWURADZE na ɔse, na Babilɔnfo no do, na n’asafohen na n’enyansafo no do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afona wɔ ahohyehyɛfo no do, na wɔbɛyɛ akwasampafo! Afona wɔ hɔn mbarimba akatakyi no do, na hɔn akoma botutu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afona wɔ hɔn mpɔnkɔ na hɔn ntseaseanam do, na aforaforafo a wɔwɔ no mu no nyina do, ama wɔaayɛ dɛ mbaa: afona wɔ n’akoradze do, ama woeewia.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Weseeyɛ wɔ n’esu do, na wɔbɔwewew: osiandɛ ɔyɛ ehonyi a woesian asaase, na wɔabobɔ adam wɔ abosom ho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi sar do mbowa abɔyafo wɔnye mpataku bɛtsena wɔ hɔ, na nsohor bɛtsena mu: na wɔrenntsena do bio dabiarada; eso wɔrenntsena do bio ofi ebusuasantsen kɛpem ebusuasantsen.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn butuuw Sodom na Gomora na hɔn ho nkurow no, EWURADZE na ɔse; dɛmara so na nyimpa biara renntsena hɔ, eso nyimpa biara rennyɛ ɔmamforanyi wɔ hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, ɔman bi fi kwaamu afamu reba; na wobekenyan ɔman kɛse, na ahemfo pii efi asaase ne mfɛndzanan noho.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wokurakura egyen na peaa; hɔn tsir yɛ dzen, na wonnyi ehumbɔbɔr; hɔn ndze wor dɛ po, na wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do; obiara etwa mpasuar, dɛ ɔbarimba a ɔrokɔ akono wɔ wo do, Ao Babilɔn babaa!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Babilɔnhen atse hɔn nka, na n’abaw egura: nketsenketse akyer no, na yaw a ɔtse dɛ ɔbaa a ɔwɔ awoko mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, ɔbɔfow dɛ gyata fi Jordan ne ntsɛn no mu abɛtsena bea a ɔyɛ dzen no do, na mebɛma woeguan efi me nkyɛn awerɛfir mu; na obiara a wɔasan mu eyi no no, ɔno na medze no besi no do: na woana na ɔtse dɛ emi? Woana na ɔbɛhyɛ me mber? Woana nye oguanhwɛfo no a obegyina m’enyim no?
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ntsie EWURADZE n’apam a ɔapam etsia Babilɔn no; na ne tsirmpɔw a ɔabɔ etsia Kaldeafo asaase no: Ampaara wobotwuw hɔn adze akɔ, mekyerɛ nguankuw mu nkakraba no; ampaara ɔbɛma hɔn tsenabea ayɛ amamfo ama hɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Babilɔn ne gye ne dede ntsi, asaase wosow, na wɔtse nkekamu no wɔ amanaman mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, mobɔbɔ ɔsɛɛ mframa aba Babilɔn do, na hɔn a wɔtse Leb-kamai do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mobɔsoma ahɔho akɔ Babilɔn, na woekohuw no. Wɔbɔto n’asaase no pan: na ɔfona da no mu wobotwa no ho ehyia etsia no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mma egyentonyi no nnkontom n’egyen, na mma ɔmmema noho do wɔ ne dadzetar no mu: na mma hom nngyaa ne mberantsɛ no; hom nsɛɛ no dɔm nyinara huntuhuntu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔbɔtotɔ ahwehwe ase wɔ Kaldeafo asaase do, na woeehwirahwira hɔn mu wɔ n’abrɔn mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Israel anaa Juda hɔn Nyankopɔn, dɔm EWURADZE no, ɔnndaan hɔn nngyaae; kaansa afɔdzi ahyɛ hɔn asaase do ma etsia Israel Krɔnkrɔnnyi no mpo a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nguan mfi Babilɔn mu, na nyimpa biara ngye noho nkwa; mma wonntwa hom nkyen wɔ n’emumuyɛ mu; na EWURADZE n’awerdziber nye no; obotua no n’ahyɛnanmu kaw no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna Babilɔn yɛ sika kɔɔpow wɔ EWURADZE nsamu a ɔmaa asaase nyinara bowee: amanaman anom ne nsa bi; dɛm ntsi na amanaman abobɔ adam.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Babilɔn ahwe ase awerɛfir mu asɛɛ: hom ntwa ewuo mma no; hom mfa ne yaw n’ano edur mbra, bi a wɔsa no yarba a ɔbɛyɛ yie.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nkyɛ yɛresa Babilɔn yarba, naaso annsa. Hom ndan no ngya, na hom mma hɛn mu biara nkɔ nankasa no kurow mu: osiandɛ n’atsɛmbu edu ɔsor, na wɔama do ekodu wimu wimu mpo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: EWURADZE eyi hɛn tsenenee edzi: hom mbra, ma yɛnkɛka EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn n’edwuma nkyerɛ wɔ Zion.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nsew egyen menaba no ano; hom nsuo akokyɛm no mu dzen: EWURADZE ekenyan Media ahemfo hɔn sunsum; osiandɛ wɔabɔ Babilɔn ho tsirmpɔw dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ no: na EWURADZE n’awerdzi, n’asɔrfi ho awerdzi nye no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nsi frankaa ntsia Babilɔn afasu, hom mma aweɔn mu nyɛ dzen, hom mfa aweɔmfo nsisi, hom nsiesie atsɛwfo: na EWURADZE ahyehyɛ wɔ ne tsirmu, na eso ɔayɛ dza ɔkae wɔ Babilɔnfo ho no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao ɔwo a etse esu pii do, w’akoradze dɔɔ so, w’ewiei aba, w’enyikaber esusudze no a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɔm EWURADZE aka noho ntam, dɛ, Ampaara medze nyimpa mebɛhyɛ wo ma, dɛ mbɛbɛw; na wɔabɔ wo do ose.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔno na ɔdze no tum ayɛ asaase, ɔno na ɔdze ne nyansaa etsintsim wiadze, na ɔdze ne ntseasee atserɛw ɔsorsor mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Sɛ ɔbɔ ne ndze mu a, esu no weɔɔyɛ ba ɔsorsor, na ɔma ehubɔhubɔw tu fi asaase ano fa sor; ɔno na ɔyɛ enyinam na nyankom, na ɔdze mframa fi n’adzekorabea ba.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nyimpa biara abɛyɛ dɛ abowa na onnyim dze; osikadwinnyi biara ne sianhonyi hyɛ no enyito: na no guhonyi yɛ ator, na ahom biara nnyi hɔn mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Wɔyɛ egyangyandze, ndaadaa dwuma a: hɔn asotweber mu wɔbɛhera.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Jakob ne kyɛfa nntse dɛ iyinom; na ɔno nye adze nyinara ne yɛfo; na Israel nye n’egyapadze ebusuakuw; dɔm EWURADZE nye ne dzin.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔwo nye m’ekuma na m’akondadze; ɔwo na medze mubobubu amanaman mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mebɛsɛɛ ahendzi;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na medze ɔwo mubobubu pɔnkɔ na nyia ɔtse no do no mu esinesin;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na medze ɔwo mubobubu tseaseanam na nyia ɔtse mu no mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu ɔbanyin na ɔbaa mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu akɔdaa na abofra mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu aberantsɛ na ababaawa no mu esinesin;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na medze ɔwo mubobubu oguanhwɛfo na no nguankuw no mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu ɔnantwi na ne mpamho no mu esinesin; na medze ɔwo mubobubu ambradofo na amampanyin no mu esinesin.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mubotua Babilɔn na Kaldeafo no nyinara kaw wɔ hɔn mbusu a wɔabɔ no hom enyim wɔ Zion no nyinara ho, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hwɛ, menye wo enya, bepɔw sɛɛfo, EWURADZE na ɔse, ɔwo esɛɛ asaase nyinara: na mebɛtsen me nsa wɔ wo do, na mepirepirew wo mefi abotan no do, na mayɛ wo bepɔw hyewee.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na wɔremmfa wo mu ɔbo bi nnto kutuwdo, anaa ɔbo bi nnto fapem; na ebɛyɛ amamfo daa, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nsi frankaa wɔ asaase no do, hom nhɛn akasamu no wɔ amanaman mu, hom nsiesie amanaman nkyer no ho sa, hom nhyia Ararat, Minni, na Askenaz ahendzi nyinara mbra no do; hom nhyɛ ɔsahen mbra no do; hom mfa mpɔnkɔ mbra dɛ mbɛbɛw wirikyee.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom nsiesie amanaman ntu no do ɔsa, Media ahemfo hɔn ambradofo, na hɔn amampanyin nyinara, na no tumdzi asaase no nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na asaase no ho popo na ɔtseetsee: osiandɛ EWURADZE ne tsirmpɔw a ɔwɔ Babilɔn do no osi pi, dɛ ɔbɛyɛ Babilɔn amamfo a obiara nnyi mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Babilɔn akatakyi no woegyaa ko, wɔaka hɔn akoban no mu; hɔn ahoɔdzen apa; wɔayɛ dɛ mbasiafo; wɔato ne tsenabea mu ogya; woebubu n’adaban mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbirikatufo baako botu mbirika ekehyia ɔbaako so, na ɔbɔfo baako ekehyia ɔbaako so akɔbɔ amandzɛɛ akyerɛ Babilɔnhen dɛ wɔagye no kurow no wɔ mbea nyinara:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na wɔagye etwae no, na wɔdze ogya ahyew ndzɛmbir no, na mbarimba akofo no bo etutu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no se nye yi: Babilɔn babaa tse dɛ ewuporoweebea ber a wotsiatsia do no; aka mber kakra, ma twaber edu ama no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar awe me, ɔadwerew me, ɔayɛ me dɛ kyɛnse pan, ɔamen me dɛ nsu mu abowapɔn ɔdze m’akɔndɔdze ahyɛ ne yafun ma; oepuw me egu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nyia a ɔtse Zion bɛka dɛ, Etsirmɔdzendze a wɔdze ayɛ emi na mo honam no ɔmbra Babilɔn do; na Jerusalɛm bɛka dɛ, Mo bɔgyaa ngu Kaldeafo do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, mibedzi w’asɛm ama wo, na medzi wer ama wo; na mobɔwew no po, na mama no nsunyiwa ayɛ wesee.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Babilɔn bɛdan amamfo, mpataku tsenabea, ahobowdze, na asesardze a obiara nntse mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hɔn nyinara bɔbobɔ mu awor dɛ ngyatafɔr; wɔbɔpɔw dɛ ngyatamba.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Sɛ hɔn ho hyehye hɔn a, mobɔto hɔn pon, na mama wɔabobow, na woedzi ehurusi, na wɔada daa nda prɛko, na wonnkenyan, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Medze hɔn besian dɛ nguambaa akɔ ekumii, dɛ nguannyin ɔnye mpɔnkyenyin.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ woedua agye Sesak a! Mbrɛ asaase nyina ayɛyi no wɔafa no mprase a! Mbrɛ Babilɔn edua adan amamfo wɔ amanaman mu a!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Po abɛseram Babilɔn do: n’asorɛkye dodow akɛtaa no do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: No nkurow adan afo, asaase kɛsɛɛ, na sar, asaase a ɔdasanyi biara nntsena do, eso nyimpa ne ba biara nntwa mu wɔ hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mubobu atsɛn megu Bel do wɔ Babilɔn, na meyi dza ɔamemen no mefi n’anomu epue; na amanaman nnkɔbɔ mu apem akɔ ne nkyɛn ara bio: nyew, Babilɔn ɔfasu ahwe ase!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Me man, hom mfi no mu mfir, na hom mu nyimpa biara ngye noho mfi EWURADZE n’ebufuhyew mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Eso mma hom akoma nntu, eso mma hom nnsuro wɔ akwansosɛm a hom bɛtse wɔ asaase no do no ho; na akwansosɛm kor bɛba afe kor mu, na n’ekyir afe kor so mu akwansosɛm, na akatabansɛm aba asaase no do, nyia odzi tum oetsia nyia odzi tum.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a mubobubu atsɛn egu Babilɔn sianhonyi do, na n’asaase no nyina n’enyi bɔto; na n’atɔfoe nyina bɔhwehwe ase wɔ ne finimfin.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna enyigye ntsi ɔsor na asaase, na dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara bɔtow Babilɔn ho ndwom; na afofafo befi kwaamu afamu aba no do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Dɛ mbrɛ Babilɔn maa Israel atɔfo hwehwee ase no, dɛmara so Babilɔn na asaase nyina hɔn atɔfoe bɔhwehwe ase wɔ hɔ.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hom a hom efi afona anomu, hom nduom, na mma hom nngyina komm; hom mfi ekyirekyir nkaa EWURADZE, na hom mma Jerusalɛm mbra hom adwen mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Hɛn enyi ato, osiandɛ yɛatse ahorbahyɛ nka; enyimguase akata hɛn enyim: osiandɛ ananaben aba EWURADZE ne fie krɔnkrɔnmbea no do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ɔno ntsi, hwɛ, nda reba a, EWURADZE na ɔse, mubobu ne sianhonyi nyina atsɛn; na epirafo besi nkrum wɔ n’asaase nyina do.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Sɛ Babilɔn fow kɔ sor mpo, na ɔkyekyer n’ahoɔdzen sorɔnsorɔmbea no akoban mpo a me nkyɛn ara na afofafo befir aba no do, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nkekamu a ofi Babilɔn, na ɔsɛɛ kɛse a ofi Kaldeafo asaase do ne ndze na ɔda mu no!
title: JEREMIAH

text: Osiandɛ EWURADZE refa Babilɔn afo, na ɔma no mu ndze kɛse no sɛɛ fi mu; na hɔn asorɛkye wor dɛ esu pii na hɔn ndze gyegye huoo:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na afofanyi no aba no do, Babilɔn do a, na wɔafa ne mbarimba akatakyi no, woebubu hɔn ngyen mu esinesin: na EWURADZE yɛ ahyɛnanmu Nyankopɔn, tua ara na obotua hɔn kaw.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na mebɛma n’asafohen na n’enyansafo, n’ambradofo na n’amampanyin na n’akatakyi no wɔabobow; na wɔbɛda daa nda prɛko, na wonnkenyan, Ɔhen a ne dzin dze dɔm EWURADZE no na ɔse.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Babilɔn afasu atɛtɛr no, wobodwuruw no pasaa, na wɔdze ogya ahyew no mbobotsen atsentsen no; na ɔman no bɛberɛ ama egyangyandze, na amanaman no aberɛ ama ogya; na wɔbɔtɔ bahaw.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Asɛm a nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia dze hyɛɛ Maseia ba Neria ne ba Seraia, ber a ɔnye Judahen Zedekia kɔr Babilɔn wɔ n’ahendzi afe a otsia anan no mu nye yi. Afei na Seraia yɛ gyaasehen.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Jeremia kyerɛɛw mbusu a ɔbɛba Babilɔn do nyina hyɛɛ nwoma mu, mekyerɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Babilɔn ho yi nyina.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Jeremia see Seraia, dɛ, Sɛ idu Babilɔn a, ɔno hwɛ na kenkan nsɛm yi nyina,
title: JEREMIAH

text: na se dɛ, EWURADZE, ɔwo na akasa bea yi ho dɛ ibotwa no akyen, amma obiara aanntsena mu, nyimpa o, abowa o, na mbom dɛ ɔnyɛ amamfo ara daa.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ sɛ iwie nwoma yi kenkan a, fa ɔbo kyekyer ho, na tow kyen Eufrates mu:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na ka dɛ, Dɛm na Babilɔn bɔdɔ, na onnkopue bio wɔ mbusu a medze mebɛba do no ntsi: na wɔbɔtɔ bahaw. Mbrɛ Jeremia nsɛm yi pem nye ha.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Zedekia bedzii hen no nna oedzi mfe eduonu biako; na odzii hen mfe dubiako wɔ Jerusalɛm: na ne na dzin dze Hamutal, Jeremia a ofi Libna ne babaa a.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dza omuo wɔ EWURADZE enyiwa do, dɛ mbrɛ Jehoiakim yɛe no nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔnam EWURADZE n’ebufuw do na ɔbaa dɛm wɔ Jerusalɛm na Juda, dze bodur dɛ ɔtoow hɔn fii n’enyim kyenee: na Zedekia tseew Babilɔnhen no do etua.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ n’ahendzi afe a otsia akron no mu no, bosoom a otsia du no, nna Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar botuaa Jerusalɛm, ɔno na no dɔm nyinara, na wɔkyeer do nsera; na wɔtoow aban bɔɔ ho aprɔw tsiaa no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna wotuaa kurow no kodur ɔhen Zedekia n’afe a otsia dubiako no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Bosoom a otsia anan no mu, bosoom no ne nda akron no mu no, ɔkɔm yɛɛ dzendzenndzen wɔ kurow no mu ara, ma wonnyaa edziban biara mma asaase no do nkorɔfo no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna wotuetuee kurow no ho, na mbarimba akofo no nyina guanguanee fii kurow no mu anadwe dze faa afasu ebien no ntamu, abobow kɛse no a ɔwɔ ɔhen no ture no ho no kɔree; (afei na Kaldeafo etwa kurow no ho ehyia:) na wɔdze faa Araba kwan no do kɔree.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Kaldeafo dɔm no tsiiw ɔhen no, na wɔkɔtoo Zedekia wɔ Jeriko tɛtɛr mu; na no dɔm nyina fii ne nkyɛn petsee.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna wɔkyeer ɔhen no, na wɔdze no kɛmaa Babilɔnhen wɔ Ribla a ɔwɔ Hamat asaase do no; na obuaa no atsɛn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Babilɔnhen kum Zedekia ne mbabanyin no wɔ n’enyim: okunkum Juda asafohen nyinara so wɔ Ribla.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na otutuu Zedekia n’enyiwa; na Babilɔnhen dze no too mpokyerɛ mu, na ɔdze no kɔr Babilɔn, na ɔdze no too efiadze kodur dɛ owui.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Afei bosoom a otsia enum no mu no, bosoom no ne dadu a ɔyɛ ɔhen Nebukadenezar, Babilɔnhen no n’afe a otsia duakron no mu no, aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan a ogyina Babilɔnhen no n’enyim no, ɔbaa Jerusalɛm:
title: JEREMIAH
