text: na ɔhyeew EWURADZE ne fi na ɔhen no ne fi; na Jerusalɛm efi nyinara, ofi kɛse biara mpo na ɔdze ogya hyeew no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Kaldeafo dɔm a wɔka aweɔmfo safohen no ho nyinara dwuruuw Jerusalɛm afasu no nyina hyiae.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nna aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan soaa ɔman no mu ehiafo neminemi no bi kɔr ndɔmmum, na ɔman no mu nkaa a wɔkaa kurow no mu, na awaefo a wɔwaae kɔr Babilɔnhen nkyɛn na nyimpadodow no mu nkaa no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan daan asaase no mu ehiafo neminemi no bi gyae dɛ wɔnyɛ wenyin tureahwɛfo na ekuafo.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na boran edum no a ɔwɔ EWURADZE fie no, na ngyinado na boran po a ɔwɔ EWURADZE fie no, Kaldeafo no bubuu mu esinesin, na wɔsoaa boran a ɔwɔ ho no nyina kɔr Babilɔn.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nsenaba so, na nsofi, na edumgya, na mbɛɛsen, na ntser, na boran nkɔɔpow a wɔdze som nyina, wɔfae kɔree.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na nkɔɔpow, na ogya asɛn, na mbɛɛsen, na nsenaba, na nkandzeadua, na ntser, na nkɔɔpow; dza ɔyɛ sika dze no, wɔ sika mu, dza ɔyɛ dwetɛ dze no, wɔ dwetɛ mu, na aweɔmfo safohen no fae kɔree.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Edum ebien, po kor no, na boran anantwi duebien a ɔwɔ ngyinado no a ɔhen Solomon yɛe maa EWURADZE fi no n’ase no: nkɔɔpow yinom nyinara no boran no woenntum ennker.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔyɛ edum no dze, nkyindur ndua kor no krɔn yɛ basafa akron; na ahoma basafa esia twa ho hyia; na ne peperepee nsatseaba anan: na tu da mu.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ne tsir no boran a; na tsir kor no krɔn yɛ basafa ebien na fa, na atena na pɔmegranate eduaba wɔ tsir no ho hyia, ne nyinara boran a: na nkyindur ndua a otsia ebien no, no ho wɔ dɛmara bi, na pɔmegranate eduaba so.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na pɔmegranate ekutu eduokron esia wɔ afa na afa; na pɔmegranate ekutu a ɔwɔ atena no ho hyia nyina yɛ ɔha.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na aweɔmfo safohen no faa ɔsɔfopanyin Seraia, na ɔsɔfo edziekyir Zefania, na abowanoahwɛfo baasa:
title: JEREMIAH

text: na kurow no mu na ɔfaa ɔpanyin a wɔdze no sii mbarimba akofo no do; na hɔn a wohun ɔhen no enyim, beesuon a wohun hɔn wɔ kurow no mu no; na ɔsahen ne kyerɛwnyi a ɔpon asaase no do nkorɔfo kɔ ɔsa; na asaase no do nkorɔfo no mu mbarimba eduosia a wohun hɔn kurow no mu no.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan faa hɔn, dze hɔn kɛmaa Babilɔnhen wɔ Ribla.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na Babilɔnhen bobɔɔ hɔn, na okunkum hɔn wɔ Ribla a ɔwɔ Hamat asaase do no do. Dɛm na wɔfaa Juda ndɔmmum fii n’asaase do kɔree.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nkorɔfo a Nebukadenezar soaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔree no nye woyinom: afe a otsia esuon no mu Judafo mpensa eduonu ebiasa:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nebukadenezar n’afe a otsia duawɔtwe no mu no ɔsoaa nyimpa ahaawɔtwe eduasa ebien ndɔmmum fii Jerusalɛm:
title: JEREMIAH

text: Nebukadenezar n’afe a otsia eduonu ebiasa no mu na aweɔmfo safohen Nebuzaradan soaa Judafo ahaesuon eduanan enum ndɔmmum kɔree: nyimpa nyinara wɔyɛ mpemanan ahaesia.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Judahen Jehoiakin no ndɔmmumkɔ afe a otsia eduasa esuon no mu, bosoom a otsia duebien no mu, bosoom no ne da a otsia eduonu enum no mu, na Babilɔnhen Evil-merodak, n’ahendzi afe a odzi kan no mu, ɔmaa Judahen Jehoiakin ne tsir do, na oyii no fii efiadze puei;
title: JEREMIAH

text: na ɔnye no kasaa kasa pa, na ɔmaa n’akɔngua kyɛɛn ahemfo a wɔnye no wɔ Babilɔn no hɔn akɔngua.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔsesaa n’efiadzenda atar no, na odzidzii wɔ n’enyim daa no nkwa nda nyinara.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Na ɔyɛ n’akɔhomabɔdze no, wɔdze ne daa akɔhomabɔdze no maa no fii Babilɔnhen no ne nkyɛn, da biara n’afamudze wɔ no nkwa nda nyinara mu, dze kodur no wu da.
title: JEREMIAH

text: Ao, kurow a nkyɛ no mu mba dɔɔ so no mbrɛ oedua ayɛ bɔɔ a! Mbrɛ oedua ayɛ dɛ kunafo a, ɔno a nkyɛ ɔyɛ kɛse wɔ amanaman mu! Nyia nkyɛ ɔyɛ ɔhembaa wɔ amantɔw mu no, Mbrɛ oedua adan ɔsomfo a!
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Osu ara na osu anadwe, na ne nyinsuwa eguar no. N’adɔfo nyinara mu no, onnya obiara a ɔkyekye no werɛ: ne mfɛfo nyinara etwitwa no nkontompɔ, wɔadan n’atamfo.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Juda etu kɔ ndɔmmum mu wɔ amandzehu mu, na ɔsom kɛse da no do; Ndɛ ɔtse amanamamfo mu, na onnya ahomgyebea biara. Hɔn a wɔtaa no do no nyinara akɔto no dɛ oehin mu ahar mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Zion n’akwan rutwa ewuo, osiandɛ obi mmba nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn no ase; No mbobokɛse nyinara mu ayɛ bɔɔ, n’asɔfoe risi nkrum: Ne nkataasia werɛ ahow, na noara so ayɛ no wenwen.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: N’ahohiahiafo abɛyɛ banodzifo, n’atamfo ayɛ prɔmprɔm; Na EWURADZE ahyɛ no awerɛhow, wɔ ne mbrato dodow ntsi: Ne mba nkakramba edzi atamfo enyim kɔ ndɔmmum mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Zion babaa n’akɛseyɛ no, ne nyinara efi no ho kɔ. Ne mbapɔmba ayɛ dɛ ntwe a wonnya edzidzibea, woguan hɔn etsiwfo enyim kɔ a wonnyi ahoɔdzen.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Jerusalɛm n’awerɛhow na n’amandzehu nda no mu no, ɔkaa dza ɔsom no bo nyinara a ɔwɔ hɔ fir tsetse nda mu no: Ber a ne man kɔtɔɔ atamfo nsamu, na obiara ammboa no no, atamfo no dzii dɛw, na wosii n’amamfoyɛ ho atwetwe.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Jerusalɛm ayɛ bɔn kɛsekɛse; dɛm ntsi ɔayɛ atwetwesidze. Hɔn a wodzii no nyi nyinara no, wommbu no bi, osiandɛ woehu n’adagyaw. Nyew, osi nkrum, na ɔdan n’enyim kɔ nkyɛn.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ne fi kekaa n’asetar mu; ɔanndwen ne daakye ho; dɛm ntsi na ɔabrɛ adze nwionn no; a onnyi ɔwerɛkyekyefo biara no. O EWURADZE, hwɛ m’amandzehu; osiandɛ ɔtamfo no edzi konyim.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ahohiahianyi no atserɛw ne nsamu akata dza ɔsom no bo nyinara do; Mpo oehu dɛ amanamamfo ahɛn no krɔnkrɔnbea, Nyew, hɔn a ehyɛɛ hɔn ho mbra dɛ mma wɔnnhɛn wo mboanofo mu no a.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ne man nyinara si nkrum, ber a wɔrohwehwɛ edziban; Wɔdze dza ɔsom hɔn bo amema agye edziban a wɔdze bɔdwedwe ɔkra: EWURADZE e, hwɛ, na hu; mbrɛ mo ho esi ayɛ nkɔw.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hom a hom rutwa mu sen nyina, aso ɔnnyɛ hom asɛm bi? Hom nhwɛ, na hom nhu kyerɛ dɛ yaw bi wɔ hɔ a ɔtse dɛ me yaw a aka me a EWURADZE dze ahow mo werɛ wɔ n’ebufuhyew da mu yi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ofir ɔsor na ɔasoma ogya, na ahɛnhɛn me mbiew mu, na oedzidzi mu: Oesua m’anan efir, ɔasan me ekyir; Ɔama mayɛ kyirpaanyi na matɔ bitsi adzekyee nyina.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔdze ne nsa akyekyer me mbrato ayɛ no kɔndua no; Wɔdze hɔn atoatoa mu, woedu mo kɔn ho; ɔama m’ahoɔdzen apa. EWURADZE eyi me ahyɛ hɔn a munntum hɔn enyim gyina nsa.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE ammfa m’akatakyi a wɔtse mo mu no annyɛ hwee; Ɔafrɛ nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn etsia me dɛ wɔmbɔdwerew me mberantsɛ: EWURADZE etsiatsia Juda babaa ɔbaabun no do dɛ mbrɛ wotsiatsia wenyintwer mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ndzɛmba yinom ntsi na musu; m’enyiwa kyi nyinsuwa gu famu; Osiandɛ ɔwerɛkyekyefo a ɔbɔdwedwe me kra no, ɔnye me ntamu atwe: Me mba ayɛ ekyirpaafo, osiandɛ ɔtamfo no edzi nyim.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Zion tserɛw ne nsamu; naaso obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔkyekye no werɛ; EWURADZE ahyɛ wɔ Jakob ho dɛ, hɔn a wɔabɔ no ho aprɔw nyinara wɔnnyɛ n’atamfo: Jerusalɛm adan efifidze wɔ hɔn mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE dzi bem; osiandɛ emi matsew ne mbrasɛm do etua: naaso aman nyina hom ntsie, na hom nhu me yaw: me nkataasia na me mberantsɛ kɔ; wɔkɔ ndɔmmum mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Mefrɛfrɛɛ mo nwewefo, naaso wɔdaadaa me: M’asɔfoe na me mpanyimfo gyaagyaa hɔn sunsum mu wɔ kurow no mu, ber a wɔrohwehwɛ edziban ekenyan hɔn ahoɔdzen no.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE, hwɛ; mowɔ ahokyer mu; mo nson mu hyehye me; M’akoma etwa noho wɔ mo mu; osiandɛ matsew etua kɛsekɛse ntsi. Guado ɛ, afona ruhwinhwim kɔ, fie so ɛ, owu dɛmara.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Wɔtsee mbrɛ misii sii nkrum; naaso obi nnyi hɔ a ɔkyekye mo werɛ. M’atamfo nyina atse mo fona; ɔyɛ hɔn dɛw dɛ ɔwo na ayɛ: Ebɛma da a aka ato hɔ no edu, na hɔn so wɔayɛ dɛ emi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ma hɔn emumuyɛ nyina mbra w’enyim; Na yɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ edze ayɛ me osian me mbrato nyinara ntsi. Na mo nkrumsi adɔɔ so, na m’akoma atɔ bitsi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE edua dze fua akata Zion babaa do wɔ n’ebufuw mu a! Ofi sor atow Israel n’ahoɔfɛw akyen asaase do, Na ɔnnkaa n’ananadzegua wɔ n’ebufuw da no mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE asɛɛ Jakob ne ntsenabea nyina, na oennhu no mbɔbɔr; N’ebufuhyew mu no oedwuruw Juda babaa n’aban dzendzen egu famu; na oegu ahendzi no na mu mbapɔmba no ho fi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Oetwa Israel ahoɔdzen nyina egu wɔ n’ebufuhyew mu; Ɔatwe ne nsa nyimfa ekyir efi hɔnho wɔ ɔtamfo no enyim: Na ɔahyew Jakob dɛ gyaframee a ɔhyew bɔ aprɔw.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔakontom n’egyen dɛ ɔtamfo, ɔdze ne nsa nyimfa egyina dɛ ahohiahianyi, Na oekuku hɔn a yɛdze hɔn hoahoaa hɛnho nyina: Oehue n’ebufuhyew egu dɛ ogya, wɔ Zion babaa n’asesee mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE adan dɛ ɔtamfo, ɔamen Israel; Ɔamemen n’ahemfi nyinara, ɔasɛɛ n’akoban so: Na ɔama babaa Juda no nkɔmbɔdzi na sukwadwom adɔɔ so.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Oebubu ne ntamadan mu, dɛ gyama ture bi; Ɔasɛɛ n’eguabɔbea: EWURADZE etwa nhyiamu krɔnkrɔn na ahomgyeda mu wɔ Zion. Na n’ebufuw ne hyeehyew no mu oebu ɔhen no na ɔsɔfo no enyimtsia.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE atow n’afɔrmbukyia akyen, na no krɔnkrɔnbea ho ayɛ no mfon, Ɔdze n’ahemfie afasu no ahyɛ ɔtamfo no nsa; Wɔyɛɛ dede wɔ EWURADZE fie, dɛ afahyɛ da mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE esua ne tsir mu dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ Zion babaa n’afasu; Ɔatwe ahoma no mu, ɔnntwee ne nsa ekyir nngyaa dɛ ɔresɛɛ adze: Na ɔama pampi na fasu etwa sukwadwom; wɔabɔ mu afomfɔn.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: No mbobokɛse no amem famu; ɔasɛɛ n’adaban no na oebubu mu. Ne hen na ne mbapɔmba wɔ amanaman mu mbra nnyi hɔ bio; Nyew, no nkɔnhyɛfo nnya EWURADZE hɔ enyido adzehu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Zion babaa ne mpanyimfo tsetse famu, wɔayeyɛ konkomm; Woetu huntuma egugu hɔn etsifi, wɔdze eyitam esisi hɔn asen: Jerusalɛm mbaabun esisi hɔn etsir adze.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Nyinsuwa ama m’enyiwa resa, mo nson mu hyehye me, Me mberɛbo ehue egu famu, wɔ me man ne babaa ne sɛɛe ntsi; Osiandɛ mbofra nkakraba na enumfoanomba atotɔ bitsi wɔ kurow n’abrɔn no mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Wobisa hɔn nanom dɛ, Henfa na eburow na wenyin wɔ? Ber a wɔatotɔ bitsi dɛ epirafo wɔ kurow n’abrɔn no mu, Ber a woehue hɔn kra egu hɔn nanom hɔn bo mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ebɛn dase na mindzi nkyerɛ wo? Jerusalɛm babaa, ebɛnadze na memfa ntoto wo ho? Zion babaa baabun, ebɛnadze na memma ɔnye wo nsɛ, mfa nkyekye wo werɛ? Na wo pira so dɛ po: woana botum ayɛ wo edur?
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Wo nkɔnhyɛfo ehu egyangyandze na nkwaseasɛm ho enyido adzehu ama wo; Na wɔannda w’emumuyɛ edzi, dɛ wɔdze wo ndɔmmumkɔ bɛsan aba; Na mbom ator na nkɔnhyɛsɛm a ɔma efom na wohunii kyerɛɛ wo.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɔn a wotwa mu sen nyina bɔ hɔn nsamu gu wo do; Wɔsesar Jerusalɛm babaa na wɔwosow hɔn tsir gu no do, dɛ: Aso iyi nye kurow a adasamba frɛ no Ahoɔfɛw a oedzi mu, Asaase nyina enyigye no?
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: W’atamfo nyina ahanhan hɔn anomu wɔ wo do; Wɔsesar na wɔtwɛr hɔn se; wɔka dɛ, Yɛamemen no! Nyew, da a yɛhwɛɛ no kwan no nye yi; yeenya, yeehu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE ayɛ dza osusui no; Ɔama n’asɛm aba mu pɛpɛɛpɛr dza ɔhyɛe wɔ tsetse nda mu no; Oedwuruw egu famu, oennya ehumbɔbɔr: Na ɔama ɔtamfo edzi wo eduwa; Ɔama w’ahohiahiafo ahoɔdzen do.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɔn akoma kekaa mu frɛɛ EWURADZE: Ao Zion babaa ne fasu! Ma nyinsuwa mpem dɛ esutsen adzekyee na anadwe; Mma nngye w’ahom, mma mma w’enyiwa nnda.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Soɛr, keka mu wɔ anadwe, wɔ adasu n’ahyɛse; Hue w’akoma dɛ nsu gu wɔ EWURADZE n’enyim: Ma wo nsa do kyerɛ no do wɔ wo mbofra nkakraba no hɔn nkwa ntsi, Ɔkɔm ntsi wɔtotɔ bitsi wɔ abrɔn biara etsifi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE e, hwɛ, na hu nyia ayɛ no dɛm yi! Aso mbaa bedzi hɔn yafumba, mboframba a hɔnara wɔawo hɔn no? Aso woboku ɔsɔfo na nkɔnhyɛnyi wɔ EWURADZE no krɔnkrɔnbea?
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Aberantsɛ na akɔdaa wɔdeda famu wɔ abrɔn mu; Me nkataasia na me mberantsɛ atotɔ afona anomu: Ekuku hɔn w’ebufuw da no mu; eku, na ennhu mbɔbɔr.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔwo afrɛ m’atamfo wɔ mbea nyina dɛ gyama afahyɛ da bi, Na obiara nnyi hɔ a ofii nsa anaa ɔkae wɔ EWURADZE n’ebufuw da no mu: Hɔn a magyegye hɔn na manyɛn hɔn no, me tamfo ama wɔasa.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Emi nye nyimpa a mehu amandze wɔ n’ebufuw abaa no ano.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔapam me dze me kɔ sum mu mbrɛ kan biara nnyi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Emi mara nko mo do na ɔdandan ne nsa, ɔdze tsia me adzekyee nyina.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔama mo honam na mo wer ayɛ dadaw; oebubu me mbiew.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔatow esiw me kwan, na ɔdze bɔwema na ɔyaw etwa mo ho ehyia.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔama matsena mbea a ɔyɛ sum mu, dɛ hɔn a woewuwu akyɛr.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔagye mo ho ban, na munntum mummpue; ɔama mo nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no ayɛ dur.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Kaansa musu frɛ mboa mpo a, osiw me mpaabɔ kwan.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔdze abo a woetwa ato m’atsempɔn mu fasu, ɔakyeakyea m’akwan.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔayɛ dɛ osisi a ɔretsɛw me, dɛ ogyata a ɔhyɛ nsumaa mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔadan m’akwan akɔ nkyɛn, na ɔatsetsew mo mu esinesin; ɔama mayɛ pasaa.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔakontom n’egyen, na ɔdze me esi hɔ dɛ botae ama egyen menaba.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔama n’egyen kotoku mu egyen menaba ahɛn me nsɛbɛ mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Madan ɔsesɛba ama me man nyina; na hɔn atwetwesi ndwom adzekyee nyina.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔdze wenwen ahyɛ me ma, ɔama bɔwen afon me.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Eso ɔdze mbosaabo ebubu me se, ɔdze nso akata mo do.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Na ɔwo eyi me kra efi asomdwee ho kɔ ekyirekyir; mo werɛ fir prɔmprɔmyɛ.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Na mesee dɛ, M’enyimnyam asa, na dza m’enyi da kwan wɔ EWURADZE hɔ no.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Mekaa m’amandzehu na m’awerɛhow a, ɔyɛ ɔbɔwen na ɔbɔwema ma me.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Me kra da ho ara kaa, na ɔabrɛ adze wɔ mo mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Naaso iyi na mekaakaa mo ho wɔ ho, dɛm ntsi na mowɔ enyidado yi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE no dɔ a otsim ntsi na yɛnnhyewee yi, na n’ehumbɔbɔr no tun nntwa da.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Wɔyɛ fofor anapa biara; wo nokwardzi so.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE nye me kyɛfa, me kra na ɔse; dɛm ntsi m’enyi da no do.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE ye dze ma hɔn a wɔtweɔn no no, dze ma ɔkra a ɔhwehwɛ n’ekyir kwan no.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Oye ma ɔdasanyi dɛ n’enyi bɛda do na ɔayɛ komm atweɔn EWURADZE no nkwagye.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Oye ma ɔdasanyi dɛ ɔsoa no kɔndua wɔ ne mbofrabermu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Sɛ EWURADZE dze to no do a, ma no nko ntsena hɔ na ɔnyɛ komm.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ma ɔmfa n’ano mbutuw huntuma mu; sɛ bi a enyidado bi bɛba a.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ma ɔmfa n’afon mma nyia ɔbɔ mu no; ma ahorba nhyɛ no ma tɔ.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Na EWURADZE nnkɔtow akyen ara afebɔɔ.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Na kaansa ɔhyɛ awerɛhow mpo a, ne yamu bɛhyehye no wɔ no mbɔbɔrhu dodow ntsi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Na ɔnnyɛ ne pɛ dɛ obehiahia ho ɔpɛdo, eso dɛ obeyi adasamba awerɛhow.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Sɛ wɔdwerew asaase do adaduafo nyina wɔ ananadze,
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: sɛ wɔdan ɔdasanyi ne ndzinoa to nkyɛn wɔ Ɔsorsornyi no enyim,
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: sɛ wɔdan ɔdasanyi n’asɛm enyi a, aso EWURADZE nnhu a?
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Woana na ɔka ma ɔba mu, ber a EWURADZE nnhyɛe no?
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ana nnyɛ Ɔsorsornyi no n’anomu na mbusu na siar fir ba?
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na nyimpa tseasenyi nhwinhwin, wɔ no bɔn ho ntsea ho?
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Wɔmma yɛnhwehwɛ hɛn akwan mu na yɛmpa mu, na yɛnsan nkɔ EWURADZE hɔ.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Wɔmma yɛmmema hɛn akoma ɔnye hɛn nsa do mma Nyankopɔn wɔ sorsor.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɛn na yɛato mbra na yɛatsew etua; na ɔwo emmfae nnkyɛe.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Edze ebufuw akata woho na etsiw hɛn; ekuku a ennhu mbɔbɔr.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Edze nsuwusiw akata woho, amma hɛn mpaabɔ biara eennhwira mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔwo ayɛ hɛn nwurabanwuraba na ntɔmpamu wɔ aman finimfin.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɛn atamfo nyinara ahanhan hɔn anomu petopetoo wɔ hɛn do.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Suro na mona abɛda hɛn do, amamfo na ɔsɛɛ.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: M’enyiwa kyi nyinsuwa esutsen gu famu, wɔ me man ne babaa ne sɛɛe ntsi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: M’enyiwa wora nsu gu famu, na onngyaa, ɔnntow mu,
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: ekodu dɛ EWURADZE bɔbɔ ne tsir adze na oefi ɔsor ahwɛ.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: M’enyiwa hyɛ me awerɛhow, wɔ mo kurow ne mbabaa nyinara ntsi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɔn a wɔyɛ m’atamfo kwa no, woetsiw me dɛ anoma.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Woetwa mo nkwa do wɔ mona efiadze no mu, na woesun ɔbo ato mo do.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Esu no praam me tsir do; mesee dɛ, Woetwa me akyen.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ao EWURADZE, mifi mona no n’ase noho noho na mobɔɔ wo dzin.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔwo itsiee me ndze, mma nnsiw w’aso wɔ me nkrumsi do, mbom ma me ahomgye.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔwo twee pinii wɔ da a mefrɛɛ wo no: na esee dɛ, Mma nnsuro.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE, ɔwo edzi me kra n’asɛm ama no; ɔwo apon me kra.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE, ɔwoara ehu mfom a wɔdze afom me; bua m’atsɛn ma me.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔwo ehu hɔn enyitan nyina, na hɔn tsirmpɔw nyina a wɔbɔ wɔ mo ho no.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE, ɔwoara atse hɔn ahorba, na hɔn tsirmpɔw nyina a wɔdze tsia me no.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɔn a wɔtaa mo do no hɔn huhuhuhu na ehwinhwin, soɛr tsia me adzekyee nyina.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hwɛ, hɔn asetsena na hɔn soɛr; emi nye hɔn atwetwesi ndwom.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE, ɔwoara ma hɔn ahyɛnanmu akatua, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nsaano edwuma tse.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ma hɔn akoma atseetsee, ma wo mpaamba nka hɔn.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Tsiw hɔn ebufuw mu, na sɛɛ hɔn fi EWURADZE no sorsor no ase.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Mbrɛ sikakɔkɔɔ enyi edua ebisiw a! Mbrɛ sika mapa twann edua asakyer a! Krɔnkrɔnbea abo no woehue egugu abrɔn biara ne tsir.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Zionmba a wɔsom bo a wɔdze hɔn to sika mapa ho no, Mbrɛ woedua ebu hɔn dɛ dɛtse nsenaba, ɔwemfo ne nsaano edwuma a!
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Nsɔ mpo wɔtwe enumfo, wɔma hɔn mba wonum: naaso me man adan otsirmɔdzennyi, dɛ sar do nsohor.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Akɔkowaba ne tɛkyerɛma fam n’anomu wɔ nsukɔm ntsi: Mbofra nkakraba bisa edziban, naaso nyimpa biara mmbu bi mma hɔn.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɔn a wodzii adɔkɔdɔkɔdze ayeyɛ pasapasaa wɔ abrɔn mu: Hɔn a wɔnyɛɛn hɔn serdaa mu no wɔyɛ nsumina etuu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Na me man n’emumuyɛ ayɛ kɛse asen Sodom no bɔn, Ɔno a wobutuuw no amonmu, a nnyɛ nsa biara na ɔyɛe.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: N’ekunyin ho tsew sen esukwankyɛba, wɔhoa sen enumfonsu. Hɔn honamenyi ber mu sen nankyenema, hɔn ho senasena dɛ hoabo.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Afei dze hɔn enyim bir sen gyabiriw; wohu hɔn abrɔn mu a, wonnhu hɔn: Hɔn honanwer femfam hɔn mbiew ho; ɔakyenkyen, ɔayɛ dɛ dua.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɔn a wɔtotɔ afona ano no woye sen hɔn a ɔkɔm kuku hɔn; woyinom hɔn ahom apa, wɔayeyɛ nkamfenkamfe, wɔ haban mu nduadzewa a abɔ hɔn no ntsi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Mbaa a wɔyɛ ehumbɔbɔr no hɔn nsa anoa hɔnankasa hɔn mba; wɔdaan hɔn edziban wɔ me man ne sɛɛe ntsi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE ewie n’ebufuhyew fa, oehue n’ebufuw dzendzen no egu; Na oekua ogya bi wɔ Zion a ɔamemen ne mfapem no.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Asaase do ahemfo anngye enndzi, wɔnye wiadze mba nyinara so, Dɛ ɔhohiahianyi na ɔtamfo bɛba abɛhɛn Jerusalɛm mbobokɛse mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: No nkɔnhyɛfo hɔn bɔn, na n’asɔfoe hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi a, na wɔaka atseneneefo bɔgyaa egu wɔ ne finimfin.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Wɔkekaa dɛ enyifurafo wɔ abrɔn mu, bɔgya egu hɔn ho fi, ma dɛm ntsi adasa nntum nnka hɔn ntar.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Wɔtseaa mu kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom mfi hɔ, Hom a hom ho egu fi! Hom mfi hɔ, hom mfi hɔ, mma hom mmfa hom nsa nnka biribiara: Aber a woguanee kekyinkyinii no, adasa kae wɔ amanaman mu dɛ, Wɔnnkɛyɛ amamforafora wɔ ha bio.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE n’ebufuw apaapaa hɔn mu; ɔnnkɛda ho ebu hɔn bi bio: woemmbu asɔfo no bi, mpanyimfo no so ennya hɔn enyim enyimpa.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɛn enyiwa da ho bu dɛ ɔrohwɛ hɛn mboa kwan ara gyan: hɛn aweɔn mu yɛaweɔn ama ɔman bi a onnkotum nkwa gye.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Wɔtwee hɛn anamɔn, ma yenntum nnkɔ hɛn abrɔn mu: Hɛn ewiei abɛn, hɛn nda aso; osiandɛ hɛn ewiei aba.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɛn etsiwfo hɔn ho yɛ har sen ɔsor nkɔr: Wotsiiw hɛn mbepɔw do, wɔtsɛɛw hɛn sar do.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɛn ahwentokura mu ahom, nyia EWURADZE asera no no, wɔkyeer no wɔ hɔn amona mu; ɔno na yɛkae wɔ no ho dɛ, No nwin ase na yebenya nkwa wɔ amanaman mu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Edom babaa a etse Uz asaase do, dzi ehurusi na ma w’enyi ngye: Kɔɔpow no botwa mu aba wo so wo hɔ; ebɔbow, na wɔato wo pan.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Zion babaa, w’emumuyɛ ho ntsea no aba ewiei. Ɔrennda ho nnsoa wo nnkɔ ndɔmmum mu: mbom, Edom babaa, obotua wo w’emumuyɛ ho kaw; ɔbɛda wo bɔn edzi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE, kaa dza aba hɛn do: Hwɛ, na hu hɛn enyimguase.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Wɔadan hɛn egyapadze ama ahɔho, Hɛn efi ama ananaben.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Yɛayɛ enyisaba na ngyanka, Hɛn nanom ayɛ dɛ ekunafo.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Yeetua sika anom hɛnankasa hɛn nsu; Wɔdze hɛn nyena atɔn hɛn.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɛn etsiwfo dze hɛn kɔn ekyir: Yɛaberɛ, na yeennya ahomgye.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Yɛdze hɛn nsa ama Egyptfo, Na Asiriafo, ma yeenya edziban amee.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɛn egyanom ayɛ bɔn, na wonnyi hɔ; Na hɛn dze, yɛasoa hɔn emumuyɛ.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Nkowaa dzi hɛn do tum: Obi nnyi hɔ a ɔgye hɛn fi hɔn nsamu.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɛn nkwa kitsakitsa hɛn nsamu na yɛkɛfa hɛn edziban, wɔ sar do afona no ntsi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɛn wer ahyew tumm dɛ fononoo wɔ ɔkɔm ne gyaframee ntsi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Woguu Zion mbaa enyim ase, Juda nkurow mu mbabun no.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Wɔkyekyeer mbapɔmba nsa sensɛnee: Wɔannhwɛ mpanyimfo enyim emmbu hɔn bi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɔn mberantsɛ soaa ewuyambo, Na mbofra fintsiwii wɔ nyena nkyekyeree ase.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Mpanyimfo egyaa abobotsen ano ba, Mberantsɛ egyaa hɔn sanku bɔ.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Hɛn akoma n’enyigye abɔ adze; Hɛn asaw adan nkɔmbɔdzi.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Abɔtsir no efi hɛn tsir egu: Yendue, osiandɛ yɛayɛ bɔn!
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Iyi ntsi na hɛn akoma atɔ bitsi; Ndzɛmba yinom ntsi na hɛn enyiwa ayɛ kusukusu;
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Zion bepɔw a ayɛ amamfo ntsi; Nsɔ nenam do.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE, ɔwoara na etse hɔ daa; W’ahengua fir ebusuasantsen kodu ebusuasantsen.
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wo werɛ fir hɛn daa, Na epa hɛn mber tsentsen dɛm yi?
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: EWURADZE, san hɛn bra wo nkyɛn na yɛbɛsan; Yɛ hɛn nda fofor dɛ tsetse dze no,
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Anaa ɔwo apow hɛn koraa, na wo bo efuw hɛn dodoodow?
title: LAMENTATIONS

text: Afei ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia eduasa no mu no, bosoom a otsia anan no mu da a otsia enum no, ber a mowɔ ndɔmmumfo mu wɔ Kebar esutsen ho no, na ɔsorsor buebuei, na muhun Nyankopɔn ho enyido adzehu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bosoom no mu da a otsia enum a ɔyɛ ɔhen Jehoiakin no ndɔmmumkɔ afe a otsia enum mu no,
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Buzi ba, ɔsɔfo Ezekiel hɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ Kaldeafo asaase a ɔwɔ Kebar esutsen ho; na EWURADZE ne nsa baa no do wɔ hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mohwɛe, na hwɛ, ehum kɛse bi tui fi kwaamu afamu bae, nsuwusiw kɛse nye gya a ɔabobɔw noho hyɛ mu, na ɔhyerɛn bi etwa no ho ehyia. Na gya no ne finimfin no, biribi a enyi tse dɛ sika na dwetɛ mforae hyerɛn wɔ hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na no mu na abɔdze enyikan baanan bi saso fi puei. Na mbrɛ hɔn hwɛbea tse nye yi; wɔwɔ dasanyi ne saso.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na obiara wɔ enyim anan, na hɔn mu biara wɔ ntsaban anan.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn anansa yɛ tromm; na hɔn ananadze tse dɛ nantwiba n’ananadze: na wɔyeyɛɛ hyenhyerɛnn dɛ ayewa a wɔapɔw ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔwɔ nyimpa nsa wɔ hɔn ntsaban ase wɔ hɔn afa anan: na hɔn baanan no wowɔ enyim na hɔn ntsaban dɛm;
title: EZEKIEL

text: hɔn ntsaban toatoa mu; wɔnam a, wonntwa hɔnho; hɔn mu biara nam n’enyim tsenn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hɔn enyim ne saso mbrɛ ɔtse nye yi; hɔn baanan no nyina wowɔ nyimpa enyim; wɔ hɔn enyim, na wɔwɔ gyata enyim wɔ enyimfa afamu; wɔwɔ nantwi enyim wɔ abankum afamu; na wɔwɔ ɔkɔr enyim so wɔ hɔn ekyir.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔatserɛw hɔn ntsaban mu hwɛ ɔsor afamu; obiara ne ntsaban ebien ebien toatoa mu, na ebien ebien katakata hɔn nyimpadua ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn mu biara nam n’enyim tsenn: mbrɛ sunsum rokɔ, na wɔkɔ; wɔnam a wonntwa hɔnho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na abɔdze enyikan ne saso dze, hɔn hwɛbea tse dɛ gyabiriw a ɔdzɛw, dɛ mbrɛ ogya atsɛn no hwɛbea tse; ɔkɔ sor ba ase wɔ abɔdze enyikan no ntamu: na gya no dzɛw huoo, na enyinam fi gya no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na abɔdze enyikan no tutuu mbirika dzii akɔnaaba tse dɛ enyinam ne nyinamee.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na morohwɛ abɔdze enyikan no, hwɛ, hwiir kor si asaase no do wɔ abɔdze enyikan no nkyɛn, enyim anan no mu biara nedze kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nhwiir no na hɔn nyɛbea tse dɛ sikabereebo enyi: na baanan no nyina hɔn saso kor: na hɔn hwɛbea na nyɛbea tse dɛ hwiir a ɔhyɛ hwiir mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔnam a, wɔnam hɔn afa anan no do: wɔnam a, wonntwa hɔnho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn ho nhankra no dze, wɔkrɔn ma ɔyɛ hu; na baanan no nhankra no ayeyɛ enyiwa enyiwa abɔ ho aprɔw.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ abɔdze enyikan no rokɔ a, nhwiir no dzi hɔn nkyɛn: na sɛ wɔma abɔdze enyikan no do fi famu a, nhwiir no so mema do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Beebiara a sunsum no rokɔ no, wɔkɔ; hɔ ara na sunsum no wɔ dɛ ɔkɔ: na nhwiir no mema do wɔ hɔn nkyɛnmu; na abɔdze enyikan no no sunsum wɔ nhwiir no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ hɔn wɔkɔ a, woyinom so wɔkɔ; na sɛ wogyina a, nna woyinom so woegyina; na sɛ wɔma hɔn do fi famu a, nhwiir no mema do wɔ hɔn nkyɛn: osiandɛ abɔdze enyikan no no sunsum wɔ nhwiir no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na abɔdze enyikan no n’etsifi wɔ wimu ne saso, ɔtse dɛ ahwehwɛbo a ɔyɛ hu n’enyi, wɔatserɛw mu akatakata hɔn etsifi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn ntsaban tsen tsenn dzi mbɔenyim wɔ wimu no ase: hɔn mu biara wɔ ebien a ɔkata ne nyimpadua afa ha, na hɔn mu biara so wɔ ebien a ɔkata ne nyimpadua afa ha so.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ wɔrokɔ a, metse hɔn ntsaban ne dede a ɔtse dɛ esu akɛse dede, ɔtse dɛ Otumfo no ne ndze dede weɔɔ a ɔtse dɛ dɔm ne dede: sɛ wogyina a, wogyaagyaa hɔn ntsaban mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ndze bi fi wimu a ɔwɔ hɔn etsifi no mu: sɛ wogyina a, wogyaagyaa hɔn ntsaban mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wimu a ɔwɔ hɔn etsifi no do wɔ ahengua saso wɔ hɔ a ɔtse dɛ hoabo no hwɛbea: na ahengua no ne saso no do na saso a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a ɔtse do wɔ sor no hwɛbea no wɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na muhun dɛ ɔtse dɛ sika na dwetɛ mforaa enyi, ɔtse dɛ gya a ɔwɔ no mu bɔ no aprɔw no hwɛbea, ɔnam mbrɛ n’asen na mbrɛ ɔdze fa no sor no tse no ntsi; na mbrɛ n’asen na ɔdze fa no ase no no hwɛbea tse no, muhun dɛ ɔtse dɛ ogya, na hyerɛn etwa no ho ehyia.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛ mbrɛ nyankontɔn a ɔwɔ nsuwusiw mu wɔ nsutɔ da mu tse no, mbrɛ ɔhyerɛn a etwa noho ehyia no no hwɛbea tse ara nye no. Iyi nye EWURADZE n’enyimnyam no hwɛbea no ne saso. Na muhunii no, medze m’enyim bɔɔ famu, na metsee obi a ɔrekasa ne ndze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, gyina wo nan do, ma menye wo nkasa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ me no, sunsum no bɛhɛɛn mo mu, na ɔmaa migyinaa me nan do; na metsee nyia ɔrekasa kyerɛ me no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, Morosoma wo Israelmba nkyɛn, amanaman etuatsewfo a wɔatsew mo do etua no nkyɛn: hɔn na hɔn egyanom afom me, dze ebodu ndɛ da yi ara mpo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mba no yɛ enyiammbɔho na akomadzen; morosoma wo hɔn nkyɛn: na akɛse hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn dze, sɛ wotsie o, sɛ woenntsie o, (osiandɛ wɔyɛ etuatsew fi,) wobohu ara dɛ saa nkɔnhyɛnyi bi aba hɔn mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba dze, mma nnsuro hɔn, eso mma nnsuro hɔn nsɛm, kaansa nkɔkrɔw na nsoɛ wɔ wo nkyɛn, na etse nyankomaketsembowa mu ara mpo a: mma nnsuro hɔn nsɛm, eso mma wo bo nntu wɔ hɔn enyim, kaansa wɔyɛ etuatsew fi mpo a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na kɛka me nsɛm kyerɛ hɔn, sɛ wotsie o, sɛ woenntsie o: na wɔyɛ etuatsewfo dodow.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba dze, tsie dza meka kyerɛ wo yi; mma nnyɛ etuatsewnyi dɛ etuatsew fie no: bue w’anomu, na dzi dza medze rema wo yi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mohwɛe no, nna hwɛ, wɔatsen nsa bi wɔ mo do; na, hwɛ, nwoma mbobɔwee bi wɔ mu;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na ɔtserɛɛw mu wɔ m’enyim; na wɔakyerɛw no mu na n’ekyir: na wɔakyerɛw sukwadwom, na apensi, na mbusu wɔ mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, dzi dza ihu no; dzi nwoma mbobɔwee yi, na kɔ, kɛkasa kyerɛ Israel fifo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mubuee m’anomu, na ɔmaa midzii nwoma mbobɔwee no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, dzi nwoma mbobɔwee a medze rema wo yi, na fa hyɛ wo nson ma. Nna midzii; na ne dɛw yɛɛ dɛ ewo wɔ m’anomu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, si mu, kɔ Israel fifo nkyɛn, na kɛka me nsɛm yi kyerɛ hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na nnyɛ ɔman a hɔn kasaa yɛ ananakasa, na hɔn kasaa yɛ dzen, na wɔasoma wo hɔn nkyɛn, na mbom Israel fifo a;
title: EZEKIEL

text: nnyɛ aman pii a hɔn kasaa yɛ ananakasa, na hɔn kasaa yɛ dzen a enntse hɔn nsɛm ase no bi a. Ampaara sɛ mosomaa wo hɔn nkyɛn a, nkyɛ wobetsie wo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Israel fifo dze, worinntsie wo; osiandɛ worinntsie me; na Israel fifo nyina hɔn momapɔw do ayɛ dzen na hɔn akoma epirim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hwɛ, mayɛ w’enyim dzendzen wɔ hɔn enyim, na wo momapɔw do dzendzen wɔ hɔn mmomapɔw do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛ dɛnkyɛmbo a ɔyɛ dzen sen twerɛbo na mayɛ wo momapɔw: mma nnsuro hɔn, eso mma hɔn enyim nntu wo bo, kaansa wɔyɛ etuatsew fi mpo a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio so ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, me nsɛm a mebɛka akyerɛ wo nyina gye no w’akoma mu, na fa w’asowa tsie.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na si mu, kɔ ndɔmmumkɔfo no nkyɛn, wo man ne mba no nkyɛn, na kɛkasa kyerɛ hɔn, na se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi; sɛ wobetsie o, sɛ wonnketsie o.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna sunsum no maa me do, ma metsee twiradada kɛse bi wɔ m’ekyir, dɛ, Nhyira mfi ne bea do nka EWURADZE n’enyimnyam.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na metsee abɔdze enyikan no ne ntsaban ne dede ber a wotwutwuuw ho no, na nhwiir a ɔwɔ hɔn nkyɛnmu no ne dede, mekyerɛ twiradada kɛse bi ne dede no a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna sunsum no maa me do, na ɔdze me kɔree: na mokɔr no wenwen mu, wɔ mo sunsum ne hyew mu, na EWURADZE ne nsa yɛɛ dzen wɔ mo do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mebaa Tel-abib ndɔmmumkɔfo a wɔtsetse esutsen Kebar ho no nkyɛn, na mbrɛ wɔtse no; na medze ahobow tsenaa hɔn mu hɔ ndaesuon.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ndaesuon no wiei no, EWURADZE asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, mayɛ wo ɔweɔmfo ama Israel fifo: dɛm ntsi tsie m’anomu asɛm, na bɔ hɔn kɔkɔ ma me.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ mese mumuyɛnyi dɛ, Owu ara na ibowu; na ɔwo ammbɔ no kɔkɔ, na annkasa dɛ erobɔ mumuyɛnyi no kɔkɔ efi n’emumuyɛ kwan no ho, dze agye ne kra nkwa a; mumuyɛnyi kor noara bowu n’emumuyɛ mu; na no bɔgyaa no dze, mobɔhwehwɛ no wɔ wo nsamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso sɛ ebɔ mumuyɛnyi no kɔkɔ, na ɔanndan emmfi n’emumuyɛ ho, anaa n’emumuyɛ kwan ho a, obowu noara n’emumuyɛ mu; na ɔwo dze na agye wo kra.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio, sɛ tseneneenyi san fi ne ndzeyɛtsenenee ho, na ɔyɛ emumuyɛ, na medze fintsidua to n’enyim a, obowu: osiandɛ ɔwo ammbɔ no kɔkɔ ntsi, obowu no bɔn mu na ne ndzeyɛtsenenee a ɔayɛ no, wɔnnkɛkaa; na no bɔgyaa dze, mobɔhwehwɛ no wɔ wo nsamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso sɛ ɔwo ebɔ tseneneenyi kɔkɔ dɛ mma tseneneenyi nnyɛ bɔn, na ɔannyɛ bɔn a, obenya nkwa ara ampa, osiandɛ otsiee kɔkɔbɔ; na ɔwo agye wo kra.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE nsa baa mo do wɔ hɔ; na ɔsee me dɛ, Soɛr, fir edzi kɔ tɛtɛr no mu, na menye wo nkasa wɔ hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mosoɛree, na mifiir edzi kɔr tɛtɛr no mu: na, hwɛ, EWURADZE n’enyimnyam gyina hɔ, dɛ enyimnyam a muhunii wɔ esutsen Kebar ho no: na medze m’enyim butuuw famu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna sunsum no bɛhɛɛn mo mu, na ɔdze me gyinaa me nan do; na ɔnye me kasae, na ɔsee me dɛ, Kɔ, kɔtow woho abow mu wɔ wo fie.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba dze, hwɛ, wɔdze nkyehoma bogu wo do, na wɔdze akyekyer wo, na irimmfir edzi nnkɔ hɔn mu:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na mebɛma wo tɛkyerɛma afam w’anomu, na atɔ mum, na annyɛ kasanyimfo amma hɔn: na wɔyɛ etuatsew fi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ menye wo kasa a, mubobue w’ano, na ase hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Nyia otsie no, ma ontsie; na nyia onntsie no, mma onntsie: na wɔyɛ etuatsew fi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔwo so, onyimpa ba, fa ntaayaa, na fa to w’enyim, na sensan kurow wɔ do, Jerusalɛm a:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na kɔ ho ntuae, na tow ho aban, na hɔr ho pempe; kyer ho nsera so hyia, na fa afasubu ndadzefir sisi ho hyia.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwoara fa dadzesɛn, na fa si dadze fasu wɔ ɔwo na kurow no ntamu: na fa w’enyi si do, na wɔbɔkɔ no ntuae, na akɔ no ntuae. Iyi bɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛdze ama Israel fifo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio so, da w’abankum do, na fa Israel fi emumuyɛ to do: nda dodow a ebɛda do no, ebɔsoa hɔn emumuyɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mahyɛ hɔn emumuyɛ mfe no dɛ ɔnyɛ nda dodow mma wo, mekyerɛ nda ahaasa eduokron: mbrɛ ebɔsoa Israel fi emumuyɛ nye no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na bio, sɛ iwie iyinom yɛ a, da w’enyimfa do, na asoa Juda fi emumuyɛ: adaduanan, da kor afe kor, na mahyɛ ama wo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na fa w’enyi si Jerusalɛm ntuae no do, wo nsa ho nda hɔ; na hyɛ nkɔm gu no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na, hwɛ, medze nkyehoma bogu wo do, na irunntwa adafa, dze ekodu dɛ ewie wo ntuae nda no ana.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na woara fa ewifua pa, na atoko, na eduwa, na asaduwa, na ewifua, na ewi, na fa hyɛ ɔsan kor mu, na fa yɛ edziban; nda dodow a edze bɛda w’afa no, mekyerɛ nda ahaasa eduokron, na ibedzi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na w’edziban a ibedzi no ne nkerii bɛyɛ dwetɛbona eduonu da kor: ofi ber to ber na dzi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na nom nsu a woesusu no susutoa nkyɛmu esia mu kor: ofi ber to ber na nom.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na dzi no dɛ atoko tatar, na fa egyanan a ofi nyimpa mu no to hɔn enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, Dɛmara so na Israelmba bedzi hɔn edziban a ɔyɛ nkɔw, wɔ amanaman a mebɛpam hɔn makɔ hɔ no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Ao, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn! Hwɛ, me kra ho nnguu fi: na ofitsi me mbafose besi sesei minndzii dza noara oewu, anaa mbowa atsetse no da; eso nam a wokyir bi nnkɔr m’anomu pɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Hwɛ, medze nantwibin mahyɛ wo nyimpa efikyir ananmu, na esiesie w’edziban wɔ do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio so, ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, hwɛ, mubobu edziban dua mu wɔ Jerusalɛm: na wobedzi edziban nkerii do, na nhwɛyie mu; na wɔbɔnom nsu nsusui do, na ahobow mu:
title: EZEKIEL

text: ama woeehia edziban na nsu, na hɔn ho abow hɔn, ɔbaako wɔ ɔbaako ho, na wɔaafomfɔn wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, fa afona ndam ndam, dɛ oyifo ne yindam kitsa, na fa twerɛw wo tsir na wo bɔdwesa: na fa nsɛn ker nhwi no, na kyɛ mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Fa gya hyew nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor wɔ kurow no finimfin, ber a ntuae nda no ewie du no; na fa nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor so, na fa afona bobɔ ho hyia; na fa nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor so petse mframa mu, na mobɔtwe afona edzi hɔn ekyir.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na fa mu kumaabi, na fa kyekyer w’atar ano.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na fa iyinom mu bi bio, na tow gu gya no mu, na hyew no wɔ gya no mu; no mu na gya befir aba Israel fifo nyina mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Jerusalɛm nye yi: medze no esi amanaman finimfin, na nkurow nkurow etwa no ho ehyia.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔatsew me ntsɛmbu do etua wɔ dɛ ɔayɛ emumuyɛ asen amanaman no, na m’ahyɛdze so do asen nkurow nkurow a etwa no ho ehyia no: na wɔapow m’atsɛmbudze, na m’ahyɛdze dze, wɔannantsew mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ hom yɛ akɔnkyew sen amanaman a etwa hom ho ehyia, na hom annantsew m’ahyɛdze mu, na hom enndzi m’atsɛmbudze do, na hom annyɛ dɛ amanaman a etwa hom ho ehyia no hɔn mmom no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, emi, emi mara, na menye wo enya; na mubobu atsɛn wɔ wo mu wɔ amanaman enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na dza mennyɛɛ da no mebɛyɛ no wo mu, na merennyɛ ne saso bio, wɔ w’ekyiwadze nyinara ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi egyanom bedzi mba wɔ wo mu, na mba edzi hɔn egyanom; na mubobu atsɛn wɔ wo mu, na wo nkaase nyina mabɔ apetse mframa nyina mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, ampaara, osiandɛ edze w’atantandze nyina, na w’ekyiwadze nyina egu mo krɔnkrɔnbea ho fi ntsi, mo so mubokuw wo do; eso m’enyi rennkam do, na mo so murunnhu wo mbɔbɔr.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wo mu nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor bowuwu yardɔm ano, na ɔkɔm ahyew hɔn wɔ wo mu; na nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor so bɔtotɔ afona ano etwa wo ho ehyia; na nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor so na mobɔbɔ apetse mframa nyina mu, na matwe afona ataa hɔn do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ m’ebufuw bowie nye yi, na m’enyiber adwe hɔn do, na mo werɛ akyekye: na wobohu dɛ emi mara EWURADZE na makasa wɔ mo mbɔdzembɔ mu, ber a mewie m’ebufuhyew wɔ hɔn do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nkyii so mebɛyɛ wo amamfo na ahorohoraa, wɔ amanaman a woetwa mo ho ehyia no mu, wɔ hɔn a wotwa mu nyina enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ ahorohoraa na adapaa, afotu na ahobowdze, ama amanaman a woetwa wo ho ehyia; ber a mubobu atsɛn wɔ wo mu wɔ ebufuw na ebufuhyew, na nkaenyim dzendzen mu no: emi EWURADZE na maka.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ber a mobɔtotow ɔkɔm mbusu egyen menaba megu hɔn do, dza ɔdze ɔsɛɛ ba a mobɔtotow dɛ medze resɛɛ hom; na mabɛma kɔm adɔɔ hom do so, na mebu w’edziban dua mu;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na mobɔsoma kɔm na mbowa ebusufo aba hom do, na wɔama edzi awo mba ewu; na yardɔm na bɔgya bodua wo mu asen; na medze afona bɛba wo do: emi EWURADZE na maka.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, ma w’enyi ntsim Israel mbepɔw do, na hyɛ nkɔm kyerɛ hɔn,
title: EZEKIEL

text: na se dɛ, Hom Israel mbepɔw, hom ntsie EWURADZE Nyankopɔn n’asɛm. Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛ mbepɔw na nkokwaa, esuka na mbɔnsa no nye yi: Hwɛ, emi, emi mara, medze afona bɛba hom do, na masɛɛ hom sorɔnsorɔmbea.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom afɔrmbukyia bɛdan afo, na hom ewia ehonyi ebubu: na mobɔtotow hom atɔfoe no egu hom abosom enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze Israelmba hɔn efun bogugu hɔn abosom enyim; na medze hom mbiew apetse hom afɔrmbukyia ho ehyia.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom tsenabea nyinara mu nkurow no bɔbobɔ, na sorɔnsorɔmbea no ayɛ afoafo; ama hom afɔrmbukyia eedwurudwuruw, na wɔaayɛ afoafo, na hom abosom eebubu abobɔ adze, na woeetwitwa hom ewia ehonyi no egugu famu, na hom ndwuma no wɔaasɛɛ no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na atɔfo no bɔhwehwe ase wɔ hom mu, na hom ehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso mibegyaa nkaase, wɔ dɛ hom benya obinom a wobefi afona nsa wɔ amanaman mu, ber a wɔbɔbɔ hom apetse nkurow nkurow do no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom mu hɔn a wobefi nsa no wɔbɛkaa me wɔ amanaman a wɔbɔsoa hɔn akɔ hɔ ndɔmmum mu no mu, mbrɛ woedua na wɔdze hɔn ndwamanyɛ akoma a atwe efi mo ho na enyiwa a odzi hɔn abosom ekyir yɛ ndwamandze no egura me: na hɔnankasa hɔn ho bɛyɛ hɔn nkɔw wɔ hɔnankasa hɔn enyiwa do ɔnam mbusu a wɔabɔ wɔ hɔn ekyiwadze nyinara mu no ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE: nnyɛ gyan ara na maka dɛ mobɔbɔ hɔn mbusu yi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Bɔ wo nsamu, na fa w’anan pempem famu, na se dɛ, Ao, osian Israelfi ho ekyiwadze no mbusu ntsi a: na wɔbɔtotɔ afona, kɔm, na yardɔm ano.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nyia ɔwɔ ekyirekyir no bowu yardɔm ano; na nyia ɔbɛn bɔtɔ afona ano: na nyia ɔbɛka ma wɔakɔ no ntuae no, obowu kɔm ano: mbrɛ mibesi mewie m’ebufuhyew wɔ hɔn do nye no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, ber a hɔn atɔfoe bɛdeda hɔn abosom ntamu etwa hɔn afɔrmbukyia ho ehyia no, wɔ koko tsentsen biara do wɔ mbepɔw etsifi nyinara, na ndua ebun ebun biara ase, na esudur kusuww biara ase, beebi mbrɛ wɔhyew eduhuam ma hɔn abosom no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛtsen me nsa wɔ hɔn do, na mama asaase no ayɛ afo na ɔabɔ, ofitsi sar a odzi kɔ Dibla afamu no do, wɔ hɔn tsenambea nyinara do; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio so EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se Israel asaase no nye yi, Ewiei nye yi! Ewiei no aba asaase no ne mfɛndzanan no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afei na ewiei no aba wo do, na mobɔsoma m’ebufuw ma ɔaba wo do, na mebu wo atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ w’akwan no tse; na medze w’ekyiwadze nyina bɛba wo do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na m’enyiwa rennkam wo do, eso murunnhu mbɔbɔr: na medze w’akwan bɛba wo do, na w’ekyiwadze aka wo mu: Na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Mbusu bi, mbusu kor pɛ bi; hwɛ, ɔreba.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ewiei aba, ewiei no aba, ɔasoɛr wo do; hwɛ, ɔreba.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Asaase no do nkorɔfo, w’atsɛmbu aba wo do: ber no edu, da no abɛn; weɔɔweɔɔyɛ da a, na nnyɛ enyigye esebɔ wɔ mbepɔw no do bi a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afei ɔrennkyɛr na mehue m’ebufuhyew egu wo do, na mewie m’ebufuw wɔ wo do mebu wo atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ w’akwan tse; na medze w’ekyiwadze nyina aba wo do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na m’enyi rennkam, eso murunnhu mbɔbɔr: mobɔtwe w’aso, dɛ mbrɛ w’akwan tse, na w’ekyiwadze aka wo mu; Na hom bohu dɛ emi EWURADZE na mobɔbɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hwɛ, da no, hwɛ, ɔreba! W’atsɛmbu efir edzi; abaa no abɔ nhyiren, ntsɛn abɔ nkukuduuduw.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Akakabensɛm asoɛr ayɛ emumuyɛ abaa; hɔnara o, hɔn nyimpadodow o, hɔn ahonya o, hɔn mu biara rennka: eso abɔsoyɛ biara rennka hɔn mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ber no aba, da no rotwe bɛn: mma adzetɔnyi nndzi ehurusi, eso mma adzetɔnnyi nndzi nkɔmbɔ: osiandɛ ebufuw aba ne nyimpadodow no nyinara do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na adzetɔnnyi rennsan nnkɔ dza wɔatɔn no ho, kaansa wɔda ho tse ase mpo a: na enyido adzehu no ɔfa ne nyimpadodow no nyinara ho, obiara rennsan; eso obiara rennhyɛ noho dzen wɔ ne bra n’emumuyɛ mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔabɔ akasamu no mu, na woesiesie adze nyina; naaso obiara nnkɔ ɔsa: osiandɛ m’ebufuw wɔ ne nyimpadodow no nyinara do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afona wɔ mfikyir, na yardɔm na kɔm wɔ kurow mu: nyia ɔwɔ haban mu no obowu afona ano; na nyia ɔwɔ kurow mu no, kɔm na yardɔm bɛmen no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ hɔn mu bi fi mu guan a, wobohu hɔn wɔ mbepɔw do, na wɔayɛ dɛ mbɔnsa mu mbubur, hɔn nyinara ridzi awerɛhow, obiara wɔ n’emumuyɛ mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nsa nyinara mu bɔgogow, na anankoroma nyinara ayeyɛ mberɛw dɛ nsu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wobofurafura eyitam so, na nketsenketse akyekyer hɔn; na enyim nyinara bogugu ase, na hɔn etsir nyinara do apepa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔbɔtow hɔn dwetɛ egu abrɔn mu, na hɔn sikakɔkɔɔ ayɛ dɛ efifidze; hɔn dwetɛ na hɔn sika runntum nngye hɔn wɔ EWURADZE n’ebufuw da no mu; wɔnnkɛmee hɔn akra, eso wɔrennhyehyɛ hɔn nson amaama: osiandɛ ɔno na ɔayɛ hɔn emumuyɛ ho fintsidua.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hɔn ahokadze ne fɛɛfɛw no dze, wɔdze dzii abakombasɛm: na wɔyɛɛ hɔn ekyiwadze na hɔn atantandze no mfonyi no wɔ mu: dɛm ntsi na mama adan hɔn efifidze no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze bɛhyɛ ananaben nsa dɛ afonam, na asaase no do emumuyɛfo no nsa dɛ asadze; na wobogu ho fi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mebɛdan m’enyim so efi hɔn do, na woegu mo sumabea ho fi: na edwotwafo bɛhɛn mu na wobogu ho fi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Yɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no: na asaase no do ayɛ ewudzi ma, na kurow no mu ayɛ akakabensɛm ma.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi medze amanaman mu abɔn no bɛba, ma wɔabɛfa hɔn efiefi no ayɛ hɔndze: mebɛma ahoɔdzenfo nkontompɔ so abɔ adze; na wobogu hɔn krɔnkrɔn mbea so ho fi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ ɔsɛɛ ba a, wɔbɔhwehwɛ asomdwee, naaso wonnkenya bi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbusu bɔbɔ mbusu do, na huhuhuhu abɔ huhuhuhu do; na wɔbɔhwehwɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi hɔ enyido adzehu; na mbra no bɛhera efi asɔfo no ho, na apam efi mpanyimfo no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔhen begyam, na bapɔmba no efura abagura, na asaase no do nkorɔfo no hɔn abaw mu etu: na mebɛyɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kwan tse, na mebu hɔn atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata hɔn; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia esia no mu no, bosoom a otsia esia no mu da a otsia enum no, ber metse me fie na Juda mpanyin no tsetse m’enyim no, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ne nsa tɔɔ mo do wɔ hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mohwɛe, na muhun nyimpa saso bi a no hwɛbea tse dɛ ogya; na ofi mbrɛ ɔhwɛ dɛ ɔyɛ n’asen na odzi sian no, gya a: na ofi n’asen na ɔdze fow sor no, ɔtse dɛ hyerɛn no hwɛbea, n’enyi tse dɛ sika na dwetɛ mforaforaa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔtseen nsa bi ne saso, na osuoo m’etsifi nhwi mu; na sunsum no maa mo do duaa asaase na sor ntamu, wɔ Nyankopɔn enyido adzehu mu dze me baa Jerusalɛm abangua a ɔwɔ mu a ɔhwɛ kwaamu afamu n’abobotsen no ano; mbrɛ nyinkuntwe no honyi a oyi nyinkun no si.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na, hwɛ, Israel Nyankopɔn n’enyimnyam wɔ hɔ, dɛ mbrɛ hwɛbea a muhunii wɔ tɛtɛr no mu tse no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, afei ma w’enyiwa do hwɛ kwaamu afamu. Nna memaa m’enyiwa do mohwɛɛ kwaamu afamu, na hwɛ nyinkuntwe honyi yi wɔ afɔrmbukyia abobokɛse no ano.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, ana ihu dza wɔreyɛ? Mekyerɛ ekyiwadze akɛse a Israelfo reyɛ no wɔ ha, ma nkyɛ meefi mo krɔnkrɔnbea maakɔ ekyirekyir no? Mbom mbrɛana irubohu ekyiwadze akɛse bi so a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔdze me baa abangua abow no ano; na mohwɛe no, na, hwɛ, otokur bi wɔ afasu no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, afei bɔr fasu no mu: na mobɔɔr fasu no mu no, nna hwɛ, abow nye yi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Hɛn mu, kɔhwɛ emumuyɛ ekyiwadze a wɔreyɛ no wɔ hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mehɛɛn mu kɔhwɛe; na muhun aweaweambowa n’ahorow, na mbowa a wokyir, na Israel fi abosom nyinara a woekrukyekrukye hɔn wɔ afasu no ho ehyia.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Israelmba mu mpanyimfo eduosuon gyinagyina hɔn enyim, na Safan ba Jaazania gyina hɔn finimfin, na nyimpa biara ne nsa dze no nduhuamsɛn mu; na eduhuam wusiw no ne nka faa sor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, ana ehu dza Israelmba mu mpanyimfo reyɛ wɔ sum mu no, nyimpa biara wɔ n’ehonyi mpia mu, na wɔka dɛ, EWURADZE nnhu hɛn; EWURADZE apa asaase no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔsee me bio so dɛ, Ebɛda ho ara ehu ekyiwadze akɛse bi so a wɔreyɛ no bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔdze me baa EWURADZE fie abokɛse no a odzi kwaamu afamu no ano; na, hwɛ, mbaa tsetse hɔ rusu Tammuz.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, aso ehu iyi? Ibohu ara ehu ekyiwadze akɛse a ɔsen iyinom bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔdze me baa EWURADZE afamu abangua no do, na hwɛ, EWURADZE asɔrdan abow no ano, nkrandaa no na afɔrmbukyia no ntamu, mbarimba bɛyɛ eduonu enum wɔ hɔ a hɔn ekyir dzi EWURADZE asɔrdan no do, na hɔn enyim dzi boka afamu; na wɔkotowee sɔɔr ewia wɔ boka afamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, ana ehu iyi? Aso ɔyɛ adze kakraba ma Judamba dɛ wɔyɛ ekyiwadze a wɔyɛ no wɔ ha yi? Wɔdze akakabensɛm ahyɛ asaase no do ma, na wɔasan ribeyi me ebufuw: na, hwɛ, wɔdze odubaa no ka hɔn hwen.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi na mo so mibedzi no ebufuhyew mu: m’enyiwa rennkam do, eso murunnhu mbɔbɔr: na kaansa wɔdze ndze kɛse keka mu gu m’aso mu mpo a, mirinntsie hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔdze ndze kɛse kaa mu guu m’asomu, dɛ, Hom mma hɔn a wɔhwɛ kurow no do no wɔntwe mpin, nyimpa biara n’akodze a wɔdze sɛɛ kitsa ne nsamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hwɛ, mbarimba baasa fi etsifi abokɛse a ɔda kwaamu afamu kwan do no bae, nyimpa biara n’akodze a wɔdze ku kitsa ne nsamu; na barimba baako wɔ hɔn mu a ɔhyɛ ndwera a kyerɛwnyi dubirtoa sɛn ne nkyɛmfamu. Na wɔkɔr mu kegyinaa boran afɔrmbukyia no nkyɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Israel Nyankopɔn n’enyimnyam fii kerub a ɔwɔ do no do baa ofi no n’abowano: na ɔfrɛɛ barimba a ɔhyɛ ndwera a kyerɛwnyi dubirtoa sɛn ne nkyɛmfamu no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, Kodua kurow no mu, Jerusalɛm mu, na kɛhyɛ mbarimba a wosi nkrum na wɔkeka mu wɔ ekyiwadze a wɔyɛ no wɔ mu no hɔn momapɔw do nsew.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na nkaa no so ɔsee hɔn wɔ m’aso mu dɛ, Hom ndzi n’ekyir nkodua kurow no mu, na hom nkuku: mma hom enyiwa nnkam do, eso mma hom nnhu mbɔbɔr:
title: EZEKIEL

text: hom nku akɔdaa, aberantsɛ na ababaawa, na mbofraba na mbaa dwɛɛ: na nyimpa biara a nsewhyɛ wɔ no ho no dze, mma hom mmbɛn no; na hom nhyɛ ase wɔ mo krɔnkrɔn bea hɔ. Nna wɔhyɛɛ ase wɔ atsetsefo a wɔwɔ ofi no enyim no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ngu ofi no ho fi, na hom mfa atɔfo nhyehyɛ abangua no do amaama: hom mfir edzi nkɔ. Na wofiir edzi kɔree, na wokunkum no, wɔ kurow no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, aber a worukuku no, na aka mo nko no, nna medze m’enyim butuuw famu, na mekaa mu mesee dɛ, Ao, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn! Aso ebɛsɛɛ Israel nkaa nyinara wɔ w’ebufuw a iruhue egu Jerusalɛm do no mu?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Israel na Juda fifo emumuyɛ so ntrado, na asaase no do ayɛ bɔgya ma na kurow no mu ayɛ ntɛnkyew ma: na wɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE apa asaase, na EWURADZE nnhu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na emi so dze, m’enyiwa rennkam, eso murunnhu mbɔbɔr, na medze hɔn kwan bobua hɔn etsifi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hwɛ, barimba a ɔhyɛ ndwera a dubirtoa sɛn ne nkyɛmfamu no, bɔbɔɔ amandzɛɛ no, dɛ, Mayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ehyɛɛ me no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mohwɛe, na muhun wimu a ɔwɔ kerubfo no etsifi no, na biribi yii noho wɔ do tse dɛ hoabo, no hwɛbea tse dɛ ahengua ne saso.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ nyimpa a ɔhyɛ ndwera no, na ɔsee dɛ, Kɛhɛn ekyinehyia nhwiir no ntamu, kerub no n’ase, na fa gyansenama hyehyɛ wo nsa ebien nyina amaama wɔ kerubfo no ntamu, na petse kurow no do. Na ɔkɛhɛɛn mu wɔ m’enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afei barimba no kɛhɛɛn mu no, nna kerubfo no gyinagyina dan no ne nkyɛnmu nyimfa afamu; na fua hyɛɛ abangua a ɔwɔ mu no ma.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna EWURADZE n’enyimnyam fii kerub no do fowee kɔr sor, na okegyinaa dan no n’abowano; na fua hyɛɛ dan no ma, na EWURADZE n’enyimnyam ne hyerɛn yɛɛ abangua no ma.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na kerubfo no hɔn ntsaban ne gyegye no wɔtsee no wɔ abowano abangua no do mpo, dɛ Otumfo Nyankopɔn ne ndze, ber a ɔrekasa no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, ber a ɔhyɛɛ barimba a ɔhyɛ ndwera no, dɛ, Fa gya fi ekyinehyia nhwiir no ntamu, wɔ kerubfo no ntamu no, ɔkɛhɛɛn mu na okegyinaa hwiir no nkyɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na kerub no tseen ne nsa fii kerubfo no ntamu, ɔdze kɔr gya a ɔwɔ kerubfo ntamu no do, na ɔfaa bi, na ɔdze kitsaa nyia ɔhyɛ ndwera no nsamu, na ɔgyee dze kɔree.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na nyimpa nsa saso bi puei wɔ kerubfo no ho, wɔ hɔn ntsaban ase.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mohwɛe, na hwɛ, nhwiir anan wɔ kerubfo no nkyɛnmu, hwiir kor wɔ kerub kor nkyɛnmu, na hwiir kor so wɔ kerub kor so nkyɛnmu: na nhwiir no hwɛbea tse dɛ sikabereebo enyi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn hwɛbea no dze, anan nyina hɔn saso kor, dɛ gyama hwiir a nkyɛ ɔhyɛ hwiir mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ wɔnam a, wɔnam hɔn afa anan no do: na sɛ wɔnam a, wonntwa hɔnho, na beebi mbrɛ tsir no hwɛ no na wɔka do; wɔnam a, wonntwa hɔnho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn nyimpadua nyina, na hɔn ekyir, na hɔn nsa, na hɔn ntsaban, na hɔn nhwiir no, enyiwaenyiwa ayɛ ho ma etwa ehyia, nhwiir a hɔn baanan no wɔ no a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nhwiir no dze, wɔfrɛɛ hɔn wɔ m’asomu, ekyinehyia nhwiir no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na obiara n’enyim anan: enyim a odzi kan no yɛ kerub enyim, na enyim a otsia ebien no yɛ nyimpa enyim, na dza otsia ebiasa no yɛ gyata enyim, na dza otsia anan no yɛ ɔkɔr enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na kerubfo no memaa hɔnho do: iyi nye abɔdze nyikamfo a muhunii wɔ esutsen Kebar ho no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na kerubfo no rokɔ a, nhwiir no dzi hɔn nkyɛn: na kerubfo no ma hɔn ntsaban do dɛ wɔrema hɔnho do efi asaase do a, nhwiir no so nndan mmfi hɔn nkyɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ hɔn wogyina a, nna woyinom so woegyina; na sɛ wɔmema hɔnho do a, nna woyinom so nye hɔn amema hɔnho do: osiandɛ abɔdze nyikan no no sunsum wɔ hɔn mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’enyimnyam no fii ofi no abowano kegyinaa kerub no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na kerubfo no memaa hɔn ntsaban do, na wɔmemaa hɔnho do fii asaase do wɔ m’enyim dɛ worifir edzi, na nhwiir no wɔ hɔn nkyɛnmu: na wokegyinaa EWURADZE fie abokɛse a odzi boka no ano; na Israel Nyankopɔn n’enyimnyam no wɔ hɔn etsifi sor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Iyi nye abɔdze enyikan a muhunii wɔ Israel Nyankopɔn n’ase wɔ esutsen Kebar ho no; na muhun dɛ wɔyɛ kerubfo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Obiara wɔ enyim anan, na obiara wɔ ntsaban anan; na nyimpa nsa ne saso wɔ hɔn ntsaban no ase.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn enyim ne saso dze, enyim a muhunii wɔ esutsen Kebar ho no a, hɔn nhwɛbea na hɔn munantwɛr; hɔn mu obiara nam n’enyim tsenn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio so sunsum no maa me do, na ɔdze me baa EWURADZE fie boka afamu abotsen a ɔhwɛ boka no ano: na hwɛ, mbarimba eduonu enum gyinagyina abotsen no ano; na muhun Azzur ba Jaazania na Benaia ba Pelatia, ɔman no mu mbapɔmba no, wɔ hɔn finimfin.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, woyinom nye mbarimba a wɔhyehyɛ emumuyɛ wɔ tsirmu, na wɔma apam bɔn wɔ kurow yi mu:
title: EZEKIEL

text: hɔn a wɔka dɛ, Aber a wɔdze si adan mmbɛnee: kurow yi nye dadzesɛn no, na hɛn nye nam no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi, onyimpa ba, hyɛ nkɔm, hyɛ nkɔm tsia hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE no sunsum tɔɔ mo do, na ɔsee me dɛ, Kasa dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Israelmba, mbrɛ hom ase nye yi: na minyim ndzɛmba a aba hom adwen mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom ama hom atɔfoe adɔɔ so wɔ kurow yi mu, na hom dze n’atɔfoe ahyehyɛ abrɔn no amaama.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hom atɔfoe a hom dze egugu mu no, hɔn nye nam no, na kurow yi nye dadzesɛn no: na wɔdze hom befi mu efir.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom esuro afona no; na medze afona no bɛba hom do, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze hom befi mu efir edzi na medze hom ahyɛ ananaben nsa, na mayɛ m’atsɛmbudze wɔ hom mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom bɔtotɔ afona ano: mubobu hom atsɛn wɔ Israel he do; na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Kurow yi rennyɛ hom dadzesɛn, eso hom rennyɛ nam wɔ mu; mubobu hom atsɛn wɔ Israel he do;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE: osiandɛ hom annantsew m’ahyɛdze do, eso hom annyɛ m’atsɛmbudze, mbom hom ekedzi amanaman a etwa hom ho ehyia no hɔn mmom do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, mehyɛɛ nkɔm no, nna Benaia ba Pelatia wui. Nna medze m’enyim butuuw famu, na medze ndze kɛse mekaa mu dɛ, Ao EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, aso iboku Israel nkaa no ase koraa?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, wo nuanom, mekyerɛ wo nuanom, wo bɔgyaa, na Israelfo nyinara, hɔn nyinara, hɔn nye hɔn a Jerusalɛmmba ase hɔn dɛ, Hom mfi EWURADZE nkyɛn nkɔ ekyirekyir; hɛn na wɔdze asaase yi ama hɛn dɛ enyadze:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Kaansa meyi hɔn akɔ ekyirekyir amanaman mu, na mabɔ hɔn apetse nkurow nkurow mu mpo a, mebɛyɛ hɔn krɔnkrɔn bea mber kakra wɔ nkurow nkurow a wɔakɔ do no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Mobɔboaboa hom ano efi aman mu, na mapon hom ehyia efi nkurow nkurow a wɔabɔ hom apetse hɔ no do, na medze Israel asaase ama hom.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔbɛba hɔ na wobeyi no mu atantandze nyina na no mu ekyiwadze nyinara efi hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛma hɔn akoma kor, na medze sunsum fofor ahyɛ hom mu; na mibeyi ɔbo akoma no mefi hɔn honam mu, na mama hɔn honam akoma:
title: EZEKIEL

text: ama wɔaanantsew m’ahyɛdze do, na woedzi mo mmom do, na wɔaayɛ: na wɔbɛyɛ me man, na mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn a hɔn akoma dzi hɔn atantandze na hɔn ekyiwadze akoma ekyir no dze, medze hɔn akwan bobua hɔn etsifi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna kerubfo no memaa hɔn ntsaban do, na nhwiir no dzi hɔn nkyɛnmu; na Israel Nyankopɔn n’enyimnyam wɔ hɔn do wɔ sor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’enyimnyam fi kurow no ne finimfin foow sor, na okegyinaa bepɔw a ɔda kurow no no boka afamu no no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sunsum no maa me do, na ɔdze me nam Nyankopɔn no sunsum do kɔr Kaldea ndɔmmumkɔfo no nkyɛn wɔ enyido adzehu mu. Nna enyido adzehu a muhunii no ofii mo do kɔr sor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mekaa ndzɛmba a EWURADZE dze kyerɛɛ me no nyinara ho asɛm kyerɛɛ ndɔmmumkɔfo no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ so, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, etse etuatsew fi mu; hɔn a wɔwɔ enyi a wɔdze hu, na wonnhu; wɔwɔ aso a wɔdze tse, na wɔnntse; osiandɛ wɔyɛ etuatsew fi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔwo, onyimpa ba, siesie tukɔr ndzɛmba na tu ewiaber kɔ wɔ hɔn enyim; na tu fi mbrɛ ewɔ no kɔ beebi fofor wɔ hɔn enyim: bi a wɔbɔdwen ho, kaansa wɔyɛ etuatsew fi mpo a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na yi wo ndzɛmba ewiaber fir edzi wɔ hɔn enyim, dɛ tukɔr ndzɛmba: na ɔwoara dze, si mu ewimbir wɔ hɔn enyim, dɛ aber a nkorɔfo rutu akɔ ndɔmmum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bɔr fasu mu wɔ hɔn enyim, na soa adze dua mu pue.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bɔ no akɔnkɔn wɔ hɔn enyim, na fa dua sum mu fir edzi; kata w’enyim mma eennhu daadze: na medze wo mayɛ asɛnkyerɛdze mama Israelmba.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na meyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔhyɛɛ me no: medze me ndzɛmba fiir edzi ewiaber, dɛ tukɔr ndzɛmba, na ewimbir no, medze me nsa bɔɔr fasu no mu; medze nam sum mu fiir edzi, na mobɔɔ no akɔnkɔn wɔ hɔn enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na adze kyee no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, aso Israelmba, etuatsewfo no, nnsee wo dɛ, Ereyɛ dɛn nye yi?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Adzesoa yi fi ɔhen a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no ho, na Israelmba nyina a wɔwɔ hɔn mu no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ka dɛ, Emi nye hom asɛnkyerɛdze: dɛ mbrɛ mayɛ no, dɛmara na wɔdze bɛyɛ hɔn: wobotu akɔ ndɔmmum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔhen a ɔwɔ hɔn mu no bɔsoa adze wɔ no kɔn ho wɔ sum mu, na oefir edzi: wɔbɔbɔr fasu mu na wɔdze edua mu efir edzi: ɔbɛkata n’enyim, osiandɛ ɔremmfa n’enyiwa nnhu famu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mobɔtow mo boa so megu no do, na wɔapa no wɔ m’efir mu: na medze no bɛba Babilɔn wɔ Kaldeafo asaase do; naaso orunnhu, kaansa hɔ na obowu mpo a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn a woetwa no ho ehyia dɛ wɔbɔboa no nyina, na n’asafo nyina, mobɔbɔ hɔn apetse mframa nyina mu; na mobɔtwe afona no etsiw hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, ber a mobɔhotse amanaman mu, na mabɔ hɔn apetse nkurow nkurow do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mibegyaa hɔn mu nyimpa kumaabi efi afona, ɔkɔm na yardɔm nsa; ama waaka hɔn ekyiwadze nyina akyerɛ wɔ amanaman a wɔbɛba mu no mu; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio so EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, fa ahohim dzi w’edziban, na fa ahopopo na nhwɛyie nom wo nsu;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na se asaase no do nkorɔfo no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se wɔ Jerusalɛmmba, na Israel asaase ho nye yi: Wɔdze nhwɛyie bedzi hɔn edziban, na wɔdze ahobow anom hɔn nsu, ama n’asaase ayɛ afo wɔ dza ɔwɔ mu nyinara ho, osian hɔn a wɔtse do nyina hɔn akakabensɛm ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na nkurow a wɔtsetse do nyina bɔbɔ, na asaase no adan afo; na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, ebɛn abɛbusɛm nye yi a hom wowɔ no Israel asaase do dɛ, Nda mu atwe na enyido adzehu biara yɛ kwa yi?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi ka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Mebɛma abɛbusɛm yi abɔ adze, na worummbu no dɛ bɛ bio wɔ Israel; na se hɔn dɛ, Nda no na enyido adzehu nyina no nsunsuando abɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na enyido adzehu gyangyan anaa adzɛfɛdzɛfɛw mbusu nkɔnhyɛ biara remmba Israel fi mu ara bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na emi nye EWURADZE; mebɛkasa, na asɛm a mebɛka no, ɔbɛba mu; wɔronntwe nnkɔ ekyir bio: na, etuatsew fi e, hom nda mu na mebɛka asɛm no na mayɛ, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ bio dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, hwɛ, hɔn a wɔwɔ Israel fie no se dɛ, Enyido adzehu a ohu no ayɛ nda pii a ɔreba nedze, na ɔhyɛ mber a ɔwɔ ekyirekyir ho nkɔm.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi; Wɔronntwe me nsɛm mu biara nnkɔ ekyir bio, na asɛm a mebɛka no, ɔbɛba mu, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, hyɛ Israel nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛ nkɔm no do nkɔm, na se hɔn a wofi hɔnankasa hɔn akoma mu hyɛ nkɔm no dɛ, Hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm:
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ndom nka nkɔnhyɛfo nkwasea a wodzi hɔnankasa hɔn sunsum ekyir na wonnhun hwee no!
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ao Israel, wo nkɔnhyɛfo ayɛ dɛ ekurofo mu nsɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom mmfowee nnkɔr ntokur no mu, eso hom nngyee Israel fi ho ban, dɛ wobegyina akono wɔ EWURADZE ne da no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Woehu egyangyandze na ator mbusu nkɔnhyɛ, dɛ wɔka dɛ EWURADZE na ɔse; naaso na EWURADZE nnsomaa hɔn: na wɔama adasa enya enyidado dɛ asɛm no bɛhyɛ ma.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ana hom nnhun enyido adzehu gyangyan, na hom nnhyɛɛ ator mbusu nkɔm, ber a hom se dɛ, EWURADZE na ɔse; naaso na nnyɛ emi na maka?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ hom aka nsɛm huhuw na hom ehu ator ntsi, dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, menye hom enya, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na me nsa bɛda nkɔnhyɛfo a wohu egyangyandze, na wɔhyɛ nkɔntor no do: wɔrommfora me man baguafo mu, eso wɔrennkyerɛw hɔn wɔ Israel fi nkyerɛwee no mu, eso wɔrennhɛn Israel asaase mu, na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE Nyankopɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Osian, osian ara dɛ hom adaadaa me man, dɛ, Asomdwee; na asomdwee biara nnyi hɔ; na sɛ obi tow fasu a, hwɛ, wɔdze kaadow twuw ho ntsi:
title: EZEKIEL

text: se hɔn a wɔdze kaadow twuw ho no dɛ, obobu; nsupramee bɛba; na hom, sorabo akɛse, hom bɔtotɔ; na ehum mframa bɛpaapaa mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hwɛ, sɛ fasu no dwuruw a, ana wɔnnkɛse hom dɛ, Ntwuwho a hom dze etwuw ho no wɔ hen?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ehum mframa na medze mebɛpaapaa mu mpo wɔ m’ebufuhyew mu; na nsupramee bɛba wɔ m’ebufuw mu, na sorabo akɛse aba wɔ m’ebufuhyew mu ahyew no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mubodwuruw fasu a hom dze kaadow etwuw ho no, na medze aka famu, ma ne fapem ho ada hɔ: na obobu, na hom adwerew wɔ mu; na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ mubowie m’ebufuhyew wɔ fasu no, na hɔn a wɔdze kaadow twuuw ho no nye no; na mebɛse hom dɛ, Fasu no nye hɔn a wotwuuw ho no nnyi hɔ bio;
title: EZEKIEL

text: mekyerɛ Israel nkɔnhyɛfo no a wɔhyɛ Jerusalɛm ho nkɔm na wohu asomdwee ho enyido adzehu ma no, na asomdwee nnyi hɔ no, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, fa w’enyi si wo man ne mbabaa a wofi hɔnankasa hɔn akoma mu hyehyɛ nkɔm no ho; na hyɛ nkɔm gu hɔn do,
title: EZEKIEL

text: na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ndom nka mbaa a wɔpempam nsɛbɛ bobɔ hɔn nsakɔn nyina, na wɔyɛ nduukuu ma nyimpa horow hɔn etsir dɛ wɔdze rotwee akra! Aso hom bɔtwee me man hɔn akra, na hom agye akra nkwa ama hom ho?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom egu mo ho fi wɔ me man mu wɔ atoko nsa amaama na boodoo esinesin ntsi, dɛ hom ruku akra a wɔnnsɛ dɛ wowu, na hom dze regye akra a wɔnnsɛ dɛ wɔtsena ase nkwa, ɔnam hom ator a hom dzidzi kyerɛ me man a wotsiee atorsɛm no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, Mitsia hom nsɛbɛ a hom dze tweetwee akra wɔ hɔ ma woeetu no, na mebɛtsetsew hɔn mefi hom abaw do; na mebɛma akra no akɔ, mekyerɛ akra a hom tweetwee hɔn ma woeetu no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom nduukuu no so mebɛtsetsew mu na meyi me man efi wo nsamu, mma wɔaannda ho anntsena hom nsamu, mma wɔaanntweetwee hɔn; na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Osiandɛ hom dze ator ahow ɔtseneneenyi a emi mara mennhyɛɛ no awerɛhow no no werɛ; na hom ahyɛ mumuyɛnyi ne nsa dzen, amma ɔaannsan emmfi n’emumuyɛ kwan no ho ma wɔaanngye no nkwa:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi hom runnhu egyangyandze, anaa hom rennhyɛ mbusu nkɔm bio: na mibeyi me man mefi hom nsamu; na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna Israel mpanyimfo no bi baa me nkyɛn na wɔtsenatsenaa m’enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ;
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, mbarimba yi wɔdze hɔn abosom esuma hɔn akoma mu, na wɔdze hɔn emumuyɛ ne fintsidua esi hɔn enyim: aso ɔsɛ dɛ wɔba mo hɔ ebisa?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi kasa kyerɛ hɔn na se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Israel fi mu ɔbarimba biara a ɔdze n’abosom bosuma n’akoma mu, na ɔdze n’emumuyɛ ho fintsidua esi n’enyim, na ɔaba nkɔnhyɛnyi hɔ no; emi EWURADZE mubobua no wɔ mu dɛ mbrɛ n’abosom dodow tse;
title: EZEKIEL

text: ama meesuo Israelmba mu wɔ hɔnara hɔn akoma mu, osiandɛ wɔnam hɔn abosom do atsew hɔnho efi me nkyɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi se Israelmba dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hom nsan, na hom ndan hom ho mfi hom abosom ho; na hom ndan hom enyi mfi hom ekyiwadze nyinara ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Israelmba anaa ahɔho a wɔakɛyɛ amamforafo wɔ Israel no mu obiara a ɔbɛtsew noho efi me nkyɛn na ɔdze n’abosom esuma n’akoma mu, na ɔdze n’emumuyɛ ho fintsidua esi n’enyi do, na ɔaba nkɔnhyɛnyi hɔ ebebisa mo hɔ adze no; emi EWURADZE mara na mubobua no:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na medze m’enyi bɛsa nyimpa no, na mayɛ no ahobowdze ma ɔaayɛ asɛnkyerɛdze na kasabɛbu na mubotwa no efi me man mu akyen; na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi bi wɔdaadaa no ma ɔka asɛm bi a, emi EWURADZE na madaadaa nkɔnhyɛnyi no, na mebɛtsen me nsa wɔ no do, na masɛɛ no efi me man Israel mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔbɔsoa hɔn emumuyɛ: nkɔnhyɛnyi n’emumuyɛ bɛyɛ dɛ nyia ɔba no hɔ no n’emumuyɛ no ara;
title: EZEKIEL

text: amma Israelmba aanntɔ gon emmfi me nkyɛn bio, eso wɔaammfa hɔn mbrato eenngu hɔnho fi bio; na mbom ama wɔaayɛ me man na emi so maayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, sɛ asaase bi dze mbrato yɛ me bɔn, na metsen me nsa wɔ no do, na mubu n’edziban dua mu, na mema kɔm ba do, na mutwa nyimpa, na abowa fi do kyen;
title: EZEKIEL

text: kaansa mbarimba baasa yi, Noa, Daniel, na Job, wɔ hɔ mpo a, hɔnara hɔn akra ara na wɔnam hɔn tsenenee do bɛgye, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ mema mbowa bɔn kyin asaase no do, na wɔsɛɛ no, ma ɔyɛ afo, ma biara nndua do wɔ mbowa ntsi a:
title: EZEKIEL

text: kaansa mbarimba baasa yi wɔ mu a, dɛ metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, wɔrenngye mbabanyin anaa mbabaa; hɔnara nko na wɔbɛgye hɔn, na asaase no dze, ɔbɛyɛ afo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Anaaso sɛ medze afona ba asaase no do, na mese dɛ, Afona e, fa asaase no do ɛ; ma muntwa nyimpa na abowa fi do nkyen;
title: EZEKIEL

text: kaansa mbarimba baasa yi wɔ hɔ mpo a, dɛ metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, wɔrenngye mbabanyin anaa mbabaa, na hɔnara nko na wɔbɛgye hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Anaaso sɛ mosoma yardɔm ba asaase no do, na muhue m’ebufuhyew gu do wɔ bɔgya mu, dɛ murutwa nyimpa na abowa mefi do a:
title: EZEKIEL

text: kaansa Noa, Daniel, na Job wɔ hɔ mpo a, dɛ metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, wɔrenngye babanyin anaa babaa; hɔnara hɔn akra ara na wɔnam hɔn tsenenee do bɛgye.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Na akantam dɛ mobɔsoma m’atsɛmbudze yerɛyerɛw anan, afona, na kɔm, na mbowa bɔn, na yardɔm maba Jerusalɛm do eebotwa nyimpa na abowa efi mu?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso, hwɛ, wobegyaa nkaase bi wɔ mu a wɔdze hɔn befir edzi akɔ, mbabanyin na mbabaa nyina: hwɛ, wobefir edzi aba hom nkyɛn, na hom ehu hɔn abrabɔ na hɔn ndzeyɛɛ: na wɔbɛkyekye hom werɛ wɔ mbusu a medze aba Jerusalɛm do no ho, dza medze aba do nyinara no ho a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔbɛkyekye hom werɛ, ber a hom bohu hɔn abrabɔ na hɔn ndzeyɛɛ no: nna hom bohu dɛ dza mayɛ no wɔ mu nyinara nnyɛ kwa ara na mayɛ, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo ho, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, ebɛnadze na wenyindua dze sen dua biara, wenyin abaw a ɔwɔ kwaa mu ndua mu no?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Aso wɔfa no dua bi dze ayɛ edwuma bi? Anaadɛ wɔfa mu bi yɛ bɔfondua a wɔdze adze sɛn do?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hwɛ, wɔtow kyen gya mu kua no nyena: gya no amen n’ano afa na afa nyina, na ne finimfin no ahyew; aso mfaso bi wɔ ho ma edwuma bi?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hwɛ, odzi mu no mpo, ɔammfata edwuma biara: na burbur ber a gya no amen no, ma ɔahyew yi, na ɔbɛfata edwuma bi anaa?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Dɛ mbrɛ wenyindua a ɔwɔ kwaa mu ndua a medze ayɛ nyena ekua gya tse no, dɛmara so na medze Jerusalɛmfo bɛma.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze m’enyi bɛsa hɔn; wobefi gya no mu efir, na gya no bɛmen hɔn; na sɛ medze m’enyi sa hɔn a, hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛma asaase no ayɛ afo, osiandɛ wɔato mbra, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ bio, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, ma Jerusalɛm nhu n’ekyiwadze,
title: EZEKIEL

text: na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛ Jerusalɛm nye yi: W’awoe na w’awobea wɔ Keenanfo asaase do; w’egya yɛ Amorinyi, na wo na yɛ Hitinyi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na w’awobea dze, da a wɔwoo wo no, woenntwa wo funuma, eso wɔammfa nsu ennguar wo ma wo ho emmfir; wɔammfa nkyen ennhura wo ho koraa, eso wɔammfa tam annkyekyer wo ho koraa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Obiara ne yamu annhyehye no amma wo, annyɛ iyinom amma wo, ammfa ennhu wo mbɔbɔr; mbom wɔtoow wo kyeen sardo prododo, osiandɛ wo nyimpamu yɛ hɔn tan, wɔ da a wɔwoo wo no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mubotwaa mu wo nkyɛn, na muhun wo dɛ ereyankam wo bɔgyaa mu no, mesee wo dɛ, Kaansa ewɔ wo bɔgyaa mu mpo a, nya nkwa; nyew, mesee wo dɛ, Kaansa ewɔ wo bɔgyaa mu mpo a, nya nkwa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Memaa edɔɔr dɛ hamu nkukuduuduw, na ɔwo yɛɛ pii na yɛɛ kɛse, na w’ahoɔfɛw gyinaa mu mbordo; wo mpokuwa bobɔe, na wo tsinhwi fuwii; naaso nna idzi adagyaw na kwatserkwa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afei mubotwaa mu wɔ wo nkyɛn, na mohwɛɛ wo no, hwɛ, wo ber no yɛ ɔdɔ ber; na medze m’atarse tserɛɛw wo do, na mekataa w’adagyaw do: nyew, mekaa ntam kyerɛɛ wo, na menye wo dzii ahyɛmu, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, na ebɛyɛɛ medze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna medze nsu guaar wo; nyew, mohohoor wo ho bɔgya koraa fii wo ho, na medze ngo seraa wo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mehyɛɛ wo atar a woedzi mu akye so, na mehyɛɛ wo nsukraman nwoma mpaboa, na medze ndwera pa kyekyeer wo ho, na medze serekye kataa wo do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Medze ahyehyɛdze hyehyɛɛ wo so, na medze nkaba hyɛɛ wo nsa, na medze ntweaban too wo kɔn mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze pɛtsea hyɛɛ wo hwen mu, na medze asowamuadze hyehyɛɛ w’asowa mu, na medze abɔtsir fɛɛfɛw bɔɔ wo tsir.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ wɔdze sika na dwetɛ hyehyɛɛ wo nye yi; na wo ntar yɛ ndwera pa, na serekye, na nkyermu, isiam pa na ewo, na ngo, nna idzii: na wo ho yɛɛ fɛw mbordo, na idzii yie kodur ahendzi mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na w’ahoɔfɛw ne nka tahyee kɔr amanaman mu; osiandɛ odzi mu, osian m’enyimnyam a medze mehyɛɛ wo no ntsi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso ɔwo edze wo werɛ tweer w’ahoɔfɛw, na egoor ndwamangor wɔ w’atsenka ntsi, na ihuee wo ndwamangor guu obiara a orutwa mu no do; ɔyɛɛ nedze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo efaa w’atar bi, na edze yɛɛ nsorɔnsorɔmbea a wɔaka no edur horow maa woho, na egoor do ndwamangor: ndzɛmba a ɔtse dɛm bi nnkɛba, ɔrennyɛ dɛm so.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔwo efaa wo ndwindze fɛɛfɛw, me sika na dwetɛ a medze memaa wo no so bi, na edze yɛɛ mbarimba ehonyi maa woho, na enye hɔn goor ndwamangor;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na efaa wo ntar a woedzi mu akye no dze kataa hɔn do, na edze mo ngo na m’eduhuam sii hɔn enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: M’edziban so a medze maa wo no, isiam pa, na ngo, na ewo a medze nyɛɛn wo no, edze sii hɔn enyim mpo dɛ nka huanhuam, nna mbrɛ ɔyɛe nye no; EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio so afa wo mbabanyin na wo mbabaa a awo hɔn ama me no, na woyinom na edze hɔn abɔ afɔr ama hɔn dɛ wɔmmemen hɔn. Aso wo ndwamanyɛ yɛ adze ketseaba,
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛ ekuku me mba, na eyi hɔn ama, dɛ wondua gya mu mma hɔn?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na w’ekyiwadze na wo ndwamanyɛ nyinara mu annkaa wo mbofraber mu nda a idzii adagyaw na kwatserkwa, na ereyankayankam wo bɔgyaa mu no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔaba dɛ w’emumuyɛ nyinara ekyir no, (ndom, ndom nka wo! EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse,)
title: EZEKIEL

text: na atow dampan ama woho, na ayɛ sorɔnsorɔmbea wɔ abrɔn nyinara mu ama woho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Akwan nyina tsir na ayɛ mpampaa, na ayɛ w’ahoɔfɛw ekyiwadze, na ebue w’anan mu ama obiara a oetwa mu asen no, na ama wo ndwamanyɛ adɔɔ so.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Enye Egyptfo, w’amanyimfo abran no so, agor ndwamangor; na ama wo ndwamanyɛ adɔɔ so dze eyi me ebufuw.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, matsen me nsa wɔ wo do, na mehuan wo daa daa edziban no do, na medze wo ahyɛ hɔn a wokyir wo no hɔn pɛ nsa, Filistiafo mbabaa a hɔn enyi to wo ndwamambra ho no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Enye Asiriafo so agor ndwamangor, osiandɛ ammee; nyew, enye hɔn agor ndwamangor, naaso ammee.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nkyii so ama wo ndwamanyɛ adɔɔ so wɔ Keenan asaase do, ekodu Kaldea; na iyiara so mpo ammee wo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ w’akoma dua yɛ mberɛw a, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, dɛ eyɛ ndzɛmba yinom nyina a ɔyɛ ɔbaa edwaman a oepirim n’enyim ne ndzeyɛɛ;
title: EZEKIEL

text: wɔ dɛ etow wo dampan wɔ akwan nyina tsir, na eyɛ wo sorɔnsorɔmbea wɔ abrɔn nyina mu no; na ɔwo annyɛ dɛ edwaman, wɔ dɛ epow apɛdze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔyer a ɔto awar! Ɔgye ahɔho hyɛ no kun ananmu!
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔkyɛ ndwaman nyinara akyɛdze: naaso ɔwo dze, edze w’akyɛdze mema w’adɔfo nyinara, na ema hɔn mboaba, ama wofi mbeambea nyinara aba wo nkyɛn abɔgor ndwamangor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ntsi ɔwo wo ndwamanyɛ no, yɛ soronko fi mbaa binom dze ho, osiandɛ obi ammbɔ wo paa wɔ ndwamangor mu: mbom dɛ ɔwo na ema akatua, na wɔmma wo akatua no, eyɛ soronko ampa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi, edwaman e, tsie EWURADZE n’asɛm:
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ wohuee w’ahonamfi gui, na ɔnam wo ndwamangor a enye w’adɔfo goree ma w’adagyaw daa edzi; na osian w’ekyiwadze abosom no nyinara, na wo mba hɔn bɔgyaa a edze maa hɔn no ntsi;
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi hwɛ, mibehyiahyia w’adɔfo nyinara a enye hɔn agye enyi, na hɔn a ekyir hɔn no nyinara; mobɔboaboa hɔn ano wɔ mbeambea nyina metsia wo, na meyi w’adagyaw edzi makyerɛ hɔn, ma woeehu w’adagyaw nyina.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mubobu wo atsɛn, dɛ mbrɛ mbaa a wɔtoto awar ano na wɔka bɔgya gu no wobu hɔn atsɛn; na medze ebufuhyew na nyinkuntwe bɔgyaa bɛba wo do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze wo bɛhyɛ hɔn nsa so, na w’edwuruw wo dampan na woebubu wo sorɔnsorɔmbea: na wɔbɛpa wo ho efuradze, na wɔafa wo ndwindze fɛɛfɛw no: na wɔbɛdan wo egya adagyaw na kwatserkwa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔbɔbɔ ngua wɔ wo do so, na woesiw wo abo, na wɔdze hɔn mfona ehwirahwira wo mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔdze gya bɛhyew w’adan, na woebua wo atsɛn wɔ mbaa pii enyim; na mebɛma egyaa ndwamangor, na eremma apɛdze so ara bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mebɛma m’ebufuhyew adwe wɔ wo do, na me nyinkuntwe efi wo do, na mayɛ komm, na mo bo rummfuw bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Osiandɛ annkaa wo mbofraber mu nda no, na ahow mo werɛ wɔ ndzɛmba yinom nyina mu ntsi; dɛm ntsi hwɛ, mo so medze wo kwan bobua w’etsifi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse: na mma nnyɛ ndwamandze yi mmbɔ w’ekyiwadze nyina do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hwɛ, obiara a obubu mbɛ no, obobu bɛ yi etsia wo, dɛ, Mbrɛ na tse no, mbrɛ ne babaa so tse ara nye no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wo na ne babaa nye wo, ɔno a okyir no kun na ne mba no, na wo nkyerɛbaa hɔn akyerɛbaa nye wo, hɔn a wokyir hɔn kunnom na hɔn mba no: wo na yɛ Hitinyi, na w’egya yɛ Amorinyi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na w’akyerɛbaa panyin nye Samaria a ɔtse w’abankum, ɔno na ne mbabaa: na w’akyerɛbaa kakraba a ɔtse w’abanyimfa no, ɔno nye Sodom na ne mbabaa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso emmfaa hɔn akwan do, eso ennyɛɛ hɔn ekyiwadze no bi: mbom, mber kakraabi ntamu no, ɔwo esɛɛe seen hɔn wɔ w’akwan nyina mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛ metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, W’akyerɛbaa Sodom, ɔno na ne mbabaa, ɔnnyɛɛ dza ayɛ yi, ɔwo na wo mbabaa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hwɛ, iyi nye w’akyerɛbaa Sodom n’emumuyɛ; ntsɛn, edzidzimee, na ahotɔ dwudwoodwo mu na ɔno na ne mbabaa wɔtsena; eso ɔannhyɛ abɔbɔfo na hianyi nsa dzen.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔyɛɛ ahopɔw, na wɔyɛɛ ekyiwadze wɔ m’enyim: dɛm ntsi miyiyii hɔn wɔ hɔ dɛ mbrɛ mohwɛ a oye.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Eso Samaria nnyɛɛ wo bɔn mu fa; mbom ɔwo ama w’ekyiwadze adɔɔ so akyɛn hɔn, na edze w’ekyiwadze a ayɛ no nyinara ebu wo nkyerɛbaa bem.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔwoara so, soa woara w’enyito, dɛ ebu atsɛn ama wo nkyerɛbaa; ɔnam wo bɔn a edze ayɛ ekyiwadze asen hɔn no ntsi, hɔn ho tsew sen wo: nyew, ma w’enyim ngu ase so, na soa w’enyito, wɔ dɛ ebu wo nkyerɛbaa bem.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze hɔn ndɔmmumkɔ, Sodom na ne mbabaa hɔn yieyɛ, na Samaria na ne mbabaa hɔn yieyɛ, na wo yieyɛ a wɔwɔ hɔn mu no hɔn yieyɛ bɛsan aba:
title: EZEKIEL

text: ama ɔwoara asoa woara w’enyito, na w’enyi ato wɔ dza ayɛ nyinara ntsi, wɔ dɛ eyɛ akyekyewerɛ ma hɔn no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wo nkyerɛbaa, Sodom na ne mbabaa bɛsan aba hɔn asetsena dadaw no mu, na Samaria na ne mbabaa aba hɔn asetsena dadaw no mu, na ɔwo na wo mbabaa bɛsan aba hom asetsena dadaw no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wo nkontompɔ da no mu no, ammfa w’ano ammbɔ w’akyerɛbaa Sodom ne dzin;
title: EZEKIEL

text: ansaana woyi w’emumuyɛ edzi no, dɛ ber a Siria mbabaa, na hɔn a woetwa no ho ehyia nyina, Filistiafo mbabaa a woyii wo ehi bɔɔ wɔ aprɔw no, wɔsopaa wo no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔwo asoa wo ndwamandze na w’ekyiwadze no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Menye wo bedzi no dɛ mbrɛ ayɛ no ara, ɔwo a ebu ntam no tootooba, edze ato ahyɛmu no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso emi dze, mebɛkaa m’ahyɛmu a menye wo dzii wɔ wo mbofraber nda no mu no, na mebɛma daa ahyɛmudzi etsim hɔ ama wo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔno na ebɛkaa w’akwan no, na w’enyi ato, ber a ebɛgye wo nkyerɛbaa, wo nkyerɛbaa mpanyin na nkakraba no: na medze hɔn ayɛ mbabaa ama wo, na ɔnnam w’ahyɛmudzi no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛma menye wo ahyɛmudzi no egyina; na ibohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE:
title: EZEKIEL

text: ama aakaa, na w’enyim eegu ase, na eemmbue w’ano da biara bio, wɔ w’enyito ntsi; ber a medze dza ayɛ nyinara efir wo no, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, ma abrɔme bi, na bu bɛ bi kyerɛ Israelmba;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ɔkɔr kɛse bi, ne ntsaban akɛse akɛse, ne ntsaban ano nsorɔnsorɔmm, ntɛkyerɛ ntokowa ntokowa ayɛ no ho ma, baa Lebanon. Ɔbɛgyee nkyindur ndua etsifi,
title: EZEKIEL

text: ɔpempaan no nkɔn mu mfefɛwee afor no, na ɔdze kɔr eguadzi asaase bi do; ɔdze kesii eguadzifo kurow bi mu.
title: EZEKIEL
