text: Ɔfaa asaase no do aba no so bi, na ɔdze kɛtsɛɛw asaaseber mu; ɔdze sii esu pii ho; ɔtsɛɛw no dɛ esukɔndo dua.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na onyinii, na ɔbɛyɛɛ wenyindua tantam, na mbom tsiatsiaba a n’abaw tsentsen kɔ no do, na no ndwow wɔ n’ase: nna ɔbɛyɛɛ wenyindua, na ɔtotoo abaw, na ofifiir ahaban.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔkɔr kɛse bi so wɔ hɔ a ne ntsaban akɛse akɛse na ne ntɛkyerɛ pii: na, hwɛ, wenyindua yi fi n’akɔfi do konkoom no ndwow kɔr no do, na ɔtotoo n’abaw kɔr no do, ama oeegugu do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔtsɛɛw no asaase pa do wɔ esu pii nkyɛn, ama ɔaatoto abaw, na ɔaasow nduadzewa, na ɔaayɛ wenyindua fɛɛfɛw.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ka dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Aso obowie yie? Aso onnkotutu no ndwow, na oetwitwa no nduadzewa, ama ɔaakyenkyen; ama n’ahaban momon a ɔfefɛw nyina aakyenkyen; dɛ ɔnndze ahoɔdzen kɛse anaa nyimpa pii a wɔdze botutu no efi no ndwow ase.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nyew, hwɛ, woenya atsɛw yi, aso obowie yie? Aso boka mframa ka no a, ɔnnkɛkyenkyen koraa? Ɔbɛkyenkyen wɔ akɔfi a ofifiir wɔ do no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nkyii so EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afei ka kyerɛ etuatsew fi no dɛ, Aso hom nnyim dza ndzɛmba yinom kyerɛ? Ka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Hwɛ, Babilɔnhen baa Jerusalɛm, na ɔbɛfaa no mu hen, na no mu mbapɔmba, na ɔdze hɔn baa ne nkyɛn wɔ Babilɔn;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na ɔfaa adehye no bi, na ɔnye no dzii ahyɛmu; ɔmaa odzii nsew so, na ɔfaa asaase no do akatakyi no kɔree:
title: EZEKIEL

text: ma ahendzi no aabrɛ adze, na ɔaamma noho do, na mbom dɛ obedzi n’ahyɛmu no do na oeegyina.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔtseew no do etua tutuu ahembɔfo ma wɔkɔr Egypt, ama wɔaama no mpɔnkɔ na nyimpa pii. Aso obowie yie? Aso nyia ɔyɛ ndzɛmba yinom obefi nsa? Aso ɔbɔto ahyɛmu no, naaso oefi nsa?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛ metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, ampaara beebi mbrɛ ɔhen a ɔdze no dzii hen a obuu ne ntam enyimtsia, na ɔtoo n’ahyɛmu no ɔtse no, ne nkyɛn hɔ ara wɔ Babilɔn na obowu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Eso Farao nye no dɔm akatakyi na n’asafo akɛse rinndzi mma no wɔ ɔsa no mu, ber a wɔbɔtotow mpampi na woesisi aban, dɛ wotwitwa nyimpa pii egu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Osiandɛ oebu ntam no enyimtsia dɛ ɔatoto ahyɛmudzi no ano; na hwɛ, ɔdze ne nsa ama, naaso na ɔayɛ ndzɛmba yinom nyina, onnkefi nsa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Dɛ metse ase yi, ampaara me ntam no a oebu no enyimtsia, na m’ahyɛdze no a ɔatoto ano no, medze mubobua noara n’etsifi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze mo boa mebɛtserɛw no do, na wɔapa no wɔ m’efir mu, na medze no aba Babilɔn, na menye no eyi atsɛn wɔ hɔ wɔ ne mbrato a ɔato etsia me no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na n’eguamfo nyinara a wɔwɔ n’asafo asafo mu nyinara bɔtotɔ wɔ afona ano, na hɔn a wɔbɛka no wɔbɔbɔ hɔn apetse mframa nyina mu, na hom bohu dɛ emi EWURADZE mara na maka.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Mebɛfa nkyindur ndua a ɔkrɔn no nkɔn mu bi so, na medze atsɛw; mebɛpan no nkɔn mu afɔr mfefɛwee fɛɛfɛw no bi, na mara medze akɛtsɛw wɔ bepɔw a ɔwar na ɔkrɔn no no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Israel sorɔnsorɔmbea bepɔw no do na mebɛtsɛw no: ama ɔaatoto abaw, na ɔasow nduaba, na ɔayɛ nkyindur ndua fɛɛfɛw. N’ase na nnoma nyina na ntɛkyerɛmbowa nyina bɛgyegye; no ndubaa no nwinwin mu na wɔbɛgyegye.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na haban mu ndua nyina bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE. Mebrɛ dua tsentsen adze, na mema dua a ɔwɔ famu no krɔn, na mema dua momon kyenkyen, na mema dua wui yɛ prɔmprɔm: emi mara EWURADZE na mase na mebɛyɛ so.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ bio, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom fa no dɛn, na hom bu bɛ yi wɔ Israel asaase ho, dɛ, Egyanom edzi wenyinamba yerɛyerɛw ma mba hɔn se afemfem?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, hom rinnya ho kwan bio ebu bɛ yi wɔ Israel.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hwɛ, akra nyinara yɛ medze; dɛ mbrɛ egya ne kra yɛ medze no, mbrɛ ɔba so ne kra tse ara nye no: ɔkra a ɔyɛ bɔn no, ɔnoara na obowu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ nyimpa tsen na ɔyɛ dza ɔfa mbra mu na ɔtsen,
title: EZEKIEL

text: na onndzidzii wɔ mbepɔw no do, eso ɔmmaa n’enyiwa do nnhwɛɛ Israelmba hɔn abosom no, eso onnguu ne nyɛnko ho fi, eso ɔnnkɔr ɔbaa a ɔayɛ bra ho;
title: EZEKIEL

text: eso ɔmmfoom obiara, na mbom ɔdze kafonyi n’ahobadze asan ama no, ɔmmfaa apempensi mmfoom obiara n’adze, ɔdze n’edziban ama nyia ɔkɔm dze no, na ɔdze n’atar ama nyia odzi adagyaw;
title: EZEKIEL

text: nyia ɔmmbɔɔ bosa nnsii akaperɛ, eso ɔnngyee nsiho, ɔatwe ne nsa efi emumuyɛ ho, oebu nyimpa na nyimpa ntamu atsɛn nokwar,
title: EZEKIEL

text: ɔanantsew m’ahyɛmudzi do, na oedzi m’atsɛmbudze do, dɛ oedzi nokwar a; ɔno na ɔtsen, nkwa ara na obenya, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ ɔwo babanyin a ɔyɛ odwotwafo, bɔgyakagufo, na ɔyɛ ndzɛmba yinom mu kor biara
title: EZEKIEL

text: na onndzi ndwuma no no mu biara, mbom oedzidzi wɔ mbepɔw no do mpo, na oegu ne nyɛnko ne yer ho fi,
title: EZEKIEL

text: ɔafom ɔbɔbɔfo na ohianyi, ɔdze apempensi afa obi n’adze, ɔmmfaa ahobadze nnsanee mmae, na ɔama n’enyiwa do ahwɛ abosom, ɔyɛ ekyiwadze,
title: EZEKIEL

text: ɔabɔ bosa esi akaperɛ, na ɔagye nsiho a: aso obenya nkwa? Onnkenya nkwa. Ɔayɛ ekyiwadze yinom nyinara: owu ara na obowu; no bɔgyaa bogu n’etsifi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afei, hwɛ, sɛ ɔwo babanyin a ohu n’egya no bɔn a ɔayɛ nyinara na osuro, na ɔnnyɛ ne saso,
title: EZEKIEL

text: onndzidzi wɔ mbepɔw no do, eso ɔmma n’enyiwa do nnhwɛ Israel fie abosom, onngu ne nyɛnko ne yer ho fi,
title: EZEKIEL

text: eso ɔmmfom obiara, ɔnngye biribiara nsi ahoba, eso ɔmmfa apempensi mmfa obi n’adze, mbom ɔdze n’edziban ama nyia ɔkɔm dze no, na ɔdze atar ahyɛ nyia odzi adagyaw,
title: EZEKIEL

text: ɔatwe ne nsa efi ɔbɔbɔfo ho, onnsi akaperɛ, na ɔnngye nsiho, ɔayɛ m’atsɛmbudze, ɔanantsew m’ahyɛdze do a; orunnwu wɔ n’egya n’emumuyɛ ntsi, nkwa ara na obenya.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na n’egya dze, susuampaara dɛ ɔayɛ emim, ɔdze apempensi afa no nua afo, na ɔayɛ dza onnye wɔ ɔman no no mu no, hwɛ, obowu wɔ n’emumuyɛ mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso hom se dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ɔba nnsoa n’egya n’emumuyɛ? Sɛ ɔba ayɛ dza ɔfa mbra mu na ɔtsen, na oedzi m’ahyɛdze nyinara do, na ɔayɛ a, nkwa ara na obenya.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔkra a ɔyɛ bɔn no, ɔno na obowu: ɔba ronnsoa egya n’emumuyɛ; eso egya ronnsoa ɔba n’emumuyɛ; ɔtseneneenyi ne ndzeyɛtsenenee bɛtsena no do, na omumuyɛnyi n’emumuyɛ atsena no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ omumuyɛnyi san fi ne ndzebɔn a ɔayɛ nyinara ho, na odzi m’ahyɛdze nyinara do, na ɔyɛ dza ɔfa mbra mu na ɔtsen a, nkwa ara na obenya, orunnwu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbrato a ɔato no mu biara wɔrennkaa nntsia no: ne ndzeyɛtsenenee a ɔayɛ no no mu na ɔbɛtsena ase.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Aso mowɔ enyigye bi wɔ omumuyɛnyi no wu ho? EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse: na nnyɛ dɛ mbom ɔbɛdan efi no kwan mu, na oenya nkwa?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ tseneneenyi san fi ne ndzeyɛtsenenee ho, na ɔyɛ emumuyɛ, na ɔyɛ ekyiwadze a omumuyɛnyi yɛ no bi a, aso ɔbɛtsena ase? N’atseneneedze a ɔayɛ no, wɔrennkaa no mu biara: na mbrato a ɔato no mu, na no bɔn a ɔayɛ no mu, ɔnoara mu na obowu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso hom se dɛ, EWURADZE n’amambu nnsaa. Israelmba e, hom ntsie: Aso m’amambu nnsaa? Ana nnyɛ homara hom amambu na ɔnnsaa?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ tseneneenyi dan fi ne ndzeyɛtsenenee ho, na ɔyɛ emumuyɛ na owu wɔ mu a; n’emumuyɛ a ɔayɛ no mu na obowu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio so, sɛ omumuyɛnyi dan fi n’emumuyɛ a ɔayɛ no ho, na ɔyɛ dza ɔfa mbra mu na ɔtsen a, ɔbɛgye ne kra nkwa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Osiandɛ ɔdwendwen ho, na ɔdan fi ne mbrato a ɔato nyinara ho no, nkwa ara na obenya, orunnwu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso Israel fie se dɛ, EWURADZE n’amambu nnsaa. Ao Israelfo, aso m’amambu nnsaa? Aso nnyɛ homara hom amambu na ɔnnsaa?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi, Israel fie, mubobu hom atsɛn, obiara dɛ mbrɛ n’akwan tse, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse. Hom nsan, hom nsan mfi hom mbrato nyinara ho; annyɛ dɛm a emumuyɛ bɛma hom asɛɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom ntow hom mbratodze a hom dze ato mbra no nyina mfi hom ho ngu; na hom nya akoma fofor na sunsum fofor mma homho: na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bowu, Israel fie?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na minnyi nyia owu no wu ho enyigye, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse: dɛm ntsi hom nsakyer, na hom nnya nkwa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo dze, ma sukwadwom do wɔ Israel mbapɔmba ho,
title: EZEKIEL

text: na se dɛ, Mbrɛ wo na si yɛ gyataber: wɔ ngyatanyin ntamu a! Ɔnyɛn ne mba wɔ ngyatafɔr mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔnyɛɛn ne mba no mu kor; ɔbɛyɛɛ gyatafɔr: na osuasuaa ahayɛ, na ɔmemeen nyimpa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Amanaman so tsee ne nka; wɔkyeer no wɔ hɔn amona mu: na wɔdze nkwaba twee no kɔr Egypt asaase do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afei ber a ohun dɛ ɔatweɔn atweɔn, na n’enyidado apa no, nna ɔfaa ne mba no mu baako so, na ɔyɛɛ no gyatafɔr.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔnantsenantseew ngyata mu, na ɔbɛyɛɛ gyatafɔr: na osuasuaa ahayɛ, ɔmemeen nyimpa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔmaa hɔn ekunafo yɛ pii; na ɔbobɔɔ hɔn nkurow, na asaase no, nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyina ho boow hɔn, osian no pɔw ne dede ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna amanaman no fi amantɔw no mu kae kuae botwae yeer no mbea nyinara: na wɔdze hɔn boa tserɛɛw hɔn do; wɔkyeer no wɔ hɔn mona no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔdze nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn too no na wɔdze no too buw mu, na wɔdze no kɛmaa Babilɔnhen; wɔdze no kɔtoo aban dzendzen mu, amma wɔaanntse ne ndze bio wɔ Israel mbepɔw do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nkyɛ wo na tse dɛ wenyindua, wɔ wo bɔgyaa no a wɔtsɛɛw no esu ho: no nsowee na n’abaw yeyɛɛ yie wɔ esu pii no ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na onyaa mbaa dzendzen dze yɛɛ nhempoma maa hɔn a wodzi mpanyin, na hɔn tsentsen kɔree kodur nkorbata kusuww no mu, na wohun no no krɔn mu, ɔnye n’abaw no dodow mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso wɔpaan no ebufuhyew mu, wɔtoow no kyeen famu, na boka mframa no kyenkyeen no no nsowee no poe: ne mbaa dzendzen no bubui na ɔkyenkyenee: gya no hyeew no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na afei wɔatsɛw no wɔ sar do, wɔ asaase kɛsɛɛ a nsu nnyi do no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na gya efi n’abaw no mu, ɔahyew n’abaw na no nsowee, ma abaa a ɔyɛ dzen a wɔdze yɛ ahempoma a wɔdze dzi panyin nnyi no mu hɔ bio. Osukwadwom nye yi, na abɛyɛ osukwadwom.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia esuon no mu, bosoom a otsia enum no, bosoom no ne dadu no, na Israel mpanyimfo no mu bi baa dɛ wɔreba EWURADZE hɔ ebisa, na wɔbɛtsenatsenaa m’enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, kasa kyerɛ Israel mpanyimfo, na se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Aso hom aba mo hɔ ebisa? Metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse hom remmba mo hɔ ebisa ara da.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, aso ibobu hɔn atsɛn, aso ibobu hɔn atsɛn? Ma wonhu hɔn egyanom hɔn atantandze;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Da a mesaan mu miyii Israel, na memaa me nsa do kyerɛɛ Jakob fi asefo no, na memaa wohun me wɔ Egypt asaase do no, ber a memaa me nsa do kyerɛɛ hɔn, dɛ, Emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn no;
title: EZEKIEL

text: da no na memaa me nsa do kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ medze hɔn rifir edzi efi Egypt asaase do makɔ asaase bi a makɛsera mahwɛ mama hɔn a numfonsu na ewo pem do a ɔyɛ asaase nyina enyimnyam no no do:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na mesee hɔn dɛ, Hom mu nyimpa biara ntotow n’enyiwa mu atantandze no ngugu, na mma hom mmfa Egypt abosom no nngu homho fi; emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn dze, wɔtseew mo do etua na wɔammpɛ dɛ wotsie emi; hɔn mu nyimpa biara anntow n’enyiwa mu atantandze no enngu, eso wɔammpow Egypt abosom no: nna mesee dɛ mubohue m’ebufuhyew megu hɔn do, medze mewie m’ebufuw wɔ hɔn do wɔ Egypt asaase mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na me dzin ntsi meyɛe mma no ho eenngu fi wɔ amanaman a wɔtse hɔn mu no hɔn enyiwa mu, hɔn a memaa wohun me wɔ hɔn enyiwa mu, dɛ miyii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi memaa wofii Egypt asaase do, na medze hɔn mebaa sar no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze m’ahyɛdze memaa hɔn, na mekyerɛɛ hɔn m’atsɛmbudze a sɛ dasanyi yɛ a, ɔbɛtsena ase wɔ mu no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nkyii so medze m’ahomgyenda so memaa hɔn, ma aayɛ asɛnkyerɛdze ada menye hɔn ntamu, ama woeehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE a metsew hɔn ho no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbom Israel fifo tseew mo do etua wɔ sar no do: wɔannantsew m’ahyɛdze do, na wɔpoow m’atsɛmbudze a, sɛ ɔdasanyi yɛ a ɔbɛtsena ase wɔ mu no; na woguu m’ahomgyenda no ho fi kɛsenara: nna mesee dɛ mubohue m’ebufuhyew megu hɔn do wɔ sar no do, medze mahyew hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na me dzin ntsi meyɛe amma no ho eenngu fi wɔ amanaman a hɔn enyi tuae ma medze hɔn fiir edzi no hɔn enyiwa mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio so memaa me nsa do wɔ hɔn do wɔ sar no do, dɛ meremmfa hɔn mmba asaase a ɔpem numfonsu na ewo a ɔyɛ asaase nyina enyimnyam a medze memaa hɔn no no do;
title: EZEKIEL

text: osiandɛ wɔpoow m’atsɛmbudze, na wɔannantsew m’ahyɛdze mu, na woegu m’ahomgyenda ho fi: osiandɛ hɔn akoma dzii hɔn abosom ekyir.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso muhun hɔn mbɔbɔr ma mannsɛɛ hɔn, eso mennkum hɔn ase koraa wɔ sar no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mekaa kyerɛɛ hɔn mba wɔ sar no do, dɛ, Mma hom nnantsew hom egyanom ahyɛdze no mu, eso mma hom nndzi hɔn atsɛmbudze no do, eso mma hom mmfa hɔn abosom nngu homho fi:
title: EZEKIEL

text: emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn; hom nnantsew m’ahyɛdze do, na hom ndzi m’atsɛmbudze do, na hom nyɛ:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na hom nyɛ m’ahomgyenda no krɔnkrɔn na wɔbɛyɛ menye hom ntamu asɛnkyerɛdze, ama hom eehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mba no so tseew mo do etua; wɔannantsew m’ahyɛdze mu, eso woenndzi m’atsɛmbudze no do annyɛ, dza sɛ dasanyi yɛ a, ɔbɛtsena ase wɔ mu no; woguu m’ahomgyenda no ho fi: nna mesee dɛ mubohue m’ebufuhyew megu hɔn do, medze mewie m’ebufuw wɔ hɔn do wɔ sar no no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso misiankaa me nsa, na me dzin ntsi meyɛe ma no ho enngu fi wɔ amanaman a medze hɔn fiir edzi wɔ hɔn enyim no enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nkyii so memaa me nsa do kyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ sar no do, dɛ mobɔbɔ hɔn ahotse amanaman no mu, na mabɔ hɔn apetse nkurow nkurow do;
title: EZEKIEL

text: osiandɛ wɔannyɛ m’atsɛmbudze, mbom wɔpoow m’ahyɛdze, na woguu m’ahomgyenda ho fi na hɔn enyi dzii hɔn egyanom abosom no ekyir.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nkyii so bio mehyɛɛ hɔn ahyɛdze a onnye, na atsɛmbudze a wɔrenntsena ase wɔ mu;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na muguu hɔn ho fi wɔ hɔnankasa hɔn ayɛyɛdze no mu, wɔ dɛ wɔmaa dza obue wotoa ano nyina oduaa gya mu, ama maasɛɛ hɔnara ma woeehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi, onyimpa ba, kasa kyerɛ Israel fifo na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Iyi mu so na hom egyanom akasa mo ho kasa bɔn dɛ wɔato mbra etsia me no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na minyae medze hɔn mebaa asaase a memaa me nsa do dɛ medze mebɛma hɔn no no do no, nna hɔn enyi bɔ koko a ɔkrɔn biara, na dɔtɔ wusuww biara do a, nna wɔabɔ hɔ okum afɔr, na hɔ na wɔdze hɔn ehiyi afɔrbɔdze no bae, hɔ ara so na woyii hɔn hua huanhuam, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn ɔnom afɔr wɔ hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mesee hɔn dɛ, Bea sorɔnsorɔm a hom kɔ hɔ yi, ase nye dɛn? Dɛm ntsi na wɔtoo no dzin Bama araa dze bodu ndɛ da yi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi se Israel fie dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: aso hom egyanom akwan do na hom gu homho fi, na hɔn atantandze ekyir na hom dzi dze gor ndwamangor yi?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ hom dze hom ayɛyɛdze ba, na hom dze hom mba bɔ ɔhyew afɔr a, hom dze hom abosom nyinara gu homho fi dze bodu ndɛ da yi. Ao Israel fie, aso hom bɛba mo hɔ ebisa? Metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, hom remmba mo hɔ ebisa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dza ɔba hom adwen mu no ɔrennyɛ hɔ koraa; wɔ dɛ hom ka dɛ, Yɛbɛyɛ dɛ amanaman no, dɛ nkurow nkurow do ebusua ebusua no na yɛasom dua na ɔbo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, ampaara medze nsa a ɔyɛ dzen, na basa a wɔatsen mu, na ebufuhyew a woehue egu mibedzi hom do hen:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na mibeyi hom efi aman mu, na maboaboa hom ano efi nkurow nkurow a mabɔ hom apetse hɔ no mu, medze nsa a ɔyɛ dzen, na basa a wɔatsen mu, na ebufuhyew a woehue egu;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na medze hom bɛba aman no hɔn sar no do, na mubobu hom atsɛn wɔ hɔ enyim tua enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛ mbrɛ menye hom egyanom dzii wɔ Egypt asaase sar do no, dɛmara so na menye hom beyi atsɛn, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛma hom edua abaa no ase, na medze hom aba ahyɛmu no ne nkyekyeree no mu;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na mibeyiyi hom mu etuatsewfo, na hɔn a wɔto mbra tsia me no; medze hɔn befi asaase a wɔakɛyɛ hɔ no amamforafo no aba, naaso wɔrennhɛn Israel asaase do: na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Israel fie, hom dze, mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hom nkɔ, obiara nkɔsom n’abosom ɛ, na n’ekyir no so sɛ hom enntsie me a: na me dzin krɔnkrɔn no dze hom rennda ho mmfa hom ayɛyɛdze na hom abosom nngu ho fi bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn, Israel bepɔw a ɔkrɔn no no do, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, hɔ na Israel fie nyina, hɔn nyina, wɔbɔsom me wɔ asaase no do: hɔ na wɔbɔsɔ m’enyi, na hɔ na mibebisa hom afɔrbɔdze, na hom ayɛyɛdze mu nduadzewakan no, ɔnye akrɔnkrɔndze nyina.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom bɔsɔ m’enyi dɛ hua huanhuam, ber a mibeyi hom efi aman no mu, na maboaboa hom ano mefi nkurow nkurow a wɔabɔ hom apetse do no do; na mo ho bɛtsew wɔ hom mu wɔ amanaman no enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, ber a medze hom bɛba Israel asaase do, kurow a memaa me nsa do dɛ medze bɛma hom egyanom no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔ na hom bɛkaakaa hom abrabɔ, na hom nyɛe nyina a hom dze egu homho fi no; na hom ho bɛyɛ hom nkɔw wɔ hom enyi do wɔ hom mbusu a hom abɔ no nyina ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, ber a osian me dzin ntsi ma menye hom edzi, na nnyɛ dɛ osian hom akwan bɔn no, na hom ndzeyɛɛ a aprɔw no ntsi, Israel fifo, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, fa w’enyi si pomu afamu, na ma w’asɛm nsosɔw pomu afamu, na hyɛ pomu afamu haban no no kwaa no do nkɔm;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na se pomu afamu kwaa no dɛ, Tsie EWURADZE n’asɛm; Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, mobɔsɔ gya wɔ wo mu, na ɔbɛhyew wo mu dua momon biara, na dua wui biara: gyaframee a ɔdzɛɛw framfram no orunndum, na ɔbɛhyew enyim nyina fi pomu afamu akɛpem kwaamu afamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na adasa nyina bohu dɛ emi EWURADZE na masɔ; orunndum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Ao EWURADZE Nyankopɔn! Wɔka wɔ mo ho dɛ, Ana nnyɛ mbɛ ara na obubu a?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, fa w’enyim si Jerusalɛm do na ma w’asɛm nsosɔw ngu krɔnkrɔnbea no do, na hyɛ nkɔm tsia Israel asaase;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na se Israel asaase dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, menye wo enya, na mobɔtwe m’afona efi no bɔha no mu, na metwa atseneneefo na emumuyɛfo efi wo mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔnam dɛ mubotwa atseneneefo na emumuyɛfo nyina efi wo mu ntsi na mobɔtwe m’afona efi no bɔha mu no, wɔ adasa nyina do ofi pomu afamu kesi kwaamu afamu;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na adasa nyina bohu dɛ emi EWURADZE na matwe m’afona efi no bɔha mu; ɔrennsan nnkɔ mu bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi onyimpa ba, si nkrum; fa akoma a ebubu na awerɛhow si nkrum yaayaw wɔ hɔn enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ wɔse wo dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na irisi nkrum a? Ɔno se dɛ, Akwansosɛm no ntsi a, osiandɛ ɔreba; na akoma biara bɛnan, na nsa nyina agogow, na sunsum biara atɔ bitsi, na anankoroma nyina ayeyɛ mberɛw dɛ nsu: hwɛ ɔreba, na wɔbɛyɛ, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, hyɛ nkɔm, na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Ka dɛ, Afona o, afona o, wɔasew ano, na wɔapɔw ho:
title: EZEKIEL

text: wɔasew ano ama oeekuku; wɔapɔw ho ma ɔaayɛ dɛ enyinam: Yebesi dɛn ama hɛn ho asɛpɛw hɛn? Ebu abaa no enyimtsia, na enyidzi nyina.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔdze afona ama dɛ wɔmpɔw ho, ama wɔdze nsa eesuo mu; afona no, wɔasew ano, nyew, wɔapɔw ho, ama wɔdze aahyɛ okufo nsamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, Keka mu na bɔ mbubuw: na ɔreba me man na Israel mbapɔmba nyinara do: woeyi hɔn nye me man ama afona: Ao, fa wo nsa hwe wo bo do ae!
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hwɛ; na sɛ abaa no a obu enyimtsia no mpo nnyi hɔ bio so ɛ? EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔwo, onyimpa ba, hyɛ nkɔm, na bɔ wo nsamu; na ma afona no mbra mprɛnu, mprɛnsa, afona a wɔdze dzi ewu a. Afona a odzi ewu kɛse a etwa hom ho nyina ehyia.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi hɔn akoma etutu na hɔn a wofintsiw adɔɔ so. Medze afona no n’ano esisi hɔn mbobokɛse nyina ano, Aa! Wɔayɛ no dɛ enyinam; wɔasew ano dze ruboku.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Twa kɔ enyimfa; gyina mpasuar do, kɔ bankum; mbrɛ w’enyi besi biara.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mo so mobɔbɔ me nsamu na mama m’ebufuhyew adwe: emi EWURADZE na maka.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ bio, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Eso onyimpa ba, kyerɛ akwan ebien ma Babilɔnhen no n’afona ndua do mbra; ebien no nyina befir asaase kor do edzi: na sensan bea bi, sensan no wɔ kwan a wɔdze kɔ kurow no mu no ne tsir do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Kyerɛ kwan a afona no nam do bɛba Ammonmba Rabaa, na Juda a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm a wɔagye ho ban no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Babilɔnhen gyinaa nkwanta do, akwan ebien etsifi, dɛ ɔrehyɛ mbusunkɔm: ɔwosowosoow egyen menaba no, ɔkɔr ebusua honyi hɔ ebisa, ɔhwɛɛ mberɛbo mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Jerusalɛm ho mbusu nkɔnhyɛ dze ne nsa nyimfa mu, dɛ wɔmfa afasubu ndadzefir nsisi, dɛ wombue ano wɔ oku mu, dɛ wɔmfa esebɔ mma ndze do, dɛ wɔmfa afasubu ndadzefir a wobesisi mbobokɛse no nsisi, dɛ wɔnhohɔr apempe nsisi, na wɔntotow aban.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛ mbusu nkɔnhyɛ gyangyan wɔ hɔn enyi do, ama hɔn a wɔaka ntam egu hɔn do no: na ɔnodze, ɔma wɔkaa hɔn emumuyɛ ama wɔaakyer hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ hom ayɛ ma wɔakaa hom emumuyɛ, wɔ dɛ hom mbrato ada edzi, na hom bɔn yi noho wɔ hom nyɛe nyinara mu ntsi; osiandɛ hom aba nkaa mu ntsi, wɔdze nsa bɛkyer hom.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, omumuyɛnyi otsiɔdzennyi Israelhen ɔwo a wo da edu, ewiei no no mbusu ber no a;
title: EZEKIEL

text: mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hom nyi akyekyertsir no, na hom mpɔr ahembɔtsir no: ndzɛmba nnkɛyɛ dɛm daa. Ma dza ɔbrɛ adze no do, na brɛ dza ɔkrɔn no adze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mubobutuw, mubobutuw, Nyew, mubobutuw no! (Dɛm bi so nnsii da,) ekodu dɛ nyia ɔyɛ nedze no bɛba; na medze ama no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, hyɛ nkɔm, na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ka wɔ Ammonmba, na hɔn ahorohoraa no ho nye yi; na se dɛ, Afona, wɔatwe afona, wɔapɔw ho dze ruboku, dɛ ondzi nam, ma ɔaayɛ dɛ enyinam:
title: EZEKIEL

text: ber a wohu egyangyandze ma wo, ber a wɔhyɛ mbusu nkɔntor ma wo, dɛ wɔdze wo bɔto emumuyɛfo etsiɔdzenfo a hɔn da edu wɔ ewiei asotweber mu no hɔn kɔn ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ma ɔnsan nkɛhyɛ no bɔha mu! Beebi mbrɛ wɔbɔɔ wo no, asaase a wɔwoo wo wɔ do no, na mubobu wo atsɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mubohue m’ebufuhyew egu wo do; medze m’ebufuw ne gya no mubohuw egu wo do: na mibeyi wo ahyɛ mbarimba etsirmɔdzenfo a wɔawea adzesɛɛ ho hɔn nsa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ebɛyɛ nyena ama gya no; wo bɔgyaa bogu asaase no finimfin; wɔrennkaa wo bio: na emi EWURADZE na maka.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ bio dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, aso ibobu atsɛn, aso ibobu bɔgyakafo kurow no atsɛn? Nna ma onhu n’ekyiwadze no nyinara.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Kurow a ɔka bɔgya gu wɔ ne finimfin ama ne ber edu, na ɔyɛ abosom tsia noho dze gu noho fi!
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wo bɔgyaa a aka egu no mu na idzi fɔ, na w’abosom a ayɛ no mu na edze egu woho fi; na ama wo nda no abɛn, na edu wo mfe no mpo ho: dɛm ntsi na mayɛ wo enyimguasedze ama amanaman, na atwetwesidze ama nkurow nkurow nyina.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hɔn a wɔbɛn na hɔn a wɔnye wo ntamu twe besi wo atwetwe, ɔwo a wo dzin asɛɛ na weɔɔweɔɔyɛ ahyɛ wo ma.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hwɛ, Israel mbapɔmba no, obiara dɛ mbrɛ no tum tse, abɛka bɔgya egu wɔ hom mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wo mu na wɔayeyaw egya na na; wo mu na woedzi ɔhɔho emim: wo mu na wɔafom egyankaba na okunafo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔwo ebu m’akrɔnkrɔndze enyimtsia, na egu m’ahomgyenda ho fi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nkorɔfo a wɔkasa sɛɛ obi dzin no aba hom mu abɛka bɔgya egu: na wo mu na woedzidzi mbepɔw do: wo finimfin na wɔayɛ ndwamandze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wo mu na wɔapanta hɔn egyanom adagyaw do: wo mu na wɔabrɛ nyia no ho ekum wɔ n’asabu mu no adze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na obi nye ne nyɛnko ne yer ayɛ atantandze; na obi so dze ndwamandze egu n’asew ho fi; na obi so abrɛ n’akyerɛbaa, n’egya ne babaa adze wɔ wo mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wo mu na woedzidzi mboaba dɛ wɔbɛka bɔgya egu; ɔwo esi akaperɛ na agye nsiho, na edze nhyɛdo enya w’amanyimfo ho mfaso edzifodze mu, na wo werɛ efir emi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, maprapra me nsamu wɔ w’enyiber mfaso a edzi no ho, na wo bɔgyaa a aba mu no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Aso w’akoma botum sɔw, anaadɛ aso wo nsamu bɛyɛ dzen, wɔ da a menye wo bedzi no? Emi EWURADZE na maka, na mebɛyɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mobɔbɔ wo ahotse amanaman mu, na mabɔ wo apetse wɔ nkurow nkurow do; na mebɛhyew wo ho fi mefi wo ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wo ho bogu fi wɔ amanaman enyim; na ibohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, Israel fi ayɛ dɛ dutu ama me: hɔn nyinara ayɛ boran na kyɛnse na dadze na sumbui, wɔ fononoo mu; wɔyɛ dwetɛfi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ hom nyinara adan dutu ntsi no, dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, mobɔboa hom ano ehyia Jerusalɛm finimfin.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛ mbrɛ wɔboaboa dwetɛ na boran na dadze na sumbui na kyɛnse ano kogu fononoo mu, dɛ wohutsa ho gya mu ma ɔnnan no; dɛmara so na mobɔboa hom ano wɔ m’ebufuw na m’ebufuhyew mu, na medze hom egugu hɔ, na manan hom.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ampaara, mobɔboa hom ano, na mehutsa hom ho wɔ m’ebufuw gya mu, na hom anan wɔ ne finimfin.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛ mbrɛ wɔnan dwetɛ wɔ fononoo mu no, dɛmara na wɔbɛnan hom wɔ mu; na hom bohu dɛ emi EWURADZE na mehue m’ebufuhyew megu hom do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, se no dɛ, Eyɛ asaase a wɔnntseew ho, eso nsu nntɔree nnguu do wɔ ebufuhyew da no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: No nkɔnhyɛfo tsirdo apam bi wɔ ne finimfin, dɛ gyata a ɔropɔw tsetsew n’afonam mu: wɔamemen akra; wɔfa egyapadze na ndzɛmba a wɔsom bo; wɔama n’ekunafo adɔɔ so wɔ no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: N’asɔfoe ayɛ me mbra yerɛyerɛw, na woegu m’akrɔnkrɔndze ho fi: wɔamma sorbi annda dza ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn na dza ɔnnyɛ krɔnkrɔn ntamu, eso wɔamma adasa ennhu he a ɔda dza no ho tsew na dza no ho nntsew ntamu, na wɔdze hɔn enyiwa esuma efi m’ahomgyenda ho, na woegu mo ho fi wɔ hɔn mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hɔn mu mbapɔmba wɔtse dɛ mpataku a wɔropɔw afonam; dɛ wɔbɛka bɔgya egu, na wɔasɛɛ akra, ama woeenya enyiber mfaso edzi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na no nkɔnhyɛfo dze kaadow etwuw ho ama hɔn, wohu egyangyandze, na wɔhyɛ mbusu nkɔntor kyerɛ hɔn, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: naaso na EWURADZE nnkasae.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔman no mu nkorɔfo woedzi emim, na wɔayɛ nwuradandze; nyew, wɔatseetsee bɔbɔnyi na hianyi, na woebu pɛrpɛr do ahaw hɔho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mohwehwɛɛ hɔn mu nyimpa a ɔbɛgye ban no, anaadɛ obegyina tokur mu wɔ m’enyim ama asaase no, amma maannsɛɛ no: na meennhu bi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mehue m’ebufuhyew megu hɔn do; medze m’ebufuw ne gya mahyew hɔn: medze hɔnankasa hɔn abrabɔ ebua hɔn etsifi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ bio, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, mbaa beenu, na kor bi mba wɔ hɔ:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na wɔgogoor ndwamangor wɔ Egypt; wɔgogoor ndwamangor wɔ hɔn mbofrabermu: hɔ na womiamiaa hɔn enumfo, na hɔ na wopirapiraa hɔn mbaabun mu mpokuwa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn edzin dze Ohola panyin no, na n’akyerɛbaa Oholiba: na wɔbɛyɛɛ medze, na wɔwoo mbabanyin na mbabaa. Na hɔn edzin no nye yi, Samaria nye Ohola, na Jerusalɛm nye Oholiba.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Ohola kɔgoor ndwamangor ber a ɔyɛ medze; na n’enyi hyeew n’adɔfo ho, n’amanyimfo Asiriafo no ho,
title: EZEKIEL

text: hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ bibir ntar, ambradofo na mpanyin, hɔn nyinara mberantsɛ a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw a, mpɔnkɔdofo a wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔdze no ndwamanyɛ kɔr hɔn do, hɔn nyinara Asiriafo mu mbɛtseefo a: na hɔn mu biara a n’enyi hyeew no ho no, ɔdze hɔn abosom nyina guu no ho fi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Eso onngyaa no ndwamanyɛ no ofitsi Egypt nda no mu; na ne nkataasiaber mu na wɔnye no dae, na wopiraa ne mbaabun mu mpokuwa: na wohuee hɔn ndwamanyɛ guu no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi miyii no hyɛɛ n’adɔfo nsa, Asiriafo a n’enyi hyeew hɔn ho no nsa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Woyinom na woyii n’adagyaw too gua: wɔfaa ne mbabanyin na ne mbabaa, na ɔnoara wɔdze afona kum no: na ɔbɛyɛɛ fen wɔ mbaa mu; na wɔyɛɛ no n’atsɛmbudze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na n’akyerɛbaa Oholiba hun iyi, naaso ɔprɔwee wɔ n’enyihyew mu kɛse seen ɔno, na no ndwamanyɛ a ɔdɔɔ so seen n’akyerɛbaa no ndwamanyɛ no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: N’enyi hyeew Asiriafo ho, ambradofo na mpanyin, n’amanyimfo a woewuna ntar gɔsɔɔ, mpɔnkɔdofo a wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do, hɔn nyinara mberantsɛ a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na muhun dɛ no ho egu fi; hɔn beenu no faa kwan kor do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔmaa no ndwamanyɛ dɔɔ so; na ohun mbarimba a wɔasensan hɔn mfonyi wɔ fasu ho, Kaldeafo ehonyi a wɔdze edur memen asensan,
title: EZEKIEL

text: wɔdze abɔdo abobɔ hɔn asen, akyekyertsir a wɔahyɛ no edur sensɛn hɔn etsir ho, ehwɛ hɔn nyina a wɔyɛ dɛ ahenmba, dɛ mbrɛ Babilɔnfo a wɔwɔ hɔn awobea Kaldea no wɔtse no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na n’enyi bɔɔ hɔn do ara pɛ na n’enyi hyeew hɔn ho, na ɔsomaa abɔfo kɔr hɔn nkyɛn wɔ Kaldea.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Babilɔnfo no baa ne nkyɛn nye no bɛdaa dɔ mpa do, na wɔdze hɔn ndwamanyɛ guu no ho fi, na ɔnye hɔn guu noho fi, na ne kra tseew noho fii hɔn nkyɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ ɔdaa no ndwamanyɛ edzi, na ɔmaa n’adagyaw daa edzi nye no: nna me kra tseew noho fii no ho, dɛ mbrɛ me kra tseew noho fii n’akyerɛbaa ho no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso ɔmaa no ndwamangor dɔɔ so, dze kaa ne mbofrabermu nda no a ɔgoor ndwamangor wɔ Egypt asaase do no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na n’enyi hyeew hɔn mponafo ho, hɔn a hɔn honam tse dɛ nsoasopɔnkɔ honam, na hɔn ahobaa tse dɛ mpɔnkɔ ahobaa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm na edze kaa wo nkataasiaber mu ndwamanyɛ, wɔ pira a Egyptfo piraa wo mpokuwa, wɔ wo nkataasiaber mu enumfo no ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi, Oholiba, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, mebɛma w’adɔfo do etsia wo, hɔn a wo kra atsew noho efi hɔn ho no, na medze hɔn efi nkyɛnkyɛn nyinara aba wo do;
title: EZEKIEL

text: Babilɔnfo na Kaldeafo nyinara, Pekodfo, Soafo na Koafo, na Asiriafo a wɔka hɔn ho no nyinara: mberantsɛ a hɔn ho yɛ fɛw, hɔn nyina ambradofo na mpanyin a, ahenmba na atsenkafo a hɔn nyinara wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔdze akondadze, ntseaseanam na nhwiir, na aman asafo; wɔdze nkataenyim na kyɛm na dadzekyɛw bɔbɔ wo do nsera ehyia: na medze atsɛmbu mebɛhyɛ hɔn nsa, na woebu wo atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn atsɛmbudze tse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze me nyinkuntwe besi wo do, na wɔnye wo edzi no ebufuhyew mu; wobotwitwa wo hwen na w’asowa; na wo nkaase bɔtotɔr afona ano: wɔbɛfa wo mbabanyin na wo mbabaa; na wo nkaase no gya bɛmen hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔbɔworɔw wo ho ntar so, na wɔafa wo ndwindze fɛɛfɛw no akɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm na mebɛma w’atantandze no abɔ adze efi wo ho, ɔnye wo ndwamangor a edze fi Egypt asaase do bae no: ma amma w’enyi do aannkyerɛ hɔn, anaaso aannkaa Egypt bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, medze wo bɛhyɛ hɔn a etan hɔn no nsa, hɔn a wo kra atsew noho efi hɔn ho no nsa:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na wɔnye wo bedzi no tan mu, na woeyi w’afonadze nyina akɔ, na woegyaa wo adagyaw kwatserkwa: na wo ndwamangor n’adagyaw bɛda edzi, w’atantandze na wo ndwamangor nyina.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ndzɛmba yinom na wɔdze bɛyɛ wo, wɔ dɛ akɔgor ndwamangor edzi amanaman ekyir dze hɔn abosom egu wo ho fi ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Anantsew w’akyerɛbaa no kwan do; dɛm ntsi medze no kɔɔpow bɛhyɛ wo nsa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ebɔnom w’akyerɛbaa no kɔɔpow a ɔdɔ na ɔso no bi: wɔbɛyɛ wo ɔsesɛba na woedzi wo ho fɛw; dza ɔwɔ mu so.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Asabow na awerɛhow bɛhyɛ wo ma, ɔnye ahodwuruw na amamfoyɛ kɔɔpow, ɔnye w’akyerɛbaa Samaria no kɔɔpow.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ebɔnom na ehwiew mu mpo, na awe ne fɛr, na atsetsew w’enumfo mu: na emi na maka, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ wo werɛ efir me, na atow me akyen w’ekyir ntsi, dɛm ntsi soa w’atantandze na wo ndwamangor so.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE see me bio so, dɛ: Onyimpa ba, aso ibobu Ohola na Oholiba atsɛn? Nna yi hɔn atantandze kyerɛ hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔatoto awar, na bɔgya wɔ hɔn nsamu, na wɔdze hɔn abosom atoto awar; na wɔama hɔn mba a wɔwoo hɔn maa me no so wɔahyew hɔn ogya mu abɔ afɔr ma wɔamemen hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio so iyi na wɔdze ayɛ me: woegu mo krɔnkrɔnbea ho fi da kor noara, na woehura m’ahomgyenda no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wonyae kunkum hɔn mba maa hɔn abosom no, nna wɔbaa mo krɔnkrɔnbea da kor noara bohuraa ho; na, hwɛ, mbrɛ wɔayɛ wɔ me fi mu nye yi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na bio so hom asoma ekehyia mbarimba fir ekyirekyir: hɔn ho na wotuu abɔfo, na, hwɛ, wɔbae; hɔn ntsi na iguaree, ekaa w’enyiwa edur, na edze ahyehyɛdze hyehyɛɛ woho;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na etsenaa mpikyi a ɔyɛ fɛw do, ɔnye epon a wɔato si enyim a edze m’eduhuam na mo ngo sisii do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na nyimpadodow a hɔn ho adwe hɔn no hɔn dede ka no ho: na wɔdze asabokwafo kaa nyimpadodow no ho fi sar no do bae; na wɔdze nkaba hyehyɛɛ hɔn emu ebien nyina nsa, na abɔtsir fɛɛfɛw bobɔɔ hɔn etsir.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mekaa no wɔ nyia ɔayɛ aberwa wɔ awarto mu no ho dɛ, Afei na wɔnye no bɔgor ndwamangor, na ɔno so nye hɔn agor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔkɔr no ho, dɛ mbrɛ wɔkɔ edwaman ho: dɛm na wɔkɔr Ohola na Oholiba mbaa ndwaman no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbarimba atseneneefo, wɔdze mbaa awartofo hɔn atsɛmbu, na mbaa a wɔka bɔgya gu hɔn atsɛmbu bobu hɔn; osiandɛ wɔyɛ mbaa awartofo, na bɔgya wɔ hɔn nsamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Medze mboanofo bɛba hɔn do, na medze hɔn ama ma wɔatow hɔn edzi akɔnaaba, na wɔafa hɔn afo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mboanofo no besiw hɔn abo, ma wɔdze hɔn afona ekuku hɔn; wobokuku hɔn mbabanyin na hɔn mbabaa, na wɔdze gya ahyew hɔn efi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm na mebɛma atantandze abɔ adze wɔ asaase no do, ma wɔaakyerɛkyerɛ mbaa nyina mma wɔaannyɛ hɔn atantandze no bi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔbɛhyɛ hom atantandze no ananmu egu hom do, na hom asoa hom abosom no hɔn bɔn no: na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE Nyankopɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio afe a otsia akron no, bosoom a otsia du no, bosoom no ne dadu mu no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, kyerɛw da no ne dzin, ndɛ da yi ara a: dakor yi ara na Babilɔnhen twee piin Jerusalɛm.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na bu bɛ kyerɛ etuatsewfo no, na se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hom mfa dadzesɛn no nsi do, na hom nhue nsu so ngu mu:
title: EZEKIEL

text: hom ntase nankum no ngu mu, mekyerɛ nankum pa biara, aserɛ no, na abasa no; fa mbiew pa hyɛ no ma.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom mfa nguankuw mu dza oye, na hom nhyɛ mbiew no so wɔ ase: ma onhur yie; nyew, ma ne mbiew no mben wɔ no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ndom nka bɔgya kurow, ɔnka dadzesɛn a ne nkandar wɔ no mu, na ne nkandar mmfi no mu! Hom nyiyi no wɔ mu nankum nankum; tonto biara mmbɔ no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na no bɔgyaa wɔ no mu; ɔkae guu ɔbotan pataa do; oennhue enngu famu, dɛ wɔdze dɛtse bɛkata do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma ɔakɔtwe ebufuhyew aba ebedzi wer ntsi, mehue bɔgya a ɔkae no egu botan pataa do, amma wɔaannkata do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ndom nka bɔgya kurow no! Mo so mebɛma n’ase abo adɔɔ so.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Soa nyena gu do, ma gya no ndzɛw, noa nam no yie, na ma no mpiw, na ma mbiew no nhyew.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na fa no pan si ne ngyansenama no do, ma ɔndɔ, na no boran no nhyew, na no ho fi no nnan, ma no ho nkandar no nhyew.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔayɛ edwuma aberɛ: naaso ne nkandar dodow no mmfi no ho: gya mma ne nkandar no mmfi ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso, mutwuuw wo ho wɔ w’atantandze no mu no: wo ho emmfir wɔ w’atantandze no mu; ntsi, wo ho renntsew wɔ w’efifidze no mu ara bio, ekodu dɛ m’ebufuhyew a ɔwɔ wo do no bɛmee.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Emi EWURADZE na maka: ɔbɛba mu, na mayɛ; merennsan m’ekyir, eso merennkam do, eso murunnu moho; mbrɛ w’akwan tse, na mbrɛ wo nyɛe tse no, dɛmara na wobobu wo atsɛn, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Eso EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, hwɛ, medze ɔbɔ miriyi w’enyiwa n’akɔndɔdze efi wo ho: naaso mma nndzi nkɔmbɔ anaa nnsu, eso mma wo nyinsuwa nnkyi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Si nkrum foo; mma nndzi owufo ho nkɔmbɔ, fa w’abɔtsir bɔ, na fa wo nsokota hyɛ w’anan, na mma nnkata w’ano, na mma nndzi adasa edziban.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm na mekasaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no anapa; na ewimbir no na me yer wui: na anapa no meyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔhyɛɛ me no ara.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔman no see me dɛ, Aso ennkɛkyerɛ hɛn hɛn ho ndzɛmba kor a dza ereyɛ no dɛm yi fa ho?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mesee hɔn dɛ, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Kasa kyerɛ Israelmba dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, mubohura mo krɔnkrɔnbea ho, hom tum no nkontompɔ no, hom enyiwa n’akɔndɔdze no, na dza hom kra hu no mbɔbɔr no; na hom mbabanyin na hom mbabaa a hom adan hɔn egya ekyir no bɔtotɔr afona ano.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ mayɛ yi: hom rennkata hom ano, hom rinndzi adasa edziban.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom abɔtsir bɔbobɔ hom etsir, na hom nsokota ahyehyɛ hom anan: hom rinndzi nkɔmbɔ anaa hom runnsu: na hom bɛyeyɛ nkamfenkamfe wɔ hom emumuyɛ mu, na hom esisi nkrum akyerɛkyerɛ hom ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm na Ezekiel bɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze ama hom; dɛ dza ɔayɛ nyinara hom bɛyɛ: ber a iyi bɛba mu no, nna hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE Nyankopɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, ana ɔnnkɛba mu da no ara a mebɛgye hɔn nsamu ahoɔdzen, hɔn enyimnyam enyigye, hɔn enyiwa n’akɔndɔdze no, na dza wɔdze hɔn akoma si do no, hɔn mbabanyin na hɔn mbabaa no,
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛ da no ara mu na nyia ofi nsa no ɔbɛba wo nkyɛn abɛma w’asowa atse?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Da no mu na w’ano bobue ama nyia oefi nsa no, na ebɛkasa, na anntɔ mmum bio: dɛm na ebɛyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze ama hɔn; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, fa w’enyi si Ammonmba do, na hyɛ nkɔm gu hɔn do:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na se Ammonmba dɛ, Hom ntsie EWURADZE Nyankopɔn n’asɛm; Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ esee dɛ, Yɛɛ, dze tsiaa mo krɔnkrɔnbea, ber a wohuraa ho no; na edze tsiaa Israel asaase, ber a wɔyɛɛ no amamfo no; na edze tsiaa Juda fifo, ber a wɔkɔr ndɔmmum ntsi:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi hwɛ, mibeyi wo ama bokamba ayɛ hɔn enyadze, na wɔbɛkyekyer hɔn nseraban wɔ wo mu, na woesisi hɔn tsenambea wɔ wo mu; wobedzi w’eduaba, na wɔanom w’enumfonsu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze Rabaa bɛyɛ efumpɔnkɔ dan, na Ammonmba ayɛ bea a nguankuw butubutuw hɔ; na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ abɔ wo nsamu, na edze w’anan apempem famu, na edze wo kra mu ntsɛn nyina edzi eduwa wɔ Israel asaase ho ntsi;
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi hwɛ, matsen me nsa wɔ wo do, na mibeyi wo ayɛ afonam ama amanaman; na mubotwa wo efi aman mu, na mama ahera efi nkurow nkurow mu; mebɛsɛɛ wo; na ibohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ Moab na Seir ka dɛ, Hwɛ, Judafo ayɛ dɛ amanaman nyinara ntsi;
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi hwɛ, mubobue Moab nkyɛnmu efi nkurow ho, efi no nkurow a ɔdeda n’ahe do no ho, asaase no n’enyimnyam, Bɛt-jesimot, Baal-meon, na Kiriataim,
title: EZEKIEL

text: medze mama bokamba, etsia Ammonmba no, na medze ama hɔn dɛ enyadze mma wɔaannkaa Ammonmba wɔ amanaman mu:
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛyɛ Moab do atsɛmbudze; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ Edom edzi Juda fi wer, na ɔafom kɛsenara, na oetua hɔn wer ama nankasa noho no;
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye yi; Mebɛtsen me nsa wɔ Edom do, na metwitwa no mu nyimpa na abowa mefi do: na mebɛma ɔayɛ afo efi Teman; na wɔbɔtotɔ afona ano ekodu Dedan mpo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na menam me man Israel do mibedzi Edom wer; na wɔnye Edom bedzi dɛ mbrɛ m’ebufuw na m’ebufuhyew tse: na wobohu m’awerdzi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ Filistiafo edzi no awerdzi do, na wɔdze kra ho ehi etua wer dɛ wɔdze daa tan bɛsɛɛ hɔn ntsi;
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, mebɛtsen me nsa wɔ Filistiafo do, na metwitwa Keretfo, na masɛɛ mpoano nkaa no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze ntwuwenyim dzendzenndzen bedzi hɔn wer kɛsenara; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, ber a mibedzi hɔn wer no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia dubiako no mu no, bosoom no ne da a odzi kan no, na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, osiandɛ Taere akasa etsia Jerusalɛm, dɛ, Yɛɛ, woebubu nyia nkyɛ ɔyɛ aman abobokɛse no; oebue ato me hɔ: mebɛhyɛ ma, aber yi a ɔayɛ amamfo yi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, Taere, menye wo enya! Mebɛma amanaman pii aba wo do, dɛ mbrɛ po ma n’asorɛkye ba.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔbɛsɛɛ Taere afasu, na woedwuruw n’aban atsentsen no: mobɔtwerɛw ne dɛtse so mefi mu, na mayɛ no botan pataa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔbɛyɛ mboa hatabea wɔ po finimfin; na emi na maka, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse: na ɔbɛyɛ amanaman asadze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ne nkorɔfo a wɔwowɔ mu no, wɔdze afona bokuku hɔn: na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, medze Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar, ahemfo hen no, fi haban mu afamu bɛba Taere do, ɔnye mpɔnkɔ, na ntseaseanam, na mpɔnkɔdofo, na asafo, na nyimpadodow.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔdze afona bɛsɛɛ wo nkuroba a wɔwɔ wo ase nyina: na obesi wo ho aban, na ɔatow wo ho mpampi, na ɔama akokyɛm no do etsia wo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔdze n’afasubu ndadzefir besisi w’afasu ho, na ɔdze no nkuma ebubu w’aban atsentsen no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: No mpɔnkɔ dodow ntsi hɔn ho huntuma bɛkata wo do: mpɔnkɔdofo, na nhwiir, na ntseaseanam hɔn dede ntsi w’afasu bɔwosow, ber a ɔbɛhɛn w’abobokɛse mu no, dɛ mbrɛ mbarimba hɛn kurow a woebu no no mu no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔdze no mpɔnkɔ ntɔtse betsiatsia w’abrɔn nyinara do: ɔdze afona boku ɔman no, na w’ahoɔdzen n’edum no bɔhwe famu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔdze w’ahonyadze bɛyɛ asadze, na wɔafa w’eguadze afo: na wobodwuruw w’afasu egu famu, na wɔasɛɛ w’efi fɛɛfɛw no: na wɔdze w’abo na wo ndua na wo dɛtse bogu nsu no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛma w’adwontow ne dede abɔ adze; na w’asanku ndze so wɔrenntse bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛyɛ wo ɔbotan pataa: ebɛyɛ mboa hatabea. Worinnsi wo bio: na emi EWURADZE na maka, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se Taere nye yi: Aso esupruw no nnkɔwosow wɔ w’asehwe ne dede ntsi, ber a w’epirafo risi apen, na worukuku wɔ wo mu no?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna po do mbapɔmba nyina befifi hɔn nhengua do esiansian, na woeyiyi hɔn ngudontar, na wɔaworɔworɔw hɔn ntar a woedzi no akye: wobofura ahopopo: wɔbɛtsenatsena famu, na hɔn ho apopo mbertsia biara mu, na hɔn ho edwuruw hɔn wɔ wo ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wobotwa wo ho sukwadwom ase wo dɛ, Mbrɛ edua asɛɛ nye yi, ɔwo a apodofo bɛtsenaa wo mu, O atsenka kurow ɔwo a nkyɛ eyɛ dzen wɔ po mu, ɔwo na wo mu mba a hom maa hom ho hu tɔɔ hɔn a wɔtɔ kɔ hɔ nyina do!
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afei nsuano aman no ho bɔpopo wɔ w’asehwe da no mu; nyew, nsuano aman a wɔwɔ po ho no bo botutu wɔ wo nkɔree no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ber a mebɛyɛ wo ekurofo, dɛ nkurow a obi nntse mu no; ber a medze ebun no bɛba wo do, na esukɛse akata wo do no;
title: EZEKIEL

text: nna medze wo besian akɔ hɔn a wɔkɔ mona mu no ho, ma aakɔ tsetseetse nkorɔfo no nkyɛn, na mama akɛtsena asaase ne tsirmu no ho, mbea a ɔyɛ amamfo fir tsetseetse, wɔ hɔn a wɔkɔ mona mu no nkyɛn, amma wɔaanntsena wo mu bio: na medze enyimnyam besi atseasefo asaase do:
title: EZEKIEL

text: mebɛyɛ wo ehudze, na erenntsena hɔ bio: kaansa wɔbɔhwehwɛ wo mpo a, worunnhu wo bio da, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ bio, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, twa Taere ho ewuo;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na se Taere dɛ, ɔwo a etse po ahɛnee, eyɛ amanaman oguadzinyi ma nsuano aman pii, mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: O Taere, ɔwo na aka dɛ, Mo ho ewie fɛw yɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: W’ahe wɔ po finimfin, w’adantofo ama wo ho ewie fɛw yɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Senir kupresi ndua na wɔdze ayɛ wo ntaabow: wɔdze Lebanon nkyindur ndua ayɛ w’abradaandua.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bashan esudur ndua na wɔdze ayɛ wo ntabon; asombɛn a wɔdze ewurawura papaa a ofi Kittim nsuano do na wɔdze ayɛ wo mangow.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ndwera pa a ofi Egypt a woedzi mu akye na wɔdze yɛɛ w’abradaa, ma ɔaayɛ frankaa; bibir tam a ofi nsuano Elisha do na wɔdze yɛɛ w’akatado.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Zionfo na Arvadfo no nye w’akwamfo: Taere, w’enyansafo wɔ wo mu, hɔn nye wo hɛn akwankyerɛfo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Gebal nkɔdaa na n’enyansafo wɔ wo mu a wosisiw wo hɛn ne mbabaae: po do ahɛn nyina ɔnye hɔn hɛnmufo wɔ wo mu dɛ wɔrebɛsesa w’eguadze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Persiafo na Ludfo na Putfo wɔ wo dɔm mu wɔyɛ w’akofo etsitsir: wɔdze kyɛm na dadzekyɛw sensɛɛn wo mu; woyii w’ahoɔfɛw sii hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Arvad mbarimba nye wo dɔm wowɔ w’afasu ho hyiae, na Gammadfo no wɔ w’aban atsentsen mu. Wɔdze hɔn akyɛm sensɛɛn w’afasu ho hyiae; wɔama w’ahoɔfɛw edzi mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Tarsis yɛɛ wo guadzinyi wɔ ahonyadze horow nyina no dodow ntsi; dwetɛ, dadze, kyɛnse, na sumbui na wɔdze bɛgyee wo hɔ adze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Javan, Tubal, na Mesek, hɔn na wɔyɛɛ w’abatafo: wɔdze nyimpa na boran ndzɛmba gyee w’eguadze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hɔn a wofi Togarma fie wɔdze mpɔnkɔ na ɔsampɔnkɔ na asoasompɔnkɔ bɛgyee wo hɔ adze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dedanfo yɛɛ w’abatafo: esupruw pii yɛɛ eguaase maa w’edwinsa; wɔdze asonse na kusibir ntoaba nye wo bedzii nsesagua.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Siria yɛɛ wo guadzinyi wɔ w’edwinsa dodow ntsi: wɔdze nserɛmɛmbo, ɔberdum tam, na nkyermu tam, na ndwera pa, na nankyenema, na mbotamemen, na wɔdze bɛsesa wo hɔ adze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Juda na Israel asaase, wɔyɛɛ w’abatafo: wɔdze Minnit ewifua, atoko na ewo, na ngo, na akyenkyendur dze bɛsesa w’eguadze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Damaskɔs yɛɛ wo guadzinyi wɔ w’edwinsa dodow ntsi, ɔnam w’ahonyadze horow nyinara no dodow ntsi: wɔdze Helbon wenyin na nguannhwi fufuw bae.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Vedan na Javan dze asaabahoma nye wo bedzii sesagua: dadze a wɔabɔ, keesia, na kalamus sesaa w’eguadze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dedan dze aboɔdzen tam a wɔdze tsena pɔnkɔ do nye wo bedzii gua.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Arabia na Kedar mbapɔmba nyina yɛɛ wo nsaano eguadzifo; wɔ nguambaa, nguannyin, na mpɔnkɔ mu, iyinom mu na wɔnye wo dzii gua.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Seba na Raama abatafo so nye wo bedzii gua: wɔdze eduhuam nyina mu etsitsir, na aboɔdzembo nyina, na sika nye wo bedzii sesagua.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Haran na Kanne na Eden, abatafo a wofi Seba, Assur na Kilmad no nye wo bedzii gua.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Woyinom wɔyɛɛ abatafo wɔ eguadze fɛɛfɛw mu, wɔ bibir tam mbobɔe na nkyermutam, na ebirɛmpɔntam ndaka a wɔdze ahoma abɔ mu a wɔdze nkyindur ndua yɛe, wɔdze gyee w’eguadze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Tarsis ahɛn nye w’akwantufo a wɔdze w’eguadze dzi akɔnaaba: na ebɛyɛɛ ma, na w’enyim baa nyam papaara wɔ po finimfin.
title: EZEKIEL

text: W’akwamfo dze wo aba nsu akɛse mu: boka mframa abobɔ wo wɔ po finimfin.
title: EZEKIEL

text: W’ahonyadze na w’adzetɔndze, w’eguadze, w’ahɛnmufo na wo hɛn akwankyerɛfo, hɔn a wosisiw wo hɛn ne mbabaae, nye w’eguadze sesafo, na wo mu akofo nyina, na w’asafo a wɔwɔ wo mu nyina, wɔbɔtotɔ po finimfin wɔ wo sɛɛ da no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wo hɛn akwankyerɛfo nkeka mu ne dede ntsi, mfikyirkurow no bɔwosow.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn a wɔdzedze ntabon, hɛnmufo, na po do akwankyerɛfo no nyina, fifi hɔn ahɛn mu besiansian ebegyinagyina daadze,
title: EZEKIEL

text: na wɔbɛpra hɔn ndze egu mu wɔ wo do, na woesu suwen. Wobotu dɛtse egu hɔn etsifi, na wɔdze hɔn ho ayankayankam nso mu:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na wɔbɛprapra hɔn tsir na woefurafura eyitam, na wɔdze ɔkra n’awerɛhow na mbubuwbɔ yaayaw esu ama wo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn ewuotwa no mu, wɔbɛma sukwadwom do wɔ wo ntsi, na woetwa wo ho sukwadwom, dɛ, Woana tse dɛ Taere, ɔno a wɔama ɔayɛ dzinn wɔ po finimfin yi?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ber a w’adzetɔndze fi po nyina mu bae no, edze maa aman pii wɔmee; edze w’ahonyadze na w’eguadze dodow maa asaase do ahemfo nyaa hɔn ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afei a epo bubuu wo wɔ esubun no mu no, w’eguadze na w’asafo a wɔwɔ wo mu nyinara nye wo totɔree.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nsuano aman nyina ho edwuruw hɔn wɔ wo ntsi, na hu ekitsakitsa hɔn ahemfo, hɔn enyim atotow.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Aman mu eguadzifo sesar wo; w’ewiei annyɛ fɛw koraa, na eremmba bio ara ekesi afebɔɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ bio, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, ka kyerɛ Taere mampanyin no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ ama w’akoma do, na ase dɛ, Meyɛ nyame, metse nyamegua do, wɔ po finimfin, naaso eyɛ nyimpa na ennyɛ nyame bi, kaansa eyɛɛ w’akoma dɛ nyame akoma mpo a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hwɛ, eyɛ nyansafo sen Daniel; esumadze biara nnyi hɔ a wobotum wɔdze esuma wo:
title: EZEKIEL

text: ɔnam wo nyansaa na wo ntseasee do na enya woho, na enya sika na dwetɛ egu w’adzekoradze mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔnam wo nyansaa dodow wɔ eguadzi mu na ama w’ahonya adɔɔ so, na ama w’akoma do wɔ w’ahonya ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ ayɛ w’akoma dɛ nyame akoma;
title: EZEKIEL

text: ntsi hwɛ, medze ananaben mebɛba wo do, amanaman mu etsiɔdzenfo no a: na wɔbɔtwetwe hɔn mfona wɔ wo nyansaa ne fɛw do, na woegu wo hyerɛn ho fi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔdze wo besian akɔ mona no mu; na ibowu atɔfo wu wɔ po finimfin.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Aso ebɛda ho aka dɛ, Meyɛ nyame, wɔ nyia oku wo no enyim, ber a eyɛ nyimpa, na ennyɛ nyame, wɔ nyia opira wo no ne nsamu?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ibowu monomonomfo wu wɔ ananaben nsamu: na emi na maka, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio so EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, ma sukwadwom do wɔ Taerehen ho, na se no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nyi yi: Ɔwo dze, nsɔwano nkaba a ɔso pɛ nye wo, nyansa ahyɛ wo ma, na idzi mu wɔ ahoɔfɛw mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔwo nkyɛ ewɔ Nyame no ture Eden mu; aboɔdzembo biara yɛɛ w’akataho, bɔgyanambo, kratsebo, nye dɛnkyɛmbo, sikabereebo, epopobibirbo, na ahwehwɛbo, hoabo, nserɛmɛmbo, na ahabanmomonbo wɔyɛɛ sika edwindze maa wo: na w’ahosiesiedze. Da a wɔbɔɔ wo no na wosiesiee hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔwo na eyɛɛ kerub a wɔasera no no a ɔkata do no: na medze wo sii hɔ, ma ebɛtsenaa Nyame bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no no do; gya abo no ntamu na enantsewee dzii fowsian.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Idzii mu wɔ w’akwan mu fi da a wɔbɔɔ wo araa dze kodur dɛ wohun ɔbrakyew wɔ wo mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: W’eguadze dodow ntsi wɔdze emimdzi hyɛɛ wo mu ma, na eyɛɛ bɔn: dɛm ntsi na motoow wo kyeen dɛ atantandze fii Nyame bepɔw no do; na Kerub a ɔweɔn wo no paam wo fii gya abo no ntamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Emaa w’akoma do wɔ w’ahoɔfɛw ntsi, edze wo hyerɛn ama wo nyansaa aprɔw: matow wo akyen famu, medze wo ato ahemfo enyim, dɛ wɔnhwɛ wo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: W’emumuyɛ no dodow ntsi, w’eguadzi mu brakyew ntsi, egu wo krɔnkrɔnmbea ho fi; dɛm ntsi na mama gya fir wo mu efir edzi, ɔahyew wo, na madan wo nso wɔ asaase do wɔ hɔn a wɔhwɛ wo nyina enyiwa do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hɔn a wonyim wo aman mu nyina ho bɔbow hɔn wɔ wo ho: w’ewiei adan ehudze, na erenntsena hɔ ara bio da.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, fa w’enyi si Sidon do, na hyɛ nkɔm gu do,
title: EZEKIEL

text: na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: O Sidon, menye wo enya; na wɔbɛhyɛ me enyimnyam wɔ wo mu. Wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, ber a mewie no mu atsɛmbudze yɛ, na masan moho wɔ no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mobɔsoma yardɔm akɔ no mu, na bɔgya akɔ n’abrɔn mu; na ewufo bɔtotɔ famu wɔ no mu, wɔ afona a ofi mbeambea bɛba no do no ano; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na nsoɛ a ɔwɔ, anaa hwirom a ano yɛ yaw, rimmfi hɔn a woetwa hɔn ho ehyia a wobu hɔn enyimtsia no mu nnko hɔ mma Israel fie bio; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE Nyankopɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Sɛ minya boa Israel fie ano aman a wɔapetse mu no mu, na mo ho san wɔ hɔn mu wɔ amanaman enyim a, nna wɔbɛtsena hɔnankasa hɔn asaase a medze maa m’akowaa Jakob no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔbɛtsena do dwudwoodwo; nyew, wobesisi adan, na wɔatsetsɛw wenyin nture, na wɔatsena dwudwoodwo; sɛ minya yɛ atsɛmbudze wɔ hɔn a wobu hɔn enyimtsia bɔ hɔn ho aprɔw nyina do a; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afe a otsia du no mu, bosoom a otsia du no mu, bosoom no ne dadu ndaebien no mu, na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, fa w’enyi si Egypthen Farao no do, na hyɛ ɔno na Egypt nyina do nkɔm:
title: EZEKIEL

text: kasa, na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, menye wo enya, Egypthen Farao, nsuaboa kɛse a ɔda n’esutsen mu a ɔka dɛ, M’esutsen yɛ mankasa medze, mara meyɛɛ maa moho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze nkwaba mebɛhyɛ w’adadaw mu, na mama w’esutsen mu nam afemfam w’abon ho; na mibeyi wo efi esutsen no mu aba sor, ɔnye w’esutsen no mu nam a ɔfemfam w’abon ho no nyinara.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mobɔtow wo akyen sar no do, ɔwo na w’esutsen no mu nam nyinara: na ebɔtɔ sar petee enyi: wɔrommboaboa wo ano, eso worinnsie wo. Medze wo ama asaase do mbowa na wimu nnoma dɛ edziban.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Egyptfo nyina bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, osiandɛ wɔayɛ ndzɛmbir poma ama Israel fie.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Aber a wosuoo wo nsamu no, ibui, na isunsuaan hɔn mbatsir nyina: na aber a wɔtweer wo no, ibui, na emaa hɔn sisiw nyina kyirenii.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, medze afona bɛba wo do, na metwa wo mu nyimpa na abowa egu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Egypt asaase bɛyɛ afoafo na ɔada pan; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE: osiandɛ ɔaka dɛ, Esutsen no yɛ medze, na emi na mayɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi hwɛ, menye ɔwo ɔnye w’esutsen enya, na mebɛma Egypt asaase ada hɔ pan koraa na ɔayɛ afoafo, ofi Sevene abantsentsen ho dze kodu Etiopia he do mpo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa anamɔn biara remmfa do, anaa abowa anamɔn biara remmfa do, eso wɔrenntsena do mfe eduanan.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛyɛ Egypt asaase amamfo wɔ nkurow nkurow a wɔayeyɛ afoafo no mu, na no nkurow a wɔwɔ nkurow a abobɔ no mu no, wɔayeyɛ afoafo mfe eduanan: na mobɔbɔ Egypt apetse amanaman mu, na mapansam hɔn megu nkurow nkurow no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Mfe eduanan n’ewiei na mobɔboaboa Egyptfo ano efi aman a wɔabɔ hɔn apetse do no mu:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na medze Egypt ndɔmmum bɛsan aba, na mama wɔaba Patros asaase do bio, aba hɔn awobea asaase no do; na wɔbɛyɛ ahenman a ɔbrɛ adze wɔ hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ nhenman mu dza ɔbrɛ adze kyɛn ne nyina; eso ɔremma noho do abɔ amanaman do bio: na mebɛma woesuar, ma woenndzi amanaman do tum bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔrennda ho ayɛ Israel fifo awerɛhyɛmu bio, dɛ ɔma wɔkaa emumuyɛ, ber a wɔdan hɔn enyi dzi hɔn abosom ekyir: na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE Nyankopɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ afe eduonu esuon no mu no, bosoom a odzi kan no mu, bosoom no ne da a odzi kan no na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar maa no dɔm bɔsoom ɔsom kɛse bi tsiaa Taere: etsifi biara pepae, na batsir biara hoɛɛhoɛɛe: naaso ɔno anaa no dɔm woennya akatua bi wɔ Taere nsamu, wɔ ɔsom a ɔbɔsomee tsiaa no no ntsi:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, medze Egypt asaase bɛma Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar; na ɔbɛfa ne nyimpadodow no akɔ, na ɔafa n’asadze, na ɔafa n’afonam; na ɔno bɛyɛ no dɔm no hɔn akatua.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Medze Egypt asaase ama no dɛ som a ɔsomee no n’ahyɛnanmu, osiandɛ wɔyɛe maa me, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Da no mu no na mebɛma ambɛn efifir ama Israel fifo, na mama wo anobue wɔ hɔn finimfin; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ bio, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, hyɛ nkɔm, na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hom mbɔ mbubuw, Ndom nka da no!
title: EZEKIEL

text: Osiandɛ da no abɛn mekyerɛ EWURADZE ne da no abɛn, mununkum da a; ɔbɛyɛ amanamamfo hɔn da.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na afona bɛba Egypt do, na ahoguan aba Etiopia, ber a atɔfo bɔtotɔ Egypt; na wɔbɛfa ne nyimpadodow no akɔ, na woedwuruw ne fapem no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Etiopia, na Put, na Lud, na aforaforafo no nyina, na Kub, na asaase a oedzi ahyɛmu ne mba no, wɔnye hɔn bɔtotɔ afona ano.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Hɔn a wosuo Egypt mu gyina no so bɔtotɔ, na n’ahoɔdzen nkontompɔ no bodwuruw: ofi Migidɔl kɔ Siene na wɔbɔtotɔ wɔ mu wɔ afona ano, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔbɛyɛ afo wɔ nkurow nkurow a wɔayeyɛ afo no mu, na no nkurow afora nkurow a wɔayeyɛ amamfo no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, ber a mato gya wɔ Egypt, na n’aboafo nyina asɛɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Da no mu na abɔfo befi m’enyim efir edzi wɔ ahɛn mu ekopuw Etiopiafo a hɔn enyi nnyi hɔnho do no; na ahoguan bɛba hɔn do, dɛ Egypt da no mu; na, hwɛ, ɔreba.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Eso mebɛma Egypt nyimpadodow no nam Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar nsa do abɔ asa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔno na ne man a wɔka no ho no, amanaman mu etsiɔdzenfo no, wɔdze hɔn bɛba ma wɔabɛsɛɛ asaase no; na wɔbɔtwetwe hɔn mfona wɔ Egypt do, na wɔama atɔfo ahyɛ asaase no do ma.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛma esutsen no awewew, na matɔn asaase no ahyɛ emumuyɛfo nsamu, na menam ananaben nsa do mayɛ asaase no na dza ɔwɔ mu nyina amamfo: emi EWURADZE na maka.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Mebɛsɛɛ abosom no so, na mama ehonyi no abɔ adze wɔ Memfis; na bapɔmba biara rummpue Egypt asaase do bio: na medze hu bɛba Egypt asaase no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛma Patros ayɛ afo, na mato gya wɔ Zoan, na mayɛ atsɛmbudze wɔ Tebes.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mubohue m’ebufuw egu Sin, Egypt abandzendzen no do: na mubotwa Tebes nyimpadodow no egu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mobɔto Egypt gya; ahoguan kɛse bɛba Pelusium do, na woebubu Tebes mu: na Memfis benya ahohiahiafo ewiaber.
title: EZEKIEL

text: On kurow na Pi-beset kurow mu mberantsɛ bɔtotɔ afona ano: na nkurow yi bɔkɔ ndɔmmum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Da no bɛhyɛ sum wɔ Tehafenehes so, ber a mubobubu Egypt nkɔndua wɔ hɔ, na ahopɔw n’ahoɔdzen no abɔ adze: ɔnodze, mununkum bɛkata no do, na ne mbabaa akɔ ndɔmmum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ mibesi ayɛ atsɛmbudze wɔ Egypt nye yi: na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, afe a otsia dubiako no, bosoom a odzi kan no, bosoom no ne da a otsia esuon no, na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, mebu Egypthen Farao ne basa; na, hwɛ, wɔnnkɛkyekyer no mbrɛ wɔyɛ no yarsa edur, dɛ wɔdze ntamadan rekyekyer ma ɔaayɛ dzen, dɛ otum suo afona mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, menye Egypthen Farao enya, na mubobubu ne mbasa, dza ɔyɛ dzen no, na dza ebu no; na mebɛma afona no efi ne nsamu atɔ famu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mobɔbɔ Egyptfo apetse amanaman mu, na mapansam hɔn akɔ nkurow nkurow do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛhyɛ Babilɔnhen n’abasa dzen, na medze m’afona mahyɛ ne nsa: na mubobubu Farao ne basa mu, ma ɔaapempen nyimpa a ɔda atɔe mu n’apen wɔ n’enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛma Babilɔnhen ne basa ayɛ dzen, na Farao ne basa atɔ famu; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, ber a medze m’afona bɛhyɛ Babilɔnhen nsa, ma ɔaatsen no wɔ Egypt asaase do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mobɔbɔ Egyptfo apetse amanaman mu, na mapansam hɔn akɔ nkurow nkurow do; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia dubiako no, bosoom a otsia ebiasa no, bosoom no ne da a odzi kan no, na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, ka kyerɛ Egypthen Farao, na ne nyimpadodow no dɛ; Etse dɛ woana wɔ w’akɛseyɛ mu?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hwɛ, Asirianyi no yɛɛ dɛ Lebanon nkyindur ndua a n’abaw fɛɛfɛw, na oewuna kusuww, na ne tsentsen krɔn; na n’etsifi du nsuwusiw ntamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Esu no maa ɔyɛɛ kɛse, ebun no maa onyinii: n’esutsen pemee bɔɔ n’atsɛwndua ho aprɔw; na ɔmaa n’esuka dur kwaa mu ndua nyina ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi no krɔn yɛɛ sorɔnsorɔm seen kwaa mu ndua nyinara; na no nkorbata yɛɛ dodow, na no ndubaa yɛɛ atsentsen wɔ nsu dodow a onyae ntsi, wɔ ber a ɔtotoo hɔn no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔsor nnoma nyina yeyɛɛ hɔn mberɛbuw wɔ no nkorbata no mu, na no ndubaa no ase na hambowa nyina wowoo hɔn mba, na n’ase nwinwin na amanaman akɛse nyina tsenae.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm na no ho yɛɛ fɛw wɔ n’akɛseyɛ mu, wɔ no ndubaa n’atsentsen ntsi: osiandɛ no ndwow wɔ esu pii ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nyankopɔn ture mu odum enntum ammfa no ennsuma: ɔpepeaa annyɛ dɛ no nkorbata no; na papaa annyɛ dɛ n’abaw akɛse no: eso dua biara nnyi Nyankopɔn no ture mu a ɔtse dɛ ɔno wɔ n’ahoɔfɛw mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Meyɛɛ no fɛɛfɛw wɔ no ndubaa dodow ntsi: ma Eden ndua a wɔwɔ Nyankopɔn ture mu nyinara enyi beer no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ awar kronn, na ɔama ne tsentsen ano ekodu nsuwusiw mu, na ɔama n’akoma do wɔ no krɔn mu ntsi,
title: EZEKIEL

text: medze no mebɛhyɛ amanaman mu otumfo no nsa mpo; ɔnye no bedzi ara ampa: n’emumuyɛ ntsi na meyi no edzi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ananaben, amanaman mu ahoɔhufo no, woetwa no akyen, na wɔadan no egya: mbepɔw do na mbɔnsa nyina mu na no ndubaa abɔhwe, na no nkorbata ebubu wɔ asaase no do esuka no ho; na asaase no do aman no nyinara efi no nwinwin ase esian kɔ, na wɔadan no egya.
title: EZEKIEL

text: No kukuw a osi famu no do na ɔsor nnoma nyinara bɛgyegye, na hambowa nyinara bɛtsena no ndubaa do:
title: EZEKIEL

text: ma eekodu dɛ esu no ho ndua no mu biara nnkɛma hɔnho do wɔ hɔn krɔn mu, eso wɔaamma hɔn tsentsen ano annkɔ nsuwusiw mu, eso amma hɔn etumfo no aammema hɔnho do wɔ hɔn krɔn mu, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔnom nsu nyinara: osiandɛ woeyi hɔn nyinara ama wu, akɔ daadzetsirmu no ho, wɔ adasamba mu, akɛka hɔn a wosian kɔ mona mu no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Da a osianee kɔr samanadze no, memaa nkɔmbɔdzi bae: ɔno ntsi mekataa ebun no do, na misiiw n’esutsen no ano, na esu akɛse no siankae: na memaa Lebanon twaa ewuo wɔ ne ntsi, na hamu ndua nyinara tɔɔ bitsi wɔ ne ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Memaa amanaman wosowee wɔ n’asehwe ne dede ntsi, ber a motoow no hwee famu kɔtɔɔ samanadze kɛkaa hɔn a wosian kɔ mona mu nyinara ho: na Eden ndua nyina, Lebanon dze dza wɔasan mu eyi na oye kyɛn no, hɔn a wɔnom nsu nyina, wɔkyekyee hɔn werɛ wɔ daadzetsirmu no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hɔn so wɔnye no sianee kɔr samanadze kɛkaa hɔn a wɔatotɔ afona ano no ho; nyew, hɔn a nkyɛ wɔyɛ ne basa a wɔtsena no nwinwin ase wɔ amanaman mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Woana na enye no sɛ dɛm wɔ enyimnyam na akɛseyɛ mu wɔ Eden ndua no mu? Naaso wɔdze wo bɛka Eden ndua no ho esian akɔ daadzetsirmu no ho: ebɛda monomonomfo mu, wɔ hɔn a wɔatotɔ afona ano no nkyɛn. Iyi nye Farao na ne nyimpadodow nyinara, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na afe a otsia duebien no mu, bosoom a otsia duebien no ne da a odzi kan no mu no, na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, ma sukwadwom do wɔ Egypthen Farao ho, na se no dɛ, Wɔdze wo too amanaman gyatafɔr ho: naaso etse dɛ abowa kɛse a ɔwɔ pomu; na edze w’esutsen no paapaa mu, na edze w’anan fontaan esu no, na emaa hɔn esutsen no fonee.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Mebɛtserɛw mo boa mu akata ɔwo na aman pii asafo no do; na wɔbɔtwetwe wo aba sor wɔ mo boa mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mobɔtow wo akyen famu, na matow wo akyen sar do, na mama sor nnoma nyina abɛgyegye wo do, na mama asaase nyina do mbowa edzi wo nam amee.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze wo nam mobɔto mbepɔw do, na medze wo fun ahyɛ mbɔnsa ma.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Medze wo bɔgyaa so bogugu asaase do ekodu mbepɔw no ho; na ebɛhyɛ esuka no amaama.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ mubodum wo a, mebɛkata sor enyi, na mama no nworaba ayɛ sum; medze nsuwusiw mebɛkata ewia do, na bosoom so nnkɛma ne kan.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mebɛma sor nkandzea a ɔhyerɛn nyina ebir wɔ wo do, na mama sum ahyɛ w’asaase do, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mubohur aman pii hɔn bo so, ber a mebɛfa wo ndɔmmum akɔ aman a innyim do no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nyew, mebɛma wo ho ayɛ aman pii hu, na hɔn ahemfo hɔn bo botutu kɛsenara wɔ wo ho, ber a mibenyinam m’afona wɔ hɔn enyim no; na hɔn ho bɔpopo mbertsia biara mu, nyimpa biara wɔ nankasa no nkwa ho, wɔ w’asehwe da no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Babilɔnhen n’afona bɛba wo do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Medze akatakyi hɔn mfona no mebɛma wo nyimpadodow no atotɔ; amanaman mu hɔn a womuo papaapa nyina: na wɔbɛsɛɛ Egypt ne ntsɛn, na woedwuruw ne nyimpadodow no nyina.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mebɛsɛɛ no mbowa nyina so mefi esu pii ho; eso nyimpa anamɔn rommfontan hɔn bio, anaaso mbowa ntɔtse rommfontan hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mebɛma hɔn nsu enyi agyen, na mama hɔn esutsen apem dɛ ngo, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ber a mebɛma Egypt asaase ayɛ amamfo na ɔabɔ no, asaase a n’amayɛ nyina abɔ no no, ber a mubokuku hɔn a wɔtse do nyina no, nna wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sukwadwom a wɔdze botwa ewuo nye yi; amanaman mbabaa no wɔdze botwa sukwadwom: wɔdze botwa Egypt na ne nyimpadodow no nyina ho sukwadwom, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔbaa dɛ afe a otsia duebien no, bosoom no mu da a otsia duenum no so, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, twa ewuo wɔ Egypt nyimpadodow no ntsi, na tow ɔno na amanaman atsenkafo hɔn mbabaa no kɛhyɛ daadzetsirmu no ho, nkɛka hɔn a wosian kɔ mona mu no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Woana na esen no ahoɔfɛw? Sian, na kɛda monomonomfo no nkyɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hɔn a wɔtotɔ afona ano no mu, na wɔbɔtotɔ: woeyi no ama afona: wɔntwe ɔno na ne nyimpadodow nyina nkɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Akatakyi mu ahoɔdzenfo no fi samanadze bɛkasa akyerɛ ɔno na hɔn a wɔboa no no: woesian deda hɔ komm, monomonomfo a afona kunkum hɔn no a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Asiria wɔ hɔ ɔnye n’asafo nyinara; ne ndakamona etwa no ho ehyia: hɔn nyinara atɔfo a afona kunkum hɔn a:
title: EZEKIEL

text: ɔno a wɔabɔ ne nda wɔ mona mu noho noho, na n’asafo etwa n’adakamona ho ehyia: hɔn nyinara atɔfo a afona kunkum hɔn a woyii hu wɔ atseasefo asaase do no a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hɔ na Elam na ne nyimpadodow etwa n’adakamona ho ehyia nyina wɔ: hɔn nyinara atɔfo a afona kunkum hɔn a wɔdze monomonomyɛ esian kɔ asaasetsirmu no ho a woyii hu wɔ atseasefo asaase do, na wɔnye hɔn a wosian kɔ mona mu no asoa hɔn enyito.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔatow no mpa wɔ atɔfo no mu aka ne nyimpadodow nyina ho; ne ndakamona etwa no ho ehyia: hɔn nyinara monomonomfo a afona kunkum hɔn a; osiandɛ hɔn ho hu ka atseasefo asaase no, na wɔnye hɔn a wosian kɔ mona mu no asoa hɔn enyito: wɔdze no ato atɔfo finimfin.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hɔ na Mesek, Tubal, na ne nyimpadodow no nyina wɔ; ne ndakamona etwa no ho ehyia: hɔn nyinara monomonomfo a afona kunkum hɔn a; osiandɛ woyii hu wɔ atseasefo asaase do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔrennye akatakyi a wɔatotɔ monomonomfo mu no a wɔdze hɔn akondadze esian kɔ samanadze no, na wɔdze hɔn mfona atoto hɔn tsir adze, na hɔn emumuyɛ wɔ hɔn mbiew do no, adeda; osiandɛ hɔn ho hu kitsaa akatakyi wɔ atseasefo asaase no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo so wobobubu wo wɔ monomonomfo no mu, na enye hɔn a wɔatotɔ afona ano no akɛda.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hɔ na Edom wɔ, n’ahemfo na ne mbapɔmba nyina a hɔn ahoɔdzen no mu ara wɔdze hɔn atoto hɔn a wɔatotɔ afona ano no nkyɛn: wɔnye monomonomfo na hɔn a wosian kɔ mona mu no bɛdeda.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hɔ na kwaamu afamu mbapɔmba no wɔ, hɔn nyinara, na Zidonfo nyinara a wɔnye atɔfo esian kɔ no; hɔn ho hu a wɔdze hɔn akatakyisɛm yii no mu na hɔn enyi atoto; na wɔnye hɔn a wɔatotɔ afona ano no deda hɔ dɛ monomonomfo, na wɔnye hɔn a wosian kɔ mona mu no soa hɔn enyito.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Farao bohu hɔn, na no werɛ akyekye wɔ ne nyimpadodow no nyinara ho: mekyerɛ Farao na no dɔm nyina a wɔatotɔ afona ano no, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mama no ho hu ada atseasefo asaase no do: na wɔdze no bɔto monomonomfo no finimfin, wɔ hɔn a wɔtotɔ afona ano no nkyɛn, mekyerɛ Farao na ne nyimpadodow no nyina, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, kasa kyerɛ wo man ne mba, na se hɔn dɛ, Sɛ medze afona no ba asaase bi do, na sɛ asaase no mu mba no yi barimba bi fi hɔn mu, na wɔdze no si ɔweɔmfo ma hɔnho:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na sɛ ber a obohu afona dɛ ɔreba asaase no do no, ɔbɔ akasamu no mu dze bɔ ɔman no kɔkɔ
title: EZEKIEL

text: na obi tse akasamu no ndze, na ɔammfa kɔkɔbɔ no a, sɛ afona no ba, na ɔfa no kɔ a, no bɔgyaa bobua nankasa n’etsifi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ ɔtsee akasamu no ne ndze, na ɔammfa kɔkɔbɔ no a, no bɔgyaa bobua n’etsifi: naaso sɛ ɔfaa kɔkɔbɔ no a, nkyɛ ɔagye ne kra nkwa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ ɔweɔmfo no hu dɛ afona no reba, na ɔammbɔ akasamu no mu, na ɔman no ennya nkaabɔ, na afona no ba bɛfa nyimpa biara fi hɔn mu kɔ a; ɔnoara dze wɔafa no kɔ wɔ n’emumuyɛ mu, naaso no bɔgyaa no mibebisa no wɔ ɔweɔmfo no nsamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔwo, onyimpa ba, medze wo esi ɔweɔmfo ama Israelfo; dɛm ntsi tsie m’anomu asɛm, na fa me nkaabɔ ma hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ mese mumuyɛnyi dɛ, Mumuyɛnyi, wu ara na ibowu, na ɔwo annkasa ammbɔ mumuyɛnyi no kɔkɔ emmfi ne bra ho a, mumuyɛnyi no dze, obowu n’emumuyɛ mu, naaso no bɔgyaa no dze, mibebisa no wɔ wo nsamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso, sɛ ɔwo ebɔ mumuyɛnyi no kɔkɔ wɔ ne bra ho dɛ ɔnsan mfi ho, na ɔanndan emmfi ne bra ho a; obowu n’emumuyɛ mu, na ɔwo dze agye wo kra nkwa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, se Israelfo dɛ: Mbrɛ hom kasa nye yi, dɛ, Hɛn mbrato na hɛn bɔn hyɛ hɛn do, na yɛafomfɔn wɔ mu; yebesi dɛn koraa atsena ase?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Se hɔn dɛ, Metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, Minnyi enyigye wɔ mumuyɛnyi no wu mu; na mbom dɛ mumuyɛnyi bɛdan efi ne bra ho na oenya nkwa a: hom nsan, hom nsan mfi hom bra bɔn no ho; na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom bowu, Israel fifo?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, se wo man no ne mba no dɛ, Ɔtseneneenyi ne ndzeyɛtsenenee renngye no wɔ ne mbrato da no mu; na mumuyɛnyi n’emumuyɛ dze, orinnsian ɔno ntsi mma ɔnnhwe ase wɔ da a ɔbɛsan efi n’emumuyɛ ho no: eso nyia ɔyɛ tseneneenyi no nam dɛm do runntum ntsena ase wɔ da a ɔbɛyɛ bɔn no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ mese tseneneenyi dɛ obenya nkwa ara ampa a; sɛ ɔtwer ne ndzeyɛtsenenee, na ɔyɛ emumuyɛ a, wɔrennkaa ne ndzeyɛtsenenee no mu biara; na emumuyɛ a ɔayɛ no, ɔnoara mu na obowu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bio, sɛ mese mumuyɛnyi dɛ, Owu na ibowu; na sɛ ɔsan fi no bɔn ho, na ɔyɛ dza ɔfa mbra mu na ɔtsen a;
title: EZEKIEL

text: sɛ mumuyɛnyi no dan ahobadze no ma, ɔhyɛ dza owiae no ananmu, ɔnantsew nkwa ahyɛdze no do, dɛ ɔnnyɛ emumuyɛdze a; nkwa ara na obenya, orunnwu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔrennkaa no bɔn a ɔayɛ no mu biara nntsia no: ɔayɛ dza ɔfa mbra mu na ɔtsen; nkwa ara na obenya.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso wo man ne mba no wɔse dɛ, EWURADZE n’amambu nnsaa: na hɔn dze, hɔnara na hɔn amambu nnsaa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ tseneneenyi san fi ne ndzeyɛtsenenee ho, na ɔyɛ emumuyɛ a, no mu ara na obowu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ mumuyɛnyi san fi n’emumuyɛ ho, na ɔyɛ dza ɔfa mbra mu na ɔtsen a, ɔnam do benya nkwa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso hom ka dɛ, EWURADZE n’amambu nnsaa. Israel fifo, mubobu hom atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ hom mu biara n’abrabɔ tse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ hɛn ndɔmmumkɔ afe a otsia duebien no, bosoom a otsia du no, bosoom no ne da a otsia enum no mu, na obi a oguanee fi Jerusalɛm mu baa mo hɔ, dɛ; Wɔabɔ kurow no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afei EWURADZE nsa baa mo do ewimbir no, ansaana nyia oguanee no reba; aber a ɔbaa mo hɔ anapa no, nna oebue m’ano dada; na m’ano buei na mutumii kasaa bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, hɔn a wɔtse Israel asaase do ekurofo mu no ka dɛ, Abraham yɛ ɔbaakofo, na onyaa asaase no tsenaa do: na hɛn dze, yɛdɔɔ so; wɔdze asaase no ama hɛn dɛ egyapadze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hom dze bɔgya ka ho dzidzi, na hom ma hom enyi do hwɛ hom abosom, na hom ka bɔgya gu: aso hom bɛfa asaase no ayɛ homdze?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom gyinagyina hom afona do, hom yɛ ekyiwadze, na hom mu biara gu ne nyɛnko yer ho fi: aso hom bɛfa asaase no ayɛ homdze?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ ka kyerɛ hɔn nye yi, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Metse ase yi, ampaara hɔn a wɔwowɔ ekurofo no do no bɔtotɔ afona ano, na nyia ɔwɔ haban petee mu no, medze no bɛma mbowa ma woeedzi, na hɔn a wɔwowɔ aban adzendzen na etu mu no, wobowuwu yardɔm ano.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛma asaase no ayɛ amamfo na ahobowdze, na no tum no nkontompɔ no bɔbɔ adze; na Israel mbepɔw bɛyɛ afo, ma biara runndua do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, ber a mayɛ asaase no amamfo na ahobowdze no, osian hɔn ekyiwadze nyinara a wɔayɛ ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba dze, wo man ne mba keka wo ho asɛm wɔ afasu ho na adan mbobow ano, na obi kasa kyerɛ obi, biara na no nua, dɛ, Meserɛ hom, hom mbra mbetsie asɛm kor a ofi EWURADZE nkyɛn aba.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔba wo nkyɛn dɛ man bi ba, na wɔtsenatsena w’enyim dɛ me man, na wotsie wo nsɛm, na wɔnnyɛ: osiandɛ wɔdze hɔn ano kyerɛ dɔ pii, naaso hɔn akoma dze, odzi hɔn mfaso ekyir.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na, hwɛ, etse dɛ obi a ne ndze fenemfenem na onyim sanku bɔ papaara, no ndwom dɛdɛɛdɛw ma hɔn: osiandɛ wɔtse wo nsɛm, naaso wɔnnyɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ iyi ba mu a, (hwɛ, ɔbɛba,) nna wobohu dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi atsena hɔn mu pɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, hyɛ nkɔm tsia Israel nguanhwɛfo, hyɛ nkɔm, na se hɔn, mekyerɛ nguanhwɛfo no, dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ndom nka Israel nguanhwɛfo a wɔnyɛn hɔnankasa hɔnho! Aso nnyɛ nguan na nguanhwɛfo wɔsɛ dɛ wɔnyɛn hɔn?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom dzi angoa no, na hom fura nguannhwi, hom ku dza wɔadɔ angoa no; na hom nnyɛn nguan no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom annhyɛ hɔn a woegura no dzen, eso hom annsa dza ɔyar no yarba, eso hom annkyekyer dza ebubu no, eso hom annkɛfa dza wɔapam no no ammba, eso hom annhwehwɛ dza ayew no n’ekyir kwan; na mbom hom dze nhyɛ na etsiɔdzen edzi hɔn do tum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔbɔɔ hɔn petsee, osiandɛ wonnyi guanhwɛfo: na wɔbɛyɛɛ edziban maa hambowa nyinara, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn petsee.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mo nguan kyinkyiin mbepɔw nyina na koko tsentsen biara do: nyew, wɔbɔɔ mo nguan petsee asaase nyina enyi; na biara nnyi hɔ a ɔhwehwɛɛ hɔn anaa otsiiw hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi, hom nguanhwɛfo, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm:
title: EZEKIEL

text: Metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, ampaara, susuampaara dɛ mo nguan bɛyɛɛ afonam, na mo nguan bɛyɛɛ edziban maa hambowa nyinara, osiandɛ guanhwɛfo biara nnyi hɔ ntsi, eso mo nguanhwɛfo annhwehwɛ mo nguan, na mbom nguanhwɛfo no nyɛɛn hɔnankasa hɔnho, na wɔannyɛn mo nguan no;
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi, hom nguanhwɛfo, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm;
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, menye nguanhwɛfo no enya; na mibebisa mo nguan wɔ hɔn nsamu, na mama woegyaa nguan no nyɛn; eso nguanhwɛfo no rennyɛn hɔnankasa hɔnho ara bio; na mebɛgye mo nguan efi hɔn anomu, mma wɔannyɛ edziban amma hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, emi mara, marankasa, mobɔhwehwɛ mo nguan, na metsiw hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛ mbrɛ guanhwɛfo tsiw no nguankuw wɔ da a ɔaba no nguan a wɔabɔ hɔn apetse mbeambea no mu no, dɛmara so na mibetsiw mo nguan; na mibeyi hɔn efi mbeambea nyina a wɔabɔ hɔn apetse hɔ no wɔ mununkum na sum da no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mibeyi hɔn mefi aman mu, na maboaboa hɔn ano mefi nkurow nkurow do, na medze hɔn aba hɔnara hɔn asaase do; na manyɛn hɔn wɔ Israel mbepɔw do esuka no nkyɛn, nye asaase no do tsenabea nyina.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze edzidzidze pa mebɛnyɛn hɔn, na Israel mbepɔw atsentsen do bɛyɛ hɔn nguamban: hɔ na wobobutubutuw nguamban pa mu, na edzidzibea a ɔatɔ seradze mu na wobedzidzi wɔ Israel mbepɔw do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Emi mara mebɛnyɛn mo nguan, na mama woebutubutuw famu, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mobɔhwehwɛ dza ɔyewee no, na medze dza wɔpaam no no asan aba, na makyekyer dza wobubui no, na mahyɛ dza ɔyaree no dzen: na mebɛsɛɛ dza ɔadɔ seradze na dza ɔyɛ dzen no; mebɛnyɛn hɔn atsɛmbu mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom, mo nguankuw dze, mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, murubu nantwi na nantwi ntamu atsɛn, na nguannyin na mpɔnkyenyin ntamu so.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Aso ɔyɛ adze kakraba ma hom dɛ hom dzidzi edzidzibea pa do, na hom edzidzibea nkaa no dze, tsiatsia ara na hom tsiatsia do? Hom nom nsu a agyen, na nkaa no dze, hom dze hom anan fon no?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mo nguan dze, wodzi dza hom dze hom anan etsiatsia do, na wɔnom dza hom dze hom anan afon no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛ hɔn nye yi: Hwɛ, emi, marankasa, mubobu nantwi a ɔadɔ seradze na nantwi a ɔafɔn ntamu atsɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Osiandɛ hom dze hom nkyɛnmu na hom abatsir sunsun, na hom dze hom mmbɛn sesɛ ayarfo nyina, kodu dɛ hom abɔ hɔn apetse mbeambea ntsi;
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi mebɛgye mo nguankuw nkwa, na wɔrennyɛ afonam bio; na mubobu nantwi na nantwi ntamu atsɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze guanhwɛfo kor mibesi hɔn do, na ɔanyɛn hɔn, m’akowaa David a; ɔbɛnyɛn hɔn, na ɔayɛ hɔn guanhwɛfo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na emi EWURADZE mebɛyɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn, na m’akowaa David ayɛ hɔn mu safohen; emi EWURADZE na maka.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na menye hɔn bedzi asomdwee ahyɛmu, na mama mbowa bɔn efi asaase no do: na wɔbɛtsena sar do dwudwoodwo, na wɔadeda kwaa mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛma hɔn na mbeambea a wɔdeda mo koko ho hyia no ayɛ nhyira; na mebɛma nyankom atɔ wɔ ne ber mu; ɔbɛyɛ nhyira nyankom.
title: EZEKIEL
