text: Na haban mu dua bɔsow n’aba, na asaase beyi no ndɔbaa, na wɔbɛyɛ sɔkyee wɔ hɔn asaase do; na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, ber a mebubu hɔn kɔndua ne mbeabeamu no, na meyi hɔn mefi hɔn a wodzii hɔn nya no nsa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔrennda ho nnyɛ amanaman afonam bio, eso asaase do abowa remmemen hɔn; na wɔbɛtsena hɔ dwudwoodwo, na biara nnkɛma hɔn bo etu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mibesiesie kwa a ɔyɛ atsenka ama hɔn, na kɔm runnku hɔn bio wɔ asaase no do, anaa so wɔronnsoa abosonsɔrfo hɔn enyito bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wobohu dɛ emi EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn menye hɔn tse, na dɛ hɔn, Israel fifo, wɔyɛ me man, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom mo nguan, m’edzidzibea do nguan, hom yɛ nyimpa, na emi nye hom Nyankopɔn, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ bio, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, fa w’enyi si Seir bepɔw do, na hyɛ nkɔm gu no do, na se no dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, Seir bepɔw, menye wo enya, na mebɛtsen me nsa wɔ wo do, na mayɛ wo amamfo na ahobowdze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mebɛma wo nkurow abobɔ, na ɔwo ebɛyɛ amamfo; na ibohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Osiandɛ ewɔ daa enyitan na eyi Israelmba ahyɛ afona no n’ahoɔdzen nsa wɔ hɔn mbusu ber mu, wɔ hɔn ewiei emumuyɛ ne ber no ntsi:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi, metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, mibesiesie wo mama bɔgya, na bɔgya etsiw wo: susuampa dɛ ɔwo ennkyir bɔgya no, bɔgya ara na obetsiw wo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ mubodua ayɛ bepɔw Seir ahobowdze na amamfo nye no; na mubotwa nyia ɔresen na nyia ɔresan no efi mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze n’atɔfoe bɛhyɛ ne mbepɔw do amaama: wo nkoko do na wo mbɔnsa mu na w’esuka nyina mu na hɔn a wɔatotɔ afona ano nyina no bogugu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mebɛma ayɛ daa amamfo, na wo nkurow no wɔrenntsena do: na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Osiandɛ aka dɛ, Amanaman ebien yi, na nkurow nkurow ebien yi bɛyɛ medze, na yɛafa edzi do; ber a nna EWURADZE wɔ hɔ:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi, metse ase yi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, mebɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ w’ebufuw no tse, na dɛ mbrɛ w’enyitan a akyerɛ no wɔ kyir a edze kyir hɔn no mu no tse; na mebɛma woehu me wɔ hɔn mu, ber a mubobu wo atsɛn no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ibohu dɛ emi EWURADZE matse wo kasabɔn a akasa etsiatsia Israel mbepɔw no dɛ, Wɔayeyɛ afoafo, wɔdze ama hɛn dɛ yendzi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom dze hom ano edzi mo do ekokrokosɛm, na hom ama hom nsɛm adɔɔ so etsia me: matse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ber a asaase nyina bedzi ehurusi no, mebɛyɛ wo amamfo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo idzii Israel fifo egyapadze eduwa, dɛ ɔayɛ afo ntsi no, dɛmara na medze bɛyɛ wo: Seir bepɔw, ebɛyɛ afo, na Edom nyina no mu nyina mpo: na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, hyɛ nkɔm kyerɛ Israel mbepɔw no, na se dɛ, Israel mbepɔw, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ tamfo no aka hom ho asɛm dɛ, Yɛɛ! Na, Tsetse mbepɔw no abɛyɛ hɛndze no:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi hyɛ nkɔm, na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osian ara mpo dɛ wɔayɛ hom amamfo, na wɔamemen hom mbea nyinara, ma hom adan enyadze ama amanaman nkaa no, na hom deda akasakasafo ano, na hom ayɛ nkorɔfo nsopa ntsi:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi, Israel mbepɔw, hom ntsie EWURADZE Nyankopɔn n’asɛm; Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛ mbepɔw na akoko, esuka na mbɔnsa, ekurofo na nkurow a woetutu do a ayeyɛ afodze na asesardze ama amanaman nkaa a wɔabɔ hɔn ho aprɔw no nye yi:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ampa me nyinkuntwe gya no mu na makasa etsia amanaman nkaa no, na Edom nyina wɔdze hɔn akoma nyina n’enyigye na kra mu enyimtsiabu mu afa m’asaase ayɛ hɔn enyadze, dɛ wɔbɔtow akyen ayɛ afodze:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi hyɛ Israel asaase ho nkɔm, na se mbepɔw na akoko, esuka na mbɔnsa no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, maka no wɔ me nyinkuntwe na m’ebufuhyew mu, osiandɛ hom asoa abosonsɔrfo enyito ntsi:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Mama me nsa do, dɛ, Ampaara, abosonsɔrfo a abɔ hom ho aprɔw no, hɔnara na wɔbɔsoa hɔn enyito.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom, Israel mbepɔw dze, hom bɔtoto hom abaw, na hom asow hom aba ama me man Israel; na wɔabɛn wɔreba.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na, hwɛ, mowɔ hɔ ma hom, na mebɛdan maba hom nkyɛn, na wɔbɔdɔw hom na woedua hom do adze:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na mebɛma nyimpa adɔɔ so wɔ hom do, Israel fi nyina nyina: na nkurow no wɔbɛtsenatsena mu, na wɔakyekyer ekurofo no:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na mebɛma nyimpa na mbowa adɔɔ so wɔ hom do; na wɔbɔdɔr na wɔawowo: na mebɛma wɔatsenatsena hom do dɛ hom nkan no ber no, na mayɛ hom yie asen hom ahyɛse no: na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nyew, mebɛma nyimpa anantsenantsew hom do, me man Israel no a; na wɔbɛfa wo ayɛ hɔndze, na ayɛ hɔn egyapadze, na ofitsi kɔ yi, erennda ho nngye hɔn nsamu mba bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Osiandɛ wɔse wo dɛ, Ɔwo asaase yi eyɛ nyimpa ɔmememfo, na ama wo man edzi awo mba ewu:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi eremmemen nyimpa bio, eso eremma wo man nndzi awo mba ewu bio, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse;
title: EZEKIEL

text: eso meremma enntse abosonsɔrfo enyito no bio, eso eronnsoa aman ahorohoraa bio, eso eremma wo man mmfintsiw bio, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ bio, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, ber a Israel fi tsenatsenaa hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do no, wɔdze hɔn abrabɔ na hɔn ndzeyɛɛ guu ho fi: hɔn abrabɔ yɛɛ m’enyi do dɛ ɔbrafo no ho fi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi na muhuee m’ebufuhyew guu hɔn do wɔ bɔgya a wɔkae guu asaase no do ntsi, na hɔn abosom a wɔdze guu ho fi no ntsi:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na mobɔɔ hɔn petsee amanaman mu, na mepansaam hɔn guguu nkurow do: mbrɛ hɔn abrabɔ na hɔn ndzeyɛɛ tse no, na mubuu hɔn atsɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wodur amanaman a wɔkɔr hɔ no do no, wohuraa me dzin krɔnkrɔn no ho; wɔ dɛ adasa kaa no wɔ hɔn ho dɛ, Woyinom nye EWURADZE ne man, na woefi n’asaase do kɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na minyaa tsema wɔ me dzin krɔnkrɔn a Israel fifo huraa ho wɔ amanaman a wɔkɔr hɔn mu no ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi se Israel fifo dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Israel fifo, nnyɛ hom ntsi bi na meyɛ iyi, na mbom me dzin krɔnkrɔn a hom huraa ho wɔ amanaman a hom kɔr hɔn mu no ntsi a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛyɛ me dzin kɛse a woegu ho fi, wɔ amanaman a hom egu ho fi wɔ hɔn mu no krɔnkrɔn; na amanaman bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, ber a wɔbɛda mo krɔnkrɔnyɛ edzi wɔ hom mu wɔ hom enyiwa mu no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mibeyi hom efi amanaman mu, na maboaboa hom ano efi nkurow nkurow nyina do, na medze hom aba homankasa hom asaase do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze esu krɔngyenn mebɛpetse hom do, na hom ho atsew: hom ho fi nyina, na hom abosom nyina na mebɛtsew hom ho efi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mebɛma hom akoma fofor so, na medze sunsum fofor ahyɛ hom mu: na mibeyi ɔbo akoma efi hom honam mu, na mama hom honam akoma.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze mo sunsum bɛhyɛ hom mu, na mama hom anantsew m’ahyɛdze mu, na hom esie m’atsɛmbudze no, na hom ayɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom bɛtsena asaase a medze maa hom egyanom no do; na hom bɛyɛ me man, na emi so mayɛ hom Nyankopɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛgye hom efi hom efifidze nyina mu: na mebɛfrɛ eburow aba, na mama ɔadɔɔ so, na meremmfa kɔm bi nnto hom do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛma dua no nsowee, na hamu ndɔbaa adɔɔ so, amma hom ennya kɔm ho ahorohoraa wɔ amanaman mu bio.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna hom bɛkaa hom abrabɔ bɔn, na hom ndzeyɛɛ a ɔnnyɛ no; na homankasa hom ho bɛyɛ hom nkɔw wɔ hom enyiwa do wɔ hom emumuyɛ na hom atantandze no ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nnyɛ hom ntsi bi na meyɛ iyi, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, hom nhu: Israel fi, hom enyi nto na hom enyim ngu ase wɔ hom abrabɔ ntsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Da a mebɛtsew hom ho efi hom emumuyɛdze nyina mu no, mebɛma wɔatsenatsena nkurow no do, na wɔakyekyer amamfo no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na asaase a ɔda hɔ pan no, wɔbɔdɔw, ber a nkyɛ ɔdaa hɔ pan wɔ hɔn a wotwaa mu nyina enyiwa mu no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔbɛse dɛ, Asaase a ɔdaa hɔ pan yi na ɔayɛ dɛ Eden ture yi; na nkurow a ɔbobɔe, ɔyeyɛɛ amamfo na odwurudwuruwii no na wɔagyegye ho ban na wɔtsetse do yi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna amanaman a aka a wɔabɔ hom ho aprɔw no bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE na mesi dza odwuruwii no, na matsɛw dza ɔyɛɛ afo no: emi EWURADZE na maka, na mebɛyɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Iyi so ntsi na Israel fifo bɛba mo hɔ ebisa, ma mayɛ mama hɔn; mebɛma wɔadɔr nyimpa dɛ nguankuw.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛ nguankuw a wɔdze bɔ ɔhyew afɔr, dɛ Jerusalɛm nguankuw wɔ n’afahyɛ ber mu; dɛmara so na ekurofo no nyimpa ekuwekuw bɛhyehyɛ no amaama: na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE ne nsa baa mo do, na ɔdze me puei wɔ EWURADZE no sunsum mu, na ɔdze me kesii bɔnsa no finimfin; na mbiew ahyɛ mu ma;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na ɔmaa mikyiin ho hyiae: na hwɛ, wɔdɔɔ so papaara wɔ bɔnsa no enyi; na hwɛ, hɔn ho akokwa dɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, Aso mbiew yi benya nkwa? Na mubuaa dɛ, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn, ɔwoara na inyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me bio dɛ, Hyɛ nkɔm wɔ mbiew yi do, na ka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom mbiew a hom ho akokwa, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se mbiew yi nye yi: Hwɛ, mebɛma ahom ahɛn hom mu, na hom enya nkwa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze ntsin esusuo hom mu, na medze nam egu hom do, na medze werba akata hom do, na medze ahom ahɛn hom mu, na hom enya nkwa; na hom ehu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mehyɛɛ nkɔm dɛ mbrɛ wɔhyɛɛ me no: na merehyɛ nkɔm no, metsee dede, na hwɛ, asaasewosow a, na mbiew no boaboaa ano, biew besii ne biew enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mohwɛe, na hwɛ, ntsin baa hɔn do, na nam baa ho, na werba bɛkataa do: naaso nna ahom bi nnyi mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Hyɛ nkɔm kyerɛ mframa no, onyimpa ba, hyɛ nkɔm, na se mframa no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ahom e, fi mframa ananmu bra, na bɔhom gu atɔfo yi do, ma wonnya nkwa ɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna mehyɛɛ nkɔm dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyɛɛ me no, na ahom no baa hɔn mu, na wonyinyaa nkwa, na wogyinagyinaa hɔn anan do, dɔm kɛse paara.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, mbiew yi nye Israel fifo nyinara: na hwɛ, wɔka dɛ, Hɛn mbiew ho akokwa, na hɛn enyidado ahera; woetwa hɛn akyen korakora.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi hyɛ nkɔm, na se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, murubuebue hom ndakamona ano, na mama hom efi hom nda mu epuepue, me man; na medze hom aba Israel asaase do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, ber a mebuebue hom ndakamona ano, na mama hom efi hom ndakamona mu epuepue no, me man.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze mo sunsum bɛhyɛ hom mu, na hom enya nkwa, na medze hom ekodua homankasa hom asaase do: na hom bohu dɛ emi EWURADZE na maka, na mayɛ, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ bio, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, fa poma kor ma woho, na kyerɛw wɔ do dɛ, Juda dze, na ne mfɛfo Israelmba no dze: nkyii fa poma kor so, na kyerɛw wɔ do, Josef dze, Efraim poma, na ne mfɛfo Israel fifo nyinara dze:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na fa ebien nyina bɔ mu kyekyer no poma kor ma woho, na wɔnyɛ kor wɔ wo nsamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ wo man hɔn mba no ka kyerɛ wo dɛ, Aso erennkyerɛ hɛn yinom ase a?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, mebɛfa Josef no poma a ɔdze Efraim ne nsamu na Israel mbusuakuw na ne mfɛfo dze no; medze hɔn mebɛka Juda poma no ara ho, na mayɛ hɔn poma kor, na wɔayɛ kor wɔ me nsamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mpoma a ekyerɛkyerɛɛw do no, ma wɔnko wo nsamu wɔ hɔn enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na se hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, mebɛfa Israelmba efi amanaman a wɔakokɔ hɔ no mu, na maboaboa hɔn ano wɔ mbea nyina, na medze hɔn akɔ hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na mebɛyɛ hɔn ɔman kor wɔ asaase no mu, wɔ Israel mbepɔw no do: na ɔhen kor edzi hɔn nyina hɔn do hen: na wɔrennda ho nnyɛ aman ebien bio, eso wɔrennda ho mmpaa hɔn mu nyɛ nhenman ebien bio ara da:
title: EZEKIEL

text: eso wɔremmfa hɔn abosom, na hɔn atantandze, na hɔn mbrato mu biara nnda ho nngu hɔnho fi ara bio: na mebɛgye hɔn nkwa efi hɔn tsenabea a wɔayeyɛ hɔn bɔn no, na matsew hɔn ho: nna wɔbɛyɛ me man, na mo so mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na m’akowaa David bedzi hɔn do hen; na hɔn nyinara enya guanhwɛfo kor: wɔbɛnantsew m’atsɛmbudze mu so, na woedzi m’ahyɛdze do, na wɔayɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔbɛtsena asaase a medze maa m’akowaa Jakob a hom egyanom tsenaa do no do; na wɔbɛtsena do, hɔn, na hɔn mba, na hɔn mba so hɔn mba, afebɔɔ: na m’akowaa David bɛyɛ hɔn safohen afebɔɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nkyii so menye hɔn bedzi asomdwee ho ahyɛmu: ɔbɛyɛ domankoma ahyɛmu ama hɔn: na medze hɔn betsim, na mama wɔadɔr, na medze mo krɔnkrɔnbea mesi hɔn mu afebɔɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Me ntamadan so besi hɔn nkyɛn; na mebɛyɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn, na hɔn so wɔayɛ me man.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na amanaman bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE a metsew Israel ho, ber a mo krɔnkrɔn bea ebesi hɔn mu afebɔɔ no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: EZEKIEL

text: Onyimpa ba, fa w’enyi tsim Gog do, wɔ Magog asaase do, Mesek, na Tubal safohen no, na hyɛ nkɔm tsia no,
title: EZEKIEL

text: na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, Gog, Mesek, na Tubal safohen, menye wo enya:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na mebɛdandan wo, na medze nkwaba ewurawura w’adadaw mu, na meyi wo efir edzi, ɔnye wo dɔm nyinara, mpɔnkɔ na mpɔnkɔdofo, hɔn nyinara wɔhyehyɛ dadzentar twem asafo kɛse pa a wɔhyehyɛ kyɛm na dadzekyɛw, hɔn nyinara wɔdzedze mfona:
title: EZEKIEL

text: Persia, Kus, na Put ka hɔn ho: hɔn nyina wɔwɔ kyɛm na dadzekyɛw:
title: EZEKIEL

text: Gomer, na no dɔmtutuw no nyina: Togarma fi a ɔwɔ kwaamu afamu noho noho no na no dɔmtutuw no nyina: mekyerɛ aman pii ka wo ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Da wo ho do, ɛhɛɛ, mia, ɔwo na w’asafo asafo a wɔaboaboa ano ehyia wo nkyɛn nyinara, na yɛ weɔmfo ma hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nda pii ekyir no wɔbɛba abɛsera wo: mfe a odzi ekyir no mu no ebɛba asaase a wɔdze asan efi afona ano no mu, na wɔaboa ano efi aman pii mu, wɔ Israel mbepɔw do a wɔayeyɛ amamfo daa no mu: na woeyi efi aman mu, na wɔbɛtsena dwudwoodwo, hɔn nyinara.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ebɔfow sor, na aba dɛ ehum, ebɛyɛ dɛ nsuwusiw akata asaase no do, ɔwo, na wo dɔmtutuw nyinara, na aman pii a wɔkeka wo ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ɔbɛba dɛ da no mu no, nsɛm bi bɛba w’adwen mu, na ebɛhyehyɛ tsirmu nhyehyɛɛ bɔn bi:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na ase dɛ, Mobɔfow makɔ nkurow a afasu mmbɔ ho aprɔw no n’asaase no do; mubokotua hɔn a hɔn asomu adwe hɔn, wɔtse hɔ dwudwoodwo a hɔn nyinara wɔtsetse mbrɛ afasu nnyi, na wonnyi adaban na mbobotsen so no:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛ mebɛfa asadze na mafa afo; madan wo nsa wɔ amamfo a ndɛ wɔtsetse do no do, na ɔman a wɔaboaboa ano efi amanaman a woenyinya anyɛmbowa na ndzɛmba ndzɛmba a wɔtsetse asaase ne finimfin no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Seba, na Dedan, na Tarsis eguadzifo wɔnye hɔn ngyatafɔr nyinara, wɔbɛse wo dɛ, Aso asadze na aba rebɛfa, aso apon w’asafo dɔm rebɛfa afo, dɛ erobɔsoa dwetɛ na sika akɔ, erebɛfa anyɛmbowa na ndzɛmba ndzɛmba akɔ, rebɛfa asadze kɛse?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi, onyimpa ba, hyɛ nkɔm, na se Gog dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Aso da no a me man Israel bɛtsena ase dwudwoodwo no, ana innkohu?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ibefi wo tsenabea wɔ kwaamu afamu etsiwatsiwa mu no ho aba, ɔwo, na aman pii ka wo ho, hɔn nyinara wɔtsetse mpɔnkɔ do, asafo kɛse na dɔm akatakyi a:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na ɔwo Gog botu aba me man Israel do, dɛ nsuwusiw abɛkata asaase do; nda a odzi ekyir no mu no, ɔbɛba dɛ medze wo bɛba m’asaase do, ma amanaman ehu me, ber a mo krɔnkrɔnyɛ bɛda edzi wɔ wo mu wɔ hɔn enyiwa do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Aso ɔwo nye nyia no a mekaa no ho asɛm tsetsebaado, menam mo nkowaa Israel nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm nda no mu mfe pii dɛ medze wo bɛba hɔn do no?
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na da no mu no, ɔbɛba dɛ, ber a Gog botua Israel asaase no, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, m’ebufuhyew bɛdzɛw m’ahwentokura mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na me nyinkuntwe na m’ebufuw ne gya no mu na makasa dɛ, Ampaara nda no mu na ɔwosow kɛse bɛba Israel asaase do;
title: EZEKIEL

text: ma po mu nam, nnoma a wɔwɔ wimu, na hambowa, na aweaweambowa a wɔweawea asaase do nyinara, na adasamba a wɔwɔ asaase enyi nyinara hɔn ho bɔwosow wɔ m’enyim, na wobodwuruw mbepɔw egu famu, na mbotan kronkronn no bɔhwehwe ase, na fasu biara bɛka famu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛfrɛ afona aba no do ekitsa me mbepɔw nyina, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse: nyimpa biara n’afona botwa no nua.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze yardɔm na bɔgya menye no bedzi; na mobɔtɔ nsupramee, na sorbo akɛse, gya, na sɔɔfee megu ɔno, na no dɔmtutuw, na aman pii a wɔka no ho no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mubohuhor moho, na mayɛ mo ho krɔnkrɔn, na mama woehu me wɔ aman pii enyim, na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, hyɛ Gog do nkɔm, na se dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Hwɛ, Gog! Mesek, na Tubal safohen, menye wo enya:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na mebɛdandan wo, na megya wo akɔ, na mama etu efi kwaamu afamu etsiwatsiwa mu aba; na medze wo maba Israel mbepɔw do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: na mobɔbɔ w’egyen mefi wo nsa bankum mu, na mama w’egyen menaba efi wo nsa nyimfa mu atotɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔwoara ebɔtɔ wɔ Israel mbepɔw do, ɔwo, na wo dɔmtutuw nyinara, na aman a wɔka wo ho no: medze wo mebɛma nnoma edzinam ahorow nyina, na hambowa ma woedzi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Tɛtɛr mu na ebɔtɔ: na emi na maka, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mobɔsoma gya makɔ Magog, na hɔn a wɔtsetse esupruw mu dwudwoodwo no mu: na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mebɛma woehu me dzin krɔnkrɔn no wɔ me man Israel mu; eso meremma kwan ma woehura me dzin krɔnkrɔn no ho ara bio: na amanaman bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE, Israel mu Krɔnkrɔnnyi no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hwɛ, ɔreba, na wɔbɛyɛ, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse; iyi nye da a maka ho asɛm no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hɔn a wɔtsetse Israel nkurow mu no befir edzi, na wɔakɔtoto akodze no mu gya wɔahyew no, akyɛm na nkataenyim nyina, ngyen na ngyen menaba, na apɔtsibaa, na mpeaa, na wobokua no mfe esuon:
title: EZEKIEL

text: dɛm ntsi wɔnnkɛpɛ hamu nyena, eso wonnkotwa bi wɔ kwaa mu; na wobokua akodze no: na wɔbɛfa hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn afo no afo, na wɔafom hɔn a wɔfoom hɔn no EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na da no, ɔbɛba dɛ mebɛma Gog funsie bea wɔ Israel, wɔ akwantsemfo bɔnsa no po boka afamu: na obesiw akwantsemfo no kwan: na hɔ na wobesie Gog na ne nyimpadodow no nyinara: na wɔbɛfrɛ no Hamon gog bɔnsa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na abosoom esuon na Israel fifo dze besie hɔn, ama wɔaatsew asaase no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nyew, asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyinara besie hɔn; na da a wɔbɛhyɛ me enyimnyam no, ɔbɛyɛ atsenka ama hɔn, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wobeyiyi mbarimba a wɔbɛda ho ayɛ edwuma no esi nkyɛn a wobekyinkyin asaase no do woesie akwantsemfo a wɔaka wɔ asaase no enyi wɔdze atsew ho: abosoom esuon ekyir no, wɔbɔtwee ahwehwɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na akwantsemfo no botwa mu wɔ asaase no do; na sɛ biara hu nyimpa ne biew a, nna ɔahyɛ no egyina, ekodu dɛ esiefo no bɛba ebesie no Hamon-gog bɔnsa no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Hamona so bɛyɛ kurow bi ne dzin. Dɛm na wobesi atsew asaase no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔwo, onyimpa ba, mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Kasa kyerɛ nnoma horow nyina, na hambowa biara, dɛ, Hom mpon hom ho nhyia mbra; hom mboa hom ho ano mfi nkyɛnkyɛn nyina mbra mo kum afɔr a muruku mama hom no ho, mekyerɛ okum afɔr kɛse wɔ Israel mbepɔw do, ma hom edzi nam na wɔanom bɔgya.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom bedzi akatakyi nam, na wɔanom asaase do mbapɔmba bɔgyaa, nguannyin, nguambaa, na mpɔnkye, anantwinyin, hɔn nyinara Basan anyɛmbowa a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom bedzi angoa amee, na wɔanom bɔgya abow, wɔ mo kum afɔr a mekum mama hom no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mpɔnkɔ na ntseaseanam, ɔnye mbarimba akatakyi, na asambarimba nyinara bɛmee hom wɔ mo pon do, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na medze m’enyimnyam mibesi amanaman mu, na amanaman nyinara bohu m’atsɛmbudze a mayɛ, na me nsa a medze mato hɔn do no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ofitsi da no dze kɔ no Israel fifo bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na amanaman bohu dɛ Israel fifo kɔr ndɔmmum wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ ntsi; osiandɛ wɔfomee tsiaa me, na medze m’enyim huntsaa hɔn: nna medze hɔn mehyɛɛ hɔn ahohiahiafo nsa, na hɔn nyinara wɔtotɔr afona ano.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ hɔn ahoɔfi na mbrɛ hɔn mbrato tse no ara na medze meyɛɛ hɔn; na medze m’enyim huntsaa hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Afei na medze Jakob befi ndɔmmumkɔ mu asan aba, na mehu Israel fifo nyina mbɔbɔr; na matwe me dzin krɔnkrɔn no ho nyinkun.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔbɔsoa hɔn enyimguase, na hɔn mfom a wɔdze afom me no nyinara, ber a wɔbɛtsena hɔn asaase no do dwudwoodwo na obiara nnkeyi hɔn hu no;
title: EZEKIEL

text: ber a medze hɔn fi aman mu asan aba, na maboa hɔn ano efi hɔn atamfo nsaase do, na mo krɔnkrɔnyɛ ada edzi wɔ hɔn mu wɔ amanaman pii enyim no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wobohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn, wɔ dɛ memaa wɔkɔr ndɔmmum wɔ amanaman mu, na maboaboa hɔn ano akɔ hɔnankasa hɔn asaase do; na mirinngyaa hɔn mu biara bio wɔ hɔ ntsi;
title: EZEKIEL

text: eso meremmfa m’enyim nnhuntsa hɔn bio: osiandɛ mehue mo sunsum egu Israel fifo do, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hɛn ndɔmmumkɔ afe a otsia eduonu enum, afe no n’ahyɛse, bosoom ne dadu no, wɔbɔɔ kurow no ekyir afe a otsia duanan no, da no ara na EWURADZE ne nsa baa mo do, na ɔdze me baa hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nyankopɔn enyido adzehu mu na ɔdze me baa Israel asaase do, na ɔdze me besii bepɔw a ɔkrɔn papaara bi do a no do tse dɛ kurow bi a wɔakyekyer no pomu afamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔdze me baa hɔ, na hwɛ, barimba a no su tse dɛ boran no su wɔ hɔ a asaaba ahoma na susu ndzɛmbir kitsa ne nsamu; na ogyinaa abobokɛse no ano.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbarimba no see me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, fa w’enyiwa hwɛ, na fa w’asowa tsie, na fa w’akoma tsim dza medze rebɛkyerɛ wo yi nyinara do; na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ a medze mebɛkyerɛ wo ntsi na wɔdze wo aba ha yi: paa mu ka dza iruhu nyina kyerɛ Israel fifo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hwɛ, fasu wɔ fi no ho hyia, na barimba no ne nsamu dze ndzɛmbir susudze a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa ebiasa a nsatseama deda anamɔn kor na fa biara do: nna osusuu fasu no ne peperee, ndzɛmbir kor; na no krɔn, ndzɛmbir kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbaa abobokɛse no a odzi boka no ho, na ɔfoow no ntwerba no; na osusuu abobokɛse no ano, ne tɛtɛr ndzɛmbir kor: na n’ano kor so, ne tɛtɛr ndzɛmbir kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na aweɔmfopia biara ne tsentsen ndzɛmbir kor, na ne tɛtɛr ndzɛmbir kor; na mpia no ne ntamu kwan yɛ basafa ebien na fa, ebien na fa; na abobokɛse no no pon ano a ɔwɔ abobokɛse a odzi kɔ ofi no ho ne dampan nkyɛn no yɛ ndzɛmbir kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Osusuu abobokɛse a odzi kɔ ofi no ho so ne dampan, ndzɛmbir kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna osusuu abobokɛse no ne dampan, basafa awɔtwe; na no pondua basafa ebien; na abobokɛse no ne dampan a odzi kɔ fi no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na aweɔmfo mpia a odzi kɔ boka no, ebiasa dzi fa ha, na ebiasa dzi fa noho; ebiasa nyina hɔn nsusui kor: na mpondua no wɔ nsusui kor wɔ afa ha na ha.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na osusuu abobokɛse no ano ne tɛtɛr basafa enum; na abobokɛse no, ne tsentsen basafa esia na fa;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na mpia no enyim kwan, anamɔn kor na fa wɔ afa ha, na anamɔn kor na fa wɔ afa kor so; na mpia no basafa ebiasa wɔ afa ha, na basafa ebiasa wɔ afa kor so.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na osusuu abobokɛse no ofitsi aweɔmfopia kor no nkurii do kesi kor so no nkurii do, ne tɛtɛr basafa duebien na fa; abow na abow dzi abɔenyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔyɛɛ apondua no so, basafa du; na pondua no ho wɔ abangua a otwa abobokɛse no ho hyiahyia.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ofi abobokɛse n’ahɛnee enyim dze kesi dan mu abobokɛse ne dampan no enyim, yɛ basafa eduonu enum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ntokura a ɔfemfam ano wowɔ aweɔmfo mpia no na no pondua no ho dze kɛpem abobokɛse a ɔwɔ mu no ho dze twa ho hyiahyia, na mpia no aatse no so dɛmara: na ntokura deda no mu bɔ aprɔw: na mbɛdua wowɔ pondua biara ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔdze me baa guado afamu abangua mu, na, hwɛ, mpia wowɔ hɔ, ɔnye abonsɛwee a otwa abangua no ho hyiahyia: abonsɛwee no do wɔ mpia eduasa:
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na abonsɛwee no wɔ mbobokɛse no nkyɛnmu, na ɔnye mbobokɛse no ne tsentsen mu sɛ, mekyerɛ ase abonsɛwee no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna osusuu ne tɛtɛr ofitsi ase abobokɛse no enyim dze kesi fie afamu abangua no enyim wɔ guado, basafa eduonum, wɔ boka na kwaamu afamu nyina.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na guado afamu abangua a n’enyi dzi kwaamu afamu n’abobokɛse no, osusuu ne tsentsen na ne tɛtɛr.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na n’aweɔmfo mpia ebiasa dzi afa ha na ebiasa dzi afa kor so; na no mpondua na ne ntamu kwan no, no nsusui tse dɛ abobokɛse kan dze no: ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu enum, na ne tɛtɛr basafa duebien na fa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na no ntokura, na ne ntamu, na ne mbɛdua no, no nsusui tse dɛ abobokɛse a n’enyi dzi boka no nedze; na wɔnam ntwerba esuon do na wɔfow kɔ hɔ; na ne ntamu afasu no sisi enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na fie afamu abangua no ɔwɔ abobokɛse bi a osi abobokɛse kor no ne tsentsen do, wɔ kwaamu afamu na boka nyina; na osusui fitsi abobokɛse ano kesi abobokɛse ano, basafa eduonum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ogyaa me kɔr pomu afamu, na hwɛ, abobokɛse wɔ pomu afamu: na osusuu mpondua na n’aatse no dɛ mbrɛ nsusui yinom tse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ntokura twa ɔno nye ne ntamu kwan no ho hyiahyia, dɛ mbrɛ ntokura no tse: ne tsentsen basafa eduonu enum, ne tɛtɛr basafa duebien na fa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ntwerba esuon na wɔnam do kɔ mu, na n’aatse no sisi enyim: na mbɛdua wowɔ n’apondua no ha na ha.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na fie afamu abangua no wɔ abobokɛse a odzi kɔ pomu afamu: na osusui fir abobokɛse ano kesi abobokɛse ano wɔ pomu afamu, basafa eduonum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔdze me faa pomu afamu abobokɛse no mu kɔr fie afamu abangua no do: na osusuu pomu afamu abobokɛse no dɛ mbrɛ nsusui yinom tse;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na n’aweɔmfo mpia, n’apondua, na n’aatse no dɛ mbrɛ nsusui yinom tse: na ntokura wowɔ ɔno nye n’aatse no ho hyiahyia: na ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu enum, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa duebien na fa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na aatse bɔ ho aprɔw, ne tsentsen basafa duebien na fa, na ne tɛtɛr basafa ebien na fa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na n’aatse no dzi kɔ guado afamu abangua no do; na mbɛdua wowɔ n’apondua ho: na ntwerba awɔtwe wɔ hɔ a wɔdze fow.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔdze me baa fie afamu abangua no do wɔ boka afamu: na osusuu abobokɛse no dɛ mbrɛ nsusui yinom tse;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na n’aweɔmfo mpia no, na n’apondua no, na ne ntamu kwan no, dɛ mbrɛ nsusui yinom tse: na ntokura wowɔ ɔno ɔnye n’aatse no ho hyiahyia: ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu enum na fa, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa duebien na fa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na n’aatse no dzi kɔ guado afamu abangua no ho; na mbɛdua wowɔ n’apondua no ho afa ha na ha: na ntwerba awɔtwe wɔ ho a wɔdze fow.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔdze me baa kwaamu afamu abobokɛse no ano: na osusuu dɛ mbrɛ nsusui yinom tse;
title: EZEKIEL

text: n’aweɔmfo mpia, n’apondua na n’aatse no; na ntokura wowɔ ho bɔ ho aprɔw hyia: ne tsentsen basafa eduonu enum na fa, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa duebien na fa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na n’apondua no dzi kɔ guado afamu abangua no do; na mbɛdua wowɔ apondua no ho afa ha na ha: na ntwerba awɔtwe wɔ ho a wɔdze fow.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na pia na n’ano abow wɔ mbobokɛse no n’apondua no ho; hɔ na wɔhohoor ɔhyew afɔr no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na abobokɛse no ne dampan no mu edzidzipon ebien sisi afa ha, na edzidzipon ebien sisi afa kor so a woku ɔhyew afɔr, na bɔn ho afɔr, na asodzi afɔr wɔ do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ne nkyɛnmu no guado mbrɛ wɔdze fow kɔ abobokɛse no ano wɔ kwaamu afamu no edzidzipon ebien sisi hɔ; na ne nkyɛnmu no afa so a odzi kɔ abobokɛse no ne dampan ho no, edzidzipon ebien sisi hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Edzidzipon anan wɔ afa, na edzidzipon anan wɔ afa so, wɔ abobokɛse no ne nkyɛnmu; edzidzipon awɔtwe do na wokunkum mbowa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hyew afɔr edzidzipon anan sisi hɔ a ɔyɛ ɔbo a wɔasen, ne tsentsen yɛ anamɔn ebien na fa, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ anamɔn ebien na fa, na no krɔn yɛ anamɔn kor na fa; no do na wɔdze ndadze a wɔdze kunkum ɔhyew afɔr na okum afɔr no gugui.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na nkɔtɔkorba a ne tsentsen nsatseama hyehyɛ dan no mu bɔ aprɔw: na edzidzipon no no do na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze nam no gu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na abobokɛse a ɔwɔ mu no ekyir na mpiaba wowɔe ma adwontofo a wɔwɔ fie afamu abangua no a ɔwɔ kwaamu afamu abobokɛse ne nkyɛnmu no do; na enyim dzi pomu afamu: kor wɔ boka afamu abobokɛse no ne nkyɛnmu a n’enyim dzi kwaamu afamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Pia a n’enyim dzi pomu afamu yi, asɔfo no a wɔyɛ ofi no do ahwɛfo no dze a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na pia a n’enyim dzi kwaamu afamu no, asɔfo a wɔyɛ afɔrmbukyia no do ahwɛfo no dze a: woyinom nye Zadok ne mba a wofi Levimba no mu a wɔbɛn EWURADZE bɔsom no no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na osusuu abangua no, ne tsentsen basafa eduonum, na ne tɛtɛr basafa eduonum, ɔda etwaanan; na afɔrmbukyia no si ofi no enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔdze me baa ofi no ne dampan no ho, na osusuu dampan no n’apondua nyina, basafa ebien na fa wɔ afa ha, na basafa ebien na fa wɔ afa kor so: na abobokɛse no ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebiasa wɔ afa ha, na basafa kor na fa so wɔ afa kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dampan no ne tsentsen yɛ basafa du, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa enum na fa; wɔ ntwerba a wɔfow dze kɔ mu no do: na edum sisi apondua no nkyɛn, kor si afa na kor so si afa kor so.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔdze me baa asɔrdan no mu, na osusuu apondua ne tɛtɛr basafa ebiasa wɔ afa ha, na ne tɛtɛr basafa ebiasa wɔ afa kor so, mbrɛ ntamadan no ne tɛtɛr tse nye no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na n’ano kwan ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa enum; na ne nkyɛnkyɛn yɛ basafa ebien na fa wɔ afa kor, na basafa ebien na fa wɔ afa kor so: na osusuu ne tsentsen, basafa eduonu, na ne tɛtɛr, basafa du.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔkɔr mu, kosusuu abow no n’ano dum biara, basafa kor: na abow no, basafa ebiasa; na abow no ne tɛtɛr, basafa ebiasa na fa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na osusuu ne tsentsen, basafa du, na ne tɛtɛr, basafa du, wɔ asɔrdan no n’enyim, na ɔsee me dɛ, Ha nye krɔnkrɔn mu krɔnkrɔn bea no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna osusuu dan no ne fasu, basafa ebiasa; na nkyɛnkyɛn pia biara so, ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebien, dze twa ɔdan no ho nyina hyiahyia.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na nkyɛnkyɛn mpia no asansa a, pia si pia do akyerɛpɛn eduasa; na wɔkɔr fasu a ɔwɔ dan no ho no ma nkyɛnkyɛn mpia no twa ho hyia no mu, ama woeesusuo mu, naaso na ɔnndzedze dan no nankasa n’afasu no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ber a nkyɛnkyɛn mpia no rokɔ sor hyia no, nna n’ano retrɛ; na dan no no ho mpia no kɔ sor ara bɔ dan no ho aprɔw hyia: dɛm ntsi no mu trɛ wɔ dan no no ho wɔ sor: ne dɛm no fi ase dze no mu dua finimfin dze no mu kɔ sor dze no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na muhunii so dɛ dan no wɔ bamba a ɔbɔ ho aprɔw: ne nkyɛnmu mpia no ne ngyinado no odu ndzɛmbir mu a ɔyɛ basafa ebiasa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nkyɛnmu mpia no ekyir fasu no, ne peperee yɛ basafa ebien na fa: na dza wogyae no nye nkyɛnmu mpia a ɔwɔ mu no n’ananmu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mpia no ntamu ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa du dze bɔ dan no ho aprɔw dze hyia twem.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na nkyɛnkyɛn mpia no no mbobow no dzi kɔ mbrɛ wogyae no do, abow kor dzi kɔ kwaamu afamu, abow kor dzi kɔ pomu afamu: na ɔkwan a wogyae no ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebien na fa twa ho hyia.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na dan a osi mfikyir wɔ anee afamu no ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa eduasa enum: na dan no n’afasu ne peperee yɛ basafa ebien na fa dze bɔ ho aprɔw, na ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduanan enum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna osusuu dan no, ne tsentsen basafa eduonum; na dza osi nkyɛnmu no, na ɔdan no n’afasu no, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonum;
title: EZEKIEL

text: eso dan no n’enyim ne tɛtɛr, na dza osi nkyɛnmu no wɔ boka afamu, basafa eduonum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na osusuu dan no ne tsentsen mu wɔ dza osi nkyɛnmu wɔ n’ekyir no enyim, na n’abrandaa a ɔwɔ afa no, basafa eduonum, na asɔrdan a ɔwɔ mu no, na abangua ne dampan no;
title: EZEKIEL

text: mbobow ano, na ntokura a ɔfemfam ano, na mbrandaa a abɔ ebiasa no ho aprɔw, wɔ abowano ne tsentsendo, wɔdze ndua asam enyi ehyia, na ofi famu ɔkɛka ntokura no ho; na ntokura no wɔakatakata ho;
title: EZEKIEL

text: dze kodu kwan a ɔda abow no etsifi, mekyerɛ dan a ɔwɔ mu no a, na n’ekyir, na fasu no no mu na n’ekyir afamu nyina wɔ no nsusui.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔdze kerubfo na mbɛdua yeyɛe; na abɛdua wɔ kerub na kerub ntamu, na kerub biara wɔ enyim ebien;
title: EZEKIEL

text: ma tserɛ nyimpa enyim dzi abɛdua no do wɔ afa kor, na gyatafɔr enyim dzi abɛdua no n’afa kor so: dɛm na wosii yɛɛ no dan no mu nyina hyiae.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ofi famu kɛka abow no etsifi wɔyeyɛɛ kerubfo na mbɛdua: mbrɛ asɔrfi no n’afasu tse nye no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔyɛ asɔrdan no dze, n’apondua no yɛ etwaanan; na krɔnkrɔn bea no n’enyim dze, no nhwɛbea tse dɛ asɔrdan no nhwɛbea.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afɔrmbukyia no dua dze a, no krɔn basafa kor na fa, na ne tsentsen basafa kor; na n’eduodoo mu, na ne tsentsen, na n’afasu, dua dze a: na ɔsee me dɛ, Iyi nye pon a osi EWURADZE enyim.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na asɔrdan no na krɔnkrɔn bea no wowɔ mbobow ebien.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbobow no yɛ ntanta, ntaabow a ogu mu ebien ebien; ntaabow ebien yɛ kor dze, na ntaabow ebien yɛ kor so dze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔyɛɛ kerubfo na mbɛdua wɔ asɔrdan no no mbobow no do, dɛ mbrɛ wɔyɛe wɔ afasu no ho no; na dua mpuna deda dampan no enyim wɔ gua do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ntokura a ɔfemfam ano na mbɛdua wɔ afa ha na ha, wɔ adampan no ne nkyɛnmu: mbrɛ dan no ne nkyɛnkyɛn mpia, na mpuna durdur no tsetsee nye no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔdze me puei faa kwaamu afamu kwan no do kɔr guado afamu abangua no do: na ɔdze me baa pia a ɔwɔ nkyɛnmu no ne tsentsendo, na ɔwɔ dan no a odzi kɔ kwaamu afamu ne tsentsendo no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Basafa ɔha no ne tsentsen enyim na kwaamu afamu abow no da, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa eduonum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Fie afamu abangua no ne basafa du tsentsendo, na guado afamu abangua no n’abosɛwee no tsentsendo, nna abrandaa dzi abɔenyim wɔ asansa no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mpia no enyim wɔ kwan a ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa enum wɔ fie afamu a ɔyɛ basafa eduonum kwan; na hɔn mbobow no dzi kwaamu afamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sor mpia no yɛ ntsiantsia: osiandɛ mbrandaa no gyee mu bi, ma ɔnntrɛ dɛ dan no n’ase na finimfin dze no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔyɛ asansa, na onnyi edum dɛ abangua no n’edum: dɛm ntsi sor dze no muae seen ase dze no na finimfin dze no ofitsi famu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na aboban a ɔwɔ fie ekyir mpia no nkyɛnmu, mbrɛ odzi kɔ mpia no enyim guado abangua no ho no, ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu enum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mpia a ɔwɔ guado afamu abangua no mu no ne tsentsen yɛ basafa eduonu enum: na, hwɛ, asɔrdan no enyim dze ɔyɛ basafa eduonum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔkwan da mpia yinom ase wɔ boka afamu a obi dze fi guado afamu abangua no do kɔ mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Abangua a odzi kɔ boka afamu no ne fasu peperee no mu, wɔ dza osi nkyɛnmu enyim, na dan no enyim no, mpia wowɔ hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na kwan a ɔda hɔn enyim no tse dɛ mpia a odzi kɔ kwaamu afamu no kwan no no hwɛbea; mbrɛ ne tsentsen tse no, dɛmara so na ne tɛtɛr tse: na ne mfiredzi nyina tse dɛ mbrɛ no ho nsiesiei, na mbobow tsetsee.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ mpia a odzi kɔ pomu afamu no mbobow tse no, dɛmara so na kwan no ne tsir abow no tse, kwan a, sɛ obi reba mu a, ɔda no boka afamu fasu no enyim pɛpɛɛpɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Kwaamu afamu mpia no na pomu afamu mpia no a wɔwowɔ nkyɛnkyɛn bea no enyim no, hɔn nye mpia krɔnkrɔn a asɔfo a wɔbɛn EWURADZE no wobedzi akrɔnkrɔndze mu akrɔnkrɔndze no wɔ hɔ: hɔara so na wɔdze akrɔnkrɔndze mu akrɔnkrɔndze, na edziban afɔr, na bɔn ho afɔr, na afɔdzi afɔr no bogugu; na bea no yɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Sɛ asɔfo no hɛn mu a, ɔno mma wommfi krɔnkrɔn bea hɔ nkɔ guado abangua no do, na mbom hɔara na wɔmfa hɔn ntar a wɔdze som no ngu; osiandɛ hɔnho tsew na wɔnhyehyɛ ntar fofor ansaana wɔabɛn dza ɔyɛ man no dze no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na onyae wiee dan a ɔwɔ mu no susu no, ɔdze me fiir edzi faa abobokɛse a ɔhwɛ boka afamu no do, na osusui twaa ho hyiae.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔdze susu ndzɛmbir susuu boka afamu, basafa ahaebien nye eduonum, ɔdze susui twae hyiae.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔdze susu ndzɛmbir susuu kwaamu afamu basafa ahaebien nye eduonum twae hyiae.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔdze susu ndzɛmbir susuu pomu afamu basafa ahaebien nye eduonum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔdanee kɔr anee afamu, na ɔdze susu ndzɛmbir susuu basafa ahaebien nye eduonum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Osusuu no wɔ afa anan no: fasu bɔ ho aprɔw, ne tsentsen basafa ahaebien nye eduonum, na ne tɛtɛr basafa ahaebien nye eduonum, dze apaa dza ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔnbea na dza ɔyɛ kwasafodze no ntamu.

title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔdze susu ndzɛmbir susuu kwaamu afamu basafa ahaebien nye eduonum twae hyiae.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔdze susu ndzɛmbir susuu pomu afamu basafa ahaebien nye eduonum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔdanee kɔr anee afamu, na ɔdze susu ndzɛmbir susuu basafa ahaebien nye eduonum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Osusuu no wɔ afa anan no: fasu bɔ ho aprɔw, ne tsentsen basafa ahaebien nye eduonum, na ne tɛtɛr basafa ahaebien nye eduonum, dze apaa dza ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔnbea na dza ɔyɛ kwasafodze no ntamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔdze me faa krɔnkrɔn bea abobokɛse no a ɔhwɛ boka afamu no sanee bae; na wɔtoow mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Abobokɛse yi wɔbɔtow mu ara, worummbue, eso nyimpa biara rennhɛn mu nnkɔ mu, na EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na ɔahɛn mu akɔ mu; dɛm ntsi wɔbɔtow mu ara.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na bapɔmba no dze, ɔbɛtsena mu dɛ bapɔmba oedzidzi wɔ EWURADZE enyim; ɔnam abobokɛse no ne dampan kwan do bɛba mu na kwan kor noara mu na ɔnam befir edzi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔdze me faa kwaamu afamu abobokɛse no kwan no do baa dan no enyim; na mohwɛe, na hwɛ, EWURADZE n’enyimnyam ahyɛ EWURADZE ne fi no ma: na medze m’enyim butuuw famu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, hyɛ no nsew yie, na fa w’enyiwa hwɛ, na fa w’asowa tsie dza mereka akyerɛ wo wɔ EWURADZE fi ho ahyɛdze no nyina, na no ho mbra no nyina; na hyɛ fi no ne nhɛnmu ɔnye krɔnkrɔnbea no n’edzifir nyina nsew yie.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na se etuatsewfo no, Israel fifo no dɛ, Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ao hom Israel fifo, hom mma hom atantandze ndɔɔ so mma hom,
title: EZEKIEL

text: wɔ dɛ hom dze ananaben, akoma na honam mu monomonomfo aba dɛ wɔmbɛtsena mo krɔnkrɔnbea mu, wombohura ho, mekyerɛ me dan no, ber a hom dze m’edziban, angoa na bɔgya ma, na wɔato m’ahyɛmu dze aka hom atantandze nyinara ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom annhwɛ m’akrɔnkrɔndze ahwɛdodze no do: na mbom hom esisi mo krɔnkrɔnbea no mu ahwɛdodze no do ahwɛdofo amema hom ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Ɔnanaben biara a ɔyɛ akoma na honam mu monomonomnyi no, ɔrennhɛn mo krɔnkrɔnbea no mu, wɔ ɔnana biara a ɔwɔ Israelmba mu no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Levifo a wofii me nkyɛn kɔr ekyirekyir ber a Israel bɔɔ ko fii me nkyɛn, wɔbɔɔ ko fii me nkyɛn kedzii hɔn abosom ekyir no; hɔnara wɔbɔsoa hɔn emumuyɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso wɔbɛyɛ mo krɔnkrɔnbea mu asomfo a wɔhwɛ fi no no mbobotsen ano, na wɔsom wɔ fi no mu: hɔn na wɔbɔbɔ hyew afɔr na kum afɔr ama man no, na wobegyina hɔn enyim wɔasom hɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Osiandɛ wɔsoom hɔn wɔ hɔn abosom enyim, na wɔbɛyɛɛ emumuyɛ fintsidua maa Israel fifo ntsi; mama me nsa do wɔ hɔn do, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse, na wɔbɔsoa hɔn emumuyɛ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔronntwe mmbɛn me mmbɛyɛ asɔfo dwuma mma me, eso wɔremmbɛn m’akrɔnkrɔndze mu biara, n’akrɔnkrɔndze mu akrɔnkrɔndze no a: na mbom wɔbɔsoa hɔn enyimguase, na hɔn atantandze a wɔayeyɛ no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Naaso mebɛyɛ hɔn fi no n’ahwɛdodze no do ahwɛfo, wɔ no mu som nyina, na dza wɔyɛ wɔ mu nyina ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na asɔfo Levifo, Zadokmba no a wɔhwɛɛ mo krɔnkrɔnbea ahwɛdze no, ber a Israelmba bɔɔ ko fii me nkyɛn no, hɔnara na wɔbɛbɛn me abɔsom me; na wobegyina m’enyim wɔdze angoa na bɔgya abɔ afɔr ama me, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔbɛhɛn mo krɔnkrɔnbea hɔ, na woepinkyɛn m’edzidzipon ho wɔabɔsom me, na wɔayɛ m’ahwɛdodze no do ahwɛfo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ sɛ wɔrehɛn fie afamu abangua no no mbobokɛse no mu a, wɔnhyehyɛ ndwera ntar; na mma kuntu-tam biara nnka hɔn ho, ber a wɔrosom wɔ fie afamu abangua no no mbobokɛse no mu, na fi no mu no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wɔmfa ndwera abɔtsir mbobɔ hɔn etsir, na ndwera nsiasen nsisi hɔn asen; mma wɔmmfa biribiara a ɔma mfifir mmbɔ hɔn ho do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ worifir edzi wɔakɔ guado afamu abangua no do wɔ man no nkyɛn a, wonyiyi hɔn ntar a wɔhyɛe somee no, na wɔmfa ngu mpia krɔnkrɔn no mu, na wɔmfa ntar fofor nhyɛ, amma wɔaammfa hɔn ntar no annkɛtsew man no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Eso mma wonnyiyi hɔn tsir, anaa wonnsie tsimum; susua ara na wonsusua hɔn tsir.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Eso mma sɔfo biara nnom nsa, ber a ɔrehɛn fie afamu abangua no do no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Eso mma wɔnnwar kunafo, anaa nyia wɔako no awar: na mbom wɔmfa Israel fi asefo mu mbaabun, anaa kunafo a ɔyɛ sɔfo bi no kunafo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ me man sorbi a ɔda krɔnkrɔndze na kwasafodze ntamu, na wɔmma wonhu dza no ho tsew na dza no ho nntsew.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mansotwe mu so hɔnara na wongyina mbu atsɛn: dɛ mbrɛ m’atsɛmbu tse na wombu atsɛn: na wonsie me mbra na m’ahyɛdze wɔ me fa a wɔhyɛ nyinara mu; na wɔnyɛ n’ahomgyenda no krɔnkrɔn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mma wɔnnkɔ fun bi ho nnkogu hɔnho fi: gyedɛ egya, anaa na, anaa babanyin, anaa babaa anaa nuabanyin, anaa akyerɛbaa a onnyae nnyaa kun, na wɔwɔ ho kwan dɛ wogu hɔnho fi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wɔtsew no ho wie a, wɔnkan ndaesuon mma no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na da a ɔrokɔ krɔnkrɔnbea fie afamu abangua no do akɔsom wɔ krɔnkrɔnbea hɔ no, ɔbɔ no bɔn ho afɔr, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na wobenya egyapadze; emi nye hɔn egyapadze: na mma hom mma hɔn kyɛfa wɔ Israel; emi nye hɔn kyɛfa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Wondzi edziban afɔr, na bɔn ho afɔr, na afɔdzi afɔr; na dza woehyira do ama wɔ Israel biara nyɛ hɔndze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na adze biara mu nduadzewakan nyinara mu dza odzi kan no, na adze biara mu ayɛyɛdze nyinara ho ayɛyɛdze biara, nyɛ asɔfo no dze: hom mfa hom mbɔr a odzi kan no so mma sɔfo no, ma ɔaama nhyira aba wo fi do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mma asɔfo no nndzi dza noara oewu, anaaso wɔatsetsew no mu biara, sɛ anoma o, abowa o.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nkyii so sɛ hom rotwe asaase no ho tonto akyɛ egyapadze a, hom nyi do ayɛyɛdze mma EWURADZE, dɛ asaase no mu kyɛfa krɔnkrɔn: ne tsentsen nyɛ ndzɛmbir ne tsentsen basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum, na ne tɛtɛr nyɛ mpemdu: ɔnyɛ krɔnkrɔn wɔ n’ahe do nyinara nhyiahyia.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Susu iyi mu dza ne tsentsen yɛ basafa ahaebien eduonum na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ahaebien eduonum a ɔda etwaanan hyia ma krɔnkrɔnbea no; na basafa eduonu enum nyɛ ne mfikyir asaase ntwa ho nhyia.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na nsusui yi ara mu na susu dza ne tsentsen yɛ basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ mpemdu: na iyi mu na krɔnkrɔnbea no, akrɔnkrɔndze mu akrɔnkrɔndze no nsi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Asaase no mu akrɔnkrɔndze nye no, ɔnyɛ asɔfo no dze, krɔnkrɔnbea asomfo a wɔtwe bɛn bɔsom EWURADZE; na ɔnyɛ hɔn adan sisibea, na bea krɔnkrɔn mma krɔnkrɔnbea no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na dza ne tsentsen yɛ basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa mpemenum no ɔnyɛ Levifo a wɔyɛ fi no mu asomfo no dze, ɔnyɛ hɔnankasa hɔn kyɛfa, mpia eduonu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom nyi kurow no ne kyɛfa a ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa mpem ebien nye ahaenum, na ne tsentsen yɛ basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum wɔ krɔnkrɔnbea ayɛyɛdze no ne nkyɛn: na ɔnyɛ Israel fifo no nyinara dze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na bapɔmba no n’afamudze biara ɔda ayɛyɛdze krɔnkrɔn na kurow no ne kyɛfa ha na ha, wɔ ayɛyɛdze krɔnkrɔn no enyim, na kurow no ne kyɛfa enyim, wɔ anee afamu dze rokɔ anee, na boka afamu dze rokɔ boka: na ne tsentsen ɔnye kyɛfa no mu kor nsɛ, mfi anee he do nkɔ boka he do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Asaase no do ɔnyɛ ne kyɛfa wɔ Israel mu: na mma me mbapɔmba nnda ho nnhyɛ me man do bio; na mbom wɔmfa asaase no mma Israel fifo dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mbusuakuw tsetsee.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Israel mbapɔmba, hom mma ɔndɔɔ hom so: hom nyi emimdzi na nhyɛdo, na hom nyɛ atsɛmbudze na pɛrpɛr; hom ngyaa me man epoobɔ, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hom nya nsɛn tsenn, na efa tsenn, na bat tsenn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Esusudze efa na bat nsusui nyɛ kor, na bat no nyɛ esusudze homer nkyɛmu du mu kor, na efa no nyɛ homer nkyɛmu du mu kor: no nsusui nyɛ dɛ homer dze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na dwetɛbona nyɛ gera eduonu: hom mina nyɛ dwetɛbona eduonu, dwetɛbona eduonu enum, dwetɛbona duenum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Iyi nye ayɛyɛdze a hom mfa mma; ewifua homer mu efa nkyɛmu esia mu kor, na hom mfa atoko homer mu efa nkyɛmu esia mu kor mma:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na ngo ho nhyehyɛɛ no dze, ngo bat no, bat nkyɛmu du mu kor na hom mfa mfi susukora a ɔyɛ homer a odzi bat du no mu ma; na bat du ɔyɛ homer kor:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na eguambaa kor mfi nguankuw no mu, nguan ahaenu a wɔwɔ Israel dzidzibea a ɔyɛ fɔɔfɔɔ no mu; ma ɔnyɛ edziban afɔr na hyew afɔr, na asomdwee afɔr, mfa mpata mma hɔn, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Asaase no do nkorɔfo nyinara mfa ayɛyɛdze yi mma Israel mu bapɔmba.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na bapɔmba no n’afamu dze nye dɛ ɔma hyew afɔr na edziban afɔr, na ɔnom afɔr, wɔ afahyɛ no mu, na abosoom fofor no mu, na ahomgyenda no mu, wɔ Israel fifo afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ nyinara mu: ɔno na onsiesie bɔn ho afɔr no, na edziban afɔr no, na hyew afɔr no na asomdwee afɔr no wɔdze ayɛ mpata ama Israel fifo.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Bosoom a odzi kan no mu no, bosoom no ne da a odzi kan no mu no, fa nantwifɔr a onndzii dzɛm; na tsew krɔnkrɔnbea no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɔfo no mfa bɔn ho afɔr no bɔgyaa no bi, na ɔmfa ngugu fi no n’apondua no, na afɔrmbukyia no ne bamba aduodoo anan no na fie afamu abangua no n’abobokɛse apondua no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na dɛmara na hom nyɛ no bosoom no ne da a otsia esuon no mma biara a ɔfom, na nyia ɔyɛ kotobonyi no: dɛm na hom mfa nyɛ mpata mma fi no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na bosoom a odzi kan no, ne da a otsia duanan no, hom ndzi apaho no, ndaesuon afahyɛ no; epitsi na wondzi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na da no mu no bapɔmba no mfa nantwinyin nsiesie nankasa na asaase no do nkorɔfo nyinara tsir do bɔn ho afɔr.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na afahyɛ no ne ndaesuon no, onsiesie hyew afɔr mma EWURADZE, anantwinyin esuon na nguannyin esuon a wonndzii dzɛm daa daa ndaesuon; na bɔn ho afɔr so apɔnkyenyin daa daa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na onsiesie edziban afɔr so, nantwinyin kor dze efah kor na dwanyin kor dze efa kor, na ngo hin kor nka efa kor ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Bosoom a otsia esuon no mu, bosoom ne da a otsia duenum no mu, afahyɛ no mu, ɔnyɛ dɛmara ndaesuon: dɛ mbrɛ bɔn ho afɔr no tse, dɛ mbrɛ hyew afɔr no tse, na dɛ mbrɛ edziban afɔr no tse, na dɛ mbrɛ ngo no tse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Fie afamu abangua no n’abobokɛse no a ɔhwɛ boka afamu no wɔntow mu araa dwumadzi ndaesia; na ahomgyeda no dze, wombue, na bosoom fofor ne da no so wombue.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na bapɔmba no ndua guado afamu abobokɛse no ne dampan kwan no mu nhɛn mu mbegyina abobokɛse no no pondua no ano, na sɔfo no nsiesie ne hyew afɔr no na n’asomdwee afɔr no na ɔnsom wɔ abobokɛse no n’ahɛnee; na omfir edzi: na mma wɔnntow abobokɛse no mu araa ma onkodu ewimbir.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na asaase no do nkorɔfo no wɔnkotow abobokɛse n’abow no ano nsɔr wɔ EWURADZE enyim wɔ ahomgyenda na abosoom fofor no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hyew afɔr a bapɔmba no bɔbɔ ama EWURADZE no ɔnyɛ wɔ ahomgyeda no mu, nguambaa a wonndzii dzɛm esia na dwanyin a onndzii dzɛm;
title: EZEKIEL

text: na edziban afɔr dwanyin no dze, ɔnyɛ efa kor, na nguambaa no ho edziban afɔr no dze, dɛ mbrɛ noara obotum, na ngo hin kor ka efa kor ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na bosoom fofor ne da no mu no, ɔnyɛ nantwifɔr a onndzii dzɛm; na nguambaa esia na dwanyin kor a wonndzii dzɛm:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na onsiesie edziban afɔr no, nantwinyin no no ho dze, efa kor, na dwanyin no no ho dze, efa kor, na nguambaa no no ho dze, dɛ mbrɛ noara obotum, na ngo hin kor ka efa kor ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ bapɔmba no ɔrehɛn mu a, ondua abobokɛse no ne dampan kwan no mu, na ondua mu hɔ ara so mfir edzi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ asaase no do nkorɔfo no reba EWURADZE enyim wɔ afahyɛ a wɔahyehyɛ ato hɔ no mu a, nyia odua kwaamu afamu abobokɛse no no kwan no mu hɛn mu bɔkotow sɔr no, ondua pomu afamu kwan no mu mfir edzi; na nyia odua pomu afamu abobokɛse no kwan no mu hɛn mu no, ondua kwaamu afamu abobokɛse no kwan no mu mfir edzi: mma onndua abobokɛse no kwan a ɔnam mu baa mu no ara mu nnsan, na mbom ondua n’enyim tsenn mfir edzi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na bapɔmba no, sɛ wɔrokɔ mu a, ondzi hɔn finimfin nye bɔn nkɔ mu; na sɛ worifir edzi a, wɔmbɔ mu kor mfir edzi.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na afahyɛ no na ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn no mu no, edziban afɔr no nyɛ nantwinyin ho efa kor, dwanyin ho efa kor, na nguambaa no ho dze, dɛ mbrɛ obotum ma, na ngo hin kor ka efa kor ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ bapɔmba no dze ɔpɛ afɔr, hyew afɔr anaa asomdwee afɔr, dɛ ɔpɛ afɔr ma EWURADZE a, obi mbue abobokɛse a ɔhwɛ boka afamu no mma no, na onsiesie ne hyew afɔr na n’asomdwee afɔr dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛ no ahomgyeda no ara; na ompue; na sɛ opue a, obi ntow abobokɛse no mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na eguambaa a oedzi afe kor a onndzii dzɛm na fa siesie hyew afɔr ma EWURADZE daa daa: anapa anapa na siesie.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na siesie edziban afɔr ka ho anapa anapa, esusudze efa nkyɛmu esia mu kor, na ngo hin nkyɛmu ebiasa mu kor mfa mfɔw isiam pa no; ɔmmfa daa ahyɛdze no do nyɛ EWURADZE edziban afɔr afebɔɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm na wonsiesie eguambaa no, na edziban afɔr, na ngo no, anapa anapa, nyɛ daa hyew afɔr.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Sɛ bapɔmba no yɛ ne mba mu bi ayɛ a, ɔyɛ n’egyapadze, ɔnyɛ ne mba dze; hɔn egyapadze mu kyɛfa nye no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na sɛ ɔdze n’egyapadze bi yɛ no nkowaa no mu bi ayɛ a, ɔnyɛ nedze araa nkodu fahodzi afe no; na nkyii ɔnsan nkɛyɛ bapɔmba no dze bio; na n’egyapadze no dze, ɔnyɛ ne mba no dze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nkyii so mma bapɔmba no mfa ɔmamfo no hɔn egyapadze no bi, onntu hɔn mmfi hɔn kyɛfa do; narankasa ne kyɛfa no na ɔmfa mu bi mma ne mba: amma me man mu nyimpa biara wɔaammpansam no emmfi ne kyɛfa do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔdze me nam kwan a ɔda abobokɛse nkyɛnmu no do baa asɔfo mpia krɔnkrɔn no a ɔhwɛ kwaamu afamu no mu: na hwɛ, bea bi wɔ anee afamu ekyir no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Ha nye bea a asɔfo no nnoa afɔdzi ho afɔr, na bɔn ho afɔr no, na wɔnto edziban afɔr no wɔ hɔ; amma wɔaammfa hɔn emmfir edzi annkɔ guado afamu abangua no do, annkɛtsew ɔman no ho.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔdze me fiir edzi baa guado afamu abangua no do, na ɔmaa mutwaa mu wɔ abangua no n’aduodoo anan no ho; na hwɛ, abangua no no duodoo biara wowɔ abangua.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Abangua no no n’aduodoo anan no mu, abangua hyehyɛ mu hɔ, ne tsentsen basafa eduonu na ne tɛtɛr duenum: aduodoo no mu abangua anan yinom nyina hɔn nsusui kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na bamba bi bɔ anan no ho aprɔw hyia twem, na wɔayeyɛ mbukyia wɔ mbamba no ase dze bɔ aprɔw hyia.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Iyinom nye edzibannoa adan a ofi no mu asomfo no nnoa ɔman no hɔn kum afɔr no wɔ hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔdze me sanee baa fi no n’abowano; na hwɛ, esu repem fi dan no n’apondua no ase rokɔ boka afamu, na dan no n’enyim dzi boka afamu: na esu no fi dan no enyimfa no ase wɔ pomu afamu afɔrmbukyia no ne nkyɛnmu risian.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔdze me fiir kwaamu afamu abobokɛse no no kwan do fiir edzi, na ɔdze me ponee besii guado abobokɛse no a n’enyi dzi boka afamu no; na hwɛ, esu fi nyimfa kwan no do repem.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na barimba no a ɔdze esusuhoma wɔ ne nsamu fiir edzi kɔr boka afamu no, osusuu basafa ahaenum, na ɔmaa mutwaa esu no, esu a ɔka m’anandwe no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na osusuu ahaenum so, na ɔmaa mutwaa esu no, esu a ɔka m’anankoroma. Osusuu ahaenum so bio, na ɔmaa mutwaa esu no, esu a ɔka m’asen no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: N’ekyir no, osusuu ahaenum; na esutsen a munntum nntwa a: osiandɛ esu no eyir ayɛ esu a wɔbor wɔ mu, esutsen a wotwa a ɔnnyɛ a.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, ana ehu iyi? Nna ɔdze me bae, na ɔmaa mesanee baa esutsen no no nkɔnkɔnoa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mesanee bae no, hwɛ, esutsen no no nkɔnkɔnoa efifir ndua pii afa na afa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Esu yinom repem kɔ boka afamu mbew do, na obesian akɔ Araba: na ɔakɔ pomu; pomu na esu a wɔmaa ɔpemee no bɔkɔ; na wɔasa esu no yarba.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, abɔdze nyikan biara a ɔyɛ menyamenya wɔ beebiara a esutsen no bɛba no, obenya nkwa; na nam bɛyɛ boboebo wɔ hɔ: osiandɛ esu yi ekodu hɔ, na wɔbɛsa po n’esu no yarba, na adze biara benya nkwa wɔ mbrɛ esutsen no bodu biara.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ apofo begyinagyina ho: ofitsi En-gedi araa dze kodu En-eglaim ɔbɛyɛ asawu hatabea; no mu nam bɛyɛ ahorow, dɛ po kɛse no mu nam, pii pa.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na n’adɛtsebir na n’atakyɛ no dze, wɔnnkɛsa no yarba; wobegyaa mu ama nkyen.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na esutsen no kɔn do, afa na afa, na dua biara a ɔma edziban befir hɔ a n’ahaban rommpo, na n’aba so rennsa: ɔbɔsow aba afofor bosoom mpempem nyina, osiandɛ n’esu fi krɔnkrɔnbea hɔ pem: na n’aba bɛyɛ edziban, na n’ahaban ayɛ edur.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE Nyankopɔn se nye iyi: Iyi nye he a hom dze bɛkyɛ asaase no ama Israel mbusuakuw duebien no dɛ egyapadze: Josef benya kyɛpɛn.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na hom nkyɛ ndzi do, baako nedze nyɛ dɛ biara so nedze; ɔno no ho na memaa me nsa do dɛ medze bɛma hom egyanom: na asaase yi bɛda hɔ ama hom dɛ egyapadze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na iyi nyɛ asaase no ne he: kwaamu afamu, ofi po kɛse no ho, nam Hetlon kwan do, dze besi kwan a wɔdze kɔ Zedad no do;
title: EZEKIEL

text: Hamat, Berotha, Sibraim a ɔda Damaskɔs he na Hamat he ntamu no; Hazer-hatikon a ɔda Hauran he ho no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na he a ofi po ho nye Hazar-enan a ɔda Damaskɔs ntoaado, na kwaamu afamu he a ɔda kwaamu afamu no, ɔnyɛ Hamat. Iyi nye mbrɛ odzi kɔ kwaamu afamu no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na boka afamu he a ɔda Hauran na Damaskɔs na Gilead, ɔnye Israel asaase ntamu no, ɔnyɛ Jordan; hom nsusu mfi kwaamu afamu he no ho nkɔ boka po no ho, iyi nye mbrɛ odzi kɔ boka afamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na pomu afamu he a ɔda pomu afamu no, ɔnyɛ mbrɛ ofi Tamar wɔ Meribat kades esu no ho araa dze nam Egypt ɔwora no n’ano araa dze kodu po kɛse no ano. Iyi nye mbrɛ odzi kɔ pomu afamu wɔ pomu afamu no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na anee afamu he no ɔnyɛ po kɛse no, ofitsi pomu afamu he no ano araa dze kesi Hamat ne tsentsendo. Iyi nye mbrɛ odzi kɔ anee afamu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Dɛm na hom nsi nkyɛ asaase yi mu mfa dɛ mbrɛ Israel mbusuakuw tsetsee.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ hom bɔtwe tonto akyɛ egyapadze ama hom ho na ananaben a wɔaba hom mu ahɔhotsena a wɔbɔwowo mba wɔ hom mu no; na wɔnyɛ mma hom dɛ hɔn a wɔwo hɔn wɔ Israelmba mu; wɔnye hom nnya egyapadze wɔ Israel mbusuakuw mu.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔmbra dɛ ebusuakuw biara a ɔnanaben no bɛba hɔ ahɔhotsena no, hɔ ara na hom mma no n’egyapadze, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Afei yinom nye mbusuakuw no edzin: ofi kwaamu afamu ewiei, wɔ Hetlon kwan nkyɛnmu a edze rokɔ Hamat, Hazar enan wɔ Damaskɔs he do, kwaamu afamu wɔ Hamat nkyɛnmu; na wonnya hɔn nkyɛnmu, wɔ boka na anee; Dan, kyɛfa kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔnam Dan he ho, ofi boka afamu kesi anee afamu; Aser, kyɛfa kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Aser he ho ofi boka afamu araa dze kesi anee afamu; Naftali, kyɛfa kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔnam Naftali he ho, ofi boka afamu dze kesi anee afamu; Manaasɛ kyɛfa kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔnam Manaasɛ he ho, ofi boka afamu dze kesi anee afamu; Efraim, kyɛfa kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔnam Efraim he ho, ofi boka afamu araa dze kesi anee afamu; Reuben, kyɛfa kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Reuben he ho, ofi boka afamu dze kesi anee afamu; Juda, kyɛfa kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔnam Juda he ho, ofi boka afamu dze kesi anee afamu, ɔnyɛ ayɛyɛdze a hom mfa mma, ne tɛtɛr ndzɛmbir basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum, na ne tsentsen dɛ kyɛfa no mu kor, ofi boka afamu dze kesi anee afamu: na krɔnkrɔnbea no nda finimfin.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ayɛyɛdze a hom mfa mma EWURADZE no ne tsentsen nyɛ ndzɛmbir basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum, na ne tɛtɛr basafa mpem enum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na woyinom, asɔfo ara, na ayɛyɛdze krɔnkrɔn no nyɛ hɔndze; odzi kɔ kwaamu afamu ne tsentsen nyɛ basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum, na odzi kɔ anee afamu ne tɛtɛr nyɛ basafa mpem enum, na odzi kɔ boka afamu ne tɛtɛr nyɛ basafa mpem enum, na odzi kɔ pomu afamu ne tsentsen nyɛ basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum: na EWURADZE no krɔnkrɔnbea no nda finimfin.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔnyɛ Zadokmba mu asɔfo a wɔasan hɔn ho a woesie m’ahwɛdodze no dze; hɔn a wɔammfom ber a Israelmba fomee, dɛ mbrɛ Levifo fomee no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na ɔnyɛ ayɛyɛdze a ofi asaase no mu ayɛyɛdze no mma hɔn, akrɔnkrɔndze mu adze krɔnkrɔn, wɔ Levifo he no do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na Levifo no nnya asɔfo he no ne tsentsendo ne tsentsen basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum, na ne tɛtɛr basafa mpem enum: ne tsentsen mu nyinara nyɛ basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum na ne tɛtɛr nyɛ basafa mpem enum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mma wɔnntɔn mu bi, eso mma wɔnnsesa, eso mma wɔnndandan asaase no do nduadzewakan no mmema: na ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn ma EWURADZE.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na basafa mpem ebien ahaenum a ɔka wɔ ne tɛtɛr mu no, wɔ ne tɛtɛr mu basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum enyim no, ɔnyɛ kwasafodze mma kurow no dɛ hɔn tsenabew na no ho mfikyir asaase: na kurow no nda finimfin.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na yinom nyɛ hɔn nsusui: kwaamu afamu basafa mpemebien ahaebien nye eduonum, na pomu afamu nyɛ basafa mpemebien ahaebien nye eduonum, na boka afamu basafa mpemebien ahaebien nye eduonum, na anee afamu basafa mpemebien ahaebien nye eduonum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na kurow no nnya mfikyir asaase; kwaamu afamu basafa ɔha nye eduonu enum, na pomu afamu basafa ɔha nye eduonu enum, na boka afamu ahaenu eduonum, na anee afamu basafa ɔha nye eduonu enum.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na nkaa no ne tsentsen mu a odzi ayɛyɛdze krɔnkrɔn no ne tsentsendo no ɔnyɛ basafa mpem enum wɔ boka afamu, na basafa mpem enum wɔ anee afamu: na ondzi ayɛyɛdze krɔnkrɔn no ne tsentsendo; na no ndɔbaa no nyɛ edziban mma kurow no mu edwumayɛfo no.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na kurow no mu edwumayɛfo a wofifi Israel mbusuakuw nyinara mu no, wɔndɔw do.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ayɛyɛdze no nyinara nyɛ ne tsentsen mu basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum na ne tɛtɛr mu basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum: hom mma ayɛyɛdze krɔnkrɔn no ɔnyɛ kurow manmu no nyinara nda etwaanan.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na nkaa no nyɛ bapɔmba no dze, wɔ dza ɔda ayɛyɛdze krɔnkrɔn na kurow no manmu no, n’afa na n’afa, wɔ ayɛyɛdze no ne basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum a odzi kɔ boka afamu he no do no enyim, na anee afamu wɔ basafa mpem duebien nye ahaenum a odzi kɔ anee he no do no enyim, wɔ kyɛfa no ne tsentsendo, ɔnyɛ bapɔmba no dze: na ayɛyɛdze krɔnkrɔn na ofi no no krɔnkrɔnbea no, ɔnda finimfin.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Nkyii so ofi Levifo no hɔn kyɛfa na kurow no ne kyɛfa a ɔda bapɔmba no nedze ne finimfin no, wɔ Juda he na Benjamin he ntamu no, ɔnyɛ bapɔmba no dze.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na mbusuakuw nkaa no dze: ofi boka afamu dze kesi anee afamu; Benjamin, kyɛfa kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na dza odzi Benjamin he do, ofi boka afamu dze kesi anee afamu; Simeon, kyɛfa kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na dza odzi Simeon he do, ofi boka afamu dze kesi anee afamu; Isakar, kyɛfa kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na dza odzi Isakar he do, ofi boka afamu dze kesi anee afamu; Zebulun, kyɛfa kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na dza odzi Zebulun he do, ofi boka afamu dze kesi anee afamu; Gad, kyɛfa kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na dza odzi Gad he do, odzi kɔ pomu afamu a ɔda pomu afamu ne he nyɛ ofi Tamar araa dze nam Meribat kades esu no ho, wɔ Egypt ɔwora no do dze kodu po kɛse no ano.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Iyi nye asaase a hom ntwe tonto nkyɛ mma Israel mbusuakuw dɛ egyapadze, na yinom nye hɔn kyɛfa horow, EWURADZE Nyankopɔn na ɔse.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Na yinom nye kurow no ne mfiredzi: kwaamu afamu nsusui nyɛ ndzɛmbir basafa mpemebien ahaebien nye eduonum:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na kurow no no mbobokɛse no wɔmfa Israel mbusuakuw no edzin mfrɛ hɔn; mbobokɛse ebiasa dzi kwaamu afamu: Reuben abobokɛse, kor; Juda abobokɛse, kor; Levi abobokɛse, kor:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na boka afamu ndzɛmbir basafa mpemebien ahaebien nye eduonum, na mbobokɛse ebiasa; mekyerɛ Josef abobokɛse no, kor; Benjamin abobokɛse, kor; Dan abobokɛse, kor:
title: EZEKIEL

text: na pomu afamu no nsusui ndzɛmbir basafa mpemebien ahaebien nye eduonum; na mbobokɛse ebiasa: Simeon abobokɛse, kor; Isakar abobokɛse, kor; Zebulun abobokɛse, kor:
title: EZEKIEL

text: anee afamu ndzɛmbir mpemanan ahaenum, ɔnye no mbobokɛse ebiasa: Gad abobokɛse, kor; Aser abobokɛse, kor; Naftali abobokɛse, kor.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Ɔnyɛ ndzɛmbir basafa mpem akron ntwa ho nhyia: na ofitsi da no kurow no ne dzin nyɛ, EWURADZE wɔ hɔ.
title: EZEKIEL

text: Judahen Jehoiakim n’ahendzi afe a otsia ebiasa no mu no, na Babilɔnhen Nebukadenezar baa Jerusalɛm botuu hyɛɛ no do.
title: DANIEL

text: Na EWURADZE dze Judahen Jehoiakim na Nyankopɔn fie nkɔɔpow no mu bi hyɛɛ ne nsa; na ɔsoae kɔr n’abosomfie wɔ Sinar asaase do: na ɔdze nkɔɔpow no baa no bosom akoradzedan no mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔhen no kasaa kyerɛɛ ɔsomfopanyin Aspenaz, dɛ ɔmfa Israelmba no mu binom mbra, hɔn a wɔyɛ ahen asefo na ekunyin no;
title: DANIEL

text: mberantsewa a wonndzii dzɛm, na mbom hɔn ho yɛ fɛw, na hɔn enyi atsew nyansa nyina mu, na wonyim dze, na wohu nyimdzee mu, na wɔfata dɛ wɔsom wɔ ɔhen no n’ahemfie; na ɔnkyerɛ hɔn ma wonsua Kaldeafo nwoma na kasa.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔhen no hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmma hɔn ahendziban na ne nsa a ɔnom no bi daa daa nyina, na wɔnnyɛn hɔn mfe ebiasa; na ɔno ekyir no wɔmbɔsom ɔhen no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na hɔn mu bi a wofi Judamba mu nye Daniel, Hanania, Misael, na Azaria.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔsomfopanyin no totoo hɔn edzin: ɔtoo Daniel dzin Bɛltesasar; na ɔtoo Hanania dzin Sadrak; na ɔtoo Misael dzin Mesak; na ɔtoo Azaria dzin Abednego.
title: DANIEL

text: Na Daniel suae wɔ n’akoma mu dɛ ɔremmfa ahendziban anaa ne nsa a ɔnom no nngu no ho fi: dɛm ntsi ɔserɛɛ ɔsomfopanyin no amma oeenngu no ho fi.
title: DANIEL

text: Na Nyankopɔn maa Daniel nyaa ɔsomfopanyin no enyim enyimpa na ayamuhyehye.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔsomfopanyin no see Daniel dɛ, Musuro mo wura ɔhen a ɔahyehyɛ hom edziban na anondze: na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn ntsi na obohu hom enyim mbɔbɔmbɔbɔr akyɛn mberantsewa a wɔyɛ hom etsipɛmfo no? Hom reyɛ ma me tsir ato wɔ ɔhen enyim.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna Daniel see ɔsomfo a ɔsomfopanyin dze no esi Daniel, Hanania, Misael na Azaria do no, dɛ:
title: DANIEL

text: Meserɛ wo, sɔ wo nkowaa hwɛ dadu: na wɔmma hɛn fan ma yendzi, na nsu ma yɛnnom.
title: DANIEL

text: Nkyii so ma wɔnhwɛ hɛn enyim, na hɔn so a wodzi ahendziban bi no hɔn enyim wɔ w’enyim: na mbrɛ ɔwoara ibohu no, enye wo nkowaa ndzi.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna otsiee hɔn wɔ asɛm yi mu, na ɔsɔɔ hɔn hwɛɛ dadu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na dadu ekyir no, hɔn enyim yeyɛɛ fɛɛfɛw, na hɔn honam yeyɛɛ abran seen mberantsewa a wodzii ahendziban no bi no nyinara.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔsomfo no yii hɔn edziban, na hɔn nsa a nkyɛ ɔwɔ dɛ wɔnom no fii hɔ, na ɔmaa hɔn fan.
title: DANIEL

text: Na mberantsewa baanan yi dze, Nyankopɔn maa hɔn nyimdzee, na nwomasua na nyansa nyina mu enyitsew: na Daniel nyaa ntseasee wɔ enyido adzehu na adaaso nyinara mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na da a ɔhen no hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa hɔn mbra no durii no, ɔsomfopanyin no dze hɔn baa Nebukadenezar enyim.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔhen no nye hɔn twetwee nkɔmbɔ; na hɔn nyinara mu woennhu obiara a ɔtse dɛ Daniel, Hanania, Misael, na Azaria: dɛm ntsi wɔbɛkaa ɔhen no n’apamfo ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Na asɛm biara a ɔfa nyansa na ntseasee ho a ɔhen no bisaa hɔn mu no, ohun hɔn dɛ woye mpɛn du sen nkongyaayifo na nkaberkyerfo a wɔwɔ n’ahenman mu no nyinara.
title: DANIEL

text: Na Daniel tsenaa hɔ araa dze kodur ɔhen Sirus n’afe a odzi kan no mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na Nebukadenezar n’ahendzi afe a otsia ebien no mu no, na Nebukadenezar sosoo adaa; na no werɛ howee, na ne nda fii no do kɔree.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔhen no hyɛɛ dɛ wɔnkɛfrɛ nkongyaayifo, na nkaberkyerfo, na abayifo, na Kaldeafo dɛ wɔmbɛkyerɛ ɔhen n’adaaso no. Nna wɔbae begyinagyinaa ɔhen no enyim.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔhen no see hɔn dɛ, Maso daa bi, na moho hiahia me dɛ mebɛkaa daa no na mehu ne nkyerɛase.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna Kaldeafo no kasaa kyerɛɛ ɔhen no wɔ Siria kasa mu, dɛ, Ɔhen nya nkwa daa; ka daa no kyerɛ wo nkowaa, ma yɛnkyerɛ ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔhen no buae see Kaldeafo no dɛ, Dza maka no ara na maka: sɛ hom annkyerɛ me daa no na n’ase a, wobotwitwa hom mu esinesin, na wɔadan hom efi sumina.
title: DANIEL

text: Na sɛ hom kyerɛ daa no na n’ase a, hom benya mo hɔ akyɛdze na akatua na enyidzi kɛse: dɛm ntsi hom nkyerɛ me daa no na n’ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Wobuaa no mpɛn ebien see dɛ, Ma ɔhen nka daa no nkyerɛ no nkowaa, ma yɛnkyerɛ ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔhen no buae see dɛ, Muhu no pefee dɛ mber ara na hom regye, osiandɛ hom nyim dɛ sɛ mekasa a menndan m’ano.
title: DANIEL

text: Na sɛ hom amma mennhu daa no a, ɔno adze bɛyɛ hom: osiandɛ hom ahyehyɛ atorsɛm na nsɛmfun dɛ hom rebɛka no m’enyim, ekodu dɛ mebɛsakyer m’adwen: dɛm ntsi hom nka daa no nkyerɛ me, ma munhu dɛ hom botum akyerɛ me ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Kaldeafo no buae wɔ ɔhen no enyim see dɛ, Nyimpa biara nnyi asaase do a obotum akyerɛ ɔhen n’asɛm yi: siantsir nye dɛ ɔhen, owura, anaa otumfo biara mmbisaa nkongyaayifo, anaa nkaberkyernyi, anaa Kaldeanyi biara hɔ asɛm a ɔtse dɛm pɛn.
title: DANIEL

text: Na asɛm a ɔyɛ dzen na ɔhen ribisa yi, na obiara nnyi hɔ a obotum akyerɛ wɔ ɔhen enyim, gyedɛ abosom a hɔn tsenabea nnyi adasa mu no.
title: DANIEL

text: Iyi ntsi na ɔhen no no bo fuwii na n’enyi beer kɛse, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wonku Babilɔn enyansafo no nyinara.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna wɔhyɛɛ mbra dɛ wonku enyansafo no; na wɔhwehwɛɛ Daniel na ne n’anyɛnkofo no dɛ woboku hɔn.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna Daniel dze kasa pa na adwenmutsewee bisaa ɔhen ne safohen Ariok a nna oepue dɛ orukoku Babilɔn enyansafo no dɛ;
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn na mbra a ɔyɛ dzen dɛm fi ɔhen no hɔ yi? Nna Ariok kaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ Daniel.
title: DANIEL

text: Na Daniel kɔr dan mu kɛserɛɛ ɔhen no dɛ ɔmma no ber, na ɔbɛkyerɛ daa no ase akyerɛ no.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna Daniel kɔr ne fie, na ɔkɛdaa nsɛm no edzi kyerɛɛ ne mfɛfo Hanania, Misael, na Azaria:
title: DANIEL

text: dɛ wɔnserɛ ɔsor Nyankopɔn hɔ mbɔbɔrhu wɔ esumasɛm yi ho; amma woeennkuku Daniel na n’anyɛnkofo no aannka Babilɔn enyansafo nkaa no ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Na woyii esumasɛm no kyerɛɛ Daniel wɔ anadwe enyido adzehu mu. Nna Daniel hyiraa ɔsor Nyankopɔn.
title: DANIEL

text: Daniel kaa dɛ, Nhyira nka Nyankopɔn dzin daa daa: Ɔno na nyansa na tum dzi wɔ no:
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔno na ɔsakyer mber na hyɛber: Otu ahen, na ɔhyɛ ahen: Ɔma enyansafo nyansa, Na hɔn a wɔwɔ ntseasee no, nyimdzee.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔda ndzɛmba a no mu dɔ na osuma edzi: Onyim dza ɔwɔ sum mu, na kan nye no tse.
title: DANIEL

text: Meda wo ase, miyi wo ayɛw, Ɔwo, m’egyanom Nyankopɔn, Ama me nyansa na tum, Na afei ama mehu dza yebisaa wo no: Na ɔwo na ama yeehu ɔhen no n’adaaso.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi Daniel kɔr Ariok a ɔhen no ahyɛ no dɛ onku Babilɔn enyansafo no nkyɛn: kɛsee no dɛ: Mma nnsɛɛ Babilɔn enyansafo no: fa me kɔ ɔhen no enyim, na mebɛkyerɛ daa no ase akyerɛ no.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna Ariok yɛɛ ntsɛm dze Daniel baa ɔhen no enyim, na mbrɛ ɔsee nye yi, Mehu Juda ndɔmmumkɔfo no mu banyin bi a ɔbɛma ɔhen ehu daa no na nkyerɛase no.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔhen no buae see Daniel a ne dzin dze Bɛltesasar no dɛ, Ana ɔwo ibotum ama mehu daa a maso no, na ne nkyerɛase no?
title: DANIEL

text: Daniel buaa ɔhen no see dɛ, Esumasɛm a ɔhen ebisa yi enyansafo, nkaberkyerfo, nkongyaayifo, anaa sebramufo runntum nkyerɛ ɔhen;
title: DANIEL

text: na mbom Nyankopɔn bi wɔ sor a ɔda esumadze edzi, na ɔno na ɔama ɔhen Nebukadenezar ehu dza daakye ɔbɛba no. Wo daa no, na w’enyido adzehu wɔ wo mpa do no, nye yinom:
title: DANIEL

text: ɔwo, ɔhen, eda wo mpa do no, edwendween pii, na dza daakye ɔbɛba no: na nyia ɔda esumadze edzi no eyi akyerɛ wo no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na emi dze, nnyɛ nyansa biara a mowɔ kyɛn atseasefo nyina ntsi na woeyi esumasɛm yi akyerɛ me, na mbom mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ a wɔbɛma ɔhen ehu nkyerɛase no, na ɔwoara ehu w’akoma mu nsusui ntsi a.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔwo, ɔhen, ihun ohonyi kɛse bi. Ohonyi yi a ɔso, na ɔhyerɛn hyɛnn yi, begyinaa w’enyim; nna n’enyim yɛ hu.
title: DANIEL

text: Ohonyi yi dze, ne tsir yɛ sika pa, n’akoko na n’abasa dwetɛ a, ne yafun na n’aserɛ boran a,
title: DANIEL

text: n’anantu dadze a, n’anansa dadze fa na dɛtse fa.
title: DANIEL

text: Ehwɛe araa kodur dɛ ɔbo bi a wɔnndze nsa twae tsewee bɔhwee ohonyi no n’anansa a ɔyɛ dadze na dɛtse no do, na obubuu no pɔsɔpɔsɔ.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna dadze, dɛtse, boran, dwetɛ, na sika no bɔɔ mu bubuu pɔsɔpɔsɔ dɛ ɔpɛber mu ewuporowee ntsɛw; na mframa soaa hɔn nyina kɔree, dɛ woennhu hɔn beebiara bio: na ɔbo a ɔbɔbɔɔ ohonyi no do no, bɛyɛɛ bepɔw kɛse, na ɔhyɛɛ asaase nyina do ma.
title: DANIEL

text: Iyi nye adaaso no; na yɛbɛka ne nkyerɛase no so wɔ ɔhen enyim.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔwo, ɔhen, eyɛ ahemfo hen a ɔsor Nyankopɔn dze ahendzi, tum, ahoɔdzen, na enyimnyam no ama wo;
title: DANIEL

text: na beebiara mbrɛ adasamba, hambowa, na ɔsor ntumbowa wowɔe no, ɔdze hɔn ahyɛ wo nsa, na ɔahyɛ wo dɛ dzi hɔn nyinara do tum: ɔhen, ɔwo nye sika tsir no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔwo w’ekyir na ahendzi fofor bi so bɔsoɛr a ɔnnto wodze: na ahendzi bi so a otsia ebiasa a ɔyɛ boran dze a, obedzi asaase nyina do tum.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ahendzi a otsia anan no bɛyɛ dzen dɛ dadze: susuampa dɛ dadze bubu adze nyinara pɔsɔpɔsɔ na ɔbrɛ no adze no: dɛmara na obobubu pɔsɔpɔsɔ na ɔadwerew iyinom nyinara.
title: DANIEL

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ ihun anansa na anansɔba dɛ fa yɛ ɔwemfo dɛtse na fa so yɛ dadze no, ahendzi no mu bɛpaapaa; na mbom dadze dzenyɛ bɛba mu hɔ, susuampa dɛ ihun dɛ wɔdze dadze afora awendɛtse mu ntsi.
title: DANIEL

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ anansɔba no mu bi yɛ dadze, na bi so yɛ awendɛtse no, dɛmara so na ahendzi no mu fa bɛyɛ dzen, na fa so bɛyɛ mberɛw.
title: DANIEL

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ ihun dɛ wɔdze dadze afora awendɛtse mu no, wɔdze hɔn ho bɔfora adasa asefo mu; na wɔremmfemfam hɔnho, dɛ mbrɛ dadze nnye awendɛtse nndzi afora no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ahemfo no hɔn nda no mu na ɔsor Nyankopɔn bɛma ahendzi a wɔrennsɛɛ no da, eso wɔrenndan n’ahendzi nngya ɔman fofor bi do; na obobu ahendzi yinom pɔsɔpɔsɔ na ɔama ɔasa, na ɔnodze begyina daa.
title: DANIEL

text: Susuampa dɛ ihun ɔbo bi a wɔnndze nsa twae fii bepɔw no mu tsewee, na obobubuu dadze no, boran, awendɛtse, dwetɛ, na sika no pɔsɔpɔsɔ no: Nyankopɔn kɛse no ama ɔhen ehu dza daakye ɔbɛba: na daa no yɛ nokwar, na ne nkyerɛase no si pi.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔhen Nebukadenezar dze n’enyim boom famu, na ɔkotowee sɔɔr Daniel, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmbɔ Daniel ayɛyɛdze afɔr na nduhuam afɔr.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔhen no see Daniel dɛ, Ampaara wo Nyankopɔn nye enyame mu Onyame, na ahemfo Wura, na esumasɛm yikyerɛfo, ɔnam dɛ ɔwo na etum ada esumasɛm yi edzi.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔhen no yɛɛ Daniel ɔkɛse, na ɔmaa no akyɛdze akɛse pii, na ɔmaa odzii tum wɔ Babilɔn asaase nyinara do, na ɔbɛyɛɛ ambrado tsitsir wɔ Babilɔn enyansafo nyinara do.
title: DANIEL

text: Na Daniel serɛɛ ɔhen no ma ɔyɛɛ Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego Babilɔn asaase mu nsɛm do ahwɛfo: na Daniel dze, ɔtsenaa ɔhen no n’aban mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔhen Nebukadenezar yɛɛ sika honyi a ne tsentsen yɛ basafa duenum, na ne tɛtɛr basafa kor na fa: na ɔdze sii Dura tɛtɛr mu, wɔ Babilɔn asaase do.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔhen Nebukadenezar somae ma wokehyiahyiaa amansin ahemfo, abakomafo, ambradofo, atsɛmbufo, afotosamfo, apamfo, mbrakyerɛfo, na asaase no do etumfo nyinara dɛ wɔmbra honyi a ɔno ɔhen Nebukadenezar dze esi hɔ no no mpuei ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna amansin ahemfo, na abakomafo, na ambradofo, atsɛmbufo, afotosamfo, apamfo, mbrakyerɛfo, na asaase no do etumfo no nyinara boaa ano behyiaa dɛ worubopue honyi a ɔhen Nebukadenezar dze esi hɔ no; na wobegyinaa honyi a Nebukadenezar dze esi hɔ no enyim.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔsɛn no tseatseaa mu kɛse dɛ, Amanaman, na kasa horow, hom na wɔahyɛ hom,
title: DANIEL

text: dɛ, aber biara a hom bɛtse abɛn, dodogya, nsankutsen, sambuka, bɛntasanku, na bɔtɔwasanku, na nsanku horow nyina ne ndze no, hom nhwe ase nkotow nsɔr sika honyi a ɔhen Nebukadenezar dze esi hɔ no:
title: DANIEL

text: na obiara a ɔannhwe ase annkotow annsɔr no, amonmu no ara wɔbɔtow no akyen fononoo gya framfram no mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi aber a aman no nyinara tsee abɛn, dodogya, nsankutsen, sambuka, bɛntasanku, na nsanku horow nyina ne ndze no, nna amanaman, na kasa horow no nyinara hwehwee ase kotowee sɔɔr sika honyi a ɔhen Nebukadenezar dze esi hɔ no.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi aber no ara mu no, Kaldeafo binom kɔree kɔtoatoaa Jewfo no ano.
title: DANIEL

text: Wɔkɛsee ɔhen Nebukadenezar dɛ, Ɔhen, nya nkwa daa.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔhen, ɔwoara na ahyɛ mbra dɛ nyimpa biara a ɔbɛtse abɛn, dodogya, nsankutsen, sambuka, bɛntasanku, bɔtɔwasanku, na nsanku horow nyinara ne ndze no, ɔnhwe ase nkotow nsɔr sika honyi no:
title: DANIEL

text: na obiara a ɔannhwe famu annkotow annsɔr no, wɔntow no nkyen fononoo gya framfram no mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Jewfo bi wɔ hɔ a ayɛ hɔn Babilɔn asaase mu nsɛm do ahwɛfo, Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego; ɔhen, mbarimba yinom, woemmbu wo bi: wɔnnsom w’abosom, eso wɔnnkotow nnsɔr sika honyi a edze esi hɔ no.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna Nebukadenezar kaa no ebufuw na ebufuhyew mu dɛ wɔmfa Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego mbra. Nna wɔdze dɛm mbanyin yi begyinaa ɔhen no enyim.
title: DANIEL

text: Nebukadenezar buae see hɔn dɛ, Ao Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego, aso hom boapa ara na hom nnsom mo bosom, eso hom nnkotow nnsɔr sika ohonyi a medze esi hɔ no?
title: DANIEL

text: Afei dze sɛ hom esiesie hom ho dɛ aber a hom bɛtse abɛn, dodogya, nsankutsen, sambuka, bɛntasanku, na bɔtɔwasanku, na nsanku horow nyina ne ndze no, hom bɔhwe ase akotow asɔr ohonyi a mayɛ no a, oye: na sɛ hom annkotow annsɔr no a, dɔnhwer no mu ara wɔbɔtow hom egu fononoo gya framfram no mu; na bosom kor a ɔbɛgye hom efi me nsamu no nye woana?
title: DANIEL

text: Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego buae see ɔhen no dɛ, Ao Nebukadenezar, onnhia hɛn dɛ yebobua wo asɛm yi mu bi.
title: DANIEL

text: Sɛ ɔba no dɛm a, hɛn Nyankopɔn a yɛsom no no obotum dɛ ɔgye hɛn fi fononoo gya framfram no mu; na ɔno na ɔbɛgye hɛn efi ɔwo, ɔhen, wo nsamu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na sɛ annyɛ dɛm mpo a, ɔhen, hu dɛ yɛronnsom w’abosom, eso yɛronnkotow nnsɔr ohonyi a edze esi hɔ no da.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ebufuhyew hyɛɛ Nebukadenezar ma, na n’enyim sakyeree tsiaa Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego: dɛm ntsi ɔkasae, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmma fononoo no ndɔ mpɛn ara esuon nkyɛn mbrɛ ɔtɔ dɛ wɔma ɔdɔ.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ mbanyin akatakyi bi a wɔwɔ no dɔm no mu no dɛ wɔnkyekyer Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego, na wɔnkɔtow hɔn ngu fononoo gya framfram no mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna wɔkyekyeer hɔn wɔ hɔn ntwontwo (togaase), hɔn sorntar na hɔn egugudo, na hɔn ntar nkaa no mu, na wɔtoow hɔn guu fononoo gya framfram no mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔnam dɛ wɔnam ɔhen no ne mbrasɛm dzendzen no do ama fononoo no adɔ huruhuru mbordo ntsi, ogyaframee no kum mbanyin a wɔdze Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego kɔree no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na mberantsɛ baasa yi, Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego a wɔakyekyer hɔn no kɔhwee fononoo gya framfram no mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔhen Nebukadenezar no ho boow no, na ɔsoɛɛr ntsɛmara: obisaa n’apamfo no dɛ, Ana nnyɛ mbanyin baasa a wɔakyekyer hɔn na yɛtoow hɔn guu ogya no mu? Wobuaa ɔhen no dɛ, Nyew, Ɔhen, ɔnoara nye no.
title: DANIEL

text: Obuaa hɔn dɛ, Hwɛ, muhu mbanyin baanan a wɔasan hɔn nenam ogya no mu, na hwee nnyɛɛ hɔn; na nyia otsia anan no no hwɛbea tse dɛ abosomba bi.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna Nebukadenezar twee bɛɛn fononoo gya framfram no ano: na ɔkasaa dɛ, Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego, hom, ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn no nkowaa, hom mpue mbra ha. Nna Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego fii ogya no mu puei.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna amansin ahemfo, abakomafo, na ambradofo, na ɔhen no n’apamfo a wobehyiae no, hun mbanyin yi dɛ ogya no ennya hɔn nyimpadua do tum, eso hɔn tsinhwi ennhum, hɔn ntwontwo (togaase) annsakyer, na eso ogya hua ammfa hɔn do.
title: DANIEL

text: Nebukadenezar see dɛ, Nhyira nka Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego hɔn Nyankopɔn a ɔasoma no bɔfoe ma ɔabɛgye no nkowaa a wɔdze hɔn werɛ tweer no, na ɔasakyer ɔhen n’asɛm no, na oegyaa hɔn nyimpadua mu ama, amma wɔaannsom ɔbosom biara anaa wɔaannkotow annsɔr no, gyedɛ hɔnankasa hɔn Nyankopɔn.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mehyɛ mbra, dɛ ɔman, amanaman, na kasa horow biara a ɔbɛka asɛmbɔn bi etsia Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego hɔn Nyankopɔn no, wobotwitwa hɔn mu esinesin, na wɔayɛ hɔn efi dɛ sumina: osiandɛ tum biara nnyi hɔ a otum gye nkwa dɛ iyi.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔhen no maa Sadrak, Mesak, na Abednego hɔn dzibew krɔnee wɔ Babilɔn asaase do.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔhen Nebukadenezar dze kɛma aman, amanaman, na kasa horow a wɔtse asaase do nyina dɛ; ma onsi hom yie mbordo.
title: DANIEL

text: Nsɛnkyerɛdze na anwanwadze a Ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn ayɛ ama me no, mohwɛ a, oye dɛ mebɛka akyerɛ hom.
title: DANIEL

text: Mbrɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛdze no dua yɛ akɛse a! Na mbrɛ n’anwanwadze no dua yɛ dzen a! N’ahendzi yɛ daa ahendzi, na no tumdzi fi mbasantsen kesi mbasantsen do.
title: DANIEL

text: Emi Nebukadenezar metse dwudwoodwo wɔ me fie, na mo ho tɔɔ me wɔ m’aban mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Minyaa adaaso bi a ɔmaa mo bo tui; na me mpa do adwendwen na m’enyido adzehu haaw me.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi mehyɛɛ mbra dɛ wɔmfa Babilɔn enyansafo nyina mbra m’enyim, ma wɔmbɛkyerɛ me adaaso no ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna nkongyaayifo, nkaberkyerfo, Kaldeafo, na sebramufo bae: na mekaa adaaso no wɔ hɔn enyim; naaso wɔamma mennhu ne nkyerɛase.
title: DANIEL

text: Na n’ekyir no, Daniel a ne dzin nye Bɛltesasar, dɛ mbrɛ mo bosom ne dzin tse no, na abosom krɔnkrɔn nyina hɔn sunsum wɔ no mu no, baa m’enyim: na mekaa adaaso no wɔ n’enyim, dɛ,
title: DANIEL

text: Bɛltesasar, nkongyaayifo wura, osiandɛ minyim dɛ abosom krɔnkrɔn no hɔn sunsum wɔ wo mu, na esumasɛm biara nnhaw wo ntsi, ka m’adaaso a muhunii wɔ enyido adzehu mu no na ne nkyerɛase no kyerɛ me.
