title: DANIEL

text: Mbrɛ m’enyido adzehu wɔ me mpa do tse no nye yi: Muhun dɛ dua bi si asaase finimfin a ɔyɛ tsentsenntsen.
title: DANIEL

text: Dua no nyinii, na ɔyɛɛ dzen, na ne tsentsen kodur sor, na wohunii wɔ asaase do beebiara.
title: DANIEL

text: Na n’ahaban yɛ fɛw, na no nsowee pii, na edziban wɔ mu ma nyimpa nyina: hambowa gyee nwin wɔ ase, na wimu ntumbowa sisii n’abaw do, na abɔdze nyina dzidzii do.
title: DANIEL

text: Muhunii wɔ m’enyido adzehu mu wɔ me mpa do no mu dɛ, ɔweɔmfo krɔnkrɔnnyi bi fi sor dwirii.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔtseaa mu dzendzen see dɛ, Hom ntow dua no nto famu, na hom ntwitwa n’abaw no, hom mpo n’ahaban ngu, na hom mbɔ no nsowee mpetse: wɔmma mbowa nguan mfi ase, na ntumbowa mfi m’abaw no do.
title: DANIEL

text: Naaso hom ngya no ndwow dusin wɔ asaase mu, wɔ dadze na boran mpokyerɛ mu, wɔ hamu nkyɛkyɛr momon mu; na ɔsor bɔsu mfɔw no, na ɔnye mbowa nwe asaase do efuw:
title: DANIEL

text: n’adwen nsakyer ngyaa nyimpa dze yɛ, na wɔmma no mbowa adwen; na mfe esuon ntwa ne tsir do.
title: DANIEL

text: Aweɔmfo krɔnkrɔn no do na atsɛn yi nam, na akrɔnkrɔmfo asɛm do na adze yi sii: ama atseasefo eehu dɛ Ɔsorsornyi no dzi nyimpa ahendzi do tum, na ɔdze ma obiara a ɔpɛ, na ɔdze nyimpa mu ɔhobrɛadzenyi biara si do.
title: DANIEL

text: Adaaso yi na emi ɔhen Nebukadenezar mehu: na ɔwo, Bɛltesasar, ka nkyerɛase no kyerɛ me, osiandɛ enyansafo a wɔwɔ m’ahendzi mu nyinara enntum amma mennhu nkyerɛase no; na ɔwo dze, ibotum, osiandɛ abosom krɔnkrɔn sunsum wɔ wo mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna Daniel a ne dzin dze Bɛltesasar no no ho boow no kakra ara sann, na n’adwen haaw no. Ɔhen no see no dɛ, Bɛltesasar, mma daa no, anaa ne nkyerɛase no nnhaw wo. Bɛltesasar buae see dɛ, Mo wura, nkyɛ adaaso no mfa hɔn a wokyir wo ho, na ne nkyerɛase mfa w’ahohiahiafo ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Dua no a ihunii a onyinii na ɔyɛɛ dzen a ne tsentsen kɛpeem sor, na wohun no wɔ wiadze nyina;
title: DANIEL

text: na n’ahaban yɛ fɛw, na no nsowee pii, na edziban wɔ mu ma nyimpa nyina; na hambowa tsetse ase, na wimu nnoma sisi n’abaw do no
title: DANIEL

text: nye ɔwo, ɔhen a enyin, na ayɛ dzen: osiandɛ wo kɛseyɛ enyin, na ekodu sor, na wo tumdzi ekodu asaase ewiei.
title: DANIEL

text: Na susuampa dɛ ɔhen hun ɔweɔmfo krɔnkrɔnnyi bi dɛ ofi sor dwirii bɛsee dɛ, Hom ntow dua no nto famu, na hom nsɛɛ no; naaso hom ngyaa no ndwow dusin wɔ asaase mu, wɔ dadze na boran mpokyerɛ mu, wɔ hamu nkyɛkyɛr momon mu; na ɔsor bɔsu mfɔw no, na ɔnye hambowa ndzidzi nkodu dɛ mfe esuon botwa ne tsir do no;
title: DANIEL

text: ɔhen, nkyerɛase no nye yi, na ɔyɛ Ɔsorsornyi no ne ntsea a ɔaba mo wura ɔhen do.
title: DANIEL

text: Wɔbɛpam wo efi nyimpa mu, na enye hambowa atsena, na wɔama awe efuw dɛ anantwi, na ɔsor bɔsu afɔw wo, na mfe esuon etwa wo tsir do; ekodu dɛ ibohu dɛ Ɔsorsornyi no dzi tum wɔ nyimpa ahendzi do, na ɔdze ma obiara a ɔpɛ.
title: DANIEL

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ wɔhyɛɛ dɛ wongyaa dua no ndwow dusin no; sɛ inya hu dɛ Ɔsorsor dzi tum a, w’ahendzi begyina ama wo.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi, ɔhen, ma m’afotu nsɔ w’enyi, na fa, ndzeyɛtsenenee pon wo bɔn, na fa abɔbɔfo do mbɔbɔrhu pepa w’emumuyɛ; dɛ bi a wɔbɛma w’eyiedzi awar a.
title: DANIEL

text: Iyi nyina baa ɔhen Nebukadenezar do.
title: DANIEL

text: Abosoom duebien ekyir no, dabi nna ɔhen no nenam Babilɔn ahemfi no etsifi,
title: DANIEL

text: na ɔkasae see dɛ, Ana nnyɛ Babilɔn kɛse a menam m’ahoɔdzen tum na mo tumdzi enyimnyam do makyekyer ayɛ m’ahendzi tsenabea no nye yi bi?
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔhen no n’ano da asɛm no do ara, nna ndze bi fi sor baa dɛ, Ɔhen Nebukadenezar ei, ɔwo na wɔreka kyerɛ wo, dɛ: ahendzi no efi wo nsamu kɔ.
title: DANIEL

text: Na wɔbɛpam wo efi nyimpa mu, na enye hambowa akɛtsena; wɔbɛma awe efuw dɛ anantwi, na mfe esuon etwa wo tsir do; ekodu dɛ ibohu dɛ Ɔsorsornyi no dzi tum wɔ nyimpa ahendzi do, na ɔdze ma obiara a ɔpɛ.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɔn no mu ara na asɛm no baa mu wɔ Nebukadenezar do: na wɔpaam no fii nyimpa mu, na ɔwee efuw dɛ anantwi, na ɔsor bɔsu fɔɔw no honam, dze kodur dɛ ne tsinhwi fuuw dɛ ɔkɔr ntɛkyerɛ, na n’awerɛw yɛɛ dɛ nnoma dze.
title: DANIEL

text: Na nda no n’ewiei no, emi Nebukadenezar memaa m’enyi do hwɛɛ ɔsor, na me ntseasee sanee baa mo hɔ, na mihyiraa Ɔsorsornyi no, na miyii nyia ɔtse ase daa no ayɛw, mekamfoo no; dɛ no tumdzi yɛ daa tumdzi, na n’ahendzi fi mbasantsen kesi mbasantsen:
title: DANIEL

text: na asaase do atsefo nyina wommbu hɔn hwee: na ɔyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ wɔ ɔsor dɔm mu, na asaase do atsefo mu: na obi nnyi hɔ a obotum esianka ne nsa, anaa oebisa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ereyɛ yi?
title: DANIEL

text: Aber no ara na me ntseasee sanee baa mo hɔ; na m’ahendzi enyimnyam ntsi mo tumdzi na me hyerɛn sanee baa mo hɔ; na m’apamfo na m’ebirɛmpɔn bɔhwehwɛɛ me; na wotsintsiim me wɔ m’ahendzi mu, na wɔdze akɛseyɛ a ɔkyɛn kaa mo ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Afei emi, Nebukadenezar, miyi ɔsor Hen ayɛw, na muhuhor no, na mekamfo no; dɛ no ndwuma nyinara yɛ nokwardzi, na n’akwan yɛ atsɛmbudze: na hɔn a wɔnantsew ahopɔw do no, otum dɛ ɔbrɛ hɔn adze.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔhen Belsazar too n’ebirɛmpɔn apem pon kɛse, na ɔnoom nsa wɔ hɔn enyim.
title: DANIEL

text: Ber a nsa no baa n’enyi do no, ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa sika na dwetɛ nkɔɔpow a n’egya Nebukadenezar kɛfaa no asɔrdan a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm mu no mbra; ma ɔhen no na n’ebirɛmpɔn, ne yernom na no nwewefo nnom mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna wɔdze sika nkɔɔpow a wɔkɛfaa no Nyankopɔn fie asɔrdan a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm mu no bae; na ɔhen no na n’ebirɛmpɔn, ne yernom na no nwewefo no noom mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Wɔnoom nsa, na wɔkamfoo sika, na dwetɛ, boran, dadze, ndua, na abo abosom no.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɔn no ara mu na nyimpa nsatseaba puei bae bɛkyerɛɛw ahemfie fasu no ne ban ho wɔ kandzeadua no ne tsentsendo: na ɔhen hun nsa a ɔkyerɛwee no ne fa bi.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔhen no n’enyim danee, na n’adwen haaw no; na n’asen mu akwaa sansanee, na no nkotodwe sesɛɛ ho biribiriw.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔhen tseaa mu dzendzen dɛ wɔmfa nkaberkyerfo, Kaldeafo, na sebramufo mbra. Ɔhen no kaa kyerɛɛ Babilɔn enyansafo no dɛ, Obiara a ɔbɛkenkan kyerɛw yi, na wɔakyerɛ me n’ase no, wobofura no ɔberdum, na oenya sika ntweaban egu no kɔn mu, na ɔayɛ ahenman yi mu tumdzifo a otsia ebiasa.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔhen no n’enyansafo no nyina bae: na woenntum annkenkan kyerɛw no, eso wɔamma ɔhen no ennhu nkyerɛase no.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔhen Belsazar no ho guaan no kɛse, na n’enyim danee, na n’ebirɛmpɔn no hɔn enyi bɔe.
title: DANIEL

text: Na osian ɔhen na n’ebirɛmpɔn hɔn kasaa no ntsi, ɔhembaa no baa aponto dan no mu: ɔhembaa no kasae see dɛ, Ɔhen, nya nkwa daa; mma w’adwen nnhaw wo, eso mma w’enyim nndan:
title: DANIEL

text: banyin bi wɔ w’ahenman mu a abosom krɔnkrɔn sunsum wɔ no mu, na wohun no mu kan, na nyimdzee, na nyansa a ɔtse dɛ abosom nyansaa wɔ w’egya nda no mu: na w’egya Nebukadenezar, mekyerɛ w’egya ɔhen noara, dze no sii nkongyaayifo, nkaberkyerfo, Kaldeafo na sebramufo do panyin;
title: DANIEL

text: osiandɛ wohun sunsum a ɔkyɛn, na nyimdzee, na ntseasee, adaaso asekyerɛ, na nsɛm a no mu yɛ sum mu kyerɛ, na anyanyan pɔw mu san, wɔ Daniel kor yi ara a ɔhen too no Bɛltesasar no mu. Afei ma wɔnkɛfrɛ Daniel, na ɔbɛkyerɛ ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna wɔdze Daniel baa ɔhen no enyim. Ɔhen no bisaa Daniel dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye Daniel a ifi Juda ndɔmmummba a m’egya dze hɔn fi Juda bae no mu no?
title: DANIEL

text: Matse wo nka dɛ abosom no sunsum wɔ wo mu, na dɛ woehu kan na ntseasee na nyansa kyɛnee wɔ wo mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na afei wɔdze enyansafo, nkaberkyerfo, aba m’enyim dɛ wɔmbɛkenkan kyerɛw no na wɔmma munhu ne nkyerɛase: na woenntum asɛm no n’ase kyerɛ.
title: DANIEL

text: Na matse wo nka, dɛ itum asɛm ase kyerɛ, na esan anyanyan pɔw: afei sɛ itum kenkan kyerɛw no, na ema muhu ne nkyerɛase a, wobofura wo ɔberdum, na enya sika ntweaban egu wo kɔn mu, na ayɛ ahenman no tumdzifo a otsia ebiasa.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna Daniel buae see ɔhen no dɛ, W’akyɛdze nko woara wo hɔ, na fa w’akatua ma obi; naaso mebɛkenkan kyerɛw no akyerɛ wo, na mama ehu ne nkyerɛase.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔwo ɔhen, Ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn dze ahendzi no, na akɛseyɛ, na enyimnyam, na tumdzi, maa w’egya Nebukadenezar:
title: DANIEL

text: na osian tum a ɔdze maa no ntsi, aman, amanaman, na kasa horow nyina ho popoe na wosuroi wɔ n’enyim: nyia ɔpɛ na okum no, na nyia ɔpɛ na ɔmaa ɔtsenaa ase; na nyia ɔpɛ na ɔmaa no do, na nyia ɔpɛ na ɔbrɛɛ no adze.
title: DANIEL

text: Na n’akoma maa noho do, na no sunsum sorowee ma ɔyɛɛ nkontompɔdze no, wotuu no fii n’ahengua no do, na wɔgyee n’enyimnyam fii ne nsamu:
title: DANIEL

text: na wɔpaam no fii adasamba mu; na wɔyɛɛ n’adwen dɛ mbowa dze, na ɔnye sar do nsoasopɔnkɔ kɛtsenae; wɔmaa ɔwee efuw dɛ anantwi, na ɔsor bɔsu fɔɔw no honam: kodur dɛ ohun dɛ Ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn no dzi tum wɔ nyimpa ahendzi mu, na dɛ ɔnoara na ɔdze obiara a ɔpɛ si do.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔwo ne ba, Belsazar, inyim iyi nyinara dze, naaso ammbrɛ w’akoma adze;
title: DANIEL

text: na mbom ama woho do etsia ɔsor Wura; na wɔdze ne fie nkɔɔpow aba w’enyim na ɔwo na w’ebirɛmpɔn, wo yernom na wo nwewefo, anonom mu nsa; na ɔwo akamfo dwetɛ, na sika, boran, dadze, dua, na ɔbo abosom a wonnhu adze, eso wɔnntse asɛm, na wonnyim no: na Nyankopɔn a w’ahom wɔ ne nsamu, na w’akwan nyina yɛ nedze no dze, annhyɛ no enyimnyam:
title: DANIEL

text: ɔno ntsi na wɔsomaa nsakum no fi n’enyim bae, na kyerɛw yi wokrukyei.
title: DANIEL

text: Na kyerɛw a wokrukyei no nye: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.
title: DANIEL

text: Asɛm no ne nkyerɛase nye yi: MENE; Nyankopɔn akan w’ahendzi, na ɔdze aba ewiei.
title: DANIEL

text: TEKEL; woeker wo wɔ nsɛn mu, na woehu wo dɛ etɔ sin.
title: DANIEL

text: PERES (UPHARSIN); wɔakyɛ w’ahendzi mu na wɔdze ama Mediafo na Persiafo.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna Belsazar hyɛe ma wofuraa Daniel ɔberdum, na wɔdze sika ntweaban guu no kɔn mu, na wɔbɔɔ no ho dawur dɛ ɔbɛyɛ ahendzi no mu tumdzifo a otsia ebiasa.
title: DANIEL

text: Anadwe no ara na wokum Kaldeahen Belsazar.
title: DANIEL

text: Na Medianyi Darius ne nsa kaa ahendzi no, nna oedzi mfe eduosia ebien.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔsɔɔ Darius enyi dɛ ɔdze amansin ahemfo ɔha eduonu sisi ahendzi no do wɔ ahenman no nyina mu;
title: DANIEL

text: na hɔn do etsitsir baasa a hɔn mu baako nye Daniel; dɛ amansin ahemfo no mbu nkontaa nkyerɛ hɔn, amma ɔhen ne biribi aannsɛɛ.
title: DANIEL

text: Na Daniel yi gyee dzin seen etsitsir na amansin ahemfo no, osiandɛ sunsum kyɛnee bi wɔ no mu; na ɔhen no dween dɛ ɔdze no besi ahenman no nyina do.
title: DANIEL

text: Na etsitsir na amansin ahemfo no hwehwɛɛ dɛ wobenya asɛm bi etsia Daniel wɔ ahendzi no afamu; na woennya asɛm anaa bɔn biara; osiandɛ odzii nokwar, eso woennhu no ho mfom anaa bɔn biara.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna mbanyin yi kaa dɛ, Yerinnya asɛm biara nntsia Daniel yi, gyedɛ yenya no wɔ ne Nyankopɔn mbra afamu.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna etsitsir na amansin ahemfo yinom boaa hɔn ano baa ɔhen no nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Ɔhen Darius, nya nkwa daa.
title: DANIEL

text: Ahenman yi mu etsitsir, abakomafo na amansin ahemfo, apamfo na ambradofo, abɔ mu etu egyina dɛ wɔdze ɔhen ne dzin bɛhyɛ mbra dzendzen, na wɔabra ketsee dɛ, obiara a obebisa bosom anaa nyimpa bi hɔ biribi adaduasa yi, gyedɛ ɔwo, ɔhen, hɔ no, wɔbɔtow no akyen ngyatabɔn mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Afei, ɔhen, ma mbra no ntsim, na fa nsa hyɛ kyerɛwee no ase, ma wɔnnsakyer no, dɛ mbrɛ Mediafo na Persiafo mbra wɔnndan enyi no tse.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔhen Darius dze ne nsa hyɛɛ kyerɛwee no na mbra no ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Na Daniel hun dɛ wɔdze nsa ahyɛ kyerɛwee no ase no, ɔkɔr ne fie; (eso ne pia no ntokura ebuebue kyerɛ Jerusalɛm do); na ɔkotoow n’anankoroma enyim mprɛnsa da kor, na oyii mpaa, na ɔdaa ase, wɔ ne Nyankopɔn enyim, dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ no nkan no ara.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna mbanyin yi boaboaa hɔn ano, na wɔkɔtoo Daniel dɛ oribisa adze rokotow serɛ wɔ ne Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna wɔkɔree kɛkaa ɔhen no ne mbra no ho asɛm wɔ ɔhen no enyim dɛ; Ana ɔwo ennhyɛɛ mbra dɛ nyimpa biara a obebisa bosom anaa nyimpa hɔ adze adaduasa yi, gyedɛ ɔwo, ɔhen, hɔ no, wɔbɔtow no akyen gyatabɔn no mu? Ɔhen no buaa dɛ, Ɔyɛ nokwar, dɛ mbrɛ Mediafo na Persiafo mbra a wɔnndan enyi no tse.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna wɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, Daniel no a ofi Judafo ndɔmmummba mu no, ommbu ɔwo, ɔhen na wo mbra a ahyɛ bi, na ɔbɔ mpaa bisa adze mprɛnsa da kor.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔhen no, tsee asɛm yi no, ɔyɛɛ no awerɛhow dodow, na osuaa n’akoma mu dɛ ɔbɛgye no, na ɔbɔɔ mbɔdzen araa kodur ewimbir dɛ nkyɛ ɔbɛgye no efi mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna mbanyin yi boaa hɔn ano baa ɔhen no nkyɛn na wɔsee ɔhen no dɛ, Ɔhen, hu dɛ ɔyɛ Mediafo na Persiafo mbra dɛ, mbra anaa ahyɛdze biara a ɔhen ahyɛ no wɔnndan no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔhen no hyɛe ma wɔdze Daniel bae, na wɔtoow no kyeen ngyatabɔn no mu. Na ɔhen no kasaa berɛww kyerɛɛ Daniel dɛ, Wo Nyankopɔn a esom no daa daa no ɔnoara ɔbɛgye wo.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna wɔdze ɔbo bae, na wɔdze hiin bɔn no ano; na ɔhen no dze nankasa ne mpɛtsea na ebirɛmpɔmfo mpɛtsea sɔɔw ano; amma wɔaannsakyer Daniel ho adze biara.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔhen no kɔr n’aban mu, na odzii mbuada anadwe no: eso ɔamma wɔammfa enyigyedze bi ammba n’enyim: na ne nda guanee fii no ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔhen no soɛɛr anapahema, na ɔdze ntsɛntsɛm kɔr ngyatabɔn no ano.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔbɛɛn bɔn no wɔ Daniel nkyɛn no, ɔdze awerɛhow ndze tseaa mu: ɔhen no kasae see Daniel dɛ, Daniel, Nyankopɔn tseasefo n’akowaa, ana wo Nyankopɔn a esom no daa daa no etum agye wo efi ngyata no anomu anaa?
title: DANIEL

text: Nna Daniel see ɔhen no dɛ, Ɔhen, nya nkwa daa.
title: DANIEL

text: Me Nyankopɔn asoma no bɔfoe, ma oebomua ngyata no ano, na wɔannyɛ me hwee: osiandɛ oehu me dɛ midzi bem wɔ n’enyim; na ɔwo, ɔhen, w’enyim so mennyɛɛ bɔn bi.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen no dɛw mbordo, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wonyi Daniel mfi bɔn no mu mbra sor. Na woyii Daniel fii bɔn no mu baa sor, na woennhu kam biara wɔ no ho, osiandɛ ɔdze no werɛ hyɛɛ ne Nyankopɔn mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔhen no hyɛe, na wɔdze mbanyin no a wɔtoatoaa Daniel no bae, na wɔtoow hɔn guu ngyatabɔn no mu, hɔn, hɔn mba, na hɔn yernom; na ngyata no faa hɔn do, na wɔbobɔɔ hɔn mbiew mu, ansaana worudu bɔn no ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔhen Darius kyerɛwee kɛmaa aman, amanaman, na kasa horow nyina a wɔtsetse asaase nyina do no; Onsi hom yie mbordo.
title: DANIEL

text: Mehyɛ mbra dɛ, m’ahenman a midzi do tum nyina mu, adasa ho mpopo na wonsuro wɔ Daniel ne Nyankopɔn no enyim: na ɔno nye Nyankopɔn tseasefo, na otsim hɔ daa, na n’ahendzi dza wɔnnsɛɛ no da a, na no tumdzi bɛtsena hɔ ekodu ewiei:
title: DANIEL

text: ɔno na ɔgye na oyi fi mbusu mu, na ɔyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze na anwanwadze wɔ sor na asaase; ɔno na oeyi Daniel efi ngyata tum nsa.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi Daniel yi dzii yie wɔ Darius ahendzi mu, na Persianyi Sirus ahendzi mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Babilɔnhen Belsazar n’afe a odzi kan mu no, Daniel soo daa na ohun enyido adzehu wɔ ne mpa do: nna ɔkyerɛɛw adaaso no na osii nsɛm no tam kae.
title: DANIEL

text: Daniel kaa dɛ, Muhunii wɔ m’enyido adzehu mu anadwe, na, hwɛ, ɔsor mframa anan no tui bɔɔ po kɛse no do.
title: DANIEL

text: Na mbowa akɛse anan fi po no mu puei, ɔsor kor biara.
title: DANIEL

text: Dza odzi kan no tse dɛ gyata, na ɔwɔ ɔkɔr ntsaban: mohwɛe araa ma okodur dɛ wotutuu n’atsaban, na wɔmaa no do fii asaase do, na wɔmaa ogyinaa anan ebien do dɛ nyimpa, na wɔmaa no nyimpa akoma.
title: DANIEL

text: Na hwɛ, abowa bi so a otsia ebien a ɔtse dɛ osisi, na ogyinae tɔree kɔr fakor, na mparba ebiasa hyɛ n’anomu wɔ ne se ntamu: na ndze bi see no dɛ, Soɛr, dzi bɔnam pii.
title: DANIEL

text: Iyi ekyir no muhun fofor so a ɔtse dɛ ɔsebɔ a nnoma ntsaban anan sisi n’ekyir; abowa no wɔ etsir anan so; na wɔdze tumdzi maa no.
title: DANIEL

text: Iyi ekyir no muhunii wɔ anadwe enyido adzehu mu bio, na hwɛ, abowa a otsia anan a no ho yɛ hu, yɛ nwanwa, yɛ dzen mbordo; na ɔwɔ dadze se akɛse: na ɔmemenee kekaaw mu esinesin, na ɔdze n’anan tsiatsiaa nkaa no do: na ɔsor ɔno na mbowa a wodzii n’enyim kan no nyina; na ɔwɔ mmbɛn du.
title: DANIEL

text: Morodwendwen mmbɛn no ho no, hwɛ, ambɛn kakraba fofor bi so puei wɔ hɔn ntamu, na mmbɛn a wodzii kan no mu ebiasa ase tutui wɔ n’enyim: na, hwɛ, enyiwa a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa enyiwa na ano a ɔkeka nsɛm akɛse wɔ ambɛn no ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Mohwɛe araa kesii dɛ wɔdze ahengua sisii hɔ, na nyia ɔwɔ hɔ fi mbersantsen bɛtsenaa do: n’atar hoa dɛ esukwankyɛba, na ne tsir do nhwi tse dɛ oguannhwi fitafita; n’ahengua ogyaframee a, na no nhwiir ogyadzɛwee a.
title: DANIEL

text: Ogya esutsen fi n’enyim worae bae: mpempem mpempem soom no, na pedu mbɔho pedu gyinagyinaa n’enyim. Wɔhyɛɛ ase dɛ worubu atsɛn, na wobuebuee nwoma no mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Mohwɛe araa ma okesii dɛ ɔnam nsɛm akɛse a ambɛn no kae ntsi; wokum abowa no, na wɔsɛɛ no honam, na wɔdze no maa ogyaframee.
title: DANIEL

text: Na mbowa nkaa no dze, wɔgyee hɔn tumdzi; naaso wɔhyɛɛ hɔn nda na ber a hɔn nkwa bɔtoa do ekodu.
title: DANIEL

text: Minyaa anadwe enyido adzehu bio, na hwɛ, obi a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa ba dze ɔsor nsuwusiw reba, na ɔbaa nyia ɔwɔ hɔ fi mbersantsen no nkyɛn, na wɔdze no pinkyɛɛn n’enyim.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔno na wɔmaa no tumdzi, na enyimnyam, na ahendzi, dɛ aman, amanaman, na kasa horow nyina nsom no: no tumdzi yɛ daa tumdzi a orunntwa mu da, na n’ahendzi yɛ dza wɔrennsɛɛ no.
title: DANIEL

text: Emi Daniel dze, mo sunsum bɔmee wɔ mo honam mu, na m’enyido adzehu no haaw me.
title: DANIEL

text: Mipinkyɛɛn hɔn a wogyinaa hɔ no mu baako, na mibisaa no dza muhunii no nyina ho asekyerɛ. Nna ɔkaa kyerɛɛ me, na ɔmaa muhun ndzɛmba no ne nkyerɛase.
title: DANIEL

text: Mbowa akɛse a wɔyɛ anan yi, wɔyɛ ahemfo baanan a wobefi asaase do asoɛr.
title: DANIEL

text: Na Ɔsorsornyi no n’ahotseweefo no dze, wɔbɛgye ahendzi no, na woenya ahendzi no daa, mbersantsen mfesantsen.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna mohwehwɛɛ dɛ muhu nokwar no wɔ abowa a otsia anan a ɔsor ɔno na hɔn nyina no a no ho yɛ hu mbordo a ne se yɛ dadze, na n’awerɛw yɛ boran a ɔmemenee ɔkekaaw mu esinesin na ɔdze n’anan tsiatsiaa nkaa no do no ho no nkyerɛase;
title: DANIEL

text: na ne tsir do mmbɛn du no, na ambɛn fofor bi so a opuei na ebiasa tutui wɔ n’enyim; ambɛn no a ɔwɔ enyiwa, na ano a ɔkaa nsɛm akɛse, na ehwɛ a ɔso sen ne mfɛfo no ho dze;
title: DANIEL

text: mohwɛe, na ambɛn kor no ara nye ahotseweefo no dzii ako, na odzii hɔn do nyim;
title: DANIEL

text: dze kesii dɛ nyia ɔwɔ hɔ fi mbersantsen no bae, na wɔdze abemdzi maa Ɔsorsornyi no n’ahotseweefo no; na ber baa dɛ ahotseweefo no nyaa ahendzi no.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔkaa dɛm dɛ, Abowa a otsia anan no bɛyɛ ahendzi a otsia anan wɔ asaase do a ɔbɔsor ɔno wɔ ahendzi nyina mu, na ɔamen asaase nyina, na oetsiatsia do, na oebubu mu esinesin.
title: DANIEL

text: Na mmbɛn du no ho dze, ahendzi kor yi ara mu na ahemfo du bɔsoɛr: na hɔn ekyir no fofor bi bɔsoɛr; na ɔbɔsor ɔno na hɔn a wodzi kan no, na ɔbɛbrɛ ahemfo ebiasa adze.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔbɛka nsɛm etsia Ɔsorsornyi no na ɔama Ɔsorsornyi no n’ahotseweefo no aberɛ: na ɔbɔdwen dɛ ɔbɛsakyer mber na mbra; na wɔdze hɔn bɛhyɛ ne nsa ma ekodu mfe ebiasa na fa.
title: DANIEL

text: Na wɔbɛtsena ase ebu atsɛn, na wɔbɛgye ne nsamu tumdzi no, na wɔasɛɛ no dze pasaa.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ahendzi, na tumdzi, na ahenman a wɔwɔ wiadze nyina n’akɛseyɛ wɔdze bɛma Ɔsorsornyi no n’ahotseweefo man no: n’ahendzi yɛ daa ahendzi, na tumdzi nyina bɔsom no ayɛ setsie ama no.
title: DANIEL

text: Ha na asɛm no n’ase si. Emi Daniel dze, m’adwen haaw me pii, na m’enyim sakyeree: na medze asɛm no siee m’akoma mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔhen Belsazar n’ahendzi a otsia ebiasa no mu no, emi mara Daniel nyaa enyido adzehu bi wɔ kan dza woyii kyerɛɛ me no ekyir.
title: DANIEL

text: Na muhunii wɔ enyido adzehu mu; dɛ, nna mowɔ Susan ahemfie a ɔwɔ Elam ɔmansin mu no mu; na mowɔ esutsen Ulai ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna memaa m’enyi do na hwɛ, oguannyin a ɔwɔ mmbɛn ebien gyina esu no ano: na mmbɛn ebien no wowar; na kor war sen kor, na dza ɔwar no na odzii ekyir firii.
title: DANIEL

text: Muhun oguannyin no dɛ ɔresesɛ kɔ anee, kwaamu na pomu afamu; na mbowa biara nntum nngyina n’enyim, eso obiara nnyi hɔ a otum gye obi fi ne nsamu; na ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ na ohuhoor noho.
title: DANIEL

text: Na morodwendwen ho no, hwɛ, apɔnkyenyin fi anee nam asaase enyi bae, na no ho nnka famu: na apɔnkye no wɔ ambɛn kɛse bi a osi n’enyiwa ntamu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔbaa oguannyin a ɔwɔ mmbɛn ebien a muhun no dɛ ogyina esutsen no ano no nkyɛn, na ɔdze n’ahoɔdzen ebufuhyew tutuu mbirika kɛhyɛɛ oguannyin no do.
title: DANIEL

text: Na muhun dɛ opiin oguannyin no nkyɛn, na n’enyi beer no do, na ɔsesɛɛ oguannyin no, na obubuu ne mmbɛn ebien no; na ahoɔdzen bi nnyi oguannyin no mu dɛ ɔdze begyina n’enyim; na ɔtoow no kyeen famu, na otsiatsiaa no do, na obi nnyi hɔ a otumii gyee oguannyin no fii ne nsamu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na apɔnkyenyin no huhoor noho mbordo: na ɔtraa do no, ambɛn kɛse no bui; na mmbɛn akɛse anan besisii ananmu kyerɛkyerɛɛ ɔsor mframa anan no do.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ambɛn kakraba kor bi fi hɔn mu firii a ɔyɛɛ kɛse mbordo kɔr pomu afamu, na boka afamu, na asaase fɛɛfɛw no no do.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔyɛɛ kɛse kɛpeem ɔsor dɔm mpo do; na ɔtoow dɔm no na nworaba no mu bi guguu famu, na otsiatsiaa hɔn do.
title: DANIEL

text: Nyew, ɔmemaa noho do kodur dɔm no safohen no do mpo; na ɔgyee daa ɔhyew afɔr no fii ne nsamu, na wɔtoow no krɔnkrɔn bea no kyeen famu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na wɔdze dɔm no kaa daa ɔhyew afɔr no ho maa no wɔ mbrato mu; na ɔtoow nokwar kyeen famu na ɔyɛɛ n’apɛdze na ɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna metsee dɛ ɔkrɔnkrɔnnyi bi rekasa; na ɔkrɔnkrɔnnyi fofor bi so see ɔbaako a ɔrekasa no dɛ, Dabɛn na daa ɔhyew afɔr na amamfoyɛ mbrato a wɔdze krɔnkrɔnbea na dɔm no maa dɛ wɔmfa anan ntsiatsia do no ho enyido adzehu no besi?
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Obekesi ewimbir na anapa mpem ebien ahaebiasa; ansaana wɔatsew krɔnkrɔnbea no ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ aber a emi mara Daniel morohwehwɛ dɛ mebɛtse ase; no, awerɛfir mu ara hwɛ, obi beyii noho gyinaa m’enyim dɛ banyin.
title: DANIEL

text: Na metsee nyimpa ndze wɔ Ulai nsu kɔn do ntamu a ɔfrɛe see dɛ, Gabriel, ma banyin yi ntse enyido adzehu no ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔbɛɛn mbrɛ migyinae no; na ɔbae no, mobɔɔ hu, na medze m’enyim butuuw famu: na ɔsee me dɛ, Onyimpa ba, tse ase; na enyido adzehu no fa ewiei ber no ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔnye me rekasa no, motɔɔ nda heii, na osuoo mo mu, na ɔdze me gyinaa tsentsen.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, merema ehu dza ɔbɛba ekyir ebufuw ber no mu: na ɔfa ewiei ber a wɔahyɛ no ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Oguannyin a ihunii a ɔwɔ mmbɛn ebien no, hɔn nye Media na Persia ahemfo
title: DANIEL

text: Na apɔnkyenyin wirikyee no nye Griisen: na ambɛn kɛse a osi n’enyiwa ntamu no ɔnye ɔhen a odzi kan.
title: DANIEL

text: Na dza obui a anan besisii ananmu no, ahendzi anan bɔsoɛr efi ɔman no mu, na no mu biara no tum nnkɔto kan dze no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na hɔn ahendzi n’ekyir ber no a mbrato ewie mayɛ no, ɔhen a n’enyim yɛ hu a ɔtse nsɛm a no mu yɛ sum ase bɔsoɛr.
title: DANIEL

text: Na no tum bɛyɛ dzen, naaso nnyɛ noara no tum a: na ɔbɛsɛɛ adze nwanwa na oedzi yie na ɔayɛ n’apɛdze: na ɔbɛsɛɛ ahoɔdzenfo na akrɔnkrɔmfo no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na n’enyitsew ntsi ɔbɛma ndaadaa edzi yie wɔ ne nsamu; na ɔbɛmema noho do wɔ n’akoma mu, na hɔn sɔkyeeyɛ no mu, ɔbɛsɛɛ piinara: ɔbɔsoɛr etsia ahen mu hen no so; na ɔnodze wobobu no a wɔnndze nyimpa nsa.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ewimbir ewimbir na anapa anapa enyido adzehu a wɔkae no, yɛ nokwar: na ɔwo dze, tow enyido adzehu no mu; na ɔfa mber pii a ɔreba ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Na emi Daniel, adze bɔɔ mo do, na meyaar nda bi; nna mosoɛree, na meyɛɛ ɔhen n’edwuma: na enyido adzehu no yɛɛ me ahobow, na obiara anntse ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Ahasuerus ne ba Darius a n’ase fi Mediafo mu a wɔyɛɛ no Kaldeafo ahenman do ɔhen no,
title: DANIEL

text: n’ahendzi afe a odzi kan no mu no nna emi Daniel metsee ase wɔ nwoma no mu, mfe dodow a EWURADZE asɛm baa nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia hɔ dɛ ɔbɛma Jerusalɛm amamfoyɛ ewie du wɔ mfe eduosuon mu no ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Medze m’enyi tsiim EWURADZE Nyankopɔn do, dɛ medze mbuada, na eyitam, na nso, na nkotoserɛ bɔbɔ mpaa.
title: DANIEL

text: Na mobɔɔ EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn mpaa, na mekaa mo bɔn, mesee dɛ, Ao EWURADZE, Nyankopɔn kɛse a no ho yɛ hu a osie ahyɛmudzi na mbɔbɔrhu ma hɔn a wɔdɔ no na wosie ne mbrasɛm;
title: DANIEL

text: yɛayɛ bɔn, na yɛabɔ ɔbrakyew, na yɛayɛ emumuyɛ, na yɛatsew etua, dɛ yɛaman efi w’ahyɛdze na w’atsɛmbudze ho mpo;
title: DANIEL

text: na yenntsie wo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no a wɔdze wo dzin kasaa kyerɛɛ hɛn ahemfo, hɛn asafohemfo, na hɛn egyanom, na asaase no do nkorɔfo no nyina no.
title: DANIEL

text: EWURADZE, ɔwo na ndzeyɛtsenenee dzi wɔ wo, na hɛn dze, enyimguase dzi wɔ hɛn, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi; na Judafo, na Jerusalɛm atsefo, na Israel nyinara a wɔbɛn, na hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir, wɔ nkurow nkurow a hɔn mfom a wɔafom wo ntsi etu hɔn akɔ hɔ no do.
title: DANIEL

text: EWURADZE, hɛn na enyimguase dzi wɔ hɛn, hɛn ahemfo, hɛn asafohemfo, na hɛn egyanom, osiandɛ yɛayɛ bɔn etsia wo.
title: DANIEL

text: EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn na mbɔbɔrhu na fakyɛ dzi wɔ no; na hɛn dze, yɛatsew no do etua;
title: DANIEL

text: eso yeenntsie EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn ndze, dɛ yɛbɛnantsew ne mbra a ɔnam no nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo do dze sii hɛn enyim no mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Nyew, Israel nyina ato wo mbra, na wɔaman nkyɛn, dɛ wɔrennyɛ setsie mma wo ndze; dɛm ntsi na woehue ndom no egu hɛn do, na ntam no a wɔakyerɛw no Nyankopɔn akowaa Moses mbra mu no; osiandɛ yɛayɛ bɔn etsia no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔahyɛ ne nsɛm a ɔkasae tsiaa hɛn, na hɛn atsɛmbufo a wobuu hɛn atsɛn no dzen, dɛ ɔdze mbusu kɛse yi aba hɛn do: na wɔnnyɛɛ bi pɛn wɔ wi ase nyina dɛ mbrɛ wɔayɛ no wɔ Jerusalɛm no.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no Moses mbra mu no, na mbusu yi nyina aba hɛn do: naaso yɛnnserɛɛ EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn n’enyimtsewee, dɛ yɛbɛdan efi hɛn emumuyɛ ho, na yeenya nhumu wɔ wo nokwar no mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi na EWURADZE atweɔn na ber a ɔsɛ mu no, ɔdze atoyerɛnkyɛm aba hɛn do: na EWURADZE hɛn Nyankopɔn dze, ɔtsen wɔ n’edwuma a ɔyɛ nyina mu, na hɛn na yɛannyɛ setsie amma ne ndze.
title: DANIEL

text: Na afei, hɛn EWURADZE Nyankopɔn a edze wo nsa a ɔyɛ dzen yii wo man fii Egypt asaase do dze gyee dzin, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse ndɛ da yi: yɛayɛ bɔn, yɛayɛ no emumuyɛ mu.
title: DANIEL

text: EWURADZE, dɛ mbrɛ wo tsenenee nyina tse no, meserɛ wo, ma w’ebufuw na w’ebufuhyew ndan mfi wo kurow Jerusalɛm, wo bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do: osian hɛn bɔn ntsi, na hɛn egyanom emumuyɛ ntsi, na Jerusalɛm na wo man adan ahorohoraadze ama hɔn a wɔabɔ hɛn ho aprɔw yi.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, hɛn Nyankopɔn, yɛ aso ma w’akowaa ne mpaabɔ, na no nkotoserɛ, na ma w’enyim nhyerɛn wo krɔnkrɔnbea a ayɛ amamfo no do, wɔ ɔwoara EWURADZE ntsi.
title: DANIEL

text: Me Nyankopɔn, brɛ w’aso adze tsie; bue w’enyiwa, na hwɛ hɛn amamfo, na kurow a wɔbɔ wo dzin frɛ no no: na yɛmmfa hɛn nkotoserɛ mmbɔto w’enyim wɔ hɛn tsenenee ntsi, na mbom wo mbɔbɔrhu akɛse no ntsi a.
title: DANIEL

text: Ao EWURADZE tsie; ao EWURADZE, fa kyɛ; ao EWURADZE, yɛ aso na yɛ; mma nkyinkyim; ao me Nyankopɔn, osian ɔwoara ntsi, osiandɛ wo dzin na wɔbɔ frɛ wo kurow na wo man.
title: DANIEL

text: Na meda do rekasa, na morobɔ mpaa, na mereka mo bɔn na me man Israel hɔn bɔn, na medze mo nkotoserɛ roto EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn enyim ama me Nyankopɔn ne bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no;
title: DANIEL

text: nyew, meda do rekasa wɔ mpaabɔ mu no, ɔbɔfo Gabriel a muhun no enyido adzehu no mu ahyɛse no tuu paa baa me nkyɛn wɔ ewimbir afɔrbɔ ber mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ me, na ɔnye me kasae dɛ, Daniel e, afei maba dɛ merebɛma awea ntseasee ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Wo nkotoserɛ ahyɛse no, mbrasɛm no fiir edzi, na maba dɛ merebɛka akyerɛ wo; osiandɛ wɔdɔ wo kɛse dɛ: dɛm ntsi dwendwen asɛm no ho, na tse enyido adzehu no ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Wɔahyɛ mfe eduosuon ahorow esuon mbra wɔ wo man na wo kurow krɔnkrɔn no do, dɛ wonwie mbrato, wɔmma bɔn mbɔ adze, wɔmpata mma emumuyɛ, na wɔmfa daa tsenenee mbra, na wɔnsɔw enyido adzehu na nkɔnhyɛ ano, na wɔnsera akrɔnkrɔndze mu akrɔnkrɔndze no ngo.
title: DANIEL

text: Dɛm ntsi hu dɛ, ofitsi mbrasɛm a ɔka dɛ wɔnsan nkyekyer Jerusalɛm nsi n’ananmu no dze kesi ɔhen a wɔasera no no do no yɛ mfe esuon: na mfe esuon ahorow eduosia ebien na wɔdze bɛkyekyer ɔbrɔn na ɔfasu no wɔ ahohiahia ber mu mpo.
title: DANIEL

text: Na dɛm mber no ekyir no, wobotwa nyia wɔasera no no akyen, na onnkenya biribiara: na ɔhen a ɔbɛba no ne man bɛsɛɛ kurow na krɔnkrɔnbea no; na n’ewiei bɛba wɔ nsuyirii mu, ɔko bɛba araa dze ekesi ase; woesua amamfoyɛ ato hɔ.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔnye pii bedzi ahyɛmu pintsinn mfe esuon: na ber no ne finimfin ɔbɛma okum afɔr na edziban afɔr abɔ adze; na ekyiwadze no etsifi na amamfoyɛfo besi; na ɔdze ekowie dɛ dza woesua ato hɔ no, woehue ebufuw egu amamfoyɛfo no do.
title: DANIEL

text: Persiahen Sirus n’afe a otsia ebiasa no mu no, wɔdaa asɛm bi edzi kyerɛɛ Daniel a ne dzin dze Bɛltesasar no; nna asɛm no yɛ nokwar, na ɔfa ɔko kɛse ho na ne ntseasee yɛ dzen: naaso ɔtsee asɛm no ase, na onyaa enyido adzehu no ho ntseasee.
title: DANIEL

text: Nda no mu no emi Daniel mo werɛ hoow adapɛn pɔr pɔr ebiasa.
title: DANIEL

text: Menndzi edziban pa biara, na nam anaa nsa annka m’ano, eso mannsera koraa, dze kesii dɛ dapɛn pɔr pɔr ebiasa no soe.
title: DANIEL

text: Na bosoom a odzi kan no ne da a otsia eduonu anan no mu no, ber a mowɔ esutsen a ɔyɛ Hidekel ho no,
title: DANIEL

text: memaa m’enyi do mohwɛe, na muhun banyin bi a ofura ndwera a Ufaz sika mapa bɔ n’asen wɔ hɔ.
title: DANIEL

text: Ne nyimpadua so tse dɛ sikabereebo, n’enyim tse dɛ enyinam, n’enyiwa tse dɛ kandzea gya, na n’abasa na n’anan tse dɛ ayewa a wɔapɔw ho, na ne kasaa ndze tse dɛ nyimpadodow ndze.
title: DANIEL

text: Na emi Daniel nko na muhun enyido adzehu no: na mbanyin a wɔka mo ho no ennhu enyido adzehu no; naaso ahopopo kɛsenara tɔɔ hɔn do, na woguanee dze hɔnho kosumae.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔkaa mo nko a nna morohwɛ enyido adzehu kɛse yi, na ahoɔdzen bi annka mo mu: na m’ahoɔfɛw daan prɔwee wɔ mo mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Naaso metsee ne ndze: na metsee n’asɛm no, nna m’enyim butuw famu a matɔ nda heii.
title: DANIEL

text: Na, hwɛ, nsa bi bosuoo mo mu a ɔmaa moweaweaa m’anankoroma enyim na me nsamu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Daniel e, nyimpa a wɔdɔ wo kɛse, tsie asɛm a merebɛka akyerɛ wo yi na gyina tsentsen; na ɔwo na wɔasoma me wo nkyɛn yi: na ɔkaa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ me no, medze ahopopo migyinae.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Daniel, mma nnsuro; na ofitsi da a odzi kan a edze w’akoma sii do dɛ ebɛtse asɛm no ase, na abrɛ woho adze wɔ wo Nyankopɔn enyim no, na wɔtsee wo nsɛm: na wo nsɛm ntsi na maba.
title: DANIEL

text: Na Persia ahenman safohen no siiw me kwan adapɛn ebiasa; na, hwɛ, Maekɛl a ɔyɛ abɔfo etsitsir no mu baako no, bae bɔboaa me: na mekaa hɔ wɔ Persia ahemfo no nkyɛn.
title: DANIEL

text: Afei maba dɛ merebɛma ehu dza ɔbɛba wo man do nda a odzi ekyir no mu: na enyido adzehu no da ho wɔ hɔ nda pii.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔkaa nsɛm yi dɛm kyerɛɛ me no, medze m’enyim sii famu, na motɔɔ mmum.
title: DANIEL

text: Na, hwɛ, obi a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa ba saso bɛkaa m’anofamfa: nna mubuee m’ano kasaa kyerɛɛ nyia ogyina m’enyim no dɛ, Ao mo wura, enyido adzehu no ntsi, awerɛhow kɛse ahyɛ mo do, na minnyi ahoɔdzen bi wɔ mo mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na mo wura n’akowaa yi nye mo wura bɛkasa? Na emi dze, amonmu no ara ahoɔdzen biara annka mo mu, eso ahom biara annka mo mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna obi a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa saso bɛkaa me bio, na ɔhyɛɛ me dzen.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Ao nyimpa a wɔdɔ wo kɛse, mma nnsuro: asomdwee nka wo, hyɛ dzen, ɛhɛɛ, hyɛ dzen. Na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ me no, mehyɛɛ dzen, na mesee dɛ, Ma mo wura nkasa; osiandɛ ɔwo ahyɛ me dzen.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Ana inyim dza osian ntsi ma maba wo hɔ? Na afei na mebɛsan nye Persia safohen no akɔko: na misi mu kɔ a, hwɛ Griis safohen no bɛba.
title: DANIEL

text: Naaso mebɛka dza woekrukye no wɔ nokwar kyerɛwee mu no akyerɛ wo; na obi nnyi hɔ a osuo mo mu tsia yinom, gyedɛ Maekɛl.
title: DANIEL

text: Na emi dze, Medianyi Darius n’afe a odzi kan no mu no migyinaa dɛ murusuo no mu mahyɛ no dzen.
title: DANIEL

text: Na afei na mebɛkyerɛ wo nokwar no. Hwɛ, ahemfo baasa bɛda ho asoɛr wɔ Persia; na dza otsia anan no benya noho asen nkaa no nyinara; na sɛ n’ahonya ma no ho yɛ dzen a, obekenyan adze nyina etsia Griis ahenman.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔhen tumfo bi bɔsoɛr a ɔdze tumdzi kɛse bedzi hen, na ɔayɛ dza ɔpɛ.
title: DANIEL

text: Na oetsim, no n’ahendzi bɔbɔ, na wɔakyekyɛ mu afa ɔsor mframa anan afamu; na wɔremmfa mma n’asefo, eso ɔrennyɛ dɛ mbrɛ no tumdzi a ɔdze dzii hen no tse; na wobotutu n’ahendzi, woekwetsi yinom na wɔdze ama binom.
title: DANIEL

text: Na pomu afamu hen no no ho bɛyɛ dzen, na n’asafohemfo no mu baako; na no ho bɛyɛ dzen asen no, na oenya tumdzi; no tumdzi bɛyɛ tumdzi kɛse.
title: DANIEL

text: Na mfe bi ekyir no, wɔbɛfefa hɔnho anyɛnko; na pomu afamu hen ne babaa bɛba kwaamu afamu hen nkyɛn dɛ ɔnye no rebɛyɛ asomdwee: na ɔremma ne basa ahoɔdzen no nka no ho; na ɔno na ne basa rinngyina; na obeyi ɔbaa no, na hɔn a wɔdze no bae no, na nyia ɔwoo no no, na nyia ɔhyɛɛ no dzen wɔ mber no mu no ama.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔbaa no no ndwow mu mfɛwee bi mu na obi bɔsoɛr esuo n’ananmu a ɔbɛba dɔm no nkyɛn, na ɔahɛn kwaamu afamu ɔhen n’abankɛse no mu, na ɔnye hɔn ako, na oedzi konyim:
title: DANIEL

text: na ɔbɔsoa hɔn abosom, nye hɔn ehonyi a woegu, na hɔn dwetɛ na sika nkɔɔpow fɛɛfɛw no, ndɔmmum akɔ Egypt; na ɔbɔtwe no ho mfe bi efi kwaamu afamu ɔhen no ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔbɛba pomu afamu ɔhen no n’ahenman mu dze, naaso ɔbɛsan akɔ nankasa n’asaase do.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ne mba bedzi ako, na wɔaboa dɔm akɛse pii ano a wobeyir apram do dɛ nsu: na wɔbɛsan ebedzi ako ekodu n’abankɛse no ho mpo.
title: DANIEL

text: Na pomu afamu hen n’enyi bɛber, na oepue nye kwaamu afamu hen no akɔko; na kwaamu afamu hen no dze nyimpadodow kɛse begyina hɔ, naaso wobedzi nkogu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na pomu afamu hen no bɔsoɛr, na n’akoma ama noho do: na ɔbɛka mpem du du egu famu, naaso orinndzi nyim nnkyɛr.
title: DANIEL

text: Na kwaamu afamu hen no bɛsan dze nyimpadodow a wɔdɔɔ so sen kan no dze no ebegyina; na ɔdze rokɔ mfe bi ekyir no, ɔbɛsan dze dɔm kɛse na ndzɛmba pii aba.
title: DANIEL

text: Na mber no mu no, pii bɔsoɛr etsia pomu afamu hen no; nkyii so wo man mu akakabemfo mba bɛmema hɔnho do dɛ wɔbɛma enyido adzehu no etsim; na wɔbɔhwehwe ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna kwaamu afamu hen no bɛba abɔhɔr pempe, na ɔafa kurow a ɔagye ho ban dzendzen no: na pomu afamu akofo, anaa no dɔm a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn no runntum nngyina, eso worinnya ahoɔdzen bi nngyina.
title: DANIEL

text: Na nyia ɔbɛba no do no bɛyɛ dza nankasa pɛ, na obiara nnkotum n’enyim gyina. Na obegyina asaase fɛɛfɛw no do, na ɔdze ne nsa asɛɛ no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔdze besi n’enyim dɛ ɔdze n’ahenman ahoɔdzen nyina reba, na tɔɔtsenyɛfo ka no ho; na ɔbɛyɛ n’apɛdze: na ɔdze mbaa babaa no ama no, dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ no; na orinngyina, eso ɔronnko hɔ mma no.
title: DANIEL

text: Iyi ekyir no ɔbɛdan n’enyi akɔ nsupruw do, na ɔafa dodowara: na ɔsafohen bi bɛma oegyaa ahorohoraa a ɔhyɛ no hyɛ; naaso mpo, ɔbɛma n’ahorohoraa no adan ebua nankasa n’etsifi.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna ɔbɛdan n’enyi akɔ nankasa n’asaase do akoban no do: naaso obefintsiw ahwe ase, na worunnhu no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na obi bɔsoɛr egyina n’ananmu a ɔbɛma towgyegyenyi pempensinyi bi edua ɔman no n’enyimnyam mu; na wɔbɛsɛɛ no nda kumaabi mu, nnyɛ ebufuw mu, anaa ɔko mu a.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔkwasampanyi bi bɔsoɛr n’ananmu a wɔmmfaa ahendzi no n’enyimnyam mmaa no: na ɔbɛba no ahodweber mu, na ɔdze adzɛfɛdzɛfɛsɛm ebosuo ahendzi no mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔdze nsuyirii abasa bɛpram hɔn efi n’enyim, na woebubu hɔn; nyew, ahyɛmu safohen no so
title: DANIEL

text: Na nkabɔmu a wɔnye no bɛyɛ no ekyir, ɔbɛyɛ no ndaadaa mu: na ɔbɔfow aba, na ɔdze dɔm kakrabaa bi bɛba abɛyɛ dzen.
title: DANIEL

text: Ahodweber mu na obotu aba asaase no do mbrɛ ɔyɛ fɔɔfɔɔ; na ɔbɛyɛ dza n’egyanom, anaa n’egyanom hɔn egyanom nnyɛɛ pɛn; ɔbɛpetse afodze, na asadze, na ahodze ama hɔn. Nyew, ɔbɛhyehyɛ ne tsirmu nhyehyɛɛ wɔ akoban no mu ma ekodu ber bi.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔdze dɔm kɛse bekenyan no tum na ne ndam etsia pomu afamu hen no; na pomu afamu hen dze dɔm a ɔyɛ dzen pii pa botu sa abɔko: naaso orinngyina, osiandɛ wɔbɔkɔ ne tsir do apam.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɛhɛɛ, hɔn a wodzi n’edziban na wɔbɛsɛɛ no, na no dɔm no bɛpram do na atɔfo pii ahwehwe ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ahemfo beenu no dze, hɔn akoma bɛyɛ emumuyɛ, na wɔbɛka atorsɛm wɔ edzidzipon kor do: na orunnwie yie; na ewiei no bɛba ara wɔ ber a wɔahyɛ.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna kwaamuhen no dze ahodze kɛse bɛsan akɔ nankasa n’asaase do; naaso n’akoma betsia ahyɛmu krɔnkrɔn no, na ɔayɛ n’apɛdze, na ɔasan akɔ nankasa n’asaase do.
title: DANIEL

text: Ber a wɔahyɛ no mu na ɔbɛsan aba pomu afamu; na ekyir dze no rennyɛ dɛ kan dze no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na Kittim ahɛn bɛba no do; na n’akoma botu na ɔasan, na oenya ebufuw wɔ ahyɛmu krɔnkrɔn no do, na ɔayɛ n’apɛdze: ɔbɛsan mpo, na n’enyi aba hɔn a wɔapow ahyɛmu krɔnkrɔn no do.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔdze nsordaafo begyina n’afamu, na wobogu krɔnkrɔn bea no ho fi, mekyerɛ abankɛse no mpo, na woeyi daa ɔhyew afɔr no wɔ hɔ, na wɔdze amamfoyɛ ekyiwadze a ɔbɔ man no ebesi hɔ.
title: DANIEL

text: Na hɔn a wɔbɔ ahyɛmu no ho mbusu no, ɔdze adzɛfɛdzɛfɛw bɛsɛɛ hɔn: naaso ɔman a wonyim hɔn Nyankopɔn no dze, hɔn ho bɛyɛ dzen, na wɔayɛ adze.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔman no mu hɔn a wonyim nyansa no, wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ nyimpa pii: naaso wɔbɔtotɔ afona ano na ogyaframee mu, ndɔmmumfa na afofa mu, nda pii.
title: DANIEL

text: Na sɛ wɔbɔhwehwe ase a, wɔdze mboa kakrabaa bi bɔboa hɔn: na nyimpa pii dze adzɛfɛdzɛfɛw dze hɔnho bɛbata hɔn ho.
title: DANIEL

text: Na hɔn mu binom a wɔyɛ enyansafo no, wɔbɔtotɔ, dɛ wɔrosɔ hɔn ahwɛ, na wɔapɔw hɔn ho, na wɔahoa hɔn ho fitaa, ekesi ewiei aber no do: osiandɛ ɔbɛkyɛr ekodu aber a wɔahyɛ no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔhen no bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ; na ɔbɛma noho do, na oedzi bosom biara do ekromponsɛm, na wɔaka anwanwasɛm etsia enyame mu Nyame: na obesi no yie ara ekodu dɛ ebufuhyew no bɛsa; na dza woesua apaa do no, wɔbɛyɛ.
title: DANIEL

text: Eso orummbu n’egyanom abosom anaa mbaa hɔn ahwehwɛdze no bi, eso orummbu bosom biara bi. Na obohuhor noho wɔ adze nyina do.
title: DANIEL

text: Na n’ananmu na obedzi abankɛse bosom no nyi: na bosom a n’egyanom nnyim no no na ɔdze sika, na dwetɛ, na aboɔdzembo, na afɛɛfɛdze bedzi no nyi.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔdze bosom nanaben no mboa bɛyɛ abankɛse dzendzenndzen no ho adze; obiara a obu no bi no, ɔdze enyimnyam bɛyɛ no kɛse: na ɔbɛma woedzi dodowara do tum, na wɔakyɛ asaase no ayɛ akatua.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ewiei ber no mu na pomu afamu hen no ɔnye no befimfen: na kwaamu afamu hen no dze ntseaseanam, na mpɔnkɔdofo, na ahɛn pii bɛba no do dɛ kyinehyia mframa; na ɔbɛkɛhɛn nkurow nkurow no mu, na ɔapram do.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔbɛhɛn asaase fɛɛfɛw no so do, na wobobutuw nkurow nkurow pii: na yinom dze, wɔbɛgye hɔn efi ne nsamu: Edom, na Moab, na Ammonmba mu etsitsir no.
title: DANIEL

text: Ɔbɛtsen ne nsa so wɔ nkurow nkurow no do: na Egypt asaase nnkefi nsa.
title: DANIEL

text: Na obenya sika na dwetɛ akoradze na Egypt ndzɛmba a ɔsom bo nyinara edzi do tum: na Libiyafo na Etiopiafo bedzi n’anamɔn ekyir
title: DANIEL

text: Na nsɛm a ofi boka na kwaamu afamu bɛhaw no: na ɔdze enyiber kɛse epue akɔ dɛ ɔrekɛsɛɛ na ɔadwerew nyimpa pii huntuhuntu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔdze n’ahemfi ntamadan no besi po na enyimnyam bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no ntamu; naaso ɔbɛba n’ewiei, na obiara rommboa no.
title: DANIEL

text: Ber no na Maekɛl, ɔbɔfo tsitsir no, bɔsoɛr egyina: na ahohiaber bɛba a ofitsi dɛ aman bɔbɔɔ adze besi ber no mu ɔmmbaa da: ber no na wɔbɛgye wo man no mu obiara a wobohu no dɛ wɔakyerɛw ne dzin wɔ nwoma no mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na hɔn mu piinara a wɔadeda famu wɔ dɛtse mu no, wobenyan, binom akɔ daa nkwa mu, na binom akɔ enyimguase na daa sesar mu.
title: DANIEL

text: Na hɔn a wonyim nyansa no, wɔbɛhyerɛn dɛ wimu hyerɛn; na hɔn a wɔdan piinara kɔ tsenenee mu no, wɔbɛhyerɛn dɛ nworaba afebɔɔ.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔwo Daniel dze, tow nsɛm no mu, na sɔw nwoma no ano, na onkodu ewiei ber no: piinara boguan edzi akɔnaaba, na nyimdzee adɔɔ so.
title: DANIEL

text: Nna emi Daniel muhun dɛ mbanyin afofor beenu gyina hɔ, ɔbaako wɔ esutsen no kɔn do afa kor, na ɔbaako so wɔ esutsen no kɔn do afa kor.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔbaako bisaa nyimpa no a ofura ndwera no a ɔwɔ esutsen no etsifi no dɛ, Ɔbɛkyɛr ekodu dabɛn ana anwanwadze yinom ewiei aba mu?
title: DANIEL

text: Na metsee dɛ nyimpa a ofura ndwera no a ɔwɔ esutsen no etsifi no, na ɔmaa ne nyimfa na ne bankum do kyerɛɛ sor, na ɔkaa nyia ɔtse ase daa no ntam no see dɛ obodu mfe ebiasa na fa; na sɛ wowie ɔman krɔnkrɔn no n’ahoɔdzen mu bubu a, nna wobowie ndzɛmba yinom nyina.
title: DANIEL

text: Na metsee, na manntse ase: nna mesee dɛ, Ao mo wura, ndzɛmba yi ewiei bɛyɛ dɛn?
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Daniel, kɔ wo kwan: na wɔatotow nsɛm no mu, wɔasɔw ano, dze rikesi ewiei ber.
title: DANIEL

text: Piinara bɛtsew hɔnho, ahoa hɔnho, apɔw hɔnho; na emumuyɛfo bɔkɔ do ara ayɛ emumuyɛ; na emumuyɛfo biara renntse ase: na hɔn a wɔyɛ enyansafo no na wɔbɛtse ase.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ofitsi ber a wobeyi daa ɔhyew afɔr no wɔ hɔ, na wɔdze amamfoyɛ ekyiwadze a ɔbɔ ɔman no esi hɔ no, yɛ nda apem ahaenu eduokron.
title: DANIEL

text: Osiarfo nye nyia ɔrotweɔn ekodu nda apem ahaasa eduasa enum do no.
title: DANIEL

text: Na ɔwo Daniel dze, hom do araa kodu ewiei: na ebɔkɔ w’ahomgye mu, na ebɔsoɛr ekenya wo kyɛfa wɔ nda no ewiei.
title: DANIEL

text: Iyi nye EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔbaa Beeri ba Hosea hɔ, wɔ Juda ahemfo Uzia, Jotam, Ahaz, na Hezekia nda mu, na Israelhen Jeroboam a ɔyɛ Joas ne ba no ne nda mu no.
title: HOSEA

text: Ber a EWURADZE nam Hosea do kasaa asɔpɔn no, EWURADZE see Hosea dɛ, Kɔ, kɛfa ɔbaa edwaman na ndwaman mba war: na asaase no efi EWURADZE nkyɛn rogor ndwamangor kɛse.
title: HOSEA

text: Nna ɔkɔree kɛfaa Diblaim ne babaa Gomer; na onyinsenii woo babanyin maa no.
title: HOSEA

text: Na EWURADZE kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, To no dzin Jezreel; osiandɛ aka kakra ma meebedzi Jezreel no bɔgyaa ho wer wɔ Jehu fi do, na maama Israel fi ahendzi no abɔ adze.
title: HOSEA

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no mubobubu Israel egyen mu wɔ Jezreel bɔnsa mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Na onyinseen bio na ɔwoo babaa. Na EWURADZE see no dɛ, To no dzin Lo-ruhama a ne nkyerɛase nye nyia oennhu no mbɔbɔr: osiandɛ merennda ho nnhu Israel fi mbɔbɔr, na medze akyɛ hɔn bio.
title: HOSEA

text: Na mubohu Juda fi mbɔbɔr na magye hɔn nkwa, wɔ EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn no mu, naaso menndze egyen, anaa afona, anaa akodze, mpɔnkɔ, anaa mpɔnkɔdofo.
title: HOSEA

text: Na otwaa Lo-ruhama enumfo no, onyinsenii, na ɔwoo babanyin.
title: HOSEA

text: Na EWURADZE see dɛ, To no dzin Lo-ammi ase nye dɛ ɔnnyɛ me man: osiandɛ hom nnyɛ me man, na mo so mennyɛ hom Nyankopɔn.
title: HOSEA

text: Naaso Israelmba hɔn dodow bɛyɛ dɛ mpoano anhwea a wonnsusu eso wɔnnkan; na ɔbɛba dɛ fakor a wɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nnyɛ me man no, wɔbɛse hɔn dɛ, Hom yɛ Nyame tseasefo mba.
title: HOSEA

text: Na Judamba na Israelmba bɔbɔ mu ehyia na wɔahyɛ otsitsir kor ama hɔnho, na wɔafow efi asaase no do akɔ: na Jezreel da no bɛyɛ da kɛse.
title: HOSEA

text: Hom nse hom nuanom mbanyin dɛ, Ammi, ase nye dɛ me man; na hom nkyerɛbaa dɛ, Ruhama a ne nkyerɛase nye nyia oehu no mbɔbɔr.
title: HOSEA

text: Hom nye hom na nkasa, hom nye no nkasa; na ɔnnyɛ me yer, na mo so mennyɛ no kun: na hom mma onyi no ndwamanyɛ no mfi n’enyi do, na n’awarto mfi n’enumfo ntamu;
title: HOSEA

text: amma maammpa no ho tam ma oeenndzi adagyaw, na maammfa no ennsi hɔ dɛ da a wɔwoo no no, na maannyɛ no dɛ sar do, na maammfa no ennsi hɔ dɛ asaase kɛsɛɛ, na maammfa nsukɔm ennku no;
title: HOSEA

text: nyew, munnkohu ne mba mbɔbɔr; osiandɛ wɔyɛ ndwaman mba.
title: HOSEA

text: Na hɔn na akɔgor ndwamangor: nyia onyinseen hɔn no ayɛ enyitodze: na ɔka dɛ, Mibedzi mo nwewefo ekyir, hɔn a wɔma me m’edziban na mo nsu, mo nguannhwi na m’asaaba, mo ngo na me nsa.
title: HOSEA

text: Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, medze nsoɛ besi no kwan do ban, na matow ɔfasu esiw n’enyim, na onnkohu no kwan mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Na obetsiw no nwewefo, na ɔronnto hɔn; na ɔbɔhwehwɛ hɔn ekyir kwan, na onnkohu hɔn: nna ɔbɛse dɛ, Mebɛsan m’ekyir akɔ mo kun a odzi kan no nkyɛn; na aber no mu no nna oye ma me sen seseiara.
title: HOSEA

text: Na oennhu dɛ emi na memaa no eburow, na nsa, na ngo, na memaa dwetɛ na sika dɔree maa no a wɔhweree maa Baal no.
title: HOSEA

text: Dɛm ntsi mebɛsan abɛgye m’eburow wɔ n’aber mu, na me nsa wɔ ne hyɛber mu, na meyi mo nguannhwi na m’asaaba a nkyɛ ɔbɛkata n’adagyaw do no.
title: HOSEA

text: Na afei mebɛda no ndwamandze edzi wɔ no nwewefo enyim, na obiara renngye no mmfi me nsamu.
title: HOSEA

text: Eso mebɛma n’enyigye nyina abɔ adze, n’afahyɛ, n’abosoom fofor, na n’ahomgyenda, na n’ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn nyina.
title: HOSEA

text: Na mebɛsɛɛ no wenyinndua na n’adɔmbandua a ɔaka wɔ ho dɛ, Yinom nye m’apɛdze a mo nwewefo dze ama me: na mebɛdan no kwaa, na hamu mbowa bedzi.
title: HOSEA

text: Na medze nda a ɔdze maa Baalim a ɔhyeew afɔr maa no, ber a ɔdze asowamuadze na ndwindze hyehyɛɛ noho, na okedzii no nwewefo ekyir, na emi dze no werɛ fiir me no, bɛba abɔhwe n’etsifi, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: HOSEA

text: Dɛm ntsi, hwɛ, mebɛdzɛfɛdzɛfɛw no, na medze no aba sar no do, na maka no awerɛkyekyesɛm.
title: HOSEA

text: Na mifi hɔ edze no wenyin nture bɛma no, na Akor mbɔnsa no na ɔayɛ enyidado abow, na ɔbɛgye do wɔ hɔ, dɛ ne nkataasiaber nda mu, na dɛ da a ofi Egypt asaase do bae no mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no mu, EWURADZE na ɔse, ɔwo ebɛfrɛ me Isi, ase nye dɛ mo kun; na eremmfrɛ me Baali a ase nye me Baal no bio.
title: HOSEA

text: Na mibeyi Baal ahorow edzin efi w’anomu, na wɔremmfa hɔn edzin mmfrɛ wo bio.
title: HOSEA

text: Na da no mu menye hambowa bedzi ahyɛmu ama wo, na wimu ntumbowa, na famu aweaweambowa: na mubobubu afona na egyen akodzi mu efi asaase no do, na mama wɔatsena hɔ dwudwoodwo.
title: HOSEA

text: Na mebɛgye wo ayewar ama moho afebɔɔ; ampaara, mebɛgye wo ayewar wɔ tsenenee, na atsɛmbu, na adɔyɛ, na mbɔbɔrhu mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Mebɛgye wo ayewar koraa mama moho wɔ nokwardzi mu: na ɔwo bohu EWURADZE.
title: HOSEA

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ da no, mebɛgye do, EWURADZE na ɔse, Mebɛgye ɔsor do, na hɔn so agye asaase do;
title: HOSEA

text: na asaase agye eburow, na nsa, na ngo do: na hɔn so agye Jezreel do.
title: HOSEA

text: Na mubodua wo asaase no do ama moho; na mehu nyia wonnhu no mbɔbɔr no mbɔbɔr; na mase hɔn a nkyɛ wɔnnyɛ me man no dɛ, Me man nye wo; na hɔn so wɔase me dɛ, Me Nyankopɔn.
title: HOSEA

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Kɔ bio kɔdɔ ɔbaa edwamambɔnyi a ɔyɛ ɔwartofo, dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE adɔ Israelmba, naaso wɔdan kɔ abosom fofor hɔ, na wɔdɔ esikyireamba tatar no.
title: HOSEA

text: Dɛm ntsi medze dwetɛbona duenum, na atoko homer kor, na fa tɔɔ no:
title: HOSEA

text: na mesee no dɛ, Tsena hɔ ma me nda pii; mma nngor ndwamangor, eso mma nnyɛ banyin bi yer: dɛm na mo so mebɛyɛ ama wo.
title: HOSEA

text: Na Israelmba bɛtsena hɔ nda pii dɛ wonnyi hen, na wonnyi safohen, na wonnyi okum afɔr, na wonnyi dum, na wonnyi asɔfontar (efod) anaa ebusua ehonyi (terafim) biara.
title: HOSEA

text: N’ekyir no Israelmba bɛsan, na wɔabɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn n’ekyir kwan, na hɔn hen David; na wɔdze suro aba hɔn EWURADZE na n’ayamuyie nkyɛn wɔ ekyir nda no mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Israelmba, hom ntsie EWURADZE n’asɛm: na EWURADZE nye asaase no do atsefo enya asɛm, osiandɛ nokwar, na mbɔbɔrhu, na Nyankopɔn ho nyimdzee nnyi asaase no do.
title: HOSEA

text: Hwee nnyi hɔ dɛ ntanka, mbrato, ewudzi, adzewia, na awarto; wɔtoto araa ma bɔgyaka toa bɔgyaka do.
title: HOSEA

text: Dɛm ntsi asaase no bedzi awerɛhow, na obiara a ɔtse do no n’enyim bosuam, ɔnye hambowa na wimu ntumbowa; nyew, po mu nam so bɛsa.
title: HOSEA

text: Naaso mma nyimpa biara nndzi aper, anaa nyimpa biara nntwuw enyim; na wo man tse dɛ hɔn a wɔnye ɔsɔfo no dzi aper.
title: HOSEA

text: Na ibefintsiw ewiaber, na nkɔnhyɛnyi no so nye wo befintsiw anadwe; na mebɛsɛɛ wo na.
title: HOSEA

text: Nyimdzee a onnyi hɔ ntsi, wɔresɛɛ me man: na ɔwo so, osiandɛ apow nyimdzee ntsi, mo so mobɔpow wo, dɛ ennda ho nndzi mo sɔfoe na wo werɛ efir wo Nyankopɔn ne mbra ntsi, mo so mo werɛ befir wo mba.
title: HOSEA

text: Wɔmaa wɔdɔree ntsi nna wɔyɛɛ bɔn tsiaa me a: mebɛdan hɔn enyimnyam enyimguase.
title: HOSEA

text: Wodzidzi me man no bɔn ho, na wɔdze hɔn akoma si hɔn emumuyɛ do.
title: HOSEA

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, mbrɛ ɔman tse no, mbrɛ ɔsɔfo so tse ara nye no: na mebɛtsea hɔn wɔ hɔn abrabɔ ho, na metua hɔn kaw wɔ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ ho.
title: HOSEA

text: Na wobedzidzi, na wɔremmee; wɔbɛyɛ ndwaman, na wɔronndɔr: osiandɛ woegyaa dɛ wobu EWURADZE bi.
title: HOSEA

text: Ndwamanyɛ na nsa na nsa fofor yi ntseasee fi hɔ.
title: HOSEA

text: Me man bisa hɔn ndusin hɔ apam, na hɔn poma ka asɛm kyerɛ hɔn osiandɛ hɔn ndwamanyɛ sunsum ama wɔafom, na woefi hɔn Nyankopɔn ase akɛyɛ ndwamandze.
title: HOSEA

text: Wɔbɔ afɔr wɔ mbepɔw etsifi, na wɔhyew nduhuam wɔ akoko do, wɔ esudur na nduahen na ndutan ase, osiandɛ no nwin ye: ntsi na hom mbabaa gor ndwamangor, na hom nyefor toto awar no.
title: HOSEA

text: Sɛ hom mbabaa gor ndwamangor, na hom nyefor toto awar a, merenntsea hɔn; osiandɛ mbanyin no ara so nye ndwaman no man nkyɛn, na wɔnye abosom mfonabaa bɔ afɔr: na ɔman a wonnyi ntseasee no wobobutuw no.
title: HOSEA

text: Kaansa ɔwo, Israel, gor ndwamangor mpo a, mma Juda nndzi so. Na mma hom mmba Gilgal, eso mma hom mmfow nnkɔ Bɛt-aven, anaa mma hom nnka ntam dɛ, Dɛ EWURADZE tse ase yi.
title: HOSEA

text: Na Israel ayɛ asoɔdzendze, dɛ nantwiburwa ɔsoɔdzenfo: afei na EWURADZE bɛnyɛn hɔn dɛ eguambaa wɔ bea tɛtɛr do.
title: HOSEA

text: Efraim dze noho akɔbɔ abosom ho; hom ngyaa no.
title: HOSEA

text: Hɔn nsanom atra do: wɔgor ndwamangor daa; hɔn etsitsir pɛ enyimguase pa ara.
title: HOSEA

text: Mframa edura no ho ahyɛ hɔn ntsaban mu; na hɔn enyi bɔto hɔn okum afɔr ho.
title: HOSEA

text: Hom asɔfo e, hom ntsie yi, na hom Israel fi hom nkyɛn aso, na ɔhen ne fiemba e, hom nyɛ aso, na hom do na atsɛmbu no aba; na hom ayɛ efir wɔ Mizpa, na eboa a wɔatserɛw mu wɔ Tabor etsifi.
title: HOSEA

text: Na etuatsewfo no enya ewu ndzii; na emi na meka hɔn nyina hɔn enyim.
title: HOSEA

text: Minyim Efraim, na Israel so nnsuma me: na afei, ao Efraim, ayɛ ndwamandze, Israel no ho egu fi.
title: HOSEA

text: Hɔn ndzeyɛɛ remma wɔnnsan mmba hɔn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn: na ndwamanyɛ sunsum wɔ hɔn mu, na wonnyim EWURADZE.
title: HOSEA

text: Na Israel ahopɔw dzi n’enyim dase dɛm ntsi Israel na Efraim befintsiw wɔ hɔn emumuyɛ mu: Juda so nye hɔn befintsiw.
title: HOSEA

text: Wɔdze hɔn nguan na hɔn anantwi bɔkɔ akɔhwehwɛ EWURADZE: na worunnhu no osiandɛ ɔatwe noho efi hɔn nkyɛn.
title: HOSEA

text: Woetwa EWURADZE nkontompɔ; na wɔawowo anana mba: afei bosoom fofor bɛmen hɔn nye hɔn kyɛfa.
title: HOSEA

text: Hom mbɔ abɛn no mu wɔ Gibea, na akasamu no mu wɔ Rama: hom mbɔ ehuu wɔ Bɛt-aven; Benjamin e, w’ekyir a.
title: HOSEA

text: Efraim bɛyɛ amamfo wɔ nkaenyim da no mu: dza ɔbɛba ara ampa na mama woehu wɔ Israel mbusuakuw mu no.
title: HOSEA

text: Juda asafohen ayɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔtwe ɔhe pin ekyir: mubohue m’ebufuw egu hɔn do dɛ nsu.
title: HOSEA

text: Efraim tseetsee, wɔadwerew no atsɛmbu mu; osiandɛ no bo dwee dɛ obedzi egyangyandze ekyir.
title: HOSEA

text: Dɛm ntsi na mayɛ dɛ awebowa ama Efraim, na dɛ nhuhunii ama Juda fi.
title: HOSEA

text: Ber a Efraim hun ne yarba, na Juda hun n’epirakur no, nna Efraim sii mu kɔr Asiria, na ɔsomae kɔr ɔhen Jareb nkyɛn: naaso orunntum nnsa wo yarba, eso ɔremma wo pirakur no nnsa.
title: HOSEA

text: Na emi dze, mebɛyɛ dɛ gyata ama Efraim, na dɛ gyatafɔr ama Juda fi. Emi, emi mara, na mebɛtsetsew mu na makɔ; mebɛfa akɔ, na obi nnyi hɔ a ɔbɛgye nkwa.
title: HOSEA

text: Mebɛsan akɔ me beebi, ekodu dɛ wobohu hɔn mfom, na wɔbɔhwehwɛ m’enyim: hɔn ahohia mu na wɔbɔhwehwɛ me enyiberdo.
title: HOSEA

text: Hom mbra ma yɛnsan nkɔ EWURADZE nkyɛn. Oepirapira hɛn naaso ɔbɛsa hɛn yarba; ɔabobɔ hɛn a, ɔbɛkyekyer hɛn epirakur.
title: HOSEA

text: Nda ebien ekyir no, ɔbɛma yeenya nkwa bio: da a otsia ebiasa no, ɔbɛma yɛasoɛr, na yɛatsena ase wɔ n’enyim.
title: HOSEA

text: Na hom mma yenhu, hom mma yɛnka do nhu EWURADZE; no mpuei si pi dɛ adzekyee: na ɔbɛba hɛn nkyɛn dɛ nyankom, dɛ ekyir nyankom a ɔfɔw asaase.
title: HOSEA

text: Ao Efraim, menyɛ wo dɛn? Ao Juda, menyɛ wo dɛn? Hom papayɛ tse dɛ anapa fua, na dɛ ɔbɔsu a ɔpɛ ntsɛm wew.
title: HOSEA

text: Dɛm ntsi na medze nkɔnhyɛfo no etwitwa hɔn egu; na medze m’anomunsɛm ekuku hɔn: na m’atsɛmbu tse dɛ kan a opue.
title: HOSEA

text: Na morohwehwɛ ehumbɔbɔr, na nnyɛ okum afɔr a; na Nyame ho nyimdzee sen ɔhyew afɔr.
title: HOSEA

text: Na hɔn dze, wɔtse dɛ Adam a wɔato ahyɛmu no: hɔ na woetwa me nkontompɔ.
title: HOSEA

text: Gilead yɛ emumuyɛfo kurow, bɔgya akeka no ho.
title: HOSEA

text: Mbrɛ edwotwafo dɔm tsɛw nyimpa no, dɛmara na asɔfokuw no dzi ewu wɔ Sekem afamu kwan no mu: nyew, wɔayɛ ebusudze ampa.
title: HOSEA

text: Mehu enyinyandze wɔ Israel fi mu: hɔ na wohu ndwamandze wɔ Efraim, Israel ho egu fi.
title: HOSEA

text: Juda e, hɔ ara so na wɔahyɛ otwaber ama wo, ber a medze me man ndɔmmumkɔfo no bɛsan aba no.
title: HOSEA

text: Ber a nkyɛ mepɛ dɛ mesa Israel yarba no, nna Efraim emumuyɛ na Samaria ndzebɔn ada edzi; na wodzi atorsɛm: na owifo hɛn mu, na edwotwafo dɔm fa afo wɔ gua do.
title: HOSEA

text: Na wɔnndwen hɔn akoma mu dɛ mekaa hɔn ndzebɔn nyina: afei hɔnankasa hɔn ndzeyɛɛ etwa hɔn ho ehyia wɔ m’enyim.
title: HOSEA

text: Wɔdze hɔn ndzebɔn ma ɔhen n’enyi gye, na wɔdze hɔn atorsɛm ma mbapɔmba no so enyi gye.
title: HOSEA

text: Hɔn nyina yɛ awartofo; wɔtse dɛ fononoo a boodootofo ekua mu gya; ogyaa gya no mu kua fi mbɔrfetsew do kesii ne kawee do.
title: HOSEA

text: Hɛn hen n’afahyɛ da no mu asafohen no maa nsahyew bɔɔ hɔn yar; na wɔnye atwetwesifo dzii afora.
title: HOSEA

text: Na woesiesie hɔn akoma dɛ fononoo, ber a wɔda atsɛwee mu no: hɔn boodootofo da anadwe nyina; anapa no ɔdzɛw dɛ ogya framee.
title: HOSEA

text: Hɔn nyinara adɔ dɛ fononoo, na wɔmemen hɔn atsɛmbufo; hɔn ahemfo nyinara ahwehwe ase: obi nnyi hɔn mu a ɔfrɛ me.
title: HOSEA

text: Efraim dze noho aforafora aman mu; Efraim yɛ tatar a enyinyan.
title: HOSEA

text: Anana edzi n’ahoɔdzen, na onnyim: nyew, gon so apetse ne tsirmu na ɔnodze onnyim.
title: HOSEA

text: Na Israel ahopɔw dzi n’enyim dase: naaso wɔnnsanee mmbaa EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn hɔ, eso wɔnnhwehwɛɛ no, wɔ iyi nyina ntsi.
title: HOSEA

text: Na Efraim tse dɛ ebubur kotobonyi a onnyi ntseasee: wɔrefrɛ mboa fi Egypt no nna wɔredan Asiria so.
title: HOSEA

text: Wɔrokɔ a, mebɛtserɛw mo boa mu akata hɔn do; mubodwir hɔn dɛ wimu ntumbowa: mebɛtsea hɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mboanofo no atse no.
title: HOSEA

text: Wondue! Osiandɛ woefi me nkyɛn abɔ ko; ɔsɛɛ nto hɔn! Osiandɛ wɔato me mbra: na sɛ nkyɛ mobɔpon hɔn mpo a, woedzi mo ho atorsɛm.
title: HOSEA

text: Na wonnsui mmfrɛɛ me hɔn akoma mu, na wɔkeka mu wɔ hɔn mpa do: eburow na nsa ntsi na wohyia, wɔtsew mo do etua.
title: HOSEA

text: Makyerɛkyerɛ hɔn abasa na mahyɛ no dzen nyinara ekyir no mpo, hɔn dze, wosusu mbusu wɔ mo ho.
title: HOSEA

text: San dze, wɔsan, naaso nnyɛ ɔsorsornyi no ne nkyɛn bi a; wɔtse dɛ egyen daadaafo: wɔ hɔn tɛkyerɛma nsɛmpii ntsi, hɔn asafohen bɔtotɔ afona ano: na iyi bɛyɛ hɔn atwetwesi wɔ Egypt asaase do.
title: HOSEA

text: Fa akasamu no tua w’ano. Ɔbɛba EWURADZE fi no do dɛ ɔkɔr: osiandɛ wɔafomfom m’ahyɛmu, na wɔato me mbra.
title: HOSEA

text: Wobosu afrɛ me dɛ, Me Nyankopɔn, hɛn Israelfo dze, yenyim wo.
title: HOSEA

text: Israel atow dza oye akyen: na ɔtamfo no betsiw no.
title: HOSEA

text: Woesisi ahen, naaso ommfi emi; wɔahyehyɛ asafohen, na minnyim: wɔdze hɔn dwetɛ na hɔn sika ayeyɛ abosom amema hɔnho, ama woeetwa hɔn akyen.
title: HOSEA

text: Ao Samaria, wɔatow wo nantwiburwa no akyen; m’ebufuw asɔ etsia hom: onkodu dabɛn ara ana hom etum ɔbra a no ho tsew bɔ?
title: HOSEA

text: Na Israel mu na iyi so fi; odwimfo yɛe, na ɔnnyɛ Nyame bi: nyew, Samaria nantwiburwa no wobobubu no pɔsɔpɔsɔ.
title: HOSEA

text: Na wodua mframa, na wobobu ekyinehyia mframa: onnyi eburow a ogyinae; bɛtsem no remma isiam; na sɛ ɔma bi mpo a, ananaben bedzi.
title: HOSEA

text: Wɔamen Israel: afei wɔtse amanaman mu dɛ kuraba a enyi biara nnsɔ no.
title: HOSEA

text: Na wɔafow kɔ Asiria, dɛ sar do asoaso a no nko atsew noho: Efraim abɔ adɔfo paa.
title: HOSEA

text: Nyew, kaansa wɔbobɔ apaa wɔ amanaman mu mpo a, afei na mobɔboa hɔn ano; osiandɛ hɔn ho ahyɛ ase rusuar wɔ ahemfo mu hen no n’adzesoa ntsi.
title: HOSEA

text: Ɔnam dɛ Efraim ama afɔrmbukyia adɔɔ so dze ayɛ bɔn ntsi, afɔrmbukyia adan no bɔnyɛ.
title: HOSEA

text: Makyerɛw me mbra wɔ ahyɛdze mpemdu mu ama hɔn naaso, wobu no ananadze.
title: HOSEA

text: Na m’ayɛyɛdze okum afɔr no ho dze, wɔdze nam bɔ okum afɔr, na wodzi; na EWURADZE enyi nnsɔ: afei na ɔbɛkaa hɔn emumuyɛ, na ɔabɛsera hɔn bɔn; wɔbɛsan akɔ Egypt.
title: HOSEA

text: Na Israel no werɛ efir no Bɔfo, na oesisi ahemfi; na Juda ama nkurow a wɔabɔ ho ban no adɔɔ so: na mobɔto no nkurow no mu gya, na ɔamemen n’aban no.
title: HOSEA

text: Israel e, mma nndzi ehurusi wɔ enyigye ntsi, dɛ aman no; na efi wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn akɛyɛ ndwamandze, adɔ apɛdze wɔ ewuporow pia nyina do.
title: HOSEA

text: Ewuporow na nsatwer rennyɛn hɔn, na nsa fofor no bɔbɔ hɔn.
title: HOSEA

text: Wɔrenntsena EWURADZE n’asaase do; na Efraim bɛsan akɔ Egypt, na wobedzi edziban a ho nntsew wɔ Asiria.
title: HOSEA

text: Wonnkohue nsa afɔrbɔdze egu ama EWURADZE, eso hɔn ho nnkɛyɛ no enyisɔ: hɔn kum afɔr bɛyɛ hɔn dɛ awerɛhofo edziban; hɔn a wodzi bi nyina ho bogu fi: na hɔn edziban no wɔdze bɛsa hɔn kɔm; ɔremmba EWURADZE fie.
title: HOSEA

text: Ebɛnadze na hom bɛyɛ no wɔ ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn da no, na EWURADZE afahyɛ da no mu?
title: HOSEA

text: Na, hwɛ, woefi ɔsɛɛ nkyɛn kɔ, naaso Egypt bɛtase hɔn, Memfis besie hɔn: hɔn dwetɛ edwindze fɛɛfɛw no nsason bɛfa: nsoɛ bɛba hɔn asesee mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Ɔsera nda no edu, ahyɛnanmu nda no edu; Israel bohu. Hom ka dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi yi yɛ ɔkwasea, nyimpa a ɔwɔ sunsum no egyim, wɔ hom emumuyɛ dodow na manso pii no ntsi.
title: HOSEA

text: Nkɔnhyɛnyi no nye me Nyankopɔn yɛ aweɔmfo ma Efraim: naaso nkɔnhyɛnyi no dze, anomasuafo efir wɔ n’akwan nyina mu, na wɔtan no wɔ ne Nyankopɔn fie mpo.
title: HOSEA

text: Woegu hɔnho fi pɔtɔɔ, dɛ Gibea nda no mu: ɔbɛkaa hɔn emumuyɛ, na ɔbɛsera hɔn bɔn.
title: HOSEA

text: Muhun Israel dɛ sar do wenyinaba: muhun hom egyanom dɛ adɔmbadua abakan wɔ ne beree ber a odzi kan no mu: na hɔn dze, wɔkɔr Baal-peor nkyɛn, na wohyiraa hɔnho do maa enyitodze, na wɔdandaan ekyiwadze dɛ dza wɔdɔɔ no no.
title: HOSEA

text: Efraim dze, hɔn enyimnyam botu akɔ dɛ anoma; abawoo, na abatur, na nyinsen nnkɛba hɔ.
title: HOSEA

text: Na sɛ wɔhwɛ hɔn mba ma wonyin mpo a, mebɛma woedzi awo mba ewu, amma nyimpa biara aannka; nyew, sɛ motwe moho fi hɔn nkyɛn so a, wondue!
title: HOSEA

text: Efraim, mehu no dɛ Taere a wɔatsɛw no asaase fɛɛfɛw do: naaso Efraim noara dze ne mba bopue akɛma okumfo no.
title: HOSEA

text: EWURADZE e, fa ma hɔn ɛ: ebɛnadze na edze bɛma? Ma hɔn awotoa a ɔpon ɔba, na numfo a atwentwem.
title: HOSEA

text: Hɔn emumuyɛ nyina wɔ Gilgal; na hɔ na mikyiir hɔn: osian hɔn ndzeyɛɛ n’emumuyɛ ntsi, mibeyi hɔn edzi efi me fie: moronndɔ hɔn bio; hɔn asafohen nyina etuatsewfo a.
title: HOSEA

text: Wɔabɔ Efraim adze, hɔn ndwow akyenkyen, wɔronnsow aba: nyew, sɛ wɔsow mpo a, mebɛsɛɛ hɔn yafun mu aba a wɔdɔ no no.
title: HOSEA

text: Me Nyankopɔn bɔtow hɔn egu, osiandɛ wɔannyɛ aso amma no: na wɔbɛyɛ awonawonafo wɔ amanaman mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Israel yɛ wenyindua prɔmprɔm a oyiyi n’aba: naaso mbrɛ n’aba dodow tse no, mbrɛ ɔama n’afɔrmbukyia adɔɔ so nye no: na mbrɛ n’asaase ne yie tse no, mbrɛ ɔayɛ abosondum fɛɛfɛw nye no.
title: HOSEA

text: Hɔn akoma mu apaa; afei na wobohu dɛ wodzi fɔ: EWURADZE bodwuruw hɔn afɔrmbukyia no, ɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn abosondum no.
title: HOSEA

text: Ampaara afei na wɔbɛse dɛ, Yennyi ɔhen: na yennsuro EWURADZE; na ɔhen no dze, obotum ayɛ ebɛnadze ama hɛn?
title: HOSEA

text: Wɔka nsɛnhun, wɔka ntanhun dzidzi ahyɛmu: dɛm ntsi na atsɛmbu fifir dɛ bɔr wɔ kwa mu akɔfi mu no.
title: HOSEA

text: Bɛt-aven anantwimba ho hu bɛka Samaria atsefo: na ne mamfo, na asɔfo a wodzi ho ehurusi no, bedzi nkɔmbɔ wɔ n’enyimnyam ho, osiandɛ oetu kɔ.
title: HOSEA

text: No so wɔdze bɔkɔ Asiria akɛkyɛ ɔhen Jareb: enyito bɛka Efraim, na Israel enyi ato wɔ n’apam ho.
title: HOSEA

text: Na Samaria dze, woetwa ne hen akyen dɛ nsuenyi ehur.
title: HOSEA

text: Aven nsorɔnsorɔmbea so a ɔyɛ Israel hɔn bɔn no, wɔbɛsɛɛ no: nsoɛ na nkɔkrɔw befifir hɔn afɔrmbukyia do; na wɔbɛse mbepɔw dɛ, Hom nkata hɛn do; na akoko dɛ, Hom nhwe hɛn do.
title: HOSEA

text: Ao Israel, ifitsi Gibea nda do na ayɛ bɔn: hɔ na wogyinae; amma ɔsa a wotuu no wɔ emumuyɛfo mba do no aannto hɔn wɔ Gibea.
title: HOSEA

text: Ber a mepɛ no, mebɛtsea hɔn; na wobehyiahyia aman aba hɔn do, ber a wɔdze hɔn emumuyɛ ho akatua aba hɔn do ebien no.
title: HOSEA

text: Na Efraim yɛ nantwifɔr a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ no a ɔpɛ ewuporow; na emi dze, matra aba no kɔn fɛɛfɛw no do: medze apɔnkɔdofo bɛba Efraim do; Juda bofuntum, Jakob bɔbobɔ n’afapo.
title: HOSEA

text: Hom ndua aba mma hom ho wɔ tsenenee mu, hom mbu no mbɔbɔrhu mu; hom ndɔw hom epe: na edu ber a wɔdze hwehwɛ EWURADZE ekyir kwan, ekesi dɛ ɔbɛba abɔtɔ ndzeyɛtsenenee nsu egu hom do.
title: HOSEA

text: Hom efuntum ndzebɔn, hom ebu emumuyɛ; hom edzi ator aba: na ɔwo, edze woho tweer wo kwan no do, na wo mbarimba akatakyi no hɔn dodow.
title: HOSEA

text: Dɛm ntsi weɔɔweɔɔyɛ bɔsoɛr wɔ wo man no mu, na wɔbɛsɛɛ w’abankɛse no nyinara, dɛ mbrɛ Salman sɛɛ Bɛt-arbel wɔ ɔko ber no mu: wɔtsetseew na nye ne mba mu esinesin.
title: HOSEA

text: Dɛmara so na Bɛtɛl, hom bɛyɛ wɔ hom emumuyɛ pii no ntsi: adze rebɛkye no, wobotwa Israelhen akyen koraa.
title: HOSEA

text: Ber a Israel yɛ abofra no, nna modɔɔ no na mefrɛɛ me ba fiir Egypt.
title: HOSEA

text: Mber dodow a mefrɛɛ hɔn no, mbrɛ wofii me nkyɛn kɔree nye no: wɔbɔɔ okum afɔr maa Baalim, na wɔhyeew eduhuam maa ehonyi a woegu.
title: HOSEA

text: Naaso emi na megyee Efraim taataa: mutuur hɔn me basa do; na bio, woennhu dɛ emi na mesaa hɔn yarba.
title: HOSEA

text: Onyimpa ahoma na medze twee hɔn, ɔdɔ ntampehoma a: na meyɛɛ dɛ hɔn a woyi kɔndua fi adadaw do maa hɔn, na medze edziban sisii hɔn enyim.
title: HOSEA

text: Wɔbɛsan akɔ Egypt asaase do bio; na Asirianyi no bɛyɛ hɔn hen, osiandɛ wɔpoow dɛ wɔbɛsan aba me nkyɛn.
title: HOSEA

text: Na afona bɛba no nkurow do, na ɔasɛɛ ne ndaban, na ɔamen hɔn, osian hɔnankasa hɔn apam ntsi.
title: HOSEA

text: Ekyir ara na me man pɛ dɛ ɔsan fi me nkyɛn kɔ: sɛ wɔfrɛ hɔn ɔsorsornyi no nkyɛn mpo a, obiara nnkasa ho koraa.
title: HOSEA

text: Ao Efraim, mebɛyɛ dɛn eyi wo ama? Israel, mebɛyɛ dɛn eyi wo ama, ao? Mebɛyɛ dɛn mayɛ wo dɛ Adma? Mebɛyɛ dɛn koraa dze wo esi hɔ dɛ Zeboim? Ao, m’akoma adan wɔ mo mu ae, na m’ayamuhyehye abɔ mu redzɛw mo mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Minnkedzi m’ebufuw ne hyeehyew no ekyir, merennsan mmbɛsɛɛ Efraim: osiandɛ meyɛ Onyame, na nnyɛ nyimpa; Krɔnkrɔnnyi a ɔwɔ wo finimfin: na merennhɛn kurow no mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Wobedzi EWURADZE ekyir, ɔno a ɔbɔpɔw dɛ gyata; na ɔnodze ɔbɔpɔw, na mbofra no dze ahopopo fi anee aba.
title: HOSEA

text: Wɔdze ahopopo fi Egypt bɛba dɛ anoma, na woefi Asiria asaase do aba dɛ ebubur: na medze hɔn mama woetsim wɔ hɔn efi mu, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: HOSEA

text: Efraim dze atorsɛm, na Israel fi dze ndaadaa etwa mo ho ehyia: naaso mbom Juda da ho dze Nyame dzi hen, na odzi nokwar ma Krɔnkrɔnnyi no.
title: HOSEA

text: Efraim dzi aahow, na odzi boka aahow ekyir: dabaa ɔma atorsɛm na amamfoyɛ dɔɔ so; na wɔnye Asiria dzi ahyɛmu, na wɔsoa ngo kɔ Egypt.
title: HOSEA

text: Na EWURADZE nye Juda enya asɛm, na ɔbɛtsea Jakob dɛ mbrɛ n’akwan tse; mbrɛ ne ndzeyɛɛ tse ara na ɔbɛhyɛ no ananmu.
title: HOSEA

text: Yafun mu na osuoo no nua anantsir: na n’ahoɔdzen mu, na ɔnye Nyankopɔn tetaree:
title: HOSEA

text: nyew, onyaa ahoɔdzen boor ɔbɔfo no dze do; na odzii nyim: osui, na ɔkotowee serɛɛ no: ohun no wɔ Bɛtɛl, na hɔ na ɔnye hɛn kasae;
title: HOSEA

text: mekyerɛ EWURADZE, dɔm Nyankopɔn no a; ne nkaa dzin dze EWURADZE.
title: HOSEA

text: Dɛm ntsi san bra wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn: suo mbɔbɔrhu na atsɛmbu mu, na tweɔn wo Nyankopɔn daa.
title: HOSEA

text: Ɔbatanyi no kitsa nsisi nsɛn wɔ ne nsamu: na ɔpɛ emimdzi.
title: HOSEA

text: Na Efraim tuuw noho see dɛ, Ampaara menya moho, menya adze: m’edwuma nyina mu worunnhu mo mu emumuyɛ biara a ɔyɛ bɔn.
title: HOSEA

text: Naaso emi nye EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn dze fitsi Egypt asaase do; mebɛma ada ho ara atsena asese mu bio, dɛ afahyɛ krɔnkrɔn nda no mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Makasa akyerɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no so, na mama enyido adzehu adɔɔ so; na menam nkɔnhyɛfo som do mebubu mbɛ.
title: HOSEA

text: Ana Gilead yɛ emumuyɛdze a? Wɔadan egyangyandze koraa; Gilgal mu na wɔdze anantwi bɔ okum afɔr: nhwɛ, hɔn afɔrmbukyia tse dɛ kwa mu akɔfi mu esiwesiw.
title: HOSEA

text: Na Jakob guanee kɔr Aram haban mu, na Israel somee wɔ yer ntsi, na yer ntsi ɔhwɛɛ nguan.
title: HOSEA

text: Na EWURADZE nam nkɔnhyɛnyi do dze Israel fii Egypt bae, na ɔnam nkɔnhyɛnyi do koraa no do.
title: HOSEA

text: Efraim eyi ebufuw yerɛyerɛɛyerɛw: dɛm ntsi wɔbɛma no bɔgyaa ebua n’etsifi, na n’EWURADZE adan n’ahorohoraa egu no do.
title: HOSEA

text: Efraim kasae no, ɔyɛɛ ahopopo; ɔyɛɛ ɔkɛse wɔ Israel: naaso odzii so wɔ Baal mu no, owui.
title: HOSEA

text: Na afei wɔyɛ bɔn mbordo ara, na wɔdze hɔn dwetɛ ayeyɛ ehonyi a woegu amema hɔnho, ayeyɛ abosom dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ntseasee tse, ne nyinara odwimfo edwuma a: wɔka no wɔ hɔn ho dɛ, Nyimpa a wɔbɔ okum afɔr no mfew anantwimburwa no ano.
title: HOSEA

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔbɛyɛ dɛ anapa nsuwusiw, na dɛ ɔbɔsu a ɔsen ahema kɔ, dɛ ntsɛw a ekyinehyia mframa tu no fi ewuporowee do, na dɛ wusiw a otu fa wusiw tokura mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Naaso emi nye EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn fitsi Egypt asaase do; na mma nnhu ɔbosom fofor bi nnka mo ho, eso ɔgyefo bi nnyi hɔ ka mo ho.
title: HOSEA

text: Sar no do, nsukɔm asaase no do, nna muhun wo ampa.
title: HOSEA

text: Wonyaa edzidzibea pa no, wɔmee, na ber a wɔmee no, hɔn akoma maa noho do, ma dɛm ntsi hɔn werɛ efir me.
title: HOSEA

text: Dɛm ntsi na mayɛ dɛ gyata ama hɔn na mebɛtsɛw kwan nkyɛn dɛ sebɔ:
title: HOSEA

text: mobɔtotɔr hɔn dɛ sisi a wɔagye ne mba, na matsetsew hɔn akoma toa mu na hɔ na mobɔwe hɔn dɛ gyata; abowa bɔyafo bosunsuan hɔn mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Ao Israel, meyɛ wo boafo dze, naaso wɔbɛsɛɛ wo ara.
title: HOSEA

text: Na afei wo hen no wɔ hen, ma ɔaagye wo wɔ wo nkurow nyina mu? Na w’atsɛmbuafo a eka wɔ hɔn ho dɛ, Ma me ɔhen na asafohen no?
title: HOSEA

text: Mama wo ahemfo wɔ m’ebufuw mu, na meyi hɔn hɔ wɔ m’abohur mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Wɔakyekyer Efraim emumuyɛ; wɔdze no bɔn esie fiadze.
title: HOSEA

text: Ɔreper dɛ ɔbaa ɔwokofo a yaw aka no: naaso dɛ ɔba a onnyim nyansa ntsi, ne mber aso dze, naaso orikyinkyim wɔ beebi mbrɛ mba dua mu pue kɔ no.
title: HOSEA

text: Mibeyi hɔn tsir efi adakamona no tum nsa; mobɔpon hɔn efi owu nsa: owu e, w’ayardɔm wɔ hen o? Adakamona e, wo sɛɛe wɔ hen o? Nnuho bosuma efi m’enyi do.
title: HOSEA

text: Kaansa ɔbɔsow aba wɔ no nuanom mu mpo a, boka aahow bɔbɔ, EWURADZE n’aahow fi sar do botu, na ne mbasu awew, na no nsunyiwa akɔ atwee; ɔno na ɔbɛfa akoradzedan mu nkɔɔpow fɛɛfɛw no asadze.
title: HOSEA

text: Samaria ne tsir bɔto; osiandɛ ɔatsew ne Nyankopɔn do etua: wɔbɔtotɔ afona anomu: wɔbɛtsetsew hɔn nkɔkowaba mu esinesin, na wɔapaapaa hɔn enyinsemfo mu.
title: HOSEA

text: Ao Israel, san bra EWURADZE wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn ae; na woara w’emumuyɛ dze wo ahwe ase.
title: HOSEA

text: Hom mfa nsɛm nsan mbra EWURADZE hɔ: hom nse no dɛ, Yi emumuyɛ nyina kɔ, na gye dza oye: nna yɛdze hɛn anofamfa bɛyɛ anantwi abɔ wo afɔr.
title: HOSEA

text: Assur renngye hɛn nkwa; yɛrenntsena mpɔnkɔ do nnantsew: eso yɛrennse hɛn nsaano edwuma bio dɛ, Hom nye hɛn abosom: na ɔwo wo mu na egyanka nya ehumbɔbɔr.
title: HOSEA

text: Mebɛsa hɔn ekyirsan no yarba, mebɛpra me yamu adɔ hɔn: osiandɛ m’ebufuw adan efi hɔn do.
title: HOSEA

text: Mebɛyɛ dɛ ɔbɔsu ama Israel; ɔbɔbɔ nhyiren dɛ esukookoo, na ɔatsentsen no ndwow dɛ Lebanon.
title: HOSEA

text: N’abaw bɛtserɛw, na ne fɛw ayɛ dɛ ngodua, na oeyi huam dɛ Lebanon.
title: HOSEA

text: Hɔn a wɔtse no nwin ase bɛsan aba; wobenya nkwa bio dɛ eburow, na wɔabɔ nhyiren dɛ wenyindua: ne nka bɛyɛ dɛ Lebanon nsa.
title: HOSEA

text: Efraim bɛse dɛ, Ebɛnadze na menye abosom wɔ yɛ bio? Emi dze, magye do, na m’enyi bɛka no ho: metse dɛ kupresi dua frɔmfrɔm; emi mo do na wobohu wo nsowee.
title: HOSEA

text: Woana nye onyansafo a ɔbɛtse ndzɛmba yinom ase? Ɔbadwembanyi a obohu? Na EWURADZE n’akwan tsen, na atseneneefo bɛnantsew do; na mbratofo dze, wɔbɔhwehwe ase wɔ do.
title: HOSEA

text: Iyi nye EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔbaa Petuel ba Joel hɔ no.
title: JOEL

text: Hom nkɔdaa, hom ntsie iyi, na hom asaase do atsefo nyina, hom nyɛ aso. Aso iyi bi aba da wɔ hom nda mu, anaaso hom egyanom nda mu?
title: JOEL

text: Hom nka ho asɛm nkyerɛ hom mba, na hom mba nka nkyerɛ hɔn mba, na hɔn so hɔn mba nka nkyerɛ mbasantsen a odzi do.
title: JOEL

text: Ekuadze a efuse gyae no, abɛbɛw edzi; na dza abɛbɛw gyae no, konyinko edzi; na konyinko ndzikaase no, esa edzi.
title: JOEL

text: Asabokwafo, hom nnyan na hom nsu; na hom nsanomfo nyina, hom ntwa ewuo, wɔ nsa fenemfenem ntsi, osiandɛ woetwa efi hom anomu.
title: JOEL

text: Na ɔman bi etu aba m’asaase do, hɔn ho yɛ dzen, na hɔn dodow nnyi ano; hɔn se tse dɛ gyata se, na wɔwɔ gyata kɛse ne nyepi se.
title: JOEL

text: Ɔasɛɛ mo wenyindua, na ɔawaawaa m’adɔmbadua ho: ɔapɔr ho ahon egu, na ɔatow akyen; n’abaw ho ayɛ sakosako.
title: JOEL

text: Twa ewuo dɛ ɔbaabun a ofura eyitam ma ne nkataasiaber mu kun.
title: JOEL

text: Woetwa edziban afɔr na ɔnom afɔr efi EWURADZE fie; asɔfo, na EWURADZE asomfo no, robɔ mbubuw.
title: JOEL

text: Kwaa asɛɛ, asaase ridzi nkɔmbɔ; na eburow asɛɛ, nsa fofor awew, ngo akɔ atwee.
title: JOEL

text: Ao ekuafo, hom enyi nwu, ao wenyin turehwɛfo, hom nka mbɔɔ, wɔ ewifua na atoko no ntsi; na haban mu ndɔbaa no ahera.
title: JOEL

text: Wenyindua akyenkyen, na adɔmbadua enyinyam; pɔmegranate ekutudua, abɛdua so, na aperdua, mekyerɛ haban mu ndua nyinara akyenkyen; osiandɛ enyigye ho ato wɔ adasamba mu.
title: JOEL

text: Asɔfo, hom mfa eyitam mbɔ hom ho do, na hom nka mbɔɔ; afɔrmbukyia ho asomfo, hom ntwa ewuo; hom me Nyankopɔn n’asomfo, hom mbra mbɛda eyitam mu anadwe yi nyina: na edziban afɔr na ɔnom afɔr egyaa wɔ hom Nyankopɔn fie ba.
title: JOEL

text: Hom ntu mbuadadzi nsi nkyɛn, hom mfrɛ baguabɔ krɔnkrɔn, hom mboa mpanyimfo na asaase no do atsefo nyina ano mbra EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn fie, na hom nsu ntɔ EWURADZE do.
title: JOEL

text: Ao da no a! Na EWURADZE ne da no abɛn, na ɔbɛba dɛ ɔsɛɛ a ofi otumfo no ne nkyɛn.
title: JOEL

text: Ana wonntwaa edziban mmfii hɛn enyim, ana enyigye na ahosɛpɛw mmfii hɛn Nyankopɔn fie?
title: JOEL

text: Aba aprɔw n’akɔfi ase; mputu adeda apanapan, asan ebubu; osiandɛ eburow akyenkyen.
title: JOEL

text: Mbrɛ mbowa dua si apen a! Anyɛmbowakuw reberɛ, osiandɛ wonnyi edzidzibea; ɛhɛɛ, nguankuw ruhu amandze.
title: JOEL

text: Ao EWURADZE, ɔwo na musu frɛ wo: na ogya ahyew sar do edzidzimbea, na ogyaframee ahyew hamu ndua nyinara.
title: JOEL

text: Nyew, hambowa rehaahaw kyerɛ wo: osiandɛ nsu nwora nyina awewew, na ogya ahyew sar do edzidzimbea.
title: JOEL

text: Hom mbɔ akasamu no mu wɔ Zion, na hom mbɔ ehuu wɔ me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do; hom mma asaase no do atsefo nyina ho mpopo: osiandɛ EWURADZE da no rudu, na ɔabɛn;
title: JOEL

text: sum na kusuww da, fua na sum kebii da, dɛ ahanamakye a ayerɛw mbepɔw do; ɔman bi a ɔso na no ho yɛ dzen a ne saso mmbaa da a, eso n’ekyir bi remmba, dze ekesi mbasantsen pii mfe do mpo.
title: JOEL

text: Ogya hyew dzi hɔn enyim; ogyaframee dzɛw dzi hɔn ekyir: hɔn enyim asaase tse dɛ Eden ture, na hɔn ekyir dze, sar huntuhuntu a; nyew, obi mmfi hɔn nsa.
title: JOEL

text: Hɔn hwɛbea tse dɛ mpɔnkɔ hɔn hwɛbea; na wotu mbirika dɛ mpɔnkɔdofo.
title: JOEL

text: Wohuruhuruw dɛ ntseaseanam kyirdidi wɔ mbepɔw do, dɛ gyaframee a ɔrehyew mburonan hurududuudu, dɛ dɔm a hɔn ho yɛ dzen a wɔatoto hɔn wɔ akono.
title: JOEL

text: Aman ho guan hɔn wɔ hɔn enyim: na enyim nyina atotow.
title: JOEL

text: Wotu mbirika dɛ mbarimba akatakyi; wɔfow afasu dɛ akombarimba; na wɔtsen fa hɔn akwan do, na wɔnntsew hɔn santsen mu.
title: JOEL

text: Eso ɔbaako nnsun ne nyɛnko; hɔn nyina nenam hɔn mpasuar do: wɔbɔ hwira akodze mu a, wonnhuenyan.
title: JOEL

text: Wɔyɛ kurow no mu menyamenya; wotutu afasu do mbirika; wɔfow kɔ efi mu; wɔnam ntokura mu hɛn mu dɛ owifo.
title: JOEL

text: Asaase wosow wɔ hɔn enyim; ɔsor hihim: ewia na bosoom hyɛ sum, na nworaba yi hɔn hyerɛn fi hɔ:
title: JOEL

text: na EWURADZE ma ne ndze do wɔ no dɔm enyim; na ne nseraban so dɛ; na nyia odzi n’asɛm ekyir no no ho yɛ dzen: na EWURADZE da no so na ɔyɛ hu dɛ; na woana botum enyim gyina?
title: JOEL

text: Naaso seseiara mpo, EWURADZE na ɔse, hom mfa hom akoma nyina, na akɔnkyen, na osu, na ewuotwa nsan mbra me nkyɛn:
title: JOEL

text: na hom nsunsuan hom akoma mu, na nnyɛ hom ntar a, na hom ndan mbra EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn nkyɛn: na ɔyɛ ɔdomfo, na mbɔbɔrhufo, ɔfa ebufuw nyaa, na n’adɔyɛ so, na ɔsakyer n’adwen wɔ mbusu ho.
title: JOEL

text: Woana nyim dɛ ɔrennsan nnsakyer n’adwen, na onngya nhyira wɔ n’ekyir a, ɔyɛ edziban afɔr na ɔnom afɔr a wɔdze bɛma EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn?
title: JOEL

text: Hom mbɔ akasamu no mu wɔ Zion, hom ntu akɔnkyen nsi nkyɛn, hom mfrɛ ehyiadzi krɔnkrɔn:
title: JOEL

text: hom mboa ɔman no ano, hom ntsew mboanofo no ho, hom nhyira nkɔdaa, hom mboa mbofraba ano, na enumfoanomba: hom mma ayeforkun mfi ne pia mu mpue, na ayefor mfi n’adankyir.
title: JOEL

text: Hom mma asɔfo no, EWURADZE asomfo no, nsu wɔ nkrandaa na afɔrmbukyia no ntamu, na hom mma wɔnse dɛ, Kam wo man, ao EWURADZE, na mma mmfa w’egyapadze mma ahorohoraa, amma amanaman eenndzi hɔn do tum. Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na wɔka no aman mu dɛ, Hɔn Nyankopɔn no wɔ hen?
title: JOEL

text: Nna afei EWURADZE twee n’asaase ho nyinkun, na ohun ne man mbɔbɔr.
title: JOEL

text: Na EWURADZE buae see ne man dɛ, Hwɛ, merebrɛ hom eburow, nsa, na ngo, na mama hom amee: na merennhyɛ hom ahorohoraa wɔ amanaman mu bio.
title: JOEL

text: Na mibeyi kwaamu afamu dɔm no efi hom nkyɛn akɔ, na meetwuw hɔn adze akɔ asaase kwawee na amamfo do, na hɔn twafo dɔm no akɔ boka afamu po no mu, na hɔn nkyidɔm akɔ anee afamu po no ho; na hɔn bɔnee bɛyɛ kɛse, na hɔn nyaanyan so akɔ sor, osiandɛ woedzi bɔn dodow.
title: JOEL

text: Asaase e, mma nnsuro, w’enyi ngye na dzi ehurusi; osiandɛ EWURADZE ayɛ ndzɛmba akɛse.
title: JOEL

text: Hambowa, mma hom akoma nntu; na sar do mfunoma refefɛw, na dua rosow n’aba, adɔmbadua na wenyindua riyi hɔn ahoɔdzen ma.
title: JOEL

text: Zionmba, hom enyi ngye, na hom ndzi ehurusi wɔ EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn mu: na ɔrema hom esusow nsu wɔ tsenenee mu, na ɔrema nsu atɔ ama hom, esusow na ɔbɛsɛ nsu, wɔ bosoom a odzi kan no mu.
title: JOEL

text: Na ewifua bɛhyɛ poroweebea amaama, na nsa na ngo bɛyɛ nkorbaa amaama ebu do.
title: JOEL

text: Na mebɛhyɛ hom mfe a mbɛbɛw, nkonyinko, na esa, na efuse, mo dɔm a mosomaa hɔn baa hom do no dzii no, ananmu.
title: JOEL

text: Na hom bedzidzi bafuu na hom amee, na hom eyi EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn a ɔnye hom edzi no nwanwa mu no ne dzin ayɛw: na me man n’enyim runngu ase dabiarada.
title: JOEL

text: Na hom bohu dɛ mowɔ Israel finimfin, na dɛ emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn, na obi nnyi hɔ bio: na me man enyim runngu ase dabiarada.
title: JOEL

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ n’ekyir no, mubohue mo sunsum egu adasa nyina do; na hom mbabanyin na hom mbabaa bɛhyɛ nkɔm, na hom nkɔdaa asoso adaa, hom mberantsɛ ehuhu enyido adze:
title: JOEL

text: na eso hom nkowaa na hom mfonabaa do na mubohue mo sunsum egu wɔ nda no mu.
title: JOEL

text: Na mebɛkyerɛ anwanwadze wɔ sor na asaase, bɔgya, na ogya wusiw kumbɔɔ.
title: JOEL

text: Ewia bɛdan sum, na bosoom adan bɔgya ansaana EWURADZE ne da kɛse a ɔyɛ hu no aba.
title: JOEL

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ obiara a ɔbɔbɔ EWURADZE ne dzin no, wɔbɛgye no nkwa: na Zion bepɔw do na Jerusalɛm na dɛ mbrɛ EWURADZE aka no, hɔn a wobefi nsa nye hɔn a EWURADZE refrɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn a wɔaka no mu no bɛtsena.
title: JOEL

text: Na, hwɛ, nda na ber no mu a medze Juda na Jerusalɛm ndɔmmum bɛsan aba bio no,
title: JOEL

text: mobɔboa amanaman nyina ano, na medze hɔn aba Jehosafat bɔnsa no mu; na menye hɔn edzi asɛm wɔ me man na m’egyapadze Israel ntsi, dɛ wɔabɔ hɔn apetse amanaman, na wɔakyɛ m’asaase mu.
title: JOEL

text: Na wɔatwe me man ho tonto: na wɔdze abanyimbasiaba apɛ edwaman, na wɔatɔn akataasia agye nsa anom.
title: JOEL

text: Hom reyɛ me dɛn, ao Taere, na Zidon, na Filistia amantɔw nyina? Ana hom bɛyɛ biribi ahyɛ me ananmu? Na sɛ hom yɛ biribi hyɛ me ananmu a, ɔhardo ntsɛmara na mebɛdan hom ahyɛnanmu no egu hom etsifi.
title: JOEL

text: Osiandɛ hom afa mo dwetɛ na me sika, na hom dze m’afɛɛfɛdze papa no nyina kɔ hom asɔrdan no mu;
title: JOEL

text: hom atɔn Judamba so na Jerusalɛm mba ama Griikfo mba, ama hom eeyi hɔn efi hɔn he do akɔ ekyirekyir:
title: JOEL

text: hwɛ, mibekenyan hɔn efi mbrɛ hom tontɔɔn hɔn kɔree no, na madan hom ahyɛnanmu no ebua homankasa hom etsifi;
title: JOEL

text: na mobɔtɔn hom mbabanyin na hom mbabaa ahyɛ Judamba nsa, na wɔbɔtɔn hɔn ama Seba mba, ɔman a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir; EWURADZE na ɔaka.
title: JOEL

text: Hom mbɔ yi dawur wɔ amanaman mu; hom nkyer ɔsa: hom nkenyan mbarimba akatakyi no; hom mma akofo nyina ntwe mbɛn, wɔmfow mbra.
title: JOEL

text: Hom mfa hom nsɔw mbobɔ mfona, na hom mfa hom ndar mbobɔ mpeaa: onyia ɔyɛ mberɛw nka dɛ, Meyɛ dzen.
title: JOEL

text: Hom nyɛ ntsɛm mbra, hom amanaman a woetwa ehyia nyina, na hom mboa hom ano mbehyia. Ao EWURADZE, hɔ na ma w’akatakyi no wonsian mbra.
title: JOEL

text: Amanaman nkenyan hɔnho, na wontu mbra Jehosafat bɔnsa no mu: na hɔ na mebɛtsena ase mebu amanaman a woetwa ehyia nyinara atsɛn.
title: JOEL

text: Hom mfa kantankrankye no nto mu, na ekuadze no aber: hom mbra, hom mbetsiatsia; na nsatwer no ayɛ ma, nkorbaa no ebubu do; na hɔn emumuyɛ adɔɔ so.
title: JOEL

text: Nyimpa mpempem mu mpempem wɔ atsɛmbu bɔnsa no mu. Na EWURADZE ne da no abɛn wɔ atsɛmbu bɔnsa no mu.
title: JOEL

text: Ewia na bosoom ahyɛ sum; na nworaba egyaa hyerɛn.
title: JOEL

text: Na EWURADZE befi Zion apɔw, na oefi Jerusalɛm ama ne ndze do; na ɔsorsor na asaase awosow: na EWURADZE bɛyɛ guansumabea ama ne man, na akoban ama Israelmba.
title: JOEL

text: Ɔno na hom bohu dɛ emi nye EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn a metse Zion, me bepɔw krɔnkrɔn no do no: nna Jerusalɛm bɛyɛ krɔnkrɔnbea, na ananaben biara runntwa mu wɔ hɔ bio.
title: JOEL

text: Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ mbepɔw bɔsosɔw nsa fenemfenem, na akoko no do apem numfonsu, na nsu ebu Juda nworaba nyina do; na nsunyiwa befi EWURADZE fie apem akɔfɔw Sittim bɔnsa no.
title: JOEL

text: Egypt bɛyɛ amamfo, na Edom ayɛ sar kwawee, wɔ etsirmɔdzendze a wɔdze yɛɛ Judamba ntsi, na dɛ wɔaka bɔgya a odzi bem egu wɔ hɔn asaase do ntsi.
title: JOEL

text: Na Juda dze, ɔbɛtsena hɔ daa, na Jerusalɛm fi mbasantsen ekesi mbasantsen.
title: JOEL

text: Na mobɔtɔ hɔn bɔgyaa do wer a monntɔe no: na EWURADZE bɛtsena Zion.
title: JOEL

text: Iyi nye dza Amos a ɔwɔ Tekoa nguanhwɛfo mu no hunii wɔ Israel ho wɔ Judahen Uzia ber do, na Israelhen Jeroboam a ɔyɛ Joas ne ba no ber do, mfe ebien ansaana asaasewosow no reba no.
title: AMOS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, EWURADZE fi Zion bɔpɔw, na oefi Jerusalɛm ama ne ndze do; na nguanhwɛfo no hɔn nguandzidzibea bedzi awerɛhow, na Karmel etsifi etwintwam.
title: AMOS
