title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna mibisaa no dɛ, Erokɔ hen? Na ɔsee me dɛ, Murukosusu Jerusalɛm mahwɛ ne tɛtɛr, na ne tsentsen.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na, hwɛ, ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no fiir edzi, na ɔbɔfo fofor fiir edzi kehyiaa no,
title: ZECHARIAH

text: na ɔsee no dɛ, Tutu mbirika, kɛka kyerɛ aberantsɛ yi, dɛ, Jerusalɛm wɔbɛtsena mu dɛ nkuroba a wonnyi afasu, ɔnam nyimpa na anyɛmbowa dodow a wɔwɔ mu ntsi.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na emi, EWURADZE na mese, mara na mebɛyɛ gya fasu mabɔ no ho aprɔw, na mayɛ enyimnyam wɔ ne finimfin.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Ao o, ao o, guan fi kwaamu afamu asaase no do, EWURADZE na ɔse: na matserɛw hom mu dɛ sor mframa anan no, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Ao o, Zion, guan, ɔwo a enye Babilɔn babaa tse.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: M’enyimnyam ntsi na masoma wo amanaman a wɔfaa hom afo no nkyɛn: na nyia ɔka hom no, ɔka emi EWURADZE m’enyi kyiresua.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na, hwɛ, mobɔwosow me nsa egu hɔn do, na wɔayɛ afodze ama hɔn a wɔsoom hɔn no: na obiara bohu dɛ dɔm EWURADZE na ɔasoma me.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Ao Zion babaa, tow ndwom na dzi ehurusi: na, hwɛ, mereba, na mabɛtsena wo finimfin, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na amanaman pii dze hɔnho bɔbɔ EWURADZE ho wɔ da no mu, na wɔayɛ me man: na mebɛtsena wo mu, na ehu dɛ dɔm EWURADZE na ɔasoma me wo nkyɛn.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na EWURADZE bɛfa Juda edzi do dɛ ne kyɛfa wɔ asaase krɔnkrɔn no do, na ɔada ho asan mu eyi Jerusalɛm.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Adasa nyina, hom ntaa dzinn wɔ EWURADZE enyim: na ɔasoɛr wɔ ne tsenabea krɔnkrɔn hɔ.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔkyerɛɛ me Josua, ɔsɔfopanyin no, dɛ ogyina EWURADZE no bɔfoe no enyim, na Satan gyina n’abanyimfa rotoatoa no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na EWURADZE no bɔfoe no see Satan dɛ, Satan e, EWURADZE ntwuw w’enyim; nyew, EWURADZE a ɔasan mu eyi Jerusalɛm no ontwuw w’enyim. Aso dɛm banyin yi nntse dɛ gyantsia a woehwim efi gya mu?
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna Josua hyɛ ntar fi, na ogyina ɔbɔfo no enyim.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbɔfo no kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn a wogyinagyina n’enyim no, dɛ, Hom nyi ntar fi no mfi no ho. Na ɔsee Josua dɛ, Hwɛ, mama w’emumuyɛ efi wo ho kɔ, na mebɛhyɛ wo ebirɛmpɔn ntar.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Hom mfa asɔfokyɛw a ɔyɛ fɛw nsoa ne tsir. Nna wɔdze asɔfokyɛw a ɔyɛ fɛw soaa ne tsir, na wɔhyɛɛ no ntar; nna EWURADZE bɔfoe no gyina hɔ.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na EWURADZE bɔfoe no see Josua dɛ,
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Sɛ ebɛnantsew m’akwan do, na esie m’ahyɛdze a, ɔno na wo so ebɔhwɛ me fie nsɛm do, na aweɔn m’abangua so, na mama enya hɔn a wogyina ha yi ntamu beebi egyina.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Ao ɔsɔfopanyin Josua, ɔwo na wo mfɛfo a wɔtsetse w’enyim, afei hom ntsie; na wɔyɛ nyimpa a wɔyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze: na, hwɛ, medze m’akowaa, Abaw no, bopue aba.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na hwɛ, ɔbo a medze ato Josua enyim no; enyiwa esuon wɔ ɔbo kor do: hwɛ, mubokrukye no nkrukyei no, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, na mibeyi asaase no n’emumuyɛ da kor.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Da no mu, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, hom mu nyimpa biara bɛfrɛfrɛ ne nyɛnko aba wenyindua na adɔmbadua ase.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no baa bio, na obenyaan me dɛ nyimpa a woenyan no efi ne nda mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na obisaa me dɛ, Ihu ebɛnadze? Na mubuaa dɛ, Muhu kandzeadua a ne nyina yɛ sika, na no ngotoa taa n’etsifi, na ne nkandzea esuon no wowɔ do; ndodobɛn esuon wɔ nkandzea a wɔwɔ n’etsifi no do nkorkor:
title: ZECHARIAH

text: na ngondua ebien sisi ne nkyɛnmu, kor si ngotoa no n’enyimfa, na kor so si n’abankum.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mibisaa ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no, dɛ, Mo wura, iyinom ebɛnadze a?
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no buae see me dɛ, Aso innyim iyinom n’adzeban? Na mesee dɛ, Mo wura, oho.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna obuae see me dɛ, Iyi nye EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔbaa Zerubabel hɔ, dɛ, Ɔnnam w’ahoɔdzen do, ɔnnam wo tum do, mbom ɔnam mo sunsum do, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Ao bepɔw kɛse, woana nye wo? Ebɛdan asaase tɛtɛr wɔ Zerubabel enyim: na ɔdze etsifi bo no bopue aba abɔbɔ do ose dɛ, Adom, adom mbra do.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa me nkyɛn bio dɛ,
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Zerubabel ne nsa na ɔatow fie yi fapem; na ne nsa na obowie so; na ɔwo ehu dɛ dɔm EWURADZE na ɔasoma me wo nkyɛn.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na kaansa wobuu edwuma yi n’ahyɛse kakrabaa yi enyimtsia mpo a, ber a wobohu promo no wɔ Zerubabel ne nsamu no, hɔn enyi bɛgye na wobedzi ehurusi. Nkandzeadua esuon a ihunii no yɛ EWURADZE n’enyiwa; wokyin dzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna mubuae, na mibisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze nye ngondua ebien yi a wosisi kandzeadua no n’enyimfa na n’abankum yi?
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mibisaa no bio dɛ, Ebɛn ngondua abaw ebien nye iyinom yi a wɔwɔ sika ano ebien a ohue sika ngo fa mu yi?
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na obuaa me see dɛ, Aso innyim iyinom hɔn adzeban? Na mesee dɛ, Mo wura, oho.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Iyinom nye nyimpa beenu a wɔasera hɔn ngo a wogyinagyina asaase nyina EWURADZE nkyɛn no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna memaa m’enyi do bio, na muhun nwoma mbobɔwee a ɔnenam wimu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na obisaa me dɛ, Ihu ebɛnadze? Na mubuaa dɛ, Muhu nwoma mbobɔwee a ɔnenam wimu; ne tsentsen yɛ basafa enum, na ne tɛtɛr yɛ basafa ebien na fa.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna ɔsee me dɛ, Iyi nye ndom a opue kɔ asaase nyina enyi no: na obiara a owia adze no wɔbɔpo no wɔ afa kor dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse; na obiara a ɔka ntanhun no wɔbɔpo no wɔ afa kor so dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mebɛma oepue akɔ, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, na ɔakɛhɛn owifo no fie, na nyia ɔdze me dzin ka ntanhun no fie: na ɔbɛtsena ne fi mu, na ɔahyew ɔno nye no ndua na n’abo.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no puei, na ɔsee me dɛ, Afei ma w’enyi do, na hwɛ adzekor a orupue yi.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mibisaa dɛ, Ebɛnadze a? Na ɔsee me dɛ, Iyi nye efa esusudze a orupue no. Ɔkaa bio so dɛ, Iyi nye hɔn hwɛbea wɔ asaase nyina do:
title: ZECHARIAH

text: (na hwɛ, wɔmaa sumbui talent kor do:) na iyi nye ɔbaa a ɔtse efa esusudze no mu no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Emumuyɛ nye yi; na ɔtoow no kyeen efa esusudze no mu: na ɔtoow sumbui durdur no hin ano.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna memaa m’enyi do, na muhun mbaa beenu dɛ oepue na mframa wɔ hɔn ntsaban mu; na hɔn ntsaban tse dɛ ɔkompɛtɛ ne ntsaban: na wɔmaa efa esusudze no do wɔ asaase na sor ntamu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna mibisaa ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no dɛ, Iyinom dze efa efa esusudze no rokɔ hen?
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Wɔdze rokɔ ekesi dan ama no wɔ Sinar asaase do: na sɛ wowie siesie a, wɔdze no besi ne bea no do wɔ hɔ.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na memaa m’enyi do bio, na mohwɛe, na muhun, ntseaseanam anan a wofi mbepɔw ebien ntamu reba; na mbepɔw no yɛ boran mbepɔw.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Tseaseanam a odzi kan no, mpɔnkɔ memen wɔ mu; na tseaseanam a otsia ebien no, mpɔnkɔ tuntum wɔ mu;
title: ZECHARIAH

text: na tseaseanam a otsia ebiasa no, mpɔnkɔ fitaa wɔ mu; na dza otsia anan no, mpɔnkɔ wonawona ahoɔdzenfo wɔ mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna mibisaa ɔbɔfo a ɔnye me kasae no dɛ, Mo wura, iyinom yɛ ebɛnadze?
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbɔfo no buae see me dɛ, Iyinom nye sor mframa anan a wofir edzi fi asaase nyina EWURADZE n’enyim no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Tseaseanam a mpɔnkɔ tuntum wɔ mu no puei kɔr kwaamu afamu asaase do, na efufuw no fiir edzi dzii hɔn ekyir; na wonawona no puei kɔr pomu afamu asaase do.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ahoɔdzenfo no puei no, hɔnho peer hɔn dɛ wokekyin dzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mfi ha nkɔ nkekyin ndzi akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do. Nna wokekyinii dzii akɔnaaba wɔ asaase do.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna ɔbɔɔ mu kasaa kyerɛɛ me, dɛ, Hwɛ, hɔn a wɔkɔ kwaamu afamu asaase do no wɔama mo sunsum ho asan no wɔ kwaamu afamu asaase do.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Gye sika na dwetɛ fi Heldai, Tobija na Jedaia a wofi Babilɔn ndɔmmum aba no hɔ, na da no ara kɔ Zefania ba Josia a ɔno so fi Babilɔn bae no ne fie; na fa yɛ abɔtsir na fa bɔ ɔsɔfopanyin Josua, Jehozada ba no ne tsir;
title: ZECHARIAH

text: na ka kyerɛ no, dɛ, Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE kasa se nye yi, dɛ, Hwɛ, banyin bi a ne dzin dze Abaw no; na ɔbɛfefɛw wɔ n’ananmu, na oesi EWURADZE n’asɔrdan no:
title: ZECHARIAH

text: ɔnoara na obesi EWURADZE n’asɔrdan no; na ɔbɔsoa enyimnyam no, na ɔatsena n’ahengua do edzi hen; na ɔbɛyɛ ɔsɔfo wɔ n’ahengua do: na asomdwee ahyɛmu no bɛtsena hɔn beenu ntamu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na abɔtsir no bɛyɛ nkaadze ama Helem, na Tobija, na Jedaia, na Zefania ba Hen, wɔ EWURADZE asɔrdan no mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir no bɛba ebesi EWURADZE asɔrdan no bi, na hom ehu dɛ dɔm EWURADZE na ɔasoma me hom hɔ. Na sɛ hom dze mbɔdzembɔ tsie EWURADZE hom Nyankopɔn ne ndze a, iyi bɛba mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔhen Darius n’ahendzi afe a otsia anan mu no, EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Zekaria hɔ wɔ bosoom a otsia akron a ɔno nye Kislev no, ne da a otsia anan mu no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna Bɛtɛlfo asoma Sarezer na Regem-melek, na hɔn nyimpa aba dɛ wɔmbɔkotow nserɛ EWURADZE n’enyimpa,
title: ZECHARIAH

text: na wombisa dɔm EWURADZE ne fie asɔfo no na nkɔnhyɛfo no, dɛ, Aso munsu wɔ bosoom a otsia enum no mu, na menkyen kɔm, dɛ mbrɛ mayɛ no wɔ mfe pii mu yi?
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna dɔm EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Ka kyerɛ asaase no do man nyina, na asɔfo no na bisa hɔn dɛ, Ana hom yɛɛ akɔnkyen dzii awerɛhow wɔ bosoom a otsia enum na esuon mu mfe eduosuon yi no, hom kyeen kɔm yi maa emi mara anaa?
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na sɛ hom dzidzi, na hom nom a, hom nndzi mma homankasa homho, na hom nnom mma homankasa homho anaa?
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Aso nnyɛ nsɛm yi na EWURADZE nam nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzii kan no do tseaa mu wɔ ber a Jerusalɛm da ho wɔ hɔ na hom tse mu no, na ɔyɛɛ prɔmprɔm a no nkurow etwa no ho ehyia, na wɔtse Pomu afamu na ɔbɔn mu no?
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na EWURADZE n’asɛm baa Zekaria hɔ, dɛ,
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE aka nye yi, dɛ, Hom mbu nokwar atsɛn, na nyimpa biara nkyerɛ mbɔbɔrhu na ayamuhyehye wɔ no nua do:
title: ZECHARIAH

text: na mma hom nntseetsee okunafo na egyankaba, ɔnana na ɔbɔbɔfo; na mma hom mu biara mmfa no nua ho adwembɔn.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Naaso wɔammpen dɛ wobetsie, na wɔkoakoaa hɔn mbatsir, na wosisiiw hɔn aso, amma wɔaanntse.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nyew, wɔyɛɛ hɔn akoma dɛ dɛnkyɛmbo, amma wɔaanntse mbra no, na nsɛm a dɔm EWURADZE nam no sunsum do maa nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzii kan no bɛkae no: dɛm ntsi na ebufuw kɛse fiir dɔm EWURADZE hɔ bae no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ emi mefrɛɛ hɔn na woenntsie no, dɛmara na hɔn so wɔbɛtsea mu afrɛ me na mirinntsie, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse;
title: ZECHARIAH

text: na medze ekyinehyia mframa bɔɔ hɔn petsee amanaman nyina a wonnyim hɔn no mu. Dɛm na asaase no bɛyɛɛ amamfo wɔ hɔn ekyir, dɛ obiara ammfa do annsan: osiandɛ wɔmaa asaase fɛɛfɛw no yɛɛ afo.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na dɔm EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Motwe Zion ho nyinkun kɛse, na enyiber kɛse na medze twe no ho nyinkun.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE se nye yi: Meresan aba Zion nkyɛn, na mebɛtsena Jerusalɛm mu: na wɔbɛfrɛ Jerusalɛm Nokwar kurow no; na dɔm EWURADZE ne bepɔw no, Bepɔw krɔnkrɔn.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Nkɔdaa na mberwa bɛda ho atsenatsena Jerusalɛm abrɔn mu, na onyin dodow ntsi, nyimpa biara bekitsa poma wɔ ne nsamu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mbanyimbasiaba na nkataasia bɛhyɛ kurow no n’abrɔn no amaama, na woedzi agor wɔ abrɔn no mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Sɛ ɔyɛ ɔman yi ne nkaa no nwanwa wɔ nda no mu a, aso ɔbɛyɛ nwanwa wɔ emi so m’enyi do anaa? Dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Hwɛ, mebɛgye me man nkwa efi boka asaase no do, na anee asaase no do:
title: ZECHARIAH

text: na medze hɔn aba, na wɔabɛtsena Jerusalɛm mu; na wɔbɛyɛ me man, na emi so mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn, wɔ nokwar na tsenenee mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: hom nhyehyɛ hom nsamu dzen, hom a hom tse nsɛm yi wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo anomu wɔ nda yi mu, hɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ da no a wɔtoow dɔm EWURADZE ne fi fapem no, dɛ worisi asɔrdan no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ansaana da no reba no, na apaabɔ ho akatua nnyi hɔ mma nyimpa bi, eso apaabɔ nnyi hɔ mma abowa; eso asomdwee biara nnyi hɔ mma nyia opue anaa nyia ɔba mu osian ɔhohiahiafo no ntsi: na memaa nyimpa nyina obiara nye ne nyɛnko dzii esi.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na afei dze mennkɛyɛ dɛ nkan no ama ɔman yi nkaa no, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na asomdwee aba bɛba hɔ; wenyindua bɔsow n’aba, na asaase ama no ndɔbaa, na sorsor bɔtɔ no bɔsu; na mebɛma ɔman yi ne nkaa no enya ndzɛmba yinom nyina edzi.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛɛ ndom wɔ amanaman mu no, ao Juda fifo na Israel fifo, dɛmara na mebɛgye hom nkwa, na hom ayɛ nhyira: mma hom nnsuro, na mbom hom nhyehyɛ hom nsamu dzen.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Dɛ mbrɛ modween dɛ mebɛyɛ hom bɔn wɔ ber a hom egyanom yii me ebufuw no na mannsesa m’adwen no;
title: ZECHARIAH

text: dɛmara so bio na madwen nda yi mu dɛ mebɛyɛ Jerusalɛm na Juda fi yie: mma hom nnsuro.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Iyinom nye ndzɛmba a hom nyɛ; Hom mu nyimpa biara nkasa nokwar nkyerɛ ne nyɛnko; hom mbua nokwar na asomdwee atsɛn wɔ hom mbobokɛse mu:
title: ZECHARIAH

text: na mma hom mu obiara nndwen n’akoma mu bɔn wɔ ne nyɛnko ho; na mma hom mmpɛ ator ntanka: na iyinom nyina yɛ ndzɛmba a mikyir, EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na dɔm EWURADZE n’asɛm baa mo hɔ, dɛ,
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Bosoom a otsia anan, enum esuon na du no mu akɔnkyen no, bɛyɛ enyigye na ahosɛpɛw, na ahotɔ afahyɛ ama Juda fi; dɛm ntsi hom ndɔ nokwar na asomdwee.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Ɔbɛba no dɛmara, dɛ aman, na nkurow pii mu atsefo bɛba:
title: ZECHARIAH

text: na kurow kor mu atsefo bɔkɔ kor so mu akɛse dɛ, Hom mma yɛnkɔ ntsɛmara nkɔtotɔ nserɛ EWURADZE n’enyimpa, na yɛnhwehwɛ dɔm EWURADZE n’ekyir kwan: na mara so morokɔ.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nyew, aman pii na amanaman a wɔyɛ dzen bɛba abɔhwehwɛ dɔm EWURADZE n’ekyir kwan wɔ Jerusalɛm, na wɔatotɔ aserɛ EWURADZE n’enyimpa.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE se nye yi: Nda no mu na ɔbɛba dɛ mbanyin du a wofi amanaman kasaa nyina mu bosusuo Jewnyi baako n’atar ano, dɛ, Yɛnye hom bɔkɔ, osiandɛ yɛatse dɛ Nyankopɔn nye hom wɔ hɔ.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Iyi nye EWURADZE n’asɛm: EWURADZE n’atsɛmbu bɛtsena Hadrak asaase do na Damaskɔs mu. Na nnyɛ Israel mbusuakuw nko na wɔyɛ EWURADZE dze, na Aram nkuropɔn so yɛ nedze.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na dɛmara so ɔbɛyɛ Hamat so a ɔtoa do no; na Taere na Zidon so, kaansa wɔdwen dɛ wonyim nyansa papaapa mpo a.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na Taere sii akoban maa noho, na otsiaa dwetɛ dɛ huntuma, na sika mapa dɛ abrɔn mu dɛtse.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na hwɛ, EWURADZE bɛma efi ne nsa, na ɔabɔ no tum a ɔwɔ po mu no; na ogya ahyew nankasa.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Ashkelon bohu, na oesuro; Gaza so, na ayɛ no yayaayaw; na Ekron, na ɔahyɛ n’enyisun enyito: na Gaza nnkenya ɔhen biara, na Ashkelon so wɔrenntsena mu bio.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na amamforafo bɛtsena Ashdod, na metwa Filistiafo ahopɔw do.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mibeyi no bɔgyanam efi n’anomu, na n’ekyiwadze no efi ne se mu; na no so bɛyɛ nkaa ama hɛn Nyankopɔn: na ɔayɛ dɛ Juda mbusuakuw no mu bi, na Ekron ayɛ dɛ Jebusnyi.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mobɔbɔ nsera ehyia me fi ho wɔ dɔm no enyim, na obi enntwa mu annkɔ anaa annsan ammba: na ahohiahiafo biara enntwa mu ammfa hɔn mu bio: na afei dze, marankasa na mobɔhwɛ me man do.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Dzi ehurusi kɛse, ao Zion babaa; bɔ ose, ao Jerusalɛm babaa: hwɛ, wo hen reba wo nkyɛn: ɔtsen, na ɔwɔ nkwagye; ɔdwe na ɔtse asoaso do, asoaso a ɔyɛ asoasopɔnkɔber ne ba do.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mubotwa ntseaseanam efi Efraim, na pɔnkɔ efi Jerusalɛm, na woetwa akodzi egyen so; na ɔbɛka asomdwee nsɛm akyerɛ amanaman: na n’ahendzi befi po ho ekesi po ho, na efi Esutsen no ho ekesi asaase ano noho.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔwo so, w’ahyɛmudzi bɔgyaa no ntsi meyi w’adaduafo efi mona a nsu nnyi mu no mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Hom nsan mbra akoban no mu, hom enyidado adaduafo: ndɛ mpo meka kyerɛ hom dɛ mubobu no mbɔho ama hom.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na makom Juda ama moho, medze Efraim ahyɛ egyen no mu; na mibekenyan wo mbabanyin, ao Zion, medze etsia wo mbabanyin, ao Griis, na mebɛyɛ wo dɛ ɔkatakyi afona.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na wobohu EWURADZE wɔ hɔn do, na n’egyen menaba befir edzi dɛ enyinam: na EWURADZE Nyankopɔn bɛhɛn akasamu no, na ɔdze pomu afamu ekyinehyia mframa epue.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Dɔm EWURADZE botwitwa agye hɔn; na woedzidzi, na woetsiatsia tseabo do; na wɔanom, na nsa ntsi wɔayɛ weɔɔweɔɔ: na wɔbɛhyɛ hɔn amaama dɛ ndweraa, dɛ afɔrmbukyia no aduodoo.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na da no EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn no bɛgye hɔn nkwa dɛ ne man nguankuw: na wɔbɛyɛ abɔtsir ho abo a wɔama do wɔ asaase no do.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mbrɛ ne yie na n’ahoɔfɛw dua yɛ kɛse a! Edziban bɛma mberantsɛ no ayɛ prɔmprɔm, na nsa so ama mbabaawa no ayɛ dɛmara.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Hom mbisa EWURADZE, EWURADZE a ɔma asenaman paapaa no hɔ nsu wɔ ɔbɛsɛber; na ɔbɛma nsu atɔ berdzedzeedze ama hom, na hom nyina enyinya sar mu mfunoma.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na terafim, ebusua ehonyi no, aka nsɛngyan, na nkɔnhyɛfo no ehu atorsɛm; na adaasofo ka akɔhwisɛm, wɔdze nsɛnhun kyekye werɛ kwa: dɛm ntsi ɔman no fa hɔn kwan dɛ nguan, hɔn ho hiahia hɔn, osiandɛ guanhwɛfo bi nnyi hɔ.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mo bo efuw nguanhwɛfo no, na mebɛtsea dɛm mpɔnkyenyin no: na dɔm EWURADZE abɛsera no nguankuw Juda fi no, na ɔdze hɔn bɛyɛ n’enyimnyam pɔnkɔ wɔ ɔsa mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: No mu na kutuwdo bo, prɛgow, akodzi egyen na apempensifo nyina bɔbɔ mu fi aba.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na wɔbɛyɛ dɛ akatakyi a wotsiatsia abrɔn mu dɛtse do wɔ ɔko no mu; na wɔbɔko osiandɛ EWURADZE nye hɔn wɔ hɔ; na hɔn a wɔtse pɔnkɔ do no enyim bogu ase.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mebɛhyɛ Juda fi dzen, na magye Josef fi nkwa, na medze hɔn asan aba, na mehu hɔn mbɔbɔr; na wɔbɛyɛ dɛ gyama manntow hɔn annkyen: na emi nye EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn, na mibetsie hɔn.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na Efraim bɛyɛ dɛ ɔkatakyi, na hɔn akoma edzi ehurusi dɛ gyama nsa ntsi a: ɛhɛɛ, hɔn mba bohu, na woedzi ehurusi; hɔn akoma enyi bɛgye EWURADZE mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mobɔbɔ nhwiroma afrɛ hɔn, na maboa hɔn ano; osiandɛ mapon hɔn: na wɔbɔdɔr dɛ mbrɛ wɔadɔr yi.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mubodua hɔn amanaman mu; na wɔbɛkaa me wɔ ekyirekyir nkurow mu: na wɔnye hɔn mba benya nkwa, na wɔasan aba.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Medze hɔn befi Egypt asaase so do aba bio, na maboa hɔn ano efi Asiria; na medze hɔn bɛba Gilead na Lebanon asaase do; na wonnkenya kwan ama hɔn mpo.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na wobodua ahohia po no mu, na ɔabobɔ po asorɛkye no, na Nael mu ebun nyina awewew: na Asiria no nkontompɔ no abrɛ adze, na Egypt ahempoma no eefi hɔ akɔ.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mebɛhyɛ hɔn dzen wɔ EWURADZE mu; na wɔbɛnantsew afow esian wɔ EWURADZE dzin mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Ao Lebanon, buebue wo mbobow, ma gya nhyew wo odum ndua.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Ao kupresidua, twa ewuo, na odum ahwe ase, osiandɛ enyimnyamfo no asɛɛ: ao hom Basan nsudur, hom ntwa ewuo, na kwaa dzendzen no aba famu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nguanhwɛfo ewuotwa ne gyegyee nye no! Na hɔn enyimnyam asɛɛ: ngyatafɔr pɔw ne gyegyee nye no osiandɛ Jordan ahohyehyɛ asɛɛ.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Mbrɛ EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn se nye yi: Hom nnyɛn okum nguankuw no a
title: ZECHARIAH

text: hɔn a wɔtɔ hɔn no, woku hɔn, na wonndzi so; na hɔn a wɔtɔn hɔn no ka dɛ, Nhyira nka EWURADZE, na menya moho: na hɔnankasa hɔn ahwɛfo no nnhu hɔn mbɔbɔr.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na merennda ho nnya asaase no do atsefo no ho tsimbɔbɔr bio, EWURADZE na ɔse: na, hwɛ, mibeyi obiara ahyɛ ne nyɛnko nsa, na ne hen nsa: na wɔbɔbobɔ asaase no, mirinnyi hɔn mmfi hɔn nsamu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna menyɛɛn okum nguankuw no, nguankuw no mu dza wɔyɛ mbɔbɔr no. Na mefaa mpoma ebien; mefrɛɛ kor Enyimpa, na mefrɛɛ kor so Nkabɔmu; na menyɛɛn nguankuw no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mutwaa nguanhwɛfo baasa no kyenee wɔ bosoom kor mu; osiandɛ hɔn ho foon me kra, na mo so mo ho foon hɔn kra.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Merennyɛn hom: dza oruwu no, ma onwu; na dza wotwa no kyen no, wontwa no nkyen; na hɔn a aka no, obiara ndzi ne nyɛnko ne nam.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mefaa mo poma Enyimpa no na mutwaa mu, dɛ moroto m’ahyɛmu a menye aman nyina edzi no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na wɔtoo no da no ara: na nguankuw no mu abɔbɔfo a wɔhwɛɛ me no wohun dɛ ɔyɛ EWURADZE asɛm ampa.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mesee hɔn dɛ, Sɛ oye wɔ hom adwen mu a, hom mma me m’apaabɔdze; na sɛ ɔnntse dɛm a, hom mma ɔnka. Nna wokeer m’akatua ndwetɛbona eduasa maa me.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Tow gu adzekorabea, enyimnyam bo a woetwa no me tsir no. Na mefaa ndwetɛbona eduasa no, na motowee guu adzekorabea, wɔ EWURADZE fie.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mutwaa mo poma kor no, Nkabɔmu no mu, ama maasɛɛ Juda na Israel ntamu enuayɛ no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na EWURADZE see me dɛ, Nkyii so bio fa guanhwɛfo kwasea no n’edwindadze no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na, hwɛ, mebɛma guanhwɛfo bi do wɔ asaase do a ɔrennsera hɔn a woetwa hɔn akyen no, eso ɔronnhwehwɛ hɔn a wɔapetse no, na ɔrennsa dza ebubu no yarba; eso ɔrennyɛn dza ɔtse apɔw no, na mbom obedzi dza adɔ angoa ne nam, na ɔapaapaa no n’anansa mu esinesin.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Oguanhwɛfo gyangyan a ɔdan nguan no gya no, ondue! Afona bɛba n’abasa do, na n’enyiwa nyimfa do: ne basa bɛkyenkyen, na n’enyiwa nyimfa efura kusuww.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: EWURADZE atsɛmbusɛm a ɔfa Israel ho. Mbrɛ EWURADZE a ɔtserɛw sorsor mu, na ɔto asaase fapem, na ɔbɔ nyimpa no sunsum wɔ no mu no, se nye yi:
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Hwɛ, mebɛyɛ Jerusalɛm ntentan kɔɔpow ama aman a etwa ehyia ho nyina, na Jerusalɛm no ntuae no bɛka Juda so.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ mebɛyɛ Jerusalɛm ɔbo durdur mama aman nyina; hɔn a wɔdze bɔsoa hɔnho nyina bepirapira; na asaase do amanaman nyina bɔboa hɔn ano aba no do.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Da no mu no, EWURADZE na ɔse, medze ahobow mobɔbɔ mpɔnkɔ nyina, na medze abɔdam abɔ hɔn do atsefo: na mubobue m’enyi wɔ Juda fi do, na medze enyifura abɔ aman no mpɔnkɔ nyina.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na Juda ebusuakuw bɛse wɔ hɔn akoma mu dɛ, Jerusalɛm atsefo hɔn ahoɔdzen wɔ dɔm EWURADZE hɔn Nyankopɔn no mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Da no mu na mebɛyɛ Juda ebusuakuw dɛ gyasɛn wɔ nyena mu na gyatsɛn wɔ efiefi mu; na wɔahyew aman a etwa ho ehyia no wɔ bankum na nyimfa: na Jerusalɛm bɛda ho atsena ne tsenabea bio, wɔ Jerusalɛm hɔ ara.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: EWURADZE so bedzi kan agye Juda asese nkwa, amma David fie enyimnyam na Jerusalɛm atsefo hɔn enyimnyam aammema hɔnho do ammbɔ Juda do.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Da no mu no EWURADZE botwitwa agye Jerusalɛm atsefo; na nyia ɔyɛ mberɛw wɔ hɔn mu wɔ da no mu no ayɛ dɛ David; na David fie bɛyɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn, dɛ EWURADZE bɔfoe a odzi hɔn enyim.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ mobɔhwehwɛ amanaman a wɔbaa Jerusalɛm do nyina masɛɛ hɔn.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mubohue adom na ntotɔserɛ sunsum egu David fi na Jerusalɛm atsefo do; na wɔbɔhwɛ ɔno a wɔwɔɔ no peaa no: na woesu no, dɛ mbrɛ obi su ne ba kor, na woegyam no, dɛ mbrɛ obi gyam n’abakan.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Da no mu no, ewuotwa kɛse bɛba Jerusalɛm, dɛ Hadadrim-mon ewuotwa wɔ Megiddon bɔnsa mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na asaase no botwa ewuo, ebusua biara no nko; David fie ebusua nko, na hɔn yernom nko; Natan fie ebusua nko, na hɔn yernom nko;
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Levi fie ebusua nko, na hɔn yernom nko; Simei ebusua nko, na hɔn yernom nko;
title: ZECHARIAH

text: ebusua ebusua a aka no nyina, ebusua biara nko, na hɔn yernom nko.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Da no mu no wobobue nsunyiwa ama David fi na Jerusalɛm atsefo, ɔnam hɔn bɔn na ahonamfi ntsi.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, mubotwa abosom no edzin efi asaase no do, na wɔrennkaa hɔn bio: na eso mebɛma nkɔnhyɛfo no na sunsum fi no efi asaase no do efi.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, sɛ obi da ho hyɛ nkɔm a, nna n’egya na ne na a wɔwoo no no wɔbɛse no dɛ, Efata owu; osiandɛ eka atorsɛm wɔ EWURADZE ne dzin mu: na sɛ ɔkɔ do hyɛ nkɔm a, n’egya na ne na a wɔwoo no no, wɔbɔwɔ no nkrantsee.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ, sɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no mu biara hyɛ nkɔm a, n’enyi bɔto wɔ noara n’enyido adzehu no mu; eso wɔnnkɛhyɛ nhwi egugudo dze esisi bio:
title: ZECHARIAH

text: na mbom ɔbɛka dɛ, Mennyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi bi, meyɛ okuafo; na mayɛ kuadwuma fitsi mo mbofrabermu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na sɛ obi bisa no dɛ, Na wo nsa ntamu epirakur yi ɛ? Ɔno na obobua dɛ, Dza wɔdze piraa me wɔ m’adɔfo fie no a.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Afona e, soɛr hyɛ mo guanhwɛfo no do ɛ, na ɔbanyin a ɔyɛ mo ho nyimpa no do ɛ, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse: bɔ guanhwɛfo no, ma nguan no mpetse; na mebɛdan me nsa etsia nkakraba no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba wɔ asaase nyina do, EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ, no mu nkyekyɛmu ebien wobotwitwa, na woewuwu; na dza otsia ebiasa no, wobegya no wɔ mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na medze nkyekyɛmu a otsia ebiasa no mubodua gya mu aba, na mahoa hɔn ho dɛ mbrɛ wɔhoa dwetɛ ho, na mahwɛ hɔn mu dɛ mbrɛ wɔhwɛ sika mu: wɔbɛfrɛ me dzin, na emi so metsie hɔn: mebɛse dɛ, Me man nye hɔn; na hɔn so wɔase dɛ, EWURADZE nye me Nyankopɔn.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Hwɛ, EWURADZE ne da reba a wɔbɛkyɛ w’asadze mu wɔ wo finimfin.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na mobɔboa amanaman nyina ano aba Jerusalɛm do nye no abɔko; na wɔbɛfa kurow no, na wɔafom efiefi no, na wɔatoto mbaa no mbɔndar: na kurow no fa botu akɔ ndɔmmum mu, na ɔman no nkaase no dze worunntwitwa hɔn mmfi kurow no mu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Nna EWURADZE bopue, na ɔnye amanaman no akɔko, dɛ mbrɛ ɔkoe wɔ nkoda mu no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na da no, n’anan besisi Ngo bepɔw no a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm tsentsendo wɔ boka afamu no do, na Ngo bepɔw no bɛpaa ebien wɔ ne finimfin fi boka afamu dze ekesi anee afamu, na ɔayɛ bɔnsa kɛsenara; na bepɔw no ne fa bɔtwe akɔ kwaamu afamu, na ne fa so atwe akɔ pomu afamu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na hom boguanguan afa me mbepɔw no no bɔnsaa no mu; na me bepɔw no no bɔnsaa no bodu Azel: ɛhɛɛ, hom boguanguan, dɛ mbrɛ hom guanguanee wɔ asaasewosow enyim wɔ Judahen Uzia nda mu no: na EWURADZE me Nyankopɔn bɛba, na akrɔnkrɔmfo nyina bɛka wo ho.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na da no, ɔbɛba dɛ awɔw yayaayaw biara nnkɛba:
title: ZECHARIAH

text: na adzekyee so bɛyɛ kor a EWURADZE na onyim; ɔnnyɛ adzekyee, na ɔnnyɛ adzesaa so: na ɔbɛba dɛ ewimbir no na kan bɛba.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na da no, ɔbɛba dɛ nkwa nsu befi Jerusalɛm apem; no mu fa akɔ boka afamu po no mu, na no mu fa so akɔ anee afamu po no mu: ɔpɛber na awɔwber mu na ɔbɛba.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na EWURADZE bedzi hen wɔ asaase no nyina do: da no mu na EWURADZE bɛda noho edzi dɛ EWURADZE kor no ara, na ne dzin so yɛ soronko.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Asaase no nyina bɛdan dɛ Araba, efi Geba ekesi Rimmon wɔ Jerusalɛm pomu afamu; na ɔbɔkrɔn, na ɔatsena ne tsenabea, dze efi Benjamin abobokɛse no ano dze ekesi odzi kan no ho, dze ekesi kutuwdo abobokɛse no ano, na efi Hananel abantsentsen no ho dze ekesi ɔhen ne nsatwer no ho.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na nyimpa bɛtsena mu, na ndom biara remmba hɔ bio; na mbom Jerusalɛm bɛtsena dwudwoodwo.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔyardɔm a EWURADZE dze bɔbɔ amanaman a woetu Jerusalɛm do sa no nyina nye iyi: ber a wogyinagyina hɔn anan do no, hɔn honam bɔprɔw, na hɔn enyiwa so aprɔw wɔ hɔn etu mu, na hɔn tɛkyerɛma aprɔw wɔ hɔn anomu.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba wɔ da no mu dɛ weɔɔweɔɔyɛ kɛse fi EWURADZE hɔ bɛba hɔn mu; na hɔn mu obiara bosuo ne nyɛnko ne nsamu, na ne nsa ama do etsia ne nyɛnko nsa.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na Juda so nye Jerusalɛm bɔko; na wɔbɔboaboa amanaman a etwa ehyia nyina hɔn ahonya ano, sika, na dwetɛ na ntar pii.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔpɔnkɔ, asoasopɔnkɔ, efupɔnkɔ, na asoaso, na mbowa a wɔwɔ nsera mu no hɔn yardɔm bɛyɛ dɛ yardɔm yi ara.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ, amanaman a wotuu Jerusalɛm do sa no nyinara mu dza aka no nyinara bɔfow aba, afrenhyia afrenhyia abɔkotow asɔr Ɔhen, dɔm EWURADZE no, na wɔahyɛ ntamadan afahyɛ no.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ asaase do mbusua nyinara mu hɔn a wɔnnkɔfow aba Jerusalɛm abɔkotow asɔr Ɔhen, dɔm EWURADZE no, nsu ronntɔ hɔn do.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Na sɛ Egypt ebusua ammfow annkɔ ammba a, ɔronntɔ hɔn do; yardɔm a EWURADZE dze bɔbɔ amanaman a wɔnnkɔfow aba abɛhyɛ ntamadan afahyɛ no ɔbɛba hɔ.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Iyi bɛyɛ Egypt na amanaman a wɔnnkɔfow aba abɛhyɛ ntamadan afahyɛ no nyinara hɔn ntsea.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Da no mu no, wɔbɛkyerɛw no wɔ mpɔnkɔ ndɔndɔmba do dɛ, KRƆNKRƆN MA EWURADZE na EWURADZE fie nkutu bɛyɛ dɛ afɔrmbukyia enyim ndweraa.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: Ɛhɛɛ, nkutu a wɔwɔ Jerusalɛm na Juda mu nyina bɛyɛ krɔnkrɔn ama dɔm EWURADZE: na hɔn a wɔbɔ okum afɔr nyina bɛba abɛfa mu bi akɔnoa adze wɔ mu: na da no mu no Keenannyi biara renntsena dɔm EWURADZE fie bio.
title: ZECHARIAH

text: EWURADZE n’asɛm a ɔnam Malaki do baa Israel hɔ nye iyi.
title: MALACHI

text: Madɔ hom, EWURADZE na ɔse. Naaso hom ka dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na adɔ hɛn? Ana nnyɛ Jakob no nua nye Esau? EWURADZE na ɔse: naaso modɔɔ Jakob;
title: MALACHI

text: na Esau dze mikyiir no, na memaa ne mbepɔw yɛɛ afo, na medze n’egyapadze maa sar do mpataku.
title: MALACHI

text: Sɛ Edom ka dɛ, Wɔabɔ hɛn apetse, naaso yɛbɛsan akɛkyekyer mbeambea a ayeyɛ afoafo no a; mbrɛ dɔm EWURADZE so se nye yi, wɔbɛkyekyer, na emi so mubodwuruw egu famu: kɛpem dɛ adasa bɛfrɛ hɔn dɛ, Emumuyɛ man, na Ɔman a EWURADZE afa hɔn ho ebufuw daapem.
title: MALACHI

text: Na hom enyiwa bohu, na hom aka dɛ, EWURADZE yɛ Okokroko mpo tra Israel ahe do.
title: MALACHI

text: Ɔba dzi n’egya nyi, na akowaa dzi no wura nyi: sɛ egya nye me a, nna m’enyidzii wɔ hen? Na sɛ owura nye me a, mo ho suro wɔ hen? Dɔm EWURADZE na ɔka kyerɛ hom asɔfo a wobu me dzin enyimtsia no. Na hom bisa dɛ, Ebɛn mu na yebu wo dzin enyimtsia?
title: MALACHI

text: Hom dze paanoo a no ho ekum brɛ me wɔ m’afɔrmbukyia do. Na hom bisa dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na yeegu wo ho fi? Wɔ dɛ hom ka dɛ, EWURADZE n’edzidzipon no woebu no enyimtsia.
title: MALACHI

text: Na sɛ hom dze abowa nyitɔr ba bɔbɔ afɔr a, ɔnnyɛ bɔn bi! Na sɛ hom dze mbowa mpakye na ayarfo ba bɔbɔ afɔr a, ɔnnyɛ bɔn bi! Afei dze fa kɛma w’ambrado; dɛ n’enyi bɔsɔ wo a? Anaaso mpo dɛ ɔbɔhwɛ w’enyim a? Dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: MALACHI

text: Na afei, hom ntotɔ nserɛ EWURADZE n’enyimpa, ma ɔmbɔdom hɛn ɛ: na sɛ hom nsamu na iyi fi a, aso ɔbɔhwɛ hom mu obiara enyim? Dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: MALACHI

text: Kɛtseankyɛ obi wɔ hom mu a ɔbɔtotow mbobow no mu, amma hom aannsɔ m’afɔrmbukyia do ogya kwa! M’enyi nnsɔ hom hwee, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, eso merenngye hom nsamu ayɛyɛdze biara.
title: MALACHI

text: Na ofitsi wipuei dze kesi no tɔree mpo, me dzin yɛ kɛse wɔ Amanaman mu; na wɔhyew eduhuam bɔ afɔr ma me dzin wɔ mbeambea nyina, na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze a no ho tsew ba: na me dzin yɛ kɛse wɔ Amanaman mu, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: MALACHI

text: Na hom dze, hom gu ho fi, wɔ dɛ hom ka dɛ, EWURADZE n’edzidzipon no ho ekum, na no do aba, n’edziban no, hom bu no enyimtsia.
title: MALACHI

text: Hom ka so dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔhaw bɛn nye yi! Na hom tweetwee gu do, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse; na afei so hom dze dza wɔdze enyimpi fae, na mbowa mpakye na ayarfo no ba; dɛm na hom dze hom ayɛyɛdze ba. Aso mebɛgye iyi wɔ hom nsamu? EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: MALACHI

text: Na ndom nka nyia ɔwɔ onyin wɔ no nguankuw mu, na ɔdze bɔ anohoba, naaso osisi na ɔdze dza odzi dzɛm bɔ EWURADZE okum afɔr no: na ɔhen kɛse nye me, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, na me dzin yɛ hu wɔ Amanaman mu.
title: MALACHI

text: Na afei, hom asɔfo so, mbrasɛm yi homdze a.
title: MALACHI

text: Sɛ hom enntsie, na sɛ hom ammfa annto akoma mu, dɛ hom dze enyimnyam bɛma me dzin a, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, ɔnodze, mobɔsoma ndom aba hom do, na madom hom nhyira: nyew, madom hom dada, osiandɛ hom mmfa m’asɛm nnto hom akoma mu.
title: MALACHI

text: Hwɛ, mubotwuw hom asefo no enyim wɔ hom ntsi, na matow egyanan apetse hom enyim, mekyerɛ hom kum afɔr egyanan no; na wɔbɛsesaw hom aka ho akɔ.
title: MALACHI

text: Na hom bohu dɛ emi na masoma mbrasɛm yi abrɛ hom, ama m’ahyɛmu aako Levi nkyɛn, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: MALACHI

text: M’ahyɛmu a menye no dzii no yɛ nkwa na asomdwee; na medze maa no ama oeesuro, na ampa osuroo me, na me dzin ho yɛɛ no hu.
title: MALACHI

text: Nokwar mbra no daa n’anomu, na woennhu ɔbrakyewsɛm biara wɔ n’anomu; ɔnye me nantseew asomdwee na tɔɔtsenyɛ mu, na ɔdaan dodowara fii emumuyɛ ho.
title: MALACHI

text: Na otwar dɛ ɔsɔfo n’ano sie nyimdzee, odzi mbra do, na ɔyɛ nhwɛdo pa ma afofor: osiandɛ ɔno nye dɔm EWURADZE no bɔfoe.
title: MALACHI

text: Naaso hom aman efi kwan no mu; hom ama dodowara efintsiw mbra no mu; hom asɛɛ Levi ahyɛmu no, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: MALACHI

text: Dɛm ntsi na mo so mama hom ayɛ enyimguasefo na nkɔhweaban wɔ aman nyina enyim, dɛ mbrɛ hom nndzi m’akwan do, na hom ahwɛ nyimpa enyim wɔ mbra no mu ara no.
title: MALACHI

text: Ana nnyɛ egya kor na hɛn nyina yɛwɔ? Ana nnyɛ Nyankopɔn kor na ɔbɔɔ hɛn nyina? Ɔyɛ dɛn na hɛn mu obiara twa no nua nkontompɔ, yɛdze gu hɛn egyanom ahyɛmu ho fi yi?
title: MALACHI

text: Juda etwa nkontompɔ, na wɔayɛ ekyiwadze wɔ Israel na Jerusalɛm; osiandɛ Juda ehura EWURADZE no krɔnkrɔnbea a ɔdɔ no no ho, na ɔawar anana bosom ne babaa.
title: MALACHI

text: EWURADZE botwa ɔbanyin a onyim naaso ɔhyɛ da ara yɛ iyi no efi Jakob asese mu, na ɔapow n’ayɛyɛdze a ɔdze brɛ dɔm EWURADZE no.
title: MALACHI

text: Na iyi so bio na hom yɛ: hom dze nyinsuwa kata EWURADZE n’afɔrmbukyia no do, osu na nkrumsi, ma dɛm ntsi ommbu ayɛyɛdze no bi bio, eso ɔmmfa ɔpɛ pa bi nngye no wɔ hom nsamu.
title: MALACHI

text: Naaso hom ka dɛ, Ase nye dɛn? Ase nye dɛ EWURADZE ayɛ ɔwo na wo mberantsɛber mu yer no ntamu dasefo, ɔno na etwa no nkontompɔ, naaso ɔno nye wo kafo, na w’ahyɛmudzi yer.
title: MALACHI

text: Ana Nyankopɔn annyɛ hom kor a no su wɔ hom mu? Ebɛnadze ntsi a? Dɛ hom bɔwo mba a wɔyɛ Nyamesurofo. Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie wɔ hom sunsum ho, na mma obiara nntwa ne mberantsɛber mu yer nkontompɔ.
title: MALACHI

text: Na emi mikyir awargu, EWURADZE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, na ɔse, na nyia ɔdze emimdzi kata n’atar do, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse: dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie wɔ hom sunsum ho, amma hom eenntwa nkontompɔ.
title: MALACHI

text: Hom dze hom nsɛm ama EWURADZE aberɛ. Naaso hom bisa dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na yɛama ɔaberɛ? Dɛ hom ka dɛ, Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔn no, oye wɔ EWURADZE enyim, na hɔn ho yɛ no enyigye. Na hom bisa so dɛ, Atsɛmbu Nyankopɔn no, ɔwɔ hen?
title: MALACHI

text: Hwɛ, morosoma mo bɔfoe, na obesiesie kwan edzi m’enyim: na EWURADZE a hom rohwehwɛ no no, ɔbɛba n’asɔrfi mu awora; ɛhɛɛ, ahyɛmu no ho bɔfo a hom enyi gye no ho no, hwɛ, ɔreba, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: MALACHI

text: Na woana botum egyina ne mbae da no enyim? Na sɛ opue a, woana botum egyina? Osiandɛ ɔtse dɛ namfo gya, na ɔtanhofo semina:
title: MALACHI

text: na ɔbɛtsena ase dɛ dwetɛ namfo na yiyimufo, na ɔbɛtsew Levimba ho, na ɔapɔw hɔn ho dɛ sika na dwetɛ; na wɔdze ayɛyɛdze bɛma EWURADZE wɔ tsenenee mu.
title: MALACHI

text: Nna Juda na Jerusalɛm ayɛyɛdze bɔsɔ EWURADZE enyi dɛ kan nda no, na tsetse mfe no.
title: MALACHI

text: Na mebɛbɛn hom ebobu atsɛn; na mebɛyɛ ɔdasefo a no ho yɛ har etsia abayifo, na awartofo, na ntanhunkafo; na hɔn a wodzi ɔpaanyi emim wɔ n’apaadze mu, na wosisi okunafo, na egyankaba, na wɔbɔ ɔhɔho enyi fi ne ndzinoa ho, na wonnsuro me no, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: MALACHI

text: Na emi EWURADZE mennsakyer; dɛm ntsi na hom, Jakob mba, hom nnsae no.
title: MALACHI

text: Ofitsi hom egyanom nda do na hom adan efi m’ahyɛdze ho, na hom enndzi do. Hom nsan mbra me nkyɛn, na mebɛsan aba hom nkyɛn, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse. Na hom bisa dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na yɛnsan?
title: MALACHI

text: Aso nyimpa bowia Nyame n’adze? Naaso hom wia me. Na hom bisa dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na yewia wo? Ebupɛn du na ayɛyɛdze mu a.
title: MALACHI

text: Wɔdze ndom adom hom; osiandɛ hom wia me, ɔman yi nyinara a.
title: MALACHI

text: Hom mfa ebupɛn du no nyina mbra adzekoradan no mu, ma edziban mbra me fie, na hom mfa yi nsɔ me nhwɛ, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ munnkobue sor ntokura ama hom, na mehue nhyira ama hom a hom rinnya bea a ɔso a wɔdze bɛgye a.
title: MALACHI

text: Na mubotwuw ɔsɛɛfo no enyim wɔ hom ntsi, na ɔnnkɛsɛɛ hom asaase do nduadzewa; eso hom wenyindua nnkɔpo no nsowee egu famu ansaana ne ber edu, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: MALACHI

text: Na amanaman nyina bɛfrɛ hom ahomkafo: osiandɛ hom bɛyɛ enyika asaase, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: MALACHI

text: Hom akasa dzendzen etsia me, EWURADZE na ɔse. Naaso hom bisa dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na yɛakasa etsia wo?
title: MALACHI

text: Hom aka dɛ, Nyamesom yɛ kwa: na ebɛn mfaso na ɔyɛ dɛ yeedzi n’ahyɛdze do, na yɛanantsew wɔ nnuho mu wɔ dɔm EWURADZE enyim?
title: MALACHI

text: Na afei yɛfrɛ ɔhopɔwnyi dɛ ɔhomkanyi; ɛhɛɛ, hɔn a wɔyɛ emumuyɛ no esi hɔn yie; nyew, mpo wɔsɔ Nyankopɔn hwɛ, na wofi mu fir so.
title: MALACHI

text: Nna hɔn a wosuroo EWURADZE no kasaa kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔnho: na EWURADZE kyɛɛn aso, na otsiei, na wɔkyerɛɛw nkaa nwoma wɔ n’enyim maa hɔn a wosuroo EWURADZE, na wɔdwendween ne dzin ho no.
title: MALACHI

text: Na wɔbɛyɛ medze, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, wɔ da a mebɛyɛ yi no mu, mekyerɛ m’akoradze soronko; na mobɔfofɔw hɔn dɛ mbrɛ obi fofɔw ne ba a ɔsom no yie no.
title: MALACHI

text: Ɔno na hom bɛsan ebohu sorbi a ɔda tseneneenyi na mumuyɛnyi ntamu, nyia ɔsom Nyankopɔn na nyia ɔnnsom no no ntamu.
title: MALACHI

text: Hwɛ, da no reba, ɔrehyew dɛ fononoo mu gya; na ahopɔwfo nyina, nye emumuyɛfo nyina bɛyɛ dɛ mburonan: na da a ɔreba no bɛhyew hɔn, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse, dɛ orinngya hɔn ndwow anaa abaw biara.
title: MALACHI

text: Na hom a hom suro me dzin no dze, ndzeyɛtsenenee ewia dze ayarsa wɔ ne ntsaban mu bopue ama hom; na hom bopue, na hom ehuruhuruw dɛ nantwiban mu anantwifɔr.
title: MALACHI

text: Na hom betsiatsia emumuyɛfo do; na wɔbɛyɛ nso wɔ hom ananadze wɔ da a mebɛyɛ yi no mu, dɔm EWURADZE na ɔse.
title: MALACHI

text: Hom nkaa m’akowaa Moses mbra a mehyɛɛ no wɔ Horeb maa Israel nyinara no, mekyerɛ ahyɛdze na atsɛmbudze no.
title: MALACHI

text: Hwɛ, mobɔsoma nkɔnhyɛnyi Elija abrɛ hom ansaana EWURADZE ne da kɛse a ɔyɛ hu no edu.
title: MALACHI

text: Na ɔbɛdandan egyanom hɔn akoma aba mba do, na mba hɔn akoma aba hɔn egyanom do; amma maammfa ndom ammbɔbɔ asaase no.
title: MALACHI

text: Jesus Kraest, David ne ba, Abraham ne ba no n’ebusuasantsen nwoma.
title: MATTHEW

text: Abraham woo Isaak, na Isaak woo Jakob; na Jakob so woo Juda nye no nuanom;
title: MATTHEW

text: na Juda nye Tamar woo Perez nye Zera; na Perez woo Hezron; na Hezron woo Ram;
title: MATTHEW

text: na Ram woo Amminadab; na Amminadab woo Nahshon; na Nahshon woo Salmon;
title: MATTHEW

text: Salmon nye Rahab woo Boaz; na Boaz nye Rut woo Obed; na Obed woo Jesse;
title: MATTHEW

text: na Jesse woo Ɔhen David. Na David nye nyia nkyɛ ɔyɛ Uria yer no woo Solomon;
title: MATTHEW

text: na Solomon woo Rehoboam; na Rehoboam woo Abija; na Abija woo Asa;
title: MATTHEW

text: Asa woo Jehosafat; na Jehosafat woo Joram; na Joram woo Uzia;
title: MATTHEW

text: na Uzia woo Jotam; na Jotam woo Ahaz; na Ahaz woo Hezekia;
title: MATTHEW

text: na Hezekia woo Manaasɛ; na Manaasɛ woo Amon; na Amon woo Josia;
title: MATTHEW

text: na Josia woo Jekonia nye no nuanom wɔ aber wɔfaa hɔn ndɔmmum kɔr Babilɔn no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Babilɔn ndɔmmumkɔ ber no ekyir no, Jekonia woo Sealtiel; na Sealtiel woo Zerubabel;
title: MATTHEW

text: na Zerubabel woo Abiud; Abiud woo Eliakim; na Eliakim woo Azor;
title: MATTHEW

text: Azor so woo Sadok; na Sadok woo Akim; na Akim woo Eliud;
title: MATTHEW

text: Eliud woo Eleazar; na Eleazar woo Matan; na Matan woo Jakob;
title: MATTHEW

text: na Jakob woo Josef, Mary a ɔwoo nyia wɔfrɛ no Kraest no no kun no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Afei ebusuasantsen a ofi Abraham do besi David do nyina yɛ ebusuasantsen duanan; na ofi David do besi Babilɔn ndɔmmumkɔ ber no do yɛ ebusuasantsen duanan; na ofi Babilɔn ndɔmmumkɔ ber no do besi Kraest no do yɛ ebusuasantsen duanan.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mbrɛ Jesus Kraest n’awoo tse nye yi: ber a wɔdze ne na Mary maa Josef dɛ n’esiwayer, na wonnyae nnhyiaa mu no, wohun no dɛ onyinsen dza ofi Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na no kun Josef yɛ nyimpa tsenenee, na ɔmmpɛ dɛ ogu n’enyim ase bagua mu ntsi, ɔdween dɛ obegyaa no wɔ nsumaa mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na aber a ɔrodwen yinom ho no, hwɛ, Ewuradze bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ no wɔ adaaso mu see dɛ, Josef, David ba, mma nnsuro dɛ ebɛfa wo yer Mary aba wo nkyɛn; na dza onyinsen no fi Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔbɔwo babanyin, na ato no dzin Jesus, osiandɛ ɔno na ɔbɛgye ne man efi hɔn bɔn mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na yinom nyina ayɛ hɔ, ma dza Ewuradze nam nkɔnhyɛnyi no do kae no aaba mu dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Hwɛ, ɔbaabun benyinsen, na ɔawo babanyin, Na wɔbɔto no dzin Immanuel, (a ne nkyerɛase nye dɛ, Onyame nye hɛn wɔ hɔ.)
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Josef fii nda mu nyanee no, ɔyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ bɔfo no hyɛɛ no no, na ɔkɛfaa ne yer baa ne nkyɛn;
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔnnye no ennhyia mu araa dze kodur dɛ ɔwoo babanyin: na ɔtoo no dzin Jesus.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ber a wɔwoo Jesus wɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm wɔ Judea, wɔ Ɔhen Herod aber do no, hwɛ, enyansafo bi fi boka baa Jerusalɛm bebisaa dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Hen na nyia wɔawo no Jewfo Hen no wɔ? Na yehun no woraba wɔ boka, na yɛaba dɛ yɛrobɔkotow no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Ɔhen Herod tsee no, n’akoma tui, na Jerusalɛm nyina so dɛmara.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ohyiaa ɔman no asɔfompanyin nye akyerɛwfo nyina no, obisabisaa hɔn fakor a wɔbɔwo Kraest no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Wɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm wɔ Judea, na dɛm na nkɔnhyɛnyi no akyerɛw dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔwo, Bɛtlɛhɛm, Juda asaase, Ampaara ennyɛ kumaba wɔ Juda asafohen no mu: Na ɔwo wo mu na ambrado befi aba; Ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ me man Israel no guanhwɛfo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Herod frɛɛ enyansafo no wɔ nsumaa mu no, obisaa hɔn ber a woraba no puei no ara yie.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsomaa hɔn Bɛtlɛhɛm dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɔhwehwɛ abofraba no ho asɛm yie, na sɛ hom hu no a, hom mbɛka nkyerɛ me, ma mo so membra mombɔkotow no bi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn dze, wotsiee ɔhen no no, wosii mu kɔree; na hwɛ, woraba a wohunii wɔ boka no dzii hɔn enyim kodur dɛ okegyinaa mbrɛ abofraba no wɔ no etsifi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wohun woraba no, wodzii dɛw kɛse pa ara.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔbaa dan no mu bohun abofraba no ɔnye ne na Mary, na wɔkotowee sɔɔr no, na wobuee hɔn akoradze kyɛɛ no adze, sika nye krɔbɔw nye eduhuam mɛɛr.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na woyii kyerɛɛ hɔn adaaso mu dɛ mma wɔnnsan nnkɔ Herod nkyɛn bio no, wɔfaa kwan fofor bi do sanee kɔr hɔn kurow mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wofiir hɔ kɔree no, hwɛ, Ewuradze no bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ Josef adaaso mu see no dɛ, Soɛr, fa abofraba no nye ne na guan kɔ Egypt, na tsena hɔ kodu dɛ mebɛse wo: na Herod robɔhwehwɛ abofraba no eku no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsoɛree no, ɔfaa abofraba no nye ne na anadwe, na osii mu kɔr Egypt,
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔwɔ hɔ araa dze kodur Herod no wu, ma dza Ewuradze nam nkɔnhyɛnyi no do kae no aaba mu dɛ, Mafrɛ me ba efi Egypt.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Herod hun dɛ enyansafo no edzi no ho fɛw no, no bo fuuw kɛsenara, na ɔsomae ma wokokum mbofra nyina a wɔwɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm nye no ntoaado nyina a woedzi mfe ebien nye hɔn a wonnyae nndzii, dɛ mbrɛ mber a obisaa enyansafo no yie no wɔkyerɛɛ no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia kae no baa mu dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Wɔtsee ndze bi wɔ Rama, Osu nye ewuotwa kɛse, Rakel rusu ne mba, Na ɔmmpɛ dɛ wɔkyekye no werɛ, osiandɛ wonnyi hɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Herod wui no, hwɛ, EWURADZE no bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ Josef adaaso mu wɔ Egypt see no dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Soɛr, fa abofraba no nye ne na kɔ Israel asaase do, na hɔn a nna wɔrohwehwɛ abofraba no eku no no, ewu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ɔsoɛree faa abofraba no nye ne na na ɔbaa Israel asaase do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔtsee dɛ Arkelaus ridzi hen wɔ Judea wɔ n’egya Herod ananmu no, osuroo dɛ ɔbɔkɔ hɔ, na woyii kyerɛɛ no adaaso mu no, ɔmaan Galilii afamu,
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔbɛtsenaa kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Nazarɛt mu, ma dza nkɔnhyɛfo no kae no aaba mu dɛ, Wɔbɛfrɛ no Nazarɛtnyi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nda no mu no John Onumanyi no bae bɛkaa asɛm wɔ Judea sar do,
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nnu homho, na ɔsor ahenman no abɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na oyi nye nyia nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia kaa no ho asɛm dɛ, Obi ne ndze retsea mu wɔ sar no do dɛ, Hom nsiesie Ewuradze no kwan, Hom mma n’atsempɔn ntsentsen no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna John fura efupɔnkɔnhwi tam, na nwoma abɔdo bɔ n’asen, na n’edziban nye mbɛbɛw na kwaa mu wo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jerusalɛm nye Judea nyina nye asaase a abɔ Jordan ho aprɔw nyina puei kɔr no hɔ
title: MATTHEW

text: kɛkaa hɔn bɔn, na onumaa hɔn wɔ esutsen Jordan mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ohun Farisiifo nye Sadusiifo no mu pii dɛ wɔreba n’enuma ho no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nhurutsia mba! Woana tuee hom aso dɛ hom nguan mfi ebufuw a ɔreba no ho?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na afei hom nsow aba a ɔkyerɛ nnuho:
title: MATTHEW

text: na mma hom nnsusu nnka wɔ hom mu dɛ, Hɛn dze, hɛn egya nye Abraham: na mese hom dɛ, Nyankopɔn botum dɛ onyan mba fi abo yi mu ma Abraham.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na afei so wɔdze ekuma no ato ndua no ndwow ho dada, dɛ dua biara a ɔnnsow aba pa no wobotwa no ato gya mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Emi dze, munuma hom nsu mu kɔ nnuho mu, na nyia odzi m’ekyir reba no ɔkrɔn kyɛn me, no nsokota mpo mennsɛ dɛ mikitsa: ɔno na obonuma hom wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu, na gya mu;
title: MATTHEW

text: ɔno na no nhuwdo apaawa adze kitsa ne nsamu, na ɔbɛpra ne famu hɔ kofee, na ɔaboaboa n’ewifua ano ekogu san do, na ntsɛw no ɔdze gya a onndum ahyew.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Jesus fii Galilii baa John hɔ wɔ Jordan dɛ onnuma no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na John dze, nkyɛ orisiw no kwan dɛ, Emi na mihia dɛ ɔwo inuma me, na ɔwo ereba mo hɔ yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Sesei dze, ma ho kwan, na ɔnam iyi do na yɛhyɛ tsenenee nyina ma. Nna ɔpeen do maa no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wonumaa Jesus wiei ma ofii nsu no mu no, hwɛ, ntsɛmara sor buei maa no, na ohun dɛ Nyankopɔn no Sunsum risian tse dɛ ebubur ba no do;
title: MATTHEW

text: na hwɛ, ndze bi fi sor kaa dɛ, Oyi nye mo Dɔba a ɔsɔ m’enyi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Sunsum no dze Jesus kɔr sar no do ma abɔnsam no kɔsɔɔ no hwɛe.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na odzii mbuada adaduanan adzekyee nye adzesaa, na ekyir no ɔkɔm dzee no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsɔhwɛfo no baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba a, kasa ma abo yi ndan paanoo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see dɛ, Wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Nnyɛ paanoo nko bi na nyimpa nam do bɛtsena ase, na asɛm biara a ofi Nyankopɔn anomu so.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna abɔnsam faa no kɔr kurow krɔnkrɔn no mu, na ɔdze no kesii asɔrfi ne bea sorɔnsorɔm no do,
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba a, tow woho kyen famu: na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Ɔbɛhyɛ n’abɔfoe mbra wɔ wo ho, Na wɔdze hɔn nsa bɔsɔw wo, amma aammfa wo nan ammpem ɔbo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Wɔakyerɛw bio dɛ, Mma nnsɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na abɔnsam faa no bio kɔr kokwaa tsentsenntsen bi do, na ɔkyerɛɛ no wiadze ahenman nyina nye no mu enyimnyam.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Yinom nyina na medze mebɛma wo, sɛ ebɔkotow asɔr me a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Jesus see no dɛ, Fi ha fi, Satan: na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Sɔr Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na no nko na som no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna abɔnsam no gyaa no hɔ; na hwɛ, abɔfo bae bɔsoom no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus tsee dɛ woeyi John ama no, ɔtwee noho kɔr Galilii;
title: MATTHEW

text: na ofii Nazarɛt no, ɔbae bɛtsenaa Karpernaum a ɔwɔ mpoano wɔ Zebulun nye Naftali ntoaado no;
title: MATTHEW

text: ma dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia kae no aaba mu dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Zebulun asaase! Naftali asaase! Po kwan do, Jordan egya, Amanamamfo Galilii,
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔman a wɔtse sum mu Ehu kan kɛse, Na hɔn a wɔtse owu asaase sunkamm do no, kan epue ama hɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ofitsi dɛm aber no Jesus hyɛɛ n’asɛnka ase na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nnu homho, na ɔsor ahenman no abɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔnenam Galilii po ho no, ohun enuanom beenu, Simon a wɔfrɛ no Peter, nye no nua Andrew dɛ wɔrotow eboa wɔ po mu; osiandɛ wɔyɛ afarfo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mbedzi m’ekyir, na mebɛyɛ hom nyimpa enufo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ntsɛmara wɔdaan eboa no gyae na wobedzii n’ekyir.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ofii hɔ kɔr n’enyim no, ohun enuanom beenu so, Zebedee ne ba James nye no nua John a wɔnye hɔn egya Zebedee wɔ hɛn mu resa hɔn mboa; na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ntsɛmara wɔdaan hɛn no nye hɔn egya gyae, na wokedzii n’ekyir.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus kekyimaa Galilii nyina kyerɛkyerɛe wɔ nhyiamudan mu; na ɔkaa ahenman no ho asɛmpa no, na ɔsaa nyarba nyina nye ahoɔmberɛw nyina wɔ ɔman no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na no ho asɛm tahyee kɔr Siria nyina; na wɔdze hɔn a wɔyar nyina a nyarba nye amandzehu horow ekitsa hɔn, nye hɔn a mbɔnsam afa hɔn, nye hɔn a wotwa ehim, nye mbubuifo brɛɛ no, ma ɔsaa hɔn yarba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpadodow pii a wofi Galilii nye Dekapolis nye Jerusalɛm nye Judea nye Jordan egya kaa no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ohun nyimpadodow no, ɔkɔr koko no do, na ɔtsenaa ase no, n’esuafo baa ne nkyɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuee n’ano kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ:
title: MATTHEW

text: Nhyira aka sunsum mu ehiafo, na hɔn na ɔsor ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nhyira aka hɔn a hɔn werɛ ahow, na hɔn na wɔbɛkyekye hɔn werɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nhyira aka abrɛfo, na hɔn na wobenya asaase no edzi do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nhyira aka hɔn a tsenenee ho ɔkɔm nye nsukɔm dze hɔn, na hɔn na wɔbɛma wɔamee.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nhyira aka mbɔbɔrhufo, na hɔn na wobohu hɔn mbɔbɔr.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nhyira aka hɔn a hɔn akoma mu tsew, na hɔn na wobohu Nyankopɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nhyira aka esiesiefo, na hɔn na wɔbɛfrɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn mba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nhyira aka hɔn a tsenenee ntsi wɔahaw hɔn, na hɔn na ɔsor ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nhyira aka hom ber a wɔbɛyaw hom, na wɔahaw hom, na wɔaka nsɛmbɔn nyina ato hom do akɔhwi mu, wɔ me ntsi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom ndzi dɛw na hom ho nsɛpɛw hom, na hom akatua so wɔ sor; na dɛmara na wɔhaaw nkɔnhyɛfo a wodzii hom kan no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nye asaase do nkyen; na sɛ nkyen no ayew ne dɛw a, wɔdze ebɛnadze bɛhyɛ no nkyen? Onnye mma hwee bio, na mbom wɔtow gu ma nyimpa tsiatsia do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nye wiadze kan no. Kurow a ɔda koko do nntum nnsuma.
title: MATTHEW

text: Eso wɔnnsɔ kandzea mmfa nnsi kuruw ase; na wɔdze si kandzeadua do, ma ɔhyerɛn ma hɔn a wɔwɔ fie nyina.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ne dɛm ntsi, hom mma hom kan no nhyerɛn wɔ nyimpa enyim, ama woeehu hom ndwuma pa na wɔaahyɛ hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no enyimnyam.
title: MATTHEW

text: Mma hom nndwen dɛ mebae dɛ merebɛsɛɛ mbra no anaa nkɔnhyɛfo no: dabida, mammbɛsɛɛ, mbom mebɛhyɛɛ ma.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nokwar mese hom dɛ, Sor nye asaase nnyae nntwaa mu yi, akyerɛwdze kor anaadɛ nsensanee kor mpo nnkefi mbra no ho etwa mu, gyedɛ ne nyina ahyɛ ma ana.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi obiara a ɔbɔto mbransɛm nketseaba yi mu kor, na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ nyimpa dɛm no, wɔbɛfrɛ no aketseaba wɔ sor ahenman no mu; na obiara a ɔbɛyɛ na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ no, ɔno na wɔbɛfrɛ no ɔkɛse wɔ sor ahenman no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mese hom dɛ gyedɛ hom tsenenee kyɛn Akyerɛwfo no nye Farisiifo no hɔn tsenenee, ɔno hom nnkɛhɛn sor ahenman no mu da.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom atse dɛ wɔkaa kyerɛɛ tsetsefo no dɛ, Mma nndzi ewu, na obiara a obedzi ewu no, obedzi fɔ wɔ atsɛmbu no mu;
title: MATTHEW

text: na emi dze mese hom dɛ, Obiara a no bo fuw no nua gyan, obedzi atsɛmbu no mu fɔ; na obiara a ɔbɛse no nua, Raka, obedzi fɔ wɔ mpanyimfo bagua mu; na obiara a ɔbɛse, Ɔkwasea no, obedzi fɔ akɔ amandzehu kurow mu gya no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ edze w’ayɛyɛdze ba afɔrmbukyia no ho, na sɛ ekaa wɔ hɔ dɛ wo nua wɔ wo ho asɛm bi a,
title: MATTHEW

text: gyaa w’ayɛyɛdze wɔ afɔrmbukyia no enyim hɔ, na dzi kan kɔ nye wo nua nkɔbɔ mu, ana aba abɛma w’ayɛyɛdze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Enye wo tamfo mbɔ mu ntsɛm ber a enye no wɔ kwan mu no; amma da bi wo tamfo eennyi wo annhyɛ ɔtsɛmbuafo nsa, na ɔtsɛmbuafo no eennyi wo annhyɛ ɔsomfo nsa, ma wɔaammfa wo annkɔto efiadze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nokwar mese wo dɛ, Innkefi hɔ gyedɛ etua kapɛrba biara a aka ekyir no ana.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom atse dɛ wɔkaa dɛ, Mma nnto awar;
title: MATTHEW

text: na emi dze mese hom dɛ, Obiara a ɔhwɛ ɔbaa dɛ no kɔn dɔ no no, ɔafa no dada wɔ n’akoma mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ w’enyiwa nyimfa to wo fintsidua a, tu na tow fi woho kyen: na oye ma wo dɛ wo nyimpadua ne fa kor bɛsɛɛ na wɔammfa wo nyimpadua nyina annkɔto amandzehu kurow mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ wo nsa nyimfa to wo fintsidua a, twa na tow fi woho kyen: na oye ma wo dɛ ebɔhwer wo nyimpadua ho beebi na wo nyimpadua nyina nnkɔkɔ amandzehu kurow mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Wɔkae so dɛ, Obiara a obegyaa ne yer awar no, ma ɔmma no awargu no ho krataa;
title: MATTHEW

text: naaso emi dze, mese hom dɛ, Obiara a obegyaa ne yer, ber a basia no mmbɔɔ edwaman no, ɔma basia no to awar; na obiara a ɔbɔwar nyia woegyaa no no, ɔto awar.
title: MATTHEW

text: Bio hom atse dɛ wɔkaa kyerɛɛ tsetsefo no dɛ, Mma nnka ntanhun, na fa w’atanyi ma Ewuradze;
title: MATTHEW

text: na emi dze, mese hom dɛ, Mma hom nnka ntam koraa: mma hom nnka ɔsor, osiandɛ ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn n’ahengua;
title: MATTHEW

text: mma hom nnka asaase, osiandɛ ɔyɛ n’ananadzegua; mma hom nnka Jerusalɛm, osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔhen kɛse no kurow.
title: MATTHEW

text: Eso mma mmfa wo tsir nnka ntam, osiandɛ irunntum nnyɛ nhwi kor fufuw anaa tuntum.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom mma hom Nyew, nyɛ Nyew; na hom Oho, nnyɛ Oho; osiandɛ biribi a ɔkyɛn yinom fi bɔn mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom atse dɛ wɔkaa dɛ, Enyiwa nsi enyiwa ananmu, na ese nsi ese ananmu;
title: MATTHEW

text: naaso emi dze, mese hom dɛ, Mma hom nye ɔbɔnfo no nndzi esi; mbom sɛ obi bɔ wo sotɔr wɔ w’enyimfa a, dan bankum no so ma no;
title: MATTHEW

text: na sɛ obi pɛ dɛ ɔnye wo dzi asɛm, na ɔgye w’asetar a, ma ɔmfa wo nkatado no so;
title: MATTHEW

text: na obiara a ɔbɛhyɛ wo dɛ enye no nkɔ ɔkwansin kor no, enye no nkɔ ebien.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nyia ɔserɛ wo no, ma no; nyia ɔpɛ dɛ ɔfɛm wɔ wo hɔ no, mma nndan woho mmfi no ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom atse dɛ wɔkaa dɛ, Dɔ wo nyɛnko na tan wo tamfo;
title: MATTHEW

text: naaso emi dze, mese hom dɛ, Hom ndɔ hom atamfo, na hom nsɔr mma hɔn a wɔhaw hom;
title: MATTHEW

text: ama hom aayɛ hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no ne mba: na ɔma n’ewia fir wɔ nyimpa bɔn nye nyimpa pa do, na ɔtɔ nsu gu hɔn a wɔtsen nye hɔn a wɔnntsen do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ hom dɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ hom a, ebɛn akatua na hom nya? Ana atowgyefo no so nnyɛ dɛmara?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ hom kyia hom nuanom nko a, ebɛnadze na hom ayɛ abor do? Ana amanamamfo no so nnyɛ dɛmara?
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ndzi mu, dɛ mbrɛ hom sor Egya no dzi mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nhwɛ yie, mma hom aannyɛ hom tsenenee wɔ nyimpa enyim dɛ wonhu: ɔyɛ dɛm a, hom nnyi akatua wɔ hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no nkyɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ ereyɛ adɔyɛ a, mma nnhɛn totorobɛnto wɔ w’enyim dɛ mbrɛ ndabrabafo no yɛ wɔ nhyiamudan nye abrɔn mu no, ama woeenya nyimpa hɔ enyimnyam. Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Woenya hɔn akatua dada.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ ereyɛ adɔyɛ a, mma wo nsa bankum nnhu dza wo nsa nyimfa reyɛ;
title: MATTHEW

text: ama w’adɔyɛ aaka nsumaa mu, na w’Egya a ohu nsumaa mu no obotua wo kaw wɔ gua do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ hom rosɔr a, mma hom nnyɛ dɛ ndabrabafo no; osiandɛ wɔpɛ dɛ wogyina nhyiamudan mu nye abɔntsen ntoaado sɔr, ama nyimpa eehu. Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Woenya hɔn akatua dada.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔwo dze, sɛ erosɔr a, hɛn wo pia mu, na atow w’abow mu no, sɔr ma w’Egya a ɔwɔ nsumaa mu no, na w’Egya a ohu nsumaa mu no obotua wo kaw wɔ gua do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom rosɔr a, mma hom nnyɛ kasafow ara gyan, dɛ amanamamfo no: osiandɛ wɔdwen dɛ wobetsie hɔn wɔ hɔn kasa dodow ntsi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi mma hom nyɛ dɛ hɔn: osiandɛ hom Egya nyim ndzɛmba a ohia hom ansaana hom ribisa no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nsɔr dɛm: Hɛn Egya a ewɔ sor, wo dzin ho ntsew,
title: MATTHEW

text: w’ahendzi mbra, wɔnyɛ wo pɛ wɔ asaase do dɛ mbrɛ wɔyɛ no wɔ sor.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ma hɛn, hɛn daa daa edziban ndɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na fa hɛn mfom kyɛ hɛn, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn so yɛdze kyɛ hɔn a wɔfom hɛn no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mma mmfa hɛn nnkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu, na yi hɛn fi mbusu mu. [Na ɔwo na ahendzi, nye tum nye enyimnyam yɛ wodze daa. Amen]
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ hom dze nyimpa hɔn mfom kyɛ hɔn a, hom sor Egya so dze bɛkyɛ hom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ hom ammfa nyimpa hɔn mfom annkyɛ hɔn a, hom Egya so remmfa hom mfom nnkyɛ hom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na eso sɛ hom ridzi mbuada a, mma hom nnyɛ dɛ ndabrabafo no mmunamuna hom enyim: na wɔsɛɛ hɔn enyim ma nyimpa eehu dɛ woridzi mbuada. Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Woenya hɔn akatua.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔwo dze, sɛ idzi mbuada a, sera wo tsirmu na hohor w’enyim;
title: MATTHEW

text: amma eennyi woho annkyerɛ nyimpa dɛ iridzi mbuada, na mbom wɔ w’Egya a ɔwɔ nsumaa mu no enyim, na w’Egya a ohu nsumaa mu no ɔbɛma wo akatua.
title: MATTHEW

text: Mma hom mmpɛ akoradze nngu asaase do, mbrɛ nkakraka nye nkandar sɛɛ no, na ewifo bubu mu kowia;
title: MATTHEW

text: na hom mpɛ akoradze ngu sor, mbrɛ nkakraka nye nkandar nnsɛɛ no, na ewifo mmbubu mu nnkowia:
title: MATTHEW

text: na mbrɛ w’akoradze wɔ no, hɔ na w’akoma so wɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nyimpadua ne kandzea nye enyiwa: dɛm ntsi sɛ w’enyiwa yɛ kor a, wo nyimpadua nyina bɛyɛ kann.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ w’enyiwa muo a, wo nyimpadua nyina bɛyɛ kusuww. Na sɛ kan a ɔwɔ wo mu no yɛ sum a, sum no ne kɛse tse dɛn!
title: MATTHEW

text: Obiara nntum nnsom ewuranom beenu; osiandɛ obekyir baako na ɔadɔ baako, anaadɛ obedzi baako nyi na oebu ɔbaako enyimtsia. Hom runntum nnsom Nyankopɔn nye ahonyadze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, Mma hom nndwendwen hom nkwa ho, dɛ ebɛnadze na hom bedzi anaa ebɛnadze na hom bɔnom, anaaso hom nyimpadua ho, dɛ ebɛnadze na hom bofura. Ana nkwa nnkyɛn edziban, anaa nyimpadua nnkyɛn efuradze?
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nhwɛ wimu nnoma dɛ wonndua na wommbu, eso wɔmmboaboa ano nnhyɛ san do; naaso hom sor Egya nyɛn hɔn. Ana hom nnsom bo pii nnkyɛn hɔn?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom mu woana na ɔdwendwen a, obotum dze basafa kor ato ne tsentsen do?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔyɛ dɛn na hom dwendwen wɔ efuradze ho? Hom nhwɛ nsua haban mu nsukookoo mbrɛ wonyin: wɔnnyɛ edwuma, eso wɔnntow asaaba:
title: MATTHEW

text: naaso mese hom dɛ Solomon n’enyimnyam nyina mu mpo ɔannkeka noho dɛ yinom mu kor.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ Nyankopɔn ma haban mu efuw a ɔwɔ ha ndɛ na ɔkyena wɔdze gu fononoo mu efuradze dɛm a, ɔnnkɛyɛ dza ɔkyɛn yi pii ama hom, hom a hom gyedzi suar?
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi mma hom nndwendwen dɛ, ebɛnadze na yebedzi? Anaa, Ebɛnadze na yɛbɔnom, anaa, ebɛnadze na yebofura?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na dɛm ndzɛmba yi nyina na amanamamfo hwehwɛ; na hom sor Egya nyim dɛ yinom nyina hia hom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom ndzi kan nhwehwɛ n’ahenman nye ne tsenenee, na wɔdze yinom nyina bɛka hom ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi mma hom nndwendwen ɔkyena ho; na ɔkyena bɔdwendwen nankasa no ho. Da kor no mu bɔn dɔɔ so ma da no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Mma hom mmbu atsɛn, ma wommbu hom atsɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na atsɛmbu kor a hom dze bobu no, wɔdze bobu hom; na esusudze kor a hom dze susu no, wɔdze bosusu ama hom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔyɛ dɛn na ehwɛ duaba a ɔwɔ wo nua enyiwa mu, na enndwen mpuna a ɔwɔ wankasa w’enyiwa mu ho?
title: MATTHEW

text: Anaaso ebɛyɛ dɛn ase wo nua dɛ, Ma minyi duaba mfi w’enyiwa mu, na hwɛ, mpuna wɔ wankasa w’enyiwa mu?
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔwo dabrabanyi, dzi kan yi mpuna fi wankasa w’enyiwa mu: nna ibohu yie eyi duaba no efi wo nua enyiwa mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Mma hom mmfa dza no ho tsew no mma nkraman, eso mma hom nntow hom ahondze pa nngu mpreko enyim, amma wɔaammfa hɔn anan enntsiatsia do, na wɔaannsan bio ammbɛtsetsew hom mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom mbisa na wɔbɛma hom; hom nhwehwɛ na hom bohu; hom mbɔ mu na wobobue hom:
title: MATTHEW

text: na obiara a obisa no onya; na nyia ɔhwehwɛ no ohu; na nyia ɔbɔ mu no wobobue no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Anaaso hom mu woana, na sɛ ne ba bisa no paanoo a, ɔbɛma no ɔbo?
title: MATTHEW

text: Anaaso sɛ obisa no esunam a, ɔbɛma no ɔwɔ?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ hom a hom muo yi nyim mbrɛ hom dze akyɛdze pa ma hom mba a, mpɛn ahen ara na hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no nnkɛfa ndzɛmba pa ama hɔn a wobisa no?
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi adze biara a hom pɛ dɛ nyimpa yɛ ma hom no, hom nyɛ dɛmara so mma hɔn; na iyi nye mbra no nye nkɔnhyɛfo no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nhɛn abow tseaba no mu, na abow a ɔtsɛw, na ɔkwan a ɔyɛ tɛtɛr nye dza wɔdze kɔ ɔsɛɛ mu, na piinara wɔ hɔ a wɔfa mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na abow a ɔyɛ tseaba na ɔkwan a ɔyɛ heaheaba nye dza wɔdze kɔ nkwa mu, na kumaabi na wohu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo ho, na wɔba hom nkyɛn wɔ nguannwoma akataho mu, na hɔn mu dze, wɔyɛ mpataku edzifodzepɛfo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hɔn aba na hom dze bohu hɔn. Ana nyimpa tsetsew wenyinaba wɔ nsoɛ do, anaaso adɔmba wɔ kɔkrɔ do?
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛmara na dua pa ɔsow aba pa; na dua a ɔaprɔw dze, ɔsow aba bɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dua pa nntum nnsow aba bɔn, na eso dua a ɔaprɔw nntum nnsow aba pa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dua biara a ɔnnsow aba pa no, wotwa, na wɔtow kyen gya mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi hom dze hɔn aba bohu hɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nnyɛ obiara a ɔse me dɛ, Ewuradze, Ewuradze, na ɔbɔkɔ sor ahenman no mu; na nyia ɔbɛyɛ m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor no ne pɛ a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Da no mu no dodowara bɛse me dɛ, Ewuradze, Ewuradze, ana yɛammfa wo dzin annhyɛ nkɔm, na yɛammfa wo dzin enntu mbɔnsam, na yɛammfa wo dzin annyɛ tum ndwuma pii?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na aber no, mebɛpaa mu maka akyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Minnyim hom da: hom mfi me nkyɛn nkɔ, hom a hom yɛ emumuyɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi obiara a otsie me nsɛm yi na ɔyɛ no, wɔdze no bosusu badwembanyi a osii ne dan wɔ ɔbotan do no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nsu tɔree, na nsuyirii bae, na ehum tui, ma wɔboor dan no na ɔannhwe ase, osiandɛ wɔtoo ne fapem wɔ ɔbotan do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara a otsie me nsɛm yi na ɔnnyɛ no, wɔdze no bosusu kotobonyi a osii ne dan wɔ anhwea do no ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nsu tɔree, na nsuyirii bae, na ehum tui boor dan no, na ɔhwee ase, na n’asehwe no so.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Jesus wiee nsɛm yi no, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛɛ nyimpadodow no ahobow;
title: MATTHEW

text: osiandɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ nyia ɔwɔ tum, na ɔnntse dɛ akyerɛwfo no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ofii koko no do sianee no, nyimpadodow pii kaa no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔkwatanyi bi bae bɔkotoow no see dɛ, Mo wura, sɛ epɛ a, ibotum dɛ ema mo ho san.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔtseen ne nsa dze kaa no see dɛ, Mepɛ, wo ho nsan. Na ntsɛmara na kwata no fii no ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Hwɛ na aannka annkyerɛ obiara, mbom san kɔ, fa woho kɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no, na kɛma ayɛyɛdze a Moses hyɛe no fa yɛ dasedzi ma hɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔkɛhɛɛn Karpernaum no, ɔhamupanyin bi baa ne nkyɛn bɛserɛɛ no see no dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Mo wura, m’akowaa da fie yar mbubui retseetsee dodow.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Mebɛba mabɛsa no yarba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔhamupanyin no buae see dɛ, Mo wura, mennsɛ dɛ ebɛhɛn me hatsɛw ase; na ka asɛm no nko, na m’akowaa ho bɛsan no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mo so meyɛ nyimpa a mowɔ tum ase, na mowɔ nsordaafo wɔ m’ase, na mese yi dɛ, Kɔ a, ɔkɔ; na mese obi so dɛ, Bra a, ɔba; na mese m’akowaa dɛ, Yɛ iyi a, ɔyɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus tsee no, ɔyɛɛ no nwanwa, na ɔsee hɔn a wɔka no do no dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Israel mu mpo munnhun gyedzi a ɔtse dɛm yi bi pɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mese hom dɛ dodowara befi boka nye anee aba, na wɔnye Abraham nye Isaak nye Jakob abɛtsena ase wɔ sor ahenman no mu;
title: MATTHEW

text: ber a ahenman no ne mba no dze wɔbɔtow hɔn egu ekyirekyir sum no mu: mbrɛ osu nye asetwɛr wɔ no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus see ɔhamupanyin no dɛ, Kɔ, na dɛ mbrɛ agye edzi yi, ɔnyɛ dɛmara mma wo. Na dɔn no ara mu akowaa no tsee apɔw.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus baa Peter fie no, ohun n’asew basia dɛ ɔda hɔ yar papu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na osuoo ne nsa mu na papu no fii no do; na ɔsoɛree na ɔsoom no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na odur ewimbir no, wɔdze pii a mbɔnsam afa hɔn brɛɛ no; na ɔdze n’asɛm tuu esunsum no, na ɔsaa hɔn a wɔyar nyina yarba,
title: MATTHEW

text: ama dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia kae no aaba mu dɛ, Ɔno na ɔfaa hɛn ahoɔmberɛw, na ɔsoaa hɛn nyarba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus hun nyimpadodow pii wɔ no ho no, ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔnkɔ esuegya no ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Ɔkyerɛwfo bi bae bɛsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛnyi, beebiara a ebɔkɔ no, mebɛka wo do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Nsɔ wɔ etu, na wimu nnoma wɔ mberɛbuw, na nyimpa Ba no dze, onnyi mbrɛ ɔdze ne tsir to.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na n’esuafo mu bi so see no dɛ, Mo wura, ma me kwan ma monkɔ minkesie m’egya ana.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Ka mo do, na ma ewufo nsie hɔnara hɔn ewufo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔkɔr hɛn mu no, n’esuafo no kaa no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hwɛ, ehum kɛse tui wɔ po no mu, na asorɛkye kataa hɛn no do, nna ɔno dze, ɔada.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔbae benyaan no see dɛ, Owura, gye hɛn, yɛrehera.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom yɛ ehufo, hom a hom gyedzi suar? Nna ɔsoɛree na ɔbraa mframa nye po no, na ɔtaa dzinn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔyɛɛ nyimpa no nwanwa na wɔsee dɛ, Ebɛn nyimpa nye yi a mframa na po mpo wotsie no yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na odur esuegya no ho wɔ Gadarafo asaase do no, nyimpa beenu bi a mbɔnsam afa hɔn behyiaa no kwan; wofi abodan mu na wɔyɛ abɔyafo mbordo dɛ, ma ntsi obi nntum nntwa mu wɔ kwan no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hwɛ, wɔtseaa mu see dɛ, Yɛnye wo wɔ ebɛn yɛ, ɔwo, Nyankopɔn Ba? Ana ebaa ha dɛ erebɛhaw hɛn ansaana ber no edu?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ofi hɔn nkyɛn kɔ ekyir kakra no, mprekokuw kɛse bi wɔ hɔ ridzidzi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mbɔnsam no serɛɛ no dɛ, Sɛ itu hɛn a, soma hɛn mprekokuw no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ. Na wopuei sii mu kɔr mpreko no mu; na hwɛ, mprekokuw no nyina faa twitwi kesiaan ɔbo kronn no koguguu po no mu, na wowuwui wɔ nsu no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn a wɔrenyɛn hɔn no guanee kɔr kurow no mu kɛkaa ne nyina nye dza ɔbaa hɔn a mbɔnsam afa hɔn no do no ho asɛm.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na kurow no nyina fiir edzi behyiaa Jesus, na wohun no no, wɔserɛɛ no dɛ omfi hɔn ntoaado nkɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔkɔr hɛn mu, na otwae baa nankasa no kurow mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hwɛ, wɔdze mbubuinyi a ɔda mpa do brɛɛ no; na Jesus hun hɔn gyedzi no, ɔsee mbubuinyi no dɛ, ɔba, hyɛ dzen, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hwɛ, kyerɛwfo no binom sesee wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, oyi ɔkã ebususɛm.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus hun hɔn adwen no, ɔsee dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom rodwen dza omuo wɔ hom akoma mu yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mmuana na ɔyɛ mberɛw kɛse, ebɛse dɛ, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo, anaa ebɛse dɛ, soɛr na nantsew, a?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma hom ehu dɛ nyimpa Ba no wɔ tum wɔ asaase do dɛ ɔdze bɔn kyɛ a, (nna ɔsee mbubuinyi no dɛ) soɛr, fa wo mpa na kɔ wo fie.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsoɛree na osii mu kor ne fie.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpadodow no hunii no, wosuroi, na woyii Nyankopɔn a ɔdze dɛm tum ama nyimpa no ayɛw.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔresen no, ohun nyimpa bi a wɔfrɛ no Matthew dɛ ɔtse atowgye, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ka mo do. Na ɔsoɛree kaa no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔtse edzidzi wɔ ne fie; na hwɛ, atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo pii nye Jesus nye n’esuafo bɛtsenatsenaa hɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Phariseefo no hunii no, wɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom kyerɛkyerɛfo nye atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo dzidzi yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔtsee no, ɔsee dɛ, hɔn a wɔtse hɔn apɔw mu no, wonnhia oduyɛfo, na mbom hɔn a wɔyar no a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom nkɔ nkosūa iyi ase: Mepɛ ehumbɔbɔr, na nnyɛ afɔrbɔ a. Mammbɛfrɛ atseneneefo, ha mbom ndzebɔnyɛfo a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna John n’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, ebɛnadze ntsi na yɛnye Phariseefo no yɛtɔ dɛ yedzi mbuada, na w’esuafo dze, wonndzi mbuada yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Ayeforpia mu mba no, aber a ayeforkun no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn, wobotum edzi nkɔmbɔ anaa? Na nda no bɛba a wobeyi ayeforkun no efi hɔn nkyɛn, na nkyii wobedzi mbuada.
title: MATTHEW

text: Obi mmfa tam fofor sin nntaa atar dadaw mu: Dɛm no, dza wɔdze taa mu no yi fi atar no mu, na ntsewee no yɛ kɛse.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔmmfa wenyin fofor nngu nwomantoa dadaw mu: Dɛm no, nwomantoa no paa, na wenyin no hue gu, ma toa no so sɛɛ; na wɔdze wenyin fofor gu toa fofor mu, ma ebien nyina ayɛ yie.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔrekã yinom kyerɛ hɔn no, hwɛ, ɔpanyin bi bae bɔkotoow no see dɛ, me babaa ewu sesei; na bra bɛfa wo nsa to no do, na obenya nkwa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus soɛree kaa no do, na n’esuafo no so dɛmara.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hwɛ, ɔbaa bi a ɔyar bɔgyaagu mfe duebien bae bedzii n’ekyir kãa n’atar ano ndwow:
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔsee wɔ no mu dɛ, sɛ mekã n’atar nko ara a, mo ho bɛyɛ me dzen.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus daan noho no, na ohun no no, ɔsee dɛ, Babaa, hyɛ dzen, wo gyedzi agye wo. Na ofitsi dɔn no ara mu na ɔbaa no no ho yɛɛ no dzen.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus hɛɛn ɔpanyin ne fie, na ohun atɛntɛbɛnhɛmfo nye nyimpadodow a wɔreyɛ dedeede no,
title: MATTHEW

text: ɔsee hɔn dɛ, hom ntwe homho, na akataasiaba no nnwui, na ɔada. Na wɔsereew no twee.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na woyii nyimpadodow no edzi no, ɔkɔr dan mu na okosuoo ne nsa mu, na akataasiaba no soɛree.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na iyi ho asɛm tahyee asaase nyina do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus fi hɔ rokɔ no, enyifurafo beenu kaa no do tsēaa mu see dɛ, David ba, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na odur fi no mu no, enyifurafo no baa ne nkyɛn, na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, ana hom gye dzi dɛ mubotum ayɛ yi? Wɔsee no dɛ, nyew, Owura.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ɔkãa hɔn enyiwa see dɛ, mbrɛ hom gyedzi tse no, ɔnyɛ dɛmara mma hom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn enyiwa buebuei. Na Jesus braa hɔn dzendzenndzen dɛ, Hom nhwɛ mma obiara eennhu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔndze, wofii hɔ no, wɔdze ne nka kɛtahyee wɔ asaase nyina do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na worifir edzi no, hwɛ, wɔdze mmura a abɔnsam afa no brɛɛ no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na otuu abɔnsam no, mmura no kasae. Na ɔyɛɛ nyimpadodow no nwanwa, na wɔsee dɛ, wonnhun dɛm yi bi pɛn wɔ Israel.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Phariseefo no dze, wɔsee dɛ, Mbɔnsam hɔn panyin do na ɔnam tu mbɔnsam no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus kekyiin nkurow nye nkurobaase nyina mu kyerɛkyerɛe wɔ hɔn nhyiamudan mu, na ɔkãa ahenman no ne nsɛmpa no ho asɛm, na ɔsaa nyarba nyina nye ahoɔmberɛw nyina.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ohun nyimpadodow no, ne yamu hyehyee no maa hɔn, osiandɛ wɔahaw na wɔapetse dɛ nguan a wonnyi guanhwɛfo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, Otwa-edwuma no dɔɔ sõ ampa, na edwumayɛfo no dze wosuar.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nserɛ otwa-edwuma no wura ma ɔnsoma edwumayɛfo mbra no twa-edwuma no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ n’esuafo duebien no baa ne nkyɛn no, ɔmaa hɔn tum wɔ esunsum fi do, dɛ wontu hɔn, na wɔnsa nyarba nyina, nye ahoɔmberɛw nyina.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na esuafo duebien no hɔn edzin nye yinom: dza odzi kan no, Simon a wɔfrɛ no Peter, nye no nua Andrew; James, Zebedee ba no, nye no nua John;
title: MATTHEW

text: Filip nye Bartholomew; Tomas nye Matthew towgyenyi no; James, Alfaeus ba no, nye Tadeus;
title: MATTHEW

text: Simon Kanannyi, nye Judas Iskariot a oyii no mae no so.
title: MATTHEW

text: Duebien yi na Jesus somaa hɔn, na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnkɔ amanaman kwan no mu, eso mma hom nnhɛn Samariafo kurow biara mu:
title: MATTHEW

text: na mbom hom nkɔ Israel fie nguan a wɔayew no nkyɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom kɔ a, hom nkɛka dɛ, Ɔsor ahenman no abɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nsa ayarfo yarba, hom nnyan ewufo, hom mma akwatafo ho nsan, hom ntu mbɔnsam: hom enya no kwa: hom mfa mma kwa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Mma hom mmfa sika, anaa dwɛɛtɛɛ, anaa kɔɔber nngu hom abɔdo mu;
title: MATTHEW

text: mma hom mmfa bɔtɔ, anaa sorntar ebien, anaa nsokota, anaa poma: osiandɛ ɔfata odwumayɛnyi dɛ odzidzi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na kurow anaa ekurobaase biara a hom bɛhɛn mu no, hom nhwehwɛ nyia ɔsɛ wɔ hɔ; na hɔ na hom ntsena nkodu dɛ hom befi hɔ akɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ hom rehɛn ofi no mu a, hom nkyia.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ ɔyɛ fie a ɔfata a, hom asomdwee nka no, na sɛ ɔmmfata a, hom asomdwee nsan mbra hom hɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara a ɔnnkɛgye hom anaa onnketsie hom asɛm no, hom fi ofi anaa kurow no mu rokɔ a, hom mporoporow hom ananadze huntuma.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nokwar mese hom dɛ atsɛmbu da no mu dza ɔbɛba dɛm kurow no do no bɛsen dza ɔbaa Sodom nye Gomora do no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hwɛ, mosoma hom dɛ nguan wɔ mpataku finimfin: dɛm ntsi hom nyɛ enyansafo dɛ nwɔ, na hom nyɛ krɔnn dɛ mbubur.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom nhwɛ yie wɔ nyimpa ho; osiandɛ wobeyi hom akɔ mpanyimfo bagua mu, na wɔaka hom mpire wɔ hɔn nhyiamudan mu;
title: MATTHEW

text: na eso wɔdze hom bɔkɔ ambradofo nye ahemfo enyim wɔ me ntsi, dze eedzi dase ama hɔn nye amanaman.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ woyi hom ma a, mma hom nndwendwen mbrɛ hom bɛyɛ, anaa dza hom bɛka, na wɔdze dza hom bɛka bɛma hom dɔn no ara mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nnyɛ hom na hom kasa, na hom Egya no Sunsum na ɔkasa wɔ hom mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nua beyi nua ama owu, egya beyi ba ama; na mba bɔsoɛr wɔ awofo do na wɔama woeku hɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpa nyina bɛtan hom wɔ me dzin ntsi: na nyia ɔbɛtsena mu ekodu ewiei no, ɔno na wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ wɔtseetsee hom wɔ kurow yi mu a, hom nguan nkɔ fofor mu; na nokwar mese hom dɛ, Hom nnkowie Israel nkurow nyina do kɔ ansaana Nyimpa Ba no aba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Osuanyi nnkyɛn ne kyerɛkyerɛfo, na akowaa nnkyɛn no wura.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔdɔɔ so ma osuanyi dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛ ne Kyerɛkyerɛfo, na akowaa dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛ no wura. Na sɛ wɔafrɛ ofiwura no Beelzebul a, ebɛn edzin ara na wɔnnkɛfa afrɛ ne fifo!
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi mma hom nnsuro hɔn: na biribi do nnkatae a worinnyi no edzi, na onnhuntae a worunnhu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dza meka kyerɛ hom wɔ sum mu no, hom nka no kan mu; na dza hom tse no asomu no, hom mpaa mu nka no adan etsifi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mma hom nnsuro hɔn a woku nyimpadua no, na ɔkra dze, wonntum nnku no: na mbom hom nsuro nyia obotum asɛɛ ɔkra nye nyimpadua nyina wɔ amandzehu kurow mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ana wɔnntɔn nsorɔm ebien nngye pɛsewa? Naaso hɔn mu kor mpo nnkokwetsir hom Egya ahwe famu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom tsinhwi mpo wɔakan ne nyina.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi mma hom nnsuro: na hom som bo kyɛn nsorɔm pii.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi obiara a ɔbɔbɔ me dzin wɔ nyimpa enyim no, ɔno na mo so mobobɔ ne dzin wɔ m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor n’enyim.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara a ɔbɛpa me wɔ nyimpa enyim no, ɔno na mo so mebɛpa no m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor n’enyim.
title: MATTHEW

text: Mma hom nndwen dɛ mebae mobɔsomaa asomdwee wɔ asaase do: mammba mammbɔsoma asomdwee, na mbom nkrantsee a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mebae mebɛpaapaa mu ma banyin nye n’egya eenya, babaa nye ne na eenya, asew basia nye n’asewbaa eenya:
title: MATTHEW

text: na nyimpa n’atamfo bɛyɛ ne fifo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nyia ɔdɔ egya anaa na kyɛn me no, ɔmmfata me; na nyia ɔdɔ babanyin anaa babaa kyɛn me no, ɔmmfata me.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyia ɔmmfa ne mbeamudua na ɔnnka mo do no, ɔmmfata me.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nyia ɔdɔ no nkwa no, ɔbɛyew no; na nyia ɔyew no nkwa wɔ me ntsi no, obohu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nyia ɔgye hom no, ɔgye me; na nyia ɔgye me no, ɔgye nyia ɔsomaa me no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nyia ɔgye nkɔnhyɛnyi wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi dzin mu no, obenya nkɔnhyɛnyi akatua; na nyia ɔgye ɔtseneneenyi wɔ ɔtseneneenyi dzin mu no, obenya ɔtseneneenyi akatua.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara a ɔbɛma nketseaba yi mu baako nsunwin kɔɔpow ma mpo wɔ osuanyi dzin mu no, nokwar mese hom dɛ n’akatua rommbɔ no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus wiee n’esuafo duebien no kasakyerɛ no, ofii hɔ dɛ ɔrekɛkyerɛkyerɛ na ɔakɛka asɛm wɔ hɔn nkurow mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na John tsee Kraest no ndwuma wɔ efiadze no, ɔsomaa n’esuafo no kebisaa no dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Ana ɔwo nye nyia ɔreba no, anaa yɛnhwɛ nyimpa fofor bi so kwan?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɛka dza hom ehu na hom atse yi nkyerɛ John:
title: MATTHEW

text: enyifurafo hu adze, mbubua nantsew, akwatafo ho san, etsitsifo tse asɛm, ewufo nyan, na wɔka asɛmpa no kyerɛ ehiafo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nhyira aka nyia mennyɛ fintsidua mma no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na John n’esuafo no rokɔ no, Jesus hyɛɛ ase kaa John ho asɛm kyerɛɛ nyimpadodow no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom kɔr sar no do kɔhwɛe? Ndzɛmbir a mframa rihim no a?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ebɛnadze na hom puei kɔhwɛe? Nyimpa a ofura serekye tam a? Hwɛ, hɔn a wofura serekye tam wɔ ahemfo fie.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ebɛnadze koraa na hom kɔree kɔhwɛe? Ana dɛ hom bohu nkɔnhyɛnyi a? Nyew, mese hom dɛ nyia ɔkyɛn nkɔnhyɛnyi mpo a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Oyi nye nyia wɔakyerɛw no ho asɛm dɛ, Hwɛ, morosoma mo bɔfoe ma oeedzi w’enyim kan a Obesiesie wo kwan a ɔda w’enyim no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nokwar mese hom dɛ, hɔn a mbaa awo hɔn nyina mu biara mmpuei a ɔyɛ kɛse kyɛn John Onumanyi no; naaso nyia ɔyɛ aketseaba wɔ sor ahenman mu no yɛ kɛse kyɛn no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ofitsi dɛ John Onumanyi no bae dze bodu ndɛ sor ahenman no gye enyiber, na hɔn a hɔn enyi aber no fa no enyiɔdzen do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nkɔnhyɛfo nyina nye mbra no hyɛɛ nkɔm bɛpeem John do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ hom pɛ dɛ hom gye to mu a, oyi nye Elija a ɔreba no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nyia ɔwɔ aso a ɔdze tsie no ma ontsie.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ebɛnadze na medze ɔsantsen yi mobɔto ho? Ɔtse dɛ mbofraba a wɔtsenatsena gua do, na wɔrefrɛfrɛ hɔn anyɛnkofo, se dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Yɛahɛn atɛntɛbɛn ama hom, na hom annsaw; yeetwa ewuo na hom werɛ annhow.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na John bae, onndzidzi eso ɔnnom, na wɔse dɛ, Ɔwɔ abɔnsam.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nyimpa Ba no bae, odzidzi na ɔnom, wɔse dɛ, Hwɛ, nyimpa tumfur, nsahweam, atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo nyɛnko. Naaso nyansa no ndwuma bu no bem.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ɔhyɛɛ ase twuuw nkurow a ɔyɛɛ no tum ndwuma pii wɔ mu no enyim, osiandɛ woennu hɔnho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Korazin, due! Bɛtsaeda, due! Osiandɛ sɛ tum ndwuma a wɔyɛe wɔ hom mu yi, wɔyɛɛ no wɔ Taere nye Sidon mu a, nkyɛ wonuu hɔnho dada wɔ eyitam nye nso mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mese hom dɛ atsɛmbu da no mu ɔbɛfanyim Taere nye Sidon akyɛn hom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔwo, Karpernaum, wɔbɛma wo do akɔ sor anaa? Hwɛ, wɔbɛbrɛ wo adze akɔ samanadze; osiandɛ tum ndwuma a wɔyɛe wɔ wo mu yi, sɛ wɔyɛɛ no wɔ Sodom a, nkyɛ wɔtse hɔ bodu ndɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mese hom dɛ atsɛmbuda no ɔbɛfanyim Sodom akyɛn wo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na aber no mu, Jesus buae see dɛ, Miyi wo ayɛw, Egya, sor nye asaase Wura, dɛ edze ndzɛmba yi esuma enyansafo nye abadwembafo, na eyi akyerɛ nkɔkowaba.
title: MATTHEW
