text: Nyew, Egya, dɛm na ɔsɔɔ w’enyi.
title: MATTHEW

text: M’Egya dze ndzɛmba nyina ahyɛ me nsa; na obiara nnyim Ɔba no, gyedɛ Egya no; eso obiara nnyim Egya no gyedɛ Ɔba no, na nyia Ɔba no pɛ dɛ oyi no kyerɛ no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nyina hom mbra mo hɔ, hom a hom reyɛ edwuma berɛ na wɔasoa hom dza ɔyɛ dur, na mebɛma hom ahomgye.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom mfa mo kɔndua nto hom do, na hom nsua me, osiandɛ modwe na mebrɛ moho adze wɔ akoma mu; na hom benya ahomgye ama hom akra.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mo kɔndua yɛ mberɛw, na m’adzesoa yɛ har.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na aber no mu Jesus koduaa eburow kwa mu ahomgyeda; na ɔkɔm dzee n’esuafo no, wɔhyɛɛ ase pempaan eburow mbɛtsem no wee.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Farisiifo no hunii no, wɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, w’esuafo no reyɛ dza ɔmmfa mbra mu ahomgyeda.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnkenkaan dza David yɛe aber a ɔkɔm dzee ɔno nye hɔn a wɔka no ho no?
title: MATTHEW

text: Mbrɛ ɔkɛhɛɛn Nyankopɔn fie na okedzii kyerɛpaanoo a ɔmmfa mbra mu dɛ odzi, anaa hɔn a wɔka no ho no, gyedɛ asɔfo no ara nko no?
title: MATTHEW

text: Anaaso hom nnkenkanee wɔ mbra no mu, mbrɛ ahomgyeda no mu asɔfo no wɔto ahomgyeda wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na wonndzi fɔ?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mese hom dɛ nyia ɔkyɛn asɔrfi no wɔ ha.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ hom tsee kasa yi ase a, dɛ, Mepɛ ehumbɔbɔr na nnyɛ afɔrbɔ a, nkyɛ hom emmbu hɔn a wonndzi fɔ no fɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpa Ba no yɛ ahomgyeda no so no wura.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ofii hɔ kɔree, na ɔkɔr hɔn nhyiamudan no mu;
title: MATTHEW

text: na hwɛ, nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a ne nsa adwe. Na wobisaa no see dɛ, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ wɔsa yarba ahomgyeda? Ama woeetum aatoa no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mu nyimpa bɛn, na sɛ ɔwɔ oguan kor, na sɛ ɔkɔtɔ mona mu ahomgyeda a, onnkosuo no mu na ɔama no do?
title: MATTHEW

text: Ebɛnadze a? Ana nyimpa nsom bo nkyɛn oguan a? Dɛm ntsi ɔfa mbra mu dɛ wɔyɛ papa ahomgyeda.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ɔsee nyimpa no dɛ, Tsen wo nsa. Na ɔtsenee; na ɔsanee yɛɛ mu dɛ kor no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Farisiifo no puei, na wɔkɛfaa apam wɔ no ho, mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ asɛɛ no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus hunii no, ɔtwee noho fii hɔ, na dodowara kaa no do, na ɔsaa hɔn nyina yarba,
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wonnyi no nnkyerɛ:
title: MATTHEW

text: ma dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia kae no aaba mu dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Hwɛ, mo somfo a meyi no, Mo dɔfo a me kra enyiwa sɔ no: Medze mo Sunsum bogu no do, Na ɔaka atsɛmbu akyerɛ amanaman.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔnnkɛper, eso ɔnnkɛtsea mu; Eso obiara nnkɛtse ne ndze wɔ abɔntsen do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ndzɛmbir a ɔakonkon no onnkobu, Na asaaba a opun wusiw onnkodum no, Dze ekesi dɛ ɔbɛma atsɛmbu akɔ konyim mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ne dzin mu na amanaman dze hɔn werɛ bɛhyɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna wɔdze obi a abɔnsam afa no a ɔyɛ onyifurafo nye mmum brɛɛ no: na ɔsaa no yarba, na mmum no kasae na ohun adze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpadodow no nyina ho boow hɔn, na wɔsee dɛ, Ana oyi nye David ba no?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Farisiifo no tsee no, wɔsee dɛ, Oyi nntum nntu mbɔnsam gyedɛ ɔnam mbɔnsam panyin Beelzebul do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ohun hɔn adwen no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ahenman biara nye noho dzi mpaapaamu a, ɔyɛ amamfo, na kurow anaa fi biara a ɔnye noho dzi mpaapaamu no orinngyina:
title: MATTHEW

text: na sɛ Satan tu Satan a, nna ɔnye noho edzi mpaapaamu: ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na n’ahenman egyina?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ emi menam Beelzebul do tu mbɔnsam a, woana do na hom mba nam tu hɔn? Dɛm ntsi hɔn na wɔbɛyɛ hom atsɛmbuafo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ menam Nyankopɔn Sunsum do tu mbɔnsam a, nna Nyankopɔn ahenman enya aba hom nkyɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Anaadɛ, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na obi botum akɔ ɔkatakyi bi ne fie akɔfow n’efidze, gyedɛ odzi kan kyekyer ɔkatakyi no, ansaana ɔafow ne fie.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nyia ɔnnka mo ho no, na ɔnye me enya; nyia ɔnye me mmboaboa ano no, ɔhotse gu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, Bɔn biara, ɔnye ebususɛm biara, wɔdze bɛkyɛ nyimpa, na ebususɛm a otsia Sunsum no dze, wɔnnkɛfa akyɛ nyimpa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara a ɔbɛka asɛm etsia nyimpa Ba no, wɔdze bɛkyɛ no, na obiara a ɔbɛka asɛm etsia Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no, wɔnnkɛfa akyɛ no wɔ wiadze ha, nye wiadze a ɔreba no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom mma dua no nyɛ yie, na n’aba so nyɛ yie; anaadɛ hom mma dua no mprɔw, na n’aba so mprɔw: osiandɛ dua wɔdze n’aba hu no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nhurutsia mba, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na hom muo yi, hom bɛka nsɛm pa? Na dza ebu do wɔ akoma mu no na ano ka.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nyimpa pa fi ne ndzepa korabea na oyi ndzepa fi ba; na nyimpa bɔn fi ne ndzɛmba bɔn korabea na oyi dza omuo fi ba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mese hom dɛ nsɛngyan biara a nyimpa bɛka no wobobu ho nkontaa wɔ atsɛmbu da mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Osiandɛ wo nsɛm do na wɔnam bobu wo bem; na wo nsɛm do na wɔnam bobu wo fɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Akyerɛwfo no nye Farisiifo no mu binom buae see dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yɛpɛ dɛ yehu wo hɔ asɛnkyerɛdze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Ɔsantsen bɔn nye awartofo rohwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze, na wɔremma hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze biara dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi Jona asɛnkyerɛdze no:
title: MATTHEW

text: na dɛ mbrɛ Jona dzii ndaansa adzekyee nye adzesaa wɔ bonso yamu no, dɛmara na nyimpa Ba no bedzi ndaansa adzekyee nye adzesaa wɔ asaase tsirmu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ninive mbarimba nye ɔsantsen yi bɔsoɛr wɔ atsɛmbu no mu, na woebu hɔn fɔ; osiandɛ wonuu hɔnho wɔ Jona n’asɛnka ase, na hwɛ, nyia ɔsen Jona wɔ ha.
title: MATTHEW

text: Pomu afamu ɔhembaa nye ɔsantsen yi bɔsoɛr wɔ atsɛmbu no mu, na oebu hɔn fɔ: osiandɛ ofii asaase ano noho bae betsiee Solomon ne nyansaa, na hwɛ, nyia ɔsen Solomon wɔ ha.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sunsum fi, sɛ ofi nyimpa mu fir a, okekyin wewew do hwehwɛ ahomgye na onnya bi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ɔse dɛ, Mebɛsan akɔ me fie a mifii mu bae no mu, na ɔba a, ɔto no pan, wɔaprapra mu na wɔahyehyɛ mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ɔkɔ kɛfa esunsum esuon fofor a womuo sen nankasa ka no ho, na wɔbɛhɛn mu tsena hɔ: na nyimpa no n’ekyir asetsena yɛ bɔn sen nkan no dze; dɛmara na ɔbɛyɛ ama ɔsantsen bɔn yi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔda do rekasa kyerɛ nyimpadodow no, hwɛ, ne na nye no nuanom begyinaa abow enyim hwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔnye no kasa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obi see no dɛ, Hwɛ, wo na ɔnye wo nuanom gyina abow enyim rohwehwɛ nye wo akasa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see nyia ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no no dɛ, Woana nye me na, na woananom nye mo nuanom?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔtseen ne nsa wɔ n’esuafo no do see dɛ, Hwɛ, me na nye mo nuanom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara a ɔbɛyɛ m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor no ne pɛ no, ɔno nye mo nua, nye m’akyerɛbaa, nye me na.
title: MATTHEW

text: Da no ara Jesus fiir fie kɛtsenaa mpoano.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpadodow pii behyiaa ne nkyɛn, ma dɛm ntsi ɔkɔr hɛn mu kɛtsenaa ase wɔ mu; na nyimpadodow no nyina gyinagyinaa mpoano.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔkaa ndzɛmba pii kyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ mbɛbu mu see dɛ, Hwɛ, oduafo no kɔree kɛpee aba;
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔrepe aba no, bi koguu kwan nkyɛn na nnoma bae bɔsosɔwee;
title: MATTHEW

text: na bi koguu abosam do mbrɛ oennya dɛtse pii; na ntsɛmara na ofirii, osiandɛ oennya dɛtse a ɔdɔ;
title: MATTHEW

text: na ewia soɛree no, onyinyamee na osiandɛ onnyi ndwow ntsi ɔkyenkyenee.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na bi so koguu nsoɛ mu, na ofifirii ara na nsoɛ no miaa no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na bi so koguu asaase pa mu, na ɔsoow aba, bi ɔha, bi eduosia, bi eduasa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nyia ɔwɔ aso no, ma ontsie.
title: MATTHEW

text: N’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na ekasa kyerɛ hɔn mbɛbu mu yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Hom dze, wɔdze ama hom dɛ hom nhu sor ahenman no mu esumasɛm, na hɔn dze, wɔmmfae mmaa hɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara a ɔwɔ no, na wɔbɛma no na oenya mbordo, na obiara a onnyi no, dza ɔwɔ mpo wɔbɛgye ne nsamu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi na mekasa kyerɛ hɔn mbɛbu mu, osiandɛ wɔhwɛ a wonnhu, wɔtse a wonntsie, eso wɔnntse ase.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn mu na Isaia nkɔnhyɛ no aba mu dɛ, Tse dze, hom bɛtse naaso hom nnkɛtse ase; Na hwɛ dze, hom bɔhwɛ naaso hom nnkohu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔman yi hɔn akoma epirim, Na hɔn aso esisiw dɛ wɔbɛtse Na woemuamua hɔn enyiwa Amma aber bi wɔaammfa hɔn enyiwa ennhu, Na wɔaammfa hɔn aso anntse, Na wɔaammfa hɔn akoma anntse ase, Na wɔaannsakyer Amma maannsa hɔn yarba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nhyira aka hom enyiwa dɛ wohu, nye hom asowa dɛ wɔtse.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nokwar mese hom dɛ nkɔnhyɛfo nye atseneneefo pii pɛɛ dɛ wohu dza hom hu yi, naaso woennhu, na wɔtse dza hom tse yi, naaso wɔanntse.
title: MATTHEW

text: Afei hom ntsie oduafo no ne bɛ no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Sɛ obiara tse ahenman no no ho asɛm, na ɔnntse ase a, ɔbɔn no ba bɛfa dza wɔpee no n’akoma mu no kɔ. Oyi nye dza wɔpee no wɔ kwan nkyɛn no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na dza wɔpee no abosam do no, ɔnye nyia otsie asɛm no, na ntsɛmara ɔdze dɛw gye;
title: MATTHEW

text: na onnyi ndwow wɔ no mu, na ɔwɔ hɔ ma ɔkyɛr kakra, sɛ abɛbrɛsɛ anaa ahohia soɛr wɔ asɛm no ntsi a, ntsɛmara na ato no fintsidua.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na dza wɔpee no nsoɛ mu no, nye nyia otsie asɛm no, na wiadze yi mu akɔdadwen nye ahonya ndaadaa mia asɛm no, ma ɔnnsow aba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na dza wɔpee no asaase pa mu no, ɔnye nyia otsie asɛm no, na ɔtse ase; ɔno so na ɔsow aba, bi ɔha, bi eduosia, bi eduasa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Obuu bɛ fofor so kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Sor ahenman no tse dɛ nyimpa a oduaa aba pa wɔ no kwa mu;
title: MATTHEW

text: na nyimpa dedae no, ne tamfo bae boduaa nworahaban so wɔ ewifua pa no mu, na ɔkɔree.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na oyii ahaban na ɔsoow aba no, nna nworahaban no so daa edzi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ofiwura no nkowaa bae bɛsee no dɛ, Yewura, ana ammpe aba pa wɔ wo kwa no mu? Na nworahaban yi so fi hen?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔtamfo na ɔayɛ yi. Na nkowaa no see no dɛ, Ana epɛ dɛ yɛkɔ kɔboaboa ano?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Oho: bɛyɛ na hom roboaboa nworahaban no ano no, hom etutu ewifua no so aka ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom mma n’ebien nyina nnyin nkesi twaber no; na twaber no mebɛse etwafo no dɛ, Hom ndzi kan mboaboa nwora no ano, na hom nkyekyer no efiefi ma wɔnhyew no, na hom mboaboa ewifua no ano nkɔ me san do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Obuu bɛ fofor so kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Sor ahenman no tse dɛ sinape abafua a nyimpa fae koduaa no kwa mu;
title: MATTHEW

text: ɔno na osuar kyɛn aba nyina; na sɛ onyin a, ɔyɛ kɛse kyɛn nhaban nyina na ɔyɛ dua, ma wimu nnoma bɛgyegye n’abaw do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Obuu bɛ fofor so see hɔn dɛ, Sor ahenman no tse dɛ mbɔrkaw a ɔbaa fae sumaa mbɔr korbaa ebiasa mu dze kesii dɛ ne nyina kawee.
title: MATTHEW

text: Yinom nyina Jesus kaa kyerɛɛ nyimpadodow no wɔ mbɛbu mu, na oennkwetsi bɛ annkasa annkyerɛ hɔn;
title: MATTHEW

text: ma dza nkɔnhyɛnyi no kae no aaba mu dɛ, Mubobue m’ano wɔ mbɛbu mu; Mebɛpaa mu maka nsɛm a ohuntsa fi wiadze ahyɛse.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Jesus gyaa nyimpadodow no kwan na ɔbaa fie. Na n’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, Kyerɛ hɛn kwa mu nwora no ho bɛ no ase.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see dɛ, Nyia oduaa aba pa no nye nyimpa Ba;
title: MATTHEW

text: kwa no nye wiadze; aba pa no nye ahenman no ne mba; nwora no nye ɔbɔn no ne mba;
title: MATTHEW

text: ɔtamfo a oduaa hɔn nye abɔnsam; twaber nye wiadze n’ewiei; na etwafo no nye abɔfo no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ wɔboaboa nwora no ano wɔhyew no wɔ gya mu no, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ wɔ wiadze n’ewiei nye no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nyimpa Ba no bɔsoma n’abɔfoe na wɔakɔboaboa dza ɔto fintsidua nyina ano efi n’ahenman mu; nye hɔn a wɔyɛ emumuyɛ nyina,
title: MATTHEW

text: na wɔatow hɔn egu gya fononoo mu: hɔ na osu nye asetwɛr wɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔno na atseneneefo bɛhyerɛn dɛ ewia wɔ hɔn Egya ahenman mu. Nyia ɔwɔ aso no, ma ontsie.
title: MATTHEW

text: Sor ahenman no tse dɛ akoradze a wɔdze sumaa haban mu a nyimpa hunii no, ɔdze huntsae, na no ho dɛw ntsi ɔkɔree kɔtɔɔn dza ɔwɔ nyina na ɔtɔɔ haban no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Bio, sor ahenman no tse dɛ batanyi a ɔrohwehwɛ ahondze pa;
title: MATTHEW

text: na ohun ahondze kor a no bo so no, ɔkɔree kɔtɔɔn dza ɔwɔ nyina na ɔkɔtɔe.
title: MATTHEW

text: Bio, sor ahenman no tse dɛ eboa a wɔtowee guu po mu a obumaa nam ahorow nyina bi;
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔyɛɛ ma no, wotwuwii baa mpoano na wɔtsenaa famu, na wɔboaboaa papa no ano guu mbirefi mu, na wɔtoow dza omuo no gui.
title: MATTHEW

text: Mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ wɔ wiadze ewiei nye no; abɔfo bɛba abɛpa nyimpa bɔn efi atseneneefo mu,
title: MATTHEW

text: na wɔatow hɔn egu ogya fononoo mu; hɔ na osu nye asetwɛr wɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom atse yinom nyina ase? Wobuaa no dɛ, Nyew.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛm ntsi kyerɛwnyi a wɔayɛ no osuanyi ama sor ahenman no ɔtse dɛ ofiwura a ofi n’adzekorabea yi ndzɛmba afofor nye adadaw pue.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Jesus wiee mbɛ yi bu no, ofii hɔ kɔree.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔkɔr nankasa no kurow mu no, ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ hɔn nhyiamudan mu, ma hɔn ho boow hɔn na wɔsee dɛ, Oyi nyaa nyansa nye tum ndwuma yi wɔ hen?
title: MATTHEW

text: Ana nnyɛ dwimfo no ne ba nye yi? Ana ne na wɔmmfrɛ no Mary, na no nuanom nye James, Josef, Simon, nye Judas?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nnyɛ ne nkyerɛbaa nyina na wɔnye hɛn wɔ ha yi? Na afei oyi nyaa ndzɛmba yinom nyina wɔ hen?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn fintsidua. Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi nnhwer enyidzi gyedɛ nankasa no kurow mu, nye nankasa ne fie.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na gyedzi a wonnyi ntsi ɔannyɛ tum ndwuma pii wɔ hɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Aber no mu no, ɔmansinhen Herod tsee Jesus ne nka,
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔsee n’asomfo no dɛ, Iyi dze, John Onumanyi no a: oenyan no efi ewufo mu; dɛm ntsi na tum ndwuma yi da edzi wɔ no mu yi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ansaana no nna Herod no nua Filip ne yer Herodias ntsi, Herod akyer John akyekyer no akɔto efiadze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ne siantsir nye dɛ John see no dɛ, Innyi ho kwan dɛ ewar basia no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔpɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ oku no naaso osuroo ɔman no, osiandɛ wobuu John dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wodzii Herod n’awoda no, Herodias ne babaa bae bɛsawee wɔ hɔn enyim, na ɔsɔɔ Herod n’enyi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔno do na ɔdze ntam bɔɔ no anohoba dɛ ɔbɛma no biribiara a obebisa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ne na kaa hyɛɛ ne ntsirmu no, ɔsee dɛ, Fa John Onumanyi no ne tsir to prɛtse mu ma me ha.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen no yaw; naaso ne ntam nye hɔn a wɔnye no tse edzidzi no ntsi, ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma no:
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔsomae ma wokotwaa John ne tsir wɔ efiadze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔdze ne tsir too prɛtse mu bae, na wɔdze maa akataasia no, na ɔdze kɛmaa ne na.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na n’esuafo no bae bɛfaa no fun no kesiei, na wɔkɔree kɛkaa kyerɛɛ Jesus.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus tsee no, ɔtwee noho fii hɔ nam hɛn mu kɔr sar do nkyɛn beebi, na nyimpadodow no tsee no, wofii nkurow mu nam daadze tsiiw no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na odwirii no, ohun nyimpadodow pii, na ne yamu hyehyee no maa hɔn, na ɔsaa hɔn ayarfo yarba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na odur ewimbir no, n’esuafo baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Ha yi sar do a, na adze so resa: gya nyimpadodow yi kwan, ma wɔnkɔ nkuraase nkɔtɔ edziban mma hɔnho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Onnhia dɛ wɔkɔ beebiara: homara hom mma hɔn biribi ma wondzi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛwɔ paanoo enum nye esunam ebien pɛ wɔ ha.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mfa mbrɛ me ha.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ nyimpadodow no dɛ wɔntsenatsena mpɔnkɔfuw no do, na ɔfaa paanoo enum no, nye esunam ebien no, na ɔhwɛɛ sor no, ohyiraa do, na obubui, na ɔdze paanoo no maa n’esuafo no, na n’esuafo no dze maa nyimpadodow no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn nyina dzidzii mee; na wɔtasee mporoporoba a ɔkae no, nkɛntsɛn duebien amaama.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn a wodzidzii no, sɛ wɔannkan mbaa nye mbofraba annka ho a, wɔbɛyɛ mpemenum.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ntsɛmara opiapiaa n’esuafo no dɛ wɔnkɔ hɛn mu na wondzi n’enyim kan wɔ esuegya noho, ma ongya nyimpadodow no kwan.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ogyaa nyimpadodow no kwan no, ɔkɔr koko no do nkyɛn beebi kɔsɔree; na odur ewimbir no nna noara nko na ɔwɔ hɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna aber yi mu no, hɛn no wɔ po finimfin, na asorɛkye rubu bɔ no; na mframa so esi hɔn enyim.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ahanamakye ndɔnnan rokɔ no, ɔnantseew po enyi baa hɔn nkyɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wohun dɛ ɔrenantsew po enyi no, hɔn akoma tui, na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔsaman a, na wɔdze hu kekaa mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ntsɛmara ɔnye hɔn kasae, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nhyɛ dzen: mara a, mma hom nnsuro.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Peter buaa no see dɛ, Ewuradze, sɛ woara a, hyɛ me ma membra wo nkyɛn wɔ nsu no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Bra. Na Peter fii hɛn no mu sii, na ɔnantseew nsu no do dɛ ɔrokɔ Jesus nkyɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ohun mframa no, osuroi; na ɔhyɛɛ ase rodɔ no, ɔkaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze, gye me.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ntsɛmara Jesus too ne nsa suoo no mu, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ɔwo a wo gyedzi suar, ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na egyee kyim?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔbaa hɛn no mu no, mframa no gyaae.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn a wɔwɔ hɛn no mu no kotoow no dɛ, Ampa, Nyankopɔn Ba nye wo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wotwae no, wɔbaa Genesaret asaase do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpa a wɔwɔ hɔ no hun no no, wɔsomae ma wɔkɔr nkurow a etwa ehyia nyina mu, na wɔdze hɔn a wɔyaryar nyina brɛɛ no,
title: MATTHEW

text: na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmma wɔnka n’atar no ara nko mpo: na dodow a wɔkaa no no, hɔn ho yɛɛ hɔn dzen.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Farisiifo nye kyerɛwfo a wofi Jerusalɛm baa Jesus nkyɛn bebisaa no dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn na w’esuafo fom mpanyimfo atsetsesɛm do? Dɛ wɔnnhohor hɔn nsa ho ana woedzidzi yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom so hom atsetsesɛm ntsi hom fom Nyankopɔn mbrasɛm do?
title: MATTHEW

text: Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ dɛ, Dzi w’egya nye wo na nyi, na, Obiara a ɔhyɛ egya anaa na ahorba no, owu na ma onwu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom dze, hom se dɛ, Obiara a ɔbɛse n’egya anaa ne na dɛ, Dza nkyɛ edze benya mo ho mfaso yɛ akyɛdze ma Nyankopɔn,
title: MATTHEW

text: nna onnyi dɛ odzi n’egya nyi. Na hom atsetsesɛm ntsi hom amma Nyankopɔn mbra no enntsim.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ndabrabafo, Isaia hyɛɛ hom ho nkɔm yie dɛ ɔse,
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔman yi dze hɔn anofamfa dzi me nyi, Naaso hɔn akoma dze, ɔnye me ntamu twe kɛse;
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔsɔr me gyan, Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɔyɛ nyimpa ahyɛdze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus frɛɛ nyimpadodow no baa ne nkyɛn no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ntsie na hom ntse ase:
title: MATTHEW

text: Nnyɛ dza ɔkɔ anomu na ogu nyimpa ho fi, na mbom dza ofi anomu ba no na ogu nyimpa ho fi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna n’esuafo no bae bɛsee no dɛ, Inyim dɛ Farisiifo no tsee asɛm yi no, ayɛ hɔn fintsidua?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Dua biara a m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor no anntsɛw no, wobotu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom ngyaa hɔn: wɔyɛ akwankyerɛfo enyifurafo. Na sɛ onyifurafo kyerɛ onyifurafo kwan a, hɔn beenu nyina bɔtɔ mona mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Peter buae see no dɛ, Kyerɛ hɛn bɛ yi ase.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ana hom so nnyae nnyaa ntseasee?
title: MATTHEW

text: Ana hom nnhu dɛ biribiara a ɔhɛn anomu no ɔkɔ yafun mu, na woyi gu tsea mu?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na dza ofi anomu ba no, ofi akoma mu, na ɔno na ogu nyimpa ho fi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na akoma mu na adwembɔn fi ba, ewudzi, awarto, ndwamanyɛ, adzewia, dasewia, ebususɛm:
title: MATTHEW

text: yinom nye ndzɛmba a ogu nyimpa ho fi; na edze nsa a wɔannhohor ho bedzidzi dze, onngu nyimpa ho fi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus twee noho fii hɔ kɔr Taere nye Sidon afamu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hwɛ, Keenannyi ɔbaa fi ntoaado hɔ bae bɛkaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze, David ba, hu me mbɔbɔr: na abɔnsam rehaw me babaa papa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na oemmbua no asɛm biara. Na n’esuafo no bae bɛserɛɛ no dɛ, Gya no kwan ma ɔnkɔ, na ɔrekeka mu dzi hɛn ekyir.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see dɛ, Wɔannsoma me obiara hɔ dɛ Israel fie nguan a wɔayew no nko hɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔbae bɔkotoow no see dɛ, Ewuradze, boa me.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see dɛ, Ɔnnsɛ dɛ wɔfa mba edziban tow ma nkramanmba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔbaa no see dɛ, Mo wura, nyew: naaso nkramanmba no dzi mporoporoba a ofi hɔn wuranom pon do gu no bi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Jesus buae see no dɛ, Ɔbaa, wo gyedzi so: ɔnyɛ hɔ mma wo dɛ mbrɛ epɛ. Na ofi dɔn no ara mu ne babaa no ho yɛɛ no dzen.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus fii hɔ baa Galilii po ho, na ɔkɔr koko do kɛtsenaa ase wɔ hɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpadodow pii baa ne nkyɛn a wɔdze mbubua, enyifurafo, mmum, mpakye, nye binom pii; na wɔdze hɔn boguu n’ananadze na ɔsaa hɔn yarba:
title: MATTHEW

text: ma ɔyɛɛ nyimpadodow no nwanwa dɛ mmum rekasa, mpakye ridzi mu, mbubua renantsew, na enyifurafo ruhu adze; na wɔhyɛɛ Israel Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus frɛɛ n’esuafo see hɔn dɛ, Me yamu hyehye me ma nyimpadodow yi, osiandɛ wɔatsena me nkyɛn ndaansa yi na wonnyi biribi a wodzi; na memmpɛ dɛ migya hɔn kwan ma wɔdze kɔm kɔ, bɛyɛ na wɔakɔtɔ bitsi wɔ kwan mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na n’esuafo no see no dɛ, Henfa na yebenya paanoo a ɔbɛmee nyimpadodow pii yi wɔ sar do ha?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Paanoo ahen na hom wɔ? Na wɔsee no dɛ, Esuon, nye esunam nketsenketse kakraabi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ nyimpadodow no dɛ wɔntsenatsena famu;
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔfaa paanoo esuon no, nye esunam no; na ɔdaa ase, na obubui, na ɔdze maa esuafo no, na esuafo no so dze maa nyimpadodow no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn nyina dzidzii mee; na wɔtasee mporoporoba a ɔkae no, mbirefi esuon amaama.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn a wodzidzii no, wɔyɛ mpemanan a wɔnnkan mbaa nye mbofraba nnka ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ogyaa nyimpadodow no kwan, na ɔfoow hɛn baa Magadan ntoaado.
title: MATTHEW

text: Farisiifo nye Sadusiifo bi bae bɔsɔɔ Jesus hwɛe bisaa no dɛ ɔnkyerɛ hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze a ofi sor.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Odu ewimbir a, hom ka dɛ, Wimu bɛtsew, osiandɛ sor aber.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na anapa hom se dɛ, Ndɛ ehum botu, osiandɛ sor ayɛ kowioo na oemuna. Hom tum hwɛ wimu kyerɛ dza obesi, na mber ho nsɛnkyerɛdze dze, hom nntum nnkyerɛ ase.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔsantsen bɔn a wonndzi nokwar rohwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze, na wɔremma hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze bi dɛ Jona dze no. Na ogyaa hɔn hɔ kɔree.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na esuafo no dur esuegya noho no, nna hɔn werɛ efir dɛ wɔfa paanoo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ, na hom nhwɛ yie wɔ Farisiifo nye Sadusiifo mbɔrkaw no ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wosusui wɔ hɔn tsirmu dɛ, Yɛammfa paanoo ntsi a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus hunii no, ɔsee dɛ, Hom a hom gyedzi suar, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom susu se wɔ hom mu dɛ osiandɛ hom ammfa paanoo ntsi a?
title: MATTHEW

text: Ana hom nnyae nnhunii, anaa hom nnkaa nyimpa mpemenum paanoo enum no, nye nkɛntsɛn dodow a hom fae no?
title: MATTHEW

text: Anaadɛ mpemanan paanoo esuon no, nye mbirefi dodow a hom fae no?
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom nnhu dɛ nnyɛ paanoo ho asɛm bi na mereka? Na hom nhwɛ yie wɔ Farisiifo nye Sadusiifo mbɔrkaw ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna wohun dɛ ɔannse hɔn dɛ wɔnhwɛ yie wɔ paanoo mbɔrkaw ho, na Farisiifo nye Sadusiifo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus dur Kaesarea Filipi afamu no, obisaa n’esuafo dɛ, Nyimpa se dɛ nyimpa Ba no nye woana?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Binom se John Onumanyi no a; binom se Elija a; na binom so se Jeremia anaa nkɔnhyɛfo no mu baako a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Na hom dze, hom se dɛ woana nye me?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Simon Peter buae see dɛ, Ɔwo nye Kraest no, Nyankopɔn tseasefo no ne Ba no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Nhyira aka wo, Simon, Jona ba; na nnyɛ honam nye bɔgya na woeyi akyerɛ wo, na m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor no a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mo so mese wo dɛ, Ɔwo nye Peter, na ɔbotan yi do na medze m’asɔr besi; na samanadze aponkɛse rinndzi do nyim.
title: MATTHEW

text: Medze sor ahenman ne nsaafee mebɛma wo: na biribiara a ebɛkyekyer wɔ asaase do no, wɔbɛkyekyer wɔ sor; na biribiara a ebɛsan wɔ asaase do no, wɔbɛsan wɔ sor.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ɔbraa n’esuafo no dɛ mma wɔnnka nnkyerɛ obiara dɛ ɔno nye Kraest no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ofitsi aber no na Jesus hyɛɛ ase kyerɛɛ n’esuafo dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ ɔkɔ Jerusalɛm, na okohu amandze pii wɔ mpanyimfo nye asɔfompanyin, nye kyerɛwfo nsa, na woeku no, na da a otsia ebiasa no ɔasoɛr.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Peter dze no kɔr nkyɛn, na ɔhyɛɛ ase twuuw n’enyim, dɛ, Wɔmma ɔmpar wo, Ewuradze: iyi remmba wo do da.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔdaan noho see Peter dɛ, Fi mo do, Satan: eyɛ fintsidua ma me; osiandɛ enndwen Nyankopɔn dze, na edwen nyimpa dze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Jesus see n’esuafo no dɛ, Sɛ obi pɛ dɛ odzi m’ekyir a, ma ɔmpa noho, na ompegya ne mbeamudua na ɔnka mo do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔgye no nkwa no, ɔbɛyew no, na obiara a emi ntsi ɔbɛyew no nkwa no, obohu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ nyimpa nya wiadze nyina ma ntsi ɔhwer no nkwa a, ebɛn mfaso na obenya? Anaa ebɛnadze na nyimpa bɛma dze asesa no nkwa?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpa Ba no dze n’Egya n’enyimnyam nye n’abɔfoe bɛba; na aber no na obotua nyimpa nyina kaw dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ tse.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Hɔn a wogyina ha yi, binom wɔ hɔ a wɔronnsɔ owu nnhwɛ ansaana woehu nyimpa Ba dɛ ɔreba wɔ n’ahendzi mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nda esia ekyir no Jesus faa Peter nye James nye no nua John, na ɔdze hɔn kɔr nkyɛn wɔ kokwaa tsentsen bi do;
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔsakyeree wɔ hɔn enyim, na n’enyim hyerɛɛn dɛ ewia, na n’atar yɛɛ fitaa dɛ kan.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hwɛ, Elija nye Moses puee hɔn nkyɛn, na wɔnye Jesus kasae.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Peter see Jesus dɛ, Ewuradze, oye ma hɛn dɛ yɛtsena ha, na sɛ epɛ a, mobɔbɔ asese ebiasa, ɔwo wodze kor, Moses dze kor, Elija dze kor.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na n’ano da do rekasa no, hwɛ, mununkum hyɛnn bɛkataa hɔn do, na ndze bi fi mununkum no mu see dɛ, Oyi nye mo Dɔba a ɔsɔ m’enyi: hom ntsie no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na esuafo no tsee no, wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu, na wosuroo pii.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus bae dze ne nsa bɛkaa hɔn na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nsoɛr, mma hom nnsuro.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔmemaa hɔn enyiwa do no, woennhu obiara dɛ Jesus nko.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wofi kokwaa no do risian no, Jesus braa hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnka dza hom ehu yi nnkyerɛ obiara, gyedɛ nyimpa Ba no asoɛr efi ewufo mu ana.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na n’esuafo no bisaa no see dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na Akyerɛwfo no ka dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ Elija dzi kan ba?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see dɛ, Elija dze, odzi kan ba ampa, na obesiesie ndzɛmba nyina:
title: MATTHEW

text: na mese hom dɛ Elija aba dada, na woennhu no anngye no, na wɔyɛɛ no dza wɔpɛe nyina. Dɛmara na nyimpa Ba no so bohu hɔn nsa mu amandze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna esuafo no hun dɛ ɔreka John Onumanyi no no ho asɛm.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔbaa nyimpadodow no nkyɛn no, nyimpa bi baa no hɔ bɔkotoow no see dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Ewuradze, hu me babanyin mbɔbɔr, na otwa ehim na ohu amandze bɔn, na ɔtɔ dɛ ɔhwe gya mu, na ɔtɔ dɛ ɔhwe nsu mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na medze no brɛɛ w’esuafo, na woenntum annsa no yarba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus buae see dɛ, Ao ɔsantsen a hom nnyi gyedzi na hom akyea, menye hom ntsena nkodu dabɛn? Minsie hom ho abotar nkodu dabɛn? Hom mfa no mbrɛ me ha.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus bɔɔ no ham, na abɔnsam no fii no mu firii; na ofitsi dɔn no ara mu na abofra no ne yarba gyaae.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna esuafo no baa Jesus hɔ wɔ nkyɛn, na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na yeenntum enntu no?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom gyedzi suar ntsi a: na nokwar mese hom dɛ, Sɛ hom wɔ gyedzi a ɔtse dɛ sinape abafua a, nkyɛ hom bɛse kokwaa yi dɛ, Tutu fi ha kɔ noho, na nkyɛ obotutu, na nkyɛ biribiara ronnso hom yɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: (Naaso iyi ne saso mmfir edzi, gyedɛ ɔnam mpaabɔ ɔnye mbuadadzi do.)
title: MATTHEW

text: Na worikyinkyin Galilii no, Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Woribeyi Nyimpa Ba no ahyɛ nyimpa nsa;
title: MATTHEW

text: na woboku no, na da a otsia ebiasa no obenyan. Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn awerɛhow pii.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔbaa Karpernaum no, hɔn a wɔgyegye asɔrdan ho tow no baa Peter nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, Ana hom kyerɛkyerɛnyi no nntua asɔrdan ho tow no?
title: MATTHEW

text: Obuaa dɛ, Otua. Na ɔbaa fie no, Jesus dzii kan bisaa no dɛ, Simon, edwen dɛn? Asaase do ahemfo no woananom hɔ na wɔgyegye amandze anaa tow? Hɔn mba hɔ anaa anana hɔ a?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Anana hɔ no, Jesus see no dɛ, Ɔno dze na mba no fa hɔnho dzi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Naaso mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma yɛnnkɔfom hɔn ntsi, kɔ mpoano kɔtow nkwaba, na fa nam a obedzi kan aba no, na ibue n’anomu a, ibohu sika wɔ mu: fa kotua ma emi na ɔwo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Aber no ara mu na esuafo no baa Jesus hɔ bebisaa dɛ, Woana na ɔyɛ kɛse wɔ sor ahenman no mu?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ abofraba bi baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔdze no gyinaa hɔn finimfin,
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Mese hom nokwar mu dɛ, gyedɛ hom dan na hom yɛ dɛ mbofraba, ɔno hom runntum nnhɛn Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu da.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi, obiara a ɔbɛbrɛ noho adze dɛ abofraba yi no, ɔnoara na ɔyɛ kɛse wɔ sor ahenman no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara a ɔbɛgye abofraba a ɔtse dɛm yi kor wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔgye emi mara.
title: MATTHEW

text: Sɛ hom mu obiara to mbofra nkakraba a wɔgye me dzi yi mu baako fintsidua a, oye ma no dɛ wɔdze ewuyambo kɛse sɛn no kɔn mu, na wɔkɔtow no kyen nsu mu wɔ po bun mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Fintsiduato ntsi wiadze ndue! Na otwar dɛ fintsiduato ba, na nyimpa a fintsidua nam no do ba no, ndue!
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ wo nsa anaa wo nan to wo fintsidua a, twa, na tow fi woho kyen: oye ma wo dɛ edze abasin anaa anansin bɔkɔ nkwa mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ wo nsa ebien nye w’anan ebien, na wɔbɔtow wo akyen onnyiewiei gya mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ w’enyiwa to wo fintsidua a, tu, na tow fi woho kyen. Oye ma wo dɛ edze enyiwa kor bɔkɔ nkwa mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ enyiwa ebien na wɔbɔtow wo akyen ogya amandzehu kurow mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nhwɛ yie mma hom eemmbu nkakraba yi mu baako enyimtsia, na mese hom dɛ ɔsor noho hɔn abɔfoe hwɛ m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor no enyim daa.
title: MATTHEW

text: (Na nyimpa Ba no bae dɛ ɔrebɛgye dza ayew no nkwa.)
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom dwen dɛn? Sɛ nyimpa bi wɔ nguan ɔha, na hɔn mu baako tɔ gon a, ana onngyaa eduokron akron no hɔ, na ɔnnkɔ nkokwaa do nnkɔhwehwɛ dza ɔayew no?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ ɔba dɛ ohu no a, nokwar mese hom dɛ odzi dɛw wɔ no ho kyɛn eduokron akron no a wɔanntɔ gon no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛmara na ɔnnyɛ hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor ne pɛ dɛ nkakraba yi mu baako bɛyew.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ wo nua fom wo a, kɔ na keyi no atsɛn wɔ ɔwo nye ɔno nko ntamu: sɛ otsie wo a, enya wo nua.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ oenntsie wo a, fa kor anaa ebien ka woho, ama nyimpa beenu anaa baasa aayɛ asɛm no ho adasefo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ ɔpow dɛ obetsie hɔn a, kɛka kyerɛ asɔr no, na sɛ ɔpow dɛ obetsie asɔr so a, bu no dɛ amanamamfo mu baako nye towgyenyi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Biribiara a hom bɛkyekyer wɔ asaase do no, wɔbɛkyekyer no wɔ sor; na biribiara a hom bɛsan wɔ asaase do no, wɔbɛsan no wɔ sor.
title: MATTHEW

text: Bio, mese hom dɛ, Sɛ hom mu beenu yɛ anokor wɔ asaase do wɔ biribi a wobebisa ho a, m’Egya a ɔwɔ sor bɛyɛ ama hɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mbrɛ beenu anaa baasa ehyia wɔ me dzin mu no, nna mowɔ hɔn finimfin.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Peter bae bɛsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, mpɛn ahen na mo nua fom me a, memfa nkyɛ no? Onkodu mpɛn esuon anaa?
title: MATTHEW

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Mennse wo dɛ onkodu mpɛn esuon, na mpɛn eduosuon mbɔho esuon.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi sor ahenman no tse dɛ ɔhen bi a ɔpɛɛ dɛ ɔnye no nkowaa bu nkontaa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ ase rubu no, wɔdze baako a ɔmaa no talent mpemdu brɛɛ no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na osiandɛ onnyi dza ɔdze botua ntsi, no wura hyɛɛ dɛ wɔntɔn ɔno, nye ne yer, nye ne mba, nye dza ɔwɔ nyina mfa ntua kaw.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi akowaa no hwee daadze wɔ n’enyim, na ɔtotɔɔe serɛɛ no dɛ, Mo wura, nya abotar wɔ mo ho, na mubotua wo ne nyina.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na akowaa no wura ne yamu hyehyee no, na ogyaa no, na ɔdze kaw no kyɛɛ no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na akowaa noara fiir edzi kohun no wura no nkowaa no mu baako a ɔdze no kaw kakraabi denare ɔha; na osuoo no mu, na ɔtɔɔr ne meneba dɛ, Tua dza edze me.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na akowaa no hwee daadze wɔ n’enyim na ɔserɛɛ no dɛ, Nya abotar wɔ mo ho, na mubotua wo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔno dze, ɔammpen, na ɔkɔree dze no kɔtoo efiadze dɛ onkodu dɛ obotua dza ɔdze no no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na no wura no nkowaa no hun dza esi no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn yaw dɛ, na wɔkɔree kɛkaa dza esi no nyina kyerɛɛ hɔn wura.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na no wura frɛɛ no see no dɛ, Akowaa bɔn, medze wo kaw no nyina kyɛɛ wo osiandɛ eserɛɛ me ntsi:
title: MATTHEW

text: ana ɔnnsɛ wo so dɛ nkyɛ ihu wo nyɛnko akowaa no mbɔbɔr, dɛ mbrɛ muhun wo mbɔbɔr no?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na no wura no bo fuwii, na oyii no maa ahohiahiafo dɛ wɔntseetsee no araa nkodu dɛ obotua ne kaw no nyinara.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛmara na mo sor Egya bɛyɛ hom, sɛ hom emmfi hom akoma mu ammfa obiara no nua no bɔn annkyɛ no a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus wiee nsɛm yi ka no, osii mu fii Galilii na ɔbaa Judea ntoaado wɔ Jordan egya;
title: MATTHEW

text: na nyimpadodow pii kaa no do, na ɔsaa hɔn yarba wɔ hɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Farisiifo bi baa ne nkyɛn bɔsɔɔ no hwɛe see no dɛ, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ obi gyina asɛm biara do gyaa ne yer awar?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see dɛ, Ana hom nnkenkaan dɛ nyia ahyɛse no ɔbɔɔ hɔn no yɛɛ hɔn ɔbanyin nye ɔbaa,
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Iyi ntsi na ɔbanyin begya n’egya nye ne na hɔ, na ɔdze noho akɛbata ne yer ho; na hɔn beenu ayɛ honankor?
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm no na wɔnnda ho nnyɛ beenu bio, na wɔyɛ honankor. Ntsi dza Nyankopɔn dze abɔ mu no, mma nyimpa nntsew mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Wɔsee no dɛ, Na ɔyɛ dɛn na Moses hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmma ɔbaa no awargyaa krataa na wongyaa no yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom akoma dzen ntsi na Moses maa hom kwan dɛ hom ngyaa hom yernom, na ofi ahyɛse no dze nna ɔnntse dɛm.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mese hom dɛ, Obiara a obegyaa ne yer, na nnyɛ ndwamanyɛ ntsi, na ɔbɔwar fofor no, ɔato awar.
title: MATTHEW

text: Esuafo no see no dɛ, Sɛ dɛm na ɔbanyin nye ne yer ntamu asɛm tse dze a, nna onnye dɛ wɔwar.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nnyɛ nyimpa nyina na wobotum agye asɛm yi, gyedɛ hɔn a wɔdze ama hɔn no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Binom wɔ hɔ a wɔwoo hɔn fii hɔn na yamu dɛ mma wɔnnwar; na binom so wɔ hɔ a nyimpa yɛɛ hɔn ma wɔnnwar; na binom so wɔ hɔ a sor ahendzi no ntsi wɔnnwar. Nyia obotum agye no, ma ɔngye.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna wɔdze mbofraba brɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa ne nsa ngu hɔn do, na ɔmbɔ mpaa mma hɔn; naaso esuafo no kasaa hɔn a wɔdze hɔn bae no enyim.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus see dɛ, Hom mma mbofraba no kwan ma wɔmbra me nkyɛn, mma hom nnsiw hɔn kwan, na woyinom dɛm na sor ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔdze ne nsa guu hɔn do no, ofii hɔ kɔree.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hwɛ, obi bae bɛsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ebɛn adzepa na menyɛ ama meenya onnyiewiei nkwa?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ibisa me papa ho asɛm? Baako pɛ na ɔyɛ papa; na sɛ epɛ dɛ ekɔ nkwa mu a, dzi mbransɛm no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Obisaa Jesus dɛ, Dza ɔwɔ hen a? Jesus see no dɛ, Mma nndzi ewu, Mma nnto awar, Mma nnwia adze, Mma nndzi dasewia,
title: MATTHEW

text: Dzi w’egya nye wo na nyi, na, Dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa woho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Aberantsɛ no see no dɛ, Iyi nyina medzi do: aka me ebɛnadze bio?
title: MATTHEW

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Sɛ epɛ dɛ idzi mu a, kɔ kɔtɔn dza ewɔ, na fa kyɛ ehiafo, na ibenya akoradze wɔ sor, na afei bra bɛka mo do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na aberantsɛ no tsee asɛm no, ɔdze yaw kɔree, osiandɛ ɔyɛ nyimpa a ɔwɔ ahonyadze pii.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus see n’esuafo no dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔyɛ dzen ma ɔhonyanyi dɛ ɔbɔkɔ sor ahenman no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na bio mese hom dɛ ɔyɛ mberɛw ma efupɔnkɔ dɛ obodua doroba enyiwa mu kyɛn dɛ ɔhonyanyi bɔkɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na esuafo no tsee no, hɔn ho boow hɔn pii, na wɔsee dɛ, Dɛm a nna woana koraa na wobotum agye no nkwa?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus hwɛɛ hɔn see dɛ, Nyimpa afamu na iyi nntum dɛm yɛ, na Nyankopɔn afamu dze, adze biara nnso no yɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Peter buae see no dɛ, Hwɛ, yeegyaa ndzɛmba nyina na yɛabɛka wo do: ebɛnadze na yebenya?
title: MATTHEW

text: Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ hom a hom ebedzi m’ekyir yi, wiadze fofor no mu a nyimpa Ba no bɛtsena n’enyimnyam ahengua do no, hom so hom bɛtsena nhengua duebien do ebu Israel ebusuakuw duebien no atsɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara a oegyaa fie, anaa enuanom, anaa nkyerɛbaa, anaa egya, anaa na, anaa mba, anaa nsaase, wɔ me dzin ntsi, obenya mbɔho mpɛn ɔha, na oenya onnyiewiei nkwa ayɛ nedze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na edzikamfo pii bedzi ekyir na ekyidzifo so pii bedzi kan.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔsor ahenman no tse dɛ nyimpa a ɔyɛ asaasewura a opuee anapaatu dɛ ɔrokɔbɔ edwumafo paa akɔ no wenyin ture mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔnye edwumayɛfo no dzii ano da kor akatua no, ɔmaa wɔkɔr no wenyin ture mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na opuei bɛyɛ dɛ anapa ndɔnkron no, na okohun binom dɛ wogyinagyina gua do enyihaw mu;
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom so hom nkɔ wenyin ture no mu, na dza ɔsɛ no mebɛma hom. Na wɔkɔree.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔkɔr bio bɛyɛ ewiaber duebien nye ndɔnebiasa no mu kɛyɛɛ dɛmara.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na bɛyɛ ewimbir ndɔnnum mu no, ofiir edzi kohun binom dɛ wogyinagyina hɔ, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na adzekyee yi nyina hom gyinagyina ha enyihaw mu yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Wɔsee no dɛ, osiandɛ obiara mmbɔɔ hɛn paa. Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom so hom nkɔ wenyin ture no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na odur ewimbir no, wenyin ture no wura see ɔhwɛdofo no dɛ, Frɛ edwumayɛfo no, na ma hɔn hɔn apaabɔdze, hyɛ ase fi hɔn a wodzii ekyir no do kesi hɔn a wodzii kan no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn a wɔfaa hɔn ewimbir ndɔnnum no bae no, hɔn nyina nyaa da kor akatua nkorkor.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na edzikamfo no bae no, wosusuu dɛ wobenya kɛse; na hɔn so hɔn mu biara nyaa dakor akatua nkorkor.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn nsa kae no, wohwinhwinii tsiaa asaasewura no
title: MATTHEW

text: dɛ, Ekyirfo yi dze, dɔnhwer kor pɛ na wɔyɛɛ edwuma, na ama wɔnye hɛn a adzekyee yi ne berɛ nye ne hyew adzen hɛn yi agye akatua pɛr.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see hɔn mu baako dɛ, Nyɛnko, mennyɛɛ wo bɔn bi: ana menye wo enndzi ano da kor akatua?
title: MATTHEW

text: Fa wodze na kɔ; mepɛ dɛ mema ekyidzifo yi dɛ mbrɛ memaa woara.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ana minnyi ho kwan dɛ medze mankasa m’adze yɛ dza mepɛ? Me yamu ye ntsi ɔyɛ wo ehi anaa?
title: MATTHEW

text: Mbrɛ ekyidzifo bedzi kan, na Edzikamfo edzi ekyir ara nye no. (Na wɔafrɛ pii, naaso kakraabi na woeyi hɔn.)
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus rofow akɔ Jerusalɛm no, ɔfaa esuafo duebien no nko kɔr nkyɛn na ɔsee hɔn wɔ kwan no mu dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Hwɛ, yɛrofow akɔ Jerusalɛm, na wobeyi nyimpa Ba no ahyɛ asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no nsa, na woebu no fɔ dɛ wonku no,
title: MATTHEW

text: na woeyi no ama amanamamfo dɛ wonsi no atwetwe na wɔnka no mpire, na wɔmbɔ no mbeamudua mu; naaso da a otsia ebiasa no obenyan.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Zebedee mba no hɔn na nye ne mba baa ne nkyɛn bɔkotoow no, na ɔserɛɛ no hɔ biribi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na epɛ? Ɔsee no dɛ, Hyɛ ma me mba beenu yi, baako aatsena w’enyimfa, na baako aatsena w’abankum, wɔ w’ahenman no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus buae see dɛ, Hom nnyim dza hom reserɛ yi: ana hom botum anom kɔɔpow a morobɔnom no? (Anaa enuma a wɔdze rubonuma me no hom botum ma wɔdze enuma hom?) Wɔsee no dɛ, Yebotum.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mo kɔɔpow dze, hom bɔnom, (m’enuma no, wɔdze bonuma hom): naaso m’enyimfa nye m’abankum tsena dze, ɔnnyɛ medze dɛ medze bɛma; na wɔdze bɛma hɔn a m’Egya esiesie ama hɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na du no tsee no, wonyaa ebufuw wɔ enuanom beenu no ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus frɛɛ hɔn baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nyim dɛ amanaman ahemfo no, wodzi hɔn do wura, na hɔn mu akɛse dzi hɔn do tum.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔrennyɛ dɛm wɔ hom mu: na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔbɛyɛ kɛse wɔ hom mu no, ɔbɛyɛ hom somfo;
title: MATTHEW

text: na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ odzi hom mu kan no, ɔbɛyɛ hom akowaa:
title: MATTHEW

text: dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa Ba no so ɔammba dɛ wɔnsom no, na mbom dɛ ɔbɔsomee, ama ɔdze no nkwa aayɛ apondze ama dodowara no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wofi Jeriko rokɔ no, nyimpadodow pii kaa no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hwɛ, enyifurafo beenu bi a wɔtse kwan nkyɛn no tsee dɛ Jesus rutwa mu no, wɔtseatseaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze, David ba, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpadodow no braa hɔn dɛ wɔnka hɔn ano nto mu; na mbom wɔtseatseaa mu kɛse see dɛ, Ewuradze, David ba, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus gyinae, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn, na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom pɛ dɛ meyɛ ma hom?
title: MATTHEW

text: Wobuaa no dɛ, Ewuradze, nkyɛ hɛn enyiwa eebue.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus ne yamu hyehyee no wɔ hɔn ho, na ɔdze ne nsa kaa hɔn enyiwa, na hɔ no ara wohun adze na wɔkaa no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔbɛɛn Jerusalɛm, na wodur Bɛtfage, wɔ Ngo Bepɔw no ho no, Jesus somaa esuafo beenu
title: MATTHEW

text: see hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ ekuroba a ɔda hom enyim no mu, na ntsɛmara hom bohu asoasopɔnkɔ a wɔamontan no, nye ne ba: hom nsan hɔn na hom mfa mbrɛ me.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ obiara se hom biribi a, hom nse dɛ, Ewuradze wɔ hɔn ho hia, na ntsɛmara ɔbɛma wɔdze aba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔyɛɛ yinom ma dza nkɔnhyɛnyi no kae no aaba mu dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nse Zion babaa, Hwɛ, wo hen reba wo nkyɛn: Ɔdwe, na ɔtse asoasopɔnkɔ do, nye asoasopɔnkɔ a ɔsoa adze ne ba do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na esuafo no kɔree kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Jesus hyɛɛ hɔn no,
title: MATTHEW

text: na wɔdze asoasopɔnkɔ no nye ne ba no bae, na wɔdze hɔn ntar guu hɔn do, na ɔtsenaa do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpadodow pii dze hɔn ntar sesɛɛw kwan no mu, na binom twitwaa ndubaa sesɛɛw kwan no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpadodow a wodzi enyim no, na hɔn a wodzi ekyir no tseaa mu see dɛ, Hosanna, David ba no! Nhyira nye nyia ɔnam Ewuradze dzin mu reba no! Hosanna wɔ sorsor!
title: MATTHEW

text: Na odur Jerusalɛm no, kurow no nyina bɔɔ twitwi bisabisaa dɛ, Iyi woana a?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpadodow no see dɛ, Oyi nye Jesus, nkɔnhyɛnyi a ofi Nazarɛt a ɔwɔ Galilii no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus kɔr Nyankopɔn asɔrfi no mu, na ɔkɛpaam hɔn a wɔtɔn nye hɔn a wɔtɔ wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na obutuuw sikasesafo hɔn apon nye hɔn a wɔtɔn mbubur no hɔn ngua;
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Wɔbɛfrɛ me fi asɔryɛbea: na hom dze, hom reyɛ no edwotwafo tu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na enyifurafo nye mpakye baa no hɔ wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na ɔsaa hɔn yarba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na asɔfompanyin nye akyerɛwfo no hun anwanwadze a ɔyɛe no, ɔnye mbofraba a wɔretseatsea mu wɔ asɔrfi no mu dɛ, Hosanna, David ba no, wonyaa ebufuw pii,
title: MATTHEW

text: na wɔsee no dɛ, Etse dza yinom reka yi? Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Nyew: ana hom nnkenkaan pɛn dɛ, Nkɔkowaba nye numfoanomba anomu, na ɔwo esiesie ayɛyi ama woho anaa?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ogyaa hɔn hɔ, na ofii kurow no mu kɔr Bɛtani kɛtsenaa hɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na anapa no a ɔresan aba kurow no mu no, ɔkɔm dzee no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ohun adɔmbadua wɔ kwan no do no, ɔbaa ho naaso oennhu biribiara wɔ do dɛ ahaban nko; na ɔsee no dɛ, Mma aba nnsow wo do dabiarada. Na amonmu hɔ ara adɔmbadua no kyenkyenee.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na esuafo no hunii no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn nwanwa, na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na amonmu ha yi ara adɔmbadua yi akyenkyen yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Sɛ hom wɔ gyedzi, na hom nnyɛ ekyingye a, nkyɛ nnyɛ adɔmbadua dze yi nko na hom bɛyɛ, na mpo sɛ hom se koko yi dɛ, Tutu na kɔhwe po mu, a, nkyɛ ɔbɛyɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na biribiara a hom bebisa no mpaabɔ mu, na hom gye dzi no, hom nsa bɛka.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔbaa asɔrfi mu, na ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ no, asɔfompanyin nye ɔman mpanyimfo no baa ne nkyɛn bebisaa no dɛ, Ebɛn tum na enam do yɛ ndzɛmba yi, na woana maa wo tum yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Mo so mibebisa hom asɛm kor a sɛ hom kyerɛ me ano a, mo so mebɛkyerɛ hom tum kor a medze meyɛ yinom.
title: MATTHEW

text: John enuma no, ofi hen? Ofi sor anaa ofi nyimpa? Na wosusui wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, Sɛ yɛka dɛ, Ofi sor, a, ɔbɛse hɛn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom anngye enndzi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ yɛka dɛ, Ofi nyimpa, a, yesuro nyimpadodow no: osiandɛ hɔn nyina bu John nkɔnhyɛnyi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wobuaa Jesus see dɛ, Yennyim. Na no so see hɔn dɛ, Mo so merennka tum kor a medze yɛ yinom mennkyerɛ hom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom dwen iyi ho dɛn? Nyimpa bi wɔ mba beenu; na ɔbaa nyia odzi kan no hɔ bɛsee no dɛ, Ɔba, ndɛ kɔ kɛyɛ mo wenyin ture mu edwuma.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see dɛ, Moronnkɔ, na n’ekyir no onuu noho na ɔkɔree.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔbaa nyia otsia ebien no hɔ bɛsee no dɛmara. Na obuae see dɛ, Mo wura, mobɔkɔ, naaso ɔannkɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hɔn beenu yi mu woana na ɔyɛɛ n’egya ne pɛ? Wɔsee dɛ, Nyia odzi kan no a. Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Meka no nokwar mu dɛ, towgyefo nye ndwaman ridzi hom enyim akɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na John nam tsenenee kwan mu baa hom nkyɛn, na hom anngye no enndzi: na towgyefo nye ndwaman gyee no dzii: na hom dze, hom hunii no hom ammfe homho ekyir dɛ hom bɛgye no edzi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom ntsie bɛ fofor so: asaasewura bi wɔ hɔ a ɔyɛɛ wenyin ture, na ɔgyee ho ban hyiae, na otuu wenyintwer, na ɔtoow abantsentsen wɔ mu, na ɔdze fɛɛm ekuafo bi, na ɔdɔɔ mu kɔr beebi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na eduaba no ne ber durii no, ɔsomaa no nkowaa wɔ ekuafo no nkyɛn dɛ wɔnkɛgye n’eduaba no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ekuafo no kyeer no nkowaa no, na wɔhwee bi, na wokum bi, na wosiiw bi abo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Bio, ɔsomaa nkowaa fofor a wɔdɔɔ so kyɛn nkan dze no; na wɔyɛɛ hɔn dɛmara.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na n’ekyir no, ɔsomaa ne babanyin wɔ hɔn hɔ, na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔbɛfɛr me ba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Naaso ekuafo no hun babanyin no, wɔsesee wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, Nyia a odzi adze no nye yi: hom mbra ma yenku no, na yɛmfa n’egyapadze no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔkyeer no, na wɔtoow no fii wenyin ture mu hɔ kyenee, na wokum no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi aber a wenyin ture no wura bɛba, ebɛnadze na ɔbɛyɛ ekuafo no?
title: MATTHEW

text: Wɔsee no dɛ, Ɔbɛsɛɛ nyimpa bɔn no pasaa, na ɔdze no wenyin ture no afɛm ekuafo fofor a wɔdze eduaba no bɛma no wɔ n’aber mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnkenkaan kyerɛwsɛm no mu pɛn dɛ, Ɔbo a adantofo powee no, Ɔnoara na ɔabɛyɛ kutuwdo bo; Iyi Ewuradze na ɔayɛ, Na ɔyɛ nwanwa wɔ hɛn enyiwa do?
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, Nyankopɔn ahenman no, wɔbɛgye efi hom nsamu dze akɛma ɔman a wɔdze mu eduaba bɛba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara a ɔbɔhwe ɔbo yi do no obobubu, na obiara a ɔbo no bɔhwe no do no, ɔbɔdwow no dɛ isiam.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na asɔfompanyin nye Farisiifo no tsee ne mbɛ no, wohun dɛ ɔkaa hɔn ho asɛm.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔkyer no no, wosuroo nyimpadodow no, osiandɛ nna wobu no nkɔnhyɛnyi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus buae kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn mbɛbu mu bio dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔsor ahenman no tse dɛ ɔhen bi a ohyiaa ayefor maa ne babanyin,
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔsomaa no nkowaa dɛ wɔnkɛfrɛ hɔn a wohyiaa hɔn ayefor ase no: na wɔammpɛ dɛ wɔba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Bio ɔsomaa nkowaa afofor dɛ wɔnkɛka nkyerɛ hɔn a woehyia hɔn no dɛ, Hwɛ, mesiesie m’edziban, meku m’anantwi nye m’anyɛmbowa, na woewie adze nyinara yɛ: hom mbra ayefor ase.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔammfa annyɛ hwee, na wɔkɔr hɔn beebi: obi kɔr no kwa mu, obi so kɔr n’eguadzi ho:
title: MATTHEW

text: na nkaa no kyeer nkowaa no hyɛɛ hɔn fɛr, na wokum hɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔhen no bo fuwii, na ɔsomaa no dɔm ma wɔkɛsɛɛ ewudzifo no, na wɔhyeew hɔn kurow.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ɔsee no nkowaa no dɛ, Woewie ayefor pon no siesie dze, naaso hɔn a wokehyiaa hɔn no ammfata hɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nkɔ atsempɔn nkwanta do na dodowara a hom bohu hɔn no, hom mfrɛ hɔn mbra ayefor ase.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nkowaa no fiir edzi kɔr atsempɔn do, na wɔkɔboaboaa dodowara a wohun hɔn no ano, papa nye bɔn nyina, ma edzidzifo hyɛɛ ayefor no ase ma.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔhen no baa mu bɔhwɛɛ hɔn a wɔtse edzidzii no, ohun nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a ɔnnhyɛ ayeforhyia atar;
title: MATTHEW

text: na obisaa no dɛ, Awɛ, eyɛɛ dɛn baa mu ha, na ennhyɛ ayeforhyia atar yi? Na ɔtɔɔ mmum.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ɔhen no see asomfo no dɛ, Hom nkyekyer ne nsa nye n’anan na hom mfa no nkɔ nkɔtow no nkyen ekyirekyir sum no mu: hɔ na osu nye asetwɛr wɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Osiandɛ wɔafrɛ pii, naaso kakraabi na woeyi hɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Farisiifo no kɔree kɛfaa apam, mbrɛ wobesi esua no efir wɔ kasa mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔsomaa hɔn esuafo ɔnye Herod akadofo wɔ no hɔ, na wɔsee dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yenyim dɛ eyɛ nokwafo, na ekyerɛkyerɛ Nyankopɔn kwan no wɔ nokwar mu, na innsuro nyimpa biara; eso ennhwɛ nyimpa enyim.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi ka kyerɛ hɛn: Edwen dɛn? Ɔfa mbra mu dɛ yɛma Kaesar ntoboa anaa oho?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus hun hɔn emumuyɛ no, ɔsee dɛ, Ndabrabafo, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom rosɔ me hwɛ yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom mfa towsika no mbɛkyerɛ me. Na wɔdze sika denare brɛɛ no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Woana no mfonyi nye n’akyerɛwee nye yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Wɔsee dɛ, Kaesar dze a. Nna ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ntsi hom ndan dza ɔyɛ Kaesar dze mma Kaesar, na dza ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn dze mma Nyankopɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔtsee no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn nwanwa, na wogyaa no hɔ kɔree.
title: MATTHEW

text: Da no ara na Sadusiifo a wɔka dɛ wunyan nnyi hɔ no bae bebisaa no dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Kyerɛkyerɛfo, Moses see dɛ, Sɛ obi wu, na sɛ onnyi mba a, no nua nwar ne yer, na ɔnwo mba mma no nua.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na enuanom beesuon tsenaa hɛn nkyɛn ha; na nyia odzii kan no waree, na owui, na onnyi mba no ɔdaan ne yer gyaa no nua;
title: MATTHEW

text: nyia otsia ebien no nye ebiasa no yɛɛ dɛm ara, bodur nyia otsia esuon no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ne nyina ekyir no, ɔbaa no so wui.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi wunyan no mu, beesuon no mu woana na ɔbɛyɛ ne yer? Osiandɛ hɔn nyina waar no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Hom fom, osiandɛ hom nnyim kyerɛwsɛm no nye Nyankopɔn no tum so.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wunyan no mu, wɔnnwar eso wɔmma awar, na wɔtse dɛ Nyankopɔn abɔfoe wɔ sor.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ewufo hɔn nyan ho dze, ana hom nnkenkaan dza Nyankopɔn kae no dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Emi nye Abraham Nyankopɔn, Isaak Nyankopɔn, Jakob Nyankopɔn no? Ɔnnyɛ ewufo Nyankopɔn na atseasefo Nyankopɔn a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpadodow no tsee no, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no yɛɛ hɔn ahobow.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Farisiifo no tsee dɛ oemua Sadusiifo no ano no, wodzii ehyia.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn mu baako a ɔyɛ mbrakyerɛfo sɔɔ no hwɛe bisaa no dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Kyerɛkyerɛfo, Mbra no mu asɛnkɛse nye dza ɔwɔ hen?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Dɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wɔ w’akoma nyina mu, nye wo kra nyina mu, nye w’adwen nyina mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Iyi nye mbra no mu asɛm a odzi kan, na ɔso.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na dza otsia ebien no a ɔtse dɛ ɔno no nye dɛ, Dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa woho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Mbransɛm ebien yi do na mbra nye nkɔnhyɛfo no nyina gyinae.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Farisiifo no boaa ano no, Jesus bisaa hɔn dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom dwen Kraest no ho dɛn? Woana ba nye no? Wɔsee no dɛ, David a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Dɛm a ɔyɛ dɛn na David nam Sunsum mu frɛ no Ewuradze, ber a ɔkaa dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Ewuradze see m’Ewuradze dɛ, Tsena m’abanyimfa Kodu dɛ medze w’atamfo bogu w’ananadze?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ David frɛ no Ewuradze a, ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔyɛ ne ba?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara enntum amma no mbuae biara, na ofitsi da no obiara ennsi no bo dɛ obebisa no asɛm bio.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Jesus kasaa kyerɛɛ nyimpadodow no nye n’esuafo dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Kyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo no tse Moses egua do:
title: MATTHEW

text: dɛm ntsi adze nyina a wɔbɛhyɛ hom no, hom ndzi do, na hom nyɛ: mbom mma hom nnyɛ hɔn ndzeyɛɛ bi: osiandɛ hɔn dze, wɔka naaso wɔnnyɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔkyekyer ndzesoadze durdur a no soa yɛ yaw na wɔdze to nyimpa kɔn ho, na hɔn dze, wɔmmpɛ dɛ wɔdze hɔn nsatseaba mpo suo mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn ndwuma nyina wɔyɛ ama nyimpa eehu: wɔyɛ dza wɔkyerɛw nyamesɛm hyɛ mu bobɔ hɔn enyim no atɛtɛr, na woyi hɔn ntar ano ndwow akɛse,
title: MATTHEW

text: na wɔpɛ mpanyin tsenabea wɔ edzidzi ase, nye mpanyin ngua wɔ nhyiamudan mu
title: MATTHEW

text: nye gua do nkyiakyia, na dɛ nyimpa bɛfrɛ hɔn Rabae (Kyerɛkyerɛfo).
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom dze, mma wɔmmfrɛ hom Rabae; na ɔbaako na ɔyɛ hom kyerɛkyerɛfo, na hom nyina yɛ enuanom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mma hom mmfrɛ obi hom egya wɔ asaase do: na ɔbaako nye hom Egya, ɔno nye nyia ɔwɔ sor no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Eso mma wɔmmfrɛ hom akwankyerɛfo: na ɔbaako nye hom kwankyerɛfo, ɔnye Kraest no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyia ɔyɛ kɛse wɔ hom mu no, ɔbɛyɛ hom somfo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara a ɔbɛma noho do no, wɔbɛbrɛ no adze, na obiara a ɔbɛbrɛ noho adze no, wɔbɛma no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom ndue! Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Na hom tow ɔsor ahenman mu wɔ nyimpa enyim, naaso homankasa hom nnkɔ mu, eso hɔn a wɔrokɔ mu no hom mma hɔn kwan mma wɔnnkɔ mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: (Hom ndue, Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Hom na hom bɔ ekunafo epoo, na hom petuw bɔ mpaa atsentsen kyerɛ: dɛm ntsi hom benya afɔdzi kɛse.)
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom ndue, Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Dɛ hom bɔ po ho nye asaase do aprɔw kɛyɛ nyimpa baako hom fɛkuwnyi; na sɛ ɔyɛ dɛm a, hom ma ɔyɛ amandzehu kurow mu ba mbɔho ebien kyɛn homankasa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom ndue! Enyifurafo akwankyerɛfo a hom se dɛ, Obiara a ɔbɛka asɔrfi no ntam no nnyɛ hwee; na obiara a ɔbɛka sika a ɔwɔ asɔrfi no mu no ho ntam dze, ɔda no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nkwasea nye enyifurafo! No mu dza ɔwɔ hen na ɔso, sika no anaa asɔrfi no a ɔtsew sika no ho no a?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obiara a ɔbɛka afɔrmbukyia no ntam no, ɔnnyɛ hwee; na obiara a ɔbɛka ayɛyɛdze a ɔwɔ do ho ntam no, ɔda no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Enyifurafo! Dza ɔwɔ hen na ɔso? Ayɛyɛdze no anaa afɔrmbukyia a ɔtsew ayɛyɛdze no ho no a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔka afɔrmbukyia no ntam no, ɔka ɔno nye dza ɔwɔ do no nyina.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyia ɔka asɔrfi ntam no, ɔka ɔno nye nyia ɔtse mu no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyia ɔka ɔsor ntam no, ɔka Nyankopɔn n’ahengua nye nyia ɔtse do no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom ndue, Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Na hom yi eme nye nunum nye mprɛgowamba mpo ho ebupɛn du du ma, naaso hom egyaa mbra no mu dza ɔsom bo yie no a ɔyɛ atsɛmbu, ehumbɔbɔr nye gyedzi no; iyi na ɔsɛ dɛ hom yɛ, ber a hom nndan nkaa no so nngya.
title: MATTHEW

text: Enyifurafo akwankyerɛfo a hom sɔn ntonton do, naaso hom men efupɔnkɔ!
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom ndue, Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Hom twuw nkɔɔpow nye mprɛtse ekyir, naaso no mu dze, apempensi nye edzifodze ahyɛ ma.
title: MATTHEW

text: Farisiinyi onyifurafo, dzi kan twuw kɔɔpow nye prɛtse mu, ama n’ekyir so eefir.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom ndue, Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Na hom tse dɛ nda a wɔahoa ho, na n’ekyir pue fɛfɛɛfɛw, na no mu dze efun mbiew ɔnye fi nyina ahyɛ ma.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛmara so naaso hom yɛ dɛ nyimpa tsenenee wɔ nyimpa enyim na hom mu dze, ndabraba nye emumuyɛ nyina ahyɛ ma.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom ndue, Akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo, ndabrabafo! Osiandɛ hom tow nkɔnhyɛfo nda do, na hom hyehyɛ nyimpa tsenenee abodan no,
title: MATTHEW

text: na hom ka dɛ, Sɛ yɛwɔ hɛn egyanom aber do a, nkyɛ yɛnye hɔn ammbɔ mu wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo no bɔgyaa ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Iyi ntsi hom dzi homho dase dɛ hɔn a wokum nkɔnhyɛfo no hɔn mba nye hom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ntsi hom nhyɛ hom egyanom etwadze no ma.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom mbowatsena, nhurutsia mba! Hom bɛyɛ dɛn eguan efi amandzehu kurow atsɛmbu no mu?
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi hwɛ, morosoma nkɔnhyɛfo nye enyansafo nye Akyerɛwfo wɔ hom hɔ, na hom boku hɔn mu bi, na hom abɔ hɔn mbeamudua mu; na hɔn mu bi so hom bɛka hɔn mpire wɔ hom nhyiamudan mu, na hom atseetsee hɔn efi kurow mu akɔ kurow mu;
title: MATTHEW

text: ma bɔgya tsenenee a wɔaka egu asaase yi do nyina eegu hom do, ofitsi tseneneenyi Abel bɔgyaa do kesi Barakia ba Zekaria a hom kum no wɔ asɔrdan nye afɔrmbukyia no ntamu no bɔgyaa do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Mese hom nokwar mu dɛ, Yinom nyina bɛba ɔsantsen yi do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ao! Jerusalɛm, Jerusalɛm, ɔwo a iku nkɔnhyɛfo no, na isiw hɔn a wɔasoma hɔn wo nkyɛn abo, mpɛn ahen na mepɛɛ dɛ moboaboa wo mba ano, dɛ mbrɛ akokɔtan boaboa ne mba ano wɔ ne ntsaban ase, naaso hom ammpɛ!
title: MATTHEW

text: Hwɛ, woegyaa wo fie ato hɔ pan ama hom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mese hom dɛ, Ofitsi sesei yi hom runnhu me ara dze akɛpem dɛ hom bɛse dɛ, Nhyira nye nyia ɔnam Ewuradze ne dzin mu reba no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus fiir edzi fii asɔrfi no mu kɔree, na n’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛkyerɛɛ no asɔrfi no aban no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnhu yinom nyina? Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Wonnkegya ɔbo kor a ɔda kor do wɔ ha a wonnkodwuruw egu famu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔko Ngo Bepɔw no do no, n’esuafo baa ne nkyɛn nsumaa mu bɛsee no dɛ, Kyerɛ hɛn aber a yinom bɛyɛ hɔ, na wo mbae nye wiadze ewiei ho asɛnkyerɛdze bɛyɛ dɛn?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie amma obi aanndaadaa hom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na dodowara bɛba wɔ me dzin mu dɛ, Emi nye Kraest no, na wɔadaadaa pii.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom bɛtse ko nye akosɛm nka: hom nhwɛ, mma hom akoma nntu, na otwar dɛ yinom nyina ba, naaso ewiei no nnyae nndurii.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔman bɔsoɛr ɔman do, na ahenman bɔsoɛr ahenman do; na ɔkɔm nye asaasewosow bɛba mbeambea.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na yinom nyina nye awoko ahyɛse.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna wobeyi hom ama ahohiahia na woeku hom, na amanaman nyina bɛtan hom wɔ me dzin ntsi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔno na ɔbɔto dodowara fintsidua, na wobeyiyi hɔnho ama, na wɔatentan hɔnho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo pii bɔsoɛr na wɔadaadaa dodowara.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na osiandɛ emumuyɛ bɔdɔɔ so ntsi, dodowara hɔn dɔ bɛyɛ mberɛw.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyia obetsim ekodu ewiei no, ɔno na wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ahenman ho asɛmpa yi, wɔbɛka wɔ wiadze nyina dze edzi amanaman nyina dase; na nkyii ewiei no bɛba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom hu amambɔe ekyiwadze a Daniel nkɔnhyɛnyi kaa ho asɛm no, dɛ ogyina krɔnkrɔnbea hɔ a (ma nyia ɔrekenkan no ntse ase)
title: MATTHEW

text: ɔno na hɔn a wɔwɔ Judea nguan nkɔ nkokwaa do:
title: MATTHEW

text: mma nyimpa a ɔwɔ dan etsifi nnsian mmbɛfa biribi mmfi ne dan mu;
title: MATTHEW

text: na nyia ɔwɔ haban mu, mma ɔnnsan n’ekyir bio mmbɛfa ne nkatado.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn a wɔafa efur, nye hɔn a wɔma numfo wɔ nda no mu ndue!
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom nsɔr ma hom eguanguanber no aammba awɔwber mu, anaa ahomgyeda;
title: MATTHEW

text: na aber no ahohiahia kɛse a ofitsi wiadze ahyɛse dze bodu aber no ɔmmba da, eso ɔremmba da, nna ɔbɛba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ woenntwa nda no do tsia a, nkyɛ honam biara nnkenya nkwa; na mpamufo ntsi wobotwa nda no do tsia.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na aber no sɛ obiara se hom dɛ, Hwɛ, Kraest no wɔ ha, anaaso, Ɔwɔ ha a, mma hom nngye nndzi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Kraest atorfo nye nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo bɔsoɛr na wɔakyerɛ asɛnkyerɛdze akɛse nye anwanwadze, ma sɛ annhwɛ a mpamufo no mpo wɔbɛdaadaa hɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hwɛ, maka akyerɛ hom ansaana edu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi, sɛ wɔse hom dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔwɔ sar no do a, mma hom mmpue nnkɔ, Hwɛ, ɔwɔ adankyir a, mma hom nngye nndzi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ enyinam nyinam fi boka, na ɔhyerɛn kɔ anee no, mbrɛ nyimpa Ba no ne mbae so bɛyɛ ara nye no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na beebiara mbrɛ fun wɔ no, hɔ na mpɛtɛ bɔboaboa hɔn ano.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ntsɛmara, nda no mu ahohia no ekyir no, ewia bɛhyɛ sum, na bosoom nnkɛma ne kan, na nworaba fi sor bɔtotɔ, na sor etum bɔwosow:
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔno na nyimpa Ba no n’asɛnkyerɛdze bopue wimu, na wiadze mbusuakuw nyina bɔkɔ ahohia kɛse mu, na wobohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔreba wɔ sor nsuwusiw do, wɔ tumdzi nye enyimnyam kɛse mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔdze totorobɛnto a ne ndze so bɔsoma n’abɔfoe, ma wɔaabɔboaboa hɔn a wɔapa mu eyi hɔn no ano efi mbrɛ mframa anan no fi ba no, efi sor ano kor akɛpem afa kor so.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nsua adɔmbadua ho bɛ no: sɛ n’abaw yɛ momon, na oriyi ahaban a, nna hom nyim dɛ ɔhyewber abɛn;
title: MATTHEW

text: dɛmara na hom so sɛ hom hu dɛ yinom nyina yɛ hɔ a, hom nhu dɛ abɛn na edu abowano.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Mbasantsen yi nnkotwa mu akɔ gyedɛ yinom nyina ayɛ hɔ ansaana.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔsor nye asaase botwa mu akɔ naaso me nsɛm dze, orunntwa mu da.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na da no nye dɔn no obiara nnyim: nnyɛ abɔfo a wɔwɔ sor no, nnyɛ Ɔba no so, na Egya no nko a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ Noa nda no yɛe no, mbrɛ nyimpa Ba no ne mbae so bɛyɛ ara nye no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ nda no a odzi nsuyirii no kan no, wodzidzii, na wɔnomee, wɔwaree, na wɔmaa awar dze kodur da a Noa kɛhyɛɛ hɛn adaka no mu no,
title: MATTHEW

text: na woennhu araa dze kodur dɛ nsuyirii no bae bɛfaa hɔn nyinara kɔree no, mbrɛ nyimpa Ba no ne mbae so bɛyɛ ara nye no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔno na nyimpa beenu wɔ haban mu a, wɔbɛfa baako na woegya kor no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Mbaa beenu bɛyam wɔ ewuyambo do, na wɔbɛfa baako na woegya kor no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nweɔn, osiandɛ hom nnyim dɔn kor a hom wura bɛba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom nhu yi dɛ, sɛ ofiwura no nyim dasu kor a owifo no bɛba a, nkyɛ ɔweɔnee, na ɔamma woemmbobubu ne dan mu annkɔ mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi hom so hom nyɛ krado, osiandɛ dɔn a hom enyi nnda mu na nyimpa Ba no reba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Afei woana nye akowaa nokwafo nye nyansafo a no wura dze no esi ne fikuw do, dɛ ɔmma hɔn edziban wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu?
title: MATTHEW

text: Nhyira aka akowaa no a, sɛ no wura ba a, obohu no dɛ ɔreyɛ dɛm,
title: MATTHEW

text: Nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔdze no besi n’adze a ɔwɔ nyina do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ akowaa bɔn se n’akoma mu dɛ, Mo wura rikyim ne ba;
title: MATTHEW

text: na sɛ ɔhyɛ ase bobɔ no nwurankowaa, na sɛ ɔnye asabokwafo dzidzi na ɔnom a,
title: MATTHEW

text: akowaa no wura bɛba da a ɔnnhwɛ no kwan, nye dɔn a onnyim mu,
title: MATTHEW

text: na oetwa no mu ebien, na ɔama ɔnye ndabrabafo edzi afora; hɔ na osu nye asetwɛr wɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna wɔdze sor ahenman no bɔto mbaabun du a wɔfaa hɔn nkandzea dɛ worikehyia ayeforkun kwan no ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn mu beenum yɛɛ mbadwemba, na beenum dze, wɔannyɛ mbadwemba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn a wɔannyɛ mbadwemba no, wɔfaa hɔn nkandzea no, wɔammfa ngo annka ho;
title: MATTHEW

text: na mbadwemba no faa ngo guu hɔn ntoa mu kaa hɔn nkandzea no ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ayeforkun no kyɛree no, hɔn nyina totɔɔ nkom na wɔdedae.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na esuom no, wɔtseaa mu dɛ, Hwɛ, ayeforkun no reba o! Hom nkɔ nkehyia no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna mbaabun no nyina soɛree na wɔkekaa hɔn nkandzea.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn a wɔannyɛ mbadwemba no see mbadwemba no dɛ, Hom mma hɛn hom ngo no bi, na hɛn nkandzea rudundum.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mbadwemba no buaa dɛ, Oho, bɛyɛ na ɔronnso hɛn nye hom; na mbom hom nkɔ hɔn a wɔtɔn no hɔ nkɔtɔ homdze.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔkɔree rokɔtɔ no, ayeforkun no bae, na hɔn a wɔayɛ krado no nye no kɔr ayefor ase, na wɔtoow abow no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ekyir no na mbaabun nkaa no so bae bɛsee dɛ, Owura, owura, bue hɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔno dze, obuaa hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, minnyim hom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nweɔn, na hom nnyim da no anaa dɔn no, (a Nyimpa ba no bɛba.)
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a ɔrodɔ mu akɔ beebi a ɔfrɛɛ no nkowaa, na ɔdze n’adze a ɔwɔ hyɛɛ hɔn nsa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔmaa baako talent enum, ɔbaako so ebien, na ɔbaako so kor, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nyina hɔn tum tse, na ɔkɔree.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ntsɛmara nyia onyaa talent enum no kɔree, na ɔdze kedzii gua, na onyaa ho talent enum so.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛmara so na nyia onyaa ebien no, onyaa ho ebien so.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyia onyaa kor no, ɔkɔree kɔbɔɔr daadze, na ɔdze no wura ne sika no sumae.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔkyɛree kyɛree no, nkowaa no hɔn wura no bae, na ɔnye hɔn bobuu nkontaa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyia onyaa talent enum no bae dze talent enum ka ho baa dɛ, Mo wura, edze talent enum hyɛɛ me nsa: hwɛ, menya ho talent enum aka ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: No wura see no dɛ, Mbo! Akowaa pa nye nokwafo, edzi ndzɛmba kumaabi ho nokwar: medze wo besi ndzɛmba pii do: kɔ wo wura dɛw mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyia onyaa talent ebien no so bae, na ɔsee dɛ, Mo wura, edze talent ebien hyɛɛ me nsa: hwɛ, menya ho talent ebien aka ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: No wura see no dɛ, Mbo! Akowaa pa nye nokwafo, edzi ndzɛmba kumaabi ho nokwar, medze wo besi ndzɛmba pii do: kɔ wo wura dɛw mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyia onyaa talent kor no so bae bɛsee dɛ, Mo wura, minyim wo dɛ eyɛ nyimpa a eyɛ dzen a itwa wɔ mbrɛ innduae, na eboaboa ano wɔ mbrɛ emmfae mmpetsee;
title: MATTHEW

text: na musuroi, na mokɔree, na medze wo talent no kosumaa daadze: hwɛ, w’adze nye yi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na no wura buae see no dɛ, Akowaa bɔn nye kwadwefo, inyim dɛ mutwa wɔ mbrɛ munnduae, na moboaboa ano wɔ mbrɛ memmfae mmpetsee:
title: MATTHEW

text: dɛm ntsi nkyɛ ɔsɛ wo dɛ edze me sika kɛma sikasesafo, na meba a, mabɛgye m’adze nye no ho nsiho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi, hom ngye talent no wɔ ne nsamu, na hom mfa mma nyia ɔwɔ talent du no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Osiandɛ obiara a ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no na oenya mbordo; na nyia onnyi no, dza ɔwɔ no mpo, wɔbɛgye ne nsamu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na akowaa a no ho nnyi mfaso no dze, hom ntow no nkyen ekyirekyir sum no mu: hɔ na osu nye asetwɛr wɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na aber a nyimpa Ba no bɛba wɔ n’enyimnyam mu, na n’abɔfoe no nyina ka no ho no, nna ɔbɛtsena n’enyimnyam ahengua no do;
title: MATTHEW

text: na wɔbɔboaboa amanaman nyina ano wɔ n’enyim, na ɔbɛpaapaa hɔn mu dɛ mbrɛ oguanhwɛfo paapaa nguan nye mpɔnkye mu;
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔdze nguan no begyina n’enyimfa, na ɔdze mpɔnkye no egyina n’abankum.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Ɔhen no bɛse hɔn a wɔwɔ n’enyimfa no dɛ, Hom mbra, hom a m’Egya ehyira hom, hom mbɛfa ahenman a wofitsi wiadze ahyɛse siesiei maa hom no ntsena mu:
title: MATTHEW

text: osiandɛ ɔkɔm dzee me, na hom maa me edziban; nsukɔm dzee me, na hom maa me anondze; meyɛɛ hɔho, na hom faa me kɔr fie;
title: MATTHEW

text: midzii adagyaw, na hom furaa me tam; meyaree, na hom bɔhwɛɛ me; medaa efiadze na hom baa me nkyɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔno na atsenenee no bobua ase no dɛ, Ewuradze, dabɛn na yehun wo dɛ ɔkɔm dze wo, na yɛmaa wo edziban, anaa nsukɔm dze wo, na yɛmaa wo anondze?
title: MATTHEW

text: Dabɛn na yehun wo dɛ eyɛ hɔho na yɛfaa wo kɔr fie, anaa idzi adagyaw, na yefuraa wo tam?
title: MATTHEW

text: Anaa dabɛn na yehun wo dɛ eyar anaa eda efiadze, na yɛbaa wo nkyɛn?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Ɔhen no bobua ase hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Susuampa dɛ hom ayɛ ama mo nuanom nketseaba yi mu kor no, hom ayɛ ama me.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔno na ɔbɛse hɔn a wɔwɔ bankum no so dɛ, Hom a wɔadom hom, hom mfi me nkyɛn nkɔ onnyiewiei gya a woesiesie ama abɔnsam nye n’abɔfoe no no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Osiandɛ ɔkɔm dzee me, na hom amma me edziban; nsukɔm dzee me, na hom amma me anondze;
title: MATTHEW

text: meyɛɛ hɔho, na hom ammfa me annkɔ fie; midzii adagyaw, na hom emmfura me tam; meyaree na medaa efiadze, na hom ammbɔhwɛ me.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔno na hɔn so bobua ase dɛ, Ewuradze, dabɛn na yehun wo dɛ ɔkɔm dze wo, anaa nsukɔm dze wo, anaa eyɛ hɔho, anaa idzi adagyaw, anaa eyar, anaa eda efiadze, na yɛannsom wo?
title: MATTHEW

text: Ɔno na obobua hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Susuampa dɛ hom annyɛ amma hom nuanom nketseaba yi mu kor no, hom annyɛ amma me.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na yinom bɔkɔ onnyiewiei amandzehu no mu, na atsenenee no bɔkɔ onnyiewiei nkwa no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Jesus wiee nsɛm yi nyina ka no, ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nyim dɛ aka nda ebien ma apaho no edu, na woribeyi nyimpa Ba no ama, ma wɔaabɔ no mbeamudua mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna asɔfompanyin nye ɔman mpanyimfo no kehyiaa ɔsɔfopanyin a wɔfrɛ no Kaiafas n’aban mu,
title: MATTHEW

text: na wotuu egyina wɔ mbrɛ wɔnam nyansa mu bɛkyer Jesus eku no ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: na wɔsee dɛ, Nnyɛ afahyɛ mu bi a, amma wentwiwentwi aammba ɔman no mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ber a Jesus wɔ Bɛtani wɔ Simon kwatanyi no ne fie no,
title: MATTHEW

text: ɔbaa bi a ɔdze ngohuam a ɔsom bo alabastron toa ma baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔtse edzidzi no, obohuei guu n’etsifi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na esuafo no hunii no, wonyaa ebufuw na wɔsee dɛ, Adzesɛɛ a ɔtse dɛm yi ase nye dɛn?
title: MATTHEW

text: Nkyɛ wɔbɔtɔn ngohuam yi agye sika pii na wɔdze akyɛ ehiafo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus tsee no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rehaw ɔbaa no? Na ɔayɛ edwuma pa wɔ mo ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom wɔ ehiafo wɔ hom nkyɛn daa; na emi dze, hom nnyi me daa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na dɛ oehue ngohuam yi egu me nyimpadua do yi, ɔayɛ ama me nsiei.
title: MATTHEW

text: Meka no nokwar kyerɛ hom dɛ, Beebiara a wɔbɛka asɛmpa yi wɔ wiadze nyina mu no, dza ɔbaa yi ayɛ so wɔbɛka dze ayɛ ne nkaa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna duebien no mu kor a wɔfrɛ no Judas Iskariot no kɔr asɔfompanyin no hɔ,
title: MATTHEW

text: na ɔkɛsee hɔn dɛ, Hom bɛma me ebɛnadze ma meeyi no ama hom? Na wokeer ndwetɛbona eduasa maa no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ofitsi aber no, ɔhwehwɛɛ mbrɛ obenya kwan eyi no ama.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na epitsi afahyɛ da a odzi kan no, esuafo no baa Jesus nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Hen na epɛ dɛ yesiesie ma ikedzi apaho no?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nkɔ kurow no mu osimesi no hɔ, na hom nkɛse no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo no se, Me ber abɛn: wo fie na menye m’esuafo bedzi apaho no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na esuafo no kɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ Jesus hyɛɛ hɔn no na wosiesiee apaho no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na odur ewimbir no, ɔnye esuafo duebien no bɛtsenaa edzidzii.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na woridzidzi no, ɔsee dɛ, Ampa, mese hom dɛ, Hom mu baako beyi me ama.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn awerɛhow pii, na wɔhyɛɛ ase see no nkorkor dɛ, Ewuradze, ana emi a?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na obuae see dɛ, Nyia ɔnye me to nsa wɔ ɔsɛn no mu no, ɔnoara na obeyi me ama.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyimpa Ba no rokɔ, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ no ho: mbom nyimpa a wɔnam no do beyi nyimpa Ba no ama no ndue! Sɛ wɔannwo dɛm nyimpa no a, nkyɛ oye ma no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Judas a oriyi no ama no buae see dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ana emi a? Ɔsee no dɛ, Aka.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na woridzidzi no, Jesus faa paanoo na ohyiraa do na obubui, na ɔdze maa n’esuafo no na ɔsee dɛ, Hom ngye ndzi: iyi nye me nyimpadua.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔfaa kɔɔpow, na ɔdaa ase, na ɔdze maa hɔn dɛ, Hom nyinara nnom bi:
title: MATTHEW

text: na iyi nye mo bɔgyaa a ɔyɛ ahyɛmu no dze a dodowara ntsi woruhue egu ama bɔnfakyɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mese hom dɛ, Ofitsi ndɛ, moronnom wenyinaba yi bio dze ekesi da no a menye hom bɔnom no fofor wɔ m’Egya n’ahenman no mu no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔtoow ndwom no, wopuei kɔr Ngo Bepɔw no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Mo ho bɛyɛ hom nyina fintsidua anadwe yi: na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Mobɔbɔ oguanhwɛfo no, na kuw no mu nguan nyina abɔ apetse.
title: MATTHEW

text: Naaso me nyan ekyir no mibedzi hom enyim akɔ Galilii.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Peter buae see no dɛ, Sɛ wo ho bɛyɛ hɔn nyina fintsidua a, emi dze, ɔnnkɛyɛ me fintsidua.
title: MATTHEW

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Meka kyerɛ wo wɔ nokwar mu dɛ, Anadwe yi, ansaana akokɔ bɔbɔn no, ebɛpa me mprɛnsa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Peter see no dɛ, Sɛ menye wo bowu mpo a, meremmpa wo da; na dɛmara na hɔn nyina so kae.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Jesus nye hɔn baa beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Getsemane, na ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, Hom ntsena ha ma monkɔ noho monkɔsɔr.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔfaa Peter nye Zebedee mba beenu no kaa no ho, na no werɛ hyɛɛ ase howee, na ɔbɔmee.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Awerɛhow ahyɛ me kra no do dze kɔ owu mu: hom ntsena ha na hom nye me nweɔn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔkɔr enyim kakra na ɔdze n’enyim kobutuwii, na ɔbɔɔ mpaa dɛ, Egya, sɛ ɔbɛyɛ a, ma kɔɔpow yi mpa mo ho nkɔ: naaso nnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ mepɛ bi a, na mbrɛ ɔwo epɛ a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔbaa esuafo no nkyɛn, na obohun dɛ wɔdeda, na ɔsee Peter dɛ, Aso hom enntum nye me annweɔn dɔnhwer kor mpo?
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nweɔn na hom nsɔr, mma hom aannkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu: sunsum pɛ dze, na honam yɛ mberɛw.
title: MATTHEW

text: Bio, ɔkɔr ne mpɛn ebien kɔsɔɔr dɛ, M’Egya, sɛ kɔɔpow yi nnkɛpa mo ho akɔ gyedɛ monom a, wo pɛ nyɛ hɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔbae no, obohun dɛ wɔadeda bio, osiandɛ hɔn enyiwa akom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ogyaa hɔn hɔ kɔr bio kɔsɔɔr ne mprɛnsa kaa asɛm kor no ara.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ɔbaa esuafo no nkyɛn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Na hom da ho da regye hom ahom? Hwɛ, dɔn no abɛn, na Nyimpa Ba no, woeyi no ahyɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo nsa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Hom nsoɛr ma yɛnkɔ: hwɛ, nyia oriyi me ama no abɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔda do rekasa no, hwɛ, Judas a ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako no, bae, na nyimpadodow pii a wɔdzedze nkrantsee nye mpɔtsibaa fi asɔfompanyin nye ɔman mu mpanyimfo no hɔ ka no ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nyia oyii no mae no maa hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze dɛ, Nyia mebɛfew n’ano no, ɔno nye no: hom nkyer no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ntsɛmara ɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn na ɔsee dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, o! Na ɔfeew n’ano.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Damfo, yɛ dza ɔnam do ma aba. Nna wɔbae dze hɔn nsa bosusuoo no mu, na wɔkyekyeer no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hwɛ, hɔn a wɔnye Jesus nam no mu baako tseen ne nsa twee ne nkrantsee, na ɔdze bɔɔ ɔsɔfopanyin no n’akowaa n’aso twae.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Jesus see no dɛ, Fa wo nkrantsee hyɛ ne hyɛbea bio, na hɔn a wɔtwe nkrantsee nyina, nkrantsee anomu na wɔbɔtotɔr.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ana edwen dɛ murunntum mennserɛ m’Egya ma mprɛmprɛ ara ɔnnsoma abɔfo a wɔbɔbor asafokuw duebien?
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna dɛm a, kyerɛwnsɛm no bɛyɛ dɛn aba mu dɛ otwar dɛ ɔyɛ dɛm?
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɔn no ara mu na Jesus see nyimpadodow no dɛ, Ana hom firii baa mo do dɛ owifo do, na hom dze nkrantsee nye mpɔtsibaa rebɛkyer me yi? Daa nna metse asɔrfi mu rekyerɛkyerɛ no, hom annkyer me.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na yinom nyina yɛe ma nkɔnhyɛfo no kyerɛwnsɛm no aaba mu. Nna esuafo no nyina gyaa no hɔ, na woguanee.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn a wɔkyeer Jesus no dze no kɔr Kaiafas ɔsɔfopanyin no nkyɛn, mbrɛ kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no ehyia.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Peter dzii n’ekyir wɔ ekyirekyir dze kodur ɔsɔfopanyin n’abanguado, na ɔkɛhɛɛn mu nye asomfo no kɛtsenaa hɔ dɛ ɔrohwɛ dza obesi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na asɔfompanyin nye baguafo no nyina hwehwɛɛ Jesus ho dasekrum dze eku no:
title: MATTHEW

text: na adasetorfo pii bae naaso woennya bi. Na ekyir no beenu bae.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Oyi kaa dɛ, Mubotum medwuruw Nyankopɔn asɔrdan no na mesi no ndaansa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsɔfopanyin no gyinae na ɔsee no dɛ, Irummbua bi? Ebɛnadze na yinom ridzi dase tsia wo yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus muaa n’ano. Na ɔsɔfopanyin no see no dɛ, Meka tsease Nyankopɔn dɛ sɛ ɔwo nye Kraest no, Nyankopɔn ba no a, ka kyerɛ hɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Aka: eso mese wo dɛ, Ofi ndɛ hom bohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔtse tum no nsa nyimfa, na ɔreba wɔ sor nsuwusiw do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ɔsɔfopanyin no sunsuaan n’atar mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔaka ebususɛm: ebɛn hia na ohia hɛn adasefo bio? Hwɛ, afei hom atse ebususɛm no:
title: MATTHEW

text: hom dwen dɛn? Wobuae see dɛ Ɔsɛ owu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna wohinaa n’enyi do ntafi, na wɔbobɔɔ no ekutuku, na binom so bobɔɔ no asotɔr dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Kraest, kyerɛ hɛn! Woana na ɔbɔɔ wo?
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Peter dze, ɔtse abangua no do hɔ; na abaawa bi baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, Ɔwo so enye Jesus Galiliinyi no nam.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsanee wɔ hɔn nyina enyim dɛ, Minnyim dza ereka yi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ofiir edzi kɔr paado no, abaawa bi so hun no, na ɔsee hɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ no dɛ, Oyi so nye Jesus Nazarɛtnyi no nam.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na bio ɔdze ntanka saan dɛ, Minnyim nyimpa no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔkyɛɛr kakra no hɔn a wogyina hɔ no bae bɛsee Peter dɛ, Ampa dɛ ifi hɔn mu, na wo kasaa yi wo edzi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii nsew na ɔkekaa ntam dɛ, Minnyim nyimpa no. Na ntsɛmara na akokɔ bɔnee.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Peter kaa Jesus n’asɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Ansaana akokɔ bɔbɔn no, na apa me mprɛnsa. Na ofiir edzi, na okosuu yayaayaw.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na adze kyee no, asɔfompanyin nye ɔman mpanyimfo no nyina faa Jesus ho apam dɛ woboku no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔkyekyeer no dze no kɔree kɛhyɛɛ ambrado Pilate nsa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Judas a oyii no mae no, ohun dɛ woebu no fɔ no, onuu no ho, na ɔdze ndwetɛbona eduasa no brɛɛ asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Mayɛ bɔn dɛ meyi bɔgya a onndzi fɔ ama. Na wobuaa dɛ, Ɔfa hɛn ho bɛn? Woara w’asɛm a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔtoow ndwetɛbona no guu asɔrdan no mu, na osii mu kɔree kɛsɛɛn ne men.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na asɔfompanyin no faa ndwetɛbona no na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔmmfa mbra mu dɛ wɔdze to ayɛyɛdze adaka no mu, osiandɛ ɔyɛ bɔgya ho sika.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔfaa apam, na wɔdze kɛgyee ɔwemfo asaase no, ama woeesie ahɔho wɔ mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi asaase no, wɔfrɛ no bɔgya asaase dze bodu ndɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Jeremia kae no baa mu dɛ, Na wɔfaa ndwetɛbona eduasa no, nyia wodzii ne tsir bo no no bo a Israelmba mu binom twae no,
title: MATTHEW

text: na wɔdze gyee ɔwemfo asaase no, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze hyɛɛ me no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus gyinaa ambrado no enyim; na ambrado no bisaa no dɛ, Ana Jewfo Hen nye wo a? Na Jesus see no dɛ, Aka.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no toatoaa no, naaso oemmbua hwee.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Pilate see no dɛ, Ana enntse ndzɛmba pii a woridzi ho dase tsia wo yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Naaso oemmbua no wɔ asɛm kor mpo ho, ma ɔyɛɛ ambrado no nwanwa kɛse.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna afahyɛ du a, ambrado no tɔ dɛ ogyaa daduanyi kor a wɔpɛ ma nyimpadodow no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna wɔwɔ daduanyi bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Barabbas.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi wobehyiae no, Pilate bisaa hɔn dɛ, Woana na hom pɛ dɛ migyaa no ma hom? Barabbas anaa Jesus a wɔfrɛ no Kraest no a?
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna onyim dɛ enyitan ntsi na woyii no mae.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔtse atsɛmbu egua do no, ne yer somaa obi wɔ ne nkyɛn dɛ, Mma ennye nyimpa tsenenee no nndzi asɛm bi, na ɔno ntsi mehu amandze pii wɔ adaaso mu ndɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no wee guu nyimpadodow no aso mu dɛ wombisa Barabbas, na wonku Jesus.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ambrado no bisaa hɔn dɛ, Hɔn beenu yi mu woana na hom pɛ dɛ migyaa no ma hom? Wɔsee dɛ, Barabbas a.
title: MATTHEW

text: Pilate see hɔn dɛ, Na Jesus a wɔfrɛ no Kraest no, menyɛ no dɛn? Hɔn nyina see dɛ, Ma wɔmbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛn bɔn na ɔayɛ? Na wɔtseatseaa mu mbordo dɛ, Ma wɔmbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
title: MATTHEW
