text: Na Pilate hun dɛ onntum nnyɛ ho hwee, na mbom wentwiwentwi reba no, ɔfaa nsu hohoor ne nsa ho wɔ nyimpadodow no enyim see dɛ, Minndzi so wɔ nyimpa tsenenee yi no bɔgyaa ho: homara hom asɛm.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔman no nyina buae see dɛ, No bɔgyaa ngu hɛn nye hɛn mba etsifi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ogyaa Barabbas maa hɔn, na Jesus dze, ɔkaa no mpire no, oyii no mae dɛ wɔnkɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna ambrado no no nsordaafo no faa Jesus kɔr ambrado aban mu hɔ, na wohyiahyiaa nsordaafokuw no nyina baa ne nkyɛn.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔpɔɔr n’atar, na wɔdze atar memen hyɛɛ no,
title: MATTHEW

text: na wɔween nsoɛ katraka dze hyɛɛ ne tsir, na wɔdze ndzɛmbir hyɛɛ ne nsa nyimfa mu, na wobuu ntwɛr wɔ n’enyim, na wosii no atwetwe dɛ, Jewfo Hen, o!
title: MATTHEW

text: Wohinahinaa ntafi guu no do, na wɔgyee ndzɛmbir no na wɔdze bɔɔ n’etsifi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wowiee no atwetwe si no, wɔpɔɔr atar no wɔ no ho, na wɔdze nankasa n’atar hyɛɛ no, na wɔdze no kɔree dɛ wɔrokɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na worupue akɔ no, wohun Sirenenyi bi a ne dzin dze Simon: ɔno na wɔhyɛɛ no dɛ ɔnsoa ne mbeamudua no nye hɔn nkɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wokodur beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Golgota, ɔnye dɛ Tsikwankora Bea no,
title: MATTHEW

text: wɔmaa no wenyin a wɔdze bɔwema afora mu dɛ ɔnnom; na ɔkaa n’ano no ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔnom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no, wɔtwee tonto kyɛɛ n’atar; (ama dza nkɔnhyɛnyi no kae no aba mu dɛ, Na wɔkyɛɛ m’atar mu maa hɔn ho, na wɔtwee me ntar ho tonto.)
title: MATTHEW

text: na wɔtsenatsenaa ase weɔɔn no wɔ hɔ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔdze n’ewusi a wɔkyerɛwee no faam n’etsifi dɛ, OYI NYE JESUS JEWFO HEN NO.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔbɔɔ edwotwafo beenu mbeamudua mu kaa no ho, ɔbaako wɔ n’enyimfa, ɔbaako wɔ n’abankum.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn a worutwa mu no dzii no nsɛmbɔn, na wɔwosowosoow hɔn tsir
title: MATTHEW

text: see dɛ, Ɔwo a idwuruw asɔrdan no na isi no ndaansa, gye woho; sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba no a, fi mbeamudua ho si famu ɛ!
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛmara so na asɔfompanyin no nye kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no sii no atwetwe see dɛ,
title: MATTHEW

text: Oyi gyee binom: naaso onntum nngye nankasa noho. Ɔno nye Israel Hen no: wɔmma omfi mbeamudua no ho nsi famu, na yɛbɛgye no edzi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nyew, ɔdze noho atwer Nyankopɔn: sɛ Nyankopɔn pɛ a, wɔmma ɔngye no, osiandɛ ɔnoara see dɛ, Nyankopɔn Ba nye me.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛmara na edwotwafo no a wɔbɔɔ hɔn nye no mbeamudua mu no so yaaw no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ofi bɛyɛ ewiaber duebien ber no, sum hyɛɛ asaase nyina do kesii ndɔnebiasa ber no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na bɛyɛ ndɔnebiasa no, Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu dɛ, Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani? Ɔno nye dɛ, Me Nyankopɔn, me Nyankopɔn, ɔyɛ dɛn na apa me yi?
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hɔn a wogyinaa hɔ binom tsee no, wɔsee dɛ, Oyi refrɛ Elija.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ntsɛmara hɔn mu baako tuu mbirika kɛfaa posaa dze kɔbɔɔ wenyin yerɛyerɛw mu, na ɔdze tuaa ndzɛmbir ano maa no dɛ ɔnnom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na nkaa no see dɛ, Gyaa ma yɛnhwɛ dɛ Elija bɛba abɛgye no anaa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu bio no, ogyaa no sunsum mu.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hwɛ, asɔrdan no mu ntwamutam no tseew ebien fi sor besii ase, na asaase wosowee, na abotan paapaae,
title: MATTHEW

text: na ahotseweefo a wɔadeda dodowara hɔn efun nyanyanee,
title: MATTHEW

text: na wofi nda no mu puepuei wɔ ne nyan no ekyir no, wɔkɔr kurow krɔnkrɔn no mu keyii hɔnho kyerɛɛ dodowara.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔhamupanyin no nye hɔn a wɔka no ho roweɔn Jesus no hun asaasewosow no nye ndzɛmba a ɔyɛe no, wosuroo pii na wɔsee dɛ, Ampaara, Nyankopɔn Ba nye yi.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na mbaa dodowara wɔ hɔ a wogyinaa ekyir hwɛe, woyinom na wɔkaa Jesus do fiir Galilii na wɔsoom no;
title: MATTHEW

text: na Mary Magdalene, nye James nye Joses hɔn na Mary, nye Zebedee mba no hɔn na ka hɔn ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na odur ewimbir no, ɔhonyanyi bi a ofi Arimatea a wɔfrɛ no Josef a noara so yɛ Jesus no suanyi bae;
title: MATTHEW

text: ɔno na ɔkɔr Pilate hɔ kɛserɛɛ Jesus no fun. Nna Pilate hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa mma no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Josef faa fun no dze bobɔɔw ndwera a n’enyi tsew mu,
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔdze too nankasa ne nda fofor a otwaa no ɔbotan mu no mu, na opireew ɔbo kɛse hiin nda no ano, na ɔkɔree.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Mary Magdalene nye Mary baako no so wɔ hɔ, na wɔtsenatsena nda no enyim.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na adze kyee a ɔyɛ da a odzi Ahosiesieda no ekyir no, asɔfompanyin nye Farisiifo no behyiae wɔ Pilate nkyɛn
title: MATTHEW

text: bɛsee dɛ, Hɛn wura, yɛkaa dɛ ɔdaadaafo no tse ase no, ɔkaa dɛ, Ndaansa ekyir mibenyan.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi ka ma wɔnkɛhyɛ nda no nsew nkodu da a otsia ebiasa no, amma n’esuafo aammba emmbowia no, na wɔaannse ɔman no dɛ, Oenyan efi ewufo mu; ɔno ekyir nsɛmansɛma no bɛsen kan dze no koraa.
title: MATTHEW

text: Pilate see hɔn dɛ, Hom wɔ aweɔmfo: hom nkɔ nkɛhyɛ no nsew dɛ mbrɛ hom botum.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔkɔree, na wɔkɛhyɛɛ nda no nsew: wɔsɔɔw ɔbo no ano, nna aweɔmfo no ka hɔn ho.
title: MATTHEW

text: Ahomgyeda no twaa mu, na da a odzi dapɛn no kan no enyim retsetsew no, Mary Magdalene nye Mary baako no baa dɛ wɔrobɔhwɛ nda no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hwɛ, asaase wosoow kɛse papaapa, na Ewuradze bɔfoe fi sor sianee na ɔbae bepireew ɔbo no fii nda no ano, na ɔtsenaa do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na no ho tse dɛ enyinam, na n’efuradze hoa dɛ esukwankyɛba.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na no ho hu ntsi hɔn a wɔroweɔn no ho popoe, na wɔyɛɛ dɛ ewufo.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na ɔbɔfo no buae see mbaa no dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro, na minyim dɛ hom rohwehwɛ Jesus a wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Onnyi ha: na ɔasoɛr dɛ mbrɛ ɔkae no: hom mbra mbɔhwɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze dae.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hom nkɔ ntsɛm nkɛka nkyerɛ n’esuafo no dɛ, Ɔasoɛr efi ewufo mu; na hwɛ, oedzi hom enyim kɔ Galilii: hɔ na hom bohu no; hwɛ, maka akyerɛ hom.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wofiir edzi ntsɛm fii nda no ho dze suro nye dɛw kɛse tutuu mbirika dɛ wɔrekɛka akyerɛ n’esuafo no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na hwɛ, Jesus hyiaa hɔn see hɔn dɛ, Mema hom mbo na yɛ o! Na wɔbaa bosusuoo n’anan mu, na wɔkotoow no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Nna Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro; hom nkɔ nkɛka nkyerɛ mo nuanom dɛ wɔnkɔ Galilii, na hɔ na wobohu me.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔrokɔ no, hwɛ, aweɔmfo no mu binom baa kurow no mu bɛkaa nsɛm a esi no nyina kyerɛɛ asɔfompanyin no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔnye mpanyimfo no hyiae na wɔfaa apam no, wɔmaa nsordaafo no sika kɛse,
title: MATTHEW

text: na wɔsee dɛ, Hom nka dɛ, Anadwe a yɛdae no nna n’esuafo bae bowiaa no.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na sɛ iyi du ambrado asomu a, yebotu n’aso esuma, na yɛamma annyɛ hom do asɛm.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wɔgyee sika no, na wɔkɛyɛɛ dɛ mbrɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn no; na asɛm yi tahyee wɔ Jewfo mu dze bodu ndɛ.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na esuafo dubiako no sii mu kɔr Galilii, wɔ kokwaa a Jesus kyerɛɛ hɔn no do.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na wohun no no, wɔkotoow no; na binom gyee ekyingye.
title: MATTHEW

text: Na Jesus bɛkasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Wɔdze sor nye asaase do tum nyina ama me.
title: MATTHEW

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nkɔ nkɛyɛ amanaman nyina m’esuafo, na hom nnuma hɔn nhyɛ Egya, nye Ɔba, nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn dzin mu;
title: MATTHEW

text: na hom nkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn dɛ wondzi dza mahyɛ hom nyina do: na hwɛ, menye hom wɔ hɔ daa, dze kesi wiadze ewiei.
title: MATTHEW

text: Jesus Kraest, [Nyankopɔn Ba] no, ne nsɛmpa no ahyɛse.
title: MARK

text: Dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia mu dɛ, Hwɛ, morosoma mo bɔfoe ma oeedzi w’enyim kan, Obesiesie wo kwan mu;
title: MARK

text: Obi ne ndze retsea mu wɔ sar no do dɛ, Hom nsiesie Ewuradze no kwan, Hom mma n’atsempɔn ntsentsen;
title: MARK

text: John bae bonumae wɔ sar no do na ɔpaa mu kaa nnuho enuma a ɔdze kɔ bɔnfakyɛ mu no ho asɛm.
title: MARK

text: Na Judea man nyina, na Jerusalɛmfo nyina puee kɔr no hɔ kɛkaa hɔn bɔn, na onumaa hɔn wɔ Esutsen Jordan mu.
title: MARK

text: Nna John fura efupɔnkɔnhwi tam na nwoma abɔdo bɔ n’asen, na odzi mbɛbɛw na kwaa mu ewo.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔpaa mu kaa dɛ, Obi a no ho yɛ dzen kyɛn me dzi m’ekyir reba a no nsokota ho ahoma mpo mennsɛ dɛ mobɔkotow masan.
title: MARK

text: Emi dze, munumaa hom nsu mu, na ɔno, dze, obonuma hom wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu no Jesus fii Galilii Nazarɛt bae, na John numaa no wɔ Esutsen Jordan mu.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara a ofi nsu no mu reba no, ohun dɛ sor apaa ebien na Sunsum no tse dɛ ebubur risian ba no do:
title: MARK

text: na ndze bi fii sor baa dɛ, Ɔwo nye mo Dɔba a esɔ m’enyi.
title: MARK

text: Na amonmu hɔ ara na Sunsum no faa no ɔhardo kɔr sar no do.
title: MARK

text: Na odzii sar no do hɔ adaduanan, ma Satan sɔɔ no hwɛe; nna ɔnye hambowa wɔ hɔ; na abɔfo no soom no.
title: MARK

text: Na afei woyii John mae no ekyir no, Jesus baa Galilii bɛkaa Nyankopɔn ho asɛmpa no, na ɔsee dɛ,
title: MARK

text: Aber no aso na Nyankopɔn ahenman no abɛn: hom nnu homho, na hom ngye asɛmpa no ndzi.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔnenam Galilii po ho no, ohun Simon nye Simon no nua Andrew dɛ wɔrotow eboa wɔ po mu, osiandɛ wɔyɛ apofo.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom mbedzi m’ekyir na mebɛma hom ayɛ nyimpa enufo.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara wɔdaan eboa no gyaae na wobedzii n’ekyir.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkɔr enyim kakra no, ohun James, Zebedee ne ba no, ɔnye no nua John a hɔn so wɔwɔ hɛn mu resa hɔn mboa.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara ɔfrɛɛ hɔn; na wɔdaan hɔn egya Zebedee nye apaafo no gyaa hɛn no mu, na wokedzii n’ekyir.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔkɔr Karpernaum; na ntsɛmara ahomgyeda no ɔkɛhɛɛn nhyiamudan no mu kɛkyerɛkyerɛe.
title: MARK

text: Na ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛɛ hɔn ahobow, osiandɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ nyia ɔwɔ tum, na ɔnntse dɛ kyerɛwfo no.
title: MARK

text: Ber no ara mu no, nna nyimpa bi wɔ nhyiamudan no mu a ɔwɔ sunsum fi;
title: MARK

text: na ɔtseaa mu see dɛ, Ebɛnadze na yɛnye wo wɔ yɛ, Jesus Nazarɛtnyi? Ana ebae dɛ erebɛsɛɛ hɛn? Minyim wo nyimpa ban, Nyankopɔn no Hotseweenyi no a.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus bɔɔ no ham dɛ, Ka w’ano to mu, na fi no mu fi!
title: MARK

text: Na sunsum fi no twaa no hwee hɔ na ɔkaa mu kɛse fii no mu firii.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn nyina ho boow hɔn ara ma wobisabisaa hɔnho dɛ, Ebɛnadze nye yi? Nkyerɛkyerɛ fofor bɛn a! Ɔdze tum hyɛ esunsum fi mpo, na wotsie n’asɛm.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara ne nka tahyee ɔman a etwa Galilii ho nyina mu.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara wofii nhyiamudan no mu firii no wɔbaa Simon nye Andrew fie, wɔnye James nye John.
title: MARK

text: Nna Simon n’asew da hɔ yar papu; na ntsɛmara wɔkaa no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no;
title: MARK

text: na Jesus kosuoo ne nsamu maa no do; na papu no fii no do, na ɔhyɛɛ ase soom hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na ewimbir a ewia kɔtɔree no wɔdze hɔn a wɔyaryar na hɔn a mbɔnsam afa hɔn nyina brɛɛ no.
title: MARK

text: Na kurow no nyina behyiaa mu wɔ abow no ano.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsaa dodowara a wɔwɔ nyarba horow no yarba, na otuu mbɔnsam pii; na ɔamma mbɔnsam no kwan dɛ wɔnkasa, osiandɛ wonyim no.
title: MARK

text: Na anapaatu, ansaana adze rebɛkye no, ɔsoɛree na opuei kɔr sar bi do, na ɔkɔbɔɔ mpaa wɔ hɔ.
title: MARK

text: Na Simon nye hɔn a wɔka no ho no, tsiiw no;
title: MARK

text: na wohun no na wɔsee no dɛ, Nyimpa nyina rohwehwɛ wo.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma yɛnkɔ nkurow nkaa no so mu, ama maakɛka asɛm no wɔ hɔ so, osiandɛ iyi ntsi na mebae.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkɔr hɔn nhyiamudan a ɔwɔ Galilii nyina mu kɛkaa asɛm no, na otuu mbɔnsam.
title: MARK

text: Na kwatanyi bi baa no hɔ bɛserɛɛ no, bɔkotoow no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ epɛ a, ibotum dɛ ema mo ho san.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus ne yamu hyehyee no maa no, na ɔtseen ne nsa dze kaa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Mepɛ, wo ho nsan wo.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara na kwata no fii no ho, ma no ho sanee.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus braa no dzendzenndzen, na ɔmaa ofii hɔ ntsɛmara, na ɔsee no dɛ,
title: MARK

text: Hwɛ ma aannka biribi annkyerɛ obiara; na san kɔ, fa woho kɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no, na w’ahosan ntsi kotua dza Moses hyɛe no fa yɛ dase ma hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔno dze, ɔdze kɛtahyee pii, na ɔmaa asɛm no trɛe, ma dɛm ntsi Jesus enntum annkɔ kurow bi mu petee bio, mbom sar do hɔ beebi na ɔtsenae; na wofii mbea nyina baa ne nkyɛn.
title: MARK

text: Nda kakra bi ekyir no, ɔkɔr Karpernaum bio, na wɔtsee dɛ ɔwɔ fie.
title: MARK

text: Na dodowara behyiaa mu, ma nna wonnya kwan bio mma hɔn, nnyɛ abowano hɔ mpo; na ɔkaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔdze mbubuinyi a nyimpa baanan so no baa no hɔ.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔnam nyimpadodow no ntsi na wonnya kwan nntwe mmbɛn no no, wɔkɛpaa dan a ɔwɔ mu no etsifi; na wotuu mu tu na wɔdze kɛtɛ a mbubuinyi no da do no duaa mu gyaagyaa mu sii famu.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus hun hɔn gyedzi no, ɔsee mbubuinyi no dɛ, Ɔba, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo.
title: MARK

text: Nna kyerɛwfo no binom tsetse hɔ, na wɔdwendween hɔn akoma mu dɛ,
title: MARK

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn na oyi kasa dɛm yi? Ebususɛm na ɔka: woana botum dze bɔn akyɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn nkotsee?
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara Jesus hun wɔ no sunsum mu dɛ wɔrodwendwen dɛm wɔ hɔn akoma mu no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rodwendwen dɛm wɔ hom akoma mu yi?
title: MARK

text: Dza ɔwɔ hen na ɔyɛ mberɛw kɛse, dɛ ebɛse mbubuinyi no dɛ, Wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo, anaa ebɛse dɛ, Soɛr, fa wo kɛtɛ, na nantsew, a?
title: MARK

text: Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma hom ehu dɛ nyimpa Ba no wɔ tum wɔ asaase do dɛ ɔdze bɔn kyɛ ntsi, ɔsee mbubuinyi no dɛ,
title: MARK

text: Mese wo dɛ, Soɛr, fa wo kɛtɛ na kɔ wo fie.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsoɛree, na ntsɛmara ɔfaa kɛtɛ no, na osii mu wɔ hɔn nyina enyim kɔree. Na ɔmaa hɔn nyina ho boow hɔn, na wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam dɛ, Yennhun dɛm adze yi bi da.
title: MARK

text: Na opuee bio kɔr mpoano; na nyimpadodow no nyina kɔr no hɔ, na ɔhyɛɛ ase kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔresen no ohun Alfaeus ne ba Levi dɛ ɔtse atowgyebea, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ka mo do. Na ɔsoɛree kaa no do.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔtse edzidzi wɔ ne fie no; atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo pii nye Jesus na n’esuafo bɛtsenatsenaa hɔ: nna hɔn a wɔka no do no dɔɔ so.
title: MARK

text: Na akyerɛwfo a wofi Farisiifo no mu no hun dɛ ɔnye ndzebɔnyɛfo nye atowgyefo ridzidzi no, wobisaa n’esuafo no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔnye atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo dzidzi nom yi?
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus tsee no ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hɔn a wɔtse apɔw no, wonnhia oduyɛfo, na mbom hɔn a wɔyar no a: mammbɛfrɛ atseneneefo, na mbom ndzebɔnyɛfo a.
title: MARK

text: Nna John n’esuafo nye Farisiifo no ridzi mbuada: na binom bae bebisaa no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na John n’esuafo nye Farisiifo hɔn esuafo no wodzi mbuada, na w’esuafo dze, wonndzi mbuada yi?
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Ayeforpia mu mba no, aber a ayeforkun no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn no, aso wobotum edzi mbuada anaa? Aber tsentsen biara a wɔwɔ ayeforkun no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn no, worunntum nndzi mbuada.
title: MARK

text: Na nda bɛba a wobeyi ayeforkun no efi hɔn nkyɛn, na da no mu nkyii wobedzi mbuada.
title: MARK

text: Obi mmfa tam fofor sin nntaa atar dadaw mu: dɛm no, dza wɔdze taa mu no yi fi mu, fofor no fi dadaw no mu, na ntsewee no yɛ kɛse.
title: MARK

text: Na obi mmfa wenyin fofor nngu nwomantoa dadaw mu; dɛm no, wenyin no bɛpaa nwomantoa no, na wenyin no asɛɛ, ɔnye nwomantoa no so: na wenyin fofor dze, wɔdze gu nwomantoa fofor mu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Jesus kɛfaa eburow kwa mu ahomgyeda bi; na n’esuafo no nam rokɔ no, wɔhyɛɛ ase pempaan eburow mbɛtsem no bi.
title: MARK

text: Na Farisiifo no see no dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔyɛ dɛn na wɔreyɛ dza ɔmmfa mbra mu wɔ ahomgyeda mu yi?
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnkenkaan dza David yɛe wɔ aber a ohiaa no, na ɔkɔm dzee ɔnoara na hɔn a wɔka no ho no, pɛn anaa?
title: MARK

text: Mbrɛ ɔkɛhɛɛn Nyankopɔn ne fie, aber a Abiathar yɛ ɔsɔfopanyin no, na okedzii kyerɛpaanoo a ɔmmfa mbra mu dɛ obiara dzi, gyedɛ asɔfo no nko, na ɔmaa hɔn a wɔka no ho no so bi no?
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nyimpa ntsi na wɔyɛɛ ahomgyeda, na nnyɛ ahomgyeda ntsi na wɔyɛɛ nyimpa:
title: MARK

text: dɛm ntsi nyimpa Ba no yɛ ahomgyeda no so mpo no wura.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkɛhɛɛn nhyiamudan no mu bio; na nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a ne nsa adwedwe.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔtsɛɛw no hwɛɛ dɛ ɔbɛyɛ no edur ahomgyeda no, ama wɔaatoa no.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee nyimpa no a ne nsa adwedwe no dɛ, Soɛr gyina finimfin.
title: MARK

text: Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ ahomgyeda wɔbɛyɛ dza oye, anaa wɔbɛyɛ dza omuo? Wɔbɛgye nkwa, anaa woboku a?
title: MARK

text: Na womuaa hɔn ano. Na ɔhwɛɛ hɔn hyiae ebufuw do, na hɔn akoma dzen ntsi ɔyɛɛ no yaw no, ɔsee nyimpa no dɛ, Tsen wo nsa. Na ɔtsenee; na ne nsa no sanee dzii mu.
title: MARK

text: Na Farisiifo no puei, na ntsɛmara wɔnye Herod akadofo kɛfaa apam wɔ mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ asɛɛ no ho.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus nye n’esuafo no twee hɔnho kɔr mpoano; na nyimpadodow pii fii Galilii kaa no do;
title: MARK

text: na wofi Judea, Jerusalɛm, Idumea, na Jordan egya, na Taere nye Sidon nkyɛn, nyimpadodow pii a wɔtsee ndzɛmba akɛse pii a ɔyɛe no, na wɔbaa ne nkyɛn.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ n’esuafo no dɛ wɔnyɛ hɛn kakraba bi krado ntweɔn no wɔ nyimpadodow no ntsi, amma wɔaannkyer no do;
title: MARK

text: ɔnam dɛ ɔsaa pii yarba ntsi, dodowara a mbusu horow aba hɔn do no bɛkyeer no do dɛ worubosusuo no mu.
title: MARK

text: Na esunsum fi so, sɛ wohu no a, wotwa hwe n’enyim, na wɔka mu dɛ, Ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn Ba no.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus braa hɔn ketsee dɛ mma wonnyi no nnkyerɛ.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkɔr koko do, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn a noara rohwehwɛ hɔn no, na wɔkɔr ne nkyɛn.
title: MARK

text: Na oyii duebien, dɛ wɔnye no bɛtsena,
title: MARK

text: na dɛ ɔbɔsoma hɔn ama wɔaakɛka asɛm no na woeenya tum dze etu mbɔnsam.
title: MARK

text: Na Simon ɔtoo no dzin Peter,
title: MARK

text: na Zebedee ba James, nye James no nua John; na ɔtoo hɔn dzin Boanerges, ɔno nye dɛ Senaman Mba;
title: MARK

text: nye Andrew, nye Filip, nye Bartholomew, nye Matthew, nye Tomas, nye Alfaeus ba James, nye Tadeus,
title: MARK

text: nye Keenannyi Simon, nye Judas Iskariot a ɔno na oyii no mae no.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbaa fie; na nyimpadodow no behyiaa bio, ma dɛm ntsi woenntum enndzidzi mpo.
title: MARK

text: Na n’ebusuafo no tsee no, wofiir edzi dɛ wɔrobɔtwe no akɔ, osiandɛ nna binom reka dɛ, N’adwen mu aka.
title: MARK

text: Na kyerɛwfo no a wofi Jerusalɛm bae no see dɛ, Ɔwɔ Beelzebul, na mbɔnsam hɔn panyin do na ɔnam tu mbɔnsam no.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn baa ne nkyɛn no, obubuu mbɛ see hɔn dɛ, Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na Satan botum etu Satan?
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ ahenman nye no ho dzi mpaapaamu a, ahenman no nntum nngyina.
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ ofi nye no ho dzi mpaapaamu a, ofi no runntum nngyina.
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ Satan asoɛr nankasa no do na oedzi mpaapaamu a, onnkotum egyina, nna n’ewiei edu.
title: MARK

text: Na obi nntum nnkɔ ɔkatakyi bi ne fie nnkotu nhyɛ n’efidze do mfom mfa, gyedɛ odzi kan kyekyer ɔkatakyi no, ansaana ɔafom ne fie.
title: MARK

text: Mereka akyerɛ hom pefee dɛ, Bɔn nyina wɔdze bɛkyɛ nyimpa mba, nye ebususɛm a wɔbɛka nyina;
title: MARK

text: naaso nyia ɔbɛka ebususɛm etsia Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no dze, orinnya fakyɛ da, na onnyiewiei afɔdzi da no do:
title: MARK

text: osiandɛ wɔsee dɛ, Ɔwɔ sunsum fi.
title: MARK

text: Na ne na nye no nuanom bae begyinaa abow no enyim somae ma wɔkɛfrɛɛ no.
title: MARK

text: Nna nyimpadodow tsetse ne nkyɛn, na wɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, wo na nye wo nuanom gyina abow enyim rohwehwɛ wo.
title: MARK

text: Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Woana nye me na nye mo nuanom?
title: MARK

text: Na ɔtoo n’enyi hwɛɛ hɔn a wɔtsetse ne nkyɛn hyiae no, ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, me na nye mo nuanom.
title: MARK

text: Na obiara a ɔbɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ne pɛ no, ɔno nye mo nua, nye m’akyerɛbaa, nye me na.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ ase bio kyerɛkyerɛe wɔ mpoano. Na nyimpadodow pii behyiaa ne nkyɛn, ma dɛm ntsi ɔkɔr hɛn mu kɛtsenaa ase wɔ po enyi, nna nyimpadodow no nyina wɔ mpoano wɔ daadze.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn ndzɛmba pii wɔ abɛbu mu, na ɔsee hɔn wɔ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu dɛ,
title: MARK

text: Hom ntsie: hwɛ, oduafo no kɔree koguu aba;
title: MARK

text: na orugu no, ɔbaa dɛ bi koguu kwan nkyɛn na nnoma bae bɔsosɔwee.
title: MARK

text: Na bi koguu abosamdo mbrɛ oennya dɛtse pii; na ntsɛmara na ofirii, osiandɛ oennya dɛtse a no mu dɔ;
title: MARK

text: na ewia puei no, ɔhyewee, na osiandɛ onnyi ndwow ntsi ɔkyenkyenee.
title: MARK

text: Na bi so koguu nsoɛ mu, na nsoɛ no nyinii, na omiaa no, ma ɔannsow aba.
title: MARK

text: Na bi so koguu asaase pa mu, na ɔsoow aba a onyinii na ɔdɔɔ so; na ɔsoow bi eduasa, bi eduosia, bi ɔha.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyia ɔwɔ aso a wɔdze tsie no, ma ontsie.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkaa no nko no, hɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no wɔnye duebien no bisaa no mbɛ no ase.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom na wɔdze Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu esumasɛm ama hom; na hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir no dze, wɔkyerɛ hɔn ne nyina mbɛbu mu,
title: MARK

text: ama wɔhwɛ a, wɔaahwɛ ara a wonnkohu mu, na wɔtse a wɔaatse, naaso wɔnnkɛtse ase, amma wɔaannsakyer na wɔaammfa hɔn bɔn annkyɛ hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nnyim bɛ yi? Na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na hom ehu mbɛ nyina ase?
title: MARK

text: Oduafo no gu asɛm no.
title: MARK

text: Na iyinom nye hɔn a wɔwɔ kwan nkyɛn no, wɔ mbrɛ wogu asɛm no; na wɔatse no, Satan ba ntsɛmara beyi asɛm no a wogui wɔ hɔn mu no.
title: MARK

text: Na iyinom so nye hɔn a wogu hɔn abosam do no; hɔn a wɔtse asɛm no a, ntsɛmara wɔdze dɛw gye;
title: MARK

text: naaso wonnyi ndwow wɔ hɔn mu, na wɔwɔ hɔ ber tsiaa bi ntsi, sɛ abɛbrɛsɛ anaa ahohia soɛr wɔ asɛm no ntsi a, ntsɛmara na ato hɔn fintsidua.
title: MARK

text: Iyinom nye hɔn a wogu hɔn nsoɛ mu no, hɔn a wɔatse asɛm no,
title: MARK

text: na wiadze yi mu akɔdadwen nye ahonya ndaadaa nye ndzɛmba nkaa no ho akɔndɔ kɔ hɔn mu, na omia asɛm no, ma ntsi ɔnnsow aba.
title: MARK

text: Na iyinom nye hɔn a wogu hɔn asaase pa mu no, hɔn a wɔtse asɛm no na wɔgye na wɔsow aba, bi eduasa, bi eduosia, na bi so ɔha.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana wɔdze kandzea ba dɛ wɔdze besi kuruw ase anaa mpa ase? Nnyɛ dɛ wɔdze besi kandzeadua do bi?
title: MARK

text: Na biribi nnsuma gyedɛ woribeyi akyerɛ, na woennhuntsa biribi gyedɛ ɔrebɛda gua.
title: MARK

text: Sɛ obi wɔ aso a wɔdze tsie a, ma ontsie.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ dza hom tse no yie: esusudze kor a hom dze susu no, wɔdze bosusu ama hom, na wɔdze bi bɛka hom ho.
title: MARK

text: Na nyia ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no, na nyia onnyi no, dza ɔwɔ no mpo wɔbɛgye ne nsamu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ Nyankopɔn n’ahenman tse nye yi, dɛ nyimpa bogu aba wɔ famu;
title: MARK

text: na ɔbɛda na obenyan adzesaa nye adzekyee, na aba no befifir na oenyin, na onnyim mbrɛ ɔyɛe.
title: MARK

text: Na asaase nankasa na ɔsow aba, ahaban no dzi kan, na nkyii ɔayɛ bɛtsem, na nkyii ɔayɛ eburow wɔ bɛtsem no mu.
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ aba no ber a, ntsɛmara na ɔdze kantankrankye ato mu, osiandɛ twaber edu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze na yɛdze bɔto Nyankopɔn ahenman ho? Anaadɛ ebɛn bɛ na yɛdze bɛkyerɛ?
title: MARK

text: Ɔtse dɛ sinape abafua a wodua no famu a osuar kyɛn aba a ɔwɔ asaase do nyina;
title: MARK

text: naaso sɛ wodua a, onyin yɛ kɛse kyɛn nhaban nyina, na ɔtoto abaw akɛse, ma wimu nnoma tum yɛ hɔn mberɛbuw wɔ no nwin mu.
title: MARK

text: Na mbɛ a ɔtsetse dɛm yi pii na ɔdze kaa asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn, dɛ mbrɛ wobotum etsie.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔannkasa annkyerɛ hɔn a ɔannka no abɛbu mu, na ɔka hɔn nko a, ɔkyerɛ n’esuafo no ndzɛmba nyina ase.
title: MARK

text: Dɛm da no ara, odur ewimbir no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma yentwa nkɔ esuegya noho.
title: MARK

text: Na wogyaa nyimpadodow no kwan no, wɔkɔr hɛmba a Jesus wɔ mu no mu. Nna ahɛn nkakraba bi so ka ho.
title: MARK

text: Na mframa kɛse bɔɔ huu, na asorɛkye bui bɔhwee hɛn no mu, ma nna ɔreyɛ ayɛ ma.
title: MARK

text: Nna Jesus dze, ɔwɔ hɛntu ada wɔ sundze do; na wonyaan no na wɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔnnyɛ wo asɛm dɛ yɛremem?
title: MARK

text: Na onyanee no, ɔbraa mframa no, na ɔsee po no dɛ, Taa dzinn! Na mframa no dwee, na ɔyɛɛ dzinn koraa.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom yɛ ehufo dɛm yi? Ana hom da ho nnyi gyedzi?
title: MARK

text: Na wosuroo pii, na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Woana nye yi a mframa na po mpo wotsie n’asɛm yi?
title: MARK

text: Na wɔbaa po no n’egya wɔ Gerasafo asaase do.
title: MARK

text: Na ofii hɛn no mu no, ntsɛmara na nyimpa bi a ɔwɔ sunsum fi fiir abodan mu wɔ esiei behyiaa no:
title: MARK

text: ɔno na ɔdze abodan mu ayɛ ne tsenabew; na obiara nntum mmfa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mpo nnkyekyer no bio,
title: MARK

text: mber pii na wɔdze mpokyerɛ nye nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn akyekyer no, na ɔatsetsew nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no mu, ebubu mpokyerɛ no mu, na obiara nnyi ahoɔdzen dɛ ɔbɔdwedwe no.
title: MARK

text: Na dabaa adzekyee nye adzesaa nyina nna ɔwɔ abodan mu nye nkokwaa do, ɔretseatsea mu, na ɔdze abo rutwitwa noho.
title: MARK

text: Na ohun Jesus wɔ ekyirekyir no, otutuu mbirika kɔkotoow no;
title: MARK

text: na ɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu see dɛ, Menye wo wɔ ebɛn yɛ, Jesus, Ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn Ba? Meka Nyankopɔn dɛ mma nnhaw me!
title: MARK

text: Osiandɛ nna Jesus ase no dɛ, Sunsum fi, fi nyimpa no mu!
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus bisaa no dɛ, Wo dzin dze dɛn? Na ɔsee no dɛ, Me dzin dze Legyin, osiandɛ yɛdɔɔ so.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔserɛɛ no pii dɛ mma ɔmmpam hɔn mmfi asaase no do.
title: MARK

text: Nna mprekokuw kɛse bi wɔ kokwaa ne nkyɛn a woridzidzi.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔserɛɛ no see dɛ, Soma hɛn mpreko no mu, ma yɛnkɔ hɔn mu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔmaa hɔn kwan. Na esunsum fi no fiir edzi kɛhɛɛn mpreko no mu, na okuw no nyina faa twitwi kesiaan ɔbo kronn no koguguu po no mu, wɔbɛyɛ mpemebien, na wɔtseetsee wui wɔ po no mu.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn a wɔrenyɛn mpreko no guanee na wɔkɛkae wɔ kurow no mu na no nkwaado. Na wopuei bɔhwɛɛ adze kor a aba no.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn no, wobohun nyia mbɔnsam faa no no dɛ ɔtse hɔ hyɛ atar, na n’adwen mu atsew no, mekyerɛ nyia a onyaa Legyin no a; na wosuroi.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn a wohunii no kaa mbrɛ ɔyɛɛ nyia mbɔnsam faa no nye mpreko no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔhyɛɛ ase serɛɛ Jesus dɛ omfi hɔn apaamu hɔ nkɔ.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔrokɔ hɛn no mu no, nyimpa a nkan no mbɔnsam faa no no serɛɛ no dɛ ɔnye no bɛtsena.
title: MARK

text: Naaso Jesus amma no kwan, na ɔsee no dɛ, Kɔ wo fie wɔ w’ebusuafo nkyɛn kɛka ndzɛmba akɛse a Ewuradze ayɛ ama wo, na mbrɛ oesi ehu wo mbɔbɔr no.
title: MARK

text: Na osii mu kɔree, na ɔkɛhyɛɛ ase kaa ndzɛmba akɛse a Jesus yɛe maa no no wɔ Dekapolis, na ɔyɛɛ nyimpa nyina nwanwa.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus nam hɛn no mu twae baa esuegya bio no, nyimpadodow pii behyiaa no ho: nna ɔwɔ mpoano.
title: MARK

text: Na nhyiamudan mu mpanyimfo no mu baako a ne dzin dze Jairus bae; na ohun no no, ɔhwee n’ananadze,
title: MARK

text: na ɔserɛɛ no pii dɛ, Me babaa kakraba ruwu: meserɛ wo, bra bɛfa wo nsa to no do, ma no ho nyɛ no dzen na onnya nkwa.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔnye no kɔree, na nyimpadodow pii kaa no do, na wɔkyeer no do.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbaa bi a oenya bɔgyaagu mfe duebien,
title: MARK

text: na oehu amandze pii wɔ eduyɛfo pii nsa, na ɔahwer dza ɔwɔ nyina, na ɔnnyɛ yie biara, na mbom sor araa na yarba no kɔ no,
title: MARK

text: tsee Jesus ne nka no, obedzii n’ekyir nyimpadodow no mu dze ne nsa bɛkaa n’atar;
title: MARK

text: osiandɛ ɔsee dɛ, Sɛ meka n’atar nko mpo a, mo ho bɛyɛ me dzen.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara no bɔgya bura wewee, na ɔtsee wɔ no honam mu dɛ woeyi no mbusu no kɔ.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara Jesus hun wɔ no mu dɛ ahoɔdzen a ɔwɔ no mu no bi efi mu no, ɔdaan noho wɔ nyimpadodow no mu see dɛ, Woana dze ne nsa kaa m’atar?
title: MARK

text: Na n’esuafo no see no dɛ, Ehu dɛ nyimpadodow no akyer wo do, na afei iribisa dɛ, Woana dze ne nsa kaa me yi ɛ?
title: MARK

text: Na ɔtoo n’enyi aprɔw dɛ obohu nyia ɔyɛɛ dɛm adze no.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbaa no, onyim dza wɔayɛ wɔ no mu no, dze suro nye ahopopo bae botwae hwee n’enyim na ɔkaa nokwar no nyina kyerɛɛ no.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Babaa, wo gyedzi agye wo: kɔ asomdwee mu, na wo ho nyɛ wo dzen mfi wo mbusu mu.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus da ho rekasa no, binom fi nhyiamudan mu panyin no ne fie bae bɛsee dɛ, Wo babaa no ewu: eda ho ara rehaw Kyerɛkyerɛfo no ayɛ dɛn?
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus tsee asɛm a wɔreka no, ɔsee nhyiamudan mu panyin no dɛ, Mma nnsuro, na gye dzi ara.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔamma obiara kwan ma oeenndzi n’ekyir, gyedɛ Peter nye James nye John, James no nua no.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔbaa nhyiamudan mu panyin no ne fie; na Jesus hun dɛ hɔ ayɛ gyigyeegye, na nkorɔfo rusu na wɔreka mmɔn.
title: MARK

text: Ɔkɛhɛɛn hɔ no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom reyɛ dede na hom rusu yi? Abofra no nnwui, na ɔada.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn dze, wɔsereew no twee. Na Jesus yii hɔn nyina edzi no, ɔfaa abofraba no n’egya nye ne na na ɔnye hɔn a wɔka no ho no kɔr mbrɛ abofraba no wɔ.
title: MARK

text: Na osuoo abofraba no ne nsamu, na ɔsee dɛ, Talita, kumi: ne nkyerɛase nye dɛ, Akataasia, mese wo dɛ, Nyan.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara na akataasia no soɛree na ɔnantsewee: (nna oedzi mfe duebien.) Na ntsɛmara hɔn ho boow hɔn kɛse.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbraa hɔn ketsee dɛ mma wɔnnka ma obiara nntse, na ɔsee dɛ wɔmma abofra no biribi ma ondzi.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus fii hɔ kɔree, na ɔbaa nankasa no kurow mu, na n’esuafo no dzii n’ekyir.
title: MARK

text: Na ahomgyeda no durii no, ɔhyɛɛ ase kyerɛkyerɛe wɔ nhyiamudan no mu, na nyimpadodow no tsiee no no, hɔn ho boow hɔn dɛ, Henfa na oyi nyaa dɛm ndzeyɛɛ yi? Ebɛn nyansa nye dza wɔdze ama no yi, na ebɛn tum ndwuma nye dza ɔdze ne nsa ayɛ yi?
title: MARK

text: Ana nnyɛ odwimfo no a ɔyɛ Mary ne ba no, James nye Judas nye Simon hɔn nua no nye yi bi? Ana nnyɛ ne nkyerɛbaa na wɔwɔ hɛn nkyɛn ha yi? Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn fintsidua.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Enyidzi mmbɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi gyedɛ nankasa no kurow mu, nye n’ebusuafo mu, nye nankasa ne fie.
title: MARK

text: Na oenntum annyɛ tum edwuma biara wɔ hɔ, gyedɛ ayarfo kumaabi a ɔdze ne nsa too hɔn do yɛɛ hɔn edur.
title: MARK

text: Na gyedzi a wonnyi yɛɛ no nwanwa. Nna okekyiin nkurobaase kyerɛkyerɛe.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ duebien no, na ɔhyɛɛ ase somaa hɔn beenu beenu, na ɔmaa hɔn tum wɔ esunsum fi do;
title: MARK

text: na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ mma wɔmmfa biribiara nntu kwan, gyedɛ poma nko: mma wɔmmfa edziban anaa kotoku, anaa sika wɔ hɔn abɔdo mu;
title: MARK

text: na wɔnhyɛ mpaboa, na mma wɔnnhyɛ ntar ebien.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Beebiara mbrɛ hom bɛhɛn fi biara mu no, hom ntsena hɔ nkodu dɛ hom befi hɔ akɔ.
title: MARK

text: Na kurow biara a ɔnnkɛgye hom no, na wonnketsie hom wɔ mu no, hom fi hɔ rokɔ a, hom mporoporow hom ananadze huntuma ngye dase ntsia hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔkɔree kɛpae mu kaa dɛ wonnu hɔnho.
title: MARK

text: Na wotuu mbɔnsam pii na wɔdze ngo seraa ayarfo pii saa hɔn yarba.
title: MARK

text: Na Ɔhen Herod tsee, osiandɛ Jesus ne dzin tahyee: na ɔsee dɛ, John Onumanyi no enyan efi ewufo mu: dɛm ntsi na tum ndzɛmba yi reyɛ no mu edwuma no.
title: MARK

text: Na binom see dɛ, Elija a; na binom so see dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi a, tse dɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no mu baako.
title: MARK

text: Na Herod tsee no, ɔsee dɛ, John a mutwaa ne tsir no enyan bio.
title: MARK

text: Nna Herod nankasa asoma ma woekosuo John mu akyer no akɔto efiadze, wɔ no nua Filip yer Herodias ntsi: osiandɛ nna Herod awar no.
title: MARK

text: Na John see Herod dɛ, Ɔmmfa mbra mu mma wo dɛ ebɔwar wo nua ne yer.
title: MARK

text: Na Herodias kyekyeer no hyɛɛ ne yamu, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ oku no, naaso oenntum:
title: MARK

text: osiandɛ Herod suroo John, nna onyim dɛ ɔyɛ nyimpa tsenenee nye krɔnkrɔn ntsi, ɔbɔɔ no ho ban. Sɛ oritsie no a, no ho hyehye no dodow, naaso ɔdze dɛw tsiee no.
title: MARK

text: Na da bi a Herod ridzi n’awoda no, ɔtoo pon maa n’ekunyin nye n’asafohen nye Galilii mpanyimfo;
title: MARK

text: na Herodias ne babaa bae bɛsawee ma ɔsɔɔ Herod nye hɔn a wɔtse edzidzi no enyiwa: na ɔhen no see akataasia no dɛ, Bisa me biribiara a epɛ, na medze bɛma wo.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Biribiara a ibebisa me no, medze bɛma wo dze ekesi m’ahenman ne fa.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkɔree kɛsee ne na dɛ, Mimbisa ebɛnadze? Na ne na see dɛ, John Onumanyi no ne tsir.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara ɔyɛɛ har baa ɔhen ne nkyɛn, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, Mepɛ dɛ edze John Onumanyi no ne tsir to prɛtse mu ma me seseiara.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ɔhen no yaw dodoodow, na osian ne ntam nye hɔn a wɔnye no tse edzidzi no ntsi, ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔbɛka oho akyerɛ no.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara ɔhen no somaa ɔbrafo hyɛɛ no dɛ ɔnkɛfa tsir no mbra; na ɔkɔree kotwaa John ne tsir wɔ efiadze,
title: MARK

text: na ɔdze ne tsir no too prɛtse mu bae, na ɔdze maa akataasia no, na akataasia no dze kɛmaa ne na.
title: MARK

text: Na n’esuafo no tsee no, wɔbae bɛfaa no fun na wɔdze kɔtoo nda bi mu.
title: MARK

text: Na asomafo no boaa hɔn ano baa Jesus nkyɛn na wɔbɛkaa dza wɔayɛ nye dza wɔakyerɛkyerɛ nyina kyerɛɛ no.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Homankasa hom mbra sar do nkyɛn beebi, na hom mbɔhom kakra. Osiandɛ nna dodowara reba rokɔ ma wonnya adagyer nndzidzi mpo.
title: MARK

text: Na wosii mu nam hɛn mu kɔr sar do beebi.
title: MARK

text: Na nyimpa pii hun dɛ worisi mu, na wonyim hɔn no, wofi nkurow nyina mu tutuu mbirika nam daadze kɔr hɔ, na wotwaar hɔn ano.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbaa daadze no, ohun nyimpadodow pii na ne yamu hyehyee no maa hɔn osiandɛ wɔtse dɛ nguan a wonnyi ɔhwɛfo; na ɔhyɛɛ ase kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn ndzɛmba pii.
title: MARK

text: Na adze rebɛsa no, n’esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn bɛsee dɛ, Ha yɛ sar do, na adze so resa;
title: MARK

text: gyaa hɔn ma wɔnkɔ nkuroba nye nkuraase a etwa ehyia yi mu nkɔtɔ biribi ndzi.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Homara hom mma hɔn biribi ma wondzi. Na wɔsee no dɛ, Ana yɛnkɔtɔ paanoo sika denare ahaenu mfa mma hɔn ma wondzi?
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom wɔ paanoo ahen? Hom nkɔhwɛ. Na wɔkɔhwɛe no wɔsee dɛ, Enum, nye esunam ebien.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔmma hɔn nyinara ntsenatsena ekuw ekuw wɔ efuw momon no do.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔtsenatsenaa akyerɛpɛn akyerɛpɛn, ɔha, ɔha, nye eduonum, eduonum.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔfaa paanoo enum no, nye esunam ebien no, na ɔhwɛɛ sor no, ohyiraa do, na obubuu paanoo no, na ɔdze maa n’esuafo no dɛ wɔmfa ntoto hɔn enyim; na ɔkyɛɛ esunam ebien no mu maa hɔn nyinara.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn nyina dzidzii na wɔmee.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔtasee mporoporoba nkɛntsɛn duebien nye esunam no so bi.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn a wodzii paanoo no, wɔyɛ mbarimba mpemenum.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara opiapiaa n’esuafo no dɛ wɔnkɔ hɛn mu na wondzi n’enyim kan wɔ esuegya noho wɔ Bɛtsaeda, ma ɔno nhwɛ, ngya nyimpadodow no kwan.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkraa hɔn no, osii mu kɔr kokwaa do kɔsɔree.
title: MARK

text: Na odur anafua no, nna hɛn no wɔ po finimfin, na no nko wɔ daadze.
title: MARK

text: Na ohun dɛ wɔrofona akwan, osiandɛ mframa esi hɔn enyim no, bɛyɛ anafua dasu a otsia anan no mu no ɔnantseew po enyi baa hɔn nkyɛn, na ɔyɛɛ dɛ ɔrepɛ apa hɔn ho;
title: MARK

text: na hɔn dze, wohun dɛ ɔrenantsew po enyi no, wɔdween dɛ saman a, na wɔkekaa mu,
title: MARK

text: osiandɛ hɔn nyina hun no ma hɔn akoma tui. Na ntsɛmara ɔnye hɔn kasae, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nhyɛ dzen: mara a, mma hom nnsuro.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkɔr hɔn nkyɛn wɔ hɛn no mu, na mframa no gyaae. Na hɔn ho boow hɔn dodoodow koraa,
title: MARK

text: osiandɛ wɔanntse paanoo no ho asɛm no ase, nna hɔn akoma epirim.
title: MARK

text: Na wotwae no, wɔbaa Genesaret asaase do na wodwirii.
title: MARK

text: Na wofii hɛn mu no, ntsɛmara na wohun no,
title: MARK

text: na wotutuu mbirika kekyiin asaase nyina mu, na wɔhyɛɛ ase soaa hɔn a wɔyar wɔ nkɛtɛ do baa beebiara a wɔtsee dɛ ɔwɔ no.
title: MARK

text: Na beebiara a ɔkɔree, nkurobaase anaa nkurow anaa nkuroba mu o, wɔdze ayarfo totoo gua do, na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmma wɔmfa hɔn nsa nka n’atar ano ndwow nko kɛkɛ; na dodow a wɔkaa no no, hɔn ho yɛɛ hɔn dzen.
title: MARK

text: Na Farisiifo no nye kyerɛwfo bi a wofi Jerusalɛm bae behyiaa ne nkyɛn,
title: MARK

text: na wohun dɛ n’esuafo no bi dze nsa a ho nntsew, ɔno nye dɛ nsa a wɔannhohor ho, ridzidzi.
title: MARK

text: (Na Farisiifo no nye Jewfo nyina, sɛ wɔannhohor hɔn nsa ho yie a, wonndzidzi, na wokitsa mpanyimfo atsetsesɛm no mu;
title: MARK

text: na sɛ wofi gua do ba, na wɔannhohor hɔnho a, wonndzidzi, na ndzɛmba pii ka ho a wɔagye dɛ wobosuo mu, nkɔɔpow nye nhina nye nyewasɛn ho hohor.)
title: MARK

text: Na Farisiifo no nye kyerɛwfo no bisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na w’esuafo nnantsew mpanyimfo atsetsesɛm no do, na wɔdze nsa a ho nntsew dzidzi yi?
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Isaia hyɛɛ hom ndabrabafo ho nkɔm yie dɛ (dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no), Ɔman yi dze hɔn anofamfa dzi me nyi, Na hɔn akoma dze, ɔnye me ntamu twe kɛse;
title: MARK

text: Na wɔsɔr me gyan, Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɔyɛ nyimpa ahyɛdze.
title: MARK

text: Hom egya Nyankopɔn ne mbra hɔ: na hom esuo nyimpa atsetsesɛm mu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkɔr do see hɔn dɛ, Hom pow Nyankopɔn ne mbra no papaara pi, ama hom eedzi hom atsetsesɛm do.
title: MARK

text: Na Moses kaa dɛ, Dzi w’egya nye wo na nyi, na, Obiara a ɔhyɛ egya anaa na ahorba no, owu na onwu;
title: MARK

text: naaso hom dze, hom se dɛ, Sɛ nyimpa bi se n’egya anaa ne na dɛ, biribiara a nkyɛ edze benya mo ho mfaso no yɛ Korban (ɔnye dɛ, Akyɛdze a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn dze) a,
title: MARK

text: ɔno hom mma no kwan dɛ mma ɔnnyɛ biribi mma n’egya anaa ne na bio:
title: MARK

text: ɔnam hom atsetsesɛm a hom dze bae no do, hom amma Nyankopɔn asɛm enntsim; na ndzɛmba a ɔtse dɛm pii na hom yɛ.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ nyimpadodow no baa ne nkyɛn bio no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nyina ntsie me na hom ntse ase:
title: MARK

text: biribiara nnyi nyimpa ho a ɔkɔ no mu a obotum egu no ho fi; na dza ofi nyimpa mu ba no, ɔno na ogu nyimpa ho fi.
title: MARK

text: Sɛ obiara wɔ aso a wɔdze tsie a, wɔmma ontsie.
title: MARK

text: Na ofii nyimpadodow no nkyɛn kɔr fie no, n’esuafo no bisaa no bɛ no ase.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom so nnyi ntseasee dɛm? Ana hom nnhu dɛ biribiara a ofi nyimpa ho kɔ no mu no, onntum nngu no ho fi,
title: MARK

text: osiandɛ ɔnnkɔ n’akoma mu, na mbom ɔkɔ yafun mu, na okeyi gu egyanan mu. [Ɔkaa yi dze tseew edziban nyina ho.]
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Dza ofi nyimpa no mu ba no, ɔno na ogu ho fi.
title: MARK

text: Na nyimpa akoma mu, na adwembɔn fi ba, ndwamanyɛ,
title: MARK

text: adzewia, ewudzi, ayefasɛm, enyiber, emumuyɛ, nsisi, atantanbra, enyibɔn, ebususɛm, ntsɛn, nkwaseasɛm:
title: MARK

text: ndzebɔn yinom nyina fi mu na ɔba na ogu nyimpa ho fi.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsoɛree fii hɔ kɔr Taere nye Sidon ntoaado. Na ɔkɔr fi bi mu, na ɔammpɛ dɛ obiara tse, naaso oenntum ennsuma.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara ɔbaa bi a ne babaa kakraba wɔ sunsum fi tsee ne nka no, ɔbae bɔhwee n’ananadze.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbaa no yɛ Griiknyi, na n’awoo mu ɔyɛ Sirofonisianyi; na ɔserɛɛ no dɛ ontu sunsum fi no mfi ne babaa no mu.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Ma mba no mmee ansaana, na ɔnnsɛ dɛ wɔfa mba edziban tow ma mbɔdɔm.
title: MARK

text: Na obuae see no dɛ, Mo wura, ɔyɛ nokwar dze; naaso pon ase mbɔdɔm no, wodzi mba hɔn mporoporoba no bi.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Asɛm a aka yi ntsi kɔ: sunsum fi no efi wo babaa no mu.
title: MARK

text: Na osii mu kɔr ne fie no, ohun dɛ abofraba no da mpa do, na sunsum fi no efi no mu kɔ.
title: MARK

text: Na ofii Taere ntoaado bio koduaa Sidon mu dze faa Dekapolis ntoaado ne finimfin baa Galilii po ho.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔdze otsitsifo a ɔpo dodow brɛɛ no, na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa ne nsa nto no do.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔdze no fii nyimpadodow no mu kɔr nkyɛn na ɔdze ne nsatseaba hyɛɛ n’asowa mu, na ɔtoo ntafi dze kaa ne tɛkyerɛma,
title: MARK

text: na ɔhwɛɛ sor sii nkrum see no dɛ, Efaata, ase nye dɛ, Bue.
title: MARK

text: Na n’aso buebuei na ne tɛkyerɛma ase ahoma sanee, na ɔkasaa yie.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnka nnkyerɛ obiara; na mpɛn dodow a ɔbraa hɔn no, mpɛn dodow a wɔdze tahyee kɛse nye no.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn ahobow mbordo, na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔayɛ ndzɛmba nyina yie: ɔma tsitsifo tse asɛm na ɔma mmum kasa.
title: MARK

text: Dɛm mber no mu no, ɔbaa dɛ nyimpadodow no dɔɔ so bio na wonnyi biribi a wodzi no, Jesus frɛɛ n’esuafo no see hɔn dɛ,
title: MARK

text: Me yamu hyehye me ma nyimpadodow yi, osiandɛ wɔatsena me nkyɛn ndaansa yi na wonnyi biribi a woridzi;
title: MARK

text: sɛ migya hɔn kwan ma wɔdze kɔm kɔ fie a, wɔbɔtotɔ bitsi wɔ kwan mu, osiandɛ hɔn mu binom fi ekyirekyir bae.
title: MARK

text: Na n’esuafo no buaa no dɛ, Henfa na nyimpa benya paanoo a ɔdze bɛmee yinom wɔ sar yi do ha?
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus bisaa hɔn dɛ, Paanoo ahen na hom wɔ? Na wɔsee dɛ, Esuon.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ nyimpadodow no dɛ wɔntsena famu, na ɔfaa paanoo esuon no, na ɔdaa ase no, obubui, na ɔdze maa n’esuafo no dɛ wɔmfa ntoto hɔn enyim; na wɔdze totoo nyimpadodow no enyim.
title: MARK

text: Nna wɔwɔ esunam kakraba bi, na ohyiraa do na ɔkaa dɛ wɔmfa no so ntoto hɔn enyim.
title: MARK

text: Na wodzidzii mee, na wɔtasee mporoporoba a ɔkae no nkɛntsɛn esuon.
title: MARK

text: Nna nyimpa no bɛyɛ mpemanan. Na Jesus gyaa hɔn kwan.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara ɔnye n’esuafo no kɔr hɛn mu na ɔbaa Dalmanuta afamu.
title: MARK

text: Na Farisiifo no bae, na wɔhyɛɛ ase nye no yiyii nsɛm ano, hwehwɛɛ asɛnkyerɛdze bi a ofi sor, dze sɔɔ no hwɛe.
title: MARK

text: Na osii nkrum kɛse wɔ no sunsum mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na ɔsantsen yi rohwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze yi? Mereka no nokwar mu kyerɛ hom dɛ, Wɔremmfa asɛnkyerɛdze biara mma ɔsantsen yi.
title: MARK

text: Na ogyaa hɔn hɔ, na ɔtsenaa hɛn mu bio kɔr esuegya noho.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn werɛ fiir dɛ wɔbɛfa paanoo, nna wonnyi biribi wɔ hɛn no mu wɔ hɔn nkyɛn dɛ paanoo kor pɛ.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ Farisiifo mbɔrkaw nye Herod no mbɔrkaw ho.
title: MARK

text: Na wosusui sesee hɔnho dɛ, Gyama yennyi paanoo ntsi a.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus hunii no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom susu dɛ osiandɛ hom nnyi paanoo ntsi a? Ana hom nnyae nnhunii, eso hom nntse ase? Hom akoma epirim anaa?
title: MARK

text: Ana hom wɔ enyiwa naaso hom nnhu adze? Na hom wɔ aso na hom nntse? Ana hom nnkaa?
title: MARK

text: Mububuu paanoo enum maa mpemenum no, mporoporoba nkɛntsɛnma ahen na hom tasee? Nna wɔsee no dɛ, Duebien.
title: MARK

text: Na esuon no so a memaa mpemanan no, mporoporoba mbirefi ma ahen na hom tasee? Na wɔsee dɛ, Esuon.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom da ho nntse ase?
title: MARK

text: Na wɔbaa Bɛtsaeda; na wɔdze onyifurafo bi brɛɛ no, na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa ne nsa nka no.
title: MARK

text: Na osuoo onyifurafo no ne nsamu dze no fii ekuroba no mu; na ɔtoo ntafi guu n’enyiwa do, na ɔdze ne nsa too no do no, obisaa no dɛ, Ihu adze anaa?
title: MARK

text: Na ɔmaa n’enyiwa do, na ɔsee dɛ, Muhu nyimpa, na muhu hɔn tse dɛ ndua nenam.
title: MARK

text: Nkyii ɔdze ne nsa guu n’enyiwa do bio, ma ɔhwɛɛ n’enyim tɔɔtsenn, na no ho sanee, na ohun adze nyina krɔnn.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔmaa ɔkɔr ne fie see no dɛ, Mma nnkɔ ekuroba no mu hɔ mpo.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus nye n’esuafo no fii hɔ kɔr Kaesarea Filipi nkuroba no mu; na obisaa n’esuafo no wɔ kwan mu dɛ, Nyimpa se dɛ woana nye me?
title: MARK

text: Na wobuae see no dɛ, John Onumanyi no a, na binom se, Elija a; binom so se, Nkɔnhyɛfo no mu baako a.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus noara bisaa hɔn dɛ, Na hom dze, hom se dɛ woana nye me? Peter buae see no dɛ, Ɔwo nye Kraest no.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnka no ho asɛm nnkyerɛ obiara.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ ase kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ ɔsɛ nyimpa Ba no dɛ obohu amandze pii, na mpanyimfo nye asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no apow no, na woeku no, na ne ndaansa ɔasoɛr.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkaa asɛm no petee. Na Peter suoo no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ ase twuuw n’enyim.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔno dze, ɔdaan noho hwɛɛ n’esuafo no no, otwuuw Peter n’enyim see dɛ, Fi mo do, Satan: na enndwen Nyankopɔn dze, na nyimpa dze na edwen.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ nyimpadodow no nye n’esuafo no so baa ne nkyɛn no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Sɛ obi pɛ dɛ odzi m’ekyir a, ma ɔmpa noho ekyir, na ompegya ne mbeamudua na ɔnka mo do.
title: MARK

text: Na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔgye ne kra nkwa no, ɔbɛyew no, na obiara a emi nye asɛmpa no ntsi ne nkwa befi ne nsa no, wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ nyimpa nya wiadze nyina ma ntsi ɔhwer no nkwa a, ebɛn mfaso na obenya?
title: MARK

text: Na ebɛnadze na nyimpa bɛma dze asesa no nkwa?
title: MARK

text: Osiandɛ obiara a n’enyi bɔto emi nye me nsɛm ho wɔ awartofo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo santsen yi mu no, ɔno so na nyimpa Ba no n’enyi bɔto no ho, ber a ɔnye n’abɔfoe krɔnkrɔn bɛba wɔ n’egya n’enyimnyam mu no.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Hɔn a wogyina ha yi, binom wɔ hɔ a wɔronnsɔ owu nnhwɛ ansaana woehu Nyankopɔn n’ahenman no dɛ ɔdze tum aba.
title: MARK

text: Na ndaesia ekyir no, Jesus faa Peter nye James nye John, na ɔdze hɔn nko kɔr nkyɛn wɔ kokwaa tsentsen bi do; na ɔsakyeree wɔ hɔn enyim;
title: MARK

text: na n’atar hyerɛɛn fitafita, dɛ mbrɛ asaase yi do ɔtanhofo biara nnkotum ahoa no dɛm.
title: MARK

text: Na Elija nye Moses puee hɔn nkyɛn, na wɔnye Jesus kasae.
title: MARK

text: Na Peter buae see Jesus dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, oye ma hɛn dɛ yɛtsena ha, na ma yɛmbɔ asese ebiasa, wodze kor, Moses dze kor, Elija dze kor.
title: MARK

text: Nna onnhu dza ɔnka, osiandɛ nna suro kɛse aka hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na mununkum bi bɛkataa hɔn do, na ndze fii mununkum no mu baa dɛ, Oyi nye mo Dɔba no: hom ntsie no.
title: MARK

text: Na amonmu hɔ ara wɔtotoo hɔn enyiwa, naaso woennhu nyimpa biara dɛ Jesus nko, nye hɔnara.
title: MARK

text: Na wofi kokwaa do risian no, ɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnka dza wohunii no nnkyerɛ obiara, gyedɛ nyimpa Ba no asoɛr efi ewufo mu ana.
title: MARK

text: Na wosuoo asɛm no mu, na wobisabisaa hɔnho dɛ ewufo mu soɛr no ase nye dɛn.
title: MARK

text: Na wobisaa no see dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na kyerɛwfo no ka dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ Elija idzi kan ba?
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Elija dze, obedzi kan aba ampa, na ɔaabɔtoto ndzɛmba nyina yie: na ebɛnadze ntsi na wɔakyerɛw no nyimpa Ba no ho dɛ obohu amandze pii naaso wonnkobu no hwee?
title: MARK

text: Na mese hom dɛ Elija aba dada, na eso wɔayɛ no dza wɔpɛ nyina, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ no ho.
title: MARK

text: Na wodur esuafo no nkyɛn no, wohun nyimpadodow pii wɔ hɔn ho, na kyerɛwfo dɛ wɔnye hɔn riyiyi asɛm ano.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara nyimpadodow no nyina hun Jesus no, hɔn ho dwiriiw hɔn, na wotutuu mbirika bae bekyiaa no.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus bisaa hɔn dɛ, Ebɛn asɛm na hom nye hɔn riyiyi ano yi?
title: MARK

text: Na nyimpadodow no mu baako buaa no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, medze me babanyin brɛɛ wo, osiandɛ ɔwɔ mmum sunsum;
title: MARK

text: na beebiara a osuo no mu no, ɔtsetsew noho gu, na n’ano twa ehur, na ɔtwɛr ne se, na ɔkyenkyen: na mesee w’esuafo no dɛ wontu no, naaso woenntum.
title: MARK

text: Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Ao santsen a hom nnyi gyedzi, menye hom ntsena nkodu dabɛn? Hom mfa no mbrɛ me.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔdze no brɛɛ Jesus; na ohun Jesus no, ntsɛmara na sunsum no twaa no ehim, na ɔhwee daadze ma opirepirewii, na n’ano twaa ehur.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus bisaa n’egya dɛ, Iyi yɛɛ no mber dodow bɛn nye yi? Na ɔsee dɛ, Ofi no mbofraber mu;
title: MARK

text: na mpɛn pii na ɔaka no ato gya, nye nsu mu, dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ no; na sɛ ibotum ayɛ ho biribi a, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr na boa hɛn.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Sɛ ibotum a! Nyia ɔgye dzi no, ndzɛmba nyina botum ayɛ hɔ ama no.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara abofra no n’egya tseaa mu see dɛ, Megye midzi: boa me wɔ m’ekyingye gye ho.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus hun dɛ nyimpadodow dze enguan reba no, ɔbɔɔ sunsum fi no ham see no dɛ, Ɔwo, sunsum mmum nye tsitsifo, mara mehyɛ wo dɛ fi no mu fi, na mma nnkɔ no mu bio.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkaa mu na otwaa no ehim pii no, ofii no mu firii; na ɔbɛyɛɛ dɛ owufo, ma dodowara see dɛ, Oewu.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus suoo ne nsamu maa no do, na ɔsoɛree.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus baa fie no, n’esuafo no bisaa no nsumaa mu dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na yeenntum enntu no yi?
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Iyi ne saso nntum nndua biribiara do mmpue gyedɛ mpaabɔ [na akɔnkyen] do.
title: MARK

text: Na wofii hɔ kotwaa mu wɔ Galilii, na ɔammpɛ dɛ obiara tse.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ n’esuafo no, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Woriyi nyimpa Ba no ahyɛ nyimpa nsa, na woboku no; na woku no a ne ndaansa no ɔbɔsoɛr bio.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn dze, wɔanntse asɛm no ase, naaso wosuroo dɛ wobebisa no.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔbaa Karpernaum; na ɔwɔ fie no, obisaa hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom dwendween ho wɔ kwan mu no?
title: MARK

text: Na womuaa hɔn ano: osiandɛ wɔadwendwen wɔ hɔn mu wɔ kwan mu dɛ woana na ɔyɛ kɛse.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔtsenaa ase no, ɔfrɛɛ duebien no see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ obi pɛ kan edzi a, obedzi hom nyina ekyir na ɔbɛyɛ hom nyina somfo.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔfaa abofraba sii hɔn finimfin, na ɔyɛɛ no etuu, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ,
title: MARK

text: Obiara a ɔbɛgye dɛm mbofraba yi mu baako wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔgye emi mara, na obiara a ɔgye me no, nnyɛ emi na ɔgye, na nyia ɔsomaa me no a.
title: MARK

text: Na John see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yehun obi dɛ ɔdze wo dzin rutu mbɔnsam, na yesiiw no kwan, ɔnam dɛ ɔnnka hɛn ho ntsi.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see dɛ, Mma hom nnsiw no kwan, osiandɛ obi nnyi hɔ a ɔdze me dzin bɛyɛ tum edwuma bi na obotum egu mo ho fi hɔ no ara.
title: MARK

text: Nyia onntsia hɛn no, ɔwɔ hɛn afa.
title: MARK

text: Na obiara a ɔbɛma hom nsu kɔɔpow ma hom aanom wɔ me dzin mu, dɛ hom yɛ Kraest dze ntsi no, nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔnnkɛyew n’akatua.
title: MARK

text: Na obiara a ɔbɔto nkakraba a wɔgye me dzi yi mu baako fintsidua no, oye ma no dɛ wɔdze ewuyambo kɛse sɛn no kɔn mu na wɔdze no kɔto po mu.
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ wo nsa na ɔto wo fintsidua a, twa: oye ma wo dɛ edze abasin bɔkɔ nkwa mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ wo nsa ebien dze bɔkɔ amandzehu kurow mu, wɔ gya a orunndum da no mu.
title: MARK

text: [Hɔ na hɔn abowaba nnwu, na gya no nndum.]
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ wo nan na ɔto wo fintsidua a, twa: oye ma wo dɛ edze anansin bɔkɔ nkwa mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ w’anan ebien na wɔdze wo bɔkɔto amandzehu kurow mu.
title: MARK

text: [Hɔ na hɔn abowaba nnwu, na gya no nndum.]
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ w’enyiwa na ɔto wo fintsidua a, tu: oye ma wo dɛ edze enyi kor bɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n’ahenman mu kyɛn dɛ ewɔ enyiwa ebien na wɔdze wo bɔkɔto amandzehu kurow mu;
title: MARK

text: hɔ na abowaba nnwu, na gya no onndum.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔdze gya bɛhyɛ nyimpa nyina nkyen. [Wɔdze nkyen bɔto afɔrbɔdze nyina mu.]
title: MARK

text: Nkyen ye: na sɛ nkyen ayew dza ɔma ɔyɛ nkyen mapa a, hom dze ebɛnadze bɔto mu? Hom nnya nkyen wɔ homara hom mu, na hom nye homho homho ntsena asomdwee mu.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus soɛree fii hɔ baa Judea nye Jordan afamu; na nyimpadodow boaboaa ano wɔ ne nkyɛn bio, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔtɔ dɛ ɔyɛ no, ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn bio.
title: MARK

text: Na Farisiifo bi baa ne nkyɛn bebisaa no asɛm dze sɔɔ no hwɛɛ dɛ, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ ɔbanyin begyaa ne yer awar?
title: MARK

text: Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Moses hyɛɛ hom dɛn?
title: MARK

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Moses maa kwan dɛ wɔnkyerɛw awargyaa nwoma mma no, na wongyaa no.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom akoma dzen ntsi na ɔkyerɛɛw mbrasɛm yi maa hom.
title: MARK

text: Naaso ofitsi abɔdze ahyɛse no, ɔbanyin na ɔbaa na ɔyɛɛ hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Iyi ntsi na ɔbanyin begya n’egya nye ne na hɔ, na ɔdze noho akɔbɔ ne yer ho;
title: MARK

text: na hɔn beenu ayɛ honankor; dɛm no nna wɔnnda ho nnyɛ beenu bio, na wɔyɛ honankor.
title: MARK

text: Dɛm ntsi dza Nyankopɔn dze abɔ mu no, mma nyimpa nntsew mu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔwɔ fie no, n’esuafo no bisaa no wɔ asɛm kor yi ara ho bio.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nyimpa biara a obegyaa ne yer na ɔawar fofor no, ɔato awar wɔ ɔbaa no afamu;
title: MARK

text: na sɛ ɔbaa no so gyaa no kun na ɔwar fofor a, ɔto awar.
title: MARK

text: Na binom dze mbofraba brɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa ne nsa nka hɔn; na n’esuafo no twuuw hɔn enyim.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus hunii no, onyaa ebufuw, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma mbofraba no kwan ma wɔmbra me nkyɛn, na mma hom nnsiw hɔn kwan, na woyinom dɛm na Nyankopɔn ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
title: MARK

text: Meka no nokwar kyerɛ hom dɛ, Obiara a ɔnnkɛgye Nyankopɔn ahenman no dɛ abofraba no, ɔnnkɔkɔ mu da.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔyɛɛ mbofra no etuu, na ɔdze ne nsa guu hɔn do dze hyiraa hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus fi hɔ sii kwan no mu no, obi tutuu mbirika bɔkotoow no, na obisaa Jesus dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo pa, ebɛnadze na menyɛ ama meenya onnyiewiei nkwa ayɛ medze?
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na efrɛ me papa? Obiara nnyɛ papa gyedɛ baako: ɔno nye Nyankopɔn.
title: MARK

text: Inyim mbrasɛm no, Mma nndzi ewu, Mma nnto awar, Mma nnwia adze, Mma nngye dasewia, Mma nnsisi, Dzi w’egya nye wo na nyi.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yinom nyinara mifitsi mo mbofraber mu na midzii do.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus hwɛɛ no no, ɔdɔɔ no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Aka wo adze kor: kɔ, kɔtɔn dza ewɔ nyina fa kyɛ ehiafo, na ibenya akoradze wɔ sor, na bra bɛka mo do.
title: MARK

text: Na asɛm no ntsi nyimpa no munae, na ɔdze yaw kɔree: osiandɛ nna ɔyɛ nyimpa a ɔwɔ ahonyadze pii.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus too n’enyi hwɛɛ hɔn hyiae, na ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, Ebɛn dzen na ɔyɛ ma hɔn a wɔwɔ ahonya dɛ wɔbɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n’ahenman mu!
title: MARK

text: Na asɛm no yɛɛ esuafo no ahobow. Na Jesus buae see hɔn bio dɛ, Mbofra, ebɛn dzen na ɔyɛ ma hɔn [a wɔtwer ahonya] dɛ wɔbɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n’ahenman mu!
title: MARK

text: Na ɔyɛ mberɛw ma efupɔnkɔ dɛ obodua doroba enyiwa mu kyɛn dɛ ɔhonyanyi bɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n’ahenman mu.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn ho boow hɔn mbordo, na wɔsee no dɛ, Dɛm a nna woana koraa na wobotum agye no nkwa?
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus hwɛɛ hɔn see dɛ, Nyimpa afamu na iyi nntum nnyɛ dɛm, na nnyɛ Nyankopɔn afamu a: na Nyankopɔn afamu dze, adze biara nnso no yɛ.
title: MARK

text: Na Peter hyɛɛ ase see no dɛ, Hwɛ, yeegya ndzɛmba nyinara na yɛabɛka wo do.
title: MARK

text: Jesus see dɛ, Mereka no nokwar mu akyerɛ hom dɛ, Obiara nnyi hɔ a oegya fie, anaa enuanom, anaa nkyerɛbaa, anaa na, anaa egya, anaa mba, anaa nsaase wɔ emi nye asɛmpa no ntsi,
title: MARK

text: na onnkenya ho mbɔho mpɛn ɔha wɔ ber yi mu, efie, nye enuanom, nye nkyerɛbaa, nye nanom, nye mba, nye nsaase, ɔnye ayakayakadze; na wiadze a ɔreba no mu onnyiewiei nkwa.
title: MARK

text: Na Edzikamfo pii bedzi ekyir, na ekyidzifo so pii bedzi kan.
title: MARK

text: Nna wɔnam kwan mu rokɔ Jerusalɛm; na Jesus dzi hɔn enyim kan, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn ahobow; na hɔn a wodzi n’ekyir no suroi. Na ɔfaa duebien no bio na ɔhyɛɛ ase kaa ndzɛmba a ɔbɛba no do no kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ,
title: MARK

text: Hwɛ, yɛrokɔ Jerusalɛm; na wobeyi Nyimpa Ba no ahyɛ asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no nsa, na woebu no fɔ ama owu, na woeyi no ama amanamamfo;
title: MARK

text: na wobesi no atwetwe, na wɔatoto ntafi egu no do, na wɔaka no mpire, na woeku no; naaso ne ndaansa mu ɔbɔsoɛr.
title: MARK

text: Na James nye John, Zebedee mba no, baa no hɔ bɛsee dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yɛpɛ dɛ biribiara a yɛbɛserɛ wo no eyɛ ma hɛn.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom pɛ dɛ meyɛ mema hom?
title: MARK

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Ma hɛn mu baako ntsena w’enyimfa, na baako so ntsena w’abankum wɔ w’enyimnyam mu.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom nnyim dza hom reserɛ yi: ana hom botum anom kɔɔpow a monom no, anaa wɔdze enuma a wɔdze numa me no enuma hom?
title: MARK

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Yebotum. Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Kɔɔpow a monom no dze, hom bɔnom ampa, na enuma a wɔdze numa me no, wɔdze bonuma hom;
title: MARK

text: na m’enyimfa nye m’abankum tsena dze, ɔnnyɛ medze dɛ medze bɛma: na wɔdze bɛma hɔn a woesiesie ama hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na du no tsee no wɔhyɛɛ ase nyaa ebufuw wɔ James nye John ho.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus frɛɛ hɔn baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nyim dɛ hɔn a wobu hɔn dɛ wodzi amanaman do, wodzi hɔn do wura, na hɔn mu akɛse no dzi hɔn do tum.
title: MARK

text: Naaso onnyi dɛ ɔba dɛm wɔ hom mu: na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔkɛse wɔ hom mu no, ɔbɛyɛ hom somfo;
title: MARK

text: na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ odzi hom mu kan no, ɔbɛyɛ hom nyina hom akowaa.
title: MARK

text: Na nyimpa Ba no so, ɔammba dɛ wɔnnsom no, mbom ɔbɔsomee, ama ɔdze no nkwa aayɛ werdam ama dodowara.
title: MARK

text: Na wodur Jeriko; na ɔnye n’esuafo no nye nyimpadodow pii rifi Jeriko akɔ no, nna Timeɔs ne ba Bartimeɔs a ɔyɛ onyifurafo na ɔserɛserɛ adze no, tse kwan nkyɛn.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔtsee dɛ ɔyɛ Jesus Nazarɛtnyi no no, ɔhyɛɛ ase tseatseaa mu dɛ, Jesus, David ba, hu me mbɔbɔr.
title: MARK

text: Na dodowara braa no dɛ ommua n’ano; na mbom ɔtseaa mu kɛse dɛ, Ɔwo, David ba, hu me mbɔbɔr.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus gyinae, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mfrɛ no. Na wɔfrɛɛ onyifurafo no see no dɛ, Ka w’akoma to wo yamu: soɛr, ɔrefrɛ wo.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔtoow ne tam gui, na ɔsoɛɛr putupruw, na ɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus bisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na epɛ dɛ meyɛ ma wo? Na onyifurafo no see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, nkyɛ meehu adze bio.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Kɔ, wo gyedzi agye wo. Na ntsɛmara ohun adze, na ɔkaa Jesus do wɔ kwan no mu.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔbɛɛn Jerusalɛm wɔ Bɛtfage nye Bɛtani, wɔ Ngo Bepɔw ho no, ɔsomaa n’esuafo no mu beenu,
title: MARK

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ ekuroba a ɔda hom enyim no mu: na hom du hɔ ara pɛr a, hom bohu asoasopɔnkɔba bi a wɔamontan no a nyimpa biara nntsenaa do da: hom nsan no mfa no mbra.
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ obi bisa hom dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom reyɛ yi a, hom nse dɛ, Ewuradze wɔ no ho hia, na ntsɛmara ɔbɛma wɔdze no aba ha.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔkɔree no wokohun asoasopɔnkɔba no dɛ wɔamontan no abow ho, wɔ abɔntsen petee mu, na wɔsaan no.
title: MARK

text: Hɔn a nna wogyina hɔ no bi bisaa dɛ, Hom resan asoasopɔnkɔba no ayɛ dɛn?
title: MARK

text: Na wobuaa hɔn dɛ mbrɛ Jesus see hɔn no ara; na wɔmaa hɔn kwan.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔdze asoasopɔnkɔba no brɛɛ Jesus, na wɔtoow hɔn ntar guu no do; na ɔtsenaa no do.
title: MARK

text: Na dodowara dze hɔn ntar sesɛɛw kwan mu; na binom so dze ndubaa a woetwitwa wɔ efuw mu.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn a wodzii enyim no, na hɔn so a wodzii ekyir no tseaa mu dɛ, Hosanna! Nhyira nye nyia ɔnam Ewuradze dzin mu reba no!
title: MARK

text: Nhyira nye hɛn egya David ahendzi a ɔreba no! Hosanna wɔ sorsor!
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkɛhɛɛn Jerusalɛm no, ɔkɔr asɔrfi no mu; na ɔahwɛ ndzɛmba nyina ewie, na adze resa no, ɔnye duebien no fii hɔ kɔr Bɛtani.
title: MARK

text: Na adze kyee a wofi Bɛtani reba no, ɔkɔm dzee Jesus.
title: MARK

text: Na ohun adɔmbadua bi wɔ ekyirekyir dɛ ahaban wɔ do no, ɔkɔr hɔ dɛ bi a nkyɛ obohu biribi wɔ do, naaso odur hɔ no oennhu biribiara dɛ ahaban nko: osiandɛ nna adɔmba ber nndurii.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see adɔmbadua no dɛ, Mma obi nndzi wo do eduaba bio da. Na n’esuafo no tsee.
title: MARK

text: Na wodur Jerusalɛm; na ɔkɔr asɔrfi no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ ase paam hɔn a wɔtɔn nye hɔn a wɔtɔ wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na obutuuw sikasesafo hɔn apon nye hɔn a wɔtɔn mbubur no hɔn ngua;
title: MARK

text: na ɔamma kwan amma obiara aannsoa adze ammfa asɔrfi no mu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛe see hɔn dɛ, Ana wɔnnkyerɛw no dɛ, Wɔbɛfrɛ me fi asɔryɛbea ama amanaman nyinara? Naaso hom dze, hom ayɛ no edwotwafo tu.
title: MARK

text: Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no tsee, na wɔhwehwɛɛ mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ asɛɛ no: na wosuroo no, osiandɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛɛ nyimpadodow nyina ahobow.
title: MARK

text: Na adzesae no, Jesus nye n’esuafo no fii kurow no mu hɔ.
title: MARK

text: Na anapa no a wɔresen no, wohun adɔmbadua no dɛ ofitsi no ndwow akyenkyen.
title: MARK

text: Na Peter kaae na ɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, hwɛ, adɔmbadua a edoom no no akyenkyen.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Hom nya gyedzi wɔ Nyankopɔn mu.
title: MARK

text: Na nokwar mese hom dɛ, Obiara a ɔbɛse kokwaa yi dɛ, Tutu na kɔhwe po mu, na ɔnnyɛ ekyingye wɔ n’akoma mu, na ɔbɛgye edzi dɛ dza ɔrese no ɔreyɛ hɔ no, ɔbɛyɛ hɔ ama no.
title: MARK

text: Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, Biribiara a hom sɔr bisa no, hom ngye ndzi dɛ hom enya na hom benya.
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ hom gyina hɔ rosɔr, na sɛ hom nye obi wɔ asɛm bi a, hom mfa nkyɛ, ama hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no so dze hom mfom aakyɛ hom.
title: MARK

text: [Na sɛ hom ammfa annkyɛ a, hom egya a ɔwɔ sor no so nnkɛfa hom mfom akyɛ hom.]
title: MARK

text: Na wɔbaa Jerusalɛm bio; na ɔnenam asɔrfi no mu no, asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no baa ne nkyɛn,
title: MARK

text: na wobisaa no dɛ, Ebɛn tum na edze yɛ ndzɛmba yi, anaa woana na ɔmaa wo tum dɛ yɛ yinom?
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Mibebisa hom asɛm kor, na hom mbua me, na mebɛkyerɛ hom tum kor a medze yɛ yinom:
title: MARK

text: John enuma no, ofir sor anaa ofir nyimpa? Hom mbua me.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔdwendween ho wɔ hɔn ntamu dɛ, Sɛ yɛka dɛ, Ofir sor a, ɔbɛse dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom anngye no enndzi?
title: MARK

text: Anaa yɛnka dɛ, Ofir nyimpa? Nna wosuro nkorɔfo no, osiandɛ hɔn nyina buu John dɛ ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi ampa.
title: MARK

text: Ntsi wobuaa Jesus see no dɛ, Yennyim. Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Mo so mennkɛkyerɛ hom tum kor a medze yɛ yinom.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ ase kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn abɛbu mu dɛ, Nyimpa bi yɛɛ wenyin ture, na ɔgyee ho ban hyiae, na otuu wenyintwer, na ɔtoow abantsentsen wɔ mu, na ɔdze fɛɛm ekuafo bi, na ɔdɔɔ mu kɔr beebi.
title: MARK

text: Na ber durii no, ɔsomaa akowaa bi wɔ ekuafo no hɔ dɛ ɔnkɛgye wenyin ture eduaba no bi wɔ ekuafo no hɔ mbra.
title: MARK

text: Na ekuafo no kyeer no hwee no, na wɔmaa ɔdze nsapan kɔree.
title: MARK

text: Na bio ɔsomaa akowaa fofor wɔ hɔn hɔ, na wɔbobɔɔ ne tsir pirapiraa no, na woguu n’enyim ase.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsanee somaa ɔfofor so; na ɔno dze, wokum no, nna afofor pii so: wɔhwee binom na wokum binom.
title: MARK

text: Nna ɔwɔ obi so wɔ hɔ a ɔno yɛ no dɔba; na ekyir no ɔsomaa ɔno so wɔ hɔn hɔ, na ɔsee dɛ, Wɔbɛfɛr me ba.
title: MARK

text: Na ekuafo no dze, wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Odziadzenyi no nye yi: hom mbra ma yenku no, na egyapadze no bɛyɛ hɛndze.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔkyeer no kum no, na wɔtoow no fii wenyin ture mu hɔ kyenee.
title: MARK

text: Dɛm a nna ebɛnadze na wenyin ture no wura bɛyɛ? Ɔbɛba abɛsɛɛ ekuafo no, na ɔdze wenyin ture no ama afofor.
title: MARK

text: Ana hom nnkenkaan kyerɛw yi pɛn dɛ, Ɔbo a adantofo powee no, Ɔnoara na, ɔabɛyɛ kutuwdo bo;
title: MARK

text: Iyi Ewuradze na Ɔayɛ, Na ɔyɛ nwanwa wɔ hɛn enyiwa do?
title: MARK

text: Na wɔpɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ wɔkyer no; osiandɛ wohun dɛ bɛ yi a obui no tsia hɔn; naaso wosuroo nyimpadodow no ntsi wogyaa no hɔ kɔree.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔsomaa Farisiifo nye Herod akadofo no mu bi dɛ wonkodua ne kasaa do mfa nsun no efir nkyer no.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔbae no wɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yenyim dɛ eyɛ nokwafo, na ennyɛ nyimpa enyim nhwehwɛmu; eso innsuro nyimpa enyim asɛnka, na ekyerɛkyerɛ Nyankopɔn no kwan no wɔ nokwar mu. Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ yɛyi ntoboa ma Kaesar anaa oho?
title: MARK

text: Yɛmma anaa mma yɛmma? Na ohun hɔn ndabraba no ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rosɔ me ahwɛ yi? Hom mfa sika denare mbrɛ me ma monhwɛ.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔdze bae. Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Woana no mfonyi nye akyerɛw nye yi? Na wɔsee no dɛ, Kaesar dze a.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa dza ɔyɛ Kaesar dze mma Kaesar, na dza ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn dze mma Nyankopɔn. Na no ho yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa dodow.
title: MARK

text: Na Sadusiifo so bi a wɔka dɛ wunyan nnyi hɔ no baa ne nkyɛn; na wobisaa no dɛ,
title: MARK

text: Kyerɛkyerɛfo, Moses kyerɛwee maa hɛn dɛ, Sɛ obi no nua wu na ogya ne yer, na oenngya mba a, no nua nwar ne yer no na ɔnwo mba mma no nua.
title: MARK

text: Na enuanom beesuon wɔ hɔ: na nyia odzi kan no waar yer, na owui no, oenngya mba;
title: MARK

text: na nyia otsia ebien no waar no, na owui, na no so enngya mba; nyia otsia ebiasa no dɛmara;
title: MARK

text: na beesuon no enngya mba. Ne nyina ekyir no, ɔbaa no so wui.
title: MARK

text: Na wunyan no mu, hɔn mu woana na ɔbɛyɛ ne yer? Osiandɛ beesuon no awar no.
title: MARK

text: Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Ana nnyɛ yi ntsi na hom fom yi, dɛ hom nnyim kyerɛwsɛm no nye Nyankopɔn no tum no so?
title: MARK

text: Na wɔsoɛr fi ewufo mu a, wɔnnwar eso wɔmma awar, na wɔtse dɛ abɔfo a wɔwɔ sor.
title: MARK

text: Na ewufo ho no dze, dɛ wobenyan no, ana hom nnkenkaan no wɔ Moses nwoma no mu, mbrɛ Nyankopɔn kasaa kyerɛɛ no wɔ Haban no mu dɛ, Emi nye Abraham Nyankopɔn, Isaak Nyankopɔn, Jakob Nyankopɔn?
title: MARK

text: Ampaara, nnyɛ ewufo Nyankopɔn, mbom enyikamfo Nyankopɔn a: dɛm ntsi hom fom pii.
title: MARK

text: Na kyerɛwfo no mu baako bae bɛtsee dɛ woribisabisa nsɛm no, na ohun dɛ Jesus ebua hɔn yie no, obisaa no dɛ, Mbransɛm no nyina dza ɔwɔ hen na odzi kan?
title: MARK

text: Jesus buaa dɛ, Dza odzi kan no nye dɛ, Israel, tsie: Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze kor:
title: MARK

text: na dɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wɔ w’akoma nyina mu nye wo kra nyina mu, nye w’adwen nyina mu, nye w’ahoɔdzen nyina mu.
title: MARK

text: Na dza otsia ebien no nye yi: Dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa wo ho. Mbrasɛm biara nnyi hɔ a ɔso kyɛn yinom.
title: MARK

text: Na kyerɛwnyi no see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ampa aka no yie dɛ Nyankopɔn yɛ kor; na obi nnyi hɔ dɛ ɔno nko.
title: MARK

text: Na dɛ ebɔdɔ no wɔ w’akoma nyina mu, nye wo ntseasee nyina mu, nye w’ahoɔdzen nyina mu, na ebɔdɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa wo ho no, kyɛn hyew afɔr, nye afɔrbɔ nyina koraa.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus hun dɛ oebua nyansa mu no, ɔsee no dɛ, Ɔwo na Nyankopɔn n’ahenman no ntamu nntwe. Na obiara ennsi no bo dɛ obebisa no asɛm bi bio.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus rekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔrfi no mu no, obisaa dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na kyerɛwfo no ka dɛ Kraest no yɛ David ba?
title: MARK

text: Na David nankasa nam Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu ka dɛ, Ewuradze see m’Ewuradze dɛ, Tsena m’abanyimfa Kodu dɛ medze w’atamfo mebɛyɛ w’ananadzegua.
title: MARK

text: Dɛm ntsi David noara frɛ no Ewuradze; na ofi hen bɛyɛɛ ne ba? Nna nyimpadodow nyina dze enyigye tsiee no.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkae wɔ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ akyerɛwfo a wɔpɛ ntar atsentsen mu nantsew, nye gua do nkyiakyia;
title: MARK

text: ɔnye mpanyin gua wɔ nhyiamudan mu, nye mpanyin tsenabea wɔ edzidzi ase ho:
title: MARK

text: hɔn na wɔbɔ ekunafo epoo, na wopetuw bɔ mpaa atsentsen kyerɛ: mese, woyinom benya afɔbu kɛsenara.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔtsenaa ase wɔ sikakorabea no ne tsentsendo na ɔhwɛɛ mbrɛ nyimpadodow no sii dze sika guu sikakorabea no mu; na dodow a wɔyɛ ahonyafo no dze pii guu mu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbaa kunafo hianyi bi so bae bɔtoow mpɛsewamba ebien a wɔbɛyɛ pɛsewa kor guu mu.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus frɛɛ n’esuafo see hɔn dɛ, Meka no nokwar mu kyerɛ hom dɛ, okunafo hianyi yi dze pii ebogu mu akyɛn hɔn a wɔdze bi ebogu sikakorabea no mu no nyina:
title: MARK

text: osiandɛ hɔn nyina dza wɔwɔ ma abor hɔn do no, nna wɔdze bi ebogu mu, na oyi dze, ofi ne hia mu dze dza ɔwɔ nyina, n’asetsena nyina na ɔdze ebogu mu.
title: MARK

text: Na orifi asɔrfi mu no, n’esuafo no mu baako see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, hwɛ, abo akɛse bi nye aban akɛse bi so!
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Ehu aban akɛse yi? Wonnkegya ɔbo kor a ɔda kor do a wonnkodwuruw egu famu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔtse Ngo Bepɔw no do wɔ asɔrfi tsentsendo no, Peter, James, John nye Andrew bisaa no nsumaa mu dɛ,
title: MARK

text: Kyerɛ hɛn aber a iyinom bɛyɛ hɔ: na sɛ iyinom nyina rebɛba mu a, n’asɛnkyerɛdze nye dɛn?
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus hyɛɛ ase see hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie amma obi aanndaadaa hom.
title: MARK

text: Na dodowara bɛba wɔ me dzin mu dɛ, Emi nye no, na wɔadaadaa pii.
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ hom tse ko nye akosɛm a, mma hom akoma nntu: na otwar dɛ ɔba, na ewiei no nnyae nndurii.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔman bɔsoɛr ɔman do, na ahenman bɔsoɛr ahenman do; na asaasewosow bɛba mbeambea, na ɔkɔm bɛba: iyinom dze, awoko no ahyɛse ara a.
title: MARK

text: Na hom nhwɛ homho yie: na wobeyi hom akɔ mpanyimfo bagua mu, na wɔahwe hom wɔ nhyiamudan mu, na hom egyina ambradofo nye ahemfo enyim wɔ me ntsi, dze edzi dase akyerɛ hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na asɛmpa no, otwar dɛ wɔka kyerɛ amanaman nyina ansaana.
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ wɔdze hom rokɔ ekeyi hom ama a, mma hom nndwendwen dza hom bɛka ho ansaana: na biribi a wɔdze bɛma hom dɔn no mu no, ɔnoara na hom nka: osiandɛ nnyɛ hom na hom kasa, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no a.
title: MARK

text: Na nua beyi nua ama owu, egya beyi ɔba ama; na mba bɔsoɛr wɔ awofo do na wɔama woeku hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na nyimpa nyina bɛtan hom wɔ me dzin ntsi; na nyia ɔbɛtsena mu ekodu ewiei no, ɔno na wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ hom hu amambɔe ekyiwadze no dɛ ogyina mbrɛ ɔnnsɛ a (ma nyia ɔrekenkan no ntse ase dɛ ogyina hɔ ma ohonyi no), ɔno na hɔn a wɔwɔ Judea no nguan nkɔ nkokwaa do;
title: MARK

text: na mma nyimpa a ɔwɔ dan etsifi nnsian mmba dan mu, na eso mma ɔnnhɛn mu nnkɛfa biribi wɔ ne dan mu;
title: MARK

text: na mma nyia ɔwɔ haban mu no nnsan n’ekyir bio mmbɛfa ne nkatado.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn a wɔafa efur nye hɔn a wɔma numfo wɔ nda no mu ndue!
title: MARK

text: Na hom nsɔr ma iyinom aammba awɔwber mu.
title: MARK

text: Na nda no mu bɛba ahohiahia kɛse a ofitsi Nyankopɔn ne wiadze mbɔe ahyɛse araa bodu aber no ɔmmbaa dɛm da, eso bi remmba da.
title: MARK

text: Na sɛ Ewuradze enntwa nda no do tsia a, nkyɛ honam biara nnkenya nkwa, na ne mpamufo a ɔpaa hɔn no ntsi oetwa nda no do tsia.
title: MARK

text: Na aber no sɛ obiara se hom dɛ, Hwɛ, Kraest no wɔ ha, anaaso, Hwɛ, ɔwɔ hɔ no a, mma hom nngye nndzi,
title: MARK

text: na Kraest atorfo, nye nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo bɔsoɛr na wɔakyerɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze a sɛ anhwɛ a, wɔdze bɛdaadaa mpamufo no mpo.
title: MARK

text: Na hom dze, hom nhwɛ yie: osiandɛ medzi kan aka ne nyina akyerɛ hom.
title: MARK

text: Na dɛm ahohiahia nda no ekyir no, ewia bɛhyɛ sum, na bosoom nnkɛma ne kan,
title: MARK

text: na nworaba fi sor bɔtotɔ, na sor etum bɔwosow.
title: MARK

text: Ɔno na wobohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔreba wɔ nsuwusiw do, wɔ tum nye enyimnyam kɛse mu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔno na ɔbɔsoma n’abɔfoe ma wɔaakɔboaboa ne mpamufo no ano efi mframa anan no mu, ofi asaase ano kesi sor ano.
title: MARK

text: Hom nsua adɔmbadua no ho bɛ no: sɛ n’abaw yɛ momon, na oriyi ahaban a, nna hom nyim dɛ ɔhyewber abɛn;
title: MARK

text: dɛmara na hom so sɛ hom hu dɛ yinom yɛ hɔ a, hom nhu dɛ abɛn, edu abowano.
title: MARK

text: Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Mbasantsen yi nnkotwa mu akɔ gyedɛ yinom nyina ayɛ hɔ ansaana.
title: MARK

text: Ɔsor nye asaase botwa mu akɔ na me nsɛm dze, wonnkotwa mu akɔ da.
title: MARK

text: Na da no nye dɔn no dze obiara nnyim: abɔfo a wɔwɔ sor no so nnyim, Ɔba no so nnyim, gyedɛ Egya no nko.
title: MARK

text: Hom nhwɛ yie, hom nweɔn na hom mbɔ mpaa, na hom nnyim da pɔtsee a ber no bodu.
title: MARK

text: Ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a ɔrodɔ mu a ogyaa ne fi, na ɔmaa no nkowaa tum, na ɔmaa hɔn nyina hɔn edwuma nkorkor, na ɔhyɛɛ abowanohwɛfo no dɛ ɔnweɔn.
title: MARK

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nweɔn, na hom nnyim dɔn kor a ofiwura bɛba: adansaber o, esuom o, akokɔbɔnee o, anapahema o;
title: MARK

text: amma ɔaammba awerɛfir mu emmbohu hom dɛ hom deda.
title: MARK

text: Na dza meka kyerɛ hom yi, meka kyerɛ nyimpa nyina so dɛ, Hom nweɔn.
title: MARK

text: Nna aka nda ebien ma apaho nye epitsi afahyɛ no edu; na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no hwehwɛɛ mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ nam nyansa mu akyer Jesus na woeku no:
title: MARK

text: na wɔsee dɛ, Nnyɛ afahyɛ mu bi a, amma wentwiwentwi aammba ɔman no mu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔwɔ Bɛtani Simon kwatanyi no fie, na ɔtse edzidzi no, ɔbaa bi baa hɔ a ɔdze alabastron toa a nard ngohuam a ɔsom bo wɔ mu; na ɔbɔɔ toa no na ohuei guu n’etsifi.
title: MARK

text: Na binom wɔ hɔ a wonyaa ebufuw wɔ hɔn mu, na wɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na wɔresɛɛ ngohuam yi?
title: MARK

text: Nkyɛ wobotum atɔn ngohuam yi agye bɔbor sika denare ahaasa na wɔdze ama ehiafo. Na wohwinhwinii tsiaa no.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see dɛ, Hom ngyaa no; ebɛnadze ntsi na hom rehaw no? Ɔayɛ edwuma pa wɔ mo ho.
title: MARK

text: Na hom wɔ ehiafo wɔ hom nkyɛn daa, na aber biara a hom pɛ, hom botum ayɛ hɔn yie, na emi dze, hom nnyi me daa.
title: MARK

text: Ɔayɛ dza obotum: oedzi kan abɛsera me nyimpadua akɔ sie mu.
title: MARK

text: Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Beebiara a wɔbɛka asɛmpa yi wɔ wiadze nyina mu no, dza ɔbaa yi ayɛ so wɔbɛka dze ayɛ ne nkaa.
title: MARK

text: Na Judas Iskariot a ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako fii hɔ kɔr asɔfompanyin no nkyɛn dɛ obeyi Jesus ama hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔtsee no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn dɛw, na wɔbɔɔ anohoba dɛ wɔbɛma no sika. Na ɔhwehwɛɛ mbrɛ obesi eyi no ama wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu.
title: MARK

text: Na epitsi da a odzi kan a woku apahoguan no, n’esuafo no see no dɛ, Hen na epɛ dɛ yekesiesie ma ikedzi apaho no?
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsomaa n’esuafo no mu beenu, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ kurow no mu, na nyimpa bi a ɔso nsuhina behyia hom: hom nka no do;
title: MARK

text: na beebiara a ɔbɛhɛn no hom nse ofiwura no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo no se, M’ahɔhodan a menye m’esuafo bedzi mu apaho no wɔ hen?
title: MARK

text: Na ɔnoara ɔbɛkyerɛ hom sordan kɛse bi a wɔahyehyɛ mu, na woesiesie mu; hɔ na hom nsiesie mma hɛn.
title: MARK

text: Na esuafo no sii mu kɔree, na wɔbaa kurow no mu na wobohun dɛ mbrɛ ɔsee hɔn no, na wosiesiee apaho no.
title: MARK

text: Na odur ewimbir no, ɔnye duebien no bae.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔtwetwer hɔ ridzidzi no, Jesus see dɛ, Ampa mese hom dɛ, Hom mu baako a ɔnye me dzidzi na obeyi me ama.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn awerɛhow na wɔhyɛɛ ase nkorkor bisaa no dɛ, Ana emi a?
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Duebien no mu baako a ɔnye me to nsa wɔ ɔsɛn no mu no a.
title: MARK

text: Na nyimpa Ba no rokɔ, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ no ho; naaso nyimpa a wɔnam no do beyi nyimpa Ba no ama no ndue! Sɛ wɔannwo dɛm nyimpa no a, nkyɛ oye ma no.
title: MARK

text: Na woridzidzi no, ɔfaa paanoo na ohyiraa do na obubui, na ɔdze maa hɔn; na ɔsee dɛ, Hom ngye: iyi nye me nyimpadua.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔfaa kɔɔpow na ɔdaa ase no, ɔdze maa hɔn ma hɔn nyina nomee.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Iyi nye mo bɔgyaa a ɔyɛ ahyɛmu no a dodowara ntsi woruhue egu no.
title: MARK

text: Nokwar mese hom dɛ, moronnom wenyinaba no bi bio, dze ekodu da a mobɔnom no fofor wɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔtoow ndwom no, wofiir edzi kɔr Ngo Bepɔw no do.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Wɔbɔto hom nyina fintsidua: na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Mobɔbɔ oguanhwɛfo no, na nguan no abɔ apetse.
title: MARK

text: Naaso mo wusoɛr ekyir no mibedzi hom enyim akɔ Galilii.
title: MARK

text: Na Peter see no dɛ, Sɛ wɔbɔto hɔn nyina fintsidua mpo a, nnyɛ emi a.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Nokwar mese wo dɛ, Ndɛ anadwe yi, ansaana akokɔ bɔbɔn mprɛnu no, ebɛpa me mprɛnsa.
title: MARK

text: Na Peter dze, mbom ɔkaa no enyiberdo dɛ, Sɛ menye wo bowu mpo a, meremmpa wo da; na dɛmara na hɔn nyina so kae.
title: MARK

text: Na wodur beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Getsemane; na ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, Hom ntsena ha ma monkɔsɔr.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔfaa Peter nye James nye John kaa noho, na ɔhyɛɛ ase bɔɔ hu na ɔbɔmee.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Awerɛhow ahyɛ me kra do dze kɔ owu mu: hom ntsena ha, na hom nweɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkɔr enyim kakra, na ɔkɔhwee famu na ɔsɔɔr dɛ, sɛ ɔbɛyɛ a, dɔn no mpa no ho nkɔ.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Aba, Egya! Adze biara nnso wo yɛ: yi kɔɔpow yi pa mo ho; naaso nnyɛ dza mepɛ bi a, na dza ɔwo epɛ a.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbae bohun dɛ wɔdeda, na ɔsee Peter dɛ, Simon, ana ada? Ana enntum annweɔn dɔnhwer kor mpo?
title: MARK

text: Hom nweɔn na hom nsɔr, amma hom aannkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu: sunsum no pɛ dze, naaso honam yɛ mberɛw.
title: MARK

text: Na osii mu kɔr bio, na ɔkɔsɔree kaa asɛm kor no ara.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsanee bae bohun hɔn dɛ wɔdeda bio, na hɔn enyiwa akom; na woennya mbuae bi amma no.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔbaa ne mpɛn ebiasa, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nda dza aka yi, na hom nhom. Ayɛ yie! Dɔn no edu; hwɛ, woriyi nyimpa Ba no ahyɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo nsa.
title: MARK

text: Hom nsoɛr ma yɛnkɔ; hwɛ, nyia oriyi me ama no abɛn.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔnara, ɔda do rekasa no, Judas a ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako bae, na nyimpadodow a wɔdzedze nkrantsee nye mpɔtsibaa fi asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no hɔ ka no ho.
title: MARK

text: Na nyia oyii no mae no maa hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze dɛ, Nyia mebɛfew n’ano no, nye ɔno: hom nkyer no na hom nsuo no mu yie mfa no nkɔ.
title: MARK

text: Na odur hɔ no, ntsɛmara na ɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn na ɔsee no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, na ɔfeew n’ano.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔdze hɔn nsa susuoo no mu na wɔkyekyeer no.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn a wogyinagyina hɔ no mu baako twee ne krantsee bɔɔ ɔsɔfopanyin n’akowaa twaa n’aso.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Ana hom firii baa mo do dɛ hom reba owifo do, na hom dze nkrantsee nye mpɔtsibaa rebɛkyer me yi?
title: MARK

text: Daa mowɔ hom nkyɛn wɔ asɔrfi mu kyerɛkyerɛe no, hom annkyer me; na dɛ kyerɛwsɛm no bɛba mu ntsi a.
title: MARK

text: Na esuafo no nyinara gyaa no hɔ, na woguanee.
title: MARK

text: Na aberantsɛ baako bi kaa no do a nna oetu ndwera akata n’adagyaw do; na wɔkyeer no;
title: MARK

text: na ogyaa ndwera no hɔ na ɔdze adagyaw guanee.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔdze Jesus kɔr ɔsɔfopanyin no hɔ; na asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo nye kyerɛwfo no nyina behyiaa ne nkyɛn.
title: MARK

text: Na Peter dzii n’ekyir wɔ ekyirekyir dze kodur ɔsɔfopanyin n’abanguado, na ɔnye asomfo no kɛtsenaa hɔ too gya.
title: MARK

text: Na asɔfompanyin nye baguafo no nyina hwehwɛɛ dɛ wobenya Jesus ho dase bi dze eeku no; naaso woennya bi.
title: MARK

text: Na dodowara gyee no ho dasewia, na hɔn dasee annsaa.
title: MARK

text: Na binom soɛree gyee no ho dasewia dɛ,
title: MARK

text: Yɛtsee dɛ ɔsee dɛ, Mubodwuruw asɔrdan a wɔdze nsa ayɛ yi na ndaansa mu matow bi a wɔammfa nsa annyɛ.
title: MARK

text: Na dɛm no mpo so hɔn dasee annsaa.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsɔfopanyin no gyinaa finimfin na obisaa Jesus dɛ, Immbua bi? Ebɛnadze na yinom regye wo ho dase yi?
title: MARK

text: Na omuaa n’ano, na oemmbua bi. Na ɔsɔfopanyin no bisaa no bio dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye Kraest no, nyia woehyira no no ne Ba no?
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus see dɛ, Emi nye no: na hom bohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔtse tum no abanyimfa, na ɔreba wɔ sor nsuwusiw mu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsɔfopanyin no sunsuaan n’atar mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛn hia na ohia hɛn adasefo bio?
title: MARK

text: Hom atse ebususɛm no: hom dwen dɛn? Na hɔn nyinara buu no fɔ dɛ ɔsɛ owu.
title: MARK

text: Na binom hyɛɛ ase hinaa ntafi guu no do, na wɔkataa n’enyi, na wɔbobɔɔ no ekutuku, na wɔsee no dɛ, Hyɛ nkɔm! Na asomfo no bobɔɔ no asotɔr.
title: MARK

text: Na Peter wɔ ase wɔ abangua no do hɔ no, ɔsɔfopanyin ne mbaawa no mu baako bae,
title: MARK

text: na ohun Peter dɛ ɔroto gya no, ɔhwɛɛ no dzinn na ɔsee no dɛ, Ɔwo so nye Nazarɛtnyi Jesus nam.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsaan dɛ, Minnyim no, eso menntse dza ereka yi ase mpo. Na ofiir edzi kɔr paado; na akokɔ bɔnee.
title: MARK

text: Na abaawa no hun no na ɔhyɛɛ ase see hɔn a wogyina hɔ no dɛ, Oyi so fi hɔn mu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsaan bio. Na ɔkyɛɛr kakra no, hɔn a wogyina hɔ no see Peter bio dɛ, Ampa dɛ ifi hɔn mu, osiandɛ eyɛ Galiliinyi.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii nsew na ɔkekaa ntam dɛ, Minnyim nyimpa yi a hom reka no ho asɛm yi.
title: MARK

text: Na ntsɛmara na akokɔ bɔɔn ne mpɛn ebien. Na Peter kaa asɛm no a Jesus kaa kyerɛɛ no no dɛ, Ansaana akokɔ bɔbɔn mprɛnu no, ebɛpa me mprɛnsa. Na ɔhyɛɛ ase sui.
title: MARK

text: Na adze kyee ara nna asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no nye kyerɛwfo nye baguafo no nyina kɔr apam, na wɔkyekyeer Jesus dze no kɔree kɛhyɛɛ Pilate nsa.
title: MARK

text: Na Pilate bisaa no dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye Jewfo Hen no? Na Jesus buaa no see dɛ, Ɔwoara na aka.
title: MARK

text: Na asɔfompanyin no toatoaa no pii.
title: MARK

text: Na Pilate bisaa no bio see dɛ, Ana irummbua hwee? Hwɛ ndzɛmba pii a wɔdze toatoa wo yi.
title: MARK
