text: Naaso Jesus emmbua hwee bio, na ɔyɛɛ Pilate nwanwa.
title: MARK

text: Nna afahyɛ du a, ɔtɔ dɛ Pilate gyaa daduanyi kor biara a wɔbɛserɛ no ma hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Nna woegu nyimpa bi a wɔfrɛ no Barabbas nye hɔn a wɔka no ho a wɔtseew etua na wɔnam etuatsew no do dzii ewu no mpokyerɛ.
title: MARK

text: Na nyimpadodow no kɔr Pilate hɔ hyɛɛ ase serɛɛ no dɛ ɔnyɛ mma hɔn dɛ mbrɛ ɔtɔ dɛ ɔyɛ no.
title: MARK

text: Na Pilate buaa hɔn dɛ, Ana hom pɛ dɛ migyaa Jewfo Hen no mema hom?
title: MARK

text: Na ohun dɛ enyitan ntsi na asɔfompanyin no yii no mae.
title: MARK

text: Na asɔfompanyin no hyɛɛ nyimpadodow no tsipia dɛ mbom ongyaa Barabbas mma hɔn.
title: MARK

text: Na Pilate buae see hɔn bio dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom pɛ dɛ meyɛ nyia hom frɛ no Jewfo Hen no?
title: MARK

text: Na wɔtseaa mu bio dɛ, Bɔ no mbeamudua mu!
title: MARK

text: Na Pilate see hɔn dɛ, Ebɛn bɔn na ɔayɛ? Na wɔtseatseaa mu mbordo dɛ, Bɔ no mbeamudua mu!
title: MARK

text: Na Pilate pɛɛ dɛ ɔma nyimpadodow no abodwee no, ogyaa Barabbas maa hɔn, na Jesus dze, ɔkaa no mpire no, oyii no mae dɛ wɔnkɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
title: MARK

text: Na nsordaafo no dze no kɔr abangua no a ɔyɛ Ambrado Aban no do; na wɔfrɛfrɛɛ nsordaafokuw no nyina boaa ano.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔdze tam memen furaa no, na wɔbɔɔ nsoɛ katraka soaa no;
title: MARK

text: na wɔhyɛɛ ase kyiakyiaa no dɛ, Jewfo Hen nye yi o!
title: MARK

text: Na wɔdze ndzɛmbir bɔɔ n’etsifi, na wohinahinaa ntafi guu no do, na wobuu ntwɛr sɔɔr no.
title: MARK

text: Na wosii no atwetwe wiei no woyii tam memen no wɔ no ho, na wɔdze nankasa n’atar hyɛɛ no, na wɔdze no kɔr dɛ wɔrokɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔhyɛɛ Simon Sirenenyi bi a ofi kwaa mu rutwa mu, Alɛksandar nye Rufus hɔn egya no, dɛ ɔnsoa ne mbeamudua no.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔdze no kɔr beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Golgota a ne nkyerɛase nye Tsikwankora Bea.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔmaa no wenyin a wɔdze eduhuam mɛɛr afora mu, naaso ɔannom.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu, na wɔkyɛɛ n’atar mu, twee tonto hwehwɛɛ dza obiara bɛfa.
title: MARK

text: Na anapa ndɔnkron no mu na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔkyerɛɛw dza wogyinaa do buu no fɔ no wɔ n’etsifi dɛ JEWFO HEN.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔbɔɔ edwotwafo beenu mbeamudua mu kaa no ho, ɔbaako wɔ n’enyimfa, na ɔbaako wɔ n’abankum.
title: MARK

text: [Na kyerɛw no a ɔka dɛ, Wɔkaan no foraa emumuyɛfo no, baa mu.]
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn a worutwa mu no, kaa ebususɛm tsiaa no na wɔwosowosoow hɔn tsir dɛ, Ɛhɛɛ! Ɔwo a idwuruw asɔrdan no na etow no ndaansa mu,
title: MARK

text: gye woho fi mbeamudua yi ho si famu ɛ!
title: MARK

text: Dɛmara so na asɔfompanyin no nye akyerɛwfo no sii no atwetwe dɛ, Ɔgyee binom: naaso onntum nngye nankasa noho.
title: MARK

text: Afei wɔmma Kraest no, Israel Hen no, mfi mbeamudua no ho nsi famu, ma yenhu na yɛngye ndzi ɛ. Na hɔn a wɔbɔɔ hɔn mbeamudua mu kaa no ho no so yaaw no bi.
title: MARK

text: Na ewiaber duebien durii no, sum hyɛɛ asaase no nyina do kodur ndɔnebiasa no.
title: MARK

text: Na ndɔnebiasa no mu no, Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu dɛ, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani? Ne nkyerɛase nye dɛ, Me Nyankopɔn, me Nyankopɔn, ɔyɛ dɛn na apa me yi?
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn a wogyinaa hɔ binom tsee no, wɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, ɔrefrɛ Elija.
title: MARK

text: Na baako tuu mbirika dze sapɔw kɔbɔɔ wenyin yerɛyerɛw mu, dze tuaa ndzɛmbir ano maa no dɛ ɔnnom, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom ngyaa ma yɛnhwɛ dɛ Elija bɛba ebeyi no anaa.
title: MARK

text: Na Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu no, ogyaa no sunsum mu.
title: MARK

text: Na asɔrdan no mu ntwamutam no tseew ebien fii sor besii ase.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔhamupanyin a ogyinaa hɔ wɔ ne tsentsendo no, ohun dɛ oegyaa no sunsum mu dɛm no, ɔsee dɛ, Ampaara, nyimpa yi Nyankopɔn Ba a.
title: MARK

text: Na mbaa bi so wɔ hɔ a wofi ekyir hwɛe: hɔn mu binom nye Mary Magdalene, Mary, James kuma nye Josef hɔn na, nye Salome;
title: MARK

text: na hɔn so na ɔwɔ Galilii no, wɔkaa no do na wɔsoom no, wɔnye mbaa pii a wɔnye no baa Jerusalɛm.
title: MARK

text: Na odur ewimbir no, nna ɔyɛ Ahosiesieda, ɔnye da a odzi ahomgyeda no enyim ntsi no,
title: MARK

text: Josef a ofi Arimatea, baguanyi nyimnyamfo a ɔno so rohwɛ Nyankopɔn ahenman kwan no bae, na osii no bo kɔr Pilate hɔ kɛserɛɛ Jesus no fun no.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔyɛɛ Pilate nwanwa dɛ oewu dada; na ɔfrɛɛ ɔhamupanyin no bisaa no dɛ owui akyɛr anaa.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔtsee no wɔ ɔhamupanyin no hɔ no, ɔdze fun no kyɛɛ Josef.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔtɔɔ ndwera bi, na oyii no dze no kyekyeer ndwera no mu, na ɔdze no too nda a woetwa no ɔbotan bi mu no mu, na opireew ɔbo hiin nda no ano.
title: MARK

text: Na Mary Magdalene nye Mary, Joses ne na, hwɛɛ mbrɛ wɔdze no toe.
title: MARK

text: Na ahomgyeda no twaa mu no, Mary Magdalene nye James ne na Mary nye Salome, tɔɔ nduhuam dɛ wɔdze rokɔ akɛsera no.
title: MARK

text: Na da a odzi dapɛn no kan no n’anapatutuitu na wɔkɔr nda no do, nna ewia epue.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Woana bepirew ɔbo no efi nda no ano ama hɛn?
title: MARK

text: Na wɔtoo hɔn enyi no wohun dɛ woepirew ɔbo no efi hɔ: osiandɛ ɔso kɛsenara.
title: MARK

text: Na wɔhɛɛn nda no mu no, wohun aberantsɛ bi a ɔtse nyimfa hyɛ atar fufuw tsentsen, na wɔbɔɔ hu.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma hom mmbɔ hu: hom rohwehwɛ Jesus Nazarɛtnyi a wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no; Ɔasoɛr: onnyi ha. Hwɛ mbrɛ wɔdze no toe!
title: MARK

text: Na hom nkɔ nkɛka nkyerɛ n’esuafo no, ɔnye Peter, dɛ, Oedzi hom enyim kɔ Galilii: hɔ na hom bohu no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔsee hom no.
title: MARK

text: Na wofiir edzi fiir nda no ho guanee, na ahopopo nye ahobow kaa hɔn, na wɔannka hwee annkyerɛ obiara, osiandɛ wosuroi.
title: MARK

text: [Na ɔsoɛɛr da a odzi dapɛn no kan no anapatutuitu no, odzii kan yii noho kyerɛɛ Mary Magdalene a otuu mbɔnsam esuon fii no mu no.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔkɔree kɛkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn a wɔnye no tsenae a woridzi nkɔmbɔ na worusu no.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn dze wɔtsee dɛ ɔtse ase na oehu no no, wɔanngye enndzi.
title: MARK

text: Na n’ekyir no woyii no wɔ suban fofor mu kyerɛɛ hɔn mu beenu a wɔnam rokɔ ekuraase;
title: MARK

text: na hɔn so kɔree kɛkaa kyerɛɛ nkaa no; na wɔanngye hɔn so enndzi.
title: MARK

text: N’ekyir no a dubiako no tse edzidzi no, woyii no kyerɛɛ hɔn, na otwuuw hɔn enyim wɔ hɔn ekyingye nye hɔn akoma dzen ntsi, osiandɛ wɔanngye hɔn a wohun no dɛ ɔasoɛr no enndzi.
title: MARK

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ wiadze nyinara nkɛka asɛmpa no nkyerɛ abɔdze nyina.
title: MARK

text: Nyia ɔgye dzi na wonuma no no, obenya nkwa, na nyia ɔnngye nndzi no, wobobu no fɔ.
title: MARK

text: Na nsɛnkyerɛdze yi bɛka hɔn a wɔgye dzi do: wɔnam me dzin do botu mbɔnsam; wɔbɛkasa kasa fofor;
title: MARK

text: wɔbɛma nwɔ do, na sɛ wɔnom bɔr biara a, ɔrennyɛ hɔn hwee; wɔdze hɔn nsa bogu ayarfo do na hɔn ho ayɛ hɔn dzen.
title: MARK

text: Na afei Ewuradze Jesus kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn ekyir no, wɔfaa no kɔr sor, na ɔkɛtsenaa Nyankopɔn abanyimfa.
title: MARK

text: Na hɔn dze, wofii hɔ kɔree kɛkaa asɛm no wɔ mbea nyina, Ewuradze nye hɔn yɛɛ edwuma, na ɔdze nsɛnkyerɛdze hyɛɛ asɛm no dzen.] Amen.
title: MARK

text: Ɔnam dɛ dodowara dze ato hɔn do dɛ wɔbɛkyerɛw ndzɛmba a aba mu wɔ hɛn mu no esiado esiado,
title: LUKE

text: dɛ mbrɛ hɔn a ahyɛse no wɔdze hɔn enyiwa hunii na wɔyɛɛ asɛm no ho asomfo no dze abrɛ hɛn no ntsi;
title: LUKE

text: Onyimnyamfo Kɛse Teofilus, mohwɛ a oye ma mo so dɛ mahwehwɛ ne nyina mu pɛpɛɛpɛ fitsi ahyɛse yi, mekyerɛw no esiado esiado brɛ wo,
title: LUKE

text: ama eehu nsɛm a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ wo no no mu nokwar.
title: LUKE

text: Judea ɔhen Herod n’aber do no, nna ɔsɔfo bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Zekaria a ofi Abija no kuw mu; na ne yer nye Aaron ne mbabaa no mu bi a wɔfrɛ no Elizabet.
title: LUKE

text: Nna hɔn beenu nyina yɛ atseneneefo wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim, na wodzii Ewuradze ne mbransɛm ɔnye n’ahyɛdze no nyina do, dɛ asɛm biara ho nnyi,
title: LUKE

text: mbom nna wonnyi ba, osiandɛ nna Elizabet yɛ ɔbɔnyin, na afei hɔn beenu nyina so enyinyin papaapa.
title: LUKE

text: Da bi nna esi n’asɔfokuw do dɛ wɔyɛ edwuma wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim,
title: LUKE

text: na dɛ mbrɛ asɔfo dwuma no ne nhyehyɛɛ tse no, wɔtwee tonto yii no dɛ ɔnkɔ Ewuradze asɔrdan no mu nkɛhyew eduhuam.
title: LUKE

text: Na ber a ɔrehyew eduhuam no, nna ɔman no nyimpadodow nyina gyina abowano rosɔr.
title: LUKE

text: Na Ewuradze no bɔfoe begyinaa eduhuam afɔrmbukyia no nyimfa yii noho kyerɛɛ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na Zekaria hun no no, n’akoma tui, na hu kaa no.
title: LUKE

text: Na bɔfo no see no dɛ, Mma nnsuro, Zekaria, na wɔatse wo nkotoserɛ, na wo yer Elizabet bɔwo babanyin ama wo, na ato no dzin John.
title: LUKE

text: Na ibenya dɛw nye enyigye, na nyimpa dodowara bedzi n’awoo ho dɛw.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbɛyɛ kɛse wɔ Ewuradze enyim, na ɔnnkɔnom wenyin anaaso nsa biara, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bɛhyɛ no ma fi ne na ne yamu mpo.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbɛdan Israelmba dodowara aba Ewuradze hɔn Nyankopɔn hɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔnam Elija no sunsum nye no tum mu bedzi n’enyim akɛdan egyanom hɔn akoma aba hɔn mba ho, nye asoɔdzenfo aba tseneneefo hɔn nyimdzee mu, na oesiesie ɔman a wɔaboaboa hɔnho ama Ewuradze.
title: LUKE

text: Na Zekaria see bɔfo no dɛ, Mubodua dɛn mehu yi? Osiandɛ meyɛ akɔdaa na me yer so edzi mfe pii.
title: LUKE

text: Na bɔfo no buae see no dɛ, Emi nye Gabriel a migyina Nyankopɔn enyim, na wɔasoma me dɛ membɛkasa nkyerɛ wo, na menka wo nsɛmpa yi.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, ebɔtɔ mmum, na irunntum nnkasa dze akɛpem da a yinom bɛyɛ hɔ, osiandɛ anngye me nsɛm a ɔbɛba mu wɔ n’aber do no enndzi.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔyɛɛ nkorɔfo a wɔrotweɔn Zekaria no nwanwa dɛ ɔakyɛr dɛm wɔ asɔrdan no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na opuei no, oenntum annkasa annkyerɛ hɔn; na wohun dɛ oekenya enyido adzehu bi wɔ asɔrdan mu hɔ; na ɔnodze, ɔkɔr do araa dze ne nsa yɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze osiandɛ nna ɔda ho araa tɔ mmum.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ no som nda wiee du no, osii mu kɔr nankasa ne fie.
title: LUKE

text: Na nda no ekyir no ne yer Elizabet nyinsenii na osumaa noho abosoom enum see dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Dza Ewuradze ayɛ me, wɔ nda a ɔabɔhwɛ me dɛ obeyi m’enyimguase wɔ nyimpa mu no, nye yi.
title: LUKE

text: Na bosoom a otsia esia no mu no, Nyankopɔn somaa ɔbɔfo Gabriel wɔ Galilii kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Nazarɛt,
title: LUKE

text: wɔ ɔbaabun bi a wɔdze no ama ɔbanyin bi a wɔfrɛ no Josef a ofi David ebusua mu no awar no hɔ; na ɔbaabun no ne dzin dze Mary.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa no hɔ bɛsee no dɛ, Ei, ɔwo a wɔadom wo kɛse, dzi dɛw! Ewuradze dzi w’ekyir.
title: LUKE

text: Na n’akoma tui wɔ kasa no ho, na ɔdwendween ne tsir mu dɛ ebɛn nkyia na iyi bɛyɛ.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbɔfo no see no dɛ, Mary, mma nnsuro, na enya Nyankopɔn enyim adom.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, ibenyinsen, na awo babanyin na ato no dzin JESUS.
title: LUKE

text: Ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ kɛse, na wɔbɛfrɛ no nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no ne Ba; na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn dze n’egya David ahengua no bɛma no,
title: LUKE

text: na obedzi Jakob fi do hen daapem, na n’ahendzi nnkɔbɔ adze da.
title: LUKE

text: Na Mary see ɔbɔfo no dɛ, Minnyim banyin yi, yinom besi dɛn aba mu?
title: LUKE

text: Na bɔfo no buae see no dɛ, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bɛba wo do, na nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no n’ahoɔdzen bɛkata wo do; dɛm ntsi so adze krɔnkrɔn a wɔbɔwo no no, wɔbɛfrɛ no Nyankopɔn Ba.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, wo busuanyi Elizabet so enyinsen babanyin wɔ ne mberwaber mu, na nyia wɔfrɛ no ɔbɔnyin no, n’abosoom esia nye yi.
title: LUKE

text: Na Nyankopɔn afamu dze, biribiara nnyi hɔ a onntum nnyɛ hɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Na Mary see dɛ, Hwɛ, Ewuradze afonabaa nye me: ɔnyɛ hɔ mma me dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm se. Na bɔfo no fii ne nkyɛn kɔree.
title: LUKE

text: Na nda no mu ara Mary soɛɛr ntsɛntsɛm kɔr Juda nkokodo nkurow no bi mu;
title: LUKE

text: na ɔkɛhɛɛn Zekaria fie kekyiaa Elizabet.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Elizabet tsee Mary ne nkyia no, ɔba no huruuw ne yamu; na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn hyɛɛ Elizabet ma,
title: LUKE

text: na ɔdze ndze kɛse kasae see dɛ, Nhyira aka wo wɔ mbasiafo mu, na nhyira aka wo yamu aba.
title: LUKE

text: Na iyi fi hen ba mo hɔ, dɛ m’Ewuradze ne na bɛba me nkyɛn?
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, ntsɛmara a wo nkyia twaa m’asomu no, na abofra no dze dɛw huruhuruwii wɔ mo mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na nhyira aka nyia ɔagye edzi: na dza Ewuradze ama wɔabɛka akyerɛ no no bɛba mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na Mary see dɛ: Me kra tonton Ewuradze,
title: LUKE

text: Na mo sunsum dzi dɛw wɔ me Nyankopɔn m’Agyenkwa no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Osiandɛ ɔabɔhwɛ n’afonabaa wɔ ne mbrɛadze asetsena mu: Na hwɛ, ofitsi ndɛ ebusuasantsen nyina bɛfrɛ me osiarfo.
title: LUKE

text: Osiandɛ Otumfo ayɛ adze kɛse ama me; na Ne dzin nye krɔnkrɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na n’ehumbɔbɔr wɔ hɔn a wosuro no do fi ebusuasantsen do kɛpem ebusuasantsen.
title: LUKE

text: Ɔdze ne basa akyerɛ ahoɔdzen, Ɔapansam nkontompɔfo wɔ hɔn akoma adwen mu.
title: LUKE

text: Oetu etumfo efi hɔn nhengua do, Na ɔama hɔn a wɔbrɛ adze no do.
title: LUKE

text: Ɔdze ndzepa amee hɔn a ɔkɔm dze hɔn, na oegya ahonyafo kwan wɔ yafumpan mu.
title: LUKE

text: Oesuo n’akowaa Israel mu dɛ ɔdze bɛkaa n’ehumbɔbɔr,
title: LUKE

text: dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom no, ama Abraham nye n’asefo daa.
title: LUKE

text: Na Mary nye Elizabet tsenaa bɛyɛ abosoom ebiasa, na ɔsanee kɔr noara ne fie.
title: LUKE

text: Na Elizabet n’aber a ɔdze bɔwo durii, na ɔwoo babanyin.
title: LUKE

text: Na no sɔnmufo nye n’ebusuafo tsee ehumbɔbɔr kɛse a Ewuradze dze ehu no, na wɔnye no dzii dɛw.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ne ndaawɔtwe soe no, wɔbaa dɛ worubotwa abofra no twatsia, na wɔpɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ wɔbɛfrɛ no Zekaria, dɛ mbrɛ n’egya ne dzin tse,
title: LUKE

text: naaso ne na buae see dɛ, Oho, na wɔbɛfrɛ no John.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Obiara nnyi w’ebusua mu a ne dzin dze dɛm.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔdze nsa bisaa n’egya dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ dɛ wɔfrɛ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na obisaa kyerɛwpon kyerɛɛw do dɛ, Ne dzin nye John. Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nyina nwanwa.
title: LUKE

text: Na n’ano nye ne tɛkyerɛma buee amonmu hɔ ara, na ɔkasae yii Nyankopɔn ayɛw.
title: LUKE

text: Na hu kaa hɔn a wɔtsetse hɔn nkyɛn nyina, na nsɛm yi nyina wɔkekae wɔ Judea nkokodo nkurow nyina mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔtsee nyina dze too hɔn akoma mu dɛ, Abofra bɛn na oyi bɛyɛ? Osiandɛ Ewuradze ne nsa wɔ no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na n’egya Zekaria dze, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bɛhyɛɛ no ma na ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Nhyira nka Ewuradze, Israel Nyankopɔn; Osiandɛ ɔabɔhwɛ no nkorɔfo na ɔapon hɔn,
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔama nkwagye ambɛn do ama hɛn Wɔ n’akowaa David fie,
title: LUKE

text: dɛ mbrɛ ɔnam no nkɔnhyɛfo krɔnkrɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ fi tsetse no hɔn ano do kae no,
title: LUKE

text: dɛ wɔngye hɛn mfi hɛn atamfo nye hɔn a wokyir hɛn nyina nsamu;
title: LUKE

text: Dɛ ɔbɛyɛ ehumbɔbɔr ama hɛn egyanom, na ɔakaa n’ahyɛmu krɔnkrɔn no;
title: LUKE

text: ntam a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɛn egya Abraham,
title: LUKE

text: dɛ ɔbɛma woeyi hɛn efi hɛn atamfo nsamu, na yɛasom no dɛ hu nnyi mu,
title: LUKE

text: wɔ ahotsewee nye tsenenee mu wɔ n’enyim hɛn nkwa nda nyina.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔwo abofra yi, wɔbɛfrɛ wo nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no nkɔnhyɛnyi: Osiandɛ ibedzi Ewuradze n’enyim kan ekesiesie n’akwan mu,
title: LUKE

text: dze nkwagye ho nyimdzee akɛma no nkorɔfo wɔ hɔn bɔnfakyɛ mu a
title: LUKE

text: ofi hɛn Nyankopɔn n’ayamuhyehye mbɔbɔrhu no mu, a ɔnam do ma adzekyee a ofi sor abɔhwɛ hɛn no,
title: LUKE

text: dɛ ɔbɛhyerɛn ama hɔn a wɔtsetse sum mu nye owu no sunsuma ase; na wɔatsentsen hɛn anan akɔ asomdwee kwan no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na abofra no nyinii, na ɔyɛɛ dzen wɔ sunsum mu; na ɔtsenaa sar no do kodur da a ɔdze noho kɛkyerɛɛ Israel.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu no, mbra bi fii Kaesar Augustus hɔ baa dɛ wɔnkan wiadze nyina nkyerɛw hɔn edzin.
title: LUKE

text: Iyi nye ɔkankyerɛw asɔpɔn no a wɔyɛɛ no ber a Kerinius dzi Siria ambrado no.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyimpa nyina kɔr hɔnara hɔn nkurow mu dɛ wɔnkyerɛw hɔn dzin.
title: LUKE

text: Na Josef so fii Galilii, wɔ Nazarɛt kurow no mu, kɔr Judea, David kurow a wɔfrɛ no Bɛtlɛhɛm no mu, osiandɛ ofi David fie nye n’ebusua mu ntsi,
title: LUKE

text: ama wɔaakan ɔno nye n’esiyer Mary a ne yafun no enyin no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, wɔwɔ hɔ no, ne nda a ɔsɛ dɛ ɔdze wo durii.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔwoo n’abakan banyimba, na ɔdze adasoe kyekyeer no ho, na ɔdze no too mbowa edzidzidaka mu, osiandɛ ɔkwan nnyi ahɔhodan no mu ma hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Nna nguanhwɛfo bi wɔ ɔman no ara mu, da haban mu roweɔn hɔn nguankuw anadwe.
title: LUKE

text: Na Ewuradze bɔfoe begyinaa hɔn nkyɛn, na Ewuradze n’enyimnyam hyerɛnee bɔɔ hɔn ho aprɔw, na hu kaa hɔn kɛse.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbɔfo no see hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro; na hwɛ, mebrɛ hom nsɛmpa a ɔyɛ dɛw kɛse a ɔbɛyɛ aman nyina dze,
title: LUKE

text: na ndɛ wɔawo Agyenkwa ama hom wɔ David kurow mu, ɔno nye Kraest Ewuradze.
title: LUKE

text: Na iyi nye hom asɛnkyerɛdze: hom bohu abofra bi dɛ ɔkyekyer adasoe mu da mbowa edzidzidaka mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na awerɛfir mu ara ɔsor dɔm pii bɛkaa ɔbɔfo no ho yii Nyankopɔn ayɛw see dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Enyimnyam nka Nyankopɔn wɔ sorsor, Na asomdwee nka nyimpa a wɔsɔ n’enyi wɔ asaase do.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ abɔfo no fii hɔn nkyɛn kɔr sor no, nguanhwɛfo no sesee hɔnho dɛ, Hom mma yɛnkɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm nkɔhwɛ dza ɔaba a Ewuradze eyi akyerɛ hɛn yi.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔbaa ntsɛntsɛm, na wobohun Mary nye Josef nye abofra no dɛ ɔda mbowa edzidzidaka mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na wobohun no no, wɔkaa asɛm a wɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ abofra no ho no ma ɔtahyee.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔtsee nyina, dza nguanhwɛfo no kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa.
title: LUKE

text: Na Mary dze, ɔdze nsɛm yi nyina siei, na ɔdween ho wɔ n’akoma mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na nguanhwɛfo no sanee kɔree kɛhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam na woyii no ayɛw wɔ dza wɔtsee na wokohunii dɛ mbrɛ wɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn nyina tse no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ndaawɔtwe durii a worubotwa no twatsia no, wɔtoo no dzin JESUS, dɛ mbrɛ bɔfo no dze too no ana woribenyinsen no yafun mu no.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn ahoguar da no durii dɛ mbrɛ Moses mbra se no, wɔdze no kɔr Jerusalɛm dɛ wɔdze no rekɛkyɛ Ewuradze,
title: LUKE

text: dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no Ewuradze ne mbra mu dɛ, Banyimba biara a obobue awotoa ano no, wɔbɛfrɛ no krɔnkrɔn ama Ewuradze,
title: LUKE

text: na wɔakɔbɔ afɔr dɛ mbrɛ wɔkaa no Ewuradze mbra no mu no, Ntamram ebien, anaadɛ mbuburmba ebien.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi wɔ Jerusalɛm a ne dzin dze Simeon; na ɔyɛ nyimpa nyamesuronyi a ɔtsen, ɔrotweɔn Israel awerɛkyekyer, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn wɔ no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn yii kyerɛɛ no dɛ onnkohu wu gyedɛ oehu Ewuradze ne Kraest no ana.
title: LUKE

text: Na Sunsum no dze no baa asɔrdan no mu: ber a abofra Jesus n’awofo dze no baa dɛ wɔrebɛyɛ mbrɛ mbra no n’atɔrmuadze tse ama no no.
title: LUKE

text: Nna Simeon faa no too n’abaw mu, yii Nyankopɔn ayɛw na afei ɔkaa dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Ewuradze, nkyii gya w’akowaa kwan asomdwee mu, dɛ mbrɛ w’asɛm se;
title: LUKE

text: Osiandɛ m’enyiwa ehu wo nkwagye a
title: LUKE

text: Esiesie wɔ amanaman nyina enyim;
title: LUKE

text: Ɔkandzea a ɔbɛma amanamamfo do atsew, Na wo man Israel enyimnyam.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔyɛɛ abofra no n’egya nye ne na nwanwa wɔ dza wɔkaa no wɔ no ho no ho;
title: LUKE

text: na Simeon hyiraa hɔn, na ɔsee ne na Mary dɛ, Hwɛ, oyi na wɔdze no esi hɔ ama Israel mu dodowara hɔn asehwe nye hɔn soɛr, ɔnye asɛnkyerɛdze a wɔbɛkasa etsia no;
title: LUKE

text: ama akoma dodowara mu adwen aada edzi, na ɔwoara so nkrantsee bohwira w’akoma mu.
title: LUKE

text: Nna Anna, ɔbaa nkɔnhyɛnyi bi a ɔyɛ Fanuel babaa a ofir Aser ebusuakuw mu wɔ hɔ: oenyin, na ɔwaar ne nkataasiaber mu nye no kun tsenaa mfe esuon,
title: LUKE

text: na ɔayɛ okunafo bɛyɛ mfe eduowɔtwe anan, na ɔammpa asɔrdan mu da, na ɔdze akɔnkyen nye mpaabɔ som Nyankopɔn adzekyee nye adzesaa.
title: LUKE

text: Na dɔn no ara mu, no so bae beyii Nyankopɔn ayɛw, na ɔkaa no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn a wɔrotweɔn dɛ wɔbɔpon Jerusalɛm no nyina.
title: LUKE

text: Na wowiee dza Ewuradze mbra se nyina yɛ no, wɔsanee kɔr hɔnankasa hɔn kurow Nazarɛt a ɔwɔ Galilii mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na abofra no nyinii, na ɔyɛɛ ndam, na nyansa hyɛɛ no ma, na Nyankopɔn adom wɔ no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na n’awofo no kɔr Jerusalɛm afe nyina wɔ apaho afahyɛ no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na odzii mfe duebien no, wɔkɔr Jerusalɛm dɛ mbrɛ afahyɛ n’atɔrmuadze tse,
title: LUKE

text: na wodzii nda no wiei na wɔresan akɔ no, abofra Jesus no kaa ekyir wɔ Jerusalɛm a nna n’egya nye ne na dze, wonnyim;
title: LUKE

text: na wosusuu dɛ ɔafora dɔm no mu ntsi, wɔnantseew dakor kwansin na wɔkɔhwehwɛɛ no wɔ hɔn ebusuafo nye hɔn amanyimfo mu;
title: LUKE

text: na woennhu no no, wɔsanee kɔr Jerusalɛm kɔhwehwɛɛ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ne ndaansa durii no, wokohun no wɔ asɔrfi no mu dɛ ɔtse akyerɛkyerɛfo no finimfin, oritsie hɔn na oribisabisa hɔn nsɛm;
title: LUKE

text: na hɔn a wotsiee no nyina, ne ntseasee nye ne mbuae yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa.
title: LUKE

text: Na wohun no no, hɔn ho boow hɔn, na ne na see no dɛ, Ɔba, na ɔyɛ dɛn na enye hɛn edzi no dɛm yi? Hwɛ, w’egya nye emi dze yaw na ahwehwɛ wo.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom hwehwɛɛ me ayɛ dɛn? Ana hom nnyim dɛ otwar dɛ metsena m’Egya fie?
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn dze, wɔanntse asɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no ase.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔnye hɔn sii mu kɔr Nazarɛt, na ɔbrɛɛ noho adze maa hɔn; na ne na dze, ɔdze nsɛm yi nyina siei wɔ n’akoma mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus nyinii wɔ nyansa nye honandua mu, na onyaa enyimpa wɔ Nyankopɔn nye nyimpa enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Na Tiberius Kaesar dzi adze, n’afe duenum no mu, na Pontius Pilate dzi Judea ambrado, na Herod dzii Galilii ɔmansinhen, na no nua Filip dzi ɔmansinhen wɔ Iturea nye Trakonitis asaase do, na Lisanias dzi Abilene ɔmansinhen,
title: LUKE

text: na Annas nye Kaiafas dzi asɔfompanyin no, Nyankopɔn asɛm baa Zekaria ne ba John hɔ wɔ sar no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa asaase a abɔ Jordan ho aprɔw nyina, na ɔpaa mu kaa nnuho enuma a ɔdze kɔ bɔnfakyɛ mu no ho asɛm,
title: LUKE

text: dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no wɔ nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia ne nsɛm nwoma mu dɛ, Obi ne ndze retsea mu wɔ sar no do dɛ, Hom nsiesie Ewuradze no kwan, Hom ntsentsen n’atsempɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Wɔbɛhyɛ mbɔnsa nyina amaama, Mbepɔw nye nkokwaa nyina wɔbɛbrɛ no adze; dza akyeakyea nyina bɛtsentsen, Na akwan a ɔyɛ kekakeka ayɛ trontrom.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyimpa nyina bohu Nyankopɔn no nkwagye.
title: LUKE

text: Na obisaa nyimpadodow a woepue aba dɛ onnuma hɔn no dɛ, Nhurutsia mba! Woana tuu hom fo dɛ hom nguan mfi ebufuw a ɔreba no ho?
title: LUKE

text: Na afei hom nsow aba a ɔfata nnuho na mma hom nnhyɛ ase nnka wɔ hom mu dɛ, Hɛn dze, hɛn egya nye Abraham: na mese hom dɛ Nyankopɔn botum dɛ onyan mba fi abo yi mu ma Abraham.
title: LUKE

text: Na afei so dze, wɔdze abɔndua no ato ndua no ndwow ho dada, dɛ dua biara a ɔnnsow aba pa no wobotwa no ato gya mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyimpadodow no bisaa no dɛ, Na yɛnyɛ dɛn?
title: LUKE

text: Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Nyia ɔwɔ sorntar ebien, wɔmma ɔmma nyimpa a onnyi bi no bi; na nyia ɔwɔ edziban so, wɔmma ɔnyɛ dɛmara.
title: LUKE

text: Na atowgyefo bi baa dɛ onnuma hɔn, na wobisaa no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yɛnyɛ dɛn?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nngye mma ɔnnkyɛn dza wɔahyɛ ato hɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Na asogyafo bi so bisaa no dɛ, Hɛn so yɛnyɛ dɛn? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnyɛ obiara heihei, eso mma hom nntoatoa obiara gyan, na hom mma hom akatua nsɔ hom enyi.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔman no hɔn enyiwa daa kwan, na hɔn nyina susui wɔ hɔn akoma mu wɔ John ho dɛ gyama ɔno nye Kraest no,
title: LUKE

text: John buae see hɔn nyina dɛ, Emi dze, munuma hom nsu mu; na nyia no ho yɛ dzen kyɛn me no reba a no nsokota ho ahoma mpo, mennsɛ dɛ mesan: ɔno na obonuma hom wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu, na gya mu;
title: LUKE

text: ɔno na no nhuwdo apaawa kitsa ne nsamu, dɛ ɔrebɛpra ne famu hɔ kofee, na ɔaboaboa n’ewifua ano ekogu san do, na ntsɛw no ɔdze gya a onndum ahyew.
title: LUKE

text: Na ndzɛmba pii ka ho wɔ n’afotu mu a ɔdze kaa nsɛmpa kyerɛɛ nkorɔfo no.
title: LUKE

text: Naaso ɔmansinhen Herod a nna ɔnam no nua ne yer Herodias, nye emumuyɛ bi so a ɔno Herod ayɛ ma John etwuw n’enyim ntsi no,
title: LUKE

text: dze ne nyina kaa ho na ɔdze John too efiadze.
title: LUKE

text: Na aber a ogu do runuma nkorɔfo nyina no, Jesus so bae ma wonumaa no, na ɔrobɔ mpaa no, sor buei,
title: LUKE

text: na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn sianee wɔ honam subea mu, tse dɛ ebubur baa no do, na ndze bi fi sor bae dɛ, Ɔwo nye mo Dɔba a esɔ m’enyi.
title: LUKE

text: Jesus hyɛɛ n’edwuma ase no nna oedzi bɛyɛ mfe eduasa; na, (dɛ mbrɛ nkorɔfo dwenee no,) ɔyɛ Josef a Heli woo no no ne ba, na Heli so n’egya nye
title: LUKE

text: Mattat a n’egyanom santsen nye; Levi, Melki, Janai, Josef,
title: LUKE

text: Matatias, Amos, Nahum, Esli, Naggai,
title: LUKE

text: Maat, Matatias, Semein, Josek, Joda,
title: LUKE

text: Joanan, Resa, Zerubabel, Sealtiel, Neri,
title: LUKE

text: Melki, Addi, Kosam, Elmadam, Er,
title: LUKE

text: Jesus, Eliezer, Jorim, Mattat, Levi,
title: LUKE

text: Simeon, Judas, Josef, Jonam, Eliakim,
title: LUKE

text: Melea, Menna, Mataata, Natan, David,
title: LUKE

text: Jesse, Obed, Boaz, Salmon, Nahshon,
title: LUKE

text: Amminadab, Arni, Hezron, Perez, Juda,
title: LUKE

text: Jakob, Isaak, Abraham, Tera, Nahor,
title: LUKE

text: Serug, Reu, Peleg, Eber, Sela,
title: LUKE

text: Kainan, Arfakad, Sem, Noa, Lamek,
title: LUKE

text: Metusela, Enok, Jared, Mahalaleel, Kainan,
title: LUKE

text: Enos, Set, na Adam a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn ne ba no.
title: LUKE

text: Jesus a nna Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahyɛ no ma no, sanee fii Jordan ho, na Sunsum no dze no duaduaa sar no do adaduanan,
title: LUKE

text: na abɔnsam sɔɔ no hwɛe. Na nda no mu no oenndzi hwee; na owiei no, ɔkɔm dzee no.
title: LUKE

text: Na abɔnsam see no dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba a, hyɛ ɔbo yi ma ɔndan paanoo.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Nnyɛ paanoo nko bi na nyimpa nam do bɛtsena ase.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔdze no kɔr beebi a ɔkrɔn kɛkyerɛɛ no wiadze ahenman nyina prɛko pɛr.
title: LUKE

text: Na abɔnsam see no dɛ, Ɔwo na medze tum yi nyina nye no mu enyimnyam bɛma wo: osiandɛ wɔdze ahyɛ me nsa, na obi a mepɛ no, medze mema no.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ ebɔsɔr wɔ m’enyim a, ne nyina bɛyɛ wodze.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Sɔr Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn, na no nko na som no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔdze no kɔr Jerusalɛm, dze no kesii asɔrfi ne bea sorɔnsorɔm no do, na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba a, tow woho fi ha kyen famu:
title: LUKE

text: na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Ɔbɛhyɛ n’abɔfoe mbra wɔ wo ho, dɛ wɔmbɔ wo ho ban,
title: LUKE

text: na, Wɔbɔsoa wo hɔn nsamu, Amma aammfa wo nan ammpem ɔbo da.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Wɔaka dɛ, Mma nnsɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ.
title: LUKE

text: Na abɔnsam wiee no nsɔhwɛ nyina no, ogyaa no hɔ kakra.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus nam Sunsum n’ahoɔdzen mu sanee baa Galilii, na ne nka tahyee nkurow a woetwa ehyia nyina mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn nhyiamudan no mu, na hɔn nyina hyɛɛ no enyimnyam.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa Nazarɛt, mbrɛ wɔtsetsee no no, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔtɔ dɛ ɔyɛ no, ɔkɔr nhyiamudan no mu ahomgyeda no, na ɔsoɛree gyinaa dɛ ɔrebɛkenkan.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔdze nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia no nwoma no maa no, Na ɔtserɛɛw nwoma no mu, na ohun bea a wɔakyerɛw no hɔ dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Ewuradze no Sunsum wɔ mo do, osiandɛ ɔasera me ngo dɛ membɛka nsɛmpa nkyerɛ ehiafo. Ɔasoma me dɛ membɛpaa ɔgye mma ndɔmmumfo, na mumbue enyifurafo enyi, na membɛgye hɔn a wɔretseetsee hɔn no,
title: LUKE

text: na membɛda afe a Ewuradze n’enyimpa bɛba no nkorɔfo do no edzi.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbobɔɔw nwoma no, na ɔdze maa ɔsomfo no, na ɔtsenaa ase; na hɔn a wɔwɔ nhyiamudan mu hɔ nyina, hɔn enyiwa tsiim no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ ase kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Ndɛ na kyerɛw yi aba mu wɔ hom asowa mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn nyina dzii no dase, na adom nsɛm a ofii n’anomu no yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa; na wɔsee dɛ, Ana nnyɛ Josef ba no nye yi?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ampaara, hom dze bɛ yi bobu me: Ɔsafo, sa woho yarba: biribiara a yɛatse dɛ wɔyɛe wɔ Karpernaum no, yɛ no wankasa wo kurow mu ha so.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi biara, wɔmmpɛ no noara no kurow mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na meka no nokwar kyerɛ hom dɛ, Elija n’aber do a wɔtoow ɔsor mu mfensa abosoom esia no na ɔkɔm kɛsenara sii asaase nyina do no, nna ekunafo pii wɔ Israel;
title: LUKE

text: naaso wɔannsoma Elija wɔ hɔn mu biara hɔ, gyedɛ Sidon kurow Zarefat mu, wɔ ɔbaa kunafo bi hɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Na nkɔnhyɛnyi Elisha n’aber do no, nna akwatafo pii wɔ Israel; na wɔamma hɔn mu biara ho annsan, gyedɛ Sirianyi Naaman.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔwɔ nhyiamudan no mu nyina, wɔtsee dɛm asɛm yi no, ebufuw hyɛɛ hɔn ma;
title: LUKE

text: na wɔsoɛree sunsuun no fii kurow no mu, dze no kɔr koko a hɔn kurow no si do no no kɔn do, dɛ wɔrokɔwɔ no akɔmfo.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔno dze, ɔnam hɔn finimfin kɔree.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkɔr Galilii kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Karpernaum mu. Nna ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ hɔn fa ahomgyeda no ho;
title: LUKE

text: na ne nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛɛ hɔn ahobow, osiandɛ n’asɛm dze tum nam.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyimpa bi wɔ nhyiamudan no mu a ɔwɔ sunsum fi, na ɔdze ndze kɛse kaa mu dɛ
title: LUKE

text: Aa! Ebɛnadze na yɛnye wo wɔ yɛ, Jesus Nazarɛtnyi? Ana ebae dɛ erebɛsɛɛ hɛn? Minyim wo nyimpaban, Nyankopɔn no Hotseweenyi no.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus bɔɔ no ham see dɛ, Ka w’ano to mu, na fi no mu fi. Na abɔnsam no twaa no hwee hɔn finimfin no, nna ofii no mu firii, a ɔannyɛ no hwee.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nyina ahobow, na wɔkekaa kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔnho dɛ, Ebɛn asɛm nye yi, dɛɔdze tum nye ahoɔdzen hyɛ esunsum fi ma wotu kɔ?
title: LUKE

text: Na no ho asɛm tahyee aman a woetwa ehyia hɔ no nkurow nyina mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsoɛree fii nhyiamudan no mu baa Simon fie. Nna papu kɛse aka Simon n’asew, na wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na okegyinaa no do tseaa yarba no, ma ofii no do, na ɔsoɛɛr ntsɛmara soom hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na wi rokɔtɔ no, hɔn a wɔwɔ ayarfo a yarba horow rehaw hɔn nyina dze hɔn brɛɛ no, ma ɔdze ne nsa too hɔn nyina do nkorkor yɛɛ hɔn edur.
title: LUKE

text: Na mbɔnsam so fii dodowara mu firii, na wɔkaa mu kɛse see dɛ, Ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn Ba no. Na ɔbɔɔ hɔn ham, na ɔamma hɔn kwan dɛ wɔnkasa, osiandɛ wonyim dɛ ɔno nye Kraest no.
title: LUKE

text: Na adze kyee no, osii mu kɔr sar bi do, na nyimpadodow no hwehwɛɛ no, na wokodur ne nkyɛn no, wosiankaa no dɛ mma ommfi hɔn nkyɛn nnkɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Otwar dɛ meka Nyankopɔn ahenman ho nsɛmpa kyerɛ nkurow bi so, osiandɛ iyi ntsi na wɔsomaa me.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkɛkaa asɛm no wɔ Judea nhyiamudan mu.
title: LUKE

text: Ber bi a nna Jesus gyina Genesaret nsutaae ho, na nyimpadɔm akyer no do dɛ woribetsie Nyankopɔn n’asɛm no;
title: LUKE

text: ohun ahɛn ebien dɛ wogyinagyina nsutaae no do: na afarfo no efi mu rokɔhor hɔn mboa.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkɔr hɛn no kor a ɔyɛ Simon dze no no mu, na ɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔnkwan mfi daadze kakra. Na ɔtsenaa ase na ofi hɛn no mu kyerɛkyerɛɛ nyimpadodow no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ogyaa kasa no, ɔsee Simon dɛ, Kwan kɔ mbrɛ ɔdɔ, na hom nkɔtow hom mboa mfa nam.
title: LUKE

text: Na Simon buae see dɛ, Yewura, yɛayɛ edwuma anafua yi nyina, a yeennya hwee; naaso w’asɛm ntsi mobɔtow eboa no.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm no, wɔpaa nam pii, ma nkyɛ hɔn mboa retsetsew.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔtoo nsa frɛɛ afarfo bi a wɔwɔ hɛn kor no mu dɛ wɔmbra mbɔboa hɔn. Na wɔbae bɛhyɛɛ ahɛn ebien nyina amaama, ma nkyɛ wɔreyɛ esiw mpo.
title: LUKE

text: Na Simon Peter hunii no, ɔhwee Jesus n’ananadze see dɛ, Ao Ewuradze, fi me nkyɛn kɔ, na meyɛ nyimpa dzebɔnyɛnyi.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ɔno nye hɔn a wɔnye no wɔ hɔ nyina ahobow, wɔ nam dodow a wɔfae no ntsi;
title: LUKE

text: na dɛm ara so na ɔyɛɛ James nye John, Zebedee mba no a wɔnye Simon yɛ apofo no. Na Jesus see Simon dɛ, Mma nnsuro: na ofitsi ndɛ ibonu nyimpa.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔdze hɔn ahɛn bodwiir daadze no, wɔdaan ne nyina gyae, na wɔkaa no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔwɔ nkurow no mu kor mu no, hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi a kwata ayɛ no ho ma baa hɔ; na ohun Jesus no, ɔdze n’enyim butuuw famu, na ɔserɛɛ no see dɛ, Mo wura, sɛ epɛ a, ibotum dɛ ema mo ho san.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔtseen ne nsa dze kaa no see dɛ, Mepɛ, wo ho nsan. Na ntsɛmara na kwata no fii no ho.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbraa no dɛ: mma nnka nnkyerɛ obiara; kɔ, fa woho kɛkyerɛ ɔsɔfo no, na w’ahosan ntsi kotua dza Moses hyɛe no fa yɛ dase ma hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na afei dze ne nka tahyee mbordo, na nyimpadodow pii behyiaa dɛ woribetsie no, na ɔasa hɔn nyarbanyarba.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔtwee noho kɔr sar no do kɔsɔree.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ da bi ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ no, nna Farisiifo nye mbra no n’akyerɛkyerɛfo a wofi Galilii, Judea nye Jerusalɛm nkurow nyina mu aba tsetse hɔ; na Ewuradze n’ahoɔdzen wɔ no do dɛ ɔdze bɛsa yarba.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, mbanyin bi dze nyimpa bi a ɔyar mbubui da mpa do bae, na wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wobenya kwan dze no abɔto n’enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Na woennya kwan a wɔdze no bodua mu aba wɔ nyimpadodow no ntsi no, wɔkɔr dan no etsifi, na wɔdze no duaa dan no nkurii no mu wɔ ne mpa do besii finimfin wɔ Jesus n’enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Na ohun hɔn gyedzi no, ɔsee dɛ, Nyimpa, wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo.
title: LUKE

text: Na akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo no hyɛɛ ase dwendween dɛ, Na woana nye yi a ɔreka ebususɛm yi? Woana botum dze bɔn akyɛ gyedɛ Nyankopɔn nko?
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus hun hɔn adwendwen no, obuae see hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom rodwendwen wɔ hom akoma mu yi?
title: LUKE

text: Dza ɔwɔ hen na ɔyɛ mberɛw kɛse, dɛ ebɛse dɛ, Wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo; anaa ebɛse dɛ, Soɛr na nantsew a?
title: LUKE

text: Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma hom ehu dɛ nyimpa Ba no wɔ tum wɔ asaase do dɛ ɔdze bɔn kyɛ no ntsi, (ɔkaa kyerɛɛ nyia ɔyar mbubui no dɛ,) Mese wo dɛ, Soɛr, fa wo mpa na kɔ wo fie.
title: LUKE

text: Na, ntsɛmara ɔsoɛree wɔ hɔn enyim na ɔfaa dza ɔda do no, na osii mu kɔr ne fie, a ɔrehyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
title: LUKE

text: Na ahobow kaa hɔn nyina, na wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam; na hu kɛse kaa hɔn ma wɔkaa dɛ, Yeehu anwanwadze ndɛ.
title: LUKE

text: Na iyi ekyir no, opuei na okohun towgyenyi bi a ne dzin dze Levi, dɛ ɔtse atowgyebea, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ka mo do.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔdaan biribiara gyae, na ɔsoɛree kaa no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na Levi too no pon kɛsenara wɔ ne fie; na atowgyefo nye nkorɔfo bi, nyimpadodow kɛsenara, nye hɔn bɛtsenatsenaa ho.
title: LUKE

text: Na Farisiifo nye hɔn akyerɛwfo no hwinhwinii kyerɛɛ n’esuafo no see dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom nye atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo dzidzi nom yi?
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Hɔn a wɔtse hɔn apɔw mu no, wonnhia oduyɛfo, na mbom hɔn a wɔyar no a.
title: LUKE

text: Mammbɛfrɛ atseneneefo, na mbom ndzebɔnyɛfo, dɛ wonnu hɔnho.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, John n’esuafo no dze, wɔtɔ dɛ wodzi mbuada pii, na wɔyɛ nkotoserɛ, na Farisiifo so dɛmara; naaso wodze yi dze, wodzidzi na wɔnom.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Aso hom botum ama ayefor asefo no edzi mbuada aber a ayeforkun no wɔ hɔn nkyɛn no?
title: LUKE

text: Na nda no bɛba, na sɛ woyi ayeforkun no fi hɔn nkyɛn a, ɔno na nda no mu wobedzi mbuada.
title: LUKE

text: Na obuu bɛ yi so kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Obi nntsew tam fofor sin nntaa atar dadaw mu: dɛm no, fofor no dze ɔbɛtsew, osiandɛ sin fofor a ɔdze taa mu no nye dadaw no nnkɛsaa.
title: LUKE

text: Na obi mmfa wenyin fofor nngu nwomatoa dadaw mu: dɛm no, wenyin fofor no bɛpaa nwomatoa no, na obohue egu, na nwomatoa no so bɛsɛɛ.
title: LUKE

text: Na wenyin fofor dze, ɔsɛ dɛ wɔdze gu ntoa fofor mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na obiara nnom wenyin dadaw nwie na ɔnnhwehwɛ fofor. Dza ɔka nye dɛ, Dadaw no ara ye.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ okoduaa eburow kwa mu ahomgyeda, na n’esuafo no pempaan eburow mbɛtsem no bi posae wɔ hɔn nsamu wee.
title: LUKE

text: Na Farisiifo no mu binom see dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom reyɛ dza ɔmmfa kwan mu dɛ wɔyɛ no ahomgyeda yi?
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Ana hom nnkenkaan iyi mpo, dza David, aber a ɔkɔm dzee ɔnoara na hɔn a wɔka no ho no, ɔyɛe no?
title: LUKE

text: Mbrɛ ɔkɛhɛɛn Nyankopɔn fie, na ɔkɛfaa kyerɛpaanoo no dzii, na ɔmaa hɔn a wɔka no ho no so bi wɔ ber a ɔmmfa mbra mu dɛ obiara dzi gyedɛ asɔfo no nkotsee no?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nyimpa Ba no yɛ ahomgyeda no no wura.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ahomgyeda kor bi so mu, ɔkɔr nhyiamudan mu kɛkyerɛkyerɛe; na nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a ne nsa nyimfa adwe.
title: LUKE

text: Na akyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo no tsɛɛw no dɛ ɔbɛyɛ edur ahomgyeda no, ama woeenya biribi akɔtoa no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔno dze, nna onyim hɔn adwen, ntsi ɔsee nyimpa a ne nsa adwe no dɛ, Soɛr gyina finimfin. Na ɔsoɛree gyinae.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Miribisa hom asɛm, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ ahomgyeda wɔbɛyɛ dza oye, anaa wɔbɛyɛ omuo? Wɔbɛgye nkwa, anaa wɔbɛsɛɛ?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔhwɛɛ hɔn nyina hyiae, na ɔsee no dɛ, Tsen wo nsa. Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm, na ne nsa no sanee yɛɛ mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ebufuhyew hyɛɛ hɔn nyina ma, na wotutuu egyina wɔ adze a wɔdze bɛyɛ Jesus ho.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu no, ɔkɔr koko bi do kɔsɔree; na ɔsɔɔr anafua no nyina bɔɔ mpaa kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na adze kyee no, ɔfrɛɛ n’esuafo no, na ɔpaa hɔn mu duebien a ɔfrɛɛ hɔn asomafo no.
title: LUKE

text: Simon a ɔtoo no Peter, nye no nua Andrew, James, John, Filip nye Bartholomew,
title: LUKE

text: Matthew, Tomas, Alfaeus ba James, Simon a wɔfrɛ no Zealot no,
title: LUKE

text: nye James ne ba Judas, nye Judas Iskariot a oyii no mae no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔnye hɔn sianee begyinaa beebi a hɔ taa, nye n’esuafo kuw kɛse no nye ɔman no mu nyimpadodow pii a wofi Judea nyina, Jerusalɛm, Taere nye Sidon mpoano a wɔbae betsiee no no, na wɔbɔhwehwɛɛ ayarsa no;
title: LUKE

text: na hɔn a esunsum fi rehaw hɔn no, na ɔsaa hɔn nyina yarba.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyimpadodow no nyina hwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔdze hɔn nsa bɛka no, osiandɛ tum fii no mu bae bɛsaa hɔn nyina yarba.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔmaa n’enyi do wɔ n’esuafo no do, na ɔsee dɛ, Nhyira aka hom ehiafo, na hom na Nyankopɔn ahenman no yɛ hom dze.
title: LUKE

text: Nhyira aka hom a ɔkɔm dze hom sesei yi, na wɔbɛma hom amee. Nhyira aka hom a hom rusu sesei yi, na hom bɛserew.
title: LUKE

text: Nhyira aka hom ber a nyimpa bekyir hom, na woeyi hom edzi efi mu, na wɔayaw hom, na wɔatow hom dzin akyen dɛ dzin bɔn wɔ nyimpa Ba no ntsi.
title: LUKE

text: Da no hom ndzi dɛw, na hom ndzi ehurusi: na hwɛ, hom akatua so wɔ sor: na dɛmara na hɔn egyanom dze yɛɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no.
title: LUKE

text: Na hom ahonyafo, hom ndue! Osiandɛ hom enya hom awerɛkyekyer dada.
title: LUKE

text: Hom a hom amee sesei yi, hom ndue! Na ɔkɔm bɛdze hom. Hom a hom serew sesei yi, hom ndue! Na hom bedzi nkɔmbɔ na hom esu.
title: LUKE

text: Aber a nyimpa nyina ka hom ho asɛm pa no, hom ndue! Na dɛmara na hɔn egyanom yɛe maa nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo no.
title: LUKE

text: Na meka kyerɛ hom a hom ritsie yi dɛ, Hom ndɔ hom atamfo, hom nyɛ hɔn a wɔtan hom yie,
title: LUKE

text: hom nhyira hɔn a wɔdom hom, na hom nsɔr mma hɔn a wɔbɔ hom adapaa.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyia ɔbɔ w’aso fakor mu no, dan fakor so ma no; na nyia ɔfa wo nkatado no, mma nnsiw no w’asetar ho kwan.
title: LUKE

text: Obiara a ɔserɛ wo no, ma no; na nyia ɔfa w’adze no, mma mmbisa no bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na dza hom pɛ dɛ nyimpa yɛ ma hom no, hom so nyɛ dɛmara mma hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ hom dɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ hom a, ebɛn ndaase na hom nya? Na ndzebɔnyɛfo mpo dɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ hom yɛ yie ma hɔn a wɔyɛ hom yie a, ebɛn ndaase na hom nya? Na ndzebɔnyɛfo so yɛ dɛmara.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ hom dze fɛm hɔn a hom enyi da do dɛ hom nsa bɛka efi hɔn hɔ bio a, ebɛn ndaase na hom nya? Ndzebɔnyɛfo so dze fɛm ndzebɔnyɛfo dɛ hɔn nsa bɛka no bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na mbom hom ndɔ hom atamfo, hom nyɛ papa, na hom mfa mfɛm dɛ hom enyi nnda biribi do, na hom akatua bɔdɔɔ so, na hom ayɛ nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no ne mba, osiandɛ ɔnodze, ɔyɛ adɔyɛ ma etsiafo nye emumuyɛfo.
title: LUKE

text: Hom nyɛ mbɔbɔrhufo, dɛ mbrɛ hom Egya so yɛ mbɔbɔrhunyi no.
title: LUKE

text: Mma hom mmbu atsɛn, na wonnkobu hom atsɛn; mma hom mmbu fɔ, na wonnkobu hom fɔ; hom mfa nkyɛ, na wɔdze akyɛ hom;
title: LUKE

text: hom mma, na wɔama hom: esusudze pa a wɔahohom do na wɔawosow no ma ebu do na wɔdze bogu hom bo mu; na esusudze kor a hom dze susu no, wɔdze bosusu ama hom bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na obuu hɔn bɛ so dɛ, Ana onyifurafo botum akyerɛ onyifurafo kwan? Hɔn beenu nyina nnkɔtɔ mona mu anaa?
title: LUKE

text: Osuanyi nnkyɛn ne kyerɛkyerɛfo, na obiara a oedzi mu no bɛyɛ dɛ ne kyerɛkyerɛfo.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔyɛ dɛn na ehwɛ duaba a ɔwɔ wo nua enyiwa mu, na ennhwɛ mpuna a ɔwɔ woara w’enyiwa mu no?
title: LUKE

text: Anaadɛ ebɛyɛ dɛn etum ase wo nua dɛ, Onua, ma minyi duaba a ɔwɔ w’enyiwa mu, na wankasa w’enyiwa mu mpuna dze innhu? Ɔwo dabrabanyi, dzi kan yi mpuna fi wankasa w’enyiwa mu: nna ibohu no yie eyi duaba a ɔwɔ wo nua enyiwa mu no.
title: LUKE

text: Dua pa biara nnyi hɔ a ɔsow aba prɔwee na dua prɔwee so nnyi hɔ a ɔsow aba pa.
title: LUKE

text: Na dua biara wɔdze n’aba hu no. Na nyimpa nntsetsew adɔmba wɔ nsoɛ do, na eso wɔnntsetsew wenyinaba wɔ kɔkrɔw do.
title: LUKE

text: Nyimpa pa fi n’akoma mu ndzepa korabea na oyi adze pa pue, na nyimpa bɔn fi ne ndzɛmba bɔn korabea na oyi dza omuo pue: na ofi dza abor do wɔ akoma mu no na ano ka.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔyɛ dɛn na hom frɛ me Ewuradze, Ewuradze, naaso hom nnyɛ dza mese?
title: LUKE

text: Obiara a ɔba mo hɔ, na otsie m’asɛm, na ɔyɛ no, mebɛkyerɛ hom nyia ɔnye no sɛ:
title: LUKE

text: ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a osii dan, na otui ma ɔdɔe, na ɔtoo fapem wɔ ɔbotan do; na nsu yirii no, esutsen pemee boor dan no, naaso oenntum annwosow no, osiandɛ woesi no yie.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyia otsie na ɔnnyɛ no, ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a osii dan wɔ asaase enyi, na onnyi fapem; ɔno na nsu yirii faa ho no, ɔhwee ase ntsɛmara, na dan no sɛɛe koraa.
title: LUKE

text: Na owiee ne nsɛm no nyina ka wɔ nkorɔfo no asomu no, ɔkɛhɛɛn Karpernaum.
title: LUKE

text: Nna asogyafo do ɔhamupanyin bi n’akowaa a ɔsom no bo kɛse yar ma ɔreyɛ ewu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔtsee Jesus ne nka no, ɔsomaa Jewfo mpanyin bi wɔ no hɔ kɛserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmbra mbɛgye n’akowaa no nkwa.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn no wɔserɛɛ no enyiberdo see dɛ, Ɔsɛ dɛ ebɛyɛ dɛm adze yi ma no:
title: LUKE

text: osiandɛ ɔdɔ hɛn man, na ɔnoara na osii hɛn nhyiamudan yi.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus nye hɔn kɔree. Na ɔrebɛn fie no ho no, ɔhamupanyin no somaa n’anyɛnkofo bi wɔ no hɔ kɛsee no dɛ, Mo wura, mma nnhaw woho: na mennsɛ dɛ ebɛhɛn me hatsɛw ase;
title: LUKE

text: iyi ntsi na memmbu moho dɛ mesɛ dɛ meba wo nkyɛn no; dɛm ntsi ɔwo kasa ara, na m’akowaa no bɛtse apɔw.
title: LUKE

text: Na mo so meyɛ nyimpa a wɔdze me ahyɛ tum ase, na mowɔ nsordaafo wɔ m’ase, na mese yi dɛ, Kɔ a, ɔkɔ; na mese obi so, Bra a, ɔba, na mese m’akowaa dɛ, Yɛ yi a, ɔyɛ.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus tsee yinom no, no ho yɛɛ no nwanwa, na ɔsee nyimpadodow a wodzi n’ekyir no dɛ, Mese hom dɛ, Israel mu mpo munnhun gyedzi a ɔtse dɛm yi bi pɛn.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔsomaa hɔn no sanee kɔr fie kohun akowaa no dɛ no ho ayɛ no dzen.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ annkyɛr biara na ɔkɔr kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Nain mu; na n’esuafo no nye nyimpadodow pii nye no kɔree.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbɛɛn kurow no n’abobow ekyir no, nna wɔso bi a oewu a ɔyɛ ne na ne ba kortsee, rupue, na ɔbaa no yɛ okunafo; na nyimpadodow pii fi kurow no mu ka no ho.
title: LUKE

text: Na Ewuradze hun basia no, ne yamu hyehyee no maa no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Mma nnsu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔdze ne nsa kɛkaa fundaka no, na hɔn a wɔso no no gyinae; Na ɔsee dɛ, Aberantsɛ, mese wo dɛ, Soɛr.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyia oewu no soɛree, na ɔhyɛɛ ase kasae. Na ɔdze no hyɛɛ ne na nsa.
title: LUKE

text: Na hu kaa hɔn nyina; na wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam see dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi kɛse asoɛr wɔ hɛn mu, na, Nyankopɔn abɔhwɛ ne man.
title: LUKE

text: Na no ho asɛm tahyee Judea nyina, nye asaase a etwa ho ehyia nyina mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na John n’esuafo kɛkaa yinom nyina ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na John frɛɛ n’esuafo mu beenu, na ɔsomaa hɔn Ewuradze hɔ kebisaa no dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye nyia ɔreba no, anaa yɛrotweɔn obi so?
title: LUKE

text: Na mbarimba no baa ne nkyɛn no, wɔsee dɛ, John Onumanyi no asoma hɛn wo hɔ dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye nyia ɔreba no, anaa yɛrotweɔn obi so?
title: LUKE

text: Na dɔnhwer kor no ara mu ɔsaa dodowara hɔn nyarba, na oyii hɔn haw nye esunsum fi fii hɔn do, na ɔmaa enyifurafo pii hun adze.
title: LUKE

text: Na obuaa hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɛka dza hom ehu na hom atse yi nkyerɛ John, dɛ enyifurafo hu adze, mbubuafo nantsew, akwatafo ho san, etsitsifo tse asɛm, ewufo nyan, na wɔka asɛmpa kyerɛ ehiafo.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyia mennkɛyɛ no fintsidua no, nhyira aka no.
title: LUKE

text: Na John n’abɔfoe no kɔree no, ɔhyɛɛ ase bisaa nyimpadodow no wɔ John ho dɛ, Ebɛnadze na hom kɔr sar no do kɔhwɛe? Ndzɛmbir a mframa rihim no a?
title: LUKE

text: Na ebɛnadze na hom puei kɔhwɛe? Nyimpa a ofura tam papa a? Hwɛ, hɔn a wofura atam hyerɛpɛɛ, na wɔyɛ anomu dɛw no, wɔwɔ ahemfie.
title: LUKE

text: Na ebɛnadze na hom puei kɔhwɛe? Nkɔnhyɛnyi a? Nyew, mese hom dɛ, nyia ɔkyɛn nkɔnhyɛnyi mpo a.
title: LUKE

text: Oyi nye nyia wɔakyerɛw no ho dɛ, Hwɛ, morosoma mo bɔfoe ma oeedzi w’enyim kan a Obesiesie wo kwan edzi w’enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Mese hom dɛ, hɔn a mbaa awo hɔn nyina mu biara mmpuei a ɔyɛ kɛse kyɛn John: naaso nyia ɔyɛ aketseaba koraa wɔ sor ahenman no mu no yɛ kɛse kyɛn no.
title: LUKE

text: (Na nkorɔfo a wɔtsee nyina nye atowgyefo no, gyee Nyankopɔn no ndwuma no too mu na wɔdze John n’enuma no numaa hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Naaso Farisiifo nye mbrakyerɛfo no dze, wɔpoow Nyankopɔn n’apam maa hɔnho, osiandɛ wɔamma oennuma hɔn.)
title: LUKE

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na medze ndɛ mber yi mu nyimpa bɔto ho, na wɔtse dɛ ebɛnadze mpo?
title: LUKE

text: Wɔtse dɛ mbofraba a wɔtsenatsena gua do, na wɔrefrɛfrɛ hɔnho se dɛ, Yɛahɛn atɛntɛbɛn ama hom, na hom annsaw; yeetwa ewuo na hom ennsu.
title: LUKE

text: John Onumanyi no aba, onndzidzi, ɔnnom nsa, na hom se dɛ, Ɔwɔ sunsum bɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Nyimpa Ba no aba, odzidzi na ɔnom, na hom se dɛ, Hwɛ, nyimpa tumfur, nsahweam, atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo nyɛnko!
title: LUKE

text: Naaso nyansa ne mba bu no bem.
title: LUKE

text: Na Farisiifo no mu kor serɛɛ no dɛ ɔnye no nkedzidzi, na ɔkɔr Farisiinyi no ne fie kɛtsenaa edziban ho.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa bi a ɔwɔ kurow no mu a ɔyɛ dzebɔnyɛnyi; tsee dɛ oridzidzi wɔ Farisiinyi no ne fie no, ɔdze ngohuam alabasta toaba ma bae,
title: LUKE

text: na obegyinaa n’ekyir wɔ n’anan ho sui, na ɔhyɛɛ ase dze ne nyinsuwa fɔɔw n’anan ho, na ɔdze ne tsinhwi pepae, na ɔfeew n’anan ho, na ɔdze ngohuam seraa ho.
title: LUKE

text: Na Farisiinyi a ohyiaa no edzidzi no hunii no, ɔkae wɔ ne tsirmu dɛ, Sɛ oyi yɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi a, nkyɛ obohu onyia kor a, anaa ɔbaa kor a ɔdze ne nsa aka no yi, dɛ ɔyɛ dzebɔnyɛnyi.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus buae see no dɛ, Simon, mowɔ asɛm bi ka kyerɛ wo. Na ɔsee dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ka.
title: LUKE

text: Bosabɔnyi bi wɔ akafo beenu: baako dze sika denare ahaenum, baako so dze eduonum.
title: LUKE

text: Na wonnya bi nntua no, ɔdze kyɛɛ hɔn beenu nyina kwa. Dɛm ntsi hɔn mu woana bɔdɔ no dodow?
title: LUKE

text: Simon buae see dɛ, Mususu dɛ, nyia ɔdze dodow kyɛɛ no no a. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ebua atsɛn pa.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔdaan n’enyiwa wɔ ɔbaa no do see Simon dɛ, Ehu ɔbaa yi? Mebaa wo fie no, ɔwo amma me me nan ho nsu; naaso ɔnodze, ɔdze ne nyinsuwa afɔw me nan ho, na ɔdze ne tsinhwi apepa.
title: LUKE

text: Ɔwo ammfew m’ano, naaso ɔno dze, ofitsi dɛ mebaa ha yi, onngyaa me nan ho few.
title: LUKE

text: Ɔwo ammfa ngo annsera me tsirmu, naaso ɔno dze, ɔdze ngohuam asera me nan ho mpo.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛm ntsi mese wo dɛ no bɔn a ɔdɔɔ so no, wɔdze akyɛ no, osiandɛ no dɔ dɔɔ so; na nyia wɔdze kumaabi akyɛ no, ɔdɔ kumaabi.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Wɔdze wo bɔn akyɛ wo.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔnye no tse edzidzi no hyɛɛ ase kae wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, Woana nye oyi a ɔdze bɔn so kyɛ yi?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee ɔbaa no dɛ, Wo gyedzi agye wo: kɔ asomdwee mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na yinom ekyir no, ɔbaa dɛ annkyɛr biara na okoduaduaa nkurow mu nye nkuraase kɛkaa Nyankopɔn n’ahenman no ho asɛmpa no kyerɛe; nna duebien no ka no ho,
title: LUKE

text: nye mbaa bi so a woetu hɔn esunsum bɔn na wɔasa hɔn ahoɔmberɛw yarba: Mary a wɔfrɛ no Magdalene a mbɔnsam esuon efi no mu no,
title: LUKE

text: nye Joana, Herod no somfo panyin Kusa ne yer no, nye Susanna, nye dodowara so a wɔdze hɔn ahodze bi soom no no.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyimpadodow pii boaa ano, na hɔn a wofii nkurow nyina mu baa ne nkyɛn no, obuu hɔn bɛ dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Ogufo no kɔree koguu n’aba: na ɔrotow petse no, bi koguu kwan nkyɛn, na wotsiatsiaa do, na wimu nnoma bɔsosɔwee.
title: LUKE

text: Bi so koguu ɔbotan do, na ofifirii no, ɔkyenkyenee, osiandɛ onnyi fawin ntsi.
title: LUKE

text: Na bi so koguu nsoɛ finimfin, na nsoɛ no nye no fifirii, na omiaa no.
title: LUKE

text: Bi so koguu asaase pa do, na ofifirii na ɔsoow aba mbɔho ɔha. Na ɔkaa yinom no, ɔtseaa mu dɛ, Nyia ɔwɔ aso a wɔdze tsie no, ma ontsie.
title: LUKE

text: Na n’esuafo no bisaa no dɛ bɛ yi n’ase nye dɛn?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom dze, wɔdze ama hom dɛ hom nhu Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu esumasɛm; na nkaa no dze, wɔdze ma hɔn mbɛbu mu, ama wɔhwɛ a, woeennhu, na wɔtse a, wɔaanntse ase.
title: LUKE

text: Na bɛ no n’asekyerɛ nye yi: aba no nye Nyankopɔn n’asɛm no.
title: LUKE

text: Hɔn a wɔwɔ kwan nkyɛn no nye hɔn a woetsie; na abɔnsam ba, na obeyi asɛm no fi hɔn akoma mu, ma wɔaanngye enndzi na wɔaanngye hɔn nkwa.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔwɔ ɔbotan do nye hɔn a wotsie a, wɔdze dɛw gye asɛm no; na yinom wonnyi ndwow, na wɔgye dzi ma ɔkyɛr kakra, na nsɔhwɛber ba a nna wɔhwe ase.
title: LUKE

text: Na dza okoguu nsoɛ mu no, yinom nye hɔn a woetsie na wɔrokɔ no, ɔbra yi mu akɔdadwen nye ahonya nye enyigyedze mia hɔn, ma wɔnnsow aba ma ɔmmber yie.
title: LUKE

text: Na dza ɔwɔ asaase pa mu no, yinom nye hɔn a wɔdze akoma pa a oye etsie asɛm no, wɔdze sie, na wɔnam abotar mu sow aba.
title: LUKE

text: Obi nnsɔ kandzea na ɔmmfa kuruw mmbua do, anaa ɔmmfa nnsi mpa ase; na ɔdze si kandzeadua do, ma hɔn a wɔkɔ mu hɔ eehu ne kan.
title: LUKE

text: Na biribi nnsuma a wonnkeyi no edzi, na onnhunta a wonnkohu na ɔnnkɛda gua.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie mbrɛ hom dua tsie; na obiara a ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no, na obiara a onnyi no, dza osusu dɛ ɔwɔ mpo wɔbɛgye ne nsamu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ne na nye no nuanom baa ne nkyɛn, na woenntum ammbɛn no wɔ nyimpadodow no ntsi.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Wo na nye wo nuanom gyina abow enyim rohwehwɛ ehu wo.
title: LUKE

text: Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Me na nye mo nuanom nye woyi a wotsie Nyankopɔn asɛm na wɔyɛ.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ da bi ɔnye n’esuafo no kɔr hɛmba mu, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mma yentwa nkɔ esuegya no ho, na wɔkwanee kɔree.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔrokɔ no ɔdae; na mframa kɛse bɔɔ huu baa esu no do, na nkyɛ nsu rehyɛ hɔn hɛmba no ma, nna wɔwɔ amandzehu mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔdze nkekamu baa ne nkyɛn benyaan no see dɛ, Owura, Owura, yɛrehera! Na onyanee no, ɔbraa mframa no nye nsu no ne begyabegya no, na ogyaae, na hɔ taa dzinn.
title: LUKE

text: Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Hom gyedzi wɔ hen? Na wosuroi, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nwanwa, na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Woana nye yi a ɔhyɛ mframa nye nsu mpo ma wotsie no yi?
title: LUKE

text: Na wodur Gerasafo asaase do a ɔwɔ Galilii tsentsendo.
title: LUKE

text: Na ofii hɛmba mu kɔr daadze no, ɔbarimba bi a ɔwɔ sunsum fi puei fi kurow no mu behyiaa no: na mber pii nna ɔnnhyɛ atar, ɔnntsena fie biara mu, na mbom abodan mu wɔ esiei na ɔtse.
title: LUKE

text: Na ohun Jesus no, ɔkaa mu, na ɔhwee n’enyim daadze, na ɔdze ndze kɛse see dɛ, Menye wo wɔ ebɛn yɛ, Jesus, Ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn Ba? Meserɛ wo dɛ mma nnhaw me.
title: LUKE

text: Osiandɛ nna Jesus aka akyerɛ sunsum fi no dɛ omfi nyimpa no mu. (Osiandɛ mber pii ɔkyer no, na wɔdze nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn nye mpokyerɛ to no weɔn no; naaso obubu dza wɔdze kyekyer no no mu, na sunsum no pam no kɔ sar do.)
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus bisaa no dɛ, Wo dzin dze dɛn? Na ɔsee dɛ, Legyin, osiandɛ mbɔnsam pii ahɛn no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na esunsum bɔn no serɛɛ no dɛ mma ɔnnhyɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnkɔ bun no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na mprekokuw kɛse bi wɔ hɔ a woridzidzi wɔ kokwaa no do; na esunsum no serɛɛ no dɛ ɔmma hɔn kwan ma wɔnkɔ hɔn mu. Na ɔmaa hɔn ho kwan.
title: LUKE

text: Na esunsum bɔn no fii nyimpa no mu kɔr mpreko no mu, na okuw no faa twitwi kesiaan ɔbo kronn koguguu nsu no mu, na wɔtseetsee wui.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔrenyɛn hɔn no hun dza aba no, woguanee na wɔkɛkae wɔ kurow no mu na no nkwaado.
title: LUKE

text: Nna wopuei bɔhwɛɛ dza aba no, na wɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn bohun nyimpa a sunsum bɔn fii no mu kɔree no dɛ ɔtsena Jesus n’anan ho, hyɛ atar, na n’adwen mu atsew no, na wosuroi.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wohunii no kaa mbrɛ ɔyɛe ma nyia nkyɛ sunsum bɔn wɔ no mu no no ho sanee no kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na Gerasafo nkurow a etwa ehyia nyina mu nkorɔfo bɛserɛɛ Jesus dɛ omfi hɔn nkyɛn nkɔ, osiandɛ hu kɛse kaa hɔn. Na ɔkɔfoow hɛmba sanee kɔree.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyimpa a sunsum bɔn fii no mu kɔree no serɛɛ no dɛ ɔnye no bɛtsena; naaso Jesus gyaa no kwan dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: San kɔ wo fie, na kɛka ndzɛmba akɛse a Nyankopɔn ayɛ ama wo kyerɛ. Na osii mu kɔree kɛkaa ndzɛmba a Jesus ayɛ ama no wɔ kurow no nyina mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Jesus sanee kɔree no, nyimpadodow no gyee no, osiandɛ nna hɔn nyina rotweɔn no.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi a ne dzin dze Jairus a ɔyɛ nhyiamudan mu panyin no bae; na ɔbɔhwee Jesus n’ananadze, na ɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmbra ne fie;
title: LUKE

text: na ɔwɔ babaa kor a oedzi bɛyɛ mfe duebien na ɔda hɔ ruwu. Na ɔrokɔ no nyimpadodow no kyeer no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa bi a oenya bɔgyaagu mfe duebien, na ɔahwer n’adze nyina ama eduyɛfo, na eso obiara enntum annsa no yarba,
title: LUKE

text: bae bedzii n’ekyir kaa n’atar ano ndwow; na amonmu hɔ ara na no bɔgyaagu twae.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see dɛ, Woana na ɔkaa me no? Na hɔn nyina resan no, Peter nye hɔn a wɔka no ho no kaa dɛ, Yewura, nyimpadodow akyer wo do na worimia wo.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see dɛ, Obi aka me, na mehu dɛ ahoɔdzen bi efi mo mu kɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa no hun dɛ oennsuma no, ɔdze ahopopo bae, na ɔbɔhwee n’enyim, na ɔkaa adze kor a osian ntsi ma ɔkaa no, na mbrɛ no ho yɛɛ no dzen amonmu hɔ ara kyerɛɛ no wɔ nkorɔfo no nyina enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Babaa, wo gyedzi agye wo: kɔ asomdwee mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔrekasa no, obi fi nhyiamudan mu panyin no ne fie bae bɛsee dɛ, Wo babaa no ewu: mma nnhaw Kyerɛkyerɛfo no.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus tsee no, obuaa no dɛ, Mma nnsuro, na gye dzi ara, na obenya nkwa.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa fie no mu no, ɔamma kwan mma obiara annkɔ mu, gyedɛ Peter, nye John, nye James, nye abofra no n’egya nye ne na.
title: LUKE

text: Nna hɔn nyina rusu na woridzi awerɛhow. Na ɔsee dɛ, Mma hom nnsu: onnwui, na ɔada.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔsereew no twee, osiandɛ wonyim dɛ oewu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔnodze osuoo ne nsamu, na ɔfrɛɛ no dɛ, Ababaawa, nyan.
title: LUKE

text: Na no sunsum sanee baa bio, na ɔsoɛɛr ntsɛmara. Na Jesus hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmma no biribi ma ondzi.
title: LUKE

text: Na n’awofo no ho boow hɔn; naaso ɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnka dza wɔayɛ no nnkyerɛ obiara.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ duebien no boaa ano, na ɔmaa hɔn ahoɔdzen nye tum wɔ mbɔnsam nyina na ayarsa do.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsomaa hɔn dɛ wɔnkɛka Nyankopɔn ahenman no ho asɛm, na wɔmma ayarfo nya ayarsa.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma hom mmfa biribiara nntu kwan, mma hom mmfa poma anaa kotoku anaa edziban anaa sika, na mma hom mmfa ntar ebien so.
title: LUKE

text: Na fie biara a hom bɛhɛn mu no, hom ntsena hɔ ara, na hom eefi hɔ akɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔrenngye hom no, hom fi kurow mu hɔ rokɔ a, hom mporoporow hom ananadze huntuma ngye dase ntsia hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na wosii mu koduaduaa nkurow no nyina mu kaa asɛmpa no, na wɔsaa yarba wɔ mbea nyina.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔmansinhen Herod tsee dza ɔyɛe nyina, na ne tsirmu yɛɛ no basabasa, osiandɛ binom kaa dɛ John efi ewufo mu asoɛr;
title: LUKE

text: na binom so kaa dɛ Elija eyi noho; na binom so dɛ tsetse nkɔnhyɛfo no mu baako asoɛr bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na Herod see dɛ, Metwa John ne tsir; na woana nye nyia metse no ho nsɛm dɛm yi? Na ɔpɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ obohu no.
title: LUKE

text: Na asomafo no sanee bae no, wɔbɛkaa dza wɔakɛyɛ nyina kyerɛɛ no. Na ɔfaa hɔn kɔr nkyɛn beebi, wɔ kurow a wɔfrɛ no Bɛtsaeda no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyimpadodow no hunii no, wɔkɛkaa no do; na ɔgyee hɔn na ɔkaa Nyankopɔn ahenman no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn, na ɔsaa hɔn a wohia ayarsa no yarba.
title: LUKE

text: Na wi rokɔtɔ no, duebien no bae bɛsee no dɛ, Gya nyimpadodow yi kwan ma wɔnkɔ nkurow nye nkuraase a woetwa ehyia yi mu nkɛtsena hɔ, ama woeenya edziban: na mbrɛ yɛwɔ yi dze, sar do a.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Homara hom mma hɔn biribi ma wondzi. Na wobuaa dɛ, Yennyi biribiara dɛ paanoo enum, na esunam ebien, gyedɛ yɛkɔ kɔtɔ edziban ma nkorɔfo yi nyina.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔbɛyɛ mbarimba mpemenum. Na ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, Hom mma wɔntsenatsena famu ekuw mu, eduonum, eduonum.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔyɛɛ dɛm na wɔmaa hɔn nyina tsenaa famu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔfaa paanoo enum no, nye esunam ebien no, na ɔhwɛɛ sor no, ohyiraa do, na obubui dze maa n’esuafo no dɛ wɔnkyɛ mma nyimpadodow no.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn nyina dzidzii na wɔmee; na wɔtasee mporoporoba a ɔboor do no nkɛntsɛn duebien.
title: LUKE

text: Na aber bi a noara nko wɔ hɔ rosɔr na n’esuafo no ka no ho no, obisaa hɔn dɛ, Nyimpadodow se dɛ woana nye me?
title: LUKE

text: Na wobuae see dɛ, John Onumanyi no a, na binom se Elija a; binom so se dɛ tsetse nkɔnhyɛfo no bi na ɔasoɛr bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Na hom dze, hom se dɛ woana nye me? Na Peter buae see dɛ, Nyankopɔn ne Kraest no a.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbraa hɔn hyɛɛ hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnka iyi nnkyerɛ obiara,
title: LUKE

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔsɛ nyimpa Ba no dɛ obohu amandze pii, na mpanyimfo nye asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no apow no, na woeku no, na da a otsia ebiasa no oenyan.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn nyina dɛ, Sɛ obi pɛ dɛ odzi m’ekyir a, ma ɔmpow noho, na ɔmma ne mbeamudua do daa na ɔnka mo do.
title: LUKE

text: Na obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔkora ne nkwa no, ɔbɔhwer no, na obiara a ɔbɔhwer no nkwa wɔ emi ntsi, ɔno na obenya no bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ nyimpa nya wiadze nyina, na sɛ ɔyew noho, anaaso ɔhwer ne kra a, ebɛn mfaso na obenya?
title: LUKE

text: Osiandɛ obiara a n’enyi bɔto emi nye me nsɛm ho no, ɔno na nyimpa Ba no n’enyi bɔto no ho, ber a ɔdze nankasa nye n’Egya nye abɔfo krɔnkrɔn enyimnyam no bɛba no.
title: LUKE

text: Na meka kyerɛ hom nokwar mu dɛ, Hɔn a wogyina ha yi, binom wɔ hɔ a wɔronnsɔ owu nnhwɛ ansaana woehu Nyankopɔn n’ahenman no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nsɛm yi ekyir bɛyɛ ndaawɔtwe no, ɔfaa Peter, John nye James, na ɔkɔr kokwaa bi do kɔsɔree.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔrosɔr no, n’enyim su sakyeree, na ne ntar yɛɛ fitaa hyɛnhyɛnn.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, mbarimba beenu nye no kasae: wɔyɛ Moses nye Elija.
title: LUKE

text: Hɔn na woyii hɔnho wɔ enyimnyam mu, na wɔkaa wu a orukowu wɔ Jerusalɛm no ho asɛm.
title: LUKE

text: Nna nda afa Peter nye hɔn a wɔka no ho no kɛsenara, na wonyanee no, wohun n’enyimnyam nye mbarimba beenu a wogyina ne nkyɛn no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ worisi mu efi ne nkyɛn no, Peter see Jesus dɛ, Ewuradze, oye ma hɛn dɛ yɛtsena ha, na ma yɛmbɔ asese ebiasa, wodze kor, Moses dze kor, Elija dze kor; a nna onnyim dza ɔreka.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔreka dɛm no, mununkum bɛkataa hɔn do; na wɔrehɛn mununkum no mu no, wosuroi.
title: LUKE

text: Na ndze fi mununkum no mu baa dɛ, Oyi nye me Ba, nyia masan mu meyi no: hom ntsie no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ndze no twaa mu no, nna aka Jesus nko wɔ hɔ. Na womuamuaa do, na nda no mu no wɔannka ndzɛmba a wohunii no ho asɛm biara annkyerɛ obiara.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ n’adzekyee a wofi kokwaa no do baa famu no, nyimpadodow pii behyiaa no.
title: LUKE

text: Hɔ no ara, obi fi nyimpadodow no mu tseaa mu dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, meserɛ wo, hwɛ me ba yi: na me ba kor ara nye no;
title: LUKE

text: na sunsum bi kyer no, na ɔka mu awerɛfir mu, na ɔtsetsew no ma n’ano twa ehur, na ɔposa no araa ma ɔyɛ dzen ana oegyaa no.
title: LUKE

text: Na meserɛɛ w’esuafo no dɛ wontu no, naaso woenntum.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus buae see dɛ, Ao ɔsantsen a hom nnyi gyedzi na hom akyea, menye hom ntsena na minsie hom ho abotar nkodu dabɛn? Fa wo ba no bra ha.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔreba no, sunsum fi no twaa no hwee famu, na ɔtsetseew no, na Jesus bɔɔ sunsum fi no ham, na ɔsaa abofra no yarba, na ɔdze no maa n’egya.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn nyina ho boow hɔn, wɔ Nyankopɔn no tumdzi kɛse no ntsi. Na ber a obiara no ho abow no wɔ ndzɛmba a Jesus yɛe nyina ho no, ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Hom mma nsɛm yi nkɔ hom asomu: na nyimpa Ba no, woribeyi no ahyɛ nyimpa nsa.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔanntse asɛm yi ase, na ohuntaa hɔn amma woeennhu, na wosuroo dɛ wobebisa no asɛm yi ho biribi.
title: LUKE

text: Na atsɛnyiyi baa hɔn mu dɛ hɔn mu woana na ɔyɛ kɛse.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus hun hɔn akoma mu adwen no, ɔfaa abofraba bi gyinaa ne nkyɛn,
title: LUKE

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Obiara a ɔbɛgye abofraba yi wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔgye emi mara; na obiara a ɔgye me no, ɔgye nyia ɔsomaa me no: na nyia ɔyɛ ekumaba wɔ hom nyina mu no, ɔno na ɔyɛ kɛse.
title: LUKE

text: Na John buae see dɛ, Hɛn wura, yehun obi dɛ ɔdze wo dzin rutu esunsum fi, na yesiiw no kwan, osiandɛ ɔnnka hɛn ho.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Mma hom nnsiw no kwan: na nyia onntsia hom no, ɔwɔ hom afa.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda a wɔrebɛfa no akɔ sor reyɛ edu no, osii n’adwen pi dze n’enyi kyerɛɛ dɛ ɔrokɔ Jerusalɛm,
title: LUKE

text: na ɔsomaa abɔfo dzii n’enyim kan; na wɔkɔree no, wɔkɛhɛɛn Samariafo kurow bi mu dɛ worikesiesie hɔ ama no.
title: LUKE

text: Naaso wɔanngye no, osiandɛ nna n’enyi kyerɛ Jerusalɛm.
title: LUKE

text: Na n’esuafo James nye John hunii no, wɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, ana epɛ dɛ yɛka ma ogya fi sor ba bɛhyew hɔn?
title: LUKE

text: Naaso Jesus daan noho twuuw hɔn enyim;
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔkɔr ekuroba bi so mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔnam kwan mu rokɔ no, obi kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Beebiara a ebɔkɔ no, mebɛka wo do.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Nsɔ wɔ etu, na wimu nnoma wɔ mberɛbuw, naaso nyimpa Ba no dze, onnyi beebi a ɔdze ne tsir to.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see obi so dɛ, Ka mo do, na ɔsee no dɛ, Ma me kwan ma monkɔ minkesie m’egya ana.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ma ewufo nsie hɔnara hɔn ewufo, na ɔwo dze, kɔ kɛka Nyankopɔn n’ahenman ho asɛm.
title: LUKE

text: Na obi so see no dɛ, Ewuradze, mebɛka wo do, na ma me kwan ma menkɛkra hɔn a wɔwɔ me fie ana.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Obi a ɔdze ne nsa kosuo funtumdadze no mu, na ɔhwɛ n’ekyir no, ɔmmfata Nyankopɔn ahenman no.
title: LUKE

text: Na iyi ekyir no, Ewuradze yii eduosuon afofor so, na ɔsomaa hɔn beenu beenu dzii n’enyim kan kɔr kurow anaa beebiara a nankasa robɔkɔ hɔ no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Otwadwuma no dɔɔ so ampa, na edwumayɛfo no dze, wosuar: dɛm ntsi hom nserɛ otwadwuma no wura ma ɔnsoma edwumayɛfo mbra no twadwuma no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Hom nkɔ: hwɛ, mosoma hom dɛ nguambaa wɔ mpataku finimfin.
title: LUKE

text: Mma hom mmfa sika kotoku, anaa bɔtɔ, anaa nsokota; na mma hom nnkyia obi wɔ kwan mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ofi biara a hom bɛhɛn mu no, hom ndzi kan nse dɛ, Asomdwee mbra ofi yi do.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ asomdwee ba wɔ hɔ a, hom asomdwee bɛtsena no do, na sɛ ɔnntse dɛm a, ɔbɛsan aba hom hɔ bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na fie hɔ ara na hom ntsena, na hom ndzi na hom nnom dza wɔbɛma: osiandɛ odwumayɛfo n’apaadze sɛ no: mma hom mmfi fie kor mu nnkɔ fofor mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na kurow biara a hom kɔ mu, na wɔgye hom, hom ndzi dza wɔdze besi hom enyim;
title: LUKE

text: na hom nsa no mu ayarfo yarba, na hom nse hɔn dɛ, Nyankopɔn ahenman no abɛn hom.
title: LUKE

text: Na kurow biara a hom kɔ mu na wɔnngye hom no, hom mfir nkɔ n’abɔntsen do, na hom nse dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Hom kurow mu huntuma a ayeyɛ hɛn ho mpo yɛprapra gu hom do: na ɔyɛ dɛn ara a, hom nhu iyi dɛ Nyankopɔn ahenman no abɛn hom.
title: LUKE

text: Na mese hom dɛ ɔbɛfanyim Sodom wɔ da no mu akyɛn dɛm kurow no.
title: LUKE

text: Korazin ndue! Bɛtsaeda ndue! Osiandɛ sɛ tum ndwuma a wɔyɛe wɔ hom mu yi, wɔyɛɛ no wɔ Taere nye Sidon mu a, nkyɛ wɔtsenatsenaa eyitam nye nso mu nuu hɔnho ntsɛmara.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbɛfanyim Taere nye Sidon wɔ atsɛmbu no mu akyɛn hom.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔwo, Karpernaum, wɔbɛma wo do akɔ sor anaa? Hwɛ, wɔbɛbrɛ wo adze akɔ samanadze.
title: LUKE

text: Nyia otsie hom no, otsie me so, na nyia ɔpow hom no, ɔpow me so, na nyia ɔpow me, ɔpow nyia ɔsomaa me no so.
title: LUKE

text: Na eduosuon no dze dɛw sanee bɛsee dɛ, Wo dzin ntsi esunsum fi mpo abrɛ hɔnho adze ama hɛn.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Muhun Satan dɛ ofir sor rohwe ase dɛ enyinam.
title: LUKE

text: Hwɛ, mama hom tum dɛ hom ntsiatsia nwɔ nye nyankoma nketsebowa do nye ɔtamfo ahoɔdzen nyina do: na biribiara runntum nnyɛ hom.
title: LUKE

text: Naaso mma hom nndzi dɛw wɔ iyi mu dɛ esunsum fi abrɛ hɔnho adze ama hom, na mbom hom ndzi dɛw dɛ wɔakyerɛw hom edzin wɔ sor.
title: LUKE

text: Na dɔn no ara mu odzii ehurusi wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu, na ɔsee dɛ, Miyi wo ayɛw, Egya, sor nye asaase Wura, dɛ edze ndzɛmba yi esuma enyansafo nye abadwembafo, na eyi akyerɛ nkɔkowaba: ampaara, Egya, na dɛm na ɔsɔɔ w’enyi.
title: LUKE

text: Ndzɛmba nyina m’Egya dze ahyɛ me nsa; na obi nnyim mbrɛ Ɔba no tse, gyedɛ Egya no; na obi nnyim mbrɛ Egya no tse, gyedɛ Ɔba no na nyia Ɔba no pɛ dɛ oyi no kyerɛ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔdaan noho kyerɛɛ n’esuafo no see hɔn nko dɛ, Nhyira aka enyiwa a ohu dza hom hu yi.
title: LUKE

text: Na mese hom dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛfo nye ahemfo pii pɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ wohu dza hom ruhu yi, naaso woennhu, na dɛ wɔtse dza hom retse yi, naaso wɔanntse.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, mbrakyerɛfo bi soɛree sɔɔ no hwɛɛ dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ebɛnadze na menyɛ ma meenya onnyiewiei nkwa ayɛ medze?
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus bisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na wɔakyerɛw no mbra no mu? Ekenkan dɛn?
title: LUKE

text: Na obuae see dɛ, Dɔ Ewuradze wo Nyankopɔn wɔ w’akoma nyina mu, nye wo kra nyina mu, nye w’ahoɔdzen nyina mu, nye w’adwen nyina mu na, Dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa woho.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ebua yie: yɛ yi na ibenya nkwa.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔno dze, ɔpɛɛ dɛ obu noho bem no, obisaa Jesus dɛ, Nna me nyɛnko nye woana?
title: LUKE

text: Jesus buae see dɛ, Nna nyimpa bi fi Jerusalɛm risian akɔ Jeriko, na ɔkɔtɔɔ edwotwafo mu a wɔpaa no ho tam, na wopirapiraa no gyaa no hɔ kɔree, ma ɔatɔ akɔtɔmborɔnsa.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔsɔfo bi bɛfaa kwan no do, na ohun no no, osii afa noho twaa mu.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛmara na Levinyi bi so odur hɔ no, ɔbae na obohunii na osii afa noho twaa mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na Samarianyi bi a ɔnam no kwan baa mbrɛ ɔwɔ no, na obohun no no, ne yamu hyehyee no,
title: LUKE

text: na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn bɛkyekyeer n’ekur dze ngo nye wenyin guguu mu, na ɔdze no sii nankasa n’abowa do dze no kɔr ahɔhodan mu kɔhwɛɛ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na adzekyee no oyii sika denare ebien dze maa ahɔhodan wura no, na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ no yie, na biribiara a ebɔhwer aka ho no, sɛ mesan ba a, mebɛhyɛ wo ananmu.
title: LUKE

text: Afei hɔn baasa yi mu woana na ɔyɛɛ nyia ɔkɔtɔɔ edwotwafo mu no ne nyɛnko?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyia ohun no mbɔbɔr no a. Na Jesus see no dɛ, Kɔ na wo so kɛyɛ dɛmara.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ wɔrokɔ no, wokodur ekuroba bi mu, na ɔbaa bi a ne dzin dze Martha faa no kɔr ne fie.
title: LUKE

text: Nna ɔwɔ onuabaa bi a wɔfrɛ no Mary, ɔno so na ɔtsenaa Jesus anan ho na otsiee ne nsɛm.
title: LUKE

text: Na Martha fonaa noho wɔ ɔsom pii ho, na ɔbaa no hɔ bɛsee no dɛ, Mo wura, ennhwɛ dɛ mo nua egyaa mo nko ma morosom? Dɛm ntsi se no dɛ ombosuo mo mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na Ewuradze buae see no dɛ, Martha, Martha, edwendwen na ehaw woho wɔ ndzɛmba pii ho;
title: LUKE

text: adze kor na ohia: na Mary dze, oeyi dza oye a wɔrenngye ne nsamu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔwɔ beebi rosɔr, na ogyaae no, n’esuafo no mu baako see no dɛ, Ewuradze, kyerɛkyerɛ hɛn asɔr yɛ, dɛ mbrɛ John so kyerɛkyerɛɛ n’esuafo no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom rosɔr a, hom nse dɛ, Egya, wo dzin ho ntsew, w’ahendzi mbra.
title: LUKE

text: Ma hɛn hɛn daa daa edziban daa.
title: LUKE

text: Na fa hɛn bɔn kyɛ hɛn, osiandɛ hɛn so yɛdze kyɛ obiara a ɔdze hɛn kaw. Na mma mmfa hɛn nnkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mu woana na ɔwɔ nyɛnko, na ɔbɔkɔ ne nkyɛn esuom akɛse no dɛ, Damfo, fɛm me paanoo ebiasa:
title: LUKE

text: na me nyɛnko bi nam kwan aba me nkyɛn na minnya hwee nnsi n’enyim;
title: LUKE

text: na ɔno dze, obefi dan mu noho ebua dɛ, Mma nnhaw me: wɔatow abow mu dada na me mba wɔ me nkyɛn wɔ mpa do: murunntum nnsoɛr mmbɛma wo bi?
title: LUKE

text: Mese hom dɛ, Kaansa ɔnnkɔsoɛr abɛma no dɛ ɔyɛ ne nyɛnko ntsi a, n’anoɔdzen ntsi ɔbɔsoɛr abɛma no dodow a ohia no.
title: LUKE

text: Na mese hom dɛ, Hom mbisa na wɔbɛma hom; hom nhwehwɛ na hom bohu; hom mbɔ mu na wobobue ama hom:
title: LUKE

text: na obiara a obisa no onya; na nyia ɔhwehwɛ no ohu; na nyia ɔbɔ mu no wobobue no.
title: LUKE

text: Na hom mu woana na ɔyɛ egya, na sɛ ne ba bisa no paanoo a, ɔbɛma no ɔbo? Anaa esunam a, ɔdze ɔwɔ bɛyɛ esunam ama no?
title: LUKE

text: Anaadɛ obisa kyirefuwa a, ɔbɛma no nyankomaketsebowa?
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ hom a hom muo yi mpo nyim mbrɛ hom si dze akyɛdze pa ma hom mba a, mpɛn ahen ara na hom Egya a ɔwɔ sor no nnkɛfa Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ama hɔn a wobisa no?
title: LUKE

text: Nna orutu sunsum fi bi a ɔyɛ mmum. Na ɔbaa dɛ sunsum fi no fiir edzi no, mmum no kasae; na ɔyɛɛ nyimpadodow no nwanwa.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn mu binom see dɛ, Ɔnam sunsum fi panyin Beelzebul do na otu sunsum fi.
title: LUKE

text: Na binom so sɔɔ no hwɛe bisaa no hɔ asɛnkyerɛdze a ofi sor.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔno dze onyim hɔn adwen no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ahenman biara nye noho dzi mpaapaamu a, ɔyɛ amamfo, na fie bi so nye fie bi dzi a, ɔhwe ase.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ Satan so nye noho dzi mpaapaamu a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na n’ahenman egyina? Osiandɛ hom se dɛ menam Beelzebul do tu esunsum fi.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ emi menam Beelzebul do tu sunsum bɔn a, woana do na hom mba nam tu hɔn? Dɛm ntsi hɔn na wɔbɛyɛ hom atsɛmbuafo.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ menam Nyankopɔn nsatseaba do tu esunsum bɔn a, nna Nyankopɔn ahenman enya aba hom nkyɛn.
title: LUKE

text: Sɛ ɔkatakyi emia roweɔn n’aban a, n’ahodze wɔ hɔ komm:
title: LUKE

text: na sɛ obi a ɔkyɛn no ahoɔdzen ba no do, na odzi no do nyim a, ɔgye n’akodze a no werɛ twer, na ɔkyɛ n’asadze no.
title: LUKE

text: Nyia ɔnnka mo ho no, na ɔnye me enya; nyia ɔnye me mmboaboa ano no, ɔhotse gu.
title: LUKE

text: Na sunsum bɔn, sɛ ofi nyimpa mu fir a, okekyin wewewdo hwehwɛ ahomgye na onnya bi a, ɔse dɛ, Mebɛsan akɔ me fie a mifii mu bae no mu;
title: LUKE

text: na ɔba a, ɔto no dɛ wɔaprapra mu na woesiesie mu.
title: LUKE

text: Nna ɔkɔ kɛfa esunsum esuon afofor a womuo sen nankasa ka noho, na wɔbɛhɛn mu tsena hɔ: na nyimpa no n’ekyir asetsena yɛ bɔn sen nkan no dze.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔreka yinom no, ɔbaa bi a ɔwɔ nyimpadodow no mu maa ne ndze do see no dɛ, Nhyira aka yafun a ɔwoo wo, nye numfo a inumii.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔno dze, ɔsee dɛ, Mbom nhyira aka hɔn a wotsie Nyankopɔn asɛm na wodzi do.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyimpadodow boaboaa ano no, ɔhyɛɛ ase kaa dɛ, Ɔsantsen yi yɛ ɔsantsen a omuo: wɔhwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze, na wɔremma hɔn asɛnkyerɛdze biara dɛ Jona n’asɛnkyerɛdze no.
title: LUKE

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ wɔyɛɛ Jona asɛnkyerɛdze maa Ninivefo no, dɛmara na nyimpa Ba no bɛyɛ ama ɔsantsen yi.
title: LUKE

text: Pomu afamu ɔhembaa nye ɔsantsen yi mbarimba bɔsoɛr wɔ atsɛmbu no mu, na oebu hɔn fɔ: osiandɛ ofi asaase ano noho bae betsiee Solomon ne nyansaa, na hwɛ, nyia ɔsen Solomon wɔ ha.
title: LUKE

text: Ninive mbarimba nye ɔsantsen yi bɔsoɛr wɔ atsɛmbu no mu, na woebu hɔn fɔ: osiandɛ wonuu hɔnho wɔ Jona n’asɛnka ase, na hwɛ, nyia ɔsen Jona wɔ ha.
title: LUKE

text: Obi nnsɔ kandzea nnsi kukua mu, anaa kuruw ase, na ɔdze si kandzeadua do, ma hɔn a wɔhɛn mu eehu kan no.
title: LUKE

text: Nyimpadua ne kandzea nye w’enyiwa: dɛm ntsi ber a w’enyiwa yɛ kann no, nna wo nyimpadua nyina so bɛyɛ kann; na ber a omuo no, nna wo nyimpadua no so yɛ kusuww.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛm ntsi hwɛ ma kan a ɔwɔ wo mu aannyɛ sum.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ wo nyimpadua nyina yɛ kann, na beebiara nnyi sum a, ne nyina bɛyɛ kann, dɛ mbrɛ kandzea dze ne hyerɛn hyɛnhyɛnn ma wo kan no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔrekasa no, Farisiinyi bi bebisaa no dɛ ɔnye no nkedzidzi, na ɔkɔr mu kɛtsenaa edzidzii.
title: LUKE

text: Na Farisiinyi no hun dɛ ɔannhohor ne nsa ho ansaana oridzidzi no, ɔyɛɛ no nwanwa.
title: LUKE

text: Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, Afei hom Farisiifo dze, hom twuw nkɔɔpow nye mprɛtse ho, na hom mu dze, apempensi nye emumuyɛ ahyɛ ma.
title: LUKE

text: Nkwasea, ana nnyɛ nyia ɔyɛɛ ekyir no, ɔnoara na ɔyɛɛ no mu so?
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, hom mfa dza ɔwɔ mu no bi nyɛ ayɛ, na ɔno na ɔbɛma adze nyina ho efir ama hom.
title: LUKE

text: Na hom ndue, hom Farisiifo! Na hom yi eme nye nunum nye fan nyina do ebupɛn du du ma, na hom twa atsɛmbu nye Nyankopɔn dɔ no gya: na iyi na ɔsɛ dɛ nkyɛ hom yɛ, ber a hom nndan dza ɔaka no so nngya.
title: LUKE

text: Hom ndue, hom Farisiifo! Na hom pɛ mpanyin ngua wɔ nhyiamudan mu nye gua do nkyiakyia.
title: LUKE

text: Hom ndue! Na hom tse dɛ nda a ɔnnda edzi, na nyimpa a wɔnam do nnhu.
title: LUKE

text: Na mbrakyerɛfo no mu baako buae see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ese dɛm a, nna erotom hɛn so.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mbrakyerɛfo so, hom ndue! Na hom soa nyimpa ndzesoadze a no soa yɛ yaw, na homankasa dze, hom mmfa hom nsatseaba kor mpo nnka ndzesoadze no.
title: LUKE

text: Hom ndue! Na hom tow nkɔnhyɛfo nda do, naaso homara hom egyanom kum hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛm ntsi hom dzi hom egyanom ndwuma ho dase, na hom so pen do, osiandɛ hɔn na wokum hɔn, na hom na hom tow hɔn nda do.
title: LUKE

text: Iyi ntsi na Nyankopɔn ne nyansaa se dɛ, Mobɔsoma nkɔnhyɛfo nye asomafo wɔ hɔn hɔ, na woboku, na wobehiahia hɔn mu binom ho;
title: LUKE

text: ama nkɔnhyɛfo nyina bɔgyaa a wɔkae gui, ofitsi wiadze ahyɛse no, wɔaahwehwɛ no ɔsantsen yi nsamu:
title: LUKE

text: ofitsi Abel no bɔgyaa do besi Zekaria a ɔtɔr afɔrmbukyia nye asɔrdan ntamu no no bɔgyaa do, ɛhɛɛ, mese hom dɛ wɔbɔhwehwɛ no ɔsantsen yi nsamu.
title: LUKE

text: Hom mbrakyerɛfo, hom ndue! Na hom afa nyimdzee saafee: homankasa hom annkɔ mu, na hɔn a wɔrokɔ mu no so, hom siiw hɔn kwan.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔreka yinom kyerɛ hɔn no, kyerɛwfo nye Farisiifo no hyɛɛ ase hyehyɛɛ no do pii, na wɔgyegyee no kasa wɔ ndzɛmba pii ho;
title: LUKE

text: na wɔtsɛɛw no hwehwɛɛ dɛ wobenya n’anomu asɛm bi eesuo mu.
title: LUKE

text: Aber no mu ara, nyimpadodow mpempem boaboaa ano, ma mpo wotsiatsiaa hɔnho do no, ɔhyɛɛ ase kaa kyerɛɛ n’esuafo no kan dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ Farisiifo mbɔrkaw ho: ɔno nye ndabraba.
title: LUKE

text: Na biribi do nnkatae a worinnyi no edzi, na onnhuntae a worunnhu.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛm ntsi biribi a hom aka wɔ sum mu no, wɔbɛtse no wɔ kan mu; na dza hom aka wɔ asomu wɔ adankyir no, wɔbɛpaa mu aka wɔ adan etsifi.
title: LUKE

text: Na meka kyerɛ hom, m’anyɛnkofo dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro hɔn a woku honam, na n’ekyir no wonnyi biribi a wobotum ayɛ bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na mebɛkyerɛ hom nyia hom nsuro no: hom nsuro nyia oeku ewie no, ɔwɔ tum dɛ ɔdze kɔto amandzehu kurow mu: nyew, mese hom dɛ, Ɔno na hom nsuro no.
title: LUKE

text: Ana nsorɔm enum wɔnntɔn nngye mpɛsewa ebien? Naaso hɔn mu kor ara mpo nnyi hɔ a enyi pa no do wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Na hom tsinhwi mpo wɔakan ne nyina. Mma hom nnsuro: osiandɛ hom som bo kyɛn nsorɔm pii.
title: LUKE

text: Na mese hom dɛ, Obiara a ɔbɔbɔ me dzin wɔ nyimpa enyim no, ɔno na nyimpa Ba no bɔbɔ ne dzin wɔ Nyankopɔn abɔfoe enyim;
title: LUKE

text: na nyia ɔpa me nyimpa enyim no, ɔno na wɔbɛpa no Nyankopɔn abɔfoe enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Na obiara a ɔbɛka asɛm etsia nyimpa Ba no, wɔdze bɛkyɛ no; na nyia ɔka ebususɛm tsia Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no, wɔnnkɛfa akyɛ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ wɔdze hom ba nhyiamudan mu nye mpanyimfo nye etumfo enyim a, mma hom nndwendwen mbrɛ hom bɛyɛ anaa dza hom bɛka eyi homho, anaa dza hom bɛse:
title: LUKE

text: osiandɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no bɛkyerɛ hom dɔn no ara mu dza ɔsɛ dɛ hom bɛka.
title: LUKE

text: Na obi fi nyimpadodow no mu see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, ka kyerɛ mo nua ma ɔnye me nkyɛ ewungyadze no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Nyimpa, woana yɛɛ me ɔsɛndzifo nye adzekyɛfo wɔ hom do?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie na hom nsie homho wɔ enyikaber nyina ho: na nyimpa no nkwa nnyi ndzɛmba a oenya abor do mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na obuu hɔn bɛ bi dɛ, Nyimpa bi a ɔyɛ ɔdzefo n’asaase soow pii;
title: LUKE

text: na osusuu ne tsir mu dɛ, Mebɛyɛ dɛn? Osiandɛ minnyi beebi mbrɛ medze mo nduadzewa besie.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Iyi na mebɛyɛ: mubodwuruw m’asan egu famu, na mesi akɛse; na hɔ na medze m’ekuadze nye me ndzɛmba nkaa no nyina besie.
title: LUKE

text: Na mase me kra dɛ, Ɔkra, ewɔ ndzɛmba pii a wɔdze egu hɔ ama mfe pii: gye w’ahom, dzidzi, nom, na ma woho ntɔ wo.
title: LUKE

text: Na Nyankopɔn see no dɛ, Ɔkwasea, anafua yi wɔbɛgye wo kra wɔ wo nsamu; na dza esiesie no bɛyɛ woana dze?
title: LUKE

text: Mbrɛ nyia ɔboaboa akoradze ano ma noho, na ɔnnyɛ ɔdzefo wɔ Nyankopɔn afamu tse nye no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ, Mma hom nndwendwen wɔ hom nkwa ho, dɛ ebɛnadze na hom bedzi, anaaso hom nyimpadua ho, dɛ ebɛnadze na hom bofura.
title: LUKE

text: Nkwa kyɛn edziban, na nyimpadua kyɛn efuradze.
title: LUKE

text: Hom nhwɛ nkonkoran dɛ wonndua na wommbu, wonnyi efiadze anaa ɔsan, naaso Nyankopɔn nyɛn hɔn: ɔkyɛn bɛn na hom nsom bo nkyɛn nnoma no.
title: LUKE

text: Na hom mu woana na ɔdwendwen a, obotum dze basafa kor ato ne tsentsen do?
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ hom nntum adze ketseaba dɛm mpo yɛ a, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom dwendwen nkaa no ho?
title: LUKE

text: Hom nhwɛ haban mu nsukookoo, mbrɛ wonyin: wɔnnyɛ edwuma, eso wɔnntow asaaba; naaso mese hom dɛ Solomon n’enyimnyam nyina mu no mpo, n’ahosiesie annto iyinom mu kor.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ Nyankopɔn ma haban mu efuw a ɔwɔ hɔ ndɛ na ɔkyena wɔdze gu fononoo mu efuradze dɛm a, mpɛn ahen na ɔnnkɛma hom ma akyɛn dɛm, hom a hom gyedzi suar?
title: LUKE

text: Na mma hom nnhwehwɛ dza hom bedzi anaa dza hom bɔnom, eso mma hom adwen nnyɛ hom konsee.
title: LUKE

text: Na dɛm ndzɛmba yi nyina na wiadze amanaman hwehwɛ: na hom Egya nyim dɛ yinom hia hom.
title: LUKE

text: Na mbom hom nhwehwɛ n’ahenman no, na wɔdze yinom bɛka hom ho.
title: LUKE

text: Mma hom nnsuro, oguankuw ketseaba: na ɔyɛ hom Egya fɛw dɛ ɔdze ahenman no bɛma hom.
title: LUKE

text: Hom ntɔn dza hom wɔ mfa nyɛ ayɛ; hom nyɛ nkotoku a ɔrennyɛ dadaw mma homho, akoradze wɔ sor a ɔnnsa, mbrɛ owifo mmbɛn ho, na nkakraka nnsɛɛ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na mbrɛ hom akoradze wɔ no, hɔ na hom akoma so wɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Hom mbɔ hom asen do, na hom nkandzea ndzɛw;
title: LUKE

text: na hom nyɛ dɛ nyimpa a wɔrotweɔn hɔn wura, aber kor a obefi ayefor ase aba, ma sɛ ɔba na ɔbɔbɔ mu a, woeebue no ntsɛmara.
title: LUKE

text: Nhyira aka nkowaa no a, sɛ owura no ba a, ɔbɔto hɔn dɛ wɔroweɔn: nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔbɔbɔ noho do, na ɔama wɔatsena edzidzii, na ɔaba abɔsom hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ ɔba dasu ebien anaa ebiasa mu, na ɔbɔto hɔn dɛm a, nhyira aka nkowaa no.
title: LUKE

text: Na hom nhu yi, dɛ sɛ ofiwura no nyim dɔn kor a owifo no bɛba a, nkyɛ ɔbɔweɔn amma woeemmbobubu ne dan mu enndua mu.
