title: LUKE

text: Na hom so hom nyɛ krado, osiandɛ dɔn a hom nnsusu mu na nyimpa Ba no reba.
title: LUKE

text: Na Peter see dɛ, Ewuradze, hɛn nko na ibu hɛn bɛ yi, anaa edze ma obiara so?
title: LUKE

text: Na Ewuradze see dɛ, Woana koraa nye ofihwɛfo nokwafo nye nyansafo a no wura dze no besi ne fifo do, dɛ ɔmma hɔn edziban a ɔyɛ hɔn kyɛpɛn wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu?
title: LUKE

text: Nhyira aka akowaa no a, sɛ no wura ba a, obohu no dɛ ɔreyɛ dɛm.
title: LUKE

text: Nokwar mese hom dɛ ɔdze no besi n’adze a ɔwɔ nyina do.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ akowaa no se n’akoma mu dɛ, Mo wura rikyim ne ba; na ɔhyɛ ase bobɔ nkowaa nye mfonabaa no, na odzidzi na ɔnom bow a;
title: LUKE

text: akowaa no wura bɛba da a ɔronnhwɛ no kwan, ɔnye dɔn a onnyim mu, na oetwa no mu ebien, na ɔama ɔnye ndabrabafo no edzi afora.
title: LUKE

text: Na akowaa no a onyim no wura ne pɛ, na oennsiesie noho, na eso ɔannyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ no, wɔbɔhwe no mbaa pii.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyia onnyim, na ɔyɛɛ ndzɛmba a ɔsɛ ɔhwe no, wɔbɔhwe no kakrabaa. Na obiara a wɔama no dodow na wɔbɛgye dodow wɔ no hɔ; na nyia wɔdze pii ahyɛ ne nsa no, nna wobebisa no dza ɔbor do.
title: LUKE

text: Mebae dɛ morobɔsɔ gya wɔ asaase do, na sɛ asɔ dada a, ebɛnadze bio na mepɛ sen dɛm?
title: LUKE

text: Na mowɔ enuma bi a wɔdze bonuma me, na mbrɛ mo ho dua kyer me gyedɛ ayɛ hɔ ana!
title: LUKE

text: Hom susu dɛ mebae dɛ merebɛma asomdwee wɔ asaase do anaa? Mese hom dɛ, Dabida, na mbom mpaapaamu a:
title: LUKE

text: na ofitsi ndɛ beenum wɔ ofi kor mu bedzi mpaapaamu, baasa nye beenu benya, na beenu nye baasa so enya.
title: LUKE

text: Wobedzi mpaapaamu, ma egya nye ba enya, na ɔba nye n’egya enya; na na nye babaa enya, na babaa nye ne na enya; asewbasia nye n’asew enya, na asew nye n’asewbasia enya.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee nyimpadodow no so dɛ, Sɛ hom hu nsuwusiw fir anee rosoɛr a, ntsɛmara hom se dɛ, Nsu reba, na ɔba dɛm.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ hom hu dɛ pomu mframa robɔ a, hom se dɛ, Ɔhyew reba, na ɔba mu.
title: LUKE

text: Ndabrabafo, hom nyim asaase nye ɔsor enyim ndzɛmba ho ase kyerɛ; na ɔyɛ dɛn na hom nnhu aber yi ne nkyerɛasee yi?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔyɛ dɛn na homankasa so hom mmbu dza ɔtsen ho atsɛn?
title: LUKE

text: Na enye wo tamfo rokɔ otumfo enyim a, enye no wɔ kwan mu no, bɔ mbɔdzen yi woho wɔ ne nsamu; amma ɔaammfa wo annhyɛ ɔsɛndzifo nsa, na ɔsɛndzifo no aammfa wo annhyɛ ɔsomfo no nsa, na ɔsomfo no aammfa wo annkɔto efiadze.
title: LUKE

text: Nokwar mese wo dɛ, Innkefi hɔ ara da, gyedɛ etua kapɛrba a aka ekyir no mpo ana.
title: LUKE

text: Na aber no ara mu binom wɔ hɔ a wɔkaa Galiliifo a Pilate dze hɔn bɔgyaa foraa hɔn afɔrbɔdze mu no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na obuaa hɔn dɛ, Ana hom susu dɛ Galiliifo yi osiandɛ wohun dɛm amandze ntsi, wɔyɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo kyɛn Galiliifo nyina?
title: LUKE

text: Mese hom dɛ, Dabida: na mbom gyedɛ hom nu homho, ɔno hom nyina bɛhyew dɛmara.
title: LUKE

text: Anaaso hom susu dɛ nyimpa duawɔtwe a Siloam abantsentsen hwee hɔn do kum hɔn no, wɔyɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo kyɛn hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalɛm nyina?
title: LUKE

text: Mese hom dɛ, Dabida: na mbom gyedɛ hom nu homho, ɔno hom nyina bɔkɔ ɔsɛɛ mu dɛmara.
title: LUKE

text: Na obuu bɛ yi so: Obi wɔ adɔmbadua a wɔtsɛɛw no wɔ no wenyin ture mu, na ɔbae bɔhwehwɛɛ aba wɔ do, naaso oennya bi.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee turehwɛfo no dɛ, Hwɛ, mfe ebiasa nye yi a maba mabɔhwehwɛ adɔmbadua yi do aba, na mennya bi: twa no kyen; ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔkantan asaase no do so?
title: LUKE

text: Na obuae see no dɛ, Mo wura, ma onsi hɔ afe yi so nkodu dɛ mubofuntum ho, na medze sumina egu ase:
title: LUKE

text: na sɛ a ɔsow aba a, oye; na sɛ ɔannsow so a, ɔno eetwa no akyen.
title: LUKE

text: Nna ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ nhyiamudan bi mu ahomgyeda.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, ɔbaa bi wɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ ahoɔmberɛw sunsum mfe duawɔtwe, na no mu apon, ma onntum nntsen no mu koraa.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus hun no no, ɔfrɛɛ no see no dɛ, Ɔbaa, wɔasan wo efi w’ahoɔmberɛw mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔdze ne nsa too no do, na ntsɛmara ɔtsenee, na ɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔyɛɛ nhyiamudan mu panyin no ebufuw dɛ Jesus asa yarba wɔ ahomgyeda mu no, ɔsee nyimpadodow no dɛ, Nda esia wɔ hɔ a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔdze yɛ edwuma: no mu na hom mbra ma wɔnsa hom yarba, na nnyɛ ahomgyeda no mu a.
title: LUKE

text: Na Ewuradze buae see no dɛ, Ndabrabafo, ana hom mu biara nnsan ne nantwi, anaa n’asoasopɔnkɔ mmfi ban mu mmfa no nnkɔ esunomee ahomgyeda?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔnnsɛ dɛ ɔbaa yi a ɔyɛ Abraham babaa a Satan akyekyer no, mfe araa duawɔtwe yi, wɔsan no fi nkyekyeree yi mu ahomgyeda anaa?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkaa dɛm no, hɔn a wɔkasaa tsiaa no no nyina enyi toe, na nyimpadodow no nyina dzii dɛw wɔ enyimnyam ndzɛmba a ɔyɛe no nyina ho.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyankopɔn ahenman no tse dɛ ebɛnadze, na ebɛnadze koraa na medze mobɔto ho?
title: LUKE

text: Ɔtse dɛ sinape abafua a nyimpa fae kɔtoo no ture mu; na onyinii yɛɛ dua kɛse, na wimu nnoma bɛgyegyee n’abaw do.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkaa bio dɛ, Ebɛnadze na medze Nyankopɔn ahenman no mobɔto ho?
title: LUKE

text: Ɔtse dɛ mbɔrkaw a ɔbaa fae sumaa mbɔr korbaa ebiasa mu dze kesii dɛ ne nyina kawee.
title: LUKE

text: Na okoduaduaa nkurow nye nkuroba mu kyerɛkyerɛe, a ɔnam do rokɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: LUKE

text: Na obi see no dɛ, Ewuradze, ana kumaabi na wɔbɛgye hɔn nkwa? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Hom mper nhɛn abow tseabaa no mu; na mese hom dɛ, Dodowara bɔhwehwɛ mu ahɛn na wonnkotum.
title: LUKE

text: Prɛko ara ofiwura no bɔsoɛr, na ɔatow abow no mu no, na hom bɛhyɛ ase egyina ekyir, na hom abɔ abow no mu ase dɛ, Ewuradze, Ewuradze, bue hɛn ae, na obobua ase hom dɛ, Minnyim mbrɛ hom fi;
title: LUKE

text: ɔno na hom bɛhyɛ ase aka dɛ, Yeedzidzi, yɛanom wɔ w’enyim, na akyerɛkyerɛ wɔ hɛn abrɔn mu pɛn;
title: LUKE

text: na ɔbɛka dɛ, Mese hom dɛ, minnyim mbrɛ hom fir: hom mfi mo do, hom emumuyɛfo nyina.
title: LUKE

text: Hɔ na osu nye asetwɛr bɛba, dɛ hom bohu Abraham nye Isaak nye Jakob, nye nkɔnhyɛfo no nyinara wɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman mu, na homankasa dze, wɔatam hom efi mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na wofi boka nye anee nye pomu nye habanmu bɛba abɛtsena ase wɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, ekyidzifo bi wɔ hɔ a wobedzi kan, na edzikamfo bi wɔ hɔ a wobedzi ekyir.
title: LUKE

text: Na dɔn kor no ara Farisiifo bi bae bɛsee no dɛ, Fi ha kɔ, na Herod repɛ wo eku wo.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkɛse ɔsɔ no dɛ, Hwɛ murutu mbɔnsam na masa yarba ndɛ nye ɔkyena, na da otsia ebiasa no mewie
title: LUKE

text: Naaso ɔsɛ me dɛ mutu kwan ndɛ nye ɔkyena, nye da ɔtoa do no: osiandɛ ɔnnkɛyɛ dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi bɔtɔr beebiara gyedɛ Jerusalɛm.
title: LUKE

text: Ao! Jerusalɛm, Jerusalɛm, ɔwo a iku nkɔnhyɛfo no, na isiw hɔn a wɔasoma hɔn wo nkyɛn abo, mpɛn ahen na mepɛɛ dɛ moboaboa wo mba ano, dɛ mbrɛ akokɔ baatan boaboa ne mba ano wɔ ne ntsaban ase, na hom ammpɛ!
title: LUKE

text: Hwɛ, woegyaa wo fie ofi pan ama hom. Na mese hom dɛ, Hom runnhu me gyedɛ da a ɔbɛba dɛ hom bɛse dɛ, Nhyira nye nyia ɔnam Ewuradze ne dzin mu reba no.
title: LUKE

text: Ahomgyeda bi, Jesus kɔr Farisiifo panyin bi ne fie kedzidzii, na nkorɔfo tsetsɛɛw no.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, nyimpa bi wɔ n’enyim hɔ a ɔyar ahohon.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus bisaa mbrakyerɛfo nye Farisiifo no dɛ, Ana ɔfa mbra mu dɛ wɔsa yarba ahomgyeda anaadɛ wɔnnsa?
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔyɛɛ komm. Na ɔfaa no saa no yarba, na ɔmaa ɔkɔree.
title: LUKE

text: Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Hom mu woana, na n’asoasopɔnkɔ anaa ne nantwi kɔtɔ bura mu ahomgyeda a, ɔnnkɔtwe no ntsɛmara?
title: LUKE

text: Na woenntum emmbua no yinom ho bi bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na ohun dɛ hɔn a wɔfrɛɛ hɔn edzidzi no hwehwɛ mpanyin tsenabea no, obuu bɛ kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Sɛ obi to nsa frɛ wo ayefor ase a, mma nnkɛtsena mpanyin tsenabea; bi a ɔafrɛ obi a ɔyɛ onyimnyamfo sen wo,
title: LUKE

text: na nyia ɔfrɛɛ hom no ba a, ɔbɛse wo dɛ, Ma oyi kwan, na edze enyito bɛhyɛ ase akɛfa tsenabea a ɔnnkrɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Ntsi sɛ wɔfrɛ wo a, kɔ kɛtsena bea a ɔnnkrɔn, ama nyia ɔtoo nsa ɔfrɛɛ wo no ba a, ɔaase wo dɛ, Me gyafo, bra kan, bɛtsena ha; nna ibenya enyidzi wɔ hɔn a wɔnye wo tse edzidzii no enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Osiandɛ obiara a ɔbɛma noho do no, wɔbɛbrɛ no adze; na obiara a ɔbɛbrɛ noho adze no, wɔbɛma no do.
title: LUKE

text: Nna ɔsee nyia ɔfrɛɛ hɔn no so dɛ, Sɛ eto pon ewia anaa anadwe a, mma mmfrɛ w’anyɛnkofo, anaa wo nuanom, anaa w’ebusuafo, anaadɛ wo sɔnmufo ahonyafo: bɛyɛ na hɔn so ɔaafrɛ wo bi, ma enya akatua.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ eto pon a, frɛ ehiafo, nye epirafo, nye mpakye, nye enyifurafo:
title: LUKE

text: na ibenya nhyira, osiandɛ wonnyi dza wɔdze botua wo kaw; na atseneneefo wunyan no mu nna wobotua wo kaw.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔnye no tse edzidzii no mu baako tsee dɛm no, ɔsee no dɛ, Nhyira aka nyia obedzidzi wɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Nyimpa bi too pon kɛse, na ɔfrɛɛ nyimpa pii;
title: LUKE

text: na edzidziber durii no, ɔsomaa n’akowaa dɛ ɔnkɛse hɔn a wɔfrɛɛ hɔn no dɛ, Hom mbra, na ndzɛmba nyina ayɛ krado.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn nyina nam adwen kor do hyɛɛ ase yiyii ano. Nyia odzi kan no see dɛ, Matɔ asaase bi, na ohia dɛ mokɔhwɛ: meserɛ wo, ma me kwan.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaako so see dɛ, Matɔ anantwi mpamho enum, na morokɔsɔ hɔn ahwɛ: meserɛ wo ma me kwan.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaako so see dɛ, Mawar yer na dɛm ntsi murunntum mmba.
title: LUKE

text: Na akowaa no bae bɛkaa yinom kyerɛɛ no wura. Nna ofiwura no no bo fuwii na ɔsee n’akowaa no dɛ, Yɛ ntsɛm si kurow mu abɔntsen nye nsaaba mu, na kɛfa ehiafo nye epirafo nye enyifurafo nye mpakye bra ha.
title: LUKE

text: Na akowaa no see dɛ, Mo wura, mayɛ dɛ mbrɛ ehyɛe no, naaso ɔkwan da ho wɔ hɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Na owura no kaa kyerɛɛ n’akowaa no dɛ, Pue kɔ akwantsen nye ban mu, na kɛhyɛ hɔn ma wɔmbra, ma me dan nyɛ ma.
title: LUKE

text: Na mese hom dɛ, nkorɔfo no a wɔfrɛɛ hɔn no mu biara ronnsɔ m’edziban nnhwɛ.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyimpadodow pii nye no kɔree: na ɔdaan noho kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Sɛ obiara ba mo hɔ, na oennkyir n’egya, nye ne na, nye ne yer, nye ne mba, nye no nuanom, nye ne nkyerɛbaa, nye nankasa no ho so a, orunntum nnyɛ mo suanyi.
title: LUKE

text: Na obiara a ɔnnsoa ne mbeamudua na onndzi m’ekyir no, onnkotum ayɛ mo suanyi.
title: LUKE

text: Na hom mu woana, na ɔpɛ dɛ ɔtow abantsentsen, na onndzi kan nntsena ase, na ommbu ho nkontaa, dɛ ɔwɔ dza ɔdze botum ewie anaa?
title: LUKE

text: Bɛyɛ na oenya ato fapem no, sɛ oenntum ennwie a, hɔn a wohu nyina bɛhyɛ ase esi no atwetwe dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Nyimpa yi hyɛɛ ase dɛ orisi, naaso oenntum ennwie.
title: LUKE

text: Anaaso ɔhen bɛn na ɔrokɔ dɛ ɔnye ɔhen obi rokɔko a, onndzi kan nntsena ase na ɔmmfa apam dɛ obotum dze ɔpedu ekehyia nyia ɔdze ɔpeduonu reba no do no anaa?
title: LUKE

text: Annyɛ dɛm a, ɔbaako no da ho wɔ ekyirekyir no, otu abɔfo ma wɔkɛserɛ nsiesie.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛmara so na hom mu biara a ɔnnkɔpow dza ɔwɔ nyina no, runntum nnyɛ mo suanyi.
title: LUKE

text: Nkyen dze, oye; naaso sɛ nkyen no ayew ne dɛw a, wɔdze ebɛnadze bɛma ayɛ nkyen bio?
title: LUKE

text: Ɔmmfata asaase anaa suminado, na wɔtow gu. Nyia ɔwɔ aso a ɔdze tsie no, ma ontsie.
title: LUKE

text: Na atowgyefo nye ndzebɔnyɛfo nyina twee piinii dɛ woribetsie no.
title: LUKE

text: Na Farisiifo nye mbrakyerɛfo no so hwinhwiin dɛ, Dɛm nyimpa yi gye ndzebɔnyɛfo, na ɔnye hɔn dzidzi.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛm ntsi Jesus buu hɔn bɛ yi dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Hom mu nyimpa bɛn na sɛ ɔwɔ nguantsen ɔha, na hɔn mu kor kɛyew a, onnkegyaa eduokron akron no wɔ sar do, na ɔnnka dza ayew no do nnkodu dɛ obohu no?
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ ohu no a, ɔdze no to ne batsir do, na odzi dɛw.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ ɔba fie a, ɔfrɛfrɛ n’anyɛnkofo nye no sɔnmufo boa ano, na ɔse hɔn dɛ, Hom nye me ndzi dɛw, na mehu mo guan a ɔyewee no.
title: LUKE

text: Mese hom dɛ, Dɛmara na dɛw bɛba ɔsor wɔ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi baako a onu noho, sen atseneneefo eduokron akron a wonnhia nnuho no.
title: LUKE

text: Anaaso ɔbaa bɛn na ɔwɔ sika ndwetɛbona du na sɛ no mu kor yew a, ɔronnsɔ kandzea, na ɔmmpra dan mu, na ɔnnhwehwɛ no yie ara nnkodu dɛ obohu?
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ ohu a, ɔfrɛfrɛ n’anyɛnkofo nye no sɔnmufo boa ano se dɛ, Hom nye me ndzi dɛw, na mehu dwetɛbona a ɔyewee no.
title: LUKE

text: Mese hom dɛ, Dɛmara na dɛw ba Nyankopɔn abɔfoe enyim wɔ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi baako a onu noho no ho.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyimpa bi wɔ mbabanyin beenu:
title: LUKE

text: na hɔn mu kakraba no see n’egya dɛ, Egya, fa w’ahodze mu kyɛpɛn a ɔbɛyɛ medze no ma me. Na ɔkyɛɛ n’egyapadze mu maa hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na enndzi da biara na ɔba kakraba no boaboaa ne nyina ano, na ɔdɔɔ mu kɔr asaase bi do ekyirekyir; hɔ na ɔkɔbɔɔ asakasakabra sɛɛ n’ahodze nyina.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔhweer ne nyina wiei no, ɔkɔm kɛse bi baa asaase no do, na ɔhyɛɛ ase dzii hia.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkɔree dze noho kɔbɔɔ asaase no do nkorɔfo no mu bi ho; na ɔsomaa no ma ɔkɔr ne hamu kɛnyɛɛn mpreko.
title: LUKE

text: Na no kɔn dɔɔ dɛ ɔdze eduwahon a mpreko dzi no bi hyɛ ne yafun ma; naaso obiara amma no.
title: LUKE

text: Na n’enyi baa noho do no, ɔkaa dɛ, Apaafo ahen na m’egya wɔ a wɔwɔ edziban dzi ma ɔbor do, na emi ɔkɔm ruku me yi?
title: LUKE

text: Mobɔsoɛr, na makɔ m’egya nkyɛn, na mase no dɛ, Egya, mayɛ bɔn etsia ɔsor nye w’enyim,
title: LUKE

text: na memmfata dɛ wɔfrɛ me wo ba bio: na yɛ me dɛ w’apaafo no mu baako.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsoɛree baa n’egya nkyɛn. Na ɔda ho wɔ ekyirekyir no, n’egya hun no, na ne yamu hyehyee no, na otuu mbirika kɛbaar no kɔn, na ɔfeew n’ano.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔba no see no dɛ, Egya, mayɛ bɔn etsia ɔsor nye w’enyim, na memmfata dɛ wɔfrɛ me wo ba bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na n’egya no see no nkowaa dɛ, Hom nyɛ ntsɛm mfa atar pa mbra mbɛhyɛ no, na hom mfa mpɛtsea nhyɛ ne nsa, nye mpaboa nhyɛ ne nan;
title: LUKE

text: na hom mfa nantwiba a ɔadɔ seradze no mbra mboku no, na yendzi, na hɛn ho ntɔ hɛn,
title: LUKE

text: osiandɛ me babanyin yi owui, na oenyan bio; ɔyewee, na woehu no. Na wɔhyɛɛ ase maa hɔn enyi gyee.
title: LUKE

text: Nna ne ba panyin no wɔ hamu: na ɔreba na ɔbɛɛn fie no, ɔtsee asanku nye asaw.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ nkowaa no baako bisaa no dza ɔrokɔ do.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Wo nua aba, na w’egya eku nantwiba a ɔadɔ seradze no, osiandɛ ne nsa aka no nkwahosan mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na no bo fuwii, na ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔkɔ fie; na n’egya puei bɔtotɔe serɛɛ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔno dze, obuaa n’egya dɛ, Hwɛ, mfe pii yi na masom wo, eso mommfoom wo mbra do da; naaso emi dze, emmaa me apɔnkyeba mpo dɛ menye m’anyɛnkofo mfa nngye hɛn enyiwa da;
title: LUKE

text: na wo ba yi a ɔnye ndwaman edzi w’ahodze yi bae no dze, eku nantwiba a ɔadɔ seradze no ama no.
title: LUKE

text: Na n’egya see no dɛ, Ɔba, ɔwo wɔ me nkyɛn daa, na dza mowɔ nyina yɛ wodze.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsɛ dɛ hɛn ho tɔ hɛn, na yedzi dɛw: osiandɛ wo nua yi, owui, na ɔtse ase bio: ɔyewee, na woehu no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ esuafo no so dɛ, Ɔhonyanyi bi wɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ ofihwɛfo bi, na wɔkɔtoaa no maa no dɛ ɔresɛɛ n’adze.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ no see no dɛ, Ebɛnadze nye yi a metse no wɔ wo ho yi? Bobu wo fihwɛ adwuma ho akontaa, na innyi ho kwan dɛ idzi fihwɛfo bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na ofihwɛfo no kae wɔ no mu dɛ, Mebɛyɛ dɛn? Mo wura rebɛgye edwuma no wɔ me nsamu. Minnyi ahoɔdzen dɛ mubotutu; na ehua so yɛ me fɛr.
title: LUKE

text: Ɛhɛɛ, mehu dza mebɛyɛ, ama woyi me ofihwɛ edwuma do a, wɔaagye me akɔ hɔn efiefi mu.
title: LUKE

text: Nna ɔfrɛɛ no wura n’akafo nyina baa ne nkyɛn, na obisaa nyia odzi kan no dɛ, Edze mo wura kaw ahen?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ngo etwadze ɔha. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Fa wo nwoma na tsena ase ntsɛm kyerɛw eduonum.
title: LUKE

text: Nna obisaa baako so dɛ, Wo so edze ahen? Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewifua etwadze ɔha. Ɔsee no dɛ, Fa wo nwoma na kyerɛw eduowɔtwe.
title: LUKE

text: Na owura no kamfoo ofihwɛfo onyitseweefo no dɛ ɔayɛ no nyansa mu: iyi mpo kyerɛ dɛ wiadze yi mba nye hɔnankasa hɔn santsen dzi no nyansa mu kyɛn kan mba.
title: LUKE

text: Na mese hom dɛ, Hom mfa wiadze ahonyadze a ɔnntsen no bi do nya anyɛnkofo; na sɛ ofi hom nsa a, wɔaagye hom akɔ onnyiewiei ntamadan no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Nyia odzi nokwar wɔ adze ketseaba mu no, odzi nokwar wɔ pii mu; na nyia ɔnntsen wɔ adze ketseaba mu no, ɔnntsen wɔ pii so mu.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom enndzi nokwar wɔ wiadze ahonyadze a ɔnntsen no mu a, woana dze dza ɔyɛ tsenenee no bɛhyɛ hom nsa?
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ hom enndzi nokwar wɔ obi dze mu a, woana dze homankasa homdze bɛma hom?
title: LUKE

text: Akowaa biara nntum nnsom wuranom beenu: na obekyir kor no na ɔadɔ kor no, anaadɛ obosuo kor no mu na oebu kor no enyimtsia. Hom runntum nnsom Nyankopɔn nye wiadze ahonyadze.
title: LUKE

text: Na Farisiifo no a wɔyɛ sikapɛfo tsee yinom nyina no, wosii no atwetwe.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nye hɔn a wobu hɔnho bem wɔ nyimpa enyim, na Nyankopɔn dze onyim hom akoma mu, na dza wohuhor no wɔ nyimpa mu no yɛ ekyiwadze wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Mbra no nye nkɔnhyɛfo no bɛpeem John do; na ofitsi ɔno do no, wɔka Nyankopɔn ahenman ho no asɛmpa, na obiara dze enyiber kɔ mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔyɛ mberɛw dɛ sor nye asaase botwa mu sen dɛ mbra no ne nsensanee kor mpo befi mu.
title: LUKE

text: Obiara a obegyaa ne yer na ɔawar fofor no, ɔto awar; na obiara a ɔbɔwar nyia no kun egyaa no no, ɔto awar.
title: LUKE

text: Nna osikanyi bi wɔ hɔ a ɔhyɛ aboɔdzen ntar a ɔyɛ fɛw, na ɔtsenaa enyigye nye afɛɛfɛdze mu daa.
title: LUKE

text: Na ohianyi bi so wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Lazarus a wɔdze no bɔtoo n’abowano a oetutu ekur,
title: LUKE

text: na no kɔn dɔɔ dɛ odzi dza ofi osikanyi no no pon do gu famu mee; naaso mbɔdɔm bae bɛtafeer n’ekur mu mpo.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ohianyi no wui, na abɔfo bɔsoaa no kɔr Abraham no bo mu; na osikanyi no so wui na wosiee no.
title: LUKE

text: Na samanadze na osikanyi no maa n’enyi do, nna ɔwɔ ahoguan kɛse mu, na ohun Abraham wɔ ekyirekyir, na Lazarus twer no bo mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔtseaa mu see dɛ, Egya Abraham, hu me mbɔbɔr, na soma Lazarus ma ɔmfa ne nsatseaba ano mbɔ nsu mu, na ɔmfa mbɔdwedwe me tɛkyerɛma: na mo ho ruguan me wɔ gyaframee yi mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na Abraham see dɛ, Ɔba, kaa dɛ wo nkwaber mu inyaa wo ndzepa, dɛmara na Lazarus so nyaa ne ndzebɔn; na afei no werɛ akyekyer, na wo so ruhu amandze.
title: LUKE

text: Na yinom nyina ekyir no, ɔka kɛse da yɛnye hom ntamu, ma hɔn a wɔpɛ dɛ wofi ha tra ba hom nkyɛn nntum, na eso wonntum mmfi noho nntra mmba hɛn nkyɛn.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛm dze a, egya, meserɛ wo, soma no wɔ m’egya fie,
title: LUKE

text: na mowɔ enuanom beenum, ma ɔnkɛkyerɛ hɔn mbrɛ ndzɛmba tse amma hɔn so wɔaammba amandzehubea yi mu bi.
title: LUKE

text: Na Abraham see dɛ, Wɔwɔ Moses nye nkɔnhyɛfo no wɔ hɔ: ma wontsie hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Oho, egya Abraham, na sɛ obi fi ewufo mu kɔ hɔn nkyɛn a, nna wobonu hɔnho.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ woenntsie Moses nye nkɔnhyɛfo no a, obi fi ewufo mu soɛr mpo a, wɔrenngye no nndzi.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ n’esuafo no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ara a fintsidua bɛba: na nyia ɔnam no do bɛba no ndue!
title: LUKE

text: Oye ma no dɛ wɔdze ewuyambo sɛn no kɔn mu, na wɔdze no kɔto po mu, kyɛn dɛ ɔbɔto nkakraba yi mu baako fintsidua.
title: LUKE

text: Hom nhwɛ homho yie: sɛ wo nua fom wo a, ka n’enyim; na sɛ onu noho a, fa kyɛ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ ɔfom wo mpɛn esuon da kor, na sɛ ɔsan ba wo hɔ mpɛn esuon da kor se dɛ, Menu moho a, fa kyɛ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na asomafo no see Ewuradze dɛ, To hɛn gyedzi mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na Ewuradze see dɛ, Sɛ hom wɔ gyedzi a ɔtse dɛ sinape abafua a ne kɛse tse dɛ wusa aba a, nkyɛ hom bɛse ankye dua yi dɛ, Wo ndwow ase ntutu, na kɛtsɛw po mu, na nkyɛ obetsie hom.
title: LUKE

text: Na hom mu woana na ɔwɔ akowaa a ofuntum daadze, anaa ɔhwɛ nguantsen, na sɛ ofi hamu ba fie a, ɔbɛse no dɛ, Bra ntsɛm bɛtsena edzidzi;
title: LUKE

text: na mbom ɔrennse no dɛ, Siesie dza mibedzi na bɔ woho do bɔsom me, na mindzidzi na monnom ana, na ekyirii wo so edzidzi na anom?
title: LUKE

text: Ana ɔbɛda akowaa no ase dɛ ɔayɛ dza wɔhyɛɛ no no?
title: LUKE

text: Dɛmara na hom so sɛ hom wie dza wɔahyɛ hom nyina yɛ a, hom nse dɛ, Yɛyɛ nkowaa a mfaso nnyi hɛn ho: yɛayɛ dza ɔsɛ dɛ yɛyɛ.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔrokɔ Jerusalɛm no, okotwaa mu wɔ Samaria nye Galilii ntoaado.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔrekɛhɛn kurow bi mu no, mbarimba du a wɔyɛ akwatafo hyiaa no a wogyinagyinaa ekyir;
title: LUKE

text: na wɔmaa hɔn ndze do see dɛ, Yewura Jesus, hu hɛn mbɔbɔr.
title: LUKE

text: Na ohun hɔn no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nkɔ mfa hom ho nkɛkyerɛ asɔfo no. Na ɔbaa dɛ wɔrokɔ no, hɔn ho sanee.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn mu baako hun dɛ no ho asan no, ɔsaan n’ekyir dze ndze kɛse hyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam,
title: LUKE

text: na ɔdze n’enyim butuuw famu wɔ n’ananadze daa no ase: nna ɔno yɛ Samarianyi.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus bisaa dɛ, Ana nnyɛ du na hɔn ho sanee? Na baakron no dze wɔwɔ hen?
title: LUKE

text: Woennhu obiara a ɔsanee dze enyimnyam brɛɛ Nyankopɔn, dɛ ɔhɔho yi nko?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Soɛr kɔ: wo gyedzi agye wo.
title: LUKE

text: Na Farisiifo no bisaa no dɛ aber bɛn na Nyankopɔn ahenman no bɛba no, obuaa hɔn dɛ, Nyankopɔn ahenman no mmba dɛ enyi tuae,
title: LUKE

text: na eso wɔrennse dɛ, Hwɛ ha, anaa, Hwɛ hɔ: na hwɛ, Nyankopɔn ahenman no wɔ hom mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, Nda bi bɛba a hom bɛpɛ nyimpa Ba ne nda no mu kor ahwɛ, na hom nnkohu.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔbɛka kyerɛ hom dɛ, Hwɛ ha, anaa, Hwɛ hɔ no a, mma hom nnkɔ, eso mma hom nndzi hɔn ekyir.
title: LUKE

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ enyinam tsew nyinam fi sor hyerɛn kɔ ase beebi no, dɛmara na nyimpa Ba no bɛyɛ wɔ ne da no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na otwar dɛ obohu amandze pii, na ɔsantsen yi apow no ana.
title: LUKE

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛe wɔ Noa nda no mu no, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ wɔ nyimpa Ba no ne nda mu ara nye no.
title: LUKE

text: Na wodzidzii, wɔnomee, wɔwaree, wɔmaa awar dze kodur da a Noa kɔr hɛn adaka no mu, na nsuyirii no bae bɛsɛɛ hɔn nyina.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛmara na ɔyɛe wɔ Lot nda no mu: wodzidzii, wɔnomee, wɔtɔe, wɔtɔnee, woduae, wɔtowee;
title: LUKE

text: na da ara a Lot fiir Sodom firii no, nna ogya nye sɔɔfee fi sor tɔree bɛsɛɛ hɔn nyina;
title: LUKE

text: dɛmara so na ɔbɛyɛ wɔ da a wobeyi nyimpa Ba no edzi no.
title: LUKE

text: Da no, nyia ɔwɔ dan etsifi na n’adze wɔ dan mu no, mma onnsian mmbɛfa; na nyia ɔwɔ haban mu no so, mma ɔnnsan n’ekyir.
title: LUKE

text: Hom nkaa Lot ne yer no.
title: LUKE

text: Obiara a ɔbɔhwehwɛ dɛ ɔgye no nkwa ayɛ nedze no, ɔbɛyew no; na obiara a ɔbɛyew no nkwa no, ɔbɛgye no.
title: LUKE

text: Mese hom dɛ, Anadwe no mbarimba beenu bɛda mpa kor do, na wɔbɛfa baako na woegya baako.
title: LUKE

text: Mbaa beenu bɔbɔ mu ayam ewu, na wɔbɛfa baako na woegya baako.
title: LUKE

text: [Mbarimba beenu bɔwɔ haban mu, wɔbɛfa baako na woegya baako.]
title: LUKE

text: Na wobuaa no dɛ, Hen a, Ewuradze? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mbrɛ fun wɔ no, hɔ na mpɛtɛ bɔboaboa hɔn ano.
title: LUKE

text: Na obuu hɔn bɛ bi dze kyerɛɛ dɛ otwar dɛ nyimpa bɔ mpaa daa, na ɔnntɔ bahaw:
title: LUKE

text: Ɔtsɛmbuafo bi wɔ kurow bi mu a onnsuro Nyankopɔn, eso ɔmmfɛr nyimpa.
title: LUKE

text: Nna okunafo bi wɔ kurow no mu; na ɔdze ne nkyɛn mbae ara bɛsee dɛ, Dzi m’asɛm na gye me wɔ me tamfo nsamu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔammpen ma ɔkyɛr kakra; na n’ekyir no ɔkae wɔ no mu dɛ, Munnsuro Nyankopɔn eso memmfɛr nyimpa,
title: LUKE

text: naaso osiandɛ okunafo yi rehaw me ntsi, mibedzi n’asɛm ama no, amma ɔaammfa ne ba a ɔba daa no ammbɛtseetsee me.
title: LUKE

text: Na Ewuradze see dɛ, Hom ntsie dza ɔtsɛmbuafo a ɔnntsen yi mpo reka.
title: LUKE

text: Ana Nyankopɔn nnkedzi ama ne mpamufo a wosu frɛ no adzekyee nye adzesaa? Aso ɔbɛkyɛr hɔn asɛm ho pii ana ɔaboa hɔn?
title: LUKE

text: Mese hom dɛ, obedzi asɛm agye hɔn ntsɛm. Naaso sɛ nyimpa Ba no ba a, ana obohu gyedzi wɔ asaase do anaa?
title: LUKE

text: Na obuu binom a wɔdze hɔnho twer hɔnho dɛ wɔtsen na wommbu nkaa no bi bɛ yi dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Nyimpa beenu kɔr asɔrfi mu dɛ wɔrokɔsɔr; ɔbaako yɛ Farisiinyi, na ɔbaako so yɛ towgyenyi.
title: LUKE

text: Farisiinyi no gyinae sɔree wɔ no mu dɛ, Nyankopɔn, meda wo ase dɛ menntse dɛ mbrɛ nyimpa nkaa no tse, apempensifo, nkontompɔfo, nyefafo, anaa dɛ towgyenyi yi mpo.
title: LUKE

text: Midzi mbuada mpɛn ebien wɔ dapɛn mu; miyi dza mowɔ nyina do ebupɛndu du mema.
title: LUKE

text: Na towgyenyi no gyinaa ekyirekyir, ɔammpɛ dɛ ɔma n’enyiwa do kyerɛ sor mpo, na ɔdze ne nsa hwee koko do see dɛ, Nyankopɔn, hu emi dzebɔnyɛnyi mbɔbɔr.
title: LUKE

text: Mese hom dɛ, Oyi dze bem saan ne fie mbom, kyɛɛn ɔbaako no: na obiara a ɔbɛma noho do no, wɔbɛbrɛ no adze; na obiara a ɔbɛbrɛ noho adze no, wɔbɛma no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔdze hɔn mbɔdomaba so brɛɛ no dɛ ɔmfa ne nsa nka hɔn; na esuafo no hunii no, wotwuuw hɔn enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus frɛɛ hɔn baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom mma mbofraba no kwan ma wɔmbra me nkyɛn, na mma hom nnsiw hɔn kwan, na woyi dɛm na Nyankopɔn ahenman no yɛ hɔndze.
title: LUKE

text: Meka no nokwar mu kyerɛ hom dɛ, Obiara a ɔnnkɛgye Nyankopɔn ahenman no dɛ abofraba no, ɔnnkɔkɔ mu da.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔpanyin bi bisaa no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo pa, ebɛnadze na menyɛ ma meenya onnyiewiei nkwa ayɛ medze?
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na efrɛ me papa? Obiara nnyɛ papa gyedɛ ɔbaako: ɔno nye Nyankopɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Inyim mbransɛm no, Mma nndzi ewu, Mma nnto awar, Mma nnwia adze, Mma nngye dasewia, Dzi w’egya nye wo na nyi.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Yinom nyinara mifitsi me mbofraber mu na medzi do.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus tsee dɛm no, ɔsee no dɛ, Ɔda ho ka wo adze kor: kɔtɔn dza ewɔ nyinara, na kyɛ ma ehiafo, na ibenya akoradze wɔ sor, na bra bɛka mo do.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔtsee yi no ɔyɛɛ no awerɛhow dɛ, osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔhonyanyi mapa.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus hun no no, ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛn dzen na ɔyɛ ma hɔn a wɔwɔ ahonya dɛ wɔbɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n’ahenman mu!
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔyɛ mberɛw ma efupɔnkɔ dɛ obodua doroba enyiwa mu kyɛn dɛ ɔhonyanyi bɔkɔ Nyankopɔn n’ahenman mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔtsee no kaa dɛ, Dɛm a nna woana na wobotum agye no nkwa?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Dza nyimpa nntum nnyɛ no, ɔnnso Nyankopɔn yɛ.
title: LUKE

text: Na Peter see dɛ, Hwɛ, yeegyaa hɛn ndzɛmba nyina na yɛabɛka wo do.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Obi nnyi hɔ a oegyaa fie anaa yer anaa enuanom anaa awofo anaa mba wɔ Nyankopɔn n’ahenman ntsi,
title: LUKE

text: na onnkenya ho mbɔho pii wɔ ber yi mu, na wiadze a ɔreba no mu onnyiewiei nkwa.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔfaa duebien no na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hwɛ, yɛrokɔ Jerusalɛm, na ndzɛmba a nkɔnhyɛfo no akyerɛw no nyimpa Ba no ho nyina bɛba mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na wobeyi no ama amanamamfo, na wobesi no atwetwe, na wɔabɔ no adapaa, na wɔatoto ntafi egu no do;
title: LUKE

text: na wɔaka no mpire, na woeku no; na da a otsia ebiasa no ɔbɔsoɛr bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn dze wɔanntse iyinom mu biara ase, na asɛm yi sumaa hɔn, na woennhu dza ɔreka no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔbɛɛn Jeriko no, onyifurafo bi tse kwan nkyɛn reserɛserɛ adze;
title: LUKE

text: na ɔtsee dɛ nyimpadodow rutwa mu no, obisaa dɛ ebɛn asɛm rokɔ do?
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ Jesus Nazarɛtnyi no na ɔresen.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkaa mu see dɛ, Jesus, David ba, hu me mbɔbɔr!
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wodzi kan no braa no dɛ ɔnka n’ano nto mu; na ɔnodze, mbom ɔtseaa mu dzendzen dɛ, David ba, hu me mbɔbɔr.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus gyinae, na ɔkaa dɛ wɔmfa no mbra ne nkyɛn; na ɔbɛnee no, obisaa no dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Ebɛnadze na epɛ dɛ meyɛ mema wo? Na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, nkyɛ meehu adze.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Hu adze: wo gyedzi agye wo.
title: LUKE

text: Na amonmu hɔ ara ohun adze, na ɔkaa no do, dze enyimnyam maa Nyankopɔn; na nkorɔfo no nyina hunii no, wɔdze ayɛyi maa Nyankopɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkɛhɛɛn Jeriko dɛ orutwa mu wɔ hɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Zakeɔs a ɔyɛ towgyenyi panyin, na ɔyɛ ɔhonyanyi.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔpɛɛ dɛ ohu Jesus ne nyimpa ban; naaso nyimpadodow no ntsi nna onntum, osiandɛ ɔyɛ akɔtsia.
title: LUKE

text: Na otutuu mbirika dzii kan kɔfoow ankye dua dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ no, osiandɛ hɔ na ɔrebɛfa.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus dur hɔ no, ɔhwɛɛ sor, na ɔsee no dɛ, Zakeɔs, yɛ ntsɛm si famu, na ndɛ ɔsɛ dɛ metsena wo fie.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔyɛɛ ntsɛm sii famu, na ɔdze dɛw bɛgyee no.
title: LUKE

text: Na dɔm no hunii no, hɔn nyina hwinhwiin dɛ, Ɔakɔ akɔsoɛ nyimpa a ɔyɛ dzebɔnyɛnyi.
title: LUKE

text: Na Zakeɔs gyinae, na ɔkaa kyerɛɛ Ewuradze dɛ, Ao Ewuradze, medze m’ahodze fa mekyɛ ehiafo; na sɛ menam ndabraba do magye obi ne biribi a, mobɔ ho mpɛn anan mutua kaw.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Nokwasɛm nye yi, ndɛ na nkwagye aba fie yi mu, osiandɛ no so yɛ Abraham ba bi no.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyimpa Ba no baa dɛ ɔrobɔhwehwɛ na ɔabɛgye dza ɔayew no.
title: LUKE

text: Na woritsie no no, ɔtoaa do buu bɛ yi, osiandɛ nna ɔabɛn Jerusalɛm na dɔm no susuu dɛ amonmu hɔ ara na Nyankopɔn n’ahenman no ribeyi noho edzi.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔsee dɛ, Ɔdehye bi kɔr asaase bi do ekyirekyir dɛ ɔrekɛgye ahendzi, na ɔasan aba.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ no nkowaa du, na ɔdze mpireguan du maa hɔn, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa ndzi gua nkodu dɛ mebɛba.
title: LUKE

text: Na ne mamfoo no kyiir no, na wotuu abɔfo kaa no do kɛsee dɛ, Yɛmmpɛ dɛ oyi dzi hɛn do hen.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ne nsa kaa ahendzi no na ɔsanee bae no, ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfrɛ nkowaa a ɔdze sika no maa hɔn no mbrɛ no, na onhu dza woedzi gua enyinya.
title: LUKE

text: Na dza odzi kan no bae bɛsee dɛ, Mo wura, wo pireguan no enya mpireguan du aka ho.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mbo, akowaa pa: osiandɛ edzi ketseaba yi mu nokwar ntsi, dzi nkurow du do tum.
title: LUKE

text: Na dza otsia ebien no bae bɛsee dɛ, Mo wura, wo pireguan no enya mpireguan enum aka ho.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee no so dɛ, Wo so dzi nkurow enum do.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaako no bae bɛsee dɛ, Mo wura, hwɛ, wo pireguan a medze hyɛɛ duukuu mu siei no nye yi:
title: LUKE

text: na musuroo wo, osiandɛ eyɛ nyimpa a eyɛ dzen: efa dza emmfae nntoo hɔ, na itwa dza innduae.
title: LUKE

text: Ɔsee no dɛ, Wankasa w’anomu asɛm na menam do bobu wo atsɛn, akowaa bɔn. Inyim dɛ meyɛ nyimpa a meyɛ dzen a mefa dza memmfae nntoo hɔ na mutwa dza munnduae:
title: LUKE

text: na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na ammfa me sika annkɔto sikasesafo adaka mu, na meba a maabɛgye m’adze nye no ho nsiho?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn a wogyina hɔ no dɛ, Hom ngye ne nsamu pireguan no, na hom mfa mma nyia ɔwɔ du no.
title: LUKE

text: (Na wɔsee no dɛ, Owura, ɔwɔ mpireguan du.)
title: LUKE

text: Mese hom dɛ, obiara a ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no; na nyia onnyi no, dza ɔwɔ no mpo wɔbɛgye ne nsamu.
title: LUKE

text: Na m’atamfo a wɔammpɛ dɛ midzi hɔn do hen no, hom mfa hɔn mbra ha, na hom mboku hɔn wɔ m’enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Na owiee dɛm ka no, osii mu dzii kan dɛ ɔrokɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbɛɛn Bɛtfage nye Bɛtani wɔ bepɔw a wɔfrɛ no Ngo Bepɔw ho no, ɔsomaa n’esuafo beenu
title: LUKE

text: dɛ, Hom nkɔ ekuroba a ɔda hom enyim no mu, na hom du mu a, hom bohu asoasopɔnkɔba a wɔamontan no a nyimpa bi nntsenaa do da: hom nsan no mfa no mbra.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ obi bisa hom dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom resan no a, hom nse no dɛ, Ewuradze wɔ no ho hia.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔsomaa hɔn no kɔree kohun dɛ mbrɛ ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no ara.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔresan asoasopɔnkɔba no, no wuranom see hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na hom resan asoasopɔnkɔba no?
title: LUKE

text: Na wobuaa dɛ, Ewuradze wɔ no ho hia.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔdze asoasopɔnkɔba no brɛɛ Jesus, na wɔtoow hɔn ntar guu no do, na wɔdze Jesus tsenaa do.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔrokɔ no, wɔdze hɔn ntar sesɛɛw kwan mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔrebɛn mbrɛ woribesian Ngo Bepɔw no, n’esuafo kuw no nyina hyɛɛ ase dzii dɛw, na wɔdze ndze kɛse yii Nyankopɔn ayɛw wɔ tum ndwuma a woehu nyina ntsi,
title: LUKE

text: dɛ, Nhyira nye Ɔhen a ɔnam Ewuradze dzin mu reba no! Asomdwee wɔ sor, na enyimnyam wɔ sorsor no ho!
title: LUKE

text: Na Farisiifo no binom a wɔwɔ nyimpadodow no mu no see no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, twuw w’esuafo yi enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Na obuae see dɛ, Mese hom dɛ, sɛ woyinom mua hɔn ano mpo a, nkyɛ abo bɛtsea mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbɛnee no, ɔhwɛɛ kurow no sui wɔ do,
title: LUKE

text: dɛ, Sɛ ɔwo, ɔwoara so mpo, sɛ ndɛ inyim ndzɛmba a ɔfa asomdwee ho a nkyɛ oye! Naaso afei wɔdze esuma efi w’enyi do.
title: LUKE

text: Na nda bi bɛba wo do a w’atamfo bɔto pempe abɔ wo ho aprɔw, na wɔabɔ wo ho kɔntɔnkrɔn, na wɔaka wo ahyɛ mu wɔ mbea nyina,
title: LUKE

text: na woedwuruw wo egu famu, ɔnye wo mba a wɔwɔ wo mu, na worinngyaa wo mu ɔbo a ɔda bo do; osiandɛ ennhu wo ber a adom ntsi wɔbɔhwɛɛ wo no.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus kɔr asɔrfi no mu no, ɔhyɛɛ ase paam hɔn a wɔtɔn,
title: LUKE

text: see hɔn dɛ, Wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Me fie bɛyɛ asɔryɛbea, na hom dze, hom ayɛ no edwotwafo tu.
title: LUKE

text: Nna ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ daa wɔ asɔrfi no mu. Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo nye ɔman mu etsitsir hwehwɛɛ dɛ woboku no,
title: LUKE

text: naaso woennhu mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ; osiandɛ ɔman no nyina dze hɔnho takyeer no ho tsiee no.
title: LUKE

text: Na nda no mu kor a ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ nkorɔfo no wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na ɔreka asɛmpa no, asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo nye mpanyimfo no baa no do,
title: LUKE

text: na wɔbɛkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Ka tum kor a edze yɛ ndzɛmba yi, anaadɛ nyia ɔmaa wo tum yi, kyerɛ hɛn.
title: LUKE

text: Na obuae see hɔn dɛ, Mo so mibebisa hom asɛm, na hom nka nkyerɛ me;
title: LUKE

text: John enuma no, ofir sor anaa ofir nyimpa?
title: LUKE

text: Na wosusuu hɔn mu dɛ, Sɛ yɛka dɛ, Ofi sor a, ɔbɛse dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom anngye no enndzi?
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ yɛka dɛ, Ofi nyimpa a, nkorɔfo no nyina besiw hɛn abo, osiandɛ wɔgye dzi ampa dɛ John yɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi.
title: LUKE

text: Na wobuaa dɛ wonnyim mbrɛ ofi.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Mo so mennkɛkyerɛ hom tum kor a medze yɛ iyinom.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ ase buu nkorɔfo no bɛ dɛ, Nyimpa bi yɛɛ wenyin ture, na ɔdze fɛɛm ekuafo bi, na ɔdɔɔ mu kɔr beebi kɛkyɛree.
title: LUKE

text: Na ber durii no, ɔsomaa akowaa bi wɔ ekuafo no hɔ dɛ wɔmfa wenyin ture eduaba no bi mma no: na ekuafo no hwee no, na wɔmaa ɔdze nsapan kɔree.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔtoaa do somaa akowaa fofor so; ɔno so wɔhwee no, na woguu n’enyim ase, na wɔmaa ɔdze nsapan kɔree.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔtoaa do somaa dza otsia ebiasa; na ɔno so wopiraa no na wɔtoow no fii hɔ kyenee.
title: LUKE

text: Na wenyin ture no wura no see dɛ, Mebɛyɛ dɛn? Mobɔsoma mo dɔba: annyɛ a ɔnodze wɔbɛfɛr no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ekuafo no hun no no, wosusuu hɔn mu dɛ, Nyia odzi adze no nye yi: hom mma yenku no, ama egyapadze no aayɛ hɛndze.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔtoow no fii wenyin ture no mu kyenee, na wokum no. Dɛm ntsi ebɛnadze na wenyin ture no wura bɛyɛ hɔn?
title: LUKE

text: Ɔbɛba abɛsɛɛ ekuafo yi, na ɔdze wenyin ture no ama afofor. Na wɔtsee no, wɔsee dɛ, Nyame mmpa ngu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔhwɛɛ hɔn see hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze nye yi a wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Ɔbo a adantofo powee no, Ɔnoara na ɔabɛyɛ kutuwdo bo?
title: LUKE

text: Obiara a ɔbɔhwe ɔbo yi do no bobubu, na obiara a ɔbo no bɔhwe no do no, ɔbɔdwow no dɛ isiam.
title: LUKE

text: Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no hwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔdze nsa suo no mu kyer no dɔn no ara mu, na wosuroo nkorɔfo no; osiandɛ wohun dɛ bɛ yi a obui no tsia hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔweɔɔn no na wɔsomaa aserafo bi a wopetuuw dɛ wɔyɛ atseneneefo, dɛ wonkosuo no mu wɔ ne kasaa mu, ama woeeyi no ahyɛ ambrado ne mbra nye no tum nsa.
title: LUKE

text: Na wobisaa no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, yenyim dɛ eka na ekyerɛkyerɛ yie, eso emmfɛr obi enyim, na ekyerɛkyerɛ Nyankopɔn kwan no wɔ nokwar mu:
title: LUKE

text: aso ɔfa mbra mu dɛ yɛma Kaesar ntoboa anaa?
title: LUKE

text: Na ohun hɔn adwembɔn no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Hom mfa sika denare mbɛkyerɛ me. Woana no mfonyi nye nkyerɛwee na ɔwɔ do yi? Na wɔsee dɛ, Kaesar dze a.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔno dze, hom ndan dza ɔyɛ Kaesar dze mma Kaesar, na dza ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn dze mma Nyankopɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na woenntum ennsuo ne nsɛm mu wɔ nkorɔfo no enyim; na no mbuae no yɛɛ hɔn nwanwa na womuaa hɔn ano.
title: LUKE

text: Na Sadusiifo no a wɔgye kyim dɛ wunyan nnyi hɔ no mu bi baa ne nkyɛn bebisaa no dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Kyerɛkyerɛfo, Moses kyerɛwee maa hɛn dɛ, Sɛ obi no nua wu, na ɔwɔ yer, na ɔannwo mba a, no nua no nwar ne yer no na ɔnwo mba mma no nua owufo no.
title: LUKE

text: Nna enuanom beesuon wɔ hɔ; nyia odzi kan no waaree, na oennya ba, na owui;
title: LUKE

text: na nyia otsia ebien no,
title: LUKE

text: na nyia otsia ebiasa no so waar no, na dɛmara so hɔn beesuon nyina enngyaa mba, na wowuwui.
title: LUKE

text: Na ekyir no, ɔbaa no so wui.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛm ntsi wunyan no mu no, ɔbaa no bɛyɛ hɔn mu woana ne yer? Osiandɛ beesuon no nyina awar no.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, wiadze yi mu mba war, na wɔdze hɔn ma awar:
title: LUKE

text: na hɔn a wobobu hɔn dɛ wɔfata dɛ hɔn nsa bɛka wiadze a ɔreba no, nye nyan a wonyan fi ewufo mu no dze, wɔnnwar, eso wɔmma awar;
title: LUKE

text: na eso wonntum nnwu bio, na wɔnye abɔfo no sɛ, na wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn mba, dɛ wɔyɛ owunyan mba ntsi.
title: LUKE

text: Na dɛ ewufo nyan dze, Moses so kyerɛe wɔ Haban no mu dɛ, ɔfrɛɛ Ewuradze dɛ, Abraham Nyankopɔn, Isaak Nyankopɔn nye Jakob Nyankopɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔnnyɛ ewufo Nyankopɔn, na enyikamfo Nyankopɔn a: osiandɛ hɔn nyina tse ase ma no.
title: LUKE

text: Na kyerɛwfo no bi buaa dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo, aka no yie.
title: LUKE

text: Na iyi ekyir, woennsi hɔn bo dɛ wobebisa no asɛm bi bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na wɔka dɛ Kraest no yɛ David ba?
title: LUKE

text: Na David noara ka wɔ Ndwom Nwoma no mu dɛ, Ewuradze see m’Ewuradze dɛ, Tsena m’abanyimfa,
title: LUKE

text: Kodu dɛ medze w’atamfo mebɛyɛ w’ananadzegua.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ David frɛ no Ewuradze a, na ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔyɛ ne ba?
title: LUKE

text: Na nkorɔfo no nyina tsee no, ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ kyerɛwfo a wɔpɛ ntar atsentsen mu nantsew, nye gua do nkyiakyia, ɔnye mpanyin gua wɔ nhyiamudan mu, nye mpanyin tsenabea wɔ edzidzi ase ho:
title: LUKE

text: hɔn na wɔbɔ ekunafo epoo, na wopetuw bɔ mpaa atsentsen kyerɛ. Mese, yinom benya afɔbu kɛsenara.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔmaa n’enyi do hun ahonyafo a wɔrotow hɔn ayɛyɛdze gu sikakorabea no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ohun kunafo hianyi bi so a ɔbɔtoow mpɛsewamba ebien guu mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Nokwar mese hom dɛ okunafo hianyi yi dze pii ebogu mu akyɛn hɔn nyina.
title: LUKE

text: Na yinom nyina dza wɔwɔ ma abor hɔn do na wɔdze bi ebogu ayɛyɛdze no mu, na oyi dze, ofi ne hia mu dze n’asetsena a ɔwɔ nyina ebogu mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na binom reka asɔrfi no ho asɛm, mbrɛ woesi dze abo fɛɛfɛw nye adzekyɛdze ahyehyɛ mu no, ɔsee dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Ndzɛmba yi a hom hu yi, nda bɛba a wonnkegya ɔbo kor a ɔda kor do wɔ mu a wonnkodwuruw egu famu.
title: LUKE

text: Na wobisaa no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛnyi, dabɛn na yinom bɛyɛ hɔ, na yinom rebɛba mu a, n’asɛnkyerɛdze nye dɛn?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nhwɛ yie amma wɔaanndaadaa hom: na dodowara bɛba wɔ me dzin mu dɛ, Emi nye no, na, Aber no abɛn: mma hom nndzi hɔn ekyir.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ hom tse ɔko nye basabasayɛ nka a, mma ɔnnyɛ hom hu; na otwar dɛ yinom dzi kan ba, naaso ewiei no dze, nna onndurii.
title: LUKE

text: Nna ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔman bɔsoɛr ɔman do, na ahenman asoɛr ahenman do,
title: LUKE

text: na asaasewosow kɛse bɛba, na ɔkɔm nye ɔyardɔm bɛba mbeambea, na dza ɔyɛ hu nye nsɛnkyerɛdze akɛse befi sor aba.
title: LUKE

text: Na dza odzi yinom nyina kan nye dɛ wɔdze nsa bosuo hom mu, na wɔahaw hom, dze eyi hom akɔ nhyiamudan mu nye efiadze, na wɔdze hom aba ahemfo nye ambradofo enyim wɔ me dzin ntsi.
title: LUKE

text: Iyi bɛma hom enya kwan edzi mo ho dase.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mfa nto hom tsirmu mu dɛ hom nnkedzi kan adwendwen dza hom dze beyi hom ano ho:
title: LUKE

text: osiandɛ emi na mebɛma hom ano nye nyansa a hom atamfo nyina runntum nngyina enyim, eso worunntua ano.
title: LUKE

text: Na awofo, nye nuanom, nye ebusuafo, nye anyɛnkofo beyi hom ama, na wɔama woeeku hom mu binom,
title: LUKE

text: na nyimpa nyina bɛtan hom wɔ me dzin ntsi.
title: LUKE

text: Naaso hom tsinhwi kor mpo nnkɛyew.
title: LUKE

text: Hom abotar mu na hom bɛgye hom akra.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ hom hu Jerusalɛm dɛ dɔm etwa ho ehyia a, nna hom nhu dɛ ne nsɛɛe abɛn.
title: LUKE

text: Ɔno na hɔn a wɔwɔ Judea nguan nkɔ nkokwaa do, na wɔmma hɔn a wɔwɔ mu no mfi mu nkɔ, na mma hɔn a wɔwɔ haban mu no nnkɔ mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na iyi nye awerdzi nda, ma dza wɔakyerɛw nyina aaba mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔafa yafun, nye hɔn a wɔma enumfo wɔ nda no mu ndue! Osiandɛ atseetsee kɛse bɛba asaase no do, na ebufuw bɛba ɔman no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔbɔtotɔ nkrantsee anomu, na wɔafa hɔn ndɔmmum akɔ aman nyina do, na amanamamfo betsiatsia Jerusalɛm do ekodu dɛ amanaman aber no bɔso.
title: LUKE

text: Na nsɛnkyerɛdze bɛba ewia nye bosoom nye nworaba mu, na asaase do amanaman ho bɛhyehye hɔn kɛse, ɔnam po gyigyeegye nye asorɛkye a oruhur ntsi;
title: LUKE

text: nyimpa bɔtɔ akɔtɔmborɔnsa wɔ hu nye ndzɛmba a hɔn enyi tua dɛ ɔreba wiadze do ntsi, na ɔsor etum bɔwosow.
title: LUKE

text: Ɔno na wobohu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔreba wɔ nsuwusiw do, wɔ ahoɔdzen nye enyimnyam kɛse mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ ndzɛmba yi hyɛ ase reba a, ɔno na hom nhwɛ sor, na hom mma hom tsir do, osiandɛ hom ber a wɔdze bɔpon hom no edu.
title: LUKE

text: Na obuu hɔn bɛ dɛ, Hom nhwɛ adɔmbadua nye ndua nyina:
title: LUKE

text: sɛ wɔfefɛw na hom hwɛ a, nna homankasa hom nyim dɛ ɔhyewber abɛn.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛmara na hom so, sɛ hom hu dɛ iyinom rokɔ do a, hom nhu dɛ Nyankopɔn ahendzi no abɛn.
title: LUKE

text: Nokwar mese hom dɛ, Mbasantsen yi runntwa mu nnkɔ gyedɛ ne nyina ayɛ hɔ ansaana.
title: LUKE

text: Ɔsor nye asaase botwa mu akɔ; naaso me nsɛm dze, wonnkotwa mu akɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Na hom nhwɛ homho yie, mma etumfursɛm nye asabow nye ɔbra yi ho dadwen aannhyɛ hom akoma do, mma nda no eemmbefir hom awora dɛ mbrɛ efir huan awerɛfir mu:
title: LUKE

text: na da no bɛba hɔn a wɔtse asaase do no nyina do.
title: LUKE

text: Mbom hom nweɔn daa, na hom nsɔr ama hom eenya tum dɛ hom dze befi ndzɛmba yi a ɔbɛba yi nyina nsa, na hom etum egyina nyimpa Ba no enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Na adzekyee biara nna ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔrfi mu, na anadwe biara nna oepue akɛtsena bepɔw a wɔfrɛ no Ngo Bepɔw do.
title: LUKE

text: Na nkorɔfo no nyina baa ne nkyɛn anapaatu wɔ asɔrfi mu, dɛ woribetsie no.
title: LUKE

text: Na epitsi afahyɛ no a wɔfrɛ no Apaho no bɛnee.
title: LUKE

text: Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no hwehwɛɛ mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ eku Jesus, naaso nna wosuro nkorɔfo no.
title: LUKE

text: Na Satan kɛhɛɛn Judas a wɔfrɛ no Iskariot a ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako no mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkɔree nye asɔfompanyin nye asafohen no kɛhyehyɛɛ mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ eyi no ama hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn dɛw, na wɔnye no hyehyɛɛ dɛ wɔbɛma no sika.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbɔɔ hɔn anohoba, na ɔhwehwɛɛ mbrɛ obenya kwan edua nyimpadodow no ekyir eyi no ama hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na epitsi da a ɔsɛ dɛ woku apahoguan no durii.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsomaa Peter nye John dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkesiesie apaho no mma hɛn ma yembedzi.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Hen na epɛ dɛ yekesiesie?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom du kurow no mu a, nyimpa bi a ɔso esuhina behyia hom: hom nka no do nkɔ fie a ɔbɔkɔ mu no mu,
title: LUKE

text: na hom nse fiewura no dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛnyi no se, Ahɔhodan a menye m’esuafo bedzi mu apaho no wɔ hen?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbɛkyerɛ hom sor dan kɛse bi a wɔahyehyɛ mu: hɔ na hom nsiesie.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔkɔree kohun dɛ mbrɛ ɔsee hɔn no, na wosiesiee apaho no.
title: LUKE

text: Na dɔn no durii no, ɔbɛtsenaa ase, na asomafo duebien no ka no ho.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mo kɔn adɔ akyɛr dɛ menye hom dzi apaho yi ansaana mehu amandze:
title: LUKE

text: na mese hom dɛ, Mirinndzi bi bio gyedɛ ber a ɔaba mu wɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman mu no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔfaa kɔɔpow na ɔdaa ase no, ɔsee dɛ, Hom ngye yi nkyɛ mma homho:
title: LUKE

text: na mese hom dɛ, Moronnom wenyinaba no bi bio dze ekodu dɛ Nyankopɔn ahendzi bɛba.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔfaa paanoo na ɔdaa ase no, obubui, na ɔdze maa hɔn dɛ, Iyi nye me nyimpadua a wɔdze rema wɔ hom ntsi: hom nyɛ yi mfa nyɛ me nkaa.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛmara so na wowiee edzidzi no, ɔfaa kɔɔpow no see dɛ, Kɔɔpow yi nye ahyɛmu fofor no wɔ mo bɔgyaa mu, ɔno na hom ntsi woruhue egu.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, nyia oriyi me ama no ne nsa nye me wɔ pon no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na nokwar, nyimpa Ba no rokɔ dɛ mbrɛ wɔahyɛ no dze, naaso nyimpa a wɔnam no do ribeyi no ama no ndue!
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔhyɛɛ ase bisabisaa hɔn mu dɛ woana na ɔrebɛyɛ dɛm adze yi?
title: LUKE

text: Na noko bi so baa hɔn mu dɛ hɔn mu woana na wobobu no kɛse.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Amanaman ahemfo dzi hɔn do wura, na hɔn a wodzi hɔn do tum no, wɔfrɛ hɔn Ayamuyiefo.
title: LUKE

text: Na hom dze, mma hom nnyɛ dɛm: na mbom nyia ɔyɛ hom mu kɛse, wɔmma ɔnyɛ dɛ ekumaba, na nyia ɔyɛ otsitsir no, ɔnyɛ dɛ nyia ɔsom.
title: LUKE

text: Na woana na ɔyɛ kɛse, nyia ɔtse edziban ho anaa nyia ɔsom a? Nnyɛ nyia ɔtse edziban ho anaa? Na emi dze, mowɔ hom mu dɛ nyia ɔsom.
title: LUKE

text: Na hom nye hɔn a hom da ho ka mo ho wɔ mo nsɔhwɛ mu;
title: LUKE

text: na mo so mehyɛ ahendzi ma hom, dɛ mbrɛ m’Egya ahyɛ ama me no,
title: LUKE

text: ama hom eedzidzi na hom aanom wɔ mo pon do wɔ m’ahenman mu; na hom bɛtsena nhengua do ebu Israel ebusuakuw duebien no atsɛn.
title: LUKE

text: Simon, Simon, hwɛ, Satan ebisa dɛ obenya hom na ɔapo hom do dɛ eburow;
title: LUKE

text: na maserɛ ama wo, amma wo gyedzi aammpa, na sɛ daakye esan gyina a, hyɛ wo nuanom dzen.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, mayɛ krado dɛ menye wo bɔkɔ efiadze nye wu nyina mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Peter, Meka kyerɛ wo dɛ akokɔ rommbɔn ndɛ ansaana asan mprɛnsa dɛ innyim me.
title: LUKE

text: Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Mosomaa hom a hom nndze sika kotoku nye bɔtɔ nye mpaboa no, biribi hiaa hom anaa? Na wɔsee dɛ, Ennhia hɛn hwee.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Afei dze, nyia ɔwɔ sika kotoku, ma ɔmfa, na bɔtɔ so dɛmara, na nyia onnyi bi no, ma ɔntɔn no sortar ntɔ afona.
title: LUKE

text: Na mese hom dɛ iyi a wɔakyerɛw no otwar dɛ ɔba mu wɔ mo ho dɛ, Wɔkaan no foraa mbratofo, na dza ɔfa mo ho no rebɛba mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, hwɛ, mfona ebien nye yi. Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔnoara ye.
title: LUKE

text: Na opuei, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔtɔ dɛ ɔyɛ no, ɔkɔr Ngo Bepɔw do, na n’esuafo no so kaa no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na odur hɔ no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nsɔr ama hom aannkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔtwee noho fii hɔn nkyɛn bɛyɛ dɛ ɔbotowee na ɔkɔkotoow ne ntwɛr enyim sɔɔr dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Egya, sɛ epɛ a, yi kɔɔpow yi pa mo ho; naaso nnyɛ emi me pɛ a, na wodze na ɔnyɛ hɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbɔfo bi fi sor beyii noho kyerɛɛ no hyɛɛ no dzen.
title: LUKE

text: Na owuyaw mu no, ɔbɔɔ mpaa enyiberdo, na ne fifir yɛɛ dɛ bɔgya atɔwatɔw a ɔsosɔ famu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsoɛree fii n’asɔryɛ mu no, ɔbaa n’esuafo no nkyɛn na obohun hɔn dɛ awerɛhow ntsi wɔadeda.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom ada yi? Hom nsoɛr nsɔr mma hom aannkɔ nsɔhwɛ mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔda do rekasa no, hwɛ, nyimpadodow nye nyia wɔfrɛ no Judas a ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako dzi hɔn enyim na ɔtwee bɛɛn Jesus dɛ ɔrebɛfew n’ano.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Judas, edze mfewano riyi nyimpa Ba no ama anaa?
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn no hun dza ɔreba no, wɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze, yɛmfa afona mbobɔ hɔn anaa?
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn mu baako bɔɔ ɔsɔfopanyin n’akowaa, na otwaa n’asowa nyimfa.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus buae see dɛ, Hom mma ɔmpa ha ara; na ɔdze ne nsa kaa asowa no famee.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see asɔfompanyin nye asɔrfi mu asafohen, nye mpanyimfo a wɔbaa no do no dɛ, Ana hom puei baa mo do dɛ owifo do, na hom dze mfona nye mpɔtsibaa yi?
title: LUKE

text: Mowɔ hom nkyɛn wɔ asɔrfi mu hɔ daa no, hom anntsen hom nsa annka me: na iyi nye hom ber, na sum mu tum.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔfaa no kɔree, na wɔdze no baa ɔsɔfopanyin no fie. Na Peter dzii n’ekyir wɔ ekyirekyir.
title: LUKE

text: Na wokuaa gya wɔ abangua no finimfin na wɔtsenaa ho no, Peter bɛtsenaa hɔn mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔtse gya no ho no, abaawa bi hun no, na ɔhwɛɛ no komm, na ɔsee dɛ, Oyi so nye no nam.
title: LUKE

text: Na Peter saan dɛ, Ɔbaa, minnyim no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔkyɛɛr kakra no obi so hun no, na ɔsee dɛ, Wo so fi hɔn mu. Na Peter see dɛ, Onua, mimmfi mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na n’ekyir bɛyɛ dɔnhwer kor na obi so kaa gyinaa do dɛ, Ɔyɛ ampa, oyi so nye no nam: na ɔyɛ Galiliinyi.
title: LUKE

text: Na Peter see dɛ, Onua, minnyim dza ereka yi. Na amonmu hɔ ara a ɔda do rekasa no, na akokɔ bɔnee.
title: LUKE

text: Na Ewuradze daan noho hwɛɛ Peter. Na Peter kaa asɛm a Ewuradze kae no, mbrɛ ɔsee no dɛ, Ansaana akokɔ bɔbɔn ndɛ, ebɛpa me mprɛnsa.
title: LUKE

text: Na opuei, na okosuu yayaayaw.
title: LUKE

text: Na mbanyin a wɔdze Jesus mu no, sii no atwetwe bobɔɔ no.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔkataa n’enyiwa, na wobisaa no dɛ, Hyɛ nkɔm! Woana na ɔbɔɔ wo?
title: LUKE

text: Na ebususɛm pii keka ho a wɔkae tsiaa no.
title: LUKE

text: Na adze kyee no, ɔman mpanyimfo nye asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no behyiae, na wɔdze no kɔr hɔn asɛndzii, dɛ,
title: LUKE

text: Sɛ ɔwo nye Kraest no a, ka kyerɛ hɛn. Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Sɛ meka kyerɛ hom a, hom renngye nndzi;
title: LUKE

text: na mo so mibisa hom a, hom rummbua bi.
title: LUKE

text: Na daakye nyimpa Ba no bɛtsena Nyankopɔn n’ahoɔdzen nyimfa.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn nyina see dɛ, Nna kyerɛ dɛ, ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn Ba no a? Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom na hom ka dɛ emi nye no.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Ebɛn dase na ohia ma hɛn bio? Osiandɛ hɛnankasa yɛatse wɔ n’anomu.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyimpadodow no nyina soɛree, na wɔdze no kɔr Pilate nkyɛn.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔhyɛɛ ase toatoaa no dɛ, Yeehu oyi dɛ ɔresɛɛ hɛn man yi na ɔbra dɛ mma wɔmma Kaesar ntoboa, na ɔka dɛ nankasa nye Kraest, ɔhen no.
title: LUKE

text: Na Pilate bisaa no dɛ, Ana Jewfo Hen nye wo? Na obuaa no dɛ, Aka.
title: LUKE

text: Pilate see asɔfompanyin nye nyimpadodow no dɛ, Munnhu afɔdzi biara wɔ nyimpa yi ho.
title: LUKE

text: Na mbom wogyinaa do dzendzen dɛ, Ohuenyan ɔman no, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ Judea man nyina mu, ɔhyɛɛ ase wɔ Galilii na ɔdze ebodu ha yi.
title: LUKE

text: Na Pilate tsee no, obisaa dɛ nyimpa yi Galiliinyi anaa?
title: LUKE

text: Na ohun dɛ ofi Herod ase no, ɔsomaa no wɔ Herod nkyɛn, na aber no mu nna Herod nankasa so wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: LUKE

text: Na Herod hun Jesus no, ɔyɛɛ no dɛw pii: na ɔpɛɛ dɛ obohu no akyɛr, osiandɛ ɔatse no ho asɛm, na n’enyi daa kwan dɛ obohu asɛnkyerɛdze bi a ɔbɛyɛ.
title: LUKE

text: Na obisabisaa no nsɛm pii, naaso ɔnodze, oemmbua no hwee.
title: LUKE

text: Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no gyinae toatoaa no dzendzenndzen ara.
title: LUKE

text: Na Herod nye no nsordaafo no bɔɔ no adapaa, na wosii no atwetwe, na wɔhyɛɛ no efuradze dɛhyɛdɛhyɛ bi dze no kɛmaa Pilate bio.
title: LUKE

text: Na da no ara na Pilate nye Herod yɛɛ nyɛnko: na nkan no dze nna wɔrotwe manso wɔ hɔn ntamu.
title: LUKE

text: Na Pilate frɛɛ asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo nye ɔman no boaa ano no,
title: LUKE

text: ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom dze nyimpa yi brɛɛ me dɛ nyia ɔresɛɛ ɔman no, na hwɛ, mahwehwɛ no mu wɔ hom enyim, naaso mennhu ndzɛmba a hom dze toatoa no yi ho afɔdzi biara wɔ nyimpa yi mu;
title: LUKE

text: oho, nnyɛ Herod so a: na ɔsomaa no sanee brɛɛ hɛn; na hwɛ, ɔnnyɛɛ okumadze biara.
title: LUKE

text: Dɛm ntsi mobɔhwe no, na megyaa no.
title: LUKE

text: [Nna otwar dɛ ogyaa kor ma hɔn afahyɛ no mu.]
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn nyina tseaa mu prɛko dɛ, Fa oyi kɔ, na gyaa Barabbas ma hɛn:
title: LUKE

text: (ɔno na osian sakasaka a wɔyɛɛ no kurow mu hɔ nye ewudzi ntsi wɔdze no too efiadze.)
title: LUKE

text: Na Pilate kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn bio, pɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ ogyaa Jesus;
title: LUKE

text: na wɔtseatseaa mu dɛ, Bɔ no mbeamudua mu, bɔ no mbeamudua mu!
title: LUKE

text: Na obisaa hɔn ne mprɛnsa dɛ, Ebɛn bɔn na nyimpa yi ayɛ? Munnhu dza ɔayɛ biara a ɔsɛ dɛ owu: dɛm ntsi mobɔhwe no, na megyaa no.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔdze ndze kɛse daa ho tseaa mu dɛ wɔmbɔ no mbeamudua mu. Na hɔn ndze hyɛɛ nedze no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na Pilate buu atsɛn dɛ wɔnyɛ hɔn ebisadze mma hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyia osian sakasaka nye ewudzi ntsi wɔdze no too efiadze no a wɔserɛɛ maa no no, ogyaa no, na Jesus dze, oyii no maa hɔn pɛ.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔdze no rokɔ no, wosuoo Simon bi a ofi Sirene a nna ofi haban mu reba mu, na wɔdze mbeamudua no too no do dɛ ɔnsoa ndzi Jesus n’ekyir.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔman no mu nyimpadodow kɛse kaa no do, nye mbaa a woridzi no nkɔmbɔ na worusu.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus daan noho hwɛɛ hɔn, na ɔsee dɛ, Jerusalɛm mbabaa, mma hom nnsu mma me, na hom nsu mma homho nye hom mba.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, nda reba a wɔbɛse dɛ, Nhyira nye abɔnyin, nye yafun a ɔnnwoo da, nye numfo a wonnuum da.
title: LUKE

text: Ɔno na wɔbɛhyɛ ase aka akyerɛ nkokwaa dɛ, Hom nhwe hɛn do, na mbepɔw dɛ, Hom nkata hɛn do.
title: LUKE

text: Na sɛ wɔdze iyi yɛ duamon a, ebɛnadze na wɔdze bɛyɛ duawui?
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔdze mbratofo beenu kaa no ho kɔree, dɛ wonkoku hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na wodur beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Tsikwankora Bea no, wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu wɔ hɔ, ɔnye mbratofo no, ɔbaako wɔ ne nyimfa, na ɔbaako wɔ n’abankum.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus see dɛ, Egya, fa kyɛ hɔn, na wonnyim dza wɔreyɛ. Na wɔkyɛɛ n’atar mu twee ho tonto.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔman no gyinaa hɔ hwɛe. Na mpanyimfo no so sii no atwetwe dɛ, Ɔgyee binom: ma ɔngye noho, ɛhɛɛ, sɛ ɔno nye Kraest a Nyankopɔn eyi no no a.
title: LUKE

text: Na nsordaafo no so sii no atwetwe, na wɔdze wenyin yerɛyerɛw bɛmaa no,
title: LUKE

text: na wɔsee dɛ, Sɛ ɔwo nye Jewfo Hen no a, gye woho.
title: LUKE

text: Nna akyerɛw bi so wɔ n’etsifi dɛ, OYI NYE JEWFO HEN NO.
title: LUKE

text: Na mbratofo a wɔsɛɛn hɔn no mu baako yaaw no dɛ, Nnyɛ ɔwo nye Kraest no a? Gye woho na gye hɛn ɛ.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaako no buaa no kaa n’enyim dɛ, Ana innsuro Nyankopɔn, dɛ ewɔ afɔbu kor yi ara mu?
title: LUKE

text: Na hɛn dze, ɔfata hɛn, osiandɛ hɛn nsa aka akatua a ɔsɛ hɛn ndzeyɛɛ; na oyi dze, ɔmmfomee wɔ biribiara ne nyɛe mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Jesus, sɛ eba w’ahendzi mu a, kaa me.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus buaa no dɛ, Ampaara mese wo dɛ ndɛ ebɛka mo ho wɔ Paradise hɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Na bɛyɛ dɛ ewiaber duebien no, sum hyɛɛ asaase no nyina do kodur ndɔnebiasa no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ewia kɔr sum; na asɔrdan no mu ntwamutam no tseew ebien wɔ finimfin.
title: LUKE

text: Na Jesus dze ndze kɛse kaa mu dɛ, Egya, wo nsamu na medze mo sunsum mehyɛ. Na ɔsee dɛm no, ogyaa no sunsum mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔhamupanyin no hun dza ayɛ no, ɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam see dɛ, Ampaara nyimpa yi tseneneenyi a.
title: LUKE

text: Na nyimpadodow a wɔbaa hɔ bɔhwɛɛ adze nyina no hun dza esi no, wɔdze hɔn nsa bobɔɔ hɔn koko do sanee kɔree.
title: LUKE

text: Na n’amanyimfo nyina, nye mbaa a wodzii n’ekyir fii Galilii nyina kegyinaa ekyirekyir hwɛɛ ndzɛmba yi.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi a ne dzin dze Josef a ɔyɛ nyimpa papa na ɔtsen, ka abaguafo no ho,
title: LUKE

text: naaso ɔnodze ɔammpen hɔn apam nye hɔn ndzeyɛɛ no do. Ofi Jewfo kurow Arimatea mu, nna ɔrotweɔn Nyankopɔn n’ahendzi no.
title: LUKE

text: Ɔno na ɔkɔr Pilate hɔ kɛserɛɛ Jesus no fun no.
title: LUKE

text: Na oyii no dze ndwera tam kyekyeer no ho, na ɔdze no too ɔboda a obiara nndaa mu da mu.
title: LUKE

text: Nna da no yɛ Ahosiesieda, na ahomgyeda no rebɛn.
title: LUKE

text: Na mbaa a wɔnye no fii Galilii bae no dzii ekyir bɔhwɛɛ nda no, nye mbrɛ wɔdze no fun toe.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔsanee kesiesiee nduhuam nye ngohuam. Na ahomgyeda no wɔhoom dzinn, dɛ mbrɛ mbrasɛm no tse.
title: LUKE

text: Na da a odzi dapɛn no kan no, anapaatu no na mbaa no dze nduhuam a wosiesiei no kɔr nda no do.
title: LUKE

text: Na wokohun ɔbo no dɛ woepirew no efi nda no abowano.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔhɛɛn mu no, woennhu Ewuradze Jesus no fun.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ iyi yɛɛ hɔn adwen mu basabasa no, hwɛ, mbarimba beenu begyinaa hɔn nkyɛn a wɔhyɛ ntar hyɛnhyɛn;
title: LUKE

text: na hu kaa hɔn, na wɔbɔɔ hɔn enyi adze sensɛɛn famu no, wɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom rohwehwɛ nyia ɔtse ase no wɔ ewufo mu yi?
title: LUKE

text: Onnyi ha, na ɔasoɛr: hom nkaa mbrɛ ɔda ho wɔ Galilii no, ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hom dɛ
title: LUKE

text: ɔsɛ nyimpa Ba no dɛ wobeyi no ahyɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo nsa na wɔabɔ no mbeamudua mu na da a otsia ebiasa no ɔasoɛr bio no.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔkaa ne nsɛm no,
title: LUKE

text: na wofii nda no do sanee bɛkaa ndzɛmba yi nyina kyerɛɛ dubiako no, nye nkaa no nyina.
title: LUKE

text: Mary Magdalene nye Joana nye James ne na Mary, nye mbaa nkaa a wɔka hɔn ho no na wɔbɛkaa nsɛm yinom kyerɛɛ asomafo no.
title: LUKE

text: Na nsɛm yi yɛɛ hɔn dɛ nsɛnhun, na wɔanngye hɔn enndzi.
title: LUKE

text: Na Peter dze, ɔsoɛree tutuu mbirika kɔr nda no do, na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze no, ohun dɛ ndwera atam no nko gugu hɔ; na ɔsanee kɔr ne fie, na dza esi no yɛɛ no nwanwa.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, da no ara, hɔn mu beenu sii mu kɔr ekuroba bi a ne dzin dze Emmaus a ofi Jerusalɛm kɔ hɔ bɛyɛ akwansimba eduosia mu.
title: LUKE

text: Nna woridzi nsɛm a aba yi nyina ho nkɔmbɔ.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, woridzi nkɔmbɔ na woribisabisa hɔnho nsɛm no, Jesus nankasa twee bɛɛn hɔn nye hɔn siaan anan kɔree.
title: LUKE

text: Naaso wosuoo hɔn enyiwa mu, ma woennhu ne nyimpa ban.
title: LUKE

text: Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Ebɛn nsɛm nye yi a hom dze ridzi nkɔmbɔ nam yi? Na wogyinae a hɔn werɛ ahow.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn mu baako a ne dzin dze Kleopas see no dɛ, Ana ɔwo nko na eyɛ hɔho wɔ Jerusalɛm, ma innyim dza ɔaba nda yi mu yi?
title: LUKE

text: Na obisaa hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze a? Na wɔsee no dɛ, Dza ɔfa Jesus Nazarɛtnyi a ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi tumfo wɔ ndzeyɛɛ nye kasa mu wɔ Nyankopɔn nye ɔman nyina enyim no ho:
title: LUKE

text: mbrɛ asɔfompanyin nye hɛn mpanyimfo no yii no maa dɛ wombu no fɔ nku no, na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɛn dze, hɛn enyi daa kwan dɛ nkyɛ ɔno nye nyia ɔrebɛgye Israel. Na iyi nyina ekyir so, wɔyɛɛ ndzɛmba yi ndaansa nye ndɛ.
title: LUKE

text: Na mbaa bi so a wofi hɛn mu a wɔkɔr nda no do anapahema abɛma hɛn ho abow hɛn;
title: LUKE

text: wɔbae bɛkaa dɛ woennhu no fun no, mbom woehu abɔfo bi wɔ enyido adzehu mu so a wɔkaa dɛ ɔtse ase.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn a wɔnye hɛn wɔ hɔ binom kɔr nda no do, na wokohun dɛ mbrɛ mbaa no so kae no ara, naaso ɔno dze, woennhu no.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔnoara see hɔn dɛ, Ao hom a hom adwen mu nndɔ na hom yɛ nyaa wɔ hom akoma mu dɛ hom bɛgye dza nkɔnhyɛfo no kae no nyina edzi!
title: LUKE

text: Ana ɔnnsɛ Kraest no dɛ obohu dɛm amandze na ɔakɔ n’enyimnyam mu?
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ ase fi Moses nye nkɔnhyɛfo no nyina do kyerɛɛ hɔn nkyerɛw nyina mu dza ɔfa no ho no ase.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔbɛɛn ekuroba a wɔrokɔ mu no, nna ɔyɛɛ dɛ dza ɔrokɔ n’enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔhyɛɛ no dɛ, Nye hɛn ntsena, na orudu ewimbir, na adze reyɛ asa. Na ɔmanee dɛ ɔnye hɔn bɛtsena.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ɔnye hɔn tse edzidzii no, ɔfaa paanoo, na ohyiraa do, na obubui maa hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn enyiwa buei ma wohun no, na ɔyeew hɔn enyiwa do.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Ɔnye hɛn rekasa wɔ kwan mu, na obuee kyerɛwnsɛm no mu kyerɛɛ hɛn no, aso hɛn akoma anndzɛw hɛn mu dɛɛdɛɛw?
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔsoɛɛr dɔn no ara mu sanee baa Jerusalɛm, na wobohun dubiako no nye hɔn a wɔka hɔn ho no dɛ wɔaboa hɔn ano,
title: LUKE

text: na wɔreka dɛ, Ewuradze asoɛr ampa, na oeyi noho akyerɛ Simon.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn so wɔkaa dza ɔbaa kwan no mu, na mbrɛ wohun no wɔ paanoo bu mu no kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔrekasa dɛm no, Jesus nankasa begyinaa hɔn finimfin, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Asomdwee nka hom.
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔbobɔɔ piriw na hu kaa hɔn, na wosusuu dɛ woehu ɔsaman.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom akoma etutu yi? Na ebɛnadze ntsi na adwendwen soɛrsoɛr hom akoma mu yi?
title: LUKE

text: Hom nhwɛ me nsa nye me nan dɛ emi mankasa a: hom nka me nhwɛ; na ɔsaman nnyi honam nye mbiew dɛ mbrɛ hom hu dɛ mowɔ yi.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee dɛm no, ɔdze ne nsa nye ne nan kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Nna wɔda ho nngye nndzi wɔ dɛw ntsi, na ɔyɛ hɔn nwanwa no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom wɔ edziban bi wɔ ha?
title: LUKE

text: Na wɔmaa no esunam a wɔatoto sin.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔgyee na odzii wɔ hɔn enyim.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Iyi nye me nsɛm a meda ho wɔ hom nkyɛn no mekaa kyerɛɛ hom dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mo ho wɔ Moses mbra, nye nkɔnhyɛfo, nye ndwom no mu nyina bɛba mu.
title: LUKE

text: Nna obuee hɔn adwen mu, ama wɔaatse kyerɛwnsɛm no ase;
title: LUKE

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Dɛmara na wɔakyerɛw no, dɛ Kraest no bohu amandze na da a otsia ebiasa no ɔasoɛr efi ewufo mu;
title: LUKE

text: na woedua ne dzin do akɛka nnuho nye bɔnfakyɛ akyerɛ amanaman nyina, wobefitsi ase wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: LUKE

text: Hom yɛ yinom ho adasefo.
title: LUKE

text: Na hwɛ, morosoma m’Egya n’anohoba maba hom do: na hom ntsena kurow no mu nkodu dɛ wobefi sor abrɛ hom ahoɔdzen.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔdze hɔn fiir edzi kodur Bɛtani tsentsendo, na ɔmaa ne nsa do hyiraa hɔn.
title: LUKE

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ, orihyira hɔn no, ɔnye hɔn paapaa mu na wɔfaa no kɔr sor.
title: LUKE

text: Na hɔn dze, wɔkotowee sɔɔr no, na wɔdze dɛw kɛse sanee baa Jerusalɛm;
title: LUKE

text: na wɔtsenaa asɔrfi mu hɔ daa yii Nyankopɔn ayɛw.
title: LUKE

text: Ahyɛse no nna Asɛm no wɔ hɔ, na Asɛm no nye Nyame wɔ hɔ, na Asɛm no ankasa so nye Nyame.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔnoara na ahyɛse no ɔnye Nyame wɔ hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Wɔnam no do yɛɛ adze nyina na woennkwetsi no annyɛ biribiara a wɔyɛe.
title: JOHN

text: No mu na nkwa wɔ, na nkwa no nye nyimpa ne kan.
title: JOHN

text: Na kan no hyerɛn wɔ sum mu, na sum no enntum annhyɛ no do.
title: JOHN

text: Nyimpa bi bae a Nyankopɔn somaa no a ne dzin dze John.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔnoara na ɔbaa adasedzi, dɛ oribedzi kan no ho dase, ama nyimpa nyina eedua no do agye edzi.
title: JOHN

text: Nnyɛ ɔno nye kan no bi, na obedzii kan no ho dase.
title: JOHN

text: Nokwar kan no a ɔhyerɛn ma nyimpa nyina no na ɔreba wiadze no.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔwɔ wiadze, na wɔnam no do yɛɛ wiadze, naaso wiadze ennhu no.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔbaa dza ɔyɛ nedze hɔ, naaso hɔn a wɔyɛ nedze no anngye no.
title: JOHN

text: Na dodow a wɔgyee no no, ɔmaa hɔn tum dɛ wɔnyɛ Nyankopɔn mba, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔgye ne dzin dzi no a,
title: JOHN

text: wommfi bɔgya anaa honam ne pɛ anaa ɔbarimba ne pɛ mu, na ofi Nyankopɔn mu na wɔwoo hɔn.
title: JOHN

text: Na Asɛm no bɛyɛɛ honam, na ɔbɔsoɛɛ hɛn mu, na yehun n’enyimnyam dɛ Egya no ne Ba kortsee no n’enyimnyam a adom nye nokwar ahyɛ no ma.
title: JOHN

text: (John dzii no ho dase na ɔtseaa mu dɛ: Oyi nye nyia mekae wɔ no ho dɛ, Nyia odzi m’ekyir reba no, ɔkyɛn me, osiandɛ odzii me kan no.)
title: JOHN

text: Ofi adom a ahyɛ no ma no mu na hɛn nyina yeenya adom abɔ adom do yi;
title: JOHN

text: na mbra no dze, wɔnam Moses do dze mae, na adom nye nokwar no dze, ɔnam Jesus Kraest do na ɔbae.
title: JOHN

text: Obi nnhun Nyankopɔn pɛn; Ɔba a wɔwoo no kor no a ɔtwer Egya no bo mu no, ɔno na oeyi no akyerɛ.
title: JOHN

text: John dzii dase yi wɔ ber a Jewfo fi Jerusalɛm somaa asɔfo nye Levifo dɛ wonkebisa no dɛ, Woana nye wo no?
title: JOHN

text: Ɔpaa mu kae na ɔannsan; ɔpaa mu kaa no kofee dɛ, Nnyɛ emi nye Kraest no.
title: JOHN

text: Wobisaa no dɛ, Woana nye wo? Elija nye wo a? Na ɔsee dɛ, Nnyɛ emi nye no. Nkɔnhyɛnyi no nye wo a? Na obuaa dɛ, Oho.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Dɛm a nna woana koraa nye wo? Ama yeenya bi akɛka akyerɛ hɔn a wɔsomaa hɛn. Eka dɛn wɔ woho?
title: JOHN

text: Ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye obi ne ndze a ɔretsea mu wɔ sar no do dɛ, Hom ntsentsen Ewuradze no kwan no, dɛ mbrɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia kae no.
title: JOHN

text: Nna hɔn a wɔsomaa hɔn no fi Farisiifo mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na wobisaa no see no dɛ, Sɛ nnyɛ ɔwo nye Kraest anaa Elija anaa nkɔnhyɛnyi no a, ebɛnadze ntsi na inuma?
title: JOHN

text: John buaa hɔn dɛ, Emi dze, munuma hom nsu mu, na obi gyina hom finimfin a hom nnyim no,
title: JOHN

text: ɔno nye nyia odzi m’ekyir reba no a ne mpaboa ho ahoma mpo mennsɛ dɛ mesan.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi sii no wɔ Bɛtani Jordan egya mbrɛ John runuma no.
title: JOHN

text: Na adze kyee no, John hun Jesus dɛ ɔreba ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nhwɛ, Nyankopɔn Eguambaa a oyi wiadze bɔn kɔ no.
title: JOHN

text: Oyi nye nyia mekae wɔ no ho dɛ, Ɔbarimba bi dzi m’ekyir reba a ɔkyɛn me mpo no, osiandɛ odzii me kan.
title: JOHN

text: Nna emi mara so minnyim no, na dɛ wobeyi no akyerɛ Israel ntsi na mebae mubonumae wɔ nsu mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na John dzii dase dɛ, Muhun Sunsum no dɛ ofi sor sianee dɛ ebubur na ɔbɛtsenaa no do.
title: JOHN

text: Nna emi dze minnyim no, na nyia ɔsomaa me ma mubonumae wɔ nsu mu no, ɔnoara na ɔsee me dɛ, Nyia ibohu dɛ Sunsum no besian abɛtsena no do no, ɔno nye nyia onuma wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu no.
title: JOHN

text: Na mehu na medzi dase dɛ ɔno nye Nyankopɔn Ba no.
title: JOHN

text: Na adze kyee bio no, nna John nye n’esuafo beenu gyina hɔ;
title: JOHN

text: na ohun Jesus dɛ ɔnenam hɔ no, ɔsee dɛ, Hom nhwɛ, Nyankopɔn Eguambaa no!
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔrekasa no n’esuafo beenu tsee na wɔkɛkaa Jesus do.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus daan noho, na ohun dɛ wɔka no do no, obisaa hɔn dɛ, Hom rohwehwɛ ebɛnadze? Na wɔsee no dɛ, Rabae, (ase nye dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo) etse hen?
title: JOHN

text: Obuaa hɔn dɛ, Hom mbra mbɔhwɛ. Na wɔbae bohun mbrɛ ɔtse, na wɔnye no tsenaa hɔ da no; nna wɔabɔ bɛyɛ ewimbir ndɔnnan.
title: JOHN

text: Na beenu a wɔtsee John n’asɛm na wɔkaa no do no, hɔn mu kor nye Andrew, Simon Peter no nua no.
title: JOHN

text: Na odzii kan bohun no nua Simon, na ɔsee no dɛ, Yeehu Messia no (ne nkyerɛase nye Kraest, anaadɛ, Nyia wɔasera no).
title: JOHN

text: Ɔdze no baa Jesus nkyɛn. Jesus hwɛɛ no see no dɛ, Ɔwo nye Simon, John ne ba no: wɔbɛfrɛ wo Siifas (ne nkyerɛase nye Peter anaadɛ Ɔbotan).
title: JOHN

text: Adze kyee no, Jesus pɛɛ dɛ ɔkɔ Galilii, na ohun Filip. Na Jesus see no dɛ, Ka mo do.
title: JOHN

text: Nna Filip fi Bɛtsaeda, Andrew nye Peter hɔn kurow mu.
title: JOHN

text: Filip kohun Nataniel, na ɔsee no dɛ, Yeehu nyia Moses kaa no ho asɛm wɔ mbra no mu no, na nkɔnhyɛfo no so kyerɛɛw no ho asɛm no, Jesus, Josef ba no a ofi Nazarɛt no a.
title: JOHN

text: Na Nataniel see no dɛ, Aso biribi papa bi botum efi Nazarɛt aba da? Filip see no dɛ, Bra bɔhwɛ ɛ.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus hun Nataniel dɛ ɔreba ne nkyɛn, na ɔkaa no ho asɛm dɛ, Hwɛ, ampaara Israelnyi nye yi a ndaadaa bi nnyi no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Nataniel bisaa no dɛ, Inyim me wɔ hen? Jesus buaa no dɛ, Ansaana Filip frɛɛ wo a ewɔ adɔmbadua no ase no, nna muhun wo.
title: JOHN

text: Nataniel buae see no dɛ, Rabae, ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn Ba no, ɔwo nye Israel Hen no.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa no dɛ, Mesee wo dɛ muhun wo adɔmbadua no ase ntsi na egye dzi yi? Ibohu ndzɛmba akɛse a ɔsen iyinom.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Mese hom nokwar mu dɛ, Hom bohu dɛ ɔsor ebue na Nyankopɔn abɔfo rofow sian wɔ Nyimpa Ba no do.
title: JOHN

text: Na da a otsia ebiasa no, wohyiaa ayefor wɔ Kaana a ɔwɔ Galilii, nna Jesus ne na wɔ hɔ;
title: JOHN

text: na wɔtoo nsa frɛɛ Jesus nye n’esuafo no so baa ayefor no ase.
title: JOHN

text: Na nsa no annso no, Jesus ne na kɛkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Hɔn nsa asa.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus buaa no dɛ, Ɔbaa, menye wo wɔ ebɛn nhyehyɛɛ? Me ber nnyae nndurii.
title: JOHN

text: Ne na see asomfo no dɛ, Biribiara a ɔbɛse hom no, hom nyɛ.
title: JOHN

text: Nna abo esuhina esia sisi hɔ, dɛ mbrɛ Jewfo hɔn ahoguar tse, kor bedzi etwahina ebien anaa ebiasa.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa nsu nhyehyɛ esuhina no amaama. Na wɔhyehyɛɛ no amaama tɛntɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Afei hom nsesaw nkɛma edzidziase panyin no. Na wɔdze kɔree.
title: JOHN

text: Na edzidziase panyin no kaa n’ano nsu a ɔadan nsa no hwɛe no, na onnyim mbrɛ ofir no (nna asomfo no a wɔsesaw nsu no dze wonyim), ɔfrɛɛ ayeforkun no,
title: JOHN

text: na ɔsee no dɛ, Nyimpa biara dze nsa papa no dzi kan besisi hɔ, na wɔanom abobow no, nna wɔdze dza onnye no ba, na ɔwo dze, edze nsa papa no esie ebodu sesei.
title: JOHN

text: Nsɛnkyerɛdze a odzi kan yi Jesus yɛe wɔ Kaana a ɔwɔ Galilii, na oyii n’enyimnyam kyerɛe; na n’esuafo no gyee no dzii.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi ekyir no, Jesus kɔr Karpernaum, ɔno nye ne na nye no nuanom nye n’esuafo, na wɔtsenaa hɔ nda kakra ara.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo apaho no bɛnee; na Jesus kɔr Jerusalɛm.
title: JOHN

text: Na okohun hɔn a wɔtɔn anantwi, nye nguan, nye mbubur, nye sikasesafo wɔ asɔrdan no mu dɛ wɔtsenatsena hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔdze ahoma yɛɛ mpire paam hɔn nyina, nguan no nye anantwi no, na ohuee sikasesafo sika gui, na ɔkaa hɔn apon butubutuwii.
title: JOHN

text: Na hɔn a wɔtɔn mbubur no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa yinom mfi ha! Mma hom nnyɛ m’Egya fie eguadzi fie!
title: JOHN

text: Na n’esuafo no kaae dɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Wo fie ho mbɔdzembɔ bɛhyɛ me ma.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi ntsi Jewfo no buae see no dɛ, Ebɛn asɛnkyerɛdze na edze kyerɛ hɛn dɛ ewɔ ho kwan dɛ eyɛ iyi?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Hom ndwuruw asɔrdan yi, na ndaansa mu mebɛma do bio.
title: JOHN

text: Nna Jewfo no see no dɛ, Mfe eduanan esia mu na wɔdze sii asɔrdan yi, na ɔwo ebɛma do nda ebiasa mu?
title: JOHN

text: Naaso ɔno dze, ɔkaa ne nyimpadua asɔrdan no ho asɛm.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔsoɛree fii ewufo mu no, n’esuafo no kaae dɛ ɔkaa iyi kyerɛɛ hɔn, na wɔgyee kyerɛwsɛm no nye asɛm a Jesus kae no dzii.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm apaho afahyɛ no mu no dodowara hun ne nsɛnkyerɛdze a ɔyɛe no, na wɔgyee ne dzin dzii;
title: JOHN

text: na Jesus dze, ɔammfa noho amma hɔn, osiandɛ onyim nyimpa nyina,
title: JOHN

text: na onnhia no dɛ obi dzi nyimpa ho dase, osiandɛ nankasa nyim dza ɔwɔ nyimpa mu.
title: JOHN

text: Nna nyimpa bi fi Farisiifo no mu wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Nikodemɔs a ɔyɛ Jewfo panyin bi;
title: JOHN

text: ɔnoara na ɔbaa Jesus nkyɛn anadwe, na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, Rabae, yenyim dɛ ifi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn na aba dɛ kyerɛkyerɛnyi; osiandɛ obi nntum nnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze a eyɛ yi, gyedɛ Nyankopɔn ka no ho.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buae see no dɛ, Meka no nokwar mu kyerɛ wo dɛ, Sɛ wɔannwo nyimpa fofor a, orunntum nnhu Nyankopɔn ahenman no.
title: JOHN

text: Nikodemɔs kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na nyimpa a oenyin no, wobotum awo no bio? Obotum akɔ ne na yamu bio ma wɔasan awo no anaa?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa dɛ, Meka no nokwar mu pefee kyerɛ wo dɛ, Sɛ woemmfi nsu nye Sunsum mu annwo nyimpa a, orunntum nnhɛn Nyankopɔn ahenman mu.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia wofi honam mu awo no no, ɔyɛ honam; na nyia wofi Sunsum mu awo no no, ɔyɛ Sunsum.
title: JOHN

text: Mma ɔnnyɛ wo nwanwa dɛ mese wo dɛ, Otwar dɛ wɔwo hom fofor.
title: JOHN

text: Mframa bɔ wɔ mbrɛ ɔpɛ, na etse ne ndze, naaso innyim mbrɛ ofi ba, na mbrɛ ɔkɔ. Mbrɛ obiara a wofi Sunsum mu awo no tse nye no.
title: JOHN

text: Nikodemɔs bisaa no dɛ, Yinom besi dɛn ayɛ hɔ?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa no dɛ, Ana eyɛ Israel kyerɛkyerɛnyi na innyim yinom yi?
title: JOHN

text: Ampaara, mese wo dɛ, yɛka dza yenyim na yedzi dza yeehu ho dase; na hom nngye hɛn dasee no nndzi.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ meka hom asaase afamu ndzɛmba na hom nngye nndzi a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na sɛ meka ɔsor ndzɛmba kyerɛ hom a, hom bɛgye edzi.
title: JOHN

text: Na obi mmfoow sor, gyedɛ nyia ofi sor sianee no, mekyerɛ, nyimpa Ba no a.
title: JOHN

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ Moses maa ɔwɔ no do wɔ sar no do no, dɛmara so na otwar dɛ wɔma nyimpa Ba no do,
title: JOHN

text: ama obiara a ɔgye no dzi no eenya onnyiewiei nkwa.
title: JOHN

text: Na mbrɛ Nyankopɔn sii dɔɔ wiadze nye yi, dɛ ɔdze ne Ba a ɔwoo no kor no mae, ama obiara a ɔgye no dzi no aannhera, na oeenya onnyiewiei nkwa.
title: JOHN

text: Na Nyankopɔn annsoma ne Ba wɔ wiadze dɛ ombobu wiadze atsɛn, na dɛ wondua no do ngye wiadze nkwa.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia ɔgye no dzi no, wommbu no atsɛn; nyia ɔnngye no nndzi no, woebu no atsɛn dada; osiandɛ ɔnngyee Nyankopɔn ne Ba kortsee no ne dzin nndzii.
title: JOHN

text: Na iyi nye atsɛmbu no, dɛ kan no aba wiadze, na nyimpa adɔ sum akyɛn kan no; osiandɛ hɔn ndwuma yɛ bɔn.
title: JOHN

text: Na obiara a ɔyɛ dza ɔmmfata no, okyir kan, eso ɔmmba kan no ho, amma woeennyi no atsɛn wɔ no ndwuma ho.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyia ɔyɛ nokwar no, ɔba kan no ho, ma no ndwuma aada edzi dɛ Nyankopɔn mu na ɔayɛ.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi ekyir no Jesus nye n’esuafo baa Judea asaase do, na ɔnye hɔn tsenaa hɔ, na onumae.
title: JOHN

text: Nna John so runuma wɔ Aenon a ɔbɛn Salim, osiandɛ nsu pii wɔ hɔ; na binom baa hɔ ma onumaa hɔn.
title: JOHN

text: Nna wonnyae mmfaa John nntoo efiadze.
title: JOHN

text: Na ekyingyegye bi baa John n’esuafo nye Jewnyi bi afamu a ɔfa ahoguar ho.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔbaa John nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Rabae, nyia ɔkaa wo ho wɔ Jordan egya no a egyee no ho dase no, hwɛ, ɔno so runuma na nyimpa nyina reba no hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: John buae na ɔsee dɛ, Nyimpa runntum nnya biribi, gyedɛ wɔdze fi sor ma no.
title: JOHN

text: Homankasa gye me dase dɛ mekaa dɛ, Nnyɛ emi nye Kraest no, na wɔsomaa me dzii n’enyim.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia ɔwɔ ayefor no nye ayeforkun; na ayeforkun ne nyɛnko a ogyina hɔ na otsie no, n’enyi gye kɛse wɔ ayeforkun no ne ndze ntsi; afei na m’enyigye yi ahyɛ ma.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔno dze, otwar dɛ ɔkɔ kan kyɛn me, na emi dze, midzi ekyir.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia ofi sor bae no kyɛn nyimpa nyina; nyia ofi famu no, ɔyɛ famunyi, na ɔkasa dɛ famunyi. Nyia ofi sor bae no kyɛn nyimpa nyina;
title: JOHN

text: dza oehu na ɔatse no na ɔgye ho dase, na obiara nngye ne dasee nndzi.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia ɔagye ne dase no, ɔasɔw ano dɛ Nyankopɔn yɛ nokwafo.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyia Nyankopɔn somaa no no, ɔka Nyankopɔn ne nsɛm, na Nyankopɔn dze Sunsum no ma no mbordo.
title: JOHN

text: Egya no dɔ Ɔba no, na ɔdze ndzɛmba nyina ahyɛ ne nsa.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia ɔgye Ɔba no dzi no, ɔwɔ onnyiewiei nkwa; na nyia onndzi Ɔba no n’asɛm do no dze, orinnya nkwa, na Nyankopɔn n’ebufuw wɔ no do.
title: JOHN

text: Afei Jesus hun dɛ Farisiifo no atse dɛ ɔno Jesus rinya esuafo pii na orunuma nyimpa sen John no
title: JOHN

text: (naaso Jesus nankasa ennuma na n’esuafo a),
title: JOHN

text: ofii Judea na osii mu kɔr Galilii bio.
title: JOHN

text: Nna otwar dɛ ɔfa Samaria.
title: JOHN

text: Na afei okodur Samaria kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Sikaar a ɔbɛn asaase a Jakob dze kyɛɛ ne ba Josef no ho;
title: JOHN

text: nna Jakob bura so wɔ hɔ. Nna Jesus aberɛ wɔ n’akwantu mu ntsi, ɔtsenaa bura no do dɛmara; bɛyɛ ewiaber duebien no.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔbaa bi a ofi Samaria bae bɔtoow nsu. Jesus see no dɛ, Ma me bi monnom.
title: JOHN

text: (Nna n’esuafo no kɔ kurow mu rokɔtɔ edziban.)
title: JOHN

text: Na Samarianyi ɔbaa no see no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔwo a eyɛ Jewnyi ibisa emi a meyɛ Samarianyi ɔbaa hɔ nsu anom? (Ɔkaa dɛm osiandɛ nna Jewfo nye Samariafo nnka.)
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buae see no dɛ, Sɛ inyim Nyankopɔn akyɛdze no, nye nyia ɔse wo dɛ, Ma me bi monnom yi a, nkyɛ ibebisa no ma ɔaama wo nkwa nsu.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔbaa no see no dɛ, Owura, Innyi adze a edze rotow, na bura no mu so dɔ; hen koraa na ibenya nkwa nsu no?
title: JOHN

text: Ana ɔwo eso kyɛn hɛn egya Jakob a ɔkyɛɛ hɛn bura yi, na nankasa nye ne mba nye no mbowa noom bi?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buae see no dɛ, Obiara a ɔbɔnom nsu yi bi no, nsukɔm bɛdze no bio.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyia ɔbɔnom nsu a mebɛma no no, nsukɔm nnkɛdze no da, na nsu a mebɛma no no bɛyɛ no mu nsubura a opuw nsu kɔ onnyiewiei nkwa mu.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔbaa no see no dɛ, Ma me dɛm nsu yi ɛ, amma nsukɔm anndze me ma mammba ammbɔtow nsu yi bi.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Kɔ kɛfrɛ wo kun na bra ha.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔbaa no buae see no dɛ, Minnyi kun. Jesus see no dɛ, Aka no yie dɛ, Minnyi kun:
title: JOHN

text: na nye mbanyin beenum atsena; na nyia enye no wɔ hɔ sesei yi mpo, ɔnnyɛ wo kun bi a; iyi dze, aka no nokwar ankasa.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔbaa no see no dɛ, Mo wura, muhu dɛ eyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi.
title: JOHN

text: Hɛn egyanom sɔree wɔ bepɔw yi do, na hom dze, hom se dɛ Jerusalɛm nye bea a ɔsɛ dɛ nyimpa sɔr wɔ hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Ɔbaa, gye me dzi dɛ dɔn no reba a nnyɛ bepɔw yi do, eso nnyɛ Jerusalɛm na hom bɔsɔr Egya no.
title: JOHN

text: Hom sɔr dza hom nnyim; hɛn dze, yɛsɔr dza yenyim, osiandɛ nkwagye fi Jewfo mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na dɔn no reba, na oenya edu, dɛ hɔn a wɔsɔr nokwar mu no bɔsɔr Egya no wɔ sunsum nye nokwar mu: na iyinom dɛm na Egya no rohwehwɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔsɔr no no yɛ.
title: JOHN

text: Nyankopɔn yɛ sunsum, na hɔn a wɔsɔr no no, ɔsɛ dɛ wɔsɔr no wɔ sunsum nye nokwar mu.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔbaa no see no dɛ, Minyim dɛ Messia no (a wɔfrɛ no Kraest no) reba; na ɔnodze, sɛ ɔba a, ɔbɛpaa mu aka adze nyina akyerɛ hɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa no dɛ, Emi a menye wo rekasa yi, emi nye ɔno.
title: JOHN

text: Na ha yi na n’esuafo no bae; na ɔyɛɛ hɔn ahobow dɛ ɔnye ɔbaa no rekasa, naaso obi emmbisa no dɛ, Erohwehwɛ ebɛnadze, anaa, Ɔyɛ dɛn na enye no rekasa yi?
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔbaa no gyaa n’ehina no hɔ na osii mu kɔr kurow no mu, na ɔsee kuromba no dɛ,
title: JOHN

text: Hom mbra mbɔhwɛ nyimpa bi a ɔaka dza mayɛ nyina akyerɛ me. Ana nnyɛ oyi nye Kraest no bi a?
title: JOHN

text: Nna nyimpa fii kurow no mu dɛ wɔreba ne nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Na ne ntamu no, n’esuafo no see no dɛ, Rabae, dzidzi.
title: JOHN

text: Na obuaa hɔn dɛ, Mowɔ edziban midzi a hom nnyim.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi n’esuafo no sesee hɔnho dɛ, Ana obi abrɛ no biribi ma oedzi?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see hɔn dɛ, M’edziban nye dɛ meyɛ nyia ɔsomaa me no pɛ na muwie n’edwuma.
title: JOHN

text: Ana hom nnka dɛ aka abosoom anan na twaber edu? Hwɛ! Mese hom dɛ, Hom mma hom enyi do nhwɛ nhaban no, dɛ oenya ahoa dze kyerɛ dɛ edu twaber.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyia otwa no gye akatua na ɔboaboa aba no ano kɔ onnyiewiei nkwa mu, na nyia oduae nye nyia otwae nyina aabɔ mu edzi dɛw.
title: JOHN

text: Na iyi mu asɛm no yɛ nokwar dɛ obi dua na obi twa.
title: JOHN

text: Mosomaa hom dɛ hom nkotwa dza hom nnyɛɛ ho edwuma; binom aberɛ hɔnho ayɛ, na hom dze, hom ebedzi hɔn edwuma mu aba.
title: JOHN

text: Na Samariafo a wɔwɔ kurow yi mu dodowara gyee no dzii wɔ dase a ɔbaa no dzii dɛ, Ɔaka dza mayɛ nyina akyerɛ me no ntsi.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi Samariafo baa ne nkyɛn no, wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔnye hɔn ntsena. Na ɔtsenaa hɔ nda ebien.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyimpa dodow a ɔkyɛn nkan no gyee no dzii wɔ n’asɛm ntsi,
title: JOHN

text: na wɔsee ɔbaa no dɛ, Afei nnyɛ w’asɛm ntsi na yɛgye dzi, na hɛnankasa so yɛatse na yenyim dɛ oyi nye wiadze Agyenkwa no.
title: JOHN

text: Na nda ebien twaa mu no, ofii hɔ sii mu kɔr Galilii.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus noara gyee dase dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi nnyi enyidzi wɔ nankasa no kurow mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na odur Galilii no, Galiliifo gyee no too mu, osiandɛ wohun dza ɔyɛe wɔ Jerusalɛm wɔ afahyɛ no ase nyina; osiandɛ hɔn so kɔr afahyɛ no ase bi.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus baa Kaana a ɔwɔ Galilii mbrɛ ɔdaan nsu wenyin no bio. Na ahenkowaa panyin bi wɔ hɔ a ne ba yar wɔ Karpernaum.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔtsee dɛ Jesus fi Judea aba Galilii no, ɔkɔr ne nkyɛn kɛserɛɛ no dɛ ɔmbra mbɛsa ne ba no yarba, na ɔreyɛ ewu.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus see no dɛ, Sɛ hom ennhu nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze a, hom nnkɛgye edzi da.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔpanyin no see no dɛ, Mo wura, Sian bra ansaana me ba no ewu.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus kaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Kɔ, wo ba no atse apɔw. Na nyimpa no gyee asɛm a Jesus kaa kyerɛɛ no no dzii, na ɔkɔree.
title: JOHN
