text: Na ɔresan akɔ no, no nkowaa behyiaa no kaa dɛ ne ba no atse apɔw.
title: JOHN

text: Na obisaa hɔn dɔn kor a no ho hyɛɛ ase yɛɛ no dzen; na wɔsee no dɛ, Ndeda ewiaber dɔnkor no mu na papu no gyaae.
title: JOHN

text: Na egya no hun dɛ dɔn no ara a Jesus see no dɛ, Wo ba no atse apɔw no mu a, na ɔgyee dzii, ɔno nye ne fifo nyina.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi so nye asɛnkyerɛdze a otsia ebien a Jesus fi Judea baa Galilii no ɔyɛe.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi ekyir no Jewfo afahyɛ bi durii, na Jesus kɔr Jerusalɛm.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jerusalɛm abobow a wɔfrɛ no Nguantsen Kuropon no ho nsutaae bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no wɔ Hebriw kasa mu Bɛtsaeda a ɔwɔ nkrandaa enum.
title: JOHN

text: Na iyinom mu na ayarfo nyimpakuw pii, enyifurafo, mpakye, nye hɔn a wɔyar mbubui dedae [rotweɔn nsu no no nwosowee.
title: JOHN

text: Na odu mber bi a Ewuradze no bɔfoe sian nsutaae no mu bɔfon no; na obiara a nsu no fon ekyir no odzi kan kɔtɔ mu no, yarba biara a ɔyar no, onya ayarsa.]
title: JOHN

text: Nna nyimpa bi wɔ hɔ a oedzi mfe eduasa awɔtwe wɔ ne yarba mu;
title: JOHN

text: na Jesus hun dɛ ɔda hɔ, na onyim dɛ ɔakyɛr hɔ no, obisaa no dɛ, Epɛ dɛ wo ho yɛ wo dzen anaa?
title: JOHN

text: Ɔyarfo no buaa dɛ, Owura, minnyi nyimpa biara a sɛ wɔbɔfon nsu no a ɔdze me to nsutaae no mu: na sɛ mereba a, nna obi edzi m’enyim kan akɔtɔ mu.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Soɛr, fa wo kɛtɛ na nantsew.
title: JOHN

text: Na amonmu no ara nyimpa no ho yɛɛ no dzen, na ɔfaa ne kɛtɛ, na ɔnantsewee. Nna da no yɛ ahomgyeda.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi Jewfo no see nyia wɔsaa no yarba no dɛ, Ndɛ yɛ ahomgyeda, innyi ho kwan dɛ esoa wo kɛtɛ.
title: JOHN

text: Obuaa hɔn dɛ, Nyia ɔmaa mo ho yɛɛ me dzen no, ɔnoara na ɔsee me dɛ, Fa wo kɛtɛ na nantsew.
title: JOHN

text: Wobisaa no dɛ, Woana nye nyimpa a ɔsee wo dɛ, Fa wo kɛtɛ na nantsew, no?
title: JOHN

text: Nna nyia wɔsaa no yarba no nnyim nyimpa kor no, osiandɛ nna nyimpadodow wɔ hɔ ntsi Jesus atwe noho efi hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: N’ekyir no Jesus hun no asɔrfi mu na ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ, wo ho ayɛ wo dzen: mma nnyɛ bɔn bio, mma dza omuo kyɛn yi aammba wo do.
title: JOHN

text: Nyimpa no sii mu kɛkaa kyerɛɛ Jewfo no dɛ Jesus na ɔmaa no ho yɛɛ no dzen.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi na Jewfo no hiahiaa Jesus ho, osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ ndzɛmba yi ahomgyeda.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, M’Egya yɛ edwuma bodu sesei na mo so meyɛ edwuma.
title: JOHN

text: Na dɛm siantsir yi tsitsir ntsi na Jewfo no hwehwɛɛ dɛ woku no, osiandɛ nnyɛ ahomgyeda nko na ɔato, na eso ɔfrɛɛ Nyankopɔn nankasa n’Egya, dze yɛɛ noho dɛ ɔnye Nyankopɔn yɛ pɛr.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Meka no nokwar mu kyerɛ hom dɛ, Ɔba no nankasa nntum nnhyɛ noho nnyɛ hwee, gyedɛ dza ohu Egya no dɛ ɔyɛ; na biribiara a Egya no yɛ no, ɔnoara Ɔba no so yɛ no dɛmara.
title: JOHN

text: Na Egya no dɔ Ɔba no, na ɔkyerɛ no dza nankasa yɛ no nyina, na ɔbɛkyerɛ no ndwuma a ɔkyɛn yinom, na aayɛ hom ahobow.
title: JOHN

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ Egya no nyan ewufo na ɔma hɔn nkwa no, dɛmara so na Ɔba no dze nkwa ma hɔn a ɔpɛ.
title: JOHN

text: Na eso Egya no mmbu obiara atsɛn, na ɔdze atsɛmbu nyina ahyɛ Ɔba no nsa,
title: JOHN

text: ama obiara eedzi Ɔba no nyi, dɛ mbrɛ wodzi Egya no nyi. Nyia onndzi Ɔba no nyi no, onndzi Egya a ɔsomaa no no so nyi.
title: JOHN

text: Mereka akyerɛ hom nokwar mu dɛ, nyia ɔtse m’asɛm, na ɔgye nyia ɔsomaa me no dzi no, ɔwɔ onnyiewiei nkwa, na ɔremmba atsɛmbu mu, na mbom oetwa mu efi owu mu aba nkwa mu.
title: JOHN

text: Mereka akyerɛ hom wɔ nokwar mu pi dɛ, dɔn no reba na enya edu a ewufo bɛtse Nyankopɔn Ba no ne ndze, na hɔn a wɔbɛtse no benya nkwa.
title: JOHN

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ Egya no wɔ nkwa wɔ nankasa no mu no, dɛmara so na ɔdze maa Ɔba no dɛ onnya nkwa wɔ nankasa no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔmaa no tum dɛ ombu atsɛn so, osiandɛ ɔyɛ Onyimpa Ba.
title: JOHN

text: Mma yi nnyɛ hom nwanwa: na dɔn no reba a hɔn a wɔwɔ nda mu nyina bɛtse me ndze,
title: JOHN

text: na wɔasoɛr epue; na hɔn a wɔayɛ papa no, bɔkɔ nkwa wunyan mu; na hɔn a wɔayɛ dza omuo no, akɔ afɔdzi wunyan mu.
title: JOHN

text: Mankasa munntum mennhyɛ moho nnyɛ hwee; dza metse no nna mubu ho atsɛn, na m’atsɛmbu tsen, osiandɛ monnhwehwɛ dza mankasa mepɛ, na dza nyia ɔsomaa me no pɛ a.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ mankasa midzi moho dase a, me dasee nnyɛ nokwar.
title: JOHN

text: Obi wɔ hɔ a odzi mo ho dase, na minyim dɛ ne dasee a odzi wɔ mo ho no yɛ nokwar.
title: JOHN

text: Hom somae kɔr John hɔ, na ɔagye nokwar no ho dase:
title: JOHN

text: na emi dze, menngye nyimpa hɔ dase, na meka yinom ama hom eenya nkwa.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔno nye kandzea a ɔdzɛw na ɔhyerɛn, na hom pɛɛ dɛ hom enyi gye wɔ ne kan mu mber kakra.
title: JOHN

text: Na emi dze, mowɔ dasefo a ɔkyɛn John, na ndwuma a Egya no dze ama me dɛ munwie no, ndwuma a meyɛ noara gye mo ho dase dɛ Egya no na ɔasoma me.
title: JOHN

text: Na Egya no a ɔsomaa me no nankasa agye mo ho dase. Hom nntsee ne ndze da, eso hom nnhun no su,
title: JOHN

text: na hom nnyi n’asɛm tse hom mu, osiandɛ nyia ɔsomaa no no, hom nngye no nndzi.
title: JOHN

text: Hom hwehwɛ kyerɛwsɛm no mu, osiandɛ hom susu dɛ yinom mu na hom wɔ onnyiewiei nkwa; naaso yinom nye dza wɔgye mo ho dase,
title: JOHN

text: na hom mmpɛ dɛ hom ba me nkyɛn ma hom eenya nkwa.
title: JOHN

text: Menngye enyimnyam wɔ nyimpa hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na minyim hom dɛ hom nnyi Nyankopɔn no dɔ wɔ hom mu.
title: JOHN

text: Emi dze, menam m’Egya dzin do maba, na hom nngye me; sɛ obi nam nankasa ne dzin do ba a, ɔno na hom bɛgye no.
title: JOHN

text: Hom bɛyɛ dɛn etum agye edzi, hom a hom gye enyimnyam wɔ homho nkorkor, na hom nnhwehwɛ enyimnyam a ofi Nyankopɔn hɔ ba no?
title: JOHN

text: Mma hom nnsusu dɛ emi na mobɔkɔ akɔtoa hom ama Egya no, na nyia ɔtoa hom wɔ hɔ, mekyerɛ Moses a hom dze hom werɛ atwer no no.
title: JOHN

text: Na sɛ hom agye Moses edzi a, nkyɛ hom bɛgye mo so edzi; osiandɛ nankasa kyerɛɛw mo ho nsɛm.
title: JOHN

text: Na sɛ hom nngye ne kyerɛw no nndzi a, hom bɛyɛ dɛn etum agye m’asɛm edzi?
title: JOHN

text: Iyi ekyir no, Jesus sii mu kɔr Galilii po a ɔyɛ Tiberias po no egya.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyimpadodow pii dzii n’ekyir, osiandɛ wohun nsɛnkyerɛdze a ɔyɛe wɔ hɔn a wɔyar ho.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus kɔr koko no do na ɔnye n’esuafo kɛtsenaa hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Nna apaho no, Jewfo afahyɛ no, abɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Na afei, Jesus maa n’enyi do, na ohun dɛ nyimpadodow kɛse reba ne nkyɛn no, ɔsee Filip dɛ, Hen na yebenya paanoo atɔ ama yinom eedzi?
title: JOHN

text: Na iyi dze ɔkae ara dze sɔɔ no hwɛe, osiandɛ nna nankasa nyim dza ɔrebɛyɛ.
title: JOHN

text: Filip buaa no dɛ, Paanoo Denare ahaebien mpo nnkɔso hɔn dɛ hɔn nyina benya nkakrankakra.
title: JOHN

text: Na n’esuafo no mu baako, Andrew a ɔyɛ Simon Peter no nua no, see no dɛ,
title: JOHN

text: Banyimba bi wɔ ha a ɔwɔ atoko paanoo enum na esunam nkakraba ebien; na iyi dze, ebɛnadze na ɔbɛyɛ ama nyimpa pii yi?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see dɛ, Hom mma nyimpa no ntsenatsena famu. Eso nna sar pii wɔ hɔ. Na dɔm no tsenatsenaa famu ma hɔn dodow bɛyɛ mpemenum.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus faa paanoo no nye esunam no na ɔdaa ase no, ɔkyɛe maa hɔn a wɔtsetse hɔ no, dɛ dodow biara a obiara hia.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔmee no, ɔsee n’esuafo dɛ, Hom mboaboa mporoporoba a ɔaka no ano, amma biribiara aannyɛ gyan.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔboaboaa ano, na wɔdze atoko paanoo enum no no mporoporoba a hɔn a wodzidzii no gyaae no hyɛɛ mbirefi duebien amaama.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyimpa no hun asɛnkyerɛdze a ɔyɛe no, wɔkaa dɛ, Ampa, oyi nye nkɔnhyɛnyi a ɔreba wiadze no.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus hun dɛ wɔreba abɛfa no ahyɛ no dze no ekedzi hen ntsi, ɔno nko twee noho kɔr koko no do bio.
title: JOHN

text: Na odur ewimbir no, n’esuafo no kɔr mpoano;
title: JOHN

text: na wɔkɔr hɛn mu twaa po no dɛ wɔrokɔ Karpernaum. Nna sum agye, naaso Jesus nnyae mmbaa hɔn nkyɛn,
title: JOHN

text: na po no hurii wɔ mframa kɛse a ɔbɔe no ntsi.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔkwaan bɛyɛ akwansimba eduonu enum anaadɛ eduasa no, wohun Jesus dɛ ɔnam po no do, na ɔrotwe abɛn hɛn no, na wosuroi.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mara a, mma hom nnsuro.
title: JOHN

text: Afei ɔbaa hɔ nkyɛn wɔ hɛn no mu, na ntsɛmara na hɛn no dur asaase a wɔrokɔ do no do.
title: JOHN

text: Adze kyee no, nyimpadodow a wogyinagyina po no egya no hun dɛ hɛn nnyi hɔ dɛ kor pɛr, naaso Jesus annka n’esuafo no ho annkɔ hɛn no mu, na n’esuafo nko na wɔkɔree.
title: JOHN

text: Na ahɛn bi fii Tiberias baa mbrɛ Ewuradze daa ase na wodzii paanoo wɔ hɔ no.
title: JOHN

text: Ntsi nyimpadodow no hun dɛ Jesus nnyi hɔ na n’esuafo so nnyi hɔ no, hɔn so wɔkɔr hɛn mu na wɔbaa Karpernaum bɔhwehwɛɛ Jesus.
title: JOHN

text: Na wobohun no wɔ po no egya no, wobisaa no dɛ, Rabae, aber bɛn na ebaa ha?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Meka no nokwar mu kyerɛ hom dɛ, Nnyɛ hom hun nsɛnkyerɛdze ntsi na hom rohwehwɛ me, na mbom hom dzii paanoo na hom mee no ntsi a.
title: JOHN

text: Mma hom nnyɛ edwuma wɔ edziban a ɔsɛɛ ho, na mbom hom nyɛ wɔ edziban a ɔtsena hɔ kodu onnyiewiei nkwa mu a nyimpa Ba dze bɛma hom no ho; na ɔno na Egya Nyankopɔn asɔw n’ano.
title: JOHN

text: Na wobisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na yɛnyɛ na yaayɛ Nyankopɔn ndwuma?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Iyi nye Nyankopɔn edwuma, dɛ hom bɛgye nyia ɔnoara somaa no no edzi.
title: JOHN

text: Na wobisaa no dɛ, Asɛnkyerɛdze bɛn na ebɛyɛ ma yeehu na yaagye wo edzi? Ebɛn edwuma na ereyɛ?
title: JOHN

text: Hɛn egyanom dzii manna no wɔ sar no do, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ɔmaa hɔn paanoo fi sor ama woeedzi.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Meka no nokwar mu kyerɛ hom dɛ, Nnyɛ Moses na ɔmaa hom paanoo a ofi sor no, na m’Egya na ɔma hom paanoo papa a ofi sor no;
title: JOHN

text: na Nyankopɔn paanoo nye nyia ofi sor sian ba na ɔma wiadze nkwa no.
title: JOHN

text: Nna wɔsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, ma hɛn paanoo yi bi daa.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Emi nye nkwa paanoo no: nyia ɔba mo hɔ no, ɔkɔm nnkɛdze no da, na nyia ɔgye me dzi no nsukɔm nnkɛdze no da.
title: JOHN

text: Na mesee hom dɛ, Hom ehu me naaso hom nngye nndzi.
title: JOHN

text: Dza Egya no dze ama me biara bɛba mo hɔ; na nyia ɔbɛba mo hɔ no moronntow no nnkyen da,
title: JOHN

text: osiandɛ mifi sor sianee bae, nnyɛ dɛ merebɛyɛ mankasa me pɛ, na mbom nyia ɔsomaa me no ne pɛ a.
title: JOHN

text: Na iyi nye nyia ɔsomaa me no ne pɛ, dɛ dza ɔdze ama me nyina mennkɛyew no mu hwee, na mebɛma no do wɔ da a odzi ekyir no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na iyi nye m’Egya ne pɛ, dɛ obiara a ɔhwɛ Ba no na ɔgye no dzi no, onnya onnyiewiei nkwa, na mebɛma no do wɔ da a odzi ekyir no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Nna Jewfo no hwinhwinii wɔ no ho dɛ ɔkaa dɛ, Emi nye paanoo a ofi sor sianee bae no,
title: JOHN

text: na wɔsee dɛ, Ana nnyɛ oyi nye Jesus, Josef ne ba a yenyim n’egya nye ne na no? Na ɔyɛ dɛn na afei ɔse dɛ, Mesian efi sor aba yi?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buae na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Mma hom nnhwinhwin hom mu.
title: JOHN

text: Obiara nntum mmba mo hɔ, gyedɛ Egya no a ɔsomaa me no twe no, na mebɛma no do wɔ da a odzi ekyir no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Wɔakyerɛw wɔ Nkɔnhyɛfo no mu dɛ, Na hɔn nyina Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn. Obiara a ɔatse wɔ Egya no nkyɛn na oesua no, ɔba mo hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Nnyɛ dɛ obiara ehu Egya no, gyedɛ nyia ofi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no, ɔno na oehu Egya no.
title: JOHN

text: Nokwar nye iyi, mese hom dɛ, nyia ɔgye dzi no wɔ onnyiewiei nkwa.
title: JOHN

text: Emi nye nkwa paanoo no.
title: JOHN

text: Hom egyanom dzii manna no wɔ sar no do na wowuwui;
title: JOHN

text: iyi nye paanoo a ofi sor sian ba no, ama nyimpa eedzi bi na oeennwu.
title: JOHN

text: Emi nye paanoo tseasenyi a ofi sor sianee bae no; sɛ obi dzi paanoo yi bi a, ɔbɛtsena ase daa; na ampaara paanoo a medze bɛma nye mo honam wɔ wiadze nkwa ntsi.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo no bisabisaa hɔn ho dɛ, Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na dɛm nyimpa yi botum dze no honam ama hɛn ma yeedzi?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Meka no nokwar mu kyerɛ hom dɛ, sɛ hom enndzi nyimpa Ba no honam na hom annom no bɔgyaa a, hom nnyi nkwa wɔ hom mu.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia odzi mo honam na ɔnom mo bɔgyaa no, ɔwɔ onnyiewiei nkwa, na da a odzi ekyir no mu mebɛma no do.
title: JOHN

text: Na mo honam yɛ edziban ampa, na mo bɔgyaa yɛ anondze ampa.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia odzi mo honam na ɔnom mo bɔgyaa no na ɔtse mo mu, na mo so metse no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛ mbrɛ Egya tseasenyi no somaa me, na mudua Egya no do metse ase no, nyia odzi mo honam no, nankasa so bodua mo do atsena ase.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi nye paanoo a ofi sor sianee bae no: nnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ hom egyanom dzii manna no na wowuwui no; nyia obedzi paanoo yi no, ɔbɛtsena ase daa.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔkaa asɛm yi wɔ ber a nna ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ Karpernaum nhyiamudan mu no.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi n’esuafo pii tsee no, wɔsee dɛ, Asɛm yi yɛ dzen: woana botum etsie?
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus tsee wɔ nankasa no mu dɛ n’esuafo no ruhwinhwin asɛm no ho no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana iyi yɛ hom fintsidua?
title: JOHN

text: Na afei sɛ hom hu nyimpa Ba no dɛ ɔrofow kɔ sor mbrɛ nkan no ɔwɔ no dze ɛ?
title: JOHN

text: Sunsum nye dza ɔma nkwa, mfaso biara nnyi honam mu: nsɛm a maka akyerɛ hom no yɛ sunsum, na ɔyɛ nkwa.
title: JOHN

text: Na hom mu binom wɔ hɔ a wɔnngye nndzi. Nna Jesus nyim hɔn a wɔnngye no nndzi no fitsi ahyɛse no ara na nyia obeyi no ama no so.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Iyi ntsi na mase hom dɛ obi nntum mmba mo hɔ gyedɛ Egya no ma no kwan ana.
title: JOHN

text: Ofi iyi do no, n’esuafo no pii saan ekyir, na wɔnnye no annantsew bio.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi Jesus bisaa duebien no dɛ, Ana hom so hom pɛ dɛ hom kɔ a?
title: JOHN

text: Simon Peter buaa no dɛ, Ewuradze, woana hɔ na yɛbɔkɔ? Ɔwo na ewɔ onnyiewiei nkwa ho nsɛm;
title: JOHN

text: na hɛn dze, yɛagye edzi na yenyim dɛ ɔwo nye Nyankopɔn no Hotseweenyi no.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Ana nnyɛ emi na mepaa hom duebien yi? Naaso hom mu baako yɛ abɔnsam.
title: JOHN

text: Nna Judas, Simon Iskariot ne ba no, na ɔreka no ho asɛm no: na ɔno na oribeyi no ama; eso ɔyɛ duebien no mu baako.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi ekyir no, Jesus kekyinkyiin Galilii, nna ɔmmpɛ dɛ okekyinkyin Judea, osiandɛ Jewfo no rohwehwɛ no eku no.
title: JOHN

text: Nna Jewfo no asesebɔ afahyɛ no abɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Na no nuanom no see no dɛ, Fi ha kɔ Judea ama w’esuafo no so aahwɛ wo ndwuma a ereyɛ yi.
title: JOHN

text: Na obi nnyɛ biribi wɔ nsumaa mu, na ɔnnhwehwɛ dɛ nankasa dze, wobohu no bagua mu. Sɛ eyɛ yinom a, yi woho kyerɛ wiadze.
title: JOHN

text: (Na no nuanom mpo anngye no enndzi.)
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Emi dze, me ber nnyae nndurii, na hom dze, hom mber wɔ hɔ daa.
title: JOHN

text: Wiadze nntum nntan hom, na emi dze, ɔtan me, osiandɛ megye no ho dase dɛ no ndwuma muo.
title: JOHN

text: Hom nkɔ afahyɛ no ase; emi dze, minnyae nnkɔr afahyɛ yi ase, osiandɛ me ber nnyae nndurii.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛm no ɔtsenaa Galilii.
title: JOHN

text: Na no nuanom kɔree no ekyir no, no so kɔr afahyɛ no ase, nnyɛ guado, na mbom wɔ nsumaa mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo no hwehwɛɛ no afahyɛ no ase, na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔwɔ hen?
title: JOHN

text: Na huhuhuhu pii baa nyimpadodow no mu wɔ no ho: binom se, Ɔyɛ nyimpa pa; binom se, Dabi, na ɔdaadaa nkorɔfo no.
title: JOHN

text: Naaso, Jewfo no ho hu ntsi, obi anngye enyim annka no ho asɛm.
title: JOHN

text: Na odur afahyɛ no finimfin no, Jesus kɔr asɔrfi no mu kɛkyerɛkyerɛe.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔyɛɛ Jewfo no nwanwa na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na onnsuaa nwoma, naaso onyim yi?
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Me nkyerɛkyerɛ nnyɛ medze, na nyia ɔsomaa me no dze a.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ obi pɛ dɛ ɔyɛ ne pɛ a, obohu nkyerɛkyerɛ no dɛ ofi Nyankopɔn anaadɛ ofi mankasa me tsirmu na meka.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia ɔbɔ nankasa ne tsirmu kasa no hwehwɛ nankasa n’enyimnyam; na nyia ɔhwehwɛ nyia ɔsomaa no no n’enyimnyam no, ɔno na ɔyɛ nokwafo, na dza ɔnntsen nnyi no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Ana nnyɛ Moses na ɔmaa hom mbra no? Naaso hom mu obiara nndzi mbra no do. Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom rohwehwɛ me eku me yi?
title: JOHN

text: Nyimpadodow no buaa dɛ, Ewɔ abɔnsam: woana na ɔrohwehwɛ wo eku wo?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Edwuma kor pɛ na meyɛe na ɔyɛ hom nyina nwanwa yi.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi na Moses ama hom twatsiatwa (nnyɛ dɛ ofi Moses, na ofi egyanom no) naaso ahomgyeda hom twa nyimpa twatsia.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ nyimpa nya twatsiatwa ahomgyeda ama wɔaannto Moses mbra a, hom bo efuw me dɛ mama nyimpa no ho nyina ayɛ no dzen ahomgyeda anaa?
title: JOHN

text: Mma hom mmbu atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ hom hu no enyiwa do, mbom hom mbu atsɛn tsenenee.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jerusalɛmfo no mu binom see dɛ, Ana nnyɛ oyi nye nyia wɔrohwehwɛ no eku no no?
title: JOHN

text: Na hwɛ, ɔrekasa pefee naaso wɔnnse no hwee. Gyama mpanyimfo no ehu ampa dɛ oyi nye Kraest no anaa?
title: JOHN

text: Naaso, oyi dze, yenyim mbrɛ ofi, na Kraest no dze, sɛ ɔba a, obi runnhu mbrɛ ofi.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus rekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔrfi no mu no, ɔtseaa mu na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nyim me, na eso hom nnyim mbrɛ mifi; na mankasa mannhyɛ moho mebae, na nyia ɔsomaa me no nye nokwafo a hom nnyim no.
title: JOHN

text: Emi dze, minyim no, osiandɛ mifi no hɔ, na ɔno na ɔsomaa me.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ wɔkyer no, naaso obi ammfa ne nsa ennsuo no mu, osiandɛ no dɔn nnyae nndurii.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyimpadodow no mu pii gyee no dzii na wɔsee dɛ, Ana Kraest no, sɛ ɔba a, ɔbɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze pii akyɛn dza oyi ayɛ yi?
title: JOHN

text: Farisiifo no tsee dɛ nyimpadodow no ruhwinhwin dɛm wɔ no ho, na asɔfompanyin no nye Farisiifo no somaa asomfo dɛ wɔnkɛkyer no.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus see dɛ, Aber kakrabaabi na mowɔ hom nkyɛn, na morokɔ nyia ɔsomaa me no nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Hom bɔhwehwɛ me na hom nnkohu me, na mbrɛ mowɔ no hom runntum hɔ ba.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo no kaa kyerɛɛ hɔnho dɛ, Hen na ɔrobɔkɔ na yennkohu no? Ɔbɔkɔ hɔn a wɔapetse Griikfo mu no mu akɛkyerɛkyerɛ Griikfo no anaa?
title: JOHN

text: Asɛm bɛn na ɔreka yi dɛ, Hom bɔhwehwɛ me na hom nnkohu me, na mbrɛ mowɔ hom runntum hɔ ba yi?
title: JOHN

text: Na da a odzi ekyir no a ɔyɛ afahyɛ no ne dapɔn no Jesus gyinae tseaa mu dɛ, Sɛ nsukɔm dze obi a, wɔmma ɔmbra me nkyɛn mbɔnom.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia ɔgye me dzi no, dɛ mbrɛ kyerɛwsɛm no aka no, nkwa esutsen befi ne yamu apem.
title: JOHN

text: Na iyi dze, ɔkae wɔ Sunsum a hɔn a wɔgyee no dzii no woribenya no ho, nna Sunsum no nnyae mmbae, osiandɛ wonnyae nnhyɛɛ Jesus enyimnyam.
title: JOHN

text: Ntsi nyimpadodow no mu binom tsee nsɛm yi no, wɔkaa dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi no nye yi ampa.
title: JOHN

text: Binom kaa dɛ, Kraest no nye yi; na binom so kaa dɛ, Ana Kraest no befi Galilii aba?
title: JOHN

text: Ana kyerɛwsɛm no annka dɛ, David asefo mu, nye Bɛtlɛhɛm kurow a David tsenaa mu no mu, na Kraest no befi aba?
title: JOHN

text: Na mpaapaamu baa nyimpadodow no mu,
title: JOHN

text: na hɔn mu binom pɛɛ dɛ wɔkyer no, naaso obiara ammfa ne nsa ennsuo no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na asomfo no baa asɔfompanyin no nye Farisiifo no nkyɛn, na wobisaa hɔn dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom ammfa no ammba?
title: JOHN

text: Asomfo no buaa dɛ, Nyimpa bi nnkasaa dɛm da, dɛ dɛm nyimpa yi.
title: JOHN

text: Na Farisiifo no buaa hɔn dɛ, Ana hom so wɔadaadaa hom?
title: JOHN

text: Ana mpanyimfo anaadɛ Farisiifo bi gyee no dzii?
title: JOHN

text: Na nyimpadodow a wonnyim mbra no, wɔapaa hɔn.
title: JOHN

text: Nikodemɔs a nkan no ɔbaa ne nkyɛn a ɔyɛ hɔn mu baako no kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ,
title: JOHN

text: Ana hɛn mbra so nndzii kan nntsiee nyimpa, na onnhun dza ɔayɛ a, obu no atsɛn?
title: JOHN

text: Wobuaa no dɛ, Ana wo so ifi Galilii? Hwehwɛ mu hwɛ, na hu dɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi mmpuei wɔ Galilii mu da.
title: JOHN

text: [Na hɔn nyina kokɔr hɔn efiefi.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus kɔr Ngo Bepɔw no do.
title: JOHN

text: Na ahanamakye no ɔbaa asɔrfi no mu bio, na ɔman no nyina baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔtsenaa ase kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: JOHN

text: Na kyerɛwfo no nye Farisiifo no dze basia bi a wɔakyer no awarto mu bae, na wɔdze no sii finimfin no, wɔsee no dɛ,
title: JOHN

text: Kyerɛkyerɛfo, wɔakyer ɔbaa yi wɔ awarto mu, dɛ ogu do reyɛ.
title: JOHN

text: Eso Moses wɔ mbra no mu hyɛɛ hɛn dɛ wonsiw dɛm nkorɔfo no abo: na ɔwo ese dɛn?
title: JOHN

text: Na iyi dze, wɔkae dze sɔɔ no hwɛe, ama woeenya biribi dze akɔtoa no. Na Jesus brɛɛ no mu adze dze ne nsatseaba kyerɛkyerɛɛw daadze.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔda ho ara ribisa no no, ɔtseen no mu kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom mu nyia bɔn nnyi no ho no, wɔmma ɔntow no bo kan.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔbrɛɛ no mu adze bio, na ɔdze ne nsatseaba kyerɛkyerɛɛw daadze.
title: JOHN

text: Na hɔn dze, wɔtsee na hɔn tsibowa yii hɔn atsɛn no, wofii hɔ nkorkor fitsi mpanyimfo do besi hɔn a wodzi ekyir do, na ɔkaa Jesus nko nye ɔbaa no a ogyina finimfin no.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus tseen no mu na oennhu obiara dɛ ɔbaa no nko no, obisaa no dɛ, Ɔbaa, w’atoafo no wɔ hen? Ana obi emmbu wo fɔ?
title: JOHN

text: Ɔsee no dɛ, Mo wura, obi emmbu me fɔ. Jesus see no dɛ, Mo so mummbu wo fɔ: kɔ na mma nnkɛyɛ bɔn bio.]
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus kasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn bio dɛ, Emi nye wiadze kan no: nyia odzi m’ekyir no rennantsew sum mu da, na obenya nkwa kan no.
title: JOHN

text: Farisiifo no see no dɛ, Ɔwo dze, idzi wankasa woho dase: wo dasee nnyɛ nokwar.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buae see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ midzi mankasa moho dase mpo a, me dasee yɛ nokwar, osiandɛ minyim mbrɛ mifi bae na mbrɛ morokɔ; naaso hom dze, hom nnyim mbrɛ mifi bae anaa mbrɛ morokɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Hom dze, hom bu honam enyi atsɛn, na emi dze, mummbu obi atsɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Na sɛ mubu atsɛn mpo a, nkyɛ m’atsɛmbu yɛ nokwar, osiandɛ nnyɛ mo nko na mowɔ hɔ, na emi nye Egya no a ɔsomaa me no.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔakyerɛw wɔ hom mbra no mu so dɛ nyimpa beenu hɔn dasee yɛ nokwar.
title: JOHN

text: Midzi mankasa moho dase, na Egya no a ɔsomaa me no so dzi me dase.
title: JOHN

text: Na wobisaa no dɛ, Hen na w’Egya wɔ? Jesus buaa dɛ, Hom nnyim me, eso hom nnyim m’Egya; sɛ hom nyim me a, nkyɛ hom nyim m’Egya so dɛmara.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔrfi no mu sikakorabea hɔ no nna ɔkaa nsɛm yi; naaso obi ammfa ne nsa ennsuo no mu, osiandɛ nna ne mber nnyae nndurii.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see hɔn bio dɛ, Morokɔ, na hom bɔhwehwɛ me, na hom bowu wɔ hom bɔn mu: mbrɛ morokɔ no, hom nnkotum aba hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo no see no dɛ, Oribedzi noho ewu anaa, na ɔse, Mbrɛ morokɔ no, hom runntum mmba hɔ yi?
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom dze, hom fi famu dze mu; na emi dze, mifi ɔsor dze mu; hom dze, hom fi wiadze yi mu; emi dze, mimmfi wiadze yi mu.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi mese hom dɛ hom bowu wɔ hom bɔn mu: sɛ hom nngye nndzi dɛ emi nye ɔno a, hom bowu wɔ hom bɔn mu.
title: JOHN

text: Nna wobisaa no dɛ, Woana nye wo? Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Dza mifi ahyɛse maka akyerɛ hom no ara a.
title: JOHN

text: Na mowɔ hom ho nsɛm pii a meka na mubu hom atsɛn; na nyia ɔsomaa me no yɛ nokwafo, na dza matse wɔ no hɔ na meka kyerɛ wiadze.
title: JOHN

text: Wɔanntse ase dɛ Egya no ho asɛm na ɔreka kyerɛ hɔn no.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom nya ma nyimpa Ba no do a, nna hom bohu dɛ emi nye no, na dɛ mennhyɛ mankasa moho nnyɛ biribi, na dɛ mbrɛ Egya no kyerɛkyerɛ me no, dɛmara na meka yi.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyia ɔsomaa me no nye me tse: onngyaa mo nko, osiandɛ meyɛ dza ɔsɔ n’enyi daa.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔreka dɛm nsɛm no, dodowara gyee no dzii.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus kaa kyerɛɛ Jewfo a wɔgyee no dzii no dɛ, Sɛ hom tsena m’asɛm mu a, nna hom yɛ m’esuafo ampa;
title: JOHN

text: na hom bohu nokwar no, na nokwar no bɛyɛ hom adehye.
title: JOHN

text: Wobuaa no dɛ, Yɛyɛ Abraham asefo, yɛnnyɛɛ obi nkowaa da: ɔyɛ dɛn na ese dɛ, Hom bɛyɛ adehye yi?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Meka kyerɛ hom wɔ nokwar mu dɛ, obiara a ɔyɛ bɔn no, ɔyɛ bɔn n’akowaa;
title: JOHN

text: na akowaa nnka fie daa, na ɔba dze, ɔtsena hɔ daa.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ Ɔba no yɛ hom adehye a, hom bɛyɛ adehye ampa.
title: JOHN

text: Minyim dɛ hom yɛ Abraham n’asefo, naaso hom rohwehwɛ me eku me, osiandɛ m’asɛm wura hom mu a ɔnnyɛ yie.
title: JOHN

text: Dza mehu wɔ m’Egya nkyɛn na meka na hom so hom yɛ dza hom atse wɔ hom egya nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Wobuaa no dɛ, Hɛn egya nye Abraham. Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom yɛ Abraham mba a, nkyɛ hom bɛyɛ Abraham ndwuma;
title: JOHN

text: na afei dze, hom rohwehwɛ me eku me, nyimpa a maka nokwar a metsee no Nyankopɔn nkyɛn akyerɛ hom: iyi dze, Abraham annyɛ bi.
title: JOHN

text: Hom yɛ hom egya ndwuma. Wɔsee no dɛ, Nnyɛ ndwamanyɛ mu na wɔwoo hɛn: egya kor na yɛwɔ, ɔno nye Nyankopɔn.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom egya nye Nyankopɔn a, nkyɛ hom bɔdɔ me, osiandɛ mifi Nyankopɔn mu na maba; eso mannhyɛ moho na mebae, na ɔno na ɔsomaa me.
title: JOHN

text: Ebɛnadze ntsi na hom nntse me kasaa ase? Osiandɛ hom nntum nntsie m’asɛm.
title: JOHN

text: Hom fi hom egya abɔnsam no mu, na hom egya n’akɔndɔdze na hom pɛ dɛ hom yɛ. Ɔno na ɔyɛ owudzifo fitsi ahyɛse no, na ɔnntsena nokwar mu, osiandɛ nokwar no nnyi no mu. Sɛ ɔka atorsɛm a, ofi nankasa n’adze mu na ɔka, osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔtorfo nye atorsɛm n’egya.
title: JOHN

text: Na emi dze, meka nokwar no ntsi, hom nngye me nndzi.
title: JOHN

text: Hom mu woana na obu me bɔn ho fɔ? Sɛ meka nokwar a, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom nngye me nndzi?
title: JOHN

text: Nyia ofi Nyankopɔn mu no, otsie Nyankopɔn nsɛm: iyi ntsi na hom nntsie, osiandɛ hom mmfi Nyankopɔn mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo no buaa no dɛ, Ɛhɛɛ, nnyɛ nokwar no ara na yɛkae dɛ eyɛ Samarianyi na ewɔ abɔnsam no?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa dɛ, Minnyi abɔnsam, na midzi m’Egya nyi, na hom dze, hom nndzi me nyi.
title: JOHN

text: Na emi dze monnhwehwɛ mankasa m’enyimnyam, na obi wɔ hɔ a ɔhwehwɛ na obu atsɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Mereka akyerɛ hom wɔ nokwar mu dɛ, sɛ obi dzi m’asɛm do a, orunnhu wu ara da.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo no see no dɛ, Afei na yeenya ehu dɛ ewɔ abɔnsam. Abraham nye nkɔnhyɛfo no wui, na ɔwo dze ese dɛ, Sɛ obi dzi m’asɛm do a, ɔronnsɔ owu nnhwɛ da.
title: JOHN

text: Ana ɔwo eso kyɛn hɛn egya Abraham a owui no? Na sɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no so wui a, na ɔwo ihu woho dɛn nye yi?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa dɛ, Sɛ mehyɛ moho enyimnyam a, m’enyimnyam nnyɛ hwee: m’Egya na ɔhyɛ me enyimnyam, ɔno a hom ka dɛ ɔyɛ hom Nyankopɔn no a;
title: JOHN

text: naaso hom nnyim no; na emi dze, minyim no; na sɛ meka dɛ minnyim no mpo a, mebɛyɛ ɔtorfo dɛ hom ara; na minyim no na midzi n’asɛm do.
title: JOHN

text: Hom egya Abraham dzii dɛw dɛ obohu me da; na ohunii, na n’enyi gyee.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo no see no dɛ, Innyae nndzii mfe eduonum mpo, na isii dɛn hun Abraham?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Meka no nokwar mu kyerɛ hom dɛ, ansaana Abraham rebɛba no, nna mowɔ hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Nna wɔtasee abo dɛ nkyɛ wɔrobɔtow abɔ no; na Jesus huntsaa noho na ofiir edzi fii asɔrfi no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na orutwa mu no, ohun nyimpa bi a ɔyɛ onyifuranyi fi n’awoo mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na n’esuafo bisaa no dɛ, Rabae, woana na ɔyɛɛ bɔn, nyimpa yi anaa n’awofo a, dɛ wɔwoo no onyifuranyi?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa dɛ, Nnyɛ nyimpa yi na ɔyɛɛ bɔn, eso nnyɛ n’awofo a, na mbrɛ Nyankopɔn ndwuma bɛda edzi wɔ no mu ntsi a.
title: JOHN

text: Otwar dɛ, adzekyee wɔ do yi, yɛyɛ nyia ɔsomaa me no no ndwuma; na adzesaa reba a obi nnkotum ayɛ edwuma.
title: JOHN

text: Mowɔ wiadze yi, emi nye wiadze ne kan.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔkaa dɛm yi no, ɔtoo ntafi guu daadze, na ɔdze ntafi no yɛɛ dɛtse seraa n’enyiwa do,
title: JOHN

text: na ɔsee no dɛ, Kɔ kɔhohor wɔ nsutaae Siloam mu (ne nkyerɛase nye, Nyia wɔasoma no). Na osii mu kɔree kɔhohoree, na ɔbae no nna ohu adze.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi no sɔnmufo nye hɔn a nkan no wohun no dɛ ɔyɛ ohuafo no see no dɛ, Ana nnyɛ oyi na ɔtse hɔ serɛserɛ adze no?
title: JOHN

text: Binom see dɛ, Ɔno nye yi; binom so see dɛ, Dabi, na ɔnye no sɛ; na nankasa dze ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye no.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Wosii dɛn buee w’enyi no?
title: JOHN

text: Obuaa dɛ, Nyimpa a wɔfrɛ no Jesus no yɛɛ dɛtse dze seraa m’enyi do, na ɔsee me dɛ, Kɔ nsutaae Siloam mu kɔhohor; na mokɔree kɔhohoree nna muhu adze yi.
title: JOHN

text: Wobisaa no dɛ, Ɔnoara wɔ hen? Obuaa dɛ, Minnyim.
title: JOHN

text: Wɔdze nyia nkan no ɔyɛ onyifuranyi no kɛmaa Farisiifo no.
title: JOHN

text: Na da a Jesus yɛɛ dɛtse na obuee n’enyiwa no yɛ ahomgyeda.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi Farisiifo no so bisaa no bio, mbrɛ osii hun adze. Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Dɛtse na ɔdze guu m’enyiwa do, na mohohoree, na muhun adze.
title: JOHN

text: Na Farisiifo no mu binom see dɛ, Nyimpa yi mmfi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, osiandɛ onnsie ahomgyeda; binom so see dɛ, Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na nyimpa dzebɔnyɛnyi botum ayɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze a ɔtse dɛm yi? Na mpaapaamu baa hɔn mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔsee onyifuranyi no bio dɛ, Na ɔwo dze, eka dɛn wɔ no ho, dɛ obuee w’enyiwa? Ɔsee dɛ, Ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo no anngye no ho asɛm no enndzi, dɛ nkyɛ ɔyɛ onyifuranyi na afei ohu adze, dze kodur dɛ wɔfrɛɛ nyia ohun adze no n’awofo.
title: JOHN

text: Na wobisaa hɔn dɛ, Ana hom ba a hom se wɔwoo no onyifuranyi no nye yi? Afei ɔyɛ dɛn na ohu adze yi?
title: JOHN

text: N’awofo no buaa hɔn dɛ, Yenyim dɛ hɛn ba nye yi, yenyim so dɛ wɔwoo no onyifuranyi;
title: JOHN

text: na mbrɛ ɔyɛe na afei ohu adze yi dze, yennyim; na nyimpa kor a obuee n’enyiwa no so, yennyim; ɔnoara oenyin; hom mbisa no, na nankasa bɛka noara asɛm.
title: JOHN

text: N’awofo kaa yi, osiandɛ wosuroo Jewfo no, nna Jewfo no apam dada dɛ, sɛ obi paa mu ka dɛ ɔno nye Kraest no a, wɔbɛpam no efi nhyiamudan mu.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi na n’awofo kaa dɛ, Oenyin: hom mbisa no no.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔfrɛɛ nyimpa a nkan no ɔyɛ onyifuranyi no ne mpɛn ebien, na wɔsee no dɛ, Fa enyimnyam ma Nyankopɔn, na hɛn dze, yenyim dɛ nyimpa yi yɛ dzebɔnyɛnyi.
title: JOHN

text: Na obuaa dɛ, Sɛ ɔyɛ dzebɔnyɛnyi a, minnyim. Adze kor na minyim, dɛ nkyɛ meyɛ onyifuranyi, na afei dze muhu adze.
title: JOHN

text: Wɔsee no dɛ, Ɔyɛɛ wo dɛn? Oduaa dɛn buee w’enyiwa?
title: JOHN

text: Obuaa hɔn dɛ, Maka akyerɛ hom dada, na hom enntsie; ebɛnadze ntsi na hom repɛ etsie bio? Ana hom so pɛ dɛ hom dan n’esuafo anaa?
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔyaw no na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔwo na eyɛ no suanyi, na hɛn dze, Moses esuafo nye hɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Yenyim dɛ Nyankopɔn akasa akyerɛ Moses, na oyi dze, yennyim mbrɛ ofi.
title: JOHN

text: Nyimpa no buae see hɔn dɛ, Iyi mu na ɔyɛ nwanwa, dɛ hom nnyim mbrɛ ofi, naaso obuee m’enyiwa.
title: JOHN

text: Yenyim dɛ Nyankopɔn nntsie ndzebɔnyɛfo, na sɛ obi yɛ Nyankopɔn no somfo na ɔyɛ n’apɛdze a, ɔno na otsie no.
title: JOHN

text: Ofitsi dɛ wiadze hyɛɛ ase wɔnntsee dɛ obi ebue nyia wɔawo no onyifuranyi no n’enyiwa pɛn:
title: JOHN

text: sɛ oyi mmfi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn a, nkyɛ orunntum nnyɛ hwee.
title: JOHN

text: Wobuae see no dɛ, Ɔwo, bɔn mu koraa na wɔwoo wo, nna ɔwo na erekyerɛkyerɛ hɛn yi? Na wɔpaam no fii hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus tsee dɛ wɔapam no efi edzi, na ohun no no, obisaa no dɛ, Ana egye Nyankopɔn Ba no dzi?
title: JOHN

text: Na obuae see no dɛ, Mo wura, ɔno nye woana, ma mengye no mindzi?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Ehu no na eso nyia ɔnye wo rekasa yi nye ɔno.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔsee no dɛ, Mo wura, megye midzi; na ɔkotowee sɔɔr no.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus see dɛ, Atsɛmbu ntsi na mebaa wiadze yi mu: ma hɔn a wonnhu adze no woeehu, na hɔn a wohu adze no wɔaadan enyifurafo.
title: JOHN

text: Na Farisiifo no mu bi a wɔnye no wɔ hɔ tsee nsɛm yi, na wɔsee dɛ, Aso hɛn so yɛyɛ enyifurafo?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ hom yɛ enyifurafo a, nkyɛ hom nnyi bɔn; na afei hom se dɛ, Yehu adze: ntsi na hom bɔn aka hɔ no.
title: JOHN

text: Mereka akyerɛ hom wɔ nokwar mu dɛ, Nyia onndua abowano nnkɔ nguambuw no mu, na ɔfow fa beebi no, ɔyɛ owifo nye odwotwafo;
title: JOHN

text: na nyia odua abowano kɔ mu no nye nguan no hwɛfo.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔno na abowanohwɛfo no bue ma no, na nguan no tse ne ndze, na ɔbɔ nankasa no nguan dzin frɛ hɔn, na ɔdze hɔn pue.
title: JOHN

text: Na sɛ ɔdze nankasa no nguan nyina pue a, odzi hɔn enyim, na nguan no dzi n’ekyir, osiandɛ wonyim ne ndze.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔnana dze, worinndzi n’ekyir, na woboguan efi ne nkyɛn, osiandɛ wonnyim anana ndze.
title: JOHN

text: Abɛbusɛm yi na Jesus kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn, na hɔn dze, woennhu asɛm kor a Jesus reka kyerɛ hɔn no.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi Jesus see hɔn bio dɛ, Mereka no nokwar mu akyerɛ hom dɛ, emi nye nguan no abow no.
title: JOHN

text: Hɔn a wodzii me kan bae no nyina yɛ ewifo nye edwotwafo; naaso nguan no enntsie hɔn.
title: JOHN

text: Emi nye abow no; emi na sɛ obiara nam mo do kɔ mu a, wɔbɛgye no nkwa, na ɔbɔkɔ mu bopue, na obenya edzidzibea.
title: JOHN

text: Owifo no mmba gyedɛ orubowia, na oeku, na ɔasɛɛ; emi dze, mebae ma woeenya nkwa, na woeenya no mbordo.
title: JOHN

text: Emi nye oguanhwɛfo pa no: oguanhwɛfo pa no dze no nkwa to hɔ ma nguan no.
title: JOHN

text: Naaso ɔpaanyi no a ɔnnyɛ oguanhwɛfo a nguan no yɛ nankasa nedze no, ohu dɛ pataku reba a, ogya nguan no hɔ na oguan; na pataku no ba bɔtotɔr hɔn na ɔbɔ hɔn petse.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔpaanyi guan, osiandɛ ɔyɛ ɔpaanyi na ɔnndwen nguan no ho.
title: JOHN

text: Emi nye oguanhwɛfo pa no: minyim medze, na medze nyim me,
title: JOHN

text: dɛ mbrɛ Egya no nyim me na emi so minyim Egya no. Na medze mo nkwa to hɔ ma nguan no.
title: JOHN

text: Na mowɔ nguan bi so a wommfi ban yi mu; hɔn so otwar dɛ medze hɔn meba, na wobetsie me ndze, na wɔaayɛ kuw kor nye oguanhwɛfo kor.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi na Egya no dɔ me, osiandɛ medze mo nkwa to hɔ na maafa no bio.
title: JOHN

text: Obi nngye no me nsamu; na mbom mankasa na medze to hɔ: mowɔ tum dɛ medze to hɔ, na mowɔ tum dɛ mefa no bio. Ahyɛdze yi na minyaa no m’Egya hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na mpaapaamu bi baa Jewfo no mu bio wɔ asɛm yi ntsi.
title: JOHN

text: Na hɔn mu pii see dɛ, Ɔwɔ abɔnsam, na ɔabɔ dam: ɔyɛ dɛn na hom ritsie no?
title: JOHN

text: Binom see dɛ, Iyi nnyɛ nyia ɔwɔ abɔnsam ne nsɛm a. Aso abɔnsam botum ebue onyifuranyi enyiwa anaa?
title: JOHN

text: Nna asɔrfi ne ntsewho afahyɛ no edu wɔ Jerusalɛm: na awɔwber so aba.
title: JOHN

text: Nna Jesus nenam asɔrfi no mu wɔ Solomon abrandaa no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo no botwae hyiaa no, na wɔsee no dɛ, Ebɛma hɛn enyi ada kwan ekesi dabɛn bio? Sɛ ɔwo nye Kraest no a, ka kyerɛ hɛn pefee.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Maka akyerɛ hom, na hom nngye nndzi; ndwuma a menam m’Egya ne dzin do meyɛ no, ɔnoara na odzi me dase.
title: JOHN

text: Na hom dze, hom nngye me nndzi, osiandɛ hom mmfi mo nguan mu.
title: JOHN

text: Mo nguan tsie me ndze, na minyim hɔn, na wodzi m’ekyir:
title: JOHN

text: na mema hɔn onnyiewiei nkwa, na wɔrennhera da, eso obi runnhwim hɔn wɔ me nsamu.
title: JOHN

text: M’Egya a ɔdze hɔn ama me no, ɔyɛ kɛse kyɛn adze nyina na obi nnkotum ehwim hɔn m’Egya ne nsamu.
title: JOHN

text: Emi nye Egya no yɛ kor.
title: JOHN

text: Jewfo no faa abo bio dɛ wɔdze besiw no.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Ndwuma pa pii na mifi m’Egya nkyɛn dze akyerɛ hom: ndwuma yi mu dza ɔwɔ hen ntsi na hom ribesiw me abo yi?
title: JOHN

text: Jewfo no buaa dɛ, Nnyɛ edwuma pa bi ntsi na yeribesiw wo abo, na ebususɛm ntsi a; osiandɛ ɔwo a eyɛ nyimpa yi, eyɛ woho Nyankopɔn ntsi a.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Ana wɔnnkyerɛwee wɔ hom mbra mu dɛ, Mekaa dɛ hom yɛ enyame?
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ ɔfrɛɛ hɔn a Nyankopɔn asɛm baa hɔn hɔ no enyame a, na kyerɛwsɛm no so wonntum nnsan no,
title: JOHN

text: ana hom tum ka wɔ nyia Egya no etu no esi hɔ na ɔasoma no wiadze no ho dɛ, Eka ebususɛm; osiandɛ mekaa dɛ, Emi nye Nyankopɔn Ba ntsi?
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ mennyɛ m’Egya ndwuma a, mma hom nngye me nndzi;
title: JOHN

text: na sɛ meyɛ a, kaansa hom nngye emi ara nndzi mpo a, hom ngye ndwuma no ndzi, ama hom aatse ase na hom eehu dɛ Egya no wɔ mo mu na mo so mowɔ no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔhwehwɛɛ bio dɛ wɔkyer no, na ofii hɔn nsamu kɔree.
title: JOHN

text: Na osii mu kɔr Jordan egya noho bio, mbrɛ nkan no nna John runuma no; na ɔkɛtsenaa hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na dodowara baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔsee dɛ, John dze, ɔannyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze biara: na dza John kae wɔ oyi ho nyina yɛ nokwar.
title: JOHN

text: Na dodowara gyee no dzii wɔ hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Nna ɔyarfo bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Lazarus a ofi Bɛtani, Mary nye no nuabaa Martha hɔn kurow mu.
title: JOHN

text: Mary a ɔdze ngohuam seraa Ewuradze na ɔdze ne tsinhwi pepaa n’anan ho no na no nuabanyin Lazarus yaree no.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi ne nkyerɛbaa no somae baa Jesus hɔ bɛsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, hwɛ, nyia edɔ no no yar.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus tsee no ɔsee dɛ, Yarba yi nnyɛ wuyarba, na Nyankopɔn enyimnyam ntsi a, ama wɔnam do aahyɛ Nyankopɔn Ba no enyimnyam.
title: JOHN

text: Nna Jesus dɔ Martha nye no nuabaa nye Lazarus,
title: JOHN

text: naaso ber a ɔtsee dɛ ɔyar no ɔtsenaa mbrɛ ɔwɔ no ara ndaenu.
title: JOHN

text: Nna n’ekyir no, ɔsee n’esuafo no dɛ, Hom mma yɛnkɔ Judea bio.
title: JOHN

text: Esuafo no see no dɛ, Rabae, ɔnnkyɛree biara na Jewfo no hwehwɛɛ wo dɛ wobesiw wo abo, na erokɔ hɔ bio yi?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa dɛ, Ana nnyɛ ndɔnhwer duebien na ɔwɔ adzekyee mu? Sɛ obi nam ewia a, ommfintsiw, osiandɛ ohu wiadze yi kan no.
title: JOHN

text: Na sɛ obi nam anadwe a, ofintsiw, osiandɛ kan nnyi no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔkaa yinom ekyir no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hɛn nyɛnko Lazarus ada, na morokɔ mekenyan no.
title: JOHN

text: Na esuafo no see no dɛ, Ewuradze, sɛ ɔada dze a, nna obenya nkwa.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus dze, ɔkaa no wɔ no wu ho, na hɔn dze, wosusuu dɛ eregye w’ahom wɔ nda mu ho asɛm na ɔreka.
title: JOHN

text: Nna Jesus kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn pefee dɛ, Lazarus ewu;
title: JOHN

text: na ɔyɛ me dɛw wɔ hom ntsi dɛ minnyi hɔ, ama hom aagye edzi: naaso hom mma yɛnkɔ ne nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Na Tomas a wɔfrɛ no Ata no see ne mfɛfo esuafo no dɛ, Hom mma hɛn so yɛnye no nkɔ na yɛnye no eewu.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus bae no obohun dɛ Lazarus edzi ndaanan wɔ nda no mu dada.
title: JOHN

text: Eso nna Bɛtani bɛn Jerusalɛm ho bɛyɛ akwansin ebien.
title: JOHN

text: Nna Jewfo pii aba Martha nye Mary nkyɛn dɛ wɔrebɛma hɔn hyɛ dzen wɔ hɔn nua no ntsi.
title: JOHN

text: Martha tsee dɛ Jesus reba no, ɔkɔree kehyiaa no; na Mary dze, ɔkɔr do araa tsenaa fie hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na Martha see Jesus dɛ, Ewuradze, sɛ ewɔ ha a, nkyɛ mo nuabanyin ennwu.
title: JOHN

text: Na seseiara mpo, minyim dɛ biribiara a ibebisa Nyankopɔn no, Nyankopɔn dze bɛma wo.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Wo nuabanyin bɔsoɛr bio.
title: JOHN

text: Martha see no dɛ, Minyim dɛ da a odzi ekyir wunyan no mu, ɔbɔsoɛr.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Emi nye wunyan no nye nkwa no: nyia ɔgye me dzi no, owu mpo a, ɔbɛtsena ase,
title: JOHN

text: na obiara a ɔtse ase na ɔgye me dzi no, onnkowu da. Ana egye iyi dzi?
title: JOHN

text: Ɔsee no dɛ, Nyew, Ewuradze, magye edzi dɛ ɔwo nye Kraest no, Nyankopɔn Ba no a ɔreba wiadze no.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔkaa dɛm no, osii mu kɔree kɛfrɛɛ no nuabaa Mary nsumaa mu dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo no aba, na ɔfrɛ wo.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔno so tsee no, ɔsoɛɛr ntsɛmara na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Nna Jesus nnyae mmbaa kurow no mu, na ɔwɔ mbrɛ Martha kehyiaa no hɔ no.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo a wɔnye no wɔ fie rekyekye no werɛ no hun Mary dɛ ɔasoɛr ntsɛm epue no, wodzii n’ekyir, nna wosusu dɛ ɔrokɔ nda no do ekosu wɔ hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na Mary dze, odur mbrɛ Jesus wɔ no, na ohun no no, ɔhwee n’ananadze see dɛ, Ewuradze, sɛ ewɔ ha a, nkyɛ mo nuabanyin ennwu.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus hun dɛ orusu na Jewfo a wɔnye no bae no so rusu no, osii nkrum wɔ no sunsum mu na ɔyɛɛ no awerɛhow,
title: JOHN

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Hom dze no ato hen? Wɔsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, bra bɔhwɛ.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus sui.
title: JOHN

text: Nna Jewfo no see dɛ, Hwɛ mbrɛ osi dɔ no.
title: JOHN

text: Na hɔn mu binom see dɛ, Oyi a obuee onyifuranyi no enyiwa no, oenntum amma dɛ nkyɛ oyi so orunnwu anaa?
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus sii nkrum wɔ no mu bio, na ɔbaa nda no do: ɔbodan a, nna ɔbo hin ano.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see dɛ, Hom nyi ɔbo no. Nyia owui no nuabaa Martha see no dɛ, Ewuradze, sesei dze ɔasɛɛ, na oedzi ndaanan.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Ana mannse wo dɛ, sɛ egye dzi a, ibohu Nyankopɔn enyimnyam?
title: JOHN

text: Na woyii ɔbo no. Na Jesus maa n’enyiwa do na ɔsee dɛ, Egya, meda wo ase dɛ itsie me:
title: JOHN

text: na emi dze, minyim dada dɛ itsie me daa, na nyimpadodow a wogyinagyina ho yi ntsi na mesee dɛm, ama wɔaagye edzi dɛ ɔwo na esomaa me.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔkaa dɛm no, ɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu dɛ, Lazarus, pue bra!
title: JOHN

text: Nyia owui no puei bae: nna nda mu atam kyekyer ne nan nye ne nsa, na duukuu kyekyer n’enyim: na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom nsan no, na hom mma ɔnkɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo no mu pii a wɔbaa Mary nkyɛn na wohun dza Jesus yɛe no, wɔgyee no dzii;
title: JOHN

text: na hɔn mu binom sii mu kɔr Farisiifo nkyɛn kɛkaa dza Jesus yɛe no kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: JOHN

text: Na asɔfompanyin nye kyerɛwfo no maa wokehyiaa baguafo no, na wɔsee dɛ, Yɛreyɛ dɛn, na nyimpa yi reyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze pii yi?
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ yegyaa no dɛm a, nyimpa nyina bɛgye no edzi, na Romefo afa hɛn bea nye hɛn man yi.
title: JOHN

text: Na hɔn mu baako bi, Kaiafas a odzi afe noara mu sɔfopanyin, see hɔn dɛ, Hom nnyim hwee,
title: JOHN

text: na eso hom nndwen dɛ oye ma hɛn dɛ nyimpa kor bowu ama ɔman no, na ɔman no nyina aannhyew a.
title: JOHN

text: Na iyi, nnyɛ nankasa na ɔkae, na odzi afe noara mu sɔfopanyin ntsi, ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm dɛ Jesus rubowu ama ɔman no,
title: JOHN

text: na nnyɛ ɔman no nko ntsi, na dɛ ɔrebɛka Nyankopɔn mba a wɔapetse nyina so abɔ mu ayɛ kor.
title: JOHN

text: Na ofitsi da no ara wɔfaa apam dɛ woboku no.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi Jesus annantsew petee wɔ Jewfo no mu bio; na ofii hɔ kɔr asaase a ɔbɛn sar no ho no do, wɔ kurow a wɔfrɛ no Efraim mu, na ɔnye n’esuafo kɛtsenaa hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo apaho no abɛn, na dodowara fiir asaase no do kɔr Jerusalɛm ansaana apaho no edu dɛ worukoguar hɔnho.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔhwehwɛɛ Jesus, na wogyinaa asɔrfi no mu sesee hɔnho dɛ, Hom dwen dɛn? Ɔremmba afahyɛ yi ase anaa?
title: JOHN

text: Nna asɔfompanyin no nye Farisiifo no ahyɛ mbra dɛ, obi nyim mbrɛ ɔwɔ a, ɔnkɛkyerɛ ma wɔnkyer no.
title: JOHN

text: Afei aka nda esia ma apaho no edu no, Jesus baa Bɛtani, mbrɛ Lazarus a onyaan no fii ewufo mu no wɔ no.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔtoo no pon wɔ hɔ, na Martha somee, na Lazarus dze, ɔyɛ hɔn a wɔnye no tsenaa edzidzi no mu baako.
title: JOHN

text: Na Mary faa ngohuam krɔngyenn a no bo yɛ dzen na no dur nkeriibo kor dze bɛseraa Jesus n’anan ho, na ɔdze no nhwi pepaa n’anan ho; na ngo no no huam hyɛɛ dan no ma.
title: JOHN

text: Na n’esuafo no mu baako, Judas Iskariot a oribeyi no ama no, see dɛ,
title: JOHN

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn na wɔanntɔn ngohuam yi anngye sika denare ahaebiasa, na wɔammfa amma ehiafo?
title: JOHN

text: Ɔkaa iyi no, nnyɛ dɛ ɔdwen ehiafo ho ntsi a, na osiandɛ ɔyɛ owifo, na ɔno nna okitsa kotoku no, na ɔfefa dza wɔdze gu mu no.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus see dɛ, Hom ngyaa no: ɔayɛ yi dze ama me sie da no;
title: JOHN

text: na ehiafo dze, hom wɔ hɔn hom nkyɛn daa, na emi dze, hom nnyi me daa.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo mu nyimpadodow no tsee dɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na wɔbae, nnyɛ Jesus ntsi nko, na dɛ wobohu Lazarus so a onyaan no fii ewufo mu no.
title: JOHN

text: Na asɔfompanyin no faa apam dɛ woboku Lazarus so,
title: JOHN

text: osiandɛ ne ntsi na Jewfo pii rokɔ na wɔrekɛgye Jesus edzi.
title: JOHN

text: Adze kyee no nyimpadodow pii a wɔbaa afahyɛ no ase no tsee dɛ Jesus reba Jerusalɛm no,
title: JOHN

text: wɔfefaa berɛw na wopuei dɛ worikehyia no kwan, na wɔtseatseaa mu dɛ, Hosanna! Nhyira nye nyia ɔnam Ewuradze dzin mu reba no, Israel Hen no a!
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus hun asoasopɔnkɔba bi no, ɔtsenaa no do dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ,
title: JOHN

text: Mma nnsuro, Sion babaa. Hwɛ, wo Hen reba, ɔtse asoasopɔnkɔba do!
title: JOHN

text: Iyinom n’esuafo no anntse ase kan no, na wɔhyɛɛ Jesus enyimnyam no, nna wɔkaa dɛ wɔakyerɛw yinom wɔ no ho, na wɔayɛ ama no.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyimpadodow a wɔnye no wɔ hɔ na ɔfrɛɛ Lazarus fiir nda mu na onyaan no fii ewufo mu no dzii dase.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi ntsi na nyimpadodow no kehyiaa no kwan, osiandɛ wɔtsee dɛ wɔayɛ dɛm nsɛnkyerɛdze yi.
title: JOHN

text: Na Farisiifo no kae wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, Hom hu dɛ hom nnya hwee: hwɛ, wiadze etu edzi n’ekyir.
title: JOHN

text: Na Griikfo bi wɔ hɔn a wɔaba dɛ wɔrobɔsɔr wɔ afahyɛ no ase no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Woyi na wɔbaa Filip a ofi Bɛtsaeda a ɔwɔ Galilii ne nkyɛn, na wobebisaa no dɛ, Owura, yɛpɛ dɛ yehu Jesus.
title: JOHN

text: Filip bae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ Andrew, na Andrew nye Filip bɛkaa kyerɛɛ Jesus.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Dɔn no edu a wɔbɛhyɛ nyimpa Ba no enyimnyam.
title: JOHN

text: Meka no nokwar mu kyerɛ hom dɛ, sɛ ewifua anntɔ famu ennwu a, no nko na ɔda hɔ; na sɛ owu a, ɔsow aba pii.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia ɔdɔ no nkwa no, ɔyew no, na nyia ɔtan no nkwa wɔ wiadze yi mu no, ɔbɔkora no akɔ onnyiewiei nkwa mu.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ obi som me a, ma ondzi m’ekyir, na mbrɛ mowɔ no, hɔ na mo somfo so bɛba; sɛ obi som me a, ɔno na m’Egya no bedzi no nyi.
title: JOHN

text: Afei me kra ho guan no, na menka dɛn? Egya, gye me fi dɔn yi mu? Naaso iyi ntsi na mebaa dɔn yi mu.
title: JOHN

text: Egya, hyɛ wo dzin enyimnyam. Na ndze bi fi sor bae dɛ, Mahyɛ no enyimnyam dada, na mebɛhyɛ no bio.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyimpadodow a wogyinagyina hɔ tsee no, wɔkaa dɛ ɔsenaman abɔ mu; binom see dɛ, Ɔbɔfo akasa akyerɛ no.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buae see dɛ, Nnyɛ emi ntsi na ndze yi bae, na hom ntsi a.
title: JOHN

text: Afei nye wiadze atsɛmbu; afei na wobotu wiadze hen yi adze do.
title: JOHN

text: Na emi dze, sɛ wonya ma mo do fi asaase do a, mobɔtwe nyimpa nyina aba me nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Na iyi dze ɔkae dze kyerɛɛ owu kor a orubowu.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyimpadodow no buaa dɛ, Yɛatse wɔ mbra no mu dɛ Kraest no tse hɔ daa, na ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔwo dze ese dɛ otwar dɛ wɔma nyimpa Ba do yi? Woana nye nyimpa Ba yi?
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Aka aber kakra na kan no wɔ hom mu: ber a hom wɔ kan no, hom nnantsew na sum no aammbɔto hom; na nyia ɔnantsew sum mu nnyim mbrɛ ɔrokɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Ber a hom wɔ kan no, hom ngye kan no ndzi, na hom aayɛ kan mba. Iyinom na Jesus kae na ofii hɔ dze noho kosumaa hɔn.
title: JOHN

text: Nna ɔayɛ dɛm nsɛnkyerɛdze pii yi wɔ hɔn enyim dze, naaso wɔanngye no enndzi,
title: JOHN

text: ma Isaia nkɔnhyɛnyi n’asɛm a ɔkae no aaba mu dɛ, Ewuradze, woana agye hɛn asɛnkaa edzi? Woana na woeyi Ewuradze abasa akyerɛ no?
title: JOHN

text: Iyi ntsi na woenntum anngye enndzi, osiandɛ Isaia ka bio dɛ,
title: JOHN

text: Oefura hɔn enyiwa, na oepirim hɔn akoma, ama wɔaammfa hɔn enyiwa ennhu na wɔaammfa hɔn akoma anntse ase na wɔaanndan hɔnho, na maannsa hɔn yarba.
title: JOHN

text: Iyinom Isaia hun n’enyimnyam ntsi na ɔkae, na ɔkaa no ho asɛm.
title: JOHN

text: Naaso mpanyimfo no so mu pii gyee no dzii. Na osian Farisiifo no ntsi wɔammpaa mu annka, amma woeennyi hɔn edzi emmfi nhyiamudan mu;
title: JOHN

text: na wɔdɔɔ nyimpa enyimnyam seen Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus tseaa mu see dɛ, Nyia ɔgye me dzi, nnyɛ emi na ɔgye me dzi, na nyia ɔsomaa me no a.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyia ohu me no, ohu nyia ɔsomaa me no.
title: JOHN

text: Maba wiadze dɛ kan, ma obiara a ɔgye me dzi no aanntsena sum mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na sɛ obi tse me nsɛm na ɔammfa ennsie a, emi dze, mummbu no atsɛn; na mammba dɛ murubobu wiadze atsɛn, na mbom dɛ merebɛgye wiadze nkwa.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia ɔpow me, na ɔnngye me nsɛm no, ɔwɔ nyia obu no atsɛn: asɛm no a mekae no, ɔnoara na obobu no atsɛn wɔ da a odzi ekyir no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Osiandɛ emi dze, mannhyɛ moho annkasa, na Egya no a ɔsomaa me no, ɔno na ɔahyɛ me wɔ dza menka ho na ɔhyɛ me ma mekasa.
title: JOHN

text: Na minyim dɛ ne mbrasɛm yɛ onnyiewiei nkwa, ntsi dza meka no, mbrɛ Egya no akasa akyerɛ me no, dɛmara na meka.
title: JOHN

text: Na ansaana apaho afahyɛ no rubodu no, Jesus nyim dɛ no dɔn edu dɛ oribefi wiadze yi mu akɔ Egya nkyɛn no, ɔdɔɔ nankasa nedze a wɔwɔ wiadze no, ɔdɔɔ hɔn kesii ewiei.
title: JOHN

text: Na woridzidzi no, na abɔnsam enya dze ahyɛ Judas Iskariot, Simon ne ba no, n’akoma mu dɛ onkeyi no mma,
title: JOHN

text: na Jesus nyim dɛ Egya no dze ndzɛmba nyina ahyɛ ne nsa, na dɛ ofi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn bae, na ɔrokɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no,
title: JOHN

text: ɔsoɛree fiir edzidzi na oyii ne ntar guu nkyɛn, na ɔfaa entuho bɔɔ n’asen do.
title: JOHN

text: Na afei ohuee nsu guu guarsɛn mu, na ɔhyɛɛ ase hohoor n’esuafo no anan ho, na ɔdze entuho no a ɔbɔ n’asen no pepae.
title: JOHN

text: Na obodur Simon Peter do. Na Peter see no dɛ, Ewuradze, ɔwo rohohor emi m’anan ho?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa no dɛ, Dza mereyɛ yi, sesei dze enntse ase, na daakye na ibohu.
title: JOHN

text: Peter see no dɛ, Ennkɔhohor m’anan ho da! Jesus buaa no dɛ, Sɛ mannhohor wo ho a, innyi m’afa.
title: JOHN

text: Simon Peter see no dɛ, Ewuradze, nnyɛ m’anan nko, na me nsa nye me tsir ho so.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Nyia oeguar no nnhia eguar bio, gyedɛ n’anan ho hohor, na no ho nyina efir. Na hom ho efir, na mbom nnyɛ hom nyina.
title: JOHN

text: Nna onyim nyia oribeyi no ama: dɛm ntsi na ɔsee dɛ, Nnyɛ hom nyina na hom ho efir no.
title: JOHN

text: Na owiee hɔn anan ho hohor, na ɔfaa n’atar na ɔtweer hɔ bio no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ehu dza mayɛ hom yi?
title: JOHN

text: Hom frɛ me Kyerɛkyerɛfo nye Ewuradze, na hom ka no yie, osiandɛ meyɛ dɛm so.
title: JOHN

text: Na sɛ emi, Kyerɛkyerɛfo nye Ewuradze, mahohor hom anan ho a, hom so ɔsɛ dɛ hom hohor hom anan ho nkorkor.
title: JOHN

text: Na mama hom mfatoho, ama hom so aayɛ dɛ mbrɛ mayɛ hom yi.
title: JOHN

text: Mese hom nokwar mu dɛ, akowaa nnkyɛn no wura, eso ɔsomafo nnkyɛn nyia ɔsomaa no no.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ hom nyim yinom na hom dzi do a, nhyira aka hom.
title: JOHN

text: Mennka no wɔ hom nyina ho: minyim hɔn a mapa hɔn; na dɛ kyerɛw no bɛba mu dɛ, Nyia ɔnye me dzidzi no na ɔama n’anantsir do etsia me no.
title: JOHN

text: Afei mereka akyerɛ hom ansaana aba mu, na sɛ ɔba mu a, hom aagye edzi dɛ emi nye no.
title: JOHN

text: Mese hom nokwar mu dɛ, Nyia ɔgye obiara a mosoma no no, ɔgye me; na nyia ɔgye me no, ɔgye nyia ɔsomaa me no.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus kaa dɛm no, no sunsum ho guaan no, na ɔgyee dase dɛ, Mereka no nokwar mu akyerɛ hom dɛ, Hom mu baako beyi me ama.
title: JOHN

text: Esuafo no hwehwɛɛ hɔn enyim nkorkor, naaso woennhu nyimpa kor a ɔrekyerɛ.
title: JOHN

text: Nna esuafo no mu baako a Jesus dɔɔ no no twer no bo mu.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi Simon Peter too ne nsa dɛ ombisa nyia ɔreka no ho asɛm no.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔpae tweer Jesus no bo mu no obisaa no dɛ, Ewuradze, woana a?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa dɛ, Ɔno nye nyia medze trɔma bɔbɔ mu ama no no. Na ɔdze trɔma no bɔɔ mu no, ɔdze maa Judas Iskariot, Simon ne ba no.
title: JOHN

text: Na trɔma no ekyir no, nna Satan kɛhɛɛn no mu. Na Jesus see no dɛ, Dza ereyɛ no, yɛ no ntsɛm.
title: JOHN

text: Na hɔn a wɔtsetse pon no ho mu biara ennhu dza osian ntsi ma ɔsee no dɛm.
title: JOHN

text: Na binom dween dɛ Judas kitsa kotoku no ntsi na Jesus see no dɛ, Kɔtotɔ dza ohia hɛn sie afahyɛ no, anaadɛ ɔmfa biribi mma ehiafo.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔno dze, ɔgyee trɔma no, ntsɛmara na opuei; nna ɔyɛ anafua.
title: JOHN

text: Na opuei no, Jesus see dɛ, Afei wɔahyɛ nyimpa Ba no enyimnyam, na wɔahyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na Nyankopɔn so bɛhyɛ no enyimnyam wɔ nankasa no mu, na ɔbɛhyɛ no enyimnyam ntsɛm.
title: JOHN

text: Mbofra nkakramba, aka kakrabaabi na menye hom wɔ hɔ: hom bɔhwehwɛ me, na dɛ mbrɛ mesee Jewfo no dɛ, Mbrɛ morokɔ no, hom runntum hɔ ba no, dɛmara na mese hom so sesei.
title: JOHN

text: Mbrasɛm fofor na medze ma hom, dɛ hom ndodɔ homho nkorkor: dɛ mbrɛ madɔ hom no, hom so ndodɔ homho dɛmara.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔnam iyi do na nyimpa nyina bohu dɛ hom yɛ m’esuafo, sɛ hom wɔ ɔdɔ ma homho nkorkor a.
title: JOHN

text: Simon Peter see no dɛ, Ewuradze, erokɔ hen? Jesus buaa dɛ, Mbrɛ morokɔ no irunntum mo do ka sesei, na ekyir no dze, ebɛka mo do.
title: JOHN

text: Peter see no dɛ, Ewuradze, ebɛnadze ntsi na murunntum wo do ka sesei: medze mo nkwa bɔto hɔ ama wo.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus bisaa no dɛ, Edze wo nkwa bɔto hɔ ama me? Meka no wɔ nokwar mu kyerɛ wo dɛ, Akokɔ rommbɔn mpo na apa me mprɛnsa.
title: JOHN

text: Mma hom akoma nntutu: hom ngye Nyankopɔn ndzi, hom ngye mo so ndzi.
title: JOHN

text: M’egya fie wɔ tsenabew pii; sɛ ɔnntse dɛm a, nkyɛ maka akyerɛ hom. Morokɔ ekesiesie beebi mama hom.
title: JOHN

text: Na sɛ mokɔ, na mikesiesie beebi ma hom a, mebɛba bio mabɛfa hom akɔ mankasa me nkyɛn, na mbrɛ mowɔ no, hom so aaba hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na mbrɛ morokɔ no, hom nyim kwan no.
title: JOHN

text: Tomas see no dɛ, Ewuradze, yennyim mbrɛ erokɔ, na yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ehu kwan no?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Emi nye ɔkwan no, nokwar no, nye nkwa no; obi mmba Egya no hɔ, gyedɛ ɔnam mo do.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ hom enya ehu me a, nkyɛ hom ehu m’Egya no so; na ofitsi ndɛ hom nyim no, na hom ehu no.
title: JOHN

text: Filip see no dɛ, Ewuradze, kyerɛ hɛn Egya no na ɔnoara dɔɔ so ma hɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Ana menye hom wɔ hɔ dadaada yi, innyim me, Filip? Nyia oehu me no, oehu Egya no; na ɔyɛ dɛn na ese dɛ, Kyerɛ hɛn Egya no?
title: JOHN

text: Ana enngye nndzi dɛ mowɔ Egya no mu, na Egya no so wɔ mo mu? Nsɛm a meka kyerɛ hom yi, mennhyɛ moho meka, na Egya no a ɔtse mo mu no, ɔno na ɔyɛ ndwuma no.
title: JOHN

text: Hom ngye me ndzi dɛ mowɔ Egya no mu, na Egya no so wɔ mo mu; na annyɛ dɛm a, ndwuma noara ntsi hom ngye me ndzi.
title: JOHN

text: Mese hom nokwar mu dɛ, Nyia ɔgye me dzi no, ndwuma a meyɛ no, no so bɛyɛ, na dza ɔkyɛn yinom mpo na ɔbɛyɛ, osiandɛ morokɔ Egya no hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na biribiara a hom bɛserɛ wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔno na mebɛyɛ, ama Egya no eenya enyimnyam wɔ Ba no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ hom serɛ biribi wɔ me dzin mu a, mebɛyɛ.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ hom dɔ me a, hom ndzi me mbransɛm do.
title: JOHN

text: Na mibebisa Egya no, na ɔama hom Okyigyinafo fofor, ma ɔnye hom aabɛtsena daa:
title: JOHN

text: nokwar Sunsum no a: ɔno na wiadze nntum nngye no; osiandɛ onnhu no, na eso onnyim no: na hom dze, hom nyim no; osiandɛ ɔtse hom nkyɛn, na ɔbɛtsena hom mu.
title: JOHN

text: Mirinngya hom ngyanka, mebɛba hom nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Aka kakrabaabi na wiadze nnhu me bio, na hom dze, hom hu me; osiandɛ metse ase yi, hom so bɛtsena ase.
title: JOHN

text: Da no hom bohu dɛ mowɔ m’Egya no mu na hom wɔ no mu, na mo so mowɔ hom mu.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia ɔwɔ me mbransɛm na odzi do no, ɔno nye nyia ɔdɔ me, na nyia ɔdɔ me no, m’Egya bɔdɔ no, na mo so mobɔdɔ no, na mibeyi moho makyerɛ no.
title: JOHN

text: Judas (nnyɛ Iskariot bi a) see no dɛ, Ewuradze, ebɛn asɛm na aba, na iribeyi woho akyerɛ hɛn na nnyɛ wiadze yi?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buae see no dɛ, Sɛ obi dɔ me a, obesie m’asɛm: na m’Egya bɔdɔ no, na yɛbɛba ne nkyɛn, na yɛbɛyɛ hɛn tsenabew wɔ ne nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia ɔnndɔ me no, onnsie me nsɛm: na asɛm a hom tse yi, ɔnnyɛ medze, na ɔyɛ Egya no a ɔsomaa me no dze.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm nsɛm yi na maka akyerɛ hom, ber a metse hom nkyɛn yi.
title: JOHN

text: Na Okyigyinafo no a ɔyɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no a Egya no bɔsoma no wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔno na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ hom ndzɛmba nyina: ɔbɛkaa hom dza maka akyerɛ hom nyina.
title: JOHN

text: Asomdwee na medze gya hom; mara m’asomdwee na medze mema hom: nnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ wiadze ma, na mema hom. Mma hom akoma nntutu, eso mma ɔmmbɔ hu.
title: JOHN

text: Hom tsee mbrɛ mekaa kyerɛɛ hom dɛ morokɔ na maba hom nkyɛn no. Sɛ hom dɔ me a, nkyɛ hom bedzi dɛw dɛ morokɔ Egya no hɔ, osiandɛ Egya no so sen me.
title: JOHN

text: Na afei maka akyerɛ hom ansaana aba mu, ama sɛ ɔba mu a, hom aagye edzi.
title: JOHN

text: Menye hom nnkɛkasa pii bio, na wiadze hen no reba, na onnyi mo do tum biara.
title: JOHN

text: Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma wiadze eehu dɛ modɔ Egya no, na dɛ mbrɛ Egya no hyɛɛ me no, dɛmara na meyɛ. Hom nsoɛr ma yemfi ha nkɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Emi nye nokwar wenyindua no, na m’Egya nye okuafo no.
title: JOHN

text: Mo ho abaw biara a ɔnnsow aba no, oyi no; na biara a ɔsow aba no, oyiyi ho ma ɔaasow aba pii.
title: JOHN

text: Hom ho atsew dada wɔ asɛm a maka akyerɛ hom no ntsi:
title: JOHN

text: hom ntsena mo mu, na mo so mentsena hom mu. Dɛ mbrɛ abaw nntum mmfi noara no mu nnsow aba, gyedɛ ɔtsena wenyindua no mu no, dɛmara so na hom runntum, gyedɛ hom tsena mo mu.
title: JOHN

text: Emi nye wenyindua no; hom nye abaw no: nyia ɔtse mo mu, na metse no mu no, ɔnoara na ɔsow aba pii; sɛ hom kwetsi me a, hom nnkotum ayɛ hwee.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ obi anntsena mo mu a, wotwa no kyen dɛ abaw, na ɔkyenkyen, na wɔboaboa ano kogu gya mu, na ɔhyew.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ hom tsena mo mu, na me nsɛm tsena hom mu a, hom mbisa biribiara a hom pɛ, na wɔbɛyɛ ama hom.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi mu na wɔahyɛ m’Egya enyimnyam, dɛ hom sow aba pii, na hom bɛyɛ m’esuafo.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛ mbrɛ Egya no dɔ me no, na mo so madɔ hom: hom ntsena mo dɔ mu.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ hom sie me mbransɛm a, hom bɛtsena mo dɔ mu, dɛ mbrɛ mo so mesie m’Egya ne mbransɛm na metsena no dɔ mu.
title: JOHN

text: Maka yinom akyerɛ hom ama me dɛw aatsena hom mu, na hom dɛw aahyɛ ma.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi nye me mbrasɛm, dɛ hom ndodɔ homho nkorkor, dɛ mbrɛ madɔ hom.
title: JOHN

text: Obi nnyi dɔ a ɔso kyɛn iyi, dɛ obi dze no nkwa bɔto hɔ ama n’anyɛnkofo.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ hom yɛ dza mehyɛ hom a, hom yɛ m’anyɛnkofo.
title: JOHN

text: Mennda ho mmfrɛ hom nkowaa, osiandɛ akowaa nnyim dza no wura yɛ; na mafrɛ hom anyɛnkofo, osiandɛ ndzɛmba a metsee no m’Egya hɔ nyina makyerɛ hom mu.
title: JOHN

text: Nnyɛ hom bi na hom yii me, na emi na miyii hom, na medze hom sii hɔ dɛ hom nkɔ nkɔsow aba, ma hom aba aatsena hɔ, na biribiara a hom bɛserɛ Egya no wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔdze aama hom.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi na mehyɛ hom, dɛ hom ndodɔ homho.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ wiadze tan hom a, hom nyim dɛ ɔatan me ansaana ɔretan hom.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ hom fi wiadze mu a, nkyɛ wiadze bɔdɔ nankasa nedze; na osiandɛ hom mmfi wiadze, na miyii hom fii wiadze mu ntsi, na wiadze tan hom.
title: JOHN

text: Hom nkaa asɛm no a mesee hom no, Akowaa nnkyɛn no wura. Sɛ wohiahiaa mo ho a, wobehiahia hom so ho; sɛ wosiee m’asɛm a, wobesie homdze bi.
title: JOHN

text: Na yinom nyina me dzin ntsi na wɔdze bɛyɛ hom, osiandɛ wonnyim nyia ɔsomaa me no.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ mammba mammbɛkasa annkyerɛ hɔn a, nkyɛ wonnyi bɔn; na afei dze, wonnyi hɔn bɔn do nkatado.
title: JOHN

text: Nyia ɔtan me no, ɔtan m’Egya so.
title: JOHN

text: Sɛ mannyɛ wɔ hɔn mu ndwuma a obiara annyɛ bi da a, nkyɛ wonnyi bɔn; na afei woehu na wɔatan emi nye m’Egya so.
title: JOHN

text: Na iyi aba mu ma dza wɔakyerɛw no hɔn mbra mu no aahyɛ ma dɛ, Wɔatan me kwa.
title: JOHN

text: Na Okyigyinafo no a mibefi Egya no nkyɛn masoma no hom hɔ no, nokwar Sunsum a ofir Egya no mu no, sɛ onya ba a, ɔno na obedzi mo ho dase.
title: JOHN

text: Na hom so dzi me dase, osiandɛ hom fitsi ahyɛse ka mo ho.
title: JOHN

text: Maka iyinom akyerɛ hom amma hom eemmfintsiw.
title: JOHN

text: Wobeyi hom edzi efi nhyiamudan mu mpo: dɔn no reba a obiara a oboku hom bɔdwen dɛ ɔdze rosom Nyankopɔn.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔbɛyɛ iyinom osiandɛ wonnyim Egya no, anaaso emi.
title: JOHN

text: Na maka iyinom akyerɛ hom, ama sɛ dɔn no ba a, hom aakaa dɛ mekaa kyerɛɛ hom dɛm. Na ahyɛse no mannka iyinom annkyerɛ hom, osiandɛ nna menye hom wɔ hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na afei dze, morokɔ nyia ɔsomaa me no nkyɛn; naaso hom mu biara mmbisa me dɛ, Erokɔ hen?
title: JOHN

text: Na osiandɛ maka iyinom akyerɛ hom ntsi, awerɛhow ahyɛ hom akoma ma,
title: JOHN

text: naaso dza mereka yi yɛ nokwasɛm, dɛ oye ma hom dɛ mokɔ, osiandɛ sɛ mannkɔ a, Okyigyinafo remmba hom nkyɛn, na sɛ mokɔ a, mobɔsoma no wɔ hom nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔno na sɛ ɔba a, obeyi wiadze atsɛn wɔ bɔn nye tsenenee nye atsɛmbu ho:
title: JOHN

text: bɔn ho, osiandɛ wɔnngye me nndzi;
title: JOHN

text: tsenenee ho, osiandɛ morokɔ Egya no nkyɛn, na hom nnkohu me bio;
title: JOHN

text: atsɛmbu ho, osiandɛ woebu wiadze hen atsɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Mowɔ nsɛm pii ka kyerɛ hom, na hom runntum nngye no sesei.
title: JOHN

text: Na sɛ ɔno, nokwar Sunsum no, nya ba a, obegya hom kwan akɔ nokwar nyina mu: na ɔnnkɛhyɛ nankasa noho akasa, na biribiara a ɔbɛtse na ɔbɛka, na dza ɔreba so ɔbɛkyerɛ hom.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔno na ɔbɛhyɛ me enyimnyam, osiandɛ ɔbɛfa dza ɔyɛ medze no bi na ɔdze abɛkyerɛ hom.
title: JOHN

text: Dza Egya no wɔ nyina yɛ medze: iyi ntsi na mesee dɛ, Ɔbɛfa dza ɔyɛ medze no bi na ɔdze abɛkyerɛ hom.
title: JOHN

text: Aka kakra na hom nnhu me, na bio aka kakra na hom bohu me, osiandɛ morokɔ Egya no nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Na n’esuafo no binom kekae wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, Ebɛn asɛm na ɔreka kyerɛ hɛn yi? Aka kakra na hom nnhu me; na bio aka kakra na hom bohu me: na, Osiandɛ morokɔ Egya no nkyɛn?
title: JOHN

text: Na esuafo no see dɛ, Ebɛn asɛm na ɔreka yi, Aka kakra? Yennyim dza ɔreka.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus hun dɛ wɔrepɛ ebisa no no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana iyi ho na hom ribisabisa wɔ hom mu dɛ mesee dɛ, Aka kakra na hom nnhu me, na bio aka kakra na hom bohu me yi?
title: JOHN

text: Mese hom wɔ nokwar mu dɛ, Hom bosu na hom edzi nkɔmbɔ, na wiadze edzi dɛw; hom dze, hom werɛ bɔhow, naaso hom awerɛhow bɛdan enyigye.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔbaa roko awoo a, onya awerɛhow, osiandɛ no dɔn edu; na sɛ onya wo ba no a, ɔnnkaa n’ahoguan no bio, wɔ ne dɛw a odzi dɛ wɔawo nyimpa aba wiadze ntsi.
title: JOHN

text: Na hom so sesei dze, hom enya awerɛhow; na mubohu hom bio, na hom akoma bedzi dɛw, na hom dɛw no obi renngye no hom nsamu.
title: JOHN

text: Na da no hom nnkebisa me hwee. Ampa, meka kyerɛ hom dɛ, Biribiara a hom bɛserɛ Egya no wɔ me dzin mu no, ɔdze bɛma hom.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔdze bodu sesei hom nnserɛɛ hwee wɔ me dzin mu: hom nserɛ na hom benya, ma hom dɛw aahyɛ ma.
title: JOHN

text: Maka iyinom akyerɛ hom wɔ mbɛbu mu. Dɔn no reba a mennkɛkasa akyerɛ hom wɔ mbɛbu mu bio, na maka Egya no ho asɛm akyerɛ hom petee.
title: JOHN

text: Da no hom bɛserɛ wɔ me dzin mu. Mennka nnkyerɛ hom dɛ mibebisa Egya no ama hom;
title: JOHN

text: na Egya no ankasa dɔ hom, osiandɛ hom adɔ me na hom agye edzi dɛ mifi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn mebae.
title: JOHN

text: Mifi Egya no nkyɛn na mebaa wiadze; bio meredan wiadze egya na makɔ Egya no nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: N’esuafo no see no dɛ, Hwɛ, afei ekasa pefee, na nnyɛ abɛbu mu a.
title: JOHN

text: Afei yenyim dɛ inyim ndzɛmba nyina, na onnhia wo dɛ obi bisa wo: iyi mu na yɛgye dzi dɛ ifi Nyankopɔn nkyɛn bae.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Afei hom gye dzi?
title: JOHN

text: Hwɛ, dɔn no reba na oenya edu a hom nyina bɛpetse akɔ homankasa homdze mu, na hom adan mo nko egya, naaso ɔrennka mo nko, osiandɛ Egya no wɔ me nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Maka iyinom akyerɛ hom ama hom eenya asomdwee wɔ mo mu. Wiadze mu dze, hom wɔ ahohiahia mu naaso hom mma hom akoma ntɔ hom yamu: osiandɛ medzi wiadze do konyim.
title: JOHN

text: Iyinom na Jesus kae na ɔmaa n’enyi do kɔr sor na ɔsee dɛ, Egya, dɔn no edu: hyɛ wo Ba enyimnyam, ma Ba no so nhyɛ wo enyimnyam,
title: JOHN

text: dɛ mbrɛ emaa no tum wɔ honam nyina do, dɛ biribiara a edze ama no no, ɔmma hɔn onnyiewiei nkwa no.
title: JOHN

text: Na iyi nye onnyiewiei nkwa, dɛ wobohu ɔwo, nokwar Nyame kor no, nye nyia esomaa no, mekyerɛ Jesus Kraest.
title: JOHN

text: Muwiee edwuma a edze ama me dɛ menyɛ no na mehyɛɛ wo enyimnyam wɔ asaase do;
title: JOHN

text: na afei, Egya, fa enyimnyam a mowɔ no wɔ wo nkyɛn ansaana wiadze bɔɔ adze no hyɛ me enyimnyam wɔ wankasa wo nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Miyii wo dzin edzi kyerɛɛ nyimpa a edze hɔn fi wiadze maa me no. Wɔyɛ wodze, na edze hɔn maa me, na woesie m’asɛm.
title: JOHN

text: Afei woehu dɛ ndzɛmba a edze ama me nyina fi wo hɔ;
title: JOHN

text: osiandɛ nsɛm a edze maa me no, medze ama hɔn, na hɔn so gyee na wohun ampa dɛ mifi wo nkyɛn mebae, na wɔgyee dzii dɛ ɔwoara na esomaa me.
title: JOHN

text: Mibisa ma hɔn: mimmbisa mma wiadze, na hɔn a edze hɔn ama me a, osiandɛ wɔyɛ wodze.
title: JOHN

text: Na m’adze nyina yɛ wodze, na wodze so yɛ emi medze, na wɔahyɛ me enyimnyam wɔ hɔn mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na afei minnyi wiadze bio, na yinom wɔ wiadze, na emi dze, mereba wo nkyɛn. Egya Krɔnkrɔn, fa hɔn sie wo dzin a edze ama me no mu, ama wɔaayɛ kor dɛ hɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Mowɔ hɔn nkyɛn no, medze hɔn siei wɔ wo dzin a edze ama me no mu: na moweɔɔn hɔn, na hɔn mu biara annyew, gyedɛ ɔyera ba no, ama kyerɛwsɛm no aaba mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na afei dze, mereba wo nkyɛn, na meka yinom wɔ wiadze ama woeenya me dɛw no ma wɔaahyɛ ma wɔ hɔn mu.
title: JOHN

text: Medze w’asɛm ama hɔn, na wiadze taan hɔn, osiandɛ wommfi wiadze dɛ mbrɛ mo so mimmfi wiadze.
title: JOHN

text: Mimmbisa dɛ yi hɔn fi wiadze, na mbom dɛ yi hɔn fi bɔn no ho sie.
title: JOHN

text: Wommfi wiadze dɛ mbrɛ mo so mimmfi wiadze.
title: JOHN

text: Tsew hɔn ho wɔ nokwar no mu: w’asɛm yɛ nokwar.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo somaa me wiadze no, dɛmara na mo so mosomaa hɔn wiadze.
title: JOHN

text: Na hɔn ntsi metsew moho, ama hɔn so hɔn ho aatsew nokwar mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na nnyɛ yinom nkotsee ntsi na mibisa, na hɔn a wɔnam hɔn asɛm do gye me dzi no so ntsi bi,
title: JOHN

text: ama hɔn nyina aayɛ kor, dɛ mbrɛ ɔwo, Egya, ewɔ mo mu, na mowɔ wo mu, hɔn so waayɛ kor wɔ hɛn mu, na wiadze aagye edzi dɛ ɔwo na esomaa me.
title: JOHN

text: Na enyimnyam a edze ama me no, medze ama hɔn, dɛ wɔnyɛ kor dɛ mbrɛ yɛyɛ kor;
title: JOHN

text: na emi mentsena hɔn mu, na wo so ntsena mo mu, na woeewie kor yɛ, na wiadze eehu dɛ ɔwo na esomaa me, na mbrɛ edɔɔ me no, edɔɔ hɔn so dɛmara.
title: JOHN

text: Egya, dza edze ama me no, mepɛ dɛ mbrɛ mowɔ no, hɔn so bɛka mo ho na woeehu m’enyimnyam a edze ama me no, osiandɛ edɔɔ me ansaana wɔrehyɛ wiadze ase.
title: JOHN

text: Egya Tsenenee, wiadze ennhu wo, na emi dze, muhun wo, na yinom hun dɛ ɔwo na esomaa me.
title: JOHN

text: Na miyii wo dzin kyerɛɛ hɔn, eso mibeyi akyerɛ hɔn, ama ɔdɔ a edze dɔɔ me no aatsena hɔn mu, na mo so maatsena hɔn mu.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus kaa iyinom no, ɔnye n’esuafo no puei kotwaa ɔwora Kidron, mbrɛ ture bi wɔ, na ɔnye n’esuafo no kɔr mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na Judas so a oriyi no ama no so nyim hɔ, osiandɛ Jesus nye n’esuafo no tɔɔ dɛ wokehyia hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na Judas faa asafo no nye asomfo a wofi asɔfompanyin nye Farisiifo no nkyɛn no, ɔbaa hɔ, wokitsakitsa nkandzea nye atsɛn nye akodze.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus nyim dza ɔreba no do nyina no, opuei kebisaa hɔn dɛ, Hom rohwehwɛ woana?
title: JOHN

text: Wobuaa no dɛ, Jesus Nazarɛtnyi no a. Jesus buaa hɔn dɛ, Emi nye no. Nna Judas a oriyi no ama no so nye hɔn gyina hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Emi nye no no, wɔdze hɔn ekyir hɔn ekyir kɔhwee daadze.
title: JOHN

text: Na obisaa hɔn bio dɛ, Hom rohwehwɛ woana? Na wɔsee dɛ, Jesus Nazarɛtnyi no a.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa dɛ, Mekaa kyerɛɛ hom dɛ emi nye no; dɛm ntsi sɛ emi na hom rohwehwɛ me a, hom mma iyinom nkɔ;
title: JOHN

text: ama asɛm no a ɔkaa dɛ, Hɔn a edze hɔn ama me no mannyew mu biara no, aaba mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na Simon Peter a nna ɔdze afona no twee, na ɔdze bɔɔ ɔsɔfopanyin no n’akowaa, na otwaa n’asowa nyimfa; na akowaa no ne dzin dze Malkus.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus see Peter dɛ, Fa nkrantsee no hyɛ bɔha no mu: kɔɔpow a m’Egya dze ama me no, mma monnom anaa?
title: JOHN

text: Na asafo no nye safohen no ɔnye Jewfo asomfo no faa Jesus na wɔkyekyeer no,
title: JOHN

text: na wɔdze no dzii kan kɔr Annas nkyɛn, osiandɛ Kaiafas a odzi afe no mu sɔfopanyin no n’asew nye no.
title: JOHN

text: Na Kaiafas nye nyia ɔmaa Jewfo no apam dɛ oye dɛ nyimpa baako bowu ama ɔman no no.
title: JOHN

text: Na Simon Peter nye osuanyi baako dzii Jesus ekyir, na ɔsɔfopanyin no nyim osuanyi no, na ɔnye Jesus kɛhɛɛn ɔsɔfopanyin aban mu hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na Peter dze, ogyinaa abow no ano guado. Na osuanyi no a ɔsɔfopanyin no nyim no no puei bɛkasaa kyerɛɛ abowanohwɛfo no na ɔdze Peter baa dan mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na abaawa abowanohwɛfo no see Peter dɛ, Ana wo so immfi nyimpa yi n’esuafo no mu? Peter see dɛ, Mimmfi mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na nkowaa no nye asomfo no gyinagyina hɔ a wɔdze biriw abɔ gya, osiandɛ awɔw aba, na wɔroto gya; nna Peter so gyina hɔ roto gya.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔsɔfopanyin no bisaa Jesus n’esuafo nye ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ho asɛm.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa no dɛ, Makasa petee akyerɛ wiadze; daa mekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ nhyiamudan nye asɔrfi mu, mbrɛ Jewfo nyina hyia, na mannka hwee nsumaa mu.
title: JOHN

text: Emi dze, ɔyɛ dɛn na ibisa me? Bisa hɔn a wɔtsee asɛm kor a mekaa kyerɛɛ hɔn: hwɛ, hɔn na wonyim dza mekae.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔkasaa dɛm no, asomfo a wogyina hɔ no mu baako bɔɔ Jesus sotɔr see no dɛ, Mbrɛ ibua ɔsɔfopanyin nye yi?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa no dɛ, Sɛ maka bɔn a, gye bɔn no ho dase, na sɛ oye a, ɔyɛ dɛn na ebɔ me?
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi Annas somaa no nkyehoma mu kɔr Kaiafas ɔsɔfopanyin no hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Nna Simon Peter gyina hɔ roto gya. Na wɔsee no dɛ, Ana ɔwo so immfi n’esuafo no mu? Ɔsanee na ɔsee dɛ, Mimmfi mu.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔsɔfopanyin no no nkowaa mu baako a ɔyɛ nyia Peter twaa n’asowa no no busuanyi no see no dɛ, Ana mennhu wo wɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ ture no mu?
title: JOHN

text: Na Peter saan bio; na ntsɛmara akokɔ bɔnee.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔdze Jesus fii Kaiafas nkyɛn kɔr ambrado aban mu; nna ahanamakye a, na hɔnara dze wɔannhɛn ambrado aban mu hɔ, amma hɔn ho eenngu fi na woeedzi apaho (edziban) no.
title: JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi Pilate puei baa hɔn nkyɛn na obisaa dɛ, Ebɛn sombo na hom dze bɔ dɛm nyimpa yi?
title: JOHN

text: Wobuaa no dɛ, Sɛ oyi nnyɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi a, nkyɛ yɛammfa no ammbrɛ wo.
title: JOHN

text: Na Pilate see hɔn dɛ, Homara hom mfa no, na hom nkobu no atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ hom mbra tse. Jewfo no see no dɛ, Hɛn dze, yennyi ho kwan dɛ yeku obiara;
title: JOHN

text: ma Jesus n’asɛm a ɔkae dze kyerɛɛ owu kor a orubowu no aaba mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na Pilate hɛɛn ambrado aban mu bio, na ɔfrɛɛ Jesus na ɔsee no dɛ, Ana ɔwo nye Jewfo hen no?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa no dɛ, Wankasa reka yi, anaa binom kaa no mo ho kyerɛɛ wo?
title: JOHN

text: Pilate buaa dɛ, Ana emi meyɛ Jewnyi a? Wankasa wo mamfoo nye asɔfompanyin no na wɔdze wo brɛɛ me. Ebɛnadze na eyɛe?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus buaa dɛ, M’ahendzi mmfi wiadze yi mu: sɛ m’ahendzi fi wiadze yi mu a, nkyɛ m’asomfo bɔko, amma wɔaammfa me annhyɛ Jewfo nsa; na afei m’ahendzi mmfi ha.
title: JOHN

text: Pilate see no dɛ, Nna eyɛ ɔhen nye no? Jesus buaa dɛ, Ɔwoara aka dɛ meyɛ ɔhen: iyi ntsi na wɔwoo me, iyi ntsi na mebaa wiadze, ama maabɛgye nokwar no ho dase. Obiara a ofi nokwar no mu no, otsie me ndze.
title: JOHN

text: Pilate see no dɛ, Nokwar nye ebɛnadze? Na ɔsee dɛm no, opuei kɔr Jewfo no hɔ bio, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Emi dze, munnhu afɔdzi biara wɔ no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na hom wɔ atɔrmuadze dɛ apaho no mu migyaa nyimpa baako ma hom: dɛm ntsi, hom pɛ dɛ migyaa Jewfo hen no ma hom anaa?
title: JOHN

text: Na hɔn nyina tseaa mu bio dɛ, Nnyɛ oyi a, na Barabbas a, naaso Barabbas yi yɛ odwotwafo.
title: JOHN

text: Na afei Pilate faa Jesus na ɔkaa no mpire.
title: JOHN

text: Na nsordaafo no bɔɔ nsoɛ abɔtsir na wɔdze hyɛɛ ne tsir, na wɔdze tam memen bi furaa no,
title: JOHN

text: na wopimpiin ne nkyɛn bɛsee no dɛ, Jewfo Hen no aba oo! Na wɔbobɔɔ no asotɔr.
title: JOHN

text: Na Pilate puei bio, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hwɛ, medze no pue brɛ hom, ama hom eehu dɛ munnhu afɔdzi biara wɔ no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus puei bae, nna ɔhyɛ nsoɛ abɔtsir nye atar memen no, na Pilate see hɔn dɛ, Hwɛ, nyimpa no nye yi!
title: JOHN

text: Na asɔfompanyin no nye asomfo no hun no no, wɔtseatseaa mu dɛ, Bɔ no mbeamudua mu, bɔ no mbeamudua mu! Pilate see hɔn dɛ, Homankasa hom mfa no nkɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu, na emi dze, munnhu afɔdzi biara wɔ no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Jewfo no buaa no dɛ, Yɛwɔ mbra, na hɛn mbra ntsi otwar dɛ owu, osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ noho Nyankopɔn ne Ba.
title: JOHN

text: Na Pilate tsee asɛm yi no, osuroo dodoodow,
title: JOHN

text: na ɔkɔr aban no mu bio, na ɔsee Jesus dɛ, Ifi hen? Na Jesus emmbua no.
title: JOHN

text: Na Pilate see no dɛ, Ennkasa mo ho? Innyim dɛ mowɔ tum dɛ mobɔ wo mbeamudua mu, na mowɔ tum dɛ migyaa wo anaa?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Sɛ woemmfi sor ammfa amma wo a, nkyɛ innyi mo do tum biara. Dɛm ntsi, nyia oyii me maa wo no, ɔayɛ bɔn kɛse no ara.
title: JOHN

text: Na ofitsi hɔ no, Pilate hwehwɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ ogyaa no, naaso Jewfo no tseaa mu dɛ, Sɛ igyaa oyi a, na ennyɛ Kaesar no dɔfo: obiara a ɔyɛ noho ɔhen no ɔnye Kaesar dzi esi.
title: JOHN

text: Na Pilate tsee nsɛm yi no, ɔdze Jesus puei, na ɔbɛtsenaa atsɛmbu egua no do, wɔ beebi mbrɛ wɔfrɛ no Abonsɛwee no, na Hebriw kasa mu dze, wɔfrɛ no Gabata.
title: JOHN

text: Nna ɔyɛ apaho ne nsiesie da, na ɔbɛyɛ ewiaber duebien: na ɔsee Jewfo no dɛ, Hwɛ, hom Hen nye yi!
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔtseaa mu dɛ, Fa no kɔ, fa no kɔ, bɔ no mbeamudua mu! Pilate see hɔn dɛ, Mombɔ hom Hen mbeamudua mu? Asɔfompanyin no buaa no dɛ, Yennyi ɔhen biara dɛ Kaesar.
title: JOHN

text: Na afei oyii no maa hɔn dɛ wɔnkɔbɔ no mbeamudua mu. Na wɔfaa Jesus dze no kɔree.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔso ne mbeamudua puei bodur beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Nyitsirbea a Hebriw mu wɔfrɛ no Golgota.
title: JOHN

text: Hɔ na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu, na beenu kaa no ho, afa ha kor, afa ha kor, na Jesus wɔ finimfin.
title: JOHN

text: Na Pilate kyerɛɛw ho asɛm so, na ɔdze faam mbeamudua no etsifi, na kyerɛw no nye dɛ, JESUS NAZARƐTNYI, JEWFO HEN NO.
title: JOHN

text: Na kyerɛw yi Jewfo pii kenkanee, osiandɛ mbrɛ wɔbɔɔ Jesus mbeamudua mu no ɔbɛn kurow no, na wɔkyerɛwee wɔ Hebriw nye Griik nye Romefo kasaa mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jewfo asɔfompanyin no see Pilate dɛ, Mma nnkyerɛw dɛ Jewfo Hen, na dɛ ɔno kaa dɛ, Emi nye Jewfo Hen.
title: JOHN

text: Pilate buaa dɛ, Dza makyerɛw no, makyerɛw.
title: JOHN

text: Na nsordaafo no bɔɔ Jesus mbeamudua mu no, wɔfaa ne ntar no na wɔkyɛɛ mu anan, ma sordaanyi baako nyaa kor, ɔnye n’atar nhyɛase so. Na n’atar nhyɛase no, onnyi mpamee, na wɔawen fi sor pem ase.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔsesee hɔnho dɛ, Mma hom mma yennsunsuan mu, na hom mma yɛntwe ho tonto nhwɛ nyia ɔbɛyɛ nedze; ama kyerɛw no a ɔka dɛ, Wɔkyɛɛ me tam mu maa hɔnho, Na m’atar so wɔtwee ho tonto no, aaba mu. Na nsordaafo no yɛɛ iyinom.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus ne na, ɔnye ne na no nua Mary a ɔyɛ Klopas yer, ɔnye Mary Magdalene gyina Jesus ne mbeamudua ho.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus hun ne na nye osuanyi a ɔdɔ no no dɛ ogyina hɔ no, ɔsee ne na dɛ, Ɔbaa, hwɛ, wo ba nye yi.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔsee osuanyi no dɛ, Hwɛ, wo na nye yi. Na ofitsi dɔn no ara mu na osuanyi no faa no kɔr nankasa ne fie.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi ekyir no Jesus nyim dɛ woenya ewie ndzɛmba nyina (mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma kyerɛw no aaba mu) ntsi, ɔsee dɛ, Nsukɔm dze me.
title: JOHN

text: Nna wenyin yerɛyerɛw ehina ma si hɔ, na wɔdze wenyin yerɛyerɛw no bi hyɛɛ sapɔw ma, na wɔdze tuaa odwon dua ano dze kaa n’ano.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus gyee wenyin yerɛyerɛw no, ɔsee dɛ, Mewie! Afei ɔbɔɔ ne tsir adze, na ogyaa no sunsum mu.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔnam dɛ nna ɔyɛ Ahosiesieda ma Jewfo no, na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma efun no nnkɛka mbeamudua no do ahomgyeda no (na eso ahomgyeda no yɛ dapɔn) ntsi, wɔkɛserɛɛ Pilate dɛ wonkobubu hɔn anan mu na wonnyi hɔn mfi hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na nsordaafo no bae bobubuu nyia odzi kan no n’anan mu, ɔnye nyia no so wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no nedze.
title: JOHN

text: Na wodur Jesus do na wohun dɛ oewu dada no, woemmbubu n’anan mu;
title: JOHN

text: na nsordaafo no baako dze peaa wɔɔ ne mfemu, na ntsɛmara na bɔgya nye nsu fii mu bae.
title: JOHN

text: Na nyia oehu no oedzi dase, na ne dasee yɛ nokwar, na ɔno so nyim dɛ ɔka nokwar, na hom so aagye edzi.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔyɛɛ iyinom ma kyerɛw no aaba mu dɛ, Wonnkobu ne biew bi.
title: JOHN

text: Na bio kyerɛw fofor so se, Wɔbɔhwɛ nyia wɔwɔɔ no (peaa) no.
title: JOHN

text: Na iyi ekyir no na Josef a ofi Arimatea a ɔyɛ Jesus no suanyi, na Jewfo ho hu ntsi ɔyɛɛ no nsumaa mu no, bɛserɛɛ Pilate dɛ ɔmma onyi Jesus no fun no, na Pilate maa no ho kwan; na ɔbae bɛfaa Jesus no fun no.
title: JOHN

text: Na Nikodemɔs so a nkan no ɔbaa Jesus hɔ anadwe no, dze eduhuam a wɔfrɛ no mɛɛr nye alɔe mforaforae bɛyɛ nkeriibo pɔɔn ɔha bae.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔfaa Jesus no fun na wɔdze nduhuam no kaa no ho kyekyeer ndwera mu, dɛ mbrɛ Jewfo efunsie tse.
title: JOHN

text: Na eso mbrɛ wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no, ture wɔ hɔ, na ture no mu ɔboda bi wɔ hɔ a wɔmmfaa obiara nntoo mu da.
title: JOHN

text: Na hɔ na Jewfo Ahosiesieda ntsi, na osiandɛ nda no bɛn so ntsi, wɔdze Jesus toe.
title: JOHN

text: Na da a odzi dapɛn no kan no anapatutu a enyim nntsetsewee no, Mary Magdalene baa nda no do, na obohun ɔbo no dɛ woeyi efi nda no ano.
title: JOHN

text: Na otutuu mbirika baa Simon Peter, ɔnye osuanyi baako no a Jesus dɔɔ no no hɔ na ɔsee dɛ, Woeyi Ewuradze efi nda no mu, na yennyim mbrɛ wɔdze no akɔto.
title: JOHN

text: Na Peter nye osuanyi baako no puei kɔr nda no do.
title: JOHN

text: Na hɔn beenu nyina tutuu mbirika: na osuanyi baako no paa Peter ho, na odzii kan baa nda no do.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔbɔɔ no mu adze no, ohun ndwera no dɛ ogu hɔ, naaso ɔannkɔ nda mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na Simon Peter dzii n’ekyir bae, na ɔkɔr nda no mu, na okohun ndwera no dɛ ogu hɔ,
title: JOHN

text: ɔnye duukuu a wɔdze bɔɔ ne tsir no dɛ onngu ndwera no ho, na wɔabobɔw no nko gu nkyɛn beebi.
title: JOHN

text: Na afei osuanyi baako a odzii kan baa nda no do no so kɔr mu, na okohunii, na ɔgyee dzii.
title: JOHN

text: Nna wonnyae nnhun kyerɛw no dɛ otwar dɛ ɔsoɛr fi ewufo mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na esuafo no sii mu kɔr hɔn fie bio.
title: JOHN

text: Naaso nna Mary dze, ogyina nda no do rusu. Na orusu no, ɔbɔɔ no mu adze hwɛɛ nda no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na ohun abɔfo beenu wɔ ntar fufuw mu dɛ wɔtsetse hɔ: ɔbaako tse etsifi, na ɔbaako tse anaafo wɔ beebi a Jesus no fun dae hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Na wobisaa no dɛ, Ɔbaa, ebɛnadze ntsi na irusu yi? Ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Osiandɛ woeyi m’Ewuradze kɔ, na minnyim mbrɛ wɔdze no akɔto.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔsee dɛm no, ɔdaan noho hwɛɛ n’ekyir, na ohun Jesus dɛ ogyina hɔ, naaso nna onnyim dɛ Jesus a.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Ɔbaa, ebɛnadze ntsi na irusu? Erohwehwɛ woana? Na ɔno dze, osusu dɛ ɔno nye turehwɛfo no, ɔsee no dɛ, Mo wura, sɛ ɔwo na afa no efi ha a, kyerɛ me mbrɛ edze no akɔto, na menkɛfa no.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Mary! Na ɔno daan noho see no Hebriw kasa mu dɛ, Raboni! (Ɔnye dɛ, Kyerɛkyerɛfo)
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Mma mmfa wo nsa nnka me, na minnyae monnkɔr sor wɔ m’Egya nkyɛn; na kɔ mo nuanom no nkyɛn kɛse hɔn dɛ, Morobɔkɔ sor wɔ m’Egya nye hom Egya, me Nyankopɔn nye hom Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.
title: JOHN

text: Mary bae bɛsee esuafo no dɛ, Mehu Ewuradze; ɔnye nsɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no no nyina.
title: JOHN

text: Na da a odzi dapɛn no kan no ara ewimbir no, nna ɔnam Jewfo no hɔn ho suro ntsi wɔatotow mbobow mu wɔ mbrɛ esuafo no ehyia no, na Jesus bae begyinaa hɔn finimfin, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Asomdwee nka hom!
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔsee dɛm no, ɔdze ne nsa nye ne mfemu kyerɛɛ hɔn. Na esuafo no hun Ewuradze no, wodzii dɛw.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus see hɔn bio dɛ, Asomdwee nka hom: dɛ mbrɛ Egya no asoma me no, mo so mosoma hom.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔkaa iyi no, oguu ahom guu hɔn do, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ngye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no:
title: JOHN

text: hɔn a hom dze hɔn bɔn kyɛ hɔn no, wɔdze akyɛ hɔn; hɔn a hom ma hɔn bɔn ka hɔ no, wɔama aka hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Nna Tomas, duebien no mu baako a wɔfrɛ no Ata no, onnyi hɔn mu na Jesus bae.
title: JOHN

text: Na esuafo nkaa no see no dɛ, Yeehu Ewuradze! Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Sɛ mennhu ne nsa mu mprɛgow no ananmu, na mammfa me nsatseaba mannka mprɛgow no ananmu, na mammfa me nsa annka ne mfemu a, merenngye nndzi.
title: JOHN

text: Na n’ekyir ndaawɔtwe no, nna esuafo no wɔ dan mu bio, na Tomas ka hɔn ho. Na Jesus bae, nna mbobow no wɔatotow mu; na obegyinaa hɔn finimfin, na ɔsee dɛ, Asomdwee nka hom!
title: JOHN
