text: Na ɔsee Tomas dɛ, Tsen wo nsatseaba bra ha bɔhwɛ me nsamu, na fa wo nsa bɛka me mfemu, na mma nnyɛ okyingyefo, na mbom yɛ gyedzinyi.
title: JOHN

text: Tomas buae see no dɛ, M’Ewuradze nye me Nyankopɔn!
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Tomas, ɔnam dɛ ehu me ntsi, na egye dzi yi? Nhyira aka hɔn a woennhu me eso wɔagye edzi.
title: JOHN

text: Nsɛnkyerɛdze pii so na Jesus yɛe wɔ n’esuafo enyim a wɔnnkyerɛɛw no nwoma yi mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔakyerɛw iyinom ama hom aagye edzi dɛ Jesus nye Kraest no, Nyankopɔn ne Ba no, na hom gye dzi a, hom eenya nkwa wɔ ne dzin mu.
title: JOHN

text: Iyinom ekyir no, Jesus yii noho kyerɛɛ n’esuafo wɔ Tiberias po ho; na mbrɛ oyii noho kyerɛe nye yi.
title: JOHN

text: Simon Peter nye Tomas a wɔfrɛ no Ata nye Nataniel a ofi Kana a ɔwɔ Galilii, nye Zebedee ne mba no nye esuafo no mu beenu so wɔ hɔ.
title: JOHN

text: Simon Peter see hɔn dɛ, Morokɔ po. Wɔsee no dɛ, Hɛn so yɛnye wo bɔkɔ. Na wopuei kɔr hɛn mu; naaso dɛm anadwe no woennya hwee.
title: JOHN

text: Na adze rekye no Jesus begyinaa mpoano, naaso nna esuafo no nnyim dɛ Jesus a.
title: JOHN

text: Na Jesus bisaa hɔn dɛ, Enuanom, ana hom enya nam bi? Wobuaa no dɛ, Oho.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom ntow eboa no ngu hɛn no ne nyimfa na hom benya bi. Na wogui, na nam no dodow ntsi woenntum anntwetwe.
title: JOHN

text: Na osuanyi a Jesus dɔɔ no no see Peter dɛ, Ewuradze a! Na Simon Peter tsee dɛ ɔyɛ Ewuradze no, ɔdze no sortar kyekyeer noho (nna odzi adagyaw) na ɔtoow no ho kyeen po no mu.
title: JOHN

text: Na esuafo nkaa no nam hɛn kakraba mu bae (nna wɔnye famu ntamu nnwar, ɔbɛyɛ basafa ahaenu) na wɔtwetwee eboa no nye nam no.
title: JOHN

text: Na wofii hɛn no mu siaan famu no, wohun ngyansenama a nam gu do nye paanoo.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa nam a hom nyaa no sesei no bi mbra.
title: JOHN

text: Na Simon Peter kɔree kɔtwetwee eboa no baa daadze, nam akɛse ma, ɔha eduonum ebiasa, naaso wɔdɔɔ so dɛm mpo a, eboa no anntsetsew.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see hɔn dɛ, Hom mbɛka hom ano. Esuafo no mu biara enntum emmbisa no dɛ, Woana nye wo; osiandɛ nna wonyim dɛ Ewuradze a.
title: JOHN

text: Jesus bae bɛfaa paanoo no maa hɔn, ɔnye nam no so dɛmara.
title: JOHN

text: Iyi nye ne mpɛn ebiasa a Jesus soɛree fii ewufo mu ekyir no, oyii noho kyerɛɛ n’esuafo.
title: JOHN

text: Na wɔkaa hɔn ano wiei no, Jesus bisaa Simon Peter dɛ, Simon, John ne ba, ana edɔ me sen iyinom? Ɔsee no dɛ, Nyew, Ewuradze, woara inyim dɛ modɔ wo. Jesus see no dɛ, Nyɛn mo nguambaa.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔsee no mpɛn ebien dɛ, Simon, John ne ba, ana edɔ me? Ɔsee no dɛ, Nyew, Ewuradze, woara inyim dɛ modɔ wo. Ɔsee no dɛ, Hwɛ mo nguan.
title: JOHN

text: Ɔsee no bio ne mpɛn ebiasa dɛ, Simon, John ne ba, ana edɔ me? Ɔyɛɛ Peter awerɛhow dɛ ɔsee no mpɛn ebiasa dɛ, Ana edɔ me? Na ɔsee no dɛ, Ewuradze, woara inyim adze nyina: inyim dɛ modɔ wo. Jesus see no dɛ, Nyɛn mo nguan.
title: JOHN

text: Meka no nokwar mu kyerɛ wo dɛ, eyɛ aberantsɛ no, ebɔɔ woho do, na enantseew mbrɛ woara epɛ; na sɛ inya yɛ akɔdaa a, ebɛtsen wo nsa na obi abɔ wo do na ɔdze wo akɔ mbrɛ emmpɛ.
title: JOHN

text: Na ɔkaa yi no, ɔdze kyerɛɛ owu kor a ɔdze rebɛhyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam. Na ɔkaa yi no, ɔsee no dɛ, Ka mo do.
title: JOHN

text: Na Peter daan noho no, ohun osuanyi a Jesus dɔ no no dɛ odzi n’ekyir, ɔno so na ɔtweer no bo mu wɔ edzidziase na obisaa dɛ, Ewuradze, nyia oriyi wo ama no nye woana no?
title: JOHN

text: Ɔno na Peter hun no no ɔsee Jesus dɛ, Ewuradze, na oyi ɛ?
title: JOHN

text: Jesus see no dɛ, Sɛ mepɛ dɛ ɔtsena hɔ kodu dɛ mebɛba a, ɔfa wo ho bɛn? Ɔwo dze, ka mo do.
title: JOHN

text: Na asɛm yi tahyee wɔ enuanom no mu dɛ osuanyi yi runnwu: naaso Jesus annse no dɛ orunnwu, na ɔsee no dɛ, Sɛ mepɛ dɛ ɔtsena hɔ kodu dɛ mebɛba a, ɔfa wo ho bɛn?
title: JOHN

text: Oyi nye osuanyi a odzi yinom ho dase, na ɔkyerɛɛw iyinom no, na yenyim dɛ ne dasee yɛ nokwar.
title: JOHN

text: Na ndzɛmba pii so wɔ hɔ a Jesus yɛe a, sɛ wɔrekyerɛw ne nyina nkorkor a, nkyɛ mohwɛ a nwoma a wɔbɛkyerɛw no ronnkɔ wiadze mu mpo.
title: JOHN

text: Teofilus, medzi kan akyerɛw nsɛm a ɔfa ndzɛmba nyina a Jesus hyɛɛ ase yɛe na ɔkyerɛkyerɛe no ho;
title: ACTS

text: dze kodur da a ɔdze n’ahyɛdze maa n’esuafo a ɔpaa hɔn no wiei no, na wɔnam Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn do wɔfaa no kɔr sor no.
title: ACTS

text: Hɔn so na n’amandzehu ekyir no, oyii noho kyerɛɛ hɔn adaduanan mu mpɛn pii dɛ ɔda ho tse ase dze yɛɛ dasehyɛ, na ɔkyerɛɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn n’ahendzi no ho nsɛm mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔnye hɔn dzii ehyia no, ɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ mma wommfi Jerusalɛm nnkɔ, na mbom wɔntweɔn Egya no n’anohoba no a hom tsee ho asɛm wɔ m’anomu no:
title: ACTS

text: dɛ John dze, ɔdze nsu numae, na hom dze, orinndzi nda dodow biara wɔdze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bonuma hom.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jesus nye hɔn hyiae no, wobisaa no dɛ, Ewuradze, ana ber yi mu ebɛsan dze ahendzi no ama Israel?
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ɔnnyɛ homdze dɛ hom bohu mber anaa mber nkyekyɛmu a Egya no ahyɛ ato hɔ wɔ nankasa no tum mu no.
title: ACTS

text: Na mbom Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no nya ba hom do a, hom benya ahoɔdzen; na hom bɛyɛ m’adasefo wɔ Jerusalɛm, nye Judea nyina, nye Samaria, dze ekodu asaase ano noho.
title: ACTS

text: Na owiee yinom ka, na wɔrohwɛ no no, wɔmaa no do kɔr sor, na mununkum gyee no fii hɔn enyiwa do.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔrokɔ na wɔrohwɛ sor hann no, hwɛ, mbarimba beenu bi hyɛ ntar fufuw begyinaa hɔn nkyɛn,
title: ACTS

text: na wɔkaa dɛ, Galilii mbarimba, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom gyina hɔ rohwɛ sor yi? Jesus yi ara a wɔafa no efi hom nkyɛn kɔ sor yi, ɔbɛba dɛmara dɛ mbrɛ hom ehu dɛ ɔrokɔ sor yi.
title: ACTS

text: Nna wofii koko a wɔfrɛ no Ngo Bepɔw a ɔbɛn Jerusalɛm bɛyɛ da kor kwansin no do sanee baa Jerusalɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na wodur kurow no mu no, wɔkɔr abansor hɔ beebi a wɔtse no: Peter nye John nye James nye Andrew, Filip nye Tomas, Bartholomew nye Matthew, Alfaeus ba James, Simon Zealot no nye James ne ba Judas ka ho.
title: ACTS

text: Yinom nyina dze anokor suoo ntotɔserɛ mpaabɔ mu, wɔnye mbaa bi, nye Jesus ne na Mary, nye no nuanom.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm aber no mu na Peter soɛree gyinaa enuanom bɛyɛ nyimpa ɔha eduonu no finimfin, na ɔsee dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Enuanom, otwar dɛ kyerɛwsɛm a Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no nam David n’anomu asɛm do dzii kan kae wɔ Judas a ɔyɛɛ kwankyerɛfo ma hɔn a wɔkyeer Jesus no ho no, ba mu.
title: ACTS

text: Wɔkaan no kaa hɛn ho, na wɔmaa no ne kyɛfa wɔ ɔsom yi mu.
title: ACTS

text: (Oyi na ɔdze n’emumuyɛ ho akatua nyaa asaase, na ɔwɔɔ akɔmfo, na no mu paae, ma n’ayamudze nyina tui gui;
title: ACTS

text: na hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalɛm nyina tsee, ma dɛm ntsi asaase no wɔfrɛ no hɔnankasa hɔn kasaa mu dɛ, Akeldama: ɔnye dɛ, Bɔgya Asaase no.)
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Ndwom nwoma no mu dɛ, Wɔmma ne tsenabea nyɛ amamfo, Na mma obiara nntsena mu: na, No nhwɛdodwuma no so obi mfa.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi mbarimba a wɔnye hɛn nantsewee wɔ ber a nna Ewuradze Jesus nye hɛn kɔ ba no nyina,
title: ACTS

text: ofitsi John enuma do dze besi da a wɔfaa no hɛn nkyɛn kɔr sor no, otwar dɛ hɔn mu baako nye hɛn yɛ no wunyan no ho adasefo.
title: ACTS

text: Na woyii beenu sii hɔ, Josef a wɔfrɛ no Barsabas a wɔtoo no Justus, nye Mattias.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔsɔree see dɛ, Ɔwo Ewuradze a inyim nyimpa akoma mu, kyerɛ beenu yi mu baako a eyi no
title: ACTS

text: dɛ ɔmfa ɔsom nye asomafodwuma a Judas hwee ase fii ho, ma ɔaakɔ nankasa ne tsenabea mu no, ne fa bi nsom.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtwee hɔnho tonto, na tonto no bɔɔ Mattias; na wɔkaan no foraa asomafo dubiako no.
title: ACTS

text: Ber a Pentekost da no durii no, nna hɔn nyina ehyia fakor.
title: ACTS

text: Na awerɛfir mu ara na dede a ɔtse dɛ mframa a n’ano yɛ dzen a ɔrobɔ fi sor bae, na ɔbɛhyɛɛ dan no a wɔtse mu no nyina ma.
title: ACTS

text: Na ntɛkyerɛma a wɔapaapaa mu a ɔtse dɛ gya yiyii hɔnho kyerɛɛ hɔn, na wobesisii hɔn etsifi nkorkor.
title: ACTS

text: Na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bɛhyɛɛ hɔn nyina amaama, na wɔhyɛɛ ase kasaa kasa fofor dɛ mbrɛ Sunsum no dze maa hɔn dɛ wɔnka.
title: ACTS

text: Nna Jewfo bi, nyimpa nyamesurofo a wofi amanaman a wɔwɔ wiadze nyinara tse Jerusalɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtsee dza ɔrokɔ do no, nyimpadodow bae behyiae, na hɔnho boow hɔn kɛsenara dɛ obiara tse dɛ wɔreka no kurow mu kasa.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nyina ahobow, nye nwanwa, na wɔsesee dɛ, Ana hɔn a wɔrekasa yi nyina nnyɛ Galiliifo bi a?
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔyɛ dɛn na hɛn nyina yɛretse hɛnankasa hɛn kasaa a wɔwoo hɛn wɔ mu yi?
title: ACTS

text: Partiafo nye Mediafo nye Elamfo, nye hɔn a wɔtse Mesopotemia nye Judea nye Kapadosia, Pontus nye Asia,
title: ACTS

text: Frigyia nye Pamfilia, Egypt nye Libiya fa a ɔfa Sirene, nye ahɔho a wofi Rome, Jewfo nye hɔn a wɔadan Jewfo.
title: ACTS

text: Kreetefo nye Arabiafo, yɛtse dɛ wɔdze hɛn kasaa reka Nyankopɔn n’etumdze.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ hɔn nyina ahobow, na hɔn tsirmu yɛɛ hɔn konsee, na wɔsesee hɔnho nkorkor dɛ, Iyi ase nye dɛn?
title: ACTS

text: Na binom sii atwetwe see dɛ, Nsa fofor abow hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter nye dubiako no soɛree gyinae, na ɔmaa ne ndze do see hɔn dɛ, Judea mbarimba, nye hom a hom tse Jerusalɛm nyina, hom nhyɛ iyi nsew, na hom ntsie m’asɛm a mereka yi wɔ aso pa mu.
title: ACTS

text: Woyinom mmbobowee, dɛ mbrɛ hom susu yi, osiandɛ adzekyee mu anapa ndɔnkron nye yi;
title: ACTS

text: na iyi nye dza nkɔnhyɛnyi Joel kae no:
title: ACTS

text: Nyankopɔn se, Ɔbɛba dɛ nda a odzi ekyir no mu no, Mubohue mo Sunsum egu honam nyina do: Na hom mbabanyin nye hom mbabaa bɛhyɛ nkɔm, Na hom mberantsɛ bohu enyido adzehu, Na hom nkɔdaa bɔsoso adaa:
title: ACTS

text: Na mpo mo nkowaa nye mo mfonabaa so do, na nda no mu mubohue mo Sunsum egu na wɔbɛhyɛ nkɔm.
title: ACTS

text: Na mebɛma anwanwadze aba wienyi wɔ sor, Nye nsɛnkyerɛdze wɔ asaase yi do ase; Bɔgya nye gya nye wusiw kumbɔɔ;
title: ACTS

text: Ewia bɛdan sum, Na bosoom adan bɔgya, Ansaana Ewuradze n’enyimnyam da kɛse no aba.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ obiara a ɔbɔbɔ Ewuradze ne dzin no, wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
title: ACTS

text: Israel mbarimba, hom ntsie nsɛm yi: Jesus Nazarɛtnyi no, ɔbarimba a Nyankopɔn dze tum ndwuma nye anwanwadze nye nsɛnkyerɛdze a ɔnam no do yɛe wɔ hom mu yii no kyerɛɛ hom, dɛ mbrɛ homankasa so hom nyim no.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔno na, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn ahyehyɛ ato hɔ na onyim dada no, dze no maa hom, na hom faa no, na hom nam hɔn a wɔnnka mbra nsa do bɔɔ no mbeamudua mu kum no no.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔno na Nyankopɔn nyaan no, ɔasan owuyaw no, osiandɛ ɔnnkɛyɛ yie dɛ owu botum aka no ahyɛ.
title: ACTS

text: Na David ka wɔ no ho dɛ, Muhun Ewuradze wɔ m’enyim daa, Osiandɛ ɔwɔ me nsa nyimfa, amma meennhihim:
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi m’akoma tɔɔ me yamu, na me tɛkyerɛma dzii dɛw, Na mo honam so bɔhom enyidado mu;
title: ACTS

text: Osiandɛ irinngyaa me kra wɔ samanadze, eso eremma wo Krɔnkrɔnnyi no nhu mprɔwee.
title: ACTS

text: Akyerɛ me nkwa akwan no: Edze w’enyim bɛma enyigye amee me.
title: ACTS

text: Enuanom, mowɔ ho kwan dɛ meka egyapanyin David ho asɛm kofee kyerɛ hom, dɛ oewu na woesie no, na ne nda wɔ hɛn nkyɛn ha dze bodu ndɛ.
title: ACTS

text: Na dɛ ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi na onyim dɛ Nyankopɔn aka ntam akyerɛ no dɛ n’asefo mu bi na ɔbɛma ɔatsena n’ahengua do ntsi,
title: ACTS

text: ohunii siei, na ɔkaa Kraest no wunyan ho asɛm dɛ oenngyaa ne kra wɔ samanadze, eso no honam ennhu mprɔwee.
title: ACTS

text: Jesus yi na Nyankopɔn nyaan no, na hɛn nyina yɛ ho adasefo.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei wɔdze Nyankopɔn abanyimfa maa no do no, na onyaa Egya no hɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no anohoba no ntsi na oehue dza hom ruhu na hom retse yi egu.
title: ACTS

text: Na David ammfow sor, naaso ɔnoara ka dɛ, Ewuradze see mo wura dɛ, Tsena m’abanyimfa,
title: ACTS

text: Kodu dɛ medze w’atamfo bɛyɛ w’ananadzegua.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi, wɔmma Israel fie nyina nhu ampa dɛ Jesus yi a hom bɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no, ɔno na Nyankopɔn ayɛ no Ewuradze nye Kraest.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtsee nsɛm no hɔn akoma mu wowɔɔ hɔn, na wɔsee Peter nye asomafo nkaa no dɛ, Enuanom, yɛnyɛ dɛn?
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter see hɔn dɛ, Hom nnu homho, na wonnuma hom nyina wɔ Jesus Kraest ne dzin mu nkɔ bɔnfakyɛ mu, na hom benya Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no akyɛdze no.
title: ACTS

text: Osiandɛ anohoba no yɛ hom nye hom mba nye hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyirekyir a Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn bɛfrɛ hɔn aba ne nkyɛn nyina dze.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔdze nsɛm pii kaa ho gyee dase kyerɛɛ hɔn, na otuu hɔn fo dɛ, Hom ngye homho mfi mbasantsen a hɔn bra akyewakyew yi ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wɔgyee n’asɛm no, wonumaa hɔn, na da no ara akra bɛyɛ mpensa bɛkaa hɔn ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔkɔr do suoo asomafo no hɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ nye hɔn fɛkuwbɔ, nye paanoo bubu no nye mpaabɔ mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na asomafo no yɛɛ anwanwadze nye nsɛnkyerɛdze pii, na hu kaa nyimpa nyina.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wɔgyee dzii nyina boaa ano na wɔyɛɛ hɔn adze nyina dɛ kwasafodze;
title: ACTS

text: na wɔtɔɔn hɔn ahodze nye hɔn ndzɛmba, na wɔkyɛe maa hɔn nyina, dɛ mbrɛ obiara n’ehiadze tse.
title: ACTS

text: Na daa daa wɔkɔr do dze anokor bɔɔ mu hyiae wɔ asɔrfi no mu, na wohyiaa efiefi bubuu paanoo, na wɔdze ahosɛpɛw nye komakor dzii hɔn edziban.
title: ACTS

text: Woyii Nyankopɔn ayɛw na wonyaa enyimpa wɔ ɔman no nyina enyim. Na Ewuradze dze hɔn a wɔregye hɔn nkwa no kaa hɔn ho daa daa.
title: ACTS

text: Da kor bi, Peter nye John siaan anan kɔr asɔrfi no mu ewiaber ndɔnebiasa mpaabɔ ber no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Nna barimba bi wɔ hɔ a wɔwoo no obubuafo a daa wɔdze no bɔto asɔrfi abotsen a wɔfrɛ no Fɛɛfɛw no ano, ama ɔaaserɛ hɔn a wɔrokɔ asɔrfi no mu no adze.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔno na ohun Peter nye John dɛ wɔrekɛhɛn asɔrfi no mu no, obisaa hɔn hɔ akyɛdze.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter dze n’enyiwa tsiim no do, na John so dɛmara, na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ hɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔhwɛɛ hɔn komm, nna osusu dɛ oribenya biribi efi hɔn hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter see no dɛ, Sika nye dwetɛ dze, minnyi bi, na dza mowɔ na medze rema wo yi. Nazarɛtnyi Jesus Kraest ne dzin mu, nantsew.
title: ACTS

text: Na osuoo ne nsa nyimfa mu maa no do, na amonmu hɔ ara n’anansa nye n’anamɔn mu yɛɛ dzen.
title: ACTS

text: Na ohuruwii gyinae, na ɔnantsewee; na ɔnye hɔn kɔr asɔrfi no mu, na ɔnam no nna oruhuruhuruw, na oriyi Nyankopɔn ayɛw.
title: ACTS

text: Na nkorɔfo nyina hun no dɛ ɔnam na oriyi Nyankopɔn ayɛw.
title: ACTS

text: Na wohunii so dɛ ɔnoara nye nyia adzeserɛ ntsi ɔtsena Abow a wɔfrɛ no Fɛɛfɛw no ano no; na adze a ayɛ no no ntsi nwanwa nye ahobow hyɛɛ hɔn ma.
title: ACTS

text: Ber a nna ɔtetar Peter na John ho no, nkorɔfo nyina tutuu mbirika behyiaa hɔn nkyɛn wɔ abrandaa a wɔfrɛ no Solomon dze no no do, a hɔnho abow hɔn kɛse.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter hunii no, obuaa nkorɔfo no dɛ, Israel mbarimba, Ɔyɛ dɛn na iyi yɛ hom nwanwa, anaadɛ ɔyɛ dɛn na hom hwɛ hɛn hann, dɛ gyama hɛnankasa hɛn tum anaa hɛn sompa na yɛdze maa ɔnantsewee yi?
title: ACTS

text: Abraham nye Isaak nye Jakob hɔn Nyankopɔn, hɛn egyanom Nyankopɔn, na ɔahyɛ n’Akowaa Jesus enyimnyam; ɔno a hom yii no mae, na hom poow no wɔ Pilate a obuu atsɛn dɛ nkyɛ obegyaa no no enyim no.
title: ACTS

text: Na hom poow Krɔnkrɔnnyi nye Tseneneenyi no, na hom serɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa owudzifo nkyɛ hom,
title: ACTS

text: na nkwa Hen no dze, hom kum no; ɔno na Nyankopɔn nyaan no fii ewufo mu: ɔno ho adasefo nye hɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔnam ne dzin mu gyedzi do na ne dzin do na ama oyi a hom hu no na hom nyim no yi atse apɔw: nyew, gyedzi a ɔnam no do na ɔama no ahosan koraa dɛm wɔ hom nyina enyim yi.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei, enuanom, minyim dɛ hom nnyim ntsi na hom yɛe, dɛ mbrɛ hom etsitsir so yɛe.
title: ACTS

text: Na dza Nyankopɔn nam no nkɔnhyɛfo nyina anomu kae too hɔ dɛ otwar dɛ ne Kraest no bohu amandze no, aba mu.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nnu homho, na hom ndan mbra Nyankopɔn hɔ, ama wɔaapepa hom bɔn efi hom ho,
title: ACTS

text: ama dɛm no Ewuradze aama hom ahotɔ mber, na ɔaasoma Kraest a woeyi no esi hɔ ama hom dada no, mekyerɛ Jesus a;
title: ACTS

text: ɔno na ɔsɛ dɛ ɔsor gye no sie, dze kodu ndzɛmba nyina ahyɛnanmu ber a Nyankopɔn nam no nkɔnhyɛfo krɔnkrɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ fi tsetse no hɔn anomu kae no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Moses kaa dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi bi na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn bɛma no do ama hom wɔ hom enuanom mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔmaa emi so do no: ɔno na hom ntsie no wɔ dza ɔbɛka akyerɛ hom nyina mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbɛba dɛ ɔkra biara a onnketsie nkɔnhyɛnyi no, wɔbɛsɛɛ no efi ɔman no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Ɛhɛɛ, nkɔnhyɛfo nyina a wofi Samuel do nye hɔn a wodzi do no dodow a wɔkasae no, hɔn so kaa nda yi ho asɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Hom nye nkɔnhyɛfo no nye ahyɛmu a Nyankopɔn nye hom egyanom dzii no mba, osiandɛ ɔsee Abraham dɛ, W’asefo mu na wobehyira asaase do ebusua biara.
title: ACTS

text: Hom na Nyankopɔn nyaan n’akowaa no, odzii kan somaa no hom nkyɛn dɛ ombehyira hom, dɛ ɔmbɛdan hom nyina mfi hom emumuyɛ mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔrekasa kyerɛ nkorɔfo no, asɔfo nye asɔrfi safohen, nye Sadusiifo no baa hɔn do,
title: ACTS

text: na ɔyɛɛ hɔn ehi dɛ wɔnam Jesus do reka ewufo mu soɛr ho asɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔdze nsa suoo hɔn mu dze hɔn kesiee dɛ adze nkye: osiandɛ nna edu anafua.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wɔtsee asɛm no dodowara gyee dzii; na nyimpa no dodow bɛyɛɛ mpemenum.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ adze kyee no, hɔn etsitsir nye mpanyimfo nye kyerɛwfo no behyiae wɔ Jerusalɛm,
title: ACTS

text: wɔnye ɔsɔfopanyin Annas, nye Kaiafas, nye John, nye Alɛksandar, nye dodowara a wofi sɔfopanyin ebusua mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔdze hɔn begyinaa finimfin bisaa hɔn dɛ, Ebɛn tum anaadɛ ebɛn dzin mu na hom yɛɛ yi?
title: ACTS

text: Nna Peter a Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahyɛ no ma no see hɔn dɛ, Ɔman mu etsitsir, nye mpanyimfo,
title: ACTS

text: sɛ dza wɔrepɛnsa hɛn mu ndɛ wɔ yie a wɔayɛ ama ɔyarfo yi ho, nye dɛ, Ɔnam ebɛnadze do na wɔagye no nkwa a;
title: ACTS

text: hom nyina nye Israelman nyina nhu dɛ Nazarɛtnyi Jesus Kraest a hom bɔɔ no mbeamudua mu na Nyankopɔn nyaan no fii ewufo mu no, ne dzin mu a; ɔno no mu na oyi no ho asan gyina hom enyim ha yi.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔno nye ɔbo a hom adantofo emmbu no bi, na wɔayɛ no kutuwdo bo.
title: ACTS

text: Na nkwagye nnyi obiara so mu: eso dzin fofor biara nnyi wi yi ase a wɔdze ama wɔ nyimpa mu a otwar dɛ wɔgye hɛn nkwa wɔ mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na wohun Peter nye John hɔn ndam no, na wɔtsee ase dɛ wɔyɛ nyimpa a wonnsuaa nwoma na wɔyɛ ntsetsekwaa no, ɔyɛɛ hɔn nwanwa; na wohun dɛ wɔnye Jesus anantsew pɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔhwɛɛ nyimpa a wɔasa no yarba no a ɔnye hɔn gyina hɔ no, woenntum annka hwee enntsia hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔhyɛɛ hɔn dɛ womfi bagua mu hɔ nkɔ nkyɛn, na wotuu hɔn mu egyina,
title: ACTS

text: dɛ, Yɛnyɛ nyimpa yi dɛn? Wɔnam hɔn do ayɛ asɛnkyerɛdze a ɔyɛ nwanwa, a ada edzi ama hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalɛm nyina, na yerunntum nnsan.
title: ACTS

text: Na mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma ɔnnkɛda ho atahye ɔman mu no, hom mma yempuw hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnka dzin yi ho asɛm nnkyerɛ nyimpa biara bio.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔfrɛɛ hɔn hyɛɛ hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnkasa, eso mma wɔnnkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ Jesus dzin mu koraa.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter nye John buae see hɔn dɛ, Sɛ ɔtsen wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim dɛ yetsie hom kyɛn Nyankopɔn a, hom mbua atsɛn:
title: ACTS

text: na hɛn dze, yerunntum gyedɛ yɛka dza yeehu na yɛatse.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn dze, wopupuuw hɔn bio no, wɔmaa wɔkɔree, na woennhu mbrɛ wɔbɛyɛ atsea hɔn wɔ ɔman no ntsi, osiandɛ hɔn nyina hyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ dza esi no ho.
title: ACTS

text: Nna nyimpa no a wɔyɛɛ dɛm ayarsa asɛnkyerɛdze yi wɔ no do no, edzi bɔbor mfe eduanan.
title: ACTS

text: Na wogyaa hɔn no, wɔbaa hɔn mfɛfo nkyɛn, na wɔbɛkaa dza asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no see hɔn nyina kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtsee no, wɔyɛɛ anokor maa hɔn ndze do maa Nyankopɔn see dɛ, Yewura, ɔwo a eyɛɛ ɔsor nye asaase nye po nye no mu dza ɔwɔ mu nyina
title: ACTS

text: a enam Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn do kae wɔ w’akowaa David anomu dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na amanaman reyɛ gyigyeegye, Na amanamamfo rususu adze gyangyan yi?
title: ACTS

text: Asaase do ahemfo baa mpasuar, Etsitsir boaa ano tsiaa Ewuradze nye ne Kraest no:
title: ACTS

text: ampaara w’Akowaa Krɔnkrɔn Jesus a asera no no, na Herod nye Pontius Pilate nye amanamamfo nye Israelmba hyiae tsiaa no, wɔ kurow yi mu,
title: ACTS

text: dɛ wɔrebɛyɛ dza wo nsa nye w’apam hyɛe too hɔ dɛ onsi no nyina.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei, Ewuradze, hwɛ hɔn empuw, na ma wo nkowaa mfa ndamyɛ nyina nka w’asɛm,
title: ACTS

text: dɛ ebɛtsen wo nsa asa yarba, ma wɔnam w’Akowaa Krɔnkrɔn Jesus ne dzin do aayɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze.
title: ACTS

text: Na wowiee nkotoserɛ mpaabɔ no, beebi mbrɛ woehyia hɔ no wosowee, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn hyɛɛ hɔn nyina ma, na wɔdze ndam kaa Nyankopɔn asɛm no.
title: ACTS

text: Na nyimpadodow a wɔgyee dzii no, yɛɛ akoma kor, nye ɔkra kor; na hɔn mu biara annse dɛ ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ yɛ nankasa nedze, na ne nyina yɛɛ hɔn kwasafodze.
title: ACTS

text: Na ahoɔdzen kɛse na asomafo no dze gyee Jesus no wunyan ho dase, na adom kɛse baa hɔn nyina do.
title: ACTS

text: Eso obiara nnyi hɔn mu a ohiaa no, na hɔn a wɔwɔ nsaase nye adan tontɔnee, na wɔdze dza wɔtɔnee ne tsibo bae,
title: ACTS

text: na wɔdze boguu asomafo no ananadze, na wɔkyɛe maa obiara dɛ mbrɛ ohia no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Josef a asomafo no too no Barnabas (ne nkyerɛase nye dɛ Awerɛkyekyer Ba no) a ɔyɛ Levinyi a ofi Siprusman mu no,
title: ACTS

text: ɔwɔ asaase, na ɔtɔnee, na ɔdze ne sika bae boguu asomafo no ananadze.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbarimba bi a ne dzin dze Ananias nye ne yer Safira kɔtɔɔn asaase bi,
title: ACTS

text: na ɔdze ne tsisika bi siei, nna ne yer so nyim ho bi, na ɔdze fa bi bae bɔtoo asomafo no ananadze.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter see dɛ, Ananias, ɔyɛ dɛn na Satan ahyɛ w’akoma ma dɛ ibedzi ator akyerɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no, na edze asaase no ne tsisika no bi esuma?
title: ACTS

text: Ana ɔwɔ hɔ no, nnyɛ wankasa wodze bi a? Na wɔtɔnee no, onnyi wankasa wo nsamu bi? Ɔyɛ dɛn na adwen adze yi wɔ w’akoma mu? Nnyɛ nyimpa na edzi ator akyerɛ hɔn, na Nyankopɔn a.
title: ACTS

text: Na Ananias tsee nsɛm yi no, otwae hwee famu wui, na hu kɛse kaa hɔn a wɔtsee yinom nyina.
title: ACTS

text: Na mberantsɛ no soɛree kyekyeer no ho, na wɔdze no kɔree kesiee no.
title: ACTS

text: Na n’ekyir bɛyɛ ndɔnhwer ebiasa, na ne yer a onnyim dza esi no so bae.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter see no dɛ, Ka kyerɛ me, ana hom tɔɔn asaase no gyee dɛmara? Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyew, dɛmara.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter see no dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom ayɛ kor dɛ hom robɔsɔ Ewuradze Sunsum no ahwɛ yi? Hwɛ, hɔn a wokesiee wo kun no anan wɔ abowano, na wɔbɔsoa wo so akɔ dɛmara.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔhwee n’ananadze amonmu hɔ ara wui; na mberantsɛ no bae bohun dɛ oewu no, wɔsoaa no kɔree kesiee no no kun nkyɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na hu kɛse baa asɔr mu no nyina, nye dodow a wɔtsee yinom nyina do.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔnam asomafo no nsa do na wɔyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze pii wɔ ɔman no mu, na hɔn nyina yɛɛ adwenkor wɔ Solomon abrandaa mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na nkaa no mu obiara ennsi no bo dɛ ɔdze noho bɔ hɔn ho, na ɔman no dze, wɔkamfoo hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na dodow bɛkaa hɔn ho a wɔgyee Ewuradze dzii, mbarimba nye mbaa pii,
title: ACTS

text: ma wɔsoaa ayarfo fiir edzi baa abrɔn mu so bɔtotoo mpikyi nye nkɛtɛ do, ama Peter resen a no sunsuma aakata hɔn mu bi do.
title: ACTS

text: Na nkurow a oetwa ho ehyia no mu nyimpadodow so dze ayarfo nye hɔn a esunsum fi rehyɛ hɔn amen baa Jerusalɛm, na wɔyɛɛ hɔn nyina edur.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsɔfopanyin nye hɔn a wɔka no ho a wofi Sadusiifo fɛkuw no soɛree, na nyinkun hyɛɛ hɔn ma,
title: ACTS

text: na wɔdze hɔn nsa suoo asomafo no mu, na wɔdze hɔn koguu kwasafo efiadze.
title: ACTS

text: Na Ewuradze bɔfoe bobuee efiadze no no mbobow no na ɔdze hɔn puei, na ɔsee dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Hom nkɔ nkegyina asɔrfi no mu nkɛka dɛm Nkwa yi ne nsɛm nyina nkyerɛ ɔman no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtsee no, wɔkɔr asɔrfi no mu anapaatu kɛkyerɛkyerɛe. Na ɔsɔfopanyin no nye hɔn a wɔka no ho no bae, na wɔbɛfrɛɛ baguafo nye Israelmba mpanyimfo nyina boaa ano, na wɔsomae kɔr efiadze hɔ dɛ wɔnkɛfa hɔn mbra.
title: ACTS

text: Na asomfo no kɔr hɔ na woennhu hɔn efiadze hɔ no, wɔsanee bɛkaa dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Efiadze no dze, yekohun dɛ wɔatow mu yie pɛpɛɛpɛr, na ahwɛfo no gyina ekyir wɔ abowano, naaso yebuei no yeennhu obiara wɔ mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na asɔrfi safohen no nye asɔfompanyin no tsee nsɛm yi no, hɔn tsirmu yɛɛ hɔn konsee wɔ ho dɛ, na ebɛn asɛm nye yi?
title: ACTS

text: Na obi bae bɛkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hwɛ, mbarimba no a hom dze hɔn guu efiadze no gyina asɔrfi no mu rekyerɛkyerɛ ɔman no.
title: ACTS

text: Nna safohen no nye asomfo no kɔree kɛfaa hɔn bae, nnyɛ akataban do bi a, osiandɛ wosuroo ɔman no, amma woeennsiw hɔn abo.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔdze hɔn bae no, wɔdze hɔn begyinaa bagua mu, na ɔsɔfopanyin no bisaa hɔn dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Yɛbraa hom ketsee dɛ mma hom nnkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ dɛm dzin yi mu; na hwɛ, hom dze hom nkyerɛkyerɛ ahyɛ Jerusalɛm nyina ma, na hom pɛ dɛ hom dze nyimpa yi no bɔgyaa ba hɛn do.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter nye asomafo no buae see dɛ, Otwar dɛ yetsie Nyankopɔn asɛm mbom kyɛn nyimpa dze.
title: ACTS

text: Hɛn egyanom Nyankopɔn nyaan Jesus a hom sɛɛn no dua do kum no no.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔno na Nyankopɔn dze ne nsa nyimfa maa no do dɛ Safohen nye Agyenkwa, dɛ ɔmma Israel nnuho nye bɔnfakyɛ.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɛn yɛyɛ nsɛm yi ho adasefo, dɛmara so na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no a Nyankopɔn dze ama hɔn a wotsie no no yɛ.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn dze wɔtsee yi no, hɔn akoma mu twitwaa hɔn, na wɔkɔr apam dɛ woboku hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na baguafo no mu baako a ɔyɛ Farisiinyi a ne dzin dze Gamaliel a ɔyɛ mbrakyerɛfo a ɔman no nyina buu no bi no soɛree, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa nyimpa no mfir edzi kakra.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Israel mbarimba, hom nhwɛ hom ho yie wɔ nyimpa yi ho, dza hom rebɛyɛ.
title: ACTS

text: Na ansaana mber yi rebɛba no, na Teudas a ɔhyehyɛɛ noho dɛ ɔyɛ obi soɛree, na mbarimba a hɔn dodow bɛyɛ dɛ ahaanan dze hɔnho kɔbɔɔ no ho; ɔno na wokum no, na hɔn a wotsiee no nyina hwetsee, na wɔyɛɛ gyan.
title: ACTS

text: Na oyi ekyir, Judas Galiliinyi soɛɛr ɔkankyerɛw nda no mu, na ɔtwee binom pii dzii n’ekyir; na ɔno so wui, na hɔn a wotsiee no nyina bɔɔ apetse.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei mese hom dɛ, Hom ntwe hom ho mfi nyimpa yi ho, na hom ngyaa hɔn: na sɛ apam yi anaa edwuma yi fir nyimpa mu a, obobutuw;
title: ACTS

text: na sɛ ofir Nyankopɔn a, hom runntum mmbutuw no, amma hom aammbɛyɛ dɛ hom nye Nyankopɔn mpo roko.
title: ACTS

text: Na wotsiee no na wɔfrɛɛ asomafo no bae, na wɔhwee hɔn na wɔbraa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnkasa wɔ Jesus dzin mu, na wogyaa hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn dze, wɔdze dɛw fii baguafo no enyim hɔ kɔree, dɛ woebu hɔn bi dɛ wɔsɛ dɛ wɔbɔ hɔn adapaa wɔ Dzin no ntsi.
title: ACTS

text: Na woenngyaa dɛ daa nyina wɔ asɔrfi mu nye efiefie no, wɔkyerɛkyerɛ na wɔka asɛmpa wɔ Jesus ho, dɛ ɔno nye Kraest no.
title: ACTS

text: Na nda yi mu no a esuafo no dodow rodɔɔ so no, ehwinhwin baa Helenifo no mu tsiaa Hebriwfo no, osiandɛ wobuu hɔn enyi guu hɔn ekunafo do wɔ daadaa som no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na duebien no frɛɛ esuafo kuw no nyina baa hɔn nkyɛn, na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔmmfata dɛ hɛn yɛbɛdan Nyankopɔn asɛm egya, na yɛakɔsom apon do.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, hom nhwehwɛ hom mu mbarimba beesuon a wɔwɔ dzin pa a Sunsum nye nyansa ahyɛ hɔn ma, na yenyi hɔn nsi edwuma yi do.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɛn dze, yɛbɔkɔ do araa esuo mpaabɔ nye nyamesɛm no som mu dzen.
title: ACTS

text: Na asɛm no sɔɔ dɔm no nyina enyi; na woyii Stefen, ɔbarimba a gyedzi nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahyɛ no ma, nye Filip, nye Prokorɔs, nye Nikanor, nye Timon, nye Parmenas, nye Nikolas a ofi Antiok a ɔadan Jewnyi no;
title: ACTS

text: hɔn na wɔdze hɔn gyinaa asomafo no enyim, na wɔbɔɔ mpaa dze hɔn nsa guu hɔn do.
title: ACTS

text: Na Nyankopɔn n’asɛm no dɔree, na esuafo no dodow yɛɛ pii wɔ Jerusalɛm, na asɔfo no so hɔn mu okuw kɛsenara yɛɛ setsie maa gyedzi no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Stefen a adom nye ahoɔdzen ahyɛ no ma no, yɛɛ anwanwadze nye asɛnkyerɛdze akɛse wɔ ɔman no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na binom a wofi nhyiamudan a nna wɔfrɛ no Fahodzifo Hyiadan nye Sirenefo nye Alɛksandriafo nye hɔn a wofi Silisia nye Asia dze no mu soɛree, nye Stefen gyee ekyingye.
title: ACTS

text: Na woenntum enngyina nyansa nye Sunsum a ɔdze kasae no ano.
title: ACTS

text: Nna wɔhyɛɛ nyimpa bi tsipia ma wɔsee dɛ, Yɛatse dɛ ɔka ebususɛm tsia Moses nye Nyankopɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na wohuenyaan ɔman no nye mpanyimfo, nye kyerɛwfo no, ma wɔbaa no do bɛkyeer no dze no kɔr bagua mu;
title: ACTS

text: na wɔdze adasefo atorfo begyinaa hɔ a wɔsee dɛ, Nyimpa yi nngyaa dɛ ɔkasa tsia krɔnkrɔnbea yi nye mbra no.
title: ACTS

text: Na yɛatse dɛ ɔka dɛ Jesus Nazarɛtnyi no bobutuw bea yi, na ɔasakyer amambra a Moses dze maa hɛn no.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wɔtse bagua mu hɔ nyina dze hɔn enyiwa tsiim no do no, wohun n’enyim dɛ ɔtse dɛ sor abɔfo enyim.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsɔfopanyin no bisaa no dɛ, Ana asɛm yi tse dɛm a?
title: ACTS

text: Na Stefen see dɛ, Enuanom nye egyanom, hom ntsie: Enyimnyam Nyankopɔn yii noho kyerɛɛ hɛn egya Abraham, ber a ɔwɔ Mesopotemia no, ansaana ɔrebɛtsena Haran,
title: ACTS

text: na ɔsee no dɛ, Fi w’asaase do nye w’ebusuafo mu, na bra asaase a mebɛkyerɛ wo no do.
title: ACTS

text: Nna ofii Kaldeafo asaase no do bɛtsenaa Haran; na n’egya wu ekyir no, Nyankopɔn maa ofii hɔ bɛtsenaa asaase a hom tse do sesei yi do.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔamma no egyapadze wɔ mu, nnyɛ anamɔn kor bi mpo; mbom ɔbɔɔ no anohoba dɛ ɔdze bɛma ɔno nye n’asefo a wodzi n’ekyir ma aayɛ hɔndze: naaso nna onnyae nnyaa ba.
title: ACTS

text: Na mbrɛ Nyankopɔn kae nye dɛ n’asefo bɛyɛ ahɔho wɔ anana asaase do, na wɔdze hɔn ayɛ nkowaa, na wɔayɛ hɔn bɔn mfe ahaanan.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔman no a wɔbɔkɔ hɔn mu nkowaasom no, mubobu hɔn atsɛn, Nyankopɔn na ɔse: na n’ekyir no wobefi hɔ na wɔabɔsom me wɔ bea yi mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔmaa no twatsia ahyɛmudzi no; na ɔdze dɛm woo Isaak, na ne ndaawɔtwe no otwaa no twatsia; na Isaak woo Jakob, na Jakob woo egyanom mpanyin duebien no.
title: ACTS

text: Na mpanyin duebien no dze enyitan tɔɔn Josef kɔr Egypt; na Nyankopɔn dzii n’ekyir,
title: ACTS

text: na oyii no fiir n’amandzehu nyina mu, na ɔmaa no adom nye nyansa wɔ Farao, Egypthen no, enyim, na ɔyɛɛ no otsitsir wɔ Egypt nye ne fie nyina do.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔkɔm sii Egypt nyina, nye Keenan, nye amandzehu kɛse, na hɛn egyanom ennya edziban.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jakob tsee dɛ edziban wɔ Egypt no, ɔsomaa hɛn egyanom kan.
title: ACTS

text: Na dza otsia ebien no, Josef yii noho kyerɛɛ no nuanom no, na Farao so bohun Josef n’ebusua no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Josef somae ma wɔkɛfaa n’egya Jakob nye n’ebusuafo nyina a wɔyɛ nyimpa eduosuon enum no baa ne nkyɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jakob kɔr Egypt; na ɔno nye hɛn egyanom wuwui;
title: ACTS

text: na wɔdze hɔn kɔr Sekem, na wɔdze hɔn kɔtotoo nda a Abraham dze dwɛɛtɛɛ tɔɔ no wɔ Sekem Hamor mba no hɔ no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na anohoba a Nyankopɔn kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ Abraham n’aber rudu no, ɔman no dɔree na wɔyɛɛ pii wɔ Egypt,
title: ACTS

text: dze kodur dɛ Egypthen bi soɛree a onnyim Josef.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔno na ɔnye hɛn ebusua dzii no yayaayaw, na ɔyɛɛ hɛn egyanom bɔn, na ɔmaa wɔtotoow hɔn nkɔkowaba gui ma wowuwui.
title: ACTS

text: Na aber no ara mu na wɔwoo Moses, na no ho yɛɛ fɛw wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim; na wɔhwɛɛ no abosoom ebiasa wɔ n’egya fie,
title: ACTS

text: na wɔtoow no kyenee no, Farao babaa kɛfaa no, na ɔtsetsee no dze no yɛɛ ne ba.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔdze Egyptfo nyansaa nyina tsetsee Moses, na ɔyɛɛ otumfo wɔ ne nsɛm nye ne ndzeyɛɛ nyina mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na odzii mfe eduanan no, ɔbaa n’akoma mu dɛ ɔbɔkɔ akɔhwɛ no nuanom Israelmba no.
title: ACTS

text: Na ohun obi a wɔreyɛ no bɔn no, ɔgyee ne tsir, na ɔtɔɔ nyia wɔrehyɛ no do no no wer kum Egyptnyi no;
title: ACTS

text: na osusuu dɛ no nuanom tse ase dɛ Nyankopɔn nam ne nsa do rebɛgye hɔn: naaso wɔanntse ase.
title: ACTS

text: Na adze kyee no, okopuee no nuanom do dɛ wɔroko, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ ɔka hɔn bɔ mu dɛ, Mbarimba, hom yɛ enuanom: ɔyɛ dɛn na hom reyɛ homho bɔn yi?
title: ACTS

text: Na nyia ɔreyɛ ne nyɛnko bɔn no suun no dɛ, Woana yɛɛ wo ɔpanyin nye ɔtsɛmbuafo wɔ hɛn do?
title: ACTS

text: Epɛ dɛ iku me dɛ mbrɛ ikum Egyptnyi no ndeda no?
title: ACTS

text: Na asɛm yi ntsi Moses guanee, na ɔkɛyɛɛ hɔho wɔ Midian asaase do, na ɔwoo mbabanyin beenu wɔ hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na mfe eduanan twaa mu no, Ewuradze bɔfoe yii noho kyerɛɛ no wɔ Sinai kokwaa ho sar no do, wɔ gyaframee a ofi haban bi mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na Moses hunii no, ɔyɛɛ no nwanwa wɔ n’enyi do, na ɔtwee pinii dɛ ɔrokɔhwɛ no, Ewuradze ndze baa dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Emi nye w’egyanom Nyankopɔn, Abraham nye Isaak nye Jakob hɔn Nyankopɔn. Na Moses ho popoe na oenntum annhwɛ.
title: ACTS

text: Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, San w’anan mpaboa: na bea a igyina do yi yɛ asaase krɔnkrɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Ampaara mehu me man a ɔwɔ Egypt hɔn amandzehu, na matse hɔn apempen, na mesian dɛ merebɛgye hɔn: na afei bra ma monsoma wo wɔ Egypt.
title: ACTS

text: Moses yi ara a wɔpoow no dɛ, Woana na ɔyɛɛ wo ɔpanyin nye ɔtsɛmbuafo wɔ hɛn do no, ɔnoara na Nyankopɔn nam bɔfo a oyii noho kyerɛɛ no haban mu no ne nsa do somaa no dɛ ɔpanyin nye ɔgyefo.
title: ACTS

text: Oyi na ɔdze hɔn fii Egypt puei, yɛɛ anwanwadze nye asɛnkyerɛdze wɔ Egypt, nye Po Memen mu, nye sar no do mfe eduanan.
title: ACTS

text: Oyi nye Moses a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ Israelmba no dɛ, Nkɔnhyɛnyi bi na Nyankopɔn bɛma ɔasoɛr ama hom wɔ hom enuanom mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔmaa me so.
title: ACTS

text: Oyi na ɔwɔ dɔm a wɔaboa ano wɔ sar no do no mu a ɔnye ɔbɔfo a ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no wɔ Sinai kokwaa do no nye hɛn egyanom wɔ hɔ, na onyaa nkwasɛm a nkwa wɔ mu dɛ ɔmfa mma hɛn no;
title: ACTS

text: na hɛn egyanom ammpɛ dɛ wotsie no, na wosuun no, na wɔdze hɔn akoma sanee kɔr Egypt,
title: ACTS

text: na wɔsee Aaron dɛ, Yɛ enyame a wobedzi hɛn enyim ma hɛn, na Moses yi a ɔdze hɛn fii Egypt bae no dze, yennyim dza ayɛ no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔyɛɛ nantwiba wɔ nda no mu, na wɔbɔɔ afɔr maa honyi no, na wodzii ehurusi wɔ hɔn nsaano edwuma ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na Nyankopɔn daan n’enyi, na ɔdze hɔn maa dɛ wɔnsom wimu ndzɛmba, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ nkɔnhyɛfo nwoma no mu dɛ, Israel fifo, aso hom bɔɔ okum afɔr na afɔr horow maa me Mfe eduanan wɔ sar no do?
title: ACTS

text: Mbom hom faa Molɔk ntamadan, Nye ɔbosom Refan nworaba, Ehonyi a hom yɛɛ dɛ hom bɔsom hɔn; Na mobɔsoa hom akɔ Babilɔn ekyir noho.
title: ACTS

text: Hɛn egyanom nyaa adasehyɛ ntamadan no wɔ sar no do, dɛ mbrɛ nyia ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ Moses no hyɛɛ dɛ ɔnyɛ no dɛ mbrɛ nsusudo a ohunii no tse no.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔno na hɛn egyanom nsa nyae kae no, wɔnye Josua dze baa amanaman a Nyankopɔn paam hɔn fii hɛn egyanom enyim no asaase do. Na ɔtse dɛm dze besi David n’aber do.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔno na onyaa Nyankopɔn enyim adom, na ɔserɛɛ dɛ wɔmma ɔnhwehwɛ tsenabew mma Jakob Nyankopɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na Solomon sii dan maa no.
title: ACTS

text: Naaso nyia ɔwɔ sorsor no nntsena dza nsa ayɛ mu; dɛ mbrɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi no ka dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Ɔsor nye m’ahengua, Na asaase nye m’ananadzegua: Ɔdan bɛn na hom besi ama me? Ewuradze na ɔse, Anaadɛ henfa nye m’ahomgyebea?
title: ACTS

text: Ana nnyɛ me nsa na ɔyɛɛ yinom nyina?
title: ACTS

text: Hom a hom asen hom kɔn a wonntwaa hom twatsia wɔ akoma nye asomu, daa hom siw Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no kwan: dɛ mbrɛ hom egyanom yɛe no, mbrɛ hom so yɛ nye no.
title: ACTS

text: Nkɔnhyɛfo no mu woana na hom egyanom ennhiahia no ho? Na wokum hɔn a wodzii kan kaa ɔtseneneenyi no ne mbae no; ɔno na hom ayɛ no ho yimafo nye ewudzifo;
title: ACTS

text: hom a hom gyee mbra no dɛ abɔfo ahyɛdze, naaso hom enndzi do!
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtsee yinom no, hɔn akoma mu wowɔɔ hɔn, na wɔtwɛɛr hɔn se guu no do.
title: ACTS

text: Naaso ɔno dze, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahyɛ no ma no, ɔhwɛɛ sor hann, na ohun Nyankopɔn n’enyimnyam, nye Jesus dɛ ogyina Nyankopɔn n’enyimfa,
title: ACTS

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Hwɛ, muhu dɛ ɔsor ebue, na nyimpa Ba no gyina Nyankopɔn enyimfa.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔdze ndze kɛse tseatseaa mu, na wosisiiw hɔn asowa, wɔdze adwenkor kotui hyɛɛ no do;
title: ACTS

text: na woyii no edzi fii kurow no mu kesiiw no abo: na adasefo no dze hɔn ntar guu aberantsɛ bi a wɔfrɛ no Saul n’ananadze.
title: ACTS

text: Na worisiw Stefen abo no, ɔbɔɔ mpaa dɛ, Ewuradze Jesus, gye mo sunsum.
title: ACTS

text: Na obuu ntwɛr, na ɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze, mma mmfa bɔn yi nnto hɔn do. Na ɔkaa yi no, ɔkaa n’enyi guu do.
title: ACTS

text: Na Saul so peen no ku no do. Na da no ahohiahia kɛse baa asɔr a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no do; na hɔn nyina petsee kɔr Judea nye Samaria asaase do, gyedɛ asomafo no nko.
title: ACTS

text: Na mbarimba nyamesurofo bi siee Stefen, na wosuu no pii.
title: ACTS

text: Na Saul dze, opuuw asɔrmba no wurawuraa efiefi mu twetwee mbarimba nye mbaa, ma wɔdze hɔn koguu efiadze.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wɔpetsee no kekyinii kɛkaa asɛmpa no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Filip kɔr Samaria kurow mu kɛkaa Kraest ho asɛm kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na nyimpadodow no tsee, na wohun nsɛnkyerɛdze a Filip yɛe no, wɔyɛɛ adwen kor tsiee nsɛm a ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn no.
title: ACTS

text: Na esunsum fi a wɔwɔ dodowara mu dze ndze kɛse tseaa mu puei, na mbubuifo nye mpakye pii so wɔyɛɛ hɔn edur.
title: ACTS

text: Na dɛw kɛse baa kurow no mu hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Nna ɔbarimba bi a ne dzin dze Simon wɔ kurow no mu a kan no odzii esumansɛm, na ɔmaa Samariaman no ho boow hɔn, na ɔyɛɛ noho dɛ obi a ɔyɛ kɛse bi.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔno na hɔn nyina, ofitsi nketseaba do kesi akɛse do tsiee no see dɛ, Oyi nye Nyankopɔn tum a wɔfrɛ no Kɛse no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wotsiee no, osiandɛ nna ɔdze esumansɛm ama hɔn ho abow hɔn akyɛr.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔgyee Filip a ɔkaa Nyankopɔn ahenman nye Jesus Kraest ne dzin ho asɛmpa no dzii no, mbarimba nye mbaa maa wonumaa hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na Simon nankasa gyee dzii, na wonumaa no no, ɔdze noho bɔɔ Filip ho, na ohun asɛnkyerɛdze nye tum ndwuma kɛse a wɔyɛe no, ɔyɛɛ no ahobow.
title: ACTS

text: Na asomafo a wɔwɔ Jerusalɛm tsee dɛ Samaria agye Nyankopɔn asɛm no, wɔsomaa Peter nye John wɔ hɔn nkyɛn;
title: ACTS

text: na wɔbae no, wɔbɔɔ mpaa maa hɔn dɛ wonnya Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn:
title: ACTS

text: osiandɛ onnyae mmbaa hɔn mu biara do, na enuma ara nko na woenuma hɔn ahyɛ Ewuradze Jesus dzin mu.
title: ACTS

text: Nna wɔdze hɔn nsa guu hɔn do, na wonyaa Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na Simon hun dɛ ɔnam asomafo no nsa a wɔdze guu do no do na wɔdze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn rema no, ɔdze sika brɛɛ hɔn dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Hom mma mo so tum yi bi, ama obiara a medze nsa bogu no do no, oeenya Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter see no dɛ, Wo sika nye wo nhyew, osiandɛ isusuu dɛ Nyankopɔn akyɛdze wɔdze sika nya.
title: ACTS

text: Innyi kyɛfa anaa egyapadze wɔ asɛm yi mu, osiandɛ w’akoma nntsen wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi, nu woho wɔ wo bɔn yi ho, na kotow serɛ Nyankopɔn kyerɛ dɛ ɔdze w’akoma mu adwen yi bɛkyɛ wo a.
title: ACTS

text: Na mehu dɛ ewɔ bɔwen wenwen, na emumuyɛ ahoma akyekyer wo.
title: ACTS

text: Na Simon buae see dɛ, Hom nserɛ Ewuradze mma me, mma dza hom aka yi mu biara aammba mo do.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn dze, wɔgyee dase na wɔkaa Ewuradze asɛm no, wɔsanee baa Jerusalɛm, na wɔkaa asɛmpa no wɔ Samariafo nkuroba pii mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na Ewuradze bɔfoe kasaa kyerɛɛ Filip dɛ, Soɛr, na kɔ pomu afamu kwan a ofi Jerusalɛm sian kɔ Gaza no a ɔyɛ sar no do.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsoɛree kɔree; na hwɛ, ɔbarimba Etiopianyi, ɔsaa tumfo a ɔyɛ Etiopiafo ɔhembaa Kandase ne pianyi a ɔhwɛ ne sikakorabea nyina do nye yi, ɔaba Jerusalɛm abɔsɔr;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔresan akɔ, na ɔtse ne tseaseanam mu rekenkan nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia nwoma no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Sunsum no see Filip dɛ, Twe bɛn, na fa woho kɔbɔ tseaseanam yi ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na Filip tutuu mbirika kɔr ne nkyɛn, na ɔtsee dɛ ɔrekenkan nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia nwoma no, na obisaa no dɛ, Ana etse dza erekenkan yi ase?
title: ACTS

text: Na obuaa no dɛ, Mebɛyɛ dɛn etum, gyedɛ obi kyerɛ me kwan? Na ɔserɛɛ Filip dɛ ɔmfow mbɛtsena ne nkyɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na kyerɛw no mu beebi mbrɛ ɔrekenkan nye yi: Wɔdze no dɛ oguantsen kɔr ekumii; Na dɛ mbrɛ eguambaa tɔ ne yifo enyim mmum no, Dɛmara na ommbue n’ano;
title: ACTS

text: N’ahobrɛadze mu wobuu no atsɛn: N’ebusuasantsen woana na obotum akyerɛ? Osiandɛ woeyi no nkwa efi asaase do.
title: ACTS

text: Na pianyi no bisaa Filip dɛ, Meserɛ wo, woana ho asɛm na nkɔnhyɛnyi no reka yi? Nankasa ho anaa obi ho a?
title: ACTS

text: Na Filip buee n’ano, na ofi kyerɛw no ara do kaa Jesus ho asɛmpa kyerɛɛ no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔrokɔ hɔn kwan no, wodur nsu bi do; na pianyi no see dɛ, Hwɛ, nsu nye yi: ebɛnadze na osiw m’enuma ho kwan?
title: ACTS

text: [Na Filip see dɛ, Sɛ edze w’akoma nyina gye dzi a, ewɔ ho kwan. Na obuaa dɛ, Megye midzi dɛ Jesus Kraest yɛ Nyankopɔn ne ba.]
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔhyɛe ma tseaseanam no gyinae, na hɔn beenu nyina sianee kɔr nsu no mu, Filip nye ɔsaa no, na onumaa no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wofii nsu no mu reba no, Ewuradze no Sunsum hwiim Filip, na pianyi no ennhu no bio. Na ɔdze dɛw kɔr no kwan.
title: ACTS

text: Na Filip dze, wohun no wɔ Azotus; na orutwa mu no, ɔkaa asɛmpa no wɔ nkurow nyina mu, dze kɛpeem dɛ odur Kaesarea.
title: ACTS

text: Na Saul da ho ara retseetsee na ɔrehyɛ Ewuradze n’esuafo no amen no, ɔkɔr ɔsɔfopanyin ne nkyɛn,
title: ACTS

text: na okebisaa no hɔ tum nwoma dɛ ɔdze rokɔ Damaskɔs akɔ nhyiamudan no mu, ama sɛ ohu binom a wɔwɔ Ɔkwan no mu a, mbarimba o, mbaa o, ɔaakyekyer hɔn dze hɔn aaba Jerusalɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔnam na ɔbɛɛn Damaskɔs no, awerɛfir mu ara kan fii sor bɛhyerɛnee twaa no ho hyiae;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔhwee daadze, na ɔtsee ndze bi a ɔsee no dɛ, Saul, Saul, ɔyɛ dɛn na eretseetsee me yi?
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Woana nye wo, Ewuradze? Na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye Jesus a etaa no do no:
title: ACTS

text: na soɛr kɔ kurow no mu, na wɔbɛka dza ɔsɛ wo dɛ eyɛ akyerɛ wo.
title: ACTS

text: Na mbarimba a wɔnye no nam no totɔɔ mmum gyinagyinaa hɔ, osiandɛ wɔtsee ndze dze, naaso woennhu obiara.
title: ACTS

text: Na Saul soɛree fii famu, na n’enyi do tsetsewee no, oennhu obiara, na wosusuoo ne nsa dze no baa Damaskɔs.
title: ACTS

text: Na ndaansa nna onnhu adze, eso onndzidzi na ɔnnom.
title: ACTS

text: Nna osuanyi bi wɔ Damaskɔs a ne dzin dze Ananias; ɔno na Ewuradze kaa kyerɛɛ no wɔ enyido adzehu mu dɛ, Ananias. Na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye yi, Ewuradze.
title: ACTS

text: Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, Soɛr kɔ ɔbrɔn a wɔfrɛ no Tɔɔtsen no mu, na kebisa wɔ Judas fie obi a ne dzin dze Saul a ofi Tarsus no n’ekyir kwan, na hwɛ, ɔrosɔr,
title: ACTS

text: na oehu n’enyiwa do dɛ ɔbarimba a ne dzin dze Ananias reba ne nkyɛn, na ɔdze ne nsa ato no do dɛ onhu adze.
title: ACTS

text: Na Ananias buaa dɛ, Ewuradze, matse ɔbarimba yi ho asɛm wɔ nyimpa pii anomu, bɔn dodow a ɔdze ayɛ w’ahotseweefo no wɔ Jerusalɛm;
title: ACTS

text: na ha yi so ɔwɔ tum wɔ asɔfompanyin no nsamu dɛ ɔnkyer hɔn a wɔbɔ wo dzin nyina.
title: ACTS

text: Na Ewuradze see no dɛ, Kɔ ara, na oyi nye nyia meyi no dɛ ɔnsoa me dzin nkɔ amanaman nye ahemfo, nye Israelmba enyim;
title: ACTS

text: na mebɛkyerɛ no amandze pii a otwar dɛ ohu wɔ me dzin ntsi.
title: ACTS

text: Na Ananias kɔree, na ɔkɛhɛɛn ofi no mu, na ɔdze ne nsa too no do see no dɛ, Onua Saul, Ewuradze Jesus a oyii noho kyerɛɛ wo wɔ ɔkwan a enam do reba no mu no, ɔasoma me dɛ hu adze, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn nhyɛ wo ma.
title: ACTS

text: Na ntsɛmara na biribi tse dɛ abon fii n’enyiwa do gui, na ohun adze; na ɔsoɛree ma wonumaa no;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔgyee edziban dzii ma no ho yɛɛ no dzen. Na odzii esuafo a wɔwɔ Damaskɔs no nkyɛn nda kakra.
title: ACTS

text: Na ntsɛmara ɔkaa Jesus ho asɛm wɔ nhyiamudan no mu dɛ ɔno nye Nyankopɔn Ba.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wɔtsee nyina hɔn ho boow hɔn, na wɔsee dɛ, Ana nnyɛ oyi nye nyia ɔsɛɛ hɔn a wɔbɔ dzin yi wɔ Jerusalɛm no, ana nyɛ iyi ntsi na ɔbaa ha dɛ ɔrebɛfa hɔn nkyehoma mu akɛma asɔfompanyin no bi?
title: ACTS

text: Na mbom Saul n’ahoɔdzen yɛɛ dzen mbordo, na ne nkyerɛkyerɛ kofee dɛ Jesus nye Kraest no ara no, maa Jewfo a wɔwɔ Damaskɔs ho boow hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na nda pii durii no Jewfo no paam ne tsir do dɛ woboku no:
title: ACTS

text: na Saul tsee hɔn apam no. Na wɔweɔɔn mbobow no ano ewia nye anadwe dɛ woboku no;
title: ACTS

text: na n’esuafo no faa no anadwe dze no too kɛntsɛn mu duaa fasu mu gyaagyaa no too famu.
title: ACTS

text: Na odur Jerusalɛm no, ɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ ɔdze noho kɔbɔ esuafo no ho; naaso hɔn nyina suroo no, na wɔanngye enndzi dɛ ɔyɛ osuanyi.
title: ACTS

text: Na Barnabas faa no dze no kɔr asomafo no nkyɛn, na ɔkyerɛɛ mu kyerɛɛ hɔn mbrɛ ohun Ewuradze wɔ kwan no mu, na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no, na mbrɛ ɔnam Jesus dzin mu kaa asɛm ndam do wɔ Damaskɔs.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔnye hɔn dzii ndɔfir wɔ Jerusalɛm,
title: ACTS

text: na ɔdze ndam kaa asɛm wɔ Ewuradze ne dzin mu; na ɔnye Helenifo no kasae na wɔgyee ekyingye; na wɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ woku no.
title: ACTS

text: Na enuanom no tsee no, wɔdze no kɔr Kaesarea, na wɔsomaa no fii hɔ kɔr Tarsus.
title: ACTS

text: Nna asɔrasɔr a wɔwɔ Judea nye Galilii nye Samaria nyina nyaa asomdwee, na wonyaa ntowdo na wɔnam Ewuradze no suro nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no n’awerɛkyekyer do dɔree.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Peter rikyin hɔn nyina do no, ɔbaa ahotseweefo a wɔwɔ Lida no so nkyɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na obohun nyimpa bi a ne dzin dze Aeneas a ɔyar mbubui a ɔada ne kɛtɛ do mfe awɔtwe wɔ hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter see no dɛ, Aeneas, Jesus Kraest nsa wo yarba: soɛr, na sɛw wo kɛtɛ. Na ɔsoɛɛr ntsɛmara.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wɔwɔ Lida nye Saron nyina hun no, na wɔdanee baa Ewuradze hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Nna osuanyi bi wɔ Jopa a ne dzin dze Tabita a ne nkyerɛase nye Dorkas: nna ndwuma pa nye adɔyɛ ahyɛ ɔbaa yi ma.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nda no mu ɔyaree na owui; na wowiee no eguar no wɔdze no kɔtoo aborɔsan bi mu.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔnam dɛ Lida bɛn Jopa ntsi, esuafo no tsee dɛ Peter wɔ hɔ no, wɔsomaa mbarimba beenu wɔ no hɔ kɛserɛɛ no dɛ, Mma nnyɛ ekyim dɛ ebɛba hɛn nkyɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter soɛree nye hɔn kɔree. Na odurii no, wɔdze no kɔr aborɔsan no mu, na ekunafo no nyina begyinaa ne nkyɛn sui na wɔdze ntar nye atam a Dorkas nye hɔn wɔ hɔ no ɔyɛe no kyerɛɛ no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter yii hɔn nyina edzi, na obuu ntwɛr bɔɔ mpaa; na ɔdaan noho baa fun no do see dɛ, Tabita, soɛr. Na ɔtseew n’enyiwa, na ohun Peter no, ɔsoɛree tsenaa famu.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter tseen ne nsa maa no ma osuoo mu soɛree, na ɔfrɛɛ ahotseweefo no nye ekunafo no dze no enyikan kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtsee no wɔ Jopa nyina, na dodowara gyee Ewuradze dzii.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei ɔtsenaa Jopa nda pii wɔ Simon nwomahyɛfo bi nkyɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbarimba bi wɔ Kaesarea a ne dzin dze Kornelius, ɔyɛ ɔhamupanyin wɔ asafokuw a wɔfrɛ no Italiafo dze no mu,
title: ACTS

text: nyimpa nyamesuronyi a ɔnye ne fifo nyina suro Nyankopɔn na ɔyɛ adɔyɛ pii ma nkorɔfo, na ɔyɛ nkotoserɛ asɔr ma Nyankopɔn daa.
title: ACTS

text: Na ohun n’enyido adze petee bɛyɛ ndɔnebiasa no mu dɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoe baa ne nkyɛn na ɔbɛsee no dɛ, Kornelius.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔhwɛɛ no hann no, na hu kaa no no, ɔsee dɛ, Owura, ebɛnadze a? Na ɔsee no dɛ, wo mpaabɔ nye w’adɔyɛ no aba sor abɛyɛ nkaa wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei soma mbarimba ma wɔnkɔ Jopa nkehyia Simon a wɔfrɛ no Peter no:
title: ACTS

text: ɔsoɛ Simon a ɔyɛ nwomahyɛfo bi a ne fie wɔ mpoano no hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na bɔfo no a ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ no no kɔree no, ɔfrɛɛ no nkowaa beenu nye sordaanyi nyamesuronyi bi a ofi hɔn a wɔsom no daa no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔkaa nsɛm no nyina kyerɛɛ hɔn no, ɔsomaa hɔn wɔ Jopa.
title: ACTS

text: Na adze kyee no, ber a wɔnam kwan do rebɛn kurow no, Peter kɔr dan no etsifi kɔbɔɔ mpaa bɛyɛ ewiaber duebien no mu;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔkɔm dzee no, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ odzidzi: na wogu do reyɛ edziban ama no no, n’enyiwa wiaa no ma ɔkɔr tsebea fofor mu.
title: ACTS

text: Iyi mu na ohun dɛ sor ebue, na adze bi fir sor risian a ɔtse dɛ abradaa kɛse a wɔakyekyer no etwaanan, na worigyaa mu to famu:
title: ACTS

text: no mu na asaase mbowa a wotsia ntwɛrnan, nye hɔn a wɔweawea, nye wimu ntumbowa nyina bi wɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na ndze bi baa no hɔ dɛ, Peter, soɛr: ku na dzi.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter see dɛ, Dabida, Ewuradze, osiandɛ minndzii biribi a ɔyɛ ekyiwadze anaadɛ no ho nntsew da.
title: ACTS

text: Na ndze no baa no hɔ bio ne mprɛnu dɛ, Dza Nyankopɔn asan ho no, mma mmfrɛ no ekyiwadze.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔyɛɛ yi mprɛnsa, na wɔfaa adze no kɔr sor bio.
title: ACTS

text: Na ber Peter rodwendwen enyido adze a ohunii no ho no, hwɛ, nna mbarimba a Kornelius somaa hɔn no ebisabisa Simon fie kwan ebegyinagyina abowano
title: ACTS

text: refrɛ, na woribisa dɛ Simon a wɔfrɛ no Peter soɛ hɔ anaa?
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter rodwendwen enyido adzehu no ho no, Sunsum no see no dɛ, Hwɛ, mbarimba baasa rohwehwɛ wo.
title: ACTS

text: Na soɛr sian nye hɔn nkɔ, mma ɔnnyɛ wo konsee, na mara na masoma hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter sianee kɔr mbarimba no nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Emi nye nyia hom rohwehwɛ no no: ebɛnadze ntsi na hom bae?
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔhamupanyin Kornelius, ɔbarimba tseneneenyi a osuro Nyankopɔn, na ɔwɔ dzin pa wɔ Jewfo man nyina mu no, na bɔfo krɔnkrɔn beyii kyerɛɛ no dɛ ombehyia wo nkɔ ne fie, ma onketsie w’anomu nsɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn baa dan mu, na ɔsoom hɔn hɔho. Na adze kyee no Peter nye hɔn fii hɔ kɔree, na enuanom a wofi Jopa no bi kegyaa no.
title: ACTS

text: Na adze kyee no wodur Kaesarea. Nna Kornelius rotweɔn hɔn, na ɔafrɛ n’ebusuafo nye n’anyɛnkofo a wɔbɛn aboa ano.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Peter rehɛn fie no mu no, nna Kornelius kehyiaa no hwee n’ananadze kotoow no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter maa no do see no dɛ, Soɛr: na mo so meyɛ nyimpa.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔnye no rekasa no, ɔkɔr fie no mu kohun nyimpa pii a woehyia;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nyim mbrɛ Jewnyi nnyi ho kwan dɛ ɔdze noho kɔbɔ ɔnanaben ho, anaadɛ ɔkɔ ne nkyɛn; naaso Nyankopɔn akyerɛ me dɛ mma memmfrɛ nyimpa biara ekyiwadze anaadɛ no ho nntsew:
title: ACTS

text: ntsi na hom somae ma wobehyiaa me no, mennyiyi ano, na maba yi. Nkyii mibisa hom asɛm kor a ɔnam do ma hom behyiaa me.
title: ACTS

text: Na Kornelius see dɛ, Ndaanan nye yi, bɛyɛ dɔn yi ara mu, nna mowɔ me fie ha ara reyɛ ewiaber ndɔnebiasa asɔr no, na hwɛ, ɔbarimba bi begyinaa m’enyim hyɛ atar hyerɛnn,
title: ACTS

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Kornelius, wɔatse w’asɔr na wɔakaa w’adɔyɛ no wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi, soma ma wɔnkɔ Jopa nkehyia Simon a wɔsan so frɛ no Peter no: ɔsoɛ Simon nwomahyɛfo no fie wɔ mpoano.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi ntsɛmara mosomae ma wɔbaa wo nkyɛn; na wo so ayɛ no yie dɛ aba. Ntsi nkyii hɛn nyina ehyia wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim ha dɛ yeribetsie dza Nyankopɔn ahyɛ wo nyina.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter buee n’ano see dɛ: Nokwar ara mehu dɛ Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ nyimpa enyim:
title: ACTS

text: na mbom ɔman biara mu nyia osuro no na ɔyɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee no, ɔpɛ dɛ ɔgye no.
title: ACTS

text: Asɛm no a ɔsomae brɛɛ Israelmba ma ɔkaa asomdwee a ɔnam Jesus Kraest do ho asɛmpa no (ɔno nye nyimpa nyina wura)
title: ACTS

text: homara hom nyim asɛm a wɔdze tahyee Judea nyina a ɔhyɛɛ ase wɔ Galilii wɔ enuma a John kae no ekyir:
title: ACTS

text: mekyerɛ Jesus a ofi Nazarɛt, mbrɛ Nyankopɔn dze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn nye ahoɔdzen seraa no, na okyinii yɛɛ yie, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn a abɔnsam dzi hɔn do tum no nyina edur, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn ka no ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɛn nye adasefo wɔ ndzɛmba a ɔyɛe wɔ Jewfo asaase do nye Jerusalɛm mu no ho; ɔno so na wɔsɛɛn no wɔ dua do kum no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Nyankopɔn nyaan no da a otsia ebiasa no mu, na oyii no kyerɛɛ petee,
title: ACTS

text: nnyɛ ɔman no nyina a, na dasefo a Nyankopɔn eyi ato hɔ dada no a, hɛn a ɔsoɛree fii ewufo mu no ekyir no yɛnye no dzidzii nomee no.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ hɛn dɛ yɛnka nkyerɛ ɔman no, na yendzi dase dɛ ɔno nye nyia Nyankopɔn ahyɛ no atseasefo nye ewufo ɔtsɛmbuafo.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔno na nkɔnhyɛfo nyina dzi no dase dɛ obiara a ɔbɛgye no edzi no ɔnam ne dzin mu benya bɔnfakyɛ.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter da do reka nsɛm yi no, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no boguu hɔn a wɔtsee asɛm no nyina do.
title: ACTS

text: Na agyedzifo a wofi etwatsiafo no mu a wɔnye Peter bae no ho boow hɔn dɛ woehue Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no akyɛdze no egu amanamamfo so do.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtsee dɛ wɔrekasa kasa fofor, na woriyi Nyankopɔn ayɛw. Nna Peter buae see dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Aso obi botum esiw nsu ho kwan dɛ wonnkonuma yinom a woenya Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no dɛ hɛnara so yi?
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wonnuma hɔn wɔ Jesus Kraest ne dzin mu. Nna wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔntsena hɔn nkyɛn nda kakra.
title: ACTS

text: Na asomafo nye enuanom a wɔwɔ Judea no tsee dɛ amanamamfo so agye Nyankopɔn asɛm no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter baa Jerusalɛm no, hɔn a wofi etwatsiafo mu no nye no akasakasa dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Ɔwo akɔ mbarimba a wɔnnyɛ etwatsiafo mu, na nye hɔn ekedzidzi.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter hyɛɛ asɛm no ase kaa no esiado kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Mowɔ Jopa kurow mu rosɔr, na m’enyiwa wiaa me ma mokɔr tsebea fofor mu na muhun m’enyido adze, adze bi a orisian a ɔtse dɛ abradaa kɛse a wɔakyekyer no etwaanan rigyaa mu fi sor, na ɔbaa me nkyɛn;
title: ACTS

text: na megyeen m’enyi hwɛɛ mu no, muhun asaase mbowa a wotsia ntwɛrnan nye hambowa nye hɔn a wɔweawea nye wimu ntumbowa nyina wɔ mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na metsee ndze bi a ɔsee me dɛ, Peter, soɛr: ku na dzi.
title: ACTS

text: Na mesee dɛ, Dabida, Ewuradze: osiandɛ biribiara a ɔyɛ ekyiwadze anaadɛ no ho nntsew nnkɔr m’anomu da.
title: ACTS

text: Na ndze no fi sor buaa ne mprɛnu dɛ, Dza Nyankopɔn asan ho no, mma mmfrɛ no ekyiwadze.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔyɛɛ iyi mprɛnsa, na afei wɔtwetwee ne nyina kɔr sor bio.
title: ACTS

text: Na hwɛ, amonmu hɔ ara na mbarimba baasa baa ofi a yɛwɔ mu no ano a wɔsomaa hɔn fii Kaesarea baa me nkyɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na Sunsum no see me dɛ menye hɔn nkɔ, na mma mennyɛ nyiyimu. Na enuanom beesia yi kegyaa me, na yɛkɛhɛɛn ɔbarimba no ne fie;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔkaa mbrɛ ohun ɔbɔfo no wɔ ne fie, dɛ ogyina hɔ rese no dɛ, Soma nyimpa kɔ Jopa kehyia Simon a wɔfrɛ no Peter so kyerɛɛ hɛn:
title: ACTS

text: ɔno na ɔbɛka wo nsɛm a ɔwo nye wo fiemba nyina nam do benya nkwa.
title: ACTS

text: Na mehyɛɛ ase rekasa no, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no boguu hɔn do dɛ mbrɛ ahyɛse no oguu hɛn so do no.
title: ACTS

text: Na mekaa Ewuradze asɛm a ɔkaa dɛ, John dze, ɔdze nsu numae; na hom dze, wɔdze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bonuma hom.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi, sɛ Nyankopɔn akyɛ hɔn akyɛdze kor no ara dɛ hɛn so a yɛgyee Ewuradze Jesus Kraest dzii no a, emi nye woana na mubotum esiw Nyankopɔn kwan?
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtsee yinom no, wɔyɛɛ komm, na wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam see dɛ, Nna kyerɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn ama amanamamba so nnuho a ɔdze kɔ nkwa mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a ahohia a ɔbaa Stefen do no ntsi wɔpetsee no, wokyinii kodur Fonisia nye Siprus nye Antiok, na wɔannka asɛm no annkyerɛ obiara dɛ Jewfo nko.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn mu binom yɛ Siprusfo nye Sirenefo; hɔn na wɔbaa Antiok no, wɔkasaa kyerɛɛ Helenefo no so kaa Ewuradze Jesus ho asɛmpa no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Ewuradze ne nsa nye hɔn nam, na nyimpa pii a wɔgyee dzii no wɔdanee baa Ewuradze hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na yinom ho nsɛm dur asɔr a ɔwɔ Jerusalɛm asomu, na wɔsomaa Barnabas dɛ onkekyin nkodu Antiok;
title: ACTS

text: ɔno na ɔbae, na obohun Nyankopɔn adom no, n’enyi gyee, na otuu hɔn nyina fo dɛ wonsi hɔn adwen pi ntakyer Ewuradze ho:
title: ACTS

text: osiandɛ Barnabas yɛ nyimpa papa, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn nye gyedzi so ahyɛ no ma; na nyimpadodow pii baa Ewuradze hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na ofii hɔ kɔr Tarsus kɔhwehwɛɛ Saul,
title: ACTS

text: na ohun no no, ɔdze no baa Antiok, na wɔnye asɔrmba no dzii ehyia araa afrenhyia, na wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ nyimpadodow pii. Antiok hɔ na wodzii kan too esuafo no Kristianfo.
title: ACTS

text: Na nda no mu no nkɔnhyɛfo fii Jerusalɛm baa Antiok.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn mu kor a ne dzin dze Agabus gyinae nam Sunsum no do kyerɛɛ dɛ ɔkɔm kɛse bi rebɛba asaase nyina do: ɔno na ɔbae wɔ Klaudius ber do no.
title: ACTS

text: Na esuafo no, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu biara botum no, bɔɔ hɔn tsirmu dɛ wɔdze biribi bɔmona enuanom a wɔtse Judea dze akɔhwɛ hɔn:
title: ACTS

text: ɔno na wɔyɛe, na wɔdze somaa Barnabas nye Saul dze kɛmaa mpanyimfo no.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm aber no mu, Ɔhen Herod tseen ne nsa tseetsee asɔrmba no binom ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔdze afona kum James, John no nua no.
title: ACTS

text: Na ohun dɛ Jewfo no enyi gyee ho no ntsi, ɔtoaa do kɛfaa Peter so: nna ɔyɛ epitsi nda.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔkyeer no no, ɔdze no kɔtoo efiadze, na ɔdze no hyɛɛ nsordaafokuw anan ahorow anan nsa dɛ wɔnweɔn no, na ɔdween dɛ apaho afahyɛ no ekyir obeyi no abrɛ ɔman no.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔdze Peter kesiee efiadze hɔ dze, naaso asɔrmba no bɔɔ mpaa enyiberdo ara kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn maa no.
title: ACTS

text: Na anadwe no a adze rebɛkye ma Herod ebeyi no akɔ no, Peter daa nsordaafo beenu ntamu a nna wɔdze nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ebien ato no: na aweɔmfo gyinagyina abowano roweɔn efiadze no enyiber do.
title: ACTS

text: Na hwɛ, Ewuradze bɔfoe baa ne nkyɛn na kan hyerɛɛn efiadzedan no mu, na ɔbɔɔ Peter ne nkyɛnmu nyaan no see dɛ, Soɛr ntsɛm. Na no nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no fii ne nsa gui.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbɔfo no see no dɛ, Fa w’abɔdo bɔ wo do, na kyekyer wo mpaboa. Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm. Na ɔsee no dɛ, Fura wo tam yie na ka mo do.
title: ACTS

text: Na opuei kaa no do, na oennhu dɛ dza ɔbɔfo no reyɛ no yɛ ampa, osiandɛ ɔdween dɛ ɔyɛ enyido adzehu.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtraa aweɔmfo no a wodzi kan, nye dza otsia ebien no, wɔbaa dadze abow a ɔdze kɔ kurow no mu no ho, na noara buei maa hɔn, na wopuei na wɔtraa ɔbrɔn kor, na ntsɛmara ɔbɔfo no gyaa no hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter n’enyi baa no ho do no, ɔsee dɛ, Afei na mehu ampa dɛ Ewuradze asoma no bɔfoe na oeyi me efi Herod nsamu, nye dza Jewfo man hɔn enyiwa da kwan nyina mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔrodwendwen ho no, ɔkɔr John a ɔnoara so wɔfrɛ no Mark no ne na Mary fie, mbrɛ dodowara aboa ano robɔ mpaa no.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbɔɔ paado abow no mu no, abaawa bi a ne dzin dze Roda bae betsiei;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔtsee Peter ne ndze no, dɛw ntsi oemmbue abow no, na otutuu mbirika kɔr mu kɛkaa dɛ Peter gyina abow no ekyir.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Ɔwoara w’adwen nnyɛ edwuma. Na ɔkɔr do ara kaa dɛ ɔtse dɛm. Na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔyɛ no bɔfoe.
title: ACTS

text: Na Peter kɔr do ara bɔɔ mu; na wobuei no, wohun no, na hɔn ho boow hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔdze ne nsa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnyɛ komm, na ɔkaa mbrɛ Ewuradze duae yii no fii efiadze no kyerɛɛ hɔn; na ɔsee dɛ, Hom nkɛka nsɛm yi nkyerɛ James nye enuanom no. Na ofii hɔ kɔr beebi.
title: ACTS

text: Na adze kyee no, wentwiwentwi kɛsenara na ɔbaa nsordaafo no mu dɛ, ebɛnadze ara na ayɛ Peter.
title: ACTS

text: Na Herod hwehwɛɛ no, na oennhu no no, ɔnye aweɔmfo no kɔr nhwehwɛmu, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wonkoku hɔn. Na ofii Judea kɔr Kaesarea kɛtsenaa hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na Herod nyaa Taefo nye Sidonfo ho ebufuw no; wɔyɛɛ adwenkor baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔbɛfaa ɔhen no ne pianyi Blastus nyɛnko, na woduaa no do serɛɛ amandwee, osiandɛ nna wonya hɔn edziban fi ɔhen no ne nsaase do.
title: ACTS

text: Na da a wɔhyɛe no durii no, Herod hyɛɛ n’ahentar, na ɔtsenaa asɛndzii egua do, na ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ ɔman no.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔman no bɔɔ ose dɛ, Ampa, Nyame bi ndze nye yi, na nnyɛ nyimpa dze bi a!
title: ACTS

text: Na ntsɛmara Ewuradze no bɔfoe bɔbɔɔ no, osiandɛ ɔammfa enyimnyam amma Nyankopɔn: na nsaamaa dzii no honam ma owui.
title: ACTS

text: Na Nyankopɔn asɛm nyinii, na ɔtserɛwee.
title: ACTS

text: Na Barnabas nye Saul wiee hɔn som no, wɔsanee fii Jerusalɛm na wɔfaa John a wɔtoo no Mark so no kaa hɔn ho.
title: ACTS

text: Nna asɔr a ɔwɔ Antiok no, nkɔnhyɛfo nye akyerɛkyerɛfo bi wɔ mu, hɔn nye Barnabas nye Simeon a wɔfrɛ no Niger nye Lusius, Sirenenyi no nye Manaen a wɔtsetsee ɔno nye ɔmansinhen Herod bɔɔ mu no, nye Saul.
title: ACTS

text: Na aber a wɔrosɔr Ewuradze, na woridzi mbuada no, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no see hɔn dɛ, Hom nyi Barnabas nye Saul mma me ma wɔnkɛyɛ edwuma a osian ntsi ma mafrɛ hɔn no.
title: ACTS

text: Nna wodzii mbuada, na wɔbɔɔ mpaa dze hɔn nsa guu hɔn do, na wogyaa hɔn kwan.
title: ACTS

text: Na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no somaa hɔn dɛm no, wosii mu kɔr Selusia, na wofii hɔ nam hɛn mu kɔr Siprus.
title: ACTS

text: Na wodur Salamis no, wɔkaa Nyankopɔn n’asɛm no wɔ Jewfo nhyiamudan mu; na wonyaa John so dɛ hɔn somfo.
title: ACTS

text: Na wotwaa mu wɔ supruw no mu kodur Pafos no, wokohun osumantunyi nkɔnhyɛnyi torfo, Jewnyi bi a ne dzin dze Bar-Jesus a
title: ACTS

text: ɔwɔ ambrado Sergius Paulus a ɔyɛ ɔbadwembafo no nkyɛn. Ɔno na ɔfrɛɛ Barnabas nye Saul, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ otsie Nyankopɔn asɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na Elimas nkongyaayinyi no (mbrɛ ne dzin ne nkyerɛase tse nye no) siiw hɔn kwan, na ɔhwehwɛɛ dɛ ɔdan ambrado no fi gyedzi no ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na Saul a ɔnoara so wɔfrɛ no Paul a Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahyɛ no ma no, dze n’enyi tsiim no do,
title: ACTS

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Wo a ndaadaa nye emumuyɛ nyina ahyɛ wo ma, abɔnsam ba, tsenenee nyina tamfo, ana innkegyaa dɛ ekontom Ewuradze no kwan a ɔtsen yi?
title: ACTS

text: Na afei, hwɛ, Ewuradze nsa da wo do, na w’enyi bofura, na irunnhu ewia dze ekesi da bi. Na amonmu hɔ ara na fua nye sum dwiir no do, na okyinii hwehwɛɛ binom a wobosuo ne nsamu akyerɛ no kwan.
title: ACTS

text: Aber a ambrado no hun dza esi no, ɔgyee dzii, na Ewuradze ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no yɛɛ no ahobow.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul nye hɔn a wɔnye no nam no tui fii Pafos, na wɔbaa Perga a ɔwɔ Pamfilia: na John fii hɔn nkyɛn sanee kɔr Jerusalɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn dze, wotwaa mu wɔ Perga no, wɔbaa Antiok wɔ Pisidia; na wɔkɔr nhyiamudan mu ahomgyeda kɛtsenaa hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na wowiee mbra no nye nkɔnhyɛfo kenkan no, nhyiamudan mu mpanyimfo no somae ma wɔbɛsee hɔn dɛ, Enuanom, sɛ hom wɔ afotusɛm bi ka kyerɛ nkorɔfo no a, hom nka.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul soɛree gyinae, na onyinaam ne nsa kyerɛɛ hɔn see dɛ: Israel mbarimba, nye hom a hom suro Nyankopɔn, hom ntsie.
title: ACTS

text: Israelman yi hɔn Nyankopɔn no saan mu yii hɛn egyanom, na ɔman no tsenaa Egypt asaase do dɛ ahɔho no, ɔmaa hɔn do, na ɔdze nsa a ɔkrɔn yii hɔn fii hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na bɛyɛ mfe eduanan na osiee hɔn ho abotar dandaan hɔn wɔ sar no do.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbɔɔ amantɔw esuon wɔ Keenan asaase do no, ɔdze hɔn asaase maa hɔn dɛ egyapadze, bɛyɛ mfe ahaanan eduonum;
title: ACTS

text: na n’ekyir no ɔmaa hɔn atsɛmbuafo dze bodur nkɔnhyɛnyi Samuel do.
title: ACTS

text: Na nkyii wobisaa ɔhen; na Nyankopɔn dze Saul Kish ba no a ofi Benjamin ebusuakuw mu maa hɔn mfe eduanan.
title: ACTS

text: Na otuu no no, ɔmaa David do hyɛɛ no hen maa hɔn, ɔno so na ɔgyee no ho dase dɛ, Mehu David, Jesse ba no, ɔbarimba a mankasa m’akoma da no ho: ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ m’apɛdze nyina.
title: ACTS

text: Oyi n’asefo mu na Nyankopɔn nam anohoba do eyi Jesus ayɛ Agyenkwa ama Israel;
title: ACTS

text: John dzii kan kaa nnuho enuma ho asɛm kyerɛɛ Israelman nyina ansaana ɔbae.
title: ACTS

text: Na John reyɛ ewie no dwuma dzi no, ɔsee dɛ, Hom susu dɛ emi nye woana? Nnyɛ emi nye no. Na hwɛ, obi dzi m’ekyir reba a mennsɛ dɛ mesan n’ananadze nsokota.
title: ACTS

text: Enuanom, Abraham asefo, nye hom mu obiara a osuro Nyankopɔn no, hɛn na wɔasoma nkwagye asɛm yi abrɛ hɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wɔtse Jerusalɛm nye hɔn mu etsitsir, osiandɛ wonnyim ɔno nye nkɔnhyɛfo no ndze a wɔkenkan no ahomgyeda nyina ntsi, wobuu no fɔ ma ɔbaa mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na woennhu biribiara a ɔfata wu wɔ no mu, naaso wɔserɛɛ Pilate dɛ onku no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wowiee dza wɔakyerɛw wɔ no ho nyina ma hyɛ no, woyii no fii dua no ho dze no kɔtoo nda mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na Nyankopɔn nyaan no fii ewufo mu;
title: ACTS

text: na oyii noho nda pii kyerɛɛ hɔn a wɔnye no fii Galilii baa Jerusalɛm: hɔn nye n’adasefo ma ɔman no.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɛn dze, yɛka hom anohoba a wɔbɔɔ egyanom no no ho asɛmpa,
title: ACTS

text: dɛ Nyankopɔn ama aba mu ama hɛn mba, dɛ oenyan Jesus; dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw wɔ ndwom a otsia ebien no mu dɛ, Ɔwo nye me Ba, ndɛ na mawo wo.
title: ACTS

text: Na dɛ onyaan no fii ewufo mu ma ɔronnkɔ mprɔwee mu bio no, ɔkaa no dɛm dɛ, Mebɛma hom adom krɔnkrɔn a osi pi a medze bɔɔ David anohoba no.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi so ɔka wɔ ndwom fofor bi mu dɛ, Ennkɛma wo Krɔnkrɔnnyi no ehu mprɔwee.
title: ACTS

text: Na David dze, ɔsoomee wɔ nankasa ne santsen mu wiei wɔ Nyankopɔn n’apɛdze no, ɔkɔr ne kra ekyir, na wokesiee no n’egyanom nkyɛn, na ohun mprɔwee:
title: ACTS

text: na nyia Nyankopɔn nyaan no no dze, oennhu mprɔwee.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, hom nhu dɛ ɔnam oyi do na wɔka bɔnfakyɛ kyerɛ hom;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔnam oyi do na ndzɛmba nyina a ɔnam Moses mbra do a hom enntum enndzi ho bem no, obiara a ɔgye dzi no odzi ho bem.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie mma dza wɔkaa no nkɔnhyɛfo mu no aammba hom do, dɛ;
title: ACTS

text: Hom nhwɛ, hom atwetwesifo! Ɔnyɛ hom nwanwa, na hom nhera: Osiandɛ mereyɛ edwuma bi wɔ hom nda mu, Edwuma a obi ka kyerɛ hom mpo a, hom renngye nndzi.
title: ACTS

text: Na wopuei no, wɔserɛɛ hɔn dɛ ahomgyeda bi so wɔmbɛka nsɛm yi nkyerɛ hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔpoon nhyiamudan mu som no, Jewfo nye nyamesurofo a wɔdan Jewfo no mu pii kaa Paul nye Barnabas do: na hɔn dze, wɔkasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn tuu hɔn fo dɛ wɔntsena Nyankopɔn adom no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na ahomgyeda a odzi do no durii no, ɔka kakraabi ma nkyɛ kurow mu no nyina ebehyia dɛ woribetsie Nyankopɔn asɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jewfo no hun nyimpadodow no, nyinkun hyɛɛ hɔn ma, na wɔkasae tsiaa ndzɛmba a Paul reka ho asɛm no gyee kyim, na wɔkaa ebususɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul nye Barnabas dze ndam kaa dɛ, Ohia dɛ wodzi kan ka Nyankopɔn asɛm no kyerɛ hom. Na osiandɛ hom sun kyen, na hom bu homho dɛ hom nnsɛ onnyiewiei nkwa no ntsi, hwɛ, yɛdan kɔ amanamamfo no hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na dɛmara na Ewuradze ahyɛ hɛn dɛ, Medze wo esi hɔ dɛ kandzea ama amanamamfo, Ama aayɛ nkwagye ekodu asaase ano noho.
title: ACTS

text: Na amanamamfo no tsee yi no, wodzii dɛw, na wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm no enyimnyam; na dodow a woeyi hɔn ama onnyiewiei nkwa no wɔgyee dzii.
title: ACTS

text: Na Ewuradze n’asɛm no tserɛwee wɔ asaase no nyina do.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jewfo no wee guu mbaa nyamesurofo a wɔwɔ dzin, nye kurow no mu etsitsir no aso mu, na wɔmaa ahohiahia kɛse baa Paul nye Barnabas do, na wɔpaam hɔn fii hɔn nkwaado.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn dze, wɔporoporoow hɔn anan ho huntuma guu hɔn do, na wɔbaa Ikonium.
title: ACTS

text: Na esuafo no dze, dɛw nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn hyɛɛ hɔn ma.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ Ikonium so wɔkɔr Jewfo nhyiamudan no mu, na wɔkɛkaa asɛm ma Jewfo nye Griikfo nyimpadodow pii gyee dzii.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jewfo asoɔdzenfo no kenyaan amanamamfo no, na wɔmaa wonyaa adwen bɔn wɔ enuanom no ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na dɛm ntsi wɔtsenaa hɔ kyɛree, na wɔkasaa ndam do wɔ Ewuradze mu, na no so dzii n’adom asɛm no ho dase, na ɔnam hɔn nsa do yɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze.
title: ACTS

text: Na kurow no mu nyimpadodow no mu paae, na ɔfa dzii Jewfo no afa, na ɔfa so dzii asomafo no afa.
title: ACTS

text: Na amanamamfo nye Jewfo nye hɔn etsitsir bɔɔ kyirididi baa dɛ wɔrobɔbɔ hɔn adapaa na woesiw hɔn abo no,
title: ACTS

text: wohunii na woguanee kɔr Likaonia nkurow Listra nye Derbe nye asaase a oehyia hɔ no do:
title: ACTS

text: na hɔ na wɔkɛkaa asɛmpa no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Listra hɔ ɔbarimba bi tse hɔ a ne nan mu nnyɛ dzen, ɔyɛ obubuafo fi ne na yamu a ɔnnantseew da.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔno na Paul rekasa no otsiee no. Na Paul dze, ɔdze n’enyi tsiim no do, na ohun dɛ ɔwɔ gyedzi dɛ no ho bɛsan no,
title: ACTS

text: ɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu dɛ, Soɛr gyina wo nan do tsentsen. Na ohuruhuruwii na ɔnantsewee.
title: ACTS

text: Na nyimpadodow no hun dza Paul ayɛ no, wɔmaa hɔn ndze do kae wɔ Likaonia kasa mu dɛ, Enyame eyiyi hɔnho dɛ nyimpa esiansian aba hɛn nkyɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔfrɛɛ Barnabas Zeus, nye Paul Hermes, osiandɛ ɔno nye ɔsɛnkafo tsitsir no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Zeus a ɔwɔ kurow no enyim no sɔfoe dze anantwinyin nye nhyiren katraka baa kurow no n’abowano, dɛ ɔnye nyimpadodow no robɔbɔ afɔr.
title: ACTS

text: Na asomafo Barnabas nye Paul tsee no, wosunsuaan hɔn ntar mu, na wotutuu mbirika kɔdɔɔ nyimpadodow no mu
title: ACTS

text: tseaa mu dɛ, Mbarimba, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom reyɛ yinom yi? Hɛn so yɛyɛ hom saso nyimpa dɛ homara, na yɛka asɛmpa kyerɛ hom dɛ hom ndan mfi egyangyandze yi ho nkɔ tseasefo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn: ɔno na ɔbɔɔ sor nye asaase nye po, nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyina:
title: ACTS

text: ɔno na mbersantsen a oebotwa mu no, ɔmaa amanaman nyina kwan dɛ wɔnnantsew hɔnankasa hɔn akwan mu.
title: ACTS

text: Naaso oenngyaa no ho adasedzi, dɛ ɔyɛɛ ayamuyie, na ɔdze nsu fii sor maa hom, nye ndɔbaaber, na ɔdze edziban nye abotɔyamu hyɛɛ hom akoma ma.
title: ACTS

text: Na nsɛm a wɔkae nyina ekyir no, wɔfonae ansaana worutum esiw nyimpadodow no kwan dɛ mma wɔmmbɔ afɔr mma hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jewfo bi fii Antiok nye Ikonium baa hɔ, na wɔwee guu nyimpadodow no aso mu ma wosiiw Paul abo, na wɔtwee no fiir kurow no mu a nna wosusu dɛ oewu.
title: ACTS

text: Na esuafo no begyinaa no ho hyiae no, ɔsoɛree na ɔkɔr kurow no mu; na adze kyee no ɔnye Barnabas fii hɔ kɔr Derbe.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔkaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ kurow no na wɔyɛɛ dodowara esuafo no, wɔsanee baa Listra, Ikonium nye Antiok,
title: ACTS

text: bɛhyehyɛɛ esuafo no nkuran, na wotutuu hɔn fo dɛ wɔntsena gyedzi no mu, na afei so otwar dɛ yedua ahohia pii mu kɔ Nyankopɔn ahenman no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔhyehyɛɛ mpanyimfo wɔ asɔr nyina mu, na wodzii mbuada yɛɛ asɔr no, wɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ Ewuradze a wɔgyee no dzii no ne nsa.
title: ACTS

text: Na wotwaa mu wɔ Pisidia no, wɔbaa Pamfilia.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔkaa asɛm no wɔ Perga no, wosianee bodur Atalia;
title: ACTS

text: ofi hɔ na wɔfaa nsuenyi baa Antiok mbrɛ wɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ Nyankopɔn adom nsa maa edwuma a woekowie dzi no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔbae no, wɔfrɛfrɛɛ asɔrmba no boaa ano, na wɔkaa dza Nyankopɔn dze hɔn akɛyɛ nyina, na mbrɛ oebue gyedzi abow no ama amanamamfo no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔnye esuafo no tsenaa hɔ ma ɔkyɛree.
title: ACTS

text: Na nkorɔfo bi fii Judea bae bɛkyerɛkyerɛɛ enuanom no dɛ, Sɛ woenntwa hɔn twatsia dɛ mbrɛ Moses amambra tse a, worunntum nnya nkwagye.
title: ACTS

text: Na akasakasa nye ekyingye pii baa Paul nye Barnabas na hɔn ntamu no, wɔhyɛɛ dɛ asɛm no ntsi Paul nye Barnabas nye hɔn mu binom nkɔ asomafo no nye mpanyimfo no hɔ wɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na asɔrmba no begyaa hɔn kwan no, wokotwaa mu wɔ Fonisia nye Samaria kaa amanamamfo hɔn nnuhu no ho asɛm; na iyi maa enuanom no nyina dzii dɛw kɛse.
title: ACTS

text: Na wodur Jerusalɛm no, asɔrmba nye asomafo nye mpanyimfo no maa hɔn akɔaba, na wɔkaa dza Nyankopɔn dze hɔn ayɛ nyina kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na binom a wofi Farisiifo fɛkuw no mu a wɔagye edzi no soɛree na wɔsee dɛ, Ɔsɛ dɛ wotwa hɔn twatsia na wɔhyɛ hɔn ma wodzi Moses mbra no do.
title: ACTS

text: Na asomafo nye mpanyimfo no tuu egyina dwendween asɛm yi ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔgyee kyim pii wɔ ho no, Peter soɛree, na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Enuanom, homankasa hom nyim mbrɛ Nyankopɔn sii saan mu yii me fii hom mu dadaada, dɛ amanamamfo mfa m’ano do ntsie asɛmpa no, na wɔngye ndzi.
title: ACTS

text: Na Nyankopɔn a onyim akoma mu no edzi hɔn dase, ɔama hɔn Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no, dɛ mbrɛ ɔdze maa hɛn so;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔamma soronko bi ammba yɛnye hɔn ntamu, na ɔnam gyedzi do atsew hɔn akoma mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei ɔyɛ dɛn na hom rosɔ Nyankopɔn hwɛ, dɛ hom dze kɔndua a hɛn egyanom nye hɛn enntum annsoa bɔto esuafo no kɔn do yi?
title: ACTS

text: Na yɛgye dzi dɛ ɔnam Ewuradze Jesus n’adom do na wɔbɛgye hɛn dɛ hɔn so.
title: ACTS

text: Na nyimpadodow no nyina yɛɛ dzinn: na wotsiee Barnabas nye Paul a wɔreka nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze a Nyankopɔn nam hɔn do ayɛ wɔ amanaman no mu no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔyɛɛ dzinn no, James buaa dɛ: Enuanom, hom ntsie me:
title: ACTS

text: Simeon aka mbrɛ asɔpɔn no Nyankopɔn bɔhwɛɛ amanaman, dɛ oribeyi hɔn mu ɔman ama ne dzin.
title: ACTS

text: Na iyi so na nkɔnhyɛfo no nsɛm nye no saa, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Yinom ekyir no, mebɛsan Esi David ntamadan a ɔahwe ase no bio; Na mesi dza oedwuruw no bio. Na mama do esi,
title: ACTS

text: Ma nyimpa nkaa no aahwehwɛ Ewuradze ekyir kwan, Nye amanaman a wɔabɔ me dzin wɔ hɔn do nyina.
title: ACTS

text: Ewuradze a ofi wiadze ahyɛse yi, yinom kyerɛ dɛ wonyim no no, na ɔse.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi m’asɛm a mowɔ ka nye dɛ mma yɛnnhaw hɔn a wofi amanaman mu adan aba Nyankopɔn hɔ no;
title: ACTS

text: na mbom yɛnkyerɛw nkɛma hɔn dɛ wonyi hɔnho mfi ehonyi efifidze, nye ndwamansɛm nye mbowa a woennhue hɔn bɔgyaa enngu na wowuwui, nye bɔgya ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na ofi tsetse mbersantsen na Moses wɔ hɔn a wɔka no ho asɛm wɔ nkurow nyina mu, wɔkenkaan no wɔ nhyiamudan mu ahomgyeda daa.
title: ACTS

text: Nna ɔsɔɔ asomafo nye mpanyimfo nye asɔrmba no nyina enyi dɛ wɔpa hɔn mu mbarimba bi a wɔbɔsoma hɔn aka Paul nye Barnabas ho akɔ Antiok: hɔn nye Judas a wɔfrɛ no Barsabas nye Silas, enuanom no mu etsitsir bi:
title: ACTS

text: na wɔkyerɛɛw nwoma hyɛɛ hɔn nsa dɛ, Asomafo nye enuanom mpanyimfo no kyia enuanom a wofi amanaman mu wɔ Antiok nye Siria nye Silisia:
title: ACTS

text: Susuampa dɛ yɛatse dɛ binom a wofii hɛn mu kɔree dze nsɛm abɛhaw hom asɛɛ hom adwen, naaso yɛannhyɛ hɔn dɛm ntsi,
title: ACTS

text: ɔyɛɛ hɛn dɛ oye dɛ yɛayɛ anokor yi, yɛpa mbarimba na yɛsoma hɔn nye hɛn adɔfo Barnabas nye Paul a wɔyɛ
title: ACTS

text: nyimpa a hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ntsi wɔdze hɔn nkwa ama no ba hom nkyɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi yɛasoma Judas nye Silas a wɔdze hɔn ano so bɛka hom nsɛm no ara.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsɔɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no nye hɛn so enyiwa dɛ yɛnnkɛfa adzesoa biara ato hom do dɛ dza ohia yi ara:
title: ACTS

text: dɛ hom nyi homho mfi nam a wɔdze abɔ afɔr ama ehonyi, nye bɔgya, nye mbowa a woennhue hɔn bɔgyaa enngu na wowuwui nye ndwamansɛm ho: ɔno na sɛ hom yi homho fi ho a, obowie hom yie. Onsi hom yie.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei wogyaa hɔn kwan no, wɔbaa Antiok, na wɔboaboaa nyimpadodow no ano no, woyii nwoma no mae.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔkenkanee no, wodzii dɛw wɔ awerɛkyekyer no ntsi.
title: ACTS

text: Na Judas nye Silas a hɔnara so yɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no, dze nsɛm pii tuu enuanom no fo, na wɔhyɛɛ hɔn dzen.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔkyɛɛr hɔ kakra no, enuanom no gyaa hɔn kwan dwudwoodwo ma wɔkɔr hɔn a wɔsomaa hɔn no hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: [Naaso Silas pɛɛ dɛ ɔbɛtsena hɔ ara.]
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul nye Barnabas tsenaa Antiok, wɔnye dodowara a wɔka hɔn ho, wɔkyerɛkyerɛe na wɔkaa Ewuradze n’asɛmpa.
title: ACTS

text: Na nda bi twaa mu no, Paul see Barnabas dɛ, Ma yɛnsan nkɛsera enuanom no wɔ nkurow a yɛkaa Ewuradze n’asɛm wɔ hɔ nyina mu, nkɔhwɛ mbrɛ wɔtse.
title: ACTS

text: Na Barnabas pɛɛ dɛ wɔbɛfa John a wɔfrɛ no Mark no aka hɔnho.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul anndwen dɛ oye dɛ wɔbɛfa nyia ɔtwee noho fii hɔn ho wɔ Pamfilia, na ɔnye hɔn annkɔ annkɛyɛ edwuma no, aka hɔnho.
title: ACTS

text: Na akasakasa a ɔyɛ dzen bae, ma hɔn ntamu tsetsewee, na Barnabas faa Mark faa nsuenyi kɔr Siprus;
title: ACTS

text: Paul dze ɔfaa Silas, na enuanom no dze no hyɛɛ Ewuradze adom nsa no, osii mu kɔree.
title: ACTS

text: Na okotwaa mu wɔ Siria nye Silisia hyɛɛ asɔrasɔr no dzen.
title: ACTS

text: Na okodur Derbe nye Listra so: na hwɛ, Osuanyi bi wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Timoti a ɔyɛ Jewnyi ɔbaa bi a ɔbɛyɛɛ gyedzinyi no ne ba, na n’egya dze, ɔyɛ Griiknyi.
title: ACTS

text: Oyi na enuanom a wɔwɔ Listra nye Ikonium no bɔɔ no dzin pa.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul pɛɛ dɛ ɔnye no kɔ, na ɔfaa no twaa no twatsia osian Jewfo a wɔwɔ apaa mu hɔ no ntsi, osiandɛ hɔn nyina nyim dɛ n’egya yɛ Griiknyi.
title: ACTS

text: Na worutwa mu wɔ nkurow no mu no, wɔdze mbra a asomafo nye mpanyimfo a wɔwɔ Jerusalɛm hyɛe no maa hɔn dɛ wondzi do.
title: ACTS

text: Na asɔr horow no yɛɛ ndam wɔ gyedzi no mu, na hɔn dodow kɔr sor daa.
title: ACTS

text: Na wokotwaa mu wɔ Frigyia nye Galatia asaase do, na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no braa hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnka asɛm no wɔ Asia;
title: ACTS

text: na wɔbaa Misia tsentsendo no, wɔpɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ wɔbɔkɔ Bitinia; na Jesus no Sunsum amma hɔn kwan;
title: ACTS

text: na wɔpaa Misia ho baa Troas.
title: ACTS

text: Na anadwe no, Paul nyaa enyido adzehu dɛ Masidonia ɔbarimba bi gyina hɔ reserɛ no dɛ, Twa bra Masidonia bɔboa hɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na ohun enyido adze no, ntsɛmara na yɛhyehyɛɛ dɛ yerisi mu akɔ Masidonia, osiandɛ yehun no ampa dɛ Ewuradze afrɛ hɛn dɛ yɛnkɛka asɛmpa no nkyerɛ hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi yetui fii Troas tseen hɛnho baa Samotreesi, na adze kyee no yɛbaa Neapolis;
title: ACTS

text: na yefii hɔ baa Filipi a ɔyɛ kuropɔn wɔ Masidonia a ɔyɛ mansin no mu; na yedzii kurow yi mu nda kakra.
title: ACTS

text: Na ahomgyeda no yefii kuropɔn no mu kɔr esutsen ho wɔ beebi a yɛdween dɛ asɔryɛbea bi wɔ, na yɛtsenaa ase na yɛkasaa kyerɛɛ mbaa a woebehyia hɔ no.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa bi a ne dzin dze Lidia a ɔtɔn tam memen, nyamesuronyi a ofi Tiatira kurow mu no tsee: ɔno na Ewuradze buee n’akoma dɛ ontsie dza Paul kae no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wonumaa ɔno nye ne fiemba no, ɔserɛɛ dɛ, Sɛ hom ebu me dɛ megye Ewuradze dzi ara ampa a, hom mbra me fie mbɛtsena hɔ. Na ɔserɛɛ hɛn araa ma yɛnye no kɔree.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ yɛrokɔ asɔryɛbea no, abaawa bi a ɔwɔ akɔm sunsum behyiaa hɛn, ɔno na ɔdze akɔm ama no wuranom enya hɔnho twom.
title: ACTS

text: Odzii Paul nye hɛn ekyir, na ɔtseaa mu dɛ, Nyimpa yi yɛ Ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn nkowaa a wɔkyerɛ hom nkwagye kwan.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ iyi nda pii. Na ɔyɛɛ Paul ahomtsew na ɔdaan noho see sunsum no dɛ, Mehyɛ wo wɔ Jesus Kraest dzin mu dɛ fi no mu fi. Na ofiir edzi dɔn no ara mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na no wuranom hun dɛ hɔn adzenya enyidado asa no wosusuoo Paul nye Silas mu twee hɔn kɔr gua do etsitsir no enyim,
title: ACTS

text: na wɔdze hɔn kɛmaa asɛndzifo no dɛ, Nyimpa yi a wɔyɛ Jewfo yi, wɔretan hɛn kurow yi enyi,
title: ACTS

text: na wɔrekyerɛkyerɛ amambra a yennyi ho kwan dɛ yɛgye anaadɛ yɛyɛ, ɔnam dɛ yɛyɛ Romefo ntsi.
title: ACTS

text: Na nyimpadodow no soɛree tsiaa hɔn; na asɛndzifo no tsetseew hɔn ntar mu fii hɔnho, na wɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmbɔ hɔn mbaa.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔbɔɔ hɔn mbaa pii no, wɔdze hɔn koguu efiadze, na wɔhyɛɛ efiadzehwɛnyi no dɛ ɔmfa hɔn nsie yie;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔnodze, ɔgyee dɛm ahyɛdze yi no, ɔdze hɔn koguu efiadze a ɔwɔ ekyir no mu, na ɔbɔɔ hɔn anan dua mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na esuom no, Paul nye Silas bɔɔ mpaa na wɔtoow ndwom maa Nyankopɔn, na adaduafo no tsiee hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na awerɛfir mu ara asaasewosow kɛse bae ma efiadze no fapem hihimii, na amonmu hɔ ara mbobow no nyina buebuei, na hɔn nyina hɔn nkyehoma sansanee.
title: ACTS

text: Na efiadzehwɛnyi no nyanee fii nda mu, na ohun dɛ efiadze mbobow no ebuebue no, ɔtwee n’afona dɛ oribedzi noho ewu osiandɛ ɔdween dɛ adaduafo no eguanguan.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul dze ndze kɛse tseaa mu dɛ, Mma nnyɛ woho bɔn bi, na hɛn nyina wɔ ha.
title: ACTS

text: Na obisaa kandzea dze ntsɛmpɛ kɔr mu, na ɔdze ahopopo kɔhwee Paul nye Silas enyim,
title: ACTS

text: na ɔdze hɔn fiir edzi, na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuranom, ebɛnadze na menyɛ ma wɔngye me nkwa?
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Gye Ewuradze Jesus dzi, na wɔbɛgye ɔwo nye wo fifo nkwa.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔkaa Ewuradze n’asɛm no kyerɛɛ ɔno nye hɔn a wɔwɔ ne fie nyina.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔfaa hɔn anadwe dɔn no ara mu hohoor hɔn mbaa no ano, na ɔmaa wonumaa ɔno nye hɔn a wɔyɛ nedze nyina amonmu hɔ ara.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔdze hɔn baa ne fie, na ɔtoo hɔn pon, na no ho sɛpɛɛw no, ɔnye ne fiemba nyina, osiandɛ ɔagye Nyankopɔn edzi.
title: ACTS

text: Na adze kyee no, asɛndzifo no somaa nsordaafo baa dɛ, Gyaa nyimpa no ma wɔnkɔ.
title: ACTS
