text: Na efiadzehwɛnyi no kaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ Paul dɛ, Asɛndzifo no asoma dɛ wongyaa hom ma hom nkɔ: dɛm ntsi afei hom mpue nkɔ dwudwoodwo.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul see hɔn dɛ, Woemmbu hɛn atsɛn, na wɔahwe hɛn a yɛyɛ Romefo wɔ gua do, na wɔdze hɛn egu efiadze, na afei worigyaa hɛn wɔ nsumaa mu anaa? Dabida! Na ma hɔnara mbra mbeyi hɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na nsordaafo no kɛkaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ asɛndzifo no, na wɔtsee dɛ wɔyɛ Romefo no, wosuroi;
title: ACTS

text: na wɔbae bɛpaa hɔn kyɛw maa hɔn dzibem, na woyii hɔn na wɔserɛɛ hɔn dɛ womfi kurow no mu nkɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na wofii efiadze hɔ kɔr Lidia fie, na wohun enuanom no, wɔhyɛɛ hɔn nkuran, na wofii hɔ kɔree.
title: ACTS

text: Na wokotwaa mu wɔ Amfipolis nye Apollonia no, wɔbaa Tesalonika mbrɛ Jewfo nhyiamudan bi wɔ:
title: ACTS

text: na dɛ mbrɛ Paul tɔ yɛ no, ɔkɔr mu wɔ hɔn nkyɛn ahomgyeda ebiasa, na ɔnye hɔn yɛɛ mpɛnsampɛnsamu wɔ kyerɛwnsɛm no mu,
title: ACTS

text: na obuee asɛm no do kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn mu kofee dɛ otwar dɛ Kraest no hu amandze, na ɔsoɛr fi ewufo mu; na ɔkae sɔɔw do dɛ, Jesus a meka hom no ho asɛm yi ɔnoara nye Kraest no.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn mu binom gyee dzii, na wɔdze hɔnho bɔɔ Paul nye Silas ho, a Griikfo nyamesurofo nyimpadodow pii, nye mbaa a wɔyɛ etsitsir so pii ka ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jewfo no dze, nyinkun kaa hɔn, na wɔfaa ehuhufo no mu nyimpa bɔn bi kaa hɔn ho, na wɔmaa nyimpadodow behyiae, na wɔmaa kurow no mu yɛɛ wentwiwentwi, na wɔkɛkyeer Jason dan ho hwehwɛɛ dɛ woyi hɔn pue kɛma nkorɔfo no.
title: ACTS

text: Na woennhu hɔn no, wotwuuw Jason nye enuanom no bi adze kɛmaa kurow no mu etsitsir no, na wɔtseatseaa mu dɛ, Yinom a wɔadan wiadze tsir esi famu yi, wɔaba ha so:
title: ACTS

text: hɔn na Jason agye hɔn esie, na hɔn nyina yɛ dza otsia Kaesar mbransɛm no, eso wɔka dɛ ɔhen fofor bi so wɔ hɔ, Jesus bi.
title: ACTS

text: Na iyi haaw nyimpadodow no nye kurow no mu etsitsir a wɔtsee yinom no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔmaa Jason nye nkaa no dzii egyinamu maa hɔn no, wɔmaa wɔkɔree.
title: ACTS

text: Na ntsɛmara enuanom no gyaa Paul nye Silas kwan anadwe kɔr Beroa, na wodur hɔ no, wɔkɔr Jewfo nhyiamudan no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na iyinom yɛ enyimdzefo sen hɔn a wɔwɔ Tesalonika, osiandɛ wosiesiee hɔn adwen mu tsiee asɛm no, na wɔhwehwɛɛ kyerɛwnsɛm no mu daa, kyerɛ dɛ ndzɛmba yi tse dɛm anaa.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi hɔn mu dodowara gyee dzii, nye Griikfo mbaa a wɔwɔ dzin, nye mbarimba no so pii.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jewfo a wɔwɔ Tesalonika tsee dɛ Paul akɛka Nyankopɔn asɛm no wɔ Beroa so no, wɔbaa hɔ so na wobohuur nyimpadodow no akoma na wɔhaaw hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei ntsɛmara enuanom no gyaa Paul kwan dɛ ɔnkɔ po ho, na Silas nye Timoti dze, wɔtsenaa hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wokegyaa Paul kwan no dze no kɔree kodur Atens, na ɔmaa hɔn nkra dɛ Silas nye Timoti mbra ne nkyɛn ntsɛntsɛm no, wosii mu kɔree.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul rotweɔn hɔn wɔ Atens no, ohun dɛ abosonsom ahyɛ kurow no ma, na ɔyɛɛ no ahomtsew pii.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔnye Jewfo nye nyamesurofo no yɛɛ nhwehwɛmu dzendzenndzen wɔ nhyiamudan mu, na guado so daa nyina ɔnye hɔn a ohyiaa hɔn no dzii anokɔnkɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na Epikurufo nye Stoafo enyansapɛfo bi so nye no dzii anokɔnkɔn. Na binom see dɛ, Ɔkasakasafo yi se dɛn nye yi? Binom so see dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛ ɔka anana abosom bi ho asɛm: osiandɛ ɔkaa Jesus nye wusoɛr no ho asɛmpa no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wosuoo no mu dze no kɔr Areopagus dɛ, Ana yebotum ehu nkyerɛkyerɛ fofor a erekyerɛ yi?
title: ACTS

text: Na edze nsɛm fofor bi aba hɛn asomu: dɛm ntsi yɛpɛ dɛ yɛtse ndzɛmba yi ase.
title: ACTS

text: (Osiandɛ nna Atensefo nye ahɔho a wɔabɛtsena hɔ nyina, wonnya biribiara ho adagyer ka dɛ wɔbɛka anaadɛ wobetsie asɛm fofor bi.)
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul gyinaa Areopagus finimfin, na ɔsee dɛ: Atens mbarimba, mehu dɛ hom wɔ gyedzi wɔ ndzɛmba pii mu dodow.
title: ACTS

text: Na murutwa mu, na mohwɛɛ hom adze a hom sɔr no, muhun afɔrmbukyia so a wɔakyerɛw do dɛ, NYAME A WONNYIM NO DZE A. Dɛm ntsi nyia hom nnyim na hom sɔr no no, ɔno na mereka no ho asɛm kyerɛ hom yi.
title: ACTS

text: Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛɛ wiadze nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyina, ɔno a ɔyɛ sor nye asaase wura no ntsi, ɔnntse asɔrdan a wɔdze nsa ayɛ mu;
title: ACTS

text: eso wɔnndze nyimpa nsa som no, dɛ gyama ohia no biribi, osiandɛ ɔno na ɔma nyimpa nyina nkwa nye ahom nye adze nyina;
title: ACTS

text: na ofi adze kor mu yɛɛ nyimpa amanaman nyina, dɛ wɔntsena asaase enyi nyina, na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn hyɛber, nye hɔn tsenabea he too hɔ,
title: ACTS

text: dɛ wɔnhwehwɛ Nyankopɔn, dɛ bi a hɔn nsa bɛka no, na woehu no, naaso ɔnye hɛn mu biara ntamu kwan nnwar koraa:
title: ACTS

text: na no mu na yɛtse ase, na yɛkeka hɛnho, na yɛwɔ hɔ; dɛ mbrɛ homankasa hom ndwomkyerɛwfo binom aka dɛ, Hɛn nyinara so yɛ ne mbanana.
title: ACTS

text: Na osiandɛ yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ne mbanana ntsi, ɔnnsɛ dɛ yesusu dɛ Nyame suban tse dɛ sika anaa dwetɛ, anaa ɔbo, edwin a nyimpa dze ne nyansaa nye n’adwen edzi.
title: ACTS

text: Na mber a wonnyim no dze, Nyankopɔn buu enyi guu do, na afei dze, ɔhyɛ nyimpa nyina wɔ mbea nyina dɛ wonnu hɔnho,
title: ACTS

text: osiandɛ ɔahyɛ da bi a ɔnam ɔbarimba bi a oeyi no esi hɔ no do bobu wiadze atsɛn wɔ tsenenee mu; ɔno na ɔama ɔasoɛr efi ewufo mu dze esi no pi ama nyimpa nyina dɛ wɔmfa ndzi dase.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtsee ewufo soɛr no, binom sii atwetwe, na binom so see dɛ, Yebetsie wo wɔ asɛm yi ho bio.
title: ACTS

text: Na mbrɛ Paul sii fii hɔn nkyɛn kɔree nye no.
title: ACTS

text: Naaso nyimpa bi dze hɔnho bɔɔ no ho na wɔgyee dzii: hɔn mu bi nye Dionisius Areopagusnyi no, na ɔbaa bi a ne dzin dze Damaris, nye binom a wɔka hɔn ho no.
title: ACTS

text: Na iyinom ekyir no, Paul fii Atens baa Korinte.
title: ACTS

text: Na obohun Jewnyi bi wɔ hɔ a ne dzin dze Akwila a wɔwoo no wɔ Pontus na ofi Itali baa hɔ nnkyɛree, nye ne yer Prisila, osiandɛ nna Klaudius ahyɛ dɛ Jewfo nyina mfi Rome nkɔ: na ɔbaa hɔn nkyɛn;
title: ACTS

text: na dɛ ɔnye hɔn yɛ edwuma kor ntsi, ɔtsenaa hɔn nkyɛn, na wɔyɛɛ edwuma; nna wɔyɛ ntamadanyɛfo.
title: ACTS

text: Na daa ahomgyeda ɔbɛkaa asɛm wɔ nhyiamudan mu, dɛ ɔrema Jewfo nye Griikfo agye edzi.
title: ACTS

text: Na Silas nye Timoti fii Masidonia sianee bae no, asɛm no hyɛɛ Paul do, na odzii dase kyerɛɛ Jewfo no dɛ Jesus nye Kraest no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔyɛɛ kyikyiikyi, na wɔkaa ebususɛm no, ɔpopoo n’atar mu kaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom bɔgyaa ngu homankasa hom etsifi: emi dze, minndzi so; ofitsi ndɛ mobɔkɔ Amanamamfo no hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na ofii hɔ kɔr obi a ne dzin dze Titus Justus a ɔyɛ nyamesuronyi a ne dan wɔ nhyiamudan no ho no ne fie.
title: ACTS

text: Na Krispus, nhyiamudan mu panyin nye ne fiemba nyina gyee Ewuradze dzii; na Korintefo no pii tsee no, wɔgyee dzii, ma wonumaa hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na Ewuradze see Paul wɔ enyido adzehu mu anadwe dɛ, Mma nnsuro, na kasa, na mma mmua w’ano:
title: ACTS

text: na emi mara meka wo ho, na obiara rennka wo mmbɛyɛ wo bɔn bi; osiandɛ mowɔ nkorɔfo pii wɔ kurow yi mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔtsenaa hɔ afrenhyia abosoom esia kyerɛkyerɛɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn asɛm no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Galio dzii Akaia ambrado no, Jewfo no yɛɛ adwenkor soɛɛr Paul do, na wɔdze no baa asɛndzi egua enyim dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Oyi otu nyimpa aso suma dɛ wɔnsom Nyankopɔn wɔ kwan bi do a otsia hɛn mbra.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul reyɛ ebue n’ano no, Galio see Jewfo no dɛ, Jewfo, sɛ ɔyɛ mfom anaa ehuhusɛm bi a omuo a nkyɛ ɔsɛ dɛ misie hom ho abotar tsie hom;
title: ACTS

text: na sɛ ɔyɛ asɛm nye edzin nye hom mbra ho asɛmbisa a, ɔnodze, homara hom nhwɛ: na emi dze, memmpɛ dɛ meyɛ dɛm asɛm yi ho ɔtsɛmbuafo.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔpaam hɔn fii asɛndzi egua enyim hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn nyina suoo nhyiamudan mu panyin Sostenes mu hwee no asɛndzi egua enyim hɔ. Na Galio dze, ɔammfa yinom mu biara annyɛ hwee.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul daa ho tsenaa hɔ nda kakra ara no, ɔkraa enuanom no, na ofii hɔ faa nsuenyi kɔr Siria, na Prisila nye Akwila ka no ho; na ɔpraa ne tsir wɔ Kenkreae; osiandɛ nna oedzi nsew bi.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔbaa Efeso, na ogyaa hɔn hɔ; na nankasa dze ɔkɔr nhyiamudan mu nye Jewfo kɛyɛɛ mpɛnsampɛnsamu dzendzenndzen.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔserɛɛ no dɛ ɔntsena hɔn nkyɛn nkyɛr kakra, naaso ɔammpen;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔkraa hɔn dɛ, Sɛ Nyankopɔn pɛ a, mebɛsan aba hom nkyɛn bio no, ofii Efeso sii nsuenyi.
title: ACTS

text: Na odwiir daadze wɔ Kaesarea no, ɔkɔree kekyiaa asɔrmba no, na osianee kɔr Antiok.
title: ACTS

text: Na odzii hɔ mber kakra no, ofii hɔ kekyiin Galatia nye Frigyia nkurow mu esiado esiado, hyɛɛ esuafo no nyina dzen.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jewnyi bi a ne dzin dze Apollos a wɔwoo no wɔ Alɛksandria na ɔyɛ nyimpa n’ano atsew yie, baa Efeso, na onyim kyerɛwnsɛm no yie.
title: ACTS

text: Nyimpa yi na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ no Ewuradze kwan no mu; na ɔyɛ hyew wɔ sunsum mu, ɔkae na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ dza ɔfa Jesus ho no pɛpɛɛpɛ, naaso nna John enuma no ho asɛm nko na onyim;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔhyɛɛ ase dze ndam kasae wɔ nhyiamudan mu. Ɔno na Prisila nye Akwila tsiee no no, wɔfaa no baa hɔn nkyɛn, na wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ no ma ɔkɔr kan wɔ Nyankopɔn kwan no mu ara yie.
title: ACTS

text: Na onyaa adwen dɛ obotwa mu akɔ Akaia no, enuanom no hyɛɛ no dzen na wɔkyerɛɛw nwoma kɛmaa esuafo no dɛ wɔngye no; na ɔbae no, ɔboaa hɔn a wɔnam adom do agye edzi no pii,
title: ACTS

text: osiandɛ ɔkaa Jewfo no gui wɔ bagua mu, na ɔnam kyerɛwsɛm no do kyerɛɛ mu kofee dɛ Jesus nye Kraest no.
title: ACTS

text: Na ber a Apollos wɔ Korinte no, Paul kotwaa mu wɔ amantsifi asaase no do no, ɔbaa Efeso, na obohun esuafo bi;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ana hom gyee dzii no, hom nyaa Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no? Na wɔsee no dɛ, Yɛnntsee pɛn mpo dɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn bi wɔ beebi.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Ebɛnadze mu na wonumaa hom hyɛe? Na wɔsee dɛ, John enuma no mu a.
title: ACTS

text: Paul see dɛ, John dze nnuho enuma no numae see nkorɔfo no dɛ wɔngye nyia odzi n’ekyir reba no ndzi, ɔno nye Jesus.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtsee no, wɔmaa wonumaa hɔn hyɛɛ Ewuradze Jesus dzin mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul dze ne nsa guu hɔn do no, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no baa hɔn do, na wɔdze kasa fofor kasae, na wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm.
title: ACTS

text: Nna hɔn nyina bɛyɛ mbarimba duebien.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔkɔr nhyiamudan no mu, na ɔdze akokodur kaa asɛm no ara abosoom ebiasa, na ɔnye hɔn rekasa nyina nna ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ mu yie ama wɔaagye dza ɔfa Nyankopɔn ahendzi ho no edzi.
title: ACTS

text: Nna binom akoma epirim, na woenntsie, na wɔkasaa Ɔkwan no ho bɔn wɔ nyimpadodow no enyim no, ofii hɔn nkyɛn na oyii esuafo no fii hɔn mu; na daa ɔnye hɔn kasae wɔ Tiranus ne nkyerɛkyerɛbea hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na iyi kɔr do ara kodur mfe ebien, ma dɛm no hɔn a wɔwɔ Asia nyina tsee Ewuradze asɛm, Jewfo nye Griikfo nyina.
title: ACTS

text: Na Nyankopɔn nam Paul nsa do yɛɛ tum ndwuma soronko:
title: ACTS

text: ma woyiyii no ho nduukuu anaa nsamenyim mpo koguu ayarfo do, ma yarba fii hɔn do, na esunsum bɔn so fii hɔn mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jewfo bi a wokyinkyin tu mbɔnsam sii hɔn bo dɛ wɔbɔbɔ Ewuradze Jesus dzin wɔ hɔn a wɔwɔ esunsum bɔn no do, dɛ, Meka Jesus a Paul ka no ho asɛm no gu hom do.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jewnyi sɔfopanyin bi a ɔdze Skeva ne mba beesuon bi na wɔyɛɛ dɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na sunsum bɔn no buae see hɔn dɛ, Jesus minyim, na Paul so minyim, na hom dze hom nye woananom?
title: ACTS

text: Na nyimpa no a sunsum bɔn wɔ no do no tui hyɛɛ hɔn do, na ɔboor hɔn pasaa, na wɔdze adagyaw nye pira guanguanee fii fie no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jewfo nye Griikfo a wɔwɔ Efeso nyina tsee yi, na hu kaa hɔn nyina, na wohuhoor Ewuradze Jesus ne dzin.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wɔagye edzi no mu pii so bae bɛkae na wobeyii hɔn ndzeyɛɛ kyerɛe.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wɔyɛɛ esumandze mu pii dze hɔn nwoma bae bɛhyeew no wɔ nyimpa nyina enyim; na wobuu no bo ano no, wohun dɛ osii ndwetɛbona mpem eduonum.
title: ACTS

text: Mbrɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm nam ahoɔdzen do nyinii na odzii nyim nye no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wowiee iyinom no, Paul bɔɔ ne tsirmu pɔw wɔ sunsum mu dɛ sɛ otwa mu wɔ Masidonia nye Akaia a, ɔbɔkɔ Jerusalɛm, na ɔsee dɛ, Mudu hɔ a, otwar dɛ mubokohu Rome so.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsomaa hɔn a wɔsoom no no mu beenu, Timoti nye Erastus, kɔr Masidonia, na nankasa dze, ɔkyɛree wɔ Asia kakra.
title: ACTS

text: Na ber no ara mu na sakasaka kɛsenara bae wɔ Ɔkwan no ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na dwetɛdwimfo bi a ne dzin dze Demitrius a ɔdze dwetɛ yɛ ɔbosom Artemis asɔrdan no sɛso honyi, na n’edwuma no dze mfaso pii brɛɛ edwimfo no,
title: ACTS

text: na ɔboaa hɔn nye hɔn a wɔyɛ edwuma kor no ara bi ano, na ɔsee dɛ, Ewuranom, hom nyim dɛ edwuma yi mu na yenya hɛn ahonya.
title: ACTS

text: Na hom ehu na hom atse dɛ nnyɛ Efeso ha nko, na aka kakra na ayɛ Asia nyina, na Paul yi etu nyimpadodow pii hɔn aso esuma, na ɔadan hɔn enyi dɛ dza wɔdze nsa ayɛ hɔn no nnyɛ enyame,
title: ACTS

text: na nnyɛ hɛn edwin yi nko na ɔreyɛ ayɛ gyan, na nyamebaa Artemis kɛse n’asɔrfi rebɛyɛ dɛ wommbu no hwee bio, na woetu ɔno a Asia nyina nye wiadze nyina sɔr no no efi n’akɛseyɛ mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtsee iyi no, ebufuw hyɛɛ hɔn ma, na wɔtseatseaa mu dɛ, Efesofo Artemis yɛ kɛse!
title: ACTS

text: Na sakasaka hyɛɛ kurow no ma, na wɔyɛɛ adwenkor bɔɔ krididi kɛkyeer Masidoniafo Gaius nye Aristarkus a wɔka Paul ho wɔ n’akwantu mu no, kɔr bea a nkorɔfo kɔ hɔ kɔhwɛ agor no.
title: ACTS

text: Paul pɛɛ dɛ ɔkɛhɛn nkorɔfo no mu naaso esuafo no amma no kwan.
title: ACTS

text: Na Asia mpanyimfo bi so a wɔyɛ n’adɔfo somae ma wɔkɔr no hɔ kɛserɛɛ no dɛ mma ɔnnkɔ agohwɛbea no mu hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei binom retsea mu dɛm, binom so retsea mu dɛm; na nhyiamu no ayɛ sakasaka; na dodowara yie nnyim siantsir a ɔnam do ma wobehyiae.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtwee Alɛksandar fii nyimpadodow no mu, na Jewfo no sunsuun no too kan. Na Alɛksandar dze ne nsa nyamee, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ oyi n’ano kyerɛ nkorɔfo no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wohun dɛ ɔyɛ Jewnyi no, hɔn nyina dze ndze kor tseaa mu bɛyɛ ndɔnhwer ebien dɛ, Efesofo Artemis yɛ kɛse!
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔmankyerɛwfo no dwedwee nyimpadodow no, na ɔsee dɛ, Efeso mbarimba, nyimpa bɛn na onnyim dɛ Efesofo kurow no yɛ Artemis kɛse nye honyi a ofiir Zeus bodwirii no hɔn asɔrfihwɛfo?
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi obiara runntum nnkasa nntsia iyinom, ɔsɛ hom dɛ hom yɛ komm, na hom nnyɛ biribi gyigyeegye.
title: ACTS

text: Na hom dze mbarimba yi a wɔnnyɛ asɔrfi ewifo, eso wɔnnka hɛn nyamebaa ho ebususɛm yi aba ha.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei, sɛ Demitrius nye edwimfo a wɔka no ho no wɔ obi ho asɛm bi a, asɛndzibea wɔ hɔ, ambradofo wɔ hɔ: hom mma wombeyi atsɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na sɛ hom rohwehwɛ biribi wɔ nsɛm afofor bi ho a, wobedzi no bagua mu dɛ mbrɛ mbra tse.
title: ACTS

text: Na yɛreyɛ enya amandze so ndɛ, sɛ wɔkɔtoa hɛn wɔ ndɛ begyabegya yi ho a, yennyi biribiara a yɛdze botum eyi hɛn ano wɔ nguabɔ yi ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔkaa dɛm no, ɔmaa bagua no tui.
title: ACTS

text: Na sakasaka no bɔɔ adze no, Paul frɛɛ esuafo no baa ne nkyɛn, na otuu hɔn fo no, ɔkraa hɔn, na ofii hɔ dɛ ɔrokɔ Masidonia.
title: ACTS

text: Na otwaa mu wɔ afa mu hɔ, na ɔmaa hɔn afotu pii no, ɔbaa Griis.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbɛtsenaa hɔ abosoom ebiasa, na ɔreyɛ etu akɔ Siria no, nna Jewfo no retsɛw no ntsi, ɔyɛɛ n’adwen dɛ ɔbɛfa Masidonia asan akɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na Beroanyi Sopater, Pirus ne ba, na Tesalonikafo no mu Aristarkus nye Sekundus, nye Derbenyi Gaius, nye Timoti, nye Asiafo Tikikus nye Trofimus kaa no ho.
title: ACTS

text: Yinom dzii kan kɔtweɔɔn hɛn wɔ Troas.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɛn so, epitsi nda twaa mu no, yɛfowee fii Filipi dze nda enum baa hɔn nkyɛn wɔ Troas; na yedzii hɔ nda esuon.
title: ACTS

text: Na dapɛn no mu da a odzi kan no a yebehyiaa mu dɛ yerubobu paanoo no, Paul nye hɔn kasae na ɔnam dɛ adze rebɛkye ma ɔaakɔ ntsi, ɔkaa asɛm araa kodur esuom.
title: ACTS

text: Nna nkandzea pii wɔ abansor mbrɛ yeehyia mu hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na aberantsɛ bi a ne dzin dze Eutikus tse tokura ano a n’enyi akom kɛse, na Paul kaa asɛm kyɛree no, ɔtɔɔ nkom fii asaansa no do bɔhwee ase, na wɔmaa no do no nna oewu.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul sianee kobutuuw no do, na ɔyɛɛ no etuu, na ɔsee dɛ, Mma hom nnsuro: na nkwa da ho wɔ no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa sor bio no, na obubuu paanoo, na odzii no, ɔdaa ho kasae araa kodur adzekyee, na ofii hɔ dɛm kɔree.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔdze aberantsɛ no baa enyikan, na ɔyɛɛ hɔn awerɛkyekyer kɛse.
title: ACTS

text: Na yedzii kan kɔr wusihɛn mu no, yetui kɔr Asos dɛ yɛrekɛfa Paul wɔ hɔ; na mbrɛ ɔhyɛɛ hɛn nye no, osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ n’adwen dɛ ɔbɛfa daadze akɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔnye hɛn hyiae wɔ Asos no, yɛfaa no baa nsu hɛn no mu, na yɛbaa Mitilene.
title: ACTS

text: Na yetui fii hɔ, na adze kyee no, yebodur Kios tsentsendo; na adze kyee bio no, yɛbaa Samos, na adze kyee no yedur Miletus.
title: ACTS

text: Nna Paul aka ato hɔ dɛ ɔbɛpa Efeso ho, amma ɔaannkɛkyɛr wɔ Asia; na ɔpɛɛ ntsɛm ma sɛ ɔbɛyɛ a, oeekodu Jerusalɛm Pentekost da no.
title: ACTS

text: Na ofii Miletus somae kɔr Efeso kɛfrɛɛ asɔr mpanyimfo no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔbaa ne nkyɛn no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ: Homankasa hom nyim mbrɛ ofitsi da a odzi kan a mebaa Asia no, menye hom tsenae wɔ aber no nyina mu,
title: ACTS

text: medze adwen mu ahobrɛadze nye nyinsu pii mosoom Ewuradze, nye nsɔhwɛ a ɔbaa mo do ɔnam Jewfo pempɛn a wɔpempɛɛn me no do:
title: ACTS

text: mbrɛ mannwodow ho dɛ mebɛka hom biribiara a ɔyɛ hom mfaso na mekae na mekyerɛkyerɛɛ hom guado nye efiefi,
title: ACTS

text: na midzii dase maa Jewfo nye Griikfo so wɔ nnuho a ɔkɔ Nyankopɔn do, nye gyedzi a ɔkɔ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest do no ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei, hwɛ, morokɔ Jerusalɛm dɛ woekitsa me wɔ sunsum mu, na minnyim dza ɔbɛba mo do wɔ hɔ,
title: ACTS

text: gyedɛ dase a Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no dzi wɔ nkurow nyina mu dɛ ɔkyer nye amandze rotweɔn me.
title: ACTS

text: Na memmfa mo nkwa nnyɛ biribi dɛ ɔsom mo bo, ama medze dɛw eewie m’akwantu, nye ɔsom a minyaa no Ewuradze Jesus hɔ, dɛ mindzi Nyankopɔn adom asɛmpa no ho dase no.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei, hwɛ, minyim dɛ hom a muboduaa hom mu mekaa ahenman no ho asɛm no nyina runnhu m’enyim bio.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi, ndɛ midzi hom dase dɛ mo ho san hom nyina hom bɔgyaa ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na mannwodow ho dɛ mebɛka Nyankopɔn apam nyina makyerɛ hom.
title: ACTS

text: Hom nhwɛ homho yie, nye nguankuw a Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahyɛ hom hɔn do ahwɛfo no nyina, dɛ hom bɛnyɛn Nyankopɔn asɔr a ɔdze nankasa no bɔgyaa enya no.
title: ACTS

text: Na minyim dɛ, mokɔ ekyir no, mpataku abɔyafo bɛba hom do, na wonnkegyaa nguankuw no;
title: ACTS

text: eso homankasa hom mu nyimpa bɔsoɛr a wɔbɛka nsɛnkyew dze atwe esuafo no edzi hɔn ekyir.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nweɔn, na hom nkaa dɛ mfe ara ebiasa anadwe nye ewia minngyaa dɛ medze nyinsu tu hom mu biara fo.
title: ACTS

text: Na nkyii, enuanom, medze hom hyɛ Nyankopɔn nsa, nye n’adom asɛm a otum dɛ ɔma hom ntowdo, na ɔma hom egyapadze wɔ hɔn a wɔatsew hɔn ho nyina mu no.
title: ACTS

text: M’enyi ammber obiara no dwɛɛtɛɛ anaa ne sika anaa n’atar.
title: ACTS

text: Homankasa hom nyim dɛ dza ohiaa me nye hɔn a wɔka mo ho no, mara me nsa yi ano edwuma na medze minyae.
title: ACTS

text: Adze nyina mu makyerɛ hom dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ hom yɛ edwuma dze hwɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw no, na hom kaa Ewuradze Jesus n’asɛm a ɔkaa dɛ, Ɔma yɛ nhyira kyɛn ɔgye no.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔkaa dɛm no, obuu ntwɛr nye hɔn nyina bɔɔ mpaa.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn nyina suu pii, na wotutui bebaar Paul na wɔfefeew n’ano,
title: ACTS

text: na dza ɔyɛɛ hɔn yaw kɛse nye asɛm a ɔkaa dɛ worunnhu n’enyim bio no. Na wokegyaa no wɔ wusihɛn no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ yɛtwee hɛnho fii hɔn nkyɛn na hɛn wusihɛn no tui no, yɛnam tsenn baa Kos, na n’adzekyee no yedur Rodes, na yefii hɔ baa Patara;
title: ACTS

text: na yehun wusihɛn a orutwa mu kɔ Fonisia no, yɛkɔr mu na yetui.
title: ACTS

text: Na yehun Siprus no, yegyaa no bankum, na yɛkɔr Siria, na yebodwiir Taere: nna hɔ na wusihɛn no rukotu n’adzesoa egu.
title: ACTS

text: Na yekohun esuafo no no, yɛtsenaa hɔ nda esuon: hɔn na wɔnam Sunsum no mu kaa kyerɛɛ Paul dɛ mma onntu n’anan nnsi Jerusalɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ yewiee nda no dzi no, yesii mu kɔr hɛn kwan; na hɔn nyina nye hɔn yernom nye hɔn mba begyaa hɛn kwan bodur dɛ yefii kurow no mu; na yebubuu ntwɛr wɔ mpoano hɔ bɔɔ mpaa,
title: ACTS

text: na yɛkrakraa hɛnho no, yɛkɔr wusihɛn mu, na hɔn so wɔsanee kɔr hɔn efiefi.
title: ACTS

text: Na yewiee ɔkwan a ofi Taere twa no, yekodur Petolemais na yekekyiaa enuanom no, na yedzii hɔn nkyɛn da kor.
title: ACTS

text: Na adze kyee no, yefii hɔ na yɛbaa Kaesarea; na yɛkɛhɛɛn asɛmpakafo Filip a ofi beesuon no mu no ne fie kɛtsenaa hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔno na ɔwɔ mbabaa baanan, mbaabun a wɔhyɛ nkɔm.
title: ACTS

text: Na yɛkyɛɛr hɔ nda kakra ara yie no, nkɔnhyɛnyi bi a ne dzin dze Agabus fii Judea bae.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa hɛn nkyɛn no, ɔfaa Paul n’abɔdo, na ɔdze kyekyeer nankasa ne nan nye ne nsa, na ɔsee dɛ, Mbrɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no se nye yi, Dɛmara na Jewfo a wɔwɔ Jerusalɛm no bɛkyekyer ɔbarimba a abɔdo yi yɛ nedze, na woeyi no ahyɛ amanamamfo nsa.
title: ACTS

text: Na yɛtsee yinom no, yɛnye hɔn a wofi kurow no mu no serɛɛ no dɛ mma ɔnnkɔ Jerusalɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Nna Paul buaa dɛ, Hom reyɛ dɛn nye yi, na hom rusu rububu m’akoma yi? Na mesiesie moho dɛ, nnyɛ dɛ wɔbɛkyer me nko, na eso mubowu wɔ Jerusalɛm wɔ Ewuradze Jesus ne dzin ntsi.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔammpen do amma hɛn no, yegyaa no dɛ, Ewuradze ne pɛ nyɛ hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na nda no ekyir no, yɛboaboaa hɛnho kɔr Jerusalɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na Kaesarea esuafo no mu bi so nye hɛn kɔree, na wɔdze hɛn baa Menason, Siprusnyi bi a ɔyɛ osuanyi dadaw no ne nkyɛn dɛ yɛrekɛtsena hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na yedur Jerusalɛm no, enuanom no dze enyigye gyee hɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na da a ɔtoa do no, Paul nye hɛn kɔr James nkyɛn; nna mpanyimfo no nyina wɔ hɔ bi.
title: ACTS

text: Na okyiaa hɔn no, ɔkaa ndzɛmba a Nyankopɔn nam no som do akɛyɛ wɔ amanaman mu nkorkor kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtsee no, wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam; na wɔsee no dɛ, Onua, ehu mpempem a wɔagye edzi wɔ Jewfo mu, na hɔn nyina bɔ mbɔdzen wɔ mbra no ho;
title: ACTS

text: na wɔatse wo ho asɛm dɛ ekyerɛkyerɛ Jewfo a wɔwɔ amanaman mu nyina dɛ wɔndan Moses ngya, na eka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ mma wontwa hɔn mba twatsia, eso mma wonndzi amambra no do.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei yɛnyɛ no dɛn? Ɔyɛ dɛn ara a wɔbɛtse dɛ aba ha.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi yɛ dza yɛrese wo yi: yɛwɔ mbarimba baanan a woedzi nsew;
title: ACTS

text: iyinom na fa hɔn na enye hɔn nkoguar homho, na tua kaw ma hɔn ma wonyi hɔn tsir; na hɔn nyina nhu dɛ nokwar biara nnyi wo ho asɛm a wɔtsee no mu, na mbom wankasa so enam pɛpɛɛpɛ idzi mbra no do.
title: ACTS

text: Na amanamamfo a wɔagye edzi no ho dze, yɛkyerɛwee kobuu atsɛn dɛ wonyi hɔnho mfi nam a wɔdze abɔ afɔr ama abosom, nye bɔgya, nye mbowa a wɔahyɛ hɔn fo, nye ndwamansɛm ho.
title: ACTS

text: Nna Paul faa mbarimba no, na n’adzekyee no ɔnye hɔn guaar hɔnho na ɔkɔr asɔrfi no mu, dɛ ɔrekɛkyerɛ ahoguar nda no n’ewiei, na wɔakɔbɔ afɔr ama hɔn nyina nkorkor.
title: ACTS

text: Na nda esuon reyɛ ewie so no, Jewfo a wofi Asia hun no asɔrfi mu no, wɔbɔɔ nyimpadodow no nkenyan, na wɔdze nsa suoo no mu,
title: ACTS

text: tseaa mu dɛ, Israel mbarimba, hom mboa: oyi nye nyimpa no a ɔkyerɛkyerɛ nyimpa nyina wɔ mbea nyina tsia ɔman nye mbra nye bea yi no: na ɔdze Griikfo so aba asɔrfi mu, na ɔdze fi abɛka krɔnkrɔnbea yi.
title: ACTS

text: Nna woedzi kan ehu Efesonyi Trofimus nye no wɔ kurow mu hɔ, ɔno na wɔdween dɛ gyama Paul dze no akɔ asɔrfi mu no.
title: ACTS

text: Na kurow no nyina bɔɔ twir, na nkorɔfo no dze mbirika bɔboaa ano; na wosuoo Paul mu, na wɔtwee no fii asɔrfi no mu; na ntsɛmara wɔtotoow mbobow no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔrohwehwɛ eku no no, nsɛm no kodur nsordaafokuw no mu ɔsafohen panyin no n’asomu dɛ Jerusalɛm nyina abɔ ebutuw;
title: ACTS

text: ɔno na ntsɛmara ɔfaa nsordaafo nye ɔhamumpanyin, na ɔdze mbirika kɔr hɔn do; na wohun ɔsafohen panyin no nye nsordaafo no, wogyaa Paul hwe.
title: ACTS

text: Nna ɔsafohen panyin no twee bɛnee, na obosuoo no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ebien nto no; na obisaa ne nyimpa ban nye dza ɔayɛ.
title: ACTS

text: Na binom tseaa mu dɛm, binom so tseaa mu dɛm, wɔ nyimpadodow no mu; na dede no ntsi na onntum nnhu no nokwar no, ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa no mbra aban no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na odur atwer no do no, ɔbaa dɛ nyimpadodow no hɔn gyigyeegye ntsi nsordaafo no soaa no;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔman no mu nyimpadodow dzii ekyir tseatseaa mu dɛ, Wonyi no mfi hɔ!
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔdze Paul rekɛhɛn aban no mu no, ɔsee ɔsafohen panyin no dɛ, Ana mowɔ kwan dɛ meka asɛm bi kyerɛ wo? Na ɔsee no dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Ana inyim Griik kasa? Ana nnyɛ ɔwo nye Egyptnyi a ndaano yi ɔyɛɛ sakasaka na ɔdze mbarimba a wofi ewudzifo no mu mpemanan kɔr sar do no bi?
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul see dɛ, Meyɛ Jewnyi a mifi Tarsus, Silisia kurow a ɔwɔ dzin mapa no mu nyimpa nye me, na meserɛ wo dɛ ma me kwan ma menkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔmaa no kwan no, Paul gyinaa atwer no do nyaam ne nsa kyerɛɛ nkorɔfo no; na wɔyɛɛ dzinn no, ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ hɔn wɔ Hebriw kasa mu.
title: ACTS

text: Paul dze Hebriw kasa see dɛ, Enuanom nye egyanom, hom ntsie m’anoyi a miriyi akyerɛ hom yi.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtsee dɛ ɔrekasa kyerɛ hɔn wɔ Hebriw kasa mu no, wɔyɛɛ komm koraa: na ɔsee dɛ:
title: ACTS

text: Meyɛ Jewnyi a wɔwoo me wɔ Tarsus wɔ Silisia, na wɔtsetsee me kurow yi mu, wɔ Gamaliel anan ho, wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ me egyanom mbra no mu ketsee, na mobɔɔ Nyankopɔn ho mbɔdzen, dɛ mbrɛ hom nyina yɛ ndɛ yi;
title: ACTS

text: na meyɛɛ Ɔkwan yi do akadofo ayakayakadze kɔr owu mu, mekyekyeer mbarimba nye mbaa, na miyii hɔn mae, ma wɔdze hɔn koguu efiadze;
title: ACTS

text: dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɔfopanyin no so nye mpanyimfo nyina dzi me dase no: hɔn hɔ so na mekɛgyee nwoma dɛ medze rekɛma enuanom no, mokɔr Damaskɔs dɛ merekɛfa hɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ no so aba Jerusalɛm wɔ nkyehoma mu, ma wɔaatsea hɔn.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ menam na mebɛɛn Damaskɔs bɛyɛ wigyinae no, awerɛfir mu na kan kɛse fi sor bɛhyerɛnee botwaa mo ho hyiae.
title: ACTS

text: Na mohwee daadze, na metsee ndze bi a ɔsee me dɛ, Saul, Saul, ɔyɛ dɛn na etaa mo do yi?
title: ACTS

text: Na mubuaa dɛ, Woana nye wo, Ewuradze? Na ɔsee me dɛ, Emi nye Nazarɛtnyi Jesus a etaa no do no.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wɔnye me nam no hun kan no dze, naaso wɔanntse nyia ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ me no ne ndze.
title: ACTS

text: Na mesee dɛ, Ebɛnadze na menyɛ, Ewuradze? Na Ewuradze see me dɛ, Soɛr, na kɔ Damaskɔs, na hɔ na wɔbɛka wo dza wɔahyɛ wo dɛ yɛ nyina ho asɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na kan no ne hyerɛn kɛse ntsi munnhu adze no, hɔn a wɔnye me nam no susuoo me nsa dze me baa Damaskɔs.
title: ACTS

text: Na Ananias bi a ɔyɛ nyamesuronyi dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse, na Jewfo a wɔwɔ hɔ nyina bɔɔ no dzin pa no,
title: ACTS

text: baa mo hɔ begyinaa me nkyɛn see me dɛ, Onua Saul, hu adze. Na dɔn no ara mu na memaa m’enyi do hwɛɛ no.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Hɛn egyanom Nyankopɔn no eyi wo ato hɔ dɛ ihu ne pɛ, na ihu ɔtseneneenyi no, na etse ɔnoara ne ndze.
title: ACTS

text: Na ebɛyɛ ne dasefo ama nyimpa nyina wɔ dza ehu nye dza atse ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei, ebɛnadze ntsi na irikyinkyim? Soɛr ma wonnuma wo nhohor wo bɔn, na paa mu bɔ ne dzin no.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ mesanee baa Jerusalɛm, na morobɔ mpaa wɔ asɔrfi mu no, m’enyiwa wiaa me ma mokɔr tsebea fofor mu,
title: ACTS

text: na muhun no na ɔsee me dɛ, Yɛ ntsɛm fi Jerusalɛm, osiandɛ wɔrenngye wo dasee a ibedzi wɔ mo ho no.
title: ACTS

text: Na mesee dɛ, Ewuradze, hɔnankasa nyim dɛ hɔn a wɔgye wo dzi nyina medze hɔn guu efiadze, na mohwee hɔn nhyiamudan nyina mu;
title: ACTS

text: na wɔreka wo dasefo Stefen no bɔgyaa egu no, mo so migyinaa hɔ bi, na mepeen no wu do, na mohwɛɛ hɔn a wokum no no hɔn ntar do.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Kɔ, na morosoma wo efi ha akɔ ekyirekyir wɔ amanaman mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na wotsiee no besii asɛm yi do, na wɔmaa hɔn ndze do see dɛ, Wonyi dɛm nyimpa yi mfi asaase do: na ɔnnsɛ dɛ ɔbɛtsena ase.
title: ACTS

text: Na woruhuro, na wɔrotow hɔn ntar gu, na worutu huntuma gu wimu no,
title: ACTS

text: safohen panyin no hyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa no mbra aban mu, na ɔkaa dɛ wɔnka no mpire mbisa no asɛm, ama oeehu adze kor a osian ntsi ma woruhuro gu no do yi.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔdze nguanhoma dweer ne nsa no, Paul see ɔhamupanyin a ogyinaa hɔ no dɛ, Ana hom wɔ kwan dɛ hom ka nyimpa a ɔyɛ Romenyi na wommbuu no fɔ mpire?
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔhamupanyin no tsee no, ɔkɔr safohen panyin no hɔ kɛkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na erebɛyɛ yi? Hwɛ, nyimpa yi yɛ Romenyi.
title: ACTS

text: Na safohen panyin no bae bɛsee no dɛ, Sɛ eyɛ Romenyi a, ka kyerɛ me. Na ɔsee dɛ, Nyew.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsafohen panyin no buaa dɛ, Medze sika kɛse na medze nyaa ɔmambayɛ yi. Na Paul see dɛ, Emi dze, wɔdze woo me.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi ntsɛmara hɔn a nkyɛ woribebisa no asɛm no fii ne nkyɛn, na ɔsafohen panyin no so hun dɛ ɔyɛ Romenyi na dɛ ɔakyekyer no no, osuroi.
title: ACTS

text: Na adze kyee no, na ɔpɛɛ dɛ ohu siantsir a ɔnam do ma Jewfo nye no robɔ nkuro no mu nokwar no, ɔsaan no na ɔhyɛɛ asɔfompanyin nye baguafo no nyina dɛ wombehyia, na ɔdze Paul sianee bae begyinaa hɔn enyim.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul gyeen n’enyi hwɛɛ baguafo no, ɔsee dɛ, Enuanom, tsibowa pa nyina na medze mabɔ me bra ama Nyankopɔn ebesi ndɛ yi.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsɔfopanyin Ananias hyɛɛ hɔn a wogyinaa ne nkyɛn no dɛ wɔmbɔ n’ano.
title: ACTS

text: Nna Paul see no dɛ, Nyankopɔn bɔbɔ wo, ɔwo fasu a wɔahoa ho: na etse hɔ rubu me atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse, na ibu mbra no do hyɛ dɛ wɔmbɔ me?
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wogyinaa hɔ no see no dɛ, Ereyaw Nyankopɔn no sɔfopanyin?
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul see dɛ, Enuanom, minnyim dɛ ɔyɛ sɔfopanyin: na wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Mma nnkasa bɔn wɔ wo man mu otsitsir ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul hun dɛ dɔm no fa yɛ Sadusiifo, na ɔfa yɛ Farisiifo no, ɔtseaa mu wɔ baguamu hɔ dɛ, Enuanom, meyɛ Farisiinyi, nye Farisiifo ba: ewufo no hɔn enyidado nye hɔn soɛr ntsi na worubu me atsɛn yi.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔkaa dɛm no, akasakasa baa Farisiifo no nye Sadusiifo no ntamu, na nyimpadodow no mu paae.
title: ACTS

text: Na Sadusiifo no se dɛ owusoɛr anaa ɔbɔfo anaa sunsum biara nnyi beebi: na Farisiifo no dze wɔgye ne nyina to mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔtseatseaa mu kɛse; na kyerɛwfo a wɔwɔ Farisiifo afamu no bi soɛree na wɔperee kaa dɛ, Yennhu bɔn biara wɔ nyimpa yi mu: na sɛ sunsum anaa ɔbɔfo akasa akyerɛ no a, ebɛn asɛm a?
title: ACTS

text: Na akasakasa pii soɛree no, safohen panyin no suroo dɛ wɔbɛtsetsew Paul mu ntsi, ɔhyɛɛ nsordaafo no dɛ wonsian nkohwim no wɔ hɔn nsamu, na wɔmfa no nkɔ aban mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na anadwe a odzi do no, Ewuradze begyinaa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Hyɛ dzen: na dɛ mbrɛ edzi mo ho dase wɔ Jerusalɛm yi, dɛmara so na ɔsɛ dɛ ikedzi dase wɔ Rome so.
title: ACTS

text: Na adze kyee no, Jewfo no pamee kekaa ntam dɛ worinndzidzi, eso wɔronnom, gyedɛ woeku Paul ansaana.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn a wodzii bɔtɔboa yi no bɔbor eduanan.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔbaa asɔfompanyin nye mpanyimfo no hɔ bɛsee dɛ, Yɛakeka hɛnho ntam dɛ hwee rennka hɛn ano gyedɛ yeeku Paul ansaana.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei hom nye baguafo no nkɛka nkyerɛ safohen panyin no dɛ ɔmfa no nsian mbra hom hɔ, dɛ gyama hom ribebisa no ho asɛm yie: na hɛn dze, ɔrotwe bɛn no, yeesiesie hɛnho dɛ yeboku no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul no wɔfase tsee hɔn pɔw no, ɔkɔree kɛhɛɛn aban no mu kɛkaa kyerɛɛ Paul.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul frɛɛ ɔhamupanyin kor baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔsee no dɛ, Fa aberantsɛ yi kɛma safohen panyin no, na ɔwɔ asɛm bi ka kyerɛ no.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔfaa no dze no kɔr safohen panyin no nkyɛn, na ɔsee dɛ, Paul daduanyi no frɛɛ me baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔserɛɛ me dɛ memfa aberantsɛ yi mbrɛ wo, na ɔwɔ asɛm bi ka kyerɛ wo.
title: ACTS

text: Na safohen panyin no suoo ne nsamu nye no kɔr nkyɛn beebi, na obisaa no dɛ, Ebɛnadze na ewɔ ka kyerɛ me?
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Jewfo no apam dɛ wɔbɛserɛ wo dɛ ɔkyena fa Paul sian bra bagua mu, ma aayɛ dɛ woribebisa no ho asɛm yie.
title: ACTS

text: Na mma nntsie hɔn: na hɔn mu bɔbor eduanan retsɛw no a wɔakeka hɔnho ntam dɛ worinndzidzi, eso wɔronnom gyedɛ woeku no ansaana; na sesei yi woesiesie hɔnho rotweɔn wo hɔ anohoba.
title: ACTS

text: Na safohen panyin no maa aberantsɛ no kɔree, na ɔbraa no dɛ, Mma nnka nnkyerɛ obiara dɛ aka asɛm yi akyerɛ me.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔfrɛɛ ɔhamumpanyin no beenu baa ne nkyɛn see dɛ, Hom nsiesie nsordaafo ahaenu, nye mpɔnkɔdofo eduosuon, nye peaatofo ahaenu, ma wɔnkɔ Kaesarea anadwe ndɔnkron no mu;
title: ACTS

text: na wɔnhwehwɛ mbowa so, na wɔmma Paul ntsena do, na wɔmfa no nkɔ dwudwoodwo nkɛma ambrado Feliks.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔkyerɛɛw nwoma a ɔtse dɛm yi:
title: ACTS

text: Klaudius Lisias kyia ambrado Feliks.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔbarimba yi, Jewfo no kɛfaa no dɛ nkyɛ woruboku no, na menye nsordaafo kɔr hɔn do kɛgyee no, osiandɛ metsee dɛ ɔyɛ Romenyi.
title: ACTS

text: Na merepɛ mehu sombo a wɔdze bɔɔ no no, medze no baa hɔn bagua mu;
title: ACTS

text: na muhun dɛ hɔn mbra ho nsɛmbisa ntsi na wɔnye no wɔ nkuro, na wɔammfa biribi a ɔsɛ wu anaaso nkyehoma annto no do.
title: ACTS

text: Na wobetsiaa me nan dɛ wɔretsɛw ɔbarimba no, ntsɛmara na mosomaa no wɔ wo nkyɛn, na mahyɛ n’atoafo no so dɛ wɔmbɛka dza wɔwɔ wɔ no ho wɔ w’enyim.
title: ACTS

text: Na nsordaafo no faa Paul dɛ mbrɛ wɔhyɛɛ hɔn no ara, na wɔdze no kɔr Antipatris anadwe no.
title: ACTS

text: Na adze kyee no, wɔmaa mpɔnkɔdofo no dze no kɔree, na wɔsanee baa aban mu;
title: ACTS

text: na hɔn dze wokodur Kaesarea, na woyii nwoma no maa ambrado no, wɔdze Paul so kegyinaa n’enyim.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔkenkaan nwoma no wiei no, obisaa ɔmansin kor a ofi mu; na ɔtsee dɛ ofi Silisia no,
title: ACTS

text: ɔsee dɛ, w’atoafo no ba a, nna mibetsie wo. Na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa no nsie Herod aban mu.
title: ACTS

text: Nda enum ekyir no, ɔsɔfopanyin Ananias nye mpanyimfo no binom nye mbranyimnyi bi a wɔfrɛ no Tertulus sianee bae, na hɔn na wɔbɔbɔɔ Paul ho nkuro kyerɛɛ ambrado no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔfrɛɛ no no, Tertulus hyɛɛ ase bɔɔ nkuro dɛ: Ɔnam dɛ yɛnam wo do enya asomdwee pii, nye ɔmansesɛw a ɔnam wo nyimdzee do baa man yi mu,
title: ACTS

text: onyimnyamfo Feliks, yinom nyina yɛdze ndaase nyina gye daa wɔ mbea nyina.
title: ACTS

text: Na meremma asɛm no nnwar pii ntsi, meserɛ wo fa w’adom tsie hɛn kakra.
title: ACTS

text: Na yeehu ɔbarimba yi dɛ ɔyɛ obusuyɛfo, na ɔdze mansotwe ba Jewfo nyina mu wɔ wiadze nyina, na ɔyɛ Nazarene fɛkuw no mu ɔkandzifo;
title: ACTS

text: na ɔsɔe hwɛe so dɛ ɔdze fi bɛka asɔrfi no: ɔno na yɛkɛkyeer no:
title: ACTS

text: [na nkyɛ yɛpɛɛ dɛ yɛnam hɛn mbra no do bu no atsɛn; na safohen panyin Lisias baa hɛn do, na ɔdze enyimpi bohwiim no wɔ hɛn nsamu kɔree, na ɔhyɛɛ n’atoafo dɛ wɔmbra wo hɔ;]
title: ACTS

text: na woara so ehwehwɛ mu a, ibotum ehu dza osian ntsi a yɛnye no robɔ nkuro nyina.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jewfo no so foaa no do dɛ nsɛm no nyina tse dɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na ambrado no too Paul nsa dɛ ɔnkasa no, Paul buaa dɛ: Susuampa dɛ minyim dɛ ifitsii eyɛɛ ɔman yi tsɛmbuafo edzi mfe pii ntsi, medze akomatɔmu miyi m’ano:
title: ACTS

text: na ibotum ehu dɛ ɔmmbor dadu ndaebien na mokɔr Jerusalɛm dɛ morokɔsɔr;
title: ACTS

text: na woennhu me asɔrfi mu anaa nhyiamudan mu anaa kurow mu hɔ, dɛ menye bi rekasa anaadɛ meretan nyimpadodow enyi.
title: ACTS

text: Eso worunntum nnkyerɛ ndzɛmba a wɔrotoatoa m’ano wɔ ho yi.
title: ACTS

text: Na iyi dze, mepaa mu meka kyerɛ wo dɛ, Ɔkwan a wɔfrɛ no Fɛkuw no mu na mosom m’egyanom Nyankopɔn, dɛ megye ndzɛmba a wɔakyerɛw wɔ mbra no nye nkɔnhyɛfo no mu midzi;
title: ACTS

text: na mowɔ Nyankopɔn ho enyidado a hɔnara so hwɛ no kwan no, dɛ owusoɛr bi bɛba a hɔn a wɔtsen nye hɔn a wɔnntsen so bɔsoɛr.
title: ACTS

text: Na iyi mu na mo so mobɔ bra dɛ mibenya tsibowa a ntotoananmu nnyi mu wɔ Nyankopɔn nye nyimpa afamu daa.
title: ACTS

text: Na mfe pii ekyir no, mebaa dɛ medze ayɛyɛdze merebrɛ me man, nye afɔrbɔdze;
title: ACTS

text: na iyi mu na wohun me wɔ asɔrfi mu dɛ meguar moho, eso menndze nyimpadodow anaa gyigyeegye bi; na Jewfo bi a wofi Asia,
title: ACTS

text: hɔn na ɔsɛ dɛ nkyɛ wɔba w’enyim, sɛ wɔnye me wɔ asɛm bi a wɔnye me bɔbɔ nkuro.
title: ACTS

text: Anaaso iyinom ara a wogyina ha yi nka dɛ, migyinaa baguafo no enyim no, wohun emumuyɛ bi wɔ mo ho
title: ACTS

text: ka asɛm kor yi ara a migyinaa hɔn mu no metseaa mu kaa dɛ, Ewufosoɛr ntsi na worubu me atsɛn ndɛ yi.
title: ACTS

text: Na Feliks nyim Ɔkwan no ho asɛm yie no ntsi, ɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hom ntwentweɔn do kakra na sɛ safohen panyin Lisias ba a, nna mibetsie asɛm no mu yie.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔhyɛɛ ɔhamupanyin no dɛ ɔmfa Paul nsie, na ɔmma ondzi noho, na mma onnsiw n’amanyimfo bi kwan dɛ wɔbɔsom no.
title: ACTS

text: Na nda bi ekyir Feliks nye ne yer Drusila a ɔyɛ Jewnyi no bae, na ɔsomae kɛfrɛɛ Paul, na otsiee gyedzi a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu ho asɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔreka tsenenee, nye enyidahɔ, nye atsɛmbu a ɔreba ho asɛm no, Feliks bɔɔ hu na obuaa dɛ, Sesei dze kɔ; na minya ho adagyer a, mebɛma wɔabɛfrɛ wo.
title: ACTS

text: Na n’enyi daa kwan so dɛ Paul bɛma no sika: dɛm ntsi daa ɔmaa wɔkɛfrɛɛ no, na ɔnye no twetwee nkɔmbɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na mfe ebien durii no, Porkius Festus bedzii Feliks ananmu; na Feliks pɛɛ dɛ ɔsɔ Jewfo enyi ntsi, ɔdaan Paul gyaa efiadze hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei Festus baa ɔmansin no mu no, ne ndaansa ekyir no ofii Kaesarea kɔr Jerusalɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na asɔfompanyin nye Jewfo etsitsir no kaa asɛm tsiaa Paul kyerɛɛ no, na wɔserɛɛ adom wɔ no hɔ dɛ
title: ACTS

text: ɔnsoma ma wɔnkɛfa Paul mbra Jerusalɛm; na nkyɛ wɔaatsɛw no kwan mu eku no.
title: ACTS

text: Na Festus dze, obuaa dɛ wɔdze Paul risie wɔ Kaesarea, na nankasa so ɔnnkɛkyɛr na ɔakɔ hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔsee dɛ, Dɛm ntsi hom mma hom mu hɔn a wɔwɔ tum no nye me nsian nkɔ, na sɛ biribi a ɔnnsɛ wɔ ɔbarimba yi mu a, wɔnye no nkɔbɔ nkuro.
title: ACTS

text: Na odzii hɔn mu bɛyɛ nda awɔtwe anaa dadu no, osianee kɔr Kaesarea; na adze kyee no, na ɔkɛtsenaa asɛndzigua do no, ɔhyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa Paul mbra.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbae no, Jewfo a woefi Jerusalɛm aba no botwaa no ho hyiae, na wɔdze nsɛmbɔn pii a ɔyɛ dur toatoaa no a hɔnara woenntum annkyerɛ mu;
title: ACTS

text: na Paul yii n’ano dɛ, Jewfo mbra o, asɔrfi o, Kaesar o, mennyɛɛ bɔn biara minntsiae.
title: ACTS

text: Na Festus pɛɛ dɛ onya Jewfo enyimpa ntsi, obisaa Paul dɛ, Epɛ dɛ ekɔ Jerusalɛm ma woeebu wo ndzɛmba yi ho atsɛn wɔ m’enyim anaa?
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul see dɛ, Migyina Kaesar asɛndzigua enyim, mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ wobu me atsɛn: Jewfo dze, mennyɛɛ hɔn bɔn bi, dɛ mbrɛ woara so inyim yie no.
title: ACTS

text: Na sɛ mayɛ bɔn, anaa sɛ mayɛ biribi a ɔsɛ wu a, mommpow dɛ mubowu; na sɛ ndzɛmba a yinom rotoa m’ano wɔ ho yi nnyɛ nokwar a, obi runntum mmfa me nnhyɛ hɔn nsa. Emi dze, medan Kaesar.
title: ACTS

text: Nna Festus nye baguafo no tuu egyina no, obuaa dɛ, Sɛ edze akɛdan Kaesar a, ɔnodze, Kaesar hɔ na ebɔkɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na nda bi ekyir no, Ɔhen Agrippa nye Bernise baa Kaesarea, na wobekyiaa Festus.
title: ACTS

text: Na wodzii hɔ nda pii no, Festus dze Paul ho asɛm no too ɔhen no enyim dɛ, Ɔbarimba bi wɔ hɔ a Feliks gyaa no mpokyerɛ mu:
title: ACTS

text: ɔno na mokɔr Jerusalɛm no, asɔfompanyin nye Jewfo mpanyin no kaa no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ me serɛɛ me dɛ mumbu no atsɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na mubuaa hɔn dɛ ɔnnyɛ Romefo amambra dɛ wobeyi nyimpa bi ama, gyedɛ nyia wɔrobɔ no ho nkuro no nye no nkurobɔfo no edzi enyim na enyim, na onya kwan yi n’ano wɔ dza wɔdze ato no do ho ansaana.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi wobehyiaa ha no, mannyɛ ekyim, na adze kyee no mekɛtsenaa asɛndzigua do na mehyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa ɔbarimba no mbra.
title: ACTS

text: Na no nkurobɔfo no begyinaa hɔ no, wɔannka emumuyɛdze a mususui no mu biara ho asɛm annto no do,
title: ACTS

text: na hɔnankasa hɔn nyamesom ho ekyingye a wɔnye no gyee no ho, na Jesus bi a oewu a Paul so se dɛ ɔtse ase no ho dze.
title: ACTS

text: Na dɛ minnyim mbrɛ mebɛyɛ mahwehwɛ iyinom mu ntsi, mibisaa no dɛ ɔpɛ dɛ ɔbɔkɔ Jerusalɛm ma woeekobu no atsɛn wɔ nsɛm yi ho anaa.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul dze asɛm no kɛdaan ɔhempɔn no dɛ wɔmfa no nsie ma onkodu n’enyim ntsi, mehyɛɛ dɛ wɔmfa no nsie ma onkodu dɛ mobɔsoma ma wɔdze no akɛma Kaesar.
title: ACTS

text: Nna Agrippa see Festus dɛ, Nkyɛ mo so mepɛ dɛ mitsie nyimpa no. Na ɔsee dɛ, Ɔkyena ibetsie no.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei adze kyee no, Agrippa nye Bernise dze ahokeka kɛse bae, na wɔnye asafohen mpanyin no binom, nye kurow no mu mbapɔmba no, kɔr mbrɛ wotsie asɛm hɔ, na Festus hyɛe no, wɔdze Paul bae.
title: ACTS

text: Na Festus see dɛ, Ɔhen Agrippa, nye mbarimba a hom nye hɛn wɔ ha nyina, hom nhwɛ nyimpa yi a Jewfo nyimpadodow nyina serɛɛ me tsiaa no wɔ Jerusalɛm nye ha, na wɔtseatseaa mu dɛ ɔnnsɛ dɛ ɔtsena ase bio no.
title: ACTS

text: Naaso muhun dɛ ɔannyɛ biribi a ɔsɛ wu; na nankasa dze asɛm no akɛdan ɔhempɔn no ntsi mahyɛ dɛ mobɔsoma no hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Naaso minnyi biribi tsitsir biara a mebɛkyerɛw akɛma mo wura wɔ no ho. Dɛm ntsi na medze no aba hom enyim, nkanka ɔwo, Ɔhen Agrippa, ama wowie mu hwehwɛ a, meenya biribi a mebɛkyerɛw.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔyɛ me dɛ nyansa biara nnyi mu dɛ medze daduanyi mobɔkɔ, na mennkɛkyerɛ asɛm kor a wɔdze ato no do.
title: ACTS

text: Na Agrippa see Paul dɛ, Wɔama wo kwan dɛ ka w’asɛm. Nna Paul tseen ne nsa yii n’ano dɛ:
title: ACTS

text: Muhu no dɛ me tsir ayɛ yie, Ɔhen Agrippa, dɛ miribeyi m’ano wɔ w’enyim ndɛ, wɔ nsɛm nyina a Jewfo dze roto mo do no ho;
title: ACTS

text: na ne tsitsir nye dɛ ɔwo dze awea amambra nye ekyingyesɛm a ɔwɔ Jewfo mu nyina ho: dɛm ntsi meserɛ wo dɛ to wo bo tsie me.
title: ACTS

text: M’asetsena fitsi mo mbofraber mu a ɔhyɛɛ ase wɔ mankasa me man mu, nye Jerusalɛm no, Jewfo nyina nyim:
title: ACTS

text: na wonyim me fi ahyɛse, na sɛ wɔpɛ dɛ wodzi ho dase a, wonyim dɛ moforaa fɛkuw a wotua hɛn som no ho no mu, na mobɔɔ me bra dɛ Farisiinyi.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei migyina ha na worubu me atsɛn wɔ anohoba a Nyankopɔn dze maa egyanom no ho enyidado ntsi yi:
title: ACTS

text: ɔno na hɛn mbusuakuw duebien no som enyiberdo adzesaa nye adzekyee, dze hɔn enyi to do dɛ wobenya. Na enyidado yi ho ntsi, ɔhen, nna Jewfo rotoatoa m’ano yi o.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom bu iyi asɛm a wɔnngye nndzi, dɛ Nyankopɔn nyan ewufo?
title: ACTS

text: Na ampaara mankasa so modween moho dɛ ɔsɛ me dɛ mebɛyɛ ndzɛmba pii metsia Jesus Nazarɛtnyi no ne dzin.
title: ACTS

text: Na iyi so na meyɛe wɔ Jerusalɛm: minyaa asɔfompanyin no hɔ tum no, medze ahotseweefo no pii guu efiadze, na sɛ woruku hɔn a, m’ano wɔ mu bi.
title: ACTS

text: Na motɔɔ dɛ metsea hɔn wɔ nhyiamudan nyina mu, na mehyɛɛ hɔn dɛ wɔnka ebususɛm; na mobɔɔ hɔn do dam koraa no metaa hɔn do kɔr ananaben nkurow do.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔno mu na menam rokɔ Damaskɔs na medze asɔfompanyin hɔn tum nye ho kwan no,
title: ACTS

text: wigyinae, ɔhen, muhun kwan no do kan bi a ofi sor a ɔkyɛn ewia ne hyerɛn, dɛ oebotwa emi nye hɔn a wɔnye me nam no ho ehyia.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɛn nyina hwehwee daadze no, metsee ndze bi a ɔrekasa kyerɛ me wɔ Hebriw kasa mu dɛ, Saul, Saul, ɔyɛ dɛn na etaa mo do yi? Ɔyɛ dzen ma wo dɛ ebɔwɔ dadzepoma ano ntsia.
title: ACTS

text: Na mesee dɛ, Woana nye wo, Ewuradze? Na Ewuradze see dɛ, Emi nye Jesus a etaa no do no.
title: ACTS

text: Na soɛr gyina w’anan do: na iyi ntsi na meyi moho akyerɛ wo, dɛ mibeyi wo ato hɔ dɛ ndzɛmba a ehu yi nye dza miribeyi moho akyerɛ wo wɔ mu no ho somfo nye dasefo;
title: ACTS

text: na mibeyi wo wɔ ɔman no nye amanaman a morosoma wo wɔ hɔn hɔ no nsamu,
title: ACTS

text: dɛ kobue hɔn enyi na kɛdan hɔn fi sum mu bra kan mu, ma woeefi Satan tum mu aba Nyankopɔn hɔ, na woeenya bɔnfakyɛ nye egyapadze wɔ hɔn a wɔnam gyedzi a ɔwɔ mo mu do enya ahotsewee no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi, Ɔhen Agrippa, mannyɛ enyido adzehu a ofi sor no ho asoɔdzen:
title: ACTS

text: na midzii kan kyerɛɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ Damaskɔs, nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Jerusalɛm so, nye Judea asaase do nyina, nye amanaman no, dɛ wonnu hɔnho na wɔnsan mbra Nyankopɔn hɔ, na wɔnyɛ ndwuma a ɔfata nnuho.
title: ACTS

text: Iyi ntsi na Jewfo no bɛkyeer me wɔ asɔrfi mu, hwehwɛɛ dɛ woku me.
title: ACTS

text: Na dɛ minyaa Nyankopɔn hɔ mboa ntsi, na migyina hɔ dze ebodu ndɛ, na midzi dase kyerɛ akɛse nye nkakraba nyina, na mennka asɛm biara gyedɛ dza nkɔnhyɛfo nye Moses nyina kaa dɛ ɔbɛba mu no nkotsee;
title: ACTS

text: mbrɛ otwar dɛ Kraest bohu amandze, na oedzi kan nam ewufosoɛr mu aka kan ho asɛm akyerɛ ɔman no nye amanamamfo.
title: ACTS

text: Na oyii n’ano dɛm no, Festus dze ndze kɛse tseaa mu dɛ, Paul, egyim: nwomasua dodow robɔ wo dam.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul see dɛ, Mommbɔɔ dam bi, onyimnyamfo Festus, na meka nokwar nye enyidahɔ nsɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔhen a medze ndam kasa kyerɛ no yi nyim nsɛm yi mu: na megye dzi dɛ iyinom mu biara nnsuma no; na wɔannyɛ yi wɔ kukua mu.
title: ACTS

text: Ɔhen Agrippa, egye nkɔnhyɛfo no dzi anaa? Minyim dɛ egye dzi.
title: ACTS

text: Na Agrippa see Paul dɛ, Ana edwen dɛ ber kakraabi yi ibotum ama maayɛ Kristiannyi?
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul see dɛ, Mepɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn mu dɛ, aka kakraabi o, aka pii o, nkyɛ nnyɛ wo nko, na hɔn a woritsie me ndɛ nyina aayɛ dɛ mara, gyedɛ nkyehoma yi nko.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔhen no, nye ambrado no, nye Bernise, nye hɔn a wɔnye hɔn tse hɔ no soɛree;
title: ACTS

text: na wɔkɔr nkyɛn beebi no, wɔkae wɔ hɔn mu dɛ, Nyimpa yi nnyɛɛ biribi a ɔsɛ owu anaadɛ nkyehoma.
title: ACTS

text: Na Agrippa see Festus dɛ, Sɛ nyimpa yi ammfa n’asɛm annkɛdan Kaesar a, nkyɛ woegyaa no.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔkaa dɛ yɛmfa nsuenyi nkɔ Itali no, woyii Paul nye mpokyerɛfo bi maa ɔhamupanyin bi a wɔfrɛ no Julius a ofi Augustus asogyafokuw mu no.
title: ACTS

text: Na yɛkɔr Adramitium wusihɛn bi a ɔrobɔkɔ Asia afamu mu no, yetui, na Aristarkus, Masidonianyi bi a ofi Tesalonika, ka hɛn ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na da a odzi do no, yekegyinaa Sidon; na Julius yɛɛ Paul ayamuyie maa no kwan dɛ ɔnkɔ ne amanyimfo nkyɛn ama wɔaahwɛ no.
title: ACTS

text: Na yetui fii hɔ no, yekoduaa Siprus ase, osiandɛ mframa sii hɛn enyim.
title: ACTS

text: Na yetwaa Silisia nye Pamfilia po no, yɛbaa Lisia kurow Mira ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔhamupanyin no hun Alɛksandria wusihɛn bi a ɔrokɔ Itali wɔ hɔ no, ɔdze hɛn guu mu.
title: ACTS

text: Ndafua pii na yɛnam bɔkɔɔ, na yɛfonae ana yɛrebɛn Sinidus, na mframa amma hɛn ho kwan no, yekoduaa Kreete ase kɛpaa Salmone ho;
title: ACTS

text: na yɛberɛe berɛe paa ho no, yɛbaa beebi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Ahɛngyinae Fɛɛfɛw no a Lasea kurow bɛn ho no.
title: ACTS

text: Na yɛsɛɛ mber pii na nsuenyidua yɛɛ hu, na dɛ Mbuadadzi ber no etwa mu dada ntsi no, Paul tuu hɔn fo,
title: ACTS

text: na ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Ewuranom, muhu dɛ akwantu yi amandze nye adzesɛɛ pii bɛba mu, nnyɛ eguadze nye hɛn yi nko na hɛnankasa hɛn nkwa so.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔhamupanyin no gyee akyerɛkwan no nye hɛn no wura dzii kyɛɛn dza Paul kae no.
title: ACTS

text: Na osiandɛ ahɛngyinae no nntsɛw yie dɛ wobedzi awɔwber wɔ hɔ ntsi, hɔn mu pii kaa dɛ wobotu wɔ hɔ kyerɛ wobenya kwan edu Foniks, Kreete ahɛngyinae a odzi kɔ anee pomu nye anee habanmu no, na woekedzi awɔwber.
title: ACTS

text: Na pomu mframa bɔɔ faafaa no, wosusuu dɛ hɔn nsa aka dza ɔwɔ hɔn tsirmu no, wotuu sekyɛ duaa anoano kɛbɛɛn Kreete.
title: ACTS

text: Na annkyɛr na aahow dzendzen bi a wɔfrɛ no Etsifi-Epuei Mframa fii Kreete bɔe;
title: ACTS

text: na okitsaa hɛn no, ma oenntum ennhyia mframa no, na yegyaa hɛnho ma ɔpaar hɛn.
title: ACTS

text: Na yɛdze yerɛdɛdɛɛdɛ kɛfaa supruw bi a wɔfrɛ no Kauda ase no, ɔyɛɛ dzen ana yerutum susuo hɛmba no mu;
title: ACTS

text: na wɔmaa no do no, wɔdze ndzɛmba wowaaw hɛn no kyekyeree; na wosuroo dɛ wɔbɔkɔ akɔhwe Sirtis anhweatɛnkyɛmm mu ntsi, wɔhohɔɔr abradaadua no ma ɔpaar hɔn dɛm.
title: ACTS

text: Na ehum no bɔɔ dzendzen dze hɛn kyinkyinii no, adze kyee no wotuu hɛn no mu ndzɛmba bi gui;
title: ACTS

text: na da a otsia ebiasa no wɔdze hɔnankasa hɔn nsa totoow hɛn no ho ndzɛmba gui.
title: ACTS

text: Na nda pii nna yennhu ewia anaa nworaba biara, na mframa kɛsenara sii hɛn do, afei hɔn enyidado dɛ wɔbɛgye hɛn nkwa nyina yewee.
title: ACTS

text: Na nda pii twaa mu a edziban nnkaa hɛn ano no, Paul soɛree gyinaa hɔn finimfin see dɛ, Mbarimba, ɔsɛ dɛ nkyɛ hom tsie me, na hom emmfi Kreete emmbenya amandze yi nye adzesɛɛ yi.
title: ACTS

text: Na afei dze, mutu hom fo dɛ hom mma hom akoma ntɔ hom yamu; na obiara ronnhwer no nkwa wɔ hom mu, gyedɛ hɛn yi nko na ɔbɛsɛɛ.
title: ACTS

text: Na anadwe yi Nyankopɔn a meyɛ nedze, na mosom no no, no bɔfoe begyinaa me nkyɛn
title: ACTS

text: see dɛ, Paul, mma nnsuro: otwar dɛ ikegyina Kaesar enyim; na hwɛ, Nyankopɔn dze hɔn a enye hɔn nam nyina akyɛ wo.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi, ewuranom, hom mma hom akoma ntɔ hom yamu: na megye Nyankopɔn dzi dɛ ɔbɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔaka akyerɛ me.
title: ACTS

text: Naaso otwar dɛ yekogu supruw bi do.
title: ACTS

text: Na ne dadu ndaanan anadwe no, yeridzi akɔnaaba wɔ Adria po do no, bɛyɛ esuom na hɛn no mu edwumayɛfo no dween dɛ yɛrebɛn asaase bi;
title: ACTS

text: na wɔtoow susuhoma no, wohun dɛ ɔyɛ abasamu eduonu; na wɔkɔr enyim kakra na wɔtoow bio no, wohun dɛ ɔyɛ abasamu duenum.
title: ACTS

text: Na wosuroo dɛ bi a yɛbɔkɔ akɔhwe abotan bi do ntsi, wɔtoo nsekyɛ anan wɔ hɛntu tweɔn adzekyee.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɛn no mu edwumayɛfo no hwehwɛɛ dɛ woguan fi hɛn no mu, na wogyaa hɛmba no mu too po mu yɛɛ dɛ wɔrokɔto sekyɛ wɔ hɛnkan no,
title: ACTS

text: Paul see ɔhamupanyin no nye nsordaafo no dɛ, Sɛ iyinom anntsena hɛn yi mu a, hom rinnya nkwa.
title: ACTS

text: Nna nsordaafo no twaa hɛmba no ne ntampehoma no, ma ɔhwee ase.
title: ACTS

text: Na adze rebɛkye no, Paul serɛɛ hɔn nyina dɛ wondzidzi, dɛ, Ndɛ dadu ndaanan koraa nna hom atsena edzi mbuada a hom mmfa hwee nnkaa hom ano.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi meserɛ hom dɛ hom ndzidzi, na iyi fa hom nkwa ho: na nhwi kor mpo rimmfi hom mu biara ne tsir do nntɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔkaa dɛm no, ɔfaa paanoo, na ɔdaa Nyankopɔn ase wɔ hɔn nyina enyim; na obubui hyɛɛ ase dzidzii.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn nyina hɔn akoma tɔɔ hɔn yamu, na hɔnankasa so faa edziban dzii.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɛn a yɛwɔ hɛn no mu nyina yɛ akra ahaenu eduosuon esia.
title: ACTS

text: Na wodzidzii mee no, wɔbɔɔ hɛn no har totoow ewifua no guu po mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na adze kyee no, nna wonnyim asaase no n’adaa no; naaso wohun ɔdɔndɔn bi a ɔwɔ mpoano hɔ no, wotuu egyina dɛ sɛ wobotum a, wɔbɔtwe hɛn no akɔ hɔ.
title: ACTS

text: Na wotwaa nsekyɛ no ahoma mu no, wogyaa mu guu po mu, na wɔsaan kutow no n’ahoma so; na wosii hɛnkan abradaa no maa mframa, na wɔdze too mpoano.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔbɔtɔɔ beebi a apo ebien hyia no, wɔdze hɛn no pemee; na ne kan ketsimii, na ɔkaa hɔ pintsinn, na no tun dze, asorɛkye no ne dzendzen bubuu no.
title: ACTS

text: Na nsordaafo no tuu egyina dɛ woboku adaduafo no, amma obi aammbor ennguan.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔhamupanyin no, ɔpɛɛ dɛ ɔgye Paul nkwa ntsi, osiiw hɔn dza wosusui no ho kwan; na ɔhyɛɛ dɛ hɔn a wobotum abor mfa hɔnho nkyen po mu ndzi kan nkɔ daadze;
title: ACTS

text: na nkaa no, binom butubutuuw ntaabow do, binom butubutuuw hɛn no ho ndzɛmba bi do kɔree. Na mbrɛ ɔyɛe ma hɔn nyina nyaa nkwa dur daadze nye no.
title: ACTS

text: Na yenyaa hɛn tsir dzidzii mu no, nna yehun dɛ supruw no wɔfrɛ no Malta.
title: ACTS

text: Na nyimpa a wɔwɔ hɔ no yɛɛ hɛn adɔyɛ kɛse: na ɔnam nsu a ɔrotɔ na awɔw no ntsi, wokuaa gya na wɔgyee hɛn nyina fɛfɛɛfɛw.
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul boaboaa mbabaaba ano guu gya no do no, ehurutsia fi hyew no mu bae bɛbrabraa ne nsa ho.
title: ACTS

text: Na asaase no do mba yi hun abowa no dɛ ɔsɛn ne nsa ho no, wɔsesee hɔnho nkorkor dɛ, Ampaara nyimpa yi yɛ owudzifo a oefi po mu enya nkwa dze, naaso awerdzi amma no kwan dɛ ɔtsena ase.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔpetsee abowa no kyeen gya mu, naaso hwee annyɛ no.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn dze, hɔn enyi daa kwan dɛ ɔrobɔhonhon, anaa ɔrobɔhwe ase ewu awerɛfir mu; na wɔhwɛe hwɛe na wohun dɛ biribiara annyɛ no no, wɔsesaa hɔn adwen dɛ gyama ɔyɛ onyame bi.
title: ACTS

text: Na apaamu hɔ ara na supruw no mu otsitsir a ne dzin dze Publius n’asaase wɔ; ɔno na ɔgyee hɛn yɛɛ hɛn hɔho ndaansa hwɛɛ hɛn yie.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ nna Publius n’egya da hɔ yar papu nye akokɔr: ɔno na Paul kɔr ne nkyɛn kɔbɔɔ mpaa, na ɔdze ne nsa too no do saa no yarba.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔyɛɛ dɛm no, nkaa no so a wɔyar wɔ supruw no mu no bae, na wɔsaa hɔn yar;
title: ACTS

text: hɔn so na wɔdze enyidzi pii dzii hɛn, na yerubotu no, wɔdze ndzɛmba a ohia hɛn guu hɛn no mu.
title: ACTS

text: Na abosoom ebiasa ekyir no, yɛfoow Alɛksandria hɛn bi a oedzi awɔwber wɔ supruw no mu a n’asɛnkyerɛdze nye Ntafo no kɔree.
title: ACTS

text: Na yedur Sirakuse no, yedzii hɔ ndaansa.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔ na yefii kwanee baa Rehegium; na da kor ekyir no, pomu mframa bɔe, na n’adzekyee no yekodur Puteoli;
title: ACTS

text: hɔ na yehun enuanom bi a wɔserɛɛ hɛn dɛ yɛntsena hɔn nkyɛn nda esuon; na mbrɛ yɛdze kodur Rome nye no.
title: ACTS

text: Hɔ na enuanom no, wɔtsee hɛn nka no, twaa kwan tsentsen baa bea bi a wɔfrɛ no Apius Guado, na binom so baa bea a wɔfrɛ no Nsadan Ebiasa a ɔno bɛn Rome; behyiaa hɛn, na Paul hun hɔn no, ɔdaa Nyankopɔn ase na ɔhyɛɛ dzen.
title: ACTS

text: Na yedur Rome mu no, ɔhamupanyin no dze mpokyerɛfo no maa Annkɔbea Safohen no, na Paul dze, ɔmaa no ho kwan dɛ ɔnye sordaanyi a ɔhwɛ no no nkɛtsena mbrɛ ɔpɛ.
title: ACTS

text: Na ɔbaa dɛ ndaansa ekyir no, ɔfrɛfrɛɛ Jewfo etsitsir no boaa ano; na wobehyiae no, ɔsee hɔn dɛ, Enuanom, mannyɛ biribi enntsia ɔman no anaa hɛn egyanom amambra, naaso woyii me dɛ daduanyi fii Jerusalɛm hyɛɛ Romefo nsa;
title: ACTS

text: hɔn na wɔhwehwɛɛ mu no, wɔpɛɛ dɛ wogyaa me, osiandɛ woennhu biribiara ɔfata mo wu.
title: ACTS

text: Na Jewfo kasae tsiae no, ɔbaa dɛ medze m’asɛm kɛdaan Kaesar: nnyɛ dɛ mowɔ biribi a medze bɔtoa me man bi a.
title: ACTS

text: Na iyi ntsi na meserɛɛ hom dɛ hom mbohu me na hom akasa akyerɛ me: na osian Israel enyidado ntsi na wɔdze nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn yi ato me yi.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔsee no dɛ, Hɛn dze yennyaa wo ho nwoma bi mmfii Judea, eso enuanom no mu biara mmbaa ha mmbɔbɔɔ kasee anaa ɔmmbɛkaa wo ho asɛm bɔn bi.
title: ACTS

text: Na yɛpɛ dɛ yehu dza edwen fa fɛkuw yi ho, osiandɛ yenyim dɛ wɔkasa tsia no wɔ mbea nyina.
title: ACTS

text: Na wɔhyɛɛ no da no, piinara baa ne nkyɛn wɔ mbrɛ ɔsoɛe no; hɔn na ɔkyerɛɛ hɔn ase dzii Nyankopɔn ahenman no ho dase, na ofitsi Moses mbra nye nkɔnhyɛfo no do kyerɛɛ hɔn Jesus ho asɛm mu fi anapa kesii ewimbir.
title: ACTS

text: Na binom gyee dza ɔkae no dzii, na binom so anngye enndzi.
title: ACTS

text: Na hɔn adwen annsaa wɔ dza ɔreka no ho no, wɔkɔree, na Paul kaa asɛm kor bi dɛ, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no nam nkɔnhyɛnyi Isaia do kaa no yie kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom dɛ,
title: ACTS

text: Kɔ ɔman yi hɔ na se dɛ, Ɔtse dze hom bɛtse, naaso hom renntse ase; Na ɔhwɛ dze hom bɔhwɛ, naaso hom runnhu:
title: ACTS

text: Osiandɛ ɔman yi akoma epirim, Na hɔn asowa esiw ɔtse ho, Na woemuamua hɔn enyiwa; Amma wɔaammfa hɔn enyiwa ennhu adze, Na wɔaammfa hɔn asowa anntse asɛm, Na wɔaammfa hɔn akoma anntse ase, Ma wɔaanndan ammba me nkyɛn ma maannsa hɔn yarba.
title: ACTS

text: Dɛm ntsi, hom nhu dɛ wɔasoma Nyankopɔn no nkwagye no akɛma amanamamfo: na hɔn so wɔbɛtse.
title: ACTS

text: [Na ɔkaa dɛm no, Jewfo no kɔree, na wɔgyegyee ekyingye wɔ hɔn mu.]
title: ACTS

text: Na Paul tsenaa nankasa ne fi a otua kaw mu mfe ebien, na ɔgyee hɔn a wɔbaa ne nkyɛn nyina,
title: ACTS

text: kaa Nyankopɔn ahenman no ho asɛm, na ɔdze ndamyɛ nyina kyerɛkyerɛɛ ndzɛmba a ɔfa Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ho, na obi ennsiw no kwan.
title: ACTS

text: Paul, Jesus Kraest n’akowaa, ɔsomafo a wɔafrɛ no na woeyi no esi hɔ ama Nyankopɔn n’asɛmpa a
title: ROMANS

text: ɔnam no nkɔnhyɛfo no do dzii kan bɔɔ anohoba wɔ kyerɛwsɛm krɔnkrɔn no mu,
title: ROMANS

text: wɔ ne Ba no a wɔwoo no David asenyi wɔ honam afamu no ho,
title: ROMANS

text: na woyii no kyerɛɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn Ba wɔ tum mu, wɔ ahotsewee sunsum afamu, ɔnam ewufo mu soɛr do; Jesus Kraest hɛn Ewuradze a,
title: ROMANS

text: yɛnam no do enya adom nye asomafodwuma akɔ gyedzi setsie mu wɔ amanaman nyina mu, wɔ ne dzin ntsi:
title: ROMANS

text: dɛm amanamamfo yi mu na hom so hom wɔ, hom a Jesus Kraest afrɛ hom ayɛ nedze no.
title: ROMANS

text: Emi Paul yi na mekyerɛw dze kɛma Nyankopɔn n’adɔfo a wɔwɔ Rome nyina, ahotseweefo a wɔafrɛ hɔn no. Adom nye asomdwee a ofi hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest hɔ nka hom.
title: ROMANS

text: Dza odzi kan nye dɛ menam Jesus Kraest do da me Nyankopɔn ase wɔ hom nyina ntsi, osiandɛ wɔka hom gyedzi ho asɛm wɔ wiadze nyina.
title: ROMANS

text: Na me dasefo nye Nyankopɔn a mosom no mo sunsum mu wɔ ne Ba n’asɛmpa no mu, mbrɛ minngyaa hom dzin bɔ da,
title: ROMANS

text: na meserɛ wɔ me mpaabɔ mu daa dɛ bi a da bi Nyankopɔn pɛ a, ongya me kwan pa ma membra hom nkyɛn.
title: ROMANS

text: Na m’enyi gyina dɛ muhu hom, ma meeyi sunsum mu akyɛdze bi ama hom, ama hom eetsintsim:
title: ROMANS

text: ɔno nye dɛ, yɛnam homankasa hom gyedzi na emi medze so do hɛn nyina eenya awerɛkyekyer wɔ hɛn mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na eso, enuanom, memmpɛ dɛ medze besie hom dɛ mpɛn pii nye yi a mabɔ me tsirmu pɔw dɛ mebɛba hom nkyɛn (naaso woesiw me kwan ebodu sesei) ama meenya hom so hom mu aba bi, dɛ amanamamfo nkaa no so.
title: ROMANS

text: Meyɛ kafonyi ma Griikfo nye amamforafo nyina, enyansafo nye adwenharfo nyina.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi na medze ndamyɛ ayɛ krado dɛ mebɛka asɛmpa no akyerɛ hom a hom wɔ Rome so.
title: ROMANS

text: Na m’enyi nnto asɛmpa no ho, osiandɛ ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn no tum a ɔdze kɔ nkwagye mu ma hɔn a wɔgye dzi nyina, odzi kan Jewfo, nye Griikfo so.
title: ROMANS

text: Osiandɛ no mu na woyi Nyankopɔn tsenenee edzi, ɔnam gyedzi mu kowie gyedzi mu: dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Ɔtseneneenyi nam gyedzi do benya nkwa.
title: ROMANS

text: Na wofi sor ada Nyankopɔn ebufuw no edzi etsia nyimpa a wonnsuro Nyame na wɔdze brakyew nam emumuyɛ nyina do siw nokwar no kwan no;
title: ROMANS

text: na dza wohu no Nyankopɔn ho a ɔyɛ yie no da hɔ pefee wɔ hɔn mu: osiandɛ Nyankopɔn na oeyi akyerɛ hɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn ho adze a wonnhu no, ofitsi ber a wɔbɔɔ wiadze no ɔnam ndzɛmba a wɔayɛ do ada no edzi pefee, ma wɔdze adwen hu mu, mekyerɛ no tum a onnyi ewiei nye ne nyamesu no; dɛm ntsi wonnyi anoyi biara;
title: ROMANS

text: osiandɛ wohun Nyankopɔn no, wɔannhyɛ no enyimnyam dɛ Nyankopɔn, eso wɔannda no ase; na mbom hɔn adwen yɛ nkwaseadwen, na sum hyɛɛ hɔn akoma a ntseasee nnyi mu no ma.
title: ROMANS

text: Hɔnara wɔse wɔyɛ enyansafo no, wɔdaan nkwasea,
title: ROMANS

text: na wɔsakyeer Nyankopɔn a ɔmmprɔw n’enyimnyam yɛɛ nyimpa a ɔprɔw no honyi saso, nye ntumbowa, nye mbowa a wotsia ntwɛr anan, nye aweaweambowa dze.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi Nyankopɔn yii hɔn maa efifidze wɔ hɔn akoma akɔndɔ mu, dɛ wongu hɔn nyimpadua ho fi wɔ hɔn mu,
title: ROMANS

text: osiandɛ wɔsesaa Nyankopɔn no nokwar no gyee ator, na wɔsɔree soom abɔdze kyɛɛn Bɔadze, ɔno a woehyira no daa no; Amen.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi Nyankopɔn yii hɔn maa enyimguase akɔndɔ nhyɛdo mu: na hɔn mbaa dze hɔn nyɛbea a ɔsɛ hɔn suban sesae gyee dza otsia hɔn suban;
title: ROMANS

text: dɛmara so na hɔn mbarimba so gyaa dɛ wɔnye ɔbaa hyia dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ na ɔfata hɔn suban, na mbom wonyaa akɔndɔ wɔ hɔnho nkorkor, mbarimba nye mbarimba yɛɛ adapaadze, ntsi so wonyaa akatua a ɔfata hɔn mfom wɔ hɔnankasa hɔn mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ woemmbu no bi dɛ wɔbɔkora Nyankopɔn wɔ hɔn nyimdzee mu no, Nyankopɔn so gyaa hɔn maa adwen a ɔmmfora, dɛ wɔnyɛ dza ɔmmfata.
title: ROMANS

text: Brakyew nyina hyɛɛ hɔn ma, emumuyɛ, enyiber, ndzeyɛbɔn ahyɛ hɔn ma; nyitan, ewudzi, aperper, ndaadaa, enyitsew bɔn;
title: ROMANS

text: wɔyɛ asotufo, anokumfo, Nyankopɔn tamfo, ntsɛntsɛmfo, nkontompɔfo, ahotuwfo, ndzebɔn farbaefo, awofo do asoɔdzenfo,
title: ROMANS

text: nkwaseafo, ahyɛmutofo, wonnyi tsema, wonnyi ehumbɔbɔr:
title: ROMANS

text: hɔn na wonyim Nyankopɔn ahyɛdze, dɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm ndzɛmba yi fata owu, naaso nnyɛ ne yɛ nko na wɔyɛ, na mpo wɔgye hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm ndzɛmba no so to mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, ɔwo nyimpa a ibu atsɛn, anoyi bi nnyi hɔ mma wo, na dza ibu obi atsɛn wɔ mu no ibu wankasa woho fɔ; osiandɛ ɔwo a ibu atsɛn no, eyɛ adze kor no ara.
title: ROMANS

text: Na yenyim dɛ Nyankopɔn n’atsɛmbu tse dɛ mbrɛ nokwar tse wɔ hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm ndzɛmba no do.
title: ROMANS

text: Na ɔwo, nyimpa a ibu hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm ndzɛmba no atsɛn, na eyɛ dɛmara no, ana isusu dɛ ibefi Nyankopɔn n’atsɛmbu nsa?
title: ROMANS

text: Anaadɛ ibu n’ayamuyie nye tartweɔn nye penkyɛr ahonya mapa no enyimtsia a, innyim dɛ Nyankopɔn n’ayamuyie no dze wo rokɔ nnuho mu anaa?
title: ROMANS

text: Na w’akoma dzendzen a ɔmmpɛ dɛ ɔsakyer ntsi, eroboaboa ebufuw ano ma woho wɔ ebufuw nye Nyankopɔn ne tsenenee atsɛmbu nyikyerɛ da no?
title: ROMANS

text: Ɔno na obosusu ama nyimpa biara dɛ mbrɛ no ndwuma tse:
title: ROMANS

text: hɔn a wɔdze papayɛ mu abotar hwehwɛ enyimnyam nye enyidzi, nye dza ɔmmprɔw no, ɔbɛma hɔn onnyiewiei nkwa;
title: ROMANS

text: na hɔn a wɔpɛ mansotwe, na wonntsie nokwar no na mbom wotsie dza ɔnntsen no, ebufuw nye ebufuhyew bɛba hɔn do.
title: ROMANS

text: Nyew, ahohia nye ahoguan na ɔbɛba nyimpa a wɔyɛ bɔn nyina do, Jewfo dzi kan, nye Griikfo so.
title: ROMANS

text: Na hɔn a wɔyɛ papa nyina dze, enyimnyam nye enyidzi nye asomdwee bɛka hɔn, Jewfo dzi kan, nye Griikfo so.
title: ROMANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn afamu dze, nyimpa enyimhwɛ nnyi hɔ.
title: ROMANS

text: Na dodow a woekwetsi mbra ayɛ bɔn no, wobokwetsi mbra so ahera; na dodow a wɔayɛ bɔn wɔ mbra mu no, wɔnam mbra do bobu hɔn atsɛn.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nnyɛ mbratsiefo na wɔyɛ atseneneefo wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim, na mbom hɔn a wodzi mbra do no na wobobu hɔn bem.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ amanamamfo a wonnyi mbra nam hɔn awosu do yɛ mbra mu ndzɛmba a, iyinom a wonnyi mbra no yɛ mbra ma hɔnankasa hɔnho;
title: ROMANS

text: hɔn na wɔkyerɛ dɛ wɔakyerɛw mbra ndwuma no wɔ hɔn akoma mu, hɔn tsibowa dzi hɔn dase, hɔn adwen so toatoa hɔn anaadɛ oyiyi ano ma hɔn,
title: ROMANS

text: wɔ da a Nyankopɔn nam Jesus Kraest do bobu nyimpa esumansɛm atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ me nsɛmpa tse no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ wɔfrɛ wo Jewnyi, na edze woho twer mbra no, na ituw woho wɔ Nyankopɔn mu,
title: ROMANS

text: na inyim n’apɛdze, na inyim mbrɛ wosi pa ndzɛmba mu, dɛ wofi mbra no mu akyerɛkyerɛ wo ntsi,
title: ROMANS

text: na egye woho dzi dɛ eyɛ enyifurafo kwankyerɛfo, hɔn a wɔwɔ sum mu no hɔn kan,
title: ROMANS

text: nkwasea fotufo, nkɔkowaba kyerɛkyerɛfo, na awea wɔ mbra no ho nyimdzee nye nokwar no mu a;
title: ROMANS

text: nna afei ɔwo a ekyerɛkyerɛ obi no, ennkyerɛkyerɛ wankasa woho? Ɔwo a eka dɛ mma obi nnwia adze no, woara iwia adze?
title: ROMANS

text: Ɔwo a edɛ mma wɔnnto awar no, na woara eto awar yi? Ɔwo a ikyir ohonyi no, na efom asɔrfi mu adze yi?
title: ROMANS

text: Ɔwo a ituw woho wɔ mbra mu no, na enam mbrato do dze Nyankopɔn enyim twutwuw famu yi?
title: ROMANS

text: Na hom ntsi na wɔsɛɛ Nyankopɔn ne dzin wɔ amanaman mu, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ idzi mbra no do a, twatsiatwa yɛ mfaso, na sɛ eyɛ mbratonyi a, wo twatsiatwa adan monomonomyɛ.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ obi a wonntwaa no twatsia dzi mbra no tseneneensɛm no do a, aso wonnkobu no dɛ obi a woetwa no twatsia?
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm a, sɛ nyia wɔwoo no dɛ wontwa no twatsia dzi mbra no do a, ana onnkobu ɔwo a wɔakyerɛw Mbra no ama wo na woetwa wo twatsia no atsɛn?
title: ROMANS

text: Na nnyɛ Jewnyi nye dza ɔyɛ dɛm wɔ enyiwa do, eso nnyɛ twatsiatwa nye dza ɔda enyiwa do wɔ honam mu;
title: ROMANS

text: na mbom Jewnyi mapa nye nyia ɔtse dɛm wɔ no mu, na twatsiatwa ankasa nye dza ɔyɛ akoma mu dze wɔ sunsum mu, nnyɛ kyerɛw mu a: ɔno na n’ayɛyi mmfi nyimpa, na mbom ofi Nyankopɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm a, nna ebɛnadze mu na Jewnyi enya no yie ma ɔbor do? Anaaso dɛ ebɛn mfaso na ɔwɔ twatsiatwa ho?
title: ROMANS

text: Mfaso a ɔwɔ mu dɔɔ so akwan nyina mu. Dza odzi kan nye dɛ Jewfo na wɔdze Nyankopɔn nsɛm hyɛɛ hɔn nsa.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ binom anngye enndzi a, ɔyɛ dɛn? Ana hɔn ekyingye bɛma Nyankopɔn no nokwardzi ayɛ kwa?
title: ROMANS

text: Dabida: na mbom ma Nyankopɔn nyɛ nokwafo, na nyimpa nyina nyɛ atorfo; dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ama eedzi bem wɔ wo nsɛm mu, Na wobu wo atsɛn a, eedzi nyim.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ hɛn brakyew yi na oyi Nyankopɔn ne tsenenee kyerɛ a, yɛbɛse dɛn? Dɛ Nyankopɔn nntsen dɛ ɔdze ebufuw ba hɛn do anaa? (Mekasa dɛ nyimpa.)
title: ROMANS

text: Dabida: sɛ ɔtse dɛm a, nkyɛ Nyankopɔn bɛyɛ dɛn ebu wiadze atsɛn?
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ wɔnam m’ator do ahyɛ Nyankopɔn no nokwar enyimnyam mbordo a, ɔyɛ dɛn na wɔda ho bu me atsɛn dɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi?
title: ROMANS

text: Na ebɛnadze ntsi na yɛnnka dɛ, (dɛ mbrɛ binom ka to hɛn do dɛ yɛse dɛ), Hom mma yɛnyɛ bɔn ama papa aaba? Hɔn dɛm no na wɔfata afɔbu.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm a ebɛn asɛm a? Wɔkyɛn hɛn anaa? Dabiarada: osiandɛ yeedzi kan aka afa Jewfo nye Griikfo nyina ho dɛ, hɔn nyina hyɛ bɔn ase;
title: ROMANS

text: dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Ɔtseneneenyi nnyi hɔ, ɔbaako mpo nnyi hɔ;
title: ROMANS

text: Obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔwɔ ntseasee, Obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔhwehwɛ Nyankopɔn ekyir kwan;
title: ROMANS

text: Hɔn nyina amanaman, hɔn nyina ayɛ dza mfaso nnyi ho; Obiara nnyi hɔ a ɔyɛ papa, oho, nnyɛ ɔbaako mpo.
title: ROMANS

text: Hɔn meneba yɛ nda a oebue; Wɔdze hɔn tɛkyerɛma adaadaa; Nhurutsia bɔr wɔ hɔn anofamfa ase:
title: ROMANS

text: Hɔn anomu ahyɛ ndom nye wenwen ma;
title: ROMANS

text: Hɔn anan yɛ har dɛ wɔdze keka bɔgya gu;
title: ROMANS

text: Ɔsɛɛ nye amandzehu wɔ hɔn akwan do,
title: ROMANS

text: Na asomdwee kwan no dze, woennhu;
title: ROMANS

text: Nyankopɔn ho suro biara nnyi hɔn enyiwa do.
title: ROMANS

text: Na yenyim dɛ biribiara a mbra no se no, ɔka kyerɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ mbra no ase, ama wɔaaka ano nyina ato mu, ma wiadze nyina eedzi Nyankopɔn atsɛmbu mu fɔ.
title: ROMANS

text: Osiandɛ ɔnam mbra no ndwuma do a worummbu honam biara bem wɔ n’enyim: na mbra no do na wɔnam hu bɔn mbrɛ ɔtse.
title: ROMANS

text: Na afei dze, woekwetsi mbra no eyi Nyankopɔn ne tsenenee bi edzi, no ho dase na mbra no nye nkɔnhyɛfo no dzii:
title: ROMANS

text: dza ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn tsenenee no a ɔnam Jesus Kraest ho gyedzi do hɛn hɔn a wɔgye dzi nyina mu no, osiandɛ nyiyimu biara nnyi hɔ;
title: ROMANS

text: na hɔn nyina ayɛ bɔn, na wɔatɔ sin wɔ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam ho;
title: ROMANS

text: na wɔdze n’adom nam pon a ɔwɔ Jesus Kraest mu no do bu hɔn bem kwa.
title: ROMANS

text: Ɔno na Nyankopɔn dze no sii hɔ dɛ mpatadze a ɔnam gyedzi do wɔ no bɔgyaa mu, dɛ ɔdze bɛkyerɛ ne tsenenee, dɛ bɔn a kan no wɔyɛe no ɔama etwa mu, wɔ Nyankopɔn n’abotar mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Medɛ, ɔdze kyerɛɛ ne tsenenee wɔ ber yi mu, ama nankasa oeedzi bem, na ɔaayɛ nyia ɔwɔ gyedzi wɔ Jesus Kraest mu bembufo.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm a nna ebɛn kwan na nyimpa wɔ dɛ ɔhyehyɛ no ho? Ɔmmba mu koraa. Ɔnam mbra bɛn do? Ndwuma dze no a? Oho, na ɔnam gyedzi mbra bi do.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi yebu no dɛ wokwetsi mbra ndwuma no nam gyedzi do bu nyimpa bem.
title: ROMANS

text: Anaa Nyankopɔn yɛ Jewfo nko dze? Ana ɔnnyɛ amanamamfo so dze bi? Nyew, ɔyɛ amanamamfo so Nyankopɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Sɛ Nyankopɔn kor no ara na ɔnam twatsiatwafo gyedzi do bobu hɔn bem, na ɔnam hɔn a wonntwaa hɔn twatsia so gyedzi do bobu hɔn bem a,
title: ROMANS

text: nna yɛnam dɛm gyedzi yi do ma mbra no yɛ gyan anaa? Dabida: mbom yɛma mbra no tsim.
title: ROMANS

text: Ebɛnadze koraa na afei yɛbɛka dɛ hɛn honam afamu egya Abraham enya?
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ ofir ndwuma mu na wobuu Abraham bem a, ɔwɔ dza ɔdze tuw: na nnyɛ Nyankopɔn afamu a.
title: ROMANS

text: Na ebɛnadze na kyerɛw no ka? Na Abraham gyee Nyankopɔn dzii, na wobuu no tsenenee maa no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nyia ɔyɛ edwuma no, wommbu n’akatua dɛ adom, na mbom dɛ kaw bi a wotua.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nyia ɔnnyɛ edwuma, na ɔgye nyia obu busuyɛfo bem dzi no, wobu ne gyedzi dɛ tsenenee ma no.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ David so bɔ nhyira ma nyimpa a Nyankopɔn kwetsi ndwuma bu tsenenee ma no, dɛ,
title: ROMANS

text: Nhyira nye hɔn a wɔdze hɔn mbrato akyɛ hɔn, Na hɔn ndzebɔn wɔakata do.
title: ROMANS

text: Nhyira nye nyimpa a Ewuradze rummbu bɔn nngu no do.
title: ROMANS

text: Ana nhyira yi wɔbɔ ma twatsiafo nko, anaa hɔn a wonntwaa hɔn twatsia so? Osiandɛ yɛka dɛ, Wobuu gyedzi dɛ tsenenee maa Abraham.
title: ROMANS

text: Na wobui maa no dɛn? Woetwa no twatsia no anaa wonnyae nntwaa no twatsia no a? Hwɛ, nnyɛ twatsiatwa mu a na mbom monomonomyɛ mu a;
title: ROMANS

text: na onyaa twatsiatwa asɛnkyerɛdze no dɛ gyedzi a onyae wɔ ber a wonntwaa no twatsia mu no ne tsenenee ho nsɔwano: ama ɔaayɛ agyedzifo a wɔyɛ monomonomfo nyina egya, na woeebu no tsenenee ama hɔn;
title: ROMANS

text: na ɔaayɛ twatsiatwafo egya ama hɔn a nnyɛ dɛ wofi twatsiafo mu nko, na mbom so hɔn a wotsiatsia gyedzi a hɛn egya Abraham nyae wɔ ber nna wonntwaa no twatsia no anamɔn mu no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nnyɛ mbra no do na anohoba a wɔbɔɔ Abraham anaa n’asefo dɛ wɔbɛyɛ wiadze adzedzifo nam bae, na mbom ɔnam gyedzi tsenenee do.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ hɔn a wofi mbra mu no yɛ adzedzifo a gyedzi no ayɛ kwa, na anohoba no annyɛ hwee:
title: ROMANS

text: na mbra no twe ebufuw ba, na mbrɛ mbra bi nnyi no, mbrato bi so nnyi hɔ.
title: ROMANS

text: Iyi ntsi na ofi gyedzi mu, ma oeefi adom mu, ma anohoba no eetsim ama asefo no nyina; nnyɛ hɔn a wofi mbra mu nko, na hɔn a wofi Abraham a ɔyɛ hɛn nyina egya no ne gyedzi mu no so,
title: ROMANS

text: (dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Medze wo bɛyɛ aman pii hɔn egya) wɔ nyia ɔgyee no dzii no enyim, Nyankopɔn a ɔma ewufo nkwa, na ɔfrɛ ndzɛmba a wonnyi hɔ dɛ gyama wɔwɔ hɔ no.
title: ROMANS

text: Ɔno a enyidado nnyi no, ɔgyee dzii enyidado mu, ama ɔaayɛ aman pii egya, dɛ mbrɛ wɔaka no dɛ, Dɛm na w’asefo bɛyɛ no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na ɔannyɛ gyedzi mu mberɛw annhwɛ ne nyimpadua a ewu no (nna oedzi mfe bɛyɛ ɔha), nye Sara a n’awotoa ewu no;
title: ROMANS

text: na ɔhwɛɛ Nyankopɔn anohoba no, ɔammfa ekyingye annyɛ anyanyan, na mbom ɔyɛɛ gyedzi mu ahoɔdzen hyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam,
title: ROMANS

text: na ohun ampa dɛ nyia ɔabɔ anohoba no, obotum ayɛ.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi so wobuu no dɛ tsenenee maa no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nnyɛ no nko bi ntsi na wɔakyerɛw yi dɛ wobui maa no,
title: ROMANS

text: na mbom hɛn so a wobobu ama hɛn dɛ yɛgye nyia onyaan hɛn Ewuradze Jesus fii ewufo mu dzi no ntsi a,
title: ROMANS

text: ɔno na hɛn mfom ntsi woyii no mae, na hɛn abemdzi ntsi wonyaan no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na afei wɔnam gyedzi do ebu hɛn bem ntsi, yɛnam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest do enya Nyankopɔn afamu asomdwee;
title: ROMANS

text: ɔnam no do so na yɛdze gyedzi enya adom yi a yegyina mu yi mu kwan; na yɛhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam ho enyidado mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nnyɛ yi nko bi, na mbom yɛhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ ahohia mu so: osiandɛ yenyim dɛ ahohia dze abotar ba;
title: ROMANS

text: na abotar dze osuahu ba; na osuahu dze enyidado ba;
title: ROMANS

text: na enyidado nnhyɛ enyito, osiandɛ wɔnam Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a wɔdze ama hɛn no do ehue Nyankopɔn dɔ egu hɛn akoma mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na yɛda ho yɛ mberɛw no, ber a ɔsɛ mu na Kraest wui maa ebusuyɛfo.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nyia ɔyɛ nyimpa tsenenee mpo, ɔbɛyɛ dzen ana obi ewu ama no: bi annyɛ a, nyia ɔyɛ nyimpa papa no, obi besi no bo dɛ obowu ama no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no dɔ wɔ hɛn do dɛ yɛda ho yɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo no, Kraest wui maa hɛn.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei mbom a woedua no bɔgyaa do ebu hɛn bem yi, wɔnam no do bɛgye hɛn nkwa efi ebufuw no mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ yɛyɛɛ atamfo no, wɔnam ne Ba no no wu do kaa hɛn nye Nyankopɔn bɔɔ mu a, afei mbom a wɔaka hɛn abɔ mu yi wobodua no nkwa no do agye hɛn nkwa;
title: ROMANS

text: na nnyɛ yi nko bi, na mbom yɛhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ Nyankopɔn mu, osian hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest a sesei yɛnam no do enya nkabɔmu ntsi.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi dɛ mbrɛ bɔn nam nyimpa kor do baa wiadze, na owu nam bɔn do bae no, dɛmara na owu twaa mu baa nyimpa nyina do, dɛ hɔn nyina ayɛ bɔn ntsi:
title: ROMANS

text: na bɔn wɔ wiadze ansaana mbra no reba, na mbra nnyi hɔ a, wommbu bɔn nngu obi do.
title: ROMANS

text: Na owu dzii hen fii Adam do besii Moses do, wɔ hɔn mpo a hɔn bɔn nntse dɛ Adam nedze a ɔyɛ mbrato no. Dɛm Adam yi na wɔdze no toto nyia ɔbɛba no ho.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nnyɛ mbrɛ mbrato no tse na adom akyɛdze no so tse. Na sɛ ɔbaakofo ne mbrato ntsi dodowara ewu a, Nyankopɔn adom nye adom akyɛdze a ɔwɔ nyimpa kor Jesus Kraest mu no abor do ama dodowara.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nnyɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔnam ɔbaakofo a ɔyɛɛ bɔn no do bae no na akyɛdze no tse, na atsɛmbu no nam baakofo do bɛdaan afɔbu, na adom akyɛdze no nam mbrato do bɛdaan abembu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ ɔbaakofo ne mbrato ntsi na owu nam ɔbaakofo no do dzii hen a, hɔn a woenya adom nye tsenenee akyɛdze no mbordo no so nam ɔbaakofo, Jesus Kraest do bedzi hen wɔ nkwa mu akyɛn dɛm.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei dɛ mbrɛ afɔbu nam ɔbaakofo mbrato do baa nyimpa nyina do no, dɛmara so na nkwa abembu nam ɔbaakofo abemdzi do baa nyimpa nyina do nye no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ dodowara nam nyimpa kor n’asoɔdzen do bɛyɛɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo no, mbrɛ dodowara nam ɔbaakofo ne setsie do bɛyɛ atseneneefo nye no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na mbra no kaa ho bae, ma mbrato aadɔɔ so: na mbrɛ bɔn adɔɔ so no, adom abor do akyɛn no;
title: ROMANS

text: ma dɛ mbrɛ bɔn edzi hen wɔ wu mu no, dɛmara so na adom nam tsenenee do eedzi hen akɔ onnyiewiei nkwa mu, ɔnam Jesus Kraest hɛn Ewuradze do.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei yɛbɛka dɛn? Ana yɛbɛda ho atsena bɔn mu, ma adom no adɔɔ so anaa?
title: ROMANS

text: Dabida. Ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na hɛn a yewui maa bɔn yɛbɛda ho atsena ase wɔ bɔn mu?
title: ROMANS

text: Ana hom nnyim dɛ hɛn a wonumaa hɛn hyɛɛ Kraest Jesus mu no nyina, wonumaa hɛn hyɛɛ no wu mu?
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔnam enuma mu esie yɛnye no wɔ owu mu, ma dɛ mbrɛ wɔnam Egya no n’enyimnyam do nyaan Kraest fii ewufo mu no, dɛmara so na hɛn so yaanantsew nkwa fofor mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ wɔatsɛw hɛn nye Kraest abɔ mu kor wɔ no wu mu a, nna yɛnam no wusoɛr no do nye no bɔbɔ mu kor so efifir.
title: ROMANS

text: Na yenyim dɛ wɔbɔɔ hɛn nyimpa dadaw no nye no mbeamudua mu, ma bɔn nyimpadua no eewu, amma yaannyɛ bɔn nkowaa bio:
title: ROMANS

text: na nyia oewu no, woebu no bem wɔ bɔn ho.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ yɛnye Kraest wui a, yɛgye dzi dɛ yɛnye no bɛtsena ase so;
title: ROMANS

text: osiandɛ yenyim dɛ Kraest a wonyaan no fii ewufo mu no runnwu bio, owu nndzi no do tum bio.
title: ROMANS

text: Na owu a owui no, owui maa bɔn prɛko, na ase a ɔtse no ɔtse ma Nyankopɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛmara so na hom mbubu hom ho dɛ hom ewu ama bɔn, na hom tse ase ma Nyankopɔn wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi mma hom mma bɔn nndzi hen wɔ hom nyimpadua a obowu no mu, dɛ hom betsie no wɔ n’akɔndɔ mu;
title: ROMANS

text: eso mma hom nngyaa hom nyimpadua mfafakuwa mma bɔn dɛ brakyew edwindadze, na mbom hom mfa homho mma Nyankopɔn dɛ hɔn a woefi ewufo mu tse ase, na hom ngyaa hom nyimpadua mfafakuwa mma Nyankopɔn dɛ tsenenee edwindadze.
title: ROMANS

text: Na bɔn rinndzi hom do tum bio; osiandɛ hom nnyi mbra ase, na mbom hom wɔ adom ase.
title: ROMANS

text: Afei ebɛn asɛm a? Dɛ yennyi mbra ase na yɛwɔ adom ase ntsi, yɛnyɛ bɔn anaa? Dabida.
title: ROMANS

text: Ana hom nnyim dɛ onyia hom egyaa homho ama no dɛ nkowaa dɛ hom betsie no no, sɛ bɔn a ɔdze kɔ owu mu dze o, setsie a ɔdze kɔ tsenenee mu o, ɔno a hom tsie no no no nkowaa nye hom?
title: ROMANS

text: Na ndaase nka Nyankopɔn dɛ nkyɛ hom yɛ bɔn nkowaa, na afei hom fi hom akoma mu ayɛ setsie ama nkyerɛkyerɛ soronko a wɔdze hom hyɛɛ mu no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na woeyi hom efi bɔn no nkowaasom ase, na hom abɛyɛ tsenenee no nkowaa.
title: ROMANS

text: Mekasa wɔ nyimpa afamu wɔ hom honam ne mberɛwyɛ ntsi dɛ, Mbrɛ hom gyaa hom nyimpadua mfafakuwa dɛ nkowaa maa efifidze nye emumuyɛ dze kɔr emumuyɛ mu no, dɛmara na afei hom ngyaa hom nyimpadua mfafakuwa dɛ nkowaa mma tsenenee nkɔ ahotsewee mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na hom yɛɛ bɔn nkowaa no, hom twee homho fii tsenenee ho.
title: ROMANS

text: Ebɛn aba na hom nyaa no wɔ ber no mu wɔ ndzɛmba a afei ɔyɛ hom fɛr no mu? Na ndzɛmba no n’ewiei nye owu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na afei hom enya hom fahodzi efi bɔn ho, na hom abɛyɛ Nyankopɔn nkowaa yi, hom wɔ hom aba a ɔdze kɔ ahotsewee mu, na n’ewiei nye onnyiewiei nkwa.
title: ROMANS

text: Na bɔn akatua nye owu, na Nyankopɔn n’adom akyɛdze nye onnyiewiei nkwa a ɔwɔ hɛn Ewuradze Kraest Jesus mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Enuanom minyim dɛ merekasa kyerɛ hɔn a wonyim mbra no n’adzeban. Ana hom nnyim dɛ mber tsentsen a nyimpa tse ase no, mbra no dzi no do tum?
title: ROMANS

text: Na ɔbaa a ɔwɔ kun no wɔdze mbra no kyekyer no fam no kun mber tsentsen a ɔtse ase nyina; na sɛ kun no wu a, wɔasan no efi kun no ne mbra no ho.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi kun no tse ase no, sɛ ɔdze noho kɔbɔ banyin bi ho a, wɔbɛfrɛ no ɔwartofo, na sɛ kun no wu a, oefi mbra no ho, ntsi sɛ ɔdze noho kɔbɔ banyin bi ho a, ɔnnyɛ ɔwartofo.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, dɛmara na hom so wɔnam Kraest nyimpadua do eku hom ama mbra no, ma hom dze homho akɔbɔ ɔfofor ho, mekyerɛ nyia woenyan no efi ewufo mu no, ama yaasow aba ama Nyankopɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Na yɛwɔ honam mu no, bɔn ne nhyɛdodze a ɔnam mbra no do no yɛɛ edwuma wɔ hɛn nyimpadua mfafakuwa mu dze soow aba maa owu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na afei yeewu ama dza nkyɛ ɔdze hɛn mu no ntsi, wɔasan hɛn efi mbra no ho, ma yaasom wɔ sunsum foforyɛ mu, na nnyɛ kyerɛw dadaw no mu a.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm a nna yɛbɛka dɛn? Mbra no nye bɔn anaa? Dabida, naaso mennhu bɔn gyedɛ ɔnam mbra no do: nkyɛ minnyim enyiber gyedɛ mbra no kaa dɛ, Mma w’enyi mmber adze.
title: ROMANS

text: Na bɔn nam mbrasɛm no do nyaa kwan yɛɛ enyiber nyina wɔ mo mu: na sɛ mbra nnyi hɔ a, bɔn ewu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na emi dze, mukwetsii mbra no bɔɔ bra pɛn, na mbrasɛm no bae no, bɔn nyanee;
title: ROMANS

text: na emi dze muwui, na mbrasɛm no ara a ɔbɔɔ me nkwa ho anohoba no, ɔnoara so na ɔdze me kɔr owu mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na bɔn nam mbrasɛm no do nyaa kwan daadaa me, na ɔnam do kum me.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi mbra no yɛ krɔnkrɔn, na mbrasɛm no yɛ krɔnkrɔn, nye tsenenee, nye papa.
title: ROMANS

text: Nna tserɛ dza ɔyɛ papa no daan owu maa me nye no? Dabida, na mbom bɔn, ama ɔaada edzi dɛ ɔyɛ bɔn ntsi, na ɔnam dza ɔyɛ papa no do dze wu aba mo do, ama bɔn aayɛ bɔn ntrado.
title: ROMANS

text: Na yenyim dɛ mbra no yɛ sunsum mu adze, na emi dze, meyɛ honamnyi a wɔatɔn me akɔ bɔn ase.
title: ROMANS

text: Na dza meyɛ no, minnyim: na nnyɛ dza mepɛ na meyɛ, na dza mikyir na meyɛ.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ meyɛ dza memmpɛ a, megye to mu dɛ mbra no ye.
title: ROMANS

text: Na afei nnyɛ emi na meyɛ, na bɔn a ɔtse mo mu no a.
title: ROMANS

text: Na minyim dɛ papa biara nntse mo mu, mekyerɛ me nyimpasu mu; osiandɛ papayɛ ho pɛ dze, ɔwɔ mo mu, na mbom mbrɛ minsi nyɛ dza oye no na munntum.
title: ROMANS

text: Na papa a mepɛ no mennyɛ, na bɔn a memmpɛ no, ɔno mbom na meyɛ.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ dza memmpɛ no, na meyɛ a, nna nnyɛ emi na meyɛ bio, na bɔn a ɔtse mo mu no a.
title: ROMANS

text: Nna muhu mbra bi dɛ emi a merepɛ papa ayɛ no, bɔn nye me tse.
title: ROMANS

text: Na mo mu nyimpa afamu dze m’enyi gye Nyankopɔn mbra ho;
title: ROMANS

text: naaso muhu mbra fofor bi wɔ me nyimpadua mfafakuwa mu a ɔnye m’adwen mbra ko, dɛ ɔfa me ndɔmmum ma bɔn a ɔwɔ me nyimpadua mfafakuwa mu no.
title: ROMANS

text: Ao, ɔwerɛhonyi a metse dɛm! Woana beyi me efi dɛm owu nyimpadua yi mu?
title: ROMANS

text: Na afei menam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest mu da Nyankopɔn ase! Na afei mankasa dze, medze m’adwen som Nyankopɔn ne mbra, na ɔhonam dze, medze som bɔn mbra.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei afɔbu biara nnyi hɔ ma hɔn a wɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu no.
title: ROMANS
