text: Na Kraest Jesus mu nkwa Sunsum mbra no agye me efi bɔn nye owu mbra no mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na dza mbra no enntum annyɛ, dɛ ɔnam honam no do yɛ mberɛw ntsi no, Nyankopɔn somaa nankasa ne Ba wɔ bɔn honam suban no mu, wɔ bɔn ntsi, dze buu bɔn fɔ wɔ honam mu,
title: ROMANS

text: ama mbra no n’ahyɛdze no aahyɛ ma wɔ hɛn a yɛnnantsew honam afamu, na mbom yɛnantsew sunsum afamu no mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na hɔn a wɔtɔ kɔ honam do no dwen honam dze, na hɔn a wɔtɔ kɔ sunsum do no dwen sunsum dze.
title: ROMANS

text: Na honam adwen yɛ owu, na sunsum adwen dze, ɔyɛ nkwa nye asomdwee.
title: ROMANS

text: Osiandɛ honam adwen yɛ Nyankopɔn do mansotwe na ɔmmfa noho nnhyɛ Nyankopɔn mbra no ase, ampa so orunntum;
title: ROMANS

text: na hɔn a wɔwɔ honam mu no runntum nnsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi.
title: ROMANS

text: Na hom dze, hom nnyi honam mu, na mbom hom wɔ sunsum mu, ber a Nyankopɔn no Sunsum tse hom mu no. Na obiara a onnyi Kraest no Sunsum no, ɔnnyɛ nedze.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ Kraest wɔ hom mu a, ɔnam bɔn ntsi nyimpadua no ewu, naaso tsenenee ntsi sunsum no ma nkwa.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ nyia onyaan Jesus fii ewufo mu no no Sunsum tse hom mu a, nyia onyaan Kraest Jesus fii ewufo mu no, nam no Sunsum a ɔtse hom mu no do bɛma hom nyimpadua a owu yi so enya nkwa.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi afei, enuanom, yɛyɛ akafo, mbom nnyɛ honam afamu na yɛdze kaw bi, dɛ yɛbɛtsena ase wɔ honam mu:
title: ROMANS

text: na sɛ hom tsena ase honam afamu a, hom bowu, na sɛ hom nam sunsum mu ku nyimpadua ne ndzeyɛe dze a, hom bɛtsena ase.
title: ROMANS

text: Na dodow a Nyankopɔn no Sunsum no gye hɔn taataa no, hɔn na wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn mba.
title: ROMANS

text: Na hom ennya nkowaayɛ sunsum a hom dze bosuro bio, na mbom hom enya abayɛ sunsum a yɛnam do tsea mu dɛ, Abba, Egya!
title: ROMANS

text: Na Sunsum nankasa nye hɛn sunsum dzi dase dɛ yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn mba;
title: ROMANS

text: na sɛ yɛyɛ mba a, yɛyɛ adzedzifo so, Nyankopɔn adzedzifo nye Kraest mu anyɛnkoyɛ adzedzifo, na sɛ yɛnye Kraest hu amandze dze a, yebenya kyɛfa so wɔ n’enyimnyam no mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na mubu dɛ sesei ber yi mu amandzehu no nndu enyimnyam a wɔrebɛda no edzi akyerɛ hɛn no ho koraa.
title: ROMANS

text: Na abɔdze no rotweɔn dzendzenndzen dɛ wɔbɛda Nyankopɔn ne mba edzi.
title: ROMANS

text: Na wɔdze abɔdze no hyɛɛ adze gyan ase, wɔ enyidado mu, nnyɛ nankasa ne pɛ a, na mbom nyia ɔdze hyɛɛ ase no ntsi a.
title: ROMANS

text: Osiandɛ abɔdze nankasa so wobeyi no mpɔtɔwee nkowaasom no ase akɔ Nyankopɔn mba enyimnyam adehyedzi no mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na yenyim dɛ abɔdze no nyina si nkrum dɛ ɔbaa a ɔroko awoo bodu ndɛ.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nnyɛ abɔdze no nko, na hɛnankasa so a yɛwɔ Sunsum no aba a odzi kan no, hɛn so yesi nkrum wɔ hɛn mu rotweɔn abayɛ no a wɔdze bɔpon nyimpadua no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na enyidado mu na wɔgyee hɛn nkwa: na enyidado a wohu no nnyɛ enyidado, na dza obi hu no, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na n’enyi bɛda do?
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ hɛn enyi da dza yennhu do a, nna yɛdze abotar tweɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛmara so na Sunsum no suo hɛn mu wɔ hɛn mberɛwyɛ mu, osiandɛ yennyim mbrɛ yendua mbɔ mpaa a ɔsɛ; na Sunsum nankasa na ɔdze apensi a onnyi kabea dzi ma hɛn.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nyia ɔpɛnsa akoma mu no nyim Sunsum no n’adwen mbrɛ ɔtse, osiandɛ odzi ma ahotseweefo no dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn ne pɛ tse.
title: ROMANS

text: Na yenyim dɛ hɔn a wɔdɔ Nyankopɔn no, ɔdze adze nyina bɔ mu yɛ edwuma ma hɔn yieyɛ, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔnam ne tsirmpɔw do afrɛ hɔn no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na hɔn a ohun hɔn siei no, hɔn so na oyii hɔn too hɔ dɛ wɔnye ne Ba no suban nsɛ, ama ɔno dze, ɔaayɛ enuanom pii mu abakan.
title: ROMANS

text: Na hɔn a oyii hɔn too hɔ no, hɔn so na ɔfrɛɛ hɔn, na hɔn a ɔfrɛɛ hɔn no, hɔn so na obuu hɔn bem, na hɔn a obuu hɔn bem no, hɔn so na ɔhyɛɛ hɔn enyimnyam.
title: ROMANS

text: Nna afei yɛbɛka dɛn wɔ iyinom ho? Sɛ Nyankopɔn wɔ hɛn afa a, woana na obotum asoɛr etsia hɛn?
title: ROMANS

text: Ɔno a ɔannkam nankasa ne Ba, na oyii no mae wɔ hɛn nyina ntsi no, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na ɔnnkɛfa adze nyina aka no ho adom hɛn?
title: ROMANS

text: Woana botum atoatoa hɔn a Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi hɔn no? Nyia obu bem nye Nyankopɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Woana nye nyia obu fɔ? Kraest Jesus a, ɔno a owui, nyew, na ɔsoɛree fii ewufo mu, nyia ɔtse Nyankopɔn nyimfa no a, na ɔnoara so na odzi ma hɛn no.
title: ROMANS

text: Woana bɛtsew hɛn efi Kraest dɔ no ho? Ahohia, anaa ahomtsew a, ɔhaw anaa ɔkɔm, adagyaw, anaa amandzenya a, anaa afona a?
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ɔwo ntsi woku hɛn daa nyina; Woebu hɛn dɛ nguan a woruboku hɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Naaso iyi nyina mu yɛnam nyia ɔdɔɔ hɛn no do dzi konyim bor do.
title: ROMANS

text: Na megye dzi ampa dɛ, owu anaa nkwa, anaa abɔfo, anaa etumfo, anaa dza ɔwɔ hɔ sesei, anaa dza ɔrebɛba, anaa ahoɔdzenfo,
title: ROMANS

text: anaa dza ɔkrɔn, anaa bun, anaa abɔdze biara nnkotum atsew hɛn efi Nyankopɔn dɔ no a ɔwɔ hɛn Ewuradze Kraest Jesus mu no ho.
title: ROMANS

text: Meka no nokwar wɔ Kraest mu, minndzi ator, na me tsibowa so regye me dase wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu,
title: ROMANS

text: dɛ mowɔ awerɛhow kɛse nye yaw a ɔmmbotow wɔ m’akoma mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nkyɛ mepɛ dɛ wɔyɛ mara ebusudze fi Kraest ho, ma mo nuanom a wɔyɛ m’ebusuafo wɔ honam afamu:
title: ROMANS

text: na wɔyɛ Israelfo a abayɛ no, nye enyimnyam no, nye ahyɛmu no, nye mbrahyɛ no, nye Nyankopɔn som no, nye anohoba no yɛ hɔndze;
title: ROMANS

text: na egyanom no so yɛ hɔndze, na honam afamu so Kraest a ɔyɛ adze nyina do Nyankopɔn a woehyira no daa daa no fi hɔn mu bae no. Amen.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nnyɛ dɛ gyama Nyankopɔn asɛm no ayɛ gyan bi; osiandɛ nnyɛ hɔn a wofi Israel mu nyina nye Israelfo;
title: ROMANS

text: na eso nnyɛ dɛ wɔyɛ Abraham asefo ntsi na hɔn nyina yɛ mba, na mbom, Isaak mu na wɔbɛfrɛ w’asefo.
title: ROMANS

text: Ɔno nye dɛ nnyɛ honam mu mba na wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn mba, na mbom anohoba mba no na wobu hɔn n’asefo.
title: ROMANS

text: Na anohoba no ɔnye asɛm yi, Afedan sisei mebɛba no, nna Sara enya ba.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nnyɛ dɛm nko, na Rebeka so nye ɔbaako no a ɔno nye hɛn egya Isaak nyinsenii,
title: ROMANS

text: na wonnyae nnwoo mba no, na wonnyae nnyɛɛ papa anaa bɔn no, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma Nyankopɔn ne nsanmuyi tsirmpɔw no begyina, na eemmfi ndwuma mu na mbom eefi nyia ɔfrɛ no ntsi no,
title: ROMANS

text: wɔsee no dɛ, Ɔpanyin no bɔsom ekumaba no,
title: ROMANS

text: dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Jakob na modɔɔ no, na Esau dze, metaan no.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm a afei yɛbɛka dɛn? Ana Nyankopɔn ayɛ ayɛmpamu, anaa ɔnntsen? Oho, ɔnntse dɛm da!
title: ROMANS

text: Na ɔkaa kyerɛ Moses dɛ, Nyia muhu no mbɔbɔr ara na mubohu no mbɔbɔr, na nyia me yamu hyehye me ma no ara na me yamu bɛhyehye me ama no.
title: ROMANS

text: Ntsi, ommfi nyia ɔpɛ, anaa nyia otutu mbirika, na ofi Nyankopɔn a ohu mbɔbɔr no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na kyerɛw no se Farao dɛ, Iyi ntsi na memaa wo do, dɛ mibeyi mo tum edzi wɔ wo mu, ama wɔaabɔ me dzin wɔ asaase nyina do.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔpɛ na ohu no mbɔbɔr, na nyia ɔpɛ na opirim n’akoma.
title: ROMANS

text: Na bi a ibebisa me dɛ, Dɛm a nna ɔyɛ dɛn na ɔda ho ara hu mfom wɔ nyimpa ho? Woana botum esiw ne pɛ kwan?
title: ROMANS

text: Ao, nyimpa, woana nye wo na enye Nyankopɔn yiyi nsɛm ano? Ana awendze bɛse ɔwemfo dɛ, Ɔyɛ dɛn na eyɛɛ me dɛm?
title: ROMANS

text: Ana senaba wemfo nnyi dɛtse do tum dɛ ɔdze dɛtsetɔw kor noara bi wen kɔɔpow a ɔsom bo, na ɔdze bi so wen kor so a ɔnnsom bo?
title: ROMANS

text: Na dɛ Nyankopɔn repɛ akyerɛ n’ebufuw, na oeyi no tum edzi ntsi, ɔdze abotar pii peen nkorɔfo a woeyi no ebufuw a woesiesie hɔn ama ɔsɛɛ no;
title: ROMANS

text: na sɛ ɔpɛ dɛ ɔbɛma woehu n’enyimnyam ahonya no so wɔ mbɔbɔrhu a oesiesie ama hɔn a oesiesie ama enyimnyam no so a, yɛbɛka dɛn?
title: ROMANS

text: Mekyerɛ hɛn a wɔafrɛ hɛn, nnyɛ Jewfo nko, na amanamamfo so bi ka ho.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ ɔka so wɔ Hosea mu dɛ, Mebɛfrɛ dza ɔnnyɛ me man, me man, Na nyia ɔnnyɛ mo dɔfo no, mo dɔfo.
title: ROMANS

text: Na ɔbɛba, dɛ, hɔn a wɔsee hɔn dɛ, Hom nnyɛ me man no, Hɔn na wɔbɛfrɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn tseasefo no mba.
title: ROMANS

text: Na Isaia so tsea mu wɔ Israel ho dɛ, Sɛ Israelmba dodow tse dɛ mpoano anhwea mpo a, kakraabi na wɔbɛgye hɔn nkwa.
title: ROMANS

text: Na n’asɛm no ne nwiei nye ne tsiatwa ntsi, Ewuradze bɛyɛ iyi wɔ asaase do.
title: ROMANS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ Isaia kae too hɔ dɛ, Sɛ Dɔm Ewuradze enngya hɛn asefo a, Nkyɛ yɛayɛ dɛ Sodom, na wɔama yɛayɛ dɛ Gomora.
title: ROMANS

text: Ebɛn asɛm na afei yɛbɛka? Dɛ amanamamfo a woenntsiw tsenenee no nsa aka tsenenee a ɔyɛ tsenenee a ofi gyedzi mu;
title: ROMANS

text: na Israel a otsiiw tsenenee mbra no enndu tsenenee mbra no ho.
title: ROMANS

text: Ebɛnadze ntsi a? Osiandɛ woenndua gyedzi do, na dɛ gyama ofir ndwuma mu. Wofintsiiw fintsiw bo no do,
title: ROMANS

text: dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Hwɛ, moroto fintsiwbo bi wɔ Zion, ɔbotan a ɔbɛma nkorɔfo ahwe ase: Na nyia ɔbɛgye no edzi no, n’enyim nnkogu ase.
title: ROMANS

text: Enuanom, m’akoma mu apɛdze pa ara na mo nkotoserɛ a meserɛ Nyankopɔn ma hɔn nye dɛ, wobenya nkwa.
title: ROMANS

text: Na midzi hɔn dase dɛ wɔwɔ Nyankopɔn ho mbɔdzembɔ, na mbom wonnyi ho nyimdzee.
title: ROMANS

text: Na ɔnam dɛ wonnyim Nyankopɔn ne tsenenee, na wɔhwehwɛ dɛ wɔdze hɔnankasa hɔndze si hɔ ntsi, wɔammbrɛ hɔnho adze annhyɛ Nyankopɔn tsenenee no ase.
title: ROMANS

text: Na Kraest nye mbra no n’ewiei a ɔdze obiara a ɔgye dzi kɔ tsenenee mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na Moses kyerɛw dɛ nyimpa a ɔyɛ tsenenee a ofi mbra no mu no na obenya mu nkwa.
title: ROMANS

text: Na mbrɛ tsenenee a ofi gyedzi mu no ka nye yi, Mma nnse wɔ w’akoma mu dɛ, Woana bɔfow akɔ sor? (Ɔno nye dɛ, ɔrekɛfa Kraest esian:)
title: ROMANS

text: anaadɛ, Woana besian akɔ bun no mu? (Ɔno nye dɛ, ɔrekɛfa Kraest efi ewufo mu aba).
title: ROMANS

text: Na ɔka dɛn? Asɛm no abɛn wo, ɔwɔ w’anomu, ɔwɔ w’akoma mu: (Ɔno nye gyedzi asɛm a yɛbɔ no dawur no,)
title: ROMANS

text: dɛ, Sɛ edze w’ano paa mu ka dɛ Jesus nye Ewuradze, na egye dzi wɔ w’akoma mu dɛ Nyankopɔn nyaan no fii ewufo mu a, wɔbɛgye wo nkwa:
title: ROMANS

text: na akoma na wɔdze gye dzi kɔ tsenenee mu, na ano na wɔdze paa mu ka kɔ nkwagye mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na kyerɛw no ka dɛ obiara a ɔbɛgye no edzi no n’enyim runngu ase.
title: ROMANS

text: Na soronko biara nnyi Jewnyi nye Griiknyi ntamu: na Ewuradze kor no ara na odzi hɔn nyina do, na ɔyɛ ɔhonyanyi ma hɔn a wɔfrɛ no nyina:
title: ROMANS

text: na, Obiara a ɔbɔbɔ Ewuradze dzin no obenya nkwa.
title: ROMANS

text: Na wɔbɛyɛ dɛn afrɛ nyia wɔnngyee no nndzii? Na wɔbɛyɛ dɛn agye nyia wɔnntsee no ho asɛm edzi? Na sɛ ɔsɛnkafo nnyi hɔ a, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn atse?
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ wɔnnsomaa hɔn a, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn abɔ asɛm no dawur? Dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Hɔn a wɔdze ndzepa ho asɛmpa ba no, mbrɛ hɔn anan dua yɛ fɛw a!
title: ROMANS

text: Na hɔn nyinara enntsie asɛmpa no. Na Isaia se dɛ, Ewuradze, woana na ɔagye hɛn amandzɛɛ edzi?
title: ROMANS

text: Nna gyedzi no fi otsie mu, na otsie nam Kraest asɛm do na ɔba.
title: ROMANS

text: Na mese, Ana wɔanntse koraa? Nyew, ampa, Hɔn ndze epuei akɔ asaase nyina do, Na hɔn asɛm edu wiadze ano noho.
title: ROMANS

text: Mibisa bio dɛ, Ana Israel anntse ase? Moses dzi kan ka dɛ, Medze hɔn a wɔnnyɛ ɔman beyi hom nyinkun, Ɔman a wonnyi ntseasee na medze beyi hom ebufuw.
title: ROMANS

text: Isaia so dze ndamyɛ papa ka dɛ, Hɔn a wɔannhwehwɛ me, ehu me; Meyi moho akyerɛ hɔn a woemmbisa m’ekyir kwan.
title: ROMANS

text: Na Israel dze, ɔka kyerɛ hɔn dɛ, Adzekyee tsentsen nyina metserɛɛw me nsamu maa ɔman asokyewfo nye nyiyianofo.
title: ROMANS

text: Dza afei mibisa nye dɛ, Aso Nyankopɔn atow ne man akyen anaa? Ɔnntse dɛm da. Na mankasa so meyɛ Israelnyi a mifi Abraham asefo mu, Benjamin ebusuakuw mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Nyankopɔn nntoow ne man a ohun hɔn siei no nnkyenee. Ana hom nnyim dza kyerɛw no ka wɔ Elija ho? Mbrɛ ɔbɔɔ mpaa kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn dze tsiaa Israel dɛ,
title: ROMANS

text: Ewuradze, woekuku wo nkɔnhyɛfo, na w’afɔrmbukyia so woedwurudwuruw no, na emi nko na maka, na emi so mpo wɔrohwehwɛ me eku me.
title: ROMANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn buaa no dɛn? Meyi mbarimba mpemesuon ama moho a wommbuu ntwɛr mmaa Baal.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛmara na ndɛ mber yi so nyimpa kakra aka a Nyankopɔn adom asan mu eyi hɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ ɔnam adom do a, nna ommfir ndwuma bio: ɔno dze, na nkyɛ adom nnyɛ adom bio.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm a nna ebɛn asɛm a? Dza Israel hwehwɛ no, ne nsa annka; na hɔn a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn no nsa kae, na nkaa no piriim hɔn akoma:
title: ROMANS

text: dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Nyankopɔn maa hɔn sunsum a ɔtɔ nkom, enyiwa a wɔmmfa nnhu adze, nye asowa a ɔnntse asɛm dze ebodu ndɛ da yi.
title: ROMANS

text: Na David se, Ma hɔn edzidzipon nyɛ efir, nye apafir, Nye fintsidua nye akatua mma hɔn:
title: ROMANS

text: Ma hɔn enyiwa nyɛ kusuu amma woeennhu adze, Na ma hɔn fona mma hɔn mu nkontom daa.
title: ROMANS

text: Na afei mese, Ana wofintsiwii ama wɔaahwe ase? Dabida. Na mbom ɔnam hɔn mfom do na nkwagye abɛyɛ amanamamfo dze, na ɔdze eyi hɔn nyinkun.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ hɔn mfom yɛ wiadze ahonya, na hɔn ahwerdzi ayɛ amanamamfo ahonya a, nna hɔn amayɛ dze ɔbɛkyɛn dɛm dɛn ara?
title: ROMANS

text: Na hom amanamamfo na mekasa kyerɛ hom. Dɛ meyɛ amanamamfo somafo ntsi, mehyɛ mo som yi enyimnyam,
title: ROMANS

text: dɛ bi a mibeyi hɔn a wɔyɛ mo honam no nyinkun, na magye hɔn mu binom nkwa.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ ɔtow a wɔtoow hɔn kyenee ayɛ wiadze nkabɔmu a, ɔgye a wɔbɛgye hɔn no dze ɔbɛyɛ dɛn, nnyɛ nkwa a ofi ewufo mu a?
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ aba a odzi kan no yɛ krɔnkrɔn a, ɔtɔw no so yɛ bi; na sɛ ndwow no yɛ krɔnkrɔn a, nna n’abaw no so yɛ bi.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ abaw no bi ebubu, na wɔdze ɔwo a eyɛ kwaa mu ngodua afora ahyɛ mu, ma enya ngodua no no ndwow nye no mu ngo bi a,
title: ROMANS

text: mma nnhyehyɛ woho wɔ abaw no do: na sɛ ehyehyɛ woho a, nnyɛ ɔwo na eso ndwow no, na ndwow no na ɔso wo.
title: ROMANS

text: Na bi a ebɛse dɛ, Wobubuu abaw no, ama wɔdze me aahyɛ mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Ɔyɛ nokwar, ekyingye ntsi na wobubuu hɔn, na wo so gyedzi ntsi na igyina hɔ. Mma mmema woho do, na mbom ma ɔnyɛ wo hu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ Nyankopɔn ammfa annkyɛ abaw a wofi dua no ara mu fifir no a, ɔremmfa nnkyɛ wo so.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hu dɛ Nyankopɔn ne yamu ye na ɔyɛ dzen so: ɔnye hɔn a wɔahwehwe ase no dzii no dzendzenndzen, na ɔwo dze ɔkyerɛɛ n’ayamuyie wɔ wo do, naaso gyedɛ ekɔ do araa tsena n’ayamuyie mu: annyɛ dɛm a, wobotwa wo so akyen.
title: ROMANS

text: Na hɔn so sɛ wɔannda ho anntsena hɔn ekyingye mu a, wɔdze hɔn bɛhyɛ mu bio, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn botum dze hɔn ahyɛ mu bio.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ ɔwo wotwaa wo dza noara yɛ kwaa mu ngodua ho, na sɛ wokwetsii wo bɔbea dze wo bɛhyɛɛ ngodua pa mu a, mpɛn ahen ara na wɔnnkɛfa yinom a wɔyɛ bɔbea no ara mu abaw no ahyɛ hɔnara hɔn ngodua mu bio?
title: ROMANS

text: Na, enuanom, memmpɛ dɛ misiw hom esumasɛm yi do, amma hom eemmbu homho enyansafo, dɛ akomapirim afaafa aba Israel do dze ekodu dɛ amanamamfo nyina bɛba abɛka gyedzi no ho;
title: ROMANS

text: na ɔno na Israel nyina benya nkwa, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ɔgyefo no befi Zion aba, Ɔbɛpam emumuyɛ efi Jakob asefo mu:
title: ROMANS

text: Na iyi nye m’ahyɛmu a menye hɔn bedzi, Ber a mibeyi hɔn bɔn efi hɔ no.
title: ROMANS

text: Asɛmpa no afamu dze, wɔyɛ atamfo wɔ hom ntsi; na nsanmuyi no afamu, wɔyɛ adɔfo wɔ egyanom ntsi,
title: ROMANS

text: osiandɛ sɛ Nyankopɔn ma obi adom akyɛdze na ɔfrɛ no a, ɔnntwe nnsan ekyir.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ ber a ɔabɛsen hom yɛɛ asoɔdzen, na sesei ɔnam iyinom hɔn asoɔdzen do hom enya ehumbɔbɔr no,
title: ROMANS

text: dɛmara so na iyinom ayɛ asoɔdzen sesei, ma ɔnam ehumbɔbɔr a wɔdze ehu hom no do, hɔn so woeenya ehumbɔbɔr.
title: ROMANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn aka hɔn nyina ahyɛ asoɔdzen mu ama oeehu hɔn nyina mbɔbɔr.
title: ROMANS

text: Ao, mbrɛ Nyankopɔn n’ahonya, ne nyansaa nye ne nyimdzee mu dua dɔ a! Mbrɛ N’atsɛmbu mu ntseasee dua yɛ dzen a, n’akwan so tra ntseasee.
title: ROMANS

text: Na woana na oehu Ewuradze n’adwen? Anaa woana na ɔayɛ ne pamfo?
title: ROMANS

text: Anaa woana na oedzi kan dze biribi ama no, ama ɔno so wɔaahyɛ no ananmu bio?
title: ROMANS

text: Na adze nyina fi no hɔ, na wɔnam no do ba, na wowie wɔ no mu. Ɔno na enyimnyam nka no afebɔɔ! Amen.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, menam Nyankopɔn ehumbɔbɔr do serɛ hom dɛ hom ntu hom nyimpadua nsi hɔ dɛ afɔrbɔdze nyikan nye krɔnkrɔn a ɔsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi a ɔyɛ hom som a ɔwɔ siantsir.
title: ROMANS

text: Na mma hom nnyɛ homho dɛ wiadze yi: Na mbom hom ndua hom adwen foforyɛ mu nsakyer homho, ma hom aasɔ Nyankopɔn pɛ no a oye na ɔsɔ enyi na odzi mu no ahwɛ.
title: ROMANS

text: Na menam adom a wɔdze adom me no do mekã kyerɛ hom mu nyimpa biara dɛ mma ɔnndwen nntra dza ɔsɛ dɛ ɔdwen, na mbom ɔdwen enyidahɔ adwen, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn akyɛ gyedzi nsusui ama obiara.
title: ROMANS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ yɛwɔ nyimpadua kor yi mu mfafakuwa pii, na mfafakuwa no nyina nndzi dwuma kor no,
title: ROMANS

text: dɛmara so na hɛn a yɛdɔɔ sõ no, yɛyɛ nyimpadua kor wɔ Christ mu, na yɛyɛ mfafakuwa ma hɛnho nkorkor.
title: ROMANS

text: Na yɛwowɔ adom akyɛdze a ɔsosoree dɛ mbrɛ adom a wɔdze adom hɛn no tse no, sɛ nkɔnhyɛ a, hom mma yɛnhyɛ nkɔm dɛ mbrɛ hɛn gyedzi nsusui pa;
title: ROMANS

text: sɛ ɔsom a, yemfua hɛn som mu, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo mfua ne nkyerɛkyerɛ mu,
title: ROMANS

text: nyia otu fo mfua n'afotu mu, nyia ɔkyɛ adze mfa komakor nyɛ, nyia odzi panyin, ɔmbɔ ho mbɔdzen, nyia ohu mbɔbɔr, ɔmfa enyimtswew nyɛ.
title: ROMANS

text: Mma ndabraba mfora ɔdɔ mu. Hom nkyir dza omuo na hom ntakyer dza oye ho.
title: ROMANS

text: Enuadɔ mu a, hom ndɔdɔ homho yie nkokor; enyidzi mu a, hom ndzi kan ndzidzi homho nyi;
title: ROMANS

text: mbɔdzembɔ mu a, mma hom nnyɛ nyaa nyaa; hom nyɛ sunsum mu hyew; hom nsom Ewuradze;
title: ROMANS

text: Hom ndzi dɛw wɔ enyidado mu; hom nto hom bo ase wɔ ahohia mu; hom nda ho nkura asɔryɛ mu;
title: ROMANS

text: hom nkɔ ahotsewfo hia mboa; hom ntɔ ahɔhoyɛ.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nhyira hɔn a wohiahia hom ho: Hom nhyira na mma hom nndom.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nye hɔn a wodzi dɛw ndzi dɛw; hom nye hɔn a wosū nsū.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nnyinya adwenkor wɔ homho. Mma hom mmfa hom adwen nngyina ekuromponsɛm do, na mbom hom mbrɛ homho adze mma dza ɔbrɛ adze. Mma hom mmbu homho enyansafo.
title: ROMANS

text: Mma hom mmfa bɔn nntua bɔn kaw. Hom ndwen dza ɔyɛ enyidzi wɔ nyimpa nyina enyim.
title: ROMANS

text: Sɛ ɔbɛyɛ a, hom afamu dze, hom nye nyimpa nyina ntsena asomdwee mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Adɔfo, mma hom nndzidzi homho wer, na mbom hom mma ebufuw kwan: Na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Awerdzi dzi wɔ me: Emi na mubotua kaw, Ewuardze na ɔse.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ kɔm dze wo tamfo a, ma no edziban; sɛ nsukɔm dze no a, ma no biribi ma ɔnom: Na eyɛ dɛm a, edze bɔboa gyansenama ano egu n'etsifi.
title: ROMANS

text: Mma bɔn nndzi hom do nyim, na hom mfa papa ndzi nyim wɔ bɔn do.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom mma nyimpa nyina mbrɛ hɔnho adze nhyɛ ɔman mu mpanyimfo tum ase: osiandɛ tum biara nnyi hɔ dɛ dza ofi Nyankopɔn, na tum ahorow a wɔwɔ hɔ no Nyankopɔn na ɔhyehyɛe.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi obiara a otsia tum yi no, otsia Nyankopɔn n’ahyehyɛdze, na hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm no benya afɔbu ama hɔnho.
title: ROMANS

text: Na hɔn a wodzi mpanyin no ho nnyɛ hu mma ndwuma pa, na mbom ɔyɛ hu ma bɔn. Ana emmpɛ dɛ isuro tum no? Nna yɛ papa ɛ, na ibenya ho ayɛyi:
title: ROMANS

text: osiandɛ wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn asomfo ma wo yieyɛ. Na sɛ eyɛ dza ɔyɛ bɔn a, ɔno suro tum no: osiandɛ onnkitsa tum afona no kwa, na ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn somfo nye werdzifo a ɔdze ebufuw ba nyia ɔyɛ bɔn do.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi otwar dɛ hom brɛ homho adze, nnyɛ dɛ ebufuw nko ntsi, na mbom tsibowa so ntsi.
title: ROMANS

text: Iyi ntsi so na hom yi tow; osiandɛ wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn asomfo a wɔhwɛ dɛm adze yi do.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ntua obiara ne ndzinoa mma no: hom nyi tow ahorow nyina mma nyia tow sɛ no, hom mfa nsuro mma nyia suro sɛ no, enyidzi mma nyia enyidzi sɛ no.
title: ROMANS

text: Mma hom nndze obiara kaw gyedɛ ɔdɔ a hom bɔdodɔ homho: na nyia ɔdɔ ne nyɛnko no oedzi mbra no do.
title: ROMANS

text: Na asɛm a wɔka dɛ, Mma nnto awar, Mma nndzi ewu, Mma nnwia adze, Mma w’enyi mmber adze no, anaa sɛ ahyɛdze biara ka ho a, woesi ne nyina tam wɔ asɛm yi mu dɛ, Dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ woho.
title: ROMANS

text: Ɔdɔ nnyɛ ne nyɛnko bɔn biara: dɛm ntsi sɛ yɛdodɔ hɛnho a nna yeedzi mbra no nyina do.
title: ROMANS

text: Na iyi na hom nyim, dɛ ber enya edu a yenyan fi hɛn nda mu: na afei na hɛn nkwagye abɛn kyɛn ahyɛse a yɛgyee dzii no.
title: ROMANS

text: Adzesaa akɔ enyim, adzekyee abɛn: dɛm ntsi hom mma yenyi sum mu ndwuma no ngu, na yɛnhyɛ kan no akodze no.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom mma yɛnnantsew yie dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata kan no, nnyɛ edzidzintrudu nye asabow mu, nnyɛ ndwamanyɛ nye atantandze mu, nnyɛ aperper nye nyinkun mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na mbom hom mfa Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nyɛ akontar nhyɛ, na mma hom mmfa hom adwen mma honam nhyɛ n’akɔndɔdze ma.
title: ROMANS

text: Nyia ne gyedzi yɛ mberɛw no hom ngye no, na mbom nnyɛ dɛ hom nye no beyiyi nsɛm ano wɔ mbrɛ n’adwen yɛ no no ho.
title: ROMANS

text: Obi wɔ gyedzi dɛ odzi adze nyina: na nyia ɔyɛ mberɛw no dze, odzi nhabanhaban nko.
title: ROMANS

text: Mma nyia odzi no mmbu nyia onndzi no enyimtsia, na nyia onndzi no mma ommbu nyia odzi no atsɛn: osiandɛ no so Nyankopɔn agye no ato mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Woana nye ɔwo a ibu obi no nkowaa atsɛn? Hɔnankasa hɔn wura na wogyina anaa wɔhwe ase ma no. Na wobegyina so, osiandɛ Ewuradze botum ama woegyina.
title: ROMANS

text: Na obi bu da kor bi kyɛn bi, obi so bu nda nyina pɛr. Hom mma obiara nankasa n’adwen nsi no pi.
title: ROMANS

text: Nyia ɔdwen da no do dwen do ma Ewuradze, na nyia odzi no dzi ma Ewuradze, na ɔdze ndaase ma Nyankopɔn; na nyia onndzi no, Ewuradze na onndzi mma no, na ɔdze ndaase ma Nyankopɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Na hɛn mu biara nntse ase mma noho, na hɛn mu biara nnwu mma noho.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ yɛtse ase a, yɛtse ma Ewuradze, na sɛ yewu a, yewu ma Ewuradze: dɛm ntsi yɛtse ase o, yewu o, yɛyɛ Ewuradze dze.
title: ROMANS

text: Na iyi ntsi na Kraest wui na ɔsoɛree baa nkwa mu, ama ɔaayɛ ewufo nye atseasefo hɔn Ewuradze.
title: ROMANS

text: Na ɔwo dze, ɔyɛ dɛn na ibu wo nua atsɛn? Anaaso ɔwo dze, ɔyɛ dɛn na ibu wo nua enyimtsia? Na hɛn nyina begyina Nyankopɔn asɛndzii egua no enyim.
title: ROMANS

text: Osiandɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ewuradze se, metse ase yi, emi na anankoroma nyina bɔkotow me, Na tɛkyerɛma nyina bɛka dɛ emi nye Nyankopɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Ntsi hɛn nyina bobu hɛnankasa hɛnho akontaa nkorkor akyerɛ Nyankopɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm a nna hom mma yenngyaa dɛ yebubu hɛnho atsɛn nkorkor, na mbom yemmbu iyi ho atsɛn, dɛ obiara nnkɛfa fintsidua anaa akwansiwdze bi ato no nua no kwan mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Minyim na megye dzi pi wɔ Ewuradze Jesus mu dɛ biribiara nankasa nnyɛ ekyiwadze, na nyia obu biribi ekyiwadze no, ɔnoara na adze no yɛ ekyiwadze ma no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na sɛ w’edziban ntsi wo nua no werɛ how a, nna egyaa dɛ edze ɔdɔ nantsew. Mma mmfa w’edziban nnsɛɛ nyia Kraest wui maa no.
title: ROMANS

text: Ntsi mma nnyɛ ma wɔnnkasa wo papa ho bɔn:
title: ROMANS

text: na Nyankopɔn ahenman no nnyɛ edzidzi nye ɔnom, na mbom ɔyɛ tsenenee, asomdwee, nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu enyigye.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nyia ɔsom Kraest wɔ iyinom mu no, ɔsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi na nyimpa pen no.
title: ROMANS

text: Ntsi hom mma yentsiw dza ɔyɛ asomdwee, nye dza ɔbɛma yeetu mpon nkorkor.
title: ROMANS

text: Mma onnsian edziban ntsi ma nnsɛɛ Nyankopɔn n’edwuma a ɔayɛ. Adze nyina ho tsew, naaso ɔyɛ bɔn ma nyia obedzi edziban bi a ɔbɛma obi so ayɛ bɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Oye dɛ innkedzi edziban anaa ennkɔnom wenyin anaa ennkɛyɛ dza ɔbɛma wo nua biara ayɛ bɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Gyedzi a ewɔ no, kitsa ma woho wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim. Nhyira nye nyia ommbu noho atsɛn wɔ dza obu no dɛ oye no ho.
title: ROMANS

text: Na nyia n’adwen mu yɛ no konsee no, sɛ odzi a, oedzi fɔ, osiandɛ ommfi gyedzi mu dzi: na biribiara a ommfi gyedzi mu no, ɔyɛ bɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Na hɛn a yɛyɛ dzen no, ɔsɛ dɛ yɛsoa hɔn a wɔnnyɛ dzen no hɔn mberɛwyɛ, na mma yɛnnsɔ hɛnara hɛn enyi.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom mma hɛn mu obiara nsɔ ne nyɛnko enyi mma ne yieyɛ, mfa ntow ne gyedzi do nkɔ kan.
title: ROMANS

text: Na Kraest so annsɔ nankasa noho enyi, na dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no, Hɔn a wɔhyɛɛ wo ahorba no, hɔn ahorbahyɛ no tɔɔ mo do.
title: ROMANS

text: Na biribiara a wɔkyerɛɛw no nkan no, wɔkyerɛwee maa hɛn nkyerɛkyerɛ, ama ɔnam abotar na kyerɛwnsɛm no n’awerɛkyekyer do yeenya enyidado.
title: ROMANS

text: Na abotar nye awerɛkyekyer Nyankopɔn no mma hom nnya adwenkor wɔ homho nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ Kraest Jesus dze tse,
title: ROMANS

text: ama hom dze adwenkor nye anokor aahyɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne Nyankopɔn nye n’Egya enyimnyam.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom ngyegye homho, dɛ mbrɛ Kraest so agye hom ama Nyankopɔn n’enyimnyam no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na mese dɛ wɔayɛ Kraest twatsiatwa no ho somfo wɔ Nyankopɔn no nokwar no ntsi, ma ɔaahyɛ egyanom anohoba no dzen,
title: ROMANS

text: na amanamamfo aahyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ n’ehumbɔbɔr ntsi; dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Dɛm ntsi mibeyi wo ayɛw wɔ amanaman mu, Na mabɔ wo dzin atow ndwom.
title: ROMANS

text: Na ɔka no bio dɛ, Amanaman, hom nye ne man ndzi ehurusi,
title: ROMANS

text: Na bio, Amanaman, hom nyi Ewuradze ayɛw, Na hom mma aman horow nyina nkamfo no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na bio Isaia se dɛ, Jesse ndwow no bɛba, Ɔnye nyia ɔbɔsoɛr ebedzi amanaman do: No mu na amanaman benya enyidado.
title: ROMANS

text: Na enyidado Nyankopɔn mfa gyedzi mu enyigye nye asomdwee nyina nhyɛ hom ma, ma hom aabor do wɔ enyidado mu, wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ahoɔdzen mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na megye dzi yie wɔ hom ho, mo nuanom, dɛ homankasa so papayɛ nyina ahyɛ hom ma, na nyimdzee nyina ahyɛ hom ma tɔr, na eso hom tum tutu homho fo.
title: ROMANS

text: Naaso medze ndam pii makyerɛw nsɛm yi ho bi abrɛ hom, dɛ medze rebɛkaa hom bio wɔ adom a Nyankopɔn adom me ntsi,
title: ROMANS

text: dɛ menyɛ Kraest Jesus somfo mma amanamamfo, na menkɛyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no ho asɔfodwuma, na amanaman nyɛ afɔr a ɔsɔ enyi a wɔatsew ho wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi mowɔ m’ahohyehyɛ wɔ Kraest Jesus mu wɔ ndzɛmba a ɔfa Nyankopɔn ho mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na mirinnsi mo bo nnka biribiara ho asɛm gyedɛ dza Kraest edua mo do ayɛ ama amanaman ayɛ setsie, wɔ asɛm nye ndwuma mu,
title: ROMANS

text: wɔ nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze tum mu, wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no tum mu. Na maka Kraest n’asɛmpa no nyinara fitsi Jerusalɛm na no ho nkurow mu dze ekesi Ilirikum.
title: ROMANS

text: Dza m’enyi beer ho nye dɛ mebɛka asɛmpa no, wɔ mbrɛ wɔmmbɔɔ Kraest dzin wɔ hɔ pɛn, amma maannkɔtow obi ne fapem do,
title: ROMANS

text: na mbom dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Hɔn a no ho asɛm enndu hɔn nkyɛn bohu, Na hɔn a wɔanntse bɛtse ase.
title: ROMANS

text: Na iyi ntsi so na mpɛn pii nye yi a woesiw me kwan amma maammba hom nkyɛn.
title: ROMANS

text: Na afei, minnyi mbew yi do beebi bio, na mfe pii yi nyina mepɛ dɛ meba hom nkyɛn ntsi,
title: ROMANS

text: da biara a mubotu kwan akɔ Spain no osiandɛ m’enyi da dɛ murutwa mu a, mubohu hom, na sɛ megye m’enyi kakra wɔ hom nkyɛn wie a, hom egya me kwan akɔ hɔ,
title: ROMANS

text: na sesei dze morokɔ Jerusalɛm akɔsom ahotseweefo no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na ayɛ Masidonia nye Akia fɛw dɛ wɔdze ntoboa bi kɛma ahotseweefo a wɔwɔ Jerusalɛm mu ehiafo.
title: ROMANS

text: Ɔyɛɛ hɔn fɛw dɛ wɔbɛyɛ, naaso nna wɔdze hɔn kaw, osiandɛ sɛ wɔama amanamamfo enya hɔn sunsum mu ndzɛmba bi a, nna ɔsɛ amanamamfo no so dɛ wɔdze hɔn honam mu afamu ndzɛmba bi som hɔn.
title: ROMANS

text: Dɛm ntsi muwie yi na minya mosɔw aba yi ano ma hɔn a, mebɛba mabɛfa hom nkyɛn akɔ Spain.
title: ROMANS

text: Na minyim dɛ meba hom nkyɛn a, mebɛba no Kraest ne nhyira asɛmpa no ne mayɛ mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Na afei, enuanom, menam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nye Sunsum no dɔ do meserɛ hom dɛ hom mfa me tsir do mpaa a hom bɔ serɛ Nyankopɔn ma me no mper mma me;
title: ROMANS

text: dɛ wobeyi me efi asoɔdzenfo a wɔwɔ Judea nsa, na mo som a morokɔsom wɔ Jerusalɛm no asɔ ahotseweefo no enyi,
title: ROMANS

text: ma menam Nyankopɔn pɛ do maaba hom nkyɛn wɔ enyigye mu, na emi nye hom nyina hɛn ho aatɔ hɛn.
title: ROMANS

text: Na asomdwee Nyankopɔn nye hom nyina ntsena. Amen.
title: ROMANS

text: Mekamfo hɛn akyerɛbaa Foebe a ɔyɛ Kenkreaen asɔr mu ɔsomfo no kyerɛ hom,
title: ROMANS

text: dɛ hom ngye no Ewuradze mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata ahotseweefo, na hom mboa no wɔ biribiara a obehia efi hom hɔ no mu: na nankasa so ayɛ ɔboafo ama nyimpa pii, nye mara so.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nkyia Priska nye Akwila, m’anyɛnkofo edwumayɛfo wɔ Kraest Jesus mu a
title: ROMANS

text: mo nkwa ntsi wɔdze hɔnankasa hɔn nkwa kitsaa hɔn nsamu no: na nnyɛ mo nko na meda hɔn ase, na mbom asɔr a wɔwɔ amanaman do nyina so;
title: ROMANS

text: na hom nkyia asɔr a ɔwɔ hɔn fie no so. Hom nkyia mo dɔfo Epaenetus a ɔyɛ nyia a ofi Asia a odzii kan yɛɛ Kraest dze no.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nkyia Mary a ɔbɔɔ mbɔdzen pii maa hom no.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nkyia Andronikus nye Junias, m’ebusuafo nye m’anyɛnkofo a menye hɔn ada efiadze a wɔwɔ dzin wɔ asomafo no mu, na eso wodzii m’enyim kan wɔ Kraest mu no.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nkyia Ewuradze mu mo dɔfo Ampliatus mma me.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nkyia Urbanus, hɛn nyɛnko dwumayɛnyi wɔ Kraest mu, nye mo dɔfo Stakis.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nkyia Apeles a wɔasɔ no ahwɛ wɔ Kraest mu no. Hom nkyia hɔn a wofi Aristobulus fidua mu no.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nkyia mo busuanyi Herodion. Hom nkyia hɔn a wofi Narsisus fidua mu a wɔwɔ Ewuradze mu no.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nkyia Trifaena nye Trifosa a wɔbɔ Ewuradze mu mbɔdzen no. Hom nkyia ɔdɔfo Persis a ɔbɔɔ Ewuradze mu mbɔdzen pii no.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nkyia Rufus a wɔasan mu eyi no Ewuradze mu no, ɔnye ɔno na emi hɛn na no.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nkyia Asinkritus, Flegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, nye enuanom a wɔka hɔn ho no.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom nkyia Filologus nye Julia, Nereus nye n’akyerɛbaa, nye Olimpas, nye ahotseweefo a wɔka hɔn ho no nyina.
title: ROMANS

text: Hom mfa mfewano krɔnkrɔn nkyiakyia homho nkorkor. Kraest asɔrasɔr nyina kyiakyia hom.
title: ROMANS

text: Na afei, enuanom, meserɛ hom dɛ, hɔn a wɔdze mpaapaamu ba na wɔto fintsidua a otsia nkyerɛkyerɛ a hom esua no, hom nhyɛ hɔn nsew, na hom ntwe homho mfi hɔn ho.
title: ROMANS

text: Na hɔn a wɔtse dɛm no wɔnnsom hɛn Ewuradze Kraest, na mbom hɔnankasa hɔn yafun a, na wɔdze tɛkyerɛmadɛw nye adɔkɔdɔkɔsɛm daadaa hɔn a wonnyim hwee no.
title: ROMANS

text: Na hom dze, hom setsie atahye edu nyimpa nyina asomu. Iyi ntsi midzi hom ho dɛw, naaso mepɛ dɛ hom yɛ enyansafo wɔ papa ho, na hom twe hom ho koraa fi bɔn ho.
title: ROMANS

text: Na asomdwee Nyankopɔn bodwuruw Satan wɔ hom ananadze ntsɛmara. Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest adom nka hom.
title: ROMANS

text: Me nyɛnko dwumayɛnyi Timoti kyia hom; nye m’ebusuafo Lusius nye Jason nye Sosipater.
title: ROMANS

text: Emi Tertius a mekyerɛw nwoma yi, mikyia hom Ewuradze mu.
title: ROMANS

text: Gaius a ɔsom me nye asɔrmba nyina hɔho no kyia hom. Erastus a ɔyɛ kurow yi mu sikakorafo no ɔnye no nua Kwartus kyia hom.
title: ROMANS

text: [Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest adom nye hom nyina ntsena. Amen.]
title: ROMANS

text: Na afei, nyia otum dɛ ɔhyɛ hom dzen, dɛ mbrɛ m’asɛmpa nye Jesus Kraest ho asɛnka tse, dɛ mbrɛ esumasɛm nyikyerɛ a wofi tsetse esie no foo no,
title: ROMANS

text: na afei dze woeyi no edzi, na ɔnam nkɔnhyɛfo kyerɛwnsɛm no do, dɛ mbrɛ onnyiewiei Nyankopɔn ne mbrasɛm tse no, woyi kyerɛ amanaman nyina kɔ gyedzi setsie mu,
title: ROMANS

text: Nyankopɔn a ɔno nkotsee nye nyansafo no, ɔno na enyimnyam ndua Jesus Kraest do nka no afebɔɔ. Amen.
title: ROMANS

text: Paul a wɔnam Nyankopɔn ne pɛ do wɔafrɛ no ayɛ no Jesus Kraest ɔsomafo, nye onua Sostenes,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: dze kɛma Nyankopɔn asɔr a ɔwɔ Korinte, wɔ hɔn a wɔatsew hɔn ho wɔ Kraest Jesus mu afrɛ hɔn dɛ wɔmbɛyɛ ahotseweefo, nye hɔn a wɔbɔ yɛnye hɔn nyina Ewuradze Jesus Kraest dzin wɔ mbea nyina no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Adom nye asomdwee a ofi hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest no nka hom.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Meda me Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ hom ho, wɔ Nyankopɔn adom a wɔdze adom hom wɔ Kraest Jesus mu ntsi,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: dɛ adze nyina mu wɔama hom enya hom ho wɔ no mu, wɔ kasahom nye nyimdzee nyina mu,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: dɛ mbrɛ Kraest ho dasedzi no etsim wɔ hom mu no;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: ama hom annka ekyir wɔ adom akyɛdze biara mu; ber a hom rotweɔn hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne nyikyerɛ no:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: ɔno so na ɔbɛma hom etsim ekodu ewiei amma woeennhu mfom bi wɔ hom ho wɔ Ewuradze Jesus Kraest da no mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nyankopɔn a wɔnam no do afrɛ hom aba ne Ba hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest anyɛnkoyɛ mu no, ɔyɛ nokwafo.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Afei, enuanom, menam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne dzin do meserɛ hom dɛ hom nyina nka asɛnkor, na mma mpaapaamu mmba hom mu, na mbom hom nyina ndzi mu wɔ adwen kor nye tsirmsɛm kor mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na, mo nuanom, hɔn a wofi Kloe fie ebeyi me hom ho asotsiw dɛ wentwiwentwi wɔ hom mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dza mekyerɛ nye yi, hom nyina keka dɛ, Emi dze, meyɛ Paul dze, Emi dze, meyɛ Apollos dze, Emi dze, meyɛ Siifas dze, Emi dze, meyɛ Kraest dze.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana wɔapaapaa Kraest mu? Ana Paul na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu maa hom? Anaa Paul dzin mu na wonumaa hom hyɛe?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Meda Nyankopɔn ase dɛ mennuma hom mu bi gyedɛ dɛ Krispus nye Gaius,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: amma obi aannka dɛ wonumaa hom hyɛɛ mankasa me dzin mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: (Ɛhɛɛ, mekaa dɛ munumaa Stefanas fiefo: na nkaa no dze, sɛ munumaa bi dze a, ɔno minnyim.)
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nnyɛ dɛ Kraest somaa me dɛ mumbonuma ara bi, na mbom dɛ membɛka asɛmpa no, nnyɛ dɛ ɔkasanyansa mu ara bi, amma Kraest mbeamudua no aannyɛ kwa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mbeamudua no ho asɛm no yɛ nkwaseasɛm ma hɔn a wɔrehera, na hɛn a wɔregye hɛn nkwa no dze, ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn no tum ma hɛn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Osiandɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Mebɛsɛɛ enyansafo nyansaa, Na enyimdzefo nyimdzee no meyi no tokyen.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Onyansafo wɔ hen? Ɔkyerɛwfo wɔ hen? Wiadze yi mu okyingyefo wɔ hen? Ana Nyankopɔn nndaan wiadze nyansaa nkwaseasɛm bi?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn nyansaa mu no, wiadze ammfa nyansa do ennhu Nyankopɔn no, ɔsɔɔ Nyankopɔn enyi dɛ ɔnam asɛnka no nkwaseasɛm no do bɛgye hɔn a wɔgye dzi nkwa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Osiandɛ Jewfo rohwehwɛ asɛnkyerɛdze, na Griikfo dze, wɔhwehwɛ nyansa;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na hɛn dze, yɛka Kraest a wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu ho asɛm, dza ɔyɛ fintsidua ma Jewfo, na nkwaseasɛm ma amanamamfo no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɔn a wɔafrɛ hɔn no dze, Jewfo o, Griikfo o, Kraest yɛ Nyankopɔn no tum na Nyankopɔn ne nyansaa ma hɔn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Osiandɛ dza ɔyɛ dɛ Nyankopɔn nkwaseadze yi yɛ nyansa kyɛn nyimpa ne nyansaa, na Nyankopɔn n’adze a ɔyɛ mberɛw yɛ dzen kyɛn nyimpa dze.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na, enuanom, hom nhwɛ hom frɛ no ara mpo ɛ, dɛ hom nnyɛ honam afamu enyansafo pii, nnyɛ etumfo pii, nnyɛ adehye pii:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na wiadze nkwaseadze na Nyankopɔn apa dɛ ɔdze bɛhyɛ enyansafo enyito, na wiadze mu dza ɔyɛ mberɛw na Nyankopɔn apa dɛ ɔdze bɛhyɛ dza ɔyɛ dzen enyito;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na wiadze mu dza onnyi dzin, nye dza wommbu no hwee na Nyankopɔn apa, ndzɛmba a onnyi hɔ mpo, dɛ ɔdze bɛma dza ɔwɔ hɔ ayɛ kwa;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: amma honam biara aannhyehyɛ noho wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn mu na ofi na hom wɔ Kraest Jesus mu, ɔno na wofi Nyankopɔn mu ayɛ no nyansa nye tsenenee, nye ahotsew, nye ɔgye ama hɛn:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Nyia ɔhyehyɛ noho, wɔmma ɔnhyehyɛ noho wɔ Ewuradze mu no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na emi dze, enuanom, mebaa hom nkyɛn no, mammfa kasa nye nyansa kyɛnee bɛkaa hom Nyankopɔn esumasɛm no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mobɔɔ me tsirmu pɔw dɛ nkyɛ munnkohu biribi wɔ hom mu, gyedɛ Jesus Kraest a wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na emi dze, mberɛwyɛ, nye osuro, nye ahopopo pii mu na menye hom tsenae.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na m’asɛm nye m’asɛnka enndua enyansasɛm ndɛfɛdɛfɛw mu, na mbom ɔnam Sunsum ne nyikyerɛ nye tum mu,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: amma hom gyedzi eenngyina nyimpa nyansaa mu, na mbom egyina Nyankopɔn tum mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Naaso yɛka nyansa wɔ hɔn a wodzi mu no mu, na nnyɛ nyansa a ɔyɛ wiadze yi dze, anaaso wiadze etumfo a wɔrebɛyɛ gyan dze a:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mbom yɛka Nyankopɔn nyansaa wɔ esumasɛm mu, nyansa a ohuntae a Nyankopɔn hyɛe too hɔ maa hɛn enyimnyam ansaana wɔrobɔbɔ wiadze no;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: ɔno na wiadze yi mu etumfo mu obiara ennhu: sɛ wohunii a nkyɛ wɔammbɔ enyimnyam Ewuradze no mbeamudua mu;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na mbom dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Dza enyiwa nnhunii na aso nntsee, Na ɔannhɛn nyimpa akoma mu, Ndzɛmba a Nyankopɔn esiesie ama hɔn a wɔdɔ no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɛn dze, Nyankopɔn nam Sunsum no do eyi akyerɛ hɛn: na Sunsum no pɛɛpɛw adze nyina mu, Nyankopɔn adze a no mu dɔ mu mpo.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyimpa mu woana na onyim dza ɔwɔ nyimpa mu, gyedɛ nyimpa noara no sunsum a ɔwɔ no mu? Dɛmara na obi nnyim Nyankopɔn dze, gyedɛ Nyankopɔn no Sunsum no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɛn dze, nnyɛ wiadze sunsum na yenyae na mbom sunsum a ofi Nyankopɔn mu a, ama yeehu dza Nyankopɔn dze adom hɛn no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ndzɛmba yi so na yɛka, nnyɛ nsɛm a nyimpa nyansaa kyerɛkyerɛ mu, na mbom nsɛm a Sunsum kyerɛkyerɛ mu a: yɛdze sunsum adze to sunsum adze ho.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia ɔyɛ honam mu nyimpa nntum nngye dza ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn Sunsum no ne ndzɛmba, osiandɛ ɔyɛ nkwaseasɛm ma no, na onntum nnhu mu, osiandɛ wohu no sunsum mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia ɔyɛ sunsum mu nyimpa dze, obu adze nyina atsɛn, na nankasa dze, obi mmbu no atsɛn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na woana na oehu Ewuradze n’adwen, dɛ ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ no? Na hɛn dze, yɛwɔ Kraest n’adwen.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mo so, enuanom, menntum annkasa annkyerɛ hom dɛ sunsum mu mba na mbom dɛ honam mu mba, dɛ Kraest mu nkɔkowaba.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Numfonsu na medze maa hom na hom nomee, na nnyɛ edziban bi a: na hom nnyae nntumii: eso seseiara hom nntum,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: osiandɛ hom da ho yɛ honam mu nyimpa. Mbrɛ nyinkun nye wentwiwentwi wɔ hom mu yi, ana hom nnyɛ honam mu nyimpa, na nnyɛ nyimpamu bra na hom robɔ yi?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ obi se dɛ, Emi dze, meyɛ Paul dze, na obi so se dɛ, Emi dze, meyɛ Apollos dze a, nna nnyɛ honammufo nye hom anaa?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na Apollos nye woana? Na Paul nye woana? Wɔyɛ asomfo a hom nam hɔn do gyee dzii, dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze dze maa hɔn mu biara.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Emi na muduae, Apollos na oguguu do nsu naaso Nyankopɔn na ɔmaa ndɔbaa no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi nnyɛ nyia odua na ɔyɛ biribi, eso nnyɛ nyia ogugu do nsu a, na Nyankopɔn a ɔma ndɔbaa no a.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia odua nye nyia ogugu do nsu yɛ kor, na hɔn mu biara benya nankasa n’akatua dɛ mbrɛ nankasa n’edwuma tse.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɛn dze, yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn no nkowaa a yɛnye no reyɛ edwuma; na hom so yɛ Nyankopɔn ne haban, Nyankopɔn ne dan.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn adom a ɔdze adom me tse, dɛ ɔdantofo panyin nyansafo, motoo fapem, na obi so rotow do. Na wɔmma obiara nhwɛ yie mbrɛ odua tow do.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na fapem fofor biara dze, obiara runntum nnto nnka dza wɔato no ho, ɔno nye Jesus Kraest.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ obiara dze sika, dwetɛ, aboɔdzen abo, dua, sar, nye mburonan tow fapem no do a;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: obiara n’edwuma bɛda edzi: na da no beyi ato gua, osiandɛ wɔnam ogya do beyi akyerɛ, na ogya no ara bɔsɔ obiara n’edwuma ahwɛ, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse biara.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ obiara n’edwuma a ɔatow wɔ do no tum gyina a, obenya akatua.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ obiara n’edwuma hyew a, onnkenya hwee, na nankasa dze wɔbɛgye no nkwa, naaso ɔbɛyɛ dɛ oduaa ogya mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana hom nnyim dɛ hom yɛ Nyankopɔn asɔrfi, na Nyankopɔn Sunsum no tse hom mu?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ obiara sɛɛ Nyankopɔn asɔrfi a, ɔno so Nyankopɔn bɛsɛɛ no: osiandɛ Nyankopɔn asɔrfi ho tsew, na ɔno nye homara.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Mma obi nndaadaa noho. Sɛ obiara susu dɛ ɔyɛ hom mu nyansafo wɔ wiadze yi mu a, wɔmma ɔnyɛ kwasea ama ɔaayɛ nyansafo.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na wiadze yi nyansaa yɛ nkwaseasɛm wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim. Na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ɔno na ɔkyer enyansafo wɔ hɔn enyitsew mu;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na bio, Nyankopɔn nyim enyansafo adwendwen dɛ ɔyɛ adwendwen hun.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi mma obi nnhyehyɛ noho wɔ nyimpa mu. Na adze nyina yɛ homdze;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Paul o, Apollos o, Siifas o, wiadze o, nkwa o, owu o, dza ɔwɔ hɔ sesei o, dza ɔrebɛba o; ne nyina yɛ homdze;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na hom yɛ Kraest dze, na Kraest so yɛ Nyankopɔn dze.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm na hom mma nyimpa mbu hɛn, dɛ Kraest asomfo nye Nyankopɔn esumasɛm do ahwɛfo.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na, afei, dza wɔhwehwɛ no ɔhwɛfo ho nye dɛ wohu no ɔnokwafo.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na emi dze, ɔyɛ me asɛm ketseaba bi dɛ hom anaa nyimpa abaguafo bobu me atsɛn: mankasa mpo mummbu moho atsɛn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mankasa minnyim biribi tsia mo ho, naaso minndzi bem wɔ iyi mu: nyia obu me atsɛn nye Ewuradze.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi mma hom nntwar ber ano mmbu biribi ho atsɛn, ma onkodu dɛ Ewuradze bɛba, ɔno na ɔdze sum mu dza osuma nyina bɛba kan mu, na oeyi akoma mu apam edzi: nna obiara benya n’ayɛyi efi Nyankopɔn hɔ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nsɛm yi, enuanom, madan ama mankasa moho nye Apollos ma hom eesua wɔ hɛn ho dɛ mma hom nntra dza wɔakyerɛw no, amma ɔbaako ntsi obi aannhoran enntsia ɔbaako.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na woana na ɔma eyɛ dansewa fi afofor mu? Na ebɛnadze na ewɔ a wɔammfa amma wo? Na sɛ inyae a, ɔyɛ dɛn na ehyehyɛ woho dɛ gyama ennya?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hom ewie mee dada; nyew, hom enya hom ho dada; hom ekwetsir hɛn edzi hen: nkyɛ mepɛ dɛ hom dzi hen ampa, ama hɛn so yɛnnye hom eedzi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mususu dɛ Nyankopɔn dze hɛn asomafo edzi ekyir, dɛ hɔn a woeyi hɔn ama owu; osiandɛ yɛayɛ ahwɛdze ama wiadze nye abɔfo nye nyimpa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Yɛyɛ nkwasea wɔ Kraest ntsi, na hom dze, hom yɛ enyansafo wɔ Kraest mu; yɛyɛ mberɛw, na hom dze, hom yɛ dzen; hom dze, wɔdze enyidzi ma hom, na hɛn dze, wommbu hɛn hwee.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ɔdze bodu sesei dɔn yi mu ɔkɔm nye nsukɔm nyina dze hɛn, yedzi adagyaw, wɔbɔ hɛn ekutuku, yennyi beebi tse;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na yɛberɛ dze hɛnara hɛn nsa yɛ edwuma; wɔyaw hɛn a, yehyira; wɔhaw hɛn a, yɛpen do;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: wɔsɛɛ hɛn dzin a, yɛka abodweesɛm kyerɛ hɔn; yɛayɛ dɛ wiadze fi, nyimpa mu ntɔmpamu dze ebodu ndɛ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nnyɛ dɛ merebɛhyɛ hom fɛr ntsi na merekyerɛw iyi, na mbom dɛ murubotu hom fo dɛ mba a modɔ hɔn a.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ hom wɔ akwankyerɛfo pedu wɔ Kraest mu mpo a, hom nnyi egyanom pii: na emi na menam asɛmpa no do mowoo hom wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi meserɛ hom, hom nsuasua me.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Iyi ntsi na masoma Timoti a ɔyɛ me ba dɔfo nye nokwafo wɔ Ewuradze mu no wɔ hom nkyɛn; ɔno na ɔbɛkaa hom m’akwan a ɔwɔ Kraest mu, dɛ mbrɛ mekyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔrasɔr nyina mu, wɔ mbeambea nyina no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na wosusu dɛ gyama meremmba hom nkyɛn ntsi na binom rohoran no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ Ewuradze pɛ a, mebɛba hom nkyɛn ntsɛmara, na mubohu hɔn a wɔahoran no hɔn tum, na nnyɛ hɔn nsɛm a.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn ahendzi nnyi kasa mu ara gyan, na mbom tum mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dza ɔwɔ hen na hom pɛ? Memfa abaa mbra hom do, anaa memfa ɔdɔ nye ɔdwe sunsum?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Wɔka no ampaara dɛ ndwamanyɛ wɔ hom mu, ndwamanyɛ a onnyi amanamamfo mpo mu, dɛ obi bɛfa n’egya yer.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na hom ahoran, na mbom hom enndzi awerɛhow, ama woeeyi nyia ɔayɛ dɛm adze yi wɔ hom mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na emi dze, minnyi hɔ wɔ honam mu sosoampa, naaso mowɔ hɔ wɔ sunsum mu, ntsi, mebu atsɛn dada dɛ gyama mowɔ hɔ, wɔ nyia ɔyɛɛ dɛm adze no ho,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus dzin mu, dɛ sɛ hom nye mo sunsum hyia mu, na hɛn Ewuradze Jesus no tum ka ho a,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: mibeyi onyia no ahyɛ Satan nsa ma honam no aasɛɛ, ma bi a wɔaagye sunsum no nkwa wɔ Ewuradze Jesus da no mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hom ahohyehyɛ nnye. Ana hom nnyim dɛ mbɔrkaw kakra kaw mbɔr no nyina?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nyi mbɔrkaw dadaw no, ama hom aayɛ mbɔr fofor, dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ epitsi, osiandɛ woeku hɛn apahoguan Kraest so.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mma yɛnhyɛ fa, nnyɛ dɛ yedzi mbɔrkaw dadaw bi a, eso nnyɛ dɛ yedzi nyitan nye emumuyɛ mbɔrkaw bi a, na mbom dɛ yedzi motooyɛ nye nokwar epitsi a.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Mekyerɛɛw no mo nwoma no mu brɛɛ hom dɛ mma hom nnye ndwaman mmforafora;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na nnyɛ wiadze yi ndwaman, anaadɛ enyiberfo nye apempensifo, anaa abosonsɔrfo bi koraa; ɔnodze na nkyɛ ɔsɛ dɛ hom fi wiadze.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Afei dze, mekyerɛw hom dɛ mma hom nye hɔn nndzi afora, sɛ obiara a wɔfrɛ no onua yɛ edwaman anaa onyiberfo, anaa ɔbosonsɔrnyi, anaa ntokwapɛfo, anaa ɔsabokwanyi, anaa ɔpempensinyi a, dɛm nyimpa no dze, mma hom nye no nndzidzi mpo.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na ɔfa mo ho bɛn dɛ mubobu hɔn a wommfi mu no atsɛn? Ana nnyɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ mu no na hom bu hɔn atsɛn?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɔn a wonnyi mu no dze, Nyankopɔn na obu hɔn atsɛn. Hom nyi nyimpa bɔn no mfi hom mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Aso hom mu bi nye ne nyɛnko nya asɛm bi a onnsi no bo mfa no nkɔ hɔn a wɔnntsen no enyim asɛndzii, a nnyɛ ahotseweefo no enyim a?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana hom nnyim dɛ ahotseweefo no na wobobu wiadze atsɛn? Na sɛ hom na hom bobu wiadze atsɛn a, ana hom nnsɛ dɛ hom dzi nsɛm nkakraba?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana hom nnyim dɛ yebobu abɔfo atsɛn? Na ankantam abrabɔ yi mu ndzɛmba?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ hom wɔ abrabɔ yi mu ndzɛmba ho asɛm a, hɔn a wommbu hɔn bi wɔ asɔr mu na hom dze hɔn yɛ abaguafo anaa?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Meka yi dze hyɛ hom enyito. Ana mbrɛ ɔtse nye dɛ onyansafo bi nnyi hom mu a obotum ebu nua nye nua ntamu atsɛn,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: nna onua nye nua yi atsɛn wɔ hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi mpo no enyim yi?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Esintɔ enya aba hom mu dada dɛ hom dze homho kokɔ mbra mu. Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom mma wonndzi hom emim mbom? Ɔyɛ dɛn na hom mma wonnsisi hom mbom?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mbom homankasa hom dzi emim na hom sisi, na hom dze yi yɛ hom nuanom mpo.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana hom nnyim dɛ hɔn a wɔnntsen innkenya Nyankopɔn ahenman no ayɛ hɔndze? Mma wɔnndaadaa hom: ndwaman, nye abosonsɔrfo, nye awartofo, mbanyin asansabrafo, nye mbarimba a wɔnye hɔnho da,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: nye ewifo, nye enyiberfo, nye asabokwafo, nye ntokwapɛfo, nye apempensifo rinnya Nyankopɔn ahenman no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nkyɛ mbrɛ hom mu bi tse nye no; na afei wɔatsew hom ho, na afei woebu hom bem wɔ Ewuradze Jesus Kraest dzin mu, na hɛn Nyankopɔn Sunsum no mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Mowɔ adze nyina ho kwan, naaso nnyɛ adze nyina na ɔfata; mowɔ adze nyina ho kwan, naaso memma biribi nnhyɛ mo do.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Edziban yɛ yafun dze, na yafun yɛ edziban dze, naaso Nyankopɔn bɛma ebien nyina ayɛ kwa. Na nyimpadua nnyi hɔ mma ndwamanyɛ, mbom ɔwɔ hɔ ma Ewuradze, na Ewuradze wɔ hɔ ma nyimpadua;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na Nyankopɔn nyaan Ewuradze, na ɔnam no tum do benyan hɛn so bi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana hom nnyim dɛ hom nyimpadua yɛ Kraest ho mfafakuwa? Aso memfa Kraest ho mfafakuwa menyɛ no edwaman dze? Atserkwa!
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana hom nnyim dɛ nyia ɔdze noho bɔ edwaman ho no, na ɔnye no ayɛ nyimpadua kor? Na ɔse, Hɔn beenu bɛyɛ honankor.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia ɔdze noho bɔ Ewuradze ho no nye no yɛ sunsum kor.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hom nguan ndwamanyɛ. Bɔn biara a nyimpa yɛ nnyi ne nyimpadua mu, na nyia ɔyɛ edwaman no ɔyɛ nankasa ne nyimpadua bɔn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Anaaso hom nnyim dɛ hom nyimpadua yɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a ɔwɔ hom mu a hom enya no Nyankopɔn hɔ no n’asɔrfi? Na hom nnyɛ homankasa hom dze:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: osiandɛ wɔtɔɔ hom aboɔdzen: dɛm ntsi hom nhyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ hom nyimpadua mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na dza ɔfa nsɛm a hom kyerɛwee brɛɛ me dɛ, Oye ma ɔbanyin dɛ ɔmmfa noho nnka ɔbaa no ho dze,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: nkyɛ oye naaso ndwamanyɛ ntsi, hom mma ɔbanyin biara nnya nankasa ne yer, na ɔbaa biara nnya nankasa no kun.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Wɔmma okun no nyɛ n’asɛdze mma ɔyer no dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ, na ɔyer no so nnyɛ dza ɔsɛ dɛmara so mma okun no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ɔyer no nnyi nankasa ne nyimpadua do tum, na mbom okun no a, na dɛmara so na okun no nnyi nankasa ne nyimpadua do tum, na mbom ɔyer no a.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Mma hom mmfa homho nnkam homho, gyedɛ hom yɛ anokor wɔ mber bi, ama hom eenya asɔr no ho adagyer, na hom aasan ebehyia mu bio, amma hom ho a hom nntum nnsie ntsi, Satan aannsɔ hom annhwɛ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na iyi meka no ɔkwanma afamu, na nnyɛ nhyɛdo bi a.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ nyimpa nyina yɛ dɛ mbrɛ metse yi; naaso obiara wɔ n’adom akyɛdze fi Nyankopɔn hɔ: obi wɔ no dɛm, obi so wɔ no dɛm.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na meka kyerɛ esigyafo nye ekunafo dɛ, Oye ma hɔn dɛ wɔtsena hɔ dɛ emi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ wonnyi ahohyɛdo a, wɔnwar: na awar ye kyɛn dɛ ibenya akɔndɔ bɔn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na awarfo dze, mehyɛ hɔn, nnyɛ emi a, na mbom Ewuradze a, dɛ mma ɔbaa nngyaa no kun,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: (na sɛ ogyaa no a, ondzi sigyaw; annyɛ dɛm a, ɔnye no kun nkɔbɔ mu); na mma okun so nngyaa ne yer.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nkaa no dze, emi na meka, na nnyɛ Ewuradze a, dɛ, Sɛ onua bi wɔ yer a ɔnnyɛ gyedzinyi, na sɛ ɔbaa no pen dɛ ɔnye no tsena a, mma ɔnngyaa no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na ɔbaa so a ɔwɔ kun a ɔnngye nndzi no, na sɛ okun no pen dɛ ɔnye no tsena a, mma ɔnngyaa no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na okun a ɔnngye nndzi no ho tsew ɔyer no mu, na ɔyer a ɔnngye nndzi no ho tsew okun no mu: ɔnntse dɛm a, nna hom mba ho wɔ fi, na afei dze hɔn ho tsew.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ nyia ɔnngye nndzi pɛ dɛ ogyaa kɔ a, ma ongyaa; onua kor no, anaa akyerɛbaa kor no wɔnnkyekyer no wɔ dɛm asɛm yi mu: na asomdwee mu na Nyankopɔn afrɛ hɛn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na ɔyer, bi a sɛ ebɛgye wo kun nkwa a, ana inyim? Anaaso okun, sɛ ebɛgye wo yer nkwa a, ɔwo inyim anaa?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ Ewuradze akyekyɛ ama obiara no, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn afrɛ obiara no, dɛmara na ɔmbɔ ne bra; na mbrɛ mehyehyɛ no wɔ asɔr nyina mu nye no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ wɔfrɛɛ obi na ɔyɛ twatsianyi a, mma ɔnndan monomonomnyi; sɛ wɔfrɛɛ obi na ɔyɛ monomonomnyi a, mma wonntwa no twatsia.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Twatsiatwa nnyɛ hwee, na monomonomyɛ so nnyɛ hwee, na mbom Nyankopɔn ahyɛdze ne ndzido na ohia.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ɔfrɛ kor a wɔfrɛɛ obi wɔ mu no, wɔmma ɔntsena mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Wɔfrɛɛ wo na eyɛ akowaa a, mma ɔnnyɛ wo asɛm, na sɛ ibotum enya wo fahodzi a, ɔno yɛ no dɛm.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia wɔfrɛɛ no Ewuradze mu na ɔyɛ akowaa no, ɔyɛ Ewuradze ne dehyee; dɛmara so na ɔdehye a wɔfrɛɛ no no, ɔyɛ Kraest Jesus akowaa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Wɔdze bo tɔɔ hom: mma hom nnyɛ nyimpa nkowaa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Enuanom, biribiara a wɔafrɛ obi wɔ mu no, ɔnoara mu na ɔnye Nyankopɔn ntsena.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɔn a wɔnnwaree ho dze, minnyi Ewuradze hɔ ahyɛdze bi, na meka m’adwen dɛ nyia oenya Ewuradze hɔ ehumbɔbɔr dɛ ondzi nokwar.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na dza mususu dɛ oye nye dɛ sesei ahohia yi ntsi oye ma nyimpa dɛ ɔtsena hɔ dɛmara.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Edze wo ho abata ɔyer ho anaa? Mma nnhwehwɛ dɛ ebɛsan. Ɔyer bi mmbata wo ho anaa? Mma nnhwehwɛ ɔyer.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ awar mpo a, ennyɛ bɔn, na sɛ ɔbaabun war a, ɔnnyɛ bɔn; naaso dɛm nkorɔfo no benya ɔhaw wɔ honam mu, na emi dze, mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ motwe hom fi ɔhaw no ho.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na iyi na meka enuanom, dɛ woetwa mber no tsia, ntsi afei hɔn a wɔwɔ yernom nyɛ dɛ wonnyi bi;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na hɔn a wosu no nyɛ dɛ wonnsu, na hɔn a hɔn enyi agye nyɛ dɛ hɔn enyi nngye, na hɔn a wɔtɔ nyɛ dɛ wonnyi hwee,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na hɔn a wɔdze wiadze ayɛ hɔndze, nnyɛ dɛ wɔmmfa nnyɛ nnhwee; osiandɛ wiadze no su rutwa mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ hom nnkɛyɛ dadwen. Osigyanyi yɛ Ewuradze ndzɛmba ho dadwen, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ asɔ Ewuradze enyi;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na ɔwarfo dze, ɔyɛ wiadze ndzɛmba ho dadwen, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ asɔ ne yer enyi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sorbi da ɔbaawarfo nye ɔbaabun ntamu: ɔbaa sigyanyi yɛ dadwen wɔ Ewuradze ndzɛmba ho, ama no ho aatsew wɔ nyimpadua nye sunsum so mu; na ɔbaawarfo dze, ɔyɛ dadwen wɔ wiadze ndzɛmba ho, mbrɛ ɔbɔsɔ no kun enyi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Homankasa hom yie ntsi na meka yi, nnyɛ dɛ merehyɛ hom, na mbom fɛw a ɔbɛyɛ, na ɔsom a hom bɔsom Ewuradze enyim dɛ biribi nnyɛ hom basabasa ntsi a.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ obi dwen dɛ ne ndzeyɛɛ wɔ ne baabun a ɔaso awar do mmfata, na sɛ ohia so a, wɔmma ɔnyɛ dza ɔpɛ; ɔnnyɛ bɔn, wɔmma wɔnwar.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia ogyina n’akoma mu pintsinn, na ahohia bi nnda no do, na ɔwɔ nankasa ne pɛ do tum, na oesua n’akoma mu dɛ ɔbɛma ne baabun atsena hɔ no, ɔmmfomee.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔwar n’esiwayer no yɛ no yie, na nyia ɔmmfa no mma awar no bɛyɛ yie asen no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ber tsentsen a ɔbaa no kun tse ase no wɔakyekyer no, na sɛ no kun ka beebi a, nna odzi noho dɛ ɔwar obiara a ɔpɛ, mbom Ewuradze mu nko na ɔnyɛ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ ɔtsena hɔ dɛmara a, iyi na ɔyɛ nhyira ma no, mbrɛ m’adwen tse nye no: na mususu dɛ mo so mowɔ Nyankopɔn Sunsum no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na abosom afɔrbɔdze ho dze, yenyim dɛ hɛn nyina wowɔ nyimdzee: nyimdzee dze ahomemado ba, naaso ɔdɔ dze ntowdo ba.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ obi susu dɛ onyim biribi a, onnyae nnhunii dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ ohu;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na sɛ obi dɔ Nyankopɔn a, ɔno na Nyankopɔn nyim no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na abosom afɔrbɔdze ne dzi ho dze, hɛn dze, yenyim dɛ ɔbosom nnyɛ hwee wɔ wiadze mu, na eso nyame bi nnyi hɔ dɛ ɔbaako no ara.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na kaansa ɔsor o, asaase o, dza wɔfrɛ hɔn enyame pii wɔ hɔ, dɛ enyame pii nye ewuranom pii wɔ hɔ no a,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: hɛn dze, Nyame kor na yɛwɔ, Egya no a adze nyina fir no mu, na hɛn so yɛwɔ hɔ ma no, nye Ewuradze kor, Jesus Kraest a adze nyina nam no do, na hɛn so yɛnam no do no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Naaso dɛm nyimdzee yi nnyi nyimpa nyina mu, ma ntsi binom dze hɔn ntɔyɛɛ wɔ abosonsɛm ho no dzi no dɛ abosom afɔrbɔdze, na dɛ hɔn tsibowa yɛ mberɛw ntsi, fi ka hɔn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na edziban nnkamfo hɛn mma Nyankopɔn, na nnyɛ dɛ sɛ yedzi a na yɛhyɛ ma, anaa yenndzi a, na yɛtɔ sin bi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na hom nhwɛ yie, ama no ho kwan a hom wɔ no aannyɛ fintsidua amma hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ obi hu ɔwo a ewɔ nyimdzee dɛ etse edzidzii wɔ abosondan mu, na sɛ ne tsibowa yɛ mberɛw a, ana ennkɛma oenya ngyinado ekedzi abosom afɔrbɔdze a?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nna ɔnam wo nyimdzee do na onua a ɔyɛ mberɛw a Kraest wui maa no no reyew.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ hom yɛ enuanom no bɔn dɛm pirapira hɔn tsibowa a ɔyɛ mberɛw no a, nna Kraest na hom reyɛ no bɔn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, sɛ nam ne dzi ma mo nua fintsiw a, ɔno minnkedzi ara da, na maamma mo nua emmfintsiw.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana menndze moho a? Ana mennyɛ ɔsomafo a? Ana munnhun hɛn Ewuradze Jesus a? Ana nnyɛ hom nye m’edwuma wɔ Ewuradze mu a?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ mennyɛ ɔsomafo mma binom a, hom dze meyɛ ma hom, na m’asomafoyɛ ne nsɔwano nye hom wɔ Ewuradze mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Me nyiano a miyi kyerɛ hɔn a wɔpɛnsapɛnsa mo dwumadzi mu nye iyi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana yennyi ho kwan dɛ yedzidzi na yɛnom?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana yennyi ho kwan dɛ yɛdze ɔyer a ɔyɛ gyedzinyi nantsew, dɛ asomafo nkaa no, nye Ewuradze no nuanom no, nye Siifas?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Anaaso emi nye Barnabas nko na yennyi ho kwan dɛ yegyaa dwumadzi anaa?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sordaanyi woana na ɔbɔ nankasa ne kaw kɔ sa? Woana na ɔyɛ wenyin ture na onndzi n’aba bi? Anaaso woana na ɔnyɛn anyɛmbowa na ɔnnom anyɛmbowa hɔn numfonsu bi?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana meka yi nyimpa afamu a, na mbra no so nnka dɛm?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na wɔakyerɛw no wɔ Moses mbra no mu dɛ, Mma nnkyekyer nantwi a ɔporow eburow no ano. Aso anantwi no na hɔn ho hia Nyankopɔn,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: anaa hɛn ntsi ara na ɔka dɛm? Ɛhɛɛ, hɛn ntsi na wɔkyerɛwee, osiandɛ nyia ofuntum asaase no, ɔsɛ dɛ ofuntum enyidado mu, na nyia ɔporow eburow no yɛ no enyidado mu dɛ obenya mu bi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ yeduaa sunsum ndzɛmba maa hom a, ana ɔyɛ adze a ɔso biara dɛ yebobu hom honam mu ndzɛmba?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ binom enya hom ho kwan yi bi a, ana nnyɛ hɛn mbom a? Naaso yɛammfa kwan a ɔtse dɛm yi do, na mbom yɛsɔw adze nyina, amma yeennsiw Kraest asɛmpa no kwan.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana hom nnyim dɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ asɔr ho edwuma no dzi asɔrdan mu adze no bi? Na dɛ hɔn a wɔsom afɔrmbukyia ho no nye afɔrmbukyia no nya hɔn kyɛpɛn?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛmara so na Ewuradze hyɛɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔka asɛmpa no ndzidzi asɛmpa no ho.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na emi dze, mennyɛɛ yinom mu biara; eso mennkyerɛw yi dɛ wɔnyɛ dɛm mma me; na oye ma me dɛ mubowu mbom, kyɛn dɛ obiara bɛma m’ahohyehyɛ ayɛ kwa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ meka asɛmpa no a, minnyi biribi a medze hyehyɛ moho: na ehiasɛm da mo do, na sɛ mannka asɛmpa no a, nkyɛ mundue!
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ meyɛ yi mankasa me pɛ do a, mowɔ akatua, sɛ eso mannyɛ no mankasa me pɛ do mpo a, wɔdze ofihwɛ edwuma ahyɛ me nsa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na afei m’akatua nye dza ɔwɔ hen? Ɔno nye dɛ sɛ meka asɛmpa no a, mma memmfa akabɔ nnka asɛmpa no ho, amma maammfa asɛmpa no ho kwan a mowɔ annyɛ adze ntrado.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na kaansa midzi moho do wɔ nyimpa nyina afamu mpo a, medze moho yɛɛ akowaa maa nyimpa nyina, ama me nsa aaka dodowara.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Meyɛɛ Jewnyi maa Jewfo ama meenya Jewfo; hɔn a wɔwɔ mbra no ase no, dɛ nyia ɔwɔ mbra no ase, (minnyi mbra no ase dze,) naaso meyɛɛ moho dɛ nyia ɔwɔ mbra no ase ama meenya hɔn a wɔwɔ mbra no ase:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na hɔn a wonnyi mbra no ase no, meyɛɛ dɛ minnyi mbra no ase maa hɔn, (nnyɛ dɛ minnyi mbra ase wɔ Nyankopɔn afamu, na mbom mowɔ mbra ase wɔ Kraest afamu) ama meenya hɔn a wonnyi mbra no ase no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw no, meyɛɛ dɛ nyia ɔyɛ mberɛw maa hɔn, ama meenya hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw. Mayɛ moho adze nyina ama nyimpa nyina, ama menam akwan nyina mu maagye binom nkwa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na iyi nyina asɛmpa no ntsi na meyɛ, ama meenya ho bi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana hom nnyim dɛ hɔn a wosi empire wɔ mbirikatu mu no, hɔn nyina tu dze, naaso ɔbaako na onya empiresi abadobɔdze no a? Dɛmara na hom so ntu mbirika, ama hom so hom eenya abadobɔdze no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na obiara a ɔreper edzi nkonyim wɔ empiresi mu no, ɔhyɛ noho do wɔ adze nyina mu; hɔn dze wɔyɛ ma woeenya abɔtsir a ɔsɛɛ, na hɛn dze dza ɔnnsɛɛ a.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi emi dze, mbirika a mutu yi, munntu no gyan bi, ekutuku a motow yi, monntow no dɛ dza morotow gu mframa mu ara gyan.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Mbom mehyɛ mo honam amen, na midzi no nya, ama maka asɛmpa akyerɛ binom ekyir no, woeennyi mankasa so tokyen.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na, enuanom, memmpɛ dɛ medze sie hom dɛ hɛn egyanom nyina hyɛɛ mununkum no ase, na hɔn nyina duaa po no mu,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na wonumaa hɔn nyina hyɛɛ Moses mu wɔ mununkum no nye po no mu,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na hɔn nyina dzii sunsum edziban kor no ara bi,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na hɔn nyina noom sunsum nsu kor no ara bi; na wɔnomee fii sunsum botan a ɔkaa hɔn do: na ɔbotan no nye Kraest.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Naaso hɔn mu piinara Nyankopɔn enyi annsɔ hɔn; na wodwuruuw hɔn sar no do.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Wɔdze iyinom yɛɛ mfatoho maa hɛn, ama hɛn kɔn aanndɔ ndzebɔn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn kɔn dɔe.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mma hom nnyɛ abosonsɔrfo dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu binom yɛe, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ɔman no tsenaa ase dzidzii, nomee, na wɔsoɛree goree.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Eso mma hom mma yɛmmbɔ ndwamambra dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu binom yɛe, na mpem eduonu ebiasa totɔr da kor.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Eso mma yɛnnsɔ Kraest nnhwɛ, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu binom sɔɔ no hwɛe, na nwɔ kunkum hɔn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Eso mma hom nnhwinhwin, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu binom hwinhwinii, na ɔsɛɛfo sɛɛ hɔn no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na yinom nyina yɛɛ hɔn wɔ mfatoho ntsi, na wɔkyerɛwee dze tuu hɛn a mber no ewiei ato hɛn yi fo.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi ma nyia ɔdwen dɛ ogyina hɔ no nhwɛ yie mma ɔaannhwe ase.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nsɔhwɛ bi nntoo hom dɛ dza nyimpa tum gyina enyim no ara, na Nyankopɔn yɛ ɔnokwafo a ɔremma wɔnnsɔ hom nnhwɛ nnkyɛn dza hom botum egyina ano, na mbom ɔdze ɔkwan bɛka nsɔhwɛ no ho a wɔnam mu fi nsa, ama hom eetum egyina enyim.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, m’adɔfo, hom nguan abosonsɔr.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Mekasa kyerɛ hom dɛ enyansafo: hom mbu dza meka ho atsɛn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nhyira kɔɔpow a yehyira do no, nnyɛ Kraest bɔgyaa nkitahodzi anaa? Paanoo a yebubu no, nnyɛ Kraest nyimpadua nkitahodzi anaa?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ɔnam dɛ ɔyɛ paanoo kor ntsi, hɛn a yɛdɔɔ so no yɛ nyimpadua kor; na hɛn nyina yedzi paanoo kor no ara bi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hom nhwɛ honam afamu Israel; ana hɔn a wodzi afɔrbɔdze no nye afɔrmbukyia no nndzi nkitaho?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ebɛn asɛm na mereka yi? Dɛ adze a wɔdze abɔ afɔr ama abosom yɛ biribi, anaa dɛ ɔbosom yɛ biribi?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Oho, na mbom dɛ dza amanamamfo dze bɔ afɔr no, wɔbɔ ma mbɔnsam, na nnyɛ Nyankopɔn bi a: na memmpɛ dɛ hom nye mbɔnsam dzi nkitaho.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hom runntum nnom Ewuradze kɔɔpow mu nye mbɔnsam kɔɔpow mu; hom runntum nndzidzi Ewuradze pon do na hom nndzidzi mbɔnsam pon so do.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana Ewuradze na yɛrehyɛ no ma ɔatwe nyinkun anaa? Hɛn ho yɛ dzen sen no anaa?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Kwan da adze nyina ho, na nnyɛ adze nyina na ɔfata; kwan da adze nyina ho, na nnyɛ adze nyina na ɔma ntowdo.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Mma obiara nnhwehwɛ nankasa nedze, na mbom ɔnhwehwɛ ne nyɛnko dze.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Biribiara a wɔtɔn no nangua do no hom ndzi, na mma hom mmbisabisa mu wɔ tsibowa ntsi:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na asaase nye no mu adze nyina yɛ Ewuradze dze.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi mu bi to nsa frɛ hom edzidzi na hom pɛ dɛ hom kɔ a, dza wɔdze besisi hom enyim nyina hom ndzi, mma hom mmbisabisa mu wɔ hom tsibowa ntsi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ obi se hom dɛ, Iyi yɛ adze a wɔdze abɔ afɔr ama abosom a, mma hom nndzi, wɔ nyia ɔkyerɛe no ntsi, nye tsibowa ntsi:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: medɛ tsibowa a, nnyɛ wodze, na onyia no nedze na mekyerɛ; na ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔdze obi ne tsibowa bobu m’ahofadzi atsɛn?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ medze ndaase dzi bi a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔbɔbɔ me dzin bɔn wɔ dza meda ho ase ntsi?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom ridzidzi o, hom ronom o, hom reyɛ biribi o, hom nyɛ ne nyina mma Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hom nyɛ nyimpa a fintsidua nnyi hɔn mu mma Jewfo nye Griikfo nye Nyankopɔn asɔrmba:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: dɛ mbrɛ mo so mosɔ nyimpa nyina enyi wɔ adze nyina mu, monnhwehwɛ mankasa me mfaso, na mbom dza ɔyɛ nyimpa pii dze, ama bi a woennya nkwa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hom nsuasua me, dɛ mbrɛ mo so musuasua Kraest no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Afei miyi hom ayɛw dɛ hom kaa me adze nyina mu, na hom da ho dze atsetsesɛm no mu, dɛ mbrɛ medze hyɛɛ hom nsa no ara.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mepɛ dɛ hom hu dɛ ɔbarimba biara ne tsir nye Kraest, na ɔbaa ne tsir nye ɔbarimba, na Kraest ne tsir nye Nyankopɔn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ɔbarimba biara a ɔrosɔr, anaa ɔrehyɛ nkɔm, na ɔakata ne tsir no, ɔhyɛ ne tsir fɛr.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na ɔbaa biara a ɔrosɔr, anaa ɔrehyɛ nkɔm, na ɔannkata ne tsir no, ɔhyɛ ne tsir fɛr, na ɔtse dɛ nyia ɔapra ne tsir no ara.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ ɔannkata ne tsir a, ma ɔmpra ne tsir so; na sɛ ɔyɛ enyito ma ɔbaa dɛ oyi anaa ɔpra ne tsir a, ɔnodze ma ɔnkata ne tsir.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na ɔbarimba dze, ɔnnsɛ dɛ ɔkata ne tsir, osiandɛ ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn no honyi nye n’enyimnyam, na ɔbaa dze ɔyɛ ɔbarimba n’enyimnyam.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nnyɛ ɔbarimba na ofi ɔbaa mu, na mbom ɔbaa na ofi ɔbarimba mu;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: eso nnyɛ ɔbaa ntsi na wɔbɔɔ ɔbarimba, na mbom ɔbarimba ntsi na wɔbɔɔ ɔbaa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Iyi ntsi na ɔsɛ dɛ ɔbaa nya dza ɔkyerɛ tumdzi wɔ ne tsir do, wɔ abɔfo no ntsi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Naaso Ewuradze mu dze, ɔbarimba nnkwetsir ɔbaa, na ɔbaa so nnkwetsir ɔbarimba:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaa fi ɔbarimba mu no, mbrɛ ɔbarimba so nam ɔbaa do ba nye no; na adze nyina fi Nyankopɔn mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Homankasa mbu hom mu atsɛn; ana oye dɛ ɔbaa dze tsir a ɔannkata do yɛ asɔr ma Nyankopɔn?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana ɔbrasu ara mpo nnkyerɛkyerɛ hom dɛ sɛ ɔbarimba sie tsir kusuww a, ɔyɛ enyimguase ma no a?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ ɔbaa dze osie tsir kusuww a, ɔyɛ enyimnyam ma no, osiandɛ wɔdze ne tsinhwi maa no dɛ akatado.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ obi pɛ dɛ odzi ntokwano a, hɛn dze, yɛnnyɛ dɛm adze no, na Nyankopɔn asɔrasɔr so nnyɛ dɛm.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na dza medze rehyɛ hom yi, mirinnyi hom ayɛw, osiandɛ hom nnhyia mu wɔ papa ntsi, na mbom bɔn ntsi a.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dza odzi kan nye dɛ metse dɛ sɛ hom hyia mu wɔ asɔr mu a, mpaapaamu wɔ hom mu; na megye no mu bi midzi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Oye dɛ fɛkuwbɔ horow ba hom mu, ama hɔn a wɔgye hɔn to mu no aada edzi wɔ hom mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ hom behyia fakor a, nnyɛ Ewuradze edzidzi na hom dzi no:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na hom ridzidzi a, ɔbaako dzi kan dzi nankasa n’edziban, na obi ɔkɔm dze no, na obi abow.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ebɛnadze ntsi a? Ana hom nnyi efi a hom dzidzi mu? Anaa nnyɛ Nyankopɔn asɔr na hom bu no enyimtsia, na hom hyɛ hɔn a wonnyi bi enyito? Mense hom dɛn? Minyi hom ayɛw wɔ yi mu anaa? Mirinnyi hom ayɛw.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na emi dze, minyaa Ewuradze nsamu dza medze memaa hom no dɛ: Ewuradze Jesus anadwe no a woyii no mae no, ɔfaa paanoo;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na ɔdaa ase no, obubui, na ɔsee dɛ, Me nyimpadua a wɔdze ama hom nye yi: hom nyɛ iyi mfa nyɛ me nkaa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛmara so na edzidzi ekyir no ɔfaa kɔɔpow no see dɛ, Kɔɔpow yi nye ahyɛmu fofor no wɔ mo bɔgyaa mu: hom nyɛ iyi mber biara a hom bɔnom no mfa nyɛ me nkaa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mber biara a hom dzi paanoo yi, na hom nom kɔɔpow yi, hom bɔ Ewuradze wu no ho dawur dze kesi dɛ ɔbɛba.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi obiara a obedzi paanoo yi, anaa ɔbɔnom Ewuradze kɔɔpow yi dɛ mbrɛ ɔnnsɛ no, obedzi Ewuradze nyimpadua nye no bɔgyaa ho fɔ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na ma nyimpa nsɔ noho nhwɛ, na ondua dɛm ndzi paanoo no bi, na ɔnnom kɔɔpow no bi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia odzi na ɔnom no, odzi na ɔnom dze atsɛmbu ba nankasa noho do, osiandɛ oemmbu Ewuradze nyimpadua bi yie.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Iyi ntsi na hom mu pii ayɛ mberɛw na wɔyaryar, na piinara so adeda.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ yeebu hɛnankasa hɛnho yie a, nkyɛ wommbuu hɛn atsɛn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ wobu hɛn atsɛn a, Ewuradze tsea hɛn amma woeemmbu yɛnye wiadze fɔ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, mo nuanom, sɛ hom behyia mu ribedzidzi a, hom ntwentweɔn homho.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ ɔkɔm dze bi a, wɔmma ondzidzi fie, mma hom eemmbehyia mu emmbenya atsɛmbu. Na nkaa no dze, sɛ meba a, mebɛka ho asɛm yie.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na dza ɔfa no sunsum mu nsɛm ho no dze, enuanom, memmpɛ dɛ biribiara bosuma hom.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hom nyim dɛ nkan no a hom yɛ abosonsɔrfo no, hom maa wogyaa hom kɔr abosom mmum nkyɛn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi merema hom ehu dɛ obiara a ɔnam Nyankopɔn Sunsum mu kasa no, ɔmmfrɛ Jesus ebusudze; na obiara nntum nnka dɛ Jesus nye Ewuradze gyedɛ ɔnam Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na adom akyɛdze horow wɔ hɔ, na Sunsum kor no ara a.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na ɔsom horow wɔ hɔ, na Ewuradze kor no ara a.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na dwumadzi horow wɔ hɔ, na Nyankopɔn kor no ara na ɔyɛ adze nyina wɔ hɔn nyina mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Naaso wɔdze Sunsum edziyi no ma hɔn nyina nkorkor, na aayɛ hɔn mfaso.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na wɔnam Sunsum mu ama obi enyansasɛm, obi so nyimdzeesɛm, dɛ mbrɛ Sunsum kor no ara tse:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: obi so gyedzi, wɔ Sunsum kor no ara mu; obi so yarsa akyɛdze wɔ Sunsum kor no ara mu;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: obi so etumdzeyɛ; obi so nkɔnhyɛ; obi so esunsum mu nhumu; obi so kasa horow; obi so kasa horow nkyerɛasee:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na yinom nyina Sunsum kor no ara na ɔyɛ, na ɔkyekyɛ ma hɔn nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ nyimpadua yɛ kor, na ɔwɔ mfafakuwa pii, na nyimpadua ne mfafakuwa no nyina dɔɔ so dze, naaso wɔyɛ nyimpadua kor no, mbrɛ Kraest so tse nye no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɛn nyina so, Jewfo o, Griikfo o, nkowaa o, adehye o, woenuma hɛn Sunsum kor mu aba nyimpadua kor mu; na wɔama hɛn nyina anom Sunsum kor no ara bi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyimpadua nnyɛ fafakuwa kor, na pii.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ anan se dɛ, Mennyɛ nsa ntsi mennyɛ nyimpadua ho bi a, nna nnyɛ iyi ntsi na ɔma ɔnnyɛ nyimpadua ho bi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ aso se dɛ, Mennyɛ enyiwa ntsi mennyɛ nyimpadua ho bi a, nna nnyɛ yi ntsi na ɔma ɔnnyɛ nyimpadua ho bi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ nyimpadua nyina yɛ enyiwa a, ɔtse no wɔ hen? Ne nyina yɛ ɔtse a, ohua no wɔ hen?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na afei Nyankopɔn dze mfafakuwa esisi nyimpa ho nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ hɔn nyina yɛ fafakuwa kor a, nyimpadua no wɔ hen?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na afei mfafakuwa dɔɔ so dze, naaso nyimpadua no yɛ kor.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na enyiwa nntum nnse nsa dɛ, Minnyi wo ho hia; anaaso bio, tsir nntum nnse anan dɛ, Minnyi wo ho hia.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mbom nyimpadua ho mfafakuwa a wɔyɛ dɛ wɔyɛ mberɛw dodow no hɔn na hɔn ho hia;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na nyimpadua ho bi a yɛdwen dɛ ɔnnsɛ enyidzi pii no na yɛhyɛ no enyidzi pii; na dza ɔnnyɛ fɛw wɔ hɛn ho no na ɔwɔ ahomka pii;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na dza ɔyɛ fɛw wɔ hɛn ho no nnhia dɛm: na Nyankopɔn dze nyimpadua no atoatoa mu, na mfafakuwa a wɔka bi no ɔama hɔn enyidzi pii;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: amma mpaapaamu aammba nyimpadua no mu, na mbom mfafakuwa no eenya ndwendwenho kor no ara ama hɔnho nkorkor.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ fafakuwa kor hu amandze a, mfafakuwa no nyina hu bi; na eso wɔhyɛ fafakuwa kor enyimnyam a, mfafakuwa no nyina nye no dzi dɛw.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na afei hom yɛ Kraest nyimpadua no nye no ho mfafakuwa nkorkor.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn dze binom esisi asɔr no mu: dza odzi kan asomafo, otsia ebien nkɔnhyɛfo, otsia ebiasa akyerɛkyerɛfo, nkyii etumdzeyɛ, na nkyii yarsa akyɛdze, mboa, mpanyindzi nye ɔkasa ahorow.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ana hɔn nyina yɛ asomafo? Hɔn nyina yɛ nkɔnhyɛfo? Hɔn nyina yɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo? Hɔn nyina yɛ etumdzeyɛfo?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hɔn nyina wɔ yarsa akyɛdze? Hɔn nyina kasa kasa horow? Hɔn nyina kyerɛ ase?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Mbom hom mper akyɛdze tsitsir no ho, na afei merekyerɛ hom kwan a oye kyɛn biribiara.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ medze nyimpa nye abɔfo tɛkyerɛma mekasa, na minnyi ɔdɔ a, mayɛ dɛ ayewa a ɔgyegye nye akasaa a ɔwosow.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ mowɔ nkɔnhyɛ akyɛdze, na minyim esumasɛm nyina nye nyimdzee nyina, na sɛ mowɔ gyedzi nyina ma mututu mbepɔw mpo, na minnyi ɔdɔ a, mennsɛ hwee.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ medze m’ahodze nyina mema ehiafo, na sɛ medze me nyimpadua ma dɛ wɔnhyew, na sɛ minnyi ɔdɔ a, minnya ho hwee.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ɔdɔ pen kyɛr, ne yamu ye; ɔdɔ nnyɛ ahoɔyaw, ɔdɔ nnyɛ ahohyehyɛ, ɔnnhoran;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: ɔnnyɛ noho dza ɔmmfata, ɔnnhwehwɛ nankasa nedze, no bo nnhaw no, ommbu bɔn ho akontaa;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: onndzi dɛw wɔ dza ɔnntsen ho, mbom odzi nokwar no mu ehurusi;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: ɔsoa adze nyina; ɔgye adze nyina dzi; onya adze nyina ho enyidado, na ɔsɔw adze nyina so.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ɔdɔ mmbɔ adze da: na nkɔnhyɛnsɛm dze, wobogu no; ɔkasa horow dze, wobegyaa; nyimdzee dze, wobogu no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na yenyim fa na fa, na yɛhyɛ nkɔm fa na fa:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na sɛ dza odzi mu no nya ba a, nna wobogu dza ɔyɛ fa na fa no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Meyɛ abofra no, mekasaa dɛ abofra, modween dɛ abofra, metsee adze ase dɛ abofra; na mebɛyɛɛ panyin yi, medze mbofrasɛm nyina egu nkyɛn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sesei dze yɛnam ahwehwɛ mu hu adze wɔ abɛbu mu, na ndaamba dze yebohu enyim na enyim: sesei dze minyim fa na fa, na ndaamba dze mubohu no dɛ mbrɛ woehu mo so.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na afei gyedzi, enyidado, ɔdɔ, ebiasa yi na ɔwɔ hɔ daa; na hɔn mu kɛse nye ɔdɔ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hom nhwehwɛ ɔdɔ ekyir kwan, na hom mbɔ mbɔdzen so wɔ sunsum mu ndzɛmba ho, na ne kɛse no nye dɛ hom bɛhyɛ nkɔm.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia ɔka kasa bi no, ɔnnkasa nnkyerɛ nyimpa, mbom ɔdze kyerɛ Nyankopɔn; na obi nntse ase, na sunsum mu na ɔka esumasɛm.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia ɔhyɛ nkɔm no, ɔka ntowdo nye afotu nye awerɛkyekyer nsɛm kyerɛ nyimpa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nyia ɔka kasa bi no, ɔtow nankasa noho do, na nyia ɔhyɛ nkɔm no ɔma asɔr no nya ntowdo.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ hom nyina ka kasa horow dze, naaso oye dɛ hom bɛhyɛ nkɔm: osiandɛ nyia ɔhyɛ nkɔm so sen nyia ɔka kasa horow, gyedɛ ɔkyerɛ ase ama asɔr no eenya ntowdo.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na afei, enuanom, sɛ meba hom nkyɛn mebɛkasa kasa horow, na sɛ mannkasa annkyerɛ hom wɔ nyikyerɛ mu, anaa nyimdzee mu, anaa nkɔnhyɛ mu, anaa nkyerɛkyerɛ mu a, mfaso bɛn na mebɛyɛ ama hom?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na ndzɛmba a wonnyi nkwa mpo, dɛ atɛntɛbɛn anaa nsanku, sɛ wɔanngyegye ndze horow a, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn ehu dza wɔrehɛn anaa dza wɔrobɔ?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ totorobɛnto no annhɛn yie a, woana besiesie noho akɔ akono?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛmara na hom so, sɛ hom ammfa hom tɛkyerɛma annka asɛm a wɔtse ase a, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn atse dza hom ka? Hom bɛyɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔkasa gu mframa mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Annyɛ a, ndze horow pii wɔ wiadze, naaso no mu biara nnyi hɔ a onnyi nkyerɛase.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ menntse kasa no ase a, mubobu nyia ɔkasa no dɛ ɔpɔtɔnyi, na nyia ɔkasa no so ebu me dɛ ɔpɔtɔnyi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛmara na hom so robɔ sunsum mu nsɛm ho mbɔdzen yi, hom nhwehwɛ dɛ hom bɔbor do ama asɔr no ntowdo.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔka kasa bi no ɔmbɔ mpaa dɛ ɔbɛkyerɛ ase.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ mosɔr wɔ kasa bi mu a, mo sunsum sɔr dze, naaso m’adwen dze ɔnntse ase.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nna ɔtse dɛn nye no? Medze sunsum no bɔsɔr, na medze adwen so asɔr; medze sunsum bɔtow ndwom, na medze adwen so atow ndwom.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ edze sunsum hyira a, ɔbɛyɛ dɛn na nyia ɔnntse ase no bɛse Amen wɔ wo ndaase no ekyir, ber a onnyim dza aka no?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na ɔwo dze eda ase yie dze, na ɔnodze onnya ntowdo biara.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Meda Nyankopɔn ase dɛ meka ɔkasa horow sen hom nyina:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: naaso, asɔr mu dze, mepɛ dɛ medze me ntseasee ka nsɛmfua enum ama maakyerɛkyerɛ binom so, kyɛn dɛ mebɛka nsɛm mpemdu wɔ ɔkasa bi mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Enuanom, mma hom nnyɛ mbofra wɔ adwen mu, na mbom bɔn mu na hom nyɛ mbofraba, na adwen mu dze hom nyɛ dɛ hɔn a woewie nyin.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na wɔakyerɛw no mbra no mu dɛ, Medze ananaben gyirama, nye ananaben ano na mebɛkasa akyerɛ ɔman yi, na iyi so mpo na wonnketsie me, Ewuradze na ɔse.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi kasa horow nnyɛ asɛnkyerɛdze mma hɔn a wɔgye dzi, na mbom ɔdze ma hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi; na nkɔnhyɛ dze, ɔnnyɛ hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi dze, na mbom hɔn a wɔgye dzi a.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ asɔr nyina behyia, na hɔn nyina ka kasa horow, na sɛ nyimpa bi a wonnyim ho bi, na wɔnngye nndzi ba mu a, wɔnnkɛse dɛ hom egyingyim anaa?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ hɔn nyina hyɛ nkɔm, na sɛ obi a ɔnngye nndzi anaa onnyim ho bi ba mu a, dza hom nyina reka no bɛka ne tsibowa ebu no atsɛn,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na n’akoma mu esumasɛm bɛda edzi, na ɔdze n’enyim bobutuw famu asɔr Nyankopɔn aka dɛ, Nyankopɔn wɔ hom mu ampa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nna, enuanom, ɔtse dɛm yi yɛbɛyɛ no dɛn? Sɛ hom behyia mu a, hom mu biara wɔ ndwom, wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ, wɔ nyikyerɛsɛm, wɔ kasa bi, wɔ nkyerɛasee bi. Hom mma wɔnyɛ adze nyina mma ntowdo.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ obi ka kasa bi a, wɔnyɛ beenu, na ɔtra dɛm a, baasa, na wondzi esiado, na ɔbaako nkyerɛ ase:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na sɛ asekyerɛnyi nnyi hɔ a, ommua n’ano wɔ asɔr no mu, na ɔnkasa nkyerɛ nankasa noho nye Nyankopɔn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nkɔnhyɛfo no dze, beenu anaa baasa nkasa, na nkaa no nker nsɛm no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ woyi biribi kyerɛ obi a ɔtse nkyɛn a, nyia odzi kan no mmua n’ano.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na hom nyina botum ahyɛ nkɔm nkorkor, na hom nyina eesua na hom nyina aafa mu afotu;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na nkɔnhyɛfo hɔn esunsum no hyɛ nkɔnhyɛfo no ase;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: osiandɛ Nyankopɔn nnyɛ sakasaka Nyankopɔn, na mbom ɔyɛ asomdwee dze, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse wɔ ahotseweefo asɔr nyina mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hom mma mbaa no mmua hɔn ano wɔ asɔrasɔr mu, na wɔmmaa hɔn kwan dɛ wɔkasa, na mbom wɔmbrɛ hɔnho adze dɛ mbrɛ mbra no so se.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ wɔpɛ biribi esua a, wombisa hɔnankasa hɔn kunnom wɔ fie, osiandɛ ɔyɛ enyito ma ɔbaa dɛ ɔbɛkasa wɔ asɔr mu.
