title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Wɔyɛ no dɛn? Hom mu na Nyankopɔn asɛm firii kɔree? Ana hom nkotsee na ɔbaa hom hɔ?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ obi dwen noho dɛ ɔyɛ nkɔnhyɛnyi anaa sunsummunyi a, onhu dza merekyerɛw hom yi dɛ ɔyɛ Ewuradze ahyɛdze.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ obi nnyim adze a, mma onnhu dze so.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, mo nuanom, hom mbɔ mbɔdzen nhwehwɛ nkɔnhyɛ akyɛdze, na mma hom nnsiw kasa horow mu kasa kwan.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na hom mma wɔnyɛ adze nyina fɛfɛɛfɛw esiado esiado.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na afei, enuanom, merema hom ehu asɛmpa no a mekaa kyerɛɛ hom, na hom so gyee, na hom kitsa mu so,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: ɔnam do so na hom nya nkwa, sɛ hom suo asɛmpa no ara mekaa kyerɛɛ hom no mu dzen a, gyedɛ hom gyee dzii kwa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na nsɛm a odzi kan a mo so minyae a medze hyɛɛ hom nsa nye dɛ hɛn bɔn ntsi na Kraest wui dɛ mbrɛ kyerɛwnsɛm no se;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na dɛ wosiee no, na ne ndaansa no wonyaan no dɛ mbrɛ kyerɛwnsɛm no se;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na dɛ oyii noho kyerɛɛ Siifas, na nkyii oyii noho kyerɛɛ duebien no;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na nkyii oyii noho kyerɛɛ enuanom bɔbor ahaenum prɛko a hɔn mu piinara tsetse hɔ sesei, na binom adeda;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na nkyii oyii noho kyerɛɛ James; na nkyii oyii noho kyerɛɛ asomafo no nyina;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na hɔn nyinara ekyir, na oyii noho kyerɛɛ mo so a metse dɛ obi a wɔwo no ber a ɔnnsoe mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na emi nye asomafo no mu ekumaba a mennsɛ dɛ wɔfrɛ me ɔsomafo mpo, osiandɛ mihiahiaa Nyankopɔn asɔr ho.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Naaso ɔnam Nyankopɔn adom do na metse dɛ mbrɛ metse yi, na n’adom a ɔdze doom me no annyɛ gyan: na mbom mayɛ edwuma pii asen hɔn nyina, naaso nnyɛ emi a, na mbom Nyankopɔn adom a ɔnye me nam no a.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ntsi sɛ emi o, hɔn o, dza yɛpaa mu ka nye yi, na dza hom gyee dzii nye yi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ wɔka no Kraest ho dɛ oenyan efi ewufo mu a, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom mu binom ka dɛ ewufosoɛr bi nnyi?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ ewufosoɛr bi nnyi hɔ a, nna Kraest so nnyanee:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na sɛ Kraest nnyanee a, nna hɛn asɛnka yɛ gyan, na hom gyedzi so yɛ gyan.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nyew, nna wobohu hɛn so dɛ yɛgye dasewia ma Nyankopɔn, osiandɛ yedzi Nyankopɔn dase dɛ oenyan Kraest, na sɛ ewufo nnyan dze a, nna oennyaan ɔno so.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ ewufo nnyan a, nna Kraest so nnyanee;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na sɛ Kraest nnyanee so a, nna hom gyedzi yɛ kwa, hom da ho wɔ hom bɔn mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nna eso hɔn a wɔadeda wɔ Kraest mu no ahera.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ nkwa yi mu nko na yeenya enyidado wɔ Kraest mu a, nna nyimpa nyina mu abɔbɔfo nye hɛn.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na afei Kraest enyan efi ewufo mu ayɛ hɔn a wɔadeda mu eduaba kan.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mbrɛ owu nam nyimpa do bae no, nyimpa na ewufosoɛr so nam no do bae.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ hɔn nyina wu wɔ Adam mu no, dɛmara so na hɔn nyina benya nkwa wɔ Kraest mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na obiara wɔ nankasa ne kyɛpɛn do: Kraest nye eduaba kan, na nkyii hɔn a wɔyɛ Kraest dze, wɔ ne ba mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nna nkyii ewiei no reba a ɔdze ahendzi no bɛhyɛ Nyankopɔn nye Egya no nsa, ber a ɔama mpanyindzi nye tumdzi nye ahoɔdzen nyina ayɛ kwa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na otwar dɛ odzi hen kodu dɛ ɔdze n’atamfo nyina bogu n’ananadze.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na ɔtamfo a odzi ekyir a ɔbɛma ɔayɛ kwa, nye owu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na ɔdze adze nyina egu n’ananadze. Na sɛ ɔka dɛ ɔdze adze nyina egu n’ananadze a, no mu da hɔ pefee dɛ nyia ɔdze adze nyina guu n’ananadze no nnka ho bi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ onya dze ndzɛmba nyina gu n’ananadze a, nna Ɔba no nankasa so dze noho bɛhyɛ nyia ɔdze adze nyina guu n’ananadze no n’ase, na Nyankopɔn aayɛ adze nyina mu adze nyina.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ɔnntse dɛm a, hɔn a wonuma hɔn ma ewufo no, wɔbɛyɛ dɛn? Sɛ ewufo nnyan koraa a, ɔyɛ dɛn na wonuma hɔn ma ewufo?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ɔyɛ dɛn na hɛn so yɛdze hɛn ho to amandze mu dɔnhwer nyina yi?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Enuanom, meka hom ho ahohyehyɛ a mowɔ wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Kraest Jesus mu dɛ muwu daa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ nyimpa afamu nko na menye mbowa koe wɔ Efeso a, ɔyɛ me ebɛn mfaso? Na sɛ ewufo nnyan a, hom mma yendzidzi na yɛnnom, na ɔkyena na yeewu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Mma wɔnndaadaa hom: fɛkuw bɔn sɛɛ ɔbra pa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hom mma hom enyi nda hɔ tsenenee mu, na mma hom nnyɛ bɔn; na binom nnyi Nyankopɔn ho nyimdzee: meka yi dze hyɛ hom enyito.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na bi a obi bɛse dɛ, Ewufo dua dɛn nyan? Na nyimpadua so bɛn na wɔdze bɛba?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ɔkwasea, dza idua no nnya nkwa, gyedɛ owu ansaana,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na dza idua no nnyɛ dua a ɔbɛba no na idua, na eburofua ara kwa, bi a ewifua anaa nkaa no mu bi a;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na Nyankopɔn na ɔma no dua kor a ɔpɛ, na ɔma aba biara nankasa no dua.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nnyɛ nam nyina na ɔyɛ nam kor: ɔsor nyimpa nam, ɔsor mbowa dze, ɔsor anoma dze, ɔsor esunam dze.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sor abɔdze so wɔ hɔ, na famu abɔdze wɔ hɔ: na ɔsor sor dze no n’enyimnyam, na ɔsor famu dze no nedze.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ewia enyimnyam nko, bosoom dze nko, nworaba dze nko: na ɔsosor nworaba enyimnyam nkorkor.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Mbrɛ ewufo mu soɛr so tse nye no. Wodua no prɔwee mu: wonyan no dza ɔmmprɔw mu;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: wodua no enyimguase mu: wonyan no enyimnyam mu; wodua no mberɛw mu: wonyan no ahoɔdzen mu;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: wodua no ɔkra nyimpadua: wonyan no sunsum nyimpadua. Sɛ ɔkra nyimpadua wɔ hɔ a, nna sunsum dze so wɔ hɔ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛmara so na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Adam a odzi kan no bɛyɛɛ ɔkra tseasefo: na Adam a odzi ekyir no bɛyɛɛ sunsum a ɔma nkwa.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Naaso nnyɛ sunsum dze no na odzi kan, na mbom ɔkra dze no a, na nkyii sunsum dze no reba.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Nyimpa a odzi kan no fi famu yɛ famunyi: nyimpa a otsia ebien no fi sor.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Mbrɛ famunyi no tse, mbrɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ famufo so tse nye no: na mbrɛ ɔsornyi no tse no, mbrɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ ɔsorfo tse nye no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mbrɛ yɛahyɛ famunyi no suban no, mbrɛ yɛbɛhyɛ ɔsornyi no so suban nye no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Enuanom, dza meka nye dɛ honam nye bɔgya runntum nnya Nyankopɔn ahenman no; na eso dza ɔprɔw rinnya dza ɔmmprɔw no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hwɛ, mereka hom esumasɛm: nnyɛ hɛn nyina na yɛbɛdeda, na wɔbɛsakyer hɛn nyina
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: amonmu ara, ntsɛmara, wɔ ekyir abɛntoa no mu: na wɔbɛhɛn abɛntoa no, na ewufo no benyan dɛ wɔmmprɔw da, na hɛn dze, yɛbɛsakyer.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na dza ɔprɔw yi otwar dɛ ɔhyɛ dza ɔmmprɔw, na dza owu yi otwar dɛ ɔhyɛ dza onnwu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ dza ɔprɔw yi nya hyɛ dza ɔmmprɔw, na dza owu yi nya hyɛ dza onnwu a, nna asɛm a wɔakyerɛw no bɛba mu dɛ, Owu, wɔamen no konyim mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Owu, wo konyim wɔ hen? Owu, wo hwirom wɔ hen?
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Owu hwirom nye bɔn, na bɔn tum nye mbra no:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na ndaase nka Nyankopɔn a ɔnam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest do ma hɛn konyimdzi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, mo nuanom adɔfo, hom ntsintsim, mma hom nnhinhim, hom mbor do wɔ Ewuradze edwuma mu daa, osiandɛ hom nyim dɛ hom berɛ nnkɛyɛ gyan wɔ Ewuradze mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na ntoboa a wɔdze kɛma ahotseweefo no ho dze, dɛ mbrɛ mehyehyɛɛ no asɔrasɔr a ɔwɔ Galatia mu no, dɛmara na hom so nyɛ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dapɛn mu da a odzi kan no, hom nyina ntsiatsia ngu hom nkyɛn nkorkor, dɛ mbrɛ obiara esi no yie, ama minya ba a, wɔaanngyegye tow no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ mubodu a, hɔn a hom dze nwoma bɛkyerɛ dɛ wɔfata dɛm edwuma no, mobɔsoma hɔn dze hom akyɛdze no akɔ Jerusalɛm;
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: na sɛ ɔsɛ dɛ mo so mokɔ a, menye hɔn bɔkɔ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mikesi Masidonia a, mebɛba hom nkyɛn; osiandɛ Masidonia na mirikesi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na hom nkyɛn na annyɛ a mebɛtsena menye hom edzi awɔwber mpo, na beebiara a mobɔkɔ no hom eegya me kwan.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na afei dze memmpɛ dɛ sɛ murutwa mu nko a na mubohu hom; na sɛ Ewuradze ma ho kwan a, m’enyi da dɛ mebɛkyɛr hom nkyɛn kakra.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na mebɛkyɛr Efeso ekodu Pentekost da no:
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: osiandɛ woebue abow a wodua mu dzi dwuma ama me, na mbom atamfo a wɔwɔ ho no dɔɔ so.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ Timoti ba a, hom nhwɛ ma ɔaammfa hu nye hom anntsena: osiandɛ ɔyɛ Ewuradze edwuma no bi dɛ mbrɛ mo so meyɛ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi mma obi mmbu no enyimtsia. Na hom ngya no kwan asomdwee mu ma ɔmbra me nkyɛn: na morotweɔn ɔno nye enuanom no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na onua Apollos ho dze, meserɛɛ no pii dɛ ɔnye enuanom no mbra hom nkyɛn, na ɔannyɛ ne pɛ koraa dɛ ɔbɛba sesei; na onya mu kwan a, ɔbɛba.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hom nweɔn, hom ngyina gyedzi no mu pintsinn, hom nyɛ dɛ mbarimba, hom nyɛ dzen.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Hom nyɛ hom adze nyina wɔ ɔdɔ mu.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na meserɛ hom, enuanom, hom nyim Stefanas fiemba, dɛ wɔyɛ Akaia edwuma no mu aba a odzi kan, na dɛ wɔdze hɔnho ama a wɔrosom ahotseweefo no,
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: dɛ hom so mbrɛ homho adze mma dɛm nkorɔfo no, nye obiara a ɔboa wɔ edwuma no mu na ɔberɛ.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na m’enyi gye wɔ Stefanas nye Fotunatus nye Akaikus hɔn mbaa no ho, na dza aka hom afamu no wɔabɛyɛ ama me.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Na wɔabɔdwedwe mo sunsum nye homdze: hom ndzi hɔn a wɔtse dɛm no nyi yie.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Asia asɔrasɔr kyiakyia hom. Akwila nye Priska kyia hom pii wɔ Ewuradze mu, nye asɔr a ɔwɔ hɔn fie no.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Enuanom nyina kyia hom. Hom mfa mfewano krɔnkrɔn nkyiakyia homho.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Emi Paul me nsaano nkyia nye yi.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ obi nndɔ Ewuradze a, wɔmma ɔnyɛ ebusudze. Maranata. (Ewuradze, bra!)
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Ewuradze Jesus Kraest adom nka hom.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Mo dɔ nka hom nyina wɔ Kraest Jesus mu. Amen.
title: 1ST CORINTHIANS

text: Paul a ɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ do yɛ Kraest Jesus ɔsomafo, nye onua Timoti, dze kɛma Nyankopɔn asɔr a ɔwɔ Korinte, nye ahotseweefo a wɔwɔ Akaia nyina:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Adom nye asomdwee a ofir hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nka hom.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Nhyira nka hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne Nyankopɔn nye n’Egya a ɔyɛ ehumbɔbɔr Egya nye awerɛkyekyer nyina Nyankopɔn a
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: ɔkyekye hɛn werɛ wɔ hɛn ahohia nyina mu, ama yeetum edua awerɛkyekyer a Nyankopɔn dze kyekye hɛn werɛ no do akyekye hɔn a wɔwɔ ahohia biara mu so werɛ.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ Kraest n’amandzehu kɛsenara ba hɛn do no, dɛmara na hɛn awerɛkyekyer so nam Kraest mu bu do.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ wohiahia hɛn ho a, ɔyɛ awerɛkyekyer na nkwagye ma hom; ɔno na ɔyɛ edwuma abotar mu wɔ amandze kor no ara a hɛn so yehu mu;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na hɛn enyidado a ɔwɔ hom ho no tsim, osiandɛ yenyim dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ amandzehu no mu fafafo no, mbrɛ hom yɛ awerɛkyekyer no mu bi so nye no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na, enuanom, yɛmmpɛ dɛ yesiw hom hɛn ahohia a ɔbaa hɛn do wɔ Asia no do, dɛ ɔhyɛɛ hɛn do mbordo traa hɛn ahoɔdzen, ma hɛn enyi fii hɛn nkwa do mpo:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na hɛnankasa yɛtsee hɛn owu ne mfar wɔ hɛn mu, amma yaammfa hɛn werɛ anntwer hɛnho, na mbom yɛdze atwer Nyankopɔn a onyan ewufo no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Ɔno na oyii hɛn fii dɛm owu kɛse yi mu, na ɔda ho yi hɛn, na yɛwɔ enyidado dɛ ɔbɛda ho eyi hɛn;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: hom so dze hom nkotoserɛ roboa hɛn bi a, ma akyɛdze a wɔnam dodow do dze ama hɛn no ntsi, nyimpa pii aada ase ama hɛn.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɛn ahohyehyɛ nye yi, hɛn tsibowa ne dasedzi, dɛ Nyankopɔn krɔnkrɔnyɛ nye botooyɛ mu, nnyɛ honam mu nyansa mu, na mbom Nyankopɔn adom mu, na yɛnam bɔɔ hɛn bra wɔ wiadze, nkanka wɔ hom ntamu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yɛnnkyerɛw biribi mmbrɛ hom kyɛn dza hom kenkan na hom tse ase, na m’enyi da do dɛ hom bɛtse ase dze ekesi ewiei;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: dɛ mbrɛ so hom tse hɛn ase fa na fa dɛ yɛyɛ hom ahohyehyɛ, dɛ mbrɛ hom so yɛ hɛndze wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus da no mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na dɛm awerɛhyɛmu yi mu na mepɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ mebɛba hom nkyɛn ana, ama hom eenya adom mbɔho,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na mabɛfa hom nkyɛn akɔ Masidonia, na mefi Masidonia aba hom nkyɛn bio, na hom eegya me kwan ma maakɔ Judea.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi mobɔɔ me tsirmu dɛm no, midzii adwenharsɛm anaa? Anaa me tsirmu a mobɔ no, mobɔ no honam mu na m’asɛm kor no ara ayɛ nyew, nyew, nye oho, oho anaa?
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn yɛ nokwafo no, hɛn asɛm a yɛka kyerɛ hom nnyɛ nyew nye oho.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn ba Jesus Kraest a yɛbɛkaa no ho asɛm wɔ hom mu no, emi nye Silvanus nye Timoti, ɔnnyɛ nyew nye oho, na no mu mbom na nyew no wɔ.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn abɔ anohoba dodow dɛn ara a, no mu na nyew wɔ, na iyi ntsi na no mu na Amen wɔ, ma wɔnam hɛn do hyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia oetsim hɛn nye hom wɔ Kraest mu, na ɔasera hɛn, nye Nyankopɔn no:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: ɔno so na ɔasɔw hɛn ano, na ɔama hɛn Sunsum no ne nsewhyɛ wɔ hɛn akoma mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na mefrɛ Nyankopɔn dɛ ombedzi me kra dase dɛ memmpɛ dɛ mohow hom werɛ ntsi na mammba Korinte bio no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Nnyɛ dɛ yɛyɛ hom gyedzi do ahyɛdofo, na mbom yɛyɛ hom enyigye aboafo: osiandɛ gyedzi na hom dze tsim.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na mobɔɔ me tsirmu pɔw dɛ meremmfa awerɛhow mmba hom nkyɛn bio.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ mohow hom werɛ a, woana na ɔma m’enyi gye, dɛ nyia mohow no werɛ no ara?
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na merekyerɛw hom iyi ara amma meba a meemmbenya awerɛhow wɔ hɔn a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔma me enyigye no ho, na mo werɛ wɔ hom nyina mu dɛ m’enyigye yɛ hom nyina so hom enyigye.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na mifi akoma mu ahohiahia nye ahoguan pii mu, menam nyinsuwa pii mu kyerɛɛw hom, nnyɛ dɛ hom werɛ nhow bi a, na mbom ama hom eehu ɔdɔ a modɔ hom mbordo no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ obi ahyɛ awerɛhow a, nnyɛ emi na ɔahow mo werɛ na n’afa bi mu ɔahow hom nyina hom werɛ (amma maannsoa hom dza ɔyɛ dur dodow).
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na nkaenyim a dodow no dze aka nyimpa no enyim no dɔɔ so ma no,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: ma afei mbom ɔsɛ dɛ hom dze kyɛ no na hom kyekye no werɛ, aannyɛ a nna hom ama obi a ɔtse dɛm no n’awerɛhow dodow amen no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi meserɛ hom, hom mma hom dɔ nsi pi mma no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na iyi ntsi na mekyerɛwee, ama meenya hom ho dase papa dɛ hom yɛ setsie wɔ adze nyina mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Onyia a hom dze biribi kyɛ no no, mo so medze kyɛ no, na sɛ medze biribi akyɛ a, hom ntsi na medze akyɛ wɔ Kraest enyim;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: amma Satan eenndzi hɛn enyim annkɛyɛ biribi: osiandɛ yenyim mbrɛ n’akwan tse.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Ber a mebaa Troas wɔ Kraest asɛmpa no ntsi no, Ewuradze buee abow maa me,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: naaso mennya mo sunsum mu enyigye, osiandɛ mennhu mo nua Titus wɔ hɔ; na mekraa hɔn fii hɔ kɔr Masidonia.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na ndaase nka Nyankopɔn a ɔdze hɛn to no nkonyimsantsen wɔ Kraest mu daa no, na ɔnam hɛn do yi ne nyimdzee ho nka huam kyerɛ wɔ mbea nyina no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yɛyɛ Kraest Jesus ne nka huam ma Nyankopɔn ma hɔn a wɔregye hɔn nkwa nye hɔn a wɔrehera nyina:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: binom, yɛyɛ owu ho hua dze kɔ owu mu ma hɔn; na binom so, yɛyɛ nkwa ho hua dze kɔ nkwa mu ma hɔn. Na woana na ɔfata yinom?
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɛn dze, yɛnntse dɛ pii a wɔdze Nyankopɔn asɛm yɛ eguadzi, na mbom ofi nokwardzi mu, ofi Nyankopɔn mu, na yɛkasa wɔ Kraest mu wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Ana iyi kyerɛ dɛ yɛahyɛ ase bio riyi hɛnho ayɛw anaa? Anaa yehia nkamfo nwoma a yɛdze brɛ hom, anaa ofi hom nkyɛn ba, dɛ mbrɛ binom hia no a?
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Hom nye hɛn nwoma a wɔakyerɛw no wɔ hɛn akoma mu a nyimpa nyina hu na wɔkenkan;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na hom da edzi dɛ hom yɛ Kraest Jesus nwoma a ɔnam hɛn som do a wɔammfa dubir, na mbom wɔdze Nyankopɔn tseasefo no Sunsum kyerɛwee, nnyɛ abopon do, na mbom nyimpa n’akomapon do a.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na dɛm awerɛhyɛmu yi na yɛnam Kraest do enya no Nyankopɔn afamu;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: nnyɛ dɛ hɛnara na yɛso yɛ, dɛ yebu biribi dɛ ofi hɛnankasa hɛn mu; na mbom hɛn emudzi no fi Nyankopɔn;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: ɔno so na ɔama yetum yɛ ahyɛmu fofor no ho asomfo, nnyɛ nkyerɛwee ho dze bi a, na mbom sunsum dze a: na nkyerɛwee dze ɔma owu, na sunsum na ɔma nkwa.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ owu som a wɔkyerɛwee krukyee no wɔ abo do no nyaa enyimnyam, ma Israelmba enntum anngyen enyi annhwɛ Moses enyim wɔ n’enyim enyimnyam a orutwa mu ntsi a,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: ɔbɛyɛ dɛn koraa na sunsum som no rinnya enyimnyam?
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ afɔbu som no yɛ enyimnyam a, mpɛn ahen na tsenenee som no mbom bor do pii wɔ enyimnyam mu?
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Mpo dza wɔahyɛ no enyimnyam no nnyi enyimnyam wɔ iyi afamu, osian enyimnyam no a ɔkyɛn no ntsi.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ dza otwa mu no mpo nam enyimnyam mu a, nna dza otsim hɔ no dze ɔwɔ enyimnyam pii.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yɛwɔ dɛm enyidado ntsi, yɛyɛ ɔkasa mu ndam pii,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na yɛnnyɛ dɛ Moses a ɔdze nkataenyim kataa n’enyim ma Israelmba eenntum anngyen hɔn enyi annhwɛ enyimnyam a orutwa mu no n’ewiei:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na mbom wofuraa hɔn adwen, na mpo, ɔdze bodu ndɛ nkataenyim kor no ara da ho wɔ ahyɛmu dadaw no ne kenkan do a wonnya nnyii, osiandɛ Kraest mu (nko) na woyi.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na ɔdze bodu ndɛ yi ara mpo, sɛ aber biara wɔkenkan Moses nwoma no a, nkataenyim da ho wɔ hɔn akoma do.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ aber biara wɔdan ba Ewuradze nkyɛn a, woyi nkataenyim no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na afei Ewuradze nye Sunsum no, na mbrɛ Ewuradze Sunsum wɔ na fahodzi wɔ.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɛn nyina, yɛdze enyim a wɔnnkataa do rekyerɛ Ewuradze enyimnyam no dɛ yɛrohwɛ ahwehwɛ mu, wɔsakyer hɛn kɔ subea kor no ara bi mu, fi enyimnyam mu kɔ enyimnyam mu, na iyi fi Ewuradze no sunsum no ara.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, dɛ ɔnam Nyankopɔn n’ehumbɔbɔr do na wɔdze ɔsom a ɔtse dɛm ahyɛ hɛn nsa yi, yɛmmpa abaw:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na mbom yɛapow enyimguase ndzɛmba a yɛdze suma no, yɛmmbɔ hɛn bra akɔhwi mu, eso yɛmmfa ndaadaa mmfora Nyankopɔn asɛm mu, na nokwar no ara na yɛnam do petee dze yi hɛnho kyerɛ nyimpa nyina wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ hɛn asɛmpa no do kata a, ɔkata wɔ hɔn a wɔrehera no mu,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: hɔn mu na wiadze yi nyame efura hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi no adwen, amma woeennhu Kraest a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn suban no n’asɛmpa enyimnyam ne kan no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na nnyɛ hɛn ho asɛm na yɛka, na mbom Kraest Jesus a, dɛ Ewuradze, na hɛnankasa so dze, dɛ Jesus ntsi yɛyɛ hom nkowaa.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔkaa dɛ kan mfi sum mu nhyerɛn no na ɔahyerɛn wɔ hɛn akoma mu dɛ ɔrema Nyankopɔn enyimnyam a ɔwɔ Jesus Kraest enyim no no ho nyimdzee no ne kan no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yɛwɔ akoradze yi wɔ dɛtse nkɔɔpow mu, ama tum no ne kɛseyɛ a ɔtra do no eefir Nyankopɔn na emmfir hɛn:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: wofi mbeambea hiahia hɛn ho, na wɔmmem hɛn; hɛn ho kyer hɛn, na hɛn enyidado mmpa;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: wɔtaa hɛn do, na eso wɔmmpa hɛn ekyir; woekruw hɛn ahwe ase, na eso wɔnnsɛɛ hɛn:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: daa yɛso Jesus no wu wɔ hɛn nyimpadua mu nam, ama Jesus no nkwa so aada edzi wɔ hɛn nyimpadua mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɛn a yɛtse ase yi, woyi hɛn ma owu daa, ama Jesus no nkwa so aada edzi wɔ hɛn wu honam yi mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi owu dzi dwuma wɔ hɛn mu, na nkwa so dzi dwuma wɔ hom mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yɛwɔ gyedzi sunsum kor no ara, dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Megyee dzii ntsi na mekasae yi, hɛn so yɛgye dzi na ne ntsi so yɛkasa;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na yenyim dɛ nyia onyaan Ewuradze Jesus no, obenyan hɛn so nye Jesus, na oeyi hɛn nye hom akyerɛ.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na iyi nyina hom ntsi a, na adom no aadɔɔ so edua nyimpa pii do ama ndaase a ɔbor do aaka Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi yɛmmpa abaw. Kaansa hɛn nyimpadua a enyiwa hu yi roprɔw mpo a, hɛn nyimpasu a enyi nnhu no dan fofor daa daa.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɛn sesei ahohia harhar yi, risiesie onnyiewiei enyimnyam a ɔso bor do koraa ama hɛn,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: ber a yɛnnhwɛ ndzɛmba a wohu, na mbom yɛhwɛ dza wonnhu no: osiandɛ ndzɛmba a wohu no nnkyɛr na etwa mu, na dza wonnhu no na onnyi ewiei.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yenyim dɛ sɛ wonya gura hɛn asaase ntamadan fi yi a, yɛwɔ ofi a ofir Nyankopɔn, ɔdan a wɔammfa nsa ennsi, a ɔwɔ hɔ daa, wɔ sor.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na iyi mu so na yesi nkrum na hɛn enyi gyina dɛ wɔdze hɛn fie a ofi sor no so bɛhyɛ hɛn.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ ɔba dɛ yenya hyɛ a, wonnkohu hɛn dɛ yedzi adagyaw.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɛn a yɛtsetse ntamadan yi mu no, yesi nkrum na ɔhyɛ hɛn do: nnyɛ dɛ yɛpɛ dɛ wɔpa hɛn ho tam bi a, na mbom dɛ yɛbɛhyɛ so egu do a, ama nkwa aamen dza owu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia oesiesie hɛn ama iyiara nye Nyankopɔn a ɔnoara ama hɛn Sunsum no ne nsewhyɛ no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yɛwɔ akokodur daa, na yenyim dɛ yɛtse fie wɔ nyimpadua no mu yi, yɛadɔ mu efi Ewuradze nkyɛn
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na yɛnantsew gyedzi mu, na nnyɛ dza enyi tua mu a;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: medɛ, yɛwɔ dɛm awerɛhyɛmu yi, na yɛpɛ dɛ yɛdɔ mu fi nyimpadua fie yi mu, na yɛkɔ fie wɔ Ewuradze nkyɛn.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi na yɛbɔ mbɔdzen dɛ yɛwɔ nyimpadua fie o, yɛwɔ ndɔmu o, yɛbɔsɔ n’enyi.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na otwar dɛ wɔdze hɛn pue Kraest atsɛmbu egua no enyim hɔ, ama obiara eenya dza ɔayɛ no nyimpadua yi mu no, dɛ ɔyɛ papa o, bɔn o.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yenyim Ewuradze ho suro ntsi, yɛbɔ mbɔdzen dɛ yɛbɛma nyimpa ehu no dɛm, na Nyankopɔn dze, yɛada edzi ama no, na m’enyi da do dɛ yɛada edzi ama hom tsibowa so.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yennyi hɛnho ayɛw nnkyerɛ hom bio, na mbom yɛrema hom dza hom nam do bɛhyehyɛ homho wɔ hɛn afamu, na hom eenya biribi ebua hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ hɔnho enyiwado, na nnyɛ akoma mu no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ yeegyim mpo a, yeegyim ama Nyankopɔn, na sɛ hɛn enyi da hɔ a, ɔda ma hom.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na Kraest dɔ kenyan hɛn, osiandɛ yebu no dɛ, sɛ ɔbaako wui maa hɔn nyina, nna hɔn nyina wui;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na owui maa hɔn nyina ma hɔn a wɔtse ase aannda ho anntsena ase amma hɔnankasa hɔnho, na mbom wɔaatsena ase ama nyia osiaan hɔn ntsi owui na ɔsoɛɛr bio no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi ofir ndɛ yennyim obiara wɔ honam afamu, na sɛ yeehu Kraest wɔ honam afamu mpo a, afei dze yennyim no dɛm bio.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ obi wɔ Kraest mu a, ɔyɛ abɔdze fofor: ndzɛmba adadaw no etwa mu, na hwɛ, ndzɛmba nyina ayɛ fofor.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na iyi nyina fir Nyankopɔn a ɔnam Kraest do aka hɛn nye nankasa noho abɔ mu, na ɔdze nkabɔmu som dwumadzi no ama hɛn no;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: ɔno nye dɛ Nyankopɔn nam Kraest mu kaa wiadze nye nankasa bɔɔ mu, na oemmbu hɔn mfom enngu hɔn do, na ɔdze nkabɔmu som ho dwumadzi no ahyɛ hɛn nsa.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi yɛyɛ ananmusifo ma Kraest, ɔno nye dɛ Nyankopɔn nam hɛn do rototɔ serɛ hom: yegyina Kraest ananmu serɛ hom dɛ, Hom nye Nyankopɔn nka mbɔ mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia onnyim bɔn no, ɔyɛɛ no ɔbɔn maa hɛn, ama wɔaayɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn tsenenee wɔ no mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛ yɛyɛ nkorɔfo a yɛnye no bɔ mu yɛ edwuma yi, yɛtotɔ serɛ hom dɛ mma hom nngye Nyankopɔn adom no kwa,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na Nyankopɔn ka dɛ, Ber a ɔsɛ mu na mitsiee wo, Na nkwagye da no moboaa wo: hwɛ, sesei nye ber a ɔsɛ; na sesei nye nkwagye da no!
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Yɛmmpɛ dɛ yɛto obiara fintsidua biara wɔ biribiara a yɛyɛ mu, amma woeennhu mfom bi wɔ hɛn som no ho;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na mbom adze nyina mu hom mma yɛnda hɛnho edzi dɛ Nyankopɔn asomfo, wɔ abotar pii mu, wɔ ahohia mu, wɔ ahokyer mu, wɔ ahomtsew mu,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: ɔhwe mu, efiadzenda mu, etutuw mu, ndwumadzen mu, epesi mu, mbuadadzi mu,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: ahotsew mu, nyimdzee mu, penkyɛr mu, ayamuyie mu, Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu, ɔdɔ a ndabraba nnyi mu mu,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: nokwasɛm no mu, Nyankopɔn tum mu, tsenenee akodze mu wɔ bankum nye nyimfa,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: wɔ enyimnyam nye enyimguase mu, wɔ atsenka bɔn nye atsenka pa mu; dɛ esisifo naaso anokwafo;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: dɛ hɔn a wonnyim hɔn, naaso wonyim hɔn yie; dɛ hɔn a woruwu, na hwɛ, yɛtse ase; dɛ hɔn a wɔtsea hɔn, naaso wonnku hɛn;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: dɛ awerɛhofo naaso hɛn enyi gye daa; dɛ ehiafo naaso yɛma pii nya hɔnho; dɛ wonnyi hwee, naaso yɛwɔ adze nyina.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: O Korintefo, yɛakasa pefee akyerɛ hom, yeebue hɛn akoma mu ama hom.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Nnyɛ hɛn mu na hom kyer, na mbom homankasa hom akɔndɔ mu na hom kyer.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na hom so mekasa kyerɛ hom dɛ mbofra, hom mbue hom akoma mu mma hɛn dɛ mbrɛ yɛayɛ yi.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Mma hom nnye hɔn a wɔnngye nndzi nnya nkitahodzi kor: na nkitahodzi bɛn na tsenenee nye emumuyɛ wɔ? Anaa anyɛnkoyɛ bɛn na kan nye sum wɔ?
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na ebɛn fɛkuwbɔ na Kraest nye Belial wɔ? Anaa kyɛfa bɛn na gyedzinyi nye dza ɔnngye nndzi wɔ?
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na edziesie bɛn na Nyankopɔn asɔrfi nye abosom wɔ? Na hɛn dze, yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn tseasefo n’asɔrfi; dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn aka dɛ, Mebɛtsena hɔn mu, na manantsew hɔn mu, na mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn, na hɔn so ayɛ me man.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi Hom mfi hɔn mu mbra na hom ntsew homho, Ewuradze na ɔse, Amma hom annka efifidze; Na mebɛgye hom,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na mayɛ Egya ama hom, Na hom ayɛ me mbabanyin nye mbabaa, Ewuradze Tumfo na ɔse.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Yɛwɔ dɛm anohoba yi ntsi, adɔfo, hom mma yɛnhohor hɛnho mfi honam nye sunsum mu fi nyina ho, na yenwie krɔnkrɔnyɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn ho suro mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Hom mbue hom akoma mu mma hɛn: yɛannyɛ obiara bɔn, yɛannsɛɛ obiara, yeennsisi obiara.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Mennka yi mmbu hom fɔ, na maka dada dɛ, yewu o, yɛtse ase o, hom wɔ hɛn akoma mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Medze hom tuw kɛse, mowɔ hom mu awerɛhyɛmu so, awerɛkyekyer ahyɛ me ma, wɔ hɛn ahohia nyina mu no, me dɛw bu do pii.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yɛbaa Masidonia mpo, hɛn honam ennya ahomgye bi, na wohiahiaa hɛn ho afa nyina: ɔko etwa hɛn ho ehyia na suro ahyɛ hɛn mu ma.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Naaso nyia ɔkyekye abrɛfo werɛ no nye Nyankopɔn, ɔnam Titus ne mbae do kyekyee hɛn werɛ:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na nnyɛ ne mbae nko, na awerɛkyekyer a no werɛ kyekyee wɔ hom mu so; ɔkaa mbrɛ hom esi afe me nye hom nkɔmbɔdzi nye hom mbɔdzembɔ a ɔwɔ mo ho kyerɛɛ me maa m’enyi gyee pii.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ medze nwoma bɔhoow hom werɛ a, munnu moho, sɛ munuu moho mpo a; na muhu dɛ nwoma no, sɛ mber tsiabaa bi mpo a, ɔhoow hom werɛ.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na afei dze, midzi dɛw, nnyɛ dɛ hom werɛ howee ntsi a, na dɛ hom werɛ howee kɔr nnuho mu; na hom werɛ hoow Nyankopɔn kwan do, amma hom aannhwer hɛn ho biribi.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn kwan do awerɛhow dze, ɔyɛ nnuho a wɔdze kɔ nkwagye mu a wonnu ho wɔ ho, na wiadze awerɛhow dze, ɔma owu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na hwɛ, hom werɛ a ɔhoow Nyankopɔn do yi ara, ebɛn nhwɛyie na ɔayɛ wɔ hom mu, ebɛn anoyi, ebɛn ebufuwyi, ebɛn ehubɔ, ebɛn fe, ebɛn mbɔdzembɔ, ebɛn awerdzi! Adze nyina mu hom kyerɛɛ dɛ hom ho tsew wɔ asɛm no mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ mekyerɛwee brɛɛ hom a, nnyɛ nyia ɔyɛɛ bɔn no ntsi a, eso nnyɛ nyia wɔyɛɛ no bɔn no ntsi a, na mbom ɔno nye dɛ hom nhwɛyie a hom hwɛ hɛn ho bɛda edzi ama hom wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hɛn werɛ akyekye, na hɛn awerɛkyekyer mu hɛn enyi gyee mbordo wɔ Titus n’enyigye no ho, osiandɛ hom nyina adwedwe no sunsum.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Osiandɛ sɛ medze hom hyehyɛɛ moho kyerɛɛ no a, m’enyi annto, na mbom, mbrɛ yɛkaa asɛm nyina kyerɛɛ hom nokwar mu no, dɛmara na hɛn ahohyehyɛ a yɛhyehyɛɛ hɛnho wɔ Titus enyim ayɛ nokwar.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na n’akoma wɔ hom do pii, dɛ ɔkaa hom nyina hom setsie, mbrɛ hom dze hu nye ahopopo gyee no no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Midzi dɛw dɛ adze nyina mu no mowɔ hom mu awerɛhyɛmu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na eso enuanom, yɛma hom ehu Nyankopɔn adom a ɔdze adom Masidonia asɔrasɔr:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: mbrɛ hɔn ahohia nsɔhwɛ kɛse mu hɔn dɛw mbordo nye hɔn hia dodow no buu do kyerɛɛ hɔn ayamuyie ahonya.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na midzi hɔn ho dase dɛ wɔmaa dɛ mbrɛ wobotum, mpo dza ɔtra hɔn ahoɔdzen, a ofi hɔnara hɔn pɛ mu,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na wɔtotɔe serɛɛ pii dɛ wobenya kyɛfa wɔ hɔn som a wɔdze som ahotseweefo no wɔ adɔyɛ ho;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na nnyɛ dɛ iyi yɛ biribi a hɛn enyi daa do a, na mbom wɔnam Nyankopɔn ne pɛ do dzii kan dze hɔnankasa hɔnho maa Ewuradze, na afei wɔdze hɔnho maa hɛn so.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na iyi ntsi yɛserɛɛ Titus dɛ, dɛ mbrɛ ɔhyɛɛ ase kan no, onwie adɔyɛ yi dɛmara wɔ hom so mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ hom bor do wɔ adze nyina mu no, gyedzi, nye asɛm, nye nyimdzee, nye mbɔdzembɔ, nye hom dɔ a ɔwɔ hɛn do no, hom nhwɛ dɛ hom bɔbor do wɔ adom yi so mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na mennka yi wɔ nhyɛ do, na mbom medze binom mbɔdzembɔ rosɔ hom dɔ no nokwar ahwɛ.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na hom nyim hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest n’adom, dɛ ɔyɛ ɔhonyanyi, naaso hom ntsi ɔbɛyɛɛ ohianyi, ama hom nam ne hia do aayɛ ahonyafo.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na m’adwen na mekyerɛ wɔ iyi mu, dɛ iyi na ɔfata hom, nnyɛ nyɛe nko bi, na ɔpɛ mu so, hom dzii kan hyɛɛ ase mfeda.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na afei hom nwie ne nyɛɛ no so, dɛ mbrɛ hom ayɛ krado wɔ ɔpɛ mu, no wie so aayɛ dɛmara, dɛ mbrɛ hom botum.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ ɔpɛ mu dze obi yɛ krado a, enyisɔ wɔ mu dɛ mbrɛ obi wɔ, na nnyɛ mbrɛ onnyi bi a.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na mennka yi ama binom ho aadwe hɔn, na hom dze hom ho eeguan hom,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na dɛ ɔnyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛr ntsi a; ama dɛm ber yi mu hom mbordo no aakɔhwɛ hɔn hia, na hɔn so hɔn mbordo aabɔhwɛ hom hia, na aayɛ pɛpɛɛpɛr:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw dɛ, Onyia ɔtasee pii ennya ma aammbor no do, na nyia ɔtasee kakrabaa so, ennhia no hwee.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na ndaase nka Nyankopɔn a ɔdze hom ho mbɔdzembɔ kor yi ara ahyɛ Titus n’akoma mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na otsiee hɛn afotu dze, naaso noara no mbɔdzembɔ kyɛn dɛm ntsi, ɔnam nankasa ne pɛ do baa hom nkyɛn.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yɛsomaa ɔno nye onua no a ne nkamfo wɔ asɛmpa no mu atahye wɔ asɔr nyina mu no;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na nnyɛ dɛm nko, ɔno na asɔrmba no eyi no dɛ ɔnye hɛn nnantsew wɔ adɔyɛ yi a yɛrosom ho yi mfa nkyerɛ Ewuradze n’enyimnyam nye hɛnara so hɛn mbɔdzembɔ kɛse no:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na yɛda hɛnho do amma obi eennya hɛn ho asɛm bi wɔ adze dodow a yɛrosom ho yi ho:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na yɛdwen dza ɔyɛ enyidzi ho sie, nnyɛ Nyankopɔn enyim nko, na mbom nyimpa enyim so.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yɛasoma hɛn nua a yeenya no nhunii dɛ ɔbɔ mbɔdzen wɔ ndzɛmba pii mu, na afei osian awerɛhyɛmu kɛse a oenya no hom mu ntsi, ɔbɔ mbɔdzen bor do.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Titus ho a, ɔyɛ me nyɛnko nye me nyɛnko dwumadzifo ma hom; hɛn nuanom ho a, wɔyɛ asɔr asomafo, Kraest enyimnyam.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nyi hom dɔ nye ahohyehyɛ a yɛhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ hom ho ne dasee nkyerɛ hɔn wɔ asɔrasɔr enyim.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na ahotseweefo som no ho dze, onnhia dɛ mekyerɛw mebrɛ hom;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: osiandɛ minyim hom mbɔdzembɔ a medze hyehyɛ moho kyerɛ Masidoniafo, dɛ Akaia siesiee hɔnho afrenhyia nye yi, na hom mbɔdzembɔ yi ekenyan hɔn mu piinara.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na masoma enuanom no, ama hɛn ahohyehyɛ a ɔwɔ hom ho aannyɛ kwa wɔ iyi afamu, na dɛ mbrɛ mekaa no, hom eesiesie homho;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na bi a Masidoniafo bi nye hɛn bɛba, na sɛ wɔbɔto hom dɛ hom nnsiesiee homho a, hɛn (yɛnnka dɛ hom), hɛn enyi aannto wɔ dɛm ahohyehyɛ yi mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi modween dɛ ohia dɛ meserɛ enuanom no dɛ wondzi kan wɔ hom nkyɛn mbɔboaboa hom akyɛdze a wɔabɔ hom nkaa esie no ano ngu hɔ, na ɔaada hɔ dɛ akyɛdze na nnyɛ epoobɔdze.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na dza meka nye dɛ, Nyia odua no kyenkyen mu no, obobu no kyenkyen mu, na nyia odua no bafuu no obobu no bafuu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ obiara esusu wɔ n’akoma mu, nnyɛ amemenemfe do, anaa nhyɛ do no ɔmma; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn dɔ nyia ɔtsew n’enyim dze ma.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn botum dɛ ɔma adom nyina bor do ma hom na adze nyina mu nye daa nyina hom eenya dza ɔdɔɔ so nyina, ama hom aabor do wɔ edwuma pa nyina mu:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ɔtow petse, ɔdze ma ehiafo; Ne tsenenee tsim hɔ daa.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia ɔdze aba ma oduafo, na ɔma paanoo dɛ edziban no, ɔbɛma hom aba a hom dua no adɔɔ so, na ɔama hom tsenenee eduaba adɔr;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na hom eenya hom ho wɔ ayamuyie nyina mu, dza ɔnam hɛn do yɛ ndaase ho edwuma ma Nyankopɔn no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Osiandɛ baguasom yi no som dze, nnyɛ dɛ wɔdze kɛhyɛ ahotseweefo no sintɔ ma nko, na ɔnam ndaase pii do bu do so ma Nyankopɔn;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na ɔnam ɔsom yi no nsɔhwɛ do wɔhyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ setsie a hom ka dɛ hom wɔ ma Kraest asɛmpa no, na ayamuyie ntoboa a hom yi boa hɔn nye nyimpa nyina ntsi;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na hɔn so woyi mpaa ma hom na wɔfe hom wɔ Nyankopɔn adom a ɔbor do wɔ hom do ntsi.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Ndaase nka Nyankopɔn wɔ n’akyɛdze a yenntum nnsusu no ntsi.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Afei emi mara Paul menam Kraest no dwe nye ne tsema do meserɛ hom, emi a mowɔ hom nkyɛn a mebrɛ moho adze wɔ hom enyim, na minnyi hom nkyɛn a, meyɛ dzendzenndzen no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Mepa hom kyɛw ara, mma hom nnyɛ ma meba hom nkyɛn a, mannyɛ ndam wɔ hom do; ndam a mususu dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ meyɛ wɔ hɔn a wobu hɛn dɛ yɛnam honam afamu no do no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na kaansa yɛnam honam mu a, yɛnnyɛ ɔsa wɔ honam mu
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: osiandɛ akodze a yɛdze ko no nnyɛ honam dze, na mbom ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn tum akodze a wɔdze dwuruw akoban; yedwuruw adwen;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: nye adze a ɔkrɔn biara a wɔma do tsia Nyankopɔn nyimdzee, na yɛfa adwen nyina ndɔmmum yɛ setsie ma Kraest;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na yeesiesie hɛnho dɛ, sɛ hom setsie wie pɛyɛ a, yɛbɔtɔ asoɔdzen nyina do wer.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Hom nhwɛ dza ɔda hom enyi do. Sɛ obi dze no werɛ twer nankasa noho dɛ ɔyɛ Kraest dze a, wɔmma onsusu iyi so wɔ nankasa no mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔno yɛ Kraest dze no, mbrɛ hɛn so yɛyɛ Kraest dze ara nye no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ mehyehyɛ moho mbordo wɔ tum a Ewuradze dze maa hɛn wɔ hom ntowdo na nnyɛ hom nsɛe ntsi no ho mpo a, m’enyi ronnto.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Memmpɛ dɛ ɔyɛ dɛ gyama medze nwoma rupuw hom bi.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Osiandɛ wɔse, No nwoma dze no mu yɛ dur, na okitsa tum ara yie, naaso sɛ ɔwɔ hɛn ntamu dze a, ɔyɛ mberɛw, na ne kasaa so ahoɔdzen biara nnyi mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Wɔmma onyia no nsusu dɛ, mbrɛ yennyi hɔ a yɛtse wɔ nwoma mu wɔ nsɛm mu no, yɛwɔ hɔ so a mbrɛ yɛtse wɔ nyɛe mu ara nye no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yennsi hɛn bo mmfa hɛn ho mmfora, anaa yɛmmfa hɛnho nnto hɔn a wɔkamfo hɔnankasa hɔnho no ho; na hɔn dze, wɔdze hɔnho bu hɔnho, na wɔdze hɔnho toto hɔnankasa hɔnho ntsi, wonnyim nyansa.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na hɛn dze, yɛrennhyehyɛ hɛnho ntra do, na mbom dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn no susudua esusu ama hɛn kɛpem no, dɛm esusudze yi odu hom nkyɛn.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yɛnntwe hɛn mu nntra do dɛ gyama yenndu hom nkyɛn, osiandɛ yɛdze Kraest asɛmpa no ebodu hom nkyɛn mpo.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yɛnnhyehyɛ hɛnho nntra do wɔ binom edwuma mu, na mbom yɛwɔ enyidado dɛ, sɛ hom gyedzi nyin a, wɔbɛyɛ hɛn kɛse mbordo wɔ hom mu dɛ mbrɛ hɛn susudua kɛpem,
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na yɛakɛka asɛmpa no wɔ mbeambea a ɔwɔ hom ekyir noho, na yɛannhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ mbrɛ obi no dwumadzi pem wɔ dza woewie yɛ dada no ho.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyia ɔhyehyɛ noho, ma ɔnhyehyɛ noho wɔ Ewuradze mu:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na nnyɛ nyia ɔkamfo noho na wɔapen no no, mbom nyia Ewuradze kamfo no no a.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Ao, nkyɛ hom eesie abotar etsie me nkwaseasɛm kakra ae! Nyew, hom nya mo ho abotar.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na medze Nyankopɔn ho nyinkun twe hom ho nyinkun, dɛ magye hom awar ama ɔbarimba baako, dɛ medze hom dɛ ɔbaabun krɔnn rekɛma Kraest.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na musuro dɛ bɛyɛ na oedua biribi do dɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ no dze enyitsew daadaa Eve no, dɛmara so na wɔasɛɛ hom adwen efi nokwardzi nye krɔnnyɛ a hom wɔ wɔ Kraest afamu no ho.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ nyia ɔba no ka Jesus fofor bi ho asɛm a yɛnnkae, anaa hom nya sunsum fofor bi a hom nnyae, anaa asɛmpa fofor bi a hom nngyee a, ɔnodze hom suo mu ntsɛm.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na mubu dɛ mennka asomafo etsitsir no ekyir wɔ biribiara mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Kaansa meyɛ mberɛw wɔ kasa mu a, mennyɛ dɛm wɔ nyimdzee mu, na adze nyina mu yɛada iyi edzi wɔ nyimpa nyina mu wɔ hom afamu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Anaa bɔn na mayɛ dɛ mabrɛ moho adze ma wɔaama hom do, osiandɛ mebɛkaa hom Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no kwa?
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Mefaa asɔr binom hɔ adze dɛ akatua dɛ medze robɔsom hom;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na mowɔ hom nkyɛn na adze hiaa me no, mannyɛ adzesoa amma obi, na dza ohiaa me no, enuanom a wofi Masidonia bae no maa me nsa kae; na adze nyina mu mohwɛɛ moho dɛ mennkɛyɛ adzesoa ama hom, na dɛmara so na mobɔhwɛ.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Kraest no nokwar wɔ mo mu yi, obiara rinnsiw me kwan wɔ ahohyehyɛ yi ho wɔ Akaiaman no mu hɔ.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Ebɛnadze ntsi a? Dɛ monndɔ hom ntsi a? Nyankopɔn na onyim.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na dza meyɛ no, mebɛyɛ, na maamma hɔn a wɔrohwehwɛ mo ho kwan no ennya kwan, na woeehu hɔn wɔ dza wɔdze hyehyɛ hɔnho no mu dɛ hɛnara.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na dɛm nyimpa no, wɔyɛ asomafo atorfo, ndaadaa dwumadzifo, wɔdandan hɔnho Kraest asomafo.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na ɔnnyɛ nwanwa, osiandɛ Satan mpo dan noho dɛ kan bɔfo.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔnnyɛ adze kɛse bi dɛ n’asomfo so bɛdan hɔnho dɛ tsenenee asomfo: hɔn na hɔn ewiei bɛyɛ dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndwuma tse.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Meka bio dɛ, Mma obi mmbu me ɔkwasea, na sɛ ɔtse dɛm mpo a, hom ngye me dɛ ɔkwasea, na mo so menhyehyɛ moho kakra.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dza meka no, mennka no Ewuradze tum mu, na mbom ɔtse dɛ nkwaseasɛm, wɔ ahohyehyɛ mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Ɔnam dɛ piinara hyehyɛ hɔnho wɔ honam afamu ntsi, mo so mebɛhyehyɛ moho bi.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na hom dze enyigye gye nkwasea, hom a hom yɛ enyitseweefo.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ obi dze hom ba nkowaasom ase, sɛ ɔmen hom, sɛ ɔfa hom, sɛ ɔma noho do, sɛ ɔbɔ hom enyi do a, hom pen do ma no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Meka no enyimguase mu, dɛ gyama hɛn dze yɛyɛ mberɛw, naaso dza obi dze tuw no (merekasa dɛ mbrɛ aba biara nnyi mu), mo so medze tuw.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Wɔyɛ Hebriwfo? Mo so meyɛ bi. Wɔyɛ Israelfo? Mo so meyɛ bi. Wɔyɛ Abraham asefo? Mo so meyɛ bi.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Wɔyɛ Kraest asomfo? Merekasa dɛ ɔbɔdamfo, meyɛ no somfo kyɛn hɔn; ndwumadzen mu a, mbordo; efiadzenda mu a, mbordo; ɔhwe mu a, ntrado; owu mu a, mpɛn pii.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Jewfo nsamu mpɛn enum na magye mbaa eduanan a woyi do kor.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Wɔkaa me mpire mprɛnsa, wosiiw me abo prɛko, me hɛn abɔ wɔ po do mprɛnsa, medzi bun mu adzekyee nye adzesaa;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: akwantu pii mu, esutsen mu esian, edwotwafo nsamu esian, amanyimfo nsamu esian, amanamamfo nsamu esian, kurow mu esian, wiramu esian, po mu esian, enuanom atorfo mu esian;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: edwumayɛ nye ɔberɛ, epesi pii mu, ɔkɔm nye nsukɔm mu, akɔnkyen pii mu, awɔw nye adagyaw mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Iyinom nyina da nkyɛn a, dza ɔhyɛ mo do daa daa nye asɔrasɔr no nyina ho kɔdaannda.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Woana na ɔyɛ mberɛw na mennyɛ bi? Woana na wɔato no fintsidua na ɔnnhyehye me?
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Sɛ ɔsɛ dɛ mehyehyɛ moho a, dza medze bɛhyehyɛ moho nye dza ɔkyerɛ me mberɛwyɛ.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus ne Nyankopɔn nye n’Egya a wohyira no afebɔɔ no, nyim dɛ minndzi ator.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Damaskɔs, ɔhen Aretas n’ambrado weɔɔn Damaskɔsfo kurow no dɛ ɔrepɛ me akyer me;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na wɔdze me too birefi mu duaa tokura mu gyaagyaa me ban ho sii famu, na mifii ne nsa.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Mfaso biara nnyi ho mpo a ohia dɛ mehyehyɛ moho naaso mebɛka Ewuradze enyido adzehu nye nyikyerɛ no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Minyim nyimpa bi wɔ Kraest mu a mfe duanan nye yi wohwiim no kɔr ɔsor a otsia ebiasa no, (dɛm nyimpa no sɛ ɔwɔ honam mu o, onnyi honam mu o, minnyim, Nyankopɔn na onyim).
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na minyim dɛm nyimpa no (sɛ ɔwɔ honam mu o, okwetsir honam o, minnyim, Nyankopɔn na onyim),
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: dɛ wohwiim no kɔr Paradise, na ɔkɛtsee nsɛm a wɔnnka a nyimpa biara nnyi ho kwan dɛ ɔka.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm nyimpa no afamu na mebɛhyehyɛ moho, na mankasa m’afamu dze a, merennhyehyɛ moho, gyedɛ me mberɛwyɛ mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ mepɛ dɛ mehyehyɛ moho mpo a, nkyɛ mennkɛyɛ kwasea, na mebɛkasa nokwar; naaso migyaa yɛ, ama obi eemmbu me annkyɛn mbrɛ ohu me dɛ metse, anaa ɔtse wɔ m’anomu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na nyikyerɛ ntrado no ntsi amma maamma moho do anntra do, wɔmaa me honam mu nsoɛ, Satan no bɔfoe, dɛ ɔbobɔ me ekutuku, amma maamma moho do anntra do.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na iyi ntsi meserɛɛ Ewuradze mpɛn ebiasa dɛ ɔmma omfi mo do.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, M’adom dɔɔ so ma wo: na m’ahoɔdzen dzi mu wɔ wo mberɛwyɛ mu. Dɛm ntsi medze enyigye pii hyehyɛ moho mbom wɔ me mberɛwyɛ mu, ama Kraest ahoɔdzen aabɔsoɛ mo do.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi minya enyigye wɔ mberɛwyɛ mu, enyimguase mu, ahokyer mu, ntanenyi mu, ahomtsew mu, wɔ Kraest ntsi: na meyɛ mberɛw a, nna mbom meyɛ dzen.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Ana meyɛ kwasea? Nna homara na hom ahyɛ me ma mayɛ. Na emi dze, hom mbom na nkyɛ ɔsɛ dɛ hom kamfo me, osiandɛ sɛ mennsɛ hwee mpo a, woyinom a wɔyɛ asomafo ara ma ɔbor do yi nnkyɛn me wɔ biribiara mu.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Ampaara medze abotar daa ɔsomafo nsɛnkyerɛdze edzi wɔ hom mu; iyinom nye: nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze nye tum ndwuma.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na ebɛnadze mu na hom tɔɔ sin kyɛɛn asɔr nkaa no, gyama mankasa mannyɛ adzesoa amma hom no a? Nna hom mfa mo mfom yi nkyɛ me ɛ!
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Hwɛ, iyi nye mpɛn ebiasa a mesiesie moho reba hom nkyɛn, na meremmbɛyɛ adzesoa ama hom: na nnyɛ hom adze na morohwehwɛ, na mbom homankasa a: na nnyɛ mba na ɔsɛ dɛ wɔkora ma awofo, na awofo mbom na ɔsɛ dɛ wɔkora ma mba;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na emi dze, medze enyigye pii mobɔhwer adze, na mama wɔahwer me ama hom akra. Sɛ modɔ hom mbordo dɛm a, iyi ntsi na hom dɔ me dɔ a osuar yi?
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na bi a ɔwɔ mu dɛm: mannyɛ adzesoa amma hom, naaso meyɛ onyitsewfo ntsi medze nyansa mekyeer hom.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Aso menam hɔn a mosomaa hɔn no bi do medzi hom emim anaa?
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Meserɛɛ Titus, na mosomaa onua kaa no ho. Ana Titus bedzii hom emim bi? Ana nnyɛ Sunsum kor no ara mu na yɛnantsewee? Nnyɛ anamɔn kor no ara mu anaa?
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Mber yi nyina hom dwen dɛ yeriyi hɛn ano akyerɛ hom. Yɛkasa Kraest mu wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim. Na, adɔfo, iyi nyina homankasa hom kankɔ ntsi a.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na musuro dɛ bɛyɛ na meba a, mammbɔto hom dɛ mbrɛ mepɛ, na hom so ennhu me dɛ mbrɛ hom pɛ; bɛyɛ na bi a aperper, nyinkun, ebufuw, mpaapaamu, nsekubɔ, awasawasa, ɔhoran, etutuw wɔ hom mu;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: bɛyɛ so bio na meba a, Nyankopɔn abrɛbrɛ me adze wɔ hom afamu, ama meegyam piinara a wɔyɛɛ bɔn nkan no, na wonnuu hɔnho wɔ hɔn efifidze nye ndwamanyɛ, nye ahoɔdɛw a wɔyɛɛ no ho no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Mpɛn ebiasa nye yi a mereba hom nkyɛn. Adasefo beenu anaa baasa anomu na asɛm biara begyina.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Maka ana, na mereka no bio: mbrɛ mpɛn ebien a mowɔ hom nkyɛn mekae no, dɛmara na sesei a minnyi hom nkyɛn yi meka kyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛɛ bɔn nkan no, nye hɔn a wɔaka no nyina dɛ, sɛ meba bio a, minnkegyaa hom;
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: osiandɛ hom rohwehwɛ Kraest a ɔkasa mo mu no ho biribi ehu, ɔno na ɔnnyɛ mberɛw wɔ hom afamu, na mbom ɔyɛ tumfo wɔ hom mu:
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: na ɔnam mberɛw mu na wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu dze, naaso ɔnam Nyankopɔn tum do tse ase. Na hɛn so yɛyɛ mberɛw wɔ no mu dze, naaso ɔnam Nyankopɔn tum do yɛnye no bɛtsena ase wɔ hom ntsi.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Hom mpɛnsampɛnsa hom mu nhwɛ dɛ hom wɔ gyedzi no mu anaa; hom nsɔ homho nhwɛ. Anaa hom nnyim dɛ Jesus Kraest tse hom mu? Gyedɛ gyama hom mmfora.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na m’enyi da do dɛ hom bohu dɛ hɛn dze, yɛnnyɛ nyimpa a wɔmmfora.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yɛbɔ mpaa kyerɛ Nyankopɔn dɛ mma hom nnyɛ bɔn bi: nnyɛ dɛ ama woeehu hɛn dɛ yɛfora, na mbom ama hom aayɛ dza ɔyɛ fɛw, na hɛn dze, yaayɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔfora mpo.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na yenntum nnyɛ hwee nntsia nokwar no, na mbom yɛyɛ ma nokwar no.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Na sɛ yɛyɛ mberɛw ma hom yɛ dzen a, yedzi dɛw; iyiara so ntsi na yɛbɔ mpaa, hom emudzi a.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Iyiara ntsi na minnyi hom nkyɛn yi mekyerɛw iyi mebrɛ hom, na sɛ meba a, menye hom eemmbedzi no wenwennwen, dɛ mbrɛ tum a Ewuradze dze maa me wɔ ntowdo na nnyɛ ɔsɛɛ bi ntsi no tse.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Dza medze wie nye dɛ, enuanom, hom ndzi dɛw; hom ndzi mu; hom werɛ nkyekyer; hom nyɛ adwenkor; hom ntsena asomdwee mu; na ɔdɔ nye asomdwee Nyankopɔn nye hom bɛtsena.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Hom mfa mfewano krɔnkrɔn nkyiakyia homho.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Ahotseweefo no nyina kyiakyia hom.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest adom, Nyankopɔn no dɔ, nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn anyɛnkoyɛ nka hom nyina.
title: 2ND CORINTHIANS

text: Paul, ɔsomafo a ommfi nyimpa, eso ɔnnam nyimpa do na mbom ɔnam Jesus Kraest nye Nyankopɔn Egya a onyaan Kraest fii ewufo mu no do no,
title: GALATIANS

text: nye enuanom nyina a wɔwɔ me nkyɛn, dze kɛma asɔrasɔr a wɔwɔ Galatia nyina:
title: GALATIANS

text: Adom nye asomdwee a ofi Nyankopɔn Egya, nye hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nka hom.
title: GALATIANS

text: Ɔno a hɛn bɔn ntsi ɔdze noho mae, ama oeeyi hɛn efi sesei bɔn wiadze yi mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn ne pɛ tse,
title: GALATIANS

text: ɔno na enyimnyam nka no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
title: GALATIANS

text: Ɔyɛ me ahobow dɛ hom redan homho ntsɛm dɛm efi nyia ɔfrɛɛ hom wɔ Kraest Jesus adom mu no ho akɔ asɛmpa fofor bi mu a
title: GALATIANS

text: ɔnnyɛ asɛmpa fofor biara so, mbom binom wɔ hɔ a wɔretseetsee hom, na wɔrepɛ akyea Kraest asɛmpa no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na sɛ mpo hɛn anaa abɔfo bi fi sor bɛka hom asɛmpa fofor bi ka dza yɛaka akyerɛ hom no ho a, wɔmma mbusu nka no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ yeedzi kan aka no, dɛmara na misi do bio, sɛ obi bɛka hom asɛmpa fofor bi ka dza hom agye no ho a, mbusu nka no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na afei nyimpa na morohwehwɛ enyimpa efi no hɔ anaa Nyankopɔn a? Anaa morohwehwɛ dɛ mosɔ nyimpa enyi? Sɛ meda ho mosɔ nyimpa enyi a, nkyɛ mennyɛ Kraest akowaa.
title: GALATIANS

text: Enuanom, mepɛ dɛ hom hu dɛ asɛmpa no a meka no nnyɛ nyimpa dze.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na manngye no nyimpa hɔ, eso wɔannkyerɛkyerɛ me, na mbom ɔnam Jesus Kraest ne nyikyerɛ do na minyae.
title: GALATIANS

text: Hom atse nkan no m’abrabɔ wɔ Jewfo som no mu, mbrɛ misii tseetsee Nyankopɔn asɔr no mbordo, na mobɔɔ mbɔdzen dɛ mebɛsɛɛ no no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na mokɔr kan wɔ Jewfo som mu kyɛɛn m’etsipɛmfo dodowara, wɔ mankasa me man mu, na mobɔɔ m’egyanom atsetsesɛm ho mbɔdzen pii ma mpo ɔtraa do.
title: GALATIANS

text: Naaso ber a ɔsɔɔ Nyankopɔn a ɔsaan mu yii me sii nkyɛn ansaana wɔrowo me no n’enyi, na ɔnam n’adom do frɛɛ me no,
title: GALATIANS

text: dɛ obeyi ne ba akyerɛ wɔ mo mu, ama maakɛka no ho asɛmpa akyerɛ amanamamfo no, ntsɛmara menye honam nye bɔgya enntu egyina:
title: GALATIANS

text: eso mannkɔ Jerusalɛm wɔ hɔn a wodzii me kan yɛɛ asomafo no nkyɛn, na mokɔr Arabia na mebaa Damaskɔs bio.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na mfe ebiasa ekyir no, mokɔr Jerusalɛm kohun Peter n’enyim, na midzii ne nkyɛn dadu ndaenum.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na asomafo nkaa no dze, mennhu hɔn mu biara dɛ Ewuradze no nua James.
title: GALATIANS

text: Dza merekyerɛw hom yi, Nyankopɔn enyim, minndzi ator.
title: GALATIANS

text: N’ekyir na mebaa Siria nye Silisia afamu.
title: GALATIANS

text: Nna Kraest n’asɔrasɔr a wɔwɔ Judea no nnhun m’enyim da:
title: GALATIANS

text: na tse ara nna wɔatse dɛ, Nyia nkan no ɔtseetsee hɛn no, afei dze ɔreka gyedzi a ɔpeer dɛ ɔbɛsɛɛ no no ho asɛm papa.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na emi ntsi, wɔhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na mfe duanan ekyir no, mokɔr Jerusalɛm bio, emi nye Barnabas, na mefaa Titus so kaa hɛn ho.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na menam nyikyerɛ a minyae do mokɔree: medze asɛmpa no a mekaa no amanaman mu no too hɔn enyim, (nye hɔn a wɔwɔ dzin wɔ hɔn mu no nsumaa mu), amma m’edwuma a mayɛ na dza mugu do reyɛ no aannyɛ kwa.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na Titus a ɔka mo ho a ɔyɛ Griiknyi no mpo, wɔannhyɛ no dɛ ontwa twatsia.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na enuanom atorfo a wɔaba hɛn mu no, hɔn a wowiawiaa hɔnho baa mu dɛ wɔrebɛsɛɛ hɛn adehyedzi a yɛwɔ no Kraest mu, na wɔdze hɛn aaba nkowaasom mu no:
title: GALATIANS

text: hɔn dze, yɛammbrɛ hɛnho adze amma hɔn kwan dɔnhwer kor mpo, ama asɛmpa no no nokwar no aatsena hɔ wɔ hom afamu.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na hɔn a wobu hɔn dɛ wɔyɛ etsitsir no (sɛ wɔtse dɛn ara mpo a, ɔmmfa mo ho hwee, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ nyimpa enyim) dɛm nkorɔfo a wɔse wɔwɔ dzin yi ammfa biribiara ammboa me:
title: GALATIANS

text: na mbom wohun dɛ wɔdze monomonomfo mu asɛmpaka ahyɛ me nsa, dɛ mbrɛ wɔdze twatsiafo mu dze ama Peter;
title: GALATIANS

text: (na nyia ɔnam Peter do yɛɛ edwuma maa twatsiafo mu asomafosom no, ɔnam mo so do yɛɛ edwuma maa amanamamfo no);
title: GALATIANS

text: na wohun adom a wɔdze adom me no, James, Sefaas, nye John a wobuu hɔn dɛ wɔyɛ fadum no, tseen anyɛnkoyɛ nsa nyimfa maa emi nye Barnabas, dɛ hɛn yɛnkɔ amanamamfo hɔ, na hɔn so wɔnkɔ hɔn woetwa hɔn twatsia no hɔ,
title: GALATIANS

text: mbom dza wɔdze too hɛn adwen do ara nye dɛ daa yɛnkaa abɔbɔfo; na ɔno so ara mpo nye adze a nna osi m’enyi do pɛpɛɛpɛ dɛ mebɛyɛ.
title: GALATIANS

text: Mbom aber a Sefaas baa Antiok no, mekasaa n’enyim osiandɛ ɔdaa edzi pefee dɛ ɔafom.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na ansaana binom a wofi James hɔ rebɛba no, nna ɔnye amanamamfo no dzidzii, na wɔbae no, ɔtwee noho tseew noho fii hɔn nkyɛn, amma hɔn a wofi twatsiafo mu no eenya biribi enntsia no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na Jewfo nkaa no so nye no yɛɛ dɛm ndabraba no, na hɔn ndabraba no twee Barnabas so kɛkaa hɔn ho.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na muhun dɛ wɔrennantsew tɔɔtsen dɛ mbrɛ asɛmpa no nokwar no tse no, mekaa kyerɛɛ Peter wɔ hɔn nyina enyim dɛ, Sɛ ɔwo a eyɛ Jewnyi ebɔ wo bra dɛ amanamannyi na ennyɛ dɛ Jewnyi a, ɔyɛ dɛn na ehyɛ amanamamfo dɛ wɔnyɛ dɛ Jewfo?
title: GALATIANS

text: Hɛn dze, yefi hɛn awoo mu yɛ Jewfo, na yɛnnyɛ amanaman mu ndzebɔnyɛfo bi naaso,
title: GALATIANS

text: nyim dɛ wonndua mbra ndwuma do na wobu nyimpa bem, na mbom ɔnam Jesus Kraest gyedzi mu no, hɛn mpo yɛgyee Jesus Kraest dzii, ma wɔnam Kraest mu gyedzi do eebu hɛn bem, na nnyɛ mbra ndwuma mu a, osiandɛ worunndua mbra ndwuma do mbu nyimpa biara bem.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na yɛrohwehwɛ dɛ wobu hɛn bem wɔ Kraest mu yi, na wohu hɛn dɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo a, nna Kraest yɛ ndzeyɛɛbɔn somfo anaa? Atserkwa!
title: GALATIANS

text: Na sɛ motow dza mudwuruwii no bio a, nna mekyerɛ moho dɛ mbratonyi.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na emi dze, ɔnam mbra do muwui maa mbra, ama maatsena ase ama Nyankopɔn.
title: GALATIANS

text: Wɔabɔ emi nye Kraest mbeamudua mu; naaso metse ase; na nnyɛ emi a, na Kraest na ɔtse mo mu: na ase a metse wɔ honam mu yi, metse no Nyankopɔn Ba a ɔdɔɔ me na ɔdze noho maa me no ne gyedzi mu.
title: GALATIANS

text: Memma Nyankopɔn n’adom no nnyɛ kwa: na sɛ mbra no na obu hɛn bem dze a, nna Kraest no wu no ayɛ gyan.
title: GALATIANS

text: O Galatiafo adwenmuharfo! Woana ara tumii daadaa hom dɛm? Hom ampaara a wɔdze Jesus Kraest a wɔbɔɔ no mbeamudua mu no esi hom enyim pɔkyee akyerɛ mo no nye yi?
title: GALATIANS

text: Dza mepɛ dɛ metse fi hom anomu ara nye dɛ, Ana hom nam mbra ndwuma no do nyaa Sunsum no, anaa hom nam gyedzi asɛm a hom tsee no do?
title: GALATIANS

text: Ana hom yɛ adwenhar dɛm a? Hom hyɛɛ ase wɔ Sunsum mu a, afei ɔyɛ dɛn na hom ruwie no honam mu yi?
title: GALATIANS

text: Ntsi hom ehu amandze pii yi gyan? Aso ampa dɛ enya ayɛ gyan a?
title: GALATIANS

text: Ana nyia ɔdze Sunsum no ma hom, na ɔyɛ tum ndwuma wɔ hom mu no, ɔnam mbra ndwuma do na ɔyɛ, anaa ɔnam gyedzi asɛmpa a hom tsee no do?
title: GALATIANS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ Abraham gyee Nyankopɔn dzii, na wobuu no tsenenee maa no no,
title: GALATIANS

text: dɛmara so na hom nhu dɛ hɔn a wɔgye dzi no, hɔnara nye Abraham asefo.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na kyerɛwsɛm no dzii kan hun dɛ Nyankopɔn nam gyedzi do bobu amanaman bem ntsi, kyerɛwsɛm dzii kan kaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ Abraham dɛ, Wo mu na wobehyira amanaman nyina.
title: GALATIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hɔn a wofi gyedzi mu no woehyira hɔn aka gyedzinyi Abraham ho.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na dodow a wɔdze hɔnho to mbra ndwuma do no, wɔwɔ ndom ase, na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ndom aka obiara a ɔnnkɔ do ntsena dza ɔwɔ mbra nwoma no nyina mu, na ɔnnyɛ no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na ɔyɛ pefee dɛ, mbra mu dze, obi nndzi bem wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim; osiandɛ, Ɔtseneneenyi nam gyedzi do bɛtsena ase.
title: GALATIANS

text: Ɔwɔ mu dɛ mbra mmfi gyedzi mu, naaso, Nyia ɔyɛ dza mbra no hwehwɛ no nam mu benya nkwa.
title: GALATIANS

text: Kraest poon hɛn fii mbra no no ndom mu, osiandɛ wɔdze no yɛɛ ndom maa hɛn: na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ndom aka obiara a ɔsɛn dua do:
title: GALATIANS

text: ama Abraham ne nhyira no nam Kraest Jesus do aaba amanamamfo no do, na ɔnam gyedzi do hɛn nsa aaka Sunsum a wɔdze bɔɔ anohoba no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Enuanom, medze dza yehu no daa reyɛ mfatoho: Nyimpa ne samansew a wɔasɔw ano mpo, obi nntum nnsesa no, eso ɔmmfa bi nnka ho.
title: GALATIANS

text: Afei, Abraham nye n’asenyi na wɔbɔɔ hɔn anohoba no. Anohoba no nnka dɛ, Nye w’asefo, dɛ gyama wɔyɛ pii; na mbom ɔka dɛ, Nye w’asenyi; iyi kyerɛ dɛ ɔbaako, na ɔno nye Kraest.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na dza mese nye dɛ, Ahyɛmu a Nyankopɔn dzii kan hyɛɛ no dzen (siee Kraest mu) no, mbra no a n’ekyir mfe ahaanan eduasa ansaana ɔbae no, nntum nntu nngu, ma anohoba no nnyɛ gyan.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na sɛ egyapadze no fi mbra mu a, nna ommfi anohoba mu bio: na Abraham dze, Nyankopɔn nam anohoba no do dze kyɛɛ no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Nna dɛm a mbra no nye dza ɔwɔ hen? Mbrato ntsi na wɔdze kaa ho dze kesii dɛ asenyi no a wɔdze anohoba no bɔɔ no no bɛba; na wɔnam abɔfo do hyɛe wɔ ntamugyinafo nsamu.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na ntamugyinafo nnyɛ ɔbaako, na Nyankopɔn dze ɔyɛ ɔbaako.
title: GALATIANS

text: Nna mbra no tsia Nyankopɔn anohoba no anaa? Atserkwa, oho! Na sɛ wɔhyɛɛ mbra bi a obotum ama nkwa a, nkyɛ tsenenee nam mbra do.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na kyerɛwsɛm no apata adze nyina ahyɛ bɔn ase, ama anohoba no a ɔnam Kraest mu gyedzi do no, wɔdze aama hɔn a wɔgye dzi.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na ansaana gyedzi rebɛba no, wɔdze hɛn siee mbra no mu weɔn hɛn, maa gyedzi a wɔrebɛda no edzi akyerɛ no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, nna mbra no yɛ hɛn kyerɛfo ara dze hɛn ba Kraest nkyɛn, ama wɔnam gyedzi do eebu hɛn bem.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na nkyii gyedzi enya aba yi, yɛnnda ho nnhyɛ ɔkyerɛfo no ase bio.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na hom nyina nam gyedzi do yɛ Nyankopɔn mba wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na hom mu dodow a woenuma hɔn akɔ Kraest mu no wɔahyɛ Kraest,
title: GALATIANS

text: Jewnyi anaa Griiknyi nnyi beebi, akowaa anaa ɔdehye nnyi beebi, ɔbarimba anaa ɔbaa nnyi beebi: na hom nyina ayɛ kor wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na sɛ hom yɛ Kraest dze a, na hom yɛ Abraham asefo, na hom nam anohoba no do yɛ adzedzifo.
title: GALATIANS

text: Dza mekyerɛ nye dɛ, nyia odzi adze no (obi a woegya no egyapadze no) yɛ abofra yi, kaansa ɔno nye ndzɛmba no nyina wura mpo a, ɔnnsor ɔno nye akowaa;
title: GALATIANS

text: na ɔhyɛ ahwɛdofo nye efihwɛfo ase, dze kesi dɛ mber a egya no ahyɛ no bɔso.
title: GALATIANS

text: Dɛmara so na hɛn so yɛyɛ mbofra no, yɛyɛɛ nkowaa wɔ wiadze sunsum mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ no ase:
title: GALATIANS

text: na aber no durii no, Nyankopɔn somaa ne Ba a ɔbaa woo no no, nyia wɔwoo no mbra ase no,
title: GALATIANS

text: dɛ ɔmbɔpon hɔn a wɔwɔ mbra no ase no, ama wɔaafa hɛn ayɛ mba.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na osiandɛ hom yɛ mba ntsi, Nyankopɔn asoma ne Ba no Sunsum aba hom akoma mu a ɔtsea mu dɛ, Abba, Egya.
title: GALATIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi ennda ho nnyɛ akowaa na eyɛ ɔba, na sɛ eyɛ ɔba dze a, nna enam Nyankopɔn do yɛ odziadzenyi.
title: GALATIANS

text: Naaso ber no, nna hom nnyim Nyankopɔn ntsi, hom kɔr nkowaasom mu ma hɔn a hɔn su mu wɔnnyɛ nyame no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na afei hom ebohu Nyankopɔn, anaa mpo dɛ Nyankopɔn ehu hom yi, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom dan bio kɔ sunsum mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɔyɛ mberɛw na wodzi hia no ho? Ana hom pɛ dɛ hom kɔ nkowaasom mu ma hɔn bio?
title: GALATIANS

text: Hom dzi nda, nye abosoom, nye mber, nye mfrenhyia.
title: GALATIANS

text: Musuro wɔ hom ho dɛ bi a maberɛ moho ama hom kwa.
title: GALATIANS

text: Enuanom, meserɛ hom, hom nyɛ dɛ emi, osiandɛ mo so metse dɛ hom. Hom annyɛ me bɔn bi:
title: GALATIANS

text: na hom nyim dɛ honam mberɛw do na mekaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ hom nkan no:
title: GALATIANS

text: na dza ɔyɛɛ hom nsɔhwɛ wɔ mo honam mu no, hom emmbu me enyimtsia, eso hom ennkyir me, na mbom hom gyee me dɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoe, nyew, dɛ Kraest Jesus mpo.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na afei hom enyigye no wɔ hen? Osiandɛ mara midzi hom dase dɛ sɛ nna wɔyɛ na ɔyɛ yie a, nkyɛ hom tutuu hom enyiwa mpo maa me.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na afei ɔnam dɛ meka nokwar no kyerɛ hom ntsi, madan hom tamfo anaa?
title: GALATIANS

text: Ɔbɛyɛ dɛ binom bɔ hom ho mbɔdzen hwehwɛ hom, naaso nnyɛ hom yieyɛ bi mu a, na pɛ na wɔrepɛ esiw hom kwan, ama hom aaper ahwehwɛ hɔn.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na oye dɛ nkyɛ wɔbɔ hom yieyɛ ho mbɔdzen daa, na nnyɛ ber a menye hom wɔ hɔ nko.
title: GALATIANS

text: Ao, me mba nkakraba a moroko hom awo bio ekesi dɛ wobowie Kraest suban yɛ wɔ hom mu,
title: GALATIANS

text: nyew, mepɛ dɛ nkyɛ mowɔ hom nkyɛn sesei, ama maasakyer mbrɛ mudua yɛ m’adze, osiandɛ me tsirmu yɛ me konsee wɔ hom ho.
title: GALATIANS

text: Hom a hom rohwehwɛ mbra no ase akɛhyɛ, hom nka nkyerɛ me, hom nntse dza mbra no ka anaa?
title: GALATIANS

text: Na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ Abraham woo mbabanyin beenu, ɔbaako yɛ afonabaa ba na ɔbaako yɛ ɔdehye ba.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na nyia ɔyɛ afonabaa ba no, wɔwoo no honam do, na ɔdehye ba no dze, wɔnam anohoba no do na wɔwoo no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na nsɛm no yɛ ntotoho ara: na mbaa beenu yi yɛ ahyɛmu ahorow ebien no, ɔbaako fi bepɔw Sinai do woo mba guu nkowaasom mu, ɔno nye Hagar.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na iyi nye Hagar, bepɔw Sinai ne dzin a ɔwɔ Arabia no, na ɔno gyina hɔ ma ndɛ Jerusalɛm yi: na ɔno nye ne mba wɔ nkowaasom mu.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na Jerusalɛm a ɔwɔ sor no dze, odzi noho do, ɔno nye hɛn nyina hɛn na.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Ɔbɔnyin a ennwoo, dzi dɛw; Ɔwo a ennko awoo, bɔ ose na tseatsea mu: Osiandɛ nyia onnyi bi no ne mba adɔɔ so akyɛn nyia ɔwɔ kun nedze.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na hɛn dze, enuanom, dɛ mbrɛ Isaak tse no, yɛyɛ anohoba no mba.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ ber no, nyia wɔwoo no honam do no taan nyia wɔwoo no Sunsum do no enyi no, mbrɛ ɔtse seseiara so nye no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Naaso kyerɛwsɛm no se dɛn? Pam afonabaa no nye ne ba no, na afonabaa ba no rennye ɔdehye ba no rinndzi adze.
title: GALATIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, yɛnnyɛ afonabaa mba, na mbom yɛyɛ ɔdehye no mba.
title: GALATIANS

text: Adehyedzi mu na Kraest ama yɛagye hɛnho; dɛm ntsi hom ngyina pintsinn, na mma hom mma kwan ma wɔnnyɛ hom nkowaa bio.
title: GALATIANS

text: Hwɛ, emi Paul mese hom dɛ, sɛ hom ma homho kwan ma wotwa hom twatsia a, nna Kraest nnyɛ hom mfaso bi.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na mitsi mu bio kyerɛ obiara a ɔgye twatsiatwa no dɛ, ɔyɛ kafonyi, otwar dɛ odzi mbra no nyina do.
title: GALATIANS

text: Hom a hom pɛ dɛ wobu hom bem wɔ mbra no mu no, wɔatsew hom efi Kraest mu; hom efi adom no ho ahwe ase.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na hɛn dze, yɛnam Sunsum mu dua gyedzi do tweɔn tsenenee enyidado no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na Kraest Jesus mu dze, nnyɛ twatsiatwa, anaa monomonomyɛ, na ɔyɛ biribi, na mbom gyedzi a ɔnam ɔdɔ do yɛ edwuma a.
title: GALATIANS

text: Hom tutuu mbirika yie, na woana na oesiw hom kwan dɛ mma hom nntsie nokwar no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Dɛm adwen nsakyeree yi dze, ommfi nyia ɔfrɛɛ hom no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Mbɔrkaw kakra na ɔkaw mbɔr nyina.
title: GALATIANS

text: Mowɔ awerɛhyɛmu wɔ hom ho wɔ Ewuradze mu dɛ hom ronndwen biribi fofor bi: na nyia ɔretan hom enyi no, woana nye no ara a, obenya n’atsɛmbu.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na emi dze, enuanom, sɛ meda ho ka twatsiasɛm a, nkyɛ ɔyɛ dɛn na wɔda ho tseetsee me yi? Ɔno dze nna mbeamudua no ho fintsidua no aba ewiei.
title: GALATIANS

text: Sɛ ɔka mo nko a, nkyɛ hɔn a wɔma hom adwen mu yɛ hom basabasa no edzi hɔnara hɔn ho ewu.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na hom dze, enuanom, wɔafrɛ hom ama adehyedzi, na adehyedzi no mma hom kwan ma hom nnhyɛ honam apɛdze ma, na mbom hom ndua ɔdɔ do nsonsom homho.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na mbra no nyina ahyɛ ma wɔ asɛm kor mu, ɔno nye yi; Dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ wankasa woho.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na sɛ hom keka, na hom memen homho nkorkor a, hom nhwɛ yie amma hom aannsɛɛ homho.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na mese, Hom nnantsew Sunsum mu, na mma hom nnhyɛ honam akɔndɔ ma.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na honam kɔn dɔ tsia Sunsum, na Sunsum tsia honam, na ndzɛmba ebien yi nnka, amma hom aannyɛ ndzɛmba a hom pɛ.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na sɛ Sunsum no kyerɛ hom kwan a, nna hom nnyi mbra no ase.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na honam su ndwuma no da edzi pefee, ɔno nye yinom: ndwamanyɛ, efifidze, ahoɔdɛw,
title: GALATIANS

text: abosonsɔr, abayisɛm, ɔtan, mansotwe, ahoɔyaw, ebufuw, nyinkuntwe, mpaapaamu, ekuwbɔbɔn,
title: GALATIANS

text: enyitan, asabow, asakasakagor, nye dza ɔtsetse dɛm a meka kyerɛ hom kotoo, dɛ mbrɛ maka akyerɛ hom dada no, dɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛm ndzɛmba no rinnya Nyankopɔn ahendzi no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na Sunsum no aba nye ɔdɔ, dɛw, asomdwee, penkyɛr, ayamuyie, papayɛ, gyedzi,
title: GALATIANS

text: ɔdwe, ahohyɛdo; mbra bi nnyi hɔ tsia yinom.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na hɔn a wɔyɛ Kraest Jesus dze no, wɔabɔ honam nhyɛdodze nye n’akɔndɔ nyina mbeamudua mu.
title: GALATIANS

text: Sɛ yɛtse ase wɔ Sunsum mu a, hom mma yɛnnantsew Sunsum mu so.
title: GALATIANS

text: Mma yɛnnyɛ enyimnyampɛ hun nnyiyi hɛnho ebufuw, nntentan hɛnho.
title: GALATIANS

text: Enuanom, sɛ mfom bɔto obi awerɛfir mu a, hom a hom yɛ sunsummufo no mfa tsema ndan nyia ɔafom no. Na hwɛ woho yie, amma wɔaannsɔ wo so annhwɛ.
title: GALATIANS

text: Hom nsoasoa hom mu kor biara n’adzesoa, na dɛm no hom ahyɛ Kraest mbra ma.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na sɛ obi bu noho dɛ ɔyɛ obi, wɔ aber kor a ɔnnyɛ obiara a, ɔdaadaa noara noho.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na hom mma obiara nsɔ nankasa n’edwuma nhwɛ, nna obenya noara no ho biribi dze ahyehyɛ noho, na nnyɛ obi ho a.
title: GALATIANS

text: Osiandɛ obiara bɔsoa nankasa n’adzesoa.
title: GALATIANS

text: Hom mma nyia wɔrekyerɛkyerɛ no asɛm no mu no mmema nyia ɔrekyerɛkyerɛ no no wɔ ndzepa nyina mu.
title: GALATIANS

text: Mma hom nndaadaa homho; Onyankopɔn wonnsi no atwetwe; dza nyimpa dua no, ɔnoara na obobu.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na nyia odua ma nankasa no honam no, ofi honam mu bobu prɔwee, na nyia odua ma Sunsum no fi Sunsum mu bobu onnyiewiei nkwa.
title: GALATIANS

text: Mma hom mma yɛmmberɛ wɔ papayɛ mu, na sɛ yɛanntɔ bahaw a, yebobu no ne ber ano.
title: GALATIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, sɛ yenya ber a ɔsɛ a, hom mma yɛnyɛ papa mma nyimpa nyina, nkanka hɔn a wɔyɛ gyedzi fifo no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Hom nhwɛ akyerɛw akɛse a medze mankasa me nsa akyerɛw rebrɛ hom no.
title: GALATIANS

text: Dodow a wɔpɛ dɛ hɔn enyim ba nyam wɔ honam mu no, hɔn na wɔhyɛ hom dɛ hom ntwa twatsia, dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma wɔnnkɛtseetsee hɔn wɔ Kraest mbeamudua ho ara ntsi a.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na hɔn a wɔagye twatsiatwa no mpo hɔnankasa nndzi mbra no do, na wɔrohwehwɛ dɛ hom twa twatsia, na wɔdze hom aahyehyɛ hɔnho.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na emi dze, ɔmmpar me dɛ mebɛhyehyɛ moho, gyedɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest mbeamudua no mu, ɔno do na wɔnam abɔ wiadze mbeamudua mu ama me, na wɔabɔ mo so mbeamudua mu ama wiadze.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na nnyɛ twatsiatwa anaa monomonomyɛ na ɔyɛ biribi, na mbom abɔdze fofor a.
title: GALATIANS

text: Na dodow a wodzi dɛm nhyehyɛɛ yi do no, asomdwee nye mbɔbɔrhu mbra hɔn nye Nyankopɔn ne Israel no do.
title: GALATIANS

text: Ofi ndɛ kɔ yi, mma obi nntseetsee me: osiandɛ mowɔ Jesus n’akam wɔ me nyimpadua ho.
title: GALATIANS

text: Enuanom, hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest adom nka hom sunsum. Amen.
title: GALATIANS

text: Paul a ɔnam Nyankopɔn ne pɛ do yɛ Kraest Jesus no somafo dze nwoma yi kɛma ahotseweefo a wɔwɔ Efeso a wɔyɛ Kraest Jesus mu agyedzifo no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Adom nye asomdwee a ofi Nyankopɔn hɛn Egya nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest no nka hom.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Nhyira nka hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne Nyankopɔn nye n’egya a ɔdze sunsum mu nhyira nyina ehyira hɛn wɔ sorsor wɔ Kraest Jesus mu:
title: EPHESIANS

text: dɛ mbrɛ ɔnam ɔdɔ mu yii hɛn wɔ Kraest mu ansaana wɔrehyɛ wiadze ase, dɛ yɛnyɛ ahotseweefo nye hɔn a wonndzi dzɛm biara wɔ n’enyim no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Oyii hɛn too hɔ dɛ ɔnam Jesus Kraest do bɛfa hɛn abayɛ ama noho dɛ mbrɛ ne pɛ enyisɔ tse,
title: EPHESIANS

text: ama woeeyi n’adom a ɔdze adom hɛn no Dɔba no mu no n’enyimnyam ayɛw.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Ɔnoara no mu na yɛnam no bɔgyaa do enya hɛn pon yi, mekyerɛ mfom mu fakyɛ a ɔnam n’adom ahonya do a.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Ɔama abor do ama hɛn wɔ nyansa nye nyimdzee nyina mu,
title: EPHESIANS

text: na oeyi ne pɛ n’esumasɛm akyerɛ hɛn dɛ mbrɛ n’enyisɔ a osusui wɔ ne tsirmu no tse.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛ mber no aso pɛpɛɛpɛr a wɔbɛka ndzɛmba nyina abɔ mu kor wɔ Kraest mu, ɔyɛ ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ sorsor na asaase do nyinara.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Ɔno Kraest no ara so mu na hɛn so yeenya egyapadze, dɛ mbrɛ nyia ɔnam ne pɛ apam do yɛ ndzɛmba nyina no, nam ne tsirmpɔw do hyehyɛe too hɔ;
title: EPHESIANS

text: dɛ hɛn a hɛn enyi daa Kraest do kan no mbɛyɛ n’enyimnyam ho ayɛyi.
title: EPHESIANS

text: No mu so, na hom tsee nokwar asɛm no a ɔyɛ hom nkwagye ho asɛmpa no. Ɔnoara mu so na hom gyee dzii no, wɔdze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a wɔbɔɔ ho anohoba no a
title: EPHESIANS

text: ɔyɛ hɛn kyɛfa ho nsewhyɛdze no asɔw hom ano. Iyi nye ɔgye a ɔdze agye hɔn a wɔyɛ nankasa nedze no ama n’enyimnyam ayɛyi no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, mo so metsee Ewuradze Jesus mu gyedzi a ɔwɔ hom mu, nye ɔdɔ a hom dze dɔ ahotseweefo nyina no,
title: EPHESIANS

text: minngyaa dɛ meda ase wɔ hom ntsi, na mekaa hom wɔ me mpaabɔ mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Mobɔ mpaa dɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne Nyankopɔn no, enyimnyam Egya no, ɔmma hom nyansa nye nyikyerɛ sunsum wɔ no ho nyimdzee mu;
title: EPHESIANS

text: dɛ hom adwen enyi ntsew, na hom nhu ne frɛ no ho enyidado no, nye n’egyapadze enyimnyam ahonya wɔ ahotseweefo no mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Afei so, ɔmma hom nhu no tum kɛseyɛ mbordo a ɔwɔ hɛn a yɛgye dzi no do, dɛ mbrɛ no tum ahoɔdzen ndzeyɛe a
title: EPHESIANS

text: ɔdze yɛɛ adze wɔ Kraest mu nyaan no fii ewufo mu no tse. Ɔdze no tsenaa n’enyimfa wɔ sorsor,
title: EPHESIANS

text: wɔ mpanyindzi, nye tumdzi, nye ahoɔdzen, nye ahendzi nyina do, nye dzin a wɔbɔ nyina do, nnyɛ wiadze mber yi mu nko, na mbom dza ɔreba no so mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Ɔabrɛ adze nyina adze aba n’ananadze, na ɔdze no ayɛ adze nyina do tsir ama asɔr no a
title: EPHESIANS

text: ɔyɛ ne nyimpadua no, nyia ɔhyɛ adze nyina ma wɔ ndzɛmba nyina mu no n’amayɛ mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na hom so a nkyɛ hom yɛ ewufo wɔ hom mfom nye ndzebɔn a,
title: EPHESIANS

text: nkan no hom nantseew mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔfa wiadze yi mber ho, dɛ mbrɛ wimu tum panyin no tse, sunsum a ɔyɛ edwuma sesei wɔ hɔn a wɔyɛ asoɔdzen no mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Nkyɛ hɛn nyina so tse hɔn mu bɔ hɛn bra wɔ honam akɔndɔ mu, na yɛyɛɛ dza honam nye adwen pɛ, na yɛnam hɛn awosu mu yɛɛ nkorɔfo a Nyankopɔn ebufuw wɔ hɔn do dɛ hɔn a wɔaka no so:
title: EPHESIANS

text: naaso Nyankopɔn a n’ehumbɔbɔr dɔɔ so no, nam no dɔ kɛse a ɔdze dɔɔ hɛn
title: EPHESIANS

text: wɔ ber a nna yɛyɛ ewufo wɔ mfom mu no, ama yɛnye Kraest enya nkwa; (adom do na wɔnam agye hom nkwa.)
title: EPHESIANS

text: Oenyan hɛn aka no ho, na ɔama yɛnye no atsena sorsor hɔ wɔ Kraest Jesus mu;
title: EPHESIANS

text: ama mbersantsen a ɔreba no mu oeeyi n’adom ahonya mbordo no akyerɛ, wɔ ayamuyie a ɔayɛ hɛn wɔ Kraest Jesus mu no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na adom na wɔdze nam gyedzi do agye hom nkwa; na ommfi homankasa, ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn akyɛdze a:
title: EPHESIANS

text: ommfi ndwuma mu, amma obiara aannhyehyɛ noho.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na yɛyɛ n’edwinsa a ɔbɔɔ hɛn Kraest Jesus mu maa ndwuma pa a Nyankopɔn siesiei too hɔ dɛ yɛnnantsew mu no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nkaa dɛ, hom a nkyɛ nkan no hom yɛ Amanamamfo wɔ honam mu, ma hɔn a wɔfrɛ hɔnho Twatsiatwafo, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔdze nsa ara gyan twa no honam mu no frɛ hom Monomonomfo no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Hom nkaa bio dɛ ber no, nna hom nnyi Kraest nkyɛn, na hom yɛ ananaben a hom mmfora Israel amamba, na hom yɛ ahɔho wɔ anohoba ahyɛmu horow no ho, nna hom nnyi enyidado, eso hom nnyi Nyankopɔn bi wɔ wiadze.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na afei dze, hom wɔ Kraest Jesus mu, ma Kraest bɔgya no dze hom a nkyɛ hom wɔ ekyirekyir no abɛn.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na ɔnoara ankasa nye hɛn asomdwee, ɔno a ɔayɛ ebien yi adze kor, na nankasa no honam nyimpadua mu oedwuruw fasu a otwa hɛn ntamu yɛ hɛn atamfo no egu famu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Oegu mbra no mu ahyɛdze nye nhyehyɛɛ no nyina, na ɔdze hɔn beenu nyina abɔ nyimpa fofor kor wɔ nankasa no mu, ma asomdwee aba;
title: EPHESIANS

text: na ɔnam ne mbeamudua no do aka ebien nyina abɔ mu ayɛ nyimpadua kor ama Nyankopɔn, na ɔdze mbeamudua kor yi ara so eku nyitan nyina.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na ɔbae bɛkaa asomdwee ho nsɛmpa kyerɛɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir, nye hɔn a wɔbɛn:
title: EPHESIANS

text: na ɔnam no mu na hɛn beenu nyina nam Sunsum kor mu enya kwan wɔ Egya no nkyɛn.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na afei hom nnyɛ ahɔho nye amamforafo bio, mbom hom yɛ ahotseweefo na kuromamfo nye Nyankopɔn fiemba;
title: EPHESIANS

text: wɔdze hom esi asomafo nye nkɔnhyɛfo no fapem do a Kraest Jesus nankasa nye kutuwdo bo tsitsir.
title: EPHESIANS

text: No mu na dza woesi no nyina keka si enyim a, orinyin akɛyɛ Nyankopɔn asɔrdan krɔnkrɔn wɔ Ewuradze mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Ɔnoara so no mu na worisi hom so ayɛ hom Nyankopɔn ne tsenabea wɔ Sunsum mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Iyi ntsi na emi Paul, meyɛ Kraest Jesus daduanyi ma hom amanamamfo,
title: EPHESIANS

text: ɔbɛyɛ dɛ hom atse ofihwɛ edwuma a hom ntsi wɔdze ama me no ho asɛm,
title: EPHESIANS

text: mbrɛ wɔnam nyikyerɛ do yii esumasɛm no kyerɛɛ me, dɛ mbrɛ makyerɛw no nsɛm tsiabaa bi mu abrɛ hom no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Ɔno na, sɛ hom kenkan a, hom dze bohu me ntseasee a ɔwɔ Kraest esumasɛm no mu a
title: EPHESIANS

text: mbersantsen bi mu wɔamma nyimpa mba ennhu, dɛ mbrɛ afei woeyi akyerɛ n’asomafo nye nkɔnhyɛfo krɔnkrɔn wɔ Sunsum mu no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Ɔno nye dɛ amanamamfo so bɛyɛ adzedzifo bi, nye nyimpadua kor no ara bi, na wɔnam asɛmpa no do eenya kyɛfa wɔ anohoba no ho bi, wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Ɔno no ho ɔsomfo na mebɛyɛe, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn adom akyɛdze a wɔdze akyɛ hɛn no tum edwumayɛ tse no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Emi a musuar sen ahotseweefo nyina no na wɔdze adom yi adom me, dɛ menka Kraest ahonya a onnyi nhwehwɛmu no ho asɛm nkyerɛ amanamamfo;
title: EPHESIANS

text: na memma nyimpa nyina nhu esumasɛm no ho dwumadzi a ofi tsetseetse nyina oesuma wɔ Nyankopɔn a ɔbɔɔ ndzɛmba nyina no mu no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Ama afei ɔnam asɔr no do ama mpanyindzi nye etum horow a wɔwɔ sor hɔ eehu Nyankopɔn nyansaa horow pii no,
title: EPHESIANS

text: dɛ mbrɛ tsetse tsirmpɔw a ɔbɔe wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Kraest Jesus mu no tse.
title: EPHESIANS

text: No mu na yɛnam no ho gyedzi do enya ndamyɛ nye kwan wɔ awerɛhyɛmu mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi meserɛ dɛ mma hom abaw mu mmbu wɔ amandze a hom ntsi muruhu no ho, osiandɛ iyi yɛ hom enyimnyam.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Iyi ntsi na mubu ntwɛr wɔ Egya no enyim,
title: EPHESIANS

text: ɔno a wofi no mu na egyamba a wɔwɔ sor nye asaase nyina no nya hɔn dzin.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛ mbrɛ n’enyimnyam ahonya tse no, ɔmma hom ndua no Sunsum do nnya tum mu ahoɔdzen wɔ hom mu nyimpasu no mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Ɔmma Kraest ndua gyedzi do ntsena hom akoma mu; ama sɛ hom gye ndwow na hom tsintsim wɔ dɔ mu a,
title: EPHESIANS

text: hom eenya ahoɔdzen nye ahotseweefo no nyina eehu Kraest no dɔ no ne tɛtɛr, ne tsentsen, no krɔn no nye no bun no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Nyew, nkyɛ hom eehu Kraest no dɔ a ɔbor ntseasee nyina do no, na Nyankopɔn amayɛ nyina aahyɛ hom ma.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na afei, onyia no a otum dɛ ɔyɛ ma ɔtra mbordo kyɛn adze nyina a yebisa anaa yɛdwen, dɛ mbrɛ tum a ɔyɛ hɛn mu edwuma no tse,
title: EPHESIANS

text: ɔno na enyimnyam nka no asɔr no mu, nye Kraest mu, nkɔ mbersantsen mfesantsen nyina mu. Amen.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, emi a meyɛ Ewuradze ne daduanyi no, mutu hom fo dɛ hom nnantsew dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata ɔfrɛ a wɔdze afrɛ hom,
title: EPHESIANS

text: wɔ ahobrɛadze nye ɔdwe nyina mu, nye penkyɛr. Hom mfa ɔdɔ mboaboa homho,
title: EPHESIANS

text: na hom mbɔ mbɔdzen mfa asomdwee nsuo koryɛ a Sunsum no dze ma hom no mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na hom yɛ nyimpadua kor nye Sunsum kor, dɛ mbrɛ wɔafrɛ hom wɔ hom frɛ enyidado kor mu;
title: EPHESIANS

text: Ewuradze kor, gyedzi kor, enuma kor,
title: EPHESIANS

text: hɛn nyina hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Egya kor a ɔbɔ hɛn nyina do, ɔnam hɛn nyina mu, na ɔwɔ hɛn nyina mu no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na wɔdze adom adom hɛn nyina nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ Kraest akyɛdze nsusui tse.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔse, Ɔfowee kɔr sor no, ɔfaa ndɔmmum nara kɔr ndɔmmum, Na ɔmaa nyimpa akyɛdze.
title: EPHESIANS

text: (Na sɛ ɔka dɛ, Ɔfowee kɔr sor a, nna nnyɛ dza ɔrekyerɛ ara nye dɛ, osianee so kɔr asaase ase?
title: EPHESIANS

text: Ampaara, nyia osianee no, ɔnoara so nye nyia ɔfowee bɔɔ ɔsorsor nyina do, ama ɔaahyɛ ndzɛmba nyina ma.)
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na ɔama binom ayɛ asomafo, binom nkɔnhyɛfo, binom asɛmpakafo, binom ahwɛfo nye akyerɛkyerɛfo;
title: EPHESIANS

text: dɛ ahotseweefo bedzi mu wɔ ɔsom edwuma ho ntsi, dɛ ɔdze bɔtow Kraest nyimpadua no ntsi:
title: EPHESIANS

text: ma ekodu dɛ hɛn nyina yebodu Nyankopɔn Ba no ho gyedzi nye no ho nyimdzee mu koryɛ mu, ayɛ nyimpa a oewie nyin, yeedu Kraest amayɛ esusudze no pɛn do;
title: EPHESIANS

text: amma yaannda ho annyɛ mbofraba a nkyerɛkyerɛ mframa biara tum bɔ hɛn begyabegya dze hɛn dzi akɔnaaba wɔ mbradatofo a wɔdze enyitsew na ndaadaa dzɛfɛdzɛfɛw nyimpa no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Mbom yeedzi nokwar wɔ dɔ mu, na yeenyin ndzɛmba nyinara mu akɔto Kraest a ɔyɛ hɛn tsir no;
title: EPHESIANS

text: ofi no mu, na nyimpadua no nyina, ɔnam dza akwaa nyina dze ma no do, atoatoa mu na akoakoa mu ayɛ kor, dɛ mbrɛ hɔn mu biara n’adzeyɛ nsusui tse no, nyimpadua no nyina nyin nya no ho esiyie wɔ dɔ mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, meka iyi, na misi do wɔ Ewuradze ne dzin mu, dɛ mma hom nnantsew bio dɛ mbrɛ amanamamfo nantsew wɔ adwenhun mu no,
title: EPHESIANS

text: sum ahyɛ hɔn adwen mu, wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn nkwa no ho ananaben, osian nkwaseasɛm a ɔwɔ hɔn mu, nye hɔn akoma a epirim ntsi;
title: EPHESIANS

text: hɔn enyi nnto hwee ntsi, wɔdze hɔnho ama enyimguasebra, na wɔyɛ efifidze nyina enyiberdo.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na hom dze, nnyɛ dɛm na hom suaa no Kraest hɔ;
title: EPHESIANS

text: sɛ ɔtse dɛm ampa dɛ hom atse no ho asɛm, na wɔakyerɛkyerɛ hom dɛ mbrɛ Kraest mu nokwar no tse no a:
title: EPHESIANS

text: hom nyi hom abrabɔ dadaw no nngu, nyimpa dadaw no a ɔroprɔw wɔ ndaadaa akɔndɔ mu no a;
title: EPHESIANS

text: na mbom hom nyɛ fofor wɔ hom adwen sunsum mu,
title: EPHESIANS

text: na hom nhyɛ nyimpa fofor no a wɔabɔ no Nyankopɔn do wɔ tsenenee nye ahotsew mu no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nyi atorsɛm ngu, na obiara nkasa nokwar nkyerɛ ne nyɛnko; osiandɛ yɛyeyɛ akwaa ma hɛnho nkorkor.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Ma hom bo mfuw na mma hom nnyɛ bɔn. Mma wi nntɔ hom ebufuw do:
title: EPHESIANS

text: eso mma hom mma abɔnsam kwan.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Mma owifo nnwia adze bio: na mbom ɔmbɔ mbɔdzen mfa ne nsa nyɛ edwuma pa, ama oeenya dza ɔdze bɛkyɛ nyia oehia.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Mma kasa fun biara mmfi hom anomu, na mbom dza oye ma ntowdo a ohia a ɔdze adom bɛma hɔn a wɔtse.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na mma hom nnhow Nyankopɔn no Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a wɔdze asɔw hom ano ama ɔgye da no no werɛ.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Hom mma wonyi anoɔwen nyina, nye akomabɔn, nye ebufuw, nye ndzebɔ, nye etwitwanantsir nye adwembɔn nyina mfi hom mu:
title: EPHESIANS

text: na hom nkyerɛ ayamuyie nye ayamuhyehye mma homho nkorkor; hom mfa nkyekyɛ homho dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn so dze akyɛ hom wɔ Kraest mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nsuasua Nyankopɔn, dɛ hom yɛ ne mba a ɔdɔ hom;
title: EPHESIANS

text: na hom nnantsew ɔdɔ mu, dɛ mbrɛ Kraest so dɔɔ hom, na ɔdze noho mae maa hɛn, dɛ ayɛyɛdze nye afɔrbɔdze a otu nka huahuam ma Nyankopɔn no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛ hom yɛ ahotseweefo yi, mma wɔmmbɔ ndwamansɛm anaa efifidze anaa enyiber dzin mpo wɔ hom mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Mma hom mma ɔbra a ɔmmfata, anaa kasafi, anaa fɛwdzi a ɔnnyɛ mfaso mmpue hom mu: na mbom hom nda Nyankopɔn ase.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na hom nhu iyi pefee dɛ edwaman biara, obiara a ɔyɛ efifidze anaa onyiberfo (ɔno nye dɛ ɔbosonsɔrnyi) nnyi egyapadze wɔ Kraest nye Nyankopɔn ahendzi no mu.
title: EPHESIANS
