text: Mma obi mmfa nsɛnhun nndaadaa hom: na dɛm ndzɛmba yi ntsi na Nyankopɔn ebufuw reba hɔn wɔyɛ asoɔdzen no do.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi mma hom nye hɔn nnya anyɛnkofa biara:
title: EPHESIANS

text: na nkan no nkyɛ hom yɛ sum, na afei dze, hom yɛ kan wɔ Ewuradze mu; dɛm ntsi hom nnantsew dɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ kan:
title: EPHESIANS

text: (osiandɛ kan no n’aba wɔ papayɛ nye tsenenee nye nokwar nyina mu),
title: EPHESIANS

text: hom nsɔ dza ɔsɔ Ewuradze enyi yie nhwɛ;
title: EPHESIANS

text: na mma hom nnye sum edwuma a ɔnnsow aba no nnyɛ nyɛnko, na mbom hom ntsia;
title: EPHESIANS

text: na dza wɔyɛ no nsumaa mu no ɔyɛ enyito dɛ wɔbɔ dzin mpo.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na ndzɛmba biara a kan no da no edzi no bɛyɛ kan ma wohu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔse, Nyan, ɔwo a ada! Soɛr fi ewufo mu, na Kraest bɛhyerɛn wo do.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nhwɛ yie mbrɛ hom si nantsew, nnyɛ dɛ nkwasea na mbom dɛ enyansafo;
title: EPHESIANS

text: hom mfa mber a hom nya no ndzi dwuma pa, osiandɛ mber no yɛ mber bɔn.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi mma hom nnyɛ nkwasea, na mbom hom nhu dza Ewuradze pɛ.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Eso mma hom mmbow nsa; osiandɛ ɔno na ɔdze sakasakayɛ ba, na mbom hom mma Sunsum no nhyɛ hom ma;
title: EPHESIANS

text: ber a hom dze nsankudwom, ayɛyindwom nye sunsum mu ndwom rekasa kyerɛ homho no, na hom mfa hom akoma ntow ndwom enyigye mu mma Ewuradze.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Adze nyina mu no, hom nda Nyankopɔn Egya no ase daa wɔ Jesus Kraest dzin mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Hom mfa Kraest mu suro mbrɛ homho adze mmema homho nkorkor.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Yernom, hom mbrɛ homho adze mma homankasa hom kunnom dɛ hom dze ma Ewuradze.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na okun no yɛ yer no ne tsir dɛ mbrɛ Kraest so yɛ asɔr no ne tsir, ɔno a ɔyɛ ne nyimpadua n’agyenkwa no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ asɔr brɛ noho adze ma Kraest no, dɛmara na yernom so nyɛ mma hɔn kunnom wɔ adze nyina mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Kunnom, hom ndɔ hom yernom dɛ mbrɛ Kraest so dɔɔ asɔr no, na ɔdze no nkwa too hɔ maa no no:
title: EPHESIANS

text: ama ɔayɛ no krɔnkrɔn, dɛ ɔdze nsuguar no atsew ho wɔ asɛm no mu,
title: EPHESIANS

text: ama oeetu asɔr no esi hɔ ama nankasa noho, dɛ enyimnyam asɔr a onnyi nkekaa anaa mpomponee, anaa biribiara a ɔtse dɛm, na mbom ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn na onndzii dzɛm.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛmara na ɔsɛ dɛ kunnom dɔ hɔnankasa hɔn yernom, dɛ hɔnankasa hɔn honam. Nyia ɔdɔ nankasa ne yer no, ɔdɔ nankasa noho:
title: EPHESIANS

text: osiandɛ obiara nntan nankasa no honam pɛn, na mbom ɔnyɛn no na ɔhwɛ no yie, dɛ mbrɛ Kraest so yɛ ma asɔr no;
title: EPHESIANS

text: na yɛyɛ ne nyimpadua ho akwaa.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Iyi ntsi na banyin begya n’egya nye ne na hɔ, na ɔdze noho akɛbata ne yer ho, na hɔn beenu no ayɛ honankor.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Esumasɛm yi so: na emi dze maka no Kraest nye asɔr no ho.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na hom so, obiara ndɔ nankasa ne yer dɛ mbrɛ ɔdɔ nankasa noho, na ɔyer so ondzi no kun nyi.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Mba, hom ntsie hom awofo wɔ Ewuradze mu: na iyi na ɔtsen.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dzi w’egya nye wo na nyi (ɔno nye mbra a odzi kan a anohoba ka ho),
title: EPHESIANS

text: ama eesi wo yie, na wo nda awar wɔ asaase do.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na hom egyanom, mma hom nnhyɛ hom mba ebufuw; mbom hom ntsetse hɔn wɔ Ewuradze setsie nye kasakyerɛ mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Nkowaa, hom mfa suro nye ahopopo nye akomakor ntsie hom honam afamu ewuranom asɛm, dɛ hom yɛ ma Ewuradze;
title: EPHESIANS

text: nnyɛ enyiwado som a, dɛ hɔn a wɔsɔ nyimpa enyi, na mbom dɛ Kraest nkowaa a wofi akoma mu reyɛ Nyankopɔn ne pɛ;
title: EPHESIANS

text: na wɔdze ɔpɛ pa rosom dɛ wɔdze rema Ewuradze na nnyɛ nyimpa a:
title: EPHESIANS

text: na hom nyim dɛ papa a obiara bɛyɛ no, ɔdehye o, akowaa o, ɔnoara ho akatua na obenya no wɔ Ewuradze hɔ.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Hom, ewuranom, hom nyɛ dɛmara mma hom nkowaa, na hom ngyaa mpuwbɔ; na hom nyim dɛ hɔn wura nye hom wura wɔ sor, na ɔno, nyimpa enyimhwɛ biara nnyi n’afamu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dza medze wie nye dɛ, hom nyɛ dzen wɔ Ewuradze nye no tum ahoɔdzen no mu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Hom nhyɛ Nyankopɔn akodze no nyina, ama hom eetum egyina abɔnsam ndaadaa no enyim.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Osiandɛ nnyɛ yɛnye honam nye bɔgya na enya ntokwadzi, na yɛnye mpanyindzi, tumdzi, nye wiadze yi sum mu etumfo, nye emumuyɛ esunsum a wɔwɔ sorsor no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, hom mfa Nyankopɔn akodze no nyina mmia, ama hom eetum egyina wɔ da bɔn no mu, na hom ewie akodzi yi nyina no, hom eetum egyina hom anan do.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, hom ngyina hɔ dɛ hom dze nokwar abɔ hom asen, na hom ahyɛ tsenenee akatabo no,
title: EPHESIANS

text: na hom dze asomdwee asɛmpa no ho ahosiesie ahyehyɛ hom anan;
title: EPHESIANS

text: na no korakoraa no, hom nkitsa gyedzi kokyɛm no a hom dze botum edum ɔbɔn no n’egyen ndua a ogya wɔ ano no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na hom mfa nkwagye dadzekyɛw no, nye Sunsum afona a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm no:
title: EPHESIANS

text: na hom mfa mpaabɔ nye nkotoserɛ nyina nsɔr aber nyina wɔ Sunsum mu. Na hom iyi ara ntsi, hom mbɔ mbɔdzen nweɔn, ntotɔ nserɛ mma ahotseweefo no nyina,
title: EPHESIANS

text: nye mo so, dɛ sɛ mubue m’ano a, Nyankopɔn mma me ɔkasahom ma memfa ndam nka asɛmpa no nda no mu esumasɛm no edzi,
title: EPHESIANS

text: ɔno ho ɔsomafo na meyɛ wɔ mpokyerɛ mu yi, ama maakasa ndam do wɔ mu, dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ mekasa.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Na afei, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma hom ehu mo ho asɛm no, onua dɔfo nye Ewuradze mu somfo nokwafo, Tikikus, bɛka ne nyina akyerɛ hom:
title: EPHESIANS

text: ɔno na iyiara ntsi masoma no hom nkyɛn, ma hom eehu mbrɛ hɛn asetsena mu tse, na ɔaaka hom akoma ato hom yamu.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Asomdwee nye ɔdɔ, nye gyedzi a ofir Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest no, nka enuanom no.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Adom nka hɔn a wɔdze ɔdɔ a odzi mu dɔ Ewuradze Jesus Kraest no nyina.
title: EPHESIANS

text: Paul nye Timoti, Kraest Jesus no nkowaa, dze krataa yi kɛma Kraest Jesus mu ahotseweefo nyina a wɔwɔ Filipi, nye hɔn mu ahwɛfo nye asomfo:
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Adom nye asomdwee a ofi Nyankopɔn Egya no, nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nka hom.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Mekaa hom aber biara a, meda me Nyankopɔn ase,
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: na aber biara medze enyigye sɔr ma hom nyina,
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: wɔ hom nkitahodzi a hom wɔ no asɛmpa no ne tserɛw ho ofitsi da a odzi kan no dze bodu sesei.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Mowɔ awerɛhyɛmu wɔ iyi mu dɛ nyia ɔhyɛɛ edwuma pa ase wɔ hom mu no ɔbɛma oedzi mu dze ekodu Kraest Jesus da no.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Ɔtsen ma me dɛ modwen dɛm wɔ hom ho, osiandɛ hom da m’akoma do, na hom nyina nye me wɔ kyɛfa wɔ Nyankopɔn n’adom no mu, wɔ mo mpokyerɛ mu nye mber a migyinaa pintsinn twitwae gyee asɛmpa no na mepae mu kaa no.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn nye me dasefo dɛ Kraest Jesus n’ayamuhyehye na tsema na medze afe hom nyina.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na iyi nna mobɔ ho mpaa dɛ hom nkɔ do ara mbor do wɔ nyimdzee nye nhumu nyina mu;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: ama hom eetum ehu ndzɛmba ahorow a oye nyina, na hom aayɛ krɔnn dɛ mfom bi nnyi hom ho dze ekodu Kraest da no;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: na hom asow tsenenee aba a ɔnam Jesus Kraest do ba no ama Nyakopɔn n’enyimnyam nye n’ayɛyi.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na enuanom, mepɛ dɛ hom hu dɛ, dza aba mo do no aba wɔ asɛmpa no ne kankɔ ntsi;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: ama mo mpokyerɛ no aada edzi wɔ ambrado abanmufo nye hɔn a wɔaka no nyina enyim;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: ama enuanom no pii nam mo mpokyerɛ no do eenya awerɛhyɛmu ayɛ ndam mbordo, ama sɛ wɔka Nyankopɔn asɛm no a, worunnsuro.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Ɔwɔ mu dɛ binom, nyitan nye mansotwe ntsi na wɔka Kraest ho asɛm; naaso binom wɔ hɔ a wɔdze pɛ pa ka.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Iyinom fi ɔdɔ mu ka asɛm no, osiandɛ wonyim dɛ wɔdze me esi hɔ dɛ menkasa mma asɛmpa no:
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: nkaa no dze wɔfi mansotwe mu ka Kraest ho asɛm, nnyɛ nokwar mu bi a, mbom hɔn adwen nye dɛ wɔbɛma mo ho ehiahia me ber a meda mpokyerɛ mu no.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Nna ɔyɛɛ dɛn? Akwan nyina mu no, sɛ mpetuwyɛ mu o, sɛ nokwar mu o, Kraest ho asɛm ara nna wɔka; na iyi mu nna midzi dɛw kɛse. Nyew, mobɔkɔ do so ara edzi dɛw no,
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: osiandɛ minyim dɛ ɔnam hom mpaabɔ nye Jesus Kraest no Sunsum do iyi bɛdan mo nkwagye.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Ɔyɛ m’enyisun nye m’enyidado dɛ m’enyim runngu ase wɔ biribiara mu, mbom me ndamyɛ kɛse ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse daa no, seseiara so, sɛ nkwa mu o, owu mu o, wɔbɛkamfo Kraest wɔ me nyimpadua mu.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na emi dze, ase a metse yi Kraest a, na owu so yɛ me mfaso.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Naaso sɛ honam mu atsena yi na ɔbɛma m’edwuma akɔ do dze a, nna ɔno dze, munnhu no mu dza memfa.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na mehin adze ebien yi ntamu; mo kɔn dɔ dɛ mututu ha nye Kraest kɛtsena, ɔno na nkyɛ oye koraa,
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: naaso honam mu asetsena no so hia pii ɔnam hom ntsi.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na mowɔ dɛm awerɛhyɛmu yi, minyim dɛ mebɛtsena ase na menye hom nyina atsena, wɔ hom kankɔ nye hom gyedzi mu dɛw ntsi;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: ama hom aahyehyɛ homho mbordo wɔ Kraest Jesus mu wɔ emi ntsi, osiandɛ mebɛba hom nkyɛn bio;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: mbom hom abrabɔ ara na hom mma ɔnyɛ dza ɔfata Kraest asɛmpa no, ama sɛ meba mubohu hom o, sɛ minnyi hɔ o, maatse hom asetsena ho asɛm dɛ hom gyina pintsinn wɔ sunsum kor mu, na hom dze adwen kor aabɔ mu edzi aper ama asɛmpa no mu gyedzi no;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: na mma hom mma atamfo no nnyi hom hu wɔ biribiara mu: ɔno nna ɔyɛ ɔsɛɛ ho asɛnkyerɛdze ma hɔn, na hom dze ɔyɛ nkwagye adze ma hom, na iyi no fi Nyankopɔn;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: osiandɛ wɔdze adom hom wɔ Kraest ntsi, nnyɛ dɛ hom gye no dzi nko, na mbom dɛ hom hu amandze so wɔ ne ntsi;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: na hom enya akodzi kor no ara a hom hun no wɔ mo mu no, na seseiara so hom da ho ara tse fa mo ho no.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ Kraest mu nkuranhyɛ bi, ɔdɔ awerɛkyekyer bi, Sunsum anyɛnkoyɛ bi, eso ayamuhyehye nye tsimbɔbɔr bi wɔ hɔ a,
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: hom nhyɛ me dɛw ma dɛ hom bɔdwen adze kor, enya ɔdɔ kor, adwensaa kor na adwen kor.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Mma hom nnyɛ biribi mansotwe do, anaa enyimnyam hun do, na mbom obiara mfa ahobrɛadze adwen do mbu ne nyɛnko nkyɛn nankasa noho;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: mma obiara nnhwɛ no nko n’adze, na mbom ɔnhwɛ obinom so dze bi.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Hom nnya adwen a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu no bi wɔ hom mu;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: ɔno a dɛ ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn subea, naaso oenngyina do ketsee araa dɛ ɔnye Nyankopɔn yɛ pɛr,
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: mbom ɔtoo no ho pan, faa akowaa tsebea too no do ma wɔwoo no dɛ nyimpa. Na wohun no nyimpa su mu no,
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: ɔbrɛɛ noho adze na ɔyɛɛ setsie araa kesii owu mu, nyew, mbeamudua do wu no mpo.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi so nna Nyankopɔn ama no do kɛsekɛse na ɔama no dzin bi dzin a ɔbɔ dzin biara do:
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: dɛ, Jesus dzin mu no, anankoroma nyina bɔkotow, wɔ ɔsor, asaase nye asaasease;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: na tɛkyerɛma nyina apaa mu aka dɛ Jesus Kraest nye Ewuradze dze ahyɛ Nyankopɔn Egya no enyimnyam.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, m’adɔfo, dɛ mbrɛ daa hom yɛ setsie, nnyɛ ber a mowɔ hom nkyɛn nko, na mbom afei a minnyi hom nkyɛn yi kɛse, hom mfa suro nye ahopopo nyɛ homankasa hom nkwagye ho edwuma nwie;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: na Nyankopɔn nna ɔyɛ hom mu edwuma ma hom nya pɛ na hom yɛ edwuma a ɔfata nankasa n’enyisɔ.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Mma hom mmfa ehwinhwin nye nyiyiano nyɛ dza hom yɛ biara,
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: ama hom aayɛ nyimpa a asɛm bi nnyi hom ho, na hom ho sɔnn, Nyankopɔn ne mba a nkekae bi nnyi hɔn ho, a wɔtse mbasantsen kɔntɔnkye nkyeakyeae mu, na hɔn mu na hom hyerɛn dɛ nkandzea wɔ wiadze mu.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Sɛ hom suo nkwasɛm no mu yie a, nna meenya dza medze bɛhyehyɛ moho wɔ Kraest da no mu, dɛ menntutu mbirika gyan eso mammberɛ kwa.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Ɛhɛɛ, sɛ mpo wohue me gu dɛ afɔrbɔ wɔ hom gyedzi som ho a, midzi dɛw, na menye hom nyina dzi ehurusi:
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: dɛmara na hom so ndzi dɛw na hom nye me ndzi ehurusi.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na m’enyi da do wɔ Ewuradze Jesus mu dɛ mobɔsoma Timoti wɔ hom nkyɛn ntsɛmara, ama metse hom asetsena mu nsɛm a, mo ho aatɔ me.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na minnyi obiara ɔtse dɛ ɔno a ɔbɔdwen hom asetsena ho yie bi.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na hɔn nyina hwehwɛ hɔnankasa hɔndze, na nnyɛ dza ɔyɛ Kraest Jesus dze bi a.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na hom nyim mbrɛ osi na ɔnye me som wɔ asɛmpa no afamu dɛ mbrɛ ɔba nye egya tse ara.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Ɔno na m’enyi da no do dɛ sɛ minya hu mbrɛ m’asɛm yi bowie me ara pɛr a, mobɔsoma no ntsɛmara:
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: na medze mo werɛ ahyɛ Ewuradze mu dɛ ɔnnkɛkyɛr biara na mankasa so maba.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Naaso muhun dɛ ohia dɛ mosoma Epafroditus a ɔyɛ mo nua nye me nyɛnko dwumayɛfo, nye me nyɛnko sordaanyi, nye hom somafo, nye me hia ho somfo no, wɔ hom nkyɛn;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: osiandɛ ɔfee hom nyina, na ɔhaw no pii dɛ hom tsee dɛ ɔyar.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Nyew, ɔyaree bɛɛn owu dze, naaso Nyankopɔn hun no mbɔbɔr, na nnyɛ no nko, na emi so bi, amma meennya awerɛhow ammbɔ awerɛhow do.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi na mabɔ mbɔdzen ara asoma no, ama hom hu no bio a, hom eedzi dɛw, na mo so m’awerɛhow do eehuan.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mfa dɛw nyina ngye no wɔ Ewuradze mu, na hɔn a wɔtse dɛm no hom nsuo hɔn mu wɔ enyidzi mu:
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: osiandɛ Kraest n’edwuma ntsi na ɔbɛɛn owu, na otuu no ho sii hɔ, dɛ ɔbɛma dza aka wɔ hom afamu wɔ mo ho som mu no ahyɛ ma.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Afei dza odzi ekyir a medze sɔw do nye dɛ, mo nuanom, hom ndzi dɛw wɔ Ewuradze mu. Sɛ mekyerɛw asɛm kor no ara brɛ hom bio a, ɔnnhaw me, na hom afamu so, ɔma hom tsim.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Hom nhwɛ yie wɔ mbɔdɔm no ho, hom nhwɛ yie wɔ edwumayɛfo bɔn no ho, hom nhwɛ yie wɔ twatsiatwafo no ho;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: na twatsiatwafo no ara nye hɛn a yɛnam Nyankopɔn Sunsum do som, na yɛhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ Kraest Jesus mu, na yɛmmfa hɛn werɛ nnhyɛ honam mu ndzɛmba mu no.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Nkyɛ mara so mowɔ biribi wɔ honam mu a medze mo werɛ hyɛ mu: na sɛ nyimpa biara bu dɛ ɔwɔ honam mu biribi a ɔdze no werɛ bɛhyɛ mu a, emi mbom na mowɔ no mbordo:
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: hwɛ, wotwaa me twatsia da a otsia awɔtwe no, mifi Israel asefo mu, mifi Benjamin ebusuakuw mu, Hebriwfo mu Hebriwnyi; mbra no afamu a, meyɛ Farisiinyi;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: mbɔdzembɔ afamu a, metaan asɔr no araa yie; mbra mu tsenenee afamu a, minndzi fɔ.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Naaso, dza ɔyɛɛ mfaso maa me no, Kraest ntsi mubuu no ahwerdze.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Nyew, ampaara meda ho mubu ne nyina ahwerdze wɔ m’Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ho nyimdzee kɛse no ntsi. Ne ntsi so nna mubu ndzɛmba nyina ahwerdze, na mubu ne nyina dɛ sumina do wura ama meenya Kraest ayɛ me mfaso,
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: na woeehu me wɔ no mu dɛ minnyi mankasa me tsenenee bi a ofi mbra no mu, na mbom dza ɔnam Kraest ho gyedzi do a, tsenenee a ofi Nyankopɔn hɔ, na ɔnam gyedzi do ba no:
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: ama nkyɛ meehu no yie, nye no wusoɛr tum no, na meenya kyɛfa wɔ n’amandzehu no mu, na ɔaama mayɛ dɛ ɔno wɔ no wu no mu;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: kyerɛkyerɛ me nsa bɛka wusoɛr no a.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Nnyɛ dɛ me nsa enya aka, anaa menya medzi mu dada: na mbom mepem kɔ m’enyim ara dɛ bi a me nsa bɛka dza ɔnam do ma Kraest Jesus so ne nsa aka me no.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Enuanom, mummbu moho dɛ me nsa enya aka, na mbom adze kor na meyɛ, mo werɛ fir dɛm ndzɛmba adadaw no nyina, na motwe mo mu kɔ enyim dze no ho,
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: mepem kɔ kan dɛ mubodu botae no ho, ama meekenya Nyankopɔn no sor frɛ a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu no no konyim akyɛdze no.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, hom mma hɛn mu dodow a yeedzi mu no ndwen dɛm, na sɛ hom dwen biribi fofor bi a, ɔnoara na Nyankopɔn beyi akyerɛ hom:
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: na mbom dza yeedu ho dada no, noara so do na hom mma yendua nnantsew.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Enuanom, hom nsua me, na hom nhyɛ hɔn a wɔnantsew dɛ mbrɛ hom enya hɛn ayɛ fasusu no nsew.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na dodowara wɔ hɔ a maka hom hɔn nantsewee ho asɛm, na seseiara so medze nyinsuwa reka kyerɛ hom, dɛ wɔyɛ Kraest ne mbeamudua no ho atamfo:
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: hɔn ewiei nye ɔsɛɛ, hɔn nyame nye yafun, hɔn ahohyehyɛ wɔ hɔn enyito mu, na hɔn adwen tsim asaase do ndzɛmba nko do.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na hɛn dze, hɛn mantsimadze wɔ sor; na ofi hɔ na hɛn enyi da Ewuradze Jesus Kraest kwan.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Ɔno nna ɔbɛsakyer hɛn ahobrɛadze nyimpadua no ma aasɛ n’enyimnyam nyimpadua, dɛ mbrɛ tum ndzeyɛɛ a ɔdze tum brɛ ndzɛmba nyina adze hyɛ n’ase no tse.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, mo nuanom adɔfo a mafe hom, hom a hom yɛ me dɛw nye m’ahenkyɛw, hom ngyina pintsinn dɛm wɔ Ewuradze mu, m’adɔfo.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Mutu Euodia fo, na mutu Senteke so fo, dɛ wɔnyɛ adwenkor wɔ Ewuradze mu.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na meserɛ wo so, ɔnyɛnko kɔnduahyɛfo nokwafo, boa mbaa dɛm yi a wɔnye me yɛɛ edwuma wɔ asɛmpa no mu no, nye Klement so nye m’anyɛnkofo edwumayɛfo a hɔn dzin wɔ nkwa nwoma no mu no.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Hom ndzi dɛw wɔ Ewuradze mu daa! Misi do bio dɛ, Hom ndzi dɛw!
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Hom mma nyimpa nyina nhu dɛ hom wɔ abodwekyɛr. Ewuradze abɛn.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Mma hom nnyɛ dadwen wɔ biribiara ho, na adze nyina mu hom mfa mpaabɔ nye nkotoserɛ nye ndaase mma hom ebisadze ndu Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn n’asomdwee a ɔtra ntseasee nyina no, ɔbɔweɔn hom akoma nye hom adwen wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na nkaa no, enuanom, dza ɔyɛ nokwar, dza ɔyɛ enyidzi, dza ɔtsen, dza no ho tsew, dza ɔyɛ fɛw, dza ɔwɔ dzin pa biara, sɛ ɔbra pa bi wɔ hɔ a, anaa ayɛyi bi so wɔ hɔ a, hom ndwen dɛm ndzɛmba yi ho.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Dza hom suae, na hom gyee, na hom tsee, na hom hunii wɔ mo mu no, ɔno ara na hom nyɛ, na asomdwee Nyankopɔn no nye hom bɛtsena.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Midzi dɛw kɛse so wɔ Ewuradze mu dɛ hom asan rodwendwen mo ho bio; ɔyɛ nokwar dɛ hom dwen mo ho dada, na adagyer bi na hom ennya ammfa annkyerɛ.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Nnyɛ dɛ ohia ntsi na mereka dɛm, na emi dze, mesua dɛ asetsena biara a mowɔ mu no, mema mo bo dwe mo ho.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Ahokyer mu asetsena a, minyim mu tsena, na minyim ahonya so dze mu tsena. Mesua adze biara nye adze nyina ho kwan a mefa do gyina enyim, ɔmee nye ɔkɔm, ahonya nye ohia.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Mutum adze nyina yɛ wɔ nyia ɔhyɛ me dzen no mu.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Naaso hom yɛɛ no yie dɛ hom bɔboaa me wɔ m’ahohia mu.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na hom Filipifo, homankasa so nyim dɛ, asɛmpa no n’ahyɛse mu a, mifii Masidonia kɔree no, asɔr biara nye me enndzi nkitaho wɔ ɔma nye ɔgye ho dɛ hom nko;
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: na Tesalonika mpo hom somaa prɛko na bio so ma bɔhwɛɛ me hia.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Nnyɛ dɛ morohwehwɛ akyɛdze ntsi a, na mbom morohwehwɛ aba a ɔbɔdɔɔ so ama hom nkontaabu.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na menya adze nyina ma atra do: mayɛ ma, osiandɛ me nsa kaa dza hom dze faa Epafroditus do monaa me no, ɔyɛ ohuam a ɔyɛ dɛw, afɔrbɔ a wɔgye a ɔsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi papa bi.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Na me Nyankopɔn bɛma hom dza hom hia nyina, dɛ mbrɛ n’ahonya wɔ enyimnyam mu tse, wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Afei hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn na enyimnyam nka no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Hom nkyia ahotseweefo no nyina nkorkor wɔ Kraest Jesus mu.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Ahotseweefo no nyina kyiakyia hom, nkanka hɔn a wofi Kaesar fie no.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest adom nka hom sunsum.
title: PHILIPPIANS

text: Paul a ɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ do yɛ Kraest Jesus somafo, nye hɛn nua Timoti,
title: COLOSSIANS

text: dze krataa yi kɛma enuanom ahotseweefo nye agyedzifo wɔ Kraest mu a wɔwɔ Kolosae: Adom nye asomdwee a ofi hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn hɔ nka hom.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Daa yɛbɔ mpaa ma hom a, yɛdze ndaase ma Nyankopɔn, hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest n’Egya no,
title: COLOSSIANS

text: osiandɛ yɛatse hom gyedzi a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu, nye ɔdɔ a hom dze dɔ ahotseweefo no nyina,
title: COLOSSIANS

text: osian enyidado a ɔda hɔ ma hom wɔ sor no; iyi na hom nam asɛmpa no mu nokwasɛm do edzi kan atse.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Ɔno na aba hom hɔ dɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ wiadze nyina so; rosow aba na ɔrodɔɔ so dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse wɔ hom so hom mu, ofitsi da a hom tsee na hom hun Nyankopɔn adom no nokwar mu no.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: dɛ mbrɛ hom suaa no wɔ hɛn ewurakowaa dɔfo Epafras a ɔyɛ Kraest no somfo nokwafo wɔ hɛn afamu no nkyɛn,
title: COLOSSIANS

text: ɔno so na oebeyi hom dɔ a ɔwɔ Sunsum no mu akyerɛ hɛn.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Iyi ntsi na hɛn so ofitsi da no a yɛtsee no yenngyaa dɛ yɛbɔ mpaa, na yɛserɛ ma hom, dɛ ne pɛ ho nyimdzee nhyɛ hom ma, wɔ sunsum mu nyansa nye ntseasee nyina mu;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: ama hom aanantsew dɛ ɔfata Ewuradze na ɔsɔ enyi koraa, na hom aasow edwuma pa nyina mu aba, na hom eenyin wɔ Nyankopɔn ho nyimdzee mu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na wɔdze tum nyina aahyɛ hom dzen, dɛ mbrɛ ahoɔdzen a ɔwɔ n’enyimnyam tumdzi no mu no tse, dze aakɔ abotar, nye penkyɛr nye dɛw nyina mu;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: ama hom aada Egya no ase, ɔno a ɔama yɛafata dɛ yɛnye ahotseweefo a wɔwɔ kan mu no nya kyɛfa wɔ hɔn egyapadze mu no.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Ɔno na oyii hɛn fii sum no tum no ase, na oebetsintsim hɛn wɔ no Dɔba no n’ahenman mu;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: no mu na yeenya ɔpon nye bɔnfakyɛ.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Ɔnoara na ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn a wonntum nnhu no no ne saso, nye abɔdze nyina farbae;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: osiandɛ no mu na wɔbɔɔ adze nyina, dza ɔwɔ sor nye dza ɔwɔ asaase do, dza wohu nye dza wonnhu, ahendzi o, wuradzi o, mpanyindzi o, tumdzi o, adze nyina wɔnam no do bɔe, na wɔbɔe maa no:
title: COLOSSIANS

text: na ɔnoara na ɔyɛ adze nyina mu kandzifo, na no mu na adze nyina abɔ mu etsim.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na ɔno nye nyimpadua a ɔyɛ asɔr no ne tsir: ɔno nye ahyɛse, ewufonyan mu farbae: ma adze nyina mu ɔaayɛ ɔkandzifo,
title: COLOSSIANS

text: osiandɛ ɔsɔɔ Nyankopɔn enyi dɛ n’amayɛ nyina ntsena no mu;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: na ɔnam no do aka ɔnoara ankasa nye ndzɛmba nyina abɔ mu koraa, ɔno nye dɛ, ɔnam ne mbeamudua bɔgyaa no do ayɛ asomdwee, mese, ɔnam no do aka ndzɛmba nyina abɔ mu, dɛ ɔyɛ asaase dze o, ɔsor dze o.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na hom so a nkyɛ mber a abɛsen no, nna hom yɛ etuatsewfo nye atamfo wɔ hom adwen mu, nye ndwuma bɔn mu no,
title: COLOSSIANS

text: afei ɔnam owu do aka ɔno nye hom abɔ mu wɔ no honam nyimpadua no mu, dɛ ɔdze hom besi hɔ dɛ nyimpa krɔnkrɔn a wonndzii dzɛm na asɛm nnyi hom ho wɔ n’enyim;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: sɛ hom bɛtsena gyedzi no mu, egyina hom fapem do, etsintsim, na wɔanntwe hom emmfi asɛmpa no ho enyidado a hom tsee na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ abɔdze nyina a wɔwɔ wiadze yi mu no, a emi Paul meyɛ ho ɔsomfo no mu dze a.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Afei midzi dɛw wɔ amandze a muruhu wɔ hom ntsi no mu, na mo so m’afamu mehyɛ Kraest amandzehu a aka no ma wɔ mo honam mu wɔ ne nyimpadua a ɔyɛ n’asɔr no ntsi;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: ɔno ho na wɔayɛ me ɔsomfo, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn ofihwɛ edwuma no tse, dza ɔdze ama me wɔ hom afamu, dɛ mehyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm no ma.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Nyew, esumasɛm a ofitsi mbersantsen nye mbasantsen nyina mu osumae no afei dze woebeyi akyerɛ n’ahotseweefo no a
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Nyankopɔn pɛ dɛ ɔma wohu esumasɛm yi ho enyimnyam ahonya wɔ amanaman mu, a ɔno nye Kraest a ɔwɔ hom mu no ho enyimnyam enyidado no.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Ɔno na yɛbɔ no dawur, yetu nyimpa nyina fo na yɛkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn wɔ nyansa nyina mu, dɛ yɛdze obiara bopue dɛ wodzi mu wɔ Kraest mu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Ɔno ho so na meyɛ edwuma berɛ, na meper, dɛ mbrɛ n’ahoɔdzen a ɔyɛ mo mu edwuma no tum no tse.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na mepɛ dɛ hom hu aper dzendzen a miridzi no wɔ hom nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Laodikea, nye hɔn a wonnhun m’enyim wɔ honam mu no nyina ho;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: dɛ wɔmma hɔn akoma ntɔ hɔn yamu, wɔntoatoa mu kor wɔ ɔdɔ mu, nnya ntseasee a woesi no tadua ahonya nyina, ama woeehu Nyankopɔn esumasɛm no a ɔno nye Kraest no mu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Ɔno no mu na wɔdze nyansa nye nyimdzee ahonyadze nyina esie.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na mereka iyi amma obi aammfa adɛfɛdɛfɛsɛm annto hom brada.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na kaansa minnyi hɔ honam mu a, menye hom wɔ hɔ wɔ sunsum mu, miridzi dɛw na morohwɛ hom nhyehyɛɛ nyɛbea, nye hom gyedzi a ɔwɔ Kraest mu mbrɛ osi tsim.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi dɛ mbrɛ hom gyee Kraest Jesus Ewuradze no, hom nnantsew no mu dɛmara:
title: COLOSSIANS

text: hom ngye ndwow, osiandɛ wɔdze hom esi no mu, na hom ntsim wɔ gyedzi mu dɛ mbrɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ hom no, na hom mbor do wɔ ndaase mu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Hom nhwɛ yie mma obi aammfa nyansapɛ nye ndaadaa hun a ɔnam nyimpa tsetsesɛm, nye wiadze esunsum mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ do, na mbom ɔnnam Kraest mu, ammbɛfa hom ndɔmmum:
title: COLOSSIANS

text: osiandɛ Kraest mu na Nyame ankasa n’amayɛ no tse wɔ nyimpadua no mu,
title: COLOSSIANS

text: na ɔno a ɔyɛ mpanyindzi nye tumdzi nyina hɔn tsir no mu na hom ayɛ ma.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Ɔnoara so mu na woetwa hom twatsia a wɔnndze nsa twae, na dza ɔwɔ hom nyimpadua mu a woyi gu no, woeyi wɔ Kraest twatsiatwa mu:
title: COLOSSIANS

text: na dɛ woesie ɔno nye hom wɔ enuma mu, no mu so na hom so nye no asoɛr ɔnam gyedzi a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn a onyaan no fii ewufo mu no no tum adwuma do.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na hom a nkyɛ hom ewu osian hom mfom nye hom honam a wonntwaa no twatsia ntsi, hom na ɔama hom nye no enya nkwa, dɛ ɔdze hɛn mfom nyina akyɛ hɛn;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: na ɔapepa ahyɛdze no mu nkyerɛwee a otsia hɛn no, na ɔdze akɔbɔ mbeamudua no ho eyi no wɔ kwan mu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Oyi na otuu mpanyindzi nye tumdzi gui no, oyii hɔn kyerɛe wɔ baguamu na odzii hɔn do konyim wɔ mu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi mma obi mmbu hom atsɛn wɔ edziban anaa anondze mu, anaa afahyɛ da, anaa bosoom fofor, anaa ahomgyeda afamu:
title: COLOSSIANS

text: osiandɛ wɔyɛ ndzɛmba a ɔbɛba no ho mfonyi bi ara, na papa no ara dze, ɔno nye Kraest.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Hom mma obi nndua enyido ahobrɛadze nye abɔfosom do mma hom mbɔdzembɔ akyɛdze mmbɔ hom, dɛ ɔtsena ndzɛmba a onnhu mu, na ɔhoran kwa wɔ no honam adwen mu,
title: COLOSSIANS

text: naaso onnsuo tsir no a ofi mu na nyimpadua no nyina nam akwaa nye ntsin biara do nya edziban na ɔtoatoa mu nyin wɔ nyin a ofi Nyankopɔn mu no mu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom nye Kraest wui fi wiadze sunsum mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ ho a, ɔyɛ dɛn na hom dze ahyɛdze no to hom do, dɛ hom da ho tse wiadze, dɛ,
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Mma mmfa nsa nnsuo mu, mma nnsɔ nnhwɛ, mma mmfa wo nsa nnka?
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Dɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ yi nyina yɛ dza ɔkyerɛ ndzɛmbahun wɔ nyimpa ahyɛdze nye nkyerɛkyerɛ afamu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Dza ndzɛmba yi yɛ ara nye dɛ wɔrekyerɛ nyansa wɔ enyidosom nye ahobrɛadzehun nye etsiɔdzen a wɔyɛ tsia honam; a ɔmmfa mfaso biara mmba, na mbom ne nyinara yɛ dza ɔhyɛ honam akɔndɔ ma.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ hom enya nye Kraest asoɛr a, hom nhwehwɛ dza ɔwɔ sor beebi a Kraest tse no, wɔ Nyankopɔn abanyimfa no.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Hom mfa hom adwen ngyina dza ɔwɔ sor do, na nnyɛ dza ɔwɔ asaase do a.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na hom wui, na wɔdze hom nkwa aka Kraest ho esuma Nyankopɔn mu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na ber a hom nkwa a ɔyɛ Kraest bɛda edzi no, hom so nye no bopue enyimnyam mu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nku wiadze akɔndɔ a ɔwɔ hom mfafakuwa mu no; ndwamansɛm, efifidze, akɔndɔ nhyɛdo, akɔndɔ bɔn nye enyiber a no so yɛ abosonsɔr.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Iyinom ntsi na Nyankopɔn ebufuw ba (seanntse mba do);
title: COLOSSIANS

text: dza nkan no a hom tse mu no hom nantseew mu no.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na afei so hom nyi yinom nyina ngu; ebufuw, ebufuhyew, akomadzen, etutuwpɛ, enyimguasesɛm mfi hom anomu:
title: COLOSSIANS

text: mma hom nndzidzi ator nnkyerɛkyerɛ homho, osiandɛ hom eyi nyimpa dadaw no nye ne ndzeyɛe no egu;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: na hom ahyɛ nyimpa fofor a wɔayɛ no fofor aba nyimdzee mapa mu, a ogyina nyia ɔbɔɔ no no ne saso do no;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: mbrɛ Griiknyi nye Jewnyi, twatsiatwa nye monomonomyɛ, pɔtɔfo nye Sitianyi, akowaa nye ɔdehye, bi nnyi hɔ, na mbom Kraest nye adze nyina wɔ hɔn nyina mu no.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom a hom yɛ hɔn a Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi hom, ahotseweefo nye adɔfo no, hom nhyɛ ayamuhyehye, tsimbɔbɔr, ayamuyie, ahobrɛadze, ɔdwe nye penkyɛr.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Sɛ obi wɔ obi ho asɛm bi a, hom ntsetse mma homho, na hom mfa nkyekyɛ homho nkorkor; dɛ mbrɛ Kraest dze akyɛ hom no, dɛmara na hom so nyɛ:
title: COLOSSIANS

text: na iyinom nyina do no hom nhyɛ ɔdɔ a ɔma ndzɛmba nyina wie pɛyɛ no.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na hom mma Kraest asomdwee no ndzi hen wɔ hom akoma mu, ɔno so na wɔafrɛ hom aba ho, wɔ nyimpadua kor mu. Na mma hom nnyɛ etsiafo.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Hom mma Kraest n’asɛm no ntsena hom mu pii, na hom mfa nsankundwom, nye ayɛyindwom, nye sunsum mu ndwom nkyerɛkyerɛ, na hom nkasa nkyerɛ homho nkorkor ntow ndwom adom do wɔ hom akoma mu mma Nyankopɔn.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na biribiara a hom yɛ no, kasa mu o, ndzeyɛe mu o, hom nyɛ ne nyina wɔ Ewuradze Jesus dzin mu, na hom ndua no do nda Nyankopɔn Egya no ase.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Yernom, hom mbrɛ homho adze mma hom kunnom, dɛm na ɔsɛ wɔ Ewuradze mu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Kunnom, hom ndɔ hom yernom na mma hom nnyɛ hɔn yerɛyerɛw.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Mba, hom ntsie hom awofo asɛm wɔ adze nyina mu na iyi na ɔsɔ enyi wɔ Ewuradze mu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Egyanom, mma hom nnyɛ hom mba heihei amma hɔn abaw mu aanngow.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Nkowaa, hom ntsie hom honam afamu ewuranom asɛm wɔ adze nyina mu; nnyɛ enyiwadosom mu, dɛ hom rosɔ nyimpa enyi, na mbom akoma kor mu, dɛ hom suro Ewuradze:
title: COLOSSIANS

text: na biribiara a hom yɛ no, hom mfi akoma mu nyɛ edwuma dɛ hom yɛ ma Ewuradze, na nnyɛ nyimpa;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: osiandɛ hom nyim dɛ Ewuradze hɔ na hom benya egyapadze akatua no, osiandɛ Ewuradze Kraest na hom som no.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na nyia ɔyɛ dza ɔnntsen no, dza ɔnntsen a ɔayɛ no ara na obenya bio: na nyimpa enyimhwɛ bi nnyi hɔ.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Ewuranom, hom mfa dza ɔtsen na ɔfa kwan mu mma hom nkowaa, osiandɛ hom so wɔ owura wɔ sor.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Hom nkura asɔryɛ mu dzen ara, na hom mfa ndaase nweɔn wɔ mu;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: na hom mbɔ mpaa mma hɛn so, ma Nyankopɔn mbue asɛm no ano mma hɛn; ma yɛnka Kraest esumasɛm a osian ntsi ma meda nkyehoma mu no;
title: COLOSSIANS

text: ama meeyi ato gua dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ me dɛ mekasa.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Hom nnantsew nyansa mu wɔ hɔn a wɔwɔ nkyɛn no afamu, na mma hom nsɛɛ hom ber kwa.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Hom mma hom kasaa nyɛ dza adom nkyen wɔ mu daa, ama hom eehu dza ɔsɛ dɛ hom dze bua obiara.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Mo ho nsɛm nyina dze, Tikikus, onua dɔfo a ɔyɛ ɔsomfo nokwafo nye m’ewurakowaa wɔ Ewuradze mu no bɛka akyerɛ hom.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Ɔno na iyiara ntsi masoma no hom nkyɛn, ama hom eehu hɛn asetsena mu, na ɔaaka hom akoma ato hom yamu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Onɛsimɔs, onua nokwafo dɔfo a ofi hom mu no ka no ho: hɔn na wɔbɛma hom ehu ha nsɛm nyina.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Aristarkus a ɔyɛ me nyɛnko mpokyerɛnyi no kyia hom, nye Mark, Barnabas n’awɔfase a hom enya no ho nkra dada dɛ, (sɛ ɔba hom nkyɛn a, hom ngye no no;)
title: COLOSSIANS

text: nye Jesus a wɔfrɛ no Justus no kyia hom. Woyinom nko nye hɔn a wofi twatsiatwa mu nye me ayɛ edwuma wɔ Nyankopɔn ahendzi no ho; na wɔakyekye mo werɛ pii.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Kraest n’akowaa Epafras a ofi hom mu no kyia hom, odzi aper ma hom daa wɔ mpaabɔ mu, dɛ hom ngyina hɔ pi, na hom nhyɛ ma wɔ Nyankopɔn ne pɛ nyina mu.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na midzi no dase dɛ ɔbɔɔ mbɔdzen pii maa hom nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Laodikea nye hɔn a wɔwɔ Hierapolis.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Luke, oduyɛfo dɔfo no, nye Demas kyia hom.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Hom nkyia enuanom a wɔwɔ Laodikea nye Nimfas nye asɔr a ɔwɔ ne fie no.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na sɛ wɔkenkan nwoma yi wɔ hom mu wie a, hom mma wɔnkɛkenkan no Laodikea asɔr mu so, na hom so nkenkan dza ofi Laodikea no.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Na hom nse Arkipus dɛ, Hwɛ ɔsom a wo nsa aka no Ewuradze mu no yie, na aayɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛr.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Nkyia a emi mara Paul medze me nsa kyerɛwee nye yi. Hom nkaa mo mpokyerɛ no. Adom nka hom nyina.
title: COLOSSIANS

text: Paul nye Silvanus nye Timoti dze kɛma Tesalonika asɔr a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn Egya no nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest mu no: Adom nye asomdwee nka hom.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Yɛda Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ hom nyina ntsi, yɛbɔ hom dzin wɔ hɛn asɔryɛ mu;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: na daa yɛkaa hom gyedzi ndwuma nye hom dɔ mbɔdzembɔ, nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest mu enyidado ho abotar, wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Egya no enyim;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: na, enuanom a Nyankopɔn adɔ hom, yenyim ɔsan a ɔasan mu eyi hom,
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: osiandɛ hɛn asɛmpa no ammba hom nkyɛn dɛ kasa ara kwa, na mbom ɔbae wɔ tum mu, nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn mu, nye ntseasee pii mu; dɛ mbrɛ hom nyim hɛn nyimpa ban a yɛdaa no edzi dɛ yɛyɛ wɔ hom afamu no.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na hom so suaa hɛn nye Ewuradze, dze Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ne dɛw no gyee asɛm no wɔ ahohia pii mu;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: na hom bɛyɛɛ fasusu maa hɔn a wɔgye dzi nyina wɔ Masidonia nye Akaia nyina.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na ofi hom mu na Nyankopɔn n’asɛm no apetse, nnyɛ Masidonia nye Akaia nko, na mbom mbea nyina so hom gyedzi a ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn afamu ekodu hɔ, ma onnhia dɛ yɛka ho asɛm bi mpo.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na hɔnara ka hɛn ho asɛm kyerɛ kwan kor a yenyae wɔ hom mu, na mbrɛ hom danee fii ehonyisom ho baa Nyankopɔn hɔ, dɛ hom robɔsom Nyankopɔn tseasefo nokwafo no,
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: na hom atweɔn ne Ba a onyaan no fii ewufo mu no efi sor, mekyerɛ Jesus a ɔgye hɛn fi ebufuw a ɔreba no mu no.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Enuanom, homankasa nyim dɛ hom nkyɛn a yɛbae no annyɛ gyan:
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: na yeedzi kan ehu amandze pii na wɔabɔ hɛn adapaa, wɔ Filipi dɛ mbrɛ hom nyim no, naaso yɛyɛɛ ndam wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn mu dɛ yɛbɛka Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no akyerɛ hom wɔ ɔko pii mu.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na hɛn afotusɛm mmfi mfom anaadɛ efifidze, anaa ndaadaa mu:
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: na dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn ebu hɛn bi dɛ ɔdze asɛmpa no ahyɛ hɛn nsa no, dɛmara na yɛkasa; nnyɛ dɛ yɛsɔ nyimpa enyi, na mbom Nyankopɔn a ɔsɔ adze nyina hwɛ no a.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ hom nyim, na Nyankopɔn nye hɛn dasefo no; yɛannka adɛfɛdɛfɛsɛm da eso yɛammfa asɛm bi annkata hɛn enyiber do,
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: eso yɛannhwehwɛ nyimpa enyimnyam wɔ hom anaa binom hɔ,
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: nkyɛ ɔfata dɛ yɛyɛ Kraest asomfo yi, yebisa biribi fi hom hɔ, mbom yɛyɛɛ abrɛfo wɔ hom mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔbagyegyefo bi nyɛn nankasa ne mba:
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: na ɔnam dɛ yɛdɔ hom dodoodow ntsi, yɛpɛɛ dɛ nnyɛ Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no nko na yɛbɛkyɛ ama hom, na hɛnankasa hɛn akra so mpo, osiandɛ hom ho hiaa hɛn dodow.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na enuanom, hom kaa hɛn mbɔdzembɔ nye fona: na yɛyɛɛ edwuma adzesaa nye adzekyee, amma yaannyɛ adzesoadze amma hom mu biara, na yɛdze kaa Nyankopɔn asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ hom.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Hom na Nyankopɔn nye adasefo, mbrɛ yeduae bɔɔ hɛn bra, dɛ afɔbu biara nnyi mu, krɔnkrɔn mu, tsenenee mu, maa hom a hom gye dzi no,
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: dɛ hom nyim mbrɛ yetutuu hom fo nkorkor dɛ egya nye mba, na yɛhyɛɛ hom dzen, na yedzii dase,
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: dɛ hom nnantsew dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔafrɛ hom akɔ n’ahendzi nye n’enyimnyam mu no.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Iyi so ntsi, yɛkɔ do ara da Nyankopɔn ase, osiandɛ hom gyee Nyankopɔn asɛm no wɔ hɛn hɔ no, hom anngye no dɛ nyimpa asɛm, na mbom dɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm, na dɛmara so na ɔtse ampa, iyi ara so na ɔyɛ hom a hom gye dzi no mu edwuma.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na hom, enuanom, yɛɛ Nyankopɔn asɔr a ɔwɔ Judea wɔ Kraest Jesus mu no esuafo: osiandɛ hom so hun homankasa hom mamfoo nsamu amandze dɛmara dɛ mbrɛ hɔn so hunii wɔ Judafo nsamu;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: hɔn na wokum Ewuradze Jesus nye nkɔnhyɛfo no, na wɔapempam hɛn, na wɔnnsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi, na wotsia nyimpa nyina;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: wɔbra hɛn dɛ mma yɛnnkasa nnkyerɛ amanamamfo mma wonnya nkwa; ama wɔaama hɔn bɔn ayɛ ma daa: naaso ebufuw no enya aba hɔn do ewie.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na hɛn dze, enuanom, woyii hɛn fii hom nkyɛn mber kakraabi wɔ enyido na nnyɛ akoma mu no, mbrɛ yeduae fee hom a, na yɛbɔɔ mbɔdzen pii dɛ yebohu hom enyim bio:
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: osiandɛ yɛpɛɛ dɛ nkyɛ yɛba hom nkyɛn, mankasa Paul, prɛko nye mpɛn ebien; na abɔnsam siiw hɛn kwan.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na ebɛnadze nye hɛn enyidado, anaadɛ enyigye, anaadɛ ahohyehyɛ abɔtsir? Ana nnyɛ homara wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Kraest enyim wɔ ne ba mu?
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Nyew, hom nye hɛn enyimnyam nye hɛn enyigye.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi yenntum nnhyɛ hɛn ho do bio no, yɛdween dɛ oye dɛ wogya hɛn nko ekyir wɔ Atens;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: na yɛsomaa Timoti a ɔyɛ hɛn nua nye nyɛnkodwumayɛnyi ma Nyankopɔn wɔ Kraest asɛmpa no mu no dɛ ɔmbɛhyɛ hom dzen, na ɔnkyekye hom werɛ wɔ gyedzi no ho;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: amma amandzehu yi eennhihim obiara; na homankasa nyim dɛ woeyi hɛn ato hɔ ama dɛm.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na yɛwɔ hom nkyɛn no yɛkaa kyerɛɛ hom siee dɛ yebohu amandze; dɛ mbrɛ ɔbaa mu, na hom nyim no.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Iyi ntsi na mo so munntum nnhyɛ moho do bio no, mosomae ma meehu hom gyedzi amma bi a ɔgyegyefo no aanngyegye hom na hɛn mbɔdzembɔ aannyɛ kwa.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na afei Timoti fi hom nkyɛn baa hɛn nkyɛn bɛkaa hom gyedzi nye hom dɔ ho nsɛm pa kyerɛɛ hɛn. Na ɔkaa dɛ hom kaa hɛn yie daa, na hom pɛ dɛ hom hu hɛn dɛ mbrɛ hɛn so yɛafe hom na yɛpɛ dɛ yehu hom no kyerɛɛ hɛn.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Iyi ntsi enuanom, hɛn werɛ kyekye wɔ hom nyina ho, wɔ hɛn amandzehu nye hɛn ahohia nyina mu, wɔ hom gyedzi ntsi.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na afei sɛ hom gyina pintsinn wɔ Ewuradze mu a, yeenya nkwa.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na hom ho ndaase bɛn na yebotum ada Nyankopɔn bio, wɔ dɛw nyina a yedzi wɔ hom ntsi wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: dɛ adzesaa nye adzekyee yɛreserɛ pii dɛ yembohu hom enyim ma yaabɛhyɛ dza aka wɔ hom gyedzi mu no ma?
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na hɛn Nyankopɔn a ɔnoara nye Egya no, nye hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ntsen hɛn kwan mbra hom nkyɛn.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na Ewuradze mma hom ndɔɔ so na hom mbor do wɔ dɔ mu mma homho nkorkor, nye nyimpa nyina, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn so yɛyɛ ma hom no;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: na ɔaahyɛ hom akoma dzen, dɛ afɔbu nnyi mu, krɔnkrɔnyɛ mu wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Egya no enyim, wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nye n’ahotseweefo hɔn ba mu.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Ewiei no, enuanom, yɛserɛ hom na yetu hom fo wɔ Ewuradze Jesus mu dɛ, mbrɛ hom nyaa no hɛn hɔ mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ hom nantsew na hom sɔ Nyankopɔn enyi no, dɛ mbrɛ hom yɛ yi ara, dɛmara na hom mbor do pii.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na homankasa hom nyim ahyɛdze a yɛnam Ewuradze Jesus do hyɛɛ hom no.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na iyi nye Nyankopɔn ne pɛ, dɛ hom ahotsew ntsi, hom nyi homho mfi ndwamansɛm ho;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: dɛ hom mu biara bohu mbrɛ obesi nye ne yer atsena wɔ ahotsew nye enyidzi mu.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Nnyɛ akɔndɔ nhyɛdo mu dɛ amanamamfo a wonnyim Nyankopɔn;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: amma obiara eemmbu do ennkesisi no nua wɔ asɛm no mu, osiandɛ Ewuradze nye yinom nyina ho werdzifo, dɛ mbrɛ yɛbɔɔ hom nkaa nkan no, na yedzii ho dase no.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn ammfrɛ hɛn annkɔ efifidze mu, na mbom ahotsew mu a.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi nyia ɔpow iyi no, nnyɛ nyimpa bi na ɔpow no, na Nyankopɔn a ɔdze no Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn ama hom no a.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na enuadɔ ho dze, onnhia hom dɛ obi kyerɛw brɛ hom; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn akyerɛkyerɛ homankasa dɛ hom ndodɔ homho.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na ampa so hom yɛ no wɔ enuanom a wɔwɔ Masidonia nyina ho. Naaso enuanom, yetu hom fo, dɛ hom mbor do pii;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: na hom mbɔ mbɔdzen nyɛ komm na hom nyɛ homankasa hom adze, na hom mfa hom nsa nyɛ edwuma, dɛ mbrɛ yɛhyɛɛ hom no;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: na hom aanantsew dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata wɔ hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir no enyim, na biribi eennhia hom.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Enuanom, wɔ hɔn a wɔadeda no ho dze, yɛmmpɛ dɛ yɛdze asɛm bi sie hom amma hom eenndzi awerɛhow dɛ nkaa no a wonnyi enyidado no.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na sɛ yɛgye dzi dɛ Jesus wui na ɔsoɛɛr bio a, dɛmara so na Nyankopɔn dze hɔn a wɔadeda wɔ Jesus mu bɛka no ho aba.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na iyi dze, yɛnam Ewuradze asɛm do ka kyerɛ hom dɛ, hɛn a yɛtse ase, na yɛretsena ase ekodu Ewuradze ne mbae mu no, yennkotwar hɔn a wɔadeda no ano.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Osiandɛ Ewuradze nankasa dze frɛ kɛse, nye bɔfopanyin no ne ndze, nye Nyankopɔn akasamu no fi sor besian, na Kraest mu ewufo bedzi kan asoɛr;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: ansaana wɔaabɛfa hɛn a yɛtsetse ase na yɛaka no aka hɔn ho wɔ nsuwusiw no mu ma yeekehyia Ewuradze wɔ wimu, na dɛm na yɛnye Ewuradze bɛtsena daa.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mfa nsɛm yi nkyekyekye hom werɛ nkorkor.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na nda no nye mber no ho dze, enuanom, onnhia hom dɛ wɔkyerɛw biribi brɛ hom.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Osiandɛ homankasa nyim pefee dɛ Ewuradze ne da no bɛba dɛ mbrɛ owifo ba anadwe.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na ber a wɔrese dɛ, Asomdwee nye ahotɔ no, nna awerɛfir sɛɛ bɛba hɔn do dɛ mbrɛ awoko ba ɔbaa a onyinsen do; na wonnkefi nsa.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na hom dze, enuanom, hom nnyi sum mu, nna da no abɔto hom dɛ owifo.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Hom nyina yɛ kan mba nye adzekyee mba; yɛnnyɛ adzesaa anaa sum mba.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi mma hom mma yɛnndeda dɛ nkaa no, na mbom hom mma yɛnweɔn na hɛn enyi nda hɔ.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na hɔn a wɔda da anadwe; na hɔn a wɔbow bow anadwe.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na hɛn dze, yɛyɛ adzekyee mba ntsi, hom mma hɛn enyi nda hɔ, yɛnhyɛ gyedzi nye ɔdɔ dɛ akatabo, nye nkwagye ho enyidado no dɛ dadzekyɛw.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na Nyankopɔn ennyi hɛn annto hɔ amma ebufuw, na mbom dɛ yebenya nkwagye a ɔnam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest do.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Ɔno na owui maa hɛn ama sɛ yɛtse ase o, yewu o, yɛnye no nyina aatsena ase.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nhyɛ hom ho nkuran nkorkor, na hom mboa hom ho nkorkor dɛ mbrɛ hom reyɛ yi ara.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na yɛserɛ hom, enuanom, dɛ hom ndzi hɔn a wɔyɛ hom mu edwuma no nyi, na wodzi hom do mpanyin wɔ Ewuradze mu, na wɔkasa kyerɛ hom no.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Hom mfa ɔdɔ mbu hɔn papaapa, osian hɔn edwuma no ntsi. Hom ntsena asomdwee mu.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na yetu hom fo so, enuanom, dɛ hom nkasa nkyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ basabasa, hom nkyekye hɔn a hɔn akoma apa werɛ, hom nwowaw hɔn a wɔyɛ mberɛw, na hom nyɛ penkyɛr wɔ nyimpa nyina afamu.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Hom nhwɛ mma obi ammfa bɔn enntua obi bɔn kaw; na mbom hom ndzi dza oye ekyir daa, wɔ hom ho nkorkor nye nyimpa nyina afamu.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Hom enyi ngye daa;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: mma hom nngyaa mpaabɔ da;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: adze nyina mu hom nda ase: na iyi nye Nyankopɔn ne pɛ wɔ Kraest Jesus mu wɔ hom ho.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Mma hom nndum Sunsum no;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: mma hom mmbu nkɔnhyɛsɛm enyimtsia;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: mbom hom nsɔ adze nyina nhwɛ; hom nsuo dza oye mu dzen;
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: hom ntwe homho mfi bɔn biara ho.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Na ɔno asomdwee Nyankopɔn nankasa nsan hom ho koraa, na ɔnkora hom sunsum nye kra nye nyimpadua do dɛ asɛm bi nnyi ho wɔ Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne ba mu.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Ɔnokwafo nye nyia ɔafrɛ hom no, na ɔnoara so na ɔbɛyɛ.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Enuanom, hom mbɔ mpaa mma hɛn.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Hom mfa etuwyɛ krɔnkrɔn nkyiakyia enuanom nyina.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Medze Ewuradze no tum hyɛ hom dɛ hom nkenkan nwoma yi nkyerɛ enuanom no nyina.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Ewuradze Jesus Kraest n’adom nka hom.
title: 1ST THESSALONIANS

text: Paul nye Silvanus nye Timoti dze kɛma Tesalonika asɔrasɔr a wɔwɔ hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest mu no;
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: adom nye asomdwee a ofir Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest hɔ nka hom.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Enuanom, ɔsɛ hɛn dɛ yɛda Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ hom ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ ɔfata, osiandɛ hom gyedzi rinyin mbordo, na dɔ a hom nyina dze dodɔ homho nkorkor no adɔɔ so;
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: na ɔma hɛnankasa so yɛhyehyɛ hɛnho wɔ hom mu wɔ Nyankopɔn asɔrasɔr mu wɔ hom abotar nye gyedzi a ɔwɔ hom ahohia nye amandzehu a hom rosɔw nyina mu ntsi;
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: ɔno na ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn atsɛn tsenenee sɛnkyerɛdze a ɔda gua, ama woeebu hom dɛ hom sɛ Nyankopɔn ahendzi a hom ruhu ho amandze no.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Osiandɛ ɔtsen wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim dɛ ɔdze ahohia tua hɔn a wohiahia hom ho no kaw,
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: na hom a worihiahia hom ho dze, ɔma hom nye hɛn ahomgye, wɔ da bi a Ewuradze Jesus Kraest beyi noho efi sor, nye no tum abɔfo,
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: wɔ gyaframee mu, na oebotua hɔn a wonnyim Nyankopɔn na wonntsie hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest asɛmpa no kaw.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Hɔn na wobenya akatua bɔn, ɔsɛɛ a onnyi ewiei, efi Ewuradze enyim, nye n’ahoɔdzen enyimnyam no ho,
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: ber a ɔbɛba ma wɔaahyɛ no enyimnyam wɔ n’ahotseweefo mu, na wɔaahwɛ no dɛ anwanwadze wɔ hɔn a wɔgye dzi nyina mu, osiandɛ wɔagye hɛn dasee a yedzii no wɔ hom mu no edzi wɔ da no mu.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi so na yɛsɔr ma hom daa dɛ, hɛn Nyankopɔn mbu hom dɛ hom sɛ hom frɛ, na ɔmma n’ayamuyie enyisɔ, nye gyedzi edwuma no nyɛ ma wɔ hom mu;
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: na wɔaahyɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus dzin enyimnyam wɔ hom mu, nye hom so wɔ no mu, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest n’adom tse.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Afei enuanom, ɔfa hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne mbae no, na dɛ yɛbɔboa ano ehyia ne nkyɛn dze, yɛkotow serɛ hom dɛ,
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: mma hom mma wonndua sunsum anaa asɛm, anaa nwoma bi a ɔwɔ dɛ ofi hɛn hɔ do nndan hom adwen ntsɛm, anaa nntu hom akoma dɛ gyama Kraest da no enya edu.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Mma obiara nndaadaa hom wɔ biribiara ho, osiandɛ da no nnkɛba, gyedɛ gyedzi ho asehwe no aba ana, na woeyi omumuyɛnyi no edzi, mekyerɛ, ɔsɛɛ ba no a.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Ɔhoran noho, ɔmema noho do tsia dza wɔfrɛ no onyame biara, anaa dza wɔsɔr no nyina, ma ɔtsena Nyankopɔn asɔrdan mu dze noho kyerɛ dɛ ɔno nye Nyankopɔn no.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Ana hom nkaa dɛ mowɔ hom nkyɛn no mekaa yinom nyina kyerɛɛ hom?
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Na afei hom nyim dza osiw kwan, ama woeeyi no akyerɛ wɔ nankasa n’aber do.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Na mbrato esumasɛm no enya reyɛ edwuma, na obi na orisiw kwan ma ekodu dɛ wobeyi no hɔ.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Nna nkyii wobeyi nyia onndzi mbra biara do no akyerɛ, ɔno na Ewuradze Jesus dze n’anomu ehubɔw boku no, na ɔdze ne mbae no mpuei bɛma ɔaasɛɛ.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Ɔno ne mbae no ɔnam abɔnsam edwuma do ba, wɔ tum nye nsɛnkyerɛdze nye ator anwanwadze nyina mu,
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: nye dza ɔnntsen ndaadaa nyina mu ma hɔn a wɔreyew no, osiandɛ wɔapow dɛ wɔbɔdɔ nokwar ma wɔaagye hɔn nkwa.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Iyi ntsi na Nyankopɔn soma ndaadaa dwumadzi ba hɔn mu ama wɔaagye atorsɛm edzi:
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: na woeebu hɔn a wɔanngye nokwar no enndzi na mbom hɔn enyi sɔɔ dza ɔnntsen no nyina atsɛn.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Na hɛn dze, ɔsɛ hɛn dɛ yɛda Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ hom ntsi, enuanom a Ewuradze dɔ hom, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn fi ahyɛse yii hom kɔr nkwagye mu wɔ Sunsum ahosan nye nokwar gyedzi a
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: ɔnam hɛn asɛmpa no do afrɛ hom aba mu, ma hom eenya Kraest Jesus enyimnyam no.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, hom ngyina pintsinn na hom nsuo atsetsesɛm a yɛnam asɛm anaa nwoma do kyerɛkyerɛɛ hom no mu.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Afei hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nankasa nye Egya Nyankopɔn a ɔdɔɔ hɛn na ɔmaa hɛn onnyiewiei awerɛkyekyer nye enyidado pa a ɔnam adom do no,
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: ɔnka hom akoma nto mu na ontsintsim hom wɔ asɛm nye edwuma pa nyina mu.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Dza aka no, enuanom, hom mbɔ mpaa mma hɛn, ama Ewuradze n’asɛm no atserɛw ntsɛntsɛm na wɔahyɛ no enyimnyam wɔ beebiara dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse wɔ hom nkyɛn no;
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: na wɔngye hɛn mfi nyimpabɔnfo nye emumuyɛfo nsamu, osiandɛ nnyɛ nyimpa nyina na wɔwɔ gyedzi no.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Na Ewuradze yɛ ɔnokwafo, ɔbɛma hom etsim, na ɔakora hom do wɔ omumuyɛnyi no ho.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Na yɛwɔ Ewuradze mu awerɛhyɛmu wɔ hom ho dɛ hom reyɛ dza yɛakyerɛ hom no, eso hom bɔkɔ do ayɛ.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Na Ewuradze ngya hom akoma nkɔ Nyankopɔn ho dɔ nye penkyɛr a Kraest dze ma no mu.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Afei yɛhyɛ hom, enuanom, wɔ Jesus Kraest dzin mu, dɛ hom ntwe homho mfi onua biara a ɔnantsew basabasa, na onndzi tsetse nkyerɛkyerɛ a yɛdze maa hom no do ho.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Na homankasa hom nyim dɛ ɔsɛ dɛ hom suasua hɛn; osiandɛ yɛannyɛ akwadwer wɔ hom mu;
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: eso yenndzi obiara nsamu edziban kwa, na mbom mbɔdzembɔ mu nye ɔberɛ mu na yɛyɛɛ edwuma adzekyee nye adzesaa, amma yaannyɛ adzesoadze amma hom mu biara:
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: nnyɛ dɛ yennyi ho kwan bi a, na mbom ama yɛdze hɛnho aayɛ fasusu ma hom esua hɛn.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Na yɛwɔ hom nkyɛn no, yɛhyɛɛ hom dɛ, Sɛ obi mmpɛ dɛ ɔyɛ edwuma a, na eso mma onndzidzi.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Na yɛtse dɛ binom wɔ hɔ a wɔnantsew basabasa wɔ hom mu, wɔnnyɛ edwuma na mbom wɔyɛ apɛsɛmedzifo.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Na hɔn a wɔtse dɛm no, yɛhyɛ hɔn na yetu hɔn fo wɔ Ewuradze Jesus mu dɛ wɔnyɛ foo nyɛ edwuma na wondzi hɔnankasa hɔn edziban.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Na hom dze, enuanom, mma hom mmberɛ wɔ papayɛ mu.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Na sɛ obi enntsie hɛn asɛm a ɔwɔ nwoma yi mu no a, hom nhyɛ no nsew na mma hom nnye no mmbɔ fɛkuw, na n’enyi nto.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Naaso mma hom mmbu no ɔtamfo, mbom hom ntu no fo dɛ onua.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Na afei asomdwee Ewuradze nankasa mma hom asomdwee daa wɔ adze nyina mu. Ewuradze nye hom nyina ntsena.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Emi Paul me nkyia a medze mankasa me nsa akyerɛw no nye yi. Iyi nye m’ahyɛnsewdze wɔ krataa biara a mekyerɛw ho, kwan a mefa do kyerɛw nye yi.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest adom nka hom nyinara.
title: 2ND THESSALONIANS

text: Paul, Kraest Jesus somafo, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn Agyenkwa Nyame nye hɛn enyidado Kraest Jesus n’ahyɛdze tse;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: dze kɛma Timoti, mo nokwar ba wɔ gyedzi mu; Adom, mbɔbɔrhu nye asomdwee mfi Egya Nyankopɔn nye Kraest Jesus hɛn Ewuradze hɔ nka wo.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Dɛ mbrɛ morokɔ Masidonia a meserɛɛ wo dɛ tsena Efeso na eetu binom fo, amma wɔaamma nkyerɛkyerɛ fofor bi,
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: na eso woeenntsie anansesɛm nye nananom edzin a wɔkan a wonnwie da a ɔdze nsɛmbisa ba kyɛn Nyankopɔn ne fihwɛ a ɔwɔ gyedzi mu no; dɛmara so na meyɛ no sesei.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na ahyɛdze no no botae nye ɔdɔ a ofi akoma a no mu tsew mu nye tsibowa pa nye nokwar gyedzi mu no.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Ɔno na binom apaa efi ho akɔ nsɛnhun mu;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: wɔpɛ dɛ wɔyɛ mbrakyerɛfo, naaso wɔnntse dza hɔnara wɔka no ase, na dza wɔhom do dzendzen ka ho asɛm no so wonnyim n’adzeban.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na hɛn dze, yenyim dɛ mbra no, sɛ obi dzi do nokwar mu a, oye,
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: dɛ yenyim dɛ mbra wɔnnhyɛ nnto hɔ mma ɔtseneneenyi, na mbom wɔhyɛe maa mbratofo nye asoɔdzenfo, hɔn a wonnsuro Nyankopɔn, nye ndzebɔnyɛfo, hɔn a hɔn ho nntsew, nye hɔn a hɔn ho egu fi, hɔn a woku hɔn egyanom nye hɔn nanom, nye nyimpakumfo nyina,
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: ndwaman, hɔn a wɔnye mbarimba deda, edwotwafo, atorfo, ntamtofo, ɔnye biribiara a otsia nkyerɛkyerɛ pa no;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: dɛ mbrɛ Osiarfo Nyankopɔn n’enyimnyam asɛmpa a wɔdze hyɛɛ me nsa no tse.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na meda Kraest Jesus, hɛn Ewuradze a ɔhyɛɛ me dzen no dɛ oebu me nokwafo dze me ahyɛ ɔsom no mu no ase;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: emi a nkyɛ nkan no meyɛ busuyɛnyi nye ɔhonankanyi nye ɔbofo, naaso minyaa ehumbɔbɔr; osiandɛ minnyim na meyɛe wɔ ekyingye mu;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: na hɛn Ewuradze n’adom dɔɔ so mbordo maa me na ɔmaa me gyedzi nye dɔ a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu no.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Ɔyɛ nokwasɛm a ɔsɛ dɛ wɔgye pen koraa, dɛ Kraest Jesus baa wiadze bɛgyee ndzebɔnyɛfo nkwa; hɔn mu otsitsir nye emi;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: na eso iyi ntsi na minyaa ehumbɔbɔr ama ɔnam emi, otsitsir yi mu, Kraest Jesus eeyi ne penkyɛr nyina edzi, ma maayɛ mfatoho ama hɔn a ekyir no wɔbɛgye no edzi akɔ onnyiewiei nkwa mu no.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na afei, mbersantsen Hen a ɔtse ase daa, enyiwa nnhu no, na no nkotsee nye Nyankopɔn no, ɔno na enyidzi nye enyimnyam nka no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Me ba Timoti, dɛm kasakyerɛ yi na medze hyɛ wo nsa, dɛ mbrɛ nkɔnhyɛnsɛm a wɔkaa faa wo ho kan no tse no, ama aafa do ako ɔko pa,
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: eesuo gyedzi nye tsibowa pa a binom egyaa mu akyen egu esu wɔ gyedzi no ho no mu dzen;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: hɔn mu bi nye Himeneus nye Alɛksanda a meyi hɔn ama Satan, ama woeesua dɛ onnyi dɛ wɔka ebususɛm wɔ Nyankopɔn ho.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Dɛm ntsi m’afotu nye dɛ, odzi kan, wɔnyɛ nkotoserɛ asɔr, wɔmbɔ mpaa, wɔnsɔr mbisa na wɔnda ase mma nyimpa nyina;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: ahemfo nye hɔn a wodzi tum nyina: ama yaatsena ase dwudwoodwo, komm wɔ nyamesompa nye fɔntɔmmyɛ nyina mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Iyi na oye na ɔyɛ enyisɔ wɔ hɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn enyim;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: ɔno a ɔpɛ dɛ wɔgye nyimpa nyina nkwa, na wɔba nokwar no no ho nyimdzee mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na Nyankopɔn kortsee na ɔwɔ hɔ, na Nyankopɔn nye nyimpa ntamugyinafo so kortsee, Kraest Jesus a ɔnoara so yɛ nyimpa no a.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Ɔno a ɔdze noho maa dɛ apondze maa nyimpa nyina; dɛ ɔnyɛ dase wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: no ho na wɔahyɛ me ɔsɛnkafo nye ɔsomafo, (meka no nokwar, minndzi ator), amanaman kyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ gyedzi nye nokwar mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Dɛm ntsi mepɛ dɛ mbarimba yɛ asɔr wɔ mbea nyina, wɔma nsa krɔnkrɔn a ebufuw anaa anyanyan nnyi mu do.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Dɛmara so na mbaa nhyɛ ntar a ɔkyerɛ dɛ wɔfɛr adze na hɔn enyi ka famu, mma wɔmmfa afadze hyerɛpɛɛ, tsir ne nyɛɛ ahorow, anaa sika, anaa ahondze pa anaa aboɔdzen ntar nnsiesie hɔn ho;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: na mbom, dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ mbaa a woyi nyamesom kyerɛ no, wɔmfa ndwuma pa nyɛ hɔn ahosiesie.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Wɔmma ɔbaa nyɛ komm nsua wɔ ahobrɛadze nyina mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na ɔbaa dze, memma no kwan dɛ ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ, anaa ondzi ɔbanyin do tum, na mbom ɔnyɛ komm.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na wodzii kan bɔɔ Adam ansaana wɔrobɔ Eve;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: na nnyɛ Adam na wɔdaadaa no, na ɔbaa no na wɔdaadaa no a ɔkɔtɔɔ mbrato mu;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: naaso sɛ ɔdze enyidahɔ tsena gyedzi nye dɔ nye ahotsew mu a, wɔbɛgye no nkwa n’abawoo mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Ɔyɛ nokwasɛm dɛ, Sɛ obi pɛ ɔhwɛfo edwuma a, ɔapɛ edwuma pa.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Dɛm ntsi, ɔsɛ ɔhwɛfo dɛ no ho nnyi asɛm, ɔyɛ ɔyer baako kun, n’enyi da hɔ, n’adwen mu tsew, ɔyɛ wense wense, ɔpɛ ahɔhoyɛ, otum kyerɛkyerɛ;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: ɔnnyɛ nsahweam, ɔnnyɛ pupopupo; na mbom ɔdwe, ɔmmpɛ ham, ɔnnyɛ sikanyibernyi;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: ɔhwɛ nankasa ne fie do yie, ma ne mba hyɛ n’ase wɔ fɔntɔmmyɛ nyina mu;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: na sɛ obi nnhu nankasa ne fi do hwɛ a, ɔyɛ dɛn tum hwɛ Nyankopɔn n’asɔr do?
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Mma ɔnnyɛ obi a ɔbaa asɔr no mu nkyɛree, amma ɔaannhoran annkɔtɔ abɔnsam n’afɔbu mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Afei so ɔsɛ dɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ ekyir so bɔ no dzin pa; amma ɔaannhwe enyimguase nye abɔnsam efir mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Dɛmara na asɔr mu asomfo no so ɔsɛ dɛ hɔn enyim yɛ fɔntɔmm, wɔnnyɛ tɛkyerɛmanta, wɔnnyɛ nsahweam, wɔnnyɛ edzifodzepɛfo;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: wɔkora gyedzi esumasɛm no wɔ tsibowa a no ho tsew mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na yinom so wondzi kan nsɔ hɔn nhwɛ ana, sɛ hɔn ho nnyi asɛm bi a, wɔasom dɛ asɔr mu asomfo.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Mbaa so hɔn enyim nyɛ fɔntɔmm dɛmara, mma wɔnnyɛ anokumdzifo, mbom nkorɔfo a hɔn enyi da hɔ, na wodzi nokwar wɔ adze nyina mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Asɔr mu asomfo no mu biara nyɛ nyimpa a ne yer kor a wɔhwɛ hɔn mba nye hɔnankasa hɔn fie do yie.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na hɔn a wɔasom yie dɛ asɔr mu asomfo no, wonya gyinabew pa, nye ndamyɛ kɛse wɔ gyedzi a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu no mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: M’enyi da kwan dɛ ɔnnkɛkyɛr na maba wo nkyɛn, naaso merekyerɛw iyi abrɛ wo;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: ama sɛ bi a mebɛkyɛr a, eehu mbrɛ ɔsɛ dɛ ebɔ wo bra wɔ Nyankopɔn fie a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn tseasefo n’asɔr mu a ɔyɛ nokwar no ne fadum nye ne ngyinado no.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na ekyingye nnyi ho dɛ nyamesom esumasɛm no so ampaara; Nyankopɔn daa no ho edzi wɔ honam mu, wobuu no bem wɔ sunsum mu, abɔfo hun no, wɔbɔɔ no dawur wɔ amanaman mu, wɔgyee no dzii wɔ wiadze, wɔfaa no kɔr sor wɔ enyimnyam mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na Sunsum no ka pefee dɛ, mber a odzi ekyir no mu, binom betsin ndaadaa sunsum nye mbɔnsam nkyerɛkyerɛ do atwe hɔnho efi gyedzi no ho;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: osian nyimpa atorfo hɔn ndabraba ntsi; hɔn a hɔn tsibowa ewu tse dɛ gyama wɔdze dadze hyew asaa.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Wɔkyerɛ dɛ ɔyɛ bɔn dɛ nyimpa bɔwar, na obedzi edziban a Nyankopɔn bɔɔ dɛ hɔn a wɔgye dzi na wonyim nokwar no mfa ndaase ngye ndzi no.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Osiandɛ Nyankopɔn abɔdze nyina ye, na sɛ yɛdze ndaase gye a, nna onnyi dɛ yekyir biribiara;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: osiandɛ wɔdze Nyankopɔn n’asɛm nye mpaabɔ atsew ho.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Sɛ ekaakaa enuanom no yinom a, ebɛyɛ Jesus Kraest no somfo pa a wɔanyɛn no gyedzi no nye nkyerɛkyerɛ pa a odzi ekyir no mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na mberwa anansesɛm gyangyan a ɔmmfa nyamesom pa ho no dze, pow. Na bɔ nyamesom ho mbɔdzen;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: osiandɛ honam mu mbɔdzen ho mfaso suar; na nyamesom ho wɔ mfaso ma adze nyina, na ɔwɔ nkwa a ɔwɔ hɔ sesei nye dza ɔreba no ho anohoba.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Iyi nye nokwasɛm no, na ɔsɛ dɛ wɔgye to mu koraa.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na iyi ho na yɛbɔ mbɔdzen na yɛper, osiandɛ yɛdze hɛn enyidado ato Nyankopɔn tseasefo a ɔyɛ nyimpa nyina hɔn Agyenkwa, nkanka hɔn a wɔyɛ agyedzifo no do.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Iyinom na tu ho fo enyiber do na kyerɛkyerɛ.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Mma obi mmbu w’aberantsɛyɛ tootooba; na mbom yɛ esusudo ma agyedzifo, wɔ kasa mu, abrabɔ mu, ɔdɔ mu, gyedzi mu nye ahotsew mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Ma w’enyi nku akenkan, afotu na nkyerɛkyerɛ mu ara nkodu dɛ mebɛba.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Mma w’enyi mmpa akyɛdze a wɔnam nkɔnhyɛ nye mpanyimfo nsa a wɔdze guu wo do maa wo no do.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Bɔ yinom ho mbɔdzen; fa woho ma hɔn koraa; ama wo mpontu aada edzi wɔ adze nyina mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Hwɛ wankasa wo ho yie nye nkyerɛkyerɛ no so; suo mu dzen; na eyɛ dɛm a, ebɛgye woho nye hɔn a wotsie wo no nkwa.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Mma nntwuw ɔpanyin enyim, na mbom tu no fo dɛ egya; na mberantsɛ no dɛ enuanom;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: mbaampanyin no dɛ nanom; nkataasia no dɛ nkyerɛbaa, wɔ ahotsew nyina mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Ekunafo a wɔyɛ ekunafo ara ampa no, dzi hɔn nyi.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na sɛ okunafo bi wɔ mba anaa mbanana a, wɔmma wonsua dɛ wodzi kan kyerɛ nyamesompa wɔ hɔn efiefi do, na wontua hɔn awofo kaw; na iyi na ɔsɔ enyi wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na nyia ɔyɛ okunafo ampa, na aka no nko no, ɔdze n’enyidado to Nyankopɔn do, na osuo nkotoserɛ asɔr nye mpaabɔ mu adzekyee nye adzesaa.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na nyia ɔdze noho ma wiadze enyigye no, ɔyɛ tseaseewu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na nsɛm yi na kyerɛkyerɛ hɔn, amma woeennya hɔn ho asɛm bi annka.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na sɛ obi annhwɛ nankasa nedze, nkanka ne fiefo a, ɔapa gyedzi no, ɔyɛ nyimpa bɔn kyɛn nyia ɔnngye nndzi mpo.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Mma wɔmmfa obi a onnyae nndzii mfe eduosia mmfora ekunafo nnkan. Ɔwɔ dɛ ɔyɛ obi a ɔawar kun kor,
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: na wɔbɔ no dzin pa wɔ ndwuma ho dɛ: ɔatsetse mbofra, ɔayɛ ahɔhoyɛ, ɔahohor ahotseweefo no anan ho, ɔaboa hɔn a wɔakɔ ahohia mu, na ɔdze no ho ama ndwuma pa nyina.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na ekunafo a wonnyinii dze, mma nngye hɔn; osiandɛ sɛ Kraest ho fon hɔn a, wɔbɛpɛ dɛ wɔbɔwar;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: na wonya afɔbu dɛ wɔapow gyedzi a odzi kan no.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na no mu ara so na wosua enyihaw, kyimakyima efiefi; na nnyɛ enyihaw nko, na wɔyɛ anobɛrbɛr nye agyegyensɛm mu so, keka nsɛm a ɔnnsɛ hɔn dɛ wɔka.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Dɛm ntsi mepɛ dɛ hɔn a wonnyinii no, wɔwar, wo mba, hwɛ fie, na wɔaamma ɔtamfo biara kwan mma ɔaannyaw hɔn;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: osiandɛ binom adan ekedzi abɔnsam ekyir dada.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na sɛ ɔbaa gyedzinyi bi wɔ ekunafo a, wɔmma ɔmboa hɔn; na mma wɔnnyɛ adzesoa mma asɔr; ama asɔr no aaboa hɔn a wɔyɛ ekunafo ara ampa no.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Mpanyimfo a wodzi panyin yie no, wombu hɔn dɛ wɔsɛ enyidzi mbɔho, nkanka hɔn a wɔyɛ edwuma wɔ asɛm no nye nkyerɛkyerɛ mu no.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na kyerɛw no ka dɛ, Mma nnkyekyer nantwi a ɔporow eburow no n’ano, na eso dɛ, Ɔfata dɛ odwumayɛnyi nya n’akatua.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Mma nntsie ɔpanyin ho ntoatoa, gyedɛ adasefo beenu anaa baasa anomu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Hɔn a wɔyɛ bɔn no ka hɔn enyim, ama nkaa no so eesuro.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Mehyɛ wo wɔ Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Kraest Jesus nye abɔfo a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn no enyim dɛ, hwɛ yinom yie, na mma nnyɛ tsirmsum, eso mma nnyɛ biribiara nyiyimu do.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Mma mmfa wo nsa nngu obiara do awerɛfir mu, na eso mmfa woho mmfora binom hɔn bɔn; sie woho krɔnn.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Mma nnda ho nnom nsu nko, na wo yafun nye wo mberɛw a etɔ yɛ ntsi, nom wenyin kakra.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Nyimpa binom hɔn bɔn da edzi dzi hɔn enyim dze hɔn rokɔ atsɛmbu mu, na binom dze dzi hɔn ekyir.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Dɛmara na ndwuma pa so da edzi; na dza ɔsor mbrɛ ɔtse no mpo nntum nnhuntsa.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Wɔmma dodow a wɔwɔ kɔndua ase dɛ nkowaa mbu hɔn wuranom dɛ wɔsɛ enyidzi nyina, na Nyankopɔn dzin nye nkyerɛkyerɛ no wɔaannkasa ho bɔn.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na hɔn a wɔwɔ wuranom gyedzifo, mma wommbu hɔn enyimtsia dɛ wɔyɛ enuanom ntsi; na mbom wɔnsom hɔn yie, osiandɛ hɔn a woenya adɔyɛ no bi no, wɔyɛ agyedzifo nye adɔfo. Iyinom na kyerɛkyerɛ na tu ho fo.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Sɛ obi ma nkyerɛkyerɛ fofor bi, na ɔammpen hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest nsɛm a oye no nye nkyerɛkyerɛ no a ɔdze kɔ nyamesompa mu no a,
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: ɔahoran, onnyim hwee, na mbom ɔyar ekyingye nye nokotwa a dza ofi mu ba nye nyitan, mpaapaamu, ndzebɔ, adwembɔn,
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: ɔham a ɔsɛ nyimpa a wɔaprɔw adwen mu, na nokwar no abɔ hɔn, wosusu dɛ nyamesompa yɛ adzepɛ kwan.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na nyamesompa a abodwee ka ho yɛ adzenya kɛse;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: na yɛammfa hwee ammba wiadze, eso yerunntum mmfa hwee mmfi mu nnkɔ;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: na sɛ yɛwɔ edziban nye akataho a, hom mma ɔnoara ndɔɔ hɛn so.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na mbom hɔn a wɔrepɛ ayɛ ahonyafo no, wɔhwe nsɔhwɛ nye efir nye nkwasea akɔndɔ pii a ɔyɛ mbusu a ɔtwe hɔn kogu ɔsɛɛ nye ɔhera mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na sikapɛ mbordo nye bɔn horow nyina no ndwow a binom edzi ekyir atɔ gon efi gyedzi no ho, na wɔdze yaw pii awowɔ hɔnho.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Na ɔwo, Nyankopɔn ne nyimpa dze, guan fi yinom ho; na dzi tsenenee, nyamesompa, gyedzi, ɔdɔ, abotar, nye ɔdwe ekyir.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Ko gyedzi no ko pa, suo onnyiewiei nkwa a wɔbɔɔ dzin frɛɛ wo a idzii ho dase pa no wɔ adasefo pii enyim no mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Mutu wo fo wɔ Nyankopɔn a ɔma ndzɛmba nyina nkwa, nye Kraest Jesus a odzii dase pa no wɔ Pontius Pilate enyim no enyim,
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: dɛ dzi ahyɛdze no do, mma dzɛm anaa fɛr bi mmba wo ho ma onkesi dɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest beyi noho akyerɛ:
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: dza ɔbɛkyerɛ wo nankasa n’aber mu, ɔno a ɔyɛ Otumfo siarfo kortsee, ahemfo Hen, nye ewuranom Ewuradze;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: onyia a no nko wɔ bɛkyebo nkwa, na ɔtse kan a wɔbɛn ho a ɔnnyɛ yie mu; nyia nyimpa biara nnhun no da, na wonnkotum so ehu no da; ɔno na enyidzi nye daa tum a ɔmmbɔ adze da nyɛ nedze afebɔɔ. Amen.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Kasa kyerɛ hɔn a wɔyɛ ahonyafo wɔ sesei wiadze yi mu dɛ, mma wommbu hɔn ho sorsor, eso mma wɔmmfa hɔn enyi nnto ahonyadze a onnsi pi no do, na mbom wɔmfa nto Nyankopɔn a ɔma hɛn adze nyina pii dɛ yendzi no do;
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: dɛ wɔnyɛ yie, dɛ wɔnyɛ ahonyafo wɔ ndwuma pa mu, dɛ wɔnkyɛ adze ɔhardo, na wonyi mma ɔpɛdo:
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: na wɔmfa nhyehyɛ fapem pa nto hɔ mma hɔnho nsie ndaamba, ama woeesuo nkwa a ɔyɛ nokwar nkwa no mu.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: O Timoti, kora dza wɔdze ahyɛ wo nsa no, dan woho fi ebususɛm gyangyan, nye nokotwa a wɔfom frɛ no nyimdzee no ho.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Ɔno na binom dween dɛ hɔn nsa aka ma wɔayew efi gyedzi kwan no ho no. Adom nka hom.
title: 1ST TIMOTHY

text: Emi Paul, Kraest Jesus somafo a ɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ do, dɛ mbrɛ nkwa a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu anohoba tse,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: dze kɛma no dɔba Timoti: adom, mbɔbɔrhu, asomdwee, mfi Egya Nyankopɔn nye hɛn Ewuradze Kraest Jesus hɔ nka wo.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Meda Nyankopɔn a medze tsibowa krɔnn som no dɛ mbrɛ me nananom yɛe no ase, dɛ minngyaa wo nkaa wɔ mo nkotoserɛ mu adzekyee nye adzesaa.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Sɛ mekaa wo nyinsuwa a, mo kɔn dɔ dɛ mubohu wo na dɛw aahyɛ me ma:
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: dɛ ama makaa nokwar gyedzi a ɔwɔ wo mu a odzii kan tsenaa wo nana Lɔis nye wo na Eunise mu no; na megye dzi dɛ ɔwɔ wo so wo mu.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Ɔno ntsi mekaa wo dɛ kenyan Nyankopɔn akyɛdze a inyae wɔ wo mu no ber a medze me nsa guu wo do no.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na Nyankopɔn amma hɛn suro sunsum bi, na mbom ahoɔdzen nye dɔ nye adwenmutsewee dze a.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Dɛm ntsi mma w’enyi nnto hɛn Ewuradze adasedzi no, anaa emi a meyɛ ne daduanyi no ho; na mbom sɔw asɛmpa no ho akotorka no bi, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn ahoɔdzen tse.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Ɔno na ɔgyee hɛn, na ɔdze ɔfrɛ krɔnkrɔn no frɛɛ hɛn, nnyɛ hɛn ndwuma do a, na mbom nankasa ne tsirmpɔw nye n’adom a ɔdze doom hɛn wɔ Kraest Jesus mu fi tsetseetse,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: na afei wɔnam Kraest Jesus ne nyikyerɛ do eyi no edzi no do a; ɔno a oeyi owu efi hɔ, na ɔnam asɛmpa no do dze nkwa nye bɛkyebo aba kan mu,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: no ho nna wɔahyɛ me ɔsɛnkafo, nye somafo, nye kyerɛkyerɛfo.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Ɔno ntsi so na muruhu amandze yi: naaso m’enyi nnto; osiandɛ minyim nyia magye no edzi, na megye dzi yie dɛ obotum akora dza medze ahyɛ ne nsa no esie da no.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Suo nsɛm pa esusudo a etsee no me nkyɛn no mu yie,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: wɔ gyedzi nye ɔdɔ a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu no mu. Akoradze pa a wɔdze hyɛɛ wo nsa no dua Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a ɔtse hɛn mu no do kora do.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Inyim iyi, dɛ hɔn a wɔwɔ Asia nyina danee fii me nkyɛn;
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: hɔn mu bi nye Figelus nye Hermogenes. Ewuradze nhu Onesiforɔs fie mbɔbɔr, nna ɔtɔ dɛ ɔma mo ho dwe me, na n’enyi annto mo nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn ho.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na ɔbaa Rome no, ɔdze mbɔdzen hwehwɛɛ me, na ohun me.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Ewuradze mma onnya ɔnoara Ewuradze hɔ ehumbɔbɔr wɔ da no mu; na dodow a ɔsomee wɔ Efeso, woara nyim no papaapa.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔwo, me ba, hyɛ dzen wɔ adom a ɔwɔ Kraest Jesus mu no mu.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na dza etsee no m’anomu wɔ adasefo pii enyim no, ɔnoara na fa hyɛ nyimpa anokwafo a wobotum akyerɛkyerɛ binom so nsa.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na ɔwo so sɔw akotorka no bi dɛ Kraest Jesus sordaanyi pa.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Ɔsordaanyi a ɔwɔ som mu biara mmfa daa daa asetsena mu nsɛm mbrabra noho, ama ɔaasɔ nyia ɔfaa no yɛɛ sordaanyi no enyi.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na sɛ obi si akan wɔ agodzi bi mu a, wɔmmbɔ no konyim abɔtsir, gyedɛ odzi esi dɛ mbrɛ no ho mbra tse.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Okuafo a ɔyɛ edwuma no, nna otwar dɛ odzi abakan no bi.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Dwen dza mereka yi ho; na Ewuradze bɛma wo adze nyina mu ntseasee.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Kaa Jesus Kraest a ɔasoɛr efi ewufo mu no, ofi David asefo mu, dɛ mbrɛ me nsɛmpa tse no,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: no mu na mosɔw akotorka dze besi mpokyerɛ mu, dɛ ɔdzebɔnyɛnyi; na Nyankopɔn asɛm dze, wɔnnkyer no.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Dɛm ntsi na mosɔw yinom nyina wɔ hɔn a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn no ntsi, ma hɔn so woeenya nkwagye no a ɔwɔ Kraest mu no, nye enyimnyam a onnyi ewiei.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Nokwasɛm nye yi: Sɛ yɛnye no wui a, yɛnye no bɛtsena ase so:
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: sɛ yetsintsim a, yɛnye no bedzi hen; sɛ yɛpa no a, ɔno so bɛpa hɛn:
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: sɛ hɛn, yɛnnyɛ anokwafo a, ɔno dze, ɔyɛ nokwafo; osiandɛ onntum mmpa noho ekyir.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Iyinom ho na kaa hɔn, na kasa kyerɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn enyim, dɛ mma wɔnngye nsɛm mu ekyingyehun a mfaso biara nnyi ho a ɔsɛɛ etsiefo adwen.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Bɔ mbɔdzen yi woho kyerɛ dɛ nyia Nyankopɔn apen no, odwumayɛnyi a onnyi dɛ ɔfɛr, na ɔpeepee nokwasɛm no mu yie.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na nsɛnhun dze, yi woho fi ho: na wɔbɔkɔ enyim ara wɔ mbusubɔ mu,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: na hɔn kasaa bɛtserɛw dɛ kuprɔwee: hɔn mu bi nye Himeneus nye Filetus;
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: nkorɔfo a wɔayew efi nokwar no ho ka dɛ wusoɛr no etwa mu dada, na woebutuw binom hɔn gyedzi.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Naaso Nyankopɔn fapem tsim hɔ pintsinn kitsa nsɔwano yi, Ewuradze nyim hɔn a wɔyɛ nedze: na ma obiara a ɔbɔ Ewuradze dzin ntwe noho mfi dza ɔnntsen ho.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na ofi kɛse mu nnyi sika nye dwetɛ ndzɛmba nko, na ndua nye dɛtse so; na wobu bi bi, bi so wommbu no.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na sɛ obi tsew noho fi iyinom ho a, ɔbɛyɛ adze a wobu no bi, wɔatsew ho, owura dze yɛ biribi a ɔyɛ yie, na woesiesie dze ama edwuma pa biara.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Guan fi mbabunber mu akɔndɔ ho, na nye hɔn a wofi akoma a no mu tsew mu frɛ Ewuradze ndzi tsenenee, gyedzi, ɔdɔ, nye asomdwee ekyir.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na mbatam hɔn nkwasea ekyingye dze, pow, osiandɛ inyim dɛ ɔdze ntokwaa ba.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na ɔnnsɛ Ewuradze akowaa dɛ ɔyɛ ntokwapɛfo, na mbom ɔsɛ no dɛ ɔdwe ma nyimpa nyina, ohu nkyerɛkyerɛ, ɔto no bo ase,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: ɔkyerɛkyerɛ hɔn a wɔnye hɔnho dzi esi wɔ ɔdwe mu; dɛ bi a Nyankopɔn bɛma hɔn nnuho akɔ nokwar no ho nyimdzee mu,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: na hɔn enyi do aatsew hɔn efi abɔnsam a ɔafa hɔn ndɔmmum no efir mu ama Nyankopɔn apɛdze.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Mbom tse ase dɛ nda a odzi ekyir no mu awerɛhow ber bɛba.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na nyimpa bɛyɛ ahopɛfo, sikapɛfo, ahohyehyɛfo, ahoramfo, ndzebɔfo, awofo do asoɔdzenfo, bɔnyiayɛfo, hɔn a hɔn ho nntsew,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: hɔn a wonnyi tsema, asɛnkadofo, anokumfo, hɔn a wonnyi ahohyɛdo, abɔyafo, hɔn a wɔmmpɛ papa,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: yimafo, akakabemfo, ahomemadofo, hɔn a wɔdɔ enyigye sen Nyankopɔn;
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: hɔn a wɔyɛ dɛ wɔwɔ nyamesompa, naaso wɔpow n’ahoɔdzen no: woyinom na dan woho fi hɔn nkyɛn.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Woyinom mu bi na wɔhɛnhɛn efiefi mu, kɛfa mbaa nkwasea a bɔn ahyɛ hɔn do na hɔn akɔndɔ horow dze hɔn rokɔ no ndɔmmum,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: hɔn a wosua daa, naaso wonntum nndu nokwar nyimdzee no ho da no.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ Jannes na Jambres nye Moses dzii esi no, dɛmara so na woyinom nye nokwar no dzi esi; nyimpa a hɔn adwen mu aprɔw a wɔmmfora wɔ gyedzi afamu.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na wɔronnkɔ hɔn enyim dodow biara: na hɔn nkwaseasɛm bɛda edzi wɔ nyimpa nyina enyim dɛ mbrɛ hɔndze so yɛe.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na ɔwo dze, idzii me nkyerɛkyerɛ, m’abrabɔ, me tsirmsɛm, me gyedzi, me penkyɛr, mo dɔ, m’abotar,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: m’ahohia, m’amandzehu ekyir; dza ɔbaa mo do wɔ Antiok, Ikonium, nye Listra; ahohia a mosɔwee; na Ewuradze gyee me fii ne nyinara mu no.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Nyew, hɔn a wɔpɛ dɛ wɔdze nyamesompa tsena ase wɔ Kraest Jesus mu nyina bɔsɔw ahohia.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na nyimpa bɔn nye esisifo dze, wɔbɔkɔ hɔn enyim wɔ bɔn mu, wɔdaadaa, na wɔdaadaa hɔn.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na ɔwo dze, tsena dza esua na ehu no no nokwar no mu, na inyim hɔn a esua no hɔn ho.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na ofitsi wo mbofrabermu inyim kyerɛw krɔnkrɔn no a obotum edua Kraest Jesus mu gyedzi do ama eehu nyansa akɔ nkwagye mu no.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Kyerɛwsɛm biara fi Nyankopɔn hɔ sunsum mu nkenyan, na oye ma nkyerɛkyerɛ, nkaenyim, ntsea, nye tsenenee mu ntsetsee:
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: ama Nyankopɔn nyimpa no eedzi mu, woeesiesie no koraa ama edwuma pa biara.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Afei mehyɛ wo wɔ Nyankopɔn nye Jesus Kraest a obobua atseasefo nye ewufo atsɛn, wɔ ne mbae nye n’ahendzi no mu no enyim dɛ,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: ka asɛm no, kɔ do ka no mber pa na mber bɔn mu; yi atsɛn, ka enyim, tu fo, wɔ abotar kɛse nye nkyerɛkyerɛ nyina mu.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na ber bɛba a worinntsie nkyerɛkyerɛ pa, na mbom wobedzi hɔn akɔndɔ ekyir aprapra akyerɛkyerɛfo aboa ano ma wɔakyerɛkyerɛ dza hɔnara wɔpɛ dɛ wɔtse;
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: na wɔbɛdan hɔn aso efi nokwar no ho, na wɔaman akɔ anansesɛm ho.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na ɔwo dze, gyen w’enyi wɔ adze nyina mu, sɔw akotorka, yɛ asɛmpakafo edwuma no, wie wo som koraa.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Na emi dze, woruhue me egu dada, na mo kɔber edu.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Mako ɔko pa no, mewie mbirika no tu, mesuo gyedzi no mu esie,
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: afei dza ɔda hɔ ma me nye tsenenee ahenkyɛw a Ewuradze tsɛmbuafo tsenenee no dze bɛma me da no, na nnyɛ mo nko, na hɔn a wɔdɔ ne mbae no nyina so.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Bɔ mbɔdzen bra me nkyɛn ntsɛm:
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: na Demas adɔ sesei wiadze yi egya me hɔ esi mu kɔ Tesalonika; Kresɛns kɔ Galatia, Titus kɔ Dalmatia.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Luke nko na ɔnye me wɔ ha. Fa Mark ka woho bra: na oye ma me wɔ ɔsom mu.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Tikikus dze, masoma no Efeso.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Sɛ ereba a, fa m’egudotar a medanee gyaa Troas wɔ Karpus nkyɛn no bra, nye mbuukuu no, nkanka nwoma a wɔkyerɛw do no.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Alɛksanda kɔɔberdwimfo no yɛɛ me bɔn pii: Ewuradze botua no kaw dɛ mbrɛ no ndwuma tse:
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: ɔno na wo so hwɛ yie wɔ no ho, na osiiw hɛn asɛm kwan pii.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: M’anoyi a odzi kan no mu no, obiara enndzi m’afa, na hɔn nyina daan me gyae: meserɛ dɛ mma wommbu nngu hɔn do.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Naaso Ewuradze gyinaa m’ekyir, na ɔhyɛɛ me dzen, na wɔnam mo do eewie asɛnka no, na amanamamfo nyina aatse: na wɔgyee me fii gyata anomu.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Ewuradze bɛgye me efi ndwuma bɔn nyina mu, na ɔaagye me akɔ no sor ahendzi no mu: ɔno na enyimnyam nka no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Kyia Priska nye Akwila, nye Onesiforɔs fiefo.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Erastus tsenaa Korinte: na Trofimus yar ma madan no egya Miletus.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Bɔ mbɔdzen bra ansaana awɔwber edu, Eubulus nye Pudens, nye Linus, nye Klaudia, nye enuanom no nyina kyia wo.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Ewuradze nye wo sunsum ntsena. Adom nka wo.
title: 2ND TIMOTHY

text: Emi Paul, Nyankopɔn n’akowaa nye Jesus Kraest somafo, a wɔasoma me dɛ monkɔtoa hɔn a Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi hɔn no hɔn gyedzi do, nye nokwar no ho nyimdzee no na dɛ mbrɛ nyamesom pa tse,
title: TITUS

text: wɔ onnyiewiei nkwa a Nyankopɔn a onndzi ator dze bɔɔ anohoba tsetseetse no ho enyidado mu.
title: TITUS

text: Na n’aber a ɔsɛ mu no, oyii n’asɛm edzi wɔ dawurbɔ a wɔnam Nyankopɔn hɛn Agyenkwa ahyɛdze do dze hyɛɛ me nsa no mu.
title: TITUS

text: Mekyerɛw dze kɛma Titus, me ba nokwafo wɔ gyedzi kor no ara mu. Adom nye asomdwee a ofi Egya Nyankopɔn nye Kraest Jesus hɛn Agyenkwa hɔ no nka wo.
title: TITUS

text: Iyi ntsi na medze wo gyaa Kreete, ama aatoto ndzɛmba a ɔaka no yie pɛpɛɛpɛr, na ahyehyɛ mpanyimfo wɔ kurow biara mu dɛ mbrɛ mehyɛɛ wo no;
title: TITUS

text: mekyerɛ obi a no ho nnyi asɛm bi, ɔyer baako kun, na ɔwɔ mba agyedzifo a wɔnntse asakasakabra anaa asoɔdzen ndzeyɛɛ wɔ hɔn ho.
title: TITUS

text: Osiandɛ ɔsɛ ɔhwɛfo dɛ no ho nnyi asɛm dɛ Nyankopɔn fihwɛfo; ɔnnyɛ ntsintsiman, ebufuw ebufuw, nsahweam, pupopupo, odzifodzepɛfo;
title: TITUS

text: na mbom ɔpɛ ahɔhoyɛ, ɔpɛ papa, n’adwen mu tsew, ɔtsen, no ho tsew, ɔhyɛ noho do;
title: TITUS

text: osuo nokwasɛm no mu dɛ mbrɛ wɔkyerɛɛ no, na oeetum dze nkyerɛkyerɛ pa etu fo, na oeeyi hɔn a wotsia no atsɛn.
title: TITUS

text: Na asoɔdzenfo pii wɔ hɔ, ehuhusɛnkafo nye adaadaafo, nkanka hɔn a wofi etwatsiatwafo mu a ɔsɛ dɛ wosiw hɔn ano no:
title: TITUS

text: nyimpa a mfaso tantan ntsi wɔkyerɛkyerɛ dza ɔnnsɛ dze butubutuw efiefi mpo.
title: TITUS

text: Hɔn mu ɔbaako, hɔnankasa hɔn nkɔnhyɛnyi, ka dɛ, Kreetefo yɛ atorfo daa, mbowa bɔn, akwadwefo etumfur.
title: TITUS

text: Dase yi yɛ nokwar. Dɛm ntsi ka hɔn enyim pasaa, ma woeedzi mu wɔ gyedzi no mu,
title: TITUS

text: amma wɔaammfa hɔn aso annkɔ Jewfo anansesɛm, nye hɔn a woetwa hɔnho efi nokwar no ho ahyɛdze do.
title: TITUS

text: Adze nyina ho tsew ma hɔn a hɔn ho tsew: na hɔn a wɔyɛ ahonamfi, na wɔnngye nndzi no dze, biribiara ho nntsew mma hɔn, na hɔn adwen nye hɔn tsibowa nyina ho wɔ fi.
title: TITUS

text: Wɔka dɛ wonyim Nyankopɔn, naaso wɔdze hɔn ndwuma pow no, wɔyɛ mbusubɔfo, wɔyɛ asoɔdzenfo, na wɔnnkan hɔn mmfora edwuma pa biara.
title: TITUS

text: Na ɔwo dze, ka nsɛm a ɔfata nkyerɛkyerɛ a odzi mu no:
title: TITUS

text: dɛ nkɔdaa nyɛ enyidahɔ nyɛ fɔntɔmm, hɔn adwen mu ntsew, ndzi mu wɔ gyedzi mu, ɔdɔ mu, nye abotar mu:
title: TITUS

text: dɛ mberwa so ndzi hɔnho nyi wɔ ndzeyɛɛ mu, mma wɔnnyɛ anokumfo, nnyɛ nsahweam, mbom wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ edwuma pa;
title: TITUS

text: ama wɔaatsetse mbabaawa ma wɔaadɔ hɔn kunnom, wɔaadɔ hɔn mba,
title: TITUS

text: na wɔaayɛ adwenmutseweefo, ahwɛ hɔnho yie, fieadzeyɛfo, ayamuyiefo, abrɛ hɔnho adze ama hɔnankasa hɔn kunnom, amma wɔaannkasa enntsia Nyankopɔn n’asɛm.
title: TITUS

text: Dɛmara na mberantsɛ no so tu hɔn fo ma wɔnyɛ adwenmutseweefo:
title: TITUS

text: adze nyina mu da woho edzi dɛ eyɛ ndwuma pa ho mfatoho; nkyerɛkyerɛ mu pefeeyɛ, fɔntɔmmyɛ,
title: TITUS

text: ɔkasa a odzi mu a wonnya ho asɛm bi nnka, ama nyia otsia hɛn no aafɛr dɛ onnya asɛm bɔn bi nnka.
title: TITUS
