text: Nkowaa nyɛ setsie mma hɔnankasa hɔn wuranom, wɔnsɔ hɔn enyi wɔ adze nyina mu, mma wonnyiyi hɔn asɛm ano;
title: TITUS

text: mma wonnwiawia adze, na mbom wɔnkyerɛ nokwardzi pa nyina, ama wɔdze aakorɔn Nyankopɔn hɛn Agyenkwa ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no wɔ adze nyina mu.
title: TITUS

text: Na Nyankopɔn adom a ɔdze nkwagye brɛ nyimpa nyina eyi noho edzi,
title: TITUS

text: ɔtsetse hɛn dɛ yɛmpow mbusubɔ nye wiadze akɔndɔ, na yɛmfa enyidado, nye tsenenee, nye nyamesompa ntsena sesei wiadze yi mu,
title: TITUS

text: nhwɛ nhyira enyidado no, nye hɛn Nyankopɔn kɛse, hɛn Agyenkwa Jesus Kraest n’enyimnyam mbae no kwan.
title: TITUS

text: Ɔno a ɔdze noho mae maa hɛn, ama ɔaapon hɛn efi emumuyɛ nyina mu, na ɔaatsew ɔman a ɔyɛ nankasa nedze a ɔbɔ ndwuma papa ho mbɔdzen no ho.
title: TITUS

text: Iyinom na fa tum nyina ka, tu ho fo, na ka ho enyim. Mma obi mmbu wo enyimtsia.
title: TITUS

text: Kaa hɔn ma wɔmbrɛ hɔnho adze mma mpanyimfo, nye tum horow nyina, ma wɔnyɛ setsie, na wonsiesie hɔnho mma edwuma pa biara;
title: TITUS

text: mma wɔnnka obiara ho asɛm bɔn, mma wɔnnyɛ ntokwapɛfo, wɔnyɛ abodwekyɛr na wɔnda ɔdwe nyina edzi wɔ nyimpa nyina do.
title: TITUS

text: Na hɛn so nkyɛ nkan no yɛyɛ nkwasea, asoɔdzenfo, yɛfomfomee, yɛsom akɔndɔ nye enyigyedze horow, yɛtse emumuyɛ nye nyitan mu, hɛn ho yɛ ehi, na yɛtentan hɛnho.
title: TITUS

text: Na Nyankopɔn hɛn Agyenkwa n’ayamuyie nye no dɔ a ɔwɔ nyimpa do yii noho edzi no,
title: TITUS

text: ommfi tsenenee mu ndwuma a yɛayɛ, na mbom ofi noara n’ehumbɔbɔr, na ɔnam awofofor eguar no nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn foforyɛ do gyee hɛn nkwa.
title: TITUS

text: Ɔno na ɔnam Jesus Kraest hɛn Agyenkwa do huei guu hɛn do pii,
title: TITUS

text: ma wɔnam n’adom do bu hɛn bem a, yaayɛ onnyiewiei nkwa ho enyidado no adzedzifo.
title: TITUS

text: Ɔyɛ nokwasɛm, na iyinom na mepɛ dɛ eka no ɔdzendo, ama hɔn a wɔagye Nyankopɔn edzi aadwen do esuo ndwuma pa mu. Ndzɛmba yi ye na ɔyɛ mfaso ma nyimpa:
title: TITUS

text: na nkwasea ekyingyebra nye nanakan, nye wentwiwentwi, nye mbra ho akasakasa dze, yi woho fi ho; osiandɛ mfaso nnyi ho na wɔyɛ adze gyan.
title: TITUS

text: Nyia ɔdze mpaapaamu ba a akasa akyerɛ no prɛko nye mpɛn ebien no, yi no akwa:
title: TITUS

text: hu dɛ obi a ɔtse dɛm no ɔakyea, ɔyɛ bɔn bu nankasa no ho fɔ.
title: TITUS

text: Sɛ mosoma Artemas anaa Tikikus wɔ wo nkyɛn a, bɔ mbɔdzen bra me nkyɛn wɔ Nikopolis: na hɔ na mesua me tsirmu dɛ mirikedzi awɔwber.
title: TITUS

text: Bɔ mbɔdzen gya Zenas mbranyimfo no, nye Apollos kwan yie, amma eennhia hɔn hwee.
title: TITUS

text: Na ma hɛn nkorɔfo so nsua ndwuma pa ho mbɔdzembɔ wɔ dza ohia ho, na aba pa aammbɔ hɔn.
title: TITUS

text: Hɔn a wɔwɔ me nkyɛn nyina kyiakyia wo. Kyiakyia hɔn a wɔdɔ hɛn wɔ gyedzi mu no. Adom nka hom nyina.
title: TITUS

text: Paul, Kraest Jesus daduanyi, nye onua Timoti dze kɛma Faelemɔn hɛn dɔfo nye hɛn nyɛnko dwumayɛnyi,
title: PHILEMON

text: nye hɛn akyerɛbaa Afiya, nye hɛn nyɛnko sordaanyi Aakipus, nye asɔr a ɔwɔ wo fie no:
title: PHILEMON

text: Adom nka hom nye asomdwee a ofir hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest hɔ.
title: PHILEMON

text: Mekaa wo wɔ me mpaabɔ mu a, meda me Nyankopɔn ase daa,
title: PHILEMON

text: osiandɛ metse wo dɔ a ewɔ wɔ ahotseweefo nyina ho, nye wo gyedzi wɔ Ewuradze Jesus Kraest mu no.
title: PHILEMON

text: Mobɔ mpaa dɛ ndzepa nyina a ɔnam Kraest do wɔ wo mu no ho nyimdzee bɛma wo gyedzi ayamuyie ndwuma no ada edzi yie.
title: PHILEMON

text: Mo nua, menya enyigye nye awerɛkyekyer kɛse wɔ wo dɔ ho, osiandɛ ahotseweefo akoma atɔ hɔn yamu wɔ ɔwo ntsi.
title: PHILEMON

text: Dɛm ntsi, kaansa meyɛ ndam pii wɔ Kraest mu dɛ mebɛhyɛ wo wɔ dza ɔsɛ ho a,
title: PHILEMON

text: ɔdɔ ntsi mokotow serɛ wo mbom, emi Paul a meyɛ akɔdaa, na afei meyɛ Jesus Kraest daduanyi so:
title: PHILEMON

text: mototɔ serɛ wo ma me ba a mawo no wɔ m’efiadze ndae mu,
title: PHILEMON

text: Onɛsimɔs (a nkan no nna no ho nnyi mfaso mma wo, na afei dze no ho wɔ mfaso ma emi nye ɔwo no).
title: PHILEMON

text: Ɔnoarankasa na masoma no wo hɔ bio, onyia a ɔtse dɛ mara m’akoma no a.
title: PHILEMON

text: Na nkyɛ mepɛ dɛ misianka no me nkyɛn, ama oeedzi w’ananmu asom me wɔ asɛmpa no n’efiadze ndae no mu:
title: PHILEMON

text: naaso mammpɛ dɛ migya wo ekyir yɛ biribiara, amma w’ayamuyie aannyɛ dɛ ofi nhyɛ mu, na mbom efi woara wo pɛ mu.
title: PHILEMON

text: Na bi a iyi ntsi na ɔnye wo dzii mpaamu kakra, ama eenya no daa,
title: PHILEMON

text: nnyɛ dɛ akowaa bio, mbom nyia ɔsen akowaa, onua dɔfo a oye ma me kɛse, na ankantam ɔwo, wɔ honam nye Ewuradze mu.
title: PHILEMON

text: Dɛm ntsi sɛ ibu me dɛ nyɛnko pa dze a, gye no dɛ mankasa.
title: PHILEMON

text: Na sɛ ɔayɛ wo bɔn biara, anaa ɔdze wo kaw bi a, fa yɛ mo nkontaa.
title: PHILEMON

text: Marankasa Paul na medze me nsa rekyerɛw dɛ emi mara mubotua. Na woara wo kaw a edze me a wankasa wo ho mpo ka ho no dze, menka ho hwee.
title: PHILEMON

text: Nyew, onua, ma minnya wo ho mfaso wɔ Ewuradze mu; na m’ahom nka mo ho wɔ Kraest mu.
title: PHILEMON

text: Ɔnam dɛ mowɔ awerɛhyɛmu wɔ wo setsie ho ntsi na merekyerɛw wo, minyim dɛ ebɛyɛ ma akyɛn dza mebisa yi mpo.
title: PHILEMON

text: Afei so, siesie dabew bi ma me, na mowɔ enyisun dɛ ɔnam hom mpaabɔ ntsi, wɔdze me bɛsan abrɛ hom.
title: PHILEMON

text: Epafras, me nyɛnko daduanyi wɔ Kraest Jesus mu no kyia wo,
title: PHILEMON

text: Mark, Aristarkus, Demas, Luke, m’anyɛnkofo edwumayɛfo no kyiakyia wo.
title: PHILEMON

text: Ewuradze Jesus Kraest adom nka hom sunsum.
title: PHILEMON

text: Nyankopɔn a tsetse no ɔnam akwan horow mu mpɛn pii no duaa nkɔnhyɛfo do kasaa kyerɛɛ hɛn egyanom no,
title: HEBREWS

text: nda a odzi ekyir yi mu no ɔnam Ɔba no do akasa akyerɛ hɛn; ɔno na ɔayɛ no adze nyina do ɔdzedzifo, na ɔnam no do so bɔɔ wiadze nyina.
title: HEBREWS

text: Ɔno na ɔyɛ n’enyimnyam no ne hyerɛn, na no subea saso, na ɔdze no tum asɛm suo ndzɛmba nyina mu. Ɔdze noho hohoor bɔn nyina wiei no, ɔkɛtsenaa Enyimnyam Hen no n’enyimfa wɔ sorsor.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hɔ na ɔakrɔn no akyɛn abɔfo dodow dɛ oenya dzin kunyin a ɔkyɛn hɔndze.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na abɔfo no mu woana na ɔsee no pɛn dɛ, Me Ba nye wo, ndɛ na mawo wo? Na bio, Mebɛyɛ no Egya, na ɔno so ayɛ me Ɔba?
title: HEBREWS

text: Na bio, onya dze abakan no ba wiadze a, ɔse, Ma Nyankopɔn n’abɔfoe nyina nkotow no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na abɔfo no ho dze ɔse, Ɔyɛ n’abɔfoe mframa, Na n’asomfo gyaframee:
title: HEBREWS

text: Naaso Ɔba no ho dze ɔse, Nyankopɔn, w’ahengua wɔ hɔ daa; Na tsenenee poma nye w’ahempoma.
title: HEBREWS

text: Adɔ tsenenee na ekyir emumuyɛ: ntsi Nyankopɔn, wo Nyankopɔn, dze ahosɛpɛw ngo asera wo asen w’etsipɛmfo.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na, Ɔwo, Ewuradze, ahyɛse no na etoo asaase ne fapem, Na ɔsor yɛ wo nsaano edwuma;
title: HEBREWS

text: Hɔn dze, wɔbɛsɛɛ; na ɔwo dze, ebɔkɔ do dɛmara daa; Na hɔn nyina bosuw dɛ atar;
title: HEBREWS

text: Ebɔbobɔw hɔn dɛ efuratam, dɛ atar mpo, na wɔasakyersakyer; naaso ɔwo dze, etse dɛ mbrɛ etse ara, Na wo mfe remmba ewiei da.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na abɔfo no mu woana ho na ɔaka dɛ, Tsena m’enyimfa, Ma onkodu dɛ medze w’atamfo mebɛyɛ w’ananadzegua?
title: HEBREWS

text: Ana hɔn nyina nnyɛ esunsum asomfo a hɔn a wɔbɛyɛ nkwagye no adzedzifo ntsi wɔsoma hɔn ma wɔbɔsom bi?
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔsɛ dɛ yɛhwɛ ndzɛmba a yɛatse no yie papaara, amma da bi yaammfom emmfi ho.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɛ asɛm a wɔnam abɔfo no do kae no tsimii, na mbrato nye asoɔdzen biara nyaa n’akatua a ɔsɛ a,
title: HEBREWS

text: nna hɛn so, sɛ yebu hɛn enyi gu nkwagye kɛse a ɔtse dɛm yi do a, yɛbɛyɛ dɛn efi nsa? Iyi na Ewuradze dzii kan kae, na hɔn a wɔtsee no hyɛɛ no dzen maa hɛn;
title: HEBREWS

text: na Nyankopɔn so nam nsɛnkyerɛdze nye anwanwadze nye tum ndwuma horow nye Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn akyɛdze do dɛ mbrɛ ɔnoara ɔpɛ no, hyɛɛ hɔn dasedzi no ma.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na nnyɛ abɔfo no ase na ɔdze wiadze a ɔreba a yɛka ho asɛm no ahyɛ.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na obi dzii dase wɔ beebi dɛ Ɔdasanyi nye woana, na ekaa no? Anaa nyimpa ba nye woana, a w’enyi wɔ no do yi?
title: HEBREWS

text: Ama aka kakra ma ɔato abɔfo; Edze enyimnyam nye enyidzi abɔ no abɔtsir, [Na edze no esi wo nsaano edwuma do:]
title: HEBREWS

text: Edze adze nyina ahyɛ n’ananadze. Na dɛ ɔdze adze nyina ahyɛ n’ase no, oenngyaa biribiara a wɔammfa annhyɛ n’ase. Na sesei dze yennyae nnhun dɛ wɔdze ndzɛmba nyina ahyɛ n’ase.
title: HEBREWS

text: Mbom yehu Jesus, ɔno a ber tsiabaa bi mu wɔbrɛɛ no adze seen abɔfo no, ama ɔnam Nyankopɔn adom do asɔ owu ahwɛ ama nyimpa nyina. Seseiara, osian owu amandzehu ntsi wɔdze enyimnyam nye enyidzi abɔ no abɔtsir.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ɔfataa onyia no a ndzɛmba nyina wɔ hɔ ma no na ndzɛmba nyina nam no do wɔ hɔ no dɛ, ɔdze mba pii ba enyimnyam mu no, ɔmaa hɔn nkwagye dzikamfo no nam amandzehu mu kɔr emudzi mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na nyia ɔsan ho, nye hɔn a wɔsan hɔnho no nyina fi adze kor, na dɛm ntsi ɔnnyɛ no enyito dɛ ɔbɛfrɛ hɔn enuanom,
title: HEBREWS

text: dɛ, Mobɔbɔ wo dzin akyerɛ mo nuanom; Mboanofo finimfin na mobɔtow ayɛyindwom ama wo.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na bio, Medze mo werɛ bɔtwer no. Na bio, Hwɛ, emi nye yi, nye mba a Nyankopɔn dze hɔn ama me.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na dɛ mba no wɔ bɔgya nye honam no bi ntsi, dɛmara na no so faa mu bi, ama ɔnam owu do aama onyia no a ɔwɔ owu tum, a ɔno nye abɔnsam no, ayɛ gyan;
title: HEBREWS

text: na ɔaagye hɔn a owu ho suro ntsi wɔwɔ nkowaasom mu hɔn nkwaber nyina no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ampaara nnyɛ abɔfo na osuo hɔn mu gye hɔn, na mbom Abraham asefo na osuo hɔn mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi okehiaa dɛ ɔsɛ no nuanom wɔ adze nyina mu, ama ɔaayɛ ɔsɔfopanyin mbɔbɔrhufo nye nokwafo wɔ dza ɔfa Nyankopɔn ho no mu, na ɔaayɛ ɔman no hɔn bɔn ho mpatadze.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na osiandɛ wɔsɔɔ no hwɛe ma nankasa so hun amandze ntsi, otum boa hɔn a wɔsɔ hɔn hwɛ no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi, enuanom krɔnkrɔn a hom fora sor frɛ no mu, hom nhwɛ gyedzi a yegyina do ka asɛm no ho Somafo nye Sɔfopanyin Jesus a
title: HEBREWS

text: odzii nokwar maa nyia ɔdze no sii hɔ no, dɛ mbrɛ Moses so dzii wɔ ne fi nyina do.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ɔno na woebu no dɛ enyidzi pii fata no kyɛn Moses, dɛ mbrɛ nyia osi dan no wɔ enyidzi sen dan no.
title: HEBREWS

text: (Na dan biara obi na osi; na nyia osii adze nyina nye Nyankopɔn.)
title: HEBREWS

text: Na Moses dze, odzii nokwar wɔ ne fie nyina do dɛ ɔsomfo, ama ɔaayɛ nsɛm a wɔrebɛka no ekyir yi ho adasedzi.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na Kraest dze, odzii ne fie do dɛ ɔba; na fie no nye hɛn, ber a yesuo enyidado no ho ndam nye ahohyehyɛ no mu dzen ekesi ewiei no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi, dɛ mbrɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no se no, Ndɛ, sɛ hom tse ne ndze a,
title: HEBREWS

text: Mma hom mmpirim hom akoma, dɛ ehiyi no mu, Dɛ nsɔhwɛ da no mu wɔ sar no do hɔ,
title: HEBREWS

text: Mbrɛ hom egyanom gyegyee me sɔɔ me hwɛe, na wohun mo ndwuma so,
title: HEBREWS

text: mfe araa eduanan. Dɛm ntsi mo bo fuuw dɛm mbasantsen no, Na mesee dɛ, Wɔfom wɔ hɔn akoma mu daa: Na wonnhun m’ahyɛdze.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na m’ebufuw mu no, mekaa ntam dɛ Wɔrennhɛn m’ahomgye mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom nhwɛ yie, enuanom, na ekyingye akoma bɔn bi aammba hom mu biara mu, na ɔaannwaa emmfi Nyankopɔn tseasefo no ho:
title: HEBREWS

text: na mbom hom ntutu homho fo nkorkor daa nyina, mber tsentsen a hom ka dɛ, Ndɛ no; amma bɔn ndaadaa aannsorow hom mu biara.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɛ yesuo hɛn enyidado a yenyaa no ahyɛse no mu pintsinn kodu ewiei a, nna yɛnye Kraest ayɛ kor:
title: HEBREWS

text: dɛ mbrɛ wɔka dɛ, Ndɛ da yi, sɛ hom tse ne ndze a, Mma hom mmpirim hom akoma, dɛ mber a woyii no ehi no mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na woananom na wɔtsee a, woyii ehi? Ana nnyɛ hɔn a wɔnam Moses do fii Egypt nyina no a?
title: HEBREWS

text: Na woananom ho na ɔyɛɛ no ehi mfe eduanan no? Ana nnyɛ hɔn a wɔyɛɛ bɔn ma hɔn efun dedaa sar do no a?
title: HEBREWS

text: Na woananom na ɔkaa ntam dɛ wɔrennhɛn n’ahomgye mu no? Nnyɛ hɔn a wɔyɛɛ asokyew no?
title: HEBREWS

text: Na yehu dɛ ekyingye ntsi na woenntum annhɛn n’ahomgye no mu no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi, woegya hɛn n’ahomgye mu kɔ ho anohoba yi, hom mma yensuro, ama hom mu biara aannyɛ dɛ ɔaka ekyir.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na wɔaka asɛmpa no akyerɛ hɛn dɛ hɔn so; naaso asɛm a wɔtsee no annyɛ hɔn mfaso, osiandɛ dza wɔtsee no nye hɔn gyedzi annkɔ.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hɛn a yɛagye edzi no yɛkɔ ahomgye no mu: dɛ mbrɛ ɔaka dɛ, Dɛ mbrɛ mekaa m’ebufuw mu ntam dɛ, Wɔrennhɛn m’ahomgye mu no. Mbom wofi ber a wɔtoo wiadze fapem no ewie ndwuma no dada.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ɔaka no beebi wɔ da a otsia esuon no ho dɛ, Nyankopɔn gyee n’ahom da a otsia esuon no mu wɔ no ndwuma nyina ho;
title: HEBREWS

text: na ha ɔka bio dɛ, Wɔrennhɛn m’ahomgye mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ɔnam dɛ aka dɛ binom bɔkɔ mu, na hɔn a wodzii kan kaa asɛmpa kyerɛɛ hɔn no annkɔ mu wɔ asoɔdzen ntsi no,
title: HEBREWS

text: ɔhyɛɛ da bi so bio a wɔfrɛ no Ndɛ, nam David do kaa dɛ mbrɛ wɔaka no dada no dɛ, Ndɛ, sɛ hom tse ne ndze a, Mma hom mmpirim hom akoma.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɛ Josua maa hɔn ahomgye a, nkyɛ ekyir yi ɔammbɔ da fofor bi dzin bio.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi ahomgyeda ne dzi da ho araa wɔ hɔ ma Nyankopɔn ne man.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na nyia ɔahɛn n’ahomgye mu no, nankasa so ahom efi no ndwuma ho, dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn homee fii nedze ho no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mma yɛmbɔ mbɔdzen nhɛn ahomgye no mu, amma obi eenndzi asoɔdzen kor no ara ekyir annhwe ase.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na Nyankopɔn n’asɛm wɔ nkwa, ahoɔdzen wɔ mu, na ɔyɛ ndam sen nkrantsee anofanu, na ohwira mu kodu dɛ ɔpaapaa ɔkra nye sunsum, akwaa nye ehuon mu, na no ho yɛ har hwehwɛ akoma mu adwen nye nsusui mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na abɔdze biara nnyi hɔ a ɔnnda edzi wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim, na adze nyina dzi adagyaw na no do bue wɔ nyia yɛnye no wɔ asɛm no enyim.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na dɛ yɛwɔ sɔfopanyin kɛse a oetwa mu wɔ sor, a ɔno nye Jesus, Nyankopɔn Ba no ntsi, hom mma yensuo hɛn gyedzi a yɛpaa mu ka no mu dzen.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na yennyi sɔfopanyin a onnyim hɛn mberɛwyɛ na ɔnntse mma hɛn, na mbom nyia wɔasɔ no adze nyina mu ahwɛ dɛ hɛnara so, naaso ɔannyɛ bɔn no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mma yɛmfa ndam mbra adom ahengua no enyim ama yeenya ehumbɔbɔr na yeehu adom a ɔboa hɛn ber a ɔsɛ mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɔfopanyin biara a woyi no wɔ nyimpa mu, wɔhyɛ no ma nyimpa wɔ dza ɔfa Nyankopɔn ho no ho, ma ɔaama ayɛyɛdze nye afɔrbɔdze wɔ bɔn ntsi,
title: HEBREWS

text: dɛ nyia otum hu ma hɔn a wonnyim dze na wɔfom, osiandɛ nankasa so mberɛwyɛ mmpar no;
title: HEBREWS

text: na iyi ntsi otwar dɛ ɔbɔ bɔ ho afɔr ma noho dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔ ma ɔman no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na obiara mmfa dɛm enyidzi yi mma noho gyedɛ nyia Nyankopɔn afrɛ no dɛ Aaron so.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛmara so na Kraest annhyehyɛ noho dɛ ɔbɛyɛ sɔfopanyin; na mbom nyia ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Me Ba nye wo, Ndɛ na mawo wo no:
title: HEBREWS

text: dɛ mbrɛ ɔka no beebi so dɛ, Ɔwo eyɛ daa sɔfo Wɔ Melkizedek kwan do.
title: HEBREWS

text: Ɔno na ber a ɔtse no honam mu no ɔdze nkekamu a ɔyɛ dzen nye nyinsu yɛɛ asɔr nye nkotoserɛ maa nyia obotum dɛ oyi no fi owu mu, na ne nyamesuro ntsi wotsiee no;
title: HEBREWS

text: ɔyɛ Ɔba dze, naaso osuaa amandze a, ohunii no mu setsie;
title: HEBREWS

text: na onyae dzii mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ onnyiewiei nkwagye farbaa ma hɔn a wɔyɛ setsie ma no nyina.
title: HEBREWS

text: Nyankopɔn bɔ ne dzin frɛ no Melkizedek kwan do sɔfopanyin.
title: HEBREWS

text: Ɔno ho na yɛwɔ nsɛm pii ka a ne nkyerɛasee yɛ dzen so, naaso hom asowa esiw.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na mber aba a ɔsɛ dɛ hom yɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo yi, ekehia hom bio dɛ obi kyerɛkyerɛ hom Nyankopɔn ho nsɛm fitsi ahyɛse, na hom ayɛ dɛ hɔn a ohia hɔn numfonsu no, na onnhia hɔn edziban dzen.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na obiara a onum numfonsu no nna onnyaa tsenenee nsɛm no ho nhumu, na ɔyɛ abɔdomaba.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na edziban a ɔyɛ dzen fata hɔn a woenyin a ntɔyɛɛ ntsi hɔn nkatsedze akokwa yie ma wotum hu papa nye bɔn.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mma yɛmfa ahyɛse nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɔfa Kraest ho no nto nkyɛn na yɛnhom do nkɔ emudzi mu: na mma yɛmmfa ndwuma a nkwa nnyi mu ho nnuho, nye Nyankopɔn ho gyedzi,
title: HEBREWS

text: nye esubɔ horow ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, nye nsa a wɔdze gu obi do, nye ewufosoɛr, nye onnyiewiei atsɛmbu nnto hɛn fapem bio.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na iyi sɛ Nyankopɔn ma kwan a, yɛbɛyɛ.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hɔn a wonyaa kan pɛn, na wɔasɔ ɔsor akyɛdze no ahwɛ, na woenya Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no bi,
title: HEBREWS

text: na wɔasɔ Nyankopɔn asɛm mbrɛ ɔyɛ papa nye wiadze a ɔreba no mu tum ndwuma horow ahwɛ,
title: HEBREWS

text: na woefi no ahwe ase no, onnhia dɛ wɔbɛdan hɔn bio akɔ nnuho mu; osiandɛ wɔbɔ Nyankopɔn Ba no mbeamudua mu bio ma hɔnho, na wɔhyɛ no bagua mu fɛr.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na asaase a ɔnom nsu a ɔtɔ gu do, na ofir edziban a ɔsɛ hɔn a hɔn ntsi so na wɔdɔwee no, onya Nyankopɔn hɔ nhyira.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɛ ofifir nsoɛ nye nhwirom a, wɔpow no na ɔbɛn ndom, n’ewiei nye dɛ wɔhyew.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na, adɔfo, yɛkasa dɛm dze, naaso hɛn enyi da ndzɛmba a oye kyɛn kwan wɔ hom ho, nye ndzɛmba a ɔnye nkwagye nam:
title: HEBREWS

text: na Nyankopɔn nnyɛ nyia ɔnntsen na no werɛ efir hom ndwuma nye ɔdɔ no a hom kyerɛe wɔ ne dzin ho, dɛ hom soom ahotseweefo no na hom da ho som.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na yɛpɛ dɛ hom nyina kyerɛ mbɔdzembɔ yi nkorkor ara ama hom enyidado aahyɛ ma dze ekodu ewiei:
title: HEBREWS

text: amma hom aannyɛ wantann, na mbom hom aayɛ hɔn a wɔnam gyedzi nye abotar do nya anohoba no hɔn esuafo.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na Nyankopɔn bɔɔ Abraham anohoba, nna onnyi obi a ɔso sen no a ɔbɛka ne ntam ntsi ɔkaa nankasa no ho ntam
title: HEBREWS

text: dɛ, Ampaara, ohyira na mibehyira wo, na ɔdɔr na mebɛma adɔr.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ɔtɔɔ no bo ase tweɔɔn dɛm no, ne nsa kaa anohoba no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na adasa ka nyia ɔso sen hɔn ntam; na ekyingyebra nyina ewiei nye ntam a wɔdze si do.
title: HEBREWS

text: Ntsi na Nyankopɔn pɛɛ dɛ oyi sakyer a ne tsirmsɛm nnsakyer kyerɛ anohoba no adzedzifo no pefee a, ɔdze ntam gyinaa mu;
title: HEBREWS

text: ama, ɔnam ndzɛmba ebien a ɔnnsakyer a ɔda no edzi dɛ Nyankopɔn nndzi ator wɔ biribiara mu no do, yeeguan abɔdɔ dɛ yerubosuo enyidado a wɔdze esi hɛn enyim no mu dze eenya awerɛkyekyer a osi pi.
title: HEBREWS

text: Enyidado a yɛwɔ no dɛ ɔkra ne sekyɛ a ɔnntsɛw na otsim na ɔhɛn mu kodu dza ɔwɔ ntwamutam mu no mu:
title: HEBREWS

text: hɔ na Jesus hɛɛn hɔ maa hɛn dɛ ɔkandzifo a wɔayɛ no daa sɔfopanyin wɔ Melkizedek ne nhyehyɛɛ do.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na Melkizedek yi, Salemhen, ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn no sɔfoe no, hyiaa Abraham aber a nna oekoku ahemfo no na ɔresan no, na ohyiraa no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Ɔno so na Abraham maa no ndzɛmba nyina mu ebupɛn du no. Ne dzin Melkizedek no ne nkyerɛasee a odzi kan no nye dɛ, tsenenee hen, na nkyii so Salemhen no so kyerɛ dɛ, asomdwee hen.
title: HEBREWS

text: Onnyi egya, onnyi na, onnyi mbasantsen, onnyi nda ahyɛse, anaa nkwa ewiei, naaso ɔtse dɛ Nyankopɔn Ba no, ɔyɛ ɔsɔfo afebɔɔ.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hom nhwɛ nyimpa yi a egya panyin Abraham maa no asadze a ɔsom bo no mu ebupɛn du no so a ɔso.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hɔn a wofi Levimba mu nya asɔfodwuma no wɔ ahyɛdze bi dɛ wɔgye ebupɛn du du, dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse, wɔ ɔman no hɔ, ɔnye dɛ hɔn nuanom hɔ, naaso hɔn nyina fir Abraham n’asen mu bae.
title: HEBREWS

text: Naaso dɛm nyimpa yi a ommfi hɔn ebusua mu yi no, ɔgyee Abraham hɔ ebupɛn du du na ohyiraa nyia ɔwɔ anohoba no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ekyingye biara nnyi ho dɛ nyia ɔso kyɛn na ohyira nyia osuar no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ha nyimpa a wowu na wɔgye ebupɛn du du, na hɔ dze obi a wɔgye no ho dase dɛ ɔtse ase no a.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɛ yɛreka a, Levi a ɔgye ebupɛn du du no nam Abraham do maa ebupɛn du du no bi;
title: HEBREWS

text: na ber a Melkizedek kehyiaa n’egya no na ɔda ho wɔ n’asen mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɛ emudzi wɔ Levi asɔfodzi mu a, (ɔno a ɔnam no mu na ɔman no nyaa mbra no,) nkyɛ hia bɛn na ohia dɛ sɔfo fofor bi bɔsoɛr dɛ Melkizedek akwan do sɔfopanyin; na wɔnnkan no dɛ Aaron akwan do?
title: HEBREWS

text: Na wɔasakyer asɔfodzi no a, otwar dɛ wɔsakyer mbra no so.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na nyia wɔka iyi fa no ho yi, ofi ebusuakuw fofor bi a obi mmfii mu mmbɔsoom afɔrmbukyia no ho pɛn no mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ɔda hɔ petee dɛ Juda mu na hɛn Ewuradze fi puei; ebusuakuw a Moses ammbɔ dzin annka hwee wɔ asɔfodzi ho a.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na dza ɔma ɔda hɔ petee koraa nye dɛ, sɛ Melkizedek akwan do sɔfo bɔsoɛr a,
title: HEBREWS

text: ɔnnam honam ahyɛdze do, na mbom ɔnam nkwa a ɔmmbɔ adze ahoɔdzen do:
title: HEBREWS

text: na wodzi no ho dase dɛ, Ɔwo eyɛ ɔsɔfo daa Wɔ Melkizedek akwan do.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na wogu ahyɛdze a odzi kan no, osiandɛ ɔyɛ mberɛw na ho nnyi mfaso ntsi
title: HEBREWS

text: (na mbra no amma biribi enndzi mu), na eso wɔdze enyidado a oye kyɛn a yɛnam do twe pin Nyankopɔn esi ananmu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na iyi dze wɔdze ntanka sii no pi: na hɔn dze wokwetsii ntanka dzii asɔfo,
title: HEBREWS

text: naaso ɔno dze, wɔdze ntanka hyɛɛ no ɔsɔfo, ɔnam nyia ɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Ewuradze aka ntam, ɔrennsesa n’adwen, Ɔwo eyɛ ɔsɔfo daa;
title: HEBREWS

text: mbrɛ Jesus nam bɛyɛɛ ahyɛmudzi a oye kyɛn no ho egyinamu so nye no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hɔn dze, dodowara ayɛ asɔfo osiandɛ wɔnam owu do siw hɔn kwan dɛ mma wɔnntsena hɔ daa;
title: HEBREWS

text: naaso ɔno dze, ɔtsena hɔ daa ntsi, ɔwɔ asɔfodzi a ɔnnsakyer.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi so otum gye hɔn a wɔnam no do ba Nyankopɔn hɔ no koraa, dɛ ɔtse ase daa dɛ odzi ma hɔn ntsi.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na dɛm sɔfopanyin no fata hɛn; no ho tsew, asɛm nnyi no ho, no ho nnguu fi, woeyi no efi ndzebɔnyɛfo ho, na wɔama no do akyɛn ɔsorsor;
title: HEBREWS

text: Ɔno na onnhia no daa, dɛ mbrɛ asɔfompanyin no yɛ no, dɛ odzi kan bɔ afɔr wɔ nankasa no bɔn ho ansaana ɔabɔ wɔ ɔman no nedze ho: osiandɛ ɔyɛɛ iyi prɛkopɛr, ber a ɔdze noho bɔɔ afɔr no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na mbra no hyɛ nyimpa a hɔn ho yɛ mberɛw asɔfompanyin, na ntanka asɛm a odzi ekyir no dze, ɔhyɛ Ɔba a oedzi mu no daa sɔfopanyin.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na nsɛm a yɛreka yi no mu tsitsir nye yi: dɛm sɔfopanyin yi na yɛwɔ, nyia ɔakɛtsena Enyimnyam Hen n’ahengua no enyimfa wɔ sorsor no,
title: HEBREWS

text: krɔnkrɔnbea no nye nokwar ntamadan a Nyankopɔn nankasa, na nnyɛ nyimpa bi sii no no somfo.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɔfopanyin biara wɔhyɛ no ama ɔdze ayɛyɛdze nye afɔrbɔdze aama: dɛm ntsi otwar dɛ oyi so onya biribi a ɔdze bɛma.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɛ ɔwɔ asaase do ha a, nkyɛ ɔnnyɛ ɔsɔfo koraa, osiandɛ hɔn a wɔdze ayɛyɛdze ma dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse no, wɔ hɔ dada;
title: HEBREWS

text: hɔn na wɔsom sor ndzɛmba no nsusudo nye no mfonyi; dɛ mbrɛ wɔbɔɔ Moses nkaa wɔ ber a oribesi ntamadan no: na ɔse dɛ, Hwɛ dɛ eyɛ adze nyina dɛ mbrɛ nsusudo a wɔdze kyerɛɛ wo wɔ koko no do no tse.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na afei ne nsa aka asɔfodzi a ɔkyɛn, dɛ ɔayɛ ntamugyinafo wɔ ahyɛmu a oye kyɛn a wogyina anohoba a oye kyɛn no do hyɛɛ no ho.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɛ dza odzi kan no ho nnyi asɛm a, nkyɛ wɔannhwehwɛ gyinabew bi amma dza otsia ebien no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na onyaa hɔn ho asɛm bi no, ɔkaa dɛ, Hwɛ, nda bi reba, Ewuradze na ɔse, Dɛ menye Israel fie nye Juda fie bedzi ahyɛmu fofor;
title: HEBREWS

text: Ɔnntse dɛ ahyɛmu a menye hɔn egyanom dzii Wɔ da a mususuoo hɔn nsamu yii hɔn fii Egypt asaase do no; Na hɔn dze wɔanntsena m’ahyɛmu no mu, Ntsi mo so manndwen hɔn ho, Ewuradze na ɔse.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ahyɛmu a menye Israel fi bedzi nye yi, Nda no ekyir no, Ewuradze se; Medze me mbra bɛhyɛ hɔn adwen mu, Na makyerɛw no hɔn akoma do so; Na mayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn Na hɔn so wɔayɛ me man;
title: HEBREWS

text: Na obi rennkyerɛ no kuromnyi, Obi rennkyerɛ no nua dɛ, Hu Ewuradze: Na hɔn nyina bohu me, Ofitsi hɔn mu kakraba do kesi kɛse do.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na mubohu hɔn emumuyɛ mbɔbɔr, Na mennkɛkaa hɔn bɔn bio.
title: HEBREWS

text: Ɔreka Ahyɛmu Fofor ho asɛm no ɔse, ɔayɛ dza odzi kan no dadaw. Na dza ɔayɛ dadaw na ne ber rutwa mu no ɔnnkɛkyɛr na ɔaayew.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ahyɛmu a odzi kan no wɔ nyamesom ho ahyehyɛdze, nye ne wiadze ha krɔnkrɔnbea.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na wosii ntamadan bi, dza odzi kan a wɔfrɛ no Krɔnkrɔnbea, mbrɛ kandzeadua no, nye ɔpon no, nye kyerɛpaanoo no wɔ.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ntwamutam a otsia ebien no ekyir na ntamadan a wɔfrɛ no Krɔnkrɔn mu Krɔnkrɔn no wɔ;
title: HEBREWS

text: ɔwɔ sika eduhuamhyew mbukyia, nye ahyɛmudaka no a wɔdze sika edura ho nyina a sika kutu a manna wɔ mu, nye Aaron poma a ɔfefɛwee no, nye ahyɛmu apon no wɔ mu no:
title: HEBREWS

text: na no do na enyimnyam kerubfo a wɔtserɛw mpatagua no do si; ndzɛmba yi yenntum nnka ho asɛm nkorkor sesei.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na woesiesie ndzɛmba yi dɛm no, asɔfo no kɔ ntamadan a odzi kan no mu daa kɛyɛ ɔsom ho edwuma,
title: HEBREWS

text: na dza otsia ebien no dze, sɔfopanyin no na afe du a, ɔkɔ hɔ prɛko, onngya bɔgya a ɔdze bɔ afɔr wɔ nankasa nye ɔman no hɔn mfom ntsi:
title: HEBREWS

text: Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn dze yi kyerɛ dɛ, ntamadan a odzi kan no da ho si hɔ yi, wonnyae nnyii kwan a wɔdze kɔ krɔnkrɔnbea mu no edzi;
title: HEBREWS

text: na ɔyɛ nsɛntoho ma sesei ber a ɔwɔ hɔ yi; dɛ mbrɛ wɔdze ayɛyɛdze nye afɔrbɔdze a onntum mma nyia ɔsom no nndzi mu wɔ tsibowa afamu,
title: HEBREWS

text: osiandɛ ɔnye edziban nye anondze nye eguaree horow yɛ honam afamu ahyehyɛdze ara a wɔhyɛ dɛ wɔnyɛ nkodu mber a wɔahyehyɛ ato hɔ no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na Kraest dze, ɔbaa dɛ ndzepa a aba dada no ho sɔfopanyin no, ɔnam ntamadan a ɔso na odzi mu kyɛn a wɔammfa nsa ennsi no do, ɔno nye dɛ ommfi abɔdze yi mu,
title: HEBREWS

text: na eso ɔnnam mpɔnkye nye anantwimba bɔgyaa mu, mbom ɔnam nankasa no bɔgyaa do kɛhɛɛn krɔnkrɔnbea no mu prɛko kenyaa onnyiewiei ɔgye no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɛ mpɔnkye nye anantwinyin bɔgyaa nye anantwiber nso a wɔdze petse hɔn a hɔn ho egu fi do no tsew hɔn ho kɔ honam ahosan mu a,
title: HEBREWS

text: mpɛn ahen ara na Kraest a ɔnam onnyiewiei Sunsum no do dze noho bɔɔ afɔr a nkekaa nnyi ho maa Nyankopɔn no, no bɔgyaa nnkɛtsew hom tsibowa ho efi ndwuma a nkwa nnyi mu ho akɔsom Nyankopɔn tseasefo no?
title: HEBREWS

text: Na iyi ntsi ɔyɛ ahyɛmu fofor no ho ntamugyinafo, ama hɔn a wɔafrɛ hɔn no enya onnyiewiei egyapadze no ho anohoba no, osiandɛ owu a owui no, ɔdze gyee hɔn a wɔyɛɛ nkan ahyɛmu no ho mfomdo no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na mbrɛ samansew wɔ no otwar dɛ wɔkyerɛ nyia ɔhyɛe no no wu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɛ owu ba a nna samansew wɔ ngyinado; na nyia ɔhyɛe no tse ase a, ɔnnyɛ edwuma.
title: HEBREWS

text: Ɔno ntsi na woennkwetsi bɔgya annhyɛ ahyɛmu a odzi kan no so.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na Moses kaa ahyɛdze no nyina kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyina, dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse no, ɔfaa anantwimba no nye mpɔnkye no bɔgyaa, nye nsu, nye kuntu memen, nye odwon hataw na ɔdze petsee nwoma no, nankasa nye ɔman no nyina do,
title: HEBREWS

text: na ɔsee dɛ, Iyi nye ahyɛmu a Nyankopɔn ahyɛ wɔ hom ho no no bɔgyaa.
title: HEBREWS

text: Bio so, ntamadan no nye asɔfodwuma no ho ndzɛmba nyina ɔdze bɔgya petsee ho dɛmara.
title: HEBREWS

text: Nkyɛ mereyɛ maaka dɛ adze nyina, dɛ mbrɛ mbra no tse, wɔdze bɔgya tsew ho, na sɛ bɔgya enngu a, fakyɛ bi nnyi hɔ.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi otwar dɛ sor ndzɛmba no n’esusudo no wɔdze yinom tsew ho; na sor ndzɛmba no nankasa dze, wɔdze afɔr a oye kyɛn yinom tsew ho.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na Kraest annhɛn krɔnkrɔnbea a wɔdze nsa yɛe a ɔyɛ nokwar dze no ho ntoho no mu; na mbom ɔhɛɛn ɔsor ankasa dɛ afei worikeyi no edzi wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim ama hɛn;
title: HEBREWS

text: na eso nnyɛ dɛ ɔdze noho bɔbɔ afɔr mpɛn pii dɛ mbrɛ sɔfopanyin no dze bɔgya a ɔnnyɛ nankasa nedze hɛn krɔnkrɔnbea afrenhyia afrenhyia no;
title: HEBREWS

text: ɔnodze na nkyɛ otwar dɛ ofi wiadze ahyɛse hu amandze mpɛn pii: na afei dze mbersantsen ruwie du yi, woeyi no edzi prɛko dɛ ɔnam noho afɔrbɔ do beyi bɔn akɔ.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ wɔahyɛ ama nyimpa dɛ owu prɛko, na ɔno ekyir atsɛmbu bɛba no,
title: HEBREWS

text: dɛmara na Kraest so a wɔdze no bɔɔ afɔr prɛko dɛ ɔnsoa nyimpa pii hɔn bɔn no, obokwetsi bɔn eyi noho edzi ne mpɛn ebien akyerɛ hɔn a wɔtweɔn no no dze hɔn akɔ nkwagye mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na mbra no wɔ ndzepa a ɔbɛba no no mfonyi na nnyɛ ndzɛmba no suban ankasa ntsi, wonntum mmfa afɔr kor no ara a wɔbɔ no afrenhyia afrenhyia no mma hɔn a wɔba no nndzi mu da.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hɔn a wɔba asɔr no na wɔatsew hɔnho prɛko no, sɛ wonnyi bɔn ho tsibowa bio a nkyɛ woenngyaa afɔr bɔ anaa?
title: HEBREWS

text: Na mbom wɔbɔ bɔn ho nkaa wɔ mu afrenhyia biara,
title: HEBREWS

text: osiandɛ anantwinyin nye mpɔnkye bɔgyaa runntum nnyi bɔn nnkɔ.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi ɔbaa wiadze no, ɔkaa dɛ, Afɔr nye ayɛyɛdze, ɔwo ammpɛ, Na nyimpadua na esiesie ama me;
title: HEBREWS

text: Hyew afɔr mu nye bɔn ho dze annsɔ w’enyi:
title: HEBREWS

text: Nna mesee dɛ, Hwɛ, maba, dɛ merebɛyɛ wo pɛ, ao, Nyankopɔn dɛ mbrɛ wɔakyerɛw no mo ho wɔ nwoma mbobɔwee no mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Ɔkaa no hɔ dɛ, Afɔr nye ayɛyɛdze nye hyew afɔr nye bɔn afɔr dze ammpɛ, eso w’enyi annsɔ (ɔnye dza wɔnam mbra do dze ma no) no,
title: HEBREWS

text: nkyii ɔkaa dɛ, Maba merebɛyɛ wo pɛ. Oyi dza odzi kan no hɔ, na ɔdze dza otsia ebien no eesi hɔ.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm pɛ no do na wɔnam Jesus Kraest honam a ɔdze bɔɔ afɔr prɛko maa hɛn no do atsew hɛn ho.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ɔsɔfo biara dze ogyina som daa daa bɔ afɔr kor no ara a onntum nnyi bɔn nnkɔ da no:
title: HEBREWS

text: na ɔno dze, onyae bɔɔ bɔn ho afɔr kor no, ɔkɛtsenaa Nyankopɔn nyimfa daa;
title: HEBREWS

text: hɔ na n’enyi ada kwan dɛ wɔdze n’atamfo bɛyɛ n’ananadzegua.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ɔnam afɔr kor do ama hɔn a wɔatsew hɔn ho no edzi mu daa.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn so dzi hɛn dase: na odzi kan ka dɛ,
title: HEBREWS

text: Iyi nye ahyɛmu a menye hɔn bedzi Nda no ekyir no, Ewuradze na ɔse: Medze me mbra bɛhyɛ hɔn akoma mu, Na makyerɛw no hɔn adwen mu so;
title: HEBREWS

text: nna ɔka so dɛ, Na hɔn bɔn nye hɔn mbrato merennkaa bio.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na mbrɛ yinom ho fakyɛ wɔ no, bɔn ho afɔr bi nnyi hɔ bio.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, yɛnam Jesus bɔgyaa do enya ndam dɛ yɛdze bɛhɛn krɔnkrɔnbea no,
title: HEBREWS

text: ɔnam ɔkwan a woesiesie ato hɛn hɔ no mu, kwan fofor a ɔwɔ nkwa a ɔnam ntwamutam a ɔyɛ no honam no do.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na dɛ yɛwɔ sɔfo kɛse a odzi Nyankopɔn fie do ntsi,
title: HEBREWS

text: hom mma yɛmfa nokwar akoma ntwe mpin wɔ gyedzi amayɛ mu, dɛ wɔapetse hɛn akoma ho efi tsibowa bɔn mu, na woeguar hɛn nyimpadua wɔ nsu krɔnkrɔn mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom mma yensuo hɛn enyidado a yɛpaa mu ka no mu yie, amma oeennhihim, na nyia ɔbɔɔ anohoba no ɔyɛ nokwafo.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom mma yɛndwendwen hɛnho do, nnunu hɛnho nkɔ dɔ nye ndwuma pa mu;
title: HEBREWS

text: na mma yenngyaa hɛnho hɛnho ehyiadzi, dɛ mbrɛ binom hɔn ntɔyɛɛ tse, na yentutu hɛnho fo pii wɔ ber a hom nyim dɛ da no rebɛn yi.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na yeenya nokwar no ho nyimdzee ekyir yi, sɛ yɛboapa kɛyɛ bɔn a, bɔn ho afɔrbɔ nnyi hɔ bio,
title: HEBREWS

text: na mbom atsɛmbu ho akwanhwɛ a ɔyɛ hu bi, nye ogyaframee bi a ɔbɛhyew atamfo no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɛ nyimpa a ɔpow Moses mbra no, wokwetsi ehumbɔbɔr gyina adasefo beenu anaa baasa anomu asɛm do ku no a:
title: HEBREWS

text: akatua a ɔyɛ dzen bɛn na hom susu dɛ wobobu dɛ ɔsɛ nyia oetsiatsia Nyankopɔn Ba no do, na oebu ahyɛmu bɔgyaa a wɔdze tseew no ho no ehuhudze, na ɔabɔ adom Sunsum no adapaa?
title: HEBREWS

text: Na yenyim nyia ɔka dɛ, Awerdzi yɛ medze, na mubotua kaw; na bio so, Ewuradze bobua ne man atsɛn.
title: HEBREWS

text: Adze a ɔyɛ hu nye dɛ ebɔtɔ Nyankopɔn tseasefo no ne nsamu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hom nkaa nkan nda a hom nyaa kan ekyir no hom sɔɔw amandzehu ko kɛse no;
title: HEBREWS

text: bi nye dɛ hom nam ahorbahyɛ nye ahohia do yɛɛ guasohwɛdze, na bi so nye dɛ hom yɛɛ hɔn a wɔayɛ hɔn dɛm no hɔn anyɛnkofo.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hom nyaa ayamuhyehye wɔ ndaduafo no ho, na hom dze enyigye peen hom ahodze no fom do, osiandɛ hom nyim dɛ homankasa hom wɔ ahodze a oye kyɛn iyi, na eso ɔtsena hɔ daa.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi mma hom nntow hom ndam a ɔwɔ akatua pii no nnkyen.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na ohia hom abotar, na sɛ hom wie Nyankopɔn apɛdze yɛ a, hom nsa aaka anohoba no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na aka kakraabi dɛm Na nyia ɔreba no aba, na ɔrennkyɛr.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na me tseneneenyi no nam gyedzi do benya nkwa, Na sɛ ɔsan ekyir a, me kra enyi ronnsɔ no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hɛn dze, yɛmmfora hɔn a wɔtwe hɔnho ekyir kɔ ɔsɛɛ mu no, na mbom yɛfora hɔn a wɔgye dzi dze gye hɔn kra nkwa no mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na afei gyedzi nye adze a hɛn enyi da do ho awerɛhyɛmu a osi pi, adze a enyi nntua ho no nokwar dasedzi.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na no mu na tsetsefo no nyaa dase a wɔgyee no hɔn ho.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi na yɛdze tse ase dɛ wiadze horow a wɔdze Nyankopɔn n’asɛm siesiei, na dza enyi tua ho yi mmfi dza ɔda hɔ mu na wɔyɛe.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi na Abel dze bɔɔ afɔr a oye kyɛn Kain dze maa Nyankopɔn na ɔnam do nyaa dase a wodzii no no ho dɛ ɔtsen, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn gye n’ayɛyɛdze ho dase: na ɔnam do na owui mpo a, ɔda ho kasa.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na wɔfaa Enok kɔree na oennhu owu; na woennhu no osiandɛ Nyankopɔn bɛfaa no kɔree, na ansaana wɔfaa no kɔree no, onyaa dase dɛ ɔasɔ Nyankopɔn enyi.
title: HEBREWS

text: Sɛ gyedzi nnyi mu a, obi nnkotum asɔ Nyankopɔn enyi; na nyia ɔba Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no otwar dɛ ɔgye dzi dɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na ɔyɛ hɔn a wɔhwehwɛ n’ekyir kwan no katuafo.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na wɔbɔɔ Noa nkaa wɔ dza wonnyae nnhunii ho a, nyamesuro tuu no do, na osiesiee hɛn dze gyee ne fifo nkwa, na ɔnam do buu wiadze atsɛn na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔdzedzifo maa gyedzi ho tsenenee no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na Abraham, wɔfrɛɛ no a, otsiei dɛ ɔbɔkɔ beebi a daakye obenya no dɛ egyapadze, na osii mu a nna onnyim mbrɛ ɔrokɔ.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na ɔkɛyɛɛ hɔho wɔ anohoba asaase no do dɛ dza ɔnnyɛ nedze, na ɔnye Isaak nye Jakob a wɔyɛ anohoba kor no ara adzedzifo no kɛtsenaa asese mu;
title: HEBREWS

text: na n’enyi tua kurow no a ɔwɔ fapem no a nyia ɔkyekyeree na nyia ɔyɛɛ nye Nyankopɔn no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi so na Sara dze, onyaa ahoɔdzen dze nyinseen ɔba wɔ aber a ɔatra ne nyin, osiandɛ obuu nyia ɔbɔɔ no anohoba no nokwafo:
title: HEBREWS

text: ntsi na ɔbaako a ɔyɛ dɛ oewu mpo no, ɔwoo hɔn a wɔdɔɔ so dɛ sor nworaba, na wɔtse dɛ mpoano anhwea a wonntum nnkan.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi mu na iyinom nyina wuwui, hɔn nsa annka anohoba no naaso wohunii wɔ ekyirekyir, na wɔyɛɛ no etuu paa mu kaa dɛ, wɔyɛ ahɔho nye akwantufo wɔ asaase do.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hɔn a wɔkasa dɛm no wɔda no edzi dɛ wɔrohwehwɛ hɔn kurow bi.
title: HEBREWS

text: Nna sɛ hɔn adwen wɔ dza wofii mu kɔree no do a, nkyɛ wɔwɔ ho kwan dɛ wɔsan kɔ hɔ.
title: HEBREWS

text: Mbom afei wɔrohwehwɛ dza oye kyɛn ɔno, iyi nye sor dze no: dɛm ntsi hɔn ho nnyɛ Nyankopɔn enyito dɛ wɔbɛfrɛ no hɔn Nyankopɔn, osiandɛ oesiesie kurow bi ama hɔn.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na wɔsɔɔ Abraham no hwɛe no, ɔdze Isaak kɔbɔɔ afɔr: na nyia ɔgyee anohoba no dze ne ba kor no kɛmae;
title: HEBREWS

text: ɔno na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ no dɛ, Isaak mu na wɔbɛfrɛ w’asefo no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Obuu dɛ Nyankopɔn botum enyan no efi ewufo mu mpo; hɔ so na onyaa no bio wɔ abɛbu mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na Isaak hyiraa Jakob nye Esau wɔ ndzɛmba a ɔreba ho mpo.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na Jakob ruwu a, ohyiraa Josef ne mba beenu no, na ɔkoom no poma tsir do sɔree.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na Josef n’ewiei rebɛn no, ɔkaa nkɔree a Israelmba rubotu akɔ no ho asɛm: na ɔhyɛɛ ne mbiew ho samansew.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na wɔwoo Moses no n’awofo dze no sumaa abosoom ebiasa, osiandɛ wohun dɛ ɔyɛ abofra a no ho yɛ fɛw: na woennsuro ɔhen ne mbra no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na Moses nyinii a, ɔpoow dɛ wɔbɛfrɛ no Farao babaa ba;
title: HEBREWS

text: na ɔfaa dɛ ɔnye Nyankopɔn no nkorɔfo bohu amandze mbom kyɛn dɛ obedzi bɔn ho dɛw ber tsiabaa bi;
title: HEBREWS

text: na obuu Kraest ahorbahyɛ no ahonya kɛse kyɛn Egypt ahonyadze, na ɔhwɛɛ akatua no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na ɔdaan Egypt gyae na oennsuro ɔhen no n’ebufuw no: na ɔsɔɔw no dɛ n’enyi tua nyia wonnhu no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na odzii apaho no, nye bɔgyaa petse no, ma mbakan sɛɛfo no eennkunkum hɔn no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na wotwaa Mbɛw Po no dɛ wewew do; ɔno na Egyptfo reyɛ bi ahwɛ a, po no meen hɔn no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na Jeriko afasu no wɔbɔɔ ho aprɔw nda esuon a, obui.
title: HEBREWS

text: Gyedzi ntsi na edwaman Rahab gyee akwanserafo no asomdwee mu, ma ntsi ɔammfora asokyewfo no annhera.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na menka dɛn bio? Sɛ mereka Gideon, Barak, Samson nye Jefta, David nye Samuel nye nkɔnhyɛfo no ho asɛm a, nkyɛ mber bɔbɔ me.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hɔn na wɔnam gyedzi do dzii ahendzi horow do konyim, yɛɛ ndzeyɛtsenenee, nyinyaa anohoba, siiw ngyata ano,
title: HEBREWS

text: duum gya ahoɔdzen, guaan nkrantsee ano, nyaa ahoɔmberɛw mu ahoɔdzen, yɛɛ ɔko mu mbanyinndam, kaa ananafo dɔm gui.
title: HEBREWS

text: Mbaa nsa kaa hɔn efun a wɔsoɛree, na binom so wɔhyɛɛ hɔn amen, naaso wɔammpɛ ɔgye, ama woeenya owusoɛr a oye kyɛn.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na binom so nyaa atwetwesi nye ɔhwe, nye mpokyerɛ nye efiadzenda so.
title: HEBREWS

text: Wosiiw hɔn abo, wɔdze seradaa paapaa hɔn, wɔsɔɔ hɔn hwɛe, wɔdze nkrantsee kum hɔn; wokyinii wɔ nguan nwoma nye mpɔnkye nwoma mu, ohiaa hɔn, hɔn ho guaan hɔn, wohun amandze:
title: HEBREWS

text: hɔn na wiadze mmfata hɔn: wokyinkyiin sar nye mbepɔw do, abodan nye asaase etu mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na iyinom nyina a wɔnam gyedzi do nyaa dase no, hɔn nsa annka anohoba no,
title: HEBREWS

text: osiandɛ Nyankopɔn esiesie biribi a oye kyɛn dɛm esie hɛn dɛ wokwetsi hɛn a worinndzi mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi hɛn so, dɛ yɛwɔ adasefo pii a ɔtse dɛm a woetwa hɛn ho ehyia ntsi, hom mma yɛmfa dza osiw kwan nyina nto nkyɛn, nye bɔn a ɔnnkyɛr na ɔatoto hɛn ananmu no, na yɛmfa penkyɛr ntutu empire a osi hɛn enyim no mu mbirika,
title: HEBREWS

text: nhwɛ gyedzi ne dzikamfo nye no wiefo Jesus a osian dɛw a wɔdze sii n’enyim ntsi ɔsɔɔw mbeamudua no, na n’enyi annto wɔ ho, na ɔakɛtsena ase wɔ Nyankopɔn ahengua no enyimfa no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hom mma hom adwen nkɔ nyia ɔyɛɛ abotar tsiee ndzebɔnyɛfo hɔn nyiyiano tsiaa no ho no, amma hom aammberɛ anntɔ bitsi wɔ hom akra mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Ako a hom nye bɔn ridzi no, hom nnkoe nnkodur dɛ hom kyi hom bɔgyaa;
title: HEBREWS

text: na hom werɛ efir afotu a ɔkasa kyerɛ hom dɛ mba no a ɔse, Me ba, mma mmbu Ewuradze ne ntsea no adze kakraba, Eso sɛ ɔka w’enyim a, mma mmpa abaw:
title: HEBREWS

text: Na nyia Ewuradze dɔ no no, na ɔtsea no, Na ɔhwe ɔba biara a ɔgye no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom nsɔw amandzehu dɛ ɔyɛ ntsea. Nyankopɔn nye hom ridzi no dɛ mba; na ɔba bɛn na n’egya nntsea no?
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sɛ hom nnyi ntsea a hɔn nyina nya bi no a, nna hom yɛ edwaman mba, na nnyɛ nokwar mba bi.
title: HEBREWS

text: Bio so, yenyaa hɛn honam mu egyanom a wɔtseaa hɛn, na yedzii hɔn nyi. Aso mbom yɛnnkɛfa hɛnho ahyɛ hɛn sunsum mu Egya no ase na yɛatsena ase?
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hɔn dze, ampaara wɔtseaa hɛn nda kakraabi dɛ mbrɛ wɔhwɛ a oye ma hɔn: na ɔno dze, ɔtsea hɛn ma hɛn yieyɛ ama yeenya n’ahotsew no bi.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na sesei dze ntsea nyina nnyɛ enyigye, na mbom awerɛhodze a; na n’ekyir no ɔsow asomdwee aba dze ma hɔn a wɔdze asɔ hɔn ahwɛ no, mekyerɛ tsenenee aba.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mma abaw a asensen no do, na hom mmiamia hom nkotodwe a ɔagogow no mu;
title: HEBREWS

text: na hom nsiesie akwan tsenenee mma hom anan, amma dza ɔtow apakye no no ndwonku eennhuan, na mbom wɔaasa no yarba.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom ndzi asomdwee ekyir wɔ nyimpa nyina afamu, nye ahotsewee a obi kwetsi a orunnhu Ewuradze no:
title: HEBREWS

text: hom nhwɛ yie amma obi eemmfi Nyankopɔn adom ho annka ekyir: amma bɔwen ndwow bi eemmfir annhaw hom, na eenndua do ma ɔdodow ho eenngu fi;
title: HEBREWS

text: amma obi aannyɛ edwaman anaa ohuhunyi bi, dɛ Esau a ɔtɔɔn n’abakan ndzinoa gyee edziban dzipɛn kor no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hom nyim mbrɛ ekyir no ɔpɛɛ dɛ onya nhyira no a, wɔpoow no, na nnuho kwan no dze, kaansa ɔdze nyinsuwa hwehwɛe a, oennhu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na hom nnyaa mmbaa koko no a wɔdze nsa ka, na ɔredzɛw ogya no ho, nye mununkum, nye sum, nye ehum,
title: HEBREWS

text: nye totorobɛnto ne gyegye, nye ndze a hɔn a wɔtsee no wɔserɛɛ dɛ mma wɔnnka asɛm bi nnkyerɛ hɔn bio no ho.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na woenntum annsɔw dza wɔhyɛe no a ɔse, Sɛ abowa mpo ho ka koko no a, wonsiw no abo no;
title: HEBREWS

text: na dza opuei no yɛ hu pii ntsi Moses kaa dɛ, Musuro dodow na mo ho popo.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na mbom hom aba bepɔw Sion, nye Nyankopɔn tseasefo kurow no, ɔsor Jerusalɛm no ho, nye ɔsor abɔfo mpempem,
title: HEBREWS

text: nye mbakan a wɔakyerɛw hɔn edzin wɔ sor no hɔn asafo nye baguabɔ, nye Nyankopɔn, nyimpa nyina tsɛmbuafo no, nye tseneneefo a woedzi mu esunsum,
title: HEBREWS

text: nye ahyɛmu fofor ho ntamugyinafo Jesus, nye bɔgya a ɔpetse no a ɔkasa yie kyɛn Abel dze no ho.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom nhwɛ na hom aammpow nyia ɔkasa no. Na sɛ hɔn a wɔpoow nyia ɔkasaa asaase do no mpo emmfi nsa a, mpɛn ahen na sɛ hɛn yɛdan fi nyia ofi sor kasa no ho a, yebefi nsa?
title: HEBREWS

text: Ɔno na ber no mu ne ndze wosoow asaase, na afei dze ɔabɔ anohoba dɛ, Mebɛma awosow prɛko bio, na nnyɛ asaase nko bi na ɔsor so.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na, Prɛko bio yi, ɔkyerɛ ndzɛmba a wɔwosow no ne nyii, dɛ ndzɛmba a wɔayɛ, na ndzɛmba a wɔnnwosow no eetsim hɔ.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi, dɛ yeenya ahenman a ɔnnwosow yi, hom mma yɛmfa ndaase ndua do nsom Nyankopɔn nsɔ n’enyi wɔ enyidzi nye hu mu:
title: HEBREWS

text: na hɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ ogya a ɔhyew.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom mma enuadɔ ntsena hɔ daa.
title: HEBREWS

text: Mma hom enyi mmpa ahɔhoyɛ do: na ɔno do na binom nam ayɛ abɔfo a woennhu hɔn dɛm no ahɔho.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom nkaa hɔn a wɔda efiadze no, dɛ dza hom nye hɔn da hɔ, nye hɔn a wohu amandze biara, dɛ homankasa so da ho wɔ honam mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom ndzi awar nyi wɔ adze nyina mu, na mma hom nngu awarmpa ho fi: na ndwaman nye awartofo dze, Nyankopɔn bobu hɔn atsɛn.
title: HEBREWS

text: Mma sika enyiber mmba hom abrabɔ mu. Hom mma hom bo ndwe dza hom wɔ no ara ho: na nankasa aka dɛ, Mirinngya wo da, eso meremmpa wo da biara da.
title: HEBREWS

text: Ntsi yɛdze ndam ka dɛ, Ewuradze nye mo boafo; murunnsuro: Nyimpa botum ayɛ me dɛn?
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom nkaa hɔn a wɔhwɛɛ hom do a wɔkaa nyamesɛm kyerɛɛ hom no; hom nhwɛ hɔn abrabɔ ewiei, na hom nsua hɔn gyedzi.
title: HEBREWS

text: Jesus Kraest tse dɛmara ndeda, nye ndɛ, nye daapem nyina.
title: HEBREWS

text: Mma hom mma nkyerɛkyerɛ horow fofor bi mmfa hom nnkyinkyin: na oye dɛ wɔdze adom hyɛ akoma dzen mbom, na nnyɛ edziban a hɔn a wɔnantsew mu ennya mfaso bi no a.
title: HEBREWS

text: Yɛwɔ afɔrmbukyia a hɔn a wɔsom ntamadan mu no nnyi kwan dɛ wodzi ho biribi.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na mbowa a sɔfopanyin no dze hɔn bɔgyaa kɔ krɔnkrɔnbea mu wɔ bɔn ntsi no, hɔn efun wɔhyew no nseraban no ekyir.
title: HEBREWS

text: Ntsi na Jesus so, mbrɛ ɔbɛyɛ na ɔdze no bɔgyaa atsew ɔman no ho no, ohun amandze wɔ kuropon no ekyir no.
title: HEBREWS

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mma yempue nkɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ nseraban no ekyir, dɛ yɛso n’adapaabɔ no bi.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na yennyi kurow a ɔtse hɔ daa wɔ ha, na mbom dza ɔreba no na yɛhwehwɛ n’ekyir kwan.
title: HEBREWS

text: Ɔno ntsi hom mma yendua no do mbɔ ayɛyi afɔr mma Nyankopɔn daa, ɔno nye anofamfa aba a ɔpaa mu bɔ no ne dzin.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na mma hom werɛ mmfir adɔyɛ nye adzekyɛ, na dɛm afɔrbɔdze yi na ɔsɔ Nyankopɔn enyi.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom ntsie hom akandzifo na hom mbrɛ hom ho adze mma hɔn: osiandɛ hɔn na wɔweɔn hom akra, na wobobu ho nkontaa; ama wɔdze enyigye aayɛ iyi na nnyɛ nkrumsi bi a: annyɛ dɛm a ɔnnkɛyɛ mfaso ama hom.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom nsɔr mma hɛn: na yɛwɔ awerɛhyɛmu dɛ yɛwɔ tsibowa pa, dɛ yɛpɛ dɛ yɛbɔ hɛn bra yie wɔ adze nyina mu.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na mutu hom fo papaapa dɛ hom nyɛ iyi, ama woeegyaa me ama hom ntsɛmara.
title: HEBREWS

text: Afei asomdwee Nyankopɔn a ɔnam onnyiewiei ahyɛmu no bɔgyaa do dze nguan no hɔn hwɛfo kɛse, mekyerɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest, fi ewufo mu baa bio no,
title: HEBREWS

text: ɔmma hom ndzi mu wɔ edwuma pa nyina mu, na hom nyɛ ne pɛ, na ɔmfa Jesus Kraest do nyɛ hɛn mu dza ɔsɔ n’enyi, ɔno na enyimnyam nka no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
title: HEBREWS

text: Na mutu hom fo, enuanom, hom ntsie afotusɛm yi: na makyerɛw nsɛntsia bi amona hom.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom nhu dɛ woegyaa hɛn nua Timoti; na sɛ ɔba ntsɛm a, menye no bɛba ebohu hom.
title: HEBREWS

text: Hom nkyiakyia hɔn a wɔhwɛ hom do no nyina, nye ahotseweefo no nyina. Hɔn a wofi Itali no kyiakyia hom.
title: HEBREWS

text: Adom nka hom nyina. [Amen.]
title: HEBREWS

text: James, Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest akowaa, kyia mbusuakuw duebien a wɔapetse no.
title: JAMES

text: Mo nuanom, sɛ hom kɔ nsɔhwɛ ahorow pii mu a, hom mbu no dɛw koraa;
title: JAMES

text: na hom nhu dɛ hom gyedzi no nsɔhwɛ yɛ abotar ho edwuma.
title: JAMES

text: Na hom mma abotar nwie n’edwuma yɛ pɛ, ama hom eedzi mu pirim a hom nnka ekyir wɔ biribiara mu.
title: JAMES

text: Na sɛ hom mu biara ne nyansaa ka ekyir a, ombisa Nyankopɔn a ɔdze ma nyimpa nyina kwa na ɔnnka enyim no, na ɔdze bɛma no.
title: JAMES

text: Na gyedzi mu na ma ombisa, mma ɔnnyɛ ekyingye wɔ biribiara ho: na nyia ɔgye kyim no tse dɛ po asorɛkye a mframa ridzi no akɔnaaba.
title: JAMES

text: Na mma nyimpa a n’adwen ebien ebien, na ohihim n’akwan nyina mu no;
title: JAMES

text: nndwen dɛ obenya Ewuradze hɔ biribi.
title: JAMES

text: Na wɔmma onua a ɔbrɛ adze no ndzi dɛw wɔ ɔma a wɔama no do no mu;
title: JAMES

text: na ɔdzefo so dze, wɔ brɛ a wɔabrɛ no adze no mu; osiandɛ ɔbɛsen akɔ dɛ nkyɛkyɛr nhyiren.
title: JAMES

text: Na ewia dze ne hyehye fir na ɔhyew nkyɛkyɛr, na ne nhyiren po, na no su ne fɛw sɛɛ; dɛmara so na ɔtse wɔ ɔdzefo ho; n’edwumayɛ dzendzen mu no na ɔbɛpa.
title: JAMES

text: Siarfo nye nyimpa a ɔsɔw nsɔhwɛ; na sɛ otum gyina enyim a, obenya nkwa ahenkyɛw a Ewuradze dze abɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ no no anohoba no.
title: JAMES

text: Sɛ nsɔhwɛ ba obiara do a, mma ɔnnka dɛ, Nyankopɔn na ɔrosɔ me ahwɛ: na adzebɔn bi nntum nnsɔ Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ, na ɔnoara so mmfa bɔn nnsɔ obiara nnhwɛ.
title: JAMES

text: Obiara a wɔsɔ no hwɛ no, ofi nankasa n’akɔndɔ a ɔdaadaa no twe no kɔ nsɔhwɛ mu.
title: JAMES

text: Na sɛ akɔndɔ no nyinsen a, ɔwo bɔn; na bɔn no wie nyin a, ɔwo owu.
title: JAMES

text: Mo nuanom adɔfo, mma wɔnndaadaa hom.
title: JAMES

text: Akyɛdze pa nye adom adze a odzi mu nyina fi sor, ofi kan Egya no nkyɛn na osian ba, ɔno na nsakyer nye sunsum a ɔdandan dze ba nnyi no ho.
title: JAMES

text: Ɔnam nankasa ne pɛ do na ɔdze nokwasɛm woo hɛn, ama yaayɛ n’abɔdze mu eduabakan no bi.
title: JAMES

text: Hom ntse ase dɛm, mo nuanom adɔfo, dɛ, nyimpa biara nyɛ ntsɛm ntsie, nyɛ nyaa nkasa, nyɛ nyaa mfa ebufuw:
title: JAMES

text: osiandɛ nyimpa n’ebufuw nnyɛ Nyankopɔn tsenenee ho edwuma.
title: JAMES

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nyi atantandze nye bɔn beberebe nyina ntow ngu, na hom mfa ɔdwe ngye asɛm a wɔatsɛw no hom mu a obotum agye hom akra nkwa no.
title: JAMES

text: Na hom nyɛ asɛm no ayɛfo, na mma hom nnyɛ etsiefo nko nndaadaa homho.
title: JAMES

text: Na sɛ obi yɛ asɛm no ne tsiefo, na sɛ ɔnnyɛ ne yɛfo a, ɔtse dɛ nyimpa a ɔhwɛ n’enyim wɔ ahwehwɛ mu:
title: JAMES

text: na sɛ ɔhwɛ noho na ɔkɔ a, ntsɛmara na no werɛ efir nyimpa su kor a ɔyɛ.
title: JAMES

text: Na nyia ɔhwɛ adehyedzi mbra a odzi mu no mu, na ogyina do, na ɔnnyɛ otsiefo werɛfirnyi mbom ɔyɛ edwuma no yɛfo no, ɔno na wobehyira no n’adzeyɛ mu.
title: JAMES

text: Sɛ obi dwen noho dɛ ɔyɛ nyamesomnyi, na ɔammfa ewur annto ne tɛkyerɛma mu, na ɔdaadaa nankasa n’akoma a, dɛm nyimpa no ne nyamesom yɛ kwa.
title: JAMES

text: Nyamesom a no ho tsew na fi nnyi ho wɔ hɛn Egya Nyankopɔn, enyim nye dɛ, ebɔhwɛ ngyanka nye ekunafo wɔ hɔn ahohia mu, na ibeyi woho efi wiadze nkekaa mu.
title: JAMES

text: Mo nuanom, mma hom mmfa nyimpa mu nyiyimu nnsuo hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest, enyimnyam Wura no, ne gyedzi no mu,
title: JAMES

text: Na sɛ nyimpa a ɔhyɛ sika mpɛtsea nye atar fɛɛfɛw ba hom nhyiamudan mu, na sɛ hianyi a ɔhyɛ atar tantan bi so ba hɔ,
title: JAMES

text: na sɛ hom nya enyidzi ma nyia ɔhyɛ atar fɛɛfɛw no, na hom se no dɛ, Tsena tsenabea pa ha, na hom se hianyi no dɛ, Gyina noho, anaa, Tsena m’ananadzegua ho ha a,
title: JAMES

text: ana nnyɛ nyiyimu na hom ayɛ wɔ hom mu, na hom ayɛ adwen bɔn tsɛmbuafo?
title: JAMES

text: Mo nuanom adɔfo, hom ntsie: Ana Nyankopɔn mmfaa wiadze ehiafo dɛ wɔnyɛ gyedzi mu ahonyafo nye adzedzifo wɔ ahenman a ɔdze bɔɔ hɔn a wɔdɔ no no anohoba no?
title: JAMES

text: Naaso hom ebu ohianyi enyimtsia. Ana nnyɛ ahonyafo na wɔhyɛ hom do, na hɔnankasa wɔtwe hom kɔ asɛndzii no?
title: JAMES

text: Ana nnyɛ hɔn na wɔka dzin pa a wɔdze frɛ hom no ho asɛmbɔn?
title: JAMES

text: Naaso sɛ hom hyɛ mbra kunyin no ma, dɛ mbrɛ kyerɛw no ka dɛ, Dɔ wo nyɛnko dɛ woara wo ho no a, ɔnodze, hom yɛ dza oye;
title: JAMES

text: na sɛ hom yɛ nyimpa mu nyiyimu a, hom yɛ bɔn, na mbra no yi hom atsɛn dɛ mbratofo.
title: JAMES

text: Na obiara a obedzi mbra no do na ɔato kor mpo no, odzi ne nyina ho fɔ.
title: JAMES

text: Na nyia ɔsee dɛ, Mma nnto awar no, ɔnoara so na ɔkaa dɛ, Mma nndzi ewu. Na sɛ annto awar na idzi ewu a, ayɛ mbra no tofo.
title: JAMES

text: Dɛm ntsi, hom nkasa, na hom nyɛ hom adze dɛ nyimpa a wɔnam adehyedzi mbra no do rubobu hom atsɛn.
title: JAMES

text: Na mbɔbɔrhu nnyi atsɛmbu mma nyia oennhu mbɔbɔr no: na ehumbɔbɔr soɛr dzi atsɛmbu do.
title: JAMES

text: Mo nuanom, sɛ obi ka dɛ ɔwɔ gyedzi na onnyi ndwuma a, ebɛn mfaso na ɔyɛ? Aso dɛm gyedzi no bɛgye no nkwa?
title: JAMES

text: Sɛ onua anaa akyerɛbaa dzi adagyaw, na anomu edzidzi abɔ hɔn,
title: JAMES

text: na sɛ hom mu bi se hɔn dɛ, Hom mfa asomdwee nkɔ, hom ho nyɛ hom hyew, na hom mmee, na sɛ hom amma hɔn dza ohia nyimpadua no a, ebɛn mfaso na ɔyɛ?
title: JAMES

text: Dɛmara na sɛ gyedzi so nnyi ndwuma a, nna oewu wɔ nankasa no mu.
title: JAMES

text: Nyew, obi bɛse dɛ, Ɔwo ewɔ gyedzi, na mo so mowɔ ndwuma: kyerɛ me wo gyedzi a ndwuma nnyi ho, na mo so menam mo ndwuma do bɛkyerɛ wo me gyedzi.
title: JAMES

text: Egye dzi dɛ Nyankopɔn yɛ kortsee: noara nye no: mbɔnsam so mpo gye dzi na hɔn ho popo.
title: JAMES

text: Ɔwo, nyimpa a nnyi nyimdzee, epɛ dɛ wɔkyerɛ wo dɛ gyedzi a ndwuma nnka ho no nnsow aba?
title: JAMES

text: Ana nnyɛ ndwuma mu na wɔnam buu hɛn egya Abraham bem, dɛ ɔdze ne ba Isaak bɔɔ afɔr wɔ afɔrpata no do?
title: JAMES

text: Ihu dɛ ne gyedzi nye no ndwuma yɛɛ edwuma, na ɔnam ndwuma no do na ne gyedzi dzii mu;
title: JAMES

text: na kyerɛwsɛm no a ɔka dɛ, Abraham gyee Nyankopɔn dzii, na wobuu no tsenenee maa no, na wɔfrɛɛ no Nyankopɔn ne nyɛnko hyɛɛ ma.
title: JAMES

text: Na hom hu dɛ ɔnam ndwuma do na wobu nyimpa bem, na nnyɛ gyedzi nko do.
title: JAMES

text: Ana nnyɛ dɛmara so na wɔnam ndwuma do buu edwaman Rahab bem, wɔ dɛ ɔgyee abɔfo no, na ɔmaa wɔfaa kwan fofor do kɔree no?
title: JAMES

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ nyimpadua nnyi sunsum a, nna oewu no, dɛmara na gyedzi so nnyi ndwuma a, nna oewu.
title: JAMES

text: Mo nuanom, mma hom nnyɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo pii, osiandɛ hom nyim dɛ hɛn akyerɛkyerɛfo yi na wobobu hɛn atsɛn kɛse.
title: JAMES

text: Na hɛn nyina yɛfom ndzɛmba pii mu. Sɛ obi mmfom asɛm mu a, ɔno na ɔyɛ nyimpa a odzi mu a otum dɛ ɔdze ewur to ne nyimpadua nyinara so mu.
title: JAMES

text: Na sɛ yɛdze ndabraka to mpɔnkɔ anomu ma wotsie hɛn a, yɛdandan hɔn abowamu nyina so.
title: JAMES

text: Hom nhwɛ wusihɛn so, wɔsoso araa ma mframa a ano yɛ dzen na opia hɔn, naaso wɔdze kutow kakraba dandan hɔn kɔ beebiara a hɛnkitsafo no pɛ.
title: JAMES

text: Dɛmara na tɛkyerɛma yɛ honam ho adze kakraba, naaso ɔhyehyɛ noho wɔ adze kɛse ho. Hom nhwɛ mbrɛ ogya ketseketse so tum hyew kwaa kɛse!
title: JAMES

text: Na tɛkyerɛma so yɛ ogya. Hɛn mfafakuwa nyinara mu, tɛkyerɛma na ayɛ dɛ emumuyɛ wiadze wɔ mu, na ogu nyimpadua nyina ho fi, na ɔsɔ ɔbra kwan nyina gya, na wofi hɛɛl sɔ no so gya.
title: JAMES

text: Na mbowadoma horow nye ntumbowa, nye aweaweambowa nye dza ɔwɔ po mu no, wotum dwedwe hɔn, na nyimpa dze hɔn su adwedwe hɔn:
title: JAMES

text: naaso tɛkyerɛma dze, nyimpa biara nntum nndwedwe no; ɔyɛ adzebɔn a wɔhom do a ɔnnhom, owu bɔr ahyɛ no ma.
title: JAMES

text: Ɔno na yɛdze hyira Egya Nyankopɔn, na ɔnoara so na yɛdze dom nyimpa a wɔayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn suban mu:
title: JAMES

text: ano kor no ara na nhyira nye ndom fi mu ba. Mo nuanom, ɔnnsɛ dɛ iyinom ba no dɛm koraa.
title: JAMES

text: Aso nsubura bi puw nsu dɛɛdɛw nye wenwen fi nsunyiwa kor mu?
title: JAMES

text: Mo nuanom, ana adɔmbadua botum asow ngodua aba? Anaaso wenyindua botum asow adɔmba? Dɛmara na nsu nkyenkyen runntum mmba nsu pa.
title: JAMES

text: Hom mu woana na ɔyɛ nyansafo nye nyimdzefo? Wɔmma ɔmfa ɔbra pa nkyerɛ no ndwuma wɔ ɔdwe a nyansa wɔ mu mu.
title: JAMES

text: Na sɛ hom wɔ nyinkun wenwen nye mansotwe wɔ hom akoma mu a, mma hom nnhyehyɛ homho, na hom nndzi ator nntsia nokwar no.
title: JAMES

text: Nnyɛ yi nye nyansa a ofi sor, na mbom dza ofi asaase nye honam nye abɔnsam no a.
title: JAMES

text: Na mbrɛ nyinkun nye mansotwe wɔ no, hɔ na sakasaka nye adze a ɔyɛ tan nyina wɔ.
title: JAMES

text: Na nyansa a ofi sor no dze, dza odzi kan nye dɛ no ho tsew, na ɔwɔ asomdwee, ɔdwe, ɔwɔ asoɔmberɛw, ehumbɔbɔr nye aba pa ahyɛ no ma, ɔnnyɛ ekyingye, ɔnnyɛ ndabraba.
title: JAMES

text: Na tsenenee aba wodua no tsenenee mu ma hɔn a wɔyɛ asomdwee adze.
title: JAMES

text: Hen na akasakasa nye ɔko fi ba hom mu? Ana ommfi hom akɔndɔ a odzi hom honam mu aperper no?
title: JAMES

text: Hom hwehwɛ ndzɛmba bi naaso hom nnya; ntsi hom dzi ewu na hom enyi ber, naaso hom nsa nnka; hom ko na hom ham, naaso hom nnya, osiandɛ hom mmbisa.
title: JAMES

text: Hom bisa naaso hom nsa nnka, osiandɛ hom bisa no bɔn, ama hom aahwer no hom akɔndɔdze ho.
title: JAMES

text: Awartofo, ana hom nnyim dɛ wiadze anyɛnkoyɛ yɛ tan a wɔdze tan Nyankopɔn? Dɛm ntsi obiara a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔnye wiadze yɛ nyɛnko no, yɛ Nyankopɔn ne tamfo.
title: JAMES

text: Ana hom dwen dɛ kyerɛw no kasa kwa? Ana sunsum a ɔmaa ɔbɛtsenaa hɛn mu no, no kɔn dɔ nyitan?
title: JAMES

text: Na ɔma adom pii mbom. Dɛm ntsi kyerɛwsɛm no se, Nyame siw ahopɔwfo kwan na ɔma ahobrɛadzefo adom.
title: JAMES

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mfa homho nhyɛ Nyankopɔn ase; hom mbɔ mbɔdzen nsiw abɔnsam kwan, na oboguan efi hom nkyɛn.
title: JAMES

text: Hom ntwe mpin Nyankopɔn na ɔbɔtwe epin hom. Hom nhohor hom nsa, hom ndzebɔnyɛfo; hom ntsew hom akoma mu, hom a hom adwen ebien ebien.
title: JAMES

text: Hom nka mmɔn, na hom werɛ nhow, na hom nsu: hom mma hom serew ndan awerɛhow, na hom ahosɛpɛw ndan ahonambubu.
title: JAMES

text: Hom mbrɛ homho adze wɔ Ewuradze enyim na ɔbɛma hom do.
title: JAMES

text: Enuanom, mma hom nnkeka hom ho nsɛmbɔn. Nyia ɔka no nua ho nsɛmbɔn, anaa obu no nua atsɛn no, ɔkasa tsia mbra no, na obu mbra no atsɛn; na sɛ ibu mbra no atsɛn a, nna ennyɛ mbra no yɛfo, na eyɛ ne tsɛmbuafo.
title: JAMES

text: Mbrahyɛfo nye tsɛmbuafo kortsee na ɔwɔ hɔ, ɔno nye nyia otum dɛ ɔgye nkwa na ɔsɛɛ no. Na ɔwo woana nye wo na ibu wo nyɛnko atsɛn?
title: JAMES

text: Na afei hom ɛ, hom a hom ka dɛ, Ndɛ anaa ɔkyena yɛbɔkɔ kurow yi mu ekedzi afrenhyia, na yeedzi gua enya mfaso:
title: JAMES

text: naaso hom nnyim dza ɔkyena obesi. Hom nkwa nye bɛn? Hom tse dɛ ehubɔhubɔw a oyi noho kakra na nkyii ɔhera.
title: JAMES

text: Na mbom hom nnka dɛ, Sɛ Ewuradze pɛ, na yɛtse ase a, yɛbɛyɛ iyi anaa yɛbɛyɛ dɛm.
title: JAMES

text: Na afei dze, hom tuw homho wɔ hom ahopɔw mu; na dɛm ntuw yi nyina yɛ bɔn.
title: JAMES

text: Na nyia onyim papa yɛ na ɔnnyɛ no, ɔyɛ bɔn ma no.
title: JAMES

text: Na afei hom ahonyafo e, hom nsu na hom nka mmɔn, wɔ hom amandzehu a ɔreba hom do ntsi.
title: JAMES

text: Hom ahonya aprɔw na hom ntar mbowa awe.
title: JAMES

text: Hom sika nye hom dwetɛ adɔ nkandar; na hɔn nkandar no bedzi hom dase, na woedzi hom nam dɛ ogya. Hom aboaboa ahonya ano wɔ nda a odzi ekyir yi mu.
title: JAMES

text: Hom nhwɛ, edwumayɛfo a wɔboaboa hom ekuadze ano ma hom no, hɔn akatua a hom dze nsisi fae siei no rekeka mu, na apaafo a wobuu ndɔbaa no hɔn nkekamu akɔ sor dɔm Ewuradze asomu.
title: JAMES

text: Hom atsena asaase do ahomka mu, na hom enya enyigye hun; hom anyɛn hom akoma wɔ okum da mu;
title: JAMES

text: hom ebu ɔtseneneenyi fɔ eku no; onnsiw hom kwan.
title: JAMES

text: Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, hom nyɛ penkyɛr nkodu Ewuradze ne mbae. Hwɛ, okuafo a ɔrotweɔn asaase n’aba a ɔsom bo no, onya ho abotar araa kodu dɛ ne nsa bɛka esusow nye ɔbɛsɛ.
title: JAMES

text: Dɛmara na hom so nyɛ penkyɛr; hom nhyɛ hom akoma dzen, osiandɛ Ewuradze ne mbae no abɛn.
title: JAMES

text: Enuanom, mma hom nnyɛ huhuhuhu nntsiatsia homho, ama woeemmbu hom atsɛn: hwɛ, ɔtsɛmbuafo no gyina abow no ekyir.
title: JAMES

text: Enuanom, hom mfa nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔkasae wɔ Ewuradze dzin mu no nyɛ amandzehu nye penkyɛr ho fasusu.
title: JAMES

text: Hwɛ, yɛfrɛ hɔn a wotsintsimii na wɔsɔwee no esiarfo: hom atse Job n’abotar no, na hom ehu Ewuradze ne nhyehyɛɛ, mbrɛ Ewuradze dua yɛ tsimbɔbɔr nye ehumbɔbɔr.
title: JAMES

text: Na mo nuanom, dza ɔkyɛn adze nyina nye dɛ, mma hom nnka ntam, mma hom nnka ɔsor anaa asaase anaa ntam biara: na mbom hom mma hom nyew nyɛ nyew na hom oho nyɛ oho, amma hom aannkɔtɔ atsɛmbu mu.
title: JAMES

text: Ana hom mu bi ruhu amandze? Wɔmma ɔnsɔr. Ana obi n’akoma atɔ ne yamu? Wɔmma ɔntow ayɛyindwom.
title: JAMES

text: Ana hom mu bi yar? Wɔmma ɔmfrɛ asɔr mpanyimfo, na wɔmbɔ mpaa mma no, na wɔnsera no ngo wɔ Ewuradze dzin mu:
title: JAMES

text: na gyedzi mpaabɔ no bɛgye nyia ɔyar no nkwa, na Ewuradze bɛma no do; na sɛ ɔayɛ bɔn bi a, wɔdze bɛkyɛ no.
title: JAMES

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nkeka hom bɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ homho, na hom mbɔ mpaa mma homho, ama wɔaasa hom yarba. Nyimpa tsenenee no nkotoserɛ a no mu yɛ dzen dzi nyim pii wɔ n’adzeyɛ mu.
title: JAMES

text: Elija yɛ nyimpa a ɔwɔ hɛn su kor yi ara bi, naaso ɔbɔɔ mpaa dɛ mma nsu nntɔ no, nsu anntɔ asaase do mfe ebiasa abosoom esia.
title: JAMES

text: Na ɔbɔɔ bio, na ɔsor tɔr nsu na asaase soow n’aba.
title: JAMES

text: Mo nuanom, sɛ hom mu bi fom fi nokwar no ho, na obi dan no a,
title: JAMES

text: hom mma onhu dɛ nyia ɔdan dzebɔnyɛnyi fi no mfom kwan do no, ɔbɛgye ɔkra efi owu mu, na ɔakata bɔn pii do.
title: JAMES

text: Peter, Jesus Kraest somafo, dze kɛma hɔn a wɔasan mu eyi hɔn a wɔyɛ amamforafo a wɔapetse wɔ Pontus, Galatia, Kapadosia, Asia nye Bitinia no,
title: 1ST PETER

text: dɛ mbrɛ Egya Nyankopɔn asan mu eyi hɔn ato hɔ wɔ ne nyim a onyim dada mu no tse, wɔ Sunsum n’ahotsew mu, dze kɔ setsie nye Jesus Kraest no bɔgya a ɔtsew ho mu. Adom nye asomdwee nka hom mbordo mbordo.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Nhyira nka hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ne Nyankopɔn nye n’Egya a n’ehumbɔbɔr a ɔdɔɔ so ntsi ɔnam Jesus Kraest n’ewufo mu soɛr no do awo hɛn fofor ama nkwa enyidado,
title: 1ST PETER

text: akɔ egyapadze a ɔmmprɔw, na fi ho nnyi, na ɔmmpa mu. Iyi na wɔakora no wɔ sor ama hom a
title: 1ST PETER

text: wɔnam Nyankopɔn no tum do roweɔn hom akɔ nkwagye a woesiesie dɛ woribeyi no ber a odzi ekyir no mu no.
title: 1ST PETER

text: No mu na hom ho sɛpɛw hom, hom a sesei, sɛ ɔsɛ a, wɔhow hom werɛ ber kumaabi wɔ nsɔhwɛ horow pii mu,
title: 1ST PETER

text: ama woeehu hom gyedzi no nsɔhwɛ dɛ ɔsom bo pii kyɛn sikakɔkɔɔ, wɔsɔ hwɛ wɔ ogya mu, naaso sika mpo ɔsɛɛ, aama ayɛyi nye enyimnyam nye enyidzi wɔ ber a Jesus Kraest beyi no ho edzi no mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Ɔno na hom nnhu no dze, naaso hom dɔ no; na hom nnhu no sesei dze, naaso hom gye no dzi ntsi hom ho sɛpɛw hom wɔ ahosɛpɛw a onnyi kabea a enyimnyam ahyɛ no ma mu,
title: 1ST PETER

text: aber a hom nya hom gyedzi ho akatua, mekyerɛ hom kra nkwagye no.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Dɛm nkwagye no na nkɔnhyɛfo a wɔhyɛɛ adom a ɔbɛba hom do no ho nkɔm too hɔ no, wɔhwehwɛɛ na wɔpɛnsapɛnsaa mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Wɔhwehwɛɛ ber no nye ber kor a Kraest no Sunsum a ɔwɔ hɔn mu no dzii kan daa no edzi faa n’amandzehu nye ekyir enyimnyam a ɔbɛba no ho no.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Woyii kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, nnyɛ hɔnho bi na wɔsom, na mbom wɔsom hom fa ndzɛmba a sesei yi yɛbɔ no dawur kyerɛ hom nye iyinom so a wɔnam Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn a wɔsomaa no fi sor no do bɛkaa asɛmpa no kyerɛɛ hɔn no. Nsɛm a abɔfo mpo pɛɛ dɛ wobohu mu no a.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nsi hom adwen tadua, hom enyi nda hɔ na hom mfa enyidado nto adom a wɔdze rebrɛ hom wɔ da a Jesus Kraest beyi noho akyerɛ no do koraa;
title: 1ST PETER

text: dɛ setsie mba, mma hom nnyɛ homho dɛ nkan no a hom nnyim dze ntsi no, hom dzii hom akɔndɔ ekyir no;
title: 1ST PETER

text: na dɛ nyia ɔfrɛɛ hom no yɛ krɔnkrɔn no, homankasa so nyɛ krɔnkrɔn wɔ asetsena nyina mu;
title: 1ST PETER

text: osiandɛ wɔakyerɛw no dɛ, Hom nyɛ krɔnkrɔn, osiandɛ emi meyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na sɛ hom frɛ nyia ɔnnhwɛ nyimpa enyim, na obu atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ obiara n’edwuma tse no dɛ Egya a, nna hom mfa suro mbɔ bra wɔ hom ahɔhotsena ber yi mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Hom nyim dɛ wɔammfa ndzɛmba a ɔprɔw, dwetɛ anaa sika, na wɔdze gyee hom fii hom abrabɔ gyangyan a hom egyanom dze gyaa hom no mu;
title: 1ST PETER

text: na mbom Kraest bɔgya a ɔsom bo no a, dɛ eguambaa a dzɛm nye nkekaa nnyi no ho.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Ɔno na wohun no siei ansaana wɔroto wiadze ne fapem, na woeyi no akyerɛ ber a odzi ekyir yi mu ama hom a
title: 1ST PETER

text: hom nam no do ayɛ agyedzifo wɔ Nyankopɔn a onyaan no fii ewufo mu, na ɔhyɛɛ no enyimnyam no mu, na hom gyedzi nye hom enyidado aatsena Nyankopɔn mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Ɔnam dɛ hom atsew hom akra ho wɔ setsie mu akɔ enuadɔ a ndaadaa nnyi mu ntsi, hom mfi akoma mu ndodɔ homho yie.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Nnyɛ aba a ɔprɔw mu, na mbom dza ɔmmprɔw mu na wɔnam Nyankopɔn n’asɛm a ɔtse ase na ɔbɛtsena ase daa no do no fi awo hom fofor.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na, Honam nyina tse dɛ nkyɛkyɛr, Na n’enyimnyam nyina tse dɛ nkyɛkyɛr nhyiren. Nkyɛkyɛr kyenkyen, na nhyiren po:
title: 1ST PETER

text: naaso Ewuradze n’asɛm dze, ɔtse hɔ daa. Na iyi nye asɛmpa a wɔkaa kyerɛɛ hom no.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Dɛm ntsi hom nyiyi emumuyɛ nye ndaadaa, nye ndabraba, nye nyitan, nye anokumdzi nyina ntow ngu,
title: 1ST PETER

text: na hom kɔn ndɔ asɛm no numfonsu krɔnkrɔn no dɛ mbɔdomaba a wɔawo hom fofor, na hom eenyin wɔ mu akɔ nkwa mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Sɛ hom asɔ ahwɛ dɛ Ewuradze yɛ adom a:
title: 1ST PETER

text: nna hom mbra no hɔ, dɛ ɔbo a nkwa wɔ mu a nyimpa apow, naaso Nyankopɔn dze ɔasan mu eyi, na ɔsom bo no.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Hom so wɔtse dɛ ɔbo a nkwa wɔ mu a wɔtow hom sunsum mu dan, asɔfokuw krɔnkrɔn a wɔbɔ sunsum mu afɔr a ɔnam Jesus Kraest do sɔ Nyankopɔn enyi.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Osiandɛ wɔakyerɛw no kyerɛwsɛm no mu dɛ, Hwɛ moroto kutuwdo bo wɔ Zion, ɔbo a wɔasan mu eyi, ɔsom bo: Na obiara a ɔgye no dzi no, n’enyim nnkogu ase.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Ntsi hom a hom gye no dzi no, ɔsom hom bo, na hɔn a wonntsie no dze, Ɔbo a adantofo powee no, Ɔno na ɔabɛyɛ kutuwdo bo;
title: 1ST PETER

text: nye, Fintsiw bo, nye ntotoananmu botan ama hɔn. Wofintsiw asɛm no do, osiandɛ wɔyɛ asokyewfo; na ɔno so ntsi na woyii hɔn mae.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na hom dze, hom yɛ ebusuakuw a wɔasan mu eyi hom, asɔfokuw adehye, ɔman krɔnkrɔn, nkorɔfo a Nyankopɔn enya hɔn ayɛ nankasa nedze, dɛ hom mfa nyia oyii hom fii sum mu baa n’anwanwa kan mu no ne nkamfo no nkyerɛ.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Hom a nkyɛ nkan no hom nnyɛ ɔman naaso afei dze hom ayɛ Nyankopɔn ne man; hom ennya ehumbɔbɔr, na afei dze hom enya ehumbɔbɔr.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Adɔfo, mototɔ serɛ hom dɛ ahɔho nye amamforafo, hom nyi homho mfi honam akɔndɔdze a ɔnye ɔkra ko no ho;
title: 1ST PETER

text: na hom mbɔ ɔbra pa wɔ amanaman mu; na dza wɔkasa tsia hom wɔ mu dɛ ndzebɔnyɛfo no, wɔhwɛ hom ndzeyɛe pa no a, wɔaahyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ da a ɔbɛba abɛsera hom no mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Hom mbrɛ homho adze mma nyimpa tumdzi nyina wɔ Ewuradze ntsi, ɔhempɔn a ɔyɛ abɔso o;
title: 1ST PETER

text: ambradofo a ɔsoma hɔn ma wɔtsea ndzebɔnyɛfo, na woyi apapafo so ayɛw o.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na dɛm nye Nyankopɔn ne pɛ dɛ hom dze papayɛ siw nyia n’adwen yɛ har no ne nkwaseasɛm ano:
title: 1ST PETER

text: dɛ hom tse hom ase, na hom mmfa hom fahodzi nnyɛ bɔnyɛ do nkatado, na mbom dɛ Nyankopɔn no nkowaa.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Hom ndzi nyimpa nyina nyi. Hom ndodɔ enuanom. Hom nsuro Nyankopɔn. Hom ndzi ɔhen nyi.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Nkowaa, hom mfa suro nyina mbrɛ homho adze mma hom wuranom, nnyɛ hɔn a woye na wɔdwe nko, na hɔn a wɔhyɛ hom amen so.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na sɛ ɔnam Nyankopɔn ntsi, obi nya awerɛhow, hu amandze a ɔmmfa kwan mu, na ɔsɔw ne nyina a, iyi nye enyimnyam no.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na enyimnyam bɛn na ɔyɛ, dɛ hom fom, na wɔbobɔ hom ekutuku, na hom dze abotar gye? Na mbom sɛ hom yɛ papa na hom hu amandze, na hom yɛ penkyɛr a, ɔno na ɔyɛ enyimnyam wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na iyi na wɔfrɛɛ hom baa ho, osiandɛ Kraest so hun amandze maa hom, gyaa hom esusudo dɛ hom ndzi n’anamɔn ekyir.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Ɔno na ɔannyɛ bɔn, na eso woennhu ndaadaa wɔ n’anomu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Ɔno, na wɔyaaw no naaso ɔannyaw bi; ohun amandze naaso ɔammbɔ empuw; mbom ɔdze n’asɛm hyɛɛ nyia obua atsɛn tsenenee no nsa.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Ɔnarankasa na ɔsoaa hɛn bɔn wɔ no honam mu kɔr dua no do, dɛ sɛ yeewu ama ndzeyɛbɔn a, yaatsena ase ama tsenenee; ɔno na wɔdze ne mbaa ano etua asa hom yarba.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na nkyɛ hom tse dɛ nguan a wɔayew, na afei hom asan aba hom akra hɔn Guanhwɛfo nye Hwɛdofo no nkyɛn.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Dɛmara, na yernom, hom mbrɛ homho adze mma homankasa hom kunnom; ama sɛ hɔn mu binom nngye asɛm no mpo a, woeedua hɔn yernom abrabɔ do enya hɔn ma wɔagye asɛm no;
title: 1ST PETER

text: dɛ wɔdze suro bɔhwɛ hom abrabɔ a ho tsew no.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Mma hom ahosiesie nnyɛ honam enyi dze nko, wɔ tsidwow nye sika egudze nhyɛɛ anaa ntarhyɛ fɛɛfɛw mu;
title: 1ST PETER

text: na mbom hom mma ɔnyɛ akoma mu nyimpa a osuma, sunsum a ɔdwe na ɔyɛ komm a ɔmmprɔw mu, ɔno na ɔsom bo kɛse wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na dɛm na tsetseber mu, mbaa krɔnkrɔn a wɔdze hɔnho tweer Nyankopɔn so hyehyɛɛ hɔnho, dɛ wɔbrɛɛ hɔnho adze maa hɔnankasa hɔn kunnom.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Dɛm na Sara so tsiee Abraham, na ɔfrɛɛ no owura. Ɔno na sɛ hom yɛ papa, na hom amma suro biara emmpuw hom a, hom yɛ ne mba.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Kunnom, hom nye hom yernom ntsena nyimdzee mu dɛmara, hom mfa enyidzi mma ɔbaa no, dɛ adze a ɔyɛ mberɛw, dɛ hɔn so nye hom yɛ nkwa adom no adzedzifo bi: amma hom eennsiw hom mpaabɔ kwan.
title: 1ST PETER

text: N’ewiei nye dɛ, hom nyina nnya adwenkor, hom ntsetse mma homho, hom ndodɔ dɛ enuanom, hom nyɛ ayamuhyehye, hom ndwen ahobrɛadze adwen.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Mma hom mmfa bɔn nntua bɔn kaw, ɔyaw nntua ɔyaw kaw; na mbom hom nhyira; osiandɛ hom nyim dɛ iyi ntsi na wɔfrɛɛ hom, dɛ hom mbenya nhyira.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na, Nyia ɔpɛ dɛ ɔdɔ nkwa, Na ohu nda pa no, Wɔmma ɔnkora ne tɛkyerɛma wɔ bɔn ho, Nye n’anofamfa wɔ ndaadaasɛm ho.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Ma onyi bɔn akwa na ɔnyɛ papa. Afei ɔnhwehwɛ asomdwee na ontsiw no,
title: 1ST PETER

text: osiandɛ Ewuradze n’enyiwa wɔ atseneneefo do, na n’aso wɔ hɔn sufrɛ do, mbom Ewuradze enyi sa hɔn a wɔyɛ bɔn.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na sɛ hom yɛ mbɔdzembɔfo wɔ dza oye ho a, woana nye nyia ɔbɛhaw hom?
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na sɛ hom hu amandze wɔ tsenenee ntsi a, nhyira aka hom; mma hom nnsuro hɔn ho hu, na mma hom akoma nntu;
title: 1ST PETER

text: na mbom hom mbu Ewuradze Kraest krɔnkrɔn wɔ hom akoma mu: na hom nsiesie homho daa dɛ hom beyi ano akyerɛ obiara a obisa hom enyidado a ɔwɔ hom mu no ase, wɔ ɔdwe nye suro mu:
title: 1ST PETER

text: na hom enya tsibowa pa, na dza wɔkasa tsia hom wɔ mu no, hɔn a wogu hom abrabɔ pa a ɔwɔ Kraest mu ho fi no, hɔn enyim eegu ase.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na sɛ ɔpɛ na Nyankopɔn pɛ dɛ hom hu amandze wɔ papayɛ ho a, oye mbom kyɛn dɛ hom bohu wɔ bɔnyɛ ho.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Osiandɛ Kraest so hun bɔn ho amandze prɛko, nyia ɔtsen hunii maa hɔn a wɔnntsen, ama ɔdze hɛn aakɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn; wokum no honam mu, na wɔmaa onyaa nkwa wɔ sunsum mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Ɔno mu so na ɔnam kɔree kɛkaa asɛm kyerɛɛ esunsum a wɔwɔ efiadze a
title: 1ST PETER

text: tsetseber no wɔyɛɛ asoɔdzen, wɔ ber a Nyankopɔn ne penkyɛr tweɔnee no, wɔ Noa nda no a wɔrepam hɛn no mu, no mu na, akra kakra, mekyerɛ baawɔtwe, nyaa nkwa wɔ nsu no mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Ɔno na afei so ne saso gyee hom nkwa, ɔno nye enuma, nnyɛ honam ho fi yi a, na mbom ɔyɛ tsibowa pa mu nhwehwɛmu wɔ Nyankopɔn afamu, wɔ Jesus Kraest no wusoɛr mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Ɔno na ɔkɔr sor no, ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn nyimfa; na abɔfo nye tumdzifo, nye ahoɔdzenfo abrɛ hɔnho adze ama no.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na afei, ɔnam dɛ Kraest ehu amandze ama hɛn wɔ honam mu ntsi, hom so mfa adwenkor no ara mmia homho; osiandɛ nyia oehu honam mu amandze no egyaa bɔn yɛ;
title: 1ST PETER

text: ama hom honam mu asetsena ber a aka no, hom aanntsena ase amma nyimpa akɔndɔ bio, na mbom wɔaatsena ase ama Nyankopɔn apɛdze.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na hom asɛɛ mber pii dɛ hom dze yɛɛ amanaman apɛdze, dɛ hom nantseew ahoɔdɛw, akɔndɔ bɔn, asabow, asakasakagor, edzidzimee nye abosonsom nkɔnkɔw mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na seseiara ɔyɛ wiadzefo ahobow dɛ hom nye hɔn nntutu mbirika nnkɔ dɛm sakasakayɛ pɔtɔɔ no mu bio, ntsi na wɔka hom ho nsɛm bɔn no.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Naaso wobeyi ano akyerɛ nyia oesiesie noho dɛ orubobu atseasefo nye ewufo atsɛn no.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na iyi ntsi na asɛmpa no wɔkaa kyerɛɛ ewufo no so, ama woeebu hɔn atsɛn dɛ nyimpa a wɔwɔ honam mu, na wɔaatsena ase dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn tse wɔ sunsum mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Naaso adze nyina ewiei abɛn: dɛm ntsi hom mma hom adwen mu ntsew, na hom enyi nda hɔ mma mpaabɔ:
title: 1ST PETER

text: na ne tsitsir hom mfa ɔdɔ a no mu yɛ dzen ndodɔ homho, osiandɛ dɔ kata bɔn pii do.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Hom nyɛ ahɔhoyɛ nkyerɛ hom ho a ehwinhwin biara nnyi mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Dɛ mbrɛ obiara enya akyɛdze no, hom mfa nsonsom homho, dɛ Nyankopɔn adom akyɛdze horow do efihwɛfo pa.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Sɛ obi ka asɛm a, ma ɔnka no dɛ Nyankopɔn n’anomunsɛm; sɛ obi som a, ma ɔnsom dɛ ofi ahoɔdzen a Nyankopɔn dze ma: ama wɔnam Jesus Kraest do aahyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ adze nyina mu, ɔno na enyimnyam nye ahendzi yɛ nedze mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Adɔfo, mma hom nndwen nsɔhwɛ gya a ɔaba hom mu rosɔ hom ahwɛ no ho dɛ ɔyɛ ahobowsɛm, dɛ gyama adze bi a obi nnhun bi da.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Mbom hom ndzi dɛw dɛ Kraest n’amandzehu no bi na hom ruhu, ama sɛ wɔda n’enyimnyam edzi a, hom eenya enyigye na hom ho asɛpɛw hom mbordo so.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na sɛ wɔyaw hom wɔ Kraest dzin ntsi a, nhyira aka hom, osiandɛ enyimnyam Sunsum no a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn Sunsum no edwir hom do.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na mma hom mu bi nnhu amandze dɛ owudzifo, anaadɛ owifo, anaadɛ omumuyɛfo, anaadɛ ɔsɛmpɛfo wɔ binom hɔn nsɛm ho.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na sɛ ohu amandze dɛ Kristiannyi a, mma n’enyi nnto, na wɔmma ɔnhyɛ Nyankopɔn enyimnyam wɔ dzin yi mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Osiandɛ ber edu a atsɛmbu hyɛ ase wɔ Nyankopɔn fie: na sɛ odzi kan hyɛ ase hɛn do a, hɔn a wonntsie Nyankopɔn n’asɛmpa no dze, hɔn ewiei bowie dɛn?
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na sɛ ɔyɛ dzen dɛ wɔbɛgye nyimpa tsenenee a, hen na nyia ɔnnyɛ nyamesuronyi na ɔyɛ dzebɔnyɛnyi no begyina?
title: 1ST PETER

text: Dɛm ntsi wɔmma hɔn a wohu amandze dɛ mbrɛ Nyankopɔn pɛ no, mfa hɔn akra nhyɛ hɔn Bɔfo nokwafo no ne nsa, na wɔnkɔ do araa nyɛ papa.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Mpanyin a wɔwɔ hom mu no, emi a mo so meyɛ ɔpanyin, nye Kraest amandzehu ho dasefo, na mowɔ kyɛfa wɔ enyimnyam a wɔrebɛda no edzi no mu no, mutu hom fo dɛ:
title: 1ST PETER

text: Hom nnyɛn Nyankopɔn nguankuw a wɔdze ahyɛ hom nsa no. Hom nhwɛ hɔn do wɔ Nyame mu; nnyɛ nhyɛdo, na mbom ɔpɛdo, nnyɛ edzifodzepɛ ntsi, na mbom dɛ hom wɔ mu enyigye ntsi;
title: 1ST PETER

text: nnyɛ dɛ hɔn a wodzi dza wɔdze ahyɛ hɔn nsa no do ahokyerɛ mu, na mbom hom nyɛ fasusu mma nguankuw no.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na sɛ Oguanhwɛfo panyin no yi noho edzi a, hom eenya enyimnyam ahenkyɛw a ɔmmpa da no.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Dɛmara na hom mbabun so, hom mbrɛ homho adze nhyɛ mpanyimfo ase. Nyew, hom nyina mbrɛ homho adze nhyehyɛ homho ase, na hom mfura ahobrɛadze dɛ tam: osiandɛ Nyankopɔn siw ahopɔwfo kwan, mbom ɔdom ahobrɛadzefo.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Dɛm ntsi hom mbrɛ homho adze nhyɛ Nyankopɔn tum nsa no ase, ama ɔaama hom do wɔ ber a ɔsɛ mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Hom ntow hom dadwen nyina nkyen no do, osiandɛ ɔdwen hom ho.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Hom nyɛ enyigyen, hom nweɔn: osiandɛ hom tamfo abɔnsam tse dɛ gyata a ɔropɔw nenam rohwehwɛ nyia obenya no amen no:
title: 1ST PETER

text: ɔno na hom nsiw no kwan pintsinn wɔ gyedzi no mu, osiandɛ hom nyim dɛ amandzehu kor no ara na wɔreda no edzi wɔ hom nuanom a wɔwɔ wiadze mu no mu.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Na adom nyina Nyankopɔn a ɔafrɛ hom aba n’enyimnyam a onnyiewiei mu wɔ Kraest mu no, sɛ hom nya hu amandze kakra a, ekyir yi nankasa bɛma hom edzi mu, egyina pintsinn, ɔbɛhyɛ hom dzen, na obesi hom pi.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Ɔno na enyimnyam nye tumdzi yɛ nedze mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Menam onua Silvanus a mubu no nokwafo no do, na makyerɛw nsɛm kakra yi abrɛ hom, medze tu hom fo, midzi dase dɛ iyi nye Nyankopɔn no nokwar adom no. Hom ngyina mu pintsinn.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Asɔr a ɔwɔ Babilɔn a ɔno so ɔasan mu eyi no dɛ mbrɛ woeyi hom no, kyia hom; me ba Mark so kyia hom.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Hom mfa etuwyɛ a ɔdɔ wɔ mu nkyiakyia homho. Asomdwee nka hom a hom wɔ Kraest Jesus mu nyina.
title: 1ST PETER

text: Simon Peter, Jesus Kraest n’akowaa nye somafo, dze kɛma hɔn a wɔnye hɛn enya gyedzi a ɔsom bo yi bi, wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn nye hɛn Agyenkwa Jesus Kraest tsenenee no mu.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Adom nka hom na asomdwee ndɔɔ so mma hom wɔ Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus ho nyimdzee mu.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Nyankopɔn dze nankasa no tum, nam nyia ɔafrɛ hɛn rokɔ noara n’enyimnyam nye yieyɛ mu no, no ho nyimdzee do, ama hɛn biribiara a yehia wɔ abrabɔ nye nyamesompa ho.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Ɔnoara do na ɔnam akyɛ hɛn n’anohoba a ɔsoso akɛse akɛse a ɔsom bo; dɛ sɛ hom enya eguan mprɔwee a ɔnam akɔndɔ do ba wɔ wiadze mu no a, hom eedua iyinom do enya Nyamesu no bi.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Ampaara iyiara ntsi, hom mfa mbɔdzen nyina nka ho wɔ hom afamu, na hom mfa dza ɔsɔ enyi nka hom gyedzi ho; na nyimdzee nka dza ɔsɔ enyi ho;
title: 2ND PETER

text: na enyidahɔ nka nyimdzee ho; na penkyɛr nka enyidahɔ ho;
title: 2ND PETER

text: na nyamesompa nka penkyɛr ho; na enuadɔ nka nyamesompa ho; na dɔ mapa nka enuadɔ ho.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na sɛ iyinom wɔ hom mu, na ɔdɔɔ so a, ɔremma hom nnyɛ enyiahafo, anaaso hɔn a wɔnnsow aba wɔ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest ho nyimdzee afamu no.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na nyia iyinom abɔ no no yɛ onyifuranyi, na onntum nnhu ekyir, no werɛ efir no bɔn dadaw no no nhohoree no.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Dɛm ntsi, enuanom, hom mbɔ mbɔdzen mma hom frɛ na yi a woeyi hom no nsi pi: na sɛ hom yɛ yinom a, hom rimmfintsiw da:
title: 2ND PETER

text: na dɛm na wɔbɛma hom kwan mbordo akɔ hɛn Ewuradze nye hɛn Agyenkwa Jesus Kraest ahendzi a onnyi ewiei no mu.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Dɛm ntsi, kaansa hom nyim dada, na hom etsim nokwar a ɔwɔ hom hɔ no mu mpo a, meremma m’enyi mmpa do dɛ mebɛkaakaa hom wɔ yinom ho daa.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na mubu no dɛ oye ara dɛ ber a metse ntamadan yi mu yi, medze nkaabɔ mikenyan hom,
title: 2ND PETER

text: wɔ ber minyim dɛ ɔrenkyɛr na woeyi mo ho ntamadan yi egu, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest so eyi akyerɛ me no.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Nyew, mobɔbɔ mbɔdzen, na mo nkɔree ekyir no, hom eetum akaa yinom dabaa.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na nnyɛ anansesɛm a wɔma no nyansakwan mu, na yeedzi ekyir aka hom hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest no tum nye ne mbae ho asɛm, na mbom yɛyɛ ho adasefo a yɛdze hɛn ankasa hɛn enyiwa hun ne kɛseyɛ.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na onyaa enyimnyam nye enyidzi fii Egya Nyankopɔn nkyɛn ber a ndze bi fi abɔso enyimnyam no mu fiir dɛ, Oyi nye mo Dɔba a ɔsɔ m’enyi no.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na dɛm ndze yi, hɛn a yɛnye no wɔ koko krɔnkrɔn no do no, yɛtsee dɛ ofi sor bae.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na yɛwɔ nkɔnhyɛsɛm a ogyina hɔ pintsinn kyɛn dɛm, ɔno na sɛ hom hwɛ no yie, dɛ kandzea a ɔhyerɛn beebi a ɔyɛ sunkamm dze kesi dɛ adze bɛkye, na adzekyee nworaba no epue wɔ hom akoma mu a, nna hom reyɛ dza oye.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na hom ndzi kan nhu iyi, dɛ nyimpa biara nntum no nko nnkyerɛ Kyerɛwsɛm no mu nkɔnhyɛ ase.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na nkɔnhyɛ bi nnduaa nyimpa pɛ do mmbaa pɛn: na mbom Nyankopɔn nam nyimpa do kasaa dɛ mbrɛ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no kyerɛɛ hɔn.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo so soɛɛr ɔman no mu, dɛ mbrɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo atorfo bɛba hom so hom mu a wɔdze ɔsɛɛ fɛkuwsɛm bɛba abɛhyɛ mu nsumaa mu, dɛ wɔbɔpow Ewuradze a ɔtɔɔ hɔn no mpo, na wɔdze ɔsɛɛ a ɔba ntsɛntsɛm aba hɔn do.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na dodowara bedzi hɔn ehuhubra no ekyir; na osian hɔn ntsi wɔbɛka nokwar no ho nsɛmbɔn.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na wɔnam enyiber mu dze ndaadaasɛm bɛpɛ hom hɔ adze: hɔn na ofi tsetse hɔn atsɛmbu nnkyinkyim dabiarada, na hɔn sɛɛ nntɔ nkom.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na sɛ Nyankopɔn enngyaa abɔfo a wɔyɛɛ bɔn no, na ɔdze hɔn guu amandzehu kurow no mu, na ɔdze hɔn hyɛɛ mona sunkamm mu dɛ wɔmfa hɔn nsie atsɛmbu;
title: 2ND PETER

text: na sɛ oenngyaa tsetse wiadze no, na ɔkoraa Noa a ɔyɛ tsenenee sɛnkafo nye beesuon bi so, ber a ɔdze nsuyirii bɛkataa emumuyɛfo wiadze do no;
title: 2ND PETER

text: na sɛ ɔdaan Sodom nye Gomora nkurow nso, buu hɔn fɔ butuuw hɔn, dze hɔn yɛɛ asɛndahɔ maa hɔn a ekyir no wɔbɛyɛ emumuyɛ no;
title: 2ND PETER

text: na oyii ɔtseneneenyi Lot a emumuyɛfo dze hɔn ehuhubra haaw no no:
title: 2ND PETER

text: (na dɛm mbrato ndwuma a nyimpa tsenenee no a ɔtse hɔn mu no hunii na ɔtsee no, yii ne kra ahomtsew daa nyina).
title: 2ND PETER

text: Ewuradze nyim mbrɛ oyiyi nyamesurofo fi nsɔhwɛ mu, na osie hɔn a wɔnntsen wɔ ntsea ase dze kɔ atsɛmbu da no;
title: 2ND PETER

text: na nkanka hɔn a wodzi honam ekyir efifidze ho akɔndɔ mu, na wobu tumdzi adze kakrabaa bi no. Wɔyɛ enyiɔdzemfo, ahopɛfo, hɔn ho mmpopo dɛ wɔbɛka etumfo ho nsɛmbɔn:
title: 2ND PETER

text: wɔ ber a abɔfo a wɔso wɔ tum nye ahoɔdzen mu mpo mmfa nsɛmbɔn mmbu hɔn atsɛn wɔ Ewuradze enyim.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na yinom dze, wɔtse dɛ abɔdze a wonnyi adwen, wɔawo hɔn dɛ mbowa a wɔkyer hɔn sɛɛ hɔn, wɔka nsɛmbɔn wɔ dza wonnyim ho, wɔbɛsɛɛ hɔn wɔ hɔnankasa hɔn sɛɛ mu;
title: 2ND PETER

text: wobenya dza ɔnntsen ho akatua; dza wobu no enyigye nye dɛ wɔgor asakasakagor ewia, nkekaa nye dzɛm, wɔbɔ akɔhwibra ber a wɔnye hom ridzi ɔdɔ edzidzi;
title: 2ND PETER

text: wɔwɔ enyiwa a awarto ahyɛ no ma a ɔronndwe wɔ bɔn ho da; wɔdaadaa akra a hɔn ase nntsimii; wɔwɔ akoma a wɔaben enyiber mu; ndom mba;
title: 2ND PETER

text: woegya akwantsen hɔ akɔfom kwan, woekedzi Beor ba Balaam kwan ekyir; ɔno na ɔdɔɔ ndzeyɛɛ bɔn akatua;
title: 2ND PETER

text: na eso onyaa ne mbrato ho nkaenyim: asoasopɔnkɔ a onntum nnkasa dze nyimpa ndze kasae siankaa nkɔnhyɛnyi no n’egyimsɛm.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Iyinom yɛ mbura a nsu nnyi mu, ehubɔhubɔw a ehum rutu no kɔ; hɔn na wɔdze sum kebikebi esie hɔn daa.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Wɔkeka akɛsesɛm egyangyan, nam honam akɔndɔ mu dze ahoɔdɛw daadaa hɔn a wofii abrabɔ bɔn mu nnkyɛree no;
title: 2ND PETER

text: wɔbɔ hɔn adehyedzi ho anohoba, naaso hɔnara wɔyɛ prɔwee nkowaa; na nyia obi edzi n’enyim nkogu no, ɔnoara na ɔdze no kɔ nkowaasom.
title: 2ND PETER
