text: Na ber a wɔnam Ewuradze nye Agyenkwa Jesus Kraest do efi wiadze efifidze nsa ekyir no, wɔkɔtoto mu bio hwe ase a, hɔn ekyir asetsena dan hɔn bɔn kyɛn kan no.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na nkyɛ oye ma hɔn dɛ woennhu tsenenee kwan no, kyɛn dɛ woehu ekyir no, wɔbɛdan efi ahyɛdze krɔnkrɔn no a wɔdze ahyɛ hɔn nsa no ho.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na ayɛ hɔn dɛ mbrɛ nokwar bɛ no se, Ɔkraman asan akɔ nankasa ne fe ho bio, na Prekober a woeguar no no, asan akɔ ne dɛtseprɔtɔɔ a ɔyankam wɔ mu no mu.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Adɔfo, iyi nye nwoma a otsia ebien a makyerɛw abrɛ hom; no mu na mikenyan hom adwen gyenengyenen wɔ nkaabɔ mu;
title: 2ND PETER

text: dɛ hom nkaa nsɛm a nkɔnhyɛfo krɔnkrɔn no aka ato hɔ, nye Ewuradze nye Agyenkwa ahyɛdze a ɔnam hom asomafo do no.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Hom nhu yi kan dɛ, nda a odzi ekyir no mu atwetwesifo dze atwetwesi bɛba a wɔnantsew hɔnankasa hɔn akɔndɔ ekyir,
title: 2ND PETER

text: na wɔka dɛ, Ne mbae anohoba no wɔ hen? Osiandɛ ofi da a egyanom dedae yi adze nyina tse dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse fi abɔdze ahyɛse no ara.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na wɔhyɛ da ara ma hɔn werɛ fir dɛ, ofi tsetse na ɔsor wɔ hɔ, nye asaase a ofi nsu mu, na ofi nsu finimfin betsiim hɔ wɔ Nyankopɔn n’asɛm do:
title: 2ND PETER

text: ɔno no do na ɔnam na wiadze a ɔwɔ ber no mu no, nsu kataa do sɛɛ no:
title: 2ND PETER

text: na sor a ɔwɔ hɔ sesei, nye asaase no wɔdze n’asɛm kor no ara akora do ama ogya, esie atsɛmbu nye nyimpa emumuyɛfo hɔn sɛɛ da no.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na mma hom werɛ mmfir adze kor yi, adɔfo, dɛ da kor yɛ Ewuradze dɛ mfe apem, na mfe apem yɛ no dɛ da kor.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Ewuradze nnyɛ n’anohoba ho ekyim dɛ mbrɛ binom bu no ekyimyɛ no, na mbom penkyɛr na ɔyɛ no wɔ hom do, ɔmmpɛ dɛ obiara bɛyew, na mbom ɔpɛ dɛ hɔn nyina bɛba nnuhu mu.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na Ewuradze da no bɛba dɛ owifo; no mu na sor dze dede kɛse botwa mu akɔ, na wimu adze dze ɔhyew a ɔyɛ dzen bɛnan, na asaase nye no mu ndwuma wɔbɛhyew no.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Ntsi sɛ iyinom nyina bɛsɛɛ dɛm a, nyimpa su bɛn na ɔsɛ dɛ hom yɛ, wɔ abrabɔ krɔnkrɔn nye nyamesompa mu,
title: 2ND PETER

text: ber a hom rohwɛ kwan na hom repɛ Nyankopɔn da no ne mbae ntsɛm yi? Ɔno mu na gya bɔtɔ ɔsor mu asɛɛ no, na wimu adze dze hyew a ɔyɛ dzen bɛnan no.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na dɛ mbrɛ n’anohoba tse, hɛn enyi da sor fofor nye asaase fofor a tsenenee tse mu no kwan.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Dɛm ntsi, adɔfo, osiandɛ hom enyi da yinom kwan ntsi, hom mbɔ mbɔdzen, ama woeehu hom asomdwee mu, dɛ nkekaa anaa dzɛm nnyi hom ho wɔ n’enyim.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na hom mbu dɛ Nyankopɔn penkyɛr yɛ nkwagye, dɛ mbrɛ hɛn nua dɔfo Paul so dze nyansa a wɔdze maa no no kyerɛɛw hom no;
title: 2ND PETER

text: dɛ mbrɛ ɔyɛe wɔ no nwoma nyina a ɔka iyinom ho nsɛm wɔ mu no mu so; no mu na asɛm a ne ntseasee yɛ dzen wɔ a, hɔn a wonnyim dze, na hɔn ase nntsimii no, wɔtoto no, dɛ mbrɛ wɔyɛ kyerɛwsɛm nkaa no so dze ma hɔnankasa hɔn sɛɛ.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Dɛm ntsi, adɔfo, hom nyim yinom dada ntsi, hom nhwɛ yie, amma wɔaammfa emumuyɛ ndaadaasɛm ammpra hom annkɔ, na hom eemmfi homankasa hom tsim a hom etsim mu annhwe ase.
title: 2ND PETER

text: Na mbom hom nnyin wɔ adom nye hɛn Ewuradze nye Agyenkwa Jesus Kraest nyimdzee mu. Ɔno na enyimnyam nka no sesei nye daa. [Amen.]
title: 2ND PETER

text: Dza ofitsi ahyɛse, dza yɛatse, dza yɛdze hɛn enyiwa ehu, dza yɛagyen hɛn enyiwa ahwɛ, na yɛdze hɛn nsa kae wɔ nkwa asɛm no ho no
title: 1ST JOHN

text: dɛm nkwa no woyii no kyerɛe, na yeehu na yedzi ho dase, na yɛka onnyiewiei nkwa a ɔnye Egya no wɔ hɔ, na woyii no kyerɛɛ hɛn no no ho asɛm kyerɛ hom.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Dza yeehu na yɛatse no, na yɛbɔ no dawur kyerɛ hom so, ama hom so nye hɛn eenya nkitahodzi; na hɛn nkitahodzi no yɛnye Egya no nye ne Ba Jesus Kraest na yɛwɔ,
title: 1ST JOHN

text: na yɛrekyerɛw iyinom abrɛ hom, ama hom dɛw aahyɛ ma.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na amandzɛɛ a yɛatse efi ne nkyɛn na yɛbɔ no dawur so kyerɛ hom nye dɛ, Nyankopɔn yɛ kan na sum biara nnyi no mu koraa.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Sɛ yɛka dɛ yɛnye no wɔ nkitahodzi, na yɛnantsew sum mu a, yedzi ator, na yɛnnyɛ nokwar no:
title: 1ST JOHN

text: na sɛ yɛnantsew kan mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔno ɔwɔ kan mu no a, yenya nkitahodzi wɔ hɛn ntamu, na ne Ba Jesus Kraest bɔgya no tsew hɛn ho fi bɔn nyina mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Sɛ yɛka dɛ yennyi bɔn a, yɛdaadaa hɛnho, na nokwar no nnyi hɛn mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Sɛ yɛka hɛn bɔn kyerɛ a, ɔyɛ nokwafo nye tseneneenyi dɛ ɔdze hɛn bɔn bɛkyɛ hɛn, na ɔatsew hɛn ho wɔ dza ɔnntsen nyina ho.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Sɛ yɛka dɛ yɛnnyɛɛ bɔn a, yɛma ɔyɛ ɔtorfo, na n’asɛm no nnyi hɛn mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Me mba nkakraba, merekyerɛw iyinom abrɛ hom ama hom aannyɛ bɔn. Na sɛ obi yɛ bɔn a, yɛwɔ ɔkasamaafo a otwitwa gye hɛn wɔ Egya no nkyɛn, ɔno nye Jesus Kraest, ɔtseneneenyi no:
title: 1ST JOHN

text: na ɔno nye hɛn bɔn ho mpatadze, na nnyɛ hɛn nko hɛndze, na mbom wiadze nyina so dze bi.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na sɛ yedzi n’ahyɛdze do a, iyiara na yɛdze hu dɛ yenyim no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Nyia ɔka dɛ, Minyim no, na onndzi n’ahyɛdze do no, ɔyɛ ɔtor, na nokwar no nnyi no mu:
title: 1ST JOHN

text: na obiara a odzi n’asɛm do no, ɔno no mu na ampaara Nyankopɔn no dɔ no edzi mu. Iyi na yɛdze hu dɛ yɛwɔ no mu:
title: 1ST JOHN

text: nyia ɔka dɛ ɔtse no mu no, ɔsɛ no dɛ ɔnantsew dɛ mbrɛ ɔno so nantsewee.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Adɔfo, nnyɛ ahyɛdze fofor bi na merekyerɛw abrɛ hom, na mbom ahyɛdze dadaw no nye asɛm a ofi ahyɛse no hom atse no ara.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Naaso, merekyerɛw ahyɛdze fofor abrɛ hom a ɔyɛ nokwar wɔ ɔno nye hom mu; osiandɛ sum rutwa mu, na nokwar kan no enya rehyerɛn.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Nyia ɔka dɛ ɔwɔ kan no mu, na ɔtan no nua no, ɔwɔ sum mu dze besi sesei.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Nyia ɔdɔ no nua no, ɔwɔ kan no mu, na fintsidua bi nnyi no mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na nyia ɔtan no nua tse sum mu, na ɔnantsew sum mu, na onnyim mbrɛ ɔrokɔ, osiandɛ sum no efura n’enyi.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Merekyerɛw abrɛ hom, me mba nkakraba, osiandɛ wɔdze hom bɔn akyɛ hom wɔ ne dzin ntsi.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Merekyerɛw abrɛ hom, egyanom, osiandɛ hom nyim nyia ɔwɔ hɔ fitsi ahyɛse no. Merekyerɛw abrɛ hom, mberantsɛ, osiandɛ hom edzi ɔbɔn no do konyim.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Merekyerɛw abrɛ hom, mbofra nkakraba, osiandɛ hom nyim Egya no. Merekyerɛw abrɛ hom, egyanom, osiandɛ hom ehu nyia ɔwɔ hɔ fitsi ahyɛse no. Merekyerɛw abrɛ hom mberantsɛ osiandɛ hom yɛ dzen, na Nyankopɔn asɛm tse hom mu, na hom edzi ɔbɔn no do konyim.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Mma hom nndɔ wiadze, anaadɛ ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ wiadze. Na nyia ɔdɔ wiadze no, Egya no ho dɔ nnyi no mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na dza ɔwɔ wiadze a ɔyɛ honam akɔndɔ, enyiwa akɔndɔ, nye asetsena mu enyimnyampɛ nyina no, mmfi Egya no, na mbom ofi wiadze.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na wiadze nye n’akɔndɔ rutwa mu, naaso nyia ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn n’apɛdze no dze, ɔtsena hɔ daa.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Mbofra nkakraba, dɔnhwer a odzi ekyir no nye yi: na dɛ mbrɛ hom atse dɛ antikraest rebɛba no, sesei mpo antikraest pii aba; nna yɛdze hu dɛ dɔn a odzi ekyir no ara nye yi.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Wofi hɛn mu kɔree, naaso wɔnnka hɛn ho, na sɛ wɔka hɛn ho a, nkyɛ wɔnye hɛn tsenaa hɔ: na wofii mu ama aada edzi dɛ hɔn nyina nnka hɛn ho.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na hom dze, hom enya ngosera bi fi Krɔnkrɔnnyi no hɔ, na hom nyim adze nyina.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Mannkyerɛw ammbrɛ hom dɛ hom nnyim nokwar no, na mbom dɛ hom nyim, na dɛ ator biara mmfi nokwar no mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Woana na ɔyɛ ɔtorfo dɛ nyia ɔpow dɛ Jesus nye Kraest no? Oyi nye antikraest no, nyia ɔpow Egya nye Ba no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Obiara a ɔpow Ɔba no, onnyi Egya no; na nyia ɔpaa mu bɔ Ɔba no ne dzin no, ɔwɔ Egya no so.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na hom dze, hom mma dza ofi ahyɛse no hom tsee no ntsena hom mu. Na sɛ dza hom fi ahyɛse tsee no tsena hom mu a, hom bɛtsena Ɔba no nye Egya no so mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na anohoba a ɔabɔ hɛn nye onnyiewiei nkwa.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Iyinom na makyerɛw abrɛ hom wɔ hɔn a wɔpɛ dɛ wɔma hom fom kwan no ho.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na hom dze, ngosera a hom nyae wɔ ne nsamu no tse hom mu, na onnhia hom dɛ obi kyerɛkyerɛ hom, na mbom dɛ mbrɛ no ngosera no ara kyerɛkyerɛ hom wɔ adze nyina ho no. Ɔyɛ nokwar, na ɔnnyɛ ator, na dɛ mbrɛ ɔakyerɛkyerɛ hom no, ɔno ara na hom ntsena mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na afei, me mba nkakraba, hom ntsena no mu; na sɛ oyi noho edzi a, yeenya awerɛhyɛmu, na hɛn enyi annto n’enyim wɔ ne ba no mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Sɛ hom nyim dɛ ɔyɛ tseneneenyi a, hom nhu dɛ obiara a ɔyɛ dza ɔtsen no, ɔno na Nyankopɔn awo no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Hom nhwɛ ɔdɔ bi a Egya no dze adɔ hɛn, dɛ wɔfrɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn mba. Na ampaara, yɛyɛ so. Siantsir a wiadze nnyim hɛn, nye dɛ oennhu no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Adɔfo, afei yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn mba, na mbrɛ yɛbɛyɛ no nnyae nndaa edzi, na yenyim dɛ, sɛ oyi noho edzi a, yɛbɛyɛ dɛ ɔno, osiandɛ yebohu no dɛ mbrɛ ɔtse.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na obiara a ɔwɔ enyidado yi wɔ no mu no, ɔtsew noho, dɛ mbrɛ ɔno no ho tsew no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔn no, ɔyɛ dze to mbra, na bɔn yɛ mbrato.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na hom nyim dɛ woyii no kyerɛe ama oeeyi bɔn akɔ; mbom ɔnarankasa dze, bɔn nnyi no mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Obiara a ɔtse no mu no nnyɛ bɔn: obiara a ɔyɛ bɔn no, nna onnhun no; na eso onnyim no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Mbofra nkakraba, mma obiara nndaadaa hom: nyia ɔyɛ dza ɔtsen no ɔtsen, dɛ mbrɛ no so tsen no:
title: 1ST JOHN

text: nyia ɔyɛ bɔn no fi abɔnsam, osiandɛ abɔnsam na ofi ahyɛse yɛɛ bɔn. Iyi ntsi na Nyankopɔn Ba no baa wiadze ama ɔaasɛɛ abɔnsam ndwuma.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Obiara a Nyankopɔn awo no no nnyɛ bɔn, osiandɛ no su tse no mu: na onntum nnyɛ bɔn, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn awo no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Iyi mu na Nyankopɔn mba nye abɔnsam mba da edzi: obiara a ɔnnyɛ dza ɔtsen nye nyia ɔnndɔ no nua no mmfi Nyankopɔn.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na iyi nye amandzɛɛ a hom tsee no ahyɛse no, dɛ yɛndodɔ hɛnho:
title: 1ST JOHN

text: nnyɛ dɛ Kain a ofi ɔbɔn no mu a okum no nua no. Na ɔyɛ dɛn ntsi na okum no? Osiandɛ no ndwuma yɛ bɔn, na no nua dze no dze, ɔtsen.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Mo nuanom, sɛ wiadze tan hom a, mma ɔnnyɛ hom nwanwa.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Hɛn dze, yenyim dɛ yeetwa mu fi wu mu akɔ nkwa mu, osiandɛ yɛdɔ enuanom no. Nyia ɔnndɔ no nua no tse wu mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Obiara a ɔnndɔ no nua yɛ wudzinyi: na hom nyim dɛ onnyiewiei nkwa nntsena owudzifo biara mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Iyi mu na yɛdze hu dɔ, osiandɛ ɔno ɔdze no nkwa too hɔ maa hɛn, ntsi ɔsɛ hɛn so dɛ yɛdze hɛn nkwa to hɔ ma enuanom no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na nyia ɔwɔ wiadze adze, na ohu no nua dɛ ehia no, na ɔbɔ no ayamuɔwen no, Nyankopɔn dɔ no dua dɛn tsena no mu?
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Me mba nkakraba, mma yɛmmfa nsɛm ara anaa tɛkyerɛma nndɔ, na mbom hom mma yɛndɔ wɔ ndzeyɛe nye nokwar mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na iyi mu na yɛdze bohu dɛ yefi nokwar no mu, na yɛdze besi hɛn akoma pi wɔ n’enyim
title: 1ST JOHN

text: wɔ aber biara a hɛn akoma bu hɛn fɔ no, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn so kyɛn hɛn akoma, na onyim adze nyina.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Adɔfo, sɛ hɛn akoma mmbu hɛn fɔ a, nna yɛwɔ ndam wɔ Nyankopɔn afamu;
title: 1ST JOHN

text: na biribiara a yɛserɛ no, yenya wɔ no hɔ, osiandɛ yedzi n’ahyɛdze do, na yɛyɛ dza ɔyɛ enyisɔ wɔ n’enyim.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na iyi nye n’ahyɛdze, dɛ yɛngye ne Ba Jesus Kraest ndzi, na yɛndodɔ hɛnho, dɛ mbrɛ ɔmaa hɛn ahyɛdze no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na nyia odzi n’ahyɛdze do no, ɔtse no mu, na ɔno so tse no mu. Na dza yɛdze hu dɛ ɔtse hɛn mu nye Sunsum a ɔdze ama hɛn no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Adɔfo, mma hom nngye esunsum nyina nndzi, na mbom hom nsɔ esunsum nhwɛ dɛ wofi Nyankopɔn anaa: osiandɛ nkɔnhyɛfo atorfo pii aba wiadze.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Iyi mu na hom hu Nyankopɔn Sunsum: sunsum biara a ɔpaa mu ka dɛ Jesus Kraest aba wɔ honam mu no fi Nyankopɔn:
title: 1ST JOHN

text: na sunsum biara a ɔnnka dɛ Jesus Kraest aba (wɔ honam mu) no, mmfi Nyankopɔn mu: na iyi nye antikraest a hom atse dɛ ɔreba wiadze a sesei mpo oenya aba dada no dze.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Me mba nkakraba, hom fi Nyankopɔn mu, na hom edzi hɔn do konyim: osiandɛ nyia ɔwɔ hom mu no so kyɛn nyia ɔwɔ wiadze.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Hɔn dze, wofi wiadze mu, na wofi wiadze mu kasa, na wiadze tsie hɔn.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Hɛn dze, yefi Nyankopɔn mu: nyia onyim Nyankopɔn no tsie hɛn; nyia ommfi Nyankopɔn mu no nntsie hɛn. Iyi mu na yɛdze hu nokwar sunsum, nye ndaadaa sunsum.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Adɔfo, hom mma yɛndodɔ hɛnho; na dɔ fi Nyankopɔn, na obiara a ɔwɔ ɔdɔ no, Nyankopɔn awo no na onyim Nyankopɔn.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Nyia ɔnndɔ no, onnyim Nyankopɔn, osiandɛ Nyankopɔn nye ɔdɔ.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Iyi mu na Nyankopɔn dɔ yii noho edzi wɔ hɛn ho, dɛ Nyankopɔn somaa ne Ba a ɔwoo no kor baa wiadze, dɛ yendua no do nnya nkwa.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Iyi no mu na ɔdɔ wɔ, nnyɛ dɛ hɛn na yɛdɔɔ Nyankopɔn, mbom ɔno na ɔdɔɔ hɛn, na ɔsomaa ne ba dɛ ɔmbɛyɛ mpatadze wɔ hɛn bɔn ho.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Adɔfo, sɛ Nyankopɔn dɔɔ hɛn dɛm a, ɔsɛ hɛn so dɛ yɛdodɔ hɛnho.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Obiara nnhun Nyankopɔn pɛn: sɛ yɛdodɔ hɛnho a, Nyankopɔn tse hɛn mu, na no dɔ edzi mu wɔ hɛn mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Iyi na yɛdze hu dɛ yɛtse no mu, na ɔno so tse hɛn mu, osiandɛ ɔama hɛn no Sunsum no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na yeehu na yedzi dase dɛ Egya no asoma Ɔba no dɛ wiadze Agyenkwa.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Obiara a ɔpaa mu ka dɛ Jesus nye Nyankopɔn Ba no, Nyankopɔn tse no mu na ɔno so tse Nyankopɔn mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na yeehu, na yɛagye dɔ a Nyankopɔn wɔ no wɔ hɛn ho no edzi. Nyankopɔn nye dɔ; na nyia ɔtse dɔ mu no, ɔtse Nyankopɔn mu, na Nyankopɔn so tse no mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Iyi no mu na ɔdɔ edzi mu wɔ hɛn mu, na yaayɛ ndam wɔ atsɛmbu da no mu; osiandɛ dɛ mbrɛ ɔno tse no, mbrɛ hɛn so yɛtse wɔ wiadze ha nye no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Suro biara nnyi ɔdɔ mu; na mbom ɔdɔ a odzi mu pam suro, osiandɛ suro mu wɔ ɔhaw; na nyia suro wɔ no mu no nnwie mu dzi wɔ ɔdɔ mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Yɛdɔ, osiandɛ ɔno na odzii kan dɔɔ hɛn.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Sɛ obi ka dɛ, Modɔ Nyankopɔn, na ɔtan no nua a, ɔyɛ ɔtor, na nyia ɔnndɔ no nua a ohu no no bɛyɛ dɛn adɔ Nyankopɔn a onnhu no?
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na ahyɛdze yi na yeenya no wɔ no hɔ, dɛ nyia ɔdɔ Nyankopɔn no, ɔndɔ no nua so.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Obiara a ɔgye dzi dɛ Jesus nye Kraest no, Nyankopɔn awo no: na obiara a ɔdɔ nyia ɔyɛ ɔwofo no, ɔdɔ nyia ɔawo no so.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Sɛ yɛdɔ Nyankopɔn na yɛyɛ n’ahyɛdze a, ɔno ara na yɛdze hu dɛ yɛdɔ Nyankopɔn mba.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na Nyankopɔn dɔ nye yi, dɛ yebedzi n’ahyɛdze do: na n’ahyɛdze no nnyɛ dzen.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Osiandɛ obiara a Nyankopɔn awo no no, odzi wiadze do konyim: na dza yɛdze dzi wiadze do konyim nye hɛn gyedzi.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na woana na odzi wiadze do konyim, dɛ nyia ɔgye dzi dɛ Jesus yɛ Nyankopɔn Ba no?
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Oyi nye nyia ɔnam nsu nye bɔgya do bae no, mekyerɛ Jesus Kraest; nnyɛ nsu nko, na mbom nsu nye bɔgya do. Sunsum no na odzi dase, osiandɛ Sunsum no nye nokwar no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na baasa na wodzi dase:
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Sunsum no, nsu no, nye bɔgya no: na baasa yi nyina hɔn dasee yɛ kor.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Sɛ yɛgye nyimpa ne dasee dzi a, Nyankopɔn dasee so kyɛn no: na Nyankopɔn dasee nye dase a oedzi wɔ ne Ba ho.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Nyia ɔgye Nyankopɔn Ba no dzi no wɔ dasedzi wɔ nankasa no mu; nyia ɔnngye Nyankopɔn nndzi no ɔama Nyankopɔn ayɛ ɔtorfo; osiandɛ ɔanngye dase a Nyankopɔn edzi wɔ ne Ba no ho no enndzi.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na iyi nye dase no, dɛ Nyankopɔn maa hɛn onnyiewiei nkwa, na nkwa yi wɔ ne Ba no mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Nyia ɔwɔ Ɔba no, ɔwɔ nkwa no, nyia onnyi Nyankopɔn Ba no nnyi nkwa no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Makyerɛw iyinom abrɛ hom, ama hom eehu dɛ hom wɔ onnyiewiei nkwa, hom a hom agye Nyankopɔn Ba no ne dzin edzi no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na ndam a yɛdze kɔ ne nkyɛn nye dɛ, sɛ yɛserɛ biribiara dɛ mbrɛ ɔpɛ a, otsie hɛn;
title: 1ST JOHN

text: na sɛ yenyim dɛ otsie hɛn wɔ dza yɛserɛ no ho a, yenyim dɛ yenya ndzɛmba a yɛaserɛ no wɔ no hɔ no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Sɛ obi hu no nua dɛ ɔreyɛ bɔn a ɔnnkɔ owu mu a, ɔmbɔ mpaa nserɛ mma no, na Nyankopɔn bodua no do dze nkwa ama hɔn a wɔyɛ bɔn a ɔnnkɔ wu mu no. Bɔn bi wɔ hɔ a ɔkɔ owu mu: nnyɛ ɔno ho na mese dɛ ɔmbɔ mpaa nserɛ.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Dza ɔnntsen nyina yɛ bɔn: naaso bɔn bi wɔ hɔ a ɔnnkɔ owu mu.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Yenyim dɛ obiara a Nyankopɔn awo no no, ɔnnyɛ bɔn; na mbom nyia Nyankopɔn awo no no hwɛ noho do, na ɔbɔn no nnka no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Yenyim dɛ hɛn dze, yefi Nyankopɔn, na wiadze nyina hyɛ ɔbɔn no no tum ase.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Na yenyim dɛ Nyankopɔn Ba no aba, na ɔama hɛn ntseasee a yɛdze hu nyia ɔyɛ nokwafo no, na yɛwɔ nokwafo no mu, ne Ba Jesus Kraest no. Oyi nye nokwar Nyankopɔn, nye onnyiewiei nkwa no.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Me mba nkakraba, hom nsie homho mfi ehonyisom ho.
title: 1ST JOHN

text: Emi, Ɔpanyin no, dze kɛma ewuraba a wɔasan mu eyi no nye ne mba a modɔ hɔn nokwar mu no; na nnyɛ mo nko, na hɔn a wonyim nokwar no nyina so;
title: 2ND JOHN

text: osian nokwar no a ɔtse hɛn mu, na ɔnye hɛn bɛtsena daa no ntsi.
title: 2ND JOHN

text: Adom, ehumbɔbɔr, na asomdwee mfi Egya Nyankopɔn nye Ewuradze Jesus Kraest, Egya no ne Ba no hɔ, mbra hɛn do wɔ nokwar nye ɔdɔ mu.
title: 2ND JOHN

text: Midzi dɛw kɛse, dɛ mehu wo mba dɛ wɔnam nokwar mu, dɛ mbrɛ yeenya ahyɛdze wɔ Egya no hɔ no.
title: 2ND JOHN

text: Na afei, Ewuraba, meserɛ wo, nnyɛ dɛ merekyerɛw wo ahyɛdze fofor, na mbom dza ofi ahyɛse no yenyae no, dɛ yɛndodɔ hɛnho.
title: 2ND JOHN

text: Na iyi nye ɔdɔ, dɛ yɛbɛnantsew dɛ mbrɛ n’ahyɛdze no tse. Iyi nye ahyɛdze no dɛ, mbrɛ hom fi ahyɛse tsee no, hom nnantsew mu.
title: 2ND JOHN

text: Na ndaadaafo pii aba wiadze, hɔn a wɔmmpaa mu nnka dɛ Jesus Kraest aba wɔ honam mu no. Iyinom nye ɔdaadaafo nye antikraest no.
title: 2ND JOHN

text: Hom nhwɛ homho yie, na yaannyew dza yɛayɛ edwuma enya no, na mbom yeenya akatua a odzi mu wɔ mu.
title: 2ND JOHN

text: Obiara a ɔnntsena Kraest nkyerɛkyerɛ mu na ɔfom wɔ ndzeyɛɛ mu no, onnyi Nyankopɔn: nyia ɔtse Kraest nkyerɛkyerɛ mu no, ɔno na ɔwɔ Egya no nye Ɔba no.
title: 2ND JOHN

text: Sɛ obi ba hom nkyɛn na onnsuo nkyerɛkyerɛ yi mu a, mma hom nngye no nnkɔ hom fie, eso mma hom nnkyia no;
title: 2ND JOHN

text: na nyia okyia no no, ɔyɛ ne ndzeyɛbɔn no ne fafafo.
title: 2ND JOHN

text: Mowɔ ndzɛmba pii a nkyɛ ɔwɔ dɛ mekyerɛw brɛ hom dze, naaso memmpɛ dɛ medze krataa nye dubir mekyerɛw. M’enyi da kwan dɛ mebɛba hom nkyɛn, na yɛahwɛ hɛnho enyim na enyim akasa ama hɛn dɛw aahyɛ ma.
title: 2ND JOHN

text: Wo nuabaa a wɔasan mu eyi no ne mba no kyia wo.
title: 2ND JOHN

text: Emi, Ɔpanyin no dze kɛma ɔdɔfo Gaius a modɔ no nokwar mu.
title: 3RD JOHN

text: Ɔdɔfo, mobɔ mpaa dɛ, adze nyina mu onsi wo yie, na nya apɔwmudzen, dɛ mbrɛ esi wo kra yie no.
title: 3RD JOHN

text: Na enuanom no bae bedzii dase wɔ wo nokwardzi ho, wɔ mbrɛ esi nam nokwar no mu no, na midzii dɛw dɛ.
title: 3RD JOHN

text: Minnyi dɛw biara a ɔkyɛn iyi, dɛ mebɛtse dɛ me mba nam nokwar no mu.
title: 3RD JOHN

text: Ɔdɔfo, dza eyɛ ma enuanom nye ahɔho no, yɛ no nokwar mu;
title: 3RD JOHN

text: hɔn na woedzi wo dɔ ho dase wɔ asɔr no enyim, na sɛ igya hɔn kwan dɛ mbrɛ ɔsɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim a, nna ayɛ dza odzi mu:
title: 3RD JOHN

text: osiandɛ, Kraest ntsi na wɔhyɛɛ hɔn akwantu ase a wɔanngye Amanamamfo no hɔ biribi.
title: 3RD JOHN

text: Dɛm ntsi na ɔsɛ hɛn dɛ yɛgye dɛm nkorɔfo no, na yaayɛ nyɛnko edwumayɛfo ama nokwar no.
title: 3RD JOHN

text: Makyerɛw akɛma asɔr no, naaso Diotrefɛs a ɔpɛ dɛ ɔyɛ noho kandzifo no anngye hɛn annto mu.
title: 3RD JOHN

text: Iyi ntsi sɛ meba a, mebɛkaa ne ndzeyɛe a ɔyɛ, ɔbɔ hɛn sombo a ɔnnyɛ nokwar. Iyi so mpo nndɔɔ so mma no, ɔnoara so nngye enuanom no so, na ɔsan so siw hɔn a wɔpɛ dɛ wɔyɛ dɛm no kwan, na oyi hɔn edzi fi asɔr no mu.
title: 3RD JOHN

text: Ɔdɔfo, mma nndzi bɔn ekyir, na mbom dzi papa ekyir. Nyia ɔyɛ papa no na ofi Nyankopɔn mu, nyia ɔyɛ bɔn dze, onnhun Nyankopɔn.
title: 3RD JOHN

text: Na Demitrius dze, hɔn nyinara dzi no ho dase wɔ nokwar mu, na hɛn so yedzi no ho dase; osiandɛ inyim dɛ hɛn dasee yɛ nokwar.
title: 3RD JOHN

text: Mowɔ ndzɛmba pii a nkyɛ mebɛkyerɛw wo, naaso memmpɛ dɛ medze dubir nye kyerɛwdua mekyerɛw brɛ wo:
title: 3RD JOHN

text: na m’enyi da dɛ mubohu wo ntsɛm, na yaakasa enyim na enyim. Asomdwee nka wo. Anyɛnkofo no kyiakyia wo. Bobɔ anyɛnkofo no edzin nkorkor kyiakyia hɔn.
title: 3RD JOHN

text: Jude, Jesus Kraest n’akowaa, nye James no nua no, dze kɛma hɔn a wɔafrɛ hɔn, Egya Nyankopɔn mu adɔfo, na wɔakora hɔn ama Jesus Kraest no.
title: JUDE

text: Mbɔbɔrhu nye asomdwee nye dɔ ndɔɔ so mma hom.
title: JUDE

text: Adɔfo, morobɔ mbɔdzen biara akyerɛw nkwagye a ɔyɛ hɛn nyina dze no ho asɛm abrɛ hom yi, ekehia so dɛ mekyerɛw botu hom fo dɛ, hom ndzi aper enyiberdo mma gyedzi a wɔdze maa ahotseweefo no prɛko pɛr no.
title: JUDE

text: Osiandɛ nyimpa bi ewiawia hɔnho abɛhyɛ mu a wofi tsetse dze hɔn esi hɔ ama dɛm atsɛmbu yi, emumuyɛfo a woesi hɛn Nyankopɔn adom no tsir adze bɔ egyangyanbra, na wɔpow hɛn Wura kortsee a ɔno nye hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest no.
title: JUDE

text: Na mepɛ dɛ mobɔ hom a hom nyim iyi prɛko dada yi nkaa, dɛ Ewuradze gyee ɔman no fii Egypt asaase do no ekyir no ɔsɛɛ hɔn a wɔanngye enndzi no.
title: JUDE

text: Na abɔfo a wɔannkora hɔnara hɔn mpanyindzi, na wɔdaan hɔnankasa hɔn tsenabea gyae no, ɔdze hɔn egu daa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu wɔ sum mu ama da kɛse no n’atsɛmbu no.
title: JUDE

text: Dɛmara na Sodom nye Gomora nye nkurow a ɔdeda hɔn ho a wɔyɛɛ dza iyinom yɛe dze hɔnho maa ndwamansɛm dze bɔɔ mbusu kɛse no, wɔdze hɔn esi hɔ dɛ asɛndahɔ ama ogya a onndum da ntsea no.
title: JUDE

text: Dɛmara so na iyinom so yɛ adaasofo a wogu honam ho fi, na wommbu tumdzi hwee, na wɔyeyaw enyimnyamfo.
title: JUDE

text: Naaso ber a ɔbɔfopanyin Maekɛl nye abɔnsam dzii esi kasakasae wɔ Moses fun ho no, oennsi no bo dɛ ɔyaw no bu no atsɛn, na mbom ɔsee dɛ, Ewuradze nka w’enyim.
title: JUDE

text: Na iyinom dze wɔka dza wonnyim no ho nsɛmbɔn; na dza wofi hɔn nyimpasu mu nyim no, dɛ mbowa a wonnyi adwen no. Na iyinom mu na wogu hɔnho fi.
title: JUDE

text: Wondue! Osiandɛ wɔfaa Kain kwan do, na wɔatow hɔnho akyen wɔ Balaam mfom mu wɔ mfaso ntsi, na wɔahera dɛ Kora wɔ etuatsew mu.
title: JUDE

text: Iyinom na wɔyɛ nkekaa wɔ hom dɔ edzidzi mu, wɔnye hom dzidzi, nguanhwɛfo a wonnsuro adze dɛ wɔnyɛn hɔnho, nsuwusiw a nsu nnyi mu a mframa dze hɔn kyinkyin, ɔhyewber ndua a wonnyi aba a woewu mprɛnu, eso hɔn ndwow etutu;
title: JUDE

text: po asorɛkye dzendzenndzen a wohur hɔnara hɔn enyito pue; ekyinekyin nworaba a wɔdze sum kebikebi esie ama hɔn daa.
title: JUDE

text: Iyinom so na Enok a ofi Adam do no na otsia esuon wɔ mbasantsen mu no hyɛɛ nkɔm kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ, Hwɛ, Ewuradze dze no krɔnkrɔmfo mpem du reba,
title: JUDE

text: ebobu hɔn nyina atsɛn, na oeyi emumuyɛfo nyina atsɛn wɔ hɔn emumuyɛdze a wɔyɛɛ nyina, nye etsirmɔdzensɛm a ɔyɛ dzen a ndzebɔnyɛfo emumuyɛfo kae dze tsiaa no nyina ho.
title: JUDE

text: Iyinom yɛ ehwinhwimfo, begyabegyayɛfo a wodzi hɔnara hɔn akɔndɔ ekyir, na hɔn ano ka akɛsesɛm, na mfaso ntsi wɔhwɛ nyimpa enyim.
title: JUDE

text: Na hom dze, adɔfo, hom nkaa nsɛm a hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest asomafo kae too hɔ no:
title: JUDE

text: mbrɛ wɔkaa kyerɛɛ hom dɛ, Ber a odzi ekyir no mu atwetwesifo bɛba a wɔbɛnantsew hɔnara hɔn emumuyɛ akɔndɔ ekyir no.
title: JUDE

text: Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔdze mpaapaamu ba, honam ekyidzifo a wonnyi Sunsum no.
title: JUDE

text: Na hom dze, adɔfo, hom mfa homho nsi hom gyedzi krɔnkrɔn no do mbɔ mpaa wɔ Sunsum Krɔnkrɔn no tum mu;
title: JUDE

text: hom nsie homho wɔ Nyankopɔn dɔ no mu, ntweɔn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest no mbɔbɔrhu nkɔ onnyiewiei nkwa mu.
title: JUDE

text: Na binom a wohinhim no, hom nhu hɔn mbɔbɔr;
title: JUDE

text: na binom so hom nhwim hɔn mfi gya mu ngye hɔn nkwa; na binom so hom mfa suro nhu hɔn mbɔbɔr; hom nkyir nyimpasu a ɔtse dɛ atar a nkekaaba wɔ mu mpo.
title: JUDE

text: Na afei nyia obotum akora hom ma hom eemmfintsiw, na ɔdze hom esi n’enyimnyam enyim dɛ hom nndzi dzɛm wɔ enyigye mbordo mu no,
title: JUDE

text: Nyankopɔn kortsee a ɔnam hɛn Ewuradze Jesus Kraest do yɛ hɛn Agyenkwa no, ɔno na enyimnyam, kɛseyɛ, ahoɔdzen nye tumdzi nka no, mbersantsen, sesei, nye daapem. Amen.
title: JUDE

text: Jesus Kraest ne Nyikyerɛ a Nyankopɔn dze maa no dɛ ɔnkyerɛ no nkowaa dza otwar dɛ ɔbɛba ntsɛm; na ɔsomae nam no bɔfoe do dze bɛkyerɛɛ n’akowaa John;
title: REVELATION

text: ɔno na odzii dase wɔ Nyankopɔn asɛm nye Jesus Kraest dasedzi ho, wɔ ndzɛmba a ohunii nyina ho.
title: REVELATION

text: Nhyira nye onyia a ɔkenkan, nye hɔn a wotsie nkɔnhyɛnsɛm no, na wɔdze dza wɔakyerɛw no wɔ mu no sie: osiandɛ ber no abɛn.
title: REVELATION

text: John dze kɛma asɔrtɔw esuon a wɔwɔ Asia no: Adom nye asomdwee mfi nyia ɔwɔ hɔ, ɔwɔ hɔ dada, na ɔreba no; nye esunsum esuon a wɔwɔ n’ahengua no enyim no;
title: REVELATION

text: nye Jesus Kraest a ɔyɛ dasefo nokwafo, ewufo mu abakan, nye asaase do ahemfo hɔn do hwɛdofo no nkyɛn, nka hom. Nyia ɔdɔ hɛn, na ɔdze no bɔgyaa saan hɛn fii hɛn bɔn mu;
title: REVELATION

text: na ɔayɛ hɛn ahenman, asɔfo ama n’Egya Nyankopɔn no; ɔno na enyimnyam nye tumdzi nka no mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
title: REVELATION

text: Hwɛ, ɔnam nsuwusiw mu reba; na enyiwa nyina bohu no, mpo hɔn a wɔwɔɔ no peaa no; na wiadze mbusuakuw nyina botwa no ho kwadwom. Dɛmara na ɔbɛyɛ. Amen.
title: REVELATION

text: Emi nye Alfa nye Omega, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn na ɔse, nyia ɔwɔ hɔ, ɔwɔ hɔ dada, na ɔreba no, adze nyina do Tumfo no.
title: REVELATION

text: Emi John a meyɛ hom nua, na menye hom wɔ kyɛfa wɔ Jesus Kraest mu ahohia, nye ahendzi nye abotar no mu no, ɔnam Nyankopɔn n’asɛm nye Jesus Kraest dasedzi ntsi nna mowɔ supruw a wɔfrɛ no Patmos no do.
title: REVELATION

text: Nna mowɔ Sunsum no mu Ewuradze ne da no mu, na metsee m’ekyir ndze kɛse bi, tse dɛ totorobɛnto,
title: REVELATION

text: dɛ, Dza ihu yi kyerɛw no nwoma mu, na soma kɛma asɔrtɔw esuon no; fa kɛma Efeso, nye Semirna, nye Pergamum, nye Tiatira, nye Sardis, nye Filadelfia nye Laodikea.
title: REVELATION

text: Nna medaan moho dɛ morokɔhwɛ ndze a ɔkasaa kyerɛɛ me no. Na medaan moho no, muhun sikakɔkɔɔ nkandzeadua esuon:
title: REVELATION

text: na dɛm nkandzeadua esuon no finimfin no muhun obi a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa ba, ɔhyɛ atar wiww ka ne nansa, na ɔdze sika abɔdo abɔ no koko do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ne tsir nye ne tsinhwi hoa dɛ nguanhwi fitaa, ɔtse dɛ esukwankyɛba; na n’enyiwa tse dɛ gyaframee;
title: REVELATION

text: na n’anan tse dɛ ayewa a wɔaber ho wɔ fononoo mu na woetwuw ho, na ne ndze tse dɛ esu pii ndze.
title: REVELATION

text: Na okitsa nworaba esuon wɔ ne nsa nyimfa mu, na afona anofanu ndam ndam fi n’anomu. Na no momapɔw tse dɛ ewia a ɔrehyerɛn wɔ n’ahoɔdzen mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun no no, mohwee n’ananadze dɛ owufo. Naaso ɔdze ne nsa nyimfa too mo do, see dɛ, Mma nnsuro, Emi nye ɔkandzifo nye okyidzifo no,
title: REVELATION

text: nye nyia ɔtse ase no; na muwui; na hwɛ, metse ase mbersantsen mfesantsen, na mikitsa owu nye samanadze nsaafee.
title: REVELATION

text: Afei kyerɛw dza ehu, nye dza ɔwɔ hɔ, nye dza iyi ekyir ɔbɛba no.
title: REVELATION

text: Nworaba esuon a ihunii wɔ me nsa nyimfa mu nye sikakɔkɔɔ nkandzeadua esuon no ho esumasɛm no nye iyi: nworaba esuon no nye asɔrtɔw esuon no mu abɔfo; na nkandzeadua esuon no so nye asɔrtɔw esuon no.
title: REVELATION

text: Efeso asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no, kyerɛw kɛma no dɛ: Iyi na nyia okitsa nworaba esuon no wɔ ne nsa nyimfa mu, na ɔnantsew sika nkandzeadua esuon no finimfin no, se:
title: REVELATION

text: Minyim wo ndwuma, nye wo berɛ, nye w’abotar, mbrɛ inntum nnkora emumuyɛfo, na esɔɔ hɔn a wɔfrɛ hɔnho asomafo naaso wɔnnyɛ no hwɛe, na ihun hɔn dɛ atorfo;
title: REVELATION

text: na ayɛ abotar na asɔw ɔhaw wɔ me dzin ntsi, na ammpa abaw no.
title: REVELATION

text: Naaso mowɔ biribi tsia wo, dɛ igyaa wo dɔ a nna ewɔ no kan no.
title: REVELATION

text: Dɛm ntsi, kaa mbrɛ ifi ahwe ase, na nu woho, na yɛ kan no ndwuma no; annyɛ dɛm a, mebɛba wo do, na meebeyi wo kandzeadua no efi ne sibea; gyedɛ inu woho.
title: REVELATION

text: Naaso iyi dze ebɔ ho mbɔdzen, dɛ ikyir Nikolaifo ndwuma a mo so mikyir no.
title: REVELATION

text: Onyia ɔwɔ aso no ma ontsie dza Sunsum ka kyerɛ asɔrtɔw no. Nyia odzi nyim no, mebɛma no nkwadua a osi Nyankopɔn ne Paradise no, n’aba bi ma oeedzi.
title: REVELATION

text: Na kyerɛw kɛma Semirna asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no dɛ: Iyi na ɔkandzifo nye okyidzifo, nyia owui na ɔtse ase bio no se:
title: REVELATION

text: Minyim w’ahohiahia na wo hia, naaso eyɛ ɔhonyanyi, nye hɔn a wɔ dɛ wɔyɛ Jewfo, naaso wɔnnyɛ, na mbom wɔyɛ Satan nhyiamudan no, hɔn ebususɛm no.
title: REVELATION

text: Mma nnsuro amandze a irubohu biara: hwɛ, abɔnsam dze hom mu binom rubogu efiadze, na wɔaasɔ hom ahwɛ; na hom bohu amandze dadu. Dzi nokwar kesi owu mu, na mebɛma wo nkwa ahenkyɛw.
title: REVELATION

text: Onyia ɔwɔ aso no, ma ontsie dza Sunsum no ka kyerɛ asɔrtɔw no. Nyia obedzi nyim no, owu mprɛnu nnkɛhaw no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na Pergamum asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no kyerɛw kɛma no dɛ: Iyi na nyia okitsa afona anofanu ndam ndam no se:
title: REVELATION

text: Minyim beebi a etse, mbrɛ Satan n’ahengua si no; naaso esuo me dzin mu dzen, na ammpa me gyedzi, wɔ nda a wokum me dasefo nokwafo Antipas wɔ hom mu, wɔ mbrɛ Satan tse hɔ no.
title: REVELATION

text: Naaso mowɔ asɛm kakra tsia wo, osiandɛ ewɔ binom wɔ wo hɔ a wokitsa Balaam nkyerɛkyerɛ mu, nyia ɔkyerɛɛ Balak dɛ ɔnto Israelmba fintsidua, dɛ wondzi adze a wɔdze abɔ abosom afɔr, na wɔmbɔ edwaman no.
title: REVELATION

text: Dɛmara so na ewɔ binom a wɔdze Nikolaifo nkyerɛkyerɛ a mikyir no mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Dɛm ntsi nu woho; annyɛ dɛm a, mebɛba wo do ntsɛmara, na medze m’anomu afona nye hɔn abɔko.
title: REVELATION

text: Nyia ɔwɔ aso no, ma ontsie dza Sunsum no ka kyerɛ asɔrtɔw no. Nyia obedzi nyim no, ɔno na mebɛma no manna a ohuntsa no bi, na mama no bobaa fufuw, na bobaa no do na wɔakyerɛw dzin a obi nnyim gyedɛ nyia onya no nko.
title: REVELATION

text: Tiatira asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no, kyerɛw kɛma no dɛ: Iyi na Nyankopɔn Ba no a ɔwɔ enyiwa a ɔtse dɛ gyaframee, na n’anan tse dɛ ayewa a wɔaber ho no se:
title: REVELATION

text: Minyim wo ndwuma, nye wo dɔ, nye wo gyedzi, nye wo som, nye w’abotar, nye dɛ wo ndwuma a odzi ekyir kyɛn dza odzi kan no.
title: REVELATION

text: Naaso mowɔ biribi tsia wo, dɛ ema ɔbaa Jezebel a ɔfrɛ noho nkɔnhyɛnyi no kwan, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ na ɔdaadaa mo nkowaa ma wɔbɔ edwaman, na wodzi dza wɔdze abɔ abosom afɔr.
title: REVELATION

text: Na memaa no mber dɛ onnu noho, na ɔmmpɛ dɛ onu noho fi no ndwamansɛm mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Ntsi hwɛ, medze no bɔto mpa do, na medze hɔn a wɔnye no too awar no egu ahohia kɛse mu, gyedɛ wonu hɔnho wɔ hɔn ndwuma ho.
title: REVELATION

text: Na medze owu boku ne mba; na asɔrtɔw no nyina bohu dɛ emi nye nyia ɔhwehwɛ adwen nye akoma mu; na mebɛma hom mu biara dɛ mbrɛ no ndwuma tse.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mese hom a hom aka Tiatira, dodow a wonnyi dɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ yi, hɔn a wonnyim Satan no bun no, dɛ mbrɛ wɔka no; moronnsoa hom adzesoa fofor biara.
title: REVELATION

text: Mbom dza hom wɔ no, hom nsuo mu dzen ma onkodu dɛ mebɛba.
title: REVELATION

text: Na nyia obedzi nyim na ɔayɛ mo ndwuma ekesi ewiei no, mebɛma no amanaman do tum:
title: REVELATION

text: na ɔdze dadze poma bɔhwɛ hɔn do, na obobubu hɔn posoposo dɛ ɔwemfo nsenaba.
title: REVELATION

text: Dɛ mbrɛ mo so menya no m’Egya nsamu no. Nyia obedzi nyim no, mebɛma no adzekyee woraba no.
title: REVELATION

text: Nyia ɔwɔ aso no, ma ontsie dza Sunsum no ka kyerɛ asɔrtɔw no.
title: REVELATION

text: Sardis asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no, kyerɛw kɛma no dɛ: Iyi na nyia ɔwɔ Nyankopɔn esunsum esuon no nye nworaba esuon no se: Minyim wo ndwuma, dɛ ewɔ dzin dɛ etse ase, naaso ewu.
title: REVELATION

text: Weɔn, na hyɛ ndzɛmba a wɔaka a nkyɛ worubowu no dzen: na munnhun wo ndwuma mu dza odzi mu wɔ me Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: REVELATION

text: Dɛm ntsi kaa mbrɛ inyae, na etsee; na suo mu na nu woho. Na sɛ annweɔn a, mebɛba dɛ owifo, na irunnhu dɔn kor a mebɛba wo do.
title: REVELATION

text: Naaso ewɔ edzin kakraabi wɔ Sardis a wonnguu hɔn ntar ho fi no, na wɔnye me bɛnantsew wɔ fitaa mu; osiandɛ wɔfata.
title: REVELATION

text: Nyia obedzi nyim no, ɔnoara na wɔbɛhyɛ no ntar fitaa dɛm; na meremmpepa ne dzin wɔ nkwa nwoma no mu, na mobɔbɔ ne dzin wɔ m’Egya, nye n’abɔfoe enyim.
title: REVELATION

text: Onyia ɔwɔ aso no, ma ontsie dza Sunsum no ka kyerɛ asɔrtɔw no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na kyerɛw kɛma Filadelfia asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no dɛ: Iyi na krɔnkrɔnnyi, nokwafo no, nyia okitsa David saafee, na obue a obi nntow mu, na ɔtow mu a obi so mmbue no se:
title: REVELATION

text: Minyim wo ndwuma. Hwɛ, medze abow a woebue ato w’enyim a obi nntum nntow mu, dɛ ewɔ ahoɔdzen kakra, na esie m’asɛm na ammpow me dzin ntsi.
title: REVELATION

text: Hwɛ, medze binom a wofi Satan nhyiamudan mu a wɔka dɛ wɔyɛ Jewfo, naaso wɔnnyɛ no, na wodzi ator no, ma wo: hwɛ, mebɛma wɔaba abɔkotow w’ananadze na woehu dɛ madɔ wo.
title: REVELATION

text: Ɔnam dɛ esie m’abotar asɛm no ntsi, mo so medze wo besie wɔ nsɔhwɛ dɔn a ɔbɛba wiadze nyina do aabɔsɔ hɔn a wɔtse asaase do ahwɛ no mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Mereba ntsɛm: suo dza ewɔ mu dzen, amma obi aanngye w’ahenkyɛw.
title: REVELATION

text: Nyia obedzi nyim no, mebɛyɛ no fadum wɔ me Nyankopɔn asɔrdan mu, na orimmfi mu mmpue bio: na mebɛkyerɛw me Nyankopɔn dzin wɔ no do, nye me Nyankopɔn kurow no ne dzin, Jerusalɛm fofor a ofi me Nyankopɔn hɔ fi sor ba asaase do, nye mankasa me dzin fofor no.
title: REVELATION

text: Nyia ɔwɔ aso no, ma ontsie dza Sunsum no ka kyerɛ asɔrtɔw no.
title: REVELATION

text: Laodikea asɔr mu ɔbɔfo no, kyerɛw kɛma no dɛ, Iyi na Amen, ɔnokwafo nye nokwar dasefo no, Nyankopɔn a ɔno nye abɔdze nyina farbaa no, se:
title: REVELATION

text: Minyim wo ndwuma dɛ ennyɛ nwin nnyɛ hyew: sɛ eyɛɛ nwin anaa eyɛɛ hyew a, nkyɛ mepɛ mbom.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔnam dɛ eyɛ abɔtrɔbɔdwe, na ennyɛ hyew nnyɛ nwin ntsi, mebɛfe wo efi m’anomu egu.
title: REVELATION

text: Osiandɛ eka dɛ, Meyɛ ɔhonyanyi, menya moho, onnhia me hwee; naaso innyim dɛ ɔwo nye ɔwerɛhonyi nye busuyɛnyi nye hianyi nye furafo nye kwatserkwa no a?
title: REVELATION

text: Mutu wo fo dɛ bɔtɔ mo hɔ sika a wɔaber ho wɔ gya mu, ama aayɛ ɔhonyanyi; nye ntar fitaa, na edze ahyɛ woho, na w’adagyaw ne fɛr annda edzi, nye enyiwa edur a edze bɛsera w’enyiwa do, na eehu adze.
title: REVELATION

text: Dodow a modɔ hɔn no, meka hɔn enyim na metsea hɔn: dɛm ntsi, bɔ mbɔdzen nu woho.
title: REVELATION

text: Hwɛ, migyina abow no ekyir na morobɔ mu: sɛ obi tsie me ndze na obue abow no a, mebɛhɛn mu aba ne nkyɛn, na menye no bedzidzi na ɔno so nye me edzidzi.
title: REVELATION

text: Nyia obedzi nyim no, mebɛma ɔnye me atsena m’ahengua do, dɛ mbrɛ mo so midzii nyim, na menye m’Egya tse n’ahengua do no.
title: REVELATION

text: Nyia ɔwɔ aso no, ma ontsie dza Sunsum no ka kyerɛ asɔrtɔw no.
title: REVELATION

text: Iyi ekyir no mohwɛe, na muhun abow a woebue wɔ sor, na ndze a metsee no nkan a ɔtse dɛ totorobɛnto nye me rekasa no see me dɛ, Fow bra ha, na mebɛkyerɛ wo dza otwar dɛ ɔbɛba mu wɔ iyi ekyir.
title: REVELATION

text: Ntsɛmara na mokɔr Sunsum mu: na hwɛ, wɔdze ahengua esi sor, na obi tse ahengua no do;
title: REVELATION

text: na nyia ɔtse do no, ehwɛ no a ɔtse dɛ ahwehwɛbo nye bɔgyanambo na nyankontɔn a ehwɛ a ɔtse dɛ ahatawmomonbo etwa ahengua no ho ehyia.
title: REVELATION

text: Na nhengua eduonu anan etwa ahengua no ho ehyia: na muhun mpanyimfo eduonu anan tsetse nhengua no do, hyehyɛ ntar fitaa, na sika nhenkyɛw soso hɔn etsifi.
title: REVELATION

text: Na enyinam, nye ndze horow nye asenaman fi ahengua no mu firii, nye gya nkandzea esuon a wɔyɛ Nyankopɔn esunsum esuon no, redzɛw ahengua no enyim;
title: REVELATION

text: na ahengua no enyim hɔ no, biribi wɔ hɔ a ɔtse dɛ ahwehwɛ po a ɔhyerɛn dɛ ahwehwɛ. Atseasefo baanan a enyiwa ayɛ hɔn enyim nye hɔn ekyir ma, wɔ ahengua no n’afa anan no ho, na woetwa ahengua no ho ehyia.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔtseasefo a odzi kan no tse dɛ gyata, dza otsia ebien no tse dɛ nantwiba, dza otsia ebiasa no wɔ enyim dɛ nyimpa, na dza otsia anan no tse dɛ ɔkɔr a orutu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na atseasefo baanan no mu kor biara wɔ ntsaban esia, na enyiwa ahyɛ hɔn ho nye hɔn mu ma: Adzekyee nye adzesaa nyina wonngyaa hɔn ndwom a wɔtow no dɛ; Krɔnkrɔn, Krɔnkrɔn, Krɔnkrɔn nye Ewuradze Nyankopɔn Tumfo a ɔwɔ hɔ dada, ɔwɔ hɔ ndɛ, na ɔreba no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na aber a atseasefo no dze enyimnyam nye enyidzi nye ndaase rema nyia ɔtse ahengua no do no a ɔtse hɔ mbersantsen mfesantsen no,
title: REVELATION

text: mpanyimfo eduonu anan no hwe ase wɔ dza ɔtse ahengua no do no enyim, na wɔkotow dza ɔtse ase mbersantsen mfesantsen no, na wotutu hɔn ahenkyɛw gu ahengua no enyim dɛ,
title: REVELATION

text: Hɛn Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, ɔwo efata dɛ egye enyimnyam nye enyidzi nye tum: na ɔwo na ebɔɔ adze nyina, na wo pɛ ntsi na wɔwowɔ hɔ, na wɔbɔe.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun nwoma a wɔakyerɛw no mu nye n’ekyir, na wɔdze nsɔwano esuon asɔw ano wɔ nyia ɔtse ahengua no do no ne nsa nyimfa mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun ɔbɔfo hoɔdzenfo bi a ɔdze ndze kɛse retsea mu dɛ, Woana na ɔfata dɛ obue nwoma no, na ɔtsew no nsɔwano no?
title: REVELATION

text: Na obiara nnyi sor, anaa asaase, anaa asaase ase a otumii dɛ obue nwoma no, anaa ɔhwɛ.
title: REVELATION

text: Na musuu pii, osiandɛ woennhu obiara a ɔfata dɛ obobue nwoma no, anaa ɔbɔhwɛ:
title: REVELATION

text: na mpanyimfo no baako see me dɛ, Mma nnsu: na Juda ebusuakuw mu Gyata no, David Ndwow no, oedzi konyim, dɛ obobue nwoma no na ɔatsew no nsɔwano esuon no ano.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun dɛ ahengua no nye atseasefo baanan no ntamu, nye mpanyimfo no ntamu no, Eguambaa bi gyina hɔ a ɔtse dɛ woeku no, ɔwɔ mmbɛn esuon, nye enyiwa esuon a ɔyɛ Nyankopɔn Esunsum esuon a wɔasoma hɔn akɔ asaase nyina do no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbae bɛgyee nwoma no wɔ nyia ɔtse ahengua no do no ne nyimfa.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔgyee nwoma no, atseasefo baanan no nye mpanyimfo eduonu anan no hwee ase wɔ Eguambaa no enyim, a wɔdzedze nsanku nye sika nkɔɔpow a ohuam ahyɛ no ma a ɔyɛ ahotseweefo mpaabɔ no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔtoow ndwom fofor bi dɛ, Ɔwo na efata dɛ egye nwoma no, na etsew no nsɔwano no: osiandɛ wokum wo, na edze wo bɔgyaa tɔɔ binom maa Nyankopɔn, wofi mbusuakuw nye kasa, nye nkorɔfo, nye aman nyina mu;
title: REVELATION

text: na ama wɔayɛ ahenman nye asɔfo ama hɛn Nyankopɔn: na wobedzi hen wɔ asaase do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mohwɛe, na metsee abɔfo pii a wɔabɔ ahengua no ho kɔntɔnkrɔn nye atseasefo no nye mpanyimfo no hɔn ndze, na hɔn dodow yɛ mpempem, nye ɔpepepem;
title: REVELATION

text: na wɔdze ndze kɛse see dɛ, Eguambaa no a wokum no no ɔfata dɛ ɔgye tumdzi, nye ahonya, nye nyansa, nye ahoɔdzen, nye enyidzi, nye enyimnyam, nye nhyira!
title: REVELATION

text: Na metsee dɛ abɔdze a ɔwɔ sor, nye asaase, nye asaase ase, nye dza ɔwɔ po do, nye dza ɔwɔ mu nyina se, Nhyira, nye enyidzi, nye enyimnyam, nye tumdzi, nka nyia ɔtse ahengua no do no, nye Eguambaa no, mbersantsen mfesantsen!
title: REVELATION

text: Na atseasefo baanan no see dɛ, Amen. Na mpanyimfo eduonu anan no hwehwee ase, na wɔkotoow no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun dɛ Eguambaa no tseew nsɔwano esuon no mu kor ano, na metsee atseasefo baanan no mu baako dɛ ɔdze ndze a ɔtse dɛ senaman see dɛ, Bra.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mohwɛe, na hwɛ, ɔpɔnkɔ fufuw bi, na nyia ɔtse no do no kitsa egyen; na wɔmaa no ahenkyɛw: na otuu ntsen a oridzi konyim kɔ konyim mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔtseew nsɔwano a otsia ebien no ano no, metsee ɔtseasefo a otsia ebien no dɛ ɔse, Bra.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔpɔnkɔ fofor memen bi puei, na wɔmaa nyia ɔtse no do no tum dɛ onkeyi asomdwee mfi asaase do, na wonkuku hɔnho, na wɔmaa no afona kɛse bi.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔtseew nsɔwano a otsia ebiasa no ano no, metsee ɔtseasefo a otsia ebiasa no dɛ ɔse, Bra. Na mohwɛe, na hwɛ, ɔpɔnkɔ tuntum, na nyia ɔtse no do no kitsa nsɛn wɔ ne nsamu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na metsee ndze bi wɔ atseasefo baanan no finimfin dɛ ɔse, Ewifua esusudze kor na atoko esusudze ebiasa nyɛ ɔpaanyi ne da kor akatua, naaso wenyin nye ngo no dze, mma nnsɛɛ no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔtseew nsɔwano a otsia anan no ano no, metsee ɔtseasefo a otsia anan no ndze dɛ ɔse, Bra.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhunii, na hwɛ, ɔpɔnkɔ a no ho nsonso: na nyia ɔtse no do no, ne dzin dze Owu; na Samanadze dzi n’ekyir. Na wɔmaa hɔn asaase nkyekyɛmu anan mu kor do tum, dɛ wɔmfa afona, nye ɔkɔm, nye owu, nye asaase do mbowa abɔyafo nkuku hɔn.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔtseew nsɔwano a otsia enum no ano no, muhun hɔn a Nyankopɔn asɛm nye dase a wodzii ntsi wokunkum hɔn no, hɔn akra wɔ afɔrmbukyia no ase:
title: REVELATION

text: na wɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu dɛ, Ewuradze Tumfo, Krɔnkrɔnnyi nye Nokwafo, onkodu dabɛn na irummbua atsɛn na eronntɔ hɔn a wɔtse asaase do hɔn bɔgyaa do wer?
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔmemaa hɔn mu baako biara atar fitaa; na wɔsee hɔn dɛ wɔnkɔ do nhom mber kakra, nkodu dɛ hɔn nwurakowaa nye hɔn nuanom a woboku hɔn dɛ hɔnara so no hɔn dodow bɔso ano.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔtseew nsɔwano a otsia esia no ano no, mohwɛe, na muhun asaasewosow kɛse, na ewia yɛɛ tumm dɛ eyitam, na bosoom yɛɛ dɛ bɔgya,
title: REVELATION

text: na sor nworaba totɔɔ asaase do, dɛ adɔmbadua a mframa kɛse wosow no ropo n’adɔmba bun.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔsor yewee dɛ nwoma a wɔabobɔw; na mbepɔw nye nsupruw nyina tutui fifii mbrɛ wɔwɔ.
title: REVELATION

text: Na asaase do ahemfo, nye adehye nyina, sumasumaa abodan nye mbepɔw do abotan no mu;
title: REVELATION

text: na wɔsee abotan nye mbepɔw no dɛ, Hom nhwɛ hɛn do mfa hɛn nsuma mfi nyia ɔtse ahengua do no n’enyim, nye Eguambaa no n’ebufuw no ho:
title: REVELATION

text: osiandɛ hɔn ebufuw da kɛse no aba, na woana na obotum egyina enyim?
title: REVELATION

text: Na iyi ekyir muhun abɔfo baanan a wogyinagyina asaase mfɛndzanan no ano, dzedze asaase mframa anan no mu, na mframa ammbɔ wɔ asaase anaa po anaa dua biara do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun ɔbɔfo bi so a ɔdze Nyankopɔn tseasefo no nsɔwano no dɛ ofi wipuei reba: na ɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu kyerɛɛ abɔfo baanan a wɔama hɔn kwan dɛ wɔnhaw po nye asaase no
title: REVELATION

text: dɛ, Mma hom nnhaw asaase anaa po, anaa ndua, ma onkodu dɛ yɛasɔw hɛn Nyankopɔn nkowaa ano wɔ hɔn momapɔw do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na metsee hɔn a wɔsɔɔw hɔn ano no hɔn dodow, mpem ɔha eduanan anan a wɔasɔw hɔn ano wɔ Israelmba mbusuakuw nyina mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Juda ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Reuben ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Gad ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien:
title: REVELATION

text: Aser ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Naftali ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Manaasɛ ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien:
title: REVELATION

text: Simeon ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Levi ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Isakar ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien:
title: REVELATION

text: Zebulun ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Josef ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien: Benjamin ebusuakuw mu mpemduebien.
title: REVELATION

text: Na iyi ekyir no mohwɛe, na hwɛ, nyimpadodow kɛse a obi nntum nnkan hɔn a wofi amanaman, nye mbusuakuw, nye nkorɔfo, nye kasa nyina mu, gyinagyina ahengua no nye Eguambaa no enyim, hyehyɛ ntar fitaa, na wokitsakitsa berɛw wɔ hɔn nsamu;
title: REVELATION

text: na wɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu dɛ, Nkwagye nka hɛn Nyankopɔn a ɔtse ahengua no do, nye Eguambaa no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na abɔfo no nyina etwa ahengua no nye mpanyimfo no nye atseasefo no ho ehyia, na wɔdze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu, na wɔsɔɔr Nyankopɔn
title: REVELATION

text: see dɛ, Amen! Nhyira, nye enyimnyam, nye nyansa, nye ndaase, nye enyidzi, nye tumdzi, nye ahoɔdzen nka hɛn Nyankopɔn mbersantsen mfesantsen. Amen.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mpanyimfo no baako bisaa me dɛ, Woananom nye hɔn a wɔhyehyɛ ntar fitaa yi? Na wofi hen?
title: REVELATION

text: Na mesee no dɛ, Owura, ɔwo na inyim. Na ɔsee me dɛ, Woyi nye hɔn a wofi ahohia kɛse no mu no, na wɔahor hɔn ntar, na ayɛ fitaa wɔ Eguambaa no bɔgyaa mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Dɛm ntsi na wɔwɔ Nyankopɔn ahengua no enyim; na wɔsom no adzekyee nye adzesaa wɔ n’asɔrdan mu: na nyia ɔtse ahengua no do no bɛtserɛw ne ntamadan mu akata hɔn do.
title: REVELATION

text: Ɔkɔm renndze hɔn bio, na eso nsukɔm renndze hɔn bio; na eso ewia rennhye hɔn anaa ɔhyew biara rennka hɔn:
title: REVELATION

text: na Eguambaa no a ɔwɔ ahengua no finimfin no bɛyɛ hɔn guanhwɛfo, na ɔdze hɔn akɔ nkwa nsubura ho: na Nyankopɔn bɛpepa nyinsuwa nyina efi hɔn enyiwa mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔtseew nsɔwano a otsia esuon no ano no, ɔsor taa tsinkonn bɛyɛ dɔnhwerfa.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun abɔfo beesuon a wogyinagyina Nyankopɔn enyim no; na wɔmaa hɔn totorobɛnto esuon.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo bi so bae begyinaa afɔrmbukyia no ho a okitsa sika nduhuam kɔɔpow; na wɔdze nduhuam pii maa no, dɛ ɔmfa mfora ahotseweefo mpaabɔ no mbɔ afɔr wɔ sika afɔrmbukyia no a osi ahengua no enyim no do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na nduhuam no wusiw foraa ahotseweefo mpaabɔ no fii abɔfo no nsamu faa sor kɔr Nyankopɔn enyim.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo no faa nduhuam kɔɔpow no; na ɔdze afɔrmbukyia no do gya no bi hyɛɛ no ma, na ɔtowee kyeen asaase do: na asenaman nye ndze ahorow, nye enyinam, nye asaasewosow bae.
title: REVELATION

text: Na abɔfo beesuon no a wokitsa totorobɛnto esuon no siesiee hɔnho dɛ wɔrebɛhɛn.
title: REVELATION

text: Na nyia odzi kan no hɛnee, na ɔsorbo nye gya a bɔgya edzi afora bae, na wɔtowee guu asaase do: na asaase nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor hyewee, na ndua nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor hyewee, na efuw momon nyina hyewee.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo a otsia ebien no hɛnee, na wɔtoow adze a ɔtse dɛ bepɔw kɛse a ɔredzɛw gya kyeen po mu: na po nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor daan bɔgya;
title: REVELATION

text: na abɔdze a nkwa wɔ mu a wɔwɔ po mu nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor wuwui; na ahɛn nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor sɛɛe.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo a otsia ebiasa no hɛnee, na woraba kɛse bi fi sor hwee famu a ɔredzɛw dɛ ogyatsɛn, na ɔkɔhwee esutsen nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor do, nye nsunyiwa do;
title: REVELATION

text: na woraba no ne dzin dze Bɔwen: na esu no ne nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor yɛɛ wenwen; na nyimpa piinara wuwui wɔ nsu no wen a ɔayɛ ntsi.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo a otsia anan no hɛnee, na wɔbɔɔ ewia nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor, nye bosoom nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor, nye nworaba nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor; ma hɔn nkyekyɛmu a otsia ebiasa no yeyɛɛ sum, na adzekyee nkyekyɛmu a otsia ebiasa annhyerɛn, na adzesaa so dɛmara.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhunii, na metsee ɔkɔr a orutu fa sor finimfin, dɛ ɔdze ndze kɛse rese dɛ, Hɔn a wɔtse asaase do nyina ndue, wondue, wondue, ɔnam ndze a obefi abɔfo baasa no hɔn totorobɛnto no mu aba no ntsi.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo a otsia enum no hɛnee, na muhun woraba bi a ofi sor atɔ asaase do: na wɔdze mona a obi nnhu mbrɛ no mu dɔ kɛpem no ne saafee maa no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na obuee mona a wonnhu mbrɛ no mu dɔ tse no; na wusiw a ɔtse dɛ fononoo kɛse mu wusiw fii mona no mu firii; na ewia na wimu yɛɛ sum wɔ mona no no wusiw no ntsi.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mbɛbɛw fi wusiw no mu baa asaase do; na wɔmaa hɔn tum a ɔtse dɛ asaase do nyankoma nketsebowa tum.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔkaa kyerɛɛ hɔn dɛ mma wɔnnhaw asaase do nkyɛkyɛr, anaa haban momon biara, anaa dua biara, gyedɛ nyimpa a wonnyi Nyankopɔn nsɔwano wɔ hɔn momapɔw do no nko.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔmaa hɔn kwan dɛ mma wonnku hɔn, na mbom wɔnhaw hɔn araa abosoom enum: na hɔn haw tse dɛ nyankoma nketsebowa aka nyimpa.
title: REVELATION

text: Na nda no mu nyimpa bɔhwehwɛ owu naaso worinnya; na hɔn kɔn bɔdɔ dɛ wowu, na owu befi hɔn nkyɛn eguan.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mbɛbɛw no suban tse dɛ mpɔnkɔ a woesiesie hɔn ama ɔko; na hɔn etsifi wɔ adze bi a ɔyɛ dɛ sika ahenkyɛw, na hɔn enyim tse dɛ nyimpa enyim.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔwɔ nhwi tse dɛ mbaa dze, na hɔn se tse dɛ ngyata dze.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔwɔ nkatabo a ɔtse dɛ dadze nkatabo; na hɔn ntsaban mu gyegye tse dɛ mpɔnkɔ pii tseaseanam a wɔdze twitwi rokɔ sa dze.
title: REVELATION

text: Na hɔn dua tsetse dɛ nyankoma nketsebowa dze, na ohwirom so; na hɔn ndua mu na hɔn tum a wɔdze haw nyimpa abosoom enum no wɔ.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔwɔ hɔn do hen a ɔno nye mona a wonnhu no bun ase no mu ɔbɔfo no: ne dzin wɔ Hebriw mu nye Abaddon, na Griik kasa mu dze, ne dzin dze Apollion.
title: REVELATION

text: Mbusu kor etwa mu. Hwɛ, iyi ekyir no mbusu ebien da ho reba.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo a otsia esia no hɛnee, na metsee ndze kor bi a ofi sika afɔrmbukyia a osi Nyankopɔn enyim no ne mmbɛn no mu,
title: REVELATION

text: obi a ɔreka kyerɛ ɔbɔfo a otsia esia no a okitsa totorobɛnto no dɛ, Sansan abɔfo baanan a wɔamontan hɔn esutsen Eufrates ho no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔsansaan abɔfo baanan no a woesiesie ama dɔn, nye da, nye bosoom, nye afe no, dɛ wonkuku nyimpa nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na metsee dɛ mpɔnkɔdofo dɔm no hɔn dodow yɛ ɔpepem ahaebien.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mbrɛ muhun mpɔnkɔ no nye hɔn a wɔtsetse hɔn do, wɔ enyido adzehu mu nye yi, wɔwɔ nkatabo a no su yɛ ogya nye bruu a ɔhoa nye sɔɔfee, na mpɔnkɔ no etsir tse dɛ ngyata etsir, na gya nye wusiw nye sɔɔfee fi hɔn anomu.
title: REVELATION

text: Wɔnam mbusuhaw ebiasa yi do na wokunkum nyimpa nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor, wɔdze gya, nye wusiw, nye sɔɔfee a ofi hɔn anomu no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mpɔnkɔ no hɔn ahoɔdzen wɔ hɔn ano nye hɔn ndua: na iyi na wɔdze haw.
title: REVELATION

text: Na adasa nkaa a wɔammfa mbusuhaw yi ennkuku hɔn no, woennu hɔnho emmfi hɔn ndzeyɛɛ ho, dɛ wɔnnkɔsom mbɔnsam, nye sika, nye dwetɛ, nye ayewa, nye ɔbo, nye dua ehonyi a wonnhu adze, na wɔnntse asɛm, na wonntum nnantsew:
title: REVELATION

text: na woennu hɔnho emmfi hɔn ewudzi, nye hɔn abayisɛm, nye hɔn ndwamansɛm, nye hɔn ewifosɛm ho.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun ɔbɔfo fofor hoɔdzenfo a ofi sor risian no, na ɔahyɛ nsuwusiw; nyankontɔn wɔ ne tsir do, na n’enyim tse dɛ ewia, na n’anan tse dɛ gyafadum:
title: REVELATION

text: na okitsa nwoma kakraba bi a woebue mu: na ɔdze ne nan nyimfa sii po do, na ɔdze bankum no sii asaase do;
title: REVELATION

text: na ɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu dɛ gyata ropɔw; na ɔtseaa mu no, asenaman esuon no bɔɔ hɔn ndze mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na asenaman esuon bɔɔ mu no, nkyɛ mereyɛ makyerɛw: na metsee ndze bi fi sor see me dɛ, Sɔw dza asenaman esuon no kae no ano, mma nnkyerɛw.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo no a muhun dɛ ogyina po nye asaase do no, maa ne nsa do kyerɛɛ sor,
title: REVELATION

text: na ɔkaa nyia ɔtse ase mbersantsen mfesantsen a ɔbɔɔ sor nye dza ɔwɔ mu, nye asaase nye dza ɔwɔ mu, nye po nye dza ɔwɔ mu ho ntam dɛ, Mber biara nnyi hɔ bio:
title: REVELATION

text: mbom ber a ɔbɔfo a otsia esuon no bɛhɛn no totorobɛnto no, nna Nyankopɔn bɛhyɛ n’esumasɛm nhyehyɛɛ no ma, dɛ mbrɛ ɔpaa mu kaa kyerɛɛ no nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ndze a metsee fii sor no nye me kasaa bio dɛ, Kɔ, kɛgye nwoma kakraba a woebue mu no wɔ ɔbɔfo a ogyina po nye asaase do no ne nsamu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mokɔr ɔbɔfo no hɔ kɛsee no dɛ ɔmfa nwoma kakraba no mma me. Na ɔsee me dɛ, Gye, na men; na ɔbɛyɛ wenwen wɔ wo yamu, na w’anomu dze ɔbɛyɛ fenemfenem dɛ ewo.
title: REVELATION

text: Na megyee nwoma kakraba no wɔ ɔbɔfo no nsamu, na memenee; na ɔyɛɛ fenemfenem wɔ m’anomu dɛ ewo, na muwiee men no, ɔyɛɛ wenwen wɔ me yamu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔsee me dɛ, Otwar dɛ ehyɛ nkɔm bio wɔ nkorɔfo, nye aman, nye kasa, nye ahemfo pii ho.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔmaa me ndzɛmbir a ɔtse dɛ abaa: na wɔsee me dɛ, Soɛr, na susu Nyankopɔn asɔrdan, nye afɔrmbukyia nye hɔn a wɔsɔr wɔ mu no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na paado a ɔwɔ asɔrdan no ho no dze, gya no hɔ, na mma nnsusu; na wɔdze ama amanaman; na wobetsiatsia kurow krɔnkrɔn no do abosoom eduanan ebien.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mebɛma m’adasefo beenu efurafura eyitam abɛhyɛ nkɔm nda apem ahaebien eduosia.
title: REVELATION

text: Iyinom nye ngodua ebien nye nkandzeadua ebien a wosisi asaase Wura enyim no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na sɛ obi pɛ dɛ ɔhaw hɔn a, ogya fi hɔn anomu bɛmen hɔn atamfo: obiara a ɔbɛpɛ dɛ ɔhaw hɔn no, otwar dɛ woku no dɛmara.
title: REVELATION

text: Iyinom wɔ tum dɛ wɔtow ɔsor mu ma nsu nntɔ wɔ hɔn nkɔnhyɛ nda no mu: na wɔwɔ esu no do tum dɛ wɔdan hɔn bɔgya, na wɔdze ɔyardɔm biara bɔ asaase da biara a wɔpɛ.
title: REVELATION

text: Na sɛ wowie hɔn adasedzi a, abowa no a ofi mona a wonnhu no mu dɔ mbrɛ ɔpem no nye hɔn bedzi ako, na oedzi hɔn do konyim, na oeku hɔn.
title: REVELATION

text: Na hɔn efun bɛdeda kurow kɛse no n’abrɔn mu, ɔno na sunsum mu wɔfrɛ no Sodom nye Egypt, mbrɛ wɔbɔɔ hɔn Ewuradze so mbeamudua mu no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na binom fi nkorɔfo nye mbusuakuw nye kasa nye aman mu bɔhwɛ hɔn efun ndaansa na fa, na wɔnnkɛma kwan ma wɔdze hɔn efun atoto nda mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na hɔn a wɔtse asaase do hɔn enyiwa bɛgye wɔ hɔn ho, na hɔn ahom aka hɔnho; na wɔbɛkyekyɛ hɔnho adze; osiandɛ nkɔnhyɛfo beenu yi atseetsee hɔn a wɔtse asaase do no.
title: REVELATION

text: Naaso ndaansa na fa ekyir no nkwahom fi Nyankopɔn mu kɛhɛɛn hɔn mu, na wogyinagyinaa hɔn anan do; na hu kɛse kaa hɔn a wohun hɔn no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔtsee ndze kɛse bi fi sor see hɔn dɛ, Hom mbra ɔsor ha. Na wɔkɔr sor wɔ nsuwusiw no mu; na hɔn atamfo hun hɔn.
title: REVELATION

text: Na dɔn no mu asaasewosow kɛse bae, na kurow ne nkyekyɛmu du mu kor hwee ase; na asaasewosow no kum nyimpa mpemesuon: na ihu kaa hɔn a wɔkaa no, na wɔhyɛɛ ɔsorsor Nyankopɔn no enyimnyam.
title: REVELATION

text: Mbusu a otsia ebien no ebotwa mu: hwɛ, mbusu a otsia ebiasa no reba ntsɛmara.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo a otsia esuon no hɛnee, na ndze akɛse gyegyegyegyee wɔ sor, na wɔsee dɛ, Wiadze ahendzi abɛyɛ hɛn Ewuradze nye ne Kraest dze: na obedzi hen mbersantsen mfesantsen.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mpanyimfo eduonu anan no a wɔtsetse hɔn ahengua do wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim no dze hɔn enyim butubutuuw famu, na wɔkotoow Nyankopɔn,
title: REVELATION

text: see dɛ, Yɛda wo ase, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn Tumfo, ɔwo a ewɔ hɔ dada, na ewɔ hɔ daa; osiandɛ afa wo tum kɛse no, na ahyɛ ase ridzi hen.
title: REVELATION

text: Na amanaman bo fuwii, naaso w’ebufuw aba, nye ber a ibobu ewufo atsɛn, na edze w’akatua ama wo nkowaa nkɔnhyɛfo no, nye ahotseweefo no, nye hɔn a wosuro wo dzin nyina, akɛse nye nkakramba; na asɛɛ hɔn a wɔsɛɛ asaase no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wobuee Nyankopɔn asɔrdan a ɔwɔ sor no; na wohun ahyɛmu adaka no wɔ asɔrdan no mu; na enyinam nye ndze, nye asenaman, nye asaasewosow, nye ɔsorbo kɛse bae.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wohun asɛnkyerɛdze kɛse bi wɔ sor: ɔbaa a ofura ewia, na bosoom wɔ n’ananadze, na nworaba duebien ahenkyɛw wɔ n’etsifi;
title: REVELATION

text: na onyinsen: na ɔrekeka mu roko awoo, na awoo no adzen no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wohun asɛnkyerɛdze fofor bi so wɔ sor; na hwɛ, sasabɔnsam kɔkɔɔ kokroko a ɔwɔ etsir esuon nye mmbɛn du, na ahenkyɛw esuon wowɔ n’etsifi.
title: REVELATION

text: Na no dua twee ɔsor nworaba nkyekyɛmu ebiasa mu kor, na ɔtotowee guu asaase do. Na sasabɔnsam no gyinaa ɔbaa no a ɔrobɔwo no enyim, ama sɛ ɔwo a, ɔaamen ne ba no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔwoo babanyin a ɔdze dadze poma robɔhwɛ amanaman nyina do: na wohwiim ne ba no kɔr Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, nye n’ahengua ho.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbaa no guanee kɔr sar do mbrɛ Nyankopɔn esiesie beebi ama no, dɛ wɔnyɛn no wɔ hɔ nda apem ahaenu eduosia.
title: REVELATION

text: Na akodzi baa sor: Maekɛl nye n’abɔfoe nye sasabɔnsam no dzii ako, na sasabɔnsam nye n’abɔfoe no wɔkoe;
title: REVELATION

text: na woenntum hɔn, eso woennya tsenabea wɔ sor bio.
title: REVELATION

text: Na sasabɔnsam kokroko no, ɔwɔ dadaw no a wɔfrɛ no Abɔnsam nye Satan no, wiadze nyina daadaafo no, wɔtoow no kyeen asaase do, na wɔtoow n’abɔfoe kaa no ho gui.
title: REVELATION

text: Na metsee ndze kɛse bi wɔ sor dɛ, Afei na hɛn Nyankopɔn nkwagye, nye ahoɔdzen, nye ahendzi nye ne Kraest no tumdzi no aba: osiandɛ wɔatow hɛn nuanom hɔn toafo no akyen, ɔno a ɔtoatoa hɔn wɔ hɛn Nyankopɔn enyim adzekyee nye adzesaa no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔnam Eguambaa bɔgyaa, nye hɔn dasesɛm do dzii konyim; osiandɛ wɔanndɔ hɔn nkwa araa dze kodur wu mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Dɛm ntsi hom sorsor, nye hom a hom tsetse no mu no, hom ndzi dɛw. Na asaase nye po ndue: osiandɛ abɔnsam dze ebufuw kɛse esian aba hom nkyɛn, osiandɛ onyim dɛ ne ber a ɔwɔ yɛ tsia.
title: REVELATION

text: Na sasabɔnsam no hun dɛ wɔatow no akyen asaase do no, ɔtaa ɔbaa no a ɔwoo ɔbabanyin no do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔdze ɔkorpɔn ne ntsaban ebien no maa ɔbaa no, dɛ ɔmfa ntu nkɔ ne tsenabea wɔ sar no do, mbrɛ wɔbɛmema no ber tsia, nye mber, nye ber fa, efi ɔwɔ no enyim.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔwɔ no puuw n’anomu nsu dɛ esutsen guu ɔbaa no ekyir, dɛ ɔbɛma esu no afa no akɔ.
title: REVELATION

text: Naaso asaase boaa ɔbaa no, na asaase buee n’anomu na ɔmeen esutsen no a sasabɔnsam no puwii fii n’anomu no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na sasabɔnsam no bo fuuw ɔbaa no; na okotuu n’asefo nkaa a wosie Nyankopɔn ahyɛdze, na wokitsa Jesus dasedzi mu no hɔn do sa. Na okegyinaa mpoano anhwea do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun abowa bi dɛ ofi po mu reba a ɔwɔ mmbɛn du nye etsir esuon, na ahenkyɛw du soso ne mmbɛn, na mbusudzin wowɔ n’etsir do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na abowa no a muhun no no tse dɛ ɔsebɔ, na ne nan tse dɛ sisi, na n’ano tse dɛ gyata: na sasabɔnsam no dze n’ahoɔdzen, nye n’ahengua, nye no tum kɛse maa no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun n’etsir no mu kor tse dɛ wɔabɔ no ɔbɔkum; na wɔayɛ no bɔkum pira no edur: na abowa no ho yɛɛ wiadzefo nyina nwanwa, ma wodzii n’ekyir.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔkotowee sɔɔr sasabɔnsam no, osiandɛ ɔdze no tum ama abowa no, na wɔkotowee sɔɔr abowa no see dɛ, Woana nye abowa no sɛ? Na woana botum nye no edzi ako?
title: REVELATION

text: Wɔmaa no ano a ɔka nsɛnkɛse nye ebususɛm; na wɔmaa no kwan dɛ ondzi tum abosoom eduanan ebien.
title: REVELATION

text: Na obuee n’ano kaa ebususɛm tsiaa Nyankopɔn, dɛ ɔbɛka ne dzin, nye ne ntamadan, mekyerɛ hɔn a wɔtsetse sor noho no ebususɛm.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔmaa no ho kwan dɛ ɔnye ahotseweefo no ndzi ako, na ondzi hɔn do konyim: na wɔmaa no tum wɔ mbusuakuw nye nkorɔfo, nye kasa nye amanaman nyina do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na hɔn a wɔtsetse asaase do nyina bɔkotow no, hɔn a wɔannkyerɛw hɔn edzin wɔ Eguambaa no a wofi wiadze ahyɛse kum no no ne nkwa nwoma no mu no.
title: REVELATION

text: Sɛ obi wɔ aso a, wɔmma ontsie.
title: REVELATION

text: Sɛ wɔfa obi kɔ ndɔmmum a, ndɔmmum na ɔbɔkɔ: sɛ obi dze afona ku a, afona na wɔdze boku no. Ha na ahotseweefo abotar nye gyedzi wɔ.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun abowa bi so dɛ ofi asaase mu rupue; na ɔwɔ mmbɛn ebien dɛ eguambaa, na ɔkasaa dɛ sasabɔnsam.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔdze abowa a odzi kan no no tum nyina wɔ n’enyim. Na ɔmaa asaase nye hɔn a wɔtsetse do kotoow abowa a odzi kan no a wɔyɛɛ no bɔkum pira edur no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze akɛse dɛ ɔma ogya mpo fi sor ba asaase do wɔ nyimpa enyim.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔdaadaa hɔn a wɔtsetse asaase do, wɔ nsɛnkyerɛdze a wɔdze maa no dɛ ɔnyɛ wɔ abowa no enyim ntsi; ɔkaa dɛ wɔnyɛ abowa no a afona piraa no, na ɔtse ase no no honyi.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔdze maa no dɛ ɔmfa ahom mma abowa no no honyi no, ama abowa no no honyi no aakasa, na ɔmma wonku dodow a wɔnnkɔkotow abowa no no honyi no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔma wɔhyɛ, nkakraba nye akɛse, ahonyafo nye ehiafo, adehye nye nkowaa nsew wɔ hɔn nsa nyimfa, nye hɔn momapɔw do;
title: REVELATION

text: na eso dɛ obi nntum nntɔ anaa ɔnntɔn, gyedɛ nyia ɔwɔ nsewhyɛ no, anaa abowa no ne dzin nkanee nko.
title: REVELATION

text: Ha na nyansa wɔ. Obi a ɔwɔ ntseasee, wɔmma ɔnkan abowa no ne nkanee dodow; na ɔyɛ nyimpa bi ne nkanee: na ne nkanee si ahaesia eduosia esia.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mohwɛe, na muhun dɛ Eguambaa no gyina Zion bepɔw do, na mpem ɔha eduanan anan ka no ho a wɔakyerɛw ne dzin, nye Egya no ne dzin, wɔ hɔn momapɔw do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na metsee ndze fi sor dɛ esu pii nye senaman kɛse bi ndze: na ndze no a metsee no tse dɛ asankubɔfo a wɔrobɔ hɔn nsanku:
title: REVELATION

text: na wɔtoow ndwom fofor bi wɔ ahengua no nye atseasefo baanan no enyim: na obiara enntum ennsua ndwom no tow, gyedɛ mpem ɔha eduanan anan a wɔpoon hɔn fii asaase do no nko.
title: REVELATION

text: Iyinom nye hɔn a wɔammfa mbasiafo enngu hɔn ho fi, na wɔyɛ mbabun. Iyinom nye hɔn a wodzi Eguambaa no ekyir wɔ beebiara a ɔkɔ. Iyinom na wɔpoon hɔn fii nyimpa mu yɛɛ aba a odzi kan maa Nyankopɔn nye Eguambaa no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na woennhu ator bi wɔ hɔn anomu: na eso wonndzi dzɛm bi.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun ɔbɔfo bi so a orutu nam ɔsor finimfin a okitsa onnyiewiei asɛmpa bi rekɛka akyerɛ hɔn a wɔtsetse asaase do, amanaman nye mbusuakuw nye kasa nye nkorɔfo;
title: REVELATION

text: na ɔdze ndze kɛse kaa dɛ, Hom nsuro Nyankopɔn, na hom nhyɛ no enyimnyam; na n’atsɛmbu dɔn no edu: na hom nkotow nyia ɔbɔɔ ɔsor nye asaase nye po nye nsunyiwa no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo bi so a otsia ebien dzi ekyir see dɛ, Babilɔn kɛse no ahwe ase, ahwe ase, dza ɔama amanaman nyina anom no ndwamanyɛ ebufuw wenyin no bi no a.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo bi so a otsia ebiasa dzi hɔn ekyir, dze ndze kɛse see dɛ, Sɛ obiara kotow abowa no nye no honyi, na ɔgye ne nsewhyɛ wɔ no momapɔw anaa ne nsa do a,
title: REVELATION

text: ɔno na ɔbɔnom Nyankopɔn ebufuw wenyin a wosiesie no gyenengyenen gu n’ebufuw kɔɔpow mu no bi; na wɔbɛyɛ hɔn ayakayakadze, wɔ ogya nye sɔɔfee mu, wɔ abɔfo krɔnkrɔn no nye Eguambaa no enyim:
title: REVELATION

text: na hɔn ayakayakadze wusiw bɔfow sor mbersantsen mfesantsen; na hɔn a wɔkotow abowa no nye no honyi nye obiara a ɔgye ne dzin nsewhyɛ no, wonnyi ahomgye adzekyee nye adzesaa.
title: REVELATION

text: Ha na ahotseweefo abotar wɔ, hɔn a wosie Nyankopɔn ahyɛdze nye Jesus gyedzi no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na metsee ndze bi fi sor see me dɛ, Kyerɛw, Ofitsi ndɛ kɔ yi, nhyira nye ewufo a wowu Ewuradze mu; nyew, Sunsum no na ɔse, ama wɔaahom efi hɔn berɛ mu; na hɔn ndwuma dzi hɔn ekyir.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mohwɛe, na hwɛ, nsuwusiw fitaa, na obi a ɔtse dɛ nyimpa ba tse nsuwusiw no do a sika ahenkyɛw wɔ n’etsifi, na kantankrankye ndam ndam kitsa ne nsamu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo bi so fi asɔrdan no mu puei dze ndze kɛse tseaa mu kyerɛɛ nyia ɔtse nsuwusiw no do no dɛ, Tow wo kantankrankye twitwa: na otwaber edu; na asaase do ndɔbaa eguan.
title: REVELATION

text: Na nyia ɔtse nsuwusiw do no dze ne kantankrankye toow asaase do; na wotwitwaa asaase do ekuadze.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo kɛse bi so fi sor asɔrdan no mu, na no so kitsa kantankrankye ndam ndam.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo bi so a ɔwɔ gya do tum fi afɔrmbukyia no no mu bae; na ɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu frɛɛ nyia okitsa kantankrankye ndam ndam no dɛ, Tow wo kantankrankye ndam ndam twitwa asaase wenyinaba nsiawnsiaw no; na ne wenyinaba ewie ber.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo no dze ne kantankrankye toow asaase do, na otwitwaa asaase do wenyinaba na ɔdze guu Nyankopɔn ebufuw wenyintwer kɛse no mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wotsiatsiaa twer no do wɔ kurow no ekyir, na bɔgya fi wenyintwer no mu kaa mpɔnkɔ no hɔn menyiamfrɛ no mpo pemee kodur akwansimba apem ahaesia.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun asɛnkyerɛdze bi so a ɔso na ɔyɛ nwanwa wɔ sor, abɔfo beesuon a wokitsa mbusuhaw esuon a odzi ewiei na hɔn mu na Nyankopɔn ebufuw hyɛ ma.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun biribi a ɔtse dɛ ahwehwɛ po a ogya fora mu, na hɔn a wodzii abowa no nye no honyi, nye ne nsewhyɛ, nye ne dzin nkanee ho konyim no gyinagyina ahwehwɛ po no ho kitsakitsa Nyankopɔn nsanku.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔtow Nyankopɔn n’akowaa Moses ndwom no, nye Eguambaa no ndwom, dɛ, Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, adze nyina do tumfo wo ndwuma yɛ akɛse na ɔyɛ nwanwa; amanaman Hen! W’akwan tsen na ɔyɛ nokwar.
title: REVELATION

text: Ewuradze, woana na onnkosuro, na ɔnnkɛhyɛ wo dzin enyimnyam? Osiandɛ wo nko na eyɛ krɔnkrɔn. Amanaman nyina bɛba abɔkotow w’enyim; osiandɛ wo ndzeyɛtsenenee ada edzi.
title: REVELATION

text: Na iyi ekyir no mohwɛe, na hwɛ, woebue adasedzi ntamadan asɔrdan no wɔ sor:
title: REVELATION

text: na abɔfo beesuon a wokitsa mbusuhaw esuon fi asɔrdan no mu pueii, wɔhyehyɛ ndwera fitafita a ɔhyerɛn dɛhyɛdɛhyɛ, na wɔdze sika abɔdo abobɔ hɔn koko.
title: REVELATION

text: Na atseasefo baanan no mu baako maa abɔfo beesuon no sika nkɔɔpow esuon a wɔdze Nyankopɔn a ɔtse ase mbersantsen mfesantsen no n’ebufuw ahyɛ mu ma.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wusiw a ofi Nyankopɔn enyimnyam mu nye no tum mu hyɛɛ asɔrdan no ma; na obi enntum annhɛn asɔrdan no mu dze kesii dɛ woewie abɔfo beesuon no hɔn mbusuhaw esuon no ansaana.
title: REVELATION

text: Na metsee ndze kɛse bi a ofi asɔrdan no mu rese abɔfo beesuon no dɛ, Hom nkɔ nkohue Nyankopɔn n’ebufuw nkɔɔpow esuon no ngu asaase do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na dza odzi kan no kɔree kohuee no kɔɔpow guu asaase do, na ɔdaan kur mpɔtɔwee a ɔyɛ yaw wɔ nyimpa a wɔwɔ abowa no ne nsewhyɛ, na wɔkotoow no honyi no do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na dza otsia ebien no huee no kɔɔpow guu po mu, na ɔdaan dɛ owufo bɔgyaa; na dza ɔwɔ po no mu a ɔtse ase biara wui.
title: REVELATION

text: Na dza otsia ebiasa no huee no kɔɔpow guu esutsen nye nsunyiwa do, na ɔdaan bɔgya.
title: REVELATION

text: Na metsee dɛ esu bɔfo no rese dɛ, Ɔtseneneenyi nye ɔwo a ewɔ hɔ, na ewɔ hɔ dada, ɔwo Krɔnkrɔnnyi, dɛ ebu atsɛn dɛm:
title: REVELATION

text: osiandɛ wohuee ahotseweefo nye nkɔnhyɛfo no bɔgyaa gui, na ama hɔn bɔgya dɛ wɔnnom: Dɛm na ɔfata hɔn!
title: REVELATION

text: Na metsee ndze bi so fi afɔrmbukyia no mu se dɛ, Nyew, Ewuradze, Otumfo Nyankopɔn, w’atsɛmbu yɛ nokwar nye tsenenee.
title: REVELATION

text: Na dza otsia anan no huee no kɔɔpow guu ewia do; na wɔmaa no ahoɔdzen dɛ ɔmfa gya nhyehye nyimpa.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔdze ɔhyew kɛse hyehyee nyimpa: na wɔkaa Nyankopɔn a ɔwɔ tum wɔ dɛm mbusuhaw yi do no ne dzin ho ebususɛm na woennu hɔnho annhyɛ no enyimnyam.
title: REVELATION

text: Na dza otsia enum no huee no kɔɔpow guu abowa no n’ahengua no do; na n’ahenman yɛɛ sum; na ɔyaw no ntsi wɔkekaa hɔn tɛkyerɛma,
title: REVELATION

text: na wɔkaa sor Nyankopɔn ho ebususɛm, wɔ hɔn yaw nye hɔn ekur no ntsi; na woennu hɔnho emmfi hɔn ndwuma mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na dza otsia esia no huee no kɔɔpow guu esutsen kɛse Eufrates mu; na no mu nsu wewee, ama woeesiesie kwan ama ahemfo a wofi wipuei no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun esunsum fi ebiasa a wɔtse dɛ ntwɛr fi sasabɔnsam no anomu, nye abowa no anomu, nye nkɔnhyɛnyi torfo no anomu:
title: REVELATION

text: na wɔyɛ mbɔnsam esunsum a wɔyɛ nsɛnkyerɛdze, na wopue kɔ wiadze nyina ahemfo hɔ, kɔboaboa hɔn ano ma Nyankopɔn, adze nyina do Tumfo, ne da kɛse ko no.
title: REVELATION

text: (Hwɛ, mereba dɛ owifo. Nhyira nye onyia ɔweɔn, na osie ne ntar, amma ɔaanantsew adagyaw mu na woeennhu n’ahoto.)
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔboaboaa hɔn ano kɔr beebi a wɔfrɛ no Hebriw kasa mu Harmagedon.
title: REVELATION

text: Na dza otsia esuon no huee no kɔɔpow guu ehum enyi; na ndze kɛse bi fi asɔrdan no mu ahengua no do bae dɛ, Woewie!
title: REVELATION

text: Na enyinam, nye ndze, nye asenaman bae; na asaasewosow kɛse bi bae a ofitsi ber a nyimpa baa asaase do wonnhun bi pɛn, asaasewosow kɛse a ɔyɛ dzen a.
title: REVELATION

text: Na kurow kɛse no mu paa afaafa ebiasa, na amanamamfo nkurow hwehwee ase: na wɔkaa Babilɔn kɛse no wɔ Nyankopɔn enyim, dɛ wɔbɛma no n’ebufuw a ɔyɛ hyew no no wenyin kɔɔpow.
title: REVELATION

text: Na nsupruw nyina guanguanee, na woennhu mbepɔw.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔsorbo a kor no dur bɛyɛ kyɛpɛn kɛse kor, fi sor bɔhwehwee nyimpa do: na nyimpa kasaa Nyankopɔn ho ebususɛm, wɔ ɔsorbo no ne haw ntsi: osiandɛ ne haw no so kɛse.
title: REVELATION

text: Na abɔfo beesuon no a wokitsakitsa nkɔɔpow esuon no mu baako bae nye me bɛkasae, dɛ, Bra ha, ma menkyerɛ wo edwaman kɛse no a ɔtse esu pii do no n’atsɛmbu.
title: REVELATION

text: Ɔno na asaase do ahemfo nye no agor ndwamangor, na no ndwaman wenyin abobow hɔn a wɔtsetse asaase do no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔdze me nam Sunsum mu kɔr sar do: na muhun ɔbaa bi a ɔtse abowa memen bi do, na ebususɛm edzin ahyɛ no ma, na ɔwɔ etsir esuon nye mmbɛn du.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbaa no hyɛ atar serdaa nye memen, na wɔahyehyɛ no sika nye aboɔdzen bo, nye ahondze pa, na okitsa sika kɔɔpow a ekyiwadze nye no ndwamanyɛ fi ahyɛ no ma,
title: REVELATION

text: na wɔakyerɛw dzin bi wɔ no momapɔw do dɛ, ESUMASƐM, BABILƆN KƐSE, NDWAMAN NYE ASAASE DO EKYIWADZE NE NA.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun ɔbaa no dɛ ahotseweefo no bɔgyaa nye Jesus atɔfo bɔgyaa abow no. Na muhunii no, ɔyɛɛ me nwanwa kɛse.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo no see me dɛ, Ebɛnadze ntsi na ɔyɛ wo nwanwa? Mebɛka wo ɔbaa no nye abowa a ɔso no a ɔwɔ etsir esuon nye mmbɛn du no ho esumasɛm no.
title: REVELATION

text: Abowa no a ihunii no, nkyɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, naaso onnyi hɔ, na oribefi bun no mu aba, na ɔakɔ ɔsɛɛ mu. Na ɔbɛyɛ hɔn a wɔtsetse asaase a woemmfi wiadze ahyɛse annkyerɛw hɔn edzin wɔ nkwa nwoma no mu no nwanwa, dɛ wobohu abowa no a nkyɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na onnyi hɔ, na ɔbɛba no.
title: REVELATION

text: Eha na adwen a ɔwɔ nyansa wɔ. Etsir esuon no yɛ mbepɔw esuon a ɔbaa no tse do:
title: REVELATION

text: na wɔyɛ ahemfo esuon; na beenum ahwe ase, na ɔbaako wɔ hɔ, na ɔbaako no so nnyae mmbae; na sɛ ɔba a, otwar dɛ ɔtsena hɔ kakraabi.
title: REVELATION

text: Na abowa no a nkyɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, naaso onnyi hɔ no, ɔnoara nye nyia otsia awɔtwe, na ofi esuon no mu, na ɔrokɔ ɔsɛɛ mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mmbɛn du no a ihunii no, wɔyɛ ahemfo du a wonnyae nnyaa ahendzi; naaso wɔnye abowa no nya tum dɛ ahemfo dɔnhwer kor.
title: REVELATION

text: Iyinom wɔ adwenkor, na wɔdze hɔn tum nye ahoɔdzen ma abowa no.
title: REVELATION

text: Iyinom na wɔnye Eguambaa no bedzi ako, na Eguambaa no bedzi hɔn do konyim, osiandɛ ɔno nye ewuranom Wura, nye ahemfo Hen; na hɔn a wɔafrɛ hɔn, wɔapa hɔn, na wodzi nokwar, na wɔka no ho.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Esu no a ihun dɛ ɔbaa no tse do no yɛ nkorɔfo nye nyimpadodow, nye aman, nye kasa.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mmbɛn du no a ihunii no, nye abowa no, hɔn na wobekyir edwaman no, na wɔato no seraha, na wɔato no etumpan, na woedzi ne nam, na wɔdze ogya ahyew no koraa.
title: REVELATION

text: Na Nyankopɔn dze hyɛɛ hɔn akoma mu dɛ wɔnyɛ ne tsirmsɛm, na wɔnyɛ adwenkor, na wɔmfa hɔn ahenman mma abowa no nkesi dɛ Nyankopɔn asɛm no bɛba mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbaa no a ihun no no, nye kurow kɛse no a odzi hen wɔ asaase ahemfo do no.
title: REVELATION

text: Iyinom ekyir no, muhun ɔbɔfo bi so a ofi sor risian ba a ɔwɔ tum kɛse; na n’enyimnyam hyerɛɛn asaase do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔdze ndze a ɔyɛ dzen tseaa mu dɛ, Ɔahwe ase, Babilɔn kɛse no ahwe ase, na adan mbɔnsam tsenabea, nye sunsum fi nyina atsɛwee, nye nnoma a hɔn ho nntsew na wokyir hɔn nyina atsɛwee.
title: REVELATION

text: Osiandɛ amanaman nyina anom ne ndwamanyɛ ebufuw wenyin no bi; na asaase do ahemfo nye no agor ndwamangor, na wiadze eguadzifo nam n’adɔkɔdɔkɔdzepɛ ahoɔdzen do enya hɔnho.
title: REVELATION

text: Na metsee dɛ ndze fofor bi so fi sor rese dɛ, Me man, hom mfi no mu mfi, amma hom aammfora no bɔn, na hom nsa aannka no mbusuhaw no bi:
title: REVELATION

text: osiandɛ ne ndzeyɛbɔn atsen ekodu sor mpo, na Nyankopɔn akaa n’emumuyɛ.
title: REVELATION

text: Hom ntua no kaw dɛ mbrɛ otuae, hom mfa mbɔho ebien mma no dɛ mbrɛ no ndwuma tse: kɔɔpow a ɔforae no, hom mmfora no mbɔho ebien mma no.
title: REVELATION

text: Dodow a ɔhyehyɛɛ noho na ɔyɛɛ adɔkɔdɔkɔdzepɛ no, hom mma no ɔhaw nye awerɛhow dɛmara. Osiandɛ ɔka wɔ n’akoma mu dɛ, Metse hɔ dɛ ɔhembaa, mennyɛ okunafo, na murunnhu awerɛhow ara da.
title: REVELATION

text: Dɛm ntsi no mbusuhaw bɛba da kor mu, owu nye awerɛhow nye ɔkɔm; na wɔdze gya bɛhyew no koraa, osiandɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn a obu no atsɛn no ɔyɛ otumfo.
title: REVELATION

text: Na asaase do ahemfo a wɔnye no bɔɔ edwaman na wɔnye no tsenaa adɔkɔdɔkɔdzepɛ mu no, sɛ wohu ne nhyewee no wusiw a, wobosu aka mmɔn
title: REVELATION

text: egyinagyina ekyir wɔ no mbusuhaw no hu ntsi, dɛ, Due, due, kurow kɛse Babilɔn, kurow a ɔyɛ dzen! Osiandɛ dɔnhwer kor mu na w’atsɛmbu aba.
title: REVELATION

text: Na asaase do eguadzifo su no dzi no nkɔmbɔ, osiandɛ obi nntɔ hɔn eguadze bio;
title: REVELATION

text: sika, nye dwetɛ, nye aboɔdzen bo nye ahondze pa, nye ndwera fɛɛfɛw, nye serdaa tam; nye serekye, nye memen; nye ndua a ɔyɛ huam nyina, nye asombɛn edwindze nyina, nye ndwindze a wɔdze ndua a ɔsom bo, nye ayewa, nye dadze, nye ɔbohɛn ayɛ nyina;
title: REVELATION

text: nye nhwentsea nye mpɛpɛrwa, nye nduhuam, nye nseradze, nye krɔbɔw, nye wenyin, nye ngo, nye isiam fekɔɔ, nye ewifua, nye nyɛmbowa, nye nguan, nye mpɔnkɔ, nye ntseaseanam, nye ndɔnkɔfo, nye nyimpa akra.
title: REVELATION

text: Na nduaba a wo kra kɔn dɔe no efi wo nkyɛn, na w’anomudɛdze nye wo ndzepa efi wo nkyɛn abɔ wo, na wonnkohu no bio koraa!
title: REVELATION

text: Na ndzɛmba yi ho eguadzifo a ɔmaa wonyaa hɔnho no begyinagyina ekyir wɔ ne haw no hu ntsi, na woesu na woedzi nkɔmbɔ dɛ:
title: REVELATION

text: Due, due, kurow kɛse a ofuraa ndwera pa, nye serdaa nye memen, na ɔhyehyɛ sika nye aboɔdzen bo, nye ahondze pa!
title: REVELATION

text: Osiandɛ dɔnhwer kor pɛr mu na dɛm ahonya kɛse yi ayɛ amamfo. Na hɛnwura biara nye hɔn a wɔnam hɛn mu kɔ beebi nyina, nye hɛnmufo, nye dodow a wɔyɛ po do edwuma, gyinagyinaa ekyirekyir,
title: REVELATION

text: na wohun ne nhyewee no wusiw no, wɔtseaa mu dɛ, Ebɛn kurow nna ɔtse dɛ kurow kɛse yi?
title: REVELATION

text: Na wotuu dɛtse guu hɔn etsifi, na wɔdze osu nye nkɔmbɔdzi tseaa mu dɛ, Due, due, kurow kɛse a w’aboɔdzendze ntsi hɔn a wɔwɔ hɛn wɔ po do nyina enyinya hɔnho wɔ mu! Osiandɛ dɔnhwer kor pɛr mu na wɔayɛ no amamfo.
title: REVELATION

text: Ao Ɔsor, dzi no eduwa, nye hom ahotseweefo, nye asomafo, nye nkɔnhyɛfo; osiandɛ Nyankopɔn ebu no atsɛn ama hom.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔbɔfo baako hoɔdzenfo bi maa ɔbo a ɔtse dɛ ewuyambo kɛse bi do, na ɔtowee kyeen po mu, kaa dɛ, Mbrɛ wobesi atow Babilɔn, kurow kɛse no akyen hwii nye no, na worunnhu no bio koraa.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔrenntse asankubɔfo, nye ndwontofo, nye mbɛnhɛmfo, nye totorobɛntohɛmfo ndze wɔ wo mu bio; na worunnhu edwindzi biara ho dwimfo wɔ wo mu bio; na wɔrenntse ewuyambo nka wɔ wo mu bio;
title: REVELATION

text: na kandzea ne kan rennhyerɛn wɔ wo mu bio, na wɔnnkɛtse ayeforkun nye ayefor ndze wɔ wo mu bio: w’eguadzifo yɛɛ asaase do ahemfo; osiandɛ edze w’ator nkongyaa daadaa aman nyina.
title: REVELATION

text: Na no mu na wohun nkɔnhyɛfo, nye ahotseweefo, nye hɔn a woeku hɔn asaase do nyina hɔn bɔgyaa.
title: REVELATION

text: Iyinom ekyir no metsee biribi tse dɛ nyimpadodow ndze kɛse wɔ sor dɛ, Alleluia! Nkwagye, nye enyimnyam, nye tum yɛ hɛn Nyankopɔn dze:
title: REVELATION

text: osiandɛ n’atsɛmbu yɛ nokwar na ɔtsen; na oebu edwaman kɛse no a ɔdze no ndwamanyɛ asɛɛ asaase no atsɛn, na oedzi no nkowaa bɔgyaa ho wer wɔ ne nsamu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔsee bio dɛ, Alleluia! Na no wusiw fow sor mbersantsen mfesantsen.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mpanyimfo eduonu anan no nye atseasefo baanan no hwee ase kotoow Nyankopɔn a ɔtse ahengua no no do no dɛ, Amen. Alleluia!
title: REVELATION

text: Na ndze bi fi ahengua no no mu see dɛ, Hom nyi hɛn Nyankopɔn ayɛw, hom a hom yɛ no nkowaa, nye hom a hom suro no nyina, akɛse nye nkakraba.
title: REVELATION

text: Na metsee biribi dɛ nyimpadodow kɛse ndze, nye esu pii ndze, nye asenaman pii a ɔyɛ dzen ndze, dɛ, Alleluia! Osiandɛ Ewuradze hɛn Nyankopɔn, adze nyina do Tumfo no, dzi hen.
title: REVELATION

text: Hom mma yendzi dɛw na hɛn enyi ngye mbordo, na yɛnhyɛ no enyimnyam, na Eguambaa no n’ayeforhyia no edu, na ne yer esiesie noho.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔdze ndwera fɛɛfɛw a ɔhoa fitaa maa no dɛ omfura: na ndwera fɛɛfɛw no nye ahotseweefo no ndzeyɛtsenenee.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Kyerɛw, Nhyira nye hɔn a woehyia hɔn Eguambaa no n’ayeforase. Na ɔsee me dɛ, Iyinom yɛ Nyankopɔn nsɛm a ɔyɛ nokwar.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mohwee ase wɔ n’ananadze dɛ morokotow no. Na ɔsee me dɛ, Hwɛ, mma nnyɛ dɛm: meyɛ w’ewurakowaa nye wo nuanom a wokitsa Jesus dasedzi mu no bi. Kotow Nyankopɔn: na Jesus dasedzi nye nkɔnhyɛ sunsum no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun dɛ sor ebue; na hwɛ, ɔpɔnkɔ fufuw bi, na nyia ɔtse no do no, wɔfrɛ no Kantamanto nye Nokwafo; na obu atsɛn na odzi ako wɔ nokwar mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na n’enyiwa tse dɛ gyaframee, na nhenkyɛw pii soso n’etsifi, na wɔakyerɛw ne dzin bi a obiara nnyim dɛ ɔno nko,
title: REVELATION

text: na ɔhyɛ atar bi a wɔdze abɔ bɔgya mu: na ne dzin dze Nyankopɔn Asɛm.
title: REVELATION

text: Na dɔm a wɔwɔ sor tsetse mpɔnkɔ efufuw do dzi n’ekyir, hyehyɛ ndwera pa a ɔhoa fitaa.
title: REVELATION

text: Na afona ndam ndam fi n’anomu pue a ɔdze rubotwitwa amanaman: na ɔdze dadze poma bɔhwɛ hɔn do: na ɔno na otsiatsia Nyankopɔn, adze nyina do Tumfo no n’ebufuhyew wenyintwer no do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔwɔ dzin bi a wɔakyerɛw no ne ntar do nye n’aserɛ do dɛ, AHEMFO HEN, NYE EWURANOM EWURADZE.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun ɔbɔfo baako a ogyina ewia mu; na ɔdze ndze kɛse tseaa mu see nnoma a wotu nam sor finimfin no nyina dɛ, Hom mbra mbehyia Nyankopɔn edzidzi kɛse no ase;
title: REVELATION

text: na hom mbedzi ahemfo nam, nye asafohemfo nam, nye ahoɔdzenfo nam, nye mpɔnkɔ nye hɔn a wɔtsetse do hɔn nam, nye nyimpa nyinara hɔn nam, adehye nye nkowaa, akɛse nye nkakraba.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun dɛ abowa no, nye asaase do ahemfo, nye hɔn dɔm, aboaboa hɔn ano dɛ wɔnye nyia ɔtse ɔpɔnkɔ no do nye no dɔm ribedzi ako.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔkyeer abowa no, nye nkɔnhyɛnyi torfo no a ɔyɛɛ n’enyim nsɛnkyerɛdze dze daadaa hɔn a wɔgyee abowa no ne nsewhyɛ no, nye hɔn a wɔkotoow no honyi: na wɔtoow hɔn beenu enyimon guu ogya nsutaae a sɔɔfee dzɛw mu no mu:
title: REVELATION

text: na nkaa no wɔdze nyia ɔtse pɔnkɔ no do n’afona a ofi n’anomu no kunkum hɔn, na nnoma no nyina dzii hɔn nam mee.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun ɔbɔfo bi dɛ ofi sor risian a okitsa bun no ne saafee na nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn kɛse wɔ ne nsamu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔkyeer sasabɔnsam no, ɔwɔ dadaw no a ɔno nye Abɔnsam nye Satan no, na ɔkyekyeer no mfe apem,
title: REVELATION

text: na ɔtoow no kyeen bun no mu, na ɔtoow no mu, na ɔsɔɔw ano wɔ no do, amma ɔaannkɛdaadaa amanaman no bio, gyedɛ mfe apem no aso ana: na ɔno ekyir otwar dɛ wɔsan no mber kakra.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun nhengua, na wɔtsenatsenaa do, na wɔdze atsɛmbu maa hɔn: na muhun hɔn a Jesus dasedzi, nye Nyankopɔn asɛm ntsi wotwitwaa hɔn etsir no hɔn akra, nye hɔn a wɔannkotow abowa no, anaa no honyi, na wɔanngye nsewhyɛ no wɔ hɔn momapɔw nye hɔn nsa do no; na wɔtsenaa ase nye Kraest dzii hen mfe apem.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ewufo nkaa no dze, woennya nkwa bio dze kodur dɛ mfe apem no bowie du. Iyi nye owusoɛr a odzi kan no.
title: REVELATION

text: Nhyira nye krɔnkrɔn nye onyia no a onya kyɛfa wɔ owusoɛr a odzi kan no mu no: iyinom na owu mprɛnu no nnyi hɔn do tum; na wɔbɛyɛ Nyankopɔn nye Kraest asɔfo, na wɔnye no edzi hen mfe apem.
title: REVELATION

text: Na sɛ mfe apem no wie du a, wɔbɛsan Satan efi n’efiadze,
title: REVELATION

text: na obopue akɛdaadaa amanaman a wɔwɔ asaase mfɛndzanan no, Gog nye Magog, akɔboaboa hɔn ano akɔ sa: hɔn na hɔn dodow tse dɛ mpoano anhwea.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔfowee kegyinaa asaase tɛtɛr do, na wokotwaa ahotseweefo nseraban nye kurow a wɔdɔ no no ho hyiae: na ogya fi sor wɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn bɛhyeew hɔn.
title: REVELATION
