text: Na abɔnsam a ɔdaadaa hɔn no, wɔtoow no kyeen gya nye sɔɔfee nsutaae no mu, hɔ na abowa no nye nkɔnhyɛnyi torfo no so wɔ; na wɔbɛyɛ hɔn ayaayaadze adzekyee nye adzesaa mbersantsen mfesantsen.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun ahengua fufuw kokroko, nye nyia ɔtse do no a asaase nye ɔsor fii n’enyim guanee; na woennya beebi amma hɔn no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun ewufo, nkakraba nye akɛse, dɛ wogyinagyina ahengua no enyim; na woebuebue nwoma mu: na woebue nwoma bi so a ɔyɛ nkwa nwoma no mu: na wɔnam dza wɔakyerɛw wɔ nwoma no mu no do buu ewufo no atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndwuma tse.
title: REVELATION

text: Na po yii ewufo a wɔwɔ no mu mae; na owu nye samanadze yii ewufo a wɔwɔ hɔn mu mae, na wobuu hɔn mu biara atsɛn dɛ mbrɛ hɔn ndwuma tse.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔtoow owu nye samanadze guu ogya nsutaae no mu. Iyi nye owu mprɛnu no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na obiara a woennhu dɛ wɔakyerɛw ne dzin wɔ nkwa nwoma no mu no, wɔtoow no kyeen ogya nsutaae no mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun sor fofor nye asaase fofor: na kan sor no, nye kan asaase no etwa mu kɔ; na po nnyi hɔ bio.
title: REVELATION

text: Na muhun kurow krɔnkrɔn, Jerusalɛm fofor no, dɛ ofi sor Nyankopɔn nkyɛn risian, woesiesie no dɛ ayefor a wɔahyehyɛ no ama no kun.
title: REVELATION

text: Na metsee ndze kɛse bi fi ahengua no mu see dɛ, Hwɛ, Nyankopɔn ntamadan wɔ nyimpa mu, na ɔbɛtsena mu wɔ hɔn mu, na wɔayɛ ne man, na Nyankopɔn nankasa nye hɔn bɛtsena, na ɔayɛ hɔn Nyankopɔn:
title: REVELATION

text: na ɔbɛpepa hɔn enyiwa mu nyinsuwa nyina; na owu nnyi hɔ bio; na awerɛhow, nye su, nye yaw bi nnyi hɔ bio: osiandɛ nkan no ndzɛmba no etwa mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na nyia ɔtse ahengua no do no see dɛ, Hwɛ, mereyɛ adze nyina fofor. Na ɔsee me dɛ, Kyerɛw: na nsɛm no yɛ ampa nye nokwar.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Ayɛ hɔ. Emi nye Alfa nye Omega, ahyɛse nye ewiei. Emi na medze nkwa nsubura no mu nsu mebɛkyɛ onyia nsukɔm dze no kwa.
title: REVELATION

text: Nyia odzi konyim no, obenya iyinom edzi; na mebɛyɛ ne Nyankopɔn, na ɔno so ayɛ me ba.
title: REVELATION

text: Na nkotoo, ekyingyefo, nye ekyiwadzeyɛfo, ewudzifo, nye ndwaman, nye abayifo, nye abosonsɔrfo, nye atorfo nyina dze, hɔn kyɛfa wɔ nsutaae a ogya nye sɔɔfee dzɛw mu no mu; ɔno nye owu mprɛnu no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na abɔfo beesuon a wokitsakitsa nkɔɔpow esuon no a wɔdze mbusuhaw esuon a odzi ekyir no ahyɛ mu no mu baako baa me nkyɛn nye me bɛkasaa dɛ, Bra ha, na menkyerɛ wo ayefor no, Eguambaa no ne yer no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔdze me nam Sunsum mu kɔr bepɔw kɛse tsentsen bi do, na ɔkyerɛɛ me kurow krɔnkrɔn Jerusalɛm, dɛ ofi sor Nyankopɔn nkyɛn risian.
title: REVELATION

text: Okitsa Nyankopɔn enyimnyam: ne kan tse dɛ ɔbo a ɔsom bo kɛse dze, dɛ ahwehwɛ bo a ɔtsew dɛ ahwehwɛ.
title: REVELATION

text: Ɔwɔ fasu kɛse tsentsen; ɔwɔ mbobow akɛse duebien, na mbobow no ano abɔfo duebien; na wɔakyerɛkyerɛw edzin a ɔyɛ Israel mbusuakuw duebien no edzin wowɔ do:
title: REVELATION

text: boka, mbobow ebiasa; kwaamu, mbobow ebiasa; pomu, mbobow ebiasa; anee, mbobow ebiasa.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔfasu no wɔ mfapem duebien, na Eguambaa no n’asomafo duebien no hɔn edzin duebien wowɔ do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na nyia ɔnye me kasae no kitsa susudua a ɔyɛ sika ndzɛmbir a ɔdze rubosusu kurow no, nye no mbobow, nye n’afasu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na kurow no da etwaanan, na ne tsentsen so dɛ ne tɛtɛr: na ɔdze ndzɛmbir no susuu kurow no akwansin apem ahaenum: ne tsentsen nye ne tɛtɛr nye no krɔn sɛ.
title: REVELATION

text: Na osusuu n’afasu no, basafa ɔha eduanan anan a ɔyɛ nyimpa no nsusui dɛ mbrɛ ɔbɔfo no dze no tse no ara.
title: REVELATION

text: Na dza wɔdze toow ne fasu nye ahwehwɛ bo: na kurow no yɛ sika mapa dɛ ahwehwɛ a ɔtsew.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔdze aboɔdzen bo ahorow nyina ahyehyɛ kurow no ne fasu fapem no: fapem a odzi kan yɛ ahwehwɛbo, otsia ebien yɛ hoabo, ebiasa yɛ aforaforabo, anan yɛ ahatawmomonbo,
title: REVELATION

text: otsia enum yɛ epopobibirbo, esia yɛ bɔgyanambo, esuon yɛ mununkumbo, awɔtwe yɛ sikabereebo, akron yɛ akratsebo, du yɛ dɛnkyɛmbo, dubiako yɛ ekutuhonbo na otsia duebien yɛ ɔberdumbo.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mbobow duebien no yɛ ahondze pa duebien; abobow kor wɔdze ahondze pa kor yɛe: na kurow no n’abrɔn yɛ sika mapa tse dɛ ahwehwɛ a ɔtsew.
title: REVELATION

text: Na mennhu asɔrdan wɔ mu: na Ewuradze Nyankopɔn, adze nyina do Tumfo no, nye Eguambaa no na wɔyɛ n’asɔrdan.
title: REVELATION

text: Na kurow no nnhia dɛ ewia anaa bosoom hyerɛn wɔ do: osiandɛ Nyankopɔn n’enyimnyam hyerɛɛn wɔ do, na ne nkandzea nye Eguambaa no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na amanaman bɛnantsew ne kan mu: na asaase ahemfo dze hɔn enyimnyam aba mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na wɔronntow kurow no mu adzekyee, (na adzesaa nnyi hɔ bio):
title: REVELATION

text: na wɔdze amanaman enyimnyam nye enyidzi bɛba mu:
title: REVELATION

text: na efifidze biara nye dza ɔyɛ ekyiwadze na odzi ator rennhɛn mu koraa: gyedɛ hɔn a wɔakyerɛw hɔn edzin wɔ Eguambaa no nkwa nwoma no mu no nko.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔkyerɛɛ me nkwa nsu esutsen krɔnkrɔn a n’enyi tsew dɛ ahwehwɛ a ofi Nyankopɔn nye Eguambaa no n’ahengua no mu,
title: REVELATION

text: ɔwɔ n’abɔntsen finimfin. Na esutsen n’afa ha na ha na nkwadua no wɔ a ɔsow eduaba horow duebien, na ɔsow aba bosoom nyina: na dua no n’ahaban wɔdze sa amanaman yarba.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ndom biara nnyi hɔ bio: na Nyankopɔn nye Eguambaa no hɔn ahengua besi mu: na no nkowaa bɔsom no:
title: REVELATION

text: na wobohu n’enyim; na ne dzin wɔ hɔn momapɔw do.
title: REVELATION

text: Na adzesaa nnyi hɔ bio: na wonnkehia kandzea anaa ewia ne kan; osiandɛ Ewuradze Nyankopɔn bɛhyerɛn hɔn do; na wobedzi hen mbersantsen mfesantsen.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Nsɛm yi yɛ ampa nye nokwar: na Ewuradze, nkɔnhyɛfo esunsum hɔn Nyankopɔn no, asoma no bɔfoe dɛ ɔmbɛkyerɛ n’akowaa dza otwar dɛ ɔba mu ntsɛm.
title: REVELATION

text: Na hwɛ, mereba ntsɛm: nhyira nye nyia osie nwoma yi mu nkɔnhyɛnsɛm no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na emi John nye nyia ɔtsee na ohun ndzɛmba yi. Na metsee na muhunii no, mohwee ase dɛ morokotow ɔbɔfo a ɔkyerɛɛ me ndzɛmba yi n’anan ase.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Mma nnyɛ dɛm: na meyɛ w’ewurakowaa nye wo nuanom nkɔnhyɛfo, nye hɔn a wosie nwoma yi mu nsɛm no dze: kotow sɔr Nyankopɔn.
title: REVELATION

text: Na ɔsee me dɛ, Mma nnsɔw nwoma yi mu nkɔnhyɛnsɛm no ano: na ber no edu.
title: REVELATION

text: Nyia ɔnntsen no, ɔnkɔ do araa nyɛ dza ɔnntsen: na nyia ɔyɛ fifi, ɔnda ho araa nyɛ fifi: na nyia ɔtsen no, ɔnkɔ do nyɛ dza ɔtsen: na nyia ɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn no, ɔnkɔ do nyɛ krɔnkrɔn.
title: REVELATION

text: Hwɛ, mereba ntsɛm: medze m’akatua dɛ medze rebɛma obiara dɛ mbrɛ no ndwuma tse.
title: REVELATION

text: Emi nye Alfa nye Omega, ɔkandzifo nye ekyidzifo no, ahyɛse nye ewiei no.
title: REVELATION

text: Nhyira nye hɔn a wɔhor hɔn ntar, ama woeenya nkwadua no ho kwan, na wɔaahɛn mbobow no mu akɔ kurow no mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Na n’ekyir na nkraman, nye esumantufo, nye ndwaman, nye ewudzifo, nye abosonsɔrfo, nye obiara a ɔpɛ na odzi ator no wɔ.
title: REVELATION

text: Emi, Jesus, na masoma mo bɔfoe dɛ ombedzi ndzɛmba yi ho dase nkyerɛ hom mma asɔr horow no. Emi na meyɛ David ndwow nye aba, adzekyee woraba a ɔhyerɛn no.
title: REVELATION

text: Na Sunsum nye ayefor no se, Bra. Na ma nyia ɔtse iyi no nse dɛ, Bra. Na ma nyia nsukɔm dze no no mbra: Obiara a ɔpɛ no, ɔmbra mbɛfa nkwa nsu no kwa.
title: REVELATION

text: Mobɔ obiara a ɔtse nwoma yi mu nkɔnhyɛnsɛm no kɔkɔ dɛ, Sɛ obiara dze bi ka ho a, Nyankopɔn dze mbusuhaw a wɔakyerɛw no nwoma yi mu no bi bɛka no ho:
title: REVELATION

text: na sɛ obiara yi nwoma yi mu nkɔnhyɛnsɛm no bi a, Nyankopɔn beyi ne kyɛfa efi nkwadua, nye kurow krɔnkrɔn a wɔakyerɛw no nwoma yi mu no mu.
title: REVELATION

text: Nyia odzi ndzɛmba yi ho dase no se, Ampaara: mereba ntsɛm. Amen. Ewuradze Jesus, bra!
title: REVELATION

text: Ewuradze Jesus adom no nye hom nyina ntsena. [Amen.]
title: REVELATION
